hausa: Amma suka tafi da sarkin Ai da rai suka kawo shi wurin Yoshuwa.
english: They captured the king of Ai alive, and brought him to Joshua.

hausa: Ka kasa kunne, ya Ubangiji, ka kuma ji; ka buɗe idanunka, ya Ubangiji, ka kuma gani; ka saurara ga dukan maganganun da Sennakerib ya aika don yă zagi Allah mai rai.
english: Turn your ear, Yahweh, and hear. Open your eyes, Yahweh, and behold. Hear all of the words of Sennacherib, who has sent to defy the living God.

hausa: Bai shiga ta wurin jinin awaki da na maruƙa ba; amma ya shiga Wuri Mafi Tsarki sau ɗaya tak ta wurin jininsa, bayan ya samo madawwamiyar fansa.
english: nor yet through the blood of goats and calves, but through his own blood, entered in once for all into the Holy Place, having obtained eternal redemption.

hausa: ’Yan kunne sun ƙara wa kumatunki kyau, wuyanki yana da jerin kayan wuya masu daraja.
english: Your cheeks are beautiful with earrings, your neck with strings of jewels.

hausa: Da jin wannan Ananiyas babban firist ya umarci waɗanda suke tsaye kusa da Bulus su buge bakinsa.
english: The high priest, Ananias, commanded those who stood by him to strike him on the mouth.

hausa: “Ka gaya musu cewa, ‘Ga abin da Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka yana cewa wannan za tă ci gaba? Ba za a tumɓuke ta a kuma kakkaɓe ’ya’yanta don ta bushe ba? Dukan sababbin tohonta za su bushe. Ba sai da hannu mai ƙarfi, ko kuwa da yawan mutane za a tumɓuke ta daga saiwoyinta ba.
english: “Say, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “Will it prosper? Won’t he pull up its roots and cut off its fruit, that it may wither, that all its fresh springing leaves may wither? It can’t be raised from its roots by a strong arm or many people.

hausa: In aka kama wani yana kwance da matar wani, dole a kashe dukansu biyu, wato, mutumin da ya kwana da matar da kuma matar. Dole a fid da mugu daga Isra’ila.
english: If a man is found lying with a woman married to a husband, then they shall both die, the man who lay with the woman and the woman. So you shall remove the evil from Israel.

hausa: Aka kira duk mazan Ai su fafare su, suka kuwa fafari Yoshuwa, aka yaudare su suka yi nisa da birnin.
english: All the people who were in the city were called together to pursue after them. They pursued Joshua, and were drawn away from the city.

hausa: Wuta ta cinye tentinsa; farar wuta ta rufe wurin da yake zama.
english: There will dwell in his tent that which is none of his. Sulfur will be scattered on his habitation.

hausa: Me nake gani? Sun tsorata, suna ja da baya, an ci jarumawansu. Suna gudu da sauri ba waiwayawa, akwai razana a kowane gefe,” in ji Ubangiji.
english: Why have I seen it? They are dismayed and are turned backward. Their mighty ones are beaten down, have fled in haste, and don’t look back. Terror is on every side,” says Yahweh.

hausa: a ɗaura su a kan ƙyallen kafaɗa efod a matsayin duwatsun tuni ga ’ya’yan Isra’ila. Haruna ne zai ɗauki sunayen a kafaɗarsa don tuni a gaban Ubangiji.
english: You shall put the two stones on the shoulder straps of the ephod, to be stones of memorial for the children of Israel. Aaron shall bear their names before Yahweh on his two shoulders for a memorial.

hausa: Sauran ayyukan mulkin Hezekiya da kuma kyawawa ayyukansa, suna a rubuce a cikin wahayin annabi Ishaya ɗan Amoz, a cikin littafin sarakunan Yahuda da Isra’ila.
english: Now the rest of the acts of Hezekiah and his good deeds, behold, they are written in the vision of Isaiah the prophet, the son of Amoz, in the book of the kings of Judah and Israel.

hausa: don a kāre su daga fāɗuwa cikin rami, a kāre su daga hallaka ta wurin takobi.
english: He keeps back his soul from the pit, and his life from perishing by the sword.

hausa: Ayyukan mugunta na mugun mutum tarko ne gare shi; igiyoyin zunubinsa za su daure shi kankan.
english: The evil deeds of the wicked ensnare him. The cords of his sin hold him firmly.

hausa: Kwanaki suna zuwa,’ in ji Ubangiji, ‘sa’ad da zan komo da mutanena Isra’ila da Yahuda daga bauta in kuma maido da su ga ƙasar da na ba wa kakanninsu mallaka,’ in ji Ubangiji.”
english: For, behold, the days come,’ says Yahweh, ‘that I will reverse the captivity of my people Israel and Judah,’ says Yahweh. ‘I will cause them to return to the land that I gave to their fathers, and they will possess it.’”

hausa: Sai Musa da dattawan Isra’ila suka koma sansani.
english: Moses went into the camp, he and the elders of Israel.

hausa: Ana nan sai Kayinu ya kawo waɗansu amfanin gona a matsayin hadaya ga Ubangiji.
english: As time passed, Cain brought an offering to Yahweh from the fruit of the ground.

hausa: Sai ya kwanta, ya miƙe kansa a kan yaron sau uku, ya kuma yi kuka ga Ubangiji ya ce, “Ya Ubangiji Allahna, ka mai da ran yaron nan!”
english: He stretched himself on the child three times, and cried to Yahweh and said, “Yahweh my God, please let this child’s soul come into him again.”

hausa: Amma in daga Allah ne, ba za ku iya hana waɗannan mutane ba, za ku dai sami kanku kuna gāba da Allah ne.”
english: But if it is of God, you will not be able to overthrow it, and you would be found even to be fighting against God!”

hausa: Gama sarkin Babilon zai tsaya a mararrabar hanya, a inda hanyar ta rabu biyu, don yă yi duba. Zai jefa ƙuri’a da kibiyoyinsa, zai nemi shawarar gumakansa, zai bincike hanta.
english: For the king of Babylon stood at the parting of the way, at the head of the two ways, to use divination. He shook the arrows back and forth. He consulted the teraphim. He looked in the liver.

hausa: Al’ummai za su ɗauke su su kuma kawo wurin da yake nasu. Gidan Isra’ila kuwa za tă mallaki al’ummai a matsayin bayi maza da mata a ƙasar Ubangiji. Za su mai da waɗanda suka kama su su zama kamammu su kuma yi mulki a kan waɗanda suka taɓa danne su.
english: The peoples will take them, and bring them to their place. The house of Israel will possess them in Yahweh’s land for servants and for handmaids. They will take as captives those whose captives they were; and they shall rule over their oppressors.

hausa: Da ɗan saƙon ya iso, sai aka ce wa Yehu, “Sun kawo kawunan ’ya’yan sarki.” Sai Yehu ya ce, “Ku ajiye su kashi biyu a ƙofar gari har safiya.”
english: A messenger came and told him, “They have brought the heads of the king’s sons.” He said, “Lay them in two heaps at the entrance of the gate until the morning.”

hausa: Amma sa’ad da mahukuncin ya mutu, mutanen suka koma hanyar da ta fi ta kakanninsu muni, sukan bi waɗansu alloli suna bauta musu. Suka ƙi barin mugun ayyukansu da taurin zuciyarsu.
english: But when the judge was dead, they turned back, and dealt more corruptly than their fathers in following other gods to serve them and to bow down to them. They didn’t cease what they were doing, or give up their stubborn ways.

hausa: Sa’an nan Mikahiya ya amsa, “Na ga dukan Isra’ila sun warwatsu a kan tuddai kamar tumakin da ba su da makiyaya, kuma Ubangiji ya ce, ‘Waɗannan mutane ba su da maigida. Bari kowanne yă tafi gida cikin salama.’ ”
english: He said, “I saw all Israel scattered on the mountains, as sheep that have no shepherd. Yahweh said, ‘These have no master. Let them each return to his house in peace.’”

hausa: Zan dami zukatan mutane masu yawa sa’ad da na kawo maka hallaka a cikin al’ummai, a cikin ƙasashen da ba ka taɓa sani ba.
english: “I will also trouble the hearts of many peoples, when I bring your destruction among the nations, into the countries which you have not known.

hausa: Amma a yanzu da aka ’yantar da ku daga zunubi kuka kuma zama bayi ga Allah, ribar da kuka samu tana kai ga zaman tsarki, ƙarshenta kuwa rai madawwami ne.
english: But now, being made free from sin and having become servants of God, you have your fruit of sanctification and the result of eternal life.

hausa: Za ka hallaka ’ya’yansu daga duniya, zuriyarsu kuma daga ’yan adam.
english: You will destroy their descendants from the earth, their posterity from among the children of men.

hausa: Ba ku sani ba cewa jikunanku gaɓoɓin Kiristi ne kansa? Zai kyautu in ɗauki gaɓoɓin Kiristi in haɗa da jikin karuwa? Sam!
english: Don’t you know that your bodies are members of Christ? Shall I then take the members of Christ and make them members of a prostitute? May it never be!

hausa: Da Ataliya mahaifiyar Ahaziya ta ga ɗanta ya mutu, sai ta shiga hallaka dukan iyalin gidan sarauta.
english: Now when Athaliah the mother of Ahaziah saw that her son was dead, she arose and destroyed all the royal offspring.

hausa: Itacen ya yi girma ya kuma yi ƙarfi, har tsayinsa ya taɓa sarari sama; ana iya ganinsa a ko’ina a duniya.
english: The tree grew and was strong. Its height reached to the sky and its sight to the end of all the earth.

hausa: Dukan mutanenta suna nishi da ƙyar suna neman burodi; sun sayar da dukiyarsu don su samu abinci don kada su mutu da yunwa. “Ubangiji, ka duba ka gani, gama an yashe ni.”
english: All her people sigh. They seek bread. They have given their pleasant things for food to refresh their soul. “Look, Yahweh, and see, for I have become despised.”

hausa: Sa’an nan za ku riƙa tuna, ku kuma aikata dukan umarnaina ku zama tsarkaka ga Allahnku.
english: so that you may remember and do all my commandments, and be holy to your God.

hausa: da Magfiyash, da Meshullam, da Hezir,
english: Magpiash, Meshullam, Hezir,

hausa: Saboda haka Haruna ya yi kamar yadda Musa ya faɗa, ya ruga a guje zuwa tsakiyar taron. An riga an fara annobar a cikin mutane, amma Haruna ya miƙa turaren ya kuma yi kafara dominsu.
english: Aaron did as Moses said, and ran into the middle of the assembly. The plague had already begun among the people. He put on the incense, and made atonement for the people.

hausa: sai dai an fanshe ku da jini mai daraja na Kiristi, ɗan rago marar aibi ko lahani.
english: but with precious blood, as of a lamb without blemish or spot, the blood of Christ,

hausa: Suka ba shi shekel saba’in na azurfa daga haikalin Ba’al-Berit, Abimelek kuwa ya yi amfani da shi ya yi hayar ’yan tauri waɗanda suka zama masu binsa.
english: They gave him seventy pieces of silver out of the house of Baal Berith, with which Abimelech hired vain and reckless fellows who followed him.

hausa: Kowace hadaya ta garin da aka toya a tanda, ko aka dafa a tukunya ko a kan kaskon tuya, na firist da ya miƙa ta ne,
english: Every meal offering that is baked in the oven, and all that is prepared in the pan and on the griddle, shall be the priest’s who offers it.

hausa: Sun yi wannan tambaya ce don su sa masa tarko, don su sami hanyar zarge shi. Amma Yesu ya sunkuya ya fara rubutu a ƙasa da yatsarsa.
english: They said this testing him, that they might have something to accuse him of. But Jesus stooped down and wrote on the ground with his finger.

hausa: Tausayinka da girma yake, ya Ubangiji; ka kiyaye raina bisa ga dokokinka.
english: Great are your tender mercies, Yahweh. Revive me according to your ordinances.

hausa: Sa’an nan ka kai wa mahaifinka yă ci, domin yă sa maka albarka kafin yă mutu.”
english: You shall bring it to your father, that he may eat, so that he may bless you before his death.”

hausa: Kamar yadda kaya suke haɓaka, haka ma masu amfani da su. Kuma wane amfani ne suke ga mai shi in ba ciyar da idanunsa a kansu ba?
english: When goods increase, those who eat them are increased; and what advantage is there to its owner, except to feast on them with his eyes?

hausa: Dawuda ya kawo ƙasusuwan Shawulu da na ɗansa Yonatan daga can, a kuma aka tattara dukan ƙasusuwan waɗanda Gibeyonawan suka kashe, suka kuma rataye.
english: and he brought up from there the bones of Saul and the bones of Jonathan his son. They also gathered the bones of those who were hanged.

hausa: “ ‘Saboda haka, ke karuwa, ki ji maganar Ubangiji!
english: “Therefore, prostitute, hear Yahweh’s word:

hausa: Saboda haka za a yashe Isra’ila har sai wadda take naƙuda ta haihu sauran ’yan’uwansa kuma sun dawo su haɗu da Isra’ilawa.
english: Therefore he will abandon them until the time that she who is in labor gives birth. Then the rest of his brothers will return to the children of Israel.

hausa: A shekara ta goma sha takwas ta mulkin Yerobowam ɗan Nebat, Abiyam ya zama sarkin Yahuda,
english: Now in the eighteenth year of King Jeroboam the son of Nebat, Abijam began to reign over Judah.

hausa: Duk inda tafin ƙafanku ya taka, zai zama naku; iyakarku zai kama daga hamadan Lebanon da kuma daga Kogin Yuferites zuwa Bahar Rum.
english: Every place on which the sole of your foot treads shall be yours: from the wilderness and Lebanon, from the river, the river Euphrates, even to the western sea shall be your border.

hausa: Daga iyalin Heman, Yehiyel da Shimeyi. Daga zuriyar Yedutun, Shemahiya da Uzziyel.
english: and of the sons of Heman, Jehuel and Shimei; and of the sons of Jeduthun, Shemaiah and Uzziel.

hausa: Hosa dangin Merari yana da ’ya’ya maza. Shimri na fari (ko da yake ba shi ne ɗan fari ba, mahaifinsa ya sa shi na fari),
english: Also Hosah, of the children of Merari, had sons: Shimri the chief (for though he was not the firstborn, yet his father made him chief),

hausa: “Isra’ila garke ne da ya watse da zakoki suka kora. Na farkon da ya cinye shi sarkin Assuriya ne; na ƙarshen da ya ragargaza ƙasusuwansa Nebukadnezzar sarkin Babilon ne.”
english: “Israel is a hunted sheep. The lions have driven him away. First, the king of Assyria devoured him, and now at last Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon has broken his bones.”

hausa: Ni ne Ubangiji Allahnku, wanda ya fitar da ku daga Masar, don in ba ku ƙasar Kan’ana in kuma zama Allahnku.
english: I am Yahweh your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, to give you the land of Canaan, and to be your God.

hausa: Sai Yahuda Iskariyot, ɗaya daga cikin Sha Biyun nan, ya je wajen manyan firistoci don yă bashe Yesu a gare su.
english: Judas Iscariot, who was one of the twelve, went away to the chief priests, that he might deliver him to them.

hausa: Sai ta tafi, ta yi yadda Iliya ya faɗa mata. Saboda haka aka kasance da abinci kowace rana wa Iliya da kuma don macen da iyalinta.
english: She went and did according to the saying of Elijah; and she, he, and her household ate many days.

hausa: Sai ya shiga jirgin ruwan tare da su, iskar kuma ta kwanta. Dukansu suka yi mamaki,
english: He got into the boat with them; and the wind ceased, and they were very amazed among themselves, and marveled;

hausa: Ka dawo ka ci abinci, ka kuma sha ruwa a wurin da na faɗa maka kada ka ci, ko ka sha. Saboda haka ba za a binne jikinka a kabarin kakanninka ba.’ ”
english: but came back, and have eaten bread and drank water in the place of which he said to you, “Eat no bread, and drink no water,” your body will not come to the tomb of your fathers.’”

hausa: Mutane za su yi ta tangaɗi daga teku zuwa teku suna yawo daga arewa zuwa kudu, suna neman maganar Ubangiji, amma ba za su samu ba.
english: They will wander from sea to sea, and from the north even to the east; they will run back and forth to seek Yahweh’s word, and will not find it.

hausa: “Kamar a kwanakin da kuka fito daga Masar, zan nuna musu al’ajabaina.”
english: “As in the days of your coming out of the land of Egypt, I will show them marvelous things.”

hausa: Ya ba da umarni ya ce, “Yanka yaron nan mai rai, gida biyu, kowacce ta ɗauki rabi.”
english: The king said, “Divide the living child in two, and give half to the one, and half to the other.”

hausa: Kai ne ka murƙushe kawunan dodon ruwa ka kuma ba da shi yă zama abinci ga halittun hamada.
english: You broke the heads of Leviathan in pieces. You gave him as food to people and desert creatures.

hausa: Suka yi fushi da Irmiya suka sa aka yi masa dūka aka kuma jefa shi cikin kurkuku a gidan Yonatan magatakarda, gama an mai da gidansa ya zama kurkuku.
english: The princes were angry with Jeremiah, and struck him, and put him in prison in the house of Jonathan the scribe; for they had made that the prison.

hausa: Sama’ila ta tattara mutanen Isra’ila a gaban Ubangiji a Mizfa
english: Samuel called the people together to Yahweh to Mizpah;

hausa: Zai cece ka daga bala’o’i guda shida; har bakwai ma ba abin da zai same ka.
english: He will deliver you in six troubles; yes, in seven no evil will touch you.

hausa: Kedemot da Mefa’at, tare da wuraren kiwonsu;
english: Kedemoth with its pasture lands, and Mephaath with its pasture lands;

hausa: Da su wane ne kuwa ya yi fushi har shekaru arba’in? Ba da waɗanda suka yi zunubi, waɗanda suka mutu a hamada ba?
english: With whom was he displeased forty years? Wasn’t it with those who sinned, whose bodies fell in the wilderness?

hausa: Duk da haka dukan waɗanda suka karɓe shi, ga waɗanda suka gaskata a sunansa, ya ba su iko su zama ’ya’yan Allah
english: But as many as received him, to them he gave the right to become God’s children, to those who believe in his name:

hausa: Yaƙub ya ƙaunaci Rahila, sai ya ce, “Zan yi maka aiki na shekaru bakwai domin ƙaramar ’yarka Rahila.”
english: Jacob loved Rachel. He said, “I will serve you seven years for Rachel, your younger daughter.”

hausa: Makiyayan kuwa suka koma, suna ɗaukaka suna kuma yabon Allah saboda dukan abubuwan da suka ji, suka kuma gani, yadda aka gaya musu.
english: The shepherds returned, glorifying and praising God for all the things that they had heard and seen, just as it was told them.

hausa: Sai yă sa macen tă sha ruwa mai ɗaci, mai jawo la’ana, wannan ruwa kuwa zai shiga cikinta yă kawo mata wahala mai zafi.
english: He shall make the woman drink the water of bitterness that causes the curse; and the water that causes the curse shall enter into her and become bitter.

hausa: Muryar Ubangiji mai iko ce; muryar Ubangiji da girma take.
english: Yahweh’s voice is powerful. Yahweh’s voice is full of majesty.

hausa: A filin haikali ya sami mutane suna sayar da shanu, tumaki da tattabaru, waɗansu kuma zaune a tebur suna canjin kuɗi.
english: He found in the temple those who sold oxen, sheep, and doves, and the changers of money sitting.

hausa: Duk lokacin da ruhun nan daga Allah ya sauko a kan Shawulu, sai Dawuda yă ɗauki molonsa yă kaɗa. Sa’an nan sauƙi yă zo wa Shawulu, mugun ruhu kuma yă rabu da shi.
english: When the spirit from God was on Saul, David took the harp and played with his hand; so Saul was refreshed and was well, and the evil spirit departed from him.

hausa: sai Rebeka ta ce wa ɗanta Yaƙub, “Ka ji nan, na ji mahaifinka ya ce wa ɗan’uwanka Isuwa,
english: Rebekah spoke to Jacob her son, saying, “Behold, I heard your father speak to Esau your brother, saying,

hausa: Bayan haka, mu da muke da rai da aka bari, za a ɗauke mu tare da su a cikin gizagizai don mu sadu da Ubangiji a sararin sama. Ta haka za mu kasance tare da Ubangiji har abada.
english: then we who are alive, who are left, will be caught up together with them in the clouds to meet the Lord in the air. So we will be with the Lord forever.

hausa: Babu abokin gāban da zai sa yă biya haraji; babu mugun mutumin da zai danne shi.
english: No enemy will tax him. No wicked man will oppress him.

hausa: Za a ƙasƙantar da ke, za ki ƙi yin magana daga ƙasa; maganarki za tă yi ƙasa-ƙasa daga ƙura. Muryarki za tă zama kamar fatalwa daga ƙasa; daga ƙura maganarki zai fito ƙasa-ƙasa.
english: You will be brought down, and will speak out of the ground. Your speech will mumble out of the dust. Your voice will be as of one who has a familiar spirit, out of the ground, and your speech will whisper out of the dust.

hausa: Musa da Eleyazar firist suka yi musu magana a filayen Mowab kusa da Urdun daga ƙetaren Yeriko, suka ce,
english: Moses and Eleazar the priest spoke with them in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho, saying,

hausa: Za su yi waɗannan abubuwa ne domin ba su san Uba ko ni ba.
english: They will do these things because they have not known the Father nor me.

hausa: Mun tambayi dattawan muka ce musu, “Wa ya ba ku iko ku sāke gina wannan haikali, ku kuma sāke gyara katangarsa?”
english: Then we asked those elders, and said to them thus, “Who gave you a decree to build this house, and to finish this wall?”

hausa: Ku ƙaunaci Ubangiji Allahnku da dukan zuciyarku, da dukan ranku, da kuma dukan ƙarfinku.
english: You shall love Yahweh your God with all your heart, with all your soul, and with all your might.

hausa: Wataƙila zan ɗan jima a wajenku, ko ma in ci damina a can, domin ku yi mini rakiya a tafiyata, duk inda za ni.
english: But with you it may be that I will stay with you, or even winter with you, that you may send me on my journey wherever I go.

hausa: Za ka mutu a fili, gama haka ni na faɗa, in ji Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka.
english: You will fall on the open field, for I have spoken it,” says the Lord Yahweh.

hausa: Bayan ya nemi shawara, sai sarki ya yi siffofin ’yan maruƙa biyu na zinariya. Ya ce wa mutane, “Kun daɗe kuna haurawa zuwa can Urushalima. Ga allolinku, ya Isra’ila, waɗanda suka fitar da ku daga ƙasar Masar.”
english: So the king took counsel, and made two calves of gold; and he said to them, “It is too much for you to go up to Jerusalem. Look and behold your gods, Israel, which brought you up out of the land of Egypt!”

hausa: Baƙi za su mallaki Ashdod, kuma zan kawar da girman kan Filistiyawa.
english: Foreigners will dwell in Ashdod, and I will cut off the pride of the Philistines.

hausa: Sai ka lura ka yi su daidai bisa ga fasalin da aka nuna maka a kan dutse.
english: See that you make them after their pattern, which has been shown to you on the mountain.

hausa: Amma ya ce musu, “Kada ku tsai da ni, tun da Ubangiji ya ba ni nasara a tafiyata. Ku sallame ni domin in tafi wurin maigidana.”
english: He said to them, “Don’t hinder me, since Yahweh has prospered my way. Send me away that I may go to my master.”

hausa: Igal ɗan Yusuf, daga kabilar Issakar;
english: Of the tribe of Issachar, Igal the son of Joseph.

hausa: “ ‘Sa’an nan waɗanda suke zama a garuruwan Isra’ila za su fita su tattara makamai su hura wuta da su su kuma ƙone su, manya da ƙanana garkuwoyi, bakkuna da kibiyoyi, kulake da māsu. Shekara bakwai za su yi amfani da su don hura wuta.
english: “‘“Those who dwell in the cities of Israel will go out and will make fires of the weapons and burn them, both the shields and the bucklers, the bows and the arrows, and the war clubs and the spears, and they will make fires with them for seven years;

hausa: Ya sa ƙafafuna kamar ƙafafun barewa; ya sa na iya tsaya a kan ƙwanƙoli.
english: He makes my feet like deer’s feet, and sets me on my high places.

hausa: Obadiya ɗan Shemahiya, ɗan Galal, ɗan Yedutun; da Berekiya ɗan Asa, ɗan Elkana, wanda ya zauna a ƙauyukan Netofawa.
english: and Obadiah the son of Shemaiah, the son of Galal, the son of Jeduthun; and Berechiah the son of Asa, the son of Elkanah, who lived in the villages of the Netophathites.

hausa: Ya haura zuwa haikalin Ubangiji tare da mutanen Yahuda, mutanen Urushalima, firistoci da Lawiyawa, dukan mutane daga ƙarami zuwa babba. Ya karanta dukan kalmomin Littafin Alkawari wanda aka samu a cikin haikalin Ubangiji a kunnuwansu.
english: The king went up to Yahweh’s house with all the men of Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem—the priests, the Levites, and all the people, both great and small—and he read in their hearing all the words of the book of the covenant that was found in Yahweh’s house.

hausa: Da Musa ya hau dutsen, sai girgije ya rufe dutsen,
english: Moses went up on the mountain, and the cloud covered the mountain.

hausa: don kuma su sami ikon fitar da aljanu.
english: and to have authority to heal sicknesses and to cast out demons:

hausa: Amma Ubangiji ya ce masa, “Salama! Kada ka ji tsoro, ba za ka mutu ba.”
english: Yahweh said to him, “Peace be to you! Don’t be afraid. You shall not die.”

hausa: Su kamar raƙuman ruwan teku ne masu hauka, suna taƙama da tumbatsan kumfar kunyarsu. Su kamar taurari ne masu yawo barkatai, waɗanda aka ajiye mugun duhu saboda su har abada.
english: wild waves of the sea, foaming out their own shame; wandering stars, for whom the blackness of darkness has been reserved forever.

hausa: Yana nan tare da Allah tun farar farawa.
english: The same was in the beginning with God.

hausa: Ina marmari in zauna a tentinka har abada in sami mafaka a cikin inuwar fikafikanka. Sela
english: I will dwell in your tent forever. I will take refuge in the shelter of your wings. Selah.

hausa: Sai wani doki ya fito, ja wur. Aka ba wa mai hawansa iko yă ɗauke salama daga duniya yă kuma sa mutane su kashe juna. Aka ba shi babban takobi.
english: Another came out, a red horse. To him who sat on it was given power to take peace from the earth, and that they should kill one another. There was given to him a great sword.

hausa: Daga iyakokin duniya mun ji waƙoƙi, “Ɗaukaka ga Mai Adalcin nan.” Amma na ce, “Na lalace, na lalace! Kaitona! Munafukai sun ci amana! Da munafunci munafukai sun ci amana!”
english: From the uttermost part of the earth have we heard songs. Glory to the righteous! But I said, “I pine away! I pine away! woe is me!” The treacherous have dealt treacherously. Yes, the treacherous have dealt very treacherously.

hausa: Bitrus ya fitar da su duka daga ɗakin; sa’an nan ya durƙusa ya yi addu’a. Da ya juya wajen matacciyar, sai ya ce, “Tabita, tashi.” Ta buɗe idanunta, ta ga Bitrus sai ta tashi zaune.
english: Peter sent them all out, and knelt down and prayed. Turning to the body, he said, “Tabitha, get up!” She opened her eyes, and when she saw Peter, she sat up.

hausa: Haka za a yi da kowannensu bisa ga abin da aka shirya.
english: According to the number that you shall prepare, so you shall do to everyone according to their number.

hausa: Waɗanda suke na Kiristi Yesu, sun gicciye mutuntaka tare da abubuwan da mutum yake marmari da kuma sha’awace-sha’awacensa.
english: Those who belong to Christ have crucified the flesh with its passions and lusts.

hausa: Shirye-shirye sukan lalace saboda rashin neman shawara, amma tare da mashawarta masu yawa za su yi nasara.
english: Where there is no counsel, plans fail; but in a multitude of counselors they are established.

hausa: Waɗannan su ne umarnai, ƙa’idodi da kuma dokokin da Ubangiji Allahnku ya umarce ni in koya muku don ku kiyaye a ƙasar da kuke haye Urdun don mallaka,
english: Now these are the commandments, the statutes, and the ordinances, which Yahweh your God commanded to teach you, that you might do them in the land that you go over to possess;

hausa: A kwanakin nan wani taro mai girma ya taru. Tun da yake ba su da abin da za su ci, sai Yesu ya kira almajiransa ya ce,
english: In those days, when there was a very great multitude, and they had nothing to eat, Jesus called his disciples to himself and said to them,

hausa: Sai ya ce mini, “Waɗannan su ne ɗakunan dahuwa inda masu hidima a haikali za su dafa hadayun da jama’a.”
english: Then he said to me, “These are the boiling houses, where the ministers of the house shall boil the sacrifice of the people.”

hausa: Sa’ad da taron suka ga abin da Bulus ya yi, sai suka ihu da harshen Likayoniyawa, suna cewa, “Alloli sun sauka mana da siffar mutane!”
english: When the multitude saw what Paul had done, they lifted up their voice, saying in the language of Lycaonia, “The gods have come down to us in the likeness of men!”

hausa: Ku warkar da marasa lafiya, ku tā da matattu, ku tsabtacce kutare, ku kuma fitar da aljanu. A kyauta kuka samu, ku kuma bayar a kyauta.
english: Heal the sick, cleanse the lepers, and cast out demons. Freely you received, so freely give.

hausa: Jibi wajajen yamma, ka tafi wurin da ka ɓuya lokacin da wannan matsala ta fara, ka tsaya kusa da dutsen Etsel.
english: When you have stayed three days, go down quickly and come to the place where you hid yourself when this started, and remain by the stone Ezel.

hausa: Amma sa’ad da sarki ya sami labarin maƙarƙashiyar, sai ya ba da umarnai a rubuce cewa mugun shirin da Haman ya ƙulla a kan Yahudawa yă komo kansa, kuma cewa a rataye shi da ’ya’yansa maza a kan gumagumai.
english: but when this became known to the king, he commanded by letters that his wicked plan, which he had planned against the Jews, should return on his own head, and that he and his sons should be hanged on the gallows.

hausa: Ku miƙa su kawai a wurin da Ubangiji zai zaɓa a cikin ɗaya daga kabilanku, a can za ku yi kowane abin da na umarce ku.
english: but in the place which Yahweh chooses in one of your tribes, there you shall offer your burnt offerings, and there you shall do all that I command you.

hausa: Ka more rayuwa da matarka, wadda kake ƙauna, dukan kwanakin nan marasa amfani da Allah ya ba ka a duniya. Gama wannan ne rabonka a rayuwa da kuma na faman aikinka a duniya.
english: Live joyfully with the wife whom you love all the days of your life of vanity, which he has given you under the sun, all your days of vanity, for that is your portion in life, and in your labor in which you labor under the sun.

hausa: Abin farin ciki ne ga mutanenka! Abin farin ciki ne ga fadawanka, waɗanda suke cin gaba da tsayawa a gabanka suna kuma jin hikimarka!
english: Happy are your men, and happy are these your servants, who stand continually before you and hear your wisdom.

hausa: Ka ji roƙon bawanka da kuma na mutanenka Isra’ila sa’ad da suka yi addu’a, suka fuskanci wannan wuri. Ka ji daga sama, mazauninka, kuma sa’ad da ka ji, ka gafarta.
english: Listen to the supplication of your servant, and of your people Israel, when they pray toward this place. Yes, hear in heaven, your dwelling place; and when you hear, forgive.

hausa: Sai dattawan nan ashirin da huɗu da suke zaune a kursiyoyinsu a gaban Allah, suka fāɗi da fuskokinsu a ƙasa suka kuma yi wa Allah sujada,
english: The twenty-four elders, who sit on their thrones before God’s throne, fell on their faces and worshiped God,

hausa: Kashegari, Yahudawa suka ƙulla makirci suka kuma yi rantsuwa cewa ba za su ci ko sha ba sai sun kashe Bulus.
english: When it was day, some of the Jews banded together and bound themselves under a curse, saying that they would neither eat nor drink until they had killed Paul.

hausa: Amma Dawuda bai iya zuwa gabansa don yă yi tambaya ga Allah ba, gama yana jin tsoron takobin mala’ikan Ubangiji.
english: But David couldn’t go before it to inquire of God, for he was afraid because of the sword of Yahweh’s angel.

hausa: Ku yi murna da farin ciki, ya Diyar Edom, ke mai zama a ƙasar Uz. Amma ke ma za a ba ki kwaf; za ki bugu ki zama tsirara.
english: Rejoice and be glad, daughter of Edom, who dwells in the land of Uz. The cup will pass through to you also. You will be drunken, and will make yourself naked.

hausa: ’Ya’yan Ezra maza su ne, Yeter, Mered, Efer da Yalon. Ɗaya daga cikin matan Mered ta haifi Miriyam, Shammai da Ishba wanda ya haifi Eshtemowa.
english: The sons of Ezrah: Jether, Mered, Epher, and Jalon; and Mered’s wife bore Miriam, Shammai, and Ishbah the father of Eshtemoa.

hausa: waɗanda suka gangara zuwa Masar ba tare da sun nemi shawarata; waɗanda suke neman taimakon kāriyar Fir’auna, don neman inuwar mafakar Masar.
english: who set out to go down into Egypt without asking for my advice, to strengthen themselves in the strength of Pharaoh, and to take refuge in the shadow of Egypt!

hausa: Sarakunan guda biyar suka gudu, suka ɓuya a cikin kogo a Makkeda.
english: These five kings fled, and hid themselves in the cave at Makkedah.

hausa: Gama Mahaliccinki shi ne mijinki, Ubangiji Maɗaukaki ne sunansa, Mai Tsarkin nan na Isra’ila ne Mai Fansarki; ana ce da shi Allahn dukan duniya.
english: For your Maker is your husband; Yahweh of Armies is his name. The Holy One of Israel is your Redeemer. He will be called the God of the whole earth.

hausa: Wata rana da Elisha ya zo, sai ya haura ɗakinsa ya kwanta.
english: One day he came there, and he went to the room and lay there.

hausa: Yesu ya ce, “Ku bar yara ƙanana su zo wurina, kada ku hana su, gama mulkin sama na irin waɗannan ne.”
english: But Jesus said, “Allow the little children, and don’t forbid them to come to me; for the Kingdom of Heaven belongs to ones like these.”

hausa: Za a ba da kofin rubutun a matsayin doka a kowane lardi, a kuma sanar da mutanen kowace al’umma, domin su zauna da shiri don wannan rana.
english: A copy of the letter, that the decree should be given out in every province, was published to all the peoples, that they should be ready against that day.

hausa: Ba ya ba da bashi da ruwa ko ya karɓa ƙarin riba. Yakan janye hannunsa daga aikata mugunta yakan kuma yi shari’a cikin gaskiya tsakanin mutum da mutum.
english: he who hasn’t lent to them with interest, hasn’t taken any increase from them, who has withdrawn his hand from iniquity, has executed true justice between man and man,

hausa: Firist zai karɓi hadaya ta gari don kishi daga hannuwanta, yă kaɗa shi a gaban Ubangiji sa’an nan yă kawo a bagade.
english: The priest shall take the meal offering of jealousy out of the woman’s hand, and shall wave the meal offering before Yahweh, and bring it to the altar.

hausa: Aka jefa ƙuri’u don kowace ƙofa bisa ga iyalansu, ƙarami da babba.
english: They cast lots, the small as well as the great, according to their fathers’ houses, for every gate.

hausa: amma ku bar kowace yarinyar da ba tă taɓa yin lalata da namiji ba.
english: But all the girls, who have not known man by lying with him, keep alive for yourselves.

hausa: Mutum mai cika fushi yakan tā da faɗa, mai zafin rai kuma kan yi zunubai masu yawa.
english: An angry man stirs up strife, and a wrathful man abounds in sin.

hausa: Fahariyarmu ba fiye da yadda ya kamata take ba, ba tă kuma shafi aikin waɗansu ba. Sai dai muna sa zuciya bangaskiyarku ta riƙa ƙaruwa, ta haka kuma fagen aikinmu a cikinku yă riƙa ƙaruwa ƙwarai da gaske.
english: not boasting beyond proper limits in other men’s labors, but having hope that as your faith grows, we will be abundantly enlarged by you in our sphere of influence,

hausa: Mai yiwuwa Ubangiji Allahnka ya ji dukan maganganun sarkin yaƙi, wanda maigidansa, sarkin Assuriya, ya aiko don yă rena Allah mai rai. Bari Ubangiji Allahnka yă tsawata masa saboda maganar da ya ji. Saboda haka ka yi addu’a domin raguwar da har yanzu suke a raye.”
english: It may be Yahweh your God will hear all the words of Rabshakeh, whom the king of Assyria his master has sent to defy the living God, and will rebuke the words which Yahweh your God has heard. Therefore lift up your prayer for the remnant that is left.’”

hausa: Ku kasa kunne gare ni, ku tsibirai; ku ji wannan, ku al’ummai masu nesa. Kafin a haife Ni Ubangiji ya kira ni; tun daga haihuwata ya ambaci sunana.
english: Listen, islands, to me. Listen, you peoples, from afar: Yahweh has called me from the womb; from the inside of my mother, he has mentioned my name.

hausa: gama ƙaunarka kullum tana a gabana, kuma ina cin gaba da tafiya a cikin gaskiyarka.
english: For your loving kindness is before my eyes. I have walked in your truth.

hausa: Waɗannan su ne rabon gādon da Musa ya yi lokacin da suke cikin filayen Mowab a hayin gabashin Urdun kusa da Yeriko.
english: These are the inheritances which Moses distributed in the plains of Moab, beyond the Jordan at Jericho, eastward.

hausa: Gidanka da kuma masarautarka za su dawwama har abada a gabana; gadon sarautarka kuma zai kahu har abada.’ ”
english: Your house and your kingdom will be made sure forever before you. Your throne will be established forever.”’”

hausa: Wannan ya ci gaba har shekara biyu, sai da ya sa dukan Yahudawa da Hellenawa da suke zaune a lardin Asiya suka ji maganar Ubangiji.
english: This continued for two years, so that all those who lived in Asia heard the word of the Lord Jesus, both Jews and Greeks.

hausa: “ ‘Yanzu, ka zo ku shirya da shugabana, sarkin Assuriya. Zan ba ka dawakai dubu biyu, in za ka sami mahayansu!
english: Now therefore, please give pledges to my master the king of Assyria, and I will give you two thousand horses if you are able on your part to set riders on them.

hausa: Kada ku hana wannan aiki na haikalin Allah. Bari gwamnan Yahudawa, da dattawan Yahudawa su sāke gina wannan gidan Allah a wurin da yake a dā.
english: Leave the work of this house of God alone; let the governor of the Jews and the elders of the Jews build this house of God in its place.

hausa: Amma kai, ka natsu cikin kowane hali, ka jure shan wahala, ka yi aikin mai bishara, ka cika dukan ayyukan hidimarka.
english: But you be sober in all things, suffer hardship, do the work of an evangelist, and fulfill your ministry.

hausa: da Farmashta, da Arisai, da Aridai da kuma Baizata,
english: Parmashta, Arisai, Aridai, and Vaizatha,

hausa: Ba kya yi wa kowa biyayya, ba kya kuma yarda da kuskurenki. Ba kya dogara ga Ubangiji, ba kya kuma kusatowa kusa da Allahnki.
english: She didn’t obey the voice. She didn’t receive correction. She didn’t trust in Yahweh. She didn’t draw near to her God.

hausa: Duk da haka, Yehu bai mai da hankali ya kiyaye dokokin Ubangiji, Allah na Isra’ila da dukan zuciyarsa ba. Bai rabu da zunubin Yerobowam, wanda ya sa Isra’ila ta aikata ba.
english: But Jehu took no heed to walk in the law of Yahweh, the God of Israel, with all his heart. He didn’t depart from the sins of Jeroboam, with which he made Israel to sin.

hausa: Shawulu kuwa na zaune a gindin itacen rumman a bayan garin Gibeya a Migron. Tare da shi akwai mutum wajen ɗari shida.
english: Saul stayed in the uttermost part of Gibeah under the pomegranate tree which is in Migron; and the people who were with him were about six hundred men,

hausa: Ka ce, ‘Kaitona! Ubangiji ya ƙara baƙin ciki da wahalata; na gaji da nishe-nishe ban kuma huta ba.’ ”
english: ‘You said, “Woe is me now! For Yahweh has added sorrow to my pain! I am weary with my groaning, and I find no rest.”’

hausa: Suka kafa keɓaɓɓun duwatsu da kuma ginshiƙan Ashera a kowane tudu mai tsayi da kuma a ƙarƙashin kowane babban itace.
english: and they set up for themselves pillars and Asherah poles on every high hill and under every green tree;

hausa: da Hattush, da Shebaniya, da Malluk,
english: Hattush, Shebaniah, Malluch,

hausa: Saboda haka Tamar ta tafi gidan ɗan’uwanta Amnon, wanda yake kwance. Ta ɗauki fulawa, ta kwaɓa, ta yi burodi a gabansa ta toya shi.
english: So Tamar went to her brother Amnon’s house; and he was lying down. She took dough, kneaded it, made cakes in his sight, and baked the cakes.

hausa: Za ku iya nemi baƙo yă biya ku bashin da kuke binsa, amma dole ku yafe duk wani bashin da kuke bin ɗan’uwa.
english: Of a foreigner you may require it; but whatever of yours is with your brother, your hand shall release.

hausa: “ ‘To, in ku a matsayin jama’a, da gangan kuka ƙi kiyaye waɗannan ƙa’idodi da Ubangiji ya ba wa Musa ba,
english: “‘When you err, and don’t observe all these commandments which Yahweh has spoken to Moses—

hausa: Sai Maryamu ta ce, “Raina yana ɗaukaka Ubangiji
english: Mary said, “My soul magnifies the Lord.

hausa: To, fa, sai ku kwana a nan kamar yadda waɗancan suka yi, ni kuma in roƙi Ubangiji, in ji, wace magana zai ce mini.”
english: Now therefore please stay here tonight as well, that I may know what else Yahweh will speak to me.”

hausa: Maganar Ubangiji da ta zo wa Zefaniya ɗan Kushi, ɗan Gedaliya, ɗan Amariya, ɗan Hezekiya, a zamanin Yosiya ɗan Amon sarkin Yahuda.
english: Yahweh’s word which came to Zephaniah, the son of Cushi, the son of Gedaliah, the son of Amariah, the son of Hezekiah, in the days of Josiah, the son of Amon, king of Judah.

hausa: Sai mutumin ya je ya gaya wa Yahudawa cewa Yesu ne ya warkar da shi.
english: The man went away, and told the Jews that it was Jesus who had made him well.

hausa: Duk wanda bai saurari kalmomina da annabin nan yake magana da sunana ba, ni kaina zan nemi hakki a kan mutumin.
english: It shall happen, that whoever will not listen to my words which he shall speak in my name, I will require it of him.

hausa: Amma ta haka ne Allah ya cika abin da ya rigyafaɗi ta bakin dukan annabawa cewa, Kiristinsa zai sha wahala.
english: But the things which God announced by the mouth of all his prophets, that Christ should suffer, he thus fulfilled.

hausa: Ya amsa ya ce, “Na riga na gaya muku ba ku kuwa saurara ba. Don me kuke so ku sāke ji? Ko ku ma kuna so ku zama almajiransa ne?”
english: He answered them, “I told you already, and you didn’t listen. Why do you want to hear it again? You don’t also want to become his disciples, do you?”

hausa: A dā kuna a ware da Allah, kuka kuma zama abokan gāba a cikin tunaninku saboda mugun halinku.
english: You, being in past times alienated and enemies in your mind in your evil deeds,

hausa: Shi ne ya sāke gina Elat, ya kuma maido da ita a hannun Yahuda bayan Amaziya ya huta da kakanninsa.
english: He built Elath and restored it to Judah. After that the king slept with his fathers.

hausa: Me ya sa kake baƙin ciki, ya raina? Me ya sa ka damu a cikina? Ka dogara ga Allah, gama zai sāke yabe shi, Mai Cetona da kuma Allahna.
english: Why are you in despair, my soul? Why are you disturbed within me? Hope in God! For I shall still praise him, the saving help of my countenance, and my God.

hausa: Lawiyawa suka yi yadda Musa ya umarta, a ranar, mutane wajen dubu uku suka mutu.
english: The sons of Levi did according to the word of Moses. About three thousand men fell of the people that day.

hausa: Yayinda Ezra yake addu’a, yake kuma furta laifi, yana kuka, yana a durƙushe da kansa ƙasa a gaban gidan Allah, sai babban taron jama’ar Isra’ilawa, maza, mata da yara, suka taru a wurinsa. Su ma suka yi kuka mai zafi.
english: Now while Ezra prayed and made confession, weeping and casting himself down before God’s house, there was gathered together to him out of Israel a very great assembly of men and women and children; for the people wept very bitterly.

hausa: Haka kuma, ku nemi zaman salama da cin gaba a birnin da aka kai ku zaman bauta. Ku yi addu’a ga Ubangiji saboda birnin, domin in ya ci gaba, ku ma za ku ci gaba.”
english: Seek the peace of the city where I have caused you to be carried away captive, and pray to Yahweh for it; for in its peace you will have peace.”

hausa: “Idan mutum biyu suna faɗa, har suka yi wa mace mai ciki rauni, har ya sa ta yi ɓari, amma wani lahani bai same ta ba, za a ci wa wanda ya yi mata raunin tara bisa ga yadda mijinta ya yanka za a biya, in dai abin da ya yanka ya yi daidai da abin da alƙalai suka tsara.
english: “If men fight and hurt a pregnant woman so that she gives birth prematurely, and yet no harm follows, he shall be surely fined as much as the woman’s husband demands and the judges allow.

hausa: Amma kada Kohatawa su shiga don su dubi abubuwa masu tsarki, ko na ɗan ƙanƙanin lokaci, in ba haka ba za su mutu.”
english: but they shall not go in to see the sanctuary even for a moment, lest they die.”

hausa: Ka sa sandunan a cikin zoban, a gefen akwatin domin ɗaukansa.
english: You shall put the poles into the rings on the sides of the ark to carry the ark.

hausa: Kamar yadda kare kan koma ga amansa, haka wawa kan maimaita wautarsa.
english: As a dog that returns to his vomit, so is a fool who repeats his folly.

hausa: “Kada ku jinkirta fitar da zakarku daga rumbunanku, ko harajin kayan da kuka saya. “Dole ku ba ni ’ya’yan farinku maza.
english: “You shall not delay to offer from your harvest and from the outflow of your presses. “You shall give the firstborn of your sons to me.

hausa: Ina gode wa Allah, wanda ya sa a zuciyar Titus, irin kula da nake da shi dominku.
english: But thanks be to God, who puts the same earnest care for you into the heart of Titus.

hausa: “Sa’ad da waɗannan mutane, ko annabi ko firist, ya tambaye ka, ‘Mece ce maganarUbangiji?’ Ka ce musu, ‘Wace magana? Zan yashe ku, in ji Ubangiji.’
english: “When this people, or the prophet, or a priest, asks you, saying, ‘What is the message from Yahweh?’ Then you shall tell them, ‘“What message? I will cast you off,” says Yahweh.’

hausa: Kada ka sa ƙafa a kan hanyar mugaye kada ka bi gurbin mugaye.
english: Don’t enter into the path of the wicked. Don’t walk in the way of evil men.

hausa: Abin da Allah ya faɗa game da Damaskus. “Duba, Damaskus ba za tă ƙara zama birni ba amma za tă zama tsibin juji.
english: The burden of Damascus. “Behold, Damascus is taken away from being a city, and it will be a ruinous heap.

hausa: Ku gwada kanku ku gani ko kuna cikin bangaskiya; ku auna kanku. Ashe, ba ku san cewa Kiristi Yesu yana cikinku ba? Sai ko in kun fāɗi gwajin.
english: Examine your own selves, whether you are in the faith. Test your own selves. Or don’t you know about your own selves, that Jesus Christ is in you?—unless indeed you are disqualified.

hausa: Uzziya ya huta da kakanninsa aka kuma binne shi kusa da su a fili don binnewar da take ta sarakuna, domin mutane sun ce, “Yana da kuturta.” Sai Yotam ɗansa ya gāje shi a matsayin sarki.
english: So Uzziah slept with his fathers; and they buried him with his fathers in the field of burial which belonged to the kings, for they said, “He is a leper.” Jotham his son reigned in his place.

hausa: in zama mai hidimar Kiristi Yesu ga Al’ummai da aikin firist na yin shelar bisharar Allah, don Al’ummai su zama hadaya mai karɓuwa ga Allah, tsattsarka ta wurin Ruhu Mai Tsarki.
english: that I should be a servant of Christ Jesus to the Gentiles, serving as a priest of the Good News of God, that the offering up of the Gentiles might be made acceptable, sanctified by the Holy Spirit.

hausa: Duk wanda yake da shi, za a ƙara masa, zai kuwa samu a yalwace. Duk wanda kuma ba shi da shi, ko ɗan abin da yake da shi ma, za a karɓe.
english: For whoever has, to him will be given, and he will have abundance; but whoever doesn’t have, from him will be taken away even that which he has.

hausa: Sai suka ɗibi tokar matoya, suka tsaya a gaban Fir’auna, Musa ya watsa ta a iska, sai marurai masu zafi suka fiffito bisa mutane da dabbobi.
english: They took ashes of the furnace, and stood before Pharaoh; and Moses sprinkled it up toward the sky; and it became boils and blisters breaking out on man and on animal.

hausa: In kuwa muka san cewa yana sauraranmu, ko mene ne muka roƙa, mun sani, mun riga mun sami abin da muka roƙa daga gare shi ke nan.
english: And if we know that he listens to us, whatever we ask, we know that we have the petitions which we have asked of him.

hausa: Zai sāka musu saboda zunubansu yă kuma hallaka su saboda muguntarsu; Ubangiji Allahnmu zai hallaka su.
english: He has brought on them their own iniquity, and will cut them off in their own wickedness. Yahweh, our God, will cut them off.

hausa: Mutanen suka yi mamaki suka ce, “Wane irin mutum ne wannan? Har iska da raƙuman ruwa suna masa biyayya!”
english: The men marveled, saying, “What kind of man is this, that even the wind and the sea obey him?”

hausa: Ku miƙa hadayun salama a can, kuna ci, kuna farin ciki a gaban Ubangiji Allahnku.
english: You shall sacrifice peace offerings, and shall eat there. You shall rejoice before Yahweh your God.

hausa: Na zaɓar masu inda za su bi na kuma zauna kamar sarkinsu; na zauna kamar sarki a cikin rundunansu; ina nan kamar mai yi wa masu makoki ta’aziyya.
english: I chose out their way, and sat as chief. I lived as a king in the army, as one who comforts the mourners.

hausa: Sa’ad da raɓa tana saukowa da dad dare a kan sansani, Manna ma takan sauko.
english: When the dew fell on the camp in the night, the manna fell on it.

hausa: In mai hikima ya je wurin shari’a da wawa, wawa kan yi ta fushi yana ta dariya, ba kuwa za a sami salama ba.
english: If a wise man goes to court with a foolish man, the fool rages or scoffs, and there is no peace.

hausa: Amma da suka ɗaga kai, sai suka ga cewa, an riga an gungura dutsen. Dutsen kuwa babba ne.
english: for it was very big. Looking up, they saw that the stone was rolled back.

hausa: ’Ya’yan Issakar maza su ne, Tola, Fuwa, Yoshub da Shimron.
english: The sons of Issachar: Tola, Puvah, Iob, and Shimron.

hausa: Sai sarakunan nan biyar na Amoriyawa, sarakunan Urushalima, Hebron, Yarmut, Lakish da Eglon suka haɗa sojojinsu. Suka je dukansu suka yi shirin kai wa Gibeyon hari.
english: Therefore the five kings of the Amorites, the king of Jerusalem, the king of Hebron, the king of Jarmuth, the king of Lachish, and the king of Eglon, gathered themselves together and went up, they and all their armies, and encamped against Gibeon, and made war against it.

hausa: ’Ya’yan da aka haifa musu na tsara ta uku za su iya shiga taron jama’ar Ubangiji.
english: The children of the third generation who are born to them may enter into Yahweh’s assembly.

hausa: Da farko dai, na ji cewa sa’ad da kuka taru a matsayin ikkilisiya, akwai tsattsaguwa a tsakaninku, har na fara yarda da zancen.
english: For first of all, when you come together in the assembly, I hear that divisions exist among you, and I partly believe it.

hausa: Nufin wanda ya aiko ni kuwa shi ne, kada in yar da ko ɗaya daga cikin duk waɗanda ya ba ni, sai dai in tashe su a rana ta ƙarshe.
english: This is the will of my Father who sent me, that of all he has given to me I should lose nothing, but should raise him up at the last day.

hausa: Ka tuna cewa ka mulmula ni kamar yumɓu. Yanzu za ka mai da ni in zama ƙura kuma?
english: Remember, I beg you, that you have fashioned me as clay. Will you bring me into dust again?

hausa: Kamar yadda mace ta fito daga namiji, haka kuma aka haifi namiji ta wurin mace. Sai dai kowane abu daga Allah yake.
english: For as woman came from man, so a man also comes through a woman; but all things are from God.

hausa: A Yoffa akwai wata almajira mai suna Tabita (a harshen Girik sunanta shi ne Dokas); ita mai aikin alheri ce kullum, tana kuma taimakon matalauta.
english: Now there was at Joppa a certain disciple named Tabitha, which when translated means Dorcas. This woman was full of good works and acts of mercy which she did.

hausa: Da kai da dukan sojoji, ku zaga birnin sau ɗaya kullum. Ku yi haka har kwana shida.
english: All of your men of war shall march around the city, going around the city once. You shall do this six days.

hausa: Ga abin da Ubangiji Maɗaukaki ya ce, “Waɗannan mutane sun ce, ‘Lokaci bai yi ba tukuna da za a gina gidan Ubangiji.’ ”
english: “This is what Yahweh of Armies says: These people say, ‘The time hasn’t yet come, the time for Yahweh’s house to be built.’”

hausa: Kada ku zama kamar su, gama Ubanku ya san abin da kuke bukata kafin ma ku roƙe shi.
english: Therefore don’t be like them, for your Father knows what things you need before you ask him.

hausa: Bulus da Barnabas suna fita daga majami’ar ke nan, sai mutane suka gayyace su su ƙara yin maganan nan a kan waɗannan abubuwa a ranar Asabbaci mai zuwa.
english: So when the Jews went out of the synagogue, the Gentiles begged that these words might be preached to them the next Sabbath.

hausa: Sai Isuwa ya gane cewa matan Kan’aniyawa ba su gamshi mahaifinsa Ishaku ba;
english: Esau saw that the daughters of Canaan didn’t please Isaac, his father.

hausa: Akan jefa ƙuri’a a kan cinya, amma kowace shawara mai kyau daga Ubangiji ne.
english: The lot is cast into the lap, but its every decision is from Yahweh.

hausa: Sa’ad da Isra’ila suka ga sarki ya ƙi yă saurare su, sai suka amsa wa sarki, suka ce, “Wanda rabo muke da shi a wurin Dawuda, wanda sashe muke da shi daga ɗan Yesse? Kowa yă koma tentinsa, ya Isra’ila! Ka lura da gidanka, ya Dawuda!” Saboda haka dukan Isra’ilawa suka tafi gida.
english: When all Israel saw that the king didn’t listen to them, the people answered the king, saying, “What portion do we have in David? We don’t have an inheritance in the son of Jesse! Every man to your tents, Israel! Now see to your own house, David.” So all Israel departed to their tents.

hausa: Yesu ya ce, “Gaskiya nake faɗa maka, yau, tabbatacce, a daren nan, kafin zakara yă yi cara sau biyukai da kanka za ka yi mūsun sanina sau uku.”
english: Jesus said to him, “Most certainly I tell you that you today, even this night, before the rooster crows twice, you will deny me three times.”

hausa: A bayan ƙofofi da madogaran ƙofofi kuka kafa alamun gumakanku. Kuka yashe ni, kuka kware gadonku, kuka kwanta a kansa kuka fadada shi; kuka kuma ƙulla yarjejjeniya da waɗanda kuke ƙaunar gadajensu, kuka dubi tsiraicinsu.
english: You have set up your memorial behind the doors and the posts, for you have exposed yourself to someone besides me, and have gone up. You have enlarged your bed and made a covenant for yourself with them. You loved what you saw on their bed.

hausa: har kake duba shi kowace safiya, kake kuma gwada shi koyaushe?
english: that you should visit him every morning, and test him every moment?

hausa: Dukan mutane suka yi mamaki, suka ce, “Wannan Ɗan Dawuda ne kuwa?”
english: All the multitudes were amazed, and said, “Can this be the son of David?”

hausa: To, ƙasa dai ba ta da siffa, babu kuma kome a cikinta, duhu ne kawai ya rufe ko’ina, Ruhun Allah kuwa yana yawo a kan ruwan.
english: The earth was formless and empty. Darkness was on the surface of the deep and God’s Spirit was hovering over the surface of the waters.

hausa: Sa’ad da ake yaƙi tsakanin gidan Shawulu da gidan Dawuda, sai Abner ya yi ta ƙarfafa matsayinsa a gidan Shawulu.
english: While there was war between Saul’s house and David’s house, Abner made himself strong in Saul’s house.

hausa: Ubangiji kansa yana tafe a gabanka, zai kuma kasance tare da kai, ba zai taɓa barinka ko yă yashe ka ba. Kada ka ji tsoro; kada kuma ka karai.”
english: Yahweh himself is who goes before you. He will be with you. He will not fail you nor forsake you. Don’t be afraid. Don’t be discouraged.”

hausa: Shelomit da ’yan’uwansa suka lura da dukan abubuwan da annabi Sama’ila da Shawulu ɗan Kish, da Abner ɗan Ner, da Yowab ɗan Zeruhiya suka keɓe.
english: All that Samuel the seer, Saul the son of Kish, Abner the son of Ner, and Joab the son of Zeruiah had dedicated, whoever had dedicated anything, it was under the hand of Shelomoth and of his brothers.

hausa: Ka kakkarya haƙoran a bakunansu, ya Allah; ka yayyage fiƙoƙin zakoki, ya Ubangiji!
english: Break their teeth, God, in their mouth. Break out the great teeth of the young lions, Yahweh.

hausa: Suka ce musu, “Ba za mu iya yin wannan abu ba, ba za mu iya ba da ’yar’uwarmu ga mutumin da ba shi da kaciya ba. Wannan zai zama abin kunya ne a gare mu.
english: and said to them, “We can’t do this thing, to give our sister to one who is uncircumcised; for that is a reproach to us.

hausa: Sa’an nan maganar Ubangiji ta zo ta wurin annabi Haggai cewa,
english: Then Yahweh’s word came by Haggai the prophet, saying,

hausa: Yawan ƙaruwar firistoci, haka suke yawan zunubi a kaina; sun yi musaya Ɗaukakarsu da wani abin kunya.
english: As they were multiplied, so they sinned against me. I will change their glory into shame.

hausa: Saboda haka mutanen suka sassare rassan itatuwa suka bi Abimelek. Suka tattara su a jikin mafakar suka kuma cinna mata wuta a kan mutanen da suke a ciki. Ta haka dukan mutanen da suke cikin hasumiyar Shekem, wajen maza da mata dubu ɗaya suka mutu.
english: All the people likewise each cut down his bough, followed Abimelech, and put them at the base of the stronghold, and set the stronghold on fire over them, so that all the people of the tower of Shechem died also, about a thousand men and women.

hausa: Yesu ya amsa ya ce, “Gaskiya nake gaya muku, tun ba a haifi Ibrahim ba, ni ne!”
english: Jesus said to them, “Most certainly, I tell you, before Abraham came into existence, I AM.”

hausa: Yayinda suke tafiya suna magana, sai kwatsam, keken yaƙin wuta da dawakan wuta suka ratse tsakaninsu, sai Iliya ya tafi sama a cikin guguwa.
english: As they continued on and talked, behold, a chariot of fire and horses of fire separated them; and Elijah went up by a whirlwind into heaven.

hausa: Edom zai iya cewa, “Ko da yake an ragargaza mu, ai, za mu sāke gina kufanmu.” Amma ga abin da Ubangiji Maɗaukaki ya ce, “Za su iya gini, amma zan rushe. Za a ce da su Muguwar Ƙasa, mutane da kullum suke a ƙarƙashi fushin Ubangiji.
english: Whereas Edom says, “We are beaten down, but we will return and build the waste places,” Yahweh of Armies says, “They shall build, but I will throw down; and men will call them ‘The Wicked Land,’ even the people against whom Yahweh shows wrath forever.”

hausa: ɗan Yoshuwa, ɗan Eliyezer, ɗan Yorim, ɗan Mattat, ɗan Lawi,
english: the son of Jose, the son of Eliezer, the son of Jorim, the son of Matthat, the son of Levi,

hausa: Ku da kuke ƙoƙarin kuɓuta ta wurin Doka an raba ku da Kiristi ke nan; kuka kuma fāɗi daga alheri.
english: You are alienated from Christ, you who desire to be justified by the law. You have fallen away from grace.

hausa: Shem, Arfakshad, Shela,
english: Shem, Arpachshad, Shelah,

hausa: Mutum mai aminci zai cika da albarka, amma duk mai son yin arziki dare ɗaya zai sha hukunci.
english: A faithful man is rich with blessings; but one who is eager to be rich will not go unpunished.

hausa: Mutanen Gileyad suka ce masa, “Duk da haka, muna juyo wajenka yanzu, ka zo tare da mu mu yaƙi Ammonawa, za ka kuma zama shugaban duk wanda yake zama a Gileyad.”
english: The elders of Gilead said to Jephthah, “Therefore we have turned again to you now, that you may go with us and fight with the children of Ammon. You will be our head over all the inhabitants of Gilead.”

hausa: yayinda Filistiyawa suka kai hari wa garuruwa a gindin tuddai da kuma a Negeb na Yahuda. Suka kame su suka kuma zauna a Bet-Shemesh, Aiyalon da Gederot, haka ma Soko, Timna da Gimzo tare da ƙauyuka kewayensu.
english: The Philistines also had invaded the cities of the lowland and of the South of Judah, and had taken Beth Shemesh, Aijalon, Gederoth, Soco with its villages, Timnah with its villages, and also Gimzo and its villages; and they lived there.

hausa: Yoshuwa ya sa mutum dubu biyar suka yi kwanto tsakanin Betel da Ai, a yammancin birnin.
english: He took about five thousand men, and set them in ambush between Bethel and Ai, on the west side of the city.

hausa: Baƙin ciki ya ishe ni maimakon abinci; ina ta yin nishi ba fasawa;
english: For my sighing comes before I eat. My groanings are poured out like water.

hausa: Saboda haka, kamar yadda zunubi ya shigo duniya ta wurin mutum ɗaya, mutuwa kuma ta wurin zunubi, ta haka kuwa mutuwa ta shafi dukan mutane, domin dukan mutane sun yi zunubi.
english: Therefore, as sin entered into the world through one man, and death through sin, so death passed to all men because all sinned.

hausa: Ba su san cewa Yusuf yana jin su ba, da yake yana amfani da mai fassara ne.
english: They didn’t know that Joseph understood them; for there was an interpreter between them.

hausa: Sa’an nan ya ce wa dukan taron Isra’ila, “In ya yi muku kyau kuma in nufin Ubangiji Allahnmu ne, bari mu aika da saƙo nesa da kuma ko’ina zuwa ga sauran ’yan’uwanmu a duk iyakokin Isra’ila, da kuma zuwa ga firistoci da Lawiyawa waɗanda suke tare da su a garuruwansu da makiyayansu, su zo wurinmu.
english: David said to all the assembly of Israel, “If it seems good to you, and if it is of Yahweh our God, let’s send word everywhere to our brothers who are left in all the land of Israel, with whom the priests and Levites are in their cities that have pasture lands, that they may gather themselves to us.

hausa: Maganar Ubangiji ta zo gare shi a shekara ta goma sha uku ta sarautar Yosiya ɗan Amon sarkin Yahuda,
english: Yahweh’s word came to him in the days of Josiah the son of Amon, king of Judah, in the thirteenth year of his reign.

hausa: “A wahayina na dare, na ga a gabana wani kamar ɗan mutum yana saukowa tare da gizagizan sama. Ya kusaci Wannan wanda yake Tun fil azal aka kuma kai shi gabansa.
english: “I saw in the night visions, and behold, there came with the clouds of the sky one like a son of man, and he came even to the Ancient of Days, and they brought him near before him.

hausa: Sa’an nan na ci gaba zuwa wajen Ƙofar Maɓuɓɓuga da kuma Tafkin Sarki, amma babu isashen wuri saboda abin da na hau yă bi;
english: Then I went on to the spring gate and to the king’s pool, but there was no place for the animal that was under me to pass.

hausa: Sa’ad da shugaban matsaran ya sami Irmiya sai ya ce masa, “Ubangiji Allahnka ya sa wannan masifa saboda wannan wuri.
english: The captain of the guard took Jeremiah and said to him, “Yahweh your God pronounced this evil on this place;

hausa: Wanne a cikin dukan allolin waɗannan ƙasashe da kakannina suka hallaka ya taɓa iya ceton mutanensa daga gare ni? To, yaya Allahnku zai iya cetonku daga hannuna?
english: Who was there among all the gods of those nations which my fathers utterly destroyed that could deliver his people out of my hand, that your God should be able to deliver you out of my hand?

hausa: Ubangiji ya kuma ce wa Musa,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

hausa: Moza shi ne mahaifin Bineya; Refahiya, Eleyasa da kuma Azel.
english: Moza became the father of Binea, Rephaiah his son, Eleasah his son, and Azel his son.

hausa: da yake Allah ɗaya ne kaɗai, shi kuma zai kuɓutar da masu kaciya bisa ga bangaskiya da kuma marasa kaciya ta wurin wannan bangaskiya ɗin.
english: since indeed there is one God who will justify the circumcised by faith and the uncircumcised through faith.

hausa: Wannan adalcin Allah yana zuwa ta wurin bangaskiya a cikin Yesu Kiristi ga dukan waɗanda suka ba da gaskiya ne. Ba bambanci,
english: even the righteousness of God through faith in Jesus Christ to all and on all those who believe. For there is no distinction,

hausa: Da sassafe kashegari Sarki Hezekiya ya tattara manyan birni wuri ɗaya, suka haura zuwa haikalin Ubangiji.
english: Then Hezekiah the king arose early, gathered the princes of the city, and went up to Yahweh’s house.

hausa: Suka ce, “Ka ceci rayukanmu, in ya gamshe ka, ranka yă daɗe, za mu zama bayin Fir’auna.”
english: They said, “You have saved our lives! Let us find favor in the sight of my lord, and we will be Pharaoh’s servants.”

hausa: Mahaifin Shawulu, Kish da kuma Ner mahaifin Abner, ’ya’yan Abiyel ne.
english: Kish was the father of Saul, and Ner the father of Abner was the son of Abiel.

hausa: Yayir na zuriyar Manasse ya karɓi dukan yankin ƙasar Argob a Bashan har zuwa iyakar Geshurawa da Ma’akatiyawa. Sai ya kira ƙauyukan wurin da sunansa, Hawwot Yayir.)
english: Jair the son of Manasseh took all the region of Argob, to the border of the Geshurites and the Maacathites, and called them, even Bashan, after his own name, Havvoth Jair, to this day.)

hausa: Ku yi aiki sosai, ba don kawai ku gamshe su sa’ad da suke kallonku ba. Da yake ku bayin Kiristi ne, ku aikata nufin Allah da dukan zuciyarku.
english: not in the way of service only when eyes are on you, as men pleasers, but as servants of Christ, doing the will of God from the heart,

hausa: “ ‘Amma kamar ’ya’yan ɓauren nan marasa kyau, waɗanda sun yi muni har ba a iya ci,’ in ji Ubangiji, ‘haka zan yi da Zedekiya sarkin Yahuda, fadawansa da sauran mutanen da suka tsira a Urushalima, ko suna a wannan ƙasa ko suna zama a Masar.
english: “‘As the bad figs, which can’t be eaten, they are so bad,’ surely Yahweh says, ‘So I will give up Zedekiah the king of Judah, and his princes, and the remnant of Jerusalem who remain in this land, and those who dwell in the land of Egypt.

hausa: Ku zama masu jinƙai, kamar yadda Ubanku mai jinƙai ne.
english: “Therefore be merciful, even as your Father is also merciful.

hausa: Sarki ya kama hanya, dukan gidansa kuwa suna biye da shi; amma ya bar ƙwarƙwarai goma su lura da fada.
english: The king went out, and all his household after him. The king left ten women, who were concubines, to keep the house.

hausa: amma akwai Allahn da yake a sama wanda yake bayyana asirai, ya nuna wa sarki Nebukadnezzar abin da zai faru a kwanaki masu zuwa. Mafarkinka da wahayin da ya wuce cikin tunaninka a sa’ad da kake kwance a gadonka su ne,
english: but there is a God in heaven who reveals secrets, and he has made known to King Nebuchadnezzar what will be in the latter days. Your dream and the visions of your head on your bed are these:

hausa: Yesu ya gane suna so su tambaye shi game da wannan, sai ya ce musu, “Kuna tambayar juna game da abin da nake nufi da na ce, ‘Jim kaɗan ba za ku ƙara ganina ba, da kuma bayan an jima kaɗan, za ku gan ni’?
english: Therefore Jesus perceived that they wanted to ask him, and he said to them, “Do you inquire among yourselves concerning this, that I said, ‘A little while, and you won’t see me, and again a little while, and you will see me’?

hausa: cewa zuriyarsa za tă ci gaba har abada kuma kursiyinsa zai dawwama a gabana kamar rana;
english: His offspring will endure forever, his throne like the sun before me.

hausa: Duk surutanku kamar toka suke; kāriyarku na yimɓu ne.
english: Your memorable sayings are proverbs of ashes. Your defenses are defenses of clay.

hausa: “Sa’ad da mutum ya ci amana, ya kuma yi zunubi ba da gangan ba dangane da wani cikin abubuwa masu tsarki na Ubangiji, zai kawo ga Ubangiji rago daga garke wanda ba shi da lahani saboda yin hadaya don laifinsa. Za a kimata kuɗinsa bisa ga ma’aunin shekel na tsattsarkan wuri. Hadaya ce ta laifi.
english: “If anyone commits a trespass, and sins unwittingly regarding Yahweh’s holy things, then he shall bring his trespass offering to Yahweh: a ram without defect from the flock, according to your estimation in silver by shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary, for a trespass offering.

hausa: Musa ya ce wa Ubangiji,
english: Moses spoke to Yahweh, saying,

hausa: Hannuwanka ne suka yi suka kuma siffanta ni; ka ba ni ganewa don in koyi umarnanka.
english: Your hands have made me and formed me. Give me understanding, that I may learn your commandments.

hausa: Zuriyar Bela daga Ard da Na’aman, daga Ard, kabilar Ardawa; daga Na’aman, kabilar Na’amawa;
english: The sons of Bela were Ard and Naaman: the family of the Ardites; and of Naaman, the family of the Naamites.

hausa: Amma kai ne, mutum kamar ni, abokina, abokina na kurkusa,
english: But it was you, a man like me, my companion, and my familiar friend.

hausa: Amma a ce waɗansu ba su da bangaskiya fa? Rashin bangaskiyarsu nan zai shafe amincin Allah?
english: For what if some were without faith? Will their lack of faith nullify the faithfulness of God?

hausa: Sa’ad da Yaƙub ya kai shekaru arba’in da haihuwa, sai ya auri Yudit ’yar Beyeri mutumin Hitti, da kuma Basemat ’yar Elon mutumin Hitti.
english: When Esau was forty years old, he took as wife Judith, the daughter of Beeri the Hittite, and Basemath, the daughter of Elon the Hittite.

hausa: Ya yi abin da yake daidai a gaban Ubangiji ya kuma yi tafiya a hanyoyin kakansa Dawuda, ba tare da juye dama ko hagu ba.
english: He did that which was right in Yahweh’s eyes, and walked in the ways of David his father, and didn’t turn away to the right hand or to the left.

hausa: “ ‘A wannan Shekara ta Murna, kowa zai koma ga mallakarsa.
english: “‘In this Year of Jubilee each of you shall return to his property.

hausa: har zuwa ranar da aka ɗauke shi zuwa sama, bayan ya ba da umarnai ta wurin Ruhu Mai Tsarki ga manzannin da ya zaɓa.
english: until the day in which he was received up, after he had given commandment through the Holy Spirit to the apostles whom he had chosen.

hausa: Muna da abubuwa masu yawa da za mu faɗa game da wannan batu, sai dai yana da wuya a bayyana, da yake ba ku da saurin ganewa.
english: About him we have many words to say, and hard to interpret, seeing you have become dull of hearing.

hausa: Yana cikin addu’a, sai kamannin fuskarsa ta sāke, tufafinsa kuma suka zama da haske kamar hasken walƙiya.
english: As he was praying, the appearance of his face was altered, and his clothing became white and dazzling.

hausa: Dukan mutanen nan sun ba da baikonsu daga cikin arzikinsu ne, amma ita daga cikin talaucinta, ta saka duk abin da take da shi na rayuwa.”
english: for all these put in gifts for God from their abundance, but she, out of her poverty, put in all that she had to live on.”

hausa: suna da kunnuwa, amma ba sa ji, hanci, amma ba sa jin ƙanshi
english: They have ears, but they don’t hear. They have noses, but they don’t smell.

hausa: Zan cika alkawurana ga Ubangiji a gaban dukan mutanensa,
english: I will pay my vows to Yahweh, yes, in the presence of all his people,

hausa: Ƙaunar Kiristi a gare mu, ita take mallakarmu, saboda haka mun tabbata, da yake wani ya mutu saboda dukan mutane, ashe kuwa, mutuwarsu ce dukansu.
english: For the love of Christ compels us; because we judge thus: that one died for all, therefore all died.

hausa: “Gama tunanina ba tunaninku ba ne, yadda kuke yin abubuwa ba yadda nake yin abubuwa ba ne,” in ji Ubangiji.
english: “For my thoughts are not your thoughts, and your ways are not my ways,” says Yahweh.

hausa: Ya kuma gaya mana yadda wani mala’ika ya bayyana a gidansa ya ce masa, ‘Ka aika zuwa Yoffa a kira Siman wanda ake ce da shi Bitrus.
english: He told us how he had seen the angel standing in his house and saying to him, ‘Send to Joppa and get Simon, who is called Peter,

hausa: Ku kashe dukan ’yan bijimanta bari su gangara zuwa mayanka! Kaitonsu! Gama ranansu ta zo, lokaci ya yi da za a hukunta su.
english: Kill all her bulls. Let them go down to the slaughter. Woe to them! For their day has come, the time of their visitation.

hausa: “Yahuda, ’yan’uwanka za su yabe ka; hannuwanka za su kasance a wuyan abokan gābanka, ’ya’yan mahaifinka maza za su rusuna maka.
english: “Judah, your brothers will praise you. Your hand will be on the neck of your enemies. Your father’s sons will bow down before you.

hausa: Ya yi haka don mu yabi Allah saboda alherin da ya yi mana saboda mu na ƙaunataccen Ɗansa ne.
english: to the praise of the glory of his grace, by which he freely gave us favor in the Beloved.

hausa: haka maganata da take fitowa daga bakina. Ba za tă koma gare ni wofi ba, amma za tă cika abin da nake so ta kuma cika abin da na aike ta tă yi.
english: so is my word that goes out of my mouth: it will not return to me void, but it will accomplish that which I please, and it will prosper in the thing I sent it to do.

hausa: Dukan ɗaukakar iyalinsa za tă rataya a kansa daga ’ya’yansa da zuriyarsa har zuwa dukan ƙananan kayan aikinsa, wato, daga kwanoni har zuwa tuluna.
english: They will hang on him all the glory of his father’s house, the offspring and the issue, every small vessel, from the cups even to all the pitchers.

hausa: “Sa’an nan dukan al’ummai za su ce da ku masu albarka, gama ƙasarku za tă yi daɗin zama,” in ji Ubangiji Maɗaukaki.
english: “All nations shall call you blessed, for you will be a delightful land,” says Yahweh of Armies.

hausa: Saboda haka in kun yi biyayya ga umarnan da nake ba ku a yau cikin aminci, kuna ƙaunaci Ubangiji Allahnku, kuna kuma bauta masa da dukan zuciyarku da kuma dukan ranku,
english: It shall happen, if you shall listen diligently to my commandments which I command you today, to love Yahweh your God, and to serve him with all your heart and with all your soul,

hausa: Dukan mutanen da suka fito daga Masar an yi musu kaciya, amma duk waɗanda aka haifa a jeji a tafiya daga Masar, ba a yi musu ba.
english: For all the people who came out were circumcised; but all the people who were born in the wilderness along the way as they came out of Egypt had not been circumcised.

hausa: Na kafa alkawarina da ku, ba za a ƙara hallaka dukan rayuka da ambaliyar ruwa ba; ba za a ƙara yin ambaliya don a hallaka duniya ba.”
english: I will establish my covenant with you: All flesh will not be cut off any more by the waters of the flood. There will never again be a flood to destroy the earth.”

hausa: ka ce musu kowa yă ɗauki dutse ɗaya daga tsakiyar Urdun daidai inda firistoci suka tsaya, ku kai su, ku ajiye a inda za ku sauka yau.”
english: and command them, saying, ‘Take from out of the middle of the Jordan, out of the place where the priests’ feet stood firm, twelve stones, carry them over with you, and lay them down in the place where you’ll camp tonight.’”

hausa: Ana cikin haka, Shawulu ya ɗage yana barazana yin kisa da tsananta wa almajiran Ubangiji. Sai ya je wurin babban firist
english: But Saul, still breathing threats and slaughter against the disciples of the Lord, went to the high priest

hausa: A rana ta uku, da hannuwansu suka jefar da kayan aikin jirgin ruwan a cikin teku.
english: On the third day, they threw out the ship’s tackle with their own hands.

hausa: Amma in ba da nufin yă kashe shi ba, sai dai in Allah ne ya nufa haka, to, sai mutumin yă tsere zuwa inda zan nuna muku.
english: but not if it is unintentional, but God allows it to happen; then I will appoint you a place where he shall flee.

hausa: Zan kashe waɗanda suke zaune a wannan birni, mutane da dabbobi za su kuwa mutu da muguwar annoba.
english: I will strike the inhabitants of this city, both man and animal. They will die of a great pestilence.

hausa: Daga zuriyar Gad. Aka rubuta sunayen dukan maza ɗaya-ɗaya da suka kai shekara ashirin ko fiye da suka isa shiga soja, bisa ga iyalansu da kabilarsu da take a rubuce.
english: Of the children of Gad, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war:

hausa: Sai dattawan Mowab da na Midiyawa suka tashi, suka ɗauki kuɗi don duba. Da suka zo wurin Bala’am sai suka faɗa masa abin da Balak ya ce.
english: The elders of Moab and the elders of Midian departed with the rewards of divination in their hand. They came to Balaam, and spoke to him the words of Balak.

hausa: Sai dai zan kasance a Afisa har lokacin Fentekos,
english: But I will stay at Ephesus until Pentecost,

hausa: “Bakunansu sun cike da la’ana da ɗacin rai.”
english: “Their mouth is full of cursing and bitterness.”

hausa: Akwai wani mutum a garin, mai suna Zakka. Shi shugaban masu karɓar haraji ne, mai arziki kuma.
english: There was a man named Zacchaeus. He was a chief tax collector, and he was rich.

hausa: Cikin kwaɗayinsu waɗannan malaman ƙarya za su cuce ku da tatsuniyoyin da suka ƙaga. Hukuncinsu yana a rataye a kansu tun da daɗewa, hallakarsu kuma ba ta barci.
english: In covetousness they will exploit you with deceptive words: whose sentence now from of old doesn’t linger, and their destruction will not slumber.

hausa: Na san cewa sa’ad da na zo wurinku, zan zo ne cikin yalwar albarkar Kiristi.
english: I know that when I come to you, I will come in the fullness of the blessing of the Good News of Christ.

hausa: Dukan Isra’ilawa suka yi na’am da shi, suka yi yadda Ubangiji ya umarci Musa da Haruna.
english: All the children of Israel did so. As Yahweh commanded Moses and Aaron, so they did.

hausa: za su zama rai a gare ka, abin adon da zai gyara wuyanka.
english: so they will be life to your soul, and grace for your neck.

hausa: Amma, “Duk mai yin taƙama, sai ya yi taƙama da Ubangiji.”
english: But “he who boasts, let him boast in the Lord.”

hausa: Don mai bi da kaɗe-kaɗe. Bisa ga gittit. Na ’Ya’yan Kora maza. Zabura ce. Ina misalin kyan wurin zamanka, Ya Ubangiji Maɗaukaki!
english: For the Chief Musician. On an instrument of Gath. A Psalm by the sons of Korah. How lovely are your dwellings, Yahweh of Armies!

hausa: Ubangiji ya ce wa Shaiɗan, “To, shi ke nan, duk abin da yake da shi yana hannunka, amma kada ka taɓa shi, shi kansa.” Sai Shaiɗan ya bar Ubangiji.
english: Yahweh said to Satan, “Behold, all that he has is in your power. Only on himself don’t stretch out your hand.” So Satan went out from the presence of Yahweh.

hausa: Kada a ma ambaci fasikanci, da kowane irin aikin lalata, ko kwaɗayi a tsakaninku, domin bai dace da mutane masu tsarki na Allah ba.
english: But sexual immorality, and all uncleanness or covetousness, let it not even be mentioned among you, as becomes saints;

hausa: Haka ma, in wani ya yi gasa a matsayi shi ɗan wasa ne, ba ya sami rawanin nasara, sai in ya yi gasar bisa ga dokoki.
english: Also, if anyone competes in athletics, he isn’t crowned unless he has competed by the rules.

hausa: Ba za a iya sayenta da zinariyar Ofir, ko sauran duwatsu masu daraja ba.
english: It can’t be valued with the gold of Ophir, with the precious onyx, or the sapphire.

hausa: ba su kuma san hanyar salama ba.”
english: The way of peace, they haven’t known.”

hausa: na Anatot 128
english: The men of Anathoth, one hundred twenty-eight.

hausa: Ina mamaki yadda kuka yi saurin yashe wanda ya kira ku ta wurin alherin Kiristi, kuna juyewa ga wata bishara dabam
english: I marvel that you are so quickly deserting him who called you in the grace of Christ to a different “good news”,

hausa: Zuciyata tana wahala a cikina; tsorace-tsoracen mutuwa sun sha kaina.
english: My heart is severely pained within me. The terrors of death have fallen on me.

hausa: Ya tayar wa Sarki Nebukadnezzar, wanda ya sa ya yi rantsuwa da sunan Allah. Ya zama mai kunnen ƙashi da kuma taurin zuciya, bai kuwa juye ga Ubangiji, Allah na Isra’ila ba.
english: He also rebelled against King Nebuchadnezzar, who had made him swear by God; but he stiffened his neck, and hardened his heart against turning to Yahweh, the God of Israel.

hausa: Waɗanda suka san sunanka za su dogara da kai, gama kai, Ubangiji, ba ka taɓa yashe waɗanda suke nemanka ba.
english: Those who know your name will put their trust in you, for you, Yahweh, have not forsaken those who seek you.

hausa: Saboda haka sarkin Isra’ila ya fita tare da sarkin Yahuda, da kuma sarkin Edom. Da suka yi kwana bakwai suna ta zagawa, sai sojoji da dabbobi suka rasa ruwan sha.
english: So the king of Israel went with the king of Judah and the king of Edom, and they marched for seven days along a circuitous route. There was no water for the army or for the animals that followed them.

hausa: Gama kabari ba zai yabe ka ba, matattu ba za su rera yabonka ba; waɗanda suka gangara zuwa rami ba za su sa zuciya ga amincinka ba.
english: For Sheol can’t praise you. Death can’t celebrate you. Those who go down into the pit can’t hope for your truth.

hausa: Yayinda suke shan ruwan inabin, sai suka yabi allolin zinariya da azurfa, da na tagulla, da na ƙarfe, da na itace da kuma na dutse.
english: They drank wine, and praised the gods of gold, and of silver, of bronze, of iron, of wood, and of stone.

hausa: “Ga ƙasar da ta rage, “dukan yankunan Filistiyawa da na Geshurawa.
english: “This is the land that still remains: all the regions of the Philistines, and all the Geshurites;

hausa: Sa’an nan Shafan ya koma wurin sarki ya ce masa, “Hafsoshinka sun kwashe kuɗin da suke a haikalin Ubangiji, suka ba wa masu aiki da masu lura da haikalin.”
english: Shaphan the scribe came to the king, and brought the king word again, and said, “Your servants have emptied out the money that was found in the house, and have delivered it into the hands of the workmen who have the oversight of Yahweh’s house.”

hausa: Ku tā da hannuwanku a cikin wurinsa mai tsarki ku kuma yabi Ubangiji.
english: Lift up your hands in the sanctuary. Praise Yahweh!

hausa: Za a ɗaga hannunka cikin nasara a kan abokan gābanka, za a hallaka maƙiyanka duka.
english: Let your hand be lifted up above your adversaries, and let all of your enemies be cut off.

hausa: Yoshuwa ya ɗora duwatsu goma sha biyun a tsakiyar Urdun daidai inda firistoci waɗanda suke ɗauke da akwatin alkawarin Ubangiji suka tsaya. Suna nan a can har wa yau.
english: Joshua set up twelve stones in the middle of the Jordan, in the place where the feet of the priests who bore the ark of the covenant stood; and they are there to this day.

hausa: Ku yi shagalin Bikin Tabanakul har kwana bakwai, bayan kuka gama tattara amfanin gona daga masussukarku da kuma daga wuraren matsin inabinku.
