english: You shall keep the feast of booths seven days, after you have gathered in from your threshing floor and from your wine press.

hausa: Maryamu ta tambayi mala’ikan ta ce, “Yaya wannan zai yiwu, da yake ni budurwa ce?”
english: Mary said to the angel, “How can this be, seeing I am a virgin?”

hausa: “Me ya sa almajiranka suke karya al’adun dattawa? Ba sa wanke hannuwansu kafin su ci abinci!”
english: “Why do your disciples disobey the tradition of the elders? For they don’t wash their hands when they eat bread.”

hausa: Ruhun Allah ne ya yi ni; numfashin Maɗaukaki ya ba ni rai.
english: The Spirit of God has made me, and the breath of the Almighty gives me life.

hausa: Zan kawo muku madawwamiyar kunya, kunya ta har abada wadda ba za a taɓa manta ba.”
english: I will bring an everlasting reproach on you, and a perpetual shame, which will not be forgotten.’”

hausa: Iyakarsa daga yamma kuwa shi ne Urdun a Araba, daga Kinneret zuwa Tekun Araba (wato, Tekun Gishiri) a gangaren gindin Dutsen Fisga wajen gabas.
english: the Arabah also, and the Jordan and its border, from Chinnereth even to the sea of the Arabah, the Salt Sea, under the slopes of Pisgah eastward.

hausa: Sai Musa da Haruna suka ɗauki sunayen mutanen nan da aka ba su,
english: Moses and Aaron took these men who are mentioned by name.

hausa: “ ‘Firist ba zai ƙazantar da kansa ta wurin zuwa kusa da gawa ba; amma, in gawar mahaifinsa ko mahaifiyarsa, ko ɗansa ko ’yarsa, ko ɗan’uwansa ko ’yar’uwarsa ce, to, ba zai ƙazantar da kansa ba.
english: “‘“They shall go in to no dead person to defile themselves; but for father, or for mother, or for son, or for daughter, for brother, or for sister who has had no husband, they may defile themselves.

hausa: da kuma waɗansu mata waɗanda aka warkar da su daga cututtukansu, da kuma mugayen ruhohi. Cikinsu akwai Maryamu (wadda ake kira Magdalin) wadda aljanu bakwai suka fito daga cikinta.
english: and certain women who had been healed of evil spirits and infirmities: Mary who was called Magdalene, from whom seven demons had gone out;

hausa: da Rehum, da Hashabna, da Ma’asehiya
english: Rehum, Hashabnah, Maaseiah,

hausa: Tun daga wannan lokaci, Yesu ya fara wa’azi yana cewa, “Ku tuba, gama mulkin sama ya yi kusa.”
english: From that time, Jesus began to preach, and to say, “Repent! For the Kingdom of Heaven is at hand.”

hausa: Ransu ya ɓace, domin sun sa zuciya sosai; sa’ad da suka kai wurin kuwa ba su sami abin da suka sa zuciyar samu ba.
english: They were distressed because they were confident. They came there, and were confounded.

hausa: “ ‘Kada ku zagi kurma, ko ku sa abin tuntuɓe a gaban makaho, amma ku ji tsoron Allahnku. Ni ne Ubangiji.
english: “‘You shall not curse the deaf, nor put a stumbling block before the blind; but you shall fear your God. I am Yahweh.

hausa: Dole yă tsarkake kansa da ruwa a rana ta uku, da kuma a rana ta bakwai; sa’an nan zai zama da tsarki. Amma in bai tsarkake kansa a rana ta uku da kuma a rana ta bakwai ba, ba zai kasance da tsarki ba.
english: He shall purify himself with water on the third day, and on the seventh day he shall be clean; but if he doesn’t purify himself the third day, then the seventh day he shall not be clean.

hausa: “Kaiton Assuriya, sandar fushina, a hannun da kulkin fushina yake!
english: Alas Assyrian, the rod of my anger, the staff in whose hand is my indignation!

hausa: Sa’an nan na ga Ɗan Rago, yana kamar an yanka, tsaye a tsakiyar kursiyin, halittu huɗun nan masu rai da kuma dattawan an sun kewaye shi. Yana da ƙahoni bakwai da idanu bakwai, waɗanda suke ruhohi bakwai na Allah da aka aika cikin dukan duniya.
english: I saw in the middle of the throne and of the four living creatures, and in the middle of the elders, a Lamb standing, as though it had been slain, having seven horns and seven eyes, which are the seven Spirits of God, sent out into all the earth.

hausa: “ ‘Ba za su auri matan da karuwanci ya ɓata su, ko waɗanda mazansu suka sake su ba, gama firistoci masu tsarki ne ga Allahnsu.
english: “‘They shall not marry a woman who is a prostitute, or profane. A priest shall not marry a woman divorced from her husband; for he is holy to his God.

hausa: Ta’aziyyata cikin wahalata ita ce alkawarinka yana kiyaye raina.
english: This is my comfort in my affliction, for your word has revived me.

hausa: Game da Edom. Ga abin da Ubangiji Maɗaukaki yana cewa, “Babu sauran hikima a Teman ne? Shawara ta ɓace daga masu basira ne? Hikimarsu ta ruɓe ne?
english: Of Edom, Yahweh of Armies says: “Is wisdom no more in Teman? Has counsel perished from the prudent? Has their wisdom vanished?

hausa: Ban ci wani daga cikin tsattsarkan rabo yayinda nake makoki, ko in cire wani rabo mai tsarki yayinda nake marar tsarki, ko in miƙa wani sashensa ga matattu ba. Na yi biyayya ga Ubangiji Allahna, na aikata kome da ka umarce ni.
english: I have not eaten of it in my mourning, neither have I removed any of it while I was unclean, nor given of it for the dead. I have listened to Yahweh my God’s voice. I have done according to all that you have commanded me.

hausa: Na taɓa ganin bayi a kan dawakai, yayinda ’ya’yan sarki suna takawa a ƙasa kamar bayi.
english: I have seen servants on horses, and princes walking like servants on the earth.

hausa: “Zo! Zo! Ku gudu daga ƙasar arewa,” in ji Ubangiji, “gama na warwatsa ku a kusurwoyi huɗu na sama,” in ji Ubangiji.
english: Come! Come! Flee from the land of the north,’ says Yahweh; ‘for I have spread you abroad as the four winds of the sky,’ says Yahweh.

hausa: ’Ya’yan Bela maza su ne, Addar, Gera, Abihud
english: Bela had sons: Addar, Gera, Abihud,

hausa: Ku bi titi-titi ku gayyato duk waɗanda kuka gani, su zo bikin.’
english: Go therefore to the intersections of the highways, and as many as you may find, invite to the wedding feast.’

hausa: Ya ce, ‘Bari in tafi gama iyalinmu suna miƙa hadaya a gari, ’yan’uwana kuwa sun gayyace ni in kasance a can. In na sami yardarka, bari in tafi in ga ’yan’uwana.’ Dalilin ke nan da bai zo ci da sarki ba.”
english: He said, ‘Please let me go, for our family has a sacrifice in the city. My brother has commanded me to be there. Now, if I have found favor in your eyes, please let me go away and see my brothers.’ Therefore he has not come to the king’s table.”

hausa: “Duk wanda ya ƙi yă yi alheri ga aboki ya rabu ta tsoron Maɗaukaki.
english: “To him who is ready to faint, kindness should be shown from his friend; even to him who forsakes the fear of the Almighty.

hausa: Amma in, sa’ad da firist ya bincika wannan irin mikin, bai yi zurfi fiye da fatar jiki ba kuma babu baƙin gashi a cikinsa, firist ɗin zai kaɗaice mutum mai fama da cutar, kwana bakwai.
english: If the priest examines the plague of itching, and behold, its appearance isn’t deeper than the skin, and there is no black hair in it, then the priest shall isolate the person infected with itching seven days.

hausa: “Kwanakina suna wucewa da sauri, fiye da yadda ƙoshiyar masaƙa take wucewa da sauri, za su kawo ga ƙarshe ba bege.
english: My days are swifter than a weaver’s shuttle, and are spent without hope.

hausa: Suka kuma yi masa baki mai fāɗin tafi hannu, suka yi zubin zinariya a bisa bakin.
english: He made a border of a hand’s width around it, and made a golden molding on its border around it.

hausa: Saboda haka Bilatus ya fito wajensu ya ce, “Wace ƙara kuke kawowa game da mutumin nan?”
english: Pilate therefore went out to them and said, “What accusation do you bring against this man?”

hausa: “Ko da yake na yi kuka cewa, ‘An yi mini ba daidai ba!’ Ba a amsa mini ba; ko da yake na nemi taimako, ba a yi adalci ba.
english: “Behold, I cry out of wrong, but I am not heard. I cry for help, but there is no justice.

hausa: Na kuma ji bagaden ya amsa, “I, Ubangiji Allah, Maɗaukaki, hukuntanka daidai yake na adalci ne kuma.”
english: I heard the altar saying, “Yes, Lord God, the Almighty, true and righteous are your judgments.”

hausa: Ma’arat, Bet-Anot, Eltekon, garuruwa shida ke nan da ƙauyukansu.
english: Maarath, Beth Anoth, and Eltekon; six cities with their villages.

hausa: Matsaran suna a kusurwoyi huɗu, gabas, yamma, arewa da kudu.
english: On the four sides were the gatekeepers, toward the east, west, north, and south.

hausa: A wannan lokaci mun ci dukan biranensa, muka kuma hallaka su, maza, mata da kuma yara. Ba mu bar wani da rai ba.
english: We took all his cities at that time, and utterly destroyed every inhabited city, with the women and the little ones. We left no one remaining.

hausa: A ran ashirin da bakwai ga wata na biyu, ƙasa ta bushe ƙaƙaf.
english: In the second month, on the twenty-seventh day of the month, the earth was dry.

hausa: Mala’ikan ya ce mini, “Waɗannan kalmomi amintattu ne gaskiya ne kuma. Ubangiji, Allahn ruhohin annabawa, ya aiki mala’ikansa, don yă nuna wa bayinsa abubuwan da za su faru nan ba da daɗewa ba.”
english: He said to me, “These words are faithful and true. The Lord God of the spirits of the prophets sent his angel to show to his bondservants the things which must happen soon.”

hausa: “Domin kakanninmu sun ji kishin Yusuf, sai suka sayar da shi bawa zuwa Masar. Amma Allah ya kasance tare da shi
english: “The patriarchs, moved with jealousy against Joseph, sold him into Egypt. God was with him

hausa: Shi kansa zai fanshi Isra’ila daga dukan zunubansu.
english: He will redeem Israel from all their sins.

hausa: Sai ga mutumin Kush ya iso ya ce, “Ranka yă daɗe sarki, ka ji labari mai kyau! Ubangiji ya cece ka yau daga dukan waɗanda suka tayar maka.”
english: Behold, the Cushite came. The Cushite said, “Good news for my lord the king, for Yahweh has avenged you today of all those who rose up against you.”

hausa: A gefen gabas, wanda yake da tsawon kamu 4,500 zai kasance da ƙofofi uku, ƙofar Yusuf, ƙofar Benyamin da ƙofar Dan.
english: “At the east side four thousand five hundred reeds, and three gates: even the gate of Joseph, one; the gate of Benjamin, one; the gate of Dan, one.

hausa: Kalmomin nan, “aka lissafta a gare shi” ba a rubuta su saboda shi kaɗai ba ne,
english: Now it was not written that it was accounted to him for his sake alone,

hausa: To, fa, Filistiyawa suka zo suka kai wa Kwarin Refayim hari;
english: Now the Philistines had come and made a raid in the valley of Rephaim.

hausa: “Ka ƙera kakaki guda biyu na azurfa, ka kuma yi amfani da su don kira taron jama’a wuri ɗaya, don kuma ka riƙa sanar da su lokacin tashi daga sansani.
english: “Make two trumpets of silver. You shall make them of beaten work. You shall use them for the calling of the congregation and for the journeying of the camps.

hausa: Sai suka zo don su roƙe su, suka yi musu rakiya daga kurkukun, suna roƙonsu su bar birnin.
english: and they came and begged them. When they had brought them out, they asked them to depart from the city.

hausa: Ruwan sama yana da mahaifi? Wa ya zama mahaifin raɓa?
english: Does the rain have a father? Or who fathers the drops of dew?

hausa: Ya miƙa abin da ya yi kamar hannu ya kama a gashin kaina. Ruhu ya ɗaga ni tsakanin sama da ƙasa, a cikin wahayoyi kuma Allah ya ɗauke ni zuwa Urushalima, zuwa ƙofa zuwa gabas na cikin fili, inda gunki mai tsokanar kishi yake tsaye.
english: He stretched out the form of a hand, and took me by a lock of my head; and the Spirit lifted me up between earth and the sky, and brought me in the visions of God to Jerusalem, to the door of the gate of the inner court that looks toward the north, where there was the seat of the image of jealousy, which provokes to jealousy.

hausa: Musa ya ce wa mutane, “Kada ku ji tsoro, gama Allah ya zo don yă gwada ku, don ku riƙa girmama shi, don kuma kada ku yi zunubi.”
english: Moses said to the people, “Don’t be afraid, for God has come to test you, and that his fear may be before you, that you won’t sin.”

hausa: Ka ba wa Haruna da ’ya’yansa kuɗin fansar da ya haura kai na ’ya’yan farin Isra’ilawa.”
english: and you shall give the money, with which their remainder is redeemed, to Aaron and to his sons.”

hausa: Wannan ya faru ne don a cika abin da aka faɗa ta bakin annabin cewa,
english: All this was done that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through the prophet, saying,

hausa: To, sai ku ci gaba ku cikasa ayyukan da kakanninku suka fara!
english: Fill up, then, the measure of your fathers.

hausa: Amma ruhun da yake cikin mutum, numfashin Maɗaukaki shi ne yake ba shi ganewa.
english: But there is a spirit in man, and the Spirit of the Almighty gives them understanding.

hausa: In wata gaɓa tana a damuwa, duk sai su damu tare. In kuma an ɗaukaka wata gaɓa, sai duk su yi farin ciki tare.
english: When one member suffers, all the members suffer with it. When one member is honored, all the members rejoice with it.

hausa: “Ga bawana da na zaɓa, ƙaunataccena, wanda nake farin ciki da shi; zan sa Ruhuna a kansa, zai kuma yi shelar adalci ga al’ummai.
english: “Behold, my servant whom I have chosen, my beloved in whom my soul is well pleased. I will put my Spirit on him. He will proclaim justice to the nations.

hausa: Don haka, Ɗan Mutum Ubangiji ne, har ma da na Asabbaci.”
english: Therefore the Son of Man is lord even of the Sabbath.”

hausa: Wannan ita ce hadaya ta ƙonawa ta kowace Asabbaci, ban da hadaya ta ƙonawa ta kullum, tare da ta hadaya ta sha.
english: this is the burnt offering of every Sabbath, in addition to the continual burnt offering and its drink offering.

hausa: Da Asabbaci ya wuce, sai Maryamu Magdalin, Maryamu mahaifiyar Yaƙub, da kuma Salome suka sayi kayan ƙanshi domin su je su shafa wa jikin Yesu.
english: When the Sabbath was past, Mary Magdalene, and Mary the mother of James, and Salome bought spices, that they might come and anoint him.

hausa: Ubangiji ya ce wa Musa,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

hausa: Dukan kwanakinmu sun wuce ƙarƙashin fushinka; mun gama shekarunmu da nishi.
english: For all our days have passed away in your wrath. We bring our years to an end as a sigh.

hausa: Dawuda ɗan Yesse ya zama sarki a bisa dukan Isra’ila.
english: Now David the son of Jesse reigned over all Israel.

hausa: Ubangiji ba zai gafarce shi ba, fushinsa da kishinsa za su ƙuna a kan wannan mutum. Dukan la’anonin da aka rubuta a wannan littafi za su fāɗo a kansa, Ubangiji kuwa zai shafe sunansa daga ƙarƙashin sama.
english: Yahweh will not pardon him, but then Yahweh’s anger and his jealousy will smoke against that man, and all the curse that is written in this book will fall on him, and Yahweh will blot out his name from under the sky.

hausa: Yayinda abokan gāba suka gangaro wajensa, sai Elisha ya yi addu’a ga Ubangiji ya ce, “Ka sa mutanen nan su zama makafi.” Sai Ubangiji ya buge su da makanta kamar yadda Elisha ya roƙa.
english: When they came down to him, Elisha prayed to Yahweh, and said, “Please strike this people with blindness.” He struck them with blindness according to Elisha’s word.

hausa: Ruwan sama ya sauko, rafuffuka suka cika, iska kuwa ta hura ta bugi gidan, sai ya fāɗi da mummunar ragargajewa kuwa.”
english: The rain came down, the floods came, and the winds blew and beat on that house; and it fell—and its fall was great.”

hausa: Uriya firist kuwa ya yi duk abin da Sarki Ahaz ya umarta.
english: Urijah the priest did so, according to all that King Ahaz commanded.

hausa: “Zuwa ga mala’ikan ikkilisiya a Afisa, ka rubuta, Waɗannan su ne kalmomi na wannan wanda yake riƙe da taurari bakwai a hannunsa na dama yana kuma tafiya a tsakanin alkukan fitilu bakwai na zinariya.
english: “To the angel of the assembly in Ephesus write: “He who holds the seven stars in his right hand, he who walks among the seven golden lamp stands says these things:

hausa: A lokacin in wani ya ce muku, ‘Duba, ga Kiristi nan!’ Ko, ‘Ga shi can!’ Kada ku gaskata.
english: “Then if any man tells you, ‘Behold, here is the Christ!’ or, ‘There!’ don’t believe it.

hausa: Babban birnin ya rabu kashi uku, biranen al’ummai kuma suka rurrushe. Allah ya tuna da Babilon Mai Girma ya kuma ba ta kwaf cike da ruwan inabin fushinsa.
english: The great city was divided into three parts, and the cities of the nations fell. Babylon the great was remembered in the sight of God, to give to her the cup of the wine of the fierceness of his wrath.

hausa: Ka aiko da haskenka da gaskiyarka, bari su bishe ni bari su kawo ni ga dutsenka mai tsarki, zuwa wurin da kake zama.
english: Oh, send out your light and your truth. Let them lead me. Let them bring me to your holy hill, to your tents.

hausa: Gari yana wayewa, sai Shawulu ya raba mutane kashi uku, a sa’a ta ƙarshe na daren sai suka fāɗa wa sansanin Ammonawa, suka kuma karkashe su har lokacin da rana ta yi zafi. Waɗanda suka kuɓuce kuwa suka warwatsu, har babu biyunsu da aka bari tare.
english: On the next day, Saul put the people in three companies; and they came into the middle of the camp in the morning watch, and struck the Ammonites until the heat of the day. Those who remained were scattered, so that no two of them were left together.

hausa: “Sai ɗan ya ce masa, ‘Baba, na yi wa sama, na kuma yi maka zunubi. Ni ban isa a ƙara kira na ɗanka ba.’
english: The son said to him, ‘Father, I have sinned against heaven and in your sight. I am no longer worthy to be called your son.’

hausa: Maganar Ubangiji ta zo mini cewa,
english: Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

hausa: Ya ƙara da cewa, “Faɗa albashinka, zan kuwa biya shi.”
english: He said, “Appoint me your wages, and I will give it.”

hausa: Ubangiji Allah ya ɗauko mutumin ya sa shi cikin Lambun Eden domin yă nome shi, yă kuma lura da shi.
english: Yahweh God took the man, and put him into the garden of Eden to cultivate and keep it.

hausa: A dā Allah ya yi wa kakanni-kakanninmu magana ta bakin annabawa a lokuta dabam-dabam da kuma a hanyoyi iri-iri,
english: God, having in the past spoken to the fathers through the prophets at many times and in various ways,

hausa: aka gayyaci Yesu da almajiransa su ma a auren.
english: Jesus also was invited, with his disciples, to the wedding.

hausa: Amma ku fahimci wannan. Da maigida ya san sa’ar da ɓarawo zai zo, ai, da ba zai bari a shiga, a fasa masa gida ba.
english: But know this, that if the master of the house had known in what hour the thief was coming, he would have watched and not allowed his house to be broken into.

hausa: Suka kuma aika da Hashabiya tare da Yeshahiya daga zuriyar Merari, da ’yan’uwansu da kuma ’ya’yansu, su kuma mutum 20 ne.
english: and Hashabiah, and with him Jeshaiah of the sons of Merari, his brothers and their sons, twenty;

hausa: Matakai bakwai sun haura zuwa ƙofar, da shirayi ɗaura da matakan; tana da zāne-zānen adon itatuwan dabino a bangayen a kowane gefe.
english: There were seven steps to go up to it, and its arches were before them. It had palm trees, one on this side, and another on that side, on its posts.

hausa: Sai samarin waɗanda suka je leƙen asirin suka shiga suka fitar da Rahab, mahaifinta da mahaifiyarta, da ’yan’uwanta da duk abin da yake nata. Suka fitar da iyalinta gaba ɗaya suka sa su a wani wuri, ba a cikin masauƙin Isra’ilawa ba.
english: The young men who were spies went in, and brought out Rahab with her father, her mother, her brothers, and all that she had. They also brought out all of her relatives, and they set them outside of the camp of Israel.

hausa: “Ni ne Ubangiji Allah na dukan ’yan adam. Akwai wani abin da ya gagare ni?
english: “Behold, I am Yahweh, the God of all flesh. Is there anything too hard for me?

hausa: “Na maishe ka mai jarrabawar ƙarfe mutanena ne kuwa ƙarfen, don ka lura ka kuma gwada hanyoyinsu.
english: “I have made you a tester of metals and a fortress among my people, that you may know and try their way.

hausa: Tarin fāra za su mamaye dukan itatuwanku da kuma hatsin gonarku.
english: Locusts will consume all of your trees and the fruit of your ground.

hausa: Ga abin da Ubangiji yana cewa, “In waɗanda ba su dace su sha kwaf ɗin ba suka sha shi, me ya sa za ka kuɓuta? Ba za ka kuɓuta ba, sai ka sha shi.
english: For Yahweh says: “Behold, they to whom it didn’t pertain to drink of the cup will certainly drink; and are you he who will altogether go unpunished? You won’t go unpunished, but you will surely drink.

hausa: Isra’ila ya ce wa Yusuf, “Yanzu ina a shirye in mutu, da yake na gani da kaina cewa har yanzu kana da rai.”
english: Israel said to Joseph, “Now let me die, since I have seen your face, that you are still alive.”

hausa: To, ko ni ne, ko su ne, wannan shi ne abin da muke wa’azi, shi ne kuma abin da kuka gaskata.
english: Whether then it is I or they, so we preach, and so you believed.

hausa: A bisa kawunan rayayyun halittun nan akwai abin da ya yi kamar ƙanƙara, mai bantsoro.
english: Over the head of the living creature there was the likeness of an expanse, like an awesome crystal to look at, stretched out over their heads above.

hausa: Sai ɗaukakar Ubangiji ya tashi daga bisa kerubobi ya tafi zuwa madogarar ƙofar haikali. Girgijen ya cika haikali, filin kuwa ya cika da hasken ɗaukakar Ubangiji.
english: Yahweh’s glory mounted up from the cherub, and stood over the threshold of the house; and the house was filled with the cloud, and the court was full of the brightness of Yahweh’s glory.

hausa: ya ce masa, ‘Ka kwashe kayan nan ka je ka zuba su a cikin haikalin Allah a Urushalima. Ka kuma sāke gina gidan Allah a wurin da yake a dā.’
english: He said to him, ‘Take these vessels, go, put them in the temple that is in Jerusalem, and let God’s house be built in its place.’

hausa: Maganar Ubangiji ta zo mini cewa,
english: Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

hausa: Gaskiya nake gaya muku. A cikin dukan waɗanda mata suka haifa, ba wani da ya taso da ya fi Yohanna Mai Baftisma girma; duk da haka mafi ƙanƙanta a mulkin sama ya fi shi girma.
english: Most certainly I tell you, among those who are born of women there has not arisen anyone greater than John the Baptizer; yet he who is least in the Kingdom of Heaven is greater than he.

hausa: “Amma in ka juya daga gare ni ka yashe ƙa’idodi da umarnan da na ba ka, ka yi gaban kanka don ka bauta wa waɗansu alloli ka kuma yi musu sujada,
english: But if you turn away and forsake my statutes and my commandments which I have set before you, and go and serve other gods and worship them,

hausa: Gama duk wanda ba ya gāba da mu, namu ne.
english: For whoever is not against us is on our side.

hausa: Saboda haka, da yake Kiristi ya sha wahala a jikinsa, sai ku ma ku yi wa kanku ɗamara da irin wannan hali, gama wanda ya sha wahala a jikinsa ya gama da zunubi ke nan.
english: Therefore, since Christ suffered for us in the flesh, arm yourselves also with the same mind; for he who has suffered in the flesh has ceased from sin,

hausa: “Faɗa wa Isra’ilawa cewa, ‘A ranar goma sha biyar ga wata na bakwai, za a fara Bikin Tabanakul na Ubangiji, zai kuma ɗauki kwana bakwai.
english: “Speak to the children of Israel, and say, ‘On the fifteenth day of this seventh month is the feast of booths for seven days to Yahweh.

hausa: Kun ɗaga masujadar sarkinku, siffofin gumakanku, tauraron allahnku, wanda kuka yi wa kanku.
english: You also carried the tent of your king and the shrine of your images, the star of your god, which you made for yourselves.

hausa: “ ‘Ku tsarkake kanku, ku kuma zama da tsarki, gama Ni ne Ubangiji Allahnku.
english: “‘Sanctify yourselves therefore, and be holy; for I am Yahweh your God.

hausa: Haka ku ma, ku ɗauke kanku matattu ne ga ikon zunubi amma rayayyu cikin tarayya da Allah cikin Kiristi Yesu.
english: Thus consider yourselves also to be dead to sin, but alive to God in Christ Jesus our Lord.

hausa: Ya rushe bagadan da sarakunan Yahuda suka kafa a kan ɗakin sama kusa da ɗakin sama na Ahaz, da kuma bagadai biyu da Manasse ya gina a filaye biyu na haikalin Ubangiji. Ya kawar da su daga can, ya farfashe su, ya zubar da tarkacen a Kwarin Kidron.
english: The king broke down the altars that were on the roof of the upper room of Ahaz, which the kings of Judah had made, and the altars which Manasseh had made in the two courts of Yahweh’s house, and beat them down from there, and cast their dust into the brook Kidron.

hausa: Gama daga ciki, daga zuciyar mutane, mugayen tunani suke fitowa, fasikanci, sata, kisankai, zina,
english: For from within, out of the hearts of men, proceed evil thoughts, adulteries, sexual sins, murders, thefts,

hausa: Sai mala’ikan ya ce mini, “Rubuta, ‘Masu albarka ne waɗanda aka gayyace su zuwa bikin auren Ɗan Ragon!’ ” Sai ya ƙara da cewa, “Waɗannan su ne kalmomin Allah da gaske.”
english: He said to me, “Write, ‘Blessed are those who are invited to the wedding supper of the Lamb.’” He said to me, “These are true words of God.”

hausa: ɗan Elkana, ɗan Yeroham, ɗan Eliyel, ɗan Towa,
english: the son of Elkanah, the son of Jeroham, the son of Eliel, the son of Toah,

hausa: Haman ya ƙara da cewa, “Ba duka ke nan ba, kai, ni ne kaɗai mutumin da Sarauniya Esta ta gayyata yă tafi tare da sarki zuwa liyafar da ta shirya. Ta sāke gayyace ni tare da sarki gobe.
english: Haman also said, “Yes, Esther the queen let no man come in with the king to the banquet that she had prepared but myself; and tomorrow I am also invited by her together with the king.

hausa: Murya ta shela daga Dan, tana furtawa masifa daga tuddan Efraim.
english: For a voice declares from Dan, and publishes evil from the hills of Ephraim:

hausa: Sa’ad da aka tattara Isra’ilawa, aka kuma ba su guzuri, sai suka taka suka fita don su sadu da Arameyawa. Isra’ilawa suka kafa sansani ɗaura da su kamar ƙananan garkuna biyu na awaki, yayinda Arameyawa suka rufe dukan jejin.
english: The children of Israel were mustered and given provisions, and went against them. The children of Israel encamped before them like two little flocks of young goats, but the Syrians filled the country.

hausa: Mai tsaro ya amsa, “Safiya ta gabato, haka kuma dare. In za ka yi tambaya, to, yi tambaya; sai ka sāke zuwa, ka tambaya.”
english: The watchman said, “The morning comes, and also the night. If you will inquire, inquire. Come back again.”

hausa: Amma zan zauna a cikinki masu tawali’u da masu ƙasƙantar da kai, waɗanda suke dogara ga sunan Ubangiji.
english: But I will leave among you an afflicted and poor people, and they will take refuge in Yahweh’s name.

hausa: Ta wajen yamma kuma sashen Efraim za su yi sansani a ƙarƙashin ƙa’idarsu. Shugaban mutanensa, shi ne Elishama ɗan Ammihud.
english: “On the west side shall be the standard of the camp of Ephraim according to their divisions. The prince of the children of Ephraim shall be Elishama the son of Ammihud.

hausa: mazaunan wani birni za su je wurin mazaunan wani birni su ce, ‘Bari mu je nan da nan mu roƙi Ubangiji mu kuma nemi Ubangiji Maɗaukaki. Ni kaina zan je.’
english: The inhabitants of one will go to another, saying, ‘Let’s go speedily to entreat the favor of Yahweh, and to seek Yahweh of Armies. I will go also.’

hausa: Enok ma, wanda yake na bakwai daga Adamu, ya yi annabci game da waɗannan mutane cewa, “Duba, Ubangiji yana zuwa da dubu dubban tsarkakansa
english: About these also Enoch, the seventh from Adam, prophesied, saying, “Behold, the Lord came with ten thousands of his holy ones,

hausa: Ishaya ya ɗaga murya game da Isra’ila ya ce, “Ko da yake yawan Isra’ilawa yana kama da yashi a bakin teku, ragowa ce kaɗai za su sami ceto.
english: Isaiah cries concerning Israel, “If the number of the children of Israel are as the sand of the sea, it is the remnant who will be saved;

hausa: Za a yanka sanku a idanunku, amma ba za ko ci wani abu a cikinsa ba. Za a ƙwace jakinku ƙiri-ƙiri, amma ba za a mayar muku da shi ba. Za a ba da tumakinku ga abokan gābanku, kuma ba kowa da zai cece su.
english: Your ox will be slain before your eyes, and you will not eat any of it. Your donkey will be violently taken away from before your face, and will not be restored to you. Your sheep will be given to your enemies, and you will have no one to save you.

hausa: Ɗan Ulam shi ne, Bedan. Duka waɗannan zuriyar Gileyad ne. Gileyad ɗan Makir ne, Makir kuma ɗan Manasse.
english: The sons of Ulam: Bedan. These were the sons of Gilead the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh.

hausa: Abin da yake tanƙwararre ba zai miƙu ba; ba za a kuma iya ƙidaya abin da ba shi ba.
english: That which is crooked can’t be made straight; and that which is lacking can’t be counted.

hausa: Saboda haka na aika a zo da kai nan da nan, ya kuma yi kyau da ka zo. To ga mu duka a nan a gaban Allah don mu saurari dukan abin da Ubangiji ya umarce ka ka faɗa mana.”
english: Therefore I sent to you at once, and it was good of you to come. Now therefore we are all here present in the sight of God to hear all things that have been commanded you by God.”

hausa: Suka yi ƙararrawa da zinariya zalla, suka sa su a tsakanin fasalin ’ya’yan rumman kewaye da gefe-gefen taguwa.
english: They made bells of pure gold, and put the bells between the pomegranates around the skirts of the robe, between the pomegranates;

hausa: Bilatus ya amsa ya ce, “Abin da na rubuta, na rubuta.”
english: Pilate answered, “What I have written, I have written.”

hausa: Duniya dai ta lalace sosai a gaban Allah, ta kuma cika da tashin hankali.
english: The earth was corrupt before God, and the earth was filled with violence.

hausa: Ina faɗa muku cewa waniwanda ya fi haikali yana a nan.
english: But I tell you that one greater than the temple is here.

hausa: Mutanen Efraim sun kewaye ni da ƙarairayi, gidan Isra’ila da ruɗu. Mutanen Yahuda kuma suna yi wa Allah ƙin ji, har ma a kan Mai Tsarkin nan mai aminci.
english: Ephraim surrounds me with falsehood, and the house of Israel with deceit. Judah still strays from God, and is unfaithful to the Holy One.

hausa: Na farin dai suna wa’azin Kiristi da sonkai ne, ba da zuciya ɗaya ba, a sonsu, su wahalar da ni a cikin sarƙoƙi.
english: but the latter out of love, knowing that I am appointed for the defense of the Good News.

hausa: ka haɗa kai da mu, za mu kuwa raba abin da muka sato”
english: You shall cast your lot among us. We’ll all have one purse”—

hausa: A yanzu, yunwa ta yi tsanani a ƙasar.
english: The famine was severe in the land.

hausa: Aka kuma ɗauki matar Samson aka ba wa ɗaya daga cikin waɗanda suka yi masa hidima a bikin.
english: But Samson’s wife was given to his companion, who had been his friend.

hausa: Ba na dogara ga bakana, takobina ba ya kawo nasara;
english: For I will not trust in my bow, neither will my sword save me.

hausa: gama Tudun Sihiyona ya zama kufai, sai diloli ke yawo a wurin.
english: for the mountain of Zion, which is desolate. The foxes walk on it.

hausa: Liyatu tana da raunannun idanu, amma Rahila dai tsarinta yana da kyau kuma kyakkyawa ce.
english: Leah’s eyes were weak, but Rachel was beautiful in form and attractive.

hausa: Daga zuriyar Harim, akwai Eliyezer, Isshiya, Malkiya, Shemahiya, Simeyon,
english: Of the sons of Harim: Eliezer, Isshijah, Malchijah, Shemaiah, Shimeon,

hausa: Wannan shi ne burodin da ya sauko daga sama. Kakannin-kakanninku sun ci Manna suka kuma mutu, amma duk wanda yake cin wannan burodi zai rayu har abada.”
english: This is the bread which came down out of heaven—not as our fathers ate the manna and died. He who eats this bread will live forever.”

hausa: “ ‘Baƙon da yake zaune a cikinku wanda yake so yă yi Bikin Ƙetarewar Ubangiji, dole yă yi shi bisa ga dokokinsa da ƙa’idodinsa. Dole ku kasance da ƙa’ida ɗaya ga baƙo da kuma ɗan ƙasa.’ ”
english: “‘If a foreigner lives among you and desires to keep the Passover to Yahweh, then he shall do so according to the statute of the Passover, and according to its ordinance. You shall have one statute, both for the foreigner and for him who is born in the land.’”

hausa: Sai ya zaɓi mutum biyar daga cikin ’yan’uwansa, ya gabatar da su a gaban Fir’auna.
english: From among his brothers he took five men, and presented them to Pharaoh.

hausa: Mutuwar da ya yi, ya mutu ne sau ɗaya tak, saboda yă shafe zunubi, amma rayuwar da yake yi, yana yi ne cikin tarayya da Allah.
english: For the death that he died, he died to sin one time; but the life that he lives, he lives to God.

hausa: Ka rufe ni da tsoka da fata, ka harhaɗa ni da ƙasusuwa da jijiyoyi?
english: You have clothed me with skin and flesh, and knit me together with bones and sinews.

hausa: “Saboda ka yi nishi, ɗan mutum! Yi nishi a gabansu da ajiyar zuciya da ɓacin rai.
english: “Therefore sigh, you son of man. You shall sigh before their eyes with a broken heart and with bitterness.

hausa: Abu guda ya rage, ka shirya mini masauƙi, domin ina bege za a mayar da ni gare ku albarkacin addu’o’inku.
english: Also, prepare a guest room for me, for I hope that through your prayers I will be restored to you.

hausa: Ni ne na koya wa Efraim tafiya ina kama su da hannu; amma ba su gane cewa ni ne na warkar da su ba.
english: Yet I taught Ephraim to walk. I took them by their arms, but they didn’t know that I healed them.

hausa: Yawan mutanen sashensa 74,600 ne.
english: His division, and those who were counted of them, were seventy-four thousand six hundred.

hausa: Sai Sarki Solomon ya rantse da sunan Ubangiji ya ce, “Bari Allah yă yi mini hukunci mai tsanani, idan ban sa Adoniya ya biya wannan roƙo da ransa ba!
english: Then King Solomon swore by Yahweh, saying, “God do so to me, and more also, if Adonijah has not spoken this word against his own life.

hausa: da yake ba su karɓi shawarata ba suka kuwa yi kunnen ƙashi ga tsawatata,
english: They wanted none of my counsel. They despised all my reproof.

hausa: Da suka hau jirgin ruwan, sai iskar ta kwanta.
english: When they got up into the boat, the wind ceased.

hausa: Bayan ta yaye Lo-Ruhama, sai Gomer ta sāke haifi wani ɗa namiji.
english: Now when she had weaned Lo-Ruhamah, she conceived, and bore a son.

hausa: Ka kewaye akwatin da zoban zinariya huɗu ka kuma haɗa su da ƙafafunsa huɗu, zobai biyu a kowane gefe.
english: You shall cast four rings of gold for it, and put them in its four feet. Two rings shall be on the one side of it, and two rings on the other side of it.

hausa: Sa’an nan ka ɗauki kwalabar man ka zuba a kansa, ka ce, ‘Ga abin da Ubangiji ya faɗa, na naɗa ka sarkin Isra’ila.’ Sa’an nan ka buɗe ƙofa ka ruga a guje; kada ka ɓata lokaci!”
english: Then take the vial of oil, and pour it on his head, and say, ‘Yahweh says, “I have anointed you king over Israel.”’ Then open the door, flee, and don’t wait.”

hausa: Fenuwel shi ne mahaifin Gedor, kuma Ezer shi ne mahaifin Husha. Waɗannan su ne zuriyar Hur, ɗan farin Efrata da mahaifin Betlehem.
english: Penuel was the father of Gedor and Ezer the father of Hushah. These are the sons of Hur, the firstborn of Ephrathah, the father of Bethlehem.

hausa: Ko da yake Melkizedek ba daga zuriyar Lawi ba ne, duk da haka Ibrahim ya ba shi kashi ɗaya bisa goma na abin da yake da shi, Melkizedek kuwa ya sa masa albarka, shi da aka yi wa alkawura.
english: but he whose genealogy is not counted from them has accepted tithes from Abraham, and has blessed him who has the promises.

hausa: Leɓunana za su yi sowa don farin ciki sa’ad da na rera yabo gare ka, ni, wanda ka fansa.
english: My lips shall shout for joy! My soul, which you have redeemed, sings praises to you!

hausa: da Horiyawa a ƙasar tudun Seyir har zuwa El Faran kusa da hamada.
english: and the Horites in their Mount Seir, to El Paran, which is by the wilderness.

hausa: Amma suka yi shiru, don a hanya suna gardama ne, a kan ko wane ne a cikinsu ya fi girma?
english: But they were silent, for they had disputed with one another on the way about who was the greatest.

hausa: Sa’ad da dukan aikin da Solomon ya yi domin haikalin Ubangiji ya gama, sai ya kawo abubuwan da mahaifinsa Dawuda ya keɓe a ciki, azurfa da zinariya da kuma dukan kayayyaki, ya kuwa sa su a cikin ma’ajin haikalin Allah.
english: Thus all the work that Solomon did for Yahweh’s house was finished. Solomon brought in the things that David his father had dedicated, even the silver, the gold, and all the vessels, and put them in the treasuries of God’s house.

hausa: Zadok firist kuwa da annabi Natan sun shafe shi sarki a Gihon. Daga can suka haura suna kirari, birni kuwa ta ɓarke da sowa. Surutun da kake ji ke nan.
english: Zadok the priest and Nathan the prophet have anointed him king in Gihon. They have come up from there rejoicing, so that the city rang again. This is the noise that you have heard.

hausa: Gama ta wurinsa dukanmu za mu iya zuwa gun Uba ta wurin Ruhu guda.
english: For through him we both have our access in one Spirit to the Father.

hausa: Ya jefa ni cikin laka, na zama ba kome ba sai ƙura da toka.
english: He has cast me into the mire. I have become like dust and ashes.

hausa: Danginsu, bisa ga iyalai su ne, Mika’ilu, Meshullam, Sheba, Yorai, Yakan, Ziya da Eber, su bakwai ne duka.
english: Their brothers of their fathers’ houses: Michael, Meshullam, Sheba, Jorai, Jacan, Zia, and Eber, seven.

hausa: Ba kai ba ne ka busar da teku, ka busar da ruwan zurfafa masu girma, wanda ya yi hanya a cikin zurfafan teku saboda fansassu su ƙetare?
english: Isn’t it you who dried up the sea, the waters of the great deep; who made the depths of the sea a way for the redeemed to pass over?

hausa: Saboda haka Musa ya ce, “Ga abin da Ubangiji ya ce, ‘Wajen tsakar dare, zan ratsa dukan Masar.
english: Moses said, “This is what Yahweh says: ‘About midnight I will go out into the middle of Egypt,

hausa: Ya sāke gina masujadan da mahaifinsa Hezekiya ya rurrushe. Ya kuma gina wa Ba’al bagadai. Ya kafa ginshiƙin Ashera kamar yadda Ahab sarkin Isra’ila ya yi. Ya durƙusa wa dukan rundunan taurari ya yi musu sujada.
english: For he built again the high places which Hezekiah his father had destroyed; and he raised up altars for Baal, and made an Asherah, as Ahab king of Israel did, and worshiped all the army of the sky, and served them.

hausa: Da suka isa wajen taron, sai wani mutum ya zo ya durƙusa a gabansa.
english: When they came to the multitude, a man came to him, kneeling down to him and saying,

hausa: “Don haka, ka ba da umarni a yanka mini itatuwan al’ul na ƙasar Lebanon. Ma’aikatana za su haɗa hannu da ma’aikatanka, ni kuwa zan biya ka albashin ma’aikatanka kamar yadda ka faɗa. Gama ka san cewa babu wani a cikinmu da ya iya yanka itacen katako kamar Sidoniyawa.”
english: Now therefore command that cedar trees be cut for me out of Lebanon. My servants will be with your servants; and I will give you wages for your servants according to all that you say. For you know that there is nobody among us who knows how to cut timber like the Sidonians.”

hausa: Ko da zan yi gadara fiye da kima a game da izinin nan namu, wanda Ubangiji ya bayar saboda inganta ku, ba don rushe ku ba, ba ni da abin jin kunya a ciki.
english: For even if I boast somewhat abundantly concerning our authority, which the Lord gave for building you up and not for casting you down, I will not be ashamed,

hausa: Suka ce wa Ammonawa, “Gobe za mu miƙa wuya gare ku, ku kuma yi duk abin da kuka ga dama.”
english: Therefore the men of Jabesh said, “Tomorrow we will come out to you, and you shall do with us all that seems good to you.”

hausa: Ki farka, ki farka, ya Sihiyona, ki sanya wa kanki ƙarfi. Ki sa rigarki na daraja, Ya Urushalima, birni mai tsarki. Marasa kaciya da maƙazanta ba za su shi cikinki ba.
english: Awake, awake! Put on your strength, Zion. Put on your beautiful garments, Jerusalem, the holy city, for from now on the uncircumcised and the unclean will no more come into you.

hausa: Ana ƙwace jinjiri mai shan mama; ana ƙwace ɗan yaron matalauci don biyan bashi.
english: There are those who pluck the fatherless from the breast, and take a pledge of the poor,

hausa: Duk mai aikata abin da yake zunubi shi na Iblis ne, domin Iblis mai aikata zunubi ne tun farko. Dalilin da ya sa Ɗan Allah ya bayyana kuwa shi ne don yă rushe aikin Iblis.
english: He who sins is of the devil, for the devil has been sinning from the beginning. To this end the Son of God was revealed: that he might destroy the works of the devil.

hausa: Waɗannan mutane suna da iko su kulle sararin sama don kada a yi ruwan sama a lokacin da suke annabci; suna kuma da iko su juye ruwaye su zama jini su kuma bugi duniya da kowace irin annoba a duk lokacin da suke so.
english: These have the power to shut up the sky, that it may not rain during the days of their prophecy. They have power over the waters, to turn them into blood, and to strike the earth with every plague, as often as they desire.

hausa: Ɗaya daga cikin mutanen Yowab ya tsaya kusa da Amasa ya ce, “Duk mai son Yowab, kuma duk mai son Dawuda, yă bi Yowab!”
english: One of Joab’s young men stood by him, and said, “He who favors Joab, and he who is for David, let him follow Joab!”

hausa: “Saboda haka yanzu zan rarrashe ta; zan bishe ta zuwa hamada in kuma yi mata magana a hankali.
english: “Therefore behold, I will allure her, and bring her into the wilderness, and speak tenderly to her.

hausa: A rana ta uku sai aka yi bikin aure a Kana ta Galili. Mahaifiyar Yesu kuwa tana can,
english: The third day, there was a wedding in Cana of Galilee. Jesus’ mother was there.

hausa: Sai Solomon ya ce, “Ubangiji ya ce zai zauna a gizagizai masu duhu;
english: Then Solomon said, “Yahweh has said that he would dwell in the thick darkness.

hausa: Ka ƙarfafa ni da ƙarfi saboda yaƙi; ka sa abokan gābana suka rusuna mini.
english: For you have armed me with strength to the battle. You have subdued under me those who rose up against me.

hausa: Ubangiji kuwa ya bayyana ga Ishaku ya ce, “Kada ka gangara zuwa Masar; ka yi zauna a ƙasar da zan faɗa maka.
english: Yahweh appeared to him, and said, “Don’t go down into Egypt. Live in the land I will tell you about.

hausa: Sarki kuwa ya yi ƙasaitacciyar liyafa, liyafar Esta, wa dukan hakimansa da shugabannin masarautarsa. Ya yi shelar hutu ko’ina a larduna, ya kuma raba kyautai a yalwace irin na sarauta.
english: Then the king made a great feast for all his princes and his servants, even Esther’s feast; and he proclaimed a holiday in the provinces, and gave gifts according to the king’s bounty.

hausa: Sau uku aka bulale ni da bulalar ƙarfe, sau ɗaya aka jajjefe ni da duwatsu, sau uku jirgin ruwa ya ragargaje ina ciki, na kwana na kuma yini ruwan teku yana tafiya da ni.
english: Three times I was beaten with rods. Once I was stoned. Three times I suffered shipwreck. I have been a night and a day in the deep.

hausa: Zai nuna muku wani babban ɗakin sama a shirye. Nan za ku yi shirin.”
english: He will show you a large, furnished upper room. Make preparations there.”

hausa: Saboda haka mutanen suka aika waɗansu maza zuwa Shilo, suka kuwa tafi suka kawo akwatin alkawarin Ubangiji Maɗaukaki wanda yake zaune tsakanin Kerubobi. ’Ya’yan Eli biyun nan Hofni da Finehas suna wurin tare da akwatin alkawarin Ubangiji.
english: So the people sent to Shiloh, and they brought from there the ark of the covenant of Yahweh of Armies, who sits above the cherubim; and the two sons of Eli, Hophni and Phinehas, were there with the ark of the covenant of God.

hausa: Sa’an nan na gane cewa abu mai kyau ne, daidai ne kuma mutum yă ci, yă sha, yă kuma ji daɗin aikin da ya yi a ’yan kwanakin da Allah ya ba shi, gama wannan shi aka ƙaddara wa mutum daga faman wahalarsa a duniya a cikin ’yan kwanakin da Allah ya ba shi a duniya, gama wannan shi ne rabonsa.
english: Behold, that which I have seen to be good and proper is for one to eat and to drink, and to enjoy good in all his labor, in which he labors under the sun, all the days of his life which God has given him; for this is his portion.

hausa: Bari mugaye su fāɗa a cikin ragarsu, amma bari ni in zo in wuce lafiya.
english: Let the wicked fall together into their own nets while I pass by.

hausa: Bayan da ya bayyana, daularsa za tă wargaje za a rarraba ta zuwa kusurwoyi huɗu na duniya, a ba waɗansu waɗanda ba zuriyarsa ba, ba kuwa za su yi mulki da iko kamar yadda ya yi ba, gama za a tumɓuki daularsa a kuma ba wa waɗansu.
english: When he stands up, his kingdom will be broken and will be divided toward the four winds of the sky, but not to his posterity, nor according to his dominion with which he ruled; for his kingdom will be plucked up, even for others besides these.

hausa: Zan gan shi da kaina da idanuna, Ni, ba wani ba ne. Zuciyata ta cika da wannan tunani!
english: whom I, even I, will see on my side. My eyes will see, and not as a stranger. “My heart is consumed within me.

hausa: Amma dukan dabbobin da kuma ganimar daga biranensu muka kwaso wa kanmu.
english: But all the livestock, and the plunder of the cities, we took for plunder for ourselves.

hausa: Da Allah ya ga abin da suka yi, da kuma yadda suka juya daga mugayen hanyoyinsu sai ya ji tausayinsu, bai kawo hallaka a kansu yadda ya yi shirin yi ba.
english: God saw their works, that they turned from their evil way. God relented of the disaster which he said he would do to them, and he didn’t do it.

hausa: Wannan wasiƙa ce zuwa ga dukanku da kuke a Roma waɗanda Allah yake ƙauna, waɗanda kuma ya kira domin su zama tsarkaka. Alheri da salama daga Allah Ubanmu da kuma daga Ubangiji Yesu Kiristi, su kasance tare da ku.
english: to all who are in Rome, beloved of God, called to be saints: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

hausa: Adalci da gaskiya su ne tushen kursiyinka; ƙauna da aminci suna tafiya a gabanka.
english: Righteousness and justice are the foundation of your throne. Loving kindness and truth go before your face.

hausa: “Domin ƙofar tentin, a saƙa labule mai tsayin kamu ashirin da lallausan zaren lilin mai ruwan shuɗi, da shunayya, da jan zare, mai aikin gwani, da katakai huɗu tare da rammukansu huɗu.
english: For the gate of the court shall be a screen of twenty cubits, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, the work of the embroiderer; their pillars four, and their sockets four.

hausa: Ya Ubangiji Maɗaukaki, mai albarka ne mutumin da ya dogara gare ka.
english: Yahweh of Armies, blessed is the man who trusts in you.

hausa: Amma kun yi laifi fiye da kakanninku. Duba yadda kowannenku yana bin taurin muguwar zuciyarsa a maimakon yin mini biyayya.
english: You have done evil more than your fathers, for behold, you each walk after the stubbornness of his evil heart, so that you don’t listen to me.

hausa: Sai Bilatus ya ce, “To, wato, kai sarki ne!” Yesu ya amsa ya ce, “Haka yake, ni sarki ne yadda ka faɗa. Tabbatacce, saboda wannan dalili ne aka haife ni, kuma don wannan ne na zo duniya, domin in shaidi gaskiya. Duk wanda yake gefen gaskiya yakan saurare ni.”
english: Pilate therefore said to him, “Are you a king then?” Jesus answered, “You say that I am a king. For this reason I have been born, and for this reason I have come into the world, that I should testify to the truth. Everyone who is of the truth listens to my voice.”

hausa: Ga shi, na sa masifa tă yi aiki cikin birnin da ake kira da sunana, kuna gani za ku tafi ba hukunci? Ba za ku tafi ba hukunci ba, gama ina kawo wa dukan mazaunan duniya takobi, in ji Ubangiji Maɗaukaki.’
english: For, behold, I begin to work evil at the city which is called by my name; and should you be utterly unpunished? You will not be unpunished; for I will call for a sword on all the inhabitants of the earth, says Yahweh of Armies.”’

hausa: Game da Masar. Ga saƙo game da sojojin Fir’auna Neko sarkin Masar, wanda Nebukadnezzar sarkin Babilon ya ci da yaƙi a Karkemish a Kogin Yuferites a shekara ta huɗu ta Yehohiyakim ɗan Yosiya sarkin Yahuda.
english: Of Egypt: concerning the army of Pharaoh Necoh king of Egypt, which was by the river Euphrates in Carchemish, which Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon struck in the fourth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah.

hausa: Sai ku faɗa musu, ‘Hadaya ce ta Bikin Ƙetarewa ga Ubangiji, domin ya tsallake gidajen Isra’ilawa a Masar, lokacin da ya kashe Masarawa, amma bai taɓa gidajenmu ba.’ ” Sai mutane suka rusuna, suka yi sujada.
english: that you shall say, ‘It is the sacrifice of Yahweh’s Passover, who passed over the houses of the children of Israel in Egypt, when he struck the Egyptians, and spared our houses.’” The people bowed their heads and worshiped.

hausa: In na yi wa’azi da yardar rai, ina da lada; in ba da yardar rai ba, ina dai cika amana da aka danƙa mini ne.
english: For if I do this of my own will, I have a reward. But if not of my own will, I have a stewardship entrusted to me.

hausa: Amma yayinda Ibrahim yake da rai, ya ba wa ’ya’yan ƙwarƙwaransa maza kyautai, ya kuma sallame su daga ɗansa Ishaku zuwa ƙasashen gabas.
english: but Abraham gave gifts to the sons of Abraham’s concubines. While he still lived, he sent them away from Isaac his son, eastward, to the east country.

hausa: Kika ɗauki rigunanki masu ado don ki sa a kansu, kika kuma miƙa maina da turarena a gabansu.
english: You took your embroidered garments, covered them, and set my oil and my incense before them.

hausa: In mutum yana da gagararren ɗa mai tawaye, wanda ba ya biyayya ga mahaifinsa da mahaifiyarsa, ba ya kuma jin su sa’ad da suke horonsa,
english: If a man has a stubborn and rebellious son who will not obey the voice of his father or the voice of his mother, and though they chasten him, will not listen to them,

hausa: Saboda haka aka yi farin ciki ƙwarai a birnin.
english: There was great joy in that city.

hausa: Ba shakka a lokacin ne za ka sami farin ciki daga wurin Maɗaukaki, ku kuma ɗaga idanunku ga Allah
english: For then you will delight yourself in the Almighty, and will lift up your face to God.

hausa: Ina cewa muna da tabbaci, za mu fi so mu rabu da jikin nan, mu kuma kasance a sama tare da Ubangiji.
english: We are courageous, I say, and are willing rather to be absent from the body and to be at home with the Lord.

hausa: Kamar Anakawa, su ma an ɗauka su Refahiyawa ne, amma Mowab suna kiransu Emawa.
english: These also are considered to be Rephaim, as the Anakim; but the Moabites call them Emim.

hausa: Suka amsa suka ce, “Yesu Banazare.” Yesu ya ce, “Ni ne shi.” (Yahuda kuwa wanda ya bashe shi yana nan tsaye tare da su.)
english: They answered him, “Jesus of Nazareth.” Jesus said to them, “I am he.” Judas also, who betrayed him, was standing with them.

hausa: Ya saya tudun Samariya daga Shemer, a bakin talentin biyu na azurfa, ya kuma gina birni a kan tudun, ya kira shi Samariya, bayan Shemer, sunan mai tudun a dā.
english: He bought the hill Samaria of Shemer for two talents of silver; and he built on the hill, and called the name of the city which he built, Samaria, after the name of Shemer, the owner of the hill.

hausa: “ ‘Amma fa, zan komo da nasarar Sodom da ’ya’yanta mata da ta Samariya da ’ya’yanta mata, nasararki kuma tare da su,
english: “‘“I will reverse their captivity, the captivity of Sodom and her daughters, and the captivity of Samaria and her daughters, and the captivity of your captives among them;

hausa: Za ka ci gaba da bin tsohuwar hanyar da mugayen mutane suka bi?
english: Will you keep the old way, which wicked men have trodden,

hausa: Kai mai banmamaki ne, ya Allah, cikin wurinka mai tsarki; Allah na Isra’ila yakan ba da iko da kuma ƙarfi ga mutanensa. Yabo ya tabbata ga Allah!
english: You are awesome, God, in your sanctuaries. The God of Israel gives strength and power to his people. Praise be to God!

hausa: Na umarci tsarkakana; na umarci jarumawan yaƙina su gamsar da fushina, waɗanda suke farin ciki a nasarata.
english: I have commanded my consecrated ones; yes, I have called my mighty men for my anger, even my proudly exulting ones.

hausa: Kowanne yana da fuskoki huɗu da fikafikai huɗu, a ƙarƙashin kuwa akwai wani abin da ya yi kamar hannuwan mutum.
english: Every one had four faces, and every one four wings. The likeness of the hands of a man was under their wings.

hausa: Sa’ad da aka tsananta muku a wannan wuri, ku gudu zuwa wancan. Gaskiya nake gaya muku, kafin ku gama zazzaga dukan biranen Isra’ila, Ɗan Mutum zai zo.
english: But when they persecute you in this city, flee into the next, for most certainly I tell you, you will not have gone through the cities of Israel until the Son of Man has come.

hausa: Gama wanda ɗan adam ne ya taɓa jin muryar Allah mai rai yana magana daga wuta, kamar yadda muka ji, ya kuma tsira?
english: For who is there of all flesh who has heard the voice of the living God speaking out of the middle of the fire, as we have, and lived?

hausa: Abin da nake nufi shi ne, ɗaya daga cikinku na cewa, “Ni ina bin Bulus,” wani na cewa, “Ni ina bin Afollos,” wani kuma, “Ni ina bin Kefas,” har wa yau wani kuma, “Ni ina bin Kiristi.”
english: Now I mean this, that each one of you says, “I follow Paul,” “I follow Apollos,” “I follow Cephas,” and, “I follow Christ.”

hausa: Bari mahaifinka da mahaifiyarka su yi murna; bari wadda ta haife ka tă yi farin ciki!
english: Let your father and your mother be glad! Let her who bore you rejoice!

hausa: “ ‘Ku kiyaye Asabbataina, ku kuma ba wa wuri mai tsarkina girma. Ni ne Ubangiji.
english: “‘You shall keep my Sabbaths, and have reverence for my sanctuary. I am Yahweh.

hausa: Daga zuriyar Manasse. Aka rubuta sunayen dukan maza ɗaya-ɗaya da suka kai shekara ashirin ko fiye da suka isa shiga soja, bisa ga iyalansu da kabilarsu da take a rubuce.
english: Of the children of Manasseh, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war:

hausa: Amma matar Lot ta waiwaya baya, ta kuma zama ginshiƙin gishiri.
english: But Lot’s wife looked back from behind him, and she became a pillar of salt.

hausa: Ya kuma ji haushin abokan nan guda uku, don sun kāsa amsa wa Ayuba ko da yake sun nuna Ayuba ne yake da laifi.
english: Also his wrath was kindled against his three friends, because they had found no answer, and yet had condemned Job.

hausa: Suka kashe ’ya’yan Zedekiya a gabansa, sa’an nan aka ƙwaƙule idanunsa. Suka daure shi da sarƙar tagulla, suka kai shi Babilon.
english: They killed Zedekiah’s sons before his eyes, then put out Zedekiah’s eyes, bound him in fetters, and carried him to Babylon.

hausa: Ishfan, Eber, Eliyel,
english: Ishpan, Eber, Eliel,

hausa: Saboda haka kada ku damu game da gobe, gama gobe zai damu da kansa. Damuwar yau ma ta isa wahala.
english: Therefore don’t be anxious for tomorrow, for tomorrow will be anxious for itself. Each day’s own evil is sufficient.

hausa: Amma zan komo da Isra’ila zuwa wurin kiwonsa zai kuwa yi kiwo a Karmel da Bashan; zai ƙosar da marmarinsa a tuddan Efraim da Gileyad.
english: I will bring Israel again to his pasture, and he will feed on Carmel and Bashan. His soul will be satisfied on the hills of Ephraim and in Gilead.

hausa: Waɗansu suka fāɗi a wuri mai duwatsu inda babu ƙasa sosai. Nan da nan, suka tsira domin ƙasar ba zurfi.
english: Others fell on the rocky ground, where it had little soil, and immediately it sprang up, because it had no depth of soil.

hausa: Yana kiwo a kan tuddai don abincinsa yana neman kowane ɗanyen abu mai ruwan ciyawa.
english: The range of the mountains is his pasture. He searches after every green thing.

hausa: Mutane za su zama masu son kansu, masu son kuɗi, masu taƙama, masu girman kai, masu zage-zage, marasa biyayya ga iyayensu, marasa godiya, marasa tsarki,
english: For men will be lovers of self, lovers of money, boastful, arrogant, blasphemers, disobedient to parents, unthankful, unholy,

hausa: Waɗansu irin suka fāɗi a cikin ƙaya. Da suka yi girma sai ƙaya suka shaƙe su, har ya sa ba su yi ƙwaya ba.
english: Others fell among the thorns, and the thorns grew up and choked it, and it yielded no fruit.

hausa: Ubangiji kan ba da ƙarfi ga mutanensa; Ubangiji kan albarkace mutanensa da salama.
english: Yahweh will give strength to his people. Yahweh will bless his people with peace.

hausa: Amma Allah yakan ba ƙwayar jiki yadda ya yi niyya, kuma ga kowane irin ƙwaya yakan ba ta irin jikinta.
english: But God gives it a body even as it pleased him, and to each seed a body of its own.

hausa: “Ɗan mutum, ga abin da Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka yake cewa wa ƙasar Isra’ila, “ ‘Ƙarshe ya zo! Ƙarshe ya zo a kan kusurwoyi huɗu na ƙasar.
english: “You, son of man, the Lord Yahweh says to the land of Israel, ‘An end! The end has come on the four corners of the land.

hausa: Ko kuwa kuna tsammani, sha takwas ɗin nan da suka mutu lokacin da hasumiya a Silowam ya fāɗi a kansu, sun fi dukan sauran mutanen Urushalima laifi ne?
english: Or those eighteen on whom the tower in Siloam fell and killed them—do you think that they were worse offenders than all the men who dwell in Jerusalem?

hausa: Ezra malamin Doka ya tsaya a kan dakalin itacen da aka yi saboda wannan hidima. Kusa da shi a damansa, Mattitiya, Shema, Anahiya, Uriya, Hilkiya da Ma’asehiya suka tsaya; a hagunsa kuma Fedahiya, Mishayel, Malkiya, Hashum, Hashbaddana, Zakariya da Meshullam suka tsaya.

english: Blessed be God, who has not turned away my prayer, nor his loving kindness from me.

english: God said to Jacob, “Arise, go up to Bethel, and live there. Make there an altar to God, who appeared to you when you fled from the face of Esau your brother.”

english: Listen to counsel and receive instruction, that you may be wise in your latter end.

english: The governor told them not to eat of the most holy things until a priest stood up to minister with Urim and Thummim.

hausa: Gama ga abin da Ubangiji Maɗaukaki, Allah na Isra’ila, yana cewa a idanunka da kuma a kwanakinka zan kawo ƙarshen muryar farin ciki da murna da kuma muryoyin amarya da ango a wannan wuri.
english: For Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel says: “Behold, I will cause to cease out of this place, before your eyes and in your days, the voice of mirth and the voice of gladness, the voice of the bridegroom and the voice of the bride.

hausa: Amma, kafin Irmiya yă juya yă tafi, Nebuzaradan ya ƙara da cewa, “Ka koma wurin Gedaliya ɗan Ahikam, ɗan Shafan, wanda sarkin Babilon ya naɗa a kan garuruwan Yahuda, ka zauna da shi a cikin mutane, ko kuwa ka tafi duk inda ka ga dama.” Sa’an nan shugaban ya ba shi abinci da kuma kyauta sai ya bar shi ya tafi.
english: Now while he had not yet gone back, “Go back then,” he said, “to Gedaliah the son of Ahikam, the son of Shaphan, whom the king of Babylon has made governor over the cities of Judah, and dwell with him among the people; or go wherever it seems right to you to go.” So the captain of the guard gave him food and a present, and let him go.

hausa: Amma in kuka nuna bambanci, kun yi zunubi ke nan shari’a kuma ta same ku da laifi a matsayin masu karya doka.
english: But if you show partiality, you commit sin, being convicted by the law as transgressors.

hausa: Fuskokinsu suna da kamanni ɗaya da waɗanda na gani kusa da Kogin Kebar. Kowanne ya tafi kai tsaye sosai.
english: As for the likeness of their faces, they were the faces which I saw by the river Chebar, their appearances and themselves. They each went straight forward.

hausa: Fariyar mutum kan jawo masa ƙasƙanci amma mai sauƙinkai kan sami girmamawa.
english: A man’s pride brings him low, but one of lowly spirit gains honor.

hausa: idan mai bin hakkin jinin ya same shi a bayan gari, mai bin hakkin jinin zai iya kashe mai kisankai ɗin ba tare da wani laifi ba.
english: and the avenger of blood finds him outside of the border of his city of refuge, and the avenger of blood kills the man slayer, he shall not be guilty of blood,

hausa: Ruwaye suka rufe abokan gābansu; babu ko ɗaya da ya tsira.
english: The waters covered their adversaries. There was not one of them left.

hausa: Jarumin ya amsa, “Ubangiji, ban cancanci in sa ka zo gidana ba, ka dai yi magana kawai, bawana zai warke.
english: The centurion answered, “Lord, I’m not worthy for you to come under my roof. Just say the word, and my servant will be healed.

hausa: Sa’an nan firist zai ɗibi jinin hadaya don zunubin da yatsarsa yă zuba a ƙahonin bagaden hadayar ƙonawa, yă kuma zuba sauran jinin a gindin bagade.
english: The priest shall take some of the blood of the sin offering with his finger, and put it on the horns of the altar of burnt offering; and all the rest of its blood he shall pour out at the base of the altar.

hausa: Sai ɗaukakar Ubangiji ya tashi daga bisa madogarar ƙofar haikali ya kuma tsaya a bisa kerubobi.
english: Yahweh’s glory went out from over the threshold of the house and stood over the cherubim.

hausa: Tafi, ka ratsa tsawo da fāɗin ƙasar, gama zan ba ka ita.”
english: Arise, walk through the land in its length and in its width; for I will give it to you.”

hausa: Ku yi zaman lafiya da juna. Kada ku nuna girman kai, sai ma ku riƙa cuɗanya da talakawa. Kada ku zama masu ɗaga kai.
english: Be of the same mind one toward another. Don’t set your mind on high things, but associate with the humble. Don’t be wise in your own conceits.

hausa: Duba, yau na naɗa ka a kan al’ummai da mulkoki don ka tumɓuke ka kuma rusar, ka hallaka ka kuma kakkaɓe, ka gina ka kuma shuka.”
english: Behold, I have today set you over the nations and over the kingdoms, to uproot and to tear down, to destroy and to overthrow, to build and to plant.”

hausa: Shi da bai san zunubi ba, Allah ya mai da shi kamar hadayar zunubi saboda mu, domin mu sami adalcin Allah ta wurinsa.
english: For him who knew no sin he made to be sin on our behalf, so that in him we might become the righteousness of God.

hausa: Al’umma sun fāɗa cikin ramin da suka haƙa wa waɗansu; aka kama ƙafafunsu a ragar da suka ɓoye.
english: The nations have sunk down in the pit that they made. In the net which they hid, their own foot is taken.

hausa: Yesu ya gargaɗe su ya ce, “Ku yi hankali, ku kuma lura da yistin Farisiyawa da na Hiridus.”
english: He warned them, saying, “Take heed: beware of the yeast of the Pharisees and the yeast of Herod.”

hausa: Kwarin Siddim kuwa ya cika da ramummukan kwalta, sa’ad da sarakunan Sodom da Gomorra suka gudu kuwa, waɗansu mutane suka fāɗa cikin ramummukan kwaltan, sauran kuwa suka gudu zuwa tuddai.
english: Now the valley of Siddim was full of tar pits; and the kings of Sodom and Gomorrah fled, and some fell there. Those who remained fled to the hills.

hausa: A rana ta fari ga wata na fari wanda Nuhu ya cika shekaru 601, ruwa ya shanye a ƙasa. Sai Nuhu ya buɗe murfin jirgin, ya ga cewa doron ƙasa ya bushe.
english: In the six hundred first year, in the first month, the first day of the month, the waters were dried up from the earth. Noah removed the covering of the ship, and looked. He saw that the surface of the ground was dry.

hausa: Ahitub mahaifin Zadok, Zadok mahaifin Ahimawaz,
english: Ahitub became the father of Zadok. Zadok became the father of Ahimaaz.

hausa: domin su miƙa hadayu masu daɗi ga Allah na Sama, su kuma yi addu’a domin lafiyar sarki da ’ya’yansa.
english: that they may offer sacrifices of pleasant aroma to the God of heaven, and pray for the life of the king and of his sons.

hausa: in kuma ba ku saurari maganganun bayina annabawa, waɗanda na aika muku sau da sau ba (ko da yake ba ku saurara ba),
english: to listen to the words of my servants the prophets whom I send to you, even rising up early and sending them—but you have not listened—

hausa: Yohanna ya ce, “Malam mun ga wani mutum yana fitar da aljanu a cikin sunanka, sai muka ce yă daina, domin shi ba ɗaya daga cikinmu ba ne.”
english: John said to him, “Teacher, we saw someone who doesn’t follow us casting out demons in your name; and we forbade him, because he doesn’t follow us.”

hausa: Amma Samson ya yi kwanciyarsa har tsakiyar dare. Sa’an nan ya tashi ya kama ƙofofin birnin, tare da madogarai biyunsu, ya tumɓuke, ya aza su a kafaɗarsa, ya kai su kan dutsen da yake a fuskantar Hebron.
english: Samson lay until midnight, then arose at midnight and took hold of the doors of the gate of the city, with the two posts, and plucked them up, bar and all, and put them on his shoulders and carried them up to the top of the mountain that is before Hebron.

hausa: Zo da sauri ka taimake ni, Ya Ubangiji Mai Cetona.
english: Hurry to help me, Lord, my salvation.

hausa: Yanzu ina kakanninku suke? Annabawan kuma fa, sun rayu har abada ne?
english: Your fathers, where are they? And the prophets, do they live forever?

hausa: Maganar Ubangiji ta zo mini cewa,
english: Yahweh’s word came again to me, saying,

hausa: Zabura ce. Ku rera sabuwar waƙa ga Ubangiji, gama ya yi abubuwa masu banmamaki; hannunsa na dama da hannunsa mai tsarki sun yi masa aikin ceto.
english: A Psalm. Sing to Yahweh a new song, for he has done marvelous things! His right hand and his holy arm have worked salvation for him.

hausa: Ka san Abner ɗan Ner ya zo ne yă ruɗe ka, yă ga fitarka da shigarka, yă kuma binciki kome da kake yi.”
english: You know Abner the son of Ner. He came to deceive you, and to know your going out and your coming in, and to know all that you do.”

hausa: “Ko za ka iya kama dodon ruwa da ƙugiyar kamar kifi ko kuma ka daure harshenta da igiya?
english: “Can you draw out Leviathan with a fish hook, or press down his tongue with a cord?

hausa: Ko da abokan gābansu sun kore su zuwa zaman bauta, a can zan umarci takobi yă kashe su. “Zan sa musu ido don mugunta ba don alheri ba.”
english: Though they go into captivity before their enemies, there I will command the sword, and it will kill them. I will set my eyes on them for evil, and not for good.

hausa: Ya yi kaca-kaca da ni har sai da na ƙare; ya tuge begen da nake da shi kamar itace.
english: He has broken me down on every side, and I am gone. He has plucked my hope up like a tree.

hausa: Wannan ita ce amsar da suka ba mu. “Mu bayin Allah na sama da ƙasa ne, muna sāke gina haikalin da aka gina tun shekaru da yawa da suka wuce, da wani babban sarkin Isra’ila ya gina ya kuma gama.
english: Thus they returned us answer, saying, “We are the servants of the God of heaven and earth and are building the house that was built these many years ago, which a great king of Israel built and finished.

hausa: Sai Shawulu ya sāke aiki mutanen su ga Dawuda, ya ce musu, “Ku kawo shi a gādonsa domin in kashe shi.”
english: Saul sent the messengers to see David, saying, “Bring him up to me in the bed, that I may kill him.”

hausa: Sai suka koma Urushalima daga tudun da ake kira Dutsen Zaitun, tafiyar ranar Asabbaci guda daga birnin.
english: Then they returned to Jerusalem from the mountain called Olivet, which is near Jerusalem, a Sabbath day’s journey away.

hausa: Ku kula, ku kuma lura da kanku sosai, don kada ku manta da abubuwan da idanunku suka gani, ko kuwa ku bari su fita daga zuciyarku muddin ranku. Ku koyar da su ga ’ya’yanku, da ’ya’yan ’ya’yanku.
english: Only be careful, and keep your soul diligently, lest you forget the things which your eyes saw, and lest they depart from your heart all the days of your life; but make them known to your children and your children’s children—

hausa: Me mutum zai amfana in ya sami duniya duka, amma ya rasa ransa? Ko kuwa me mutum zai bayar a bakin ransa?
english: For what will it profit a man if he gains the whole world and forfeits his life? Or what will a man give in exchange for his life?

hausa: Za a iya amince da rauni daga aboki, amma abokin gāba ko da ya sumbace ka kada ka sake da shi!
english: The wounds of a friend are faithful, although the kisses of an enemy are profuse.

hausa: suna da baka suna kuma iya harba kibiya, ko majajjawa da hannun dama ko na hagu; su ’yan’uwan Shawulu ne daga kabilar Benyamin):
english: They were armed with bows, and could use both the right hand and the left in slinging stones and in shooting arrows from the bow. They were of Saul’s relatives of the tribe of Benjamin.

hausa: I, ga abin da Ubangiji Maɗaukaki, Allah na Isra’ila yana cewa game da abubuwan da aka bari a gidan Ubangiji da kuma a cikin fadar sarkin Yahuda da Urushalima,
english: yes, Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel, says concerning the vessels that are left in Yahweh’s house, and in the house of the king of Judah, and at Jerusalem:

hausa: “Baƙon da yake zama tare da ku da yake so yă yi Bikin Ƙetarewar Ubangiji, dole yă yi wa dukan mazan da suke cikin gidansa kaciya; sa’an nan ne zai iya yin abubuwa kamar haifaffen ɗan ƙasa.
english: When a stranger lives as a foreigner with you, and would like to keep the Passover to Yahweh, let all his males be circumcised, and then let him come near and keep it. He shall be as one who is born in the land; but no uncircumcised person shall eat of it.

hausa: Mutanen dai suka firgita sa’ad da aka ɗauke su zuwa gidansa. Suka yi tunani, “An kawo mu nan ne saboda azurfan da aka sa a cikin buhunanmu da farko. Yana so yă fāɗa mana, yă kuma sha ƙarfinmu, yă ƙwace mu kamar bayi, yă kuma kwashe jakunanmu.”
english: The men were afraid, because they were brought to Joseph’s house; and they said, “Because of the money that was returned in our sacks the first time, we’re brought in; that he may seek occasion against us, attack us, and seize us as slaves, along with our donkeys.”

hausa: Gama fushinsa na ɗan lokaci ne amma alherinsa har matuƙa ne; mai yiwuwa a yi kuka da dare amma farin ciki kan zo da safe.
english: For his anger is but for a moment. His favor is for a lifetime. Weeping may stay for the night, but joy comes in the morning.

hausa: Muddin yana Banazare, ba zai ci wani abin da ya fito daga ’ya’yan inabi ba, ko ƙwayar inabi, ko ɓawonsa ma.
english: All the days of his separation he shall eat nothing that is made of the grapevine, from the seeds even to the skins.

hausa: Taron da suka bi suka dinga kururuwa, suna cewa, “A yi da shi!”
english: for the multitude of the people followed after, crying out, “Away with him!”

hausa: A daren nan, sarki bai iya barci ba, saboda haka ya ba da umarni a kawo, a kuma karanta masa littafin tarihi na shekara-shekara, da rubutaccen labarin mulkinsa.
english: On that night, the king couldn’t sleep. He commanded the book of records of the chronicles to be brought, and they were read to the king.

hausa: Mai albarka ne mutumin da Ubangiji ba zai taɓa lissafta zunubansa ba.”
english: Blessed is the man whom the Lord will by no means charge with sin.”

hausa: Sai wani soja ya gaya masa cewa, “Mahaifinka ya sa kowa ya yi rantsuwa cewa, ‘La’ananne ne mutumin da ya ci abinci kafin fāɗuwar rana!’ Shi ya sa duk sojojin ba su da ƙarfi.”
english: Then one of the people answered, and said, “Your father directly commanded the people with an oath, saying, ‘Cursed is the man who eats food today.’” So the people were faint.

hausa: Sa’an nan Ayuba ya rasu da kyakkyawan tsufa.
english: So Job died, being old and full of days.

hausa: Saboda haka Bowaz ya ce wa Rut, “’Yata, ki saurare ni. Kada ki tafi ki yi kala a wani gona, kada kuma ki tafi daga nan. Ki tsaya nan tare da ’yan matana bayi.
english: Then Boaz said to Ruth, “Listen, my daughter. Don’t go to glean in another field, and don’t go from here, but stay here close to my maidens.

hausa: Musa ya amsa ya ce, “Saboda mutanen suna zuwa wurina, don su nemi nufin Allah.
english: Moses said to his father-in-law, “Because the people come to me to inquire of God.

hausa: zai albarkace waɗanda suke tsoron Ubangiji, manya da ƙanana duka.
english: He will bless those who fear Yahweh, both small and great.

hausa: “An yi abinci domin ciki ne, ciki kuma domin abinci.” Amma Allah zai hallaka su duka. Ba a yi jiki saboda fasikanci ba, sai dai domin Ubangiji, Ubangiji kuma domin jiki.
english: “Foods for the belly, and the belly for foods,” but God will bring to nothing both it and them. But the body is not for sexual immorality, but for the Lord, and the Lord for the body.

hausa: Andarawus ɗan’uwan Siman Bitrus, yana ɗaya daga cikin biyun nan da suka bi Yesu bayan da suka ji maganar Yohanna a kan Yesu.
english: One of the two who heard John and followed him was Andrew, Simon Peter’s brother.

hausa: Na damu saboda sunana mai tsarki, wanda gidan Isra’ila ya ɓata a cikin al’ummai inda suka tafi.
english: But I had respect for my holy name, which the house of Israel had profaned among the nations where they went.

hausa: Sa’ad da Musa ya gama kafa tabanakul, sai ya shafe shi da mai, ya tsarkake shi tare da dukan kayayyakinsa, ya kuma shafe bagaden da mai, ya tsarkake shi da dukan kayayyakinsa.
english: On the day that Moses had finished setting up the tabernacle, and had anointed it and sanctified it with all its furniture, and the altar with all its vessels, and had anointed and sanctified them;

hausa: Saboda haka bari mu daina ba wa juna laifi. A maimakon, sai kowa yă yi niyya ba zai sa dutsen tuntuɓe ko abin sa fāɗuwa a hanyar ɗan’uwansa ba.
english: Therefore let’s not judge one another any more, but judge this rather, that no man put a stumbling block in his brother’s way, or an occasion for falling.

hausa: Sai mutumin Allah ya aika wa sarkin Isra’ila cewa, “Ka yi hankali da wuce wuri kaza, domin Arameyawa za su gangara can.”
english: The man of God sent to the king of Israel, saying, “Beware that you not pass this place, for the Syrians are coming down there.”

hausa: za su kuma bashe shi ga Al’ummai su yi masa ba’a, su yi masa bulala, su kuma gicciye shi. A rana ta uku kuma a tashe shi!”
english: and will hand him over to the Gentiles to mock, to scourge, and to crucify; and the third day he will be raised up.”

hausa: Yana nema daga ina ruwan rafi yake ɓulɓulowa yana kuma binciko abubuwan da suke a ɓoye yă kawo su cikin haske.
english: He binds the streams that they don’t trickle. The thing that is hidden he brings out to light.

hausa: Daga cikin waɗanda suka rage a birnin, ya ɗauki hafsa mai kula da dakaru, da kuma mashawartan sarki guda biyar. Ya kuma tafi da magatakarda wanda yake babban jami’in soja mai ɗaukan dukan jama’an ƙasar, tare da mutanensa guda sittin waɗanda aka samu a birnin.
english: and out of the city he took an officer who was set over the men of war; and five men of those who saw the king’s face, who were found in the city; and the scribe, the captain of the army, who mustered the people of the land, and sixty men of the people of the land who were found in the city.

hausa: Ubangiji ya ce, “Ka faɗa masa wannan, ‘Ga abin da Ubangiji yana cewa, zan rushe abin da na gina in kuma tumɓuke abin da na dasa, a duk fāɗin ƙasar.
english: “You shall tell him, Yahweh says: ‘Behold, that which I have built, I will break down, and that which I have planted I will pluck up; and this in the whole land.

hausa: Don haka bai ɗauki akwatin alkawarin ya kasance tare da shi a Birnin Dawuda ba. A maimakon haka, ya kai shi gidan Obed-Edom mutumin Gat.
english: So David didn’t move the ark with him into David’s city, but carried it aside into Obed-Edom the Gittite’s house.

hausa: Mun ma dawo maka da kuɗin da muka samu a cikin bakunan buhunanmu daga ƙasar Kan’ana. Saboda haka me zai sa mu saci azurfa ko zinariya daga gidan maigidanka?
english: Behold, the money, which we found in our sacks’ mouths, we brought again to you out of the land of Canaan. How then should we steal silver or gold out of your lord’s house?

hausa: Allahnmu yana a sama; yana yin duk abin da ya ga dama.
english: But our God is in the heavens. He does whatever he pleases.

hausa: ‘Yehonadab ɗan Rekab ya umarci ’ya’yansa maza kada su sha ruwan inabi sun kuma kiyaye wannan umarni. Har yă zuwa yau ba sa shan ruwan inabi, domin sun yi biyayya da umarnin kakansu. Amma na yi muku magana sau da sau, duk da haka ba ku yi biyayya ba.
english: “The words of Jonadab the son of Rechab that he commanded his sons, not to drink wine, are performed; and to this day they drink none, for they obey their father’s commandment; but I have spoken to you, rising up early and speaking, and you have not listened to me.

hausa: Sa’an nan ya fito zuwa hanyar shiga, inda wata yarinya kuma ta gan shi, ta ce wa mutanen da suke can, “Wannan mutum ma yana tare da Yesu Banazare.”
english: When he had gone out onto the porch, someone else saw him and said to those who were there, “This man also was with Jesus of Nazareth.”

hausa: Mugun ɗan saƙo kan shiga wahala, amma jakadan da mai aminci yakan kawo warkarwa.
english: A wicked messenger falls into trouble, but a trustworthy envoy gains healing.

hausa: Dawuda ya ɗauki rawani daga kan sarkinsu, nauyinsa ya kai talenti na zinariya, aka kuma yi masa ado da duwatsu masu daraja, sai Dawuda kuwa ya sa a kansa. Ya kuma kwashi ganima mai yawa daga birnin
english: David took the crown of their king from off his head, and found it to weigh a talent of gold, and there were precious stones in it. It was set on David’s head, and he brought very much plunder out of the city.

hausa: Tabbatacce ni mai zunubi ne tun haihuwa mai zunubi daga lokacin da mahaifiyata ta yi cikina.
english: Behold, I was born in iniquity. My mother conceived me in sin.

hausa: “Ka ɗauki alkama da sha’ir, wake da acca, gero da maiwa; ka sa su a tulun ajiya ka kuma yi amfani da su don yin burodi wa kanka. Za ka ci shi a kwanaki 390 da za ka kwanta a gefenka.
english: “Take for yourself also wheat, barley, beans, lentils, millet, and spelt, and put them in one vessel. Make bread of it. According to the number of the days that you will lie on your side, even three hundred ninety days, you shall eat of it.

hausa: Ga zuriyar Matsaran Ƙofofi. Zuriyar Shallum, Ater, Talmon, Akkub, Hatita da Shobai 138.
english: The gatekeepers: the children of Shallum, the children of Ater, the children of Talmon, the children of Akkub, the children of Hatita, the children of Shobai: one hundred thirty-eight.

hausa: Haka kuma, bayan abincin, ya ɗauki kwaf ruwan inabi ya ce, “Wannan kwaf ruwan inabi shi ne, na sabon alkawari cikin jinina, da aka zubar dominku.
english: Likewise, he took the cup after supper, saying, “This cup is the new covenant in my blood, which is poured out for you.

hausa: Waɗannan su ne ’ya’yan Rahila maza waɗanda ta haifa wa Yaƙub, dukansu mutum goma sha huɗu ne.
english: These are the sons of Rachel, who were born to Jacob: all the souls were fourteen.

hausa: Da Bilatus ya ji haka, sai ya yi tambaya, “Ko shi mutumin Galili ne?”
english: But when Pilate heard Galilee mentioned, he asked if the man was a Galilean.

hausa: Ta haka Ubangiji ya ceci Hezekiya da mutanen Urushalima daga hannun Sennakerib sarkin Assuriya da kuma daga hannun dukan sauran. Ya magance su a kowane gefe.
english: Thus Yahweh saved Hezekiah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem from the hand of Sennacherib the king of Assyria and from the hand of all others, and guided them on every side.

hausa: “Amma yanzu ku dube ni da kyau, zan yi muku ƙarya ne?
english: Now therefore be pleased to look at me, for surely I will not lie to your face.

hausa: Saboda haka, ga abin da Ubangiji yana cewa game da Yehohiyakim sarkin Yahuda. Ba zai kasance da wani wanda zai zauna a kan gadon sarautar Dawuda ba; za a jefar da gawarsa ta sha zafi da rana da dare kuma ta sha matsanancin sanyi.
english: Therefore Yahweh says concerning Jehoiakim king of Judah: “He will have no one to sit on David’s throne. His dead body will be cast out in the day to the heat, and in the night to the frost.

hausa: Ku tattara mutane, maza, mata da kuma yara, da baƙin da suke zama a cikin garuruwanku, saboda su saurara, su kuma koyi tsoron Ubangiji Allahnku, su lura, su bi dukan kalmomin wannan doka.
english: Assemble the people, the men and the women and the little ones, and the foreigners who are within your gates, that they may hear, learn, fear Yahweh your God, and observe to do all the words of this law,

hausa: Wata rana yayinda waɗansu Isra’ilawa suke binne wani mutum, farat ɗaya sai ga mahara; saboda haka suka jefar da gawar mutumin a kabarin Elisha. Da gawar ta taɓa ƙasusuwan Elisha, sai mutumin ya farka, ya tashi ya tsaya da ƙafafunsa.
