english: As they were burying a man, behold, they saw a band of raiders; and they threw the man into Elisha’s tomb. As soon as the man touched Elisha’s bones, he revived, and stood up on his feet.

hausa: Ku saurara, ya ku sammai, zan yi magana; bari duniya ta ji maganar bakina.
english: Give ear, you heavens, and I will speak. Let the earth hear the words of my mouth.

hausa: To, sa’ad da na ƙarshe cikin waɗannan mayaƙa a cikin mutanen ya rasu,
english: So, when all the men of war were consumed and dead from among the people,

hausa: Sa’an nan suka yi kuka ga Ubangiji cikin wahalarsu, ya kuwa cece su daga damuwarsu.
english: Then they cried to Yahweh in their trouble, and he saved them out of their distresses.

hausa: Sarki Arad Bakan’ane, wanda yake zaune a Negeb na Kan’ana, ya ji labari cewa Isra’ilawa suna zuwa.
english: The Canaanite king of Arad, who lived in the South in the land of Canaan, heard of the coming of the children of Israel.

hausa: zinace zinacenku da haniniya kamar dawakai, karuwancinku na bankunya! Na ga ayyukanku na banƙyama a kan tuddai da kuma a filaye. Kaitonki, ya Urushalima! Har yaushe za ki ci gaba da rashin tsarki?”
english: I have seen your abominations, even your adulteries and your neighing, the lewdness of your prostitution, on the hills in the field. Woe to you, Jerusalem! You will not be made clean. How long will it yet be?”

hausa: “Yabo ya tabbata ga Ubangiji, wanda ya ba wa mutanensa hutu kamar dai yadda ya yi alkawari. Babu magana guda da ta kāsa cika cikin dukan alkawaransa masu kyau da ya yi ta wurin bawansa Musa.
english: “Blessed be Yahweh, who has given rest to his people Israel, according to all that he promised. There has not failed one word of all his good promise, which he promised by Moses his servant.

hausa: Game da ku kuwa, shafan nan da kuka karɓa daga gare shi tana nan a cikinku, ba kwa kuma bukata wani yă koyar da ku. Amma kamar yadda shafan nan tasa tana koya muku kome, ita kuwa gaskiya ce ba ƙarya ba, yadda dai ta koya muku, to, sai ku zauna a cikinsa.
english: As for you, the anointing which you received from him remains in you, and you don’t need for anyone to teach you. But as his anointing teaches you concerning all things, and is true, and is no lie, and even as it taught you, you will remain in him.

hausa: Sai ya juya wajen almajiransa, ya ce musu a ɓoye, “Albarka ga idanun da suka ga abin da kuke gani.
english: Turning to the disciples, he said privately, “Blessed are the eyes which see the things that you see,

hausa: Hasken fitila ba zai ƙara haskakawa a cikinki ba. Ba za a ƙara jin muryar ango da amarya a cikinki ba. Attajiranki, dā su ne manyan mutanen duniya. Ta wurin sihirinki, dukan ƙasashe sun kauce.
english: The light of a lamp will shine no more at all in you. The voice of the bridegroom and of the bride will be heard no more at all in you, for your merchants were the princes of the earth; for with your sorcery all the nations were deceived.

hausa: Mala’ika na uku ya juye kwanonsa a bisan koguna da maɓulɓulan ruwa, sai suka zama jini.
english: The third poured out his bowl into the rivers and springs of water, and they became blood.

hausa: Zan yi wa makafi jagora a hanyoyin da ba su taɓa sani ba, a hanyoyin da ba a saba ba zan bishe su; zan mai da duhu ya zama haske a gabansu in kuma mai da ƙasa mai kururrumai ta zama sumul. Abubuwan da zan yi ke nan; ba zan yashe su ba.
english: I will bring the blind by a way that they don’t know. I will lead them in paths that they don’t know. I will make darkness light before them, and crooked places straight. I will do these things, and I will not forsake them.

hausa: Gama duwatsunta suna da daraja ga bayinka; ƙurarta kawai kan sa su ji tausayi.
english: For your servants take pleasure in her stones, and have pity on her dust.

hausa: “Ku miƙa hadayar godiya ga Allah, ku cika alkawuranku ga Mafi Ɗaukaka,
english: Offer to God the sacrifice of thanksgiving. Pay your vows to the Most High.

hausa: ’Ya’ya, ku yi biyayya ga iyayenku cikin kome, gama wannan yakan gamshi Ubangiji.
english: Children, obey your parents in all things, for this pleases the Lord.

hausa: Yesu ya tambaye su ya ce, “Har yanzu ba ku gane ba ne?
english: So Jesus said, “Do you also still not understand?

hausa: Da ya yi wa Isra’ila reni, sai Yonatan ɗan Shimeya, ɗan’uwa Dawuda, ya kashe shi.
english: When he defied Israel, Jonathan the son of Shimei, David’s brother, killed him.

hausa: Wannan ya faru saboda zunuban da ya yi, ya yi mugunta a gaban Ubangiji ya kuma yi tafiya a hanyoyin Yerobowam da kuma cikin zunubin da Yerobowam ya yi da ya sa Isra’ila suka yi.
english: for his sins which he sinned in doing that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight, in walking in the way of Jeroboam, and in his sin which he did to make Israel to sin.

hausa: Yayinda suke shan ruwan inabi a rana ta biyun nan, sai sarki ya sāke tambaya, “Sarauniya Esta, me kike so? Za a ba ki. Mene ne roƙonki? Ko da rabin masarautata ne, za a ba ki.”
english: The king said again to Esther on the second day at the banquet of wine, “What is your petition, queen Esther? It shall be granted you. What is your request? Even to the half of the kingdom it shall be performed.”

hausa: A cikinsa rai ya kasance, wannan rai kuwa shi ne hasken mutane.
english: In him was life, and the life was the light of men.

hausa: Dukanmu an yi mana baftisma ta wurin Ruhu guda zuwa ga jiki guda, ko Yahudawa ko Hellenawa, bawa ko ’yantacce, an kuma ba wa dukanmu wannan Ruhu guda mu sha.
english: For in one Spirit we were all baptized into one body, whether Jews or Greeks, whether bond or free; and were all given to drink into one Spirit.

hausa: Masu fafararmu sun kusa kama mu; mun gaji kuma ba dama mu huta.
english: Our pursuers are on our necks. We are weary, and have no rest.

hausa: Yayinda Yesu yake cin abinci a gidan Mattiyu, masu karɓar haraji da yawa da kuma masu zunubi suka zo suka kuwa ci tare da shi da kuma almajiransa.
english: As he sat in the house, behold, many tax collectors and sinners came and sat down with Jesus and his disciples.

hausa: Da ya yi addu’a gare shi, sai Ubangiji ya taɓu da tubansa, ya kuma saurari roƙonsa; saboda haka ya dawo da shi Urushalima da kuma zuwa mulkinsa. Sa’an nan Manasse ya san cewa Ubangiji shi ne Allah.
english: He prayed to him; and he was entreated by him, and heard his supplication, and brought him again to Jerusalem into his kingdom. Then Manasseh knew that Yahweh was God.

hausa: “In kun ba wa jama’ata matalauta da suke tsakaninku bashin kuɗi, kada ku zama kamar masu ba da rance; kada ku sa yă biya da ruwa.
english: “If you lend money to any of my people with you who is poor, you shall not be to him as a creditor. You shall not charge him interest.

hausa: Na lura da ku a hamada, cikin ƙasar mai ƙunar zafi.
english: I knew you in the wilderness, in the land of great drought.

hausa: Duba, dukansu masu ƙarya ne! Ayyukansu ba su da riba; siffofinsu iska ne kawai da ruɗami.
english: Behold, all of their deeds are vanity and nothing. Their molten images are wind and confusion.

hausa: Sai Elisha ya bar shi, ya koma, ya ɗauki shanunsa ya yayyanka. Ya ƙone kayan garman noman don yă dafa naman, ya kuma ba wa mutane naman, suka kuwa ci. Sa’an nan ya tashi, ya bi Iliya, ya kuma zama mai hidimarsa.
english: He returned from following him, and took the yoke of oxen, killed them, and boiled their meat with the oxen’s equipment, and gave to the people; and they ate. Then he arose, and went after Elijah, and served him.

hausa: Har ma namun jeji suna haki gare ka; rafuffuka sun bushe wuta kuma ta cinye wurin kiwo a jeji.
english: Yes, the animals of the field pant to you, for the water brooks have dried up, and the fire has devoured the pastures of the wilderness.

hausa: Ga yadda za ku yafe basusuwan, kowane mai bin bashi, yă yafe bashin da yake bin ɗan’uwansa mutumin Isra’ila. Ba zai bukaci mutumin Isra’ila wanda yake ɗan’uwa yă biya shi bashi ba, gama an yi shelar lokacin da Ubangiji ya ajiye na yafe bashi.
english: This is the way it shall be done: every creditor shall release that which he has lent to his neighbor. He shall not require payment from his neighbor and his brother, because Yahweh’s release has been proclaimed.

hausa: Daga ɗakin Gemariya ɗan Shafan magatakarda, wanda yake a fili na bisa a mashigin Sabuwar Ƙofar haikali, Baruk ya karanta wa dukan mutane a haikalin Ubangiji maganar Irmiya daga littafin.
english: Then Baruch read the words of Jeremiah from the book in Yahweh’s house, in the room of Gemariah the son of Shaphan the scribe, in the upper court, at the entry of the new gate of Yahweh’s house, in the ears of all the people.

hausa: Sarki ya ce, “Wannan ta ce, ‘Ɗana ne a raye, naki ne matacce,’ yayinda ɗayan tana cewa, ‘A’a! Ɗanki ne mataccen, nawa ne a raye.’ ”
english: Then the king said, “One says, ‘This is my son who lives, and your son is the dead one;’ and the other says, ‘No! But your son is the dead one, and my son is the living one.’”

hausa: Sane da wannan, kullum muna addu’a saboda ku, don Allahnmu yă sa ku cancanci kiransa, ta wurin ikonsa kuma yă cika kowace manufarku mai kyau da kuma kowane aikin da bangaskiyarku ta iza.
english: To this end we also pray always for you that our God may count you worthy of your calling, and fulfill every desire of goodness and work of faith with power,

hausa: Tabbatacce, gashin kanku ɗin nan ma, an ƙidaya su duka. Kada ku ji tsoro. Darajarku ta fi na kanari masu yawa girma.
english: But the very hairs of your head are all counted. Therefore don’t be afraid. You are of more value than many sparrows.

hausa: Fir’auna ya ba wa Yusuf suna Zafenat-Faneya, ya kuma ba shi Asenat ’yar Fotifera firist na On, ta zama matarsa. Yusuf kuwa ya zaga dukan ƙasar Masar.
english: Pharaoh called Joseph’s name Zaphenath-Paneah. He gave him Asenath, the daughter of Potiphera priest of On as a wife. Joseph went out over the land of Egypt.

hausa: Zeba da Zalmunna, sarakunan biyu na Midiyawa suka tsere, amma ya bi su ya kama, ya fatattaki dukan mayaƙansu.
english: Zebah and Zalmunna fled and he pursued them. He took the two kings of Midian, Zebah and Zalmunna, and confused all the army.

hausa: ’yan kunnensu, kwandagansu da lulluɓinsu,
english: the earrings, the bracelets, the veils,

hausa: ashe, ba ku nuna bambanci a tsakaninku ke nan ba, kuka kuma zama alƙalai masu mugayen tunani?
english: haven’t you shown partiality among yourselves, and become judges with evil thoughts?

hausa: wannan zunubi zai zama muku kamar bango mai tsayi, tsagagge da yake kuma fāɗuwa, da zai rushe nan da nan, ba tsammani.
english: therefore this iniquity shall be to you like a breach ready to fall, swelling out in a high wall, whose breaking comes suddenly in an instant.

hausa: Sai babban taro suka haɗu suka datse dukan maɓulɓulai da rafuffukan da suke gudu cikin ƙasar. Suka ce “Me zai sa sarakunan Assuriya su zo su sami ruwa barkatai?”
english: Then many people gathered together and they stopped all the springs and the brook that flowed through the middle of the land, saying, “Why should the kings of Assyria come, and find abundant water?”

hausa: Ga abin da Ubangiji Maɗaukaki yana cewa, “An danne mutanen Isra’ila, haka ma mutanen Yahuda. Dukan waɗanda suka kama su suna riƙe su kankan, suna kin barinsu su tafi.
english: Yahweh of Armies says: “The children of Israel and the children of Judah are oppressed together. All who took them captive hold them fast. They refuse to let them go.

hausa: Ana gab da Bikin Ƙetarewa. Yesu kuwa ya san cewa lokaci ya yi da zai bar wannan duniya, yă koma wurin Uba. Da yake ya ƙaunaci waɗanda suke nasa a duniya, yanzu kuwa ya nuna musu cikakkiyar ƙaunarsa.
english: Now before the feast of the Passover, Jesus, knowing that his time had come that he would depart from this world to the Father, having loved his own who were in the world, he loved them to the end.

hausa: Kukan nemi abu ku rasa, sai ku yi kisa da ƙyashi. In kuka rasa abin da kuke nema sai ku shiga yin gardama da faɗa. Kukan rasa ne, domin ba ku roƙi Allah ba.
english: You lust, and don’t have. You murder and covet, and can’t obtain. You fight and make war. You don’t have, because you don’t ask.

hausa: Me ya sa rigunanka suka yi ja, sai ka ce na wanda yake tattaka ’ya’yan inabi?
english: Why is your clothing red, and your garments like him who treads in the wine vat?

hausa: Ku lura fa cewa abin da kuka ji daga farko, bari yă ci gaba da kasance a cikinku. In kuwa ya ci gaba da zama a cikinku, za ku kasance a cikin Ɗan, da kuma a cikin Uban.
english: Therefore, as for you, let that remain in you which you heard from the beginning. If that which you heard from the beginning remains in you, you also will remain in the Son, and in the Father.

hausa: Gama zai umarci mala’ikunsa game da kai don su tsare ka a dukan hanyoyinka;
english: For he will put his angels in charge of you, to guard you in all your ways.

hausa: Ga abin da Ubangiji ya ce, “Saboda zunubai uku na Taya, har guda huɗu ma, ba zan fasa hukunta su ba. Don sun kwashe al’umma gaba ɗaya sun kai su bauta a Edom, ba su kula da yarjejjeniyar da aka yi ta zama kamar ’yan’uwa ba,
english: Yahweh says: “For three transgressions of Tyre, yes, for four, I will not turn away its punishment; because they delivered up the whole community to Edom, and didn’t remember the brotherly covenant;

hausa: Ku nemi Ubangiji tun yana samuwa; ku yi kira gare shi tun yana kusa.
english: Seek Yahweh while he may be found. Call on him while he is near.

hausa: Game da dawowar Ubangijinmu Yesu Kiristi da game da tattara mu gare shi, muna roƙonku, ’yan’uwa,
english: Now, brothers, concerning the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ and our gathering together to him, we ask you

hausa: Hosheya ɗan Nun, daga kabilar Efraim;
english: Of the tribe of Ephraim, Hoshea the son of Nun.

hausa: Ina da abubuwa da dama da zan rubuta maka, sai dai ba na so in yi amfani da alƙalami da inki in rubuta su.
english: I had many things to write to you, but I am unwilling to write to you with ink and pen;

hausa: An karanta, an kuma fassara mini wasiƙar da kuma aika.
english: The letter which you sent to us has been plainly read before me.

hausa: waɗanda suka zo domin su ji shi, a kuma warkar da cututtukansu. Waɗanda suke fama da mugayen ruhohi kuwa aka warkar da su.
english: as well as those who were troubled by unclean spirits; and they were being healed.

hausa: Ko kuwa in wani yana riƙe da dutsen da ya isa yă kashe mutum a hannunsa, ya kuma harbi wani da dutsen har ya mutu, to, shi mai kisankai ne, sai a kashe mai kisankan nan.
english: If he struck him with a stone in the hand, by which a man may die, and he died, he is a murderer. The murderer shall surely be put to death.

hausa: Ubangiji zai kori dukan waɗannan al’ummai a gabanku, za ku kuma kore al’umman da suka fi ku yawa da ƙarfi.
english: then Yahweh will drive out all these nations from before you, and you shall dispossess nations greater and mightier than yourselves.

hausa: Bai ci zalin wani ko ya karɓi jingina ba. Ba ya fashi amma yakan ba da abincinsa ga mayunwata ya tanada tufafi wa marasa tufafi.
english: hasn’t wronged any, hasn’t taken anything to pledge, hasn’t taken by robbery, but has given his bread to the hungry, and has covered the naked with a garment;

hausa: Ta ba wa yaron suna Ikabod, ma’ana “Ɗaukaka ta rabu da Isra’ila”, domin an ƙwace akwatin alkawarin Allah, domin kuma mutuwar surukinta da na mijinta.
english: She named the child Ichabod, saying, “The glory has departed from Israel!” because God’s ark was taken, and because of her father-in-law and her husband.

hausa: Ruhun Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka yana a kaina, domin Ubangiji ya shafe ni domin in yi wa’azi labari mai daɗi ga matalauta. Ya aiko ni in warkar da waɗanda suka karai a zuci, don in yi shelar ’yanci don ɗaurarru in kuma kunce ’yan kurkuku daga duhu
english: The Lord Yahweh’s Spirit is on me, because Yahweh has anointed me to preach good news to the humble. He has sent me to bind up the broken hearted, to proclaim liberty to the captives and release to those who are bound,

hausa: Sai macijin ya yi fushi da macen ya kuma koma wajen sauran zuriyarta don yă yaƙe su waɗannan waɗanda suke biyayya da umarnan Allah suke kuma riƙe da shaidar Yesu.
english: The dragon grew angry with the woman, and went away to make war with the rest of her offspring, who keep God’s commandments and hold Jesus’ testimony.

hausa: Kada ku danne gwauruwa ko maraya, baƙo ko talaka. A cikin zuciyarku kada ku yi mugun tunani game da juna.’
english: Don’t oppress the widow, the fatherless, the foreigner, nor the poor; and let none of you devise evil against his brother in your heart.’

hausa: Ina gab da fasa hasalata a kanki in kuma aukar da fushina a kanki; zan shari’anta ke bisa ga halinki in kuma sāka miki saboda dukan ayyukanki masu banƙyama.
english: Now I will shortly pour out my wrath on you, and accomplish my anger against you, and will judge you according to your ways. I will bring on you all your abominations.

hausa: wanda ya aika hannu ɗaukakarsa mai iko ya kasance a hannun dama na Musa, wanda ya raba ruwaye a gabansu, don yă sami wa kansa madawwamin suna,
english: Who caused his glorious arm to be at Moses’ right hand? Who divided the waters before them, to make himself an everlasting name?

hausa: Sa’an nan Benyamin suka ga an ci su. To, mutanen Isra’ila sun yi ta ja da baya daga mutanen Benyamin domin suna dogara ga waɗanda sa su yi kwanto kusa da Gibeya ne.
english: So the children of Benjamin saw that they were struck, for the men of Israel yielded to Benjamin because they trusted the ambushers whom they had set against Gibeah.

hausa: Kamar dai yadda aka kasance da mutane masu yawa waɗanda suka giggice sa’ad da suka gan shi, kamanninsa ya lalace ƙwarai fiye da na kowane mutum siffarsa kuma ta yi muni fiye da yadda ta mutum take,
english: Just as many were astonished at you— his appearance was marred more than any man, and his form more than the sons of men—

hausa: in kuma cutar a cikin rigar, ko fatar, ko kayan saƙan kore-kore ne, ko ja-ja, to, cutar fatar jiki da ake samu a riguna ce mai yaɗuwa, kuma dole a nuna wa firist.
english: if the plague is greenish or reddish in the garment, or in the leather, or in the warp, or in the woof, or in anything made of leather; it is the plague of leprosy, and shall be shown to the priest.

hausa: Gama abin da na karɓa daga wurin Ubangiji shi ne nake ba ku. Ubangiji Yesu, a daren da aka bashe shi, ya ɗauki burodi,
english: For I received from the Lord that which also I delivered to you, that the Lord Jesus on the night in which he was betrayed took bread.

hausa: Amma in ba su gaskata mu’ujizan nan biyu ba, ko kuwa ba su saurare ka ba, sai ka ɗibo ruwa daga Nilu, ka zuba a busasshiyar ƙasa. Ruwan da ka ɗebo daga kogin zai zama jini a ƙasar.”
english: It will happen, if they will not believe even these two signs or listen to your voice, that you shall take of the water of the river, and pour it on the dry land. The water which you take out of the river will become blood on the dry land.”

hausa: Mutanen Efraim suka tattaro mayaƙansu, suka haye zuwa Zafon suka cewa Yefta, “Don me ka tafi ka yaƙi Ammonawa ba ka gayyace mu ba? Za mu ƙone gidanka a kanka.”
english: The men of Ephraim were gathered together, and passed northward; and they said to Jephthah, “Why did you pass over to fight against the children of Ammon, and didn’t call us to go with you? We will burn your house around you with fire!”

hausa: “Amma yanzu suna yi mini ba’a waɗanda na girme su, waɗanda iyayensu maza ba su isa su zama karnukan kiwon garken tumakina ba.
english: “But now those who are younger than I have me in derision, whose fathers I considered unworthy to put with my sheep dogs.

hausa: Ka kiyaye ranar Asabbaci ta wurin kiyaye ta da tsarki, yadda Ubangiji Allahnka ya umarce ka.
english: “Observe the Sabbath day, to keep it holy, as Yahweh your God commanded you.

hausa: Saboda haka kyautai Yaƙub suka sha gabansa, amma shi kansa ya kwana a sansani.
english: So the present passed over before him, and he himself stayed that night in the camp.

hausa: Gama Uban yana ƙaunar Ɗan yana kuma nuna masa duk abin da yake yi. I, za ku kuwa yi mamaki, gama zai nuna masa abubuwan da suka fi waɗannan girma.
english: For the Father has affection for the Son, and shows him all things that he himself does. He will show him greater works than these, that you may marvel.

hausa: Saboda umarnin da sarki Dariyus ya aika, sai Tattenai, gwamnan Kewayen Kogin Yuferites da Shetar-Bozenai da abokansu suka yi biyayya da umarnin babu wasa.
english: Then Tattenai, the governor beyond the River, Shetharbozenai, and their companions did accordingly with all diligence, because Darius the king had sent a decree.

hausa: (Iyayensa ba su san cewa wannan daga wurin Ubangiji ne ba, wanda yake neman hanyar da za a kai wa Filistiyawa hari; gama a lokacin suna mulkin Isra’ila.)
english: But his father and his mother didn’t know that it was of Yahweh; for he sought an occasion against the Philistines. Now at that time the Philistines ruled over Israel.

hausa: Duk da wahayin ƙarya game da kai, duban ƙarya game da kai, za a sa shi a wuyan mugaye waɗanda za a kashe, waɗanda kwanansu ta zo, waɗanda lokacin hukuncinsu ya cika fal.
english: while they see for you false visions, while they divine lies to you, to lay you on the necks of the wicked who are deadly wounded, whose day has come in the time of the iniquity of the end.

hausa: Amma Bitrus ya bi daga nesa, har zuwa cikin filin gidan babban firist. Ya shiga, ya zauna tare da masu gadi, don yă ga ƙarshen abin.
english: But Peter followed him from a distance to the court of the high priest, and entered in and sat with the officers, to see the end.

hausa: Harshen da ya kawo warkarwa shi ne itacen rai, amma harshe mai ƙarya kan ragargaza zuciya.
english: A gentle tongue is a tree of life, but deceit in it crushes the spirit.

hausa: Maganar Ubangiji ta zo wa annabi Haggai sau na biyu a rana ta ashirin da huɗu ga wata cewa,
english: Yahweh’s word came the second time to Haggai in the twenty-fourth day of the month, saying,

hausa: Ga shi, na koya muku ƙa’idodi da dokoki, yadda Ubangiji Allahna ya umarce ni, don ku bi su a ƙasar da za ku shiga ku mallaki.
english: Behold, I have taught you statutes and ordinances, even as Yahweh my God commanded me, that you should do so in the middle of the land where you go in to possess it.

hausa: Abishai ya ce wa Dawuda, “Yau Allah ya ba da maƙiyinka a hannunka. Bari in kafe shi da ƙasa da māshina, zan soke shi da māshi sau ɗaya tak, ba na bukata in soke shi sau biyu.”
english: Then Abishai said to David, “God has delivered up your enemy into your hand today. Now therefore please let me strike him with the spear to the earth at one stroke, and I will not strike him the second time.”

hausa: “ ‘Saboda haka ga abin da Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka yana cewa, “ ‘Kaito birnin nan mai zubar da jini! Ni ma zan jibge itace da yawa.
english: “‘Therefore the Lord Yahweh says: “Woe to the bloody city! I also will make the pile great.

hausa: duk wanda ya saɓi sunan Ubangiji, dole a kashe shi. Dole jama’a gaba ɗaya su jajjefe shi da duwatsu. Ko baƙo, ko haifaffen ɗan ƙasa, sa’ad da ya saɓi Sunan Ubangiji, dole a kashe shi.
english: He who blasphemes Yahweh’s name, he shall surely be put to death. All the congregation shall certainly stone him. The foreigner as well as the native-born shall be put to death when he blasphemes the Name.

hausa: Na rubuta yadda na yi ne saboda sa’ad da na iso kada waɗanda ya kamata su faranta mini rai, su sa ni baƙin ciki. Na amince da ku duka a kan farin cikina naku ne ku duka.
english: And I wrote this very thing to you, so that when I came, I wouldn’t have sorrow from them of whom I ought to rejoice; having confidence in you all that my joy would be shared by all of you.

hausa: Alekzanda maƙerin ƙarafan nan ya yi mini mugunta ƙwarai. Ubangiji zai sāka masa saboda abin da ya yi.
english: Alexander the coppersmith did much evil to me. The Lord will repay him according to his deeds.

hausa: Ni ma zan faɗi nawa; ni ma zan faɗi abin da na sani.
english: I also will answer my part, and I also will show my opinion.

hausa: Duk mai kunnen ji, yă ji.”
english: He who has ears to hear, let him hear.”

hausa: In wani yana tsammani shi wani abu ne alhali kuwa shi ba kome ba, ruɗin kansa yake yi.
english: For if a man thinks himself to be something when he is nothing, he deceives himself.

hausa: Ku yi aikinku da kyakkyawar niyya, sai ka ce ga Ubangiji kuke yi, ba mutane ba.
english: with good will doing service as to the Lord and not to men,

hausa: Sai dai ku yi marmarin neman baye-baye mafi girma. Yanzu kuwa zan nuna muku mafificiyar hanya.
english: But earnestly desire the best gifts. Moreover, I show a most excellent way to you.

hausa: Zan yi maka godiya, domin ka amsa mini; ka zama mai cetona.
english: I will give thanks to you, for you have answered me, and have become my salvation.

hausa: Da yake yanzu, ya mai girma, Ubangiji ya hana ka zubar da jini da kuma ɗaukan wa kanka fansa, muddin Ubangiji yana raye, kai kuma kana a raye, bari maƙiyinka da dukan waɗanda suke niyya su cuci shugabana su zama kamar Nabal.
english: Now therefore, my lord, as Yahweh lives and as your soul lives, since Yahweh has withheld you from blood guiltiness and from avenging yourself with your own hand, now therefore let your enemies and those who seek evil to my lord be as Nabal.

hausa: Har yanzu dai da sauran dama domin waɗansu su shiga, su kuwa waɗanda aka fara yi wa albishirin nan sun kāsa shiga saboda rashin biyayya.
english: Seeing therefore it remains that some should enter into it, and they to whom the good news was preached before failed to enter in because of disobedience,

hausa: bari kuma haskokin su kasance a sararin sama domin su ba da haske a duniya.” Haka kuwa ya kasance.
english: and let them be for lights in the expanse of the sky to give light on the earth;” and it was so.

hausa: Duk da haka in aka kama shi, dole yă biya sau bakwai ko da yake abin zai ci dukan arzikin gidansa.
english: but if he is found, he shall restore seven times. He shall give all the wealth of his house.

hausa: Ana iya shan ƙarfin mutum ɗaya, mutum biyu za su iya kāre kansu. Igiya riɓi uku tana da wuya tsinkawa.
english: If a man prevails against one who is alone, two shall withstand him; and a threefold cord is not quickly broken.

hausa: Sai mahaifiyar ’ya’yan Zebedin nan ta zo wurin Yesu tare da ’ya’yanta, da ta durƙusa a ƙasa, sai ta roƙe shi yă yi mata wani abu.
english: Then the mother of the sons of Zebedee came to him with her sons, kneeling and asking a certain thing of him.

hausa: Ga maganar Ubangiji da ta zo wa Irmiya annabi game da Elam, a farkon mulkin Zedekiya sarkin Yahuda.
english: Yahweh’s word that came to Jeremiah the prophet concerning Elam, in the beginning of the reign of Zedekiah king of Judah, saying,

hausa: Ya kama ta a hannu ya taimake ta ta tsaya a ƙafafunta. Sa’an nan ya kira masu bi da kuma gwaurayen ya miƙa musu ita da rai.
english: He gave her his hand and raised her up. Calling the saints and widows, he presented her alive.

hausa: Waɗansu Filistiyawa suka kawo wa Yehoshafat kyautai da azurfa a matsayin haraji, Larabawa kuwa suka kawo masa garkuna, raguna dubu bakwai da ɗari bakwai da kuma awaki dubu bakwai da ɗari bakwai.
english: Some of the Philistines brought Jehoshaphat presents and silver for tribute. The Arabians also brought him flocks: seven thousand seven hundred rams and seven thousand seven hundred male goats.

hausa: wadda nake shan wahala har ga daurin sarƙa kamar mai laifi. Amma Maganar Allah ba a daure take ba.
english: in which I suffer hardship to the point of chains as a criminal. But God’s word isn’t chained.

hausa: ku lura. Sa’ad da ’yan matan Shilo suka fito waje don su yi rawa, ku fito a guje daga gonakin inabi, kowannenku yă kama wa kansa mata daga cikin ’yan matan Shilo, ku tafi ƙasar Benyamin.
english: and see, and behold, if the daughters of Shiloh come out to dance in the dances, then come out of the vineyards, and each man catch his wife of the daughters of Shiloh, and go to the land of Benjamin.

hausa: sai Haruna ya gaya musu dukan abin da Ubangiji ya ce wa Musa. Ya kuma aikata mu’ujizan a gaban mutanen,
english: Aaron spoke all the words which Yahweh had spoken to Moses, and did the signs in the sight of the people.

hausa: A wannan rana, da yamma, sai ya ce wa almajiransa, “Mu ƙetare zuwa wancan hayi.”
english: On that day, when evening had come, he said to them, “Let’s go over to the other side.”

hausa: Na san abin da zan yi, don mutane su karɓe ni a gidajensu, bayan an kore ni daga aiki a nan.’
english: I know what I will do, so that when I am removed from management, they may receive me into their houses.’

hausa: Da Zakariya ya gan shi sai ya firgita, tsoro kuma ya kama shi.
english: Zacharias was troubled when he saw him, and fear fell upon him.

hausa: Ya sāke gina Bet-Horon na Bisa da kuma Bet-Horon na Ƙasa a matsayin birane masu katanga, da bangaye da ƙofofi da kuma ƙyamare,
english: Also he built Beth Horon the upper and Beth Horon the lower, fortified cities with walls, gates, and bars;

hausa: Yayinda suke can, sai lokacin haihuwar jaririn ya yi,
english: While they were there, the day had come for her to give birth.

hausa: Haka kuwa dukan Isra’ila suka ji labari cewa, “Shawulu ya kai hari a ƙasar Filistiyawa, yanzu Isra’ila ta zama abin ƙi ga Filistiyawa.” Aka kira mutane su haɗu da Shawulu a Gilgal.
english: All Israel heard that Saul had struck the garrison of the Philistines, and also that Israel was considered an abomination to the Philistines. The people were gathered together after Saul to Gilgal.

hausa: “La’ananne ne mutumin da ya karkatar da makaho daga hanya.” Sai dukan mutane su ce, “Amin!”
english: ‘Cursed is he who leads the blind astray on the road.’ All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’

hausa: a kan hukunci kuma, domin an yanke hukunci a kan mai mulkin duniyan nan.
english: about judgment, because the prince of this world has been judged.

hausa: Da suka ji haka, sai suka yi fushi suka so su kashe su.
english: But they, when they heard this, were cut to the heart, and were determined to kill them.

hausa: Rawar jiki ya kama su a can, zafi kamar na mace mai naƙuda.
english: Trembling took hold of them there, pain, as of a woman in travail.

hausa: “Sa’an nan ka kwanta a hagunka ka kuma sa zunubin gidan Isra’ila a kanka. Za ka ɗauki zunubinsu na waɗansu kwanakin da kake kwance a gefenka.
english: “Moreover lie on your left side, and lay the iniquity of the house of Israel on it. According to the number of the days that you shall lie on it, you shall bear their iniquity.

hausa: Kada ku yi auratayya da su. Kada ku ba da ’ya’yanku mata wa ’ya’yansu maza, ko ku ɗauko ’ya’yansu mata wa ’ya’yanku maza.
english: You shall not make marriages with them. You shall not give your daughter to his son, nor shall you take his daughter for your son.

hausa: “Har yanzu kuma, a cikin mafarkina na ga kawuna bakwai na dawa ƙosassu masu kyau, suna girma a kara guda.
english: I saw in my dream, and behold, seven heads of grain came up on one stalk, full and good;

hausa: Ga abin da Ubangiji Maɗaukaki yana cewa, “Ga shi, zan karye ƙarfin Elam, zaunannen ƙarfinsu.
english: “Yahweh of Armies says: ‘Behold, I will break the bow of Elam, the chief of their might.

hausa: Za a ce, ina ƙoƙarin neman amincewar mutane ne, ko amincewa ta Allah? Ko kuwa ina ƙoƙarin faranta wa mutane zuciya ne? Da a ce har yanzu ina ƙoƙarin faranta wa mutane zuciya ne, ai, da ban zama bawan Kiristi ba.
english: For am I now seeking the favor of men, or of God? Or am I striving to please men? For if I were still pleasing men, I wouldn’t be a servant of Christ.

hausa: Yanar gizo-gizonsu ba amfani don tufa; ba za su iya rufuwa da abin da suka yi ba. Ayyukansu mugaye ne, ayyukan tā da hargitsi kuma suna a hannuwansu.
english: Their webs won’t become garments. They won’t cover themselves with their works. Their works are works of iniquity, and acts of violence are in their hands.

hausa: Ya kamata kowannenmu yă faranta wa maƙwabcinsa rai don kyautata zamansa domin kuma yă gina shi.
english: Let each one of us please his neighbor for that which is good, to be building him up.

hausa: Amma fatar ɗan bijimin, da namansa, da kansa, da ƙafafunsa, da kayan cikinsa, da hanjinsa,
english: He shall carry the bull’s skin, all its meat, with its head, and with its legs, its innards, and its dung

hausa: “Ga abin da Ubangiji yana cewa, yadda na kawo dukan wannan masifa a kan wannan mutane, haka zan ba su wadatar da na yi musu alkawari.
english: For Yahweh says: “Just as I have brought all this great evil on this people, so I will bring on them all the good that I have promised them.

hausa: To, ’yan’uwa, muna so ku san abin da alherin Allah ya ba wa ikkilisiyoyin Makidoniya.
english: Moreover, brothers, we make known to you the grace of God which has been given in the assemblies of Macedonia,

hausa: Sa’an nan Ubangiji ya ce wa Musa,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

hausa: Bari a canja tunaninsa irin na mutane a ba shi tunani irin na dabbobi, har sau bakwai su wuce a kansa.
english: Let his heart be changed from man’s, and let an animal’s heart be given to him. Then let seven times pass over him.

hausa: A kan duwatsun Isra’ila za ka fāɗi, kai da sojojinka da kuma al’ummai da suke tare da kai. Zan bayar da kai ka zama abinci ga tsuntsaye da namun jeji masu cin nama.
english: You will fall on the mountains of Israel, you, and all your hordes, and the peoples who are with you. I will give you to the ravenous birds of every sort and to the animals of the field to be devoured.

hausa: Zan tumɓuke daga gare ku ginshiƙan Asheranku in kuma rurrushe biranenku.
english: I will uproot your Asherah poles from among you; and I will destroy your cities.

hausa: “Yanzu, ka gaya wa bawana Dawuda ‘Ga abin da Ubangiji Maɗaukaki ya ce, na ɗauko ka daga makiyaya, daga kuma garken tumaki ka zama sarki bisan mutane Isra’ila.
english: Now therefore tell my servant David this: ‘Yahweh of Armies says, “I took you from the sheep pen, from following the sheep, to be prince over my people, over Israel.

hausa: ta Immer 1,052
english: The children of Immer: one thousand fifty-two.

hausa: Mai arziki zai yi zato shi mai hikima ne a ganinsa, amma matalauci mai basira ya fi shi sanin abin da yake daidai.
english: The rich man is wise in his own eyes; but the poor who has understanding sees through him.

hausa: Kuma duk wanda ya kira bisa sunan Ubangiji zai sami ceto.’
english: It will be that whoever will call on the name of the Lord will be saved.’

hausa: Ya sa taron su zazzauna a ƙasa.
english: He commanded the multitude to sit down on the ground;

hausa: da shanu biyu, raguna biyar, bunsurai biyar da kuma ’yan raguna biyar, dukansu bana ɗaya-ɗaya, a miƙa su hadaya ta salama. Wannan ita ce hadayar Gamaliyel ɗan Fedazur.
english: and for the sacrifice of peace offerings, two head of cattle, five rams, five male goats, and five male lambs a year old. This was the offering of Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur.

hausa: Ta Dawuda. Zan yabe ka, ya Ubangiji, da dukan zuciyata; a gaban “alloli” zan rera yabo.
english: By David. I will give you thanks with my whole heart. Before the gods, I will sing praises to you.

hausa: Sai maganar Ubangiji ta zo mini cewa,
english: Then Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

hausa: Ya karkashe manyan sarakuna, Ƙaunarsa madawwamiya ce.
english: and killed mighty kings, for his loving kindness endures forever;

hausa: suka cinye kowane abu mai ruwan kore a cikin ƙasarsu, suka cinye amfanin gonarsu
english: They ate up every plant in their land, and ate up the fruit of their ground.

hausa: Waƙar haurawa. Sun yi mini danniya ƙwarai tun ina ƙarami, bari Isra’ila yă ce,
english: A Song of Ascents. Many times they have afflicted me from my youth up. Let Israel now say:

hausa: Yesu ya gargaɗe su kada su gaya wa kowa kome a kansa.
english: He commanded them that they should tell no one about him.

hausa: Sai Ubangiji ya ce wa Yaƙub, “Koma ƙasar kakanninka da kuma danginka, zan kuwa kasance tare da kai.”
english: Yahweh said to Jacob, “Return to the land of your fathers, and to your relatives, and I will be with you.”

hausa: Sa’ad da Ammonawa suka ga Arameyawa suna gudu, sai su ma suka guda a gaban ɗan’uwansa Abishai suka shiga cikin birni. Sai Yowab ya koma Urushalima.
english: When the children of Ammon saw that the Syrians had fled, they likewise fled before Abishai his brother, and entered into the city. Then Joab came to Jerusalem.

hausa: An haskaka haske a kan masu adalci da kuma farin ciki a kan masu gaskiya a zuciya.
english: Light is sown for the righteous, and gladness for the upright in heart.

hausa: Kamar yadda kuka sha a kan tuduna mai tsarki, haka dukan al’ummai za su yi ta sha, za su sha, su kuma sha su zama sai ka ce ba su taɓa kasancewa ba.
english: For as you have drunk on my holy mountain, so all the nations will drink continually. Yes, they will drink, swallow down, and will be as though they had not been.

hausa: Amma na bar ka ka rayu domin in nuna maka ikona, domin kuma sunana yă zama abin darajantawa a dukan duniya.
english: but indeed for this cause I have made you stand: to show you my power, and that my name may be declared throughout all the earth,

hausa: An rubuta a cikin littafin annabi Ishaya cewa, “Zan aika da ɗan aikena yă sha gabanka, wanda zai shirya hanyarka,”
english: As it is written in the prophets, “Behold, I send my messenger before your face, who will prepare your way before you:

hausa: Allah ne fa yake sa mu da ku mu tsaya daram cikin Kiristi. Shi ne ya shafe mu,
english: Now he who establishes us with you in Christ and anointed us is God,

hausa: Sa’an nan Dawuda ya haye zuwa wancan gefen kwarin, ya hau kan wani tudu mai ɗan nisa inda Shawulu tare da mutanensa suke. Akwai babban fili tsakaninsu.
english: Then David went over to the other side, and stood on the top of the mountain far away, a great space being between them;

hausa: ’Ya’yan bayinka za su zauna a gabanka; zuriyarsu za su kahu a gabanka.”
english: The children of your servants will continue. Their offspring will be established before you.”

hausa: A lokacin ne suka ƙera gunki mai siffar ɗan maraƙi. Suka kawo masa hadayu suka kuma yi bikin girmama abin da suka ƙera da hannuwansu.
english: They made a calf in those days, and brought a sacrifice to the idol, and rejoiced in the works of their hands.

hausa: In ba zai iya ba, to, tun suna nesa, zai aika da wakilai, su je neman sharuɗan salama.
english: Or else, while the other is yet a great way off, he sends an envoy and asks for conditions of peace.

hausa: Amma jirgin ruwan ya shiga yashi ya kafe. Kan jirgin ya shiga cikin yashin ya kāsa motsi, sai jirgin ya fara farfashewa ta baya saboda haukan raƙuman ruwa.
english: But coming to a place where two seas met, they ran the vessel aground. The bow struck and remained immovable, but the stern began to break up by the violence of the waves.

hausa: “Game da ni dai, ga alkawarina da su,” in ji Ubangiji. “Ruhuna, wanda yake a kanka, da kuma maganata da na sa a bakinka ba za tă rabu da bakinka ba, ko daga bakunan ’ya’yanka ba, ko kuwa daga bakunan zuriyarsu ba daga wannan lokaci zuwa gaba da kuma har abada,” in ji Ubangiji.
english: “As for me, this is my covenant with them,” says Yahweh. “My Spirit who is on you, and my words which I have put in your mouth shall not depart out of your mouth, nor out of the mouth of your offspring, nor out of the mouth of your offspring’s offspring,” says Yahweh, “from now on and forever.”

hausa: Sau da dama nakan bi majami’a-majami’a, in sa a yi musu hukunci. Na kuma yi ƙoƙarin tilasta su su yi saɓo. Don kuma tsananin fushi da su, sai da na fafare su har waɗansu garuruwa na ƙetaren iyaka, ina tsananta musu.
english: Punishing them often in all the synagogues, I tried to make them blaspheme. Being exceedingly enraged against them, I persecuted them even to foreign cities.

hausa: Mai gadin kurkukun ya kira a kawo fitilu, ya ruga ciki ya fāɗi yana rawan jiki a gaban Bulus da Sila.
english: He called for lights, sprang in, fell down trembling before Paul and Silas,

hausa: Elisha ya ce musu, “Wannan ba ita ce hanyar ba, ba kuma gari ke nan ba, ku bi ni, zan kuwa kai ku wurin mutumin da kuke nema!” Sai ya kai su Samariya.
english: Elisha said to them, “This is not the way, neither is this the city. Follow me, and I will bring you to the man whom you seek.” He led them to Samaria.

hausa: Saboda haka Musa ya sassaƙa alluna biyu na dutse kamar na fari, sai ya hau Dutsen Sinai da sassafe, kamar yadda Ubangiji ya umarce shi, yana kuma ɗauke da alluna biyu na dutse a hannuwansa.
english: He chiseled two tablets of stone like the first; then Moses rose up early in the morning, and went up to Mount Sinai, as Yahweh had commanded him, and took in his hand two stone tablets.

hausa: Ta kuma haifi Sha’af mahaifin Madmanna da kuma Shewa, mahaifin Makbena da Gibeya. ’Yar Kaleb ita ce Aksa.
english: She bore also Shaaph the father of Madmannah, Sheva the father of Machbena and the father of Gibea; and the daughter of Caleb was Achsah.

hausa: “Don me kake duban ɗan tsinken da yake idon ɗan’uwanka, alhali kuwa ga gungume a naka ido?
english: Why do you see the speck that is in your brother’s eye, but don’t consider the beam that is in your own eye?

hausa: Bulus ya so ya bayyana a gaban taron, amma almajirai ba su bar shi ba.
english: When Paul wanted to enter in to the people, the disciples didn’t allow him.

hausa: Amma ina aika ’yan’uwan nan don kada taƙamar da muke yi da ku, a kan wannan al’amari ta zama a banza, sai dai domin yă zama kuna nan a shirye, kamar yadda na faɗa za ku kasance.
english: But I have sent the brothers so that our boasting on your behalf may not be in vain in this respect, that, just as I said, you may be prepared,

hausa: ba shakka, ruwan inabi ya yaudare shi; yana fariya kuma ba ya hutu. Domin shi mai haɗama ne kamar kabari kuma kamar mutuwa, ba ya ƙoshi; yakan tattara dukan al’ummai wa kansa yana kuma kama dukan mutane su zama kamammu.
english: Yes, moreover, wine is treacherous: an arrogant man who doesn’t stay at home, who enlarges his desire as Sheol; he is like death and can’t be satisfied, but gathers to himself all nations and heaps to himself all peoples.

hausa: Bayan da suka gicciye shi, sai suka raba tufafinsa a tsakaninsu ta wurin jefa ƙuri’a.
english: When they had crucified him, they divided his clothing among them, casting lots,

hausa: Sa’an nan idanunsu suka buɗe, suka gane shi. Sai ya ɓace musu.
english: Their eyes were opened and they recognized him; then he vanished out of their sight.

hausa: Daga yalwar alherinsa dukanmu muka sami albarka bisa albarka.
english: From his fullness we all received grace upon grace.

hausa: Saboda haka na ɗauko shugabannin kabilanku masu hikima, waɗanda suka saba da ma’amala da jama’a, na sa su shugabanni a gabanku, waɗansu suka zama shugabanni a kan dubu-dubu, waɗansu a kan ɗari-ɗari, waɗansu a kan hamsin-hamsin, waɗansu kuma a kan goma-goma. Na sa su zama shugabanni a kabilanku.
english: So I took the heads of your tribes, wise and respected men, and made them heads over you, captains of thousands, captains of hundreds, captains of fifties, captains of tens, and officers, according to your tribes.

hausa: Ya ce, “In wani ya ɗaura ni sosai da sababbin igiyoyin da ba a taɓa amfani da su ba, zan zama marar ƙarfi kamar kowa.”
english: He said to her, “If they only bind me with new ropes with which no work has been done, then I will become weak, and be as another man.”

hausa: Waɗannan su ne sunayen ’ya’yan da aka haifa masa a can. Shammuwa, Shobab, Natan, Solomon,
english: These are the names of those who were born to him in Jerusalem: Shammua, Shobab, Nathan, Solomon,

hausa: Ina sāke faɗa, kada wani yă ɗauka ni wawa ne. Amma in kun ɗauke ni haka, to, sai ku karɓe ni kamar yadda kuke karɓan wawa, domin in ɗan in yi taƙama.
english: I say again, let no one think me foolish. But if so, yet receive me as foolish, that I also may boast a little.

hausa: Da masinjojin suka koma wurin sarki, sai sarki ya ce da su, “Don me kuka komo?”
english: The messengers returned to him, and he said to them, “Why is it that you have returned?”

hausa: Amma domin ku san cewa Ɗan Mutum yana da iko a duniya ya gafarta zunubai.” Sai ya ce wa shanyayyen, “Na ce maka, tashi, ɗauki tabarmarka ka tafi gida.”
english: But that you may know that the Son of Man has authority on earth to forgive sins,” he said to the paralyzed man, “I tell you, arise, take up your cot, and go to your house.”

hausa: Ya sa hular kwanon da aka yi da tagulla, da rigar ƙarfe mai sulke, nauyin rigar ya kai shekel dubu biyar.
english: He had a helmet of bronze on his head, and he wore a coat of mail; and the weight of the coat was five thousand shekels of bronze.

hausa: Yesu ya amsa ya ce, “Mu je wani wuri dabam, zuwa ƙauyukan da suke kusa, don in yi wa’azi a can ma. Wannan shi ne dalilin zuwana.”
english: He said to them, “Let’s go elsewhere into the next towns, that I may preach there also, because I came out for this reason.”

hausa: Ku jefar da banzan bawan nan waje, cikin duhu, inda za a yi kuka da cizon haƙora.’
english: Throw out the unprofitable servant into the outer darkness, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.’

hausa: ɗan Zerahiya, ɗan Uzzi, ɗan Bukki,
english: the son of Zerahiah, the son of Uzzi, the son of Bukki,

hausa: Wani mutum zai mutu cikin jin daɗi da kwanciyar hankali,
english: One dies in his full strength, being wholly at ease and quiet.

hausa: Sa’ad da suka je Gileyad, wurin mutanen Ruben, mutanen Gad da kuma rabin mutanen kabilar Manasse, sai suka ce musu,
english: They came to the children of Reuben, and to the children of Gad, and to the half-tribe of Manasseh, to the land of Gilead, and they spoke with them, saying,

hausa: Ba ya bukata yă yi ta miƙa hadayu kowace rana saboda zunubansa, sa’an nan saboda zunuban mutane kamar sauran firistoci. Ya miƙa hadaya sau ɗaya tak, sa’ad da ya miƙa kansa.
english: who doesn’t need, like those high priests, to offer up sacrifices daily, first for his own sins, and then for the sins of the people. For he did this once for all, when he offered up himself.

hausa: An daɗe bayan da Ubangiji ya ba Isra’ilawa hutu daga dukan abokan gāban da suke kewaye da su. Yoshuwa kuwa ya tsufa, shekarunsa sun yi yawa,
english: After many days, when Yahweh had given rest to Israel from their enemies all around, and Joshua was old and well advanced in years,

hausa: Raina ya gaji da baƙin ciki; ka ƙarfafa ni bisa ga maganarka.
english: My soul is weary with sorrow; strengthen me according to your word.

hausa: Dawuda ya ce, “Kai da kanka za ka ga abin da bawanka zai yi.” Akish ya ce, “Da kyau, zan sa ka zama mai kāre ni.”
english: David said to Achish, “Therefore you will know what your servant can do.” Achish said to David, “Therefore I will make you my bodyguard forever.”

hausa: Sa’an nan Ubangiji ya ce wa Musa,
english: Moreover Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

hausa: Sai Gideyon ya shiga ciki, ya gyara ’yar akuya ya dafa, da garin efa ya yi burodi marar yisti. Da ya sa naman a kwando, romon kuma a tukunya, sai ya fito da su waje ya miƙa masa su a ƙarƙashin itacen oak.
english: Gideon went in and prepared a young goat and unleavened cakes of an ephah of meal. He put the meat in a basket and he put the broth in a pot, and brought it out to him under the oak, and presented it.

hausa: Yanzu an halicce su, ba da daɗewa ba; ba ku riga kun ji game da su kafin yau ba. Saboda haka ba za ku ce, ‘I, na san da su ba.’
english: They are created now, and not from of old. Before today, you didn’t hear them, lest you should say, ‘Behold, I knew them.’

hausa: Ba kuwa za a kira ku ‘malam’ ba, gama kuna da Malami ɗaya ne, Kiristi.
english: Neither be called masters, for one is your master, the Christ.

hausa: Mutanen da suke son yin arziki sukan fāɗi cikin jarraba, su fāɗa a tarko, suna mugayen sha’awace-sha’awace iri-iri na wauta da cutarwa, irin waɗanda suke dulmuyar da mutane, su kai ga lalacewa da hallaka.
english: But those who are determined to be rich fall into a temptation, a snare, and many foolish and harmful lusts, such as drown men in ruin and destruction.

hausa: Bangirma ne ga mutum ya guji faɗa, amma kowane wawa yana saurin yin faɗa.
english: It is an honor for a man to keep aloof from strife, but every fool will be quarreling.

hausa: Da sassafen kashegari rana ta biyar, ya tashi zai tafi, sai mahaifin yarinyar ya ce, “Ka ɗan zauna ka shaƙata sai rana ta yi sanyi mana!” Saboda haka su biyu suka zauna suka ci abinci tare.
english: He arose early in the morning on the fifth day to depart; and the young lady’s father said, “Please strengthen your heart and stay until the day declines;” and they both ate.

hausa: ’Yan’uwa, kada ku ɓata wa juna suna. Duk wanda ya zargi ɗan’uwansa ko ya ɗora masa laifi, yana gāba da doka ne yana kuma yin mata shari’a ke nan. In kuwa ka ɗora wa shari’a laifi, kai ba mai binta ba ne, mai ɗora mata laifi ne.
english: Don’t speak against one another, brothers. He who speaks against a brother and judges his brother, speaks against the law and judges the law. But if you judge the law, you are not a doer of the law but a judge.

hausa: Sa’ad da mugu ya samu shugabanci, mutane sukan yi ta ɓuya; amma sa’ad da mugu ya hallaka, adali kan ci gaba cikin arziki da lafiya.
english: When the wicked rise, men hide themselves; but when they perish, the righteous thrive.

hausa: Sai Musa ya ce wa Haruna da ’ya’yansa maza, “Ku dafa naman a ƙofar Tentin Sujada, ku kuma ci shi a can tare da burodi daga kwandon naɗi, yadda na umarta, cewa, ‘Haruna da ’ya’yansa maza za su ci shi.’
english: Moses said to Aaron and to his sons, “Boil the meat at the door of the Tent of Meeting, and there eat it and the bread that is in the basket of consecration, as I commanded, saying, ‘Aaron and his sons shall eat it.’

hausa: Za su cinye ’ya’yan dabbobinku da hatsin gonarku sai an hallaka ku. Ba za su rage ko ƙwayar hatsi, ko sabon ruwan inabi, ko mai ba, ba kuwa za a bar ’yan tumakinku ba, sai an lalatar da ku.
english: They will eat the fruit of your livestock and the fruit of your ground, until you are destroyed. They also won’t leave you grain, new wine, oil, the increase of your livestock, or the young of your flock, until they have caused you to perish.

hausa: Sa’ad da wani ya kawo hadaya ta salama daga garken shanu, ko na tumaki, ga Ubangiji don yă cika wani alkawari na musamman, ko hadaya ta yardar rai, dole yă zama marar lahani, ko tabo, don yă zama yardajje.
english: Whoever offers a sacrifice of peace offerings to Yahweh to accomplish a vow, or for a free will offering of the herd or of the flock, it shall be perfect to be accepted. It shall have no defect.

hausa: Sa’ad da Reyu ya yi shekaru 32, sai ya haifi Serug.
english: Reu lived thirty-two years, and became the father of Serug.

hausa: Kada ka bar zuciyarka tă yi ƙyashin masu zunubi, amma kullum tsoron Ubangiji za ka yi kishi.
english: Don’t let your heart envy sinners, but rather fear Yahweh all day long.

hausa: Saboda haka Solomon ya gina haikalin ya kuma gama shi.
english: So Solomon built the house and finished it.

hausa: Dattawan iyalinsa suka tsaya kusa da shi don su ɗaga shi daga ƙasa, amma ya ƙi, bai kuwa ci wani abu tare da su ba.
english: The elders of his house arose beside him, to raise him up from the earth; but he would not, and he didn’t eat bread with them.

hausa: Mutumin ya arzuta, arzikinsa ya yi ta haɓaka har ya zama attajiri.
english: The man grew great, and grew more and more until he became very great.

hausa: Aka dawo da gawawwakinsu Shekem aka binne su a kabarin da Ibrahim ya saya daga wurin ’ya’yan Hamor da waɗansu kuɗi a Shekem.
english: and they were brought back to Shechem and laid in the tomb that Abraham bought for a price in silver from the children of Hamor of Shechem.

hausa: Ya harba kibiyoyinsa ya kuma watsar da abokan gāba, walƙiya mai girma ya fafare su.
english: He sent out his arrows, and scattered them. He routed them with great lightning bolts.

hausa: Yaƙub kuwa ya kafa al’amudin dutse a inda Allah ya yi magana da shi, ya zuba hadaya ta sha a kansa; ya kuma zuba mai a kansa.
english: Jacob set up a pillar in the place where he spoke with him, a pillar of stone. He poured out a drink offering on it, and poured oil on it.

hausa: Saboda haka Ubangiji ya sayar da su ga Yabin sarkin Kan’ana wanda yake mulki a Hazor. Shugaban mayaƙansa shi ne Sisera, wanda yake zaune a Haroshet Haggoyim.
english: Yahweh sold them into the hand of Jabin king of Canaan, who reigned in Hazor; the captain of whose army was Sisera, who lived in Harosheth of the Gentiles.

hausa: “Ka daina maganganu na girman kai ka kuma daina faɗin kalmomin ɗaga kai; gama Ubangiji Allah ne masani daga gare shi kuma ana auna ayyuka.
english: “Don’t keep talking so exceedingly proudly. Don’t let arrogance come out of your mouth, for Yahweh is a God of knowledge. By him actions are weighed.

hausa: Sai Yesu ya tsaya, ya ba da umarni a kawo mutumin wurinsa. Da ya zo kusa, Yesu ya tambaye shi ya ce,
english: Standing still, Jesus commanded him to be brought to him. When he had come near, he asked him,

hausa: An kwantar da ni ƙasa cikin ƙura; ka kiyaye raina bisa ga maganarka.
english: My soul is laid low in the dust. Revive me according to your word!

hausa: Sun yi fariya kyan kayan adonsu suka kuma yi amfani da su don su yi gumakansu masu banƙyama, da ƙazantattun abubuwa.
english: As for the beauty of his ornament, he set it in majesty; but they made the images of their abominations and their detestable things therein. Therefore I have made it to them as an unclean thing.

hausa: “ ‘Zan ƙwace girbinsu, in ji Ubangiji. Ba a za sami inabi a kuringa ba. Ba za a sami ’ya’ya a itacen ɓaure ba, ganyayensu kuwa za su bushe. Abin da na ba su za a ƙwace.’ ”
english: “‘I will utterly consume them, says Yahweh. No grapes will be on the vine, no figs on the fig tree, and the leaf will fade. The things that I have given them will pass away from them.’”

hausa: Ta iso Urushalima da tawaga mai yawa, tare da raƙuma masu ɗauke da kayan yaji, da zinariya masu yawa, da duwatsu masu daraja. Ta zo wurin Solomon ta kuwa yi magana da shi game da dukan abin da take da shi a ranta.
english: She came to Jerusalem with a very great caravan, with camels that bore spices, very much gold, and precious stones; and when she had come to Solomon, she talked with him about all that was in her heart.

hausa: Ƙafafu sukan tattake ta, ƙafafu waɗanda aka zalunta, wato, sawun matalauta.
english: The foot shall tread it down, even the feet of the poor and the steps of the needy.”

hausa: Ko da yake kullum ina riƙe da raina a hannuwana, ba zan manta da dokarka ba.
english: My soul is continually in my hand, yet I won’t forget your law.

hausa: Sai sarkin Isra’ila ya ce, “Mene! Ubangiji ya kira mu sarakunan nan uku don kawai yă ba da mu ga Mowab ne?”
english: The king of Israel said, “Alas! For Yahweh has called these three kings together to deliver them into the hand of Moab.”

hausa: Ubangiji Allahnsu zai cece su a wannan rana gama su mutanensa ne da kuma garkensa. Za su haska a cikin ƙasarsa kamar lu’ulu’u a rawani.
english: Yahweh their God will save them in that day as the flock of his people; for they are like the jewels of a crown, lifted on high over his land.

hausa: Ita wadda take a Babilon, zaɓaɓɓiya tare da ku, tana gaishe ku, haka ma ɗana Markus.
english: She who is in Babylon, chosen together with you, greets you. So does Mark, my son.

hausa: Ira mutumin Itra, Gareb mutumin Itra,
english: Ira the Ithrite, Gareb the Ithrite,

hausa: Wannan ce abin banmamaki ta biyu da Yesu ya yi, bayan zuwansa daga Yahudiya zuwa Galili.
english: This is again the second sign that Jesus did, having come out of Judea into Galilee.

hausa: Ta yi ta cewa, “Ya Ubangiji Maɗaukaki. In har ka dubi baƙin cikin baiwarka, ka tuna da ni, ba ka kuma manta da baiwarka ba, amma ka ba ta ɗa, ni ma zan miƙa shi ga Ubangiji dukan rayuwarsa, aska kuwa ba za tă taɓa kansa ba.”
english: She vowed a vow, and said, “Yahweh of Armies, if you will indeed look at the affliction of your servant and remember me, and not forget your servant, but will give to your servant a boy, then I will give him to Yahweh all the days of his life, and no razor shall come on his head.”

hausa: Na kuma ɗaga hannu na rantse musu cewa zan watsar da su cikin al’ummai in kuma warwatsa su cikin ƙasashe,
english: Moreover I swore to them in the wilderness, that I would scatter them among the nations and disperse them through the countries,

hausa: Shawulu ya ce, “Mu bi gangara mu fafare Filistiyawa da dare mu washe su har gari yă waye, mu kuma karkashe kowannensu, kada mu bar wani da rai.” Suka ce, “Ka yi duk abin da ka ga ya fi maka kyau.” Amma firist ya ce, “Bari mu nemi nufin Allah tukuna.”
english: Saul said, “Let’s go down after the Philistines by night, and take plunder among them until the morning light. Let’s not leave a man of them.” They said, “Do whatever seems good to you.” Then the priest said, “Let’s draw near here to God.”

hausa: Sa’an nan suka aika wa Yezebel. “An jajjefe Nabot, ya kuma mutu.”
english: Then they sent to Jezebel, saying, “Naboth has been stoned and is dead.”

hausa: Sama’ila ya ce, “Ko da yake kana ganin kanka kai ba wani abu ne ba, ashe, ba kai ne yanzu shugaban kabilan Isra’ila ba? Ubangiji ya shafe ka ka zama sarkin Isra’ila.
english: Samuel said, “Though you were little in your own sight, weren’t you made the head of the tribes of Israel? Yahweh anointed you king over Israel;

hausa: To, ’yan’uwansa suka tafi kiwon garkunan mahaifinsu kusa da Shekem.
english: His brothers went to feed their father’s flock in Shechem.

hausa: Ubangiji kuwa ya ce wa masa,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

hausa: Wata rana mala’iku suka kawo kansu gaban Ubangiji, Shaiɗan shi ma ya zo tare da su.
english: Now on the day when God’s sons came to present themselves before Yahweh, Satan also came among them.

hausa: Kashegari da safe, sai ku tashi ku fāɗa wa birnin. Sa’ad da Ga’al da mutanensa suka faɗa maka, sai ka yi abin da ka iya yi da su.”
english: It shall be that in the morning, as soon as the sun is up, you shall rise early and rush on the city. Behold, when he and the people who are with him come out against you, then may you do to them as you shall find occasion.”

hausa: “An ji murya a Rama, tana kuka da makoki mai tsanani, Rahila ce take kuka domin ’ya’yanta, an kāsa ta’azantar da ita, don ba su.”
english: “A voice was heard in Ramah, lamentation, weeping and great mourning, Rachel weeping for her children; she wouldn’t be comforted, because they are no more.”

hausa: Haka ma, mutanen Memfis da Tafanes sun aske rawanin kanka
english: The children also of Memphis and Tahpanhes have broken the crown of your head.

hausa: “Wannan shi ne wurin hutuna har abada abadin; a nan zan zauna ina mulki gama ina son ta,
english: “This is my resting place forever. I will live here, for I have desired it.

hausa: Solomon kuma ya ba wa Hiram mudu gari dubu ashirin na alkama a matsayin abinci domin gidansa, ya ƙara da garwa dubu ashirin na tataccen man zaitun. Solomon ya ci gaba da yin haka ga Hiram, shekara-shekara.
english: Solomon gave Hiram twenty thousand cors of wheat for food to his household, and twenty cors of pure oil. Solomon gave this to Hiram year by year.

hausa: zuriyar Delahiya, Tobiya, da Nekoda 642.
english: The children of Delaiah, the children of Tobiah, the children of Nekoda: six hundred forty-two.

hausa: Wannan da yake zaune a kursiyin ya ce. “Ina yin kome sabo!” Sai ya ce, “Rubuta wannan, domin waɗannan kalmomi amintattu ne gaskiya ne kuma.”
english: He who sits on the throne said, “Behold, I am making all things new.” He said, “Write, for these words of God are faithful and true.”

hausa: Mutum marar azanci ba zai sani ba, wawa ba zai gane ba,
english: A senseless man doesn’t know, neither does a fool understand this:

hausa: Ba su ba ne suke ɓata sunan nan mai martaba wanda aka san ku da shi ba?
english: Don’t they blaspheme the honorable name by which you are called?

hausa: Ya ce, “Zo nan, ni kuwa zan ba da naman jikinka ga tsuntsayen sama da namun jeji su ci.”
english: The Philistine said to David, “Come to me, and I will give your flesh to the birds of the sky and to the animals of the field.”

hausa: Har illa yau waɗansu suka ce, “Mun ci bashin kuɗi don mu biya haraji a kan gonakinmu, da gonakin inabinmu.
english: There were also some who said, “We have borrowed money for the king’s tribute using our fields and our vineyards as collateral.

hausa: Ba shi da kyau ka sha zuma da yawa, haka ma ba shi da kyau ka nemi girma wa kanka.
english: It is not good to eat much honey, nor is it honorable to seek one’s own honor.

hausa: Na ce, “Zan hau itacen dabino; zan kama ’ya’yansa.” Bari nonanki su zama kamar nonna kuringa, ƙanshin numfashinki ya yi kamar gawasa,
english: I said, “I will climb up into the palm tree. I will take hold of its fruit.” Let your breasts be like clusters of the vine, the smell of your breath like apples.

hausa: Gama ba za a ƙara tunawa da mai hikima ko wawa ba; nan gaba za a manta da su. Yadda wawa zai mutu, haka ma mai hikima!
english: For of the wise man, even as of the fool, there is no memory forever, since in the days to come all will have been long forgotten. Indeed, the wise man must die just like the fool!

hausa: ’Ya’yan Beriya maza su ne, Heber da Malkiyel, wanda yake mahaifin Birzayit.
english: The sons of Beriah: Heber and Malchiel, who was the father of Birzaith.

hausa: Hezekiya yana da shekara ashirin da biyar sa’ad da ya zama sarki, ya kuma yi mulki a Urushalima shekara ashirin da tara. Sunan mahaifiyarsa Abiya, ’yar Zakariya.
english: Hezekiah began to reign when he was twenty-five years old, and he reigned twenty-nine years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Abijah, the daughter of Zechariah.

hausa: “Matattu suna cikin azaba, waɗanda suke ƙarƙashin ruwaye da dukan mazauna cikin ruwaye.
english: “The departed spirits tremble, those beneath the waters and all that live in them.

hausa: Yoshuwa ya ce, “Me ya sa ka jawo mana wahala haka? Ubangiji zai kawo maka wahala kai ma a yau.” Sai dukan Isra’ilawa suka jajjefe shi, bayan da suka gama jifarsa sai suka ƙone sauran.
english: Joshua said, “Why have you troubled us? Yahweh will trouble you today.” All Israel stoned him with stones, and they burned them with fire and stoned them with stones.

hausa: Ya tambaya, “Tabbatacce kai ne ɗana Isuwa?” Ya amsa ya ce “Ni ne.”
english: He said, “Are you really my son Esau?” He said, “I am.”

hausa: Yanzu ka tashi ka shiga cikin birnin, za a kuma gaya maka abin da dole za ka yi.”
english: But rise up and enter into the city, then you will be told what you must do.”

hausa: Dole in ci gaba da yin taƙama. Ko da yake ba za tă amfane ni ba, zan yi magana a kan ru’uyoyi da wahayoyi waɗanda na karɓa daga Ubangiji.
english: It is doubtless not profitable for me to boast, but I will come to visions and revelations of the Lord.

hausa: Kashegari da sassafe sai Ibrahim ya ɗauki abinci da salkar ruwa, ya ba wa Hagar. Ya ɗora su a kafaɗunta, sa’an nan ya sallame ta da yaron. Ta kama hanyarta ta kuma yi ta yawo a cikin jejin Beyersheba.
english: Abraham rose up early in the morning, and took bread and a container of water, and gave it to Hagar, putting it on her shoulder; and gave her the child, and sent her away. She departed, and wandered in the wilderness of Beersheba.

hausa: “ ‘Hadaya don laifi kamar hadaya don zunubi take, saboda haka ƙa’ida hanyar yinsu iri ɗaya ce. Su ɗin na firist da ya yi kafara da su ne.
english: “‘As is the sin offering, so is the trespass offering; there is one law for them. The priest who makes atonement with them shall have it.

hausa: An raba wa kabilar Yahuda gādonsu ta wurin yin ƙuri’a, bisa ga iyalansu, rabon ya kai har zuwa sashen Edom, zuwa Jejin Zin can kurewar kudu.
english: The lot for the tribe of the children of Judah according to their families was to the border of Edom, even to the wilderness of Zin southward, at the uttermost part of the south.

hausa: Dawuda ya sāke cewa, “Mutanen Keyila za su bashe ni da mutanena ga Shawulu?” Ubangiji ya ce, “Za su yi.”
english: Then David said, “Will the men of Keilah deliver me and my men into the hand of Saul?” Yahweh said, “They will deliver you up.”

hausa: Ku ɓarke cikin waƙoƙin farin ciki gaba ɗaya, kangonki na Urushalima, gama Ubangiji ya ta’azantar da mutanensa, ya fanshi Urushalima.
english: Break out into joy! Sing together, you waste places of Jerusalem; for Yahweh has comforted his people. He has redeemed Jerusalem.

hausa: Adali zai iya kasance da wahala da yawa, amma Ubangiji yakan cece shi daga dukansu;
english: Many are the afflictions of the righteous, but Yahweh delivers him out of them all.

hausa: Game da Damaskus. “Hamat da Arfad sun giggice, gama sun ji mummunar labari. Suna damuwa, sun damu kamar tekun da baya hutu.
english: Of Damascus: “Hamath and Arpad are confounded, for they have heard evil news. They have melted away. There is sorrow on the sea. It can’t be quiet.

hausa: Mafi kyau a cikinsu yana kama da ƙaya, mafi gaskiyarsu ya fi shingen ƙaya muni. Ranar da Allah zai ziyarce ku ta zo, ranar da masu gadinku za su hura ƙaho. Yanzu ne lokacin ruɗewarku.
english: The best of them is like a brier. The most upright is worse than a thorn hedge. The day of your watchmen, even your visitation, has come; now is the time of their confusion.

hausa: za ku zama firistoci masu tsarki da kuma al’umma keɓaɓɓiya a gare ni.’ Waɗannan su ne kalmomin da za ka faɗa wa Isra’ilawa.”
english: and you shall be to me a kingdom of priests and a holy nation.’ These are the words which you shall speak to the children of Israel.”

hausa: “Ɗan mutum, ka fuskanci Sidon; ka yi annabci a kanta
english: “Son of man, set your face toward Sidon, and prophesy against it,

hausa: Sai Solomon ya farka, ya gane ashe mafarki ne. Ya koma Urushalima, ya tsaya a gaban akwatin alkawarin Ubangiji ya miƙa hadayun ƙonawa da hadayun salama. Sa’an nan ya shirya wa fadawansa biki.
english: Solomon awoke; and behold, it was a dream. Then he came to Jerusalem and stood before the ark of Yahweh’s covenant, and offered up burnt offerings, offered peace offerings, and made a feast for all his servants.

hausa: Sa’ad da sarkin Ai ya ga haka, shi da duk mutanen birnin suka hanzarta da sassafe don su gamu da Isra’ilawa, su yi yaƙi da su a wani wurin da yake fuskantar Araba. Amma bai san cewa an yi masa kwanto a bayan birnin ba.
english: When the king of Ai saw it, they hurried and rose up early, and the men of the city went out against Israel to battle, he and all his people, at the time appointed, before the Arabah; but he didn’t know that there was an ambush against him behind the city.

hausa: Furta abin da zai kasance, ku gabatar da shi, bari su yi shawara tare. Wa ya faɗa wannan tuntuni, wa ya yi shelar sa a kwanakin dā? Ba ni ba ne, Ubangiji? Kuma babu Allah in ban da ni, Allah mai adalci da kuma Mai Ceto; babu wani sai ni.
english: Declare and present it. Yes, let them take counsel together. Who has shown this from ancient time? Who has declared it of old? Haven’t I, Yahweh? There is no other God besides me, a just God and a Savior. There is no one besides me.

hausa: Daga can suka tafi ƙasar tudu ta Efraim suka zo gidan Mika.
english: They passed from there to the hill country of Ephraim, and came to the house of Micah.

hausa: Daidai kamar yadda Ubana ya ba ni mulki, haka ni ma nake ba ku.
english: I confer on you a kingdom, even as my Father conferred on me,

hausa: amma Bulus bai ga ya kyautu ya tafi da shi ba, domin ya yashe su a Famfiliya bai kuwa ci gaba tare da su a aikin ba.
english: But Paul didn’t think that it was a good idea to take with them someone who had withdrawn from them in Pamphylia, and didn’t go with them to do the work.

hausa: Labudda, duk masu niyyar zaman tsarkaka, suna na Kiristi Yesu, za su sha tsanani.
english: Yes, and all who desire to live godly in Christ Jesus will suffer persecution.

hausa: in dawo da dukan mutanen a gare ka. Mutuwar wanda kake nema zai zama dawowar duka; dukan mutanen ba za su cutu ba.”
english: and I will bring back all the people to you. The man whom you seek is as if all returned. All the people shall be in peace.”

hausa: A maimakon yin ayyukanku bisa ga abubuwana masu tsarki, kun sa waɗansu su lura da wurina mai tsarki.
english: You have not performed the duty of my holy things; but you have set performers of my duty in my sanctuary for yourselves.”

hausa: Kwana bakwai suka yi sansani ɗaura da juna, a rana ta bakwai sai yaƙi ya haɗu. Isra’ilawa suka kashe sojojin kafa na Arameyawa dubu ɗari a rana ɗaya.
english: They encamped opposite each other for seven days. Then on the seventh day the battle was joined; and the children of Israel killed one hundred thousand footmen of the Syrians in one day.

hausa: Iyakoki sun fāɗo mini a wurare masu daɗi; tabbatacce ina da gādo mai bansha’awa.
english: The lines have fallen to me in pleasant places. Yes, I have a good inheritance.

hausa: Yayinda Yesu yake koyarwa a filin haikalin, sai ya yi tambaya ya ce, “Yaya malaman dokoki suke cewa Kiristi ɗan Dawuda ne?
english: Jesus responded, as he taught in the temple, “How is it that the scribes say that the Christ is the son of David?

hausa: Ya kuma kawo shi wurin Yesu. Yesu ya dube shi ya ce, “Kai ne Siman ɗan Yohanna. Za a ce da kai Kefas” (in an fassara, Bitrus ke nan).
english: He brought him to Jesus. Jesus looked at him and said, “You are Simon the son of Jonah. You shall be called Cephas” (which is by interpretation, Peter).

hausa: Waɗannan su ne ƙa’idodi saboda duk wani cuta mai yaɗuwa, don ƙaiƙayi,
english: This is the law for any plague of leprosy, and for an itch,

hausa: a gare su cikin haikalina da kuma bangayensa zan ba da matuni da kuma suna mafi kyau fiye da ’ya’ya maza da kuma ’ya’ya mata; zan ba su madawwamin sunan da ba za a raba su da shi ba.
english: I will give them in my house and within my walls a memorial and a name better than of sons and of daughters. I will give them an everlasting name that will not be cut off.

hausa: Ga abin da mai girma ya ce mini, “Cikin shekara ɗaya, kamar yadda bawan da aka bautar da shi bisa ga yarjejjeniya zai lissafta, dukan sojojin Kedar za su zo ga ƙarshe.
english: For the Lord said to me, “Within a year, as a worker bound by contract would count it, all the glory of Kedar will fail,

hausa: Bayan an binne shi, sai ya ce wa ’ya’yansa, “Sa’ad da na mutu, ku binne ni a kabarin da aka binne mutumin Allah; ku kwantar da ƙasusuwana kusa da ƙasusuwansa.
english: After he had buried him, he spoke to his sons, saying, “When I am dead, bury me in the tomb in which the man of God is buried. Lay my bones beside his bones.

hausa: Kaitonku da kuke ƙosassu yanzu, gama za ku zauna da yunwa. Kaitonku da kuke dariya yanzu, gama za ku yi makoki da kuka.
english: Woe to you, you who are full now, for you will be hungry. Woe to you who laugh now, for you will mourn and weep.

hausa: Ya aikata mugunta a gaban Ubangiji, yadda Manasse mahaifinsa ya yi.
english: He did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight, as Manasseh his father did.

hausa: “Duk da haka kukan yi tambaya, ‘Me ya sa ɗan ba zai sami rabo a laifin mahaifinsa ba?’ Da yake ɗan ya yi abin da yake daidai da kuma gaskiya, ya kuma kiyaye dukan ƙa’idodina, tabbatacce zai rayu.
english: “Yet you say, ‘Why doesn’t the son bear the iniquity of the father?’ When the son has done that which is lawful and right, and has kept all my statutes, and has done them, he will surely live.

hausa: In su annabawa ne da gaske suna kuma da maganar Ubangiji, bari su roƙi Ubangiji Maɗaukaki ya sa kada a kwashe kayayyakin da suka ragu a gidan Ubangiji da kuma a cikin fadar sarkin Yahuda da kuma cikin Urushalima a kai Babilon.
english: But if they are prophets, and if Yahweh’s word is with them, let them now make intercession to Yahweh of Armies, that the vessels which are left in Yahweh’s house, in the house of the king of Judah, and at Jerusalem, don’t go to Babylon.

hausa: Saboda, “ ‘ko sun dinga duba, ba za su taɓa gane ba, kuma ko su dinga ji, ba za su taɓa fahimta ba, in ba haka ba, mai yiwuwa, su tuba, a gafarta musu!’ ”
english: that ‘seeing they may see and not perceive, and hearing they may hear and not understand, lest perhaps they should turn again, and their sins should be forgiven them.’”

hausa: da Hosheya, da Hananiya, da Hasshub,
english: Hoshea, Hananiah, Hasshub,

hausa: Makiyaya da garkunansu za su taso mata; za su kafa tentunansu kewaye da ita, kowanne yana lura da sashensa.”
english: Shepherds with their flocks will come to her. They will pitch their tents against her all around. They will feed everyone in his place.”

hausa: Firist zai umarci a fitar da kome a gidan kafin ya shiga ya bincike cutar fatar jiki da take a rigar, saboda babu abin da yake gidan da za a furta marar tsarki ne. Bayan haka firist zai shiga ya dudduba gidan.
english: The priest shall command that they empty the house, before the priest goes in to examine the plague, that all that is in the house not be made unclean. Afterward the priest shall go in to inspect the house.

hausa: Don wannan ’yar wahalar tamu mai saurin wucewa, ita take tanadar mana madawwamiyar ɗaukaka mai yawa, fiye da kwatanci.
english: For our light affliction, which is for the moment, works for us more and more exceedingly an eternal weight of glory,

hausa: Ka ’yantar da ni daga kurkuku, don in yabi sunanka. Ta haka masu adalci za su taru kewaye da ni saboda alherinka gare ni.
english: Bring my soul out of prison, that I may give thanks to your name. The righteous will surround me, for you will be good to me.

hausa: Bayan kamar kwana takwas da yin wannan magana, sai Yesu ya ɗauki Bitrus, da Yohanna, da kuma Yaƙub, suka hau kan dutse tare don yin addu’a.
english: About eight days after these sayings, he took with him Peter, John, and James, and went up onto the mountain to pray.

hausa: A yanki tsakanin Issakar da Asher, Manasse yana da waɗannan wurare, Bet-Sheyan, Ibileyam da ƙauyukanta, da mazaunan Dor da ƙauyukanta, da mazaunan En Dor da ƙauyukanta, da mazaunan Ta’anak da ƙauyukanta, da mazaunan Megiddo da ƙauyukanta (Na uku cikin jerin shi ne Nafot).
english: Manasseh had three heights in Issachar, in Asher Beth Shean and its towns, and Ibleam and its towns, and the inhabitants of Dor and its towns, and the inhabitants of Endor and its towns, and the inhabitants of Taanach and its towns, and the inhabitants of Megiddo and its towns.

hausa: Ya zaɓi ƙasa mafi kyau wa kansa; aka ajiye masa rabon shugaba. Sa’ad da shugabannin mutane suka taru, ya aikata adalcin Ubangiji da kuma hukuncinsa game da Isra’ila.”
english: He provided the first part for himself, for the lawgiver’s portion was reserved for him. He came with the heads of the people. He executed the righteousness of Yahweh, His ordinances with Israel.”

hausa: waɗanda Ubangiji ya sa wa albarka za su gāji ƙasar, amma waɗanda ya la’anta, za a kore su.
english: For such as are blessed by him shall inherit the land. Those who are cursed by him shall be cut off.

hausa: Ya dalaye kerubobin da zinariya.
english: He overlaid the cherubim with gold.

hausa: Sai ya aike su Betlehem ya ce, “Ku je ku binciko a hankali game da yaron nan. Da kun same shi, sai ku kawo mini labari nan da nan, domin ni ma in je in yi masa sujada.”
english: He sent them to Bethlehem, and said, “Go and search diligently for the young child. When you have found him, bring me word, so that I also may come and worship him.”

hausa: Wannan yana da kyau, yakan kuma gamshi Allah Mai Cetonmu,
english: For this is good and acceptable in the sight of God our Savior,

hausa: In ɗaya daga cikin mazanku ya ƙazantu saboda zubar da maniyyi, sai yă fita daga sansani yă zauna waje da sansani.
english: If there is among you any man who is not clean by reason of that which happens to him by night, then shall he go outside of the camp. He shall not come within the camp;

hausa: Amma ku kam, kuna da shafewa daga wurin Mai Tsarkin nan, kuma dukanku kun san gaskiya.
english: You have an anointing from the Holy One, and you all have knowledge.

hausa: Shawulu ya ce wa bawan, “Idan muka isa can, me za mu ba wa mutumin? Ga shi abinci guzurinmu duk ya ƙare, ba mu da wani abin da za mu kai wa mutumin Allahn nan. Me muke da shi?”
english: Then Saul said to his servant, “But behold, if we go, what should we bring the man? For the bread is spent in our sacks, and there is not a present to bring to the man of God. What do we have?”

hausa: Enok, Metusela, Lamek, Nuhu.
english: Enoch, Methuselah, Lamech,

hausa: Duk wanda kuka gafarta wa zunubansa, an gafarta masa ke nan. Duk wanda ba ku gafarta wa ba kuwa, ba a gafarta masa ba ke nan.”
english: If you forgive anyone’s sins, they have been forgiven them. If you retain anyone’s sins, they have been retained.”

hausa: Matanmu da ’ya’yanmu za su zauna a biranen da suke da katanga, don kāriya daga mazaunan ƙasar, amma mu, za mu ɗauki makamai mu tafi tare da sauran Isra’ilawa, har mu kai su wuraren zamansu.
english: but we ourselves will be ready armed to go before the children of Israel, until we have brought them to their place. Our little ones shall dwell in the fortified cities because of the inhabitants of the land.

hausa: Gama tun halittar duniya halayen Allah marar ganuwa, madawwamin ikonsa da kuma allahntakarsa, ana iya ganinsu sarai, ana fahimtarsu ta wurin abubuwan da Allah ya halitta, domin kada mutane su sami wata hujja.
english: For the invisible things of him since the creation of the world are clearly seen, being perceived through the things that are made, even his everlasting power and divinity, that they may be without excuse.

hausa: Ba shi da kyau ka yi wa mugu alheri ko ka hana wa marar laifi adalci.
english: To be partial to the faces of the wicked is not good, nor to deprive the innocent of justice.

hausa: Ga abin da Ishaya ɗan Amoz ya gani game da Yahuda da Urushalima.
english: This is what Isaiah the son of Amoz saw concerning Judah and Jerusalem.

hausa: Da yamma ta yi, sai Yesu da almajiransa suka bar garin.
english: When evening came, he went out of the city.

hausa: taurari za su fāffāɗo daga sararin sama. Za a kuma girgiza manyan abubuwan da suke a sararin sama.’
english: the stars will be falling from the sky, and the powers that are in the heavens will be shaken.

hausa: “Wannan shi ne alkawarin da zan yi da su bayan wannan lokaci, in ji Ubangiji. Zan sa dokokina a cikin zukatansu, in kuma rubuta su a kan zukatansu.”
english: “This is the covenant that I will make with them after those days,” says the Lord, “I will put my laws on their heart, I will also write them on their mind;” then he says,

hausa: Saboda haka sarki ya ce wa Yowab da komandodin da suke tare da shi, “Tafi cikin dukan kabilan Isra’ila, daga Dan har zuwa Beyersheba, ku ƙidaya mayaƙa don in san yawansu.”
english: The king said to Joab the captain of the army, who was with him, “Now go back and forth through all the tribes of Israel, from Dan even to Beersheba, and count the people, that I may know the sum of the people.”

hausa: Tabbatacce a banza na bar zuciyata da tsabta; a banza na wanke hannuwa don nuna rashin laifi.
english: Surely I have cleansed my heart in vain, and washed my hands in innocence,

hausa: Ubangiji ya ce, “Sa’ad da Masarawa, Amoriyawa, Ammonawa, Filistiyawa,
english: Yahweh said to the children of Israel, “Didn’t I save you from the Egyptians, and from the Amorites, from the children of Ammon, and from the Philistines?
