hausa: Sai dai yadda yake gani yanzu, ko kuma wa ya buɗe idanunsa, ba mu sani ba. Ku tambaye shi. Ai, shi ba yaro ba ne, zai faɗa da bakinsa.”
english: but how he now sees, we don’t know; or who opened his eyes, we don’t know. He is of age. Ask him. He will speak for himself.”

hausa: Ku kuma yi mana addu’a, mu ma, don Allah yă buɗe ƙofa saboda saƙonmu, don mu iya yin shelar asirin Kiristi, wanda saboda shi nake cikin sarƙoƙi.
english: praying together for us also, that God may open to us a door for the word, to speak the mystery of Christ, for which I am also in bonds,

hausa: Sa’ad da ka rushe lamiri mai bi marar ƙarfi, ka yi wa Kiristi zunubi ke nan.
english: Thus, sinning against the brothers, and wounding their conscience when it is weak, you sin against Christ.

hausa: ’Ya’yan Yahallelel su ne, Zif, Zifa, Tiriya da Asarel.
english: The sons of Jehallelel: Ziph, Ziphah, Tiria, and Asarel.

hausa: An yi amfani da azurfa talenti 100 don yin rammuka na wuri mai tsarki, da kuma rammukan labule, rammuka 100 daga talenti 100, talenti ɗaya don rami ɗaya.
english: The one hundred talents of silver were for casting the sockets of the sanctuary and the sockets of the veil: one hundred sockets for the one hundred talents, one talent per socket.

hausa: Abubuwan da za ku yi ke nan. Ku gaya wa juna gaskiya, ku kuma dinga yin shari’ar gaskiya a ɗakunanku na shari’arku;
english: These are the things that you shall do: speak every man the truth with his neighbor. Execute the judgment of truth and peace in your gates,

hausa: Ya ce, “Za mu haura zuwa Urushalima, za a bashe Ɗan Mutum, ga manyan firistoci da malaman dokoki. Za su yi masa hukuncin kisa, a kuma ba da shi ga Al’ummai,
english: “Behold, we are going up to Jerusalem. The Son of Man will be delivered to the chief priests and the scribes. They will condemn him to death, and will deliver him to the Gentiles.

hausa: Ana gādon dawakai da wadata daga iyaye ne, amma mace mai basira daga Ubangiji ne.
english: House and riches are an inheritance from fathers, but a prudent wife is from Yahweh.

hausa: kuɗin fansa domin rai yana da tsada, babu abin da za a biya da ya taɓa isa,
english: For the redemption of their life is costly, no payment is ever enough,

hausa: Za ku yi zama cikin damuwa kullum, cike da tsoro, dare da rana, ba tabbacin abin da zai faru da ranku.
english: Your life will hang in doubt before you. You will be afraid night and day, and will have no assurance of your life.

hausa: Ku yi tsaro kullum, ku yi addu’a don ku iya kuɓuta daga dukan waɗannan abubuwa da suke kusan faruwa, don ku iya tsayawa a gaban Ɗan Mutum.”
english: Therefore be watchful all the time, praying that you may be counted worthy to escape all these things that will happen, and to stand before the Son of Man.”

hausa: Suka raunana ƙafafunsa da sarƙa aka sa wuyansa cikin ƙarafa,
english: They bruised his feet with shackles. His neck was locked in irons,

hausa: Ya aikata mugunta a gaban Ubangiji, amma ba kamar na sarakunan Isra’ilan da suka riga shi ba.
english: He did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight, yet not as the kings of Israel who were before him.

hausa: Bulus da Barnabas kuwa suka daɗe sosai a can, suna magana gabagadi saboda Ubangiji, wanda kuwa ya tabbatar da saƙon alherinsa ta wurinsa su su aikata ayyuka da alamu masu banmamaki.
english: Therefore they stayed there a long time, speaking boldly in the Lord, who testified to the word of his grace, granting signs and wonders to be done by their hands.

hausa: “Dole ne ku kawo mafi kyau daga nunan fari na gonakinku a gidan Ubangiji Allahnku. “Kada ku dafa ɗan akuya a cikin madarar mahaifiyarsa.
english: You shall bring the first of the first fruits of your ground into the house of Yahweh your God. “You shall not boil a young goat in its mother’s milk.

hausa: A lokacin da Dawuda yana zaune a Horesh cikin jejin Zif, ya sami labari cewa Shawulu ya fito don yă kashe shi.
english: David saw that Saul had come out to seek his life. David was in the wilderness of Ziph in the woods.

hausa: Domin tsananin azaba, sai ya ƙara himma cikin addu’a, zuffansa kuma na ɗigowa ƙasa kamar jini.
english: Being in agony, he prayed more earnestly. His sweat became like great drops of blood falling down on the ground.

hausa: Amma ’ya’yansa suka amsa, “To, ya dace ke nan da ya yi da ’yar’uwarmu kamar karuwa?”
english: They said, “Should he deal with our sister as with a prostitute?”

hausa: Mai adalci yakan mutu, ba kuwa wanda yakan yi tunani a zuciyarsa; an kwashe mutanen kirki, ba kuwa wanda ya fahimta cewa an kwashe masu adalci don a tsame su daga mugunta.
english: The righteous perish, and no one lays it to heart. Merciful men are taken away, and no one considers that the righteous is taken away from the evil.

hausa: Bari masu ce mini, “Allah yă ƙara!” Su sha mamaki saboda kunyar da za su sha.
english: Let them be desolate by reason of their shame that tell me, “Aha! Aha!”

hausa: Za su ce, “Wannan ƙasar da take kango a dā ta zama kamar lambu Eden; biranen da dā suke kufai, kango da kuma aka lalata, yanzu suna da katanga ana kuma zama a ciki.”
english: They will say, ‘This land that was desolate has become like the garden of Eden. The waste, desolate, and ruined cities are fortified and inhabited.’

hausa: “Muna gaya muku labari mai daɗi cewa abin da Allah ya yi wa kakanninmu alkawari,
english: We bring you good news of the promise made to the fathers,

hausa: Zai zama kyauta ta musamman a gare su daga tsattsarkan rabon ƙasar, kusa da yankin Lawiyawa.
english: It shall be to them an offering from the offering of the land, a most holy thing, by the border of the Levites.

hausa: Sa’ad da kuma mutanen suka yi tambaya, ‘Me ya sa Ubangiji Allahnmu ya yi dukan wannan gare mu?’ Sai ka amsa musu, ‘Yadda kuka yashe ni kuka kuma bauta wa baƙin alloli a ƙasarku, haka yanzu za ku bauta wa baƙi a ƙasar da ba taku ba.’
english: It will happen when you say, ‘Why has Yahweh our God done all these things to us?’ Then you shall say to them, ‘Just as you have forsaken me and served foreign gods in your land, so you will serve strangers in a land that is not yours.’

hausa: Har yanzu wannan wanda yana kama da mutum ya taɓa ni ya kuma ba ni ƙarfi.
english: Then one like the appearance of a man touched me again, and he strengthened me.

hausa: “Sa’ad da yarinya, wadda har yanzu tana a gidan mahaifinta ta yi wa Ubangiji alkawari, ko ta rantse za tă yi wani abu,
english: “Also, when a woman vows a vow to Yahweh and binds herself by a pledge, being in her father’s house, in her youth,

hausa: Da Yoshuwa ya gama yin wa mutane magana, sai firistoci guda bakwai waɗanda suke riƙe da ƙahoni guda bakwai a gaban Ubangiji suka sha gaba suna busa ƙahoninsu, akwatin alkawari kuwa yana biye da su.
english: It was so, that when Joshua had spoken to the people, the seven priests bearing the seven trumpets of rams’ horns before Yahweh advanced and blew the trumpets, and the ark of Yahweh’s covenant followed them.

hausa: A shekara ta uku ta Sairus sarkin Farisa, sai aka ba wa Daniyel (wanda ake kira Belteshazar) wahayi. Saƙon kuwa gaskiya ce wadda take tattare da babban yaƙi. Fahimtar saƙon ya zo masa a cikin wahayi.
english: In the third year of Cyrus king of Persia a message was revealed to Daniel, whose name was called Belteshazzar; and the message was true, even a great warfare. He understood the message, and had understanding of the vision.

hausa: Haruna shi ne mahaifin Nadab, Abihu, Eleyazar da kuma Itamar.
english: To Aaron were born Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar.

hausa: Amma dai zan kafa alkawarina da Ishaku wanda Saratu za tă haifa maka war haka shekara mai zuwa.”
english: But I will establish my covenant with Isaac, whom Sarah will bear to you at this set time next year.”

hausa: Ta haka Yehoshafat ya yi mulki a bisa Yahuda. Yana da shekara talatin da biyar sa’ad da ya zama sarkin Yahuda, ya kuma yi mulki a Urushalima shekara ashirin da biyar. Sunan mahaifiyarsa Azuba ce, ’yar Shilhi.
english: So Jehoshaphat reigned over Judah. He was thirty-five years old when he began to reign. He reigned twenty-five years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Azubah the daughter of Shilhi.

hausa: Zai hukunta ku da kibiyoyi masu tsini na jarumi, tare da garwashin wuta na itacen tsintsiya.
english: Sharp arrows of the mighty, with coals of juniper.

hausa: Esta ta ce, “In ya gamshi sarki, bari sarki, tare da Haman su zo wurin liyafar da na shirya wa sarki yau.”
english: Esther said, “If it seems good to the king, let the king and Haman come today to the banquet that I have prepared for him.”

hausa: An yi ƙafafun da ƙarfe, tafin ƙafafunta kuma an yi rabi da ƙarfe rabi kuma da yumɓu.
english: its legs of iron, its feet part of iron and part of clay.

hausa: A kuma koya mata yadda za tă tafi wurin sarki. Aka ba ta duk abin da take so ta riƙe daga gidan matan kulle zuwa fadar sarki.
english: The young woman then came to the king like this: whatever she desired was given her to go with her out of the women’s house to the king’s house.

hausa: A wurin mugaye za su daina yin mugunta, gajiyayyu kuma za su huta.
english: There the wicked cease from troubling. There the weary are at rest.

hausa: amma za su ce, ‘Muddin Ubangiji yana raye, wanda ya fito da zuriyar Isra’ila daga ƙasar arewa da kuma daga dukan ƙasashen da ya yashe su.’ Sa’an nan za su zauna a ƙasarsu.”
english: but, ‘As Yahweh lives, who brought up and who led the offspring of the house of Israel out of the north country, and from all the countries where I had driven them.’ Then they will dwell in their own land.”

hausa: “Amma kuka sa keɓaɓɓun suka sha ruwan inabi kuka kuma umarci annabawa kada su yi annabci.
english: “But you gave the Nazirites wine to drink, and commanded the prophets, saying, ‘Don’t prophesy!’

hausa: Ga masu sayar da tattabaru kuwa ya ce, “Ku kwashe waɗannan daga nan! Don me za ku mai da gidan Ubana kasuwa!”
english: To those who sold the doves, he said, “Take these things out of here! Don’t make my Father’s house a marketplace!”

hausa: Alamunsa da girma suke,
english: How great are his signs! How mighty are his wonders! His kingdom is an everlasting kingdom. His dominion is from generation to generation.

hausa: Bayan misalin wata uku sai aka faɗa wa Yahuda cewa, “Tamar, surukarka ta yi laifin karuwanci, a sakamakon haka yanzu ta yi ciki.” Yahuda ya ce, “A fid da ita, a ƙone!”
english: About three months later, Judah was told, “Tamar, your daughter-in-law, has played the prostitute. Moreover, behold, she is with child by prostitution.” Judah said, “Bring her out, and let her be burned.”

hausa: Suka shiga sashe na cikin gida sai ka ce suna so su ɗibo alkama ne, suka soke shi a ciki. Sa’an nan Rekab da Ba’ana ɗan’uwansa suka zame suka ɓace.
english: They came there into the middle of the house as though they would have fetched wheat, and they struck him in the body; and Rechab and Baanah his brother escaped.

hausa: Ku yi shelar ikon Allah, wanda ɗaukakarsa take a bisa Isra’ila, wanda ikonsa yake a cikin sarari.
english: Ascribe strength to God! His excellency is over Israel, his strength is in the skies.

hausa: Sai Yesu ya shiga wani gida, taro kuma ya sāke haɗuwa, har shi da almajiransa ma ba su sami damar cin abinci ba.
english: The multitude came together again, so that they could not so much as eat bread.

hausa: Mutumin da yake cin kowane irin abinci, kada yă rena wanda ba ya cin, wanda kuma ba ya cin kowane irin abinci, kada yă ga laifin mutumin da yake ci, domin Allah ya riga ya karɓe shi.
english: Don’t let him who eats despise him who doesn’t eat. Don’t let him who doesn’t eat judge him who eats, for God has accepted him.

hausa: Na zaɓi hanyar gaskiya; na sa zuciyata a kan dokokinka.
english: I have chosen the way of truth. I have set your ordinances before me.

hausa: Ko da yake bai kawar da masujadan kan tudu daga Isra’ila ba, zuciyar Asa ta cika da bin Ubangiji dukan kwanakinsa.
english: But the high places were not taken away out of Israel; nevertheless the heart of Asa was perfect all his days.

hausa: Marmarin rago zai zama mutuwarsa, domin hannuwansa sun ƙi su yi aiki.
english: The desire of the sluggard kills him, for his hands refuse to labor.

hausa: “Allah ya yi wa mutum duk waɗannan, sau biyu, har ma sau uku.
english: “Behold, God does all these things, twice, yes three times, with a man,

hausa: Ka sha ƙarfinsa gaba ɗaya, sai ya ɓace, ka sauya yanayinsa ka kuma kore shi.
english: You forever prevail against him, and he departs. You change his face, and send him away.

hausa: Ubangijinmu Yesu Kiristi kansa da kuma Allah Ubanmu, wanda ya ƙaunace mu kuma ta wurin alherinsa yă ba mu madawwamiyar ƙarfafawa da kyakkyawar bege,
english: Now our Lord Jesus Christ himself, and God our Father, who loved us and gave us eternal comfort and good hope through grace,

hausa: Aka daɗe ana yaƙi tsakanin gidan Shawulu da gidan Dawuda. Dawuda kuwa ya yi ta ƙara ƙarfi, yayinda gidan Shawulu ya yi ta raguwa a ƙarfi.
english: Now there was a long war between Saul’s house and David’s house. David grew stronger and stronger, but Saul’s house grew weaker and weaker.

hausa: Ya sa su a ƙarƙashin kulawar bayinsa, kowane kashin garke ya kasance a ware. Ya ce wa bayinsa, “Ku sha gabana, ku kuma ba da rata tsakanin garke da garke.”
english: He delivered them into the hands of his servants, every herd by itself, and said to his servants, “Pass over before me, and put a space between herd and herd.”

hausa: waɗanda suke farin ciki sa’ad da suka kai kabari?
english: who rejoice exceedingly, and are glad, when they can find the grave?

hausa: Amma matar ta ce masa, “Tabbatacce ka dai san abin da Shawulu ya yi, ya karkashe masu duba da masu maitanci a ƙasar. Me ya sa kake sa mini tarko, don ka sa a kashe ni?”
english: The woman said to him, “Behold, you know what Saul has done, how he has cut off those who have familiar spirits and the wizards out of the land. Why then do you lay a snare for my life, to cause me to die?”

hausa: “Ko da yake mugunta tana da daɗi a bakinsa kuma yana ɓoye ta a harshensa,
english: “Though wickedness is sweet in his mouth, though he hide it under his tongue,

hausa: Yayinda nake tare da su, na kāre su na kuma kiyaye su ta wurin sunan nan da ka ba ni. Ba ko ɗayan da ya ɓace, sai dai wannan da aka ƙaddara zuwa ga hallaka don Nassi yă cika.
english: While I was with them in the world, I kept them in your name. I have kept those whom you have given me. None of them is lost except the son of destruction, that the Scripture might be fulfilled.

hausa: Sa’ad da mutanen wurin suka tambaye shi game da matarsa, sai ya ce, “’Yar’uwata ce,” gama yana tsoro yă ce, “Ita matata ce.” Ya yi tunani, “Mutane wannan wuri za su kashe ni ta dalili Rebeka, domin kyakkyawa ce.”
english: The men of the place asked him about his wife. He said, “She is my sister,” for he was afraid to say, “My wife”, lest, he thought, “the men of the place might kill me for Rebekah, because she is beautiful to look at.”

hausa: Yanzu sai ku furta zunubanku ga Ubangiji, Allahn kakanninku, ku kuma yi nufinsa. Ku raba kanku da mutanen da suke kewaye da ku, ku kuma rabu da baƙin mata.”
english: Now therefore make confession to Yahweh, the God of your fathers and do his pleasure. Separate yourselves from the peoples of the land and from the foreign women.”

hausa: Gama da nake jin yunwa, ba ku ba ni abinci ba, da nake jin ƙishirwa, ba ku ba ni abin sha ba,
english: for I was hungry, and you didn’t give me food to eat; I was thirsty, and you gave me no drink;

hausa: Ka ɗaura su a zuciyarka har abada; ka ɗaura su kewaye da wuyanka.
english: Bind them continually on your heart. Tie them around your neck.

hausa: “Saboda jinƙanka mai girma, ba ka yashe su a hamada ba. Da rana, ginshiƙin girgije bai daina bishe su a hanyarsu ba, da dare kuma ginshiƙin wuta bai daina haskakawa a hanyar da za su bi ba.
english: yet you in your manifold mercies didn’t forsake them in the wilderness. The pillar of cloud didn’t depart from over them by day, to lead them in the way; neither did the pillar of fire by night, to show them light, and the way in which they should go.

hausa: Za a jawo mai girman kai ƙasa a kuma ƙasƙantar da mai ɗaga kai; Ubangiji kaɗai za a ɗaukaka a wannan rana,
english: The loftiness of man shall be bowed down, and the arrogance of men shall be brought low; and Yahweh alone shall be exalted in that day.

hausa: A rana ta biyu ga wata, shugabannin iyalai, tare da firistoci da Lawiyawa, suka taru kewaye da Ezra malamin Doka don su mai da hankali ga kalmomin Dokar.
english: On the second day, the heads of fathers’ households of all the people, the priests, and the Levites were gathered together to Ezra the scribe, to study the words of the law.

hausa: Sa’ad da Yerobowam ya ji abin da mutumin Allah ya tā da murya ya faɗa game da bagaden Betel, sai ya miƙa hannunsa daga bagaden ya ce, “Ku kama shi!” Amma sai hannun da ya miƙa ya yanƙwane, har bai iya janye shi ba.
english: When the king heard the saying of the man of God, which he cried against the altar in Bethel, Jeroboam put out his hand from the altar, saying, “Seize him!” His hand, which he put out against him, dried up, so that he could not draw it back again to himself.

hausa: rumman ɗari huɗu don jeri biyu na tuƙaƙƙe (layi biyu na rumman don kowane tuƙaƙƙe, mai adon kwano mai siffar kwartaniya a bisan ginshiƙai);
english: and the four hundred pomegranates for the two networks—two rows of pomegranates for each network, to cover the two bowls of the capitals that were on the pillars.

hausa: sai na zo na kuma kwashe ku zuwa ƙasa kamar taku, ƙasar hatsi da kuma sabon ruwan inabi, ƙasar abinci da gonakin inabi.
english: until I come and take you away to a land like your own land, a land of grain and new wine, a land of bread and vineyards.

hausa: ba su suka gani abin da ya yi wa mayaƙan Masar, da dawakansu da keken yaƙinsu, yadda ya sha kansu da ruwan Jan Teku yayinda suke bin ku, da yadda Ubangiji ya hallaka su ƙaƙaf ba.
english: and what he did to the army of Egypt, to their horses, and to their chariots; how he made the water of the Red Sea to overflow them as they pursued you, and how Yahweh has destroyed them to this day;

hausa: Ya buɗe sararin sama, ya sauko ƙasa, girgije mai duhu suna ƙarƙashin ƙafafunsa.
english: He bowed the heavens also, and came down. Thick darkness was under his feet.

hausa: Da gwamna ya yi masa alama yă yi magana, sai Bulus ya amsa ya ce, “Na san cewa ka yi shekaru da yawa kana mulki a wannan ƙasa; saboda haka ina farin ciki in kāre kaina.
english: When the governor had beckoned to him to speak, Paul answered, “Because I know that you have been a judge of this nation for many years, I cheerfully make my defense,

hausa: Yana da girma a kyau, da dogayen rassansa da ya baza, gama saiwoyinsa sun nutse can ƙasa har cikin yalwar ruwaye.
english: Thus it was beautiful in its greatness, in the length of its branches; for its root was by many waters.

hausa: Ɗakunanta na matsara, bangayenta duk suna da girma ɗaya da sauran. Hanyar shiga da shirayinta suna da tagogi duk a kewaye. Tsawonta kamu hamsin ne, fāɗinta kuma kamu ashirin da biyar ne.
english: with its lodges, its posts, and its arches, according to these measurements. There were windows in it and in its arches all around. It was fifty cubits long, and twenty-five cubits wide.

hausa: Ina da iko in cuce ka; amma jiya da dare Allahn mahaifinka ya faɗa mini, ‘Ka yi hankali kada ka faɗa wa Yaƙub wani abu ko mai kyau ko marar kyau.’
english: It is in the power of my hand to hurt you, but the God of your father spoke to me last night, saying, ‘Be careful that you don’t speak to Jacob either good or bad.’

hausa: Da rana sukan yi karo da duhu; da rana ma suna lallube kamar a duhun dare suke.
english: They meet with darkness in the day time, and grope at noonday as in the night.

hausa: Sa’ad da suka zazzage shi, bai rama ba; sa’ad da ya sha wahala, bai yi barazana ba. A maimakon haka, ya miƙa kansa ga wanda yake shari’ar adalci.
english: When he was cursed, he didn’t curse back. When he suffered, he didn’t threaten, but committed himself to him who judges righteously.

hausa: cewa ba za ka cuce mu ba, kamar yadda ba mu fitine ka ba, amma muka yi maka kirki, muka kuma sallame ka cikin salama. Yanzu kuwa kai albarkatacce ne na Ubangiji.”
english: that you will do us no harm, as we have not touched you, and as we have done to you nothing but good, and have sent you away in peace.’ You are now the blessed of Yahweh.”

hausa: Ku dai tabbata, ba wani mai fasikanci, ko mai aikin lalata, ko mai kwaɗayin (wanda shi da mai bautar gumaka ɗaya ne), da yake da gādo a mulkin Kiristi da na Allah.
english: Know this for sure, that no sexually immoral person, nor unclean person, nor covetous man (who is an idolater), has any inheritance in the Kingdom of Christ and God.

hausa: Suka tashi daga Tahat, suka yi sansani a Tera.
english: They traveled from Tahath, and encamped in Terah.

hausa: Kada ka yi garajen ɗibiya hannuwa, kada kuma ka yi tarayya a cikin zunuban waɗansu. Ka kiyaye kanka da tsarki.
english: Lay hands hastily on no one. Don’t be a participant in other people’s sins. Keep yourself pure.

hausa: Zuriyar Yowel su ne, Shemahiya, Gog, Shimeyi,
english: The sons of Joel: Shemaiah his son, Gog his son, Shimei his son,

hausa: tare da Azariya, Ezra, Meshullam,
english: and Azariah, Ezra, and Meshullam,

hausa: Ta gare shi ne kuka gaskata da Allah, wanda ya tā da shi daga matattu, aka kuma ɗaukaka shi, ta haka bari bangaskiyarku da begenku su kasance ga Allah.
english: who through him are believers in God, who raised him from the dead and gave him glory, so that your faith and hope might be in God.

hausa: Kenaniya, shugaban Lawiyawa, shi ne mai bi da waƙoƙi. Wannan hakkinsa ne, gama shi gwani ne a wannan fanni.
english: Chenaniah, chief of the Levites, was over the singing. He taught the singers, because he was skillful.

hausa: Masu albarka ne waɗanda suke masu jinƙai, gama za a nuna musu jinƙai.
english: Blessed are the merciful, for they shall obtain mercy.

hausa: Ya kawo azurfa da zinariya da kayayyakin da shi da mahaifinsa suka keɓe a haikalin Ubangiji.
english: He brought into Yahweh’s house the things that his father had dedicated, and the things that he himself had dedicated: silver, gold, and utensils.

hausa: ’Ya’yan ɗan’uwansa Helem su ne, Zofa, Imna, Shelesh da Amal.
english: The sons of Helem his brother: Zophah, Imna, Shelesh, and Amal.

hausa: Amma in ka sami wani wanda yake da gumakanka, ba zai rayu ba. Kai da kanka ka duba a gaban danginmu, ko akwai wani abin da yake naka a nan tare da ni; in ka gani, ka ɗauka.” Yaƙub dai bai san cewa Rahila ta sace gumakan ba.
english: Anyone you find your gods with shall not live. Before our relatives, discern what is yours with me, and take it.” For Jacob didn’t know that Rachel had stolen them.

hausa: Domin shi Allah wanda ya ce, “Bari haske yă haskaka daga duhu,” ya sa haskensa ya haskaka a cikin zukatanmu, don yă ba mu hasken sanin ɗaukakar Allah a fuskar Kiristi.
english: seeing it is God who said, “Light will shine out of darkness,” who has shone in our hearts to give the light of the knowledge of the glory of God in the face of Jesus Christ.

hausa: Sai Ubangiji ya ce wa Yoshuwa, “Kada ka ji tsoro; kada ka karaya. Ka ɗauki dukan sojojin ku kai wa Ai hari, gama na ba ka nasara a kan sarkin Ai, mutanensa, birninsa da kuma ƙasarsa.
english: Yahweh said to Joshua, “Don’t be afraid, and don’t be dismayed. Take all the warriors with you, and arise, go up to Ai. Behold, I have given into your hand the king of Ai, with his people, his city, and his land.

hausa: wanda ya ja kekunan yaƙi da dawakai, mayaƙa da kuma ƙarin mayaƙa tare ya kwantar da su a can, ba kuwa za su ƙara tashi ba, ya kashe hayaƙi daga lagwani,
english: who brings out the chariot and horse, the army and the mighty man (they lie down together, they shall not rise; they are extinct, they are quenched like a wick) says:

hausa: Dubi ƙasar Babiloniyawa, wannan mutanen da yanzu ba su da wani amfani! Assuriyawa sun mai da ita wurin zaman halittun hamada; sun gina hasumiyoyin kwanto, suka ragargaza kagararta ƙaf suka mai da ita kango.
english: Behold, the land of the Chaldeans. This people didn’t exist. The Assyrians founded it for those who dwell in the wilderness. They set up their towers. They overthrew its palaces. They made it a ruin.

hausa: Naman jikinsa ya lalace ba wani abu mai kyau a ciki kuma ƙasusuwansa da suke a rufe da tsoka yanzu duk sun fito.
english: His flesh is so consumed away that it can’t be seen. His bones that were not seen stick out.

hausa: “Ni ne Ubangiji; sunana ke nan! Ba zan ba da ɗaukakata ga wani ba ko yabona ga gumaka.
english: “I am Yahweh. That is my name. I will not give my glory to another, nor my praise to engraved images.

hausa: “ ‘Sama ne kursiyina, duniya kuma wurin ajiye tafin ƙafata. Wane irin gida za ka gina mini? Ko kuwa ina wurin hutuna zai kasance? In ji Ubangiji.
english: ‘heaven is my throne, and the earth a footstool for my feet. What kind of house will you build me?’ says the Lord. ‘Or what is the place of my rest?

hausa: Takan lura da gona sosai ta kuma saye ta; daga abin da take samu na kuɗin shiga take shuka gonar inabi.
english: She considers a field, and buys it. With the fruit of her hands, she plants a vineyard.

hausa: Sa’ad da Yaƙub ya farka daga barci, sai ya yi tunani ya ce, “Tabbatacce Ubangiji yana a wannan wuri, ban kuwa sani ba.”
english: Jacob awakened out of his sleep, and he said, “Surely Yahweh is in this place, and I didn’t know it.”

hausa: Ubangiji yakan lura da dukan waɗanda suke ƙaunarsa, amma dukan mugaye zai hallaka su.
english: Yahweh preserves all those who love him, but he will destroy all the wicked.

hausa: Amma yakan tsawata musu, kada su shaida ko wane ne shi.
english: He sternly warned them that they should not make him known.

hausa: Ungozoman suka amsa wa Fir’auna suka ce, “Ai, matan Ibraniyawa ba kamar matan Masarawa ba ne, gwarzaye ne, sukan haihu kafin ungozomomin su kai wurinsu.”
english: The midwives said to Pharaoh, “Because the Hebrew women aren’t like the Egyptian women; for they are vigorous and give birth before the midwife comes to them.”

hausa: Ba abin da yake rufe da ba za a fallasa ba, ko kuma abin da yake ɓoye da ba za a bayyana ba.
english: But there is nothing covered up that will not be revealed, nor hidden that will not be known.

hausa: Sa’an nan Yusuf ya shigar da Yaƙub mahaifinsa, ya gabatar da shi a gaban Fir’auna. Bayan Yaƙub ya albarkaci Fir’auna,
english: Joseph brought in Jacob, his father, and set him before Pharaoh; and Jacob blessed Pharaoh.

hausa: Dawuda ya ce wa mutanensa, “Kowa yă rataya takobinsa.” Sai duk suka yi haka. Dawuda kuma ya rataya nasa. Mutum wajen ɗari huɗu suka tafi tare da Dawuda, mutum ɗari biyu kuwa suka zauna suna gadin kayansu.
english: David said to his men, “Every man put on his sword!” Every man put on his sword. David also put on his sword. About four hundred men followed David, and two hundred stayed by the baggage.

hausa: Kuna ci gaba da magana a kan ɗan’uwanku ku kuma yi maganar ƙarya a kan ɗan mahaifinku.
english: You sit and speak against your brother. You slander your own mother’s son.

hausa: “ ‘Duk gadon da mutumin mai ɗigar ya kwanta a kai, zai zama marar tsarki, kuma duk abin da ya zauna a kai, zai zama marar tsarki.
english: “‘Every bed on which he who has the discharge lies shall be unclean; and everything he sits on shall be unclean.

hausa: Ba shakka a lokacin ne za ka lura da matakaina amma ba za ka kula da zunubaina ba.
english: But now you count my steps. Don’t you watch over my sin?

hausa: Dalilin ke nan Manasse ya sami kashi goma ban da ƙasar Gileyad da Bashan a gabashin Urdun,
english: Ten parts fell to Manasseh, in addition to the land of Gilead and Bashan, which is beyond the Jordan;

hausa: Yeshuwa ne mahaifin Yohiyakim, Yohiyakim shi ne mahaifin Eliyashib, Eliyashib shi ne mahaifin Yohiyada,
english: Jeshua became the father of Joiakim, and Joiakim became the father of Eliashib, and Eliashib became the father of Joiada,

hausa: Ba shi da kyau a hukunta marar laifi, ko a bulale shugaba saboda mutuncinsu.
english: Also to punish the righteous is not good, nor to flog officials for their integrity.

hausa: Muryar ta yi magana da shi sau na biyu ta ce, “Kada ka ce da abin da Allah ya tsarkake marar tsarki.”
english: A voice came to him again the second time, “What God has cleansed, you must not call unclean.”

hausa: zan kafa kujerar sarautarka a bisa Isra’ila har abada, kamar yadda na alkawarta wa Dawuda mahaifinka sa’ad da na ce, ‘Ba za ka taɓa rasa wani a kan kujerar sarautar Isra’ila ba.’
english: then I will establish the throne of your kingdom over Israel forever, as I promised to David your father, saying, ‘There shall not fail from you a man on the throne of Israel.’

hausa: Sarkin Ahaz ya umarci Uriya cewa, “A kan babban sabon bagade, ka miƙa hadayar ƙonawa ta safe, da hadayar hatsi ta yamma, da hadayar sarki ta ƙonawa da hadayarsa ta hatsi, da hadaya ta dukan jama’ar ƙasar, tare da hadayan hatsinsu da kuma ta sha. Ka yayyafa jinin hadayun ƙonawa a kan bagade. Amma zan yi amfani da bagaden tagulla don neman bishewa.”
english: King Ahaz commanded Urijah the priest, saying, “On the great altar burn the morning burnt offering, the evening meal offering, the king’s burnt offering and his meal offering, with the burnt offering of all the people of the land, their meal offering, and their drink offerings; and sprinkle on it all the blood of the burnt offering, and all the blood of the sacrifice; but the bronze altar will be for me to inquire by.”

hausa: Daga wannan sabon wata zuwa wancan, kuma daga wannan Asabbaci zuwa wancan, dukan mutane za su zo su rusuna a gabana,” in ji Ubangiji.
english: It shall happen that from one new moon to another, and from one Sabbath to another, all flesh will come to worship before me,” says Yahweh.

hausa: ka kuma sa wuƙa a maƙogwaronka in kai mai ci da yawa ne.
english: put a knife to your throat if you are a man given to appetite.

hausa: Amma Allah ya tashe shi daga matattu,
english: But God raised him from the dead,

hausa: Waɗanda suke ƙirƙiro mugayen dabaru suna nan kusa, amma suna nesa da dokarka.
english: They draw near who follow after wickedness. They are far from your law.

hausa: Ya sa 70,000 a cikinsu su zama ’yan ɗauko, 80,000 kuma su zama masu fasan dutse a tuddai, sa’an nan 3,600 su zama shugabanni masu lura da aiki.
english: He set seventy thousand of them to bear burdens, eighty thousand who were stone cutters in the mountains, and three thousand six hundred overseers to assign the people their work.

hausa: A wannan rana Fir’auna ya ba da wannan umarni wa shugabannin masu gandu,
english: The same day Pharaoh commanded the taskmasters of the people and their officers, saying,

hausa: Gama ya ce, ‘Ba ribar da mutum zai samu lokacin da yake ƙoƙari yă faranta wa Allah zuciya.’
english: For he has said, ‘It profits a man nothing that he should delight himself with God.’

hausa: Daga nan kuma suka ci gaba, suka yi sansani a Kwarin Zered.
english: From there they traveled, and encamped in the valley of Zered.

hausa: Sai suka kawo shi. Da ruhun ya ga Yesu, nan da nan sai ya buge yaron da farfaɗiya. Ya fāɗi a ƙasa, yana birgima, bakinsa yana kumfa.
english: They brought him to him, and when he saw him, immediately the spirit convulsed him and he fell on the ground, wallowing and foaming at the mouth.

hausa: Don mai bi da kaɗe-kaɗe. Na ’ya’yan Kora maza. Zabura ce. Ka nuna wa ƙasarka alheri, ya Ubangiji; ka mai da nasarorin Yaƙub.
english: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by the sons of Korah. Yahweh, you have been favorable to your land. You have restored the fortunes of Jacob.

hausa: yă yi kafara domin Wuri Mafi Tsarki, Tentin Sujada da bagade, da kuma saboda firistoci da kuma dukan jama’ar Isra’ila.
english: Then he shall make atonement for the Holy Sanctuary; and he shall make atonement for the Tent of Meeting and for the altar; and he shall make atonement for the priests and for all the people of the assembly.

hausa: Nakan sanar da ƙarshe tun daga farko, daga fil azal, abin da yake zuwa nan gaba. Na ce nufina zai tabbata, kuma zan aikata dukan abin da na gan dama.
english: I declare the end from the beginning, and from ancient times things that are not yet done. I say: My counsel will stand, and I will do all that I please.

hausa: Gama a lokacin za a yi wata matsananciyar wahala, wadda ba a taɓa yi ba tun farkon duniya har ya zuwa yanzu ba kuwa za a ƙara yi ba.
english: for then there will be great suffering, such as has not been from the beginning of the world until now, no, nor ever will be.

hausa: Wane ne zai iya gane yadda ya shimfiɗa gizagizai yadda yake tsawa daga wurin zamansa?
english: Indeed, can anyone understand the spreading of the clouds and the thunderings of his pavilion?

hausa: Daga wannan rana zuwa gaba, rabin mutane suka yi aiki, yayinda sauran rabin suka kintsa da māsu, da garkuwa, da bakkuna da makamai. Shugabanni suka goyi bayan dukan mutanen Yahuda
english: From that time forth, half of my servants did the work, and half of them held the spears, the shields, the bows, and the coats of mail; and the rulers were behind all the house of Judah.

hausa: Sai ga wani mutum daga Sairin da ake kira Siman, mahaifin Alekzanda da Rufus, yana wucewa kan hanyarsa daga ƙauye. Sai suka tilasta shi yă ɗauki gicciyen.
english: They compelled one passing by, coming from the country, Simon of Cyrene, the father of Alexander and Rufus, to go with them that he might bear his cross.

hausa: Saboda haka Fir’auna ya kira Abram ya ce, “Me ke nan ka yi mini? Me ya sa ba ka faɗa mini cewa ita matarka ce ba?
english: Pharaoh called Abram and said, “What is this that you have done to me? Why didn’t you tell me that she was your wife?

hausa: “Yanzu, sai ku ji tsoron Ubangiji, ku bauta masa da dukan aminci. Ku zubar da allolin da kakanninku suka yi musu sujada a hayin Kogin Yuferites da kuma a Masar, ku bauta wa Ubangiji.
english: “Now therefore fear Yahweh, and serve him in sincerity and in truth. Put away the gods which your fathers served beyond the River, in Egypt; and serve Yahweh.

hausa: Ubangiji ya kira ki itacen zaitun mai inuwa kyakkyawa mai ’ya’ya masu kyau. Amma da ƙugin babbar hadari zai cinna masa wuta, rassansa za su kakkarye.
english: Yahweh called your name, “A green olive tree, beautiful with goodly fruit.” With the noise of a great roar he has kindled fire on it, and its branches are broken.

hausa: Saboda haka Allah ya yi sarari ya raba ruwan da yake ƙarƙashin sararin da ruwan da yake bisansa. Haka kuwa ya kasance.
english: God made the expanse, and divided the waters which were under the expanse from the waters which were above the expanse; and it was so.

hausa: Saboda haka Ubangiji ya yi fushi ƙwarai da Isra’ila, ya kuma kawar da su daga gabansa. Kabilar Yahuda kaɗai aka bari,
english: Therefore Yahweh was very angry with Israel, and removed them out of his sight. There was none left but the tribe of Judah only.

hausa: Almajiran suka zo wurinsa suka tambaye shi, “Me ya sa kake wa mutane magana da misalai?”
english: The disciples came, and said to him, “Why do you speak to them in parables?”

hausa: Shi da ya ƙyifta ido da mugunta kan jawo baƙin ciki surutun wawa kuma kan zo da lalaci.
english: One who winks with the eye causes sorrow, but a chattering fool will fall.

hausa: Mai shaidar da yake malalaci yana wa shari’a ba’a ne, bakin mugaye kuma na haɗiye mugunta.
english: A corrupt witness mocks justice, and the mouth of the wicked gulps down iniquity.

hausa: “In kuwa mutumin matalauci ne ba zai iya samu waɗannan ba, to, dole yă ɗauki ɗan rago guda kamar hadaya don laifi a kaɗa don a yi kafara dominsa, tare da humushin garwa gari mai laushi haɗe da mai don hadaya ta gari, da moɗa na mai,
english: “If he is poor, and can’t afford so much, then he shall take one male lamb for a trespass offering to be waved, to make atonement for him, and one tenth of an ephah of fine flour mixed with oil for a meal offering, and a log of oil;

hausa: “Suna faranta wa sarki zuciya da muguntarsu, shugabanni kuma da ƙarairayinsu.
english: They make the king glad with their wickedness, and the princes with their lies.

hausa: “Ɗan mutum, yi magana da mutanen ƙasarka ka faɗa musu cewa, ‘Sa’ad da na kawo takobi a kan ƙasar, mutanen ƙasar kuwa suka zaɓi ɗaya daga cikin mutanensu suka mai da shi mai tsaro,
english: “Son of man, speak to the children of your people, and tell them, ‘When I bring the sword on a land, and the people of the land take a man from among them, and set him for their watchman,

hausa: Ya kuma ’yantar da mu daga abokan gābanmu, Ƙaunarsa madawwamiya ce.
english: and has delivered us from our adversaries, for his loving kindness endures forever;

hausa: A cikinki akwai waɗanda suke kwana da matan mahaifansu; a cikinki akwai waɗanda suke kwana da mata a lokacin da suke al’adarsu, sa’ad da suke da rashin tsarki.
english: In you have they uncovered their fathers’ nakedness. In you have they humbled her who was unclean in her impurity.

hausa: Sa’an nan ya furta saƙonsa. “Maganar Bala’am ɗan Beyor, saƙon mutumin da idanunsa ke gani sarai,
english: He took up his parable, and said, “Balaam the son of Beor says, the man whose eyes are open says;

hausa: Amma bayan na tashi, zan sha gabanku zuwa Galili.”
english: But after I am raised up, I will go before you into Galilee.”

hausa: Kashegari taron da suka tsaya a wancan ƙetaren tafkin suka lura cewa jirgin ruwa ɗaya ne yake a can dā ma, kuma sun lura cewa Yesu bai shiga ciki tare da almajiransa ba, gama sun tashi su kaɗai.
english: On the next day, the multitude that stood on the other side of the sea saw that there was no other boat there, except the one in which his disciples had embarked, and that Jesus hadn’t entered with his disciples into the boat, but his disciples had gone away alone.

hausa: Za aka hallaka gidan Ahab maigidanka, zan kuma ɗauki fansar jinin bayina annabawa da kuma jinin dukan bayin Ubangiji da Yezebel ta zub da.
english: You must strike your master Ahab’s house, that I may avenge the blood of my servants the prophets, and the blood of all the servants of Yahweh, at the hand of Jezebel.

hausa: Domin ƙaunarka ta fi rai kyau, leɓunana za su ɗaukaka ka.
english: Because your loving kindness is better than life, my lips shall praise you.

hausa: Kowace karuwa kan karɓi kuɗi, amma kina ba da kyautai ga dukan kwartayenki, kina ba su cin hanci don su zo wurinki daga ko’ina don alherai marasa ƙa’ida.
english: People give gifts to all prostitutes; but you give your gifts to all your lovers, and bribe them, that they may come to you on every side for your prostitution.

hausa: Daga cikin man da yake a tafinsa zai zuba a wuri da ya zuba jinin hadaya don laifi, a leɓatun kunnen dama na wanda za a tsabtaccen, a babban yatsar hannun damansa da kuma a babban yatsar ƙafa damansa.
english: Then the priest shall put some of the oil that is in his hand on the tip of the right ear of him who is to be cleansed, and on the thumb of his right hand, and on the big toe of his right foot, on the place of the blood of the trespass offering.

hausa: “Ina aikan ku kamar tumaki a cikin kyarketai. Saboda haka ku zama masu wayo kamar macizai, kuma marasa ɓarna kamar kurciyoyi.
english: “Behold, I send you out as sheep among wolves. Therefore be wise as serpents and harmless as doves.

hausa: Ubangiji yana fushi da dukan al’ummai; hasalarsa tana a kan mayaƙansu. Zai hallaka su tas, zai ba da su a karkashe.
english: For Yahweh is enraged against all the nations, and angry with all their armies. He has utterly destroyed them. He has given them over for slaughter.

hausa: “ ‘Kada ka yi jima’i da ’yar’uwar mahaifiyarka, ko ta mahaifinka, gama wannan zai ƙasƙantar da dangi na kurkusa, dukanku za ku ɗauki laifin.
english: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your mother’s sister, nor of your father’s sister, for he has made his close relative naked. They shall bear their iniquity.

hausa: Tsara guda za tă yi maganar ayyukanka ga wata tsara; za su yi magana game da manyan ayyukanka.
english: One generation will commend your works to another, and will declare your mighty acts.

hausa: Da ƙyiftawar ido a kan wadata ta ɓace, gama tabbatacce sukan yi fikafikai sukan tashi sama kamar gaggafa.
english: Why do you set your eyes on that which is not? For it certainly sprouts wings like an eagle and flies in the sky.

hausa: Bari waɗannan mutane su sassanta mutane a kan ƙananan matsaloli, amma kowace babban matsala, ko bukata ta musamman, sai su kawo wurinka, ƙananan matsaloli kuma sai su yanke hukuncin da kansu. Ta haka ne za su taimaka wajen ɗaukan nauyin jama’a, don su sa aikin yă zama maka da sauƙi.
english: Let them judge the people at all times. It shall be that every great matter they shall bring to you, but every small matter they shall judge themselves. So shall it be easier for you, and they shall share the load with you.

hausa: Sa’ad da Amaziya ya bar bin Ubangiji, aka shirya masa maƙarƙashiya a Urushalima, sai ya gudu zuwa Lakish, amma suka aiki mutane suka bi shi zuwa Lakish, a can suka kashe shi.
english: Now from the time that Amaziah turned away from following Yahweh, they made a conspiracy against him in Jerusalem. He fled to Lachish, but they sent after him to Lachish and killed him there.

hausa: Da suna cikin tafiya, sai barci ya kwashe shi. Sai wata babban iska ta taso kan tafkin, har ruwa ya fara shiga cikin jirgin. Suka shiga babban hatsari.
english: But as they sailed, he fell asleep. A wind storm came down on the lake, and they were taking on dangerous amounts of water.

hausa: Zai zama abin kaito ga mata masu ciki, da mata masu renon ’ya’ya, a waɗancan kwanakin! Za a yi baƙin ciki mai tsanani a ƙasar, da kuma fushi mai tsanani a kan mutanen nan.
english: Woe to those who are pregnant and to those who nurse infants in those days! For there will be great distress in the land and wrath to this people.

hausa: Za a ci Keriyot a kuma kame kagarai. A wannan rana zukatan jarumawan Mowab za su zama kamar zuciyar macen da take naƙuda.
english: Kerioth is taken, and the strongholds are seized. The heart of the mighty men of Moab at that day will be as the heart of a woman in her pangs.

hausa: Ba mu kuwa ba su zarafi ba ko kaɗan, don gaskiyar bishara ta ci gaba da kasance tare da ku.
english: to whom we gave no place in the way of subjection, not for an hour, that the truth of the Good News might continue with you.

hausa: Kada kuma ku ɓata wa Ruhu Mai Tsarki na Allah rai, wanda da shi aka hatimce ku da shi don ranar fansa.
english: Don’t grieve the Holy Spirit of God, in whom you were sealed for the day of redemption.

hausa: Daga baya, Dawuda ya ji labarin sai ya ce, “Ni da masarautata har abada ba mu da laifi a gaban Ubangiji game da jinin Abner ɗan Ner.
english: Afterward, when David heard it, he said, “I and my kingdom are guiltless before Yahweh forever of the blood of Abner the son of Ner.

hausa: Sarkin Aram ya ce, “Ko ta ƙaƙa, ka tafi, zan aika da wasiƙa ga sarkin Isra’ila.” Sai Na’aman ya tashi, ɗauke da talenti goma na azurfa, shekel dubu shida na zinariya, da tufafi kashi goma.
english: The king of Syria said, “Go now, and I will send a letter to the king of Israel.” He departed, and took with him ten talents of silver, six thousand pieces of gold, and ten changes of clothing.

hausa: Shugaban matsara kuma ya ɗauki Serahiya babban firist, da Zefaniya wanda yake biye da babban firist, da mutum uku masu tsaron ƙofar, ya tafi da su.
english: The captain of the guard took Seraiah the chief priest, and Zephaniah the second priest, and the three keepers of the threshold,

hausa: mutane da yawa suka zo wurinsa. Suka ce, “Ko da yake Yohanna bai yi wani abin banmamaki ba, duk abubuwan da Yohanna ya faɗa game da mutumin nan gaskiya ne.”
english: Many came to him. They said, “John indeed did no sign, but everything that John said about this man is true.”

hausa: zai kuma yayyafa jinin hadaya don zunubin a gefen bagade; a tsiyaye sauran jinin kuma a gindin bagade. Hadaya ce ta zunubi.
english: He shall sprinkle some of the blood of the sin offering on the side of the altar; and the rest of the blood shall be drained out at the base of the altar. It is a sin offering.

hausa: Bari kowane mutum da dabba yă yafa rigunan makoki. Kowa yă roƙi Allah da gaske, kowa kuma yă bar mugayen ayyukan da yake yi.
english: but let them be covered with sackcloth, both man and animal, and let them cry mightily to God. Yes, let them turn everyone from his evil way and from the violence that is in his hands.

hausa: “ ‘Amma na san wurin zamanka da fitarka da shigarka da yadda kake fushi da ni.
english: But I know your sitting down, your going out, your coming in, and your raging against me.

hausa: Ta haka ƙarfina ya ƙare a cikina zuciyata ta damu ƙwarai.
english: Therefore my spirit is overwhelmed within me. My heart within me is desolate.

hausa: Sai Iliya ya ce wa Elisha, “Ka dakata a nan; Ubangiji ya aike ni Betel.” Amma Elisha ya amsa ya ce, “Muddin Ubangiji yana a raye, kai kuma kana a raye, ba zan rabu da kai ba.” Saboda haka suka gangara zuwa Betel.
english: Elijah said to Elisha, “Please wait here, for Yahweh has sent me as far as Bethel.” Elisha said, “As Yahweh lives, and as your soul lives, I will not leave you.” So they went down to Bethel.

hausa: Da suka iso Gibeya, jerin gwanon annabawa suka sadu da shi Ruhun Allah kuma ya sauko a kansa da iko, sai ya shiga yin annabci tare da su.
english: When they came there to the hill, behold, a band of prophets met him; and the Spirit of God came mightily on him, and he prophesied among them.

hausa: Saƙon da annabi Habakkuk ya karɓa.
english: The revelation which Habakkuk the prophet saw.

hausa: Sai mutumin ya komo da ni zuwa ƙofar waje na wuri mai tsarki, wadda take fuskantar gabas, tana kuwa a rufe.
english: Then he brought me back by the way of the outer gate of the sanctuary, which looks toward the east; and it was shut.

hausa: Ubangiji zai bugi Masar da annoba; zai buge su ya kuma warkar da su. Za su juyo wurin Ubangiji, zai amsa roƙonsu ya kuma warkar da su.
english: Yahweh will strike Egypt, striking and healing. They will return to Yahweh, and he will be entreated by them, and will heal them.

hausa: Aka haifa wa Enok Irad, Irad kuma ya haifi Mehujayel, Mehujayel kuma ya haifi Metushayel, Metushayel kuma ya haifin Lamek.
english: Irad was born to Enoch. Irad became the father of Mehujael. Mehujael became the father of Methushael. Methushael became the father of Lamech.

hausa: Amma fa, bayan ’yan’uwansa suka tafi Bikin, shi ma ya tafi, ba a fili ba, amma a ɓoye.
english: But when his brothers had gone up to the feast, then he also went up, not publicly, but as it were in secret.

hausa: A cikin taron kuwa aka yi ta raɗe-raɗe game da shi. Waɗansu suka ce, “Shi mutumin kirki ne.” Waɗansu kuwa suka ce, “A’a, ai, ruɗin mutane yake.”
english: There was much murmuring among the multitudes concerning him. Some said, “He is a good man.” Others said, “Not so, but he leads the multitude astray.”

hausa: Saboda haka sarkin Isra’ila ya kira ɗaya daga cikin ma’aikatansa ya ce, “A kawo Mikahiya ɗan Imla nan da nan.”
english: Then the king of Israel called an officer, and said, “Get Micaiah the son of Imla quickly.”

hausa: Sa’an nan za ku furta a gaban Ubangiji Allahnku cewa, “Mahaifina mutumin Aram ne mai yawo, ya gangara zuwa Masar da mutane kaɗan, ya zauna a can, ya kuma zama babban al’umma, mai iko da kuma mai yawa.
english: You shall answer and say before Yahweh your God, “My father was a Syrian ready to perish. He went down into Egypt, and lived there, few in number. There he became a great, mighty, and populous nation.

hausa: “Ka duba, ka gani ya Ubangiji. Wane ne ka taɓa yi wa haka? Ko ya kamata uwaye su ci ’ya’yansu, ’ya’yan da suka yi reno? Ko ya kamata a kashe firistoci da annabawa a cikin haikalin Ubangiji?
english: “Look, Yahweh, and see to whom you have done thus! Should the women eat their offspring, the children that they held and bounced on their knees? Should the priest and the prophet be killed in the sanctuary of the Lord?

hausa: Amma saboda yawan ƙaunar da yake mana, Allah, wanda yake mai yawan jinƙai,
english: But God, being rich in mercy, for his great love with which he loved us,

hausa: Na faɗi haka ne don ku ji kunya. Ashe, ba za a iya samun wani a cikinku mai hikima wanda zai iya sasanta tsakanin masu bi ba?
english: I say this to move you to shame. Isn’t there even one wise man among you who would be able to decide between his brothers?

hausa: Sa’ad da Abner wanda yake tare da mutane ashirin suka zo wurin Dawuda a Hebron, Dawuda ya shirya masa liyafa tare da mutanensa.
english: So Abner came to David to Hebron, and twenty men with him. David made Abner and the men who were with him a feast.

hausa: Dukan garkunan Kedar za su taru a wurinki ragunan Nebayiwot za su yi miki hidima; za a karɓe su kamar hadayu a kan bagadenki, zan kuma darjanta haikalina mai ɗaukaka.
english: All the flocks of Kedar will be gathered together to you. The rams of Nebaioth will serve you. They will be accepted as offerings on my altar; and I will beautify my glorious house.

hausa: Sa’ad da dukan sarakuna waɗanda suke abokan tarayya na Hadadezer suka ga Isra’ila sun ci su da yaƙi, sai suka yi sulhu da Isra’ilawa, suka kuma zama bayinsu. Wannan ya sa Arameyawa suka ji tsoron ƙara kai wa Ammonawa gudummawa.
english: When all the kings who were servants to Hadadezer saw that they were defeated before Israel, they made peace with Israel and served them. So the Syrians were afraid to help the children of Ammon any more.

hausa: Dukanku za ku wuce ta kai tsaye ta inda katangar ta tsage, za a jefar da ku a Harmon,” in ji Ubangiji.
english: You will go out at the breaks in the wall, everyone straight before her; and you will cast yourselves into Harmon,” says Yahweh.

hausa: tare da ’yan’uwansu waɗanda suke aiki domin haikali, su 822 ne. Akwai kuma Adahiya ɗan Yeroham, ɗan Felaliya, ɗan Amzi, ɗan Zakariya, ɗan Fashhur, ɗan Malkiya,
english: and their brothers who did the work of the house, eight hundred twenty-two; and Adaiah the son of Jeroham, the son of Pelaliah, the son of Amzi, the son of Zechariah, the son of Pashhur, the son of Malchijah,

hausa: A wannan rana aka mai da Mowab bayin Isra’ila, ƙasar kuwa ta sami zaman lafiya shekara takwas.
english: So Moab was subdued that day under the hand of Israel. Then the land had rest eighty years.

hausa: Ka kawo ’yan’uwanka Lawiyawa daga kabilar kakanka tare da kai, don su taimake ka sa’ad da kai da ’ya’yanka kuke hidima a gaban Tentin Sujada.
english: Bring your brothers also, the tribe of Levi, the tribe of your father, near with you, that they may be joined to you, and minister to you; but you and your sons with you shall be before the Tent of the Testimony.

hausa: Sai firistoci da shugaban masu gadin haikalin da kuma Sadukiyawa suka hauro wurin Bitrus da Yohanna yayinda suke cikin magana da mutane.
english: As they spoke to the people, the priests and the captain of the temple and the Sadducees came to them,

hausa: Sa’ad da Ataliya mahaifiyar Ahaziya ta ga cewa ɗanta ya mutu, sai ta tashi ta hallaka dukan ’yan gidan sarautar Yahuda.
english: Now when Athaliah the mother of Ahaziah saw that her son was dead, she arose and destroyed all the royal offspring of the house of Judah.

hausa: Kamar yadda ba ka san hanyar iska ba, ko yadda aka siffanta jiki a cikin mahaifiya, haka ba za ka fahimci aikin Allah Mahaliccin dukan abubuwa ba.
english: As you don’t know what is the way of the wind, nor how the bones grow in the womb of her who is with child; even so you don’t know the work of God who does all.

hausa: “Ga abin da Ubangiji yana cewa, ‘Duk wanda ya zauna a wannan birni zai mutu ta takobi, yunwa ko annoba, amma duk wanda ya je wurin Babiloniyawa zai rayu. Zai tsira da ransa, ya rayu.’
english: “Yahweh says, ‘He who remains in this city will die by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence, but he who goes out to the Chaldeans will live. He will escape with his life and he will live.’

hausa: Saboda haka fa, kada mu zama kamar saura, waɗanda suke barci, sai dai mu zama masu tsaro da masu kamunkai.
english: so then let’s not sleep, as the rest do, but let’s watch and be sober.

hausa: Tun kalmomin suna cikin bakinsa sai ya ji murya daga sama tana cewa, “Wannan shi ne abin da aka zartar a kanka, Sarki Nebukadnezzar. An karɓe ikon mulkinka.
english: While the word was in the king’s mouth, a voice came from the sky, saying, “O King Nebuchadnezzar, to you it is spoken: ‘The kingdom has departed from you.

hausa: Zai zama kamar sa’ad da mai girbi ya tara hatsin da yake tsaye ya kuma girbe hatsin da hannunsa kamar sa’ad da mutum ya yi kala kawunan hatsi a Kwarin Refayim.
english: It will be like when the harvester gathers the wheat, and his arm reaps the grain. Yes, it will be like when one gleans grain in the valley of Rephaim.

hausa: Zan rushe gidan rani da na damina; gidajen da aka yi musu ado da hauren giwa za a rushe su haka ma duk za a rurrushe manyan gidaje,” in ji Ubangiji.
english: I will strike the winter house with the summer house; and the houses of ivory will perish, and the great houses will have an end,” says Yahweh.

hausa: Ya yi wa’azin mulkin Allah yana kuma koyarwa game da Ubangiji Yesu Kiristi, gabagadi ba tare da wani abu ya hana shi ba.
english: preaching God’s Kingdom and teaching the things concerning the Lord Jesus Christ with all boldness, without hindrance.

hausa: Na ba ku madara ba abinci mai tauri ba, domin ba ku balaga ba a lokacin. Kai, har yanzu ma, ba ku balaga ba.
english: I fed you with milk, not with solid food, for you weren’t yet ready. Indeed, you aren’t ready even now,

hausa: Har yă zuwa yau, sun nace da ayyukansu na dā. Ba sa yin wa Ubangiji sujada, ba sa kuma bin dokoki da farillansa, dokoki da umarnan da Ubangiji ya ba wa zuriyar Yaƙub, wadda ya ba wa suna Isra’ila.
english: To this day they do what they did before. They don’t fear Yahweh, and they do not follow the statutes, or the ordinances, or the law, or the commandment which Yahweh commanded the children of Jacob, whom he named Israel;

hausa: Ubangiji ya kuma yi magana wa Ahaz ya ce,
english: Yahweh spoke again to Ahaz, saying,

hausa: Yoshuwa kuwa da dukan Isra’ilawa suka tashi daga Lakish zuwa Eglon; suka yi shiri suka kai mata hari.
english: Joshua passed from Lachish, and all Israel with him, to Eglon; and they encamped against it and fought against it.

hausa: Zabura ta Dawuda. Ya Ubangiji, ka ji addu’ata, ka saurari kukata don neman jinƙai; cikin amincinka da adalcinka ka amsa mini.
english: A Psalm by David. Hear my prayer, Yahweh. Listen to my petitions. In your faithfulness and righteousness, relieve me.

hausa: Kai kuwa ka tsaya a nan tare da ni saboda in ba ka umarnai, ƙa’idodi da kuma dokoki duka, da za ka koya musu don su bi a ƙasar da nake ba su, su mallaka.”
english: But as for you, stand here by me, and I will tell you all the commandments, and the statutes, and the ordinances, which you shall teach them, that they may do them in the land which I give them to possess.”

hausa: Saboda haka rabona shi ne watanni na zama banza, kowane dare kuwa sai ɓacin rai nake samu.
english: so I am made to possess months of misery, wearisome nights are appointed to me.

hausa: Ga abin da Ubangiji yana cewa, “Wane laifi ne kakanninku sun same ni da shi, da suka tsaya nesa da ni? Sun bi gumakan banza su kansu suka kuma zama banza da kansu.
english: Yahweh says, “What unrighteousness have your fathers found in me, that they have gone far from me, and have walked after worthless vanity, and have become worthless?

hausa: Suka sāke yi wa Dawuda wannan magana amma Dawuda ya ce, “Kuna tsammani abu mai sauƙi ne mutum yă zama surukin sarki? Ni talaka ne, kuma ba sananne ba.”
english: Saul’s servants spoke those words in the ears of David. David said, “Does it seem to you a light thing to be the king’s son-in-law, since I am a poor man and little known?”

hausa: Sa’an nan mu mutanenka, tumakin makiyayarka, za mu yabe ka har abada; daga tsara zuwa tsara za mu yi ta ba da labarin yabonka.
english: So we, your people and sheep of your pasture, will give you thanks forever. We will praise you forever, to all generations.

hausa: Bisa ga umarnin sarki sai suka cire manyan duwatsu masu kyau don a tanada tushen duwatsun da aka gyara domin haikalin daga wurin haƙar duwatsun.
english: The king commanded, and they cut out large stones, costly stones, to lay the foundation of the house with worked stone.

hausa: Ubangiji zai gāji Yahuda a matsayin rabonsa a cikin ƙasa mai tsarki zai kuma sāke zaɓi Urushalima.
english: Yahweh will inherit Judah as his portion in the holy land, and will again choose Jerusalem.

hausa: Mahaifinsa Zakariya ya cika da Ruhu Mai Tsarki sai ya yi annabci ya ce,
english: His father Zacharias was filled with the Holy Spirit, and prophesied, saying,

hausa: kusa da ƙofofin shiga cikin birni, a mashigai, ta tā da murya,
english: Beside the gates, at the entry of the city, at the entry doors, she cries aloud:

hausa: Dawuda ya kame keken yaƙinsa dubu ɗaya, da mahayan kekunan yaƙi dubu bakwai da sojojin kafa guda dubu ashirin. Ya yayyanke dukan agaran dawakansa, amma ya bar dawakai da suka isa jan kekunan yaƙi ɗari.
english: David took from him one thousand chariots, seven thousand horsemen, and twenty thousand footmen; and David hamstrung all the chariot horses, but reserved of them enough for one hundred chariots.

hausa: Yabo ga Ubangiji, Allah na Isra’ila, daga madawwami zuwa madawwami. Bari dukan mutane su ce, “Amin!” Yabo ga Ubangiji.
english: Blessed be Yahweh, the God of Israel, from everlasting even to everlasting! Let all the people say, “Amen.” Praise Yah!

hausa: Wannan rarrashin da ake muku ba daga wanda ya kira ku ba ne.
english: This persuasion is not from him who calls you.

hausa: Zakariya, Aziyel, Shemiramot, Yehiyel, Unni, Eliyab, Ma’asehiya da Benahiya, ne za su kaɗa molaye masu murya sama-sama, bisa ga alamot.
english: and Zechariah, Aziel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Unni, Eliab, Maaseiah, and Benaiah, with stringed instruments set to Alamoth;

hausa: “Wane ne bawan nan mai aminci da kuma mai hikima, wanda maigida ya sa yă lura da bayi a cikin gidansa, yă riƙa ba su abinci a daidai lokaci?
english: “Who then is the faithful and wise servant, whom his lord has set over his household, to give them their food in due season?

hausa: waɗanda nake ajiya domin lokacin wahala, domin kwanakin yaƙi da faɗa?
english: which I have reserved against the time of trouble, against the day of battle and war?

hausa: Na ji kuka kamar na mace mai naƙuda, nishi kamar na wadda take haihuwa ɗanta na fari, kukan Diyar Sihiyona tana haki, da ƙyar take numfashi, tana miƙa hannuwanta tana cewa, “Wayyo ni kaina! Na suma; an ba da raina ga masu kisana.”
english: For I have heard a voice as of a woman in travail, the anguish as of her who gives birth to her first child, the voice of the daughter of Zion, who gasps for breath, who spreads her hands, saying, “Woe is me now! For my soul faints before the murderers.”

hausa: a ranan nan wanda ya tsere zai zo don yă ba ka labari.
english: that in that day he who escapes will come to you, to cause you to hear it with your ears?

hausa: sai Sarki Solomon da dukan taron Isra’ila da suka tattaru kewaye da shi a gaban akwatin alkawari, suka yi ta miƙa hadayar tumaki da bijimai masu yawa da ba a iya lissaftawa, ko ƙirgawa.
english: King Solomon and all the congregation of Israel, who were assembled to him, were with him before the ark, sacrificing sheep and cattle that could not be counted or numbered for multitude.

hausa: Duk da haka, maza da matan da suke gaskata ga Ubangiji sai ƙaruwa suke, suka kuma ƙaru a yawa.
english: More believers were added to the Lord, multitudes of both men and women.

hausa: Saurari kuka daga Horonayim, kukan risɓewa mai girma da hallaka.
english: The sound of a cry from Horonaim, desolation and great destruction!

hausa: Suka yi hidimar alƙalanci na mutane a dukan lokaci. Gardandamin da suke da wuya, suka kawo wurin Musa, amma ƙananan batuttuwa, suka shari’anta a tsakaninsu.
english: They judged the people at all times. They brought the hard cases to Moses, but every small matter they judged themselves.

hausa: don in iya tafiya a gaban Ubangiji a ƙasar masu rai.
english: I will walk before Yahweh in the land of the living.

hausa: Amma ina faɗa muku, Iliya ya riga ya zo, kuma suka yi duk abin da suka ga dama da shi, kamar yadda aka rubuta game da shi.”
english: But I tell you that Elijah has come, and they have also done to him whatever they wanted to, even as it is written about him.”

hausa: “Ba zan hukunta ’ya’yanku mata sa’ad da suka juya ga yin karuwanci ba, balle surukanku mata, sa’ad da suka yi zina, gama mazan da kansu suna ma’amala da karuwai suna kuma miƙa hadaya tare da karuwai na masujada, mutane marasa ganewa za su lalace!
english: I will not punish your daughters when they play the prostitute, nor your brides when they commit adultery; because the men consort with prostitutes, and they sacrifice with the shrine prostitutes; so the people without understanding will come to ruin.

hausa: Akwai ƙananan tagogi a ɗakunan da kuma a bangayen hanyar shiga, yadda suke a shirayin; tagogi a kewaye duka suna fuskantar ciki. An yi wa bangayen da suke waje ƙofar shiga ado da zāne-zāne siffofin itatuwan dabino.
english: There were closed windows to the side rooms, and to their posts within the gate all around, and likewise to the arches. Windows were around inward. Palm trees were on each post.

hausa: “In ya zo ya kulle ka a kurkuku ya ce kai mai laifi ne, wa zai hana shi?
english: If he passes by, or confines, or convenes a court, then who can oppose him?

hausa: Bayan wannan Ibrahim ya binne matarsa Saratu a kogon a filin Makfela kusa da Mamre (wanda yake a Hebron) a ƙasar Kan’ana.
english: After this, Abraham buried Sarah his wife in the cave of the field of Machpelah before Mamre (that is, Hebron), in the land of Canaan.

hausa: Dawuda ya yaƙe su tun daga fāɗuwar rana har yammar kashegari. Ba ko ɗaya da ya tsira sai samari ɗari huɗu waɗanda suka tsere a kan raƙuma.
english: David struck them from the twilight even to the evening of the next day. Not a man of them escaped from there, except four hundred young men who rode on camels and fled.

hausa: “Ba itace mai kyau da yake ba da munanan ’ya’ya. Mummunan itace kuma ba ya ba da ’ya’ya masu kyau.
english: “For there is no good tree that produces rotten fruit, nor again a rotten tree that produces good fruit.

hausa: za su yi masa bulala, su kuma kashe shi. A rana ta uku kuma zai tashi.”
english: They will scourge and kill him. On the third day, he will rise again.”

hausa: Amma kāriyar Fir’auna za tă zama muku abin kunya, inuwar Masar za tă jawo muku kunya.
english: Therefore the strength of Pharaoh will be your shame, and the refuge in the shadow of Egypt your confusion.

hausa: Zan hukunta waɗanda suke zama a Masar da takobi, yunwa da annoba, yadda na hukunta Urushalima.
english: For I will punish those who dwell in the land of Egypt, as I have punished Jerusalem, by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence;

hausa: Masifa a kan masifa za su zo, jita-jita kuma a kan jita-jita. Za su yi ƙoƙarin samun wahayi daga annabi; koyarwar doka ta wurin firist za tă ɓace, kamar yadda shawarar dattawa za tă ɓace.
english: Mischief will come on mischief, and rumor will be on rumor. They will seek a vision of the prophet; but the law will perish from the priest, and counsel from the elders.

hausa: Ƙasar ta more hutun Asabbacinta; a dukan lokacin zamanta kango ta huta, har sai da shekaru saba’in nan suka cika bisa ga maganar Ubangiji da Irmiya ya faɗi.
english: to fulfill Yahweh’s word by Jeremiah’s mouth, until the land had enjoyed its Sabbaths. As long as it lay desolate, it kept Sabbath, to fulfill seventy years.

hausa: Ruwan ya taso ya rufe duwatsu, zurfin ruwa daga duwatsun zuwa inda jirgin yake ya fi ƙafa ashirin.
english: The waters rose fifteen cubits higher, and the mountains were covered.

hausa: Ya ce wa Lawiyawa waɗanda suke koyar da dukan Isra’ila da kuma waɗanda aka tsarkake wa Ubangiji. “Ku sa akwatin alkawari mai tsarki a cikin haikalin da Solomon ɗan Dawuda sarkin Isra’ila ya gina. Ba za a riƙa ɗaukansa a kafaɗa ba. Yanzu ku bauta wa Ubangiji Allahnku da kuma mutanensa Isra’ila.
english: He said to the Levites who taught all Israel, who were holy to Yahweh, “Put the holy ark in the house which Solomon the son of David king of Israel built. It will no longer be a burden on your shoulders. Now serve Yahweh your God and his people Israel.

hausa: Za tă ba ka ƙayayyuwa da sarƙaƙƙiya za ka kuwa ci ganyayen gona.
english: It will yield thorns and thistles to you; and you will eat the herb of the field.

hausa: Sai dukan mugaye da marasa kirki daga cikin mutanen da suka tafi tare da Dawuda suka ce, “Tun da yake ba su tafi tare da mu ba, ba za mu ba su kome daga cikin ganimar da muka ƙwato ba, sai dai kowane mutum yă ɗauki matarsa da ’ya’yansa yă tafi.”
english: Then all the wicked men and worthless fellows of those who went with David answered and said, “Because they didn’t go with us, we will not give them anything of the plunder that we have recovered, except to every man his wife and his children, that he may lead them away and depart.”

hausa: Sai Ubangiji ya yi fushi da Musa ya ce, “Ɗan’uwanka Haruna Balawe, ba ya nan ne? Na san ya iya magana. Ya riga ya kama hanya don yă sadu da kai, zai kuma yi farin ciki sa’ad da ya gan ka.
english: Yahweh’s anger burned against Moses, and he said, “What about Aaron, your brother, the Levite? I know that he can speak well. Also, behold, he is coming out to meet you. When he sees you, he will be glad in his heart.

hausa: Yaron nan Sama’ila ya yi hidima a gaban Ubangiji a ƙarƙashin Eli. A waɗannan kwanaki kuwa jin magana daga wurin Ubangiji ba safai ba, babu kuma wahayi da yawa.
english: The child Samuel ministered to Yahweh before Eli. Yahweh’s word was rare in those days. There were not many visions, then.

hausa: Ga shi, na faɗa muku tun da wuri.
english: “Behold, I have told you beforehand.

hausa: Gama ka ba shi iko bisa dukan mutane domin yă ba da rai madawwami ga duk waɗanda ka ba shi.
english: even as you gave him authority over all flesh, so he will give eternal life to all whom you have given him.

hausa: “ ‘In mutum ya yi zina da matar wani, da matar maƙwabcinsa, dole a kashe su biyu da suka yi zinan.
english: “‘The man who commits adultery with another man’s wife, even he who commits adultery with his neighbor’s wife, the adulterer and the adulteress shall surely be put to death.

hausa: Kada ku gwada Ubangiji Allahnku kamar yadda kuka yi a Massa.
english: You shall not tempt Yahweh your God, as you tempted him in Massah.

hausa: Amma duk wanda yake annabci, yana magana ne da mutane domin yă gina su, yă ƙarfafa su, yă kuma yi musu ta’aziyya.
english: But he who prophesies speaks to men for their edification, exhortation, and consolation.

hausa: Ku yi ƙarfin hali ku kuma ƙarfafa, dukanku masu sa bege a kan Ubangiji.
english: Be strong, and let your heart take courage, all you who hope in Yahweh.

hausa: Daga abin da zai miƙa sai a miƙa waɗannan hadayu na ƙonawa ga Ubangiji a wuta, wato, dukan kitsen da ya rufe kayan cikin, ko kuwa da suka shafe su,
english: He shall offer from it as his offering, an offering made by fire to Yahweh; the fat that covers the innards, and all the fat that is on the innards,

hausa: Saboda haka ku yafa tufafin makoki, ku yi makoki da kuka, gama fushin Ubangiji bai juye daga gare mu ba.
english: For this, clothe yourself with sackcloth, lament and wail; for the fierce anger of Yahweh hasn’t turned back from us.

hausa: Kun kuma manta da kalmar ƙarfafawan nan da tana ce da ku ’ya’ya, “Ɗana kada ka rena horon Ubangiji, kada kuma ka fid da zuciya sa’ad da ya kwaɓe ka,
english: You have forgotten the exhortation which reasons with you as with children, “My son, don’t take lightly the chastening of the Lord, nor faint when you are reproved by him;

hausa: Saboda haka suka kira duka shugabannin Filistiyawa suka tambaye su, suka ce, “Me za mu da akwatin alkawarin Allahn Isra’ila?” Sai suka amsa suka ce, “A ɗauki akwatin alkawarin Allah na Isra’ila a kai shi Gat.” Sai suka ɗauki akwatin alkawarin Allah na Isra’ila.
english: They sent therefore and gathered together all the lords of the Philistines, and said, “What shall we do with the ark of the God of Israel?” They answered, “Let the ark of the God of Israel be carried over to Gath.” They carried the ark of the God of Israel there.

hausa: Sa’ad da na harbe ki da mugayen kibiyoyina da kuma kibiyoyi masu hallakarwa na yunwa, zan yi harbi don in kashe ki. Zan kawo ƙarin yunwa a kanki in kuma yanke tanadin abincinki.
english: when I send on them the evil arrows of famine that are for destruction, which I will send to destroy you. I will increase the famine on you and will break your staff of bread.

hausa: kada ku ƙulla wa maƙwabtanku mugunta, kuma kada ku so yin rantsuwa ta ƙarya. Ina ƙyamar waɗannan duka,” in ji Ubangiji Maɗaukaki.
english: and let none of you devise evil in your hearts against his neighbor, and love no false oath; for all these are things that I hate,” says Yahweh.

hausa: Dutsen Sihiyona ya yi farin ciki, ƙauyukan Yahuda suna murna saboda hukuntanka.
english: Let Mount Zion be glad! Let the daughters of Judah rejoice because of your judgments.

hausa: Yayinda Yesu yake cikin magana da taron, sai ga mahaifiyarsa da ’yan’uwansa tsaye a waje, suna so su yi magana da shi.
english: While he was yet speaking to the multitudes, behold, his mother and his brothers stood outside, seeking to speak to him.

hausa: amma akwai sauran kabilu bakwai na Isra’ila waɗanda ba su samu rabon gādonsu ba tukuna.
english: Seven tribes remained among the children of Israel, which had not yet divided their inheritance.

hausa: Kada ka yi nesa da ni, gama wahala na kusa kuma babu wani da zai taimaka.
english: Don’t be far from me, for trouble is near. For there is no one to help.

hausa: Ƙasarsu za tă zama kufai, abin reni har abada; dukan waɗanda suka wuce za su yi mamaki su kaɗa kai.
english: to make their land an astonishment, and a perpetual hissing. Everyone who passes by it will be astonished, and shake his head.

hausa: “Faɗa wa Isra’ilawa, ‘Duk wanda ya kawo hadaya ta salama ga Ubangiji, sai ya kawo hadayarsa ga Ubangiji daga cikin hadayu na salama.
english: “Speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘He who offers the sacrifice of his peace offerings to Yahweh shall bring his offering to Yahweh out of the sacrifice of his peace offerings.

hausa: Ku datse wa Babilon mai shuka, da mai girbi lauje a lokacin girbi. Saboda takobin mai zalunci bari kowa ya koma ga mutanensa, bari kowa ya gudu zuwa ga ƙasarsa.
english: Cut off the sower from Babylon, and him who handles the sickle in the time of harvest. For fear of the oppressing sword, they will each return to their own people, and they will each flee to their own land.

hausa: Biye da shi, Binnuyi ɗan Henadad ya yi gyaran wani sashe, daga gidan Azariya zuwa kusurwa,
english: After him, Binnui the son of Henadad repaired another portion, from the house of Azariah to the turning of the wall, and to the corner.

hausa: Sa’an nan suka zubar da allolin nan daga cikinsu suka bauta wa Ubangiji. Ubangiji kuwa bai ƙara daure da azabar da Isra’ila suke sha ba.
english: They put away the foreign gods from among them and served Yahweh; and his soul was grieved for the misery of Israel.

hausa: Saboda haka, a cikin ikkilisiyoyin Allah muna taƙama game da daurewarku da kuma bangaskiyarku cikin dukan tsanani da gwaje-gwajen da kuke sha.
english: so that we ourselves boast about you in the assemblies of God for your perseverance and faith in all your persecutions and in the afflictions which you endure.

hausa: Sa’ad da bokayen Fir’auna suka yi ƙoƙari yin sihiri iri na rufe ido domin su fito da kwari, sai suka kāsa. Ƙwari masu cizo kuwa suka rufe mutane da dabbobi.
english: The magicians tried with their enchantments to produce lice, but they couldn’t. There were lice on man, and on animal.

hausa: Amma Nadab da Abihu sun mutu sa’ad da suka miƙa hadaya da haramtacciyar wuta a gaban Ubangiji.)
english: Nadab and Abihu died when they offered strange fire before Yahweh.

hausa: Saboda haka ta ba shi baranyarta Bilha tă zama matarsa. Yaƙub kuwa ya kwana da ita,
english: She gave him Bilhah her servant as wife, and Jacob went in to her.

hausa: Bayan ya ƙwace makaman ikoki da hukumomi, ya kunyata su a sarari, ya ci nasara a bisansu ta wurin gicciye.
english: Having stripped the principalities and the powers, he made a show of them openly, triumphing over them in it.

hausa: Zai juya harshensu a kansu yă kuma kawo su ga hallaka; duk waɗanda suka gan su za su kaɗa kai, suna musu ba’a.
english: Their own tongues shall ruin them. All who see them will shake their heads.

hausa: A ranar da kuka kaɗa damin, dole ku miƙa hadaya ta ƙonawa na ɗan rago bana ɗaya, marar lahani ga Ubangiji,
english: On the day when you wave the sheaf, you shall offer a male lamb without defect a year old for a burnt offering to Yahweh.

hausa: Daga Yahuda dutsen kusurwa zai fito, daga gare shi za a samu abin kafa tenti, daga gare shi za a sami bakan yaƙi, daga gare shi za a sami kowane mai mulki.
english: From him will come the cornerstone, from him the tent peg, from him the battle bow, from him every ruler together.

hausa: Elisha ya amsa mata ya ce, “Me kike so in yi miki? Ki faɗa mini, me kike da shi a gidanki?” Sai ta ce, “Baiwarka ba ta da kome a can, sai ɗan tulun man zaitun.”
english: Elisha said to her, “What should I do for you? Tell me, what do you have in the house?” She said, “Your servant has nothing in the house, except a pot of oil.”

hausa: Dole ƙauna tă zama ta gaskiya. Ku ƙi duk abin da yake mugu; ku manne wa abin da yake nagari.
english: Let love be without hypocrisy. Abhor that which is evil. Cling to that which is good.

hausa: Zai mallaki dukiyoyi na zinariya, da na azurfa, da dukan abubuwa masu tsada na Masar. Zai kuma ci Libiyawa da Kush da yaƙi.
english: But he will have power over the treasures of gold and of silver, and over all the precious things of Egypt. The Libyans and the Ethiopians will follow his steps.

hausa: In kuwa Shaiɗan yana gāba da kansa, ya kuma rabu biyu, ba zai tsaya ba, ƙarshensa ya zo ke nan.
english: If Satan has risen up against himself, and is divided, he can’t stand, but has an end.

hausa: Ya jajjefi Dawuda da dukan fadawan sarki da duwatsu, ko da yake sojoji da masu gadin sarki na musamman suna kewaye da sarki dama da hagu.
english: He cast stones at David and at all the servants of King David, and all the people and all the mighty men were on his right hand and on his left.

hausa: Azurfarsu ko zinariyarsu ba za su iya cetonsu ba a ranar fushin Ubangiji.” A cikin zafin kishinsa za a hallaka dukan duniya gama zai kawo ƙarshen dukan mazaunan duniya nan da nan.
english: Neither their silver nor their gold will be able to deliver them in the day of Yahweh’s wrath, but the whole land will be devoured by the fire of his jealousy; for he will make an end, yes, a terrible end, of all those who dwell in the land.

hausa: ba mai buguwa ba, ba mai rikici ba sai dai mai hankali, ba mai yawan faɗa ba, ba kuma mai yawan son kuɗi ba.
english: not a drinker, not violent, not greedy for money, but gentle, not quarrelsome, not covetous;

hausa: “Kafin naƙuda ya fara mata, ta haihu; kafin zafi ya zo mata, ta haifi ɗa.
english: “Before she travailed, she gave birth. Before her pain came, she delivered a son.

hausa: Za ku san cewa ni ne Ubangiji, sa’ad da na yi muku haka saboda sunana ba bisa ga mugayen hanyoyinku da ayyukanku marasa kyau ba, ya gidan Isra’ila, in ji Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka.’ ”
english: You will know that I am Yahweh, when I have dealt with you for my name’s sake, not according to your evil ways, nor according to your corrupt doings, you house of Israel,” says the Lord Yahweh.’”

hausa: Gajimare ya rufe shi, saboda haka ba ya ganinmu lokacin da yake takawa a cikin sammai.’
english: Thick clouds are a covering to him, so that he doesn’t see. He walks on the vault of the sky.’

hausa: “Ya ku raguwar Yahuda, Ubangiji ya ce muku, ‘Kada ku je Masar.’ Ku tabbatar da wannan. Na gargaɗe ku yau
english: “Yahweh has spoken concerning you, remnant of Judah, ‘Don’t go into Egypt!’ Know certainly that I have testified to you today.

hausa: daga kabilar Gad kuwa suka sami Ramot a Gileyad, Mahanayim,
english: and out of the tribe of Gad, Ramoth in Gilead with its pasture lands, Mahanaim with its pasture lands,

hausa: Yehu ya ce, “Zo tare da ni ka ga himmata saboda Ubangiji.” Sa’an nan ya sa suka tafi tare cikin keken yaƙinsa.
english: He said, “Come with me, and see my zeal for Yahweh.” So they made him ride in his chariot.

hausa: Na kira gare ka, ya Allah, gama za ka amsa mini; ka kasa kunne ka kuma ji addu’ata.
english: I have called on you, for you will answer me, God. Turn your ear to me. Hear my speech.

hausa: shuɗi, shunayya da jan zare, lallausan lilin, da gashin akuya,
english: blue, purple, scarlet, fine linen, goats’ hair,

hausa: Amma kai, ya Ubangiji, kakan yi musu dariya; kana yi wa dukan waɗannan al’ummai ba’a.
english: But you, Yahweh, laugh at them. You scoff at all the nations.

hausa: Shekara shida, za ku yi shuki, shekara shida kuma za ku aske gonakin inabinku, ku kuma tattara hatsinsu.
english: You shall sow your field six years, and you shall prune your vineyard six years, and gather in its fruits;

hausa: Sai annabi Ishaya ya roƙi Ubangiji, Ubangiji kuwa ya sa inuwa ta koma baya da taki goma bisa ga magwajin rana wanda Sarki Ahaz ya gina.
english: Isaiah the prophet cried to Yahweh; and he brought the shadow ten steps backward, by which it had gone down on the sundial of Ahaz.

hausa: Cikin waɗannan kwanakin mutane za su nemi mutuwa, amma ba za su samu ba; za su yi marmarin mutuwa, amma mutuwa za tă ɓace musu.
english: In those days people will seek death, and will in no way find it. They will desire to die, and death will flee from them.

hausa: “Kamar yadda aka tattara ciyayin aka kuma ƙone a wuta, haka zai zama a ƙarshen zamani.
english: As therefore the darnel weeds are gathered up and burned with fire; so will it be at the end of this age.

hausa: akwai labule mai kamu goma sha biyar a ɗayan gefen ƙofar shiga zuwa filin Tentin Sujada, da sanduna uku da rammuka uku.
english: and so for the other side: on this hand and that hand by the gate of the court were hangings of fifteen cubits; their pillars three, and their sockets three.

hausa: “Ka ji addu’ata, ya Ubangiji, ka saurari kukata ta neman taimako; kada ka kurmance ga kukata. Gama ina zama tare da kai kamar baƙo, baƙo, kamar yadda dukan kakannina sun kasance.
english: “Hear my prayer, Yahweh, and give ear to my cry. Don’t be silent at my tears. For I am a stranger with you, a foreigner, as all my fathers were.

hausa: Sai suka amsa wa Yoshuwa suka ce, “Duk abin da ka ce mu yi, za mu yi. Duk inda kuma ka aike mu, za mu je.
english: They answered Joshua, saying, “All that you have commanded us we will do, and wherever you send us we will go.

hausa: Har yanzu kuna rayuwa bisa ga halin mutuntaka. Da yake akwai kishi da faɗace-faɗace a cikinku, ba rayuwa irin ta halin mutuntaka ke nan kuke yi ba? Kuma ba rayuwa irin ta mutane ce kawai kuke yi ba?
english: for you are still fleshly. For insofar as there is jealousy, strife, and factions among you, aren’t you fleshly, and don’t you walk in the ways of men?

hausa: Ka tuna, ya Allah, raina numfashi ne kawai; idanuna ba za su taɓa sāke ganin farin ciki ba.
