english: Oh remember that my life is a breath. My eye will no more see good.

hausa: “Ka dubi al’ummai, ka gani, ka sha mamaki. Ga shi zan yi wani abu a kwanakinka, wanda ko ma an faɗa maka ba za ka gaskata ba.
english: “Look among the nations, watch, and wonder marvelously; for I am working a work in your days which you will not believe though it is told you.

hausa: Bayan ya haifi Shela kuwa, Arfakshad ya yi shekara 403, ya kuma haifi waɗansu ’ya’ya maza da mata.
english: Arpachshad lived four hundred three years after he became the father of Shelah, and became the father of more sons and daughters.

hausa: A kowane gari a Yahuda, ya gina masujadan kan tudu don ƙone hadayu ga waɗansu alloli, ya kuma tsokane Ubangiji Allah na kakanninsa ya yi fushi.
english: In every city of Judah he made high places to burn incense to other gods, and provoked Yahweh, the God of his fathers, to anger.

hausa: ka kama mafi kyau daga cikin garken. Ka tara itace a ƙarƙashinta saboda ƙasusuwan; ka sa ta tafasa ka kuma dafa ƙasusuwan a cikinta.
english: Take the choice of the flock, and also a pile of wood for the bones under the cauldron. Make it boil well. Yes, let its bones be boiled within it.”

hausa: Laban ya ce, “Wannan tsibi, shi ne shaida tsakaninka da ni a yau.” Shi ya sa aka kira shi Galeyed.
english: Laban said, “This heap is witness between me and you today.” Therefore it was named Galeed

hausa: wadda ta aiko da jakadu ta teku cikin jiragen ruwan da aka yi da kyauro a bisa ruwa. Ku tafi, ku ’yan saƙo masu sauri, zuwa ga dogayen mutane masu sulɓin jiki, zuwa ga mutanen da ake jin tsoro a ko’ina, al’umma mai ƙarfin iko tana jawabin da ba a saba ji ba, mai ƙasar da koguna suka raba.
english: that sends ambassadors by the sea, even in vessels of papyrus on the waters, saying, “Go, you swift messengers, to a nation tall and smooth, to a people awesome from their beginning onward, a nation that measures out and treads down, whose land the rivers divide!”

hausa: Bari Fir’auna yă naɗa komishinoni a kan ƙasar don su karɓi kashi ɗaya bisa biyar na girbin Masar a lokacin shekaru bakwai na yalwar abinci.
english: Let Pharaoh do this, and let him appoint overseers over the land, and take up the fifth part of the land of Egypt’s produce in the seven plenteous years.

hausa: in na ɗaga hannuna don in cuci maraya, domin na san in na faɗa za a ji ni a wurin masu shari’a,
english: if I have lifted up my hand against the fatherless, because I saw my help in the gate;

hausa: Ba zuriyar Haruna firist, mai lahanin da zai zo kusa don yă miƙa hadayun da aka yi ga Ubangiji da wuta. Da yake yana da lahani, ba zai zo kusa don yă miƙa abincin Allahnsa ba.
english: No man of the offspring of Aaron the priest who has a defect shall come near to offer the offerings of Yahweh made by fire. Since he has a defect, he shall not come near to offer the bread of his God.

hausa: Sai Nebukadnezzar ya matsa kusa da ƙofar tanderun wutar ya yi kira da ƙarfi, “Shedrak, Meshak da Abednego, bayin Allah Mafi Ɗaukaka ku fito! Ku zo nan!” Sai Shadrak, Meshak da Abednego suka fita daga cikin wutar,
english: Then Nebuchadnezzar came near to the mouth of the burning fiery furnace. He spoke and said, “Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego, you servants of the Most High God, come out, and come here!” Then Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego came out of the middle of the fire.

hausa: Kashegari, mugun ruhu daga Allah ya fāɗo wa Shawulu da tsanani. Yana annabci a gidansa, Dawuda kuwa yana bugan molo kamar yadda ya saba. Shawulu yana riƙe da māshi a hannunsa.
english: On the next day, an evil spirit from God came mightily on Saul, and he prophesied in the middle of the house. David played with his hand, as he did day by day. Saul had his spear in his hand;

hausa: Balak kuwa ya ɗauki Bala’am zuwa ƙwanƙolin Feyor, wanda yake fuskantar hamada.
english: Balak took Balaam to the top of Peor, that looks down on the desert.

hausa: Efraim zai ce, me kuma zai haɗa ni da gumaka? Zan amsa masa in kuma lura da shi. Ni kamar koren itacen fir ne; amincinka yana fitowa daga gare ni ne.”
english: Ephraim, what have I to do any more with idols? I answer, and will take care of him. I am like a green cypress tree; from me your fruit is found.”

hausa: Ubangiji zai komar da ku cikin jiragen ruwa zuwa Masar, tafiyar da na ce kada ku ƙara yi. A can za ku ba da kanku don sayarwa ga abokan gābanku a matsayin bayi maza da mata, amma ba wanda zai saye ku.
english: Yahweh will bring you into Egypt again with ships, by the way of which I told you that you would never see it again. There you will offer yourselves to your enemies for male and female slaves, and nobody will buy you.

hausa: In ba a hore ku ba (kowa kuwa yakan sami horo), to, ku shegu ne ba ’ya’yan gida ba.
english: But if you are without discipline, of which all have been made partakers, then you are illegitimate, and not children.

hausa: Mutanenka suka zauna a cikinsa, kuma daga yalwarka, ya Allah, ka tanada wa matalauta.
english: Your congregation lived therein. You, God, prepared your goodness for the poor.

hausa: Amma in kuka yi hankali kuka yi mini biyayya, in ji Ubangiji, ba ku kuwa shigar da kaya ta ƙofofi a ranar Asabbaci ba, amma kuka kiyaye ranar Asabbaci da tsarki ba tare da yin wani aiki a cikinta ba,
english: It will happen, if you diligently listen to me,” says Yahweh, “to bring in no burden through the gates of this city on the Sabbath day, but to make the Sabbath day holy, to do no work therein;

hausa: Shi da ya shaida waɗannan abubuwa ya ce, “I, ina zuwa da wuri.” Amin. Zo, Ubangiji Yesu!
english: He who testifies these things says, “Yes, I am coming soon.” Amen! Yes, come, Lord Jesus!

hausa: Sai ya je wurin Bilatus ya roƙa a ba shi jikin Yesu.
english: This man went to Pilate, and asked for Jesus’ body.

hausa: Sai Bulus ya sauka, ya miƙe a kan saurayin ya rungume shi ya ce, “Kada ku damu, yana da rai!”
english: Paul went down and fell upon him, and embracing him said, “Don’t be troubled, for his life is in him.”

hausa: Ya ce, “Wannan mugunta ce,” ya kuma tura ta cikin kwandon ya rufe da murfin dalman, ya kuma danna da dutse.
english: He said, “This is Wickedness;” and he threw her down into the middle of the ephah basket; and he threw the lead weight on its mouth.

hausa: “Da zarar wasiƙan nan ta sadu da ku, da yake ’ya’yan maigidanku suna tare da ku, kuna kuma da kekunan yaƙi da dawakai, da birni mai katanga da makamai,
english: “Now as soon as this letter comes to you, since your master’s sons are with you, and you have chariots and horses, a fortified city also, and armor,

hausa: don ka buɗe idanun makafi ka ’yantar da kamammu daga kurkuku kuma kunce ɗaurarrun kurkuku masu zama cikin duhu.
english: to open the blind eyes, to bring the prisoners out of the dungeon, and those who sit in darkness out of the prison.

hausa: Allah ya miƙa Yesu Kiristi a matsayin hadayar kafara, ta wurin bangaskiya cikin jininsa. Ya yi haka domin yă nuna adalcinsa, domin a cikin haƙurinsa bai hukunta zunuban da aka aikata a dā ba
english: whom God sent to be an atoning sacrifice through faith in his blood, for a demonstration of his righteousness through the passing over of prior sins, in God’s forbearance;

hausa: Zuriyar Ferez kuwa, daga Hezron, kabilar Hezronawa; daga Hamul; kabilar Hamulawa.
english: The sons of Perez were: of Hezron, the family of the Hezronites; of Hamul, the family of the Hamulites.

hausa: Hikima takan sa mutum guda mai hikima yă yi ƙarfi fiye da masu mulki goma a cikin birni.
english: Wisdom is a strength to the wise man more than ten rulers who are in a city.

hausa: Ya ɗauki Bitrus da ’ya’ya biyun nan na Zebedi tare da shi, sai ya fara baƙin ciki, ya kuma damu.
english: He took with him Peter and the two sons of Zebedee, and began to be sorrowful and severely troubled.

hausa: “ ‘Kada ka auri ’yar’uwar matarka ta zama kishiyar matarka ka kuma yi jima’i da ita yayinda matarka tana da rai.
english: “‘You shall not take a wife in addition to her sister, to be a rival, to uncover her nakedness, while her sister is still alive.

hausa: An yi mata gado a cikin matattu, tare da dukan jama’arta kewaye da kabarinta. Dukansu marasa kaciya ne, da aka kashe da takobi. Domin tsoronsu ya bazu cikin ƙasar masu rai, suna shan kunya tare da waɗanda suka gangara zuwa rami; an kwantar da su tare da waɗanda aka kashe.
english: They have made Elam a bed among the slain with all her multitude. Her graves are around her, all of them uncircumcised, slain by the sword; for their terror was caused in the land of the living, and they have borne their shame with those who go down to the pit. He is put among those who are slain.

hausa: Waɗannan ƙari ne ga hadayun ƙonawa na wata-wata da na kullayaumi, tare da hadayun garinsu da hadayun sha yadda aka tsara. Hadayu ne da aka miƙa wa Ubangiji ta wuta don daɗin ƙanshi.
english: in addition to the burnt offering of the new moon with its meal offering, and the continual burnt offering with its meal offering, and their drink offerings, according to their ordinance, for a pleasant aroma, an offering made by fire to Yahweh.

hausa: “Saboda haka, sai ku zauna a shirye, domin ba ku san lokacin da maigidan zai dawo ba, ko da yamma ne, ko da tsakar dare ne, ko lokacin da zakara na cara ne, ko kuma da safe ne.
english: Watch therefore, for you don’t know when the lord of the house is coming—whether at evening, or at midnight, or when the rooster crows, or in the morning;

hausa: Suka nufo ni daga kowane gefe; suka auko mini da dukan ƙarfinsu.
english: As through a wide breach they come. They roll themselves in amid the ruin.

hausa: Sheba ya bi ta dukan kabilan Isra’ila zuwa Abel da kuma ta dukan yankin Beriyawa, waɗanda suka taru suka bi shi.
english: He went through all the tribes of Israel to Abel, to Beth Maacah, and all the Berites. They were gathered together, and went also after him.

hausa: Ɗan barci, ɗan gyangyaɗi, ɗan naɗin hannuwa don a huta,
english: A little sleep, a little slumber, a little folding of the hands to sleep—

hausa: ba su ba ne suka gani abin da ya yi ga Datan da Abiram, ’ya’yan Eliyab mutumin Ruben, sa’ad da ƙasa ta buɗe bakinta a tsakiyar dukan Isra’ila ta haɗiye su tare da gidajensu, tentunansu da kowane abu mai rai da yake nasu ba.
english: and what he did to Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab, the son of Reuben—how the earth opened its mouth and swallowed them up, with their households, their tents, and every living thing that followed them, in the middle of all Israel;

hausa: Amma ko da zan yi shari’a, shari’ata daidai ce, don ba ni kaɗai ba ne. Ina tare da Uba da ya aiko ni.
english: Even if I do judge, my judgment is true, for I am not alone, but I am with the Father who sent me.

hausa: Ta yaya mutum zai iya zama mai adalci a gaban Allah? Ta yaya mutumin da mace ta haifa zai zama mai tsarki?
english: How then can man be just with God? Or how can he who is born of a woman be clean?

hausa: Girmankai kan jawo faɗa ne kawai, amma hikima tana samuwa a waɗanda suke jin shawara.
english: Pride only breeds quarrels, but wisdom is with people who take advice.

hausa: Cikin dukan ayyukan banƙyamarki da karuwancinki ba ki tuna da kwanakin ƙuruciyarki ba, sa’ad da kike tsirara tik, kina birgima cikin jininki.
english: In all your abominations and your prostitution you have not remembered the days of your youth, when you were naked and bare, and were wallowing in your blood.

hausa: Nauyin ƙusoshin ya kai shekel hamsin na zinariya. Ya kuma shafe benaye da zinariya zalla.
english: The weight of the nails was fifty shekels of gold. He overlaid the upper rooms with gold.

hausa: Aka yi dukan ƙarafan kafa tabanakul da kuma na kewayen filin Tentin Sujada da tagulla ne.
english: All the pins of the tabernacle, and around the court, were of bronze.

hausa: Da matsowar Barak, Ubangiji ya murƙushe Sisera da dukan sarakunansa da mayaƙansa da takobi, Sisera kuwa ya gudu da ƙafa ya bar keken yaƙinsa.
english: Yahweh confused Sisera, all his chariots, and all his army, with the edge of the sword before Barak. Sisera abandoned his chariot and fled away on his feet.

hausa: Yanzu fa, sai ku ƙarfafa, ku yi jaruntaka, gama Shawulu sarkinku ya mutu, gidan Yahuda kuwa sun naɗa ni sarki a kansu.”
english: Now therefore let your hands be strong, and be valiant; for Saul your lord is dead, and also the house of Judah have anointed me king over them.”

hausa: Yayinda take haihuwa, ɗaya daga cikinsu ya fid da hannunsa; sai ungonzomar ta ɗauki jan zare ta ɗaura a hannun, ta ce, “Wannan ne ya fito da farko.”
english: When she travailed, one put out a hand, and the midwife took and tied a scarlet thread on his hand, saying, “This came out first.”

hausa: Za ka faɗi kome da na umarce ka, ɗan’uwanka Haruna kuwa zai faɗa wa Fir’auna, yă bar Isra’ilawa su fita daga ƙasarsa.
english: You shall speak all that I command you; and Aaron your brother shall speak to Pharaoh, that he let the children of Israel go out of his land.

hausa: Saboda wannan ne na nemi in gan ku in kuma yi magana da ku. Saboda begen Isra’ila ne, nake a daure da wannan sarƙa.”
english: For this cause therefore I asked to see you and to speak with you. For because of the hope of Israel I am bound with this chain.”

hausa: Saboda haka suka ratsa Misiya suka zo Toruwas.
english: Passing by Mysia, they came down to Troas.

hausa: Haka ma in ba a busa ƙaho sosai ba, wa zai yi shirin yaƙi?
english: For if the trumpet gave an uncertain sound, who would prepare himself for war?

hausa: Saboda haka Musa da Eleyazar suka aikata yadda Ubangiji ya umarci Musa.
english: Moses and Eleazar the priest did as Yahweh commanded Moses.

hausa: Da yamma ta yi, sai ga wani mutum mai arziki daga Arimateya, sunansa Yusuf, wanda shi da kansa almajirin Yesu ne.
english: When evening had come, a rich man from Arimathaea named Joseph, who himself was also Jesus’ disciple, came.

hausa: Sai ya fara la’antar kansa, yana rantsuwa musu, yana cewa, “Ban san wannan mutumin da kuke magana a kai ba.”
english: But he began to curse and to swear, “I don’t know this man of whom you speak!”

hausa: Ya kawo firistoci da Lawiyawa, ya tattara su a filin da yake a gefen gabas
english: He brought in the priests and the Levites and gathered them together into the wide place on the east,

hausa: Ka kuma sa sauran bakunan sarƙoƙin nan biyu a kan tsaikon nan biyu, kana haɗa su da ƙyallen kafaɗa na efod a gaba.
english: The other two ends of the two braided chains you shall put on the two settings, and put them on the shoulder straps of the ephod in its forepart.

hausa: Bari Isra’ila yă ce, “Ƙaunarsa madawwamiya ce har abada.”
english: Let Israel now say that his loving kindness endures forever.

hausa: Mutanen Ruben, mutanen Gad da rabin kabilar Manasse sun kasance da mutane 44,760 shiryayyu don aikin soja, jarumawan da za su iya riƙe garkuwa da takobi, waɗanda suke iya yin amfani da baka, waɗanda kuma aka horar don yaƙi.
english: The sons of Reuben, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh, of valiant men, men able to bear buckler and sword, able to shoot with bow, and skillful in war, were forty-four thousand seven hundred sixty that were able to go out to war.

hausa: Sa’an nan Yaƙub ya sa ’ya’yansa da matansa a kan raƙuma,
english: Then Jacob rose up, and set his sons and his wives on the camels,

hausa: Ma’aka ƙwarƙwarar Kaleb ita ce mahaifiyar Sheber da Tirhana.
english: Maacah, Caleb’s concubine, bore Sheber and Tirhanah.

hausa: Ubangiji ya yi magana da Musa a Tentin Sujada a cikin Hamadar Sinai, a rana ta fari na watan biyu a shekara ta biyu, bayan Isra’ilawa suka fito Masar ya ce,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, in the Tent of Meeting, on the first day of the second month, in the second year after they had come out of the land of Egypt, saying,

hausa: Kayin, Gibeya, Timna, garuruwa goma ke nan da ƙauyukansu.
english: Kain, Gibeah, and Timnah; ten cities with their villages.

hausa: Wata ranar Asabbaci, Yesu yana koyarwa a wata majami’a,
english: He was teaching in one of the synagogues on the Sabbath day.

hausa: Da tsakar dare sai wani abu ya firgitar da mutumin, ya kuwa juya sai ya tarar da mace kwance a ƙafafunsa.
english: At midnight, the man was startled and turned himself; and behold, a woman lay at his feet.

hausa: Sa’ad da akwatin alkawarin Ubangiji ya shiga Birnin Dawuda, sai Mikal ’yar Shawulu ta leƙa ta taga ta ga Dawuda sarki yana tsalle, yana rawa a gaban Ubangiji, sai ta rena shi a zuciyarta.
english: As Yahweh’s ark came into David’s city, Michal the daughter of Saul looked out through the window and saw King David leaping and dancing before Yahweh; and she despised him in her heart.

hausa: Kada ku ci zakkar hatsi, da na sabon inabi, da kuma na mai a biranenku, ko kuwa na ’ya’yan fari na garkunanku na shanu da na tumaki, ko kuwa duk wani abin da kuka yi alkawari za ku bayar, ko hadayunku na yardar rai, ko kyautai na musamman.
english: You may not eat within your gates the tithe of your grain, or of your new wine, or of your oil, or the firstborn of your herd or of your flock, nor any of your vows which you vow, nor your free will offerings, nor the wave offering of your hand;

hausa: Sa’ad da Sila da Timoti suka iso daga Makidoniya, sai Bulus ya ba da kansa ga yin wa’azi kaɗai, yana tabbatar wa Yahudawa cewa Yesu shi ne Kiristi.
english: When Silas and Timothy came down from Macedonia, Paul was compelled by the Spirit, testifying to the Jews that Jesus was the Christ.

hausa: To, Yusuf ne gwamnar ƙasar wanda yake sayar da hatsi ga dukan mutanenta. Saboda haka sa’ad da ’yan’uwan Yusuf suka isa, sai suka rusuna masa har ƙasa da fuskokinsu.
english: Joseph was the governor over the land. It was he who sold to all the people of the land. Joseph’s brothers came, and bowed themselves down to him with their faces to the earth.

hausa: Da jin ƙarar muryoyinsu madogarai da madogaran ƙofa suka girgiza, haikali kuma ya cika da hayaƙi.
english: The foundations of the thresholds shook at the voice of him who called, and the house was filled with smoke.

hausa: Kowanne a cikin almajiran, gwargwadon azancinsa, ya yanke shawara ya ba da gudummawa ga ’yan’uwan da suke zama a Yahudiya.
english: As any of the disciples had plenty, each determined to send relief to the brothers who lived in Judea;

hausa: Aka kuma raba wa sauran mutanen kabilar Manasse rabon gādonsu bisa ga iyalansu, wato, Abiyezer, Helek, Asriyel, Shekem, Hefer da Shemida. Waɗannan su ne ’ya’yan Manasse, maza, ɗan Yusuf bisa ga iyalansu.
english: So this was for the rest of the children of Manasseh according to their families: for the children of Abiezer, for the children of Helek, for the children of Asriel, for the children of Shechem, for the children of Hepher, and for the children of Shemida. These were the male children of Manasseh the son of Joseph according to their families.

hausa: Sai shugaban sojojin ya yi kira da Yahudanci ya ce, “Ku ji muryar babban sarki, sarkin Assuriya!
english: Then Rabshakeh stood and cried with a loud voice in the Jews’ language, and spoke, saying, “Hear the word of the great king, the king of Assyria.

hausa: “Ku na wannan zamani, ku saurari maganar Ubangiji. “Na zama wa Isra’ila hamada ne ko ƙasa mai babban duhu? Me ya sa mutanena suke cewa, ‘Muna da ’yanci mu yi ta yawo; ba za mu ƙara zuwa wurinka ba’?
english: Generation, consider Yahweh’s word. Have I been a wilderness to Israel? Or a land of thick darkness? Why do my people say, ‘We have broken loose. We will come to you no more’?

hausa: “Sa’an nan za ku ce, ‘Haba, mu da muka ci, muka sha tare da kai, har ka yi koyarwa a cikin titi-titi namu.’
english: Then you will begin to say, ‘We ate and drank in your presence, and you taught in our streets.’

hausa: Amma mahaifinsa ya ƙi ya ce, “Na sani, ɗana, na sani. Shi ma zai zama mutane, zai kuma zama mai girma. Duk da haka ɗan’uwansa zai zama mai girma fiye da shi, kuma zuriyarsa za tă zama ƙungiyar al’ummai.”
english: His father refused, and said, “I know, my son, I know. He also will become a people, and he also will be great. However, his younger brother will be greater than he, and his offspring will become a multitude of nations.”

hausa: Sai annabin ya cire ƙyallen da sauri daga kansa, da ya rufe idanunsa, sarkin Isra’ila kuwa ya gane shi a matsayi ɗaya daga cikin annabawa.
english: He hurried, and took the headband away from his eyes; and the king of Israel recognized that he was one of the prophets.

hausa: Saboda haka Ahab ya kira sojoji matasa na shugabannin yankuna, mutum 232. Sa’an nan ya tattara sauran Isra’ilawa su 7,000 gaba ɗaya.
english: Then he mustered the young men of the princes of the provinces, and they were two hundred and thirty-two. After them, he mustered all the people, even all the children of Israel, being seven thousand.

hausa: Sa’an nan Babiloniyawa za su koma su yaƙi wannan birni su ci ta su kuma ƙone shi.’
english: The Chaldeans will come again, and fight against this city. They will take it and burn it with fire.”’

hausa: Gaskiya nake gaya maka, ba za ka fita ba, sai ka biya kobo na ƙarshe.
english: Most certainly I tell you, you shall by no means get out of there until you have paid the last penny.

hausa: Ya yi tafiya a hanyoyin sarakunan Isra’ila ya kuma yi zubin gumaka domin a bauta wa Ba’al.
english: but he walked in the ways of the kings of Israel, and also made molten images for the Baals.

hausa: Bugu da ƙari, dukan shugabannin firistoci da mutane suka ƙara zama marasa aminci, suna bin dukan abubuwan banƙyama na al’ummai, suka ƙazantar da haikalin Ubangiji, wanda ya tsarkake a Urushalima.
english: Moreover all the chiefs of the priests and the people trespassed very greatly after all the abominations of the nations; and they polluted Yahweh’s house which he had made holy in Jerusalem.

hausa: “Amma idanunka da zuciyarka sun kahu kawai a kan ƙazamar riba, da a kan zub da jinin marar laifi da kuma a kan danniya da zalunci.”
english: But your eyes and your heart are only for your covetousness, for shedding innocent blood, for oppression, and for doing violence.”

hausa: Sa’ad da Yared ya yi shekara 162, sai ya haifi Enok.
english: Jared lived one hundred sixty-two years, then became the father of Enoch.

hausa: Waɗannan su ne wahayin da na gani a lokacin da nake kwance a gadona, na duba, a gabana kuwa ga wani itace a kafe a tsakiyar duniya, yana da tsawo ƙwarai.
english: These were the visions of my head on my bed: I saw, and behold, a tree in the middle of the earth; and its height was great.

hausa: Gizagizai sun sauko da ruwa, sararin sama suka buga tsawa; kibiyoyinka suka yi ta kai komo da walƙiya.
english: The clouds poured out water. The skies resounded with thunder. Your arrows also flashed around.

hausa: ’Ya’yan Gershon maza, bisa ga dangi su ne, Libni da Shimeyi.
english: The sons of Gershon: Libni and Shimei, according to their families.

hausa: Ga abin da Ubangiji ya ce mini, “Ka je ka tsaya a ƙofar mutane, inda sarakunan Yahuda sukan shiga su fita; ka tsaya kuma a dukan sauran ƙofofin Urushalima.
english: Yahweh said this to me: “Go and stand in the gate of the children of the people, through which the kings of Judah come in and by which they go out, and in all the gates of Jerusalem.

hausa: Bari Allah yă albarkace ki saboda hikima yanke hukuncinki da kuma hana ni zubar da jini da ɗauka wa kaina fansa da hannuna a wannan rana.
english: Blessed is your discretion, and blessed are you, who have kept me today from blood guiltiness, and from avenging myself with my own hand.

hausa: Tana ta farko cikin ayyukan Allah, Mahaliccinta kaɗai yake iya tunkarar ta da takobi.
english: He is the chief of the ways of God. He who made him gives him his sword.

hausa: Saboda haka ya aiko da hannun da ya yi rubutun nan.
english: Then the part of the hand was sent from before him, and this writing was inscribed.

hausa: “Amma yanzu ka saurara, ya Yaƙub, bawana, Isra’ila, wanda zaɓa.
english: Yet listen now, Jacob my servant, and Israel, whom I have chosen.

hausa: ɗan Zuf, ɗan Elkana, ɗan Mahat, ɗan Amasai,
english: the son of Zuph, the son of Elkanah, the son of Mahath, the son of Amasai,

hausa: Sa’an nan Dawuda ya karɓi abin da ta kawo masa daga hannunta, ya kuma ce mata, “Ki koma gida kada ki damu, na ji koke-kokenki, zan kuma biya miki bukatarki.”
english: So David received from her hand that which she had brought him. Then he said to her, “Go up in peace to your house. Behold, I have listened to your voice and have granted your request.”

hausa: Kuma ga su wane ne Allah ya rantse cewa ba za su taɓa shiga hutunsa ba, in ba ga marasa biyayyan nan ba?
english: To whom did he swear that they wouldn’t enter into his rest, but to those who were disobedient?

hausa: “Ina ne hanyar zuwa gidan haske? Kuma a ina duhu yake zama?
english: “What is the way to the dwelling of light? As for darkness, where is its place,

hausa: Sa’ad da magana ta zo kunnen Sanballat, da Tobiya, da Geshem mutumin Arab da kuma sauran abokan gābanmu cewa na sāke gina katangar har babu sauran tsaguwa da ta ragu, ko da yake har zuwa lokacin ban sa ƙofofi a ƙyamare ba
english: Now when it was reported to Sanballat, Tobiah, Geshem the Arabian, and to the rest of our enemies that I had built the wall, and that there was no breach left in it (though even to that time I had not set up the doors in the gates),

hausa: “Amma ku fa, wa, kuke ce da ni?” Bitrus ya amsa ya ce, “Kiristi na Allah.”
english: He said to them, “But who do you say that I am?” Peter answered, “The Christ of God.”

hausa: In waɗansu suna samun wannan taimako daga gare ku, ashe, mu ba mu fi cancanta mu samu ba? Amma ba mu yi amfani da wannan ’yancin ba. A maimakon haka, mun jure da kome, domin kada mu hana bisharar Kiristi yaɗuwa.
english: If others partake of this right over you, don’t we yet more? Nevertheless we didn’t use this right, but we bear all things, that we may cause no hindrance to the Good News of Christ.

hausa: Shawulu da Isra’ilawa suka taru suka yi sansani a Kwarin Ela suka ja dāgā don su yi yaƙi da Filistiyawa.
english: Saul and the men of Israel were gathered together, and encamped in the valley of Elah, and set the battle in array against the Philistines.

hausa: “Zan hallaka kome a fuskar duniya,” in ji Ubangiji.
english: I will utterly sweep away everything from the surface of the earth, says Yahweh.

hausa: Ya kuma ce, “Za ka gan su suna yin abubuwan da suka fi waɗannan banƙyama.”
english: He said also to me, “You will again see more of the great abominations which they do.”

hausa: Duk sun kauce gaba ɗaya, sun zama marasa amfani; babu wani mai aikata nagarta, babu ko ɗaya.”
english: They have all turned away. They have together become unprofitable. There is no one who does good, no, not so much as one.”

hausa: Ban rubuta maka maganganu talatin ba, maganganun shawara da sani,
english: Haven’t I written to you thirty excellent things of counsel and knowledge,

hausa: “Yabo ga Ubangiji wanda ya cece ku daga hannun Masarawa da na Fir’auna, wanda kuma ya cece mutanensa daga hannun Masarawa.
english: Jethro said, “Blessed be Yahweh, who has delivered you out of the hand of the Egyptians, and out of the hand of Pharaoh; who has delivered the people from under the hand of the Egyptians.

hausa: Kuma babbar hanya za tă kasance a can; za a ce ta ita Hanyar Mai Tsarki. Marasa tsarki ba za su yi tafiya a kanta ba; za tă zama domin waɗanda suka yi tafiya a wannan Hanya ce; mugaye da wawaye ba za su yi ta yawo a kanta ba.
english: A highway will be there, a road, and it will be called “The Holy Way”. The unclean shall not pass over it, but it will be for those who walk in the Way. Wicked fools shall not go there.

hausa: Ya aika da saƙo zuwa ga dukan ɓangarorin masarautar, zuwa ga kowane lardi a irin nasa rubutu, zuwa kuma ga kowane mutane a nasu harshe, ana shelar a kowane yare na mutane, cewa kowane mutum yă zama mai mulki bisa gidansa.
english: for he sent letters into all the king’s provinces, into every province according to its writing, and to every people in their language, that every man should rule his own house, speaking in the language of his own people.

hausa: Gama za ki fadada zuwa dama da hagu; zuriyarki za su kori al’ummai su kuma zauna a kufan biranensu.
english: For you will spread out on the right hand and on the left; and your offspring will possess the nations and settle in desolate cities.

hausa: Ubangiji Allahnku ya albarkace ku cikin dukan aikin hannuwanku. Ya kiyaye ku cikin tafiyarku a duk fāɗin hamada. Waɗannan shekaru arba’in Ubangiji Allahnku ya kasance tare da ku, ba kuwa kun rasa wani abu ba.
english: For Yahweh your God has blessed you in all the work of your hands. He has known your walking through this great wilderness. These forty years, Yahweh your God has been with you. You have lacked nothing.

hausa: Yakan tanada wa shanu abinci da kuma saboda ’ya’yan hankaki sa’ad da suka yi kira.
english: He provides food for the livestock, and for the young ravens when they call.

hausa: tare kuma da kowane ’yan raguna goma sha huɗu, kashi ɗaya bisa goma.
english: and one tenth for every lamb of the fourteen lambs;

hausa: Za ku kasance da doka iri ɗaya wa baƙo da kuma wa haifaffen ɗan ƙasa. Ni ne Ubangiji Allahnku.’ ”
english: You shall have one kind of law for the foreigner as well as the native-born; for I am Yahweh your God.’”

hausa: Samariya ba tă aikata ko rabin zunubanki ba. Kin aikata abubuwa masu banƙyama fiye da su, suka kuma sa ’yan’uwanki mata suka zama kamar masu adalci ta wurin dukan waɗannan abubuwa da kika aikata.
english: Samaria hasn’t committed half of your sins; but you have multiplied your abominations more than they, and have justified your sisters by all your abominations which you have done.

hausa: Saboda haka sai ya ce wa mutanen Fenuwel, “Sa’ad da na dawo da nasara zan rushe wannan hasumiya.”
english: He spoke also to the men of Penuel, saying, “When I come again in peace, I will break down this tower.”

hausa: Hayaƙi ya tashi daga kafan hancinsa; wuta mai ci daga bakinsa, garwashi wuta mai ci daga bakinsa.
english: Smoke went out of his nostrils. Consuming fire came out of his mouth. Coals were kindled by it.

hausa: Don haka, dole maza su ƙaunaci matansu kamar yadda suke ƙaunar jikunansu. Wanda yake ƙaunar matarsa, yana ƙaunar kansa ne.
english: Even so husbands also ought to love their own wives as their own bodies. He who loves his own wife loves himself.

hausa: gama shi ne Allahnmu mu mutanen makiyayansa ne, garke kuwa a ƙarƙashin kulawarsa. Yau, in kuka ji muryarsa,
english: for he is our God. We are the people of his pasture, and the sheep in his care. Today, oh that you would hear his voice!

hausa: Suna fakonsa, don su kama shi a kan wata magana da zai faɗa.
english: lying in wait for him, and seeking to catch him in something he might say, that they might accuse him.

hausa: allolin da suka ci kitsen hadayunsu suka kuma sha ruwan inabin hadayunsu? Ku sa su tashi su taimake ku mana! Bari su ba ku mafaka!
english: which ate the fat of their sacrifices, and drank the wine of their drink offering? Let them rise up and help you! Let them be your protection.

hausa: Yesu ya sāke tafiya bakin tafkin. Taro mai yawa ya zo wurinsa, sai ya fara koya musu.
english: He went out again by the seaside. All the multitude came to him, and he taught them.

hausa: Tabbatacce hannun Ubangiji bai kāsa yin ceto ba, kunnensa kuma bai kurmance da zai kāsa ji ba.
english: Behold, Yahweh’s hand is not shortened, that it can’t save; nor his ear dull, that it can’t hear.

hausa: Sai Yaƙub ya ce, “Na yarda! Ɗana Yusuf yana da rai har yanzu. Zan tafi in gan shi kafin in mutu.”
english: Israel said, “It is enough. Joseph my son is still alive. I will go and see him before I die.”

hausa: Sa’an nan zai miƙa kurciyoyi ko tattabarai, waɗanda mutumin zai iya,
english: He shall offer one of the turtledoves, or of the young pigeons, which ever he is able to afford,

hausa: muna ƙarfafa ku, muna ta’azantar da ku, muna kuma gargaɗe ku ku yi rayuwar da za tă cancanci Allah, wanda ya kira ku zuwa mulkinsa da kuma ɗaukakarsa.
english: to the end that you should walk worthily of God, who calls you into his own Kingdom and glory.

hausa: Sandan mutumin da na zaɓa zai yi toho, da haka zan raba kaina da gunagunin da Isra’ilawa suke yi.”
english: It shall happen that the rod of the man whom I shall choose shall bud. I will make the murmurings of the children of Israel, which they murmur against you, cease from me.”

hausa: Wani jarumin da ake kira Goliyat wanda ya fito daga Gat, ya fita daga sansanin Filistiyawa. Tsawonsa ya fi ƙafa tara.
english: A champion out of the camp of the Philistines named Goliath of Gath, whose height was six cubits and a span went out.

hausa: Dukan wannan ƙasa za tă zama kango, kuma waɗannan al’ummai za su bauta wa sarkin Babilon shekaru saba’in.
english: This whole land will be a desolation, and an astonishment; and these nations will serve the king of Babylon seventy years.

hausa: Ka ce musu, ‘Ku ji maganar Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka. Ga abin da Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka yana cewa domin kun ce “Yauwa” a kan wuri mai tsarkina sa’ad da aka ƙazantar da shi da kuma a kan ƙasar Isra’ila sa’ad da aka mai da ita kufai da lokacin da aka kai mutanen Yahuda bautar talala,
english: Tell the children of Ammon, ‘Hear the word of the Lord Yahweh! The Lord Yahweh says, “Because you said, ‘Aha!’ against my sanctuary when it was profaned, and against the land of Israel when it was made desolate, and against the house of Judah when they went into captivity,

hausa: Alheri da salama daga Allah Ubanmu da Ubangiji Yesu Kiristi, su kasance tare da ku.
english: Grace to you and peace from God the Father and our Lord Jesus Christ,

hausa: Ka ji daɗinka a cikin Ubangiji zai kuwa biya bukatun zuciyarka.
english: Also delight yourself in Yahweh, and he will give you the desires of your heart.

hausa: Zai kawo muku dukan cututtukan Masar da kuke tsoro, za su kuwa manne muku.
english: He will bring on you again all the diseases of Egypt, which you were afraid of; and they will cling to you.

hausa: Ka tuna da ni, ka yi mini alheri, ya Allah, saboda dukan abubuwan da na yi saboda waɗannan mutane.
english: Remember me, my God, for all the good that I have done for this people.

hausa: Lawiyawa ba su da rabo a cikinku, domin aikin firistocin da suke yi wa Ubangiji shi ne gādonsu. Gad, Ruben da rabin kabilar Manasse kuwa sun riga sun samu gādonsu a gabashin gefen Urdun, Musa bawan Ubangiji ya ba su.”
english: However, the Levites have no portion among you; for the priesthood of Yahweh is their inheritance. Gad, Reuben, and the half-tribe of Manasseh have received their inheritance east of the Jordan, which Moses the servant of Yahweh gave them.”

hausa: Ruhun Ubangiji zai sauko a kanka da iko, za ka kuma yi annabci tare da su. Za a canja ka ka zama dabam.
english: Then Yahweh’s Spirit will come mightily on you, then you will prophesy with them and will be turned into another man.

hausa: Na yi kira ga sunanka, ya Ubangiji, daga rami mai zurfi.
english: I called on your name, Yahweh, out of the lowest dungeon.

hausa: Don haka firist ya ba shi keɓaɓɓen burodi, tun da yake babu wani burodi a can sai dai burodin Kasancewa da aka cire daga gaban Ubangiji, aka sa burodi mai zafi a maimakon wanda aka cire a ranar.
english: So the priest gave him holy bread; for there was no bread there but the show bread that was taken from before Yahweh, to be replaced with hot bread in the day when it was taken away.

hausa: Za su manta da kunyar da suka sha da dukan rashin amincin da suka nuna mini sa’ad da suke zama lafiya a ƙasarsu inda ba wanda zai tsorata su.
english: They will forget their shame and all their trespasses by which they have trespassed against me, when they dwell securely in their land. No one will make them afraid

hausa: “Ga abin da Sennakerib sarkin Assuriya ya ce ga me kake dogara, har da ka dāge cikin Urushalima da aka yi mata kwanto?
english: Sennacherib king of Assyria says, “In whom do you trust, that you remain under siege in Jerusalem?

hausa: Duk wanda yake da umarnaina yana kuma yin biyayya da su, shi ne wanda yake ƙaunata. Wanda yake ƙaunata kuwa Ubana zai ƙaunace shi, ni ma zan ƙaunace shi, in kuma bayyana kaina gare shi.”
english: One who has my commandments and keeps them, that person is one who loves me. One who loves me will be loved by my Father, and I will love him, and will reveal myself to him.”

hausa: Amma na dogara a kan ƙaunarka marar ƙarewa; zuciyata tana farin ciki a cikin cetonka.
english: But I trust in your loving kindness. My heart rejoices in your salvation.

hausa: Ƙasar da na ba wa Ibrahim da Ishaku, zan kuma ba ka, zan kuma ba da wannan ƙasa ga zuriyarka a bayanka.”
english: The land which I gave to Abraham and Isaac, I will give it to you, and to your offspring after you I will give the land.”

hausa: Sa’an nan na ga babban farin kursiyi da kuma wannan da yake zama a kansa. Duniya da sararin sama kuwa suka ɓace daga gabansa, babu wuri kuwa dominsu.
english: I saw a great white throne and him who sat on it, from whose face the earth and the sky fled away. There was found no place for them.

hausa: Sa’ad da nake cikin damuwa, na nemi Ubangiji; da dare na miƙa hannuwa ba gajiya raina kuma ya ƙi yă ta’azantu.
english: In the day of my trouble I sought the Lord. My hand was stretched out in the night, and didn’t get tired. My soul refused to be comforted.

hausa: Sarkin, ba zai nemi dawakai da yawa wa kansa ba, ko yă sa mutane su koma Masar don su sami ƙarin dawakai ba, gama Ubangiji ya faɗa muku, “Ba za ku ƙara koma wancan hanya kuma ba.”
english: Only he shall not multiply horses to himself, nor cause the people to return to Egypt, to the end that he may multiply horses; because Yahweh has said to you, “You shall not go back that way again.”

hausa: Duk abincin da aka yarda a ci, wanda ya taɓa ruwa daga irin tukunyan nan zai zama marar tsabta, kuma duk ruwan da za a sha daga irin tukunyan nan ƙazantacce ne.
english: All food which may be eaten which is soaked in water shall be unclean. All drink that may be drunk in every such vessel shall be unclean.

hausa: Za su iya taimakon ’yan’uwansu cikin tafiyar da ayyuka a Tentin Sujada, amma su kansu ba za su yi aikin ba. Haka fa za ka ba wa Lawiyawa aikinsu.”
english: but shall assist their brothers in the Tent of Meeting, to perform the duty, and shall perform no service. This is how you shall have the Levites do their duties.”

hausa: Sai firist ya ce, “Takobin Goliyat Bafilistin nan wanda ka kashe a Kwarin Ela yana nan. An naɗe shi da ƙyallen aka ajiye a bayan Efod, in kana so, sai ka ɗauka. Ba wani takobi kuma sai wancan.” Dawuda ya ce, “Ba ni shi, ai, ba wani kamar sa.”
english: The priest said, “Behold, the sword of Goliath the Philistine, whom you killed in the valley of Elah, is here wrapped in a cloth behind the ephod. If you would like to take that, take it, for there is no other except that here.” David said, “There is none like that. Give it to me.”

hausa: Bari duk zuriyarsa su mutu, a shafe sunayensu daga tsara mai zuwa.
english: Let his posterity be cut off. In the generation following let their name be blotted out.

hausa: Kamar yadda iska take hura hayaƙi, bari yă hura su haka; kamar yadda kaki kan narke a gaban wuta, bari mugaye su hallaka a gaban Allah.
english: As smoke is driven away, so drive them away. As wax melts before the fire, so let the wicked perish at the presence of God.

hausa: Ubangiji kansa ya warwatsa su; ya daina duban su. Ba a ba firistoci girma, ba su ba dattawa gata.
english: Yahweh’s anger has scattered them. He will not pay attention to them any more. They didn’t respect the persons of the priests. They didn’t favor the elders.

hausa: Zai rufe ka da fikafikansa, a ƙarƙashin fikafikansa kuwa za ka sami mafaka; amincinsa zai zama maka garkuwa da katanga.
english: He will cover you with his feathers. Under his wings you will take refuge. His faithfulness is your shield and rampart.

hausa: Alherin Ubangijinmu Yesu Kiristi yă kasance tare da ku duka.
english: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.

hausa: Wanda ya kawo hadayarsa a rana ta farko shi ne Nashon ɗan Amminadab, shugaban mutanen Yahuda.
english: He who offered his offering the first day was Nahshon the son of Amminadab, of the tribe of Judah,

hausa: Lawiyawa ne za su yi aikin Tentin Sujada, su kuma ɗauki nauyin kowane laifin da aka aikata a wurin. Wannan za tă zama dawwammamiyar farilla ce daga yanzu har tsararraki masu zuwa. Ba za su sami gādo a cikin Isra’ilawa ba.
english: But the Levites shall do the service of the Tent of Meeting, and they shall bear their iniquity. It shall be a statute forever throughout your generations. Among the children of Israel, they shall have no inheritance.

hausa: Ba ana sayar da kanari biyar a kan kobo biyu ba? Duk da haka, Allah bai manta da ko ɗayansu ba.
english: “Aren’t five sparrows sold for two assaria coins? Not one of them is forgotten by God.

hausa: da kuma daga Yesu Kiristi, wanda yake amintaccen shaida, ɗan farin daga tashin matattu, da kuma mai mulkin sarakunan duniya. Gare shi wanda yake ƙaunarmu wanda kuma ya ’yantar da mu daga zunubanmu ta wurin jininsa,
english: and from Jesus Christ, the faithful witness, the firstborn of the dead, and the ruler of the kings of the earth. To him who loves us, and washed us from our sins by his blood—

hausa: Ya sa su yi bikin kowace shekara a ranaku goma sha huɗu da goma sha biyar na watan Adar
english: to enjoin them that they should keep the fourteenth and fifteenth days of the month Adar yearly,

hausa: Yehu ya huta tare da kakanninsa, aka binne shi a Samariya. Yehoyahaz kuma ya ci sarauta bayansa.
english: Jehu slept with his fathers; and they buried him in Samaria. Jehoahaz his son reigned in his place.

hausa: Na yi rantsuwa na kuma tabbatar da shi, cewa zan bi dokokinka masu adalci.
english: I have sworn, and have confirmed it, that I will obey your righteous ordinances.

hausa: Ya fafari Abner, bai juya dama ko hagu ba, yayinda yake fafararsa.
english: Asahel pursued Abner. He didn’t turn to the right hand or to the left from following Abner.

hausa: Ya yi abin da yake daidai a gaban Ubangiji, kamar dai yadda mahaifinsa Amaziya ya yi.
english: He did that which was right in Yahweh’s eyes, according to all that his father Amaziah had done.

hausa: Na tara wa kaina azurfa da zinariya, ina da ma’ajin sarakuna da yankuna. Na samo wa kaina mawaƙa mata da maza, da dukan irin matan da kowane namiji zai so.
english: I also gathered silver and gold for myself, and the treasure of kings and of the provinces. I got myself male and female singers, and the delights of the sons of men: musical instruments of all sorts.

hausa: daga Bamot kuma suka tafi kwarin da yake cikin Mowab inda ƙwanƙolin Fisga yake fuskantar hamada.
english: and from Bamoth to the valley that is in the field of Moab, to the top of Pisgah, which looks down on the desert.

hausa: “Ɗan mutum, gidan Isra’ila ta zama ƙwan maƙera a gare ni; dukansu tagulla ne, kuza, ƙarfe da darma da suka rage a tanderu. Su ƙwan maƙerar azurfa ne kawai.
english: “Son of man, the house of Israel has become dross to me. All of them are bronze, tin, iron, and lead in the middle of the furnace. They are the dross of silver.

hausa: Sai mamacin ya fito, hannuwansa da ƙafafunsa a daure da ƙyallayen lilin, fuskarsa kuwa an naɗe da mayafi. Yesu ya ce musu, “Ku tuɓe kayan bizo, ku bar shi yă tafi.”
english: He who was dead came out, bound hand and foot with wrappings, and his face was wrapped around with a cloth. Jesus said to them, “Free him, and let him go.”

hausa: A can ya kakkarya kibiyoyin wuta, garkuwoyi da takuban, makaman yaƙi. Sela
english: There he broke the flaming arrows of the bow, the shield, and the sword, and the weapons of war. Selah.

hausa: Sai ya ce, “Wanda irin garuruwa ke nan ka ba ni, ɗan’uwana?” Saboda haka ya kira su Ƙasar Kabul, sunan da suke da shi har wa yau.
english: He said, “What cities are these which you have given me, my brother?” He called them the land of Cabul to this day.

hausa: Ba ni da ’yanci ne? Ni ba manzo ba ne? Ni ban gan Yesu Ubangijinmu ba ne? Ba ku ne sakamakon aikina cikin Ubangiji ba?
english: Am I not free? Am I not an apostle? Haven’t I seen Jesus Christ, our Lord? Aren’t you my work in the Lord?

hausa: “ ‘Kada ka yi jima’i da matar ɗanka. Ita matar ɗanka ne; kada ka yi jima’i da ita.
english: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your daughter-in-law. She is your son’s wife. You shall not uncover her nakedness.

hausa: suna ƙoƙari su san lokaci da kuma yanayin da Ruhun Kiristi da yake cikinsu yana nunawa sa’ad da ya yi faɗi a kan wahalolin Kiristi da kuma ɗaukaka da za tă bi.
english: searching for who or what kind of time the Spirit of Christ which was in them pointed to when he predicted the sufferings of Christ and the glories that would follow them.

hausa: Don mai bi da kaɗe-kaɗe. Wani maskil ta Dawuda. Sa’ad da Doyeg mutumin Edom ya tafi wurin Shawulu ya ce masa, “Dawuda ya tafi gidan Ahimelek.” Me ya sa kake fariya game da mugunta, kai babban mutum? Me ya sa kake fariya dukan yini, kai da kake abin kunya a idanun Allah?
english: For the Chief Musician. A contemplation by David, when Doeg the Edomite came and told Saul, “David has come to Ahimelech’s house.” Why do you boast of mischief, mighty man? God’s loving kindness endures continually.

hausa: ’Ya’yan Nadab maza su ne, Seled da Affayim. Seled ya mutu babu yara.
english: The sons of Nadab: Seled and Appaim; but Seled died without children.

hausa: Ya amsa ya ce, “Ina gaya muku, ko da sun yi shiru, duwatsu za su fara kirari.”
english: He answered them, “I tell you that if these were silent, the stones would cry out.”

hausa: ba kuwa zai ba waninsu wani naman ’ya’yansa da yake ci ba. Gama dukan abin da ya rage masa ke nan saboda wahalar da abokan gābanku za su gasa muku a lokacin da ake kwanton wa dukan biranenku.
english: so that he will not give to any of them of the flesh of his children whom he will eat, because he has nothing left to him, in the siege and in the distress with which your enemy will distress you in all your gates.

hausa: Ubangiji zai kafa ku kamar mutanensa masu tsarki, kamar yadda ya yi alkawari da rantsuwa, in kun kiyaye umarnan Ubangiji Allahnku, kuka kuma yi tafiya a hanyoyinsa.
english: Yahweh will establish you for a holy people to himself, as he has sworn to you, if you shall keep the commandments of Yahweh your God, and walk in his ways.

hausa: “Mutane masu ganewa za su ce, masu hikima waɗanda suka ji ni za su ce mini,
english: Men of understanding will tell me, yes, every wise man who hears me:

hausa: Suka ɗinɗinke labule biyar a harhaɗe, suka kuma yi haka da sauran labule biyar ɗin.
english: He coupled five curtains to one another, and the other five curtains he coupled to one another.

hausa: Ubangiji ya ce wa Musa, “Ka ce wa Haruna, ‘Ka ɗauki sandanka, ka miƙa hannunka kan ruwan Masar, kan kogunansu da rafuffukansu da kududdufansu da kuma dukan tafkunansu, za su zama jini.’ Jini zai kasance ko’ina a Masar, har ma a cikin abubuwan ajiyar ruwansu da aka yi da itace da kuma dutse.”
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “Tell Aaron, ‘Take your rod, and stretch out your hand over the waters of Egypt, over their rivers, over their streams, and over their pools, and over all their ponds of water, that they may become blood. There will be blood throughout all the land of Egypt, both in vessels of wood and in vessels of stone.’”

hausa: amma har da ƙasar kan tudu ma, ko da yake jeji ne, ku je ku gyara shi, duk yă zama naku. Ko da yake Kan’aniyawa suna da kekunan yaƙi na ƙarfe, suna kuma da ƙarfi, duk da haka za ku kore su.”
english: but the hill country shall be yours. Although it is a forest, you shall cut it down, and it’s farthest extent shall be yours; for you shall drive out the Canaanites, though they have chariots of iron, and though they are strong.”

hausa: Amma Yahudawan da suke a Shusha suka taru a rana ta goma sha uku da ta sha huɗu, sa’an nan a rana ta goma sha biyar suka huta, suka kuma mai da ita ranar biki da ta farin ciki.
english: But the Jews who were in Susa assembled together on the thirteenth and on the fourteenth days of the month; and on the fifteenth day of that month, they rested, and made it a day of feasting and gladness.

hausa: Ka nuna hanya guda wadda takobi zai fāɗo wa Rabba ta Ammonawa ɗayan kuma da zai fāɗo a kan Yahuda da kuma Urushalima mai katanga.
english: You shall appoint a way for the sword to come to Rabbah of the children of Ammon, and to Judah in Jerusalem the fortified.

hausa: Ya kuma fitar da Isra’ila daga cikinsu Ƙaunarsa madawwamiya ce.
english: and brought out Israel from among them, for his loving kindness endures forever;

hausa: A wani lokaci, yayinda yake ci tare da su, ya ba su wannan umarni, “Kada ku bar Urushalima, amma ku jira kyautar da Ubana ya yi alkawari, wadda kuka ji na yi magana a kai.
english: Being assembled together with them, he commanded them, “Don’t depart from Jerusalem, but wait for the promise of the Father, which you heard from me.

hausa: Kwana shida kafin Bikin Ƙetarewa, sai Yesu ya iso Betani, inda Lazarus yake, wanda Yesu ya tā da daga matattu.
english: Then, six days before the Passover, Jesus came to Bethany, where Lazarus was, who had been dead, whom he raised from the dead.

hausa: Wajen mutum dubu arba’in shirye domin yaƙi, suka wuce a gaban Ubangiji zuwa filayen Yeriko.
english: About forty thousand men, ready and armed for war, passed over before Yahweh to battle, to the plains of Jericho.

hausa: Rago ba ya gashin abin da ya kama daga farauta, amma mai aiki tuƙuru yakan ɗauki mallakarsa da muhimmanci.
english: The slothful man doesn’t roast his game, but the possessions of diligent men are prized.

hausa: Sai almajiransa suka tuna cewa a rubuce yake, “Himma saboda gidanka zai cinye ni.”
english: His disciples remembered that it was written, “Zeal for your house will eat me up.”

hausa: Sai Yaƙub ya gangara zuwa Masar, inda shi da kuma kakanninmu suka mutu.
english: Jacob went down into Egypt and he died, himself and our fathers;

hausa: Ɗaukakar Ubangiji ta shiga haikali ta ƙofar da take fuskantar gabas.
english: Yahweh’s glory came into the house by the way of the gate which faces toward the east.

hausa: Sai ya ce musu, “Ashe, ku marasa azanci ne, masu nauyin zuciyar gaskata, da dukan abin da annabawa suka faɗa!
english: He said to them, “Foolish people, and slow of heart to believe in all that the prophets have spoken!

hausa: Sai Musa ya rubuta duk abin da Ubangiji ya faɗa. Ya tashi kashegari da sassafe ya gina bagade kusa da dutsen, ya aza al’amudai goma sha biyu bisa ga kabilu goma sha biyu na Isra’ila.
english: Moses wrote all Yahweh’s words, then rose up early in the morning and built an altar at the base of the mountain, with twelve pillars for the twelve tribes of Israel.

hausa: Sai sarki ya ce wa matar, “Kada ki ɓoye mini kome daga abin da zan tambaye ki.” Matar ta ce, “Bari ranka yă daɗe sarki yă yi tambaya.”
english: Then the king answered the woman, “Please don’t hide anything from me that I ask you.” The woman said, “Let my lord the king now speak.”

hausa: Ammiyel ɗan Gemalli, daga kabilar Dan;
english: Of the tribe of Dan, Ammiel the son of Gemalli.

hausa: Ga abin da Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka yana cewa, “Waɗannan su ne iyakokin da za ku raba ƙasar gādo cikin kabilan Isra’ila goma sha biyu, da rabo biyu don Yusuf.
english: The Lord Yahweh says: “This shall be the border by which you shall divide the land for inheritance according to the twelve tribes of Israel. Joseph shall have two portions.

hausa: Sai Allah ya ce masa, “Ni ne Allah Maɗaukaki, ka yi ta haihuwa, ka kuma riɓaɓɓanya. Al’umma da tarin al’ummai za su fito daga gare ka, sarakuna kuma za su fito daga jikinka.
english: God said to him, “I am God Almighty. Be fruitful and multiply. A nation and a company of nations will be from you, and kings will come out of your body.

hausa: Ko da yake ni kamar salkar ruwan inabi ne a cikin hayaƙi, ban manta da ƙa’idodinka ba.
english: For I have become like a wineskin in the smoke. I don’t forget your statutes.

hausa: “Ga sunayensu. “Kaleb ɗan Yefunne, daga kabilar Yahuda;
english: These are the names of the men: Of the tribe of Judah, Caleb the son of Jephunneh.

hausa: duk mutumin da ya taɓa kowane irin abu haka, zai ƙazantu har yamma, ba kuwa zai ci daga cikin tsarkakakkun abubuwan nan ba, sai ya yi wanka tukuna.
english: the person that touches any such shall be unclean until the evening, and shall not eat of the holy things unless he bathes his body in water.

hausa: Saboda ni, za a ja ku zuwa gaban gwamnoni da gaban sarakuna domin ku ba da shaida a gabansu, da kuma ga Al’ummai.
english: Yes, and you will be brought before governors and kings for my sake, for a testimony to them and to the nations.

hausa: Ka sa ɗan’uwanka yă biya ka bashin da kake binsa ba dalili; ka ƙwace wa mutanen rigunansu ka bar su tsirara.
english: For you have taken pledges from your brother for nothing, and stripped the naked of their clothing.

hausa: Da jin kukansu, dukan Isra’ilawa da suke kewaye da su suka gudu, suna ihu, “Ƙasa za tă haɗiye mu, mu ma!”
english: All Israel that were around them fled at their cry; for they said, “Lest the earth swallow us up!”

hausa: Da Yerobowam ya fita Urushalima, sai annabi Ahiya, mutumin Shilo ya tarar da shi a hanya. Lokacin kuwa Ahiya yana saye da sabuwar riga, ba kowa a filin sai su biyu kaɗai.
english: At that time, when Jeroboam went out of Jerusalem, the prophet Ahijah the Shilonite found him on the way. Now Ahijah had clad himself with a new garment; and the two of them were alone in the field.

hausa: Kada mu gwada Kiristi yadda waɗansunsu suka yi, har macizai suka kakkashe su.
english: Let’s not test Christ, as some of them tested, and perished by the serpents.

hausa: Saurayi mai shekara tsakanin biyar da ashirin, za a biya azurfa ashirin, yarinya kuma azurfa goma.
english: If the person is from five years old to twenty years old, then your valuation shall be for a male twenty shekels, and for a female ten shekels.

hausa: In ka nuna wa ’yan’uwa waɗannan abubuwa, za ka zama mai hidima mai kyau na Kiristi Yesu, wanda aka goya cikin gaskiyar bangaskiya da kuma koyarwa mai kyau wadda ka bi.
english: If you instruct the brothers of these things, you will be a good servant of Christ Jesus, nourished in the words of the faith and of the good doctrine which you have followed.

hausa: “Ina gaya muku, wannan mutum ne, ba ɗayan ba, ya koma gida baratacce, babu laifi a gaban Allah. Gama duk wanda ya ɗaukaka kansa, za a ƙasƙantar da shi. Wanda kuma ya ƙasƙantar da kansa, za a ɗaukaka shi.”
english: I tell you, this man went down to his house justified rather than the other; for everyone who exalts himself will be humbled, but he who humbles himself will be exalted.”

hausa: Suka tā da murya da ƙarfi suna cewa, “Ceto na Allahnmu ne, wanda yake zaune a bisan kursiyi, da kuma na Ɗan Ragon.”
english: They cried with a loud voice, saying, “Salvation be to our God, who sits on the throne, and to the Lamb!”

hausa: Yesu ya je ya taɓa akwatin gawar, sai masu ɗaukarsa suka tsaya cik. Sai ya ce, “Saurayi, na ce maka, tashi!”
english: He came near and touched the coffin, and the bearers stood still. He said, “Young man, I tell you, arise!”

hausa: Ba za su ƙara ƙazantar da kansu da gumaka da mugayen siffofi ko kuma da wani daga laifofinsu ba, gama zan cece su daga dukan zunubinsu na ridda, zan kuma tsarkake su. Za su zama mutanena, ni kuma zan zama Allahnsu.
english: They won’t defile themselves any more with their idols, nor with their detestable things, nor with any of their transgressions; but I will save them out of all their dwelling places in which they have sinned, and will cleanse them. So they will be my people, and I will be their God.

hausa: Suka ce masa, “Ka zo ka zama mana shugaba, don mu yaƙi Ammonawa.”
english: They said to Jephthah, “Come and be our chief, that we may fight with the children of Ammon.”

hausa: Wace daidaituwa ce tsakanin Kiristi da Iblis? Me ya haɗa mai bi da marar bi?
english: What agreement does Christ have with Belial? Or what portion does a believer have with an unbeliever?

hausa: Suna da dawakai guda 736, alfadarai 245,
english: Their horses were seven hundred thirty-six; their mules, two hundred forty-five;

hausa: Aka yi wa Ibrahim da ɗansa Ishmayel kaciya a rana ɗaya.
english: In the same day both Abraham and Ishmael, his son, were circumcised.

hausa: Yesu ya sāke ɗibiya hannuwansa a idanun mutumin, sai idanunsa suka buɗe, ya sami gani, ya kuma ga kome sarai.
english: Then again he laid his hands on his eyes. He looked intently, and was restored, and saw everyone clearly.

hausa: Mai albarka ne wanda ya saurare ni; yana tsaro kullum a ƙofofina, yana jira a ƙofar shigata.
english: Blessed is the man who hears me, watching daily at my gates, waiting at my door posts.

hausa: A gaban ɗakunan akwai hanya a can ciki mai fāɗin kamu goma, tsawonta kuma kamu ɗari. Ƙofofinsu suna wajen arewa.
english: Before the rooms was a walk of ten cubits’ width inward, a way of one cubit; and their doors were toward the north.

hausa: “Ina fushi da makiyayan, zan kuma hukunta shugabannin; gama Ubangiji Maɗaukaki zai lura da garkensa, wato, gidan Yahuda, zai kuma sa su zama kamar doki mai fariya cikin yaƙi.
english: My anger is kindled against the shepherds, and I will punish the male goats, for Yahweh of Armies has visited his flock, the house of Judah, and will make them as his majestic horse in the battle.

hausa: Amma na san cewa kai da fadawanka, har wa yau ba ku ji tsoron Ubangiji Allah ba tukuna.”
english: But as for you and your servants, I know that you don’t yet fear Yahweh God.”

hausa: ɗan Amzi, ɗan Bani, ɗan Shemer,
english: the son of Amzi, the son of Bani, the son of Shemer,

hausa: A ranan nan, za ku roƙa a cikin sunana. Ban ce zan roƙi Uba a madadinku ba.
english: In that day you will ask in my name; and I don’t say to you that I will pray to the Father for you,

hausa: ku faɗa wa firist da yake aiki a lokacin, “Na sakankance yau ga Ubangiji Allahnka, cewa na zo ƙasar da Ubangiji ya rantse zai ba wa kakanninmu.”
english: You shall come to the priest who shall be in those days, and tell him, “I profess today to Yahweh your God, that I have come to the land which Yahweh swore to our fathers to give us.”

hausa: suka hallaka birnin, da sarkinta da ƙauyukanta, suka karkashe dukan mazaunan wurin, ba su bar wani da rai ba. Suka yi wa Debir da sarkinta yadda suka yi wa Libna da sarkinta da kuma Hebron.
english: He took it, with its king and all its cities. They struck them with the edge of the sword, and utterly destroyed all the souls who were in it. He left no one remaining. As he had done to Hebron, so he did to Debir, and to its king; as he had done also to Libnah, and to its king.

hausa: Sa’ad da Mefiboshet ɗan Yonatan, ɗan Shawulu, ya zo wurin Dawuda, sai ya rusuna har ƙasa ya yi gaisuwar bangirma. Dawuda ya ce, “Mefiboshet!” Shi kuwa ya amsa ya ce, “Ranka yă daɗe, ga ni, bawanka.”
english: Mephibosheth, the son of Jonathan, the son of Saul, came to David, fell on his face, and showed respect. David said, “Mephibosheth?” He answered, “Behold, your servant!”

hausa: Shaidu marasa imani sun fito; suna mini tambaya a kan abubuwan da ban san kome a kai ba.
english: Unrighteous witnesses rise up. They ask me about things that I don’t know about.

hausa: Yayinda suke fitar da kuɗin da aka kai cikin haikalin Ubangiji, sai Hilkiya firist ya sami Littafin Dokar Ubangiji da aka bayar ta wurin Musa.
english: When they brought out the money that was brought into Yahweh’s house, Hilkiah the priest found the book of Yahweh’s law given by Moses.

hausa: In maɓulɓulanku suka cika suna malala har waje, rafuffukan ruwanku a dandalin jama’a?
english: Should your springs overflow in the streets, streams of water in the public squares?

hausa: Ga shi, Ubangiji yana zuwa da wuta, kuma kekunan yaƙinsa suna kama da guguwa; zai sauko da fushinsa da zafi, tsawatawarsa kuma da harsunan wuta.
english: For, behold, Yahweh will come with fire, and his chariots will be like the whirlwind; to give his anger with fierceness, and his rebuke with flames of fire.

hausa: Amma yanzu Adoniya ya zama sarki, kai kuwa ranka yă daɗe sarki, ba ka san wani abu game da shi ba.
english: Now, behold, Adonijah reigns; and you, my lord the king, don’t know it.

hausa: Amma ban yi amfani da ko ɗaya daga cikin waɗannan ’yancin ba. Ba kuma ina rubuta muku wannan da fata za ku yi mini waɗannan abubuwa ba ne. Gwamma in mutu, da wani yă hana ni wannan abin taƙama.
english: But I have used none of these things, and I don’t write these things that it may be done so in my case; for I would rather die, than that anyone should make my boasting void.

hausa: Ubangiji ya ce mini, “Duba, na fara ba da Sihon da ƙasarsa gare ku. Yanzu ku fara cinta, ku kuma mallake ƙasarsa.”
english: Yahweh said to me, “Behold, I have begun to deliver up Sihon and his land before you. Begin to possess, that you may inherit his land.”

hausa: Zuciyarsa tana da kāriya, ba zai ji tsoro ba; a ƙarshe zai zama mai nasara a kan maƙiyansa.
english: His heart is established. He will not be afraid in the end when he sees his adversaries.

hausa: Sa’ad da suka sa madogarar ƙofarsu kusa da madogarar ƙofata, da katanga kawai a tsakanina da su, sun ɓata sunana mai tsarki ta wurin ayyukansu masu banƙyama. Saboda haka na hallaka su cikin fushina.
english: in their setting of their threshold by my threshold and their door post beside my door post. There was a wall between me and them; and they have defiled my holy name by their abominations which they have committed. Therefore I have consumed them in my anger.

hausa: Ya cece ni daga abokin gābana mai ƙarfi, daga abokan gābana, waɗanda suka fi ƙarfina.
english: He delivered me from my strong enemy, from those who hated me; for they were too mighty for me.

hausa: Duk da haka Shawulu ya yi ta ƙara ƙarfi, ya kuma rikitar da Yahudawan da suke zaune a Damaskus, ta wurin tabbatar musu cewa, Yesu shi ne Kiristi.
english: But Saul increased more in strength, and confounded the Jews who lived at Damascus, proving that this is the Christ.

hausa: Me ya sa ba ka bi umarnin Ubangiji ba? Me ya sa ka sa hannu a ganima, ka kuma yi mugun abu a gaban Ubangiji?”
english: Why then didn’t you obey Yahweh’s voice, but took the plunder, and did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight?”

hausa: Game da sauran ayyukan mulkin Ela, da dukan abin da ya yi, duk a rubuce suke a cikin littafin tarihin sarakunan Isra’ila.
english: Now the rest of the acts of Elah, and all that he did, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

hausa: Gama duk wanda ya ɗaukaka kansa, za a ƙasƙantar da shi. Shi wanda kuma ya ƙasƙantar da kansa, za a ɗaukaka shi.”
english: For everyone who exalts himself will be humbled, and whoever humbles himself will be exalted.”

hausa: Mikahiya ya amsa, “Za ka gane a ranar da ka je ka ɓuya a ciki cikin ɗaki.”
english: Micaiah said, “Behold, you will see on that day when you go into an inner room to hide yourself.”

hausa: Suna ciyar da kansu a kan zunuban mutanena suna kuma haɗamar muguntarsu.
english: They feed on the sin of my people, and set their heart on their iniquity.

hausa: Ina faɗa muku wannan ne don kada wani yă ruɗe ku da daɗin baki.
english: Now I say this that no one may delude you with persuasiveness of speech.

hausa: Ku gwada ku gani cewa Ubangiji yana da kyau; mai albarka ne mutumin da yake neman mafaka a gare shi.
english: Oh taste and see that Yahweh is good. Blessed is the man who takes refuge in him.

hausa: Ku zauna a bukkoki kwana bakwai. Dukan ’yan ƙasa haifaffun Isra’ilawa, za su zauna a bukkoki
english: You shall dwell in temporary shelters for seven days. All who are native-born in Israel shall dwell in temporary shelters,

hausa: Sa’an nan Ubangiji ya buɗe idanun Bala’am, ya kuwa ga mala’ikan Ubangiji tsaye a hanya da takobi a zāre. Sai ya sunkuyar da kansa, ya fāɗi rubda ciki.
english: Then Yahweh opened the eyes of Balaam, and he saw Yahweh’s angel standing in the way, with his sword drawn in his hand; and he bowed his head, and fell on his face.

hausa: Ya ce wa Haruna, “Mene ne waɗannan mutane suka yi maka da ka kai su ga wannan zunubi mai girma?”
english: Moses said to Aaron, “What did these people do to you, that you have brought a great sin on them?”

hausa: Lokacin da mutane suka ga al’amudin girgije a tsaye a ƙofar tentin, sai duk su miƙe tsaye su yi sujada, kowa a ƙofar tentinsa.
english: All the people saw the pillar of cloud stand at the door of the Tent, and all the people rose up and worshiped, everyone at their tent door.

hausa: “Ina a birnin Yoffa ina addu’a, sai ga wahayi ya zo mini. Na ga ana sauko da wani abu kamar babban mayafi daga sama ta kusurwansa huɗu, ya kuma sauko inda nake.
english: “I was in the city of Joppa praying, and in a trance I saw a vision: a certain container descending, like it was a great sheet let down from heaven by four corners. It came as far as me.

hausa: Ubangiji kuwa zai kiyaye alkawarinsa gare ni da ya ce, ‘In zuriyarka suka lura da yadda suke rayuwa, in kuma suka yi tafiya da aminci a gabana da dukan zuciyarsu, da kuma dukan ransu, ba za ka kāsa samun mutum a kujerar sarautar Isra’ila ba.’
english: Then Yahweh may establish his word which he spoke concerning me, saying, ‘If your children are careful of their way, to walk before me in truth with all their heart and with all their soul, there shall not fail you,’ he said, ‘a man on the throne of Israel.’

hausa: Ya ce, “In kai Ɗan Allah ne, yi tsalle ka sauka ƙasa. Gama a rubuce yake, “ ‘Zai umarci mala’ikunsa game da kai, za su tallafe ka da hannuwansu, don kada ka buga ƙafarka a kan dutse.’”
english: and said to him, “If you are the Son of God, throw yourself down, for it is written, ‘He will command his angels concerning you,’ and, ‘On their hands they will bear you up, so that you don’t dash your foot against a stone.’”

hausa: Za ka ci gaba a kan mutanena Isra’ila kamar yadda girgijen yakan rufe ƙasa. A kwanaki masu zuwa, ya Gog, zan kawo ka, ka yi yaƙi da ƙasata, domin al’ummai su san ni sa’ad da na nuna kaina mai tsarki ta wurinka a gabansu.
english: You will come up against my people Israel as a cloud to cover the land. It will happen in the latter days that I will bring you against my land, that the nations may know me when I am sanctified in you, Gog, before their eyes.”

hausa: Sa’an nan suka gaskata alkawarinsa suka kuma rera yabonsa.
english: Then they believed his words. They sang his praise.

hausa: Na kwanta a faɗake; na zama kamar tsuntsun da yake shi kaɗai a kan rufin ɗaki.
english: I watch, and have become like a sparrow that is alone on the housetop.

hausa: Ku bar wannan hanya, ku tashi daga wannan hanya, ku kuma daina kalubalantarmu da Mai Tsarkin nan na Isra’ila!”
english: Get out of the way. Turn away from the path. Cause the Holy One of Israel to cease from before us.”

hausa: Ka riƙe ni za a kuma cece ni; kullayaumi zan ɗauka ƙa’idodinka da muhimmanci.
english: Hold me up, and I will be safe, and will have respect for your statutes continually.

hausa: Yarinyar da take bakin ƙofar ta ce wa Bitrus, “Kai ba ɗaya ne daga cikin almajiran mutumin nan ba ne?” Bitrus ya amsa ya ce, “A’a, ba na ciki.”
english: Then the maid who kept the door said to Peter, “Are you also one of this man’s disciples?” He said, “I am not.”

hausa: Sai aka ba wa kowannensu farin riga, aka kuma faɗa musu su ɗan jira kaɗan sai an cika adadin abokansu masu hidima da kuma ’yan’uwansu waɗanda za a kashe kamar yadda su ma aka kashe su.
english: A long white robe was given to each of them. They were told that they should rest yet for a while, until their fellow servants and their brothers, who would also be killed even as they were, should complete their course.

hausa: Sai sarki da dukan mutanen suka miƙa hadayu a gaban Ubangiji.
english: Then the king and all the people offered sacrifices before Yahweh.

hausa: Ibrahim da Saratu dai sun riga sun tsufa sosai. Saratu kuma ta wuce shekarun haihuwa.
english: Now Abraham and Sarah were old, well advanced in age. Sarah had passed the age of childbearing.

hausa: Bai bar kowa yă danne su ba; saboda su, ya tsawata wa sarakuna,
english: He allowed no one to do them wrong. Yes, he reproved kings for their sakes,

hausa: ta wurin ikon alamu da ayyukan banmamaki, da kuma ikon Ruhun Allah. Ta haka daga Urushalima har yă zuwa kewayen Illirikum, na yi wa’azin bisharar Kiristi.
english: in the power of signs and wonders, in the power of God’s Spirit; so that from Jerusalem and around as far as to Illyricum, I have fully preached the Good News of Christ;

hausa: Abincin da aka samu ta hanyar zamba yakan zama da daɗi, amma mutum zai ƙarasa da baki cike da yashi.
english: Fraudulent food is sweet to a man, but afterwards his mouth is filled with gravel.

hausa: Ba ku ji ko balle ku gane ba; tun da kunnenku bai buɗu ba. Tabbatacce na san yadda kun zama masu tayarwa; an kira ku ’yan tawaye daga haihuwa.
english: Yes, you didn’t hear. Yes, you didn’t know. Yes, from of old your ear was not opened, for I knew that you dealt very treacherously, and were called a transgressor from the womb.

hausa: Gama shekaru dubu a gabanka kamar kwana ɗaya ne da ya wuce, ko sa’a guda na dare.
english: For a thousand years in your sight are just like yesterday when it is past, like a watch in the night.

hausa: “’Ya’yan Haruna, firistoci ne, za su busa kakaki. Wannan za tă zama dawwammamiyar farilla gare ku da kuma tsararraki masu zuwa.
english: “The sons of Aaron, the priests, shall blow the trumpets. This shall be to you for a statute forever throughout your generations.

hausa: “ ‘Je ka wurin mutanen nan ka ce, “Za ku yi ta ji amma ba za ku fahimta ba; za ku yi ta dubawa, amma ba za ku gani ba.”
english: saying, ‘Go to this people and say, in hearing, you will hear, but will in no way understand. In seeing, you will see, but will in no way perceive.

hausa: Dawuda a lokacin ya riga ya auri Ahinowam daga Yezireyel, dukansu suka zama matansa.
english: David also took Ahinoam of Jezreel; and they both became his wives.

hausa: Da hannunka ka kori al’ummai ka kuma dasa kakanninmu; ka ragargaza mutanen ka kuma sa kakanninmu suka haɓaka.
english: You drove out the nations with your hand, but you planted them. You afflicted the peoples, but you spread them abroad.

hausa: Sai dattawan da kuma dukan waɗanda suke a ƙofar suka ce, “Mu shaidu ne. Bari Ubangiji yă sa macen da take zuwa cikin gidanka ta zama kamar Rahila da Liyatu, waɗanda tare suka gina gidan Isra’ila. Bari ka sami martaba a cikin Efrata ka kuma zama sananne cikin Betlehem.
english: All the people who were in the gate, and the elders, said, “We are witnesses. May Yahweh make the woman who has come into your house like Rachel and like Leah, which both built the house of Israel; and treat you worthily in Ephrathah, and be famous in Bethlehem.

hausa: Suka nemi taimako, amma babu wanda zai cece su, suka yi kira ga Ubangiji, amma ba a amsa musu ba.
english: They looked, but there was no one to save; even to Yahweh, but he didn’t answer them.

hausa: Har yaushe, ya ku mutane za ku mai da ɗaukakata abin kunya? Har yaushe za ku ƙaunaci ruɗu ku nemi allolin ƙarya? Sela
english: You sons of men, how long shall my glory be turned into dishonor? Will you love vanity and seek after falsehood? Selah.

hausa: “Gobe war haka zan aiko maka da wani mutum daga ƙasar Benyamin. Ka keɓe shi shugaban mutanena Isra’ila. Shi zai cece mutanena daga hannun Filistiyawa. Na ga azabar mutanena gama kukansu ya hauro wurina.”
english: “Tomorrow about this time I will send you a man out of the land of Benjamin, and you shall anoint him to be prince over my people Israel. He will save my people out of the hand of the Philistines; for I have looked upon my people, because their cry has come to me.”

hausa: Amma kashegari, rana ta biyu ga wata, kujeran Dawuda kuma ba kowa, sai Shawulu ya ce wa ɗansa Yonatan, “Me ya sa ɗan Yesse bai zo cin abinci, jiya da yau ba?”
english: On the next day after the new moon, the second day, David’s place was empty. Saul said to Jonathan his son, “Why didn’t the son of Jesse come to eat, either yesterday, or today?”

hausa: tufafi masu kyau, da manyan rigunansu, da mayafansu, da jakar kuɗinsu
english: the fine robes, the capes, the cloaks, the purses,

hausa: Sai waɗansu sojoji suka tambaye shi, “Mu fa? Me ya kamata mu yi?” Sai ya amsa ya ce, “Kada ku ƙwace kuɗin mutane, kada kuma ku yi shaidar ƙarya. Ku yi haƙuri da abin da ake biyanku.”
english: Soldiers also asked him, saying, “What about us? What must we do?” He said to them, “Extort from no one by violence, neither accuse anyone wrongfully. Be content with your wages.”

hausa: Saye da rigunan sarakuna, sarki Isra’ila da Yehoshafat sarkin Yahuda suna zaune a kan kujerunsu na mulki a masussuka ta ƙofar shigar Samariya, tare da dukan annabawa suna ta annabci a gabansu.
english: Now the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat the king of Judah each sat on his throne, arrayed in their robes, and they were sitting in an open place at the entrance of the gate of Samaria; and all the prophets were prophesying before them.

hausa: Ya ce, “Kada ku firgita. Kuna neman Yesu Banazare wanda aka gicciye ne. Ya tashi! Ba ya nan. Ku dubi inda aka kwantar da shi.
english: He said to them, “Don’t be amazed. You seek Jesus, the Nazarene, who has been crucified. He has risen! He is not here. See the place where they laid him!

hausa: Na duba, sai na ga kamannin kursiyin saffaya a kan sararin da yake a bisa kawunan kerubobi.
english: Then I looked, and see, in the expanse that was over the head of the cherubim there appeared above them as it were a sapphire stone, as the appearance of the likeness of a throne.

hausa: A cikin ƙofar gabas akwai ɗakuna uku a kowane gefe na hanyar shiga; dukan ukun girmansu ɗaya, bangayen da suke tsakani a kowane gefe girmansu ɗaya ne.
english: The side rooms of the gate eastward were three on this side, and three on that side. The three of them were of one measure. The posts had one measure on this side and on that side.

hausa: Yayinda Irmiya yana a tsare a sansanin matsara, sai maganar Ubangiji ta zo masa sau na biyu cewa,
english: Moreover Yahweh’s word came to Jeremiah the second time, while he was still locked up in the court of the guard, saying,

hausa: Wanda ya karɓi irin da ya fāɗi cikin ƙaya kuwa, shi ne mutumin da yakan ji maganar, sai dai damuwoyin rayuwan nan da jarrabar arzikin duniya sukan shaƙe shi, yă sa maganar ta kāsa amfani.
english: What was sown among the thorns, this is he who hears the word, but the cares of this age and the deceitfulness of riches choke the word, and he becomes unfruitful.

hausa: Amma saboda sunana na yi abin da zai kiyaye shi daga ƙazantuwa a idanun al’umman da a idonsu na fisshe su.
english: But I worked for my name’s sake, that it should not be profaned in the sight of the nations, in whose sight I brought them out.

hausa: suka kuma ce wa Yesu, “Malam, an kama wannan mace tana zina.
english: they told him, “Teacher, we found this woman in adultery, in the very act.

hausa: Da safe sa’ad da mutanen garin suka tashi, sai suka tarar an rushe bagaden Ba’al, tare da ginshiƙin Ashera da yake kusa da shi, duk an sare, bijimi na biyu kuma aka miƙa hadaya a kan sabon bagaden!
english: When the men of the city arose early in the morning, behold, the altar of Baal was broken down, and the Asherah was cut down that was by it, and the second bull was offered on the altar that was built.

hausa: Muddin ina raye, in ji Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka, zan yi mulki a kanku da hannu mai iko da kuma hannu mai ƙarfi da kuma fushi.
english: As I live,” says the Lord Yahweh, “surely with a mighty hand, with an outstretched arm, and with wrath poured out, I will be king over you.

hausa: Sa’an nan Mika ya naɗa Balawen, saurayin kuwa ya zama masa firist ya kuma zauna a gidansa.
english: Micah consecrated the Levite, and the young man became his priest, and was in the house of Micah.

hausa: Ina rubuta muku waɗannan abubuwa ne game da waɗanda suke ƙoƙari su sa ku kauce.
english: These things I have written to you concerning those who would lead you astray.

hausa: kuma wannan dutsen da na kafa al’amudi, zai zama gidan Allah, kuma dukan abin da ka ba ni zan ba ka kashi ɗaya bisa goma.”
english: then this stone, which I have set up for a pillar, will be God’s house. Of all that you will give me I will surely give a tenth to you.”

hausa: Yabez ya yi kuka ga Allah na Isra’ila ya ce, “Ka yi mini albarka ka fadada yankina! Bari hannunka yă kasance tare da ni, yă kuma kiyaye ni daga abin da zai cuce ni, don kada in shiga wahala.” Sai Allah ya ji roƙonsa.
english: Jabez called on the God of Israel, saying, “Oh that you would bless me indeed, and enlarge my border! May your hand be with me, and may you keep me from evil, that I may not cause pain!” God granted him that which he requested.

hausa: Dukan waɗannan abubuwa da Solomon ya yi suna da tsada ƙwarai har suka kai nauyin tagullar da ya fi misali.
english: Thus Solomon made all these vessels in great abundance, so that the weight of the bronze could not be determined.

hausa: sai Laban ya ce masa, “Don kawai kai dangina ne na kusa, sai kawai ka yi mini aiki a banza? Faɗa mini abin da albashinka zai zama.”
english: Laban said to Jacob, “Because you are my relative, should you therefore serve me for nothing? Tell me, what will your wages be?”

hausa: Isra’ila kuringa ce mai yaɗuwa; ya fitar da ’ya’ya wa kansa. Yayinda ’ya’yan suka ƙaru, ya gina ƙarin bagadai; da ƙasarsa ta wadata, ya yi wa keɓaɓɓun duwatsu ado.
english: Israel is a luxuriant vine that produces his fruit. According to the abundance of his fruit he has multiplied his altars. As their land has prospered, they have adorned their sacred stones.

hausa: Yonatan ya ce wa Adoniya, “A ina! Ranka yă daɗe, Sarkinmu Dawuda ya naɗa Solomon sarki.
english: Jonathan answered Adonijah, “Most certainly our lord King David has made Solomon king.

hausa: Amma sa’ad da suka zo kan Yesu suka tarar ya riga ya mutu, ba su karya ƙafafunsa ba.
english: but when they came to Jesus and saw that he was already dead, they didn’t break his legs.

hausa: Sai Amma Allah ya juya musu baya ya kuma ba da su ga bautar abubuwan da suke a sararin sama. Wannan ya yi daidai da abin da yake a rubuce a cikin littafin annabawa cewa, “ ‘Kun kawo mini hadayu da sadakoki shekaru arba’in cikin, hamada, ya gidan Isra’ila?
english: But God turned away and gave them up to serve the army of the sky, as it is written in the book of the prophets, ‘Did you offer to me slain animals and sacrifices forty years in the wilderness, O house of Israel?

hausa: Mutanen Arfad da Helek sun yi tsaron katangar a kowace gefe; mutanen Gammad su ne a hasumiyoyinki. Sun rataye garkuwoyinsu kewaye da katangarki; sun sa kyanki ya zama cikakke.
english: The men of Arvad with your army were on your walls all around, and valiant men were in your towers. They hung their shields on your walls all around. They have perfected your beauty.

hausa: Yaƙub ya ce masa, “Ka dai san yadda na yi maka aiki da kuma yadda dabbobinka suka yi yawa a hannuna.
english: Jacob said to him, “You know how I have served you, and how your livestock have fared with me.

hausa: Suka yi ƙyallen maƙalawa a ƙirji, aikin gwani. Suka yi shi kamar efod, na zinariya, da na shuɗi, da na shunayya, da na jan zare, da kuma na lallausan lilin.
english: He made the breastplate, the work of a skillful workman, like the work of the ephod: of gold, of blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen.

hausa: Kabilar Manasse ce za tă zama ta biye. Shugabansu shi ne Gamaliyel ɗan Fedazur.
