english: “Next to him shall be the tribe of Manasseh. The prince of the children of Manasseh shall be Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur.

hausa: Yesu kuwa ya san tunaninsu, sai ya ce musu, “Duk mulkin da yake gāba da kansa, zai lalace, kuma gidan da yake gaba da kansa zai rushe.
english: But he, knowing their thoughts, said to them, “Every kingdom divided against itself is brought to desolation. A house divided against itself falls.

hausa: Yanzu, ya sarki, ka gangaro, ka zo a duk lokacin da ka ga ya yi maka, ka zo mu kuma hakkinmu ne mu bashe shi a hannun sarki.”
english: Now therefore, O king, come down. According to all the desire of your soul to come down; and our part will be to deliver him up into the king’s hand.”

hausa: Waɗansu shugabannin iyalai sun ba da darik 20,000 na zinariya da mina 2,200 na azurfa don aiki.
english: Some of the heads of fathers’ households gave into the treasury of the work twenty thousand darics of gold, and two thousand two hundred minas of silver.

hausa: Amma matattunka za su rayu; jikunansu za su tashi. Ku da kuke zama a ƙura, ku farka ku kuma yi sowa don farin ciki. Raɓarka kamar raɓar safiya ce; duniya za tă haifi matattunta.
english: Your dead shall live. Their dead bodies shall arise. Awake and sing, you who dwell in the dust; for your dew is like the dew of herbs, and the earth will cast out the departed spirits.

hausa: Sa’ad da kayan cinikinki suka tafi ƙasashen hayi, kin gamsar da al’ummai masu yawa; da dukiyarki masu yawa da kuma kayan cinikinki kin azurtar da sarakunan duniya.
english: When your wares came from the seas, you filled many peoples. You enriched the kings of the earth with the multitude of your riches and of your merchandise.

hausa: Sai ya ce mini, “Shiga ka ga mugaye da kuma abubuwa banƙyamar da suke yi a can.”
english: He said to me, “Go in, and see the wicked abominations that they do here.”

hausa: “Ko yanzu”, in ji Ubangiji, “Ku juyo gare ni da dukan zuciyarku, da azumi da kuka da makoki.”
english: “Yet even now,” says Yahweh, “turn to me with all your heart, and with fasting, and with weeping, and with mourning.”

hausa: Saboda haka sa’ad da Ahiya ya ji motsin sawunta a ƙofa, sai ya ce, “Ki shigo, matar Yerobowam. Me ya sa kike yi kamar wata ce dabam? An aiko ni wurinki da labari marar daɗi.
english: So when Ahijah heard the sound of her feet as she came in at the door, he said, “Come in, Jeroboam’s wife! Why do you pretend to be another? For I am sent to you with heavy news.

hausa: Ba don in kunyata ku ba ne na rubuta wannan, sai dai don in gargaɗe ku a kan cewa ku ’ya’yana ne, ƙaunatattu.
english: I don’t write these things to shame you, but to admonish you as my beloved children.

hausa: “ ‘In yana miƙa akuya ce, zai kawo ta a gaban Ubangiji.
english: “‘If his offering is a goat, then he shall offer it before Yahweh.

hausa: Za su zo da rawan jiki kamar tsuntsaye daga Masar, kamar kurciyoyi daga Assuriya. Zan zaunar da su a cikin gidajensu,” in ji Ubangiji.
english: They will come trembling like a bird out of Egypt, and like a dove out of the land of Assyria; and I will settle them in their houses,” says Yahweh.

hausa: “Sa’ad da yunwa ko annoba ta fāɗo a ƙasar, ko wahala ko fumfuna, ko fāra ko fāra ɗango, ko sa’ad da abokan gāba sun yi musu ƙawanya a kowane daga biranensu, dukan wata masifa ko cutar da za tă zo,
english: “If there is famine in the land, if there is pestilence, if there is blight or mildew, locust or caterpillar; if their enemies besiege them in the land of their cities; whatever plague or whatever sickness there is—

hausa: Yadda na hukunta kakanninku a hamadar ƙasar Masar, haka zan hukunta ku, in ji Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka.
english: Just as I entered into judgment with your fathers in the wilderness of the land of Egypt, so I will enter into judgment with you,” says the Lord Yahweh.

hausa: Amma ban gaskata waɗannan abubuwa ba sai da na zo na gani da idanuna. Tabbatacce, ba a ma faɗa mini ko rabi ba. Gama cikin hikima da arziki, ka wuce labarin da na ji nesa ba kusa ba.
english: However, I didn’t believe the words until I came and my eyes had seen it. Behold, not even half was told me! Your wisdom and prosperity exceed the fame which I heard.

hausa: Da ya leƙa nan da can bai kuwa ga kowa ba, sai ya kashe mutumin Masar, ya ɓoye shi a yashi.
english: He looked this way and that way, and when he saw that there was no one, he killed the Egyptian, and hid him in the sand.

hausa: Amma ka guji jayayyar banza da ƙididdigar asali da gardandami da faɗace-faɗace game da Doka, gama ba su da riba kuma aikin banza ne.
english: but shun foolish questionings, genealogies, strife, and disputes about the law; for they are unprofitable and vain.

hausa: Kullum ina tare da ku a filin haikali, amma ba ku kama ni ba. Amma wannan ne sa’a naku, lokacin da duhu yake mulki.”
english: When I was with you in the temple daily, you didn’t stretch out your hands against me. But this is your hour, and the power of darkness.”

hausa: Bilatus ya yi tambaya, “To, me zan yi da Yesu wanda ake kira Kiristi?” Duka suka ce, “A gicciye shi!”
english: Pilate said to them, “What then shall I do to Jesus who is called Christ?” They all said to him, “Let him be crucified!”

hausa: Ta mori dukan ikon dabban nan ta fari a madadinta, ta sa duniya da mazaunanta su yi wa dabba ta farin nan sujada, wadda aka warkar mata da raunin nan da zai iya kashe ta.
english: He exercises all the authority of the first beast in his presence. He makes the earth and those who dwell in it to worship the first beast, whose fatal wound was healed.

hausa: “Amma da ’yan hayan suka hangi ɗan, sai suka ce wa juna, ‘Wannan shi ne magājin. Ku zo, mu kashe shi, mu ci gādonsa.’
english: But the farmers, when they saw the son, said among themselves, ‘This is the heir. Come, let’s kill him and seize his inheritance.’

hausa: “ ‘Kukan ce, “Kuna so ku zama kamar sauran al’ummai, kamar sauran mutanen duniya, waɗanda suke bauta wa itace da dutse.” Amma abin da kuke tunani ba zai taɓa faruwa ba.
english: “‘“That which comes into your mind will not be at all, in that you say, ‘We will be as the nations, as the families of the countries, to serve wood and stone.’

hausa: ya ce, “Me za ku ba ni, in na bashe shi gare ku?” Sai suka ƙirga masa kuɗi azurfa talatin.
english: and said, “What are you willing to give me if I deliver him to you?” So they weighed out for him thirty pieces of silver.

hausa: Ka ɗaura takobinka a gefenka, ya jarumi; ka rufe kanka da ɗaukaka da kuma daraja.
english: Strap your sword on your thigh, O mighty one, in your splendor and your majesty.

hausa: Yayinda suke kaɗe-kaɗe za su rera, “Dukan maɓulɓulaina suna cikinki.”
english: Those who sing as well as those who dance say, “All my springs are in you.”

hausa: In kun kasance a cikina kalmomina kuma suka kasance a cikinku, ku roƙi kome da kuke so, za a kuwa ba ku.
english: If you remain in me, and my words remain in you, you will ask whatever you desire, and it will be done for you.

hausa: Aka kuma yi tagogi masu sandunan ƙarfe, jeri uku, kowace taga tana ɗaura da ’yar’uwarta, har jeri uku.
english: There were beams in three rows, and window was facing window in three ranks.

hausa: Ubangiji ya ce wa Musa,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

hausa: Daga iyakar duniya na yi kira gare ka, na yi kira yayinda zuciyata ta karai; ka bishe ni zuwa dutsen da ya fi ni tsayi.
english: From the end of the earth, I will call to you when my heart is overwhelmed. Lead me to the rock that is higher than I.

hausa: Sa’ad da ya yi wa Isra’ila ba’a, sai Yonatan ɗan Shimeya, ɗan’uwan Dawuda ya kashe shi.
english: When he defied Israel, Jonathan the son of Shimea, David’s brother, killed him.

hausa: A rana ta shida za su shirya abin da suka kwaso, wannan kuwa zai zama ninki biyu na abin da sukan tattara na sauran ranaku.”
english: It shall come to pass on the sixth day, that they shall prepare that which they bring in, and it shall be twice as much as they gather daily.”

hausa: Na gode wa Kiristi Yesu Ubangijinmu, wanda ya ba ni ƙarfi, saboda ya amince da ni, har ya sa ni aikinsa.
english: I thank him who enabled me, Christ Jesus our Lord, because he counted me faithful, appointing me to service,

hausa: Babu raguwar da za a bar musu, domin zan kawo masifa a kan mutanen Anatot a shekarar hukuncinsu.’ ”
english: There will be no remnant to them, for I will bring evil on the men of Anathoth, even the year of their visitation.’”

hausa: da Hodiya, da Bani da kuma Beninu.
english: Hodiah, Bani, and Beninu.

hausa: An tsage duniya, duniya ta farfashe ta wage, an girgiza duniya ƙwarai.
english: The earth is utterly broken. The earth is torn apart. The earth is shaken violently.

hausa: Sai Yohanan ɗan Kareya da dukan shugabannin sojojin da suke tare da shi suka bi da dukan waɗanda suka tsira daga Mizfa waɗanda ya karɓe daga Ishmayel ɗan Netaniya bayan ya kashe Gedaliya ɗan Ahikam, wato, sojoji, mata, yara da fadawan da ya kawo daga Gibeyon
english: Then Johanan the son of Kareah and all the captains of the forces who were with him took all the remnant of the people whom he had recovered from Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, from Mizpah, after he had killed Gedaliah the son of Ahikam—the men of war, with the women, the children, and the eunuchs, whom he had brought back from Gibeon.

hausa: Ko yayinda yake tafiya a kan hanya wawa yakan nuna cewa ba shi da hankali, yakan nuna wa kowa wawancinsa.
english: Yes also when the fool walks by the way, his understanding fails him, and he says to everyone that he is a fool.

hausa: Ta haka za ka yi nasara in ka mai da hankali ga kiyaye ƙa’idodi da dokokin da Ubangiji ya ba wa Musa saboda Isra’ila. Ka yi ƙarfin hali ka kuma ƙarfafa. Kada ka ji tsoro ko ka fid da zuciya.
english: Then you will prosper, if you observe to do the statutes and the ordinances which Yahweh gave Moses concerning Israel. Be strong and courageous. Don’t be afraid and don’t be dismayed.

hausa: Sai wani sabon sarki wanda bai san Yusuf ba, ya hau sarautar Masar.
english: Now there arose a new king over Egypt, who didn’t know Joseph.

hausa: Gama tun da a cikin hikimar Allah, duniya a cikin hikimarta ba tă san shi ba, Allah ya ji daɗin ceton waɗanda suka ba da gaskiya ta wurin wautar wa’azin bishara.
english: For seeing that in the wisdom of God, the world through its wisdom didn’t know God, it was God’s good pleasure through the foolishness of the preaching to save those who believe.

hausa: Sarki da Yehohiyada suka ba da shi ga mutanen da suka yi aikin da ake bukata don haikalin Ubangiji. Suka ɗauki masu gini da kafintoci don su gyara haikalin Ubangiji, da kuma ma’aikatan ƙarafa da tagulla don su gyara haikalin.
english: The king and Jehoiada gave it to those who did the work of the service of Yahweh’s house. They hired masons and carpenters to restore Yahweh’s house, and also those who worked iron and bronze to repair Yahweh’s house.

hausa: Ya ce musu, “Wannan shi ne abin da na gaya muku tun ina tare da ku cewa, dole a cika kome da aka rubuta game da ni, a cikin Dokar Musa, da Annabawa, da kuma Zabura.”
english: He said to them, “This is what I told you while I was still with you, that all things which are written in the law of Moses, the prophets, and the psalms concerning me must be fulfilled.”

hausa: kuma kada ku ba shi hutu sai ya kafa Urushalima ya kuma mai da ita yabon duniya.
english: and give him no rest until he establishes, and until he makes Jerusalem a praise on the earth.

hausa: waɗanda dā ba su yi biyayya ba sa’ad da Allah ya jira da haƙuri a kwanaki Nuhu yayinda ake sassaƙa jirgi. A cikinsa mutane kima ne kawai, su takwas, aka kuɓutar ta ruwa,
english: who before were disobedient when God waited patiently in the days of Noah while the ship was being built. In it, few, that is, eight souls, were saved through water.

hausa: Yana cikin tafiya, sai ya ga Lawi, ɗan Alfayus zaune a inda ake karɓar haraji. Yesu ya ce masa, “Bi ni.” Sai Lawi ya tashi, ya bi shi.
english: As he passed by, he saw Levi the son of Alphaeus sitting at the tax office. He said to him, “Follow me.” And he arose and followed him.

hausa: Dawuda ya ce wa Gad, “Na shiga uku. Bari in fāɗa a hannuwan Ubangiji, gama jinƙansa yana da girma sosai; amma kada ka bari in fāɗa a hannuwan mutane.”
english: David said to Gad, “I am in distress. Let me fall, I pray, into Yahweh’s hand, for his mercies are very great. Don’t let me fall into man’s hand.”

hausa: Yabon kanmu ne kuma muka fara yi? Ko kuwa muna bukatar wasiƙun yabo ne zuwa gare ku, ko daga gare ku, kamar yadda waɗansu suke yi?
english: Are we beginning again to commend ourselves? Or do we need, as do some, letters of commendation to you or from you?

hausa: Almajiran suka tafi suka yi kamar yadda Yesu ya umarce su.
english: The disciples went and did just as Jesus commanded them,

hausa: Aka yi lissafi aka auna kome aka tarar yana nan daidai, aka kuma rubuta yawan nauyin a lokacin.
english: Everything was counted and weighed; and all the weight was written at that time.

hausa: Mai hallakarwa zai aukar wa kowane gari, kuma ba wani garin da zai kuɓuta. Kwari zai lalace tudu kuma ya hallaka, domin Ubangiji ya faɗa.
english: The destroyer will come on every city, and no city will escape; the valley also will perish, and the plain will be destroyed, as Yahweh has spoken.

hausa: Suka tashi daga Bene Ya’akan, suka yi sansani a Hor Haggidgad.
english: They traveled from Bene Jaakan, and encamped in Hor Haggidgad.

hausa: Ya kuma yi kwanoni da manyan cokula da kuma kwanonin yayyafawa. Ta haka Huram ya gama dukan aikin da ya yi wa Sarki Solomon a haikalin Ubangiji.
english: Hiram made the pots, the shovels, and the basins. So Hiram finished doing all the work that he worked for King Solomon in Yahweh’s house:

hausa: “Masu saurin gudu ba sa iya gudu haka ma masu ƙarfi ba sa iya kuɓuta. A arewa ta Kogin Yuferites sun yi tuntuɓe sun fāɗi.
english: “Don’t let the swift flee away, nor the mighty man escape. In the north by the river Euphrates they have stumbled and fallen.

hausa: Sai na fāɗi a ƙasa na kuma ji wata murya ta ce mini, ‘Shawulu! Shawulu! Don me kake tsananta mini?’
english: I fell to the ground and heard a voice saying to me, ‘Saul, Saul, why are you persecuting me?’

hausa: Yusuf ya amsa ya ce, “Ina neman ’yan’uwana ne. Za ka iya faɗa mini inda suke kiwon garkunansu?”
english: He said, “I am looking for my brothers. Tell me, please, where they are feeding the flock.”

hausa: Na san kowane tsuntsun da yake a duwatsu kuma halittun filaye nawa ne.
english: I know all the birds of the mountains. The wild animals of the field are mine.

hausa: “ ‘Zan yi gāba da mutumin da ya juyo ga masu duba da bokaye, don yă yi karuwanci ta wurin bin su, zan kuma raba shi daga mutanensa.
english: “‘The person that turns to those who are mediums and wizards, to play the prostitute after them, I will even set my face against that person, and will cut him off from among his people.

hausa: Ranar Shirye-shiryen Makon Bikin Ƙetarewa ce kuwa, wajen sa’a ta shida. Sai Bilatus ya ce wa Yahudawa, “Ga sarkinku.”
english: Now it was the Preparation Day of the Passover, at about the sixth hour. He said to the Jews, “Behold, your King!”

hausa: Daga baya Isra’ilawa za su dawo su nemi Ubangiji Allahnsu da kuma Dawuda sarkinsu. Za su je da rawan jiki wajen Ubangiji da kuma ga albarkunsa a kwanakin ƙarshe.
english: Afterward the children of Israel shall return and seek Yahweh their God, and David their king, and shall come with trembling to Yahweh and to his blessings in the last days.

hausa: Sai Shawulu ya sa waɗansu tufafi ya ɓad da kama, shi da waɗansu mutum biyu suka tafi wurin matar da dare, ya ce mata, “Ki yi mini duba ta hanyar sihiri, ki hawar mini duk wanda zan faɗa miki.”
english: Saul disguised himself and put on other clothing, and went, he and two men with him, and they came to the woman by night. Then he said, “Please consult for me by the familiar spirit, and bring me up whomever I shall name to you.”

hausa: Sakayya nawa ne, zan kuwa ɗau fansa. A cikin lokaci, ƙafarsu za tă yi santsi; ranar masifarsu ta yi kusa hallakarsu kuma tana gaggautawa a kansu.”
english: Vengeance is mine, and recompense, at the time when their foot slides, for the day of their calamity is at hand. Their doom rushes at them.”

hausa: Sai ya ce wa mai lura da gonar inabin, ‘Yau shekara uku ke nan ina zuwa neman ’ya’yan ɓaure daga itacen nan, amma ba na samun kome. Sare shi! Don me za a bar shi ya tare wuri.’
english: He said to the vine dresser, ‘Behold, these three years I have come looking for fruit on this fig tree, and found none. Cut it down! Why does it waste the soil?’

hausa: “In wani daga cikinku yana so ya gina gidan sama, ai, yakan fara zama ne, ya yi lissafin abin da ginin zai ci tukuna, don yă ga ko yana da isashen kuɗi da zai gama ginin.
english: For which of you, desiring to build a tower, doesn’t first sit down and count the cost, to see if he has enough to complete it?

hausa: Dukan waɗanda suke neman ribar da ba a samu a hanya mai kyau; ƙarshen wannan yakan ɗauke rayukansu.
english: So are the ways of everyone who is greedy for gain. It takes away the life of its owners.

hausa: Sau da sau suka riƙa gwada Allah; suka tsokane Mai Tsarki na Isra’ila.
english: They turned again and tempted God, and provoked the Holy One of Israel.

hausa: Ubangiji Maɗaukaki zai bulale su da tsumagiya, kamar sa’ad da ya bugi Midiyan a dutsen Oreb; zai kuma ɗaga sandarsa a bisa ruwaye, yadda ya yi a Masar.
english: Yahweh of Armies will stir up a scourge against him, as in the slaughter of Midian at the rock of Oreb. His rod will be over the sea, and he will lift it up like he did against Egypt.

hausa: Sa’an nan ya bayyana ga Yaƙub, sa’an nan ga dukan manzannin,
english: Then he appeared to James, then to all the apostles,

hausa: Firist zai ɗauki ɗan rago na hadaya don laifi tare da moɗa na mai, ya kaɗa su a gaban Ubangiji kamar hadaya ta kaɗawa.
english: The priest shall take the lamb of the trespass offering, and the log of oil, and the priest shall wave them for a wave offering before Yahweh.

hausa: ya yi rumman guda ɗari huɗu na sashi yanar biyun (jeri biyu na rumman don kowace yanar, yana adon dajiyoyi masu fasalin kwano a kan ginshiƙai);
english: the four hundred pomegranates for the two networks; two rows of pomegranates for each network, to cover the two bowls of the capitals that were on the pillars;

hausa: Ba za su ƙara zama ganimar al’ummai ba, ba kuwa namun jeji za su cinye su ba. Za su zauna lafiya, kuma babu wani da zai sa su ji tsoro.
english: They will no more be a prey to the nations, neither will the animals of the earth devour them; but they will dwell securely, and no one will make them afraid.

hausa: Sai na ce, “Kash, Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka! Suna zance a kaina cewa, ‘Ba misalai kawai yake yi ba?’ ”
english: Then I said, “Ah Lord Yahweh! They say of me, ‘Isn’t he a speaker of parables?’”

hausa: Yanzu kuwa wajen sa’a ta shida ne, kuma duhu ya rufe ko’ina a ƙasar, har zuwa sa’a ta tara,
english: It was now about the sixth hour, and darkness came over the whole land until the ninth hour.

hausa: Kada ka rufe laifinsu, kada kuwa ka gafarta musu, gama sun ci mutuncinmu, mu da muke gini.
english: Don’t cover their iniquity. Don’t let their sin be blotted out from before you; for they have insulted the builders.”

hausa: Saboda haka za ku ba da kyautan bankwana ga Moreshet Gat. Garin Akzib zai zama abin yaudara ga sarakunan Isra’ila.
english: Therefore you will give a parting gift to Moresheth Gath. The houses of Achzib will be a deceitful thing to the kings of Israel.

hausa: Ƙasusuwanta bututun tagulla ne, haƙarƙarinta kamar sandunan ƙarfe.
english: His bones are like tubes of bronze. His limbs are like bars of iron.

hausa: Na yi shela ga Yahudawa da Hellenawa cewa dole su juye ga Allah cikin tuba su kuma amince da Ubangijinmu Yesu.
english: testifying both to Jews and to Greeks repentance toward God and faith toward our Lord Jesus.

hausa: Sun yi ƙarya a kan Ubangiji; sun ce, “Ba zai yi kome ba! Ba wata masifar da za tă same mu; ba za mu taɓa ganin takobi ko yunwa ba.
english: They have denied Yahweh, and said, “It is not he. Evil won’t come on us. We won’t see sword or famine.

hausa: Yana da ’ya’ya maza bakwai da ’yan mata uku,
english: There were born to him seven sons and three daughters.

hausa: An haɗiye Isra’ila; yanzu tana cikin al’ummai kamar abin da ba shi da amfani.
english: Israel is swallowed up. Now they are among the nations like a worthless thing.

hausa: Ku tuna, dā ku bayi ne a Masar, Ubangiji Allahnku kuma ya fisshe ku. Shi ya sa nake ba ku wannan umarni a yau.
english: You shall remember that you were a slave in the land of Egypt, and Yahweh your God redeemed you. Therefore I command you this thing today.

hausa: ‘Ku da kanku kun ga abin da na yi wa Masar, da yadda na ɗauko ku a kan fikafikan gaggafa na kawo ku wurina.
english: ‘You have seen what I did to the Egyptians, and how I bore you on eagles’ wings, and brought you to myself.

hausa: Na sāke ɗaga kai sama, sai ga kekunan yaƙi guda huɗu a gabana suna fitowa tsakanin duwatsu guda biyu, duwatsun tagulla!
english: Again I lifted up my eyes, and saw, and behold, four chariots came out from between two mountains; and the mountains were mountains of bronze.

hausa: Za ka kawo Lawiyawa a gaban Ubangiji, Isra’ilawa kuma za su ɗibiya musu hannuwansu.
english: You shall present the Levites before Yahweh. The children of Israel shall lay their hands on the Levites,

hausa: Game da Lawi ya ce, “Tummim da Urim na mutumin da ka nuna masa tagomashi ne. Ka gwada shi a Massa; ka yi faɗa da shi a ruwan Meriba.
english: About Levi he said, “Your Thummim and your Urim are with your godly one, whom you proved at Massah, with whom you contended at the waters of Meribah.

hausa: Ba a jima ba, sai ga wata guguwar iska mai ƙarfin da ake kira “’Yar arewa maso gabas,” ta buga daga tsibirin.
english: But before long, a stormy wind beat down from shore, which is called Euroclydon.

hausa: Saboda haka sarki ya ce wa Shimeyi, “Ba za ka mutu ba.” Sarki kuwa ya yi alkawari har da rantsuwa.
english: The king said to Shimei, “You will not die.” The king swore to him.

hausa: Saboda haka, a wannan batu na yanzu, ina ba ku shawara. Ku ƙyale mutanen nan! Ku bar su su tafi! Gama in manufarsu ko ayyukansu na mutum ne, ai, zai rushe.
english: Now I tell you, withdraw from these men and leave them alone. For if this counsel or this work is of men, it will be overthrown.

hausa: Sai Bitrus ya ce masa, “Eniyas, Yesu Kiristi ya warkar da kai. Tashi ka naɗe tabarmarka.” Nan da nan Eniyas ya tashi.
english: Peter said to him, “Aeneas, Jesus Christ heals you. Get up and make your bed!” Immediately he arose.

hausa: Ka sayar mana da abincin da za mu ci, da kuma ruwan da za mu sha a farashinsu na azurfa. Ka dai bar mu mu wuce ta ƙasarka kawai,
english: You shall sell me food for money, that I may eat; and give me water for money, that I may drink. Just let me pass through on my feet,

hausa: Sa’an nan almajiransa goma sha ɗaya, suka tafi Galili, suka je dutsen da Yesu ya gaya musu.
english: But the eleven disciples went into Galilee, to the mountain where Jesus had sent them.

hausa: Ka tsawata wa masu fariya, waɗanda suke la’anta waɗanda kuma suka kauce daga umarnanka.
english: You have rebuked the proud who are cursed, who wander from your commandments.

hausa: Miriyam da Haruna suka fara zargin Musa saboda matarsa ’yar ƙasar Kush da ya aura.
english: Miriam and Aaron spoke against Moses because of the Cushite woman whom he had married; for he had married a Cushite woman.

hausa: Sarki da fadawansa da dukan taro a Urushalima suka yanke shawara su yi Bikin Ƙetarewa a wata na biyu.
english: For the king had taken counsel with his princes and all the assembly in Jerusalem to keep the Passover in the second month.

hausa: Dokar Esta ta tabbatar da waɗannan umarnai game da Furim, aka kuma rubuta ta cikin tarihi.
english: The commandment of Esther confirmed these matters of Purim; and it was written in the book.

hausa: Za su rarrabu. Mahaifi yana gāba da ɗan, ɗan kuma yana gāba da mahaifin. Mahaifiya tana gāba da diyar, diyar kuma tana gāba da mahaifiyar. Suruka tana gāba da matar ɗa, matar ɗa kuma tana gāba da suruka.”
english: They will be divided, father against son, and son against father; mother against daughter, and daughter against her mother; mother-in-law against her daughter-in-law, and daughter-in-law against her mother-in-law.”

hausa: Kaiton birni mai zub da jini, wadda take cike da ƙarairayi, cike da ganima, wadda ba a rasa masu fāɗawa cikin wahala!
english: Woe to the bloody city! It is all full of lies and robbery—no end to the prey.

hausa: Ubangiji Allah na sama, wanda ya fitar da ni daga gidan mahaifina, da kuma ƙasar asalina wanda kuma ya yi magana da ni, ya yi mini alkawari da rantsuwa cewa, “Ga zuriyarka zan ba da wannan ƙasa, zai aika mala’ikansa yă sha gabanka domin ka samo wa ɗana mata daga can.
english: Yahweh, the God of heaven—who took me from my father’s house, and from the land of my birth, who spoke to me, and who swore to me, saying, ‘I will give this land to your offspring—he will send his angel before you, and you shall take a wife for my son from there.

hausa: Duk da haka, ba ku amince da Ubangiji Allahnku ba,
english: Yet in this thing you didn’t believe Yahweh your God,

hausa: Ubangiji ya ce wa Musa,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

hausa: “ ‘Mutanen Damaskus sun ga abin da za ki iya bayarwa sai suka yi ciniki da ke, ta sayi kayanki da ruwan inabi daga Helbon, da ulu daga Zahar.
english: “‘“Damascus was your merchant for the multitude of your handiworks by reason of the multitude of all kinds of riches, with the wine of Helbon, and white wool.

hausa: Bari kowa yă kasance da sauƙinkai. Ubangiji ya yi kusan zuwa.
english: Let your gentleness be known to all men. The Lord is at hand.

hausa: Sai na yi tunani a zuciyata, “Allah zai shari’anta masu adalci da masu mugunta, gama za a kasance da lokaci domin kowane aiki, lokaci domin kowane abu.”
english: I said in my heart, “God will judge the righteous and the wicked; for there is a time there for every purpose and for every work.”

hausa: Rago ya ƙosa ya sami wani abu ainun amma ba ya samun kome, amma sha’awar mai aiki tuƙuru yakan ƙoshi sosai.
english: The soul of the sluggard desires, and has nothing, but the desire of the diligent shall be fully satisfied.

hausa: Sai ya ce, “Daniyel, kai ne wanda ake ƙauna sosai, ka yi lura da kyau game da kalmomin da zan yi maka magana a kansu, ka tashi yanzu, gama an aiko ni a gare ka.” Sa’ad da ya faɗa mini haka, sai na tashi a tsaye ina rawan jiki.
english: He said to me, “Daniel, you greatly beloved man, understand the words that I speak to you, and stand upright, for I have been sent to you, now.” When he had spoken this word to me, I stood trembling.

hausa: Gama kun san cewa ba da abubuwa masu lalacewa kamar azurfa ko zinariya ce aka fanshe ku daga rayuwar banza da kuka karɓa daga kakanni-kakanninku ba,
english: knowing that you were redeemed, not with corruptible things like silver or gold, from the useless way of life handed down from your fathers,

hausa: Kowa yă yi amfani da kowace baiwar da ya samu don kyautata wa waɗansu, cikin aminci yana aikata alherin Allah a hanyoyi dabam-dabam.
english: As each has received a gift, employ it in serving one another, as good managers of the grace of God in its various forms.

hausa: A wannan rana za a kasance da babban hanya daga Masar zuwa Assuriya. Assuriyawa za su tafi Masar, Masarawa kuma za su tafi Assuriya. Masarawa da Assuriyawa za su yi sujada tare.
english: In that day there will be a highway out of Egypt to Assyria, and the Assyrian shall come into Egypt, and the Egyptian into Assyria; and the Egyptians will worship with the Assyrians.

hausa: Ta amsa, ta ce, “I, Ubangiji, amma karnuka ma sukan ci gutsattsarin da sukan fāɗi daga teburin maigidansu.”
english: But she said, “Yes, Lord, but even the dogs eat the crumbs which fall from their masters’ table.”

hausa: A banza suke mini sujada, koyarwarsu, dokokin mutane ne kawai.’
english: They worship me in vain, teaching as doctrines the commandments of men.’

hausa: ’Ya’yan Kaleb ɗan Yefunne maza su ne, Iru, Ela da Na’am. Ɗan Ela shi ne, Kenaz.
english: The sons of Caleb the son of Jephunneh: Iru, Elah, and Naam. The son of Elah: Kenaz.

hausa: “A waɗannan lokutan mutane da yawa za su tashi gāba da sarkin Kudu. Amma waɗansu ’yan kama-karya za su taso daga jama’arka da niyya su cika abin da wahayin ya ce, amma za a fatattake su.
english: “In those times many will stand up against the king of the south. Also the children of the violent among your people will lift themselves up to establish the vision, but they will fall.

hausa: Sa’ad da kuka ji labarin yaƙe-yaƙe, da juye juyen mulki, kada ku tsorota. Dole ne waɗannan abubuwa su fara faruwa, amma ƙarshen ba zai zo nan da nan ba.”
english: When you hear of wars and disturbances, don’t be terrified, for these things must happen first, but the end won’t come immediately.”

hausa: domin Hiridus yana jin tsoron Yohanna, ya kuma kāre shi sosai, da sanin cewa shi mutum ne mai adalci da kuma mai tsarki. Duk sa’ad da Hiridus ya saurari Yohanna, yakan damu ƙwarai, duk da haka, yakan so yă ji shi.
english: for Herod feared John, knowing that he was a righteous and holy man, and kept him safe. When he heard him, he did many things, and he heard him gladly.

hausa: Duk da haka, ka saurari abin da zan faɗa a kunnenka da kuma a kunnen duka mutane,
english: Nevertheless listen now to this word that I speak in your ears, and in the ears of all the people:

hausa: Sai ya ce wa Ubangiji, “Me ya sa ka kawo wannan damuwar a kan bawanka? Me na yi da ya ɓata maka rai har ka ɗora dukan nauyin mutanen nan a kaina?
english: Moses said to Yahweh, “Why have you treated your servant so badly? Why haven’t I found favor in your sight, that you lay the burden of all this people on me?

hausa: Ubangiji Allahnmu ya faɗa mana a Horeb cewa, “Daɗewarku a wannan dutse ya isa haka.
english: “Yahweh our God spoke to us in Horeb, saying, ‘You have lived long enough at this mountain.

hausa: Ya kuma aika mugunta a gaban Ubangiji yadda kakanninsa suka yi.
english: He did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight, according to all that his fathers had done.

hausa: Mutanen Isra’ila da na Yahuda sun tsokane ni ta wurin dukan muguntar da suka aikata su, sarakunansu da fadawansu, firistocinsu da annabawa, mutanen Yahuda da mutanen Urushalima.
english: because of all the evil of the children of Israel and of the children of Judah, which they have done to provoke me to anger—they, their kings, their princes, their priests, their prophets, the men of Judah, and the inhabitants of Jerusalem.

hausa: Bulus ya gaishe su ya kuma ba su rahoto dalla-dalla a kan abin da Allah ya yi a cikin Al’ummai ta wurin aikinsa.
english: When he had greeted them, he reported one by one the things which God had worked among the Gentiles through his ministry.

hausa: Saboda Ɗan Mutum ya zo ne, domin yă nemi abin da ya ɓata, yă cece shi kuma.”
english: For the Son of Man came to seek and to save that which was lost.”

hausa: Da yake ’ya’yan suna da nama da jini, shi ma sai ya ɗauki kamanninsu na mutum domin ta wurin mutuwarsa yă hallaka wanda yake riƙe da ikon mutuwa, wato, Iblis
english: Since then the children have shared in flesh and blood, he also himself in the same way partook of the same, that through death he might bring to nothing him who had the power of death, that is, the devil,

hausa: Dattawan jama’a za su ɗibiya hannuwansu a kan bijimin a gaban Ubangiji, sai a yanka bijimin a gaban Ubangiji.
english: The elders of the congregation shall lay their hands on the head of the bull before Yahweh; and the bull shall be killed before Yahweh.

hausa: Sa’ad da na hau kan dutse don in karɓi allunan dutse, allunan alkawarin da Ubangiji ya yi da ku, na zauna a kan dutse yini arba’in da dare arba’in; ban ci abinci ba, ban sha ruwa ba.
english: When I had gone up onto the mountain to receive the stone tablets, even the tablets of the covenant which Yahweh made with you, then I stayed on the mountain forty days and forty nights. I neither ate bread nor drank water.

hausa: Zai kiyaye ku kuma daga mazinaciya, daga mace mai lalata, mai ƙoƙarin kama ka da daɗin bakinta,
english: to deliver you from the strange woman, even from the foreigner who flatters with her words,

hausa: Ka yi masa ƙaho a kowace kusurwan nan huɗu, domin bagade da ƙahoni duk su zama ɗaya, ka dalaye bagade da tagulla.
english: You shall make its horns on its four corners. Its horns shall be of one piece with it. You shall overlay it with bronze.

hausa: Sai na tambaye shi na ce, “Mene ne waɗannan itatuwan zaitun guda biyu tsaye a hagu da kuma daman wurin ajiye fitilan fitilu?”
english: Then I asked him, “What are these two olive trees on the right side of the lamp stand and on the left side of it?”

hausa: ’Yan’uwa, a duk matsayin da mutum yake sa’ad da aka kira shi, sai yă kasance haka a sabuwar dangantakarsa da Allah.
english: Brothers, let each man, in whatever condition he was called, stay in that condition with God.

hausa: Ana faɗin abubuwa masu ɗaukaka game da ke Ya birnin Allah, Sela
english: Glorious things are spoken about you, city of God. Selah.

hausa: To, mutanen Efraim suka ce wa Gideyon, “Me ya sa ka yi mana haka? Me ya sa ba ka kira mu lokacin da ka tafi yaƙi da Midiyawa ba?” Suka zarge shi sosai.
english: The men of Ephraim said to him, “Why have you treated us this way, that you didn’t call us when you went to fight with Midian?” They rebuked him sharply.

hausa: Ku zo ku ga abin da Allah ya yi, ayyukansa masu banmamaki a madadin mutum!
english: Come, and see God’s deeds— awesome work on behalf of the children of men.

hausa: Ya miƙa hannunsa daga sama ya kama ni; ya ja ni daga zurfin ruwaye.
english: He sent from on high. He took me. He drew me out of many waters.

hausa: don ku zama marasa abin zargi, sahihai ’ya’yan Allah, waɗanda ba su da laifi, a zamanin mutane karkatattu, kangararru, waɗanda kuke haskakawa a cikinsu kamar fitilu a duniya
english: that you may become blameless and harmless, children of God without defect in the middle of a crooked and perverse generation, among whom you are seen as lights in the world,

hausa: Kowace zuciya ta san ɓacin ranta, kuma babu wani dabam da zai yi rabon jin daɗinsa.
english: The heart knows its own bitterness and joy; he will not share these with a stranger.

hausa: Na ga Ubangiji yana tsaye a gaban bagade, ya kuma ce, “Bugi kan ginshiƙan don madogaran ƙofa su girgiza. Saukar da su a kan dukan mutane; waɗanda ba su mutu ba zan kashe su da takobi. Ba mutum guda da zai tsere, babu wani da zai tsira.
english: I saw the Lord standing beside the altar, and he said, “Strike the tops of the pillars, that the thresholds may shake. Break them in pieces on the head of all of them. I will kill the last of them with the sword. Not one of them will flee away. Not one of them will escape.

hausa: Bayan ɗan lokaci, sai na tsattsaye a wurin, suka hauro wurin Bitrus, suka ce, “Tabbatacce, kai ɗayansu ne, don harshen maganarka, ya tone ka.”
english: After a little while those who stood by came and said to Peter, “Surely you are also one of them, for your speech makes you known.”

hausa: Waɗannan su ne dabbobin da za ku iya ci, saniya, tunkiya, akuya,
english: These are the animals which you may eat: the ox, the sheep, the goat,

hausa: Sai Otniyel ɗan Kenaz, ƙanen Kaleb ya ci birnin, saboda haka Kaleb ya ba shi ’yarsa Aksa ya aura.
english: Othniel the son of Kenaz, Caleb’s younger brother, took it, so he gave him Achsah his daughter as his wife.

hausa: Kada ku ba shi rancen kuɗi da ruwa, ko ku sayar masa abinci don samun riba.
english: You shall not lend him your money at interest, nor give him your food for profit.

hausa: Ga Ubangiji na yi kuka mai ƙarfi, ya kuwa amsa mini daga tudunsa mai tsarki. Sela
english: I cry to Yahweh with my voice, and he answers me out of his holy hill. Selah.

hausa: suka ce wa Musa, “Mun ƙazantu saboda mun taɓa gawa, don me aka hana mu mu ba da hadaya ga Ubangiji tare da sauran Isra’ilawa a ƙayyadadden lokaci?”
english: Those men said to him, “We are unclean because of the dead body of a man. Why are we kept back, that we may not offer the offering of Yahweh in its appointed season among the children of Israel?”

hausa: amma don gwauruwan nan ta dame ni, zan tabbatar cewa ta sami adalci, domin kada tă gajiyar da ni, da yawan zuwanta.’ ”
english: yet because this widow bothers me, I will defend her, or else she will wear me out by her continual coming.’”

hausa: Wannan hidimar da kuke yi, ba bukatun mutanen Allah kaɗai take biya ba, amma tana cike da hanyoyin nuna godiya masu yawa ga Allah.
english: For this service of giving that you perform not only makes up for lack among the saints, but abounds also through much giving of thanks to God,

hausa: yammancin Ekron da dukan garuruwa da ƙauyukan da suke kusa da Ashdod.
english: from Ekron even to the sea, all that were by the side of Ashdod, with their villages.

hausa: Bayan Absalom ya gudu sai ya je wurin Geshur, ya zauna a can shekara uku.
english: So Absalom fled and went to Geshur, and was there three years.

hausa: Da iyayensa suka gan shi sai suka yi mamaki. Mahaifiyarsa ta ce masa, “Ɗana, don me ka yi mana haka? Ni da mahaifinka duk mun damu muna nemanka.”
english: When they saw him, they were astonished; and his mother said to him, “Son, why have you treated us this way? Behold, your father and I were anxiously looking for you.”

hausa: Adahiya ɗan Yeroham, ɗan Fashhur, ɗan Malkiya; da Ma’asai ɗan Adiyel, ɗan Yazera, ɗan Meshullam, ɗan Meshillemit, ɗan Immer.
english: and Adaiah the son of Jeroham, the son of Pashhur, the son of Malchijah; and Maasai the son of Adiel, the son of Jahzerah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Meshillemith, the son of Immer;

hausa: Ban karɓe ta daga wurin wani mutum ba, ba a kuma koya mini ita ba, a maimako, na karɓe ta, ta wurin wahayi daga Yesu Kiristi ne.
english: For I didn’t receive it from man, nor was I taught it, but it came to me through revelation of Jesus Christ.

hausa: Gama na san cewa babu wani abin kirkin da yake zaune a cikina, wato, a mutuntakata. Gama sha’awar yin abu mai kyau kam ina da ita, sai dai ikon yin ne fa babu.
english: For I know that in me, that is, in my flesh, dwells no good thing. For desire is present with me, but I don’t find it doing that which is good.

hausa: Aure yă zama abin girmamawa ga kowa, a kuma kiyaye gadon aure da tsabta, gama Allah zai hukunta masu zina da kuma dukan masu fasikanci.
english: Let marriage be held in honor among all, and let the bed be undefiled; but God will judge the sexually immoral and adulterers.

hausa: Duk sa’ad da za a gusar da tabanakul, Lawiyawa ne za su saukar da shi; kuma duk sa’ad da za a kafa shi, Lawiyawa ne za su yi haka. Duk wani dabam da ya je kusa da shi za a kashe shi.
english: When the tabernacle is to move, the Levites shall take it down; and when the tabernacle is to be set up, the Levites shall set it up. The stranger who comes near shall be put to death.

hausa: In bawa ya tsere zuwa wurinku don mafaka, kada ku miƙa shi ga ubangidansa.
english: You shall not deliver to his master a servant who has escaped from his master to you.

hausa: Da Yesu ya ji labari cewa an kulle Yohanna a kurkuku, sai ya koma zuwa Galili.
english: Now when Jesus heard that John was delivered up, he withdrew into Galilee.

hausa: Bari sammai su yi farin ciki, bari duniya tă yi murna; bari teku tă yi ruri, da kuma dukan abin da yake cikinsa;
english: Let the heavens be glad, and let the earth rejoice. Let the sea roar, and its fullness!

hausa: ‘Kalno bai kasance kamar Karkemish ba? Hamat bai zama kamar Arfad Samariya kuma kamar Damaskus ba?
english: Isn’t Calno like Carchemish? Isn’t Hamath like Arpad? Isn’t Samaria like Damascus?”

hausa: ’Yan’uwana, fiye da kome, kada ku yi rantsuwa ko da sama, ko da ƙasa ko da wani abu dabam. Bari “I” naku yă zama “I”. “A’a” naku kuma yă zama “A’a”, don kada a hukunta ku.
english: But above all things, my brothers, don’t swear—not by heaven, or by the earth, or by any other oath; but let your “yes” be “yes”, and your “no”, “no”, so that you don’t fall into hypocrisy.

hausa: Kun zama matattu saboda ku masu zunubi ne kuma saboda halin zunubanku aka ware. Sa’an nan Allah ya sa kuka rayu tare da Kiristi. Ya gafarta mana dukan zunubanmu.
english: You were dead through your trespasses and the uncircumcision of your flesh. He made you alive together with him, having forgiven us all our trespasses,

hausa: An lalatar da tentina; dukan igiyoyinsa sun tsintsinke. ’Ya’yana maza sun bar ni ba sa nan; ba wanda aka bari da zai kafa tentina ko ya kafa mini mafaka.
english: My tent has been destroyed, and all my cords are broken. My children have gone away from me, and they are no more. There is no one to spread my tent any more, to set up my curtains.

hausa: Ki kwana a nan, da safe kuwa in yana so yă fansa, to, da kyau, sai yă fansa. Amma in ba ya niyya, tabbatacce, na rantse da Ubangiji mai rai zan yi. Ki kwanta a nan sai da safe.”
english: Stay this night, and in the morning, if he will perform for you the part of a kinsman, good. Let him do the kinsman’s duty. But if he will not do the duty of a kinsman for you, then I will do the duty of a kinsman for you, as Yahweh lives. Lie down until the morning.”

hausa: Sa’an nan ta ce, “Ga Bilha, mai baiwata, ka kwana da ita don tă haifa mini ’ya’ya, ta gare ta kuwa ni ma in gina iyali.”
english: She said, “Behold, my maid Bilhah. Go in to her, that she may bear on my knees, and I also may obtain children by her.”

hausa: Rago yakan ce, “Akwai zaki a kan hanya, zaki mai faɗa yana yawo a tituna!”
english: The sluggard says, “There is a lion in the road! A fierce lion roams the streets!”

hausa: Ana nan, sai Ubangiji ya kawo wata iska mai tsanani ta koro makware daga teku. Ta bar su birjik kewaye da sansani, tsayinsu daga ƙasa ya kai kamu biyu, misalin tafiyar nisan yini guda ta kowace fuska.
english: A wind from Yahweh went out and brought quails from the sea, and let them fall by the camp, about a day’s journey on this side, and a day’s journey on the other side, around the camp, and about two cubits above the surface of the earth.

hausa: A wuri mai tsarki na can ciki, ya yi kerubobi biyu na itacen zaitun, kowanne mai tsayi kamu goma.
english: In the inner sanctuary he made two cherubim of olive wood, each ten cubits high.

hausa: Gama ko Ɗan Mutum ma, bai zo domin a bauta masa ba, amma don yă yi bauta, yă kuma ba da ransa fansa saboda mutane da yawa.”
english: For the Son of Man also came not to be served but to serve, and to give his life as a ransom for many.”

hausa: Suka yi shelar azumi, suka kuma zaunar da Nabot a wuri mai martaba a cikin mutane.
english: They proclaimed a fast, and set Naboth on high among the people.

hausa: Ta haka Ubangiji zai yi kishin ƙasarsa yă kuma ji tausayin mutanensa.
english: Then Yahweh was jealous for his land, and had pity on his people.

hausa: Bayan ya haifi Mahalalel, Kenan ya yi shekara 840, ya kuma haifi waɗansu ’ya’ya maza da mata
english: Kenan lived after he became the father of Mahalalel eight hundred forty years, and became the father of other sons and daughters

hausa: Ga wuraren da Isra’ilawa suka yi sansani sa’ad da suka fito runduna-runduna a ƙarƙashin Musa da Haruna daga Masar.
english: These are the journeys of the children of Israel, when they went out of the land of Egypt by their armies under the hand of Moses and Aaron.

hausa: Ka ga mutum mai yin magana da garaje? To, gara a sa zuciya ga wawa da a sa zuciya gare shi.
english: Do you see a man who is hasty in his words? There is more hope for a fool than for him.

hausa: Ruwan ya komo ya rufe keken yaƙin da mahayan, dukan sojojin Fir’aunan da suka bi bayan Isra’ilawa cikin teku, ba ko ɗaya da ya tsira.
english: The waters returned, and covered the chariots and the horsemen, even all Pharaoh’s army that went in after them into the sea. There remained not so much as one of them.

hausa: Ka yi murna, kai matashi, a ƙuruciyarka, bari zuciyarka kuma tă yi farin ciki a kwanakin ƙuruciyarka. Ka bi shawarar zuciyarka da kuma duk abin da idanunka suka gani, amma ka sani fa, cikin dukan al’amuran nan Allah zai shari’anta ka.
english: Rejoice, young man, in your youth, and let your heart cheer you in the days of your youth, and walk in the ways of your heart, and in the sight of your eyes; but know that for all these things God will bring you into judgment.

hausa: Dukan bukatata tana a shimfiɗe a gabanka, ya Ubangiji; ajiyar zuciyata ba ta ɓoyuwa daga gare ka.
english: Lord, all my desire is before you. My groaning is not hidden from you.

hausa: Zan mai da su al’umma ɗaya a cikin ƙasar, a kan duwatsun Isra’ila. Za a kasance da sarki guda a kan dukansu ba za su ƙara zama al’ummai biyu ko su rabu su zama masarautai biyu ba.
english: I will make them one nation in the land, on the mountains of Israel. One king will be king to them all. They will no longer be two nations. They won’t be divided into two kingdoms any more at all.

hausa: Ka farka, ya Ubangiji! Don me kake barci? Ta da kanka! Kada ka ƙi mu har abada.
english: Wake up! Why do you sleep, Lord? Arise! Don’t reject us forever.

hausa: Sai na yi tambaya, na ce, “Ina za ka?” Ya amsa mini ya ce, “Zan je in auna Urushalima, in ga yadda fāɗinta da tsawonta suke.”
english: Then I asked, “Where are you going?” He said to me, “To measure Jerusalem, to see what is its width and what is its length.”

hausa: Amma da suka shiga ciki, ba su iske jikin Ubangiji Yesu ba.
english: They entered in, and didn’t find the Lord Jesus’ body.

hausa: (A ƙarƙashin fikafikan kerubobin ana iya ganin abin da ya yi kamar hannuwan mutum.)
english: The form of a man’s hand appeared here in the cherubim under their wings.

hausa: suka ƙulla shawara su kama Yesu da makirci, su kuma kashe shi.
english: They took counsel together that they might take Jesus by deceit and kill him.

hausa: Ka shuka irinka da safe, da yamma kuma kada ka janye hannunka, gama ba ka san wanda zai yi albarka ba, ko wannan ko wancan, ko kuma duka biyunsu su yi albarka.
english: In the morning sow your seed, and in the evening don’t withhold your hand; for you don’t know which will prosper, whether this or that, or whether they both will be equally good.

hausa: Ka sa su danƙa su a hannun waɗanda aka zaɓa don biyan ma’aikatan da suka yi gyara a haikalin Ubangiji,
english: Let them deliver it into the hand of the workers who have the oversight of Yahweh’s house; and let them give it to the workers who are in Yahweh’s house, to repair the damage to the house,

hausa: Kun kuma sa Ubangiji ya yi fushi a Tabera, a Massa da kuma a Kibrot Hatta’awa.
english: At Taberah, at Massah, and at Kibroth Hattaavah you provoked Yahweh to wrath.

hausa: A lokacin da Yesu ya yi rayuwa a duniya, ya yi addu’o’i da roƙe-roƙe tare da kuka mai zafi da kuma hawaye ga wannan wanda yake da ikon cetonsa daga mutuwa, aka kuwa ji shi saboda tsananin bangirman da ya yi.
english: He, in the days of his flesh, having offered up prayers and petitions with strong crying and tears to him who was able to save him from death, and having been heard for his godly fear,

hausa: Laifofinku sun raba ku da waɗannan abubuwa; zunubanku sun hana ku samun alheri.
english: “Your iniquities have turned away these things, and your sins have withheld good from you.

hausa: Bari yabon Allah yă kasance a bakunansu takobi mai kaifi kuma a hannuwansu,
english: May the high praises of God be in their mouths, and a two-edged sword in their hand,

hausa: Jimillar ’ya’yan fari maza daga wata ɗaya da kuma fiye, da aka rubuta bisa ga sunayensu, 22,273 ne.
english: All the firstborn males according to the number of names from a month old and upward, of those who were counted of them, were twenty-two thousand two hundred seventy-three.

hausa: Wani daga cikin annabawansu ma ya ce, “Kiretawa a kullum maƙaryata ne, mugayen dabbobi, ragwaye haɗamammu.”
english: One of them, a prophet of their own, said, “Cretans are always liars, evil beasts, and idle gluttons.”

hausa: Bayan Ubangiji ya gaya wa Ayuba waɗannan abubuwa, ya ce wa Elifaz mutumin Teman, “Ina fushi da kai da abokanka guda biyu domin ba ku faɗi abin da yake daidai game da ni ba, kamar yadda bawana Ayuba ya yi.
english: It was so, that after Yahweh had spoken these words to Job, Yahweh said to Eliphaz the Temanite, “My wrath is kindled against you, and against your two friends; for you have not spoken of me the thing that is right, as my servant Job has.

hausa: Ubangiji yana tare da ni; ba zan ji tsoro ba. Me mutum zai yi mini?
english: Yahweh is on my side. I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?

hausa: Biranen da suke a filayen kwari su ne, Eshtawol, Zora; Ashna,
english: In the lowland, Eshtaol, Zorah, Ashnah,

hausa: A wannan rana mutane za su nemi Mahaliccinsu su kuma juye idanunsu ga Mai Tsarkin nan na Isra’ila.
english: In that day, people will look to their Maker, and their eyes will have respect for the Holy One of Israel.

hausa: ɗansa na fari kuwa shi ne Abdon, sai Zur, Kish, Ba’al, Ner, Nadab,
english: His firstborn son was Abdon, then Zur, Kish, Baal, Ner, Nadab,

hausa: Ya ga cewa babu wani, ya yi mamaki cewa babu wanda zai shiga tsakani; saboda haka hannunsa ya aikata masa ceto, adalcinsa kuma ya raya shi.
english: He saw that there was no man, and wondered that there was no intercessor. Therefore his own arm brought salvation to him; and his righteousness sustained him.

hausa: Matuƙan jirgin suka ce wa juna, “Ku zo, mu jefa ƙuri’a mu ga wa ke da alhakin wannan masifa.” Sai suka jefa ƙuri’a, ƙuri’ar kuwa ta fāɗa a kan Yunana.
english: They all said to each other, “Come! Let’s cast lots, that we may know who is responsible for this evil that is on us.” So they cast lots, and the lot fell on Jonah.

hausa: Aka kuma binne ƙasusuwan Yusuf da aka kawo daga Masar, a Shekem a wurin da Yaƙub ya saya da azurfa ɗari daga ’ya’yan Hamor, babban Shekem. Wurin ya zama gādon zuriyar Yusuf.
english: They buried the bones of Joseph, which the children of Israel brought up out of Egypt, in Shechem, in the parcel of ground which Jacob bought from the sons of Hamor the father of Shechem for a hundred pieces of silver. They became the inheritance of the children of Joseph.

hausa: Ta wurin yin adalci sarki kan sa ƙasa tă yi ƙarƙo amma duk mai haɗama don cin hanci kan rushe ƙasar.
english: The king by justice makes the land stable, but he who takes bribes tears it down.

hausa: Har yă zuwa wannan sa’a, yunwa da ƙishirwa muke ciki, muna sanye da tsummoki, ana wulaƙanta mu, ba mu kuma da gida.
english: Even to this present hour we hunger, thirst, are naked, are beaten, and have no certain dwelling place.

hausa: Absalom ya gudu ya tafi wurin Talmai ɗan Ammihud, sarkin Geshur. Amma Sarki Dawuda ya yi ta makokin ɗansa kowace rana.
english: But Absalom fled and went to Talmai the son of Ammihur, king of Geshur. David mourned for his son every day.

hausa: Suka firgita, suka tsorota, suna tsammani fatalwa ce suka gani.
english: But they were terrified and filled with fear, and supposed that they had seen a spirit.

hausa: Sai Yesu ya amsa ya ce, “Ku daina gunaguni a junanku.
english: Therefore Jesus answered them, “Don’t murmur among yourselves.

hausa: Yayinda ni, Daniyel, nake duban wahayi ina ƙoƙari in fahimce shi, sai ga wani a gabana wanda ya yi kama da mutum.
english: When I, even I Daniel, had seen the vision, I sought to understand it. Then behold, there stood before me someone with the appearance of a man.

hausa: “Zan koya muku game da ikon Allah; ba zan ɓoye hanyoyin Maɗaukaki ba.
english: I will teach you about the hand of God. I will not conceal that which is with the Almighty.

hausa: Zan hana ƙwari su cinye hatsinku. Kuringar inabi a gonakinku kuma ba za su zubar da ’ya’yansu kafin su nuna ba,” in ji Ubangiji Maɗaukaki.
english: I will rebuke the devourer for your sakes, and he shall not destroy the fruits of your ground; neither shall your vine cast its fruit before its time in the field,” says Yahweh of Armies.

hausa: Ta biye kuma kamar ta farkon take. ‘Ka ƙaunaci maƙwabcinka kamar kanka.’
english: A second likewise is this, ‘You shall love your neighbor as yourself.’

hausa: Saboda haka Laban ya tara dukan mutanen wurin, ya yi biki.
english: Laban gathered together all the men of the place, and made a feast.

hausa: Ka yi fama, kyakkyawar fama ta bangaskiya. Ka riƙi rai madawwamin nan, wanda aka kira saboda shi, sa’ad da ka yi kyakkyawar shaida a gaban shaidu masu yawa.
english: Fight the good fight of faith. Take hold of the eternal life to which you were called, and you confessed the good confession in the sight of many witnesses.

hausa: Sa’an nan sarkin Arewa zai kai wa sarkin Kudu hari, amma zai janye, yă koma ƙasarsa.
english: He will come into the realm of the king of the south, but he will return into his own land.

hausa: A wannan rana bayin Ishaku suka zo suka faɗa masa game da rijiyar da suka haƙa. Suka ce, “Mun sami ruwa!”
english: The same day, Isaac’s servants came, and told him concerning the well which they had dug, and said to him, “We have found water.”

hausa: Sai ya amsa ya ce, “Na ga Shaiɗan ya fāɗi daga sama kamar walƙiya.
english: He said to them, “I saw Satan having fallen like lightning from heaven.

hausa: Ya kafa mayaƙa a dukan biranen katangar Yahuda, ya kuma sa runduna a Yahuda da kuma a garuruwan Efraim da mahaifinsa Asa ya ci da yaƙi.
english: He placed forces in all the fortified cities of Judah, and set garrisons in the land of Judah and in the cities of Ephraim, which Asa his father had taken.

hausa: Kowane hannu zai raunana, kowace gwiwa kuma za tă zama marar ƙarfi kamar ruwa.
english: All hands will be feeble, and all knees will be weak as water.

hausa: “A cikin wahalata na yi kira ga Ubangiji; na yi kira ga Allahna. Daga cikin haikalinsa ya saurare muryata; kukata ta zo kunnensa.
english: In my distress, I called on Yahweh. Yes, I called to my God. He heard my voice out of his temple. My cry came into his ears.

hausa: Dukan waɗanda suke riƙe da matuƙi za su ƙyale jiragensu; ma’aikatan jirage da dukan matuƙan jirage za su tsaya a bakin teku.
english: All who handle the oars, the mariners and all the pilots of the sea, will come down from their ships. They will stand on the land,

hausa: Yayinda Solomon yake tsufa, matansa suka juye zuciyarsa ga bin waɗansu alloli, zuciyarsa kuwa ba tă bi Ubangiji Allahnsa ɗungum kamar yadda zuciyar Dawuda mahaifinsa ta kasance ba.
english: When Solomon was old, his wives turned away his heart after other gods; and his heart was not perfect with Yahweh his God, as the heart of David his father was.

hausa: dole maigidansa yă kai shi gaban alƙalai. Zai kai shi ƙofa ko madogarar ƙofa, yă huda kunnensa da basilla, sa’an nan zai zama bawansa duk tsawon kwanakinsa a duniya.
english: then his master shall bring him to God, and shall bring him to the door or to the doorpost, and his master shall bore his ear through with an awl, and he shall serve him forever.

hausa: Ya ce musu, “Ku dube ni, ku bi abin da na yi. Sa’ad da na kai sansanin, ku yi daidai abin da na yi.
english: He said to them, “Watch me, and do likewise. Behold, when I come to the outermost part of the camp, it shall be that, as I do, so you shall do.

hausa: tare da katakai a fiƙe ɗaura da juna. Haka suka yi da dukan katakan tabanakul.
english: Each board had two tenons, joined to one another. He made all the boards of the tabernacle this way.

hausa: Za ka ci gaba da fushi da mu har abada ne? Za ka ja fushinka cikin dukan tsararraki?
english: Will you be angry with us forever? Will you draw out your anger to all generations?

hausa: don a yi shelar ƙaunarka da safe amincinka kuma da dare,
english: to proclaim your loving kindness in the morning, and your faithfulness every night,

hausa: Abner ya waiga, sai ya ce, “Kai ne, Asahel?” Ya ce, “Ni ne.”
english: Then Abner looked behind him and said, “Is that you, Asahel?” He answered, “It is.”

hausa: Za a yi kuka a dukan gonakin inabi, gama zan ratsa a cikinku,” in ji Ubangiji.
english: In all vineyards there will be wailing, for I will pass through the middle of you,” says Yahweh.

hausa: Masu tsaron haikali. Zuriyar Shallum, Ater, Talmon, Akkub, Hatita, da Shobai mutum 139.
english: The children of the gatekeepers: the children of Shallum, the children of Ater, the children of Talmon, the children of Akkub, the children of Hatita, the children of Shobai, in all one hundred thirty-nine.

hausa: Da mutanen na barin Yesu, sai Bitrus ya ce masa, “Ubangiji, ya yi kyau da muke nan. Bari mu kafa bukkoki guda uku, wato, ɗaya dominka, ɗaya domin Musa, ɗaya kuma domin Iliya.” (Bai ma san abin da yake faɗi ba.)
english: As they were parting from him, Peter said to Jesus, “Master, it is good for us to be here. Let’s make three tents: one for you, one for Moses, and one for Elijah,” not knowing what he said.

hausa: Lokacin da yake shi kaɗai, Sha Biyun, da kuma waɗanda suke kewaye da shi, suka tambaye shi game da misalan.
english: When he was alone, those who were around him with the twelve asked him about the parables.

hausa: Yaƙub ɗan Zebedi da kuma ɗan’uwansa Yohanna (ga waɗannan kuwa ya sa musu suna Buwarnajis, wato, “’ya’yan tsawa”);
english: James the son of Zebedee; and John, the brother of James, (whom he called Boanerges, which means, Sons of Thunder);

hausa: Saboda haka sa’ad da Yusuf ya zo wurin ’yan’uwansa, sai suka tuɓe masa rigarsa, rigan nan mai gwanin kyau da ya sa,
english: When Joseph came to his brothers, they stripped Joseph of his tunic, the tunic of many colors that was on him;

hausa: Iliya ya ce mata, “Kada ki ji tsoro. Ki tafi gida, ki yi yadda kika ce. Amma da farko ki yi mini ’yar wainar burodi daga abin da kike da shi ki kawo mini, sa’an nan ki yi wani abu wa kanki da kuma ɗanki.
english: Elijah said to her, “Don’t be afraid. Go and do as you have said; but make me a little cake from it first, and bring it out to me, and afterward make some for you and for your son.

hausa: Ya ɗauki dokokin Alkawari ya sa a cikin akwatin, ya kuma zura sandunan a zoban akwatin, sa’an nan ya sa murfin kafara a bisansa.
english: He took and put the covenant into the ark, and set the poles on the ark, and put the mercy seat above on the ark.

hausa: Akwatin Alkawarin ya daɗe a Kiriyat Yeyarim ya kai shekara ashirin cif. Sai dukan mutanen Isra’ila suka yi makoki suka nemi Ubangiji.
english: From the day that the ark stayed in Kiriath Jearim, the time was long—for it was twenty years; and all the house of Israel lamented after Yahweh.

hausa: Zan ba da Mowabawa tare da Ammonawa ga mutanen Gabas abin mallaka, don kada a ƙara tuna da Ammonawa a cikin al’ummai;
english: to the children of the east, to go against the children of Ammon; and I will give them for a possession, that the children of Ammon may not be remembered among the nations.

hausa: Ba zan ƙara bari ku ji maganar banza ta al’ummai ba, ba kuwa za ku ƙara shan ba’ar mutane ko in sa al’ummarku ta fāɗi ba, in ji Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka.’ ”
english: “I won’t let you hear the shame of the nations any more. You won’t bear the reproach of the peoples any more, and you won’t cause your nation to stumble any more,” says the Lord Yahweh.’”

hausa: Zan zub da hasalata a kanka in hura maka wutar fushina; Zan ba da kai a hannun mugayen mutanen da suka gwanince a hallakarwa.
english: I will pour out my indignation on you. I will blow on you with the fire of my wrath. I will deliver you into the hand of brutish men, skillful to destroy.

hausa: Ya zama kuwa sa’ad da Musa yake masauki a kan hanya sai Ubangiji ya gamu da shi, ya nema ya kashe shi.
english: On the way at a lodging place, Yahweh met Moses and wanted to kill him.

hausa: zuciyata ta ƙara zafi a cikina. Kuma sa’ad da nake tunani, wuta ta yi ta kuna; sai na yi magana da harshena na ce,
english: My heart was hot within me. While I meditated, the fire burned. I spoke with my tongue:

hausa: Ba za ka ji tsoron razanar dare, ko kibiyoyi da suke firiya da rana ba,
english: You shall not be afraid of the terror by night, nor of the arrow that flies by day,

hausa: Matarsa mutumin kuwa ta kawo tabarma ta shimfiɗa a bakin rijiyar, sai ta kawo hatsi ta baza a kanta. Ba kuwa wanda ya san abin da ta yi.
english: The woman took and spread the covering over the well’s mouth, and spread out crushed grain on it; and nothing was known.

hausa: Tufafinku ba su yayyage ba, ƙafafunku kuma ba su kumbura ba a waɗannan shekaru arba’in.
english: Your clothing didn’t grow old on you, neither did your foot swell, these forty years.

hausa: Cikin tashin hankali, ka jefa ni cikin zurfafa, a tsakiyar teku, ka kuma jujjuya ni a cikin ruwa; dukan raƙuman ruwanka da ambaliyarka sun bi ta kaina.
english: For you threw me into the depths, in the heart of the seas. The flood was all around me. All your waves and your billows passed over me.

hausa: Sai wata mata mai hikima ta yi kira daga ciki birnin ta ce, “Ku saurara! Ku saurara! Ku gaya wa Yowab yă zo nan ina so in yi magana da shi.”
english: Then a wise woman cried out of the city, “Hear, hear! Please say to Joab, ‘Come near here, that I may speak with you.’”

hausa: Ƙaunarsu, ƙiyayyarsu, da kuma kishinsu tuni sun ɓace; ba za su taɓa zama sashen wani abin da yake faruwa a duniya ba.
english: Also their love, their hatred, and their envy has perished long ago; neither do they any longer have a portion forever in anything that is done under the sun.

hausa: In ta hidima ce; sai yă yi hidima. In kuma ta koyarwa ce, sai yă koyar;
english: or service, let’s give ourselves to service; or he who teaches, to his teaching;

hausa: ’Ya’yan Mika maza su ne, Fiton, Melek, Tareya da Ahaz.
english: The sons of Micah: Pithon, Melech, Tahrea, and Ahaz.

hausa: Maƙiyanta sun zama shugabanninta; Abokan gābanta suna da kwanciyar rai. Ubangiji ya kawo mata ɓacin rai domin yawan zunubanta. ’Ya’yanta sun tafi bauta, a ƙarƙashin maƙiyanta.
english: Her adversaries have become the head. Her enemies prosper; for Yahweh has afflicted her for the multitude of her transgressions. Her young children have gone into captivity before the adversary.

hausa: “Ka yi magana da Isra’ilawa, ka ce musu, ‘Bayan kun shiga ƙasar da nake ba ku a matsayin gida,
english: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘When you have come into the land of your habitations, which I give to you,

hausa: Bayan ta faɗa haka kuwa, sai ta koma ta je ta kira ’yar’uwarta Maryamu a gefe. Ta ce, “Ga Malam ya zo, kuma yana kiranki.”
english: When she had said this, she went away and called Mary, her sister, secretly, saying, “The Teacher is here and is calling you.”

hausa: Amma ba su san cewa matattu suna a can ba, cewa baƙinta suna a can cikin zurfin kabari ba.
english: But he doesn’t know that the departed spirits are there, that her guests are in the depths of Sheol.

hausa: Aka kore shi daga cikin mutane aka kuma ba shi tunani irin na dabba; ya yi zama tare da jakunan jeji, ya kuma ci ciyawa kamar shanu; jikinsa kuma ya jiƙe da raɓa, har zuwa lokacin da ya gane, ashe, Allah Maɗaukaki ne mai iko duka a kan dukan mulkoki a duniya, yake kuma ba da mulki ga duk wanda ya ga dama.
english: He was driven from the sons of men, and his heart was made like the animals’, and his dwelling was with the wild donkeys. He was fed with grass like oxen, and his body was wet with the dew of the sky, until he knew that the Most High God rules in the kingdom of men, and that he sets up over it whomever he will.

hausa: Ga waɗanda suke da aure kuwa ina ba da wannan umarni (ba ni ba, amma Ubangiji) cewa kada mace ta rabu da mijinta.
english: But to the married I command—not I, but the Lord—that the wife not leave her husband

hausa: Zuriyar Yusuf bisa ga kabilansu ta wurin Manasse da Efraim.
english: The sons of Joseph after their families: Manasseh and Ephraim.

hausa: Ba’ala, Iyim, Ezem,
english: Baalah, Iim, Ezem,

hausa: ya ce musu, “Ku je ƙauyen da yake gaba da ku, da shigarku, za ku tarar da wani ɗan jaki a daure a can, wanda ba wanda ya taɓa hawa. Ku kunce shi ku kawo nan.
english: and said to them, “Go your way into the village that is opposite you. Immediately as you enter into it, you will find a young donkey tied, on which no one has sat. Untie him and bring him.

hausa: Yaya matashi zai kiyaye hanyarsa da tsabta? Sai ta yin rayuwa bisa ga maganarka.
english: How can a young man keep his way pure? By living according to your word.

hausa: Geyuwel ɗan Maki, daga kabilar Gad.
english: Of the tribe of Gad, Geuel the son of Machi.

hausa: Kamar kamannin bakan gizo a cikin gizagizai a ranar da aka yi ruwan sama, haka hasken da ya kewaye shi. Wannan shi ne kwatancin kamannin ɗaukakar Ubangiji. Sa’ad da na gani, sai na fāɗi rubda ciki, na kuma ji muryar wani tana magana.
english: As the appearance of the rainbow that is in the cloud in the day of rain, so was the appearance of the brightness all around. This was the appearance of the likeness of Yahweh’s glory. When I saw it, I fell on my face, and I heard a voice of one that spoke.

hausa: Mutanen da ba ku sani ba za su ci kayan gonarku da amfanin wahalarku, za a yi ta cucinku, ana kuma danne ku kullum.
english: A nation which you don’t know will eat the fruit of your ground and all of your work. You will only be oppressed and crushed always,

hausa: Na biyar don wata na biyar, shi ne Shamhut mutumin Izhar shugaban mayaƙa. Akwai mutane 24,000 a sashensa.
english: The fifth captain for the fifth month was Shamhuth the Izrahite. In his division were twenty-four thousand.

hausa: A’a, ai, abin da aka yi magana ta bakin annabi Yowel ke nan cewa,
english: But this is what has been spoken through the prophet Joel:

hausa: da rabin Gileyad, da Ashtarot, Edireyi (biranen sarki Og a Bashan). Wannan shi ne rabon da zuriyar Makir ɗan Manasse suka samu, domin rabin ’ya’yan Makir maza, bisa ga iyalansu.
english: Half Gilead, Ashtaroth, and Edrei, the cities of the kingdom of Og in Bashan, were for the children of Machir the son of Manasseh, even for the half of the children of Machir according to their families.

hausa: Waɗansu suka ce shi mana. Waɗansu kuwa suka ce, “A’a, ya dai yi kama da shi.” Amma shi ɗin ya ce, “Ƙwarai kuwa ni ne.”
english: Others were saying, “It is he.” Still others were saying, “He looks like him.” He said, “I am he.”

hausa: Amma Yahuda ya ce masa, “Mutumin ya gargaɗe mu sosai cewa, ‘Ba za ku sāke ganin fuskata ba sai in ɗan’uwanku yana tare da ku.’
english: Judah spoke to him, saying, “The man solemnly warned us, saying, ‘You shall not see my face, unless your brother is with you.’

hausa: Saboda haka Yefta ya tsere daga ’yan’uwansa ya zauna a ƙasar Tob, inda waɗansu ’yan iska suka kewaye shi suka bi shi.
english: Then Jephthah fled from his brothers and lived in the land of Tob. Outlaws joined up with Jephthah, and they went out with him.

hausa: Bayan ɗan lokaci kaɗan, wani dabam ya gan shi ya ce, “Kai ma ɗayansu ne.” Bitrus ya amsa ya ce, “Kai, ba na cikinsu!”
english: After a little while someone else saw him and said, “You also are one of them!” But Peter answered, “Man, I am not!”

hausa: haka za ka kore su da iska mai ƙarfi ka kuma firgita su da guguwarka.
english: so pursue them with your tempest, and terrify them with your storm.

hausa: Kowace rana akan ba shi kyauta bisa ga umarnin sarkin Babilon, saboda bukatarsa. Haka aka yi masa har rasuwarsa.
english: For his allowance, there was a continual allowance given him by the king of Babylon, every day a portion until the day of his death, all the days of his life.

hausa: “Kusa da yankin Yahuda daga gabas zuwa yamma zai zama rabon da za ku bayar a matsayin kyauta ta musamman. Faɗinsa zai zama kamu 25,000, tsawonsa kuma zai zama daidai da tsawon yankunan kabilu daga gabas zuwa yamma; wuri mai tsarki zai kasance a tsakiyar wannan yanki.
english: “By the border of Judah, from the east side to the west side, shall be the offering which you shall offer, twenty-five thousand reeds in width, and in length as one of the portions, from the east side to the west side; and the sanctuary shall be in the middle of it.

hausa: matasan da suka gan ni sukan ja gefe tsofaffi kuma suka tashi tsaye;
english: The young men saw me and hid themselves. The aged rose up and stood.

hausa: Saboda haka suka aika wa Yusuf suna cewa, “Mahaifinka ya bar waɗannan umarnai kafin yă rasu.
english: They sent a message to Joseph, saying, “Your father commanded before he died, saying,

hausa: Duba, ga wani mutum tafe a keken yaƙin tare da ƙungiyar dawakai. Ya kuma mayar da amsa, ‘Babilon ta fāɗi, ta fāɗi! Dukan siffofin allolinta kwance a ragargaje a ƙasa!’ ”
english: Behold, here comes a troop of men, horsemen in pairs.” He answered, “Fallen, fallen is Babylon; and all the engraved images of her gods are broken to the ground.

hausa: Saboda haka na ba da su ga zukatansu da suka taurare don su bi dabararsu.
english: So I let them go after the stubbornness of their hearts, that they might walk in their own counsels.

hausa: Kakanninmu sun gangaro zuwa Masar, muka zauna can shekaru da yawa. Masarawa suka wulaƙanta mu, da kuma kakanninmu,
english: how our fathers went down into Egypt, and we lived in Egypt a long time. The Egyptians mistreated us and our fathers.

hausa: Da Shishak sarkin Masar ya yaƙi Urushalima, sai ya kwashi ma’ajin haikalin Ubangiji da kuma ma’ajin fadan sarki. Ya kwashe kome da kome, har da garkuwoyin zinariyar da Solomon ya yi.
english: So Shishak king of Egypt came up against Jerusalem and took away the treasures of Yahweh’s house and the treasures of the king’s house. He took it all away. He also took away the shields of gold which Solomon had made.

hausa: Ya yi tunani, “In Isuwa ya zo ya fāɗa wa ƙungiya ɗaya, sai ƙungiya ɗayan da ta ragu ta tsira.”
english: He said, “If Esau comes to the one company, and strikes it, then the company which is left will escape.”

hausa: Kalmomin mugu sukan kwanta suna jira su yi kisankai, amma jawabin masu aikata gaskiya kan kuɓutar da su.
english: The words of the wicked are about lying in wait for blood, but the speech of the upright rescues them.

hausa: Adalai za su haɓaka kamar itacen dabino, za su yi girma kama al’ul na Lebanon;
english: The righteous shall flourish like the palm tree. He will grow like a cedar in Lebanon.

hausa: amma yakan mutu nan da nan kuma ba ya ƙara kasancewa; ko an neme shi, ba za a same shi ba.
english: But he passed away, and behold, he was not. Yes, I sought him, but he could not be found.

hausa: “Sa’ad da na sami Isra’ila, ya zama kamar samun inabi a hamada; sa’ad da na ga kakanninku, ya zama kamar ganin ’ya’yan itace na farko a itacen ɓaure. Amma sa’ad da suka zo Ba’al-Feyor, suka keɓe kansu wa gumaka bankunya sai suka zama abubuwan banƙyama kamar abubuwan da suke ƙauna.
english: I found Israel like grapes in the wilderness. I saw your fathers as the first ripe in the fig tree at its first season; but they came to Baal Peor, and consecrated themselves to the shameful thing, and became abominable like that which they loved.

hausa: To, Absalom ya haɗu da mutanen Dawuda. Yana hawan dokinsa, kuma yayinda dokin ya kusa kai cikin rassan babban itacen oak, sai kan Absalom ya sarƙafe a kan itacen oak ɗin. Dokin ya wuce da gudu, shi kuwa ya rataye a can yana lilo.
english: Absalom happened to meet David’s servants. Absalom was riding on his mule, and the mule went under the thick boughs of a great oak; and his head caught hold of the oak, and he was hanging between the sky and earth; and the mule that was under him went on.

hausa: Ka mai da mu, ya Allah; ka sa fuskarka ta haskaka a kanmu, za mu kuwa cetu.
english: Turn us again, God. Cause your face to shine, and we will be saved.

hausa: Da yawa suna magana a kaina suna cewa, “Allah ba zai cece shi ba.” Sela
english: Many there are who say of my soul, “There is no help for him in God.” Selah.

hausa: sarkin Shimron Meron, ɗaya sarkin Akshaf, ɗaya
english: the king of Shimron Meron, one; the king of Achshaph, one;

hausa: Daga ko’ina kuke da zama, ku kawo dunƙule biyu na humushin gari mai laushi da aka tuya da yisti, a matsayin hadaya ta kaɗawa ta ’ya’yan fari na itatuwa ga Ubangiji.
english: You shall bring out of your habitations two loaves of bread for a wave offering made of two tenths of an ephah of fine flour. They shall be baked with yeast, for first fruits to Yahweh.

hausa: Sai ku ɗauki wani abin tona ƙasa, sa’ad da kuka yi bayan gari, sai ku tona rami, ku rufe bayan garinku.
english: You shall have a trowel among your weapons. It shall be, when you relieve yourself, you shall dig with it, and shall turn back and cover your excrement;

hausa: ’Ya’yan Uzziyel maza, su ne, Mishayel, Elzafan da Sitri.
english: The sons of Uzziel: Mishael, Elzaphan, and Sithri.

hausa: Kafin lokacinsa yă cika, za a gama biyansa duka, kuma rassansa ba za su ba da amfani ba.
english: It will be accomplished before his time. His branch will not be green.

hausa: “Amma ’yan hayan suka kama bayinsa; suka dūke ɗaya, suka kashe ɗaya, suka kuma jajjefi na ukun.
english: The farmers took his servants, beat one, killed another, and stoned another.

hausa: Sai ta kama shi ta rungume shi da duban soyayya a fuskarta ta ce,
english: So she caught him, and kissed him. With an impudent face she said to him:

hausa: Sa’an nan ka kira ni, zan kuwa amsa, ko kuma ka bar ni in yi magana sai ka amsa mini.
english: Then call, and I will answer, or let me speak, and you answer me.

hausa: Ubangiji ya ce wa Haruna, “Tafi cikin hamada ka sadu da Musa.” Sai ya sadu da Musa a dutsen Allah, ya sumbace shi.
english: Yahweh said to Aaron, “Go into the wilderness to meet Moses.” He went, and met him on God’s mountain, and kissed him.

hausa: Gama mun ji labarin bangaskiyarku a cikin Yesu Kiristi da kuma ƙaunar da kuke yi saboda dukan tsarkaka.
english: having heard of your faith in Christ Jesus and of the love which you have toward all the saints,

hausa: Saboda sarƙoƙina, yawancin ’yan’uwa cikin Ubangiji sun sami ƙarfafawa su yi maganar Allah gabagadi da kuma babu tsoro.
english: and that most of the brothers in the Lord, being confident through my bonds, are more abundantly bold to speak the word of God without fear.

hausa: Ki ɗaga idanunki ki duba kewaye; dukan ’ya’yanki sun taru suka kuma dawo gare ki. Muddin ina raye,” in ji Ubangiji, “Za ki yafa su duka kamar kayan ado; za ki yi ado da su, kamar amarya.
english: Lift up your eyes all around, and see: all these gather themselves together, and come to you. As I live,” says Yahweh, “you shall surely clothe yourself with them all as with an ornament, and dress yourself with them, like a bride.

hausa: Zan kware fatarinku sama ya rufe fuskarku don a iya ga tsiraicinku
english: Therefore I will also uncover your skirts on your face, and your shame will appear.

hausa: Sai aka kawo masa wani bebe kuma makaho mai aljani, Yesu kuwa ya warkar da shi, har ya iya magana ya kuma sami ganin gari.
english: Then one possessed by a demon, blind and mute, was brought to him; and he healed him, so that the blind and mute man both spoke and saw.

hausa: “Amariya, babban firist, shi ne zai shugabance ku a kan dukan al’amuran da suke na wajen Ubangiji, Zebadiya ɗan Ishmayel kuwa, shugabanku a kan dukan al’amuran da suka shafi sarki, Lawiyawa kuma za su zama a matsayin manya a gabanku. Ku yi abubuwa da ƙarfin hali, bari kuma Ubangiji yă kasance tare da masu yin gaskiya.”
english: Behold, Amariah the chief priest is over you in all matters of Yahweh; and Zebadiah the son of Ishmael, the ruler of the house of Judah, in all the king’s matters. Also the Levites shall be officers before you. Deal courageously, and may Yahweh be with the good.”

hausa: Ba za su zuba hadayun ruwan inabi ga Ubangiji ba, ba kuwa hadayunsu za su gamshe shi ba. Irin hadayun nan za su zama musu kamar burodin masu makoki; duk wanda ya ci su zai ƙazantu. Wannan abincin zai zama na kansu ne; ba zai zo cikin haikalin Ubangiji ba.
english: They won’t pour out wine offerings to Yahweh, neither will they be pleasing to him. Their sacrifices will be to them like the bread of mourners; all who eat of it will be polluted; for their bread will be for their appetite. It will not come into Yahweh’s house.

hausa: Ƙasarsu ta cika da azurfa da zinariya; dukiyarsu kuma ba iyaka. Ƙasarsu ta cika da dawakai; kekunan yaƙinsu kuma ba iyaka.
english: Their land is full of silver and gold, neither is there any end of their treasures. Their land also is full of horses, neither is there any end of their chariots.

hausa: Rikici kuma ya tashi tsakanin masu kiwon dabbobin Abram da na Lot. Mazaunan ƙasar, a lokacin kuwa Kan’aniyawa da Ferizziyawa ne.
english: There was strife between the herdsmen of Abram’s livestock and the herdsmen of Lot’s livestock. The Canaanites and the Perizzites lived in the land at that time.

hausa: Sai sarki ya umarci Benahiya ya ce, “Yi kamar yadda ya faɗa. Ka kashe shi, ka kuma binne shi, ka wanke ni da gidan mahaifina daga laifin jini marasa laifin da Yowab ya zubar.
english: The king said to him, “Do as he has said, and fall on him, and bury him, that you may take away the blood, which Joab shed without cause, from me and from my father’s house.

hausa: Suka tafi wani wurin da ake kira Getsemane, Yesu ya kuma ce wa almajiransa, “Ku zauna a nan, yayinda ni kuwa in yi addu’a.”
english: They came to a place which was named Gethsemane. He said to his disciples, “Sit here while I pray.”

hausa: Duk wanda ya yi biyayya da umarninsa ba zai sami lahani ba, zuciya mai hikima kuma zai san lokacin da ya dace da kuma hanyoyin da suka fi.
english: Whoever keeps the commandment shall not come to harm, and his wise heart will know the time and procedure.

hausa: “ ‘Kada ku yi rashin adalci cikin shari’a; kada ku nuna sonkai ga matalauci, ko ku goyi bayan mai arziki, amma ku shari’anta maƙwabci cikin gaskiya.
english: “‘You shall do no injustice in judgment. You shall not be partial to the poor, nor show favoritism to the great; but you shall judge your neighbor in righteousness.

hausa: Al’ummai za su ji game da kunyar da kika sha; kukanki zai cika duniya. Jarumi zai yi tuntuɓe a kan wani; dukansu biyu za su fāɗi tare.”
english: The nations have heard of your shame, and the earth is full of your cry; for the mighty man has stumbled against the mighty, they both fall together.”

hausa: Amma mahaifiyar yaron ta ce, “Muddin Ubangiji yana raye, kai kuma kana a raye, ba zan bar ka ba.” Saboda haka ya tashi ya bi ta.
english: The child’s mother said, “As Yahweh lives, and as your soul lives, I will not leave you.” So he arose, and followed her.

hausa: A ranar farko ta kowace mako, ya kamata kowannenku yă keɓe ’yan kuɗi bisa ga abin da yake samu, yă ajiye, ba sai na zo kafin a tara taimakon ba.
english: On the first day of every week, let each one of you save as he may prosper, that no collections are made when I come.

hausa: Yakan janye hannunsa daga zunubi ba ya kuma ba da bashi da ruwa ko karɓan riba da yawa. Yakan kiyaye dokokina ya kuma bi ƙa’idodina. Ba zai mutu saboda zunubin mahaifinsa ba; tabbatacce zai rayu.
english: who has withdrawn his hand from the poor, who hasn’t received interest or increase, has executed my ordinances, has walked in my statutes; he shall not die for the iniquity of his father. He shall surely live.

hausa: Sai ta zo ta bayansa, ta taɓa bakin rigarsa. Nan da nan, zubar da jininta ya tsaya.
english: came behind him and touched the fringe of his cloak. Immediately the flow of her blood stopped.

hausa: Gama ni ne Ubangiji Allahnka, wanda ya riƙe ka da hannun damana ya kuma ce maka, Kada ka ji tsoro; zan taimake ka.
english: For I, Yahweh your God, will hold your right hand, saying to you, ‘Don’t be afraid. I will help you.’
