hausa: Allah ba ya bukata yă ci gaba da bincike mutane, har da za su zo gabansa don yă shari’anta su.
english: For he doesn’t need to consider a man further, that he should go before God in judgment.

hausa: Ku tuna da shugabanninku, waɗanda suka faɗa muku maganar Allah. Ku dubi irin rayuwar da suka yi ku kuma yi koyi da bangaskiyarsu.
english: Remember your leaders, men who spoke to you the word of God, and considering the results of their conduct, imitate their faith.

hausa: Da zarar na aika Artemas ko Tikikus zuwa wurinka, sai ka yi iyakacin ƙoƙarinka ka zo wurina a Nikofolis, domin na yanke shawara in ci damina a can.
english: When I send Artemas to you, or Tychicus, be diligent to come to me to Nicopolis, for I have determined to winter there.

hausa: Marta ta amsa ta ce, “Na sani zai sāke tashi a tashin matattu a rana ta ƙarshe.”
english: Martha said to him, “I know that he will rise again in the resurrection at the last day.”

hausa: “Ga shi, yana nan a rubuce a gabana cewa ba zan ƙyale ba, zan yi cikakken ramuwa; zan yi ramuwa a cinyoyinsu
english: “Behold, it is written before me: I will not keep silence, but will repay, yes, I will repay into their bosom

hausa: Iyakarsu ta gabas kuwa ita ce Tekun Gishiri wadda ta zarce har zuwa gaɓar Urdun. Iyakarsu ta arewa ta fara ne daga Tekun Gishiri a bakin Urdun,
english: The east border was the Salt Sea, even to the end of the Jordan. The border of the north quarter was from the bay of the sea at the end of the Jordan.

hausa: Sa’an nan ya sallami ’yan’uwansa, yayinda suke barin wurin ya ce musu, “Kada ku yi faɗa a hanya!”
english: So he sent his brothers away, and they departed. He said to them, “See that you don’t quarrel on the way.”

hausa: Wahayin annabawanki ƙarya ne kuma marasa amfani; ba su tona zunubanki ba yadda za su iya ceto ki daga bauta ba. Sun yi miki annabcin ƙarya marar amfani.
english: Your prophets have seen false and foolish visions for you. They have not uncovered your iniquity, to reverse your captivity, but have seen for you false revelations and causes of banishment.

hausa: Suka yi amfani da shi don yin rammukan ƙofar Tentin Sujada, da bagaden tagulla tare da ragar tagulla da dukan kayayyakinsa,
english: With this he made the sockets to the door of the Tent of Meeting, the bronze altar, the bronze grating for it, all the vessels of the altar,

hausa: Da gari ya waye, sai alƙalan suka aika ma’aikatansu wajen mai gadin kurkukun da umarni cewa, “Ka saki mutanen nan.”
english: But when it was day, the magistrates sent the sergeants, saying, “Let those men go.”

hausa: duk sukan zo da nufin tā-da-na-zaune-tsaye. Ana jin tsoronsu tun ma kafin su iso suna tattara bayi kamar yashi.
english: All of them come for violence. Their hordes face forward. They gather prisoners like sand.

hausa: Wane ne zai yi gāba da mugaye domina? Wane ne zai ɗauki matsayi ya yi gāba da masu aikata mugunta domina?
english: Who will rise up for me against the wicked? Who will stand up for me against the evildoers?

hausa: Akwai kuma mutane da yawa a Isra’ila masu kuturta a zamanin annabi Elisha, amma ba ko ɗayansu da aka tsarkake sai Na’aman mutumin Suriyan nan kaɗai.”
english: There were many lepers in Israel in the time of Elisha the prophet, yet not one of them was cleansed, except Naaman, the Syrian.”

hausa: Yana cika gizagizai da lema; yana baza walƙiyarsa ta cikinsu.
english: Yes, he loads the thick cloud with moisture. He spreads abroad the cloud of his lightning.

hausa: Dukan garuruwan nan kowannensu yana kewaye da wurin kiwo.
english: Each of these cities included their pasture lands around them. It was this way with all these cities.

hausa: Kamar zaki mai haurawa daga kurmin Urdun zuwa wurin kiwo mai dausayi, zan fafare Babilon daga ƙasan nan da nan. Wane ne zaɓaɓɓen da zan naɗa domin wannan? Wane ne kamar ni da zai kalubalance ni? Kuma wanda makiyayi zai iya tsaya gāba da ni?”
english: Behold, the enemy will come up like a lion from the thickets of the Jordan against the strong habitation; for I will suddenly make them run away from it. Whoever is chosen, I will appoint him over it, for who is like me? Who will appoint me a time? Who is the shepherd who can stand before me?”

hausa: Sama’ila ya ce wa mai dahuwa, “Kawo naman da na ba ka, wannan da na ce ka ajiye dabam.”
english: Samuel said to the cook, “Bring the portion which I gave you, of which I said to you, ‘Set it aside.’”

hausa: Suna yin musu alkawarin ’yanci, yayinda su kansu bayi ne ga aikin lalata gama mutum bawa ne ga duk abin da ya mallake shi.
english: promising them liberty, while they themselves are bondservants of corruption; for a man is brought into bondage by whoever overcomes him.

hausa: Sai Yoshuwa ya aiki ’yan aika suka tafi da gudu zuwa tenti ɗin, haka kuwa suka same su a ɓoye a tentinsa, da azurfa a ƙarƙashi.
english: So Joshua sent messengers, and they ran to the tent. Behold, it was hidden in his tent, with the silver under it.

hausa: Muka ci gaba a gefen gaɓar da ƙyar har muka iso wani wurin da ake kira Kyakkyawan Mafaka, kusa da garin Laseya.
english: With difficulty sailing along it we came to a certain place called Fair Havens, near the city of Lasea.

hausa: “ ‘Domin ka riƙe ƙiyayya ta tun dā, ka kuma ba da mutanen Isra’ila domin a kashe su da takobi a lokacin masifarsu, lokacin da adadin horonsu ya cika,
english: “‘“Because you have had a perpetual hostility, and have given over the children of Israel to the power of the sword in the time of their calamity, in the time of the iniquity of the end,

hausa: Ya aikata mugunta a gaban Ubangiji, domin ya yi tafiya a hanyoyin mahaifinsa da na mahaifiyarsa, da kuma a hanyoyin Yerobowam ɗan Nebat, wanda ya sa Isra’ila suka yi zunubi.
english: He did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight, and walked in the way of his father, and in the way of his mother, and in the way of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, in which he made Israel to sin.

hausa: Ka furta su masu laifi, ya Allah! Bari makircinsu yă zama fāɗuwarsu. Ka kore su saboda yawan zunubansu, saboda sun tayar maka.
english: Hold them guilty, God. Let them fall by their own counsels. Thrust them out in the multitude of their transgressions, for they have rebelled against you.

hausa: Ka tashi, Ubangiji! Ka hukunta miyagu, ya Allah. Kada ka manta da marasa ƙarfi.
english: Arise, Yahweh! God, lift up your hand! Don’t forget the helpless.

hausa: Sai Siman Bitrus ya ce musu, “Za ni kamun kifi,” suka ce, “Za mu tafi tare da kai.” Saboda haka suka fita suka shiga jirgin ruwa, amma a daren nan ba su kama kome ba.
english: Simon Peter said to them, “I’m going fishing.” They told him, “We are also coming with you.” They immediately went out and entered into the boat. That night, they caught nothing.

hausa: zan aika da ruwan sama a lokacinsa, ƙasa kuma za tă ba da hatsi, itatuwa kuma za su haihu ’ya’yansu.
english: then I will give you your rains in their season, and the land shall yield its increase, and the trees of the field shall yield their fruit.

hausa: Isra’ilawa suka tafi suka yi yadda Ubangiji ya umarci Musa da Haruna.
english: The children of Israel went and did so; as Yahweh had commanded Moses and Aaron, so they did.

hausa: Sa’an nan za ka bi hanyarka lafiya, ƙafarka kuwa ba zai yi tuntuɓe ba;
english: Then you shall walk in your way securely. Your foot won’t stumble.

hausa: In mutum ya sami maƙiyinsa, zai bar shi yă tafi lafiya ba tare da yin masa rauni ba? Ubangiji yă sāka maka, gama ka nuna mini alheri a yau.
english: For if a man finds his enemy, will he let him go away unharmed? Therefore may Yahweh reward you good for that which you have done to me today.

hausa: Yosiya ya kawo dukan firistoci daga garuruwan Yahuda, ya kuma lalatar da masujadan kan tuddai daga Geba har zuwa Beyersheba, inda firistoci suke ƙona turare. Ya rurrushe matsafai a ƙofofi shigan gari na mashigi zuwa Ƙofar Yoshuwa, gwamnan birnin, wanda yake a hagu da ƙofar birnin.
english: He brought all the priests out of the cities of Judah, and defiled the high places where the priests had burned incense, from Geba to Beersheba; and he broke down the high places of the gates that were at the entrance of the gate of Joshua the governor of the city, which were on a man’s left hand at the gate of the city.

hausa: Gama abin da kuka nema daga Ubangiji Allahnku ke nan a Horeb, a ranar taro, sa’ad da kuka ce, “Kada ka bari mu ji muryar Ubangiji Allahnmu, ko mu ƙara ganin wuta mai girma, in ba haka ba, za mu mutu.”
english: This is according to all that you desired of Yahweh your God in Horeb in the day of the assembly, saying, “Let me not hear again Yahweh my God’s voice, neither let me see this great fire any more, that I not die.”

hausa: Don mai bi da kaɗe-kaɗe. Na ’ya’yan Kora maza. Zabura ce. Ku ji wannan, dukanku mutane; ku saurara, dukanku waɗanda suke zama a wannan duniya,
english: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by the sons of Korah. Hear this, all you peoples. Listen, all you inhabitants of the world,

hausa: Gama kai, ya Ubangiji, ka ceci raina daga mutuwa, idanuna daga hawaye, ƙafafuna daga tuntuɓe,
english: For you have delivered my soul from death, my eyes from tears, and my feet from falling.

hausa: Wannan zai zama rabon Haruna da ’ya’yansa maza daga Isra’ilawa. Gama wannan hadaya ta ɗagawa ce daga cikin hadayu na salama da Isra’ilawa za su miƙa wa Ubangiji.
english: It shall be for Aaron and his sons as their portion forever from the children of Israel; for it is a wave offering. It shall be a wave offering from the children of Israel of the sacrifices of their peace offerings, even their wave offering to Yahweh.

hausa: “Ka tabbatar ba ka ƙidaya mutanen Lawi ko kuma ka haɗe su tare a ƙidayan sauran Isra’ilawa ba.
english: “Only the tribe of Levi you shall not count, neither shall you take a census of them among the children of Israel;

hausa: Sai Esta ta aika da wannan amsa ga Mordekai cewa,
english: Then Esther asked them to answer Mordecai,

hausa: “Kada ku saurari Hezekiya. Ga abin da sarkin Assuriya ya faɗa. Ku nemi salama da ni ku kuma fito zuwa wurina. Ta haka kowa zai ci daga kuringarsa da kuma itacen ɓaurensa ya kuma sha ruwa daga tankinsa,
english: Don’t listen to Hezekiah, for the king of Assyria says, ‘Make your peace with me, and come out to me; and each of you eat from his vine, and each one from his fig tree, and each one of you drink the waters of his own cistern;

hausa: “Kai ne Ubangiji Allah, wanda ya zaɓi Abram, ya fitar da shi daga Ur na Kaldiyawa, ya kuma ba shi suna Ibrahim.
english: You are Yahweh, the God who chose Abram, brought him out of Ur of the Chaldees, gave him the name of Abraham,

hausa: “Saboda haka kada ka yi addu’a don wannan mutane ko ka yi wani kuka ko roƙo dominsu, gama ba zan ji ka ba.
english: “Therefore don’t pray for this people. Don’t lift up a cry or prayer for them or make intercession to me; for I will not hear you.

hausa: Da Shawulu ya ga yadda yake cin nasara, sai ya ji tsoronsa.
english: When Saul saw that he behaved himself very wisely, he stood in awe of him.

hausa: Ba zai shiga inda akwai gawa ba. Kada yă ƙazantar da kansa, ko ma ta mahaifinsa ce ko ta mahaifiyarsa.
english: He must not go in to any dead body, or defile himself for his father or for his mother.

hausa: “Mayaƙansa za su taso su ƙazantar da kagarar haikali za su kuma kawar da hadaya ta kullum. Sa’an nan za su kafa abin banƙyama da yake lalatarwa.
english: “Forces from him will profane the sanctuary, even the fortress, and will take away the continual burnt offering. Then they will set up the abomination that makes desolate.

hausa: Iliya ya ji tsoro, ya gudu don yă ceci ransa. Sa’ad da ya kai Beyersheba a Yahuda, sai ya bar bawansa a can.
english: When he saw that, he arose and ran for his life, and came to Beersheba, which belongs to Judah, and left his servant there.

hausa: Don mai bi da kaɗe-kaɗe. Mai muryar “Kada A Hallaka.” Zabura ta Asaf. Waƙa ce. Muna maka godiya, ya Allah, muna maka godiya, gama Sunanka yana kusa; mutane na faɗin ayyukanka masu banmamaki.
english: For the Chief Musician. To the tune of “Do Not Destroy.” A Psalm by Asaph. A song. We give thanks to you, God. We give thanks, for your Name is near. Men tell about your wondrous works.

hausa: Ya sa ƙafafun keken yaƙinsu suka fita don su kāsa tuƙi. Sai Masarawa suka ce, “Bari mu gudu daga Isra’ilawa gama Ubangiji yana yaƙi dominsu gāba da Masar.”
english: He took off their chariot wheels, and they drove them heavily; so that the Egyptians said, “Let’s flee from the face of Israel, for Yahweh fights for them against the Egyptians!”

hausa: Abimelek ya kore shi, mutane da yawa suka ji ciwo a yaƙin, har zuwa ƙofar birnin.
english: Abimelech chased him, and he fled before him, and many fell wounded, even to the entrance of the gate.

hausa: Duk lokacin da mugun ruhun ya kama shi, yakan jefa shi a ƙasa. Bakinsa yakan yi kumfa, yă cije haƙorarsa, yakan sa jikinsa ya sandare, yă zama da ƙarfi. Na roƙi almajiranka su fitar da ruhun, amma ba su iya ba.”
english: and wherever it seizes him, it throws him down; and he foams at the mouth, grinds his teeth, and becomes rigid. I asked your disciples to cast it out, and they weren’t able.”

hausa: Da Ubangiji ya gan ta, sai ya ji tausayinta ya ce, “Kada ki yi kuka.”
english: When the Lord saw her, he had compassion on her and said to her, “Don’t cry.”

hausa: Ni, Daniyel, na gaji matuƙa na kuma yi rashin lafiya na kwanaki masu yawa. Sa’an nan sai na tashi na ci gaba da hidimar sarki. Wahayin ya shige mini duhu, ya fi ƙarfin fahimtata.
english: I, Daniel, fainted, and was sick for some days. Then I rose up and did the king’s business. I wondered at the vision, but no one understood it.

hausa: Suna ba’a, suna faɗin mugayen abubuwa; cikin girman kan suna barazana yin danniya.
english: They scoff and speak with malice. In arrogance, they threaten oppression.

hausa: Lamirina bai ba ni laifi ba, sai dai wannan bai mai da ni marar laifi ba. Ubangiji ne mai hukunta ni.
english: For I know nothing against myself. Yet I am not justified by this, but he who judges me is the Lord.

hausa: Da ’yan’uwansa suka sami wannan labari, sai suka tafi don su dawo da shi, suna cewa, “Ai, ya haukace.”
english: When his friends heard it, they went out to seize him; for they said, “He is insane.”

hausa: Ya Urushalima, ki wanke mugunta daga zuciyarki ki sami ceto. Har yaushe za ki zauna riƙe da mugayen tunani?
english: Jerusalem, wash your heart from wickedness, that you may be saved. How long will your evil thoughts lodge within you?

hausa: Zai sa adalcinka yă haskaka kamar hasken safiya, gaskiyarka kuma kamar rana a tsaka.
english: he will make your righteousness shine out like light, and your justice as the noon day sun.

hausa: Ahab ɗan Omri ya yi mugunta sosai a gaban Ubangiji fiye da wani daga cikin waɗanda suka riga shi.
english: Ahab the son of Omri did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight above all that were before him.

hausa: Ku furta ɗaukakarsa a cikin al’ummai, ayyukansa masu al’ajabai a cikin mutane.
english: Declare his glory among the nations, and his marvelous works among all the peoples.

hausa: Gama da ni kaina na miƙa hannuna na buge ka da jama’arka da annoba, ai, da an hallaka ku a duniya ƙaƙaf.
english: For now I would have stretched out my hand, and struck you and your people with pestilence, and you would have been cut off from the earth;

hausa: Sai Musa ya ce wa mutane, “Ku tuna da wannan rana, ranar da kuka fito daga Masar, daga ƙasar bauta, gama Ubangiji ya fito da ku da hannu mai iko. Kada ku ci wani abin da yake da yisti.
english: Moses said to the people, “Remember this day, in which you came out of Egypt, out of the house of bondage; for by strength of hand Yahweh brought you out from this place. No leavened bread shall be eaten.

hausa: Ga shi, hadarin Ubangiji zai fasu cikin hasala, iskar guguwa mai hurawa a kan kawunan mugaye.
english: Behold, Yahweh’s storm, his wrath, has gone out, a sweeping storm; it will burst on the head of the wicked.

hausa: Yakan bi da masu tawali’u cikin abin da yake daidai ya kuma koyar da su hanyoyinsa.
english: He will guide the humble in justice. He will teach the humble his way.

hausa: Ka tabbata ka san lafiyar garken tumakinka, ka mai da hankali ga garken shanunka;
english: Know well the state of your flocks, and pay attention to your herds,

hausa: Ya ce, “Wace jingina zan ba ki?” Sai ta amsa, “Hatiminka da ka rataye a wuya da kuma sandan da yake a hannunka.” Ya ba da su gare ta, ya kuma kwana da ita, sai ta yi ciki.
english: He said, “What pledge will I give you?” She said, “Your signet and your cord, and your staff that is in your hand.” He gave them to her, and came in to her, and she conceived by him.

hausa: Amma ba a bayyana mini wannan asiri saboda ina da wata hikima fiye da sauran mutane ba, sai dai domin a sanar wa sarki da fassarar, ka kuma san tunanin da ya shiga zuciyarka.
english: But as for me, this secret is not revealed to me for any wisdom that I have more than any living, but to the intent that the interpretation may be made known to the king, and that you may know the thoughts of your heart.

hausa: “Daga lokacin da za a hana miƙa hadayar ƙonawa ta yau da kullum, a kuma kafa abin banƙyama, wanda yake lalatarwa, za a yi kwana 1,290.
english: “From the time that the continual burnt offering is taken away and the abomination that makes desolate set up, there will be one thousand two hundred ninety days.

hausa: Ƙarfi da mutunci su ne suturarta; za tă iya yin dariyar kwanaki masu zuwa.
english: Strength and dignity are her clothing. She laughs at the time to come.

hausa: Ƙasar za tă yi makoki, kowane iyali zai yi makoki a ware, tare da matansu su ma a ware, iyalin gidan Dawuda da matansu, iyalin gidan Natan da matansu,
english: The land will mourn, every family apart; the family of David’s house apart, and their wives apart; the family of the house of Nathan apart, and their wives apart;

hausa: Duk abin da mai ƙazanta ya taɓa, ya ƙazantu, kowa kuma ya taɓa wannan abu, ya ƙazantu ke nan, har yamma.”
english: “Whatever the unclean person touches shall be unclean; and the soul that touches it shall be unclean until evening.”

hausa: Maigidan wannan bawa zai dawo a ranar da bai yi tsammani ba, a sa’ar kuma da bai sani ba.
english: the lord of that servant will come in a day when he doesn’t expect it and in an hour when he doesn’t know it,

hausa: Ga shi shekaru biyu ke nan ake yunwa a ƙasar, kuma da sauran shekara biyar masu zuwa da ba za a yi noma ko girbi ba.
english: For these two years the famine has been in the land, and there are yet five years, in which there will be no plowing and no harvest.

hausa: Idan ya hana ruwan sama, za a yi fări; in kuma ya saki ruwa za a yi ambaliya.
english: Behold, he withholds the waters, and they dry up. Again, he sends them out, and they overturn the earth.

hausa: Yara sukan tara itace, iyaye suka hura wuta, mata kuma sukan kwaɓa kullu don su yi wa Sarauniyar Sama waina. Sukan miƙa hadayun sha ga waɗansu alloli don su tsokane ni in yi fushi.
english: The children gather wood, and the fathers kindle the fire, and the women knead the dough, to make cakes to the queen of the sky, and to pour out drink offerings to other gods, that they may provoke me to anger.

hausa: Yayinda nake duba, kerubobin suka buɗe fikafikansu suka kuma tashi daga ƙasa, yayinda suka tafi kuwa, da’irorin suka tafi tare da su. Suka tsaya a mashigin ƙofar gabas na gidan Ubangiji, ɗaukakar Allah na Isra’ila kuwa yana a kansu.
english: The cherubim lifted up their wings and mounted up from the earth in my sight when they went out, with the wheels beside them. Then they stood at the door of the east gate of Yahweh’s house; and the glory of the God of Israel was over them above.

hausa: Ni dai matalauci ne da mai bukata; bari Ubangiji yă tuna da ni. Kai ne taimakona da mai cetona; Ya Allahna, kada ka jinkirta.
english: But I am poor and needy. May the Lord think about me. You are my help and my deliverer. Don’t delay, my God.

hausa: Dā mu ’yan’uwa ne goma sha biyu, ’ya’yan mahaifi guda maza. Ɗayanmu ya rasu, kuma ƙaramin yanzu yana tare da mahaifinmu a Kan’ana.’
english: We are twelve brothers, sons of our father; one is no more, and the youngest is today with our father in the land of Canaan.’

hausa: Sai Ehud ya matso yayinda shi kuwa yake zaune shi kaɗai a ɗakin sama mai sanyi a fadansa ya ce, “Ina da saƙo daga wurin Allah dominka.” Sarki ya tashi daga kujerarsa,
english: Ehud came to him; and he was sitting by himself alone in the cool upper room. Ehud said, “I have a message from God to you.” He arose out of his seat.

hausa: Daga can yake neman abincinsa; idanunsa suna gani daga nesa.
english: From there he spies out the prey. His eyes see it afar off.

hausa: Sai Shawulu ya ce wa mai ɗauka masa makami, “Ka zare takobinka ka soke ni, kada waɗannan marasa kaciya su zo su ci mini mutunci, su kashe ni.” Amma mai ɗaukan makaman bai yarda ba don ya ji tsoro sosai. Sai Shawulu ya zāre takobinsa ya soki kansa.
english: Then Saul said to his armor bearer, “Draw your sword, and thrust me through with it, lest these uncircumcised come and thrust me through and abuse me!” But his armor bearer would not, for he was terrified. Therefore Saul took his sword and fell on it.

hausa: Sun yi mamaki da ba kwa haɗa kai da su a yanzu, da ba kwa kutsa kai tare da su cikin irin rayuwar banzan nan, har suna zaginku.
english: They think it is strange that you don’t run with them into the same excess of riot, speaking evil of you.

hausa: ka kuma sa musu huluna a kansu. Sa’an nan ka ɗaura wa Haruna da ’ya’yansa abin ɗamara. Su kuwa da zuriyarsu, aikin firist kuwa zai zama nasu ta wurin dawwammamiyar farilla. “Ta haka za ka keɓe Haruna da ’ya’yansa maza.
english: You shall clothe them with belts, Aaron and his sons, and bind headbands on them. They shall have the priesthood by a perpetual statute. You shall consecrate Aaron and his sons.

hausa: Yayinda Yesu yake tafiya a gaɓar Tekun Galili, sai ya ga Siman da ɗan’uwansa Andarawus, suna jefa abin kamun kifi a cikin tafkin, domin su masunta ne.
english: Passing along by the sea of Galilee, he saw Simon and Andrew, the brother of Simon, casting a net into the sea, for they were fishermen.

hausa: Samson ya ce mata, “In wani ya ɗaura ni da sababbin igiyoyin da ba su bushe ba, zan zama marar ƙarfi kamar kowa.”
english: Samson said to her, “If they bind me with seven green cords that were never dried, then shall I become weak, and be as another man.”

hausa: Ya haƙa ƙasa ya kuma tsintsince duwatsun ya shuka mata inabi mafi kyau. Ya gina hasumiyar tsaro a cikinta ya kuma shirya wurin matsin ruwan inabi. Sa’an nan ya sa rai ga samun girbi mai kyau na inabin, amma sai ga shi inabin ya ba da munanan ’ya’ya.
english: He dug it up, gathered out its stones, planted it with the choicest vine, built a tower in the middle of it, and also cut out a wine press in it. He looked for it to yield grapes, but it yielded wild grapes.

hausa: Ubangiji ya aika da saƙon gāba da Yaƙub; zai auka wa Isra’ila.
english: The Lord sent a word into Jacob, and it falls on Israel.

hausa: A cikin Tentin Sujada, a waje da labulen da yake a gaban Akwatin Alkawari, Haruna da ’ya’yansa za su sa fitilu su yi ta ci a gaban Ubangiji, daga yamma har safiya. Wannan za tă zama dawwammamiyar farilla a cikin Isra’ila har tsararraki masu zuwa.
english: In the Tent of Meeting, outside the veil which is before the covenant, Aaron and his sons shall keep it in order from evening to morning before Yahweh: it shall be a statute forever throughout their generations on the behalf of the children of Israel.

hausa: Ya bi gurbin gidan Ahab, ya yi mugunta a gaban Ubangiji yadda gida Ahab ta yi, gama yana da dangantaka ta aure da gidan Ahab.
english: He walked in the way of Ahab’s house and did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight, as did Ahab’s house, for he was the son-in-law of Ahab’s house.

hausa: Sa’ad da Yesu ya ɗaga kai ya ga taro mai yawa suna zuwa wajensa, sai ya ce wa Filibus, “Ina za mu sayi burodi saboda mutanen nan su ci?”
english: Jesus therefore, lifting up his eyes and seeing that a great multitude was coming to him, said to Philip, “Where are we to buy bread, that these may eat?”

hausa: Amma kai da ’ya’yanka maza da mata za su iya ci ƙirjin da aka kaɗa, da kuma cinyar da aka miƙa. Ku ci su a wuri mai tsabta; an ba da su gare ku da kuma ’ya’yanku a matsayin rabo daga hadaya ta salama ta Isra’ilawa.
english: The waved breast and the heaved thigh you shall eat in a clean place, you, and your sons, and your daughters with you: for they are given as your portion, and your sons’ portion, out of the sacrifices of the peace offerings of the children of Israel.

hausa: Sai sarkin Isra’ila ya ce wa Yehoshafat, “Ban faɗa maka cewa bai taɓa yin annabci wani abu mai kyau game da ni, sai mummuna kawai ba?”
english: The king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, “Didn’t I tell you that he would not prophesy good concerning me, but evil?”

hausa: Elisha ya tashi, ya yi ta kai komo a cikin ɗakin. Sa’an nan ya sāke koma kan gadon yă miƙe a kan yaron, sai yaron ya yi atishawa sau bakwai, ya kuma buɗe idanunsa.
english: Then he returned, and walked in the house once back and forth, then went up and stretched himself out on him. Then the child sneezed seven times, and the child opened his eyes.

hausa: na ɗayan Nebo 52
english: The men of the other Nebo: fifty-two.

hausa: Suna ta ƙara ƙarfi, har sai kowanne ya bayyana a gaban Allah a Sihiyona.
english: They go from strength to strength. Every one of them appears before God in Zion.

hausa: daga kabilar Dan, Ahiyezer ɗan Ammishaddai;
english: Of Dan: Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai.

hausa: Sa’ad da dukan albarku da la’anonin nan da na sa a gabanku suka zo muku, kuka kuma sa su a zuciya, a duk inda Ubangiji Allahnku ya watsar da ku a cikin al’ummai,
english: It shall happen, when all these things have come on you, the blessing and the curse, which I have set before you, and you shall call them to mind among all the nations where Yahweh your God has driven you,

hausa: Sa’an nan na ɗaura aniyata ga fahimtar hikima, in kuma san bambanci tsakanin hauka da wauta, amma na koyi cewa wannan ma, naushin iska ne kawai.
english: I applied my heart to know wisdom, and to know madness and folly. I perceived that this also was a chasing after wind.

hausa: Almajiran suka ce masa, “In haka yake tsakanin miji da mata, ashe, ya ma fi kyau kada a yi aure.”
english: His disciples said to him, “If this is the case of the man with his wife, it is not expedient to marry.”

hausa: domin mayafin ne abin da yake da shi na rufe jikinsa. To, da me zai rufu yă yi barci? Sa’ad da ya yi mini kuka, zan ji, gama ni mai tausayi ne.
english: for that is his only covering, it is his garment for his skin. What would he sleep in? It will happen, when he cries to me, that I will hear, for I am gracious.

hausa: Sa’ad da na ji kukansu da waɗannan koke-koke, na husata ƙwarai.
english: I was very angry when I heard their cry and these words.

hausa: Ta haka za ku yi rayuwa wadda ta dace da Ubangiji, ku kuma gamshe shi a ta kowace hanya, kuna yin aiki mai kyau ta kowace hanya, kuna kuma yin girma cikin sanin Allah.
english: that you may walk worthily of the Lord, to please him in all respects, bearing fruit in every good work and increasing in the knowledge of God,

hausa: Don me kuke duba da kishi, ya duwatsu masu wuyan hawa, a kan dutsen da Allah ya zaɓa yă yi mulki, inda Ubangiji kansa zai zauna har abada?
english: Why do you look in envy, you rugged mountains, at the mountain where God chooses to reign? Yes, Yahweh will dwell there forever.

hausa: Daga sojojin da suka je yaƙin kuwa, ka ware ganima wa Ubangiji, ka ɗauki ɗaya daga cikin mutum ɗari biyar, da shanu ɗari biyar, da jakuna ɗari biyar, da tumaki ɗari biyar.
english: Levy a tribute to Yahweh of the men of war who went out to battle: one soul of five hundred; of the persons, of the cattle, of the donkeys, and of the flocks.

hausa: Sa’an nan ka faɗa musu cewa, ‘Ga abin da Ubangiji Maɗaukaki, Allah na Isra’ila, yana cewa, zan aika wa bawana Nebukadnezzar sarkin Babilon, zan kuma sa kursiyinsa a kan waɗannan duwatsun da na binne a nan; zai fadada bukkar mulkinsa a bisansu.
english: Tell them, Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel, says: ‘Behold, I will send and take Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon, my servant, and will set his throne on these stones that I have hidden; and he will spread his royal pavilion over them.

hausa: Sai Ubangiji ya ce wa Ibrahim, “Me ya ba Saratu dariya har da ta ce, ‘Har zan iya haifi ɗa duk ta tsufata yanzu?’
english: Yahweh said to Abraham, “Why did Sarah laugh, saying, ‘Will I really bear a child when I am old?’

hausa: Ubangiji zai azurta ku sosai, a ’ya’yan cikinku, a ’ya’yan dabbobinku da kuma a hatsin gonarku, a cikin ƙasar da ya rantse wa kakanninku zai ba ku.
english: Yahweh will grant you abundant prosperity in the fruit of your body, in the fruit of your livestock, and in the fruit of your ground, in the land which Yahweh swore to your fathers to give you.

hausa: Ba’asha ɗan Ahiya na gidan Issakar ya yi maƙarƙashiya gāba da shi, ya buge shi a Gibbeton, a wani garin Filistiyawa, yayinda Nadab da dukan Isra’ila suke wa garin kwanto.
english: Baasha the son of Ahijah, of the house of Issachar, conspired against him; and Baasha struck him at Gibbethon, which belonged to the Philistines; for Nadab and all Israel were besieging Gibbethon.

hausa: “Ashe, lokaci ya yi da za ku zauna a ɗakunan da kuka yi da rufin katako, amma haikalin nan yana zaman kufai?”
english: “Is it a time for you yourselves to dwell in your paneled houses, while this house lies waste?

hausa: gama Ubangiji zai yi magana dominsu zai kuwa washe waɗanda suka washe su.
english: for Yahweh will plead their case, and plunder the life of those who plunder them.

hausa: Shafaffe na Ubangiji, numfashin ranmu, ya fāɗi cikin tarkonsu. Muna tunani cewa za mu iya rayuwa cikin sauran mutane a ƙarƙashin inuwarsa.
english: The breath of our nostrils, the anointed of Yahweh, was taken in their pits; of whom we said, under his shadow we will live among the nations.

hausa: Aka ba zuriyar Merari, gida-gida, rabon garuruwa goma sha biyu daga kabilan Ruben, Gad da Zebulun.
english: To the sons of Merari were given by lot, according to their families, out of the tribe of Reuben, and out of the tribe of Gad, and out of the tribe of Zebulun, twelve cities.

hausa: To, Yaƙub ya aiki Yahuda yă yi gaba yă sadu da Yusuf, don yă nuna musu hanyar da za su bi zuwa yankin Goshen. Da suka isa yankin Goshen,
english: Jacob sent Judah before him to Joseph, to show the way before him to Goshen, and they came into the land of Goshen.

hausa: Kullum za ku kasance da matalauta a ƙasar. Saboda haka na umarce ku ku bayar hannu sake ga ’yan’uwa da kuma matalauta, da masu bukata a ƙasarku.
english: For the poor will never cease out of the land. Therefore I command you to surely open your hand to your brother, to your needy, and to your poor, in your land.

hausa: Kun yi cikin yayi, kuka haifi kara; numfashinku wuta ne da zai cinye ku.
english: You will conceive chaff. You will give birth to stubble. Your breath is a fire that will devour you.

hausa: Abner da mutanensa suka ratsa kwarin Urdun dukan dare. Sa’an nan suka haye kogin, suka kuwa ci gaba dukan safe har suka zo Mahanayim.
english: Abner and his men went all that night through the Arabah; and they passed over the Jordan, and went through all Bithron, and came to Mahanaim.

hausa: Jimillar kuwa ita ce mutum 603,550.
english: all those who were counted were six hundred three thousand five hundred fifty.

hausa: A cikinki akwai mutane waɗanda suka nace su yi kisankai; a cikinki akwai waɗanda suke ci a dutsen tsafi suna yin ayyukan lalata.
english: Slanderous men have been in you to shed blood. In you they have eaten on the mountains. They have committed lewdness among you.

hausa: Ga shi ƙarfinta yana a ƙugunta ikonta yana cikin tsokar cikinta.
english: Look now, his strength is in his thighs. His force is in the muscles of his belly.

hausa: Yehoshafat kuma ya zauna lafiya da sarkin Isra’ila.
english: Jehoshaphat made peace with the king of Israel.

hausa: Zan tā da Sairus cikin adalcina. Zan sa dukan hanyoyinsa su miƙe. Zai sāke gina birnina ya kuma ’yantar da mutanena masu bautar talala, amma ba don wata haya ko lada ba, in ji Ubangiji Maɗaukaki.”
english: I have raised him up in righteousness, and I will make all his ways straight. He shall build my city, and he shall let my exiles go free, not for price nor reward,” says Yahweh of Armies.

hausa: Dā kam, ba shi da amfani a gare ka, amma yanzu ya zama da amfani a gare ka da kuma gare ni.
english: who once was useless to you, but now is useful to you and to me.

hausa: “To, sai ga wani baƙo ya zo wurin mai arzikin nan, amma mai arzikin ya ƙi yă kama tunkiyarsa, ko saniyarsa yă yanka don yă shirya wa baƙon da ya zo abinci. A maimako, sai ya je ya kama ’yar tunkiyan nan ta matalaucin ya yanka ya shirya wa mutumin da ya zo masa.”
english: A traveler came to the rich man, and he didn’t want to take of his own flock and of his own herd to prepare for the wayfaring man who had come to him, but took the poor man’s lamb and prepared it for the man who had come to him.”

hausa: da lokacin da Allah ya zaɓa ya cika sai ya bayyana maganarsa a sarari ta wurin wa’azin da aka danƙa mini amana ta wurin umarnin Allah Mai Cetonmu,
english: but in his own time revealed his word in the message with which I was entrusted according to the commandment of God our Savior,

hausa: Kun riga kun sami duk abin da kuke nema! Kun riga kun yi arziki! Kun zama sarakuna, kun kuma zama haka ɗin ba tare da mu ba! Da a ce kun riga kun zama sarakuna mana da sai mu zama sarakuna tare da ku!
english: You are already filled. You have already become rich. You have come to reign without us. Yes, and I wish that you did reign, that we also might reign with you!

hausa: A lokacin Abiya, ɗan Yerobowam ya kamu da ciwo,
english: At that time Abijah the son of Jeroboam became sick.

hausa: Ta ce, “Gangara don ka sadu da Ahab sarkin Isra’ila, wanda yake mulki a Samariya. Yanzu yana a gonar inabin Nabot, inda ya tafi yă mallake ta.
english: “Arise, go down to meet Ahab king of Israel, who dwells in Samaria. Behold, he is in the vineyard of Naboth, where he has gone down to take possession of it.

hausa: Ubangiji ya ce mini, “Wannan ƙofar za tă kasance a rufe. Ba za a buɗe ta ba; ba wanda zai shiga ta wurinta. Za tă kasance a rufe domin Ubangiji, Allah na Isra’ila, ya shiga ta wurinta.
english: Yahweh said to me, “This gate shall be shut. It shall not be opened, no man shall enter in by it; for Yahweh, the God of Israel, has entered in by it. Therefore it shall be shut.

hausa: Sai waɗansu Farisiyawa suka ce, “Me ya sa kuke yin abin da doka ta hana yi a ranar Asabbaci?”
english: But some of the Pharisees said to them, “Why do you do that which is not lawful to do on the Sabbath day?”

hausa: Na ƙi ina kuma ƙyamar ƙarya amma ina ƙaunar dokarka.
english: I hate and abhor falsehood. I love your law.

hausa: Sai sarki ya ce mini, “Me kake so?” Sai na yi addu’a ga Allah na sama,
english: Then the king said to me, “What is your request?” So I prayed to the God of heaven.

hausa: Har yanzu ya sāke aikan wani. Wannan kuwa suka kashe. Ya aika waɗansu da yawa; suka bubbuge waɗansu, sauran kuwa suka kashe.
english: Again he sent another, and they killed him, and many others, beating some, and killing some.

hausa: Sai Yohanan ɗan Kareya ya yi wa Gedaliya a Mizfa magana a asirce ya ce, “Bari in tafi in kashe Ishmayel ɗan Netaniya, ba kuwa wanda zai sani. Me zai sa ya ɗauke ranka ya watsar da dukan Yahudawan da suka taru kewaye da kai har waɗanda suka ragu na Yahuda su hallaka?”
english: Then Johanan the son of Kareah spoke to Gedaliah in Mizpah secretly, saying, “Please let me go, and I will kill Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, and no man will know it. Why should he take your life, that all the Jews who are gathered to you should be scattered, and the remnant of Judah perish?”

hausa: Komandodin sojoji suka yi yadda Yehohiyada firist ya umarta. Kowa ya ɗauki mutanensa, waɗanda za su kama aiki Asabbaci da waɗanda za su kama hutun Asabbaci, suka zo wurin Yehohiyada firist.
english: The captains over hundreds did according to all that Jehoiada the priest commanded; and they each took his men, those who were to come in on the Sabbath with those who were to go out on the Sabbath, and came to Jehoiada the priest.

hausa: Ina da abubuwa masu yawa da zan faɗa game ku in kuma yi muku shari’a. Amma wanda ya aiko ni mai aminci ne, abin da kuma na ji daga gare shi, shi nake gaya wa duniya.”
english: I have many things to speak and to judge concerning you. However, he who sent me is true; and the things which I heard from him, these I say to the world.”

hausa: da rigyawa ta kwashe mu, da ambaliya ta rufe mu.
english: then the waters would have overwhelmed us, the stream would have gone over our soul.

hausa: Ya ce musu, “Kada ku karɓa fiye da abin da aka ce a karɓa.”
english: He said to them, “Collect no more than that which is appointed to you.”

hausa: Sa’ad da firistoci da Lawiyawa suka tsarkake kansu da tsarki, sai suka tsarkake mutane, ƙofofi da kuma katanga.
english: The priests and the Levites purified themselves; and they purified the people, the gates, and the wall.

hausa: Akwai abubuwa shida da Ubangiji ya ƙi, abubuwa bakwai da suke abin ƙyama gare shi,
english: There are six things which Yahweh hates; yes, seven which are an abomination to him:

hausa: Duk da haka, suka ci gaba da yin zunubi; duk da abubuwan banmamakinsa, ba su gaskata ba.
english: For all this they still sinned, and didn’t believe in his wondrous works.

hausa: Mutanen Gad da mutanen Ruben, suka ce wa Musa, “Mu bayinka za mu yi yadda ranka yă daɗe ya umarta.
english: The children of Gad and the children of Reuben spoke to Moses, saying, “Your servants will do as my lord commands.

hausa: In wani ya jawo baƙin ciki, ba ni kaɗai ya jawo wa ba, amma a wani fanni, sai in ce dukanku ne ya jawo wa, ba na faɗa haka don in matsa muku lamba ba ne.
english: But if any has caused sorrow, he has caused sorrow not to me, but in part (that I not press too heavily) to you all.

hausa: Gama al’adun mutane banza ne; sukan yanke itace daga kurmi, sai mai sassaƙa yă sassaƙa shi da gizago.
english: For the customs of the peoples are vanity; for one cuts a tree out of the forest, the work of the hands of the workman with the ax.

hausa: Sai Bulus ya miƙe tsaye a tsakiyar taron Areyofagus ya ce, “Ya ku mutanen Atens! Na dai lura cewa ta kowace hanya ku masu addini ne ƙwarai.
english: Paul stood in the middle of the Areopagus and said, “You men of Athens, I perceive that you are very religious in all things.

hausa: Amma, ya Ubangiji Maɗaukaki, kai da kake yin shari’a da adalci kake gwada zuciya da kuma tunani, ka sa in ga sakayyar da za ka yi musu, gama a gare ka na danƙa maganata.
english: But, Yahweh of Armies, who judges righteously, who tests the heart and the mind, I will see your vengeance on them; for to you I have revealed my cause.

hausa: Hanyoyinsa kullum sukan yi nasara; yana da girman kai kuma dokokinka suna nesa da shi; yakan yi wa dukan abokan gābansa duban reni.
english: His ways are prosperous at all times. He is arrogant, and your laws are far from his sight. As for all his adversaries, he sneers at them.

hausa: Gama yana marmarin ganinku duka ya kuma damu domin kun ji cewa ya yi rashin lafiya.
english: since he longed for you all, and was very troubled because you had heard that he was sick.

hausa: Sai Dawuda ya rantse ya ce, “Mahaifinka ya san cewa, na sami tagomashi a gare ka, domin haka ba zai sanar maka da wannan ba, don kada yă baƙanta maka rai. Na rantse da Ubangiji, da kai kuma, taki ɗaya kaɗai ya rage tsakanina da mutuwa.”
english: David swore moreover, and said, “Your father knows well that I have found favor in your eyes; and he says, ‘Don’t let Jonathan know this, lest he be grieved;’ but truly as Yahweh lives, and as your soul lives, there is but a step between me and death.”

hausa: Hadayar da ya kawo ita ce, faranti guda ɗaya na azurfa, nauyinsa shekel ɗari ɗaya da talatin, da kuma daro na yayyafawa na azurfa, nauyinsa shekel saba’in, dukan biyu, an auna su bisa ga ma’aunin shekel na tsattsarkan wuri, kowannensu cike da lallausan gari, haɗe da mai kamar hadaya ta gari;
english: gave his offering: one silver platter, the weight of which was one hundred thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary, both of them full of fine flour mixed with oil for a meal offering;

hausa: Amma suka manta da Ubangiji Allahnsu, shi kuma ya bashe su a hannun Sisera shugaban rundunar Hazor da kuma hannun Filistiyawa da sarkin Mowab wanda suka yi yaƙi da su.
english: But they forgot Yahweh their God; and he sold them into the hand of Sisera, captain of the army of Hazor, and into the hand of the Philistines, and into the hand of the king of Moab; and they fought against them.

hausa: Amma wanda ya yi mūsun sanina a gaban mutane, shi ma za a yi mūsunsa a gaban mala’ikun Allah.
english: but he who denies me in the presence of men will be denied in the presence of God’s angels.

hausa: Mutanen suka zo wurin Musa, suka ce, “Mun yi zunubi, da muka yi wa Ubangiji da kai gunaguni. Ka yi addu’a don Ubangiji yă ɗauke mana macizan nan.” Saboda haka Musa ya yi addu’a domin mutane.
english: The people came to Moses, and said, “We have sinned, because we have spoken against Yahweh and against you. Pray to Yahweh, that he take away the serpents from us.” Moses prayed for the people.

hausa: Bayan masarauta ta kahu a hannunsa, sai ya kashe fadawan da suka kashe mahaifinsa sarki.
english: As soon as the kingdom was established in his hand, he killed his servants who had slain the king his father,

hausa: Ku yi shiru a gaban Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka, gama ranar Ubangiji ta yi kusa. Ubangiji ya shirya hadaya; ya kuma tsarkake waɗanda ya gayyato.
english: Be silent at the presence of the Lord Yahweh, for the day of Yahweh is at hand. For Yahweh has prepared a sacrifice. He has consecrated his guests.

hausa: Maganar Ubangiji ta zo wa Mika mutumin Moreshet a zamanin Yotam, da na Ahaz, da kuma na Hezekiya, sarakunan Yahuda, Mika ya ga wahayi a kan Samariya da kuma a kan Urushalima. Ga abin da ya ce.
english: Yahweh’s word that came to Micah of Morasheth in the days of Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, kings of Judah, which he saw concerning Samaria and Jerusalem.

hausa: Sarkin Babilon ya sa Mattaniya, ɗan’uwan mahaifin Yehohiyacin, ya zama sarki a madadinsa, ya canja masa suna zuwa Zedekiya.
english: The king of Babylon made Mattaniah, Jehoiachin’s father’s brother, king in his place, and changed his name to Zedekiah.

hausa: Sai Abner ya ce wa Dawuda, “Bari in tafi nan da nan in tattara dukan Isra’ila wa ranka yă daɗe, sarki, saboda su yi alkawari da kai, ka kuma ka yi mulki bisa dukansu yadda ranka yake so.” Saboda haka Dawuda ya sallami Abner, ya kuwa tafi lafiya.
english: Abner said to David, “I will arise and go, and will gather all Israel to my lord the king, that they may make a covenant with you, and that you may reign over all that your soul desires.” David sent Abner away; and he went in peace.

hausa: Ta rasu a Kiriyat Arba (wato, Hebron) a ƙasar Kan’ana, Ibrahim kuwa ya tafi ya yi makokin Saratu, yana kuka saboda ita.
english: Sarah died in Kiriath Arba (also called Hebron), in the land of Canaan. Abraham came to mourn for Sarah, and to weep for her.

hausa: ’yan leƙen asirin suka ga wani ya fito daga birnin sai suka ce masa, “Ka nuna mana yadda za mu shiga birnin, mu kuwa za mu yi maka alheri.”
english: The watchers saw a man come out of the city, and they said to him, “Please show us the entrance into the city, and we will deal kindly with you.”

hausa: “Faɗa musu cewa, ‘Don tsararraki masu zuwa, in wani zuriyarku ya ƙazantu, duk da haka ya kusaci tsarkakakku hadayun da Isra’ilawa suka keɓe ga Ubangiji, dole a raba wannan mutum daga gabana. Ni ne Ubangiji.
english: “Tell them, ‘If anyone of all your offspring throughout your generations approaches the holy things which the children of Israel make holy to Yahweh, having his uncleanness on him, that soul shall be cut off from before me. I am Yahweh.

hausa: da ƙodoji biyu tare da kitsen da yake kansu kusa da kwiɓi, da kuma murfin hanta waɗanda zai cire tare da ƙodoji.
english: and the two kidneys, and the fat that is on them, which is by the loins, and the cover on the liver, with the kidneys, he shall take away.

hausa: An shirya tara saboda masu ba’a ne, dūka kuma saboda bayan wawaye.
english: Penalties are prepared for scoffers, and beatings for the backs of fools.

hausa: Sai Yesu ya ce, “Kun ga duk waɗannan abubuwa? Gaskiya nake gaya muku, ba wani dutse a nan da za a bari a kan wani; duk za a rushe.”
english: But he answered them, “You see all of these things, don’t you? Most certainly I tell you, there will not be left here one stone on another, that will not be thrown down.”

hausa: Sa’ad da waɗanda suke ɗaukan akwatin alkawarin Ubangiji suka yi tafiya taki shida, sai yă yi hadayar bijimi da saniya mai ƙiba.
english: When those who bore Yahweh’s ark had gone six paces, he sacrificed an ox and a fattened calf.

hausa: Yoktan shi ne mahaifin, Almodad, Shelef, Hazarmawet, Yera,
english: Joktan became the father of Almodad, Sheleph, Hazarmaveth, Jerah,

hausa: Sai Yesu ya ce masa, “Rabu da ni, Shaiɗan! Gama a rubuce yake, ‘Yi wa Ubangiji Allahnka sujada, shi kaɗai kuma za ka bauta wa.’”
english: Then Jesus said to him, “Get behind me, Satan! For it is written, ‘You shall worship the Lord your God, and you shall serve him only.’”

hausa: Ku gai da Urbanus, abokin aikinmu cikin Kiristi, da kuma ƙaunataccen abokina Sitakis.
english: Greet Urbanus, our fellow worker in Christ, and Stachys, my beloved.

hausa: Amma Ubangiji ya ƙarfafa maƙiyan Rezin gāba da su ya kuma ingiza abokan gāba.
english: Therefore Yahweh will set up on high against him the adversaries of Rezin, and will stir up his enemies,

hausa: In kana ɓata wa ɗan’uwanka zuciya saboda abincin da kake ci, ba halin ƙauna kake nunawa ba ke nan. Kada abincin da kake ci yă zama hanyar lalatar da ɗan’uwanka wanda Kiristi ya mutu dominsa.
english: Yet if because of food your brother is grieved, you walk no longer in love. Don’t destroy with your food him for whom Christ died.

hausa: “A wannan rana,” in ji Ubangiji, “sarki da shugabanni za su fid da zuciya, firistoci za su razana, annabawa kuma za su yi mamaki.”
english: “It will happen at that day,” says Yahweh, “that the heart of the king will perish, along with the heart of the princes. The priests will be astonished, and the prophets will wonder.”

hausa: In kika tone mana asiri, za mu karya alkawarin da kika sa muka yi.”
english: But if you talk about this business of ours, then we shall be guiltless of your oath which you’ve made us to swear.”

hausa: Sai wani ya faɗa masa cewa, “Ga uwarka da ’yan’uwanka suna tsaye a waje suna so su gan ka.”
english: Some people told him, “Your mother and your brothers stand outside, desiring to see you.”

hausa: Gama ni ne mafi ƙanƙanta a cikin manzanni, ban kuma isa a kira ni manzo ba, domin na tsananta wa ikkilisiyar Allah.
english: For I am the least of the apostles, who is not worthy to be called an apostle, because I persecuted the assembly of God.

hausa: Dukan waɗanda suke zaune a Majalisar suka kafa wa Istifanus ido, suka kuma ga fuskarsa ta yi kama da ta mala’ika.
english: All who sat in the council, fastening their eyes on him, saw his face like it was the face of an angel.

hausa: Bayan ya kai su waje kusa da Betani, sai ya ɗaga hannuwansa ya sa musu albarka.
english: He led them out as far as Bethany, and he lifted up his hands and blessed them.

hausa: Wata rana, da yake cikin koyarwa, waɗansu Farisiyawa da malaman dokoki waɗanda suka zo daga kowane ƙauye a Galili, Yahudiya da Urushalima kuwa suna zaune. Ikon Ubangiji yana nan don yă warkar da masu ciwo.
english: On one of those days, he was teaching; and there were Pharisees and teachers of the law sitting by who had come out of every village of Galilee, Judea, and Jerusalem. The power of the Lord was with him to heal them.

hausa: Waɗannan duka suka duƙufa cikin addu’a, tare da waɗansu mata da Maryamu mahaifiyar Yesu, da kuma tare da ’yan’uwansa.
english: All these with one accord continued steadfastly in prayer and supplication, along with the women and Mary the mother of Jesus, and with his brothers.

hausa: A can ta yi ta kai da kawowa da kwartayenta, waɗanda al’auransu kamar na jakuna ne waɗanda maniyyinsu kuwa kamar na dawakai ne.
english: She lusted after their lovers, whose flesh is as the flesh of donkeys, and whose issue is like the issue of horses.

hausa: Mutane suka yi farin ciki ganin yadda shugabanninsu suke bayarwa da yardar rai, gama sun bayar hannu sake da kuma dukan zuciya ga Ubangiji. Dawuda sarki shi ma ya yi farin ciki ƙwarai.
english: Then the people rejoiced, because they offered willingly, because with a perfect heart they offered willingly to Yahweh; and David the king also rejoiced with great joy.

hausa: Wuri mai tsarki da yake waje yana da madogarar ƙofa murabba’i, haka ma wadda take a gaban Wuri Mafi Tsarki.
english: The door posts of the nave were squared. As for the face of the nave, its appearance was as the appearance of the temple.

hausa: Amma Isra’ilawa suka wuce cikin teku a busasshiyar ƙasa, ruwa kuwa ya yi musu katanga dama da hagu.
english: But the children of Israel walked on dry land in the middle of the sea, and the waters were a wall to them on their right hand and on their left.

hausa: Ubangiji ya ce mini, “Daidai ne ka gani, gama ina lura in ga cewa maganata ta cika.”
english: Then Yahweh said to me, “You have seen well; for I watch over my word to perform it.”

hausa: Da muryar ta gama magana, sai suka tarar Yesu shi kaɗai ne. Almajiran kuwa suka riƙe wannan al’amari a zukatansu. A lokacin nan, ba su gaya wa kowa abin da suka gani ba.
english: When the voice came, Jesus was found alone. They were silent, and told no one in those days any of the things which they had seen.

hausa: Ka miƙa hannunka daga bisa; ka cece ni ka kuma kuɓutar da ni daga manyan ruwaye, daga hannuwan baƙi
english: Stretch out your hand from above, rescue me, and deliver me out of great waters, out of the hands of foreigners,

hausa: (yadda ya yi magana tun tuni ta wurin annabawansa masu tsarki),
english: (as he spoke by the mouth of his holy prophets who have been from of old),

hausa: Da yamma za tă tafi can, da safe kuma ta dawo wani ɓangaren gidan matan kullen da yake a ƙarƙashin kulawar Sha’ashgaz, bābā na sarki, wanda yake lura da ƙwarƙwarai. Ba ta dawowa wurin sarki sai in ta gamshe shi, sai ya kuma kira ta da suna.
english: In the evening she went, and on the next day she returned into the second women’s house, to the custody of Shaashgaz, the king’s eunuch, who kept the concubines. She came in to the king no more, unless the king delighted in her, and she was called by name.

hausa: Yayinda Musa ya shiga cikin tentin, sai al’amudin girgije yă sauko, yă tsaya a ƙofar yayinda Ubangiji yana magana da Musa.
english: When Moses entered into the Tent, the pillar of cloud descended, stood at the door of the Tent, and Yahweh spoke with Moses.

hausa: Saboda haka sai na yi annabci yadda aka umarce ni. Da nake annabcin, sai aka ji motsi, ƙarar girgiza, sai ƙasusuwan suka harhaɗu, ƙashi ya haɗu da ƙashi.
english: So I prophesied as I was commanded. As I prophesied, there was a noise, and behold, there was an earthquake. Then the bones came together, bone to its bone.

hausa: gama Ruhu Mai Tsarki zai koya muku abin da ya dace ku faɗa a lokacin.”
english: for the Holy Spirit will teach you in that same hour what you must say.”

hausa: Da jin haka sai Daniyel ya tafi wurin sarki ya nemi ƙarin lokaci, domin yă bayyana wa sarki mafarkin da kuma fassararsa.
english: Daniel went in, and desired of the king that he would appoint him a time, and he would show the king the interpretation.

hausa: “Ka saurari zancen wannan alkawari ka kuma faɗe su ga mutanen Yahuda da kuma waɗanda suke zaune a Urushalima.
english: “Hear the words of this covenant, and speak to the men of Judah, and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem;

hausa: Amma yakan komo Rama inda gidansa yake, a nan yakan yi wa Isra’ila shari’a. A nan ne kuma ya gina wa Ubangiji bagade.
english: His return was to Ramah, for his house was there, and he judged Israel there; and he built an altar to Yahweh there.

hausa: mu haɗiye su da rai gaba ɗaya kamar kabari, kamar waɗanda suke gangarawa zuwa rami;
english: Let’s swallow them up alive like Sheol, and whole, like those who go down into the pit.

hausa: Suka rufe masa idanu suna tambaya cewa, “Ka yi annabci! Wa ya mare ka?”
english: Having blindfolded him, they struck him on the face and asked him, “Prophesy! Who is the one who struck you?”

hausa: Allah ba mai shari’ar gaskiya ba ne? Ko Maɗaukaki yakan yi abin da ba daidai ba?
english: Does God pervert justice? Or does the Almighty pervert righteousness?

hausa: Ku kanku kun san yadda muka yi zama a Masar, da yadda muka yi ta ratsawa ta tsakiyar al’ummai muka wuce.
english: (for you know how we lived in the land of Egypt, and how we came through the middle of the nations through which you passed;

hausa: To, in dare ya yi, sai ka zo da mutanenka ku yi kwanto a filaye.
english: Now therefore, go up by night, you and the people who are with you, and lie in wait in the field.

hausa: duk kuwa wanda yake bauta wa Kiristi a haka yana faranta wa Allah rai ne, yardajje kuma ga mutane.
english: For he who serves Christ in these things is acceptable to God and approved by men.

hausa: Sai Musa ya ce wa Haruna, “Ka ɗauki farantinka ka sa turare a ciki, da wuta daga bagade, ka yi maza ka tafi wajen taron, ka yi kafara dominsu. Gama fushin Ubangiji ya riga ya sauko; an kuma fara annoba.”
english: Moses said to Aaron, “Take your censer, put fire from the altar in it, lay incense on it, carry it quickly to the congregation, and make atonement for them; for wrath has gone out from Yahweh! The plague has begun.”

hausa: A haɗa da bunsuru guda, a matsayin hadaya don zunubi, ban da hadaya ta ƙonawa na kullum tare da hadayarta, ta gari da kuma hadaya ta sha.
english: and one male goat for a sin offering, in addition to the continual burnt offering, its meal offering, and its drink offering.

hausa: Abin nan da ya yi mugunta ce a gaban Ubangiji, saboda haka Ubangiji ya kashe shi, shi ma.
english: The thing which he did was evil in Yahweh’s sight, and he killed him also.

hausa: Ibrahim ya ce, “Ka tabbata ba ka komar da ɗana can ba.”
english: Abraham said to him, “Beware that you don’t bring my son there again.

hausa: “Dukiyarku da arzikinku zan ba da su ganima, babu tara, saboda duka zunubanku ko’ina a ƙasar.
english: I will give your substance and your treasures for a plunder without price, and that for all your sins, even in all your borders.

hausa: saboda jinƙai na Allahnmu mai ƙauna, hasken nan na ceto zai ɓullo mana daga sama,
english: because of the tender mercy of our God, by which the dawn from on high will visit us,

hausa: Ku kawo damuwoyinku ga Ubangiji zai kuwa riƙe ku; ba zai taɓa barin mai adalci yă fāɗi ba.
english: Cast your burden on Yahweh and he will sustain you. He will never allow the righteous to be moved.

hausa: Yesu ya ce, “To, ni ma ba zan gaya muku, ko da wane iko ne, nake yin waɗannan abubuwa ba.”
english: Jesus said to them, “Neither will I tell you by what authority I do these things.”

hausa: “ ‘In duk da haka kuka ci gaba da ƙin saurare ni, kuka ci gaba da yin adawa da ni,
english: “‘If you in spite of this won’t listen to me, but walk contrary to me,

hausa: Ba haka ya kamata yă zama da ku ba. A maimakon, duk wanda yake so yă zama babba a cikinku, dole yă zama bawanku.
english: But it shall not be so among you, but whoever wants to become great among you shall be your servant.

hausa: Ko da yake na sa ta haddasa tsoro a ƙasar masu rai, Fir’auna da dukan jama’arsa za su kwanta a cikin marasa kaciya, tare da waɗanda aka kashe da takobi, in ji Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka.”
english: “For I have put his terror in the land of the living. He will be laid among the uncircumcised, with those who are slain by the sword, even Pharaoh and all his multitude,” says the Lord Yahweh.

hausa: Aka kuma ba wa zuriyar Gershon garuruwa goma sha uku daga iyalan kabilan Issakar, Asher, Naftali, da kuma rabin kabilar Manasse a Bashan.
english: The children of Gershon had thirteen cities by lot out of the families of the tribe of Issachar, out of the tribe of Asher, out of the tribe of Naphtali, and out of the half-tribe of Manasseh in Bashan.

hausa: Mutumin ya ce, “Malam, ai, tun ina yaro na kiyaye duk waɗannan.”
english: He said to him, “Teacher, I have observed all these things from my youth.”

hausa: Faɗa wa Isra’ilawa cewa, ‘Duk wanda ya zagi Allahnsa, alhakin zai rataya a wuyansa,
english: You shall speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘Whoever curses his God shall bear his sin.

hausa: Musa ya ce wa Ubangiji, “Ya Ubangiji, ni ban mai iya magana ba ne, ban taɓa iya ba, ko a yanzu ma, bayan ka yi magana da ni, gama ni mai nauyin baki ne, mai nauyin harshe kuma.”
english: Moses said to Yahweh, “O Lord, I am not eloquent, neither before now, nor since you have spoken to your servant; for I am slow of speech, and of a slow tongue.”

hausa: Sun durƙusa suka kuma rusuna tare; ba su iya kuɓutar da nauyin kaya su kansu sukan tafi bauta.
english: They stoop and they bow down together. They could not deliver the burden, but they have gone into captivity.

hausa: Dukan Isra’ilawa suka yi gunaguni a kan Musa da Haruna, dukan taron kuwa suka ce musu, “Da ma mun mutu a Masar! Ko kuma a wannan hamada ma!
english: All the children of Israel murmured against Moses and against Aaron. The whole congregation said to them, “We wish that we had died in the land of Egypt, or that we had died in this wilderness!

hausa: Kana mulkin teku mai tumbatsa; sa’ad da raƙuma sun tashi, kakan kwantar da su.
english: You rule the pride of the sea. When its waves rise up, you calm them.

hausa: Zan aika muku da irin albarka a shekara ta shida har da ƙasar za tă ba da amfani isashe na shekara uku.
english: then I will command my blessing on you in the sixth year, and it shall bear fruit for the three years.

hausa: “ ‘Domin ba ki tuna da kwanakin ƙuruciyarki ba amma kika husatar da ni da waɗannan abubuwa, tabbatacce zan sāka miki alhakin ayyukanki, in ji Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka. Ba kin ƙara lalata ga dukan waɗansu ayyuka masu banƙyamarki ba?
english: “‘“Because you have not remembered the days of your youth, but have raged against me in all these things; therefore, behold, I also will bring your way on your head,” says the Lord Yahweh: “and you shall not commit this lewdness with all your abominations.

hausa: Jimillar zinariya daga hadaya ta kaɗawar da aka yi amfani da su domin aikin wuri mai tsarki ta kai talenti 29 da shekel 730, bisa ga ma’aunin shekel na tsattsarkan wuri.
english: All the gold that was used for the work in all the work of the sanctuary, even the gold of the offering, was twenty-nine talents and seven hundred thirty shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary.

hausa: Zai kuma miƙa hannunsa gāba da arewa yă kuma hallaka Assuriya, zai mai da Ninebe kango gaba ɗaya ta kuma zama busasshiya kamar hamada.
english: He will stretch out his hand against the north, destroy Assyria, and will make Nineveh a desolation, as dry as the wilderness.

hausa: Na ba ku iko da za ku tattaka macizai, da kunamai, ku kuma shawo kan dukan ikon abokin gāba, kuma ba wani lahani da zai same ku.
english: Behold, I give you authority to tread on serpents and scorpions, and over all the power of the enemy. Nothing will in any way hurt you.

hausa: Sun ba da gawawwakin bayinka kamar abinci ga tsuntsayen sararin sama, nama jikin tsarkakanka ga namun jejin duniya.
english: They have given the dead bodies of your servants to be food for the birds of the sky, the flesh of your saints to the animals of the earth.

hausa: “Amma a yanzu a wannan ɗan lokaci Ubangiji Allahnmu ya yi mana jinƙai, ya bar mana saura, ya kuma ba mu wuri a wurinsa mai tsarki, ya kuma ba mu ganin haske, ya ɗan rage mana nauyin bauta.
english: Now for a little moment grace has been shown from Yahweh our God, to leave us a remnant to escape, and to give us a stake in his holy place, that our God may lighten our eyes, and revive us a little in our bondage.

hausa: Da sassafe kashegari sai Laban ya sumbaci jikokinsa da ’ya’yansa mata, ya sa musu albarka. Sa’an nan ya yi bankwana da su, ya koma gida.
english: Early in the morning, Laban rose up, and kissed his sons and his daughters, and blessed them. Laban departed and returned to his place.

hausa: Yarinyar ta gamshe shi, ta kuma sami tagomashinsa. Nan da nan ya tanada mata, ya ba ta man shafawa da abinci na musamman. Ya ba ta bayi mata bakwai da aka zaɓa daga fadar sarki. Ya kuma kai ta tare da bayinta zuwa wuri mafi kyau na gidan matan kulle.
english: The maiden pleased him, and she obtained kindness from him. He quickly gave her cosmetics and her portions of food, and the seven choice maidens who were to be given her out of the king’s house. He moved her and her maidens to the best place in the women’s house.

hausa: Shi ya sa nake murna cikin rashin ƙarfi, da zagi, da shan wahaloli, da tsanantawa, da matsaloli, saboda Kiristi. Don a sa’ad da nake marar ƙarfi a nan ne nake da ƙarfi.
english: Therefore I take pleasure in weaknesses, in injuries, in necessities, in persecutions, and in distresses, for Christ’s sake. For when I am weak, then am I strong.

hausa: Ku koma cikin hankalinku yadda ya kamata, ku kuma daina yin zunubi, gama akwai waɗansu da ba su san Allah ba, na faɗi wannan ne don ku kunyata.
english: Wake up righteously and don’t sin, for some have no knowledge of God. I say this to your shame.

hausa: “ ‘Idan mace tana ɗigar jini na tsawon kwanaki, ban da kwanakin ganin al’adarta, ko kuwa idan al’adarta ya wuce yawan kwanakin da ya kamata, to, za tă ƙazantu daidai kamar na kwanakin al’adar da ta saba yi. Wato, muddin tana cikin ɗiga, ta zama mai ƙazanta.
english: “‘If a woman has a discharge of her blood many days not in the time of her period, or if she has a discharge beyond the time of her period, all the days of the discharge of her uncleanness shall be as in the days of her period. She is unclean.

hausa: Cikin haikalinka, ya Allah, mun yi tunani a kan ƙaunarka marar ƙarewa.
english: We have thought about your loving kindness, God, in the middle of your temple.

hausa: Zai kuwa aiki mala’ikunsa su busa ƙaho mai ƙara sosai, za su kuwa tattaro zaɓaɓɓunsa daga kusurwoyi huɗun nan, daga wannan bangon duniya zuwa wancan.
english: He will send out his angels with a great sound of a trumpet, and they will gather together his chosen ones from the four winds, from one end of the sky to the other.

hausa: Nauyin ’yan kunnen zinariyar ya kai shekel ɗari goma sha bakwai, ban da kayan ado, abin wuya da tufafin shunayya waɗanda sarakuna Midiyawa suke sawa ko sarƙoƙin da suke wuyar raƙumansu.
english: The weight of the golden earrings that he requested was one thousand and seven hundred shekels of gold, in addition to the crescents, and the pendants, and the purple clothing that was on the kings of Midian, and in addition to the chains that were about their camels’ necks.

hausa: Sa’ad da muka sa linzamai a bakunan dawakai don mu sa su yi mana biyayya, mukan iya bin da dabbar gaba ɗaya.
english: Indeed, we put bits into the horses’ mouths so that they may obey us, and we guide their whole body.

hausa: Gama na shaida su a kan suna da kishi bin Allah, sai dai kishinsu ba a bisa sani ba.
english: For I testify about them that they have a zeal for God, but not according to knowledge.

hausa: Sa’an nan Allah ya ce, “Bari ƙasa tă fid da tsire-tsire, da shuke-shuke, da itatuwa a bisa ƙasa masu ba da amfani da ’ya’ya a cikinsu, bisa ga irinsu.” Haka kuwa ya kasance.
english: God said, “Let the earth yield grass, herbs yielding seeds, and fruit trees bearing fruit after their kind, with their seeds in it, on the earth;” and it was so.

hausa: ɗan Etni, ɗan Zera, ɗan Adahiya
english: the son of Ethni, the son of Zerah, the son of Adaiah,

hausa: A safiyar rana ta uku, aka yi tsawa, da walƙiyoyi, sai ga girgije mai duhu a bisa dutsen, aka tsananta busar ƙaho, sai dukan jama’ar da suke cikin sansani suka yi rawar jiki.
english: On the third day, when it was morning, there were thunders and lightnings, and a thick cloud on the mountain, and the sound of an exceedingly loud trumpet; and all the people who were in the camp trembled.

hausa: “Duba, zan dawo da su daga wuraren da kuka sayar da su, in kuma yi muku abin da kuka yi musu.
english: Behold, I will stir them up out of the place where you have sold them, and will return your repayment on your own head;

hausa: Ya aikata mugunta a gaban Ubangiji. A duk tsawon mulkinsa, bai rabu da zunuban da Yerobowam ɗan Nebat ya sa Isra’ila suka aikata ba.
english: He did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight. He didn’t depart all his days from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, with which he made Israel to sin.

hausa: Isra’ilawa suka fito a guje daga Mizfa suka fafari Filistiyawa suka yi ta karkashe su a hanya har kwarin Bet-Kar.
english: The men of Israel went out of Mizpah and pursued the Philistines, and struck them until they came under Beth Kar.

hausa: Ciyawa takan yanƙwane, furanni kuma su yi yaushi, domin Ubangiji ya hura iska a kansu. Tabbatacce mutane ciyawa ne.
english: The grass withers, the flower fades, because Yahweh’s breath blows on it. Surely the people are like grass.

hausa: Ga guda, ya ba shi talenti biyar na kuɗi, ga wani talenti biyu, ga wani kuma talenti ɗaya, kowa bisa ga azancinsa. Sa’an nan ya yi tafiyarsa.
english: To one he gave five talents, to another two, to another one, to each according to his own ability. Then he went on his journey.

hausa: Kalmomin mai gulma kamar abinci mai daɗi suke; sukan gangara zuwa can cikin gaɓoɓin mutum.
english: The words of a gossip are like dainty morsels: they go down into a person’s innermost parts.

hausa: “Yi magana da Haruna da ’ya’yansa maza da kuma dukan Isra’ilawa, ka ce musu, ‘Ga abin da Ubangiji ya umarta.
english: “Speak to Aaron, and to his sons, and to all the children of Israel, and say to them, ‘This is the thing which Yahweh has commanded:

hausa: Domin ya juye kunnensa gare ni, zan kira gare shi muddin ina da rai.
english: Because he has turned his ear to me, therefore I will call on him as long as I live.

hausa: Tabbatacce, ba mai shiga gidan mai ƙarfi yă kwashe dukiyarsa, sai bayan ya daure mai ƙarfin, sa’an nan zai iya yin fashin gidansa.
english: But no one can enter into the house of the strong man to plunder unless he first binds the strong man; then he will plunder his house.

hausa: Duk wanda ya karɓi annabi don shi annabi ne, zai sami ladar annabi, duk kuwa wanda ya karɓi mutum mai adalci don shi mai adalci ne, zai sami ladar mai adalci.
english: He who receives a prophet in the name of a prophet will receive a prophet’s reward. He who receives a righteous man in the name of a righteous man will receive a righteous man’s reward.

hausa: Ya tare hanyata da tubula na duwatsu; ya sa hanyata ta karkace.
english: He has walled up my ways with cut stone. He has made my paths crooked.

hausa: “Har wa yau dai kun ji an faɗa wa mutane a dā, ‘Kada ka karya alkawarinka, sai dai ka cika alkawaran da ka yi wa Ubangiji.’
english: “Again you have heard that it was said to the ancient ones, ‘You shall not make false vows, but shall perform to the Lord your vows,’

hausa: Tsoron Ubangiji shi ne masomin ilimi, amma wawaye sun rena hikima da horo.
english: The fear of Yahweh is the beginning of knowledge, but the foolish despise wisdom and instruction.

hausa: Ba na ajiyar alherin Allah a gefe, gama da a ce ana samun adalci ta wurin Doka, ai, da Kiristi ya mutu a banza ke nan!”
english: I don’t reject the grace of God. For if righteousness is through the law, then Christ died for nothing!”

hausa: Ya Ubangiji, ka saurara! Ya Ubangiji ka gafarta! Ya Ubangiji, ka ji ka kuma yi wani abu! Saboda sunanka, ya Allahna, kada ka yi jinkiri, domin da sunanka ake kiran birninka da jama’arka.”
english: Lord, hear. Lord, forgive. Lord, listen and do. Don’t defer, for your own sake, my God, because your city and your people are called by your name.”

hausa: Za a kuma ce, “Ku gina, ku gina, ku gyara hanya! Ku kawar da abubuwan sa tuntuɓe a hanyar mutanena.”
english: He will say, “Build up, build up, prepare the way! Remove the stumbling-block out of the way of my people.”

hausa: Yotam ya sāke ginin Ƙofar Bisa na haikalin Ubangiji, ya kuma yi aiki sosai a katanga a tudun Ofel.
english: He built the upper gate of Yahweh’s house, and he built much on the wall of Ophel.

hausa: Sai mahayin dokin ya hau, ya ruga, ya taryi Yehu, ya ce, “Ga abin da sarki ya ce, ‘Lafiya?’ ” Sai Yehu ya ce masa, “Ina ruwanka da zancen lafiya? Ka shiga layi.” Sai mai tsaron ya ce wa sarki, “Ɗan saƙon ya kai wurinsu, amma ba ya dawowa.”
english: So one went on horseback to meet him, and said, “the king says, ‘Is it peace?’” Jehu said, “What do you have to do with peace? Fall in behind me!” The watchman said, “The messenger came to them, but he isn’t coming back.”

hausa: Kowa ya sani cewa na gaba shi yake sa wa na baya albarka.
english: But without any dispute the lesser is blessed by the greater.

hausa: Suka shigo da kekunan yaƙi daga Masar a kan shekel ɗari shida-shida na azurfa, doki kuma a kan shekel ɗari da hamsin-hamsin. Suka kuma riƙa fitar da su ƙasashen waje zuwa dukan sarakunan Hittiyawa da na Arameyawa.
english: They imported from Egypt then exported a chariot for six hundred pieces of silver and a horse for one hundred fifty. They also exported them to the Hittite kings and the Syrian kings.

hausa: Gama haka Ubangiji ya faɗa, “A wannan lokaci zan jefar da waɗanda suke zaune a ƙasar; zan kawo damuwa a kansu domin a kama su.”
english: For Yahweh says, “Behold, I will sling out the inhabitants of the land at this time, and will distress them, that they may feel it.”

hausa: “Sa’ad da dukan wannan ya cika kuma zai cika ɗin, sa’an nan za su sani akwai annabi a tsakiyarsu.”
english: “When this comes to pass—behold, it comes—then they will know that a prophet has been among them.”

hausa: na bari suka ƙazantu ta wurin kyautai, hadayar kowane ɗan fari don in cika su da abin tsoro domin su san cewa ni ne Ubangiji.’
english: I polluted them in their own gifts, in that they caused all that opens the womb to pass through the fire, that I might make them desolate, to the end that they might know that I am Yahweh.”’

hausa: Gari na wayewa, sai mala’ikun nan suka ƙarfafa Lot suna cewa, “Yi sauri! Ka ɗauki matarka da ’ya’yanka biyu mata waɗanda suke a nan, don kada a shafe ku sa’ad da ake hukunta birnin.”
english: When the morning came, then the angels hurried Lot, saying, “Get up! Take your wife and your two daughters who are here, lest you be consumed in the iniquity of the city.”

hausa: In kana tsoron fāɗa musu, sai ka tafi da bawanka Fura
english: But if you are afraid to go down, go with Purah your servant down to the camp.

hausa: Amma Ubangiji wanda ya fito da ku daga Masar da iko mai girma da hannu mai ƙarfi, shi ne za ku yi masa sujada. Gare shi za ku durƙusa ku kuma miƙa masa hadayu.
english: but you shall fear Yahweh, who brought you up out of the land of Egypt with great power and with an outstretched arm, and you shall bow yourselves to him, and you shall sacrifice to him.

hausa: Ya shiga gidan Allah, da shi da abokan tafiyarsa suka ci keɓaɓɓen burodin, wanda doka ta hana su yi, sai firistoci kaɗai.
english: how he entered into God’s house and ate the show bread, which was not lawful for him to eat, nor for those who were with him, but only for the priests?

hausa: Amma in ya yi shiru, wa zai ba shi laifi? In ya ɓoye fuskarsa, wa zai gan shi? Duk da haka shi yake da iko kan mutum da al’umma duka,
english: When he gives quietness, who then can condemn? When he hides his face, who then can see him? He is over a nation or a man alike,

hausa: Ka mai da kukata ta zama rawa; ka tuɓe rigar makokina ka sa mini na farin ciki,
english: You have turned my mourning into dancing for me. You have removed my sackcloth, and clothed me with gladness,

hausa: Amma ba su saurara ko su kasa kunne ba; ba su juye daga muguntarsu ko su daina ƙone turare wa waɗansu alloli ba.
english: But they didn’t listen and didn’t incline their ear. They didn’t turn from their wickedness, to stop burning incense to other gods.

hausa: Tabbatacce lokaci yana zuwa sa’ad da kome da yake cikin fadanka, da kuma dukan abin da kakanninka suka ajiye har yă zuwa yau, za a kwashe zuwa Babilon babu abin da za a bari, in ji Ubangiji.
english: ‘Behold, the days are coming when all that is in your house, and that which your fathers have stored up until today, will be carried to Babylon. Nothing will be left,’ says Yahweh.

hausa: Amma ba dukan Isra’ilawa ne suka karɓi labari mai daɗin nan ba. Gama Ishaya ya ce, “Ubangiji, wa ya gaskata saƙonmu?”
english: But they didn’t all listen to the glad news. For Isaiah says, “Lord, who has believed our report?”

hausa: Don kada in cika da girman kai saboda waɗannan mafifitan manyan wahayoyi, sai aka sa mini wata ƙaya a jikina wadda ta zama ɗan saƙon Shaiɗan, don ta wahalshe ni.
english: By reason of the exceeding greatness of the revelations, that I should not be exalted excessively, a thorn in the flesh was given to me: a messenger of Satan to torment me, that I should not be exalted excessively.

hausa: Sa’an nan Ubangiji ya ce wa Musa,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

hausa: Masu gadi suka gamu da ni yayinda suke kai kawo a cikin birni. Suka yi mini dūka, suka yi mini rauni; suka ƙwace gyalena waɗannan masu gadin katanga!
english: The watchmen who go about the city found me. They beat me. They bruised me. The keepers of the walls took my cloak away from me.

hausa: ’Ya’yan Oholibama maza ’yar Ana wadda take jikanyar Zibeyon, matar Isuwa, waɗanda ta haifa wa Isuwa su ne, Yewush, Yalam da Kora.
english: These were the sons of Oholibamah, the daughter of Anah, the daughter of Zibeon, Esau’s wife: she bore to Esau Jeush, Jalam, and Korah.

hausa: A kwanakin Yoram, Edom ta yi wa Yahuda tawaye, ta naɗa wa kanta sarki.
english: In his days Edom revolted from under the hand of Judah, and made a king over themselves.

hausa: Ashe, bai kamata kai ma ka ji tausayin abokin bautarka yadda na yi maka ba?’
english: Shouldn’t you also have had mercy on your fellow servant, even as I had mercy on you?’

hausa: Ka kuma faɗa wa Yehohiyakim sarkin Yahuda cewa, ‘Ga abin da Ubangiji yana cewa, ka ƙone wancan littafin ka kuma ce, “Don me ka rubuta a cikinsa, cewa lalle sarkin Babilon zai zo ya hallaka wannan ƙasa, zai kashe mutum duk da dabba?”
english: Concerning Jehoiakim king of Judah you shall say, ‘Yahweh says: “You have burned this scroll, saying, ‘Why have you written therein, saying, “The king of Babylon will certainly come and destroy this land, and will cause to cease from there man and animal”?’”

hausa: Dukan hidimominsu, ko na ɗauko, ko kuma na yin wani aiki, za a yi su ne bisa ga umarnin Haruna da ’ya’yansa. Za ka ba su dukan kayan da za su ɗauka a matsayin hakkinsu.
english: At the commandment of Aaron and his sons shall be all the service of the sons of the Gershonites, in all their burden and in all their service; and you shall appoint their duty to them in all their responsibilities.

hausa: Kada ka ba da ni da sha’awar maƙiyina, gama masu shaidar ƙarya sun taso a kaina, suna numfasa tashin hankali.
english: Don’t deliver me over to the desire of my adversaries, for false witnesses have risen up against me, such as breathe out cruelty.

hausa: Ta wurin daɗin baki zai gurɓata waɗannan da suka karya alkawari, amma mutanen da suka san Allahnsu za su yi tsayin daka su yi jayayya da shi.
english: He will corrupt those who do wickedly against the covenant by flatteries; but the people who know their God will be strong and take action.

hausa: Sai annabi Ishaya ya tafi wurin Sarki Hezekiya ya tambaye shi ya ce, “Me mutanen nan suka ce, kuma daga ina suka fito?” Sai Hezekiya ya ce, “Daga ƙasa mai nisa. Daga Babilon.”
english: Then Isaiah the prophet came to King Hezekiah, and said to him, “What did these men say? From where did they come to you?” Hezekiah said, “They have come from a far country, even from Babylon.”

hausa: Ina mai hikima? Ina mai zurfin bincike? Ina masana na wannan zamani? Ashe, Allah bai wofinta hikimar duniya ba?
english: Where is the wise? Where is the scribe? Where is the debater of this age? Hasn’t God made foolish the wisdom of this world?

hausa: Zuciya mai damuwa takan naƙasar da mutum, amma maganar alheri kan faranta masa rai.
english: Anxiety in a man’s heart weighs it down, but a kind word makes it glad.

hausa: “Shi ba mutum ba ne kamar ni wanda zan iya amsa masa, har da za mu yi faɗa da juna a wurin shari’a.
english: For he is not a man, as I am, that I should answer him, that we should come together in judgment.

hausa: Ba ka farin ciki a hadaya, ai da na kawo; ba ka jin daɗin hadayun ƙonawa.
english: For you don’t delight in sacrifice, or else I would give it. You have no pleasure in burnt offering.

hausa: Abokina ƙaunatacce, ina addu’a ka sami zaman lafiya don kome yă yi maka daidai, kamar yadda ruhunka yake zaune lafiya.
english: Beloved, I pray that you may prosper in all things and be healthy, even as your soul prospers.

hausa: Kamar zinariya a hancin alade haka kyan mace wadda ba ta da hankali.
english: Like a gold ring in a pig’s snout, is a beautiful woman who lacks discretion.

hausa: Amma suka amsa suka ce, “Bayinka dā su goma sha biyu ne, ’yan’uwa, ’ya’yan mutum guda maza, wanda yake zama a ƙasar Kan’ana. Ƙaraminmu yanzu yana tare da mahaifinmu, ɗayan kuma ya rasu.”
english: They said, “We, your servants, are twelve brothers, the sons of one man in the land of Canaan; and behold, the youngest is today with our father, and one is no more.”

hausa: A cikinsu, kun ga siffofi masu banƙyama da gumaka na itace da dutse, na azurfa da zinariya.
english: and you have seen their abominations and their idols of wood, stone, silver, and gold, which were among them);

hausa: Ana nan sa’ad da taron dubban mutane suka taru har suna tattaka juna, Yesu fara yin magana, da farko da almajiransa ya ce, “Ku yi hankali da yistin Farisiyawa, wato, munafunci.
english: Meanwhile, when a multitude of many thousands had gathered together, so much so that they trampled on each other, he began to tell his disciples first of all, “Beware of the yeast of the Pharisees, which is hypocrisy.

hausa: Sai na ce, “Ba haka ba ne, Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka! Ban taɓa ƙazantar da kaina ba. Daga ƙuruciyata har zuwa yanzu ban taɓa cin wani abin da aka samu ya mutu ko abin da namun jeji suka kashe ba. Ba nama marar tsabtan da ya taɓa shiga bakina.”
english: Then I said, “Ah Lord Yahweh! Behold, my soul has not been polluted; for from my youth up even until now I have not eaten of that which dies of itself, or is torn of animals. No abominable meat has come into my mouth!”

hausa: Musa yana da shekara ɗari da ashirin sa’ad da ya mutu, duk da haka idanunsa ba su dushe ba, ƙarfinsa kuwa bai ragu ba.
english: Moses was one hundred twenty years old when he died. His eye was not dim, nor his strength gone.

hausa: Ɗan Mutum zai aiki mala’ikunsa, su kuwa cire daga mulkinsa kome da yake jawo zunubi da kuma duk masu aikata mugunta.
