english: The Son of Man will send out his angels, and they will gather out of his Kingdom all things that cause stumbling and those who do iniquity,

hausa: Ko da yake akan nuna wa mugaye alheri, ba sa koyi adalci; har ma a ƙasar masu aikata gaskiya sukan ci gaba da aikata mugunta ba sa ganin girmar darajar Ubangiji.
english: Let favor be shown to the wicked, yet he will not learn righteousness. In the land of uprightness he will deal wrongfully, and will not see Yahweh’s majesty.

hausa: sun yi mini danniya ƙwarai tun ina ƙarami, amma ba su yi nasara a kaina ba.
english: many times they have afflicted me from my youth up, yet they have not prevailed against me.

hausa: domin su mallaki raguwar Edom da duk al’ummai da suke amsa sunana,” in ji Ubangiji shi wanda zai yi waɗannan abubuwa.
english: that they may possess the remnant of Edom and all the nations who are called by my name,” says Yahweh who does this.

hausa: Amaziya ya tattara mutanen Yahuda ya kuma ba su aiki bisa ga iyalansu, ya ba da aiki ga shugabannin dubu-dubu da shugabannin ɗari-ɗari, a dukan Yahuda da Benyamin. Ya kuma tattara waɗanda suke ’yan shekara ashirin da haihuwa ko fiye ya sami mutane dubu ɗari uku da suke a shirye don aikin soja, da suka isa riƙe māshi da garkuwa.
english: Moreover Amaziah gathered Judah together and ordered them according to their fathers’ houses, under captains of thousands and captains of hundreds, even all Judah and Benjamin. He counted them from twenty years old and upward, and found that there were three hundred thousand chosen men, able to go out to war, who could handle spear and shield.

hausa: Saboda haka, bangaskiya takan zo ne ta wurin jin saƙo, akan ji saƙon kuma ta wurin maganar Kiristi.
english: So faith comes by hearing, and hearing by the word of God.

hausa: ka kuma kafa katakai biyu a kusurwoyi can ƙarshe.
english: You shall make two boards for the corners of the tabernacle in the far side.

hausa: Ya kawar da karuwai maza na masujadai da suke kan tuddai waɗanda suka rage tun mulkin mahaifinsa Asa.
english: The remnant of the sodomites, that remained in the days of his father Asa, he put away out of the land.

hausa: Mutanen da suka yi kwanto su ma suka fito daga birnin suka tasar musu, ya zama an kama su a tsakiya, ga Isra’ilawa daga kowane gefe. Isra’ilawa kuwa suka karkashe su duka ba su bar wani da rai ba, ba kuma wanda ya tsere.
english: The others came out of the city against them, so they were in the middle of Israel, some on this side, and some on that side. They struck them, so that they let none of them remain or escape.

hausa: Irin abubuwan da Benahiya ɗan Yehohiyada ya yi ke nan; shi ma sananne ne kamar waɗannan jarumawa uku.
english: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada did these things and had a name among the three mighty men.

hausa: Shawulu ya ce, “Ku jefa ƙuri’a tsakanina da ɗana Yonatan.” Sai ƙuri’ar ta fāɗa a kan Yonatan.
english: Saul said, “Cast lots between me and Jonathan my son.” Jonathan was selected.

hausa: “A ƙarƙashin Heshbon masu gudun hijira suna tsaye ba mai taimako, gama wuta ta mutu daga Heshbon, harshen wuta daga tsakiyar Sihon; ta ƙone goshin Mowab, ƙoƙon kai na ’yan tayarwa masu surutu.
english: “Those who fled stand without strength under the shadow of Heshbon; for a fire has gone out of Heshbon, and a flame from the middle of Sihon, and has devoured the corner of Moab, and the crown of the head of the tumultuous ones.

hausa: Saboda haka ta gangara zuwa masussuka ta kuma yi dukan abin da surukarta ta ce ta yi.
english: She went down to the threshing floor, and did everything that her mother-in-law told her.

hausa: Me ya fi wannan kyau a kan duwatsu a ga ƙafafu na masu kawo labari mai daɗi waɗanda suke shelar salama, waɗanda suke kawo labari mai daɗi, waɗanda suke shelar ceto, waɗanda suke ce wa Sihiyona, “Allahnki yana mulki!”
english: How beautiful on the mountains are the feet of him who brings good news, who publishes peace, who brings good news, who proclaims salvation, who says to Zion, “Your God reigns!”

hausa: Bayan ya haifi Reyu, Feleg ya yi shekara 209, ya kuma haifi waɗansu ’ya’ya maza da mata.
english: Peleg lived two hundred nine years after he became the father of Reu, and became the father of more sons and daughters.

hausa: Ainihin mamar ɗan da yake a raye ta cika da tausayi saboda ɗanta, sai ta ce wa sarki, “Ina roƙonka, ranka yă daɗe, kada ka kashe yaron! Ka ba ta kawai!” Amma ɗayan matar ta ce, “Kada a ba kowa daga cikinmu ɗan da rai, a ci gaba a raba shi!”
english: Then the woman whose the living child was spoke to the king, for her heart yearned over her son, and she said, “Oh, my lord, give her the living child, and in no way kill him!” But the other said, “He shall be neither mine nor yours. Divide him.”

hausa: Kada ka yi zato baiwarka ’yar iska ce. Ina addu’a a nan saboda yawan azaba da baƙin cikin da nake ciki.”
english: Don’t consider your servant a wicked woman; for I have been speaking out of the abundance of my complaint and my provocation.”

hausa: Kada ku nuna sonkai a cikin hukuncinku, ku saurari kowane ɓangare, babba da ƙarami, kada ku ji tsoron wani, gama hukunci na Allah ne. Ku kawo kowane batun da ya sha ƙarfinku, zan kuwa saurare shi.”
english: You shall not show partiality in judgment; you shall hear the small and the great alike. You shall not be afraid of the face of man, for the judgment is God’s. The case that is too hard for you, you shall bring to me, and I will hear it.”

hausa: Amma suka nace, suna cewa, “Yana tā da hankulan mutane, ko’ina a Yahudiya da koyarwarsa. Ya fara daga Galili, ga shi har ya kai nan.”
english: But they insisted, saying, “He stirs up the people, teaching throughout all Judea, beginning from Galilee even to this place.”

hausa: A shirye muke mu hori kowane rashin biyayya, sa’ad da biyayyarku ta cika.
english: and being in readiness to avenge all disobedience when your obedience is made full.

hausa: Kada ku tsorata saboda su, gama Ubangiji Allahnku, wanda yake a cikinku, Allah ne mai girma da kuma mai banrazana.
english: You shall not be scared of them; for Yahweh your God is among you, a great and awesome God.

hausa: Ko da yake masu fariya sun shafe ni da ƙarairayi, na kiyaye farillanka da dukan zuciyata.
english: The proud have smeared a lie upon me. With my whole heart, I will keep your precepts.

hausa: Ana nan bayan haka sai waɗannan abubuwa suka faru. Nabot mutumin Yezireyel yana da gonar inabi a Yezireyel, a yankin Samariya, kusa da gidan Sarki Ahab.
english: After these things, Naboth the Jezreelite had a vineyard which was in Jezreel, next to the palace of Ahab king of Samaria.

hausa: Sai Hiridus ya kira Masanan nan a ɓoye, yă gano daga wurinsu daidai lokacin da tauraron ya bayyana.
english: Then Herod secretly called the wise men, and learned from them exactly what time the star appeared.

hausa: Kashegari suka miƙa hadayu ga Ubangiji suka kuma miƙa hadayu bijimai dubu, raguna dubu da kuma ’yan raguna dubu na ƙonawa gare shi, tare da hadayunsu na sha da sauran hadayu a yalwace saboda dukan Isra’ila.
english: They sacrificed sacrifices to Yahweh and offered burnt offerings to Yahweh on the next day after that day, even one thousand bulls, one thousand rams, and one thousand lambs, with their drink offerings and sacrifices in abundance for all Israel,

hausa: ’Ya’yan Aram maza su ne, Uz, Hul, Geter da Mash.
english: The sons of Aram were: Uz, Hul, Gether, and Mash.

hausa: Yesu ya ce musu, “Tabbatacce za ku sha daga kwaf na, sai dai zama a damana, ko haguna, ba ni nake da izinin bayarwa ba. Waɗannan wurare na waɗanda Ubana ya shirya wa ne.”
english: He said to them, “You will indeed drink my cup, and be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with; but to sit on my right hand and on my left hand is not mine to give, but it is for whom it has been prepared by my Father.”

hausa: A nan fa sai waɗansu almajiransa suka ce wa juna, “Me yake nufi da cewa, ‘Jim kaɗan ba za ku ƙara ganina ba, kuma bayan an jima kaɗan, za ku gan ni,’ da kuma, ‘Domin zan tafi wurin Uba’?”
english: Some of his disciples therefore said to one another, “What is this that he says to us, ‘A little while, and you won’t see me, and again a little while, and you will see me;’ and, ‘Because I go to the Father’?”

hausa: Sandan da yake tsakiyar katakan, zai bi daga wannan gefe zuwa ƙarshen wancan gefe.
english: The middle bar in the middle of the boards shall pass through from end to end.

hausa: A Ikoniyum Bulus da Barnabas suka shiga majami’ar Yahudawa yadda suka saba. A can suka yi magana gabagadi har Yahudawa da Al’ummai masu yawa suka gaskata.
english: In Iconium, they entered together into the synagogue of the Jews, and so spoke that a great multitude both of Jews and of Greeks believed.

hausa: Game da Zebulun ya ce, “Ka yi farin ciki, Zebulun, a fitowarka, kai kuma Issakar, a cikin tentunanka.
english: About Zebulun he said, “Rejoice, Zebulun, in your going out; and Issachar, in your tents.

hausa: Sai Ibrahim ya shuka itacen tsamiya a Beyersheba, a can kuma ya kira bisa sunan Ubangiji, Allah Madawwami.
english: Abraham planted a tamarisk tree in Beersheba, and there he called on the name of Yahweh, the Everlasting God.

hausa: Kamar al’ummai da Ubangiji ya hallakar kafin ku, haka zai hallaka ku, domin ba ku yi biyayya da muryar Ubangiji Allahnku ba.
english: As the nations that Yahweh makes to perish before you, so you shall perish, because you wouldn’t listen to Yahweh your God’s voice.

hausa: Da Yesu ya shiga Kafarnahum, sai wani jarumi ya zo wurinsa, yana neman taimako.
english: When he came into Capernaum, a centurion came to him, asking him for help,

hausa: Sa’ad da na kawo su cikin ƙasar da na rantse zan ba su suka kuma ga tudu mai tsawo ko itace mai ganye, a can suka miƙa hadayunsu, suka yi sadakokin da suka tsokane ni na yi fushi, suka miƙa turaren ƙanshinsu suka kuma zuba sadakokinsu na sha.
english: For when I had brought them into the land which I swore to give to them, then they saw every high hill and every thick tree, and they offered there their sacrifices, and there they presented the provocation of their offering. There they also made their pleasant aroma, and there they poured out their drink offerings.

hausa: Ranka yă daɗe ya tambayi bayinka ya ce, ‘Kuna da mahaifi ko ɗan’uwa?’
english: My lord asked his servants, saying, ‘Have you a father, or a brother?’

hausa: Waɗannan su ne kabilan Ruben; jimillarsu ta kai 43,730.
english: These are the families of the Reubenites; and those who were counted of them were forty-three thousand seven hundred thirty.

hausa: duk wanda kuma bai ɗauki gicciyensa ya bi ni ba, bai dace yă zama nawa ba.
english: He who doesn’t take his cross and follow after me isn’t worthy of me.

hausa: Kashegari da safe da mutanen Ashdod suka farka sai ga Dagon ya fāɗi a gaban akwatin alkawarin Ubangiji. Sai suka ɗauki Dagon suka ajiye a wurin zamansa.
english: When the people of Ashdod arose early on the next day, behold, Dagon had fallen on his face to the ground before Yahweh’s ark. They took Dagon and set him in his place again.

hausa: Yowash ya yi abin da yake daidai a gaban Ubangiji duka shekarun Yehohiyada firist.
english: Joash did that which was right in Yahweh’s eyes all the days of Jehoiada the priest.

hausa: Waɗansu sun zauna a cikin duhu da kuma zurfin ɓacin rai, ’yan kurkuku suna wahala cikin sarƙoƙin ƙarfe,
english: Some sat in darkness and in the shadow of death, being bound in affliction and iron,

hausa: Amma ba su sami ko ɗaya ba, ko da yake masu shaidar ƙarya da yawa sun firfito. A ƙarshe, biyu suka zo gaba,
english: and they found none. Even though many false witnesses came forward, they found none. But at last two false witnesses came forward

hausa: na Rama da na Geba 621
english: The men of Ramah and Geba: six hundred twenty-one.

hausa: inda ta shiga gidan Zakariya ta kuma gai da Elizabet.
english: and entered into the house of Zacharias and greeted Elizabeth.

hausa: Amma ku tuna da Ubangiji Allahnku, gama shi ne wanda yake ba ku azanci na yin arziki, ta haka kuwa ya tabbatar da alkawarinsa, wanda ya rantse wa kakanninku, kamar yadda yake a yau.
english: But you shall remember Yahweh your God, for it is he who gives you power to get wealth, that he may establish his covenant which he swore to your fathers, as it is today.

hausa: Mun riga mun sha wahala, aka kuma zage mu a Filibbi, kamar yadda kuka sani, amma da taimakon Allahnmu muka yi ƙarfin hali muka sanar muku bishararsa duk da matsananciyar gāba.
english: but having suffered before and been shamefully treated, as you know, at Philippi, we grew bold in our God to tell you the Good News of God in much conflict.

hausa: Yesu ya kalle shi da ƙauna ya ce, “Abu ɗaya ka rasa, ka tafi ka sayar da duk abin da kake da shi, ka ba wa matalauta, za ka kuwa sami dukiya a sama. Sa’an nan ka zo ka bi ni.”
english: Jesus looking at him loved him, and said to him, “One thing you lack. Go, sell whatever you have and give to the poor, and you will have treasure in heaven; and come, follow me, taking up the cross.”

hausa: Sa’ad da Yesu yake fitar da wani beben aljani daga wani mutum, da aljanin ya fita, sai mutumin wanda da bebe ne, ya yi magana, taron kuwa suka yi mamaki.
english: He was casting out a demon, and it was mute. When the demon had gone out, the mute man spoke; and the multitudes marveled.

hausa: Bari Allah mai ba da haƙuri da kuma ƙarfafawa yă ba ku ruhun haɗinkai da juna yayinda kuke bin Kiristi Yesu,
english: Now the God of perseverance and of encouragement grant you to be of the same mind with one another according to Christ Jesus,

hausa: Sai Fir’auna ya aika a kira Musa da Haruna. Ya ce musu, “A wannan karo na yi zunubi. Ubangiji, shi ne da gaskiya, ni da mutane mu ke da kuskure.
english: Pharaoh sent and called for Moses and Aaron, and said to them, “I have sinned this time. Yahweh is righteous, and I and my people are wicked.

hausa: Kai kuma Fashhur, da dukan waɗanda suke a gidanka za ku tafi zaman bauta a Babilon. A can za ku mutu a kuma binne ku, da kai da dukan abokanka waɗanda ka yi musu annabce-annabcen ƙarya.’ ”
english: You, Pashhur, and all who dwell in your house will go into captivity. You will come to Babylon, and there you will die, and there you will be buried, you, and all your friends, to whom you have prophesied falsely.’”

hausa: Kalmomi masu daɗi suna kama da kakin zuma, mai zaƙi ga rai da kuma warkarwa ga ƙasusuwa.
english: Pleasant words are a honeycomb, sweet to the soul, and health to the bones.

hausa: Tekuna sun taso, ya Ubangiji, tekuna sun ta da muryarsu; tekuna sun tā da ta raƙumansu masu tumbatsa.
english: The floods have lifted up, Yahweh, the floods have lifted up their voice. The floods lift up their waves.

hausa: Ubangiji mai girma yana a Sihiyona; an ɗaukaka shi a bisa dukan al’ummai.
english: Yahweh is great in Zion. He is high above all the peoples.

hausa: sai na sa abokan gābanka su zama matashin sawunka.” ’
english: until I make your enemies the footstool of your feet.”’

hausa: Yonatan ya ba wa yaron makaman ya ce, “Ka ɗauka ka koma gari.”
english: Jonathan gave his weapons to his boy, and said to him, “Go, carry them to the city.”

hausa: Kuma a cikin sunansa za a yi wa’azin tuba da gafarar zunubai, ga dukan ƙasashe. Za a kuwa fara daga Urushalima.
english: and that repentance and remission of sins should be preached in his name to all the nations, beginning at Jerusalem.

hausa: Sai Musa ya ce Haruna, “Ga abin da Ubangiji yake nufi sa’ad da ya ce, “ ‘A cikin waɗanda suka kusace ni za a tabbata ni mai tsarki ne; a fuskar dukan mutane za a kuwa girmama ni.’ ” Haruna ya yi shiru.
english: Then Moses said to Aaron, “This is what Yahweh spoke of, saying, ‘I will show myself holy to those who come near me, and before all the people I will be glorified.’” Aaron held his peace.

hausa: Tabbatacce alheri da ƙauna za su bi dukan kwanakin raina, zan kuwa zauna a gidan Ubangiji har abada.
english: Surely goodness and loving kindness shall follow me all the days of my life, and I will dwell in Yahweh’s house forever.

hausa: Sai ya ƙi. Ya ce, “Ba zan ci abinci ba.” Sai da bayinsa da matar suka roƙe shi, sa’an nan ya ji maganarsu, ya tashi daga ƙasa, ya zauna a bakin gado.
english: But he refused, and said, “I will not eat.” But his servants, together with the woman, constrained him; and he listened to their voice. So he arose from the earth and sat on the bed.

hausa: Isra’ila ma bai zama abin dariya a gare ki ba? Ba a kama shi cikin ɓarayi, har kaɗa kai na ba’a kike yi a duka sa’ad da kike magana game da shi?
english: For wasn’t Israel a derision to you? Was he found among thieves? For as often as you speak of him, you shake your head.

hausa: Tsoron Ubangiji shi ne maɓulɓular rai yakan juye mutum daga tarkon mutuwa.
english: The fear of Yahweh is a fountain of life, turning people from the snares of death.

hausa: Ishaya kuma ya fito gabagadi ya ce, “Waɗanda ba su neme ni ba, su suka same ni; Na bayyana kaina ga waɗanda ba su ma taɓa neman sanina ba.”
english: Isaiah is very bold and says, “I was found by those who didn’t seek me. I was revealed to those who didn’t ask for me.”

hausa: Amma Nadab da Abihu sun mutu kafin mahaifinsu, ba su kuma haifi ’ya’ya maza ba; saboda haka Eleyazar da Itamar suka yi hidimar firistoci.
english: But Nadab and Abihu died before their father, and had no children; therefore Eleazar and Ithamar served as priests.

hausa: Haka kuma, sa’ad da Allah ya kawo ɗan farinsa a duniya ya ce, “Bari dukan mala’ikun Allah su yi masa sujada.”
english: When he again brings in the firstborn into the world he says, “Let all the angels of God worship him.”

hausa: Gama ina gaya muku, ba za ku sāke ganina ba sai kun ce, ‘Mai albarka ne wanda yake zuwa cikin sunan Ubangiji.’ ”
english: For I tell you, you will not see me from now on, until you say, ‘Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord!’”

hausa: Suka binne shi, dukan Isra’ila kuwa suka yi makoki dominsa, yadda Ubangiji ya faɗa ta wurin bawansa annabi Ahiya.
english: All Israel buried him and mourned for him, according to Yahweh’s word, which he spoke by his servant Ahijah the prophet.

hausa: An yi kan wannan siffa da zinariya zalla, ƙirjinta da kuma hannuwanta an yi su da azurfa, cikinta da kuma cinyarta da tagulla ne.
english: As for this image, its head was of fine gold, its chest and its arms of silver, its belly and its thighs of bronze,

hausa: Amma da suka yi kuka ga Ubangiji, sai ya tad musu da mai ceto, Otniyel ɗan Kenaz, ƙanen Kaleb wanda ya cece su.
english: When the children of Israel cried to Yahweh, Yahweh raised up a savior to the children of Israel, who saved them, even Othniel the son of Kenaz, Caleb’s younger brother.

hausa: Bayan lokacin bikin ya wuce, sai Ayuba yă aika su zo don yă tsarkake su. Tun da sassafe zai miƙa hadaya ta ƙonawa domin kowannensu, don yana tunani cewa, “Mai yiwuwa ’ya’yana sun yi wa Allah zunubi, ko sun la’anta shi a cikin zuciyarsu.” Haka Ayuba ya saba yi.
english: It was so, when the days of their feasting had run their course, that Job sent and sanctified them, and rose up early in the morning, and offered burnt offerings according to the number of them all. For Job said, “It may be that my sons have sinned, and renounced God in their hearts.” Job did so continually.

hausa: Ya gidan Lawi, yabi Ubangiji; ku da kuke tsoronsa, yabi Ubangiji.
english: House of Levi, praise Yahweh! You who fear Yahweh, praise Yahweh!

hausa: Kai, marar azanci! Abin da kuka shuka ba zai tsira ba sai ya mutu.
english: You foolish one, that which you yourself sow is not made alive unless it dies.

hausa: Abin da zan faɗa gaskiya ne daga cikin zuciyata; bakina zai faɗi gaskiyar abin da na sani.
english: My words will utter the uprightness of my heart. That which my lips know they will speak sincerely.

hausa: Gama kowane mai rai nawa ne, mahaifi da ɗa, duk nawa ne. Mutumin da ya yi zunubi shi zai mutu.
english: Behold, all souls are mine; as the soul of the father, so also the soul of the son is mine. The soul who sins, he shall die.

hausa: “Waɗannan su ne aune-aunen bagade a tsawon kamu, wannan kamu shi ne kamun tafin hannu. Zurfin magudanar ruwansa kamu ɗaya ne fāɗinsa kuma kamu ɗaya, tare da da’ira kamun tafi ɗaya kewaye da gefensa. Wannan kuma shi ne tsayin bagaden.
english: “These are the measurements of the altar by cubits (the cubit is a cubit and a hand width): the bottom shall be a cubit, and the width a cubit, and its border around its edge a span; and this shall be the base of the altar.

hausa: Teku ya ba da matattu da suke cikinsa, mutuwa da Hades kuma suka ba da matattu da suke cikinsu, aka kuma yi wa kowane mutum shari’a bisa ga abin da ya aikata.
english: The sea gave up the dead who were in it. Death and Hades gave up the dead who were in them. They were judged, each one according to his works.

hausa: ta wurina sarakuna suke mulki, da kuma dukan manyan mutanen da suke mulkin duniya.
english: By me princes rule, nobles, and all the righteous rulers of the earth.

hausa: Ni kaɗai, ni ne Ubangiji, kuma in ban da ni babu wani mai ceto.
english: I myself am Yahweh. Besides me, there is no savior.

hausa: Duwatsun Bashan, duwatsu masu alfarma ne; duwatsun Bashan masu wuyar hawa ne.
english: The mountains of Bashan are majestic mountains. The mountains of Bashan are rugged.

hausa: Sa’ad da ya sauka a Kaisariya, sai ya haura ya gai da ikkilisiya sa’an nan ya gangara zuwa Antiyok.
english: When he had landed at Caesarea, he went up and greeted the assembly, and went down to Antioch.

hausa: Ƙungiyar mawaƙa ta biyu suka yi jerin gwano a ɗaya gefen. Na bi su a bisan katangar, tare da rabin mutanen, muka wuce Hasumiya Tanderu zuwa Katanga Mai Faɗi,
english: The other company of those who gave thanks went to meet them, and I after them, with the half of the people on the wall above the tower of the furnaces, even to the wide wall,

hausa: Amma bai sayi gonakin firistoci ba, gama suna karɓa rabo daga Fir’auna ne, suna kuma da isashen abinci daga rabon da Fir’auna yake ba su. Dalilin ke nan da ba su sayar da gonakinsu ba.
english: Only he didn’t buy the land of the priests, for the priests had a portion from Pharaoh, and ate their portion which Pharaoh gave them. That is why they didn’t sell their land.

hausa: Sai sarki ya ce wa mutumin Allah, “Zo gida tare da ni, ka sami wani abu ka ci, zan kuwa yi maka kyauta.”
english: The king said to the man of God, “Come home with me and refresh yourself, and I will give you a reward.”

hausa: Saboda haka, Allah ya ce wa Nuhu, “Zan kawo ƙarshen dukan mutane, gama saboda su duniya ta cika da tashin hankali. Lalle zan hallaka su da kuma duniya.
english: God said to Noah, “I will bring an end to all flesh, for the earth is filled with violence through them. Behold, I will destroy them and the earth.

hausa: Sai ’yar Fir’auna ta gangara zuwa kogi domin tă yi wanka, bayinta kuwa suna tafiya a bakin kogi. Sai ta ga kwandon a ciyawa, ta aiki ɗaya daga cikin masu hidimarta tă ɗauko mata.
english: Pharaoh’s daughter came down to bathe at the river. Her maidens walked along by the riverside. She saw the basket among the reeds, and sent her servant to get it.

hausa: To, a wannan lokaci kuwa suna da wani shahararren ɗan kurkuku da ake kira Barabbas.
english: They had then a notable prisoner called Barabbas.

hausa: Bayan kwana shida, sai Yesu ya ɗauki Bitrus, Yaƙub da Yohanna tare da shi, ya kai su kan wani dutse mai tsawo, suka kasance su kaɗai a wurin. A can aka sāke kamanninsa a gabansu.
english: After six days Jesus took with him Peter, James, and John, and brought them up onto a high mountain privately by themselves, and he was changed into another form in front of them.

hausa: Irin wannan bala’i zai auko wa dawakai da alfadarai, raƙuma da jakuna, da kuma dukan dabbobi a wannan sansani.
english: A plague like this will fall on the horse, on the mule, on the camel, on the donkey, and on all the animals that will be in those camps.

hausa: Duk a cikin ƙasar ba a samu kyawawan mata kamar ’ya’yan Ayuba ba, kuma babansu ya ba su gādo tare ta ’yan’uwansu maza.
english: In all the land were no women found so beautiful as the daughters of Job. Their father gave them an inheritance among their brothers.

hausa: In masu adalci sun sami abin da ya dace da su a duniya, yaya zai zama ga marasa sanin Allah da kuma masu zunubi!
english: Behold, the righteous shall be repaid on the earth, how much more the wicked and the sinner!

hausa: Waɗansunsu ma suka haye Urdun zuwa ƙasar Gad da Gileyad. Shawulu ya zauna Gilgal, dukan ƙungiyoyi sojojin da suke tare da shi suka yi rawan jiki don tsoro.
english: Now some of the Hebrews had gone over the Jordan to the land of Gad and Gilead; but as for Saul, he was yet in Gilgal, and all the people followed him trembling.

hausa: ’Ya’yan Kohat maza su ne, Amram, Izhar, Hebron da Uzziyel.
english: The sons of Kohath were Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.

hausa: Gama dare da rana hannunka yana da nauyi a kaina; an shanye ƙarfina ƙaf sai ka ce a zafin bazara. Sela
english: For day and night your hand was heavy on me. My strength was sapped in the heat of summer. Selah.

hausa: Ina roƙonku, ’yan’uwa, ku yi hankali fa da masu raba tsakani, saɓanin koyarwar da kuka koya, suna sa tuntuɓe. Ku yi nesa da su.
english: Now I beg you, brothers, look out for those who are causing the divisions and occasions of stumbling, contrary to the doctrine which you learned, and turn away from them.

hausa: ɗan Serug, ɗan Reyu, ɗan Feleg, ɗan Eber, ɗan Sala,
english: the son of Serug, the son of Reu, the son of Peleg, the son of Eber, the son of Shelah,

hausa: “ ‘Saboda haka ga abin da Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka yana cewa ina gāba da kambunanku waɗanda kuke farautar mutane da su kamar tsuntsaye don haka zan kuma tsintsinke su daga hannuwanku; zan ’yantar da mutanen da kuka farauto kamar tsuntsaye.
english: “Therefore the Lord Yahweh says: ‘Behold, I am against your magic bands, with which you hunt the souls to make them fly, and I will tear them from your arms. I will let the souls fly free, even the souls whom you ensnare like birds.

hausa: Ina sanar da ku, ’yan’uwa, cewa nama da jini ba za su gāji mulkin Allah ba, haka ma ruɓa ba zai gāji rashin ruɓa ba.
english: Now I say this, brothers, that flesh and blood can’t inherit God’s Kingdom; neither does the perishable inherit imperishable.

hausa: su ce, “ ‘Kaito! Kaito, ya birni mai girma, saye da lallausan lilin, shunayya da kuma ja, mai walƙiya da zinariya, duwatsu masu daraja da kuma lu’ulu’ai!
english: saying, ‘Woe, woe, the great city, she who was dressed in fine linen, purple, and scarlet, and decked with gold and precious stones and pearls!

hausa: “Da ma ina nan lokacin da ya wuce baya can, kwanakin da Allah yake lura da ni,
english: “Oh that I were as in the months of old, as in the days when God watched over me;

hausa: Ashe, Ubangiji bai maishe su ɗaya ba? Cikin jiki da ruhu, su nasa ne. Me ya sa suke ɗaya? Domin yana neman ’ya’ya masu tsoron Allah. Saboda haka sai ka lura da kanka, kada kuma ka ci amanar matar ƙuruciyarka.
english: Did he not make you one, although he had the residue of the Spirit? Why one? He sought godly offspring. Therefore take heed to your spirit, and let no one deal treacherously against the wife of his youth.

hausa: Mutumin ya ce masa, “Wa ya mai da kai mai mulki da mai hukunci a kanmu? Kana so ne ka kashe ni kamar yadda ka kashe mutumin Masar nan?” Sai Musa ya tsorata, ya yi tunani ya ce, “To, fa, abin nan da na yi, ya zama sananne.”
english: He said, “Who made you a prince and a judge over us? Do you plan to kill me, as you killed the Egyptian?” Moses was afraid, and said, “Surely this thing is known.”

hausa: Ko lokacin da nake kira don neman taimako, ba ya jin addu’ata.
english: Yes, when I cry, and call for help, he shuts out my prayer.

hausa: Mutanen Merari (sauran Lawiyawan) suka sami waɗannan. Daga kabilar Zebulun suka sami Yokneyam, Karta, Rimmon da Tabor, tare da wuraren kiwonsu;
english: To the rest of the Levites, the sons of Merari, were given, out of the tribe of Zebulun, Rimmono with its pasture lands, and Tabor with its pasture lands;

hausa: Yehoyahaz yana da shekara ashirin da uku sa’ad da ya zama sarki, ya kuma yi mulki a Urushalima wata uku.
english: Joahaz was twenty-three years old when he began to reign; and he reigned three months in Jerusalem.

hausa: Ka ɗaura sarƙoƙin zinariyan nan biyu a zoban a kusurwan ƙyallen maƙalawa a ƙirji.
english: You shall put the two braided chains of gold in the two rings at the ends of the breastplate.

hausa: Bayan waɗannan abubuwa, a zamanin Artazerzes sarkin Farisa, sai Ezra ɗan Serahiya, ɗan Azariya, ɗan Hilkiya,
english: Now after these things, in the reign of Artaxerxes king of Persia, Ezra the son of Seraiah, the son of Azariah, the son of Hilkiah,

hausa: kuma don zunubin da ya yi, dole yă kawo wa Ubangiji tunkiya ko akuya daga garke kamar hadaya don zunubi; firist kuwa zai yi kafara dominsa da kuma domin zunubinsa.
english: and he shall bring his trespass offering to Yahweh for his sin which he has sinned: a female from the flock, a lamb or a goat, for a sin offering; and the priest shall make atonement for him concerning his sin.

hausa: “Zuwa ga mala’ikan ikkilisiya a Filadelfiya, ka rubuta, Waɗannan su ne kalmomi, na wanda yake mai tsarki da kuma gaskiya, wanda yake riƙe da mabuɗin Dawuda. Abin da ya buɗe ba mai rufewa, abin da kuma ya rufe ba mai buɗewa.
english: “To the angel of the assembly in Philadelphia write: “He who is holy, he who is true, he who has the key of David, he who opens and no one can shut, and who shuts and no one opens, says these things:

hausa: Saboda haka Lawiyawa suka tsaya a shirye tare da kayan kiɗin Dawuda, firistoci kuma tare da ƙahoninsu.
english: The Levites stood with David’s instruments, and the priests with the trumpets.

hausa: Kuma duk inda kuke zama, ba za ku ci jinin wani tsuntsu ko na dabba ba.
english: You shall not eat any blood, whether it is of bird or of animal, in any of your dwellings.

hausa: Kai, har ma a kan bayina, maza da mata, zan zubo Ruhuna a waɗancan kwanaki, za su kuwa yi annabci.
english: Yes, and on my servants and on my handmaidens in those days, I will pour out my Spirit, and they will prophesy.

hausa: Sai ya amsa ya ce, “Ubangiji yă albarkace ki ’yata. Wannan alheri ya fi wannan da kika nuna da farko. Ba ki gudu kin bi saurayi, mai arziki ko matalauci ba.
english: He said, “You are blessed by Yahweh, my daughter. You have shown more kindness in the latter end than at the beginning, because you didn’t follow young men, whether poor or rich.

hausa: To, Elisha ya kamu da ciwon da ya kashe shi. Yowash sarkin Isra’ila ya gangara don yă gan shi, ya kuma yi kuka dominsa. Ya yi kuka yana cewa, “Babana! Babana, keken yaƙin Isra’ila da mahayan dawakanta!”
english: Now Elisha became sick with the illness of which he died; and Joash the king of Israel came down to him, and wept over him, and said, “My father, my father, the chariots of Israel and its horsemen!”

hausa: za ku yi wa sarkin Babilon wannan ba’a. Mai danniya ya zo ga ƙarshe! Dubi yadda fushinsa ya ƙare!
english: that you will take up this parable against the king of Babylon, and say, “How the oppressor has ceased! The golden city has ceased!”

hausa: Sai Rut mutuniyar Mowab ta ce wa Na’omi, “Bari in tafi gonaki in yi kala raguwar hatsi a bayan duk wanda na sami tagomashi daga gare shi.” Na’omi ta ce mata, “Ki je, ’yata.”
english: Ruth the Moabitess said to Naomi, “Let me now go to the field, and glean among the ears of grain after him in whose sight I find favor.” She said to her, “Go, my daughter.”

hausa: Zan hallaka sarkin Ashdod da kuma mai riƙe da sandar mulki na Ashkelon. Zan hukunta Ekron, har sai dukan Filistiyawa sun mutu,” in ji Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka.
english: I will cut off the inhabitant from Ashdod, and him who holds the scepter from Ashkelon; and I will turn my hand against Ekron; and the remnant of the Philistines will perish,” says the Lord Yahweh.

hausa: Bayan Yoshuwa ya sallami Isra’ilawa, sai suka tafi don su mallaki ƙasar, kowa da nasa gādon.
english: Now when Joshua had sent the people away, the children of Israel each went to his inheritance to possess the land.

hausa: “Ko da yake ba ni da laifi, ban damu da kaina ba; na rena raina.
english: I am blameless. I don’t respect myself. I despise my life.

hausa: Saboda haka suka kama hanya daga dutsen Ubangiji, suka yi tafiya kwana uku. Akwatin alkawarin Ubangiji ya ja gabansu a waɗannan kwanaki uku, don yă samo musu masauƙi.
english: They set forward from the Mount of Yahweh three days’ journey. The ark of Yahweh’s covenant went before them three days’ journey, to seek out a resting place for them.

hausa: Za su yi zancen ɗaukakarka mai daraja, zan kuma yi tunani a kan ayyukanka masu banmamaki.
english: I will meditate on the glorious majesty of your honor, on your wondrous works.

hausa: To, me za mu ce Ibrahim kakan kakanninmu ya gani game da wannan batu?
english: What then will we say that Abraham, our forefather, has found according to the flesh?

hausa: Ka tuna wa mutane su zama masu biyayya ga masu mulki da kuma hukumomi, su zama masu biyayya suna kuma a shirye su yi kowane abin da yake mai kyau,
english: Remind them to be in subjection to rulers and to authorities, to be obedient, to be ready for every good work,

hausa: Ya koma wurin ’yan’uwansa ya ce, “Yaron ba ya can! Ina zan bi yanzu?”
english: He returned to his brothers, and said, “The child is no more; and I, where will I go?”

hausa: Sai ya ga Keniyawa, ya kuma furta maganarsa. “Wurin zamanku lafiya yake, an kuma sa sheƙarku a cikin duwatsu;
english: He looked at the Kenite, and took up his parable, and said, “Your dwelling place is strong. Your nest is set in the rock.

hausa: Dukan taron jama’a suka yarda su yi haka, domin ya yi daidai ga dukan mutane.
english: All the assembly said that they would do so, for the thing was right in the eyes of all the people.

hausa: Kamar ƙafafun gurgun da suka yi laƙwas haka karin magana yake a bakin wawa.
english: Like the legs of the lame that hang loose, so is a parable in the mouth of fools.

hausa: “Saboda haka, in ya gamshi sarki, bari yă ba da hatimi na sarauta, bari kuma a rubuta shi cikin dokokin Farisa da Mediya, wanda ba za a iya sokewa ba, cewa Bashti ba za tă ƙara zuwa gaban sarkin Zerzes ba. Bari kuma sarki yă ba da matsayinta na sarauta ga wata, wadda ta fi ta.
english: “If it pleases the king, let a royal commandment go from him, and let it be written among the laws of the Persians and the Medes, so that it cannot be altered, that Vashti may never again come before King Ahasuerus; and let the king give her royal estate to another who is better than she.

hausa: Ya ba shi tsarin dukan abin da Ruhu ya sa a zuciyarsa saboda filayen haikalin Ubangiji da ɗakunan kewaye, da ma’ajin haikalin Allah da kuma baitulmali na kayayyakin da aka keɓe.
english: and the plans of all that he had by the Spirit, for the courts of Yahweh’s house, for all the surrounding rooms, for the treasuries of God’s house, and for the treasuries of the dedicated things;

hausa: Amma ga abin da Ubangiji yana cewa, “I, za a ƙwace kamammu daga jarumawa, a kuma karɓe ganima daga hannun marasa tsoro; zan gwabza da waɗanda suke gwabzawa da ke, zan kuwa ceci ’ya’yanki.
english: But Yahweh says, “Even the captives of the mighty shall be taken away, and the plunder retrieved from the fierce, for I will contend with him who contends with you and I will save your children.

hausa: Daga zare mai ruwan shuɗi, da shuɗayya da kuma jan zare suka yi tsarkaken rigunan domin hidima a wuri mai tsarki. Suka kuma yi tsarkaken riguna don Haruna, yadda Ubangiji ya umarci Musa.
english: Of the blue, purple, and scarlet, they made finely worked garments for ministering in the holy place, and made the holy garments for Aaron, as Yahweh commanded Moses.

hausa: Ya tare mini hanya yadda ba zan iya wucewa ba; ya rufe hanyata da duhu.
english: He has walled up my way so that I can’t pass, and has set darkness in my paths.

hausa: Suka amsa, “Waɗansu suna ce Yohanna Mai Baftisma; waɗansu kuma suna ce annabi Iliya; har wa yau waɗansu suna ce Irmiya ne ko kuma ɗaya daga cikin annabawa.”
english: They said, “Some say John the Baptizer, some, Elijah, and others, Jeremiah or one of the prophets.”

hausa: Mutanen da suke sansanin suka kira Yonatan da mai ɗaukan makamansa da babbar murya suka ce, “Ku hauro wajenmu, mu kuwa za mu koya muku hankali.” Sai Yonatan ya ce wa mai ɗaukan makamansa, “Biyo ni, gama Ubangiji ya bashe su a hannun Isra’ila.”
english: The men of the garrison answered Jonathan and his armor bearer, and said, “Come up to us, and we will show you something!” Jonathan said to his armor bearer, “Come up after me, for Yahweh has delivered them into the hand of Israel.”

hausa: Adamu ya kwana da matarsa Hawwa’u, ta kuwa yi ciki ta haifi Kayinu. Sai ta ce, “Da taimakon Ubangiji na sami ɗa namiji.”
english: The man knew Eve his wife. She conceived, and gave birth to Cain, and said, “I have gotten a man with Yahweh’s help.”

hausa: “Ku kiyaye dokokina, ku kuma bi su. Ni ne Ubangiji.
english: “Therefore you shall keep my commandments, and do them. I am Yahweh.

hausa: In mace ba ta so tă rufe kanta, to, sai tă aske gashinta; in kuwa abin kunya ne mace tă yanke ko tă aske gashinta, to, sai tă rufe kanta.
english: For if a woman is not covered, let her hair also be cut off. But if it is shameful for a woman to have her hair cut off or be shaved, let her be covered.

hausa: yana bin tsakiyar babban titi na birnin. A kowane gefen kogin akwai itacen rai mai ba da ’ya’ya goma sha biyu, yana ba da ’ya’yansa kowane wata. Ganyayen itacen kuwa saboda warkar da al’ummai ne.
english: in the middle of its street. On this side of the river and on that was the tree of life, bearing twelve kinds of fruits, yielding its fruit every month. The leaves of the tree were for the healing of the nations.

hausa: Ubangiji zai shari’anta tsakanina da kai. Ubangiji zai sāka mini laifin da ka yi mini, amma ni kam ba zan taɓa ka ba.
english: May Yahweh judge between me and you, and may Yahweh avenge me of you; but my hand will not be on you.

hausa: Sai Siman Bitrus ya ce, “To, Ubangiji, ba ƙafafuna kaɗai ba har ma da hannuwana da kaina kuma!”
english: Simon Peter said to him, “Lord, not my feet only, but also my hands and my head!”

hausa: Zuriya masu zuwa za su yi masa hidima; za a faɗa wa zuriya na nan gaba game da Ubangiji.
english: Posterity shall serve him. Future generations shall be told about the Lord.

hausa: Haka ma suka ci sashen Og sarkin Bashan, ɗaya daga cikin Refahiyawa na ƙarshe da ya yi mulki a Ashtarot da Edireyi.
english: and the border of Og king of Bashan, of the remnant of the Rephaim, who lived at Ashtaroth and at Edrei,

hausa: “Gare mu kuwa, Ubangiji shi ne Allah, kuma ba mu yashe shi ba. Firistocin da suke bauta wa Ubangiji ’ya’yan Haruna maza ne, Lawiyawa ne kuwa suke taimakonsu.
english: “But as for us, Yahweh is our God, and we have not forsaken him. We have priests serving Yahweh, the sons of Aaron, and the Levites in their work.

hausa: A cikin ƙaunarka marar ƙarewa, ka rufe bakunan abokan gābana; ka hallaka dukan maƙiyana, gama ni bawanka ne.
english: In your loving kindness, cut off my enemies, and destroy all those who afflict my soul, for I am your servant.

hausa: Nan da nan ’yan’uwa suka sa Bulus yă tafi bakin teku, amma Sila da Timoti suka dakata a Bereya.
english: Then the brothers immediately sent out Paul to go as far as to the sea, and Silas and Timothy still stayed there.

hausa: saboda haka, ka yi abin da muka faɗa maka. Akwai mutum huɗu tare da mu da suka yi alkawari.
english: Therefore do what we tell you. We have four men who have taken a vow.

hausa: Ubangiji ya ce, “Domin ya ƙaunace ni, zan kuɓutar da shi; zan kiyaye shi, gama ya yarda da sunana.
english: “Because he has set his love on me, therefore I will deliver him. I will set him on high, because he has known my name.

hausa: Gaba ɗaya dai, Adamu ya yi shekaru 930, sa’an nan ya mutu.
english: All the days that Adam lived were nine hundred thirty years, then he died.

hausa: Mutane ko’ina a kabilan Isra’ila, suka yi ta gardama da juna, suna cewa, “Sarki ne ya cece mu daga hannun abokan gābanmu, shi ne kuma ya kuɓutar da mu daga hannun Filistiyawa. Amma ga shi ya tsere daga ƙasar saboda Absalom;
english: All the people were at strife throughout all the tribes of Israel, saying, “The king delivered us out of the hand of our enemies, and he saved us out of the hand of the Philistines; and now he has fled out of the land from Absalom.

hausa: Yehiyel mahaifin Gibeyon ya zauna a Gibeyon. Matarsa ita ce Ma’aka
english: Jeiel the father of Gibeon, whose wife’s name was Maacah, lived in Gibeon.

hausa: Ka saurare kukata na neman taimako, Sarkina da Allahna, gama gare ka nake addu’a.
english: Listen to the voice of my cry, my King and my God, for I pray to you.

hausa: Ya faɗi haka domin suna cewa, “Yana da mugun ruhu.”
english: —because they said, “He has an unclean spirit.”

hausa: duniya ba tă ma cancanci su zauna a cikinta ba. Suka yi ta yawo a cikin hamada da a kan duwatsu, da cikin kogwanni da kuma cikin ramummuka.
english: of whom the world was not worthy—wandering in deserts, mountains, caves, and the holes of the earth.

hausa: Ku kiyaye Asabbataina da tsarki, don su zama alama tsakaninmu. Ta haka za ku san cewa ni ne Ubangiji Allahnku.”
english: Make my Sabbaths holy. They shall be a sign between me and you, that you may know that I am Yahweh your God.’

hausa: yakan tsare dukan ƙasusuwansa, ba ko ɗayansu da zai karye.
english: He protects all of his bones. Not one of them is broken.

hausa: ’Ya’yan Yadai maza su ne, Regem, Yotam, Geshan, Felet, Efa da Sha’af.
english: The sons of Jahdai: Regem, Jothan, Geshan, Pelet, Ephah, and Shaaph.

hausa: Sai ya amsa ya ce, “Ku, ku ba su wani abu su ci.” Suka ce masa, “Ai, wannan zai ɗauki albashin wata takwas na mutum! Mu je mu kashe yawan kuɗin nan a burodi mu ba su su ci?”
english: But he answered them, “You give them something to eat.” They asked him, “Shall we go and buy two hundred denarii worth of bread and give them something to eat?”

hausa: Duk wannan zai faru saboda laifin Yaƙub, da kuma zunuban gidan Isra’ila ne. Mene ne laifin Yaƙub? Shin, ba Samariya ba ce? Ina ne maɗaukakan wuraren Yahuda? Shin, ba Urushalima ba ce?
english: “All this is for the disobedience of Jacob, and for the sins of the house of Israel. What is the disobedience of Jacob? Isn’t it Samaria? And what are the high places of Judah? Aren’t they Jerusalem?

hausa: “Ka yi daro na tagulla, ka yi masa ƙafafun da za a ajiye shi da tagulla don wanki. Ka ajiye shi tsakanin Tentin Sujada da bagade, ka zuba ruwa a ciki.
english: “You shall also make a basin of bronze, and its base of bronze, in which to wash. You shall put it between the Tent of Meeting and the altar, and you shall put water in it.

hausa: Haka ma, in kuka ga waɗannan abubuwa suna faruwa, ku sani mulkin Allah ya yi kusa.
english: Even so you also, when you see these things happening, know that God’s Kingdom is near.

hausa: Sa’an nan Ubangiji ya ce wa Musa, “Tashi da sassafe, ka sadu da Fir’auna, ka ce masa, ‘Ga abin da Ubangiji, Allah na Ibraniyawa ya ce, Ka bar mutanena su tafi don su yi mini sujada,
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “Rise up early in the morning, and stand before Pharaoh, and tell him, ‘This is what Yahweh, the God of the Hebrews, says: “Let my people go, that they may serve me.

hausa: Muna gurnani kamar beyar; muna ta ƙugi kamar kurciyoyi. Muna ta neman adalci amma ina; mun nemi fansa, amma yana can da nisa.
english: We all roar like bears and moan sadly like doves. We look for justice, but there is none, for salvation, but it is far off from us.

hausa: Siman Bitrus, bawa da kuma manzon Yesu Kiristi, Zuwa ga waɗanda ta wurin adalcin Allahnmu da Mai Cetonmu Yesu Kiristi sun sami bangaskiya mai daraja irin tamu.
english: Simon Peter, a servant and apostle of Jesus Christ, to those who have obtained a like precious faith with us in the righteousness of our God and Savior, Jesus Christ:

hausa: Waɗansu sun dogara a kekunan yaƙi waɗansu kuma a dawakai, amma mu, mun dogara a cikin sunan Ubangiji Allahnmu.
english: Some trust in chariots, and some in horses, but we trust in the name of Yahweh our God.

hausa: muddin ina raye, in ji Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka, ko da Nuhu, Daniyel da Ayuba suna a cikinta, ba za su iya ceton ɗansu ko ’yarsu ba. Za su iya ceton kansu ne kaɗai ta wurin adalcinsu.
english: though Noah, Daniel, and Job, were in it, as I live,” says the Lord Yahweh, “they would deliver neither son nor daughter; they would deliver only their own souls by their righteousness.”

hausa: Ka buɗe idanuna don in iya gani abubuwan banmamaki a cikin dokarka.
english: Open my eyes, that I may see wondrous things out of your law.

hausa: Sai sarki ya sa aka tattara masa masu sihiri da masu dabo da bokaye da masanan taurari domin su faɗi abin da ya yi mafarki a kai. Da suka shigo suka tsaya a gaban sarki,
english: Then the king commanded that the magicians, the enchanters, the sorcerers, and the Chaldeans be called to tell the king his dreams. So they came in and stood before the king.

hausa: ya je ya zauna a wani garin da ake kira Nazaret. Ta haka aka cika abin da aka faɗa ta bakin annabawa cewa, “Za a ce da shi Banazare.”
english: and came and lived in a city called Nazareth; that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through the prophets that he will be called a Nazarene.

hausa: Yabez ya fi ’yan’uwansa martaba. Mahaifiyarsa ta sa masa suna Yabez, tana cewa, “Na haife shi da azaba.”
english: Jabez was more honorable than his brothers. His mother named him Jabez, saying, “Because I bore him with sorrow.”

hausa: Fetrusiyawa, da Kasluhiyawa (inda Filistiyawa suka fito) da kuma Kaftorawa.
english: Pathrusim, Casluhim (which the Philistines descended from), and Caphtorim.

hausa: Firistocin kuwa da suke ɗauke da akwatin alkawarin Ubangiji suka tsaya daram a kan busasshiyar ƙasa a tsakiyar Urdun a lokacin da Isra’ilawa suka ƙetarewa, har sai da dukan mutane suka gama ƙetarewa.
english: The priests who bore the ark of Yahweh’s covenant stood firm on dry ground in the middle of the Jordan; and all Israel crossed over on dry ground, until all the nation had passed completely over the Jordan.

hausa: Sai Solomon ya tsaya a gaban bagaden Ubangiji, a gaban dukan taron Isra’ila, ya ɗaga hannuwansa sama,
english: Solomon stood before Yahweh’s altar in the presence of all the assembly of Israel, and spread out his hands toward heaven;

hausa: Yesu ya shiga Urushalima ya kuma tafi filin haikali. Ya dudduba kome duka, amma da yake yamma ta yi, sai ya tafi Betani tare da Sha Biyun.
english: Jesus entered into the temple in Jerusalem. When he had looked around at everything, it being now evening, he went out to Bethany with the twelve.

hausa: Ɗayansu ya tafi daga gare ni, na kuwa ce, “Tabbatacce an yayyage shi kaca-kaca.” Ban kuwa gan shi ba tuntuni.
english: One went out from me, and I said, “Surely he is torn in pieces;” and I haven’t seen him since.

hausa: Gama ya sa ranar da zai yi wa duniya shari’a da adalci ta wurin mutumin da ya naɗa. Ya riga ya ba da tabbacin wannan ga dukan mutane ta wurin tā da shi daga matattu.”
english: because he has appointed a day in which he will judge the world in righteousness by the man whom he has ordained; of which he has given assurance to all men, in that he has raised him from the dead.”

hausa: Don mai bi da kaɗe-kaɗe. Da salon “Matar Zomon Safiya.” Zabura ta Dawuda. Ya Allahna, ya Allahna, don me ka yashe ni? Me ya sa ka yi nisa da cetona, ka yi nesa daga kalmomin nishina?
english: For the Chief Musician; set to “The Doe of the Morning.” A Psalm by David. My God, my God, why have you forsaken me? Why are you so far from helping me, and from the words of my groaning?

hausa: In mai adalci ya juye daga adalcinsa ya yi zunubi, zai mutu saboda wannan; saboda zunubin da ya yi, zai mutu.
english: When the righteous man turns away from his righteousness, and commits iniquity, and dies in it, then he dies in his iniquity that he has done.

hausa: Ta wurinsa da kuma saboda sunansa, muka sami alheri muka kuma zama manzanni don mu kira mutane daga cikin dukan Al’ummai zuwa ga biyayyar da take zuwa daga bangaskiya.
english: through whom we received grace and apostleship for obedience of faith among all the nations for his name’s sake;

hausa: Sa’an nan ya auna haikalin; tsawonsa kamu ɗari ne, tsawon filin haikalin da ginin tare da bangayensa su ma kamu ɗari ne.
english: So he measured the temple, one hundred cubits long; and the separate place, and the building, with its walls, one hundred cubits long;

hausa: Suka yi kira da babbar murya suka ce, “Ya Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka, Mai Tsarki da kuma Mai Gaskiya, sai yaushe za ka shari’anta mazaunan duniya ka kuma ɗauki mana fansar jininmu?”
english: They cried with a loud voice, saying, “How long, Master, the holy and true, until you judge and avenge our blood on those who dwell on the earth?”

hausa: “Haka yake kamar yadda na faɗa wa Fir’auna cewa Allah ya nuna wa Fir’auna abin da yake shirin yi.
english: That is the thing which I have spoken to Pharaoh. God has shown Pharaoh what he is about to do.

hausa: Ƙaunataccena yana kama da barewa ko sagarin ƙishimi Duba! Ga shi can tsaye a bayan katangarmu, yana leƙe ta tagogi, yana kallo ta cikin asabari.
english: My beloved is like a roe or a young deer. Behold, he stands behind our wall! He looks in at the windows. He glances through the lattice.

hausa: “Itace mai kyau, yakan ba da ’ya’ya masu kyau. Itace marar kyau kuma, yakan ba da ’ya’ya marasa kyau. Itace dai, da irin ’ya’yansa ne ake gane shi.
english: “Either make the tree good and its fruit good, or make the tree corrupt and its fruit corrupt; for the tree is known by its fruit.

hausa: Sharon zai zama wurin kiwo don shanu, Kwarin Akor kuma wurin hutun garkuna, domin mutanena da suke nemana.
english: Sharon will be a fold of flocks, and the valley of Achor a place for herds to lie down in, for my people who have sought me.

hausa: “Amma in mai adalci ya juya daga adalcinsa ya yi zunubi ya kuma aikata abubuwa masu banƙyamar da mugun mutum ke aikatawa, zai rayu? Babu abubuwan adalcin da ya aikata da za a tuna da su. Saboda rashin amincinsa da kuma saboda zunubai da ya yi, zai mutu.
english: “But when the righteous turns away from his righteousness, and commits iniquity, and does according to all the abominations that the wicked man does, should he live? None of his righteous deeds that he has done will be remembered. In his trespass that he has trespassed, and in his sin that he has sinned, in them he shall die.

hausa: Ina faɗi muku abin da na gani a wurin Ubana, ku kuwa kuna yin abin da kuka ji daga wurin ubanku.”
english: I say the things which I have seen with my Father; and you also do the things which you have seen with your father.”

hausa: Ka tambaye ni zan kuwa sa al’ummai su zama gādonka, iyakokin duniya su zama mallakarka.
english: Ask of me, and I will give the nations for your inheritance, the uttermost parts of the earth for your possession.

hausa: Jinƙansa ya kai ga masu tsoronsa, daga zamani zuwa zamani.
english: His mercy is for generations and generations on those who fear him.

hausa: Bari yă zama sa’ad da na ce wa wata yarinya, ‘Ina roƙonki ki saukar da tulunki domin in sha,’ in ta ce, ‘Ka sha, zan kuma ba wa raƙumanka ma’; bari tă zama ita ce ka zaɓa wa bawanka Ishaku. Ta haka zan san cewa ka nuna wa maigidana alheri.”
english: Let it happen, that the young lady to whom I will say, ‘Please let down your pitcher, that I may drink,’ then she says, ‘Drink, and I will also give your camels a drink,’—let her be the one you have appointed for your servant Isaac. By this I will know that you have shown kindness to my master.”

hausa: Sabon ruwan inabi ya bushe kuringar inabi kuma sun yanƙwane; dukan masu farin ciki suna nishi.
english: The new wine mourns. The vine languishes. All the merry-hearted sigh.

hausa: Shemahiya, Yohiyarib, Yedahiya,
english: Shemaiah, Joiarib, Jedaiah,

hausa: Mun dai san cewa Allah ya yi magana da Musa, amma wannan mutum ba mu san inda ya fito ba.”
english: We know that God has spoken to Moses. But as for this man, we don’t know where he comes from.”

hausa: Dukan mutanen duniya
english: All the inhabitants of the earth are reputed as nothing; and he does according to his will in the army of heaven, and among the inhabitants of the earth; and no one can stop his hand, or ask him, “What are you doing?”

hausa: Shi ba Allah na matattu ba ne, shi Allah na masu rai ne. Kun yi mummunan kuskure!”
english: He is not the God of the dead, but of the living. You are therefore badly mistaken.”

hausa: Saboda haka samarin suka tashi aka ƙidaya su, mutum sha biyu wajen Benyamin da Ish-Boshet ɗan Shawulu, sha biyu kuma wajen Dawuda.
english: Then they arose and went over by number: twelve for Benjamin and for Ishbosheth the son of Saul, and twelve of David’s servants.

hausa: Ina gabatar muku da ’yar’uwarmu Fibi, baranyar ikkilisiya a Kenkireya.
english: I commend to you Phoebe, our sister, who is a servant of the assembly that is at Cenchreae,

hausa: An taɓa ɗaukan itacensa an yi wani abu mai amfani? Akan yi maratayi da ita da za a rataya wani abu a kai?
english: Will wood be taken of it to make anything? Will men take a pin of it to hang any vessel on it?

hausa: yaya za mu tsira in muka ƙyale irin wannan babban ceto? Wannan ceto, wanda Ubangiji ne ya fara sanar, aka kuma tabbatar mana ta bakin waɗanda suka ji shi.
english: how will we escape if we neglect so great a salvation—which at the first having been spoken through the Lord, was confirmed to us by those who heard,

hausa: Ba za su ƙara gina gidaje waɗansu kuma su zauna a cikinsu ba, ko su yi shuki waɗansu kuma su ci ba. Gama kamar yadda kwanakin itace suke, haka kwanakin mutanena za su kasance; zaɓaɓɓuna za su daɗe suna jin daɗin ayyukan hannuwansu.
english: They will not build and another inhabit. They will not plant and another eat; for the days of my people will be like the days of a tree, and my chosen will long enjoy the work of their hands.

hausa: Kada ku kasance da ma’auni iri biyu a jakarku, ɗaya babba, ɗaya ƙarami.
english: You shall not have in your bag diverse weights, one heavy and one light.

hausa: Alherin Ubangiji Yesu Kiristi, da ƙaunar Allah, da zumuntar Ruhu Mai Tsarki su kasance tare da ku duka.
english: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ, God’s love, and the fellowship of the Holy Spirit be with you all. Amen.

hausa: Kamar dai yadda Yannes da Yamberes suka tayar wa Musa, haka waɗannan mutane ma suke tayar wa gaskiya, mutane masu ɓataccen hankali, waɗanda, in ana zancen bangaskiya ne, to, fa ba sa ciki.
english: Even as Jannes and Jambres opposed Moses, so these also oppose the truth, men corrupted in mind, who concerning the faith are rejected.

hausa: Mutane da yawa suka shimfiɗa rigunarsu a kan hanya, waɗansu kuma suka baza rassan itatuwan da suka sara daga gonaki.
english: Many spread their garments on the way, and others were cutting down branches from the trees and spreading them on the road.

hausa: Yayinda sarkin Isra’ila yake wucewa kusa da katanga, sai wata mace ta yi masa kuka ta ce, “Ka taimake ni, ranka yă daɗe, sarki!”
english: As the king of Israel was passing by on the wall, a woman cried to him, saying, “Help, my lord, O king!”

hausa: Da bakinsa marar sanin Allah kan hallaka maƙwabcinsa, amma ta wurin sani mai adalci kan kuɓuta.
english: With his mouth the godless man destroys his neighbor, but the righteous will be delivered through knowledge.

hausa: Sa’an nan ya sa shi a sabon kabarinsa, wanda ya haƙa a dutse. Bayan ya gungura wani babban dutse ya rufe bakin kabarin, sai ya tafi abinsa.
english: and laid it in his own new tomb, which he had cut out in the rock. Then he rolled a large stone against the door of the tomb, and departed.

hausa: Ku, ’ya’yana ƙaunatattu, ku daga Allah ne, kun kuma yi nasara a kan magabtan Kiristi, domin wanda yake a cikinku ya fi wanda yake a duniya girma.
english: You are of God, little children, and have overcome them, because greater is he who is in you than he who is in the world.

hausa: Ga abin da Ubangiji Maɗaukaki, Allah na Isra’ila, yana cewa ku da matanku kun nuna ta wurin ayyukanku abin da kuka yi alkawari sa’ad da kuka ce, ‘Lalle za mu yi abin da muka yi alkawari na ƙone turare da kuma miƙa hadayun sha ga Sarauniyar Sama.’ “To, sai ku ci gaba, ku aikata abin da kuka yi alkawari! Ku cika alkawarinku!
english: Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel, says, ‘You and your wives have both spoken with your mouths, and with your hands have fulfilled it, saying, “We will surely perform our vows that we have vowed, to burn incense to the queen of the sky, and to pour out drink offerings to her.” “‘Establish then your vows, and perform your vows.’

hausa: wannan fa domin an kuɓutar da mu ne ta wurin alherinsa, don mu zama magāda masu begen ga rai madawwami.
english: that being justified by his grace, we might be made heirs according to the hope of eternal life.

hausa: ’Ya’yan Shimon maza su ne, Amnon, Rinna, Ben-Hanan da Tilon. Zuriyar Ishi su ne, Zohet da Ben-Zohet.
english: The sons of Shimon: Amnon, Rinnah, Ben Hanan, and Tilon. The sons of Ishi: Zoheth, and Ben Zoheth.

hausa: Ba ina ƙin masu ƙinka ba, ya Ubangiji, ina kuma ƙyamar waɗanda suke tayar maka ba?
english: Yahweh, don’t I hate those who hate you? Am I not grieved with those who rise up against you?

hausa: Kada ku yi wa matalauci sonkai a gaban shari’a.
english: You shall not favor a poor man in his cause.

hausa: yă bayyana Ɗansa a cikina, domin in yi wa’azinsa cikin Al’ummai. Ban nemi shawarar wani mutum ba.
english: to reveal his Son in me, that I might preach him among the Gentiles, I didn’t immediately confer with flesh and blood,

hausa: Amma ba za a taɓa ɗauke ƙaunata daga gare shi yadda na ɗauke ta daga wurin Shawulu ba, shi wannan wanda na kawar daga gabanka.
english: but my loving kindness will not depart from him, as I took it from Saul, whom I put away before you.

hausa: Ban da haka ma, Solomon ne sarki yanzu.
english: Also, Solomon sits on the throne of the kingdom.

hausa: Haka kuma ba za ku gina gidaje, ku dasa iri ko ku nome gonakin inabi ba; kada ku kasance da wani daga cikin waɗannan abubuwa, amma dole kullum ku zauna a tentuna. Ta haka za ku yi dogon rai a cikin ƙasar baƙuncinku.’
english: You shall not build a house, sow seed, plant a vineyard, or have any; but all your days you shall dwell in tents, that you may live many days in the land in which you live as nomads.’

hausa: Za a kuma yi wa’azin wannan bisharar mulki a cikin dukan duniya, yă zama shaida ga dukan al’ummai, sa’an nan ƙarshen yă zo.
english: This Good News of the Kingdom will be preached in the whole world for a testimony to all the nations, and then the end will come.

hausa: Shekara ta hamsin za tă zama ta murna a gare ku; kada ku yi shuki, kada kuma ku yi girbi abin da ya yi girma da kansa, ko ku girbe inabin da ba ku lura da shi ba.
english: That fiftieth year shall be a jubilee to you. In it you shall not sow, neither reap that which grows of itself, nor gather from the undressed vines.

hausa: Yesu ya ce, “Kada ki riƙe ni, gama ban riga na koma wajen Uba tukuna ba. A maimako, ki tafi wajen ’yan’uwana ki gaya musu, ‘Ina komawa wajen Ubana da Ubanku, wajen Allahna da kuma Allahnku.’ ”
english: Jesus said to her, “Don’t hold me, for I haven’t yet ascended to my Father; but go to my brothers and tell them, ‘I am ascending to my Father and your Father, to my God and your God.’”

hausa: da Zakkur, da Sherebiya, da Shebaniya,
english: Zaccur, Sherebiah, Shebaniah,

hausa: (ya yi haka ne domin yă koya wa zuriyar Isra’ilawa waɗanda ba su taɓa yin yaƙi a dā ba),
english: only that the generations of the children of Israel might know, to teach them war, at least those who knew nothing of it before:

hausa: Ammonawa suka kawo haraji wa Uzziya, sunan da ya yi kuwa ya bazu har iyakar Masar, domin ya zama mai iko sosai.
english: The Ammonites gave tribute to Uzziah. His name spread abroad even to the entrance of Egypt, for he grew exceedingly strong.

hausa: Ebed-Melek ya fita daga fadar ya ce masa,
english: Ebedmelech went out of the king’s house, and spoke to the king, saying,

hausa: Yadda muka san ƙauna ke nan, wato, Yesu Kiristi ya ba da ransa dominmu. Ya kamata mu ma mu ba da rayukanmu domin ’yan’uwanmu.
english: By this we know love, because he laid down his life for us. And we ought to lay down our lives for the brothers.

hausa: Ina da abubuwa da dama da zan rubuta muku, sai dai ba na so in yi amfani da takarda da inki in rubuta. A maimako, ina fata in ziyarce ku in kuma yi magana da ku fuska da fuska, domin farin cikinmu yă zama cikakke.
english: Having many things to write to you, I don’t want to do so with paper and ink, but I hope to come to you and to speak face to face, that our joy may be made full.

hausa: Idan shekarun suna da yawa, sai ku kara kuɗin filin, idan kuma shekarun ba su da yawa, sai ku rage kuɗin filin, gama ainihin abin da ake sayar maka shi ne yawan hatsin.
english: According to the length of the years you shall increase its price, and according to the shortness of the years you shall diminish its price; for he is selling the number of the crops to you.

hausa: Ba ku sani ba, ’yan’uwa, ina magana ne fa da mutanen da suka san doka, cewa dokar tana da iko a kan mutum muddin yana a raye ne kawai.
english: Or don’t you know, brothers (for I speak to men who know the law), that the law has dominion over a man for as long as he lives?

hausa: ku ma, a matsayinku na duwatsu masu rai, ana gina ku ga zama gidan ruhaniya don ku zama tsattsarkar ƙungiyar firistoci, kuna miƙa hadayun ruhaniya, abin karɓa ga Allah ta wurin Yesu Kiristi.
english: You also as living stones are built up as a spiritual house, to be a holy priesthood, to offer up spiritual sacrifices, acceptable to God through Jesus Christ.

hausa: Kamar kibiyoyi a hannun jarumi haka ’ya’ya mazan da aka haifa wa mutum a ƙuruciya.
english: As arrows in the hand of a mighty man, so are the children of youth.

hausa: Gama za ku tsotsa ku kuma ƙoshi da nonon ta’aziyyarta; za ku sha sosai ku kuma ji daɗin yalwarta.”
english: that you may nurse and be satisfied at the comforting breasts; that you may drink deeply, and be delighted with the abundance of her glory.”

hausa: Sa’an nan Ubangiji ya ce wa Musa,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

hausa: Gama Ubangiji ya riga ya ce wa Musa, “Ka faɗa wa Isra’ilawa, ‘Ku mutane ne masu taurinkai. In na yi tafiya da ku ko na ɗan lokaci, mai yiwuwa in hallaka ku. Yanzu sai ku tuɓe kayan adonku, zan kuwa yanke shawara a kan abin da zan yi da ku.’ ”
english: Yahweh had said to Moses, “Tell the children of Israel, ‘You are a stiff-necked people. If I were to go up among you for one moment, I would consume you. Therefore now take off your jewelry from you, that I may know what to do to you.’”

hausa: “Ohola ta shiga karuwanci yayinda take zamana; ta kuwa yi ta kai da kawowa da kwartayenta, Assuriyawa, mayaƙa
english: “Oholah played the prostitute when she was mine. She doted on her lovers, on the Assyrians her neighbors,

hausa: ta Azgad 1,222
english: The children of Azgad, one thousand two hundred twenty-two.

hausa: Ba wanda yakan zuba sabon ruwan inabi a tsofaffin salkuna. In ya yi haka, ruwan inabin zai farfashe salkunan, yă yi hasarar ruwan inabin, salkunan kuma su lalace. A’a, yakan zuba sabon ruwan inabin a sababbin salkuna.”
english: No one puts new wine into old wineskins; or else the new wine will burst the skins, and the wine pours out, and the skins will be destroyed; but they put new wine into fresh wineskins.”

hausa: Suka yi tambaya, suka ce, “To, me ya sa Musa ya umarta cewa mutum yă ba wa matarsa takardar saki, yă kuma kore ta?”
english: They asked him, “Why then did Moses command us to give her a certificate of divorce and divorce her?”

hausa: Saboda haka, bari mu yi iyakacin ƙoƙarinmu mu shiga wannan hutu, don kada wani yă kāsa ta wurin bin gurbinsu na rashin biyayya.
english: Let’s therefore give diligence to enter into that rest, lest anyone fall after the same example of disobedience.

hausa: Siman ya amsa ya ce, “A ganina, wanda aka yafe wa mai yawa ne.” Sai Yesu ya ce, “Ka faɗa daidai.”
english: Simon answered, “He, I suppose, to whom he forgave the most.” He said to him, “You have judged correctly.”

hausa: “Amma yanzu, ya Allahnmu, me za mu ce game da wannan? Gama mun ƙi bin
english: “Now, our God, what shall we say after this? For we have forsaken your commandments,

hausa: Gama dukansu, duhu mai yawa shi ne safiyarsu; suna abokantaka da razanar duhu.
english: For the morning is to all of them like thick darkness, for they know the terrors of the thick darkness.

hausa: Duk da haka zan yi wa Ariyel kwanto za tă kuma yi kuka da makoki, za tă zama mini kamar bagaden jini.
english: then I will distress Ariel, and there will be mourning and lamentation. She shall be to me as an altar hearth.

hausa: Amma duk mai duba cikakkiyar ƙa’idan nan ta ’yanci, ya kuma nace a kanta, ya zama ba mai ji ne kawai yă mance ba, sai dai mai yi ne yă zartar, to wannan shi za a yi wa albarka a cikin abin da yake yi.
english: But he who looks into the perfect law of freedom and continues, not being a hearer who forgets but a doer of the work, this man will be blessed in what he does.

hausa: amma da suka gan shi yana takawa a kan tafkin, sai suka yi tsammani fatalwa ce. Sai suka yi ihu,
english: but they, when they saw him walking on the sea, supposed that it was a ghost, and cried out;

hausa: Don me za ka sa Masarawa su ce, ‘Ai, da mugun nufi ne ya fito da su don yă shafe su daga fuskar duniya’? Ka juya daga fushinka mai zafi, ka ji tausayi, kada ka kawo masifa a kan mutanenka.
english: Why should the Egyptians talk, saying, ‘He brought them out for evil, to kill them in the mountains, and to consume them from the surface of the earth’? Turn from your fierce wrath, and turn away from this evil against your people.

hausa: Da manyan firistoci da Farisiyawa suka ji misalan Yesu, sai suka gane cewa da su yake.
english: When the chief priests and the Pharisees heard his parables, they perceived that he spoke about them.

hausa: Dukan mutane suka ga haka, kuma suka fara gunaguni, suka ce, “Ya je don yă zama baƙon ‘mai zunubi.’ ”
english: When they saw it, they all murmured, saying, “He has gone in to lodge with a man who is a sinner.”

hausa: Ku ɗaukaka Ubangiji tare da ni; bari mu ɗaukaka sunansa tare.
english: Oh magnify Yahweh with me. Let’s exalt his name together.

hausa: Ya ɗauki siffar da aka sassaƙa wadda ya yi, ya sa ta a cikin haikalin Allah, wanda Allah ya ce wa Dawuda da kuma ɗansa Solomon, “Cikin wannan haikali da kuma cikin Urushalima, wanda na zaɓa daga cikin kabilan Isra’ila, zan sa Sunana har abada.
english: He set the engraved image of the idol, which he had made, in God’s house, of which God said to David and to Solomon his son, “In this house, and in Jerusalem, which I have chosen out of all the tribes of Israel, I will put my name forever.

hausa: Za ka tsarkake su don su zama mafi tsarki, kuma duk abin da ya taɓa su, zai zama mai tsarki.
english: You shall sanctify them, that they may be most holy. Whatever touches them shall be holy.

hausa: Mai albarka ne mutumin da kullum yake jin tsoron Allah, amma duk wanda ya taurare zuciyarsa yakan shiga wahala.
english: Blessed is the man who always fears; but one who hardens his heart falls into trouble.

hausa: “ ‘Ko ma ba a fanshe shi a ɗaya daga cikin waɗannan hanyoyi ba, sai a sake shi da ’ya’yansa a Shekara ta Murna,
english: If he isn’t redeemed by these means, then he shall be released in the Year of Jubilee: he and his children with him.

hausa: Arab, Duma, Eshan,
english: Arab, Dumah, Eshan,

hausa: Mugun mutum yakan karɓa cin hanci a asirce don yă lalace yin adalci.
english: A wicked man receives a bribe in secret, to pervert the ways of justice.

hausa: Mutum mai hikima kan fāɗa wa birnin jarumawa ya kuma rushe katangar da suka dogara a kai.
english: A wise man scales the city of the mighty, and brings down the strength of its confidence.

hausa: Wane ne yake kamar Ubangiji Allahnmu, Wannan mai zama a kursiyi can bisa,
english: Who is like Yahweh, our God, who has his seat on high,

hausa: suna yabon Allah suna kuma samun tagomashin dukan mutane. Ubangiji kuwa ya ƙara yawansu kowace rana na waɗanda suke samun ceto.
english: praising God and having favor with all the people. The Lord added to the assembly day by day those who were being saved.

hausa: Ashe ban yi kuka domin waɗanda suke cikin damuwa ba? Ko zuciyata ba tă yi baƙin ciki domin matalauta ba?
english: Didn’t I weep for him who was in trouble? Wasn’t my soul grieved for the needy?

hausa: Musa ya yi yadda Ubangiji ya umarta. Suka hau Dutsen Hor a idon dukan jama’a.
english: Moses did as Yahweh commanded. They went up onto Mount Hor in the sight of all the congregation.

hausa: A rana ta takwas, dole tă ɗauki kurciyoyi biyu ko tattabari biyu ta kawo su ga firist a bakin ƙofar Tentin Sujada.
english: On the eighth day she shall take two turtledoves, or two young pigeons, and bring them to the priest, to the door of the Tent of Meeting.

hausa: cewa ko da yake mugaye suna girma kamar ciyawa kuma dukan masu aikata mugunta suna haɓaka, za a hallaka su har abada.
english: though the wicked spring up as the grass, and all the evildoers flourish, they will be destroyed forever.

hausa: gama zunubanta sun yi tsororuwa sun kai sama. Allah kuma ya tuna da laifofinta.
english: for her sins have reached to the sky, and God has remembered her iniquities.

hausa: Zuciya mai farin ciki magani ne mai kyau, amma bakin rai kan busar da ƙasusuwa.
english: A cheerful heart makes good medicine, but a crushed spirit dries up the bones.

hausa: ’Yan’uwa! Alherin Ubangijinmu Yesu Kiristi yă kasance tare da ruhunku. Amin.
english: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit, brothers. Amen.

hausa: Ya sa garkuwoyi da māsu a cikin dukan biranen, ya kuma sa suka zama da ƙarfi. Saboda haka Yahuda da Benyamin suka zama nasa.
english: He put shields and spears in every city, and made them exceedingly strong. Judah and Benjamin belonged to him.

hausa: ya buga mana hatiminsa a kan mu nasa ne, ya kuma sa mana Ruhunsa a cikin zukatanmu, domin yă tabbatar da abin da yake zuwa nan gaba.
english: who also sealed us and gave us the down payment of the Spirit in our hearts.

hausa: ’Yan’uwan Yehoram, ’ya’yan Yehoshafat maza su ne, Azariya, Yehiyel, Zakariya, Azariyahu, Mika’ilu da Shefatiya. Dukan waɗannan su ne ’ya’yan Yehoshafat sarkin Isra’ila maza.
english: He had brothers, the sons of Jehoshaphat: Azariah, Jehiel, Zechariah, Azariah, Michael, and Shephatiah. All these were the sons of Jehoshaphat king of Israel.

hausa: Ka gama makon amaryanci na ’yar nan; sa’an nan za mu ba ka ƙaramar ita ma, don ƙarin waɗansu shekaru bakwai na aiki.”
english: Fulfill the week of this one, and we will give you the other also for the service which you will serve with me for seven more years.”

hausa: Ka gai da Firiskila da Akwila da iyalin Onesiforus.
english: Greet Prisca and Aquila, and the house of Onesiphorus.

hausa: Yabo ya tabbata ga Ubangiji daga Sihiyona, gare shi wanda yake zama a Urushalima. Yabi Ubangiji.
english: Blessed be Yahweh from Zion, who dwells in Jerusalem. Praise Yah!

hausa: ‘Wannan shi ne alkawarin da na yi da ku a lokacin da kuka fito daga Masar. Ruhuna kuwa yana tare da ku. Kada ku ji tsoro.’
english: This is the word that I covenanted with you when you came out of Egypt, and my Spirit lived among you. ‘Don’t be afraid.’

hausa: Saboda haka suka ɗauke shi a keken yaƙin, suka fitar da shi, suka sa shi a wata keken yaƙin da yake da shi, suka kawo shi Urushalima, inda ya mutu. Aka binne shi a makabartar kakanninsa, sai dukan Yahuda da Urushalima suka yi makoki dominsa.
english: So his servants took him out of the chariot, and put him in the second chariot that he had, and brought him to Jerusalem; and he died, and was buried in the tombs of his fathers. All Judah and Jerusalem mourned for Josiah.

hausa: kada ku yi saurin jijjiguwa ko kuwa hankalinku yă tashi ta wurin wani annabci, rahoto ko wasiƙar da an ce daga wurinmu ne, cewa ranar Ubangiji ta riga ta zo.
english: not to be quickly shaken in your mind or troubled, either by spirit or by word or by letter as if from us, saying that the day of Christ has already come.

hausa: Sa’ad da Yesu ya zo yankin Kaisariya Filibbi, sai ya tambayi almajiransa ya ce, “Wa mutane suke ce da Ɗan Mutum?”
english: Now when Jesus came into the parts of Caesarea Philippi, he asked his disciples, saying, “Who do men say that I, the Son of Man, am?”

hausa: Suka baƙanta wa Isra’ilawa rai da bauta mai wuya, ta wurin sa su yin tubali da yumɓu, da kuma kowace irin bauta a gonaki. A cikin dukan ayyukansu, Masarawa ba su ji tausayinsu ba ko kaɗan.
english: and they made their lives bitter with hard service in mortar and in brick, and in all kinds of service in the field, all their service, in which they ruthlessly made them serve.

hausa: Da sarki ya ji maganar macen sai ya yage rigunansa. Sa’ad da sarki yake wucewa a kan katangar birnin, sai mutane suka gan yana saye da rigar makoki a ciki.
english: When the king heard the words of the woman, he tore his clothes. Now he was passing by on the wall, and the people looked, and behold, he had sackcloth underneath on his body.

hausa: Kalmomin Ubangiji kuwa ba su da kuskure, kamar azurfan da aka tace cikin matoyan yumɓu, aka tsabtacce sau bakwai.
english: Yahweh’s words are flawless words, as silver refined in a clay furnace, purified seven times.

hausa: To, ina dai faɗa muku, ina kuma nace faɗa muku a cikin Ubangiji, cewa kada ku ci gaba da yin rayuwa kamar yadda Al’ummai suke yi, masu banzan tunani.
english: This I say therefore, and testify in the Lord, that you no longer walk as the rest of the Gentiles also walk, in the futility of their mind,

hausa: Don mai bi da kaɗe-kaɗe. Zabura ta Dawuda. Ka ji ni, ya Allah, yayinda nake faɗin abin da yake damuna; ka tsare raina daga barazanan abokin gāba.
english: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. Hear my voice, God, in my complaint. Preserve my life from fear of the enemy.

hausa: “Asirce aka gaya mini maganan nan, da ƙyar kunnuwana suka iya ji.
english: “Now a thing was secretly brought to me. My ear received a whisper of it.

hausa: “Mutanen Isra’ila da na Yahuda ba abin da suka yi sai mugunta a gabana daga ƙuruciyarsu; tabbatacce, mutanen Isra’ila ba su yi kome ba sai dai tsokane ni da abin da hannuwansu suka yi, in ji Ubangiji.
english: “For the children of Israel and the children of Judah have done only that which was evil in my sight from their youth; for the children of Israel have only provoked me to anger with the work of their hands, says Yahweh.

hausa: Sun kuma kafa wa kansu masujadai da suke kan tuddai, da a kan keɓaɓɓun duwatsu, suka kuma gina ginshiƙan Ashera a kowane tudu, da kuma a ƙarƙashin kowane duhuwar itace.
english: For they also built for themselves high places, sacred pillars, and Asherah poles on every high hill and under every green tree.

hausa: Ubangiji kuwa ya dinga bayyana a Shilo, a nan ya bayyana kansa ga Sama’ila ta wurin maganarsa.
english: Yahweh appeared again in Shiloh; for Yahweh revealed himself to Samuel in Shiloh by Yahweh’s word.

hausa: abokin gābana zai ce, “Na sha ƙarfinsa,” kuma abokan gābana za su yi murna sa’ad da na fāɗi.
english: lest my enemy say, “I have prevailed against him;” lest my adversaries rejoice when I fall.

hausa: Ka yi zobai biyu na zinariya ka ɗaura su ga sauran kusurwoyi ƙyallen maƙalawa a ƙirji, a gefen ciki kusa da efod.
english: You shall make two rings of gold, and you shall put them on the two ends of the breastplate, on its edge, which is toward the side of the ephod inward.

hausa: Mutumin ya komo da ni zuwa mashigin haikalin, sai na kuwa ga ruwa yana malalowa daga ƙarƙashin madogarar ƙofar haikalin wajen gabas (gama haikalin yana fuskantar gabas). Ruwan yana malalowa daga ƙarƙashin gefen kudun haikalin, kudu da bagaden.
english: He brought me back to the door of the temple; and behold, waters flowed out from under the threshold of the temple eastward, for the front of the temple faced toward the east. The waters came down from underneath, from the right side of the temple, on the south of the altar.

hausa: Ya ɗauki burodi guda biyar da kifin nan biyu, ya ɗaga kai sama, ya yi godiya, ya kakkarya burodin. Sai ya ba wa almajiransa su rarraba wa mutane. Ya kuma rarraba kifi biyun a tsakaninsu duka.
english: He took the five loaves and the two fish; and looking up to heaven, he blessed and broke the loaves, and he gave to his disciples to set before them, and he divided the two fish among them all.

hausa: sai mahaifin yarinyar da mahaifiyarta su kawo shaida cewa ita budurwa ce wa dattawan gari a ƙofar garin.
english: then the young lady’s father and mother shall take and bring the tokens of the young lady’s virginity to the elders of the city in the gate.

hausa: Ana cikin haka, sai Absalom ya gudu. To, mutumin da yake tsaro a wannan lokaci ya ɗaga kai sai ya ga mutane da yawa a hanya, yamma da shi, suna gangarowa daga gefen tudu. Sai mai tsaron ya je ya gaya wa sarki cewa, “Na ga mutane ta wajen Horonayim, a gefen tudu.”
english: But Absalom fled. The young man who kept the watch lifted up his eyes and looked, and behold, many people were coming by way of the hillside behind him.

hausa: Ya yi murfin jinƙai da zinariya zalla, wato, tsawonsa ƙafa biyu, fāɗinsa kuma ƙafa ɗaya da rabi.
english: He made a mercy seat of pure gold. Its length was two and a half cubits, and a cubit and a half its width.

hausa: “ ‘Ga abin da Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka ya ce ku tafa hannuwanku tare ku kuma taka ƙafafunku ku yi ihu ku ce, “Kaito!” Saboda dukan mugaye da kuma abubuwan banƙyama na gidan Isra’ila, gama za su mutu ta wurin takobi, yunwa da annoba.
english: “The Lord Yahweh says: ‘Strike with your hand, and stamp with your foot, and say, “Alas!”, because of all the evil abominations of the house of Israel; for they will fall by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence.

hausa: Ba za su yi kusa don su yi hidima kamar firistoci ko su zo kusa da abubuwana masu tsarki ko hadayuna mafi tsarki ba; dole su sha kunya saboda ayyukansu na banƙyama.
english: They shall not come near to me, to execute the office of priest to me, nor to come near to any of my holy things, to the things that are most holy; but they will bear their shame and their abominations which they have committed.

hausa: To, a lokacin, an yi yunwa a ƙasar, sai Abram ya gangara zuwa Masar don yă zauna a can na ɗan lokaci, domin yunwa ta yi tsanani.
english: There was a famine in the land. Abram went down into Egypt to live as a foreigner there, for the famine was severe in the land.

hausa: “ ‘Kwanaki suna zuwa,’ in ji Ubangiji, ‘sa’ad da zan cika alkawarin alheri da na yi wa gidan Isra’ila da kuma gidan Yahuda.
english: “Behold, the days come,” says Yahweh, “that I will perform that good word which I have spoken concerning the house of Israel and concerning the house of Judah.

hausa: Dukan waɗanda suka wuce sun washe shi; ya zama abin dariya wajen maƙwabtansa.
english: All who pass by the way rob him. He has become a reproach to his neighbors.

hausa: Wauta tana da yawa a zuciyar yara, amma sandar horo zai kore ta nesa da su.
english: Folly is bound up in the heart of a child; the rod of discipline drives it far from him.

hausa: Su zama da shiri a rana ta uku, gama a ranar ce Ubangiji zai sauko a kan Dutsen Sinai a idon dukan mutane.
