english: and be ready for the third day; for on the third day Yahweh will come down in the sight of all the people on Mount Sinai.

hausa: “Saboda haka ga abin da Ubangiji Maɗaukaki, Allah na Isra’ila, yana cewa na ƙudura in aukar muku da masifa in kuma hallaka dukan Yahuda.
english: “Therefore Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel, says: ‘Behold, I will set my face against you for evil, even to cut off all Judah.

hausa: Liyatu ta sāke yin ciki ta kuma haifa wa Yaƙub ɗa na shida.
english: Leah conceived again, and bore a sixth son to Jacob.

hausa: Amma haikalin da ya yi magana jikinsa ne.
english: But he spoke of the temple of his body.

hausa: Firistocin da suke ɗauke da akwatin alkawari suka tsaya a tsakiyar Urdun, har aka gama dukan abin da Ubangiji ya umarci Yoshuwa yă gaya wa mutane, kamar yadda Musa ya ce Yoshuwa yă yi. Mutanen suka wuce da sauri.
english: For the priests who bore the ark stood in the middle of the Jordan until everything was finished that Yahweh commanded Joshua to speak to the people, according to all that Moses commanded Joshua; and the people hurried and passed over.

hausa: Wata ranar Asabbaci, Yesu yana ratsa gonakin hatsi, sai almajiransa da suke tafiya tare da shi, suka fara kakkarya waɗansu kan hatsi.
english: He was going on the Sabbath day through the grain fields; and his disciples began, as they went, to pluck the ears of grain.

hausa: Bari ’ya’yansa su zama marayu matarsa kuma gwauruwa.
english: Let his children be fatherless, and his wife a widow.

hausa: Dukan abokan gābana suna raɗa tare a kaina; suna fata mugun abu ya same ni, suna cewa,
english: All who hate me whisper together against me. They imagine the worst for me.

hausa: Yesu ya ce, “Ba ku san abin da kuke roƙo ba. Za ku iya shan kwaf da zan sha, ko a yi muku baftisma da baftismar da aka yi mini?”
english: But Jesus said to them, “You don’t know what you are asking. Are you able to drink the cup that I drink, and to be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with?”

hausa: Ba zato ba tsammani sai aka yi wata babbar girgizar ƙasa har tushen ginin kurkukun ya jijjiga. Nan da nan sai duk ƙofofin kurkukun suka bubbuɗe, sarƙoƙin kowa kuma suka ɓaɓɓalle.
english: Suddenly there was a great earthquake, so that the foundations of the prison were shaken; and immediately all the doors were opened, and everyone’s bonds were loosened.

hausa: Sarakunan nan biyu sun sa mugunta a ransu. Za su zauna a tebur guda su yi ta shara wa juna ƙarya, amma a banza, gama lokacin da aka ƙayyade bai yi ba tukuna.
english: As for both these kings, their hearts will be to do evil, and they will speak lies at one table; but it won’t prosper, for the end will still be at the appointed time.

hausa: A kan kowane ginshiƙi, an yi masa dajiyar tagulla, tsayinta kamu biyar. A bisa kan kowace dajiya akwai raga da siffofin rumman na tagulla kewaye da dajiyar. Ginshiƙi na biyu ma haka yake da siffofin rumman.
english: A capital of bronze was on it; and the height of the one capital was five cubits, with network and pomegranates on the capital all around, all of bronze. The second pillar also had the same, with pomegranates.

hausa: Wanda ya fara fita ja ne, dukan jikinsa kuwa kamar riga mai gashi. Don haka aka sa masa suna Isuwa.
english: The first came out red all over, like a hairy garment. They named him Esau.

hausa: Zan ba da su ga waɗanda suke neman ransu, ga Nebukadnezzar sarkin Babilon da fadawansa. Amma daga baya, Masar za tă kasance da mazauna kamar dā,” in ji Ubangiji.
english: I will deliver them into the hand of those who seek their lives, and into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and into the hand of his servants. Afterwards it will be inhabited, as in the days of old,” says Yahweh.

hausa: Za ku ci kowane birni mai katanga, da kowane babban gari. Za ku sare kowane itace mai kyau, ku kuma tattoshe maɓuɓɓugan ruwa. Za ku kuma yi amfani da duwatsu ku lalatar da kowace gona mai kyau.”
english: You shall strike every fortified city and every choice city, and shall fell every good tree, and stop all springs of water, and mar every good piece of land with stones.’”

hausa: A gadona na tuna da kai; ina tunaninka dukan dare.
english: when I remember you on my bed, and think about you in the night watches.

hausa: Za su hukunta ki da ƙiyayya su kuma kwashe kome da kika yi wahalarsa. Za su bar ki tsirara tik, kunyan karuwancinki kuma zai tonu. Marmarinki da fasikancinki
english: They will deal with you in hatred, and will take away all your labor, and will leave you naked and bare. The nakedness of your prostitution will be uncovered, both your lewdness and your prostitution.

hausa: Da yake sun ɓoye tarko domina ba dalili kuma babu dalili suka haƙa mini rami,
english: For without cause they have hidden their net in a pit for me. Without cause they have dug a pit for my soul.

hausa: Saboda haka Ubangiji ya aika da annoba a kan Isra’ila tun daga safe har zuwa lokacin da aka ƙayyade, mutum dubu saba’in kuwa daga Dan zuwa Beyersheba suka mutu.
english: So Yahweh sent a pestilence on Israel from the morning even to the appointed time; and seventy thousand men died of the people from Dan even to Beersheba.

hausa: Dukan mutanen suka yarda su ƙara kwana bakwai kuma, sai suka ci gaba da bikin cikin farin ciki har waɗansu kwana bakwai kuma.
english: The whole assembly took counsel to keep another seven days, and they kept another seven days with gladness.

hausa: Kedesh, Hazor, Itnan,
english: Kedesh, Hazor, Ithnan,

hausa: Suka ja shi zuwa bayan birnin suka kuma yi ta jifansa da duwatsu. Ana cikin haka, shaidun suka ajiye tufafinsu a wurin wani saurayi mai suna Shawulu.
english: They threw him out of the city and stoned him. The witnesses placed their garments at the feet of a young man named Saul.

hausa: Suka yi tebur da itacen ƙirya, tsawonsa ƙafa biyu, fāɗinsa ƙafa ɗaya, tsayinsa kuma ƙafa ɗaya da rabi.
english: He made the table of acacia wood. Its length was two cubits, and its width was a cubit, and its height was a cubit and a half.

hausa: Ga abin da Ubangiji yana cewa, shi da ya yi hanya ta cikin teku, hanya ta cikin manyan ruwaye,
english: Yahweh, who makes a way in the sea, and a path in the mighty waters,

hausa: Za a hukunta su da madawwamiyar hallaka a kuma kau da su daga gaban Ubangiji da kuma daga ɗaukakar ikonsa
english: who will pay the penalty: eternal destruction from the face of the Lord and from the glory of his might,

hausa: Ka fi Daniyel hikima ne? Ba asirin da yake ɓoye a gare ka?
english: behold, you are wiser than Daniel. There is no secret that is hidden from you.

hausa: Saboda haka, duk wanda ya ƙi wannan umarni ba mutum ne ya ƙi ba sai ko Allah, wanda ya ba ku Ruhunsa Mai Tsarki.
english: Therefore he who rejects this doesn’t reject man, but God, who has also given his Holy Spirit to you.

hausa: A wannan rana zan hukunta dukan waɗanda suke kauce taka madogarar ƙofa, waɗanda suke cika haikalin allolinsu da rikici da ruɗu.
english: In that day, I will punish all those who leap over the threshold, who fill their master’s house with violence and deceit.

hausa: Sai Ishaya ya ce wa Hezekiya, “Ka ji maganar Ubangiji Maɗaukaki.
english: Then Isaiah said to Hezekiah, “Hear the word of Yahweh of Armies:

hausa: Sa’an nan ya ce wa mutane, “Ku shirya kanku domin rana ta uku. Ku ƙame kanku daga yin jima’i.”
english: He said to the people, “Be ready by the third day. Don’t have sexual relations with a woman.”

hausa: A cikin rayuwan nan ta rashin amfani nawa, na lura da waɗannan abubuwa biyu, mai adalci yana hallakawa cikin adalcinsa, mai mugunta kuma yana tsawon rai cikin muguntarsa.
english: All this I have seen in my days of vanity: there is a righteous man who perishes in his righteousness, and there is a wicked man who lives long in his evildoing.

hausa: ba ya cin abinci a duwatsun tsafi ko ya dogara ga gumakan gidan Isra’ila. Ba ya ƙazantar da matar maƙwabcinsa ko ya kwana da mace lokacin al’adarta ba.
english: and has not eaten on the mountains, hasn’t lifted up his eyes to the idols of the house of Israel, hasn’t defiled his neighbor’s wife, hasn’t come near a woman in her impurity,

hausa: Gama ya yi magana, abu ya kuwa kasance; ya umarta, ya kuwa tsaya daram.
english: For he spoke, and it was done. He commanded, and it stood firm.

hausa: Meyonotai shi ne mahaifin Ofra. Serahiya shi ne mahaifin Yowab, mahaifin Ge-Harashim. An kira shi haka domin mutanensa masu sana’ar hannu ne.
english: Meonothai became the father of Ophrah: and Seraiah became the father of Joab the father of Ge Harashim, for they were craftsmen.

hausa: “Ya duwatsun Gilbowa, kada a sāke yin ruwa ko raɓa a kanku, balle gonakin da suke ba da hatsin hadaya su ƙara bayarwa. Gama a can ne garkuwoyin manyan sojoji suka kwanta, suka kwanta a wulaƙance. Garkuwar Shawulu kuwa, ba za a ƙara shafa mata mai ba.
english: You mountains of Gilboa, let there be no dew or rain on you, and no fields of offerings; for there the shield of the mighty was defiled and cast away, the shield of Saul was not anointed with oil.

hausa: Ya kashe ’ya’yan fari na Masar, ’ya’yan fari na mutane da na dabbobi.
english: He struck the firstborn of Egypt, both of man and animal.

hausa: Gama rayayyu sun san za su mutu, amma matattu ba su san kome ba; ba su da wata lada nan gaba an manta da su ke nan gaba ɗaya.
english: For the living know that they will die, but the dead don’t know anything, neither do they have any more a reward; for their memory is forgotten.

hausa: Wannan kuwa shi ne saƙonsa, “A bayana, wanda ya fi ni iko yana zuwa, ban kuwa isa in sunkuya in kunce igiyar takalmansa ba.
english: He preached, saying, “After me comes he who is mightier than I, the strap of whose sandals I am not worthy to stoop down and loosen.

hausa: Macen kuwa mutuniyar Hellenawa ce, an haife ta a Funisiya a Suriya. Ta roƙi Yesu yă fitar da aljani da yake jikin diyarta.
english: Now the woman was a Greek, a Syrophoenician by race. She begged him that he would cast the demon out of her daughter.

hausa: Amma waɗannan abokan gābana, waɗanda ba su so in zama sarkinsu ba, ku kawo su nan, ku karkashe su, a gabana.’ ”
english: But bring those enemies of mine who didn’t want me to reign over them here, and kill them before me.’”

hausa: Yanzu kuwa, muddin Ubangiji yana a raye, shi wanda ya kafa ni sosai a kan kujerar sarautar mahaifina Dawuda, ya kuma kafa mini mulki kamar yadda ya yi alkawari; za a kashe Adoniya yau!”
english: Now therefore as Yahweh lives, who has established me and set me on my father David’s throne, and who has made me a house as he promised, surely Adonijah shall be put to death today.”

hausa: Kaciya tana da amfani in kana kiyaye dokar, amma in kana karya dokar, ka zama kamar ba a yi maka kaciya ba.
english: For circumcision indeed profits, if you are a doer of the law, but if you are a transgressor of the law, your circumcision has become uncircumcision.

hausa: (A dā a Isra’ila, in wani yana so yă nemi nufin Allah, mutumin yakan ce, “Zo mu tafi wajen mai duba.” Gama wanda ake ce da shi annabi a yanzu, a dā ana kiransa mai duba ne.)
english: (In earlier times in Israel, when a man went to inquire of God, he said, “Come! Let’s go to the seer;” for he who is now called a prophet was before called a seer.)

hausa: Ya ce, “Ko mene ne zai faru, ina so in ruga da gudu.” Sai Yowab ya ce, “Ruga!” Sai Ahimawaz ya sheƙa a guje ya bi ta hanyar fili ya riga mutumin Kush nan.
english: “But come what may,” he said, “I will run.” He said to him, “Run!” Then Ahimaaz ran by the way of the Plain, and outran the Cushite.

hausa: Tsawarsa tana nuna cewa babbar iska da ruwa suna zuwa; ko shanu sun san da zuwansa.
english: Its noise tells about him, and the livestock also, concerning the storm that comes up.

hausa: hallaka da baƙin ciki suna ko’ina a hanyoyinsu,
english: Destruction and misery are in their ways.

hausa: Ya ce, “Ba za ki ƙara yin murna ba, Ya ke Budurwa Diyar Sidon, yanzu da kike ragargajiya! “Tashi, ki ƙetare zuwa Saifurus; a can ɗin ma ba za ki huta ba.”
english: He said, “You shall rejoice no more, you oppressed virgin daughter of Sidon. Arise, pass over to Kittim. Even there you will have no rest.”

hausa: waɗanda suka gayyace su zuwa wajen hadayu na allolinsu. Mutane suka ci suka kuma yi wa waɗannan alloli sujada.
english: for they called the people to the sacrifices of their gods. The people ate and bowed down to their gods.

hausa: Gidanta babbar hanya ce zuwa kabari mai yin jagora zuwa ɗakunan lahira.
english: Her house is the way to Sheol, going down to the rooms of death.

hausa: Ta wurin kama hannunsa na dama, ya taimake shi ya miƙe, nan take ƙafafu da idon sawun mutumin suka yi ƙarfi.
english: He took him by the right hand and raised him up. Immediately his feet and his ankle bones received strength.

hausa: Ubanni, kada ku matsa wa yaranku lamba, don kada su fid da zuciya.
english: Fathers, don’t provoke your children, so that they won’t be discouraged.

hausa: Makiyayan hamada sun cika har suna zuba; tuddai sun rufu da murna.
english: The wilderness grasslands overflow. The hills are clothed with gladness.

hausa: Sai Musa ya ce wa Ubangiji, “Ai, Masarawa za su ji game da wannan! Da ikonka ka fitar da mutanen nan daga cikinsu.
english: Moses said to Yahweh, “Then the Egyptians will hear it; for you brought up this people in your might from among them.

hausa: Wata rana Adoniya ya tafi Dutsen Zohelet kusa da En Rogel, inda ya yi hadayar tumaki, da shanun noma, da shanun da ake kiwo a gida. Ya kuma gayyaci ’yan’uwansa, wato, sauran ’ya’yan Sarki Dawuda, tare da dukan dattawan sarki da suka fito daga Yahuda,
english: Adonijah killed sheep, cattle, and fatlings by the stone of Zoheleth, which is beside En Rogel; and he called all his brothers, the king’s sons, and all the men of Judah, the king’s servants;

hausa: An ƙwace mashigai aka ƙone fadamu da wuta, sojoji kuma suka giggice.”
english: So the passages are seized. They have burned the reeds with fire. The men of war are frightened.”

hausa: Saboda haka matar Yerobowam ta yi abin da ya faɗa, ta kuma tafi gidan Ahiya a Shilo. Yanzu dai Ahiya ba ya gani; idanunsa sun tafi saboda tsufa.
english: Jeroboam’s wife did so, and arose and went to Shiloh, and came to Ahijah’s house. Now Ahijah could not see, for his eyes were set by reason of his age.

hausa: Da ma ba a halicce ni ba, da na mutu tun daga cikin cikin uwata na wuce zuwa kabari!
english: I should have been as though I had not been. I should have been carried from the womb to the grave.

hausa: “Saboda haka yanzu Ubangiji ya sa ruhun ƙarya a bakunan dukan annabawanka. Ubangiji ya zartar maka da masifa.”
english: Now therefore, behold, Yahweh has put a lying spirit in the mouth of all these your prophets; and Yahweh has spoken evil concerning you.”

hausa: Zan nuna tsarkin girman sunana, wanda aka ɓata a cikin al’umma, sunana da kuka ɓata a cikinsu. Sa’an nan al’ummai za su san cewa ni ne Ubangiji, in ji Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka, sa’ad da na nuna kaina mai tsarki ta wurinku a idanunsu.
english: I will sanctify my great name, which has been profaned among the nations, which you have profaned among them. Then the nations will know that I am Yahweh,” says the Lord Yahweh, “when I am proven holy in you before their eyes.

hausa: “Bai ci abinci a duwatsun tsafi ba ko ya dogara ga gumakan gidan Isra’ila. Bai ƙazantar da matar maƙwabcinsa ba.
english: who hasn’t eaten on the mountains, hasn’t lifted up his eyes to the idols of the house of Israel, hasn’t defiled his neighbor’s wife,

hausa: Amma gwamnonin farko, waɗanda suka riga ni, sun ɗaura wa mutane kaya mai nauyi suka karɓi shekel arba’in na azurfa daga gare su haɗe da abinci da kuma ruwan inabi. Har bayin masu mulki ma sun nawaya wa mutane. Amma ni ban yi haka ba, saboda ina tsoron Allah.
english: But the former governors who were before me were supported by the people, and took bread and wine from them, plus forty shekels of silver; yes, even their servants ruled over the people, but I didn’t do so, because of the fear of God.

hausa: Bayan haka, sai dukan jama’a suka taru domin su nuna rashin yardansu da abin da suke zato Musa da Haruna ne suka aikata. Da suka fuskanci Tentin Sujada, nan take sai girgije ya rufe shi, ɗaukaka Ubangiji kuwa ta bayyana.
english: When the congregation was assembled against Moses and against Aaron, they looked toward the Tent of Meeting. Behold, the cloud covered it, and Yahweh’s glory appeared.

hausa: Ta haka za ku miƙa hadaya ga Ubangiji daga cikin dukan zakkar da kuka karɓa daga wurin Isra’ilawa. Daga waɗannan zakka kuwa dole ku ba Haruna firist rabon Ubangiji.
english: Thus you also shall offer a wave offering to Yahweh of all your tithes, which you receive of the children of Israel; and of it you shall give Yahweh’s wave offering to Aaron the priest.

hausa: Sai macen ta ce, “Ranka yă daɗe, ina gani kai annabi ne.
english: The woman said to him, “Sir, I perceive that you are a prophet.

hausa: Waɗansu suka yi tafiya a teku cikin jiragen ruwa; su ’yan kasuwa ne a manyan ruwaye.
english: Those who go down to the sea in ships, who do business in great waters,

hausa: A zamanin Feka sarkin Isra’ila, Tiglat-Fileser sarkin Assuriya ya zo ya kama Iyon, Abel-Bet-Ma’aka, Yanowa da Kedesh da kuma Hazor. Ya kame Gileyad da Galili, haɗe da dukan ƙasar Naftali, ya kuma kwashi mutanen zuwa Assuriya.
english: In the days of Pekah king of Israel, Tiglath Pileser king of Assyria came and took Ijon, Abel Beth Maacah, Janoah, Kedesh, Hazor, Gilead, and Galilee, all the land of Naphtali; and he carried them captive to Assyria.

hausa: Sa’ad da Yefta ya komo gida a Mizfa, wa ya fito yă tarye shi, ’yarsa tilo, tana rawa kiɗin ganguna! Ita ce kaɗai ’yarsa. Ban da ita ba shi da ɗa ko ’ya.
english: Jephthah came to Mizpah to his house; and behold, his daughter came out to meet him with tambourines and with dances. She was his only child. Besides her he had neither son nor daughter.

hausa: In ya gamshe ka, bari ka albarkaci gidan bawanka don yă dawwama a gabanka har abada; gama kai, ya Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka, ka riga ka yi magana, kuma saboda kai ka sa albarka ga gidan bawanka, lalle zai kasance da albarka har abada.”
english: Now therefore, let it please you to bless the house of your servant, that it may continue forever before you; for you, Lord Yahweh, have spoken it. Let the house of your servant be blessed forever with your blessing.”

hausa: Akwai wanda zai iya ɓuya a lungu har da ba zan iya ganinsa ba?” In ji Ubangiji “Ban cika sama da ƙasa ba?” In ji Ubangiji.
english: Can anyone hide himself in secret places so that I can’t see him?” says Yahweh. “Don’t I fill heaven and earth?” says Yahweh.

hausa: Cikin sunansa al’ummai za su dogara.”
english: In his name, the nations will hope.”

hausa: alkawuran da leɓunana suka yi alkawari bakina kuma ya faɗa sa’ad da nake cikin wahala.
english: which my lips promised, and my mouth spoke, when I was in distress.

hausa: “Da dare ɗan wannan matan ya mutu domin ta kwanta a kansa.
english: This woman’s child died in the night, because she lay on it.

hausa: Kai kam ka daure ka kuma jimre da wahala saboda sunana, ba ka kuwa gaji ba.
english: You have perseverance and have endured for my name’s sake, and have not grown weary.

hausa: Amma Ubangiji Allah ya kira mutumin ya ce, “Ina kake?”
english: Yahweh God called to the man, and said to him, “Where are you?”

hausa: Da a ce kun san abin da waɗannan kalmomi suke nufi, ‘Jinƙai nake bukata, ba hadaya ba,’da ba ku zargi marar laifi ba.
english: But if you had known what this means, ‘I desire mercy, and not sacrifice,’ you wouldn’t have condemned the guiltless.

hausa: “Ɗan mutum, ’yan’uwanka, ’yan’uwanka waɗanda suke danginka na cikinka da kuma dukan gidan Isra’ila su ne waɗanda mutanen Urushalima suka ce, ‘Su ne da nisa daga Ubangiji; an ba mu wannan ƙasa ta zama mallakarmu.’
english: “Son of man, your brothers, even your brothers, the men of your relatives, and all the house of Israel, all of them, are the ones to whom the inhabitants of Jerusalem have said, ‘Go far away from Yahweh. This land has been given to us for a possession.’

hausa: Amma kai za ka koma wurin kakanninka cikin salama a kuma binne ka da kyakkyawan tsufa.
english: but you will go to your fathers in peace. You will be buried at a good old age.

hausa: yadda Ubangiji ya umarci Musa. Da haka ya ƙidaya su a Hamadar Sinai.
english: As Yahweh commanded Moses, so he counted them in the wilderness of Sinai.

hausa: Sa’ad da ya shirya wuri da kyau, ba yakan shuka kanumfari ya kuma yayyafa ɗaɗɗoya ba? Ba yakan shuka alkama a kunyoyinsa sha’ir a kunyoyinsa, tamba kuma a filinsa ba?
english: When he has leveled its surface, doesn’t he plant the dill, and scatter the cumin seed, and put in the wheat in rows, the barley in the appointed place, and the spelt in its place?

hausa: Saboda haka sai Lot ya zaɓar wa kansa dukan kwarin Urdun, ya tashi ya nufi wajen gabas. Haka fa suka rabu da juna.
english: So Lot chose the Plain of the Jordan for himself. Lot traveled east, and they separated themselves from one another.

hausa: “Ɗan mutum, an yi mata biyu, ’yan matan mahaifiya guda.
english: “Son of man, there were two women, the daughters of one mother.

hausa: Ƙasa ta yi rawa ta kuma girgiza, tussan duwatsu sun girgiza; sun yi rawa domin ya yi fushi.
english: Then the earth shook and trembled. The foundations also of the mountains quaked and were shaken, because he was angry.

hausa: Amman waɗannan dattawa waɗanda suke yin zunubi kuwa sai ka kwaɓe su a gaban jama’a, don saura su ji tsoro.
english: Those who sin, reprove in the sight of all, that the rest also may be in fear.

hausa: Ba shakka akwai harsuna iri-iri a duniya, duk da haka kowane a cikinsu yana da ma’ana.
english: There are, it may be, so many kinds of languages in the world, and none of them is without meaning.

hausa: An umarta cewa birnin za tă tafi bauta, za a kuma yi gaba da su. Bayi ’yan mata suna kuka kamar tattabaru suna buga ƙirjinsu.
english: It is decreed: she is uncovered, she is carried away; and her servants moan as with the voice of doves, beating on their breasts.

hausa: Amma suka ci gaba da yin masa zunubi, suna tayarwa a cikin hamada a kan Mafi Ɗaukaka.
english: Yet they still went on to sin against him, to rebel against the Most High in the desert.

hausa: “Ɗan mutum, faɗa wa Fir’auna sarkin Masar da jama’arsa cewa, “ ‘Da wa za a kwatanta girmanka?
english: “Son of man, tell Pharaoh king of Egypt and his multitude: ‘Whom are you like in your greatness?

hausa: Sai kowannensu ya koma gidansa.
english: Everyone went to his own house,

hausa: Hananel ɗan Shallum ɗan’uwan mahaifinka zai zo wurinka ya ce, ‘Saya filina a Anatot, domin a matsayinka na dangi na kurkusa hakkinka ne kuma kai ya wajaba ka saye shi.’
english: ‘Behold, Hanamel the son of Shallum your uncle will come to you, saying, “Buy my field that is in Anathoth; for the right of redemption is yours to buy it.”’”

hausa: Kamar yadda yatsotsin rabi na ƙarfe rabi kuma na yumɓu ne, haka wannan mulki zai zama rabi mai ƙarfi rabi kuma marar ƙarfi.
english: As the toes of the feet were part of iron, and part of clay, so the kingdom will be partly strong and partly brittle.

hausa: Maimakon haka, kyanku ya kamata yă zama ainihi na halinku na ciki, kyan da ba ya koɗewa na tawali’u da kuma na natsattsen ruhu, wanda yake mai daraja a gaban Allah.
english: but from the hidden person of the heart, in the incorruptible adornment of a gentle and quiet spirit, which is very precious in God’s sight.

hausa: Ka kiyaye ni, ya Ubangiji, daga hannuwan mugaye; ka tsare ni daga mutane masu rikici waɗanda suke shirin kwashe ni a ƙafafu.
english: Yahweh, keep me from the hands of the wicked. Preserve me from the violent men who have determined to trip my feet.

hausa: Sai Haruna ya kaɗa ƙirjin da kuma cinyar dama a gaban Ubangiji a matsayin hadaya ta kaɗawa, kamar yadda Musa ya umarta.
english: Aaron waved the breasts and the right thigh for a wave offering before Yahweh, as Moses commanded.

hausa: Ana jin nishin masu mutuwa daga birni, kuma rayukan waɗanda aka ji musu rauni suna kuka suna kira don taimako. Amma bai ba wani laifi ba.
english: From out of the populous city, men groan. The soul of the wounded cries out, yet God doesn’t regard the folly.

hausa: Daidai yana gama miƙa hadaya ke nan sai Sama’ila ya iso. Shawulu kuma ya fito domin yă yi masa maraba.
english: It came to pass that as soon as he had finished offering the burnt offering, behold, Samuel came; and Saul went out to meet him, that he might greet him.

hausa: Sa’ad da aka busa ƙahonin nan ɗari uku sai Ubangiji ya sa Midiyawa suka yi ta saran juna. Mayaƙan suka gudu zuwa Bet-Shitta wajen Zerera har zuwa yankin Abel-Mehola kusa da Tabbat.
english: They blew the three hundred trumpets, and Yahweh set every man’s sword against his fellow and against all the army; and the army fled as far as Beth Shittah toward Zererah, as far as the border of Abel Meholah, by Tabbath.

hausa: Saboda haka in ka ɗauke ni a kan ni abokin tarayya ne, sai ka marabce shi kamar yadda za ka marabce ni.
english: If then you count me a partner, receive him as you would receive me.

hausa: domin na ceci matalauta waɗanda suka nemi taimako, da marasa mahaifi waɗanda ba su da wanda zai taimake su.
english: because I delivered the poor who cried, and the fatherless also, who had no one to help him,

hausa: Masu tawali’u za su sāke yin farin ciki a cikin Ubangiji; mabukata za su yi farin ciki cikin Mai Tsarkin nan na Isra’ila.
english: The humble also will increase their joy in Yahweh, and the poor among men will rejoice in the Holy One of Israel.

hausa: Wata mutuniyar Kan’ana daga wajajen ta zo wurinsa, tana ihu tana cewa, “Ubangiji, Ɗan Dawuda, ka yi mini jinƙai! ’Yata tana shan wahala ƙwarai daga aljanin da yake cikinta.”
english: Behold, a Canaanite woman came out from those borders and cried, saying, “Have mercy on me, Lord, you son of David! My daughter is severely possessed by a demon!”

hausa: Sa’ad da mugunci ya zo, reni ma kan zo, haka kuma sa’ad da kunya ta zo, shan kunya kan biyo.
english: When wickedness comes, contempt also comes, and with shame comes disgrace.

hausa: Sa’an nan Ubangiji Allah ya yi mutum daga turɓayar ƙasa, ya kuma hura numfashin rai cikin hancinsa, mutumin kuwa ya zama rayayyen taliki.
english: Yahweh God formed man from the dust of the ground, and breathed into his nostrils the breath of life; and man became a living soul.

hausa: Gara a kasance da kaɗan da tsoron Ubangiji da a kasance da arziki mai yawa game da wahala.
english: Better is little, with the fear of Yahweh, than great treasure with trouble.

hausa: Amma Zerubbabel, Yeshuwa, da sauran shugabannin iyalai na Isra’ila suka amsa suka ce, “Ba za ku sa hannu cikin gina wa Allahnmu haikali ba, mu kaɗai za mu gina wa Ubangiji, Allah na Isra’ila gini kamar yadda Sarki Sairus, sarkin Farisa, ya umarce mu.”
english: But Zerubbabel, Jeshua, and the rest of the heads of fathers’ households of Israel said to them, “You have nothing to do with us in building a house to our God; but we ourselves together will build to Yahweh, the God of Israel, as King Cyrus the king of Persia has commanded us.”

hausa: Za su kira mutane zuwa dutse, a can za su miƙa hadayun adalci; za su yi biki a yalwan tekuna, a dukiyoyin da aka ɓoye a cikin yashi.”
english: They will call the peoples to the mountain. There they will offer sacrifices of righteousness, for they will draw out the abundance of the seas, the hidden treasures of the sand.”

hausa: Zai kāre ka daga ɓata suna, kuma ba ka bukata ka ji tsoro in hallaka ta zo.
english: You will be hidden from the scourge of the tongue, neither will you be afraid of destruction when it comes.

hausa: Amma abokan gābanki masu yawa za su zama kamar ƙura mai laushi, sojojinsu masu firgitarwa za su yi ta tashi kamar yayin da iska ta hura. Farat ɗaya, cikin ɗan lokaci,
english: But the multitude of your foes will be like fine dust, and the multitude of the ruthless ones like chaff that blows away. Yes, it will be in an instant, suddenly.

hausa: Za su san cewa ni ne Ubangiji Allahnsu, wanda ya fitar da su daga Masar saboda in zauna a cikinsu. Ni ne Ubangiji Allahnsu.
english: They shall know that I am Yahweh their God, who brought them out of the land of Egypt, that I might dwell among them: I am Yahweh their God.

hausa: (In mutum bai san yadda zai tafiyar da iyalinsa ba, yaya zai iya kula da ikkilisiyar Allah?)
english: (for how could someone who doesn’t know how to rule his own house take care of God’s assembly?)

hausa: Ya gina wurinsa mai tsarki kamar bisa, kamar duniyar da ya kafa har abada.
english: He built his sanctuary like the heights, like the earth which he has established forever.

hausa: Sai Ubangiji ya yi abin da Musa ya nema. Kwaɗin suka mutu a gidaje, da filaye, da kuma gonaki.
english: Yahweh did according to the word of Moses, and the frogs died out of the houses, out of the courts, and out of the fields.

hausa: duk wannan kuwa saboda begen nan ne ga rai madawwami da Allah ya yi alkawari tun fil azal, shi wanda ƙarya ba ta a gare shi,
english: in hope of eternal life, which God, who can’t lie, promised before time began;

hausa: Wauta kan sa mutum marar azanci ya yi farin ciki, amma mai basira kan kiyaye abin da yake yi daidai.
english: Folly is joy to one who is void of wisdom, but a man of understanding keeps his way straight.

hausa: “Me kuma Dawuda zai ce maka saboda girmamawar da ka yi wa bawanka? Gama ka san bawanka,
english: What can David say yet more to you concerning the honor which is done to your servant? For you know your servant.

hausa: “Keɓe mini kowane ɗan fari. Ɗan fari wanda ya fara buɗe mahaifa a cikin Isra’ilawa nawa ne, ko na mutum ko na dabba.”
english: “Sanctify to me all the firstborn, whatever opens the womb among the children of Israel, both of man and of animal. It is mine.”

hausa: Ya ce, “Na ji ka a cikin lambu, na kuwa ji tsoro gama ina tsirara, saboda haka na ɓuya.”
english: The man said, “I heard your voice in the garden, and I was afraid, because I was naked; so I hid myself.”

hausa: Yabi Ubangiji. Yi godiya ga Ubangiji, gama nagari ne shi; ƙaunarsa madawwamiya ce har abada.
english: Praise Yahweh! Give thanks to Yahweh, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.

hausa: “Ina misalin kyan tentunanka, ya Yaƙub, wuraren zamanka, ya Isra’ila!
english: How goodly are your tents, Jacob, and your dwellings, Israel!

hausa: ’Yan matan Urushalima, ina roƙonku, in kun sami ƙaunataccena me za ku ce masa? Ku ce masa na suma saboda ƙauna.
english: I adjure you, daughters of Jerusalem, If you find my beloved, that you tell him that I am faint with love.

hausa: “Ta yi sauri ta saukar da tulun daga kafaɗarta ta ce, ‘Sha, zan kuma ba wa raƙumanka su ma.’ Sai na sha, ta kuma shayar da raƙumana su ma.
english: She hurried and let down her pitcher from her shoulder, and said, ‘Drink, and I will also give your camels a drink.’ So I drank, and she also gave the camels a drink.

hausa: Sai na gani a cikin marasa azanci, na lura a cikin samari, wani matashi wanda ba shi da hankali.
english: I saw among the simple ones. I discerned among the youths a young man void of understanding,

hausa: Bari kukata ta zo gare ka, ya Ubangiji; ka ba ni ganewa bisa ga maganarka.
english: Let my cry come before you, Yahweh. Give me understanding according to your word.

hausa: Bayan da Dawuda ya gama magana da Shawulu, sai Yonatan ɗan Shawulu ya ji zuciyarsa tana son Dawuda sosai. Yonatan kuwa yana ƙaunar Dawuda kamar ransa.
english: When he had finished speaking to Saul, the soul of Jonathan was knit with the soul of David, and Jonathan loved him as his own soul.

hausa: Sai sarki ya ɗora Daniyel a babban matsayi ya kuma sanya shi mai mulki a kan dukan yankin ƙasar Babilon; ya kuma ɗora shi yă zama mai kula da duk masu hikima.
english: Then the king made Daniel great and gave him many great gifts, and made him rule over the whole province of Babylon and to be chief governor over all the wise men of Babylon.

hausa: Kiriyatayim, Sibma, Zeret Shahar kan tudu cikin kwari,
english: Kiriathaim, Sibmah, Zereth Shahar in the mount of the valley,

hausa: Ganin wannan sai suka kyakkece rigunansu. Sa’an nan suka jibga wa jakunansu kaya, suka koma birni.
english: Then they tore their clothes, and each man loaded his donkey, and returned to the city.

hausa: Saboda haka sarki Rehobowam ya yi garkuwoyin tagulla ya mayar da su. Ya kuma naɗa waɗannan shugabannin matsara ya sa su aiki a ƙofar zuwa fadan sarki.
english: King Rehoboam made shields of bronze in their place, and committed them to the hands of the captains of the guard, who guarded the door of the king’s house.

hausa: Sa’an nan ya kawo ni ƙofar arewa ya kuma auna ta. Girmanta ɗaya ne da sauran,
english: He brought me to the north gate, and he measured it according to these measurements—

hausa: Sa’an nan Bilatus ya tafi da Yesu ya kuma sa aka yi masa bulala.
english: So Pilate then took Jesus and flogged him.

hausa: In muka ce muna zumunci da shi amma muna tafiya cikin duhu, ƙarya muke yi, kuma ba ma rayuwa bisa ga gaskiya.
english: If we say that we have fellowship with him and walk in the darkness, we lie and don’t tell the truth.

hausa: Hezekiya ya marabci jakadun da murna ya kuma nuna musu abin da gidajen ajiyarsa sun ƙunsa, azurfa, zinariya, yaji, tatsatsen mai, dukan kayan yaƙinsa da kuma kome da yake a ma’ajinsa. Babu abin da yake a cikin fadansa ko cikin dukan masarautarsa da Hezekiya bai nuna musu ba.
english: Hezekiah was pleased with them, and showed them the house of his precious things, the silver, the gold, the spices, and the precious oil, and all the house of his armor, and all that was found in his treasures. There was nothing in his house, nor in all his dominion, that Hezekiah didn’t show them.

hausa: Sarki ya ce, “Ka sauka lafiya.” Sai ya tafi Hebron.
english: The king said to him, “Go in peace.” So he arose and went to Hebron.

hausa: daga Zera, kabilar Zerawa; daga Sha’ul, kabilar Sha’ul.
english: of Zerah, the family of the Zerahites; of Shaul, the family of the Shaulites.

hausa: Ubangiji Maɗaukaki, wanda ya dasa ki, ya furta miki masifa, domin gidan Isra’ila da kuma gidan Yahuda sun aikata mugunta suka kuma tsokane ni in yi fushi ta wurin ƙona wa Ba’al turare.
english: For Yahweh of Armies, who planted you, has pronounced evil against you, because of the evil of the house of Israel and of the house of Judah, which they have done to themselves in provoking me to anger by offering incense to Baal.

hausa: Ubangiji shi ne mafakan waɗanda ake danniya, mafaka a lokutan wahala.
english: Yahweh will also be a high tower for the oppressed; a high tower in times of trouble.

hausa: Ya amsa ya ce, “Ba ka san mene ne waɗannan ba?” Na ce, “A’a, ranka yă daɗe.”
english: He answered me, “Don’t you know what these are?” I said, “No, my lord.”

hausa: Yanzu fa Ubangiji ya ce ya siffanta ni a cikin mahaifa don in zama bawansa don in dawo da Yaƙub gare shi in kuma tattara Isra’ila gare shi, gama an girmama ni a gaban Ubangiji Allahna kuma ne ƙarfina
english: Now Yahweh, he who formed me from the womb to be his servant, says to bring Jacob again to him, and to gather Israel to him, for I am honorable in Yahweh’s eyes, and my God has become my strength.

hausa: Ahiyam ɗan Sakar mutumin Harar, Elifal ɗan Ur,
english: Ahiam the son of Sacar the Hararite, Eliphal the son of Ur,

hausa: To, Elisha yana zaune a cikin gidansa, dattawa kuwa suna zaune tare da shi. Sai sarki ya aiki ɗan aika yă ci gaba, amma kafin ɗan aikan yă isa, Elisha ya ce wa dattawan, “Kun gani ko? Wannan mai kisa ya aiko a cire mini kai! To, idan ɗan aikan ya iso, sai ku rufe ƙofar da ƙarfi, ku bar shi a waje. Ba da jimawa ba, maigidansa zai bi bayansa?”
english: But Elisha was sitting in his house, and the elders were sitting with him. Then the king sent a man from before him; but before the messenger came to him, he said to the elders, “Do you see how this son of a murderer has sent to take away my head? Behold, when the messenger comes, shut the door, and hold the door shut against him. Isn’t the sound of his master’s feet behind him?”

hausa: suna ihu suna cewa “Mutanen Isra’ila ku taimake mu! Ga mutumin da yake koya wa dukan mutane ko’ina cewa su ƙi mutanenmu da dokarmu da kuma wannan wuri. Ban da haka ma, ya kawo Hellenawa a cikin filin haikali ya ƙazantar da wurin nan mai tsarki.”
english: crying out, “Men of Israel, help! This is the man who teaches all men everywhere against the people, and the law, and this place. Moreover, he also brought Greeks into the temple and has defiled this holy place!”

hausa: Saboda haka Yohanan ɗan Kareya da dukan shugabannin sojoji da dukan mutane suka yi rashin biyayya ga umarnin Ubangiji da su zauna a ƙasar Yahuda.
english: So Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the captains of the forces, and all the people, didn’t obey Yahweh’s voice, to dwell in the land of Judah.

hausa: Yesu ya amsa ya ce, “Musa ya ba ku izini ku saki matanku saboda taurin zuciyarku ne. Amma ba haka yake ba daga farko.
english: He said to them, “Moses, because of the hardness of your hearts, allowed you to divorce your wives, but from the beginning it has not been so.

hausa: Jama’a ma suka tattaru daga garuruwa kewaye da Urushalima suna kawo marasa lafiyarsu da kuma waɗanda mugayen ruhohi suke damun su, dukansu kuwa suka warke.
english: The multitude also came together from the cities around Jerusalem, bringing sick people and those who were tormented by unclean spirits; and they were all healed.

hausa: “ ‘Duk wanda ya yi wani daga cikin waɗannan abubuwa banƙyama, dole a fid da mutumin daga cikin mutanensa.
english: “‘For whoever shall do any of these abominations, even the souls that do them shall be cut off from among their people.

hausa: Da jin haka, sai ’yan ƙasa a hasumiyar Shekem suka shiga wurin mafaka a hankalin El-Berit.
english: When all the men of the tower of Shechem heard of it, they entered into the stronghold of the house of Elberith.

hausa: “Yaya za ku ce, ‘Mu jarumawa ne, mutane masu ƙarfi a yaƙi?’
english: “How do you say, ‘We are mighty men, and valiant men for the war’?

hausa: don su hana matalauta hakkinsu su kuma ƙi yin shari’ar gaskiya a kan waɗanda suke zaluntar mutanena, suna ƙwace wa gwauraye dukiyarsu suna kuma yi wa marayu ƙwace.
english: to deprive the needy of justice, and to rob the poor among my people of their rights, that widows may be their plunder, and that they may make the fatherless their prey!

hausa: Za tă zama rumfa da inuwar da za tă tare zafin rana, da kuma mafaka da wurin ɓuya daga hadari da ruwan sama.
english: There will be a pavilion for a shade in the daytime from the heat, and for a refuge and for a shelter from storm and from rain.

hausa: Gama a ɗan lokaci mutanenka suka mallaki wurinka mai tsarki, amma yanzu abokan gābanmu sun tattake wurinka mai tsarki.
english: Your holy people possessed it but a little while. Our adversaries have trodden down your sanctuary.

hausa: har da mu ma, mu da ya kira, ba daga cikin Yahudawa kaɗai ba amma har ma daga cikin Al’ummai?
english: us, whom he also called, not from the Jews only, but also from the Gentiles?

hausa: Mai yiwuwa Ubangiji yă ga azabata, yă sāka mini da alheri saboda la’anar da nake sha a yau.”
english: It may be that Yahweh will look on the wrong done to me, and that Yahweh will repay me good for the cursing of me today.”

hausa: Wawa kan nuna fushinsa nan take, amma mai la’akari kan ƙyale zargi.
english: A fool shows his annoyance the same day, but one who overlooks an insult is prudent.

hausa: “Ɗan mutum, ka kafa fuskarka gāba da Urushalima ka kuma yi wa’azi a kan wuri mai tsarki. Ka yi annabci gāba da ƙasar Isra’ila
english: “Son of man, set your face toward Jerusalem, and preach toward the sanctuaries, and prophesy against the land of Israel.

hausa: Kun kashe mutane da yawa a wannan birni kuka kuma cika titunanta da gawawwaki.
english: You have multiplied your slain in this city, and you have filled its streets with the slain.”

hausa: Dubi yadda aka karya aka kuma ragargaza gudumar dukan duniya! Dubi yadda Babilon ta zama kufai a cikin al’ummai!
english: How the hammer of the whole earth is cut apart and broken! How Babylon has become a desolation among the nations!

hausa: Na’ara ta haifi Ahuzzam, Hefer, Temeni da Hawahashtari. Waɗannan su ne zuriyar Na’ara.
english: Naarah bore him Ahuzzam, Hepher, Temeni, and Haahashtari. These were the sons of Naarah.

hausa: Saboda haka, ku shirya kanku don aiki; ku zama masu kamunkai; ku kafa begenku duka a kan alherin da za a ba ku sa’ad da aka bayyana Yesu Kiristi.
english: Therefore prepare your minds for action. Be sober, and set your hope fully on the grace that will be brought to you at the revelation of Jesus Christ—

hausa: Don mai bi da kaɗe-kaɗe. Bisa ga gittit. Zabura ta Dawuda. Ya Ubangiji, shugabanmu, sunanka da girma take a cikin dukan duniya! Ka kafa ɗaukakarka bisa sammai.
english: For the Chief Musician; on an instrument of Gath. A Psalm by David. Yahweh, our Lord, how majestic is your name in all the earth! You have set your glory above the heavens!

hausa: Bayan Dawuda ya zauna a fadansa, sai ya ce wa annabi Natan, “Ga ni, ina zama a fadar da aka yi da al’ul, yayinda akwatin alkawarin Ubangiji yana a ƙarƙashin tenti.”
english: When David was living in his house, David said to Nathan the prophet, “Behold, I live in a cedar house, but the ark of Yahweh’s covenant is in a tent.”

hausa: Ko da yake tabbatacce an gicciye shi cikin rashin ƙarfi, duk da haka, yana rayuwa bisa ga ikon Allah. Haka mu ma marasa ƙarfi ne a cikinsa, amma ta wurin ikon Allah za mu rayu tare da shi don mu yi muku hidima.
english: For he was crucified through weakness, yet he lives through the power of God. For we also are weak in him, but we will live with him through the power of God toward you.

hausa: Duk mai kunnen ji, yă ji abin da Ruhu yake faɗa wa ikkilisiyoyi.
english: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the assemblies.

hausa: Yanzu sa’ad da kuka ji karar ƙaho, da sarewa, da garaya, da goge, da molo da algaita da kowane irin kaɗe-kaɗe da bushe-bushe, in kuna a shirye ku rusuna ƙasa ku yi wa wannan gunkin da na yi sujada, to, da kyau. Amma in ba ku yi sujada ba, za a je fa ku yanzu a cikin tanderun wutar nan. In ga kowane ne allahn nan da zai kuɓutar da ku daga hannuna?”
english: Now if you are ready whenever you hear the sound of the horn, flute, zither, lyre, harp, pipe, and all kinds of music to fall down and worship the image which I have made, good; but if you don’t worship, you shall be cast the same hour into the middle of a burning fiery furnace. Who is that god who will deliver you out of my hands?”

hausa: Shi ya sa na yi himma sosai in yi muku wa’azin bishara ku ma da kuke a Roma.
english: So as much as is in me, I am eager to preach the Good News to you also who are in Rome.

hausa: Gaskiya nake gaya muku, duk inda aka yi wa’azin bishara ko’ina a duniya, za a faɗi abin da ta yi, domin tunawa da ita.”
english: Most certainly I tell you, wherever this Good News may be preached throughout the whole world, that which this woman has done will also be spoken of for a memorial of her.”

hausa: Ko maganganun nan naka marasa amfani za su sa mutane su yi maka shiru? Ba wanda zai kwaɓe ka lokacin da kake faɗar maganar da ba daidai ba?
english: Should your boastings make men hold their peace? When you mock, will no man make you ashamed?

hausa: Ku tuna da kwanakin nan da suka wuce bayan kun sami haske, sa’ad da kuka tsaya daram a tsananin shan wahala.
english: But remember the former days, in which, after you were enlightened, you endured a great struggle with sufferings:

hausa: Don na ƙudura a raina sa’ad da nake tare da ku cewa ba zan mai da hankali ga kome ba sai dai Yesu Kiristi wanda aka gicciye.
english: For I determined not to know anything among you except Jesus Christ and him crucified.

hausa: “Kada ku ba karnuka abin da yake mai tsarki; kada kuma ku jefa wa aladu lu’ulu’anku. In kuka yi haka za su tattake su, sa’an nan su juyo su jijji muku ciwo.
english: “Don’t give that which is holy to the dogs, neither throw your pearls before the pigs, lest perhaps they trample them under their feet, and turn and tear you to pieces.

hausa: Ya yi tafiya a hanyoyin sarakunan Isra’ila, kamar yadda gidan Ahab ta yi, gama ya auri ’yar Ahab. Ya aikata mugayen ayyuka a idon Ubangiji.
english: He walked in the way of the kings of Israel, as did Ahab’s house, for he had Ahab’s daughter as his wife. He did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight.

hausa: Duka-duka Ishmayel ya yi shekara ɗari da talatin da bakwai; sai ya ja numfashinsa na ƙarshe, ya kuma mutu, aka kuma tara shi ga mutanensa.
english: These are the years of the life of Ishmael: one hundred thirty-seven years. He gave up his spirit and died, and was gathered to his people.

hausa: Ya amsa ya ce, “Mai yafa irin mai kyan nan, shi ne Ɗan Mutum.
english: He answered them, “He who sows the good seed is the Son of Man,

hausa: Kuma Ishaya ya ce, “Tushen Yesse zai tsiro, wanda zai taso yă yi mulkin al’ummai; al’ummai za su sa bege a gare shi.”
english: Again, Isaiah says, “There will be the root of Jesse, he who arises to rule over the Gentiles; in him the Gentiles will hope.”

hausa: Sai ya zo wani gari a Samariya da ake ce da shi Saikar, kurkusa da filin da Yaƙub ya ba wa ɗansa Yusuf.
english: So he came to a city of Samaria called Sychar, near the parcel of ground that Jacob gave to his son Joseph.

hausa: Dukan mutanen da Ishmayel ya kame a Mizfa suka juya, suka tafi wurin Yohanan ɗan Kareya.
english: So all the people who Ishmael had carried away captive from Mizpah turned about and came back, and went to Johanan the son of Kareah.

hausa: Bayan da ya faɗi haka, sai ya ɗauki burodi ya yi godiya ga Allah a gabansu duka. Sa’an nan ya gutsuttsura ya fara ci.
english: When he had said this and had taken bread, he gave thanks to God in the presence of all; then he broke it and began to eat.

hausa: Na ce, “Ya Ubangiji Allah na sama, Allah mai girma da mai banrazana, wanda yake kiyaye alkawarinsa na ƙauna da waɗanda suke ƙaunarsa, suke kuma yin biyayya da umarnansa,
english: and said, “I beg you, Yahweh, the God of heaven, the great and awesome God who keeps covenant and loving kindness with those who love him and keep his commandments,

hausa: ’Ya’yan Mika maza su ne, Fiton, Melek, Tereya da Ahaz.
english: The sons of Micah: Pithon, Melech, Tarea, and Ahaz.

hausa: Daga cikin waɗannan da aka zaɓa akwai waɗansu daga Yahuda, Daniyel, Hananiya, Mishayel da kuma Azariya.
english: Now among these of the children of Judah were Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah.

hausa: (Emawa, mutane ne masu ƙarfi da kuma yawa, suna kuma da tsayi kamar Anakawa, dā sun zauna a can.
english: (The Emim lived there before, a great and numerous people, and tall as the Anakim.

hausa: A shekara ta goma sha takwas ta mulkin Yosiya, ya tsarkake ƙasar da haikalin, ya aiki Shafan ɗan Azaliya da Ma’asehiya mai mulkin birni, tare da Yowa ɗan Yowahaz, marubuci, su gyara haikalin Ubangiji Allah.
english: Now in the eighteenth year of his reign, when he had purged the land and the house, he sent Shaphan the son of Azaliah, Maaseiah the governor of the city, and Joah the son of Joahaz the recorder to repair the house of Yahweh his God.

hausa: Duk amai ya rufe teburori kuma babu wani wurin da ba a ɓata ba.
english: For all tables are completely full of filthy vomit and filthiness.

hausa: Ki dawo, ki dawo, ya Bashulammiya; ki dawo, ki dawo, don mu dube ki! Ƙaunatacce Don me kuke duban Bashulammiya sai ka ce rawar Mahanayim?
english: Return, return, Shulammite! Return, return, that we may gaze at you. Lover Why do you desire to gaze at the Shulammite, as at the dance of Mahanaim?

hausa: “Gama ga abin da Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka yana cewa ina shirin miƙa ki ga waɗanda suke ƙinki, ga waɗanda kika ji ƙyamarsu kika rabu da su.
english: “For the Lord Yahweh says: ‘Behold, I will deliver you into the hand of them whom you hate, into the hand of them from whom your soul is alienated.

hausa: Ta haka, sa’ad da aka yi shelar dokar sarki ko’ina a fāɗin masarautarsa, dukan mata za su ba wa mazansu girma, daga ƙarami har zuwa babba.”
english: When the king’s decree which he shall make is published throughout all his kingdom (for it is great), all the wives will give their husbands honor, both great and small.”

hausa: “Kafin in siffanta ka a cikin ciki na san ka, kafin a haife ka, na keɓe ka; na naɗa ka ka zama annabi ga al’ummai.”
english: “Before I formed you in the womb, I knew you. Before you were born, I sanctified you. I have appointed you a prophet to the nations.”

hausa: Isra’ilawa suka aikata mugunta a gaban Ubangiji; suka manta da Ubangiji Allahnsu suka kuma bauta wa Ba’al da Ashera.
english: The children of Israel did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight, and forgot Yahweh their God, and served the Baals and the Asheroth.

hausa: Sa’ad da Yesu ya ji abin da ya faru, sai ya shiga jirgin ruwa ya janye shi kaɗai zuwa wani wuri inda ba kowa. Da jin haka, taron mutane suka bi shi da ƙafa daga garuruwa.
english: Now when Jesus heard this, he withdrew from there in a boat to a deserted place apart. When the multitudes heard it, they followed him on foot from the cities.

hausa: “In na ba da shaida a kaina, shaidata ba gaskiya ba ce.
english: “If I testify about myself, my witness is not valid.

hausa: “Na san duk abin da kuke tunani, yadda za ku saɓa mini.
english: “Behold, I know your thoughts, the plans with which you would wrong me.

hausa: Gama Kiristi masu yawa na ƙarya, da annabawan ƙarya za su firfito, su kuma aikata manyan alamu da ayyukan banmamaki don su ruɗi har da zaɓaɓɓu ma in zai yiwu.
english: For false christs and false prophets will arise, and they will show great signs and wonders, so as to lead astray, if possible, even the chosen ones.

hausa: Sun riƙa ce mini, “Ina maganar Ubangiji take? Bari tă cika yanzu!”
english: Behold, they ask me, “Where is Yahweh’s word? Let it be fulfilled now.”

hausa: A ƙofofin wuri mai tsarki da yake waje an zāna siffofin kerubobi da na itatuwan dabino kamar yadda aka zāna a bangayen, akwai kuma rumfar da aka yi da itace a gaban shirayin.
english: There were made on them, on the doors of the nave, cherubim and palm trees, like those made on the walls. There was a threshold of wood on the face of the porch outside.

hausa: Mun san cewa Allah ba ya sauraron masu zunubi. Yakan saurari mai tsoronsa mai aikata nufinsa.
english: We know that God doesn’t listen to sinners, but if anyone is a worshiper of God and does his will, he listens to him.

hausa: Yana da kyau ka kama ɗaya ba tare da ka saki wancan ba. Mai tsoron Allah zai guji wuce gona da iri.
english: It is good that you should take hold of this. Yes, also don’t withdraw your hand from that; for he who fears God will come out of them all.

hausa: Domin dukan mutanen da ya halitta za su san aikinsa, ya hana kowane mutum yin wahalar aiki.
english: He seals up the hand of every man, that all men whom he has made may know it.

hausa: “Ko kana tsammani wannan gaskiya ne? Kana cewa, ‘Ni mai adalci ne a gaban Allah.’
english: “Do you think this to be your right, or do you say, ‘My righteousness is more than God’s,’

hausa: Mutane da yawa za su zo su ce, “Ku zo, bari mu haura zuwa dutsen Ubangiji, zuwa gidan Allah na Yaƙub. Zai koya mana hanyoyinsa, domin mu yi tafiya cikin hanyoyinsa.” Dokar za tă fito daga Sihiyona, maganar Ubangiji daga Urushalima.
english: Many peoples shall go and say, “Come, let’s go up to the mountain of Yahweh, to the house of the God of Jacob; and he will teach us of his ways, and we will walk in his paths.” For the law shall go out of Zion, and Yahweh’s word from Jerusalem.

hausa: Domin Allah ya taimaki Lawiyawan da suke ɗaukar akwatin alkawarin Ubangiji, aka miƙa hadayar bijimai bakwai da raguna bakwai.
english: When God helped the Levites who bore the ark of Yahweh’s covenant, they sacrificed seven bulls and seven rams.

hausa: “Ɗan mutum, da farat ɗaya ina gab da ɗauke abin da idanunka suke jin daɗin gani. Duk da haka kada ka yi makoki ko ka yi kuka ko ka zub da hawaye.
english: “Son of man, behold, I will take away from you the desire of your eyes with one stroke; yet you shall neither mourn nor weep, neither shall your tears run down.

hausa: mulkinka yă zo a aikata nufinka a duniya kamar yadda ake yi a sama.
english: Let your Kingdom come. Let your will be done on earth as it is in heaven.

hausa: Gama Yoshuwa bai janye hannunsa da yake riƙe da māshinsa ba har sai da ya hallaka dukan mazaunan Ai.
english: For Joshua didn’t draw back his hand, with which he stretched out the javelin, until he had utterly destroyed all the inhabitants of Ai.

hausa: da aka sani tun zamanai.
english: “All of God’s works are known to him from eternity.

hausa: Filaye sun zama marasa amfani, ƙasa ta bushe; an lalatar da hatsi, sabon ruwan inabin ya bushe, mai kuma ba amfani.
english: The field is laid waste. The land mourns, for the grain is destroyed, The new wine has dried up, and the oil languishes.

hausa: Duk da tsoron da suke ji na mutanen da suke kewaye da su, sun gina bagaden a wurinsa, suka kuma miƙa hadaya ta ƙonawa a kan bagaden ga Ubangiji safe da yamma.
english: In spite of their fear because of the peoples of the surrounding lands, they set the altar on its base; and they offered burnt offerings on it to Yahweh, even burnt offerings morning and evening.

hausa: ’Yan’uwana ƙaunatattu, ku lura da wannan. Ya kamata kowa yă kasance mai saurin saurara, ba mai saurin magana ba, ba kuma mai saurin fushi ba,
english: So, then, my beloved brothers, let every man be swift to hear, slow to speak, and slow to anger;

hausa: Ya miƙa hadaya a can a ƙasar tudu, ya kuma gayyaci danginsa zuwa wurin cin abinci. Bayan suka ci, sai suka kwana a can.
english: Jacob offered a sacrifice in the mountain, and called his relatives to eat bread. They ate bread, and stayed all night in the mountain.

hausa: Sai Hiram ya aika masa jiragen ruwan da masu tuƙinsu waɗanda suka san teku sosai. Ma’aikatan Hiram suka tafi da na Solomon zuwa Ofir suka dawo da talentin zinariya ɗari huɗu da hamsin wa Sarki Solomon.
english: Huram sent him ships and servants who had knowledge of the sea by the hands of his servants; and they came with the servants of Solomon to Ophir, and brought from there four hundred fifty talents of gold, and brought them to King Solomon.

hausa: Tabbatacce Ubangiji zai ta’azantar da Sihiyona zai kuma duba da tausayi a kan dukan kufanta; zai sa hamadanta ta zama kamar Eden, ƙeƙasasshiyar ƙasarta kamar lambun Ubangiji. Za a sami farin ciki da murna a cikinta, godiya da ƙarar rerawa.
english: For Yahweh has comforted Zion. He has comforted all her waste places, and has made her wilderness like Eden, and her desert like the garden of Yahweh. Joy and gladness will be found in them, thanksgiving, and the voice of melody.

hausa: sai ta kira bayin gidan ta ce musu, “Duba, an kawo mana wannan mutumin Ibraniyawa don yă ci mutuncinmu! Ya zo nan don yă kwana da ni, amma na yi ihu.
english: she called to the men of her house, and spoke to them, saying, “Behold, he has brought a Hebrew in to us to mock us. He came in to me to lie with me, and I cried with a loud voice.

hausa: Sai Yusuf ya tara hatsi da yawan gaske, kamar yashi a bakin teku, har sai da ya kāsa iya auna shi, gama ba a iya aunawa.
english: Joseph laid up grain as the sand of the sea, very much, until he stopped counting, for it was without number.

hausa: Ner shi mahaifin Kish, Kish mahaifin Shawulu, kuma Shawulu shi ne mahaifin Yonatan, Malki-Shuwa, Abinadab da Esh-Ba’al.
english: Ner became the father of Kish. Kish became the father of Saul. Saul became the father of Jonathan, Malchishua, Abinadab, and Eshbaal.

hausa: Mun yi biyayya da kome da kakanmu Yehonadab ɗan Rekab ya umarce mu. Mu ko matanmu ko ’ya’yanmu maza da mata ba mu taɓa shan ruwan inabi ba
english: We have obeyed the voice of Jonadab the son of Rechab, our father, in all that he commanded us, to drink no wine all our days, we, our wives, our sons, or our daughters;

hausa: Dabbobin da aka tsarkake a matsayi hadayu sun kai bijimai ɗari shida da tumaki da kuma awaki dubu uku.
english: The consecrated things were six hundred head of cattle and three thousand sheep.

hausa: Ta ce wa sarki, “Labarin da na ji a ƙasata game da nasarorinka da hikimarka, gaskiya ne.
english: She said to the king, “It was a true report that I heard in my own land of your acts and of your wisdom.

hausa: “ ‘Iyakarku a arewanci kuwa za tă tashi daga Bahar Rum zuwa Dutsen Hor,
english: “‘This shall be your north border: from the great sea you shall mark out for yourselves Mount Hor.

hausa: Suka ce, “Musa ya ba da izini mutum yă rubuta takardar saki, yă kuma kore ta.”
english: They said, “Moses allowed a certificate of divorce to be written, and to divorce her.”

hausa: Sa’an nan Manowa ya sāke tambayi mala’ikan Ubangiji ya ce, “Mene ne sunanka, don mu girmama ka sa’ad da maganarka ta tabbata.”
english: Manoah said to Yahweh’s angel, “What is your name, that when your words happen, we may honor you?”

hausa: sai Ubangiji ya bayyana gare shi a daren ya ce, “Na ji addu’arka na kuma zaɓi wannan wuri don kaina, a matsayin haikali don hadayu.
english: Then Yahweh appeared to Solomon by night, and said to him, “I have heard your prayer, and have chosen this place for myself for a house of sacrifice.

hausa: Amma mugun ruhu daga Ubangiji ya sauko wa Shawulu yayinda yana zaune a cikin gidansa da māshi a hannunsa. Yayinda Dawuda yake bugan molo,
english: An evil spirit from Yahweh was on Saul as he sat in his house with his spear in his hand; and David was playing music with his hand.

hausa: I,” in ji Ubangiji, “Ina gāba da annabawan da suke kaɗa harsunansu sa’an nan su ce, ‘Ubangiji ne ya furta.’
english: Behold, I am against the prophets,” says Yahweh, “who use their tongues, and say, ‘He says.’

hausa: Duk wanda zai roƙi albarka a cikin ƙasar zai yi haka da gaskiyar Allah; wanda zai yi rantsuwa a cikin ƙasar zai rantse da gaskiyar Allah. Gama za a manta da wahalolin baya a kuma ɓoye su daga idanuna.
english: so that he who blesses himself on the earth will bless himself in the God of truth; and he who swears on the earth will swear by the God of truth; because the former troubles are forgotten, and because they are hidden from my eyes.

hausa: Haka kuwa Mikal ta sauko da Dawuda ta taga ya gudu, ya tsere.
english: So Michal let David down through the window. He went away, fled, and escaped.

hausa: Ya sanar da hanyoyinsa wa Musa, ayyukansa ga mutanen Isra’ila.
english: He made known his ways to Moses, his deeds to the children of Israel.

hausa: Suka kuma tuƙa wani rawanin ƙaya, suka sa masa a kā. Suka sa sanda a hannun damansa. Suka durƙusa a gabansa, suka yi masa ba’a, suna cewa, “Ranka yă daɗe sarkin Yahudawa!”
english: They braided a crown of thorns and put it on his head, and a reed in his right hand; and they kneeled down before him and mocked him, saying, “Hail, King of the Jews!”

hausa: Iyakar kuma ta juya yamma ta cikin Aznot-Tabo ta ɓulla a Hukkok. Ta taɓa Zebulun a kudu, Asher a yamma, da kuma Urdun a gabas.
english: The border turned westward to Aznoth Tabor, and went out from there to Hukkok. It reached to Zebulun on the south, and reached to Asher on the west, and to Judah at the Jordan toward the sunrise.

hausa: Jim kaɗan sai hayaniya ta tashi a dukan birnin. Sai mutane suka cafke Gayus da Aristarkus, abokan tafiyar Bulus daga Makidoniya, suka ruga da zuwa fili da nufi ɗaya.
english: The whole city was filled with confusion, and they rushed with one accord into the theater, having seized Gaius and Aristarchus, men of Macedonia, Paul’s companions in travel.

hausa: Waɗansu daga cikin almajiransa, suka fara magana a kan yadda aka yi wa haikalin ado da duwatsu masu kyau, da kuma kyautai da aka keɓe wa Allah. Amma Yesu ya ce,
english: As some were talking about the temple and how it was decorated with beautiful stones and gifts, he said,

hausa: Ke da kike zama kusa da ruwaye da kike kuma wadatar dukiya, ƙarshenki ya zo, lokaci ya yi da za a kau da ke.
english: You who dwell on many waters, abundant in treasures, your end has come, the measure of your covetousness.

hausa: faɗa wa gidan Isra’ila, ‘Ga abin da Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka yana cewa ina gab da ƙazantar da wuri mai tsarkina, kagarar da kuke taƙama, abin da idanunku suke jin daɗin gani, abin faranta zuciyarku. ’Ya’yanku maza da mata waɗanda kun bari a baya za su mutu ta wurin takobi.
english: ‘Speak to the house of Israel, “The Lord Yahweh says: ‘Behold, I will profane my sanctuary, the pride of your power, the desire of your eyes, and that which your soul pities; and your sons and your daughters whom you have left behind will fall by the sword.

hausa: Sai ta rusuna da fuskarta har ƙasa ta ce, “Ni baranyarka ce, na shirya in bauta maka in kuma wanke ƙafafun bayin shugabana.”
english: She arose and bowed herself with her face to the earth, and said, “Behold, your servant is a servant to wash the feet of the servants of my lord.”

hausa: Gama daga Urushalima raguwa za tă fito, kuma daga Dutsen Sihiyona ƙungiyar waɗanda suka tsira. Himmar Ubangiji Maɗaukaki zai cika wannan.
english: For out of Jerusalem a remnant will go out, and survivors will escape from Mount Zion. The zeal of Yahweh of Armies will perform this.’

hausa: “Wane mahaifi ne a cikinku, in ɗansa ya roƙe shi kifi, zai ba shi maciji a maimakon,
english: “Which of you fathers, if your son asks for bread, will give him a stone? Or if he asks for a fish, he won’t give him a snake instead of a fish, will he?

hausa: Sai Ibrahim ya kawo tumaki da shanu ya ba wa Abimelek, sai su biyun suka yi yarjejjeniya.
english: Abraham took sheep and cattle, and gave them to Abimelech. Those two made a covenant.

hausa: Sa’ad da Ba’al-Hanan ya mutu, Hadad ya gāje shi a matsayin sarki. Aka kira birninsa Fau, sunan matarsa kuwa Mehetabel ’yar Matired, ’yar Me-Zahab.
english: Baal Hanan died, and Hadad reigned in his place; and the name of his city was Pai. His wife’s name was Mehetabel, the daughter of Matred, the daughter of Mezahab.

hausa: Kada dai ku manta da Lawiyawan da suke zama a biranenku, gama ba su da rabo, ko gādo na kansu.
english: You shall not forsake the Levite who is within your gates, for he has no portion nor inheritance with you.

hausa: Jakar ta gan ni, ta kauce mini har sau uku. Da a ce ba tă kauce ba, lalle da na kashe ka, in kuwa bar ta da rai.”
english: The donkey saw me, and turned away before me these three times. Unless she had turned away from me, surely now I would have killed you, and saved her alive.”

hausa: Saboda haka suka juya a wurin suka shiga gidan saurayin nan Balawe a wajen Mika suka gaishe shi.
english: They went over there and came to the house of the young Levite man, even to the house of Micah, and asked him how he was doing.

hausa: Babu wuri mai duhu, babu inuwa mai duhu, inda masu aikata mugunta za su ɓoye.
english: There is no darkness, nor thick gloom, where the workers of iniquity may hide themselves.

hausa: In muka ce ba mu yi zunubi ba, mun mai da shi maƙaryaci ke nan, maganarsa kuwa ba ta da wuri a cikinmu.
english: If we say that we haven’t sinned, we make him a liar, and his word is not in us.

hausa: Ya sa aka kashe Yaƙub, ɗan’uwan Yohanna, da takobi.
english: He killed James, the brother of John, with the sword.

hausa: Ka fanshe ni daga mutane masu danniya, don in yi biyayya da farillanka.
english: Redeem me from the oppression of man, so I will observe your precepts.

hausa: Bai daɗe ba da Dawuda ya ce a ransa, “Ashe, a banza ne na yi ta lura da dukan abin da yake na mutumin nan a jeji, har ba abinsa da ya ɓace. Ga shi, ya rama mini alheri da mugunta.
english: Now David had said, “Surely in vain I have kept all that this fellow has in the wilderness, so that nothing was missed of all that pertained to him. He has returned me evil for good.

hausa: Amma, ku ƙaunaci abokan gābanku, ku kuma yi musu alheri, ku ba su bashi, ba da sa zuciya sai an biya ku ba. Ta yin haka ne kawai, za ku sami lada mai yawa, ku kuma zama ’ya’yan Mafi Ɗaukaka, gama shi mai alheri ne ga marasa godiya da mugaye.
english: But love your enemies, and do good, and lend, expecting nothing back; and your reward will be great, and you will be children of the Most High; for he is kind toward the unthankful and evil.

hausa: Saboda haka Musa ya ƙera macijin tagulla, ya kuma rataye shi bisa doguwar sanda. Sa’an nan duk wanda maciji ya sare shi, ya kuma dubi macijin tagullar, zai warke.
english: Moses made a serpent of bronze, and set it on the pole. If a serpent had bitten any man, when he looked at the serpent of bronze, he lived.

hausa: Sai Elisha ya ce, “Ka kira ta.” Sai ya kira ta, ta zo ta tsaya a bakin ƙofa.
english: He said, “Call her.” When he had called her, she stood in the door.

hausa: Amma bakansa yana nan daram hannuwansa masu ƙarfi ba sa jijjiguwa saboda hannun Maɗaukaki na Yaƙub, saboda Makiyayi, Dutsen Isra’ila,
english: But his bow remained strong. The arms of his hands were made strong, by the hands of the Mighty One of Jacob, (from there is the shepherd, the stone of Israel),

hausa: Sai dai Yesu bai amince da su ba, don ya san dukan mutane.
english: But Jesus didn’t entrust himself to them, because he knew everyone,

hausa: Zan kawo razana a kanki daga waɗanda suke kewaye da ke,” in ji Ubangiji Maɗaukaki. “Za a kore kowannenku, babu wani da zai tattara masu gudun hijira.
english: Behold, I will bring a terror on you,” says the Lord, Yahweh of Armies, “from all who are around you. All of you will be driven completely out, and there will be no one to gather together the fugitives.

hausa: Wa nake da shi a sama in ba kai ba? Ba na kuma sha’awar kome a duniya in ban da kai.
english: Whom do I have in heaven? There is no one on earth whom I desire besides you.

hausa: “Zan ƙarfafa gidan Yahuda in kuma ceci gidan Yusuf. Zan maido da su domin ina jin tausayinsu. Za su zama kamar ban taɓa ƙinsu ba, gama ni ne Ubangiji Allahnsu zan kuma amsa musu.
english: “I will strengthen the house of Judah, and I will save the house of Joseph. I will bring them back, for I have mercy on them. They will be as though I had not cast them off, for I am Yahweh their God, and I will hear them.

hausa: Sai Daniyel ya tafi wurin Ariyok, wanda sarki ya sa yă kashe masu hikiman Babilon, ya kuma ce masa, “Kada ka kashe masu hikiman Babilon ka kai ni wurin sarki, ni kuma zan fassara masa mafarkinsa.”
english: Therefore Daniel went in to Arioch, whom the king had appointed to destroy the wise men of Babylon. He went and said this to him: “Don’t destroy the wise men of Babylon. Bring me in before the king, and I will show to the king the interpretation.”

hausa: Mutumin kirki kan ribance kansa, amma mugu kan kawo wa kansa wahala.
english: The merciful man does good to his own soul, but he who is cruel troubles his own flesh.

hausa: Sun kuma kawo masu aiki a haikali mutum 220, ƙungiyar da Dawuda da abokan aikinsa suka keɓe don su taimaki Lawiyawa aiki. Duk aka rubuta waɗannan da sunayensu.
english: and of the temple servants, whom David and the princes had given for the service of the Levites, two hundred twenty temple servants. All of them were mentioned by name.

hausa: Ku lura da wannan wanda ya jure da irin hamayyan nan daga masu zunubi, don kada ku gaji, har ku fid da zuciya.
english: For consider him who has endured such contradiction of sinners against himself, that you don’t grow weary, fainting in your souls.

hausa: “To, me, mai gonar inabin zai yi ke nan? Zai zo yă karkashe dukan ’yan hayan nan, ya kuma ba wa waɗansu gonar inabin.
english: What therefore will the lord of the vineyard do? He will come and destroy the farmers, and will give the vineyard to others.

hausa: Tabbatacce na ga wulaƙancin da ake yi wa mutanena a Masar. Na ji nishinsu na kuma sauka domin in ’yantar da su. Yanzu ka zo, zan aike ka ka koma Masar.’
english: I have surely seen the affliction of my people who are in Egypt, and have heard their groaning. I have come down to deliver them. Now come, I will send you into Egypt.’

hausa: “Zan sa Urushalima ta zama kwaf mai sa mutanen da suke a dukan kewayenta, jiri. Yaƙi zai kewaye Urushalima har yă shafi Yahuda ma.
english: “Behold, I will make Jerusalem a cup of reeling to all the surrounding peoples, and it will also be on Judah in the siege against Jerusalem.

hausa: Sai dai kun zo ne ga Dutsen Sihiyona, ga Urushalima ta sama, birnin Allah mai rai. Kun zo ga dubu dubban mala’ikun da suke cikin taron farin ciki,
english: But you have come to Mount Zion and to the city of the living God, the heavenly Jerusalem, and to innumerable multitudes of angels,

hausa: Abidan ɗan Gideyoni kuma shi ne shugaban ɓangaren kabilar Benyamin.
english: Abidan the son of Gideoni was over the army of the tribe of the children of Benjamin.

hausa: Gama su mutanenka ne, abin gādonka, waɗanda ka fitar daga Masar, daga tanderu mai narken ƙarfe.
english: (for they are your people and your inheritance, which you brought out of Egypt, from the middle of the iron furnace);

hausa: “A wannan lokaci Mika’ilu, babban mai mulki wanda yake kāre mutanenka, zai tashi. Za a yi lokacin matsananciyar wahala wanda ba a taɓa yi tun farkon ƙasashe har zuwa yanzu. Amma a lokacin da mutanenka, kowane mutum wanda aka sami sunansa a rubuce a cikin littafin, za a cece shi.
english: “At that time Michael will stand up, the great prince who stands for the children of your people; and there will be a time of trouble, such as never was since there was a nation even to that same time. At that time your people will be delivered, everyone who is found written in the book.

hausa: Suka kawo shi wurin Yesu. Suka sa rigunarsu a kan ɗan jakin, sa’an nan suka sa Yesu a kai.
english: Then they brought it to Jesus. They threw their cloaks on the colt and sat Jesus on them.

hausa: Saboda haka aka kau da yin gaskiya adalci kuma ya tsaya can da nesa; gaskiya ta yi tuntuɓe a tituna, sahihanci ba zai shiga ba.
english: Justice is turned away backward, and righteousness stands far away; for truth has fallen in the street, and uprightness can’t enter.

hausa: Ya jingina ga yanar gizo, amma ba ta tare shi, sun kama ta, amma ba za tă taimake su tsayawa ba.
english: He will lean on his house, but it will not stand. He will cling to it, but it will not endure.

hausa: to, sai ku san wannan, ku da dukan mutanen Isra’ila cewa da sunan Yesu Kiristi Banazare, wanda kuka gicciye amma wanda Allah ya tasar daga matattu ne, wannan mutum yake tsaye a gabanku lafiyayye.
english: may it be known to you all, and to all the people of Israel, that in the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, whom you crucified, whom God raised from the dead, this man stands here before you whole in him.

hausa: Ya Ubangiji, wane ne mutum da ka kula da shi, ɗan mutum da har za ka yi tunaninsa?
english: Yahweh, what is man, that you care for him? Or the son of man, that you think of him?

hausa: Gama karkiyata mai sauƙi ce, kayana kuma marasa nauyi ne.”
english: For my yoke is easy, and my burden is light.”

hausa: Sai ya je ya ɗebo waɗansu ruhohi bakwai da suka fi shi mugunta, sai su shiga su zauna a wurin. Ƙarshen wannan mutum kuwa zai fi farkonsa muni.”
english: Then he goes and takes seven other spirits more evil than himself, and they enter in and dwell there. The last state of that man becomes worse than the first.”

hausa: Da wayo suna ƙulle-ƙulle a kan mutanenka; suna shirya maƙarƙashiya a kan waɗanda kake so.
english: They conspire with cunning against your people. They plot against your cherished ones.

hausa: “ ‘Ga waɗanda za su ragu kuwa, zan cika zukatansu da tsoro a ƙasashen abokan gābansu har motsin ganyen da iska ta hura zai sa su ruga da gudu. Za su yi gudu kamar suna gudu daga takobi ne, za su kuma fāɗi, ko da yake babu wanda yake korinsu.
english: “‘As for those of you who are left, I will send a faintness into their hearts in the lands of their enemies. The sound of a driven leaf will put them to flight; and they shall flee, as one flees from the sword. They will fall when no one pursues.

hausa: Dokar Allahnsa tana a cikin zuciyarsa; ƙafafunsa ba sa santsi.
english: The law of his God is in his heart. None of his steps shall slide.

hausa: Kuma Ubangiji ya ce, ‘Wa zai ruɗi Ahab zuwa yaƙi da Ramot Gileyad, yă kuma kai shi mutuwarsa a can?’ “Wani ya ce wannan, wani ya ce wancan.
english: Yahweh said, ‘Who will entice Ahab, that he may go up and fall at Ramoth Gilead?’ One said one thing, and another said another.

hausa: Zai yanka ɗan bijimin a gaban Ubangiji, Haruna kuwa da ’ya’yansa maza firist, za su kawo jinin su kuma yafa shi a kan bagaden a kowane gefe a mashigin Tentin Sujada.
english: He shall kill the bull before Yahweh. Aaron’s sons, the priests, shall present the blood and sprinkle the blood around on the altar that is at the door of the Tent of Meeting.

hausa: Bayan ka gani, kai ma za ka bi ƙafafun mutanenka, kamar yadda ɗan’uwanka Haruna ya yi,
english: When you have seen it, you also shall be gathered to your people, as Aaron your brother was gathered;

hausa: Na rasa wanda zan zaɓa cikin biyun nan. Ina sha’awa in yi ƙaura in zauna tare da Kiristi, wannan kuwa ya fi kyau nesa ba kusa ba;
english: But I am hard pressed between the two, having the desire to depart and be with Christ, which is far better.

hausa: Saman sammai na Ubangiji ne, amma ya ba da duniya ga mutum.
english: The heavens are Yahweh’s heavens, but he has given the earth to the children of men.

hausa: Sai Yoshuwa da dukan Isra’ilawa suka tashi daga Eglon zuwa Hebron suka kai hari a can.
english: Joshua went up from Eglon, and all Israel with him, to Hebron; and they fought against it.

hausa: Zan sa wuta a Yahuda da za tă ƙone kagarun Urushalima.”
english: but I will send a fire on Judah, and it will devour the palaces of Jerusalem.”

hausa: “Ku yi maza ku gudu! Ku zauna a kogo masu zurfi, ku da kuke zama a Hazor,” in ji Ubangiji. “Nebukadnezzar sarkin Babilon ya shirya muku maƙarƙashiya; ya ƙulla maƙarƙashiya a kanku.
english: Flee! Wander far off! Dwell in the depths, you inhabitants of Hazor,” says Yahweh; “for Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon has taken counsel against you, and has conceived a purpose against you.

hausa: Saboda haka ya gudu da dukan abin da ya mallaka, ya ƙetare Kogi, ya nufi yankin tuddan Gileyad.
english: So he fled with all that he had. He rose up, passed over the River, and set his face toward the mountain of Gilead.

hausa: Mutumin da ya karɓi talenti biyar, ya kawo ƙarin talenti biyar. Ya ce, ‘Maigida, ka danƙa mini talenti biyar. Ga shi, na yi ribar biyar.’
english: He who received the five talents came and brought another five talents, saying, ‘Lord, you delivered to me five talents. Behold, I have gained another five talents in addition to them.’

hausa: Miyakuna sun ruɓe suna kuma wari saboda wawancina na zunubi.
english: My wounds are loathsome and corrupt because of my foolishness.

hausa: Kada ku bi alloli marasa amfani. Ba za su iya yi muku kome nagari ba, ba kuwa za su iya cece ku ba, gama ba su da amfani.
english: Don’t turn away to go after vain things which can’t profit or deliver, for they are vain.

hausa: Abiya kuwa ya huta tare da kakanninsa, aka kuma binne shi a Birnin Dawuda. Asa ɗansa ya gāje shi a matsayin sarki, a zamaninsa kuma ƙasar ta zauna lafiya na shekara goma.
english: So Abijah slept with his fathers, and they buried him in David’s city; and Asa his son reigned in his place. In his days, the land was quiet ten years.

hausa: Amma kai, ɗan mutum, ka saurari abin da zan faɗa maka. Kada ka yi tawaye kamar wannan gidan ’yan tawaye; ka buɗe bakinka ka kuma ci abin da na ba ka.”
english: But you, son of man, hear what I tell you. Don’t be rebellious like that rebellious house. Open your mouth, and eat that which I give you.”

hausa: Yana kamar mai mai darajar da aka zuba a kai, yana gangarawa a gemu, yana gangarawa a gemun Haruna, har zuwa wuyan rigunansa.
english: It is like the precious oil on the head, that ran down on the beard, even Aaron’s beard, that came down on the edge of his robes,

hausa: Da yana yafa irin, waɗansu suka fāffāɗi a kan hanya, tsuntsaye kuwa suka zo suka cinye su.
english: As he sowed, some seeds fell by the roadside, and the birds came and devoured them.

hausa: A zagawa ta bakwai, da firistoci suka busa ƙahoni, sai Yoshuwa ya ba sojojin umarni ya ce, “Ku yi ihu, gama Ubangiji ya ba ku birnin!
english: At the seventh time, when the priests blew the trumpets, Joshua said to the people, “Shout, for Yahweh has given you the city!

hausa: Sa’ad da shugabannin Sarki Hezekiya suka zo wurin Ishaya,
english: So the servants of King Hezekiah came to Isaiah.

hausa: Sai sarkin Assuriya ya ji roƙonsa. Ya tashi ya fāɗa wa Damaskus da hari ya kuma kame ta. Ya kwashi mazaunanta zuwa Kir, ya kuma kashe Rezin.
english: The king of Assyria listened to him; and the king of Assyria went up against Damascus and took it, and carried its people captive to Kir, and killed Rezin.

hausa: Amma game da Ɗan ya ce, “Kursiyinka, ya Allah, zai kasance har abada abadin, adalci kuma zai zama sandan mulkinka.
english: But of the Son he says, “Your throne, O God, is forever and ever. The scepter of uprightness is the scepter of your Kingdom.

hausa: “ ‘Saboda haka ga abin da Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka ya ce muddin ina raye, zan nemi hakkin rantsuwata da ya ƙi cikawa da kuma alkawarin da ya take.
english: “Therefore the Lord Yahweh says: ‘As I live, I will surely bring on his own head my oath that he has despised and my covenant that he has broken.

hausa: Taron mutane mai girma ya haɗu a Urushalima don Bikin Burodi Marar Yisti a wata na biyu.
english: Many people assembled at Jerusalem to keep the feast of unleavened bread in the second month, a very great assembly.

hausa: Yesu ya amsa ya ce, “A rubuce yake cewa, ‘Ba da abinci kaɗai mutum yake rayuwa ba, sai dai da kowace kalmar da take fitowa daga bakin Allah.’”
english: But he answered, “It is written, ‘Man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word that proceeds out of God’s mouth.’”

hausa: “Yanzu fa, sai ku koyi wannan darasi daga itacen ɓaure. Da zarar rassansa suka yi taushi ganyayensa kuma suka toho, kun san damina ta kusa.
english: “Now from the fig tree learn this parable: When its branch has now become tender and produces its leaves, you know that the summer is near.

hausa: Kuna birkitar abubuwa, sai ka ce an mayar da mai ginin tukwane ya zama yumɓu! Abin da aka yi zai ce wa wanda ya yi shi, “Ba shi ne ya yi ni ba”? Tukunya za tă iya ce wa mai ginin tukwane, “Ba ka san kome ba”?
english: You turn things upside down! Should the potter be thought to be like clay, that the thing made should say about him who made it, “He didn’t make me;” or the thing formed say of him who formed it, “He has no understanding”?

hausa: Ba ni da wata tabbatacciyar maganar da zan rubuta wa Mai Girma game da shi. Saboda haka na kawo shi a gabanku duka, musamman a gabanka, Sarki Agiriffa, saboda a sakamakon wannan bincike zan iya samun abin da zan rubuta.
english: of whom I have no certain thing to write to my lord. Therefore I have brought him out before you, and especially before you, King Agrippa, that, after examination I may have something to write.

hausa: Saboda haka, ga abin da Ubangiji ya ce game da annabawan da suke annabci da sunana. Ban aike su ba, duk da haka suna cewa, ‘Babu takobi ko yunwar da zai taɓa wannan ƙasa.’ Waɗannan annabawa takobi da yunwa za su hallaka su.
english: Therefore Yahweh says concerning the prophets who prophesy in my name, but I didn’t send them, yet they say, ‘Sword and famine will not be in this land.’ Those prophets will be consumed by sword and famine.
