hausa: amma ya rataye shugaban masu tuya, kamar dai yadda Yusuf ya faɗa musu a fassarar mafarkan da suka yi.
english: but he hanged the chief baker, as Joseph had interpreted to them.

hausa: Don mai bi da kaɗe-kaɗe. Don Busa. Ta Dawuda. Ka saurare kalmomina, ya Ubangiji, ka ji ajiyar zuciyata.
english: For the Chief Musician, with the flutes. A Psalm by David. Give ear to my words, Yahweh. Consider my meditation.

hausa: Fushin sarki yana kama da rurin zaki; duk wanda ya sa shi fushi zai rasa ransa.
english: The terror of a king is like the roaring of a lion. He who provokes him to anger forfeits his own life.

hausa: Waɗannan su ne sarakunan ƙasashen da Isra’ilawa suka ci da yaƙi, suka kuma mallaki ƙasarsu a gabashin Urdun, daga kwarin Arnon zuwa Dutsen Hermon haɗe da dukan gefen gabas na Araba.
english: Now these are the kings of the land, whom the children of Israel struck, and possessed their land beyond the Jordan toward the sunrise, from the valley of the Arnon to Mount Hermon, and all the Arabah eastward:

hausa: A cikin dukan Isra’ila babu wanda ake yabon kyansa kamar Absalom. Tun daga kansa har zuwa tafin ƙafansa babu tabo a jikinsa.
english: Now in all Israel there was no one to be so much praised as Absalom for his beauty. From the sole of his foot even to the crown of his head there was no defect in him.

hausa: Dukan ƙauyuka suka yi ta kururuwa yayinda mutanen suke wucewa. Sarki shi ma ya haye ta Kwarin Kidron, mutane kuma suka ci gaba da tafiya zuwa wajen hamada.
english: All the country wept with a loud voice, and all the people passed over. The king also himself passed over the brook Kidron, and all the people passed over toward the way of the wilderness.

hausa: Ya aika da akwatin alkawarin ƙarfinsa zuwa bauta, darajarsa zuwa cikin hannuwan abokin gāba.
english: and delivered his strength into captivity, his glory into the adversary’s hand.

hausa: Dawuda yana dawowa daga karkashe Filistiyawa ke nan, sai Abner ya kai shi gaban Shawulu, riƙe da kan Bafilistin.
english: As David returned from the slaughter of the Philistine, Abner took him and brought him before Saul with the head of the Philistine in his hand.

hausa: da shugabanni waɗanda suke da zinariya, waɗanda suka cika gidajensu da azurfa.
english: or with princes who had gold, who filled their houses with silver;

hausa: Filin cikin ma yana da ƙofar da ta fuskanci kudu, sai ya auna daga wannan ƙofa zuwa ƙofar waje a gefen kudu; ya sami kamu ɗari.
english: There was a gate to the inner court toward the south. He measured one hundred cubits from gate to gate toward the south.

hausa: “Ni ɗin Allah na kusa ne kawai,” in ji Ubangiji, “ba Allah na nesa ba?
english: “Am I a God at hand,” says Yahweh, “and not a God afar off?

hausa: Abishuwa, Na’aman, Ahowa,
english: Abishua, Naaman, Ahoah,

hausa: Sarki Rehobowam ya kafa kansa daram a Urushalima, ya kuma ci gaba a matsayin sarki. Yana da shekara arba’in da ɗaya sa’ad da ya zama sarki, ya kuma yi mulki shekara goma sha bakwai a Urushalima, birnin da Ubangiji ya zaɓa daga dukan kabilan Isra’ila wanda zai sa Sunansa. Sunan mahaifiyarsa Na’ama ce, ita mutuniyar Ammon ce.
english: So King Rehoboam strengthened himself in Jerusalem and reigned; for Rehoboam was forty-one years old when he began to reign, and he reigned seventeen years in Jerusalem, the city which Yahweh had chosen out of all the tribes of Israel to put his name there. His mother’s name was Naamah the Ammonitess.

hausa: Ku ba ni zarafi in yi magana, bayan na gama sai ku yi ba’arku.
english: Allow me, and I also will speak. After I have spoken, mock on.

hausa: Ka taimake mu, ya Allah Mai Cetonmu, saboda ɗaukakar sunanka; ka cece mu ka kuma gafarta mana zunubanmu saboda sunanka.
english: Help us, God of our salvation, for the glory of your name. Deliver us, and forgive our sins, for your name’s sake.

hausa: Sa’an nan Yesu ya ɗaga murya ya ce, “Duk wanda ya gaskata da ni, ba ni yake gaskatawa ba, amma ga wanda ya aiko ni ne.
english: Jesus cried out and said, “Whoever believes in me, believes not in me, but in him who sent me.

hausa: Ka koya mini abin da ba zan iya gani ba; in na yi ba daidai ba, ba zan sāke yi ba.’
english: Teach me that which I don’t see. If I have done iniquity, I will do it no more’?

hausa: Jakadu za su zo daga Masar; Kush za tă miƙa kanta ga Allah.
english: Princes shall come out of Egypt. Ethiopia shall hurry to stretch out her hands to God.

hausa: Duk da haka, kamar yadda yake a rubuce cewa, “Ba idon da ya taɓa gani, ba kunnen da ya taɓa ji, ba kuma zuciyar da ta taɓa tunanin abin da Allah ya shirya wa masu ƙaunarsa.”
english: But as it is written, “Things which an eye didn’t see, and an ear didn’t hear, which didn’t enter into the heart of man, these God has prepared for those who love him.”

hausa: Kaitonki, Ariyel, Ariyel birnin da Dawuda ya zauna! Ƙara shekara ga shekara a kuma bar shagulgulanki su yi ta kewayewa.
english: Woe to Ariel! Ariel, the city where David encamped! Add year to year; let the feasts come around;

hausa: Sa’an nan Ubangiji zai fita yă yi yaƙi da waɗannan al’ummai, kamar yadda yake yaƙi a ranar yaƙi.
english: Then Yahweh will go out and fight against those nations, as when he fought in the day of battle.

hausa: Yesu ya amsa ya ce, “Yaya abokan ango za su yi azumi, sa’ad da yana tare da su? Ai, ba za su yi ba, muddin yana tare da su.
english: Jesus said to them, “Can the groomsmen fast while the bridegroom is with them? As long as they have the bridegroom with them, they can’t fast.

hausa: Game da wannan ya amsa ya ce, “’Yan’uwa da ubanni, ku saurare ni! Allah mai ɗaukaka ya bayyana ga kakanmu Ibrahim yayinda yake a ƙasar Mesofotamiya tukuna, kafin ya yi zama a Haran.
english: He said, “Brothers and fathers, listen. The God of glory appeared to our father Abraham when he was in Mesopotamia, before he lived in Haran,

hausa: Sai Dawuda ya kintsa ya tafi inda Shawulu ya yi sansani. Ya ga inda Shawulu da Abner ɗan Ner shugaban ƙungiyar soja suka kwanta. Shawulu yana kwance a cikin sansani tare da sojoji kewaye da shi.
english: Then David arose and came to the place where Saul had encamped; and David saw the place where Saul lay, with Abner the son of Ner, the captain of his army. Saul lay within the place of the wagons, and the people were encamped around him.

hausa: Solomon ya amsa wa Allah, “Ka nuna alheri mai girma ga Dawuda mahaifina ka kuma naɗa ni sarki a matsayinsa.
english: Solomon said to God, “You have shown great loving kindness to David my father, and have made me king in his place.

hausa: Sai Samson ya ce, “Bari in yi muku kacici-kacici, in kun ba ni amsa cikin kwana bakwai na wannan biki, zan ba ku riguna lilin talatin da kuma tufafi talatin.
english: Samson said to them, “Let me tell you a riddle now. If you can tell me the answer within the seven days of the feast, and find it out, then I will give you thirty linen garments and thirty changes of clothing;

hausa: Ba abin da ya rage na rundunar Yehoyahaz sai mahayan dawakai hamsin, kekunan yaƙi goma da kuma sojoji ƙasa dubu goma. Gama sarkin Aram ya hallaka sauran, ya kuma yi kaca-kaca da su kamar ƙura a masussuka.
english: For he didn’t leave to Jehoahaz of the people any more than fifty horsemen, and ten chariots, and ten thousand footmen; for the king of Syria destroyed them and made them like the dust in threshing.

hausa: Na ce zan watsar da su in sa a manta da su a tunanin ’yan adam.
english: I said that I would scatter them afar. I would make their memory to cease from among men;

hausa: Bari ɗaukaka ta tabbata a gare shi a cikin ikkilisiya da kuma a cikin Kiristi Yesu, har yă zuwa dukan zamanai, har abada abadin! Amin.
english: to him be the glory in the assembly and in Christ Jesus to all generations, forever and ever. Amen.

hausa: Zan kafe rafuffukan Nilu in sayar da ƙasar ga mugayen mutane; ta hannun baƙi zan sa ƙasar ta lalace da kome da yake cikinta. Ni Ubangiji na faɗa.
english: I will make the rivers dry, and will sell the land into the hand of evil men. I will make the land desolate, and all that is therein, by the hand of foreigners. I, Yahweh, have spoken it.”

hausa: Ko da ya kawo ɓacin rai, zai nuna tausayi sosai, ƙaunarsa tana da yawa.
english: For though he causes grief, yet he will have compassion according to the multitude of his loving kindnesses.

hausa: “Wannan Musa ne ya ce Isra’ilawa, ‘Allah zai aika muku wani annabi kamar ni daga cikin mutanenku.’
english: This is that Moses who said to the children of Israel, ‘The Lord our God will raise up a prophet for you from among your brothers, like me.’

hausa: Yana ’ya’ya maza talatin da ’ya’ya mata talatin. Ya ba da auren ’ya’yansa mata ga waɗanda ba daga dangi ba, ga ’ya’yansa maza kuwa ya kawo ’yan mata talatin su zama matansu waje da danginsa. Ibzan ya shugabanci Isra’ila shekara bakwai.
english: He had thirty sons. He sent his thirty daughters outside his clan, and he brought in thirty daughters from outside his clan for his sons. He judged Israel seven years.

hausa: Amma firist ya ce wa Dawuda, “Ba ni da burodi iri na kowa da kowa, sai dai akwai burodin da aka tsarkake. Za ka iya ɗauka ku ci idan mutanenka ba su kwana da mata ba.”
english: The priest answered David, and said, “I have no common bread, but there is holy bread; if only the young men have kept themselves from women.”

hausa: Sai Ubangiji ya ce, “Zan ɓoye wa Ibrahim abin da nake shirin yi?
english: Yahweh said, “Will I hide from Abraham what I do,

hausa: Amma bisa ga alkawarinsa muna zuba ido ga sabuwar sama da kuma sabuwar ƙasa, inda adalci zai yi zama.
english: But, according to his promise, we look for new heavens and a new earth, in which righteousness dwells.

hausa: kana kasa kunne ga abin da yake na hikima, kana kuma yin ƙoƙari ka fahimce shi,
english: so as to turn your ear to wisdom, and apply your heart to understanding;

hausa: Amma kai, ya Allah, za ka kawar da mugaye zuwa cikin ramin lalacewa; masu kisa da mutane masu ruɗu ba za su kai rabin kwanakin rayuwarsu ba. Amma ni dai, na dogara gare ka.
english: But you, God, will bring them down into the pit of destruction. Bloodthirsty and deceitful men shall not live out half their days, but I will trust in you.

hausa: Matarsa Yezebel ta shiga ciki ta tambaye shi, ta ce, “Me ya sa ka kumbura? Me ya sa ba za ka ci abinci ba?”
english: But Jezebel his wife came to him, and said to him, “Why is your spirit so sad that you eat no bread?”

hausa: Firist ɗin zai ɗiba jinin hadaya don laifin ya zuba a leɓatun kunnen dama na wanda za a tsabtacce, a babbar yatsar hannunsa na dama a kuma a babbar yatsar ƙafa damansa.
english: The priest shall take some of the blood of the trespass offering, and the priest shall put it on the tip of the right ear of him who is to be cleansed, and on the thumb of his right hand, and on the big toe of his right foot.

hausa: Ya yanka ragon gunduwa-gunduwa ya ƙone kan, ya kuma ƙone gunduwa-gunduwan da kitsen.
english: He cut the ram into its pieces; and Moses burned the head, and the pieces, and the fat.

hausa: Da Sama’ila ya tsufa, sai ya naɗa ’ya’yansa maza su zama alƙalan Isra’ila.
english: When Samuel was old, he made his sons judges over Israel.

hausa: “Na farkon ya yi kamar zaki kuma yana da fikafikai kamar gaggafa. Ina kallo, sai aka fizge fikafikanta, aka ɗaga ta sama, aka sa ta tsaya a kan ƙafafu biyu kamar mutum, aka ba ta tunani irin na mutum.
english: “The first was like a lion, and had eagle’s wings. I watched until its wings were plucked, and it was lifted up from the earth and made to stand on two feet as a man. A man’s heart was given to it.

hausa: Yahuda ma za tă yi yaƙi a Urushalima. Za a tattara dukiyar al’umman da suke kewaye, za a tara zinariya da azurfa masu yawan gaske tare da tufafi.
english: Judah also will fight at Jerusalem; and the wealth of all the surrounding nations will be gathered together: gold, silver, and clothing, in great abundance.

hausa: Kada ku yi kome da sonkai ko girman kai, sai dai cikin tawali’u, ku ɗauki waɗansu sun fi ku.
english: doing nothing through rivalry or through conceit, but in humility, each counting others better than himself;

hausa: na iyalin Malluk, Yonatan; na iyalin Shebaniya, Yusuf;
english: of Malluchi, Jonathan; of Shebaniah, Joseph;

hausa: Sai sau na biya, Sanballat ya aiki mataimakinsa gare ni da irin saƙo guda, kuma a hannunsa akwai wasiƙar da ba a yimƙe ba
english: Then Sanballat sent his servant to me the same way the fifth time with an open letter in his hand,

hausa: don da zuciya ɗaya da kuma baki ɗaya kuke ɗaukaka Allah da kuma Uban Ubangijinmu Yesu Kiristi.
english: that with one accord you may with one mouth glorify the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ.

hausa: Suka ƙi su saurare ka, suka kāsa tuna da mu’ujizan da ka aikata a cikinsu. Suka yi taurinkai, cikin tawayensu kuma suka naɗa shugaba don su koma bautarsu. Amma kai Allah ne mai gafartawa, mai alheri da jinƙai, mai jinkirin fushi, mai yalwar ƙauna. Saboda haka ba ka yashe su ba,
english: and refused to obey. They weren’t mindful of your wonders that you did among them, but hardened their neck, and in their rebellion appointed a captain to return to their bondage. But you are a God ready to pardon, gracious and merciful, slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness, and didn’t forsake them.

hausa: Ya tattara zuriyar Haruna a wuri ɗaya da kuma Lawiyawa.
english: David gathered together the sons of Aaron and the Levites:

hausa: Zan sa goshinka ya zama da tauri kamar dutse, da tauri fiye da dutsen ƙanƙara ƙarfi. Kada ka ji tsoronsu ko ka firgita ta wurinsu, ko da yake su gidan ’yan tawaye ne.”
english: I have made your forehead as a diamond, harder than flint. Don’t be afraid of them, neither be dismayed at their looks, though they are a rebellious house.”

hausa: Muryar Ubangiji ta buga da walƙatar walƙiya.
english: Yahweh’s voice strikes with flashes of lightning.

hausa: Gama kun san cewa Ubangiji zai ba da lada ga kowa gwargwadon kowane aiki nagarin da ya yi, ko shi bawa ne, ko ’yantacce.
english: knowing that whatever good thing each one does, he will receive the same good again from the Lord, whether he is bound or free.

hausa: Da ya gane haka, sai ya tafi gidan Maryamu uwar Yohanna, wanda ake kuma kira Markus, inda mutane da yawa suka taru suna addu’a.
english: Thinking about that, he came to the house of Mary, the mother of John who was called Mark, where many were gathered together and were praying.

hausa: “Ka kawo Haruna da ’ya’yansa a ƙofar Tentin Sujada ka wanke su da ruwa.
english: “You shall bring Aaron and his sons to the door of the Tent of Meeting, and shall wash them with water.

hausa: Sai na ce, “Kash, Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka, yaya ka ruɗi mutanen nan da kuma Urushalima gaba ɗaya haka ta wurin cewa, ‘Za ku zauna lafiya,’ sa’ad da takobi yana a maƙogwaronmu.”
english: Then I said, “Ah, Lord Yahweh! Surely you have greatly deceived this people and Jerusalem, saying, ‘You will have peace;’ whereas the sword reaches to the heart.”

hausa: A ranar da aka haife ki ba a yanke cibiyarki ba, ba a kuma yi miki wanka don a tsabtacce ki ba, ba a kuma goge ki da gishiri ba ko a naɗe ki cikin tsummoki.
english: As for your birth, in the day you were born your navel was not cut. You weren’t washed in water to cleanse you. You weren’t salted at all, nor wrapped in blankets at all.

hausa: Amma Allah ya ce mini, ‘Ba za ka gina gida domin Sunana ba, saboda kai mayaƙi ne ka kuma zub da jini.’
english: But God said to me, ‘You shall not build a house for my name, because you are a man of war and have shed blood.’

hausa: Ya aiko mana da saƙonsa a Babilon cewa zai ɗauki lokaci ƙwarai. Saboda haka ku gina gidaje ku zauna; ku dasa gonaki ku kuma ci abin da suka haifar.’ ”
english: because he has sent to us in Babylon, saying, The captivity is long. Build houses, and dwell in them. Plant gardens, and eat their fruit?”’”

hausa: Shuke-shukenki gonar rumman ne da ’ya’yan itace masu kyau na lalle da nardi,
english: Your shoots are an orchard of pomegranates, with precious fruits, henna with spikenard plants,

hausa: In kuma akwai wani abu har yanzu da kuke so ku kawo, dole a daidaita shi a majalisa.
english: But if you seek anything about other matters, it will be settled in the regular assembly.

hausa: Ku yi ayyukan da suka dace da tuba.
english: Therefore produce fruit worthy of repentance!

hausa: Yana tare da Nikodimus, wannan da ya taɓa zuwa wurin Yesu da dare. Nikodimus ya zo da mur da aloyes a gauraye, wajen awo ɗari.
english: Nicodemus, who at first came to Jesus by night, also came bringing a mixture of myrrh and aloes, about a hundred Roman pounds.

hausa: Amma Yowash sarkin Isra’ila ya amsa wa Amaziya sarkin Yahuda ya ce, “Wata ƙaya ce a Lebanon, ta aika da saƙo wa itacen al’ul na Lebanon cewa, ‘Ka ba ɗana ’yarka aure.’ Sai wani naman jeji na Lebanon ya zo ya tattake ƙayar.
english: Joash king of Israel sent to Amaziah king of Judah, saying, “The thistle that was in Lebanon sent to the cedar that was in Lebanon, saying, ‘Give your daughter to my son as his wife. Then a wild animal that was in Lebanon passed by and trampled down the thistle.

hausa: Sai Ubangiji ya ce wa Musa, “Ka je wurin Fir’auna ka ce masa, ‘Ga abin da Ubangiji Allah na Ibraniyawa ya ce, “Ka bar mutanena su tafi, domin su yi mini sujada.”
english: Then Yahweh said to Moses, “Go in to Pharaoh, and tell him, ‘This is what Yahweh, the God of the Hebrews, says: “Let my people go, that they may serve me.

hausa: Noga, Nefeg, Yafiya,
english: Nogah, Nepheg, Japhia,

hausa: Yana cewa, ‘Zan gina wa kaina babban fada da manyan ɗakuna.’ Ta haka sai ya yi musu manyan tagogi ya manne musu al’ul ya yi musu ado kuma da ruwan ja.
english: who says, ‘I will build myself a wide house and spacious rooms,’ and cuts out windows for himself, with a cedar ceiling, and painted with red.

hausa: Na yi kira gare ka; ka cece ni zan kuwa kiyaye farillanka.
english: I have called to you. Save me! I will obey your statutes.

hausa: Sai Ish-Boshet ya ba da umarni, aka kuwa ɗauke ta daga gidan mijinta Faltiyel ɗan Layish.
english: Ishbosheth sent and took her from her husband, Paltiel the son of Laish.

hausa: Gama za su juye ’ya’yanku maza daga bina, su bauta waɗansu alloli, fushin Ubangiji kuma zai ƙuna a kanku da sauri, zai kuma hallaka ku.
english: For that would turn away your sons from following me, that they may serve other gods. So Yahweh’s anger would be kindled against you, and he would destroy you quickly.

hausa: Eleyazar ɗan Haruna, ya mutu aka binne shi a Gibeya, wurin da aka ba ɗansa Finehas a ƙasar kan tudu ta Efraim.
english: Eleazar the son of Aaron died. They buried him in the hill of Phinehas his son, which was given him in the hill country of Ephraim.

hausa: Matsaran ƙofofi kuwa su ne, Akkub, da Talmon, da ’yan’uwansu waɗanda suke tsaron ƙofofi, su 172 ne.
english: Moreover the gatekeepers, Akkub, Talmon, and their brothers, who kept watch at the gates, were one hundred seventy-two.

hausa: Ram ya haifi Amminadab, Amminadab ya haifi Nashon, Nashon ya haifi Salmon,
english: Ram became the father of Amminadab. Amminadab became the father of Nahshon. Nahshon became the father of Salmon.

hausa: saboda su ji tsoronka a kowane lokacin da suke zaune a ƙasar da ka ba wa kakanninmu.
english: that they may fear you all the days that they live in the land which you gave to our fathers.

hausa: A ta haka fa, za a yi kafarar laifin Yaƙub, wannan kuma zai zama cikakken amfanin kau da zunubinsa. Sa’ad da ya niƙa duwatsun bagade suka zama kamar allin da aka farfashe kucu-kucu, har ba sauran ginshiƙan Ashera ko bagadan ƙona turare da za a bari a tsaye.
english: Therefore by this the iniquity of Jacob will be forgiven, and this is all the fruit of taking away his sin: that he makes all the stones of the altar as chalk stones that are beaten in pieces, so that the Asherah poles and the incense altars shall rise no more.

hausa: gama yana koya wa almajiransa. Ya ce musu, “Za a ci amanar Ɗan Mutum, a ba da shi ga hannun mutane. Za su kashe shi, bayan kwana uku kuma zai tashi.”
english: for he was teaching his disciples, and said to them, “The Son of Man is being handed over to the hands of men, and they will kill him; and when he is killed, on the third day he will rise again.”

hausa: Sai Nebukadnezzar ya husata da Shadrak, Meshak da Abednego, sai al’amuransa a kansu ya canja. Sai ya umarta a ƙara zuga wutar har sau bakwai domin tă yi zafi fiye da yadda take a dā.
english: Then Nebuchadnezzar was full of fury, and the form of his appearance was changed against Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego. He spoke, and commanded that they should heat the furnace seven times more than it was usually heated.

hausa: “Sa’ad da kuka shiga garin, kuma aka karɓe ku, ku ci ko mene ne da aka ajiye a gabanku.
english: Into whatever city you enter and they receive you, eat the things that are set before you.

hausa: Waɗancan mutane suna neman su rinjaye ku da ƙwazo, amma ba da kyakkyawar aniya ba. Abin da suke so shi ne su raba ku da mu, saboda ƙwazonku yă koma gare su.
english: They zealously seek you in no good way. No, they desire to alienate you, that you may seek them.

hausa: Saboda haka aka shirya musu babban liyafa, bayan sun ci, suka kuma sha, sai ya tura su zuwa wurin maigidansu. Ta haka ’yan harin Aram suka daina kai hari a yankin Isra’ila.
english: He prepared a great feast for them. After they ate and drank, he sent them away and they went to their master. So the bands of Syria stopped raiding the land of Israel.

hausa: Amma Musa bai ba wa Kohatawa kome ba, gama aikinsu shi ne lura da kayayyaki masu tsarki waɗanda ake ɗauka a kafaɗa.
english: But to the sons of Kohath he gave none, because the service of the sanctuary belonged to them; they carried it on their shoulders.

hausa: Ya ku zuriyar Isra’ila bayinsa, Ya ku ’ya’yan Yaƙub maza, zaɓaɓɓunsa.
english: you offspring of Israel his servant, you children of Jacob, his chosen ones.

hausa: “ ‘Kada ka yi jima’i da dabba ka ƙazantar da kanka. Mace ba za tă ba da kanta ga dabba don yă yi jima’i da ita ba; wannan abin ƙyama ne.
english: “‘You shall not lie with any animal to defile yourself with it. No woman may give herself to an animal, to lie down with it: it is a perversion.

hausa: Ubangiji ya albarkaci ƙarshen Ayuba fiye da farkonsa. Yana da tumaki guda dubu goma sha huɗu, raƙuma guda dubu shida; shanun noma guda dubu da jakuna guda dubu.
english: So Yahweh blessed the latter end of Job more than his beginning. He had fourteen thousand sheep, six thousand camels, one thousand yoke of oxen, and a thousand female donkeys.

hausa: Saboda haka sarkin Isra’ila ya tattara annabawa, kamar ɗari huɗu, ya tambaye su, “In kai yaƙi a kan Ramot Gileyad, ko kada in kai?” Suka amsa, “Ka tafi, gama Ubangiji zai ba ka ita a hannunka.”
english: Then the king of Israel gathered the prophets together, about four hundred men, and said to them, “Should I go against Ramoth Gilead to battle, or should I refrain?” They said, “Go up; for the Lord will deliver it into the hand of the king.”

hausa: Masu albarka da kuma tsarki ne waɗanda suke da rabo a tashin matattu na farko. Mutuwa ta biyu ba ta da iko a kansu, sai dai za su zama firistocin Allah da kuma na Kiristi za su kuma yi mulki tare da shi na shekaru dubu.
english: Blessed and holy is he who has part in the first resurrection. Over these, the second death has no power, but they will be priests of God and of Christ, and will reign with him one thousand years.

hausa: Yoshuwa kuwa ya cece su daga hannun Isra’ilawa, har ba su kashe su ba.
english: He did so to them, and delivered them out of the hand of the children of Israel, so that they didn’t kill them.

hausa: Zan yabe sunan Allah cikin waƙa in kuma ɗaukaka shi tare wurin yin godiya.
english: I will praise the name of God with a song, and will magnify him with thanksgiving.

hausa: Sa’an nan za su san cewa ni ne Ubangiji Allahnsu, gama ko da yake na tura su zaman bauta a cikin al’ummai, zan tattara su zuwa ƙasarsu, ba tare da barin wani a baya ba.
english: They will know that I am Yahweh their God, in that I caused them to go into captivity among the nations, and have gathered them to their own land. Then I will leave none of them captive any more.

hausa: Sa’an nan Ubangiji zai watsar da ku cikin dukan al’ummai, daga wannan bangon duniya zuwa wancan. A can za ku bauta waɗansu alloli, allolin itace da na dutse, waɗanda ko ku, ko kakanninku, ba ku sani ba.
english: Yahweh will scatter you among all peoples, from one end of the earth to the other end of the earth. There you will serve other gods which you have not known, you nor your fathers, even wood and stone.

hausa: “Fir’auna, shi da dukan sojojinsa, za su gan su zai kuma ta’azantu domin dukan jama’arsa da aka kashe da takobi, in ji Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka.
english: “Pharaoh will see them and will be comforted over all his multitude, even Pharaoh and all his army, slain by the sword,” says the Lord Yahweh.

hausa: Sai Yerobowam ya ƙara gina Shekem a ƙasar tudu ta Efraim, ya zauna a can. Daga can ya tafi ya gina Fenuwel.
english: Then Jeroboam built Shechem in the hill country of Ephraim, and lived in it; and he went out from there and built Penuel.

hausa: Duk wannan ya faru ne, don a cika abin da Ubangiji ya faɗi ta bakin annabin cewa,
english: Now all this has happened that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the Lord through the prophet, saying,

hausa: Mujiya za tă yi sheƙa a can ta zuba ƙwai; za tă ƙyanƙyashe su, ta kuma kula da ’ya’yanta a inuwar fikafikanta; a can kuma shirwa za su taru, kowa da abokinsa.
english: The arrow snake will make her nest there, and lay, hatch, and gather under her shade. Yes, the kites will be gathered there, every one with her mate.

hausa: Ga abin da Ubangiji yana cewa, “Ka gangara zuwa fadan sarkin Yahuda ka yi shelar wannan saƙo a can ka ce,
english: Yahweh said, “Go down to the house of the king of Judah, and speak this word there:

hausa: Kun hukunta kun kuma kashe mutane marasa laifi, waɗanda ba su yi gāba da ku ba.
english: You have condemned and you have murdered the righteous one. He doesn’t resist you.

hausa: To, da yake mun san ko mene tsoron Ubangiji yake, muna ƙoƙari mu rinjaye mutane. Yadda muke kuwa, yana sane a sarari ga Allah, ina kuma fata yana nan a sarari a lamirinku.
english: Knowing therefore the fear of the Lord, we persuade men, but we are revealed to God, and I hope that we are revealed also in your consciences.

hausa: Sa’ad da suke kima kawai, kima sosai, da kuma baƙi a cikinta,
english: when they were but a few men in number, yes, very few, and foreigners in it.

hausa: Fushin Balak ya ƙuna a kan Bala’am. Ya tafa hannunsa, ya ce masa, “Na kira ka don ka la’anta abokan gābana, amma sai ga shi ka sa musu albarka har sau uku.
english: Balak’s anger burned against Balaam, and he struck his hands together. Balak said to Balaam, “I called you to curse my enemies, and, behold, you have altogether blessed them these three times.

hausa: A’a, cikin dukan waɗannan abubuwa mun ma fi masu nasara ta wurin shi wanda ya ƙaunace mu.
english: No, in all these things we are more than conquerors through him who loved us.

hausa: In fa ku ba amintattu ne cikin tafiyar da dukiya ta wannan duniya ba, wa zai amince muku da dukiya ta gaskiya?
english: If therefore you have not been faithful in the unrighteous mammon, who will commit to your trust the true riches?

hausa: Za ki sāke dasa gonakin inabi a kan tussan Samariya; manoma za su yi shuka a kansu su kuma ji daɗin amfaninsu.
english: Again you will plant vineyards on the mountains of Samaria. The planters will plant, and will enjoy its fruit.

hausa: Sa’an nan cikin aminci suka kawo taimako, zakka da keɓaɓɓun kyautai. Konaniya, wani Balawe, shi ne ke lura da waɗannan abubuwa, kuma ɗan’uwansa Shimeyi shi ne na biye da shi.
english: They brought in the offerings, the tithes, and the dedicated things faithfully. Conaniah the Levite was ruler over them, and Shimei his brother was second.

hausa: Na gwammace a shaƙe ni in mutu maimakon in kasance cikin wannan jiki.
english: so that my soul chooses strangling, death rather than my bones.

hausa: Kuna yin haka ne kuwa domin abin da kuke bege yana a ajiye a sama. Kun riga kun ji game da wannan bege sa’ad da kuka gaskata saƙon nan na gaskiya wanda shi ne bisharar
english: because of the hope which is laid up for you in the heavens, of which you heard before in the word of the truth of the Good News

hausa: Zaki ba zai kasance a can ba, balle wani naman jeji mai faɗa ya haura kanta; ba za a same su a can ba. Amma fansassu ne kaɗai za su yi tafiya a can,
english: No lion will be there, nor will any ravenous animal go up on it. They will not be found there; but the redeemed will walk there.

hausa: Waɗanda suka yarda da saƙonsa kuwa aka yi musu baftisma, a ranar kuwa yawansu ya ƙaru da mutum kusan dubu uku.
english: Then those who gladly received his word were baptized. There were added that day about three thousand souls.

hausa: sai ta ga waɗansu mala’iku biyu saye da fararen tufafi, zaune a inda dā gawar Yesu take, ɗaya wajen kai ɗayan kuma wajen ƙafafu.
english: and she saw two angels in white sitting, one at the head and one at the feet, where the body of Jesus had lain.

hausa: Yana yin abubuwan banmamaki waɗanda ba a iya ganewa, mu’ujizai waɗanda ba a iya ƙirgawa.
english: He does great things past finding out; yes, marvelous things without number.

hausa: Ubangiji kuwa ya ce, ‘Wa zai ruɗe Ahab sarki Isra’ila zuwa yaƙi da Ramot Gileyad da kuma zuwa mutuwarsa a can?’ “Wani ya ba da wata shawara, wani kuma wata dabam.
english: Yahweh said, ‘Who will entice Ahab king of Israel, that he may go up and fall at Ramoth Gilead?’ One spoke saying in this way, and another saying in that way.

hausa: sai yă tuna da wannan. Duk wanda ya komo da mai zunubi daga kaucewarsa, zai cece shi daga mutuwa, yă kuma rufe zunubai masu ɗumbun yawa.
english: let him know that he who turns a sinner from the error of his way will save a soul from death and will cover a multitude of sins.

hausa: ku kuma kada ku shiga wata yarjejjeniya da mazaunan ƙasan nan, sai dai za ku rurrushe bagadansu.’ Duk da haka ba ku yi biyayya mini ba. Me ya sa kuka yi haka?
english: You shall make no covenant with the inhabitants of this land. You shall break down their altars.’ But you have not listened to my voice. Why have you done this?

hausa: Na gani na kuma shaida cewa wannan Ɗan Allah ne.”
english: I have seen and have testified that this is the Son of God.”

hausa: Kuma in suka canja zuciya a cikin ƙasar da suke zaman bauta, suka tuba suka roƙe ka a ƙasar zaman bautarsu suka kuma ce, ‘Mun yi zunubi, mu yi abin da ba daidai ba, mu kuwa yi mugunta’;
english: yet if they come to their senses in the land where they are carried captive, and turn again, and make supplication to you in the land of their captivity, saying, ‘We have sinned, we have done perversely, and have dealt wickedly;’

hausa: Ko kuwa wani yana da makami na itace a hannunsa da ya isa yă kashe mutum, ya kuma bugi wani da shi har ya mutu, shi ma mai kisankai ne, sai a kashe mai kisankan nan.
english: Or if he struck him with a weapon of wood in the hand, by which a man may die, and he died, he is a murderer. The murderer shall surely be put to death.

hausa: Ta wurin waɗannan ruwan ne aka nutsar, aka kuma hallakar da duniya ta wancan lokaci.
english: by which means the world that existed then, being overflowed with water, perished.

hausa: Gara ka zama mai haƙuri da ka zama jarumi, ya fi kyau ka iya mallakar kanka fiye da mallakar birane.
english: One who is slow to anger is better than the mighty; one who rules his spirit, than he who takes a city.

hausa: Sai mala’iku bakwai ɗin nan da suke da ƙahoni bakwai suka shirya don su busa su.
english: The seven angels who had the seven trumpets prepared themselves to sound.

hausa: Firistocin kuwa suka fito daga kogin ɗauke da akwatin alkawarin Ubangiji. Nan da nan da ƙafafunsu suka taɓa busasshiyar ƙasa, sai ruwan Urdun ya gangaro ya cika kogin kamar yadda yake a dā.
english: When the priests who bore the ark of Yahweh’s covenant had come up out of the middle of the Jordan, and the soles of the priests’ feet had been lifted up to the dry ground, the waters of the Jordan returned to their place, and went over all its banks, as before.

hausa: Ki shiga wurin Sarki Dawuda ki ce masa, ‘Ranka yă daɗe sarki, ba ka rantse mini ni baiwarka cewa, “Tabbatacce Solomon ɗanka ne zai zama sarki bayana, yă kuma zauna a kujerar sarautar ba”? To, me ya sa Adoniya ya zama sarki?’
english: Go in to King David, and tell him, ‘Didn’t you, my lord the king, swear to your servant, saying, “Assuredly Solomon your son shall reign after me, and he shall sit on my throne”? Why then does Adonijah reign?’

hausa: Ko da yake ƙanƙara za tă fāɗo a jeji, a kuma rurrushe birni gaba ɗaya,
english: though hail flattens the forest, and the city is leveled completely.

hausa: Karin maganar Solomon. Ɗa mai hikima yakan kawo wa mahaifinsa farin ciki, amma wawan ɗa kan sa wa mahaifiyarsa baƙin ciki.
english: The proverbs of Solomon. A wise son makes a glad father; but a foolish son brings grief to his mother.

hausa: Juyo daga mugunta ku yi alheri; nemi salama ku kuma yi ƙoƙarin samunta.
english: Depart from evil, and do good. Seek peace, and pursue it.

hausa: Ku yi bisa ga dokar da suka koyar muku da kuma hukuncin da suka yi muku. Kada ku juya daga abin da suka faɗa muku, ko zuwa dama, ko zuwa hagu.
english: According to the decisions of the law which they shall teach you, and according to the judgment which they shall tell you, you shall do. You shall not turn away from the sentence which they announce to you, to the right hand, nor to the left.

hausa: Ina so ku sani ’yan’uwa cewa na yi shirin zuwa wurinku sau da dama (amma aka hana ni yin haka sai yanzu). Na so in zo domin in sami mutane wa Kiristi a cikinku, kamar yadda na yi a cikin sauran Al’ummai.
english: Now I don’t desire to have you unaware, brothers, that I often planned to come to you (and was hindered so far), that I might have some fruit among you also, even as among the rest of the Gentiles.

hausa: su tambaye shi, “Kai ne wanda zai zo, ko kuwa mu sa ido ga wani?”
english: and said to him, “Are you he who comes, or should we look for another?”

hausa: Abimelek ya je wajen hasumiya ya kuma auka mata. Amma da ya yi kusa da ƙofar hasumiyar don yă cinna mata wuta,
english: Abimelech came to the tower and fought against it, and came near to the door of the tower to burn it with fire.

hausa: Suka yi ta kuka kamar dabbobi a jeji, suka taru a ƙarƙashin sarƙaƙƙiya.
english: They bray among the bushes. They are gathered together under the nettles.

hausa: Ta haka ya kawo su iyakar ƙasa mai tsarki, zuwa ƙasar tudun da hannunsa na dama ya kame.
english: He brought them to the border of his sanctuary, to this mountain, which his right hand had taken.

hausa: Amma in su nake yi, ko ba ku gaskata ni ba, to, ku gaskata ayyukan, don ku sani, ku kuma gane, Uban yana cikina, ni kuma ina cikin Uban.”
english: But if I do them, though you don’t believe me, believe the works, that you may know and believe that the Father is in me, and I in the Father.”

hausa: don kada yă ƙazantar da ’ya’yansa a cikin mutanensa. Ni ne Ubangiji, wanda ya mai da shi mai tsarki.’ ”
english: He shall not profane his offspring among his people, for I am Yahweh who sanctifies him.’”

hausa: Saboda haka ga abin da Ubangiji yana cewa, “In ka tuba, zan maido da kai don ka bauta mini; in ka ambaci maganganu masu kyau, ba marasa kyau ba, za ka zama kakakina. Bari wannan mutane su juyo gare ka, amma kada ka juye gare su.
english: Therefore Yahweh says, “If you return, then I will bring you again, that you may stand before me; and if you take out the precious from the vile, you will be as my mouth. They will return to you, but you will not return to them.

hausa: Mugaye suna satar fili ta wurin matsar da duwatsun da aka yi iyaka da su; suna satar dabbobi su kuma yi kiwon su.
english: There are people who remove the landmarks. They violently take away flocks, and feed them.

hausa: Suka tashi daga Kehelata, suka yi sansani a Dutsen Shefer.
english: They traveled from Kehelathah, and encamped in Mount Shepher.

hausa: Saboda su, dukan masu zaman bauta daga Yahuda waɗanda suke a Babilon za su yi amfani da wannan la’ana cewa, ‘Ubangiji ka yi da mu kamar Zedekiya da Ahab waɗanda sarkin Babilon ya ƙone da wuta.’
english: A curse will be taken up about them by all the captives of Judah who are in Babylon, saying, ‘Yahweh make you like Zedekiah and like Ahab, whom the king of Babylon roasted in the fire;’

hausa: Ubangiji ya ce wa Musa da Haruna,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying to them,

hausa: Sai ya karɓi abubuwan da suka ba shi, ya yi gunki na siffar ɗan maraƙi, ya sassaƙa shi da kayan aiki. Sa’ad da mutane suka gani, sai suka tā da murya suka ce, “Waɗannan su ne allolinku, ya Isra’ila, waɗanda suka fitar da ku daga Masar.”
english: He received what they handed him, fashioned it with an engraving tool, and made it a molded calf. Then they said, “These are your gods, Israel, which brought you up out of the land of Egypt.”

hausa: Wanne ya fi sauƙi, a ce wa shanyayyen, ‘An gafarta zunubanka,’ ko a ce, ‘Tashi, ɗauki tabarmarka ka yi tafiya’?
english: Which is easier, to tell the paralytic, ‘Your sins are forgiven;’ or to say, ‘Arise, and take up your bed, and walk’?

hausa: Maganar Ubangiji ta sāke zuwa mini cewa,
english: Moreover Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

hausa: Manomi yakan shuka maganar Allah.
english: The farmer sows the word.

hausa: Kun shuka da yawa, amma kun girbe kaɗan. Kun ci, amma ba ku ƙoshi ba. Kun sha, amma ba ku kashe ƙishirwa ba. Kun sa tufafi, amma ba ku ji ɗumi ba. Kuna karɓar albashi, ya zama sai ka ce kuna zuba a hudajjen aljihu.”
english: You have sown much, and bring in little. You eat, but you don’t have enough. You drink, but you aren’t filled with drink. You clothe yourselves, but no one is warm; and he who earns wages earns wages to put them into a bag with holes in it.’

hausa: Ya naɗa manyan hafsoshi a kan mutane, ya tattara su a gabansa a fili a ƙofar birni, ya kuma ƙarfafa su da waɗannan kalmomi.
english: He set captains of war over the people, gathered them together to him in the wide place at the gate of the city, and spoke encouragingly to them, saying,

hausa: To, fa, Filistiyawa suka tattara mayaƙansu suka haɗu a Soko cikin Yahuda domin yaƙi. Suka yi sansani a Efes-Dammim, tsakanin Soko da Azeka.
english: Now the Philistines gathered together their armies to battle; and they were gathered together at Socoh, which belongs to Judah, and encamped between Socoh and Azekah in Ephesdammim.

hausa: Sa’ad da kuka shiga ƙasar da Ubangiji Allahnku yake ba ku gādo, kuka mallake ta, kuka kuma zauna a cikinta,
english: It shall be, when you have come in to the land which Yahweh your God gives you for an inheritance, possess it, and dwell in it,

hausa: Yesu ya amsa musu ya ce, “Ku rushe wannan haikali, zan kuwa sāke tā da shi cikin kwana uku.”
english: Jesus answered them, “Destroy this temple, and in three days I will raise it up.”

hausa: Koyarwarsu za tă bazu kamar ruɓaɓɓen gyambo. A cikinsu akwai Himenayus da Filetus,
english: and those words will consume like gangrene, of whom is Hymenaeus and Philetus:

hausa: Kakan ceci mai tawali’u, amma idanunka suna a kan masu girman kai don ka ƙasƙantar da su.
english: You will save the afflicted people, but your eyes are on the arrogant, that you may bring them down.

hausa: “Fāɗuwar Mowab ta yi kusa; bala’inta zai auku nan da nan.
english: “The calamity of Moab is near to come, and his affliction hurries fast.

hausa: Shi ne Allahn da yake rama mini, wanda ya sa al’ummai a ƙarƙashina,
english: even the God who executes vengeance for me, who brings down peoples under me,

hausa: Sai su biyun nan suka ba da labarin abin da ya faru a hanya, da kuma yadda suka gane Yesu yayinda ya kakkarya burodin.
english: They related the things that happened along the way, and how he was recognized by them in the breaking of the bread.

hausa: Ku tafi wurin kyashi, ku ragwaye; ku lura da hanyoyinsa ku zama masu hikima!
english: Go to the ant, you sluggard. Consider her ways, and be wise;

hausa: Saboda haka Hatak ya tafi wurin Mordekai a dandalin birni, a gaban ƙofar sarki.
english: So Hathach went out to Mordecai, to the city square which was before the king’s gate.

hausa: Zan ba wa abokan gābansu dukan dukiyar wannan birni dukan amfaninsa, dukan abubuwa masu daraja na sarakunan Yahuda. Za su kwashe su ganima su kai su Babilon.
english: Moreover I will give all the riches of this city, and all its gains, and all its precious things, yes, I will give all the treasures of the kings of Judah into the hand of their enemies. They will make them captives, take them, and carry them to Babylon.

hausa: A haɗa da bunsuru guda a matsayin hadaya, don zunubi, ban da hadaya ta ƙonawa ta kullum, tare da hadayarta ta gari da hadayunsu ta sha.
english: and one male goat for a sin offering, in addition to the continual burnt offering, with its meal offering and their drink offerings.

hausa: Da fari almajiransa ba su gane dukan wannan ba. Sai bayan da aka ɗaukaka Yesu, sa’an nan suka gane cewa an rubuta waɗannan abubuwa game da shi ne, har ma suka yi masa waɗannan abubuwa.
english: His disciples didn’t understand these things at first, but when Jesus was glorified, then they remembered that these things were written about him, and that they had done these things to him.

hausa: Suna sāka alherin da na yi musu da mugunta suka bar raina da nadama.
english: They reward me evil for good, to the bereaving of my soul.

hausa: Ubangiji mai alheri ne ga waɗanda suke da bege a cikinsa, ga kuma wanda yake neman shi;
english: Yahweh is good to those who wait for him, to the soul who seeks him.

hausa: Bari teku da kome da yake cikinsa su yi ruri; bari gonaki da kome a cikinsu su yi farin ciki!
english: Let the sea roar, and its fullness! Let the field exult, and all that is in it!

hausa: Suka tashi daga Etam, suka koma baya zuwa Fi Hahirot, wajen gabashin Ba’al-Zafon, suka yi sansani kusa da Migdol.
english: They traveled from Etham, and turned back to Pihahiroth, which is before Baal Zephon, and they encamped before Migdol.

hausa: Wannan shi ne tsarin tafiyar ɓangarorin Isra’ilawa, sa’ad da sukan kama hanya.
english: Thus were the travels of the children of Israel according to their armies; and they went forward.

hausa: Bayan kuma a jefa ta cikin wuta, wuta kuma ta cinye kowane gefe ta kuma babbaka tsakiyarta, tana da amfani don yin wani abu kuma?
english: Behold, it is cast into the fire for fuel; the fire has devoured both its ends, and the middle of it is burned. Is it profitable for any work?

hausa: Sai dattawa da manyan gari, waɗanda suke zama a birnin da Nabot yake, suka yi kamar yadda Yezebel ta umarta a cikin wasiƙun da ta rubuta.
english: The men of his city, even the elders and the nobles who lived in his city, did as Jezebel had instructed them in the letters which she had written and sent to them.

hausa: Mai albarka ne mutumin da bai yi shakkar bangaskiyar da yake da ita a kaina ba.”
english: Blessed is he who finds no occasion for stumbling in me.”

hausa: Kedemot da kuma Mefa’at, tare da wuraren kiwonsu, garuruwa huɗu ke nan;
english: Kedemoth with its pasture lands, and Mephaath with its pasture lands: four cities.

hausa: Da sassafe, sai manyan firistoci da dattawa, da malaman dokoki, da dukan Majalisa, suka yanke shawara. Suka daure Yesu, suka kai shi, suka miƙa shi ga Bilatus.
english: Immediately in the morning the chief priests, with the elders, scribes, and the whole council, held a consultation, bound Jesus, carried him away, and delivered him up to Pilate.

hausa: da shanu biyu, raguna biyar, bunsurai biyar da kuma ’yan raguna biyar, dukansu bana ɗaya-ɗaya, a miƙa su hadaya ta salama. Wannan ita ce hadayar Elizur ɗan Shedeyur.
english: and for the sacrifice of peace offerings, two head of cattle, five rams, five male goats, and five male lambs a year old. This was the offering of Elizur the son of Shedeur.

hausa: Amma ku zuba ido ku ga in ya haura zuwa yankinsa, zuwa Bet-Shemesh, to, Ubangiji ne ya kawo mana babban masifar a kanmu. Amma in bai bi ta nan ba, za mu san cewa ba shi ne ya buge mu ba, tsautsayi ne kawai.”
english: Behold, if it goes up by the way of its own border to Beth Shemesh, then he has done us this great evil; but if not, then we shall know that it is not his hand that struck us. It was a chance that happened to us.”

hausa: Ka zauna a wannan ƙasa na ɗan lokaci, zan kuwa kasance tare da kai, zan kuma albarkace ka. Gama zan ba da waɗannan ƙasashe gare ka da kuma zuriyarka. Zan kuma cika rantsuwar da na yi wa mahaifinka Ibrahim.
english: Live in this land, and I will be with you, and will bless you. For I will give to you, and to your offspring, all these lands, and I will establish the oath which I swore to Abraham your father.

hausa: Gama dukan allolin al’ummai gumaka ne, amma Ubangiji ne ya yi sammai.
english: For all the gods of the peoples are idols, but Yahweh made the heavens.

hausa: Don me ka yi masa gunaguni cewa ba ya amsa tambayoyin mutum?
english: Why do you strive against him, because he doesn’t give account of any of his matters?

hausa: Kogin Kishon ya kwashe su, tsohon kogi, kogin Kishon. Ci gaba raina; ka ƙarfafa!
english: The river Kishon swept them away, that ancient river, the river Kishon. My soul, march on with strength.

hausa: Ya tambaye su ya ce, “Me kuke so in yi muku?”
english: He said to them, “What do you want me to do for you?”

hausa: Duk wanda yake jin kunyana da na kalmomina, Ɗan Mutum ma zai ji kunyarsa sa’ad da zai zo a cikin ɗaukakarsa, da ɗaukakar Uban, da kuma ta tsarkaka mala’ikun.
english: For whoever will be ashamed of me and of my words, of him will the Son of Man be ashamed when he comes in his glory, and the glory of the Father, and of the holy angels.

hausa: Ya amsa ya ce, “Ya kamata, mutumin da yake da riguna biyu, yă raba da wanda ba shi da riga, mai abinci kuma yă yi haka.”
english: He answered them, “He who has two coats, let him give to him who has none. He who has food, let him do likewise.”

hausa: Eli ya ji ihun ya yi tambaya ya ce, mene ne dalilin wannan ihu? Mutumin ya rugo wurin Eli,
english: When Eli heard the noise of the crying, he said, “What does the noise of this tumult mean?” The man hurried, and came and told Eli.

hausa: Samariya da sarkinta za su ɓace kamar kumfa a bisa ruwaye.
english: Samaria and her king float away like a twig on the water.

hausa: Ya Ubangiji, ka ga wannan; kada ka yi shiru. Kada ka yi nisa da ni, ya Ubangiji.
english: You have seen it, Yahweh. Don’t keep silent. Lord, don’t be far from me.

hausa: “Yi magana da Isra’ilawa, ka ce musu, ‘In matar wani ta kauce, ta kuma yi rashin aminci gare shi
english: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them: ‘If any man’s wife goes astray and is unfaithful to him,

hausa: sai na yi tunani cewa, ‘Yanzu Filistiyawa za su gangaro su fāɗa mini a Gilgal, ga ni kuma ban riga na nemi nufin Ubangiji ba.’ Shi ya sa ya zama mini tilas in miƙa hadaya ta ƙonawa.”
english: therefore I said, ‘Now the Philistines will come down on me to Gilgal, and I haven’t entreated the favor of Yahweh.’ I forced myself therefore, and offered the burnt offering.”

hausa: Ka tafi, ka yi shelar saƙon nan wajen arewa cewa, “ ‘Ki komo, Isra’ila marar bangaskiya,’ in ji Ubangiji, ‘Ba zan ƙara yin fushi da ke ba, gama ni mai jinƙai ne,’ in ji Ubangiji, ‘Ba zan yi fushi da ke har abada ba.
english: Go, and proclaim these words toward the north, and say, ‘Return, you backsliding Israel,’ says Yahweh; ‘I will not look in anger on you, for I am merciful,’ says Yahweh. ‘I will not keep anger forever.

hausa: Ubangiji ya ce wa Musa da Haruna,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,

hausa: Ruhun gaskiya. Duniya ba ta iya karɓarsa, don ba ta ganinsa ba ta kuma san shi ba. Amma kun san shi, saboda yana zama tare da ku zai kuma kasance a cikinku.
english: the Spirit of truth, whom the world can’t receive, for it doesn’t see him and doesn’t know him. You know him, for he lives with you and will be in you.

hausa: to, kada mijinta na farko, wanda ya sake ta yă sāke aurenta, tun da yake ta ƙazantu. Wannan zai zama abin ƙyama a gaban Ubangiji. Kada ku kawo zunubi a ƙasar da Ubangiji Allahnku yake ba ku gādo.
english: her former husband, who sent her away, may not take her again to be his wife after she is defiled; for that would be an abomination to Yahweh. You shall not cause the land to sin, which Yahweh your God gives you for an inheritance.

hausa: ’Ya’yan Yafet maza su ne, Gomer, Magog, Madai da Yaban, Tubal, Meshek, da kuma Tiras.
english: The sons of Japheth were: Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshech, and Tiras.

hausa: Duk da haka sa’ad da suke ciwo, na sanya rigar makoki na ƙasƙantar da kaina da azumi. Sa’ad da aka mayar mini da addu’o’i babu amsa,
english: But as for me, when they were sick, my clothing was sackcloth. I afflicted my soul with fasting. My prayer returned into my own bosom.

hausa: Da jin haka sai suka ɗebo duwatsu don su jajjefe shi, amma Yesu ya ɓuya, ya fita daga filin haikali.
english: Therefore they took up stones to throw at him, but Jesus hid himself and went out of the temple, having gone through the middle of them, and so passed by.

hausa: Na cuce ku ne ta wurin wani daga cikin waɗanda na aiko a gare ku?
english: Did I take advantage of you by anyone of those whom I have sent to you?

hausa: Wannan magana da nake gaya muku asiri ne da yake a ɓoye tun zamanai masu yawa, wanda yanzu aka bayyana ga tsarkaka.
english: the mystery which has been hidden for ages and generations. But now it has been revealed to his saints,

hausa: Ma’aikatan haikali sun zauna a kan tudun Ofel. Ziha, da Gishfa ne suke lura da su.
english: But the temple servants lived in Ophel; and Ziha and Gishpa were over the temple servants.

hausa: Sojojin suka yi niyya su kakkashe ’yan kurkukun don hana waninsu yă yi iyo yă tsere.
english: The soldiers’ counsel was to kill the prisoners, so that none of them would swim out and escape.

hausa: Ban ba mace izini ta koyar ko tă yi mulki a kan namiji ba; sai dai ta zauna shiru.
english: But I don’t permit a woman to teach, nor to exercise authority over a man, but to be in quietness.

hausa: a madadin mutum ya yi roƙo ga Allah kamar yadda mutum yakan yi roƙo domin abokinsa.
english: that he would maintain the right of a man with God, of a son of man with his neighbor!

hausa: ko kuwa bai gan shi ba, ya jefa dutsen da zai kashe shi a kansa, ya kuwa mutu, to, da yake shi ba abokin gābansa ba ne, bai kuma yi nufi yă ji masa ba,
english: or with any stone, by which a man may die, not seeing him, and cast it on him so that he died, and he was not his enemy and not seeking his harm,

hausa: Za tă zama mallakar raguwar gidan Yahuda; a can za su sami wurin kiwo. Da yamma za su kwanta a gidajen Ashkelon. Ubangiji Allahnsu zai lura da su; zai maido musu da martabarsu.
english: The coast will be for the remnant of the house of Judah. They will find pasture. In the houses of Ashkelon, they will lie down in the evening, for Yahweh, their God, will visit them and restore them.

hausa: Sa’an nan Musa ya fita tare da Yoshuwa mataimakinsa, ya kuwa hau kan dutsen Allah.
english: Moses rose up with Joshua, his servant, and Moses went up onto God’s Mountain.

hausa: mutumin ya kamu da cutar kuma marar tsarki ne. Firist ɗin zai furta mutumin marar tsarki saboda mikin da yake a kansa.
english: he is a leprous man. He is unclean. The priest shall surely pronounce him unclean. His plague is on his head.

hausa: na bakwai a kan Hakkoz, na takwas a kan Abiya,
english: the seventh to Hakkoz, the eighth to Abijah,

hausa: “Amma mutanena ba su saurare ni ba; Isra’ila bai miƙa kansa gare ni ba.
english: But my people didn’t listen to my voice. Israel desired none of me.

hausa: “Amma ka yi alheri ga ’ya’yan Barzillai mutumin Gileyad, ka sa su kasance a cikin waɗanda suke ci a teburinka. Sun goyi bayana sa’ad da nake gudu daga ɗan’uwanka Absalom.
english: But show kindness to the sons of Barzillai the Gileadite, and let them be among those who eat at your table; for so they came to me when I fled from Absalom your brother.

hausa: Ezekiyel zai zama alama gare ku; za ku yi daidai yadda ya yi. Sa’ad da wannan ya faru, za ku san cewa ni ne Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka.’
english: Thus Ezekiel will be a sign to you; according to all that he has done, you will do. When this comes, then you will know that I am the Lord Yahweh.’”’”

hausa: Ka cece ni ka kuma kuɓutar da ni daga hannuwan baƙi waɗanda bakunansu sun cika da ƙarya, waɗanda hannuwansu na dama masu ruɗu ne.
english: Rescue me, and deliver me out of the hands of foreigners, whose mouths speak deceit, whose right hand is a right hand of falsehood.

hausa: ƙasar Keniyawa, Kenizziyawa, Kadmoniyawa,
english: the land of the Kenites, the Kenizzites, the Kadmonites,

hausa: Amma ni dai tsutsa ne ba mutum ba, wanda mutane suke yi wa ba’a suka kuma rena shi.
english: But I am a worm, and no man; a reproach of men, and despised by the people.

hausa: A ranar shari’a, za a fi jin tausayin Taya da Sidon fiye da ku.
english: But it will be more tolerable for Tyre and Sidon in the judgment than for you.

hausa: Saboda haka Irmiya ya tafi wurin Gedaliya ɗan Ahikam, a Mizfa ya zauna tare da shi a cikin mutanen da aka bari a ƙasar.
english: Then Jeremiah went to Gedaliah the son of Ahikam to Mizpah, and lived with him among the people who were left in the land.

hausa: Mutane suka ci burodin mala’iku; ya aika musu dukan abincin da za su iya ci.
english: Man ate the bread of angels. He sent them food to the full.

hausa: Ubangiji zai nuna hannunsa mai tsarki a fili a idanun dukan al’ummai, da kuma dukan iyakokin duniya za su gani ceton Allahnmu.
english: Yahweh has made his holy arm bare in the eyes of all the nations. All the ends of the earth have seen the salvation of our God.

hausa: Jin tsoron mutum tarko ne, amma duk wanda ya dogara ga Ubangiji zai zauna lafiya.
english: The fear of man proves to be a snare, but whoever puts his trust in Yahweh is kept safe.

hausa: A can filayen Mowab, suka yi sansani kusa da Urdun ɗaura da Bet-Yeshimot har zuwa Abel-Shittim.
english: They encamped by the Jordan, from Beth Jeshimoth even to Abel Shittim in the plains of Moab.

hausa: ku waɗanda kuke hidima a gidan Ubangiji, cikin filayen gidan Allahnmu.
english: you who stand in Yahweh’s house, in the courts of our God’s house.

hausa: Sai Irmiya ya ce wa dukan mutanen, maza da mata, waɗanda suke ba shi amsa,
english: Then Jeremiah said to all the people—to the men and to the women, even to all the people who had given him an answer, saying,

hausa: amma kana ba mu nasara a kan abokan gābanmu, ka sa abokan gābanmu suka sha kunya.
english: But you have saved us from our adversaries, and have shamed those who hate us.

hausa: da duk kuma wanda ya taɓa wani abu mai rarrafe wanda yake ƙazantarwa, ko kuwa wani mutum mai ƙazanta,
english: or whoever touches any creeping thing by which he may be made unclean, or a man from whom he may become unclean, whatever uncleanness he has—

hausa: Duk haka, wanda aka koya wa maganar Kiristi, bari yă raba abubuwan nan na alheri tare da wanda ya koyar da shi.
english: But let him who is taught in the word share all good things with him who teaches.

hausa: To, akwai wani mutum a Urushalima mai suna Siman, shi mai adalci da kuma mai ibada. Yana jiran fansar Isra’ila, Ruhu Mai Tsarki kuwa yana tare da shi.
english: Behold, there was a man in Jerusalem whose name was Simeon. This man was righteous and devout, looking for the consolation of Israel, and the Holy Spirit was on him.

hausa: “ ‘To, fa, ga zunubin ’yar’uwarki Sodom. Ita da ’ya’yanta mata sun yi girman kai, sun ƙoshi fiye da kima kuma ba su kula da wani abu ba; ba su taimaki matalauta da kuma masu bukata ba.
english: “‘“Behold, this was the iniquity of your sister Sodom: pride, fullness of bread, and prosperous ease was in her and in her daughters. She also didn’t strengthen the hand of the poor and needy.

hausa: Da jin haka, waɗanda suka ji sai suka fara tashi daga wurin ɗaya-ɗaya, tun daga babbansu har ya zuwa ƙaraminsu, sai da aka bar Yesu kaɗai, tare da macen tsaye a wurin.
english: They, when they heard it, being convicted by their conscience, went out one by one, beginning from the oldest, even to the last. Jesus was left alone with the woman where she was, in the middle.

hausa: Ceto yana nesa da mugaye, gama ba sa neman ƙa’idodinka.
english: Salvation is far from the wicked, for they don’t seek your statutes.

hausa: A shekarun baya Dawuda ya ci Edom da yaƙi. Yowab, shugaban sojojinsa ya tafi can domin yă binne Isra’ilawa waɗanda suka mutu a yaƙi. Sa’ad da suke a can, sojojin Isra’ila suka kashe kowane ɗa namiji a Edom.
english: For when David was in Edom, and Joab the captain of the army had gone up to bury the slain, and had struck every male in Edom

hausa: duk da haka zan yi farin ciki da Ubangiji, zan yi murna da Allah Mai Cetona.
english: yet I will rejoice in Yahweh. I will be joyful in the God of my salvation!

hausa: Da Dawuda ya ga mala’ikan da ya bubbugi mutane, sai ya ce wa Ubangiji, “Ni ne na yi zunubi, na kuma yi abin da ba daidai ba. Waɗannan tumaki ne kawai. Me suka yi? Bari hukuncinka yă sauko a kaina da iyalina.”
english: David spoke to Yahweh when he saw the angel who struck the people, and said, “Behold, I have sinned, and I have done perversely; but these sheep, what have they done? Please let your hand be against me, and against my father’s house.”

hausa: Sai ɗayansu ya ce, “Ba za ka zo tare da bayinka ba?” Sai Elisha ya ce “Zan zo.”
english: One said, “Please be pleased to go with your servants.” He answered, “I will go.”

hausa: Ishaku ya tambayi ɗansa, “Yaya aka yi ka samo shi da sauri haka, ɗana?” Yaƙub ya amsa ya ce, “Ubangiji Allahnka ne ya ba ni nasara.”
english: Isaac said to his son, “How is it that you have found it so quickly, my son?” He said, “Because Yahweh your God gave me success.”

hausa: Gwanin mai saƙa ya saƙa abin ɗamarar efod. Da irin kayan da aka saƙa efod ne aka saƙa abin ɗamarar, wato, da zinariya, da shuɗi, da shunayya, da jan zare, da zaren lallausan lilin, yadda Ubangiji ya umarci Musa.
english: The skillfully woven band that was on it, with which to fasten it on, was of the same piece, like its work: of gold, of blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen, as Yahweh commanded Moses.

hausa: Saboda haka, fushina mai ƙuna ya fāɗo a kan garuruwan Yahuda da kuma titunan Urushalima na kuma mai da su kufai da suke a yau.
english: Therefore my wrath and my anger was poured out, and was kindled in the cities of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem; and they are wasted and desolate, as it is today.’

hausa: Zan aika da yunwa da namun jeji a kanki, za su kuma bar ku ba ’ya’ya. Annoba da zub da jini za su ratsa cikinki, zan kuma kawo takobi a kanki. Ni Ubangiji na faɗa.”
english: I will send on you famine and evil animals, and they will bereave you. Pestilence and blood will pass through you. I will bring the sword on you. I, Yahweh, have spoken it.’”

hausa: Ka hori yaro a hanyar da ya kamata yă bi, kuma sa’ad da ya tsufa ba zai bar ta ba.
english: Train up a child in the way he should go, and when he is old he will not depart from it.

hausa: Ya yi zancen mahaifinsa da mahaifiyarsa ya ce, ‘Ban kula da su ba.’ Bai gane da ’yan’uwansa ba, ko yă yarda da ’ya’yansa, amma ya kiyaye maganarka ya tsare alkawarinka.
english: He said of his father, and of his mother, ‘I have not seen him.’ He didn’t acknowledge his brothers, nor did he know his own children; for they have observed your word, and keep your covenant.

hausa: Sa’an nan ya ce musu, “Yanzu ku ɗiba ku kai wa uban bikin.” Suka yi haka.
english: He said to them, “Now draw some out, and take it to the ruler of the feast.” So they took it.

hausa: Sai Marta ta ce wa Yesu, “Ubangiji, da kana nan da ɗan’uwana bai mutu ba.
english: Therefore Martha said to Jesus, “Lord, if you would have been here, my brother wouldn’t have died.

hausa: Amma gashi kansa ya fara tohuwa kuma bayan an aske shi.
english: However, the hair of his head began to grow again after he was shaved.

hausa: Allahna ya aiko da mala’ikansa, ya kuwa rufe bakunan zakoki. Ba su yi mini rauni ba, gama an same ni marar laifi ne a gabansa. Ban kuwa taɓa yin wani abu marar kyau a gabanka ba, ya sarki.”
english: My God has sent his angel, and has shut the lions’ mouths, and they have not hurt me, because innocence was found in me before him; and also before you, O king, I have done no harm.”

hausa: A rana ta bakwai ɗin firist zai bincike shi, in kuma cutar tana yaɗuwa a cikin fatar jikin, firist ɗin zai furta shi marar tsarki, cutar fatar jiki ce mai yaɗuwa.
english: The priest shall examine him on the seventh day. If it has spread in the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean. It is the plague of leprosy.

hausa: Mu masu tarayya ne da Kiristi idan mun riƙe bangaskiyarmu da ƙarfi daga farko har zuwa ƙarshe.
english: For we have become partakers of Christ, if we hold the beginning of our confidence firm to the end,

hausa: “Sabon umarni nake ba ku. Ku ƙaunaci juna. Kamar yadda na ƙaunace ku, ku ma ku ƙaunaci juna.
english: A new commandment I give to you, that you love one another. Just as I have loved you, you also love one another.

hausa: Za su aske kawunansu saboda ke za su kuma sa tufafin makoki. Za su yi kuka dominki su yi ɓacin rai da kuma kuka mai zafi.
english: They will make themselves bald for you, and clothe themselves with sackcloth. They will weep for you in bitterness of soul, with bitter mourning.

hausa: Gaskiya nake faɗa maka, sa’ad da kake saurayi kakan yi wa kanka sutura ka tafi inda ka so; amma sa’ad da ka tsufa za ka miƙa hannuwanka, wani dabam yă yi maka sutura yă kai ka inda ba ka so.”
english: Most certainly I tell you, when you were young, you dressed yourself and walked where you wanted to. But when you are old, you will stretch out your hands, and another will dress you and carry you where you don’t want to go.”

hausa: “Amma yanzu, ya Ubangiji, me zan nema? Begena yana a gare ka.
english: Now, Lord, what do I wait for? My hope is in you.

hausa: Aka faɗa musu kada su yi wa ciyawa na duniya lahani ko wani tsiro ko itace, sai dai su yi wa mutanen da ba su da hatimin Allah a goshinsu kaɗai lahani.
english: They were told that they should not hurt the grass of the earth, neither any green thing, neither any tree, but only those people who don’t have God’s seal on their foreheads.

hausa: Idan za a rama wa Kayinu har sau bakwai, lalle za a rama wa Lamek sau saba’in da bakwai ke nan.”
english: If Cain will be avenged seven times, truly Lamech seventy-seven times.”

hausa: “Ubana ya danƙa mini dukan kome. Ba wanda ya san Ɗan sai Uban, kuma ba wanda ya san Uban, sai Ɗan, da kuma waɗanda Ɗan ya zaɓa ya bayyana musu shi.”
english: Turning to the disciples, he said, “All things have been delivered to me by my Father. No one knows who the Son is, except the Father, and who the Father is, except the Son, and he to whomever the Son desires to reveal him.”

hausa: Gama a wannan rana kowannenku zai ƙi gumakan azurfa da zinariya da hannuwanku masu zunubi suka yi.
english: For in that day everyone shall cast away his idols of silver and his idols of gold—sin which your own hands have made for you.

hausa: ’Yan’uwana, waɗansu daga iyalin gidan Kulos sun gaya mini cewa, akwai faɗa a cikinku.
english: For it has been reported to me concerning you, my brothers, by those who are from Chloe’s household, that there are contentions among you.

hausa: Ku zama masu kamunkai, ku kuma zauna a faɗake. Abokin gābanku, Iblis yana kewayewa kamar zaki mai ruri, yana neman wanda zai cinye.
english: Be sober and self-controlled. Be watchful. Your adversary, the devil, walks around like a roaring lion, seeking whom he may devour.

hausa: Yesu ya ce, “Ba kowa ba ne zai yarda da wannan magana, sai dai waɗanda aka yarda musu.
english: But he said to them, “Not all men can receive this saying, but those to whom it is given.

hausa: Wannan Rai ya bayyana, muka kuwa gan shi, muka kuma shaida shi, muna kuwa yin muku shelar wannan rai madawwami, wanda dā yake tare da Uba, ya kuma bayyana a gare mu.
english: (and the life was revealed, and we have seen, and testify, and declare to you the life, the eternal life, which was with the Father, and was revealed to us);

hausa: Sai na faɗa mata, “Za ki zauna tare da ni kwanaki masu yawa; kada ki yi karuwanci ko ki yi abuta da wani namiji, ni kuwa zan zauna tare da ke.”
english: I said to her, “You shall stay with me many days. You shall not play the prostitute, and you shall not be with any other man. I will also be so toward you.”

hausa: Da fadawan sarki Hezekiya suka isa wurin Ishaya,
english: So the servants of King Hezekiah came to Isaiah.

hausa: Sai ya cire bagaden tagulla wanda aka keɓe ga Ubangiji, ya sa shi a gaban haikalin wato, tsakanin ƙofar shiga haikalin Ubangiji da sabon bagaden. Ya ajiye shi a gefen arewa na sabon bagaden.
english: The bronze altar, which was before Yahweh, he brought from the front of the house, from between his altar and Yahweh’s house, and put it on the north side of his altar.

hausa: Wannan ya faru ne domin ba su yi biyayya ga Ubangiji Allahnsu ba, amma suka karya alkawarinsu; da dukan abin da Musa bawan Ubangiji ya umarta. Ba su saurari umarnin ba, balle su kiyaye su.
english: because they didn’t obey Yahweh their God’s voice, but transgressed his covenant, even all that Moses the servant of Yahweh commanded, and would not hear it or do it.

hausa: Yayinda Isra’ila yana zama a wancan yanki, Ruben ya shiga ya kwana da Bilha ƙwarƙwarar mahaifinsa, Isra’ila kuwa ya ji labari. Yaƙub ya haifi ’ya’ya maza goma sha biyu.
english: While Israel lived in that land, Reuben went and lay with Bilhah, his father’s concubine, and Israel heard of it. Now the sons of Jacob were twelve.

hausa: “Amma in ba ku yi haka ba, kun yi zunubi ke nan ga Ubangiji; kuma ku san cewa zunubinku zai tone ku.
english: “But if you will not do so, behold, you have sinned against Yahweh; and be sure your sin will find you out.

hausa: Kafin in zo, ka ci gaba da karanta wa mutane Nassi, da yin wa’azi, da kuma koyarwa.
english: Until I come, pay attention to reading, to exhortation, and to teaching.

hausa: Wannan shi ne abin da Ubangiji ya umarta, ‘Kowane mutum zai tattara bisa ga bukatarsa. Ku tara rabin gallon don mutum guda da yake cikin tentinku.’ ”
english: This is the thing which Yahweh has commanded: ‘Gather of it everyone according to his eating; an omer a head, according to the number of your persons, you shall take it, every man for those who are in his tent.’”

hausa: Sa’ad da ka hau bisa, ka bi da kamammu cikin tawagarka; ka karɓi kyautai daga mutane, har ma daga ’yan tawaye, don kai, ya Ubangiji Allah, za ka zauna a can.
english: You have ascended on high. You have led away captives. You have received gifts among people, yes, among the rebellious also, that Yah God might dwell there.

hausa: Ga yadda aka yi dakalan, dakalan suna da ɓangarori haɗe da mahaɗai.
english: The work of the bases was like this: they had panels; and there were panels between the ledges;

hausa: Sai Bilatus ya koma cikin fada, ya kira Yesu ya tambaye shi, “Shin, kai ne sarkin Yahudawa?”
english: Pilate therefore entered again into the Praetorium, called Jesus, and said to him, “Are you the King of the Jews?”

hausa: Yehohiyakim yana da shekara ashirin da biyar sa’ad da ya zama sarki, ya kuma yi mulki shekara goma sha ɗaya a Urushalima. Sunan mahaifiyarsa Zebuda ’yar Fedahiya, mutuniyar Ruma.
english: Jehoiakim was twenty-five years old when he began to reign, and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Zebidah the daughter of Pedaiah of Rumah.

hausa: Ka sa yă tsaya a gaban Eleyazar firist, da gaban dukan jama’a, sa’an nan ka keɓe shi a gabansu.
english: Set him before Eleazar the priest, and before all the congregation; and commission him in their sight.

hausa: wurin ajiye fitilu na zinariya zalla, da jerin fitilunsa da dukan kayayyakinsa, da man fitila,
english: the pure lamp stand, its lamps, even the lamps to be set in order, all its vessels, the oil for the light,

hausa: Allah ya kuma ce wa Musa, “Ka faɗa wa Isra’ilawa, ‘Ubangiji, Allah na kakanninka, Allah na Ibrahim, Allah na Ishaku da kuma Allah na Yaƙub, ya aiko ni wurinku.’ Wannan shi ne sunana har abada, sunan da za a tuna da ni daga tsara zuwa tsara ke nan.
english: God said moreover to Moses, “You shall tell the children of Israel this, ‘Yahweh, the God of your fathers, the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob, has sent me to you.’ This is my name forever, and this is my memorial to all generations.

hausa: Yayinda Sarki Dawuda ya kusato Bahurim, sai ga wani mutumin dangin Shawulu ya fito daga can, sunansa Shimeyi ɗan Gera. Ya fito yana ta la’anta yayinda yake fitowa.
english: When King David came to Bahurim, behold, a man of the family of Saul’s house came out, whose name was Shimei, the son of Gera. He came out and cursed as he came.

hausa: Saboda haka ku, ya al’ummai; ku lura Ya shaidu, abin da zai faru da su.
english: Therefore hear, you nations, and know, congregation, what is among them.

hausa: ku kanku kun ga dukan abubuwan da Ubangiji Allahnku ya yi da idanunku wa dukan ƙasashen nan, Ubangiji Allahnku shi ne wanda ya yi yaƙi dominku.
english: You have seen all that Yahweh your God has done to all these nations because of you; for it is Yahweh your God who has fought for you.

hausa: Ku rera gare shi, ku rera yabo gare shi; ku faɗa dukan abubuwan mamakin da ya aikata.
english: Sing to him, sing praises to him! Tell of all his marvelous works.

hausa: kafin ƙayyadadden lokacin nan yă zo ranan nan kuma ta share ku kamar ƙaiƙayi kuma kafin fushi mai tsanani na Ubangiji yă auko muku, kafin ranar fushin Ubangiji ta auko muku.
english: before the appointed time when the day passes as the chaff, before the fierce anger of Yahweh comes on you, before the day of Yahweh’s anger comes on you.

hausa: ya kuma bi shawarar matasan ya ce, “Mahaifina ya sa muku kaya masu nauyi; zan ma sa mafi nauyi. Mahaifina ya bulale ku da bulala; zan bulale ku da kunamai.”
english: and spoke to them after the counsel of the young men, saying, “My father made your yoke heavy, but I will add to it. My father chastised you with whips, but I will chastise you with scorpions.”

hausa: Su ba na duniya ba ne, kamar yadda ni ma ba na duniya ba ne.
english: They are not of the world, even as I am not of the world.

hausa: Sa’an nan ya yi wa Ibrahim alkawari game da kaciya. Ibrahim kuwa ya zama mahaifin Ishaku ya kuma yi masa kaciya kwana takwas bayan haihuwarsa. Daga baya Ishaku ya zama mahaifin Yaƙub, Yaƙub kuma ya zama mahaifin kakanninmu sha biyun nan.
english: He gave him the covenant of circumcision. So Abraham became the father of Isaac, and circumcised him the eighth day. Isaac became the father of Jacob, and Jacob became the father of the twelve patriarchs.

hausa: Yanzu, ina farin ciki saboda wuyar da nake sha dominku, don ta wurin wuyan nan zan cika abin da ya rage na wuyar da Kiristi ya sha saboda jikinsa, wato, ikkilisiya.
english: Now I rejoice in my sufferings for your sake, and fill up on my part that which is lacking of the afflictions of Christ in my flesh for his body’s sake, which is the assembly,

hausa: Allah ya kuma ce wa Ibrahim, “Game da Saira matarka kuwa, ba za ka ƙara kiranta Saira ba, sunanta zai zama Saratu.
english: God said to Abraham, “As for Sarai your wife, you shall not call her name Sarai, but her name shall be Sarah.

hausa: Duk wanda ya roƙe ka abu, ka ba shi. In kuma wani ya yi maka ƙwace, kada ka nema yă mayar maka.
english: Give to everyone who asks you, and don’t ask him who takes away your goods to give them back again.

hausa: Amma Ubangiji ya ɗauke ni daga kiwon dabbobi ya ce mini, ‘Je ka, ka yi wa mutanena Isra’ila annabci.’
english: and Yahweh took me from following the flock, and Yahweh said to me, ‘Go, prophesy to my people Israel.’

hausa: “ ‘Saboda haka ga abin da Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka yana cewa saboda maganganunku na ƙarya da wahayinku na ƙarya, ina gāba da ku, in ji Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka.
english: “‘Therefore the Lord Yahweh says: “Because you have spoken falsehood and seen lies, therefore, behold, I am against you,” says the Lord Yahweh.

hausa: Waɗannan sanduna sun yi tsawo ƙwarai har ƙarshensu sun nausa daga akwatin alkawarin, ana iya ganinsu daga gaban ciki wuri mai tsarki na can ciki amma ba daga waje Wuri Mai Tsarki ba; kuma suna nan a can har wa yau.
english: The poles were so long that the ends of the poles were seen from the ark in front of the inner sanctuary, but they were not seen outside; and it is there to this day.

hausa: Kai, zurfin yalwar hikima da kuma sanin Allah yana nan a yalwace! Hukunce-hukuncensa kuma su fi gaban bincike, hanyoyinsa kuwa sun wuce gaban ganewa!
english: Oh the depth of the riches both of the wisdom and the knowledge of God! How unsearchable are his judgments, and his ways past tracing out!

hausa: Saurayin wanda aka fi girmamawa a cikin dukan gidan mahaifinsa, bai ɓata lokaci a yin abin da suka ce ba, domin ya ji daɗin ’yar Yaƙub.
english: The young man didn’t wait to do this thing, because he had delight in Jacob’s daughter, and he was honored above all the house of his father.

hausa: Kowane ɗan fari, namiji, a Masar zai mutu, daga kan ɗan fari na Fir’auna wanda zai ci gadon sarauta, har zuwa kan ɗan fari na baiwa, wadda take niƙa, da kuma dukan ’yan farin shanu.
english: and all the firstborn in the land of Egypt shall die, from the firstborn of Pharaoh who sits on his throne, even to the firstborn of the female servant who is behind the mill, and all the firstborn of livestock.

hausa: Ɗan kasuwa yana amfani da mudu marar gaskiya; yana jin daɗin cuta.
english: A merchant has dishonest scales in his hand. He loves to defraud.

hausa: “ ‘In ya miƙa hadayar a matsayin hadaya ta godiya ce, to, zai miƙa ta tare da burodi mai kauri marar yisti, wanda aka kwaɓa da mai, da burodi marar kauri, wanda aka shafa wa mai, da kuma burodi mai kauri da aka yi da gari mai laushi wanda aka kwaɓa sosai da mai.
english: If he offers it for a thanksgiving, then he shall offer with the sacrifice of thanksgiving unleavened cakes mixed with oil, and unleavened wafers anointed with oil, and cakes mixed with oil.

hausa: Za ka shugabanci fadata, kuma dukan mutanena za su zama a ƙarƙashinka. Da sarauta kaɗai zan fi ka girma.”
english: You shall be over my house. All my people will be ruled according to your word. Only in the throne I will be greater than you.”

hausa: Ibrahim ya ɗauki itace saboda hadaya ta ƙonawa ya ɗora wa ɗansa Ishaku, shi kuwa ya riƙe wuƙa da wutar. Yayinda su biyun suke tafiya,
english: Abraham took the wood of the burnt offering and laid it on Isaac his son. He took in his hand the fire and the knife. They both went together.

hausa: ɗan Meleya, ɗan Menna, ɗan Mattata, ɗan Natan, ɗan Dawuda,
english: the son of Melea, the son of Menan, the son of Mattatha, the son of Nathan, the son of David,

hausa: Saboda haka, ku furta wa juna zunubanku, ku yi addu’a saboda juna, domin ku sami warkarwa. Addu’ar mai adalci tana da iko da kuma amfani.
english: Confess your sins to one another and pray for one another, that you may be healed. The insistent prayer of a righteous person is powerfully effective.

hausa: “ ‘Mutanen Dedan sun sayi kayanki da sirdin zama a kan dawakai.
english: “‘“Dedan was your merchant in precious saddle blankets for riding.

hausa: Tabbatacce Allah zai murƙushe kawunan abokan gābansa, rawanin gashi na waɗanda suke ci gaba cikin zunubansa.
english: But God will strike through the head of his enemies, the hairy scalp of such a one as still continues in his guiltiness.

hausa: Yefta ya ce, “A ce kun dawo da ni in yaƙi Ammonawa, Ubangiji kuwa ya ba da su a hannuna, zan zama shugabanku?”
english: Jephthah said to the elders of Gilead, “If you bring me home again to fight with the children of Ammon, and Yahweh delivers them before me, will I be your head?”

hausa: Horo mai tsanani yana jiran duk wanda ya bar hanya; wanda ya ƙi gyara zai mutu.
english: There is stern discipline for one who forsakes the way. Whoever hates reproof shall die.

hausa: Zabura ta Asaf. Ya Allah, al’ummai sun mamaye gādonka; sun ƙazantar da haikalinka mai tsarki, sun bar Urushalima kufai.
english: A Psalm by Asaph. God, the nations have come into your inheritance. They have defiled your holy temple. They have laid Jerusalem in heaps.

hausa: sai ta tuɓe rigunan gwaurancinta ta rufe kanta da lulluɓi don ta ɓad da kamanninta, sa’an nan ta je ta zauna a ƙofar shigar Enayim, wadda take a hanyar zuwa Timna. Gama ta lura cewa ko da yake Shela yanzu ya yi girma, ba a ba da ita gare shi ta zama matarsa ba.
english: She took off the garments of her widowhood, and covered herself with her veil, and wrapped herself, and sat in the gate of Enaim, which is on the way to Timnah; for she saw that Shelah was grown up, and she wasn’t given to him as a wife.

hausa: Ba sa juya ga Mafi Ɗaukaka; suna kama da tanƙwararren baka. Za a kashe shugabanninsu da takobi saboda banzan maganganunsu. Saboda wannan za a wulaƙanta su a ƙasar Masar.
english: They return, but not to the Most High. They are like a faulty bow. Their princes will fall by the sword for the rage of their tongue. This will be their derision in the land of Egypt.

hausa: Da na mai da hankalina don in sami hikima in kuma lura da wahalar mutum a duniya, ko da a ce idanunsa ba sa barci dare da rana,
english: When I applied my heart to know wisdom, and to see the business that is done on the earth (even though eyes see no sleep day or night),

hausa: Ubangiji ne yakan aika da talauci da kuma dukiya; yakan ƙasƙantar yă kuma ɗaukaka.
english: Yahweh makes poor and makes rich. He brings low, he also lifts up.

hausa: Ka jefa burodinka a bisa ruwaye, gama bayan kwanaki masu yawa, za ka sāke samunsa.
english: Cast your bread on the waters; for you shall find it after many days.

hausa: Ka kasa kunne, ya Allah, ka kuma ji; ka buɗe idanunka ka kuma ga yadda birninka ya zama kango, birnin da yake ɗauke da Sunanka. Ba cewa muna roƙonka saboda mu masu adalci ba ne, amma saboda girman jinƙanka.
english: My God, turn your ear and hear. Open your eyes and see our desolations, and the city which is called by your name; for we do not present our petitions before you for our righteousness, but for your great mercies’ sake.

hausa: sai dai a wurin da ya zaɓa yă zama mazauni don Sunansa. A can za ku miƙa hadayar Bikin Ƙetarewa da yamma, sa’ad da rana tana fāɗuwa, a ranar tunawa da fitowarku daga Masar.
english: but at the place which Yahweh your God shall choose to cause his name to dwell in, there you shall sacrifice the Passover at evening, at the going down of the sun, at the season that you came out of Egypt.

hausa: Makircin wawa zunubi ne, mutane kuma sukan yi ƙyamar mai ba’a.
english: The schemes of folly are sin. The mocker is detested by men.

hausa: “ ‘Kada a karɓi fansa saboda wanda ya tsere zuwa birnin mafaka don yă koma yă zauna gidansa tun babban firist bai rasu ba.
english: “‘You shall take no ransom for him who has fled to his city of refuge, that he may come again to dwell in the land before the death of the priest.

hausa: Amma ba za ku fita a gaggauce ba ko ku tafi da gudu; gama Ubangiji zai ja gabanku, Allah na Isra’ila zai kasance mai tsaron bayanku.
english: For you shall not go out in haste, neither shall you go by flight; for Yahweh will go before you, and the God of Israel will be your rear guard.
