hausa: Ya fi kyau kada ka ci nama ko ka sha ruwan inabi ko kuma ka yi wani abin da zai sa ɗan’uwanka yă fāɗi.
english: It is good to not eat meat, drink wine, nor do anything by which your brother stumbles, is offended, or is made weak.

hausa: Sai suka ce, “Jini ne! Ba shakka sarakunan nan sun yaƙe juna, suka karkashe juna. Ya Mowabawa, mu tafi mu kwashi ganima!”
english: They said, “This is blood. The kings are surely destroyed, and they have struck each other. Now therefore, Moab, to the plunder!”

hausa: ina nufin lamirin wancan mutum ne fa, ba naku ba. Don me lamirin wani zai shari’anta ’yancina?
english: Conscience, I say, not your own, but the other’s conscience. For why is my liberty judged by another conscience?

hausa: Duk kuma wanda ya bar gidaje ko ’yan’uwa maza ko ’yan’uwa mata ko mahaifi ko mahaifiya ko yara ko gonaki, saboda ni, zai sami abin da ya fi haka riɓi ɗari, yă kuma gāji rai madawwami.
english: Everyone who has left houses, or brothers, or sisters, or father, or mother, or wife, or children, or lands, for my name’s sake, will receive one hundred times, and will inherit eternal life.

hausa: “Duk da haka mutanen ƙasarka sun ce, ‘Hanyar Ubangiji ba daidai ba ce.’ Alhali kuwa tasu ce ba daidai ba.
english: “‘Yet the children of your people say, “The way of the Lord is not fair;” but as for them, their way is not fair.

hausa: ’Yan’uwana, in waninku ya kauce daga gaskiya, wani kuma ya komo da shi,
english: Brothers, if any among you wanders from the truth and someone turns him back,

hausa: Shi ma ya shirya abinci mai daɗi ya kawo wa mahaifinsa. Sa’an nan ya ce masa, “Babana, tashi ka zauna ka ci daga abin da na farauto, domin ka sa mini albarka.”
english: He also made savory food, and brought it to his father. He said to his father, “Let my father arise, and eat of his son’s venison, that your soul may bless me.”

hausa: Suka kuma yi sanduna na itace ƙirya, biyar domin katakan da suke a gefe guda na tabanakul,
english: He made bars of acacia wood: five for the boards of the one side of the tabernacle,

hausa: Kamar ’yan kunnen zinariya ko kuwa kayan ado na zinariya zalla haka yake da tsawatawar mai hikima ga kunne mai saurarawa.
english: As an earring of gold, and an ornament of fine gold, so is a wise reprover to an obedient ear.

hausa: Doka daga bakinka ya fi mini daraja fiye da azurfa da zinariya guda dubu.
english: The law of your mouth is better to me than thousands of pieces of gold and silver. YODH

hausa: Kada wani da yake a kan rufin gidansa, yă sauko don ɗaukar wani abu a gida.
english: Let him who is on the housetop not go down to take out the things that are in his house.

hausa: ta shida a kan Bukkiya, ’ya’yansa maza da danginsa, 12
english: the sixth to Bukkiah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

hausa: Da murya mai ƙarfi, Yesu ya ja numfashinsa na ƙarshe.
english: Jesus cried out with a loud voice, and gave up the spirit.

hausa: Yanzu fa, Bikin Burodi Marar Yistin da ake kira Bikin Ƙetarewa ya yi kusa,
english: Now the feast of unleavened bread, which is called the Passover, was approaching.

hausa: Waɗannan su ne mutanen da suka zo wurin Dawuda a Ziklag, yayinda aka kore shi daga gaban Shawulu ɗan Kish (suna cikin jarumawan da suka taimake shi a yaƙi;
english: Now these are those who came to David to Ziklag while he was a fugitive from Saul the son of Kish. They were among the mighty men, his helpers in war.

hausa: Don a fanshi ’ya’yan fari 273 na Isra’ilawa da suka fi Lawiyawa yawa,
english: For the redemption of the two hundred seventy-three of the firstborn of the children of Israel who exceed the number of the Levites,

hausa: “Ina da hadaya ta salama a gida; yau zan cika alkawarina.
english: “Sacrifices of peace offerings are with me. Today I have paid my vows.

hausa: kuma baƙi mafi mugunta na al’ummai suka sare shi suka bar shi. Rassansa sun fāɗi a kan duwatsun da suke cikin dukan kwaruruka; rassansa kuma sun kakkarye, sun fāɗi a cikin dukan magudanan ruwa na ƙasa. Dukan al’umman duniya suka fito daga ƙarƙashin inuwarsa suka bar shi.
english: Foreigners, the tyrants of the nations, have cut him off and have left him. His branches have fallen on the mountains and in all the valleys, and his boughs are broken by all the watercourses of the land. All the peoples of the earth have gone down from his shadow and have left him.

hausa: Amma zan mayar muku da lafiya in kuma warkar da mikinku,’ in ji Ubangiji, ‘domin ana ce da ku yasassu, Sihiyona wadda ba wanda ya kula da ita.’
english: For I will restore health to you, and I will heal you of your wounds,” says Yahweh, “because they have called you an outcast, saying, ‘It is Zion, whom no man seeks after.’”

hausa: gama kamar ciyawa za su bushe, kamar ɗanyun ganyaye za su mutu.
english: For they shall soon be cut down like the grass, and wither like the green herb.

hausa: Amma matsorata, da marasa bangaskiya, masu ƙazanta, masu kisankai, masu fasikanci, masu sihiri, masu bautar gumaka da dukan maƙaryata, wurinsu zai kasance a cikin tafkin wutar da yake farar wuta mai ci. Wannan fa ita ce mutuwa ta biyu.”
english: But for the cowardly, unbelieving, sinners, abominable, murderers, sexually immoral, sorcerers, idolaters, and all liars, their part is in the lake that burns with fire and sulfur, which is the second death.”

hausa: Da yamma Yoshuwa ya ba da umarni a sauko da su daga itatuwan a jefa su cikin kogon da suka ɓuya. Aka sa manyan duwatsu aka rufe bakin kogon, suna a can har wa yau.
english: At the time of the going down of the sun, Joshua commanded, and they took them down off the trees, and threw them into the cave in which they had hidden themselves, and laid great stones on the mouth of the cave, which remain to this very day.

hausa: “Na ji abubuwa da yawa kamar waɗannan; dukanku ba ku iya ta’aziyya ba!
english: “I have heard many such things. You are all miserable comforters!

hausa: A dare na goma sha huɗu iska dai tana ta korarmu a Tekun Adiriyatik, wajen tsakar dare sai masu tuƙin jirgin suka zaci sun yi kusa da ƙasa.
english: But when the fourteenth night had come, as we were driven back and forth in the Adriatic Sea, about midnight the sailors surmised that they were drawing near to some land.

hausa: Tuna da maganarka ga bawanka, gama ka ba ni bege.
english: Remember your word to your servant, because you gave me hope.

hausa: Shugabannin mutane su ne, Farosh, da Fahat-Mowab, da Elam, da Zattu, da Bani,
english: The chiefs of the people: Parosh, Pahathmoab, Elam, Zattu, Bani,

hausa: Kuma har yanzu, suna cikin rashin gaskatawa, saboda murna da mamaki, sai ya tambaye su, “Kuna da abinci a nan?”
english: While they still didn’t believe for joy, and wondered, he said to them, “Do you have anything here to eat?”

hausa: Jakar ta ce wa Bala’am, “Ni ba jakarka ba ce wadda kake hawa kullum, har yă zuwa yau? Na taɓa yin maka haka?” Bala’am ya ce, “A’a.”
english: The donkey said to Balaam, “Am I not your donkey, on which you have ridden all your life long until today? Was I ever in the habit of doing so to you?” He said, “No.”

hausa: Waɗannan su ne kabilan Manasse, jimillarsu ta kai 52,700.
english: These are the families of Manasseh. Those who were counted of them were fifty-two thousand seven hundred.

hausa: Yaƙub shi ma ya kama hanyarsa, sai mala’ikun Allah suka sadu da shi.
english: Jacob went on his way, and the angels of God met him.

hausa: Kuna gab da ƙetare Urdun fa, ku shiga, ku kuma mallaki ƙasar da Ubangiji Allahnku yake ba ku. Sa’ad da kuka karɓe ta, kuka kuma zauna a can,
english: For you are to pass over the Jordan to go in to possess the land which Yahweh your God gives you, and you shall possess it and dwell in it.

hausa: Idanun mazinaci suna jiran yamma ta yi sosai; yana tunani cewa, ‘Ba wanda zai gan ni,’ sai kuma yă ɓoye fuskarsa.
english: The eye also of the adulterer waits for the twilight, saying, ‘No eye will see me.’ He disguises his face.

hausa: Shi ya sa tun daga ranar da muka sami labarin, ba mu fasa yin addu’a dominku ba. Kullum muna roƙon Allah yă sa ku san kome da yake so ku yi, domin ku sami hikima ta Ruhu, ku kuma sami ganewar kome duka.
english: For this cause, we also, since the day we heard this, don’t cease praying and making requests for you, that you may be filled with the knowledge of his will in all spiritual wisdom and understanding,

hausa: Sarkin Ahaz ya kawar da katakon ya kuma ɗauke tasoshin daga mazauninsu da ake iya matsarwa. Ya ɗauke ƙaton kwano mai suna Teku daga kan bijiman tagullar da ya tallafe su ya ajiye a kan mazaunin dutse.
english: King Ahaz cut off the panels of the bases, and removed the basin from off them, and took down the sea from off the bronze oxen that were under it, and put it on a pavement of stone.

hausa: Ya fara ginin a rana biyu ga wata na biyu a shekara ta huɗu ta mulkinsa.
english: He began to build in the second day of the second month, in the fourth year of his reign.

hausa: Musa kuwa ya yanka ɗan ragon ya ɗibi jinin ya sa leɓatun kunnen dama na Haruna, ya kuma sa a babbar yatsarsa ta hannun dama da kuma a babbar yatsar ƙafarsa ta dama.
english: He killed it; and Moses took some of its blood, and put it on the tip of Aaron’s right ear, and on the thumb of his right hand, and on the great toe of his right foot.

hausa: Amma da Fir’auna ya ga an sami sauƙi, sai ya taurare, ya ƙi yă saurari Musa da Haruna kamar dai yadda Ubangiji ya riga ya faɗa.
english: But when Pharaoh saw that there was a respite, he hardened his heart, and didn’t listen to them, as Yahweh had spoken.

hausa: Elisha ya ce, “Samo mini ɗan gari.” Aka kawo masa ya kuma sa a cikin tukunyan ya ce, “Raba wa mutanen su ci.” Ya kasance kuwa babu wani abin damuwa a tukunyar.
english: But he said, “Then bring meal.” He threw it into the pot; and he said, “Serve it to the people, that they may eat.” And there was nothing harmful in the pot.

hausa: Sai ya yi masa kira ya ce, ‘Baba, Ibrahim, ka ji tausayina, ka aiki Lazarus ya sa ɗan yatsarsa a ruwa, ya ɗiga mini a harshe saboda in ji sanyi, domin ina shan azaba cikin wannan wuta.’
english: He cried and said, ‘Father Abraham, have mercy on me, and send Lazarus, that he may dip the tip of his finger in water and cool my tongue! For I am in anguish in this flame.’

hausa: Ya ce, “Ka fi ni gaskiya, ka yi mini alheri, ni kuwa na yi maka mugunta.
english: He said to David, “You are more righteous than I; for you have done good to me, whereas I have done evil to you.

hausa: A rana ta fari, Yunana ya kama tafiya yana ratsa birnin. Sai ya yi shela cewa, “Nan da kwana arba’in za a hallaka Ninebe?”
english: Jonah began to enter into the city a day’s journey, and he cried out, and said, “In forty days, Nineveh will be overthrown!”

hausa: saboda haka ba za ku ƙara cinye mutane ko ku sa al’ummarku ta rasa ’ya’ya ba, in ji Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka.
english: therefore you shall devour men no more, and not bereave your nation any more,” says the Lord Yahweh.

hausa: “Saboda haka fa, ɗan mutum ka yi annabci ka kuma tafa hannuwanka. Bari takobi ya yi sara sau biyu, har sau uku ma. Takobin kisa ne, takobi ne don kisa mai girma, zai kewaye su a kowane gefe.
english: “You therefore, son of man, prophesy, and strike your hands together. Let the sword be doubled the third time, the sword of the fatally wounded. It is the sword of the great one who is fatally wounded, which enters into their rooms.

hausa: Da Yesu ya gama magana, sai wani Bafarisiye ya gayyace shi cin abinci tare da shi. Sai kuwa ya shiga ya zauna a tebur.
english: Now as he spoke, a certain Pharisee asked him to dine with him. He went in and sat at the table.

hausa: Yawan ganimar da sojoji suka kawo ita ce tumaki 675,000
english: Now the plunder, over and above the booty which the men of war took, was six hundred seventy-five thousand sheep,

hausa: Kada ku ɗauki jakar kuɗi, ko jaka, ko takalma. Kada ma ku gai da kowa a kan hanya.
english: Carry no purse, nor wallet, nor sandals. Greet no one on the way.

hausa: Ina allolin Hamat da na Arfad? Ina allolin Sefarfayim, da na Hena, da na Iffa? Sun cece Samariya daga hannuna?
english: Where are the gods of Hamath and of Arpad? Where are the gods of Sepharvaim, of Hena, and Ivvah? Have they delivered Samaria out of my hand?

hausa: Ka buge su da rawar jiki, ya Ubangiji; bari al’ummai su sani su mutane ne kurum. Sela
english: Put them in fear, Yahweh. Let the nations know that they are only men. Selah.

hausa: Sai su biyu da Ruhu Mai Tsarki ya aika suka gangara zuwa Selusiya suka shiga jirgin ruwa daga can zuwa Saifurus.
english: So, being sent out by the Holy Spirit, they went down to Seleucia. From there they sailed to Cyprus.

hausa: Da Bulus ya ci gaba jawabi a kan adalci, kamunkai da kuma hukunci mai zuwa, sai Felis ya tsorata ya ce, “Yanzu kam, ya isa haka! Kana iya tafi. In na sami zarafi, zan kira ka.”
english: As he reasoned about righteousness, self-control, and the judgment to come, Felix was terrified, and answered, “Go your way for this time, and when it is convenient for me, I will summon you.”

hausa: Kai da ka kawo labari mai daɗi wa Sihiyona, ka haura a bisa dutse. Kai da ka kawo labari mai daɗi wa Urushalima, ka tā da muryarka ka yi ihu, ka ɗaga ta, kada ka ji tsoro; faɗa wa garuruwan Yahuda, “Ga Allahnku!”
english: You who tell good news to Zion, go up on a high mountain. You who tell good news to Jerusalem, lift up your voice with strength! Lift it up! Don’t be afraid! Say to the cities of Judah, “Behold, your God!”

hausa: Annabawanki sun yi wa waɗannan ayyuka shafe da farar ƙasa ta wurin wahayin ƙarya da duban ƙarya. Suna cewa, ‘Ga abin da Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka yana cewa’ alhali kuwa Ubangiji bai faɗa ba.
english: Her prophets have plastered for them with whitewash, seeing false visions, and divining lies to them, saying, ‘The Lord Yahweh says,’ when Yahweh has not spoken.

hausa: Dā kun yi waɗannan abubuwa, sa’ad da rayuwar tana cikin duniya mai wannan hali.
english: You also once walked in those, when you lived in them,

hausa: Haka, ina gaya muku, akwai murna a gaban mala’ikun Allah a kan mai zunubi guda ɗaya, da ya tuba.”
english: Even so, I tell you, there is joy in the presence of the angels of God over one sinner repenting.”

hausa: Zan mayar da dukan duwatsu su zama hanyoyi, a kuma gyara manyan hanyoyina.
english: I will make all my mountains a road, and my highways shall be exalted.

hausa: Amma Yahudawan da suka ƙi ba da gaskata, suka zuga Al’ummai suka sa ɓata tsakaninsu da ’yan’uwa.
english: But the disbelieving Jews stirred up and embittered the souls of the Gentiles against the brothers.

hausa: wanda yake da shekaru tasa’in da takwas da haihuwa, idanunsa kuma ƙarfi ya ƙare, baya iya gani.
english: Now Eli was ninety-eight years old. His eyes were set, so that he could not see.

hausa: Nan take bayan Yahuda ya karɓi burodin, sai Shaiɗan ya shige shi. Sai Yesu ya ce masa, “Abin nan da kake niyyar yi, ka yi shi maza.”
english: After the piece of bread, then Satan entered into him. Then Jesus said to him, “What you do, do quickly.”

hausa: “An rubuta zunubin Yahuda da alƙalamin ƙarfe, an rubuta da tsinin dutse, a kan allunan zukatansu da kuma a kan ƙahonin bagadansu.
english: “The sin of Judah is written with a pen of iron, and with the point of a diamond. It is engraved on the tablet of their heart, and on the horns of your altars.

hausa: Abin da ya sa nake musu magana da misalai ke nan. “Ko da yake suna kallo, ba sa gani; ko da yake suna saurara, ba sa ji ko su gane.
english: Therefore I speak to them in parables, because seeing they don’t see, and hearing, they don’t hear, neither do they understand.

hausa: Za ku iya zauna a cikinmu, ƙasar tana nan a buɗe dominku. Ku yi zama a cikinta, ku yi sana’a, ku kuma sami dukiya.”
english: You shall dwell with us, and the land will be before you. Live and trade in it, and get possessions in it.”

hausa: Yetro ya riga ya aika wa Musa cewa, “Ni surukinka Yetro, ina zuwa wurinka tare da matarka da ’ya’yanka maza biyu.”
english: He said to Moses, “I, your father-in-law Jethro, have come to you with your wife, and her two sons with her.”

hausa: domin mutumin Allah yă zama shiryayye sosai saboda kowane kyakkyawan aiki.
english: that each person who belongs to God may be complete, thoroughly equipped for every good work.

hausa: Waɗannan su ne ’ya’ya mazan da Bilha ta haifa wa Yaƙub, ita ce Laban ya ba wa ’yarsa Rahila. ’Ya’yan suka su bakwai ne.
english: These are the sons of Bilhah, whom Laban gave to Rachel, his daughter, and these she bore to Jacob: all the souls were seven.

hausa: Gama abin da Ubangiji, Allah na Isra’ila ya ce, ‘Tulun garin ba zai ƙare ba, kwalabar man kuma ba zai bushe ba sai ranar da Ubangiji ya bayar da ruwan sama a ƙasar.’ ”
english: For Yahweh, the God of Israel, says, ‘The jar of meal will not run out, and the jar of oil will not fail, until the day that Yahweh sends rain on the earth.’”

hausa: Amsar kuwa za tă zama, “Wannan ya zama haka domin wannan mutane, sun yi watsi da alkawarin Ubangiji Allah na kakanninsu, alkawarin da ya yi da su sa’ad da ya fitar da su daga Masar.
english: Then men will say, “Because they abandoned the covenant of Yahweh, the God of their fathers, which he made with them when he brought them out of the land of Egypt,

hausa: “Sa’an nan na ci gaba da kallo saboda kalmomin fariyar da wannan ƙaho yake furtawa. Na yi ta kallo har sai da aka yanke dabbar, aka kuma hallaka jikinta a cikin wuta.
english: “I watched at that time because of the voice of the arrogant words which the horn spoke. I watched even until the animal was slain, and its body destroyed, and it was given to be burned with fire.

hausa: “Kowace maganar Allah ba ta da kuskure; shi ne garkuwa ga waɗanda suke neman mafaka daga gare shi.
english: “Every word of God is flawless. He is a shield to those who take refuge in him.

hausa: In ka yi haka, Allah ya umarta za ka iya jimre gajiyar, kuma dukan mutanen nan za su koma gida da murna.”
english: If you will do this thing, and God commands you so, then you will be able to endure, and all these people also will go to their place in peace.”

hausa: Dā kam ina da rai sa’ad da ban san doka ba; amma da umarni ya zo, sai zunubi ya zaburo da rai na kuma mutu.
english: I was alive apart from the law once, but when the commandment came, sin revived and I died.

hausa: Gidan da ya shiga, ku gaya wa maigidan cewa, ‘Malam yana tambaya, ina ɗakin baƙina, inda zan ci Bikin Ƙetarewa tare da almajiraina?’
english: and wherever he enters in, tell the master of the house, ‘The Teacher says, “Where is the guest room, where I may eat the Passover with my disciples?”’

hausa: Da iyayengijin baranyar suka ga hanyar samun kuɗinsu ta toshe, sai suka kama Bulus da Sila suka ja su zuwa cikin kasuwa don su fuskanci hukuma.
english: But when her masters saw that the hope of their gain was gone, they seized Paul and Silas and dragged them into the marketplace before the rulers.

hausa: Suka yi sandunan da itacen ƙirya, suka kuma dalaye su da zinariya.
english: He made the poles of acacia wood, and overlaid them with gold.

hausa: A iyakokin Manasse akwai Bet-Sheyan, Ta’anak, Megiddo da Dor, tare da ƙauyukansu. Zuriyar Yusuf ɗan Isra’ila ta zauna a waɗannan garuruwa.
english: and by the borders of the children of Manasseh, Beth Shean and its towns, Taanach and its towns, Megiddo and its towns, and Dor and its towns. The children of Joseph the son of Israel lived in these.

hausa: Da suka bi ta Amfifolis da Afolloniya, sai suka isa Tessalonika, inda akwai majami’ar Yahudawa.
english: Now when they had passed through Amphipolis and Apollonia, they came to Thessalonica, where there was a Jewish synagogue.

hausa: “Wannan ce ƙasar da za ku raba gādo ga kabilan Isra’ila, kuma wannan ne zai zama rabonsu,” in ji Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka.
english: “This is the land which you shall divide by lot to the tribes of Israel for inheritance, and these are their several portions, says the Lord Yahweh.

hausa: Kakanninmu sun yi zunubi kuma ba sa nan yanzu, mu ne aka bari muna shan hukuncinsu.
english: Our fathers sinned, and are no more. We have borne their iniquities.

hausa: Ya Ubangiji Allah Maɗaukaki, wane ne kamar ka? Kai mai iko ne, ya Ubangiji, kuma amincinka ya kewaye ka.
english: Yahweh, God of Armies, who is a mighty one, like you? Yah, your faithfulness is around you.

hausa: ‘Kawo mini nama ka shirya mini abinci mai daɗi don in ci, in sa maka albarka a gaban Ubangiji kafin in mutu.’
english: ‘Bring me venison, and make me savory food, that I may eat, and bless you before Yahweh before my death.’

hausa: Amma Farisiyawa suka ce, “Ai, da ikon sarkin aljanu yake fitar da aljanu.”
english: But the Pharisees said, “By the prince of the demons, he casts out demons.”

hausa: Bari a suturta firistocinka da adalci; bari tsarkakanka su rera don farin ciki.”
english: Let your priests be clothed with righteousness. Let your saints shout for joy!

hausa: Gara a zauna a hamada da a zauna da mace mai fitina da kuma mugun hali.
english: It is better to dwell in a desert land, than with a contentious and fretful woman.

hausa: Shi ne wanda zai gina gida saboda Sunana. Zai zama ɗana, ni kuma zan zama mahaifinsa. Zan kafa kujerar sarautarsa a bisa Isra’ila har abada.’
english: He shall build a house for my name; and he will be my son, and I will be his father; and I will establish the throne of his kingdom over Israel forever.’

hausa: Yowab ya ce, “Ba kai ba ne za ka kai wannan labari a yau ba. Kana iya kai labarin wani lokaci, amma yau kam ba zai yiwu ba, saboda ɗan sarki ya mutu.”
english: Joab said to him, “You must not be the bearer of news today, but you must carry news another day. But today you must carry no news, because the king’s son is dead.”

hausa: ’Ya’yan Dishan maza su ne, Uz da Aran.
english: These are the children of Dishan: Uz and Aran.

hausa: Ina murna in shaida muku game da alamu da al’ajabai waɗanda Allah Mafi Ɗaukaka ya yi ta wurina.
english: It has seemed good to me to show the signs and wonders that the Most High God has worked toward me.

hausa: Sa’ad da dukan Isra’ilawa suka ji Yerobowam ya dawo, sai suka aika, suka kira shi zuwa taro, suka kuma naɗa shi sarki bisa dukan Isra’ila. Kabila Yahuda kaɗai ta kasance mai biyayya ga gidan Dawuda.
english: When all Israel heard that Jeroboam had returned, they sent and called him to the congregation, and made him king over all Israel. There was no one who followed David’s house, except for the tribe of Judah only.

hausa: In ya ƙone, zai yi hasara, amma zai sami ceto, sai dai kamar wanda ya bi ta tsakiyar wuta ne.
english: If any man’s work is burned, he will suffer loss, but he himself will be saved, but as through fire.

hausa: Ubangiji yana kusa da waɗanda suka karai ya kuma cece waɗanda aka ragargaza a ruhu.
english: Yahweh is near to those who have a broken heart, and saves those who have a crushed spirit.

hausa: Amma mugaye suna kama da tumbatsar teku, wanda ba ya natsuwa, wanda raƙumansa sukan kawo gurɓacewa da tabo.
english: But the wicked are like the troubled sea; for it can’t rest and its waters cast up mire and mud.

hausa: Kwari a baka yana lilo a gabansa kibiya da māshi suna wuce kansa.
english: The quiver rattles against him, the flashing spear and the javelin.

hausa: Ban zo don in kira masu adalci ba, sai dai masu zunubi zuwa ga tuba.”
english: I have not come to call the righteous, but sinners, to repentance.”

hausa: Ana nan sai Ubangiji ya nuna wa Saratu alheri kamar yadda ya ce, Ubangiji kuma ya yi wa Saratu abin da ya yi alkawari.
english: Yahweh visited Sarah as he had said, and Yahweh did to Sarah as he had spoken.

hausa: Waɗannan su ne kawunan iyalansu. Efer, Ishi, Eliyel, Azriyel, Irmiya, Hodawiya da Yadiyel. Su jarumawa ne, sanannu, su ne kuma kawunan iyalansu.
english: These were the heads of their fathers’ houses: Epher, Ishi, Eliel, Azriel, Jeremiah, Hodaviah, and Jahdiel—mighty men of valor, famous men, heads of their fathers’ houses.

hausa: Sa’ad da kuɗin mutanen Masar da Kan’ana suka ƙare, dukan Masar ta zo wurin Yusuf ta ce, “Ka ba mu abinci. Me zai sa mu mutu a idanunka? Kuɗinmu duk sun ƙare.”
english: When the money was all spent in the land of Egypt, and in the land of Canaan, all the Egyptians came to Joseph, and said, “Give us bread, for why should we die in your presence? For our money fails.”

hausa: Ki kau da idanu daga gare ni; gama suna rinjayata. Gashinki yana kama da garken awakin da suke gangarawa daga Gileyad.
english: Turn away your eyes from me, for they have overcome me. Your hair is like a flock of goats, that lie along the side of Gilead.

hausa: Da ma a hamada ina da wurin da matafiye za su sauka, don in bar mutanena in tafi in bar su; gama dukansu mazinata ne, taron mutane marasa aminci.
english: Oh that I had in the wilderness a lodging place of wayfaring men, that I might leave my people and go from them! For they are all adulterers, an assembly of treacherous men.

hausa: Ya yanke dangantaka da Kiristi wanda yake kai, wanda ta gare shi ne dukan jiki yake a haɗe, yake tsaye ta wurin taimakon gaɓoɓi da jijiyoyi, yana kuma girma kamar yadda Allah yake sa yă yi girma.
english: and not holding firmly to the Head, from whom all the body, being supplied and knit together through the joints and ligaments, grows with God’s growth.

hausa: “ ‘In dabbar aka yarda a ci ta mutu, duk wanda ya taɓa gawarta zai ƙazantu har yamma.
english: “‘If any animal of which you may eat dies, he who touches its carcass shall be unclean until the evening.

hausa: Na rubuta muku cikin wasiƙata, kada ku yi haɗa kai da masu aikin lalata.
english: I wrote to you in my letter to have no company with sexual sinners;

hausa: Iliya da Musa suka bayyana a gabansu, suna magana da Yesu.
english: Elijah and Moses appeared to them, and they were talking with Jesus.

hausa: Ni kaina na tabbata, ’yan’uwana, cewa ku kanku kuna cike da kirki, cikakku cikin sani da kuma ƙwararru don yin wa juna gargaɗi.
english: I myself am also persuaded about you, my brothers, that you yourselves are full of goodness, filled with all knowledge, able also to admonish others.

hausa: Abin da Allah ya faɗa game da Arabiya. Ku ayarin Dedanawa, ku da kuka sauka a jejin Arabiya,
english: The burden on Arabia. You will lodge in the thickets in Arabia, you caravans of Dedanites.

hausa: Gama da a ce gādon yă dangana a kan doka ne, ai, da ba zai dangana a kan alkawari ba; amma Allah cikin alherinsa ya ba wa Ibrahim gādon ta wurin alkawari.
english: For if the inheritance is of the law, it is no more of promise; but God has granted it to Abraham by promise.

hausa: Adalci ne zai zama abin ɗamararsa aminci kuma igiyar da zai ɗaura kewaye da gindinsa.
english: Righteousness will be the belt around his waist, and faithfulness the belt around his waist.

hausa: da zai sa yă ci gaba da rayuwa har abada yă hana shi shigan kabari yă ruɓa.
english: that he should live on forever, that he should not see corruption.

hausa: Kekunan yaƙi da mahayan dawakai su ma suka haura tare da shi. Babbar ƙungiya jama’a ce ƙwarai.
english: Both chariots and horsemen went up with him. It was a very great company.

hausa: “Kai kuma, ɗan mutum, ka yi annabci ka ce, ‘Ga abin da Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka yana cewa game da Ammonawa da kuma zarginsu. “ ‘Takobi, takobi, an ja don kisa, an goge don cinyewa yana haske kamar walƙiya!
english: “You, son of man, prophesy and say, ‘The Lord Yahweh says this concerning the children of Ammon, and concerning their reproach: “A sword! A sword is drawn! It is polished for the slaughter, to cause it to devour, that it may be as lightning;

hausa: Allah shi ne shaidata, ya san yadda nake ƙaunarku duka da ƙaunar Kiristi Yesu.
english: For God is my witness, how I long after all of you in the tender mercies of Christ Jesus.

hausa: Masu gadin kabarin kuma suka ji tsoro ƙwarai, suka yi rawan jiki, suka zama kamar matattu.
english: For fear of him, the guards shook, and became like dead men.

hausa: Sa’ad da Shekem ɗan Hamor Bahiwiye mai mulkin wurin ya gan ta, sai ya kama ta, ya kwana da ita, ya ɓata ta.
english: Shechem the son of Hamor the Hivite, the prince of the land, saw her. He took her, lay with her, and humbled her.

hausa: Kalmomin Amos, ɗaya daga cikin makiyayan Tekowa, abubuwan da ya gani game da Isra’ila shekaru biyu kafin a yi girgizar ƙasa, a lokacin da Uzziya yake sarkin Yahuda, Yerobowam ɗan Yowash kuma yake sarkin Isra’ila.
english: The words of Amos, who was among the herdsmen of Tekoa, which he saw concerning Israel in the days of Uzziah king of Judah and in the days of Jeroboam the son of Joash, king of Israel, two years before the earthquake.

hausa: Ta nufi yamma zuwa Marala, ta taɓa Dabbeshet, ta wuce zuwa rafin da yake kusa da Yokneyam.
english: Their border went up westward, even to Maralah, and reached to Dabbesheth. It reached to the brook that is before Jokneam.

hausa: Bayan haka, sanin cewa an cika kome, kuma domin a cika Nassi, sai Yesu ya ce, “Ina jin ƙishirwa.”
english: After this, Jesus, seeing that all things were now finished, that the Scripture might be fulfilled, said, “I am thirsty!”

hausa: Gama nakan ji raɗe-raɗen mutane masu yawa; akwai tsoro a kowane gefe; suna ƙulla maƙarƙashiya a kaina suna shirya su ɗauke raina.
english: For I have heard the slander of many, terror on every side, while they conspire together against me, they plot to take away my life.

hausa: Da Yesu yana fitowa daga ruwan, sai ya ga sama ya buɗe, Ruhu kuma yana saukowa a kansa kamar kurciya.
english: Immediately coming up from the water, he saw the heavens parting and the Spirit descending on him like a dove.

hausa: A rana ta fari, za ku yi taro mai tsarki, haka kuma za ku sāke yi a rana ta bakwai. Kada ku yi aiki a waɗannan ranaku, sai dai ku shirya abinci domin kowa, abin da za ku yi ke nan kawai.
english: In the first day there shall be to you a holy convocation, and in the seventh day a holy convocation; no kind of work shall be done in them, except that which every man must eat, only that may be done by you.

hausa: Saboda haka ga abin da Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka yana cewa ina gāba da Fir’auna sarkin Masar. Zan karye hannuwansa biyu, hannun da yake da kyau da kuma wanda an riga an karya, in kuma sa takobi ya fāɗi daga hannunsa.
english: Therefore the Lord Yahweh says: ‘Behold, I am against Pharaoh king of Egypt, and will break his arms, the strong arm, and that which was broken. I will cause the sword to fall out of his hand.

hausa: Sa’an nan suka zauna suna tsaronsa.
english: and they sat and watched him there.

hausa: Tsawon kowane ginshiƙi, ƙafa ashirin da bakwai ne. Hulunan tagullan da suke ƙwalƙwalin kowane ginshiƙi kuma yana da tsawon ƙafa huɗu da rabi. Kuma aka yi masa ado da saƙa da ’ya’yan itace kewaye da shi. Bayan ginshiƙin ma haka yake.
english: The height of the one pillar was eighteen cubits, and a capital of bronze was on it. The height of the capital was three cubits, with network and pomegranates on the capital around it, all of bronze; and the second pillar with its network was like these.

hausa: To, a lokacin, Sarki Yoram ya tashi daga Samariya, ya tattara sojoji daga dukan Isra’ila.
english: King Jehoram went out of Samaria at that time, and mustered all Israel.

hausa: Ya ce mini, “Ɗan mutum, tashi ka tsaya a ƙafafunka zan kuma yi maka magana.”
english: He said to me, “Son of man, stand on your feet, and I will speak with you.”

hausa: Ban san inda Ruhun Ubangiji zai kai ka sa’ad da na bar ka ba. In na tafi na faɗa wa Ahab bai kuma same ka a nan ba, zai sa a kashe ni. Tuna fa, ni bawanka, na yi wa Ubangiji sujada tun ina saurayi.
english: It will happen, as soon as I leave you, that Yahweh’s Spirit will carry you I don’t know where; and so when I come and tell Ahab, and he can’t find you, he will kill me. But I, your servant, have feared Yahweh from my youth.

hausa: Da Musa ya ji haka, sai ya fāɗi rubda ciki ya yi addu’a
english: When Moses heard it, he fell on his face.

hausa: Saboda haka suka karkaɗe ƙurar ƙafafunsu don shaidar a kansu suka kuwa tafi Ikoniyum.
english: But they shook off the dust of their feet against them, and came to Iconium.

hausa: Hawaye suna malalowa daga idanuna kamar rafi, gama ba a biyayya da dokarka.
english: Streams of tears run down my eyes, because they don’t observe your law. TZADHE

hausa: amma yanzu an bayyana ta ta wurin bayyanuwar Mai Cetonmu, Kiristi Yesu, wanda ya hallaka mutuwa ya kuma kawo rai da rashin mutuwa a sarari ta wurin bishara.
english: but has now been revealed by the appearing of our Savior, Christ Jesus, who abolished death, and brought life and immortality to light through the Good News.

hausa: Shuffiyawa da Huffiyawa zuriyar Ir ne, kuma Hushiyawa zuriyar Aher ne.
english: So were Shuppim, Huppim, the sons of Ir, Hushim, and the sons of Aher.

hausa: Suka tashi daga Makhelot, suka yi sansani a Tahat.
english: They traveled from Makheloth, and encamped in Tahath.

hausa: Sa’ad da Musa ya sauko daga kan Dutsen Sinai tare da alluna biyu na Alkawari a hannuwansa, bai san cewa fuskarsa tana ƙyalli ba saboda zaman da ya yi a gaban Ubangiji.
english: When Moses came down from Mount Sinai with the two tablets of the covenant in Moses’ hand, when he came down from the mountain, Moses didn’t know that the skin of his face shone by reason of his speaking with him.

hausa: Mafi ƙarfi fiye da tsawan manyan ruwaye, mafi ƙarfi fiye da ikon raƙuman ruwan teku, Ubangiji mai zama a bisa mai girma ne.
english: Above the voices of many waters, the mighty breakers of the sea, Yahweh on high is mighty.

hausa: gama ya lura da ƙasƙancin baiwarsa. Daga yanzu nan gaba dukan zamanai za su ce da ni mai albarka,
english: for he has looked at the humble state of his servant. For behold, from now on, all generations will call me blessed.

hausa: Sai suka tafi a jirgin ruwa su kaɗai, inda ba kowa.
english: They went away in the boat to a deserted place by themselves.

hausa: Kamar yadda yake a rubuce cewa, “Ya ba gajiyayyu hannu sake, ayyukansa na alheri madawwama ne.”
english: As it is written, “He has scattered abroad. He has given to the poor. His righteousness remains forever.”

hausa: Ka faɗa musu, ‘Muddin ina raye, in ji Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka, ba na jin daɗin mutuwar mugu, amma a maimako haka ya fi su juye daga hanyoyinsu su rayu. Ku juye! Ku juye daga mugayen hanyoyinku! Don me za ku mutu, ya gidan Isra’ila?’
english: Tell them, ‘“As I live,” says the Lord Yahweh, “I have no pleasure in the death of the wicked, but that the wicked turn from his way and live. Turn, turn from your evil ways! For why will you die, house of Israel?”’

hausa: Daga cikin ɗayansu kuma wani ƙaramin ƙaho ya fito, ya yi girma ya ƙasaita ƙwarai zuwa kudu da kuma gabas da wajen Kyakkyawar Ƙasa.
english: Out of one of them came out a little horn which grew exceedingly great—toward the south, and toward the east, and toward the glorious land.

hausa: Saboda haka kada ku ji tsoro; kun fi kanari masu yawa, daraja nesa.
english: Therefore don’t be afraid. You are of more value than many sparrows.

hausa: Ka tsarkake ni da hizzob, zan kuwa zama tsab; ka wanke ni, zan kuma fi dusan ƙanƙara fari.
english: Purify me with hyssop, and I will be clean. Wash me, and I will be whiter than snow.

hausa: Shugabanmu mai girma ne mai iko duka; ganewarsa ba shi da iyaka.
english: Great is our Lord, and mighty in power. His understanding is infinite.

hausa: Abiya ya tafi yaƙi tare da mayaƙa dubu ɗari huɗu jarumawa, Yerobowam kuwa ya ja dāgār yaƙi a kan Abiya da mayaƙa dubu ɗari takwas jarumawa.
english: Abijah joined battle with an army of valiant men of war, even four hundred thousand chosen men; and Jeroboam set the battle in array against him with eight hundred thousand chosen men, who were mighty men of valor.

hausa: Cikin dukan ’ya’yan da ta haifa; cikin dukan ’ya’yan da ta yi reno babu wani da zai kama hannunta.
english: There is no one to guide her among all the sons to whom she has given birth; and there is no one who takes her by the hand among all the sons whom she has brought up.

hausa: Ka tula gumagumai ka kuma ƙuna wuta. Ka dafa naman da kyau, kana haɗawa da yaji; ka kuma bar ƙasusuwan su ƙone.
english: Heap on the wood. Make the fire hot. Boil the meat well. Make the broth thick, and let the bones be burned.

hausa: Sarki Dariyus kuwa ya ba da umarni a bincika a duba cikin littattafan tarihin da suke a ajiye a wurin ajiyarsu a Babilon.
english: Then Darius the king made a decree, and the house of the archives, where the treasures were laid up in Babylon, was searched.

hausa: Mun ji yadda Ubangiji ya busar da ruwan Jan Teku domin ku lokacin da kuka fito daga ƙasar Masar, da kuma abin da kuka yi wa Sihon da Og, sarakunan nan biyu na Amoriyawa gabas da Urdun, waɗanda kuka hallaka su sarai.
english: For we have heard how Yahweh dried up the water of the Red Sea before you, when you came out of Egypt; and what you did to the two kings of the Amorites, who were beyond the Jordan, to Sihon and to Og, whom you utterly destroyed.

hausa: “Ku yi ƙidaya Kohatawa daga Lawiyawa, bisa ga kabilarsu da iyalansu.
english: “Take a census of the sons of Kohath from among the sons of Levi, by their families, by their fathers’ houses,

hausa: Tabbatacce, samarinta za su fāɗi a tituna; dukan sojojinta za su yi shiru a wannan rana,” in ji Ubangiji Maɗaukaki.
english: Therefore her young men will fall in her streets, and all the men of war will be brought to silence in that day,” says Yahweh of Armies.

hausa: Ubangiji ya ce wa Ayuba,
english: Moreover Yahweh answered Job,

hausa: Mefiboshet yana da wani ƙaramin ɗa sunansa Mika, dukan iyalin gidan Ziba kuwa bayin Mefiboshet ne.
english: Mephibosheth had a young son, whose name was Mica. All who lived in Ziba’s house were servants to Mephibosheth.

hausa: Sa’an nan dukan mutanenki za su zama masu adalci za su kuma mallaki ƙasar har abada. Su ne reshen da na shuka, aikin hannuwana, don nuna darajata.
english: Then your people will all be righteous. They will inherit the land forever, the branch of my planting, the work of my hands, that I may be glorified.

hausa: Amma zan nuna muku wanda za ku ji tsoronsa. Ku ji tsoron wanda, bayan da ya kashe jikin, yana da iko ya jefa ku cikin jahannama ta wuta. I, ina gaya muku, ku ji tsoronsa.
english: But I will warn you whom you should fear. Fear him who after he has killed, has power to cast into Gehenna. Yes, I tell you, fear him.

hausa: Cike da fushi, sarkin Isra’ila ya tafi fadarsa a Samariya.
english: The king of Israel went to his house sullen and angry, and came to Samaria.

hausa: Waɗannan garuruwa da ƙauyukansu su ne rabon da kabilar Naftali ta samu, bisa ga iyalansu.
english: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Naphtali according to their families, the cities with their villages.

hausa: In ba haka ba, to, me kuka je kallo? Mutum mai sanye da tufafi masu kyau ne? A’a, masu sa kayan tsada da suke cikin annashuwa, ai, a fada suke.
english: But what did you go out to see? A man clothed in soft clothing? Behold, those who are gorgeously dressed and live delicately are in kings’ courts.

hausa: Na ga dukan waɗannan, yayinda na lura da kowane abin da ake yi a duniya. Akwai lokacin da mutum yakan nauyaya wa waɗansu ba da sonsa ba.
english: All this I have seen, and applied my mind to every work that is done under the sun. There is a time in which one man has power over another to his hurt.

hausa: “Ubangiji zai tā da wani sarki wa kansa a bisa Isra’ila wanda zai hallaka iyalin Yerobowam. Ko yanzu ma, wannan zai fara faruwa.
english: Moreover Yahweh will raise up a king for himself over Israel who will cut off the house of Jeroboam. This is the day! What? Even now.

hausa: Har yaushe zan yi kokawa da tunanina kuma kowace rana in kasance da damuwa a zuciyata? Har yaushe abokin gābana zai yi nasara a kaina?
english: How long shall I take counsel in my soul, having sorrow in my heart every day? How long shall my enemy triumph over me?

hausa: Ya yi ta yawo a cikin zakoki, gama yanzu shi zaki ne mai ƙarfi. Ya koyi yayyage abin da ya yi farauta yakan kuma cinye mutane.
english: He went up and down among the lions. He became a young lion. He learned to catch the prey. He devoured men.

hausa: Ta haka Allah ya sāka muguntar da Abimelek da ya yi wa mahaifinsa ta wurin kisan ’yan’uwansa saba’in.
english: Thus God repaid the wickedness of Abimelech, which he did to his father in killing his seventy brothers;

hausa: Dukan Yahuda suka yi farin ciki game da rantsuwar domin sun yi rantsuwar gabagadi. Suka nemi Allah da gaske, suka kuma same shi. Saboda haka Ubangiji ya ba su hutu a kowane gefe.
english: All Judah rejoiced at the oath, for they had sworn with all their heart and sought him with their whole desire; and he was found by them. Then Yahweh gave them rest all around.

hausa: Me ya sa ba kwa gane da maganata? Don ba kwa iya jin abin da nake faɗi.
english: Why don’t you understand my speech? Because you can’t hear my word.

hausa: inda Yesu, wanda ya sha gabanmu, ya shiga a madadinmu. Ya zama babban firist na har abada, bisa ga tsarin Melkizedek.
english: where as a forerunner Jesus entered for us, having become a high priest forever after the order of Melchizedek.

hausa: Ubangiji yakan amince da waɗanda suke tsoronsa; yakan sa su san alkawarinsa.
english: The friendship of Yahweh is with those who fear him. He will show them his covenant.

hausa: Sa’ad da kuma iska ta taso daga kudu, kukan ce, ‘Za a yi zafi,’ sai kuwa a yi.
english: When a south wind blows, you say, ‘There will be a scorching heat,’ and it happens.

hausa: Ba su so su ga abinci ba suka kuwa kai bakin mutuwa.
english: Their soul abhors all kinds of food. They draw near to the gates of death.

hausa: Bitrus ya ce, “Mun bar kome domin mu bi ka!”
english: Peter began to tell him, “Behold, we have left all and have followed you.”

hausa: “Ga wa za ku kwatanta ni? Ko kuwa wa yake daidai da ni?” In ji Mai Tsarkin nan.
english: “To whom then will you liken me? Who is my equal?” says the Holy One.

hausa: Ahab ya gina ginshiƙin Ashera, ya kuma aikata abubuwa masu yawa don yă tsokane Ubangiji, Allah na Isra’ila yă yi fushi fiye da dukan sarakunan Isra’ila da suka riga shi.
english: Ahab made the Asherah; and Ahab did more yet to provoke Yahweh, the God of Israel, to anger than all the kings of Israel who were before him.

hausa: Zan cece ka; ba za ka mutu ta wurin takobi ba amma za ka tsira da ranka, domin ka dogara gare ni, in ji Ubangiji.’ ”
english: For I will surely save you. You won’t fall by the sword, but you will escape with your life, because you have put your trust in me,” says Yahweh.’”

hausa: yana kama da hasken safiya a safiya marar girgije, kamar haske bayan ruwan sama da yakan sa ciyawa ta tsiro daga ƙasa.’
english: shall be as the light of the morning when the sun rises, a morning without clouds, when the tender grass springs out of the earth, through clear shining after rain.’

hausa: Duk wanda ya gan ni yakan yi mini ba’a; suna yin mini ashar, suna kaɗa kansu suna cewa,
english: All those who see me mock me. They insult me with their lips. They shake their heads, saying,

hausa: Cikinta yana rufe a ɓawo masu ƙarfi, tana kabtar ƙasa in tana tafiya.
english: His undersides are like sharp potsherds, leaving a trail in the mud like a threshing sledge.

hausa: A cikin majami’ar, akwai wani mutum mai aljani, wani mugun ruhu. Mutumin ya ɗaga murya da ƙarfi ya ce,
english: In the synagogue there was a man who had a spirit of an unclean demon; and he cried out with a loud voice,

hausa: Sai suka gicciye shi. Suka rarraba tufafinsa, suka jefa ƙuri’a a kansu don su ga abin da kowa zai samu.
english: Crucifying him, they parted his garments among them, casting lots on them, what each should take.

hausa: Ya huta da kakanninsa aka kuma binne shi a Samariya tare da sarakunan Isra’ila. Yerobowam ɗansa, ya kuma gāje shi.
english: Jehoash slept with his fathers, and was buried in Samaria with the kings of Israel; and Jeroboam his son reigned in his place.

hausa: Suka ce, “Wane ne kai?” Sai Yesu ya amsa ya ce, “Ni ne wannan da na sha faɗi muku.
english: They said therefore to him, “Who are you?” Jesus said to them, “Just what I have been saying to you from the beginning.

hausa: A kwanakin nan Hezekiya ya yi ciwo, ya yi kusan mutuwa. Sai ya yi addu’a ga Ubangiji, wanda ya amsa masa ya kuma ba shi alama.
english: In those days Hezekiah was terminally ill, and he prayed to Yahweh; and he spoke to him, and gave him a sign.

hausa: Ba zai yiwu Allah yă yi ba daidai ba, Maɗaukaki ba zai yi shari’a marar gaskiya ba.
english: Yes surely, God will not do wickedly, neither will the Almighty pervert justice.

hausa: Sai Yesu ya ce musu, “Kada ku ji tsoro, ku tafi ku gaya wa ’yan’uwana, su tafi Galili. A can za su gan ni.”
english: Then Jesus said to them, “Don’t be afraid. Go tell my brothers that they should go into Galilee, and there they will see me.”

hausa: “Ku ji wannan ku kuma yi wa gidan Yaƙub gargaɗi,” in ji Ubangiji, Ubangiji Allah Maɗaukaki.
english: “Listen, and testify against the house of Jacob,” says the Lord Yahweh, the God of Armies.

hausa: Kowa ya cika da tsoro, manzannin kuwa suka aikata abubuwan banmamaki da alamu masu yawa.
english: Fear came on every soul, and many wonders and signs were done through the apostles.

hausa: To, me kuka je kallo ne? Annabi? I, ina gaya muku, ya ma fi annabi.
english: But why did you go out? To see a prophet? Yes, I tell you, and much more than a prophet.

hausa: Sa’an nan wanda yake tsarkakakke, zai ɗauki hizzob yă tsoma a ruwa, yă yayyafa a tentin da dukan kayayyakinsa, da kuma a kan mutanen da suke wurin. Dole kuma yă yayyafa ruwan a kan duk wanda ya taɓa ƙashin mutu, ko kabari, ko kuma wanda aka kashe, ko wanda ya yi mutuwa ta Allah.
english: A clean person shall take hyssop, dip it in the water, and sprinkle it on the tent, on all the vessels, on the persons who were there, and on him who touched the bone, or the slain, or the dead, or the grave.

hausa: Ni furen bi-rana ne na Sharon, furen bi-rana na kwari.
english: I am a rose of Sharon, a lily of the valleys.

hausa: An ɓoye ta daga idanun kowane abu mai rai, har tsuntsayen sararin sama ma an ɓoye masu ita.
english: Seeing it is hidden from the eyes of all living, and kept close from the birds of the sky.

hausa: Sai Sarki Solomon ya aiki mutane, suka kuma sauko da shi daga bagade. Adoniya kuwa ya zo, ya rusuna wa Sarki Solomon, sai Solomon ya ce, “Tafi gidanka.”
english: So King Solomon sent, and they brought him down from the altar. He came and bowed down to King Solomon; and Solomon said to him, “Go to your house.”

hausa: Sa’ad da Yesu ya ga mahaifiyarsa a can, da kuma almajirin nan da yake ƙauna tsaye kusa, sai ya ce wa mahaifiyarsa, “Mace, ga ɗanki,”
english: Therefore when Jesus saw his mother, and the disciple whom he loved standing there, he said to his mother, “Woman, behold, your son!”

hausa: Zan kafa sansani kewaye da ke duka; zan kewaye ki da hasumiyoyi in tasar miki da ayyukan kwantona na yaƙi.
english: I will encamp against you all around you, and will lay siege against you with posted troops. I will raise siege works against you.

hausa: A shekara ta goma sha ɗaya, a rana ta fari ga wata, maganar Ubangiji ta zo mini cewa,
english: In the eleventh year, in the first of the month, Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

hausa: Ku kawar da tsohon yisti don ku zama kamar sabon curi da aka yi babu yisti yadda dai kuke. Gama an miƙa Kiristi Ɗan Ragon Bikin Ƙetarewarmu.
english: Purge out the old yeast, that you may be a new lump, even as you are unleavened. For indeed Christ, our Passover, has been sacrificed in our place.

hausa: Wannan kashi ɗaya bisa ukun zan kawo in sa a cikin wuta; zan tace su kamar azurfa in gwada su kamar zinariya. Za su kira bisa sunana zan kuwa amsa musu; zan ce, ‘Su mutanena ne,’ za su kuma ce, ‘Ubangiji ne Allahnmu.’ ”
english: I will bring the third part into the fire, and will refine them as silver is refined, and will test them like gold is tested. They will call on my name, and I will hear them. I will say, ‘It is my people;’ and they will say, ‘Yahweh is my God.’”

hausa: Taron kuwa ya ruɗe. Waɗansu suna ihu suna ce abu kaza, waɗansu kuma wani abu dabam. Yawancin mutane kuma ba su ma san abin da ya sa suke a wurin ba.
english: Some therefore cried one thing, and some another, for the assembly was in confusion. Most of them didn’t know why they had come together.

hausa: Yehu ya shiga ya ci, ya kuma sha. Ya ce, “Ku san yadda za ku yi da la’ananniyan nan, ku binne ta, gama ’yar sarki ce.”
english: When he had come in, he ate and drank. Then he said, “See now to this cursed woman, and bury her; for she is a king’s daughter.”

hausa: To, ga duk iyali sun hau kan baiwarka, suna cewa, ‘Ki ba mu ɗayan da ya kashe ɗan’uwansa mu kashe don ran ɗan’uwansa da ya kashe; sa’an nan za mu hallaka magājin shi ma.’ Za su kashe garwashin wuta mai ci da nake da shi kaɗai, su bar mijina ba suna, ba jika, a duniya.”
english: Behold, the whole family has risen against your servant, and they say, ‘Deliver him who struck his brother, that we may kill him for the life of his brother whom he killed, and so destroy the heir also.’ Thus they would quench my coal which is left, and would leave to my husband neither name nor remainder on the surface of the earth.”

hausa: Me za mu ce ke nan? Allah marar adalci ne? Sam, ko kaɗan!
english: What shall we say then? Is there unrighteousness with God? May it never be!

hausa: Zan bar ka a cikin hamada, kai da dukan kifin rafuffukanka. Za ka fāɗi a fili ba kuwa za a tattara ka ko a kwashe ba. Zan ba da kai kamar abinci ga namun jeji na duniya da tsuntsayen sararin sama.
english: I’ll cast you out into the wilderness, you and all the fish of your rivers. You’ll fall on the open field. You won’t be brought together or gathered. I have given you for food to the animals of the earth and to the birds of the sky.

hausa: Sa’an nan tă gangara ta Urdun, tă ƙarasa a Tekun Gishiri. “ ‘Wannan za tă zama ƙasarku, tare da iyakokinta a kowane gefe.’ ”
english: The border shall go down to the Jordan, and end at the Salt Sea. This shall be your land according to its borders around it.’”

hausa: Gama Kiristi masu yawa na ƙarya, da annabawan ƙarya za su firfito, su kuma aikata manyan alamu da ayyukan banmamaki don su ruɗi har da zaɓaɓɓu ma in zai yiwu.
english: For false christs and false prophets will arise and will show signs and wonders, that they may lead astray, if possible, even the chosen ones.

hausa: Saboda haka Allah ya kewaye da mutanen ta hamada zuwa Jan Teku. Isra’ilawa kuwa suka fita daga Masar da shirin yaƙi.
english: but God led the people around by the way of the wilderness by the Red Sea; and the children of Israel went up armed out of the land of Egypt.

hausa: Tushen ginin katangar birnin kuwa an yi masa adon da kowane irin dutse mai daraja. Tushe na farko an yi shi yasfa, na biyu saffaya, na uku agat, na huɗu zumurrudu,
english: The foundations of the city’s wall were adorned with all kinds of precious stones. The first foundation was jasper, the second sapphire, the third chalcedony, the fourth emerald,

hausa: Kashegari kuma Yohanna yana can tare da biyu daga cikin almajiransa.
english: Again, the next day, John was standing with two of his disciples,

hausa: “Ka yi fili domin tabanakul. Tsawon gefen kudu zai zama kamu ɗari da labulen da aka yi da zaren lili mai kyau,
english: “You shall make the court of the tabernacle: for the south side southward there shall be hangings for the court of fine twined linen one hundred cubits long for one side.

hausa: Mun gaskata mun kuma san cewa kai ne Mai Tsarkin nan na Allah.”
english: We have come to believe and know that you are the Christ, the Son of the living God.”

hausa: Amma ɗaya matar ta ce, “A’a! Mai rai ɗin ne ɗana; mataccen naki ne.” Amma ta farin ta nace, “A’a! Mataccen ne naki; mai ran ne nawa.” A haka suka yi ta gardama a gaban sarki.
english: The other woman said, “No! But the living one is my son, and the dead one is your son.” The first one said, “No! But the dead one is your son, and the living one is my son.” They argued like this before the king.

hausa: Haka fa ’ya’yan Yaƙub maza suka yi yadda ya umarce su.
english: His sons did to him just as he commanded them,

hausa: Saboda haka, ku rabu da ƙazamin hali da kuma kowace irin mugunta ku kuma yi na’am da maganar da aka shuka a cikinku da tawali’u, wadda za tă iya cetonku.
english: Therefore, putting away all filthiness and overflowing of wickedness, receive with humility the implanted word, which is able to save your souls.

hausa: “Ku yi Bikin Burodi Marar Yisti, kwana bakwai za ku ci burodi marar yisti, kamar yadda na umarce ku. Ku yi wannan a lokacin da aka ayana a watan Abib, gama a watan ne kuka fito daga Masar. “Kada wani yă zo a gabana hannu wofi.
english: You shall observe the feast of unleavened bread. Seven days you shall eat unleavened bread, as I commanded you, at the time appointed in the month Abib (for in it you came out of Egypt), and no one shall appear before me empty.

hausa: Sa’ad da kuka shiga ƙasar da Ubangiji Allahnku yake ba ku, kuka mallake ta, kuka kuma zauna a cikinta, sai kuka ce, “Bari mu naɗa sarki a kanmu kamar sauran al’umman da suke kewaye da mu,”
english: When you have come to the land which Yahweh your God gives you, and possess it and dwell in it, and say, “I will set a king over me, like all the nations that are around me,”

hausa: Sa’an nan dukan taro suka aika wa mutanen Benyamin da suke a Dutsen Rimmon cewa yaƙi ya ƙare, yanzu sai salama.
english: The whole congregation sent and spoke to the children of Benjamin who were in the rock of Rimmon, and proclaimed peace to them.

hausa: Sai maganar Ubangiji ta zo wa Irmiya annabi cewa,
english: Then Yahweh’s word came to the prophet Jeremiah, saying,

hausa: Haka kuwa suka yi, suka aika da kyautarsa wa dattawan ikkilisiyar ta hannu Barnabas da Shawulu.
english: which they also did, sending it to the elders by the hands of Barnabas and Saul.

hausa: Mai hikima kan ji tsoron Ubangiji ya kuma guji mugunta, amma wawa yana da girman kai yakan yi kome da garaje.
english: A wise man fears and shuns evil, but the fool is hot headed and reckless.

hausa: Gama Ubangiji ba ya yashe mutane har abada.
english: For the Lord will not cast off forever.

hausa: Da Shawulu ya ji, sa Ruhun Allah ya sauko a kansa da iko, ya husata ƙwarai.
english: God’s Spirit came mightily on Saul when he heard those words, and his anger burned hot.

hausa: don ku ce wa waɗanda suke cikin kurkuku, ‘Ku fito,’ ga waɗanda suke cikin duhu kuma, ‘Ku ’yantu!’ “Za su yi kiwo kusa da hanyoyi su kuma sami wurin kiwo a kowane tudu.
english: saying to those who are bound, ‘Come out!’; to those who are in darkness, ‘Show yourselves!’ “They shall feed along the paths, and their pasture shall be on all treeless heights.

hausa: Ubangiji ya ba wa Solomon hikima, kamar yadda ya yi masa alkawari. Dangantakar zaman lafiya ta kasance tsakanin Hiram da Solomon, su biyun suka yi yarjejjeniya.
english: Yahweh gave Solomon wisdom, as he promised him. There was peace between Hiram and Solomon, and the two of them made a treaty together.

hausa: Saboda haka ki ce ke ’yar’uwata ce, domin ta dalilinki a mutunta ni, a kuma bar ni da rai.”
english: Please say that you are my sister, that it may be well with me for your sake, and that my soul may live because of you.”

hausa: “Akwai abubuwa huɗu a duniya da suke ƙanana, duk da haka suna da hikima ƙwarai.
english: “There are four things which are little on the earth, but they are exceedingly wise:

hausa: “Amma wane ni, kuma wace ce jama’ata da za mu iya ba ka a yalwace kamar haka? Kome daga gare ka suka fito, kuma mun ba ka abin da kawai ya fito daga hannunka ne.
english: But who am I, and what is my people, that we should be able to offer so willingly as this? For all things come from you, and we have given you of your own.

hausa: Sa’ad da ya koma, ya tarar da gidan a share da tsabta, kuma a shirye.
english: When he returns, he finds it swept and put in order.

hausa: Dukan abubuwan da ka yi za su yabe ka, ya Ubangiji; tsarkakanka za su ɗaukaka ka.
english: All your works will give thanks to you, Yahweh. Your saints will extol you.

hausa: da ta Besai, da ta Meyunawa, da ta Nefussiyawa,
english: the children of Besai, the children of Meunim, the children of Nephushesim,

hausa: Babu wani abu marar tsarkin da zai taɓa shiga cikin birnin, babu kuma wani mai aikata abin kunya ko ruɗi da zai shiga, sai dai waɗanda aka rubuta sunayensu a cikin littafin rai na Ɗan Ragon.
english: There will in no way enter into it anything profane, or one who causes an abomination or a lie, but only those who are written in the Lamb’s book of life.

hausa: Bulus ya zuba wa Majalisar ido ya ce, “’Yan’uwana, na cika aikina ga Allah cikin lamiri mai kyau har yă zuwa yau.”
english: Paul, looking steadfastly at the council, said, “Brothers, I have lived before God in all good conscience until today.”

hausa: Ubangiji ya ce wa Musa,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

hausa: A lokacin nan Yoshuwa ya je ya hallaka Anakawa daga ƙasar tudu. Daga Hebron, Debir da Anab. Daga dukan ƙasar tuddai na Yahuda, da kuma dukan ƙasar tudu ta Isra’ila, Yoshuwa ya hallaka su duka da garuruwansu.
english: Joshua came at that time, and cut off the Anakim from the hill country, from Hebron, from Debir, from Anab, and from all the hill country of Judah, and from all the hill country of Israel. Joshua utterly destroyed them with their cities.

hausa: “Tafi ka faɗa wa Ebed-Melek mutumin Kush, ‘Ga abin da Ubangiji Maɗaukaki, Allah na Isra’ila, yana cewa ina gab da cika maganata a kan wannan birni ta wurin masifa, ba wadata ba. A lokacin za tă cika a idanunka.
english: “Go, and speak to Ebedmelech the Ethiopian, saying, ‘Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel, says: “Behold, I will bring my words on this city for evil, and not for good; and they will be accomplished before you in that day.

hausa: Sai wawayen suka ce wa masu hikimar, ‘Ku ɗan sassam mana manku; fitilunmu suna mutuwa.’
english: The foolish said to the wise, ‘Give us some of your oil, for our lamps are going out.’

hausa: Zan sheƙe ki da abin sheƙewa a ƙofofin birnin ƙasar. Zan kawo baƙin ciki da hallaka a kan mutanena, gama ba su canja hanyoyinsu ba.
english: I have winnowed them with a fan in the gates of the land. I have bereaved them of children. I have destroyed my people. They didn’t return from their ways.

hausa: Yana cire sarƙar da sarakuna suka ɗaura yă kuma ɗaura musu wata tsumma a kwankwaso.
english: He loosens the bond of kings. He binds their waist with a belt.

hausa: Zuriyar Ruben ɗan fari na Isra’ila, daga Hanok; kabilar Hanokawa; daga Fallu; kabilar Falluyawa;
english: Reuben, the firstborn of Israel; the sons of Reuben: of Hanoch, the family of the Hanochites; of Pallu, the family of the Palluites;

hausa: Saboda haka, ’yan’uwa, mu ba ’ya’yan mace ’yar aikin gida ba ne, amma na ainihin matan gidan ne.
english: So then, brothers, we are not children of a servant, but of the free woman.

hausa: Sai Yesu ya amsa ya ce, “Anya, za ka iya ba da ranka saboda ni? Gaskiya nake faɗa maka, kafin zakara yă yi cara, za ka yi mūsun sanina sau uku!
english: Jesus answered him, “Will you lay down your life for me? Most certainly I tell you, the rooster won’t crow until you have denied me three times.

hausa: Wannan mugu da mazinacin zamani yana neman wani abin banmamaki, amma ba wata alamar da za a nuna wa wannan zamani sai dai ta Yunana.” Sai Yesu ya bar su ya tafi abinsa.
english: An evil and adulterous generation seeks after a sign, and there will be no sign given to it, except the sign of the prophet Jonah.” He left them and departed.

hausa: kada kuma ku ba wa Iblis dama.
english: and don’t give place to the devil.

hausa: Gama ya ce wa Musa, “Zan nuna jinƙai ga wanda zan nuna jinƙai, zan kuma ji tausayin wanda zan ji tausayi.”
english: For he said to Moses, “I will have mercy on whom I have mercy, and I will have compassion on whom I have compassion.”

hausa: Yesu, har yanzu cike da juyayi, ya zo kabarin. Kogo ne da aka rufe bakin da dutse.
english: Jesus therefore, again groaning in himself, came to the tomb. Now it was a cave, and a stone lay against it.

hausa: ‘Ga abin da Ubangiji ya ce kada ku haura don ku yi yaƙi da ’yan’uwanku. Ku tafi gida kowannenku, gama wannan yi na ne.’ ” Saboda haka suka yi biyayya ga maganar Ubangiji suka kuma koma daga takawa don yaƙi da Yerobowam.
english: ‘Yahweh says, “You shall not go up, nor fight against your brothers! Every man return to his house; for this thing is of me.”’” So they listened to Yahweh’s words, and returned from going against Jeroboam.

hausa: Kwana arba’in ambaliya ta yi ta saukowa a duniya, sa’ad da ruwa ya yi ta ƙaruwa sai ya yi ta ɗaga jirgin sama, ya kuwa tashi can bisa duniya.
english: The flood was forty days on the earth. The waters increased, and lifted up the ship, and it was lifted up above the earth.

hausa: Ka kai wa Allah na Urushalima duk kayan da aka ba ka amanarsu don yin sujada a haikalin Allahnka.
english: The vessels that are given to you for the service of the house of your God, deliver before the God of Jerusalem.

hausa: “Tabbatacce, dukan annabawa daga Sama’ila zuwa gaba, dukansu da suka yi magana, sun rigya faɗin waɗannan kwanaki.
english: Yes, and all the prophets from Samuel and those who followed after, as many as have spoken, also told of these days.

hausa: Zai hukunta waɗanda ba su san Allah ba da kuma waɗanda ba su yi biyayya da bisharar Ubangijinmu Yesu ba.
english: punishing those who don’t know God, and to those who don’t obey the Good News of our Lord Jesus,

hausa: Haka kuma, ka ƙarfafa samari su zama masu kamunkai.
english: Likewise, exhort the younger men to be sober minded.

hausa: mai koyar da masu wauta, malamin jarirai, domin a cikin dokar ce akwai sani da gaskiya
english: a corrector of the foolish, a teacher of babies, having in the law the form of knowledge and of the truth.

hausa: Shi ya sa na yi fushi da wancan zamani, na kuma ce, ‘Kullum zukatansu a karkace suke, ba su kuma san hanyoyina ba.’
english: Therefore I was displeased with that generation, and said, ‘They always err in their heart, but they didn’t know my ways.’

hausa: Suka auri mata Mowabawa, sunan ɗaya Orfa ɗayan kuma Rut. Bayan sun zauna a can kamar shekara goma,
english: They took for themselves wives of the women of Moab. The name of the one was Orpah, and the name of the other was Ruth. They lived there about ten years.

hausa: “ ‘Akwai kuma wata babbar gaggafa mai manyan fikafikai da gashi mai yawa. Kuringan nan ta tanƙwasa saiwoyinta zuwa wajen wannan gaggafa daga inda aka shuka ta, ta kuma miƙe rassanta wajenta don gaggafar ta yi mata banruwa.
english: “‘“There was also another great eagle with great wings and many feathers. Behold, this vine bent its roots toward him, and shot out its branches toward him, from the ground where it was planted, that he might water it.

hausa: Da ranar Fentekos ta yi, dukansu suna tare wuri ɗaya.
english: Now when the day of Pentecost had come, they were all with one accord in one place.

hausa: Amma zan kafa alkawarina da kai, kai kuma za ka shiga jirgin, kai da ’ya’yanka maza da matarka da matan ’ya’yanka tare da kai.
english: But I will establish my covenant with you. You shall come into the ship, you, your sons, your wife, and your sons’ wives with you.

hausa: Ya kuma yi mulki a kan gabashin Araba daga tekun Kinneret zuwa Tekun Araba (wato, Tekun Gishiri), zuwa Bet-Yeshimot da kuma kudu zuwa gangaren dutsen Fisga.
english: and the Arabah to the sea of Chinneroth, eastward, and to the sea of the Arabah, even the Salt Sea, eastward, the way to Beth Jeshimoth; and on the south, under the slopes of Pisgah:

hausa: “Tun da daɗewa ka karya karkiyarka ka kuma tsintsinke sarƙoƙinka; sai ka ce, ‘Ba zan bauta maka ba!’ Tabbatacce, a kan kowane tudu mai tsayi da kuma a ƙarƙashin kowane ɗanyen itace ka kwanta kamar karuwa.
english: “For long ago I broke off your yoke, and burst your bonds. You said, ‘I will not serve;’ for on every high hill and under every green tree you bowed yourself, playing the prostitute.

hausa: In kuwa ya ba da ’ya’ya shekara mai zuwa, yana da kyau! In kuwa ba haka ba, sai ka sare shi.’ ”
english: If it bears fruit, fine; but if not, after that, you can cut it down.’”

hausa: Sai na ce, ‘Ga ni nan, a rubuce yake cikin naɗaɗɗen littafi na zo in aikata nufinka, ya Allah.’ ”
english: Then I said, ‘Behold, I have come (in the scroll of the book it is written of me) to do your will, O God.’”

hausa: Macen tana saye da tufafi masu ruwan ja da shunayya, tana ƙyalli da zinariya, duwatsu masu daraja da kuma lu’ulu’ai. Tana riƙe da kwaf na zinariya a hannunta, cike da abubuwa masu banƙyama da kuma ƙazantar zinace zinacenta.
english: The woman was dressed in purple and scarlet, and decked with gold and precious stones and pearls, having in her hand a golden cup full of abominations and the impurities of the sexual immorality of the earth.

hausa: “Kada ku ɗora wa wani, ku ma ba za a ɗora muku ba. Kada ku yanke wa wani hukunci, ku ma ba za a yanke muku ba. Ku gafarta, ku ma za a gafarta muku.
english: Don’t judge, and you won’t be judged. Don’t condemn, and you won’t be condemned. Set free, and you will be set free.

hausa: Musa da Eleyazar firist, suka karɓi zinariya daga shugabannin dubu-dubu da shugabannin ɗari-ɗari, suka kawo cikin Tentin Sujada, don su zama abin tuni ga Isra’ilawa a gaban Ubangiji.
english: Moses and Eleazar the priest took the gold of the captains of thousands and of hundreds, and brought it into the Tent of Meeting for a memorial for the children of Israel before Yahweh.

hausa: Gare shi wanda ya ci nasara ya kuma aikata nufina har ƙarshe, zan ba shi iko a kan al’ummai.
english: He who overcomes, and he who keeps my works to the end, to him I will give authority over the nations.

hausa: Mutanena za su zauna lafiya a wuraren salama, a gidaje masu kāriya, a wuraren hutun da babu fitina.
english: My people will live in a peaceful habitation, in safe dwellings, and in quiet resting places,

hausa: Ga kuma wani abin da kuke yi. Kukan cika bagaden Ubangiji da hawaye. Kukan yi kuka kuna ihu gama Ubangiji ba ya mai da hankali ga hadayunku ko yă karɓe su da farin ciki.
english: “This again you do: you cover Yahweh’s altar with tears, with weeping, and with sighing, because he doesn’t regard the offering any more, neither receives it with good will at your hand.

hausa: Sai suka gwada zurfin ruwan suka ga ya kai ƙafa ɗari da ashirin. Bayan ɗan lokaci kaɗan suka sāke gwadawa suka ga zurfin ya kai ƙafa tasa’in.
english: They took soundings and found twenty fathoms. After a little while, they took soundings again, and found fifteen fathoms.

hausa: Sun cika da kowace irin ƙeta, mugunta, kwaɗayi, da tunanin banza da wofi. Suka kuma cika da kishi, kisankai, faɗa, ruɗu, da kuma riƙo a zuci. Su masu gulma ne,
english: being filled with all unrighteousness, sexual immorality, wickedness, covetousness, malice; full of envy, murder, strife, deceit, evil habits, secret slanderers,

hausa: wanda ya sa zuciyarsa ga neman Allah, Ubangiji Allah na kakanninsa, ko da shi marar tsarki ne bisa ga dokokin wuri mai tsarki.”
english: who sets his heart to seek God, Yahweh, the God of his fathers, even if they aren’t clean according to the purification of the sanctuary.”

hausa: “Ka gaya wa mutane, ‘Ku tsarkake kanku don gobe, za ku ci nama. Ubangiji ya ji ku sa’ad da kuka yi kuka cewa, “Da mun sami nama mun ci mana! Ai, da ba mu da damuwa, gama lokacin da muke zama cikin Masar ba mu da damuwa!” Yanzu Ubangiji zai ba ku nama, za ku kuma ci.
english: “Say to the people, ‘Sanctify yourselves in preparation for tomorrow, and you will eat meat; for you have wept in the ears of Yahweh, saying, “Who will give us meat to eat? For it was well with us in Egypt.” Therefore Yahweh will give you meat, and you will eat.

hausa: Toho ɗaya yana a ƙarƙashin rassa biyu waɗanda suke daga wurin ajiye fitilan, toho na biyu yana a ƙarƙashin rassa biyu na biye, toho na uku kuma yana a ƙarƙashin rassa biyu na uku, duka-duka rassa shida ne.
english: and a bud under two branches of one piece with it, and a bud under two branches of one piece with it, and a bud under two branches of one piece with it, for the six branches going out of it.

hausa: in ba haka ba duk wanda ya ji zai kunyata ka ba za ka kuma taɓa rabuwa da wannan mummuna suna ba.
english: lest one who hears it put you to shame, and your bad reputation never depart.

hausa: “Sai mahaifinmu ya ce, ‘Ku koma ku sayo ƙarin abinci.’
english: Our father said, ‘Go again and buy us a little food.’

hausa: Na kawo gunagunina a gabansa; a gabansa na faɗa wahalata.
english: I pour out my complaint before him. I tell him my troubles.

hausa: Ku yi farin ciki a cikin Ubangiji, ku da kuke masu adalci, ku kuma yabi sunansa mai tsarki.
english: Be glad in Yahweh, you righteous people! Give thanks to his holy Name.

hausa: “Ga abin da Ubangiji Maɗaukaki, Allah na Isra’ila, yana cewa, ‘Ku saurara! Zan kawo wa wannan birni da ƙauyukan da suke kewayensa kowace masifar da na furta a kansu, domin sun yi taurinkai, ba su kuwa saurari maganata ba.’ ”
english: “Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel says, ‘Behold, I will bring on this city and on all its towns all the evil that I have pronounced against it, because they have made their neck stiff, that they may not hear my words.’”

hausa: Ana cikin haka, mutane a Yahuda suka ce, “Ƙarfin ma’aikata yana kāsawa, akwai kuma sauran tarkace da yawa da ba za mu iya sāke gina katangar ba.”
english: Judah said, “The strength of the bearers of burdens is fading and there is much rubble, so that we are not able to build the wall.”

hausa: sai ya sāke koma cikin fada. Ya tambayi Yesu, “Daga ina ka fito?” Amma Yesu bai amsa masa ba.
english: He entered into the Praetorium again, and said to Jesus, “Where are you from?” But Jesus gave him no answer.

hausa: Alherin Ubangijinmu Yesu Kiristi yă kasance tare da ku.
english: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you. Amen.

hausa: Ni kuma zan ce wa raina, “Kana da kaya da yawa masu kyau, da aka yi ajiyarsu domin shekaru da dama masu zuwa. Yi hutunka, ka ci, ka sha, ka yi annashuwa.” ’
english: I will tell my soul, “Soul, you have many goods laid up for many years. Take your ease, eat, drink, and be merry.”’

hausa: Da Yesu ya yi gaba daga wurin, sai ya ga wani mutum mai suna Mattiyu zaune a inda ake karɓar haraji. Ya ce masa, “Bi ni.” Mattiyu kuwa ya tashi ya bi shi.
english: As Jesus passed by from there, he saw a man called Matthew sitting at the tax collection office. He said to him, “Follow me.” He got up and followed him.

hausa: Ka ɗaukaka ƙahona kamar na ɓauna; an zubo mai masu kyau a kaina.
english: But you have exalted my horn like that of the wild ox. I am anointed with fresh oil.

hausa: Sai sarki ya ce, “Kawo mini takobi.” Sai aka kawo takobi wa sarki.
english: The king said, “Get me a sword.” So they brought a sword before the king.

hausa: Ƙarshen abu ya fi farkonsa, haƙuri kuma ya fi girman kai.
english: Better is the end of a thing than its beginning. The patient in spirit is better than the proud in spirit.

hausa: Zai zo ya yaƙi Masar, ya kawo mutuwa ga waɗanda aka ƙaddara musu mutuwa, zaman bauta ga waɗanda aka ƙaddara musu zaman bauta, da kuma takobi ga waɗanda aka ƙaddara su mutu ta takobi.
english: He will come, and will strike the land of Egypt; such as are for death will be put to death, and such as are for captivity to captivity, and such as are for the sword to the sword.

hausa: ka ce, ‘Ga abin da Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka yana cewa ina gāba da kai, Dutsen Seyir, zan kuma miƙa hannuna gāba da kai in mai da kai kango.
english: and tell it, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “Behold, I am against you, Mount Seir, and I will stretch out my hand against you. I will make you a desolation and an astonishment.

hausa: Na kuma ba su Asabbataina kamar alama tsakaninmu, domin su san cewa Ni Ubangiji ne yake tsarkake su.
english: Moreover also I gave them my Sabbaths, to be a sign between me and them, that they might know that I am Yahweh who sanctifies them.

hausa: Sai aka yi wata babbar girgizar ƙasa. Don wani mala’ikan Ubangiji ya sauka daga sama, ya je kabarin, ya gungurar da dutsen, ya kuma zauna a kai.
english: Behold, there was a great earthquake, for an angel of the Lord descended from the sky and came and rolled away the stone from the door and sat on it.

hausa: Ubangiji zai busar da bakin tekun Masar; da iska mai zafi zai share hannunsa a bisa Kogin Yuferites Zai rarraba shi yă zama ƙanana rafuffuka bakwai saboda mutane su iya hayewa da ƙafa.
english: Yahweh will utterly destroy the tongue of the Egyptian sea; and with his scorching wind he will wave his hand over the River, and will split it into seven streams, and cause men to march over in sandals.

hausa: Sai ya juya ya dube su, ya la’anta su da sunan Ubangiji. Sai beyar guda biyu suka fito daga jeji suka hallaka matasa arba’in da biyu daga cikinsu.
english: He looked behind him and saw them, and cursed them in Yahweh’s name. Then two female bears came out of the woods and mauled forty-two of those youths.

hausa: Ya yi kasai da ransa sa’ad da ya kashe Bafilistin nan. Ubangiji ya ba wa dukan Isra’ila babban nasara, ka gani, ka kuma yi farin ciki. Don me za ka ci mutuncin amintaccen mutum kamar Dawuda ta wurin kashe shi ba tare da wani dalili ba?”
english: for he put his life in his hand and struck the Philistine, and Yahweh worked a great victory for all Israel. You saw it and rejoiced. Why then will you sin against innocent blood, to kill David without a cause?”

hausa: In wani yana koyarwar ƙarya bai kuma yarda da sahihiyar koyarwar Ubangijinmu Yesu Kiristi da kuma koyarwa ta tsoron Allah ba,
english: If anyone teaches a different doctrine and doesn’t consent to sound words, the words of our Lord Jesus Christ, and to the doctrine which is according to godliness,

hausa: Za a yi mata abin ɗamara da irin kayan da aka yi efod da shi, wato, da zinariya, da shuɗi, da shunayya, da mulufi, da lallausan zaren lilin.
english: The skillfully woven band, which is on it, shall be like its work and of the same piece; of gold, blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen.

hausa: Da mutanen za su kama hanya su je su zāna yadda ƙasar take, Yoshuwa ya umarce su cewa, “Ku je ku ga yadda ƙasar take. Sa’an nan ku dawo wurina, zan yi muku ƙuri’a a nan Shilo a gaban Ubangiji.”
english: The men arose and went. Joshua commanded those who went to survey the land, saying, “Go walk through the land, survey it, and come again to me. I will cast lots for you here before Yahweh in Shiloh.”

hausa: hadayun ƙonawa da kuma hadayun zunubi ba ka ji daɗin.
english: You had no pleasure in whole burnt offerings and sacrifices for sin.

hausa: da kuma duk abubuwan da ya yi wa sarakuna biyu na Amoriyawa gabas da Urdun, Sihon sarkin Heshbon, da Og sarkin Bashan wanda ya yi mulki a Ashtarot.
english: and all that he did to the two kings of the Amorites who were beyond the Jordan, to Sihon king of Heshbon and to Og king of Bashan, who was at Ashtaroth.

hausa: A dā da Shawulu yake sarauta a bisanmu, kai ne kake bi Isra’ilawa zuwa yaƙe-yaƙensu. Ubangiji kuwa ya ce maka, ‘Za ka zama makiyayi mutanena Isra’ila, za ka kuma zama sarkinsu.’ ”
english: In times past, when Saul was king over us, it was you who led Israel out and in. Yahweh said to you, ‘You will be shepherd of my people Israel, and you will be prince over Israel.’”

hausa: Gama sa’ad da muka zo Makidoniya, jikin nan namu bai sami hutu ba, sai ma aka matsa mana a ta kowane gefe, a waje ga rikici, a zukatanmu kuma ga tsoro.
english: For even when we had come into Macedonia, our flesh had no relief, but we were afflicted on every side. Fightings were outside. Fear was inside.

hausa: Yayinda suke shan ruwan inabi, sarki ya sāke ce wa Esta, “Yanzu, mece ce bukatarki? Za a biya miki shi. Kuma mene ne roƙonki? Kai, ko rabin masarautata ce, za a ba ki.”
english: The king said to Esther at the banquet of wine, “What is your petition? It shall be granted you. What is your request? Even to the half of the kingdom it shall be performed.”

hausa: Ba a tunawa da mutanen dā, haka su ma da ba a haifa ba tukuna waɗanda za su biyo bayansu ba za a tuna da su ba.
english: There is no memory of the former; neither shall there be any memory of the latter that are to come, among those that shall come after.

hausa: Mutane za su zalunci juna mutum da mutum, maƙwabci da maƙwabci. Yara za su rena tsofaffi, ƙasƙantacce zai rena mai daraja.
english: The people will be oppressed, everyone by another, and everyone by his neighbor. The child will behave himself proudly against the old man, and the wicked against the honorable.

hausa: Idanunku za su ga sarki a cikin kyansa ku kuma hangi ƙasar da take shimfiɗe can da nisa.
english: Your eyes will see the king in his beauty. They will see a distant land.

hausa: Yayinda Yezebel tana kisan annabawan Ubangiji, Obadiya ya ɗauki annabawa ɗari ya ɓoye a kogwanni biyu, hamsin a kowanne, ya kuma tanada musu abinci da kuma ruwa.)
english: for when Jezebel cut off Yahweh’s prophets, Obadiah took one hundred prophets, and hid them fifty to a cave, and fed them with bread and water.)

hausa: Ga abin da za mu yi musu, za mu bar su da rai don kada fushin Allah yă sauka a kanmu gama mun riga mun rantse musu.”
english: We will do this to them, and let them live; lest wrath be on us, because of the oath which we swore to them.”

hausa: Annabawa suna annabcin ƙarya, firistoci suna mulki da ikon kansu, mutanena kuma suna son haka. Amma me za ku yi a ƙarshe?
english: The prophets prophesy falsely, and the priests rule by their own authority; and my people love to have it so. What will you do in the end of it?

hausa: “A gabana kuma ga dabba ta biyu, wadda ta yi kamar beyar. Aka ɗaga ta a gefenta guda, tana kuwa da haƙarƙarai uku a bakinta a tsakanin haƙoranta. Aka faɗa mata, ‘Tashi ki cika cikinki da ɗanyen nama!’
english: “Behold, there was another animal, a second, like a bear. It was raised up on one side, and three ribs were in its mouth between its teeth. They said this to it: ‘Arise! Devour much flesh!’

hausa: Ya ba su wani misali ya ce, “Mulkin sama yana kama da ƙwayar mustad, wadda mutum ya ɗauka ya shuka a gonarsa.
english: He set another parable before them, saying, “The Kingdom of Heaven is like a grain of mustard seed which a man took, and sowed in his field,

hausa: waɗanda Ubangiji ya ba wa Musa a Dutsen Sinai, a Hamadar Sinai, a ranar da ya umarci Isra’ilawa su kawo hadayunsu ga Ubangiji.
english: which Yahweh commanded Moses in Mount Sinai in the day that he commanded the children of Israel to offer their offerings to Yahweh, in the wilderness of Sinai.

hausa: a kan adalci, domin zan tafi wurin Uba, inda ba za ku ƙara ganina ba;
english: about righteousness, because I am going to my Father, and you won’t see me any more;

hausa: Dole mai hidimar ikkilisiya yă zama mijin mace guda dole kuma yă iya tafiyar da ’ya’yansa da kuma iyalinsa da kyau.
english: Let servants be husbands of one wife, ruling their children and their own houses well.

hausa: A waccan rana zan yi alkawari dominsu da namun jeji da kuma tsuntsayen sararin sama da dukan halittu masu rarrafe a ƙasa. Baka da takobi da yaƙi zan sa su ƙare a ƙasar, domin duk su zauna lafiya.
english: In that day I will make a covenant for them with the animals of the field, and with the birds of the sky, and with the creeping things of the ground. I will break the bow, the sword, and the battle out of the land, and will make them lie down safely.

hausa: “Ko wannan ba wani abu ba ne a wurinku, dukanku masu wucewa? Ku duba ku gani. Ko akwai wata wahala kamar irin wadda nake sha, wadda Ubangiji ya auko mini a cikin zafin fushinsa?
