english: “Is it nothing to you, all you who pass by? Look, and see if there is any sorrow like my sorrow, which is brought on me, with which Yahweh has afflicted me in the day of his fierce anger.

hausa: Karnuka sun kewaye ni; ƙungiyar mugaye sun sa ni a tsaka, sun soki hannuwana da ƙafafuna.
english: For dogs have surrounded me. A company of evildoers have enclosed me. They have pierced my hands and feet.

hausa: Na faɗa muku yau, amma har yanzu ba ku yi biyayya ga Ubangiji Allahnku cikin dukan abin da ya aiko ni in faɗa muku ba.
english: I have declared it to you today; but you have not obeyed Yahweh your God’s voice in anything for which he has sent me to you.

hausa: Ya kuma ce wa wani mutum, “Ka bi ni.” Amma mutumin ya amsa ya ce, “Ubangiji, bari in je in binne mahaifina tukuna.”
english: He said to another, “Follow me!” But he said, “Lord, allow me first to go and bury my father.”

hausa: Kagararsu za tă fāɗi saboda razana; da ganin matsayin yaƙin, shugabannin yaƙinsu za su firgita,” in ji Ubangiji, wanda wutarsa tana a Sihiyona, wanda matoyarsa tana a Urushalima.
english: His rock will pass away by reason of terror, and his princes will be afraid of the banner,” says Yahweh, whose fire is in Zion, and his furnace in Jerusalem.

hausa: Sai Yesu ya tafi tare da shi. Babban taron kuma ya bi shi, suna ta matsinsa a kowane gefe.
english: He went with him, and a great multitude followed him, and they pressed upon him on all sides.

hausa: Kin kuma yi karuwanci da Assuriyawa, domin ba kya ƙoshi; kai ko bayan wannan, ba ki ƙoshi ba.
english: You have played the prostitute also with the Assyrians, because you were insatiable; yes, you have played the prostitute with them, and yet you weren’t satisfied.

hausa: “Ko a yau, ina kuka mai zafi; hannunsa yana da nauyi duk da nishin da nake yi.
english: “Even today my complaint is rebellious. His hand is heavy in spite of my groaning.

hausa: Saboda sunanka, ya Ubangiji, ka gafarta laifina, ko da yake mai girma ne.
english: For your name’s sake, Yahweh, pardon my iniquity, for it is great.

hausa: Zabura ta Asaf. Allah yana shugabanta cikin babban taro; yakan zartar da hukunci a cikin “alloli”.
english: A Psalm by Asaph. God presides in the great assembly. He judges among the gods.

hausa: Kafin shekarun yunwa su zo, Asenat ’yar Fotifera, firist na On, ta haifa wa Yusuf ’ya’ya maza biyu.
english: To Joseph were born two sons before the year of famine came, whom Asenath, the daughter of Potiphera priest of On, bore to him.

hausa: Ba shakka, kamar yadda gaskiyar Kiristi take a cikina, babu wani a yankunan Akayya da zai iya hana yin taƙaman nan tawa.
english: As the truth of Christ is in me, no one will stop me from this boasting in the regions of Achaia.

hausa: Wannan da ya kasance tun farko, wanda muka ji, wanda muka gani da idanunmu, wanda muka duba, hannuwanmu kuma suka taɓa, wannan ne muke shela game da Kalman rai.
english: That which was from the beginning, that which we have heard, that which we have seen with our eyes, that which we saw, and our hands touched, concerning the Word of life

hausa: Amma yaron nan Sama’ila, yana hidima a gaban Ubangiji yana sanye da efod na lilin.
english: But Samuel ministered before Yahweh, being a child, clothed with a linen ephod.

hausa: Sa’an nan na ga mugayen ruhohi guda uku da suka yi kamar kwaɗi; suka fito daga bakin macijin nan, da kuma daga bakin dabbar, da kuma daga bakin annabin ƙaryan nan.
english: I saw coming out of the mouth of the dragon, and out of the mouth of the beast, and out of the mouth of the false prophet, three unclean spirits, something like frogs;

hausa: Sai ya ɗauki rigar da ta fāɗo daga Iliya ya koma ya tsaya a gaɓar Kogin Urdun.
english: He also took up Elijah’s mantle that fell from him, and went back and stood by the bank of the Jordan.

hausa: Haka yake. Amma an sassare su ne saboda rashin bangaskiya, kai kuma kana tsaye ta wurin bangaskiya. Kada ka yi taƙama, sai dai ka ji tsoro.
english: True; by their unbelief they were broken off, and you stand by your faith. Don’t be conceited, but fear;

hausa: Yokshan shi ne mahaifin Sheba da Dedan. Zuriyar Dedan su ne mutanen Ashur, da mutanen Letush, da kuma mutanen Lewummin.
english: Jokshan became the father of Sheba, and Dedan. The sons of Dedan were Asshurim, Letushim, and Leummim.

hausa: “Ka aika da wannan saƙo zuwa ga dukan masu zaman bauta cewa, ‘Ga abin da Ubangiji yana cewa game da Shemahiya, mutumin Nehelam. Domin Shemahiya ya yi muku annabci, ko da yake ban aike shi ba, ya kuma sa kuka gaskata ƙarya,
english: “Send to all of the captives, saying, ‘Yahweh says concerning Shemaiah the Nehelamite: “Because Shemaiah has prophesied to you, and I didn’t send him, and he has caused you to trust in a lie,”

hausa: shamuwa, kowane irin jinjimi, katutu da kuma jamage.
english: the stork, any kind of heron, the hoopoe, and the bat.

hausa: “Me kuke tsammani game da Kiristi? Ɗan wane ne shi?” Suka amsa suka ce, “Ɗan Dawuda.”
english: saying, “What do you think of the Christ? Whose son is he?” They said to him, “Of David.”

hausa: Sai ya shiga jirgin ruwa, almajiransa kuwa suka bi shi.
english: When he got into a boat, his disciples followed him.

hausa: Mala’ikan da ya cece ni daga dukan cuta bari yă albarkaci samarin nan. Bari a kira su da sunana da sunayen kakannina Ibrahim da Ishaku bari kuma su ƙaru ƙwarai a bisa duniya.”
english: the angel who has redeemed me from all evil, bless the lads, and let my name be named on them, and the name of my fathers Abraham and Isaac. Let them grow into a multitude upon the earth.”

hausa: Kai kuwa, ɗan mutum, kada ka ji tsoro, ko da sarƙaƙƙiya da ƙayayyuwa duk sun kewaye ka kana kuma zama a cikin kunamai. Kada ka ji tsoron abin da za ka faɗa ko ka firgita ta wurinsu, ko da yake su gida ne mai tawaye.
english: You, son of man, don’t be afraid of them, neither be afraid of their words, though briers and thorns are with you, and you dwell among scorpions. Don’t be afraid of their words, nor be dismayed at their looks, though they are a rebellious house.

hausa: Tun farar farawa akwai Kalma, Kalman kuwa yana nan tare da Allah, Kalman kuwa Allah ne.
english: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God.

hausa: Sa’an nan Isuwa ya ce, “Bari mu tafi, zan yi maka rakiya.”
english: Esau said, “Let’s take our journey, and let’s go, and I will go before you.”

hausa: Bayan na dudduba abubuwa, sai na miƙe tsaye na ce wa manyan gari da shugabanni da kuma sauran jama’a, “Kada ku ji tsoronsu. Ku tuna da Ubangiji, wanda yake mai girma da banrazana, ku yi yaƙi don ’yan’uwanku, da ’ya’yanku maza da mata, da matanku da kuma gidajenku.”
english: I looked, and rose up, and said to the nobles, to the rulers, and to the rest of the people, “Don’t be afraid of them! Remember the Lord, who is great and awesome, and fight for your brothers, your sons, your daughters, your wives, and your houses.”

hausa: A ranan nan Yoshuwa ya ci Makkeda da yaƙi. Ya karkashe mutanen tare da sarkinta. Bai bar wani da rai ba. Ya yi wa sarkin Makkeda yadda ya yi wa sarkin Yeriko.
english: Joshua took Makkedah on that day, and struck it with the edge of the sword, with its king. He utterly destroyed it and all the souls who were in it. He left no one remaining. He did to the king of Makkedah as he had done to the king of Jericho.

hausa: Ta haka, ba ya sauran rayuwarsa a kan mugayen sha’awace-sha’awacen jiki, sai dai nufin Allah.
english: that you no longer should live the rest of your time in the flesh for the lusts of men, but for the will of God.

hausa: “Ɗan mutum, ka fuskanci wajen Ammonawa ka kuma yi annabci a kansu.
english: “Son of man, set your face toward the children of Ammon, and prophesy against them.

hausa: Su ne suka yi magana da Fir’auna sarkin Masar game da fitar da Isra’ilawa daga Masar, wannan Musa da Haruna.
english: These are those who spoke to Pharaoh king of Egypt, to bring out the children of Israel from Egypt. These are that Moses and Aaron.

hausa: Ya ce, “Na yi zunubi da na ci amanar marar laifi.” Suka ce masa, “Ina ruwanmu da wannan? Wannan dai ruwanka ne.”
english: saying, “I have sinned in that I betrayed innocent blood.” But they said, “What is that to us? You see to it.”

hausa: Ga abin da Ubangiji Maɗaukaki, Allahna Isra’ila, yana cewa ku gyara hanyoyinku da ayyukanku, zan kuwa bar ku ku zauna a wannan wuri.
english: Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel says, “Amend your ways and your doings, and I will cause you to dwell in this place.

hausa: Taron mutane mai yawa suna tafiya tare da Yesu, sai ya juya ya ce musu,
english: Now great multitudes were going with him. He turned and said to them,

hausa: Ya Ubangiji Allah na kakanninmu Ibrahim, Ishaku da Isra’ila, ka sa wannan sha’awa a cikin zukatan mutanenka har abada, ka kuma bar zukatansu su yi maka biyayya.
english: Yahweh, the God of Abraham, of Isaac, and of Israel, our fathers, keep this desire forever in the thoughts of the heart of your people, and prepare their heart for you;

hausa: Sa’ad da Bulus ya kai bakin matakala, sai da sojoji suka ɗaga shi sama saboda tsananin haukan taron.
english: When he came to the stairs, he was carried by the soldiers because of the violence of the crowd;

hausa: “ ‘Saboda haka ga abin da Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka ya ce musu, duba, ni kaina zan hukunta tsakanin turkakkun tumaki da ramammun tumaki.
english: “Therefore the Lord Yahweh says to them: ‘Behold, I, even I, will judge between the fat sheep and the lean sheep.

hausa: “Ɗan mutum, ka fuskanci Fir’auna sarkin Masar ka kuma yi annabci gāba da shi da dukan Masar.
english: “Son of man, set your face against Pharaoh king of Egypt, and prophesy against him and against all Egypt.

hausa: Amma mahaifinsa zai mutu saboda zunubinsa, domin ya yi ƙwace, ya yi wa ɗan’uwansa fashi ya kuma yi abin da ba daidai ba a cikin mutanensa.
english: As for his father, because he cruelly oppressed, robbed his brother, and did that which is not good among his people, behold, he will die in his iniquity.

hausa: Amma aka tumɓuke ta cikin fushi aka jefar da ita a ƙasa. Iskar gabas ta sa ta yanƙwane, aka kakkaɓe ’ya’yanta; rassanta masu ƙarfi suka bushe wuta kuma ta cinye su.
english: But it was plucked up in fury. It was cast down to the ground, and the east wind dried up its fruit. Its strong branches were broken off and withered. The fire consumed them.

hausa: Masu adalci za su ga su ji tsoro; za su yi masa dariya, suna cewa,
english: The righteous also will see it, and fear, and laugh at him, saying,

hausa: Daga baya, a lokacin girbin alkama, Samson ya ɗauki ɗan akuya ya tafi yă ziyarci matarsa. Sai ya ce, “Zan in shiga ɗakin matata.” Amma mahaifinta ya hana shi shiga.
english: But after a while, in the time of wheat harvest, Samson visited his wife with a young goat. He said, “I will go in to my wife’s room.” But her father wouldn’t allow him to go in.

hausa: “Simeyon da Lawi ’yan’uwa ne, takubansu makamai ne na tā da hankali.
english: “Simeon and Levi are brothers. Their swords are weapons of violence.

hausa: Da ma kaina maɓulɓulan ruwa ne idanuna kuma maɓulɓulan hawaye! Da sai in yi kuka dare da rana saboda mutanena da aka kashe.
english: Oh that my head were waters, and my eyes a spring of tears, that I might weep day and night for the slain of the daughter of my people!

hausa: Yayinda da nake magana da addu’a, ina furta zunubina da zunubin mutanena Isra’ila ina miƙa koke-kokena ga Ubangiji Allahna saboda tudunsa mai tsarki,
english: While I was speaking, praying, and confessing my sin and the sin of my people Israel, and presenting my supplication before Yahweh my God for the holy mountain of my God—

hausa: Game da ke, ya hasumiyar tsaron garke, Ya mafaka Diyar Sihiyona, za a maido miki da mulkinki na dā, sarauta kuma za tă zo wa Diyar Urushalima.”
english: You, tower of the flock, the hill of the daughter of Zion, to you it will come. Yes, the former dominion will come, the kingdom of the daughter of Jerusalem.

hausa: zai zama abu ɗaya ga firist kamar yadda yake ga mutane, ga maigida kamar yadda yake ga bawa, ga uwargijiya kamar yadda yake ga baiwa, ga mai sayarwa kamar yadda yake ga mai saya, ga mai karɓan rance kamar yadda yake ga mai ba da rance, ga mai karɓan bashi kamar yadda yake ga mai ba da bashi.
english: It will be as with the people, so with the priest; as with the servant, so with his master; as with the maid, so with her mistress; as with the buyer, so with the seller; as with the creditor, so with the debtor; as with the taker of interest, so with the giver of interest.

hausa: Ina sa rai a cikin Ubangiji Yesu cewa zan aika da Timoti zuwa gare ku ba da daɗewa ba, don ni ma in ji daɗi sa’ad da na ji labarinku.
english: But I hope in the Lord Jesus to send Timothy to you soon, that I also may be cheered up when I know how you are doing.

hausa: Muna roƙonka, ka yarda mana mu bi ta ƙasarka. Ba za mu bi ta wani fili, ko gonar inabi ba, ko mu sha ruwa daga wata rijiya ba. Za mu bi ta babban hanyar sarki, ba kuwa za mu kauce dama, ko hagu ba, har mu wuce yankinka.”
english: “Please let us pass through your land. We will not pass through field or through vineyard, neither will we drink from the water of the wells. We will go along the king’s highway. We will not turn away to the right hand nor to the left, until we have passed your border.”

hausa: Abin da na yi ke nan a Urushalima. Da izinin manyan firistoci na sa tsarkaka da yawa a kurkuku, sa’ad da kuma ake kashe su, nakan ka da ƙuri’ata gāba da su.
english: I also did this in Jerusalem. I both shut up many of the saints in prisons, having received authority from the chief priests; and when they were put to death I gave my vote against them.

hausa: Saboda haka, ya sarki, ina roƙonka ka karɓi shawarar da zan ba ka; ka furta zunubanka ta wurin yin abin da yake daidai. Ka bar muguntarka, ka aikata alheri ga waɗanda ake wulaƙantawa, wataƙila za a ƙara tsawon kwanakinka da salama.”
english: Therefore, O king, let my counsel be acceptable to you, and break off your sins by righteousness, and your iniquities by showing mercy to the poor. Perhaps there may be a lengthening of your tranquility.”

hausa: Game da zuriyar Hebron kuwa, Yeriya ne babba bisa ga tarihin zuriyar iyalansu. A shekara ta arba’in ta sarautar Dawuda, sai aka yi binciken tarihi, aka tarar jarumawa cikin zuriyar Hebron suna zama a Yazer cikin Gileyad ne.
english: Of the Hebronites, Jerijah was the chief of the Hebronites, according to their generations by fathers’ households. They were sought for in the fortieth year of the reign of David, and mighty men of valor were found among them at Jazer of Gilead.

hausa: Sai ya ce musu, “Raina yana cike da baƙin ciki har ma kamar zan mutu. Ku dakata a nan ku yi tsaro.”
english: He said to them, “My soul is exceedingly sorrowful, even to death. Stay here and watch.”

hausa: Kefar Ammoni, Ofni da Geba, garuruwa goma sha biyu ke nan da ƙauyukansu.
english: Chephar Ammoni, Ophni, and Geba; twelve cities with their villages.

hausa: Yusuf kuwa ya fāɗa a kan mahaifinsa, ya yi kuka a kansa, ya kuma sumbace shi.
english: Joseph fell on his father’s face, wept on him, and kissed him.

hausa: sai Isra’ilawa suka wuce cikin teku a kan busasshiyar ƙasa, ruwan ya zama musu katanga dama da hagu.
english: The children of Israel went into the middle of the sea on the dry ground; and the waters were a wall to them on their right hand and on their left.

hausa: Balak ya ce wa Bala’am, “Me ke nan ka yi mini? Na kawo ka, ka la’anta abokan gābana, sai ga shi albarka kake sa musu!”
english: Balak said to Balaam, “What have you done to me? I took you to curse my enemies, and behold, you have blessed them altogether.”

hausa: Da farin ciki zan ɗebo ruwa daga rijiyoyin ceto.
english: Therefore with joy you will draw water out of the wells of salvation.

hausa: Ku yi hankali, ku yi biyayya da dukan waɗannan umarnan da nake ba ku, da kuma ’ya’yanku, don ku zauna lafiya, da ku da ’ya’yanku a bayanku, gama za ku riƙa aikata abin da yake daidai da kuma yake mai kyau a gaban Ubangiji Allahnku.
english: Observe and hear all these words which I command you, that it may go well with you and with your children after you forever, when you do that which is good and right in Yahweh your God’s eyes.

hausa: Ku tashi! Mu tafi! Ga mai bashe ni ɗin yana zuwa!”
english: Arise! Let’s get going. Behold, he who betrays me is at hand.”

hausa: Sai shi da Dawuda suka shiga gonar sha’ir ɗin, suka tsaya ciki don su tsare ta. Suka ragargaza Filistiyawa, Ubangiji kuma ya kawo babban nasara.
english: They stood in the middle of the plot, defended it, and killed the Philistines; and Yahweh saved them by a great victory.

hausa: Abin da ya taɓa kasancewa, zai sāke kasance, abin da aka yi za a sāke yi kuma; babu wani abu sabo a duniya.
english: That which has been is that which shall be, and that which has been done is that which shall be done; and there is no new thing under the sun.

hausa: “Ka ce, ‘Saurara yanzu, zan kuma yi magana zan tambaye ka, kuma za ka amsa mini.’
english: You said, ‘Listen, now, and I will speak; I will question you, and you will answer me.’

hausa: Allah ya kasance da yaron, yayinda yake girma. Ya yi zama a jeji, ya kuma zama maharbi.
english: God was with the boy, and he grew. He lived in the wilderness, and as he grew up, he became an archer.

hausa: Kai, yadda halitta take ma, ai, ta koya muku cewa in namiji yana da dogon gashi, abin kunya ne a gare shi,
english: Doesn’t even nature itself teach you that if a man has long hair, it is a dishonor to him?

hausa: Sai ya kira ni ya ce, “Duba, waɗanda suka nufi wajen ƙasar arewa sun ba wa Ruhuna hutu a ƙasar arewa.”
english: Then he called to me, and spoke to me, saying, “Behold, those who go toward the north country have quieted my spirit in the north country.”

hausa: Gama Allah zai shari’anta kowane irin aiki, har da waɗanda aka yi a ɓoye, ko nagari ne, ko mugu.
english: For God will bring every work into judgment, with every hidden thing, whether it is good, or whether it is evil.

hausa: Zakoki goma sha biyu sun tsaya a kan matakalai shida, ɗaya a ƙarshen matakala guda. Ba a taɓa yin irin wannan abu don wata masarauta ba.
english: Twelve lions stood there on the one side and on the other on the six steps. There was nothing like it made in any other kingdom.

hausa: Dawuda ya sa wannan tă zama dawwammamiyar farilla ga Isra’ila tun daga wannan rana har yă zuwa yau.
english: It was so from that day forward that he made it a statute and an ordinance for Israel to this day.

hausa: Ka kawo ta gidanka ka sa tă aske kanta, tă yanka kumbanta
english: then you shall bring her home to your house. She shall shave her head and trim her nails.

hausa: “Haka Ubana da yake cikin sama zai yi da kowannenku, in ba ku yafe wa ’yan’uwanku daga zuciyarku ba.”
english: So my heavenly Father will also do to you, if you don’t each forgive your brother from your hearts for his misdeeds.”

hausa: Gama dukanku da aka yi muku baftisma cikin Kiristi, kuna sanye da Kiristi ke nan.
english: For as many of you as were baptized into Christ have put on Christ.

hausa: Bulus ya ce, “Ai, baftismar Yohanna, baftisma ce ta tuba. Ya ce wa mutane su gaskata a wani wanda yake zuwa bayansa, wato, Yesu.”
english: Paul said, “John indeed baptized with the baptism of repentance, saying to the people that they should believe in the one who would come after him, that is, in Christ Jesus.”

hausa: Wawa yakan kame hannuwansa yă kuma lalatar da kansa.
english: The fool folds his hands together and ruins himself.

hausa: Sai ta mamanne gashin awakin nan biyu a hannuwansa da bayan wuyarsa wanda ba gashi.
english: She put the skins of the young goats on his hands, and on the smooth of his neck.

hausa: Suka taimaki Dawuda a kan ƙungiyoyin hari, gama dukansu jarumawa ne sosai, kuma su shugabanni ne a cikin mayaƙansa.
english: They helped David against the band of raiders, for they were all mighty men of valor and were captains in the army.

hausa: “Sai mai gonar inabin ya ce, ‘Me zan yi? Zan aiki ɗana da nake ƙauna, wataƙila za su girmama shi.’
english: The lord of the vineyard said, ‘What shall I do? I will send my beloved son. It may be that seeing him, they will respect him.’

hausa: Ba shakka yana iya gane mutanen da suke marasa gaskiya; kuma in ya ga abin da yake mugu, ba ya kula ne?
english: For he knows false men. He sees iniquity also, even though he doesn’t consider it.

hausa: Wuta tana fitowa daga bakinta; tartsatsin wuta suna fitowa,
english: Out of his mouth go burning torches. Sparks of fire leap out.

hausa: Cin hanci kamar sihiri yake ga wanda yake ba da shi; ko’ina ya juye, yakan yi nasara.
english: A bribe is a precious stone in the eyes of him who gives it; wherever he turns, he prospers.

hausa: Zuciyar mai hikima kan bi da bakinsa, kuma leɓunansa kan inganta umarni.
english: The heart of the wise instructs his mouth, and adds learning to his lips.

hausa: Saboda haka sai ku kula da kanku sosai, ku ƙaunaci Ubangiji Allahnku.
english: Take good heed therefore to yourselves, that you love Yahweh your God.

hausa: Saboda haka in ka yi mini sujada, dukan wannan zai zama naka.”
english: If you therefore will worship before me, it will all be yours.”

hausa: Saboda haka Ubangiji ya kawo manyan hafsoshin mayaƙan sarkin Assuriya a kansu, waɗanda suka ɗauki Manasse a matsayi ɗan kurkuku, suka sa ƙugiya a hancinsa, suka daure shi da sarƙoƙin tagulla suka kuma kai shi Babilon.
english: Therefore Yahweh brought on them the captains of the army of the king of Assyria, who took Manasseh in chains, bound him with fetters, and carried him to Babylon.

hausa: Ba kuwa don su zuriyarsa ne dukansu suka zama ’ya’yan Ibrahim ba. A maimako, “Ta wurin Ishaku ne za a lissafta zuriyarka.”
english: Neither, because they are Abraham’s offspring, are they all children. But, “your offspring will be accounted as from Isaac.”

hausa: Sai ya gina birni kewaye da shi, daga madogaran gini zuwa katangar da take kewaye, yayinda Yowab ya maido da sauran birnin.
english: He built the city all around, from Millo even around; and Joab repaired the rest of the city.

hausa: Hafarayim, Anaharat,
english: Hapharaim, Shion, Anaharath,

hausa: Aka kuma cika nassin nan da ya ce, “Ibrahim ya gaskata Allah, aka kuma lissafta wannan adalci ne gare shi,” aka kuma ce da shi abokin Allah.
english: So the Scripture was fulfilled which says, “Abraham believed God, and it was accounted to him as righteousness,” and he was called the friend of God.

hausa: don su ji tsoronka su kuma yi tafiya a hanyoyinka a kowane lokacin da suke zama a ƙasar da ka ba wa kakanninsu.
english: that they may fear you, to walk in your ways as long as they live in the land which you gave to our fathers.

hausa: Sa’ad da kuka gina sabon gida, ku ja masa dakali kewaye da rufinku don kada ku jawo laifin zub da jini a kan gidanku in wani ya fāɗi daga kan rufin.
english: When you build a new house, then you shall make a railing around your roof, so that you don’t bring blood on your house if anyone falls from there.

hausa: duhu kawai yake jiran dukiyarsa. Wutar da ba a fifita ba za tă cinye shi ta kuma ƙona duk abin da ya rage a tentinsa.
english: All darkness is laid up for his treasures. An unfanned fire will devour him. It will consume that which is left in his tent.

hausa: Daniyel kuwa ya kasance a nan har shekara ta farko ta mulkin sarki Sairus.
english: Daniel continued even to the first year of King Cyrus.

hausa: Saboda haka Ebed-Melek ya ɗauki mutane tare da shi suka shiga ɗaki a ƙarƙashin baitulmali a cikin fada. Ya ɗauko waɗansu tsofaffin tsummoki da tsofaffi riguna daga can ya kuma zurara su da igiya wa Irmiya a cikin rijiyar.
english: So Ebedmelech took the men with him, and went into the house of the king under the treasury, and took from there rags and worn-out garments, and let them down by cords into the dungeon to Jeremiah.

hausa: A wannan lokaci zan bincike Urushalima da fitilu in kuma hukunta waɗanda ba su kula ba, waɗanda suke kamar ruwan inabin da aka bar a ƙasan tukunya, waɗanda suke tsammani, ‘Ubangiji ba zai yi kome ba nagari ko mummuna.’
english: It will happen at that time, that I will search Jerusalem with lamps, and I will punish the men who are settled on their dregs, who say in their heart, “Yahweh will not do good, neither will he do evil.”

hausa: Amma ko gashi ɗaya na kanku, ba zai hallaka ba.
english: And not a hair of your head will perish.

hausa: Zai zama kamar mai tace azurfa da mai tsarkaketa; zai tsabtacce Lawiyawa, yă kuma tace su kamar zinariya da azurfa. Sa’an nan Ubangiji zai sami mutanen da za su kawo hadayu a cikin adalci.
english: and he will sit as a refiner and purifier of silver, and he will purify the sons of Levi, and refine them as gold and silver; and they shall offer to Yahweh offerings in righteousness.

hausa: Ga abin da Ubangiji yana cewa, “Ka rabu da wannan mutum sai ka ce marar ’ya’ya, mutumin da ba zai yi nasara a rayuwarsa ba, gama babu zuriyarsa da za tă yi nasara babu wani da zai zauna a kursiyin Dawuda ko ya ƙara yin mulkin Yahuda.”
english: Yahweh says, “Record this man as childless, a man who will not prosper in his days; for no more will a man of his offspring prosper, sitting on David’s throne and ruling in Judah.”

hausa: Sai Irmiya ta ɗauko wani littafi ya ba wa Baruk ɗan Neriya marubuci, kuma yayinda Irmiya yake shibtawa, Baruk ya rubuta a littafin dukan maganar da take a littafin da Yehohiyakim sarkin Yahuda ya ƙone. Ya kuma ƙara ire-iren maganganun nan a kansu.
english: Then Jeremiah took another scroll, and gave it to Baruch the scribe, the son of Neriah, who wrote therein from the mouth of Jeremiah all the words of the book which Jehoiakim king of Judah had burned in the fire; and many similar words were added to them.

hausa: Sa’an nan Yesu ya ce wa taron mutane da kuma almajiransa,
english: Then Jesus spoke to the multitudes and to his disciples,

hausa: Dukan waɗannan la’anoni za su sauko a kanku. Za su bi ku, su same ku, sai an hallaka ku, domin ba ku yi biyayya ga Ubangiji Allahnku, kuka kuma kiyaye umarnai da ƙa’idodin da ya ba ku ba.
english: All these curses will come on you, and will pursue you and overtake you, until you are destroyed, because you didn’t listen to Yahweh your God’s voice, to keep his commandments and his statutes which he commanded you.

hausa: Ahab kuma ya aika a kawo Obadiya, sarkin fadansa (Obadiya dai cikakken mai gaskata da Ubangiji ne.
english: Ahab called Obadiah, who was over the household. (Now Obadiah feared Yahweh greatly;

hausa: Abokaina ƙaunatattu, wannan ita ce wasiƙata ta biyu gare ku. Na rubuta su biyun su zama abin tuni don su faɗakar da ku ga tunani mai kyau.
english: This is now, beloved, the second letter that I have written to you; and in both of them I stir up your sincere mind by reminding you

hausa: Kada ku ƙasƙantar da sunana mai tsarki. Dole Isra’ilawa su gane Ni mai tsarki ne. Ni ne Ubangiji, wanda ya keɓe ku a matsayin tsarkaka
english: You shall not profane my holy name, but I will be made holy among the children of Israel. I am Yahweh who makes you holy,

hausa: A shekara ta uku ta Asa sarkin Yahuda, Ba’asha ɗan Ahiya ya zama sarkin dukan Isra’ila a Tirza, ya kuma yi sarauta shekara ashirin da huɗu.
english: In the third year of Asa king of Judah, Baasha the son of Ahijah began to reign over all Israel in Tirzah for twenty-four years.

hausa: Firist zai ƙone su a kan bagade kamar abinci, hadaya ce da aka yi da wuta, mai daɗin ƙanshi. Dukan kitsen na Ubangiji ne.
english: The priest shall burn them on the altar: it is the food of the offering made by fire, for a pleasant aroma; all the fat is Yahweh’s.

hausa: Na zama kamar asu ga Efraim, kamar ruɓa ga mutanen Yahuda.
english: Therefore I am to Ephraim like a moth, and to the house of Judah like rottenness.

hausa: na nanata abubuwan da suka riga suka faru tuntuni, bakina ya yi shelar su na kuma sanar da su; sai nan da nan na aikata, suka kuma faru.
english: I have declared the former things from of old. Yes, they went out of my mouth, and I revealed them. I did them suddenly, and they happened.

hausa: Akwai Lawiyawa shida da suke tsaron ƙofar gabas, huɗu a ƙofar kudu, huɗu kuma a ƙofar arewa, biyu-biyu suke tsaron ɗakunan ajiya.
english: Eastward were six Levites, northward four a day, southward four a day, and for the storehouse two and two.

hausa: domin ba su taryi Isra’ila da abinci da ruwa ba amma suka yi hayar Bala’am don yă kira la’ana a kansu. (Amma Allahnmu, ya mai da la’anar ta zama albarka.)
english: because they didn’t meet the children of Israel with bread and with water, but hired Balaam against them to curse them; however, our God turned the curse into a blessing.

hausa: “ ‘Sa’ad da kuka shiga ƙasar kuka kuma shuka kowane irin itace mai ’ya’ya na ci, ku ɗauki ’ya’yan itatuwan nan a matsayi an hana ku ci. Shekara uku za ku ɗauka a matsayi an hana ku, ba za ku ci su ba.
english: “‘When you come into the land, and have planted all kinds of trees for food, then you shall count their fruit as forbidden. For three years it shall be forbidden to you. It shall not be eaten.

hausa: Sa’ad da ɗan’uwanka ya daina fushi da kai, ya kuma manta da abin da ka yi masa, zan aika don ka dawo daga can. Don me zan rasa ku biyu a rana guda?”
english: until your brother’s anger turns away from you, and he forgets what you have done to him. Then I will send, and get you from there. Why should I be bereaved of you both in one day?”

hausa: Ka karɓi yabon bakina da nake yi da yardar rai, ya Ubangiji, ka kuwa koya mini dokokinka.
english: Accept, I beg you, the willing offerings of my mouth. Yahweh, teach me your ordinances.

hausa: Za ka sāke jin tausayinmu; za ka tattake zunubanmu a ƙarƙashin sawunka ka kuma tura dukan kurakuranmu zuwa cikin zurfafan teku.
english: He will again have compassion on us. He will tread our iniquities under foot. You will cast all their sins into the depths of the sea.

hausa: awaki ɗari biyu da bunsurai ashirin, tumaki ɗari biyu da raguna ashirin,
english: two hundred female goats and twenty male goats, two hundred ewes and twenty rams,

hausa: Lokacin haihuwa da lokacin mutuwa, lokacin shuki da lokacin tumɓukewa.
english: a time to be born, and a time to die; a time to plant, and a time to pluck up that which is planted;

hausa: Na kuma tattara su a bakin rafi wanda yake gangarawa zuwa Ahawa, muka kafa sansani a can kwana uku. Da na bincika cikin mutane da firistoci, sai na tarar babu Lawiyawa.
english: I gathered them together to the river that runs to Ahava; and there we encamped three days. Then I looked around at the people and the priests, and found there were none of the sons of Levi.

hausa: sai ya ce, “Ku ba da wuri. Ai, yarinyar ba tă mutu ba, tana barci ne.” Amma suka yi masa dariya.
english: he said to them, “Make room, because the girl isn’t dead, but sleeping.” They were ridiculing him.

hausa: Gama dole mai ruɓa yă maye wa mai ruɓan nan, marar mutuwa kuma yă maye wa mai mutuwan nan.
english: For this perishable body must become imperishable, and this mortal must put on immortality.

hausa: Mai arzikin yana da babban garken tumaki, da kuma shanu,
english: The rich man had very many flocks and herds,

hausa: Ya tafi wurinta, sai ta ce, “Kai ne Yowab?” Ya ce, “Ni ne”. Ta ce, “Ka ji abin da zan ce maka.” Ya ce, “Ina jinki.”
english: He came near to her; and the woman said, “Are you Joab?” He answered, “I am.” Then she said to him, “Hear the words of your servant.” He answered, “I’m listening.”

hausa: na iyalin Iddo, Zakariya; na iyalin Ginneton, Meshullam;
english: of Iddo, Zechariah; of Ginnethon, Meshullam;

hausa: Amma za a jefar da masu mugunta duka kamar ƙayayyuwan da ba a tattara da hannu.
english: But all the ungodly will be as thorns to be thrust away, because they can’t be taken with the hand.

hausa: Yanzu zan ba da dukan ƙasashenku ga bawana Nebukadnezzar sarkin Babilon; zan sa namun jeji ma su bauta masa.
english: Now I have given all these lands into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon, my servant. I have also given the animals of the field to him to serve him.

hausa: Kowane tsibiri ya gudu ba a kuwa ƙara ganin duwatsu ba.
english: Every island fled away, and the mountains were not found.

hausa: Amma in kin kauce yayinda kike auren mijinki, kika kuma ƙazantar da kanki ta wurin kwana da wani dabam da ba mijinki ba,”
english: But if you have gone astray, being under your husband’s authority, and if you are defiled, and some man has lain with you besides your husband—”

hausa: Da sassafe kuma, dukan mutanen suka zo haikalin, don su saurare shi.
english: All the people came early in the morning to him in the temple to hear him.

hausa: Duk wanda yake aikata nufin Allah, shi ne ɗan’uwana, da ’yar’uwata, da kuma mahaifiyata.”
english: For whoever does the will of God is my brother, my sister, and mother.”

hausa: Zan kore al’umma daga gabanku, in fadada kan iyakarku, babu wanda zai yi ƙyashin ƙasarku a lokutan nan uku na shekara da kuka haura don ku bayyana a gaban Ubangiji, Allahnku.
english: For I will drive out nations before you and enlarge your borders; neither shall any man desire your land when you go up to appear before Yahweh, your God, three times in the year.

hausa: Ma’aka matar Makir ta haifi ɗa ta kuma ba shi suna Feresh. Sunan ɗan’uwansa Sheresh, ’ya’yan Feresh maza kuwa su ne Ulam da Rakem.
english: Maacah the wife of Machir bore a son, and she named him Peresh. The name of his brother was Sheresh; and his sons were Ulam and Rakem.

hausa: Masu girman kai suna kai mini hari, ya Allah; ƙungiyar marasa imani suna neman raina, mutanen da ba su kula da kai ba.
english: God, the proud have risen up against me. A company of violent men have sought after my soul, and they don’t hold regard for you before them.

hausa: Ta haka suna jawo wa kansu hukunci, saboda sun karya alkawarinsu na farko.
english: having condemnation, because they have rejected their first pledge.

hausa: “Ɗan mutum, Nebukadnezzar sarkin Babilon ya sa sojojinsa su matsa wa Taya; kowane kai ya koɗe, kowace kafaɗa kuma ta goge. Duk da haka shi da sojojinsa ba su sami wani lada daga matsin da suka yi a kan Taya ba.
english: “Son of man, Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon caused his army to serve a great service against Tyre. Every head was made bald, and every shoulder was worn; yet he had no wages, nor did his army, from Tyre, for the service that he had served against it.

hausa: don bayarwarka ta zama a ɓoye. Ubanka kuwa mai ganin abin da ake yi a ɓoye, zai sāka maka.
english: so that your merciful deeds may be in secret, then your Father who sees in secret will reward you openly.

hausa: Sun sāka mini alheri da mugunta, ƙauna kuma da ƙiyayya.
english: They have rewarded me evil for good, and hatred for my love.

hausa: Kush da kuma Masar su ne ƙarfinta marar iyaka; Fut da Libiya suna cikin mataimakanta.
english: Cush and Egypt were her boundless strength. Put and Libya were her helpers.

hausa: Za a ƙasƙantar da mai girman kai za a kuma lalatar da fariyar masu ɗaga kai; Ubangiji kaɗai za a ɗaukaka a wannan rana.
english: The lofty looks of man will be brought low, the arrogance of men will be bowed down, and Yahweh alone will be exalted in that day.

hausa: Kamar zaki sun laɓe sun kwanta, kamar zakanya, wa zai yi ƙarfin hali yă tashe su? “Bari waɗanda suka albarkace ka, su sami albarka waɗanda kuma suka la’anta ka, su la’antu!”
english: He couched, he lay down as a lion, as a lioness; who shall rouse him up? Everyone who blesses you is blessed. Everyone who curses you is cursed.”

hausa: Ta haka yake da fifiko a kan mala’iku kamar yadda sunan da ya gāda ya fi nasu fifiko.
english: having become as much better than the angels as the more excellent name he has inherited is better than theirs.

hausa: “Sa’an nan Haruna zai shiga Tentin Sujada yă tuɓe rigunansa na lilin da ya sa, kafin yă shiga Wuri Mafi Tsarki, zai kuma bar su a can.
english: “Aaron shall come into the Tent of Meeting, and shall take off the linen garments which he put on when he went into the Holy Place, and shall leave them there.

hausa: Girmankan Isra’ila ya ba da shaida a kansa, amma duk da haka bai dawo ga Ubangiji Allahnsa ko yă neme shi ba.
english: The pride of Israel testifies to his face; yet they haven’t returned to Yahweh their God, nor sought him, for all this.

hausa: Masu adalci za su yi murna sa’ad da aka rama musu, sa’ad da suka wanke ƙafafunsu cikin jinin mugaye.
english: The righteous shall rejoice when he sees the vengeance. He shall wash his feet in the blood of the wicked,

hausa: Sarki ya ce wa Ittai mutumin Gat, “Don me za ka zo tare da mu? Ka koma ka zauna tare da Sarki Absalom. Kai baƙo ne, ɗan gudun hijira daga garinka.
english: Then the king said to Ittai the Gittite, “Why do you also go with us? Return, and stay with the king; for you are a foreigner and also an exile. Return to your own place.

hausa: A wancan lokaci na faɗa muku cewa, “Ku kaya ne masu nauyi da ni kaɗai ba zan iya ɗauka ba.
english: I spoke to you at that time, saying, “I am not able to bear you myself alone.

hausa: Amma domin kakanninmu sun ɓata wa Allah na sama rai, sai ya bari suka fāɗa cikin hannun Nebukadnezzar mutumin Kaldiya, sarkin Babilon, wanda ya rushe wannan haikali, ya kuma kwashe mutane zuwa Babilon.
english: But after our fathers had provoked the God of heaven to wrath, he gave them into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, the Chaldean, who destroyed this house and carried the people away into Babylon.

hausa: Rehobowam ya huta da kakanninsa aka kuma binne shi a Birnin Dawuda. Abiya ɗansa kuma ya gāje shi a matsayin sarki.
english: Rehoboam slept with his fathers, and was buried in David’s city; and Abijah his son reigned in his place.

hausa: Dukan ƙauyukan Yahudiya da dukan mutanen Urushalima suka fiffito zuwa wurinsa. Suna furta zunubansu, ya kuwa yi musu baftisma a Kogin Urdun.
english: All the country of Judea and all those of Jerusalem went out to him. They were baptized by him in the Jordan river, confessing their sins.

hausa: Amma Allah ya zaɓi abubuwa masu wautata duniya, don yă kunyata masu hikima. Allah ya zaɓi abubuwa marasa ƙarfi na duniya, domin ya ba wa masu ƙarfi kunya.
english: but God chose the foolish things of the world that he might put to shame those who are wise. God chose the weak things of the world that he might put to shame the things that are strong.

hausa: Mutanenku biyar za su kori mutum ɗari, mutanenku ɗari kuma za su kori mutane dubu goma, abokan gābanku kuma za su fāɗi a kaifin takobi a gabanku.
english: Five of you shall chase a hundred, and a hundred of you shall chase ten thousand; and your enemies shall fall before you by the sword.

hausa: (Har yanzu ba su fahimci Nassin nan da ya ce lalle ne Yesu yă tashi daga matattu ba.)
english: For as yet they didn’t know the Scripture, that he must rise from the dead.

hausa: Bulus, da Sila, da Timoti, Zuwa ga ikkilisiya ta Tessalonikawa ta Allah Ubanmu da Ubangiji Yesu Kiristi.
english: Paul, Silvanus, and Timothy, to the assembly of the Thessalonians in God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ:

hausa: Hazayel sarkin Aram ya mutu, sai Ben-Hadad ɗansa ya gāje shi.
english: Hazael king of Syria died; and Benhadad his son reigned in his place.

hausa: Abin da yake faruwa ke nan da duk wanda yake mantawa da Allah; waɗanda ba su da Allah, ba su da bege.
english: So are the paths of all who forget God. The hope of the godless man will perish,

hausa: Gama sa’ad da halin mutuntaka yake mulkinmu, sha’awace-sha’awacen zunubi waɗanda dokar ta zuga sun yi ta aiki a jikunanmu, don mu ba da amfani wa mutuwa.
english: For when we were in the flesh, the sinful passions which were through the law worked in our members to bring out fruit to death.

hausa: Wannan ya kai Bulus da Barnabas suka shiga babban gardama da muhawwara da su. Saboda haka aka naɗa Bulus da Barnabas tare da waɗansu masu bi, su haura zuwa Urushalima don su ga manzanni da dattawa a kan wannan magana.
english: Therefore when Paul and Barnabas had no small discord and discussion with them, they appointed Paul, Barnabas, and some others of them to go up to Jerusalem to the apostles and elders about this question.

hausa: Da kan sandan da yake a hannunsa, mala’ikan Ubangiji ya taɓa naman da burodi marar yistin. Sai wuta ta fito daga dutsen ta cinye naman da burodin. Mala’ikan kuwa ya ɓace.
english: Then Yahweh’s angel stretched out the end of the staff that was in his hand, and touched the meat and the unleavened cakes; and fire went up out of the rock and consumed the meat and the unleavened cakes. Then Yahweh’s angel departed out of his sight.

hausa: Zalunci yakan mai da mutum mai hikima wawa, cin hanci kuma yakan lalace hali.
english: Surely extortion makes the wise man foolish; and a bribe destroys the understanding.

hausa: Yankin ƙasarsu ya ƙunshi Yazer, da dukan garuruwan Gileyad, da rabin ƙasar Ammonawa har zuwa Arower kusa da Rabba,
english: Their border was Jazer, and all the cities of Gilead, and half the land of the children of Ammon, to Aroer that is near Rabbah;

hausa: Gama Allah ya daure dukan mutane ga rashin biyayya don yă nuna jinƙai ga kowa.
english: For God has bound all to disobedience, that he might have mercy on all.

hausa: “In wani ya yi maka magana, za ka ji haushi? Amma wa zai iya yin shiru?
english: “If someone ventures to talk with you, will you be grieved? But who can withhold himself from speaking?

hausa: Benahiya ɗan Yehohiyada, shi ne shugaban mayaƙa. Zadok da Abiyatar, su ne firistoci.
english: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over the army; Zadok and Abiathar were priests;

hausa: Saboda haka mutanen suka ɗauki kyautar, da kuma kuɗin da ya ninka na farko. Suka kuma ɗauki Benyamin, suka gaggauta suka gangara zuwa Masar suka kuma gabatar da kansu ga Yusuf.
english: The men took that present, and they took double money in their hand, and Benjamin; and got up, went down to Egypt, and stood before Joseph.

hausa: Don me zan ji tsoro sa’ad da mugayen kwanaki suka zo, sa’ad da mugaye masu ruɗu suka kewaye ni,
english: Why should I fear in the days of evil, when iniquity at my heels surrounds me?

hausa: Sarki Isra’ila ya amsa, ya ce, “Ku faɗa masa, ‘Wanda ya sa kayan yaƙinsa bai kamata yă yi fariya ba sai ya tuɓe su.’ ”
english: The king of Israel answered, “Tell him, ‘Don’t let him who puts on his armor brag like he who takes it off.’”

hausa: Ka juye idanuna daga abubuwa marasa amfani; ka kiyaye raina bisa ga maganarka.
english: Turn my eyes away from looking at worthless things. Revive me in your ways.

hausa: “Amma shi zai amma ya ce, ‘Ban san ku, ko inda kuka fito ba. Ku rabu da ni, dukan ku masu aikata mugunta!’
english: He will say, ‘I tell you, I don’t know where you come from. Depart from me, all you workers of iniquity.’

hausa: Da sojoji suka kai gab da shigar da Bulus cikin bariki, sai ya ce wa shugaban ƙungiyar sojan, “Ko ka yarda in yi magana da kai?” Sai ya amsa ya ce, “Ka iya Girik ne?
english: As Paul was about to be brought into the barracks, he asked the commanding officer, “May I speak to you?” He said, “Do you know Greek?

hausa: Dukan yinin, Abimelek ya matsa yaƙi da birnin sai da ya cinye ta ya kuma kashe mutanenta. Sa’an nan ya hallaka birnin ya barbaza gishiri a kanta.
english: Abimelech fought against the city all that day; and he took the city and killed the people in it. He beat down the city and sowed it with salt.

hausa: Lokacin da abokan Ayuba su uku wato, Elifaz mutumin Teman, Bildad mutumin Shuwa, da Zofar mutumin Na’ama suka ji wahalar da ta auka wa Ayuba, sai suka shirya suka bar gidajensu suka je don su ta’azantar da shi.
english: Now when Job’s three friends heard of all this evil that had come on him, they each came from his own place: Eliphaz the Temanite, Bildad the Shuhite, and Zophar the Naamathite; and they made an appointment together to come to sympathize with him and to comfort him.

hausa: Amma in wanda yake da ƙazanta bai tsarkake kansa ba, dole a ware shi daga cikin jama’a, domin ya ƙazantar da wuri mai tsarki na Ubangiji. Ba a yayyafa masa ruwa na tsarkakewa ba, ya zama da ƙazanta.
english: But the man who shall be unclean, and shall not purify himself, that soul shall be cut off from among the assembly, because he has defiled the sanctuary of Yahweh. The water for impurity has not been sprinkled on him. He is unclean.

hausa: Wannan shi ne alkawarina da kai da kuma zuriyarka a bayanka, alkawarin da za ka kiyaye ke nan. Kowane namiji a cikinku kuwa za a yi masa kaciya.
english: This is my covenant, which you shall keep, between me and you and your offspring after you. Every male among you shall be circumcised.

hausa: “Wannan shi ne mafarkin da ni, Nebukadnezzar, na yi. Yanzu Belteshazar, sai ka faɗa mini abin da yake nufi, domin babu wani a cikin masu hikima a mulkina da ya iya fassara mini shi. Amma za ka iya, domin ruhun alloli masu tsarki yana a bisanka.”
english: “This dream I, King Nebuchadnezzar, have seen; and you, Belteshazzar, declare the interpretation, because all the wise men of my kingdom are not able to make known to me the interpretation; but you are able, for the spirit of the holy gods is in you.”

hausa: Banza ne ka farka da wuri ka koma da latti, kana fama don abincin da za ka ci, gama yakan ba da barci ga waɗanda yake ƙauna.
english: It is vain for you to rise up early, to stay up late, eating the bread of toil, for he gives sleep to his loved ones.

hausa: ya kuma kawo kwanon zinariya ɗaya, mai nauyin shekel goma, cike da turaren hayaƙi;
english: one golden ladle of ten shekels, full of incense;

hausa: Ku yi farin ciki a cikin Ubangiji kullum. Ina sāke gaya muku ku yi farin ciki!
english: Rejoice in the Lord always! Again I will say, “Rejoice!”

hausa: Me kuma? Ta ko yaya dai, ko da gangan, ko da gaske, ana shelar Kiristi. Domin wannan kuwa ina farin ciki. I, zan kuwa ci gaba da farin ciki,
english: What does it matter? Only that in every way, whether in pretense or in truth, Christ is proclaimed. I rejoice in this, yes, and will rejoice.

hausa: Amma Isra’ilawa suka kwashe ganima da dabbobin birnin nan yadda Ubangiji ya umarci Yoshuwa.
english: Israel took for themselves only the livestock and the goods of that city, according to Yahweh’s word which he commanded Joshua.

hausa: ’Yan matan Urushalima, ku yi mini alkawari da bareyi da ƙishimai na jeji. Ba za ku tā da ko ku farka ƙauna ba sai haka ya zama lalle.
english: I adjure you, daughters of Jerusalem, by the roes, or by the hinds of the field, that you not stir up, nor awaken love, until it so desires.

hausa: Saboda haka zan miƙa hannuna in bugi Masarawa da duk al’ajaban da zan aikata a cikinsu. Bayan haka zai bar ku, ku tafi.
english: I will reach out my hand and strike Egypt with all my wonders which I will do among them, and after that he will let you go.

hausa: Ki tattara sojojinki, ya ke birnin mayaƙa, gama an kewaye mu da yaƙi. Za su bugi kumatun mai mulkin Isra’ila da sandar ƙarfe.
english: Now you shall gather yourself in troops, daughter of troops. He has laid siege against us. They will strike the judge of Israel with a rod on the cheek.

hausa: To, Barzillai fa tsoho ne, mai shekara tamanin. Ya tanada wa sarki a lokaci da yake Mahanayim, gama shi attajiri ne.
english: Now Barzillai was a very aged man, even eighty years old. He had provided the king with sustenance while he stayed at Mahanaim, for he was a very great man.

hausa: Bari yă ba da kumatunsa a mare shi, yă kuma bari a ci masa mutunci.
english: Let him give his cheek to him who strikes him. Let him be filled full of reproach.

hausa: Suka yi wa gumakansu sujada, waɗanda suka zama tarko gare su.
english: They served their idols, which became a snare to them.

hausa: Ya tambayi ’yan matansa, “To ina yake? Don me kuka bar shi a can? A gayyace shi, yă zo, yă ci wani abu.”
english: He said to his daughters, “Where is he? Why is it that you have left the man? Call him, that he may eat bread.”

hausa: Yawan jama’ar duka ya kai mutum 42,360,
english: The whole assembly together was forty-two thousand three hundred sixty,

hausa: Rago kan sa hannunsa a kwano ba ya ma iya ɗaga shi ya kai bakinsa!
english: The sluggard buries his hand in the dish; he will not so much as bring it to his mouth again.

hausa: Amma Yehosheba, ’yar Sarki Yehoram, ta ɗauki Yowash ɗan Ahaziya ta sace shi daga cikin ’ya’yan gidan sarauta waɗanda ake shiri a kashe, ta sa shi tare da mai renonsa a ɗakin kwana. Haka fa, Yehosheba ’yar sarki Yoram, matar Yehohiyada firist, ta yi, gama ita ’yar’uwar Ahaziya ce, ta ɓoye Yowash don kada Ataliya tă kashe shi.
english: But Jehoshabeath, the king’s daughter, took Joash the son of Ahaziah, and stealthily rescued him from among the king’s sons who were slain, and put him and his nurse in the bedroom. So Jehoshabeath, the daughter of King Jehoram, the wife of Jehoiada the priest (for she was the sister of Ahaziah), hid him from Athaliah, so that she didn’t kill him.

hausa: Duk lokacin da halittu masu ran nan suka rera ɗaukaka, girma da kuma godiya ga wannan wanda yake zaune a kan kursiyin da kuma wanda yake mai rai har abada abadin,
english: When the living creatures give glory, honor, and thanks to him who sits on the throne, to him who lives forever and ever,

hausa: A ƙofar Tentin Sujada, Haruna da ’ya’yansa maza za su ci wannan rago da burodin da yake cikin kwandon.
english: Aaron and his sons shall eat the meat of the ram, and the bread that is in the basket, at the door of the Tent of Meeting.

hausa: Bayan ya yi azumi yini arba’in da kuma dare arba’in, sai ya ji yunwa.
english: When he had fasted forty days and forty nights, he was hungry afterward.

hausa: “Yanzu ka yi annabcin dukan waɗannan maganganu a kansu ka kuma ce musu, “ ‘Ubangiji zai yi ruri daga bisa; zai yi tsawa daga mazauninsa mai tsarki ya kuma yi ruri da ƙarfi a kan ƙasarsa. Zai yi ihu kamar waɗanda suke matsin ’ya’yan inabi, yi ihu a kan dukan waɗanda suke zaune a duniya.
english: “Therefore prophesy against them all these words, and tell them, “‘Yahweh will roar from on high, and utter his voice from his holy habitation. He will mightily roar against his fold. He will give a shout, as those who tread grapes, against all the inhabitants of the earth.

hausa: A ganina ya dace in tunashe ku muddin ina raye cikin tentin wannan jiki,
english: I think it right, as long as I am in this tent, to stir you up by reminding you,

hausa: Sun koma ga zunuban kakanni kakanninsu, waɗanda suka ƙi su saurari maganata. Suka bi waɗansu alloli don su bauta musu. Da gidan Isra’ila da kuma gidan Yahuda duk sun take alkawarin da na yi da kakanni kakanninsu.
english: They have turned back to the iniquities of their forefathers, who refused to hear my words. They have gone after other gods to serve them. The house of Israel and the house of Judah have broken my covenant which I made with their fathers.

hausa: A Damaskus kuwa akwai wani almajiri mai suna Ananiyas. Ubangiji ya kira shi a cikin wahayi ya ce, “Ananiyas!” Ananiyas ya amsa, “Ga ni, ya Ubangiji.”
english: Now there was a certain disciple at Damascus named Ananias. The Lord said to him in a vision, “Ananias!” He said, “Behold, it’s me, Lord.”

hausa: Na gaji sharkaf an kuma ragargaza ni; ina nishi da wahala a cikin zuciyata.
english: I am faint and severely bruised. I have groaned by reason of the anguish of my heart.

hausa: Ahaziya fa ya fāɗo daga tagar ɗakin samansa a Samariya ya ji rauni. Saboda haka ya aiki masinjoji, yana cewa, “Ku je ku tuntuɓi Ba’al-Zebub, allahn Ekron, ku ga ko zan warke daga wannan rauni.”
english: Ahaziah fell down through the lattice in his upper room that was in Samaria, and was sick. So he sent messengers, and said to them, “Go, inquire of Baal Zebub, the god of Ekron, whether I will recover from this sickness.”

hausa: Gama mai hallakarwa ya auka wa Babilon, a kama sojojinta, a kuma kakkarya bakkunansu. Gama Ubangiji shi Allah ne mai sakayya; zai yi sakayya sosai.
english: For the destroyer has come on her, even on Babylon. Her mighty men are taken. Their bows are broken in pieces, for Yahweh is a God of retribution. He will surely repay.

hausa: Ubangiji ya amsa masa ya ce, “Ku munafukai! Ashe, kowannenku ba yakan kunce bijiminsa ko jakinsa, yă kai shi waje yă ba shi ruwa, a ranar Asabbaci ba?
english: Therefore the Lord answered him, “You hypocrites! Doesn’t each one of you free his ox or his donkey from the stall on the Sabbath and lead him away to water?

hausa: har sai lokacin da Ubangiji ya ba su hutawa, kamar yadda ya yi muku, kuma har sai su ma sun ƙwace ƙasar da Ubangiji Allahnku ya yi alkawari zai ba su. Bayan haka ne za ku koma ku mallaki ƙasarku, wadda Musa bawan Ubangiji ya ba ku a gabashin Urdun.”
english: until Yahweh has given your brothers rest, as he has given you, and they have also possessed the land which Yahweh your God gives them. Then you shall return to the land of your possession and possess it, which Moses the servant of Yahweh gave you beyond the Jordan toward the sunrise.’”

hausa: Ƙarfin takawarsa ya ragu; dabararsa ta ja fāɗuwarsa.
english: The steps of his strength will be shortened. His own counsel will cast him down.

hausa: Daga ’ya’yan Asaf, Zakkur, Yusuf, Netaniya da Asarela. ’Ya’yan Asaf sun kasance a ƙarƙashin kulawar Asaf, wanda ya yi annabci a ƙarƙashin kulawar sarki.
english: of the sons of Asaph: Zaccur, Joseph, Nethaniah, and Asharelah. The sons of Asaph were under the hand of Asaph, who prophesied at the order of the king.

hausa: Bayan ta yaye shi, sai ta ɗauki yaron tare da bijimi bana uku, da mudun gari, da salkan ruwan inabi, ta kawo su a gidan Ubangiji a Shilo.
english: When she had weaned him, she took him up with her, with three bulls, and one ephah of meal, and a container of wine, and brought him to Yahweh’s house in Shiloh. The child was young.

hausa: Ai, shi Uban kansa yana ƙaunarku domin kun ƙaunace ni kun kuma gaskata cewa daga Allah na fito.
english: for the Father himself loves you, because you have loved me, and have believed that I came from God.

hausa: amma a shekara ta bakwai za ku bar ƙasa tă huta. Sa’an nan matalautan da suke cikinku za su sami abinci daga cikinta, namun jeji kuma za su ci abin da aka bari. Ku yi haka da gonakinku na inabi, da na itatuwan zaitun.
english: but the seventh year you shall let it rest and lie fallow, that the poor of your people may eat; and what they leave the animal of the field shall eat. In the same way, you shall deal with your vineyard and with your olive grove.

hausa: Kuma ’ya’yan Mushi maza su ne, Mali, Eder da Yerimot. Waɗannan su ne Lawiyawa bisa ga iyalansu.
english: The sons of Mushi: Mahli, Eder, and Jerimoth. These were the sons of the Levites after their fathers’ houses.

hausa: Saboda haka sa’ad da Allah ya hallaka waɗannan biranen kwarin, ya tuna da Ibrahim, ya kuma fitar da Lot daga masifar da ta hallaka biranen da Lot ya zauna.
english: When God destroyed the cities of the plain, God remembered Abraham, and sent Lot out of the middle of the overthrow, when he overthrew the cities in which Lot lived.

hausa: Sai shugabannin Filistiyawa suka tafi wurinta suka ce, “Ki yi ƙoƙari ki ga ko za ki rarrashe shi yă nuna miki asirin ƙarfinsa da yadda za mu iya shan ƙarfinsa don mu ɗaura shi mu yi nasara a kansa. Kowannenmu zai ba ki shekel dubu ɗari ɗaya na azurfa.”
english: The lords of the Philistines came up to her and said to her, “Entice him, and see in which his great strength lies, and by what means we may prevail against him, that we may bind him to afflict him; and we will each give you eleven hundred pieces of silver.”

hausa: In kuna da wata ƙarfafawa daga tarayya da Kiristi, in da wata ta’aziyya daga ƙaunarsa, in da wani zumunci da Ruhu, in da juyayi da tausayi,
english: If therefore there is any exhortation in Christ, if any consolation of love, if any fellowship of the Spirit, if any tender mercies and compassion,

hausa: Maganar Ubangiji ta zo mini cewa,
english: Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

hausa: Da Yesu ya ga Natanayel yana zuwa, sai ya yi magana game da shi cewa, “Ga mutumin Isra’ila na gaske wanda ba shi da ha’inci.”
english: Jesus saw Nathanael coming to him, and said about him, “Behold, an Israelite indeed, in whom is no deceit!”

hausa: A kan bagaden, ya ƙone kitsen, ƙodojin, da abin da ya rufe hanta, daga hadaya don zunubi, yadda Ubangiji ya umarci Musa.
english: but the fat, and the kidneys, and the cover from the liver of the sin offering, he burned upon the altar, as Yahweh commanded Moses.

hausa: A wannan lokaci ni Daniyel na yi makoki har na sati uku.
english: In those days I, Daniel, was mourning three whole weeks.

hausa: Sa’an nan ka yi sanduna da itacen ƙirya, ka dalaye su da zinariya.
english: You shall make poles of acacia wood, and overlay them with gold.

hausa: Idan aka ci naman hadayarsa ta salama a rana ta uku, ba za a karɓi wanda ya ba da hadayar har ya sami albarkar hadayar ba, naman zai zama abin ƙyama, duk wanda ya ci kuwa ya yi laifi.
english: If any of the meat of the sacrifice of his peace offerings is eaten on the third day, it will not be accepted, and it shall not be credited to him who offers it. It will be an abomination, and the soul who eats any of it will bear his iniquity.

hausa: In ba shi da ’yan’uwa, a ba da gādonsa ga ’yan’uwan mahaifinsa.
english: If he has no brothers, then you shall give his inheritance to his father’s brothers.

hausa: Amma Bitrus ya yi ta nanatawa da ƙarfi ya ce, “Ko da zan mutu tare da kai, ba zan taɓa yin mūsun saninka ba.” Duk sauran ma suka ce haka.
english: But he spoke all the more, “If I must die with you, I will not deny you.” They all said the same thing.

hausa: ka buɗe idanunsu su kuwa juyo daga duhu zuwa haske, daga mulkin Shaiɗan kuma zuwa wurin Allah, domin su sami gafarar zunubai da kuma matsayi a cikin waɗanda aka tsarkake ta wurin bangaskiya a cikina.’
english: to open their eyes, that they may turn from darkness to light and from the power of Satan to God, that they may receive remission of sins and an inheritance among those who are sanctified by faith in me.’

hausa: Ka sa ni a ramin da yake can ƙasa cikin zurfafa mafi duhu.
english: You have laid me in the lowest pit, in the darkest depths.

hausa: “ ‘Kada ka yi jima’i da ’yar’uwar mahaifiyarka, domin ita dangin mahaifiyarka ce na kusa.
english: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your mother’s sister, for she is your mother’s near kinswoman.

hausa: Ku da kuke tsoronsa, ku dogara ga Ubangiji, shi ne mai taimakonsu da garkuwarsu.
english: You who fear Yahweh, trust in Yahweh! He is their help and their shield.

hausa: kada ku ji tsoro “saboda a yanzu na yi niyya in sāke yi wa Urushalima da Yahuda abu mai kyau.
english: so again I have thought in these days to do good to Jerusalem and to the house of Judah. Don’t be afraid.

hausa: Amsar kuwa za tă zama, ‘Domin sun keta alkawarin Ubangiji Allahnsu, suka yi sujada suka kuma bauta wa waɗansu alloli.’ ”
english: Then they will answer, ‘Because they abandoned the covenant of Yahweh their God, worshiped other gods, and served them.’”

hausa: samari da ’yan mata, tsofaffi da yara.
english: both young men and maidens, old men and children.

hausa: Sarki ya sa azurfa ta zama barkatai a Urushalima kamar duwatsu, al’ul kuma da yawa kamar itatuwan fir a gindin tsaunuka.
english: The king made silver as common in Jerusalem as stones, and he made cedars to be as abundant as the sycamore trees that are in the lowland.

hausa: Ni, Nebukadnezzar, ina zaune a gidana cikin fadata, ina jin daɗi ina bunkasa.
english: I, Nebuchadnezzar, was at rest in my house, and flourishing in my palace.

hausa: Ubangiji ya ƙasƙantar da Yahuda saboda Ahaz sarkin Isra’ila, gama ya hadasa mugunta a Yahuda kuma ya kasance marar aminci ga Ubangiji.
english: For Yahweh brought Judah low because of Ahaz king of Israel, because he acted without restraint in Judah and trespassed severely against Yahweh.

hausa: “Sa’an nan Sarki zai ce wa waɗanda suke damansa, ‘Ku zo, ku da Ubana ya yi wa albarka; ku karɓi gādonku, mulkin da aka shirya muku tun halittar duniya.
english: Then the King will tell those on his right hand, ‘Come, blessed of my Father, inherit the Kingdom prepared for you from the foundation of the world;

hausa: gama an yi amfani da farantan don miƙa mini turare. Sai ka ɗauki farantan mutanen da suka yi zunubin da ya jawo musu mutuwa ka ƙera farantan, ka yi murfin bagade da su, gama an miƙa su a gaban Ubangiji, suka zama tsarkakakku. Bari su zama alama ga Isra’ilawa.”
english: even the censers of those who sinned against their own lives. Let them be beaten into plates for a covering of the altar, for they offered them before Yahweh. Therefore they are holy. They shall be a sign to the children of Israel.”

hausa: Ubangiji ya ce wa Shaiɗan, “Ubangiji ya tsawata maka, Shaiɗan! Ubangiji wanda ya zaɓi Urushalima, ya tsawata maka! Ashe, mutumin nan ba shi ne sandar da take ƙonewa da aka ciro daga cikin wuta ba?”
english: Yahweh said to Satan, “Yahweh rebuke you, Satan! Yes, Yahweh who has chosen Jerusalem rebuke you! Isn’t this a burning stick plucked out of the fire?”

hausa: Allah alƙali ne mai adalci, Allahn da yakan bayyana fushinsa kowace rana.
english: God is a righteous judge, yes, a God who has indignation every day.

hausa: Yanzu a shirye nake in ziyarce ku sau na uku, ba zan kuma nawaita muku ba, don ba kayanku nake so ba, ku nake so. Gama ba yara ne da ɗaukar nauyin iyayensu ba, sai dai iyaye ne da ɗaukar nauyin yaran.
english: Behold, this is the third time I am ready to come to you, and I will not be a burden to you; for I seek not your possessions, but you. For the children ought not to save up for the parents, but the parents for the children.

hausa: “ ‘Ba wani da zai iya keɓe ɗan farin dabba, da yake ɗan fari ya riga ya zama na Ubangiji, ko na saniya, ko na tunkiya, na Ubangiji ne.
english: “‘However the firstborn among animals, which belongs to Yahweh as a firstborn, no man may dedicate, whether an ox or a sheep. It is Yahweh’s.

hausa: Sai annabin ya ce, “Kada ka ji tsoro, waɗanda suke tare da mu sun fi waɗanda suke tare da su.”
english: He answered, “Don’t be afraid, for those who are with us are more than those who are with them.”

hausa: Ko da yake suna cewa, ‘Muddin Ubangiji yana raye,’ duk da haka suna rantsuwar ƙarya.”
english: Though they say, ‘As Yahweh lives,’ surely they swear falsely.”

hausa: Mun san cewa muna rayuwa a cikinsa shi kuma a cikinmu, domin ya ba mu Ruhunsa.
english: By this we know that we remain in him and he in us, because he has given us of his Spirit.

hausa: Duk za a bar su wa tsuntsayen dutse su ci da kuma namun jeji; tsuntsaye kuma za su ci rani a kansu, namun jeji kuma za su yi damina a kansu.
english: They will be left together for the ravenous birds of the mountains, and for the animals of the earth. The ravenous birds will eat them in the summer, and all the animals of the earth will eat them in the winter.

hausa: Faltiyel ɗan Azzan, shugaba daga kabilar Issakar;
english: Of the tribe of the children of Issachar a prince, Paltiel the son of Azzan.

hausa: Haka ma, a wannan zamani akwai ragowar da aka zaɓa ta wurin alheri.
english: Even so too at this present time also there is a remnant according to the election of grace.

hausa: zan kafa alkawarina kamar madawwamin alkawari tsakanina da kai da kuma zuriyarka bayanka har tsararraki masu zuwa, in zama Allahnka da kuma Allahn zuriyarka a bayanka.
english: I will establish my covenant between me and you and your offspring after you throughout their generations for an everlasting covenant, to be a God to you and to your offspring after you.

hausa: Ban same shi da wani laifin da ya isa kisa ba, amma saboda ya ɗaukaka ƙararsa zuwa gaban Babban Sarki sai na yanke shawara in aika da shi Roma.
english: But when I found that he had committed nothing worthy of death, and as he himself appealed to the emperor, I determined to send him,

hausa: ’Ya’yan Zebulun maza su ne, Sered, Elon da Yaleyel.
english: The sons of Zebulun: Sered, Elon, and Jahleel.

hausa: Mutumin Habasha zai iya canja launin fatar jikinsa ko damisa ta canja dabbare dabbarenta? Ba za ku iya yin alheri ku da kuka saba da yin mugunta ba.
english: Can the Ethiopian change his skin, or the leopard his spots? Then may you also do good, who are accustomed to do evil.

hausa: Kafin in yi magana da harshena ka santa gaba ɗaya, ya Ubangiji.
english: For there is not a word on my tongue, but behold, Yahweh, you know it altogether.

hausa: ta Shefatiya 372
english: The children of Shephatiah: three hundred seventy-two.

hausa: Sihon sarkin Amoriyawa, Og sarkin Bashan da kuma dukan sarakunan Kan’ana,
english: Sihon king of the Amorites, Og king of Bashan, and all the kingdoms of Canaan—

hausa: Zan ma mai da kaina abin reni fiye da haka, za a kuma zama abin reni a gare ki. Amma waɗannan bayi ’yan matan da kika yi magana a kai, za su gan ni da martaba.”
english: I will be yet more undignified than this, and will be worthless in my own sight. But the maids of whom you have spoken will honor me.”

hausa: Rago kan sa hannunsa a kwano ba ya ma iya ɗaga shi ya kai bakinsa.
english: The sluggard buries his hand in the dish. He is too lazy to bring it back to his mouth.

hausa: To, yayinda yake a Urushalima a Bikin Ƙetarewa, mutane da yawa suka ga abubuwan banmamakin da yake aikata suka kuma gaskata da sunansa.
english: Now when he was in Jerusalem at the Passover, during the feast, many believed in his name, observing his signs which he did.

hausa: Yosiya ya farfashe keɓaɓɓun duwatsu, ya rurrushe ginshiƙan Asheransu, ya baza ƙasusuwan mutane a can.
english: He broke in pieces the pillars, cut down the Asherah poles, and filled their places with men’s bones.

hausa: ya ga cewa saurayin ba ya nan, zai mutu. Bayinka za su sa bawanka, mahaifinmu, yă mutu cikin baƙin ciki, da tsufansa.
english: it will happen, when he sees that the boy is no more, that he will die. Your servants will bring down the gray hairs of your servant, our father, with sorrow to Sheol.

hausa: ɗan Mattat, ɗan Lawi, ɗan Melki, ɗan Yannai, ɗan Yusuf,
english: the son of Matthat, the son of Levi, the son of Melchi, the son of Jannai, the son of Joseph,

hausa: Suka ce masa, “Ai, Yesu Banazare ne ke wucewa.”
english: They told him that Jesus of Nazareth was passing by.

hausa: Yana da kyau ku kasance da irin wannan niyya idan da nufi mai kyau ne, ku kuma kasance a haka koyaushe ba sai ina tare da ku ba.
english: But it is always good to be zealous in a good cause, and not only when I am present with you.

hausa: Saboda zunuban bakunansu, saboda maganganun leɓunansu, bari a kama su cikin fariyarsu. Saboda zage-zage da ƙarairayin da suke yi,
english: For the sin of their mouth, and the words of their lips, let them be caught in their pride, for the curses and lies which they utter.

hausa: Sa’an nan Ubangiji ya ce wa Musa, “Yanzu za ka gan abin da zan yi da Fir’auna. Zan sa shi dole yă bar su su tafi, har ma yă iza ƙyeyarsu don su bar ƙasarsa!”
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “Now you shall see what I will do to Pharaoh, for by a strong hand he shall let them go, and by a strong hand he shall drive them out of his land.”

hausa: Gama ƙaunarka da girma take, bisa fiye da sammai; amincinka ya kai sarari.
english: For your loving kindness is great above the heavens. Your faithfulness reaches to the skies.

hausa: In ka mai da Mafi Ɗaukaka wurin zamanka, har ma Ubangiji wanda yake mafakata,
english: Because you have made Yahweh your refuge, and the Most High your dwelling place,

hausa: In kuwa mutumin ya ce masa, “Bari kitse yă ƙone tukuna, sa’an nan ka ɗiba duk abin da kake so.” Sai bawan yă ce masa, “A’a, ka ba ni yanzu, in ka ƙi kuwa zan ɗiba ƙarfi da yaji.”
english: If the man said to him, “Let the fat be burned first, and then take as much as your soul desires;” then he would say, “No, but you shall give it to me now; and if not, I will take it by force.”

hausa: A kan hanyarsu suka kafa sansani kusa da Kiriyat Yeyarim a Yahuda. Shi ya sa a ana kira wurin nan yamma da Kiriyat Yeyarim Mahane Dan har wa yau.
english: They went up and encamped in Kiriath Jearim in Judah. Therefore they call that place Mahaneh Dan to this day. Behold, it is behind Kiriath Jearim.

hausa: “ ‘Yahuda da Isra’ila sun yi kasuwanci da ke; sun sayi kayanki da alkama da Minnit da alawa, da zuma, da mai, da ganyaye masu ƙanshi.
english: “‘“Judah and the land of Israel were your traders. They traded wheat of Minnith, confections, honey, oil, and balm for your merchandise.

hausa: Saboda haka, Eli ya gaya wa Sama’ila cewa, “Je ka kwanta, in kuma ya kira ka, ka ce masa, ‘Ya Ubangiji ka yi magana gama bawanka yana saurara.’ ” Sama’ila ya koma ya kwanta a wurin kwanciyarsa.
english: Therefore Eli said to Samuel, “Go, lie down. It shall be, if he calls you, that you shall say, ‘Speak, Yahweh; for your servant hears.’” So Samuel went and lay down in his place.

hausa: Duk da haka, ya gidan Isra’ila kun ce, ‘Hanyar Ubangiji ba daidai ba ce.’ Amma zan hukunta kowane ɗayanku gwargwadon ayyukansa.”
english: Yet you say, “The way of the Lord is not fair.” House of Israel, I will judge every one of you after his ways.’”

hausa: in wani ya ji busar amma bai kula ba, takobin zai zo ya ɗauki ransa, jininsa kuwa zai zauna a kansa.
english: then whoever hears the sound of the trumpet and doesn’t heed the warning, if the sword comes and takes him away, his blood will be on his own head.

hausa: Nan da nan da ya ga zoben hancin da woroworo a hannuwan ’yar’uwansa, ya kuma ji Rebeka ta faɗa abin da mutumin ya ce mata, sai ya fita zuwa wurin mutumin, ya same shi yana tsaye wajen raƙuma kusa da rijiyar.
english: When he saw the ring, and the bracelets on his sister’s hands, and when he heard the words of Rebekah his sister, saying, “This is what the man said to me,” he came to the man. Behold, he was standing by the camels at the spring.

hausa: Waɗannan su ne manya a cikin zuriyar Isuwa, ’Ya’ya Elifaz maza ɗan farin Isuwa, Shugabannin su ne; Teman, Omar, Zefo, Kenaz,
english: These are the chiefs of the sons of Esau: the sons of Eliphaz the firstborn of Esau: chief Teman, chief Omar, chief Zepho, chief Kenaz,

hausa: domin rana ta daina haskakawa. Labulen da yake cikin haikali kuma ya yage kashi biyu.
english: The sun was darkened, and the veil of the temple was torn in two.

hausa: Ka sa shi ƙasa kaɗan da darajar mala’iku; ka naɗa shi da ɗaukaka da girma,
english: You made him a little lower than the angels. You crowned him with glory and honor.

hausa: Attai na shida, Eliyel na bakwai,
english: Attai the sixth, Eliel the seventh,

hausa: Gama Ubangiji zai rushe Babilon, zai sa ta ƙame bakinta na alfarma. Sojoji za su yi ta kutsawa kamar raƙuman ruwa; suna tā da muryoyinsu.
english: For Yahweh lays Babylon waste, and destroys out of her the great voice! Their waves roar like many waters. The noise of their voice is uttered.

hausa: Ta buɗe bakinta don tă yi wa Allah saɓo, ta kuma ɓata sunansa da kuma mazauninsa da na waɗanda suke zama a sama.
english: He opened his mouth for blasphemy against God, to blaspheme his name, his dwelling, and those who dwell in heaven.

hausa: Sa’an nan zan karya bakan da take a hannun hagunka, in sa kibiyoyin da suke a hannun damanka su fāɗi.
english: I will strike your bow out of your left hand, and will cause your arrows to fall out of your right hand.

hausa: Kaiton waɗanda suka gangara zuwa Masar don neman taimako, waɗanda suke dogara ga dawakai, waɗanda suke dogara ga yawan kekunan yaƙinsu da kuma a girman ƙarfin mahayan dawakansu, amma ba sa dogara ga Mai Tsarkin nan na Isra’ila, ko ya nemi taimako daga Ubangiji.
english: Woe to those who go down to Egypt for help, and rely on horses, and trust in chariots because they are many, and in horsemen because they are very strong, but they don’t look to the Holy One of Israel, and they don’t seek Yahweh!

hausa: ’Ya’yan Reyuwel maza, Shugabannin su ne; Nahat, Zera, Shamma da Mizza. Waɗannan su ne manya da suka fito daga dangin Reyuwel a Edom; su ne jikokin Basemat matar Isuwa.
english: These are the sons of Reuel, Esau’s son: chief Nahath, chief Zerah, chief Shammah, chief Mizzah. These are the chiefs who came of Reuel in the land of Edom. These are the sons of Basemath, Esau’s wife.

hausa: Don mai bi da kaɗe-kaɗe. Don Yedutun. Zaburar Dawuda. Raina na samun hutu a wurin Allah ne kaɗai; cetona na zuwa daga gare shi.
english: For the Chief Musician. To Jeduthun. A Psalm by David. My soul rests in God alone. My salvation is from him.

hausa: Amma bayan kwana uku da rabi ɗin numfashin rai daga Allah ya shige su, suka kuwa tashi tsaye, tsoro kuma ya kama waɗanda suka gan su.
english: After the three and a half days, the breath of life from God entered into them, and they stood on their feet. Great fear fell on those who saw them.

hausa: Er da Onan, ’ya’yan Yahuda ne, amma sun mutu a Kan’ana.
english: The sons of Judah: Er and Onan. Er and Onan died in the land of Canaan.

hausa: Kaitona! Wane ne zai cece ni daga wannan jiki mai mutuwa?
english: What a wretched man I am! Who will deliver me out of the body of this death?

hausa: Tabbatacce kai ne wanda yake ƙaunar mutane; dukan tsarkaka suna a hannunka. A ƙafafunka, duk suka rusuna, daga wurinka kuma suka karɓi umarni,
english: Yes, he loves the people. All his saints are in your hand. They sat down at your feet. Each receives your words.

hausa: Har Assuriya ma ta haɗa kai da su don ta ba da ƙarfi ga zuriyar Lot. Sela
english: Assyria also is joined with them. They have helped the children of Lot. Selah.

hausa: Abin da muke magana a nan shi ne, muna da irin wannan babban firist, wanda ya zauna a hannun dama na kursiyin Maɗaukaki a sama,
english: Now in the things which we are saying, the main point is this: we have such a high priest, who sat down on the right hand of the throne of the Majesty in the heavens,

hausa: Sarki ya san waɗannan abubuwa, ina kuma iya yin magana da shi a sake. Na tabbata cewa ba ɗaya daga cikin waɗannan da ya kuɓuce saninsa, domin ba a ɓoye aka yi shi ba.
english: For the king knows of these things, to whom also I speak freely. For I am persuaded that none of these things is hidden from him, for this has not been done in a corner.

hausa: Dattawan da suka bi da al’amuran ikkilisiya da kyau sun cancanci girmamawa ninki biyu, musamman waɗanda aikinsu wa’azi ne da kuma koyarwa.
english: Let the elders who rule well be counted worthy of double honor, especially those who labor in the word and in teaching.

hausa: Kada ka ba da ƙarfinka a kan mata, ƙarfinka ga waɗanda suka hallaka sarakuna.
english: Don’t give your strength to women, nor your ways to that which destroys kings.

hausa: “Sai mahaifin ya ce masa, ‘Ɗana, kullum kana nan tare da ni, kuma duk abin da nake da shi, naka ne.
english: “He said to him, ‘Son, you are always with me, and all that is mine is yours.

hausa: Da Ba’asha ya ji haka, sai ya daina ginin Rama, ya janye zuwa Tirza.
english: When Baasha heard of it, he stopped building Ramah, and lived in Tirzah.

hausa: Sa’an nan Allah ya ce wa Nuhu,
english: God spoke to Noah, saying,

hausa: Fuskata ta yi ja don kuka idanuna sun kukumbura;
english: My face is red with weeping. Deep darkness is on my eyelids,

hausa: Sai Daniyel (wanda ake kira Belteshazar) ya tsaya zugum na ɗan lokaci, tunaninsa ya ba shi tsoro. Saboda haka sarki ya ce, “Belteshazar, kada ka bar mafarkin ko ma’anarsa ta tayar maka da hankali.” Belteshazar ya amsa ya ce, “Ranka yă daɗe, in dai har mafarkin zai tsaya a kan abokan gābanka da ma’anarsa kuma ta faɗa kan maƙiyan!
english: Then Daniel, whose name was Belteshazzar, was stricken mute for a while, and his thoughts troubled him. The king answered, “Belteshazzar, don’t let the dream or the interpretation trouble you.” Belteshazzar answered, “My lord, may the dream be for those who hate you, and its interpretation to your adversaries.

hausa: Sai dai muna ganin Yesu, wanda aka mai da shi ƙasa kaɗan da darajar mala’iku, yanzu kuwa an naɗa shi da ɗaukaka da girma domin yă sha wahalar mutuwa, domin ta wurin alherin Allah yă ɗanɗana mutuwa saboda kowa.
english: But we see him who has been made a little lower than the angels, Jesus, because of the suffering of death crowned with glory and honor, that by the grace of God he should taste of death for everyone.

hausa: A dā, ko a lokacin da Shawulu yake sarki, ai, kai ne kake shugabantar Isra’ila a yaƙe-yaƙe. Kuma Ubangiji Allahnka ya ce maka, ‘Za ka zama makiyayin mutanena Isra’ila, za ka kuma zama mai mulkinsu.’ ”
english: In times past, even when Saul was king, it was you who led out and brought in Israel. Yahweh your God said to you, ‘You shall be shepherd of my people Israel, and you shall be prince over my people Israel.’”

hausa: Ba zan kafa a gaban idanuna 1 wani abu marar kyau ba. Na ƙi jinin ayyukan mutane marasa aminci; ba za su manne mini ba.
english: I will set no vile thing before my eyes. I hate the deeds of faithless men. They will not cling to me.

hausa: “Yi magana da Isra’ilawa, ka ce musu, ‘Sa’ad da kuka shiga ƙasar da zan ba ku, kuka kuma girbe amfanin gonarta, sai ku kawo wa firist damin hatsi na farko da kuka girbe.
english: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘When you have come into the land which I give to you, and shall reap its harvest, then you shall bring the sheaf of the first fruits of your harvest to the priest.

hausa: Ka ga zurfin ramakonsu, da duk mugun shirin da suke yi mini.
english: You have seen all their vengeance and all their plans against me.

hausa: Daga zuriyar Zebulun. Aka rubuta sunayen dukan maza ɗaya-ɗaya da suka kai shekara ashirin ko fiye da suka isa shiga soja, bisa ga iyalansu da kabilarsu da take a rubuce.
english: Of the children of Zebulun, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war:

hausa: Dukan al’ummai za su iya tafiya a cikin sunan allolinsu; mu dai za mu yi tafiya a cikin sunan Ubangiji Allahnmu har abada abadin.
english: Indeed all the nations may walk in the name of their gods, but we will walk in the name of Yahweh our God forever and ever.

hausa: Za su shuka alkama, su girbe ƙayayyuwa; za su gajiyar da kansu, ba za su kuwa sami kome ba. Saboda haka ku sha kunyar abin da kuka girbe saboda zafin fushin Ubangiji.”
english: They have sown wheat, and have reaped thorns. They have exhausted themselves, and profit nothing. You will be ashamed of your fruits, because of Yahweh’s fierce anger.”

hausa: Ta kuma yi manyan ayyuka da kuma alamu masu banmamaki, har ta sa wuta ta sauko daga sama zuwa ƙasa a gaban idon mutane.
english: He performs great signs, even making fire come down out of the sky to the earth in the sight of people.

hausa: Domin halin Sarauniya zai zama sananne ga dukan mata, ta haka kuwa za su ƙasƙantar da mazansu su kuma ce, ‘Sarki Zerzes ya umarta a kawo Sarauniya Bashti a gabansa, amma ta ƙi zuwa.’
english: For this deed of the queen will become known to all women, causing them to show contempt for their husbands when it is reported, ‘King Ahasuerus commanded Vashti the queen to be brought in before him, but she didn’t come.’

hausa: Ba a dai ƙidaya zuriyar Lawi tare da saura kabilan ba.
english: But the Levites after the tribe of their fathers were not counted among them.

hausa: Sauran ayyukan mulkin Manasse, haɗe da addu’arsa ga Allahnsa da kuma kalmomin da mai duba ya yi masa cikin sunan Ubangiji, Allah na Isra’ila, suna a rubuce cikin tarihin sarakunan Isra’ila.
english: Now the rest of the acts of Manasseh, and his prayer to his God, and the words of the seers who spoke to him in the name of Yahweh, the God of Israel, behold, they are written among the acts of the kings of Israel.

hausa: Sa’an nan na ji wata murya tana ce mini, ‘Bitrus, ka tashi. Ka yanka ka ci.’
