english: I also heard a voice saying to me, ‘Rise, Peter, kill and eat!’

hausa: A shekara ta goma sha huɗu ta mulkin sarkin Hezekiya, sai sarki Sennakerib sarkin Assuriya ya kai farmaki wa biranen Yahuda masu katanga ya kuma kama su.
english: Now in the fourteenth year of King Hezekiah, Sennacherib king of Assyria came up against all the fortified cities of Judah and took them.

hausa: Bitrus ya juya ya ga cewa almajirin nan da Yesu yake ƙauna yana binsu. (Wannan ne ya jingina a jikin Yesu sa’ad da suke cin abincin yamman nan da ya ce, “Ubangiji wane ne zai bashe ka?”)
english: Then Peter, turning around, saw a disciple following. This was the disciple whom Jesus loved, the one who had also leaned on Jesus’ chest at the supper and asked, “Lord, who is going to betray you?”

hausa: Sa’ad da aka gama miƙawa, sai sarki da mutanen da suke tare da shi suka durƙusa suka yi sujada.
english: When they had finished offering, the king and all who were present with him bowed themselves and worshiped.

hausa: Maganar Ubangiji ta zo mini cewa,
english: Again Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

hausa: Kada irin wannan mutum yă yi tsammani zai sami wani abu daga Ubangiji;
english: For that man shouldn’t think that he will receive anything from the Lord.

hausa: gama yana tsare abin da masu adalci suke bukata yana kuma tsare hanyar amintattunsa.
english: that he may guard the paths of justice, and preserve the way of his saints.

hausa: Suka yi gunaguni a tentunansu ba su kuwa yi biyayya da Ubangiji ba.
english: but murmured in their tents, and didn’t listen to Yahweh’s voice.

hausa: Yayinda suke tafiya, sukan tafi kowane gefe huɗun da kerubobin suka nufa; da’irorin ba sa juyawa yayinda kerubobin suke tafiya. Kerubobin suka tafi kowane gefen da kan ya nufa, ba tare da juyawa ba sa’ad da suke tafiya.
english: When they went, they went in their four directions. They didn’t turn as they went, but to the place where the head looked they followed it. They didn’t turn as they went.

hausa: Amma Ubangiji zai ceci Isra’ila da madawwamin ceto; ba za ku sāke shan kunya ko ƙasƙanci ba, har abada.
english: Israel will be saved by Yahweh with an everlasting salvation. You will not be disappointed nor confounded to ages everlasting.

hausa: Ka yi wa bawanka alheri bisa ga maganarka, ya Ubangiji.
english: You have treated your servant well, according to your word, Yahweh.

hausa: Kwanonin zinariya goma sha biyu da aka cika da turaren hayaƙi kuwa, nauyinsu shekel goma ne kowanne, bisa ga ma’aunin shekel na tsattsarkan wuri. Duka-duka dai, nauyin kwanonin zinariya, shekel ɗari ɗaya ne da ashirin.
english: the twelve golden ladles, full of incense, weighing ten shekels apiece, according to the shekel of the sanctuary; all the gold of the ladles weighed one hundred twenty shekels;

hausa: Da suka ci gaba da yin masa tambayoyi, sai ya miƙe tsaye ya ce musu, “In da wani a cikinku da ba shi da zunubi, sai yă fara jifanta da dutse.”
english: But when they continued asking him, he looked up and said to them, “He who is without sin among you, let him throw the first stone at her.”

hausa: Shimeya, Haggiya da Asahiya.
english: Shimea his son, Haggiah his son, Asaiah his son.

hausa: da Daniyel, da Ginneton, da Baruk,
english: Daniel, Ginnethon, Baruch,

hausa: Ya tsawata wa Jan Teku, ya kuwa bushe; ya bi da su ta cikin zurfafa sai ka ce a hamada.
english: He rebuked the Red Sea also, and it was dried up; so he led them through the depths, as through a desert.

hausa: Sai Ibrahim ya ce wa babban bawan gidansa, wanda yake lura da duk abin da yake da shi, “Sa hannunka a ƙarƙashin cinyata.
english: Abraham said to his servant, the elder of his house, who ruled over all that he had, “Please put your hand under my thigh.

hausa: “Kwanaki suna zuwa,” in ji Ubangiji, “sa’ad da zan kafa gidan Isra’ila da gidan Yahuda da ’ya’yan mutane da na dabbobi.
english: “Behold, the days come,” says Yahweh, “that I will sow the house of Israel and the house of Judah with the seed of man and with the seed of animal.

hausa: Zan ɗaura aure da yake cikin aminci za ki kuwa yarda cewa ni ne Ubangiji.
english: I will even betroth you to me in faithfulness; and you shall know Yahweh.

hausa: A wannan dare Allah ya bayyana ga Solomon, ya ce masa, “Roƙi duk abin da kake so in ba ka.”
english: That night, God appeared to Solomon and said to him, “Ask for what you want me to give you.”

hausa: Mala’ikan Ubangiji ya ce wa Bala’am, “Ka tafi tare da mutanen, amma abin da na faɗa maka ne kaɗai za ka faɗa.” Saboda haka Bala’am ya tafi tare da dattawan Balak.
english: Yahweh’s angel said to Balaam, “Go with the men; but you shall only speak the word that I shall speak to you.” So Balaam went with the princes of Balak.

hausa: Ceton adalai kan zo daga Ubangiji; shi ne mafaka a lokacin wahala.
english: But the salvation of the righteous is from Yahweh. He is their stronghold in the time of trouble.

hausa: In kuka ji an yi magana a kan wani daga cikin biranen da Ubangiji Allahnku yake ba ku ku zauna a ciki
english: If you hear about one of your cities, which Yahweh your God gives you to dwell there, that

hausa: Sa’ad da muka zo Urushalima, ’yan’uwa suka karɓe mu da murna.
english: When we had come to Jerusalem, the brothers received us gladly.

hausa: da kuma cikin gādon da ba zai taɓa lalacewa, ɓacewa ko koɗewa ba, ajiyayye a sama dominku,
english: to an incorruptible and undefiled inheritance that doesn’t fade away, reserved in Heaven for you,

hausa: Amma Arameyawa suka gudu a gaban Isra’ila, Dawuda kuwa ya kashe mahayan keken yaƙinsu ɗari bakwai, da sojojin ƙasa dubu arba’in. Ya bugi Shobak, shugaban ƙungiyar sojansu ya kuwa mutu a can.
english: The Syrians fled before Israel; and David killed seven hundred charioteers of the Syrians and forty thousand horsemen, and struck Shobach the captain of their army, so that he died there.

hausa: “Wannan ce za tă zama iyakar ƙasa. “A wajen arewa za tă fara daga Bahar Rum ta hanyar Hetlon ta wuce Lebo Hamat zuwa Zedad,
english: “This shall be the border of the land: “On the north side, from the great sea, by the way of Hethlon, to the entrance of Zedad;

hausa: “ ‘Duk da haka, zan kawo lafiya da warkarwa gare ta; zan warkar da mutanena in kuma wadata su da salama da zama lafiya.
english: behold, I will bring it health and healing, and I will cure them; and I will reveal to them abundance of peace and truth.

hausa: Yesu ya tambaye shi ya ce, “Me kake so in yi maka?” Makahon ya ce, “Rabbi, ina so in sami ganin gari.”
english: Jesus asked him, “What do you want me to do for you?” The blind man said to him, “Rabboni, that I may see again.”

hausa: Da safe Dawuda ya rubuta wa Yowab wasiƙa ya ba wa Uriya.
english: In the morning, David wrote a letter to Joab and sent it by the hand of Uriah.

hausa: suna da hannuwa, amma ba sa iya taɓa kome, ƙafafu, amma ba sa iya tafiya; ba sa iya ce wani abu da maƙogwaronsu.
english: They have hands, but they don’t feel. They have feet, but they don’t walk, neither do they speak through their throat.

hausa: Akwai kuma waɗansu biyar, Hashuba, Ohel, Berekiya, Hasadiya da Yushab-Hesed.
english: and Hashubah, Ohel, Berechiah, Hasadiah, and Jushab Hesed, five.

hausa: Da ya gama auna filin da yake cikin haikali, sai ya fitar da ni ta ƙofar gabas ya auna dukan filin kewaye.
english: Now when he had finished measuring the inner house, he brought me out by the way of the gate which faces toward the east, and measured it all around.

hausa: “Ka yi magana da Isra’ilawa, ka ce musu, ‘Duk sa’ad da mutum ya yi rantsuwa ta musamman zai keɓe wani ga Ubangiji, ta wurin biyan kuɗaɗen fansa,
english: “Speak to the children of Israel, and say to them, ‘When a man consecrates a person to Yahweh in a vow, according to your valuation,

hausa: Haka yake rubutu cikin dukan wasiƙunsa, yana magana a cikinsu a kan waɗannan al’amura. Wasiƙunsa sun ƙunshi waɗansu abubuwa masu wuyar fahimta, waɗanda jahilai da kuma waɗanda ba tsayayyu ba ne suke murɗe ma’anarsu, kamar yadda suke yi da sauran Nassosi, ta haka suke jawo wa kansu hallaka.
english: as also in all of his letters, speaking in them of these things. In those, there are some things that are hard to understand, which the ignorant and unsettled twist, as they also do to the other Scriptures, to their own destruction.

hausa: Sarakunanki ruri ne na zakoki, shugabanninki kyarketan dare ne, waɗanda ba sa rage kome don safe.
english: Her princes within her are roaring lions. Her judges are evening wolves. They leave nothing until the next day.

hausa: A nan ne mutanen Isra’ila suka sha kashi a hannun mutanen Dawuda. Waɗanda suka yi rauni da kuma waɗanda suka mutu a ranar sun yi yawa, mutum dubu ashirin.
english: The people of Israel were struck there before David’s servants, and there was a great slaughter there that day of twenty thousand men.

hausa: Alade ma marar tsarki ne; ko da yake yana da rababben kofato, shi ba ya sāke tona abin da ya riga ya haɗiye. Ba za ku ci namansu ko ku taɓa gawarsu ba.
english: The pig, because it has a split hoof but doesn’t chew the cud, is unclean to you. You shall not eat their meat. You shall not touch their carcasses.

hausa: Ka albarkaci ɗaukan dabarunsa, ya Ubangiji, ka kuma ji daɗin aikin hannuwansa. Ka murƙushe kwankwaso waɗanda suka tayar masa; ka bugi abokan gābansa har sai ba su ƙara tashi ba.”
english: Yahweh, bless his skills. Accept the work of his hands. Strike through the hips of those who rise up against him, of those who hate him, that they not rise again.”

hausa: “Ka yi makoki game da sarakunan Isra’ila
english: “Moreover, take up a lamentation for the princes of Israel,

hausa: Sai ya kasance cewa Sarki ya sa dogari wanda ya raka shi wajen Elisha ya tsare ƙofar birnin. Sai mutane suka tattake shi a ƙofar har ya mutu, kamar yadda annabi Elisha ya faɗa sa’ad da sarki ya tafi wurinsa.
english: The king had appointed the captain on whose hand he leaned to be in charge of the gate; and the people trampled over him in the gate, and he died as the man of God had said, who spoke when the king came down to him.

hausa: kullum za ka riƙa fushi? Hasalarka za tă ci gaba har abada ne?’ Haka kike magana, amma kina aikata dukan muguntar da kika iya yi.”
english: “‘Will he retain his anger forever? Will he keep it to the end?’ Behold, you have spoken and have done evil things, and have had your way.”

hausa: Ɗan Yonatan shi ne, Merib-Ba’al wanda ya zama mahaifin Mika.
english: The son of Jonathan was Merib-baal. Merib-baal became the father of Micah.

hausa: Duk sa’ad da bakan gizo ya bayyana cikin gizagizan, zan gan shi in kuma tuna da madawwamin alkawari tsakanin Allah da dukan halittu masu rai, na kowane iri a duniya.”
english: The rainbow will be in the cloud. I will look at it, that I may remember the everlasting covenant between God and every living creature of all flesh that is on the earth.”

hausa: “Saboda haka ga abin da Ubangiji yana cewa game da sarkin Assuriya, “Ba zai shiga wannan birni ba ya harbe kibiya a nan. Ba zai zo gabansa da garkuwa ba ko ya gina mahaurai kewaye a kansa ba.
english: “Therefore Yahweh says concerning the king of Assyria, ‘He will not come to this city, nor shoot an arrow there, neither will he come before it with shield, nor cast up a mound against it.

hausa: Yana kuma da ƙwarƙwara wadda take Shekem, ita ma ta haifa masa ɗa wanda ya ba shi suna Abimelek.
english: His concubine who was in Shechem also bore him a son, and he named him Abimelech.

hausa: Ku dubi abin da wannan baƙin ciki irin na tsoron Allah ya kawo muku mana, ya sa ku marmarin aikatawa, da nuna cewa kun yi kuskure, ya sa kuka yi fushi, kuka kuma ji tsoro, ya sa kuka sa zuciya, kuka kuma sa aniya, ya sa kuna a shirye ku ga an yi horon da ya dace. Game da wannan sha’ani kam, lalle ta kowace hanya kun nuna cewa ba ku da laifi.
english: For behold, this same thing, that you were grieved in a godly way, what earnest care it worked in you. Yes, what defense, indignation, fear, longing, zeal, and vindication! In everything you demonstrated yourselves to be pure in the matter.

hausa: Kafin bangaskiyan nan tă zo, mun kasance a daure a kurkuku a ƙarƙashin Doka, a kulle sai da bangaskiyar da za tă zo ta bayyana.
english: But before faith came, we were kept in custody under the law, confined for the faith which should afterwards be revealed.

hausa: Waɗannan su ne sarakunan da suka yi mulki a Edom kafin wani sarki mutumin Isra’ila yă yi mulki,
english: These are the kings who reigned in the land of Edom, before any king reigned over the children of Israel.

hausa: Ina roƙonku ’yan’uwa, saboda Ubangijinmu Yesu Kiristi da kuma saboda ƙaunar Ruhu, ku haɗa kai tare da ni cikin famata ta wurin yin addu’a ga Allah saboda ni.
english: Now I beg you, brothers, by our Lord Jesus Christ and by the love of the Spirit, that you strive together with me in your prayers to God for me,

hausa: Sa’ad da rana ta fāɗi, aka kuwa yi duhu, sai wata tukunya mai hayaƙi, mai harshen wuta mai ci, ta bayyana, ta kuma wuce tsakanin abubuwan nan da aka tsaga.
english: It came to pass that, when the sun went down, and it was dark, behold, a smoking furnace and a flaming torch passed between these pieces.

hausa: Sai Yowab ya je wurin sarki ya ce, “Me ke nan ka yi? Abner ya zo wurinka. Don me ka ƙyale shi yă tafi? Ga shi kuwa ya tafi!
english: Then Joab came to the king and said, “What have you done? Behold, Abner came to you. Why is it that you have sent him away, and he is already gone?

hausa: “Saboda haka ka faɗa wa gidan Isra’ila cewa, ‘Ga abin da Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka yana cewa ku tuba! Ku juyo daga gumakanku ku kuma furta dukan ayyukanku masu banƙyama!
english: “Therefore tell the house of Israel, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “Return, and turn yourselves from your idols! Turn away your faces from all your abominations.

hausa: Yesu ya amsa ya ce, “Idan na so yă kasance da rai har in dawo, mene ne naka a ciki? Kai dai bi ni.”
english: Jesus said to him, “If I desire that he stay until I come, what is that to you? You follow me.”

hausa: “Babu wani bawa mai iya bauta wa iyayengiji biyu ba. Ko dai ya ƙi ɗaya, ya so ɗayan, ko kuwa ya dāge ga yi wa ɗaya bauta, sa’an nan ya rena ɗayan. Ba za ku iya ku bauta wa Allah tare da bauta wa Mammon (wato, Kuɗi) a lokaci ɗaya ba.”
english: No servant can serve two masters, for either he will hate the one and love the other; or else he will hold to one and despise the other. You aren’t able to serve God and Mammon.”

hausa: Sai Yowab ya shiga gidan sarki ya ce, “Yau ka kunyatar da dukan mutanenka, waɗanda ba da daɗewa ba sun ceci ranka, da rayukan ’ya’yanka maza, da na ’ya’yanka mata, da na matanka da kuma na ƙwarƙwaranka.
english: Joab came into the house to the king, and said, “Today you have shamed the faces of all your servants who today have saved your life, and the lives of your sons and of your daughters, and the lives of your wives, and the lives of your concubines;

hausa: Iri suna ta yanƙwanewa a busasshiyar ƙasa Ɗakunan ajiya sun lalace, an rurrushe rumbunan hatsin, gama hatsi ya ƙare.
english: The seeds rot under their clods. The granaries are laid desolate. The barns are broken down, for the grain has withered.

hausa: Amma yanzu, masarautarka ba za tă dawwama ba, Ubangiji ya riga ya sami wani wanda zuciyarsa ke ƙauna, ya naɗa shi shugaban mutanensa gama ba ka bi umarnin Ubangiji ba.”
english: But now your kingdom will not continue. Yahweh has sought for himself a man after his own heart, and Yahweh has appointed him to be prince over his people, because you have not kept that which Yahweh commanded you.”

hausa: Ƙarshe ya zo! Ƙarshe ya zo! Ya farka a kanki. Ga shi, ya zo!
english: An end has come. The end has come! It awakes against you. Behold, it comes.

hausa: Suka tashi daga Tera, suka yi sansani a Mitka.
english: They traveled from Terah, and encamped in Mithkah.

hausa: In muka furta zunubanmu, shi mai aminci ne, mai adalci kuma, zai gafarta mana zunubanmu, yă kuma tsarkake mu daga dukan rashin adalci.
english: If we confess our sins, he is faithful and righteous to forgive us the sins and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.

hausa: Azmawet mutumin Harum, Eliyaba mutumin Sha’albo,
english: Azmaveth the Baharumite, Eliahba the Shaalbonite,

hausa: Za a wofinta duniya ƙaƙaf a kuma washe ta sarai. Ubangiji ne ya faɗa haka.
english: The earth will be utterly emptied and utterly laid waste; for Yahweh has spoken this word.

hausa: “ ‘A wannan rana,’ in ji Ubangiji Maɗaukaki, ‘Zan karya karkiya daga wuyansu zan kuma cire musu kangi; baƙi ba za su ƙara bautar da su ba.
english: It will come to pass in that day, says Yahweh of Armies, that I will break his yoke from off your neck, and will burst your bonds. Strangers will no more make them their bondservants;

hausa: gama ya san yadda aka yi mu, ya tuna cewa mu ƙura ne.
english: For he knows how we are made. He remembers that we are dust.

hausa: Sa’an nan Yaƙub ya kyakkece tufafinsa, ya sa tufafin makoki, ya kuma yi makoki domin ɗansa kwanaki masu yawa.
english: Jacob tore his clothes, and put sackcloth on his waist, and mourned for his son many days.

hausa: Allah ya fitar da su daga Masar; suna da ƙarfi iri na kutunkun ɓauna.
english: God brings them out of Egypt. He has as it were the strength of the wild ox.

hausa: Don tsoron ganin azabarta za su tsaya daga nesa, su yi kuka suna cewa, “ ‘Kaito! Kaito, ya birni mai girma. Ya ke Babilon, birni mai iko! Cikin sa’a guda hallakarki ta zo!’
english: standing far away for the fear of her torment, saying, ‘Woe, woe, the great city, Babylon, the strong city! For your judgment has come in one hour.’

hausa: “Ina cikin dubawa, “sai aka ajiye kursiyoyi, sai ga wani wanda yake tun fil azal ya zauna a mazauninsa. Rigarsa ta yi fari fat kamar ƙanƙara; gashin kansa sun yi fari kamar ulu. Kursiyinsa kuma harshen wuta, dukan ƙafafun kursiyin masu kama da keken yaƙin, wuta ne.
english: “I watched until thrones were placed, and one who was Ancient of Days sat. His clothing was white as snow, and the hair of his head like pure wool. His throne was fiery flames, and its wheels burning fire.

hausa: Biyu-biyu na dukan halittu masu numfashi suka zo wurin Nuhu, suka shiga jirgi.
english: Pairs from all flesh with the breath of life in them went into the ship to Noah.

hausa: Sa’ad da Mordekai yake zaune a bakin ƙofar sarki, sai Bigtana da Teresh, biyu daga cikin hafsoshin sarki masu gadin ƙofar shiga, suka yi fushi, suka kuma ƙulla su kashe sarki Zerzes.
english: In those days, while Mordecai was sitting in the king’s gate, two of the king’s eunuchs, Bigthan and Teresh, who were doorkeepers, were angry, and sought to lay hands on the King Ahasuerus.

hausa: Da zuffan goshinka za ka ci abincinka har ka koma ga ƙasa, da yake daga cikinta aka yi ka. Gama kai turɓaya ne, kuma ga turɓaya za ka koma.”
english: You will eat bread by the sweat of your face until you return to the ground, for you were taken out of it. For you are dust, and you shall return to dust.”

hausa: Sai na ga sama a buɗe can kuwa a gabana ga farin doki, sunan mahayinsa Mai Aminci da Mai Gaskiya ne. Da adalci yake shari’a yake kuma yaƙi.
english: I saw heaven opened, and behold, a white horse, and he who sat on it is called Faithful and True. In righteousness he judges and makes war.

hausa: Lawiyawa suka tsarkake kansu, suka kuma wanke tufafinsu. Sai Haruna ya miƙa su kamar hadaya ta kaɗawa a gaban Ubangiji, ya kuma yi kafara saboda su don yă tsarkake su.
english: The Levites purified themselves from sin, and they washed their clothes; and Aaron offered them for a wave offering before Yahweh and Aaron made atonement for them to cleanse them.

hausa: Dawuda ya ji tsoron Ubangiji a ranar, sai ya ce, “Yaya akwatin alkawarin Ubangiji zai iya zuwa wurina?”
english: David was afraid of Yahweh that day; and he said, “How could Yahweh’s ark come to me?”

hausa: Ubana, wanda ya ba ni su, ya fi duka girma, ba mai ƙwace su daga hannun Ubana.
english: My Father who has given them to me is greater than all. No one is able to snatch them out of my Father’s hand.

hausa: Su ruhohin aljanu ne da suke aikata abubuwan banmamaki, sukan je wurin sarakunan dukan duniya, don su tattara su don yaƙi a babbar ranar Allah Maɗaukaki.
english: for they are spirits of demons, performing signs, which go out to the kings of the whole inhabited earth, to gather them together for the war of that great day of God the Almighty.

hausa: Saboda haka da muka kāsa daurewa, sai muka ga ya fi kyau a bar mu a Atens mu kaɗai.
english: Therefore when we couldn’t stand it any longer, we thought it good to be left behind at Athens alone,

hausa: Ba yadda mutum zai kahu ta wurin aikata mugunta, amma ba za a tumɓuke adali ba.
english: A man shall not be established by wickedness, but the root of the righteous shall not be moved.

hausa: Ta Dawuda. A gare ka nake kira, ya Ubangiji Dutsena; kada ka yi mini kunnen ƙashi. Gama in ka yi shiru, zan zama kamar waɗanda suka gangara rami.
english: By David. To you, Yahweh, I call. My rock, don’t be deaf to me, lest, if you are silent to me, I would become like those who go down into the pit.

hausa: wanda yake gafarta dukan zunubai yake kuma warkar da dukan cututtuka,
english: who forgives all your sins, who heals all your diseases,

hausa: Sa’ad da Filistiyawa suka ji an naɗa Dawuda sarki a bisa dukan Isra’ila, sai suka haura da cikakken mayaƙa don su neme shi, amma Dawuda ya ji game da wannan ya kuwa fita don yă ƙara da su.
english: When the Philistines heard that David was anointed king over all Israel, all the Philistines went up to seek David; and David heard of it, and went out against them.

hausa: Zan yayyafa muku ruwa mai tsabta, zan kuwa tsarkake ku daga dukan ƙazantarku daga kuma dukan gumakanku.
english: I will sprinkle clean water on you, and you will be clean. I will cleanse you from all your filthiness and from all your idols.

hausa: Ya aikata mugunta a gaban Ubangiji, ya bi munanan al’adun al’umman da Ubangiji ya kora a gaban Isra’ilawa.
english: He did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight, after the abominations of the nations whom Yahweh cast out before the children of Israel.

hausa: Ubangiji Allahnmu ya taimake mu muka ci Arower wadda take a gefen Kwarin Arnon, da garin da yake a cikin kwarin, har zuwa Gileyad. Babu garin da ya gaggare mu.
english: From Aroer, which is on the edge of the valley of the Arnon, and the city that is in the valley, even to Gilead, there was not a city too high for us. Yahweh our God delivered up all before us.

hausa: Sa’an nan ikkilisiya ko’ina a Yahudiya, Galili da kuma Samariya ta sami salama. Ta yi ƙarfi; ta kuma ƙarfafa ta wurin Ruhu Mai Tsarki, ta ƙaru sosai tana rayuwa cikin tsoron Ubangiji.
english: So the assemblies throughout all Judea, Galilee, and Samaria had peace and were built up. They were multiplied, walking in the fear of the Lord and in the comfort of the Holy Spirit.

hausa: Yesu ya amsa ya ce, “Abin da ba ya yiwuwa ga mutane, mai yiwuwa ne ga Allah.”
english: But he said, “The things which are impossible with men are possible with God.”

hausa: Ya ƙarfina, na dogara gare ka; kai, ya Allah, kai ne kagarata,
english: Oh, my Strength, I watch for you, for God is my high tower.

hausa: Domin waɗancan kwanakin za su zama kwanaki na baƙin ciki, waɗanda ba a taɓa yin irinsa ba tun farkon halitta, har yă zuwa yanzu, ba kuwa za a sāke yin irinsa ba.
english: For in those days there will be oppression, such as there has not been the like from the beginning of the creation which God created until now, and never will be.

hausa: sai shekaru bakwai na yunwa suka soma shigowa, kamar yadda Yusuf ya faɗa. Aka yi yunwa ko’ina amma ban da ƙasar Masar. Don akwai abinci.
english: The seven years of famine began to come, just as Joseph had said. There was famine in all lands, but in all the land of Egypt there was bread.

hausa: Kuna tuntuɓe dare da rana, annabawa ma suna tuntuɓe tare da ku. Saboda haka zan hallaka mahaifiyarku,
english: You will stumble in the day, and the prophet will also stumble with you in the night; and I will destroy your mother.

hausa: Mutumin da yake da arziki ba tare da ganewa ba shi kamar dabbobi ne da suke mutuwa.
english: A man who has riches without understanding, is like the animals that perish.

hausa: Bayan kwanaki masu yawa, sai Yahudawa suka haɗa baki su kashe shi,
english: When many days were fulfilled, the Jews conspired together to kill him,

hausa: Sa’ad da Yobab ya rasu, Husham daga ƙasar Temaniyawa ya gāje shi.
english: Jobab died, and Husham of the land of the Temanites reigned in his place.

hausa: Ubangiji ya ɗauke hukuncinki, ya mai da abokan gābanki baya. Ubangiji, Sarkin Isra’ila, yana tare da ke; ba kuma za ki ƙara jin tsoron wani lahani ba.
english: Yahweh has taken away your judgments. He has thrown out your enemy. The King of Israel, Yahweh, is among you. You will not be afraid of evil any more.

hausa: Namun jeji suna girmama ni, diloli da mujiyoyi ma haka, domin na tanada musu ruwa a hamada da rafuffuka a ƙeƙasasshiyar ƙasa, don a ba da abin sha ga mutanena, zaɓaɓɓuna,
english: The animals of the field, the jackals and the ostriches, shall honor me, because I give water in the wilderness and rivers in the desert, to give drink to my people, my chosen,

hausa: Da ya tambayi lokacin da ɗansa ya sami sauƙi, sai suka ce masa, “Zazzaɓin ya sake shi jiya a sa’a ta bakwai.”
english: So he inquired of them the hour when he began to get better. They said therefore to him, “Yesterday at the seventh hour, the fever left him.”

hausa: Zan ba su zuciya ɗaya da aiki ɗaya, don kullum su ji tsorona domin amfaninsu da kuma amfanin ’ya’yansu a bayansu.
english: I will give them one heart and one way, that they may fear me forever, for their good and the good of their children after them.

hausa: Korneliyus kuwa ya zura masa ido a tsorace ya ce, “Mene ne, ya Ubangiji?” Mala’ikan ya ce, “Addu’o’inka da kyautanka ga matalauta sun kai har sama, hadayar tunawa ce a gaban Allah.
english: He, fastening his eyes on him and being frightened, said, “What is it, Lord?” He said to him, “Your prayers and your gifts to the needy have gone up for a memorial before God.

hausa: amma ba su gane cewa na tuna da dukan ayyukan muguntarsu ba. Zunubansu sun kewaye su; kullum suna a gabana.
english: They don’t consider in their hearts that I remember all their wickedness. Now their own deeds have engulfed them. They are before my face.

hausa: “Wannan za tă zama dawwammamiyar farilla ce gare ku. Za a riƙa yin kafara sau ɗaya a shekara saboda dukan zunuban Isra’ilawa.” Aka kuma yi haka, yadda Ubangiji ya umarci Musa.
english: “This shall be an everlasting statute for you, to make atonement for the children of Israel once in the year because of all their sins.” It was done as Yahweh commanded Moses.

hausa: Ƙofar zuwa ɗakunan ƙasa tana gefen kudu na haikalin; akwai matakai da suka bi zuwa hawa na tsakiya, daga can kuma matakan sun wuce zuwa hawa na uku.
english: The door for the middle side rooms was in the right side of the house. They went up by winding stairs into the middle floor, and out of the middle into the third.

hausa: zan kuma riɓaɓɓanya mutane a kanku, dukan gidan Isra’ila ke nan. Za a zauna a birane a kuma sāke gina rusassun wurare.
english: I will multiply men on you, all the house of Israel, even all of it. The cities will be inhabited and the waste places will be built.

hausa: Wajen tsakar dare Bulus da Sila suna addu’a suna rera waƙoƙi ga Allah, sauran ’yan kurkuku kuwa suna sauraronsu.
english: But about midnight Paul and Silas were praying and singing hymns to God, and the prisoners were listening to them.

hausa: Su da suke neman raina za su hallaka; za su gangara zuwa zurfafan duniya.
english: But those who seek my soul to destroy it shall go into the lower parts of the earth.

hausa: Amma Allah ya ce wa Bala’am, “Kada ka tafi tare da su. Kada ka la’anta mutanen nan, gama su masu albarka ne.”
english: God said to Balaam, “You shall not go with them. You shall not curse the people, for they are blessed.”

hausa: A wannan rana Nuhu tare da matarsa da ’ya’yansa maza, Shem, Ham da Yafet da matansu uku suka shiga jirgi.
english: In the same day Noah, and Shem, Ham, and Japheth—the sons of Noah—and Noah’s wife and the three wives of his sons with them, entered into the ship—

hausa: Ka mayar mini farin cikin cetonka ka kuma ba ni ruhun biyayya, yă riƙe ni.
english: Restore to me the joy of your salvation. Uphold me with a willing spirit.

hausa: “Game da kai kuma, ɗan mutum, mutanen ƙasarka suna magana da juna game da kai a katanga da kuma ƙofofin gidaje, suna ce wa juna, ‘Ku zo mu tafi mu ji maganar da ta zo daga wurin Ubangiji.’
english: “As for you, son of man, the children of your people talk about you by the walls and in the doors of the houses, and speak to one another, everyone to his brother, saying, ‘Please come and hear what the word is that comes out from Yahweh.’

hausa: Kuma ya umarci waɗansu ƙarfafan sojoji a cikin rundunarsa su daure Shadrak, Meshak da Abednego su jefa su cikin tanderun wutar.
english: He commanded certain mighty men who were in his army to bind Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego, and to cast them into the burning fiery furnace.

hausa: Dawuda tare da shugabannin mayaƙa, suka keɓe waɗansu daga ’ya’yan Asaf, Heman da Yedutun don hidimar yin annabci, suna amfani da garayu, molaye da ganguna. Ga jerin mutanen da suka yi wannan hidima.
english: Moreover, David and the captains of the army set apart for the service certain of the sons of Asaph, of Heman, and of Jeduthun, who were to prophesy with harps, with stringed instruments, and with cymbals. The number of those who did the work according to their service was:

hausa: Sa’an nan suka tafi wurin Sarki Hezekiya suka faɗa masa, “Mun tsarkake haikalin Ubangiji gaba ɗaya, bagaden ƙone hadaya tare da dukan kayayyakinsa, da tebur don shirya tsarkaken burodi, tare da dukan kayayyakinsa.
english: Then they went in to Hezekiah the king within the palace and said, “We have cleansed all Yahweh’s house, including the altar of burnt offering with all its vessels, and the table of show bread with all its vessels.

hausa: Sa’ad da ya same su, sai ya maimaita waɗannan kalmomi gare su.
english: He overtook them, and he spoke these words to them.

hausa: Ya sāke aikan wani bawa, shi ma suka yi masa dūka, suka kunyata shi, suka kuma kore shi hannu wofi.
english: He sent yet another servant, and they also beat him and treated him shamefully, and sent him away empty.

hausa: Fir’auna ya ce wa Yusuf, “Faɗa wa ’yan’uwanka, ‘Yi wannan; ku jibge dabbobinku ku koma zuwa ƙasar Kan’ana,
english: Pharaoh said to Joseph, “Tell your brothers, ‘Do this: Load your animals, and go, travel to the land of Canaan.

hausa: To, a kwanakin nan shawarar da Ahitofel yakan bayar takan zama kamar wadda aka nemi daga Allah ne. Haka Dawuda da Absalom duk suke ɗaukan dukan shawarar Ahitofel.
english: The counsel of Ahithophel, which he gave in those days, was as if a man inquired at the inner sanctuary of God. All the counsel of Ahithophel was like this both with David and with Absalom.

hausa: Firist ɗin zai bincike shi, in ƙurjin ya yaɗu a fatar jikinsa, zai furta shi marar tsarki; cuta ce mai yaɗuwa.
english: The priest shall examine him; and behold, if the scab has spread on the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean. It is leprosy.

hausa: Da Bulus ya ɗaukaka ƙara zuwa gaban Babban Sarki sai na umarta a tsare shi har kafin in aika shi zuwa ga Kaisar.”
english: But when Paul had appealed to be kept for the decision of the emperor, I commanded him to be kept until I could send him to Caesar.”

hausa: Manzon ya tashi ya tafi, da ya iso kuwa sai ya gaya wa Dawuda dukan abin da Yowab ya aike shi yă faɗa.
english: So the messenger went, and came and showed David all that Joab had sent him for.

hausa: Sai ya ce musu, “Kun san Laban, jikan Nahor?” Suka amsa, “I, mun san shi.”
english: He said to them, “Do you know Laban, the son of Nahor?” They said, “We know him.”

hausa: Gama shi da yakan ɗauki fansa a kan mai kisa yakan tuna; ba ya ƙyale kukan masu wahala.
english: For he who avenges blood remembers them. He doesn’t forget the cry of the afflicted.

hausa: Ba su iya yinsa a daidai lokacinsa ba domin babu isashen firistocin da suka tsarkake kansu, mutane kuma ba su taru a Urushalima ba.
english: For they could not keep it at that time, because the priests had not sanctified themselves in sufficient number, and the people had not gathered themselves together to Jerusalem.

hausa: Gama shi bawan Allah ne don kyautata rayuwarka. Amma in ka aikata mugunta, to, sai ka ji tsoro, don ba a banza ne shugaba yake ɗaukan takobinsa ba. Shi fa bawan Allah ne, ta wurinsa ne fushin Allah yakan hukunta masu laifi.
english: for he is a servant of God to you for good. But if you do that which is evil, be afraid, for he doesn’t bear the sword in vain; for he is a servant of God, an avenger for wrath to him who does evil.

hausa: Ba za ka yi zina ba.
english: “You shall not commit adultery.

hausa: “Ku fito daga cikinta, jama’ata! Ku tsere da ranku! Ku tsere daga zafin fushin Ubangiji.
english: “My people, go away from the middle of her, and each of you save yourselves from Yahweh’s fierce anger.

hausa: Ba gare mu ba, ya Ubangiji, ba gare mu ba amma ga sunanka yă sami ɗaukaka, saboda ƙaunarka da amincinka.
english: Not to us, Yahweh, not to us, but to your name give glory, for your loving kindness, and for your truth’s sake.

hausa: A zamanin dā, ya bar dukan ƙasashe su yi yadda suka ga dama.
english: who in the generations gone by allowed all the nations to walk in their own ways.

hausa: (amma ga shi yau kun tayar wa iyalin mahaifina, kuka kashe ’ya’yansa saba’in a dutse guda, kuka kuma naɗa Abimelek, ɗan baiwa, sarki a kan ’yan ƙasar Shekem domin shi ɗan’uwanku ne)
english: and you have risen up against my father’s house today and have slain his sons, seventy persons, on one stone, and have made Abimelech, the son of his female servant, king over the men of Shechem, because he is your brother);

hausa: In na ce wa kabari, ‘Kai ne mahaifina,’ tsutsa kuma ke ce, ‘Mahaifiyata’ ko ‘’yar’uwata,’
english: if I have said to corruption, ‘You are my father,’ and to the worm, ‘My mother,’ and ‘My sister,’

hausa: Ya zama sarki yana da shekaru ashirin da biyar, ya kuma yi mulki a Urushalima shekaru ashirin da tara. Sunan mahaifiyarsa Yehoyaddin, mutuniyar Urushalima.
english: He was twenty-five years old when he began to reign; and he reigned twenty-nine years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Jehoaddin of Jerusalem.

hausa: ’Ya’yan maza Yaban su ne, Elisha, Tarshish, Kittim da Rodanim.
english: The sons of Javan were: Elishah, Tarshish, Kittim, and Dodanim.

hausa: “Abin banmamaki da bantsoro ya faru a ƙasar.
english: “An astonishing and horrible thing has happened in the land.

hausa: Duk abin da yake na Uba nawa ne. Shi ya sa na ce, ‘Ruhun zai ɗauko daga abin da yake nawa, yă bayyana muku.’ ”
english: All things that the Father has are mine; therefore I said that he takes of mine and will declare it to you.

hausa: ’Ya’yan Ana su ne, Dishon da Oholibama ’yar Ana.
english: These are the children of Anah: Dishon and Oholibamah, the daughter of Anah.

hausa: Suka ce, “Ubangiji ya yi magana ta wurin Musa ne kaɗai? Ashe, bai yi magana ta wurinmu mu ma ba?” Ubangiji kuwa ya ji wannan.
english: They said, “Has Yahweh indeed spoken only with Moses? Hasn’t he spoken also with us?” And Yahweh heard it.

hausa: Dole yă juye daga mugunta, ya aikata nagarta; dole yă nemi salama yă kuma bi ta.
english: Let him turn away from evil and do good. Let him seek peace and pursue it.

hausa: Wane ne ya kashe Abimelek ɗan Yerub-Beshet? Ba mace ce ta jefa dutsen niƙa a kansa daga katanga, ta haka ya mutu a Tebez ba? Me ya sa kuka je kurkusa da katangar?’ In ya tambaye ka wannan, sai ka ce masa, ‘Har bawanka Uriya mutumin Hitti ma ya mutu.’ ”
english: Who struck Abimelech the son of Jerubbesheth? Didn’t a woman cast an upper millstone on him from the wall, so that he died at Thebez? Why did you go so near the wall?’ then you shall say, ‘Your servant Uriah the Hittite is also dead.’”

hausa: “Ku lura da wannan, ku da kuka manta da Allah, ko kuwa in yayyage ku kucu-kucu, ba kuma wanda zai cece ku.
english: “Now consider this, you who forget God, lest I tear you into pieces, and there be no one to deliver.

hausa: Gama suna surutai banza na girman kai, ta wurin son bin fasikanci na mutuntaka, sukan jan hankulan mutanen da suke kuɓucewa daga waɗancan masu zama cikin kuskure.
english: For, uttering great swelling words of emptiness, they entice in the lusts of the flesh, by licentiousness, those who are indeed escaping from those who live in error;

hausa: Ni da kaina na zaɓo ’yan’uwanka Lawiyawa daga cikin Isra’ilawa a matsayin kyauta a gare ku, keɓaɓɓu don Ubangiji, domin su yi hidima a Tentin Sujada.
english: Behold, I myself have taken your brothers the Levites from among the children of Israel. They are a gift to you, dedicated to Yahweh, to do the service of the Tent of Meeting.

hausa: Attai shi ne mahaifin Natan, Natan shi ne mahaifin Zabad,
english: Attai became the father of Nathan, and Nathan became the father of Zabad,

hausa: na Sena’a 3,630.
english: The children of Senaah, three thousand six hundred thirty.

hausa: Ku sha ruwa daga tankinku, ruwa mai gudu daga rijiyarku.
english: Drink water out of your own cistern, running water out of your own well.

hausa: “Ka miƙa kanka ga Allah ka samu salamarsa; ta haka ne arziki zai zo maka.
english: “Acquaint yourself with him now, and be at peace. By it, good will come to you.

hausa: ku kuma yi rayuwar ƙauna, kamar yadda Kiristi ya ƙaunace mu, har ya ba da kansa dominmu a matsayin sadaka mai ƙanshi da kuma hadaya ga Allah.
english: Walk in love, even as Christ also loved us and gave himself up for us, an offering and a sacrifice to God for a sweet-smelling fragrance.

hausa: Bitrus ya amsa ya ce, “Bari kuɗinka ya hallaka tare da kai, domin ka yi tsammani za ka iya saya kyautar Allah da kuɗi!
english: But Peter said to him, “May your silver perish with you, because you thought you could obtain the gift of God with money!

hausa: Amma ku yi wa kanku ajiyar dukiya a sama, inda ba tsatsa da asu da za su ɓata su, inda kuma ba ɓarayin da za su fasa, su yi sata.
english: but lay up for yourselves treasures in heaven, where neither moth nor rust consume, and where thieves don’t break through and steal;

hausa: ya kuma kawo kwanon zinariya ɗaya mai nauyin shekel goma, cike da turaren hayaƙi;
english: one golden ladle of ten shekels, full of incense;

hausa: Mutanen Sidon da Arfad su ne matuƙan jirgin ruwanki; gwanayenki, ya Taya, suna ciki a matsayi matuƙan jiragen ruwa.
english: The inhabitants of Sidon and Arvad were your rowers. Your wise men, Tyre, were in you. They were your pilots.

hausa: Kada ka ƙyale hikima, za tă kuwa tsare ka; ka ƙaunace ta, za tă kuwa lura da kai.
english: Don’t forsake her, and she will preserve you. Love her, and she will keep you.

hausa: Sa’an nan mutane Yahuda suka ce wa mutanen Simeyon “Ku zo tare da mu a yankin da aka ba mu rabon mu don mu yaƙi Kan’aniyawa. Mu ma mu bi ku wurin naku.” Saboda haka mutanen Simeyon suka tafi tare da su.
english: Judah said to Simeon his brother, “Come up with me into my lot, that we may fight against the Canaanites; and I likewise will go with you into your lot.” So Simeon went with him.

hausa: Ram shi ne mahaifin Amminadab, Amminadab kuwa shi ne mahaifin Nashon, shugaban mutanen Yahuda.
english: Ram became the father of Amminadab, and Amminadab became the father of Nahshon, prince of the children of Judah;

hausa: gama in ka kāsa biya za a ƙwace gadon da kake kwanciya a kai ma.
english: If you don’t have means to pay, why should he take away your bed from under you?

hausa: In suka ce, “Zo mu tafi; mu yi kwanton ɓauna, mu nemi wani mu kashe, mu fāɗa wa marasa laifi;
english: If they say, “Come with us. Let’s lie in wait for blood. Let’s lurk secretly for the innocent without cause.

hausa: Cikin ƙasar da muka kwasa a lokacin, na ba wa mutanen Ruben da mutanen Gad yankin arewa na Arower ta Kwarin Arnon, haɗe da rabin ƙasar tudu ta Gileyad, tare da biranenta.
english: This land we took in possession at that time: from Aroer, which is by the valley of the Arnon, and half the hill country of Gilead with its cities, I gave to the Reubenites and to the Gadites;

hausa: Allah ya halicci namun jeji bisa ga irinsu, dabbobi bisa ga irinsu, da kuma dukan halittu masu rarrafe a ƙasa bisa ga irinsu. Allah kuwa ya ga yana da kyau.
english: God made the animals of the earth after their kind, and the livestock after their kind, and everything that creeps on the ground after its kind. God saw that it was good.

hausa: Sa’an nan Ibrahim ya yi gudu zuwa garkensa, ya zaɓi ɗan maraƙi ya ba wa bawansa, bawansa kuma ya yi sauri ya gyara shi.
english: Abraham ran to the herd, and fetched a tender and good calf, and gave it to the servant. He hurried to dress it.

hausa: Gādo ga bawansa Isra’ila; Ƙaunarsa madawwamiya ce.
english: even a heritage to Israel his servant, for his loving kindness endures forever;

hausa: Manowa ya tashi ya bi matarsa. Da ya zo wurin mutumin, sai ya ce, “Kai ne wanda ka yi magana da matata?” Ya ce, “Ni ne.”
english: Manoah arose and followed his wife, and came to the man, and said to him, “Are you the man who spoke to my wife?” He said, “I am.”

hausa: Game da sauran ayyukan mulkin Yehoshafat da abubuwan da ya yi, da kuma yaƙe-yaƙensa, duk a rubuce suke a cikin littafin tarihin sarakunan Yahuda.
english: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoshaphat, and his might that he showed, and how he fought, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

hausa: Ƙafafunsu sukan gaggauta zuwa aikata zunubi; suna da saurin zub da jini. Tunaninsu mugaye ne; lalaci da hallaka sun shata hanyoyinsu.
english: Their feet run to evil, and they hurry to shed innocent blood. Their thoughts are thoughts of iniquity. Desolation and destruction are in their paths.

hausa: Hadayar da ya kawo ita ce, faranti guda ɗaya na azurfa, nauyinsa shekel ɗari ɗaya da talatin, da kuma daro na yayyafawa na azurfa, nauyinsa shekel saba’in, dukan biyu, an auna su bisa ga ma’aunin shekel na tsattsarkan wuri, kowannensu cike da lallausan gari, haɗe da mai kamar hadaya ta gari;
english: gave his offering: one silver platter, the weight of which was one hundred thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary, both of them full of fine flour mixed with oil for a meal offering;

hausa: “Saboda haka fa, Sarki Agiriffa, ban yi rashin biyayya ga wahayin nan daga sama ba.
english: “Therefore, King Agrippa, I was not disobedient to the heavenly vision,

hausa: Bawanka ya kashe zaki da beyar, wannan Bafilistin marar kaciya zai zama kamar ɗaya daga cikinsu, domin ya rena rundunar Allah mai rai.
english: Your servant struck both the lion and the bear. This uncircumcised Philistine shall be as one of them, since he has defied the armies of the living God.”

hausa: suka gudu a bisa duwatsu, suka gangara zuwa cikin kwaruruka, zuwa wurin da ka shirya musu.
english: The mountains rose, the valleys sank down, to the place which you had assigned to them.

hausa: Yesu ya amsa ya ce, “Kuna tsammani waɗannan Galiliyawan sun fi dukan sauran Galiliyawa zunubi ne, shi ya sa suka sha irin wannan wahala?
english: Jesus answered them, “Do you think that these Galileans were worse sinners than all the other Galileans, because they suffered such things?

hausa: Sai ya yi addu’a ga Ubangiji ya ce, “Ya Ubangiji, ba irin abin da na faɗa ke nan ba tun ina gida? Wannan ne ya sa na yi ƙoƙarin tserewa zuwa Tarshish. Ai, na sani kai Allah ne mai alheri da tausayi, mai jinkirin fushi da cikakkiyar ƙauna, kai Allah ne mai dakatar da nufinka na yin hukunci.
english: He prayed to Yahweh, and said, “Please, Yahweh, wasn’t this what I said when I was still in my own country? Therefore I hurried to flee to Tarshish, for I knew that you are a gracious God and merciful, slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness, and you relent of doing harm.

hausa: Kuma akan bukaci wani a tsakani ne idan da mutum biyu ake zance, Allah kuwa ɗaya ne.
english: Now a mediator is not between one, but God is one.

hausa: Yowab da dukan Isra’ilawa suka zauna a can, wata shida, sai da suka hallaka dukan mutane a Edom.
english: (for Joab and all Israel remained there six months, until he had cut off every male in Edom),

hausa: A ƙarshe, za a yi mulki na huɗu, mai ƙarfi kamar ƙarfe, Da yake baƙin ƙarfe yakan kakkarya, ya ragargaje abubuwa, haka nan wannan mulki zai ragargaje sauran mulkoki
english: The fourth kingdom will be strong as iron, because iron breaks in pieces and subdues all things; and as iron that crushes all these, it will break in pieces and crush.

hausa: Gama wane bege marar tsoron Allah yake da shi, lokacin da aka datse shi, lokacin da Allah ya ɗauke ransa?
english: For what is the hope of the godless, when he is cut off, when God takes away his life?

hausa: To, ku ji, ya Isra’ila, ku kasa kunne ga ƙa’idodi da dokokin da nake shirin koya muku. Ku bi su domin ku yi tsawon rai, ku kuma shiga ku mallaki ƙasar da Ubangiji, Allahn kakanninku yake ba ku.
english: Now, Israel, listen to the statutes and to the ordinances which I teach you, to do them, that you may live and go in and possess the land which Yahweh, the God of your fathers, gives you.

hausa: Kwana uku bayan isowa a lardin, sai Festus ya haura daga Kaisariya zuwa Urushalima,
english: Festus therefore, having come into the province, after three days went up to Jerusalem from Caesarea.

hausa: “Kada fa ku yi tsammani zan yi ƙararku wurin Uba. Akwai mai yin ƙararku, shi ne Musa, wanda kuke dogara da shi.
english: “Don’t think that I will accuse you to the Father. There is one who accuses you, even Moses, on whom you have set your hope.

hausa: Duk da haka akwai waɗansunku da ba su gaskata ba.” Gama Yesu ya sani tun farko, waɗanda ba su gaskata ba, da kuma wanda zai bashe shi.
english: But there are some of you who don’t believe.” For Jesus knew from the beginning who they were who didn’t believe, and who it was who would betray him.

hausa: Rana tana fāɗuwa, sai mutane suka yi ta kawo wa Yesu dukan waɗanda suke da cuta iri-iri, sai ya ɗibiya wa kowannensu hannuwansa, ya warkar da su.
english: When the sun was setting, all those who had any sick with various diseases brought them to him; and he laid his hands on every one of them, and healed them.

hausa: gama duk ’ya’yan fari nawa ne. Lokacin da karkashe duk ’ya’yan fari a Masar, na keɓe wa kaina kowane ɗan fari a Isra’ila, ko mutum, ko dabba. Za su zama nawa. Ni ne Ubangiji.”
english: for all the firstborn are mine. On the day that I struck down all the firstborn in the land of Egypt I made holy to me all the firstborn in Israel, both man and animal. They shall be mine. I am Yahweh.”

hausa: Na kuma ɗauki Rut mutuniyar Mowab, gwauruwar Malon a matsayin matata domin sunan mamaci da kuma mallakarsa yă ci gaba, domin kada sunansa yă ɓace daga cikin iyali ko daga tarihin gari. A yau ku ne shaidu!”
english: Moreover, Ruth the Moabitess, the wife of Mahlon, I have purchased to be my wife, to raise up the name of the dead on his inheritance, that the name of the dead may not be cut off from among his brothers and from the gate of his place. You are witnesses today.”

hausa: Kan Efraim shi ne Samariya, kan Samariya kuma kawai shi ne ɗan Remaliya. In ba ku tsaya da ƙarfi cikin bangaskiyarku ba, ba za ku dawwama ba.’ ”
english: The head of Ephraim is Samaria, and the head of Samaria is Remaliah’s son. If you will not believe, surely you shall not be established.’”

hausa: Da yake abubuwan ƙyama ne a gare ku, ba za ku ci namansu ba, kuma dole ku yi ƙyamar gawawwakinsu.
english: and you shall detest them. You shall not eat of their meat, and you shall detest their carcasses.

hausa: Ga abin da Ubangiji Maɗaukaki, Allah na Isra’ila, yana cewa, ‘Kamar yadda na kwararo fushina da hasalata a kan mazaunan Urushalima, haka kuma zan kwararo fushina a kanku sa’ad da kuka tafi Masar. Za ku zama abin la’ana da abin tsoro, abin ƙyama da abin ba’a; ba za ku ƙara ganin wannan wuri ba.’
english: For Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel, says: ‘As my anger and my wrath has been poured out on the inhabitants of Jerusalem, so my wrath will be poured out on you, when you enter into Egypt; and you will be an object of horror, an astonishment, a curse, and a reproach; and you will see this place no more.’

hausa: Haka Musa ya ƙidaya ’ya’yan fari na Isra’ilawa, yadda Ubangiji ya umarce shi.
english: Moses counted, as Yahweh commanded him, all the firstborn among the children of Israel.

hausa: Sarki ya umarci Yowab, Abishai, da Ittai, ya ce musu, “Ku yi mini hankali da saurayin nan Absalom.” Dukan mutane kuwa suka ji yadda sarki yake ba wa kowane komanda umarni.
english: The king commanded Joab and Abishai and Ittai, saying, “Deal gently for my sake with the young man Absalom.” All the people heard when the king commanded all the captains concerning Absalom.

hausa: Kumatunsa kamar lambun kayan yaji suna ba da turare. Leɓunansa sun yi kamar furen bi-rana suna ɗiga da mur.
english: His cheeks are like a bed of spices with towers of perfumes. His lips are like lilies, dropping liquid myrrh.

hausa: Sa’an nan sarki ya ƙara wa su Shadrak, Meshak da Abednego girma a yankin Babilon.
english: Then the king promoted Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego in the province of Babylon.

hausa: an yi mini kaciya a rana ta takwas, asalina Isra’ila ne, na kabilar Benyamin, mutumin Ibraniyawa ɗan Ibraniyawa; bisa ga doka kuwa ni Bafarisiye ne;
english: circumcised the eighth day, of the stock of Israel, of the tribe of Benjamin, a Hebrew of Hebrews; concerning the law, a Pharisee;

hausa: sai yă lasafta yawan shekarun da aka yi tun da an sayar da filin. Kuɗin filin zai dangana ga yawan shekarun da suka rage kafin shekara hamsin ta murna da za tă zo; sa’an nan zai iya koma ga mallakarsa.
english: then let him reckon the years since its sale, and restore the surplus to the man to whom he sold it; and he shall return to his property.

hausa: Sai Musa ya aika a kira Datan da Abiram, ’ya’yan Eliyab maza, amma suka ce, “Ba za mu zo ba!
english: Moses sent to call Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab; and they said, “We won’t come up!

hausa: Ni ne Ubangiji, Mai Tsarkin nan, Mahaliccin Isra’ila, Sarkinku.”
english: I am Yahweh, your Holy One, the Creator of Israel, your King.”

hausa: Ku yi sowa don farin ciki, ya ku sammai; ki yi farin ciki, ya ke duniya; ku ɓarke da waƙa, ya ku duwatsu! Gama Ubangiji ya ta’azantar da mutanensa zai kuma ji tausayin mutanensa da suke shan wahala.
english: Sing, heavens, and be joyful, earth! Break out into singing, mountains! For Yahweh has comforted his people, and will have compassion on his afflicted.

hausa: Nan da nan mutanen Benyamin suka tattara mayaƙa dubu ashirin da shida masu takuba daga biranensu, ban da mayaƙa ɗari bakwai da aka zaɓa daga mazauna a Gibeya.
english: The children of Benjamin were counted on that day out of the cities twenty-six thousand men who drew the sword, in addition to the inhabitants of Gibeah, who were counted seven hundred chosen men.

hausa: Saboda haka aikin a gidan Allah a Urushalima ya tsaya cik sai a shekara ta biyu ta mulkin Dariyus sarkin Farisa.
english: Then work stopped on God’s house which is at Jerusalem. It stopped until the second year of the reign of Darius king of Persia.

hausa: Suka amsa suka ce, “Bayinka sun zo ne daga ƙasa mai nisa gama Ubangiji Allahnka ya yi suna sosai. Gama mun ji labarin abubuwan da ya yi. Dukan abubuwan da ya yi a Masar
english: They said to him, “Your servants have come from a very far country because of the name of Yahweh your God; for we have heard of his fame, all that he did in Egypt,

hausa: Ba na faɗin wannan don in sa muku laifi. Na riga na gaya muku yadda muke ƙaunarku ƙwarai cikin zukatanmu, har babu abin da zai iya raba ku da ƙaunarmu, ko a mutuwa ko a rayuwa.
english: I say this not to condemn you, for I have said before that you are in our hearts to die together and live together.

hausa: Amma ba su fahimci abin da yake nufi da wannan magana ba. Ba su gane ba, don an ɓoye musu shi. Su kuwa sun ji tsoro su tambaye shi.
english: But they didn’t understand this saying. It was concealed from them, that they should not perceive it, and they were afraid to ask him about this saying.

hausa: Saboda haka Abimelek ya aika Ishaku yă je, sa’an nan ya ce, “Tabbatacce ita matarka ce! Me ya sa ka ce, ‘Ita ’yar’uwata ce?’ ” Ishaku ya amsa masa ya ce, “Don na yi tsammani zan rasa raina saboda ita.”
english: Abimelech called Isaac, and said, “Behold, surely she is your wife. Why did you say, ‘She is my sister’?” Isaac said to him, “Because I said, ‘Lest I die because of her.’”

hausa: “Duk da haka zan maido da wadatar Elam a kwanaki masu zuwa,” in ji Ubangiji.
english: ‘But it will happen in the latter days that I will reverse the captivity of Elam,’ says Yahweh.”

hausa: Sa’ad da kuka yi girbin inabi a gonar inabinku, kada ku yi kalan abin da ya rage. Ku bar shi don baƙo, maraya da kuma gwauruwa.
english: When you harvest your vineyard, you shall not glean it after yourselves. It shall be for the foreigner, for the fatherless, and for the widow.

hausa: Ashe, dukan mala’iku ba ruhohi masu hidima ba ne da aka aika don su yi wa waɗanda za su gāji ceto hidima?
english: Aren’t they all serving spirits, sent out to do service for the sake of those who will inherit salvation?

hausa: Adoniram kuwa shi ne shugaban aikin gandu; Yehoshafat ɗan Ahilud shi ne marubucin tarihi;
english: Adoram was over the men subject to forced labor, Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud was the recorder,

hausa: A ce wani ɗan’uwa ko ’yar’uwa ba shi da riguna ko abincin yini,
english: And if a brother or sister is naked and in lack of daily food,

hausa: Ta ce a ranta, “Ko da rigarsa ce kawai na taɓo, zan warke.”
english: for she said within herself, “If I just touch his garment, I will be made well.”

hausa: Sai Yoshuwa da dukan Isra’ilawa suka ɗauki Akan ɗan Zera, da azurfar, doguwar rigar, sandan zinariya, ’ya’yansa maza da mata, shanunsa, jakuna da tumaki, tentinsa da duk abin da yake da shi, suka kai su Kwarin Akor.
english: Joshua, and all Israel with him, took Achan the son of Zerah, the silver, the robe, the wedge of gold, his sons, his daughters, his cattle, his donkeys, his sheep, his tent, and all that he had; and they brought them up to the valley of Achor.

hausa: Ana cikin haka, mutane suna jiran Zakariya, suna kuma mamaki me ya sa ya daɗe haka a cikin haikali.
english: The people were waiting for Zacharias, and they marveled that he delayed in the temple.

hausa: Mala’ika na uku ya busa ƙahonsa, sai wani babban tauraro mai cin wuta kamar toci, ya fāɗi daga sararin sama, a kan kashi ɗaya bisa uku na koguna da kuma a bisa maɓulɓulan ruwa
english: The third angel sounded, and a great star fell from the sky, burning like a torch, and it fell on one third of the rivers, and on the springs of water.

hausa: Amma amfanin da Ruhu yake bayar shi ne ƙauna, farin ciki, salama, haƙuri, kirki, nagarta, aminci,
english: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faith,

hausa: In ba ku faɗa mini mafarkin ba, akwai hukunci guda ɗaya kurum dominku. Kun haɗa baki domin ku faɗa mini munanan al’amura domin ku ruɗe ni har lokaci yă wuce. Sai ku faɗa mini mafarkin, ta haka kuwa zan sani za ku iya yi mini fassararsa.”
english: But if you don’t make known to me the dream, there is but one law for you; for you have prepared lying and corrupt words to speak before me, until the situation changes. Therefore tell me the dream, and I will know that you can show me its interpretation.”

hausa: A tituna sun sa tsummoki a jikunansu; a kan rufin ɗakuna da kuma dandalin taruwa dukansu sai makoki suke yi, sun kwanta suna kuka.
english: In their streets, they clothe themselves in sackcloth. In their streets and on their housetops, everyone wails, weeping abundantly.

hausa: Gaskiya nake gaya muku, sai ƙwayar alkama ta fāɗi ƙasa ta mutu, in ba haka ba za tă kasance ƙwaya ɗaya tak. Amma in ta mutu, za tă ba da ’ya’ya da yawa.
english: Most certainly I tell you, unless a grain of wheat falls into the earth and dies, it remains by itself alone. But if it dies, it bears much fruit.

hausa: Tabbatacce Allah ne mai taimakona, Ubangiji shi ne wanda yake riƙe ni.
english: Behold, God is my helper. The Lord is the one who sustains my soul.

hausa: To, in Allah ya ba su kyauta yadda ya ba mu, mu da muka gaskata da Ubangiji Yesu Kiristi, wane ni da zan yi hamayya da Allah?”
english: If then God gave to them the same gift as us when we believed in the Lord Jesus Christ, who was I, that I could withstand God?”

hausa: Gama Ɗan Ragon da yake a tsakiyar kursiyin zai zama makiyayinsu; ‘zai bi da su zuwa ga maɓulɓular ruwan rai.’ ‘Allah kuwa zai share dukan hawaye daga idanunsu.’ ”
english: for the Lamb who is in the middle of the throne shepherds them and leads them to springs of life-giving waters. And God will wipe away every tear from their eyes.”

hausa: Ta haka muka san cewa mu na gaskiya ne, kuma za mu iya tsaya a gaban Allah ba tare da rawar jiki ba.
english: And by this we know that we are of the truth and persuade our hearts before him,

hausa: Amma in ƙurjin ya yaɗu a fatar jikinsa bayan ya nuna kansa ga firist don a furta shi tsarkake, dole yă sāke bayyana a gaban firist.
english: But if the scab spreads on the skin after he has shown himself to the priest for his cleansing, he shall show himself to the priest again.

hausa: Amma mutumin Allah ya amsa wa sarki, “Ko da za ka ba rabin mallakarka, ba zan tafi tare da kai ba, ba kuwa zan ci abinci, ko in sha ruwa a can ba.
english: The man of God said to the king, “Even if you gave me half of your house, I would not go in with you, neither would I eat bread nor drink water in this place;

hausa: Manyan firistoci da malaman dokoki suka ji wannan, sai suka fara neman hanyar da za su kashe shi, gama suna jin tsoronsa, saboda dukan taron suna mamakin koyarwarsa.
english: The chief priests and the scribes heard it, and sought how they might destroy him. For they feared him, because all the multitude was astonished at his teaching.

hausa: “Sa’ad da abokan gāba suka ci mutanenka Isra’ila a yaƙi saboda sun yi maka zunubi, sa’ad da kuma suka dawo gare ka don su furta sunanka, suna addu’a suna roƙo gare ka a wannan haikali,
english: “When your people Israel are struck down before the enemy because they have sinned against you, if they turn again to you and confess your name, and pray and make supplication to you in this house,

hausa: Ga mutanen da suka yi hidimar, tare da ’ya’yansu maza. Daga mutanen Kohat akwai, Heman, mawaƙi ɗan Yowel, ɗan Sama’ila,
english: These are those who served, and their sons. Of the sons of the Kohathites: Heman the singer, the son of Joel, the son of Samuel,

hausa: da Ishmahiya daga Gibeyon, wani jarumi a cikin Talatin nan, wanda shi ne shugaban Talatin; Irmiya, Yahaziyel, Yohanan, Yozabad daga Gedera,
english: Ishmaiah the Gibeonite, a mighty man among the thirty and a leader of the thirty; Jeremiah; Jahaziel; Johanan; Jozabad the Gederathite;

hausa: Karnuka za su cinye waɗanda suke na Ba’asha da suka mutu a birni, tsuntsaye kuma za su cinye waɗanda suka mutu a jeji.”
english: The dogs will eat Baasha’s descendants who die in the city; and he who dies of his in the field, the birds of the sky will eat.”

hausa: Ya mai da shugaban masu shayarwa a matsayinsa, saboda haka shugaban masu shayarwa ya sāke sa kwaf a hannun Fir’auna,
english: He restored the chief cup bearer to his position again, and he gave the cup into Pharaoh’s hand;

hausa: Ni ne Ubangiji wanda ya fitar da ku daga Masar don in zama Allahnku; saboda haka ku zama da tsarki, domin Ni mai tsarki ne.
english: For I am Yahweh who brought you up out of the land of Egypt, to be your God. You shall therefore be holy, for I am holy.

hausa: Ranarki ba za tă ƙara fāɗuwa ba watanki kuma ba zai ƙara shuɗewa ba; Ubangiji zai zama madawwamin haskenki, kwanakin baƙin cikinki za su ƙare.
english: Your sun will not go down any more, nor will your moon withdraw itself; for Yahweh will be your everlasting light, and the days of your mourning will end.

hausa: “Ya makantar da idanunsu ya kuma taurare zukatansu, don kada su gani da idanunsu, ko su fahimta a zukatansu, ko kuwa su juyo, har in warkar da su.”
english: “He has blinded their eyes and he hardened their heart, lest they should see with their eyes, and perceive with their heart, and would turn, and I would heal them.”

hausa: Ku bar shi yă zauna a cikinku a duk inda yake so, da kuma a kowane garin da ya zaɓa. Kada ku tsananta masa.
english: He shall dwell with you, among you, in the place which he shall choose within one of your gates, where it pleases him best. You shall not oppress him.

hausa: Ishbi-Benob kuwa, wani daga zuriyar Rafa, wanda nauyin kan māshinsa na tagulla ya yi shekel ɗari uku, wanda yake kuma da sabon māshi, ya ce zai kashe Dawuda.
english: and Ishbibenob, who was of the sons of the giant, the weight of whose spear was three hundred shekels of bronze in weight, he being armed with a new sword, thought he would kill David.

hausa: Saboda haka Musa ya sanar wa Isra’ilawa ƙayyadaddun bukukkuwan Ubangiji.
english: So Moses declared to the children of Israel the appointed feasts of Yahweh.

hausa: Babu abin da zai rage sai cizon haƙora a cikin kamammu ko mutuwa cikin waɗanda aka kashe. Duk da haka, fushinsa bai huce ba, hannunsa har yanzu yana a miƙe.
english: They will only bow down under the prisoners, and will fall under the slain. For all this his anger is not turned away, but his hand is stretched out still.

hausa: Gama ya warkar da mutane da yawa, masu cututtuka suka yi ta ƙoƙarin zuwa gaba, don su taɓa shi.
english: For he had healed many, so that as many as had diseases pressed on him that they might touch him.

hausa: Na fito da ku daga ƙasar Masar na kuma ’yantar da ku daga ƙasar bauta. Na aika da Musa yă jagorance ku, haka ma Haruna da Miriyam.
english: For I brought you up out of the land of Egypt, and redeemed you out of the house of bondage. I sent before you Moses, Aaron, and Miriam.

hausa: Yoshuwa ɗan Nun, bawan Ubangiji, ya mutu yana da shekara ɗari da goma.
english: Joshua the son of Nun, the servant of Yahweh, died, being one hundred ten years old.

hausa: Sama’ila ya tashi daga Gilgal ya tafi Gibeya a ƙasar Benyamin. Shawulu kuma ya ƙidaya mutanen da suke tare da shi, yawansu ya kai wajen mutum ɗari shida.
english: Samuel arose, and went from Gilgal to Gibeah of Benjamin. Saul counted the people who were present with him, about six hundred men.

hausa: Za a ci ta a ranar da kuka miƙa ta, ko kuwa a kashegarin; duk abin da ya rage har kwana ta uku dole a ƙone shi.
english: It shall be eaten the same day you offer it, and on the next day. If anything remains until the third day, it shall be burned with fire.

hausa: Nebuzaradan babban hafsan matsaran, ya kwashi waɗanda suka rage a cikin birnin, tare da sauran jama’a, da waɗanda suka miƙa kansu ga sarkin Babilon, ya kai su bauta.
english: Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard carried away captive the rest of the people who were left in the city and those who had deserted to the king of Babylon—all the rest of the multitude.

hausa: Na sani kana jin daɗina, gama abokin gābana ba zai ci nasara a kaina ba.
english: By this I know that you delight in me, because my enemy doesn’t triumph over me.

hausa: Duk wannan fa don amfaninku ne, domin alherin nan da yake bazuwa zuwa ga mutane masu yawa, yă zama dalilin godiya mai yawa ga ɗaukakar Allah.
english: For all things are for your sakes, that the grace, being multiplied through the many, may cause the thanksgiving to abound to the glory of God.

hausa: Saboda haka ka yi musu magana ka faɗa musu cewa, ‘Ga abin da Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka yana cewa sa’ad da wani mutumin Isra’ila ya kafa gumaka a cikin zuciyarsa ya kuma sa mugun abin tuntuɓe a gabansa sa’an nan ya tafi wurin annabi, Ni Ubangiji zan amsa masa da kaina game da babban bautar gumakarsa.
english: Therefore speak to them and tell them, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “Every man of the house of Israel who takes his idols into his heart and puts the stumbling block of his iniquity before his face then comes to the prophet, I Yahweh will answer him there according to the multitude of his idols,

hausa: Ko kunne ba ya gwada kalmomi kamar yadda harshe yake ɗanɗana abinci?
english: Doesn’t the ear try words, even as the palate tastes its food?

hausa: Dawuda ya ce, “Duk wanda ya jagoranci yaƙi a kan Yebusiyawa zai zama babban shugaban mayaƙa.” Yowab ɗan Zeruhiya ya fara haurawa, ta haka ya zama shugaba.
english: David had said, “Whoever strikes the Jebusites first shall be chief and captain.” Joab the son of Zeruiah went up first, and was made chief.

hausa: Shalim, Aiyalon, Itla,
english: Shaalabbin, Aijalon, Ithlah,

hausa: Za su zama kayan ado don su inganta ka da kuma sarƙar wuya don su yi wa wuyanka ado.
english: for they will be a garland to grace your head, and chains around your neck.

hausa: Kada ku bar maharbi yă ja bakansa, kada kuma ku bari yă sa kayan yaƙinsa. Kada ku rage samarinta, ku hallaka sojojinta ƙaf.
english: Against him who bends, let the archer bend his bow, also against him who lifts himself up in his coat of mail. Don’t spare her young men! Utterly destroy all her army!

hausa: Umma, Afek da Rehob. Garuruwa ashirin da biyu ke nan da ƙauyukansu.
english: Ummah also, and Aphek, and Rehob: twenty-two cities with their villages.

hausa: Bayan ya haifi Serug, Reyu ya yi shekara 207, ya kuma haifi waɗansu ’ya’ya maza da mata.
english: Reu lived two hundred seven years after he became the father of Serug, and became the father of more sons and daughters.

hausa: Dattawan sun bar ƙofar birnin, samari sun daina rera waƙa.
english: The elders have ceased from the gate, and the young men from their music.

hausa: Siman Zilot da kuma Yahuda Iskariyot wanda ya bashe Yesu.
english: Simon the Zealot; and Judas Iscariot, who also betrayed him.

hausa: Allah yă ƙara fāɗin ƙasar Yafet; bari Yafet yă zauna a tentunan Shem, bari kuma Kan’ana yă zama bawansa.”
english: May God enlarge Japheth. Let him dwell in the tents of Shem. Let Canaan be his servant.”

hausa: Da Sanballat ya ji cewa muna sāke ginin katangar, sai ya husata, ya haukace ƙwarai. Ya yi wa Yahudawa dariya,
english: But when Sanballat heard that we were building the wall, he was angry, and was very indignant, and mocked the Jews.

hausa: Sa’ad da dukan mutane suka gan shi yana tafiya yana yabon Allah,
english: All the people saw him walking and praising God.

hausa: Duk rashin adalci, zunubi ne, amma akwai waɗansu zunuban da ba sa kai ga mutuwa.
english: All unrighteousness is sin, and there is sin not leading to death.

hausa: bisa ga bukace-bukace na kullum don hadayun da Musa ya umarta don Asabbatai, Sabon Wata da kuma bukukkuwa uku na shekara, Bikin Burodi Marar Yisti, Bikin Makoni da Bikin Tabanakul.
english: even as the duty of every day required, offering according to the commandment of Moses on the Sabbaths, on the new moons, and on the set feasts, three times per year, during the feast of unleavened bread, during the feast of weeks, and during the feast of booths.

hausa: Ka yi kiwon mutanenka da sandarka, garken gādonka, wanda yake zaune shi kaɗai a kurmi, a ƙasa mai kyau ta kiwo, bari su yi kiwo a Bashan da Gileyad kamar a kwanakin dā.
english: Shepherd your people with your staff, the flock of your heritage, who dwell by themselves in a forest. Let them feed in the middle of fertile pasture land, in Bashan and Gilead, as in the days of old.

hausa: Yabi Ubangiji. Yabi Allah a cikin wurinsa mai tsarki; yabe shi a cikin sammai na ikonsa.
english: Praise Yah! Praise God in his sanctuary! Praise him in his heavens for his acts of power!

hausa: Yesu ya miƙa hannunsa ya taɓa mutumin. Ya ce, “Ina so, ka tsabtacce!” Nan da nan aka warkar da shi daga kuturtarsa.
english: Jesus stretched out his hand and touched him, saying, “I want to. Be made clean.” Immediately his leprosy was cleansed.

hausa: Sauran hadaya ta garin zai zama na Haruna da ’ya’yansa; sashe mafi tsarki ne na hadayar da aka yi ga Ubangiji ta wuta.
english: That which is left of the meal offering shall be Aaron’s and his sons’. It is a most holy part of the offerings of Yahweh made by fire.

hausa: A shekara ta bakwai, a wata na biyar a rana ta goma, waɗansu dattawan Isra’ila suka zo don su nemi nufin Ubangiji, suka kuwa zauna a ƙasa a gabana.
english: In the seventh year, in the fifth month, the tenth day of the month, some of the elders of Israel came to inquire of Yahweh, and sat before me.

hausa: Gama ran da ka fita, ka haye Kwarin Kidron, ka tabbata za ka mutu, alhakin jininka kuwa zai koma kanka.”
english: For on the day you go out and pass over the brook Kidron, know for certain that you will surely die. Your blood will be on your own head.”

hausa: Game da waɗansu abubuwan da suka faru a zamanin Yoram, ba suna a rubuce a cikin littafin tarihin sarakunan Yahuda ba?
english: The rest of the acts of Joram, and all that he did, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

hausa: Ya kuma aike su, su yi wa’azin mulkin Allah, su kuma warkar da marasa lafiya.
english: He sent them out to preach God’s Kingdom and to heal the sick.

hausa: Ku tattara dukan ganimar birnin a tsakiyar gari, ku ƙone birnin da kuma ganimar ƙurmus a matsayin hadaya ta ƙonawa ga Ubangiji Allahnku. Birnin zai kasance kufai har abada, kada a sāke gina shi.
english: You shall gather all its plunder into the middle of its street, and shall burn with fire the city, with all of its plunder, to Yahweh your God. It shall be a heap forever. It shall not be built again.

hausa: wajen Bet-Hogla ta wuce har zuwa arewancin Bet-Araba, zuwa Dutsen Bohan ɗan Ruben.
english: The border went up to Beth Hoglah, and passed along by the north of Beth Arabah; and the border went up to the stone of Bohan the son of Reuben.

hausa: Zan kuma ba shi tauraron asubahi.
english: and I will give him the morning star.

hausa: Bawanka yana nan a cikin mutanen da ka zaɓa, mutane masu girma, waɗanda suka wuce ƙirge, ko a lissafta.
english: Your servant is among your people which you have chosen, a great people, that can’t be numbered or counted for multitude.

hausa: Babu sauran shan ruwan inabi suna rera waƙa; barasa ya zama da ɗaci ga masu shanta.
english: They will not drink wine with a song. Strong drink will be bitter to those who drink it.

hausa: Dangin da suke maza masu yaƙi sun kasance na dukan gidajen Issakar ne, kamar yadda aka rubuta a cikin tarihi, su 87,000 ne duka.
english: Their brothers among all the families of Issachar, mighty men of valor, listed in all by genealogy, were eighty-seven thousand.

hausa: “ ‘Na yi miki wanka na wanke miki jini daga gare ki na kuma shafa miki mai.
english: “‘“Then I washed you with water. Yes, I thoroughly washed away your blood from you, and I anointed you with oil.

hausa: Bar ni kawai, in hallaka su, in kuma shafe sunansu daga ƙarƙashin sama. Zan kuwa yi maka wata al’umma mafi ƙarfi da kuma masu yawa fiye da su.”
english: Leave me alone, that I may destroy them, and blot out their name from under the sky; and I will make of you a nation mightier and greater than they.”

hausa: Shi ya sa nake rubuta waɗannan abubuwa, sa’ad da ba na nan tare da ku, domin sa’ad da na zo, kada yă zama mini tilas in yi muku tsanani a game da nuna ikon nan da Ubangiji ya ba ni saboda ingantawa, ba saboda rushewa ba.
english: For this cause I write these things while absent, that I may not deal sharply when present, according to the authority which the Lord gave me for building up and not for tearing down.

hausa: Ya amsa ya ce, “Ku je ku gaya wa dilan nan, wato, mai makirci cewa, ‘Da yau da kuma gobe, zan fitar da aljanu, in kuma warkar da mutane, sa’an nan a rana ta uku in cika burin aikina.
english: He said to them, “Go and tell that fox, ‘Behold, I cast out demons and perform cures today and tomorrow, and the third day I complete my mission.

hausa: Da Yahudawan da suke a Tessalonika suka ji cewa Bulus yana wa’azin maganar Allah a Bereya, sai suka je can ma, suna zuga taro suna kuma tā da hankalinsu.
english: But when the Jews of Thessalonica had knowledge that the word of God was proclaimed by Paul at Beroea also, they came there likewise, agitating the multitudes.

hausa: Waɗannan su ne siffofi marurai na zinariya waɗanda Filistiyawa suka aika domin miƙa hadaya don laifi ga Ubangiji, ɗaya domin Ashdod, ɗaya domin Gaza, ɗaya domin Ashkelon, ɗaya domin Gat, ɗaya kuma domin Ekron.
english: These are the golden tumors which the Philistines returned for a trespass offering to Yahweh: for Ashdod one, for Gaza one, for Ashkelon one, for Gath one, for Ekron one;

hausa: Sai Dawuda ya ce wa Akish, “In na sami tagomashi a gabanka ka ba ni wani wuri a cikin biranenka in zauna a can. Don me bawanka zai kasance tare da kai a gidan sarauta?”
english: David said to Achish, “If now I have found favor in your eyes, let them give me a place in one of the cities in the country, that I may dwell there. For why should your servant dwell in the royal city with you?”

hausa: Iwan da ta tanƙware ba zai karye ba, ba zai kashe lagwani mai hayaƙi ba. Cikin aminci zai kawo adalci;
english: He won’t break a bruised reed. He won’t quench a dimly burning wick. He will faithfully bring justice.

hausa: Sa’an nan sai ƙarshen ta zo, sa’ad da zai miƙa wa Allah Uba mulki, bayan ya hallaka dukan sarauta, mulki da iko.
english: Then the end comes, when he will deliver up the Kingdom to God the Father, when he will have abolished all rule and all authority and power.

hausa: Ku ɗaga kawunanku, ya ku ƙofofi; ku ɗagu, ku daɗaɗɗun ƙofofi, don Sarkin ɗaukaka yă shiga.
english: Lift up your heads, you gates! Be lifted up, you everlasting doors, and the King of glory will come in.

hausa: Timoti, ka lura da abin da aka danƙa maka amana. Ka yi nesa da masu maganganun rashin tsoron Allah da kuma yawan mūsu da ake ƙarya, ake ce da shi ilimi,
english: Timothy, guard that which is committed to you, turning away from the empty chatter and oppositions of what is falsely called knowledge,

hausa: Ka faɗa musu, ‘Ga abin da Ubangiji yana cewa, in ba ku saurare ni, ku kuma bi dokata, wadda na sa a gabanku ba,
english: You shall tell them, “Yahweh says: ‘If you will not listen to me, to walk in my law which I have set before you,

hausa: “Ɗan mutum, ka ɗauki sanda ka rubuta a kansa, ‘Na Yahuda da Isra’ilawan da suke tare da shi.’ Sa’an nan ka ɗauki wani sanda, ka rubuta a kansa, ‘Sandan Efraim, na Yusuf da dukan gidan Isra’ilan da suke tare da shi.’
english: “You, son of man, take one stick and write on it, ‘For Judah, and for the children of Israel his companions.’ Then take another stick, and write on it, ‘For Joseph, the stick of Ephraim, and for all the house of Israel his companions.’

hausa: Sai mala’ikan ya ɗauki kaskon, ya cika shi da wuta daga bagaden, ya kuma wurga shi bisan duniya; sai aka yi ta yin tsawa, ƙararraki, walƙiya, da kuma girgizar ƙasa.
english: The angel took the censer, and he filled it with the fire of the altar, then threw it on the earth. Thunders, sounds, lightnings, and an earthquake followed.

hausa: Ya sarki, ka fitar da doka, cewa duk wanda ya ji karar ƙaho, da sarewa, da garayu da goge, da molo da algaita da kowane irin kayan kaɗe-kaɗe da bushe-bushe sai yă rusuna yă yi sujada ga siffar zinariya,
english: You, O king, have made a decree that every man who hears the sound of the horn, flute, zither, lyre, harp, pipe, and all kinds of music shall fall down and worship the golden image;

hausa: Saboda haka a ranar suka kira Gideyon, “Yerub-Ba’al,” suna cewa, “Bari Ba’al ya yi hamayya da shi,” domin ya rushe bagaden Ba’al.
english: Therefore on that day he named him Jerub-Baal, saying, “Let Baal contend against him, because he has broken down his altar.”

hausa: Namansu zai zama naka, haka ma ƙirji na kaɗawa da cinyar dama za su zama naka.
english: Their meat shall be yours, as the wave offering breast and as the right thigh, it shall be yours.

hausa: Kada ku zama marasa himma, sai dai masu himma a ruhaniyarku, kuna bauta wa Ubangiji.
english: not lagging in diligence, fervent in spirit, serving the Lord,

hausa: Ka kasa kunne, ya Ubangiji, ka ji; ka buɗe idanunka ya Ubangiji ka gani; ka saurari kalmomin da Sennakerib ya aiko don yă yi wa Allah mai rai ba’a.
english: Incline your ear, Yahweh, and hear. Open your eyes, Yahweh, and see. Hear the words of Sennacherib, which he has sent to defy the living God.

hausa: Suka sa tsofaffin takalman da suka sha gyara, suka sa tsofaffin tufafi. Dukan abincinsu na tafiya ya bushe ya yi fumfuna.
english: and old and patched sandals on their feet, and wore old garments. All the bread of their food supply was dry and moldy.

hausa: Ba zai bari ƙafarka tă yi santsi ba, shi da yake tsaronka ba zai yi gyangyaɗi ba;
english: He will not allow your foot to be moved. He who keeps you will not slumber.

hausa: Waɗannan su ne zuriyar Ishaku ɗan Ibrahim. Ibrahim ya haifi Ishaku,
english: This is the history of the generations of Isaac, Abraham’s son. Abraham became the father of Isaac.

hausa: Duk abin da yake tafiya a kan dāginsa cikin dabbobin da suke da ƙafa huɗu, haram ne a gare ku. Duk wanda ya taɓa mushensu zai ƙazantu har zuwa yamma.
english: Whatever goes on its paws, among all animals that go on all fours, they are unclean to you. Whoever touches their carcass shall be unclean until the evening.

hausa: Ta wurinsa aka halicci dukan abu, abubuwan da suke cikin sama da abubuwan da suke a duniya, waɗanda ake gani, da waɗanda ba a gani, ko kursiyoyi ko ikoki ko masu mulki ko hukumomi; an halicci dukan abu ta wurinsa da kuma dominsa ne.
english: For by him all things were created in the heavens and on the earth, visible things and invisible things, whether thrones or dominions or principalities or powers. All things have been created through him and for him.

hausa: Za a zauna a Yahuda har abada Urushalima kuma daga tsara zuwa tsara.
english: But Judah will be inhabited forever, and Jerusalem from generation to generation.

hausa: Da jarumin nan tare da waɗanda suke tsaron Yesu, suka ga girgizar ƙasa, da kuma abin da ya faru, sai tsoro ya kama su, suka kuma ce, “Gaskiya, wannan Ɗan Allah ne!”
english: Now the centurion and those who were with him watching Jesus, when they saw the earthquake and the things that were done, were terrified, saying, “Truly this was the Son of God!”

hausa: Ku faɗa mini nawa ne dukiyar aure da kuma sadakin da zan kawo bisa ga yadda kuke so, zan kuwa biya duk abin da kuka ce. Ku dai bar ni in aure yarinyar ta zama matata.”
english: Ask me a great amount for a dowry, and I will give whatever you ask of me, but give me the young lady as a wife.”

hausa: Yusuf ya yi umarni a cika buhunansu da hatsi, a kuma sa azurfan kowane mutum a cikin buhunsa, a kuma ba su kalaci don tafiyarsu. Bayan aka yi musu wannan,
english: Then Joseph gave a command to fill their bags with grain, and to restore each man’s money into his sack, and to give them food for the way. So it was done to them.

hausa: Wannan shi ne jerin Isra’ilawa, kawunan iyalai, shugabannin dubu-dubu da shugabannin ɗari-ɗari, da manyan ma’aikatansu, waɗanda suka yi wa sarki hidima a dukan abin da ya shafi ɓangarorin mayaƙan da suke aiki wata-wata a dukan shekara. Kowane sashe yana da mutane 24,000.
