english: Now the children of Israel after their number, the heads of fathers’ households and the captains of thousands and of hundreds, and their officers who served the king in any matter of the divisions which came in and went out month by month throughout all the months of the year—of every division were twenty-four thousand.

hausa: Maɗaukaki ya fi ƙarfin ganewarmu, shi babban mai iko ne, mai gaskiya da babban adalci, ba ya cutar mutum.
english: We can’t reach the Almighty. He is exalted in power. In justice and great righteousness, he will not oppress.

hausa: An yi dukan ayyukan Solomon, daga ranar kafa tushen haikalin Ubangiji har gamawarsa. Ta haka aka gama haikalin Ubangiji.
english: Now all the work of Solomon was accomplished from the day of the foundation of Yahweh’s house until it was finished. So Yahweh’s house was completed.

hausa: “Bayin mai gonar suka zo wurinsa suka ce, ‘Ranka yă daɗe, ashe, ba iri mai kyau ka shuka a gonarka ba? To, ina ciyayin nan suka fito?’
english: The servants of the householder came and said to him, ‘Sir, didn’t you sow good seed in your field? Where did these darnel weeds come from?’

hausa: “Saboda haka ga abin da Ubangiji ya ce, “ ‘Matarka za tă zama karuwa a cikin birni, kuma da takobi za a kashe ’ya’yanka maza da mata. Za a auna ƙasarka a kuma raba ta, kai kuma za ka mutu a ƙasar arna. Ba shakka Isra’ila za su tafi zaman bauta, nesa da ainihin ƙasarsu.’ ”
english: Therefore Yahweh says: ‘Your wife shall be a prostitute in the city, and your sons and your daughters shall fall by the sword, and your land shall be divided by line; and you yourself shall die in a land that is unclean, and Israel shall surely be led away captive out of his land.’”

hausa: Eliyezer ɗan Dodabahu na Maresha ya yi annabci a kan Yehoshafat cewa, “Domin ka haɗa kai da Ahaziya, Ubangiji zai hallaka abin da ka yi.” Jiragen ruwan kuwa suka farfashe, ba a kuwa iya sa su je kasuwanci ba.
english: Then Eliezer the son of Dodavahu of Mareshah prophesied against Jehoshaphat, saying, “Because you have joined yourself with Ahaziah, Yahweh has destroyed your works.” The ships were wrecked, so that they were not able to go to Tarshish.

hausa: “Duk wanda ya shiga gidan yayinda aka rufe shi zai ƙazantu har yamma.
english: “Moreover he who goes into the house while it is shut up shall be unclean until the evening.

hausa: Ubangiji zai zama abin tsoro a gare su sa’ad da ya hallaka allolin ƙasar. Al’ummai a kowane bakin teku za su yi masa sujada, kowa a ƙasarsa.
english: Yahweh will be awesome to them, for he will famish all the gods of the land. Men will worship him, everyone from his place, even all the shores of the nations.

hausa: “Saboda haka kada ku ji tsoronsu. Ba abin da yake a rufe da ba za a tone ba, ko kuwa a ɓoye da ba za a bayyana ba.
english: Therefore don’t be afraid of them, for there is nothing covered that will not be revealed, or hidden that will not be known.

hausa: Sai suka aiki manzanni zuwa Kiriyat Yeyarim suka ce, “Filistiyawa sun komo da akwatin alkawarin Ubangiji, ku zo ku ɗauka ku kai wajenku.”
english: They sent messengers to the inhabitants of Kiriath Jearim, saying, “The Philistines have brought back Yahweh’s ark. Come down and bring it up to yourselves.”

hausa: Ku kuma yi addu’a domina, don duk sa’ad da na buɗe bakina, in sami kalmomi babu tsoro, don in sanar da asirin bishara,
english: Pray for me, that utterance may be given to me in opening my mouth, to make known with boldness the mystery of the Good News,

hausa: An riga an sa bakin gatari a gindin itatuwa, kuma duk itacen da bai ba da ’ya’ya masu kyau ba, za a sare shi a jefa cikin wuta.”
english: Even now the ax also lies at the root of the trees. Every tree therefore that doesn’t produce good fruit is cut down and thrown into the fire.”

hausa: Saniya da beyar za su yi kiwo tare, ƙananansu za su kwanta tare, zaki kuma zai ci ciyawa kamar saniya.
english: The cow and the bear will graze. Their young ones will lie down together. The lion will eat straw like the ox.

hausa: Bari kuma ka karɓi wannan kyautar da baiwarka ta kawo don samarin da suke binka.
english: Now this present which your servant has brought to my lord, let it be given to the young men who follow my lord.

hausa: “Na kira ga Ubangiji, wanda ya cancanci yabo, na kuwa tsira daga abokan gābana.
english: I call on Yahweh, who is worthy to be praised; So shall I be saved from my enemies.

hausa: Saboda haka Isuwa (wato, Edom) ya zauna a ƙasar tuddai na Seyir.
english: Esau lived in the hill country of Seir. Esau is Edom.

hausa: Ubangiji ya ce wa Musa,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

hausa: Abi-Albon, mutumin Arba, da Azmawet, mutumin Bahurim,
english: Abialbon the Arbathite, Azmaveth the Barhumite,

hausa: Sauran man da yake cikin tafinsa firist ɗin zai zuba a kan wannan da za a tsabtaccen don a yi kafara dominsa a gaban Ubangiji.
english: The rest of the oil that is in the priest’s hand he shall put on the head of him who is to be cleansed, to make atonement for him before Yahweh.

hausa: Bari zuciyata ta kasance marar abin zargi wajen ƙa’idodinka, don kada in sha kunya.
english: Let my heart be blameless toward your decrees, that I may not be disappointed. KAPF

hausa: Da suna shiga cikin kabarin, sai suka ga wani saurayi sanye da farar riga, yana zaune a hannun dama, sai suka firgita.
english: Entering into the tomb, they saw a young man sitting on the right side, dressed in a white robe; and they were amazed.

hausa: Al’ummai da za ku kora sukan saurari waɗannan masu maita, ko masu duba. Amma ku, Ubangiji Allahnku bai yarda muku ku yi haka ba.
english: For these nations that you shall dispossess listen to those who practice sorcery and to diviners; but as for you, Yahweh your God has not allowed you so to do.

hausa: Dukanmu da muka balaga ya kamata mu yi wannan irin ganin abubuwa. In kuwa saboda wani dalili tunaninku ya yi dabam, Allah zai bayyana muku wannan ma.
english: Let us therefore, as many as are perfect, think this way. If in anything you think otherwise, God will also reveal that to you.

hausa: Jagoran dogarawan sarkin Assuriya ya ce musu, “Ku ce wa Hezekiya, “ ‘Ga abin da babban sarkin Assuriya ya ce, da wa kake taƙama?
english: Rabshakeh said to them, “Say now to Hezekiah, ‘The great king, the king of Assyria, says, “What confidence is this in which you trust?

hausa: Ubangiji kuwa yana tare da Yusuf, Yusuf kuwa yi nasara, ya zauna a gidan mutumin Masar maigidansa.
english: Yahweh was with Joseph, and he was a prosperous man. He was in the house of his master the Egyptian.

hausa: Ba a tuge igiyar tentinsu, don su mutu ba tare da hikima ba?’
english: Isn’t their tent cord plucked up within them? They die, and that without wisdom.’

hausa: Wata al’umma ta mamaye ƙasata, tana da ƙarfi ba ta kuma ƙidayuwa; tana da haƙoran zaki, da zagar zakanya.
english: For a nation has come up on my land, strong, and without number. His teeth are the teeth of a lion, and he has the fangs of a lioness.

hausa: Ibrahim kuwa ya zauna a ƙasar Filistiyawa na dogon lokaci.
english: Abraham lived as a foreigner in the land of the Philistines many days.

hausa: Suka yi alkawari don su nemi Ubangiji Allah na kakanninsu, da dukan zuciyarsu da kuma dukan ransu.
english: They entered into the covenant to seek Yahweh, the God of their fathers, with all their heart and with all their soul;

hausa: “Ku ne gishirin duniya, amma in gishiri ya rabu da daɗin ɗanɗanonsa, yaya za a sāke mai da daɗin ɗanɗanonsa? Ba shi da sauran amfani, sai dai a zubar da shi mutane kuma su tattaka.
english: “You are the salt of the earth, but if the salt has lost its flavor, with what will it be salted? It is then good for nothing, but to be cast out and trodden under the feet of men.

hausa: Saboda haka fa, dokar tana da tsarki, umarnin kuma yana da tsarki, su duka suna da adalci da kuma kyau.
english: Therefore the law indeed is holy, and the commandment holy, righteous, and good.

hausa: Suka gangara cikin kabari da rai, tare dukan mallakarsu; ƙasa ta rufe su, suka hallaka, suka rabu da jama’ar.
english: So they, and all that belonged to them went down alive into Sheol. The earth closed on them, and they perished from among the assembly.

hausa: Yaƙub ya kafa al’amudi bisa kabarinta, al’amudin kabarin Rahila ke nan, wanda yake can har wa yau.
english: Jacob set up a pillar on her grave. The same is the Pillar of Rachel’s grave to this day.

hausa: zan hukunta Mowabawa. Ta haka za su san cewa ni ne Ubangiji.’ ”
english: I will execute judgments on Moab. Then they will know that I am Yahweh.”

hausa: Sarki ya ce wa Sarauniya Esta, “Yahudawa sun karkashe, suka kuma hallaka mutum ɗari biyar, da kuma ’ya’ya maza goma na Haman a mazaunin masarauta a Shusha. Me suka yi a sauran lardunan sarki? Yanzu kuma mene ne roƙonki? Za a ba ki. Mece ce bukatarki? Za a biya miki.”
english: The king said to Esther the queen, “The Jews have slain and destroyed five hundred men in the citadel of Susa, including the ten sons of Haman; what then have they done in the rest of the king’s provinces! Now what is your petition? It shall be granted you. What is your further request? It shall be done.”

hausa: Dukan Isra’ila fa suka taru wurin Dawuda a Hebron suka ce, “Mu jiki da jininka ne.
english: Then all Israel gathered themselves to David to Hebron, saying, “Behold, we are your bone and your flesh.

hausa: Ya kuma ɗauko sojan haya jarumawa dubu ɗari ɗaya daga Isra’ila a kan talenti ɗari na azurfa.
english: He also hired one hundred thousand mighty men of valor out of Israel for one hundred talents of silver.

hausa: sai na koma zuwa Urushalima. A nan na ji game da mugun abin da Eliyashib ya aikata da ya tanada wa Tobiya ɗaki a filayen gidan Allah.
english: and I came to Jerusalem, and understood the evil that Eliashib had done for Tobiah, in preparing him a room in the courts of God’s house.

hausa: A daren nan mala’ikan Ubangiji ya fita ya kashe dakaru dubu ɗari da tamanin da biyu a sansanin Assuriyawa. Da mutane suka farka da safe, sai ga gawawwaki ko’ina.
english: That night, Yahweh’s angel went out and struck one hundred eighty-five thousand in the camp of the Assyrians. When men arose early in the morning, behold, these were all dead bodies.

hausa: ka kafa katakan suna duban juna. Ka yi da dukan katakan tabanakul haka.
english: There shall be two tenons in each board, joined to one another: thus you shall make for all the boards of the tabernacle.

hausa: Suka ce masa, “To, mun zo ne mu daure ka mu kai wa Filistiyawa.” Samson ya ce, “Ku rantse mini ba za ku kashe ni da kanku ba.”
english: They said to him, “We have come down to bind you, that we may deliver you into the hand of the Philistines.” Samson said to them, “Swear to me that you will not attack me yourselves.”

hausa: Yanzu zan karya karkiyarsu daga wuyanki in kuma tsittsinke sarƙar da suka ɗaura ki.”
english: Now I will break his yoke from off you, and will burst your bonds apart.”

hausa: A can Yahuda ya sadu da ’yar wani Bakan’ane, mai suna Shuwa. Ya aure ta, ya kuma kwana da ita;
english: There, Judah saw the daughter of a certain Canaanite man named Shua. He took her, and went in to her.

hausa: Sa’ad da Yohanan ɗan Kareya da dukan shugabannin sojojin da suke tare da shi suka ji dukan laifofin da Ishmayel ɗan Netaniya ya aikata,
english: But when Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the captains of the forces who were with him, heard of all the evil that Ishmael the son of Nethaniah had done,

hausa: Ta haka zan kafa alkawarina da ke, za ki kuma san cewa ni ne Ubangiji.
english: I will establish my covenant with you. Then you will know that I am Yahweh;

hausa: Zai yiwu kursiyin da ya cika da lalaci yă haɗa kai da kai, wanda yake kawo azaba ta wurin abin da ya zartar?
english: Shall the throne of wickedness have fellowship with you, which brings about mischief by statute?

hausa: Ku rera ga Ubangiji, gama ya aikata manyan abubuwa; bari a sanar da wannan ga dukan duniya.
english: Sing to Yahweh, for he has done excellent things! Let this be known in all the earth!

hausa: shukar tana bin yaɗuwa, jijiyoyinta suna nannaɗe duwatsu, suna neman wurin da za su kama sosai a cikin duwatsu.
english: His roots are wrapped around the rock pile. He sees the place of stones.

hausa: tebur da sandunansa, da dukan kayansa da kuma burodin kasancewa;
english: the table with its poles and all its vessels, and the show bread;

hausa: To, me ya sa ba ka kiyaye rantsuwar da ka yi ga Ubangiji, ka kuma yi biyayya da umarnin da na ba ka ba?”
english: Why then have you not kept the oath of Yahweh and the commandment that I have instructed you with?”

hausa: Sai mutumin ya ce mini, “Ɗakin da yake fuskantar kudu ne na firistocin da suke lura da haikali,
english: He said to me, “This room, which faces toward the south, is for the priests who perform the duty of the house.

hausa: Gama zan gafarta muguntarsu ba zan kuma ƙara tuna da zunubansu ba.”
english: For I will be merciful to their unrighteousness. I will remember their sins and lawless deeds no more.”

english: Jehoash the son of Jehoahaz took again out of the hand of Benhadad the son of Hazael the cities which he had taken out of the hand of Jehoahaz his father by war. Joash struck him three times, and recovered the cities of Israel.

english: Won’t all these take up a parable against him, and a taunting proverb against him, and say, ‘Woe to him who increases that which is not his, and who enriches himself by extortion! How long?’

hausa: A ce su masu hikima ne har su gane wannan su gane abin da ƙarshensu zai zama!
english: Oh that they were wise, that they understood this, that they would consider their latter end!

english: But sanctify the Lord God in your hearts. Always be ready to give an answer to everyone who asks you a reason concerning the hope that is in you, with humility and fear,

english: Of Naphtali: one thousand captains, and with them with shield and spear thirty-seven thousand.

english: Therefore also we make it our aim, whether at home or absent, to be well pleasing to him.

english: the anointing oil, and the incense of sweet spices for the holy place: according to all that I have commanded you they shall do.”

english: All the offspring of Israel will be justified in Yahweh, and will rejoice!

english: They said to him, “Why does my lord speak such words as these? Far be it from your servants that they should do such a thing!

english: and their brothers, according to their generations, nine hundred fifty-six. All these men were heads of fathers’ households by their fathers’ houses.

english: if they break my statutes, and don’t keep my commandments;

hausa: Arzikin mutum zai iya kuɓutar da ransa, amma matalauci ba ya jin barazana.
english: The ransom of a man’s life is his riches, but the poor hear no threats.

hausa: “Ka tuna, ya Ubangiji, yadda na yi tafiya a gabanka da aminci da dukan zuciya na kuma yi abin da yake nagari a idanunka.” Sai Hezekiya ya yi kuka mai zafi.
english: and said, “Remember now, Yahweh, I beg you, how I have walked before you in truth and with a perfect heart, and have done that which is good in your sight.” Then Hezekiah wept bitterly.

hausa: Sai sarki ya umarce Ebed-Melek mutumin Kush, “Ka ɗauko mutane talatin daga nan ku fid da Irmiya annabi daga rijiyar kafin ya mutu.”
english: Then the king commanded Ebedmelech the Ethiopian, saying, “Take from here thirty men with you, and take up Jeremiah the prophet out of the dungeon, before he dies.”

hausa: “Kada ku riƙe wata zinariya ko azurfa ko jan ƙarfe a aljihunanku,
english: Don’t take any gold, silver, or brass in your money belts.

hausa: Za a tattaka wannan rawani, girman kai na mashayan Efraim da ƙafa.
english: The crown of pride of the drunkards of Ephraim will be trodden under foot.

hausa: Ina faɗa muku, a cikin duk waɗanda mata suka haifa, ba wanda ya fi Yohanna girma. Duk da haka wanda ya fi ƙasƙanta a Mulkin Allah ya fi shi.”
english: “For I tell you, among those who are born of women there is not a greater prophet than John the Baptizer; yet he who is least in God’s Kingdom is greater than he.”

hausa: Suka nemi hanyar kama shi, amma suka ji tsoron taron, don mutane sun ɗauka shi annabi ne.
english: When they sought to seize him, they feared the multitudes, because they considered him to be a prophet.

hausa: Kada ku ci shi da burodin da aka yi da yisti, kwana bakwai za ku ci burodi marar yisti, burodi ne na wahala, gama kun bar Masar da gaggawa, saboda haka dukan kwanakin rayuwarku za ku tuna da lokacin da kuka fita daga Masar.
english: You shall eat no leavened bread with it. You shall eat unleavened bread with it seven days, even the bread of affliction (for you came out of the land of Egypt in haste) that you may remember the day when you came out of the land of Egypt all the days of your life.

hausa: na ashirin da uku wa Delahiya da kuma na ashirin da huɗu a kan Ma’aziya.
english: the twenty-third to Delaiah, and the twenty-fourth to Maaziah.

english: They had for their inheritance Beersheba (or Sheba), Moladah,

hausa: Wata rana, Yesu yana tsaye a bakin Tafkin Gennesaret, mutane kuma suna ta matsawa kewaye da shi, domin su ji maganar Allah,
english: Now while the multitude pressed on him and heard the word of God, he was standing by the lake of Gennesaret.

hausa: Kaiton waɗanda suke kafa dokokin rashin gaskiya, waɗanda suke ba da ƙa’idodin danniya,
english: Woe to those who decree unrighteous decrees, and to the writers who write oppressive decrees

hausa: Amma in har kuka faɗa mini mafarkina kuka kuma bayyana fassararsa, za ku sami lada mai girma. Saboda haka ku faɗa mini mafarkin da kuma fassararsa.”
english: But if you show the dream and its interpretation, you will receive from me gifts, rewards, and great honor. Therefore show me the dream and its interpretation.”

hausa: Sai taron suka fāɗa wa Bulus da Sila gaba ɗaya, alƙalan kuwa suka yi umarni a tuɓe su a kuma yi musu dūka.
english: The multitude rose up together against them and the magistrates tore their clothes from them, then commanded them to be beaten with rods.

hausa: ba kuwa firistoci waɗanda suke Lawiyawa za su rasa mutumin da zai ci gaba da tsaya a gabana don miƙa hadayun ƙonawa, ya ƙona hadayun hatsi ya kuma miƙa sadakoki ba.’ ”
english: The Levitical priests won’t lack a man before me to offer burnt offerings, to burn meal offerings, and to do sacrifice continually.”

english: which my soul still seeks, but I have not found. I have found one man among a thousand, but I have not found a woman among all those.

hausa: Solomon ya amsa dukan tambayoyinta; babu wani abin da ya yi masa wuya yă bayyana mata.
english: Solomon answered all her questions. There wasn’t anything hidden from Solomon which he didn’t tell her.

hausa: A rana ta ashirin da uku na watan bakwai sai ya sallami mutane su tafi gidajensu da farin ciki da kuma murna a zuciya saboda abubuwa masu kyau da Ubangiji ya yi domin Dawuda da Solomon da kuma domin mutanensa Isra’ila.
english: On the twenty-third day of the seventh month, he sent the people away to their tents, joyful and glad of heart for the goodness that Yahweh had shown to David, to Solomon, and to Israel his people.

hausa: Nebukadnezzar na Babilon da kansa kuwa ya zo birnin yayinda hafsoshinsa suka kewaye ta.
english: Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came to the city while his servants were besieging it,

hausa: Haka ma bai kamata a sami datti, ƙazamar magana, ko zancen banza a cikinku ba, domin ba su dace ba, a maimakon haka sai ku yi ta yin godiya.
english: nor filthiness, nor foolish talking, nor jesting, which are not appropriate, but rather giving of thanks.

hausa: Shammot mutumin Haror, Helez mutumin Felon,
english: Shammoth the Harorite, Helez the Pelonite,

hausa: Sai Na’aman ya ce, “In ba za ka karɓa ba, ina roƙonka, bari a ba wa bawanka ƙasa gwargwadon abin da jakuna biyu za su iya ɗauka, gama bawanka ba zai sāke yin hadaya ta ƙonawa, ko wata hadaya ga wani allah ba, sai ga Ubangiji.
english: Naaman said, “If not, then, please let two mules’ load of earth be given to your servant; for your servant will from now on offer neither burnt offering nor sacrifice to other gods, but to Yahweh.

hausa: allolin mutanen kewayenku, ko na kusa, ko na nisa, daga wannan ƙarshen ƙasar zuwa wancan),
english: of the gods of the peoples who are around you, near to you, or far off from you, from the one end of the earth even to the other end of the earth—

hausa: “Ɗan mutum, ka shirya kacici-kacici ka faɗa wa gidan Isra’ila misali.
english: “Son of man, tell a riddle, and speak a parable to the house of Israel;

hausa: Sai macen ta yi kamar yadda mutumin Allah ya faɗa. Ita da iyalinta suka tafi ƙasar Filistiyawa suka zauna shekara bakwai.
english: The woman arose, and did according to the man of God’s word. She went with her household, and lived in the land of the Philistines for seven years.

hausa: A wannan rana na kira bisa sama da ƙasa a matsayin shaidu a kanku, cewa na sa a gabanku rai da mutuwa, albarku da la’anoni. Yanzu sai ku zaɓi rai, saboda ku da ’ya’yanku ku rayu
english: I call heaven and earth to witness against you today that I have set before you life and death, the blessing and the curse. Therefore choose life, that you may live, you and your descendants,

hausa: Sa’an nan Musa ya karɓe su daga hannuwansu ya ƙone a bagade a bisa hadaya ta ƙonawa a matsayin hadaya ta naɗi, mai daɗin ƙanshi, hadaya ce da aka ƙone da wuta ga Ubangiji.
english: Moses took them from their hands, and burned them on the altar on the burnt offering. They were a consecration offering for a pleasant aroma. It was an offering made by fire to Yahweh.

hausa: Ta haka zai yi kafara domin Wuri Mafi Tsarki saboda ƙazantar tawayen Isra’ilawa, da laifofinsu, da dukan zunubansu. Haka zai yi saboda Tentin Sujada wanda yake a cikinsu a tsakiyar ƙazantarsu.
english: He shall make atonement for the Holy Place, because of the uncleanness of the children of Israel, and because of their transgressions, even all their sins; and so he shall do for the Tent of Meeting that dwells with them in the middle of their uncleanness.

hausa: Saboda Ubangiji ya kulle mahaifarta, sai kishiyarta ta dinga tsokanarta don tă ba ta haushi.
english: Her rival provoked her severely, to irritate her, because Yahweh had shut up her womb.

hausa: amma na san shi, domin ni daga wurinsa ne, kuma shi ya aiko ni.”
english: I know him, because I am from him, and he sent me.”

hausa: “Gaya wa Isra’ilawa, ‘Sa’ad da namiji ko mace ya yi wa ɗan’uwansa laifi ta kowace hanya, ta yin haka, ya yi rashin aminci ga Ubangiji, mutumin kuwa ya yi laifi ke nan
english: “Speak to the children of Israel: ‘When a man or woman commits any sin that men commit, so as to trespass against Yahweh, and that soul is guilty,

hausa: Ina roƙonku ’yan’uwa, ku zama kamar ni, gama na zama kamar ku. Ba ku yi mini wani laifi ba.
english: I beg you, brothers, become as I am, for I also have become as you are. You did me no wrong,

hausa: Sai Ubangiji ya aiki mala’ika, wanda ya karkashe dukan jarumawa da shugabanni da kuma hafsoshi a sansanin sarkin Assuriyawa. Saboda haka sai sarkin Assuriya ya janye zuwa ƙasarsa da kunya. Da ya shiga haikalin Allahnsa, sai waɗansu a cikin ’ya’yansa maza suka yanka shi da takobi.
english: Yahweh sent an angel, who cut off all the mighty men of valor, the leaders, and captains in the camp of the king of Assyria. So he returned with shame of face to his own land. When he had come into the house of his god, those who came out of his own body killed him there with the sword.

hausa: Sa’ad da Set ya yi shekara 105, sai ya haifi Enosh.
english: Seth lived one hundred five years, then became the father of Enosh.

hausa: “ ‘Domin sun ɓad da mutanena, suna cewa, “Salama,” sa’ad da ba salama, kuma saboda, sa’ad da ana gina katanga marar ƙarfi, sukan shafe ta da farar ƙasa,
english: “‘Because, even because they have seduced my people, saying, “Peace;” and there is no peace. When one builds up a wall, behold, they plaster it with whitewash.

english: Therefore Levi has no portion nor inheritance with his brothers; Yahweh is his inheritance, according as Yahweh your God spoke to him.)

hausa: Ga ƙungiya mafi girma, ka ba ta rabo mafi girma; ga ƙaramar ƙungiya kuwa, ka ba ta ƙarami rabo; kowane zai karɓa rabonsa ga yawan mutanen da aka rubuta.
english: To the more you shall give the more inheritance, and to the fewer you shall give the less inheritance. To everyone according to those who were counted of him shall his inheritance be given.

hausa: Da ƙyar yake tunani a kan kwanakin rayuwarsa, domin Allah ya yarje masa, yă zauna da farin ciki.
english: For he shall not often reflect on the days of his life, because God occupies him with the joy of his heart.

hausa: Da Yosiya ya dubi kewaye da shi, ya ga kaburburan da suke can a gefen tudu, sai ya sa aka kwaso ƙasusuwan da suke cikinsu aka ƙone a kan bagade don yă lalatar da shi bisa ga maganar Ubangiji ta bakin mutumin Allah, wanda ya yi annabcin waɗannan abubuwa.
english: As Josiah turned himself, he spied the tombs that were there in the mountain; and he sent, and took the bones out of the tombs, and burned them on the altar, and defiled it, according to Yahweh’s word which the man of God proclaimed, who proclaimed these things.

hausa: A lokacin nan Yoshuwa ya yi wannan alkawari cewa, “Ubangiji zai tsine wa mutumin da zai yi ƙoƙarin sāke gina birnin nan, Yeriko. “A bakin ran ɗan farinsa zai kafa harsashin birnin; a bakin ran ɗan autansa kuma zai sa ƙofofin birnin.”
english: Joshua commanded them with an oath at that time, saying, “Cursed is the man before Yahweh who rises up and builds this city Jericho. With the loss of his firstborn he will lay its foundation, and with the loss of his youngest son he will set up its gates.”

hausa: Sarakunan duniya ba su gaskata ba, haka ma mutanen duniya, cewa magabta da maƙiya za su iya shiga ƙofofin Urushalima.
english: The kings of the earth didn’t believe, neither did all the inhabitants of the world, that the adversary and the enemy would enter into the gates of Jerusalem.

hausa: bari mu matso kusa da Allah da zuciya mai gaskiya da kuma cikakken tabbaci mai zuwa ta wurin bangaskiya. Bari mu bar zukatan da tsabta, lamirinmu babu mugunta, da kuma jikunanmu a wanke da ruwa.
english: let’s draw near with a true heart in fullness of faith, having our hearts sprinkled from an evil conscience and having our body washed with pure water,

hausa: Ku ƙarfafa, ku yi ƙarfin hali. Kada ku ji tsoro, ko ku firgita saboda su, gama Ubangiji Allahnku yana tafe tare da ku, ba zai taɓa barinku ko yă yashe ku ba.”
english: Be strong and courageous. Don’t be afraid or scared of them, for Yahweh your God himself is who goes with you. He will not fail you nor forsake you.”

hausa: Kun san cewa na yi aiki wa mahaifinku da dukan ƙarfina,
english: You know that I have served your father with all of my strength.

hausa: Sa’an nan zai mai da hankalinsa zuwa ƙasashe a bakin kogi, zai kuma kama da yawansu, amma wani komanda zai kawo ƙarshen faɗin ransa, zai kuma sa faɗin ransa yă koma masa.
english: After this he will turn his face to the islands, and will take many, but a prince will cause the reproach offered by him to cease. Yes, moreover, he will cause his reproach to turn on him.

hausa: Siman kansa ya gaskata aka kuma yi masa baftisma. Ya kuma bi Filibus ko’ina, yana mamakin manyan alamu da ayyukan banmamakin da ya gani.
english: Simon himself also believed. Being baptized, he continued with Philip. Seeing signs and great miracles occurring, he was amazed.

hausa: Ku yi sowa don farin ciki ga Ubangiji, dukan duniya, ku ɓarke da waƙa ta murna tare da kiɗi;
english: Make a joyful noise to Yahweh, all the earth! Burst out and sing for joy, yes, sing praises!

hausa: Duk da haka ba a kawar da masujadai kan tudu ba, domin har yanzu mutanen ba su tsayar da zukatansu ga Allahn kakanninsu ba.
english: However the high places were not taken away, and the people had still not set their hearts on the God of their fathers.

hausa: Sama’ila kuwa ya yi abin da Ubangiji ya umarce shi. Da ya isa Betlehem, sai dattawan garin suka tarye shi da rawar jiki, suka ce masa, “Mai duba, wannan ziyara lafiya dai ko?”
english: Samuel did that which Yahweh spoke, and came to Bethlehem. The elders of the city came to meet him trembling, and said, “Do you come peaceably?”

hausa: Wa zai iya tsaya wa fushinsa? Wa yake da ikon jimre wa zafin hasalarsa? Ana zuba fushinsa kamar wuta; aka kuma ragargaza duwatsu a gabansa.
english: Who can stand before his indignation? Who can endure the fierceness of his anger? His wrath is poured out like fire, and the rocks are broken apart by him.

hausa: Ka koya wa mai hikima zai kuwa ƙara hikima; ka koya wa mai adalci zai kuwa ƙara koyonsa.
english: Instruct a wise person, and he will be still wiser. Teach a righteous person, and he will increase in learning.

hausa: Nan da nan aka baza umarnin, sai Isra’ilawa suka bayar ’ya’yan farin hatsinsu, sabon ruwan inabi, mai da kuma zuma da dukan abin da gona ta bayar, hannu sake. Suka kawo zakan kowane abu da yawa.
english: As soon as the commandment went out, the children of Israel gave in abundance the first fruits of grain, new wine, oil, honey, and of all the increase of the field; and they brought in the tithe of all things abundantly.

hausa: Zan tashi yanzu in zagaya gari, in ratsa titunansa da dandalinsa; zan nemi wanda zuciyata take ƙauna. Saboda haka na neme shi, amma ban same shi ba.
english: I will get up now, and go about the city; in the streets and in the squares I will seek him whom my soul loves. I sought him, but I didn’t find him.

hausa: Ana cikin haka sai babban taron Yahudawa suka sami labari Yesu yana can suka kuwa zo, ba kawai don shi ba amma don su kuma ga Lazarus, wanda ya tā da daga matattu.
english: A large crowd therefore of the Jews learned that he was there; and they came, not for Jesus’ sake only, but that they might see Lazarus also, whom he had raised from the dead.

hausa: Gama Ubangiji Allahnku, Allah ne mai jinƙai; ba zai yashe ku ko yă hallaka, ko kuma yă manta da alkawarin da ya yi da kakanninku, wanda ya tabbatar da su da rantsuwa ba.
english: For Yahweh your God is a merciful God. He will not fail you nor destroy you, nor forget the covenant of your fathers which he swore to them.

hausa: Mutum mai kyauta zai azurta; shi da yakan taimake waɗansu, za a taimake shi.
english: The liberal soul shall be made fat. He who waters shall be watered also himself.

hausa: “Ka yi tabanakul bisa ga fasalin da aka nuna maka a bisa dutsen.
english: You shall set up the tabernacle according to the way that it was shown to you on the mountain.

hausa: Ya aikata mugunta a gaban Ubangiji yadda mahaifinsa ya yi.
english: He did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight, according to all that his father had done.

hausa: Saboda haka Yoshuwa ya ce wa Isra’ilawa, “Har yaushe za ku yi jinkirin shiga, ku mallaki ƙasar da Ubangiji Allah na iyayenku ya ba ku?
english: Joshua said to the children of Israel, “How long will you neglect to go in to possess the land, which Yahweh, the God of your fathers, has given you?

hausa: “Sai ka sani ka kuma fahimci wannan; Tun daga sa’ad da aka kafa doka don a maido a kuma sāke gina Urushalima har sai Shafaffen nan, mai mulki, ya zo, za a yi shekara arba’in da tara, da shekara ɗari huɗu da talatin da huɗu. Za a sāke gina ta a yi mata tituna da mafaka.
english: “Know therefore and discern that from the going out of the commandment to restore and build Jerusalem to the Anointed One, the prince, will be seven weeks and sixty-two weeks. It will be built again, with street and moat, even in troubled times.

hausa: Saratu ta yi shekara ɗari da ashirin da bakwai a duniya.
english: Sarah lived one hundred twenty-seven years. This was the length of Sarah’s life.

hausa: Ku nemi Ubangiji, dukanku ƙasashe masu tawali’u, ku da kuke yin abin da ya umarta. Ku nemi adalci da tawali’u; mai yiwuwa ku sami mafaka a ranar fushin Ubangiji.
english: Seek Yahweh, all you humble of the land, who have kept his ordinances. Seek righteousness. Seek humility. It may be that you will be hidden in the day of Yahweh’s anger.

hausa: Duka-duka, Ibrahim ya yi shekara ɗari da saba’in da biyar.
english: These are the days of the years of Abraham’s life which he lived: one hundred seventy-five years.

hausa: “Ɗan mutum, ka yi annabci ka ce, ‘Ga abin da Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka yana cewa, “ ‘Yi kuka kana cewa, “Kaito saboda wannan rana!”
english: “Son of man, prophesy, and say, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “Wail, ‘Alas for the day!’

hausa: Yesu ya ce musu, “Gaskiya nake gaya muku, ba Musa ne ya ba ku burodi daga sama ba, sai dai Ubana ne yake ba ku burodi na gaskiya daga sama.
english: Jesus therefore said to them, “Most certainly, I tell you, it wasn’t Moses who gave you the bread out of heaven, but my Father gives you the true bread out of heaven.

hausa: Aka sallami mutanen sai suka gangara zuwa Antiyok, inda suka tara ikkilisiya wuri ɗaya suka ba da wasiƙar.
english: So, when they were sent off, they came to Antioch. Having gathered the multitude together, they delivered the letter.

hausa: Ta haka ’ya’yanmu maza a ƙuruciyarsu za su zama kamar tsire-tsiren da aka kula da su, ’ya’yanmu mata kuma za su zama kamar ginshiƙai da sassaƙa don adon fada.
english: Then our sons will be like well-nurtured plants, our daughters like pillars carved to adorn a palace.

hausa: Solomon ya yi ƙoƙari yă kashe Yerobowam, amma Yerobowam ya tsere zuwa Masar, zuwa wurin sarki Shishak, ya zauna a can sai bayan mutuwar Solomon.
english: Therefore Solomon sought to kill Jeroboam, but Jeroboam arose and fled into Egypt, to Shishak king of Egypt, and was in Egypt until the death of Solomon.

hausa: Sa’ad da kuke girbi a gonarku, sai kuka manta da dami, kada ku koma don ku ɗauka. Ku bar shi don baƙo, maraya da kuma gwauruwa, saboda Ubangiji Allahnku yă albarkace ku a cikin dukan aikin hannuwanku.
english: When you reap your harvest in your field, and have forgotten a sheaf in the field, you shall not go again to get it. It shall be for the foreigner, for the fatherless, and for the widow, that Yahweh your God may bless you in all the work of your hands.

hausa: Kerub na biyun shi ma kamu goma ne, gama kerubobi biyun sun yi kama da juna a girma da kuma siffa.
english: The other cherub was ten cubits. Both the cherubim were of one measure and one form.

hausa: Amma da manyan firistoci da malaman dokoki suka ga abubuwan banmamakin da ya yi, yara kuma suna ihu a filin haikali suna cewa, “Hosanna ga Ɗan Dawuda,” sai fushi ya kama su.
english: But when the chief priests and the scribes saw the wonderful things that he did, and the children who were crying in the temple and saying, “Hosanna to the son of David!” they were indignant,

hausa: Sa’an nan wani mutumin Isra’ila ya kawo wata Bamidiyana a iyalinsa a idon Musa da dukan taron jama’ar Isra’ila, yayinda suke kuka a ƙofar Tentin Sujada.
english: Behold, one of the children of Israel came and brought to his brothers a Midianite woman in the sight of Moses, and in the sight of all the congregation of the children of Israel, while they were weeping at the door of the Tent of Meeting.

hausa: Za su fāɗi cikin waɗanda aka kashe da takobi. Takobin da an zāre; bari a ja ta a tafi tare da dukan jama’arta.
english: They will fall among those who are slain by the sword. She is delivered to the sword. Draw her away with all her multitudes.

hausa: Duk wanda ya ziyarce ta ba ya ƙara komowa ba zai ƙara komowa ga hanyar rai.
english: None who go to her return again, neither do they attain to the paths of life.

hausa: Ittai ɗan Ribai daga Gibeya a Benyamin, Benahiya mutumin Firaton,
english: Ithai the son of Ribai of Gibeah of the children of Benjamin, Benaiah the Pirathonite,

hausa: Na tona rijiyoyi a ƙasashen waje na kuma sha ruwa a can. Da tafin ƙafafuna na busar da dukan rafuffukan Masar.”
english: I have dug and drunk strange waters, and I will dry up all the rivers of Egypt with the sole of my feet.”

hausa: “Sa’an nan za su kira gare ni amma ba zan amsa ba; za su neme ni amma ba za su same ni ba.
english: Then they will call on me, but I will not answer. They will seek me diligently, but they will not find me,

hausa: Za ki ɗauki hakkin lalatarki da kuma ayyukanki masu banƙyama, in ji Ubangiji.
english: You have borne your lewdness and your abominations,” says Yahweh.

hausa: Ubangiji ya ce wa Musa, “Bayan ka koma Masar, ka tabbata ka aikata dukan mu’ujizan da na sa cikin ikonka a gaban Fir’auna. Amma zan taurare zuciyarsa domin kada yă bar mutanen su tafi.
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “When you go back into Egypt, see that you do before Pharaoh all the wonders which I have put in your hand, but I will harden his heart and he will not let the people go.

hausa: Zan kuma tanada wuri domin mutanena Isra’ila, zan kuma kafa su saboda za su kasance da gidan kansu ba kuwa za a ƙara damunsu ba. Mugayen mutane ba za su ƙara zaluntar su ba, yadda suka yi da farko
english: I will appoint a place for my people Israel, and will plant them, that they may dwell in their own place, and be moved no more. The children of wickedness will not waste them any more, as at the first,

hausa: Sa’an nan ƙasar za tă ba da amfaninta, za ku kuwa ci ku ƙoshi, ku kuma zauna lafiya.
english: The land shall yield its fruit, and you shall eat your fill, and dwell therein in safety.

hausa: A shekara ta talatin da bakwai ta bautar Yehohiyacin sarkin Yahuda, a shekaran da Ewil-Merodak ya ci sarautan Babilon, sai ya saki Yehohiyacin daga jaru, ya sake shi a rana ashirin da bakwai ga watan goma sha biyu.
english: In the thirty-seventh year of the captivity of Jehoiachin king of Judah, in the twelfth month, on the twenty-seventh day of the month, Evilmerodach king of Babylon, in the year that he began to reign, released Jehoiachin king of Judah out of prison,

hausa: Ya gidan Dawuda ga abin da Ubangiji yana cewa, “ ‘Ku yi gaskiya kowace safiya; ku kuɓuta daga hannun mai danniya wannan da aka yi wa fashi in ba haka ba hasalata za tă sauka ta kuma ci kamar wuta saboda muguntar da kuka aikata za tă ci babu wanda zai kashe ta.
english: House of David, Yahweh says, ‘Execute justice in the morning, and deliver him who is robbed out of the hand of the oppressor, lest my wrath go out like fire, and burn so that no one can quench it, because of the evil of your doings.

hausa: Mutane sun tashi kamar ƙaƙƙarfar zakanya; sun tā da kansu kamar zaki wanda ba ya hutawa sai ya cinye naman abin da ya kama ya kuma sha jinin abin da ya kama.”
english: Behold, a people rises up as a lioness. As a lion he lifts himself up. He shall not lie down until he eats of the prey, and drinks the blood of the slain.”

hausa: Sa’ad da Yusuf ya ga Benyamin tare da su, sai ya ce wa mai hidimar gidansa, “Ka shigar da mutanen cikin gida, ka yanka dabba ka shirya, gama mutanen za su ci abincin rana tare da ni.”
english: When Joseph saw Benjamin with them, he said to the steward of his house, “Bring the men into the house, and butcher an animal, and prepare; for the men will dine with me at noon.”

hausa: Amma wanda bai sani ba, ya kuwa yi abin da ya isa horo, za a dūke shi kaɗan. Duk wanda aka ba shi mai yawa, mai yawan ne za a bida daga gare shi. Duk wanda kuma aka ba shi riƙon amana mai yawa, fiye da haka kuma za a bida daga gare shi.
english: but he who didn’t know, and did things worthy of stripes, will be beaten with few stripes. To whomever much is given, of him will much be required; and to whom much was entrusted, of him more will be asked.

hausa: domin sun aikata mugunta a idanuna, suka kuma tsokane ni tun daga ranar da kakanninsu suka fito daga Masar, har yă zuwa yau.”
english: because they have done that which is evil in my sight, and have provoked me to anger since the day their fathers came out of Egypt, even to this day.’”

hausa: Abin da Allah ya faɗa game da Taya. Ku yi kuka mai zafi, ya jiragen ruwan Tarshish! Gama an hallaka Taya aka kuma bar su babu gida ko tasha. Daga ƙasar Saifurus magana ta zo musu.
english: The burden of Tyre. Howl, you ships of Tarshish! For it is laid waste, so that there is no house, no entering in. From the land of Kittim it is revealed to them.

hausa: Ƙasar ta fid da tsire-tsire, da shuke-shuke masu ba da ’ya’ya bisa ga irinsu, ta fid kuma da itatuwa masu ba da ’ya’ya da iri a cikinsu bisa ga irinsu. Allah ya ga yana da kyau.
english: The earth yielded grass, herbs yielding seed after their kind, and trees bearing fruit, with their seeds in it, after their kind; and God saw that it was good.

hausa: Sa’an nan Rut mutuniyar Mowab ta ce, “Ya ma ce mini, ‘Ki riƙa bin ma’aikatana sai sun ƙare yin girbin dukan hatsina.’ ”
english: Ruth the Moabitess said, “Yes, he said to me, ‘You shall stay close to my young men until they have finished all my harvest.’”

hausa: Da aka shigo da akwatin alkawarin Ubangiji a cikin sansani, sai Isra’ilawa suka tā da babbar murya har ƙasa ta jijjiga.
english: When the ark of Yahweh’s covenant came into the camp, all Israel shouted with a great shout, so that the earth resounded.

hausa: ’Ya’yan Tola maza su ne, Uzzi, Refahiya, Yeriyel, Ibsam da Sama’ila, su ne kuma kawunan iyalansu. A zamanin mulkin Dawuda, an rubuta zuriyar Tola a matsayin mayaƙa a cikin tarihinsu, sun kai 22,600.
english: The sons of Tola: Uzzi, Rephaiah, Jeriel, Jahmai, Ibsam, and Shemuel, heads of their fathers’ houses, of Tola; mighty men of valor in their generations. Their number in the days of David was twenty-two thousand six hundred.

hausa: Yanzu mun san cewa in an hallaka tentin duniyan nan da muke ciki, muna da wani gini daga Allah, madawwamin gida a sama, wanda ba da hannuwan mutum ne suka gina shi ba.
english: For we know that if the earthly house of our tent is dissolved, we have a building from God, a house not made with hands, eternal, in the heavens.

hausa: Sa’ad da alhini ya yi yawa a cikina, ta’aziyyarka ta kawo farin ciki wa raina.
english: In the multitude of my thoughts within me, your comforts delight my soul.

hausa: Wanda aka ɗauko haya ba shi ne makiyayi mai tumakin ba. Saboda haka sa’ad da ya ga kyarkeci yana zuwa, sai yă sheƙa da gudu yă bar tumakin. Sai kyarkecin yă kai wa garken hari, yă kuma watsar da su.
english: He who is a hired hand, and not a shepherd, who doesn’t own the sheep, sees the wolf coming, leaves the sheep, and flees. The wolf snatches the sheep and scatters them.

hausa: firist ɗin zai fita a bakin ƙofar gidan ya rufe ta na kwana bakwai.
english: then the priest shall go out of the house to the door of the house, and shut up the house seven days.

hausa: Ya ce, “Ɗan mutum, wannan shi ne kursiyina da wurin tafin ƙafafuna. A nan ne zan zauna a cikin Isra’ilawa har abada. Gidan Isra’ila ba zai ƙara ɓata sunana mai tsarki ba, ko su ko sarakunansu, ta wurin karuwanci da gumakan da ba su da rai, sarakunansu a masujadan kan tudu.
english: He said to me, “Son of man, this is the place of my throne and the place of the soles of my feet, where I will dwell among the children of Israel forever. The house of Israel will no more defile my holy name, neither they nor their kings, by their prostitution and by the dead bodies of their kings in their high places;

hausa: Ubangiji yana tare da ni; shi ne mai taimakona. Zan yi nasara a kan abokan gābana.
english: Yahweh is on my side among those who help me. Therefore I will look in triumph at those who hate me.

hausa: Ubanninmu sun hore mu na ɗan lokaci yadda suka ga ya fi kyau; amma Allah yakan hore mu don amfaninmu, domin mu sami rabo cikin tsarkinsa.
english: For they indeed for a few days disciplined us as seemed good to them, but he for our profit, that we may be partakers of his holiness.

hausa: Kullum suna bayar hannu sake suna kuma ba da bashi ba da wahala ba, za a yi wa ’ya’yansu albarka.
english: All day long he deals graciously, and lends. His offspring is blessed.

hausa: Gama nufin Ubana shi ne, duk wanda yake duban Ɗan, ya kuma gaskata shi zai sami rai madawwami, ni kuwa zan tashe shi a rana ta ƙarshe.”
english: This is the will of the one who sent me, that everyone who sees the Son and believes in him should have eternal life; and I will raise him up at the last day.”

hausa: Sai ta shiga, ta fāɗi a ƙafafunsa ta rusuna har ƙasa. Sa’an nan ta ɗauki ɗanta ta fita.
english: Then she went in, fell at his feet, and bowed herself to the ground; then she picked up her son, and went out.

hausa: Ta wurin bangaskiya Ibrahim, sa’ad da Allah ya gwada shi, sai ya miƙa Ishaku hadaya. Shi da ya karɓi alkawaran ya yi shirin miƙa makaɗaicin ɗansa,
english: By faith, Abraham, being tested, offered up Isaac. Yes, he who had gladly received the promises was offering up his only born son,

hausa: Saboda haka Isra’ilawa suka tashi a rana ta uku suke je biranen mutanen, wato, Gibeyon, Kefira, Beyerot da Kiriyat Yeyarim.
english: The children of Israel traveled and came to their cities on the third day. Now their cities were Gibeon, Chephirah, Beeroth, and Kiriath Jearim.

hausa: Sa’an nan ya gargaɗe almajiransa cewa kada su faɗa wa kowa shi ne Kiristi.
english: Then he commanded the disciples that they should tell no one that he was Jesus the Christ.

hausa: Mutanen da suka keta alkawarina da ba su cika sharuɗan alkawarin da suka yi a gabana ba, zan yi da su kamar ɗan maraƙin da suka yanka biyu suka bi ta tsakiyarsa.
english: I will give the men who have transgressed my covenant, who have not performed the words of the covenant which they made before me when they cut the calf in two and passed between its parts:

hausa: “Sai ku yi Bikin Burodi Marar Yisti. Ku kuma ci burodi marar yisti har kwana bakwai, kamar yadda na umarce ku. Ku yi wannan a ƙayyadadden lokacinsa a watan Abib, gama a cikin watan ne kuka fita daga Masar.
english: “You shall keep the feast of unleavened bread. Seven days you shall eat unleavened bread, as I commanded you, at the time appointed in the month Abib; for in the month Abib you came out of Egypt.

hausa: Sun aikata abin da ikonka da kuma nufinka ya riga ya shirya tuntuni zai faru.
english: to do whatever your hand and your counsel foreordained to happen.

hausa: A shekara ta huɗu ta Hezekiya, wato, shekara ta bakwai ke nan ta mulkin Hosheya ɗan Ela sarkin Isra’ila; Shalmaneser Sarkin Assuriya ya tasam ma Samariya da yaƙi; ya kewaye ta.
english: In the fourth year of King Hezekiah, which was the seventh year of Hoshea son of Elah king of Israel, Shalmaneser king of Assyria came up against Samaria and besieged it.

hausa: Mutanen Yamma suna mamakin abin da ya faru da shi; tsoro ya kama mutanen gabas.
english: Those who come after will be astonished at his day, as those who went before were frightened.

hausa: Dangin Merari su ne. Mali da Mushi. Ga kabilan Lawiyawa bisa ga iyalansu.
english: The sons of Merari by their families: Mahli and Mushi. These are the families of the Levites according to their fathers’ houses.

hausa: Elam na biyar, Yehohanan na shida da Eliyehoyenai na bakwai.
english: Elam the fifth, Jehohanan the sixth, and Eliehoenai the seventh.

hausa: Allah ya tashe wannan Yesu zuwa rai, mu kuwa duk shaidu ne ga wannan.
english: This Jesus God raised up, to which we all are witnesses.

hausa: “Za ku rarraba wannan ƙasa a tsakaninku bisa ga kabilan Isra’ila.
english: “So you shall divide this land to yourselves according to the tribes of Israel.

hausa: Ya ce, “Je ka ka faɗa wa wannan mutane, “ ‘Kome yawan kasa kunne da za ku yi, ba za ku fahimta ba; Kome yawan dubar da za ku yi, ba za ku san abin da yake faruwa ba.’
english: He said, “Go, and tell this people, ‘You hear indeed, but don’t understand. You see indeed, but don’t perceive.’

hausa: “Ka shafe Haruna da ’ya’yansa maza, ka kuma tsarkake su don su yi mini hidima a matsayin firistoci.
english: You shall anoint Aaron and his sons, and sanctify them, that they may minister to me in the priest’s office.

hausa: Absalom ya ce wa Ahitofel, “Ba mu shawararka. Me za mu yi?”
english: Then Absalom said to Ahithophel, “Give your counsel what we shall do.”

hausa: “Yanzu ga shi na zo don in faɗa wannan wa ranka yă daɗe sarki, don mutane sun tsorata ni. Baiwarka ta yi tunani ta ce, ‘Zan yi magana wa sarki; wataƙila yă yi abin da baiwarsa ta roƙa.
english: Now therefore, seeing that I have come to speak this word to my lord the king, it is because the people have made me afraid. Your servant said, ‘I will now speak to the king; it may be that the king will perform the request of his servant.’

hausa: Kai kaɗai na yi wa zunubi na yi abin da yake mugu a idonka, ta haka an tabbatar kai mai gaskiya sa’ad da ka yi magana aka kuma nuna kai mai adalci ne sa’ad da ka hukunta.
english: Against you, and you only, I have sinned, and done that which is evil in your sight, so you may be proved right when you speak, and justified when you judge.

hausa: “Ɗan mutum, faɗa wa gidan Isra’ila, ‘Ga abin da kuke cewa, “Laifofinmu da zunubanmu suna nawaita mana, muna kuma lalacewa saboda su. Ta ƙaƙa za mu rayu?” ’
english: “You, son of man, tell the house of Israel: ‘You say this, “Our transgressions and our sins are on us, and we pine away in them. How then can we live?”’

hausa: Yehoshafat ya zauna a Urushalima, ya kuma fita yana shiga cikin mutane daga Beyersheba zuwa ƙasar tudun Efraim ya kuma juyar da su ga Ubangiji Allah na kakanninsu.
english: Jehoshaphat lived at Jerusalem; and he went out again among the people from Beersheba to the hill country of Ephraim, and brought them back to Yahweh, the God of their fathers.

hausa: Amma godiya ga Allah! Shi ne ya ba mu nasara ta wurin Ubangijinmu Yesu Kiristi.
english: But thanks be to God, who gives us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ.

hausa: labulen filin, sandunansa da rammukansa, labulen ƙofar shiga filin; igiyoyi da ƙarafan kafa filin; dukan kayan aikin tabanakul da Tentin Sujada;
english: the hangings of the court, its pillars, its sockets, the screen for the gate of the court, its cords, its pins, and all the instruments of the service of the tabernacle, for the Tent of Meeting,

hausa: Filistiyawa suka tunƙuro mayaƙansu domin su sadu da Isra’ilawa, yaƙi kuwa ya yi tsanani har Isra’ilawa suka sha kashi a hannun Filistiyawa. Filistiyawa suka kashe Isra’ilawa kusan mutum dubu huɗu a bakin dāgā.
english: The Philistines put themselves in array against Israel. When they joined battle, Israel was defeated by the Philistines, who killed about four thousand men of the army in the field.

hausa: Aka yi yaƙi tsakanin Rehobowam da Yerobowam a duk kwanakin Abiya.
english: Now there was war between Rehoboam and Jeroboam all the days of his life.

hausa: Bayan ta sa shi ya yi barci a cinyarta, sai ta kira wani ya zo ya aske kitso guda bakwai nan a kansa, aka fara rinjayensa. Ƙarfinsa kuwa ya rabu da shi.
english: She made him sleep on her knees; and she called for a man and shaved off the seven locks of his head; and she began to afflict him, and his strength went from him.

hausa: “Mutumin da yake shugaba a ƙasar ya yi mana matsananciyar magana, ya kuma ɗauke mu tamƙar ’yan leƙen asirin ƙasa.
english: “The man, the lord of the land, spoke roughly with us, and took us for spies of the country.

hausa: Na yi fushi saboda kwaɗayin zunubinsa; na yi masa horo, na kuma ɓoye fuskata saboda fushi, duk da haka ya ci gaba da ayyukan zunubinsa.
english: I was angry because of the iniquity of his covetousness and struck him. I hid myself and was angry; and he went on backsliding in the way of his heart.

hausa: Ku riƙe su da mutunci sosai cikin ƙauna saboda aikinsu. Ku yi zaman lafiya da juna.
english: and to respect and honor them in love for their work’s sake. Be at peace among yourselves.

hausa: Ko za a gaya masa cewa ina so in yi magana? Ko wani zai nemi a haɗiye shi?
english: Will it be told him that I would speak? Or should a man wish that he were swallowed up?

hausa: Musa ya aike su zuwa yaƙi, dubu ɗaya daga kowace kabila, tare da Finehas ɗan Eleyazar, firist, wanda ya ɗauki kayayyaki daga wuri mai tsarki da ƙahoni don kiran yaƙi.
english: Moses sent them, one thousand of every tribe, to the war with Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest, to the war, with the vessels of the sanctuary and the trumpets for the alarm in his hand.

hausa: Sai ya gaya musu wannan misali ya ce, “Ku dubi itacen ɓaure da dukan itatuwa.
english: He told them a parable. “See the fig tree and all the trees.

hausa: Kada ka ce wa maƙwabcinka “Ka yă dakata sai gobe,” idan kana iya taimakonsa yanzu.
english: Don’t say to your neighbor, “Go, and come again; tomorrow I will give it to you,” when you have it by you.

hausa: Ba ta wurin doka ce Ibrahim da zuriyarsa suka sami alkawarin cewa zai zama magājin duniya ba, amma sai dai ta wurin adalcin da yake zuwa ta wurin bangaskiya.
english: For the promise to Abraham and to his offspring that he would be heir of the world wasn’t through the law, but through the righteousness of faith.

hausa: Ya amsa mini ya ce, “Zunubin gidan Isra’ila da Yahuda ya yi girma ainun; ƙasar ta cika da rashin adalci. Suna cewa, ‘Ubangiji ya yashe ƙasar; Ubangiji ba ya gani.’
english: Then he said to me, “The iniquity of the house of Israel and Judah is exceedingly great, and the land is full of blood, and the city full of perversion; for they say, ‘Yahweh has forsaken the land, and Yahweh doesn’t see.’

hausa: Da aljanun suka fita daga cikin mutumin, sai suka shiga cikin aladun. Garken kuma ya gangara daga kan tudun zuwa cikin tafkin, kuma suka nutse.
english: The demons came out of the man and entered into the pigs, and the herd rushed down the steep bank into the lake and were drowned.

hausa: Macen ta ce, “Na san cewa Almasihu” (da ake ce da shi Kiristi) “yana zuwa. Sa’ad da ya zo kuwa, zai bayyana mana kome.”
english: The woman said to him, “I know that Messiah is coming, he who is called Christ. When he has come, he will declare to us all things.”

hausa: Sau uku a shekara, dukan mazanku za su bayyana a gaban Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka, Allah na Isra’ila.
english: Three times in the year all your males shall appear before the Lord Yahweh, the God of Israel.

hausa: duk da haka ina roƙonka saboda ƙauna, na fi so in roƙe ka, ni Bulus tsoho, a yanzu kuma ga ni ɗan sarƙa saboda Kiristi Yesu.
english: yet for love’s sake I rather appeal to you, being such a one as Paul, the aged, but also a prisoner of Jesus Christ.

hausa: Sai ya ce, “Ku kawo mini sabuwar ƙwarya, ku kuma sa gishiri a ciki.” Sai suka kawo masa.
english: He said, “Bring me a new jar, and put salt in it.” Then they brought it to him.

hausa: ’Yar’uwarsa Makir mai suna Hammoleket ta haifi Ishod, Abiyezer da Mala.
english: His sister Hammolecheth bore Ishhod, Abiezer, and Mahlah.

hausa: Matasa maza waɗanda ba su da wata naƙasa kuma kyawawa, hazikai ta kowace hanyar koyo, sanannu, masu saurin fahimtar abu, da kuma waɗanda suka cancanci su yi aiki a fadar sarki. Zai koya musu harshen Babiloniyawa da kuma littattafansu.
english: youths in whom was no defect, but well-favored, skillful in all wisdom, endowed with knowledge, understanding science, and who had the ability to stand in the king’s palace; and that he should teach them the learning and the language of the Chaldeans.

hausa: amma ba su iya cin nasara kan hikimarsa ko kuma a kan Ruhu wanda ta wurinsa ne ya magana ba.
english: They weren’t able to withstand the wisdom and the Spirit by which he spoke.

hausa: Ya tafi Nazaret, inda aka yi renonsa. A ranar Asabbaci kuma, ya shiga majami’a kamar yadda ya saba. Sai ya miƙe don yă yi karatu.
english: He came to Nazareth, where he had been brought up. He entered, as was his custom, into the synagogue on the Sabbath day, and stood up to read.

hausa: Absalom ya zauna a Urushalima shekara biyu amma ba tare da ganin fuskar sarki ba.
english: Absalom lived two full years in Jerusalem, and he didn’t see the king’s face.

hausa: Ku shuka wa kanku adalci, ku girbe ’ya’yan jinƙai marar ƙarewa, ku kuma nome ƙasar da ba a nome ba; gama lokaci ne na neman Ubangiji, sai ya zo ya zubo adalci a kanku.
english: Sow to yourselves in righteousness, reap according to kindness. Break up your fallow ground, for it is time to seek Yahweh, until he comes and rains righteousness on you.

hausa: In kuwa Ruhu wannan da ya tā da Yesu daga matattu yana zama a cikinku, shi wanda ya tā da Kiristi daga matattu zai ba da rai ga jikunanku masu mutuwa ta wurin Ruhunsa, wanda yake zama a cikinku.
english: But if the Spirit of him who raised up Jesus from the dead dwells in you, he who raised up Christ Jesus from the dead will also give life to your mortal bodies through his Spirit who dwells in you.

hausa: Da jin haka, sai wani da yake tare da shi a tebur ɗin, ya ce wa Yesu, “Mai albarka ne wanda zai ci abinci a bikin nan a mulkin Allah.”
english: When one of those who sat at the table with him heard these things, he said to him, “Blessed is he who will feast in God’s Kingdom!”

hausa: Yoshuwa kuwa ya ƙwace dukan ƙasar yadda Ubangiji ya umarci Musa, ya ba da ita ta zama ƙasar gādo ga Isra’ilawa, kabila-kabila. Ta haka ƙasar ta huta daga yaƙi.
english: So Joshua took the whole land, according to all that Yahweh spoke to Moses; and Joshua gave it for an inheritance to Israel according to their divisions by their tribes. Then the land had rest from war.

hausa: ta Adin 655
english: The children of Adin: six hundred fifty-five.

hausa: Yahuda ya ci amana. An yi abin kunya a Isra’ila da kuma a Urushalima. Yahuda ya ƙazantar da wuri mai tsarkin da Ubangiji yake ƙauna, ta wurin auren ’yar wani baƙon allah.
english: Judah has dealt treacherously, and an abomination is committed in Israel and in Jerusalem; for Judah has profaned the holiness of Yahweh which he loves, and has married the daughter of a foreign god.

hausa: Sai suka amsa suka ce, “Kai ma daga Galili ne? Bincika ka gani, za ka iske cewa ba annabin da zai fito daga Galili.”
english: They answered him, “Are you also from Galilee? Search and see that no prophet has arisen out of Galilee.”

hausa: Yesu ya tambaye shi, “Mene ne sunanka?” Sai ya amsa, “Tuli,” gama aljanu masu ɗumbun yawa ne suna cikinsa.
english: Jesus asked him, “What is your name?” He said, “Legion,” for many demons had entered into him.

hausa: Na zo cikin duniya a kan ni haske ne, don duk wanda ya gaskata da ni, kada yă zauna a cikin duhu.
english: I have come as a light into the world, that whoever believes in me may not remain in the darkness.

hausa: mutanen rabin kabilar Manasse, sanannu da sunaye suka zo suka mai da Dawuda sarki, su 18,000;
english: Of the half-tribe of Manasseh: eighteen thousand, who were mentioned by name, to come and make David king.

hausa: “Gishiri yana da daɗi, amma in ya rabu da ɗanɗanonsa, ta yaya za a sāke mai da ɗanɗanonsa? Ku kasance da gishiri a cikinku, ku kuma yi zauna lafiya da juna.”
english: Salt is good, but if the salt has lost its saltiness, with what will you season it? Have salt in yourselves, and be at peace with one another.”

hausa: A cikin kome ya yi tafiya a hanyoyin mahaifinsa Asa, bai kuma kauce daga gare su ba; ya yi abin da yake daidai a gaban Ubangiji. Amma bai rurrushe masujadai da suke kan tuddai ba, mutane kuwa suka ci gaba da miƙa hadayu suna kuma ƙone turare a can.
english: He walked in all the way of Asa his father. He didn’t turn away from it, doing that which was right in Yahweh’s eyes. However, the high places were not taken away. The people still sacrificed and burned incense on the high places.

hausa: Shi ya sa da yawa a cikinku ba su da ƙarfi, suna kuma da rashin lafiya, waɗansunku kuma sun riga sun yi barci.
english: For this cause many among you are weak and sickly, and not a few sleep.

hausa: Dole kowa yă bincike kansa kafin yă ci burodin yă kuma sha daga kwaf ɗin.
english: But let a man examine himself, and so let him eat of the bread and drink of the cup.

hausa: “Amma su kakanninmu, suka yi fariya da taurinkai, ba su kuwa yi biyayya ga umarnanka ba.
english: “But they and our fathers behaved proudly, hardened their neck, didn’t listen to your commandments,

hausa: Zan rera ga Ubangiji dukan raina; zan rera yabo ga Allahna muddin ina raye.
english: I will sing to Yahweh as long as I live. I will sing praise to my God while I have any being.

hausa: Sarki ya yi shelar umarnin Ubangiji. Ubangiji ya ce mini, “Kai Ɗana ne; yau na zama Mahaifinka.
english: I will tell of the decree: Yahweh said to me, “You are my son. Today I have become your father.

hausa: Sai annabin ya amsa, “Ni ma annabi ne, kamar ka. Kuma mala’ika ya ce mini ta wurin kalmar Ubangiji, ‘Dawo da shi zuwa gidanka saboda yă ci abinci, yă kuma sha ruwa.’ ” (Amma yana masa ƙarya ne.)
english: He said to him, “I also am a prophet as you are; and an angel spoke to me by Yahweh’s word, saying, ‘Bring him back with you into your house, that he may eat bread and drink water.’” He lied to him.

hausa: Ya kuwa wulaƙanta mutanenmu sosai, ya kuma gwada wa kakanni-kakanninmu azaba ta wurin tilasta su su zubar da sababbin jariransu, don su mutu.
english: The same took advantage of our race and mistreated our fathers, and forced them to abandon their babies, so that they wouldn’t stay alive.

hausa: Elkana, Isshiya, Azarel, Yoyezer da Yashobeyam daga Kora;
english: Elkanah, Isshiah, Azarel, Joezer, and Jashobeam, the Korahites;

hausa: “Ka umarci Isra’ilawa su ba wa Lawiyawa garuruwan da za su zauna a ciki daga cikin gādon da Isra’ilawa za su mallaka. A kuma ba su wurin kiwo kewaye da garuruwan.
english: “Command the children of Israel to give to the Levites cities to dwell in out of their inheritance. You shall give pasture lands for the cities around them to the Levites.

hausa: Amam, Shema, Molada,
english: Amam, Shema, Moladah,

hausa: Amma in zukatanku suka kangare, ba su kuwa yi biyayya ba, in kuma aka rinjaye ku don ku rusuna ga waɗansu alloli ku yi musu bauta,
english: But if your heart turns away, and you will not hear, but are drawn away and worship other gods, and serve them,

hausa: Ban yi ƙyashin azurfa ko zinariya ko tufafin kowa ba.
english: I coveted no one’s silver, gold, or clothing.

hausa: Harshe yana da ikon rai da mutuwa, kuma waɗanda suke ƙaunarsa za su ci amfaninsa.
english: Death and life are in the power of the tongue; those who love it will eat its fruit.

hausa: Bari su yabi sunan Ubangiji, gama sunansa ne kaɗai mafi ɗaukaka; darajarsa ta fi ƙarfin duniya da sammai.
english: Let them praise Yahweh’s name, for his name alone is exalted. His glory is above the earth and the heavens.

hausa: Mala’ikan Ubangiji ya sāke dawowa sau na biyu ya taɓa shi, ya ce, “Tashi ka ci abinci, gama tafiyar za tă yi maka yawa.”
english: Yahweh’s angel came again the second time, and touched him, and said, “Arise and eat, because the journey is too great for you.”

hausa: Dukan ƙasar da kake gani zan ba ka, kai da zuriyarka har abada.
english: for I will give all the land which you see to you and to your offspring forever.

hausa: Ya aikata mugunta domin bai sa zuciyarsa ga neman Ubangiji ba.
english: He did that which was evil, because he didn’t set his heart to seek Yahweh.

hausa: Suka kuma haura ta Negeb, suka iso Hebron, inda Ahiman, da Sheshai, da Talmai, zuriyar Anak, suke zama. (An gina Hebron da shekara bakwai kafin a gina Zowan a Masar.)
english: They went up by the South, and came to Hebron; and Ahiman, Sheshai, and Talmai, the children of Anak, were there. (Now Hebron was built seven years before Zoan in Egypt.)

hausa: da kai ne na ragargaza doki da mahayi, da kai ne na ragargaza keken yaƙin da matuƙi,
english: With you I will break in pieces the horse and his rider.

hausa: Ko da me hikima take, Abin ya yi mana zurfi ƙwarai, yana da wuyar ganewa, wa zai iya gane shi?
english: That which is, is far off and exceedingly deep. Who can find it out?

hausa: “Sauran mutum ɗaya da ya rage ya aika, ɗa, da yake ƙauna. Daga ƙarshe sai ya aike shi, yana cewa, ‘Za su girmama ɗana.’
english: Therefore still having one, his beloved son, he sent him last to them, saying, ‘They will respect my son.’

hausa: Musa ya ba wa Eleyazar abin da aka ware wa Ubangiji, kamar yadda Ubangiji ya umarci Musa.
english: Moses gave the tribute, which was Yahweh’s wave offering, to Eleazar the priest, as Yahweh commanded Moses.

hausa: Sai waɗannan Lawiyawa suka shiga aiki, daga Kohatawa Mahat ɗan Amasai da Yowel ɗan Azariya. Daga Kabilar Merari, Kish ɗan Abdi da Azariya ɗan Yahallelel. Daga Gershonawa, Yowa ɗan Zimma da Eden ɗan Yowa.
english: Then the Levites arose: Mahath, the son of Amasai, and Joel the son of Azariah, of the sons of the Kohathites; and of the sons of Merari, Kish the son of Abdi, and Azariah the son of Jehallelel; and of the Gershonites, Joah the son of Zimmah, and Eden the son of Joah;

hausa: Tsoron Allah ya kama dukan mulkokin ƙasashe sa’ad da suka ji yadda Ubangiji ya yi yaƙi a kan abokan gāban Isra’ila.
english: The fear of God was on all the kingdoms of the countries when they heard that Yahweh fought against the enemies of Israel.

hausa: Gama Ubangiji ne ya taurare zukatansu waɗannan sarakuna suka yi yaƙi da Isra’ilawa don yă hallaka su gaba ɗaya, yă gamar da su ba jinƙai, yadda Ubangiji ya umarci Musa.
english: For it was of Yahweh to harden their hearts, to come against Israel in battle, that he might utterly destroy them, that they might have no favor, but that he might destroy them, as Yahweh commanded Moses.

hausa: Shugabansu zai zama ɗaya daga cikinsu; mai mulkinsu zai taso daga cikinsu. Zan kawo shi kusa zai kuma zo kusa da ni, gama wane ne zai miƙa kansa don yă yi kusa da ni?’ In ji Ubangiji.
english: Their prince will be one of them, and their ruler will proceed from among them. I will cause him to draw near, and he will approach me; for who is he who has had boldness to approach me?” says Yahweh.

hausa: Bari sammai su yi farin ciki, bari duniya tă yi murna; bari su ce a cikin al’ummai, “Ubangiji yana mulki!”
english: Let the heavens be glad, and let the earth rejoice! Let them say among the nations, “Yahweh reigns!”

hausa: Ubangiji kuwa ya ba Isra’ilawa dukan ƙasar da ya yi wa kakanninsu alkawari, suka kuwa mallake ta, suka zauna a cikinta.
english: So Yahweh gave to Israel all the land which he swore to give to their fathers. They possessed it, and lived in it.

hausa: Hezekiya kuwa ya yi addu’a ga Ubangiji ya ce, “Ya Ubangiji, Allah na Isra’ila, wanda yake zaune tsakanin kerubobi, kai kaɗai ne Allah bisa dukan mulkokin duniya. Kai ka yi sama da duniya.
english: Hezekiah prayed before Yahweh, and said, “Yahweh, the God of Israel, enthroned above the cherubim, you are the God, even you alone, of all the kingdoms of the earth. You have made heaven and earth.

hausa: suka tafi don su yaƙi Bera sarkin Sodom, Birsha sarkin Gomorra, Shinab sarkin Adma, Shemeber sarkin Zeboyim, da kuma sarkin Bela (wato, Zowar).
english: they made war with Bera, king of Sodom; Birsha, king of Gomorrah; Shinab, king of Admah; Shemeber, king of Zeboiim; and the king of Bela (also called Zoar).

hausa: Ka mai da hankali ga umarni ka kuma kasa kunne ga kalmomin sani.
english: Apply your heart to instruction, and your ears to the words of knowledge.

hausa: Ba ƙafar mutum ko ta dabbar da za tă ratsa ta; ba wanda zai zauna a can har shekaru arba’in.
english: No foot of man will pass through it, nor will any animal foot pass through it. It won’t be inhabited for forty years.

hausa: Ku gina birane domin matanku da ’ya’yanku, ku gina katanga kuma domin dabbobinku, amma fa ku cika abin da kuka yi alkawari.”
english: Build cities for your little ones, and folds for your sheep; and do that which has proceeded out of your mouth.”

hausa: Sa’an nan ta ba sarki talenti 120 na zinariya, kayan yaji masu yawa, da kuma duwatsu masu daraja. Ba a taɓa kasance da irin kayan yaji mai yawa kamar waɗanda sarauniyar Sheba ta ba wa sarki Solomon ba.
english: She gave the king one hundred and twenty talents of gold, spices in great abundance, and precious stones. There was never before such spice as the queen of Sheba gave to King Solomon.

hausa: Amma da ba su same su ba, sai suka ja Yason da waɗansu ’yan’uwa zuwa gaban mahukuntan birnin, suna ihu suna cewa, “Waɗannan mutanen da suke tā da fitina ko’ina a duniya sun iso nan,
english: When they didn’t find them, they dragged Jason and certain brothers before the rulers of the city, crying, “These who have turned the world upside down have come here also,

hausa: Sa’ad da ya kai wani wuri, sai ya dakata domin yă kwana, gama rana ta riga ta fāɗi. Ya ɗauki dutse daga cikin duwatsun wurin, ya sa shi ya zama matashin kansa, sa’an nan ya kwanta don yă yi barci.
english: He came to a certain place, and stayed there all night, because the sun had set. He took one of the stones of the place, and put it under his head, and lay down in that place to sleep.

hausa: Kansa zinariya ce zalla; gashinsa dogaye ne baƙi wuluk kamar hankaka.
english: His head is like the purest gold. His hair is bushy, black as a raven.

hausa: Abin da aka yi a yau umarni ne daga Ubangiji don yin kafara saboda ku.
english: What has been done today, so Yahweh has commanded to do, to make atonement for you.

hausa: Zan sa inuwar da rana ta yi a kan matakalar Ahaz ta koma baya da taki goma.’ ” Saboda haka inuwar ta koma da baya daga fuskar rana har taki goma.
english: Behold, I will cause the shadow on the sundial, which has gone down on the sundial of Ahaz with the sun, to return backward ten steps.”’” So the sun returned ten steps on the sundial on which it had gone down.

hausa: Saboda haka mugaye ba za su iya tsayawa a shari’a ba, balle a sami masu zunubi a taron adalai.
english: Therefore the wicked shall not stand in the judgment, nor sinners in the congregation of the righteous.

hausa: Lokacin da ya yi iska ya sa ta hura, ya kuma auna ruwaye.
english: He establishes the force of the wind. Yes, he measures out the waters by measure.

hausa: Bayan Mikahiya ya faɗa musu kome da ya ji Baruk ya karanta wa mutane daga littafin,
english: Then Micaiah declared to them all the words that he had heard, when Baruch read the book in the ears of the people.

hausa: Za su kore ku daga majami’a; lalle, lokaci yana zuwa da duk wanda ya kashe ku, zai ɗauka yana yin wa Allah hidima ne.
english: They will put you out of the synagogues. Yes, the time is coming that whoever kills you will think that he offers service to God.

hausa: “Sa’an nan ya ce, ‘Allah na kakanninmu ya zaɓe ka ka san nufinsa ka kuma ga Mai Adalcin nan ka kuma ji kalmomi daga bakinsa.
english: He said, ‘The God of our fathers has appointed you to know his will, and to see the Righteous One, and to hear a voice from his mouth.

hausa: Na ɗauki ƙwarƙwarata na yayyanka gunduwa-gunduwa na aika da shi ga kowane yankin gādon Isra’ila, domin sun aikata mugu abu da abin kunya a Isra’ila.
english: I took my concubine and cut her in pieces, and sent her throughout all the country of the inheritance of Israel; for they have committed lewdness and folly in Israel.

hausa: Zan lalatar da duwatsu da tuddai in busar da dukan itatuwansu; zan mai da koguna su zama tsibirai in kuma busar da tafkuna.
english: I will destroy mountains and hills, and dry up all their herbs. I will make the rivers islands, and will dry up the pools.

hausa: Kanki ya yi miki rawani kamar Dutsen Karmel. Gashinki ya yi kamar shunayya; yakan ɗauke hankalin sarki.
english: Your head on you is like Carmel. The hair of your head like purple. The king is held captive in its tresses.

hausa: Gama ina shaida cewa sun bayar daidai gwargwadon iyawarsu, har ma fiye da ƙarfinsu. Su kansu,
english: For according to their power, I testify, yes and beyond their power, they gave of their own accord,

hausa: “Na gan shi, amma ba yanzu ba; na hange shi, amma ba kusa ba. Tauraro zai fito daga Yaƙub; sandan mulki zai fito daga Isra’ila. Zai ragargaje goshin Mowab, kawunan dukan ’ya’yan Set.
english: I see him, but not now. I see him, but not near. A star will come out of Jacob. A scepter will rise out of Israel, and shall strike through the corners of Moab, and crush all the sons of Sheth.

hausa: da ta dukan Naftali, da yankin Efraim da na Manasse, dukan ƙasar Yahuda har zuwa Bahar Rum,
english: and all Naphtali, and the land of Ephraim and Manasseh, and all the land of Judah, to the Western Sea,

hausa: Waɗansu Farisiyawa suka zo suka gwada shi, ta wurin yin masa tambaya cewa, “Daidai ne bisa ga doka, mutum yă saki matarsa?”
english: Pharisees came to him testing him, and asked him, “Is it lawful for a man to divorce his wife?”

hausa: Tun daga wannan lokaci zuwa gaba, Shawulu ya dinga kishin Dawuda.
english: Saul watched David from that day and forward.

hausa: Saboda haka, za ka ga ƙasar daga nesa kawai; ba za ka shiga ƙasar da nake ba wa mutanen Isra’ila ba.”
english: For you shall see the land from a distance; but you shall not go there into the land which I give the children of Israel.”

hausa: Ka tace azurfa sai kayan su fito don maƙerin azurfa;
english: Take away the dross from the silver, and material comes out for the refiner.

hausa: Fir’auna kuwa ya kira masu hikima da masu sihiri, sai bokayen Masarawa ma suka yi irin abubuwan nan da bokancinsu.
english: Then Pharaoh also called for the wise men and the sorcerers. They also, the magicians of Egypt, did the same thing with their enchantments.

hausa: Amma hannun wanda zai ci amanata, yana cin abincin tare da ni.
english: But behold, the hand of him who betrays me is with me on the table.

hausa: Muddin da sauran rana, dole mu yi aikin wanda ya aiko ni. Dare yana zuwa, sa’ad da ba wanda zai iya yin aiki.
english: I must work the works of him who sent me while it is day. The night is coming, when no one can work.

hausa: Na sa bakan gizona cikin gizagizai, shi ne kuwa zai zama alamar alkawari tsakanina da duniya.
english: I set my rainbow in the cloud, and it will be a sign of a covenant between me and the earth.

hausa: Kada ka ɗaukaka kanka a gaban sarki, kada kuma ka nemi wa kanka wuri a cikin manyan mutane;
english: Don’t exalt yourself in the presence of the king, or claim a place among great men;

hausa: Ya kwantar da hadiri suka yi tsit; raƙuman ruwan teku suka yi shiru.
english: He makes the storm a calm, so that its waves are still.

hausa: Sai da dukan mutanen suka wuce sa’an nan akwatin alkawari da firistoci suka sha gaba.
english: When all the people had completely crossed over, Yahweh’s ark crossed over with the priests in the presence of the people.

hausa: Akwai jikuna iri na samaniya, akwai kuma jikuna iri na duniya; sai dai darajar jikunan samaniya dabam take, darajar jikunan duniya kuma dabam take.
english: There are also celestial bodies and terrestrial bodies; but the glory of the celestial differs from that of the terrestrial.

hausa: Sa’an nan ta ci gaba, ta yi gabas zuwa Gat-Hefer da Et Kazin; ta ɓulla a Rimmon, ta juya zuwa Neya.
english: From there it passed along eastward to Gath Hepher, to Ethkazin; and it went out at Rimmon which stretches to Neah.

hausa: Amma mutanen nan suna da tauraren zukata, kuma ’yan tawaye ne; sun kauce suka kuma rabu da ni.
english: “But this people has a revolting and a rebellious heart. They have revolted and gone.

hausa: da rammukan sanduna don kewaye filin, da waɗanda suke ƙofarsa, da dukan ƙarafan kafa tenti don tabanakul, da kuma don kewaye filin.
english: the sockets around the court, the sockets of the gate of the court, all the pins of the tabernacle, and all the pins around the court.

hausa: Ina gāba da ku, mazaunan Urushalima, ku da kuke zama a bisa wannan kwari kan dutsen da yake a fili, in ji Ubangiji ku da kuke cewa, “Wa zai iya yaƙe mu? Wa zai iya shiga mafakarmu?”
english: Behold, I am against you, O inhabitant of the valley, and of the rock of the plain,’ says Yahweh. ‘You that say, “Who would come down against us?” or, “Who would enter into our homes?”

hausa: Sarki Zedekiya ya ce wa Irmiya, “Ina jin tsoron Yahudawan da suka tafi wurin Babiloniyawa, gama Babiloniyawa mai yiwuwa su ba da ni gare su su kuma wulaƙanta ni.”
english: Zedekiah the king said to Jeremiah, “I am afraid of the Jews who have defected to the Chaldeans, lest they deliver me into their hand, and they mock me.”

hausa: Ku bar salamar Kiristi tă yi mulki a zukatanku, da yake a matsayin gaɓoɓin jiki ɗaya an kira ku ga salama. Ku zama masu godiya.
english: And let the peace of God rule in your hearts, to which also you were called in one body, and be thankful.

hausa: Gama ba ku bauta wa Ubangiji Allahnku da farin ciki da kuma murna a lokacin wadata ba,
english: Because you didn’t serve Yahweh your God with joyfulness and with gladness of heart, by reason of the abundance of all things;

hausa: A dā Finehas ɗan Eleyazar ne yake lura da matsaran, kuma Ubangiji ya kasance tare da shi.
english: Phinehas the son of Eleazar was ruler over them in time past, and Yahweh was with him.

hausa: Saboda mu iya yin wa’azin bishara a yankunan da suke gaba da ku. Gama ba ma so mu yi taƙama game da aikin da aka riga aka yi a sashen wani.
english: so as to preach the Good News even to the parts beyond you, not to boast in what someone else has already done.

hausa: Waɗannan su ne kabilan Dan bisa ga kabilarsu, daga Shuham, kabilar Shuhamawa. Waɗannan su ne kabilan Dan.
english: These are the sons of Dan after their families: of Shuham, the family of the Shuhamites. These are the families of Dan after their families.

hausa: Yau ka ga da idonka yadda Ubangiji ya bashe ka a hannuna a cikin kogon nan. Waɗansu sun ce mini in kashe ka, amma na bar ka, na ce, ‘Ba zan sa hannuna a kan shugabana ba, gama shi shafaffe ne na Ubangiji.’
english: Behold, today your eyes have seen how Yahweh had delivered you today into my hand in the cave. Some urged me to kill you, but I spared you. I said, ‘I will not stretch out my hand against my lord, for he is Yahweh’s anointed.’

hausa: Ku bi a hankali, kada ku ɗora mini laifi; ku sāke dubawa, gama ba ni da laifi.
english: Please return. Let there be no injustice. Yes, return again. My cause is righteous.

hausa: Yosiya ya fitar da dukan gumakan banƙyama daga dukan yankunan Isra’ilawa, ya kuma sa dukan waɗanda suke a Isra’ila su bauta wa Ubangiji Allahnsu. Muddin ransa, ba su fasa bin Ubangiji Allah na kakanninsu ba.
english: Josiah took away all the abominations out of all the countries that belonged to the children of Israel, and made all who were found in Israel to serve, even to serve Yahweh their God. All his days they didn’t depart from following Yahweh, the God of their fathers.

hausa: sai dai Kaleb ɗan Yefunne. Zai gan ta, zan ba shi duk ƙasar da tafin ƙafarsa ta taka, shi da zuriyarsa, gama ya bi Ubangiji da zuciya ɗaya.”
english: except Caleb the son of Jephunneh. He shall see it. I will give the land that he has trodden on to him and to his children, because he has wholly followed Yahweh.”

hausa: Sai ya tambayi almajiransa, “Ina bangaskiyarku?” A cikin tsoro da mamaki, suka ce wa junansu, “Wane ne wannan? Yana ba da umarni ga iska da ruwa ma, kuma suna biyayya da shi?”
english: He said to them, “Where is your faith?” Being afraid, they marveled, saying to one another, “Who is this then, that he commands even the winds and the water, and they obey him?”

hausa: Bulus ya amsa ya ce, “Yanzu ina tsaye a gaban kotun Kaisar, inda ya kamata a yi mini shari’a. Ban yi wani laifi ga Yahudawa ba, kai da kanka ma ka san da haka sarai.
english: But Paul said, “I am standing before Caesar’s judgment seat, where I ought to be tried. I have done no wrong to the Jews, as you also know very well.

hausa: Wautar mutum kan lalatar da ransa, duk da haka zuciyarsa kan ba wa Ubangiji laifi.
english: The foolishness of man subverts his way; his heart rages against Yahweh.

hausa: Bari su rera game da hanyoyin Ubangiji, gama ɗaukakar Ubangiji da girma take.
english: Yes, they will sing of the ways of Yahweh, for Yahweh’s glory is great!
