hausa: Ya kuma buge wani jibgaggen mutumin Masar. Duk da māshin da mutumin Masar yana riƙe a hannunsa, Benahiya ya kai masa hari da kulki. Ya ƙwace māshin daga hannunsa, ya kuma kashe shi da māshin.
english: He killed a huge Egyptian, and the Egyptian had a spear in his hand; but he went down to him with a staff and plucked the spear out of the Egyptian’s hand, and killed him with his own spear.

hausa: Sai mala’ikan ya nuna mini kogin ruwan rai, mai ƙyalli kamar madubi, yana gangarawa daga kursiyin Allah da na Ɗan Ragon,
english: He showed me a river of water of life, clear as crystal, proceeding out of the throne of God and of the Lamb,

hausa: domin dukan al’ul na Lebanon, masu tsayi da masu fariya, da kuma dukan itatuwan oak na Bashan,
english: for all the cedars of Lebanon, that are high and lifted up, for all the oaks of Bashan,

hausa: A rana ta biye sai ya sallame mutane. Suka sa wa sarki albarka, sa’an nan suka watse zuwa gida, da farin ciki, da murna a zukatansu saboda kyawawan abubuwan da Ubangiji ya yi domin bawansa Dawuda, da kuma mutanensa Isra’ila.
english: On the eighth day he sent the people away; and they blessed the king, and went to their tents joyful and glad in their hearts for all the goodness that Yahweh had shown to David his servant, and to Israel his people.

hausa: ’Ya’yan Shem maza su ne, Elam, Asshur, Arfakshad, Lud da Aram.
english: The sons of Shem were: Elam, Asshur, Arpachshad, Lud, and Aram.

hausa: Ba kawai ya yarda yă je wurinku kamar yadda muka roƙe shi yă yi ba, amma ya so yă zo kamar yadda ya riga ya yi niyya.
english: For he indeed accepted our exhortation, but being himself very earnest, he went out to you of his own accord.

hausa: Za ku zama abin ƙi, abin dariya, da kuma abin habaici ga dukan al’ummai inda Ubangiji zai kore ku zuwa.
english: You will become an astonishment, a proverb, and a byword among all the peoples where Yahweh will lead you away.

hausa: Amma sa’ad da ya roƙa, dole yă gaskata, ba tare da shakka ba, domin shi mai shakka, yana kama da raƙumar ruwan tekun da iska take kori tana kuma ɓuɓɓugowa.
english: But let him ask in faith, without any doubting, for he who doubts is like a wave of the sea, driven by the wind and tossed.

hausa: Wane daɗi Allah zai ji in kai mai adalci ne? Wace riba zai samu in rayuwarka marar laifi ce?
english: Is it any pleasure to the Almighty that you are righteous? Or does it benefit him that you make your ways perfect?

hausa: Mai Adalci kan lura da gidan mugu kan kuma zama sanadin lalacin mugu.
english: The Righteous One considers the house of the wicked, and brings the wicked to ruin.

hausa: Duk da haka har wa yau Ubangiji bai ba ku hankalin ganewa, ko idanun da za su gani, ko kunnuwan da za su ji ba.
english: But Yahweh has not given you a heart to know, eyes to see, and ears to hear, to this day.

hausa: Aka ba ’yan’uwansu Lawiyawa dukan sauran ayyukan tabanakul, gidan Allah.
english: Their brothers the Levites were appointed for all the service of the tabernacle of God’s house.

hausa: Zan nuna muku jinƙai don yă nuna muku jinƙai ya kuma maido da ku ƙasarku.’
english: I will grant you mercy, that he may have mercy on you, and cause you to return to your own land.

hausa: A ranar, Dawuda ya gudu daga wajen Shawulu ya tafi wuri Akish sarkin Gat.
english: David arose and fled that day for fear of Saul, and went to Achish the king of Gath.

hausa: Saboda haka kamar yadda Ubangiji ya umarta, sai Isra’ilawa suka ba wa Lawiyawa waɗannan garuruwa da wuraren kiwo daga cikin gādonsu.
english: The children of Israel gave to the Levites out of their inheritance, according to the commandment of Yahweh, these cities with their pasture lands.

hausa: Hikimarsa tana da zurfi, ikonsa yana da yawa. Wane ne ya taɓa yin faɗa da shi har ya yi nasara?
english: God is wise in heart, and mighty in strength. Who has hardened himself against him and prospered?

hausa: Mutanen kuma suka yi zato zai kumbura ko kuma nan da nan zai fāɗi matacce, amma da aka daɗe ba su ga wani abu ya faru da shi ba, sai suka sāke ra’ayi suka ce shi wani allah ne.
english: But they expected that he would have swollen or fallen down dead suddenly, but when they watched for a long time and saw nothing bad happen to him, they changed their minds and said that he was a god.

hausa: Da haka za ka keɓe Lawiyawa daga sauran Isra’ilawa, Lawiyawa za su zama nawa.
english: Thus you shall separate the Levites from among the children of Israel, and the Levites shall be mine.

hausa: Saboda haka za a washe Babiloniyawa; dukan waɗanda suka washe ta za su ƙoshi,” in ji Ubangiji.
english: Chaldea will be a prey. All who prey on her will be satisfied,” says Yahweh.

hausa: Sa’an nan Ubangiji ya ce, “Ruhuna ba zai zauna a cikin mutum har abada ba, saboda shi mai mutuwa ne, kwanakinsa za su zama shekaru ɗari da arba’in ne.”
english: Yahweh said, “My Spirit will not strive with man forever, because he also is flesh; so his days will be one hundred twenty years.”

hausa: “Na kafa Sarkina a kan kursiyi a kan Sihiyona, dutsena mai tsarki.”
english: “Yet I have set my King on my holy hill of Zion.”

hausa: Ɗan Ana shi ne, Dishon. ’Ya’yan Dishon maza su ne, Hemdan, Eshban, Itran da Keran.
english: The son of Anah: Dishon. The sons of Dishon: Hamran, Eshban, Ithran, and Cheran.

hausa: ka ce musu, ‘Ga abin da Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka yana cewa a ranar da na zaɓi Isra’ila, na ɗaga hannuna, na rantse wa zuriyar gidan Yaƙub na kuma bayyana kaina gare su a Masar da hannun da na ɗaga na ce musu, “Ni ne Ubangiji Allahnku.”
english: Tell them, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “In the day when I chose Israel, and swore to the offspring of the house of Jacob, and made myself known to them in the land of Egypt, when I swore to them, saying, ‘I am Yahweh your God;’

hausa: Ya umarce su, “Ga abin da za ku faɗa wa maigidana Isuwa, ‘Bawanka Yaƙub ya ce, na yi zama tare da Laban na kuwa kasance a can sai yanzu.
english: He commanded them, saying, “This is what you shall tell my lord, Esau: ‘This is what your servant, Jacob, says. I have lived as a foreigner with Laban, and stayed until now.

hausa: Duba! Ubangiji yana zuwa daga wurin zamansa; zai sauko yă taka maɗaukakan wuraren duniya.
english: For behold, Yahweh comes out of his place, and will come down and tread on the high places of the earth.

hausa: In mai shi yana so yă fanshi dabbar, dole yă ƙara kashi ɗaya bisa biyar na darajarta.
english: But if he will indeed redeem it, then he shall add the fifth part of it to its valuation.

hausa: Masu miƙa kyautar azurfa, ko tagulla suka kawo su a matsayin kyautai ga Ubangiji, kuma kowane mutumin da yake da itacen ƙirya don kowane sashin aikin, ya kawo.
english: Everyone who offered an offering of silver and bronze brought Yahweh’s offering; and everyone with whom was found acacia wood for any work of the service, brought it.

hausa: Isra’ilawa suka yi dukan aikin nan yadda Ubangiji ya umarci Musa.
english: According to all that Yahweh commanded Moses, so the children of Israel did all the work.

hausa: Sai Ubangiji ya ce masa, “Sa hannunka ka ɗauke shi ta wutsiya.” Sai Musa ya miƙa hannu, ya kama macijin, macijin kuwa ya dawo sanda a hannunsa.
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “Stretch out your hand, and take it by the tail.” He stretched out his hand, and took hold of it, and it became a rod in his hand.

hausa: Manta-uwa sun ba da ƙanshinsu, a bakin ƙofa kuwa akwai kowane abinci mai daɗi, sabo da tsoho, da na ajiye dominka, ƙaunataccena.
english: The mandrakes produce fragrance. At our doors are all kinds of precious fruits, new and old, which I have stored up for you, my beloved.

hausa: Sarki ya ce, “Ina yake?” Ziba ya ce, “Yana a gidan Makir ɗan Ammiyel a Lo Debar.”
english: The king said to him, “Where is he?” Ziba said to the king, “Behold, he is in the house of Machir the son of Ammiel, in Lo Debar.”

hausa: “Ni ne makiyayi mai kyau. Makiyayi mai kyau yakan ba da ransa domin tumakin.
english: “I am the good shepherd. The good shepherd lays down his life for the sheep.

hausa: Hilkiya babban firist ya ce wa Shafan magatakarda, “Na sami Littafin Doka a haikalin Ubangiji.” Sai ya ba wa Shafan, shi kuma ya karanta.
english: Hilkiah the high priest said to Shaphan the scribe, “I have found the book of the law in Yahweh’s house.” Hilkiah delivered the book to Shaphan, and he read it.

hausa: (Me ake nufin da “ya hau,” in ba cewa dā ya sauka can ƙarƙashin ƙasa ba?
english: Now this, “He ascended”, what is it but that he also first descended into the lower parts of the earth?

hausa: “Ya amsa ya ce, ‘A’a, don kada garin tuttumɓuke ciyayi, ku cire har da alkamar.
english: “But he said, ‘No, lest perhaps while you gather up the darnel weeds, you root up the wheat with them.

hausa: Gama yanzu tabbatacce muna da rai, da yake kuna nan tsaye daram a cikin Ubangiji.
english: For now we live, if you stand fast in the Lord.

hausa: “Kana cewa game da wannan birni, ‘Ta wurin takobi, yunwa da annoba za a ba da shi ga sarkin Babilon’; amma ga abin da Ubangiji, Allah na Isra’ila yana cewa
english: Now therefore Yahweh, the God of Israel, says concerning this city, about which you say, “It is given into the hand of the king of Babylon by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence:”

hausa: “Akwai waɗanda sukan zagi mahaifinsu ba sa kuma sa wa mahaifiyarsu albarka;
english: There is a generation that curses their father, and doesn’t bless their mother.

hausa: Amma Asahel ya ƙi yă bar fafararsa; saboda haka Abner ya soki Asahel da māshinsa a ciki; har māshin ya fita ta bayansa. Nan take ya fāɗi, ya mutu. Kowa da ya zo wurin da Asahel ya fāɗi, ya mutu, sai yă tsaya.
english: However, he refused to turn away. Therefore Abner with the back end of the spear struck him in the body, so that the spear came out behind him; and he fell down there and died in the same place. As many as came to the place where Asahel fell down and died stood still.

hausa: Sarki ya ba da taimako daga mallakarsa domin hadayun ƙonawa, safe da yamma da kuma don hadayun ƙonawa a Asabbatai, Sabon Wata da kuma ƙayyadaddun bukukkuwa kamar yadda yake a rubuce a cikin Dokar Ubangiji.
english: He also appointed the king’s portion of his possessions for the burnt offerings: for the morning and evening burnt offerings, and the burnt offerings for the Sabbaths, for the new moons, and for the set feasts, as it is written in Yahweh’s law.

hausa: A ƙarshe, ’yan’uwa, ku yi mana addu’a domin saƙon Ubangiji yă yi saurin bazuwa a kuma girmama shi, kamar yadda yake a wurinku.
english: Finally, brothers, pray for us, that the word of the Lord may spread rapidly and be glorified, even as also with you,

hausa: “Ya sarakuna, ku ji! Ku saurara, ku masu mulki! Zan yi waƙa ga Ubangiji, zan yi waƙa; zan yi kaɗe-kaɗe ga Ubangiji, Allah na Isra’ila.
english: “Hear, you kings! Give ear, you princes! I, even I, will sing to Yahweh. I will sing praise to Yahweh, the God of Israel.

hausa: Wata rana da yamma, Dawuda ya tashi daga gadonsa, ya zaga kewaye a rufin fadansa. Daga rufin ya ga wata mace tana wanka. Matar kyakkyawa ce ƙwarai.
english: At evening, David arose from his bed and walked on the roof of the king’s house. From the roof, he saw a woman bathing, and the woman was very beautiful to look at.

hausa: “ ‘In mutum ya auri ’yar’uwarsa, ko ’yar mahaifinsa, ko kuwa ta mahaifiyarsa, suka kuma yi jima’i, abin kunya ne. Dole a raba su a idanun mutanensu. Ya ƙasƙantar da ’yar’uwarsa kuma za a nemi hakki daga gare shi.
english: “‘If a man takes his sister—his father’s daughter, or his mother’s daughter—and sees her nakedness, and she sees his nakedness, it is a shameful thing. They shall be cut off in the sight of the children of their people. He has uncovered his sister’s nakedness. He shall bear his iniquity.

hausa: na iyalin Sallu, Kallai; na iyalin Amok, Eber;
english: of Sallai, Kallai; of Amok, Eber;

hausa: A kashegarin Bikin, a wannan rana, sai suka ci daga cikin amfanin ƙasar, burodi marar yisti da hatsin da aka gasa.
english: They ate unleavened cakes and parched grain of the produce of the land on the next day after the Passover, in the same day.

hausa: Asna, Meyunawa, Nefussiyawa,
english: the children of Asnah, the children of Meunim, the children of Nephisim,

hausa: Wa zai iya hawan tudun Ubangiji? Wa zai iya tsaya a wurinsa mai tsarki?
english: Who may ascend to Yahweh’s hill? Who may stand in his holy place?

hausa: Sa’ad da ya zo daga Urushalima don yă taryi sarki, sai sarki ya ce masa, “Me ya sa ba ka tafi tare da ni ba Mefiboshet?”
english: When he had come to Jerusalem to meet the king, the king said to him, “Why didn’t you go with me, Mephibosheth?”

hausa: Sai suka tambaye shi, “Wace abin banmamaki ce za ka yi don mu gani mu kuwa gaskata ka? Me za ka yi?
english: They said therefore to him, “What then do you do for a sign, that we may see and believe you? What work do you do?

hausa: Ku gaggai da juna da sumba mai tsarki.
english: Greet one another with a holy kiss.

hausa: Bayan Hiridus ya mutu, sai mala’ikan Ubangiji ya bayyana ga Yusuf a mafarki a Masar,
english: But when Herod was dead, behold, an angel of the Lord appeared in a dream to Joseph in Egypt, saying,

hausa: Ka yi gudu ka tarye ta ka tambaye ta, ‘Lafiyarki? Mijinki yana nan lafiya? Yaronki yana nan lafiya?’ ” Ta amsa ta ce, “Kome lafiya yake.”
english: Please run now to meet her, and ask her, ‘Is it well with you? Is it well with your husband? Is it well with your child?’” She answered, “It is well.”

hausa: ba za a haɗa ka tare da su a jana’iza ba, gama ka hallaka ƙasarka ka kuma kashe mutanenka. Ba za a ƙara ambaci zuriyarka masu aikata mugunta ba.
english: You will not join them in burial, because you have destroyed your land. You have killed your people. The offspring of evildoers will not be named forever.

hausa: da ta zo muku. Ko’ina a duniya wannan bishara tana yi ta haihuwa tana kuma girma, kamar yadda take yi a cikinku tun daga ranar da kuka ji ta kuka kuma fahimci alherin Allah cikin dukan gaskiyarta.
english: which has come to you, even as it is in all the world and is bearing fruit and growing, as it does in you also, since the day you heard and knew the grace of God in truth,

hausa: Sai Absalom ya je wurin sarki ya ce, “Bawanka ya sa masu askin tumaki sun zo. Ko sarki da fadawansa za su zo tare da ni?”
english: Absalom came to the king and said, “See now, your servant has sheep shearers. Please let the king and his servants go with your servant.”

hausa: Wannan ne ƙofar Ubangiji inda adalai za su shiga.
english: This is the gate of Yahweh; the righteous will enter into it.

hausa: Suka shirya kyautansu domin isowar Yusuf da rana, gama sun ji cewa zai ci abinci a nan.
english: They prepared the present for Joseph’s coming at noon, for they heard that they should eat bread there.

hausa: yayinda muke sauraron begenmu mai albarka bayyanuwar ɗaukakar Allahnmu mai girma da kuma Mai Cetonmu, Yesu Kiristi,
english: looking for the blessed hope and appearing of the glory of our great God and Savior, Jesus Christ,

hausa: Amma ya yi mūsu ya ce, “Ban san abin da kike magana ba, balle ma in fahimce ki.” Sai ya fita zuwa zaure.
english: But he denied it, saying, “I neither know nor understand what you are saying.” He went out on the porch, and the rooster crowed.

hausa: ‘Ga abin da Ubangiji, Allah na Isra’ila, yake cewa ina shirin juya kayan yaƙin da suke a hannuwanka a kanka, waɗanda kake amfani don ka yaƙi sarki Babilon da kuma Babiloniyawa waɗanda suka kewaye katangar birnin, zan kuwa tsiba kayan yaƙinka a tsakiyar birnin nan.
english: ‘Yahweh, the God of Israel says, “Behold, I will turn back the weapons of war that are in your hands, with which you fight against the king of Babylon, and against the Chaldeans who besiege you outside the walls; and I will gather them into the middle of this city.

hausa: Na kuma faɗa musu game da yadda alherin Allahna yake tare da ni da kuma abin da sarki ya faɗa mini. Suka amsa, suka ce, “Mu tashi, mu kama gini.” Sai suka fara wannan aiki mai kyau.
english: I told them about the hand of my God which was good on me, and also about the king’s words that he had spoken to me. They said, “Let’s rise up and build.” So they strengthened their hands for the good work.

hausa: To, gidan Yusuf suka auka wa Betel, Ubangiji kuwa yana tare da su.
english: The house of Joseph also went up against Bethel, and Yahweh was with them.

hausa: Nan kusa kuwa akwai tulunan ruwa shida na dutse a ajiye, irin da Yahudawa suke amfani da su don tsarkakewa bisa ga al’ada, kowace kan ci gallon kusan ashirin zuwa talatin.
english: Now there were six water pots of stone set there after the Jews’ way of purifying, containing two or three metretes apiece.

hausa: A rana ta takwas, Gamaliyel ɗan Fedazur, shugaban mutanen Manasse, ya kawo hadayarsa.
english: On the eighth day Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur, prince of the children of Manasseh,

hausa: Mutane daga Taya waɗanda suke zama a Urushalima suna shigar da kifi da kaya iri-iri na ’yan kasuwa suna kuma sayar da su a Urushalima a ranar Asabbaci wa mutanen Yahuda.
english: Some men of Tyre also lived there, who brought in fish and all kinds of wares, and sold on the Sabbath to the children of Judah, and in Jerusalem.

hausa: Manzannin suka taru kewaye da Yesu, suka ba shi rahoton duk abin da suka yi, da kuma suka koyar.
english: The apostles gathered themselves together to Jesus, and they told him all things, whatever they had done, and whatever they had taught.

hausa: Ya aika daga sama ya kuwa cece ni, yana tsawata wa waɗanda suke fafarata da zafi; Sela Allah yakan aika da ƙaunarsa da amincinsa.
english: He will send from heaven, and save me, he rebukes the one who is pursuing me. Selah. God will send out his loving kindness and his truth.

hausa: Sa’ad da Nuhu ya farka daga buguwarsa ya kuma gane abin da ƙarami ɗansa ya yi,
english: Noah awoke from his wine, and knew what his youngest son had done to him.

hausa: Ya kuma ce, “Da me za mu kwatanta mulkin Allah, ko kuwa da wane misali za mu bayyana shi?
english: He said, “How will we liken God’s Kingdom? Or with what parable will we illustrate it?

hausa: mutanen Simeyon, jarumawa shiryayyu don yaƙi, su 7,100;
english: Of the children of Simeon, mighty men of valor for the war: seven thousand one hundred.

hausa: Saboda haka ya ba da umarni a yi musu baftisma cikin sunan Yesu Kiristi. Sa’an nan suka roƙi Bitrus yă zauna da su na ’yan kwanaki.
english: He commanded them to be baptized in the name of Jesus Christ. Then they asked him to stay some days.

hausa: Amma Yehowash sarkin Isra’ila ya mai da martani wa Amaziya sarkin Yahuda ya ce, “Wata ’yar ƙaya a kurmin Lebanon ta aika da saƙo wurin itacen al’ul a Lebanon cewa, ‘Ka ba ɗana ’yarka aure.’ Amma wani naman jeji ya zo ya tattake ƙayar.
english: Jehoash the king of Israel sent to Amaziah king of Judah, saying, “The thistle that was in Lebanon sent to the cedar that was in Lebanon, saying, ‘Give your daughter to my son as wife.’ Then a wild animal that was in Lebanon passed by, and trampled down the thistle.

hausa: Ka kasance marar laifi cikin dukan hanyoyinka daga ranar da aka halicce ka sai da aka sami mugunta a cikinka.
english: You were perfect in your ways from the day that you were created, until unrighteousness was found in you.

hausa: A kan wane hali ne aka lissafta masa? Bayan da aka yi masa kaciya ne, ko kuwa kafin kaciyar? Ba bayan an yi masa kaciya ba ne, amma kafin a yi masa kaciya!
english: How then was it counted? When he was in circumcision, or in uncircumcision? Not in circumcision, but in uncircumcision.

hausa: “In aka iske ɓarawo yana cikin ƙoƙarin shiga yă yi sata, aka buge shi har ya mutu, to, ba za a nemi alhakin jininsa daga wurin kowa ba;
english: If the thief is found breaking in, and is struck so that he dies, there shall be no guilt of bloodshed for him.

hausa: Sa’an nan Sarki Dawuda ya ce wa dukan taron, “Ɗana Solomon, wanda Allah ya zaɓa, matashi ne, kuma bai gogu ba. Aikin yana da yawa, domin wannan ƙasaitaccen ginin ba na mutum ba ne, na Ubangiji Allah ne.
english: David the king said to all the assembly, “Solomon my son, whom alone God has chosen, is yet young and tender, and the work is great; for the palace is not for man, but for Yahweh God.

hausa: Daga zuriyar Ruben ɗan fari na Isra’ila. Aka rubuta sunayen dukan maza ɗaya-ɗaya da suka kai shekara ashirin ko fiye da suka isa shiga soja, bisa ga iyalansu da kabilarsu da take a rubuce.
english: The children of Reuben, Israel’s firstborn, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, one by one, every male from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war:

hausa: Bayansa, Abdon ɗan Hillel, daga Firaton, ya shugabanci Isra’ila.
english: After him, Abdon the son of Hillel the Pirathonite judged Israel.

hausa: Maganar Ubangiji ta zo mini cewa, “Me ka gani, Irmiya?” Sai na amsa na ce, “Na ga reshen itacen almon.”
english: Moreover Yahweh’s word came to me, saying, “Jeremiah, what do you see?” I said, “I see a branch of an almond tree.”

hausa: Biye da su, Liyatu da ’ya’yanta suka zo suka rusuna. A ƙarshe duka, sai Yusuf da Rahila suka zo, su ma suka rusuna.
english: Leah also and her children came near, and bowed themselves. After them, Joseph came near with Rachel, and they bowed themselves.

hausa: Sukan yi sansani a ƙasar sun lalatar da hatsi har zuwa Gaza kuma ba sa barin wani abu mai rai wa Isra’ila, ko tumaki ko shanu ko jakuna.
english: They encamped against them, and destroyed the increase of the earth, until you come to Gaza. They left no sustenance in Israel, and no sheep, ox, or donkey.

hausa: Sa’an nan Ruhu ya ɗaga ni sama ya kawo ni cikin fili na can ciki, ɗaukakar Ubangiji kuwa ta cika haikalin.
english: The Spirit took me up and brought me into the inner court; and behold, Yahweh’s glory filled the house.

hausa: Musa kuwa ya husata da shugabannin sojojin da suke shugabannin dubbai da shugabannin ɗari-ɗarin da suka dawo daga yaƙi.
english: Moses was angry with the officers of the army, the captains of thousands and the captains of hundreds, who came from the service of the war.

hausa: Ka kula kada ka juya ga mugunta, abin da ka fi so fiye da wahala.
english: Take heed, don’t regard iniquity; for you have chosen this rather than affliction.

hausa: Da sassafe a ranar farko ta mako, tun da sauran duhu, Maryamu Magdalin ta tafi kabarin ta kuwa tarar an kawar da dutsen daga bakin kabarin.
english: Now on the first day of the week, Mary Magdalene went early, while it was still dark, to the tomb, and saw that the stone had been taken away from the tomb.

hausa: Ina ta roƙo cewa Allah na Ubangijinmu Yesu Kiristi, Uba Maɗaukaki, yă ba ku Ruhun hikima da na ganewa, domin ku san shi da kyau.
english: that the God of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of glory, may give to you a spirit of wisdom and revelation in the knowledge of him,

hausa: Maganar Ubangiji ta zo gare ni cewa,
english: Moreover Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

hausa: Ya mutanena, an ragargaje ku a masussuka, na faɗa muku abin da na ji daga Ubangiji Maɗaukaki, daga Allah na Isra’ila.
english: You are my threshing, and the grain of my floor!” That which I have heard from Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel, I have declared to you.

hausa: To, fa, ga abin da Ubangiji yana cewa, shi da ya halicce ka, ya Yaƙub, shi da ya siffanta ka, ya Isra’ila, “Kada ka ji tsoro, gama na fanshe ka; na kira ka da suna; kai nawa ne.
english: But now Yahweh who created you, Jacob, and he who formed you, Israel, says: “Don’t be afraid, for I have redeemed you. I have called you by your name. You are mine.

hausa: Akwai wani mutum mai suna Yusuf, ɗan Majalisa, wanda shi nagari ne, mai adalci,
english: Behold, there was a man named Joseph, who was a member of the council, a good and righteous man

hausa: Saboda haka Isra’ilawa suka yi duk ko mene ne da Ubangiji ya umarci Musa. Ta haka ne suka yi sansani a ƙarƙashin ƙa’idarsu kowanne tare da kabilarsa da danginsa.
english: Thus the children of Israel did. According to all that Yahweh commanded Moses, so they encamped by their standards, and so they set out, everyone by their families, according to their fathers’ houses.

hausa: da Serahiya, da Azariya, da Irmiya,
english: Seraiah, Azariah, Jeremiah,

hausa: Ya ce mata, “Tashi; mu tafi.” Amma ba amsa. Sai ya sa ta a kan jakinsa ya kama hanyar gida.
english: He said to her, “Get up, and let’s get going!” but no one answered. Then he took her up on the donkey; and the man rose up, and went to his place.

hausa: “Na zo ne domin in kawo wuta a duniya. Ina so da ta riga ta ƙunu!
english: “I came to throw fire on the earth. I wish it were already kindled.

hausa: Ana nan, sai Nahash sarkin Ammonawa ya mutu, sai ɗansa ya gāje shi a matsayin sarki.
english: After this, Nahash the king of the children of Ammon died, and his son reigned in his place.

hausa: Na tambayi mala’ikan da yake mini magana, na ce, “Mene ne waɗannan?” Ya amsa mini ya ce, “Waɗannan su ne ƙahonin da suka watsar da Yahuda, Isra’ila da kuma Urushalima.”
english: I asked the angel who talked with me, “What are these?” He answered me, “These are the horns which have scattered Judah, Israel, and Jerusalem.”

hausa: Da sarki ya ji kalmomin Doka, sai ya yage rigunansa.
english: When the king had heard the words of the law, he tore his clothes.

hausa: Ku kuma ce wa Amasa, ‘Ashe, kai ba jikina ba ne da jinina? Allah yă hukunta ni, da hukunci mai tsanani, idan daga yanzu ba ka zama komandan sojojina a maimakon Yowab ba.’ ”
english: Say to Amasa, ‘Aren’t you my bone and my flesh? God do so to me, and more also, if you aren’t captain of the army before me continually instead of Joab.’”

hausa: A wata na bakwai na wannan shekara, annabi Hananiya ya mutu.
english: So Hananiah the prophet died the same year in the seventh month.

hausa: ’Ya’yan Nuhu maza su ne, Shem, Ham da Yafet.
english: Noah, Shem, Ham, and Japheth.

hausa: “Ku yi farin ciki a wannan rana, ku kuma yi tsalle don murna, saboda ladarku yana da yawa a sama. Gama haka kakanninsu suka yi wa annabawa.
english: Rejoice in that day and leap for joy, for behold, your reward is great in heaven, for their fathers did the same thing to the prophets.

hausa: Wanda, ko da yake cikin ainihin surar Allah yake, bai mai da daidaitakansa nan da Allah wani abin riƙewa kam-kam ba,
english: who, existing in the form of God, didn’t consider equality with God a thing to be grasped,

hausa: Ku kiyaye watan Abib, ku kuma yi shagalin Bikin Ƙetarewar Ubangiji Allahnku, domin a watan Abib ne ya fitar da ku daga Masar da dad dare.
english: Observe the month of Abib, and keep the Passover to Yahweh your God; for in the month of Abib Yahweh your God brought you out of Egypt by night.

hausa: “Ka yi tabanakul da labule goma na lilin mai laushi a naɗe shi biyu, a saƙa labulen da ulu mai ruwan shuɗi, da ulu mai ruwan shunayya, da kuma ulu mai ruwan ja. Waɗannan labule za a yi musu zānen siffofin kerubobi, aikin gwani.
english: “Moreover you shall make the tabernacle with ten curtains of fine twined linen, and blue, and purple, and scarlet, with cherubim. You shall make them with the work of a skillful workman.

hausa: Amma Allah ya nuna mana ƙaunarsa a wannan. Tun muna masu zunubi tukuna, Kiristi ya mutu dominmu.
english: But God commends his own love toward us, in that while we were yet sinners, Christ died for us.

hausa: Sai dukan mutane suka amsa, suka ce, “Bari alhakin jininsa yă zauna a kanmu da ’ya’yanmu!”
english: All the people answered, “May his blood be on us and on our children!”

hausa: Da mutanen Dawuda suka isa wurin Nabal, suka ba wa Nabal wannan saƙo a sunan Dawuda, sai suka jira.
english: When David’s young men came, they spoke to Nabal all those words in the name of David, and waited.

hausa: To, sa’ad da dukan sarakunan yammancin Urdun suka ji waɗannan abubuwa, sai waɗanda suke kan tudu, da na cikin kwari a yammanci, da dukan waɗanda suke gefen Bahar Rum har zuwa Lebanon (sarakunan Hittiyawa, Amoriyawa, Kan’aniyawa, Ferizziyawa, Hiwiyawa da Yebusiyawa)
english: When all the kings who were beyond the Jordan, in the hill country, and in the lowland, and on all the shore of the great sea in front of Lebanon, the Hittite, the Amorite, the Canaanite, the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite, heard of it

hausa: To, in za a iya yin wa yaro kaciya a ranar Asabbaci don kada a karya dokar Musa, don me kuke fushi da ni saboda na warkar da mutum a ranar Asabbaci?
english: If a boy receives circumcision on the Sabbath, that the law of Moses may not be broken, are you angry with me because I made a man completely healthy on the Sabbath?

hausa: Za su ratsa cikin tekun wahala; zan kwantar da raƙuman teku dukan zurfafan Nilu kuma za su bushe. Za a ƙasƙantar da Assuriya, sandar sarautar Masar kuma za tă rabu da ita.
english: He will pass through the sea of affliction, and will strike the waves in the sea, and all the depths of the Nile will dry up; and the pride of Assyria will be brought down, and the scepter of Egypt will depart.

hausa: “Dab da yankin firistoci, Lawiyawa za su sami rabo mai tsawon kamu 25,000, fāɗin kuma kamu 10,000. Tsawonsa gaba ɗaya zai zama kamu 25,000, fāɗinsa kuma kamu 10,000.
english: “Alongside the border of the priests, the Levites shall have twenty-five thousand cubits in length and ten thousand in width. All the length shall be twenty-five thousand, and the width ten thousand.

hausa: Bayan an fitar da taron waje, sai ya shiga ciki ya kama yarinyar a hannu, ta kuwa tashi.
english: But when the crowd was sent out, he entered in, took her by the hand, and the girl arose.

hausa: Shi Dutse ne, ayyukansa cikakku ne, dukan hanyoyinsa kuwa masu adalci ne. Allah mai aminci, wanda ba ya yin rashi gaskiya, shi mai adalci ne, nagari ne kuma.
english: The Rock: his work is perfect, for all his ways are just. A God of faithfulness who does no wrong, just and right is he.

hausa: Sai Sama’ila ya ce wa mutane, “Ku zo mu tafi Gilgal, a can za a yi wankan sarauta.”
english: Then Samuel said to the people, “Come! Let’s go to Gilgal, and renew the kingdom there.”

hausa: Sai ya ce musu, “An yi Asabbaci saboda mutum ne, ba mutum saboda Asabbaci ba.
english: He said to them, “The Sabbath was made for man, not man for the Sabbath.

hausa: Ubangiji ya ce wa Musa,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

hausa: Sa’ad da Musa ya gama karanta waɗannan kalmomi ga dukan Isra’ila,
english: Moses finished reciting all these words to all Israel.

hausa: “Kada ku miƙa mini hadayar jini tare da wani abu mai yisti. “Ba za a bar kitsen bikin hadayata yă kwana ba.
english: “You shall not offer the blood of my sacrifice with leavened bread. The fat of my feast shall not remain all night until the morning.

hausa: Sa’an nan ka sa tukunyan nan da babu kome a kan garwashi sai ta yi zafi har darmarta ta yi ja wur domin dattinta ya narke tsatsarta kuma ta ƙone.
english: Then set it empty on its coals, that it may be hot, and its bronze may burn, and that its filthiness may be molten in it, that its rust may be consumed.

hausa: Wani mutumin da ake kira Barabbas, yana a kurkuku, tare da waɗansu ’yan tawaye da suka yi kisankai a lokacin wani hargitsi.
english: There was one called Barabbas, bound with his fellow insurgents, men who in the insurrection had committed murder.

hausa: “Gare ka zan ba da ƙasar Kan’ana a matsayin rabo za ka yi gādo.”
english: saying, “To you I will give the land of Canaan, the lot of your inheritance,”

hausa: Saboda haka Sarki Dawuda ya umarta aka kawo shi daga gidan Makir ɗan Ammiyel, daga Lo Debar.
english: Then King David sent and brought him out of the house of Machir the son of Ammiel, from Lo Debar.

hausa: Sai ya ce mini, “Ka yi wa waɗannan ƙasusuwa annabci ka ce musu, ‘Busassun ƙasusuwa, ku ji maganar Ubangiji!
english: Again he said to me, “Prophesy over these bones, and tell them, ‘You dry bones, hear Yahweh’s word.

hausa: Sai maganar Ubangiji ta zo wa Irmiya cewa,
english: Yahweh’s word came to Jeremiah, saying,

hausa: don kada kowa yă saya ko yă sayar, sai dai yana da alamar, wadda take sunan dabbar ko kuma lambar sunanta.
english: and that no one would be able to buy or to sell unless he has that mark, which is the name of the beast or the number of his name.

hausa: “Kada ka baza ƙarairayi game da bawa ga maigidansa, in ba haka ba, zai la’ance ka, za ka kuwa sha wahala a kan haka.
english: “Don’t slander a servant to his master, lest he curse you, and you be held guilty.

hausa: A manyan ruwaye hatsin Shihor suka iso; girbin Nilu ne kuɗin shiga na Taya ta kuma zama kasuwar al’ummai.
english: On great waters, the seed of the Shihor, the harvest of the Nile, was her revenue. She was the market of nations.

hausa: Iblis ya kai shi can kan wani wuri mai tsawo, ya nunnuna masa a ƙyiftawar ido dukan mulkokin duniya.
english: The devil, leading him up on a high mountain, showed him all the kingdoms of the world in a moment of time.

hausa: Musa ya yi yadda Ubangiji ya umarce shi. Ya ɗauki Yoshuwa, ya sa ya tsaya a gaban Eleyazar firist, da kuma gaban dukan jama’a.
english: Moses did as Yahweh commanded him. He took Joshua, and set him before Eleazar the priest and before all the congregation.

hausa: Sa’an nan Dawuda ya ce wa Yowab da dukan mutanen da suke tare da shi, “Ku yayyage rigunarku, ku sa tsummoki, ku yi tafiya kuna kuka a gaban Abner.” Sarki Dawuda kansa ya bi masu ɗauke da gawar daga baya.
english: David said to Joab and to all the people who were with him, “Tear your clothes, and clothe yourselves with sackcloth, and mourn in front of Abner.” King David followed the bier.

hausa: Ɗan’uwan Mika shi ne, Isshiya; daga ’ya’yan Isshiya maza, Zakariya.
english: The brother of Micah: Isshiah; of the sons of Isshiah, Zechariah.

hausa: Saboda haka Yonatan ya yi yarjejjeniya da gidan Dawuda cewa Ubangiji yă kawo dukan maƙiyin Dawuda ga mutuwa.
english: So Jonathan made a covenant with David’s house, saying, “Yahweh will require it at the hand of David’s enemies.”

hausa: Ƙa’idodinka suna nan daram; tsarki ya yi wa gidanka ado har kwanaki marar ƙarewa, ya Ubangiji.
english: Your statutes stand firm. Holiness adorns your house, Yahweh, forever more.

hausa: Sunanka, ya Ubangiji, dawwammame ne har abada, sanin da aka yi maka, ya Ubangiji, yana nan cikin dukan zamanai.
english: Your name, Yahweh, endures forever; your renown, Yahweh, throughout all generations.

hausa: A wannan dare Ubangiji ya ce masa, “Ka ɗauki bijimi na biyu daga garken mahaifinka, wannan mai shekara bakwai. Ka rushe bagaden mahaifinka na Ba’al ka sare ginshiƙin Ashera kusa da ita.
english: That same night, Yahweh said to him, “Take your father’s bull, even the second bull seven years old, and throw down the altar of Baal that your father has, and cut down the Asherah that is by it.

hausa: Sa’an nan fushina a kanki zai huce fushin kishina kuma ya kwanta; zan huce ba kuwa zan ƙara yin fushi ba.
english: So I will cause my wrath toward you to rest, and my jealousy will depart from you. I will be quiet, and will not be angry any more.

hausa: “Saboda dukan muguntarsu a Gilgal, na ƙi su a can. Saboda ayyukansu na zunubi, zan kore su daga gidana. Ba zan ƙara ƙaunace su ba; dukan shugabanninsu ’yan tawaye ne.
english: “All their wickedness is in Gilgal; for there I hated them. Because of the wickedness of their deeds, I will drive them out of my house! I will love them no more. All their princes are rebels.

hausa: Mafi hikima cikin ’yan matanta suka amsa mata, tabbatacce, ta ci gaba ta ce wa kanta,
english: Her wise ladies answered her, Yes, she returned answer to herself,

hausa: “Sa’ad da mugun ruhu ya fita daga mutum, yakan bi wuraren da ba ruwa yana neman hutu, ba ya kuwa samu.
english: “When an unclean spirit has gone out of a man, he passes through waterless places seeking rest, and doesn’t find it.

hausa: Saboda haka suka zo wurin Musa da Eleyazar da kuma shugabannin jama’a, suka ce,
english: Then the children of Gad and the children of Reuben came and spoke to Moses, and to Eleazar the priest, and to the princes of the congregation, saying,

hausa: Ka kiyaye ni yadda ake kiyaye ido; ka ɓoye ni cikin inuwar fikafikanka
english: Keep me as the apple of your eye. Hide me under the shadow of your wings,

hausa: Sa’an nan na furta zunubina a gare ka ban kuwa ɓoye laifina ba. Na ce, “Zan furta laifofina ga Ubangiji.” Ka kuwa gafarta laifin zunubina. Sela
english: I acknowledged my sin to you. I didn’t hide my iniquity. I said, I will confess my transgressions to Yahweh, and you forgave the iniquity of my sin. Selah.

hausa: Yunwa ta kama shi ya kuwa so yă ci wani abu, yayinda ake shirya abinci, sai wahayi ya zo masa.
english: He became hungry and desired to eat, but while they were preparing, he fell into a trance.

hausa: Yana a duniya, kuma ko da yake an yi duniya ta wurinsa ne, duniya ba tă gane shi ba.
english: He was in the world, and the world was made through him, and the world didn’t recognize him.

hausa: Mutane suna ci, suna sha, suna aurayya, ana kuma ba da su ga aure, har ranar da Nuhu ya shiga jirgin. Sa’an nan ambaliyar ruwan ya sauka, ya hallaka su duka.
english: They ate, they drank, they married, and they were given in marriage until the day that Noah entered into the ship, and the flood came and destroyed them all.

hausa: Sai Dawuda ya nemi nufin Ubangiji, ya ce, “In tafi in fāɗa wa Filistiyawa da yaƙi?” Ubangiji kuwa ya ce masa, “Jeka ka yi yaƙi da Filistiyawa, ka ceci Keyila.”
english: Therefore David inquired of Yahweh, saying, “Shall I go and strike these Philistines?” Yahweh said to David, “Go strike the Philistines, and save Keilah.”

hausa: Kada ku ƙaunaci duniya, ko wani abin da yake cikinta. In wani yana ƙaunar duniya, ƙaunar Uba ba ta cikinsa.
english: Don’t love the world or the things that are in the world. If anyone loves the world, the Father’s love isn’t in him.

hausa: “In ƙasata tana kuka da ni kunyoyinta duk sun cika da hawaye,
english: If my land cries out against me, and its furrows weep together;

hausa: Dukan sojojin da suke tare da shi suka nufi birnin, da suka kai kuwa sai suka kafa sansaninsu a arewancin Ai. Tsakaninsu da Ai akwai kwari.
english: All the people, even the men of war who were with him, went up and came near, and came before the city and encamped on the north side of Ai. Now there was a valley between him and Ai.

hausa: Dukan kwanakin ransa mugu yana shan wahala, wahala kaɗai zai yi ta sha.
english: the wicked man writhes in pain all his days, even the number of years that are laid up for the oppressor.

hausa: Ba sauran zamana a duniya, amma waɗannan a duniya suke, ni kuwa ina zuwa wurinka. Ya Uba Mai Tsarki, ka kiyaye su ta wurin ikon sunanka, sunan da ka ba ni, don su zama ɗaya kamar yadda muke ɗaya.
english: I am no more in the world, but these are in the world, and I am coming to you. Holy Father, keep them through your name which you have given me, that they may be one, even as we are.

hausa: In mutum ya auri mace, bayan ya kwana da ita, sa’an nan ya ƙi ta
english: If any man takes a wife, and goes in to her, hates her,

hausa: Ko ka yi magana da duniya, za tă kuma koya maka, ko kuma ka bar kifin teku su sanar da kai.
english: Or speak to the earth, and it will teach you. The fish of the sea will declare to you.

hausa: Gama ya cece ni daga dukan wahalolina, idanuna kuma sun ga an yi nasara a kan maƙiyana.
english: For he has delivered me out of all trouble. My eye has seen triumph over my enemies.

hausa: Ka cece ni daga abokan gābana, ya Ubangiji, gama na ɓoye kaina a gare ka.
english: Deliver me, Yahweh, from my enemies. I flee to you to hide me.

hausa: Saboda haka, ba mu fid da zuciya ba. Ko da yake a waje, jikinmu mai mutuwa yana lalacewa, amma can ciki, ana sabunta mu kowace rana.
english: Therefore we don’t faint, but though our outward person is decaying, yet our inward person is renewed day by day.

hausa: Saboda haka dukan mutane Isra’ilawa suka taru suka kuma haɗu kamar mutum guda don su fāɗa wa birnin da yaƙi.
english: So all the men of Israel were gathered against the city, knit together as one man.

hausa: Ɗumbun mutanen da suka yi barci cikin turɓayar duniya za su farka, waɗansu zuwa ga rai madawwami, waɗansu zuwa ga madawwamiyar kunya da kuma madawwamin ƙasƙanci.
english: Many of those who sleep in the dust of the earth will awake, some to everlasting life, and some to shame and everlasting contempt.

hausa: Sa’ad da Sarki Hezekiya ya ji haka, sai ya kyakkece rigunansa ya kuma sanya tsummoki ya tafi ya shiga haikalin Ubangiji.
english: When King Hezekiah heard it, he tore his clothes, covered himself with sackcloth, and went into Yahweh’s house.

hausa: Zedekiya yana da shekara ashirin da ɗaya sa’ad da ya zama sarki, ya kuma yi mulki a Urushalima shekara goma sha ɗaya.
english: Zedekiah was twenty-one years old when he began to reign, and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem.

hausa: Domin zan karkashe adalai da kuma mugaye, ba zan rufe takobina a kan kowa daga kudu zuwa arewa ba.
english: Seeing then that I will cut off from you the righteous and the wicked, therefore my sword will go out of its sheath against all flesh from the south to the north.

hausa: Ba na so in gan ku yanzu in wuce kawai, ina fata zan yi ’yan kwanaki tare da ku, in Ubangiji ya yarda.
english: For I do not wish to see you now in passing, but I hope to stay a while with you, if the Lord permits.

hausa: Ya kasance da garkunan tumaki da na shanu da bayi masu yawa, har Filistiyawa suka yi ƙyashinsa.
english: He had possessions of flocks, possessions of herds, and a great household. The Philistines envied him.

hausa: Ina jin daɗi ƙwarai a cikin Ubangiji; raina yana farin ciki a cikin Allahna. Gama ya suturce ni da rigunan ceto ya yi mini ado da rigar adalci, yadda ango yakan yi wa kansa ado kamar firist kamar kuma yadda amarya takan sha ado da duwatsunta masu daraja.
english: I will greatly rejoice in Yahweh! My soul will be joyful in my God, for he has clothed me with the garments of salvation. He has covered me with the robe of righteousness, as a bridegroom decks himself with a garland and as a bride adorns herself with her jewels.

hausa: Zan kafa mulkinsa har abada in bai kauce ga kiyaye umarnaina da dokokina ba, yadda ake yi a wannan lokaci.’
english: I will establish his kingdom forever if he continues to do my commandments and my ordinances, as it is today.’

hausa: “Jarumawa sun fāɗi a yaƙi! Ga Yonatan matacce a tuddanku.
english: How the mighty have fallen in the middle of the battle! Jonathan was slain on your high places.

hausa: Na kuma ba da Gileyad ga Makir.
english: I gave Gilead to Machir.

hausa: Muryar Ubangiji ta kakkarya itatuwan al’ul na Lebanon. Ubangiji ya kakkarya itatuwan al’ul na Lebanon kucu-kucu.
english: Yahweh’s voice breaks the cedars. Yes, Yahweh breaks in pieces the cedars of Lebanon.

hausa: Gama ku, ’yan’uwa, kun zama masu koyi da ikkilisiyoyin Allah a Yahudiya waɗanda suke cikin Kiristi Yesu. Kun sha wahala a hannun mutanen ƙasarku kamar yadda ikkilisiyoyin nan ma suka sha a hannun Yahudawa,
english: For you, brothers, became imitators of the assemblies of God which are in Judea in Christ Jesus; for you also suffered the same things from your own countrymen, even as they did from the Jews

hausa: “Muddin ina raye,” in ji Sarki, wanda sunansa ne Ubangiji Maɗaukaki, “wani zai ɓullo wanda yake kamar Tabor a cikin duwatsu, kamar Karmel kusa da teku.
english: “As I live,” says the King, whose name is Yahweh of Armies, “surely like Tabor among the mountains, and like Carmel by the sea, so he will come.

hausa: Sa’an nan ya komo wurin almajiransa, ya tarar suna barci. Ya tambayi Bitrus ya ce, “Ashe, ba za ku iya yin tsaro tare da ni ko na sa’a guda ba?
english: He came to the disciples and found them sleeping, and said to Peter, “What, couldn’t you watch with me for one hour?

hausa: Sai Ubangiji ya aiko da macizai masu dafin a cikinsu, suka sassari mutane, Isra’ilawa masu yawa kuwa suka mutu.
english: Yahweh sent venomous snakes among the people, and they bit the people. Many people of Israel died.

hausa: “ ‘Amma firistoci, waɗanda suke Lawiyawa kuma zuriyar Zadok waɗanda suka yi aminci ta wurin yin ayyukansu a wurina mai tsarki sa’ad da Isra’ilawa suka kauce daga gare ni, su ne za su zo kusa don hidima a gabana; za su tsaya a gabana don miƙa hadayun kitse da jini, in ji Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka.
english: “‘“But the Levitical priests, the sons of Zadok, who performed the duty of my sanctuary when the children of Israel went astray from me, shall come near to me to minister to me. They shall stand before me to offer to me the fat and the blood,” says the Lord Yahweh.

hausa: Sa’an nan Elisha ya yi addu’a ya ce, “Ya Ubangiji, ka buɗe idanunsa yă gani!” Sai Ubangiji ya buɗe idanun bawan, ya duba, ya ga tuddai cike da dawakai da keken yaƙin wuta kewaye da Elisha.
english: Elisha prayed, and said, “Yahweh, please open his eyes, that he may see.” Yahweh opened the young man’s eyes, and he saw; and behold, the mountain was full of horses and chariots of fire around Elisha.

hausa: “ ‘In namiji ya kwana da ita, al’adarta kuwa ta taɓa shi, zai ƙazantu na kwana bakwai; duk kuma gadon da ya kwanta a kai, zai ƙazantu.
english: “‘If any man lies with her, and her monthly flow is on him, he shall be unclean seven days; and every bed he lies on shall be unclean.

hausa: Sarki mai hikima yakan gane mugunta; ya hukunta su ba tausayi.
english: A wise king winnows out the wicked, and drives the threshing wheel over them.

hausa: Cikin famanku da zunubi, ba ku yi tsayayya har ga zub da jininku ba tukuna.
english: You have not yet resisted to blood, striving against sin.

hausa: Wa zai yi muku lahani in kun himmantu ga yin nagarta?
english: Now who will harm you if you become imitators of that which is good?

hausa: Har ƙasar ma ta ƙazantu, saboda haka na hukunta ta saboda zunubinta, ƙasar kuwa ta amayar da mazaunanta.
english: The land was defiled. Therefore I punished its iniquity, and the land vomited out her inhabitants.

hausa: Kelub, ɗan’uwan Shuha, shi ne mahaifin Mehir, wanda shi ne mahaifin Eshton.
english: Chelub the brother of Shuhah became the father of Mehir, who was the father of Eshton.

hausa: “Za su ɗauki dukan kayayyakin da ake amfani da su a wuri mai tsarki, su nannaɗe su da zane mai ruwan shuɗi, su rufe shi da fatar shanun teku, sa’an nan a sa su a kan sandan ɗaukarsa.
english: “They shall take all the vessels of ministry with which they minister in the sanctuary, and put them in a blue cloth, cover them with a covering of sealskin, and shall put them on the frame.

hausa: Amma da yake ya shafi gardama ce game da kalmomi da sunaye da kuma dokarku, sai ku ji da ita da kanku. Ni ba zan zama mai shari’a kan irin waɗannan abubuwa ba.”
english: but if they are questions about words and names and your own law, look to it yourselves. For I don’t want to be a judge of these matters.”

hausa: Za su zo da kuka; za su yi addu’a yayinda nake komo da su. Zan bishe su kusa da rafuffukan ruwa a miƙaƙƙiyar hanya inda ba za su yi tuntuɓe ba, domin ni ne mahaifin Isra’ila, Efraim kuma ɗan farina ne.
english: They will come with weeping. I will lead them with petitions. I will cause them to walk by rivers of waters, in a straight way in which they won’t stumble; for I am a father to Israel. Ephraim is my firstborn.

hausa: Sa’an nan Ubangiji ya ce wa Musa, “Miƙa hannunka sama domin a yi duhu a bisa Masar, duhun da za a iya taɓawa.”
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “Stretch out your hand toward the sky, that there may be darkness over the land of Egypt, even darkness which may be felt.”

hausa: Sai Ayuba ya amsa,
english: Then Job answered,

hausa: Amma Na’omi ta ce, “Ku koma gida, ’ya’yana mata. Don me za ku tafi tare da ni? Zan ƙara samun waɗansu ’ya’ya maza da za su zama mazanku ne?
english: Naomi said, “Go back, my daughters. Why do you want to go with me? Do I still have sons in my womb, that they may be your husbands?

hausa: Farat ɗaya, da suka waiwaya, ba su ƙara ganin kowa tare da su ba, sai dai Yesu.
english: Suddenly looking around, they saw no one with them any more, except Jesus only.

hausa: Kada hakkin kowa yă zauna a kanku, sai dai na ƙaunar juna, don mai ƙaunar maƙwabcinsa ya cika Doka ke nan.
english: Owe no one anything, except to love one another; for he who loves his neighbor has fulfilled the law.

hausa: Ku kasa kunne, ya sammai! Ki saurara, ya duniya! Gama Ubangiji ya yi magana, “Na yi renon ’ya’ya, na kuma raya su, amma sun tayar mini.
english: Hear, heavens, and listen, earth; for Yahweh has spoken: “I have nourished and brought up children and they have rebelled against me.

hausa: Yana cikin magana sai ga taro sun zo. Mutumin nan da ake kira Yahuda, ɗaya daga cikin Sha Biyun, shi ya bi da su. Sai ya matso kusa da Yesu don yă yi masa sumba.
english: While he was still speaking, a crowd appeared. He who was called Judas, one of the twelve, was leading them. He came near to Jesus to kiss him.

hausa: Sarki kuwa ya yi magana da su, sai ya gano cewa babu wani kamar Daniyel, Hananiya, Mishayel da kuma Azariya; don haka sai suka shiga yi wa sarki hidima.
english: The king talked with them; and among them all was found no one like Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah. Therefore they stood before the king.

hausa: amma na ba su wannan umarni cewa ku yi mini biyayya, zan kuwa zama Allahnku ku kuma ku zama mutanena. Ku yi tafiya cikin dukan hanyoyin da na umarce ku, don ku zauna lafiya.
english: but this thing I commanded them, saying, ‘Listen to my voice, and I will be your God, and you shall be my people. Walk in all the way that I command you, that it may be well with you.’

hausa: Sai Yesu ya yi tambaya ya ce, “Burodi guda nawa kuke da su?” Suka ce, “Bakwai.”
english: He asked them, “How many loaves do you have?” They said, “Seven.”

hausa: Sai Yesu ya ce masa, “Yau, ceto ya zo gidan nan, domin wannan mutum shi ma ɗan Ibrahim ne.
english: Jesus said to him, “Today, salvation has come to this house, because he also is a son of Abraham.

hausa: Amma Yesu ya zo ya taɓa su ya ce, “Ku tashi, kada ku ji tsoro.”
english: Jesus came and touched them and said, “Get up, and don’t be afraid.”

hausa: saboda ku, ’ya’yanku, da kuma ’ya’yansu bayansu za su ji tsoron Ubangiji Allahnku muddin kuna rayuwa ta wurin kiyaye dukan ƙa’idodinsa da umarnan da na ba ku, da kuma don ku yi tsawon rai.
english: that you might fear Yahweh your God, to keep all his statutes and his commandments, which I command you—you, your son, and your son’s son, all the days of your life; and that your days may be prolonged.

hausa: To, a Urushalima akwai wani tafki kusa da Ƙofar Tumaki, wanda a yaren Arameyik ake kira Betesda an kuma kewaye shi da shirayi biyar.
english: Now in Jerusalem by the sheep gate, there is a pool, which is called in Hebrew, “Bethesda”, having five porches.

hausa: suka ce masa, “Barorinka sun ƙidaya mayaƙan da suke ƙarƙashinmu, babu ko ɗayan ya ɓace.
english: They said to Moses, “Your servants have taken the sum of the men of war who are under our command, and there lacks not one man of us.

hausa: Ka ce wa firistoci waɗanda suke ɗauke da akwatin alkawari, ‘Sa’ad da kuka kai bakin Urdun, ku shiga cikin ruwan ku tsaya.’ ”
english: You shall command the priests who bear the ark of the covenant, saying, ‘When you come to the brink of the waters of the Jordan, you shall stand still in the Jordan.’”

hausa: “Zan lissafta Rahab a cikin waɗanda suka san ni, Filistiya ita ma, da Taya, tare da Kush, zan kuma ce, ‘An haifi wannan a Sihiyona.’ ”
english: I will record Rahab and Babylon among those who acknowledge me. Behold, Philistia, Tyre, and also Ethiopia: “This one was born there.”

hausa: Ya kuma gina ɗakunan gefe duka a gefen haikalin. Tsayin kowanne, kamu biyar ne, aka haɗa su da haikalin da manyan katakan al’ul.
english: He built the floors all along the house, each five cubits high; and they rested on the house with timbers of cedar.

hausa: Amma sashen kitsen maraƙin da na ragon, da wutsiya mai kitse, da kitsen da yake rufe da kayan ciki, da ƙodoji da kuma kitsen da ya rufe hanta,
english: and the fat of the bull and of the ram, the fat tail, and that which covers the innards, and the kidneys, and the cover of the liver;

hausa: Ya Ubangiji, za ka kiyaye mu lafiya ka tsare mu daga irin mutanen nan har abada.
english: You will keep them, Yahweh. You will preserve them from this generation forever.

hausa: “ ‘Gefenku na kudu zai haɗa da wani sashin Hamadan Zin ta iyakar Edom. A gabas, iyakarku ta kudu za tă fara daga ƙarshen Tekun Gishiri,
english: then your south quarter shall be from the wilderness of Zin along by the side of Edom, and your south border shall be from the end of the Salt Sea eastward.

hausa: “Sa’ad da kuka miƙa hadaya ta godiya ga Ubangiji, ku miƙa ta a yadda za tă zama yardajje a madadinku.
english: “When you sacrifice a sacrifice of thanksgiving to Yahweh, you shall sacrifice it so that you may be accepted.

hausa: marasa ƙauna, marasa gafartawa, masu ɓata sunayen waɗansu, marasa kamunkai, masu ƙeta, marasa ƙaunar nagarta,
english: without natural affection, unforgiving, slanderers, without self-control, fierce, not lovers of good,

hausa: Waɗannan kuwa suka koma suka shaida wa sauran, amma su ma ba su gaskata ba.
english: They went away and told it to the rest. They didn’t believe them, either.

hausa: Duk mutumin da ya shiga ƙirge daga mai shekaru ashirin zuwa gaba, ya ba da rabin shekel. Mazan da suka shiga ƙirge sun kai mutum 603,550.
english: a beka a head, that is, half a shekel, according to the shekel of the sanctuary, for everyone who passed over to those who were counted, from twenty years old and upward, for six hundred three thousand five hundred fifty men.

hausa: A maimakon haka, gaɓoɓin jiki da ake gani kamar ba su da ƙarfi, su ne masu muhimmanci.
english: No, much rather, those members of the body which seem to be weaker are necessary.

hausa: “Benyamin kyarkeci ne mai kisa; da safe yakan cinye abin da ya farauto da yamma yakan raba ganima.”
english: “Benjamin is a ravenous wolf. In the morning he will devour the prey. At evening he will divide the plunder.”

hausa: In aka sami wani daga cikin bayinka da shi, zai mutu; sai sauran su zama bayin mai girma.”
english: With whomever of your servants it is found, let him die, and we also will be my lord’s slaves.”

hausa: Abokaina ƙaunatattu, mu ƙaunaci juna, domin ƙauna tana zuwa daga Allah ne. Duk mai ƙauna, haifaffe ne na Allah, ya kuma san Allah.
english: Beloved, let’s love one another, for love is of God; and everyone who loves has been born of God and knows God.

hausa: kamar yadda zuriyar Isuwa, waɗanda suke zaune a Seyir, da Mowabawa, waɗanda suke zaune a Ar, suka yardar mana, gama muna so mu ƙetare Urdun zuwa ƙasa wadda Ubangiji, Allahnmu yake ba mu.”
english: as the children of Esau who dwell in Seir, and the Moabites who dwell in Ar, did to me, until I pass over the Jordan into the land which Yahweh our God gives us.”

hausa: sai mijinta ya je wajenta biko don yă rarashe ta komo. Ya tafi tare bawansa da kuma jakuna biyu. Sai ta shigar da shi gidan mahaifinta, sa’ad da mahaifinta ya gan shi, ya marabce shi da murna.
english: Her husband arose and went after her to speak kindly to her, to bring her again, having his servant with him and a couple of donkeys. She brought him into her father’s house; and when the father of the young lady saw him, he rejoiced to meet him.

hausa: Amma wani yana iya tambaya yă ce, “Ta yaya ake tā da matattun? Da wane irin jiki za su tashi?”
english: But someone will say, “How are the dead raised?” and, “With what kind of body do they come?”

hausa: Ina tabbatar muku a zamanin Iliya, akwai gwauraye da yawa a Isra’ila, sa’ad da aka rufe sararin sama har shekara uku da rabi, aka kuma yi yunwa mai tsanani ko’ina a ƙasar.
english: But truly I tell you, there were many widows in Israel in the days of Elijah, when the sky was shut up three years and six months, when a great famine came over all the land.

hausa: Yanzu kukan Isra’ilawa ya kai gare ni, na kuma ga yadda Masarawa suke wulaƙanta su
english: Now, behold, the cry of the children of Israel has come to me. Moreover I have seen the oppression with which the Egyptians oppress them.

hausa: Furfura rawani ne mai daraja; akan same ta ta wurin yin rayuwa ta adalci.
english: Gray hair is a crown of glory. It is attained by a life of righteousness.

hausa: Da majajjawa da dutse kawai Dawuda ya ci nasara a kan Bafilistin. Ya buge shi, ya kashe shi ba tare da takobi a hannunsa ba.
english: So David prevailed over the Philistine with a sling and with a stone, and struck the Philistine and killed him; but there was no sword in David’s hand.

hausa: Ga sunayen mutanen Gershon, Libni, da Shimeyi
english: These are the names of the sons of Gershon by their families: Libni and Shimei.

hausa: Sa’ad da mutane suka gan shi, sai suka yabi allahnsu, suna cewa, “Allahnmu ya bashe abokin gābanmu a hannunmu, wanda ya lalace ƙasarmu ya kuma raɓanya kisan mutanenmu.”
english: When the people saw him, they praised their god; for they said, “Our god has delivered our enemy and the destroyer of our country, who has slain many of us, into our hand.”

hausa: Duk waɗannan za su sha kanki cikin farat ɗaya, a rana guda, rashin ’ya’ya da gwauranci. Za su zo a kanki da cikakken minzani, duk da yawan masu dubanki da kuma dukan sihirinki.
english: But these two things will come to you in a moment in one day: the loss of children and widowhood. They will come on you in their full measure, in the multitude of your sorceries, and the great abundance of your enchantments.

hausa: Bari ƙaunarka marar ƙarewa ta zo gare ni, ya Ubangiji, cetonka bisa ga alkawarinka;
english: Let your loving kindness also come to me, Yahweh, your salvation, according to your word.

hausa: Duk wanda ya taɓa ƙaya yakan yi amfani da wani ƙarfe ne ko sandar māshi; akan ƙone su inda suke a zube.”
english: The man who touches them must be armed with iron and the staff of a spear. They will be utterly burned with fire in their place.”

hausa: Masu fariya suna yi mini ba’a ba tare da an hana su ba, amma ban rabu da dokar ba.
english: The arrogant mock me excessively, but I don’t swerve from your law.

hausa: Gaskiya ne cewa ba ma samun yardar Allah ta wurin abin da muke ci. Ba ma rasa wani abu idan ba mu ci ba, kuma ba ma ƙaru da wani abu in muka ci.
english: But food will not commend us to God. For neither, if we don’t eat are we the worse, nor if we eat are we the better.

hausa: Sa’ad da kwanaki suka yi don Elizabet ta haihu, sai ta haifi ɗa.
english: Now the time that Elizabeth should give birth was fulfilled, and she gave birth to a son.

hausa: Amma game da ni, zan sa bege ga Ubangiji, ina sauraron Allah Mai Cetona; Allahna kuwa zai ji ni.
english: But as for me, I will look to Yahweh. I will wait for the God of my salvation. My God will hear me.

hausa: Ishaya ya faɗi haka ne, saboda ya hangi ɗaukakar Yesu, ya kuwa yi magana a kansa.
english: Isaiah said these things when he saw his glory, and spoke of him.

hausa: Wannan ya zama haka saboda Isra’ilawa su kawo wa Ubangiji hadayun da suke yi a filaye. Dole su kawo su ga firist, wato, ga Ubangiji, a ƙofar Tentin Sujada, su miƙa su a matsayin hadayun salama.
english: This is to the end that the children of Israel may bring their sacrifices, which they sacrifice in the open field, that they may bring them to Yahweh, to the door of the Tent of Meeting, to the priest, and sacrifice them for sacrifices of peace offerings to Yahweh.

hausa: Sai ya umarci jama’a ya ce, “Mu je zuwa! Ku zaga birnin, masu tsaro da makamai su shiga gaban akwatin alkawarin Ubangiji.”
english: They said to the people, “Advance! March around the city, and let the armed men pass on before Yahweh’s ark.”

hausa: Daga baya, sa’ad da Sennakerib sarkin Assuriya da dukan mayaƙansa suke kwanto wa Lakish, sai ya aiki hafsoshinsa da wannan saƙo wa Hezekiya sarkin Yahuda da kuma wa dukan mutanen Yahuda waɗanda suke can cewa,
english: After this, Sennacherib king of Assyria sent his servants to Jerusalem, (now he was attacking Lachish, and all his forces were with him), to Hezekiah king of Judah, and to all Judah who were at Jerusalem, saying,

hausa: Na yi miki ado da kayan ado masu daraja, na sa miki mundaye a hannuwanki da abin wuya a wuyanki,
english: I decked you with ornaments, put bracelets on your hands, and put a chain on your neck.

hausa: Yowab ya ba labarin yawan mayaƙan wa Dawuda. A cikin Isra’ila akwai mutum miliyon da dubu ɗari ɗaya waɗanda za su iya riƙe takobi, haɗe da dubu ɗari huɗu da saba’in a Yahuda.
english: Joab gave the sum of the census of the people to David. All those of Israel were one million one hundred thousand men who drew a sword; and in Judah were four hundred seventy thousand men who drew a sword.

hausa: a cikin hannunka ya sanya ɗan adam, da namun jeji da tsuntsayen sama. A duk inda suke zaune, ya maishe ka ka yi mulki a bisansu kai ne kan zinariyan nan na siffar.
english: Wherever the children of men dwell, he has given the animals of the field and the birds of the sky into your hand, and has made you rule over them all. You are the head of gold.

hausa: Ubangiji kuma ya juya ya kafa wa Bitrus ido. Sai Bitrus ya tuna da maganar da Ubangiji ya ce masa, “Kafin zakara ya yi cara yau, za ka yi mūsun sanina sau uku.”
english: The Lord turned and looked at Peter. Then Peter remembered the Lord’s word, how he said to him, “Before the rooster crows you will deny me three times.”

hausa: Ba a sami maƙeri ɗaya a dukan ƙasar Isra’ila ba domin Filistiyawa sun ce, “In ba haka ba Ibraniyawa za su ƙera wa kansu takuba ko māsu.”
english: Now there was no blacksmith found throughout all the land of Israel, for the Philistines said, “Lest the Hebrews make themselves swords or spears”;

hausa: Baratar da mai laifi a kuma hukunta mai adalci, Ubangiji ya ƙi su biyu.
english: He who justifies the wicked, and he who condemns the righteous, both of them alike are an abomination to Yahweh.

hausa: Sa’ad da ya ga kekunan yaƙi tare da ƙungiyoyin dawakai, mahaya a kan jakuna, ko mahaya a kan raƙuma, to, fa ya zauna a faɗake, ya kintsa sosai.”
english: When he sees a troop, horsemen in pairs, a troop of donkeys, a troop of camels, he shall listen diligently with great attentiveness.”

hausa: Da yawa cikin waɗanda suka gaskata yanzu suka zo a fili suka furta mugayen ayyukansu.
english: Many also of those who had believed came, confessing and declaring their deeds.

hausa: domin doka tana jawo fushi ne. Kuma inda babu doka babu keta umarni ke nan.
english: For the law produces wrath; for where there is no law, neither is there disobedience.

hausa: Ya amsa ya ce, “Duk tsiron da Ubana na sama bai shuka ba, za a tumɓuke shi daga saiwoyi.
english: But he answered, “Every plant which my heavenly Father didn’t plant will be uprooted.

hausa: Na kuma ce musu, “Kowannenku ya zubar da mugayen siffofin da kuka kafa idanunku a kai, kuma kada ku ƙazantar da kanku da gumakan Masar. Ni ne Ubangiji Allahnku.”
english: I said to them, ‘Each of you throw away the abominations of his eyes. Don’t defile yourselves with the idols of Egypt. I am Yahweh your God.’

hausa: Suka kuma yaƙi sansanin makiyaya suka kwashe tumaki da awaki da raƙuma. Suka koma Urushalima.
english: They also struck the tents of those who had livestock, and carried away sheep and camels in abundance, then returned to Jerusalem.

hausa: waɗanda suka rusuna a kan rufin ɗaki don su yi sujada ga rundunar taurari. Waɗanda suka rusuna suka kuma yi rantsuwa da sunan Ubangiji suke kuma rantsuwa da sunan Molek.
english: those who worship the army of the sky on the housetops, those who worship and swear by Yahweh and also swear by Malcam,

hausa: Waɗanda suka buga hatimin su ne, Nehemiya ɗan Hakaliya, wanda yake gwamna. Zedekiya
english: Now those who sealed were: Nehemiah the governor, the son of Hacaliah, and Zedekiah,

hausa: Ruwan ya janye a hankali daga ƙasa. A ƙarshen kwanaki ɗari da hamsin ɗin, ruwan ya ragu.
english: The waters continually receded from the earth. After the end of one hundred fifty days the waters receded.

hausa: Zurfafan ruwaye sun rufe su; suka nutse cikin zurfi kamar dutse.
english: The deeps cover them. They went down into the depths like a stone.

hausa: Game da Yusuf ya ce, “Bari Ubangiji yă albarkaci ƙasarsa da raɓa mai daraja daga sama a bisa da kuma zurfin ruwan da suke kwance a ƙarƙashi;
english: About Joseph he said, “His land is blessed by Yahweh, for the precious things of the heavens, for the dew, for the deep that couches beneath,

hausa: Zabura ta Dawuda. Ubangiji, wa zai zauna cikin wuri mai tsarkinka? Wa zai zauna a kan tudunka mai tsarki?
english: A Psalm by David. Yahweh, who shall dwell in your sanctuary? Who shall live on your holy hill?

hausa: Zan ba wa bayinka masu yankan katakai waɗanda suka yanka katako, garwa niƙaƙƙen alkama dubu ashirin, garwan sha’ir dubu ashirin da randunan ruwan inabi dubu ashirin da kuma randunan man zaitun dubu ashirin.”
english: Behold, I will give to your servants, the cutters who cut timber, twenty thousand cors of beaten wheat, twenty thousand baths of barley, twenty thousand baths of wine, and twenty thousand baths of oil.”

hausa: Kuka dawo, kuka yi kuka a gaban Ubangiji, amma bai kula da ku ba, balle yă saurare ku.
english: You returned and wept before Yahweh, but Yahweh didn’t listen to your voice, nor turn his ear to you.

hausa: Shi wanda ya yi duwatsu, ya halicci iska, ya kuma bayyana wa mutum tunaninsa, shi wanda ya juya safiya ta zama duhu yana takawa a wurare masu tsawo na duniya, Ubangiji Allah Maɗaukaki ne sunansa.
english: For, behold, he who forms the mountains, creates the wind, declares to man what is his thought, who makes the morning darkness, and treads on the high places of the earth: Yahweh, the God of Armies, is his name.”

hausa: daga zuriyar Elizafan, Shemahiya shugaba da dangi 200;
english: of the sons of Elizaphan, Shemaiah the chief, and his brothers two hundred;

hausa: Idanuna suna a kan dukan hanyoyinsu; ba a ɓoye suke daga gare ni, kuma zunubansu ba a ɓoye suke a idanuna ba.
english: For my eyes are on all their ways. They are not hidden from my face. Their iniquity isn’t concealed from my eyes.

hausa: Mutumin da ya ci gaba da taurinkai bayan an kwaɓe shi ba da daɗewa ba zai hallaka ba makawa.
english: He who is often rebuked and stiffens his neck will be destroyed suddenly, with no remedy.

hausa: Akwai dawakai 736, alfadarai 245
english: Their horses were seven hundred thirty-six; their mules, two hundred forty-five;

hausa: An ture ni baya na kusa fāɗuwa, amma Ubangiji ya taimake ni.
english: You pushed me back hard, to make me fall, but Yahweh helped me.

hausa: Sa’an nan Ubangiji ya ce wa Musa, “Hau bisa wannan dutse a Abarim. Ka ga ƙasar da na ba wa Isra’ilawa.
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “Go up into this mountain of Abarim, and see the land which I have given to the children of Israel.

hausa: gama sun yi zina kuma jinin yana a hannuwansu. Sun yi zina da gumakansu; har suka miƙa ’ya’yansu da suka haifa mini, su zama musu abinci.
english: For they have committed adultery, and blood is in their hands. They have committed adultery with their idols. They have also caused their sons, whom they bore to me, to pass through the fire to them to be devoured.

hausa: Ba ma sa abin tuntuɓe wa kowa, domin kada hidimarmu ta zama abin zargi.
english: We give no occasion of stumbling in anything, that our service may not be blamed,

hausa: Sababbi ne kowace safiya; amincinka kuwa mai girma ne.
english: They are new every morning. Great is your faithfulness.

hausa: Sa’ad da kuka ɗaga hannuwanku wajen yin addu’a, zan ɓoye fuskata daga gare ku; ko da kun miƙa addu’o’i masu yawa, ba zan kasa kunne ba. Hannuwanku sun cika da jini!
english: When you spread out your hands, I will hide my eyes from you. Yes, when you make many prayers, I will not hear. Your hands are full of blood.

hausa: Wannan ƙungiyar Isra’ilawan da aka kwashe zuwa bauta da suke a Kan’ana za su mallaki ƙasar har zuwa Zarefat; waɗannan da aka kwashe zuwa bauta daga Urushalima da suke a Sefarad za su mallaki garuruwan Negeb.
english: The captives of this army of the children of Israel, who are among the Canaanites, will possess even to Zarephath; and the captives of Jerusalem, who are in Sepharad, will possess the cities of the Negev.

hausa: Waɗannan kam, su ne abubuwan da ya kamata ka koyar, ka ƙarfafa ka kuma tsawata da dukan iko. Kada ka yarda wani yă rena ka.
english: Say these things and exhort and reprove with all authority. Let no one despise you.

hausa: Na auna musu talenti 650 na azurfa, talenti ɗari na kwanonin azurfa, talenti 100 na zinariya,
english: I weighed into their hand six hundred fifty talents of silver, one hundred talents of silver vessels, one hundred talents of gold,

hausa: amma dole duniya ta koya cewa ina ƙaunar Uba, ina kuma yin yadda Ubana ya umarce ni. “Ku zo, mu bar nan.
english: But that the world may know that I love the Father, and as the Father commanded me, even so I do. Arise, let’s go from here.

hausa: “ ‘Ga abin da Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka yana cewa, “ ‘Zan hallaka gumaka in kuma kawo ƙarshen siffofi a Memfis. Ba za a ƙara samun yerima a ƙasar Masar ba, zan kuma baza tsoro a duk fāɗin ƙasar.
english: “‘The Lord Yahweh says: “I will also destroy the idols, and I will cause the images to cease from Memphis. There will be no more a prince from the land of Egypt. I will put a fear in the land of Egypt.

hausa: Sa’an nan Musa ya yanka ɗan ragon, ya kuma yayyafa jinin a kowane gefe na bagaden.
english: He killed it; and Moses sprinkled the blood around on the altar.

hausa: Sa’ad da Ubangiji bai iya jurewa da mugayen ayyukanku da kuma abubuwa banƙyama da kuka aikata ba, sai ƙasarku ta zama abin la’ana da kufai babu mazauna yadda yake a yau.
english: Thus Yahweh could no longer bear it, because of the evil of your doings and because of the abominations which you have committed. Therefore your land has become a desolation, an astonishment, and a curse, without inhabitant, as it is today.

hausa: Saboda haka bayan suka yi azumi da addu’a, sai suka ɗibiya musu hannuwansu a kansu suka sallame su.
english: Then, when they had fasted and prayed and laid their hands on them, they sent them away.

hausa: Har abokina na kurkusa, wanda na amince da shi, wanda muke cin abinci tare, ya juya yana gāba da ni.
english: Yes, my own familiar friend, in whom I trusted, who ate bread with me, has lifted up his heel against me.

hausa: Maknadebai, Shashai, Sharai,
english: Machnadebai, Shashai, Sharai,

hausa: Shawulu ya sami Sama’ila a hanyar shiga gari, sai ya tambaye shi ya ce, “Ina roƙonka ka nuna mini gidan mai duba?”
english: Then Saul approached Samuel in the gateway, and said, “Please tell me where the seer’s house is.”

hausa: Kai mai albarka ne, ya Isra’ila! Wane ne yake kamar ka, mutanen da Ubangiji ya ceta? Shi ne mafakarka da mai taimakonka da kuma takobinka mai ɗaukaka. Abokan gābanka za su zo neman jinƙai a gabanka, za ka kuwa tattake masujadansu.”
english: You are happy, Israel! Who is like you, a people saved by Yahweh, the shield of your help, the sword of your excellency? Your enemies will submit themselves to you. You will tread on their high places.”

hausa: Kwana shida za ku tattara shi, amma a rana ta bakwai, Asabbaci, ba za a same shi ba.”
english: Six days you shall gather it, but on the seventh day is the Sabbath. In it there shall be none.”

hausa: Madogaran ƙofofinka za su zama ƙarfe da tagulla, ƙarfinka kuma zai zama daidai da kwanakinka.
english: Your bars will be iron and bronze. As your days, so your strength will be.

hausa: Da farko ga waɗanda suke a Damaskus, sa’an nan ga waɗanda suke a Urushalima da kuma cikin dukan Yahudiya, da kuma ga Al’ummai su ma, na yi wa’azi don su tuba su juyo ga Allah su kuma tabbatar da tubansu ta wurin ayyukansu.
english: but declared first to them of Damascus, at Jerusalem, and throughout all the country of Judea, and also to the Gentiles, that they should repent and turn to God, doing works worthy of repentance.

hausa: A Asabbatai da kuma a Sabuwar Wata mutanen ƙasar za su yi sujada a gaban Ubangiji a mashigin wannan hanyar shiga.
english: The people of the land shall worship at the door of that gate before Yahweh on the Sabbaths and on the new moons.

hausa: Oholibama, Ela, Finon.
english: chief Oholibamah, chief Elah, chief Pinon,

hausa: Amma Uriya ya kwanta a ƙofar fada tare da dukan bayin maigidansa, bai kuwa tafi gidansa ba.
english: But Uriah slept at the door of the king’s house with all the servants of his lord, and didn’t go down to his house.

hausa: In kuwa mun zama ɗaya tare da shi haka a cikin mutuwarsa, tabbatacce mu ma za mu zama ɗaya tare da shi cikin tashinsa daga matattu.
english: For if we have become united with him in the likeness of his death, we will also be part of his resurrection;

hausa: Ta wurin alherin da Allah ya ba ni, na kafa tushen gini kamar ƙwararren magini, wani kuma dabam yana gini a kai. Amma kowa yă lura da yadda yake gini.
english: According to the grace of God which was given to me, as a wise master builder I laid a foundation, and another builds on it. But let each man be careful how he builds on it.

hausa: Filistiyawa suka sāke kai hari wa kwarin;
english: The Philistines made another raid in the valley.

hausa: Wanda ya shimfiɗa duniya a kan ruwaye, Ƙaunarsa madawwamiya ce.
english: to him who spread out the earth above the waters, for his loving kindness endures forever;

hausa: Ka halicce arewa da kudu; Tabor da Hermon suna rera don farin ciki ga sunanka.
english: You have created the north and the south. Tabor and Hermon rejoice in your name.

hausa: Ka tuna da Yesu Kiristi, wanda aka tā da shi daga matattu, zuriyar Dawuda, wanda shi ne bisharata,
english: Remember Jesus Christ, risen from the dead, of the offspring of David, according to my Good News,

hausa: Allah ya sa zuciyata ta yi sanyi; Maɗaukaki ya tsorata ni.
english: For God has made my heart faint. The Almighty has terrified me.

hausa: Girmankai yakan zo kafin hallaka, girman kai yakan zo kafin fāɗuwa.
english: Pride goes before destruction, and an arrogant spirit before a fall.

hausa: “A sa’ad da kake kwance, ya sarki, tunaninka ya ga al’amuran da suke zuwa, kuma shi mai bayyana al’amuran ya bayyana maka asiran abubuwan da za su faru.
english: “As for you, O king, your thoughts came on your bed, what should happen hereafter; and he who reveals secrets has made known to you what will happen.

hausa: Kana ganin mutumin da yake da gwaninta a cikin aikinsa? Zai yi wa sarakuna hidima; ba zai yi hidima wa mutanen da ba su iya ba.
english: Do you see a man skilled in his work? He will serve kings. He won’t serve obscure men.

hausa: “Sa’an nan masu adalci za su amsa masa, su ce, ‘Ubangiji, yaushe muka gan ka da yunwa muka ciyar da kai, ko da ƙishirwa muka ba ka abin sha?
english: “Then the righteous will answer him, saying, ‘Lord, when did we see you hungry and feed you, or thirsty and give you a drink?

hausa: Zan aika da yunwa mai tsanani a kansu, zazzaɓi mai zafi da muguwar annoba; zan aika da haƙoran namun jeji a kansu, da dafin mesa masu ja da ciki.
english: They shall be wasted with hunger, and devoured with burning heat and bitter destruction. I will send the teeth of animals on them, with the venom of vipers that glide in the dust.

hausa: Gama in rana ta fito ta yi zafi mai tsanani sai ta sa tsiro yă yanƙwane tsiro; furensa yă kakkaɓe, kyansa kuma yă lalace. Haka ma mai arziki zai shuɗe yayinda yake cikin harkarsa.
english: For the sun arises with the scorching wind and withers the grass; and the flower in it falls, and the beauty of its appearance perishes. So the rich man will also fade away in his pursuits.

hausa: “Ki yi murna a kanta, ya sama! Ku yi murna, ku tsarkaka! Ku yi murna, ku manzanni da annabawa! Allah ya hukunta shi saboda abin da ya yi muku.”
english: “Rejoice over her, O heaven, you saints, apostles, and prophets, for God has judged your judgment on her.”

hausa: Daga lokacin da ya sa shi shugaban gidansa da kuma a kan dukan abin da yake da shi, sai Ubangiji ya albarkaci gidan mutumin Masar saboda Yusuf. Albarkar Ubangiji tana a kan kome da Fotifar yake da shi a gida da kuma a jeji.
english: From the time that he made him overseer in his house, and over all that he had, Yahweh blessed the Egyptian’s house for Joseph’s sake. Yahweh’s blessing was on all that he had, in the house and in the field.

hausa: Saurayin ya ce, “Ina kan dutsen Gilbowa a lokacin sai na ga Shawulu jingine a māshinsa. Kekunan yaƙi da mahayansu suna matsowa kusa da shi.
english: The young man who told him said, “As I happened by chance on Mount Gilboa, behold, Saul was leaning on his spear; and behold, the chariots and the horsemen followed close behind him.

hausa: Dawuda ya ce wa Allah, “Ba ni ba ne na umarta a ƙidaya mayaƙan? Ni ne wanda ya yi zunubin da kuma abin da ba daidai ba. Waɗannan dai tumaki ne. Me suka yi? Ya Ubangiji Allahna, bari hannunka ya fāɗi a kaina da kuma iyalina, amma kada ka bar wannan annoba ya kasance a kan mutanenka.”
english: David said to God, “Isn’t it I who commanded the people to be counted? It is even I who have sinned and done very wickedly; but these sheep, what have they done? Please let your hand, O Yahweh my God, be against me and against my father’s house; but not against your people, that they should be plagued.”

hausa: Rehobowam ya tafi Shekem, gama dukan Isra’ila sun je can don su naɗa shi sarki.
english: Rehoboam went to Shechem, for all Israel had come to Shechem to make him king.

hausa: Yehohiyada ya umarci komandodin sojoji waɗanda suke lura da mayaƙa, ya ce, “Ku fitar da ita daga cikinku, ku kuma kashe duk wanda ya bi ta.” Gama firist ɗin ya ce, “Kada a kashe ta a cikin haikalin Ubangiji.”
english: Jehoiada the priest commanded the captains of hundreds who were set over the army, and said to them, “Bring her out between the ranks. Kill anyone who follows her with the sword.” For the priest said, “Don’t let her be slain in Yahweh’s house.”

hausa: Ku taimaki mutanen Allah masu bukata. Ku zama masu karɓan baƙi.
english: contributing to the needs of the saints, and given to hospitality.

hausa: Ku ɗauki ƙunshin itacen hizzob, ku tsoma cikin jinin da yake a kwano, ku yayyafa wa dogaran ƙofa duka biyu, da bisa kan ƙofar. Kada wani daga cikinku yă fita daga ƙofar gidansa sai da safe.
english: You shall take a bunch of hyssop, and dip it in the blood that is in the basin, and strike the lintel and the two door posts with the blood that is in the basin. None of you shall go out of the door of his house until the morning.

hausa: “ ‘In ɗaya daga ciki mutanen ƙasarku ya talauta, ba ya kuma iya tallafa wa kansa a cikinku, sai ku taimake shi kamar yadda za ku yi da baƙo a cikinku.
english: “‘If your brother has become poor, and his hand can’t support himself among you, then you shall uphold him. He shall live with you like an alien and a temporary resident.

hausa: Zan kuwa zaɓa waɗansunsu kuma su zama firistoci da Lawiyawa,” in ji Ubangiji.
english: Of them I will also select priests and Levites,” says Yahweh.

hausa: amma da ambaliyar ruwa zai kawo Ninebe ga ƙarshe; zai fafari maƙiyansa zuwa cikin duhu.
english: But with an overflowing flood, he will make a full end of her place, and will pursue his enemies into darkness.

hausa: Ku zo kusa, ku al’ummai, ku kuwa saurara ku kasa kunne, ku mutane! Bari duniya ta ji, da kuma dukan abin da yake cikinta, duniya, da dukan abin da yake fitowa daga gare ta!
english: Come near, you nations, to hear! Listen, you peoples. Let the earth and all it contains hear, the world, and everything that comes from it.

hausa: Abin da ya rushe ba a iya ginawa ba; in ya kulle mutum ba a iya buɗe shi a sake shi ba.
english: Behold, he breaks down, and it can’t be built again. He imprisons a man, and there can be no release.
