hausa: “Yanzu dai, zan faɗa maka gaskiya. Sarakuna uku za su taso a Farisa, sa’an nan kuma na huɗu, wanda zai fi dukansu dukiya. Sa’ad da zai sami iko saboda dukiyarsa, zai zuga dukan kowane mutum yă yi gāba da masarautar Girka.
english: “Now I will show you the truth. Behold, three more kings will stand up in Persia. The fourth will be far richer than all of them. When he has grown strong through his riches, he will stir up all against the realm of Greece.

hausa: Mutum mai saurin fushi yakan yi ayyukan wauta, akan kuma ƙi mai son nuna wayo.
english: He who is quick to become angry will commit folly, and a crafty man is hated.

hausa: Duk da haka, ba kai ba ne za ka gina haikali, amma ɗanka, wanda yake namanka da jininka, shi ne wanda zai gina haikali domin Sunana.’
english: Nevertheless, you shall not build the house; but your son who shall come out of your body, he shall build the house for my name.’

hausa: Ya tambayi mutanen da suke zama a can ya ce, “Ina karuwar haikalin da take a bakin hanya a Enayim?” Sai suka ce, “Ba a taɓa kasance da karuwar haikali a nan ba.”
english: Then he asked the men of her place, saying, “Where is the prostitute, that was at Enaim by the road?” They said, “There has been no prostitute here.”

hausa: Kuma sa’ad da suka tambaye ka, ‘Me ya sa kake nishi?’ Sai ka ce musu, ‘Domin labarun da suke fitowa. Kowace zuciya za tă narke kowane hannu kuma ya gurgunta; kowane ruhu zai sume kowane gwiwa kuma ta rasa ƙarfi kamar ruwa.’ Yana zuwa! Tabbatacce zai faru, in ji Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka.”
english: It shall be, when they ask you, ‘Why do you sigh?’ that you shall say, ‘Because of the news, for it comes! Every heart will melt, all hands will be feeble, every spirit will faint, and all knees will be weak as water. Behold, it comes, and it shall be done, says the Lord Yahweh.’”

hausa: Tsoro ya rufe ni; an kawar mini mutuncina kamar da iska, dukiyata ta watse kamar girgije.
english: Terrors have turned on me. They chase my honor as the wind. My welfare has passed away as a cloud.

hausa: Barorinsa suka ce masa, “Me ya sa kake yin haka? Yayinda yaron yake da rai, ka yi azumi, ka kuma yi kuka, amma yanzu da yaron ya mutu, ka tashi, ka kuma ci abinci!”
english: Then his servants said to him, “What is this that you have done? You fasted and wept for the child while he was alive, but when the child was dead, you rose up and ate bread.”

hausa: Kamar wani da ya kama kare a kunnuwa haka yake da mai wucewa da ya tsoma baki a faɗan da ba ruwansa.
english: Like one who grabs a dog’s ears is one who passes by and meddles in a quarrel not his own.

hausa: Na biyun,
english: The second took her as wife, and he died childless.

hausa: Daga baya sai na tafi Suriya da Silisiya.
english: Then I came to the regions of Syria and Cilicia.

hausa: Mutane suka tsawata musu, suka ce musu su yi shiru. Sai suka ƙara ɗaga murya suna cewa, “Ubangiji, Ɗan Dawuda, ka ji tausayinmu!”
english: The multitude rebuked them, telling them that they should be quiet, but they cried out even more, “Lord, have mercy on us, you son of David!”

hausa: amma Yesu ya ce musu, “Na nuna muku ayyukan alheri masu yawa da Uba ya aiko ni in yi, a kan wanne kuke so ku jajjefe ni?”
english: Jesus answered them, “I have shown you many good works from my Father. For which of those works do you stone me?”

hausa: Wanda ya haƙa rami yakan fāɗa cikin ramin da ya haƙa.
english: He has dug a hole, and has fallen into the pit which he made.

hausa: “Ya ke mutuwa, ina nasararki? Ya ke mutuwa, ina dafinki?”
english: “Death, where is your sting? Hades, where is your victory?”

hausa: Gama a gare mu an haifa mana yaro, a gare mu an ba da ɗa, gwamnati za tă kasance a kafaɗarsa. Za a ce da shi Mashawarci Mai Banmamaki, Allah Maɗaukaki Uban Madawwami, Sarkin Salama.
english: For a child is born to us. A son is given to us; and the government will be on his shoulders. His name will be called Wonderful Counselor, Mighty God, Everlasting Father, Prince of Peace.

hausa: Manoma sun nome bayana suka yi kunyoyinsu da tsayi.
english: The plowers plowed on my back. They made their furrows long.

hausa: Sa’an nan zan ɗauke hannuna, ka kuwa ga bayana; amma fuskata, ba za ka gani ba.”
english: then I will take away my hand, and you will see my back; but my face shall not be seen.”

hausa: Su duka masu taurinkai ne, ’yan tawaye, suna yawo suna baza jita-jita. Su tagulla ne da ƙarfe; dukansu lalatattu ne.
english: They are all grievous rebels, going around to slander. They are bronze and iron. All of them deal corruptly.

hausa: Sai sarki Sairus ya fitar da kayan da suke na haikalin Ubangiji waɗanda Nebukadnezzar ya kwashe daga Urushalima ya sa a haikalin allahnsa.
english: Also Cyrus the king brought out the vessels of Yahweh’s house, which Nebuchadnezzar had brought out of Jerusalem, and had put in the house of his gods;

hausa: “Mowab ta kasance cikin kwanciyar rai tun ƙuruciyarta, kamar ruwan inabin da aka bari lis, ba a juya daga tulu zuwa wani tulu ba ba tă tafi bauta ba. Saboda haka tana da ɗanɗanonta, kuma ƙanshinta bai canja ba.
english: “Moab has been at ease from his youth, and he has settled on his dregs, and has not been emptied from vessel to vessel, neither has he gone into captivity; therefore his taste remains in him, and his scent is not changed.

hausa: Ƙaunataccena ya yi magana ya ce mini, “Tashi, ƙaunatacciyata, kyakkyawata, ki zo tare da ni.
english: My beloved spoke, and said to me, “Rise up, my love, my beautiful one, and come away.

hausa: Yesu ya ce wa macen, “Bangaskiyarki ta cece ki, ki sauka lafiya.”
english: He said to the woman, “Your faith has saved you. Go in peace.”

hausa: Ƙasa ta buɗe ta haɗiye Datan ta binne iyalin Abiram.
english: The earth opened and swallowed up Dathan, and covered the company of Abiram.

hausa: Ga waɗanda ba su da Dokar kuwa, na zama kamar wanda ba shi da Dokar (ko da yake ba ni da ’yanci daga dokar Allah, amma ina ƙarƙashin dokar Kiristi), domin in rinjayi waɗanda ba su da dokar.
english: to those who are without law, as without law (not being without law toward God, but under law toward Christ), that I might win those who are without law.

hausa: Ku tafi daga gare ni, dukanku masu aikata mugunta, gama Ubangiji ya ji kukata.
english: Depart from me, all you workers of iniquity, for Yahweh has heard the voice of my weeping.

hausa: “Za su ɗauki zane mai ruwan shuɗi su rufe wurin ajiye fitilan da yake don fitilu, tare da fitilunsa, lagwaninsa da farantansa, da dukan tulunansa don man amfaninsu.
english: “They shall take a blue cloth and cover the lamp stand of the light, its lamps, its snuffers, its snuff dishes, and all its oil vessels, with which they minister to it.

hausa: Hawaye na kwararowa daga idanuna domin an hallaka mutanena.
english: My eye runs down with streams of water, for the destruction of the daughter of my people.

hausa: Ku rurrushe bagadansu, ku farfashe keɓaɓɓun duwatsunsu, ku sassare ginshiƙan Asheransu.
english: but you shall break down their altars, and dash in pieces their pillars, and you shall cut down their Asherah poles;

hausa: Yawan mutane shi ne ɗaukakar sarki, amma in ba tare da mabiya ba sarki ba kome ba ne.
english: In the multitude of people is the king’s glory, but in the lack of people is the destruction of the prince.

hausa: “ ‘Gama zubar da jini yana a tsakiyarta, ta zubar da shi a dutsen da yake a fili; ba tă zubar da shi a ƙasa ba, inda ƙura za tă rufe shi.
english: “‘“For the blood she shed is in the middle of her. She set it on the bare rock. She didn’t pour it on the ground, to cover it with dust.

hausa: “La’ananne ne mutumin da ya kashe maƙwabcinsa a ɓoye.” Sai dukan mutane su ce, “Amin!”
english: ‘Cursed is he who secretly kills his neighbor.’ All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’

hausa: Sa’ad da safiya ta yi, sai ga Liyatu! Saboda haka Yaƙub ya ce wa Laban, “Mene ne ke nan ka yi mini? Na yi maka bauta domin Rahila, ba haka na yi ba? Don me ka ruɗe ni?”
english: In the morning, behold, it was Leah! He said to Laban, “What is this you have done to me? Didn’t I serve with you for Rachel? Why then have you deceived me?”

hausa: Ana cikin haka, sai almajiransa suka roƙe shi suka ce, “Rabbi, ci abinci mana.”
english: In the meanwhile, the disciples urged him, saying, “Rabbi, eat.”

hausa: Sun raba rigunana a tsakaninsu suka kuma jefa ƙuri’a a kan rigunana.
english: They divide my garments among them. They cast lots for my clothing.

hausa: Ɗana, kada ka rena horon Ubangiji kada kuma ka ƙi tsawatawarsa,
english: My son, don’t despise Yahweh’s discipline, neither be weary of his correction;

hausa: Gama Ubangiji kansa zai sauko daga sama, da umarni mai ƙarfi, da muryar babban mala’ika da kuma busar ƙahon Allah, waɗanda suka mutu kuwa cikin Kiristi za su tashi da farko.
english: For the Lord himself will descend from heaven with a shout, with the voice of the archangel and with God’s trumpet. The dead in Christ will rise first,

hausa: Na ga nawayar da Allah ya ɗora a kan mutane.
english: I have seen the burden which God has given to the sons of men to be afflicted with.

hausa: Kwanakina sun wuce, shirye-shiryena sun ɓaci haka kuma abubuwan da zuciyata take so.
english: My days are past. My plans are broken off, as are the thoughts of my heart.

hausa: Suna zuwa daga ƙasashe masu nesa, daga iyakokin duniya, Ubangiji da kuma fushinsa, zai hallaka dukan ƙasar.
english: They come from a far country, from the uttermost part of heaven, even Yahweh, and the weapons of his indignation, to destroy the whole land.

hausa: Ya yi abin da yake daidai a gaban Ubangiji, amma ba da dukan zuciyarsa ba.
english: He did that which was right in Yahweh’s eyes, but not with a perfect heart.

hausa: Za ku bar sunanku ga zaɓaɓɓuna yă zama abin la’antarwa; Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka zai kashe ku, amma ga bayina zai ba su wani suna.
english: You will leave your name for a curse to my chosen, and the Lord Yahweh will kill you. He will call his servants by another name,

hausa: Bari kowane abu mai numfashi yă yabi Ubangiji. Yabi Ubangiji.
english: Let everything that has breath praise Yah! Praise Yah!

hausa: Sauran ayyukan mulkin Uzziya daga farko zuwa ƙarshe, suna a rubuce ta hannun annabi Ishaya ɗan Amoz.
english: Now the rest of the acts of Uzziah, first and last, Isaiah the prophet, the son of Amoz, wrote.

hausa: Mizfa Kefira, Moza,
english: Mizpeh, Chephirah, Mozah,

hausa: Amma ga kowannenmu an ba da alheri bisa ga yadda Kiristi ya rarraba.
english: But to each one of us, the grace was given according to the measure of the gift of Christ.

hausa: Sai duk suka juya kan Sostenes shugaban majami’a suka yi masa dūka a gaban kotun. Amma Galliyo ko yă kula.
english: Then all the Greeks seized Sosthenes, the ruler of the synagogue, and beat him before the judgment seat. Gallio didn’t care about any of these things.

hausa: Za su yi kyan gani da kuma bansha’awa! Hatsi zai sa samari su yi murna, sabon ruwan inabi kuma zai sa ’yan mata su yi farin ciki.
english: For how great is his goodness, and how great is his beauty! Grain will make the young men flourish, and new wine the virgins.

hausa: A wannan dare aka kashe Belshazar, sarkin Babiloniyawa,
english: In that night Belshazzar the Chaldean King was slain.

hausa: Ɗaya daga cikin waɗanda suka saurare mu mace ce mai suna Lidiya, mai sayar da yadunan jan garura masu tsada daga birnin Tiyatira, mai yi wa Allah sujada. Ubangiji ya buɗe zuciyarta har ta karɓi saƙon Bulus.
english: A certain woman named Lydia, a seller of purple, of the city of Thyatira, one who worshiped God, heard us. The Lord opened her heart to listen to the things which were spoken by Paul.

hausa: Dabbar da kuma ƙahoni goma da ka gani za su ƙi jinin karuwar. Za su kai ta ga hallaka su kuma bar ta tsirara; za su ci namanta su kuma ƙone ta da wuta.
english: The ten horns which you saw, they and the beast will hate the prostitute, will make her desolate, will strip her naked, will eat her flesh, and will burn her utterly with fire.

hausa: Ka faɗa wa mutanen ƙasar cewa, ‘Ga abin Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka yana cewa game da waɗanda suke zama a Urushalima da kuma cikin ƙasar Isra’ila. Za su ci abincinsu da razana, su sha ruwansu da tsoro, gama za a washe dukan abin da yake ƙasarsu saboda hargitsin dukan waɗanda suna zama a can.
english: Tell the people of the land, ‘The Lord Yahweh says concerning the inhabitants of Jerusalem and the land of Israel: “They will eat their bread with fearfulness and drink their water in dismay, that her land may be desolate, and all that is therein, because of the violence of all those who dwell therein.

hausa: “La’ananne ne mutumin da ya sassaƙa siffa, ko ya yi zubin gunki, abar ƙyama ce ga Ubangiji, aikin hannu mai sana’a da aka kafa a ɓoye.” Sai dukan mutane su ce, “Amin!”
english: ‘Cursed is the man who makes an engraved or molten image, an abomination to Yahweh, the work of the hands of the craftsman, and sets it up in secret.’ All the people shall answer and say, ‘Amen.’

hausa: a kuma same ni a cikinsa, ba da wani adalcin kaina wanda yake zuwa daga bin doka ba, sai dai adalcin da yake samuwa ta wurin bangaskiya a cikin Kiristi, adalcin da yake fitowa daga Allah da kuma yake zuwa ta wurin bangaskiya.
english: and be found in him, not having a righteousness of my own, that which is of the law, but that which is through faith in Christ, the righteousness which is from God by faith,

hausa: Ku kasa kunne ku kuma zo gare ni; ku saurare ni, don ranku ya rayu. Zan yi madawwamin alkawari da ku, zan nuna muku ƙaunata marar ƙarewa da na yi wa Dawuda alkawari.
english: Turn your ear, and come to me. Hear, and your soul will live. I will make an everlasting covenant with you, even the sure mercies of David.

hausa: A haɗa da bunsuru guda, a matsayin hadaya don zunubi, ban da hadaya ta ƙonawa ta kullum, tare da hadayarta ta gari da hadaya ta sha.
english: and one male goat for a sin offering; in addition to the continual burnt offering, its meal offering, and its drink offering.

hausa: ka ce, ‘Ga abin da Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka yana cewa, “ ‘Ina gāba da ke, ya Sidon, zan sami ɗaukaka a cikinki. Za su san cewa ni ne Ubangiji, sa’ad da na zartar da hukunci a kanta na kuma nuna kaina mai tsarki a cikinta.
english: and say, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “Behold, I am against you, Sidon. I will be glorified among you. Then they will know that I am Yahweh, when I have executed judgments in her, and am sanctified in her.

hausa: Isuwa ya ɗauki matansa da ’ya’yansa maza da mata da kuma dukan membobin gidansa, ya kuma ɗauki shanunsa da dukan sauran dabbobinsa, da dukan dukiyarsa da ya samu a ƙasar Kan’ana zuwa wata ƙasa nesa da ɗan’uwansa Yaƙub.
english: Esau took his wives, his sons, his daughters, and all the members of his household, with his livestock, all his animals, and all his possessions, which he had gathered in the land of Canaan, and went into a land away from his brother Jacob.

hausa: Kyakkyawa ce cikin tsayinta, abin farin cikin dukan duniya. Kamar ƙwanƙoli mafi tsayi na Zafon ne Dutsen Sihiyona, birnin Babban Sarki.
english: Beautiful in elevation, the joy of the whole earth, is Mount Zion, on the north sides, the city of the great King.

hausa: Da ya gama magana, sai ya ce wa Siman, “Ka tuƙa jirgin zuwa inda akwai zurfi, ka saukar da abin kamun kifinka ka kama kifi.”
english: When he had finished speaking, he said to Simon, “Put out into the deep and let down your nets for a catch.”

hausa: In mutum ya fanshi wani zakansa, dole yă ƙara kashi ɗaya bisa biyar na darajar.
english: If a man redeems anything of his tithe, he shall add a fifth part to it.

hausa: Zan sauko in yi magana da kai a can, zan kuma ɗauki Ruhun da yake kanka in mai da shi wajensu. Za su taimake ka ɗaukan nauyin mutane, don yă zama ba kai kaɗai ba ne mai ɗaukan kaya.
english: I will come down and talk with you there. I will take of the Spirit which is on you, and will put it on them; and they shall bear the burden of the people with you, that you don’t bear it yourself alone.

hausa: Sai suka tashi daga inda tentin Kora, da Datan, da Abiram suke. Datan da Abiram kuwa suka fita suna tsaye tare da matansu da ’ya’yansu da ’yan ƙananansu a ƙofar tentinsu.
english: So they went away from the tent of Korah, Dathan, and Abiram, on every side. Dathan and Abiram came out, and stood at the door of their tents with their wives, their sons, and their little ones.

hausa: Sa’an nan su wuce da sauri kamar iska, mutane ne masu laifi, waɗanda ƙarfinsu shi ne allahnsu.”
english: Then they sweep by like the wind and go on. They are indeed guilty, whose strength is their god.”

hausa: da katakai ashirin da rammukan tagulla ashirin da ƙugiyoyin azurfa da kuma rammuka a kan katakai.
english: Its pillars shall be twenty, and their sockets twenty, of bronze. The hooks of the pillars and their fillets shall be of silver.

hausa: Zai shari’anta mutanenka da adalci, marasa ƙarfinka da shari’ar gaskiya.
english: He will judge your people with righteousness, and your poor with justice.

hausa: Zai zama kamar duban ƙarya ne ga waɗanda suka yi rantsuwar yin masa biyayya, amma zai tunashe su game da laifinsu ya kuma kama su.
english: It will be to them as a false divination in their sight, who have sworn oaths to them; but he brings iniquity to memory, that they may be taken.

hausa: Gaskiya nake gaya muku, duk wanda yake da bangaskiya gare ni, zai yi abubuwan da ni nake yi. Zai ma yi abubuwa masu girma fiye da waɗannan, don zan tafi wurin Uba.
english: Most certainly I tell you, he who believes in me, the works that I do, he will do also; and he will do greater works than these, because I am going to my Father.

hausa: na kuma yi addu’a, na ce, “Ya Allah, ina cike da kunya, ba zan iya ɗaga fuskata gare ka ba, ya Allahna, domin zunubanmu sun fi mu tsayi, tudunsu har ya kai sama.
english: and I said, “My God, I am ashamed and blush to lift up my face to you, my God, for our iniquities have increased over our head, and our guiltiness has grown up to the heavens.

hausa: Game da ayyukan mulkin Rehobowam, daga farko zuwa ƙarshe, ba a rubuce suke a tarihin Shemahiya annabi da Iddo mai gani wanda yake zancen zuriyoyi ba? Aka kasance da yaƙe-yaƙe tsakanin Rehobowam da Yerobowam.
english: Now the acts of Rehoboam, first and last, aren’t they written in the histories of Shemaiah the prophet and of Iddo the seer, in the genealogies? There were wars between Rehoboam and Jeroboam continually.

hausa: Suka tashi daga Hazerot, suka yi sansani a Ritma.
english: They traveled from Hazeroth, and encamped in Rithmah.

hausa: An aske kowane kai aka kuma yanke kowane gemu aka kuma sa wa kowane kwankwaso rigar makoki.
english: For every head is bald, and every beard clipped. There are cuttings on all the hands, and sackcloth on the waist.

hausa: Ku raba kanku da dukan laifofin da kuka yi, ku sami sabuwar zuciya da sabon ruhu. Don me za ku mutu, ya gidan Isra’ila?
english: Cast away from you all your transgressions in which you have transgressed; and make yourself a new heart and a new spirit. For why will you die, house of Israel?

hausa: Haka Isra’ilawa suka ba wa Lawiyawa waɗannan garuruwa da wuraren kiwo masu kyau, yadda Ubangiji ya umarta ta wurin Musa.
english: The children of Israel gave these cities with their pasture lands by lot to the Levites, as Yahweh commanded by Moses.

hausa: Amma ya san hanyar da nake bi; sa’ad da ya gwada ni zan fito kamar zinariya.
english: But he knows the way that I take. When he has tried me, I will come out like gold.

hausa: na Mikmash 122
english: The men of Michmas: one hundred twenty-two.

hausa: In na yi kokawa da mugayen namomin jeji a Afisa bisa ga ra’ayin mutane ne kawai, mece ce ribata, in har ba a tā da matattu? Ai, “Sai mu ci mu sha, da yake gobe za mu mutu.”
english: If I fought with animals at Ephesus for human purposes, what does it profit me? If the dead are not raised, then “let’s eat and drink, for tomorrow we die.”

hausa: Amma mu ’yan mulkin sama ne. Muna kuma jira zuwan Mai Ceto daga can, Ubangiji Yesu Kiristi,
english: For our citizenship is in heaven, from where we also wait for a Savior, the Lord Jesus Christ,

hausa: Allah ɗaya Uban duka, wanda yake a bisa duka, ta wurin duka, a cikin duka kuma.
english: one God and Father of all, who is over all and through all and in us all.

hausa: Numfashinta yana fitar da wuta; idanunta kamar hasken zuwan safe.
english: His sneezing flashes out light. His eyes are like the eyelids of the morning.

hausa: Sa’ad da manzannin da suke a Urushalima suka ji cewa Samariya ta karɓi maganar Allah, sai suka aika musu da Bitrus da Yohanna.
english: Now when the apostles who were at Jerusalem heard that Samaria had received the word of God, they sent Peter and John to them,

hausa: Amma yanzu kun juya kun kuma ɓata sunana; kowannenku ya mayar da bayi maza da matan da kuka ’yantar su tafi inda suka ga dama. Kun sāke tilasta su su zama bayinku.
english: but you turned and profaned my name, and every man caused his servant and every man his handmaid, whom you had let go free at their pleasure, to return. You brought them into subjection, to be to you for servants and for handmaids.’”

hausa: An tura shi daga cikin haske zuwa cikin duhu, an kore shi daga duniya.
english: He will be driven from light into darkness, and chased out of the world.

hausa: Shawulu ya ce wa Dawuda, “Ga diyata Merab zan ba ka ka aura, kai dai ka yi mini aiki da himma, ka kuma yi yaƙe-yaƙen Ubangiji.” Saboda Shawulu ya ce wa kansa, “Ba zan ɗaga hannuna a kansa ba, Filistiyawa ne za su yi wannan.”
english: Saul said to David, “Behold, my elder daughter Merab. I will give her to you as wife. Only be valiant for me, and fight Yahweh’s battles.” For Saul said, “Don’t let my hand be on him, but let the hand of the Philistines be on him.”

hausa: Yanzu fa, Hiridus mai sarauta ya ji labarin dukan abubuwan da suke faruwa. Sai ya rikice, don waɗansu mutane suna cewa, Yohanna Mai Baftisma ne ya tashi daga matattu,
english: Now Herod the tetrarch heard of all that was done by him; and he was very perplexed, because it was said by some that John had risen from the dead,

hausa: gama ba tă hana uwata ɗaukar cikina, don ta hana ni shan wahalan nan ba.
english: because it didn’t shut up the doors of my mother’s womb, nor did it hide trouble from my eyes.

hausa: An ɗauke su da tsarki, domin suna miƙa abincin Allahnku. An ɗauka su masu tsarki gama Ni Ubangiji, mai tsarki ne, Ni wanda ya mai da ku masu tsarki.
english: Therefore you shall sanctify him, for he offers the bread of your God. He shall be holy to you, for I Yahweh, who sanctify you, am holy.

hausa: Dawuda ya gina wa Ubangiji bagade a wurin, ya kuma miƙa masa hadaya ta ƙonawa, da hadaya ta salama. Sa’an nan Ubangiji ya amsa addu’o’in a madadin ƙasar, aka kuma kawar wa Isra’ila annoban.
english: David built an altar to Yahweh there, and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings. So Yahweh was entreated for the land, and the plague was removed from Israel.

hausa: Yanzu zan faɗa muku abin da zan yi da gonar inabina. Zan cire katangar da ta kewaye ta, za tă kuwa lalace; zan rushe bangonta, za a kuwa tattake ta.
english: Now I will tell you what I will do to my vineyard. I will take away its hedge, and it will be eaten up. I will break down its wall, and it will be trampled down.

hausa: Sai ya aiki bayinsa su kira waɗanda aka gayyata zuwa bikin, amma waɗanda aka ce su zo bikin, suka ƙi zuwa.
english: and sent out his servants to call those who were invited to the wedding feast, but they would not come.

hausa: A rana ta tara ta watan huɗu, lokacin da yunwa ta yi tsanani a birnin, babu kuma abinci domin mutane su ci.
english: On the ninth day of the fourth month, the famine was severe in the city, so that there was no bread for the people of the land.

hausa: Yanzu da Allah ya kunce bakana ya ba ni wahala sun raba ni da mutuncina.
english: For he has untied his cord, and afflicted me; and they have thrown off restraint before me.

hausa: Ba jikin ruhaniya ne ya zo da farko ba, na mutuntakan ne, daga baya kuma sai na ruhaniya.
english: However, that which is spiritual isn’t first, but that which is natural, then that which is spiritual.

hausa: Sai sarki ya umarta, a kawo mutanen nan da suka yi wa Daniyel maƙarƙashiya, a tura su, da ’ya’yansu, da matansu cikin ramin zakoki. Kafin ma su kai ƙurewar ramin, sai zakoki suka hallaka su suka yayyage su, suka yi kaca-kaca da su.
english: The king commanded, and they brought those men who had accused Daniel, and they cast them into the den of lions—them, their children, and their wives; and the lions mauled them, and broke all their bones in pieces before they came to the bottom of the den.

hausa: gama in ba tare da shi ba, wa zai iya ci yă sha yă kuma ji daɗi?
english: For who can eat, or who can have enjoyment, more than I?

hausa: Ubangiji ya ce wa Musa,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

hausa: A wannan rana za su yi ta ruri a kansa kamar rurin teku. Kuma in wani ya dubi ƙasar, zai ga duhu da damuwa; haske ma zai zama duhu ta wurin gizagizai.
english: They will roar against them in that day like the roaring of the sea. If one looks to the land, behold, darkness and distress. The light is darkened in its clouds.

hausa: Amma duk sa’ad da wani ya juyo ga Ubangiji, akan kawar da lulluɓin.
english: But whenever someone turns to the Lord, the veil is taken away.

hausa: Rana guda a filayen gidan sun fi dubu a wani wuri dabam; zan gwammaci in zama mai tsaron ƙofa a gidan Allahna da in zauna a tentunan mugaye.
english: For a day in your courts is better than a thousand. I would rather be a doorkeeper in the house of my God, than to dwell in the tents of wickedness.

hausa: Gama Ubangiji Allahnku yana zagawa a cikin sansaninku don yă tsare ku, yă kuma bashe abokan gābanku gare ku. Dole sansaninku yă kasance da tsarki, saboda kada yă ga wani abu marar kyau a cikinku, har yă juya daga gare ku.
english: for Yahweh your God walks in the middle of your camp, to deliver you, and to give up your enemies before you. Therefore your camp shall be holy, that he may not see an unclean thing in you, and turn away from you.

hausa: Ya amsa ya ce, “Sai da addu’akaɗai irin wannan yakan fita.”
english: He said to them, “This kind can come out by nothing but by prayer and fasting.”

hausa: Sai ya ce, “To, shi ke nan, bari yă zama yadda kuka faɗa. Duk wanda aka same shi da kwaf na azurfan zai zama bawana, sauran kuwa za su ’yantu daga zargin.”
english: He said, “Now also let it be according to your words. He with whom it is found will be my slave; and you will be blameless.”

hausa: suka yi kira da babbar murya, suka ce, “Yesu, Ubangiji, ka ji tausayinmu!”
english: They lifted up their voices, saying, “Jesus, Master, have mercy on us!”

hausa: zuwa ƙasa mai duhun gaske, da inuwa da hargitsi, inda haske yake kamar duhu.”
english: the land dark as midnight, of the shadow of death, without any order, where the light is as midnight.’”

hausa: Da kowane bijimi, a shirya kashi ɗaya bisa uku na efan lallausan gari, kwaɓaɓɓe da mai; da rago guda kuwa, a shirya kashi biyu bisa goma na efan lallausan gari, kwaɓaɓɓe da mai;
english: with their meal offering, fine flour mixed with oil. You shall offer three tenths for a bull, and two tenths for the ram.

hausa: Ku tabbata kun keɓe kashi ɗaya bisa goma na amfanin gonakinku kowace shekara.
english: You shall surely tithe all the increase of your seed, that which comes out of the field year by year.

hausa: Rehum shugaban rundunar soja, da Shimshai marubuci, suka rubuta wasiƙar a kan Urushalima zuwa ga sarki Artazerzes, suka ce.
english: Rehum the chancellor and Shimshai the scribe wrote a letter against Jerusalem to Artaxerxes the king as follows.

hausa: Suka yi kuka a gaban Ubangiji suka ce, “Mun yi zunubi mun bar Ubangiji, muka bauta wa Ba’al da Ashtarot. Amma ka cece mu yanzu daga hannun abokan gābanmu, mu kuwa za mu bauta maka.”
english: They cried to Yahweh, and said, ‘We have sinned, because we have forsaken Yahweh and have served the Baals and the Ashtaroth; but now deliver us out of the hand of our enemies, and we will serve you.’

hausa: Ƙauna da aminci za su sadu; adalci da salama za su yi wa juna sumba.
english: Mercy and truth meet together. Righteousness and peace have kissed each other.

hausa: Amma sa’ad da Bikin Tabanakul na Yahudawa ya yi kusa,
english: Now the feast of the Jews, the Feast of Booths, was at hand.

hausa: Sa’ad da kuka roƙa, ba kwa samu, don kun roƙa da mugun nufi, don ku kashe abin da kuka samu a kan sha’awace-sha’awacenku.
english: You ask, and don’t receive, because you ask with wrong motives, so that you may spend it on your pleasures.

hausa: Sai Sarki Rehobowam ya nemi shawarar dattawan da suka yi wa mahaifinsa Solomon hidima a lokacin da yake da rai, ya tambaye suya ce, “Wace shawara za ku ba ni don in amsa wa waɗannan mutane?”
english: King Rehoboam took counsel with the old men, who had stood before Solomon his father while he yet lived, saying, “What counsel do you give me about how to answer these people?”

hausa: gama mugaye da masu ruɗu sun buɗe bakunansu a kaina; sun yi magana a kaina da harsunan ƙarya.
english: for they have opened the mouth of the wicked and the mouth of deceit against me. They have spoken to me with a lying tongue.

hausa: Kwaram, sai ga Yesu ya gamu da su ya ce, “Gaisuwa.” Sai suka zo kusa da shi, suka rungumi ƙafafunsa, suka yi masa sujada.
english: As they went to tell his disciples, behold, Jesus met them, saying, “Rejoice!” They came and took hold of his feet, and worshiped him.

hausa: “Sai ka ce wa bayinka, ‘Ku kawo mini shi don in gan shi da kaina.’
english: You said to your servants, ‘Bring him down to me, that I may set my eyes on him.’

hausa: Zan zama Ubansa, shi kuma yă zama ɗana. Idan ya yi laifi, zan yi amfani da mutane in hukunta shi. Mutane ne za su zama bulalata.
english: I will be his father, and he will be my son. If he commits iniquity, I will chasten him with the rod of men and with the stripes of the children of men;

hausa: Zan yi magana; kalmomina suna dab da fitowa daga bakina.
english: See now, I have opened my mouth. My tongue has spoken in my mouth.

hausa: Wannan ya faru a ran goma sha uku na watan Adar. A rana ta goma sha huɗu kuwa suka huta, suka kuma mai da ita ranar biki da kuma ta farin ciki.
english: This was done on the thirteenth day of the month Adar; and on the fourteenth day of that month they rested and made it a day of feasting and gladness.

hausa: Sa’ad da mutanen Yahuda suka zo wurin da yake fuskantar hamada, suka duba ta wajen babban rundunar, sai suka ga gawawwaki birjik a ƙasa; babu wani wanda ya kuɓuta.
english: When Judah came to the place overlooking the wilderness, they looked at the multitude; and behold, they were dead bodies fallen to the earth, and there were none who escaped.

hausa: A rana ɗaya Feka ɗan Remaliya ya kashe sojoji dubu ɗari da dubu ashirin a Yahuda, domin Yahuda sun yashe Ubangiji Allah na kakanninsu.
english: For Pekah the son of Remaliah killed in Judah one hundred twenty thousand in one day, all of them valiant men, because they had forsaken Yahweh, the God of their fathers.

hausa: Haka zai zama a duniya da kuma a cikin al’ummai, kamar sa’ad da akan karkaɗe itacen zaitun, ko kuma kamar sa’ad da ake barin kala bayan an girbe inabi.
english: For it will be so within the earth among the peoples, as the shaking of an olive tree, as the gleanings when the vintage is done.

hausa: (Wannan ce ƙidaya ta fari da aka yi a lokacin da Kwiriniyus yake gwamnar Suriya.)
english: This was the first enrollment made when Quirinius was governor of Syria.

hausa: Da ya zo wurinmu, sai ya ɗauki ɗamarar Bulus, ya ɗaura hannuwansa da ƙafafunsa da ita sa’an nan ya ce, “Ruhu Mai Tsarki ya ce, ‘Haka Yahudawan Urushalima za su daure mai wannan ɗamara su kuma ba da shi ga Al’ummai.’ ”
english: Coming to us and taking Paul’s belt, he bound his own feet and hands, and said, “The Holy Spirit says: ‘So the Jews at Jerusalem will bind the man who owns this belt, and will deliver him into the hands of the Gentiles.’”

hausa: kuma kamar zafin hamada. Ka kwantar da hayaniyar baƙi; kamar yadda inuwar girgije kan rage zafin rana, haka ake kwantar da waƙar mugaye.
english: As the heat in a dry place you will bring down the noise of strangers; as the heat by the shade of a cloud, the song of the dreaded ones will be brought low.

hausa: ’Ya’yan Naftali maza su ne, Yaziyel, Guni, Yezer da Shallum, su zuriyar Bilha ne.
english: The sons of Naphtali: Jahziel, Guni, Jezer, Shallum, and the sons of Bilhah.

hausa: Sai Musa ya ce musu, “Da haka za ku san cewa Ubangiji ne ya aiko ni, in yi dukan waɗannan abubuwa, ba da nufin kaina na yi su ba.
english: Moses said, “Hereby you shall know that Yahweh has sent me to do all these works; for they are not from my own mind.

hausa: “Ku je, ku nemi nufin Ubangiji saboda ni da saboda jama’a da kuma saboda dukan Yahuda game da abin da wannan littafi da aka samo ya ƙunsa. Fushin Ubangiji mai girma ne a kanmu domin kakanninmu ba su kiyaye kalmomin littafin nan ba; ba su aikata bisa ga abin da yake a rubuce game da mu ba.”
english: “Go inquire of Yahweh for me, and for the people, and for all Judah, concerning the words of this book that is found; for great is Yahweh’s wrath that is kindled against us, because our fathers have not listened to the words of this book, to do according to all that which is written concerning us.”

hausa: Ya hau kerubobi, ya tashi sama; ya yi firiya a fikafikan iska.
english: He rode on a cherub, and flew. Yes, he was seen on the wings of the wind.

hausa: “Je ka faɗa wa bawana Dawuda, ‘Ga abin da Ubangiji ya ce, kai ne za ka gina mini gida in zauna?
english: “Go and tell my servant David, ‘Yahweh says, “Should you build me a house for me to dwell in?

hausa: su kuma dawo cikin hankulansu su kuɓuta daga tarkon Iblis, wanda ya sa suka zama kamammu don su aikata nufinsa.
english: and they may recover themselves out of the devil’s snare, having been taken captive by him to do his will.

hausa: Daga abin da ya fito leɓunan mutum ne mutum kan ji daɗin abubuwa masu kyau, amma marar aminci yakan ƙosa ya tā-da-na-zaune-tsaye.
english: By the fruit of his lips, a man enjoys good things, but the unfaithful crave violence.

hausa: Zai zo ya karkashe masu hayan nan, ya ba wa waɗansu gonar inabin.” Da mutanen suka ji wannan, sai suka ce, “Allah ya sawwaƙa!”
english: He will come and destroy these farmers, and will give the vineyard to others.” When they heard that, they said, “May that never be!”

hausa: Sa’an nan Musa ya sallame surukinsa Yetro, ya kuwa koma ƙasarsa.
english: Moses let his father-in-law depart, and he went his way into his own land.

hausa: kashin da aka ba wa jama’a kuwa tumaki 337,500 ne,
english: (now the congregation’s half was three hundred thirty-seven thousand five hundred sheep,

hausa: Sai sarki Nebukadnezzar ya fāɗi da fuskarsa har ƙasa a gaban Daniyel domin ya girmama shi ya kuma umarta a miƙa hadaya da kuma hadayar ƙonawa ta turare ga Daniyel.
english: Then King Nebuchadnezzar fell on his face, worshiped Daniel, and commanded that they should offer an offering and sweet odors to him.

hausa: Dukan rafuffuka sukan gangara zuwa teku, duk da haka teku ba ya cika. Daga inda rafuffukan suke fitowa, a can suke komawa kuma.
english: All the rivers run into the sea, yet the sea is not full. To the place where the rivers flow, there they flow again.

hausa: zuwa Keriyot da Bozra zuwa dukan garuruwan Mowab, nesa da kusa.
english: on Kerioth, on Bozrah, and on all the cities of the land of Moab, far or near.

hausa: Ku ɗaukaka a cikin sunansa mai tsarki bari zukatan waɗanda suke neman Ubangiji su yi farin ciki.
english: Glory in his holy name. Let the heart of those who seek Yahweh rejoice.

hausa: Da ƙarfi yana magana da kansa yana cewa, “Zan kafe Dawuda da bango.” Amma Dawuda ya bauɗe masa sau biyu.
english: and Saul threw the spear, for he said, “I will pin David to the wall!” David escaped from his presence twice.

hausa: Na san ayyukanka, faman aikinka da daurewarka. Na san cewa ba ka iya haƙuri da mugayen mutane, ka gwada waɗanda suke cewa su manzanni ne, alhali kuwa ba haka ba ne, ka kuwa tarar cewa su na ƙarya ne.
english: “I know your works, and your toil and perseverance, and that you can’t tolerate evil men, and have tested those who call themselves apostles, and they are not, and found them false.

hausa: Sa’an nan mutumin ya auna tsawo da fāɗin ƙofar da take fuskantar arewa, wadda take bi zuwa filin waje.
english: He measured the length and width of the gate of the outer court which faces toward the north.

hausa: Da Dawuda ya komo fadarsa a Urushalima, sai ya ɗauko ƙwarƙwaran goma nan da ya bari su lura da fada, ya keɓe su a wani gida inda za a yi tsaronsu. Ya tanada musu, amma bai kwana da su ba. Aka sa su a keɓe har iyakar rayuwarsu, suka yi zama kamar gwauraye.
english: David came to his house at Jerusalem; and the king took the ten women his concubines, whom he had left to keep the house, and put them in custody and provided them with sustenance, but didn’t go in to them. So they were shut up to the day of their death, living in widowhood.

hausa: A Urushalima ya yi na’urori da gwanaye suka sarrafa don amfani a hasumiyoyi da kuma a kusurwar kāriya don harbin kibiyoyi da jefan manyan duwatsu. Sunansa ya bazu ko’ina, gama ya sami taimako sosai har ya zama mai iko.
english: In Jerusalem, he made devices, invented by skillful men, to be on the towers and on the battlements, with which to shoot arrows and great stones. His name spread far abroad, because he was marvelously helped until he was strong.

hausa: Zan harhaɗa muku jijiyoyi in sa muku tsoka in kuma rufe ku da fata; zan sa numfashi a cikinku, za ku kuwa rayu. Sa’an nan za ku san cewa ni ne Ubangiji.’ ”
english: I will lay sinews on you, and will bring up flesh on you, and cover you with skin, and put breath in you, and you will live. Then you will know that I am Yahweh.”’”

hausa: Duk wanda ya ji ni ya yaba mini waɗanda suka gan ni kuma sun amince da ni,
english: For when the ear heard me, then it blessed me, and when the eye saw me, it commended me,

hausa: Gama a rubuce yake cewa Ibrahim yana da ’ya’ya biyu maza, ɗaya ta wurin mace ’yar aikin gidansa, ɗaya kuma ta wurin ainihin matarsa.
english: For it is written that Abraham had two sons, one by the servant, and one by the free woman.

hausa: Ya Ubangiji Allah, kada ka ƙyale shafaffenka.
english: “Yahweh God, don’t turn away the face of your anointed. Remember your loving kindnesses to David your servant.”

hausa: Sai Ibrahim ya tashi daga gefen matarsa da ta mutu, ya yi magana da Hittiyawa. Ya ce,
english: Abraham rose up from before his dead and spoke to the children of Heth, saying,

hausa: Amma ku je ku koyi abin da wannan yake nufi, ‘Jinƙai nake bukata, ba hadaya ba.’Gama ban zo domin in kira masu adalci ba, sai dai masu zunubi.”
english: But you go and learn what this means: ‘I desire mercy, and not sacrifice,’ for I came not to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.”

hausa: To, akwai waɗansu Hellenawa a cikin waɗanda suka haura don su yi sujada a Bikin.
english: Now there were certain Greeks among those who went up to worship at the feast.

hausa: Gama ga abin da Ubangiji Maɗaukaki ya ce, “Bayan ya ɗaukaka ni, ya kuma aiko ni ga ƙasashen da suka washe ku gama duk wanda ya taɓa ku ya taɓa ƙwayar idonsa ne.
english: For Yahweh of Armies says: ‘For honor he has sent me to the nations which plundered you; for he who touches you touches the apple of his eye.

hausa: (To, a kwanakin can a Isra’ila, domin a tabbatar da fansa da kuma musayar da mallaka, mutum zai cire takalminsa ya ba wa ɗayan. Wannan ita ce hanyar tabbatar da al’amarin a hukumance a cikin Isra’ila.)
english: Now this was the custom in former time in Israel concerning redeeming and concerning exchanging, to confirm all things: a man took off his sandal, and gave it to his neighbor; and this was the way of formalizing transactions in Israel.

hausa: Saboda haka ba za ku kasance da wani a taron jama’ar Ubangiji da zai raba ƙasar ta wurin jefa ƙuri’a ba.
english: Therefore you will have no one who divides the land by lot in Yahweh’s assembly.

hausa: Bulus, da ya gane cewa waɗansu daga cikinsu Sadukiyawa ne sauran kuma Farisiyawa ne, sai ya ɗaga murya a Majalisar ya ce, “’Yan’uwana, ni Bafarisiye ne, ɗan Farisiyawa. Ana mini shari’a saboda begen da nake da shi a kan tashin matattu.”
english: But when Paul perceived that the one part were Sadducees and the other Pharisees, he cried out in the council, “Men and brothers, I am a Pharisee, a son of Pharisees. Concerning the hope and resurrection of the dead I am being judged!”

hausa: Yawan mutanen sashensa 41,500 ne.
english: His division, and those who were counted of them, were forty-one thousand five hundred.

hausa: Sa’an nan suka ƙona birnin tare da dukan abin da yake ciki tatas, amma suka sa azurfa da zinariya da kayan tagulla da na ƙarfe a cikin ma’aji na haikalin Ubangiji.
english: They burned the city with fire, and all that was in it. Only they put the silver, the gold, and the vessels of bronze and of iron into the treasury of Yahweh’s house.

hausa: Sa’an nan Filibus ya fara da wannan Nassi ɗin ya kuma faɗa masa labari mai daɗi game da Yesu.
english: Philip opened his mouth, and beginning from this Scripture, preached to him about Jesus.

hausa: Na roƙi almajiranka su fitar da shi, amma ba su iya ba.”
english: I begged your disciples to cast it out, and they couldn’t.”

hausa: Zan kuma kira Uriya firist da Zakariya ɗan Yeberekiya su zama mini amintattun shaidu.”
english: and I will take for myself faithful witnesses to testify: Uriah the priest, and Zechariah the son of Jeberechiah.”

hausa: Sai ya tafi maɓulɓular ruwan yana watsa gishirin a ciki, yana cewa, “Ga abin da Ubangiji ya ce, ‘Na warkar da ruwan nan. Ba zai ƙara jawo mutuwa, ko yă hana ƙasar ba da amfani ba.’ ”
english: He went out to the spring of the waters, and threw salt into it, and said, “Yahweh says, ‘I have healed these waters. There shall not be from there any more death or barren wasteland.’”

hausa: “ ‘In mutum ya sayar da gida a birni mai katanga, yana da izini yă fanshe shi a ƙarshen shekara guda, bayan ya sayar da shi.
english: “‘If a man sells a dwelling house in a walled city, then he may redeem it within a whole year after it has been sold. For a full year he shall have the right of redemption.

hausa: Duk wanda ya yi laifi, za a sāka masa don laifinsa, babu sonkai.
english: But he who does wrong will receive again for the wrong that he has done, and there is no partiality.

hausa: Bai ga hanyoyina ba ne bai ƙirga kowace takawata ba?
english: Doesn’t he see my ways, and count all my steps?

hausa: Ubangiji ya ce mini, “Ka tafi, ka sāke nuna wa matarka ƙauna, ko da yake wani yana son ta, ita kuma mazinaciya ce. Ka ƙaunace ta yadda Ubangiji yake ƙaunar Isra’ilawa, ko da yake sun juya ga waɗansu alloli suna kuma ƙauna wainar zabibi mai tsarki.”
english: Yahweh said to me, “Go again, love a woman loved by another, and an adulteress, even as Yahweh loves the children of Israel, though they turn to other gods, and love cakes of raisins.”

hausa: Ko da yake Ubangiji ya aiki annabawa zuwa wurin mutane don su dawo da su gare shi, kuma ko da yake sun ba da shaida a kansu, ba su saurara ba.
english: Yet he sent prophets to them to bring them again to Yahweh, and they testified against them; but they would not listen.

hausa: Ya ce wa matar, “Ba shakka za mu mutu, gama mun ga Allah!”
english: Manoah said to his wife, “We shall surely die, because we have seen God.”

hausa: Yesu ya amsa ya ce, “Aboki, yi abin da ya kawo ka.” Sa’an nan mutanen suka matso, suka kama Yesu suka riƙe shi.
english: Jesus said to him, “Friend, why are you here?” Then they came and laid hands on Jesus, and took him.

hausa: Rera yabai ga Ubangiji, wanda yake zaune a kursiyi a Sihiyona; yi shela a cikin al’ummai abin da ya aikata.
english: Sing praises to Yahweh, who dwells in Zion, and declare among the people what he has done.

hausa: Sai babban firist ya tambaye shi ya ce, “Waɗannan zargen gaskiya ne?”
english: The high priest said, “Are these things so?”

hausa: Ahaz shi ne mahaifin Yada, Yada shi ne mahaifin Alemet, Azmawet da Zimri, Zimri kuwa shi ne mahaifin Moza.
english: Ahaz became the father of Jarah. Jarah became the father of Alemeth, Azmaveth, and Zimri. Zimri became the father of Moza.

hausa: Sa’an nan mutum biyar ɗin nan da suka leƙi asirin ƙasar Layish suka ce wa ’yan’uwansu, “Kun san cewa ɗaya daga cikin gidajen nan yana da efod, waɗansu allolin iyali, siffar da aka sassaƙa da kuma gunki na zubi? To, kun san abin da za ku yi.”
english: Then the five men who went to spy out the country of Laish answered and said to their brothers, “Do you know that there is in these houses an ephod, and teraphim, and a carved image, and a molten image? Now therefore consider what you have to do.”

hausa: Marar azanci kan gaskata kome, amma mai la’akari kan yi tunani game da matakinsa.
english: A simple man believes everything, but the prudent man carefully considers his ways.

hausa: Na ga dukan abubuwan da ake yi a duniya, dukansu ba su da amfani, naushin iska ne kawai.
english: I have seen all the works that are done under the sun; and behold, all is vanity and a chasing after wind.

hausa: da shanu biyu, raguna biyar, bunsurai biyar da kuma ’yan raguna biyar, dukansu bana ɗaya-ɗaya, a miƙa su hadaya ta salama. Wannan ita ce hadayar Eliyab ɗan Helon.
english: and for the sacrifice of peace offerings, two head of cattle, five rams, five male goats, and five male lambs a year old. This was the offering of Eliab the son of Helon.

hausa: A wannan lokaci, da mutanen Benyamin suka fito daga Gibeya don su yaƙe su, sai suka sāke kashe Isra’ilawa dubu goma sha takwas, dukansu ɗauke da takuba.
english: Benjamin went out against them out of Gibeah the second day, and destroyed down to the ground of the children of Israel again eighteen thousand men. All these drew the sword.

hausa: Ka bayyana ikonka, ya Allah; ka nuna ƙarfinka, ya Allah, kamar yadda ka yi a dā.
english: Your God has commanded your strength. Strengthen, God, that which you have done for us.

hausa: sa’ad da na yi masa iyaka na sa masa ƙofofi da wurin kullewa.
english: marked out for it my bound, set bars and doors,

hausa: Sai bayin Na’aman suka je kusa da shi suka ce, “Baba, da a ce annabin ya ce ka yi wani abu mai wuya, da ba za ka yi ba? Balle fa cewa kawai ya yi, ‘Ka yi wanka ka kuma tsarkaka’!”
english: His servants came near and spoke to him, and said, “My father, if the prophet had asked you do some great thing, wouldn’t you have done it? How much rather then, when he says to you, ‘Wash, and be clean’?”

hausa: Laban ya ce in ka wulaƙanta ’ya’yana mata, ko ka auri waɗansu mata ban da ’ya’yana mata, ko da yake babu wani da yake tare da mu, ka tuna cewa Allah shi ne shaida tsakaninka da ni.”
english: If you afflict my daughters, or if you take wives in addition to my daughters, no man is with us; behold, God is witness between me and you.”

hausa: A shekara ta ashirin da bakwai na Asa sarkin Yahuda, Zimri ya yi mulki a Tirza kwana bakwai. Mayaƙa suka yi sansani kusa da Gibbeton, wani garin Filistiyawa.
english: In the twenty-seventh year of Asa king of Judah, Zimri reigned seven days in Tirzah. Now the people were encamped against Gibbethon, which belonged to the Philistines.

hausa: Nan take sai ga Musa da Iliya suka bayyana a gabansu, suna magana da Yesu.
english: Behold, Moses and Elijah appeared to them talking with him.

hausa: Sa’an nan ya tsawata musu cikin fushinsa ya kuma razanar da su cikin hasalarsa, yana cewa,
english: Then he will speak to them in his anger, and terrify them in his wrath:

hausa: Kwana shida za ku ci burodi marar yisti, a rana ta bakwai kuma sai ku yi taro ga Ubangiji Allahnku, a cikin wannan rana ba za ku yi kowane irin aiki ba.
english: Six days you shall eat unleavened bread. On the seventh day shall be a solemn assembly to Yahweh your God. You shall do no work.

hausa: da shanu biyu, raguna biyar, bunsurai biyar da kuma ’yan raguna biyar dukansu bana ɗaya-ɗaya, a miƙa su hadaya ta salama. Wannan ita ce hadayar Netanel ɗan Zuwar.
english: and for the sacrifice of peace offerings, two head of cattle, five rams, five male goats, five male lambs a year old. This was the offering of Nethanel the son of Zuar.

hausa: Ku kula, kada ku yi yarjejjeniya da waɗanda suke zaune a ƙasar da za ku tafi, in ba haka ba, za su zama muku tarko.
english: Be careful, lest you make a covenant with the inhabitants of the land where you are going, lest it be for a snare among you;

hausa: Amma Gideyon ya ce musu, “Ni, ko ɗana, ba za mu yi mulkinku ba. Ubangiji ne zai yi mulkinku.”
english: Gideon said to them, “I will not rule over you, neither shall my son rule over you. Yahweh shall rule over you.”

hausa: Ka tuna da bayinka Ibrahim, Ishaku da Yaƙub. Kada ka kula da taurinkan, mugunta da kuma zunubin wannan mutane.
english: Remember your servants, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. Don’t look at the stubbornness of this people, nor at their wickedness, nor at their sin,

hausa: Taron mutane mai yawan gaske suka taru kewaye da shi har ya kai sai da ya shiga jirgin ruwa ya zauna, yayinda dukan mutane suka tsaya a gaci.
english: Great multitudes gathered to him, so that he entered into a boat and sat; and all the multitude stood on the beach.

hausa: “ ‘Kada a sayar da gona ɗinɗinɗin, gama ƙasar tawa ce, ku kuwa baƙi ne kawai, kuma ’yan haya nawa.
english: “‘The land shall not be sold in perpetuity, for the land is mine; for you are strangers and live as foreigners with me.

hausa: Yanzu tsibirai suna rawar jiki a ranar fāɗuwarki; tsibirai a cikin teku sun tsorata a ɓacewarki.’
english: Now the islands will tremble in the day of your fall. Yes, the islands that are in the sea will be dismayed at your departure.’

hausa: Dukansu kuwa suka cika da Ruhu Mai Tsarki suka kuma fara magana da waɗansu harsuna yadda Ruhu ya sa suka iya.
english: They were all filled with the Holy Spirit and began to speak with other languages, as the Spirit gave them the ability to speak.

hausa: Da suka kai Urushalima, sai Yesu ya shiga filin haikalin, ya fara korar waɗanda suke saya da sayarwa a can. Ya tutture tebur na masu musayar kuɗi, da kujerun masu sayar da tattabaru,
english: They came to Jerusalem, and Jesus entered into the temple and began to throw out those who sold and those who bought in the temple, and overthrew the money changers’ tables and the seats of those who sold the doves.

hausa: Ba za a iya daidaita darajarta da duwatsun Tofaz na Kush ba, zallar zinariya ma ba tă isa ta saye ta ba.
english: The topaz of Ethiopia will not equal it. It won’t be valued with pure gold.

hausa: Ka fi Ibrahim mahaifinmu ne? Ya mutu, haka ma annabawa. Wa kake ɗauka kanka ne?”
english: Are you greater than our father Abraham, who died? The prophets died. Who do you make yourself out to be?”

hausa: Amma Yahudawa suka yi kishi; saboda haka suka tattara ’yan iska daga kasuwa, suka shirya wata ƙungiya, suka tā da tarzoma a birni. Suka ruga zuwa gidan Yason suna neman Bulus da Sila don su kawo su a gaban taron.
english: But the unpersuaded Jews took along some wicked men from the marketplace and gathering a crowd, set the city in an uproar. Assaulting the house of Jason, they sought to bring them out to the people.

hausa: haka ma tsire-tsire kusa da Nilu, a bakin kogi. Kowane abin da aka shuka a gefen Nilu zai bushe, iska ta kwashe su ƙaf.
english: The meadows by the Nile, by the brink of the Nile, and all the sown fields of the Nile, will become dry, be driven away, and be no more.

hausa: “Meshek da Tubal suna can, tare da dukan jama’arsu kewaye da kaburburansu. Dukansu marasa kaciya ne, da aka kashe da takobi domin sun haddasa tsoronsu a ƙasar masu rai.
english: “There is Meshech, Tubal, and all their multitude. Their graves are around them, all of them uncircumcised, slain by the sword; for they caused their terror in the land of the living.

hausa: sai ku zaɓi mafi cancanta a cikin ’ya’yan maigidanku ku sa shi a kan kursiyin mahaifinsa. Sa’an nan ku yi yaƙi don gidan maigidanku.”
english: select the best and fittest of your master’s sons, set him on his father’s throne, and fight for your master’s house.”

hausa: Sai mala’ikan Ubangiji ya bayyana gare shi, tsaye a dama da bagaden turare.
english: An angel of the Lord appeared to him, standing on the right side of the altar of incense.

hausa: Waɗannan su ne manyan jarumawan Dawuda, su ne, tare da dukan Isra’ila, suka ba wa mulkinsa goyon baya mai ƙarfi da ya kai bisa dukan ƙasar, yadda Ubangiji ya yi alkawari.
english: Now these are the chief of the mighty men whom David had, who showed themselves strong with him in his kingdom, together with all Israel, to make him king, according to Yahweh’s word concerning Israel.

hausa: Ku busa ƙaho a cikin Sihiyona; ku yi karar amo a tsaunina mai tsarki. Bari dukan mazaunan ƙasar su yi rawan jiki, gama ranar Ubangiji tana zuwa. Tana gab da faruwa
english: Blow the trumpet in Zion, and sound an alarm in my holy mountain! Let all the inhabitants of the land tremble, for the day of Yahweh comes, for it is close at hand:

hausa: Bayan an haifi Nuhu, Lamek ya yi shekara 595, yana kuma da ’ya’ya maza da mata.
english: Lamech lived after he became the father of Noah five hundred ninety-five years, and became the father of other sons and daughters.

hausa: Musa ya ɗebo dukan kitsen da yake kewaye da kayan ciki, da kuma wanda ya rufe hanta, da ƙodojin, da kuma kitsensu, ya kuma ƙone su a kan bagade.
english: He took all the fat that was on the innards, and the cover of the liver, and the two kidneys, and their fat; and Moses burned it on the altar.

hausa: Fir’auna Neko ya sa shi a sarƙa a Ribla a ƙasar Hamat don kada yă yi mulki a Urushalima, sa’an nan ya sa wa Yahuda harajin talenti ɗari na azurfa, da talenti ɗaya na zinariya.
english: Pharaoh Necoh put him in bonds at Riblah in the land of Hamath, that he might not reign in Jerusalem; and put the land to a tribute of one hundred talents of silver and a talent of gold.

hausa: sarkin Afek, ɗaya sarkin Sharon, ɗaya
english: the king of Aphek, one; the king of Lassharon, one;

hausa: Suna yin rayuwarsu cikin arziki kuma su mutu cikin salama.
english: They spend their days in prosperity. In an instant they go down to Sheol.

hausa: “Ni ne Ubangiji Allahnku, wanda ya fitar da ku daga Masar; zan sa ku sāke zauna a tentuna, kamar a kwanakin ƙayyadaddun bukukkuwanku.
english: “But I am Yahweh your God from the land of Egypt. I will yet again make you dwell in tents, as in the days of the solemn feast.

hausa: Mugaye suna fako suna jira masu adalci, suna ƙoƙari neman ransu;
english: The wicked watch the righteous, and seek to kill him.

hausa: Yesu ya kalle su ya ce, “Ga mutum kam, wannan ba mai yiwuwa ba ne, amma ga Allah, wannan mai yiwuwa ne; dukan abubuwa masu yiwuwa ne ga Allah.”
english: Jesus, looking at them, said, “With men it is impossible, but not with God, for all things are possible with God.”

hausa: Kwarin teku sun bayyana tussan duniya sun bayyana a fili sa’ad da ka tsawata, ya Ubangiji, sa’ad da ka numfasa daga hancinka.
english: Then the channels of waters appeared. The foundations of the world were laid bare at your rebuke, Yahweh, at the blast of the breath of your nostrils.

hausa: Saboda haka aka ba wa zuriyar Haruna Hebron (birnin mafaka), da Libna, Yattir Eshtemowa,
english: To the sons of Aaron they gave the cities of refuge, Hebron, Libnah also with its pasture lands, Jattir, Eshtemoa with its pasture lands,

hausa: Ku rera ga Ubangiji, ku tsarkakansa; ku yabi sunansa mai tsarki.
english: Sing praise to Yahweh, you saints of his. Give thanks to his holy name.

hausa: Gaba ɗaya dai, Nuhu ya yi shekara 950, sa’an nan ya mutu.
english: All the days of Noah were nine hundred fifty years, and then he died.

hausa: Duk da haka, yanzu ina farin ciki, ba don na sa ku baƙin ciki ba, sai dai domin baƙin cikinku ya kai ku ga tuba. Gama kun yi baƙin ciki kamar yadda Allah ya so, saboda haka, ba ku yi hasarar kome a sanadinmu ba.
english: I now rejoice, not that you were grieved, but that you were grieved to repentance. For you were grieved in a godly way, that you might suffer loss by us in nothing.

hausa: Rehobowam ya amsa, “Ku tafi, bayan kwana uku, ku dawo.” Sai mutane suka watse.
english: He said to them, “Depart for three days, then come back to me.” So the people departed.

hausa: Zan harbi kibiya uku ta wajen, sai ka ce dai ina harbin baka.
english: I will shoot three arrows on its side, as though I shot at a mark.

hausa: Suka yi sanduna da itacen ƙirya, suka kuma dalaye su da tagulla.
english: He made the poles of acacia wood, and overlaid them with bronze.

hausa: Jimillar dabbobi don hadaya ta salama, ta kai shanu ashirin huɗu, raguna sittin, bunsurai sittin da kuma ’yan raguna sittin, dukansu bana ɗaya-ɗaya. Waɗannan su ne hadayu saboda keɓewar bagade, bayan an shafe shi.
english: and all the cattle for the sacrifice of peace offerings: twenty-four bulls, sixty rams, sixty male goats, and sixty male lambs a year old. This was the dedication offering of the altar, after it was anointed.

hausa: A wannan rana mutumin Allah ya ba da alama, “Ga alamar da Ubangiji ya furta. Wannan bagade zai tsage yă rabu kashi biyu, tokar da yake a kansa za tă zuba a ƙasa.”
english: He gave a sign the same day, saying, “This is the sign which Yahweh has spoken: Behold, the altar will be split apart, and the ashes that are on it will be poured out.”

hausa: Bayan da suka gama yin masa ba’a, suka tuɓe rigar mai ruwan shunayyar, suka sa masa nasa tufafi. Sai suka tafi da shi don a gicciye shi.
english: When they had mocked him, they took the purple cloak off him, and put his own garments on him. They led him out to crucify him.

hausa: Tsayin filin zai zama kamu ɗari, fāɗinsa kuma kamu hamsin, tsayin labulensa na lallausan zaren lilin zai zama kamu biyar, a kuma yi rammukansa da tagulla.
english: The length of the court shall be one hundred cubits, and the width fifty throughout, and the height five cubits, of fine twined linen, and their sockets of bronze.

hausa: Suka yi kwana bakwai suna Bikin Burodi Marar Yisti, suna cike da farin ciki, gama Ubangiji ya cika su da farin ciki don ya sa sarkin Assuriya ya canja tunaninsa, ya taimake su cikin aikin gidan Allah, Allah na Isra’ila.
english: and kept the feast of unleavened bread seven days with joy; because Yahweh had made them joyful, and had turned the heart of the king of Assyria to them, to strengthen their hands in the work of God, the God of Israel’s house.

hausa: Kada ku yi wa juna ƙarya, da yake kun tuɓe tsohon halinku tare da ayyukansa
english: Don’t lie to one another, seeing that you have put off the old man with his doings,

hausa: Dukan ƙasashe kuwa suka zo Masar don saya hatsi daga Yusuf, gama yunwa ta yi tsanani a dukan duniya.
english: All countries came into Egypt, to Joseph, to buy grain, because the famine was severe in all the earth.

hausa: Sa’an nan na ga sabon sama da sabuwar duniya, gama sama na farko da duniya ta farko sun shuɗe, babu kuma wani teku.
english: I saw a new heaven and a new earth, for the first heaven and the first earth have passed away, and the sea is no more.

hausa: Sa’ad da ya fitar da dukan nasa waje, sai ya ja gabansu, tumakinsa kuma sukan bi shi domin sun san muryarsa.
english: Whenever he brings out his own sheep, he goes before them; and the sheep follow him, for they know his voice.

hausa: Bayan mulkin Rehobowam ya kahu kamar sarki ya kuma yi ƙarfi, shi da dukan Isra’ila suka yi biris da dokar Ubangiji.
english: When the kingdom of Rehoboam was established and he was strong, he abandoned Yahweh’s law, and all Israel with him.

hausa: Sai Allah ya ce, “Ni ne Allah, Allah na mahaifinka. Kada ka ji tsoron zuwa Masar, gama zan mai da kai al’umma mai girma a can.
english: He said, “I am God, the God of your father. Don’t be afraid to go down into Egypt, for there I will make of you a great nation.

hausa: Wannan ne zai zama tsattsarkan rabo domin firistoci. Tsawon zai zama kamu 25,000 a wajen arewa, fāɗin kuma kamu 10,000 wajen yamma, kamu 10,000 zai zama fāɗinsa a wajen gabas, tsawonsa a wajen kudu zai zama kamu 25,000. A tsakiyarsa ne wuri mai tsarki na Ubangiji zai kasance.
english: For these, even for the priests, shall be the holy offering: toward the north twenty-five thousand in length, and toward the west ten thousand in width, and toward the east ten thousand in width, and toward the south twenty-five thousand in length; and the sanctuary of Yahweh shall be in the middle of it.

hausa: “Zan kuma zubo wa gidan Dawuda da mazaunan Urushalima ruhun alheri da na addu’a. Za su dube ni, wannan da suka soke shi, za su kuma yi makoki dominsa kamar yadda mutum yakan yi makokin mutuwar ɗansa tilo, su kuma yi baƙin ciki ƙwarai kamar yadda mutum yakan yi baƙin ciki don ɗan fari.
english: I will pour on David’s house and on the inhabitants of Jerusalem the spirit of grace and of supplication. They will look to me whom they have pierced; and they shall mourn for him as one mourns for his only son, and will grieve bitterly for him as one grieves for his firstborn.

hausa: Ku dogara ga Ubangiji da kuma ƙarfinsa; ku nemi fuskarsa kullum.
english: Seek Yahweh and his strength. Seek his face forever more.

hausa: Sa’an nan Ubangiji ya ce wa Nuhu. “Shiga jirgin, kai da dukan iyalinka, gama na ga kai mai adalci ne a wannan zamani.
english: Yahweh said to Noah, “Come with all of your household into the ship, for I have seen your righteousness before me in this generation.

hausa: Zuciyarsa kuwa ta damu da son Dina ’yar Yaƙub, ya kuwa ƙaunaci yarinyar, ya yi mata magana a hankali.
english: His soul joined to Dinah, the daughter of Jacob, and he loved the young lady, and spoke kindly to the young lady.

hausa: Da Dawuda ya isa ƙwanƙoli, inda mutane sun saba yi wa Allah sujada, Hushai, mutumin Arkitawa kuwa yana can don yă tarye shi, taguwarsa a yage, ga kuma ƙura a kansa.
english: When David had come to the top, where God was worshiped, behold, Hushai the Archite came to meet him with his tunic torn and earth on his head.

hausa: Amma akwai wani wurin da wani ya shaida cewa, “Mene ne mutum, da kake tuna da shi, ɗan mutum da kake kula da shi?
english: But one has somewhere testified, saying, “What is man, that you think of him? Or the son of man, that you care for him?

hausa: Saboda ƙuncin rayuwar da ake ciki, ina gani ya fi kyau ku kasance yadda kuke.
english: Therefore I think that because of the distress that is on us, it’s good for a man to remain as he is.

hausa: Hilen, Debir,
english: Hilen with its pasture lands, Debir with its pasture lands,

hausa: Yaƙub ya ce, “Ka rantse mini.” Sai Yusuf ya rantse masa, Isra’ila kuwa ya yi godiya ga Allah yayinda ya jingina a kan sandansa.
english: Israel said, “Swear to me,” and he swore to him. Then Israel bowed himself on the bed’s head.

hausa: Zai ceci wanda ma yake mai laifi, wanda zai tsirar da shi ta wurin tsabtar hannuwanka.”
english: He will even deliver him who is not innocent. Yes, he will be delivered through the cleanness of your hands.”

hausa: sa’an nan haka ba kwa ƙara barinsa yă yi wa mahaifinsa ko mahaifiyarsa wani abu.
english: “then you no longer allow him to do anything for his father or his mother,

hausa: Ku ji karar bulala da kwaramniyar ƙafafu, da sukuwar dawakai da girgizar kekunan yaƙi!
english: The noise of the whip, the noise of the rattling of wheels, prancing horses, and bounding chariots,

hausa: Me ya sa wahalata ba ta ƙarewa mikina kuma ba ya warkuwa? Za ka zama mini kamar rafi mai yaudara ne, kamar maɓulɓulan da ta kafe ne?
english: Why is my pain perpetual, and my wound incurable, which refuses to be healed? Will you indeed be to me as a deceitful brook, like waters that fail?

hausa: Mutanen Yahuda suka taru gaba ɗaya don su nemi taimako daga wurin Ubangiji, tabbatacce suka fito daga kowane garin Yahuda don su neme shi.
english: Judah gathered themselves together to seek help from Yahweh. They came out of all the cities of Judah to seek Yahweh.

hausa: In wani ya fita kan hanya, alhakin jininsa yă kasance a kansa; ba ruwanmu. Amma in aka taɓa wani da yake cikin gidanki tare da ke, alhakin jininsa yana kanmu.
english: It shall be that whoever goes out of the doors of your house into the street, his blood will be on his head, and we will be guiltless. Whoever is with you in the house, his blood shall be on our head, if any hand is on him.

hausa: ’Ya’yan Lawi maza su ne, Gershon, Kohat da Merari.
english: The sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.

hausa: A shekara ta huɗu ta Yehohiyakim ɗan Yosiya sarkin Yahuda, wannan magana ta zo wa Irmiya daga wurin Ubangiji cewa,
english: In the fourth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah, this word came to Jeremiah from Yahweh, saying,

hausa: Ɗan Mutum ya zo yana ci, yana sha, sai kuka ce, ‘Ga mai yawan ci, mashayi, da kuma abokin masu karɓar haraji da masu zunubi.’
english: The Son of Man has come eating and drinking, and you say, ‘Behold, a glutton and a drunkard, a friend of tax collectors and sinners!’

hausa: “Zan tula masifu a kansu in kuma gama kibiyoyina a kansu.
english: “I will heap evils on them. I will spend my arrows on them.

hausa: Da sai in ji daɗi duk zafin da nake sha ban hana maganar Mai Tsarkin nan cika ba.
english: Let it still be my consolation, yes, let me exult in pain that doesn’t spare, that I have not denied the words of the Holy One.

hausa: an yi wa taguwar wuyan wundi a tsakiya kamar sulke, aka daje wuyan don kada yă kece.
english: The opening of the robe in the middle of it was like the opening of a coat of mail, with a binding around its opening, that it should not be torn.

hausa: Ɗaya daga cikinsu, mai suna Kiliyobas, ya tambaye shi ya ce, “Ashe, kai baƙo ne a Urushalima, da ba ka san abubuwan da suka faru a can, a cikin kwanakin nan ba?”
english: One of them, named Cleopas, answered him, “Are you the only stranger in Jerusalem who doesn’t know the things which have happened there in these days?”

hausa: Sa’an nan aka sa zoban kurkusa da bakin don riƙe sandunan da ake amfani da su wurin ɗaukan teburin.
english: The rings were close by the border, the places for the poles to carry the table.

hausa: Saboda ungozomomin suna tsoron Allah, sai Allah ya ba su iyalan kansu.
english: Because the midwives feared God, he gave them families.

hausa: Ko ikonsa ba ya ba ku tsoro? Tsoronsa ba zai auka muku ba?
english: Won’t his majesty make you afraid and his dread fall on you?

hausa: Sai dai kada ku tayar wa Ubangiji. Kada kuma ku ji tsoron mutane ƙasar, domin za mu gama da su. Kāriyarsu ta gama, amma Ubangiji yana nan tare da mu. Kada ku ji tsoronsu.”
english: Only don’t rebel against Yahweh, neither fear the people of the land; for they are bread for us. Their defense is removed from over them, and Yahweh is with us. Don’t fear them.”

hausa: Za ki cika da buguwa da baƙin ciki, kwaf lalaci da kaɗaici, kwaf na ’yar’uwarki Samariya.
english: You will be filled with drunkenness and sorrow, with the cup of astonishment and desolation, with the cup of your sister Samaria.

hausa: Ka lura fa, kada hasken da yake cikinka ya zamana duhu ne.
english: Therefore see whether the light that is in you isn’t darkness.

hausa: Shimeyi mutumin Ramat shi ne mai lura da gonakin inabi. Zabdi mutumin Shifam shi ne mai lura da amfanin gonakin inabi don matsin ruwan inabi.
english: Over the vineyards was Shimei the Ramathite. Over the increase of the vineyards for the wine cellars was Zabdi the Shiphmite.

hausa: Da Yesu yana zaune a kan Dutsen Zaitun da yake ɗaura da haikali, sai Bitrus, Yaƙub, Yohanna da kuma Andarawus, suka tambaye shi a ɓoye, suka ce,
english: As he sat on the Mount of Olives opposite the temple, Peter, James, John, and Andrew asked him privately,

hausa: Mai yin ba’a yakan ƙi gyara; ba zai nemi shawara mai hikima ba.
english: A scoffer doesn’t love to be reproved; he will not go to the wise.

hausa: Ya kori al’ummai a gabansu ya rarraba ƙasashensu gare su a matsayin gādo; ya zaunar da kabilan Isra’ila a gidajensu.
english: He also drove out the nations before them, allotted them for an inheritance by line, and made the tribes of Israel to dwell in their tents.

hausa: Hanyar adali kamar fitowar rana ce, sai ƙara haske take yi, har ta kai tsaka.
english: But the path of the righteous is like the dawning light that shines more and more until the perfect day.

hausa: Zan daga kwaf na ceto in kuma kira ga sunan Ubangiji.
english: I will take the cup of salvation, and call on Yahweh’s name.

hausa: Duk wanda yake da Ɗan, yana da rai; wanda kuwa ba shi da Ɗan Allah, ba shi da rai.
english: He who has the Son has the life. He who doesn’t have God’s Son doesn’t have the life.

hausa: Sai sojojin suka karɓi kuɗin, suka kuma yi kamar yadda aka umarce su. Wannan labarin kuwa shi ne ake bazawa ko’ina a cikin Yahudawa, har yă zuwa yau.
english: So they took the money and did as they were told. This saying was spread abroad among the Jews, and continues until today.

hausa: Sarkin Isra’ila ya ce wa Yehoshafat, “Ban faɗa maka cewa bai taɓa yin annabci wani abu mai kyau game da ni, in ba masifa ba?”
english: The king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, “Didn’t I tell you that he would not prophesy good concerning me, but evil?”

hausa: To, Yohanna ma yana yin baftisma a Ainon kusa da Salim, saboda akwai ruwa da yawa a can, mutane kuwa suka yi ta zuwa don a yi musu baftisma.
english: John also was baptizing in Enon near Salim, because there was much water there. They came and were baptized;

hausa: Ba ni da wani kamar sa, wanda yake da ainihin sha’awa a zaman lafiyarku.
english: For I have no one else like-minded, who will truly care about you.

hausa: Sai ta fita ta ce wa mahaifiyarta, “Me zan roƙa?” Ta ce, “Kan Yohanna Mai Baftisma.”
english: She went out and said to her mother, “What shall I ask?” She said, “The head of John the Baptizer.”

hausa: Duk da haka, muddin ina raye, kuma muddin ɗaukakar Ubangiji ta cika dukan duniya,
english: but in very deed—as I live, and as all the earth shall be filled with Yahweh’s glory—

hausa: don neman rayuwa ta horo da kuma ta hankali, kana yin abin da yake daidai, mai adalci da kuma wanda ya dace;
english: to receive instruction in wise dealing, in righteousness, justice, and equity;

hausa: Ka share mutane cikin barcin mutuwa; suna kama da sabuwa ciyawar safiya,
english: You sweep them away as they sleep. In the morning they sprout like new grass.

hausa: bayan ya ci abinci, sai sāke samun ƙarfi. Shawulu ya yi kwanaki masu yawa tare da almajiran da suke a Damaskus.
english: He took food and was strengthened. Saul stayed several days with the disciples who were at Damascus.

hausa: Amma shirye-shiryen Ubangiji kan tsaya daram har abada, manufofin zuciyarsa kuwa har dukan zamanai.
english: The counsel of Yahweh stands fast forever, the thoughts of his heart to all generations.

hausa: A lokacin an naɗa mutane su lura da ɗakunan ajiya don sadakoki, nunan fari da kuma zakka. Daga gonakin garuruwan da suke kewaye za su kawo sassan da Dokar ta umarta zuwa ɗakunan ajiya domin firistoci da Lawiyawa, gama Yahuda ya ji daɗin aikin firistoci da Lawiyawa.
english: On that day, men were appointed over the rooms for the treasures, for the wave offerings, for the first fruits, and for the tithes, to gather into them according to the fields of the cities the portions appointed by the law for the priests and Levites; for Judah rejoiced for the priests and for the Levites who served.

hausa: wato, dukan sauran bijimi, dole yă ɗauke su zuwa waje da sansani zuwa wani wuri mai tsabta inda ake zub da toka, yă ƙone shi a itacen da yake cin wuta a tarin toka.
english: —all the rest of the bull—outside of the camp to a clean place where the ashes are poured out, and burn it on wood with fire. It shall be burned where the ashes are poured out.

hausa: Yakan ce wa kansa, “Ai, Allah ya manta; ya rufe fuskarsa ba ya gani.”
english: He says in his heart, “God has forgotten. He hides his face. He will never see it.”

hausa: ku ƙi kowace mugunta.
english: Abstain from every form of evil.

hausa: ka girmama mahaifinka da mahaifiyarka,’ka kuma ‘ƙaunaci maƙwabcinka kamar kanka.’”
english: ‘Honor your father and your mother.’ And, ‘You shall love your neighbor as yourself.’”

hausa: “In ka yi wauta ka kuma ɗaukaka kanka, ko kuwa wani yana ƙulla maka mugunta, ka dāfa hannunka a bisa bakinka!
english: “If you have done foolishly in lifting up yourself, or if you have thought evil, put your hand over your mouth.

hausa: “ ‘Kada ku ƙazantar da kanku da wani daga cikin waɗannan, domin haka al’umman da zan kora a gabanku suka ƙazantu.
english: “‘Don’t defile yourselves in any of these things; for in all these the nations which I am casting out before you were defiled.

hausa: Zabura ta Dawuda. Sa’ad da ya gudu daga ɗansa Absalom. Ya Ubangiji, abokan gābana nawa ne! Su nawa suke gāba da ni!
english: A Psalm by David, when he fled from Absalom his son. Yahweh, how my adversaries have increased! Many are those who rise up against me.

hausa: Ku dubi hankaki. Ba sa shuki ko girbi, kuma ba su da ɗakin ajiya ko rumbu ba, duk da haka, duk da haka, Allah na ciyar da su. Darajarku ta fi na tsuntsaye sau da yawa!
english: Consider the ravens: they don’t sow, they don’t reap, they have no warehouse or barn, and God feeds them. How much more valuable are you than birds!

hausa: Hezekiya kansa bai rushe waɗannan masujadan kan tudu da bagadai, yana ce wa Yahuda da Urushalima, ‘Dole ku yi sujada a gaban bagade guda ku kuma ƙone hadayu a kansa ba’?
english: Hasn’t the same Hezekiah taken away his high places and his altars, and commanded Judah and Jerusalem, saying, ‘You shall worship before one altar, and you shall burn incense on it’?

hausa: Sa’ad da Mafi Ɗaukaka ya ba da al’ummai gādonsu, sa’ad da ya raba dukan ’yan adam, ya kafa iyakoki wa mutane bisa ga yawan ’ya’yan Isra’ila maza.
english: When the Most High gave to the nations their inheritance, when he separated the children of men, he set the bounds of the peoples according to the number of the children of Israel.

hausa: Solomon ya haura zuwa bagaden tagulla a gaban Ubangiji a cikin Tentin Sujada, ya kuma miƙa hadayu na ƙonawa dubbai a kansa.
english: Solomon went up there to the bronze altar before Yahweh, which was at the Tent of Meeting, and offered one thousand burnt offerings on it.

hausa: Ta wurin bangaskiya ne Yusuf, sa’ad da kwanakinsa suka yi kusan ƙarewa, ya yi magana game da fitowar Isra’ilawa daga Masar ya kuma ba da umarni game da ƙasusuwansa.
english: By faith Joseph, when his end was near, made mention of the departure of the children of Israel, and gave instructions concerning his bones.

hausa: sai ku yanke hannunta. Kada ku ji tausayinta.
english: then you shall cut off her hand. Your eye shall have no pity.

hausa: Duk da haka, bai kawar da masujadan kan tudu ba; mutane suka ci gaba da yin hadaya da ƙona turare a can. Yotam ya sāke gina Ƙofar Bisa ta haikalin Ubangiji.
english: However the high places were not taken away. The people still sacrificed and burned incense in the high places. He built the upper gate of Yahweh’s house.

hausa: Ku rera ɗaukaka ga sunansa; ku sa yabonsa yă zama da ɗaukaka!
english: Sing to the glory of his name! Offer glory and praise!

hausa: A lokacin Ubangiji ya ce mini, “Ka sassaƙa alluna biyu na dutse kamar na farko, ka haura wurina a kan dutse. Ka kuma yi akwatin katako.
english: At that time Yahweh said to me, “Cut two stone tablets like the first, and come up to me onto the mountain, and make an ark of wood.

hausa: Sarki ya umarci Haman ya ce, “Tafi yanzu ka karɓi rigar da dokin, ka kuma yi yadda ka shawarta wa Mordekai, mutumin Yahudan nan, wanda yake zama a bakin ƙofar sarki. Kada ka kāsa yin kome daga cikin abin da ka faɗa.”
english: Then the king said to Haman, “Hurry and take the clothing and the horse, as you have said, and do this for Mordecai the Jew, who sits at the king’s gate. Let nothing fail of all that you have spoken.”

hausa: Dukansu kuwa za a bizne su a ƙasa, kuma tsutsotsi za su cinye su.
english: They lie down alike in the dust. The worm covers them.

hausa: “Bawan ya dawo ya ce, ‘Ranka yă daɗe, an yi abin da ka umarta, amma har yanzu da sauran wuri.’
english: “The servant said, ‘Lord, it is done as you commanded, and there is still room.’

hausa: A kwanaki masu zuwa Yaƙub zai yi saiwa, Isra’ila zai yi toho ya kuma yi fure ya cika dukan duniya da ’ya’ya.
english: In days to come, Jacob will take root. Israel will blossom and bud. They will fill the surface of the world with fruit.

hausa: Wannan mutum Yehohiyacin ne da aka rena, fasasshen tukunya, abin da babu wanda yake so? Me ya sa za a jefar da shi da ’ya’yansa a jefar da su a ƙasar da ba su sani ba?
english: Is this man Coniah a despised broken vessel? Is he a vessel in which no one delights? Why are they cast out, he and his offspring, and cast into a land which they don’t know?

hausa: ya kuma cece shi daga dukan wahalolinsa. Ya ba wa Yusuf hikima ya kuma sa ya sami farin jini a wurin Fir’auna, sarkin Masar; saboda haka ya mai da shi mai mulki a kan Masar da kuma dukan fadarsa.
english: and delivered him out of all his afflictions, and gave him favor and wisdom before Pharaoh, king of Egypt. He made him governor over Egypt and all his house.

hausa: Elisha ya ce, “Kada ka kashe su. Za ka kashe mutanen da ka kame da takobi ko bakanka? Ka ba su abinci da ruwa su ci, su sha, sa’an nan su koma wurin maigidansu.”
english: He answered, “You shall not strike them. Would you strike those whom you have taken captive with your sword and with your bow? Set bread and water before them, that they may eat and drink, then go to their master.”

hausa: Yayinda Yohanna yake kammala aikinsa ya ce, ‘Wa kuke tsammani ni nake? Ba ni ne shi ba. A’a, amma yana zuwa bayana, wanda ko takalmansa ma ban isa in kunce ba.’
english: As John was fulfilling his course, he said, ‘What do you suppose that I am? I am not he. But behold, one comes after me, the sandals of whose feet I am not worthy to untie.’

hausa: Saboda haka, ku sani cewa Ubangiji Allahnku, shi ne Allah; shi Allah ne mai aminci, yana kiyaye alkawarinsa na ƙauna ga tsararraki dubu na waɗanda suke ƙaunarsa suke kuma kiyaye umarnansa.
english: Know therefore that Yahweh your God himself is God, the faithful God, who keeps covenant and loving kindness to a thousand generations with those who love him and keep his commandments,

hausa: Oholibama kuwa ta haifa masa Yewush, Yalam da Kora. Waɗannan su ne ’ya’yan Isuwa maza, waɗanda aka haifa masa a Kan’ana.
english: Oholibamah bore Jeush, Jalam, and Korah. These are the sons of Esau, who were born to him in the land of Canaan.

hausa: A can ne kabilu suke haurawa, kabilan Ubangiji, don su yabi sunan Ubangiji bisa ga farillan da aka ba wa Isra’ila.
english: where the tribes go up, even Yah’s tribes, according to an ordinance for Israel, to give thanks to Yahweh’s name.

hausa: Bitrus ya ja shi gefe ya fara tsawata masa yana cewa, “Sam, Ubangiji! Wannan ba zai taɓa faruwa da kai ba!”
english: Peter took him aside and began to rebuke him, saying, “Far be it from you, Lord! This will never be done to you.”

hausa: Sai duk taron suka yi tsit yayinda suke sauraron Barnabas da Bulus suna ba da labari game da ayyuka da kuma abubuwan banmamakin da Allah ya yi a cikin Al’ummai ta wurinsu.
english: All the multitude kept silence, and they listened to Barnabas and Paul reporting what signs and wonders God had done among the nations through them.

hausa: Da yamma, sai razana ba tsammani! Kafin safiya, duk sun ɓace! Wannan ne rabon waɗanda suka washe mu, rabon waɗanda suka yi mana ƙwace.
