english: At evening, behold, terror! Before the morning, they are no more. This is the portion of those who plunder us, and the lot of those who rob us.

hausa: Sa’ad da aka busa su biyu, dukan jama’a za su taru a gabanka a ƙofar Tentin Sujada.
english: When they blow them, all the congregation shall gather themselves to you at the door of the Tent of Meeting.

hausa: Kaɗan da kake da shi kafin zuwata ya ƙaru sosai, kuma Ubangiji ya albarkace ka a duk inda na tafi. Amma yanzu, yaushe zan yi wani abu domin gidana ni ma?”
english: For it was little which you had before I came, and it has increased to a multitude. Yahweh has blessed you wherever I turned. Now when will I provide for my own house also?”

hausa: Saboda haka ka faɗa musu cewa, ‘Wannan ce al’ummar da ba tă yi biyayya ga Ubangiji Allahnta ba, ba kuwa ta karɓi gyara ba. Gaskiya ta ƙare; ta ɓace gaba ɗaya daga leɓunansu.
english: You shall tell them, ‘This is the nation that has not listened to Yahweh their God’s voice, nor received instruction. Truth has perished, and is cut off from their mouth.’

hausa: Don son yă faranta wa taron rai, sai Bilatus ya sakar musu Barabbas. Ya sa aka yi wa Yesu bulala, sa’an nan ya ba da shi a gicciye.
english: Pilate, wishing to please the multitude, released Barabbas to them, and handed over Jesus, when he had flogged him, to be crucified.

hausa: Amma wanda yakan ji kalmomina, ba ya kuma aikata su, yana kama da mutumin da ya gina gida a ƙasa, ba tare da ya kafa tushen gini ba. A sa’ad da ƙarfin ruwa ya buga gidan, sai gidan yă rushe, mummunar rushewa kuwa.”
english: But he who hears and doesn’t do, is like a man who built a house on the earth without a foundation, against which the stream broke, and immediately it fell; and the ruin of that house was great.”

hausa: Wane ne ba zai girmama ka ba, Ya Sarkin al’ummai? Tsoronka wajibi ne. A cikin dukan masu hikima na al’ummai kuma cikin dukan mulkokinsu, babu kamar ka.
english: Who shouldn’t fear you, King of the nations? For it belongs to you. Because among all the wise men of the nations, and in all their royal estate, there is no one like you.

hausa: “Ba za su koma Masar ba Assuriya kuma ba za tă yi mulki a bisansu ba saboda sun ƙi su tuba ba?
english: “They won’t return into the land of Egypt; but the Assyrian will be their king, because they refused to repent.

hausa: An yi wani ɗan ƙaramin birni mai mutane kaɗan a ciki. Sai wani babban sarki ya kawo masa yaƙi, ya kafa masa babban sansani.
english: There was a little city, and few men within it; and a great king came against it, besieged it, and built great bulwarks against it.

hausa: In wani ya mare ka a wannan kumatu, juya masa ɗayan ma, in wani ya ƙwace maka babban riga, kada ma ka hana masa ’yar cikin ma.
english: To him who strikes you on the cheek, offer also the other; and from him who takes away your cloak, don’t withhold your coat also.

hausa: “ ‘Muddin in raye, in ji Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka, zai mutu a Babilon, a ƙasar sarkin nan da ya naɗa shi, domin bai cika rantsuwa da alkawarin da ya yi ba.
english: “‘As I live,’ says the Lord Yahweh, ‘surely in the place where the king dwells who made him king, whose oath he despised, and whose covenant he broke, even with him in the middle of Babylon he will die.

hausa: Suka kwashe dukan ganima haɗe da mutane da dabbobi,
english: They took all the captives, and all the plunder, both of man and of animal.

hausa: gama sa’ad da jama’a suka yi tayarwa saboda rashin ruwa a Hamadan Zin, ku biyu, ba ku kiyaye umarnina don ku ɗaukaka ni matsayin mai tsarki, a gabansu ba.” (Waɗannan su ne ruwaye na Meriba da Kadesh, a Hamadan Zin.)
english: because in the strife of the congregation, you rebelled against my word in the wilderness of Zin, to honor me as holy at the waters before their eyes.” (These are the waters of Meribah of Kadesh in the wilderness of Zin.)

hausa: In mai mulki yana sauraran ƙarairayi, dukan ma’aikatansa za su zama mugaye.
english: If a ruler listens to lies, all of his officials are wicked.

hausa: Kai ne Allah mafakata. Me ya sa ka ƙi ni? Me zai sa in yi ta yawo ina makoki, a danne a hannun abokin gāba?
english: For you are the God of my strength. Why have you rejected me? Why do I go mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?

hausa: Sai ta ce masa, “I, Ubangiji, na gaskata kai ne Kiristi, Ɗan Allah, mai zuwa cikin duniya.”
english: She said to him, “Yes, Lord. I have come to believe that you are the Christ, God’s Son, he who comes into the world.”

hausa: Waƙar haurawa. Na yi kira ga Ubangiji cikin damuwata, ya kuwa amsa mini.
english: A Song of Ascents. In my distress, I cried to Yahweh. He answered me.

hausa: Ko ma yayinda suke a masarautarsu, suna jin daɗin girmar kyautatawarka gare su, cikin ƙasar mai girma, da kuma mai fāɗin da ka ba su, ba su bauta maka ko su juye daga mugayen hanyoyinsu ba.
english: For they have not served you in their kingdom, and in your great goodness that you gave them, and in the large and rich land which you gave before them. They didn’t turn from their wicked works.

hausa: Ya Ubangiji, ta wurin kiyaye dukan ayyukanka na adalci, ka huce daga fushinka da hukuncinka da ka yi a kan Urushalima, birninka, tudunka mai tsarki. Zunubinmu da laifofin iyayenmu sun mai da Urushalima da kuma mutanenka abin ba’a ga dukan waɗanda suke kewaye da mu.
english: Lord, according to all your righteousness, please let your anger and your wrath be turned away from your city Jerusalem, your holy mountain; because for our sins and for the iniquities of our fathers, Jerusalem and your people have become a reproach to all who are around us.

hausa: “Yi magana domin bebaye, domin hakkin dukan waɗanda suke naƙasassu.
english: Open your mouth for the mute, in the cause of all who are left desolate.

hausa: Musa, Haruna da kuma shugabannin jama’a, suka ƙidaya Kohatawa ta kabilarsu da kuma iyalansu.
english: Moses and Aaron and the princes of the congregation counted the sons of the Kohathites by their families, and by their fathers’ houses,

hausa: Yanzu da bangaskiya ta zo, ba sauran zamanmu a ƙarƙashin Doka.
english: But now that faith has come, we are no longer under a tutor.

hausa: A ranar sha bakwai ga wata na biyu, na shekara ta ɗari shida na rayuwar Nuhu, a ran nan sai dukan maɓuɓɓugai na manyan zurfafa suka fashe, tagogin sammai suka buɗe.
english: In the six hundredth year of Noah’s life, in the second month, on the seventeenth day of the month, on that day all the fountains of the great deep burst open, and the sky’s windows opened.

hausa: Shi zuriyar Ferez ne kuma babba na dukan shugabannin mayaƙa don wata na farko.
english: He was of the children of Perez, the chief of all the captains of the army for the first month.

hausa: Ya ci gaba da cewa, “Ku lura da abin da kuke ji da kyau. Mudun da ka auna da shi, da shi za a auna maka, har ma a ƙara.
english: He said to them, “Take heed what you hear. With whatever measure you measure, it will be measured to you; and more will be given to you who hear.

hausa: Gama duk wanda ya same ni ya sami rai zai kuma sami tagomashi daga Ubangiji.
english: For whoever finds me finds life, and will obtain favor from Yahweh.

hausa: Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka ya ba ni harshen umarni, don in san maganar da za tă ƙarfafa gajiyayye. Ya farkar da ni da safe, ya farkar da kunnena don in saurara kamar wanda ake koya masa.
english: The Lord Yahweh has given me the tongue of those who are taught, that I may know how to sustain with words him who is weary. He awakens morning by morning, he awakens my ear to hear as those who are taught.

hausa: Ruhun Ubangiji ya sauko masa, domin yă zama mahukuncin Isra’ila yă kuma je yaƙi. Ubangiji ya bayar da Kushan-Rishatayim sarkin Aram a hannun Otniyel, ya kuwa sha ƙarfinsa.
english: Yahweh’s Spirit came on him, and he judged Israel; and he went out to war, and Yahweh delivered Cushan Rishathaim king of Mesopotamia into his hand. His hand prevailed against Cushan Rishathaim.

hausa: Na san wanda zai fanshe ni yana nan da rai, kuma a ƙarshe zai tsaya a kan duniya.
english: But as for me, I know that my Redeemer lives. In the end, he will stand upon the earth.

hausa: Ibrahim ya yarda da sharuɗan Efron, sai ya auna masa farashin da ya faɗa a kunnuwan Hittiyawa, shekel ɗari huɗu na azurfa, bisa ga ma’aunin da ’yan kasuwa suke amfani da shi a lokacin.
english: Abraham listened to Ephron. Abraham weighed to Ephron the silver which he had named in the hearing of the children of Heth, four hundred shekels of silver, according to the current merchants’ standard.

hausa: Saboda haka Gad ya tafi wurin Dawuda ya ce masa, “Ga abin da Ubangiji ya ce, ‘Ka yi zaɓi,
english: So Gad came to David and said to him, “Yahweh says, ‘Take your choice:

hausa: sai Ishaku ya yi tambaya, ya ce wa mahaifinsa Ibrahim, “Baba?” Ibrahim ya ce masa, “Na’am ɗana!” Ishaku ya ce, “Ga dai wuta, ga kuma itace, amma ina ɗan ragon hadaya ta ƙonawa?”
english: Isaac spoke to Abraham his father, and said, “My father?” He said, “Here I am, my son.” He said, “Here is the fire and the wood, but where is the lamb for a burnt offering?”

hausa: Ga abin da Ubangiji, Ubangiji Maɗaukaki, ya faɗa, “Je, ka faɗa wa wannan mai hidima, Shebna, sarkin fada.
english: The Lord, Yahweh of Armies says, “Go, get yourself to this treasurer, even to Shebna, who is over the house, and say,

hausa: ya sauko da Manna wa mutanensa don su ci, ya ba su hatsin sama.
english: He rained down manna on them to eat, and gave them food from the sky.

hausa: Wannan abu ya faru saboda zunuban da Yerobowam ya yi, ya kuma sa Isra’ila ya yi, kuma saboda ya tsokane Ubangiji, Allah na Isra’ila, ya yi fushi.
english: for the sins of Jeroboam which he sinned, and with which he made Israel to sin, because of his provocation with which he provoked Yahweh, the God of Israel, to anger.

hausa: Sama da ƙasa za su shuɗe, amma maganata ba za tă taɓa shuɗe ba.
english: Heaven and earth will pass away, but my words will not pass away.

hausa: “Ku kasa kunne gare ni, mutanena; ku ji ni, al’ummata. Doka za tă fito daga gare ni; shari’ata za tă zama haske ga al’ummai.
english: “Listen to me, my people; and hear me, my nation, for a law will go out from me, and I will establish my justice for a light to the peoples.

hausa: “Ni ne kuringar inabi na gaskiya, Ubana kuwa shi ne manomin.
english: “I am the true vine, and my Father is the farmer.

hausa: Cikin hamayya da shi waɗannan ’yan ƙasar Shekem suka sa mutane a kan tuddai don su yi kwanton ɓauna a kan su yi fashi ga duk wanda ya wuce a can, wannan fa ya kai kunnen Abimelek.
english: The men of Shechem set an ambush for him on the tops of the mountains, and they robbed all who came along that way by them; and Abimelech was told about it.

hausa: Ka ba ta ladar da ya dace tă samo wa kanta, bari kuma ayyukanta su kawo mata yabo a ƙofar shiga birni.
english: Give her of the fruit of her hands! Let her works praise her in the gates!

hausa: ban da harajin da fatakai da ’yan kasuwa suke biya. Haka kuma dukan sarakunan Arabiya da gwamnonin ƙasar suka kawo zinariya da azurfa wa Solomon.
english: in addition to that which the traders and merchants brought. All the kings of Arabia and the governors of the country brought gold and silver to Solomon.

hausa: Ya rufe bangon ciki da katakan itacen al’ul tun daga ƙasa har zuwa sama, ya kuma rufe daɓen da katakan itacen fir.
english: He built the walls of the house within with boards of cedar; from the floor of the house to the walls of the ceiling, he covered them on the inside with wood. He covered the floor of the house with cypress boards.

hausa: haka ma Ma’asehiya, Shemahiya, Eleyazar, Uzzi, Yehohanan, Malkiya, Elam da Ezer. Mawaƙan suka rera waƙoƙi a ƙarƙashin kulawar Yezrahiya.
english: and Maaseiah, Shemaiah, Eleazar, Uzzi, Jehohanan, Malchijah, Elam, and Ezer. The singers sang loud, with Jezrahiah their overseer.

hausa: Adalai kan yi kuka, Ubangiji kuwa yakan ji su; yakan cece su daga dukan wahalarsu.
english: The righteous cry, and Yahweh hears, and delivers them out of all their troubles.

hausa: Sa’an nan za a ba da mulki, iko da girma na mulkokin da suke a ƙarƙashin dukan sammai ga tsarkaka, mutane na Mafi Ɗaukaka. Mulkinsa kuwa mulki ne marar matuƙa, kuma dukan masu mulki za su yabe shi, su kuma yi masa biyayya.’
english: The kingdom and the dominion, and the greatness of the kingdoms under the whole sky, will be given to the people of the saints of the Most High. His kingdom is an everlasting kingdom, and all dominions will serve and obey him.’

hausa: A wajen yamma, Bahar Rum ne zai zama iyakar zuwa wani wuri ɗaura da Lebo Hamat. Wannan ita ce iyakar a wajen yamma.
english: “The west side shall be the great sea, from the south border as far as opposite the entrance of Hamath. This is the west side.

hausa: Fetahahiya ɗan Meshezabel, ɗaya daga zuriyar Zera ɗan Yahuda ne, wakilin sarki cikin dukan al’amuran da suka shafi mutane.
english: Pethahiah the son of Meshezabel, of the children of Zerah the son of Judah, was at the king’s hand in all matters concerning the people.

hausa: Gama da so na ne, sai a la’anta ni a kuma raba ni da Kiristi saboda ’yan’uwana, waɗannan na kabilata,
english: For I could wish that I myself were accursed from Christ for my brothers’ sake, my relatives according to the flesh

hausa: Ubangiji ya ce, “Ga su, su jama’a ɗaya ce, su duka kuwa harshensu guda ne. Wannan kuwa masomi ne kawai na abin da za su iya yi, babu kuma abin da suka yi shirya yi da ba za su iya yi ba.
english: Yahweh said, “Behold, they are one people, and they all have one language, and this is what they begin to do. Now nothing will be withheld from them, which they intend to do.

hausa: Na haƙa rijiyoyi a baƙuwar ƙasa na kuma sha ruwa a can. Da tafin ƙafafuna na busar da dukan rafuffukan Masar.’
english: I have dug and drunk water, and with the sole of my feet I will dry up all the rivers of Egypt.”

hausa: Ya ce wa Yaƙub, “Ina roƙonka, ka ɗan ɗiba mini faten nan! Ina fama da yunwa!” (Shi ya sa aka kira shi Edom.)
english: Esau said to Jacob, “Please feed me with some of that red stew, for I am famished.” Therefore his name was called Edom.

hausa: Ke ’yar mahaifiyarki ce da gaske, wadda ta ƙi mijinta da ’ya’yanta; ke kuma ’yar’uwar ’yar’uwanki mata ce da gaske, waɗanda suka ƙi mazansu da ’ya’yansu. Mahaifiyarki mutuniyar Hitti ce, mahaifinki kuma mutumin Amoriyawa ne.
english: You are the daughter of your mother, who loathes her husband and her children; and you are the sister of your sisters, who loathed their husbands and their children. Your mother was a Hittite, and your father an Amorite.

hausa: Ki saurara, ya ke diya, ki lura ku kuma kasa kunne, Ki manta da mutanenki da gidan mahaifinki.
english: Listen, daughter, consider, and turn your ear. Forget your own people, and also your father’s house.

hausa: Amma kada a sayar da filayen kiwo na waɗannan birane; mallakarsu ce, ta ɗinɗinɗin.
english: But the field of the pasture lands of their cities may not be sold, for it is their perpetual possession.

hausa: Ya yi tambaya ya ce, “Me ka gani Amos?” Sai na amsa na ce, “Kwandon nunannun ’ya’yan itace.” Sai Ubangiji ya ce mini, “Lokaci ya yi wa mutanena Isra’ila da ba zan ƙara barinsu ba.
english: He said, “Amos, what do you see?” I said, “A basket of summer fruit.” Then Yahweh said to me, “The end has come on my people Israel. I will not again pass by them any more.

hausa: “To, da yake Ubangiji, Allah na Isra’ila, ya kori Amoriyawa a gaban mutanensa Isra’ila, wane ’yanci kake da shi da za ka karɓe ta?
english: So now Yahweh, the God of Israel, has dispossessed the Amorites from before his people Israel, and should you possess them?

hausa: Na gama ku da Ubangiji ku sa a karanta wannan wasiƙa ga dukan ’yan’uwa.
english: I solemnly command you by the Lord that this letter be read to all the holy brothers.

hausa: “Kada ku saurari Hezekiya. Ga abin da sarkin Assuriya ya ce, ku shirya zaman lafiya da ni, ku fito zuwa wurina. Kowane ɗayanku kuwa zai ci ’ya’yan inabinsa da ’ya’yan ɓaurensa, yă kuma sha ruwa daga randarsa,
english: Don’t listen to Hezekiah.’ For the king of Assyria says, ‘Make your peace with me, and come out to me; and everyone of you eat from his own vine, and everyone from his own fig tree, and everyone drink water from his own cistern;

hausa: Ba za su dubi bagade ba, waɗanda suke aikin hannuwansu, ba za su kuma kula da ginshiƙan Ashera ba da kuma bagadan turaren da yatsotsinsu suka yi.
english: They will not look to the altars, the work of their hands; neither shall they respect that which their fingers have made, either the Asherah poles or the incense altars.

hausa: Amma Ubangiji ya ce wa Sama’ila, “Kada ka dubi kyan tsarinsa ko tsayinsa, domin ba shi nake so ba, gama yadda Ubangiji yake gani, ba haka mutum yake gani ba. Mutum yakan dubi kyan tsari ne kawai daga waje, amma Ubangiji yakan dubi zuciya.”
english: But Yahweh said to Samuel, “Don’t look on his face, or on the height of his stature, because I have rejected him; for I don’t see as man sees. For man looks at the outward appearance, but Yahweh looks at the heart.”

hausa: Allah ya ce, “Bari ruwan da yake ƙarƙashin sama yă tattaru wuri ɗaya, bari kuma busasshiyar ƙasa tă bayyana.” Haka kuwa ya kasance.
english: God said, “Let the waters under the sky be gathered together to one place, and let the dry land appear;” and it was so.

hausa: “Da haka za su sa sunana a kan Isra’ilawa, ni kuma zan albarkace su.”
english: “So they shall put my name on the children of Israel; and I will bless them.”

hausa: Ornan ya ce wa Dawuda, “Ka karɓa! Bari ranka yă daɗe, sarki yă yi duk abin da ya ga ya yi masa kyau. Duba, zan ba da shanu domin hadaya ta ƙonawa, da itacen sussuka, da kuma alkama domin hadaya ta gari. Zan ba da dukan wannan.”
english: Ornan said to David, “Take it for yourself, and let my lord the king do that which is good in his eyes. Behold, I give the oxen for burnt offerings, and the threshing instruments for wood, and the wheat for the meal offering. I give it all.”

hausa: gama zan ba ka lada mai yawa in kuma yi duk abin da ka ce. Ka zo ka la’anta mini waɗannan mutane.”
english: for I will promote you to very great honor, and whatever you say to me I will do. Please come therefore, and curse this people for me.’”

hausa: An janye shi a ranan nan, saboda haka garken da yake cikin wahala masu kallona sun san cewa maganar Ubangiji ce.
english: It was broken in that day; and thus the poor of the flock that listened to me knew that it was Yahweh’s word.

hausa: Allah ya yi manyan haskoki biyu, babban hasken yă mallaki yini, ƙaramin kuma yă mallaki dare. Ya kuma yi taurari.
english: God made the two great lights: the greater light to rule the day, and the lesser light to rule the night. He also made the stars.

hausa: Za ku shuka iri da yawa a gona, amma za ku girbe kaɗan, domin fāra za su cinye su.
english: You will carry much seed out into the field, and will gather little in, for the locust will consume it.

hausa: Ba za ka ƙara dawo ƙasar da kake marmarin dawowa ba.”
english: But to the land to which their soul longs to return, there they will not return.”

hausa: Mutanen Yahuda kuma suka je wurin Yoshuwa a Gilgal, sai Kaleb ɗan Yefunne Bakenizze ya ce wa Yoshuwa, “Ka san abin da Ubangiji ya gaya wa Musa, mutumin Allah a Kadesh Barneya game da kai da ni.
english: Then the children of Judah came near to Joshua in Gilgal. Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite said to him, “You know the thing that Yahweh spoke to Moses the man of God concerning me and concerning you in Kadesh Barnea.

hausa: ‘Za a kwashe su zuwa Babilon a can kuwa za su kasance sai ranar da na neme su,’ in ji Ubangiji. ‘Sa’an nan zan komo da su in maido da su wannan wuri.’ ”
english: ‘They will be carried to Babylon, and there they will be, until the day that I visit them,’ says Yahweh; ‘then I will bring them up, and restore them to this place.’”

hausa: Ban ci abinci mai kyau ba; ba nama ko ruwa inabin da ya shiga bakina; kuma ba na amfani da man shafawa gaba ɗaya har sai da sati nan uku suka wuce.
english: I ate no pleasant food. No meat or wine came into my mouth. I didn’t anoint myself at all, until three whole weeks were fulfilled.

hausa: Annas babban firist yana nan, haka ma Kayifas Yohanna, Alekzanda da kuma sauran mutanen da suke iyalin babban firist.
english: Annas the high priest was there, with Caiaphas, John, Alexander, and as many as were relatives of the high priest.

hausa: In wani bai yi biyayya da umarninmu a wannan wasiƙa ba, sai fa ku lura da shi. Kada ku haɗa kai da shi, don yă ji kunya.
english: If any man doesn’t obey our word in this letter, note that man and have no company with him, to the end that he may be ashamed.

hausa: Zan tayar wa kaina amintaccen firist wanda zai aikata abin da nake so yă yi, zan kuwa ba shi zuriya da koyaushe za su yi aiki a gaban zaɓaɓɓen sarkina.
english: I will raise up a faithful priest for myself who will do according to that which is in my heart and in my mind. I will build him a sure house. He will walk before my anointed forever.

hausa: daga kabilar Issakar, Netanel ɗan Zuwar;
english: Of Issachar: Nethanel the son of Zuar.

hausa: Urushalima tana tangaɗi, Yahuda yana fāɗuwa; maganganunsu da ayyukansu suna gāba da Ubangiji, suna rena ɗaukakar kasancewarsa.
english: For Jerusalem is ruined, and Judah is fallen; because their tongue and their doings are against Yahweh, to provoke the eyes of his glory.

hausa: Sa’an nan Musa ya ce, “An keɓe ku ga Ubangiji a yau, gama kun yi gāba da ’ya’yanku da ’yan’uwanku, ya kuma albarkace ku a wannan rana.”
english: Moses said, “Consecrate yourselves today to Yahweh, for every man was against his son and against his brother, that he may give you a blessing today.”

hausa: Ina faɗin gaskiya a cikin Kiristi ba ƙarya nake yi ba, lamirina ya tabbatar da wannan a cikin Ruhu Mai Tsarki.
english: I tell the truth in Christ. I am not lying, my conscience testifying with me in the Holy Spirit

hausa: Dole a bar wutar da take bisa bagaden tă yi ta ci; kada tă mutu. Kowace safiya firist zai ƙara itacen wuta, yă shirya hadaya ta ƙonawa a bisa wutar yă kuma ƙone kitsen hadaya ta salama a kansa.
english: The fire on the altar shall be kept burning on it, it shall not go out; and the priest shall burn wood on it every morning. He shall lay the burnt offering in order upon it, and shall burn on it the fat of the peace offerings.

hausa: Wannan shaida gaskiya ce. Saboda haka, sai ka tsawata musu sosai, don su zama sahihai a wajen bangaskiya,
english: This testimony is true. For this cause, reprove them sharply, that they may be sound in the faith,

hausa: “ ‘Duk wanda ya taɓa jikin mai ɗiga, dole yă wanke rigunansa, yă kuma yi wanka, zai kuma ƙazantu har yamma.
english: “‘He who touches the body of him who has the discharge shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening.

hausa: “Ka tafi wurin iyalin Rekabawa ka gayyace su su zo a ɗaya daga cikin ɗakunan da suke gefe a gidan Ubangiji ka kuma ba su ruwan inabi su sha.”
english: “Go to the house of the Rechabites, and speak to them, and bring them into Yahweh’s house, into one of the rooms, and give them wine to drink.”

hausa: Ya gidan Isra’ila, yabi Ubangiji; Ya gidan Haruna, yabi Ubangiji;
english: House of Israel, praise Yahweh! House of Aaron, praise Yahweh!

hausa: “Ka gangara zuwa gidan mai ginin tukwane, a can zan ba ka saƙona.”
english: “Arise, and go down to the potter’s house, and there I will cause you to hear my words.”

hausa: Yoshuwa ya ce wa mutanen, “Ba za ku iya bauta wa Ubangiji ba gama shi Allah mai tsarki ne; mai kishi kuma. Ba zai gafarta muku zunubin tawaye ba.
english: Joshua said to the people, “You can’t serve Yahweh, for he is a holy God. He is a jealous God. He will not forgive your disobedience nor your sins.

hausa: Ku tuna da abubuwan mamakin da ya yi, mu’ujizansa, da kuma hukunce-hukuncen da ya zartar,
english: Remember his marvelous works that he has done: his wonders, and the judgments of his mouth,

hausa: Yoshuwa kuma ya ce, “Ya Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka, me ya sa ka sa mutanen nan suka ƙetare Urdun don ka bari mu shiga hannun Amoriyawa su hallaka mu? Kila da mun haƙura mun zauna a ɗaya gefen Urdun da ya fi mana!
english: Joshua said, “Alas, Lord Yahweh, why have you brought this people over the Jordan at all, to deliver us into the hand of the Amorites, to cause us to perish? I wish that we had been content and lived beyond the Jordan!

hausa: Saboda haka mai hankali yakan yi shiru a lokuta kamar haka, gama lokutan mugaye ne.
english: Therefore a prudent person keeps silent in such a time, for it is an evil time.

hausa: Sai Adamu ya sāke kwana da matarsa, ta haifi ɗa, aka kuma ba shi suna Set, gama ta ce, “Allah ya ba ni wani yaro a madadin Habila, tun da yake Kayinu ya kashe shi.”
english: Adam knew his wife again. She gave birth to a son, and named him Seth, saying, “for God has given me another child instead of Abel, for Cain killed him.”

hausa: Babbar ranar Ubangiji ta yi kusa, ta yi kusa kuma tana zuwa da sauri. Ku saurara! Kukan ranar Ubangiji za tă yi zafi, za a ji kururuwan jarumi a can.
english: The great day of Yahweh is near. It is near and hurries greatly, the voice of the day of Yahweh. The mighty man cries there bitterly.

hausa: Ku kuwa magādan annabawan ne da kuma na alkawarin da Allah ya yi da kakanninku. Ya ce wa Ibrahim, ‘Ta wurin zuriyarka, dukan kabilan duniya za su sami albarka.’
english: You are the children of the prophets, and of the covenant which God made with our fathers, saying to Abraham, ‘All the families of the earth will be blessed through your offspring.’

hausa: sai ya ɗaga murya ya ce, “Tashi ka tsaya kan ƙafafunka!” Da jin haka, sai mutumin ya yi wuf ya kuma fara tafiya.
english: said with a loud voice, “Stand upright on your feet!” He leaped up and walked.

hausa: Ya kuma sa matsaran ƙofofi a ƙofofin haikalin Ubangiji don kada wani da ba shi da tsarki yă shiga.
english: He set the gatekeepers at the gates of Yahweh’s house, that no one who was unclean in anything should enter in.

hausa: Ko za ka amince da shi yă kawo maka hatsinka gida yă tattara shi a masussuka?
english: Will you confide in him, that he will bring home your seed, and gather the grain of your threshing floor?

hausa: Efafaras, abokin tarayyata a kurkuku cikin Kiristi Yesu, yana gaishe ka.
english: Epaphras, my fellow prisoner in Christ Jesus, greets you,

hausa: In bai tanada mata waɗannan abubuwa uku ba, sai tă tafi ’yantacciya, babu biyan kome.
english: If he doesn’t do these three things for her, she may go free without paying any money.

hausa: A wannan sa’a aka yi wata babbar girgizar ƙasa kashi ɗaya bisa goma kuma na birnin ya rushe. Aka kashe mutane dubu bakwai a girgizar ƙasar, waɗanda suka tsira kuwa suka ji tsoro suka ɗaukaka Allah na sama.
english: In that day there was a great earthquake, and a tenth of the city fell. Seven thousand people were killed in the earthquake, and the rest were terrified and gave glory to the God of heaven.

hausa: “Sa’an nan za ku san cewa ni, Ubangiji Allahnku, ina zaune a Sihiyona, dutsena mai tsarki. Urushalima za tă zama mai tsarki; baƙi ba za su ƙara mamaye ta ba.
english: “So you will know that I am Yahweh, your God, dwelling in Zion, my holy mountain. Then Jerusalem will be holy, and no strangers will pass through her any more.

hausa: Saboda haka mutanena za su yi zaman bauta domin rashin fahimi; manyan mutanensu za su mutu da yunwa talakawansu kuma su mutu da ƙishirwa.
english: Therefore my people go into captivity for lack of knowledge. Their honorable men are famished, and their multitudes are parched with thirst.

hausa: Mutanen ƙasar na yin ƙwace suna yin fashi; suna cin zalin matalauta da mabukata suna wulaƙanta baƙo suna hana musu adalci.
english: The people of the land have used oppression and exercised robbery. Yes, they have troubled the poor and needy, and have oppressed the foreigner wrongfully.

hausa: “Me kuma Dawuda zai ce maka? Gama ka san bawanka, ya Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka.
english: What more can David say to you? For you know your servant, Lord Yahweh.

hausa: Sai Asa ya kira ga Ubangiji Allahnsa ya ce, “Ubangiji, babu wani kamar ka da zai taimaki marar ƙarfi a kan mai ƙarfi. Ka taimake mu, ya Ubangiji Allahnmu, gama mun dogara a gare ka, kuma a cikin sunanka muka fito don mu yaƙi wannan babbar runduna. Ya Ubangiji, kai ne Allahnmu; kada ka bar mutum yă yi nasara a kanka.”
english: Asa cried to Yahweh his God, and said, “Yahweh, there is no one besides you to help, between the mighty and him who has no strength. Help us, Yahweh our God; for we rely on you, and in your name we have come against this multitude. Yahweh, you are our God. Don’t let man prevail against you.”

hausa: “Kun yi ta yawo kewaye da ƙasar tudun nan da daɗewa; yanzu ku juya, ku nufi arewa.
english: “You have encircled this mountain long enough. Turn northward.

hausa: “Ko za ka ƙi yarda da shari’ata? Za ka ba ni laifi don ka nuna kai marar laifi ne?
english: Will you even annul my judgment? Will you condemn me, that you may be justified?

hausa: Amma Yesu ya kira yaran a wurinsa ya ce, “Ku bar yara ƙanana su zo wurina. Kada ku hana su, gama mulkin Allah na irin waɗannan ne.
english: Jesus summoned them, saying, “Allow the little children to come to me, and don’t hinder them, for God’s Kingdom belongs to such as these.

hausa: “Ku dubi yadda furanni suke girma. Ba sukan yi aiki, ko saƙa ba, duk da haka, ina faɗa muku cewa, ko Solomon cikin kyakkyawan darajarsa duka, bai yafa kayan ado da ya kai kamar na ko ɗaya a cikinsu ba.
english: Consider the lilies, how they grow. They don’t toil, neither do they spin; yet I tell you, even Solomon in all his glory was not arrayed like one of these.

hausa: Har yanzu dai ba ku roƙi kome cikin sunana ba. Ku roƙa za ku kuwa samu, farin cikinku kuwa zai zama cikakke.
english: Until now, you have asked nothing in my name. Ask, and you will receive, that your joy may be made full.

hausa: Saboda haka Solomon ya yi abin da yake mugu a gaban Ubangiji. Bai bi Ubangiji gaba ɗaya kamar yadda Dawuda mahaifinsa ya yi ba.
english: Solomon did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight, and didn’t go fully after Yahweh, as David his father did.

hausa: Wanda kuma ya sa na sami tagomashi a gaban sarki da mashawartansa, da kuma duk manyan masu muƙami nasa. Gama Ubangiji Allahna yana tare da ni, sai na sami ƙarfin hali na tattara shugabannin mutane daga Isra’ila, don mu tafi tare.
english: and has extended loving kindness to me before the king and his counselors, and before all the king’s mighty princes. I was strengthened according to Yahweh my God’s hand on me, and I gathered together chief men out of Israel to go up with me.

hausa: Saboda haka ku roƙi Ubangijin girbi, yă aiko da ma’aikata cikin gonarsa na girbi.”
english: Pray therefore that the Lord of the harvest will send out laborers into his harvest.”

hausa: Bari su yi godiya ga Ubangiji saboda ƙaunarsa marar ƙarewa da kuma ayyukansa masu banmamaki saboda mutane.
english: Let them praise Yahweh for his loving kindness, for his wonderful deeds for the children of men!

hausa: Bayan mutanen sun daɗe ba su ci abinci ba, Bulus ya miƙe tsaye a gabansu ya ce, “Mutane, da kun ji shawarata na kada ku tashi daga Kirit, da ba ku fāɗa wannan masifa da hasara ba.
english: When they had been long without food, Paul stood up in the middle of them and said, “Sirs, you should have listened to me, and not have set sail from Crete and have gotten this injury and loss.

hausa: Ubangiji ya kira Sama’ila sau na uku, Sama’ila kuma ya tashi ya tafi wurin Eli, “Ga ni, gama ka kira ni.” Sai Eli ya gane cewa Ubangiji ne ke kira yaron.
english: Yahweh called Samuel again the third time. He arose and went to Eli and said, “Here I am; for you called me.” Eli perceived that Yahweh had called the child.

hausa: Ba hannuna ba ne ya yi dukan waɗannan abubuwa, ta haka suka kasance?” In ji Ubangiji. “Wannan mutum ne nake jin daɗi, shi da yake mai ƙasƙanci da kuma zuciyar yin tuba, yana kuma rawar jiki ga maganata.
english: For my hand has made all these things, and so all these things came to be,” says Yahweh: “but I will look to this man, even to he who is poor and of a contrite spirit, and who trembles at my word.

hausa: Ban da haka, kamar yadda ku Filibbiyawa kuka sani, a farkon kwanakin da kuka ji bishara, sa’ad da na tashi daga Makidoniya, babu wata ikkilisiyar da tă yi tarayya da ni a fannin bayarwa da karɓa, sai ku kaɗai;
english: You yourselves also know, you Philippians, that in the beginning of the Good News, when I departed from Macedonia, no assembly shared with me in the matter of giving and receiving but you only.

hausa: yadda Ubangiji ya umarta, suka ba shi garin da ya ce a ba shi, Timnat Serad a ƙasar tudu ta Efraim. Ya kuma gina garin ya zauna a can.
english: According to Yahweh’s commandment, they gave him the city which he asked, even Timnathserah in the hill country of Ephraim; and he built the city, and lived there.

hausa: Suka kwashe dukan dukiyarsu da dukan matansu da ’ya’yansu, suka kwashe kome da yake cikin gidaje.
english: and all their wealth. They took captive all their little ones and their wives, and took as plunder everything that was in the house.

hausa: Sai waɗansu shugabanni a Efraim, Azariya ɗan Yehohanan, Berekiya ɗan Meshillemot, Hezekiya ɗan Shallum da Amasa ɗan Hadlai, suka tasar wa waɗanda suke isowa daga yaƙi.
english: Then some of the heads of the children of Ephraim, Azariah the son of Johanan, Berechiah the son of Meshillemoth, Jehizkiah the son of Shallum, and Amasa the son of Hadlai, stood up against those who came from the war,

hausa: Gara matalauci wanda yake tafiya babu abin zargi da mai arziki wanda hanyoyinsa mugaye ne.
english: Better is the poor who walks in his integrity than he who is perverse in his ways, and he is rich.

hausa: Amma sai ga waɗansu Yahudawa waɗanda ka ɗora su a kan harkokin yankin Babilon, wato, Shadrak, Meshak da Abednego waɗanda ba su kula da umarninka ba, ya sarki. Ba su bauta wa allolin ba balle su yi sujada ga gunkin zinariya da ka kafa.”
english: There are certain Jews whom you have appointed over the affairs of the province of Babylon: Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego. These men, O king, have not respected you. They don’t serve your gods, and don’t worship the golden image which you have set up.”

hausa: Zan yi gāba da wannan mutum, zan kuma raba shi da mutanensa; gama ta wurin miƙa ’ya’yansa ga Molek, ya ƙazantar da wuri mai tsarkina, ya kuma ƙazantar da sunana mai tsarki.
english: I also will set my face against that person, and will cut him off from among his people, because he has given of his offspring to Molech, to defile my sanctuary, and to profane my holy name.

hausa: Sauran suka kama bayinsa suka wulaƙanta su, suka kuma kashe su.
english: and the rest grabbed his servants, treated them shamefully, and killed them.

hausa: Saboda haka, ga abin da Ubangiji yana cewa, ‘Ina shirin kawar da kai daga fuskar duniya. A wannan shekara za ka mutu, domin ka yi wa’azin tawaye a kan Ubangiji.’ ”
english: Therefore Yahweh says, ‘Behold, I will send you away from off the surface of the earth. This year you will die, because you have spoken rebellion against Yahweh.’”

hausa: Amma Ubangiji ya ce wa mahaifina Dawuda, ‘Domin yana a zuciyarka ka gina haikali domin Sunana, ka yi daidai da ka kasance da wannan a zuciyarka.
english: But Yahweh said to David my father, ‘Whereas it was in your heart to build a house for my name, you did well that it was in your heart;

hausa: Ba zan iya ɗaukan dukan mutanen nan ni kaɗai ba, nauyin ya yi mini yawa.
english: I am not able to bear all this people alone, because it is too heavy for me.

hausa: Zakoki masu ruri suna yayyage abin da suka kama sun buɗe bakunansu a kaina.
english: They open their mouths wide against me, lions tearing prey and roaring.

hausa: Kibzayim da Bet-Horon, tare da wuraren kiwonsu, garuruwa huɗu ke nan.
english: Kibzaim with its pasture lands, and Beth Horon with its pasture lands: four cities.

hausa: Amma in suka ce mana, ‘Ku haura wurinmu,’ to, sai mu haura, wannan zai zama mana alama cewa Ubangiji ya bashe su a hannunmu.”
english: But if they say this, ‘Come up to us!’ then we will go up, for Yahweh has delivered them into our hand. This shall be the sign to us.”

hausa: In gida yana gāba da kansa, wannan gida ba zai tsaya ba.
english: If a house is divided against itself, that house cannot stand.

hausa: In kun yi biyayya da maganar Ubangiji Allahnku, kuka kuma lura, kuka bi dukan umarnan da na ba ku a yau, Ubangiji Allahnku zai sa ku bisa dukan al’ummai a duniya.
english: It shall happen, if you shall listen diligently to Yahweh your God’s voice, to observe to do all his commandments which I command you today, that Yahweh your God will set you high above all the nations of the earth.

hausa: amma ina fushi da ƙasashen da suke ji suna zaman lafiya, na ɗan yi fushina kawai, amma sai suka ƙara musu masifar.’
english: I am very angry with the nations that are at ease; for I was but a little displeased, but they added to the calamity.”

hausa: Takan yi riguna na lilin ta sayar; takan kuma sayar wa ’yan kasuwa da ɗamara.
english: She makes linen garments and sells them, and delivers sashes to the merchant.

hausa: In wani ya yi magana, ya kamata yă yi ta a matsayin wanda yake magana ainihin kalmomin Allah. In wani yana yin hidima, ya kamata yă yi ta da ƙarfin da Allah ya tanadar, domin a cikin kome a yabi Allah ta wurin Yesu Kiristi. A gare shi ɗaukaka da iko sun tabbata har abada abadin. Amin.
english: If anyone speaks, let it be as it were the very words of God. If anyone serves, let it be as of the strength which God supplies, that in all things God may be glorified through Jesus Christ, to whom belong the glory and the dominion forever and ever. Amen.

hausa: da kuma yadda tun kana ɗan jinjiri ka san Nassosi masu tsarki, waɗanda suke iya sa ka zama mai hikima zuwa ceto ta wurin bangaskiya cikin Kiristi Yesu.
english: From infancy, you have known the holy Scriptures which are able to make you wise for salvation through faith which is in Christ Jesus.

hausa: Yayinda suke zaune a teburi, sai maganar Ubangiji ta zo wa tsohon annabin da ya dawo da mutumin Allah.
english: As they sat at the table, Yahweh’s word came to the prophet who brought him back;

hausa: Rayuwa bangaskiya muke, ba ta ganin ido ba.
english: for we walk by faith, not by sight.

hausa: Gama ga abin da Amos yake cewa, “ ‘Yerobowam zai mutu ta wurin takobi, kuma tabbatacce Isra’ila za su tafi zaman bauta, nesa da ainihin ƙasarsu.’ ”
english: For Amos says, ‘Jeroboam will die by the sword, and Israel shall surely be led away captive out of his land.’”

hausa: Duk abin da ya fita daga bakinku, sai ku lura ku cika shi, kamar yadda kuka yarda da kanku, kuka yi alkawarin ga Ubangiji Allahnku da bakinku.
english: You shall observe and do that which has gone out of your lips. Whatever you have vowed to Yahweh your God as a free will offering, which you have promised with your mouth, you must do.

hausa: In wani annabi ko mai mafarkai, ya bayyana a cikinku, ya kuma yi muku shelar wata alama mai banmamaki ko al’ajabi,
english: If a prophet or a dreamer of dreams arises among you, and he gives you a sign or a wonder,

hausa: Amma zan sa ka zama mai taurinkai da taurin zuciya kamar su.
english: Behold, I have made your face hard against their faces, and your forehead hard against their foreheads.

hausa: “Faɗa musu cewa, ‘Ga abin da Ubangiji, Allah na Isra’ila, yana cewa a cika kowace salkar ruwan inabi da ruwan inabi.’ In kuwa suka ce maka, ‘Ba mu san cewa ya kamata a cika kowace salkar ruwan inabi da ruwan inabi ba?’
english: “Therefore you shall speak to them this word: ‘Yahweh, the God of Israel says, “Every container should be filled with wine.”’ They will tell you, ‘Do we not certainly know that every container should be filled with wine?’

hausa: Sai mutane suka tambaye ni suka ce, “Ba za ka faɗa mana abin da waɗannan abubuwa suke nufi a gare mu ba?”
english: The people asked me, “Won’t you tell us what these things mean to us, that you act like this?”

hausa: Amma game da ni, kullayaumi zan kasance da sa zuciya; zan yabe ka sau da sau.
english: But I will always hope, and will add to all of your praise.

hausa: amma yana karɓan mutane daga kowace al’ummar da take tsoronsa suke kuma aikata abin da yake daidai.
english: but in every nation he who fears him and works righteousness is acceptable to him.

hausa: Ya Ubangiji, ka ji zaginsu, da duka mugun shirin da suke yi mini
english: You have heard their reproach, Yahweh, and all their plans against me,

hausa: “Ka yi shelar wannan a Masar, ka kuma furta shi a Migdol; ka yi shelarsa kuma a Memfis da Tafanes. ‘Ku ɗauki matsayinku ku kuma shirya, gama takobi na cin waɗanda suke kewaye da ku.’
english: “Declare in Egypt, publish in Migdol, and publish in Memphis and in Tahpanhes; say, ‘Stand up, and prepare, for the sword has devoured around you.’

hausa: Bayan wannan, maganar Ubangiji ta zo wa Abram cikin mafarki cewa, “Kada ka ji tsoro, Abram. Ni ne garkuwarka, kuma ladanka zai zama mai girma.”
english: After these things Yahweh’s word came to Abram in a vision, saying, “Don’t be afraid, Abram. I am your shield, your exceedingly great reward.”

hausa: Ka shafe daron da wurin ajiyarsa, ka kuma keɓe su.
english: You shall anoint the basin and its base, and sanctify it.

hausa: Zai haras da dukiyar da ya haɗiye; Allah zai sa cikinsa yă haras da su.
english: He has swallowed down riches, and he will vomit them up again. God will cast them out of his belly.

hausa: Amma kwa iya yanka nama ku ci a garuruwanku, a duk lokacin da ranku yake so, kamar yadda ake yi da gada ko barewa, bisa ga albarkar da Ubangiji Allahnku yake sa muku. Marar tsarki da mai tsarki, duka za ku iya ci.
english: Yet you may kill and eat meat within all your gates, after all the desire of your soul, according to Yahweh your God’s blessing which he has given you. The unclean and the clean may eat of it, as of the gazelle and the deer.

hausa: Sa’an nan Rebeka ta ce wa Ishaku, “Ni fa na gaji da matan Hittiyawan nan. In Yaƙub ya auri mata daga cikin matan ƙasan nan, wato, daga matan Hittiyawa irin waɗannan, rayuwata ba za tă daɗa mini kome ba.”
english: Rebekah said to Isaac, “I am weary of my life because of the daughters of Heth. If Jacob takes a wife of the daughters of Heth, such as these, of the daughters of the land, what good will my life do me?”

hausa: “Ga yadda Haruna zai shiga wuri mai tsarki, zai zo da ɗan bijimi domin hadaya don zunubi da kuma rago domin hadaya ta ƙonawa.
english: “Aaron shall come into the sanctuary with a young bull for a sin offering, and a ram for a burnt offering.

hausa: Gama Ubangiji Allah rana ne da kuma garkuwa; Ubangiji yakan yi alheri da kuma daraja; ba ya hana kowane abu mai kyau wa waɗanda suke aikata abin da yake daidai.
english: For Yahweh God is a sun and a shield. Yahweh will give grace and glory. He withholds no good thing from those who walk blamelessly.

hausa: “In macen aure ta yi alkawari, ko ta rantse za tă yi wani abu,
english: “If she vowed in her husband’s house or bound her soul by a bond with an oath,

hausa: “ ‘Domin kun ce, “Waɗannan al’ummai biyu da ƙasashe za su zama namu za mu kuma mallake su,” ko da yake Ni Ubangiji ina a can,
english: “‘“Because you have said, ‘These two nations and these two countries will be mine, and we will possess it,’ although Yahweh was there,

hausa: Duk sa’ad da suka ga kuɗin sun ƙaru a akwatin, sai marubucin fada da babban firist, su ƙirga kuɗin da aka kawo a haikalin Ubangiji su sa a jakankuna.
english: When they saw that there was much money in the chest, the king’s scribe and the high priest came up, and they put it in bags and counted the money that was found in Yahweh’s house.

hausa: Yesu ya ce, “Ku zo, ku bi ni, ni kuwa zan mai da ku masuntan mutane.”
english: Jesus said to them, “Come after me, and I will make you into fishers for men.”

hausa: Kwana uku bayan haihuwar jaririna, wannan mata ma ta haifi jariri. Mu dai kaɗai ne; babu wani a gidan sai mu biyu.
english: The third day after I delivered, this woman delivered also. We were together. There was no stranger with us in the house, just us two in the house.

hausa: Sa’an nan suka ce, “Wace kabila ce cikin kabilan Isra’ila ba tă zo taro a gaban Ubangiji a Mizfa ba?” Sai su gane cewa babu wani daga Yabesh Gileyad da ya zo sansani don taron.
english: They said, “What one is there of the tribes of Israel who didn’t come up to Yahweh to Mizpah?” Behold, no one came from Jabesh Gilead to the camp to the assembly.

hausa: Duk katakan da suke kewaye da filin, za a yi musu maɗaurai na azurfa da kuma ƙugiyoyi, da rammukan tagulla.
english: All the pillars of the court around shall be filleted with silver; their hooks of silver, and their sockets of bronze.

hausa: Sa’ad da suka isa wurin da Allah ya faɗa masa, sai Ibrahim ya gina bagade a can, ya kuma shisshirya itacen a kai. Ya ɗaura ɗansa Ishaku, ya kwantar da shi a kan itacen, a bisa bagaden.
english: They came to the place which God had told him of. Abraham built the altar there, and laid the wood in order, bound Isaac his son, and laid him on the altar, on the wood.

hausa: Ni, Bulus nake rubuta wannan gaisuwa da hannuna.
english: This greeting is by me, Paul, with my own hand.

hausa: Ku ƙarfafa hannuwa marasa ƙarfi, ku ƙarfafa gwiwoyin da suka gaji;
english: Strengthen the weak hands, and make the feeble knees firm.

hausa: Duk wanda ya ce yana rayuwa a cikinsa dole yă yi tafiya kamar yadda Yesu ya yi.
english: he who says he remains in him ought himself also to walk just like he walked.

hausa: Ku ƙasƙantar da kanku a gaban Ubangiji, zai kuwa ɗaukaka ku.
english: Humble yourselves in the sight of the Lord, and he will exalt you.

hausa: Kukan yi ƙuri’a a kan marayu ku kuma sayar da abokinku.
english: Yes, you would even cast lots for the fatherless, and make merchandise of your friend.

hausa: A ƙarshe, ’yan’uwana, ku yi farin ciki a cikin Ubangiji! Ba abin damuwa ba ne a gare ni in sāke rubuta muku irin waɗannan abubuwa, domin lafiyarku ne.
english: Finally, my brothers, rejoice in the Lord! To write the same things to you, to me indeed is not tiresome, but for you it is safe.

hausa: “Kai mai girma ne, ya Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka! Babu wani kamar ka, babu kuma wani Allah sai kai; kamar yadda muka ji da kunnuwanmu.
english: Therefore you are great, Yahweh God. For there is no one like you, neither is there any God besides you, according to all that we have heard with our ears.

hausa: Da ji wannan, sai aka yi musu baftisma a cikin sunan Ubangiji Yesu.
english: When they heard this, they were baptized in the name of the Lord Jesus.

hausa: domin mutanen Beyerot sun gudu zuwa Gittayim inda suke zaman baƙunci har wa yau.
english: and the Beerothites fled to Gittaim, and have lived as foreigners there until today).

hausa: Sai Ubangiji ya ce wa Yoshuwa, “Duba, na ba ka nasara a kan Yeriko, duk da sarkinta da mayaƙanta.
english: Yahweh said to Joshua, “Behold, I have given Jericho into your hand, with its king and the mighty men of valor.

hausa: Amma a ranar da Lot ya bar Sodom, sai aka yi ruwan wuta da farar wuta daga sama, aka hallaka su duka.
english: but in the day that Lot went out from Sodom, it rained fire and sulfur from the sky and destroyed them all.

hausa: mai domin fitila, kayan yaji domin man keɓewa da kuma turare mai ƙanshi,
english: oil for the light, spices for the anointing oil and for the sweet incense,

hausa: Ku kam, a dā ku matattu ne saboda laifofinku da kuma zunubanku.
english: You were made alive when you were dead in transgressions and sins,

hausa: Ba kukan ce, ‘Sauran wata huɗu a yi girbi ba?’ Ina gaya muku, ku ɗaga idanu ku dubi gonaki! Sun isa girbi.
english: Don’t you say, ‘There are yet four months until the harvest’? Behold, I tell you, lift up your eyes and look at the fields, that they are white for harvest already.

hausa: Na ga wani abu mai bantsoro a gidan Isra’ila. A can Efraim ya miƙa wuya ga karuwanci Isra’ila kuma ta ƙazantu.
english: In the house of Israel I have seen a horrible thing. There is prostitution in Ephraim. Israel is defiled.

hausa: Muguntarku takan shafi mutum kamar ku ne kaɗai, adalcinku kuma yakan shafi ’yan adam ne kaɗai.
english: Your wickedness may hurt a man as you are, and your righteousness may profit a son of man.

hausa: Kamar marasa sani Allah suna mini riyar ba’a; Suna hararata da ƙiyayya.
english: Like the profane mockers in feasts, they gnashed their teeth at me.

hausa: ya adana rayukanmu ya kuma kiyaye ƙafafunmu daga santsi.
english: who preserves our life among the living, and doesn’t allow our feet to be moved.

hausa: Ku gaggai da juna da sumba mai tsarki. Dukan ikkilisiyoyin Kiristi suna gaishe ku.
english: Greet one another with a holy kiss. The assemblies of Christ greet you.

hausa: In zan ci gaba da rayuwa a cikin jiki, wannan zai zama aiki mai amfani a gare ni. Duk da haka me zan zaɓa? Ban sani ba!
english: But if I live on in the flesh, this will bring fruit from my work; yet I don’t know what I will choose.

hausa: Bayan da Yesu ya faɗi wannan, sai ya dubi sama ya yi addu’a ya ce, “Uba, lokaci ya yi. Ka ɗaukaka Ɗanka, don Ɗanka yă ɗaukaka ka.
english: Jesus said these things, then lifting up his eyes to heaven, he said, “Father, the time has come. Glorify your Son, that your Son may also glorify you;

hausa: (Musa ya riga ya ba rabin kabilar Manasse gādo a Bashan; sauran rabin kabilar kuma Yoshuwa ya ba su gādo tare ’yan’uwansu a yammacin hayin Urdun.) Sa’ad da Yoshuwa ya sallame su su tafi gida, ya sa musu albarka,
english: Now to the one half-tribe of Manasseh Moses had given inheritance in Bashan; but Joshua gave to the other half among their brothers beyond the Jordan westward. Moreover when Joshua sent them away to their tents, he blessed them,

hausa: Sai ya amsa ya ce, “Ba ku karanta abin da Dawuda ya yi ba ne sa’ad da shi da abokan tafiyarsa suka ji yunwa?
english: But he said to them, “Haven’t you read what David did when he was hungry, and those who were with him:

hausa: Saboda haka Ubangiji Allah ya kore shi daga Lambun Eden domin yă nome ƙasa wadda aka yi shi.
english: Therefore Yahweh God sent him out from the garden of Eden, to till the ground from which he was taken.

hausa: Amma abubuwan da suke fitowa ta baki suna fitowa ne daga zuciya, su ne kuma suke ƙazantar da mutum.
english: But the things which proceed out of the mouth come out of the heart, and they defile the man.

hausa: Waɗanda suke da iyayengiji masu bi, to, kada su yi musu reni domin su ’yan’uwa ne. A maimako, sai ma su fi bauta musu, saboda waɗanda suke cin moriyar hidimarsu masu bi ne, ƙaunatattu ne kuma a gare su. Waɗannan su ne abubuwan da za ka koya musu ka kuma gargaɗe su.
english: Those who have believing masters, let them not despise them because they are brothers, but rather let them serve them, because those who partake of the benefit are believing and beloved. Teach and exhort these things.

hausa: Suka farfasa dutsen tsafin Ba’al, suka kuma rushe haikalin, mutane suka mai da wurin salga har yă zuwa yau.
english: They broke down the pillar of Baal, and broke down the house of Baal, and made it a latrine, to this day.

hausa: Yakan yi taƙama da ƙulle-ƙullen zuciyarsa; yana albarkaci mai haɗama yana kuma ƙin Ubangiji.
english: For the wicked boasts of his heart’s cravings. He blesses the greedy and condemns Yahweh.

hausa: Sai Ayuba ya amsa,
english: Then Job answered,

hausa: Isra’ilawa suka kama tafiya daga Rameses zuwa Sukkot. Akwai maza dubu ɗari shida da suke tafiya da ƙafa, ban da mata da yara.
english: The children of Israel traveled from Rameses to Succoth, about six hundred thousand on foot who were men, in addition to children.

hausa: Sai na ji wani abu mai ƙara kamar ƙasaitaccen taron mutane, kamar rurin ruwaye masu gudu da kuma kamar bugun tsawa mai ƙarfi, suna tā da murya suna cewa, “Halleluya! Gama Ubangiji Allahnmu Maɗaukaki ne yake mulki.
english: I heard something like the voice of a great multitude, and like the voice of many waters, and like the voice of mighty thunders, saying, “Hallelujah! For the Lord our God, the Almighty, reigns!

hausa: Ka yi nesa da mugayen sha’awace-sha’awace na ƙuruciya, ka kuma bi adalci, bangaskiya, ƙauna da kuma salama, tare da waɗanda suke kira ga Ubangiji daga zuciya mai tsabta.
english: Flee from youthful lusts; but pursue righteousness, faith, love, and peace with those who call on the Lord out of a pure heart.

hausa: na kuma ba wa Baruk ɗan Neriya, ɗan Masehiya, wannan takarda a gaban Hananel yaron ɗan’uwan mahaifina da kuma a gaban shaidun da suka sa hannu a takardan ciniki da kuma a gaban dukan Yahudawan da suke zaune a sansanin matsaran.
english: and I delivered the deed of the purchase to Baruch the son of Neriah, the son of Mahseiah, in the presence of Hanamel my uncle’s son, and in the presence of the witnesses who signed the deed of the purchase, before all the Jews who sat in the court of the guard.

hausa: Gaskiya, a yanzu ya kamata a ce kun zama malamai, sai ga shi kuna bukatar wani yă sāke koya muku abubuwa masu sauƙi game da abin da Allah ya faɗa. Kuna bukatar madara, ba abinci mai kauri ba!
english: For although by this time you should be teachers, you again need to have someone teach you the rudiments of the first principles of the revelations of God. You have come to need milk, and not solid food.

hausa: Sai Daniyel ya amsa ya ce, “Ran sarki, yă daɗe!
english: Then Daniel said to the king, “O king, live forever!

hausa: Haman ɗan Hammedata, mutumin Agag, abokin gāban dukan Yahudawa, ya ƙulla maƙarƙashiya game da Yahudawa, domin a hallaka su, ya kuma jefa fur (wato, ƙuri’a) don yă hallaka su.
english: because Haman the son of Hammedatha, the Agagite, the enemy of all the Jews, had plotted against the Jews to destroy them, and had cast “Pur”, that is the lot, to consume them and to destroy them;

hausa: Zai ce, “To, ina allolinsu, dutsen da suka yi mafaka a ciki,
english: He will say, “Where are their gods, the rock in which they took refuge,

hausa: ka ce, “ ‘Mahaifiyarki zakanya ce cikin zakoki! Takan kwanta cikin ’yan zakoki ta kuma yi renon kwiyakwiyanta.
english: and say, ‘What was your mother? A lioness. She couched among lions, in the middle of the young lions she nourished her cubs.

hausa: “A hallaka ranar da aka haife ni, da kuma daren da aka ce, ‘An haifi jariri namiji!’
english: “Let the day perish in which I was born, the night which said, ‘There is a boy conceived.’

hausa: “Ni kuwa, saboda ayyukansu da kuma tunaninsu, ina dab da zuwa in tattara dukan al’ummai da harsuna, za su kuma zo su ga ɗaukakata.
english: “For I know their works and their thoughts. The time comes that I will gather all nations and languages, and they will come, and will see my glory.

hausa: “Zan cece ka daga hannuwan mugaye in ɓamɓare ka daga hannun marasa tausayi.”
english: “I will deliver you out of the hand of the wicked, and I will redeem you out of the hand of the terrible.”

hausa: Biranen kuwa su ne, Bezer a dutsen hamada, don mutanen Ruben; Ramot Gileyad, don mutanen Gad; da kuma Golan a Bashan, don mutanen Manasse.
english: Bezer in the wilderness, in the plain country, for the Reubenites; and Ramoth in Gilead for the Gadites; and Golan in Bashan for the Manassites.

hausa: Waɗannan su ne ƙa’idodi don hadaya ta ƙonawa, hadaya ta gari, hadaya don zunubi, hadaya don laifi, hadaya ta naɗi da kuma hadaya ta salama,
english: This is the law of the burnt offering, the meal offering, the sin offering, the trespass offering, the consecration, and the sacrifice of peace offerings

hausa: Amma Manasse ba su kori mutane Bet-Sheyan ko Ta’anak ko Dor ko Ibileyam ko Megiddo tare da ƙauyukansu ba, gama Kan’aniyawa sun dāge su zauna a wannan ƙasa.
english: Manasseh didn’t drive out the inhabitants of Beth Shean and its towns, nor Taanach and its towns, nor the inhabitants of Dor and its towns, nor the inhabitants of Ibleam and its towns, nor the inhabitants of Megiddo and its towns; but the Canaanites would dwell in that land.

hausa: nan take suka bar jirgin ruwan da mahaifinsu suka kuwa bi Yesu.
english: They immediately left the boat and their father, and followed him.

hausa: Da farko, ina gode wa Allahna ta wurin Yesu Kiristi saboda ku duka, gama ana ba da labarin bangaskiyarku a ko’ina a duniya.
english: First, I thank my God through Jesus Christ for all of you, that your faith is proclaimed throughout the whole world.

hausa: Da aka faɗa wa Solomon cewa Shimeyi ya bar Urushalima zuwa Gat, har ya dawo.
english: Solomon was told that Shimei had gone from Jerusalem to Gath, and had come again.

hausa: Amma Allah ya bayyana mana shi ta wurin Ruhunsa. Ruhu yana bincika dukan abubuwa, har ma da abubuwa masu zurfi na Allah.
english: But to us, God revealed them through the Spirit. For the Spirit searches all things, yes, the deep things of God.

hausa: sai ka ji addu’arsu da kuma roƙonsu daga sama, ka kuma biya musu bukatarsu.
english: then hear from heaven their prayer and their supplication, and maintain their cause.

hausa: Suna gama magana ke nan sai almajiransa suka iso, suka yi mamakin ganin yana magana da mace. Amma ba wanda ya ce, “Me kake so?” Ko “Me ya sa kake magana da ita?”
english: Just then, his disciples came. They marveled that he was speaking with a woman; yet no one said, “What are you looking for?” or, “Why do you speak with her?”

hausa: Saboda haka na tafi wurin gwamnonin Kewayen Kogin Yuferites, na ba su wasiƙun sarki. Sarki kuma ya aika da hafsoshin mayaƙa da kuma mahayan dawakai tare da ni.
english: Then I came to the governors beyond the River, and gave them the king’s letters. Now the king had sent captains of the army and horsemen with me.

hausa: Suna kaɗa garaya, da molaye a bukukkuwansu, ganguna da busa da ruwan inabi, amma ba su kula da ayyukan Ubangiji ba, ba sa biyayya ga aikin hannuwansa.
english: The harp, lyre, tambourine, and flute, with wine, are at their feasts; but they don’t respect the work of Yahweh, neither have they considered the operation of his hands.

hausa: kuka yi hadayar da akan yi da wuta ga Ubangiji, daga cikin shanu, ko tumaki, abin ƙanshi mai daɗi ga Ubangiji, ko hadaya ta ƙonawa, ko hadayu don alkawura na musamman, ko hadayar yardar rai, ko kuma hadaya ta biki,
english: and will make an offering by fire to Yahweh—a burnt offering, or a sacrifice, to accomplish a vow, or as a free will offering, or in your set feasts, to make a pleasant aroma to Yahweh, of the herd, or of the flock—

hausa: Sa’an nan Laban ya ce masa, “Kai nama da jinina ne.” Bayan Yaƙub ya zauna da shi na wata guda cif,
english: Laban said to him, “Surely you are my bone and my flesh.” Jacob stayed with him for a month.

hausa: A wajen Gershonawa, kabilarsa su ne Libniyawa, da Shimeyiyawa; waɗannan su ne mutanen Gershom.
english: Of Gershon was the family of the Libnites, and the family of the Shimeites. These are the families of the Gershonites.

hausa: na Azmawet 42
english: The children of Azmaveth, forty-two.

hausa: Halittun hamada za su sadu da kuraye, awakin jeji za su yi ta kiran juna; a can halittun dare su ma za su huta su kuma nemi wurin hutu wa kansu.
english: The wild animals of the desert will meet with the wolves, and the wild goat will cry to his fellow. Yes, the night creature shall settle there, and shall find herself a place of rest.

hausa: Ishaku ya yi addu’a ga Ubangiji a madadin matarsa, saboda ba ta haihuwa. Ubangiji ya amsa addu’arsa, matarsa Rebeka kuwa ta yi ciki.
english: Isaac entreated Yahweh for his wife, because she was barren. Yahweh was entreated by him, and Rebekah his wife conceived.

hausa: ruwan inabi yakan sa zuciyar mutum tă yi murna, mai kuwa yakan sa fuska tă yi haske, abinci kuma da yake riƙe zuciyarsa.
english: wine that makes the heart of man glad, oil to make his face to shine, and bread that strengthens man’s heart.

hausa: Saboda haka Balawen ya yarda ya zauna tare da shi, ɗan saurayin kuwa ya zama kamar ɗaya daga cikin ’ya’yansa.
english: The Levite was content to dwell with the man; and the young man was to him as one of his sons.

hausa: Sai Ishaku ya zauna a Gerar.
english: Isaac lived in Gerar.

hausa: “Ina da shaidar da ta fi ta Yohanna ƙarfi. Gama aikin nan da Uba ya ba ni in kammala, wanda kuwa nake yi, yana ba da shaida cewa Uba ne ya aiko ni.
english: But the testimony which I have is greater than that of John; for the works which the Father gave me to accomplish, the very works that I do, testify about me, that the Father has sent me.

hausa: Allah ba ya danne fushinsa; ko dodannin ruwan da ake kira ayarin Rahab ya tattake su.
english: “God will not withdraw his anger. The helpers of Rahab stoop under him.

hausa: Saboda haka, da yake alkawarin shiga hutunsa yana nan har yanzu, sai mu yi hankali kada waninku yă kāsa shiga.
english: Let’s fear therefore, lest perhaps anyone of you should seem to have come short of a promise of entering into his rest.

hausa: To, Hiram sarkin Taya ya aiki manzanni wurin Dawuda tare da gumaguman itacen al’ul, da kafintoci, da kuma maginan duwatsu, suka kuwa gina wa Dawuda fada.
english: Hiram king of Tyre sent messengers to David, with cedar trees, carpenters, and masons; and they built David a house.

hausa: Suka kawo bijimai bakwai, raguna bakwai, bunsurai bakwai da kuma awaki mata bakwai a matsayin hadaya don zunubi domin masarauta, domin wuri mai tsarki da kuma domin Yahuda. Sarki ya umarce firistoci, zuriyar Haruna, su miƙa waɗannan a bagaden Ubangiji.
english: They brought seven bulls, seven rams, seven lambs, and seven male goats, for a sin offering for the kingdom, for the sanctuary, and for Judah. He commanded the priests the sons of Aaron to offer them on Yahweh’s altar.

hausa: Muryar manya ta yi tsit harshensu ya manne a rufin bakunansu.
english: The voice of the nobles was hushed, and their tongue stuck to the roof of their mouth.

hausa: Na shawarce ka ka sayi zinariyar da aka tace cikin wuta daga gare ni, don ka yi arziki; da fararen tufafi ka sa, don ka rufe kunyar tsirancinka; da kuma maganin ido ka sa a idanunka, don ka gani.
english: I counsel you to buy from me gold refined by fire, that you may become rich; and white garments, that you may clothe yourself, and that the shame of your nakedness may not be revealed; and eye salve to anoint your eyes, that you may see.

hausa: mun yi zunubi muka kuma yi ba daidai ba. Mu mugaye ne da kuma ’yan tawaye; mun juya wa umarninka da shari’unka baya.
english: we have sinned, and have dealt perversely, and have done wickedly, and have rebelled, even turning aside from your precepts and from your ordinances.

hausa: Farat ɗaya Babilon za tă fāɗi ta farfashe. Ku yi kuka dominta! Ku samo mata magani saboda azabarta; wataƙila za a iya warkar da ita.
english: Babylon has suddenly fallen and been destroyed! Wail for her! Take balm for her pain. Perhaps she may be healed.

hausa: Da shan dūka, da shan dauri, da yawan hargitsi, da yawan fama, da rashin barci, da kuma yunwa.
english: in beatings, in imprisonments, in riots, in labors, in watchings, in fastings,

hausa: Gumakan da suke cikin duwatsu masu sulɓi su ne rabonku; su ɗin, su ne rabonku. I, gare su kuka kwarara hadayu na sha kuka kuma miƙa hadayu na gari. Saboda waɗannan abubuwa, zan yi haƙuri?
english: Among the smooth stones of the valley is your portion. They, they are your lot. You have even poured a drink offering to them. You have offered an offering. Shall I be appeased for these things?

hausa: Ubangiji ya sauko a kan ƙwanƙolin Dutsen Sinai, ya kira Musa zuwa ƙwanƙolin dutsen. Musa kuwa ya haura
english: Yahweh came down on Mount Sinai, to the top of the mountain. Yahweh called Moses to the top of the mountain, and Moses went up.

hausa: Sa’an nan Zofar mutumin Na’ama ya amsa,
english: Then Zophar, the Naamathite, answered,

hausa: Da ma a ce ina tare da ku yanzu in canja muryata mana! Gama na damu ƙwarai saboda ku!
english: but I could wish to be present with you now, and to change my tone, for I am perplexed about you.

hausa: Zalmon, mutumin Aho, da Maharai, mutumin Netofa,
english: Zalmon the Ahohite, Maharai the Netophathite,

hausa: suka yi wa Allah da Musa gunaguni, suka ce, “Me ya sa kuka fitar da mu daga Masar, kuka kawo mu mu mutu a wannan hamada? Babu abinci! Babu ruwa! Mu dai mun gaji da wannan abinci marar amfani!”
english: The people spoke against God and against Moses: “Why have you brought us up out of Egypt to die in the wilderness? For there is no bread, there is no water, and our soul loathes this disgusting food!”

hausa: Na’aman ya ce, “Ba damuwa, karɓi talenti biyu.” Ya roƙi Gehazi yă karɓa, sa’an nan ya ƙunsa masa talentin biyu na azurfa ya sa masa a kan jakankuna biyu, ya haɗa da tufafi kashi biyu, ya ba bayinsa biyu suka ɗauka, ya ce su sha gaban Gehazi.
english: Naaman said, “Be pleased to take two talents.” He urged him, and bound two talents of silver in two bags, with two changes of clothing, and laid them on two of his servants; and they carried them before him.

hausa: Gidajensu suna zama cikin lafiya ba ruwansu da fargaba. Kuma Allah ba ya ba su horo.
english: Their houses are safe from fear, neither is the rod of God upon them.

hausa: Amma in gwauruwa tana da ’ya’ya ko jikoki, to, sai su fara koyon yin ayyukan addininsu ga danginsu, ta haka za su sāka wa iyayensu da kakanninsu, gama wannan yakan gamshi Allah.
english: But if any widow has children or grandchildren, let them learn first to show piety toward their own family and to repay their parents, for this is acceptable in the sight of God.

hausa: Fiffike ɗaya na kerub na fari tsawonsa kamu biyar ne, ɗayan fiffike kuma kamu biyar, kamu goma daga ƙarshen fiffike zuwa ƙarshen fiffike.
english: Five cubits was the length of one wing of the cherub, and five cubits was the length of the other wing of the cherub. From the tip of one wing to the tip of the other was ten cubits.

hausa: Sai manzannin suka ce wa Ubangiji, “Ka ƙara mana bangaskiya!”
english: The apostles said to the Lord, “Increase our faith.”

hausa: Sa’ad da Kora ya tara mabiyansa don su yi hamayya da Musa da Haruna a ƙofar Tentin Sujada, sai ɗaukakar Ubangiji ta bayyana ga dukan taron.
english: Korah assembled all the congregation opposite them to the door of the Tent of Meeting. Yahweh’s glory appeared to all the congregation.

hausa: Razana da tsoro za su fāɗo a kansu. Da ikon hannunka za su tsaya cik kamar dutse, har sai mutanen da ka kawo sun wuce, ya Ubangiji.
english: Terror and dread falls on them. By the greatness of your arm they are as still as a stone, until your people pass over, Yahweh, until the people you have purchased pass over.

hausa: Mahaifinsu Efraim ya yi makoki dominsu kwanaki masu yawa sai danginsa suka zo don su yi masa ta’aziyya.
english: Ephraim their father mourned many days, and his brothers came to comfort him.

hausa: “ ‘Zan yi alkawarin salama da su in kuma kawar wa ƙasar da namun jeji domin su zauna a hamada su kuma kwana a kurmi lafiya lau.
english: “‘I will make with them a covenant of peace, and will cause evil animals to cease out of the land. They will dwell securely in the wilderness and sleep in the woods.

hausa: da ta Gazzam, da ta Uzza, da ta Faseya,
english: the children of Gazzam, the children of Uzza, the children of Paseah,

hausa: Ubangiji ya yi magana fuska da fuska da ku daga wuta a kan dutse.
english: Yahweh spoke with you face to face on the mountain out of the middle of the fire,

hausa: “ ‘Za ku yi sata da kisa, ku yi zina da rantsuwar ƙarya, kuna ƙone turare wa Ba’al kuna kuma bin waɗansu allolin da ba ku sani ba,
english: Will you steal, murder, commit adultery, swear falsely, burn incense to Baal, and walk after other gods that you have not known,

hausa: Cikin kowane batun da ya zo gabanku daga ’yan’uwanku waɗanda suke zama a birane, ko batun na kisa ne ko kuwa waɗansu batuttuwan da suka shafi doka, umarnai, ƙa’idodi ko farillai, dole ku ja musu kunne kada su yi wa Ubangiji zunubi; in ba haka ba fushinsa zai sauko a kanku da ’yan’uwanku. Ku yi wannan, ta haka ba za ku kuwa yi zunubi ba.
english: Whenever any controversy comes to you from your brothers who dwell in their cities, between blood and blood, between law and commandment, statutes and ordinances, you must warn them, that they not be guilty toward Yahweh, and so wrath come on you and on your brothers. Do this, and you will not be guilty.

hausa: In mutane biyu suna faɗa, sai matar mutum ɗaya daga cikinsu ta zo don tă kuɓutar da mijinta daga abokin faɗarsa, ta kuma miƙa hannu ta kama marainan wancan,
english: When men strive against each other, and the wife of one draws near to deliver her husband out of the hand of him who strikes him, and puts out her hand, and grabs him by his private parts,

hausa: Ka zo yanzu ka la’anta waɗannan mutane, domin sun fi ƙarfina. Wataƙila zan iya cin nasara a kansu, in kuma kore su daga ƙasar. Gama na sani duk waɗanda ka sa musu albarka, sun zama masu albarka ke nan, waɗanda kuma ka la’anta, sun la’antu ke nan.”
english: Please come now therefore, and curse this people for me; for they are too mighty for me. Perhaps I shall prevail, that we may strike them, and that I may drive them out of the land; for I know that he whom you bless is blessed, and he whom you curse is cursed.”

hausa: Ɗan Uzziyel shi ne, Mika; daga ’ya’yan Mika maza, Shamir.
english: The sons of Uzziel: Micah; of the sons of Micah, Shamir.

hausa: “ ‘Watanni bakwai gidan Isra’ila zai yi ta binne su don a tsarkake ƙasar.
english: “‘“The house of Israel will be burying them for seven months, that they may cleanse the land.

hausa: “Maigidansa ya amsa ya ce, ‘Madalla, bawan kirki mai aminci! Ka yi aminci a kan abubuwa kaɗan, zan sa ka lura da abubuwa masu yawa. Zo ka yi farin ciki tare da maigidanka!’
english: “His lord said to him, ‘Well done, good and faithful servant. You have been faithful over a few things. I will set you over many things. Enter into the joy of your lord.’

hausa: Zan watsar da su a cikin al’ummai da su da kakanninsu ba su sani ba, zan kuma fafare su da takobi sai na hallaka su.”
english: I will scatter them also among the nations, whom neither they nor their fathers have known. I will send the sword after them, until I have consumed them.”

hausa: Wannan fa shawara ce nake ba ku, ba umarni ba.
english: But this I say by way of concession, not of commandment.

hausa: “Gama ga abin da Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka yana cewa daga arewa zan kawo wa Taya Nebukadnezzar sarkin Babilon, sarkin sarakuna, tare da dawakai da kekunan yaƙi, da mahayan dawakai da babbar rundunar soja.
english: “For the Lord Yahweh says: ‘Behold, I will bring on Tyre Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, king of kings, from the north, with horses, with chariots, with horsemen, and an army with many people.

hausa: Amma da yake barin wurin, ya yi alkawari cewa, “Zan dawo in Allah ya yarda.” Sa’an nan ya tashi daga Afisa a jirgin ruwa.
english: but taking his leave of them, he said, “I must by all means keep this coming feast in Jerusalem, but I will return again to you if God wills.” Then he set sail from Ephesus.

hausa: Shi ya sa Amoriyawa suka rubuta wannan waƙa game da Heshbon suka ce, “Ku zo mu sāke gina Heshbon, birnin Sihon.
english: Therefore those who speak in proverbs say, “Come to Heshbon. Let the city of Sihon be built and established;

hausa: Gama ɗan nan nawa, da ya mutu, amma yanzu yana da rai kuma. Da ya ɓata, amma yanzu an same shi.’ Sai suka fara shagali.
english: for this, my son, was dead and is alive again. He was lost and is found.’ Then they began to celebrate.

hausa: “Saboda haka yanzu ina umartanku a gaban dukan Isra’ila da na taron jama’ar Ubangiji, da kuma a kunnuwan Allahnmu. Ku yi hankali ku kiyaye dukan umarnan Ubangiji Allahnku don ku mallaki wannan kyakkyawar ƙasa ku kuma bar wa zuriyarku gādo har abada.
english: Now therefore, in the sight of all Israel, Yahweh’s assembly, and in the audience of our God, observe and seek out all the commandments of Yahweh your God, that you may possess this good land, and leave it for an inheritance to your children after you forever.

hausa: sa’an nan suka kawo shi da farko wurin Annas, wanda yake surukin Kayifas, babban firist a shekaran nan.
english: and led him to Annas first, for he was father-in-law to Caiaphas, who was high priest that year.

hausa: kuma cewa ya kamata su yi shelar wannan magana, su kuma yaɗa ta a duk garuruwansu da kuma cikin Urushalima cewa, “Ku fita zuwa cikin ƙasar tudu ku kawo rassa daga itatuwan zaitun da na zaitun jeji, da kuma daga dargaza, da dabino da itatuwa masu ganye, don yin bukkoki”, kamar yadda yake a rubuce.
english: and that they should publish and proclaim in all their cities and in Jerusalem, saying, “Go out to the mountain, and get olive branches, branches of wild olive, myrtle branches, palm branches, and branches of thick trees, to make temporary shelters, as it is written.”

hausa: Gama annabci bai taɓa samo tushensa daga nufin mutum ba, sai dai mutane sun yi magana daga Allah yayinda Ruhu Mai Tsarki ya bishe su.
english: For no prophecy ever came by the will of man, but holy men of God spoke, being moved by the Holy Spirit.

hausa: Ku kuma masu bayi, dole ku bi da bayinku da kyau. Ku daina ba su tsoro. Ku tuna, ku da su, Maigida ɗaya kuke da shi a sama, kuma ba ya nuna bambanci.
english: You masters, do the same things to them, and give up threatening, knowing that he who is both their Master and yours is in heaven, and there is no partiality with him.

hausa: “Muka kuma ce, ‘In har suka ce mana, ko ’ya’yanmu haka, sai mu amsa mu ce ku dubi bagaden da yake daidai da na Ubangiji wanda iyayenmu suka gina, ba don ƙona hadayu da kuma yin sadaka ba, sai dai don yă zama shaida tsakaninmu da ku.’
english: “Therefore we said, ‘It shall be, when they tell us or our generations this in time to come, that we shall say, “Behold the pattern of Yahweh’s altar, which our fathers made, not for burnt offering, nor for sacrifice; but it is a witness between us and you.”’

hausa: “ ‘Ku miƙe tsaye a gaban tsofaffi, ku nuna bangirma ga waɗanda suka tsufa, ku kuma girmama Allahnku. Ni ne Ubangiji.
english: “‘You shall rise up before the gray head and honor the face of the elderly; and you shall fear your God. I am Yahweh.

hausa: Saboda haka sai ya auri Gomer ’yar Dibilayim, ta kuwa yi ciki ta haifi ɗa namiji.
english: So he went and took Gomer the daughter of Diblaim; and she conceived, and bore him a son.

hausa: Ku sa waɗansu daga cikin shugabanninku su tafi tare da ni su kawo ƙararsu a kan mutumin a can, in ya aikata wani laifi.”
english: “Let them therefore”, he said, “that are in power among you go down with me, and if there is anything wrong in the man, let them accuse him.”

hausa: Na faɗa muku tun kafin yă faru, domin in ya faru, ku gaskata.
english: Now I have told you before it happens so that when it happens, you may believe.

hausa: Don mai bi da kaɗe-kaɗe. Da kayan kiɗi masu tsirkiya. Ta Dawuda. Ka amsa mini sa’ad da na kira gare ka, Ya Allahna mai adalci. Ka ba ni sauƙi daga wahalata; ka ji tausayina ka kuma ji addu’ata.
english: For the Chief Musician; on stringed instruments. A Psalm by David. Answer me when I call, God of my righteousness. Give me relief from my distress. Have mercy on me, and hear my prayer.

hausa: Duniya da sha’awace-sha’awacenta suna shuɗewa, amma mutumin da yake aikata nufin Allah, zai rayu har abada.
english: The world is passing away with its lusts, but he who does God’s will remains forever.

hausa: sun lura da ma’aikata, suka kuma lura da dukan masu aiki daga aiki zuwa aiki. Waɗansu Lawiyawan su ne marubuta, magatakarda da kuma masu tsaron ƙofofi.
english: Also they were over the bearers of burdens, and directed all who did the work in every kind of service. Of the Levites, there were scribes, officials, and gatekeepers.

hausa: Ma’aikatana za su gangara da su daga Lebanon zuwa bakin teku. Zan sa a ɗaɗɗaura su su bi ruwan teku daga Lebanon zuwa bakin Bahar Rum da za ka nuna mini. A can zan kunce maka su, sa’an nan ka kwashe. Kai kuma za ka biya bukatata ta wurin tanadin abinci wa gidana.”
english: My servants will bring them down from Lebanon to the sea. I will make them into rafts to go by sea to the place that you specify to me, and will cause them to be broken up there, and you will receive them. You will accomplish my desire, in giving food for my household.”

hausa: Sai ya amsa ya ce, “ ‘Ka ƙaunaci Ubangiji Allahnka da dukan zuciyarka, da dukan ranka, da dukan ƙarfinka, da kuma dukan hankalinka’; kuma, ‘Ka ƙaunaci maƙwabcinka kamar kanka.’ ”
english: He answered, “You shall love the Lord your God with all your heart, with all your soul, with all your strength, and with all your mind; and your neighbor as yourself.”

hausa: to, sai a yi da shi yadda ya yi niyya yă yi da ɗan’uwansa. Dole ku fid da mugu daga cikinku.
english: then you shall do to him as he had thought to do to his brother. So you shall remove the evil from among you.

hausa: A can za ku tuna da halinku da kuma dukan ayyukanku waɗanda kuka ɓata kanku da su, za ku kuwa ji ƙyamar kanku saboda mugayen abubuwan da kuka aikata.
english: There you will remember your ways, and all your deeds in which you have polluted yourselves. Then you will loathe yourselves in your own sight for all your evils that you have committed.

hausa: Saboda haka Ubangiji Maɗaukaki ya ce, “Domin kun ƙi ku saurara ga maganata,
english: Therefore Yahweh of Armies says: “Because you have not heard my words,

hausa: gama kyautar Allah da kiransa ba a sokewa.
english: For the gifts and the calling of God are irrevocable.

hausa: ta goma sha tara a kan Malloti, na goma sha biya a kan Yerimot, ’ya’yansa maza da danginsa, 12
english: for the nineteenth to Mallothi, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

hausa: Aka kuma same shi a kamannin mutum, ya ƙasƙantar da kansa ya kuma zama mai biyayya wadda ta kai shi har mutuwa, mutuwar ma ta gicciye!
english: And being found in human form, he humbled himself, becoming obedient to the point of death, yes, the death of the cross.

hausa: A cikin alloli babu kamar ka, ya Ubangiji; babu ayyukan da za a kwatanta da naka.
english: There is no one like you among the gods, Lord, nor any deeds like your deeds.

hausa: To, an yi waɗansu ’yan’uwa guda bakwai. Na fari ya yi aure, ya mutu babu ’ya’ya.
english: There were seven brothers. The first took a wife, and dying left no offspring.

hausa: Kada ku zama kamar Kayinu, wanda ya zama na mugun nan, ya kuma kashe ɗan’uwansa. Me ya sa ya kashe shi? Domin ayyukansa mugaye ne, na ɗan’uwansa kuma na adalci ne.
english: unlike Cain, who was of the evil one and killed his brother. Why did he kill him? Because his deeds were evil, and his brother’s righteous.

hausa: Dukan waɗanda suke rarrafe, za su zama marasa tsarki gare ku. Duk wanda ya taɓa su sa’ad da suka mutu, zai zama ƙazantacce har zuwa yamma.
english: These are they which are unclean to you among all that creep. Whoever touches them when they are dead shall be unclean until the evening.

hausa: ta kuwa yi ciki, ta kuma haifi ɗa.
english: Bilhah conceived, and bore Jacob a son.

hausa: Ya ba da su ga Gibeyonawa, waɗanda suka kashe su, suka kuma rataye jikunansu a gaban Ubangiji. Dukan bakwai ɗin an kashe su gaba ɗaya; an kashe su a farkon kwanankin girbi, daidai lokacin fara girbin sha’ir.
english: He delivered them into the hands of the Gibeonites; and they hanged them on the mountain before Yahweh, and all seven of them fell together. They were put to death in the days of harvest, in the first days, at the beginning of barley harvest.

hausa: Da ya ci gaba daga nan, sai ya ga waɗansu ’yan’uwa guda biyu, Yaƙub ɗan Zebedi da ɗan’uwansa Yohanna. Suna cikin jirgin ruwa tare da mahaifinsu Zebedi, suna shirya abin kamun kifinsu. Yesu ya kira su,
