english: Going on from there, he saw two other brothers, James the son of Zebedee, and John his brother, in the boat with Zebedee their father, mending their nets. He called them.

hausa: Wane ne yake cika zuciya da hikima ko kuma yake ba zuciya ganewa?
english: Who has put wisdom in the inward parts? Or who has given understanding to the mind?

hausa: Wani mutum ya ruga ya je ya jiƙo soso da ruwan tsami, ya soka a sanda ya miƙa wa Yesu yă sha. Ya ce, “Ku ƙyale shi. Bari mu ga ko Iliya zai zo yă saukar da shi.”
english: One ran, and filling a sponge full of vinegar, put it on a reed and gave it to him to drink, saying, “Let him be. Let’s see whether Elijah comes to take him down.”

hausa: “Ka tashi tsaye ka tsaya da ƙarfi kamar namiji; zan yi maka tambaya kuma za ka amsa mini.
english: “Now brace yourself like a man. I will question you, and you will answer me.

hausa: Ya ce wa mutanensa, “Duba Isra’ilawa sun yi yawa, sun fi ƙarfinmu.
english: He said to his people, “Behold, the people of the children of Israel are more and mightier than we.

hausa: “Yanzu shekaruna ɗari da ashirin ne, ba na iya kaiwa da komowa. Ubangiji ya ce mini, ‘Ba za ka haye Urdun ba.’
english: He said to them, “I am one hundred twenty years old today. I can no more go out and come in. Yahweh has said to me, ‘You shall not go over this Jordan.’

hausa: Ubangiji ya ce, “Yawan hadayunku, mene ne suke a gare ni?” Ina da isashen hadayun ƙonawa, na raguna da na kitsen dabbobi masu ƙiba; ba na jin daɗin jinin bijimai da na tumaki da kuma na awaki.
english: “What are the multitude of your sacrifices to me?”, says Yahweh. “I have had enough of the burnt offerings of rams and the fat of fed animals. I don’t delight in the blood of bulls, or of lambs, or of male goats.

hausa: shi ma zai sha ruwan inabin fushin Allah, wanda aka zuba da duk ƙarfinsa a kwaf fushinsa. Za a ba shi azaba da farar wuta mai ci a gaban tsarkakan mala’iku da na Ɗan Ragon.
english: he also will drink of the wine of the wrath of God, which is prepared unmixed in the cup of his anger. He will be tormented with fire and sulfur in the presence of the holy angels and in the presence of the Lamb.

hausa: Zan yabe ka da garaya saboda amincinka, ya Allah; zan rera yabo gare ka da molo, Ya Mai Tsarki na Isra’ila.
english: I will also praise you with the harp for your faithfulness, my God. I sing praises to you with the lyre, Holy One of Israel.

hausa: Allah yana cikin fadodinta; ya nuna kansa mafaka ce gare ta.
english: God has shown himself in her citadels as a refuge.

hausa: “Ka kuma yi sanduna da itacen ƙirya. Sanduna biyar domin katakai na gefe ɗaya na tabanakul,
english: “You shall make bars of acacia wood: five for the boards of the one side of the tabernacle,

hausa: To, a tashin matattu, matar wa za tă zama, don duk su bakwai nan sun aure ta?”
english: In the resurrection, when they rise, whose wife will she be of them? For the seven had her as a wife.”

hausa: “Ku tuna da dokar bawana Musa, ƙa’idodi da dokokin da na ba shi a Horeb domin dukan Isra’ila.
english: “Remember the law of Moses my servant, which I commanded to him in Horeb for all Israel, even statutes and ordinances.

hausa: Sa’ad da mala’ikan da ya yi masa magana ya tafi, sai Korneliyus ya kira biyu daga cikin bayinsa da kuma wani soja mai ibada wanda yake ɗaya a cikin masu yin masa hidima.
english: When the angel who spoke to him had departed, Cornelius called two of his household servants and a devout soldier of those who waited on him continually.

hausa: “Ɗan fari na kowane mutum zai zama nawa, har da ɗan farin na dabbobi, ko na garken shanu ko na tumaki.
english: “All that opens the womb is mine; and all your livestock that is male, the firstborn of cow and sheep.

hausa: Yanzu kuma kun nuna mini ba ku iya taimako; kun ga abin bantsoro kuka tsorata.
english: For now you are nothing. You see a terror, and are afraid.

hausa: Bayan mutuwar Shawulu, Dawuda ya dawo daga karkashe Amalekawa. Sai ya zauna a Ziklag kwana biyu.
english: After the death of Saul, when David had returned from the slaughter of the Amalekites, and David had stayed two days in Ziklag,

hausa: Ka tsarkake su ta wurin gaskiya; maganarka ce gaskiya.
english: Sanctify them in your truth. Your word is truth.

hausa: Ya amsa, ya ce, “Ina kishi dominka Ubangiji, Allah Maɗaukaki. Isra’ilawa sun ƙi alkawarinka, suka rurrushe bagadanka, suka kuma kashe annabawanka da takobi. Ni ne kaɗai na rage, yanzu, ni ma suna ƙoƙari su kashe ni.”
english: He said, “I have been very jealous for Yahweh, the God of Armies; for the children of Israel have forsaken your covenant, thrown down your altars, and killed your prophets with the sword. I, even I only, am left; and they seek my life, to take it away.”

hausa: Firistoci, ’ya’yan Lawi maza, za su fito, gama Ubangiji Allahnku ya zaɓe su su yi masa hidima, su kuma furta albarku a cikin sunan Ubangiji, za su kuma daidaita duk rigimar cin mutunci.
english: The priests the sons of Levi shall come near, for them Yahweh your God has chosen to minister to him, and to bless in Yahweh’s name; and according to their word shall every controversy and every assault be decided.

hausa: In Allah bai yarda da bayinsa ba, in ya sami mala’ikunsa da laifi,
english: Behold, he puts no trust in his servants. He charges his angels with error.

hausa: Sai suka yi alamu wa mahaifinsa, don su san sunan da zai su a kira yaron.
english: They made signs to his father, what he would have him called.

hausa: Sai ta wuce zuwa Azmon ta haɗu da Rafin Masar, ta ƙarasa a Bahar Rum. Wannan shi ne iyakarsu ta kudu.
english: and it passed along to Azmon, went out at the brook of Egypt; and the border ended at the sea. This shall be your south border.

hausa: “Ka tambayi dukan mutanen ƙasar da firistoci cewa, ‘Sa’ad da kuka yi makoki da azumi a wata na biyar da na bakwai dukan shekaru saba’in nan, a ainihi saboda ni kuka yi azumi?
english: “Speak to all the people of the land and to the priests, saying, ‘When you fasted and mourned in the fifth and in the seventh month for these seventy years, did you at all fast to me, really to me?

hausa: Gashin kansu ya yi kamar gashin kan mata, haƙoransu kuma sun yi kamar haƙoran zakoki.
english: They had hair like women’s hair, and their teeth were like those of lions.

hausa: Na amsa musu na ce, “Allah na sama zai ba mu nasara. Mu bayinsa za mu tashi mu fara gini, amma game da ku kam, ba ku da rabo cikin Urushalima, ba ku da wani hakki ko wani abin tunawa.”
english: Then I answered them, and said to them, “The God of heaven will prosper us. Therefore we, his servants, will arise and build; but you have no portion, nor right, nor memorial in Jerusalem.”

hausa: Ko da jawabinsa ya ɗauki hankali, kada ka gaskata shi, gama abubuwa ƙyama guda bakwai sun cika zuciyarsa.
english: When his speech is charming, don’t believe him, for there are seven abominations in his heart.

hausa: “To, da a ce kun yi abin bangirma da aniya mai kyau sa’ad da kuka naɗa Abimelek sarki, da kun nuna wa Yerub-Ba’al da iyalinsa ladabi, da kuma kun yi masa abin da ya cancanci shi,
english: “Now therefore, if you have dealt truly and righteously, in that you have made Abimelech king, and if you have dealt well with Jerubbaal and his house, and have done to him according to the deserving of his hands

hausa: Amma ɗayan mai laifi ya kwaɓe shi ya ce, “Ba ka da tsoron Allah ne, wai saboda kana ƙarƙashin hukunci ɗaya tare da shi?
english: But the other answered, and rebuking him said, “Don’t you even fear God, seeing you are under the same condemnation?

hausa: Amma yanzu dole ku raba kanku da dukan ire-iren abubuwan nan. Ku daina fushi, ku daina ƙiyayya da ƙeta. Ku bar ɓatan suna da kuma ƙazamar magana daga leɓunanku.
english: but now you must put them all away: anger, wrath, malice, slander, and shameful speaking out of your mouth.

hausa: Zunubanka ne suke gaya maka abin da za ka ce; kana magana kamar mai wayo.
english: For your iniquity teaches your mouth, and you choose the language of the crafty.

hausa: Ki yi ihu, ya ke ƙofa! Yi kururuwa, ya ke birni! Ku razana, dukanku Filistiyawa! Ƙunshin hayaƙi yana tasowa daga arewa, kuma babu matsorata a cikin sojojinsa.
english: Howl, gate! Cry, city! You are melted away, Philistia, all of you; for smoke comes out of the north, and there is no straggler in his ranks.

hausa: “Ta yaya zan iya yin faɗa da shi? Ina zan iya samun kalmomin da zan yi gardama da shi?
english: How much less will I answer him, and choose my words to argue with him?

hausa: na iyalin Hilkiya, Hashabiya; na iyalin Yedahiya, Netanel.
english: of Hilkiah, Hashabiah; of Jedaiah, Nethanel.

hausa: Wani ya ce masa, “Mahaifiyarka da ’yan’uwanka suna tsaye a waje, suna so su yi magana da kai.”
english: One said to him, “Behold, your mother and your brothers stand outside, seeking to speak to you.”

hausa: Firist zai kawo ta bagade, yă murɗe wuyan tsuntsun yă ƙone shi a kan bagade; zai tsiyaye jininsa tsuntsun a gefen bagaden.
english: The priest shall bring it to the altar, and wring off its head, and burn it on the altar; and its blood shall be drained out on the side of the altar;

hausa: Mutanen Yahuda kuma suka ci Gaza, Ashkelon, da Ekron, kowace birni tare da yankinsa.
english: Also Judah took Gaza with its border, and Ashkelon with its border, and Ekron with its border.

hausa: Da shi ne ya taɓa bakina ya ce, “Duba, wannan ya taɓa leɓunanka, yanzu fa an kawar da laifofinka, an kuma gafarta maka zunubanka.”
english: He touched my mouth with it, and said, “Behold, this has touched your lips; and your iniquity is taken away, and your sin forgiven.”

hausa: “Za su san cewa ni ne Ubangiji sa’ad da na watsar da su a cikin al’ummai na kuma warwatsa su cikin ƙasashe.
english: “‘They will know that I am Yahweh when I disperse them among the nations and scatter them through the countries.

hausa: ’Ya’yan Benyamin maza su ne, Bela, Beker, Ashbel, Gera, Na’aman, Ehi, Rosh, Muffim, Huffim da Ard.
english: The sons of Benjamin: Bela, Becher, Ashbel, Gera, Naaman, Ehi, Rosh, Muppim, Huppim, and Ard.

hausa: Wani kuma zai mutu cikin ɗacin rai, bai taɓa jin daɗin wani abu mai kyau ba.
english: Another dies in bitterness of soul, and never tastes of good.

hausa: Al’ummai za su gani su kuma ji kunya, za a kuma ƙwace musu dukan ikonsu. Za su kama bakinsu kunnuwansu kuma za su zama kurame.
english: The nations will see and be ashamed of all their might. They will lay their hand on their mouth. Their ears will be deaf.

hausa: ku duwatsu, kuka yi tsalle kamar raguna, ku tuddai, kamar tumaki?
english: You mountains, that you skipped like rams? You little hills, like lambs?

hausa: ‘Ko zai yiwu mutum yă fi Allah adalci, ko kuma mutum yă fi wanda ya halicce shi tsarki?
english: ‘Shall mortal man be more just than God? Shall a man be more pure than his Maker?

hausa: Malkiya ɗan Harim, da Hasshub ɗan Fahat-Mowab ya yi gyare-gyaren wani sashe da kuma Hasumiyar Wurin Gashi.
english: Malchijah the son of Harim and Hasshub the son of Pahathmoab repaired another portion and the tower of the furnaces.

hausa: “Efraim yana cuɗanya da al’ummai; Efraim waina ne mai fāɗi da ba a juye ba.
english: Ephraim mixes himself among the nations. Ephraim is a pancake not turned over.

hausa: A hannun Ubangiji zuciyar sarki kamar ruwan rafi ne wanda yake bi da shi duk inda ya so.
english: The king’s heart is in Yahweh’s hand like the watercourses. He turns it wherever he desires.

hausa: Ka ɗan miƙa hannunka ka raba shi da duk abin da yake da shi, ba shakka zai la’anta ka kana ji, kana gani.”
english: But stretch out your hand now, and touch all that he has, and he will renounce you to your face.”

hausa: Babilon ta zama ƙoƙon zinariya a hannun Ubangiji, ta sa dukan duniya ta yi maye. Ƙasashe sun sha ruwan inabinta, saboda haka yanzu sun haukace.
english: Babylon has been a golden cup in Yahweh’s hand, who made all the earth drunk. The nations have drunk of her wine; therefore the nations have gone mad.

hausa: Wannan babban asiri ne, amma na ɗauke shi a matsayin kwatanci ne na Kiristi da ikkilisiya.
english: This mystery is great, but I speak concerning Christ and the assembly.

hausa: Sai dai in ba za su iya ƙame kansu ba, to, su yi aure, don yă fi kyau a yi aure, da sha’awa ta sha kan mutum.
english: But if they don’t have self-control, let them marry. For it’s better to marry than to burn with passion.

hausa: Ku bayar hannu sake gare shi, ku kuma yi haka ba tare da gunaguni ba; saboda wannan fa Ubangiji Allahnku zai albarkace ku a cikin dukan aikinku, da kuma kome da kuka sa hannunku a kai.
english: You shall surely give, and your heart shall not be grieved when you give to him, because it is for this thing Yahweh your God will bless you in all your work and in all that you put your hand to.

hausa: Bakunansu na cewa sama na su ne, kuma harsunansu sun mallaki duniya.
english: They have set their mouth in the heavens. Their tongue walks through the earth.

hausa: Ko da bishararmu a rufe take, tana a rufe ne ga waɗanda suke hallaka.
english: Even if our Good News is veiled, it is veiled in those who are dying,

hausa: Ana cikin haka sai wani annabi ya zo wurin Ahab sarkin Isra’ila ya sanar masa cewa, “Ga abin da Ubangiji ya ce, ‘Ka ga wannan ɗumbun mayaƙa? Zan ba da su cikin hannunka a yau, sa’an nan za ka san cewa ni ne Ubangiji.’ ”
english: Behold, a prophet came near to Ahab king of Israel, and said, “Yahweh says, ‘Have you seen all this great multitude? Behold, I will deliver it into your hand today. Then you will know that I am Yahweh.’”

hausa: Ku yi godiya ga Ubangijin iyayengiji. Ƙaunarsa madawwamiya ce.
english: Give thanks to the Lord of lords, for his loving kindness endures forever;

hausa: Ka sa su ɗauki ɗan bijimi tare da lallausan garin hadaya, kwaɓaɓɓe da mai; sa’an nan, kai kuma ka ɗauki ɗan bijimi na biyu na hadaya don zunubi.
english: Then let them take a young bull and its meal offering, fine flour mixed with oil; and another young bull you shall take for a sin offering.

hausa: Daga nan iyakar ta juya baya zuwa Rama, ta bi ta birnin nan mai katanga na Taya, ta juya ta nufi Hosa, sa’an nan ta ɓulla ta Bahar Rum cikin yankin Akzib,
english: The border turned to Ramah, to the fortified city of Tyre; and the border turned to Hosah. It ended at the sea by the region of Achzib;

hausa: domin dukan dogayen duwatsu da kuma tuddai masu tsayi,
english: for all the high mountains, for all the hills that are lifted up,

hausa: Kashegari, Musa ya zauna domin yă yi wa mutane shari’a, sai suka tsaya kewaye da shi daga safe har yamma.
english: On the next day, Moses sat to judge the people, and the people stood around Moses from the morning to the evening.

hausa: Duk da haka sa’ad da nake begen abu mai kyau, mugun abu ne ya zo; Sa’ad da nake neman haske, sai duhu ya zo.
english: When I looked for good, then evil came. When I waited for light, darkness came.

hausa: Daga fitowar rana zuwa inda take fāɗuwa, a yabi sunan Ubangiji.
english: From the rising of the sun to its going down, Yahweh’s name is to be praised.

hausa: An kewaye babban filin da katanga da jerin uku-uku na duwatsun da aka gyara, da kuma jeri guda na gyararren al’ul, kamar yadda aka yi na filin cikin haikalin Ubangiji da shirayinsa.
english: The great court around had three courses of cut stone with a course of cedar beams, like the inner court of Yahweh’s house and the porch of the house.

hausa: Tiglat-Fileser sarkin Assuriya ya zo wurinsa, sai ya wahalar da sarki Ahaz maimakon taimakonsa.
english: Tilgath-pilneser king of Assyria came to him and gave him trouble, but didn’t strengthen him.

hausa: Ka kori maza da mata ma; ka kai su bayan sansani domin kada su ƙazantar da sansani inda nake zama a cikinsu.”
english: You shall put both male and female outside of the camp so that they don’t defile their camp, in the midst of which I dwell.”

hausa: yanzu da kuka ɗanɗana alherin Ubangiji.
english: if indeed you have tasted that the Lord is gracious.

hausa: amma shekaru bakwai na yunwa za su biyo bayansu. Tsananin yunwar za tă sa a manta da dukan isashen abincin da aka samu a ƙasar Masar, yunwa kuwa za tă rufe dukan ƙasar.
english: Seven years of famine will arise after them, and all the plenty will be forgotten in the land of Egypt. The famine will consume the land,

hausa: Isuwa ya riƙe Yaƙub a zuciya saboda albarkar da mahaifinsa ya sa masa. Ya ce wa kansa, “Kwanakin mutuwar mahaifina sun yi kusa; sa’an nan zan kashe ɗan’uwana Yaƙub.”
english: Esau hated Jacob because of the blessing with which his father blessed him. Esau said in his heart, “The days of mourning for my father are at hand. Then I will kill my brother Jacob.”

hausa: Abiyezer, mutumin Anatot, da Mebunnai, mutumin Husha,
english: Abiezer the Anathothite, Mebunnai the Hushathite,

hausa: Musa da Eleyazar firist, suka karɓi zinariya da kayan adon duka daga gare su.
english: Moses and Eleazar the priest took their gold, even all worked jewels.

hausa: haka aka miƙa Kiristi hadaya sau ɗaya domin yă ɗauke zunuban mutane masu yawa; zai kuma bayyana sau na biyu, ba don yă ɗauki zunubi ba, sai dai don yă kawo ceto ga waɗanda suke jiransa.
english: so Christ also, having been offered once to bear the sins of many, will appear a second time, not to deal with sin, but to save those who are eagerly waiting for him.

hausa: daga Fahat-Mowab, Eliyehoyenai ɗan Zerahiya ne shugaba, tare da shi akwai mutum 200;
english: Of the sons of Pahathmoab, Eliehoenai the son of Zerahiah; and with him two hundred males.

hausa: ko da yake ni kaina ina da dalilan dogara da haka. In kuwa akwai wani wanda yake tsammani yana da dalilan dogara ga jiki, ni fa na fi shi,
english: though I myself might have confidence even in the flesh. If any other man thinks that he has confidence in the flesh, I yet more:

hausa: Yoshuwa ya ce musu, “Kada ku ji tsoro, ko kuwa ku razana, amma ku ƙarfafa, ku yi ƙarfin hali. Haka Ubangiji zai yi da duk abokan gāban da za ku yi yaƙi da su.”
english: Joshua said to them, “Don’t be afraid, nor be dismayed. Be strong and courageous, for Yahweh will do this to all your enemies against whom you fight.”

hausa: Kashegari, sa’ad da Yesu tare da almajiran nan uku suka sauka daga kan dutsen, sai taro mai yawa ya haɗu da shi.
english: On the next day, when they had come down from the mountain, a great multitude met him.

hausa: Saboda haka ya iya ba da ceto gaba ɗaya ga masu zuwa wurin Allah ta wurinsa, gama kullum a raye yake saboda yă yi roƙo dominsu.
english: Therefore he is also able to save to the uttermost those who draw near to God through him, seeing that he lives forever to make intercession for them.

hausa: Har yanzu ba ku gane ba ne? Ba ku tuna da gurasa biyar ɗin nan na mutum dubu biyar ba? Kwando nawa kuka tattara cike?
english: Don’t you yet perceive or remember the five loaves for the five thousand, and how many baskets you took up,

hausa: Aka zaunar da ’yan’uwan Yusuf a gabansa bisa ga shekarunsu, daga ɗan fari zuwa auta. ’Yan’uwan kuwa suka duddubi juna suna mamaki.
english: They sat before him, the firstborn according to his birthright, and the youngest according to his youth, and the men marveled with one another.

hausa: Wane ne wannan Sarkin ɗaukaka? Ubangiji ne mai ƙarfi mai iko, Ubangiji mai girma a yaƙi.
english: Who is the King of glory? Yahweh strong and mighty, Yahweh mighty in battle.

hausa: Ubangiji ce, “In na sami mutum hamshin masu adalci a cikin birnin Sodom, zan bar dukan birnin saboda su.”
english: Yahweh said, “If I find in Sodom fifty righteous within the city, then I will spare the whole place for their sake.”

hausa: Gama zuciyar mutanen nan ta yi tauri; da ƙyar suke ji da kunnuwansu, sun kuma rufe idanunsu. In ba haka ba za su iya gani da idanunsu, su ji da kunnuwansu, su fahimta a zukatansu, su kuma juyo, in kuwa warkar da su.’
english: For this people’s heart has grown callous. Their ears are dull of hearing. Their eyes they have closed. Lest they should see with their eyes, hear with their ears, understand with their heart, and would turn again, then I would heal them.’

hausa: Wannan shi ne ma’anar wannan wahayin da ka gani na dutsen da aka yanko daga jikin tsaunin, amma ba da hannun ɗan adam ba, dutsen da ya ragargaza ƙarfen, da tagullar, da yumɓun da azurfar da kuma zinariyar. “Allah mai girma ya nuna wa sarki abin da zai faru nan gaba. Mafarkin gaskiya ne, fassararsa kuma abin dogara ne.”
english: Because you saw that a stone was cut out of the mountain without hands, and that it broke in pieces the iron, the bronze, the clay, the silver, and the gold, the great God has made known to the king what will happen hereafter. The dream is certain, and its interpretation sure.”

hausa: suna da kunnuwa, amma ba sa ji, ba kuwa numfashi a bakunansu.
english: They have ears, but they can’t hear, neither is there any breath in their mouths.

hausa: “A, Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka, ka yi sammai da duniya ta wurin ikonka mai girma da kuma hannunka mai iko. Ba abin da ya gagare ka.
english: “Ah Lord Yahweh! Behold, you have made the heavens and the earth by your great power and by your outstretched arm. There is nothing too hard for you.

hausa: Ta amsa ta ce, “Ka yi mini alheri na musamman, tun da ka ba ni wuri a Negeb, ina roƙonka, ka ba ni maɓulɓulan ruwa.” Kaleb kuwa ya ba ta maɓulɓulan ruwa na tuddai da na kwari.
english: She said, “Give me a blessing. Because you have set me in the land of the South, give me also springs of water.” So he gave her the upper springs and the lower springs.

hausa: Ta je ta gaya wa waɗanda dā suke tare da shi, waɗanda kuma suke makoki da kuka.
english: She went and told those who had been with him, as they mourned and wept.

hausa: Sa’an nan mala’ikan Ubangiji ya tambaye shi, “Don me ka buge jakarka har sau uku? Na fito ne don in hana ka, gama hanyarka ba daidai ba ce a gabana.
english: Yahweh’s angel said to him, “Why have you struck your donkey these three times? Behold, I have come out as an adversary, because your way is perverse before me.

hausa: Ku keɓe shekara ta hamsin ku kuma yi shelar ’yanci a dukan ƙasar ga mazaunanta. Za tă zama shekarar murna gare ku; kowannenku zai koma ga mallakar iyalinsa, kuma kowa ga danginsa.
english: You shall make the fiftieth year holy, and proclaim liberty throughout the land to all its inhabitants. It shall be a jubilee to you; and each of you shall return to his own property, and each of you shall return to his family.

hausa: Yayinda akwatin alkawarin Ubangiji yake shiga Birnin Dawuda, Mikal ’yar Shawulu ta leƙa daga taga. Sa’ad da ta ga Sarki Dawuda yana rawa yana shagali, sai ta rena masa wayo a zuciyarta.
english: As the ark of Yahweh’s covenant came to David’s city, Michal the daughter of Saul looked out at the window, and saw king David dancing and playing; and she despised him in her heart.

hausa: Gama dutsensu ba kamar Dutsenmu ba ne, abokan gābanmu sun san da haka.
english: For their rock is not as our Rock, even our enemies themselves concede.

hausa: Ahimawaz ɗan Zadok ya sāke ce wa Yowab, “Ko mene ne zai faru, ina roƙonka bari in bi bayan mutumin Kush nan.” Amma Yowab ya ce, “Ɗana me ya sa kake so ka je? Ba ka da labarin da zai jawo maka lada.”
english: Then Ahimaaz the son of Zadok said yet again to Joab, “But come what may, please let me also run after the Cushite.” Joab said, “Why do you want to run, my son, since you will have no reward for the news?”

hausa: Amma mata Za tă sami ceto za su sami ceto ta wurin haihuwa, in suka ci gaba cikin bangaskiya, ƙauna da kuma tsarki tare da halin sanin ya kamata.
english: but she will be saved through her childbearing, if they continue in faith, love, and holiness with sobriety.

hausa: Waɗannan su ne kalmomin da Musa ya yi wa dukan Isra’ila, a hamada gabas da Urdun, wato, Araba, ɗaura da Suf, tsakanin Faran da Tofel, Laban, Hazerot da Dizahab.
english: These are the words which Moses spoke to all Israel beyond the Jordan in the wilderness, in the Arabah opposite Suf, between Paran, Tophel, Laban, Hazeroth, and Dizahab.

hausa: don su kuɓuce wa Babiloniyawa. Sun ji tsoronsu domin Ishmayel ɗan Netaniya ya kashe Gedaliya ɗan Ahikam, wanda sarkin Babilon ya naɗa gwamna a kan ƙasar.
english: because of the Chaldeans; for they were afraid of them, because Ishmael the son of Nethaniah had killed Gedaliah the son of Ahikam, whom the king of Babylon made governor over the land.

hausa: Sai suka fita daga garin suka nufa inda yake.
english: They went out of the city, and were coming to him.

hausa: Dukan jama’ar da suka komo daga zaman bauta suka yi bukkoki suka kuma zauna a cikinsu. Daga kwanakin Yoshuwa ɗan Nun har yă zuwa yau, Isra’ilawa ba su taɓa yin bikinsa haka ba. Mutane suka cika da farin ciki sosai.
english: All the assembly of those who had come back out of the captivity made temporary shelters and lived in the temporary shelters, for since the days of Joshua the son of Nun to that day the children of Israel had not done so. There was very great gladness.

hausa: Musa ya ce wa shugabannin kabilan Isra’ila, “Ga abin da Ubangiji ya umarta.
english: Moses spoke to the heads of the tribes of the children of Israel, saying, “This is the thing which Yahweh has commanded.

hausa: Ko cikin dariya zuciya takan yi ciwo, kuma farin ciki kan iya ƙarasa a baƙin ciki.
english: Even in laughter the heart may be sorrowful, and mirth may end in heaviness.

hausa: Sai Yoshuwa ya kira mutum goma sha biyu da ya zaɓa daga cikin Isra’ilawa, ɗaya daga kowace kabila
english: Then Joshua called the twelve men whom he had prepared of the children of Israel, a man out of every tribe.

hausa: Arbadiyawa, Zemarawa da Hamawa.
english: the Arvadite, the Zemarite, and the Hamathite.

hausa: Zai dawo da ku zuwa ƙasar da take ta kakanninku, za ku kuwa mallake ta. Zai sa ku yi arziki, ku kuma yi yawa fiye da kakanninku.
english: Yahweh your God will bring you into the land which your fathers possessed, and you will possess it. He will do you good, and increase your numbers more than your fathers.

hausa: Wane ne Allah kamar ka, wanda yake yafe zunubi yă kuma gafarta laifofin mutanensa da suka ragu? Ba ka zama mai fushi har abada amma kana marmari ka nuna jinƙai.
english: Who is a God like you, who pardons iniquity, and passes over the disobedience of the remnant of his heritage? He doesn’t retain his anger forever, because he delights in loving kindness.

hausa: Ubangiji ya ce wa Musa,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

hausa: Sai Sarki ya amsa wa mutane da zafi. Yana ƙin shawarar da dattawa suka ba shi.
english: The king answered the people roughly, and abandoned the counsel of the old men which they had given him,

hausa: to, sai ka yi haka, ɗana don ka ’yantar da kanka; da yake ka shiga hannuwan maƙwabcinka, ka tafi ka ƙasƙantar da kanka; ka roƙi maƙwabcinka!
english: Do this now, my son, and deliver yourself, since you have come into the hand of your neighbor. Go, humble yourself. Press your plea with your neighbor.

hausa: Me ya sa kuke kuka a kan mikinku, wahalarku da ba ta da magani? Domin laifinku da girma yake da kuma zunubanku masu yawa na yi muku waɗannan abubuwa.
english: Why do you cry over your injury? Your pain is incurable. For the greatness of your iniquity, because your sins have increased, I have done these things to you.

hausa: Ka cika alkawarinka ga bawanka, saboda a ji tsoronka.
english: Fulfill your promise to your servant, that you may be feared.

hausa: na Rama da Geba 621
english: The children of Ramah and Geba, six hundred twenty-one.

hausa: Sa’ad da iyayensu maza ko ’yan’uwansu suka kawo mana ƙara, za mu ce musu, ‘Ku yi mana alheri ku bar su, domin ba mu samo musu mata ba lokacin yaƙi, ku kuma marasa laifi ne, tun da yake ba ku ba da ’ya’yan matanku gare su ba.’ ”
english: It shall be, when their fathers or their brothers come to complain to us, that we will say to them, ‘Grant them graciously to us, because we didn’t take for each man his wife in battle, neither did you give them to them; otherwise you would now be guilty.’”

hausa: Yusuf, wani Balawe daga Saifurus, wanda manzanni suke kira Barnabas (wanda yake nufin Ɗan Ƙarfafawa)
english: Joses, who by the apostles was also called Barnabas (which is, being interpreted, Son of Encouragement), a Levite, a man of Cyprus by race,

hausa: mu sanannu ne, duk da haka an ɗauke mu kamar ba a san mu ba, muna mutuwa, duk da haka a raye muke, an ba mu horo, duk da haka ba a kashe mu ba,
english: as unknown and yet well known, as dying and behold—we live, as punished and not killed,

hausa: Ba da daɗewa za a ’yantar da ’yan kurkuku; ba za su mutu a kurkuku ba, ba kuwa za su rasa abinci ba.
english: The captive exile will speedily be freed. He will not die and go down into the pit. His bread won’t fail.

hausa: Wannan zai zama na keɓaɓɓun firistoci, zuriyar Zadok, waɗanda suka yi aminci cikin hidimata ba su kuwa karkata kamar yadda Lawiyawa suka yi sa’ad da Isra’ilawa suka karkace ba.
english: It shall be for the priests who are sanctified of the sons of Zadok, who have kept my instruction, who didn’t go astray when the children of Israel went astray, as the Levites went astray.

hausa: Da zuriyarku ta zama kamar yashi, ’ya’yanku kamar tsabar hatsin da ba a iya ƙidayawa; da ba za a taɓa yanke sunansu balle a hallaka su daga gabana ba.”
english: Your offspring also would have been as the sand and the descendants of your body like its grains. His name would not be cut off nor destroyed from before me.”

hausa: Muryar tana cewa, “Ka yi shela.” Na kuwa ce, “Me zan yi shelar?” “Dukan mutane kamar ciyawa suke, kuma dukan ɗaukakarsu kamar furannin jeji ne.
english: The voice of one saying, “Cry out!” One said, “What shall I cry?” “All flesh is like grass, and all its glory is like the flower of the field.

hausa: Zuciyata kan faɗa game da kai, “Nemi fuskarsa!” Fuskarka, Ubangiji, zan nema.
english: When you said, “Seek my face,” my heart said to you, “I will seek your face, Yahweh.”

hausa: Ubangiji yana ƙaunar adalci duniya ta cika da ƙaunarsa marar ƙarewa.
english: He loves righteousness and justice. The earth is full of the loving kindness of Yahweh.

hausa: Ku je wurin firistoci, waɗanda suke Lawiyawa, ga kuma alƙalin wanda yake mulki a lokacin. Ku bincika daga gare su, za su kuwa ba da hukunci.
english: You shall come to the priests who are Levites and to the judge who shall be in those days. You shall inquire, and they shall give you the verdict.

hausa: Ya gina Wuri Mafi Tsarki na can ciki, ya gina shi a can ƙuryar haikalin. Tsayinsa kamu ashirin ne, an manne masa katakan itacen al’ul tun daga ƙasa har zuwa sama.
english: He built twenty cubits of the back part of the house with boards of cedar from the floor to the ceiling. He built this within, for an inner sanctuary, even for the most holy place.

hausa: Haka ma ɗakunanta, bangayenta da shirayinta, ƙofar tana da tagogi duk a kewaye. Tsawonta kamu hamsin, fāɗinta kuma kamu ashirin da biyar.
english: its lodges, its posts, and its arches. There were windows in it all around. The length was fifty cubits and the width twenty-five cubits.

hausa: Sa’ad da kuma Ubangiji Allahnku ya ba da su gare ku, kuka kuma ci su da yaƙi, sai ku hallaka su ƙaƙaf. Kada ku yi yarjejjeniya da su, kada kuma ku nuna musu jinƙai.
english: and when Yahweh your God delivers them up before you, and you strike them, then you shall utterly destroy them. You shall make no covenant with them, nor show mercy to them.

hausa: Na ɗaga hannuwana ga umarnanka, waɗanda nake ƙauna, ina kuma tunani a kan ƙa’idodinka.
english: I reach out my hands for your commandments, which I love. I will meditate on your statutes. ZAYIN

hausa: “Duk wanda ana amincewa da shi cikin ƙaramin abu, ana kuma amincewa da shi cikin babba. Kuma duk marar gaskiya cikin ƙaramin abu, zai zama marar gaskiya cikin babba.
english: He who is faithful in a very little is faithful also in much. He who is dishonest in a very little is also dishonest in much.

hausa: Ka haɗa labule biyar tare, ka yi haka kuma da suran biyar ɗin.
english: Five curtains shall be coupled together to one another, and the other five curtains shall be coupled to one another.

hausa: Yanzu fa, Allahnmu, muna gode maka, muna kuma yabon ɗaukakar sunanka.
english: Now therefore, our God, we thank you and praise your glorious name.

hausa: Yoshuwa ya cinye yankin duka da yaƙi, haɗe da na kan tudu, da Negeb, da kwarin yamma, da filayen cikin duwatsu tare da sarakunansu duka. Bai bar wani da rai ba, ya kashe duk wani mai numfashi, yadda Ubangiji, Allah na Isra’ilawa ya umarta.
english: So Joshua struck all the land, the hill country, the South, the lowland, the slopes, and all their kings. He left no one remaining, but he utterly destroyed all that breathed, as Yahweh, the God of Israel, commanded.

hausa: Ƙasarsu ta cika da gumaka; sukan rusuna ga aikin hannuwansu, ga abin da yatsotsinsu suka yi.
english: Their land also is full of idols. They worship the work of their own hands, that which their own fingers have made.

hausa: Mutum mai adalci da gaske yakan sami rai, amma shi da ya duƙufa ga aikata mugunta kan tarar da mutuwarsa.
english: He who is truly righteous gets life. He who pursues evil gets death.

hausa: Mai girbi na samun lada, yana kuma tara amfani zuwa rai madawwami, domin mai shuka da mai girbi su yi farin ciki tare.
english: He who reaps receives wages and gathers fruit to eternal life, that both he who sows and he who reaps may rejoice together.

hausa: sarkin Debir, ɗaya sarkin Bet-Gader, ɗaya
english: the king of Debir, one; the king of Geder, one;

hausa: Tun ina ƙarami na sha wahala na kuma yi kusa in mutu; na sha wahalar razanarka kuma na kuma fid da zuciya.
english: I am afflicted and ready to die from my youth up. While I suffer your terrors, I am distracted.

hausa: Saboda haka na yi kiwon garken da za a yanka, musamman garken da ake zalunta. Sai na ɗauki sanduna biyu na kira ɗaya Tagomashi, ɗaya kuma Haɗinkai, sai na yi kiwon garken.
english: So I fed the flock to be slaughtered, especially the oppressed of the flock. I took for myself two staffs. The one I called “Favor” and the other I called “Union”, and I fed the flock.

hausa: Suna cewa, “Yaya Allah zai sani? Mafi Ɗaukaka yana da sani ne?”
english: They say, “How does God know? Is there knowledge in the Most High?”

hausa: Sa’ad da suka dawo daga wurin kasuwanci, dole su wanke hannu kafin su ci abinci. Sukan kuma kiyaye waɗansu al’adu da yawa, kamar wanken kwafuna, tuluna da butoci.)
english: They don’t eat when they come from the marketplace unless they bathe themselves, and there are many other things which they have received to hold to: washings of cups, pitchers, bronze vessels, and couches.)

hausa: Duk mai farfasa duwatsu shi za su yi wa rauni; duk mai faskaren itace yana cikin hatsarinsu.
english: Whoever carves out stones may be injured by them. Whoever splits wood may be endangered by it.

hausa: Surukarta ta tambaye ta, “Ina kika yi kala a yau? Ina kika yi aiki? Albarka ta tabbata ga mutumin nan ta ya lura da ke!” Sai Rut ta faɗa wa surukarta game da wurin wanda ta yi ta aiki. Ta ce, “Sunan mutumin da na yi aiki da shi a yau Bowaz ne.”
english: Her mother-in-law said to her, “Where have you gleaned today? Where have you worked? Blessed be he who noticed you.” She told her mother-in-law with whom she had worked, “The man’s name with whom I worked today is Boaz.”

hausa: Amma bisa ga umarnin Ubangiji Allahnmu, ba ku yi kusa da wata ƙasar Ammonawa, ko ƙasar da take gefen kwarin kogin Yabbok, ko kuwa wadda take kewaye da birane cikin tuddai ba.
english: Only to the land of the children of Ammon you didn’t come near: all the banks of the river Jabbok, and the cities of the hill country, and wherever Yahweh our God forbade us.

hausa: A rana ta fari ta Bikin Burodi Marar Yisti, sai almajiran suka zo wurin Yesu suka yi tambaya suka ce, “Ina kake so mu je mu shirya maka wurin da za ka ci Bikin Ƙetarewa?”
english: Now on the first day of unleavened bread, the disciples came to Jesus, saying to him, “Where do you want us to prepare for you to eat the Passover?”

hausa: Kada ku auro wa ’ya’yanku maza ’yan matansu, waɗanda suke yi wa alloli sujada, har su sa ’ya’yanku su bi allolinsu.
english: and you take of their daughters to your sons, and their daughters play the prostitute after their gods, and make your sons play the prostitute after their gods.

hausa: Gama Dawuda bai hau zuwa sama ba, duk da haka ya ce, “ ‘Ubangiji ya ce wa Ubangijina, “Zauna a hannun damana,
english: For David didn’t ascend into the heavens, but he says himself, ‘The Lord said to my Lord, “Sit by my right hand

hausa: Sa’an nan mahaifinsa Ishaku ya ce masa, “Zo nan, ɗana ka sumbace ni.”
english: His father Isaac said to him, “Come near now, and kiss me, my son.”

hausa: Ban taɓa zama a gida ba tun daga ranar da na fito da Isra’ilawa daga Masar har yă zuwa yau. Ina dai kai da kawowa a tenti, a matsayin mazaunina.
english: For I have not lived in a house since the day that I brought the children of Israel up out of Egypt, even to this day, but have moved around in a tent and in a tabernacle.

hausa: “ ‘Kowace dabbar da ba ta da rababben kofato ko ba ta tuƙa, haram ce gare ku; duk wanda ya taɓa gawarsu zai ƙazantu.
english: “‘Every animal which has a split hoof that isn’t completely divided, or doesn’t chew the cud, is unclean to you. Everyone who touches them shall be unclean.

hausa: Suka tashi daga Rissa, suka yi sansani a Kehelata.
english: They traveled from Rissah, and encamped in Kehelathah.

hausa: Suka kalubalance shi suka ce, “Ba daidai ba ne, Uzziya, ka ƙone turare ga Ubangiji. Wannan aikin firistoci zuriyar Haruna ne, waɗanda aka tsarkake don ƙone turare. Ka bar wuri mai tsarki, gama ka kasance marar aminci; kuma Ubangiji Allah ba zai girmama ka ba.”
english: They resisted Uzziah the king, and said to him, “It isn’t for you, Uzziah, to burn incense to Yahweh, but for the priests the sons of Aaron, who are consecrated to burn incense. Go out of the sanctuary, for you have trespassed. It will not be for your honor from Yahweh God.”

hausa: Nadab ɗan Yerobowam ya zama sarkin Isra’ila a shekara ta biyu ta Asa sarkin Yahuda, ya kuma yi mulki a bisa Isra’ila shekara biyu.
english: Nadab the son of Jeroboam began to reign over Israel in the second year of Asa king of Judah; and he reigned over Israel two years.

hausa: “Ga shi, ina zuwa da wuri! Ladan da zan bayar yana tare da ni, kuma zan ba wa kowa gwargwadon abin da ya yi.
english: “Behold, I am coming soon! My reward is with me, to repay to each man according to his work.

hausa: Ina fuskantar mutuwa kowace rana. I, kamar yadda yake tabbatacce cewa ina taƙama da ku cikin Kiristi Yesu Ubangijinmu.
english: I affirm, by the boasting in you which I have in Christ Jesus our Lord, I die daily.

hausa: Ku ɗauki wannan da farin ciki mai tsabta, ’yan’uwana, duk sa’ad da gwaje-gwaje na kowane iri suka zo muku,
english: Count it all joy, my brothers, when you fall into various temptations,

hausa: sai ku tuɓe tsohon mutumin nan naku da kuma rayuwarku ta dā, wadda take lalacewa saboda sha’awace-sha’awacen da suke ruɗe ku.
english: that you put away, as concerning your former way of life, the old man that grows corrupt after the lusts of deceit,

hausa: Allah ya yi ayyukan banmamakin da suka wuce misali ta hannu Bulus,
english: God worked special miracles by the hands of Paul,

hausa: A daren nan maganar Allah ta zo wa Natan cewa,
english: That same night, the word of God came to Nathan, saying,

hausa: Amma da ba tă iya ɓoye shi kuma ba, sai ta yi kwandon kyauro ta shafa masa kwalta. Bayan haka sai ta sa jaririn a cikin kwandon, ta je ta ajiye kwandon tare da jaririn a cikin kyauro, a bakin kogin.
english: When she could no longer hide him, she took a papyrus basket for him, and coated it with tar and with pitch. She put the child in it, and laid it in the reeds by the river’s bank.

hausa: Ba ruwanka da wannan hidimar, domin zuciyarka ba daidai take a gaban Allah ba.
english: You have neither part nor lot in this matter, for your heart isn’t right before God.

hausa: Suna ƙwace wa marayu jakunansu suna kuma ƙwace wa gwauruwa sa don suna binta bashi.
english: They drive away the donkey of the fatherless, and they take the widow’s ox for a pledge.

hausa: Ta wurin ƙauna da aminci akan yi kafarar zunubi; ta wurin tsoron Ubangiji mutum kan guji mugunta.
english: By mercy and truth iniquity is atoned for. By the fear of Yahweh men depart from evil.

hausa: Daga baya Yesu ya bayyana a wani kamanni dabam ga biyunsu, yayinda suke tafiya ƙauye.
english: After these things he was revealed in another form to two of them as they walked, on their way into the country.

hausa: Shugabannin Zowan ba kome ba ne, wawaye ke kawai; mashawarta masu hikima na Fir’auna suna ba da shawarwari marasa amfani. Yaya za ka ce wa Fir’auna, “Ni ɗaya ne cikin masu hikima, almajirin sarakuna na dā can”?
english: The princes of Zoan are utterly foolish. The counsel of the wisest counselors of Pharaoh has become stupid. How do you say to Pharaoh, “I am the son of the wise, the son of ancient kings”?

hausa: Sai Irmiya ya ce wa dukan fadawa da kuma dukan mutane, “Ubangiji ya aiko ni in yi annabci gāba da wannan gida da wannan birni dukan abin da na faɗa.
english: Then Jeremiah spoke to all the princes and to all the people, saying, “Yahweh sent me to prophesy against this house and against this city all the words that you have heard.

hausa: dukansu suna saye da takobi dukansu ƙwararru ne a yaƙi, kowanne da takobinsa a rataye a gefensa, a shirye don abubuwan bantsoro na dare.
english: They all handle the sword, and are expert in war. Every man has his sword on his thigh, because of fear in the night.

hausa: Amma ya zama mana dole, mu yi shagali, mu yi murna, domin ɗan’uwan nan naka, da ya mutu, yanzu kuwa yana da rai, da ya ɓata, amma yanzu an same shi.’ ”
english: But it was appropriate to celebrate and be glad, for this, your brother, was dead, and is alive again. He was lost, and is found.’”

hausa: “ ‘Sa’ad da kuka shirya rago don hadaya ta ƙonawa saboda alkawari na musamman, ko hadaya ta salama ga Ubangiji,
english: When you prepare a bull for a burnt offering or for a sacrifice, to accomplish a vow, or for peace offerings to Yahweh,

hausa: Ga lissafin ma’aikatan gandun da Sarki Solomon ya ɗauka don ginin haikalin Ubangiji, da fadarsa, da madogaran gini, da katangar Urushalima, da kuma Hazor Megiddo da Gezer.
english: This is the reason of the forced labor which King Solomon conscripted: to build Yahweh’s house, his own house, Millo, Jerusalem’s wall, Hazor, Megiddo, and Gezer.

hausa: Gama da irin shari’ar da kuka yi wa waɗansu, da ita za a shari’anta ku. Mudun da kuka yi awo da shi, da shi za a yi muku.
english: For with whatever judgment you judge, you will be judged; and with whatever measure you measure, it will be measured to you.

hausa: Duk waɗanda suka riga ni zuwa ɓarayi ne, ’yan fashi kuma, amma tumakin ba su saurare su ba.
english: All who came before me are thieves and robbers, but the sheep didn’t listen to them.

hausa: Sun kuwa ji daɗin yin haka, gama ya zama kamar bashi ne a gare su. Da yake Al’ummai sun sami rabo cikin albarkun ruhaniyar Yahudawa, ya zama musu kamar bashi su ma su taimaki Yahudawa da albarkunsu na kayan duniya.
english: Yes, it has been their good pleasure, and they are their debtors. For if the Gentiles have been made partakers of their spiritual things, they owe it to them also to serve them in material things.

hausa: “Ina gab da bin hanyar da kowa a duniya zai bi. Saboda haka ka yi ƙarfin hali, ka nuna kanka namiji,
english: “I am going the way of all the earth. You be strong therefore, and show yourself a man;

hausa: Sai Na’omi ta ce wa surukarta, “Ubangiji yă yi masa albarka! Bai daina nuna alheri ga masu rai da matattu ba.” Ta ƙara da cewa, “Wannan mutum danginmu ne na kusa; shi ɗaya daga cikin danginmu mai fansa.”
english: Naomi said to her daughter-in-law, “May he be blessed by Yahweh, who has not abandoned his kindness to the living and to the dead.” Naomi said to her, “The man is a close relative to us, one of our near kinsmen.”

hausa: Da a ce ita katanga ce, da sai mu gina hasumiyar azurfa a kanta. Da a ce ita ƙofa ce, da sai mun yi mata ƙyauren itacen al’ul.
english: If she is a wall, we will build on her a turret of silver. If she is a door, we will enclose her with boards of cedar.

hausa: Gama mamaki ya kama shi da abokansa duka, saboda yawan kifin da suka kama.
english: For he was amazed, and all who were with him, at the catch of fish which they had caught;

hausa: Domin kana fushi da ni reninka ya iso kunnuwata, zan sa ƙugiyata a hancinka da linzamina a bakinka, zan kuma sa ka koma a ta hanyar da ka zo.’
english: Because of your raging against me, and because your arrogance has come up into my ears, therefore I will put my hook in your nose, and my bridle in your lips, and I will turn you back by the way by which you came.’

hausa: Ba don kun fi sauran al’ummai yawa ne ya sa Ubangiji ya ƙaunace ku, ya kuma zaɓe ku ba, gama ku ne mafi ƙanƙanta cikin dukan al’ummai.
english: Yahweh didn’t set his love on you nor choose you, because you were more in number than any people; for you were the fewest of all peoples;

hausa: Ba kai ka zuba ni kamar madara ba, na daskare kamar cuku.
english: Haven’t you poured me out like milk, and curdled me like cheese?

hausa: Dawuda ya ce masa, “Za ka iya kai ni wurin maharan nan?” Ya ce, “Idan ka rantse mini da Allah, ba za ka kashe ni ba, ba kuwa za ka mai da ni wurin ubangidana ba, sai in kai ka inda maharan suke.”
english: David said to him, “Will you bring me down to this troop?” He said, “Swear to me by God that you will not kill me and not deliver me up into the hands of my master, and I will bring you down to this troop.”

hausa: Ubangiji yana nesa da mugaye amma yakan ji addu’ar adalai.
english: Yahweh is far from the wicked, but he hears the prayer of the righteous.

hausa: Gama inda akwai kishi da sonkai, a can za a tarar da hargitsi da kowane irin mugun aiki.
english: For where jealousy and selfish ambition are, there is confusion and every evil deed.

hausa: Gama, “Duk wanda yake so yă ji daɗin rayuwa, yă kuma ga kwanaki masu kyau dole yă ƙame harshensa daga mugunta leɓunansa kuma daga maganar yaudara.
english: For, “He who would love life and see good days, let him keep his tongue from evil and his lips from speaking deceit.

hausa: Saboda haka mutane suka aika Yerobowam yă zo, sai shi da dukan taron Isra’ila suka tafi wurin Rehobowam, suka ce masa,
english: and they sent and called him), Jeroboam and all the assembly of Israel came, and spoke to Rehoboam, saying,

hausa: A keɓewar katangar Urushalima, an nemi Lawiyawa daga inda suke zama aka kawo su Urushalima don su yi bikin miƙawa da farin ciki da waƙoƙin godiya da kuma kiɗin kuge, garaya da molo.
english: At the dedication of the wall of Jerusalem, they sought the Levites out of all their places, to bring them to Jerusalem to keep the dedication with gladness, both with giving thanks and with singing, with cymbals, stringed instruments, and with harps.

hausa: Ai, ba mai yabon kansa ake amincewa da shi ba, sai dai wanda Ubangiji ya yaba wa.
english: For it isn’t he who commends himself who is approved, but whom the Lord commends.

hausa: Yesu ya zura musu ido ya ce, “To, mene ne ma’anar abin da aka rubuta cewa, “ ‘Dutsen da magina suka ƙi, shi ne kuwa ya zama dutsen kan ginin’
english: But he looked at them and said, “Then what is this that is written, ‘The stone which the builders rejected was made the chief cornerstone’?

hausa: Bakina zai yi maganar hikima; magana daga zuciyata za tă ba da ganewa.
english: My mouth will speak words of wisdom. My heart will utter understanding.

hausa: Nan da nan ya ɗibi waɗansu hafsoshi da sojoji suka gangara a guje wurin taron. Da masu hargitsin suka ga shugaban ƙungiyar sojan da sojojinsa, sai suka daina dūkan Bulus.
english: Immediately he took soldiers and centurions and ran down to them. They, when they saw the chief captain and the soldiers, stopped beating Paul.

hausa: Shemuyel ɗan Ammihud, daga kabilar Simeyon
english: Of the tribe of the children of Simeon, Shemuel the son of Ammihud.

hausa: In na faɗa wa adali cewa tabbatacce zai rayu, amma sai ya dogara ga adalcinsa ya kuma aikata mugunta, babu ayyukan adalcinsa da za a tuna; zai mutu saboda muguntar da ya aikata.
english: When I tell the righteous that he will surely live, if he trusts in his righteousness and commits iniquity, none of his righteous deeds will be remembered; but he will die in his iniquity that he has committed.

hausa: ’Ya’yansu, waɗanda ba su san wannan doka ba, dole su ji ta, su kuma koyi tsoron Ubangiji Allahnku muddin ranku a ƙasar da kuke haye Urdun ku ci gādonta.”
english: and that their children, who have not known, may hear and learn to fear Yahweh your God, as long as you live in the land where you go over the Jordan to possess it.”

hausa: Sai ya ce musu, “Al’umma za tă tasar wa al’umma, mulki zai tasar wa mulki.
english: Then he said to them, “Nation will rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom.

hausa: Amma sa’ad da kake addu’a, sai ka shiga ɗakinka, ka rufe ƙofa, ka yi addu’a ga Ubanka wanda ba a gani. Ubanka kuwa mai ganin abin da ake yi a ɓoye, zai sāka maka.
english: But you, when you pray, enter into your inner room, and having shut your door, pray to your Father who is in secret; and your Father who sees in secret will reward you openly.

hausa: Na yi tunaninsu a zuciyata sa’an nan na zargi manyan gari da shugabanni. Na ce musu, “Kuna musguna wa ’yan’uwanku ta wurin ba su rance da ruwa!” Saboda haka na kira babban taro gaba ɗaya don a magance wannan.
english: Then I consulted with myself, and contended with the nobles and the rulers, and said to them, “You exact usury, everyone of his brother.” I held a great assembly against them.

hausa: Amma muna so mu ji ra’ayinka, gama mun san cewa mutane ko’ina suna muguwar magana a kan wannan ɗarikar.”
english: But we desire to hear from you what you think. For, as concerning this sect, it is known to us that everywhere it is spoken against.”

hausa: A shekara ta talatin da takwas ta mulkin Azariya sarkin Yahuda, Zakariya ɗan Yerobowam ya zama sarkin Isra’ila a Samariya, ya kuma yi mulki wata shida.
english: In the thirty-eighth year of Azariah king of Judah, Zechariah the son of Jeroboam reigned over Israel in Samaria six months.

hausa: Ba za a toya shi da yisti ba; na ba su yă zama rabonsu daga cikin hadayun da ake ƙonawa da wuta, abu ne mafi tsarki, kamar hadaya don zunubi da laifi.
english: It shall not be baked with yeast. I have given it as their portion of my offerings made by fire. It is most holy, as are the sin offering and the trespass offering.

hausa: Bezer, Hod, Shamma, Shilsha, Itran da Bera.
english: Bezer, Hod, Shamma, Shilshah, Ithran, and Beera.

hausa: “Da na kuma kakkarya burodin nan bakwai wa mutum dubu huɗu, kwanduna nawa kuka kwashe cike da gutsattsarin?” Suka ce, “Bakwai.”
english: “When the seven loaves fed the four thousand, how many baskets full of broken pieces did you take up?” They told him, “Seven.”

hausa: Ban da haka ma, zan ba ka abin da ba ka nema ba; arziki da girma, don a rayuwarka ba za ka kasance da wani kamar ka ba a cikin sarakuna.
english: I have also given you that which you have not asked, both riches and honor, so that there will not be any among the kings like you for all your days.

hausa: Duk inda kuke zama, garuruwa za su zama kango, za a kuma ragargaza masujadai, saboda bagadanku su rurrushe su zama kango, a kuma farfasa gumakanku su lalace, za a rurrushe bagadan ƙone turarenku, a kuma shafe dukan abin da kuka yi.
english: In all your dwelling places, the cities will be laid waste and the high places will be desolate, so that your altars may be laid waste and made desolate, and your idols may be broken and cease, and your incense altars may be cut down, and your works may be abolished.

hausa: saboda Allah na mahaifinka, wanda ya taimake ka, saboda Maɗaukaki, wanda yake albarkace ka da albarkar sama da take bisa albarkun zurfafa da suke ƙarƙashin ƙasa albarkun mama da kuma mahaifa.
english: even by the God of your father, who will help you, by the Almighty, who will bless you, with blessings of heaven above, blessings of the deep that lies below, blessings of the breasts, and of the womb.

hausa: Hezekiya ya dogara ga Ubangiji, Allah na Isra’ila. Ba a yi wani kamar sa ba cikin dukan sarakunan Yahuda; ko kafin shi, ko kuma bayansa.
english: He trusted in Yahweh, the God of Israel, so that after him was no one like him among all the kings of Judah, nor among them that were before him.

hausa: Dukiyar masu arziki ita ce birninsu mai katanga; suna gani cewa ba za a iya huda katangar ba.
english: The rich man’s wealth is his strong city, like an unscalable wall in his own imagination.

hausa: Ka ba su, ya Ubangiji Me za ka ba su? Ka ba su mahaifar da za su yi ɓarin ciki da busassun nono.
english: Give them—Yahweh what will you give? Give them a miscarrying womb and dry breasts.

hausa: Gama abin da dā take da ɗaukaka, ba ta da ɗaukaka a yanzu, in aka kwatantata da mafificiyar ɗaukaka ta yanzu.
english: For most certainly that which has been made glorious has not been made glorious in this respect, by reason of the glory that surpasses.

hausa: Ga wasiƙar da Tattenai, gwamnan Kewayen Kogin Yuferites, da Shetar-Bozenai da abokansu masu riƙe da muƙamai a Kewayen Kogin Yuferites suka aika wa Sarki Dariyus.
english: The copy of the letter that Tattenai, the governor beyond the River, and Shetharbozenai, and his companions the Apharsachites who were beyond the River, sent to Darius the king follows.

hausa: Iliya ya amsa, ya ce, “I, je ka faɗa wa maigidanka cewa, ‘Iliya yana a nan.’ ”
english: He answered him, “It is I. Go, tell your lord, ‘Behold, Elijah is here!’”

hausa: Gama Ubangiji Maɗaukaki, Allah na Isra’ila da Yahuda bai yashe su ba, ko da yake ƙasarsu cike da take da laifi a gaban Mai Tsarki na Isra’ila.
english: For Israel is not forsaken, nor Judah, by his God, by Yahweh of Armies; though their land is full of guilt against the Holy One of Israel.

hausa: Ya sa raƙuman suka durƙusa kusa da rijiya a bayan gari; wajen yamma ne, lokacin da mata sukan fita ɗiban ruwa.
english: He made the camels kneel down outside the city by the well of water at the time of evening, the time that women go out to draw water.

hausa: shirwa, da duk wani irin baƙin shirwa,
english: the red kite, any kind of black kite,

hausa: Isra’ilawa suka ce wa Gideyon, “Ka yi mulkinmu, kai, ɗanka da jikanka, domin ka cece mu daga hannun Midiyawa.”
english: Then the men of Israel said to Gideon, “Rule over us, both you, your son, and your son’s son also; for you have saved us out of the hand of Midian.”

hausa: Domin Ubangiji ya bayyana mini maƙarƙashiyarsu, na santa, gama a wannan lokaci ya nuna mini abin da suke yi.
english: Yahweh gave me knowledge of it, and I knew it. Then you showed me their doings.

hausa: Zai mutu saboda rashin ɗa’a yawan wawancinsa zai sa yă kauce.
english: He will die for lack of instruction. In the greatness of his folly, he will go astray.

hausa: Ba shakka sai in ɗora a kafaɗata, zan aza a kaina kamar rawani.
english: Surely I would carry it on my shoulder, and I would bind it to me as a crown.

hausa: Tare da bijiman, ragunan da ’yan raguna, a miƙa hadayun gari da hadayun sha, bisa ga adadin da aka ƙayyade.
english: and their meal offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, according to their number, after the ordinance;

hausa: sai ya ce musu, “Ku ɗauki bayin sarki tare da ku, ku kuma sa ɗana Solomon a kan dokina, ku gangara da shi zuwa Gihon.
english: The king said to them, “Take with you the servants of your lord, and cause Solomon my son to ride on my own mule, and bring him down to Gihon.

hausa: “ ‘Kowane sirdi da mai ɗigar ya zauna a kai zai ƙazantu,
english: “‘Whatever saddle he who has the discharge rides on shall be unclean.

hausa: Wane ne maƙaryaci? Ai, shi ne mutumin da yake mūsun cewa Yesu shi ne Kiristi. Irin wannan mutum shi ne magabcin Kiristi, ya yi mūsun Uban da kuma Ɗan.
english: Who is the liar but he who denies that Jesus is the Christ? This is the Antichrist, he who denies the Father and the Son.

hausa: “Ko da yake an lalatar da ke aka kuma mai da ke kufai ƙasarki kuma ta zama kango, yanzu za ki kāsa sosai saboda yawan mutanenki, kuma waɗanda suka cinye ki za su kasance can da nisa.
english: “For, as for your waste and your desolate places, and your land that has been destroyed, surely now that land will be too small for the inhabitants, and those who swallowed you up will be far away.

hausa: A kwanakin nan Isra’ila ba su da sarki. To, wani Balawe wanda yake zama a wani lungu na ƙasar tudu ta Efraim ya ɗauko wa kansa ƙwarƙwara daga Betlehem cikin Yahuda.
english: In those days, when there was no king in Israel, there was a certain Levite living on the farther side of the hill country of Ephraim, who took for himself a concubine out of Bethlehem Judah.

hausa: Ya ce da babbar murya, “Ku ji tsoron Allah ku kuma ɗaukaka shi, domin sa’ar hukuncinsa ya yi. Ku yi wa wannan da ya halicci sammai, ƙasa, teku, da maɓulɓulan ruwa sujada.”
english: He said with a loud voice, “Fear the Lord, and give him glory, for the hour of his judgment has come. Worship him who made the heaven, the earth, the sea, and the springs of waters!”

hausa: Gama kamar yadda Uban yana da rai a cikinsa, haka ya sa Ɗan yă kasance da rai a cikin kansa.
english: For as the Father has life in himself, even so he gave to the Son also to have life in himself.

hausa: wanda ya sami tagomashi daga Allah, ya kuma nemi yă yi wa Allah na Yaƙub wurin zama.
english: who found favor in the sight of God, and asked to find a habitation for the God of Jacob.

hausa: Gama akwai ’yan tawaye da yawa, masu surutun banza da masu ruɗi, musamman ƙungiyar masu kaciya.
english: For there are also many unruly men, vain talkers and deceivers, especially those of the circumcision,

hausa: In Shaiɗan yana gāba da kansa, yaya mulkinsa zai tsaya? Ina faɗin haka domin kun ce, da ikon Be’elzebub nake fitar da aljanu.
english: If Satan also is divided against himself, how will his kingdom stand? For you say that I cast out demons by Beelzebul.

hausa: Da a ce yana a duniya ne, da bai zama firist ba, domin a nan akwai mutanen da doka ta naɗa don su miƙa baye-baye.
english: For if he were on earth, he would not be a priest at all, seeing there are priests who offer the gifts according to the law,

hausa: Gama abin yabo ne in mutum ya yi haƙuri cikin zafin wahalar rashin adalci saboda yana sane da Allah.
english: For it is commendable if someone endures pain, suffering unjustly, because of conscience toward God.

hausa: daga Hezron, kabilar Hezronawa; daga Karmi, kabilar Karmiyawa.
english: of Hezron, the family of the Hezronites; of Carmi, the family of the Carmites.

hausa: Duk wannan ya faru ne saboda Isra’ilawa sun yi wa Ubangiji Allahnsu zunubi, shi wanda ya fitar da su daga Masar daga ƙarƙashin ikon Fir’auna sarkin Masar. Sun yi wa waɗansu alloli sujada
english: It was so because the children of Israel had sinned against Yahweh their God, who brought them up out of the land of Egypt from under the hand of Pharaoh king of Egypt, and had feared other gods,

hausa: Raguwa za tă komo, raguwar Yaƙub za su komo ga Maɗaukaki Allah.
english: A remnant will return, even the remnant of Jacob, to the mighty God.

hausa: Maƙwabta sukan gudu daga matalauta, amma masu arziki suna da abokai da yawa.
english: The poor person is shunned even by his own neighbor, but the rich person has many friends.

hausa: Madogaran sama sun girgiza, saboda tsawatawarsa.
english: The pillars of heaven tremble and are astonished at his rebuke.

hausa: Gama Ubangiji yana lura da yadda adalai suke yin abubuwa, amma ayyukan mugaye za su kai su ga hallaka.
english: For Yahweh knows the way of the righteous, but the way of the wicked shall perish.

hausa: Ta ce, “Ina da ɗan roƙon da zan nema ka yi mini. Ina fata ba za ka hana ni ba.” Sai sarki ya amsa ya ce, “Mahaifiyata, sai ki faɗa in ji, ba zan hana miki ba.”
english: Then she said, “I ask one small petition of you; don’t deny me.” The king said to her, “Ask on, my mother, for I will not deny you.”

hausa: Amma mala’ikan Ubangiji ya ce wa Iliya mutumin Tishbe, “Ka haura ka taryi masinjojin sarkin Samariya, ka tambaye su, ‘Don babu Allah ne a Isra’ila da za ku tafi ku tuntuɓi Ba’al-Zebub allahn Ekron?’
english: But Yahweh’s angel said to Elijah the Tishbite, “Arise, go up to meet the messengers of the king of Samaria, and tell them, ‘Is it because there is no God in Israel that you go to inquire of Baal Zebub, the god of Ekron?

hausa: Ko da yake na warwatsa su cikin mutane, duk da haka a can ƙasashe masu nisa za su tuna da ni. Su da ’ya’yansu za su rayu, za su kuwa komo.
english: I will sow them among the peoples. They will remember me in far countries. They will live with their children and will return.

hausa: Za ka zama mai shaidarsa ga dukan mutane game da abin da ka gani ka kuma ji.
english: For you will be a witness for him to all men of what you have seen and heard.

hausa: Kun yi tsere mai kyau a dā. Wa ya shige gabanku ya hana ku bin gaskiya?
english: You were running well! Who interfered with you that you should not obey the truth?

hausa: Gama a duk sa’ad da kuke cin wannan burodi, kuke kuma sha daga wannan kwaf, kuna shelar mutuwar Ubangiji ne har yă dawo.
english: For as often as you eat this bread and drink this cup, you proclaim the Lord’s death until he comes.

hausa: Yanzu, ina ce wa sauranku da kuke a Tiyatira, ku da ba ku riƙe da koyarwarta ba kuma ba ku koyi abin da suke kira zurfafan asiran Shaiɗan, ‘Ba zan ƙara muku wani nauyi ba.
english: But to you I say, to the rest who are in Thyatira—as many as don’t have this teaching, who don’t know what some call ‘the deep things of Satan’—to you I say, I am not putting any other burden on you.

hausa: Iyakar ta gangara zuwa gefen dutsen da yake fuskantar Kwarin Ben Hinnom, wanda yake arewa da Kwarin Refayim. Ta ci gaba ta gangara ta Kwarin Hinnom ta yi kudu kusa da birnin Yebusiyawa har zuwa En Rogel.
english: The border went down to the farthest part of the mountain that lies before the valley of the son of Hinnom, which is in the valley of Rephaim northward. It went down to the valley of Hinnom, to the side of the Jebusite southward, and went down to En Rogel.

hausa: “Ka ba su mulkoki da al’ummai, kana ba su har ma da ƙasashen da suke jeji. Suka ci ƙasar Sihon na sarkin Heshbon da ƙasar Og inda sarkin Bashan yake mulki.
english: Moreover you gave them kingdoms and peoples, which you allotted according to their portions. So they possessed the land of Sihon, even the land of the king of Heshbon, and the land of Og king of Bashan.

hausa: Gwanayen Solomon da na Hiram da kuma mutanen Gebal, su suka yanka, suka kuma shirya katako da dutse don ginin haikali.
english: Solomon’s builders and Hiram’s builders and the Gebalites cut them, and prepared the timber and the stones to build the house.

hausa: Sai Ubangiji ya ce wa Yoshuwa,
english: Yahweh spoke to Joshua, saying,

hausa: Shi kansa ya sha gabansu, ya rusuna har ƙasa sau bakwai, kafin ya kai kusa da inda ɗan’uwansa Isuwa yake.
english: He himself passed over in front of them, and bowed himself to the ground seven times, until he came near to his brother.

hausa: Sun nutse da zurfi cikin lalaci, kamar a kwanakin Gibeya. Allah zai tuna da muguntarsu yă kuma hukunta su saboda zunubansu.
english: They have deeply corrupted themselves, as in the days of Gibeah. He will remember their iniquity. He will punish them for their sins.

hausa: Za su rufe fuskar ƙasar, har da ba za a iya ganin ƙasa ba. Za su cinye ɗan sauran abin da ya rage muku daga ɓarnar ƙanƙara, za su cinye dukan itatuwan da suke girma a gonakinku.
english: and they shall cover the surface of the earth, so that one won’t be able to see the earth. They shall eat the residue of that which has escaped, which remains to you from the hail, and shall eat every tree which grows for you out of the field.

hausa: Sa’ad da halittun suke tafiya, sai na ji ƙarar fikafikansu, kamar rurin ruwaye masu gudu, kamar muryar Maɗaukaki, kamar hayaniyar rundunar mayaƙa. In sun tsaya cik, sukan sauko da fikafikansu.
english: When they went, I heard the noise of their wings like the noise of great waters, like the voice of the Almighty, a noise of tumult like the noise of an army. When they stood, they let down their wings.

hausa: Na bishe su da linzamin alheri da tausayi, da ragamar ƙauna; Na cire karkiya daga wuyansu na kuma rusuna na ciyar da su.
english: I drew them with cords of a man, with ties of love; and I was to them like those who lift up the yoke on their necks; and I bent down to him and I fed him.

hausa: Tun fil azal babu wanda ya taɓa ji, babu kunnen da ya gane, babu idon da ya ga wani Allah in ban da kai, wanda ya aikata waɗannan al’amura a madadin waɗanda suke sa zuciya a gare shi.
english: For from of old men have not heard, nor perceived by the ear, nor has the eye seen a God besides you, who works for him who waits for him.

hausa: Amma Baruk ɗan Neriya yana zuga ka a kanmu don ka ba da mu ga Babiloniyawa, don su kashe mu ko su kai mu zaman bauta a Babilon.”
english: but Baruch the son of Neriah has turned you against us, to deliver us into the hand of the Chaldeans, that they may put us to death or carry us away captive to Babylon.”

hausa: Sai dukan mazan da suka san cewa matansu suna ƙone turare wa waɗansu alloli, tare da dukan matan da suke a nan babban taro, da kuma dukan mutanen da suke zama a Masar ta Ƙasa da ta Bisa, suka ce wa Irmiya,
english: Then all the men who knew that their wives burned incense to other gods, and all the women who stood by, a great assembly, even all the people who lived in the land of Egypt, in Pathros, answered Jeremiah, saying,

hausa: dā shi ɗaya ne cikinmu, ya kuma yi hidima a cikin aikin nan.”
english: For he was counted with us, and received his portion in this ministry.

hausa: Ku zo, mu yi dabara a kansu, in ba haka ba za su ƙaru fiye da haka, in kuwa yaƙi ya tashi tsakaninmu da abokan gāba, za su iya haɗa kai da abokan gāba, su yaƙe mu, su bar ƙasar.”
english: Come, let’s deal wisely with them, lest they multiply, and it happen that when any war breaks out, they also join themselves to our enemies and fight against us, and escape out of the land.”

hausa: A Horeb, kun tayar wa Ubangiji har ya yi fushin da ya isa yă hallaka ku.
english: Also in Horeb you provoked Yahweh to wrath, and Yahweh was angry with you to destroy you.

hausa: Saboda haka ku saurari maganar Ubangiji, ku masu ba’a ku da kuke mulkin wannan mutane a Urushalima.
english: Therefore hear Yahweh’s word, you scoffers, that rule this people in Jerusalem:

hausa: Sai muka yi kuka ga Ubangiji Allahn kakanninmu, Ubangiji kuwa ya ji kukanmu, ya kuma azabar da muke sha, da wahalar da muke sha, da danniyar da suke yin mana.
english: Then we cried to Yahweh, the God of our fathers. Yahweh heard our voice, and saw our affliction, our toil, and our oppression.

hausa: Ko da yake Ubangiji ya aika dukan bayinsa annabawa gare ku sau da sau, ba ku saurara ba, ba ku kuma kula ba.
english: Yahweh has sent to you all his servants the prophets, rising up early and sending them (but you have not listened or inclined your ear to hear),

hausa: A shekara ta tara, a wata na goma, a rana ta goma, maganar Ubangiji ta zo mini cewa,
english: Again, in the ninth year, in the tenth month, in the tenth day of the month, Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

hausa: Ya dalaye shi da zinariya zalla, ciki da waje, ya kuma yi zubin zinariya kewaye da shi.
english: He overlaid it with pure gold inside and outside, and made a molding of gold for it around it.

hausa: Waɗannan su ne shugabannin iyalai, da kuma waɗanda suka dawo tare da ni daga Babilon a zamanin mulkin Sarki Artazerzes.
english: Now these are the heads of their fathers’ households, and this is the genealogy of those who went up with me from Babylon, in the reign of Artaxerxes the king:

hausa: Saboda haka yanzu sai ku ɗauki bijimai guda bakwai, da raguna bakwai, ku je wurin bawana Ayuba ku miƙa hadaya ta ƙonawa domin kanku. Bawana Ayuba zai yi muku addu’a zan kuwa karɓi addu’arsa in bi da ku nisa da wawancinku. Ba ku faɗi abin da yake daidai game da ni ba yadda bawana Ayuba ya yi ba.”
english: Now therefore, take to yourselves seven bulls and seven rams, and go to my servant Job, and offer up for yourselves a burnt offering; and my servant Job shall pray for you, for I will accept him, that I not deal with you according to your folly. For you have not spoken of me the thing that is right, as my servant Job has.”

hausa: Diyar Taya za tă zo da kyauta, mawadata za su nemi tagomashinki.
english: The daughter of Tyre comes with a gift. The rich among the people entreat your favor.

hausa: Ka lura da matakanka sa’ad da ka tafi gidan Allah. Ka je kusa don ka saurara a maimakon miƙa hadaya kamar wawaye, waɗanda ba su san sun yi laifi ba.
english: Guard your steps when you go to God’s house; for to draw near to listen is better than to give the sacrifice of fools, for they don’t know that they do evil.

hausa: “Amma kuringar ta ce, ‘In bar ruwan inabina, wanda yake faranta zuciyar alloli da mutane, in zo in yi fama da itatuwa?’
english: “The vine said to them, ‘Should I leave my new wine, which cheers God and man, and go to wave back and forth over the trees?’

hausa: ’Ya’yan Karmi maza su ne, Akar wanda ya kawo masifa wa Isra’ila ta wurin yin abin da aka haramta.
english: The son of Carmi: Achar, the troubler of Israel, who committed a trespass in the devoted thing.

hausa: Zan mai da gidanka kamar gida Yerobowam ɗan Nebat, da na Ba’asha ɗan Ahiya, domin ka tsokane ni har na yi fushi, ka kuma sa Isra’ila ya yi zunubi.’
english: I will make your house like the house of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, and like the house of Baasha the son of Ahijah, for the provocation with which you have provoked me to anger, and have made Israel to sin.”

hausa: Mala’ikan Ubangiji ya sami Hagar kusa da maɓulɓula a jeji, ita ce maɓulɓular da take gefen hanya zuwa Shur.
english: Yahweh’s angel found her by a fountain of water in the wilderness, by the fountain on the way to Shur.

hausa: Sauran Isra’ilawa za su zauna ƙungiya-ƙungiya, kowane mutum a ƙungiyarsa daidai bisa ga ƙa’idarsa.
english: The children of Israel shall pitch their tents, every man by his own camp, and every man by his own standard, according to their divisions.

hausa: Suka yi katakan tabanakul da itacen ƙirya.
english: He made the boards for the tabernacle of acacia wood, standing up.

hausa: Suka shimfiɗa duwatsun onis, suka jera su cikin tsaiko na zinariya, suka kuma zāna sunayen ’ya’yan Isra’ila a kan duwatsun kamar yadda akan yi hatimi.
english: They worked the onyx stones, enclosed in settings of gold, engraved with the engravings of a signet, according to the names of the children of Israel.

hausa: Duba, ina yi abu sabo! Yanzu yana faruwa; ba ku gan shi ba? Ina yin hanya a cikin hamada rafuffuka kuma a cikin ƙeƙasasshiyar ƙasa.
english: Behold, I will do a new thing. It springs out now. Don’t you know it? I will even make a way in the wilderness, and rivers in the desert.

hausa: Tabbatacce wannan kuwa saboda ribata ne cewa in sha irin wahalan nan. Cikin ƙaunarka ka kiyaye ni daga ramin hallaka; ka sa dukan zunubaina a bayanka.
english: Behold, for peace I had great anguish, but you have in love for my soul delivered it from the pit of corruption; for you have cast all my sins behind your back.

hausa: Amma da suka hura wuta a tsakiyar harabar gidan, kowa ya zauna, sai Bitrus ya zo ya zauna tare da su.
english: When they had kindled a fire in the middle of the courtyard and had sat down together, Peter sat among them.

hausa: masu amfani da kayan duniya kuwa, kada su duƙufa a cikinsu. Gama duniyan nan a yadda take mai shuɗewa ce.
english: and those who use the world, as not using it to the fullest. For the mode of this world passes away.

hausa: Firistocin da suke kawunan iyalai, sun kai 1,760. Dukansu ƙwararru ne, masu hakkin hidima a cikin gidan Allah.
english: and their brothers, heads of their fathers’ houses, one thousand seven hundred sixty; they were very able men for the work of the service of God’s house.

hausa: Saboda haka Shawulu ya zaɓi mutum dubu uku daga cikin dukan Isra’ila, suka fita neman Dawuda da mutanensa kusa da Duwatsun Awakin Jeji.
english: Then Saul took three thousand chosen men out of all Israel, and went to seek David and his men on the rocks of the wild goats.

hausa: Bilatus ya ce, “Don me? Wane laifi ya yi?” Amma suka ƙara tā da ihu, suna cewa, “A gicciye shi!”
english: But the governor said, “Why? What evil has he done?” But they cried out exceedingly, saying, “Let him be crucified!”

hausa: Zan ci gaba da ƙaunarsa har abada, alkawarina da shi ba zai taɓa fasa ba.
english: I will keep my loving kindness for him forever more. My covenant will stand firm with him.

hausa: Zai wanke kayan cikin da kuma ƙafafun da ruwa, firist ɗin kuwa zai ƙone dukan waɗannan a kan bagade. Hadaya ce ta ƙonawa, hadaya ce kuma wadda aka yi da wuta, mai daɗin ƙanshi ga Ubangiji.
english: but he shall wash its innards and its legs with water. The priest shall burn all of it on the altar, for a burnt offering, an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to Yahweh.

hausa: Amma dole ku koma ga Allahnku; ku ci gaba da ƙauna da yin gaskiya, ku kuma saurari Allahnku kullum.
english: Therefore turn to your God. Keep kindness and justice, and wait continually for your God.

hausa: Wani maƙerin azurfa, mai suna Demetiriyus wanda yake ƙera siffar ɗakunan tsafin Artemis da azurfa, ba ƙaramin ciniki yake kawo wa mutane masu sana’an nan ba.
english: For a certain man named Demetrius, a silversmith who made silver shrines of Artemis, brought no little business to the craftsmen,

hausa: Ku tattara kayayyakinku don ku bar ƙasar, ku da kuke zaune a wurin da aka kewaye da yaƙi.
english: Gather up your wares out of the land, you who live under siege.

hausa: Kun sayar da mutanen Yahuda da na Urushalima ga mutanen Hellenawa, don ku aika da su nesa da ƙasarsu.
english: and have sold the children of Judah and the children of Jerusalem to the sons of the Greeks, that you may remove them far from their border.

hausa: Kai ne Allahn da yakan aikata mu’ujizai; ka nuna ikonka a cikin mutane.
english: You are the God who does wonders. You have made your strength known among the peoples.

hausa: Da Shawulu ya tambayi Dawuda, sai Dawuda ya ce masa, “Kada kowa yă damu saboda wannan Bafilistin. Bawanka zai je yă yi faɗa da shi.”
english: David said to Saul, “Let no man’s heart fail because of him. Your servant will go and fight with this Philistine.”

hausa: Yaƙub kuma ya lura cewa halin Laban gare shi ya canja ba kamar yadda yake a dā ba.
english: Jacob saw the expression on Laban’s face, and, behold, it was not toward him as before.

hausa: Ya kuma ba shi iko yă hukunta domin shi Ɗan Mutum ne.
english: He also gave him authority to execute judgment, because he is a son of man.

hausa: Ya aikata abin da yake daidai a gaban Ubangiji, yadda mahaifinsa Amaziya ya yi.
english: He did that which was right in Yahweh’s eyes, according to all that his father Amaziah had done.

hausa: Shi da dukan iyalinsa masu ibada ne masu tsoron Allah kuma; yakan ba da kyauta hannu sake ga masu bukata yana kuma addu’a ga Allah ba fasawa.
english: a devout man, and one who feared God with all his house, who gave gifts for the needy generously to the people, and always prayed to God.

hausa: A lokacin nan, Sarki Zerzes ya yi mulki daga gadon sarauta, cikin mazaunin masarautar Shusha.
english: in those days, when the King Ahasuerus sat on the throne of his kingdom, which was in Susa the palace,

hausa: Na ce, “Ba zan ƙara ganin Ubangiji ba, Ubangiji a ƙasa ta masu rai; ba zan ƙara ga wani mutum, ko in kasance tare da waɗanda suke zama a wannan duniya ba.
english: I said, “I won’t see Yah, Yah in the land of the living. I will see man no more with the inhabitants of the world.

hausa: Dukan mutanen da suke cikin majami’a suka fusata ƙwarai da jin wannan.
english: They were all filled with wrath in the synagogue as they heard these things.

hausa: Ya faɗa haka ne don yă nuna irin mutuwar da zai yi.
english: But he said this, signifying by what kind of death he should die.

hausa: Azariya ɗan Hilkiya, ɗan Meshullam, ɗan Zadok, ɗan Merahiyot, ɗan Ahitub, shugaban da yake lura da gidan Allah;
english: and Azariah the son of Hilkiah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Zadok, the son of Meraioth, the son of Ahitub, the ruler of God’s house;

hausa: Da isarsu a can, sai suka tara ikkilisiya wuri ɗaya suka ba da rahoton duk abin da Allah ya aikata ta wurinsu da kuma yadda ya buɗe ƙofar bangaskiya domin Al’ummai.
english: When they had arrived and had gathered the assembly together, they reported all the things that God had done with them, and that he had opened a door of faith to the nations.

hausa: Amma matar ta ɓoye mutanen nan biyu. Ta ce, “I, mutanen sun zo wurina, amma ban san daga ina suka zo ba,
english: The woman took the two men and hid them. Then she said, “Yes, the men came to me, but I didn’t know where they came from.

hausa: Saboda haka sa’ad da Yaƙub ya dawo daga jeji a wannan yamma sai Liyatu ta fito ta tarye shi. Ta ce, “Dole ka kwana da ni, na yi hayarka da manta-uwa na ɗana.” Saboda haka ya kwana da ita a wannan dare.
english: Jacob came from the field in the evening, and Leah went out to meet him, and said, “You must come in to me; for I have surely hired you with my son’s mandrakes.” He lay with her that night.

hausa: Suna sa harsunansu su yi kaifi kamar na maciji; dafin gamsheƙa yana a leɓunansu. Sela
english: They have sharpened their tongues like a serpent. Viper’s poison is under their lips. Selah.

hausa: Sai Yoshuwa da dukan mayaƙan suka auka musu a bakin Ruwayen Meron.
english: So Joshua came suddenly, with all the warriors, against them by the waters of Merom, and attacked them.

hausa: Amma duba, sai ga shi kuna farin ciki kuna kuma murna, kuna yankan shanu kuna kashe tumaki, kuna cin nama kuna kuma shan ruwan inabi! Kuna cewa, “Bari mu ci mu kuma sha, gama gobe za mu mutu!”
english: and behold, there is joy and gladness, killing cattle and killing sheep, eating meat and drinking wine: “Let’s eat and drink, for tomorrow we will die.”

hausa: Zai tsaya a gaban Eleyazar firist, wanda zai nemi masa shawara ta wurin Urim a gaban Ubangiji. Da umarninsa, da shi da dukan jama’ar Isra’ilawa za su fita, da umarninsa kuma za su shiga.”
english: He shall stand before Eleazar the priest, who shall inquire for him by the judgment of the Urim before Yahweh. At his word they shall go out, and at his word they shall come in, both he and all the children of Israel with him, even all the congregation.”

hausa: Da waɗannan za ka yi man shafewa mai tsarki, yadda mai yin turare yake yi. Zai zama man shafewa mai tsarki.
english: You shall make it into a holy anointing oil, a perfume compounded after the art of the perfumer: it shall be a holy anointing oil.

hausa: Sa’an nan sarki ya ce wa Amasa, “Ka tattaro mutanen Yahuda su zo wurina cikin kwana uku, kai kuwa ka kasance a can kai kanka.”
english: Then the king said to Amasa, “Call me the men of Judah together within three days, and be here present.”

hausa: Sa’ad da aka kira Ammonawa su yi ɗamarar yaƙi, sai su kuma kafa sansani a Gileyad, Isra’ilawa kuwa suka tattaru suka kafa sansani Mizfa.
english: Then the children of Ammon were gathered together and encamped in Gilead. The children of Israel assembled themselves together and encamped in Mizpah.

hausa: Da Hadad ya mutu, Samla daga Masreka ya gāje shi a matsayin sarki.
english: Hadad died, and Samlah of Masrekah reigned in his place.
