hausa: Sai Bowaz ya tambayi shugaban masu girbinsa, “Wace yarinya ce wannan?”
english: Then Boaz said to his servant who was set over the reapers, “Whose young lady is this?”

hausa: Yoshuwa kuwa ya cinye sarakunan nan duka da ƙasashensu gaba ɗaya gama Ubangiji, Allah na Isra’ila ne ya yi yaƙi domin Isra’ilawa.
english: Joshua took all these kings and their land at one time because Yahweh, the God of Israel, fought for Israel.

hausa: Sa’ad da kogi ya cika yana hauka, ba tă damu ba; ba abin da zai same ta ko da a gaban bakinta Urdun yake wucewa.
english: Behold, if a river overflows, he doesn’t tremble. He is confident, though the Jordan swells even to his mouth.

hausa: Amma duk wani abin da ba shi da ƙege da ɓamɓaroki, ba za ku ci ba; gama marar tsarki ne gare ku.
english: You shall not eat whatever doesn’t have fins and scales. It is unclean to you.

hausa: Da Abigiyel ta ga Dawuda, sai ta gaggauta ta sauka daga kan jaki, ta rusuna a gaban Dawuda da fuskarta har ƙasa.
english: When Abigail saw David, she hurried and got off her donkey, and fell before David on her face and bowed herself to the ground.

hausa: farawa daga baftisma ta Yohanna har zuwa sa’ad da aka ɗauke Yesu daga gare mu. Gama dole ɗaya daga waɗannan ya zama shaidar tashinsa daga matattu tare da mu.”
english: beginning from the baptism of John to the day that he was received up from us, of these one must become a witness with us of his resurrection.”

hausa: na iyalin Yohiyarib, Mattenai; na iyalin Yedahiya, Uzzi;
english: of Joiarib, Mattenai; of Jedaiah, Uzzi;

hausa: Za a albarkaci kwandonku da kwanon kwaɓan kullunku.
english: Your basket and your kneading trough shall be blessed.

hausa: Fatrusawa, Kasluhiyawa (daga waɗanda Filistiyawa suka fito) da Kaftorawa.
english: Pathrusim, Casluhim (where the Philistines came from), and Caphtorim.

hausa: “ ‘In kuka kawo toyayyen hadayar gari da aka yi daga matoya, zai ƙunshi gari mai laushi, toyayye ba tare da yisti ba, gauraye kuma da mai, ko kuwa ƙosai da aka yi ba tare da yisti ba, aka kuma kwaɓa da mai.
english: “‘When you offer an offering of a meal offering baked in the oven, it shall be unleavened cakes of fine flour mixed with oil, or unleavened wafers anointed with oil.

hausa: Ku ba da kanku ga juna cikin ƙauna irin ta ’yan’uwa. Kowa yă yi ƙoƙari wajen girmama wani fiye da kansa.
english: In love of the brothers be tenderly affectionate to one another; in honor prefer one another,

hausa: Nan fa, a ƙasar Mowab Musa bawan Ubangiji ya mutu, yadda Ubangiji ya faɗa.
english: So Moses the servant of Yahweh died there in the land of Moab, according to Yahweh’s word.

hausa: Waɗanda suke ƙin Ubangiji za su fāɗi a gabansa da rawar jiki, hukuncinsu kuma zai dawwama har abada.
english: The haters of Yahweh would cringe before him, and their punishment would last forever.

hausa: Sai Zakariya ya tambayi mala’ikan ya ce, “Yaya zan tabbatar da wannan? Ga ni tsoho, matana kuma ta kwana biyu.”
english: Zacharias said to the angel, “How can I be sure of this? For I am an old man, and my wife is well advanced in years.”

hausa: Amma waɗanda suke ƙinsa, a fili yakan sāka musu da hallaka; ba zai yi jinkiri yin ramuwa a kan maƙiyinsa ba, zai yi ramuwar a fili.
english: and repays those who hate him to their face, to destroy them. He will not be slack to him who hates him. He will repay him to his face.

hausa: Gare shi wanda ya raba Jan Teku biyu Ƙaunarsa madawwamiya ce.
english: to him who divided the Red Sea apart, for his loving kindness endures forever;

hausa: Isra’ilawa suka ji daɗin rahoton da suka ji, suka kuma yi wa Allah yabo. Ba su sāke yin maganar zuwa yaƙi don su rushe ƙasar da mutanen Ruben da mutanen Gad suke ciki ba.
english: The thing pleased the children of Israel; and the children of Israel blessed God, and spoke no more of going up against them to war, to destroy the land in which the children of Reuben and the children of Gad lived.

hausa: Bari in samo muku wani abu ku ci don ku wartsake, sa’an nan ku ci gaba da tafiyarku; da yake kun biyo wurin bawanku.” Suka ce, “To, sai ka yi abin da ka ce.”
english: I will get a piece of bread so you can refresh your heart. After that you may go your way, now that you have come to your servant.” They said, “Very well, do as you have said.”

hausa: Yesu ya amsa, “Ba su bukata su tafi. Ku ku ba su wani abu su ci.”
english: But Jesus said to them, “They don’t need to go away. You give them something to eat.”

hausa: “Ɗalibi ba ya fin malaminsa, haka ma, bawa ba ya fin maigidansa.
english: “A disciple is not above his teacher, nor a servant above his lord.

hausa: saboda haka Ubangiji yana shirin yă kawo musu rigyawar ruwan Kogi, wato, sarkin Assuriya da dukan sojojinsa. Zai cika dukan gaɓoɓinsa, yă kuma malala har zuwa bakin kogi.
english: now therefore, behold, the Lord brings upon them the mighty flood waters of the River: the king of Assyria and all his glory. It will come up over all its channels, and go over all its banks.

hausa: Duk wanda ya karya ɗaya daga cikin mafi ƙanƙanta na umarnan nan, ya kuma koya wa waɗansu su yi haka, za a ce da shi mafi ƙanƙanta a mulkin sama. Amma duk wanda ya aikata, ya kuma koyar da waɗannan umarnai, za a kira shi mai girma a cikin mulkin sama.
english: Therefore, whoever shall break one of these least commandments and teach others to do so, shall be called least in the Kingdom of Heaven; but whoever shall do and teach them shall be called great in the Kingdom of Heaven.

hausa: Kuma ka ce, ba ya ba da horo cikin fushinsa ko kaɗan ba ya kula da mugunta.
english: But now, because he has not visited in his anger, neither does he greatly regard arrogance,

hausa: Amma ni kamar itace zaitun ne ina haɓaka a gidan Allah; na dogara ga ƙauna marar ƙarewa ta Allah har abada abadin.
english: But as for me, I am like a green olive tree in God’s house. I trust in God’s loving kindness forever and ever.

hausa: Sai Yesu ya ce musu, “A wannan dare, dukanku za ku ja da baya saboda ni, gama a rubuce yake cewa, “ ‘Zan bugi makiyayin, tumakin garken kuwa za su fasu.’
english: Then Jesus said to them, “All of you will be made to stumble because of me tonight, for it is written, ‘I will strike the shepherd, and the sheep of the flock will be scattered.’

hausa: Walƙiyarsa ta haskaka duniya; duniya ta gani ta kuma yi rawar jiki.
english: His lightning lights up the world. The earth sees, and trembles.

hausa: To, fa, Zedekiya ɗan Kena’ana ya yi ƙahonin ƙarfe, ya kuma furta, “Ga abin da Ubangiji ya ce, ‘Da waɗannan za ka sassoki Arameyawa sai sun hallaka.’ ”
english: Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah made himself horns of iron and said, “Yahweh says, ‘With these you shall push the Syrians, until they are consumed.’”

hausa: Amma kuka bar ni kuka bauta wa waɗansu alloli, saboda haka ni ma ba zan ƙara cece ku ba.
english: Yet you have forsaken me and served other gods. Therefore I will save you no more.

hausa: Musa ya aiki manzanni daga Kadesh zuwa wurin sarkin Edom cewa, “Ga abin da ɗan’uwanka Isra’ila ya ce ka san duk irin wahalolin da ya same mu.
english: Moses sent messengers from Kadesh to the king of Edom, saying: “Your brother Israel says: You know all the travail that has happened to us;

hausa: Yana cikin tafiya, sai mutane suka shimfiɗa rigunarsu a kan hanya.
english: As he went, they spread their cloaks on the road.

hausa: Amma Ubangiji ya ce mini, “In faɗa muku, ‘Kada ku fāɗa musu da yaƙi, gama ba zai kasance tare da ku ba. Idan kuka kuskura, abokan gābanku za su murƙushe ku.’ ”
english: Yahweh said to me, “Tell them, ‘Don’t go up and don’t fight; for I am not among you, lest you be struck before your enemies.’”

hausa: Ba ma neman yabo daga wurin mutane, ko a gare ku, ko ga waɗansu. A matsayinmu na manzannin Kiristi da mun so, da mun nawaita muku,
english: nor seeking glory from men (neither from you nor from others), when we might have claimed authority as apostles of Christ.

hausa: Garuruwan da za ku ba wa Lawiyawa daga ƙasar da Isra’ilawa suka mallaka, za a ba da su bisa girman gādon kowace kabila. Ka karɓi garuruwa masu yawa daga kabilar da take da garuruwa masu yawa, amma kaɗan daga kabilar da ba ta da garuruwa masu yawa.”
english: Concerning the cities which you shall give of the possession of the children of Israel, from the many you shall take many, and from the few you shall take few. Everyone according to his inheritance which he inherits shall give some of his cities to the Levites.”

hausa: Ɗana, in zuciyarka mai hikima ce, to, zuciyata za tă yi murna;
english: My son, if your heart is wise, then my heart will be glad, even mine.

hausa: Ku sayar da dukiyarku, ku ba wa matalauta. Ku yi wa kanku jakar kuɗin da ba za su lalace ba. Ku yi wa kanku ajiyar dukiyar da ba za tă kare ba a sama, inda ɓarawo ba zai yi kusa ba, asu kuma ba za su iya su lalatar ba.
english: Sell what you have and give gifts to the needy. Make for yourselves purses which don’t grow old, a treasure in the heavens that doesn’t fail, where no thief approaches and no moth destroys.

hausa: a ƙarshe duka, ya bayyana a gare ni, kamar wanda an haifa a lokacin da bai kamata ba.
english: and last of all, as to the child born at the wrong time, he appeared to me also.

hausa: “Ka karɓi azurfa da zinariya daga masu zaman bauta Heldai, Tobiya, Yedahiya, waɗanda suka iso daga Babilon. A ranar kuma ka je gidan Yosiya ɗan Zefaniya.
english: “Take of them of the captivity, even of Heldai, of Tobijah, and of Jedaiah; and come the same day, and go into the house of Josiah the son of Zephaniah, where they have come from Babylon.

hausa: Amma duk wata halitta mai fikafikai mai tsabta ce, za ku iya ci.
english: Of all clean birds you may eat.

hausa: “Kwanaki suna zuwa,” in ji Ubangiji, “sa’ad da zan hukunta dukan waɗanda aka yi musu kaciya kawai a jiki,
english: “Behold, the days come,” says Yahweh, “that I will punish all those who are circumcised only in their flesh:

hausa: gama za ka sa su juye bayansu sa’ad da ka auna su da bakan da ka ja.
english: For you will make them turn their back, when you aim drawn bows at their face.

hausa: Ba za a ƙara kiranka Abram ba; sunanka zai zama Ibrahim, gama na mai da kai uban al’ummai masu yawa.
english: Your name will no more be called Abram, but your name will be Abraham; for I have made you the father of a multitude of nations.

hausa: Shafat ɗan Hori, daga kabilar Simeyon;
english: Of the tribe of Simeon, Shaphat the son of Hori.

hausa: su kuma fito, waɗanda suka aikata nagarta za su tashi zuwa ga rai, waɗanda kuma suka aikata mugunta za su tashi zuwa ga hukunci.
english: and will come out; those who have done good, to the resurrection of life; and those who have done evil, to the resurrection of judgment.

hausa: Ba na jin kunyar bishara, gama ita ikon Allah ne domin ceton kowa da ya gaskata, da farko ga Yahudawa, sa’an nan ga Al’ummai.
english: For I am not ashamed of the Good News of Christ, because it is the power of God for salvation for everyone who believes, for the Jew first, and also for the Greek.

hausa: Ka tuna da ni, ya Ubangiji, sa’ad da ka nuna alheri ga mutanenka, ka zo ka taimake ni sa’ad da ka cece su,
english: Remember me, Yahweh, with the favor that you show to your people. Visit me with your salvation,

hausa: Kada ka cika yin mugunta, kada kuma ka cika yin wauta, don me za ka mutu kafin lokacinka?
english: Don’t be too wicked, neither be foolish. Why should you die before your time?

hausa: abokin gāban da yake shuka su kuwa, Iblis ne. Lokacin girbi kuma shi ne ƙarshen zamani, masu girbin kuwa su ne mala’iku.
english: The enemy who sowed them is the devil. The harvest is the end of the age, and the reapers are angels.

hausa: ya kuma tanada masa babban ɗakin da dā ake ajiyar hadayun hatsi da turare da kayayyaki haikali, da kuma zakan hatsi, sabon ruwan inabi da kuma mai da aka umarta don Lawiyawa, mawaƙa da kuma matsaran ƙofofi, da kuma sadakoki domin firistoci.
english: had prepared for him a great room, where previously they laid the meal offerings, the frankincense, the vessels, and the tithes of the grain, the new wine, and the oil, which were given by commandment to the Levites, the singers, and the gatekeepers; and the wave offerings for the priests.

hausa: Wane ne ya taimake ka ka yi waɗannan maganganu? Kuma ruhun wane ne ya yi magana ta bakinka?
english: To whom have you uttered words? Whose spirit came out of you?

hausa: Ya kuma bar Obed-Edom da ’yan’uwansa sittin da takwas don su yi hidima tare. Obed-Edom ɗan Yedutun da Hosa kuma, su ne matsaran ƙofofi.
english: and Obed-Edom with their sixty-eight relatives; Obed-Edom also the son of Jeduthun and Hosah to be doorkeepers;

hausa: Dare da rana sun zama mana katanga kewaya da mu, a duk tsawon lokacin da muke kiwon tumakinmu kusa da su.
english: They were a wall to us both by night and by day, all the while we were with them keeping the sheep.

hausa: Na sani, Allahna, cewa kakan gwada zuciya, kakan kuma gamsu da mutunci. Dukan waɗannan abubuwa na bayar da yardar rai da kuma kyakkyawar niyya. Yanzu kuma da farin ciki na ga yadda mutanenka waɗanda suke a nan da yardar rai suka ba ka.
english: I know also, my God, that you try the heart and have pleasure in uprightness. As for me, in the uprightness of my heart I have willingly offered all these things. Now I have seen with joy your people, who are present here, offer willingly to you.

hausa: Suna cikin wannan zance, sai ga Yesu da kansa tsaye a tsakiyarsu. Sai ya ce musu, “Salama a gare ku!”
english: As they said these things, Jesus himself stood among them, and said to them, “Peace be to you.”

hausa: Farillanka su ne gādona har abada; su ne farin cikin zuciyata.
english: I have taken your testimonies as a heritage forever, for they are the joy of my heart.

hausa: Dukan tsuntsayen sararin sama suka yi sheƙa a rassansa, dukan namun jeji suka haihu a ƙarƙashin rassansa; dukan al’ummai suka zauna a inuwarsa.
english: All the birds of the sky made their nests in its boughs. Under its branches, all the animals of the field gave birth to their young. All great nations lived under its shadow.

hausa: Taron suka saurari Bulus sai da ya yi wannan magana. Sa’an nan suka ɗaga muryoyinsu suka yi ihu suka ce, “A raba duniya da wannan mutum! Bai cancanci yă rayu ba!”
english: They listened to him until he said that; then they lifted up their voice and said, “Rid the earth of this fellow, for he isn’t fit to live!”

hausa: Amma da Irmiya ya gama faɗar wa dukan mutanen abin da Ubangiji ya umarce shi ya faɗa, sai firistoci, annabawa da dukan mutane suka kama shi suka ce, “Mutuwa za ka yi!
english: When Jeremiah had finished speaking all that Yahweh had commanded him to speak to all the people, the priests and the prophets and all the people seized him, saying, “You shall surely die!

hausa: Amma in wani wanda ba shi da tsarki ya ci naman hadaya ta salama ga Ubangiji, za a fid da mutumin daga cikin mutanensa.
english: but the soul who eats of the meat of the sacrifice of peace offerings that belongs to Yahweh, having his uncleanness on him, that soul shall be cut off from his people.

hausa: Sarki ya yi baƙin ciki, amma saboda rantsuwarsa da kuma baƙinsa, sai ya ba da umarni a ba ta abin da ta roƙa
english: The king was grieved, but for the sake of his oaths and of those who sat at the table with him, he commanded it to be given,

hausa: Tashi nan da nan ka tafi Faddan Aram, zuwa gidan mahaifin mahaifiyarka Betuwel. Ka ɗauko wa kanka mata a can daga cikin ’ya’ya matan Laban ɗan’uwan mahaifiyarka.
english: Arise, go to Paddan Aram, to the house of Bethuel your mother’s father. Take a wife from there from the daughters of Laban, your mother’s brother.

hausa: Kun ga da idanunku, manyan gwaje-gwaje, alamu masu banmamaki da al’ajabai, hannu mai ƙarfi da kuma mai ikon da Ubangiji Allahnku ya fitar da ku. Ubangiji Allahnku zai yi haka ga dukan mutanen da yanzu kuke tsoro.
english: the great trials which your eyes saw, the signs, the wonders, the mighty hand, and the outstretched arm, by which Yahweh your God brought you out. So shall Yahweh your God do to all the peoples of whom you are afraid.

hausa: “ ‘Ni ne kaɗai zan zama abin gādon da firistoci za su kasance da shi. Kada ka ba su wani mallaka a Isra’ila; zan zama mallakarsu.
english: “‘They shall have an inheritance: I am their inheritance; and you shall give them no possession in Israel. I am their possession.

hausa: A maimakon haka, sai ya fita, ya fara magana a sake, yana baza labarin. Saboda haka, Yesu bai ƙara iya shiga cikin gari a fili ba, sai dai ya kasance a wuraren da ba kowa. Duk da haka, mutane suka yi ta zuwa wurinsa daga ko’ina.
english: But he went out, and began to proclaim it much, and to spread about the matter, so that Jesus could no more openly enter into a city, but was outside in desert places. People came to him from everywhere.

hausa: Yanzu sai ku aika wa Dawuda saƙo nan da nan ku ce masa, ‘Kada ka kwana a mashigai cikin hamada; ka tabbata ka haye ba faci, in ba haka ba sarki da dukan mutanensa za su hallaka.’ ”
english: Now therefore send quickly, and tell David, saying, ‘Don’t lodge tonight at the fords of the wilderness, but by all means pass over, lest the king be swallowed up, and all the people who are with him.’”

hausa: da labulen filin da yake kewaye da tabanakul da kuma bagade, da igiyoyi, da kuma kowane abin da ya danganci aikinsu.
english: the hangings of the court, the screen for the door of the court which is by the tabernacle and around the altar, and its cords for all of its service.

hausa: Ka yi ƙarfin hali bari mu yi yaƙi da jaruntaka saboda mutanenmu da biranen Allahnmu. Ubangiji zai yi abin da ya ga ya yi masa kyau.”
english: Be courageous, and let’s be strong for our people and for the cities of our God. May Yahweh do that which seems good to him.”

hausa: 7-8 A rana ta ashirin da huɗu ga watan goma sha ɗaya, wato, watan Shebat, a shekara ta biyu ta Dariyus, maganar Ubangiji ta zo wa annabi Zakariya ɗan Berekiya ɗan Iddo.
english: On the twenty-fourth day of the eleventh month, which is the month Shebat, in the second year of Darius, Yahweh’s word came to the prophet Zechariah the son of Berechiah, the son of Iddo, saying,

hausa: Dawuda ya sa rundunoni kashi ɗaya bisa uku a ƙarƙashin Yowab, kashi ɗaya bisa uku a ƙarƙashin Abishai, ɗan’uwan Yowab ɗan Zeruhiya, kashi ɗaya bisa uku a ƙarƙashin Ittai mutumin Gat. Sai sarki ya ce wa rundunonin, “Tabbatacce zan tafi tare da ku.”
english: David sent the people out, a third part under the hand of Joab, and a third part under the hand of Abishai the son of Zeruiah, Joab’s brother, and a third part under the hand of Ittai the Gittite. The king said to the people, “I will also surely go out with you myself.”

hausa: “Ubangiji ne ƙarfina da mafakata, ya zama cetona. Shi Allahna ne, zan yabe shi. Allah na kakana, zan ɗaukaka shi.
english: Yah is my strength and song. He has become my salvation. This is my God, and I will praise him; my father’s God, and I will exalt him.

hausa: Sa’ad da kuka ji sun ɗauki dogon lokaci suna busa ƙaho, sai mutane gaba ɗaya su tā da murya su yi ihu da ƙarfi; katangar birnin kuwa za tă rushe, sai sojoji su haura, ko wanne yă nufi inda ya fuskanta kai tsaye.”
english: It shall be that when they make a long blast with the ram’s horn, and when you hear the sound of the trumpet, all the people shall shout with a great shout; then the city wall will fall down flat, and the people shall go up, every man straight in front of him.”

hausa: Suka sāke dawowa cikin Urushalima. Da Yesu yana tafiya a filin haikali, sai manyan firistoci, malaman dokoki da kuma dattawa suka zo wurinsa.
english: They came again to Jerusalem, and as he was walking in the temple, the chief priests, the scribes, and the elders came to him,

hausa: Ta ce musu, “Kada ku kira ni Na’omi. Ku kira ni Mara gama Maɗaukaki ya sa raina ya yi ɗaci sosai.
english: She said to them, “Don’t call me Naomi. Call me Mara, for the Almighty has dealt very bitterly with me.

hausa: Bari kada kowa yă yi masa alheri ko yă ji tausayin marayunsa.
english: Let there be no one to extend kindness to him, neither let there be anyone to have pity on his fatherless children.

hausa: yadda gaggafa take firiya a sararin sama, yadda maciji yake tafiya a kan dutse, yadda jirgin ruwa yake tafiya a teku, da kuma sha’ani tsakanin namiji da ’ya mace.
english: The way of an eagle in the air, the way of a serpent on a rock, the way of a ship in the middle of the sea, and the way of a man with a maiden.

hausa: Sai na yi tunani a zuciyata, “Ƙaddarar wawa za tă same ni ni ma. Wace riba ce hikimata za tă jawo mini?” Na ce a zuciyata, “Wannan ma ba shi da amfani.”
english: Then I said in my heart, “As it happens to the fool, so will it happen even to me; and why was I then more wise?” Then I said in my heart that this also is vanity.

hausa: Kalman ya zama mutum, ya kuwa zauna a cikinmu. Muka ga ɗaukakarsa, ɗaukaka ta wanda yake Ɗaya kuma Makaɗaici, wanda ya zo daga wurin Uba, cike da alheri da gaskiya.
english: The Word became flesh and lived among us. We saw his glory, such glory as of the only born Son of the Father, full of grace and truth.

hausa: Ya miƙa hadayarsa ta ƙonawa da ta hatsi, ya zuba hadayarsa ta sha, ya kuma yayyafa jinin hadayunsa ta zumunci a bisa bagaden.
english: He burned his burnt offering and his meal offering, poured his drink offering, and sprinkled the blood of his peace offerings on the altar.

hausa: Amma kashegari sai ya ɗauki tsumma mai kauri, ya jiƙa shi, ya rufe fuskar sarki da shi, har sai da sarki ya mutu. Sai Hazayel ya gāje shi a matsayin sarki.
english: On the next day, he took a thick cloth, dipped it in water, and spread it on the king’s face, so that he died. Then Hazael reigned in his place.

hausa: da kuma Yahuda Iskariyot, wanda ya bashe Yesu.
english: and Judas Iscariot, who also betrayed him. Then he came into a house.

hausa: Bikin Ƙetarewar Ubangiji, zai fara da yamma a ranar goma sha huɗu na wata na fari.
english: In the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month in the evening, is Yahweh’s Passover.

hausa: ya kuma kawo bunsuru ɗaya domin hadaya don zunubi;
english: one male goat for a sin offering;

hausa: Amma ba su kasa kunne ko su saurara ba, a maimako, sai suka bi taurinkai na mugayen zukatansu. Saboda haka na kawo musu dukan la’anonin alkawarin da na riga na umarce su, su bi amma ba su kiyaye ba.’ ”
english: Yet they didn’t obey, nor turn their ear, but everyone walked in the stubbornness of their evil heart. Therefore I brought on them all the words of this covenant, which I commanded them to do, but they didn’t do them.’”

hausa: “Wannan za tă zama hadaya ta ƙonawar da za a dinga yi kowace rana, daga tsara zuwa tsara. Za a yi ta miƙa hadayar a ƙofar Tentin Sujada a gaban Ubangiji. A can zan sadu da kai, in yi magana da kai;
english: It shall be a continual burnt offering throughout your generations at the door of the Tent of Meeting before Yahweh, where I will meet with you, to speak there to you.

hausa: a raba daidai wa daida, sai ku taimake su a yanzu da yalwarku saboda rashinsu. Wata rana su ma su taimake ku da yalwarsu saboda rashinku, don a daidaita al’amari,
english: but for equality. Your abundance at this present time supplies their lack, that their abundance also may become a supply for your lack, that there may be equality.

hausa: Kewaye da kursiyin kuwa akwai waɗansu kursiyoyi ashirin da huɗu, zaune a kansu kuwa dattawa ashirin da huɗu ne. Suna saye da fararen tufafi suna kuma da rawanin zinariya a kawunansu.
english: Around the throne were twenty-four thrones. On the thrones were twenty-four elders sitting, dressed in white garments, with crowns of gold on their heads.

hausa: Amma Nassi ya kulle kome a ƙarƙashin ikon zunubi, domin abin da aka yi alkawarin nan, da ake bayar ta wurin bangaskiya a cikin Yesu Kiristi, a ba da shi ga waɗanda suka gaskata.
english: But the Scripture imprisoned all things under sin, that the promise by faith in Jesus Christ might be given to those who believe.

hausa: Ubangiji ya ce wa Musa,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

hausa: Saboda wannan zan yi baƙin ciki, in yi kuka; zan yi tafiya ba takalmi, zan tuɓe, in kuma yi tafiya tsirara. Zan yi kuka kamar dila, in yi baƙin ciki kamar mujiya.
english: For this I will lament and wail. I will go stripped and naked. I will howl like the jackals and mourn like the ostriches.

hausa: In muna shan wahala, ai, muna shanta domin ta’aziyyarku, da cetonku ne, in mun sami ta’aziyya, ai, mun same ta domin ta’aziyyarku ce, wadda take sa ku jure wa irin wahalan nan, da muke sha.
english: But if we are afflicted, it is for your comfort and salvation. If we are comforted, it is for your comfort, which produces in you the patient enduring of the same sufferings which we also suffer.

hausa: Ka faɗa wa hikima, “Ke ’yar’uwata ce,” ka kuma kira fahimi danginka;
english: Tell wisdom, “You are my sister.” Call understanding your relative,

hausa: iyalin gidan Lawi da matansu, iyalin gidan Shimeyi da matansu,
english: the family of the house of Levi apart, and their wives apart; the family of the Shimeites apart, and their wives apart;

hausa: Harshe mai faɗin ƙarya yana ƙin waɗanda yake ɓata musu rai, daɗin baki kuma yakan aikata ɓarna.
english: A lying tongue hates those it hurts; and a flattering mouth works ruin.

hausa: Gama Ubangiji Allahnku, yana tafe tare da ku, zai yaƙi abokan gābanku dominku, yă ba ku nasara.”
english: for Yahweh your God is he who goes with you, to fight for you against your enemies, to save you.”

hausa: “Daidai haka zai zama, a ranar da Ɗan Mutum zai bayyana.
english: It will be the same way in the day that the Son of Man is revealed.

hausa: A kimanta kowace daraja bisa ga ma’aunin shekel na tsattsarkan wuri, gera ashirin ga shekel.
english: All your valuations shall be according to the shekel of the sanctuary: twenty gerahs to the shekel.

hausa: A maimakon haka, sai sarki ya umarci Yerameyel ɗan sarki, Serahiya ɗan Azriyel da Shelemiya ɗan Abdeyel su kama Baruk marubuci da Irmiya annabi. Amma Ubangiji ya ɓoye su.
english: The king commanded Jerahmeel the king’s son, and Seraiah the son of Azriel, and Shelemiah the son of Abdeel, to arrest Baruch the scribe and Jeremiah the prophet; but Yahweh hid them.

hausa: “In ka sayi mutumin Ibraniyawa a matsayin bawa, zai bauta maka shekara shida. Amma a shekara ta bakwai, za ka ’yantar da shi, yă tafi ’yantacce, ba tare da ya biya kome ba.
english: “If you buy a Hebrew servant, he shall serve six years, and in the seventh he shall go out free without paying anything.

hausa: “Ku yi matuƙar ƙoƙari ku shiga ta matsattsiyar ƙofa, domin ina faɗa muku, mutane da yawa za su yi ƙoƙarin shiga, amma ba za su iya ba.
english: “Strive to enter in by the narrow door, for many, I tell you, will seek to enter in and will not be able.

hausa: “Sa’an nan ka fasa tulun yayinda waɗanda suka tafi tare da kai suna duba,
english: “Then you shall break the container in the sight of the men who go with you,

hausa: Wawa yakan ji daɗi halin mugunta, amma mutum mai fahimi kan ji daɗin hikima.
english: It is a fool’s pleasure to do wickedness, but wisdom is a man of understanding’s pleasure.

hausa: Saboda haka yi annabci ka ce musu, ‘Ga abin da Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka yana cewa ya mutanena, zan buɗe kaburburanku in fitar da ku daga cikinsu; zan mai da ku ƙasar Isra’ila.
english: Therefore prophesy, and tell them, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “Behold, I will open your graves, and cause you to come up out of your graves, my people; and I will bring you into the land of Israel.

hausa: Sai annabin ya ce, “Domin ba ka yi biyayya da Ubangiji ba, da zarar ka bar ni zaki zai kashe ka.” Daga baya mutumin ya tafi, zaki ya same shi, ya kuma kashe shi.
english: Then he said to him, “Because you have not obeyed Yahweh’s voice, behold, as soon as you have departed from me, a lion will kill you.” As soon as he had departed from him, a lion found him and killed him.

hausa: “Sai mutumin wanda yake shugaba a kan ƙasar ya ce mana, ‘Ga yadda zan san ko ku mutane masu gaskiya ne. Ku bar ɗaya daga cikin ’yan’uwanku a nan tare da ni, ku ɗauki abinci domin gidajenku masu yunwa, ku tafi.
english: The man, the lord of the land, said to us, ‘By this I will know that you are honest men: leave one of your brothers with me, and take grain for the famine of your houses, and go your way.

hausa: Sa’an nan ya ce mini, “Ɗan mutum, waɗannan ƙasusuwa su ne dukan gidan Isra’ila. Suna cewa, ‘Ƙasusuwanmu sun bushe, sa zuciyarmu duk ya tafi; an share mu ƙaf.’
english: Then he said to me, “Son of man, these bones are the whole house of Israel. Behold, they say, ‘Our bones are dried up, and our hope is lost. We are completely cut off.’

hausa: Mutumin kirki yakan fito da abubuwa masu kyau daga ajiyar da aka a yi cikinsa, mugun mutum kuwa yakan fito da mugayen abubuwa daga cikin muguntar da aka yi ajiya a cikinsa.
english: The good man out of his good treasure brings out good things, and the evil man out of his evil treasure brings out evil things.

hausa: Sai dai ku yi hankali, kada yin amfani da ’yancinku yă zama abin sa tuntuɓe ga marasa ƙarfi.
english: But be careful that by no means does this liberty of yours become a stumbling block to the weak.

hausa: Yerameyel yana da wata mata, wadda sunanta Atara; ita ce mahaifiyar Onam.
english: Jerahmeel had another wife, whose name was Atarah. She was the mother of Onam.

hausa: Duk mai hikima, bari yă ji waɗannan abubuwa yă kuma lura da ƙauna mai girma ta Ubangiji.
english: Whoever is wise will pay attention to these things. They will consider the loving kindnesses of Yahweh.

hausa: Ya amsa ya ce, “Ku lura, kada ku kuma a ruɗe ku. Gama da yawa za su zo a cikin sunana, suna cewa, ‘Ai, ni ne shi,’ da kuma, ‘Lokaci ya yi kusa.’ Kada ku bi su.
english: He said, “Watch out that you don’t get led astray, for many will come in my name, saying, ‘I am he,’ and, ‘The time is at hand.’ Therefore don’t follow them.

hausa: Yarmut da En Gannim, tare da wuraren kiwonsu, garuruwa huɗu ke nan;
english: Jarmuth with its pasture lands, En Gannim with its pasture lands: four cities.

hausa: Sai Isra’ilawa suka haura zuwa Betel suka nemi nufin Allah, suka ce, “Wane ne a cikinmu zai fara fāɗa wa mutanen Benyamin?” Ubangiji ya ce, “Yahuda ce za tă fara.”
english: The children of Israel arose, went up to Bethel, and asked counsel of God. They asked, “Who shall go up for us first to battle against the children of Benjamin?” Yahweh said, “Judah first.”

hausa: da kuma sahihanci cikin maganar da ba za a iya kushewa ba, domin masu gāba da kai su ji kunya, su kuma rasa wani mugun abin da za su faɗa game da mu.
english: and soundness of speech that can’t be condemned, that he who opposes you may be ashamed, having no evil thing to say about us.

hausa: Ku yi auratayya da mu; ku aurar mana da ’ya’yanku mata, ku kuma ku auro ’ya’yanmu mata wa kanku.
english: Make marriages with us. Give your daughters to us, and take our daughters for yourselves.

hausa: Duwatsu za su narke a ƙarƙashin ƙafafunsa, kamar kaki a gaban wuta, kwaruruka kuma za su ɓace, kamar ruwan da yake gangarowa daga tsauni.
english: The mountains melt under him, and the valleys split apart like wax before the fire, like waters that are poured down a steep place.

hausa: Ka mai da mu, ya Ubangiji Allah Maɗaukaki; ka sa fuskarka ta haskaka a kanmu, za mu kuwa cetu.
english: Turn us again, Yahweh God of Armies. Cause your face to shine, and we will be saved.

hausa: A cikinki sun rena mahaifi da mahaifiya; a cikinki sun zalunci baƙo suka wulaƙanta maraya da gwauruwa.
english: In you have they treated father and mother with contempt. Among you they have oppressed the foreigner. In you they have wronged the fatherless and the widow.

hausa: Saboda haka ina taƙama cikin Kiristi Yesu a cikin hidimata ga Allah.
english: I have therefore my boasting in Christ Jesus in things pertaining to God.

hausa: Jiya da dare wani mala’ikan Allahn da nake nasa nake kuma bauta wa ya tsaya kusa da ni
english: For there stood by me this night an angel, belonging to the God whose I am and whom I serve,

hausa: da masu zina da kuma da maza masu kwana da maza, ko mata masu kwana da mata, da masu cinikin bayi da masu ƙarya da kuma masu shaidar ƙarya, da kuma duk wani abin da ya saɓa wa sahihiyar koyarwa,
english: for the sexually immoral, for homosexuals, for slave-traders, for liars, for perjurers, and for any other thing contrary to the sound doctrine,

hausa: Su marasa amfani ne, abubuwan ba’a ne kawai; sa’ad da lokacin hukuncinsu ya kai, za su hallaka.
english: They are vanity, a work of delusion. In the time of their visitation, they will perish.

hausa: Waɗannan su ne sharuɗan alkawarin da Ubangiji ya umarci Musa yă yi da Isra’ilawa a Mowab, wato, ban da alkawarin da ya yi da su a Dutsen Horeb.
english: These are the words of the covenant which Yahweh commanded Moses to make with the children of Israel in the land of Moab, in addition to the covenant which he made with them in Horeb.

hausa: A maimakon ƙanshi, wari ne za a ji; a maimakon abin ɗamara, igiya ce za a samu; a maimakon kyakkyawan gashi, sanƙo za su kasance da shi a kai; a maimakon tufafi masu kyau, za su sa tsummoki; a maimakon kyau, za su zama munana.
english: It shall happen that instead of sweet spices, there shall be rottenness; instead of a belt, a rope; instead of well set hair, baldness; instead of a robe, a wearing of sackcloth; and branding instead of beauty.

hausa: Sai ’yan’uwansa suka ce masa, “Kana nufin za ka yi mulki a kanmu ke nan? Ko kuwa za ka zama sarki, a bisanmu?” Suka ƙara ƙin jininsa saboda mafarkinsa da kuma abin da ya faɗa.
english: His brothers asked him, “Will you indeed reign over us? Will you indeed have dominion over us?” They hated him all the more for his dreams and for his words.

hausa: Ku ɗauki magana tare da ku ku komo wurin Ubangiji. Ku ce masa, “Ka gafarta mana dukan zunubanmu ka kuma karɓe mu da alheri, don mu iya yabe ka da leɓunanmu.
english: Take words with you, and return to Yahweh. Tell him, “Forgive all our sins, and accept that which is good; so we offer bulls as we vowed of our lips.

hausa: Dan, Yusuf, Benyamin, Naftali, Gad da Asher.
english: Dan, Joseph, Benjamin, Naphtali, Gad, and Asher.

hausa: Mutanen Ai suka juya suka ga hayaƙin birninsu yana tashi sama, amma ba yadda za su iya tsira ta ko’ina, gama Isra’ilawan da suke gudu zuwa cikin jeji suka juya suka fara fafarar waɗanda suke fafararsu.
english: When the men of Ai looked behind them, they saw, and behold, the smoke of the city ascended up to heaven, and they had no power to flee this way or that way. The people who fled to the wilderness turned back on the pursuers.

hausa: A ƙarshe, sai ya aiki ɗansa a wurinsu. Ya ce, ‘Za su girmama ɗana.’
english: But afterward he sent to them his son, saying, ‘They will respect my son.’

hausa: ku da kuke cin naman mutanena, ku feɗe fatar jikinsu kuke kakkarya ƙasusuwansu, kuke yayyanka su gunduwa-gunduwa kamar naman da za a toya, kamar naman da za a sa a dafa.”
english: who also eat the flesh of my people, and peel their skin from off them, and break their bones, and chop them in pieces, as for the pot, and as meat within the cauldron.

hausa: Sa’an nan Yowab ya tafi Geshur ya dawo da Absalom Urushalima.
english: So Joab arose and went to Geshur, and brought Absalom to Jerusalem.

hausa: Sai suka yi kuka ga Ubangiji suka ce, “Ya Ubangiji, in ka yarda kada ka bar mu mu mutu saboda ran mutumin nan. Kada ka yi mana hukuncin masu kisankai, gama kai ne, ya Ubangiji, ka ga ya gamshe ka.”
english: Therefore they cried to Yahweh, and said, “We beg you, Yahweh, we beg you, don’t let us die for this man’s life, and don’t lay on us innocent blood; for you, Yahweh, have done as it pleased you.”

hausa: amma ’yan’uwana waɗanda muka je tare su suka ba da rahoton da ya sa zukatan mutane suka narke don tsoro. Ni kam na bi Ubangiji Allah da dukan zuciyata.
english: Nevertheless, my brothers who went up with me made the heart of the people melt; but I wholly followed Yahweh my God.

hausa: Don a cika maganar da Ubangiji ya yi ta wurin Irmiya, a shekara farko ta Sairus sarkin Farisa, sai Ubangiji ya motsa zuciyar Sairus na Farisa don yă yi shela a dukan masarautarsa, ya kuma sa shi a rubuce cewa,
english: Now in the first year of Cyrus king of Persia, that Yahweh’s word by the mouth of Jeremiah might be accomplished, Yahweh stirred up the spirit of Cyrus king of Persia, so that he made a proclamation throughout all his kingdom, and put it also in writing, saying,

hausa: Laban ya amsa, “Ba al’adarmu ba ce a nan a ba da ’ya ƙarama aure kafin ’yar fari.
english: Laban said, “It is not done so in our place, to give the younger before the firstborn.

hausa: Ban aiki waɗannan annabawa ba, duk da haka sun tafi da saƙonsu; ban yi musu magana ba, duk da haka sun yi annabci.
english: I didn’t send these prophets, yet they ran. I didn’t speak to them, yet they prophesied.

hausa: Saboda haka mutanen da Musa ya aika, su leƙo asirin ƙasar, waɗanda suka komo, suka sa taron jama’a su yi gunaguni a kansa saboda sun kawo rahoto mai banrazana a kan ƙasar,
english: The men whom Moses sent to spy out the land, who returned and made all the congregation to murmur against him by bringing up an evil report against the land,

hausa: Sunan mutumin, Elimelek ne, sunan matarsa Na’omi; sunayen ’ya’yan nan nasu biyu, su ne Malon da Kiliyon. Su Efratawa ne daga Betlehem ta Yahuda. Suka kuwa tafi Mowab suka zauna a can.
english: The name of the man was Elimelech, and the name of his wife Naomi. The names of his two sons were Mahlon and Chilion, Ephrathites of Bethlehem Judah. They came into the country of Moab and lived there.

hausa: Ƙasar da take shan ruwan sama da yake fāɗi a kanta kullum da kuma take ba da hatsin da yake da amfani ga waɗanda ake noma dominsu, takan sami albarkar Allah.
english: For the land which has drunk the rain that comes often on it and produces a crop suitable for them for whose sake it is also tilled, receives blessing from God;

hausa: “Kada zuciyarku ta ɓaci. Ku gaskata da Allah, ku kuma gaskata da ni.
english: “Don’t let your heart be troubled. Believe in God. Believe also in me.

hausa: Zuciyarsa ta duƙufa ga hanyoyin Ubangiji, bugu da ƙari, ya kawar masujadan kan tudu da ginshiƙan Ashera daga Yahuda.
english: His heart was lifted up in the ways of Yahweh. Furthermore, he took away the high places and the Asherah poles out of Judah.

hausa: Shi kuwa da yake jingine kusa da Yesu, ya ce, “Ubangiji, wane ne?”
english: He, leaning back, as he was, on Jesus’ chest, asked him, “Lord, who is it?”

hausa: Mutanen Yusuf suka amsa suka ce, “Ƙasar kan tudu ba ta ishe mu ba, ga kuma Kan’aniyawan da suke zama a filin, da waɗanda suke Bet-Sheyan da ƙauyukanta, da waɗanda suke Kwarin Yezireyel, duk suna da keken yaƙin ƙarfe.”
english: The children of Joseph said, “The hill country is not enough for us. All the Canaanites who dwell in the land of the valley have chariots of iron, both those who are in Beth Shean and its towns, and those who are in the valley of Jezreel.”

hausa: Ga abin da Ubangiji yana cewa, “Dubi yadda ruwaye suna tasowa a arewa; za su zama kogi mai rigyawa. Za su malala a ƙasa da kuma a kan kome da yake cikinta, garuruwa da waɗanda suke zaune a cikinsu. Mutane za su yi kuka; dukan mazaunan ƙasar za su yi kururuwa
english: Yahweh says: “Behold, waters rise up out of the north, and will become an overflowing stream, and will overflow the land and all that is therein, the city and those who dwell therein. The men will cry, and all the inhabitants of the land will wail.

hausa: Bisa ga bishewarsa suke juyawa a kan fuskar duniya, suna yin dukan abin da ya umarce su su yi.
english: It is turned around by his guidance, that they may do whatever he commands them on the surface of the habitable world,

hausa: A shekara ta farko ta mulkin sarki Sairus, sarki ya ba da umarni game da haikalin Allah a Urushalima, ya ce, Bari a sāke gina haikalin yă zama wurin miƙa hadayu, a kuma aza harsashin ginin haikalin. Tsayinsa zai zama ƙafa tasa’in, fāɗinsa kuma kamu tasa’in.
english: In the first year of Cyrus the king, Cyrus the king made a decree: Concerning God’s house at Jerusalem, let the house be built, the place where they offer sacrifices, and let its foundations be strongly laid, with its height sixty cubits and its width sixty cubits;

hausa: Kada ku zama kamar iyayenku da ’yan’uwanku, waɗanda suka yi rashin aminci ga Ubangiji Allah na kakanninsu, har ya mai da su abin tsoro, yadda kuke gani.
english: Don’t be like your fathers and like your brothers, who trespassed against Yahweh, the God of their fathers, so that he gave them up to desolation, as you see.

hausa: Ƙasar gaba ɗaya daga Geba zuwa Rimmon, kudu da Urushalima, za tă zama kamar Araba. Amma Urushalima za tă kasance a wurinta, daga Ƙofar Benyamin zuwa sashen Ƙofa ta Farko, zuwa Ƙofar Kusurwa, daga kuma Hasumiyar Hananel zuwa wurin matsin ruwan inabin sarki.
english: All the land will be made like the Arabah, from Geba to Rimmon south of Jerusalem; and she will be lifted up and will dwell in her place, from Benjamin’s gate to the place of the first gate, to the corner gate, and from the tower of Hananel to the king’s wine presses.

hausa: Amma almajiransa suka ɗauke shi da dare suka saukar da shi a cikin kwando ta taga a katanga.
english: but his disciples took him by night and let him down through the wall, lowering him in a basket.

hausa: Amma yayinda yamma ke gabatowa sai yă wanke kansa, da fāɗuwar rana kuwa sai yă koma cikin sansani.
english: but it shall be, when evening comes, he shall bathe himself in water. When the sun is down, he shall come within the camp.

hausa: Duk wanda ya gaskata da Ɗan yana da rai madawwami, amma duk wanda ya ƙi Ɗan ba zai sami rai ba, gama fushin Allah yana nan a bisansa.”
english: One who believes in the Son has eternal life, but one who disobeys the Son won’t see life, but the wrath of God remains on him.”

hausa: Amma in yana da miki ja-ja da ya yi fari a sanƙonsa ko a goshinsa, cuta mai yaɗuwa ce take fasuwa a kai ko a goshin.
english: But if a reddish-white plague is in the bald head or the bald forehead, it is leprosy breaking out in his bald head or his bald forehead.

hausa: Yayinda Yehu yake hukunta wa gidan Ahab, sai ya sami fadawan Yahuda da kuma ’ya’yan dangin Ahaziya maza, waɗanda suke yi wa Ahaziya hidima, sai ya kashe su.
english: When Jehu was executing judgment on Ahab’s house, he found the princes of Judah and the sons of the brothers of Ahaziah serving Ahaziah, and killed them.

hausa: Yana ba da ceto ga mutanensa; ya kafa alkawarinsa har abada, tsarki da banrazana ne sunansa.
english: He has sent redemption to his people. He has ordained his covenant forever. His name is holy and awesome!

hausa: Dawakansa za su yi yawa har su rufe ke da ƙura. Katanga za su girgiza saboda motsin dawakan yaƙi, kekunan doki da keken yaƙin sa’ad da suka shiga birnin da aka rushe katangar.
english: By reason of the abundance of his horses, their dust will cover you. Your walls will shake at the noise of the horsemen, of the wagons, and of the chariots, when he enters into your gates, as men enter into a city which is broken open.

hausa: Ki ji gargaɗi, ya Urushalima, ko kuwa in juya daga gare ki in mai da ƙasarki kufai don kada wani ya zauna a cikinta.”
english: Be instructed, Jerusalem, lest my soul be alienated from you, lest I make you a desolation, an uninhabited land.”

hausa: Yusuf ya ce masa, “A’a, mahaifina, wannan shi ne ɗan farin; ka sa hannunka na dama a kansa.”
english: Joseph said to his father, “Not so, my father, for this is the firstborn. Put your right hand on his head.”

hausa: sa’an nan za ku yi farin ciki a cikin Ubangiji, zan kuma sa ku a kan maɗaukaka ƙasashe ku kuma yi biki a gādon mahaifinku Yaƙub.” Ni Ubangiji ne na faɗa.
english: then you will delight yourself in Yahweh, and I will make you to ride on the high places of the earth, and I will feed you with the heritage of Jacob your father;” for Yahweh’s mouth has spoken it.

hausa: Duk da haka, jama’ar kowace ƙasa, suka ƙera tasu alloli a garuruwa masu yawa inda suke zaune, suka sa su a masujadan da mutanen Samariya suka gina a kan tuddai.
english: However every nation made gods of their own, and put them in the houses of the high places which the Samaritans had made, every nation in their cities in which they lived.

hausa: ’Ya’yan Kohat maza su ne, Amram, Izhar, Hebron da Uzziyel.
english: The sons of Kohath: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.

hausa: Sai sarki ya ce wa Ziba, “Duk abin da yake na Mefiboshet, ya zama naka.” Ziba ya rusuna ya ce, “Bari in dinga samun tagomashi a gabanka ranka yă daɗe.”
english: Then the king said to Ziba, “Behold, all that belongs to Mephibosheth is yours.” Ziba said, “I bow down. Let me find favor in your sight, my lord, O king.”

hausa: Ba ya barin mugaye da rai sai dai yana ba waɗanda ake tsanantawa hakkinsu.
english: He doesn’t preserve the life of the wicked, but gives justice to the afflicted.

hausa: “ ‘Bayan Banazaren ya aske gashinsa da ya alamta keɓewa, firist zai ɗauki dafaffiyar kafaɗar rago, da ƙosai da kuma waina daga cikin kwando waɗanda duka biyu marar yisti ne, yă sa su a tafin hannun keɓaɓɓen.
english: The priest shall take the boiled shoulder of the ram, one unleavened cake out of the basket, and one unleavened wafer, and shall put them on the hands of the Nazirite after he has shaved the head of his separation;

hausa: “Amma anya, Allah, za ka zauna a duniya? Sammai, har ma da saman sammai ba za tă iya riƙe ka ba, balle wannan haikalin da na gina!
english: But will God in very deed dwell on the earth? Behold, heaven and the heaven of heavens can’t contain you; how much less this house that I have built!

hausa: Sai Ubangiji ya yi juyayi, bai kuwa kawo wa mutanensa bala’in da ya yi niyya ba.
english: So Yahweh turned away from the evil which he said he would do to his people.

hausa: Abram da Nahor suka yi aure. Sunan matar Abram, Saira ne, sunan matar Nahor kuwa Milka; ita ’yar Haran ce, mahaifin Milka da Iska.
english: Abram and Nahor married wives. The name of Abram’s wife was Sarai, and the name of Nahor’s wife was Milcah, the daughter of Haran, who was also the father of Iscah.

hausa: Amma Solomon ne ya gina masa gida.
english: But Solomon built him a house.

hausa: Absalom ya riga ya naɗa Amasa a kan sojoji a maimakon Yowab. Amasa kuwa ɗan wani mutum mai suna Itra ne, mutumin Ishmayel wanda ya auri Abigiyel, ’yar Nahash, ’yar’uwar Zeruhiya mahaifiyar Yowab.
english: Absalom set Amasa over the army instead of Joab. Now Amasa was the son of a man whose name was Ithra the Israelite, who went in to Abigail the daughter of Nahash, sister to Zeruiah, Joab’s mother.

hausa: Sa’an nan Gideyon ya zo ya ce wa mutanen Sukkot, “To, ga Zeba da Zalmunna, waɗanda kuka yi mini ba’a kuna cewa, ‘Ka kama Zeba da Zalmunna ko ne? Me zai sa mu ba mutanenka da suka gaji burodi?’ ”
english: He came to the men of Succoth, and said, “See Zebah and Zalmunna, concerning whom you taunted me, saying, ‘Are the hands of Zebah and Zalmunna now in your hand, that we should give bread to your men who are weary?’”

hausa: Ubangiji ya yi wannan, ya kuma yi kyau a idanunmu’?”
english: This was from the Lord. It is marvelous in our eyes’?”

hausa: “Zan kafa iyakokinku daga Jan Teku zuwa Bahar Rum, daga hamada kuma zuwa Kogi. Zan ba da mazaunan ƙasar a hannunku, za ku kuwa kore su daga gabanku.
english: I will set your border from the Red Sea even to the sea of the Philistines, and from the wilderness to the River; for I will deliver the inhabitants of the land into your hand, and you shall drive them out before you.

hausa: ya yi dakalai goma da kwanoninsu goma;
english: the ten bases; the ten basins on the bases;

hausa: Da Yesu ya sāke ɗaga murya da ƙarfi, sai ya saki ruhunsa.
english: Jesus cried again with a loud voice, and yielded up his spirit.

hausa: Gama kai ne ɗaukakarsu da ƙarfinsu, kuma ta wurin alherinka ka ɗaukaka ƙahonka.
english: For you are the glory of their strength. In your favor, our horn will be exalted.

hausa: An ’yanta ku daga zunubi, kun kuma zama bayi ga aikin adalci.
english: Being made free from sin, you became bondservants of righteousness.

hausa: Sai ya yi kira da babbar murya ya ce, ‘A sare itacen a kuma yayyanka rassansa; a karkaɗe ganyensa a kuma warwatsar da ’ya’yansa. Bari dabbobi su tashi daga ƙarƙashinsa da kuma tsuntsayen da suke a rassansa.
english: He cried aloud and said this: ‘Cut down the tree, and cut off its branches! Shake off its leaves and scatter its fruit! Let the animals get away from under it and the birds from its branches.

hausa: Sa’an nan ta juye a kasko ta ba shi burodin, amma ya ƙi ci. Amnon ya ce, “A sa kowa yă fita daga nan.” Saboda haka kowa ya fita ya bar shi.
english: She took the pan and poured them out before him, but he refused to eat. Amnon said, “Have all men leave me.” Then every man went out from him.

hausa: Sa’an nan ya auna bakin hanyar shiga ya sami fāɗinsa kamu goma, tsawonsa kuma kamu goma sha uku.
english: He measured the width of the opening of the gate, ten cubits; and the length of the gate, thirteen cubits;

hausa: Wanne cikin dukan allolin ƙasashen nan ya iya ceton ƙasarsa daga gare ni? Yaya kuwa Ubangiji zai iya ceci Urushalima daga hannuna?”
english: Who are they among all the gods of these countries that have delivered their country out of my hand, that Yahweh should deliver Jerusalem out of my hand?’”

hausa: Zai daure jakinsa a kuringa, aholakinsa a rassa mafi kyau; zai wanke tufafinsa cikin ruwan inabi rigunansa cikin inabi ja wur kamar jini.
english: Binding his foal to the vine, his donkey’s colt to the choice vine, he has washed his garments in wine, his robes in the blood of grapes.

hausa: Duba ta damata ka gani; babu wanda ya kula da ni. Ba ni da mafaka; babu wanda ya kula da raina.
english: Look on my right, and see; for there is no one who is concerned for me. Refuge has fled from me. No one cares for my soul.

hausa: Ta haka zan aukar wa katangar da hasalata da kuma a kan waɗanda suka yi shafenta da farar ƙasa. Zan ce muku, “Katangar ta fāɗi haka kuma mutanen da suka shafe ta da farar ƙasa,
english: Thus I will accomplish my wrath on the wall, and on those who have plastered it with whitewash. I will tell you, ‘The wall is no more, nor those who plastered it—

hausa: mutanen da na yi saboda kaina don su furta yabona.
english: the people which I formed for myself, that they might declare my praise.

hausa: Ku zo, bari mu rusuna mu yi sujada, bari mu durƙusa a gaban Ubangiji Mahaliccinmu;
english: Oh come, let’s worship and bow down. Let’s kneel before Yahweh, our Maker,

hausa: Saboda haka dukan mutane suka tuttuɓe ’yan kunnensu suka kawo wa Haruna.
english: All the people took off the golden rings which were in their ears, and brought them to Aaron.

hausa: Kalmomin Irmiya ɗan Hilkiya, ɗaya daga cikin firistoci a Anatot a yankin Benyamin.
english: The words of Jeremiah the son of Hilkiah, one of the priests who were in Anathoth in the land of Benjamin.

hausa: Gumaka suna maganganun ruɗu, masu duba suna ganin wahayoyin ƙarya, suna faɗa mafarkan ƙarya suna ba da ta’aziyyar banza. Saboda haka mutane suna yawo kamar tumaki waɗanda suke shan wahala saboda rashin makiyayi.
english: For the teraphim have spoken vanity, and the diviners have seen a lie; and they have told false dreams. They comfort in vain. Therefore they go their way like sheep. They are oppressed, because there is no shepherd.

hausa: Zan kuwa cece ka da wannan birni daga hannun sarkin Assuriya. Zan kiyaye wannan birni.
english: I will deliver you and this city out of the hand of the king of Assyria, and I will defend this city.

hausa: bisa mutanen Dan shi ne, Azarel ɗan Yeroham. Waɗannan su ne shugabanni a bisa kabilan Isra’ila.
english: of Dan, Azarel the son of Jeroham. These were the captains of the tribes of Israel.

hausa: Waɗansu mutane suka kawo masa wani shanyayye, kwance a tabarma. Da Yesu ya ga bangaskiyarsu, sai ya ce wa shanyayyen, “Kada ka damu saurayi, an gafarta maka zunubanka.”
english: Behold, they brought to him a man who was paralyzed, lying on a bed. Jesus, seeing their faith, said to the paralytic, “Son, cheer up! Your sins are forgiven you.”

hausa: Mutanen da suke kwanto suka yi wuf suka ruga cikin Gibeya, suka bazu suka kuma karkashe dukan waɗanda suke a birnin.
english: The ambushers hurried, and rushed on Gibeah; then the ambushers spread out, and struck all the city with the edge of the sword.

hausa: A bikin tuna da ranar haihuwar Hiridus, diyar Hiridiyas ta yi musu rawa ta kuma gamsar da Hiridus ƙwarai,
english: But when Herod’s birthday came, the daughter of Herodias danced among them and pleased Herod.

hausa: “Ku ja dāgā kewaye da Babilon, dukanku waɗanda kuke jan baka. Ku harbe ta! Kada ku rage kibiyoyi, gama ta yi zunubi ga Ubangiji.
english: Set yourselves in array against Babylon all around, all you who bend the bow; shoot at her. Spare no arrows, for she has sinned against Yahweh.

hausa: Erastus ya dakata a Korint, na kuma bar Turofimus cikin rashin lafiya a Miletus.
english: Erastus remained at Corinth, but I left Trophimus at Miletus sick.

hausa: Musa ya sa bagaden zinariya a cikin Tentin Sujada a gaban labulen
english: He put the golden altar in the Tent of Meeting before the veil;

hausa: Bai ba shi gādo a nan ba, ko taki ɗaya na ƙasa. Amma Allah ya yi masa alkawari cewa shi da zuriyarsa masu zuwa bayansa za su mallaki ƙasar, ko da yake a lokacin Ibrahim ba shi da yaro.
english: He gave him no inheritance in it, no, not so much as to set his foot on. He promised that he would give it to him for a possession, and to his offspring after him, when he still had no child.

hausa: Cike da mamaki, suka yi tambaya suna cewa, “Ashe, duk waɗannan mutane masu magana ba Galiliyawa ba ne?
english: They were all amazed and marveled, saying to one another, “Behold, aren’t all these who speak Galileans?

hausa: Amma ku zaɓaɓɓu ne, ƙungiyar firistocin babban Sarki, al’umma mai tsarki, jama’a mallakar Allah, domin ku shaida yabon shi wanda ya kira ku daga cikin duhu zuwa haskensa mai banmamaki.
english: But you are a chosen race, a royal priesthood, a holy nation, a people for God’s own possession, that you may proclaim the excellence of him who called you out of darkness into his marvelous light.

hausa: Ga shi, zan kawo su daga ƙasar arewa in tattara su daga iyakar duniya. A cikinsu makafi da guragu za su kasance, mata masu ciki da matan da suke naƙuda; jama’a mai yawan gaske za su komo.
english: Behold, I will bring them from the north country, and gather them from the uttermost parts of the earth, along with the blind and the lame, the woman with child and her who travails with child together. They will return as a great company.

hausa: Da su da danginsu, dukansu su 288 ne kuma horarru da ƙwararru ne a kaɗe-kaɗe da bushe-bushe domin Ubangiji.
english: The number of them, with their brothers who were instructed in singing to Yahweh, even all who were skillful, was two hundred eighty-eight.

hausa: a shekara ta goma sha takwas ta sarautar Nebukadnezzar, ya tafi da Yahudawa daga Urushalima 832;
english: in the eighteenth year of Nebuchadnezzar, he carried away captive from Jerusalem eight hundred thirty-two persons;

hausa: Saboda haka, ka ba da umarni, a tsare kabarin sai rana ta uku ɗin. In ba haka ba, almajiransa za su iya zuwa su sace jikin, sa’an nan su faɗa wa mutane cewa, an tashe shi daga matattu. Ruɗin ƙarshen nan fa, sai yă fi na farkon muni.”
english: Command therefore that the tomb be made secure until the third day, lest perhaps his disciples come at night and steal him away, and tell the people, ‘He is risen from the dead;’ and the last deception will be worse than the first.”

hausa: Gama in har Allah bai bar rassan nan na asali ba, kai ma ba zai bar ka ba.
english: for if God didn’t spare the natural branches, neither will he spare you.

hausa: Wata rana wajen ƙarfe uku na yamma ya ga wahayi. A sarari ya ga wani mala’ikan Allah, wanda ya zo wajensa ya ce, “Korneliyus!”
english: At about the ninth hour of the day, he clearly saw in a vision an angel of God coming to him and saying to him, “Cornelius!”

hausa: Wanda kuwa ya aiko ni yana tare da ni; bai bar ni ni kaɗai ba, domin kullum ina aikata abin da ya gamshe shi.”
english: He who sent me is with me. The Father hasn’t left me alone, for I always do the things that are pleasing to him.”

hausa: “Me ya sa ba ku ci hadaya don zunubi a cikin wuri mai tsarki ba? Mafi tsaki ne; an ba ku ne don a ɗauke laifin jama’a ta wurin yin kafara saboda su a gaban Ubangiji.
english: “Why haven’t you eaten the sin offering in the place of the sanctuary, since it is most holy, and he has given it to you to bear the iniquity of the congregation, to make atonement for them before Yahweh?

hausa: Waɗansu sun hauro daga garuruwan Tel-Mela, Tel-Harsha, Kerub, Addon da Immer, amma ba su iya nuna cewa iyalansu su zuriyar Isra’ila ce ba,
english: These were those who went up from Tel Melah, Tel Harsha, Cherub, Addon, and Immer; but they could not show their fathers’ houses, nor their offspring, whether they were of Israel:

hausa: Ta haka kuwa za a ceci dukan Isra’ila, kamar yadda yake a rubuce cewa, “Mai ceto zai zo daga Sihiyona; zai kawar da rashin bin Allah daga Yaƙub.
english: and so all Israel will be saved. Even as it is written, “There will come out of Zion the Deliverer, and he will turn away ungodliness from Jacob.

hausa: Saƙona da wa’azina ba su zo cikin hikima da kalmomin lallashi ba, sai dai da nuna ikon Ruhu,
english: My speech and my preaching were not in persuasive words of human wisdom, but in demonstration of the Spirit and of power,

hausa: Shi ne sarki a bisa Yeshurun sa’ad da shugabannin mutane suka taru, tare da kabilan Isra’ila.
english: He was king in Jeshurun, when the heads of the people were gathered, all the tribes of Israel together.

hausa: Ku nemi Ubangiji ku kuma rayu, ko kuwa zai ratsa yă share gidan Yusuf kamar wuta; zai cinye Betel kuwa ba zai sami wanda zai kashe ta ba.
english: Seek Yahweh, and you will live, lest he break out like fire in the house of Joseph, and it devour, and there be no one to quench it in Bethel.

hausa: Ka koya musu dokokinsa da farillarsa, ka kuma nuna musu hanyar rayuwa da ayyukan da za su yi.
english: You shall teach them the statutes and the laws, and shall show them the way in which they must walk, and the work that they must do.

hausa: Na kasance tare da kai duk inda ka tafi, na kuma kawar da dukan abokan gābanka a gabanka. Yanzu zan sa sunanka yă shahara kamar sunayen shahararrun mutanen duniya.
english: I have been with you wherever you went, and have cut off all your enemies from before you. I will make you a great name, like the name of the great ones who are on the earth.

hausa: A can suka dakata don su kwana, suka tafi suka zauna a dandali birnin, amma wani ya shigar da su gidansa da daren.
english: They went over there, to go in to stay in Gibeah. He went in, and sat down in the street of the city; for there was no one who took them into his house to stay.

hausa: Bukki ɗan Yogli, shugaba daga kabilar Dan;
english: Of the tribe of the children of Dan a prince, Bukki the son of Jogli.

hausa: gama da a ce na iya daɗin baki, da wanda ya yi ni ya ɗauke ni daga nan tuntuni.
english: For I don’t know how to give flattering titles, or else my Maker would soon take me away.

hausa: Ke kuma, saboda jinin alkawarina da ke, zan ’yantar da ’yan kurkukunki daga rami marar ruwa.
english: As for you also, because of the blood of your covenant, I have set free your prisoners from the pit in which is no water.

hausa: “Sai maigidansa, ya amsa ya ce, ‘Zan hukunta ka a kan kalmominka, kai mugun bawa! Ashe, ka san cewa ni mai wuyan sha’ani ne, nakan ɗauka abin da ban ajiye ba, ina kuma girbin abin da ban shuka ba?
english: “He said to him, ‘Out of your own mouth I will judge you, you wicked servant! You knew that I am an exacting man, taking up that which I didn’t lay down and reaping that which I didn’t sow.

hausa: Musa ya yi tsammani mutanensa za su gane cewa, Allah yana amfani da shi don yă cece su, amma ba su gane ba.
english: He supposed that his brothers understood that God, by his hand, was giving them deliverance; but they didn’t understand.

hausa: Ni ban isa a ƙara kira na ɗanka ba. Ka mai da ni kamar ɗaya daga cikin bayinka.” ’
english: I am no more worthy to be called your son. Make me as one of your hired servants.”’

hausa: Yezebel matarsa ta ce, “Yaya kake yi kamar ba kai ne sarki Isra’ila ba? Tashi ka ci abinci! Ka yi farin ciki. Zan ba ka gonar inabin Nabot mutumin Yezireyel.”
english: Jezebel his wife said to him, “Do you now govern the kingdom of Israel? Arise, and eat bread, and let your heart be merry. I will give you the vineyard of Naboth the Jezreelite.”

hausa: “Amma talakawansa suka ƙi shi, sai suka aikar da wakilai bayansa, domin su ce, ‘Ba mu son wannan mutum ya zama sarkinmu.’
english: But his citizens hated him, and sent an envoy after him, saying, ‘We don’t want this man to reign over us.’

hausa: Duk mai kunnen ji, yă ji abin da Ruhu yake faɗa wa ikkilisiyoyi.
english: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the assemblies.

hausa: Sa’ad da rassanta suka bushe, sai su kakkarye su mata kuma su zo su yi itacen wuta da su. Gama mutane ne marar azanci; saboda haka Mahaliccinsu bai ji tausayinsu ba, Mahaliccinsu bai nuna musu jinƙai ba.
english: When its boughs are withered, they will be broken off. The women will come and set them on fire, for they are a people of no understanding. Therefore he who made them will not have compassion on them, and he who formed them will show them no favor.

hausa: Yanzu ka fita ka ƙarfafa mutanenka. Na rantse da Ubangiji, in ba ka fita ba, babu mutum guda da za a bari tare da kai a daren nan. Wannan zai fi maka muni fiye da kowace irin masifar da ta auko maka tun ƙuruciyarka har zuwa yanzu.”
english: Now therefore arise, go out and speak to comfort your servants; for I swear by Yahweh, if you don’t go out, not a man will stay with you this night. That would be worse to you than all the evil that has happened to you from your youth until now.”

hausa: Muka aiki Timoti, wanda yake ɗan’uwanmu da kuma abokin aikin Allah a cikin yaɗa bisharar Kiristi, don yă gina ku yă kuma ƙarfafa ku cikin bangaskiyarku,
english: and sent Timothy, our brother and God’s servant in the Good News of Christ, to establish you and to comfort you concerning your faith,

hausa: Kamar furen bi-rana a cikin ƙayayyuwa haka ƙaunatacciyata take a cikin ’yan mata.
english: As a lily among thorns, so is my love among the daughters.

hausa: Ubangiji yana mulki har abada, Allahnki, ya Sihiyona, daga zamani zuwa zamani. Yabi Ubangiji.
english: Yahweh will reign forever; your God, O Zion, to all generations. Praise Yah!

hausa: Ruhu Mai Tsarkin nan shi ne tabbacin da Allah ya yi na cewa zai ba mu kome da ya yi alkawari, har ya sa muka sani nan gaba Allah zai ceci waɗanda suke nasa. Wannan kuwa domin yabon ɗaukakarsa ne.
english: who is a pledge of our inheritance, to the redemption of God’s own possession, to the praise of his glory.

hausa: Na Benyamin su ne, Sallu ɗan Meshullam, ɗan Hodawiya, ɗan Hassenuwa;
english: Of the sons of Benjamin: Sallu the son of Meshullam, the son of Hodaviah, the son of Hassenuah;

hausa: “ ‘Kada ka yi jima’i da ’yar ɗanka ko ’yar ’yarka, wannan zai ƙasƙantar da kai.
english: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your son’s daughter, or of your daughter’s daughter, even their nakedness; for theirs is your own nakedness.

hausa: Akwai ruɗu a zukatan waɗanda suke ƙulla mugunta, amma waɗanda suke aikata alheri za su yi farin ciki.
english: Deceit is in the heart of those who plot evil, but joy comes to the promoters of peace.

hausa: Saboda haka sai ta ce, “Ka sa a ba wa ɗan’uwanka Adoniya, Abishag mutuniyar Shunam tă zama matarsa.”
english: She said, “Let Abishag the Shunammite be given to Adonijah your brother as wife.”

hausa: A shekara ta ashirin da biyar ta zaman bauta, a farkon shekara, a rana ta goma ga wata, a shekara ta goma sha huɗu bayan fāɗuwar birnin Urushalima, a wannan rana ikon Ubangiji ya sauko a kaina ya kuma iza ni.
english: In the twenty-fifth year of our captivity, in the beginning of the year, in the tenth day of the month, in the fourteenth year after the city was struck, in the same day, Yahweh’s hand was on me, and he brought me there.

hausa: Har yaushe, ya Ubangiji za ka yi ta fushi? Har abada ne? Har yaushe kishinka zai yi ta ƙuna kamar wuta?
english: How long, Yahweh? Will you be angry forever? Will your jealousy burn like fire?

hausa: Yini naka ne, dare kuma naka ne; ka kafa rana da wata.
english: The day is yours, the night is also yours. You have prepared the light and the sun.

hausa: “Ka saurara, ya ɗana! Ka saurara, ɗan cikina! Ka saurara, ya ɗan amshin addu’ata!
english: “Oh, my son! Oh, son of my womb! Oh, son of my vows!

hausa: Masu zama a ƙofa suna mini ba’a, na zama waƙa a bakin bugaggu da giya.
english: Those who sit in the gate talk about me. I am the song of the drunkards.

hausa: Wajen tsakar rana kashegari yayinda suke cikin tafiyarsu suna kuma dab da birnin, sai Bitrus ya hau bisan rufin gida yă yi addu’a.
english: Now on the next day as they were on their journey and got close to the city, Peter went up on the housetop to pray at about noon.

hausa: Almajiransa suka yi mamakin kalmominsa. Amma Yesu ya sāke ce musu, “’Ya’yana, yana da wuya fa a shiga mulkin Allah!
english: The disciples were amazed at his words. But Jesus answered again, “Children, how hard it is for those who trust in riches to enter into God’s Kingdom!

hausa: Sai tsoro ya kama su duka, suka yabi Allah, suna cewa, “Babban annabi ya bayyana a cikinmu. Allah ya zo domin yă taimaki mutanensa.”
english: Fear took hold of all, and they glorified God, saying, “A great prophet has arisen among us!” and, “God has visited his people!”

hausa: Kai Ya Ubangiji, ka sa fitilata ta yi ta ci; Allahna ya mai da duhu ya zama haske.
english: For you will light my lamp, Yahweh. My God will light up my darkness.

hausa: Gehazi ya yi gaba, ya shimfiɗa sandan a fuskar yaron, amma babu motsi, babu alamar rai. Saboda haka Gehazi ya koma ya taryi Elisha, ya faɗa masa, “Yaron bai tashi ba.”
english: Gehazi went ahead of them, and laid the staff on the child’s face; but there was no voice and no hearing. Therefore he returned to meet him, and told him, “The child has not awakened.”

hausa: Makiyaya ba za su sami wurin da za su gudu su tafi ba, shugabannin garke ba za su sami wurin kuɓuta ba.
english: The shepherds will have no way to flee. The leader of the flock will have no escape.

hausa: Sa’ad da muka ji haka, sai mu da mutanen da suke can muka roƙi Bulus kada yă je Urushalima.
english: When we heard these things, both we and the people of that place begged him not to go up to Jerusalem.

hausa: Dukan waɗannan mutane suna a ƙarƙashin kulawar mahaifansu don kaɗe-kaɗe da bushe-bushe a cikin haikalin Ubangiji, da ganguna, molaye da garayu, don hidima a gidan Allah. Asaf, Yedutun da Heman suna ƙarƙashin kulawar sarki.
english: All these were under the hands of their father for song in Yahweh’s house, with cymbals, stringed instruments, and harps, for the service of God’s house: Asaph, Jeduthun, and Heman being under the order of the king.

hausa: Kamar yadda na gargaɗe ka sa’ad da zan je Makidoniya, ka zauna can Afisa domin ka umarci waɗansu mutane kada su koyar da ƙa’idodin ƙarya nan gaba
english: As I urged you when I was going into Macedonia, stay at Ephesus that you might command certain men not to teach a different doctrine,

hausa: Ba su yi tambaya, ‘Ina Ubangiji, wanda ya fitar da su daga Masar ya bishe su cikin jeji cikin hamada da kwazazzabai ƙasa mai fări da kuma duhu, ƙasar da ba kowa mai ratsa ta ba kowa kuma mai zama a cikinta?’
english: They didn’t say, ‘Where is Yahweh who brought us up out of the land of Egypt, who led us through the wilderness, through a land of deserts and of pits, through a land of drought and of the shadow of death, through a land that no one passed through, and where no man lived?’

english: Yahweh answered me, “Write the vision, and make it plain on tablets, that he who runs may read it.

english: For who makes you different? And what do you have that you didn’t receive? But if you did receive it, why do you boast as if you had not received it?

english: “Yahweh, the God of Israel says: ‘Like these good figs, so I will regard the captives of Judah, whom I have sent out of this place into the land of the Chaldeans, as good.

english: They traveled from Moseroth, and encamped in Bene Jaakan.

english: they also resorted to a ruse, and went and made as if they had been ambassadors, and took old sacks on their donkeys, and old, torn-up and bound up wineskins,

english: but now I have chosen Jerusalem, that my name might be there; and I have chosen David to be over my people Israel.’

english: For though you have ten thousand tutors in Christ, you don’t have many fathers. For in Christ Jesus, I became your father through the Good News.

english: So David went and took the bones of Saul and the bones of Jonathan his son from the men of Jabesh Gilead, who had stolen them from the street of Beth Shan, where the Philistines had hanged them in the day that the Philistines killed Saul in Gilboa;

hausa: Amma duk sa’ad da ya je gaban Ubangiji don yă yi magana da shi, sai yă tuɓe lulluɓin har sai ya fito. Kuma duk sa’ad da ya fito yă faɗa wa Isra’ilawa abin da aka umarce shi,
english: But when Moses went in before Yahweh to speak with him, he took the veil off, until he came out; and he came out, and spoke to the children of Israel that which he was commanded.

english: They began to accuse him, saying, “We found this man perverting the nation, forbidding paying taxes to Caesar, and saying that he himself is Christ, a king.”

english: You shall couple five curtains by themselves, and six curtains by themselves, and shall double over the sixth curtain in the forefront of the tent.

english: The lowest floor was five cubits wide, and the middle was six cubits wide, and the third was seven cubits wide; for on the outside he made offsets in the wall of the house all around, that the beams should not be inserted into the walls of the house.

english: Boaz said to the elders and to all the people, “You are witnesses today, that I have bought all that was Elimelech’s, and all that was Chilion’s and Mahlon’s, from the hand of Naomi.

hausa: Ban da haka ma, na ji nishe-nishen Isra’ilawa, waɗanda Masarawa suka bautar, na kuma tuna da alkawarina.
english: Moreover I have heard the groaning of the children of Israel, whom the Egyptians keep in bondage, and I have remembered my covenant.

english: For when they are saying, “Peace and safety,” then sudden destruction will come on them, like birth pains on a pregnant woman. Then they will in no way escape.

hausa: Da numfashinsa Allah yana samar da ƙanƙara sai manyan ruwaye su zama ƙanƙara.
english: By the breath of God, ice is given, and the width of the waters is frozen.

hausa: kana ba shi sauƙi a lokacin wahala, sai har an haƙa rami wa mugaye.

english: When therefore he heard that he was sick, he stayed two days in the place where he was.

english: Then Eliphaz the Temanite answered,

english: Let’s go early up to the vineyards. Let’s see whether the vine has budded, its blossom is open, and the pomegranates are in flower. There I will give you my love.

english: After some days Paul said to Barnabas, “Let’s return now and visit our brothers in every city in which we proclaimed the word of the Lord, to see how they are doing.”

english: I did so as I was commanded. I brought out my baggage by day, as baggage for moving, and in the evening I dug through the wall with my hand. I brought it out in the dark, and bore it on my shoulder in their sight.
