hausa: “In kuwa ya zama muna so mu sami zaman marasa laifi a gaban Allah ta wurin dogara ga Kiristi, sa’an nan an same mu mu kanmu ma masu zunubi ne, ashe, ko wannan zai nuna Kiristi yana ƙarfafa zunubi ke nan? A’a, ko kusa!
english: But if while we sought to be justified in Christ, we ourselves also were found sinners, is Christ a servant of sin? Certainly not!

hausa: Zai tā da tuta saboda al’ummai yă kuma tattara masu zaman bauta na Isra’ila; zai tattara mutanen Yahuda da suke a warwatse kusurwoyi huɗu na duniya.
english: He will set up a banner for the nations, and will assemble the outcasts of Israel, and gather together the dispersed of Judah from the four corners of the earth.

hausa: ya sauka zuwa yammancin bakin iyakar Yalfetiyawa har zuwa yankin Bet-Horon wanda yake cikin kwari. Ya zarce kuma zuwa Gezer, ya gangara ya yi ƙarshe a Bahar Rum.
english: and it went down westward to the border of the Japhletites, to the border of Beth Horon the lower, and on to Gezer; and ended at the sea.

hausa: Kada ka razana da yawa sa’ad da mutum ya yi arziki sa’ad da darajar gidansa ta ƙaru;
english: Don’t be afraid when a man is made rich, when the glory of his house is increased;

hausa: Amma wa zai iya gina haikali dominsa, shi wanda sammai, har ma da sama sammai, ba za su iya riƙe shi ba? To, wane ne ni da zan gina haikali dominsa, in ba dai wurin ƙona hadayu a gabansa ba?
english: But who is able to build him a house, since heaven and the heaven of heavens can’t contain him? Who am I then, that I should build him a house, except just to burn incense before him?

hausa: Yaƙub ya yi zama a Masar shekaru goma sha bakwai, yawan shekarunsa duka sun zama ɗari da arba’in da bakwai.
english: Jacob lived in the land of Egypt seventeen years. So the days of Jacob, the years of his life, were one hundred forty-seven years.

hausa: sa’ad da mutum ya yi irin laifin nan, ya kuwa tabbata mai laifi ne, to, sai yă komar da abin da ya ƙwace, ko abin da ya samu ta hanyar zalunci, ko abin da aka ba shi ajiya, ko abin da ya tsinta.
english: then it shall be, if he has sinned, and is guilty, he shall restore that which he took by robbery, or the thing which he has gotten by oppression, or the deposit which was committed to him, or the lost thing which he found,

hausa: Saboda haka, ’yan’uwa tsarkaka, waɗanda suke da rabo a kiran nan na sama, ku kafa tunaninku a kan Yesu, manzo da kuma babban firist wanda muke shaidawa.
english: Therefore, holy brothers, partakers of a heavenly calling, consider the Apostle and High Priest of our confession: Jesus,

hausa: Gama ƙaunarsa da girma take gare mu, amincin Ubangiji kuma madawwami ne har abada. Yabi Ubangiji.
english: For his loving kindness is great toward us. Yahweh’s faithfulness endures forever. Praise Yah!

hausa: ɗan Simeyon, ɗan Yahuda, ɗan Yusuf, ɗan Yonam, ɗan Eliyakim,
english: the son of Simeon, the son of Judah, the son of Joseph, the son of Jonan, the son of Eliakim,

hausa: Idan kowa ya yi muku mugunta, kada ku sāka masa da mugunta. Ku lura don ku aikata abin da kowa zai iya gani cewa daidai ne.
english: Repay no one evil for evil. Respect what is honorable in the sight of all men.

hausa: Zai zama ruhun adalci gare shi wanda yake zaune a kujerar shari’a, wurin samun ƙarfi ga waɗanda suka kori abokan gāban da suka fāɗa musu da yaƙi a ƙofofi.
english: and a spirit of justice to him who sits in judgment, and strength to those who turn back the battle at the gate.

hausa: Ku san cewa Ubangiji shi ne Allah. Shi ne ya yi mu, mu kuwa nasa ne; mu mutanensa ne, tumakin makiyayarsa.
english: Know that Yahweh, he is God. It is he who has made us, and we are his. We are his people, and the sheep of his pasture.

hausa: da kiɗin molo mai tsirkiya goma da kuma ƙarar garaya.
english: with the ten-stringed lute, with the harp, and with the melody of the lyre.

hausa: Sunan Ubangiji hasumiya ce mai ƙarfi; masu adalci kan gudu zuwa wurinta don su zauna lafiya.
english: Yahweh’s name is a strong tower: the righteous run to him, and are safe.

hausa: Amma Adoniya, don tsoron Solomon, ya je ya kama ƙahon bagade ya riƙe.
english: Adonijah was afraid because of Solomon; and he arose, and went, and hung onto the horns of the altar.

hausa: Yoshuwa ɗan Nun da Kaleb ɗan Yefunne waɗanda suke tare da masu leƙo asirin ƙasar, suka yayyage tufafinsu
english: Joshua the son of Nun and Caleb the son of Jephunneh, who were of those who spied out the land, tore their clothes.

hausa: Sa’an nan ɗaya daga cikin kerubobin ya miƙa hannu zuwa wurin wutar da take tsakaninsu. Ya ɗebo wutar daga ciki ya zuba a hannuwan mutumin da yake saye da lilin, shi kuwa ya karɓa ya fita.
english: The cherub stretched out his hand from between the cherubim to the fire that was between the cherubim, and took some of it, and put it into the hands of him who was clothed in linen, who took it and went out.

hausa: Ku ji, ya Isra’ila, ku kuma kula, ku kiyaye su don yă zama muku da lafiya, ku kuma ƙaru sosai a ƙasa mai zub da madara da zuma, kamar dai yadda Ubangiji, Allahn kakanninku ya yi muku alkawari.
english: Hear therefore, Israel, and observe to do it, that it may be well with you, and that you may increase mightily, as Yahweh, the God of your fathers, has promised to you, in a land flowing with milk and honey.

hausa: Kowane itace da irin ’ya’yansa ne ake saninsa. Mutane ba sa tsinke ’ya’yan ɓaure daga ƙaya, ko kuwa ’ya’yan inabi daga sarƙaƙƙiya.
english: For each tree is known by its own fruit. For people don’t gather figs from thorns, nor do they gather grapes from a bramble bush.

hausa: Bayan sun yi masa ba’a, sai suka tuɓe masa rigar, suka sa masa nasa tufafin. Sai suka tafi da shi, domin su gicciye shi.
english: When they had mocked him, they took the robe off him, and put his clothes on him, and led him away to crucify him.

hausa: Kada ku yi wani turare irinsa wa kanku; ku ɗauke shi a matsayi mai tsarki ga Ubangiji.
english: You shall not make this incense, according to its composition, for yourselves: it shall be to you holy for Yahweh.

hausa: ‘Zan kawo masifa a kanka. Zan kawar da zuriyarka, in kuma yanke daga Ahab kowane ɗa namiji na ƙarshe cikin Isra’ila, bawa ko ’yantacce.
english: Behold, I will bring evil on you, and will utterly sweep you away and will cut off from Ahab everyone who urinates against a wall, and him who is shut up and him who is left at large in Israel.

hausa: Sai Fir’auna ya kira Musa da Haruna ya ce, “Ku tafi, ku miƙa hadaya ga Allahnku, a nan a cikin ƙasar.”
english: Pharaoh called for Moses and for Aaron, and said, “Go, sacrifice to your God in the land!”

hausa: Gunki dai, maƙeri kan yi zubinsa, maƙerin zinariya kuma yă ƙera shi da zinariya yă kuma sarrafa masa sarƙoƙin azurfa.
english: A workman has cast an image, and the goldsmith overlays it with gold, and casts silver chains for it.

hausa: Don me mugaye suke rayuwa har su tsufa, suna kuma ƙaruwa da iko?
english: “Why do the wicked live, become old, yes, and grow mighty in power?

hausa: Maganar Ubangiji da ta zo wa Hosiya ɗan Beyeri a zamanin mulkin Uzziya, Yotam, Ahaz da Hezekiya, sarakunan Yahuda, da zamanin mulkin Yerobowam ɗan Yowash sarkin Isra’ila.
english: Yahweh’s word that came to Hosea the son of Beeri, in the days of Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, kings of Judah, and in the days of Jeroboam the son of Joash, king of Israel.

hausa: Matsaran Isra’ila makafi ne, dukansu jahilai ne; dukansu bebayen karnuka ne ba za su iya haushi ba; suna kwance ne kawai suna mafarki, suna son barci ba dama.
english: His watchmen are blind. They are all without knowledge. They are all mute dogs. They can’t bark— dreaming, lying down, loving to slumber.

hausa: su kawo Sarauniya Bashti a gabansa, sanye da rawanin sarautarta, don ta nuna kyanta wa mutane da kuma hakimai, gama ita kyakkyawa ce ƙwarai.
english: to bring Vashti the queen before the king wearing the royal crown, to show the people and the princes her beauty; for she was beautiful.

hausa: A shekara ta fari ta mulkin Belshazar sarkin Babilon, Daniyel ya yi mafarki, wahayoyi kuma suka ratsa tunaninsa a sa’ad da yake a kwance a gadonsa. Sai ya rubuta abin da mafarkin ya ƙunsa.
english: In the first year of Belshazzar king of Babylon, Daniel had a dream and visions of his head while on his bed. Then he wrote the dream and told the sum of the matters.

hausa: Ka zauna tare da ni, kada ka ji tsoro mutumin da yake neman ranka, yana nema raina ma. Ka zauna lafiya tare da ni.”
english: Stay with me. Don’t be afraid, for he who seeks my life seeks your life. You will be safe with me.”

hausa: Ubangiji zai sāka masa saboda jinin da ya zubar, domin ba da sanin mahaifina Dawuda ne ya fāɗa wa mutum biyun nan da takobi ba. Dukansu biyu, Abner ɗan Ner, shugaban mayaƙan Isra’ila, da Amasa ɗan Yeter, shugaban mayaƙan Yahuda, mutane ne mafi kyau da kuma mafi adalci fiye da shi.
english: Yahweh will return his blood on his own head, because he fell on two men more righteous and better than he, and killed them with the sword, and my father David didn’t know it: Abner the son of Ner, captain of the army of Israel, and Amasa the son of Jether, captain of the army of Judah.

hausa: Daga baya ya sāke gina katangar waje na Birnin Dawuda, yamma da maɓulɓular Gihon a cikin kwari, har zuwa mashigin Ƙofar Kifi, ya kuma kewaye tudun Ofel; ya yi ta da tsayi sosai. Ya sa hafsoshin mayaƙa cikin dukan biranen katanga a Yahuda.
english: Now after this, he built an outer wall to David’s city on the west side of Gihon, in the valley, even to the entrance at the fish gate. He encircled Ophel with it, and raised it up to a very great height; and he put valiant captains in all the fortified cities of Judah.

hausa: Yana da shekara talatin da biyu sa’ad da ya zama sarki, ya kuma yi mulki na tsawon shekara takwas a Urushalima.
english: He was thirty-two years old when he began to reign. He reigned eight years in Jerusalem.

hausa: Sai Laban ya ce wa Yaƙub, “Me ke nan ka yi? Ka ruɗe ni, ka kuma ɗauki ’ya’yana mata kamar kamammun yaƙi.
english: Laban said to Jacob, “What have you done, that you have deceived me, and carried away my daughters like captives of the sword?

hausa: Ezra ya iso Urushalima a wata na biyar na shekara ta bakwai na kama mulkin sarkin.
english: He came to Jerusalem in the fifth month, which was in the seventh year of the king.

hausa: ko da yake ba zai iya rabuwa da ita ba, yana kuma ajiye ta a bakinsa,
english: though he spare it, and will not let it go, but keep it still within his mouth,

hausa: Saboda haka yanzu, ku tabbatar da wannan. Za ku mutu ta wurin takobi, yunwa da annoba a wurin da kuke so ku tafi ku zauna.”
english: Now therefore know certainly that you will die by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence in the place where you desire to go to live.”

hausa: Rai madawwami kuwa shi ne, su san ka, Allah makaɗaici mai gaskiya, da kuma Yesu Kiristi, wanda ka aiko.
english: This is eternal life, that they should know you, the only true God, and him whom you sent, Jesus Christ.

hausa: Bai yarda a tattake ’yan kurkuku a ƙasa ba,
english: To crush under foot all the prisoners of the earth,

hausa: Ta haka zan zartar da hukunci a kan Masar, za su kuwa san cewa ni ne Ubangiji.’ ”
english: Thus I will execute judgments on Egypt. Then they will know that I am Yahweh.”’”

hausa: Yesu ya tsawata masa ya ce, “Yi shiru! Fita daga cikinsa!”
english: Jesus rebuked him, saying, “Be quiet, and come out of him!”

hausa: Amma duk al’ummar da ta rusuna da wuyarta a ƙarƙashin karkiyar sarkin Babilon ta kuma bauta masa, zan bar al’ummar ta zauna a ƙasarta ta noma ta, ta kuma zauna a can, in ji Ubangiji.” ’ ”
english: But the nation that brings their neck under the yoke of the king of Babylon and serves him, that nation I will let remain in their own land,’ says Yahweh; ‘and they will till it and dwell in it.’”’”

hausa: Ya kira sammai da suke bisa, da duniya, don yă shari’anta mutanensa.
english: He calls to the heavens above, to the earth, that he may judge his people:

hausa: Zai kuma kawo ɗaya daga kowace a matsayin hadaya, baiko ne ga Ubangiji. Wannan zai zama na firist da ya yafa jinin hadaya ta salama ne.
english: Of it he shall offer one out of each offering for a heave offering to Yahweh. It shall be the priest’s who sprinkles the blood of the peace offerings.

hausa: Da harshe mukan yabi Ubangijinmu da kuma Ubanmu, da shi kuma muke la’antar mutane, waɗanda aka halitta a kamannin Allah.
english: With it we bless our God and Father, and with it we curse men who are made in the image of God.

hausa: Zan komo da Yahuda da Isra’ila daga bauta zan kuma sāke gina su kamar yadda suke a dā.
english: I will restore the fortunes of Judah and Israel, and will build them as at the first.

hausa: Ka yi tambaya, ‘Wane ne wannan da ya ƙi karɓar shawarata shi marar ilimi?’ Ba shakka na yi magana game da abubuwan da ban gane ba, abubuwan ban al’ajabi da sun fi ƙarfin ganewata.
english: You asked, ‘Who is this who hides counsel without knowledge?’ therefore I have uttered that which I didn’t understand, things too wonderful for me, which I didn’t know.

hausa: Sa’ad da ka gama tsarkake shi, sai ka miƙa ɗan bijimi da kuma rago daga cikin garke, dukansu marasa lahani.
english: When you have finished cleansing it, you shall offer a young bull without defect and a ram out of the flock without defect.

hausa: Sai Yesu ya ce musu, “Ai, Ɗan Mutum ne Ubangijin Asabbaci.”
english: He said to them, “The Son of Man is lord of the Sabbath.”

hausa: Karnuka za su ci waɗanda suka mutu na Yerobowam a cikin birni, kuma tsuntsayen sararin sama za su cinye waɗanda suka mutu a jeji. Ni Ubangiji na faɗa!’
english: The dogs will eat whoever belongs to Jeroboam who dies in the city; and the birds of the sky will eat whoever dies in the field, for Yahweh has spoken it.”’

hausa: Yakan ce wa kansa, “Ba abin da zai girgiza ni; kullum zan yi murna ba zan taɓa shiga wahala ba.”
english: He says in his heart, “I shall not be shaken. For generations I shall have no trouble.”

hausa: “Sa’ad da Haruna ya gama yin kafara domin Wuri Mafi Tsarki, Tentin Sujada da kuma bagade, sai yă kawo akuya mai rai.
english: “When he has finished atoning for the Holy Place, the Tent of Meeting, and the altar, he shall present the live goat.

hausa: Sai suka ba wa magina da kafintoci kuɗi, suka ba wa mutanen Sidon da na Taya abinci, da abin sha, da mai, don su kawo itatuwan al’ul a Yaffa daga Lebanon ta teku, yadda Sairus sarkin Farisa ya ba da umarni.
english: They also gave money to the masons and to the carpenters. They also gave food, drink, and oil to the people of Sidon and Tyre to bring cedar trees from Lebanon to the sea, to Joppa, according to the grant that they had from Cyrus King of Persia.

hausa: Wanda ya karɓi irin da ya fāɗi a wuraren duwatsu kuwa, shi ne mutumin da yakan ji maganar, nan da nan kuwa yă karɓe ta da murna.
english: What was sown on the rocky places, this is he who hears the word and immediately with joy receives it;

hausa: Zela, Hayelef, birnin Yebusiyawa (wato, Urushalima), Gibeya da Kiriyat, garuruwa goma sha huɗu ke nan da ƙauyukansu. Wannan shi ne rabon gādon kabilar Benyamin bisa ga iyalansu.
english: Zelah, Eleph, the Jebusite (also called Jerusalem), Gibeath, and Kiriath; fourteen cities with their villages. This is the inheritance of the children of Benjamin according to their families.

hausa: To, fa, sarkin Aram yana yaƙi da Isra’ila. Bayan ya tattauna da hafsoshinsa, sai ya ce, “Zan kafa sansanina a wurin kaza da kaza.”
english: Now the king of Syria was at war against Israel; and he took counsel with his servants, saying, “My camp will be in such and such a place.”

hausa: “Na hallaka waɗansunku kamar yadda na hallaka Sodom da Gomorra. Kuna kama da itace mai cin wutar da na cire daga cikin wuta, duk da haka ba ku juyo gare ni ba,” in ji Ubangiji.
english: “I have overthrown some of you, as when God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah, and you were like a burning stick plucked out of the fire; yet you haven’t returned to me,” says Yahweh.

hausa: Gama sun haura zuwa Assuriya kamar jakin jejin da yake yawo shi kaɗai. Efraim ya sayar da kansa ga maza.
english: For they have gone up to Assyria, like a wild donkey wandering alone. Ephraim has hired lovers for himself.

hausa: ganin haka sai Masarawa suka ƙara musu wahala.
english: The Egyptians ruthlessly made the children of Israel serve,

hausa: Mutum mai ƙarfi zai zama kamar rama, aikinsa kuma kamar tartsatsin wuta; duka za su ƙone tare, ba kuwa wanda zai kashe wutar.”
english: The strong will be like tinder, and his work like a spark. They will both burn together, and no one will quench them.”

hausa: “La’ananne ne macucin da yake da lafiyayyiyar dabba namiji a garkensa wadda ya yi alkawari zai bayar, amma sai ya miƙa hadayar dabba mai aibi ga Ubangiji. Gama ni babban sarki ne, za a kuma ji tsoron sunana a cikin al’ummai,” in ji Ubangiji Maɗaukaki.
english: “But the deceiver is cursed who has in his flock a male, and vows and sacrifices to the Lord a defective thing; for I am a great King,” says Yahweh of Armies, “and my name is awesome among the nations.”

hausa: Kamar yadda girgije yakan ɓace yă tafi, haka mutum yake shige zuwa kabari ba kuwa zai dawo ba.
english: As the cloud is consumed and vanishes away, so he who goes down to Sheol will come up no more.

hausa: Saboda haka ga abin da Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka yana cewa, ‘Domin ku duka kun zama ƙwan maƙera, zan tattara ku a Urushalima.
english: Therefore the Lord Yahweh says: ‘Because you have all become dross, therefore, behold, I will gather you into the middle of Jerusalem.

hausa: Amma domin ina faɗin gaskiya, ba kwa gaskata!
english: But because I tell the truth, you don’t believe me.

hausa: Amma ya zama haka domin Ubangiji ya ƙaunace ku, ya kuma kiyaye rantsuwar da ya yi wa kakanninku da ya fitar da ku da hannu mai ƙarfi, ya kuma cece ku daga ƙasar bauta, daga ikon Fir’auna sarkin Masar.
english: but because Yahweh loves you, and because he desires to keep the oath which he swore to your fathers, Yahweh has brought you out with a mighty hand and redeemed you out of the house of bondage, from the hand of Pharaoh king of Egypt.

hausa: Gama Ɗan Mutum zai zo cikin ɗaukakar Ubansa, tare da mala’ikunsa, sa’an nan zai ba wa kowane mutum lada gwargwadon abin da ya yi.
english: For the Son of Man will come in the glory of his Father with his angels, and then he will give to everyone according to his deeds.

hausa: Kamar beyar da take a laɓe tana jira, kamar zaki a ɓoye,
english: He is to me as a bear lying in wait, as a lion in hiding.

hausa: Sa’ad da suka fita daga haikali zuwa fili na waje inda mutane suke, sai su tuɓe rigunan da suka yi hidima da su su bar su a tsarkakan ɗakuna, su sa waɗansu riguna, don kada su tsarkake mutane ta wurin rigunansu.
english: When they go out into the outer court, even into the outer court to the people, they shall put off their garments in which they minister and lay them in the holy rooms. They shall put on other garments, that they not sanctify the people with their garments.

hausa: Ka cire mini ba’a da reni, gama ina kiyaye farillanka.
english: Take reproach and contempt away from me, for I have kept your statutes.

hausa: (Duk Atenawa da baƙin da suke zama a can suna zaman kashe wando ne kawai kuma ba abin da suke yi sai dai taɗi da kuma jin sababbin ra’ayoyi.)
english: Now all the Athenians and the strangers living there spent their time in nothing else, but either to tell or to hear some new thing.

hausa: Suka tuɓe shi, suka yafa masa wata jar riga.
english: They stripped him and put a scarlet robe on him.

hausa: Bayan an yi waɗannan abubuwa duka, sai shugabanni suka zo wurina suka ce, “Mutanen Isra’ila, har da firistoci da Lawiyawa ba su keɓe kansu daga maƙwabtansu ba, ba su kuma keɓe kansu daga irin rayuwar ƙazantar mutanen ƙasar ba, wato, rayuwar irinta Kan’aniyawa, da Hittiyawa, da Ferizziyawa, da Yebusiyawa, da Ammonawa, da Mowabawa, da Masarawa da Amoriyawa.
english: Now when these things were done, the princes came near to me, saying, “The people of Israel, the priests, and the Levites have not separated themselves from the peoples of the lands, following their abominations, even those of the Canaanites, the Hittites, the Perizzites, the Jebusites, the Ammonites, the Moabites, the Egyptians, and the Amorites.

hausa: Kin bi hanyar ’yar’uwarki; saboda haka zan sa kwaf nata a hannunki.
english: You have walked in the way of your sister; therefore I will give her cup into your hand.’

hausa: Kwando guda yana da ’ya’yan ɓaure masu kyau sosai, kamar waɗanda suka nuna da wuri; ɗayan kwandon kuma yana da ’ya’yan ɓaure marasa kyau, sun yi muni har ba a iya ci.
english: One basket had very good figs, like the figs that are first-ripe; and the other basket had very bad figs, which could not be eaten, they were so bad.

hausa: Da sauƙi za ka iya tabbatar cewa, bai fi kwana goma sha biyu da suka wuce ne na tafi Urushalima, domin yin sujada ba.
english: seeing that you can verify that it is not more than twelve days since I went up to worship at Jerusalem.

hausa: Ba ta rashin ladabi, ba ta sonkai, ba ta da saurin fushi, ba ta riƙe mutum a zuciya.
english: doesn’t behave itself inappropriately, doesn’t seek its own way, is not provoked, takes no account of evil;

hausa: Suka amsa suka ce, “A’a, ranka yă daɗe, bayinka sun zo don saya abinci ne.
english: They said to him, “No, my lord, but your servants have come to buy food.

hausa: Za ku iya cin duk dabbar da take da rababben kofato, wadda kuma take sāke tona abin da suka riga suka haɗiye.
english: Every animal that parts the hoof, and has the hoof split in two and chews the cud, among the animals, you may eat.

hausa: To wani mutum mai suna Ananiyas tare da matarsa Saffiratu, shi ma ya sayar da wata mallakarsa.
english: But a certain man named Ananias, with Sapphira his wife, sold a possession,

hausa: Saboda haka, ya kamata mutane su ɗauke mu a matsayin bayin Kiristi, da kuma a matsayin waɗanda aka ba su amanar asirin abubuwan Allah.
english: So let a man think of us as Christ’s servants and stewards of God’s mysteries.

hausa: sai ya yi annabcinsa ya ce, “Maganar Bala’am ɗan Beyor, saƙon mutumin da idanunsa ke gani sarai,
english: He took up his parable, and said, “Balaam the son of Beor says, the man whose eyes are open says;

hausa: ’Ya’yan maza Reyuwel su ne, Nahat, Zera, Shamma da Mizza.
english: The sons of Reuel: Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah.

hausa: “Gaya wa Isra’ilawa cewa, ‘Sa’ad da waninku ko zuriyarku ya ƙazantu ta wurin taɓa gawa, ko kuwa ya yi tafiya mai nisa, duk da haka zai kiyaye Bikin Ƙetarewa ta Ubangiji.
english: “Say to the children of Israel, ‘If any man of you or of your generations is unclean by reason of a dead body, or is on a journey far away, he shall still keep the Passover to Yahweh.

hausa: Kada mai girma sarki yă damu da jita-jitan nan cewa an kashe dukan ’ya’yan sarki maza. Amnon ne kaɗai ya mutu.”
english: Now therefore don’t let my lord the king take the thing to his heart, to think that all the king’s sons are dead; for only Amnon is dead.”

hausa: “ ‘Waɗannan mutane da baki kawai suke girmama ni, amma zukatansu suna nesa da ni.
english: ‘These people draw near to me with their mouth, and honor me with their lips; but their heart is far from me.

hausa: Ya ce, ‘Dukan shugabannin yaƙina ba sarakuna ba ne?’
english: For he says, “Aren’t all of my princes kings?

hausa: “Ka gaya mana, yaushe waɗannan abubuwa za su faru? Wace alama ce kuma za tă nuna cewa, duk waɗannan suna dab da cikawa?”
english: “Tell us, when will these things be? What is the sign that these things are all about to be fulfilled?”

hausa: In mutum ya yi wa wani laifi Allah yakan kāre shi; amma in mutum ya yi wa Ubangiji zunubi wa zai kāre shi?” Duk da haka, ’ya’yansa ba su kula da gargaɗin mahaifinsu ba, domin nufin Ubangiji ne yă hallaka su.
english: If one man sins against another, God will judge him; but if a man sins against Yahweh, who will intercede for him?” Notwithstanding, they didn’t listen to the voice of their father, because Yahweh intended to kill them.

hausa: A wannan rana, da farko, Dawuda ya sa Asaf da ’yan’uwansa su rera wannan zabura ta yabo ga Ubangiji.
english: Then on that day David first ordained giving of thanks to Yahweh by the hand of Asaph and his brothers.

hausa: Musa fa ya saba ɗaukan tenti yă kafa shi a bayan sansani da ɗan nisa, yana kiransa “Tentin Sujada.” Duk wanda yake neman wani abu daga wurin Ubangiji sai yă tafi Tentin Sujada a bayan sansani.
english: Now Moses used to take the tent and pitch it outside the camp, far away from the camp, and he called it “The Tent of Meeting.” Everyone who sought Yahweh went out to the Tent of Meeting, which was outside the camp.

hausa: Musa ya kasance tare da Ubangiji kwana arba’in da dare arba’in, bai ci ba, bai sha ba. Ya kuma rubuta kalmomin alkawari a kan alluna, wato, dokoki goma.
english: He was there with Yahweh forty days and forty nights; he neither ate bread, nor drank water. He wrote on the tablets the words of the covenant, the ten commandments.

hausa: Tun yana cikin magana da su, sai ga Rahila ta zo da tumakin mahaifinta, gama ita makiyayyiya ce.
english: While he was yet speaking with them, Rachel came with her father’s sheep, for she kept them.

hausa: Amma idan mai dabbar yana a wurin, wanda ya karɓa aron, ba zai biya kome ba. In an yi hayar dabbar ce, to, kuɗin da aka biya na hayar zai zama a madadin rashin.
english: If its owner is with it, he shall not make it good. If it is a leased thing, it came for its lease.

hausa: “Ba za mu saurari saƙon da ka yi mana magana a sunan Ubangiji ba!
english: “As for the word that you have spoken to us in Yahweh’s name, we will not listen to you.

hausa: Ya Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka, mai fansana mai ƙarfi, wanda yake garkuwoyin kaina a ranar yaƙi.
english: Yahweh, the Lord, the strength of my salvation, you have covered my head in the day of battle.

hausa: To, akwai waɗansu kutare huɗu a ƙofar gari. Suka ce wa junansu, “Don me za mu zauna a nan sai mun mutu?
english: Now there were four leprous men at the entrance of the gate. They said to one another, “Why do we sit here until we die?

hausa: ’Ya’yan Amram maza su ne, Haruna da Musa. Haruna shi ne aka keɓe, shi da zuriyarsa har abada, don su tsarkake kayayyakin mafi tsarki, su miƙa hadayu a gaban Ubangiji, su yi hidima a gabansa su kuma furta albarku a cikin sunansa har abada.
english: The sons of Amram: Aaron and Moses; and Aaron was separated that he should sanctify the most holy things, he and his sons forever, to burn incense before Yahweh, to minister to him, and to bless in his name forever.

hausa: Amma waɗansunsu suka ce, “Ai, da ikon Be’elzebub, sarkin aljanu ne, yake fitar da aljanu.”
english: But some of them said, “He casts out demons by Beelzebul, the prince of the demons.”

hausa: Na tara, don wata na tara, shi ne Abiyezer mutumin Anatot, mutumin Benyamin. Akwai mutane 24,000 a sashensa.
english: The ninth captain for the ninth month was Abiezer the Anathothite, of the Benjamites. In his division were twenty-four thousand.

hausa: In bijimin ya kashe bawa ko baiwa, mai shi zai biya shekel talatin na azurfa wa maigidan bawan, a kuma a jajjefe bijimin.
english: If the bull gores a male servant or a female servant, thirty shekels of silver shall be given to their master, and the ox shall be stoned.

hausa: To, me za mu ce ke nan? Mun fi su ke nan? Ina, ko kaɗan! Mun riga mun zartar cewa da Yahudawa da Al’ummai duk suna a ƙarƙarshin zunubi.
english: What then? Are we better than they? No, in no way. For we previously warned both Jews and Greeks that they are all under sin.

hausa: Da manzannin suka dawo, sai suka faɗa wa Yesu abin da suka yi. Sai ya ɗauke su, suka keɓe kansu su kaɗai, zuwa wani gari da ake kira Betsaida.
english: The apostles, when they had returned, told him what things they had done. He took them and withdrew apart to a desert region of a city called Bethsaida.

hausa: Sai ya tashi, ya ɗauki yaron da mahaifiyarsa suka tafi ƙasar Isra’ila.
english: He arose and took the young child and his mother, and came into the land of Israel.

hausa: “Matasa da tsofaffi duk suna kwanciya a cikin ƙurar tituna; an karkashe matasa da ’yan matana da takobi. Ka kashe su a ranar fushinka; ka kashe su ba tausayi.
english: “The youth and the old man lie on the ground in the streets. My virgins and my young men have fallen by the sword. You have killed them in the day of your anger. You have slaughtered, and not pitied.

hausa: Sa’ad da Yaƙub ya sami labari cewa akwai hatsi a Masar, sai ya ce wa ’ya’yansa maza, “Don me kuke duban juna kawai?”
english: Now Jacob saw that there was grain in Egypt, and Jacob said to his sons, “Why do you look at one another?”

hausa: an zāna siffofin kerubobi da na itatuwan dabino. Zānen siffar itacen dabino yana a tsakanin kerub da kerub. Kowane kerub yana da fuska biyu,
english: It was made with cherubim and palm trees. A palm tree was between cherub and cherub, and every cherub had two faces,

hausa: A rana ta farko, za ku yi tsattsarkan taro, ba kuwa za a yi aikin da aka saba yi na kullum ba.
english: In the first day shall be a holy convocation. You shall do no regular work,

hausa: Wanda ya yi shuki don yă gamshi mutuntakarsa, daga wannan mutuntaka zai girbi hallaka. Wanda ya yi shuki domin yă gamshi Ruhu, daga Ruhu zai girbi rai madawwami.
english: For he who sows to his own flesh will from the flesh reap corruption. But he who sows to the Spirit will from the Spirit reap eternal life.

hausa: Kamar yadda aka faɗa cewa, “Yau, in kuka ji muryarsa, kada ku taurare zukatanku kamar yadda kuka yi a tawayen nan.”
english: while it is said, “Today if you will hear his voice, don’t harden your hearts, as in the rebellion.”

hausa: Saboda wannan, hannun kowane mutum zai yi rauni, ƙarfin halin kowane mutum zai kāsa.
english: Therefore all hands will be feeble, and everyone’s heart will melt.

hausa: A Ranar Ubangiji ina cikin Ruhu, sai na ji a bayana wata babbar murya kamar ƙaho,
english: I was in the Spirit on the Lord’s day, and I heard behind me a loud voice, like a trumpet

hausa: “Bari mu tafi wurin zamansa; bari mu yi sujada a wurin sa ƙafafunsa,
english: “We will go into his dwelling place. We will worship at his footstool.”

hausa: Māsu ba su sa ta tă gudu; jifar majajjawa kamar na ciyawa ne gare ta.
english: The arrow can’t make him flee. Sling stones are like chaff to him.

hausa: “Ka faɗa wa Isra’ilawa, ‘Kada ku ci wani kitsen shanu, ko na tumaki, ko kuwa na awaki.
english: “Speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘You shall eat no fat, of bull, or sheep, or goat.

hausa: Bari dukan duniya ta ji tsoron Ubangiji; bari dukan mutanen duniya su girmama shi.
english: Let all the earth fear Yahweh. Let all the inhabitants of the world stand in awe of him.

hausa: Bayan sojojin Babiloniyawa suka janye daga Urushalima saboda sojojin Fir’auna,
english: When the army of the Chaldeans had withdrawn from Jerusalem for fear of Pharaoh’s army,

hausa: Ba mu karɓi ruhun duniya ba, sai dai Ruhun da yake daga Allah, domin mu fahimci abin da Allah ya ba mu hannu sake.
english: But we received not the spirit of the world, but the Spirit which is from God, that we might know the things that were freely given to us by God.

hausa: Mutanen kuwa suka yi juyayi saboda mutanen Benyamin, domin Ubangiji ya yi gibi a cikin kabilan Isra’ila.
english: The people grieved for Benjamin, because Yahweh had made a breach in the tribes of Israel.

hausa: Sa’ad da yunwa ta bazu a dukan ƙasar, sai Yusuf ya buɗe gidajen ajiya, ya kuma sayar da hatsi ga Masarawa, gama yunwa ta yi tsanani a dukan Masar.
english: The famine was over all the surface of the earth. Joseph opened all the store houses, and sold to the Egyptians. The famine was severe in the land of Egypt.

hausa: Ka fitar da mutanenka Isra’ila daga Masar da alamu da abubuwa banmamaki, ta wurin hannu mai iko da kuma hannu mai ƙarfi tare da banrazana mai girma.
english: and brought your people Israel out of the land of Egypt with signs, with wonders, with a strong hand, with an outstretched arm, and with great terror;

hausa: shanu 36,000,
english: thirty-six thousand head of cattle,

hausa: Shi ne zai gina gida domina, zan kuma kafa sarautarsa har abada.
english: He will build me a house, and I will establish his throne forever.

hausa: Wanda tafiyarsa ta aikata gaskiya ce kan ji tsoron Ubangiji, amma wanda hanyoyinsa ba a kan gaskiya ba ne yakan rena shi.
english: He who walks in his uprightness fears Yahweh, but he who is perverse in his ways despises him.

hausa: Ya cika ni da kayan ɗaci ya gundure ni da abinci mai ɗaci.
english: He has filled me with bitterness. He has stuffed me with wormwood.

hausa: Gama in wani wanda lamirinsa ba shi da ƙarfi ya gan ka, kai da kake da wannan sani, kana ci a haikalin gumaka, ashe, ba zai sami ƙarfin halin cin abin da aka miƙa wa gumaka ba?
english: For if a man sees you who have knowledge sitting in an idol’s temple, won’t his conscience, if he is weak, be emboldened to eat things sacrificed to idols?

hausa: Tabbatacce, duk waɗanda suka ƙudura suka tafi Masar su zauna a can za su mutu ta wurin takobi, yunwa da annoba; ba ko ɗayansu zai tsira ko ya kuɓuta wa masifar da zan aukar a kansu.’
english: So will it be with all the men who set their faces to go into Egypt to live there. They will die by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence. None of them will remain or escape from the evil that I will bring on them.’

hausa: Yabi Ubangiji, ku mala’ikunsa, ku jarumawa masu yi masa aiki, waɗanda suke yin biyayya da maganarsa.
english: Praise Yahweh, you angels of his, who are mighty in strength, who fulfill his word, obeying the voice of his word.

hausa: Zan sa masu zaluntarki su ci naman jikinsu; za su bugu da jininsu, sai ka ce sun sha ruwan inabi. Sa’an nan dukan mutane za su sani cewa ni, Ubangiji, ni ne Mai Cetonki, Mai Fansarki, Maɗaukakin nan na Yaƙub.”
english: I will feed those who oppress you with their own flesh; and they will be drunk on their own blood, as with sweet wine. Then all flesh shall know that I, Yahweh, am your Savior and your Redeemer, the Mighty One of Jacob.”

hausa: Amma waɗansu firistoci ne suke harhaɗa kayan yajin.
english: Some of the sons of the priests prepared the mixing of the spices.

hausa: Aikin Lawiyawa shi ne su taimaki zuriyar Haruna a hidimar haikalin Ubangiji; su lura da filaye da kuma ɗakunan da suke gefe, su tsarkake dukan kayayyaki masu tsarki, su kuma yi waɗansu ayyuka a gidan Allah.
english: For their duty was to wait on the sons of Aaron for the service of Yahweh’s house—in the courts, in the rooms, and in the purifying of all holy things, even the work of the service of God’s house;

hausa: Sa’an nan Musa ya yi fili kewaye da tabanakul da kuma bagaden, ya rataye labule a ƙofar shiga filin. Da haka Musa ya gama aikin.
english: He raised up the court around the tabernacle and the altar, and set up the screen of the gate of the court. So Moses finished the work.

hausa: Shi ne zai gina haikalin Ubangiji, za a kuma martaba shi da daraja, zai kuma zauna yă yi mulki a kan kursiyinsa. Zai zama firist a kan kursiyinsa. Kuma a tsakanin biyun za a sami zaman lafiya.’
english: He will build Yahweh’s temple. He will bear the glory, and will sit and rule on his throne. He will be a priest on his throne. The counsel of peace will be between them both.

hausa: Amma yanzu a cikin Kiristi Yesu, ku da dā kuke can da nesa an kawo ku kusa ta wurin jinin Kiristi.
english: But now in Christ Jesus you who once were far off are made near in the blood of Christ.

hausa: Sa’an nan ya ƙi tentunan Yusuf, bai zaɓi kabilar Efraim ba;
english: Moreover he rejected the tent of Joseph, and didn’t choose the tribe of Ephraim,

hausa: Suka tambaye shi suka ce, “Kana jin abin da waɗannan suke faɗa?” Yesu ya amsa ya ce, “I, ba ku taɓa karanta ba cewa, “ ‘Daga leɓunan yara da jarirai kai, Ubangiji, ka shirya wa kanka yabo’?”
english: and said to him, “Do you hear what these are saying?” Jesus said to them, “Yes. Did you never read, ‘Out of the mouth of children and nursing babies, you have perfected praise’?”

hausa: Zan warwatsa dukan waɗanda suke kewaye da shi a dukan fuskokin iska, ma’aikatansa da dukan rundunoninsa, zan fafare su da takobin da aka zāre.
english: I will scatter toward every wind all who are around him to help him, and all his bands. I will draw out the sword after them.

hausa: Ya saki musu fushinsa mai zafi, hasalarsa, zafin rai da kuma ɓacin ransa, ƙungiyar mala’iku masu hallakarwa.
english: He threw on them the fierceness of his anger, wrath, indignation, and trouble, and a band of angels of evil.

hausa: Duba, ina tsaye kusa da wannan rijiya; in wata yarinya ta fito domin tă ɗiba ruwa, wadda in na ce mata, “Ina roƙonki bari in ɗan sha ruwa daga tulunki,”
english: behold, I am standing by this spring of water. Let it happen, that the maiden who comes out to draw, to whom I will say, “Please give me a little water from your pitcher to drink,”

hausa: Sa’ad da kun kai can, za ku iske mutanen suna zama a sake, ƙasar kuwa mai faɗi ce wadda Allah ya sa a hannuwanku, ƙasar da ba tă rasa kome ba.”
english: When you go, you will come to an unsuspecting people, and the land is large; for God has given it into your hand, a place where there is no lack of anything that is on the earth.”

hausa: Duk da haka kun kyauta da kuka yi tarayya da ni cikin wahalolina.
english: However you did well that you shared in my affliction.

hausa: A rana ta biyu suka sāke zaga birnin sau ɗaya, suka kuma koma masauƙinsu. Haka suka yi har kwana shida.
english: The second day they marched around the city once, and returned into the camp. They did this six days.

hausa: Rekem, Irfeyel, Tarala,
english: Rekem, Irpeel, Taralah,

hausa: domin ran kowace halitta yana cikin jini. Shi ya sa na ce wa Isra’ilawa, “Kada ku ci jinin wani halitta, domin ran kowace halitta yana cikin jinin; duk wanda ya ci shi dole a fid da shi.”
english: For as to the life of all flesh, its blood is with its life. Therefore I said to the children of Israel, “You shall not eat the blood of any kind of flesh; for the life of all flesh is its blood. Whoever eats it shall be cut off.”

hausa: A kowane titi kin gina ɗakin tsafi kika kuma wulaƙanta kyanki, kina miƙa jikinki da ƙarin fasikanci ga duk mai wucewa.
english: You have built your lofty place at the head of every way, and have made your beauty an abomination, and have opened your feet to everyone who passed by, and multiplied your prostitution.

hausa: Haka Eleyazar, firist, ya tattara farantan tagulla waɗanda mutanen da aka hallaka suka kawo, ya ƙera murfin bagade da su,
english: Eleazar the priest took the bronze censers which those who were burned had offered; and they beat them out for a covering of the altar,

hausa: Da jin maganganun Bafilistin, sai Shawulu da dukan Isra’ila suka damu suka kuma ji tsoro.
english: When Saul and all Israel heard those words of the Philistine, they were dismayed and greatly afraid.

hausa: Zan tsaya wurin tsarona in kuma zauna a kan katanga; zan jira in ga abin da zai ce mini, da kuma wace amsa zan bayar ga wannan kuka.
english: I will stand at my watch and set myself on the ramparts, and will look out to see what he will say to me, and what I will answer concerning my complaint.

hausa: “Na yi kuka gare ka ya Allah, amma ba ka amsa mini ba. Na tashi tsaye, amma sai ka dube ni kawai.
english: I cry to you, and you do not answer me. I stand up, and you gaze at me.

hausa: Ni kuwa zan yi rubutu a kan allunan nan biyu, kalmomin da suke a alluna na farko, waɗanda ka farfashe. Za a ajiye su a cikin akwatin.”
english: I will write on the tablets the words that were on the first tablets which you broke, and you shall put them in the ark.”

hausa: Sa’an nan Yehoshafat ya miƙe tsaye a taron Yahuda da Urushalima a haikalin Ubangiji a sabon filin
english: Jehoshaphat stood in the assembly of Judah and Jerusalem, in Yahweh’s house, before the new court;

hausa: Dukan matuƙan jirgin suka tsorata, kowannensu kuma ya yi kuka ga allahnsa, suka kuma jefar da kayan jirgi a cikin teku domin su rage nauyin jirgin. Ana cikin haka, ashe, Yunana ya sauka can ƙarƙashin jirgi ya je ya kwanta, yana ta sharar barcinsa.
english: Then the mariners were afraid, and every man cried to his god. They threw the cargo that was in the ship into the sea to lighten the ship. But Jonah had gone down into the innermost parts of the ship and he was laying down, and was fast asleep.

hausa: Lokaci yana zuwa sa’ad da zan rage ƙarfinka da ƙarfin iyalin gidan mahaifinka. Domin kada a sāke samun tsohon mutum a zuriyarka.
english: Behold, the days come that I will cut off your arm and the arm of your father’s house, that there will not be an old man in your house.

hausa: ’Ya’yan Yosiya maza su ne, Yohanan ɗan fari, Yehohiyakim ɗa na biyu, Zedekiya ɗa na uku Shallum ɗa na huɗu.
english: The sons of Josiah: the firstborn Johanan, the second Jehoiakim, the third Zedekiah, and the fourth Shallum.

hausa: Yayinda nake kallo, sai na ji gaggafar da take tashi sama a tsakiyar sararin sama ta yi kira da babbar murya ta ce, “Kaito! Kaito! Kaiton mazaunan duniya, in an yi busan sauran ƙahonin da mala’ikun nan uku suke shirin busawa!”
english: I saw, and I heard an eagle, flying in mid heaven, saying with a loud voice, “Woe! Woe! Woe to those who dwell on the earth, because of the other blasts of the trumpets of the three angels, who are yet to sound!”

hausa: Sai goma daga cikin ’yan’uwan Yusuf suka gangara don su saya hatsi daga Masar.
english: Joseph’s ten brothers went down to buy grain from Egypt.

hausa: Da safe za ku ce, “Da ma yamma ne!” Da yamma kuma ku ce, “Da ma safiya ce!” Saboda tsoron da ya cika zukatanku da kuma abubuwan da idanunku za su gani.
english: In the morning you will say, “I wish it were evening!” and at evening you will say, “I wish it were morning!” for the fear of your heart which you will fear, and for the sights which your eyes will see.

hausa: Daga yamma, mutane za su ji tsoron Ubangiji, daga mafitar rana kuma, za su girmama ɗaukakarsa. Gama zai zo kamar rigyawa mai tsananin gudu cewa numfashin Ubangiji zai tafi tare da shi.
english: So they will fear Yahweh’s name from the west, and his glory from the rising of the sun; for he will come as a rushing stream, which Yahweh’s breath drives.

hausa: A’a, mutum mutumin Yahuda ne in shi mutumin Yahuda ne a zuci; kuma kaciya ita ce kaciya ta zuci, ta wurin Ruhu, ba ta wurin rubutaccen doka ba. Irin wannan mutum yana samun yabo daga Allah ne, ba ɗan adam ba.
english: but he is a Jew who is one inwardly, and circumcision is that of the heart, in the spirit, not in the letter; whose praise is not from men, but from God.

hausa: Suka cinna wa haikalin Allah wuta, suka rurrushe katangar Urushalima; suka ƙone dukan fada, suka kuma lalace kome mai amfani da yake can.
english: They burned God’s house, broke down the wall of Jerusalem, burned all its palaces with fire, and destroyed all of its valuable vessels.

hausa: Amma in da za mu auna kanmu sosai, da ba za mu shiga irin hukuncin nan ba.
english: For if we discerned ourselves, we wouldn’t be judged.

hausa: “Ɗan yisti kaɗan ne yake gama dukan curin burodi.”
english: A little yeast grows through the whole lump.

hausa: Ka kawar da shan kunyar da nake tsoro, gama dokokinka nagari ne.
english: Take away my disgrace that I dread, for your ordinances are good.

hausa: Waɗannan su ne ’ya’yan Isuwa maza (wato, Edom), waɗannan ne manyansu.
english: These are the sons of Esau (that is, Edom), and these are their chiefs.

hausa: Dawuda ya kwashe garkuwoyin zinariyan da shugabannin sojojin Hadadezer suke riƙe, ya kawo su Urushalima.
english: David took the shields of gold that were on the servants of Hadadezer, and brought them to Jerusalem.

hausa: Shebaniya, Yoshafat, Netanel, Amasai, Zakariya, Benahiya da Eliyezer firistoci, su ne za su busa ƙahoni a gaban akwatin alkawarin Allah. Obed-Edom da Yehiya su ma za su zama masu lura da ƙofofi domin akwatin alkawarin.
english: Shebaniah, Joshaphat, Nethanel, Amasai, Zechariah, Benaiah, and Eliezer, the priests, blew the trumpets before God’s ark; and Obed-Edom and Jehiah were doorkeepers for the ark.

hausa: Za su tambayi hanyar zuwa Sihiyona su kuma juya fuskokinsu wajenta. Za su zo su haɗa kansu ga Ubangiji a madawwamin alkawari da ba za a manta da shi ba.
english: They will inquire concerning Zion with their faces turned toward it, saying, ‘Come, and join yourselves to Yahweh in an everlasting covenant that will not be forgotten.’

hausa: Kush da Fut, Lidiya da dukan Arabiya, Libiya da kuma mutanen ƙasar alkawari za su mutu ta wurin takobi tare da Masar.
english: “‘“Ethiopia, Put, Lud, all the mixed people, Cub, and the children of the land that is allied with them, will fall with them by the sword.”

hausa: Sarki ya aika shi tare da Zadok firist, annabi Natan, Benahiya ɗan Yehohiyada, Keretawa, da Feletiyawa, suka sa shi a kan dokin sarki,
english: The king has sent with him Zadok the priest, Nathan the prophet, Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and the Cherethites and the Pelethites; and they have caused him to ride on the king’s mule.

hausa: “Ga abin da Ubangiji Maɗaukaki yana cewa, ‘A wannan wuri, kango da babu mutane ko dabbobi, cikin dukan garuruwansa za a sāke kasance da wurin kiwo don makiyaya su hutar da garkunansu.
english: Yahweh of Armies says: “Yet again there will be in this place, which is waste, without man and without animal, and in all its cities, a habitation of shepherds causing their flocks to lie down.

hausa: To, Amnon yana da wani aboki mai suna Yonadab, ɗan Shimeya, ɗan’uwan Dawuda. Yonadab dai mai wayo ne ƙwarai.
english: But Amnon had a friend whose name was Jonadab the son of Shimeah, David’s brother; and Jonadab was a very subtle man.

hausa: Sai Iliya ya tafi daga can ya sami Elisha ɗan Shafat, yana noma da shanu goma sha biyu masu garman noma, shi kansa yana jan na goma sha biyun. Iliya ya tafi wurinsa ya jefa mayafinsa a kan Elisha.
english: So he departed from there and found Elisha the son of Shaphat, who was plowing with twelve yoke of oxen before him, and he with the twelfth. Elijah went over to him and put his mantle on him.

hausa: Amma na san cewa sarkin Masar ba zai yarda ku tafi ba, sai hannu mai ƙarfi ya tilasta shi.
english: I know that the king of Egypt won’t give you permission to go, no, not by a mighty hand.

hausa: Duk ƙoƙarin kama ta banza ne; ganin ta kawai abin tsoro ne.
english: Behold, the hope of him is in vain. Won’t one be cast down even at the sight of him?

hausa: Hadayar mugaye abin ƙyama ne, balle ma in aka kawo da mugun nufi!
english: The sacrifice of the wicked is an abomination— how much more, when he brings it with a wicked mind!

hausa: Na duba cikinsa na ga dabbobi masu ƙafa huɗu na duniya, da namun jeji, da masu ja da ciki, da kuma tsuntsayen sararin sama.
english: When I had looked intently at it, I considered, and saw the four-footed animals of the earth, wild animals, creeping things, and birds of the sky.

hausa: To, fa, Filistiyawa suka zo suka baje ko’ina a cikin Kwarin Refayim;
english: Now the Philistines had come and spread themselves in the valley of Rephaim.

hausa: A kowane rikicin cin amana da zai shiga tsakanin mutum biyu, ko a kan bijimi, ko jaki, ko tunkiya, ko riga, kai, ko a kan kowane irin abin da ya ɓata, da ma abin da aka samu a hannun wani, in akwai jayayya, za a kawo mutumin a gaban alƙalai. Wanda alƙali ya ce shi ne mai laifi, sai yă biya ɗayan taran da za a yanka, har sau biyu.
english: For every matter of trespass, whether it is for ox, for donkey, for sheep, for clothing, or for any kind of lost thing, about which one says, ‘This is mine,’ the cause of both parties shall come before God. He whom God condemns shall pay double to his neighbor.

hausa: Ku daina dogara ga mutum, wanda numfashi ne kawai yake da shi a hancinsa. Wace daraja gare shi?
english: Stop trusting in man, whose breath is in his nostrils; for of what account is he?

hausa: Wane mutum ne kamar Ayuba, wanda yake shan ba’a kamar ruwa?
english: What man is like Job, who drinks scorn like water,

hausa: “A waccan rana,” in ji Ubangiji, “za ki ce da ni ‘mijina’; ba za ki ƙara ce ni ‘maigidana’ ba.
english: It will be in that day,” says Yahweh, “that you will call me ‘my husband,’ and no longer call me ‘my master.’

hausa: Za ka rayu ta wurin takobi za ka kuwa bauta wa ɗan’uwanka. Amma sa’ad da ka ɓalle, za ka kakkarye karkiyarsa daga wuyanka.”
english: You will live by your sword, and you will serve your brother. It will happen, when you will break loose, that you will shake his yoke from off your neck.”

hausa: waɗanda Nebukadnezzar sarkin Babilon ya kwashe sa’ad da ya kame Yekoniya ɗan Yehohiyakim sarkin Yahuda zuwa zaman bauta daga Urushalima zuwa Babilon tare da dukan manyan mutanen Yahuda da Urushalima,
english: which Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon didn’t take when he carried away captive Jeconiah the son of Jehoiakim, king of Judah, from Jerusalem to Babylon, and all the nobles of Judah and Jerusalem—

hausa: “Zuwa ga mala’ikan ikkilisiya a Lawodiseya, ka rubuta, Waɗannan su ne kalmomina Amin, amintaccen mashaidi mai gaskiya, da kuma mai mulkin halittar Allah.
english: “To the angel of the assembly in Laodicea write: “The Amen, the Faithful and True Witness, the Beginning of God’s creation, says these things:

hausa: Na rantse da kaina,” in ji Ubangiji, “cewa Bozra za tă zama kufai da kuma abin tsoro, abin dariya da abin la’ana; kuma dukan garuruwanta za su kasance kufai har abada.”
english: For I have sworn by myself,” says Yahweh, “that Bozrah will become an astonishment, a reproach, a waste, and a curse. All its cities will be perpetual wastes.”

hausa: Sai mutumin Allah ya tā da murya a kan bagade bisa ga umarnin Ubangiji ya ce, “Ya bagade, bagade! Ubangiji ya ce, ‘Za a haifi ɗa mai suna Yosiya wa gidan Dawuda. A kanka zai miƙa firistoci na masujadai kan tuddai masu miƙa hadayu a nan, za a kuma ƙone ƙasusuwan mutane a kanka.’ ”
english: He cried against the altar by Yahweh’s word, and said, “Altar! Altar! Yahweh says: ‘Behold, a son will be born to David’s house, Josiah by name. On you he will sacrifice the priests of the high places who burn incense on you, and they will burn men’s bones on you.’”

hausa: sai dai na danginsa na kusa, kamar mahaifiyarsa ko mahaifinsa, ɗansa ko ’yarsa, ɗan’uwansa,
english: except for his relatives that are near to him: for his mother, for his father, for his son, for his daughter, for his brother,

hausa: Ubangiji ya yi magana da Musa a Hamadar Sinai, a watan farko na shekara ta biyu bayan fitarsu daga ƙasar Masar. Ya ce,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, in the first month of the second year after they had come out of the land of Egypt, saying,

hausa: Matar ta yi ciki, ta kuwa aika wa Dawuda, tana cewa, “Ina da ciki.”
english: The woman conceived; and she sent and told David, and said, “I am with child.”

hausa: Amma bari masu zunubi su ɓace daga duniya mugaye kuma kada a ƙara ganinsu. Yabi Ubangiji, ya raina. Yabi Ubangiji.
english: Let sinners be consumed out of the earth. Let the wicked be no more. Bless Yahweh, my soul. Praise Yah!

hausa: “Kada ku yi maganar saɓo ga Allah, ko ku la’anta mai mulkin mutanenku.
english: “You shall not blaspheme God, nor curse a ruler of your people.

hausa: Dukan al’ummai za su yi tambaya su ce, “Me ya sa Ubangiji ya yi haka da wannan ƙasa? Me ya jawo wannan fushi mai tsanani haka?”
english: Even all the nations will say, “Why has Yahweh done this to this land? What does the heat of this great anger mean?”

hausa: kun zo ga ikkilisiyar ɗan fari, waɗanda sunayensu suna a rubuce a sama. Kun zo ga Allah, alƙalin dukan mutane, kun kuma zo ga ruhohin mutane masu adalci da aka mai da su cikakku.
english: to the festal gathering and assembly of the firstborn who are enrolled in heaven, to God the Judge of all, to the spirits of just men made perfect,

hausa: Wannan kuwa shi ne alkawarina da su sa’ad da na ɗauke musu zunubansu.”
english: This is my covenant with them, when I will take away their sins.”

hausa: A cikin dangantakarku da juna, ya kamata halayenku su zama kamar na Kiristi Yesu.
english: Have this in your mind, which was also in Christ Jesus,

hausa: wanda na taɓa jin daɗin zumunci da shi sosai yayinda muke tafiya tare a taron jama’a a gidan Allah.
english: We took sweet fellowship together. We walked in God’s house with company.

hausa: Firist ɗin zai karɓi kwandon daga hannuwanku yă sa shi a ƙasa a gaban bagaden Ubangiji Allahnku.
english: The priest shall take the basket out of your hand, and set it down before Yahweh your God’s altar.

hausa: Sa’an nan aka ce mini, “Dole ne ka sāke yin annabci game da mutane masu yawa, al’ummai, harsuna da kuma sarakuna.”
english: They told me, “You must prophesy again over many peoples, nations, languages, and kings.”

hausa: Duk da haka, dole kowannenku yă ƙaunaci matarsa kamar yadda yake ƙaunar kansa, kuma dole matar tă yi biyayya ga mijinta.
english: Nevertheless each of you must also love his own wife even as himself; and let the wife see that she respects her husband.

hausa: ta Bebai 623
english: The children of Bebai, six hundred twenty-three.

hausa: Sa’an nan birnin nan za tă sa in zama sananne, farin ciki, yabo da girma a gaban dukan al’ummai a duniya da suka ji abubuwa masu kyau da na yi mata; za su kuma yi mamaki su kuma yi rawan jiki saboda yalwar wadata da salamar da na ba ta.’
english: This city will be to me for a name of joy, for praise, and for glory, before all the nations of the earth, which will hear all the good that I do to them, and will fear and tremble for all the good and for all the peace that I provide to it.’”

hausa: Gama ya zaɓe mu a cikin Kiristi tun dā can, kafin ma a halicci duniya don mu zama masu tsarki da kuma marasa aibi a gabansa.
english: even as he chose us in him before the foundation of the world, that we would be holy and without defect before him in love,

hausa: Kada fa a ruɗe ku, “Ajiyar mugayen abokai yana ɓata hali mai kyau.”
english: Don’t be deceived! “Evil companionships corrupt good morals.”

hausa: Suna cewa, ‘Don me muka yi azumi, ba ka kuma gani ba? Me ya sa muka ƙasƙantar da kanmu, ba ka kuma lura da wannan ba?’ “Duk da haka a ranar azuminku, kuna yi yadda kuka ga dama kuna kuma zaluntar dukan ma’aikata.
english: ‘Why have we fasted,’ they say, ‘and you don’t see? Why have we afflicted our soul, and you don’t notice?’ “Behold, in the day of your fast you find pleasure, and oppress all your laborers.

hausa: Babu wanda zai shiga haikalin Ubangiji sai firistoci da Lawiyawan da suke a aiki; za su iya shiga domin su tsarkaku ne, amma sauran mutane za su kiyaye abin da Ubangiji ya sa su yi.
english: But let no one come into Yahweh’s house except the priests and those who minister of the Levites. They shall come in, for they are holy, but all the people shall follow Yahweh’s instructions.

hausa: A cikin birnin nan kuwa akwai wani mutum matalauci amma mai hikima, ya kuma ceci birnin ta wurin hikimarsa. Amma ba wanda ya tuna da matalaucin nan.
english: Now a poor wise man was found in it, and he by his wisdom delivered the city; yet no man remembered that same poor man.

hausa: Suka yi haka, da Haruna ya miƙa hannunsa da sandan, ya bugi ƙurar ƙasa, sai ƙwari masu cizo suka fito a kan mutane da dabbobi. Dukan ƙurar, ko’ina a ƙasar Masar ta zama cinnaku.
english: They did so; and Aaron stretched out his hand with his rod, and struck the dust of the earth, and there were lice on man, and on animal; all the dust of the earth became lice throughout all the land of Egypt.

hausa: Saboda haka Yaƙub ya ɗauki dutse ya kafa yă zama al’amudi.
english: Jacob took a stone, and set it up for a pillar.

hausa: Sa’an nan mutane za su ce, “Tabbatacce har yanzu ana sāka wa adalai; tabbatacce akwai Allahn da yake shari’anta duniya.”
english: so that men shall say, “Most certainly there is a reward for the righteous. Most certainly there is a God who judges the earth.”

hausa: Zuriyar Asher bisa ga kabilansu, daga Imna, kabilar Imnawa daga Ishbi, kabilar Ishbiyawa; daga Beriya, kabilar Beriyawa;
english: The sons of Asher after their families: of Imnah, the family of the Imnites; of Ishvi, the family of the Ishvites; of Beriah, the family of the Berites.

hausa: Ka miƙa bijimi ɗaya kowace rana domin hadaya don zunubi ta yin kafara. Ka tsarkake bagade ta wuri yin kafara dominsa, ka shafe shi da mai don ka tsarkake shi.
english: Every day you shall offer the bull of sin offering for atonement. You shall cleanse the altar when you make atonement for it. You shall anoint it, to sanctify it.

hausa: Cikin kwana uku, Fir’auna zai fid da kai, yă rataye ka a kan itace. Tsuntsaye kuwa za su ci naman jikinka.’ ”
english: Within three more days, Pharaoh will lift up your head from off you, and will hang you on a tree; and the birds will eat your flesh from off you.”

hausa: “Magājin wannan sarki zai zama wani mutumin banza wanda ma bai fito daga gidan sarauta ba. Zai taso ba zato ba tsammani, yă ƙwace sarautar ta hanyar zamba.
english: “In his place a contemptible person will stand up, to whom they had not given the honor of the kingdom; but he will come in time of security, and will obtain the kingdom by flatteries.

hausa: Yusuf ya ce musu, “Daidai ne yadda na faɗa muku. Ku ’yan leƙen asiri ne!
english: Joseph said to them, “It is like I told you, saying, ‘You are spies!’

hausa: Suka tsorata, suka ce wa juna, “Wane ne wannan? Har iska da raƙuman ruwa ma suna masa biyayya!”
english: They were greatly afraid and said to one another, “Who then is this, that even the wind and the sea obey him?”

hausa: Duk waɗanda suka taru a nan za su san cewa ba da māshi ko takobi ne Ubangiji yake ceto ba, gama yaƙin nan na Ubangiji ne, shi kuwa zai bashe ku duka a hannuwanmu.”
english: and that all this assembly may know that Yahweh doesn’t save with sword and spear; for the battle is Yahweh’s, and he will give you into our hand.”

hausa: A shekara ta shida, a wata shida a ranar ta biya, yayinda nake zaune a gidana dattawan Yahuda kuma suna zaune a gabana, hannun Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka ya zo a kaina a can.
english: In the sixth year, in the sixth month, in the fifth day of the month, as I sat in my house, and the elders of Judah sat before me, the Lord Yahweh’s hand fell on me there.

hausa: Ku ce wa maigidan, Malam ya aike mu mu ce maka, ‘Ina ɗakin baƙi, inda ni da almajiraina za mu ci abincin Bikin Ƙetarewa?’
english: Tell the master of the house, ‘The Teacher says to you, “Where is the guest room, where I may eat the Passover with my disciples?”’

hausa: Nufin Allah ne a tsarkake ku, cewa ku guje wa fasikanci;
english: For this is the will of God: your sanctification, that you abstain from sexual immorality,

hausa: Sai Ubangiji ya tayar wa Solomon wani abokin gāba, mai suna Hadad, mutumin Edom daga gidan sarautar Edom.
english: Yahweh raised up an adversary to Solomon: Hadad the Edomite. He was one of the king’s offspring in Edom.

hausa: “In ka ga saniyar abokin gābanka, ko jakinsa ya ɓace, ka yi ƙoƙari ka mai da shi wurinsa.
english: “If you meet your enemy’s ox or his donkey going astray, you shall surely bring it back to him again.

hausa: Ahi ɗan Abiyel, ɗan Guni, shi ne kan iyalinsu.
english: Ahi the son of Abdiel, the son of Guni, chief of their fathers’ houses.

hausa: Sai Fir’auna ya ba da umarni wa mutanensa ya ce, “Duk yaron da yake namijin da haka haifa, dole ku jefa shi cikin kogi, amma ku bar yara mata su rayu.”
english: Pharaoh commanded all his people, saying, “You shall cast every son who is born into the river, and every daughter you shall save alive.”

hausa: Ubangiji Allah ya kuma sa kowane irin itace ya tsira daga ƙasa, itace mai kyan gani, mai amfani kuma don abinci. A tsakiyar lambun kuwa akwai itacen rai da kuma itacen sanin abin da yake da kyau da abin da yake mugu.
english: Out of the ground Yahweh God made every tree to grow that is pleasant to the sight, and good for food, including the tree of life in the middle of the garden and the tree of the knowledge of good and evil.

hausa: Sa’an nan ya hau gadon yă kwanta a bisa yaron, ya miƙe a kansa, baki da baki, ido da ido, hannu da hannu. Yayinda ya miƙe kansa a kan yaron, sai jikin yaron ya ɗau ɗumi.
english: He went up and lay on the child, and put his mouth on his mouth, and his eyes on his eyes, and his hands on his hands. He stretched himself on him; and the child’s flesh grew warm.

hausa: Yayinda take addu’a ga Ubangiji, Eli ya lura da bakinta.
english: As she continued praying before Yahweh, Eli saw her mouth.

hausa: murfi na fatun rago wanda aka rina ja, da murfi na fatun shanun teku; da kuma laɓulen
english: the covering of rams’ skins dyed red, the covering of sea cow hides, the veil of the screen,

hausa: Ekron da ƙauyukan da suke kewaye da ita;
english: Ekron, with its towns and its villages;

hausa: Saboda haka Ubangiji zai yanke Isra’ila kai da wutsiya, da reshen dabino da iwa a rana guda;
english: Therefore Yahweh will cut off from Israel head and tail, palm branch and reed, in one day.

hausa: Muddin muna a raye, kullum zaman mutuwa muke yi saboda Yesu, don a bayyana ran Yesu ta wurin jikin nan namu mai mutuwa.
english: For we who live are always delivered to death for Jesus’ sake, that the life also of Jesus may be revealed in our mortal flesh.

hausa: Ka sa gunduwoyin nama a cikinta dukan gunduwoyi masu kyau, cinya da kafaɗa. Ka cika ta da waɗannan ƙasusuwa mafi kyau;
english: Gather its pieces into it, even every good piece: the thigh and the shoulder. Fill it with the choice bones.

hausa: Da daɗewa na zauna a cikin waɗanda suke ƙin salama.
english: My soul has had her dwelling too long with him who hates peace.

hausa: Suna tsammanin mafarkan da suke faɗa wa juna za su sa mutane su manta da sunana, kamar yadda kakanninsu suka manta da sunana ta wurin yin wa Ba’al sujada.
english: They intend to cause my people to forget my name by their dreams which they each tell his neighbor, as their fathers forgot my name because of Baal.

hausa: Saboda ƙishirwa ta kama shi ƙwarai, sai ya ce wa Ubangiji, “Ka ba bawanka wannan babbar nasara. To, sai in mutu da ƙishirwa, har in shiga a hannun marasa kaciyan nan su kashe ni?”
english: He was very thirsty, and called on Yahweh and said, “You have given this great deliverance by the hand of your servant; and now shall I die of thirst, and fall into the hands of the uncircumcised?”

hausa: suka furta cewa, “Wannan mutum ya ce, ‘Ina iya rushe haikalin Allah, in sāke gina shi cikin kwana uku.’ ”
english: and said, “This man said, ‘I am able to destroy the temple of God, and to build it in three days.’”

hausa: duk da haka saboda lahaninsa, ba zai yi kusa da labule, ko yă yi kusa da bagade don kada yă ƙazantar da wuri mai tsarkina. Ni ne Ubangiji wanda yake mai da su masu tsarki.’ ”
english: He shall not come near to the veil, nor come near to the altar, because he has a defect; that he may not profane my sanctuaries, for I am Yahweh who sanctifies them.’”

hausa: Mafiya kyau a cikin mata me ya sa ƙaunataccenki ya fi sauran? Don me kike roƙonmu mu faɗa masa yadda kike ji?
english: How is your beloved better than another beloved, you fairest among women? How is your beloved better than another beloved, that you do so adjure us?

hausa: Amma Ubangiji ya ce wa Ananiyas, “Je ka! Wannan mutum zaɓaɓɓen kayan aikina ne don yă kai sunana a gaban Al’ummai da sarakunansu da kuma a gaban mutanen Isra’ila.
english: But the Lord said to him, “Go your way, for he is my chosen vessel to bear my name before the nations and kings, and the children of Israel.

hausa: Ka san wautata, ya Allah; laifina ba a ɓoye yake daga gare ka ba.
english: God, you know my foolishness. My sins aren’t hidden from you.

hausa: Sa’ad da Asa ya ji waɗannan kalmomin da annabcin Azariya ɗan Oded annabi ya faɗa, sai ya sami ƙarfi hali. Ya kawar da gumaka masu banƙyama daga dukan ƙasar Yahuda da Benyamin da kuma daga garuruwan da ya ci da yaƙi a ƙasar tudu ta Efraim. Ya gyaggyara bagaden Ubangiji da yake a gaban shirayin haikalin Ubangiji.
english: When Asa heard these words and the prophecy of Oded the prophet, he took courage, and put away the abominations out of all the land of Judah and Benjamin, and out of the cities which he had taken from the hill country of Ephraim; and he renewed Yahweh’s altar that was before Yahweh’s porch.

hausa: Mutanen kuwa suka tafi suka bi ta cikin ƙasar, suka bayyana yadda take a rubuce, gari-gari, kashi bakwai, suka koma wurin Yoshuwa a Shilo.
english: The men went and passed through the land, and surveyed it by cities into seven portions in a book. They came to Joshua to the camp at Shiloh.

hausa: Kada wani da yake gona kuma yă komo don ɗaukar rigarsa.
english: Let him who is in the field not return back to get his clothes.

hausa: Sa’an nan Solomon ya tattara zuwa Urushalima dattawan Isra’ila, dukan kawunan kabilu da manyan iyalan Isra’ilawa, don su haura da akwatin alkawarin Ubangiji daga Sihiyona, Birnin Dawuda.
english: Then Solomon assembled the elders of Israel and all the heads of the tribes, the princes of the fathers’ households of the children of Israel, to Jerusalem, to bring up the ark of Yahweh’s covenant out of David’s city, which is Zion.

hausa: Zan hallaka mai mulkinta zan kuma kashe shugabanninta.”
english: and I will cut off the judge from among them, and will kill all its princes with him,” says Yahweh.

hausa: Hagab, Shamlai, Hanan,
english: the children of Hagab, the children of Shamlai, the children of Hanan,

hausa: Saboda haka sai hakimai, da wakilai da gwamnoni, mashawarta da ma’aji da alƙalai, da marubutan alƙalai, da kuma dukan ma’aikatan yankunan suka tattaru domin kaddamar da siffar da Nebukadnezzar ya kafa, suka kuma tsaya a gabansa.
english: Then the local governors, the deputies, and the governors, the judges, the treasurers, the counselors, the sheriffs, and all the rulers of the provinces were gathered together to the dedication of the image that Nebuchadnezzar the king had set up; and they stood before the image that Nebuchadnezzar had set up.

hausa: Maganar Ubangiji ta zo mini cewa,
english: Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

hausa: yă kintsa ku da kowane abu mai kyau domin aikata nufinsa, bari kuma yă aikata abin da zai gamshe shi cikinmu, ta wurin Yesu Kiristi, a gare shi ɗaukaka ta tabbata har abada. Amin.
english: make you complete in every good work to do his will, working in you that which is well pleasing in his sight, through Jesus Christ, to whom be the glory forever and ever. Amen.

hausa: To, mai bashe shi ɗin, ya riga ya shirya alama da su, “Wanda na yi masa sumba, shi ne mutumin; ku kama shi.”
english: Now he who betrayed him had given them a sign, saying, “Whoever I kiss, he is the one. Seize him.”

hausa: Suka ƙulla masa maƙarƙashiya a Urushalima, ya gudu zuwa Lakish, amma suka aika har Lakish aka kashe shi a can.
english: They made a conspiracy against him in Jerusalem, and he fled to Lachish; but they sent after him to Lachish and killed him there.

hausa: Ya bi da Dawuda har zuwa can, sai ga su a baje ko’ina a ƙasa, suna ci, suna sha, suna annashuwa saboda yawan ganimar da suka kwashe daga ƙasar Filistiyawa da ƙasar Yahuda.
english: When he had brought him down, behold, they were spread around over all the ground, eating, drinking, and dancing, because of all the great plunder that they had taken out of the land of the Philistines, and out of the land of Judah.

hausa: Sai mutanen suka ɗauki garin da sun kwaɓa ba yisti a ciki, tare da ƙwaryansu na aikin kwaɓan, suka nannaɗe su a mayafansu, suka rataye a kafaɗunsu.
english: The people took their dough before it was leavened, their kneading troughs being bound up in their clothes on their shoulders.

english: who had been carried away from Jerusalem with the captives who had been carried away with Jeconiah king of Judah, whom Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon had carried away.

english: and two olive trees by it, one on the right side of the bowl, and the other on the left side of it.”

english: I will put hostility between you and the woman, and between your offspring and her offspring. He will bruise your head, and you will bruise his heel.”

english: You who tear yourself in your anger, will the earth be forsaken for you? Or will the rock be removed out of its place?

english: Jehu drew his bow with his full strength, and struck Joram between his arms; and the arrow went out at his heart, and he sunk down in his chariot.

hausa: Shi, da dukan mutanensa suka tashi daga Ba’ala-Yahuda don su hauro da akwatin alkawarin Allah, wanda ake kira da SunanUbangiji Maɗaukaki, wanda yake zama a tsakanin kerubobin da suke a kan akwatin alkawarin.
english: David arose and went with all the people who were with him from Baale Judah, to bring up from there God’s ark, which is called by the Name, even the name of Yahweh of Armies who sits above the cherubim.

english: Solomon made all the vessels that were in Yahweh’s house: the golden altar and the table that the show bread was on, of gold;

hausa: Bai so yă ɗauki akwatin alkawarin Ubangiji yă kasance tare da shi a Birnin Dawuda ba. A maimakon haka sai ya kai shi gidan Obed-Edom mutumin Gat.
english: So David would not move Yahweh’s ark to be with him in David’s city; but David carried it aside into Obed-Edom the Gittite’s house.

hausa: Kai, har da mutumin da ya fi hankali da kuma kirki a cikinku, ba zai ji tausayi ɗan’uwansa, ko matar da yake ƙauna, ko ’ya’yansa da suka ragu ba,
english: The man who is tender among you, and very delicate, his eye will be evil toward his brother, toward the wife whom he loves, and toward the remnant of his children whom he has remaining,

hausa: “Saboda haka ga abin da Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka yana cewa zan komo da Yaƙub daga zaman bauta zan kuma yi wa dukan Isra’ila jinƙai, zan kuma yi kishi saboda sunana mai tsarki.
english: “Therefore the Lord Yahweh says: ‘Now I will reverse the captivity of Jacob and have mercy on the whole house of Israel. I will be jealous for my holy name.

hausa: Amintacciya ƙaunata za tă kasance tare da shi, kuma ta wurin sunana za a ɗaukaka ƙahonsa.
english: But my faithfulness and my loving kindness will be with him. In my name, his horn will be exalted.

hausa: Na ji wani zargin da ka yi mini na reni, kuma yadda na gane, shi ya sa zan ba da amsa.
english: I have heard the reproof which puts me to shame. The spirit of my understanding answers me.

hausa: Suka kāsa yarda da juna suka fara watsewa bayan Bulus ya yi wannan magana guda cewa, “Ruhu Mai Tsarki ya faɗa wa kakannin-kakanninku gaskiya sa’ad da ya ce ta bakin annabi Ishaya cewa,
english: When they didn’t agree among themselves, they departed after Paul had spoken one message: “The Holy Spirit spoke rightly through Isaiah the prophet to our fathers,

english: on the south; all the land of the Canaanites, and Mearah that belongs to the Sidonians, to Aphek, to the border of the Amorites;

hausa: Zan mai da bukukkuwanku na addini su zama makoki kuma dukan waƙoƙinku su zama kuka. Zan sa dukanku ku sa rigunan makoki za ku kuma aske kawunanku. Zan sa wannan lokaci yă zama kamar lokacin da ake makokin ɗan tilon da ake da shi kuma ƙarshenta kamar rana mai ɗaci.
english: I will turn your feasts into mourning, and all your songs into lamentation; and I will make you wear sackcloth on all your bodies, and baldness on every head. I will make it like the mourning for an only son, and its end like a bitter day.

hausa: Sa’an nan kerubobi, tare da da’irori kusa da su, suka buɗe fikafikansu, ɗaukakar Allah kuwa tana a bisansu.
english: Then the cherubim lifted up their wings, and the wheels were beside them. The glory of the God of Israel was over them above.

hausa: Ya kwashi ɗaukan zinariya da azurfa da duk kayan da aka samu a haikalin Ubangiji da kuma ma’ajin fadan. Ya kuma kwashi bayi sa’an nan ya koma Samariya.
english: He took all the gold and silver and all the vessels that were found in Yahweh’s house and in the treasures of the king’s house, the hostages also, and returned to Samaria.

hausa: Suka ce, “Ku zo mu yaƙe su! Mun ga ƙasar tana da kyau sosai. Ba za ku yi wani abu ba? Kada ku yi wata-wata, ku je kun mallaki ƙasar.
english: They said, “Arise, and let’s go up against them; for we have seen the land, and behold, it is very good. Do you stand still? Don’t be slothful to go and to enter in to possess the land.

hausa: Sai ya furta maganarsa ya ce, “Wayyo, wa zai rayu sa’ad da Allah ya yi haka?
english: He took up his parable, and said, “Alas, who shall live when God does this?

hausa: Zadok ɗan Ahitub da Ahimelek ɗan Abiyatar, su ne firistoci; Serahiya kuma sakatare;
english: Zadok the son of Ahitub and Ahimelech the son of Abiathar were priests, Seraiah was scribe,

hausa: Ban yi magana asirce ba, daga wani wuri a ƙasar duhu ba; ban faɗa wa zuriyar Yaƙub, ‘Ku neme ni a banza ba.’ Ni, Ubangiji maganar gaskiya nake yi; na furta abin da yake daidai.
english: I have not spoken in secret, in a place of the land of darkness. I didn’t say to the offspring of Jacob, ‘Seek me in vain.’ I, Yahweh, speak righteousness. I declare things that are right.

hausa: Lawiyawan kuwa su ne, Yeshuwa ɗan Azaniya, da Binnuyi ɗan Henadad, da Kadmiyel,
english: The Levites: Jeshua the son of Azaniah, Binnui of the sons of Henadad, Kadmiel;

hausa: Cikin fushi mai zafi na ɓoye fuskata daga gare ki na ɗan lokaci, amma da madawwamin alheri zan ji tausayinki,” in ji Ubangiji Mai Fansarki.
english: In overflowing wrath I hid my face from you for a moment, but with everlasting loving kindness I will have mercy on you,” says Yahweh your Redeemer.

hausa: Saboda haka Dawuda ya tafi Ba’al-Ferazim, a can ya ci su da yaƙi. Sai ya ce, “Kamar yadda ruwa yakan fasu, haka Ubangiji ya kakkarya abokan gābana a gabana.” Saboda haka aka kira wurin Ba’al-Ferazim.
english: David came to Baal Perazim, and David struck them there. Then he said, “Yahweh has broken my enemies before me, like the breach of waters.” Therefore he called the name of that place Baal Perazim.

hausa: Ya amsa ya ce, “An aiko ni wurin ɓatattun tumakin Isra’ila ne kaɗai.”
english: But he answered, “I wasn’t sent to anyone but the lost sheep of the house of Israel.”

hausa: Babiloniyawan da suke yaƙi da wannan birni za su zo ciki su cinna masa wuta; tare da gidaje inda mutane suka tsokane ni na yi fushi ta wurin ƙona turare a rufin ɗakuna wa Ba’al suka zub da hadayun sha wa waɗansu alloli.
english: The Chaldeans, who fight against this city, will come and set this city on fire, and burn it with the houses on whose roofs they have offered incense to Baal, and poured out drink offerings to other gods, to provoke me to anger.

hausa: Za su zama wuraren mafaka daga hannun mai bin hakki, don kada a kashe mai kisankai, tun ba a kai shi gaban shari’a, a gaban taron jama’a ba.
english: The cities shall be for your refuge from the avenger, that the man slayer not die until he stands before the congregation for judgment.

hausa: Nan da nan mahaifin yaron ya faɗa da ƙarfi ya ce, “Na gaskata, ka taimake ni in sha kan rashin bangaskiyata!”
english: Immediately the father of the child cried out with tears, “I believe. Help my unbelief!”

hausa: Gama a lokacin wahala, zai kiyaye ni lafiya a wurin zamansa; zai ɓoye ni cikin inuwar tabanakul nasa ya kuma sa ni can a bisa dutse.
english: For in the day of trouble, he will keep me secretly in his pavilion. In the secret place of his tabernacle, he will hide me. He will lift me up on a rock.

hausa: Yesu ya amsa ya ce, “A maimakon, masu albarka ne waɗanda suke jin maganar Allah, suna kuma biyayya da ita.”
english: But he said, “On the contrary, blessed are those who hear the word of God, and keep it.”

hausa: ’Ya’yan Eli firist, mutane ne masu mugunta. Ba su ɗauki Ubangiji a bakin kome ba.
english: Now the sons of Eli were wicked men. They didn’t know Yahweh.

hausa: Ganin haka, sai ɗaya daga cikin waɗanda suke tare da Yesu, ya zaro takobinsa ya kai wa bawan babban firist sara, ya fille masa kunne.
english: Behold, one of those who were with Jesus stretched out his hand and drew his sword, and struck the servant of the high priest, and cut off his ear.

hausa: A ranar kuwa mutanen Benyamin dubu ashirin da biyar ne aka kashe, dukansu jarumai.
english: So that all who fell that day of Benjamin were twenty-five thousand men who drew the sword. All these were men of valor.

hausa: Yesu ya zo, ya ɗauki burodin ya ba su, haka kuma kifin.
english: Then Jesus came and took the bread, gave it to them, and the fish likewise.

hausa: Saboda haka Yesu ya ce musu, “Lokacina bai yi ba tukuna; amma a gare ku kowane lokaci daidai ne.
english: Jesus therefore said to them, “My time has not yet come, but your time is always ready.

hausa: Zan fitar da zuriyar Yaƙub, daga Yahuda kuma waɗanda za su mallaki duwatsuna; zaɓaɓɓun mutanena za su gāje su, a can kuma bayina za su zauna.
english: I will bring offspring out of Jacob, and out of Judah an inheritor of my mountains. My chosen will inherit it, and my servants will dwell there.

hausa: Kowannenmu ya yi mafarki a wani dare, kowane mafarki kuma ya kasance da ma’anarsa.
english: We dreamed a dream in one night, he and I. Each man dreamed according to the interpretation of his dream.

hausa: ta Fahat-Mowab (ta wurin Yeshuwa da Yowab) 2,818
english: The children of Pahathmoab, of the children of Jeshua and Joab: two thousand eight hundred eighteen.

hausa: zai buɗu ya hudo; zai yi farin ciki mai girma ya kuma yi sowa don farin ciki. Za a maido wa Lebanon da darajarta, darajar Karmel da Sharon; za su ga ɗaukakar Ubangiji, darajar Allahnmu.
english: It will blossom abundantly, and rejoice even with joy and singing. Lebanon’s glory will be given to it, the excellence of Carmel and Sharon. They will see Yahweh’s glory, the excellence of our God.

hausa: Sa’ad da labarin ya kai wurin Yowab, wanda ya haɗa kai da Adoniya, ko da yake bai haɗa kai da Absalom ba, sai ya gudu zuwa tentin Ubangiji, ya kama ƙahonin bagade ya riƙe.
english: This news came to Joab; for Joab had followed Adonijah, although he didn’t follow Absalom. Joab fled to Yahweh’s Tent, and held onto the horns of the altar.

hausa: Benahiya ɗan Yehohiyada ya amsa wa sarki, ya ce, “Amin! Bari Ubangiji Allah na ranka yă daɗe sarkina, yă tabbatar da haka.
english: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada answered the king, and said, “Amen. May Yahweh, the God of my lord the king, say so.

hausa: Ku ma dole ku ba da shaida, domin kun kasance tare da ni tun daga farko.
english: You will also testify, because you have been with me from the beginning.

english: What do you plot against Yahweh? He will make a full end. Affliction won’t rise up the second time.

english: But the princes of the Philistines were angry with him; and the princes of the Philistines said to him, “Make the man return, that he may go back to his place where you have appointed him, and let him not go down with us to battle, lest in the battle he become an adversary to us. For with what should this fellow reconcile himself to his lord? Should it not be with the heads of these men?

english: Now the first lot came out for Asaph to Joseph; the second to Gedaliah, he and his brothers and sons were twelve;
