english: David went up by the ascent of the Mount of Olives, and wept as he went up; and he had his head covered and went barefoot. All the people who were with him each covered his head, and they went up, weeping as they went up.

hausa: Sa’ad da Yesu ya gama faɗin waɗannan abubuwa, sai ya bar Galili, ya tafi yankin Yahudiya a ɗaya gefen Urdun.
english: When Jesus had finished these words, he departed from Galilee and came into the borders of Judea beyond the Jordan.

hausa: Amma wannan duka ya faru ne don a cika rubuce-rubucen annabawa.” Sa’an nan dukan almajiran suka yashe shi suka gudu.
english: But all this has happened that the Scriptures of the prophets might be fulfilled.” Then all the disciples left him and fled.

hausa: “Wa ya taɓa sanin zuciyar Ubangiji? Ko kuwa yă ba shi shawara?”
english: “For who has known the mind of the Lord? Or who has been his counselor?”

english: If you make me an altar of stone, you shall not build it of cut stones; for if you lift up your tool on it, you have polluted it.

english: If a man walking in a spirit of falsehood lies, saying, “I will prophesy to you of wine and of strong drink,” he would be the prophet of this people.

english: “The voice of a multitude being at ease was with her. With men of the common sort were brought drunkards from the wilderness; and they put bracelets on their hands, and beautiful crowns on their heads.

hausa: Da ku na duniya ne, da ta ƙaunaci abinta. Kamar yadda yake, ku ba na duniya ba ne, na zaɓe ku daga duniya, shi ya sa duniya take ƙinku.
english: If you were of the world, the world would love its own. But because you are not of the world, since I chose you out of the world, therefore the world hates you.

hausa: cikin dukan hanyoyinka ka amince da shi, zai kuwa sa hanyoyinka su miƙe.
english: In all your ways acknowledge him, and he will make your paths straight.

hausa: Duk da haka, Bitrus ya tashi a guje zuwa kabarin. Da ya sunkuya, sai ya ga ƙyallayen lilin kaɗai a kwance. Sai ya koma yana tunani a ransa, a kan abin da ya faru.
english: But Peter got up and ran to the tomb. Stooping and looking in, he saw the strips of linen lying by themselves, and he departed to his home, wondering what had happened.

english: There was war between Rehoboam and Jeroboam continually.

english: Thanksgiving will proceed out of them with the voice of those who make merry. I will multiply them, and they will not be few; I will also glorify them, and they will not be small.

english: After the reading of the law and the prophets, the rulers of the synagogue sent to them, saying, “Brothers, if you have any word of exhortation for the people, speak.”

english: Then we turned, and went up the way to Bashan. Og the king of Bashan came out against us, he and all his people, to battle at Edrei.

english: For he has oppressed and forsaken the poor. He has violently taken away a house, and he will not build it up.

english: Then the king arose, and tore his garments, and lay on the earth; and all his servants stood by with their clothes torn.

hausa: To, akwai wani tulun ruwan tsami ajiye a can, saboda haka suka jiƙa soso da shi, suka soka soson a sandan itacen hizzob, suka kai bakin Yesu.
english: Now a vessel full of vinegar was set there; so they put a sponge full of the vinegar on hyssop, and held it at his mouth.

english: Nethanel the son of Zuar was over the army of the tribe of the children of Issachar.

english: He said to me, “Son of man, these are the men who devise iniquity, and who give wicked counsel in this city;

english: Then David the king went in and sat before Yahweh; and he said, “Who am I, Lord Yahweh, and what is my house, that you have brought me this far?

hausa: Ka kori gwauraye hannu wofi, ka kuma karya ƙarfin marayu.
english: You have sent widows away empty, and the arms of the fatherless have been broken.

hausa: Sa’ad da Laban ya tafi don askin tumakinsa, sai Rahila ta sace gumakan gidan mahaifinta.
english: Now Laban had gone to shear his sheep; and Rachel stole the teraphim that were her father’s.

hausa: Hasalarka ta sha kaina; razanarka ta hallaka ni.
english: Your fierce wrath has gone over me. Your terrors have cut me off.

hausa: Gama Nassi ya ce wa Fir’auna, “Na ɗaga ka saboda wannan manufa, saboda in nuna ikona a cikinka domin kuma a shaida sunana a duniya duka.”
english: For the Scripture says to Pharaoh, “For this very purpose I caused you to be raised up, that I might show in you my power, and that my name might be proclaimed in all the earth.”

hausa: Kuturtar Na’aman zai manne maka da zuriyarka har abada.” Sai Gehazi ya fita daga gaban Elisha a kuturce, fari fat kamar dusar ƙanƙara.
english: Therefore the leprosy of Naaman will cling to you and to your offspring forever.” He went out from his presence a leper, as white as snow.

hausa: Allah yana mulki a bisa al’ummai; Allah yana zama a kan kursiyinsa mai tsarki.
english: God reigns over the nations. God sits on his holy throne.

hausa: Merahiyot mahaifin Amariya, Amariya mahaifin Ahitub,
english: Meraioth became the father of Amariah. Amariah became the father of Ahitub.

english: Then he said, “Go, borrow empty containers from all your neighbors. Don’t borrow just a few containers.

english: and that every tongue should confess that Jesus Christ is Lord, to the glory of God the Father.

english: I have seen his ways, and will heal him. I will lead him also, and restore comforts to him and to his mourners.

hausa: Sai Musa ya bar Fir’auna ya kuma yi addu’a ga Ubangiji.
english: Moses went out from Pharaoh, and prayed to Yahweh.

hausa: “ ‘In mutum ya auri ’ya da mahaifiyarta, mugun abu ne. Da shi da su, dole a ƙone su da wuta, saboda kada mugun abu yă kasance a cikinku.
english: “‘If a man takes a wife and her mother, it is wickedness. They shall be burned with fire, both he and they, that there may be no wickedness among you.

english: But to this day, when Moses is read, a veil lies on their heart.

english: The king of Egypt called for the midwives, and said to them, “Why have you done this thing and saved the boys alive?”

hausa: Ba su san kome ba, ba su fahimci kome ba; an rufe idanunsu don kada su gani, tunaninsu kuma a rufe don kada su fahimta.
english: They don’t know, neither do they consider, for he has shut their eyes, that they can’t see, and their hearts, that they can’t understand.

english: and Baalath, and all the storage cities that Solomon had, and all the cities for his chariots, the cities for his horsemen, and all that Solomon desired to build for his pleasure in Jerusalem, in Lebanon, and in all the land of his dominion.

hausa: Da ya ga Bitrus da Yohanna suna gab da shiga, sai ya roƙe su kuɗi.
english: Seeing Peter and John about to go into the temple, he asked to receive gifts for the needy.

hausa: Kuka tafi wurin Molek da man zaitun kuka kuma riɓaɓɓanya turarenku. Kuka aika jakadunku can da nisa; kuka gangara zuwa cikin kabari kansa!
english: You went to the king with oil, increased your perfumes, sent your ambassadors far off, and degraded yourself even to Sheol.

hausa: Zuriyar Efraim su ne, Shutela, Bered, Tahat, Eleyada, Tahat
english: The sons of Ephraim: Shuthelah, Bered his son, Tahath his son, Eleadah his son, Tahath his son,

hausa: Ku tsaya a waje ku bar mutumin da yake karɓan rancen yă kawo muku abin da zai bayar a matsayin jingina.
english: You shall stand outside, and the man to whom you lend shall bring the pledge outside to you.

hausa: Gama rashin hankalin marasa azanci zai kashe su, rashin kulawar wawaye kuma zai hallaka su;
english: For the backsliding of the simple will kill them. The careless ease of fools will destroy them.

hausa: A bisa dakalin akwai da’irar da ta yi kamar gammo mai zurfi kamar rabin kamu. Abubuwan da suke riƙewa da kuma sassan, an haɗa su da bisa dakalin.
english: In the top of the base there was a round band half a cubit high; and on the top of the base its supports and its panels were the same.

hausa: Da a ce waɗannan mutane suna a ƙarƙashina mana! Da zan hamɓarar da shi. In ce wa Abimelek, ‘Ka tara dukan mayaƙanka!’ ”
english: I wish that this people were under my hand! Then I would remove Abimelech.” He said to Abimelech, “Increase your army and come out!”

hausa: Sa’an nan maƙiyina zai gani yă kuma sha kunya, shi da yake ce da ni “Ina Ubangiji Allahnka?” Zai gani, yă kuma ji kunya. Ko yanzu ma za a tattake shi kamar taɓo a tituna.
english: Then my enemy will see it, and shame will cover her who said to me, “Where is Yahweh your God?” My eyes will see her. Now she will be trodden down like the mire of the streets.

hausa: Sai macen ta bar tulunta na ruwa, ta koma cikin gari ta ce wa mutane,
english: So the woman left her water pot, went away into the city, and said to the people,

hausa: Dole yă biya diyyar tunkiyan nan sau huɗu, domin ya aikata haka ba tausayi.”
english: He must restore the lamb fourfold, because he did this thing and because he had no pity!”

hausa: wanda ya nannaɗe a gabana. A kowane gefensa akwai rubutun kalmomin makoki da kuka da kuma kaito.
english: He spread it before me. It was written within and without; and lamentations, mourning, and woe were written in it.

hausa: in muka jimre, za mu yi mulki tare da shi. In muka yi mūsunsa, shi ma zai yi mūsunmu;
english: If we endure, we will also reign with him. If we deny him, he also will deny us.

hausa: Sai na duba na kuma ji muryar mala’iku masu yawa, yawansu kuwa ya kai dubu dubbai, da kuma dubu goma sau dubu goma. Suka kewaye kursiyin da halittu huɗun nan masu rai da kuma dattawan nan.
english: I looked, and I heard something like a voice of many angels around the throne, the living creatures, and the elders. The number of them was ten thousands of ten thousands, and thousands of thousands,

hausa: Ka kwarara fushinka a kansu; bari fushinka mai zafi yă ci musu.
english: Pour out your indignation on them. Let the fierceness of your anger overtake them.

hausa: Sa’ad da na ce wa mugu, ‘Ya mugun mutum, tabbatacce za ka mutu,’ kai kuma ba ka yi magana don ka juyar da shi daga hanyoyinsa ba, wannan mugun mutum zai mutu domin zunubinsa, zan kuma nemi hakkin jininsa a kanka.
english: When I tell the wicked, ‘O wicked man, you will surely die,’ and you don’t speak to warn the wicked from his way, that wicked man will die in his iniquity, but I will require his blood at your hand.

hausa: Sai ya sakar musu Barabbas. Amma ya sa aka yi wa Yesu bulala, sa’an nan ya ba da shi a gicciye.
english: Then he released Barabbas to them, but Jesus he flogged and delivered to be crucified.

hausa: Yakan biya bukatun mutanen da aka danne ya kuma ba da abinci ga mayunwata. Ubangiji yakan ’yantar da ’yan kurkuku,
english: who executes justice for the oppressed; who gives food to the hungry. Yahweh frees the prisoners.

hausa: A hanyar adalci akwai rai; a wannan hanya akwai rashin mutuwa.
english: In the way of righteousness is life; in its path there is no death.

hausa: Amma Sisera, ya tsere da ƙafa zuwa tentin Yayel, matar Heber Bakene, domin suna da abokantaka da Yabin sarkin Hazor da kuma kabilar Heber Bakene.
english: However Sisera fled away on his feet to the tent of Jael the wife of Heber the Kenite; for there was peace between Jabin the king of Hazor and the house of Heber the Kenite.

hausa: Suna zuba ido a bisa, zuwa cikin sararin sama yayinda yake tafiya, nan da nan, sai ga mutane biyu saye da fararen riguna tsaye kusa da su.
english: While they were looking steadfastly into the sky as he went, behold, two men stood by them in white clothing,

hausa: Yakan ba da bashi da ruwa ya kuma karɓi riba mai yawa. Irin wannan mutum zai rayu? Ba zai rayu ba! Domin ya aikata dukan waɗannan abubuwa masu banƙyama, tabbatacce za a kashe shi, kuma hakkin jininsa zai zauna a kansa.
english: has lent with interest, and has taken increase from the poor, shall he then live? He shall not live. He has done all these abominations. He shall surely die. His blood will be on him.

hausa: Ina misalin ayyukanka, ya Ubangiji, tunaninka da zurfi suke ƙwarai!
english: How great are your works, Yahweh! Your thoughts are very deep.

hausa: sunan tauraron kuwa Maɗaci. Kashi ɗaya bisa uku na ruwaye ya zama mai ɗaci, mutane da yawa kuma suka mutu saboda shan ruwan, don ɗacinsa.
english: The name of the star is “Wormwood.” One third of the waters became wormwood. Many people died from the waters, because they were made bitter.

hausa: ’Ya’yanta sukan tashi su ce da ita mai albarka; haka mijinta ma, yakan kuma yabe ta yana cewa,
english: Her children rise up and call her blessed. Her husband also praises her:

hausa: “Ku duba yanzu cewa ni ne Shi! Ba wani allah in ban da ni. Nakan kashe in kuma rayar, nakan sa rauni in kuma warkar, ba wanda yake da iko yă cece wani daga hannuna.
english: “See now that I myself am he. There is no god with me. I kill and I make alive. I wound and I heal. There is no one who can deliver out of my hand.

hausa: Ka mai da shi mai mulki bisa ayyukan hannuwanka; ka sa kome a ƙarƙashin ƙafafunsa,
english: You make him ruler over the works of your hands. You have put all things under his feet:

hausa: Ya yi haka domin dukan baƙin matansa, waɗanda suka ƙone turare suka kuma miƙa hadayu ga allolinsu.
english: So he did for all his foreign wives, who burned incense and sacrificed to their gods.

hausa: Yowash yana da shekara goma sha bakwai sa’ad da ya zama sarki, ya kuma yi sarauta a Urushalima shekara arba’in. Sunan mahaifiyarsa Zibiya ce; ita daga Beyersheba.
english: Joash was seven years old when he began to reign, and he reigned forty years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Zibiah, of Beersheba.

hausa: Mun tsira kamar tsuntsu daga tarkon mai farauta; an tsinke tarko, muka kuwa tsira.
english: Our soul has escaped like a bird out of the fowler’s snare. The snare is broken, and we have escaped.

hausa: “Mutanena sun zama ɓatattun tumaki; makiyayansu sun bauɗar da su suka sa suna ta yawo a cikin duwatsu. Sun yi ta yawo a bisa dutse da tudu suka manta wurin hutunsu.
english: My people have been lost sheep. Their shepherds have caused them to go astray. They have turned them away on the mountains. They have gone from mountain to hill. They have forgotten their resting place.

hausa: Sai ta nausa ta yi wajen arewa, zuwa En Shemesh, ta ci gaba zuwa Gelilot, wanda yake fuskantar hawan Adummim. Daga can ta gangara zuwa Dutsen Bohan, ɗan Ruben.
english: It extended northward, went out at En Shemesh, and went out to Geliloth, which is opposite the ascent of Adummim. It went down to the stone of Bohan the son of Reuben.

hausa: Yohiyada shi ne mahaifin Yonatan, Yonatan kuma mahaifin Yadduwa.
english: and Joiada became the father of Jonathan, and Jonathan became the father of Jaddua.

hausa: Sama’ila ya ce, “Ka yi wauta da ba ka bi umarnin da Ubangiji Allahnka ya ba ka ba. Da ka yi haka da Ubangiji ya tabbatar maka da sarautar Isra’ila har abada.
english: Samuel said to Saul, “You have done foolishly. You have not kept the commandment of Yahweh your God, which he commanded you; for now Yahweh would have established your kingdom on Israel forever.

hausa: Mutum mai hikima yana da iko sosai, kuma mutum mai sani yakan ƙaru da ƙarfi;
english: A wise man has great power. A knowledgeable man increases strength,

hausa: Dawuda ya ce wa Abiyatar, “Lalle a wancan ranar, sa’ad da na ga Doyeg mutumin Edom a can, na san tabbatacce zai gaya wa sarki. Ni ne sanadin mutuwar dukan iyalin mahaifinka.
english: David said to Abiathar, “I knew on that day, when Doeg the Edomite was there, that he would surely tell Saul. I am responsible for the death of all the persons of your father’s house.

hausa: Sa’ad da Kenan ya yi shekara 70, sai ya haifi Mahalalel.
english: Kenan lived seventy years, then became the father of Mahalalel.

hausa: Yanzu Kan’aniyawa da sauran jama’a za su ji, za su zo su kewaye mu su share sunanmu daga duniya. To, yanzu me za ka yi don girman sunanka?”
english: For the Canaanites and all the inhabitants of the land will hear of it, and will surround us, and cut off our name from the earth. What will you do for your great name?”

hausa: Maganar Ubangiji ta zo wa Yunana ɗan Amittai cewa,
english: Now Yahweh’s word came to Jonah the son of Amittai, saying,

hausa: Suka ɗauke shi zuwa ƙasar Kan’ana suka kuma binne shi a kogon da yake cikin filin Makfela, kusa da Mamre, wanda Ibrahim ya saya tare da filin, ya zama makabarta daga Efron mutumin Hitti.
english: for his sons carried him into the land of Canaan, and buried him in the cave of the field of Machpelah, which Abraham bought with the field, as a possession for a burial site, from Ephron the Hittite, near Mamre.

hausa: In ka aikata dukan abin da na umarce ka, ka yi tafiya a hanyoyina, ka kuma yi abin da yake daidai a idanuna ta wurin kiyaye farillaina da umarnaina, kamar yadda Dawuda bawana ya yi, zan kasance tare da kai. Zan gina maka masarauta mai dawwama kamar wadda na gina wa Dawuda, zan kuma ba da Isra’ila gare ka.
english: It shall be, if you will listen to all that I command you, and will walk in my ways, and do that which is right in my eyes, to keep my statutes and my commandments, as David my servant did, that I will be with you, and will build you a sure house, as I built for David, and will give Israel to you.

hausa: “Ubangiji ya ƙi duk mayaƙan da suke tare da ni; ya sa wata runduna ta tayar mini ta kuma tattake samarina. Ubangiji ya tattake budurwa Diyar Yahuda kamar ’ya’yan inabi a wurin matsewa.
english: “The Lord has set at nothing all my mighty men within me. He has called a solemn assembly against me to crush my young men. The Lord has trodden the virgin daughter of Judah as in a wine press.

hausa: Da ba don Allah na mahaifina, Allah na Ibrahim da kuma Tsoron Ishaku ya kasance tare da ni ba, tabbatacce da ka sallame ni hannu wofi. Amma Allah ya ga wahalata da famar hannuwana, ya kuwa tsawata maka da dare jiya.”
english: Unless the God of my father, the God of Abraham, and the fear of Isaac, had been with me, surely now you would have sent me away empty. God has seen my affliction and the labor of my hands, and rebuked you last night.”

hausa: Wanda ya ƙosar da kai da abubuwa masu kyau domin a sabunta ƙuruciyarka kamar na gaggafa.
english: who satisfies your desire with good things, so that your youth is renewed like the eagle’s.

hausa: Ya amsa ya ce, “Ba daidai ba ne a ɗauki abincin yara a jefa wa karnukansu.”
english: But he answered, “It is not appropriate to take the children’s bread and throw it to the dogs.”

hausa: daga zuriyar Zattu, Shekaniya ɗan Yahaziyel ne shugaba, tare da shi akwai mutum 300;
english: Of the sons of Shecaniah, the son of Jahaziel; and with him three hundred males.

hausa: “Saboda haka ina sāke tuhumarku,” in ji Ubangiji. “Zan kuma tuhumi ’ya’ya ’ya’yanku.
english: “Therefore I will yet contend with you,” says Yahweh, “and I will contend with your children’s children.

hausa: Wajen maza dubu huɗu ne suka kasance. Da ya sallame su,
english: Those who had eaten were about four thousand. Then he sent them away.

hausa: Yakan ka da itacen saifires, ko kuwa ya ɗauki saifires ko oak. Yă bar shi yă yi girma a cikin itatuwan kurmi, ko yă shuka itacen fir, ruwan sama kuma yă sa yă yi girma.
english: He cuts down cedars for himself, and takes the cypress and the oak, and strengthens for himself one among the trees of the forest. He plants a cypress tree, and the rain nourishes it.

hausa: Zuriyar Yahuda bisa ga kabilansu, daga Shela, kabilar Shelayawa daga Ferez, kabilar Ferezawa; daga Zera, kabilar Zerawa;
english: The sons of Judah after their families were: of Shelah, the family of the Shelanites; of Perez, the family of the Perezites; of Zerah, the family of the Zerahites.

hausa: Za a gafarta wa dukan jama’ar Isra’ilawa, da baƙin da suke zama a cikinsu, gama duk laifin da aka yi da rashin sani, yakan shafi dukan mutane.
english: All the congregation of the children of Israel shall be forgiven, as well as the stranger who lives as a foreigner among them; for with regard to all the people, it was done unwittingly.

hausa: Game da waɗanda aka ɗauka a dā a kan su wani abu ne, ko wane ne su, duk ɗaya ne a wurina; gama Allah ba ya nuna bambanci, ina dai gaya muku waɗannan da suke wani abu ne a dā, ba su ƙara mini kome ba.
english: But from those who were reputed to be important—whatever they were, it makes no difference to me; God doesn’t show partiality to man—they, I say, who were respected imparted nothing to me,

hausa: Baranyar Rahila ta sāke yin ciki ta kuma haifi wa Yaƙub ɗa na biyu.
english: Bilhah, Rachel’s servant, conceived again, and bore Jacob a second son.

hausa: A bisa wurin ajiye fitilan kuwa za a kasance da kwafuna huɗu masu siffar furannin almon, da toho, da furanni.
english: and in the lamp stand four cups made like almond blossoms, its buds and its flowers;

hausa: Suka tashi daga Mara, suka tafi Elim, inda akwai maɓulɓulan ruwa goma sha biyu, da itatuwan dabino guda saba’in, suka yi sansani a can.
english: They traveled from Marah, and came to Elim. In Elim, there were twelve springs of water and seventy palm trees, and they encamped there.

hausa: Duk wanda ya tsawata wa wani mutum zai sami yabo a ƙarshe fiye da wanda yake mai daɗin baki.
english: One who rebukes a man will afterward find more favor than one who flatters with the tongue.

hausa: Ka kawo Haruna da ɗansa Eleyazar, ka kai su a bisan Dutsen Hor.
english: Take Aaron and Eleazar his son, and bring them up to Mount Hor;

hausa: ban da bayinsu maza da mata 7,337. Suna kuma da mawaƙa maza da mata 245.
english: in addition to their male servants and their female servants, of whom there were seven thousand three hundred thirty-seven. They had two hundred forty-five singing men and singing women.

hausa: Ka ba ni alamar alherinka, don abokan gābana su gani su kuma sha kunya, gama kai, ya Ubangiji, ka taimake ni ka kuma ta’azantar da ni.
english: Show me a sign of your goodness, that those who hate me may see it, and be shamed, because you, Yahweh, have helped me, and comforted me.

hausa: Ka mai da birnin tsibin tarkace, ka lalatar da gari mai katanga, birnin baƙi mai ƙarfi, ta ɓace; ba za a ƙara gina ta ba.
english: For you have made a city into a heap, a fortified city into a ruin, a palace of strangers to be no city. It will never be built.

hausa: Yotam ya huta tare da kakanninsa, aka kuma binne shi tare da su a Birnin Dawuda, birnin mahaifinsa. Ahaz ɗansa kuma ya gāje shi.
english: Jotham slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in his father David’s city; and Ahaz his son reigned in his place.

hausa: Sa’ad da mutane suka fara ƙaruwa a duniya, aka kuma hahhaifi musu ’ya’ya mata,
english: When men began to multiply on the surface of the ground, and daughters were born to them,

hausa: Ku bar Babilon, ku gudu daga Babiloniyawa! Ku yi shelar wannan da sowa ta farin ciki ku kuma furta shi. Ku aika shi zuwa iyakokin duniya; ku ce, “Ubangiji ya fanshi bawansa Yaƙub.”
english: Leave Babylon! Flee from the Chaldeans! With the sound of joyful shouting announce this, tell it even to the end of the earth; say, “Yahweh has redeemed his servant Jacob!”

hausa: Gama kun san cewa mun bi da kowannenku yadda mahaifi yakan yi da ’ya’yansa,
english: As you know, we exhorted, comforted, and implored every one of you, as a father does his own children,

hausa: Saboda haka Bulus ya zauna a nan har shekara ɗaya da rabi, yana koya musu maganar Allah.
english: He lived there a year and six months, teaching the word of God among them.

hausa: Ka mai da mu abin dariya ga maƙwabtanmu, abin dariya da reni ga waɗanda suke kewaye da mu.
english: You make us a reproach to our neighbors, a scoffing and a derision to those who are around us.

hausa: Amma Allah ya kashe waɗansu mutum saba’in na mutanen Bet-Shemesh domin sun leƙa cikin akwatin alkawarin Ubangiji. Mutane kuwa suka yi makoki domin Ubangiji ya hallaka mutane da yawa.
english: He struck of the men of Beth Shemesh, because they had looked into Yahweh’s ark, he struck fifty thousand seventy of the men. Then the people mourned, because Yahweh had struck the people with a great slaughter.

hausa: Muka kuwa ce wa ranka yă daɗe, ‘Saurayin ba zai iya barin mahaifinsa ba, gama in ya bar shi, mahaifinsa zai mutu.’
english: We said to my lord, ‘The boy can’t leave his father, for if he should leave his father, his father would die.’

hausa: Sa’an nan a asirce suka zuga waɗansu mutane su ce, “Mun ji Istifanus ya faɗa kalmomin saɓo game da Musa da kuma Allah.”
english: Then they secretly induced men to say, “We have heard him speak blasphemous words against Moses and God.”

hausa: Hikima tana a zuciyar mai azanci, kuma ko a cikin wawaye takan sa a santa.
english: Wisdom rests in the heart of one who has understanding, and is even made known in the inward part of fools.

hausa: Har kuka zama masu koyi da mu da kuma Ubangiji; duk da tsananin wahala, kuka karɓi saƙon nan da farin ciki wanda Ruhu Mai Tsarki ya bayar.
english: You became imitators of us and of the Lord, having received the word in much affliction, with joy of the Holy Spirit,

hausa: Amma da Sanballat, da Tobiya, da Larabawa, da Ammonawa, da kuma mutanen Ashdod suka ji cewa gyare-gyaren katangar Urushalima yana cin gaba, ana kuma tattoshe wuraren da suka tsattsaga, sai suka husata ƙwarai.
english: But when Sanballat, Tobiah, the Arabians, the Ammonites, and the Ashdodites heard that the repairing of the walls of Jerusalem went forward, and that the breaches began to be filled, they were very angry;

hausa: Yeshurun ya yi ƙiba, ya yi kauri; cike da abinci, ya zama da nauyi, ya kuma zama sumul. Ya yashe Allahn da ya yi shi, ya ƙi Dutse Cetonsa.
english: But Jeshurun grew fat, and kicked. You have grown fat. You have grown thick. You have become sleek. Then he abandoned God who made him, and rejected the Rock of his salvation.

hausa: ’Yan mata za su yi rawa su kuma yi murna, haka ma samari da tsofaffi. Zan mai da makokinsu farin ciki; zan ta’azantar da su in kuma sa su yi farin ciki a maimakon baƙin ciki.
english: Then the virgin will rejoice in the dance, the young men and the old together; for I will turn their mourning into joy, and will comfort them, and make them rejoice from their sorrow.

hausa: Da farko dai, ina gargaɗe ku cewa a yi roƙe-roƙe, ana addu’o’i, ana yin addu’a a madadin waɗansu da kuma a yi godiya saboda kowane mutum
english: I exhort therefore, first of all, that petitions, prayers, intercessions, and givings of thanks be made for all men,

hausa: bari lalaci yă kama su ba zato, bari tarkon da suka ɓoye yă kama su, bari su fāɗa cikin ramin, yă kai ga lalacinsu.
english: Let destruction come on him unawares. Let his net that he has hidden catch himself. Let him fall into that destruction.

hausa: Duk da haka Isra’ilawa ba su ƙone biranen da suke kan tuddai ba, sai Hazor kaɗai Yoshuwa ya ƙone.
english: But as for the cities that stood on their mounds, Israel burned none of them, except Hazor only. Joshua burned that.

hausa: Sai ya wayar da tunaninsu don su fahimci Nassi.
english: Then he opened their minds, that they might understand the Scriptures.

hausa: Haka kuma a gaban kursiyin akwai wani abu mai kama da tekun gilashi, yana ƙyalli kamar madubi. A tsakiya kuwa, kewaye da kursiyin, akwai halittu huɗu masu rai, cike kuma suna da idanu gaba da baya.
english: Before the throne was something like a sea of glass, similar to crystal. In the middle of the throne, and around the throne were four living creatures full of eyes before and behind.

hausa: Yaƙub da Yohanna, ’ya’yan Zebedi, abokan aikin Siman su ma suka yi mamaki. Sai Yesu ya ce wa Siman, “Kada ka ji tsoro, daga yanzu za ka riƙa kama mutane ne.”
english: and so also were James and John, sons of Zebedee, who were partners with Simon. Jesus said to Simon, “Don’t be afraid. From now on you will be catching people alive.”

hausa: Sa’ad da Yaƙub ya ji cewa akwai hatsi a Masar, sai ya aiki kakanninmu ziyararsu ta farko.
english: But when Jacob heard that there was grain in Egypt, he sent out our fathers the first time.

hausa: Don me, ya Ubangiji, ka ƙi ni ka kuma ɓoye fuskarka daga gare ni?
english: Yahweh, why do you reject my soul? Why do you hide your face from me?

hausa: zan kira dukan mutanen arewa da bawana Nebukadnezzar sarkin Babilon,” in ji Ubangiji, “zan kuma kawo su su yi gāba da wannan ƙasa da mazaunanta da kuma gāba da dukan al’ummai da suke kewaye. Zan hallaka su sarai in kuma mai da su abin bantsoro da abin dariya, za su kuma zama kufai har abada.
english: behold, I will send and take all the families of the north,” says Yahweh, “and I will send to Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon, my servant, and will bring them against this land, and against its inhabitants, and against all these nations around. I will utterly destroy them, and make them an astonishment, and a hissing, and perpetual desolations.

hausa: “Allah mai iko ne, amma ba ya rena mutane; shi mai girma ne cikin manufarsa.
english: “Behold, God is mighty, and doesn’t despise anyone. He is mighty in strength of understanding.

hausa: Shi mai yin roƙo a madadina abokina ne yayinda nake kuka ga Allah;
english: My friends scoff at me. My eyes pour out tears to God,

hausa: ‘Zai yi mulki a kansu da sandar sarauta ta ƙarfe, zai farfashe su, kamar tukwanen yumɓu’kamar yadda na karɓi iko daga Ubana.
english: He will rule them with a rod of iron, shattering them like clay pots, as I also have received of my Father;

hausa: ta kuwa yi ciki, ta haifi ɗa. Sa’ad da ta ga jaririn kyakkyawa ne, sai ta ɓoye shi har watanni uku.
english: The woman conceived and bore a son. When she saw that he was a fine child, she hid him three months.

hausa: Sai wani wanda ya yi kama da mutum ya taɓa leɓunana, na kuma buɗe bakina sai na fara magana. Na ce wa wannan da yake tsaye a gabana, “Na cika da azaba saboda wannan wahayi, ranka yă daɗe, ina kuma neman taimako.
english: Behold, one in the likeness of the sons of men touched my lips. Then I opened my mouth, and spoke and said to him who stood before me, “My lord, by reason of the vision my sorrows have overtaken me, and I retain no strength.

hausa: Ruwayen kogi za su ƙafe, bakin kogi zai shanye yă kuma bushe.
english: The waters will fail from the sea, and the river will be wasted and become dry.

hausa: Sa’an nan almajiran suka zo wurin Yesu a ɓoye suka tambaye shi suka ce, “Me ya sa ba mu iya fitar da aljanin ba?”
english: Then the disciples came to Jesus privately, and said, “Why weren’t we able to cast it out?”

hausa: da kuma yawan tacecciyar zinariya don bagaden turare. Ya kuma ba shi tsari don keken yaƙi, wato, kerubobin zinariyar da suka miƙe fikafikansu suka inuwantar da akwatin alkawarin Ubangiji.
english: and for the altar of incense, refined gold by weight; and gold for the plans for the chariot, and the cherubim that spread out and cover the ark of Yahweh’s covenant.

hausa: Bari kuma waɗannan kalmomina, waɗanda na yi addu’a a gaban Ubangiji, su yi kusa da Ubangiji Allahnmu, dare da rana, don yă biya bukatan bawansa da na mutanensa Isra’ila, bisa ga bukatan kowa,
english: Let these my words, with which I have made supplication before Yahweh, be near to Yahweh our God day and night, that he may maintain the cause of his servant and the cause of his people Israel, as every day requires;

hausa: suna shela cewa, “Ubangiji adali ne; shi ne Dutsena, kuma babu mugunta a cikinsa.”
english: to show that Yahweh is upright. He is my rock, and there is no unrighteousness in him.

hausa: tsanani, shan wahala, irin abubuwan da suka faru da ni a Antiyok, Ikoniyum da kuma Listira, tsananin da na jure. Duk da haka Ubangiji ya cece ni daga dukansu.
english: persecutions, and sufferings—those things that happened to me at Antioch, Iconium, and Lystra. I endured those persecutions. The Lord delivered me out of them all.

hausa: Allah ya halicci manyan halittun teku, da kowane mai rai da abin da yake motsi a ruwa, bisa ga irinsu, da kuma kowane tsuntsu mai fiffike bisa ga irinsa. Allah kuwa ya ga yana da kyau.
english: God created the large sea creatures and every living creature that moves, with which the waters swarmed, after their kind, and every winged bird after its kind. God saw that it was good.

hausa: Amma ka ragargaza mu ka kuma maishe mu abin farautar karnukan jeji ka kuma rufe mu cikin duhu baƙi ƙirin.
english: though you have crushed us in the haunt of jackals, and covered us with the shadow of death.

hausa: “Na san cewa za ka iya yin dukan abubuwa; ba wanda zai iya ɓata shirinka.
english: “I know that you can do all things, and that no purpose of yours can be restrained.

hausa: Amma Allah cikin ikonsa yakan kawar da masu ƙarfi, ko da yake sun yi ƙarfi, ba su da tabbacin rayuwa.
english: Yet God preserves the mighty by his power. He rises up who has no assurance of life.

hausa: Manufar Allah ita ce cewa mu da muka fara sa bege a cikin Kiristi, mu yi zaman yabon ɗaukakar Allah.
english: to the end that we should be to the praise of his glory, we who had before hoped in Christ.

hausa: Saboda haka na yanke shawara ba zan sāke kawo muku ziyara ta ɓacin rai ba.
english: But I determined this for myself, that I would not come to you again in sorrow.

hausa: Wannan magana “sau ɗayan nan” sun nuna, kawar da abin da za a iya jijjigawa, wato, ƙirƙiro abubuwa, saboda abubuwan da ba a iya jijjigawa, su kasance.
english: This phrase, “Yet once more” signifies the removing of those things that are shaken, as of things that have been made, that those things which are not shaken may remain.

hausa: Amma fadamun da tafkunan ba za su zama masu daɗi ba; za a bar su a gishirinsu.
english: But its swamps and marshes will not be healed. They will be given up to salt.

hausa: Sai Allah ya ce, “Bari haske yă kasance,” sai kuwa ga haske.
english: God said, “Let there be light,” and there was light.

hausa: Shanun nan ramammu, munana, da suka zo daga baya, shekaru bakwai ne, haka ma kawuna dawan nan shanyayyu da iskar gabas ta yanƙwane. Shekaru ne bakwai na yunwa.
english: The seven thin and ugly cattle that came up after them are seven years, and also the seven empty heads of grain blasted with the east wind; they will be seven years of famine.

hausa: Bari su ɗaukaka Ubangiji su kuma yi shelar yabonsa a tsibirai.
english: Let them give glory to Yahweh, and declare his praise in the islands.

hausa: A wannan rana wani mutumin Benyamin ya ruga da bakin dāgā ya shigo Shilo, taguwarsa a yage, kansa kuma a rufe da ƙasa.
english: A man of Benjamin ran out of the army and came to Shiloh the same day, with his clothes torn and with dirt on his head.

hausa: Duk wanda aka ƙaddara ga bauta, ga bauta zai tafi. Duk wanda aka ƙaddara za a kashe da takobi, da takobin za a kashe shi. Wannan yana bukata haƙuri da aminci a gefen tsarkaka.
english: If anyone is to go into captivity, he will go into captivity. If anyone is to be killed with the sword, he must be killed. Here is the endurance and the faith of the saints.

hausa: “Saboda haka ka ce musu, ‘Ga abin da Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka yake cewa ba wata maganata da za tă ƙara yin jinkiri; duk abin da na faɗa zai cika, in ji Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka.’ ”
english: “Therefore tell them, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “None of my words will be deferred any more, but the word which I speak will be performed,” says the Lord Yahweh.’”

hausa: Bari mu tafiyar da al’amuranmu yadda ya dace a yi da rana, ba a cikin shashanci da buguwa ba, ba cikin fasikanci da rashin kunya ba, ba kuma cikin faɗa da kishi ba.
english: Let’s walk properly, as in the day; not in reveling and drunkenness, not in sexual promiscuity and lustful acts, and not in strife and jealousy.

hausa: A kan me aka kafa tushenta, ko kuma wa ya sa dutsen kan kusurwarta,
english: What were its foundations fastened on? Or who laid its cornerstone,

hausa: Amma kamar yadda na faɗa muku, kun gan ni duk da haka ba ku gaskata ba.
english: But I told you that you have seen me, and yet you don’t believe.

hausa: “Har wa yau, za a kwatanta shi da mutumin da zai yi tafiya, wanda ya kira bayinsa ya kuma danƙa musu mallakarsa.
english: “For it is like a man going into another country, who called his own servants and entrusted his goods to them.

hausa: A ƙarshe Bilatus ya ba da shi gare su a gicciye shi. Saboda haka sojoji suka tafi da Yesu.
english: So then he delivered him to them to be crucified. So they took Jesus and led him away.

hausa: Danginsu bisa ga iyalansu da aka jera bisa ga tarihin zuriyarsu su ne, Yehiyel shi ne sarki, akwai Zakariya,
english: His brothers by their families, when the genealogy of their generations was listed: the chief, Jeiel, and Zechariah,

hausa: Ka farka, ka kuma tashi ka kāre ni! Ka yi mini faɗa, ya Allahna da shugabana.
english: Wake up! Rise up to defend me, my God! My Lord, contend for me!

hausa: hankalinsa a rabe yake. Mace marar aure ko kuwa budurwa ta damu ne da al’amuran Ubangiji. Nufinta shi ne ta ba da kanta ga Ubangiji cikin jiki da ruhu. Amma mace da take da aure ta damu ne da al’amuran wannan duniya, yadda za tă gamshi mijinta.
english: There is also a difference between a wife and a virgin. The unmarried woman cares about the things of the Lord, that she may be holy both in body and in spirit. But she who is married cares about the things of the world—how she may please her husband.

hausa: yana kuma da cikakken tabbaci cewa Allah yana da iko yă cika abin da ya yi alkawari.
english: and being fully assured that what he had promised, he was also able to perform.

hausa: Sa’an nan itatuwan jeji za su rera, za su rera don farin ciki a gaban Ubangiji, gama ya zo don yă hukunta duniya.
english: Then the trees of the forest will sing for joy before Yahweh, for he comes to judge the earth.

hausa: Saboda haka sarki ya tashi, ya zauna a bakin hanyar shiga. Da aka faɗa wa mutane cewa, “Sarki yana zaune a bakin hanyar shiga,” sai duk suka zo gabansa. Ana cikin haka, Isra’ilawa dai sun riga sun tsere zuwa gidajensu.
english: Then the king arose and sat in the gate. The people were all told, “Behold, the king is sitting in the gate.” All the people came before the king. Now Israel had fled every man to his tent.

hausa: Ban da haka ma, cikin sa zuciyata ga haikalin Allahna, yanzu na ba da ma’ajina na zinariya da azurfa saboda haikalin Allahna, fiye da kome na tanada saboda wannan haikali,
english: In addition, because I have set my affection on the house of my God, since I have a treasure of my own of gold and silver, I give it to the house of my God, over and above all that I have prepared for the holy house:

hausa: Duk da haka bai yi shakka ta wurin rashin bangaskiya game da alkawarin Allah ba, sai ma ya ƙara ƙarfafa ga bangaskiyarsa, ya kuma ɗaukaka Allah,
english: Yet, looking to the promise of God, he didn’t waver through unbelief, but grew strong through faith, giving glory to God,

hausa: Sai Batsheba ta rusuna da fuskarta har ƙasa, ta kuma durƙusa a gaban sarki ta ce, “Bari ran Sarkina Dawuda yă daɗe, har abada!”
english: Then Bathsheba bowed with her face to the earth and showed respect to the king, and said, “Let my lord King David live forever!”

hausa: Sa’an nan Adoni-Bezek ya ce, “Sarakuna saba’in waɗanda aka yayyanka manyan yatsotsinsu na hannu da na ƙafa, sun yi kalan abinci a ƙarƙashin teburina. Ga shi yanzu Allah ya rama abin da na yi musu.” Suka zo da shi Urushalima, a can kuwa ya mutu.
english: Adoni-Bezek said, “Seventy kings, having their thumbs and their big toes cut off, scavenged under my table. As I have done, so God has done to me.” They brought him to Jerusalem, and he died there.

hausa: Ɗauke da gicciyensa, ya kuwa fita zuwa wurin Ƙoƙon Kai (wanda a harshen Arameya ana ce da shi Golgota).
english: He went out, bearing his cross, to the place called “The Place of a Skull”, which is called in Hebrew, “Golgotha”,

hausa: Bitrus ya amsa ya ce, “Daga wurin waɗansu.” Yesu ya ce masa, “Wato, an ɗauke wa ’ya’yan ke nan.
english: Peter said to him, “From strangers.” Jesus said to him, “Therefore the children are exempt.

hausa: “In mutum ya sayar da ’yarsa a matsayin baiwa, ba za a ’yantar da ita kamar bawa ba.
english: “If a man sells his daughter to be a female servant, she shall not go out as the male servants do.

hausa: Ubangiji Allahnku kansa zai haye a gabanku. Zai hallaka waɗannan al’ummai da suke gabanku, za ku kuwa mallaki ƙasarsu. Yoshuwa shi ma zai haye a gabanku, yadda Ubangiji ya faɗa.
english: Yahweh your God himself will go over before you. He will destroy these nations from before you, and you shall dispossess them. Joshua will go over before you, as Yahweh has spoken.

hausa: A rana ta bakwai ɗin firist zai sāke bincike shi, in kuwa mikin ya bushe bai kuwa yaɗu a fatar jikin ba, firist ɗin zai furta shi mai tsarki; ƙurji ne kawai. Dole mutumin yă wanke rigunansa, zai kuma tsarkaka.
english: The priest shall examine him again on the seventh day. Behold, if the plague has faded and the plague hasn’t spread in the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him clean. It is a scab. He shall wash his clothes, and be clean.

hausa: Ya koyar da farillanka ga Yaƙub, dokarka kuma ga Isra’ila. Ya miƙa turare a gabanka da kuma hadaya ta ƙonawa ɗungum a kan bagadenka.
english: They shall teach Jacob your ordinances, and Israel your law. They shall put incense before you, and whole burnt offering on your altar.

hausa: Sa’ad da ya buɗe hatimi na bakwai, sai aka yi shiru a sama na kusan rabin sa’a.
english: When he opened the seventh seal, there was silence in heaven for about half an hour.

hausa: Ba na so in zauna da rai; ba zan rayu ba har abada. Ku rabu da ni; rayuwata ba ta da amfani.
english: I loathe my life. I don’t want to live forever. Leave me alone, for my days are but a breath.

hausa: Sai ƙungiyar soja tare da shugaban sojanta da kuma ma’aikatan Yahudawa suka kama Yesu. Suka daure shi
english: So the detachment, the commanding officer, and the officers of the Jews seized Jesus and bound him,

hausa: Lilin mai kyau mai ado daga Masar ne filafilan jirgin ruwanki suka kuma zama tutarki; an yi tutarki da shuɗi da shunayya daga bakin tekun Elisha.
english: Your sail was of fine linen with embroidered work from Egypt, that it might be to you for a banner. Blue and purple from the islands of Elishah was your awning.

hausa: da aka ƙidaya kabila-kabila, su 3,200 ne.
english: even those who were counted of them by their families, were three thousand two hundred.

hausa: Horon mutanena ya fi na Sodom girma, wadda aka hallaka farat ɗaya ba wani hannu da ya juya ya taimake ta.
english: For the iniquity of the daughter of my people is greater than the sin of Sodom, which was overthrown as in a moment. No hands were laid on her.

hausa: “Kai dai biya mini waɗannan bukatu biyu kawai ya Allah, ba zan kuwa ɓoye daga gare ka ba;
english: “Only don’t do two things to me, then I will not hide myself from your face:

hausa: Aka tattake su a wurin matsin inabi a bayan gari, jini kuwa ya yi ta gudana daga wurin matsin inabi tsayinsa ya kai kamar tsawon linzami a bakin doki, nisansa kuma ya kai wajen kilomita 300.
english: The wine press was trodden outside of the city, and blood came out of the wine press, up to the bridles of the horses, as far as one thousand six hundred stadia.

hausa: dukan mutane kuwa, manyan da ƙanana, suka mai da hankali gare shi suka kuma ce, “Mutumin nan shi ne ikon Allah da aka sani a matsayin Iko Mai Girma”
english: to whom they all listened, from the least to the greatest, saying, “This man is that great power of God.”

hausa: Ka san fitata da kuma kwanciyata; ka saba da dukan hanyoyina.
english: You search out my path and my lying down, and are acquainted with all my ways.

hausa: Dole alƙalan su yi bincike sosai, in kuma aka tabbatar mai ba da shaida maƙaryaci ne, yana ba da shaidar zur a kan ɗan’uwansa ne,
english: and the judges shall make diligent inquisition; and behold, if the witness is a false witness, and has testified falsely against his brother,

hausa: Ba labari sai ga taron rundunar sama suka bayyana tare da mala’ikan, suna yabon Allah suna cewa,
english: Suddenly, there was with the angel a multitude of the heavenly army praising God and saying,

hausa: Ba za mu ɓoye su wa ’ya’yanmu ba; za mu faɗa wa tsara mai zuwa ayyukan da suka zama yabo na Ubangiji, ikonsa, da abubuwan banmamakin da ya aikata.
english: We will not hide them from their children, telling to the generation to come the praises of Yahweh, his strength, and his wondrous deeds that he has done.

hausa: Ta Dawuda. Ubangiji ne haskena da cetona, wa zan ji tsoro? Ubangiji ne mafakar raina, wane ne zan ji tsoro?
english: By David. Yahweh is my light and my salvation. Whom shall I fear? Yahweh is the strength of my life. Of whom shall I be afraid?

hausa: gama ’ya’yan Yusuf sun zama kabilu biyu, Manasse da Efraim. Ba a ba Lawiyawa gādon ba sai dai garuruwan da aka ba su su zauna a ciki, da wurin kiwo mai kyau domin dabbobinsu.
english: For the children of Joseph were two tribes, Manasseh and Ephraim. They gave no portion to the Levites in the land, except cities to dwell in, with their pasture lands for their livestock and for their property.

hausa: suka kawo bayi da ganiman nan, wurin Musa da Eleyazar firist, da kuma jama’ar Isra’ilawa, a sansaninsu a filayen Mowab kusa da Urdun daga ƙetaren Yeriko.
english: They brought the captives with the prey and the plunder, to Moses, and to Eleazar the priest, and to the congregation of the children of Israel, to the camp at the plains of Moab, which are by the Jordan at Jericho.

hausa: ɗan Elkana, ɗan Yowel, ɗan Azariya, ɗan Zefaniya
english: the son of Elkanah, the son of Joel, the son of Azariah, the son of Zephaniah,

hausa: A ruɗe kuma cike da mamaki, suka tambayi junansu cewa, “Mene ne wannan yake nufi?”
english: They were all amazed and were perplexed, saying to one another, “What does this mean?”

hausa: Daga can ta ƙetare zuwa gangaren Luz a kudu (wato, Betel), ta wuce zuwa Atarot Adda a tudun arewa na kwarin Bet-Horon.
english: The border passed along from there to Luz, to the side of Luz (also called Bethel), southward. The border went down to Ataroth Addar, by the mountain that lies on the south of Beth Horon the lower.

hausa: Amma na kafa idanuna a kanka, ya Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka; a cikinka ina neman mafaka, kada ka miƙa ni ga mutuwa.
english: For my eyes are on you, Yahweh, the Lord. I take refuge in you. Don’t leave my soul destitute.

hausa: Ka rataye shi a bisa dogayen sanduna huɗun nan na itacen ƙirya, waɗanda aka dalaye da zinariya, waɗanda suke tsaya a rammuka huɗu na azurfa.
english: You shall hang it on four pillars of acacia overlaid with gold; their hooks shall be of gold, on four sockets of silver.

hausa: Fir’auna ya yi fushi da hafsoshin nan nasa guda biyu, shugaban masu shayarwa da shugaban masu tuya,
english: Pharaoh was angry with his two officers, the chief cup bearer and the chief baker.

hausa: Bayan ya bar Hebron, Dawuda ya ƙara ɗauko wa kansa waɗansu ƙwarƙwarai da mata a Urushalima. Aka haifa masa ’ya’ya maza da mata.
english: David took more concubines and wives for himself out of Jerusalem, after he had come from Hebron; and more sons and daughters were born to David.

hausa: Saboda haka ka tuba! In ba haka ba, zan zo wajenka ba da daɗewa ba in yaƙe su da takobin bakina.
english: Repent therefore, or else I am coming to you quickly and I will make war against them with the sword of my mouth.

hausa: Yesu ya ce musu, “Da Allah ne Ubanku, da kun ƙaunace ni, gama daga Allah na fito yanzu kuma ga ni nan. Ban zo saboda kaina ba, amma shi ne ya aiko ni.
english: Therefore Jesus said to them, “If God were your father, you would love me, for I came out and have come from God. For I haven’t come of myself, but he sent me.

hausa: Ashe, Allah ba zai biya wa zaɓaɓɓunsa da suke masa kuka, dare da rana adalci ba? Zai ci gaba da ƙin sauraronsu ne?
english: Won’t God avenge his chosen ones who are crying out to him day and night, and yet he exercises patience with them?

hausa: Ɗayansu ya ce wa mutumin da yake sanye da tufafin lilin, wanda yake a saman ruwan kogin, “Har yaushe waɗannan abubuwan banmamakin za su cika?”
english: One said to the man clothed in linen, who was above the waters of the river, “How long will it be to the end of these wonders?”

hausa: A wannan rana ba za ku sha kunya saboda laifofin da kuka yi mini, gama zan ɗauke wa wannan birni waɗanda suke farin ciki cikin girmankansu. Ba kuma za ka ƙara yin kallon reni a tuduna mai tsarki ba.
english: In that day you will not be disappointed for all your doings in which you have transgressed against me; for then I will take away out from among you your proudly exulting ones, and you will no more be arrogant in my holy mountain.

hausa: Lawiyawa suka rarrashi mutane duka suna cewa, “Ku natsu, gama wannan rana ce mai tsarki. Kada ku yi baƙin ciki.”
english: So the Levites calmed all the people, saying, “Hold your peace, for the day is holy. Don’t be grieved.”

hausa: Dukan sauran kayan da aka yi amfani da su a aikin wannan tabanakul, ko da wanda irin aiki ne za a yi da su, har da dukan dogayen turakunsa da na filin, za a yi su da tagulla ne.
english: All the instruments of the tabernacle in all its service, and all its pins, and all the pins of the court, shall be of bronze.

hausa: Ta ɗauka ta koma gari sai surukarta ta ga yawan abin da ta kalato. Rut kuma ta fitar da ragowar abin da ta ci bayan ta ƙoshi ta ba ta.
english: She took it up, and went into the city. Then her mother-in-law saw what she had gleaned; and she brought out and gave to her that which she had left after she had enough.

hausa: Sun shiga gidan yayinda yake kwance a gado a ɗakin barcinsa. Bayan sun soke shi sai suka kashe shi, suka kuma datse kansa. Suka ɗauke shi, suka yi tafiya dukan dare suka bi ta Araba.
english: Now when they came into the house as he lay on his bed in his bedroom, they struck him, killed him, beheaded him, and took his head, and went by the way of the Arabah all night.

hausa: “ ‘Ga abin da Ubangiji ya faɗa, “ ‘Waɗanda suke goyon bayan Masar za su fāɗi ƙarfinta da take fariya da shi zai ƙare. Daga Migdol zuwa Aswan za su mutu ta wurin takobi a cikinta, in ji Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka.
english: “‘Yahweh says: “They also who uphold Egypt will fall. The pride of her power will come down. They will fall by the sword in it from the tower of Seveneh,” says the Lord Yahweh.

hausa: Gama Ubangiji zai nuna cewa mutanensa ba su da laifi ya kuma ji tausayin bayinsa.
english: For Yahweh will judge his people and have compassion on his servants.

hausa: Sa’an nan Ubangiji ya farka sai ka ce daga barcinsa, kamar yadda mutum kan farka daga buguwar ruwan inabi.
english: Then the Lord awakened as one out of sleep, like a mighty man who shouts by reason of wine.

hausa: Ina marmarin farillanka ƙwarai! Ka kiyaye raina cikin adalcinka.
english: Behold, I long for your precepts! Revive me in your righteousness. VAV

hausa: Allahna shi ne dutsena. A gare shi nake samun kāriya shi ne garkuwata da kuma ƙahon cetona. Shi ne mafakata, maɓuyata, da mai cetona. Daga mutane masu fitina, ka cece ni.
english: God is my rock in whom I take refuge; my shield, and the horn of my salvation, my high tower, and my refuge. My savior, you save me from violence.

hausa: Hannuwanka ba a daure suke ba, ƙafafunka ba a tabaibaye suke ba. Ka mutu kamar waɗanda suke mutuwa a hannun mugaye.” Sai dukan mutane suka sāke fashe da kuka saboda shi.
english: Your hands weren’t bound, and your feet weren’t put into fetters. As a man falls before the children of iniquity, so you fell.” All the people wept again over him.

hausa: Sa’an nan Ezra ya tashi daga gidan Allah ya tafi gidan Yehohanan ɗan Eliyashib, a can ma bai ci wani abu ba, bai sha ruwa ba domin ya ci gaba da yin baƙin cikin rashin aminci na waɗanda suka dawo daga bauta.
english: Then Ezra rose up from before God’s house, and went into the room of Jehohanan the son of Eliashib. When he came there, he didn’t eat bread or drink water, for he mourned because of the trespass of the exiles.

hausa: Festus ya amsa ya ce, “Bulus yana tsare a Kaisariya, ni da kaina kuma zan je can ba da daɗewa ba.
english: However Festus answered that Paul should be kept in custody at Caesarea, and that he himself was about to depart shortly.

hausa: Sa’an nan Ruhun Ubangiji ya sauko wa Yefta. Sai ya haye Gileyad da Manasse, ya ratsa ta Mizfa zuwa Gileyad, daga can kuma ya kai wa Ammonawa hari.
english: Then Yahweh’s Spirit came on Jephthah, and he passed over Gilead and Manasseh, and passed over Mizpah of Gilead, and from Mizpah of Gilead he passed over to the children of Ammon.

hausa: Ina ba su rai madawwami, ba za su taɓa hallaka ba; ba kuma mai ƙwace su daga hannuna.
english: I give eternal life to them. They will never perish, and no one will snatch them out of my hand.

hausa: A ganina, wuyar da muke sha a wannan lokaci ba su isa a kwatanta da ɗaukakar da za a bayyana a cikinmu ba.
english: For I consider that the sufferings of this present time are not worthy to be compared with the glory which will be revealed toward us.

hausa: In ina da baiwar annabci, ina kuma iya fahimtar dukan asirai da dukan ilimi, in kuma ina da bangaskiyar da zan iya kawar da manyan duwatsu, amma ba ni da ƙauna, ni ba kome ba ne.
english: If I have the gift of prophecy, and know all mysteries and all knowledge, and if I have all faith, so as to remove mountains, but don’t have love, I am nothing.

hausa: na Betel da na Ai 123
english: The men of Bethel and Ai: one hundred twenty-three.

hausa: Da rana ta kusa fāɗuwa, sai Sha Biyun suka zo wurinsa, suka ce, “Ka sallami taron domin su shiga ƙauyuka na kewaye, su nemi abin da za su ci, da wurin kwana, don inda muke, ba kowa.”
english: The day began to wear away; and the twelve came and said to him, “Send the multitude away, that they may go into the surrounding villages and farms and lodge and get food, for we are here in a deserted place.”

hausa: Amma Allah ya aiko ni gabanku ne don in adana muku raguwa a duniya, in kuma ceci rayukanku ta wurin ceto mai girma.
english: God sent me before you to preserve for you a remnant on the earth, and to save you alive by a great deliverance.

hausa: “Duk mutumin da ya yi jima’i da dabba dole a kashe shi.
english: “Whoever has sex with an animal shall surely be put to death.

hausa: Ko jarumawa mafi jaruntaka za su gudu tsirara a ranan nan,” in ji Ubangiji.
english: He who is courageous among the mighty will flee away naked on that day,” says Yahweh.

hausa: Sai su ɗebi waɗansu duwatsu su sa a wuraren da suka ciccire waɗancan, su kuma ɗiba sabon laka su yi shafen gidan.
english: They shall take other stones, and put them in the place of those stones; and he shall take other mortar, and shall plaster the house.

hausa: Ahiyezer babbansu da Yowash ’ya’yan Shema’a maza daga Gibeya; Yeziyel da Felet ’ya’yan Azmawet; Beraka, Yehu daga Anatot,
english: The chief was Ahiezer, then Joash, the sons of Shemaah the Gibeathite; Jeziel and Pelet, the sons of Azmaveth; Beracah; Jehu the Anathothite;

hausa: “Ga abin da Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka yana cewa, ‘Domin Mowab da Seyir sun ce, “Duba, gidan Yahuda ta zama sauran al’ummai,”
english: “‘The Lord Yahweh says: “Because Moab and Seir say, ‘Behold, the house of Judah is like all the nations,’

hausa: Ka komo wurinmu, ya Allah Maɗaukaki! Ka duba daga sama ka gani! Ka lura da wannan inabi,
english: Turn again, we beg you, God of Armies. Look down from heaven, and see, and visit this vine,

hausa: Ba zan ƙara ce da ku bayi ba, don bawa bai san abin da maigidansa yake yi ba. A maimako in ce da ku abokai, domin na sanar da ku duk abin da na ji daga wurin Ubana.
english: No longer do I call you servants, for the servant doesn’t know what his lord does. But I have called you friends, for everything that I heard from my Father, I have made known to you.

hausa: Amon fāɗuwarsu zai sa ƙasa ta girgiza; za a kuma ji muryar kukansu a Jan Teku.
english: The earth trembles at the noise of their fall; there is a cry, the noise which is heard in the Red Sea.

hausa: Ka tashi ka taimake mu; ka cece mu saboda ƙaunarka marar ƙarewa.
english: Rise up to help us. Redeem us for your loving kindness’ sake.

hausa: Bitrus ya amsa, “Ku tuba a kuma yi muku baftisma, kowannenku a cikin sunan Yesu Kiristi domin gafarar zunubanku. Za ku kuwa karɓi kyautar Ruhu Mai Tsarki.
english: Peter said to them, “Repent and be baptized, every one of you, in the name of Jesus Christ for the forgiveness of sins, and you will receive the gift of the Holy Spirit.

hausa: Bakinka zai kai ka yă baro, ba nawa ba; maganar bakinka za tă juya a kanka.
english: Your own mouth condemns you, and not I. Yes, your own lips testify against you.

hausa: “Amma mai albarka ne mutumin da yake dogara ga Ubangiji, wanda ƙarfin halinsa yana daga Ubangiji.
english: “Blessed is the man who trusts in Yahweh, and whose confidence is in Yahweh.

hausa: Haka aka lissafta dukan Isra’ila a tarihin zuriyoyi a littafin sarakunan Isra’ila. Aka kwasa mutanen Yahuda zuwa zaman bauta a Babilon domin rashin aminci.
english: So all Israel were listed by genealogies; and behold, they are written in the book of the kings of Israel. Judah was carried away captive to Babylon for their disobedience.

hausa: Saboda haka sa’ad da suka cinye dukan hatsin da suka kawo daga Masar, mahaifinsu ya ce musu, “Ku koma, ku sayo mana ƙarin abinci.”
english: When they had eaten up the grain which they had brought out of Egypt, their father said to them, “Go again, buy us a little more food.”

hausa: Na san cewa duk abin da Allah ya yi zai dawwama har abada; ba abin da za a ƙara ko a rage. Allah ya yi haka domin mutane su girmama shi.
english: I know that whatever God does, it shall be forever. Nothing can be added to it, nor anything taken from it; and God has done it, that men should fear before him.

hausa: Faɗar gaskiya tana da zafi! Amma ina amfanin gardamar da kuke yi?
english: How forcible are words of uprightness! But your reproof, what does it reprove?

hausa: Hikima ba ta yin kira ne? Fahimi ba ya tā da muryarsa ne?
english: Doesn’t wisdom cry out? Doesn’t understanding raise her voice?

hausa: Sai wata alama ta bayyana a sama, wani babban jan maciji mai kawuna bakwai da ƙahoni goma da rawani bakwai a kan kawunansa.
english: Another sign was seen in heaven. Behold, a great red dragon, having seven heads and ten horns, and on his heads seven crowns.

hausa: Idan kuma wani mutum ya ji kalmomi na wannan rantsuwa, ya kuma sa wa kansa albarka yana tunani cewa, “Ba abin da zai same ni, ko da na nace a taurinkaina.” Wannan zai jawo lalacewar dukan Isra’ila tare da kai.
english: and it happen, when he hears the words of this curse, that he bless himself in his heart, saying, “I shall have peace, though I walk in the stubbornness of my heart,” to destroy the moist with the dry.

hausa: Suna cin gaba da ce wa waɗanda suka rena ni, ‘Ubangiji ya ce za ku zauna lafiya.’ Ga duka waɗanda suke bin taurin zukatansu kuwa sukan ce, ‘Babu lahanin da zai same ku.’
english: They say continually to those who despise me, ‘Yahweh has said, “You will have peace;”’ and to everyone who walks in the stubbornness of his own heart they say, ‘No evil will come on you.’

hausa: Gama Musa ya yi wa’azi a kowace birni tun zamanin dā, ana kuma karanta shi a majami’u kowane Asabbaci.”
english: For Moses from generations of old has in every city those who preach him, being read in the synagogues every Sabbath.”

hausa: Me ya sa ka rurrushe bangayensa don duk masu wucewa su tsinke ’ya’yan inabinsa?
english: Why have you broken down its walls, so that all those who pass by the way pluck it?

hausa: sai Ubangiji ya bayyana gare shi sau na biyu, kamar yadda ya bayyana masa a Gibeyon.
english: Yahweh appeared to Solomon the second time, as he had appeared to him at Gibeon.

hausa: In ka daina jin umarni, ɗana, za ka kuwa kauce daga kalmomin sani.
english: If you stop listening to instruction, my son, you will stray from the words of knowledge.

hausa: Mutanen rabin kabilar Manasse sun yi yawa; suka zauna a ƙasar daga Bashan har zuwa Ba’al-Hermon, wato, zuwa Senir (Dutsen Hermon).
english: The children of the half-tribe of Manasseh lived in the land. They increased from Bashan to Baal Hermon, Senir, and Mount Hermon.

hausa: Sa’an nan, suka koma gida, suka shirya kayan ƙanshi da turare. Amma suka huta a ranar Asabbaci don kiyaye doka.
english: They returned and prepared spices and ointments. On the Sabbath they rested according to the commandment.

hausa: Ya bugi kowane ɗan fari na Masar, mafari ƙarfin mazantakansu a tentunan Ham.
english: and struck all the firstborn in Egypt, the chief of their strength in the tents of Ham.

hausa: Saboda haka sa’ad da kun taru ikon Ubangijinmu Yesu kuma yana nan, ni ma ina tare da ku.
english: In the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, when you are gathered together with my spirit with the power of our Lord Jesus Christ,

hausa: Ba na nema wa kaina ɗaukaka, amma akwai wani wanda yake neman mini, shi ne kuma alƙali.
english: But I don’t seek my own glory. There is one who seeks and judges.

hausa: wanda ya fanshi ranka daga rami ya naɗa maka rawani da ƙauna da kuma tausayi,
english: who redeems your life from destruction, who crowns you with loving kindness and tender mercies,

hausa: Za mu yi ’yan kunnenki na zinariya, da adon azurfa.
english: We will make you earrings of gold, with studs of silver.

hausa: Ubangiji ya ƙi bagadensa ya kuma yi wofi da haikalinsa. Ya ba maƙiyinta fadodinta; suka yi sowa a cikin gidan Ubangiji kamar a ranar da ake yin biki.
english: The Lord has cast off his altar. He has abhorred his sanctuary. He has given the walls of her palaces into the hand of the enemy. They have made a noise in Yahweh’s house, as in the day of a solemn assembly.

hausa: Suka amsa, “Mutumin ya yi mana tambaya sosai game da kanmu da iyalinmu. Ya tambaye mu, ‘Mahaifinku yana da rai har yanzu? Kuna da wani ɗan’uwa?’ Mu dai mun amsa tambayoyinsa ne. Ta yaya za mu sani zai ce, ‘Ku kawo ɗan’uwanku a nan’?”
english: They said, “The man asked directly concerning ourselves, and concerning our relatives, saying, ‘Is your father still alive? Have you another brother?’ We just answered his questions. Is there any way we could know that he would say, ‘Bring your brother down’?”

hausa: Sai mugun ruhun ya jijjiga mutumin da ƙarfi, ya fita daga jikinsa da ihu.
english: The unclean spirit, convulsing him and crying with a loud voice, came out of him.

hausa: Sa’ad da dawakai, kekunan yaƙi da mahayan dawakan Fir’auna suka shiga cikin teku, Ubangiji ya mayar da ruwan teku a kansu, amma Isra’ilawa suka wuce a cikin teku a busasshiyar ƙasa.
english: For the horses of Pharaoh went in with his chariots and with his horsemen into the sea, and Yahweh brought back the waters of the sea on them; but the children of Israel walked on dry land in the middle of the sea.

hausa: “Game da ƙofar shigar tenti kuwa, ka yi labule mai ruwan shuɗi, shunayya da jan zare na lallausan lilin da aka tuƙa, aikin gwani.
english: “You shall make a screen for the door of the Tent, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, the work of the embroiderer.

hausa: Zai zama kamar ɗan kurmi a ƙasar da take kango; ba za su ga arziki sa’ad da ya zo ba. Za su zauna a busassun wuraren hamada, a cikin ƙasar gishiri inda ba kowa.
english: For he will be like a bush in the desert, and will not see when good comes, but will inhabit the parched places in the wilderness, an uninhabited salt land.

hausa: Kamar gwara mai yawo ko alallaka mai firiya, haka yake da la’anar da ba tă dace tă kama ka ba take.
english: Like a fluttering sparrow, like a darting swallow, so the undeserved curse doesn’t come to rest.

hausa: In na shiga cikin ƙasar, na ga waɗanda takobi ya kashe; in na shiga cikin birni, na ga waɗanda suke fama da yunwa. Da Annabi da firist duk sun tafi ƙasar da ba su sani ba.’ ”
english: If I go out into the field, then behold, the slain with the sword! If I enter into the city, then behold, those who are sick with famine! For both the prophet and the priest go about in the land, and have no knowledge.’”

hausa: Ke kyakkyawa ce, ƙaunatacciyata, kamar Tirza, kyakkyawa kuma kamar Urushalima, mai daraja kamar mayaƙa da tutoti.
english: You are beautiful, my love, as Tirzah, lovely as Jerusalem, awesome as an army with banners.

hausa: Da rawan jiki da kuma ruɗewa, matan suka fita a guje daga kabarin. Ba su kuwa gaya wa kowa ba, don suna tsoro.
english: They went out, and fled from the tomb, for trembling and astonishment had come on them. They said nothing to anyone; for they were afraid.

hausa: Gama shi da ya ce, “Kada ka yi zina,” shi ne kuma ya ce, “Kada ka yi kisankai.” In kuwa ba ka zina amma kana kisankai, ka zama mai karya doka ke nan.
english: For he who said, “Do not commit adultery,” also said, “Do not commit murder.” Now if you do not commit adultery but do murder, you have become a transgressor of the law.

hausa: Shirin ya yi kyau ga sarki da kuma dukan taron.
english: The thing was right in the eyes of the king and of all the assembly.

hausa: Don me, ya Ubangiji, kake tsaya can da nesa? Me ya sa kake ɓoye kanka a lokutan wahala?
english: Why do you stand far off, Yahweh? Why do you hide yourself in times of trouble?

hausa: Suka ɗauki rigan nan mai gwanin kyau, suka kawo wa mahaifinsu suka ce, “Mun sami wannan. Ka bincika shi ka gani ko rigar ɗanka ne.”
english: They took the tunic of many colors, and they brought it to their father, and said, “We have found this. Examine it, now, and see if it is your son’s tunic or not.”

hausa: Ubangiji ya sa Urdun ya zama iyaka tsakaninmu da ku, ku mutanen Ruben da mutanen Gad! Ba ku da rabo cikin Ubangiji.’ ’Ya’yanku za su iya sa ’ya’yanmu su daina tsoron Ubangiji.
english: For Yahweh has made the Jordan a border between us and you, you children of Reuben and children of Gad. You have no portion in Yahweh.”’ So your children might make our children cease from fearing Yahweh.

hausa: akan shuka shi da jiki na mutuntaka, a kuma tā da shi da jikin ruhaniya. In akwai jiki na mutuntaka, to, lalle akwai jikin ruhaniya ma.
english: It is sown a natural body; it is raised a spiritual body. There is a natural body and there is also a spiritual body.

hausa: (Mutanen Hiram da mutanen Solomon suka kawo zinariya daga Ofir, suka kuma kawo gungumen algum da duwatsu masu daraja.
english: The servants of Huram and the servants of Solomon, who brought gold from Ophir, also brought algum trees and precious stones.

hausa: Sa’an nan zan sa ruwanta su kwanta in sa rafuffukanta su gudu kamar mai, in ji Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka.
english: Then I will make their waters clear, and cause their rivers to run like oil,” says the Lord Yahweh.

hausa: Kamar yadda gawayi yake ga murhu, itace kuma ga wuta, haka mutum mai neman faɗa yake ga faɗa.
english: As coals are to hot embers, and wood to fire, so is a contentious man to kindling strife.

hausa: Yana cewa, “Lokaci ya yi. Mulkin Allah ya yi kusa. Ku tuba, ku gaskata bishara!”
english: and saying, “The time is fulfilled, and God’s Kingdom is at hand! Repent, and believe in the Good News.”

hausa: ’Ya’yan Haruna maza suka kawo masa jinin, ya kuma tsoma yatsarsa a cikin jinin ya zuba cikin ƙahonin bagade; sauran jinin kuwa ya zuba a gindin bagaden.
english: The sons of Aaron presented the blood to him; and he dipped his finger in the blood, and put it on the horns of the altar, and poured out the blood at the base of the altar;

hausa: Akwai wani mutum daga Ramatayim, mutumin Zuf daga ƙasar tuddan Efraim, sunansa Elkana, ɗan Yeroham, shi jikan Elihu ɗan Tohu, tattaɓa kunnen Zuf, mutumin Efraim.
english: Now there was a certain man of Ramathaim Zophim, of the hill country of Ephraim, and his name was Elkanah, the son of Jeroham, the son of Elihu, the son of Tohu, the son of Zuph, an Ephraimite.

hausa: ya zaunar da su tare da sarakuna, tare da sarakunan mutanensu.
english: that he may set him with princes, even with the princes of his people.

hausa: Zai nuna muku wani babban ɗakin sama da aka shirya domin baƙi. Ku yi mana shirin a can.”
english: He will himself show you a large upper room furnished and ready. Get ready for us there.”

hausa: Sai hannu ya taɓa ni ya sa makyarkyata a hannuna da ƙafafuna.
english: Behold, a hand touched me, which set me on my knees and on the palms of my hands.

hausa: In matalauci ne, kada ku kwana da abin da zai bayar a matsayin jingina a wurinku.
english: If he is a poor man, you shall not sleep with his pledge.

hausa: Da suka iso Kwarin Eshkol, sai suka yanko reshe guda na nonon inabi tare da ’ya’yansa cunkus. Mutum biyu suka ɗauka shi rataye a sanda a kafaɗarsu, suka haɗa tare da rumman da kuma ɓaure.
english: They came to the valley of Eshcol, and cut down from there a branch with one cluster of grapes, and they bore it on a staff between two. They also brought some of the pomegranates and figs.

hausa: Ya shirya makamansa masu dafi; ya shirya kibiyoyinsa masu wuta.
english: He has also prepared for himself the instruments of death. He makes ready his flaming arrows.

hausa: Ana ba da labari cewa ana lalata a cikinku, irin da ba a ma samu a cikin masu bautar gumaka. Har mutum yana kwana da matar mahaifinsa.
english: It is actually reported that there is sexual immorality among you, and such sexual immorality as is not even named among the Gentiles, that one has his father’s wife.

hausa: Da lokaci ya yi da Ubangiji zai ɗauki Iliya zuwa sama cikin guguwa, Iliya da Elisha kuwa suna kan hanyarsu daga Gilgal.
english: When Yahweh was about to take Elijah up by a whirlwind into heaven, Elijah went with Elisha from Gilgal.

hausa: Takan yi wa gadonta kayan shimfiɗa; tufafinta kuma na lilin ne mai laushi na shunayya.
english: She makes for herself carpets of tapestry. Her clothing is fine linen and purple.

hausa: Suka yi daro da gammonsa da tagulla daga madubai na mata masu yin aiki a ƙofar Tentin Sujada.
english: He made the basin of bronze, and its base of bronze, out of the mirrors of the ministering women who ministered at the door of the Tent of Meeting.

hausa: Dawuda ya kuma ce wa Solomon ɗansa, “Ka yi ƙarfin hali, ka kuma yi aikin. Kada ka ji tsoro ko ka fid da zuciya, gama Ubangiji Allah, Allahna, yana tare da kai. Ba zai bari ka ji kunya ko yă yashe ka ba, sai an gama dukan aikin saboda hidimar haikalin Ubangiji.
english: David said to Solomon his son, “Be strong and courageous, and do it. Don’t be afraid, nor be dismayed, for Yahweh God, even my God, is with you. He will not fail you nor forsake you, until all the work for the service of Yahweh’s house is finished.

hausa: Ka tashi, ya Ubangiji, kada ka bar wani yă yi nasara; bari a hukunta al’ummai a gabanka.
english: Arise, Yahweh! Don’t let man prevail. Let the nations be judged in your sight.

hausa: Ubangiji zai bishe ku kullum; zai biya muku bukatunku a ƙasa mai zafin rana ya kuma ƙarfafa ƙasusuwanku. Za ku zama kamar lambun da aka yi masa banruwa, kamar rafin da ruwansa ba ya ƙafewa.
english: and Yahweh will guide you continually, satisfy your soul in dry places, and make your bones strong. You will be like a watered garden, and like a spring of water whose waters don’t fail.

hausa: Waɗannan su ne kalmomin Dawuda na ƙarshe. “Abubuwan da Dawuda ɗan Yesse ya yi magana a kai, abubuwan da mutumin da Mafi Ɗaukaka ya girmama. Mutumin da Allah na Yaƙub ya zaɓa yă zama sarki, wanda kuma yake mawaƙi waƙoƙin Isra’ila.
english: Now these are the last words of David. David the son of Jesse says, the man who was raised on high says, the anointed of the God of Jacob, the sweet psalmist of Israel:

hausa: Sai Bulus da Barnabas suka amsa musu gabagadi, suka ce, “Ya zama mana dole mu yi muku maganar Allah da farko. Da yake kun ƙi ta ba ku kuma ga kun cancanci rai madawwami ba, to, za mu juya ga Al’ummai.
english: Paul and Barnabas spoke out boldly, and said, “It was necessary that God’s word should be spoken to you first. Since indeed you thrust it from yourselves, and judge yourselves unworthy of eternal life, behold, we turn to the Gentiles.

hausa: ashe, hidimar Ruhu ba za tă fi wannan ɗaukaka ba?
english: won’t service of the Spirit be with much more glory?

hausa: “Bayan haka, na duba, a gabana kuwa ga wata dabba wadda ta yi kamar Damisa, a bayanta kuma tana da fikafikai huɗu irin na tsuntsu. Wannan dabbar tana da kawuna huɗu, aka kuma ba ta iko tă yi mulki.
english: “After this I saw, and behold, another, like a leopard, which had on its back four wings of a bird. The animal also had four heads; and dominion was given to it.

hausa: Sai ta rubuta wasiƙu a sunan Ahab, ta buga hatiminsa a kansu, sa’an nan ta aika su ga dattawa da manyan gari waɗanda suke zama a birnin da Nabot yake.
english: So she wrote letters in Ahab’s name and sealed them with his seal, and sent the letters to the elders and to the nobles who were in his city, who lived with Naboth.

hausa: Bai kamata ki tsaya a mararraba don ki kashe waɗanda suke ƙoƙarin tserewa ba, ko ki ba da waɗanda suka tsere ga hannun maƙiyansu a ranar wahalarsu ba.
english: Don’t stand in the crossroads to cut off those of his who escape. Don’t deliver up those of his who remain in the day of distress.

hausa: Dukan ’ya’yan Lawiyawa maza daga wata ɗaya zuwa gaba, jimillarsu ta kai 23,000. Ba a ƙidaya su tare da sauran Isra’ilawa ba, domin ba a ba su gādo tare da su ba.
english: Those who were counted of them were twenty-three thousand, every male from a month old and upward; for they were not counted among the children of Israel, because there was no inheritance given them among the children of Israel.

hausa: Sai Ubangiji ya ce wa Musa,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

hausa: na tara a kan Yeshuwa, na goma a kan Shekaniya,
english: the ninth to Jeshua, the tenth to Shecaniah,

hausa: Amma in ba za ka aika da shi ba, ba za mu gangara ba, gama mutumin ya ce mana, ‘Ba za ku sāke ganin fuskata ba sai ko in ɗan’uwanku yana tare da ku.’ ”
english: but if you don’t send him, we won’t go down, for the man said to us, ‘You shall not see my face, unless your brother is with you.’”

hausa: Ku zo, ’ya’yana, ku saurare ni; zan koya muku tsoron Ubangiji.
english: Come, you children, listen to me. I will teach you the fear of Yahweh.

hausa: Masu ɓata sunana suna bina dukan yini; da yawa suna kai mini hari cikin fariyarsu.
english: My enemies want to swallow me up all day long, for they are many who fight proudly against me.

hausa: Sai dukan mutanen ƙasar suka tafi haikalin Ba’al suka rushe shi. Suka farfasa bagadai da kuma gumaka, suka kuma kashe Mattan wanda yake firist na Ba’al a gaban bagade. Sa’an nan Yehohiyada firist ya sa matsara a haikalin Ubangiji.
english: All the people of the land went to the house of Baal, and broke it down. They broke his altars and his images in pieces thoroughly, and killed Mattan the priest of Baal before the altars. The priest appointed officers over Yahweh’s house.

hausa: Ban taɓa zauna a cikin ’yan tawaye ba, ban taɓa yi murna da su ba; na zauna ni kaɗai domin hannunka yana a kaina ka kuma sa na cika da haushi.
english: I didn’t sit in the assembly of those who make merry and rejoice. I sat alone because of your hand, for you have filled me with indignation.

hausa: ɗan Mika’ilu, ɗan Ba’asehiya, ɗan Malkiya,
english: the son of Michael, the son of Baaseiah, the son of Malchijah,

hausa: suka kuma yi amfani da su, suka sayi filin mai yin tukwane, kamar yadda Ubangiji ya umarce ni.”
english: and they gave them for the potter’s field, as the Lord commanded me.”

hausa: “ ‘Saboda haka, farawa daga ranar goma sha biyar ga watan bakwai, bayan kun tara hatsin gona, ku yi bikin Ubangiji kwana bakwai; rana ta fari, rana hutu ce, rana ta takwas kuma rana hutu ce.
english: “‘So on the fifteenth day of the seventh month, when you have gathered in the fruits of the land, you shall keep the feast of Yahweh seven days. On the first day shall be a solemn rest, and on the eighth day shall be a solemn rest.

hausa: Gama Ubangiji ya riga ya gaya wa waɗancan Isra’ilawa cewa lalle za su mutu a hamada, kuma ba ko ɗayansu da ya rage, sai Kaleb ɗan Yefunne da Yoshuwa ɗan Nun.
english: For Yahweh had said of them, “They shall surely die in the wilderness.” There was not a man left of them, except Caleb the son of Jephunneh, and Joshua the son of Nun.

hausa: sarkin Urushalima, ɗaya sarkin Hebron, ɗaya
english: the king of Jerusalem, one; the king of Hebron, one;

hausa: Ka koya mini hanyarka, ya Ubangiji, zan kuwa yi tafiya cikin gaskiyarka; ka ba ni zuciya wadda ba tă rabu ba, don in ji tsoron sunanka.
english: Teach me your way, Yahweh. I will walk in your truth. Make my heart undivided to fear your name.

hausa: Sa’ad da ya yi tsawa, ruwaye a cikin sammai sukan yi ƙugi; yakan sa gizagizai su taso daga iyakokin duniya. Yakan aiki walƙiya da ruwan sama ya fitar da iska daga gidajen ajiyarsa.
english: When he utters his voice, the waters in the heavens roar, and he causes the vapors to ascend from the ends of the earth. He makes lightnings for the rain, and brings the wind out of his treasuries.

hausa: Ubangiji, Ubangiji Maɗaukaki ya kira ku a wannan rana don ku yi kuka ku yi ihu, don ku aske gashinku ku kuma sa tsummoki.
english: In that day, the Lord, Yahweh of Armies, called to weeping, to mourning, to baldness, and to dressing in sackcloth;

hausa: Maganar Ubangiji ta zo mini cewa,
english: Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

hausa: Ubangiji kuwa yana tare da mutane Yahuda. Suka mallaki ƙasar tudu, amma ba su iya suka kori mutanen daga filaye ba, domin suna da keken yaƙin ƙarfe.
english: Yahweh was with Judah, and drove out the inhabitants of the hill country; for he could not drive out the inhabitants of the valley, because they had chariots of iron.

hausa: Sai Irmiya ya amsa ya ce, “Na ji ku, tabbatacce zan yi addu’a ga Ubangiji Allahnku yadda kuka roƙa; zan faɗa muku duk abin da Ubangiji ya faɗa ba kuwa zan ɓoye muku kome ba.”
english: Then Jeremiah the prophet said to them, “I have heard you. Behold, I will pray to Yahweh your God according to your words; and it will happen that whatever thing Yahweh answers you, I will declare it to you. I will keep nothing back from you.”

hausa: Mefiboshet ya rusuna ya ce, “Ni ne wa har da za ka kula da ni? Ai! Ni bawanka ne da bai ma fi mataccen kare daraja ba.”
english: He bowed down, and said, “What is your servant, that you should look at such a dead dog as I am?”

hausa: Game da ɗayan gefen, gefen arewa na tabanakul, za ka kafa katakai ashirin,
english: For the second side of the tabernacle, on the north side, twenty boards,

hausa: Sa’an nan zan ba ku makiyaya da suke yin abin da zuciyata take so, waɗanda za su bishe ku da sani da kuma fahimi.
english: I will give you shepherds according to my heart, who will feed you with knowledge and understanding.

hausa: Mai gadin yakan buɗe wa makiyayin ƙofa, tumakin kuma sukan saurari muryarsa. Yakan kira tumakinsa da suna, yă kuma fid da su waje.
english: The gatekeeper opens the gate for him, and the sheep listen to his voice. He calls his own sheep by name and leads them out.

hausa: Kuma ikkilisiya ce jikinsa; ta kuma cika da Kiristi, wanda ya cika kome ta kowace hanya.
english: which is his body, the fullness of him who fills all in all.

hausa: Sukan ji kunyar halin banƙyamarsu kuwa? Sam, ba su da kunya ko kaɗan; ba su ma san yadda za su ji kunya ba. Saboda haka sukan fāɗi tare da fāɗaɗɗu; za su fāɗi sa’ad da aka hukunta su, in ji Ubangiji.
english: Were they ashamed when they had committed abomination? No, they were not at all ashamed. They couldn’t blush. Therefore they will fall among those who fall. In the time of their visitation they will be cast down, says Yahweh.

hausa: A wajen arewa shi ma, tsawon yă zama ƙafa ɗari. Ka kama labulen da ƙugiyoyin da aka yi da azurfa waɗanda aka manna a kan ƙarfen da aka dalaye da azurfa.
