english: Likewise for the length of the north side, there shall be hangings one hundred cubits long, and its pillars twenty, and their sockets twenty, of bronze; the hooks of the pillars, and their fillets, of silver.

hausa: Shi kuma wanda yake binciken zukatanmu ya san halin Ruhu, domin Ruhu yana roƙo a madadin tsarkaka bisa ga nufin Allah.
english: He who searches the hearts knows what is on the Spirit’s mind, because he makes intercession for the saints according to God.

hausa: Sai Yesu ya ba su wannan amsa cewa, “Gaskiya nake gaya muku, Ɗan ba ya iya yin kome da kansa; yana yin abin da ya ga Ubansa yake yi ne kawai, gama duk abin da Uban yake yi shi ne Ɗan ma yake yi.
english: Jesus therefore answered them, “Most certainly, I tell you, the Son can do nothing of himself, but what he sees the Father doing. For whatever things he does, these the Son also does likewise.

hausa: “Wannan Musa ɗin da suka ƙi suna cewa, ‘Wa ya mai da kai mai mulki da kuma alƙali?’ Allah da kansa ya aike shi, ta wurin mala’ikan da ya bayyana a gare shi a ɗan itace, yă zama mai mulkinsu, da kuma mai cetonsu.
english: “This Moses whom they refused, saying, ‘Who made you a ruler and a judge?’—God has sent him as both a ruler and a deliverer by the hand of the angel who appeared to him in the bush.

hausa: Saboda haka Yefta ya tafi tare da dattawan Gileyad, mutanen kuwa suka naɗa shi shugabansu da kuma sarkinsu. Ya kuwa maimaita dukan maganarsa a gaban Ubangiji a Mizfa.
english: Then Jephthah went with the elders of Gilead, and the people made him head and chief over them. Jephthah spoke all his words before Yahweh in Mizpah.

hausa: Saboda haka muna aika Yahuda da Sila don su tabbatar muku da baki abin da muka rubuta.
english: We have sent therefore Judas and Silas, who themselves will also tell you the same things by word of mouth.

hausa: Na lura da hanyoyina na kuma mayar da matakaina ga farillanka.
english: I considered my ways, and turned my steps to your statutes.

hausa: Wanda yake da cikin mugunta ya kuma ɗauki cikin damuwa yakan haifi ƙarya.
english: Behold, he travails with iniquity. Yes, he has conceived mischief, and brought out falsehood.

hausa: Kada ku haɗa bijimi da jaki su yi noma tare.
english: You shall not plow with an ox and a donkey together.

hausa: Sai na tsawata wa shugabanni na kuma tambaye su na ce, “Me ya sa aka ƙyale gidan Allah?” Sa’an nan na kira su gaba ɗaya na sa su a wuraren aikinsu.
english: Then I contended with the rulers, and said, “Why is God’s house forsaken?” I gathered them together, and set them in their place.

hausa: Za ka shigar da biyu na dukan halittu masu rai, namiji da ta mace a cikin jirgin, domin su rayu tare da kai.
english: Of every living thing of all flesh, you shall bring two of every sort into the ship, to keep them alive with you. They shall be male and female.

hausa: Mun kuma san cewa a cikin dukan abubuwa Allah yana aikata alheri ga waɗanda suke ƙaunarsa, yana waɗanda aka kira bisa ga nufinsa.
english: We know that all things work together for good for those who love God, for those who are called according to his purpose.

hausa: Fahimi shi ne maɓulɓular rai ga waɗanda suke da shi, amma wauta kan kawo hukunci ga wawaye.
english: Understanding is a fountain of life to one who has it, but the punishment of fools is their folly.

hausa: (Zelofehad ɗan Hefer, ba shi da ’ya’ya maza; ’yan mata ne kaɗai ya haifa, sunayensu kuwa su ne Mala, Nowa, Hogla, Milka da Tirza.)
english: Zelophehad the son of Hepher had no sons, but daughters: and the names of the daughters of Zelophehad were Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.

hausa: “Ka ɗauke shi ka lura da shi da kyau, kada ka yi masa wani mugun abu, amma ka yi masa dukan abin da yake so.”
english: “Take him and take care of him. Do him no harm; but do to him even as he tells you.”

hausa: Hanani, ɗaya daga cikin ’yan’uwana, ya zo daga Yahuda tare da waɗansu mutane. Na kuwa tambaye shi game da raguwar Yahudawan da suka tsira daga kwasan zuwa zaman bauta, da kuma game da Urushalima.
english: Hanani, one of my brothers, came, he and certain men out of Judah; and I asked them about the Jews who had escaped, who were left of the captivity, and concerning Jerusalem.

hausa: Amma mutanen Isra’ila suka ƙarfafa juna, suka sāke koma inda suka ja dāgā a rana ta farko.
english: The people, the men of Israel, encouraged themselves, and set the battle again in array in the place where they set themselves in array the first day.

hausa: Da a ce dukan jiki gaɓa ɗaya ne, da ina sauran jikin?
english: If they were all one member, where would the body be?

hausa: Don haka ina farin ciki in kashe dukan abin da nake da shi a kanku, har in ba da kaina ma dominku. In na ƙaunace ku fiye da haka, za ku rage ƙaunarku gare ni ne?
english: I will most gladly spend and be spent for your souls. If I love you more abundantly, am I loved the less?

hausa: “Kun dai ji an faɗa, ‘Ido domin ido, haƙori kuma domin haƙori.’
english: “You have heard that it was said, ‘An eye for an eye, and a tooth for a tooth.’

hausa: “Kaitonka mai gardama da Wanda ya yi ka, da wanda yake kasko a cikin kasko a ƙasa. Yumɓu ya iya ce wa magini, ‘Me kake yi?’ Aikinka na iya cewa, ‘Ba shi da hannuwa’?
english: Woe to him who strives with his Maker— a clay pot among the clay pots of the earth! Shall the clay ask him who fashions it, ‘What are you making?’ or your work, ‘He has no hands’?

hausa: Kai ne Sarkina da kuma Allahna, wanda ya ba da nasarori wa Yaƙub.
english: God, you are my King. Command victories for Jacob!

hausa: To, ta yaya za su kira ga wanda ba su gaskata ba? Ta yaya kuma za su gaskata wanda ba su taɓa ji ba? Ta yaya kuma za su ji ba tare da wani ya yi musu wa’azi ba?
english: How then will they call on him in whom they have not believed? How will they believe in him whom they have not heard? How will they hear without a preacher?

hausa: “Ya Ubangiji Maɗaukaki, Allah na Isra’ila, ka bayyana wa bawanka cewa, ‘Zan gina maka gida.’ Saboda haka bawanka ya sami ƙarfin hali yă miƙa maka wannan addu’a.
english: For you, Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel, have revealed to your servant, saying, ‘I will build you a house.’ Therefore your servant has found in his heart to pray this prayer to you.

hausa: Bayan ya ɓatar da kome, sai ga muguwar yunwa a dukan ƙasar, har ya shiga rashi.
english: When he had spent all of it, there arose a severe famine in that country, and he began to be in need.

hausa: Dawuda ya yi tunani a ransa ya ce, “Zan yi wa Hanun ɗan Nahash alheri kamar yadda mahaifinsa ya yi mini.” Saboda haka sai Dawuda ya aiki jakadu su yi masa ta’aziyyar mutuwar mahaifinsa. Sa’ad da mutanen Dawuda suka isa ƙasar Ammonawa,
english: David said, “I will show kindness to Hanun the son of Nahash, as his father showed kindness to me.” So David sent by his servants to comfort him concerning his father. David’s servants came into the land of the children of Ammon.

hausa: daga kabilar Naftali kuwa suka sami Kedesh a Galili, Hammon da Kiriyatayim, tare da wuraren kiwonsu.
english: and out of the tribe of Naphtali, Kedesh in Galilee with its pasture lands, Hammon with its pasture lands, and Kiriathaim with its pasture lands.

hausa: Ina da ganewa sosai fiye da dukan malamaina, gama ina tunani a kan farillanka.
english: I have more understanding than all my teachers, for your testimonies are my meditation.

hausa: Artazerzes, sarkin sarakuna. Zuwa ga Ezra firist, malamin Dokar Allah na sama. Gaisuwa.
english: Artaxerxes, king of kings, To Ezra the priest, the scribe of the law of the perfect God of heaven. Now

hausa: Gama Allah bai ba ta hikima ba ko kuma iya fahimta.
english: because God has deprived her of wisdom, neither has he imparted to her understanding.

hausa: Ta haka, Yahudawa suka yarda su ci gaba da bikin da suka fara, suna aikata abin da Mordekai ya rubuta musu.
english: The Jews accepted the custom that they had begun, as Mordecai had written to them,

hausa: Ki dai yarda da laifinki kin yi wa Ubangiji Allahnki tawaye, kin watsar da alheranki ga baƙin alloli a ƙarƙashin kowane itace mai duhuwa, ba ki kuwa yi mini biyayya ba,’ ” in ji Ubangiji.
english: Only acknowledge your iniquity, that you have transgressed against Yahweh your God, and have scattered your ways to the strangers under every green tree, and you have not obeyed my voice,’” says Yahweh.

hausa: “Za a yi alamu a cikin rana, da cikin wata, da cikin taurari. A duniya, al’ummai za su yi baƙin ciki, su kuma rikice don tsoro, saboda ruri da kuma tafasar teku.
english: “There will be signs in the sun, moon, and stars; and on the earth anxiety of nations, in perplexity for the roaring of the sea and the waves;

hausa: Mutanen Isra’ila suka fita yaƙi da mutane Benyamin suka kuma ja dāgār yaƙi a Gibeya.
english: The men of Israel went out to battle against Benjamin; and the men of Israel set the battle in array against them at Gibeah.

hausa: Matuƙan jiragenki sun kai ki can cikin manyan tekuna. Amma iskar gabas za tă farfasa ki kucu-kucu a tsakiyar teku.
english: Your rowers have brought you into great waters. The east wind has broken you in the heart of the seas.

hausa: Yabe shi saboda ayyukansa masu iko; yabe shi saboda mafificin girmansa.
english: Praise him for his mighty acts! Praise him according to his excellent greatness!

hausa: da kowace halitta mai rai wadda ta kasance tare da kai; wato, tsuntsaye da dabbobin gida da kuma dukan namun jeji, duk dai iyakar abin da ya fita daga jirgin; wato, kowane mai rai na duniya.
english: and with every living creature that is with you: the birds, the livestock, and every animal of the earth with you, of all that go out of the ship, even every animal of the earth.

hausa: Na faɗa haka don amfaninku ne, ba don in ƙuntata muku ba. Sai dai don ku yi rayuwa a hanyar da ta dace da nufin ku himmantu ga bautar Ubangiji ba da raba hankali ba.
english: This I say for your own benefit, not that I may ensnare you, but for that which is appropriate, and that you may attend to the Lord without distraction.

hausa: Duk abincin za ku ci, da ruwan da za ku sha, za ku biya su.’ ”
english: You shall purchase food from them for money, that you may eat. You shall also buy water from them for money, that you may drink.’”

hausa: Gama tabbatacce abokan gābanka, ya Ubangiji, tabbatacce abokan gābanka za su hallaka; za a watsar da dukan masu aikata mugunta.
english: For behold, your enemies, Yahweh, for behold, your enemies shall perish. All the evildoers will be scattered.

hausa: Ya Ubangiji Allahna, na yi kira gare ka don taimako ka kuwa warkar da ni.
english: Yahweh my God, I cried to you, and you have healed me.

hausa: A rana ta huɗu sai suka taru a Kwarin Beraka, inda suka yabi Ubangiji. Wannan ne ya sa ake kiransa Kwarin Beraka har wa yau.
english: On the fourth day, they assembled themselves in Beracah Valley, for there they blessed Yahweh. Therefore the name of that place was called “Beracah Valley” to this day.

hausa: Sai samari suka zo gaba, suka naɗe gawarsa, suka fitar da shi suka je suka binne.
english: The young men arose and wrapped him up, and they carried him out and buried him.

hausa: Na auna musu zinariya da azurfa, da kwanoni waɗanda sarki da mashawartansa, da sauran abokan aikinsa, da Isra’ilawan da suke can suka bayar domin haikalin Allahnmu.
english: and weighed to them the silver, the gold, and the vessels, even the offering for the house of our God, which the king, his counselors, his princes, and all Israel there present, had offered.

hausa: Yesu ya amsa masa ya ce, “A rubuce yake kuma cewa, ‘Kada ka gwada Ubangiji Allahnka.’”
english: Jesus said to him, “Again, it is written, ‘You shall not test the Lord, your God.’”

hausa: na Kiriyat Yeyarim, da Kefira Beyerot 743
english: The children of Kiriath Arim, Chephirah, and Beeroth, seven hundred forty-three.

hausa: Ta wurin albarkar mai aikata gaskiya birni kan ƙasaita, amma ta wurin bakin mugu akan hallaka birnin.
english: By the blessing of the upright, the city is exalted, but it is overthrown by the mouth of the wicked.

hausa: Isra’ilawa za su kiyaye Asabbaci, suna bikinsa daga tsara zuwa tsara a matsayin madawwamin alkawari.
english: Therefore the children of Israel shall keep the Sabbath, to observe the Sabbath throughout their generations, for a perpetual covenant.

hausa: Suka tashi daga Kibrot Hatta’awa, suka yi sansani a Hazerot.
english: They traveled from Kibroth Hattaavah, and encamped in Hazeroth.

hausa: Sai ’ya’yan Yaƙub suka isa Masar tare da sauran mutanen don sayen abinci, gama yunwar ta kai yankin Kan’ana ma.
english: The sons of Israel came to buy among those who came, for the famine was in the land of Canaan.

hausa: Zuriyar Shobal mahaifin Kiriyat Yeyarim su ne, Harowe, rabin Manahatiyawa,
english: Shobal the father of Kiriath Jearim had sons: Haroeh, half of the Menuhoth.

hausa: A lokacin da Hiridus ne yake sarautar Yahudiya, an yi wani firist mai suna Zakariya, na sashin firistoci gidan Abiya. Matarsa Elizabet ma ’yar zuriyar Haruna ce.
english: There was in the days of Herod, the king of Judea, a certain priest named Zacharias, of the priestly division of Abijah. He had a wife of the daughters of Aaron, and her name was Elizabeth.

hausa: Idanunmu sun gaji, suna ta dubawa ko taimako zai zo; mu sa ido ko za mu ga ƙasar da za tă iya taimakon mu.
english: Our eyes still fail, looking in vain for our help. In our watching we have watched for a nation that could not save.

hausa: Sai Eliyakim ɗan Hilkiya sarkin fada, Shebna magatakarda, da kuma Yowa ɗan Asaf marubuci suka tafi wurin Hezekiya, da rigunansu a kyakkece, suka kuwa faɗa masa abin da sarkin yaƙin ya yi ta farfaɗa.
english: Then Eliakim the son of Hilkiah, who was over the household, and Shebna the scribe, and Joah, the son of Asaph the recorder, came to Hezekiah with their clothes torn, and told him the words of Rabshakeh.

hausa: Ko da sun tona rami kamar zurfin kabari, daga can hannuna zai fitar da su. Ko da sun hau can sama daga can zan sauko da su.
english: Though they dig into Sheol, there my hand will take them; and though they climb up to heaven, there I will bring them down.

hausa: Sa’ad da Ɗan Ragon ya buɗe hatimi na biyun, sai na ji halitta mai rai na biyu ya ce, “Zo!”
english: When he opened the second seal, I heard the second living creature saying, “Come!”

hausa: Kaito, gama wannan rana za tă zama mai girma! Babu kamar ta. Zai zama lokacin wahala wa Yaƙub, amma za a cece shi daga cikinta.
english: Alas, for that day is great, so that none is like it! It is even the time of Jacob’s trouble; but he will be saved out of it.

hausa: Yaƙub ya haifi Yusuf, mijin Maryamu, wadda ta haifi Yesu, wanda ake kira Kiristi.
english: Jacob became the father of Joseph, the husband of Mary, from whom was born Jesus, who is called Christ.

hausa: Sai Dawuda ya fita don yă tarye su, ya kuma ce musu, “In kun zo wurina da salama, don ku taimake ni, to, ina a shirye in bar ku ku haɗa kai tare da ni. Amma in kun zo don ku bashe ni ga abokan gābana sa’ad da hannuwana ba su da laifi a rikici, bari Allah na kakanninmu yă duba yă kuma shari’anta ku.”
english: David went out to meet them, and answered them, “If you have come peaceably to me to help me, my heart will be united with you; but if you have come to betray me to my adversaries, since there is no wrong in my hands, may the God of our fathers see this and rebuke it.”

hausa: Ina rubuta waɗannan abubuwa gare ku, ku da kuka gaskata sunan Ɗan Allah domin ku san kuna da rai madawwami.
english: These things I have written to you who believe in the name of the Son of God, that you may know that you have eternal life, and that you may continue to believe in the name of the Son of God.

hausa: Suka yi ta zuwa wurinsa suna cewa, “Ranka yă daɗe, sarkin Yahudawa!” Suna ta marinsa a fuska.
english: They kept saying, “Hail, King of the Jews!” and they kept slapping him.

hausa: Suka amsa suka ce, “In za ka ji tausayi waɗannan mutane ka kuma gamshe su, ka kuma ba su amsar da ta dace, kullum za su zama bayinka.”
english: They spoke to him, saying, “If you are kind to these people, please them, and speak good words to them, then they will be your servants forever.”

hausa: Dukan waɗanda suka ji shi, suka yi mamakin fahimtarsa, da amsoshinsa.
english: All who heard him were amazed at his understanding and his answers.

hausa: Suna da bakuna, amma ba sa magana, idanu, amma ba sa gani;
english: They have mouths, but they don’t speak. They have eyes, but they don’t see.

hausa: “Sa’an nan waɗanda aka bari suka sauko zuwa wajen shugabanni; mutane na Ubangiji suka zo wurina tare da masu ƙarfi.
english: “Then a remnant of the nobles and the people came down. Yahweh came down for me against the mighty.

hausa: don in ji daɗin nasarar zaɓaɓɓunka, don in sami rabo cikin farin cikin al’ummarka in kuma shiga gādonka cikin yin yabo.
english: that I may see the prosperity of your chosen, that I may rejoice in the gladness of your nation, that I may glory with your inheritance.

hausa: Wannan ita ce kāriyata ga waɗanda suke tuhumata game da manzancina.
english: My defense to those who examine me is this:

hausa: Gama duk mai son ceton ransa zai rasa shi, amma duk wanda ya rasa ransa saboda ni, zai same shi.
english: For whoever desires to save his life will lose it, and whoever will lose his life for my sake will find it.

hausa: Ubangiji ya ce wa Musa, “Na ga waɗannan mutane, mutane ne masu taurinkai.”
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “I have seen these people, and behold, they are a stiff-necked people.

hausa: Za su yi magana game da ikon ayyukanka masu bantsoro, zan kuma yi shelar manyan ayyukanka.
english: Men will speak of the might of your awesome acts. I will declare your greatness.

hausa: Saboda wannan ƙasar tana makoki, kuma dukan waɗanda suke zama a cikinta sun lalace; namun jeji da tsuntsayen sararin sama da kuma kifin teku suna mutuwa.
english: Therefore the land will mourn, and everyone who dwells in it will waste away, with all living things in her, even the animals of the field and the birds of the sky; yes, the fish of the sea also die.

hausa: Sai maganar Ubangiji ta zo mini cewa,
english: Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

hausa: Tsawon kwanakinmu shekaru saba’in ne, ko tamanin, in muna da ƙarfi; duk da haka tsawonsu wahaloli ne kawai da ɓacin rai, gama da sauri suke wucewa, ta mu kuma ta ƙare.
english: The days of our years are seventy, or even by reason of strength eighty years; yet their pride is but labor and sorrow, for it passes quickly, and we fly away.

hausa: Shi ne hadayar kafara saboda zunubanmu, kuma ba don namu kaɗai ba amma har ma da zunuban duniya duka.
english: And he is the atoning sacrifice for our sins, and not for ours only, but also for the whole world.

hausa: Suka harhaɗa labule biyar wuri ɗaya, suka kuma harhaɗa shida wuri ɗaya.
english: He coupled five curtains by themselves, and six curtains by themselves.

hausa: Sai Ubangiji ya ce wa Musa, “Duba, na maishe ka kamar Allah ga Fir’auna, ɗan’uwanka Haruna kuma zai zama annabinka.
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “Behold, I have made you as God to Pharaoh; and Aaron your brother shall be your prophet.

hausa: Kuma albarka ta tabbata ga Allah Mafi Ɗaukaka wanda ya ba da maƙiyanka a hannunka.” Sa’an nan Abram ya ba shi kashi ɗaya bisa goma na kome.
english: Blessed be God Most High, who has delivered your enemies into your hand.” Abram gave him a tenth of all.

hausa: Sa’an nan Bala’am ya tafi tare da Balak zuwa Kiriyat-Huzot,
english: Balaam went with Balak, and they came to Kiriath Huzoth.

hausa: amma a waɗannan kwanaki a ƙarshe ya yi magana da mu ta wurin Ɗansa, wanda ya naɗa magājin dukan abubuwa, wanda kuma ta wurinsa ya halicci duniya.
english: has at the end of these days spoken to us by his Son, whom he appointed heir of all things, through whom also he made the worlds.

hausa: Ka ba mu taimako a kan abokin gāba, gama taimakon mutum banza ne.
english: Give us help against the enemy, for the help of man is vain.

hausa: sai Ubangiji Allahnmu ya ba da shi gare mu, muka kuwa buga shi tare da ’ya’yansa maza da kuma dukan sojojinsa.
english: Yahweh our God delivered him up before us; and we struck him, his sons, and all his people.

hausa: Yowash yana da shekara bakwai sa’ad da ya fara mulki.
english: Jehoash was seven years old when he began to reign.

hausa: Ga abin da Ubangiji ya umarta saboda ’ya’ya matan nan na Zelofehad. Za su iya auri duk wanda suka ga dama, muddin sun yi aure a cikin kabilar kakanninsu.
english: This is the thing which Yahweh commands concerning the daughters of Zelophehad, saying, ‘Let them be married to whom they think best, only they shall marry into the family of the tribe of their father.

hausa: Ya ce, “Ya Abba,Uba, kome mai yiwuwa ne a gare ka. Ka ɗauke mini wannan kwaf. Amma ba abin da nake so ba, sai dai abin da kake so.”
english: He said, “Abba, Father, all things are possible to you. Please remove this cup from me. However, not what I desire, but what you desire.”

hausa: Ku koya wa ’ya’yanku su da himma. Yi musu magana game da su sa’ad da kuke zaune a gida, da sa’ad da kuke tafiya a hanya, sa’ad da kuke kwance, da sa’ad da kuka tashi.
english: and you shall teach them diligently to your children, and shall talk of them when you sit in your house, and when you walk by the way, and when you lie down, and when you rise up.

hausa: da ƙodoji biyu da kitsen da yake a bisansu kusa da kwiɓi, da kuma rufin hanta, wanda za a cire tare da ƙodoji.
english: and he shall take away the two kidneys, and the fat that is on them, which is by the loins, and the cover on the liver, with the kidneys;

hausa: Amma Hannatu kuwa sai yă ba ta babban rabo gama yana ƙaunarta ko da yake Ubangiji ya kulle mahaifarta.
english: but he gave a double portion to Hannah, for he loved Hannah, but Yahweh had shut up her womb.

hausa: Sa’ad da aka shirya kome haka, sai firistoci suka shiga kullum cikin ɗaki na waje don su yi hidimarsu.
english: Now these things having been thus prepared, the priests go in continually into the first tabernacle, accomplishing the services,

hausa: gama Yohanna ya dinga ce masa, “Ba daidai ba ne ka aure ta.”
english: For John said to him, “It is not lawful for you to have her.”

hausa: Zan juyar da kai, in sa ƙugiyoyi a muƙamuƙanka in fitar da kai tare da dukan sojojinka, dawakanka, mahayan dawakanka saye da makamai, da kuma jama’a mai girma masu riƙe da garkuwoyi manya da ƙanana, dukansu da takuba a zāre.
english: I will turn you around, and put hooks into your jaws, and I will bring you out, with all your army, horses and horsemen, all of them clothed in full armor, a great company with buckler and shield, all of them handling swords;

hausa: Ya tambaye su, yaya suke, sa’an nan ya ce, “Yaya tsohon nan mahaifinku da kuka faɗa mini? Yana da rai har yanzu?”
english: He asked them of their welfare, and said, “Is your father well, the old man of whom you spoke? Is he yet alive?”

hausa: Me ya sa sunan mahaifinmu zai ɓace a kabilarsa don kawai ba shi da ɗa? Ka ba mu gādo cikin ’yan’uwan mahaifinmu.”
english: Why should the name of our father be taken away from among his family, because he had no son? Give to us a possession among the brothers of our father.”

hausa: Duk da haka zan bar mutane dubu bakwai na Isra’ila waɗanda ba su rusuna da gwiwansu wa Ba’al ba, ba su kuma sumbace shi da bakinsu ba.”
english: Yet I reserved seven thousand in Israel, all the knees of which have not bowed to Baal, and every mouth that has not kissed him.”

hausa: Amma mutanen suka ce wa Yoshuwa, “Mu dai! Za mu bauta wa Ubangiji.”
english: The people said to Joshua, “No, but we will serve Yahweh.”

hausa: Bayan haka, sai muka shirya muka kuma haura zuwa Urushalima.
english: After these days we took up our baggage and went up to Jerusalem.

hausa: Me ya sa kun taurare kanku kamar yadda Masarawa da Fir’auna suka yi? Da ya ba su matsanancin wahala, ba su bar Isra’ilawa suka tafi hanyarsu ba?
english: Why then do you harden your hearts as the Egyptians and Pharaoh hardened their hearts? When he had worked wonderfully among them, didn’t they let the people go, and they departed?

hausa: “In kun kiyaye ƙafafunku daga take Asabbaci da kuma daga aikata abin da kuka gan dama a ranata mai tsarki, in kuka kira Asabbaci ranar murna rana mai tsarki ta Ubangiji kuma mai bangirma, in kuka girmama ta ta wurin ƙin yin abin da kuka gan dama da kuma yin al’amuranku ko yin mugayen maganganu,
english: “If you turn away your foot from the Sabbath, from doing your pleasure on my holy day, and call the Sabbath a delight, and the holy of Yahweh honorable, and honor it, not doing your own ways, nor finding your own pleasure, nor speaking your own words,

hausa: Ba zai yiwu ku sha daga kwaf na Ubangiji ku kuma sha daga kwaf na aljanu ba, ba ya yiwuwa ku ci a teburin Ubangiji, ku kuma ci a teburin aljanu.
english: You can’t both drink the cup of the Lord and the cup of demons. You can’t both partake of the table of the Lord and of the table of demons.

hausa: Amma shi annabi ne ya kuma san abin da Allah ya yi masa alkawari da rantsuwa cewa zai ɗora ɗaya daga cikin zuriyarsa a kan gadon sarautarsa.
english: Therefore, being a prophet, and knowing that God had sworn with an oath to him that of the fruit of his body, according to the flesh, he would raise up the Christ to sit on his throne,

hausa: Kada ka ji tsoron masifar da za tă faru farat ɗaya ko lalacin da yakan auka wa mugaye,
english: Don’t be afraid of sudden fear, neither of the desolation of the wicked, when it comes;

hausa: A kwanakin Isra’ila ba ta da sarki; kowa ya yi abin da ya ga dama.
english: In those days there was no king in Israel. Everyone did that which was right in his own eyes.

hausa: “Na fitar da doka cewa a cikin dukan iyakar ƙasar mulkina, dole mutane su ji tsoro su kuma girmama Allah na Daniyel.
english: “I make a decree that in all the dominion of my kingdom men tremble and fear before the God of Daniel. “For he is the living God, and steadfast forever. His kingdom is that which will not be destroyed. His dominion will be even to the end.

hausa: tana kira ga masu wucewa, waɗanda suke tafiya kai tsaye a hanyarsu.
english: to call to those who pass by, who go straight on their ways,

hausa: Sai ya sāke sunkuyawa ya kuma yi rubutu a ƙasa.
english: Again he stooped down and wrote on the ground with his finger.

hausa: Ya kamata su tara dukan abincin waɗannan shekaru masu kyau da suke zuwa, su yi ajiyar hatsin a ƙarƙashin ikon Fir’auna, don a ajiye a birane don abinci.
english: Let them gather all the food of these good years that come, and store grain under the hand of Pharaoh for food in the cities, and let them keep it.

hausa: Sai ya yi tambaya ya ce, “Burodi nawa kuke da su? Je ku duba.” Da suka duba, sai suka ce, “Biyar da kifi biyu.”
english: He said to them, “How many loaves do you have? Go see.” When they knew, they said, “Five, and two fish.”

hausa: Ga shi nan yana magana a fili, su kuma ba su ce masa uffam ba. Ko hukumomi sun yarda cewa shi ne Kiristi?
english: Behold, he speaks openly, and they say nothing to him. Can it be that the rulers indeed know that this is truly the Christ?

hausa: Maigidana ya sa na yi rantsuwa, ya kuma ce, ‘Kada ka ɗauko wa ɗana mata daga ’ya’ya matan Kan’aniyawa, waɗanda nake zama a ƙasarsu,
english: My master made me swear, saying, ‘You shall not take a wife for my son from the daughters of the Canaanites, in whose land I live,

hausa: Yarinyar kuwa kyakkyawa ce, budurwa, ba namijin da ya taɓa kwana da ita. Ta gangara zuwa rijiyar, ta cika tulunta ta kuma hauro.
english: The young lady was very beautiful to look at, a virgin. No man had known her. She went down to the spring, filled her pitcher, and came up.

hausa: Duk wanda ya haƙa rami shi ne zai fāɗa a ciki; duk wanda ya rushe katanga, shi maciji zai sara.
english: He who digs a pit may fall into it; and whoever breaks through a wall may be bitten by a snake.

hausa: “Na ji cewa, yanzu lokacin askin tumaki ne. Sa’ad da makiyayanka suke tare da mu, ba mu cuce su ba, kuma duk zamansu a Karmel ba abin da yake nasu da ya ɓata.
english: Now I have heard that you have shearers. Your shepherds have now been with us, and we didn’t harm them. Nothing was missing from them all the time they were in Carmel.

hausa: Ku bubbuge garemaninku su zama takuba da kuma laujenku su zama māsu. Bari raunana su ce, “Ni mai ƙarfi ne!”
english: Beat your plowshares into swords, and your pruning hooks into spears. Let the weak say, ‘I am strong.’

hausa: Aka ba wa iyalan Merari (sauran Lawiyawa) garuruwa, daga kabilar Zebulun, wato, Yokneyam, Karta,
english: To the families of the children of Merari, the rest of the Levites, out of the tribe of Zebulun, Jokneam with its pasture lands, Kartah with its pasture lands,

hausa: Sa’ad da kuka kai wannan wuri, Sihon sarkin Heshbon, da Og sarkin Bashan, suka fito don su yi yaƙi da mu, amma muka ci su da yaƙi.
english: When you came to this place, Sihon the king of Heshbon and Og the king of Bashan came out against us to battle, and we struck them.

hausa: “Amma Ibrahim ya ce, ‘Ka tuna fa ɗana, a lokacin da kake duniya, ka sami abubuwa masu kyau naka, Lazarus kuwa ya sami munanan abubuwa. Amma yanzu ya sami ta’aziyya a nan, kai kuwa kana shan azaba.
english: “But Abraham said, ‘Son, remember that you, in your lifetime, received your good things, and Lazarus, in the same way, bad things. But here he is now comforted and you are in anguish.

hausa: Suka ce wa Yoshuwa, “Mu bayinku ne.” Amma Yoshuwa ya tambaye su ya ce, “Ku wane ne, kuma daga ina kuka zo?”
english: They said to Joshua, “We are your servants.” Joshua said to them, “Who are you? Where do you come from?”

hausa: Sa’an nan sarki Ahaz ya tafi Damaskus don yă sadu da Tiglat-Fileser sarkin Assuriya. Da ya kai can sai ya ga wani bagade a Damaskus, sai ya aika wa Uriya firist, da siffar bagaden, da fasalinsa, da cikakken bayanin bagaden.
english: King Ahaz went to Damascus to meet Tiglath Pileser king of Assyria, and saw the altar that was at Damascus; and King Ahaz sent to Urijah the priest a drawing of the altar and plans to build it.

hausa: Yanzu fa in za ku nuna wa maigidana alheri da aminci, ku faɗa mini, in kuma ba haka ba, ku faɗa mini, don in san hanyar da zan juya.”
english: Now if you will deal kindly and truly with my master, tell me. If not, tell me, that I may turn to the right hand, or to the left.”

hausa: Sai Bulus ya bar majami’ar ya kuma tafi ƙofar da take kusa da gidan Titus Yustus, mai yi wa Allah sujada.
english: He departed there and went into the house of a certain man named Justus, one who worshiped God, whose house was next door to the synagogue.

hausa: Rumbunanmu za su cika da kowane irin tanadi. Tumakinmu za su ƙaru ninki dubu, ninki dubu goma-goma a filayenmu;
english: Our barns are full, filled with all kinds of provision. Our sheep produce thousands and ten thousands in our fields.

hausa: (Og sarkin Bashan, ne kaɗai ya ragu cikin Refahiyawa. An yi gadonsa da ƙarfe, tsawon gadon ya fi ƙafa goma sha uku, fāɗinsa kuwa ƙafa shida ne. Yana nan a Rabba ta Ammonawa har yanzu.)
english: (For only Og king of Bashan remained of the remnant of the Rephaim. Behold, his bedstead was a bedstead of iron. Isn’t it in Rabbah of the children of Ammon? Nine cubits was its length, and four cubits its width, after the cubit of a man.)

hausa: Sa’an nan Dawuda ya ce wa dukan taron, “Ku yabi Ubangiji Allahnku.” Saboda haka suka yabi Ubangiji Allah na kakanninsu; suka rusuna suka kuma fāɗi rubda ciki a gaban Ubangiji da kuma sarki.
english: Then David said to all the assembly, “Now bless Yahweh your God!” All the assembly blessed Yahweh, the God of their fathers, and bowed down their heads and prostrated themselves before Yahweh and the king.

hausa: Amma Haruna da zuriyarsa su ne waɗanda suke miƙa hadayu a kan bagaden hadaya ta ƙonawa da kuma a kan bagaden turare haɗe da dukan abin da ake yi a Wuri Mafi Tsarki, suna yin kafara domin Isra’ila, bisa ga dukan abin da Musa bawan Allah ya umarta.
english: But Aaron and his sons offered on the altar of burnt offering, and on the altar of incense, for all the work of the most holy place, and to make atonement for Israel, according to all that Moses the servant of God had commanded.

hausa: Babu wanda ya fi Allah, saboda haka sa’ad da ya yi alkawari ga Ibrahim, sai ya rantse da sunansa,
english: For when God made a promise to Abraham, since he could swear by no one greater, he swore by himself,

hausa: Tsawon rai yana a cikin hannunta na dama; a hannunta na hagu kuwa akwai arziki da bangirma.
english: Length of days is in her right hand. In her left hand are riches and honor.

hausa: Yabe shi da ƙarar kakaki, yabe shi da garaya da molo,
english: Praise him with the sounding of the trumpet! Praise him with harp and lyre!

hausa: “ ‘Ku kiyaye Asabbaci, domin yă zama mai tsarki a gare ku. Duk wanda ya ƙazantar da shi, za a kashe shi; duk wanda ya yi wani aiki a ranar, za a ware shi daga mutane.
english: You shall keep the Sabbath therefore, for it is holy to you. Everyone who profanes it shall surely be put to death; for whoever does any work therein, that soul shall be cut off from among his people.

hausa: Allah ba marar adalci ba ne. Ba zai manta da aikinku da kuma ƙaunar da kuka nuna masa wajen taimakon mutanensa da kuma ci gaba da taimakonsu da kuke yi ba.
english: For God is not unrighteous, so as to forget your work and the labor of love which you showed toward his name, in that you served the saints, and still do serve them.

hausa: Da yawa ne, ya Ubangiji Allahna, abubuwan banmamakin da ka aikata. Abubuwan da ka shirya mana. Ba wanda zai iya faɗa maka su; a ce zan yi magana in faɗe su, za su wuce gaban misali a furta.
english: Many, Yahweh, my God, are the wonderful works which you have done, and your thoughts which are toward us. They can’t be declared back to you. If I would declare and speak of them, they are more than can be counted.

hausa: Sa’an nan za ki tuna da hanyoyinki ki kuma ji kunya sa’ad da kika karɓi ’yan’uwanki mata, waɗanda suka girme ki da kuma waɗanda kika girme su. Zan ba da su kamar ’ya’ya mata gare ki, amma ba bisa alkawarina da ke ba.
english: Then you will remember your ways and be ashamed when you receive your sisters, your elder sisters and your younger; and I will give them to you for daughters, but not by your covenant.

hausa: Da yake ya san almajiransa suna gunaguni game da wannan, sai Yesu ya ce musu, “Wannan ya ɓata muku rai ne?
english: But Jesus knowing in himself that his disciples murmured at this, said to them, “Does this cause you to stumble?

hausa: Na ba ku misali domin ku yi yadda na yi muku.
english: For I have given you an example, that you should also do as I have done to you.

hausa: Musa ya yi sauri ya rusuna har ƙasa, ya yi sujada.
english: Moses hurried and bowed his head toward the earth, and worshiped.

hausa: Dedan, Tema, Buz da dukan waɗanda suke a manisantan wurare;
english: Dedan, Tema, Buz, and all who have the corners of their beard cut off;

hausa: Firist kuwa zai yi kafara domin dukan jama’ar Isra’ilawa, za a kuma gafarta musu, gama ba da gangan ba ne suka aikata, kuma sun kawo wa Ubangiji hadayar da akan yi da wuta da kuma hadaya don zunubi saboda laifinsu.
english: The priest shall make atonement for all the congregation of the children of Israel, and they shall be forgiven; for it was an error, and they have brought their offering, an offering made by fire to Yahweh, and their sin offering before Yahweh, for their error.

hausa: Ku da kuke da yawa kamar taurari a sarari za ku ragu ku zama kaɗan, domin ba ku yi biyayya ga Ubangiji Allahnku ba.
english: You will be left few in number, even though you were as the stars of the sky for multitude, because you didn’t listen to Yahweh your God’s voice.

hausa: maharbansa sun kewaye ni. Ba tausayi, ya soke ni a ƙodata har jini ya zuba a ƙasa.
english: His archers surround me. He splits my kidneys apart, and does not spare. He pours out my bile on the ground.

hausa: Kuna kiyaye ranaku da watanni da lokuta da shekaru na musamman!
english: You observe days, months, seasons, and years.

hausa: Waɗanda suke aiki da kaɗin auduga za su karai, masu yin lilin mai kyau za su fid da zuciya.
english: Moreover those who work in combed flax, and those who weave white cloth, will be confounded.

hausa: Ya Ubangiji, kada ka yashe ni; kada ka yi nesa da ni, ya Allahna.
english: Don’t forsake me, Yahweh. My God, don’t be far from me.

hausa: Kun ɗaukaka gidan tsafin Molek, da tauraron allahnku Refan, gumakan da kuka ƙera don ku yi musu sujada. Saboda haka zan aike ku zuwa bauta’ gaba da Babilon.
english: You took up the tabernacle of Moloch, the star of your god Rephan, the figures which you made to worship, so I will carry you away beyond Babylon.’

hausa: Yahudawa suka tattaru a cikin biranensu a dukan lardunan Sarki Zerzes don su kai wa waɗanda suka nemi a hallaka su hari. Babu wanda ya tasar musu domin mutanen dukan sauran al’ummai sun jin tsoronsu.
english: the Jews gathered themselves together in their cities throughout all the provinces of the King Ahasuerus, to lay hands on those who wanted to harm them. No one could withstand them, because the fear of them had fallen on all the people.

hausa: Samson kuwa ya shugabanci Isra’ila shekara ashirin a zamanin Filistiyawa.
english: He judged Israel twenty years in the days of the Philistines.

hausa: Gama sakamakon zunubi mutuwa ne, amma kyautar Allah rai madawwami ne a cikin Kiristi Yesu Ubangijinmu.
english: For the wages of sin is death, but the free gift of God is eternal life in Christ Jesus our Lord.

hausa: Sai mai dahuwan ya ɗauko cinya da abin da yake bisanta ya kawo ya ajiye a gaban Shawulu. Sama’ila ya ce, “Ga abin da aka ajiye dominka. Ka ci, gama an keɓe shi dominka saboda wannan hidima daga lokacin da na ce, ‘Na gayyaci baƙi.’ ” Shawulu kuwa ya ci tare da Sama’ila a ranan nan.
english: The cook took up the thigh, and that which was on it, and set it before Saul. Samuel said, “Behold, that which has been reserved! Set it before yourself and eat; because it has been kept for you for the appointed time, for I said, ‘I have invited the people.’” So Saul ate with Samuel that day.

hausa: ’Yan’uwa, ku daina tunani kamar yara. Wajen mugunta ku zama jarirai, sai dai wajen tunaninku, ku zama manya.
english: Brothers, don’t be children in thoughts, yet in malice be babies, but in thoughts be mature.

hausa: Yakan sa gizagizai su taso daga iyakokin duniya; yakan aika da walƙiya tare da ruwan sama ya fito da iska daga ɗakunan ajiyarsa.
english: He causes the clouds to rise from the ends of the earth. He makes lightnings with the rain. He brings the wind out of his treasuries.

hausa: Saboda haka ya ce, “Ni bawan Ibrahim ne.
english: He said, “I am Abraham’s servant.

hausa: Ka yi nishi shiru; kada ka yi makoki saboda matacciyar. Ka naɗa rawaninka ka kuma sa takalmanka a ƙafa; kada ka rufe sashen fuskarka daga ƙasa ko ka ci abincin da masu kuka sukan ci.”
english: Sigh, but not aloud. Make no mourning for the dead. Bind your headdress on you, and put your sandals on your feet. Don’t cover your lips, and don’t eat mourner’s bread.”

hausa: A matsayina na ɗan kurkuku saboda Ubangiji, ina roƙonku ku yi rayuwar da ta dace da kiran da aka yi muku.
english: I therefore, the prisoner in the Lord, beg you to walk worthily of the calling with which you were called,

hausa: “Ga aikin kabilar Gershonawa yayinda suke aiki, suke kuma ɗaukar kaya.
english: “This is the service of the families of the Gershonites, in serving and in bearing burdens:

hausa: Sai na ga mala’iku bakwai da suke tsayawa a gaban Allah, a gare su kuwa aka ba da ƙahoni bakwai.
english: I saw the seven angels who stand before God, and seven trumpets were given to them.

hausa: mutanen Asher, ƙwararrun sojoji shiryayyu don yaƙi, su 40,000;
english: Of Asher, such as were able to go out in the army, who could set the battle in array: forty thousand.

hausa: Sa’an nan kai da ’yan’uwanka Yahudawa ku yi abin da kuka ga ya fi kyau da sauran zinariya da azurfa ɗin bisa ga nufin Allah.
english: Whatever seems good to you and to your brothers to do with the rest of the silver and the gold, do that according to the will of your God.

hausa: Duk da haka, masu adalci za su ci gaba da tafiya a kan hanyarsu, waɗanda hannuwansu suke da tsabta kuma za su ƙara ƙarfi.
english: Yet the righteous will hold to his way. He who has clean hands will grow stronger and stronger.

hausa: Isra’ilawa suka kwashi ganima da dabbobi na waɗannan birane, amma suka karkashe mutanen duka da takobi, ba su bar wani mai numfashi ba.
english: The children of Israel took all the plunder of these cities, with the livestock, as plunder for themselves; but every man they struck with the edge of the sword, until they had destroyed them. They didn’t leave any who breathed.

hausa: Da ya fito, bai iya yin musu magana ba. Sai suka gane, ya ga wahayi ne a haikali, domin ya dinga yin musu alamu, amma ya kāsa yin magana.
english: When he came out, he could not speak to them. They perceived that he had seen a vision in the temple. He continued making signs to them, and remained mute.

hausa: Ko za ku nuna masa sonkai? Ko za ku yi gardama a madadinsa?
english: Will you show partiality to him? Will you contend for God?

hausa: Sa’ad da ya ga haka, ya yi mamakin abin da ya gani. Da ya yi kusa domin ya duba sosai, sai ya ji muryar Ubangiji ta ce,
english: When Moses saw it, he wondered at the sight. As he came close to see, the voice of the Lord came to him,

hausa: Saboda haka, na ba da shi ga Ubangiji muddin ransa, zai zama na Ubangiji.” A can kuwa ya yi wa Ubangiji sujada.
english: Therefore I have also given him to Yahweh. As long as he lives he is given to Yahweh.” He worshiped Yahweh there.

hausa: Babban firist ya yage tufafinsa, ya yi ce, “Ina dalilin neman waɗansu shaidu kuma?
english: The high priest tore his clothes and said, “What further need have we of witnesses?

hausa: Da lokaci ya yi da za tă haihu, sai ga ’yan biyu maza a mahaifarta.
english: When her days to be delivered were fulfilled, behold, there were twins in her womb.

hausa: Addu’ata ita ce ƙaunarku tă yi ta cin gaba da ƙaruwa cikin sani da kuma zurfin ganewa,
english: This I pray, that your love may abound yet more and more in knowledge and all discernment,

hausa: Zan yi shelar sunan Ubangiji. Ku yabi girman Allahnmu!
english: For I will proclaim Yahweh’s name. Ascribe greatness to our God!

hausa: Zan maishe ki fā, za ki kuma zama wurin shanya abin kamun kifi. Ba za a sāke gina ki ba, gama Ni Ubangiji na faɗa, in ji Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka.
english: I will make you a bare rock. You will be a place for the spreading of nets. You will be built no more; for I Yahweh have spoken it,’ says the Lord Yahweh.

hausa: Ya kama macijin, wannan tsohon maciji, wanda yake shi ne Iblis, ko kuwa Shaiɗan, aka kuma ɗaura shi har shekara dubu.
english: He seized the dragon, the old serpent, who is the devil and Satan, who deceives the whole inhabited earth, and bound him for a thousand years,

hausa: labulen filin da yake kewaye da tabanakul da bagade, labulen ƙofa, igiyoyi da kuma dukan abubuwan da ake amfani da su wajen hidima. Geshonawa za su yi dukan abin da ya kamata a yi da waɗannan abubuwa.
english: the hangings of the court, the screen for the door of the gate of the court which is by the tabernacle and around the altar, their cords, and all the instruments of their service, and whatever shall be done with them. They shall serve in there.

hausa: Akan san ƙananan yara ta ayyukansu, ana iya sani ko rayuwarsu amintattu ne, mai nagarta.
english: Even a child makes himself known by his doings, whether his work is pure, and whether it is right.

hausa: Yesu ya amsa ya ce, “Ya ku zamani marasa bangaskiya da kuma masu taurinkai, har yaushe zan kasance tare da ku? Har yaushe kuma zan yi haƙuri da ku? Kawo mini yaron a nan.”
english: Jesus answered, “Faithless and perverse generation! How long will I be with you? How long will I bear with you? Bring him here to me.”

hausa: Kashegari, da Filistiyawa suka zo domin su washe kayan matattun, sai suka tarar Shawulu da ’ya’yansa uku duk sun mutu, a dutsen Gilbowa.
english: On the next day, when the Philistines came to strip the slain, they found Saul and his three sons fallen on Mount Gilboa.

hausa: sai ku keɓe wa kanku birane uku waɗanda suke a tsakiyar ƙasar da Ubangiji Allahnku yake ba ku ku mallaka.
english: you shall set apart three cities for yourselves in the middle of your land, which Yahweh your God gives you to possess.

hausa: Amma shugaban sojojin ya ce, “Ai, ba gare ku da sarkinku kaɗai ne shugabana ya aike ni ba. Amma har ga mutanen da suke zaune a kan katangar birnin, waɗanda za su ci kashinsu, su sha fitsarinsu!”
english: But Rabshakeh said to them, “Has my master sent me to your master and to you, to speak these words? Hasn’t he sent me to the men who sit on the wall, to eat their own dung, and to drink their own urine with you?”

hausa: “Sun ma aiki manzanni wa mutanen da suka zo daga nesa, kuma da suka iso kun yi wanka dominsu, kuka yi shafe-shafen idanunku, kuka kuma sa kayan adonku.
english: “Furthermore you sisters have sent for men who come from far away, to whom a messenger was sent, and behold, they came; for whom you washed yourself, painted your eyes, decorated yourself with ornaments,

hausa: Sa’ad da labarin ya kai fadan Fir’auna cewa ’yan’uwan Yusuf sun zo, sai Fir’auna da dukan hafsoshin suka ji daɗi.
english: The report of it was heard in Pharaoh’s house, saying, “Joseph’s brothers have come.” It pleased Pharaoh well, and his servants.

hausa: Kashegari da sassafe suka haura ta wajen ƙasa mai tudu suka ce, “Mun yi zunubi, za mu tafi inda Ubangiji ya yi alkawari.”
english: They rose up early in the morning and went up to the top of the mountain, saying, “Behold, we are here, and will go up to the place which Yahweh has promised; for we have sinned.”

hausa: Takobin Ubangiji ya jiƙu da jini, ya rufu da kitse, jinin raguna da na awaki, kitse daga ƙodar raguna. Gama Ubangiji ya yi hadayar Bozra da kuma babban kisa a Edom.
english: Yahweh’s sword is filled with blood. It is covered with fat, with the blood of lambs and goats, with the fat of the kidneys of rams; for Yahweh has a sacrifice in Bozrah, and a great slaughter in the land of Edom.

hausa: Amma ba haka nake magana da Musa bawana ba; na sa shi yă lura da dukan jama’ata Isra’ila.
english: My servant Moses is not so. He is faithful in all my house.

hausa: “An daɗe yana ƙi, amma a ƙarshe ya ce cikin tunaninsa, ‘Ko da yake ba na tsoron Allah, ba na kuma kula da mutane ba,
english: He wouldn’t for a while; but afterward he said to himself, ‘Though I neither fear God nor respect man,

hausa: Suka ce wa Allah, ‘Ka rabu da mu! Me Maɗaukaki zai yi mana?’
english: who said to God, ‘Depart from us!’ and, ‘What can the Almighty do for us?’

hausa: Wani mutum mai kuturta ya zo wurinsa, ya durƙusa ya roƙe shi ya ce, “In kana so, za ka iya tsabtacce ni.”
english: A leper came to him, begging him, kneeling down to him, and saying to him, “If you want to, you can make me clean.”

hausa: Suka kama hanya daga Dutsen Hor ta hanya zuwa Jan Teku, don su kauce wa Edom. Amma mutane suka rasa haƙuri a hanya;
english: They traveled from Mount Hor by the way to the Red Sea, to go around the land of Edom. The soul of the people was very discouraged because of the journey.

hausa: Suka auka mini cikin ranar masifata, amma Ubangiji ya kiyaye ni.
english: They came on me in the day of my calamity, but Yahweh was my support.

hausa: Da tagulla kuma ya yi duk kayayyakin bagaden, da kwanoni, da babban cokali, da daruna, da cokula masu yatsotsi, da farantan wuta.
english: He made all the vessels of the altar: the pots, the shovels, the basins, the forks, and the fire pans. He made all its vessels of bronze.

hausa: Don me kuke yawo da yawa haka, kuna ta canjin hanyoyinku? Masar za tă kunyata ku yadda kuka sha kunya a wurin Assuriya.
english: Why do you go about so much to change your ways? You will be ashamed of Egypt also, as you were ashamed of Assyria.

hausa: Da ya dawo, har yanzu ya tarar suna barci, domin idanunsu sun yi nauyi da barci.
english: He came again and found them sleeping, for their eyes were heavy.

hausa: Babu sarki a lokacin Edom, saboda haka sai mataimaki ya yi mulki.
english: There was no king in Edom. A deputy ruled.

hausa: da ƙaramin bijimi guda ɗaya, tunkiya ɗaya, da rago, dukansu bana ɗaya-ɗaya domin hadaya ta ƙonawa;
english: one young bull, one ram, one male lamb a year old, for a burnt offering;

hausa: Suka amsa suka ce, “Ka gaskata da Ubangiji Yesu, za ka sami ceto, kai da iyalinka.”
english: They said, “Believe in the Lord Jesus Christ, and you will be saved, you and your household.”

hausa: Sai na ajiye ƙwarya cike da ruwan inabi da waɗansu kwaf a gaban iyalin Rekabawan na kuma ce musu, “Ku sha ruwan inabin.”
english: I set before the sons of the house of the Rechabites bowls full of wine, and cups; and I said to them, “Drink wine!”

hausa: Wannan zai gamshi Ubangiji fiye da saniya, fiye da bijimi da ƙahoninsa da kuma kofatansa.
english: It will please Yahweh better than an ox, or a bull that has horns and hoofs.

hausa: Waɗanda aka wartsar suka yi ta wa’azin maganar a duk inda suka tafi.
english: Therefore those who were scattered abroad went around preaching the word.

hausa: Sa’ad da Yehoshafat sarkin Yahuda ya dawo zuwa fadansa a Urushalima lafiya,
english: Jehoshaphat the king of Judah returned to his house in peace to Jerusalem.

hausa: Da a ce kun gaskata da Musa, da kun gaskata ni, domin ya rubuta game da ni.
english: For if you believed Moses, you would believe me; for he wrote about me.

hausa: Suka ce, “Malam, Musa ya rubuta mana cewa, in ɗan’uwan wani mutum ya mutu, ya bar mata babu ’ya’ya, dole mutumin ya auri gwauruwar, yă kuma samo wa ɗan’uwansa ’ya’ya.
english: “Teacher, Moses wrote to us, ‘If a man’s brother dies and leaves a wife behind him, and leaves no children, that his brother should take his wife and raise up offspring for his brother.’

hausa: Saboda haka, ku ji maganar Ubangiji, dukanku masu zaman bauta waɗanda na aika daga Urushalima zuwa Babilon.
english: Hear therefore Yahweh’s word, all you captives whom I have sent away from Jerusalem to Babylon.

hausa: Segub shi ne mahaifin Yayir, wanda ya yi mulkin garuruwa uku a Gileyad.
english: Segub became the father of Jair, who had twenty-three cities in the land of Gilead.

hausa: Waɗanda suka yi su za su zama kamar su, haka kuma zai zama da dukan waɗanda suke dogara gare su.
english: Those who make them will be like them, yes, everyone who trusts in them.

hausa: Waɗannan salkuna kuma da muka cika ruwan inabi, sababbi ne amma duba yadda suka yayyage. Tufafinmu da takalmanmu duk sun yayyage don doguwar tafiya.”
english: These wineskins, which we filled, were new; and behold, they are torn. These our garments and our sandals have become old because of the very long journey.”

hausa: In ka zo tare da mu, za mu raba duk abin alherin Ubangiji ya ba mu tare da kai.”
english: It shall be, if you go with us—yes, it shall be—that whatever good Yahweh does to us, we will do the same to you.”

hausa: A Mowab zan kawo ƙarshen waɗanda suke miƙa hadayu a masujadan kan tudu suna kuma ƙone turare ga allolinsu,” in ji Ubangiji.
english: Moreover I will cause to cease in Moab,” says Yahweh, “him who offers in the high place, and him who burns incense to his gods.

hausa: Kada ki ji tsoro, ya ƙasa; ki yi murna ki kuma yi farin ciki. Tabbatacce Ubangiji ya yi abubuwa masu girma.
english: Land, don’t be afraid. Be glad and rejoice, for Yahweh has done great things.

hausa: Zan tumɓuke ka daga makaminka, za a kuma kore ka daga matsayinka.
english: I will thrust you from your office. You will be pulled down from your station.

hausa: Bisa ga ƙaunarka mai girma, ka gafarta zunubin mutanen nan, kamar dai yadda ka gafarta musu daga lokacin da suka bar Masar har zuwa yanzu.”
english: Please pardon the iniquity of this people according to the greatness of your loving kindness, and just as you have forgiven this people, from Egypt even until now.”

hausa: Yoshuwa ya ce musu, “In kuna da yawa sosai, in kuma ƙasar kan tudu ta Efraim ba ta ishe ku ba, sai ku je cikin jeji, ku nema wa kanku ƙasa a ƙasar Ferizziyawa da Refahiyawa.”
english: Joshua said to them, “If you are a numerous people, go up to the forest, and clear land for yourself there in the land of the Perizzites and of the Rephaim, since the hill country of Ephraim is too narrow for you.”

hausa: Gama da a ce alkawari na fari ba shi da wani laifi, da ba sai an sāke neman wani ba.
english: For if that first covenant had been faultless, then no place would have been sought for a second.

hausa: A Shekara ta uku ta mulki Yehohiyakim sarkin Yahuda, Nebukadnezzar sarkin Babilon ya zo Urushalima ya kuma yi mata ƙawanya.
english: In the third year of the reign of Jehoiakim king of Judah, Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came to Jerusalem and besieged it.

hausa: Lakish, Bozkat, Eglon,
english: Lachish, Bozkath, Eglon,

hausa: Ko da yake kun riga kun san duk wannan, ina so in tuna muku cewa Ubangiji ya ceci mutanensa daga Masar, duk da haka daga baya ya hallaka waɗanda ba su ba da gaskiya ba.
english: Now I desire to remind you, though you already know this, that the Lord, having saved a people out of the land of Egypt, afterward destroyed those who didn’t believe.

hausa: Ladan ɗan Gershon ne, kuma kaka ga iyalai masu yawa, har ma da iyalin ɗansa Yehiyeli,
english: The sons of Ladan, the sons of the Gershonites belonging to Ladan, the heads of the fathers’ households belonging to Ladan the Gershonite: Jehieli.

hausa: To, a tashin matattu, matar wa a cikinsu bakwai ɗin nan za tă zama, da yake dukansu sun aure ta?”
english: In the resurrection therefore, whose wife will she be of the seven? For they all had her.”

hausa: A watan tara na shekara ta biyar ta Yehohiyakim ɗan Yosiya sarkin Yahuda, an yi shela a yi azumi a gaban Ubangiji ga dukan mutanen Urushalima da waɗanda suka zo daga garuruwan Yahuda.
english: Now in the fifth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah, in the ninth month, all the people in Jerusalem and all the people who came from the cities of Judah to Jerusalem, proclaimed a fast before Yahweh.

hausa: kuma ya ce, “In ke, ko ke ɗin ma, dā ma kin san abin da zai kawo miki salama a wannan rana, amma yanzu an ɓoye shi daga idanunki.
english: saying, “If you, even you, had known today the things which belong to your peace! But now, they are hidden from your eyes.

hausa: Ku yi tafiya cikin dukan hanyar da Ubangiji Allahnku ya umarce ku, saboda ku zauna, ku yi nasara, ku kuma yi tsawon rai a ƙasar da za ku mallaka.
english: You shall walk in all the way which Yahweh your God has commanded you, that you may live and that it may be well with you, and that you may prolong your days in the land which you shall possess.

hausa: “ ‘Sa’ad da aka tsabtacce ta daga ɗigarta, dole tă ɗauki kwana bakwai, bayan haka za tă zama mai tsarki.
english: “‘But if she is cleansed of her discharge, then she shall count to herself seven days, and after that she shall be clean.

hausa: Ina gode wa Allah kullum dominku, saboda alherinsa da aka ba ku a cikin Kiristi Yesu.
english: I always thank my God concerning you for the grace of God which was given you in Christ Jesus,

hausa: Za a yi wa bakin rigar ado da fasalin ’ya’yan rumman masu launin shuɗi, da shunayya, da mulufi. A sa ƙararrawa ta zinariya a tsakankaninsu.
english: On its hem you shall make pomegranates of blue, and of purple, and of scarlet, all around its hem; with bells of gold between and around them:

hausa: Saboda haka ya sa kwanakinsu suka ƙare a banza shekarunsu kuma cikin masifa.
english: Therefore he consumed their days in vanity, and their years in terror.

hausa: Mugu yakan gudu ko babu wanda yake korarsa, amma adalai suna da ƙarfin hali kamar zaki.
english: The wicked flee when no one pursues; but the righteous are as bold as a lion.

hausa: Hadaya da sadaka ba ka sha’awa, amma kunnuwana ka huda; hadayun ƙonawa da hadayun zunubi ba ka bukata.
english: Sacrifice and offering you didn’t desire. You have opened my ears. You have not required burnt offering and sin offering.

hausa: To, sai Adoniya, ɗan Haggit ya tafi wurin Batsheba mahaifiyar Solomon. Ita kuwa ta tambaye shi ta ce, “Lafiya?” Ya amsa ya ce, “I, lafiya.”
english: Then Adonijah the son of Haggith came to Bathsheba the mother of Solomon. She said, “Do you come peaceably?” He said, “Peaceably.

hausa: Ku ’yan’uwana, an kira ku ga zama ’yantattu. Amma kada ku yi amfani da ’yancinku don aikata ayyukan mutuntaka a maimakon haka, ku yi hidimar juna da ƙauna.
english: For you, brothers, were called for freedom. Only don’t use your freedom as an opportunity for the flesh, but through love be servants to one another.

hausa: Ammonawa su ma suka haye Urdun domin su yi yaƙi da Yahuda, Benyamin da kuma gidan Efraim; Isra’ila kuwa suka kasance cikin wahala ƙwarai da gaske.
english: The children of Ammon passed over the Jordan to fight also against Judah, and against Benjamin, and against the house of Ephraim, so that Israel was very distressed.

hausa: Zifawa suka tafi wurin Shawulu a Gibeya suka ce masa, “Ashe, ba Dawuda ne yake ɓuya a cikinmu a kogwannin duwatsu a Horesh a bisan tudun Hakila, kudu da Yeshimon ba?
english: Then the Ziphites came up to Saul to Gibeah, saying, “Doesn’t David hide himself with us in the strongholds in the woods, in the hill of Hachilah, which is on the south of the desert?

hausa: Saboda haka Dawuda da Abishai suka gangara zuwa wurin rundunar da dare, sai ga Shawulu kwance yana barci a cikin sansani da māshinsa a kafe a ƙasa kusa da kansa. Abner kuwa tare da sojoji suna kwance kewaye da shi.
english: So David and Abishai came to the people by night; and, behold, Saul lay sleeping within the place of the wagons, with his spear stuck in the ground at his head; and Abner and the people lay around him.

hausa: Kush shi ne mahaifin Nimrod wanda ya yi girma ya zama jarumin yaƙi a duniya.
english: Cush became the father of Nimrod. He began to be a mighty one on the earth.

hausa: Amma in mutumin da yake da tsarki bai kuma yi tafiya ba, ya kuwa ƙi yă yi Bikin Ƙetarewar, dole a ware wannan mutum daga mutanensa, domin bai miƙa hadaya ga Ubangiji a ƙayyadadden lokaci ba. Wannan mutum zai ɗauki alhakin zunubinsa.
english: But the man who is clean, and is not on a journey, and fails to keep the Passover, that soul shall be cut off from his people. Because he didn’t offer the offering of Yahweh in its appointed season, that man shall bear his sin.

hausa: Na murƙushe su kamar ƙura mai laushi da iska ke kwashewa; na zubar da su kamar laka a tituna.
english: Then I beat them small as the dust before the wind. I cast them out as the mire of the streets.

hausa: “Nuna mini dinari. Hoton wane ne, kuma rubutun wane ne a kai?” Suka amsa, “Na Kaisar.”
english: Show me a denarius. Whose image and inscription are on it?” They answered, “Caesar’s.”

hausa: Waɗansu suka fāɗi a wurare mai duwatsu, inda babu ƙasa sosai, nan da nan kuwa suka tsira, da yake ƙasar ba zurfi.
english: Others fell on rocky ground, where they didn’t have much soil, and immediately they sprang up, because they had no depth of earth.

hausa: amma matalauci ba shi da kome sai ’yar tunkiyar da ya sayo. Ya yi kiwonta, ta kuwa yi girma tare shi da yaransa. Takan ci tare da shi ta sha ruwa a kwaf nasa, har ma ta kwanta a ƙirjinsa. Ta ma zama kamar ’ya a gare shi.
english: but the poor man had nothing, except one little ewe lamb, which he had bought and raised. It grew up together with him and with his children. It ate of his own food, drank of his own cup, and lay in his bosom, and was like a daughter to him.

hausa: “ ‘Saboda haka kada ka ji tsoro, ya Yaƙub bawana; kada ka karai, ya Isra’ila,’ in ji Ubangiji. ‘Tabbatacce zan cece ka daga wuri mai nesa, zuriyarka daga ƙasar zaman bautansu. Yaƙub zai sami salama da zaman lafiya, kuma ba wanda zai sa ya ji tsoro.
english: Therefore don’t be afraid, O Jacob my servant, says Yahweh. Don’t be dismayed, Israel. For, behold, I will save you from afar, and save your offspring from the land of their captivity. Jacob will return, and will be quiet and at ease. No one will make him afraid.

hausa: ya ba mu rai sa’ad da ya tashe Kiristi daga matattu. Ta wurin alherin Allah ne aka cece ku.
english: even when we were dead through our trespasses, made us alive together with Christ—by grace you have been saved—

hausa: Sa’ad da ta tashi, manya suna tsorata; suna ja da baya.
english: When he raises himself up, the mighty are afraid. They retreat before his thrashing.

hausa: Ubangiji ya ce wa Abram, “Tashi ka bar ƙasarka, da mutanenka, da iyalin mahaifinka, ka tafi ƙasar da zan nuna maka.
english: Now Yahweh said to Abram, “Leave your country, and your relatives, and your father’s house, and go to the land that I will show you.

hausa: Ku girgiza saboda wannan, ya sammai, ku kuma razana don tsoro mai girma,” in ji Ubangiji.
english: “Be astonished, you heavens, at this and be horribly afraid. Be very desolate,” says Yahweh.

hausa: Yanzu ba kin kira ni, ‘Mahaifina, abokina daga ƙuruciyata ba,
english: Will you not from this time cry to me, ‘My Father, you are the guide of my youth!’?

hausa: Dukan ’yan’uwan kuma da suke tare da ni a nan, Suna gai da ikkilisiyoyi a Galatiya.
english: and all the brothers who are with me, to the assemblies of Galatia:

hausa: Obil mutumin Ishmayel shi ne mai lura da raƙuma. Yedehiya mutumin Meronot shi ne mai lura da jakuna.
english: Over the camels was Obil the Ishmaelite. Over the donkeys was Jehdeiah the Meronothite. Over the flocks was Jaziz the Hagrite.

hausa: Ku yi irin rayuwa mai kyau a cikin masu bautar gumaka, yadda ko da sun zarge ku da yin laifi, za su iya ganin ayyukanku nagari, su ɗaukaka Allah a ranar da zai ziyarce mu.
english: having good behavior among the nations, so in that of which they speak against you as evildoers, they may see your good works and glorify God in the day of visitation.

hausa: “Wa ya sa ku fargaba, kuna jin tsoro har kuka yi mini ƙarya, ba ku kuma tuna da ni ba balle ku yi tunanin wannan a zukatanku? Ba don na daɗe ina shiru ba ne ya sa ba kwa tsorona?
english: “Whom have you dreaded and feared, so that you lie, and have not remembered me, nor laid it to your heart? Haven’t I held my peace for a long time, and you don’t fear me?

hausa: Adalci yakan lura da mutum mai mutunci, amma mugunta takan sha kan mai zunubi.
english: Righteousness guards the way of integrity, but wickedness overthrows the sinner.

hausa: Da ya ji ta bakin jarumin cewa haka ne, sai ya ba wa Yusuf jikin.
english: When he found out from the centurion, he granted the body to Joseph.

hausa: sai ka ji daga sama, mazauninka. Ka gafarta, ka kuma yi da kowane mutum gwargwadon duk abin da yake yi, da yake ka san zuciyarsa (gama kai kaɗai ka san zukatan mutane),
english: then hear from heaven your dwelling place and forgive, and give to every man according to all his ways, whose heart you know (for you, even you only, know the hearts of the children of men),

hausa: Kada ku ƙazantar da ƙasar da kuke zama, wadda ni kuma nake zama a ciki, gama Ni Ubangiji, ina zama a cikin Isra’ilawa.’ ”
english: You shall not defile the land which you inhabit, where I dwell; for I, Yahweh, dwell among the children of Israel.’”

hausa: Ya ce wa Yahuda, “Bari mu gina waɗannan garuruwa mu sa katanga kewaye da su, da hasumiyoyi, ƙofofi da ƙyamare. Ƙasar har yanzu tamu ce domin mun nemi Ubangiji Allahnmu, mun neme shi ya kuwa ba mu hutu a kowane gefe.” Saboda haka suka gina suka kuma yi nasara.
english: For he said to Judah, “Let’s build these cities and make walls around them, with towers, gates, and bars. The land is yet before us, because we have sought Yahweh our God. We have sought him, and he has given us rest on every side.” So they built and prospered.

hausa: Me yake jawo faɗace-faɗace da gardandami a tsakaninku? Ashe, ba sha’awace-sha’awacenku da suke yaƙi a zukatanku ba ne?
english: Where do wars and fightings among you come from? Don’t they come from your pleasures that war in your members?

hausa: Da ya yi kusa da ramin zakokin, sai ya kira Daniyel da muryar mai cike da damuwa ya ce, “Daniyel bawan Allah mai rai, ko Allahn nan naka wanda kake bauta wa kullum, ya iya cetonka daga zakoki?”
english: When he came near to Daniel in the den, he cried with a troubled voice. The king spoke and said to Daniel, “Daniel, servant of the living God, is your God, whom you serve continually, able to deliver you from the lions?”

hausa: Firistoci, da Lawiyawa, da mawaƙa, da masu tsaron ƙofofi, da masu aiki a haikali, tare da waɗansu mutane, da dukan sauran Isra’ilawa suka zauna a garuruwansu.
english: So the priests and the Levites, with some of the people, the singers, the gatekeepers, and the temple servants, lived in their cities, and all Israel in their cities.

hausa: Shawulu ya kira dukan sojojinsa don yaƙi, su gangaro zuwa Keyila su mamaye Dawuda da mutanensa.
english: Saul summoned all the people to war, to go down to Keilah to besiege David and his men.

hausa: Saboda haka bari ranka yă daɗe yă sha gaban bawansa, ni kuma in tafi a hankali bisa ga saurin abin da ake kora a gabana da kuma saurin ’ya’yan, sai na iso wurinka ranka yă daɗe, a Seyir.”
english: Please let my lord pass over before his servant, and I will lead on gently, according to the pace of the livestock that are before me and according to the pace of the children, until I come to my lord to Seir.”

hausa: Ya ce, “Allah yă sawwaƙe in yi haka, ya kamata in sha jinin waɗannan mutanen da suka yi kasai da rayukansu?” Domin sun yi kasai da rayukansu don su dawo da shi, Dawuda bai sha shi ba. Irin abubuwan da jarumawa ukun nan suka yi ke nan.
english: and said, “My God forbid me, that I should do this! Shall I drink the blood of these men who have put their lives in jeopardy?” For they risked their lives to bring it. Therefore he would not drink it. The three mighty men did these things.

hausa: Ba zai bari in yi numfashi ba, sai dai yă ƙara mini azaba.
english: He will not allow me to catch my breath, but fills me with bitterness.

hausa: Sarkin Assuriya ya kwashe Isra’ila zuwa Assuriya ya zaunar da su a Hala, da Gozan a kogin Habor da kuma garuruwan Medes.
english: The king of Assyria carried Israel away to Assyria, and put them in Halah, and on the Habor, the river of Gozan, and in the cities of the Medes,

hausa: da ƙaramin bijimi guda ɗaya, tunkiya ɗaya, da rago, dukansu bana ɗaya-ɗaya domin hadaya ta ƙonawa;
english: one young bull, one ram, one male lamb a year old, for a burnt offering;

hausa: Dole wanda ake zargin, yă kasance a birninsa na mafaka sai bayan mutuwa babban firist; sai bayan mutuwar babban firist ne kawai zai iya komo ga mallakarsa.
english: because he should have remained in his city of refuge until the death of the high priest. But after the death of the high priest, the man slayer shall return into the land of his possession.

hausa: Sai waɗansu mutanen Gad suka koma suna goyon bayan Dawuda suka kuma haɗa kai da shi a kagararsa a hamada. Su ƙwararrun mayaƙa ne, a shirye don yaƙi, kuma suna iya riƙe garkuwa da māshi. Fuskokinsu kamar fuskoki zakoki, kuma suna da sauri kamar bareyi a kan duwatsu.
english: Some Gadites joined David in the stronghold in the wilderness, mighty men of valor, men trained for war, who could handle shield and spear; whose faces were like the faces of lions, and they were as swift as the gazelles on the mountains:

hausa: Ya ƙarfina, na rera yabo gare ka; kai, ya Allah, kai ne kagarata, Allah mai ƙaunata.
english: To you, my strength, I will sing praises. For God is my high tower, the God of my mercy.

hausa: Ya gamshe Ruhu Mai Tsarki da mu ma kada a ɗora muku nauyi fiye da na waɗannan abubuwa.
english: For it seemed good to the Holy Spirit, and to us, to lay no greater burden on you than these necessary things:

hausa: Kada ku yi aiki saboda abincin da yake lalacewa, sai dai saboda abinci mai dawwama har yă zuwa rai madawwami, wanda Ɗan Mutum zai ba ku. A kansa ne Allah Uba ya sa hatimin amincewarsa.”
english: Don’t work for the food which perishes, but for the food which remains to eternal life, which the Son of Man will give to you. For God the Father has sealed him.”

hausa: Ko ni ma dā ban san shi ba, sai dai abin da ya sa na zo ina baftisma da ruwa shi ne domin a bayyana shi ga Isra’ila.”
english: I didn’t know him, but for this reason I came baptizing in water, that he would be revealed to Israel.”

hausa: Ni ma na ga wawa yana cin gaba, amma nan da nan gidansa ya zama la’ananne.
english: I have seen the foolish taking root, but suddenly I cursed his habitation.

hausa: Sai sarki ya ce, “Koma gefe ka jira a can.” Sai ya ja gefe ya tsaya.
english: The king said, “Come and stand here.” He came and stood still.

hausa: Suka bar wurin suka bi ta Galili. Yesu bai so wani yă san inda suke ba,
english: They went out from there and passed through Galilee. He didn’t want anyone to know it,

hausa: An manta da shi a duniya; ba wanda yake ƙara tunawa da shi.
english: His memory will perish from the earth. He will have no name in the street.

hausa: Amma jarumin ya so yă ceci ran Bulus, sai ya hana su aiwatar da niyyarsu. Ya kuma yi umarni duk waɗanda suka iya ruwa su fara fāɗawa zuwa gaci.
english: But the centurion, desiring to save Paul, stopped them from their purpose, and commanded that those who could swim should throw themselves overboard first to go toward the land;

hausa: Waɗannan ne zuriyar Lawi bisa ga iyalansu, kawunan iyalai kamar yadda aka rubuta su a ƙarƙashin sunayensu aka kuma ƙirga kowa, wato, masu aikin da suke ’yan shekara ashirin da haihuwa ko fiye waɗanda suka yi hidima a cikin haikalin Ubangiji.
english: These were the sons of Levi after their fathers’ houses, even the heads of the fathers’ houses of those who were counted individually, in the number of names by their polls, who did the work for the service of Yahweh’s house, from twenty years old and upward.

hausa: Za ka kiyaye shi da cikakken salama shi wanda ya kafa zuciyarsa gare ka, domin ya dogara a gare ka.
english: You will keep whoever’s mind is steadfast in perfect peace, because he trusts in you.

hausa: Don haka ne ina fama, ina kuma ƙoƙari da duk ƙarfin nan da Kiristi ya ba ni.
english: for which I also labor, striving according to his working, which works in me mightily.

hausa: Saboda haka Zadok da Abiyatar suka ɗauki akwatin alkawarin Allah suka komar da shi Urushalima, suka zauna a can.
english: Zadok therefore and Abiathar carried God’s ark to Jerusalem again; and they stayed there.

hausa: Kada ka zama mai hikima a ganinka; ka ji tsoron Ubangiji ka kuma guji mugunta.
english: Don’t be wise in your own eyes. Fear Yahweh, and depart from evil.

hausa: Sai Ubangiji ya ce, “Yanzu, mayar da hannunka a rigarka.” Sai Musa ya sa hannunsa cikin rigarsa, da ya fitar da shi, sai hannun ya koma kamar sauran jikinsa.
english: He said, “Put your hand inside your cloak again.” He put his hand inside his cloak again, and when he took it out of his cloak, behold, it had turned again as his other flesh.

hausa: Na kawo fări a ƙasar, da a kan duwatsu, da a kan hatsi, da a kan dukan abin da yake tsirowa daga ƙasa, da a kan mutane, da a kan dabbobi da kuma a kan wahalar hannuwanku.”
english: I called for a drought on the land, on the mountains, on the grain, on the new wine, on the oil, on that which the ground produces, on men, on livestock, and on all the labor of the hands.”

hausa: Ya Ubangiji me zan ce, yanzu da abokan gāban Isra’ilawa suka ci ƙarfinsu?
english: Oh, Lord, what shall I say, after Israel has turned their backs before their enemies?

hausa: Yesu ya ce musu, “Ku zo ku karya kumallo.” Ba wani daga cikin almajiran da ya yi karambanin tambayarsa, “Wane ne kai?” Sun san cewa Ubangiji ne.
english: Jesus said to them, “Come and eat breakfast!” None of the disciples dared inquire of him, “Who are you?” knowing that it was the Lord.

hausa: Kada ku kawo wani abu mai lahani, domin ba zai zama yardajje ba a madadinku.
english: But you shall not offer whatever has a defect, for it shall not be acceptable for you.

hausa: sa’ad da na sanya rigunan makoki, mutane suna maishe ni abin dariya.
english: When I made sackcloth my clothing, I became a byword to them.

hausa: Da suka kai wajen Yesu, sai suka ga mutumin da dā yake da tulin aljanun yana zaune a wurin, sanye da tufafi kuma cikin hankalinsa, sai suka ji tsoro.
english: They came to Jesus, and saw him who had been possessed by demons sitting, clothed, and in his right mind, even him who had the legion; and they were afraid.

hausa: Amma fa, sa’ad da kome ya zama maka da kyau, ka tuna da ni, ka kuma yi mini alheri, ka ambace ni wa Fir’auna, ka fid da ni daga wannan kurkuku.
english: But remember me when it is well with you. Please show kindness to me, and make mention of me to Pharaoh, and bring me out of this house.

hausa: Sai kowane mutum ya ɗauki farantinsa, ya sa wuta da kuma turare a ciki, suka tsaya da Musa da Haruna a ƙofar Tentin Sujada.
english: They each took his censer, and put fire in it, and laid incense on it, and stood at the door of the Tent of Meeting with Moses and Aaron.

hausa: Ubangiji ya ce wa Yoshuwa, “Kada ka ji tsoronsu, domin war haka gobe zan ba da dukansu a hannun Isra’ilawa, za su kuwa karkashe su. Za ku gurgunta dawakansu, ku kuma ƙone keken yaƙinsu.”
english: Yahweh said to Joshua, “Don’t be afraid because of them; for tomorrow at this time, I will deliver them up all slain before Israel. You shall hamstring their horses and burn their chariots with fire.”

hausa: “Saboda haka Sheshbazzar ya so ya aza harsashin gina gidan Allah a Urushalima. Tun daga wancan lokaci har zuwa yau ana kan gina shi amma ba a gama ba.”
english: Then the same Sheshbazzar came and laid the foundations of God’s house which is in Jerusalem. Since that time even until now it has been being built, and yet it is not completed.

hausa: Duk da haka Mai Fansarsu yana da ƙarfi; Ubangiji Maɗaukaki ne sunansa. Zai kāre muradunsu gabagadi don yă kawo hutu ga ƙasarsu, amma rashin hutu ga waɗanda suke zaune a Babilon.
english: Their Redeemer is strong. Yahweh of Armies is his name. He will thoroughly plead their cause, that he may give rest to the earth, and disquiet the inhabitants of Babylon.

hausa: Bari in gane koyarwar farillanka; sa’an nan zan yi tunani a kan abubuwan banmamakinka.
english: Let me understand the teaching of your precepts! Then I will meditate on your wondrous works.

hausa: Ruwayen Dimon sun cika da jini, amma zan yi ƙari a kan Dimon, zan kawo zaki a kan masu gudu na Mowab da kuma a kan waɗanda suka ragu a ƙasar.
english: For the waters of Dimon are full of blood; for I will bring yet more on Dimon, a lion on those of Moab who escape, and on the remnant of the land.

hausa: Da yake tashar jirgin ruwan ba tă dace a ci damina a can ba, yawanci suka ba yanke shawara cewa mu ci gaba da tafiya, da bege za mu kai Funis mu ci damina a can. Wannan tashar jirgin ruwa ne a Kirit, tana fuskantar kudu maso yamma da kuma arewa maso yamma.
english: Because the haven was not suitable to winter in, the majority advised going to sea from there, if by any means they could reach Phoenix and winter there, which is a port of Crete, looking southwest and northwest.

hausa: Amma na yi maka addu’a, Siman, domin kada bangaskiyarka ta kāsa. Bayan ka juyo, ka ƙarfafa ’yan’uwanka.”
english: but I prayed for you, that your faith wouldn’t fail. You, when once you have turned again, establish your brothers.”

hausa: Sai na ji murya daga sama ta ce, “Rubuta, Masu albarka ne matattun da suka mutu cikin Ubangiji daga yanzu zuwa gaba.” “I, za su huta daga faman aikinsu, gama ayyukansu za su bi su,” in ji Ruhu.
english: I heard a voice from heaven saying, “Write, ‘Blessed are the dead who die in the Lord from now on.’” “Yes,” says the Spirit, “that they may rest from their labors, for their works follow with them.”

hausa: Ɗayan ɗan ragon kuma za a miƙa shi da yamma, tare irin hadaya ta lallausan gari, da hadaya ta sha da ka yi da safe. Wannan hadaya ce ta ƙonawa mai daɗin ƙanshi ga Ubangiji.
english: The other lamb you shall offer at evening. As the meal offering of the morning, and as its drink offering, you shall offer it, an offering made by fire, for a pleasant aroma to Yahweh.

hausa: Waɗansu suna kama da irin da aka shuka a wurare masu duwatsu, sukan ji maganar Allah, sukan kuma karɓe ta nan da nan da farin ciki.
english: These in the same way are those who are sown on the rocky places, who, when they have heard the word, immediately receive it with joy.

hausa: Don me kake tuhumata? Ka tambayi waɗanda suka ji ni. Ba shakka, sun san abin da na faɗa.”
english: Why do you ask me? Ask those who have heard me what I said to them. Behold, they know the things which I said.”

hausa: Allah kuwa ya ce, “Bari ƙasa tă ba da halittu masu rai bisa ga irinsu; dabbobi da halittu masu rarrafe, da kuma namun jeji, kowane bisa ga irinsa.” Haka kuwa ya kasance.
english: God said, “Let the earth produce living creatures after their kind, livestock, creeping things, and animals of the earth after their kind;” and it was so.

hausa: An gicciye ni tare da Kiristi. Yanzu ba ni ne nake raye ba, Kiristi ne yake raye a cikina. Rayuwar da nake yi a jiki, ina rayuwa ce ta wurin bangaskiya cikin Ɗan Allah, wanda ya ƙaunace ni ya kuma ba da kansa domina.
english: I have been crucified with Christ, and it is no longer I who live, but Christ lives in me. That life which I now live in the flesh, I live by faith in the Son of God, who loved me and gave himself up for me.

hausa: Amma in ka yi wa mai adalcin kashedi kada yă yi zunubi bai kuwa yi zunubi ba, tabbatacce zai rayu saboda ya ji kashedin, kuma kai kam za ka kuɓuta.”
english: Nevertheless if you warn the righteous man, that the righteous not sin, and he does not sin, he will surely live, because he took warning; and you have delivered your soul.”

hausa: Sai mala’ikan Allah ya ce mini a mafarkin, ‘Yaƙub.’ Sai na amsa na ce, ‘Ga ni.’
english: The angel of God said to me in the dream, ‘Jacob,’ and I said, ‘Here I am.’

hausa: Game da girmar gwamnatinsa da salama babu iyaka. Zai gāji sarki Dawuda, yă yi mulki a matsayinsa, zai kafa mulkinsa a kan adalci da gaskiya, tun daga yanzu har zuwa ƙarshen zamani. Ubangiji Maɗaukaki ne ya yi niyyar aikata wannan duka.
english: Of the increase of his government and of peace there shall be no end, on David’s throne, and on his kingdom, to establish it, and to uphold it with justice and with righteousness from that time on, even forever. The zeal of Yahweh of Armies will perform this.

hausa: Wannan shi ne yawan mutanen da Nebukadnezzar ya kai su bauta. A shekara ta bakwai ta sarautarsa, ya tafi da Yahudawa 3,023;
english: This is the number of the people whom Nebuchadnezzar carried away captive: in the seventh year, three thousand twenty-three Jews;

hausa: Ubangiji mai adalci ne cikin dukan hanyoyinsa yana kuma nuna ƙauna ga dukan abubuwan da ya yi.
english: Yahweh is righteous in all his ways, and gracious in all his works.

hausa: Duk wanda kuma ya yi ragi a kalmomi daga littafin annabcin nan, Allah zai ɗauke rabonsa na itacen rai da kuma na birnin nan mai tsarki, waɗanda aka bayyana a littafin nan.
english: If anyone takes away from the words of the book of this prophecy, God will take away his part from the tree of life, and out of the holy city, which are written in this book.

hausa: Saboda haka sai sarki ya aiki kaftin na uku da sojojinsa hamsin. Wannan kaftin na ukun ya haura ya durƙusa a gaban Iliya, ya roƙe shi ya ce, “Mutumin Allah, ina roƙonka ka dubi darajar raina da na waɗannan sojoji hamsin, bayinka!
