english: Again he sent the captain of a third fifty with his fifty. The third captain of fifty went up, and came and fell on his knees before Elijah, and begged him, and said to him, “Man of God, please let my life and the life of these fifty of your servants be precious in your sight.

hausa: “Ku da kuke hawan fararen jakuna, kuna zama a sirdin barguna, da ku da kuke tafiya a kan hanya, ku kula
english: “Speak, you who ride on white donkeys, you who sit on rich carpets, and you who walk by the way.

hausa: Gama, “A cikin ɗan lokaci kaɗan, mai zuwan nan zai zo ba kuwa zai yi jinkiri ba.
english: “In a very little while, he who comes will come and will not wait.

hausa: Bisa ga umarnin sarki, sai ’yan-kada-tă-kwana, suka tafi da sauri. Aka ba da umarni a mazaunin masarauta da yake a Shusha. Sai Sarki da Haman suka zauna don su sha, amma birnin Shusha ya ruɗe.
english: The couriers went out in haste by the king’s commandment, and the decree was given out in the citadel of Susa. The king and Haman sat down to drink; but the city of Susa was perplexed.

hausa: Ba shakka ya Allah ka gajiyar da ni; ka ɓata gidana gaba ɗaya.
english: But now, God, you have surely worn me out. You have made all my company desolate.

hausa: Saboda haka sai ku kiyaye dukan umarnan da nake ba ku a yau, don ku sami ƙarfin da za ku shiga, ku kuma karɓi ƙasar da kuke haye Urdun ku mallaka,
english: Therefore you shall keep the entire commandment which I command you today, that you may be strong, and go in and possess the land that you go over to possess;

hausa: Abubuwan da za ku gani za su sa ku yi hauka.
english: so that the sights that you see with your eyes will drive you mad.

hausa: Saboda haka Dawuda ya aikata yadda Ubangiji ya umarce shi, ya kuma karkashe Filistiyawa tun daga Geba har zuwa Gezer.
english: David did so, as Yahweh commanded him, and struck the Philistines all the way from Geba to Gezer.

hausa: Kamar ƙanƙara a rani ko ruwan sama a lokacin girbi, haka girmamawa bai dace da wawa ba.
english: Like snow in summer, and as rain in harvest, so honor is not fitting for a fool.

hausa: suna son wurin zaman manya a wurin biki, da kuma wuraren zama gaba-gaba a majami’u;
english: and love the place of honor at feasts, the best seats in the synagogues,

hausa: To, na farkon da aka sāke zaunar da su a mallakarsu a garuruwansu, su ne waɗansu Isra’ilawa, firistoci, Lawiyawa da kuma masu hidimar haikali.
english: Now the first inhabitants who lived in their possessions in their cities were Israel, the priests, the Levites, and the temple servants.

hausa: Kashegari da sassafe, Dawuda ya tashi ya bar tumakinsa wa wani yă lura da su, sai ya ɗauki kayansa, ya kama hanya kamar yadda Yesse ya umarce shi. Ya isa sansanin daidai sa’ad da rundunar tana fitowa zuwa bakin dāgā, suna kirarin yaƙi.
english: David rose up early in the morning and left the sheep with a keeper, and took the provisions and went, as Jesse had commanded him. He came to the place of the wagons as the army which was going out to the fight shouted for the battle.

hausa: “Wa ya zuga wannan daga gabas, yana kiransa cikin adalci ga yin hidima? Ya miƙa masa al’ummai ya kuma yi nasara da sarakuna a gabansa. Ya mai da su ƙura da takobinsa, zuwa inda iska ke hurawa ta wurin bugun da ya yi musu.
english: Who has raised up one from the east? Who called him to his feet in righteousness? He hands over nations to him and makes him rule over kings. He gives them like the dust to his sword, like the driven stubble to his bow.

hausa: Dukiyar da aka samu a hanyar da ba tă dace ba, ba ta da albarka, amma adalci kan ceci mutum daga mutuwa.
english: Treasures of wickedness profit nothing, but righteousness delivers from death.

hausa: Na biye da Agiyi a matsayi, shi ne Shamma ɗan Agi, mutumin Harar. Sa’ad da Filistiyawa suka taru a wani wurin da take gona cike da waken barewa, sai rundunar Isra’ila suka gudu daga Filistiyawa.
english: After him was Shammah the son of Agee, a Hararite. The Philistines had gathered together into a troop where there was a plot of ground full of lentils; and the people fled from the Philistines.

hausa: Ubangiji ya yi magana da Musa da Haruna game da Isra’ilawa da Fir’auna sarkin Masar, ya umarce su su fitar da Isra’ilawa daga Masar.
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses and to Aaron, and gave them a command to the children of Israel, and to Pharaoh king of Egypt, to bring the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt.

hausa: Ni baƙa ce, duk da haka kyakkyawa. Ya ku ’yan matan Urushalima, ni baƙa ce kamar tentunan Kedar, kamar labulen tentin Solomon.
english: I am dark, but lovely, you daughters of Jerusalem, like Kedar’s tents, like Solomon’s curtains.

hausa: Gaggauta, ka gudu zuwa can, ba zan yi kome ba sai ka isa can.” (Domin haka ne ake kira garin Zowar.)
english: Hurry, escape there, for I can’t do anything until you get there.” Therefore the name of the city was called Zoar.

hausa: Ka rushe fuskokinsu da kunya don mutane su nemi sunanka, ya Ubangiji.
english: Fill their faces with confusion, that they may seek your name, Yahweh.

hausa: Ubangiji ya aikata manyan abubuwa dominmu, mun kuwa cika da farin ciki.
english: Yahweh has done great things for us, and we are glad.

hausa: Daga zuriyar Amram, Izhar, mutanen Hebron da kuma Uzziyel, su ma aka ba su aiki.
english: Of the Amramites, of the Izharites, of the Hebronites, of the Uzzielites:

hausa: Duk waɗanda suka ƙi horon sun rena kansu ke nan, amma duk waɗanda sun yarda da gyara sukan ƙara basira.
english: He who refuses correction despises his own soul, but he who listens to reproof gets understanding.

hausa: Haka yake, sa’ad da muke ’yan yara, mun kasance cikin bauta a ƙarƙashin ƙa’idodin duniya.
english: So we also, when we were children, were held in bondage under the elemental principles of the world.

hausa: Bangaskiyar mutum ta yarda masa yă ci kome, amma wanda bangaskiyarsa ba tă yi ƙarfi ba, yakan ci kayan lambu ne kawai.
english: One man has faith to eat all things, but he who is weak eats only vegetables.

hausa: Rana takan fito rana ta kuma fāɗi, ta kuma gaggauta zuwa inda takan fito.
english: The sun also rises, and the sun goes down, and hurries to its place where it rises.

hausa: Waƙar haurawa. Daga cikin zurfafa na yi kuka gare ka, ya Ubangiji;
english: A Song of Ascents. Out of the depths I have cried to you, Yahweh.

hausa: “Zan cinna wa katangar Damaskus wuta; za tă ci kagaran Ben-Hadad.”
english: “I will kindle a fire in the wall of Damascus, and it will devour the palaces of Ben Hadad.”

hausa: Ya kuma yi ƙananan garkuwoyi ɗari uku na zinariya. An yi kowane garkuwa da zinariya minas uku. Ya sa su a cikin Fadar Kurmin Lebanon.
english: He made three hundred shields of beaten gold; three minas of gold went to one shield; and the king put them in the House of the Forest of Lebanon.

hausa: Kamar yadda duka suka mutu cikin Adamu, haka duka za su rayu cikin Kiristi.
english: For as in Adam all die, so also in Christ all will be made alive.

hausa: Suka yi katako shida don iyaka ta ƙarshe, wato, gefen yamma na tabanakul,
english: For the far part of the tabernacle westward he made six boards.

hausa: Ya sa aka ji tausayinsu a wurin dukan waɗanda suka kame su.
english: He made them also to be pitied by all those who carried them captive.

hausa: Ruhu ne yake ba da rai; jikin kam, ba ya amfana kome. Kalmomin da na faɗa muku, Ruhu ne, da kuma rai.
english: It is the spirit who gives life. The flesh profits nothing. The words that I speak to you are spirit, and are life.

hausa: A lokacin, na roƙi Ubangiji na ce,
english: I begged Yahweh at that time, saying,

hausa: “Dole mutumin da ya saki akuya na azazel yă wanke rigunansa yă kuma yi wanka; bayan haka zai iya shiga sansani.
english: “He who lets the goat go as the scapegoat shall wash his clothes, and bathe his flesh in water, and afterward he shall come into the camp.

hausa: Kana ƙaunar mugunta fiye da alheri, ƙarya a maimakon faɗin gaskiya. Sela
english: You love evil more than good, lying rather than speaking the truth. Selah.

hausa: Ina da baƙin ciki mai yawa da kuma rashin kwanciyar rai marar ƙarewa a zuciyata.
english: that I have great sorrow and unceasing pain in my heart.

hausa: “Na biyun ya zo ya ce, ‘Ranka yă daɗe, minarka ya sami ribar biyar.’
english: “The second came, saying, ‘Your mina, Lord, has made five minas.’

hausa: Ubangiji ya karye sandar mugaye, sandan mulkin masu mulki,
english: Yahweh has broken the staff of the wicked, the scepter of the rulers,

hausa: Sa’an nan Ubangiji ya ce wa Musa, “Ka bar wannan wuri, kai da mutanen da ka fito da su daga Masar, ka haura zuwa ƙasar da na alkawarta da rantsuwa wa Ibrahim, Ishaku da Yaƙub cewa, ‘Zan ba zuriyarka.’
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, “Depart, go up from here, you and the people that you have brought up out of the land of Egypt, to the land of which I swore to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, saying, ‘I will give it to your offspring.’

hausa: Ba magani ne a Gileyad? Ba likita ne a can? To, me ya sa ba warkarwa wa raunin mutanena?
english: Is there no balm in Gilead? Is there no physician there? Why then isn’t the health of the daughter of my people recovered?

hausa: Matar kuwa ta haifi ɗa, aka sa masa suna Samson. Ya yi girma Ubangiji kuma ya albarkace shi,
english: The woman bore a son and named him Samson. The child grew, and Yahweh blessed him.

hausa: Ka dubi duk wani mai girman kai ka ƙasƙantar da shi, ka tattake mugaye a inda ka tsaya.
english: Look at everyone who is proud, and humble him. Crush the wicked in their place.

hausa: Ta zama sanadin fāɗuwar yawanci; kisan da ta yi ba ta ƙidayuwa.
english: for she has thrown down many wounded. Yes, all her slain are a mighty army.

hausa: Mutane za su sāke zauna a inuwarsa. Zai haɓaka kamar ƙwayar hatsi. Zai yi fure kamar kuringa, zai zama sananne kamar ruwan inabi daga Lebanon.
english: Men will dwell in his shade. They will revive like the grain, and blossom like the vine. Their fragrance will be like the wine of Lebanon.

hausa: Ya sa Lawiyawa su yi hidima a gaban akwatin alkawarin Ubangiji, su ɗaukaka, su gode, su kuma yabi Ubangiji, Allah na Isra’ila.
english: He appointed some of the Levites to minister before Yahweh’s ark, and to commemorate, to thank, and to praise Yahweh, the God of Israel:

hausa: Game da Yezebel kuwa, karnuka za su cinye ta a fili a Yezireyel, ba kuwa wanda zai binne ta.’ ” Sa’an nan ya buɗe ƙofa ya ruga a guje.
english: The dogs will eat Jezebel on the plot of ground of Jezreel, and there shall be no one to bury her.’” Then he opened the door and fled.

hausa: Za a iya ƙwace ganima daga jarumawa, ko a kuɓutar da kamammu daga hannun marasa tsoro?
english: Shall the plunder be taken from the mighty, or the lawful captives be delivered?

hausa: Sai ga walƙiya, ƙararraki, tsawa da kuma matsananciyar girgizar ƙasa. Ba a taɓa yin irin wannan girgizar ƙasar ba, tun kasancewar mutum a duniya, girgizar ƙasar kuwa gawurtacciya ce.
english: There were lightnings, sounds, and thunders; and there was a great earthquake such as has not happened since there were men on the earth—so great an earthquake and so mighty.

hausa: Elifelet, ɗan Ahasbai mutumin Ma’aka, Eliyam, ɗan Ahitofel mutumin Gilo,
english: Eliphelet the son of Ahasbai, the son of the Maacathite, Eliam the son of Ahithophel the Gilonite,

hausa: Wane ne ka zargi ka kuma yi wa saɓo? A kan wa ka tā da muryarka ka kuma daga idanu cikin fariya? A kan Mai Tsarkin nan na Isra’ila!
english: Whom have you defied and blasphemed? Against whom have you exalted your voice and lifted up your eyes on high? Against the Holy One of Israel.

hausa: Zuciyata ba tă daina ƙuna ba; ina fuskantar kwanakin wahala.
english: My heart is troubled, and doesn’t rest. Days of affliction have come on me.

hausa: Ubangiji ɗaya, bangaskiya ɗaya, baftisma kuma ɗaya,
english: one Lord, one faith, one baptism,

hausa: Ta wurin bangaskiya ya bar Masar, ba tare da jin tsoron fushin sarki ba; ya kuwa jure domin ya ga wannan wanda ba a iya gani.
english: By faith he left Egypt, not fearing the wrath of the king; for he endured, as seeing him who is invisible.

hausa: Ɗana, in masu zunubi sun jarabce ka, kada ka yarda.
english: My son, if sinners entice you, don’t consent.

hausa: Ta wurinsu ana gargaɗe bawanka; a kiyaye su akwai lada mai girma.
english: Moreover your servant is warned by them. In keeping them there is great reward.

hausa: Samson ya gangara zuwa Timna a can ya ga wata daga cikin ’yan mata Filistiyawa.
english: Samson went down to Timnah, and saw a woman in Timnah of the daughters of the Philistines.

hausa: “’Yan’uwa da iyaye, ku saurari kāriyata yanzu.”
english: “Brothers and fathers, listen to the defense which I now make to you.”

hausa: Amma Ubangiji ya taurare zuciyar Fir’auna, har bai yarda yă sake su ba.
english: But Yahweh hardened Pharaoh’s heart, and he wouldn’t let them go.

hausa: Wannan matalauci ya yi kira, Ubangiji kuwa ya ji shi; ya cece shi daga dukan wahalarsa.
english: This poor man cried, and Yahweh heard him, and saved him out of all his troubles.

hausa: Daga zuriyar Kohat, Uriyel shugaba da dangi 120;
english: of the sons of Kohath, Uriel the chief, and his brothers one hundred twenty;

hausa: Ya kamata kullum ƙauna tă sa mu faɗa gaskiya. Ta haka za mu yi girma a kowace hanya, mu kuma zama kamar Kiristi, wanda yake kan
english: but speaking truth in love, we may grow up in all things into him who is the head, Christ,

hausa: Zan hallaka biranen ƙasarku in yi rugu-rugu da dukan katangunku.
english: I will cut off the cities of your land and will tear down all your strongholds.

hausa: Dole yă ba da abin da ya yi gumi kafin yă samu, ba zai ci ba; ba zai ji daɗin ribar da ya samu daga kasuwancinsa ba.
english: He will restore that for which he labored, and will not swallow it down. He will not rejoice according to the substance that he has gotten.

hausa: Sunan ɗansa na fari Yowel, na biyu kuwa Abiya. Suka yi alƙalanci a Beyersheba.
english: Now the name of his firstborn was Joel, and the name of his second, Abijah. They were judges in Beersheba.

hausa: masu shirya maƙarƙashiya a zukatansu suna kuma kawo yaƙi kullum.
english: those who devise mischief in their hearts. They continually gather themselves together for war.

hausa: Ba na bukatan bijimi daga turkenku ko awaki daga garkunanku,
english: I have no need for a bull from your stall, nor male goats from your pens.

hausa: “Amma in bawan ya furta ya ce, ‘Ina ƙaunar maigidana, da matata, da ’ya’yana, ba na so kuma in ’yantu,’
english: But if the servant shall plainly say, ‘I love my master, my wife, and my children. I will not go out free;’

hausa: “In wani ya yi zunubi bai kuma yi aminci ga Ubangiji ba, wato, ta wurin yin wa abokin zamansa karya game da ajiyar da abokin ya ba shi amana, ko a kan wani alkawarin da suka yi wa juna, ko kuwa a kan yă cuci abokin,
english: “If anyone sins, and commits a trespass against Yahweh, and deals falsely with his neighbor in a matter of deposit, or of bargain, or of robbery, or has oppressed his neighbor,

hausa: Alheri yă kasance da ku duka.
english: Grace be with you all. Amen.

hausa: Sai macen ta gudu zuwa hamada zuwa inda Allah ya shirya dominta, inda za a lura da ita har kwana 1,260.
english: The woman fled into the wilderness, where she has a place prepared by God, that there they may nourish her one thousand two hundred sixty days.

hausa: Kunnuwana sun ji game da kai amma yanzu na gan ka.
english: I had heard of you by the hearing of the ear, but now my eye sees you.

hausa: Kada ka ba da ran kurciyarka ga namun jeji; kada ka manta har abada da rayukan mutanenka masu shan azaba.
english: Don’t deliver the soul of your dove to wild beasts. Don’t forget the life of your poor forever.

hausa: Ka ja bakanka, ka nemi a ba ka kibiyoyi masu yawa. Sela Ka raba duniya da koguna;
english: You uncovered your bow. You called for your sworn arrows. Selah. You split the earth with rivers.

hausa: Masu zalunci za su ƙare, masu ba’a za su ɓace, kuma dukan waɗanda suke da ido don mugunta za su hallaka,
english: For the ruthless is brought to nothing, and the scoffer ceases, and all those who are alert to do evil are cut off—

hausa: Suka yi zobai biyu na zinariya suka haɗa, suka sa su a gefe biyu na ƙyallen maƙalawa a ƙirji daga ciki kusa da efod.
english: They made two rings of gold, and put them on the two ends of the breastplate, on its edge, which was toward the side of the ephod inward.

hausa: Suka amsa suka ce, “Zai yi wa banzan mutanen nan mugun kisa, yă ba da hayar gonar inabin ga waɗansu ’yan haya, waɗanda za su ba shi rabonsa na amfanin gona a lokacin girbi.”
english: They told him, “He will miserably destroy those miserable men, and will lease out the vineyard to other farmers who will give him the fruit in its season.”

hausa: Mai hikima ya san inda ya nufa, wawa kuwa yana tafiya a cikin duhu; amma sai na gane cewa ƙaddara ɗaya ce take samunsu.
english: The wise man’s eyes are in his head, and the fool walks in darkness—and yet I perceived that one event happens to them all.

hausa: Zai ɗauki bunsurai biyu daga jama’ar Isra’ilawa na hadaya don zunubi da ɗan rago don hadaya ta ƙonawa.
english: He shall take from the congregation of the children of Israel two male goats for a sin offering, and one ram for a burnt offering.

hausa: Amma Yaƙub bai aiki Benyamin, ɗan’uwan Yusuf tare da sauran ba, gama yana tsoro kada wani abu yă faru da shi.
english: But Jacob didn’t send Benjamin, Joseph’s brother, with his brothers; for he said, “Lest perhaps harm happen to him.”

hausa: Sauran ayyukan mulkin Yosiya da kuma kyawawan abubuwan da ya yi, bisa ga abin da aka rubuta a Dokar Ubangiji,
english: Now the rest of the acts of Josiah and his good deeds, according to that which is written in Yahweh’s law,

hausa: Amma Ubangiji ya zama kagarata, Allahna kuma dutsen da nake samun mafaka.
english: But Yahweh has been my high tower, my God, the rock of my refuge.

hausa: Sai masanan taurarin suka amsa wa sarki suka ce, “Babu wani mutum a duniyan nan da zai iya yin abin da sarki yake nema! Babu wani sarki mai daraja da girma wanda ya taɓa yin irin wannan tambaya ga masu sihiri ko masu dabo ko masanan taurari.
english: The Chaldeans answered the king and said, “There is not a man on the earth who can show the king’s matter, because no king, lord, or ruler has asked such a thing of any magician, enchanter, or Chaldean.

hausa: Amma in ba za ku yarda a yi muku kaciya ba, za mu ɗauki ’yar’uwanmu mu tafi.”
english: But if you will not listen to us and be circumcised, then we will take our sister, and we will be gone.”

hausa: Gama abin da Allah ya umarce mu ke nan cewa, “ ‘Na sa ka zama haske ga Al’ummai, don ka kawo cetona zuwa iyakokin duniya.’”
english: For so has the Lord commanded us, saying, ‘I have set you as a light for the Gentiles, that you should bring salvation to the uttermost parts of the earth.’”

hausa: “ ‘Saboda haka ga abin da Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka yana cewa domin ya yi tsayi, kansa kuma ya kai cikin gizagizai, kuma domin ya yi fariya saboda tsayinsa,
english: “Therefore thus said the Lord Yahweh: ‘Because he is exalted in stature, and he has set his top among the thick branches, and his heart is lifted up in his height,

hausa: Sai ɗaya daga cikin Sha Biyun nan, wanda ake kira Yahuda Iskariyot, ya je wurin manyan firistoci
english: Then one of the twelve, who was called Judas Iscariot, went to the chief priests

hausa: Ka gyara wuri saboda shi, ya kuwa yi saiwa ya cike ƙasa.
english: You cleared the ground for it. It took deep root, and filled the land.

hausa: Ya bi duk gurbin mahaifinsa a kome, ya yi sujada ga gumakan da mahaifinsa ya yi wa, ya kuma durƙusa musu.
english: He walked in all the ways that his father walked in, and served the idols that his father served, and worshiped them;

hausa: mutanen Lawi, su 4,600,
english: Of the children of Levi: four thousand six hundred.

hausa: Dabbar da a dā ta taɓa kasancewa, amma yanzu ba ta, ita ce sarki na takwas. Ita ɗaya ce cikin bakwai ɗin, kuma tana tafiya zuwa ga hallakarta.
english: The beast that was, and is not, is himself also an eighth, and is of the seven; and he goes to destruction.

hausa: Sa’ad da na mai da Masar kufai na kuma raba ƙasar da abin da take cike da shi, sa’ad da na bugi dukan waɗanda suke cikinta, a sa’an nan ne za su san cewa ni ne Ubangiji.’
english: “When I make the land of Egypt desolate and waste, a land destitute of that of which it was full, when I strike all those who dwell therein, then they will know that I am Yahweh.

hausa: Ko da yake sun sayar da kansu a cikin al’ummai, yanzu zan tattara su wuri ɗaya. Za su fara lalacewa a ƙarƙashi danniyar babban sarki.
english: But although they sold themselves among the nations, I will now gather them; and they begin to waste away because of the oppression of the king of mighty ones.

hausa: Aka ɗauko shi a kan doki aka kawo shi Urushalima, aka kuwa binne shi tare da kakanninsa, a Birnin Dawuda.
english: They brought him on horses, and he was buried at Jerusalem with his fathers in David’s city.

hausa: Saboda haka suka ci gaba, rana tana fāɗuwa sa’ad da suka yi kusa da Gibeya a Benyamin.
english: So they passed on and went their way; and the sun went down on them near Gibeah, which belongs to Benjamin.

hausa: Suka ce, “Za mu mayar musu, kuma ba za mu bukaci wani abu daga gare su ba. Za mu yi yadda ka faɗa.” Sai na tattara firistoci na kuma sa manyan gari da shugabanni su yi rantsuwa don su yi abin da suka yi alkawari.
english: Then they said, “We will restore them, and will require nothing of them. We will do so, even as you say.” Then I called the priests, and took an oath of them, that they would do according to this promise.

hausa: Gaskiyar ita ce, sa’ad da muke tare da ku, mun sha gaya muku cewa za a tsananta mana. Haka kuwa ya faru, kamar dai yadda kuka sani.
english: For most certainly, when we were with you, we told you beforehand that we are to suffer affliction, even as it happened, and you know.

hausa: “Assuriya tana can tare da dukan sojojinta; an kewaye ta da kaburburan dukan waɗanda aka kashe, dukan waɗanda suka mutu ta wurin takobi.
english: “Asshur is there with all her company. Her graves are all around her. All of them are slain, fallen by the sword,

hausa: na ukun, Absalom ɗan Ma’aka ’yar Talmai sarkin Geshur; na huɗun, Adoniya ɗan Haggit;
english: the third, Absalom the son of Maacah the daughter of Talmai king of Geshur; the fourth, Adonijah the son of Haggith;

hausa: Don mai bi da kaɗe-kaɗe. Bisa ga mahalat. Wani maskil na Dawuda. Wawa ne kawai yakan ce a zuciyarsa, “Ba Allah.” Sun lalace, kuma hanyoyinsu ba su da kyau; babu wani mai aikata abu mai kyau.
english: For the Chief Musician. To the tune of “Mahalath.” A contemplation by David. The fool has said in his heart, “There is no God.” They are corrupt, and have done abominable iniquity. There is no one who does good.

hausa: Ƙaunarka, ya Ubangiji, kan kai sammai, amincinka har sararin sammai.
english: Your loving kindness, Yahweh, is in the heavens. Your faithfulness reaches to the skies.

hausa: Amma Allah ya sami mutane da laifi ya ce, “Ina gaya muku lokaci yana zuwa, sa’ad da zan yi sabon alkawari da gidan Isra’ila da kuma gidan Yahuda.
english: For finding fault with them, he said, “Behold, the days are coming”, says the Lord, “that I will make a new covenant with the house of Israel and with the house of Judah;

hausa: Sai Laban ya ce, “Na yarda. Bari yă zama yadda ka faɗa.”
english: Laban said, “Behold, let it be according to your word.”

hausa: Sai Dawuda tare da mutanensa, mutum ɗari shida suka tashi suka haye zuwa wurin Akish ɗan Mawok, sarkin Gat.
english: David arose and passed over, he and the six hundred men who were with him, to Achish the son of Maoch, king of Gath.

hausa: Saƙon Ubangiji ya fito daga gare ku ne ba a Makidoniya da Akayya kaɗai ba bangaskiyarku ga Allah ta zama sananne ko’ina. Saboda haka ba ma bukata mu faɗa wani abu a kai,
english: For from you the word of the Lord has been declared, not only in Macedonia and Achaia, but also in every place your faith toward God has gone out, so that we need not say anything.

hausa: Waɗannan su ne sassan ’ya’yan Haruna maza. ’Ya’yan Haruna maza su ne Nadab, Abihu, Eleyazar da Itamar.
english: These were the divisions of the sons of Aaron. The sons of Aaron: Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.

hausa: Ya amsa ya ce, “Ku shiga gari wurin wāne, ku ce masa, ‘Malam ya ce, lokacina ya yi kusa. Zan ci Bikin Ƙetarewa tare da almajiraina a gidanka.’ ”
english: He said, “Go into the city to a certain person, and tell him, ‘The Teacher says, “My time is at hand. I will keep the Passover at your house with my disciples.”’”

hausa: Sa’an nan za ku fahimci abin da yake daidai da abin da yake na adalci da abin da yake gaskiya, da kowace hanya mai kyau.
english: Then you will understand righteousness and justice, equity and every good path.

hausa: Ga abin da Ubangiji yana cewa, “Ga shi! Gaggafa tana firiya zuwa ƙasa, tana shimfiɗa fikafikanta a kan Mowab.
english: For Yahweh says: “Behold, he will fly as an eagle, and will spread out his wings against Moab.

hausa: Ta wurin bincika shi da kanka za ka gane gaskiyar game da dukan waɗannan zargin da muke kawo a kansa.”
english: By examining him yourself you may ascertain all these things of which we accuse him.”

hausa: Yesu ya sami ɗan jaki, ya hau, kamar yadda yake a rubuce cewa,
english: Jesus, having found a young donkey, sat on it. As it is written,

hausa: Suka kuma jifa ƙuri’a, kamar dai yadda ’yan’uwansu zuriyar Haruna suka yi, a gaban Sarki Dawuda da gaban Zadok, Ahimelek, da kuma a gaban kawunan iyalan firistoci da na Lawiyawa. Aka yi da iyalan wa daidai da iyalan ƙane.
english: These likewise cast lots even as their brothers the sons of Aaron in the presence of David the king, Zadok, Ahimelech, and the heads of the fathers’ households of the priests and of the Levites, the fathers’ households of the chief even as those of his younger brother.

hausa: “Ba zan shiga gidana ko in kwanta a gado ba,
english: “Surely I will not come into the structure of my house, nor go up into my bed;

hausa: Zan je in tsaya da mahaifina a fili inda kake, zan yi masa magana game da kai. Zan kuma gaya maka abin da na ji.”
english: I will go out and stand beside my father in the field where you are, and I will talk with my father about you; and if I see anything, I will tell you.”

hausa: Ka cece ni daga laifin jini, ya Allah, Allahn da ya cece ni, harshena kuwa zai rera adalcinka.
english: Deliver me from the guilt of bloodshed, O God, the God of my salvation. My tongue will sing aloud of your righteousness.

hausa: In akwai wani gidan da ba za su iya cinye rago guda ɗungum ba, saboda iyalin kima ne, to, sai su haɗa kai da maƙwabtansu, su ɗauki rago guda gwargwadon yawansu, bisa ga abin da mutum guda zai ci.
english: and if the household is too little for a lamb, then he and his neighbor next to his house shall take one according to the number of the souls. You shall make your count for the lamb according to what everyone can eat.

hausa: Haka ne tashin matattu zai kasance. Abin da aka shuka yakan ruɓe, abin da aka tā da shi kuma ba ya ruɓewa;
english: So also is the resurrection of the dead. The body is sown perishable; it is raised imperishable.

hausa: sai dai su yi ayyuka masu kyan da suka dace da matan da suke masu bauta wa Allah.
english: but with good works, which is appropriate for women professing godliness.

hausa: A wuri mai tsarki da yake waje da kuma Wuri Mafi Tsarki suna da ƙofa biyu a haɗe.
english: The temple and the sanctuary had two doors.

hausa: Sa’ad da kuka zo don ku bayyana a gabana, wa ya nemi wannan daga gare ku, da kuke kai da kawowa a filayen gidana?
english: When you come to appear before me, who has required this at your hand, to trample my courts?

hausa: Laban kuma ya ba da baranyarsa Zilfa wa ’yarsa tă zama mai hidimarta.
english: Laban gave Zilpah his servant to his daughter Leah for a servant.

hausa: Daga zuriyar Yahuda. Aka rubuta sunayen dukan maza ɗaya-ɗaya da suka kai shekara ashirin ko fiye da suka isa shiga soja, bisa ga iyalansu da kabilarsu da take a rubuce.
english: Of the children of Judah, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war:

hausa: Sa’an nan Isra’ila ya ce wa Yusuf, “Ina gab da mutuwa, amma Allah zai kasance tare da ku
english: Israel said to Joseph, “Behold, I am dying, but God will be with you, and bring you again to the land of your fathers.

hausa: A ranar farko ta mako muka taru wuri ɗaya don gutsuttsura burodi. Bulus ya yi wa mutane magana, don yana niyyar tashi kashegari, sai ya yi ta yin magana har tsakar dare.
english: On the first day of the week, when the disciples were gathered together to break bread, Paul talked with them, intending to depart on the next day; and continued his speech until midnight.

hausa: Sa’an nan ya sa labule a ƙofar shiga na tabanakul.
english: He put up the screen of the door to the tabernacle.

hausa: Daga baya, da ya koma don yă aure ta, sai ya ratse don yă ga gawar zakin. Sai ga taron ƙudan zuma da zuma a ciki,
english: After a while he returned to take her, and he went over to see the carcass of the lion; and behold, there was a swarm of bees in the body of the lion, and honey.

hausa: Me ya sa ka bari ina ta kallon rashin gaskiya? Me ya sa kake barin abin da ba daidai ba? Hallaka da tashin hankali suna a gabana; ga rashin jituwa da faɗa ko’ina.
english: Why do you show me iniquity, and look at perversity? For destruction and violence are before me. There is strife, and contention rises up.

hausa: To, shi da yake ba mai shuka iri, yake kuma ba da abinci a ci, shi ne zai ba ku irin shukawa, yă riɓanya shi, yă kuma albarkaci ayyukanku na alheri da yawa.
english: Now may he who supplies seed to the sower and bread for food, supply and multiply your seed for sowing, and increase the fruits of your righteousness,

hausa: Suka iso Betsaida, sai waɗansu mutane suka kawo wani makaho, suka roƙi Yesu yă taɓa shi.
english: He came to Bethsaida. They brought a blind man to him and begged him to touch him.

hausa: Ya aiki Eliyakim sarkin fada, Shebna magatakarda da kuma manyan firistoci, duka sanye da tsummoki, wurin Ishaya ɗan Amoz.
english: He sent Eliakim, who was over the household, and Shebna the scribe, and the elders of the priests, covered with sackcloth, to Isaiah the prophet, the son of Amoz.

hausa: “Kaitonku, domin kun gina kaburbura saboda annabawa, nan kuwa kakannin-kakanninku ne suka kashe su.
english: Woe to you! For you build the tombs of the prophets, and your fathers killed them.

hausa: Yanzu ku tsaya tsit ku ga abin da Ubangiji ke dab da yi a gabanku.
english: “Now therefore stand still and see this great thing, which Yahweh will do before your eyes.

hausa: Bakin Bahar Rum nan ne iyakar yammanci. Wannan ita ce iyakar da ta kewaye jama’ar Yahuda bisa ga iyalansu.
english: The west border was to the shore of the great sea. This is the border of the children of Judah according to their families.

hausa: Sa’an nan zan riƙa rera yabo ga sunanka in kuma cika alkawarina kowace rana.
english: So I will sing praise to your name forever, that I may fulfill my vows daily.

hausa: Sai Ubangiji ya ce, “Fita ka tsaya a kan dutse a gaban Ubangiji, gama Ubangiji yana shirin wucewa.” Sai ga babbar iska mai ƙarfi ta tsage duwatsu, ta kuma ragargaza duwatsu a gaban Ubangiji, amma Ubangiji ba ya cikin iskar. Bayan iskar sai aka yi girgizar ƙasa, amma Ubangiji ba ya cikin girgizar ƙasa.
english: He said, “Go out and stand on the mountain before Yahweh.” Behold, Yahweh passed by, and a great and strong wind tore the mountains and broke in pieces the rocks before Yahweh; but Yahweh was not in the wind. After the wind there was an earthquake; but Yahweh was not in the earthquake.

hausa: Ba shi ne ya ce wa sarakuna, ‘Ba ku da amfani ba,’ ya ce wa manya ‘Ku mugaye ne,’
english: who says to a king, ‘Vile!’ or to nobles, ‘Wicked!’?

hausa: Ubangiji ya rantse ba zai kuma canja zuciyarsa ba, “Kai firist ne har abada, bisa ga tsarin Melkizedek.”
english: Yahweh has sworn, and will not change his mind: “You are a priest forever in the order of Melchizedek.”

hausa: Amma Rehobowam ya ƙi shawarar da dattawan suka ba shi, sai ya nemi shawarar matasa waɗanda suka yi girma tare, waɗanda kuma suke masa hidima.
english: But he abandoned the counsel of the old men which they had given him, and took counsel with the young men who had grown up with him, who stood before him.

hausa: Ba za a ƙara samun la’ana ba. Kursiyin Allah da na Ɗan Ragon zai kasance a cikin birnin, bayinsa kuma za su yi masa hidima.
english: There will be no curse any more. The throne of God and of the Lamb will be in it, and his servants will serve him.

hausa: Shawara da yin tunani mai kyau nawa ne; ina da fahimi da kuma iko.
english: Counsel and sound knowledge are mine. I have understanding and power.

hausa: Na riƙe farillanka kankan, ya Ubangiji; kada ka sa in sha kunya.
english: I cling to your statutes, Yahweh. Don’t let me be disappointed.

hausa: Sa’an nan ya sa nisan tafiya kwana uku tsakaninsa da Yaƙub, yayinda Yaƙub ya ci gaba da lura da sauran garkunan Laban Yaƙub.
english: He set three days’ journey between himself and Jacob, and Jacob fed the rest of Laban’s flocks.

hausa: “Kamar yadda yake a rubuce a cikin Doka, za mu kawo ɗan fari na ’ya’yanmu maza da na garken shanunmu, da na tumakinmu, da kuma na awakinmu a gidan Allahnmu, don firistocin da suke aikin a can.
english: also the firstborn of our sons and of our livestock, as it is written in the law, and the firstborn of our herds and of our flocks, to bring to the house of our God, to the priests who minister in the house of our God;

hausa: Sa’an nan mutumin ya rusuna ya yi wa Ubangiji sujada,
english: The man bowed his head, and worshiped Yahweh.

hausa: Amma in na ce, “Ba zan ambace shi ba ba zan ƙara yin magana da sunansa ba,” sai in ji maganarsa a cikina kamar wuta, wutar da aka kulle a ƙasusuwana. Na gaji da danne ta a cikina; tabbatacce ba zan iya ba.
english: If I say that I will not make mention of him, or speak any more in his name, then there is in my heart as it were a burning fire shut up in my bones. I am weary with holding it in. I can’t.

hausa: Mun san cewa doka tana da kyau in an yi amfani da ita yadda ya kamata.
english: But we know that the law is good if a person uses it lawfully,

hausa: Daga zuriyar Hebron, Hashabiya da danginsa, su jarumawa dubu ɗaya da ɗari bakwai ne, su suke lura da Isra’ila yamma da Urdun don dukan aikin Ubangiji da kuma hidimar sarki.
english: Of the Hebronites, Hashabiah and his brothers, one thousand seven hundred men of valor, had the oversight of Israel beyond the Jordan westward, for all the business of Yahweh and for the service of the king.

hausa: ya koya mini ya ce, “Ka riƙe kalmomina da dukan zuciyarka; ka kiyaye umarnaina za ka kuwa rayu.
english: He taught me, and said to me: “Let your heart retain my words. Keep my commandments, and live.

hausa: Suka tashi nan da nan suka koma Urushalima. A can suka sami Sha Ɗayan nan da waɗanda suke tare da su a wuri ɗaya,
english: They rose up that very hour, returned to Jerusalem, and found the eleven gathered together, and those who were with them,

hausa: sai ka bar baikonka a can gaban bagade. Ka je ka shirya tukuna da ɗan’uwanka; sa’an nan ka zo ka ba da baikonka.
english: leave your gift there before the altar, and go your way. First be reconciled to your brother, and then come and offer your gift.

hausa: Mordekai kuwa ya aika da wasiƙu zuwa ga dukan Yahudawa cikin larduna 127 na masarautar Zerzes. Saƙon fatan alheri da na tabbaci,
english: He sent letters to all the Jews in the hundred twenty-seven provinces of the kingdom of Ahasuerus with words of peace and truth,

hausa: Ban yi biyayya da malamaina ba ko in saurari masu koyar da ni.
english: I haven’t obeyed the voice of my teachers, nor turned my ear to those who instructed me!

hausa: sa’ad da masu tsaron gida suke rawar jiki, majiya ƙarfi kuma suka rasa ƙarfi, sa’ad da masu niƙa suka daina don ba su da yawa, idanun da suke duba ta taga suka duhunta;
english: in the day when the keepers of the house shall tremble, and the strong men shall bow themselves, and the grinders cease because they are few, and those who look out of the windows are darkened,

hausa: Sai Sarkin Masar ya gaya wa ungozomomin matan Ibraniyawa, wato, su Shofra da Fuwa ya ce,
english: The king of Egypt spoke to the Hebrew midwives, of whom the name of the one was Shiphrah, and the name of the other Puah,

hausa: Na yi wauta kam, amma ku ne kuke tilasta mini, ku ne kuwa ya kamata ku yaba mini, domin ba inda na kāsa waɗannan mafiffitan manzanni, ko da yake ni ba kome ba ne.
english: I have become foolish in boasting. You compelled me, for I ought to have been commended by you, for I am in no way inferior to the very best apostles, though I am nothing.

hausa: Ga sunayensu, Ben-Hur, shi ne a ƙasar tudun Efraim;
english: These are their names: Ben Hur, in the hill country of Ephraim;

hausa: Azurfar da aka samu daga ƙidayar taron jama’a, talenti 100 ne, da shekel 1,775, bisa ga ma’aunin shekel na tsattsarkan wuri.
english: The silver of those who were counted of the congregation was one hundred talents and one thousand seven hundred seventy-five shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary:

hausa: Dukan mazan da aka ba su aiki a sansanin Efraim, bisa ga sashensu su kai 157,600. Su ne za su zama na ƙarshe, ƙarƙashin ƙa’idarsu.
english: “All who were counted of the camp of Dan were one hundred fifty-seven thousand six hundred. They shall set out last by their standards.”

hausa: Su da suke marasa azanci a ruhu za su sami fahimtar; waɗanda suke gunaguni za su yarda da koyarwa.”
english: They also who err in spirit will come to understanding, and those who grumble will receive instruction.”

hausa: Har waɗansu shugabannin lardin ma, abokan Bulus, suka aika masa suna roƙonsa kada yă kuskura ya shiga filin nan.
english: Certain also of the Asiarchs, being his friends, sent to him and begged him not to venture into the theater.

hausa: Ina misalin yawan aikinka, ya Ubangiji! Cikin hikima ka yi su duka; duniya ta cika da halittunka.
english: Yahweh, how many are your works! In wisdom, you have made them all. The earth is full of your riches.

hausa: Kamar jakunan jeji a hamada, matalauta suna aikin neman abinci gonaki marasa amfani suna tanada abinci wa ’ya’yansu.
english: Behold, as wild donkeys in the desert, they go out to their work, seeking diligently for food. The wilderness yields them bread for their children.

hausa: “Ɗan mutum, yi annabci ka ce, ‘Ga abin da Ubangiji ya faɗa, “ ‘Takobi, takobi, wasasshe da kuma gogagge,
english: “Son of man, prophesy, and say, ‘Yahweh says: “A sword! A sword! It is sharpened, and also polished.

hausa: Da aka sake su, Bitrus da Yohanna suka koma wajen mutanensu suka ba da labarin duk abin da manyan firistoci da dattawa suka faɗa musu.
english: Being let go, they came to their own company and reported all that the chief priests and the elders had said to them.

hausa: Sa’an nan ka ɗauki kwanon ƙarfe, ka shirya shi kamar katangar ƙarfe tsakaninka da birnin ka kuma zuba mata ido. Za tă kasance a ƙarƙashin ƙawanya, kai kuwa za ka yi mata ƙawanya. Wannan zai zama alama ga gidan Isra’ila.
english: Take for yourself an iron pan and set it for a wall of iron between you and the city. Then set your face toward it. It will be besieged, and you shall lay siege against it. This shall be a sign to the house of Israel.

hausa: Idanunka masu tsarki ne da suka fi gaban duban mugunta; ba ka amince da abin da ke ba daidai ba. To, don me ka ƙyale munafukai suna cin karensu ba babbaka? Me ya sa kake shiru sa’ad da mugaye suke haɗiye adalai da suka fi su adalci?
english: You who have purer eyes than to see evil, and who cannot look on perversity, why do you tolerate those who deal treacherously and keep silent when the wicked swallows up the man who is more righteous than he,

hausa: Ka nuna wa mutanenka lokutan wahala; ka ba mu ruwan inabin da ya sa muka bugu.
english: You have shown your people hard things. You have made us drink the wine that makes us stagger.

hausa: Duk abin da kuka koya ko kuka karɓa ko kuka ji daga wurina, ko kuka gani a cikina, ku yi aiki da shi. Allah na salama kuma zai kasance tare da ku.
english: Do the things which you learned, received, heard, and saw in me, and the God of peace will be with you.

hausa: Ku rera yabai ga Allah, ku rera yabai; ku rera yabai ga Sarkinmu, ku rera yabai.
english: Sing praises to God! Sing praises! Sing praises to our King! Sing praises!

hausa: Sai Ubangiji ya ce wa Musa,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

hausa: Sai Absalom ya aiki manzanni a asirce cikin dukan kabilan Isra’ila, ya ce musu su ce, “Da zarar kuka ji an busa ƙaho, sai ku ce, ‘Absalom sarki ne a Hebron.’ ”
english: But Absalom sent spies throughout all the tribes of Israel, saying, “As soon as you hear the sound of the trumpet, then you shall say, ‘Absalom is king in Hebron!’”

hausa: Ina magana da ku ne fa Al’ummai. Tun da yake ni manzo ne ga Al’ummai, ina taƙama da aikin nan nawa,
english: For I speak to you who are Gentiles. Since then as I am an apostle to Gentiles, I glorify my ministry,

hausa: Ɗaya daga cikin almajiran Yesu wanda yake ƙauna kuwa, yana zaune kusa da shi.
english: One of his disciples, whom Jesus loved, was at the table, leaning against Jesus’ chest.

hausa: Kada ku saurare su. Ku bauta wa sarkin Babilon, za ku kuwa rayu. Don me wannan birni zai zama kufai?
english: Don’t listen to them. Serve the king of Babylon, and live. Why should this city become a desolation?

hausa: Ƙaramin abu ne a gare ni a ce ku ne za ku gwada ni, ko kuwa a gwada ni a wata kotun mutane, ai, ko ni kaina ba na yanka wa kaina hukunci.
english: But with me it is a very small thing that I should be judged by you, or by a human court. Yes, I don’t even judge my own self.

hausa: domin Ruhu Mai Tsarki bai riga ya sauka wa waninsu ba tukuna, an dai yi musu baftisma ne kawai a cikin sunan Ubangiji Yesu.
english: for as yet he had fallen on none of them. They had only been baptized in the name of Christ Jesus.

hausa: Yanzu tafi, ka jagoranci mutanen zuwa inda na yi zance, mala’ikana kuma zai sha gabanku. Duk da haka sa’ad da lokaci ya yi da zan yi horo, zan hore su domin zunubinsu.”
english: Now go, lead the people to the place of which I have spoken to you. Behold, my angel shall go before you. Nevertheless, in the day when I punish, I will punish them for their sin.”

hausa: Ni ma zan iya yin maganganu kamar yadda kuke yi in da kuna cikin halin da nake; zan iya faɗar duk abubuwan da kuke faɗi, in kaɗa muku kaina.
english: I also could speak as you do. If your soul were in my soul’s place, I could join words together against you, and shake my head at you,

hausa: Ba shakka haka wurin zaman mugun mutum yake, haka wurin zaman wanda bai san Allah ba yake.”
english: Surely such are the dwellings of the unrighteous. This is the place of him who doesn’t know God.”

hausa: Sa’ad da suka gane da zunubin da suka aikata, dole taron su kawo ɗan bijimi a matsayin hadaya don zunubi, su kawo shi a gaban Tentin Sujada.
english: when the sin in which they have sinned is known, then the assembly shall offer a young bull for a sin offering, and bring it before the Tent of Meeting.

hausa: Ubangiji zai buge ku da maruran Masar, da ƙazuwa, da kuma ƙaiƙayi waɗanda ba za su warke ba
english: Yahweh will strike you with the boils of Egypt, with the tumors, with the scurvy, and with the itch, of which you can not be healed.

hausa: Hannuwansa kamar sandunan zinariyar da aka sa musu duwatsu masu daraja. Jikinsa ya yi kamar gogaggen hauren giwan da aka yi masa ado da duwatsun saffaya.
english: His hands are like rings of gold set with beryl. His body is like ivory work overlaid with sapphires.

hausa: Ko kyauro zai iya yi girma a wurin da ba ruwa? Ko za tă taɓa iya yin girma ba tare da ruwa ba?
english: “Can the papyrus grow up without mire? Can the rushes grow without water?

hausa: Na zo gab da hallaka gaba ɗaya a tsakiyar dukan taron.”
english: I have come to the brink of utter ruin, among the gathered assembly.”

hausa: (Matarsa mutuniyar Yahuda kuwa ta haifi Yared mahaifin Gedor, Heber mahaifin Soko, da kuma Yekutiyel mahaifin Zanowa.) Waɗannan su ne ’ya’yan Bitiya ’yar Fir’auna, wadda Mered ya aura.
english: His wife the Jewess bore Jered the father of Gedor, Heber the father of Soco, and Jekuthiel the father of Zanoah. These are the sons of Bithiah the daughter of Pharaoh, whom Mered took.

hausa: “Wannan zai mai da kai sarki ne in kana da al’ul a kai a kai? Mahaifinka bai kasance da abinci da abin sha ba? Ya yi abin da yake gaskiya da kuma daidai saboda haka kome ya kasance da lafiya da shi.
english: “Should you reign because you strive to excel in cedar? Didn’t your father eat and drink, and do justice and righteousness? Then it was well with him.

hausa: Sai ya kira biyu daga cikin jarumawansa, ya umarce su cewa, “Ku shirya sojoji ɗari biyu, da masu hawan dawakai saba’in da kuma masu māsu ɗari biyu su tafi Kaisariya da ƙarfe tara na daren nan.
english: He called to himself two of the centurions, and said, “Prepare two hundred soldiers to go as far as Caesarea, with seventy horsemen and two hundred men armed with spears, at the third hour of the night.”

hausa: In suka ce mana, ‘Ku tsaya nan har mu zo wurinku,’ za mu dakata inda muke, ba za mu haura wajensu ba.
english: If they say this to us, ‘Wait until we come to you!’ then we will stand still in our place and will not go up to them.

hausa: Ku gina hanyoyi zuwa cikinsu, ku kuma raba ƙasar da Ubangiji Allahnku yake ba ku gādo kashi uku, saboda duk wani da ya yi kisankai yă iya gudu zuwa can.
english: You shall prepare the way, and divide the borders of your land which Yahweh your God causes you to inherit into three parts, that every man slayer may flee there.

hausa: sai suka zauna da shi a ƙasa har kwana bakwai. Ba wanda ya ce masa kome, don sun ga tsananin wahalar da yake ciki.
english: So they sat down with him on the ground seven days and seven nights, and no one spoke a word to him, for they saw that his grief was very great.

hausa: Kamar dai yadda ka ga ƙarfen ya gauraye da yumɓu, haka mutanen za su zama a gauraye amma ba za su haɗu da juna ba, kamar yadda baƙin ƙarfe da yumɓu ba su haɗuwa.
english: Whereas you saw the iron mixed with miry clay, they will mingle themselves with the seed of men; but they won’t cling to one another, even as iron does not mix with clay.

hausa: Zan nuna muku kwatancin mutumin da yakan zo wurina, yă ji kalmomina, yă kuma aikata.
english: Everyone who comes to me, and hears my words and does them, I will show you who he is like.

hausa: Shugabannin suka kawo duwatsun Onis. Da duwatsu masu daraja don a jera a kan efod da ƙyallen maƙalawa a ƙirji.
english: The rulers brought the onyx stones and the stones to be set for the ephod and for the breastplate;

hausa: Labarin wannan kuwa ya bazu ko’ina a yankin.
english: The report of this went out into all that land.

hausa: Wahayin Obadiya. Ga abin da Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka ya ce a kan Edom. Mun ji saƙo daga wurin Ubangiji cewa, An aiki jakada zuwa ga al’ummai yă faɗa musu cewa, “Ku tashi, mu tafi mu yi yaƙi da ita.”
english: The vision of Obadiah. This is what the Lord Yahweh says about Edom. We have heard news from Yahweh, and an ambassador is sent among the nations, saying, “Arise, and let’s rise up against her in battle.

hausa: Amma sa’ad da na yi tuntuɓe, sukan taru suna murna; masu kai hari sun taru a kaina sa’ad da ban sani ba. Suna ɓata mini suna ba tsagaitawa.
english: But in my adversity, they rejoiced, and gathered themselves together. The attackers gathered themselves together against me, and I didn’t know it. They tore at me, and didn’t cease.

hausa: gama sun zub da jinin tsarkakanka da kuma annabawanka, ka kuwa ba su jini su sha, yadda ya dace da su.”
english: For they poured out the blood of saints and prophets, and you have given them blood to drink. They deserve this.”

hausa: Saboda haka fa, ’yan’uwa, sai ku tsaya daram ku riƙe koyarwar da muka miƙa muku, ko ta wurin maganar baki ko kuma ta wurin wasiƙa.
english: So then, brothers, stand firm and hold the traditions which you were taught by us, whether by word or by letter.

hausa: Amma waɗansunsu suka ce, “Anya, wanda ya buɗe wa makahon nan idanu, ba zai iya yin wani abu yă hana wannan mutum mutuwa ba?”
english: Some of them said, “Couldn’t this man, who opened the eyes of him who was blind, have also kept this man from dying?”

hausa: Ka daina shan ruwa kaɗai, yi amfani da ruwan inabi kaɗan saboda cikinka da kuma yawan rashin lafiyarka.
english: Be no longer a drinker of water only, but use a little wine for your stomach’s sake and your frequent infirmities.

hausa: “Sa’an nan firist ɗin zai miƙa hadaya don zunubi ya kuma yi kafara saboda wannan da za a tsabtacce daga rashin tsarkinsa. Bayan haka, firist zai yanka hadaya ta ƙonawa
english: “The priest shall offer the sin offering, and make atonement for him who is to be cleansed because of his uncleanness. Afterward he shall kill the burnt offering;

hausa: Sa’ad da suka yi kusa da gidan Mika, sai suka gane muryar saurayin nan Balawe; saboda haka suka shiga wurin suka tambaye shi, “Wa ya kawo ka nan? Me kake yi a nan? Me ya sa kake a nan?”
english: When they were by the house of Micah, they knew the voice of the young man the Levite; so they went over there and said to him, “Who brought you here? What do you do in this place? What do you have here?”

hausa: Kamar sanyin ƙanƙara a lokacin girbi haka ɗan saƙo mai aminci wanda aka aika; ya wartsakar da ran waɗanda suka aike shi.
english: As the cold of snow in the time of harvest, so is a faithful messenger to those who send him; for he refreshes the soul of his masters.

hausa: Za a shimfiɗa su a rana da wata da kuma dukan taurarin sammai, waɗanda suka ƙaunata suka kuma bauta wa, waɗanda suka bi suka nemi shawarar suka kuma yi wa sujada. Ba za a tattara su ko a binne su ba, amma za su zama kamar juji a jibge a ƙasa.
english: They will spread them before the sun, the moon, and all the army of the sky, which they have loved, which they have served, after which they have walked, which they have sought, and which they have worshiped. They will not be gathered or be buried. They will be like dung on the surface of the earth.

hausa: Mutane za su gudu zuwa kogwannin duwatsu da kuma ramummuka a ƙasa daga razanar Ubangiji da kuma darajar ɗaukakarsa, sa’ad da ya tashi don yă girgiza duniya.
english: Men shall go into the caves of the rocks, and into the holes of the earth, from before the terror of Yahweh, and from the glory of his majesty, when he arises to shake the earth mightily.

hausa: Ya auna ɗakin bakin ƙofa na can ƙarshen hanyar shiga ya sami kamu sittin. Awon ya kai har zuwa shirayin da yake fuskantar filin.
english: He also made posts, sixty cubits; and the court reached to the posts, around the gate.

hausa: Saboda haka ga abin da Ubangiji wanda ya fanshi Ibrahim, ya ce wa gidan Yaƙub, “Ba za a ƙara kunyata Yaƙub ba; fuskokinsu kuma ba za su ƙara yanƙwanewa ba.
english: Therefore Yahweh, who redeemed Abraham, says concerning the house of Jacob: “Jacob shall no longer be ashamed, neither shall his face grow pale.

hausa: Mahaifinsa Ishaku ya amsa masa ya ce, “Ga shi, ni’imar ƙasar za tă nisanci mazauninka. Raɓar samaniya can ƙwanƙoli za tă nisance ka.
english: Isaac his father answered him, “Behold, your dwelling will be of the fatness of the earth, and of the dew of the sky from above.

hausa: Saboda haka ina ba wa gwauraye masu ƙuruciya shawara su yi aure, su sami ’ya’ya, su lura da gidajensu kada kuwa su ba abokin gāba zarafin ɓata suna.
english: I desire therefore that the younger widows marry, bear children, rule the household, and give no occasion to the adversary for insulting.

hausa: Amma in a bayan gari ne mutumin ya sadu da yarinyar da aka yi alkawari aure, ya kuma yi mata fyaɗe, mutumin da ya yi wannan ne kaɗai zai mutu.
english: But if the man finds the lady who is pledged to be married in the field, and the man forces her and lies with her, then only the man who lay with her shall die;

hausa: Giddel, Gahar, Reyahiya,
english: the children of Giddel, the children of Gahar, the children of Reaiah,

hausa: Da Musa ya gama magana da su, sai ya lulluɓe fuskarsa.
english: When Moses was done speaking with them, he put a veil on his face.

hausa: Nan da nan, suka bar abin kamun kifinsu, suka bi shi.
english: Immediately they left their nets, and followed him.

hausa: An bayyana masa ta wurin Ruhu Mai Tsarki cewa ba zai mutu ba sai ya ga Kiristi na Ubangiji.
english: It had been revealed to him by the Holy Spirit that he should not see death before he had seen the Lord’s Christ.

hausa: Da suka tattara ’yan’uwansu suka kuma tsarkake kansu, sai suka shiga ciki suka tsarkake haikalin Ubangiji, kamar yadda sarki ya umarta, suna bin maganar Ubangiji.
english: They gathered their brothers, sanctified themselves, and went in, according to the commandment of the king by Yahweh’s words, to cleanse Yahweh’s house.

hausa: Ku kasa kunne, ku masu taurinkai, ku da kuke nesa da adalci.
english: Listen to me, you stubborn-hearted, who are far from righteousness!

hausa: Na tambayi mala’ikan da ya yi magana da ni na ce, “Mene ne waɗannan, ranka yă daɗe?”
english: I answered and spoke to the angel who talked with me, saying, “What are these, my lord?”

hausa: Dukan mutane za su ƙi ku saboda ni, amma wanda ya jure har ƙarshe zai sami ceto.
english: You will be hated by all men for my name’s sake, but he who endures to the end will be saved.

hausa: Sai dai ba su da ’ya’ya, domin Elizabet bakararriya ce; kuma dukansu biyu sun tsufa.
english: But they had no child, because Elizabeth was barren, and they both were well advanced in years.

hausa: Allah shi ma ya shaida ta wurin alamu, abubuwan banmamaki da mu’ujizai iri-iri, da kuma baye-bayen Ruhu Mai Tsarki da aka rarraba bisa ga nufinsa.
english: God also testifying with them, both by signs and wonders, by various works of power, and by gifts of the Holy Spirit, according to his own will?

hausa: Kada ka yarda da su, domin fiye da mutum arba’in daga cikinsu suna fakonsa. Sun yi rantsuwa ba za su ci ko sha ba sai sun kashe shi. Suna nan a shirye yanzu, suna jira ka amince da roƙonsu.”
english: Therefore don’t yield to them, for more than forty men lie in wait for him, who have bound themselves under a curse to neither eat nor drink until they have killed him. Now they are ready, looking for the promise from you.”

hausa: “Ko kuwa, yaya wani zai iya shiga gidan mai ƙarfi yă ƙwace masa kaya ba tare da ya fara daure mai ƙarfin nan tukuna ba? Sa’an nan zai iya washe gidansa.
english: Or how can one enter into the house of the strong man and plunder his goods, unless he first bind the strong man? Then he will plunder his house.

hausa: Amma dukan wannan bai biya mini bukata ba, muddin ina ganin wannan mutumin Yahudan nan Mordekai, yana zama a bakin ƙofar sarki.”
english: Yet all this avails me nothing, so long as I see Mordecai the Jew sitting at the king’s gate.”

hausa: Sa’ad da almajiransa suka ga wannan, sai suka yi fushi. Suka ce, “Wannan almubazzaranci fa!
english: But when his disciples saw this, they were indignant, saying, “Why this waste?

hausa: daga kabilar Zebulun mutum 12,000, daga kabilar Yusuf mutum 12,000, daga kabilar Benyamin mutum 12,000.
english: of the tribe of Zebulun twelve thousand, of the tribe of Joseph twelve thousand, and of the tribe of Benjamin twelve thousand were sealed.

hausa: Ish-Boshet bai ƙara yin karambanin ce wa Abner kome ba, gama yana tsoronsa.
english: He could not answer Abner another word, because he was afraid of him.

hausa: Dangina sun tafi; abokaina na kurkusa sun manta da ni.
english: My relatives have gone away. My familiar friends have forgotten me.

hausa: gama Allah ne yake aiki a cikinku, don ku nufa ku kuma aikata bisa ga nufinsa mai kyau.
english: For it is God who works in you both to will and to work for his good pleasure.

hausa: Sai Finehas ɗan Eleyazar, firist, da shugabannin suka koma Kan’ana daga saduwa da mutanen Ruben da mutanen Gad a Gileyad, suka kai wa Isra’ilawa rahoto.
english: Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest, and the princes, returned from the children of Reuben, and from the children of Gad, out of the land of Gilead, to the land of Canaan, to the children of Israel, and brought them word again.

hausa: In da na ga wani yana mutuwa don rashin sutura, ko wani mai bukata da ba shi da riga,
english: if I have seen any perish for want of clothing, or that the needy had no covering;

hausa: Cikin ɗan lokaci, za a mai da Lebanon gona mai taƙi kuma gona mai taƙi za tă zama kamar kurmi?
english: Isn’t it yet a very little while, and Lebanon will be turned into a fruitful field, and the fruitful field will be regarded as a forest?

hausa: Wataƙila sa’ad da mutanen Yahuda suka ji game da kowace masifar da na shirya in auka musu, kowa ya juya daga muguwar hanyarsa; sa’an nan in gafarta musu muguntarsu da kuma zunubinsu.”
english: It may be that the house of Judah will hear all the evil which I intend to do to them, that they may each return from his evil way; that I may forgive their iniquity and their sin.”

hausa: ta ukun farare dawakai, ta huɗu kuma dawakai masu ɗigo-ɗigo a dukan jikinsu, dukansu kuwa ƙarfafa.
english: In the third chariot were white horses. In the fourth chariot were dappled horses, all of them powerful.

hausa: za su kuma furta, “Hannuwanmu ba su zub da wannan jini ba, idanunmu kuma ba su ga an yi haka ba.
english: They shall answer and say, “Our hands have not shed this blood, neither have our eyes seen it.

hausa: Amma duk ya miƙa hadayar bijimi yana kama da wanda ya kashe mutum, kuma duk wanda ya miƙa ɗan rago, kamar wanda ya karye wuyan kare; duk wanda ya miƙa hadaya ta gari yana kama da wanda ya yi sadakar jinin alade, kuma duk wanda ya ƙone turaren tuni, kamar wanda yake bauta gunki ne. Sun zaɓi hanyoyinsu, rayukansu kuma suna jin daɗin abubuwan banƙyamarsu;
english: He who kills an ox is as he who kills a man; he who sacrifices a lamb, as he who breaks a dog’s neck; he who offers an offering, as he who offers pig’s blood; he who burns frankincense, as he who blesses an idol. Yes, they have chosen their own ways, and their soul delights in their abominations.

hausa: Ku bincika dukan tarihi mana, tun daga lokacin da Allah ya halicci mutane a cikin duniya har yă zuwa yanzu; ku tantambaya daga wannan kusurwa ta samaniya zuwa waccan, ko wani babban abu irin wannan ya taɓa faruwa, ko kuma an taɓa jin labarin irinsa?
english: For ask now of the days that are past, which were before you, since the day that God created man on the earth, and from the one end of the sky to the other, whether there has been anything as great as this thing is, or has been heard like it?

hausa: Ka ɗauko mini Lawiyawa a maimakon dukan ’ya’yan fari na Isra’ilawa, haka ma na dabbobi na Lawiyawa, a maimakon ’ya’yan fari na dabbobin Isra’ilawa. Ni ne Ubangiji.”
english: You shall take the Levites for me—I am Yahweh—instead of all the firstborn among the children of Israel; and the livestock of the Levites instead of all the firstborn among the livestock of the children of Israel.”

hausa: Ku faɗa cikin al’ummai, “Ubangiji yana mulki.” Duniya ta kahu daram, ba za a iya matsar da ita ba; zai yi wa mutane hukunci da gaskiya.
english: Say among the nations, “Yahweh reigns.” The world is also established. It can’t be moved. He will judge the peoples with equity.

hausa: Ta haka, ba sa ƙara zama biyu, sai dai ɗaya. Saboda haka abin da Allah ya haɗa fa, kada mutum yă raba.”
english: So that they are no more two, but one flesh. What therefore God has joined together, don’t let man tear apart.”

hausa: Da Asabbaci ya kewayo, sai ya fara koyarwa a cikin majami’a, mutane da yawa da suka saurare shi, suka yi mamaki. Suna tambaya, “Ina mutumin nan ya sami waɗannan abubuwa? Wace hikima ce wannan da aka ba shi, har da yana yin ayyukan banmamaki haka!
english: When the Sabbath had come, he began to teach in the synagogue, and many hearing him were astonished, saying, “Where did this man get these things?” and, “What is the wisdom that is given to this man, that such mighty works come about by his hands?

hausa: Mutanen Isra’ila haɗe da Lawiyawa, za su kawo sadakokinsu na hatsi, sabon ruwan inabi da mai a ɗakunan ajiya inda ake ajiyar kayayyakin wuri mai tsarki da kuma inda firistoci, matsaran ƙofofi da kuma mawaƙa suke zama. “Ba za mu ƙyale gidan Allahnmu ba.”
english: For the children of Israel and the children of Levi shall bring the wave offering of the grain, of the new wine, and of the oil, to the rooms where the vessels of the sanctuary are, and the priests who minister, with the gatekeepers and the singers. We will not forsake the house of our God.

hausa: Amon yana da shekara ashirin da biyu sa’ad da ya zama sarki, ya yi mulki shekara biyu a Urushalima. Sunan mahaifiyarsa Meshullemet ’yar Haruz; ita mutuniyar Yotba ce.
english: Amon was twenty-two years old when he began to reign; and he reigned two years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Meshullemeth the daughter of Haruz of Jotbah.

hausa: Ƙara mai bantsoro za tă cika kunnuwansa ’yan fashi za su kai masa hari.
english: A sound of terrors is in his ears. In prosperity the destroyer will come on him.

hausa: Fiye da mutane arba’in ne suka ƙulla wannan makirci.
english: There were more than forty people who had made this conspiracy.

hausa: Game da ayyukan mulkin Sarki Dawuda, daga farko har ƙarshe, an rubuta su a cikin tarihin Sama’ila mai duba, tarihin annabi Natan da kuma tarihin Gad mai duba,
english: Now the acts of David the king, first and last, behold, they are written in the history of Samuel the seer, and in the history of Nathan the prophet, and in the history of Gad the seer,

hausa: Budurwa za tă manta da kayan adonta amarya ta manta da kayan adon aurenta? Duk da haka mutanena sun manta da ni, kwanaki ba iyaka.
english: “Can a virgin forget her ornaments, or a bride her attire? Yet my people have forgotten me for days without number.

hausa: A wata na biyar na wannan shekara, shekara ta huɗu, a farkon sarautar Zedekiya sarkin Yahuda, sai annabi Hananiya ɗan Azzur, wanda ya fito daga Gibeyon, ya zo wurina a gidan Ubangiji a gaban firistoci da kuma dukan mutane,
english: That same year, in the beginning of the reign of Zedekiah king of Judah, in the fourth year, in the fifth month, Hananiah the son of Azzur, the prophet, who was of Gibeon, spoke to me in Yahweh’s house, in the presence of the priests and of all the people, saying,

hausa: Bari idanunsa su ga yadda zai hallaka; bari yă sha daga fushin Maɗaukaki.
english: Let his own eyes see his destruction. Let him drink of the wrath of the Almighty.

hausa: sai Ishmayel ɗan Netaniya da mutum goma waɗanda suke tare da shi suka kashe Gedaliya ɗan Ahikam, ɗan Shafan, da takobi, suka kashe wannan da sarkin Babilon ya naɗa a matsayin gwamna a kan ƙasar.
english: Then Ishmael the son of Nethaniah arose, and the ten men who were with him, and struck Gedaliah the son of Ahikam the son of Shaphan with the sword and killed him, whom the king of Babylon had made governor over the land.

hausa: Ka ceci raina daga takobi, raina mai daraja daga ikon karnuka.
english: Deliver my soul from the sword, my precious life from the power of the dog.

hausa: Sai abin da aka faɗa ta bakin annabi Irmiya ya cika cewa, “Suka ɗauki azurfa talatin, kuɗin da mutanen Isra’ila suka sa a kansa,
english: Then that which was spoken through Jeremiah the prophet was fulfilled, saying, “They took the thirty pieces of silver, the price of him upon whom a price had been set, whom some of the children of Israel priced,

hausa: “Maƙogwaronsu kamar buɗaɗɗun kaburbura ne, harsunansu suna yin ƙarya.” “Dafin mugun maciji yana a leɓunansu.”
english: “Their throat is an open tomb. With their tongues they have used deceit.” “The poison of vipers is under their lips.”

hausa: Game da Benyamin ya ce, “Bari ƙaunataccen Ubangiji yă zauna lafiya kusa da shi, gama yana tsare shi dukan yini, wanda kuma Ubangiji yake ƙauna yana zama a tsakanin kafaɗunsa.”
english: About Benjamin he said, “The beloved of Yahweh will dwell in safety by him. He covers him all day long. He dwells between his shoulders.”

hausa: Yayinda Yesu da almajiransa suna cikin tafiya, sai ya kai wani ƙauye inda wata mace mai suna Marta ta marabce shi a gidanta.
english: As they went on their way, he entered into a certain village, and a certain woman named Martha received him into her house.

hausa: Da yanzu ina kwance cikin salama; da ina barcina cikin salama
english: For now I should have lain down and been quiet. I should have slept, then I would have been at rest,

hausa: Ubangiji zai sa mutane su ji muryarsa mai daraja ya kuma sa su ga hannunsa na saukowa tare da fushi mai ƙuna da kuma wuta mai cinyewa, gizagizai za su ɓarke, za a yi hadarin tsawa da ƙanƙara.
english: Yahweh will cause his glorious voice to be heard, and will show the descent of his arm, with the indignation of his anger and the flame of a devouring fire, with a blast, storm, and hailstones.

hausa: Sai mutanen suka tafi Betel, inda suka zauna a gaban Allah har yamma, suna tā da muryoyinsu suna kuka mai zafi.
english: The people came to Bethel and sat there until evening before God, and lifted up their voices, and wept severely.

hausa: To, kai ma ka kasa kunne ga baranyarka, zan ba ka abinci ka ci don ka sami ƙarfin tafiya.”
english: Now therefore, please listen also to the voice of your servant, and let me set a morsel of bread before you. Eat, that you may have strength when you go on your way.”

hausa: gama Demas, saboda ƙaunar wannan duniya, ya yashe ni ya tafi Tessalonika. Kirssens ya tafi Galatiya, Titus kuwa ya tafi Dalmatiya.
english: for Demas left me, having loved this present world, and went to Thessalonica; Crescens to Galatia; and Titus to Dalmatia.

hausa: Ga abin da Ubangiji Maɗaukaki ya ce, “Ina kishin Sihiyona ƙwarai; ina kuma cike da kishi dominta.”
english: Yahweh of Armies says: “I am jealous for Zion with great jealousy, and I am jealous for her with great wrath.”

hausa: Sa’ad da kuka tafi yaƙi da abokan gābanku, kuka ga dawakai da kekunan yaƙi da kuma mayaƙan da suka fi ku yawa, kada ku ji tsoronsu, domin Ubangiji Allahnku, wanda ya fitar da ku daga Masar zai kasance tare da ku.
english: When you go out to battle against your enemies, and see horses, chariots, and a people more numerous than you, you shall not be afraid of them; for Yahweh your God, who brought you up out of the land of Egypt, is with you.

hausa: Akwai takobi a kan annabawan ƙaryanta! Za su zama wawaye. Akwai takobi a kan jarumawanta! Za su cika da tsoro.
english: A sword is on the boasters, and they will become fools. A sword is on her mighty men, and they will be dismayed.

hausa: Zuciya marasa haƙuri za su sani su kuma fahimta, harshen masu ana’ana kuma zai sāke su yi magana sosai.
english: The heart of the rash will understand knowledge, and the tongue of the stammerers will be ready to speak plainly.

hausa: Amma sarkin Masar ya ce wa, “Musa da Haruna, don me kuke hana mutane yin aikinsu? Ku koma wurin aikinku!”
english: The king of Egypt said to them, “Why do you, Moses and Aaron, take the people from their work? Get back to your burdens!”

hausa: Da yardar Allah, za mu ci gaba ga ƙarin ganewa.
english: This will we do, if God permits.

hausa: Suka karkashe raguwar Amalekawan da suka tsere, suka kuma zauna a can har yă zuwa yau.
english: They struck the remnant of the Amalekites who escaped, and have lived there to this day.

hausa: Sai ya sāke tambayar su ya ce, “Wa kuke nema?” Suka ce, “Yesu Banazare.”
english: Again therefore he asked them, “Who are you looking for?” They said, “Jesus of Nazareth.”

hausa: A kan rana ta goma ga watan biyar a shekara ta goma sha tara ta sarautar Nebukadnezzar, Sarkin Babilon, sai Nebuzaradan shugaban matsara da kuma ɗan majalisar sarki, ya zo Urushalima.
english: Now in the fifth month, in the tenth day of the month, which was the nineteenth year of King Nebuchadnezzar, king of Babylon, Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard, who stood before the king of Babylon, came into Jerusalem.

hausa: In kuma kana yin alheri ga masu yi maka ne kaɗai, ina ribar wannan? Ko masu zunubi ma suna yin haka.
english: If you do good to those who do good to you, what credit is that to you? For even sinners do the same.

hausa: Daga zuriyar Harim, akwai Ma’asehiya, Iliya, Shemahiya, Yehiyel da Uzziya.
english: Of the sons of Harim: Maaseiah, Elijah, Shemaiah, Jehiel, and Uzziah.

hausa: Ku tā da idanunku ku ga waɗanda suke zuwa daga arewa. Ina garken da aka ba ku tumakin da kuke taƙama a kai?
english: Lift up your eyes, and see those who come from the north. Where is the flock that was given to you, your beautiful flock?

hausa: don kuma ku gaya wa ’ya’yanku da jikokinku yadda na tsananta wa Masarawa, da kuma yadda na aikata mu’ujizai a cikinsu, don ku sani ni ne Ubangiji.”
english: and that you may tell in the hearing of your son, and of your son’s son, what things I have done to Egypt, and my signs which I have done among them; that you may know that I am Yahweh.”

hausa: Don mai bi da kaɗe-kaɗe. Bisa ga gittit. Ta Asaf. Ku rera don farin ciki ga Allah ƙarfinmu; ku yi sowa ga Allah na Yaƙub!
english: For the Chief Musician. On an instrument of Gath. By Asaph. Sing aloud to God, our strength! Make a joyful shout to the God of Jacob!

hausa: Ruwan ya tsabtacce har yă zuwa yau, bisa ga faɗin Elisha.
english: So the waters were healed to this day, according to Elisha’s word which he spoke.

hausa: In ya miƙa ɗan rago ne, zai kawo shi a gaban Ubangiji.
english: If he offers a lamb for his offering, then he shall offer it before Yahweh;

hausa: “In cutar ta fashe ko’ina a fatar jiki, har iyakar ganin firist, ta rufe dukan fatar jikin mai fama da cutar, daga kai har zuwa ƙafa,
english: “If the leprosy breaks out all over the skin, and the leprosy covers all the skin of the infected person from his head even to his feet, as far as it appears to the priest,

hausa: Hadayun Allah su ne karyayyen ruhu; karyayyiya da kuma zuciya mai tuba, Ya Allah, ba za ka ƙi ba.
english: The sacrifices of God are a broken spirit. O God, you will not despise a broken and contrite heart.

hausa: Amma game da Isra’ila ya ce, “Dukan yini na miƙa hannuwana ga mutane marasa biyayya da masu taurinkai.”
english: But about Israel he says, “All day long I stretched out my hands to a disobedient and contrary people.”

hausa: Ai, ni ne wanda ya yi duniya na kuma halicci mutum a kanta. Hannuwana ne sun miƙe sammai; na umarci rundunar sararin sama.
english: I have made the earth, and created man on it. I, even my hands, have stretched out the heavens. I have commanded all their army.

hausa: Ko kuwa in mutum bai yi tunani ba, ya yi rantsuwar yin wani abu, ko mai kyau ko marar kyau; ko da yake bai sani ba, duk da haka sa’ad da ya gane zai zama mai laifi.
english: “‘Or if anyone swears rashly with his lips to do evil or to do good—whatever it is that a man might utter rashly with an oath, and it is hidden from him—when he knows of it, then he will be guilty of one of these.

hausa: “ ‘Ka shirya; ka kintsa, kai da dukan jama’arka da suka taru kewaye da kai, ka kuma zama mai ba su umarni.
english: “‘“Be prepared, yes, prepare yourself, you, and all your companies who are assembled to you, and be a guard to them.

hausa: Finehas ɗan Eleyazar, ɗan Haruna, kuwa yana hidima a gabansa.) Suka ce, “Mu sāke haura mu yi yaƙi da mutanen Benyamin ’yan’uwanmu, ko a’a?” Ubangiji ya ce, “Ku je, gama gobe zan ba da su a hannuwanku.”
english: and Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron, stood before it in those days), saying, “Shall I yet again go out to battle against the children of Benjamin my brother, or shall I cease?” Yahweh said, “Go up; for tomorrow I will deliver him into your hand.”

hausa: Na zama mai hidimar ikkilisiya bisa ga aikin nan da Allah ya ba ni amana saboda ku, domin in sanar da maganar Allah sosai.
english: of which I was made a servant according to the stewardship of God which was given me toward you to fulfill the word of God,

hausa: “Tun daga kwanakin Gibeya, kun yi zunubi, ya Isra’ila, a can kuwa kuka ci gaba. Yaƙi bai cimma masu aikata mugunta a Gibeya ba?
english: “Israel, you have sinned from the days of Gibeah. There they remained. The battle against the children of iniquity doesn’t overtake them in Gibeah.

hausa: Don me zan ɗauki burodina da ruwana, da kuma naman da na yanka saboda masu yin wa tumakina aski in ba mutanen da ban ma san inda suka fito ba?”
english: Shall I then take my bread, my water, and my meat that I have killed for my shearers, and give it to men who I don’t know where they come from?”

hausa: Sa’an nan suka ce wa Baruk, “Faɗa mana yadda ka yi ka rubuta dukan wannan. Irmiya ne ya yi maka shibtar ta?”
english: They asked Baruch, saying, “Tell us now, how did you write all these words at his mouth?”

hausa: Me za mu ce ke nan? Dokar zunubi ce? Sam, ko kaɗan! Tabbatacce ai, da ban san mene ne zunubi ba in ba ta wurin doka ba. Gama da ban san mene ne ƙyashi yake ba tabbatacce in ba don doka ta ce, “Kada ka yi ƙyashi ba.”
english: What shall we say then? Is the law sin? May it never be! However, I wouldn’t have known sin except through the law. For I wouldn’t have known coveting unless the law had said, “You shall not covet.”

hausa: Ka lura fa, gama Ubangiji ya zaɓe ka don ka gina haikali a matsayin wuri mai tsarki. Ka yi ƙarfin hali ka kuma yi aiki.”
english: Take heed now, for Yahweh has chosen you to build a house for the sanctuary. Be strong, and do it.”

hausa: Sa’ad da Yusuf ya ga mahaifinsa yana sa hannun damansa a kan Efraim bai ji daɗi ba; saboda haka ya ɗauke hannun mahaifinsa ya cire shi daga kan Efraim zuwa kan Manasse.
english: When Joseph saw that his father laid his right hand on the head of Ephraim, it displeased him. He held up his father’s hand, to remove it from Ephraim’s head to Manasseh’s head.

hausa: Mutum mai haɗama kan kawo wahala ga iyalinsa, amma wanda yake ƙin cin hanci zai rayu.
english: He who is greedy for gain troubles his own house, but he who hates bribes will live.

hausa: A kwana a tashi har irin yă tsiro, yă yi girma, bai kuwa santa yadda aka yi ba.
english: and should sleep and rise night and day, and the seed should spring up and grow, though he doesn’t know how.

hausa: Gama Ubangiji Allah Maɗaukaki ya ce, “Zan sa wata ƙasa ta tayar muku, ya ku gidan Isra’ila, wadda za tă matsa muku tun daga Lebo Hamat zuwa kwarin Araba.”
english: For, behold, I will raise up against you a nation, house of Israel,” says Yahweh, the God of Armies; “and they will afflict you from the entrance of Hamath to the brook of the Arabah.”

hausa: Tarihin da aka rubuta game da asalin Yesu Kiristi ɗan Dawuda, ɗan Ibrahim.
english: The book of the genealogy of Jesus Christ, the son of David, the son of Abraham.

hausa: Da a ce kun saurari tsawatata, da na faɗa muku dukan abin da yake zuciyata in kuma sanar da ku tunanina.
english: Turn at my reproof. Behold, I will pour out my spirit on you. I will make known my words to you.

hausa: Amma fa, in an bukace shi yă biya, zai biya don yă fanshi ransa ta wurin biyan abin da aka aza masa.
english: If a ransom is imposed on him, then he shall give for the redemption of his life whatever is imposed.

hausa: Yesse shi ne mahaifin. Eliyab ɗan farinsa, ɗansa na biyu shi ne Abinadab, na ukun Shimeya,
english: and Jesse became the father of his firstborn Eliab, Abinadab the second, Shimea the third,

hausa: Sauran almajiran kuwa suka bi shi cikin jirgin ruwan, janye da abin kamun kifin cike da kifi, don ba su da nisa daga gaci, wajen yadi ɗari ne.
english: But the other disciples came in the little boat (for they were not far from the land, but about two hundred cubits away), dragging the net full of fish.

hausa: A daidai wannan lokaci sai ga wata mace wadda ta yi shekaru goma sha biyu tana zub da jini ta raɓo ta bayansa ta taɓa gefen rigarsa.
english: Behold, a woman who had a discharge of blood for twelve years came behind him, and touched the fringe of his garment;

hausa: Ga abin da Ubangiji yana cewa, “In a iya auna sammai a kuma bincike tushen duniya a ƙarƙas to, sai in ƙi dukan zuriyar Isra’ila ke nan saboda dukan abin da suka yi,” in ji Ubangiji.
english: Yahweh says: “If heaven above can be measured, and the foundations of the earth searched out beneath, then I will also cast off all the offspring of Israel for all that they have done,” says Yahweh.

hausa: Ubangiji shi ne ƙarfin mutanensa, kagarar ceto domin shafaffensa.
english: Yahweh is their strength. He is a stronghold of salvation to his anointed.

hausa: Zan ba da kai ga waɗanda suke neman ranka, waɗanda kake tsoro, ga Nebukadnezzar sarkin Babilon da kuma ga Babiloniyawa.
english: I would give you into the hand of those who seek your life, and into the hand of them of whom you are afraid, even into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and into the hand of the Chaldeans.

hausa: Babu mai ruɗun da zai zauna a gidana; babu mai ƙaryan da zai tsaya a gabana.
english: He who practices deceit won’t dwell within my house. He who speaks falsehood won’t be established before my eyes.

hausa: “ ‘Ba za ka aske gefe-gefe na gashin kanka ba, ko ku aske gemunku.
english: “‘You shall not cut the hair on the sides of your head or clip off the edge of your beard.

hausa: Ba haka ba ne batun. Wani mai suna Sheba ɗan Bikri ne, daga ƙasar tudun Efraim, ya tayar wa sarki, yana gāba da Dawuda. Ki ba mu wannan mutum, zan kuwa janye daga birnin.” Matar ta ce wa Yowab, “Za a jefa maka kansa daga katanga.”
english: The matter is not so. But a man of the hill country of Ephraim, Sheba the son of Bichri by name, has lifted up his hand against the king, even against David. Just deliver him, and I will depart from the city.” The woman said to Joab, “Behold, his head will be thrown to you over the wall.”

hausa: don in furta yabanka cikin ƙofofin ’Yar Sihiyona a can kuwa in yi farin ciki cikin cetonka.
english: that I may show all of your praise. I will rejoice in your salvation in the gates of the daughter of Zion.

hausa: Zan rera ga Ubangiji gama ya yi mini alheri.
english: I will sing to Yahweh, because he has been good to me.

hausa: Sa’an nan ya huta tare da kakanninsa, aka kuma binne shi cikin birnin Dawuda mahaifinsa. Rehobowam ɗansa kuwa ya gāje shi a matsayin sarki.
english: Solomon slept with his fathers, and he was buried in his father David’s city; and Rehoboam his son reigned in his place.

hausa: Masu yi wa sarki hidima, suka amsa, “Haman yana tsaye a haraba.” Sarki ya umarta, “A kawo shi ciki.”
english: The king’s servants said to him, “Behold, Haman stands in the court.” The king said, “Let him come in.”

hausa: Bakina yana magana abin da yake gaskiya, gama leɓunana sun ƙi mugunta.
english: For my mouth speaks truth. Wickedness is an abomination to my lips.

hausa: Sun kewaye ta kamar masu gadin fili, domin ta yi mini tawaye,’ ” in ji Ubangiji.
english: As keepers of a field, they are against her all around, because she has been rebellious against me,’” says Yahweh.

hausa: Ba irin zinariyar da za tă iya sayenta, ko kuma a iya auna nauyinta da azurfa.
english: It can’t be gotten for gold, neither will silver be weighed for its price.

hausa: na Yeriko 345
english: The children of Jericho: three hundred forty-five.

hausa: Ƙuri’a don Ƙofar Kudu ta fāɗo a kan Obed-Edom, ƙuri’a don ɗakin ajiya kuwa ta fāɗo a kan ’ya’yansa maza.
english: To Obed-Edom southward; and to his sons the storehouse.
