hausa: dole taro su yi hukunci tsakanin mai laifin, da mai bin hakkin jini bisa waɗannan ƙa’idodi.
english: then the congregation shall judge between the striker and the avenger of blood according to these ordinances.

hausa: Sai suka tambaye shi suka ce, “To, wane ne kai? Kai ne Iliya?” Ya ce, “A’a, ni ba shi ba ne.” “Kai ne Annabin nan?” Ya amsa ya ce, “A’a.”
english: They asked him, “What then? Are you Elijah?” He said, “I am not.” “Are you the prophet?” He answered, “No.”

hausa: Iskar gabas za tă tafi da shi; shi ke nan ya ƙare; za tă share shi daga wurinsa.
english: The east wind carries him away, and he departs. It sweeps him out of his place.

hausa: “Amma ku zo dukanku, ku sāke gwadawa! Ba zan sami mutum ɗaya mai hikima ba a cikinku.
english: But as for you all, come back. I will not find a wise man among you.

hausa: Sai almajiransa suka tambaye shi suka ce, “Rabbi, wane ne ya yi zunubi, mutumin ne, ko iyayensa, da ya sa aka haife shi makaho?”
english: His disciples asked him, “Rabbi, who sinned, this man or his parents, that he was born blind?”

hausa: Duk inda ya shiga, cikin ƙauyuka, birane ko karkara, sai su kwantar da marasa lafiya a bakin kasuwa. Suka roƙe shi yă bari su taɓa gefen rigarsa kawai, kuma duk waɗanda suka taɓa shi kuwa, suka warke.
english: Wherever he entered—into villages, or into cities, or into the country—they laid the sick in the marketplaces and begged him that they might just touch the fringe of his garment; and as many as touched him were made well.

hausa: Suka kuma tambaye su “Ina sunayen waɗanda suke wannan gini?”
english: They also asked for the names of the men who were making this building.

hausa: Da ya ji cewa, Yesu yana ƙarƙashin mulkin Hiridus ne, sai ya aika da shi zuwa wurin Hiridus, don a lokacin Hiridus yana Urushalima.
english: When he found out that he was in Herod’s jurisdiction, he sent him to Herod, who was also in Jerusalem during those days.

hausa: suka haura da akwatin alkawarin da kuma Tentin Sujada da dukan kayayyaki masu tsarkin da yake cikinta. Firistoci, waɗanda suke Lawiyawa, suka ɗauke su;
english: They brought up the ark, the Tent of Meeting, and all the holy vessels that were in the Tent. The Levitical priests brought these up.

hausa: Ga abin da Ubangiji ya ce mini, “Ka yi karkiyar itace da maɗaurai ka ɗaura a wuyanka.
english: Yahweh says to me: “Make bonds and bars, and put them on your neck.

hausa: Allah na salama zai tattake Shaiɗan ba da daɗewa ba yă kuma sa shi a ƙarƙashin sawunku. Alherin Ubangijinmu Yesu kuma yă kasance tare da ku.
english: And the God of peace will quickly crush Satan under your feet. The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you.

hausa: Ta wurin bangaskiya ne ba a kashe Rahab karuwan nan, ta tare da marasa biyayya ba don ta marabci ’yan leƙan asiri.
english: By faith Rahab the prostitute didn’t perish with those who were disobedient, having received the spies in peace.

hausa: In na ce wa mugu, ‘Lalle za ka mutu,’ ba ka kuwa yi masa kashedi ko ka tsawata masa a kan mugayen hanyoyinsa don yă ceci ransa ba, wannan mugun zai mutu saboda zunubinsa, zan kuwa nemi hakkin jininsa a hannunka.
english: When I tell the wicked, ‘You will surely die;’ and you give him no warning, nor speak to warn the wicked from his wicked way, to save his life, that wicked man will die in his iniquity; but I will require his blood at your hand.

hausa: Sa’an nan ya kawo ni filin da yake waje ya kuma bi da ni kewaye da kusurwoyi huɗunsa, na kuma ga kowace kusurwa na wani fili.
english: Then he brought me out into the outer court and caused me to pass by the four corners of the court; and behold, in every corner of the court there was a court.

hausa: Yankin Efraim ke nan bisa ga iyalansu. Iyakar ƙasarsu ta gādo ta kama daga Atarot Addar a gabas zuwa Bet-Horon,
english: This was the border of the children of Ephraim according to their families. The border of their inheritance eastward was Ataroth Addar, to Beth Horon the upper.

hausa: Wane ne ya fahimci zuciyarUbangiji, ko kuwa ya koya masa a matsayin mashawarcinsa?
english: Who has directed Yahweh’s Spirit, or has taught him as his counselor?

hausa: Wannan shi ne abin da ya yi mana alkawari, wato, rai madawwami.
english: This is the promise which he promised us, the eternal life.

hausa: Aka dawo da shi a kan doki, aka binne shi tare da kakanninsa a Birnin Yahuda.
english: They brought him on horses and buried him with his fathers in the City of Judah.

hausa: “In mutum ya bar rami a buɗe, ko ya haƙa rami bai kuma rufe ba, sai saniya ko jaki ya fāɗi a ciki,
english: “If a man opens a pit, or if a man digs a pit and doesn’t cover it, and a bull or a donkey falls into it,

hausa: Ina amfani, in mutum ya ribato duniya duka, amma ya rasa ransa, ko kuma ya yi hasarar ransa.
english: For what does it profit a man if he gains the whole world, and loses or forfeits his own self?

hausa: Sai kika ƙara fasikancinki da ya haɗa da ƙasar cinikin Babilon, amma duk da haka ba ki ƙoshi ba.
english: You have moreover multiplied your prostitution to the land of merchants, to Chaldea; and yet you weren’t satisfied with this.

hausa: Ahimelek ya roƙi Ubangiji saboda shi, ya kuma ba shi guzuri da takobin Goliyat Bafilistin.”
english: He inquired of Yahweh for him, gave him food, and gave him the sword of Goliath the Philistine.”

hausa: Fushin Ubangiji ya sāke ƙuna a kan Isra’ila, sai ya zuga Dawuda, yana cewa, “Je ka ƙidaya Isra’ila da Yahuda.”
english: Again Yahweh’s anger burned against Israel, and he moved David against them, saying, “Go, count Israel and Judah.”

hausa: Sai Ubangiji ya ce masa, “Ka koma ta hanyar da ka zo, ka tafi Hamadan Damaskus. Sa’ad da ka kai can, ka shafe Hazayel yă zama sarki bisa Aram.
english: Yahweh said to him, “Go, return on your way to the wilderness of Damascus. When you arrive, anoint Hazael to be king over Syria.

hausa: ba cikin muguwar sha’awa kamar ta marasa bangaskiya, waɗanda ba su san Allah ba;
english: not in the passion of lust, even as the Gentiles who don’t know God,

hausa: A lokacin nan, bari waɗanda suke Yahudiya, su gudu zuwa cikin duwatsu. Bari waɗanda suke cikin birnin kuma su fita, bari kuma waɗanda suke ƙauye kada su shiga birnin.
english: Then let those who are in Judea flee to the mountains. Let those who are in the middle of her depart. Let those who are in the country not enter therein.

hausa: Amma in ba ku yi alkawari ba, ba kuwa zai zama muku zunubi ba.
english: But if you refrain from making a vow, it shall be no sin in you.

hausa: Kabilar Gad za su zama na biye. Shugaban mutanensa shi ne Eliyasaf ɗan Reyuwel.
english: “The tribe of Gad: the prince of the children of Gad shall be Eliasaph the son of Reuel.

hausa: Mun ji cewa waɗansunku suna zaman banza. Ba sa aikin kome; sai shisshigi kurum.
english: For we hear of some who walk among you in rebellion, who don’t work at all, but are busybodies.

hausa: Berekiya da Elkana, ne za su zama masu lura da ƙofofi domin akwatin alkawarin.
english: Berechiah and Elkanah were doorkeepers for the ark.

hausa: bari hanyarsu tă yi duhu ta kuma yi santsi, mala’ikan Ubangiji kuma yana fafararsu.
english: Let their way be dark and slippery, Yahweh’s angel pursuing them.

hausa: A shekaru bakwai na yalwa, ƙasar ta ba da amfani mai yawa.
english: In the seven plenteous years the earth produced abundantly.

hausa: Zuciyata tana makoki saboda Mowab kamar garaya, na yi baƙin ciki saboda Kir Hareset.
english: Therefore my heart sounds like a harp for Moab, and my inward parts for Kir Heres.

hausa: Ba da ɓata lokaci ba, ya kira su, sai suka bar mahaifinsu Zebedi a cikin jirgin ruwan, tare da ’yan haya, suka kuwa bi shi.
english: Immediately he called them, and they left their father, Zebedee, in the boat with the hired servants, and went after him.

hausa: Nebukadnezzar sarkin Babilon ya kuma kwaso kayayyaki daga haikalin Ubangiji ya sa su a haikalinsa a can.
english: Nebuchadnezzar also carried some of the vessels of Yahweh’s house to Babylon, and put them in his temple at Babylon.

hausa: To, Eli kuwa ya tsufa ƙwarai, yana kuma jin labari duk abin da ’ya’yansa suke yi wa dukan Isra’ila, da yadda suke lalata da matan da suke hidima a bakin ƙofar Tentin Sujada.
english: Now Eli was very old; and he heard all that his sons did to all Israel, and how that they slept with the women who served at the door of the Tent of Meeting.

hausa: Zan yi umarni, in ji Ubangiji, zan kuma komo da su wannan birni. Za su kuwa yi yaƙi da ita, su ƙwace ta su kuma ƙone ta. Zan kuma mai da garuruwan Yahuda kufai don kada wani ya zauna a can.”
english: Behold, I will command,” says Yahweh, “and cause them to return to this city. They will fight against it, take it, and burn it with fire. I will make the cities of Judah a desolation, without inhabitant.”

hausa: bayan ya kalli kansa, sa’ad da ya tashi daga wurin, nan da nan sai yă manta da kamanninsa.
english: for he sees himself, and goes away, and immediately forgets what kind of man he was.

hausa: Na yi farin ciki da isowar Istifanas, Fortunatus da Akaikus, domin sun biya bukatar da ba ku iya biya ba.
english: I rejoice at the coming of Stephanas, Fortunatus, and Achaicus; for that which was lacking on your part, they supplied.

hausa: Suka tambayi juna, “Ashe, shi ya sa zukatanmu suka kuna a cikinmu, sa’ad da yake magana da mu a hanya, yana bayyana mana Nassi.”
english: They said to one another, “Weren’t our hearts burning within us while he spoke to us along the way, and while he opened the Scriptures to us?”

hausa: (Hermon ne Sidoniyawa suke kira Siriyon, Amoriyawa kuwa suna kira shi Senir.)
english: (The Sidonians call Hermon Sirion, and the Amorites call it Senir.)

hausa: Da Ubangiji ya ji abin da kuka faɗa, sai ya husata, ya kuma yi rantsuwa ya ce,
english: Yahweh heard the voice of your words and was angry, and swore, saying,

hausa: “Wane ne yake sakin jakin dawa yă bar shi? Wane ne yake kunce igiyoyinsu?
english: “Who has set the wild donkey free? Or who has loosened the bonds of the swift donkey,

hausa: Za ku kuwa san cewa ni ne na aika muku da wannan gargaɗi domin alkawarina da Lawi yă ci gaba,” in ji Ubangiji Maɗaukaki.
english: You will know that I have sent this commandment to you, that my covenant may be with Levi,” says Yahweh of Armies.

hausa: Abin da Allah zai sa yă faru da mugu ke nan, gādon da Allah ya ba shi ke nan.”
english: This is the portion of a wicked man from God, the heritage appointed to him by God.”

hausa: Yanzu fa Yehoshafat ya wadace ƙwarai yana kuma da girma, ya kuma haɗa kansa da Ahab ta wurin aure.
english: Now Jehoshaphat had riches and honor in abundance; and he allied himself with Ahab.

hausa: Ga abin da Ubangiji yana cewa, “Kayayyakin Masar da hajar Kush, da waɗannan dogayen Sabenawa, za su ƙetaro zuwa wurinku za su kuma zama naku; za su bi bayanku, suna zuwa cikin sarƙoƙi. Za su rusuna a gabanku su roƙe ku, suna cewa, ‘Tabbas Allah yana tare da ku, babu kuma wani; babu wani allah.’ ”
english: Yahweh says: “The labor of Egypt, and the merchandise of Ethiopia, and the Sabeans, men of stature, will come over to you, and they will be yours. They will go after you. They shall come over in chains. They will bow down to you. They will make supplication to you: ‘Surely God is in you; and there is no one else. There is no other god.

hausa: Zai ɗibiya hannunsa a kan hadaya don zunubin yă kuma yanka ta a inda ake hadaya ta ƙonawa.
english: He shall lay his hand on the head of the sin offering, and kill the sin offering in the place of burnt offering.

hausa: Amma ku, kada ku zama haka. A maimakon haka, sai dai wanda ya fi girma a cikinku, ya zama kamar wanda ya fi ƙanƙanta, wanda kuma ke mulki, ya zama kamar mai hidima.
english: But not so with you. Rather, the one who is greater among you, let him become as the younger, and one who is governing, as one who serves.

hausa: Sai Bitrus ya miƙe tsaye tare da Sha Ɗayan nan, ya ɗaga muryarsa ya yi wa taron jawabi ya ce, “’Yan’uwana Yahudawa da dukanku da kuke zama cikin Urushalima, bari in bayyana muku wannan, ku saurara da kyau ga abin da zan faɗa.
english: But Peter, standing up with the eleven, lifted up his voice and spoke out to them, “You men of Judea and all you who dwell at Jerusalem, let this be known to you, and listen to my words.

hausa: Bayan zamanin Abimelek, sai Tola ɗan Fuwa ɗan Dodo daga Issakar ya tashi don yă ceci Isra’ila. Yana zama a Shamir a ƙasar tudu ta Efraim.
english: After Abimelech, Tola the son of Puah, the son of Dodo, a man of Issachar, arose to save Israel. He lived in Shamir in the hill country of Ephraim.

hausa: Amma Ahaz ya ce, “Ba zan nema ba; ba zan gwada Ubangiji ba.”
english: But Ahaz said, “I won’t ask. I won’t tempt Yahweh.”

hausa: Sai Sama’ila ya ɗauki ’yar kwalabar mai, ya zuba man ɗin wa Shawulu a kansa, ya yi masa sumba yana cewa, “Ubangiji ya keɓe ka shugaba bisa gādonsa.
english: Then Samuel took the vial of oil and poured it on his head, then kissed him and said, “Hasn’t Yahweh anointed you to be prince over his inheritance?

hausa: “Waɗanda suke da hikima za su wayar da kan mutane da yawa, duk da haka za a kashe su da takobi, waɗansu da wuta, a washe waɗansu a kai su bauta.
english: “Those who are wise among the people will instruct many; yet they will fall by the sword and by flame, by captivity and by plunder, many days.

hausa: Za su ga fuskarsa, sunansa kuma zai kasance a goshinsu.
english: They will see his face, and his name will be on their foreheads.

hausa: “Na ba ka duk man zaitun mafi kyau, da ruwan inabi mafi kyau duka, da hatsi mafi kyau duka na nunan farinsu da suke bayarwa ga Ubangiji.
english: “I have given to you all the best of the oil, all the best of the vintage, and of the grain, the first fruits of them which they give to Yahweh.

hausa: da sanduna ashirin da rammukan sandunan tagulla ashirin, da kuma ƙugiyoyin azurfa da maɗauri a kan sandunan.
english: their pillars were twenty, and their sockets twenty, of bronze; the hooks of the pillars and their fillets were of silver.

hausa: da Beriya da Shema, waɗanda suke kawunan iyalan waɗanda suke zama a Aiyalon waɗanda kuma suka kori mazaunan Gat.
english: and Beriah and Shema, who were heads of fathers’ households of the inhabitants of Aijalon, who put to flight the inhabitants of Gath;

hausa: Ya kamata mata su zauna shiru a cikin ikkilisiyoyi. Ba su da izinin yin magana, sai dai su yi biyayya yadda Doka ta faɗi.
english: Let the wives be quiet in the assemblies, for it has not been permitted for them to be talking except in submission, as the law also says,

hausa: Kada su auri gwauruwa ko macen da aka sāke; za su auri budurwai ne kaɗai na Isra’ilawa ko gwaurayen firistoci.
english: They shall not take for their wives a widow, or her who is put away; but they shall take virgins of the offspring of the house of Israel, or a widow who is the widow of a priest.

hausa: Wannan zunubin samarin ya yi muni ƙwarai a gaban Ubangiji, domin sun wulaƙanta hadayar Ubangiji, ƙwarai da gaske.
english: The sin of the young men was very great before Yahweh; for the men despised Yahweh’s offering.

hausa: Sai Allah ya ce, “Duk da haka dai, matarka Saratu za tă haifi maka ɗa; za ka kuma kira shi Ishaku. A kansa zan tabbatar da madawwamin alkawarina, da kuma ga zuriyarsa da za su zo bayansa.
english: God said, “No, but Sarah, your wife, will bear you a son. You shall call his name Isaac. I will establish my covenant with him for an everlasting covenant for his offspring after him.

hausa: Ka ji daɗin cetona, ya Ubangiji; Ya Ubangiji, ka zo da sauri ka taimake ni.
english: Be pleased, Yahweh, to deliver me. Hurry to help me, Yahweh.

hausa: Dajiyoyin da suke a bisa ginshiƙan a shirayi suna da fasalin furen bi-rana, tsayinsu kamu huɗu-huɗu ne.
english: The capitals that were on the top of the pillars in the porch were of lily work, four cubits.

hausa: Saboda haka ka yi annabci ka ce, ‘Ga abin da Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka yana cewa domin sun lalace ku suka kuma maishe ku kufai marar amfani a kowane gefe saboda ku zama mallakar sauran al’ummai da kuma abin magana da tsegumi ga mutane,
english: therefore prophesy, and say, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “Because, even because they have made you desolate, and swallowed you up on every side, that you might be a possession to the residue of the nations, and you are taken up in the lips of talkers, and the evil report of the people;”

hausa: Ya kuma rubuta wasiƙa kamar haka,
english: He wrote a letter like this:

hausa: Shemahiya ɗan Netanel, wani Balawe ne marubuci, ya rubuta sunayensu a gaban sarki da kuma a gaban manyan ma’aikata. Zadok firist, Ahimelek ɗan Abiyatar da kuma kawunan iyalan firistoci da na Lawiyawa, iyali guda daga Eleyazar, guda kuma daga Itamar.
english: Shemaiah the son of Nethanel the scribe, who was of the Levites, wrote them in the presence of the king, the princes, Zadok the priest, Ahimelech the son of Abiathar, and the heads of the fathers’ households of the priests and of the Levites; one fathers’ house being taken for Eleazar, and one taken for Ithamar.

hausa: Sai Ubangiji ya ce wa Gideyon, “Mutanen da kake da su sun yi mini yawa da zan ba da Midiyawa a hannunsu. Don kada Isra’ila tă yi mini fahariya cewa ƙarfinta ne ya cece su,
english: Yahweh said to Gideon, “The people who are with you are too many for me to give the Midianites into their hand, lest Israel brag against me, saying, ‘My own hand has saved me.’

hausa: Amma za a ɗauki gidaje a ƙauyuka marasa katanga kewaye da su daidai da gonaki. Za a iya fanshe su, a kuma mayar da su a Shekara ta Murna.
english: But the houses of the villages which have no wall around them shall be accounted for with the fields of the country: they may be redeemed, and they shall be released in the Jubilee.

hausa: Ba zan nuna wa ’ya’yanta ƙaunata ba, domin su ’ya’yan zina ne.
english: Indeed, on her children I will have no mercy, for they are children of unfaithfulness.

hausa: Ba a kuwa yi rashin biyayya ba game da abin da sarki ya umarta game da firistoci ko Lawiyawa a kan kayan haikalin ba.
english: They didn’t depart from the commandment of the king to the priests and Levites concerning any matter or concerning the treasures.

hausa: Shekara-shekara wannan mutum yakan haura daga garinsa zuwa Shilo domin yin sujada da miƙa hadayu ga Ubangiji Maɗaukaki. A can kuwa ’ya’yan Eli maza biyu, Hofni da Finehas su ne firistoci na Ubangiji.
english: This man went up out of his city from year to year to worship and to sacrifice to Yahweh of Armies in Shiloh. The two sons of Eli, Hophni and Phinehas, priests to Yahweh, were there.

hausa: “Amma Allah ya ce masa, ‘Kai wawa! A wannan dare za a nemi ranka. Bayan haka, wa zai gāji abin da ka tara wa kanka?’
english: “But God said to him, ‘You foolish one, tonight your soul is required of you. The things which you have prepared—whose will they be?’

hausa: Ya kwashi dukan mutanen Urushalima zuwa bauta, ya kwashi dukan fadawa, da mayaƙa, da masu sana’a, da maƙera, yawansu ya kai dubu goma. Ba wanda ya ragu, sai matalautan ƙasar.
english: He carried away all Jerusalem, and all the princes, and all the mighty men of valor, even ten thousand captives, and all the craftsmen and the smiths. No one remained except the poorest people of the land.

hausa: Batun ɗan’uwanmu Afollos kuwa, na roƙe shi sosai yă zo wurinku tare da ’yan’uwa. Bai so zuwa yanzu ba, amma zai zo in ya sami zarafi.
english: Now concerning Apollos the brother, I strongly urged him to come to you with the brothers, but it was not at all his desire to come now; but he will come when he has an opportunity.

hausa: Rikicin mugaye zai yi gāba da su, gama sun ƙi su yi abin da yake daidai.
english: The violence of the wicked will drive them away, because they refuse to do what is right.

hausa: Ta haka, ƙauna ta zama cikakkiya a cikinmu domin mu kasance masu ƙarfin hali a ranar shari’a, domin a wannan duniya muna kama da shi.
english: In this, love has been made perfect among us, that we may have boldness in the day of judgment, because as he is, even so we are in this world.

hausa: An yi ƙafafun kamar ƙafafun keken yaƙi ne; gindin, da’irar, gyaffan da kuma cibiyar duk an yi su da ƙarfe ne.
english: The work of the wheels was like the work of a chariot wheel. Their axles, their rims, their spokes, and their hubs were all of cast metal.

hausa: Da suka iso, sarki ya tambaye shi, “Mika, mu tafi mu yaƙi Ramot Gileyad, ko kada mu tafi?” Ya amsa, “Kai masa yaƙi za ka kuwa yi nasara, gama za a ba da su a hannunka.”
english: When he had come to the king, the king said to him, “Micaiah, shall we go to Ramoth Gilead to battle, or shall I forbear?” He said, “Go up, and prosper. They shall be delivered into your hand.”

hausa: Sai bawan ya faɗa wa Ishaku duk abin da ya yi.
english: The servant told Isaac all the things that he had done.

hausa: Dukanku ’ya’yan haske ne da kuma ’ya’yan rana. Mu ba mutanen dare ko na duhu ba ne.
english: You are all children of light and children of the day. We don’t belong to the night, nor to darkness,

hausa: Cibiyoyin mulkinsa na farko su ne Babilon, Erek, Akkad, da Kalne a cikin Shinar.
english: The beginning of his kingdom was Babel, Erech, Accad, and Calneh, in the land of Shinar.

hausa: Ba a jima ba sai mutanen Dawuda da Yowab suka dawo daga hari. Suka kawo ganima da yawa tare da su. Abner kuwa ya riga ya bar Dawuda a Hebron, domin Dawuda ya sallame shi, shi kuma ya tafi lafiya.
english: Behold, David’s servants and Joab came from a raid and brought in a great plunder with them; but Abner was not with David in Hebron, for he had sent him away, and he had gone in peace.

hausa: Takan tabbata akwai riba a kasuwancinta, kuma fitilarta ba ya mutuwa da dare.
english: She perceives that her merchandise is profitable. Her lamp doesn’t go out by night.

hausa: Yesu ya amsa ya ce, “A rubuce yake, ‘Ba da abinci kaɗai mutum zai rayu ba.’”
english: Jesus answered him, saying, “It is written, ‘Man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word of God.’”

hausa: “Amma in kai, ko ’ya’yanka maza, suka juye daga gare ni, ba ku kuma kiyaye umarnai da ƙa’idodin da na ba ku ba, kuka yi gaba, kuka bauta wa waɗansu alloli, kuka kuma yi musu sujada,
english: But if you turn away from following me, you or your children, and not keep my commandments and my statutes which I have set before you, but go and serve other gods and worship them,

hausa: Gama a rubuce yake cewa, “Zan rushe hikimar mai hikima, basirar mai azanci kuma zan rikita shi.”
english: For it is written, “I will destroy the wisdom of the wise. I will bring the discernment of the discerning to nothing.”

hausa: ‘Ga abin da Ubangiji Maɗaukaki, Allah na Isra’ila, yana cewa ka ɗauki waɗannan takardun ciniki, wanda aka liƙe da wanda ba a liƙe ba, ka sa su a cikin tulun yumɓu don kada su lalace.
english: Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel, says: ‘Take these deeds, this deed of the purchase which is sealed, and this deed which is open, and put them in an earthen vessel, that they may last many days.’

hausa: Ruben zai sami rabo; zai yi iyaka da Efraim daga gabas zuwa yamma.
english: “By the border of Ephraim, from the east side even to the west side, Reuben, one portion.

hausa: Amma Allah ya tashe shi daga matattu, ya ’yantar da shi daga azabar mutuwa, don ba ya yiwuwa mutuwa ta riƙe shi.
english: whom God raised up, having freed him from the agony of death, because it was not possible that he should be held by it.

hausa: Amma yana kuɓutar da masu wahala; yana magana da su cikin wahalarsu.
english: He delivers the afflicted by their affliction, and opens their ear in oppression.

hausa: Da Ahitofel ya ga ba a bi shawararsa ba, sai ya hau jakinsa ya koma gidansa a garinsu. Ya kintsa gidansa sa’an nan ya rataye kansa. Ta haka ya mutu, aka kuma binne shi a kabarin mahaifinsa.
english: When Ahithophel saw that his counsel was not followed, he saddled his donkey, arose, and went home to his city, set his house in order, and hanged himself; and he died, and was buried in the tomb of his father.

hausa: Idan mutum yana riƙe da naman da aka keɓe a rigarsa, sa’an nan kuma wannan rigar ta taɓa burodi, ko dafaffen abinci, ko ruwan inabi, ko mai, ko kowane irin abinci, wannan zai sa abin yă zama tsarkake?’ ” Firistoci suka amsa, suka ce, “A’a.”
english: ‘If someone carries holy meat in the fold of his garment, and with his fold touches bread, stew, wine, oil, or any food, will it become holy?’” The priests answered, “No.”

hausa: “Kada ka zalunci baƙo, ku kanku kun san halin baƙunci, gama dā ku baƙi ne a Masar.
english: “You shall not oppress an alien, for you know the heart of an alien, since you were aliens in the land of Egypt.

hausa: Bulus manzo, aikakke ba daga wurin mutum ba, ba kuma ta wurin mutane ba, amma ta wurin Yesu Kiristi da kuma Allah Uba, wanda ya tā da Yesu daga matattu.
english: Paul, an apostle—not from men, nor through man, but through Jesus Christ, and God the Father, who raised him from the dead—

hausa: Da suka ji haka, sai hankalin taron da na mahukuntan birnin ya tashi.
english: The multitude and the rulers of the city were troubled when they heard these things.

hausa: Musa ya yanka bijimin ya ɗauki jinin, ya sa yatsarsa ya zuba a dukan ƙahonin bagade don yă tsarkake bagaden. Ya zuba sauran jinin a gindin bagade. Ta haka ya tsarkake shi don yă yi kafara dominsa.
english: He killed it; and Moses took the blood, and put it around on the horns of the altar with his finger, and purified the altar, and poured out the blood at the base of the altar, and sanctified it, to make atonement for it.

hausa: Ya ɗauke ginshiƙin Ashera daga haikalin Ubangiji zuwa Kwarin Kidron can bayan Urushalima, ya ƙone shi a can. Ya niƙa shi sai da ya zama toka, sai ya watsar da ƙurar a filin kabarin talakawa.
english: He brought out the Asherah from Yahweh’s house, outside of Jerusalem, to the brook Kidron, and burned it at the brook Kidron, and beat it to dust, and cast its dust on the graves of the common people.

hausa: “Kwana shida za ku yi aiki, amma a rana ta bakwai za ku huta; ko da lokacin noma ne, ko lokacin girbi, sai ku huta.
english: “Six days you shall work, but on the seventh day you shall rest: in plowing time and in harvest you shall rest.

hausa: Hanniyel ɗan Efod, shugaba daga kabilar Manasse ɗan Yusuf;
english: Of the children of Joseph: of the tribe of the children of Manasseh a prince, Hanniel the son of Ephod.

hausa: Hadayar da ya kawo ita ce, faranti guda ɗaya na azurfa, nauyinsa shekel ɗari ɗaya da talatin, da kuma daro na yayyafawa na azurfa, nauyinsa shekel saba’in, dukan biyu, an auna su bisa ga ma’aunin shekel na tsattsarkan wuri, kowannensu cike da lallausan gari, haɗe da mai kamar hadaya ta gari;
english: gave his offering: one silver platter, the weight of which was one hundred thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary, both of them full of fine flour mixed with oil for a meal offering;

hausa: Kada kuma su ƙara yin hadayunsu ga gumaka masu siffar bunsurai waɗanda suka bauta wa. Wannan za tă zama dawwammamiyar farilla a gare su wa tsararraki masu zuwa.’
english: They shall no more sacrifice their sacrifices to the goat idols, after which they play the prostitute. This shall be a statute forever to them throughout their generations.’

hausa: Na rubuta wa ikkilisiya, amma Diyotirefes, wanda yake son zama na farko, ya ƙi yă yi hulɗa da mu.
english: I wrote to the assembly, but Diotrephes, who loves to be first among them, doesn’t accept what we say.

hausa: Ubangiji ya kama ka saboda alhakin jinin gidan Shawulu, wanda kake sarauta a maimakonsa. Ubangiji ya ba da masarautar ga ɗanka Absalom. Hallaka ta zo maka domin kai mai kisankai ne!”
english: Yahweh has returned on you all the blood of Saul’s house, in whose place you have reigned! Yahweh has delivered the kingdom into the hand of Absalom your son! Behold, you are caught by your own mischief, because you are a man of blood!”

hausa: Ka naɗa Haruna da ’ya’yansa su yi aiki firistoci; duk wanda ya yi shisshigi a wuri mai tsarki kuwa dole a kashe shi.”
english: You shall appoint Aaron and his sons, and they shall keep their priesthood, but the stranger who comes near shall be put to death.”

hausa: Amma sarki ya ce wa Arauna, “A’a, dole in biya ka saboda waɗannan. Ba yadda zan miƙa wa Ubangiji Allahna hadayun ƙonawa da bai ci mini kome ba.” Sai Dawuda ya saya, ya kuma biya masussukar, da shanun a bakin shekel hamsin na azurfa.
english: The king said to Araunah, “No, but I will most certainly buy it from you for a price. I will not offer burnt offerings to Yahweh my God which cost me nothing.” So David bought the threshing floor and the oxen for fifty shekels of silver.

hausa: “Wannan ita ce dokar haikalin. Dukan filin da yake kewaye a kan dutsen, zai zama wuri mafi tsarki. Dokar haikalin ke nan.
english: “This is the law of the house. On the top of the mountain the whole limit around it shall be most holy. Behold, this is the law of the house.

hausa: Sa’an nan annabi Irmiya ya ce wa annabi Hananiya, “Ka saurara, Hananiya! Ubangiji bai aike ka ba, duk da haka ka lallashe wannan al’umma su dogara ga ƙarya.
english: Then the prophet Jeremiah said to Hananiah the prophet, “Listen, Hananiah! Yahweh has not sent you, but you make this people trust in a lie.

hausa: Ya miƙa ’ya’yansa maza hadaya a wuta cikin Kwarin Ben Hinnom, ya yi bokanci, ya yi duba, ya kuma yi maitanci, ya nemi shawarar mabiya da masu ruhohi. Ya yi abin da yake mugu ƙwarai a gaban Ubangiji, yana tsokanarsa yă yi fushi.
english: He also made his children to pass through the fire in the valley of the son of Hinnom. He practiced sorcery, divination, and witchcraft, and dealt with those who had familiar spirits and with wizards. He did much evil in Yahweh’s sight, to provoke him to anger.

hausa: Ya gina hasumiyoyi a hamada ya kuma haƙa rijiyoyi masu yawa, gama yana da dabbobi masu yawa a gindin duwatsu da kuma a kwari. Yana da mutane masu yin masa aiki a gonakinsa da gonakin inabinsa a tuddai da kuma a ƙasashe masu dausayi, gama yana son noma.
english: He built towers in the wilderness, and dug out many cisterns, for he had much livestock, both in the lowlands and in the plains. He had farmers and vineyard keepers in the mountains and in the fruitful fields, for he loved farming.

hausa: Dukansu sun ci abincin ruhaniya guda
english: and all ate the same spiritual food;

hausa: Mawon, Karmel, Zif, Yutta
english: Maon, Carmel, Ziph, Jutah,

hausa: “Ina ce maka, tashi, ɗauki tabarmarka, ka tafi gida.”
english: “I tell you, arise, take up your mat, and go to your house.”

hausa: Abin da nake gani yana kawo mini baƙin ciki domin dukan matan birnina.
english: My eye affects my soul, because of all the daughters of my city.

hausa: Fatar jikinmu ta yi zafi kamar murhu, muna jin zazzaɓi domin yunwa.
english: Our skin is black like an oven, because of the burning heat of famine.

hausa: Sa’an nan al’ummai kewaye da ku da suka rage za su san cewa Ni Ubangiji na sāke gina abin da aka lalace na kuma sāke shuka abin da yake kango. Ni Ubangiji na faɗa, kuma zan aikata.’
english: Then the nations that are left around you will know that I, Yahweh, have built the ruined places and planted that which was desolate. I, Yahweh, have spoken it, and I will do it.”

hausa: Amma annabin da ya yi annabcin salama shi za a ɗauka a matsayin wanda Ubangiji ya aika in har abin da ya furta ya zama gaskiya.”
english: As for the prophet who prophesies of peace, when the word of the prophet happens, then the prophet will be known, that Yahweh has truly sent him.”

hausa: “Ga fassarar, ya sarki, wannan ita ce doka wadda Mafi Ɗaukaka ya bayar a kan ranka yă daɗe, sarkina.
english: “This is the interpretation, O king, and it is the decree of the Most High, which has come on my lord the king:

hausa: Gara saurayi wanda yake matalauci amma yake da hikima da sarkin da ya tsufa mai wauta, wanda ba ya karɓar shawara.
english: Better is a poor and wise youth than an old and foolish king who doesn’t know how to receive admonition any more.

hausa: Kowannenku da ban kashe daga hidima a bagadena ba, za a bar shi don yă cika idanunka da hawaye da kuma baƙin ciki, dukan sauran zuriyarka kuwa za su mutu a ƙuruciyarsu.
english: The man of yours whom I don’t cut off from my altar will consume your eyes and grieve your heart. All the increase of your house will die in the flower of their age.

hausa: Da sarki ya dawo daga Damaskus ya ga bagaden, sai ya tafi kusa da shi ya kuma miƙa hadaya a bisansa.
english: When the king had come from Damascus, the king saw the altar; and the king came near to the altar, and offered on it.

hausa: Domin ya ƙaunaci kakanninku, ya kuma zaɓi zuriyarsu a bayansu, ya fitar da ku daga Masar ta wurin kasancewarsa da kuma ƙarfinsa mai girma,
english: Because he loved your fathers, therefore he chose their offspring after them, and brought you out with his presence, with his great power, out of Egypt;

hausa: gama na san cewa ta wurin addu’o’inku da kuma taimako daga Ruhun Yesu Kiristi, abin da ya same ni zai zama sanadin kuɓutata.
english: For I know that this will turn out to my salvation through your prayers and the supply of the Spirit of Jesus Christ,

hausa: Sun sauya gaskiyar Allah da ƙarya, suka kuma yi wa abubuwan da aka halitta sujada suna bauta musu a maimakon Mahalicci, wanda ake yabo har abada. Amin.
english: who exchanged the truth of God for a lie, and worshiped and served the creature rather than the Creator, who is blessed forever. Amen.

hausa: To, Kayinu ya ce wa ɗan’uwansa Habila, “Mu tafi gona.” Yayinda suke a gona, sai Kayinu ya tasar wa Habila ya buge shi ya kashe.
english: Cain said to Abel, his brother, “Let’s go into the field.” While they were in the field, Cain rose up against Abel, his brother, and killed him.

hausa: Waɗannan su ne ’ya’yan Dawuda maza da aka haifa masa a Hebron. Ɗan farinsa shi ne Amnon ɗan Ahinowam mutuniyar Yezireyel; na biyun, Daniyel ɗan Abigiyel mutuniyar Karmel;
english: Now these were the sons of David, who were born to him in Hebron: the firstborn, Amnon, of Ahinoam the Jezreelitess; the second, Daniel, of Abigail the Carmelitess;

hausa: Shawulu da ɗansa Yonatan da mutanen da suke tare da shi suka zauna a Geba ta Benyamin. Sa’an nan Filistiyawa suka yi sansani a Mikmash.
english: Saul, and Jonathan his son, and the people who were present with them, stayed in Geba of Benjamin; but the Philistines encamped in Michmash.

hausa: Sai duk waɗanda suke tsoron maganar Allah na Isra’ila suka kewaye ni don su ji wannan rashin imani wanda waɗanda suka dawo bauta suka yi. Na kuwa zauna a can a rikice, har lokacin miƙa hadaya na yamma.
english: Then everyone who trembled at the words of the God of Israel were assembled to me because of the trespass of the exiles; and I sat confounded until the evening offering.

hausa: Kaiton mu! Wa zai kuɓutar da mu daga hannun waɗannan manyan alloli? Su ne allolin da suka buga Masarawa da irin annoba masu yawa a jeji.
english: Woe to us! Who shall deliver us out of the hand of these mighty gods? These are the gods that struck the Egyptians with all kinds of plagues in the wilderness.

hausa: Rezon ya zama babban abokin gāban Isra’ila cikin dukan kwanakin mulkin Solomon. Ya ƙara rikici a kan rikicin Hadad. Rezon ya ƙi mulkin Isra’ila da dukan ransa. Saboda haka Rezon ya yi mulki a Aram ya kuma ƙi jinin Isra’ila.
english: He was an adversary to Israel all the days of Solomon, in addition to the mischief of Hadad. He abhorred Israel, and reigned over Syria.

hausa: “ ‘Waɗannan ƙananan dabbobi da suke rarrafe a ƙasa, haram ne a gare ku, wato, murɗiya, da ɓera, da gafiya da irinsa,
english: “‘These are they which are unclean to you among the creeping things that creep on the earth: the weasel, the rat, any kind of great lizard,

hausa: Ka kuma ce, ‘Ya Ubangiji, kai ne ka yi magana a kan wannan wuri, cewa za ka lalatar da shi, har ba abin da zai zauna a ciki, mutum ko dabba. Wurin zai zama kufai har abada.’
english: and say, ‘Yahweh, you have spoken concerning this place, to cut it off, that no one will dwell in it, neither man nor animal, but that it will be desolate forever.’

hausa: Ubangiji ya yi mini magana da hannunsa mai ƙarfi a kaina, yana yi mini gargaɗi kada in bi hanyar waɗannan mutane. Ya ce,
english: For Yahweh spoke this to me with a strong hand, and instructed me not to walk in the way of this people, saying,

hausa: Bitrus ya bi shi daga nesa, har cikin filin gidan babban firist. A can, ya zauna tare da masu gadi, yana jin ɗumin wuta.
english: Peter had followed him from a distance, until he came into the court of the high priest. He was sitting with the officers, and warming himself in the light of the fire.

hausa: Amma Gedaliya ɗan Ahikam ya ce wa Yohanan ɗan Kareya, “Kada ka yi irin wannan abu! Abin da kake faɗa game da Ishmayel ba gaskiya ba ne.”
english: But Gedaliah the son of Ahikam said to Johanan the son of Kareah, “You shall not do this thing, for you speak falsely of Ishmael.”

hausa: Ka ba da mu a cinye kamar tumaki ka kuma watsar da mu a cikin al’ummai.
english: You have made us like sheep for food, and have scattered us among the nations.

hausa: Sun tattake kawunan matalauta kamar yadda suke taka laka suka kuma danne wa marasa galihu gaskiya. Uba da ɗa su na kwana da yarinya guda, suna kuma ɓata sunana mai tsarki.
english: They trample the heads of the poor into the dust of the earth and deny justice to the oppressed. A man and his father use the same maiden, to profane my holy name.

hausa: Duk da haka ba su saurara ba, ba su kuwa mai da hankali ba; suka taurare ba su kuwa saurara ko su karɓi horo ba.
english: But they didn’t listen. They didn’t turn their ear, but made their neck stiff, that they might not hear, and might not receive instruction.

hausa: Mutane ne masu ƙarfi da kuma yawa, suna kuma da tsayi kamar Anakawa. Ubangiji ya hallaka su daga gaban Ammonawa, waɗanda suka kore su, suka kuma zauna a wurinsu.
english: a great people, many, and tall, as the Anakim; but Yahweh destroyed them from before Israel, and they succeeded them, and lived in their place,

hausa: Wata rana, a cikin kwanakin nan, Yesu ya je wani dutse domin yă yi addu’a, ya kuma kwana yana addu’a ga Allah.
english: In these days, he went out to the mountain to pray, and he continued all night in prayer to God.

hausa: Sai ya yi tambaya ya ce, “Amma ku fa, wa kuke ce da ni?” Bitrus ya amsa ya ce, “Kai ne Kiristi.”
english: He said to them, “But who do you say that I am?” Peter answered, “You are the Christ.”

hausa: Sai dai a yi kome daidai da kuma cikin tsari.
english: Let all things be done decently and in order.

hausa: A zamanin Shawulu zuriyar Ruben sun yi yaƙi da Hagirawa, suka ci su da yaƙi, suka zauna a wuraren zaman Hagirawan ko’ina a dukan yankin gabashin Gileyad.
english: In the days of Saul, they made war with the Hagrites, who fell by their hand; and they lived in their tents throughout all the land east of Gilead.

hausa: ku ba wa Ubangiji ɗaukakar da ta dace da sunansa. Ku kawo hadaya ku kuma zo gabansa; ku yi wa Ubangiji sujada cikin darajar tsarkinsa.
english: Ascribe to Yahweh the glory due to his name. Bring an offering, and come before him. Worship Yahweh in holy array.

hausa: Dukansu suna da zafi kamar matoya; suna kashe masu mulkinsu. Dukan sarakunansu sukan fāɗi, kuma babu waninsu da yake kira gare ni.
english: They are all hot as an oven, and devour their judges. All their kings have fallen. There is no one among them who calls to me.

hausa: Saye da rigunansu na sarauta, sarkin Isra’ila da Yehoshafat sarkin Yahuda suna zama a kujerun sarautarsu a masussuka ta mashigin ƙofar Samariya, tare da dukan annabawa suna ta annabci a gabansu.
english: Now the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat the king of Judah were sitting each on his throne, arrayed in their robes, in an open place at the entrance of the gate of Samaria; and all the prophets were prophesying before them.

hausa: “ ‘Amma duk wanda ya yi zunubi da gangan, ko shi ɗan ƙasa ne, ko baƙo, ya saɓi Ubangiji, dole a ware wannan mutum daga mutanensa,
english: “‘But the soul who does anything with a high hand, whether he is native-born or a foreigner, blasphemes Yahweh. That soul shall be cut off from among his people.

hausa: Da ruwa mai hauka ya share mu ƙaf.
english: Then the proud waters would have gone over our soul.

hausa: lalle wannan zai kawo mini kuɓuta gama ba wani marar tsoron Allah da zai iya zuwa wurinsa!
english: This also will be my salvation, that a godless man will not come before him.

hausa: gama yana ƙaunar al’ummarmu ta Yahudawa, har ya gina majami’armu.”
english: for he loves our nation, and he built our synagogue for us.”

hausa: Aka binne shi tare da sarakuna a cikin Birnin Dawuda, saboda kirkin da ya yi a Isra’ila wa Allah da haikalinsa.
english: They buried him in David’s city among the kings, because he had done good in Israel, and toward God and his house.

hausa: Mugun mutum kan yi tsayin daka, amma mai aikata gaskiya kan yi tunani a kan abin da yake yi.
english: A wicked man hardens his face; but as for the upright, he establishes his ways.

hausa: Haka nan fa, kowane ne a cikinku, da ba ya rabu da abin da yake da shi ba, ba zai iya zama almajirina ba.
english: So therefore, whoever of you who doesn’t renounce all that he has, he can’t be my disciple.

hausa: Ba za su yi wahala a banza ba ko su haifi ’ya’yan da aka ƙaddara da rashin sa’a; gama za su zama mutanen da Ubangiji ya yi wa albarka, su da zuriyarsu tare da su.
english: They will not labor in vain nor give birth for calamity; for they are the offspring of Yahweh’s blessed and their descendants with them.

hausa: A ranar da aka kafa Tenti na Alkawari, sai girgije ya rufe shi. Daga yamma har safe, girgijen da yake bisa tabanakul ya yi kama da wuta.
english: On the day that the tabernacle was raised up, the cloud covered the tabernacle, even the Tent of the Testimony. At evening it was over the tabernacle, as it were the appearance of fire, until morning.

hausa: kamar yadda muka karɓe su daga waɗanda tun farko shaidu ne da kuma masu hidimar bishara.
english: even as those who from the beginning were eyewitnesses and servants of the word delivered them to us,

hausa: Kada a sami wani a cikinku da ya miƙa ɗansa, ko ’yarsa a wuta, ko a sami mai duba, ko mai maita, ko mai fassara gaibi, ko mai sihiri,
english: There shall not be found with you anyone who makes his son or his daughter to pass through the fire, one who uses divination, one who tells fortunes, or an enchanter, or a sorcerer,

hausa: Sai Ruhun Allah ya sauko a kan Azariya ɗan Oded.
english: The Spirit of God came on Azariah the son of Oded.

hausa: A garin nan kuma, akwai wata gwauruwa, wadda ta dinga zuwa wurin alƙalin nan, da roƙo cewa, ‘Ka yi mini adalci tsakanina da maƙiyina.’
english: A widow was in that city, and she often came to him, saying, ‘Defend me from my adversary!’

hausa: “Kamar yadda sammai suke can nesa da ƙasa, haka yadda nake yin abubuwa suke dabam da yadda kuke yin abubuwa tunanina kuma dabam da naku.
english: “For as the heavens are higher than the earth, so are my ways higher than your ways, and my thoughts than your thoughts.

hausa: Firistoci ba za su ci mushen tsuntsu ko na dabba ba, ba kuwa za su ci waɗanda namun jeji suka kashe ba.
english: The priests shall not eat of anything that dies of itself or is torn, whether it is bird or animal.

hausa: Ya sa sauran mutanen a ƙarƙashin kulawar Abishai ɗan’uwansa, aka sa a kan Ammonawa.
english: The rest of the people he committed into the hand of Abishai his brother; and they put themselves in array against the children of Ammon.

hausa: Ko kuma, me mutum zai bayar a musayar ransa?
english: For what will a man give in exchange for his life?

hausa: na shidan Ozem na bakwai kuma Dawuda.
english: Ozem the sixth, and David the seventh;

hausa: Suka tashi daga Abrona, suka yi sansani a Eziyon Geber.
english: They traveled from Abronah, and encamped in Ezion Geber.

hausa: Zabura ta Dawuda. Ku ba da girma ga Ubangiji, ya ku manya, ku ba da girma ga Ubangiji saboda ɗaukaka da kuma ƙarfinsa.
english: A Psalm by David. Ascribe to Yahweh, you sons of the mighty, ascribe to Yahweh glory and strength.

hausa: Addu’arsa da yadda Allah ya taɓu ta wurin tubansa, da kuma dukan zunubansa da rashin biyayyarsa, da wuraren da ya gina masujadan kan tudu ya kuma kafa ginshiƙan Ashera da gumaka kafin ya ƙasƙantar da kansa, duka suna a rubuce cikin tarihin mai duba.
english: His prayer also, and how God listened to his request, and all his sin and his trespass, and the places in which he built high places and set up the Asherah poles and the engraved images before he humbled himself: behold, they are written in the history of Hozai.

hausa: Haka ya ci gaba da kasancewa; girgijen ya rufe shi, da dare kuma sai ya yi kamar wuta.
english: So it was continually. The cloud covered it, and the appearance of fire by night.

hausa: Ubangiji yakan cece bayinsa; ba wanda yake neman mafaka a wurinsa da za a hukunta.
english: Yahweh redeems the soul of his servants. None of those who take refuge in him shall be condemned.

hausa: Ubangiji ya ce wa Haruna, “Kai da ’ya’yanka, da kuma iyalin mahaifinka za ku ɗauki hakkin abin da ya shafi Tentin Sujada, kai da ’ya’yanka kaɗai za ku ɗauki hakkin aikinku wanda ya shafi firistoci.
english: Yahweh said to Aaron, “You and your sons and your fathers’ house with you shall bear the iniquity of the sanctuary; and you and your sons with you shall bear the iniquity of your priesthood.

hausa: Mutanen da suke tafiya cikin duhu sun ga babban haske; a kan waɗanda suke zama a ƙasar inuwar mutuwa haske ya haskaka.
english: The people who walked in darkness have seen a great light. The light has shined on those who lived in the land of the shadow of death.

hausa: Ƙazantarta ta manne wa rigunanta; ba tă kula da nan gaba ba, fāɗuwarta kuwa babban abu ne; babu wanda zai yi mata ta’aziyya. “Duba, ya Ubangiji, ka ga wahalata, gama maƙiyi ya yi nasara.”
english: Her filthiness was in her skirts. She didn’t remember her latter end. Therefore she has come down astoundingly. She has no comforter. “See, Yahweh, my affliction; for the enemy has magnified himself.”

hausa: Idanunsa za su duhunce fiye da ruwan inabi, haƙorarsa farare kamar madara.
english: His eyes will be red with wine, his teeth white with milk.

hausa: Zurfi kan kira zurfi cikin rurin matsirgar ruwanka; dukan raƙuma da igiyoyi sun sha kaina.
english: Deep calls to deep at the noise of your waterfalls. All your waves and your billows have swept over me.

hausa: Ina da wani ikon da zan iya taimakon kai na ne, yanzu da aka kore nasara daga gare ni?
english: Isn’t it that I have no help in me, that wisdom is driven away from me?

hausa: Sai aka raba musu abinci, nasa shi kaɗai su kuma su kaɗai, domin Masarawa ba sa cin abinci tare da Ibraniyawa, gama wannan abin ƙyama ne ga Masarawa.
english: They served him by himself, and them by themselves, and the Egyptians who ate with him by themselves, because the Egyptians don’t eat with the Hebrews, for that is an abomination to the Egyptians.

hausa: Ɗana, ka kiyaye kalmomina ka kuma ajiye umarnaina a cikinka.
english: My son, keep my words. Lay up my commandments within you.

hausa: an ba ma’aikatan da suka gyara haikalin ne.
english: for they gave that to those who did the work, and repaired Yahweh’s house with it.

hausa: Na karaya, kwanakina sun kusa ƙarewa, kabari yana jirana.
english: “My spirit is consumed. My days are extinct and the grave is ready for me.

hausa: Ashe, wannan ba shi ne kafinta nan ba? Shin, ba shi ne ɗan Maryamu ba, ba shi ne ɗan’uwan su Yaƙub, Yusuf, Yahuda da kuma Siman ba? Ashe, ’yan’uwansa mata kuma ba suna nan tare da mu ba?” Sai suka ji haushinsa.
english: Isn’t this the carpenter, the son of Mary and brother of James, Joses, Judah, and Simon? Aren’t his sisters here with us?” So they were offended at him.

hausa: An kai mu ƙasa zuwa ƙura; jikunanmu sun manne da ƙasa.
english: For our soul is bowed down to the dust. Our body clings to the earth.

hausa: Bulus, manzon Kiristi Yesu ta wurin nufin Allah, da kuma daga Timoti ɗan’uwanmu, Zuwa ga ikkilisiyar Allah da take a Korint, tare da dukan tsarkaka a ko’ina a Akayya.
english: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus through the will of God, and Timothy our brother, to the assembly of God which is at Corinth, with all the saints who are in the whole of Achaia:

hausa: Ga sunayen yaran da aka haifa masa a can. Shammuwa, Shobab, Natan, Solomon,
english: These are the names of the children whom he had in Jerusalem: Shammua, Shobab, Nathan, Solomon,

hausa: Suka yi zarge cewa, “Wannan mutum yana rarrashin mutane su yi wa Allah sujada a hanyoyin da suka saɓa wa doka.”
english: saying, “This man persuades men to worship God contrary to the law.”

hausa: Ya yi rantsuwa ga Ubangiji ya kuma yi alkawari ga Maɗaukaki na Yaƙub cewa,
english: how he swore to Yahweh, and vowed to the Mighty One of Jacob:

hausa: Kada ku miƙa wa Ubangiji dabbobi makafi, ko naƙasassu, ko masu gundumi, ko masu ɗiga, ko masu susa, ko masu kirci. Kada ku sa wani daga cikin waɗannan a bisa bagade a matsayin hadaya, gama hadaya ce da aka ƙone da wuta ga Ubangiji.
english: You shall not offer what is blind, is injured, is maimed, has a wart, is festering, or has a running sore to Yahweh, nor make an offering by fire of them on the altar to Yahweh.

hausa: Idanuna sun ga fāɗuwar maƙiyana; kunnuwana sun ji kukan mugayen maƙiyana.
english: My eye has also seen my enemies. My ears have heard of the wicked enemies who rise up against me.

hausa: Kwafuna uku masu siffar furanni almon, da toho, da kuma furannin za su kasance a rashe guda, uku a kan rashe na biye, haka kuma a kan saura rassan shida da suka miƙe daga wurin ajiye fitilan.
english: three cups made like almond blossoms in one branch, a bud and a flower; and three cups made like almond blossoms in the other branch, a bud and a flower, so for the six branches going out of the lamp stand;

hausa: “Ku zo, mu koma ga Ubangiji. Ya yayyage mu kucu-kucu amma zai warkar da mu; ya ji mana ciwo amma zai daure mana miyakunmu.
english: “Come! Let’s return to Yahweh; for he has torn us to pieces, and he will heal us; he has injured us, and he will bind up our wounds.

hausa: Ranan nan za tă zama ranar fushi, rana ce ta baƙin ciki da azaba, rana ce ta tashin hankali da lalacewa, ranar duhu baƙi ƙirin, ranar gizagizai da baƙin duhu,
english: That day is a day of wrath, a day of distress and anguish, a day of trouble and ruin, a day of darkness and gloom, a day of clouds and blackness,

hausa: Kada a ɗauke muku hankali da sababbin koyarwa dabam-dabam. Yana da kyau zukatanmu su ƙarfafa ta wurin alheri, ba ta wurin abinci waɗanda ba su da amfani ga waɗanda suke cinsu.
english: Don’t be carried away by various and strange teachings, for it is good that the heart be established by grace, not by foods, through which those who were so occupied were not benefited.

hausa: Wanda ba shi da kaciya ta jiki duk da haka yana biyayya da dokar zai iya hukunta ka, kai da kake karya dokar, ko da yake kana da rubutaccen tsarin dokar an kuma yi maka kaciya.
english: Won’t those who are physically uncircumcised, but fulfill the law, judge you, who with the letter and circumcision are a transgressor of the law?

hausa: kuma cewa kai, ya Ubangiji, mai ƙauna ne. Tabbatacce za ka sāka wa kowane mutum bisa ga abin da ya yi.”
english: Also to you, Lord, belongs loving kindness, for you reward every man according to his work.

hausa: Garuruwan Yahuda da mutanen Urushalima za su tafi su yi kuka ga allolin da suke ƙona wa turare, amma ba za su taimake su ba sam sa’ad da masifar ta auku.
english: Then the cities of Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem will go and cry to the gods to which they offer incense, but they will not save them at all in the time of their trouble.

hausa: Za ku shuka inabi ku kuma yi musu banƙasa, amma ba za ku sha ruwan inabin ba, domin tsutsotsi za su cinye su.
english: You will plant vineyards and dress them, but you will neither drink of the wine, nor harvest, because worms will eat them.

hausa: Bari idanunsu yă dushe don kada su gani, bayansu kuma yă tanƙware har abada.
english: Let their eyes be darkened, so that they can’t see. Let their backs be continually bent.

hausa: Yehu ya yi sarautar Isra’ila a Samariya shekara ashirin da takwas.
english: The time that Jehu reigned over Israel in Samaria was twenty-eight years.

hausa: Gama sa’ad da na fitar da kakanninku daga Masar na kuma yi musu magana, ban ba su dokoki kawai game da hadayun ƙonawa da sadakoki ba,
english: For I didn’t speak to your fathers or command them in the day that I brought them out of the land of Egypt concerning burnt offerings or sacrifices;

hausa: Amma game da ni, yana da kyau in kasance kusa da Allah. Na mai da Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka mafakata; zan yi shelar dukan ayyukanka.
english: But it is good for me to come close to God. I have made the Lord Yahweh my refuge, that I may tell of all your works.

hausa: Kashegari babban taron da suka zo Bikin suka sami labari cewa Yesu yana kan hanyarsa zuwa Urushalima.
english: On the next day a great multitude had come to the feast. When they heard that Jesus was coming to Jerusalem,

hausa: Ya ƙarfafa kāriyarsu ya kuma sa shugabannin mayaƙa a cikinsu, tare da tanadin abinci, man zaitun da kuma ruwan inabi.
english: He fortified the strongholds and put captains in them with stores of food, oil and wine.

hausa: Ya kawo azurfa da zinariya da kayayyaki a haikalin Allah waɗanda shi da mahaifinsa suka keɓe.
english: He brought the things that his father had dedicated and that he himself had dedicated, silver, gold, and vessels into God’s house.

hausa: Kamar dai yadda Musa ya ɗaga maciji a hamada, haka dole ne a ɗaga Ɗan Mutum,
english: As Moses lifted up the serpent in the wilderness, even so must the Son of Man be lifted up,

hausa: A daren da in gari ya waye da Hiridus yake niyyar kawo shi domin a yi masa shari’a, Bitrus yana barci tsakanin sojoji biyu, daure da sarƙoƙi biyu, masu gadi kuma suna bakin ƙofa.
english: The same night when Herod was about to bring him out, Peter was sleeping between two soldiers, bound with two chains. Guards in front of the door kept the prison.

hausa: Isra’ila ya ce wa Yusuf, “Ban yi tsammani zan ga fuskarka kuma ba, yanzu kuwa Allah ya bar ni in ga ’ya’yanka su ma.”
english: Israel said to Joseph, “I didn’t think I would see your face, and behold, God has let me see your offspring also.”

hausa: Ta kuma sha wahala ƙwarai a hannun likitoci da yawa, har ta kashe duk abin da take da shi, amma maimakon samun sauƙi, sai ciwon ya ƙara muni.
english: and had suffered many things by many physicians, and had spent all that she had, and was no better, but rather grew worse,

hausa: Zuriyar Gad bisa ga kabilansu, daga Zafon, kabilar Zafonawa; daga Haggi, kabilar Haggiwa; daga Shuni, kabilar Shunawa;
english: The sons of Gad after their families: of Zephon, the family of the Zephonites; of Haggi, the family of the Haggites; of Shuni, the family of the Shunites;

hausa: Sai sunan Dawuda ya bazu ko’ina a ƙasar, Ubangiji kuwa ya sa dukan al’ummai suka ji tsoronsa.
english: The fame of David went out into all lands; and Yahweh brought the fear of him on all nations.

hausa: Kiristi ya ba da jikinsa don yă kawar da doka da dukan umarnanta da kuma ƙa’idodinta. Ya yi haka domin yă halicci sabuwar zuriya daga zuriyoyin nan biyu. Ta haka kuma ya kawo salama tsakaninsu.
english: having abolished in his flesh the hostility, the law of commandments contained in ordinances, that he might create in himself one new man of the two, making peace,

hausa: A Damaskus, gwamnan da yake ƙarƙashin Sarki Aretas, ya sa tsare ƙofofin birnin Damaskus, don yă kama ni.
english: In Damascus the governor under King Aretas guarded the Damascenes’ city, desiring to arrest me.

hausa: Ubangiji Allah ya ce, “Bai yi kyau mutumin yă kasance shi kaɗai ba. Zan yi masa mataimakin da ya dace da shi.”
english: Yahweh God said, “It is not good for the man to be alone. I will make him a helper comparable to him.”

hausa: Saboda haka suka haura, suka fita daga Masar, suka zo wurin maihaifinsu Yaƙub a ƙasar Kan’ana.
english: They went up out of Egypt, and came into the land of Canaan, to Jacob their father.

hausa: sa’ad da kuma ku da ’ya’yanku kuka komo ga Ubangiji Allahnku, kuka kuma yi biyayya da dukan zuciyarku da kuma dukan ranku, bisa ga kome da na umarce ku a yau,
english: and return to Yahweh your God and obey his voice according to all that I command you today, you and your children, with all your heart and with all your soul,

hausa: Ga sunayen sauran mutanen Isra’ilan da suke da wannan laifi. Daga zuriyar Farosh, akwai Ramiya, da Izziya, Malkiya, Miyamin, Eleyazar, Malkiya da Benahiya.
english: Of Israel: Of the sons of Parosh: Ramiah, Izziah, Malchijah, Mijamin, Eleazar, Malchijah, and Benaiah.

hausa: Sai dai ku ƙarfafa juna kullum, muddin akwai lokacin da ana ce da shi Yau, don kada waninku yă zama mai taurin zuciya ta wurin ruɗun zunubi.
english: but exhort one another day by day, so long as it is called “today”, lest any one of you be hardened by the deceitfulness of sin.

hausa: Don mai bi da kaɗe-kaɗe. Da kayan kiɗi masu tsirkiya. Wani maskil ta Dawuda. Sa’ad da Zifawa suka tafi wurin Shawulu suka ce, “Ba Dawuda ba ne yake ɓuya a cikinmu?” Ka cece ni, ya Allah ta wurin sunanka; ka nuna ni marar laifi ne ta wurin ƙarfinka.
english: For the Chief Musician. On stringed instruments. A contemplation by David, when the Ziphites came and said to Saul, “Isn’t David hiding himself among us?” Save me, God, by your name. Vindicate me in your might.

hausa: inda manyan firistoci da shugabannin Yahudawa suka bayyana a gabansa suka kuma gabatar da ƙararsu a kan Bulus.
english: Then the high priest and the principal men of the Jews informed him against Paul, and they begged him,

hausa: in bayan ta bar gidansa ta zama matar wani dabam,
english: When she has departed out of his house, she may go and be another man’s wife.

hausa: Ya yi mafarki inda ya ga wata matakalar hawa, tsaye a ƙasa, kanta ta kai sama, mala’ikun Allah kuwa suna hawa, suna sauka a kanta.
english: He dreamed and saw a stairway set upon the earth, and its top reached to heaven. Behold, the angels of God were ascending and descending on it.

hausa: Zuriyar Manasse su ne, Asriyel zuriyarsa ne ta wurin ƙwarƙwararsa mutuniyar Aram. Ta haifa wa Makir mahaifin Gileyad.
english: The sons of Manasseh: Asriel, whom his concubine the Aramitess bore. She bore Machir the father of Gilead.

hausa: Za a zura sandunan a cikin zoban saboda su kasance a gefe biyu na bagade a lokacin da ake ɗaukarsa.
english: Its poles shall be put into the rings, and the poles shall be on the two sides of the altar when carrying it.

hausa: Yabi Ubangiji. Ku yabe shi, ya ku bayin Ubangiji, ku yabi sunan Ubangiji.
english: Praise Yah! Praise, you servants of Yahweh, praise Yahweh’s name.

hausa: Sun yi zama a cikinta suka kuma yi gina wuri mai tsarki a cikinta domin Sunanka cewa,
english: They lived in it, and have built you a sanctuary in it for your name, saying,

hausa: Gama ta wurin alherin nan da aka yi mini ne ina ce wa kowannenku. Kada yă ɗauki kansa fiye da yadda ya kamata, a maimakon haka bari yă auna kansa cikin natsuwa, gwargwadon baiwar bangaskiyar da Allah yi masa.
english: For I say through the grace that was given me, to everyone who is among you, not to think of yourself more highly than you ought to think; but to think reasonably, as God has apportioned to each person a measure of faith.

hausa: Kashegari, da Filistiyawa suka zo don su tuttuɓe waɗanda suka mutu, sai suka sami Shawulu da ’ya’yansa maza sun mutu a Dutsen Gilbowa.
english: On the next day, when the Philistines came to strip the slain, they found Saul and his sons fallen on Mount Gilboa.

hausa: waɗanda aka zaɓa bisa ga rigyasanin Allah Uba, ta wurin aikin tsarkakewar Ruhu, don biyayya ga Yesu Kiristi, su kuma sami yayyafan jininsa. Alheri da salama su zama naku a yalwace.
english: according to the foreknowledge of God the Father, in sanctification of the Spirit, that you may obey Jesus Christ and be sprinkled with his blood: Grace to you and peace be multiplied.

hausa: Duk, ke kyakkyawa ce, ƙaunatacciyata; babu wani lahani a cikinki.
english: You are all beautiful, my love. There is no spot in you.

hausa: Musa ya ce wa Ubangiji, “Kana ta faɗa mini cewa, ‘Ka jagoranci mutane nan,’ amma ba ka faɗa mini wanda zai tafi tare da ni ba. Ga shi ka ƙara ce mini, ‘Na san ka, na san sunanka, ka kuma sami tagomashi a wurina.’
english: Moses said to Yahweh, “Behold, you tell me, ‘Bring up this people;’ and you haven’t let me know whom you will send with me. Yet you have said, ‘I know you by name, and you have also found favor in my sight.’

hausa: Yakan mai da sarakuna ba kome ba yă mai da masu mulkin wannan duniya wofi.
english: who brings princes to nothing, who makes the judges of the earth meaningless.

hausa: Sa’an nan ya ce wa Zeba da Zalmunna, “Waɗanne irin mutane ne kuka karkashe a Tabor.” Suka ce, “Mutane kamar ka ne kowane kamar ɗan sarki.”
english: Then he said to Zebah and Zalmunna, “What kind of men were they whom you killed at Tabor?” They answered, “They were like you. They all resembled the children of a king.”

hausa: Waɗannan su ne dokokin da Ubangiji ya ba wa Musa a Dutsen Sinai saboda Isra’ilawa.
english: These are the commandments which Yahweh commanded Moses for the children of Israel on Mount Sinai.

hausa: ’Ya’yan Hela maza su ne, Zeret, Zohar, Etnan,
english: The sons of Helah were Zereth, Izhar, and Ethnan.

hausa: An buɗe ƙofofin rafuffukan sai wurin ya rurrushe.
english: The gates of the rivers are opened, and the palace is dissolved.

hausa: “A waɗannan kwanaki mutane ba za su ƙara ce, “ ‘Ubanni suka ci ’ya’yan inabi masu tsami, haƙoran ’ya’ya suka mutu ba.’
english: “In those days they will say no more, “‘The fathers have eaten sour grapes, and the children’s teeth are set on edge.’

hausa: Dawuda ya ƙwato kome da Amalekawa suka kwashe tare da matarsa biyu.
english: David recovered all that the Amalekites had taken, and David rescued his two wives.

hausa: In kuma bai fanshe gonar ba, ko kuwa in ya sayar wa wani dabam, ba za a taɓa fanshe ta ba.
english: If he will not redeem the field, or if he has sold the field to another man, it shall not be redeemed any more;

hausa: Ya ɗauki jakarsa cike da kuɗi ba zai kuwa dawo gida ba sai tsakiyar wata.”
english: He has taken a bag of money with him. He will come home at the full moon.”

hausa: da Ma’asehiya ɗan Baruk, ɗan Kol-Hoze, ɗan Hazahiya, ɗan Adahiya, ɗan Yohiyarib, ɗan Zakariya, zuriyar Shela.
english: and Maaseiah the son of Baruch, the son of Colhozeh, the son of Hazaiah, the son of Adaiah, the son of Joiarib, the son of Zechariah, the son of the Shilonite.

hausa: (Amma Geshur da Aram suka ƙwace Hawwot Yayir da kuma Kenat tare da ƙauyukan kewayenta, garuruwa sittin.) Dukan waɗannan su ne zuriyar Makir mahaifin Gileyad.
english: Geshur and Aram took the towns of Jair from them, with Kenath, and its villages, even sixty cities. All these were the sons of Machir the father of Gilead.

hausa: Zan yi kuka in yi kururuwa saboda duwatsu in kuma yi makoki game da wuraren kiwon hamada. Sun zama kango ba wanda yake bi cikinta, ba a kuma jin kukan shanu. Tsuntsaye sararin sama sun gudu namun jeji ma duk sun watse.
english: I will weep and wail for the mountains, and lament for the pastures of the wilderness, because they are burned up, so that no one passes through; Men can’t hear the voice of the livestock. Both the birds of the sky and the animals have fled. They are gone.

hausa: A wannan rana Saiwar Yesse zai miƙe kamar tuta don mutanenta; al’ummai za su tattaru wurinsa, wurin hutunsa kuma zai zama mai daraja.
english: It will happen in that day that the nations will seek the root of Jesse, who stands as a banner of the peoples; and his resting place will be glorious.

hausa: Ɗakunan da suke bisa ba su da fāɗi, gama mataki hawan benen ya cinye wuri fiye da a ɗakunan da suke a hawa na ƙasa da na tsakiya.
english: Now the upper rooms were shorter; for the galleries took away from these more than from the lower and the middle in the building.

hausa: Kafin zuwa Shawulu, Ubangiji ya riga ya bayyana wa Sama’ila ya ce,
english: Now Yahweh had revealed to Samuel a day before Saul came, saying,

hausa: Sa’ad da Dawuda ya yi ɗan nesa da ƙwanƙolin, sai ga Ziba mai hidimar Mefiboshet, yana jira yă tarye shi. Yana da jerin jakuna da sirdi suna ɗauke da dunƙulen burodi ɗari biyu, da ƙosai busasshen inabi ɗari ɗaya, da kosan ’ya’yan itace ɓaure guda ɗari, da salka ruwan inabi.
english: When David was a little past the top, behold, Ziba the servant of Mephibosheth met him with a couple of donkeys saddled, and on them two hundred loaves of bread, and one hundred clusters of raisins, and one hundred summer fruits, and a container of wine.

hausa: Sa’an nan matar Samson ta kwanta masa a jiki tana kuka tana cewa, “Kai maƙiyina ne, lalle ba ka ƙaunata, ka yi wa mutanena kacici-kacici, amma ba ka gaya mini amsar ba.” Ya amsa ya ce, “Ban ma bayyana wa mahaifina ko mahaifiyata ba, to, don me zan bayyana miki?”
english: Samson’s wife wept before him, and said, “You just hate me, and don’t love me. You’ve told a riddle to the children of my people, and haven’t told it to me.” He said to her, “Behold, I haven’t told my father or my mother, so why should I tell you?”

hausa: Amma za su amsa su ce, ‘Ba amfani. Za mu ci gaba da shirye-shiryenmu; kowannenmu zai bi taurin muguwar zuciyarsa.’ ”
english: But they say, ‘It is in vain; for we will walk after our own plans, and we will each follow the stubbornness of his evil heart.’”

hausa: Zan sa musu makiyaya guda, bawana Dawuda, zai kuwa lura da su; zai kula da su ya kuma zama makiyayinsu.
english: I will set up one shepherd over them, and he will feed them, even my servant David. He will feed them, and he will be their shepherd.

hausa: Ya sāke ce musu, sau na uku, “Don me? Wane laifi wannan mutum ya yi? Ni dai ban same shi da wani dalilin da ya isa a kashe shi ba. Saboda haka, zan sa a hore shi, sa’an nan in sāke shi.”
english: He said to them the third time, “Why? What evil has this man done? I have found no capital crime in him. I will therefore chastise him and release him.”

hausa: Sai Adoni-Bezek ya gudu, amma suka bi shi suka kama shi, suka yayyanka manyan yatsotsinsa na hannu da na ƙafa.
english: But Adoni-Bezek fled. They pursued him, caught him, and cut off his thumbs and his big toes.

hausa: Ta haka Yonatan ya kira Dawuda ya gaya masa dukan maganarsu. Ya kawo shi wurin Shawulu, Dawuda kuwa ya zauna tare da Shawulu kamar dā.
english: Jonathan called David, and Jonathan showed him all those things. Then Jonathan brought David to Saul, and he was in his presence as before.

hausa: Gaba ɗaya dai, Enosh ya yi shekaru 905, sa’an nan ya mutu.
english: All of the days of Enosh were nine hundred five years, then he died.

hausa: Ba zan take alkawarina ba ko in canja abin da leɓunana suka ambata.
english: I will not break my covenant, nor alter what my lips have uttered.

hausa: sarkin Taffuwa, ɗaya sarkin Hefer, ɗaya
english: the king of Tappuah, one; the king of Hepher, one;

hausa: Da tana mutuwa, matan da suke lura da ita suka ce, “Kada ki karaya kin haifi ɗa namiji.” Amma ba tă ba da amsa ko tă kula ba.
english: About the time of her death the women who stood by her said to her, “Don’t be afraid, for you have given birth to a son.” But she didn’t answer, neither did she regard it.

hausa: Razana da rami da tarko suna jiranku, Ya mutanen duniya.
english: Fear, the pit, and the snare are on you who inhabit the earth.

hausa: Yanzu ni, Nebukadnezzar, ina yabon Sarkin sama, ina waƙa ina kuma darjanta shi, saboda dukan abin da ya yi mini, mai kyau ne kuma dukan hanyoyinsa gaskiya ne. Kuma duk masu tafiya da girman kai zai ƙasƙantar da su.
english: Now I, Nebuchadnezzar, praise and extol and honor the King of heaven; for all his works are truth, and his ways justice; and those who walk in pride he is able to abase.

hausa: Akwai katanga wadda take waje, wadda ta yi hannun riga da ɗakunan filin waje; ta miƙe a gaban ɗakunan, tsawonta kamu hamsin ne.
english: The wall that was outside by the side of the rooms, toward the outer court before the rooms, was fifty cubits long.

hausa: Ubangiji nagari ne, mafaka kuma a lokacin wahala. Yana kula da waɗanda suka dogara gare shi,
english: Yahweh is good, a stronghold in the day of trouble; and he knows those who take refuge in him.

hausa: Waɗannan kuma su ne kabilan Lawiyawa, kabilar Libniyawa, kabilar Hebronawa, kabilar Maliyawa, kabilar Mushiyawa, kabilar Korayawa (Kohat shi ne kakan Amram;
english: These are the families of Levi: the family of the Libnites, the family of the Hebronites, the family of the Mahlites, the family of the Mushites, and the family of the Korahites. Kohath became the father of Amram.

hausa: Sa’ad da na je Urushalima, manyan firistoci da dattawan Yahudawa suka kawo ƙara game da shi suka kuma nema a hukunta shi.
english: about whom, when I was at Jerusalem, the chief priests and the elders of the Jews informed me, asking for a sentence against him.

hausa: Suka sami wani mutumin Masar a fili suka kawo shi wurin Dawuda. Suka ba shi abinci ya ci, suka kuma ba shi ruwa ya sha.
english: They found an Egyptian in the field, and brought him to David, and gave him bread, and he ate; and they gave him water to drink.

hausa: Bayansu kuma, sai ga waɗansu shanu bakwai suka fito ƙanjamammu, munana, ramammu. Ban taɓa ganin irin munanan shanu haka a cikin dukan ƙasar Masar ba.
english: and behold, seven other cattle came up after them, poor and very ugly and thin, such as I never saw in all the land of Egypt for ugliness.

hausa: Sa’an nan fatar jikinsa za tă zama sabuwa kamar ta jariri; za tă zama kamar lokacin da yake matashi.
english: His flesh will be fresher than a child’s. He returns to the days of his youth.

hausa: Ta haka za su dogara ga Allah ba kuwa za su manta da ayyukansa ba amma za su kiyaye umarnansa.
english: that they might set their hope in God, and not forget God’s deeds, but keep his commandments,

hausa: Saboda haka ka yi wa kanka jirgi da katakon Saifires, ka yi ɗakuna a cikinsa, ka shafe shi da ƙaro ciki da waje.
english: Make a ship of gopher wood. You shall make rooms in the ship, and shall seal it inside and outside with pitch.

hausa: Sandar mulkin mugaye ba zai ci gaba da kasance a kan ƙasar da take rabon adalai ba, domin kada masu adalci su yi amfani da hannuwansu su aikata mugunta.
english: For the scepter of wickedness won’t remain over the allotment of the righteous, so that the righteous won’t use their hands to do evil.

hausa: “ ‘Ga abin da Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka yana cewa, “ ‘Da taron jama’a masu yawa zan jefa abin kamun kifi a kanka, za su kuwa jawo ka da abin kamun kifi.
english: The Lord Yahweh says: “I will spread out my net on you with a company of many peoples. They will bring you up in my net.

hausa: Sai Lawiyawa suka ɗauki akwatin alkawarin Allah da sanduna a kafaɗunsu, kamar yadda Musa ya umarta bisa ga maganar Ubangiji.
english: The children of the Levites bore God’s ark on their shoulders with its poles, as Moses commanded according to Yahweh’s word.

hausa: Yusuf ya tafi yă faɗa wa Fir’auna, “Mahaifina da ’yan’uwana, tare da garkunansu da shanunsu da kome da suke da shi, sun zo daga ƙasar Kan’ana, suna kuwa a Goshen yanzu.”
english: Then Joseph went in and told Pharaoh, and said, “My father and my brothers, with their flocks, their herds, and all that they own, have come out of the land of Canaan; and behold, they are in the land of Goshen.”

hausa: Da zuwansa, sai ya miƙe zuwa wurin Yesu ya ce, “Gaisuwa, Rabbi!” Sa’an nan ya yi masa sumba.
english: Immediately he came to Jesus, and said, “Greetings, Rabbi!” and kissed him.

hausa: ya kuma kawo bunsuru ɗaya domin hadaya don zunubi;
english: one male goat for a sin offering;

hausa: Ya kuma kashe wani mutumin Masar mai tsayi ƙafa bakwai da rabi. Ko da yake mutumin Masar yana da māshi kamar sandan masaƙa a hannunsa, Benahiya ya yaƙe shi da kulki. Ya ƙwace māshin daga hannun mutumin Masar ya kuma kashe shi da māshin nan nasa.
english: He killed an Egyptian, a man of great stature, five cubits high. In the Egyptian’s hand was a spear like a weaver’s beam; and he went down to him with a staff, plucked the spear out of the Egyptian’s hand, and killed him with his own spear.

hausa: Kun kuma ce, ‘Mun gaji da irin wannan wahala!’ Kuna hura mini hancin reni,” in ji Ubangiji Maɗaukaki. “Sa’ad da kuka kawo raunannu, gurguntattun dabbobi, ko kuma dabbobi masu fama da cuta, kuka kuma miƙa su hadaya, kuna gani zan karɓi wannan daga gare ku?” In ji Ubangiji.
english: You say also, ‘Behold, what a weariness it is!’ And you have sniffed at it”, says Yahweh of Armies; “and you have brought that which was taken by violence, the lame, and the sick; thus you bring the offering. Should I accept this at your hand?” says Yahweh.

hausa: Daga garin alkama mai laushi marar yisti kuwa, ka yi burodi, da wainan da aka kwaɓa da mai, da ƙosai waɗanda an barbaɗa mai a kai.
english: unleavened bread, unleavened cakes mixed with oil, and unleavened wafers anointed with oil. You shall make them of fine wheat flour.

hausa: Albarkar Ubangiji kan kawo wadata, ba ya kuma ƙara wahala a kai.
english: Yahweh’s blessing brings wealth, and he adds no trouble to it.

hausa: A miƙa rago ɗaya da safe, ɗaya kuma da yamma,
english: You shall offer the one lamb in the morning, and you shall offer the other lamb at evening,

hausa: Da mutanen tsibirin suka ga macijin yana lilo a hannunsa, sai suka ce wa juna “Lalle, wannan mutum mai kisankai ne; gama ko da yake ya tsira daga teku, Adalci bai bar shi ya rayu ba.”
english: When the natives saw the creature hanging from his hand, they said to one another, “No doubt this man is a murderer, whom, though he has escaped from the sea, yet Justice has not allowed to live.”

hausa: inda kakanninku suka gwada ni, suka kuma gwada ni, ko da yake a cikin shekaru arba’in sun ga abin da na yi.
english: where your fathers tested me and tried me, and saw my deeds for forty years.

hausa: “ ‘Amma majalisa za tă yi zama, za a karɓe ikonsa, a kuma hallaka shi gaba ɗaya har abada.
english: “‘But the judgment will be set, and they will take away his dominion, to consume and to destroy it to the end.

hausa: Sai fa aka faɗa wa gidan Dawuda cewa, “Aram ya haɗa kansa da Efraim”; saboda haka zuciyar Ahaz da ta mutanensa suka firgita, sai ka ce itatuwa a kurmin da iska ta girgiza.
english: David’s house was told, “Syria is allied with Ephraim.” His heart trembled, and the heart of his people, as the trees of the forest tremble with the wind.

hausa: To, dole mai kula da Ikkilisiya yă kasance marar abin zargi, mijin mace guda, mai sauƙinkai, mai kamunkai, wanda ake girmama, mai karɓan baƙi, mai iya koyarwa,
english: The overseer therefore must be without reproach, the husband of one wife, temperate, sensible, modest, hospitable, good at teaching;

hausa: Inuwa ta rufe ta da ƙaddaji, itatuwan wardi na rafi, sun kewaye ta.
english: The lotuses cover him with their shade. The willows of the brook surround him.

hausa: Sa’an nan Shawulu ya ci Amalekawa da yaƙi tun daga Hawila har zuwa Shur, a gabashin iyakar Masar.
english: Saul struck the Amalekites, from Havilah as you go to Shur, which is before Egypt.

hausa: “Ka duba ka gani yanzu. Wane marar laifi ne ya taɓa hallaka? Ko an taɓa hallaka masu adalci?
english: “Remember, now, who ever perished, being innocent? Or where were the upright cut off?

hausa: Duk da wannan duka, Yahuda ’yar’uwarta rashin amincin ba tă komo gare ni da dukan zuciyarta ba, sai a munafunce,” in ji Ubangiji.
english: Yet for all this her treacherous sister, Judah, has not returned to me with her whole heart, but only in pretense,” says Yahweh.

hausa: A kwanakin Yohiyakim, waɗannan su ne shugabannin iyalan firistoci, na iyalin Serahiya, Merahiya; na iyalin Irmiya, Hananiya;
english: In the days of Joiakim were priests, heads of fathers’ households: of Seraiah, Meraiah; of Jeremiah, Hananiah;

hausa: Dukan raina zai ce, “Wane ne kamar ka, ya Ubangiji? Ka kuɓutar da matalauta daga waɗanda suka fi ƙarfinsu, matalauta da masu bukata daga waɗanda suke musu fashi.”
english: All my bones shall say, “Yahweh, who is like you, who delivers the poor from him who is too strong for him; yes, the poor and the needy from him who robs him?”

hausa: Hatak ya koma ya ba wa Esta rahoton abin da Mordekai ya faɗa.
english: Hathach came and told Esther the words of Mordecai.

hausa: Saboda haka bari duk mai tsoron Allah yă yi addu’a gare ka yayinda kake samuwa; tabbatacce sa’ad da manyan ruwaye suka taso, ba za su kai wurinsa ba.
english: For this, let everyone who is godly pray to you in a time when you may be found. Surely when the great waters overflow, they shall not reach to him.

hausa: A wannan rana za ku ce, “Zan yabe ka, ya Ubangiji. Ko da yake a dā ka yi fushi da ni, amma yanzu ka daina fushi da ni ka kuwa ta’azantar da ni.
english: In that day you will say, “I will give thanks to you, Yahweh; for though you were angry with me, your anger has turned away and you comfort me.

hausa: A dā Allah ya kawar da Allah ya kawar da kai ga zamanin jahilci, amma yanzu ya umarci dukan mutane a ko’ina su tuba.
english: The times of ignorance therefore God overlooked. But now he commands that all people everywhere should repent,

hausa: Na ce masa, “Ku da kayan nan tsarkaka ne ga Ubangiji. Azurfa da zinariya ɗin, bayarwa ce ta yardar rai ga Ubangiji, Allah na kakanninku.
english: I said to them, “You are holy to Yahweh, and the vessels are holy. The silver and the gold are a free will offering to Yahweh, the God of your fathers.

hausa: Amma dole ku miƙa zukatanku ga Ubangiji Allahnmu, don ku rayu, ta wurin bin ƙa’idodinsa, ku kuma yi biyayya da umarnansa, kamar yadda kuke yi a wannan lokaci.”
english: “Let your heart therefore be perfect with Yahweh our God, to walk in his statutes, and to keep his commandments, as it is today.”

hausa: yadda Ubangiji ya umarce shi, ta wurin Musa. Wannan ya zama abin tuni ga Isra’ilawa domin kada wani da ba firist ba, bai kuwa fito a cikin zuriyar Haruna ba, yă zo don yă ƙona turare a gaban Ubangiji, domin kada yă zama kamar Kora da mabiyansa.
english: to be a memorial to the children of Israel, to the end that no stranger who isn’t of the offspring of Aaron, would come near to burn incense before Yahweh, that he not be as Korah and as his company; as Yahweh spoke to him by Moses.

hausa: Sauran itatuwan jejinsa kuma za su ragu ko ɗan ƙaramin yaro ma zai iya ƙidaya su.
english: The remnant of the trees of his forest shall be few, so that a child could write their number.

hausa: Ba za a kashe ta ba dare da rana; hayaƙinta za tă yi ta tashi har abada. Daga tsara zuwa tsara za tă zama kango; babu wani da zai ƙara wucewa ta wurin.
english: It won’t be quenched night or day. Its smoke will go up forever. From generation to generation, it will lie waste. No one will pass through it forever and ever.

hausa: Sa’ad da suka ji haka, ba su ƙara yin faɗa ba, suka kuma ɗaukaka Allah, suna cewa, “To, fa, har Al’ummai ma Allah ya sa suka tuba zuwa rai.”
english: When they heard these things, they held their peace and glorified God, saying, “Then God has also granted to the Gentiles repentance to life!”

hausa: Bisa ga umarnin Ubangiji, Musa ya rubuta wuraren tafiye-tafiyensu da sansaninsu. Ga yadda tafiye-tafiyen suka kasance.
english: Moses wrote the starting points of their journeys by the commandment of Yahweh. These are their journeys according to their starting points.

hausa: “ ‘Karɓi talentin daga hannunsa ku ba wanda yake da talenti goma.
english: Take away therefore the talent from him and give it to him who has the ten talents.
