hausa: Ku ba wa Ubangiji, ya iyalan al’ummai ku ba wa Ubangiji ɗaukaka da kuma ƙarfi.
english: Ascribe to Yahweh, you families of nations, ascribe to Yahweh glory and strength.

hausa: Amma waɗannan mutane suna yin saɓo a kan abubuwan da ba su fahimta ba. Suna kama da dabbobi marasa hankali, halittun da suke bin abin da jikinsu ya faɗa musu kawai, waɗanda aka haifa don a kama a hallaka, kuma kamar dabbobi su ma za su hallaka.
english: But these, as unreasoning creatures, born natural animals to be taken and destroyed, speaking evil in matters about which they are ignorant, will in their destroying surely be destroyed,

hausa: Ya amsa ya ce, “Ashe, ba ku taɓa karanta abin da Dawuda ya yi ba, sa’ad da shi da abokan tafiyarsa suka ji yunwa, suna kuma cikin bukata?
english: He said to them, “Did you never read what David did when he had need and was hungry—he, and those who were with him?

hausa: Da kalmomin rarrashi ta sa ya kauce; ta ɗauki hankalinsa da sulɓin maganarta.
english: With persuasive words, she led him astray. With the flattering of her lips, she seduced him.

hausa: Yakan sare kowane reshe a cikina da ba ya ’ya’ya, amma yakan ƙundume kowane reshe da yake ba da ’ya’ya, domin yă ƙara ba da ’ya’ya.
english: Every branch in me that doesn’t bear fruit, he takes away. Every branch that bears fruit, he prunes, that it may bear more fruit.

hausa: (Bezalel ɗan Uri, ɗan Hur, na kabilar Yahuda, ya yi dukan abin da Ubangiji ya umarci Musa;
english: Bezalel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah, made all that Yahweh commanded Moses.

hausa: Kuna ce wa itace, ‘Kai ne mahaifina,’ ga dutse kuma, ‘Kai ne ka haife ni.’ Sun juye mini bayansu ba fuskokinsu ba; duk da haka sa’ad da suna cikin wahala, sukan ce, ‘Zo ka cece mu!’
english: who tell wood, ‘You are my father,’ and a stone, ‘You have given birth to me,’ for they have turned their back to me, and not their face, but in the time of their trouble they will say, ‘Arise, and save us!’

hausa: Sa’an nan Yahuda ya ce wa Onan, “Ka kwana da matar ɗan’uwanka ka cika wajibinka gare ta a matsayin ɗan’uwan miji, don ka samar wa ɗan’uwanka ’ya’ya.”
english: Judah said to Onan, “Go in to your brother’s wife, and perform the duty of a husband’s brother to her, and raise up offspring for your brother.”

hausa: Gaskiya nake gaya muku, lokaci yana zuwa har ma ya riga ya zo sa’ad da matattu za su ji muryar Ɗan Allah waɗanda kuwa suka ji za su rayu.
english: Most certainly I tell you, the hour comes, and now is, when the dead will hear the Son of God’s voice; and those who hear will live.

hausa: Na Bakwai, don wata na bakwai, shi ne Helez mutumin Felon, mutumin Efraim. Akwai mutane 24,000 a sashensa.
english: The seventh captain for the seventh month was Helez the Pelonite, of the children of Ephraim. In his division were twenty-four thousand.

hausa: Sai Ubangiji ya sauko don yă ga birni da kuma hasumiyar da mutanen suke gini.
english: Yahweh came down to see the city and the tower, which the children of men built.

hausa: Duk da haka Ubangiji yana marmari ya yi muku alheri; ya tashi don yă nuna muku jinƙai. Gama Ubangiji Allah ne mai aikata gaskiya. Masu albarka ne dukanku waɗanda suke dogara gare shi!
english: Therefore Yahweh will wait, that he may be gracious to you; and therefore he will be exalted, that he may have mercy on you, for Yahweh is a God of justice. Blessed are all those who wait for him.

hausa: Da tsawar muryarka, mutane za su gudu; sa’ad da ka tashi, al’ummai za su watse.
english: At the noise of the thunder, the peoples have fled. When you lift yourself up, the nations are scattered.

hausa: Ubangiji ya kuma ce wa Abram, “Ni ne Ubangiji wanda ya fitar da kai daga Ur na Kaldiyawa, domin in ba ka wannan ƙasa ka mallake ta.”
english: He said to Abram, “I am Yahweh who brought you out of Ur of the Chaldees, to give you this land to inherit it.”

hausa: Ta wurin bangaskiya ne mutane suka bi ta cikin Jan Teku, sai ka ce a kan busasshiyar ƙasa; amma da Masarawa suka yi ƙoƙari su yi haka, sai aka nutsar da su.
english: By faith they passed through the Red Sea as on dry land. When the Egyptians tried to do so, they were swallowed up.

hausa: Za ku neme ni ku kuwa same ni sa’ad da kuka neme ni da dukan zuciyarku.
english: You shall seek me and find me, when you search for me with all your heart.

hausa: Amma za ku mutu kamar mutum kurum; za ku fāɗi kamar duk wani mai mulki.”
english: Nevertheless you shall die like men, and fall like one of the rulers.”

hausa: A maimako haka, sai suka kawo waɗansu ’yan maganganu game da addininsu da ba su yarda da shi ba da kuma game da wani Yesu da ya mutu wanda Bulus ya ce yana da rai.
english: but had certain questions against him about their own religion and about one Jesus, who was dead, whom Paul affirmed to be alive.

hausa: Kayan tsari yana ruɗu, kyau kuma kan shuɗe; amma mace mai tsoron Ubangiji abar yabo ce.
english: Charm is deceitful, and beauty is vain; but a woman who fears Yahweh, she shall be praised.

hausa: bagade na tagulla na raga, da sandunansa da kayan aikinsa; da daro da wurin ajiyarsa,
english: the bronze altar, its grating of bronze, its poles, all of its vessels, the basin and its base,

hausa: Har wa yau, ina da tambaya. Shin, Isra’ila ba su fahimta ba ne? Da farko, Musa ya ce, “Zan sa ku yi kishin waɗanda ba al’umma ba; zan sa ku yi fushin al’ummar da ba ta da fahimta.”
english: But I ask, didn’t Israel know? First Moses says, “I will provoke you to jealousy with that which is no nation. I will make you angry with a nation void of understanding.”

hausa: Na ɗaga hannu sama na kuma furta. Muddin ina raye har abada,
english: For I lift up my hand to heaven and declare, as I live forever,

hausa: “Hannuwan Zerubbabel sun kafa harsashin haikalin nan; hannuwansa ne kuma za su gama ginin. Sa’an nan ne za ka san cewa Ubangiji Maɗaukaki ne ya aiko ni zuwa wurinka.
english: “The hands of Zerubbabel have laid the foundation of this house. His hands shall also finish it; and you will know that Yahweh of Armies has sent me to you.

hausa: Amma sa’ad da kake ba wa masu bukata taimako, kada ka yarda hannun hagunka yă ma san abin da hannun damarka yake yi,
english: But when you do merciful deeds, don’t let your left hand know what your right hand does,

hausa: Hafsoshin Sennakerib suka ci gaba da maganar banza wa Ubangiji Allah da kuma a kan bawansa Hezekiya.
english: His servants spoke yet more against Yahweh God and against his servant Hezekiah.

hausa: Za su yi yaƙi da Ɗan Ragon, sai dai Ɗan Ragon zai ci nasara a bisansu domin shi ne Ubangijin iyayengiji, Sarkin sarakuna, tare da shi kuwa kirayayunsa, zaɓaɓɓunsa da kuma amintattu masu binsa za su kasance.”
english: These will war against the Lamb, and the Lamb will overcome them, for he is Lord of lords and King of kings; and those who are with him are called, chosen, and faithful.”

hausa: Ga abin da Ubangiji yana cewa, “Hana muryarki kuka da kuma idanunki hawaye, gama za a sāka wa aikinki,” in ji Ubangiji. “Za su komo daga ƙasar abokin gāba.
english: Yahweh says: “Refrain your voice from weeping, and your eyes from tears, for your work will be rewarded,” says Yahweh. “They will come again from the land of the enemy.

hausa: A wannan lokaci zan tattara ku; a wannan lokaci zan kawo ku gida, zan sa a yabe ku a kuma girmama ku a cikin dukan mutanen duniya a sa’ad da na maido da arzikinku a idanunku,” in ji Ubangiji.
english: At that time I will bring you in, and at that time I will gather you; for I will give you honor and praise among all the peoples of the earth when I restore your fortunes before your eyes, says Yahweh.

hausa: Gama Ubangiji zai sāke gina Sihiyona ya kuma bayyana a ɗaukakarsa.
english: For Yahweh has built up Zion. He has appeared in his glory.

hausa: “Saboda haka ina ba ka shawara, bari a tara maka dukan Isra’ila, daga Dan zuwa Beyersheba da yawansu ya yi kamar yashin bakin teku, kai kanka ka jagorance su zuwa fagen fama.
english: But I counsel that all Israel be gathered together to you, from Dan even to Beersheba, as the sand that is by the sea for multitude; and that you go to battle in your own person.

hausa: Sa’an nan jarumai Isra’ila dubu goma suka yi gaba suka kai wa Gibeya hari. Yaƙi kuwa ya yi zafi har mutane Benyamin ba su san masifa tana dab da su ba.
english: Ten thousand chosen men out of all Israel came over against Gibeah, and the battle was severe; but they didn’t know that disaster was close to them.

hausa: Sa’ad da Yoshuwa ya ji surutun mutane suna ihu, sai ya ce wa Musa, “Kamar akwai ƙarar yaƙi a sansani.”
english: When Joshua heard the noise of the people as they shouted, he said to Moses, “There is the noise of war in the camp.”

hausa: Sai Bitrus ya ce, “Azurfa ko zinariya ba ni da su, amma abin da nake da shi, shi zan ba ka. A cikin sunan Yesu Kiristi Banazare, ka yi tafiya.”
english: But Peter said, “I have no silver or gold, but what I have, that I give you. In the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, get up and walk!”

hausa: “Yanzu, Allahna, bari idanunka su buɗu kunnuwanka kuma su saurara ga addu’o’in da ake miƙa a wannan wuri.
english: “Now, my God, let, I beg you, your eyes be open, and let your ears be attentive to the prayer that is made in this place.

hausa: Bayan abubuwan nan suka faru, sai Allah ya gwada Ibrahim. Ya ce masa, “Ibrahim!” Ibrahim ya amsa ya ce, “Ga ni.”
english: After these things, God tested Abraham, and said to him, “Abraham!” He said, “Here I am.”

hausa: Hakkin adalai kan kawo musu rai, amma albashin mugaye kan kawo musu hukunci.
english: The labor of the righteous leads to life. The increase of the wicked leads to sin.

hausa: Na mutanen Zera su ne, Yewuyel. Mutane daga Yahuda sun kai 690.
english: Of the sons of Zerah: Jeuel and their brothers, six hundred ninety.

hausa: Ta haka Isra’ila suka sa kai a bautar gumaka Ba’al-Feyor. Ubangiji kuwa ya husata da su.
english: Israel joined himself to Baal Peor, and Yahweh’s anger burned against Israel.

hausa: Bisharar da Allah ya yi alkawari tuntuni ta bakin annabawansa a cikin Nassosi Masu Tsarki
english: which he promised before through his prophets in the holy Scriptures,

hausa: Allahna kuma zai biya dukan bukatunku bisa ga ɗaukakar wadatarsa cikin Kiristi Yesu.
english: My God will supply every need of yours according to his riches in glory in Christ Jesus.

hausa: Suka rufe ƙasar har ta zama baƙi. Suka cinye abin da ƙanƙara ta rage, kowane tsiron da yake girma a gonaki, da dukan ’ya’yan itatuwa. Babu ɗanyen abin da ya ragu a kan itatuwa ko tsire-tsire a dukan ƙasar Masar.
english: For they covered the surface of the whole earth, so that the land was darkened, and they ate every herb of the land, and all the fruit of the trees which the hail had left. There remained nothing green, either tree or herb of the field, through all the land of Egypt.

hausa: Ba ku ga wahayin ƙarya kuka kuma faɗa yin duban ƙarya sa’ad da kuka ce, “Ubangiji ya furta,” ko da yake bai yi magana ba?
english: Haven’t you seen a false vision, and haven’t you spoken a lying divination, in that you say, ‘Yahweh says;’ but I have not spoken?”

hausa: Sai aka sāke yin wani yaƙin da Filistiyawa a Gob, Elhanan ɗan Ya’are-Oregim mutumin Betlehem ya kashe Goliyat mutumin Gat, wanda girmar sandan māshinsa ta yi kama da taɓarya.
english: There was again war with the Philistines at Gob, and Elhanan the son of Jaare-Oregim the Bethlehemite killed Goliath the Gittite’s brother, the staff of whose spear was like a weaver’s beam.

hausa: Sa’an nan a cikin al’ummai inda aka kai ku zaman bauta, waɗanda suka a tsere za su tuna da ni, yadda raina ya ɓaci ta wurin zukatansu marasa imani, waɗanda suka rabu da ni, da kuma ta wurin idanunsu, waɗanda suka yi sha’awace-sha’awacen gumakansu. Za su ji ƙyamar kansu saboda mugayen abubuwan da suka aikata.
english: Those of you that escape will remember me among the nations where they are carried captive, how I have been broken with their lewd heart, which has departed from me, and with their eyes, which play the prostitute after their idols. Then they will loathe themselves in their own sight for the evils which they have committed in all their abominations.

hausa: daga zuriyar Uzziyel, Amminadab shugaba da dangi 112.
english: of the sons of Uzziel, Amminadab the chief, and his brothers one hundred twelve.

hausa: yana gaya musu abin da suka yi, cewa sun yi zunubi da girman kai.
english: then he shows them their work, and their transgressions, that they have behaved themselves proudly.

hausa: Yanzu ka bar nan ka tafi gida! Na ce zan sāka maka da lada mai kyau, amma Ubangiji ya hana ka samun ladan.”
english: Therefore, flee to your place, now! I thought to promote you to great honor; but, behold, Yahweh has kept you back from honor.”

hausa: Da suka gama ci, sai Yesu ya ce wa Siman Bitrus, “Siman ɗan Yohanna, kana ƙaunata da gaske fiye da waɗannan?” Ya ce, “I, Ubangiji, ka san cewa ina sonka.” Yesu ya ce, “Ciyar da ’ya’yan tumakina.”
english: So when they had eaten their breakfast, Jesus said to Simon Peter, “Simon, son of Jonah, do you love me more than these?” He said to him, “Yes, Lord; you know that I have affection for you.” He said to him, “Feed my lambs.”

hausa: Ba wanda ya isa yă tsokane ta. Wane ne kuma ya isa yă yi tsayayya da ni?
english: None is so fierce that he dare stir him up. Who then is he who can stand before me?

hausa: Amma saboda Dawuda mahaifinka, ba zan yi haka a zamaninka ba. Zan yage ta daga hannun ɗanka.
english: Nevertheless, I will not do it in your days, for David your father’s sake; but I will tear it out of your son’s hand.

hausa: gama hukuncinsa daidai ne, mai adalci kuma. Ya hukunta babbar karuwan nan wadda ta ɓata duniya da zinace zinacenta. Ya rama jinin bayinsa a kanta.”
english: for his judgments are true and righteous. For he has judged the great prostitute who corrupted the earth with her sexual immorality, and he has avenged the blood of his servants at her hand.”

hausa: Ya sa wa Haruna taguwa, ya ɗaura igiya kewaye da shi, ya sa masa riga, ya sa masa efod. Ya kuma ɗaura masa efod wanda aka yi masa saƙar gwaninta.
english: He put the tunic on him, tied the sash on him, clothed him with the robe, put the ephod on him, and he tied the skillfully woven band of the ephod on him and fastened it to him with it.

hausa: Ko kuma kana rena wadatar alherinsa, haƙurinsa, da kuma jimrewarsa ne ba tare da sanin cewa alherin Allah yana kai ka ga tuba ba ne?
english: Or do you despise the riches of his goodness, forbearance, and patience, not knowing that the goodness of God leads you to repentance?

hausa: Sa’ad da manzannin suka komo wurin Yaƙub, suka ce, “Mun tafi wurin ɗan’uwanka Isuwa, yanzu kuwa yana zuwa ya sadu da kai, da kuma mutum ɗari huɗu tare da shi.”
english: The messengers returned to Jacob, saying, “We came to your brother Esau. He is coming to meet you, and four hundred men are with him.”

hausa: Sai mutanen Edom suka sāke amsa suka ce, “Ba za ku bi nan ba dai.” Sai Edom ya fito da runduna mai ƙarfi da yawa gaske a kan Isra’ila.
english: He said, “You shall not pass through.” Edom came out against him with many people, and with a strong hand.

hausa: Ya gamshi Dariyus ya naɗa muƙaddasai 120 su yi shugabanci a duk fāɗin masarautar,
english: It pleased Darius to set over the kingdom one hundred twenty local governors, who should be throughout the whole kingdom;

hausa: Manyan Isra’ilawa da suke bi da aikin gandu suka gane cewa sun shiga uku, sa’ad da aka gaya musu, “Ba za ku rage yawan tubulan da aka bukace ku ku yi na kowace rana ba.”
english: The officers of the children of Israel saw that they were in trouble when it was said, “You shall not diminish anything from your daily quota of bricks!”

hausa: Amma in ba ka miƙa wuya ga hafsoshin sarkin Babilon ba, za a ba da wannan birni ga Babiloniyawa za su kuma cinna mata wuta; kai kanka ba za ka tsira daga hannuwansu ba.’ ”
english: But if you will not go out to the king of Babylon’s princes, then this city will be given into the hand of the Chaldeans, and they will burn it with fire, and you won’t escape out of their hand.’”

hausa: Sa’an nan mutanen Isra’ila suka juyo musu, mutanen Benyamin kuwa suka tsorata domin sun gane masifa ta zo musu.
english: The men of Israel turned, and the men of Benjamin were dismayed; for they saw that disaster had come on them.

hausa: Sarkin Assuriya ya kai wa ƙasar Hosheya gaba ɗaya farmaki, ya kewaye Samariya na tsawon shekara uku.
english: Then the king of Assyria came up throughout all the land, went up to Samaria, and besieged it three years.

hausa: Ga wannan zancen Yohanna ya amsa ya ce, “Mutum yakan karɓi kawai abin da aka ba shi ne daga sama.
english: John answered, “A man can receive nothing unless it has been given him from heaven.

hausa: Za ku naɗa rawunanku a kai ku sa takalmanku a ƙafafunku. Ba za ku yi kuka ko makoki ba amma za ku lalace saboda zunubanku ku kuma yi ta yin nishi.
english: Your turbans will be on your heads, and your sandals on your feet. You won’t mourn or weep; but you will pine away in your iniquities, and moan one toward another.

hausa: Sojojin Babilon sun daina yaƙi, suna zaune a cikin kagaransu. Ƙarfinsu ya ƙare, sun zama mata. An sa wa wuraren zamanta wuta, an karya ƙyamaren ƙofofin garinta.
english: The mighty men of Babylon have stopped fighting, they remain in their strongholds. Their might has failed. They have become as women. Her dwelling places are set on fire. Her bars are broken.

hausa: Yabi Ubangiji. Yabi Ubangiji, ya raina.
english: Praise Yah! Praise Yahweh, my soul.

hausa: Bayan Bikin, da iyayen suka kama hanya don su koma gida, sai Yesu, yaron nan, ya tsaya a Urushalima, ba da saninsu ba.
english: and when they had fulfilled the days, as they were returning, the boy Jesus stayed behind in Jerusalem. Joseph and his mother didn’t know it,

hausa: “Ka tafi, ka tattara dukan Yahudawan da suke Shusha, ku yi azumi saboda ni. Kada ku ci ko ku sha, dare da rana har kwana uku. Ni kuwa da bayina za mu yi azumi yadda kuke yi. Idan aka yi haka, zan tafi wurin sarki, ko da yake wannan karya doka ce. Idan na hallaka, to, na hallaka.”
english: “Go, gather together all the Jews who are present in Susa, and fast for me, and neither eat nor drink three days, night or day. I and my maidens will also fast the same way. Then I will go in to the king, which is against the law; and if I perish, I perish.”

hausa: Suka yashe Ubangiji Allah na kakanninsu, wanda ya fitar da su daga Masar. Suka bi suka kuma bauta alloli dabam-dabam na mutanen da suke kewaye da su. Suka tsokani Ubangiji ya yi fushi
english: They abandoned Yahweh, the God of their fathers, who brought them out of the land of Egypt, and followed other gods, of the gods of the peoples who were around them, and bowed themselves down to them; and they provoked Yahweh to anger.

hausa: Sa’ad da mugu ya mutu, sa zuciyarsa kan hallaka; dukan abin da ya sa zuciya daga ikonsa ba ya amfana kome.
english: When a wicked man dies, hope perishes, and expectation of power comes to nothing.

hausa: Sai Yesu ya ce musu, “Haske zai kasance da ku na ɗan lokaci. Ku yi tafiya yayinda hasken yana nan tare da ku, kada duhu yă cim muku. Mai tafiya a cikin duhu bai san inda za shi ba.
english: Jesus therefore said to them, “Yet a little while the light is with you. Walk while you have the light, that darkness doesn’t overtake you. He who walks in the darkness doesn’t know where he is going.

hausa: Amma wa zai jure wa ranar zuwansa? Wa zai iya tsaya sa’ad da ya bayyana? Gama zai zama kamar wuta mai tace ƙarfe, ko sabulu mai wanki.
english: “But who can endure the day of his coming? And who will stand when he appears? For he is like a refiner’s fire, and like launderers’ soap;

hausa: Za su zo su yi sowa don farin ciki a ƙwanƙolin Sihiyona; za su yi farin ciki cikin yalwar Ubangiji hatsi, sabon ruwan inabi da mai, ’ya’yan garken tumaki da na shanu. Za su zama kamar gonar da aka yi wa banruwa, ba za su ƙara yin baƙin ciki ba.
english: They will come and sing in the height of Zion, and will flow to the goodness of Yahweh, to the grain, to the new wine, to the oil, and to the young of the flock and of the herd. Their soul will be as a watered garden. They will not sorrow any more at all.

hausa: “Amma kada a kira ku ‘Rabbi,’ gama kuna da Maigida ɗaya ne, ku duka kuwa, ’yan’uwa ne.
english: But you are not to be called ‘Rabbi’, for one is your teacher, the Christ, and all of you are brothers.

hausa: Daga Teba da Kun, garuruwan da suke ƙarƙashin Hadadezer, Dawuda ya kwashe tagulla da yawa sosai, wanda Solomon ya yi amfani don yă yi Tekun tagulla, ginshiƙai da kuma kayayyakin tagulla dabam-dabam.
english: From Tibhath and from Cun, cities of Hadadezer, David took very much bronze, with which Solomon made the bronze sea, the pillars, and the vessels of bronze.

hausa: Sa’an nan ka sa wa Haruna tsarkakun riguna, ka shafe shi, ka kuma keɓe shi don yă yi mini hidima a matsayin firist.
english: You shall put on Aaron the holy garments; and you shall anoint him, and sanctify him, that he may minister to me in the priest’s office.

hausa: “Yanzu kuma me nake da shi a nan?” In ji Ubangiji. “Gama an kwashe mutanena ba a bakin kome ba kuma waɗanda suka mallake su sun yi musu ba’a, Kullum ana cin gaba da yin wa sunana saɓo.
english: “Now therefore, what do I do here,” says Yahweh, “seeing that my people are taken away for nothing? Those who rule over them mock,” says Yahweh, “and my name is blasphemed continually all day long.

hausa: Musa ya tuɓe taguwar Haruna, ya kuma sa wa Eleyazar ɗan Haruna. Nan kuwa Haruna ya mutu a bisa dutsen. Sa’an nan Musa da Eleyazar suka sauka daga dutsen,
english: Moses stripped Aaron of his garments, and put them on Eleazar his son. Aaron died there on the top of the mountain, and Moses and Eleazar came down from the mountain.

hausa: Kuma bisa ga wannan nufi, aka mai da mu masu tsarki ta wurin miƙa hadayar jikin Yesu Kiristi sau ɗaya tak.
english: by which will we have been sanctified through the offering of the body of Jesus Christ once for all.

hausa: Kada ka bar maƙaryatan nan, su yi farin ciki a kaina; kada ka bar waɗanda suke ƙina ba dalili, su ji daɗin baƙin cikina.
english: Don’t let those who are my enemies wrongfully rejoice over me; neither let those who hate me without a cause wink their eyes.

hausa: Ya amsa ya ce, “Sanin asirin mulkin sama kam, ku aka ba wa, amma su ba a ba su ba.
english: He answered them, “To you it is given to know the mysteries of the Kingdom of Heaven, but it is not given to them.

hausa: ’Ya’yan Shemer maza su ne, Ahi, Roga, Yehubba da Aram.
english: The sons of Shemer: Ahi, Rohgah, Jehubbah, and Aram.

hausa: Da Bulus ya ɗibiya musu hannuwansa, sai Ruhu Mai Tsarki ya sauka musu, suka kuwa yi magana da harsuna, suka kuma yi annabci.
english: When Paul had laid his hands on them, the Holy Spirit came on them and they spoke with other languages and prophesied.

hausa: Menahem ya tara kuɗin ne ta hanyar haraji a Isra’ila inda ya sa kowane attajiri ya ba da shekel hamsin don a ba sarkin Assuriya. Sa’an nan sarkin Assuriya ya janye, bai ƙara kasance a ƙasar ba.
english: Menahem exacted the money from Israel, even from all the mighty men of wealth, from each man fifty shekels of silver, to give to the king of Assyria. So the king of Assyria turned back, and didn’t stay there in the land.

hausa: “Ku tabbata cewa ba a kawar da zuriyar Kohatawa daga Lawiyawa ba.
english: “Don’t cut off the tribe of the families of the Kohathites from among the Levites;

hausa: Duba, na mai da shi shaida ga mutane, shugaba da kuma jagorar mutane.
english: Behold, I have given him for a witness to the peoples, a leader and commander to the peoples.

hausa: Kada wata ƙazamar magana ta fita daga bakunanku, sai dai abin da yake da amfani don gina waɗansu bisa ga bukatunsu. Ta haka maganarku za tă zama da amfani ga masu jinta.
english: Let no corrupt speech proceed out of your mouth, but only what is good for building others up as the need may be, that it may give grace to those who hear.

hausa: Ya tambaye su, “Don me kuke barci? Ku tashi ku yi addu’a, don kada ku fāɗi cikin jarraba.”
english: and said to them, “Why do you sleep? Rise and pray that you may not enter into temptation.”

hausa: In hannunka yana sa ka yin zunubi, yanke shi. Ai, gwamma ka shiga rai da hannu ɗaya, da ka shiga jahannama ta wuta, inda ba a iya kashe wutar ba, da hannuwanka biyu.
english: If your hand causes you to stumble, cut it off. It is better for you to enter into life maimed, rather than having your two hands to go into Gehenna, into the unquenchable fire,

hausa: Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka ne zai taimake ni. Wane ne zai iya tabbatar da ni mai laifi? Duk za su koɗe kamar riga; asu za su cinye su.
english: Behold, the Lord Yahweh will help me! Who is he who will condemn me? Behold, they will all grow old like a garment. The moths will eat them up.

hausa: waɗannan annabawan Isra’ila waɗanda suka yi annabci wa Urushalima suka kuma ga mata wahayin salama sa’ad da ba salama, in ji Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka.” ’
english: to wit, the prophets of Israel who prophesy concerning Jerusalem, and who see visions of peace for her, and there is no peace,’” says the Lord Yahweh.’”

hausa: Ko da jijiyoyin itacen sun tsufa a cikin ƙasa kuma kututturensa ya mutu a cikin ƙasa.
english: Though its root grows old in the earth, and its stock dies in the ground,

hausa: Ba zan bar ku marayu ba; zan zo wurinku.
english: I will not leave you orphans. I will come to you.

hausa: Ƙafafunsa sun kai shi cikin raga, yana ta yawo a cikin ragar.
english: For he is cast into a net by his own feet, and he wanders into its mesh.

hausa: Ba wani abu kamar ta a duniya, halitta marar tsoro.
english: On earth there is not his equal, that is made without fear.

hausa: “Amma yanzu, Ayuba, ka saurari abin da zan ce; ka sa hankali ga kowane abin da zan faɗa.
english: “However, Job, please hear my speech, and listen to all my words.

hausa: ya yi kwanon da ya kira Teku, da bijimai goma sha biyu a ƙarƙashinsa;
english: the one sea; the twelve oxen under the sea;

hausa: “Ku nisanci wannan taro, gama yanzu nan zan hallaka su.” Sai Musa da Haruna suka fāɗi rubda ciki.
english: “Get away from among this congregation, that I may consume them in a moment!” They fell on their faces.

hausa: Amma ya ce mini, “Kada ka yi haka! Ni abokin bautarku ne, kai da ’yan’uwanka annabawa, da kuma waɗanda suke kiyaye kalmomin wannan littafi. Allah za ka yi wa sujada!”
english: He said to me, “You must not do that! I am a fellow bondservant with you and with your brothers, the prophets, and with those who keep the words of this book. Worship God.”

hausa: Gama burodin Allah shi ne wanda yake saukowa daga sama, yana kuma ba wa duniya rai.”
english: For the bread of God is that which comes down out of heaven and gives life to the world.”

hausa: Duk wanda ya shuka mugunta yakan girbe wahala, za a kuma hallaka sandar fushinsa.
english: He who sows wickedness reaps trouble, and the rod of his fury will be destroyed.

hausa: Suka kāsa nuna alheri ga gidan Yerub-Ba’al (wato, Gideyon) saboda abubuwa masu alherin da ya yi musu.
english: neither did they show kindness to the house of Jerubbaal, that is, Gideon, according to all the goodness which he had shown to Israel.

hausa: Sai suka tafi, suka kuma iske kome kamar yadda Yesu ya faɗa musu. Sai suka shirya Bikin Ƙetarewa.
english: They went, found things as Jesus had told them, and they prepared the Passover.

hausa: Yabi Ubangiji, ya raina, kada kuma ka manta dukan alheransa,
english: Praise Yahweh, my soul, and don’t forget all his benefits,

hausa: Wata rana Dawuda ya yi tambaya ya ce, “Akwai wani har yanzu da ya rage a gidan Shawulu wanda zan nuna masa alheri saboda Yonatan?”
english: David said, “Is there yet any who is left of Saul’s house, that I may show him kindness for Jonathan’s sake?”

hausa: “Amma kada wani mutum yă kawo tuhuma, kada wani mutum yă zargi wani, gama mutanenka suna kama da waɗanda suke kawo tuhume-tuhume a kan firist ne.
english: “Yet let no man bring a charge, neither let any man accuse; for your people are like those who bring charges against a priest.

hausa: Ishaku ya rayu shekaru ɗari da tamanin,
english: The days of Isaac were one hundred eighty years.

hausa: Na kuwa shiga na duba, sai na ga zāne-zāne ko’ina a bangon na kowane irin abubuwa masu rarrafe da kuma dabbobi masu ƙazanta da dukan gumakan gidan Isra’ila.
english: So I went in and looked, and saw every form of creeping things, abominable animals, and all the idols of the house of Israel, portrayed around on the wall.

hausa: Kamar ɗaura dutse a majajjawa haka yake da girmama wawa.
english: As one who binds a stone in a sling, so is he who gives honor to a fool.

hausa: A kan haka, shugabannin nan uku da muƙaddasan nan suka yi ƙoƙari su sami wani laifi a kan Daniyel a yadda yake tafiyar da aikin shugabancinsa, amma ba su samu ba. Ba su same shi da wani laifin cin hanci ba, domin shi amintacce ne kuma babu wani aibi a kansa ko rashin kula.
english: Then the presidents and the local governors sought to find occasion against Daniel as touching the kingdom; but they could find no occasion or fault, because he was faithful. There wasn’t any error or fault found in him.

hausa: A ƙarshen yini arba’in da dare arba’in ɗin, Ubangiji ya ba ni alluna biyu na dutse, allunan alkawari.
english: It came to pass at the end of forty days and forty nights that Yahweh gave me the two stone tablets, even the tablets of the covenant.

hausa: Tanajin Solomon na kowace rana su ne, garwa talatin na garin abinci,
english: Solomon’s provision for one day was thirty cors of fine flour, sixty measures of meal,

hausa: Bari wannan ruwa mai jawo la’ana, yă shiga jikinki saboda cikinki yă kumbura, cinyarki kuma yă shanye.” “ ‘Sai macen tă ce, “Amin. Bari yă zama haka.”
english: and this water that brings a curse will go into your bowels, and make your body swell, and your thigh fall away.” The woman shall say, “Amen, Amen.”

hausa: Kwanaki suna zuwa,” in ji Ubangiji, “sa’ad da zan aika da mutanen da za su tuntsurar da tuluna, su kuma zubar da ita waje. Za su bar tulunan ba kome a ciki su kuma farfashe tulunanta.
english: Therefore behold, the days come,” says Yahweh, “that I will send to him those who pour off, and they will pour him off; and they will empty his vessels, and break their containers in pieces.

hausa: Ɗakunan da suke gefe masu hawa uku ne, wani bisa wani, guda talatin a kowane hawa. Akwai katanga kewaye da bangayen haikalin don ta tokare ɗakunan, domin ba a so ɗakunan su jingina da bangon haikalin.
english: The side rooms were in three stories, one over another, and thirty in each story. They entered into the wall which belonged to the house for the side rooms all around, that they might be supported and not penetrate the wall of the house.

hausa: A wannan rana za ku ce, “Yi godiya ga Ubangiji, ku kira bisa sunansa; a sanar da wannan abin da ya aikata a cikin al’ummai, a kuma yi shela cewa sunansa mai girma ne.
english: In that day you will say, “Give thanks to Yahweh! Call on his name! Declare his doings among the peoples! Proclaim that his name is exalted!

hausa: “Sa’ad da suka yi maka zunubi, gama babu wanda ba ya zunubi, ka kuwa yi fushi da su, ka kuma ba da su ga abokin gāba, wanda ya kwashe su kamammu zuwa ƙasarsa, nesa ko kusa;
english: If they sin against you (for there is no man who doesn’t sin), and you are angry with them and deliver them to the enemy, so that they carry them away captive to the land of the enemy, far off or near;

hausa: Rubutaccen tarihin zuriyarsu ya nuna suna da kawunan iyalai da mazan da suka isa yaƙi 20,200.
english: They were listed by genealogy, after their generations, heads of their fathers’ houses, mighty men of valor, twenty thousand two hundred.

hausa: Ƙauna da aminci kan kiyaye sarki lafiya; ta wurin ƙauna sarautarsa za tă zauna a kafe.
english: Love and faithfulness keep the king safe. His throne is sustained by love.

hausa: Dukan masu bi suna tare, suna kuma mallakar kome tare.
english: All who believed were together, and had all things in common.

hausa: Sai Ubangiji ya ce wa Musa, “Dole mutumin yă mutu. Dole dukan taron su jajjefe shi a bayan sansani.”
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “The man shall surely be put to death. All the congregation shall stone him with stones outside of the camp.”

hausa: “Mun kuma ɗauka hakkin kawo nunan fari na hatsinmu da kuma na kowane itace mai ba da ’ya’ya a gidan Ubangiji kowace shekara.
english: and to bring the first fruits of our ground and the first fruits of all fruit of all kinds of trees, year by year, to Yahweh’s house;

hausa: Sai Yesu ya ce, “Ban gaya miki cewa in kin gaskata za ki ga ɗaukakar Allah ba?”
english: Jesus said to her, “Didn’t I tell you that if you believed, you would see God’s glory?”

hausa: Da ganinsu, al’ummai sun kamu da azaba; kowace fuska ta yanƙwane.
english: At their presence the peoples are in anguish. All faces have grown pale.

hausa: Masu binka bashi ba za su taso maka nan da nan ba? Ba za su farka su sa ka fargaba ba? Ta haka ka zama ganima a gare su.
english: Won’t your debtors rise up suddenly, and wake up those who make you tremble, and you will be their victim?

hausa: Za ku iya miƙa hadaya ta yardar rai da maraƙi, ko tunkiya mai naƙasa, ko marar cikakken lafiya, amma ba za tă zama yardajje don cika alkawarin da aka yi ba.
english: Either a bull or a lamb that has any deformity or lacking in his parts, that you may offer for a free will offering; but for a vow it shall not be accepted.

hausa: Ku yi farin ciki, ya ku al’ummai, tare da mutanensa, gama zai rama ɗau fansar jinin bayinsa; zai ɗau fansa a kan abokan gābansa yă kuma yi kafara domin ƙasarsa da mutanensa.
english: Rejoice, you nations, with his people, for he will avenge the blood of his servants. He will take vengeance on his adversaries, and will make atonement for his land and for his people.

hausa: Zai yi gardama da ni da ikonsa mai girma? Babu, ba zai zarge ni da laifi ba.
english: Would he contend with me in the greatness of his power? No, but he would listen to me.

hausa: Sai Yahudawa suka sāke ɗebo duwatsu don su jajjefe shi,
english: Therefore the Jews took up stones again to stone him.

hausa: Amma wanda Allah ya tā da daga matattu bai ruɓa ba.
english: But he whom God raised up saw no decay.

hausa: “ ‘Amma sai suka yi tawaye a kaina ba su kuwa saurare ni ba; ba su zubar da mugayen siffofin da suka kafa idanunsu a kai ba, balle su ƙi gumakan Masar. Saboda haka zan zubo hasalata a kansu in kuma aukar musu da fushina a Masar.
english: “‘“But they rebelled against me and wouldn’t listen to me. They didn’t all throw away the abominations of their eyes. They also didn’t forsake the idols of Egypt. Then I said I would pour out my wrath on them, to accomplish my anger against them in the middle of the land of Egypt.

hausa: Manyan tekuna ne wurin zamanki; maginanki sun sa kyanki ya zama cikakke.
english: Your borders are in the heart of the seas. Your builders have perfected your beauty.

hausa: Sa’ad da ya duba ya ga matafiyin a dandalin birnin, sai tsohon ya yi tambaya ya ce, “Ina za ku? Ina kuka fito?”
english: He lifted up his eyes, and saw the wayfaring man in the street of the city; and the old man said, “Where are you going? Where did you come from?”

hausa: Da wannan sai na fāɗi a gabansa, don in yi masa sujada. Amma ya ce mini, “Kada ka yi haka! Ni ma abokin bauta ne da kai da kuma ’yan’uwanka waɗanda suke riƙe da shaidar Yesu. Ka yi wa Allah sujada! Domin shaidar Yesu ita ce ruhun annabci.”
english: I fell down before his feet to worship him. He said to me, “Look! Don’t do it! I am a fellow bondservant with you and with your brothers who hold the testimony of Jesus. Worship God, for the testimony of Jesus is the Spirit of Prophecy.”

hausa: ’yan adam duka za su hallaka tare, mutum kuma zai koma ƙasa.
english: all flesh would perish together, and man would turn again to dust.

hausa: Zai ɗauki faranti cike da garwashin wuta daga bagade a gaban Ubangiji, yă kuma cika hannunsa biyu da turare mai ƙanshin da aka niƙa yă kai su bayan labule.
english: He shall take a censer full of coals of fire from off the altar before Yahweh, and two handfuls of sweet incense beaten small, and bring it within the veil.

hausa: Ziklag, Bet-Markabot, Hazar-Susa,
english: Ziklag, Beth Marcaboth, Hazar Susah,

hausa: “Amma fa, in kuka ce, ‘Ba za mu zauna a wannan ƙasa ba,’ ta haka kuka kuma nuna rashin biyayya ga Ubangiji Allahnku,
english: “‘But if you say, “We will not dwell in this land,” so that you don’t obey Yahweh your God’s voice,

hausa: Bayan sarki ya ƙone littafin da ya ƙunshi maganar da Baruk ya rubuta daga shibtar Irmiya, sai maganar Ubangiji ta zo wa Irmiya cewa,
english: Then Yahweh’s word came to Jeremiah, after the king had burned the scroll, and the words which Baruch wrote at the mouth of Jeremiah, saying,

hausa: Yana da shekara goma sha shida sa’ad da ya zama sarki, ya kuma yi mulki a Urushalima shekara hamsin da biyu. Sunan mahaifiyarsa Yekoliya daga Urushalima.
english: He was sixteen years old when he began to reign, and he reigned fifty-two years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Jecoliah of Jerusalem.

hausa: kwanon zinariya ɗaya mai nauyin shekel goma, cike da turaren hayaƙi;
english: one golden ladle of ten shekels, full of incense;

hausa: Suka tashi daga Hamadan Sinai, suka yi sansani a Kibrot Hatta’awa.
english: They traveled from the wilderness of Sinai, and encamped in Kibroth Hattaavah.

hausa: “Amma na san inda kake zama da sa’ad da kakan fita ka kuma koma da yadda ka harzuƙa gāba da ni.
english: But I know your sitting down, your going out, your coming in, and your raging against me.

hausa: Ku kuma yi addu’a yadda za a cece mu daga mugayen mutane masu mugunta, gama ba kowa ba ne yake da bangaskiya.
english: and that we may be delivered from unreasonable and evil men; for not all have faith.

hausa: Sai Eliyakim, Shebna da Yowa suka ce wa sarkin yaƙin, “Ka yi haƙuri ka yi wa bayinka magana da Arameyanci, da yake muna jinsa. Kada ka yi mana magana da Yahudanci a kunnen mutanen da suke kan katanga.”
english: Then Eliakim, Shebna and Joah said to Rabshakeh, “Please speak to your servants in Aramaic, for we understand it. Don’t speak to us in the Jews’ language in the hearing of the people who are on the wall.”

hausa: Suna kwanciya kurkusa da kowane bagade a kan tufafin da suka karɓe jingina. A gidajen allolinsu sukan sha ruwan inabin da suka karɓo daga wurin waɗanda suka ci wa tara.
english: They lay themselves down beside every altar on clothes taken in pledge. In the house of their God they drink the wine of those who have been fined.

hausa: In ya yi maka wani laifi ko kuma yana riƙe maka wani bashi, sai ka mai da shi a kaina.
english: But if he has wronged you at all or owes you anything, put that to my account.

hausa: Bari Allah Maɗaukaki yă nuna muku alheri a gaban mutumin saboda yă bar ɗan’uwanku da Benyamin su dawo tare da ku. Ni kuwa, in na yi rashi, na yi rashi.”
english: May God Almighty give you mercy before the man, that he may release to you your other brother and Benjamin. If I am bereaved of my children, I am bereaved.”

hausa: A bakin kogunan Babilon muka zauna muka yi kuka sa’ad da muka tuna da Sihiyona.
english: By the rivers of Babylon, there we sat down. Yes, we wept, when we remembered Zion.

hausa: Kullum ku dinga yin amfani da sunan Ubangijinmu Yesu Kiristi, kuna gode wa Allah Uba a kome.
english: giving thanks always concerning all things in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ to God, even the Father;

hausa: Saboda haka sarki ya kira Yehohiyada babban firist ya ce masa, “Me ya sa ba ka bukaci Lawiyawa su kawo harajin da Musa bawan Ubangiji ya ce a biya daga Yahuda da Urushalima da kuma taron Isra’ila domin Tentin Sujada Shaida ba?”
english: The king called for Jehoiada the chief, and said to him, “Why haven’t you required of the Levites to bring in the tax of Moses the servant of Yahweh, and of the assembly of Israel, out of Judah and out of Jerusalem, for the Tent of the Testimony?”

hausa: Wane ne cikin alloli, ya yi kamar ka, ya Ubangiji? Wane ne kamar ka, mai ɗaukaka cikin tsarki, mai banrazana cikin ɗaukaka, mai aikata al’ajabai?
english: Who is like you, Yahweh, among the gods? Who is like you, glorious in holiness, fearful in praises, doing wonders?

hausa: Rago kan ce, “Akwai zaki a waje!” Ko kuma “Za a kashe ni a tituna!”
english: The sluggard says, “There is a lion outside! I will be killed in the streets!”

hausa: Don mai bi da kaɗe-kaɗe. Da muryar “Lilin Alkawari.” Wani miktam ta Dawuda. Don koyarwa. Sa’ad da ya yaƙi Aram-Naharayim da Aram-Zoba, da kuma sa’ad da Yowab ya dawo ya bugi mutanen Edom dubu goma sha biyu a Kwarin Gishiri. Ka ki mu, ya Allah, ka kuma fashe kāriyarmu; ka yi fushi da mu, yanzu ka mai da mu!
english: For the Chief Musician. To the tune of “The Lily of the Covenant.” A teaching poem by David, when he fought with Aram Naharaim and with Aram Zobah, and Joab returned, and killed twelve thousand of Edom in the Valley of Salt. God, you have rejected us. You have broken us down. You have been angry. Restore us, again.

hausa: A daren nan, sai dukan jama’ar suka tā da murya, suka yi kuka da ƙarfi.
english: All the congregation lifted up their voice, and cried; and the people wept that night.

hausa: “Ku zo, ku ci abincina da ruwan inabin da na gauraye.
english: “Come, eat some of my bread, Drink some of the wine which I have mixed!

hausa: Mala’ika na biyu ya biyo yana cewa, “Ta fāɗi! Babilon Mai Girma ta fāɗi, wadda ta sa dukan al’ummai suka sha ruwan inabin hauka na zinanta.”
english: Another, a second angel, followed, saying, “Babylon the great has fallen, which has made all the nations to drink of the wine of the wrath of her sexual immorality.”

hausa: ya bi mutumin Isra’ilan nan cikin tenti, ya soke dukansu biyu, māshin ya ratsa jikin mutumin Isra’ilan har zuwa jikin macen. Sa’an nan aka tsai da annoban nan a kan Isra’ilawa.
english: He went after the man of Israel into the pavilion, and thrust both of them through, the man of Israel, and the woman through her body. So the plague was stopped among the children of Israel.

hausa: Yehud, Bene-Berak, Gat-Rimmon,
english: Jehud, Bene Berak, Gath Rimmon,

hausa: “Duk wani alkawari ko rantsuwar da gwauruwa, ko macen da aurenta ya mutu, ta yi, zai tabbata a kanta.
english: “But the vow of a widow, or of her who is divorced, everything with which she has bound her soul shall stand against her.

hausa: Akwai wani saurayi zaune a taga mai suna Yitikus, wanda barci mai nauyi ya ɗauke shi yayinda Bulus yake ta tsawaita magana. Sa’ad da yake barci, sai ya fāɗi daga gidan sama a hawa ta uku aka kuma ɗauke shi matacce.
english: A certain young man named Eutychus sat in the window, weighed down with deep sleep. As Paul spoke still longer, being weighed down by his sleep, he fell down from the third floor and was taken up dead.

hausa: Da lokaci ya yi kusa da za a ɗauki Yesu zuwa sama, sai ya ɗaura niyyar tafiya Urushalima.
english: It came to pass, when the days were near that he should be taken up, he intently set his face to go to Jerusalem

hausa: Amma dole ku kiyaye farillaina da kuma dokokina. Kada haifaffe ɗan ƙasa da baƙin da suke zama a cikinku yă yi wani daga cikin waɗannan abubuwa banƙyama,
english: You therefore shall keep my statutes and my ordinances, and shall not do any of these abominations; neither the native-born, nor the stranger who lives as a foreigner among you

hausa: Ta haka kuma ashe, Rahab karuwan nan ba a ɗauke ta mai adalci ce saboda abin da ta yi ba ne sa’ad da ta ba wa ’yan leƙen asirin nan masauƙi ta kuma sallame su suka tafi ta wata hanya dabam?
english: In the same way, wasn’t Rahab the prostitute also justified by works when she received the messengers and sent them out another way?

hausa: Na yi baƙin ciki saboda kai, Yonatan ɗan’uwana; ƙaunatacce kake a gare ni. Ƙaunarka a gare ni abar al’ajabi ce, abar al’ajabi fiye da ta mace.
english: I am distressed for you, my brother Jonathan. You have been very pleasant to me. Your love to me was wonderful, surpassing the love of women.

hausa: Waɗannan mutane maɓulɓulai ne babu ruwa da kuma hazon da guguwar iska take kora. An shirya matsanancin duhu dominsu.
english: These are wells without water, clouds driven by a storm, for whom the blackness of darkness has been reserved forever.

hausa: Ibhar, Elishuwa, Elfelet,
english: Ibhar, Elishua, Elpelet,

hausa: Na kuma yi umarni cewa duk wanda ya karya wannan doka sai a fitar da itace daga cikin gidansa, a fiƙe kan itacen, a tsire mutumin, sa’an nan a mai da gidansa juji.
english: I have also made a decree that whoever alters this message, let a beam be pulled out from his house, and let him be lifted up and fastened on it; and let his house be made a dunghill for this.

hausa: Sa’ad da Serug ya yi shekaru 30, sai ya haifi Nahor.
english: Serug lived thirty years, and became the father of Nahor.

hausa: Gawawwakinku za su zama abincin dukan tsuntsayen sarari da namun duniya, ba kuwa wanda zai kore su.
english: Your dead bodies will be food to all birds of the sky, and to the animals of the earth; and there will be no one to frighten them away.

hausa: Don haka zan jefa ta a kan gadon wahala, zan kuma sa waɗanda suke zina da ita, su sha azaba ƙwarai, sai dai in sun tuba daga hanyoyinta.
english: Behold, I will throw her and those who commit adultery with her into a bed of great oppression, unless they repent of her works.

hausa: Ya aikata mugayen ayyuka a gaban Ubangiji, yadda gidan Ahab ta yi, gama bayan mutuwar mahaifinsa, sai gidan Ahab ta zama masu ba shi shawara, shawarar da ta kai shi ga lalacewa.
english: He did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight, as did Ahab’s house, for they were his counselors after the death of his father, to his destruction.

hausa: Fadawan Fir’auna suka ce masa, “Har yaushe mutumin nan zai zama mana tarko? Ka bar mutanen su tafi domin su yi wa Ubangiji Allahnsu sujada. Har yanzu ba ka san cewa Masar ta lalace ba?”
english: Pharaoh’s servants said to him, “How long will this man be a snare to us? Let the men go, that they may serve Yahweh, their God. Don’t you yet know that Egypt is destroyed?”

hausa: A ƙarƙashin al’arshin fikafikansu sun miƙe kyam ɗaura da juna, kuma kowanne yana da fikafikai biyu da suka rufe jikinsa.
english: Under the expanse, their wings were straight, one toward the other. Each one had two which covered on this side, and each one had two which covered their bodies on that side.

hausa: Saboda haka suka tafi. “Ya sāke fita a sa’a ta shida da kuma sa’a ta tara, ya sāke yin haka.
english: Again he went out about the sixth and the ninth hour, and did likewise.

hausa: Ƙafafunta na kaiwa ga mutuwa; sawunta na jagora kai tsaye zuwa kabari.
english: Her feet go down to death. Her steps lead straight to Sheol.

hausa: Sa’an nan Dawuda ya ba ɗansa Solomon tsari domin shirayin haikalin, gine-ginensa, ɗakunan ajiyarsa, ɓangarorin bisansa, ɗakunan cikinsa da kuma wurin kafara.
english: Then David gave to Solomon his son the plans for the porch of the temple, for its houses, for its treasuries, for its upper rooms, for its inner rooms, for the place of the mercy seat;

hausa: A lokacin da Lot ya isa Zowar, rana ta hau.
english: The sun had risen on the earth when Lot came to Zoar.

hausa: Ka kuma sa Lawiyawa su tsaya a gaban Haruna da ’ya’yansa, sai ka miƙa su kamar hadaya ta kaɗawa ga Ubangiji.
english: You shall set the Levites before Aaron and before his sons, and offer them as a wave offering to Yahweh.

hausa: Gama ƙaunarka mai girma ce, tana kaiwa sammai; amincinka na kaiwa sarari.
english: For your great loving kindness reaches to the heavens, and your truth to the skies.

hausa: In hidimar da take jawo wa mutane hukunci tana da ɗaukaka haka, to, lalle, hidimar da take kawo adalci za tă fi ta ɗaukaka nesa!
english: For if the service of condemnation has glory, the service of righteousness exceeds much more in glory.

hausa: Saboda haka Abimelek ya yi umarni ga dukan mutane. “Duk wanda ya fitine wannan mutum ko matarsa, tabbatacce za a kashe shi.”
english: Abimelech commanded all the people, saying, “He who touches this man or his wife will surely be put to death.”

hausa: domin wani abokina da yake tafiya ya sauka a wurina. Ga shi, ba ni da abinci da zan ba shi.’
english: for a friend of mine has come to me from a journey, and I have nothing to set before him,’

hausa: Yesu ya yi waɗansu abubuwan banmamaki da yawa a gaban almajiransa da ba a rubuta a wannan littafi ba.
english: Therefore Jesus did many other signs in the presence of his disciples, which are not written in this book;

hausa: Akwai wani da yake nan ba shi da amfani shekara talatin da takwas.
english: A certain man was there who had been sick for thirty-eight years.

hausa: Yadda Musa ya yi alkawari, sai aka ba Kaleb Hebron, wanda ya kori daga cikinta ’ya’ya maza uku na Anak.
english: They gave Hebron to Caleb, as Moses had said, and he drove the three sons of Anak out of there.

hausa: Sai kuma ya ɗauki kwaf ruwan inabi, ya yi godiya, ya kuma miƙa musu, dukansu suka sha daga ciki.
english: He took the cup, and when he had given thanks, he gave to them. They all drank of it.

hausa: Yohiyada ɗan Faseya, da Meshullam ɗan Besodehiya ne suka gyara Ƙofar Yeshana. Suka kafa katakanta, suka sa ƙyamarenta, da sandunan ƙarfe na kulle ƙofofinta.
english: Joiada the son of Paseah and Meshullam the son of Besodeiah repaired the old gate. They laid its beams and set up its doors, its bolts, and its bars.

hausa: Haka ma ya yi madogarai masu gefe huɗu na katakon zaitun don ƙofar shiga zuwa babban zaure.
english: He also made the entrance of the temple door posts of olive wood, out of a fourth part of the wall,

hausa: Amma Dawuda ya ce wa Abishai, “Kada ka hallaka shi. Wa zai sa hannu a kan shafaffe na Ubangiji, har yă tsira?
english: David said to Abishai, “Don’t destroy him, for who can stretch out his hand against Yahweh’s anointed, and be guiltless?”

hausa: Sa’an nan ya ce mini, “Ɗan mutum, yanzu ka tafi gidan Isra’ila ka faɗa kalmomina gare su.
english: He said to me, “Son of man, go to the house of Israel, and speak my words to them.

hausa: Zabura ce. Waƙa ce. Domin ranar Asabbaci. Yana da kyau a yabi Ubangiji a kuma yi kiɗi ga sunanka, ya Mafi Ɗaukaka,
english: A Psalm. A song for the Sabbath day. It is a good thing to give thanks to Yahweh, to sing praises to your name, Most High,

hausa: “Mun yi zunubi mun yi tawaye ba ka kuwa gafarta ba.
english: “We have transgressed and have rebelled. You have not pardoned.

hausa: Ibrahim yana da shekara tasa’in da tara sa’ad da aka yi masa kaciya,
english: Abraham was ninety-nine years old when he was circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin.

hausa: Mala’ikan ya amsa ya ce, “Ruhu Mai Tsarki zai sauko miki, ikon Maɗaukaki kuma zai rufe ke. Saboda haka, Mai Tsarkin nan da za a haifa, za a kira shi Ɗan Allah.
english: The angel answered her, “The Holy Spirit will come on you, and the power of the Most High will overshadow you. Therefore also the holy one who is born from you will be called the Son of God.

hausa: Saboda haka Dawuda da mutanensa wajen mutum ɗari shida suka bar Keyila, suka yi ta tafiya daga wannan wuri zuwa wancan. Sa’ad da aka gaya wa Shawulu cewa Dawuda ya tsere daga Keyila, sai ya fasa tafiya can.
english: Then David and his men, who were about six hundred, arose and departed out of Keilah and went wherever they could go. Saul was told that David had escaped from Keilah; and he gave up going there.

hausa: A cikin wahayin, na ga kaina a mafakar Shusha a yankin Elam; a wahayin na ga ina a bakin Kogin Ulai.
english: I saw the vision. Now it was so, that when I saw, I was in the citadel of Susa, which is in the province of Elam. I saw in the vision, and I was by the river Ulai.

hausa: Suka ce, “Me za mu yi da waɗannan mutane? Kowa da yake zama a Urushalima ya san sun yi abin banmamaki, kuma ba za mu iya yin mūsu wannan ba.
english: saying, “What shall we do to these men? Because indeed a notable miracle has been done through them, as can be plainly seen by all who dwell in Jerusalem, and we can’t deny it.

hausa: Kada ka ɓoye fuskarka daga gare ni sa’ad da nake cikin damuwa. Ka juye kunnenka gare ni; sa’ad da na yi kira, ka amsa mini da sauri.
english: Don’t hide your face from me in the day of my distress. Turn your ear to me. Answer me quickly in the day when I call.

hausa: To, sai me? Abin da Isra’ila suka nema da himma ba su samu ba, amma zaɓaɓɓun suka samu. Sauran suka taurare,
english: What then? That which Israel seeks for, that he didn’t obtain, but the chosen ones obtained it, and the rest were hardened.

hausa: Sai Ezra firist ya miƙe tsaye ya yi musu magana ya ce, “Kun yi rashin aminci; kun aure mata baƙi, ta haka kuka ƙara kan zunubin Isra’ila.
english: Ezra the priest stood up and said to them, “You have trespassed, and have married foreign women, increasing the guilt of Israel.

hausa: Kai, ko gashin kanku ma duk an ƙidaya su.
english: But the very hairs of your head are all numbered.

hausa: “Ku tafi! Ba ku da tsabta!” Haka mutane suke ihu suke ce musu. “Ku tashi daga nan! Ku tashi daga nan! Kada ku taɓa mu!” Sa’ad da suka gudu suna yawo, mutanen waɗansu ƙasashe suka ce, “Ba za su ci gaba da zama a nan ba.”
english: “Go away!” they cried to them. “Unclean! Go away! Go away! Don’t touch! When they fled away and wandered, men said among the nations, “They can’t live here any more.”

hausa: Ku rabu da ni, ku masu aikata mugunta, don in kiyaye umarnan Allahna!
english: Depart from me, you evildoers, that I may keep the commandments of my God.

hausa: Ta wurin bangaskiya ne Yaƙub, sa’ad da yake bakin mutuwa, ya albarkaci kowane ɗan Yusuf, ya kuma yi sujada yayinda yake jingine a kan sandansa.
english: By faith Jacob, when he was dying, blessed each of the sons of Joseph, and worshiped, leaning on the top of his staff.

hausa: amma da rani sai yă bushe, lokacin zafi ba a samun ruwa yana gudu a wurin.
english: In the dry season, they vanish. When it is hot, they are consumed out of their place.

hausa: Sa’ad da na shafe ka, zan rufe sammai in duhunta taurarinsu; zan rufe rana da girgije, wata kuwa ba zai ba da haskensa ba.
english: When I extinguish you, I will cover the heavens and make its stars dark. I will cover the sun with a cloud, and the moon won’t give its light.

hausa: Ga abin da Ubangiji Maɗaukaki yana cewa, “Duba! Masifa tana yaɗuwa daga al’umma zuwa al’umma; hadari mai girma yana tasowa daga iyakar duniya.”
english: Yahweh of Armies says, “Behold, evil will go out from nation to nation, and a great storm will be raised up from the uttermost parts of the earth.”

hausa: Ya Ubangiji Allahnmu, game da dukan wannan yalwar da ka tanada saboda ginin haikali saboda Sunanka Mai Tsarki, sun fito daga hannunka ne, kuma dukan naka ne.
english: Yahweh our God, all this store that we have prepared to build you a house for your holy name comes from your hand, and is all your own.

hausa: Za su jefa su cikin wuta mai zafi, inda za a yi kuka da cizon haƙora.
english: and will cast them into the furnace of fire. There will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.

hausa: Wani mala’ika daga sama ya bayyana gare shi, ya ƙarfafa shi.
english: An angel from heaven appeared to him, strengthening him.

hausa: Bayan Yesu ya sallami taron, sai ya shiga jirgin ruwa ya tafi wajajen Magadan.
english: Then he sent away the multitudes, got into the boat, and came into the borders of Magdala.

hausa: Saboda haka, Yehu ɗan Yehoshafat, ɗan Nimshi, ya ƙulla wa Yoram maƙarƙashiya (To, Yoram da dukan Isra’ila suna kāre Ramot Gileyad daga Hazayel sarkin Aram,
english: So Jehu the son of Jehoshaphat the son of Nimshi conspired against Joram. (Now Joram was defending Ramoth Gilead, he and all Israel, because of Hazael king of Syria;

hausa: Lokacin da Afollos yake a Korint, Bulus ya bi hanyar da ta ratsa ta Asiya ya zo Afisa. A can ya sadu da waɗansu almajirai,
english: While Apollos was at Corinth, Paul, having passed through the upper country, came to Ephesus and found certain disciples.

hausa: Dole sai an fara yin wa’azin bishara ga dukan al’ummai.
english: The Good News must first be preached to all the nations.

hausa: Amma Shawulu ya fara hallaka ikkilisiya. Yana shiga gida-gida, yana jan maza da mata yana jefa su cikin kurkuku.
english: But Saul ravaged the assembly, entering into every house and dragged both men and women off to prison.

hausa: Ka ba mu yau abincin yininmu.
english: Give us today our daily bread.

hausa: Yesu ya amsa ya ce, “In kana so ka zama cikakke, ka je, ka sayar da dukan dukiyarka ka kuma ba matalauta, za ka kuwa sami dukiya a sama. Sa’an nan ka zo, ka bi ni.”
english: Jesus said to him, “If you want to be perfect, go, sell what you have, and give to the poor, and you will have treasure in heaven; and come, follow me.”

hausa: amma in dabbobin raunana ne, ba ya sa su a can. Saboda haka raunanan dabbobi suka zama na Laban, ƙarfafan kuma suka zama na Yaƙub.
english: but when the flock were feeble, he didn’t put them in. So the feebler were Laban’s, and the stronger Jacob’s.

hausa: A haɗa da bunsuru guda a matsayin hadaya don zunubi, ban da hadaya ta ƙonawa ta kullum tare da hadayarta ta hatsi da hadaya ta sha.
english: and one male goat for a sin offering; in addition to the continual burnt offering, its meal offering, and the drink offerings of it.

hausa: Bayan da Yusuf da Maryamu suka gama yin dukan abubuwan da Dokar Ubangiji ta bukaci, sai suka koma Galili suka tafi Nazaret garinsu.
english: When they had accomplished all things that were according to the law of the Lord, they returned into Galilee, to their own city, Nazareth.

hausa: Cikin dukan halittun da suke cikin ruwa, za ku iya cin duk wani da yake da ƙege da ɓamɓaroki.
english: These you may eat of all that are in the waters: you may eat whatever has fins and scales.

hausa: “Ba su san kome ba, ba su fahimci kome ba. Suna yawo cikin duhu; an girgiza dukan tussan duniya.
english: They don’t know, neither do they understand. They walk back and forth in darkness. All the foundations of the earth are shaken.

hausa: Yonatan ya yi magana mai kyau a kan Dawuda a wajen mahaifinsa ya ce, “Kada sarki yă yi wani mummunan abu wa bawansa Dawuda, gama bai yi maka wani abu marar kyau ba. Abin da ya yi ya amfane ka ƙwarai da gaske.
english: Jonathan spoke good of David to Saul his father, and said to him, “Don’t let the king sin against his servant, against David; because he has not sinned against you, and because his works have been very good toward you;

hausa: Dukan attajiran duniya za su yi biki su kuma yi sujada; dukan waɗanda suka gangara zuwa ƙura za su durƙusa a gabansa, waɗanda ba za su iya bar kansu da rai ba.
english: All the rich ones of the earth shall eat and worship. All those who go down to the dust shall bow before him, even he who can’t keep his soul alive.

hausa: Yin biyayya da irin waɗannan ƙa’idodi za su yi kamar su ne abu mafi kyau da za a yi. Sukan yi kamar suna sa a ƙaunaci Allah sosai a kuma kasance da sauƙinkai a kuma kasance da kamunkai. Amma ba su da wani iko a kan sha’awace-sha’awacenmu.
english: These things indeed appear like wisdom in self-imposed worship, humility, and severity to the body, but aren’t of any value against the indulgence of the flesh.

hausa: Bayan Musa da Haruna sun bar Fir’auna, Sai Musa ya yi kuka ga Ubangiji saboda kwaɗin da ya kawo a bisa Fir’auna.
english: Moses and Aaron went out from Pharaoh, and Moses cried to Yahweh concerning the frogs which he had brought on Pharaoh.

hausa: Haka ya yi dakalai goma. Duk an yi zubinsu iri ɗaya ne, girmansu da fasalinsu kuma iri ɗaya.
english: He made the ten bases in this way: all of them had one casting, one measure, and one form.

hausa: Zuwa ga ikkilisiyar Allah da take a Korint, da waɗanda aka tsarkake cikin Kiristi Yesu, aka kuma kira domin su zama masu tsarki, tare da dukan waɗanda suke ko’ina da suke kiran sunan Ubangijinmu Yesu Kiristi, Ubangijinsu da kuma namu.
english: to the assembly of God which is at Corinth—those who are sanctified in Christ Jesus, called saints, with all who call on the name of our Lord Jesus Christ in every place, both theirs and ours:

hausa: waɗanda suka ɗanɗana daɗin maganar Allah da kuma ikokin zamani mai zuwa,
english: and tasted the good word of God and the powers of the age to come,

hausa: Ku roƙi Ubangiji yă ba ku ruwa a lokacin bazara; Ubangiji ne yake yin gizagizan hadari. Shi ne yake ba wa mutane yayyafin ruwan sama yana kuma ba da tsire-tsire na fili ga kowa.
english: Ask of Yahweh rain in the spring time, Yahweh who makes storm clouds, and he gives rain showers to everyone for the plants in the field.

hausa: “Ga abin da Ubangiji yana cewa, Sarki da kuma Mai Fansar Isra’ila, Ubangiji Maɗaukaki. Ni ne farko ni ne kuma ƙarshe; in ban da ni babu wani Allah.
english: This is what Yahweh, the King of Israel, and his Redeemer, Yahweh of Armies, says: “I am the first, and I am the last; and besides me there is no God.

hausa: Sa’ad da suka sha, za su yi ta tangaɗi su kuma yi hauka saboda takobin da zan aika a cikinsu.”
english: They will drink, and reel back and forth, and be insane, because of the sword that I will send among them.”

hausa: In zai iya yin faɗa har yă kashe ni, to, za mu zama bayinku. Amma in na fi ƙarfinsa na kashe shi, to, sai ku zama bayinmu, ku kuma yi mana bauta.”
english: If he is able to fight with me and kill me, then will we be your servants; but if I prevail against him and kill him, then you will be our servants and serve us.”

hausa: Daga baya, annabin ya zo wurin sarkin Isra’ila ya ce, “Ka ƙarfafa matsayinka ka kuma ga abin da za a yi, gama a bazara mai zuwa sarkin Aram zai sāke kawo yaƙi.”
english: The prophet came near to the king of Israel and said to him, “Go, strengthen yourself, and plan what you must do, for at the return of the year, the king of Syria will come up against you.”

hausa: A littafina na farko, Tiyofilus, na rubuta game da dukan abin da Yesu ya fara yi, da abin da ya koyar
english: The first book I wrote, Theophilus, concerned all that Jesus began both to do and to teach,

hausa: Iliya ya ce, “Ka nemi abu mai wuya, amma in ka ga lokacin da aka ɗauke ni daga gare ka, zai zama naka, in ba haka ba, ba za ka samu ba ke nan.”
english: He said, “You have asked a hard thing. If you see me when I am taken from you, it will be so for you; but if not, it will not be so.”

hausa: gama mutanen da suka zauna a wannan ƙasa kafin ku sun aikata dukan waɗannan abubuwa, suka kuma ƙazantu.
english: (for the men of the land that were before you had done all these abominations, and the land became defiled),

hausa: Kan’ana shi ne mahaifin Sidon ɗan farinsa, da Hittiyawa,
english: Canaan became the father of Sidon his firstborn, Heth,

hausa: Dogayen surutanku ba sa ƙare ne? Me yake sa kuke ta yin waɗannan surutai har kuke cin gaba da yin gardama?
english: Shall vain words have an end? Or what provokes you that you answer?

hausa: Yoram ya umarta, “Haɗa mini keken yaƙi!” Da aka haɗa, sai Yoram sarkin Isra’ila, da Ahaziya sarkin Yahuda, suka hau suka tafi, kowa a keken yaƙinsa, don su taryi Yehu. Suka sadu da shi a filin da yake na Nabot mutumin Yezireyel.
english: Joram said, “Get ready!” They got his chariot ready. Then Joram king of Israel and Ahaziah king of Judah went out, each in his chariot; and they went out to meet Jehu, and found him on Naboth the Jezreelite’s land.

hausa: Mai albarka ne mutumin da ya sami hikima, mutumin da ya sami fahimi,
english: Happy is the man who finds wisdom, the man who gets understanding.

hausa: “To, ga abin da Ubangiji Allah Maɗaukaki, Allah na Isra’ila, yana cewa don me kuka kawo irin masifa mai girma haka a kanku ta wurin warewa daga Yahuda maza da mata, yara da jarirai, kun kuma bar kanku babu raguwa?
english: “Therefore now Yahweh, the God of Armies, the God of Israel, says: ‘Why do you commit great evil against your own souls, to cut off from yourselves man and woman, infant and nursing child out of the middle of Judah, to leave yourselves no one remaining,

hausa: Hikimar Solomon ta fi hikimar mutanen Gabas, ta kuma fi dukan hikimar Masar girma.
english: Solomon’s wisdom excelled the wisdom of all the children of the east and all the wisdom of Egypt.

hausa: Ki tashi, ki yi kuka cikin dare, dare na yi sai ki fara kuka; kina buɗewa Ubangiji zuciyarki. Ki ɗaga hannuwanki gare shi domin rayukan ’ya’yanki, waɗanda suka suma don yunwa a kan kowane titi.
english: Arise, cry out in the night, at the beginning of the watches! Pour out your heart like water before the face of the Lord. Lift up your hands toward him for the life of your young children, who faint for hunger at the head of every street.

hausa: Na rubuta muku gabagadi a kan waɗansu batuttuwa, don in sāke tuna muku su, saboda alherin da Allah ya ba ni
english: But I write the more boldly to you in part as reminding you, because of the grace that was given to me by God,

hausa: Dawakansu sun fi damisoshi sauri, sun fi kyarketan yamma zafin rai. Mahayansu suna zuwa a guje; mahayansu daga nesa suka fito. Suna firiya kamar ungulu mai sauka da gaggawa don yă ci mushe;
english: Their horses also are swifter than leopards, and are more fierce than the evening wolves. Their horsemen press proudly on. Yes, their horsemen come from afar. They fly as an eagle that hurries to devour.

hausa: Zai sa ’ya’yanku mata yin aikin turare da dafe-dafe da kuma toye-toye.
english: He will take your daughters to be perfumers, to be cooks, and to be bakers.

hausa: Sai Ubangiji ya umarci kifin, kifin kuwa ya amayar da Yunana a gaɓan teku.
english: Then Yahweh spoke to the fish, and it vomited out Jonah on the dry land.

hausa: Da ya kai gida, sai ya ɗauki wuƙa ya yayyanka ƙwarƙwaransa gunduwa-gunduwa, kashi goma sha biyu ya aika da su a ko’ina a Isra’ila.
english: When he had come into his house, he took a knife and cut up his concubine, and divided her, limb by limb, into twelve pieces, and sent her throughout all the borders of Israel.

hausa: Duk mai lura da leɓunansa yakan lura da ransa, amma duk mai magana da haushi zai kai ga lalaci.
english: He who guards his mouth guards his soul. One who opens wide his lips comes to ruin.

hausa: Sai ya ce, “Yesu, ka tuna da ni sa’ad da ka shiga mulkinka.”
english: He said to Jesus, “Lord, remember me when you come into your Kingdom.”

hausa: da kowane ’yan raguna bakwai, kashi ɗaya bisa goma.
english: one tenth for every lamb of the seven lambs;

hausa: Da suka ga babu hanyar da za su bi saboda taron, sai suka haura rufin, suka saukar da shi a kan tabarmarsa, ta bakin ramin da suka huda a rufin, suka ajiye shi a tsakiyar taron, a gaban Yesu.
english: Not finding a way to bring him in because of the multitude, they went up to the housetop and let him down through the tiles with his cot into the middle before Jesus.

hausa: Ubangiji, sun zo gare ka a cikin damuwarsu; sa’ad da ka hore su, da ƙyar suna iya yin addu’a.
english: Yahweh, in trouble they have visited you. They poured out a prayer when your chastening was on them.

hausa: Da ta ji labarin Yesu, sai ta zo ta bayansa, a cikin taron, ta taɓa rigarsa,
english: having heard the things concerning Jesus, came up behind him in the crowd and touched his clothes.

hausa: Yesu ya shiga jirgin ruwa, ya ƙetare ya zo garinsa.
english: He entered into a boat and crossed over, and came into his own city.

hausa: Saboda haka waɗanda suke da bangaskiya sun sami albarka tare da Ibrahim, mutumin bangaskiya.
english: So then, those who are of faith are blessed with the faithful Abraham.

hausa: Ina roƙonka ka gafarta wa baiwarka laifinta gama tabbatacce Ubangiji zai ba shugabana dawwammamiyar sarauta, gama kana yin yaƙin Ubangiji ne. Kuma ba wani mugun abin da zai same ka muddin kana a raye.
english: Please forgive the trespass of your servant. For Yahweh will certainly make my lord a sure house, because my lord fights Yahweh’s battles. Evil will not be found in you all your days.

hausa: Gama kwanakina sun ɓace kamar hayaƙi; ƙasusuwana suna ƙuna kamar jan wuta.
english: For my days consume away like smoke. My bones are burned as a torch.

hausa: Gama ga abin da Ubangiji Maɗaukaki yana cewa game da ginshiƙai, kwatarniya, da dakalai, da sauran kayayyaki da aka bar su a birnin nan,
english: For Yahweh of Armies says concerning the pillars, concerning the sea, concerning the bases, and concerning the rest of the vessels that are left in this city,

hausa: “Ga shi! Ina zuwa da wuri! Mai albarka ne wanda yake kiyaye kalmomin annabcin da suke cikin wannan littafi.”
english: “Behold, I am coming soon! Blessed is he who keeps the words of the prophecy of this book.”

hausa: A cikin birnin, akwai wata hasumiya mai ƙarfi, inda dukan maza da mata, dukan mutanen birnin, suka ɓuya. Suka kulle kansu, suka kuma hau rufin hasumiyar.
english: But there was a strong tower within the city, and all the men and women of the city fled there, and shut themselves in, and went up to the roof of the tower.

hausa: Ina marmarin cetonka, ya Ubangiji, dokarka kuwa ita ce farin cikina.
english: I have longed for your salvation, Yahweh. Your law is my delight.

hausa: Ba wanda yake sa bege a gare ka da zai taɓa shan kunya, amma za su sha kunya su da suke tayarwa babu dalili.
english: Yes, no one who waits for you will be shamed. They will be shamed who deal treacherously without cause.

hausa: Ta ce, “Ɗaukaka ta rabu da Isra’ila, gama an ƙwace akwatin alkawarin Allah.”
english: She said, “The glory has departed from Israel; for God’s ark has been taken.”

hausa: Game da Allah kuwa, hanyarsa cikakkiya ce; maganar Ubangiji marar kuskure ne. Shi garkuwa ne ga dukan waɗanda suke neman mafaka a gare shi.
english: As for God, his way is perfect. Yahweh’s word is tried. He is a shield to all those who take refuge in him.

hausa: Na nemi Ubangiji, ya kuwa amsa mini; ya cece ni daga dukan tsoro.
english: I sought Yahweh, and he answered me, and delivered me from all my fears.

hausa: Ku gasa shi, ku kuma ci a wurin da Ubangiji Allahnku ya zaɓa. Sa’an nan da safe, ku dawo cikin tentunanku.
english: You shall roast and eat it in the place which Yahweh your God chooses. In the morning you shall return to your tents.

hausa: Sa’ad da Ba’al-Hanan ɗan Akbor ya rasu, Hadad ya gāje shi. Sunan birninsa shi ne Fau, kuma sunan matarsa Mehetabel ce ’yar Matired, jikanyar Me-Zahab.
english: Baal Hanan the son of Achbor died, and Hadar reigned in his place. The name of his city was Pau. His wife’s name was Mehetabel, the daughter of Matred, the daughter of Mezahab.

hausa: Yesu ya ce, “ ‘In za ka iya’? Ai, kome mai yiwuwa ne ga wanda ya gaskata.”
english: Jesus said to him, “If you can believe, all things are possible to him who believes.”

hausa: Zuciyata tana nan daram, ya Allah, zuciyata tana nan daram; zan rera in kuma yi kaɗe-kaɗe.
english: My heart is steadfast, God. My heart is steadfast. I will sing, yes, I will sing praises.

hausa: da ɗakunan firistoci kamu ashirin ne kewaye da haikalin.
english: Between the rooms was a width of twenty cubits around the house on every side.

hausa: Isra’ilawa kuwa sun bauta wa Ubangiji dukan kwanakin Yoshuwa, da kuma kwanakin dattawan da ya bari, da waɗanda suka ga duk abin da Ubangiji ya yi wa Isra’ila.
english: Israel served Yahweh all the days of Joshua, and all the days of the elders who outlived Joshua, and had known all the work of Yahweh, that he had worked for Israel.

hausa: Ko da yake ina da ’yanci ba na kuma ƙarƙashin kowa, na mai da kaina bawa ga kowa, domin in rinjayi mutane da yawa.
english: For though I was free from all, I brought myself under bondage to all, that I might gain the more.

hausa: Amma kai kam, ka ci gaba da abin da ka koya ka kuma tabbatar, gama ka san waɗanda ka koye su daga gare su,
english: But you remain in the things which you have learned and have been assured of, knowing from whom you have learned them.

hausa: Yaƙin ya bazu a duk fāɗin ƙauyukan, abin da kurmin ya ci kawai a ranar ya fi yawan abin da aka kashe da takobi.
english: For the battle was there spread over the surface of all the country, and the forest devoured more people that day than the sword devoured.

hausa: “Yi magana da Haruna, ka ce masa, ‘Sa’ad da za ka shisshirya fitilun nan bakwai, ka shirya su yadda za su fuskanci gaba domin haskensu yă haskaka ta gaba.’ ”
english: “Speak to Aaron, and tell him, ‘When you light the lamps, the seven lamps shall give light in front of the lamp stand.’”

hausa: Ku lura kada wani yă zama mai fasikanci, ko marar tsoron Allah kamar Isuwa, wanda saboda ƙwaryar abinci ɗaya tak ya sayar da gādonsa na ɗan fari.
english: lest there be any sexually immoral person or profane person, like Esau, who sold his birthright for one meal.

hausa: Ga abin da Ubangiji yana cewa, Mai Fansarku, Mai Tsarkin nan na Isra’ila ya ce, “Ni ne Ubangiji Allahnku, wanda ya koya muku abin da ya fi muku kyau, wanda ya muku hanyar da za ku bi.
english: Yahweh, your Redeemer, the Holy One of Israel, says: “I am Yahweh your God, who teaches you to profit, who leads you by the way that you should go.

hausa: Ku tuna da kalmomin da na yi muku cewa, ‘Ba bawan da ya fi maigidansa,’In sun tsananta mini, ku ma za su tsananta muku. Da sun yi biyayya da koyarwata, da za su yi biyayya da taku ma.
english: Remember the word that I said to you: ‘A servant is not greater than his lord.’ If they persecuted me, they will also persecute you. If they kept my word, they will also keep yours.

hausa: Za ku mutu ta wurin takobi, zan kuma hukunta ku a iyakokin Isra’ila. Sa’an nan za ku san cewa ni ne Ubangiji.
english: You will fall by the sword. I will judge you in the border of Israel. Then you will know that I am Yahweh.

hausa: Ku yi alheri, ku kuma ji tausayin juna, kuna gafarta wa juna, kamar yadda a cikin Kiristi, Allah ya gafarta muku.
english: And be kind to one another, tender hearted, forgiving each other, just as God also in Christ forgave you.

hausa: Da ya isa ɗayan gefen a yankin Gadarenawa (ko kuwa Gerasenawa), sai ga mutum biyu masu aljanu suna fitowa daga kaburbura suka tarye shi. Su abin tsoro ne ƙwarai, har ba mai iya bin wannan hanya.
english: When he came to the other side, into the country of the Gergesenes, two people possessed by demons met him there, coming out of the tombs, exceedingly fierce, so that nobody could pass that way.

hausa: don rayuwanku ta kullum ta zama da mutunci ga waɗanda suke na waje don kuma kada ku dogara a kan kowa.
english: that you may walk properly toward those who are outside, and may have need of nothing.

hausa: Yaƙub ya fusata da ita ya ce, “Ina a matsayin Allah ne wanda ya hana ke samun ’ya’ya?”
english: Jacob’s anger burned against Rachel, and he said, “Am I in God’s place, who has withheld from you the fruit of the womb?”

hausa: Ya kuma ce, “Kada ka ji tsoro, ya kai mutumin da ake fahariya, salama a gare ka! Ka ƙarfafa yanzu; ka yi ƙarfin hali.” Sa’ad da ya yi magana da ni, sai na samu ƙarfi na ce, “Ka yi magana ranka yă daɗe, tun da yake ka sa na sami ƙarfi.”
english: He said, “Greatly beloved man, don’t be afraid. Peace be to you. Be strong. Yes, be strong.” When he spoke to me, I was strengthened, and said, “Let my lord speak, for you have strengthened me.”

hausa: Zan riɓaɓɓanya sakayyar da zan yi musu saboda muguntarsu da zunubinsu, domin sun ƙazantar da ƙasata da ƙazantattun gumakansu marasa rai, suka kuma cika abin gādona da gumakansu na banƙyama.”
english: First I will recompense their iniquity and their sin double, because they have polluted my land with the carcasses of their detestable things, and have filled my inheritance with their abominations.”

hausa: Tsawon ginin da yake fuskantar arewa kamu ɗari ne fāɗinsa kuma kamu hamsin.
english: Facing the length of one hundred cubits was the north door, and the width was fifty cubits.

hausa: Za ku iya ce, “Ubangiji ya tā da annabawa saboda mu a Babilon.”
english: Because you have said, “Yahweh has raised us up prophets in Babylon,”

hausa: Firist zai zuba man a tafin hannunsa na hagu,
english: The priest shall pour some of the oil into the palm of his own left hand;

hausa: Don mai bi da kaɗe-kaɗe. Ta Dawuda. Zabura ce. Ya Allah, wanda nake yabo, kada ka yi shiru,
english: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. God of my praise, don’t remain silent,

hausa: Sa’an nan Manowa ya ɗauki ɗan akuya, tare da hadaya ta hatsi ya miƙa wa Ubangiji a kan dutse. Ubangiji kuwa ya yi abin mamaki yayinda Manowa da matarsa suke kallo.
english: So Manoah took the young goat with the meal offering, and offered it on the rock to Yahweh. Then the angel did an amazing thing as Manoah and his wife watched.

hausa: Mai ba da shaidar ƙarya ba zai tafi babu hukunci ba, kuma duk wanda ya baza ƙarairayi ba zai kuɓuta ba.
english: A false witness shall not be unpunished. He who pours out lies shall not go free.

hausa: Haka ma aikin Allah yake. Ya so yă nuna fushinsa yă kuma sanar da ikonsa, ya yi haka cikin haƙuri ƙwarai ga waɗanda suka cancanci fushinsa, waɗanda aka shirya domin hallaka?
english: What if God, willing to show his wrath and to make his power known, endured with much patience vessels of wrath prepared for destruction,

hausa: Alheri da salama daga Allah Uba da kuma Ubangiji Yesu Kiristi, su kasance tare da ku.
english: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

hausa: Ya zaɓi mutane masu iyawa daga cikin dukan Isra’ila, ya naɗa su shugabannin mutane, shugabanni a kan dubbai, ɗari-ɗari, hamsin-hamsin da goma-goma.
english: Moses chose able men out of all Israel, and made them heads over the people, rulers of thousands, rulers of hundreds, rulers of fifties, and rulers of tens.

hausa: A ranar Asabbaci na biye kusan dukan birnin suka taru don su ji maganar Ubangiji.
english: The next Sabbath, almost the whole city was gathered together to hear the word of God.

hausa: Ka bizne su duka tare ka rufe fuskokinsu a cikin kabari.
english: Hide them in the dust together. Bind their faces in the hidden place.

hausa: “Ina da sauran abubuwa da yawa da zan faɗa muku, amma ba za ku iya ɗauka a yanzu ba.
english: “I still have many things to tell you, but you can’t bear them now.

hausa: ya ce, “Ku koma gidajenku tare da dukiya mai yawa, babban garken dabbobi, azurfa da zinariya, tagulla da ƙarfe, da tufafi masu yawa sosai, sai ku raba ganimar da kuka samu daga abokan gābanku, da ’yan’uwanku.”
english: and spoke to them, saying, “Return with much wealth to your tents, with very much livestock, with silver, with gold, with bronze, with iron, and with very much clothing. Divide the plunder of your enemies with your brothers.”

hausa: Bitrus ya tuna, sai ya ce wa Yesu, “Rabbi, duba! Itacen ɓauren nan da ka la’anta, ya yanƙwane!”
english: Peter, remembering, said to him, “Rabbi, look! The fig tree which you cursed has withered away.”

hausa: Mutane za su zo daga gabas, da yamma, da kudu, da arewa, su ɗauki wuraren zamansu a bikin, a cikin mulkin Allah.
english: They will come from the east, west, north, and south, and will sit down in God’s Kingdom.

hausa: da kowane ’yan raguna bakwai, kashi ɗaya bisa goma.
english: You shall offer one tenth for every lamb of the seven lambs;

hausa: Rashin sa’a kan fafare mai zunubi, amma wadata ce ladar adali.
english: Misfortune pursues sinners, but prosperity rewards the righteous.

hausa: Sai Sarki Rehobowam ya nemi shawarar dattawa waɗanda suka yi wa mahaifinsa Solomon, hidima a kwanakinsa. Ya ce, “Wace shawara ce za ku ba ni don in amsa wa waɗannan mutane?”
english: King Rehoboam took counsel with the old men who had stood before Solomon his father while he yet lived, saying, “What counsel do you give me to answer these people?”

hausa: Saboda haka, ƙaunatattu ’yan’uwana, ku tsaya da daram. Kada wani abu yă jijjiga ku. Ku ba da kanku kullum ga aikin Ubangiji, domin kun san cewa famar da kuke yi saboda Ubangiji ba a banza take ba.
