english: Therefore, my beloved brothers, be steadfast, immovable, always abounding in the Lord’s work, because you know that your labor is not in vain in the Lord.

hausa: Duka-duka, waɗanda aka zaɓa don su zama matsaran madogaran ƙofa sun kai 212. Aka rubuta su zuriya-zuriya a ƙauyukansu. Dawuda da Sama’ila mai duba ne suka sa matsaran a wurarensu na aminci.
english: All these who were chosen to be gatekeepers in the thresholds were two hundred twelve. These were listed by genealogy in their villages, whom David and Samuel the seer ordained in their office of trust.

hausa: Ɗan Shammai shi ne Mawon, Mawon kuma shi ne mahaifin Bet-Zur.
english: The son of Shammai was Maon; and Maon was the father of Beth Zur.

hausa: A haɗa da bunsuru guda a matsayin hadaya don zunubi, ban da hadaya ta ƙonawa ta kullum tare da hadayarta ta hatsi da hadayarta ta sha.
english: and one male goat for a sin offering; in addition to the continual burnt offering, its meal offering, and its drink offering.

hausa: Rigar, ko tariyar zare, ko kayan da aka saƙa, ko kuwa duk kayan da aka yi da fatar da aka wanke, aka kuma fid da cutar rigar, dole a sāke wanke shi, zai kuwa zama tsarkakakke.”
english: The garment, either the warp, or the woof, or whatever thing of skin it is, which you shall wash, if the plague has departed from them, then it shall be washed the second time, and it will be clean.”

hausa: Sai ya kwantar da gawar a kabarinsa, suka yi makoki a kansa, ya kuma ce, “Ayya, abokina!”
english: He laid his body in his own grave; and they mourned over him, saying, “Alas, my brother!”

hausa: Adalcina na zuwa da sauri, cetona yana a kan hanya, hannuna kuma zai kawo adalci ga al’ummai. Tsibirai za su dube ni su kuma jira da sa zuciya don hannuna.
english: My righteousness is near. My salvation has gone out, and my arms will judge the peoples. The islands will wait for me, and they will trust my arm.

hausa: Saboda haka ba za mu ji tsoro ba, ko da ƙasa ta girgiza duwatsu kuma suka fāɗi cikin zurfin teku,
english: Therefore we won’t be afraid, though the earth changes, though the mountains are shaken into the heart of the seas;

hausa: Amma Zakka ya tashi a tsaye, ya ce wa Ubangiji, “Duba, Ubangiji! Nan take, rabin dukiyar da nake da shi, na ba wa matalauta. In kuma na taɓa cutan wani, a kan wani abu, zan mayar da shi ninki huɗu.”
english: Zacchaeus stood and said to the Lord, “Behold, Lord, half of my goods I give to the poor. If I have wrongfully exacted anything of anyone, I restore four times as much.”

hausa: Daga lokacin da kakanninku suka bar Masar har yă zuwa yau, kullum na yi ta aikan bayina annabawa.
english: Since the day that your fathers came out of the land of Egypt to this day, I have sent to you all my servants the prophets, daily rising up early and sending them.

hausa: Zikri, wani jarumin Efraim, ya kashe Ma’asehiya ɗan sarki, Azrikam hafsa mai lura da fada, da kuma Elkana, mataimakin sarki.
english: Zichri, a mighty man of Ephraim, killed Maaseiah the king’s son, Azrikam the ruler of the house, and Elkanah who was next to the king.

hausa: Labarinsa ya bazu ko’ina a Suriya, mutane kuwa suka kawo masa dukan waɗanda suke fama da cututtuka iri-iri, da waɗanda suke da zafin ciwo, da masu aljanu, da waɗanda suke masu farfaɗiya, da shanyayyu, ya kuwa warkar da su.
english: The report about him went out into all Syria. They brought to him all who were sick, afflicted with various diseases and torments, possessed with demons, epileptics, and paralytics; and he healed them.

hausa: Ku yi kuka ku kuma yi makoki, ku makiyaya; ku yi ta birgima a ƙura, ku shugabannin garke. Gama lokacin da za a yanka ku ya zo; za ku fāɗi ku kuma farfasa kamar tukunyar yumɓu mai kyau.
english: Wail, you shepherds, and cry. Wallow in dust, you leader of the flock; for the days of your slaughter and of your dispersions have fully come, and you will fall like fine pottery.

hausa: A’a, ’ya’yana ba labari mai kyau nake ji cikin mutanen Ubangiji ba.
english: No, my sons; for it is not a good report that I hear! You make Yahweh’s people disobey.

hausa: Sa’an nan Dawuda ya tashi daga ƙasa. Bayan ya yi wanka, ya shafa mai, ya kuma canja rigunarsa, sa’an nan ya shiga gidan Ubangiji ya yi sujada. Sai ya tafi gidansa, ya nemi a ba shi abinci, aka ba shi, ya kuwa ci.
english: Then David arose from the earth, and washed and anointed himself, and changed his clothing; and he came into Yahweh’s house, and worshiped. Then he came to his own house; and when he requested, they set bread before him and he ate.

hausa: Mutanen nan biyun suka ce wa Lot, “Kana da wani a nan, ko surukai, ko ’ya’ya maza ko mata, ko kuwa wani dai a cikin birni wanda yake naka? Ka fitar da su daga nan,
english: The men said to Lot, “Do you have anybody else here? Sons-in-law, your sons, your daughters, and whomever you have in the city, bring them out of the place:

hausa: Amma ko mu, ko mala’ika daga sama ya yi wa’azin wata bishara dabam da wadda muka yi muku, bari yă zama la’ananne har abada!
english: But even though we, or an angel from heaven, should preach to you any “good news” other than that which we preached to you, let him be cursed.

hausa: Amma Masarawa suka wulaƙanta mu suka sa muka sha wahala, suna sa mu aikin dole.
english: The Egyptians mistreated us, afflicted us, and imposed hard labor on us.

hausa: A lokacin da Absalom yake da rai, Absalom ya gina wa kansa al’amudin tunawa, a Kwarin Sarki, gama ya yi tunani ya ce, “Ba ni da ɗa namiji wanda zai sa a riƙa tunawa da ni.” Sai ya kira ginshiƙin da sunansa, ana kuwa kira shi Al’amudin Absalom har wa yau.
english: Now Absalom in his lifetime had taken and reared up for himself the pillar which is in the king’s valley, for he said, “I have no son to keep my name in memory.” He called the pillar after his own name. It is called Absalom’s monument, to this day.

hausa: Waɗannan su ne zuriyar Haruna da Musa a lokacin da Ubangiji ya yi magana da Musa a kan Dutsen Sinai.
english: Now this is the history of the generations of Aaron and Moses in the day that Yahweh spoke with Moses in Mount Sinai.

hausa: sai matata ta niƙa hatsin wani kuma waɗansu maza su kwana da ita.
english: then let my wife grind for another, and let others sleep with her.

hausa: ya yi alkukai na zinariya zalla (Biyar a dama, biyar kuma a hagu, a gaban wuri mai tsarki na can cikin); ya yi zāne-zānen furannin zinariya da fitilu da kuma arautaki;
english: and the lamp stands, five on the right side and five on the left, in front of the inner sanctuary, of pure gold; and the flowers, the lamps, and the tongs, of gold;

hausa: Ba dukan mutane ne suka gan shi ba, amma ta wurin shaidun da Allah ya riga ya zaɓa, ta wurinmu da muka ci muka kuma sha tare da shi bayan tashinsa daga matattu.
english: not to all the people, but to witnesses who were chosen before by God, to us, who ate and drank with him after he rose from the dead.

hausa: Amma da yake ba su da saiwa, ba sa daɗewa. Da wahala ko tsanani ya tashi saboda maganar, nan da nan, sai su ja da baya.
english: They have no root in themselves, but are short-lived. When oppression or persecution arises because of the word, immediately they stumble.

hausa: Ubangiji ya cika abin da ya yi magana ta wurina. Ubangiji ya fizge mulki daga hannunka, ya ba maƙwabcinka Dawuda.
english: Yahweh has done to you as he spoke by me. Yahweh has torn the kingdom out of your hand and given it to your neighbor, even to David.

hausa: Shimeyi ɗan Ela, shi ne a Benyamin;
english: Shimei the son of Ela, in Benjamin;

hausa: Saboda haka ga abin da Ubangiji, Ubangiji Allah Maɗaukaki yana cewa, “Za a yi kururuwa a dukan tituna a kuma yi kuka don azaba a dukan wuraren da jama’a sukan taru. Za a yi kira ga manoma su yi kuka masu makoki kuma su yi kuka.
english: Therefore Yahweh, the God of Armies, the Lord, says: “Wailing will be in all the wide ways. They will say in all the streets, ‘Alas! Alas!’ They will call the farmer to mourning, and those who are skillful in lamentation to wailing.

hausa: Sauran man a tafin hannunsa firist zai sa a kan wanda za a tsabtaccen ya kuma yi kafara dominsa a gaban Ubangiji.
english: The rest of the oil that is in the priest’s hand he shall put on the head of him who is to be cleansed, and the priest shall make atonement for him before Yahweh.

hausa: Game da wannan jikina yana ciwo, zafi ya kama ni, kamar na mace mai naƙuda; na razana game da abin da na ji, na yi mamakin abin da na gani.
english: Therefore my thighs are filled with anguish. Pains have seized me, like the pains of a woman in labor. I am in so much pain that I can’t hear. I am so dismayed that I can’t see.

hausa: Kamar yadda idanun bayi suna duban hannun maigidansu, kamar yadda idanun baiwa suna duban hannun uwargijiyarta, haka idanunmu suna duban Ubangiji Allahnmu, sai ya nuna mana jinƙansa.
english: Behold, as the eyes of servants look to the hand of their master, as the eyes of a maid to the hand of her mistress, so our eyes look to Yahweh, our God, until he has mercy on us.

hausa: waɗanda duk wanda ya yi kisankai, in ba da gangan ba ne ya kashe maƙwabcinsa, wanda babu ƙiyayya tsakaninsu a dā, zai iya gudu zuwa. Zai iya gudu zuwa cikin ɗaya daga waɗannan birane, yă tsira da ransa.
english: that the man slayer might flee there, who kills his neighbor unintentionally and didn’t hate him in time past, and that fleeing to one of these cities he might live:

hausa: In da ikon Be’elzebub nake fitar da su, to, da ikon wa masu binku suke fitar da su? Saboda haka, za su zama alƙalanku ke nan.
english: But if I cast out demons by Beelzebul, by whom do your children cast them out? Therefore they will be your judges.

hausa: Amma in an sa ruwa a irin sai kuma gawar ta fāɗi a kai, to, irin ya zama haram gare ku.
english: But if water is put on the seed, and part of their carcass falls on it, it is unclean to you.

hausa: In ma ya janye zuwa cikin birni, sai dukan Isra’ila su kawo igiyoyi wa wannan birni, su ja shi zuwa kwari yă wargaje, yadda ba za a bar wani dutse a kan wani ba.”
english: Moreover, if he has gone into a city, then all Israel will bring ropes to that city, and we will draw it into the river, until there isn’t one small stone found there.”

hausa: Ga wani yin ayyukan banmamaki, ga wani annabci, ga wani baiwar rarrabe ruhohi, ga wani baiwar magana da harsuna dabam-dabam, ga wani har wa yau iya fassarar harsuna.
english: and to another workings of miracles, and to another prophecy, and to another discerning of spirits, to another different kinds of languages, and to another the interpretation of languages.

hausa: Za ka taka zaki da gamsheƙa; za ka tattake babban zaki da maciji.
english: You will tread on the lion and cobra. You will trample the young lion and the serpent underfoot.

hausa: “Ka gina bagade da itacen ƙirya, mai tsawo kamu uku, zai zama murabba’i, mai tsawo kamu biyar, fāɗi kuma kamu biyar.
english: “You shall make the altar of acacia wood, five cubits long, and five cubits wide. The altar shall be square. Its height shall be three cubits.

hausa: A kan wannan dutse Ubangiji Maɗaukaki zai shirya bikin abinci mai kyau don dukan mutane, liyafar ajiyayyen ruwan inabi da nama mafi kyau da ruwan inabi mafi kyau.
english: In this mountain, Yahweh of Armies will make all peoples a feast of choice meat, a feast of choice wines, of choice meat full of marrow, of well refined choice wines.

hausa: Sarki Solomon ya ba sarauniyar Sheba duk abin da take so da kuma ta nema; ya ba ta fiye da abin da ta kawo masa. Sa’an nan ta tashi ta koma ƙasarta tare da masu rufe mata baya.
english: King Solomon gave to the queen of Sheba all her desire, whatever she asked, more than that which she had brought to the king. So she turned and went to her own land, she and her servants.

hausa: sai shi wanda ya kawo hadayar yă miƙa wa Ubangiji hadaya ta gari mai laushi mai kyau, kashi ɗaya bisa goma na efa wanda aka kwaɓa da kwalaba ɗaya na mai.
english: then he who offers his offering shall offer to Yahweh a meal offering of one tenth of an ephah of fine flour mixed with one fourth of a hin of oil.

hausa: Za ka zama da ɓacin rai a mazaunina ko da yake za a yi wa Isra’ila alheri. A zuriyarka ba za a taɓa samun tsohon mutum ba.
english: You will see the affliction of my habitation, in all the wealth which I will give Israel. There shall not be an old man in your house forever.

hausa: Waƙar haurawa. Na tā da idanuna gare ka, gare ka da kursiyinka yake cikin sama.
english: A Song of Ascents. I lift up my eyes to you, you who sit in the heavens.

hausa: Amma ku kula! Na dai gaya muku kome tun da wuri.
english: But you watch. “Behold, I have told you all things beforehand.

hausa: Suka roƙi Festus a gaggauce a matsayin alfarma gare su, da yă sa a mai da Bulus Urushalima, gama sun ’yan kwanto su kashe shi a hanya.
english: asking a favor against him, that he would summon him to Jerusalem, plotting to kill him on the way.

hausa: Gama ya ce, “ ‘Ta wurin ƙarfin hannuna ne na aikata wannan, da kuma ta wurin hikimata, gama ina da fahimi. Na kau da iyakokin ƙasashe, na washe dukiyarsu; a matsayina na mai iko, na mamaye sarakunansu.
english: For he has said, “By the strength of my hand I have done it, and by my wisdom, for I have understanding. I have removed the boundaries of the peoples, and have robbed their treasures. Like a valiant man I have brought down their rulers.

hausa: wurin ajiye fitila da yake don fitilu da kayayyakinsa, fitilu da mai don fitila;
english: the lamp stand also for the light, with its vessels, its lamps, and the oil for the light;

hausa: Amma bayan Uzziya ya zama mai iko, sai ɗaga kai ya kai shi ga fāɗuwa. Bai yi aminci ga Ubangiji Allahnsa ba, ya kuma shiga haikalin Ubangiji don yă ƙone turare a bagaden turare.
english: But when he was strong, his heart was lifted up, so that he did corruptly and he trespassed against Yahweh his God, for he went into Yahweh’s temple to burn incense on the altar of incense.

hausa: Da yake kai ne dutsena da kuma kagarata, saboda sunanka ka bi da ni ka kuma jagorance ni.
english: For you are my rock and my fortress, therefore for your name’s sake lead me and guide me.

hausa: Duba, ina da ’ya’ya mata biyu waɗanda ba su taɓa sanin namiji ba, bari in kawo muku su ku yi kome da kuke so da su. Amma kada ku taɓa waɗannan mutane, gama su baƙina ne kuma dole in tsare su.”
english: See now, I have two virgin daughters. Please let me bring them out to you, and you may do to them what seems good to you. Only don’t do anything to these men, because they have come under the shadow of my roof.”

hausa: Ya umarce mu mu yi wa’azi ga mutane mu kuma shaida cewa shi ne wanda Allah ya naɗa yă zama mai shari’a na masu rai da na matattu.
english: He commanded us to preach to the people and to testify that this is he who is appointed by God as the Judge of the living and the dead.

hausa: Ku mazaunan Maresha Ubangiji zai kawo wanda zai ci ku da yaƙi. Sarakunan Isra’ila za su gudu zuwa Adullam.
english: I will yet bring a conqueror to you, inhabitants of Mareshah. The glory of Israel will come to Adullam.

hausa: yanzu kuwa na kawo ’ya’yan fari na gonar da kai, ya Ubangiji ka ba ni.” Sai ku sa kwandon a gaban Ubangiji Allahnku, sa’an nan ku rusuna a gabansa.
english: Now, behold, I have brought the first of the fruit of the ground, which you, Yahweh, have given me.” You shall set it down before Yahweh your God, and worship before Yahweh your God.

hausa: To, akwai wani bawa na gidan Shawulu mai suna Ziba. Sai aka kira shi yă bayyana a gaban Dawuda, sarki ya ce masa, “Kai ne Ziba?” Sai ya ce, “I, ni ne, ranka yă daɗe.”
english: There was of Saul’s house a servant whose name was Ziba, and they called him to David; and the king said to him, “Are you Ziba?” He said, “I am your servant.”

hausa: Ya kuwa mutu yadda Ubangiji ya faɗa ta bakin Iliya. Da yake Ahaziya ba shi da ɗa, sai Yoram ya gāje shi, ya zama sarki a shekara ta biyu ta mulkin Yehoram, ɗan Yehoshafat, sarkin Yahuda.
english: So he died according to Yahweh’s word which Elijah had spoken. Jehoram began to reign in his place in the second year of Jehoram the son of Jehoshaphat king of Judah, because he had no son.

hausa: Abokan gābansu suka danne su suka sa su a ƙarƙashin ikonsu.
english: Their enemies also oppressed them. They were brought into subjection under their hand.

hausa: Kwaɗin za su bar ka da gidajenka, bayinka da mutanenka; za su kasance a Nilu ne kaɗai.”
english: The frogs shall depart from you, and from your houses, and from your servants, and from your people. They shall remain in the river only.”

hausa: Ubangiji kamar maƙiyi ne; ya hallaka Isra’ila. Ya hallaka wurarenta duka ya kuma hallaka kagaranta. Ya ƙara yawan makoki da baƙin ciki wa Diyar Yahuda.
english: The Lord has become as an enemy. He has swallowed up Israel. He has swallowed up all her palaces. He has destroyed his strongholds. He has multiplied mourning and lamentation in the daughter of Judah.

hausa: Sa’ad da kuka kakkaɓe ’ya’yan zaitun daga itatuwanku, kada ku yi kalan abin da ya rage. Ku bar shi don baƙo, maraya da kuma gwauruwa.
english: When you beat your olive tree, you shall not go over the boughs again. It shall be for the foreigner, for the fatherless, and for the widow.

hausa: Saboda haka Farisiyawa suka tambaye shi yadda ya sami ganin gari. Mutumin ya amsa, “Ya shafa laka a idanuna, sai na wanke, ina kuwa gani.”
english: Again therefore the Pharisees also asked him how he received his sight. He said to them, “He put mud on my eyes, I washed, and I see.”

hausa: Akwai mutane a garuruwa da yawa waɗanda aka sa don su rarraba wa ’ya’yan Haruna, firist, maza, waɗanda suke zaune a gonaki na ƙasar garuruwansu su ba kowane namijin da aka rubuta na Lawiyawa, rabonsa.
english: Also for the sons of Aaron the priests, who were in the fields of the pasture lands of their cities, in every city, there were men who were mentioned by name to give portions to all the males among the priests and to all who were listed by genealogy among the Levites.

hausa: Yesu ya ce musu, “Sarakunan Al’ummai suna nuna iko a kan mutanensu, kuma waɗanda suke nuna iko a kansu, suna kiran kansu Masu Taimakon mutane.
english: He said to them, “The kings of the nations lord it over them, and those who have authority over them are called ‘benefactors.’

hausa: Sai Musa ya miƙa hannunsa sama, aka kuma yi duhu baƙi ƙirin bisa dukan ƙasar Masar na kwana uku.
english: Moses stretched out his hand toward the sky, and there was a thick darkness in all the land of Egypt for three days.

hausa: Ubangiji mai aminci ne, zai ƙarfafa ku, yă kuma tsare ku daga mugun nan.
english: But the Lord is faithful, who will establish you and guard you from the evil one.

hausa: Kamar sunanka, ya Allah, yabonka ya kai iyakokin duniya; hannunka na dama ya cika da adalci.
english: As is your name, God, so is your praise to the ends of the earth. Your right hand is full of righteousness.

hausa: Babu sarkin da ake ceto ta wurin yawan mayaƙansa; ba jarumin da kan kuɓuta ta wurin yawan ƙarfinsa.
english: There is no king saved by the multitude of an army. A mighty man is not delivered by great strength.

hausa: Garayata ta zama ta makoki, sarewata kuma ta zama ta kuka.
english: Therefore my harp has turned to mourning, and my pipe into the voice of those who weep.

hausa: Sai Asa ya huta tare da kakanninsa, aka kuma binne shi tare da su a birnin kakansa Dawuda. Sai Yehoshafat ɗansa ya gāje shi a matsayin sarki.
english: Asa slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in his father David’s city; and Jehoshaphat his son reigned in his place.

hausa: Ƙuri’a ta farko ta faɗa a kan Yehoyarib, na biyu a kan Yedahiya,
english: Now the first lot came out to Jehoiarib, the second to Jedaiah,

hausa: Na faɗa wa ’ya’yansu a hamada, “Kada ku bi farillai kakanninku ko ku kiyaye dokokinsu ko ku ƙazantar da kanku da gumakansu.
english: I said to their children in the wilderness, ‘Don’t walk in the statutes of your fathers. Don’t observe their ordinances or defile yourselves with their idols.

hausa: “ ‘Sa’ad da aka tsabtacce mai ɗigar, zai ɗauki kwana bakwai don tsabtaccewarsa; dole yă wanke rigunansa, yă kuma yi wanka mai tsabta, zai kuwa zama tsarkakakke.
english: “‘When he who has a discharge is cleansed of his discharge, then he shall count to himself seven days for his cleansing, and wash his clothes; and he shall bathe his flesh in running water, and shall be clean.

hausa: Jimillar dukan waɗanda suke na kabilan Kohatawa, waɗanda suka yi hidimar aiki a Tentin Sujada ke nan. Musa da Haruna sun ƙidaya su bisa ga umarnin Ubangiji.
english: These are those who were counted of the families of the Kohathites, all who served in the Tent of Meeting, whom Moses and Aaron counted according to the commandment of Yahweh by Moses.

hausa: Gama yana ƙarfafa ƙyamaren ƙofofinki yana kuma albarkace mutanenki a cikinki.
english: For he has strengthened the bars of your gates. He has blessed your children within you.

hausa: Da na zo wurinku ’yan’uwa, ban zo da iya magana ko wani mafificin hikima yayinda na yi muku shelar shaida game da Allah ba.
english: When I came to you, brothers, I didn’t come with excellence of speech or of wisdom, proclaiming to you the testimony of God.

hausa: Yaƙub ya ce, “Ina roƙonka, faɗa mini sunanka.” Amma mutumin ya amsa ya ce, “Me ya sa kake tambayata sunana?” Sa’an nan ya albarkace shi.
english: Jacob asked him, “Please tell me your name.” He said, “Why is it that you ask what my name is?” So he blessed him there.

hausa: Sai ya ce mata, “Diyata, bangaskiyarki ta warkar da ke. Ki sauka lafiya, kin kuma rabu da dukan wahalarki.”
english: He said to her, “Daughter, your faith has made you well. Go in peace, and be cured of your disease.”

hausa: Yayir, wani ɗan Manasse, ya ci ƙauyukansu da yaƙi, ya kuma ba su sunan Hawwot Yayir.
english: Jair the son of Manasseh went and took its villages, and called them Havvoth Jair.

hausa: “Zan hallaka mutane da dabbobi; zan kuma hallaka tsuntsayen sama da kifayen teku, da gumakan da suke sa mugaye su yi tuntuɓe.” “Sa’ad da zan kawar da mutum daga fuskar duniya,” in ji Ubangiji.
english: I will sweep away man and animal. I will sweep away the birds of the sky, the fish of the sea, and the heaps of rubble with the wicked. I will cut off man from the surface of the earth, says Yahweh.

hausa: “Mutane suna kuka don yawan zalunci; suna roƙo don taimako daga hannu mai ƙarfi.
english: “By reason of the multitude of oppressions they cry out. They cry for help by reason of the arm of the mighty.

hausa: Biye da shi, Malkiya, ɗaya daga cikin masu ƙera zinariya ya yi gyare-gyaren har zuwa gidan masu hidimar haikali da kuma ’yan kasuwa, ɗaura da Ƙofar Bincike, har zuwa ɗakin da yake bisa kusurwar.
english: After him, Malchijah, one of the goldsmiths to the house of the temple servants, and of the merchants, made repairs opposite the gate of Hammiphkad and to the ascent of the corner.

hausa: Ya warkar da masu raunanar zuciya ya ɗaɗɗaura miyakunsu.
english: He heals the broken in heart, and binds up their wounds.

hausa: Sai shi da almajiransa suka tafi wani ƙauye.
english: For the Son of Man didn’t come to destroy men’s lives, but to save them.” They went to another village.

hausa: da Resen, wadda take tsakanin Ninebe da Kala; wanda yake babban birni.
english: and Resen between Nineveh and the great city Calah.

hausa: Sa’an nan na ce, “Ku kasa kunne, ku shugabannin Yaƙub, ku masu mulkin gidan Isra’ila. Ya kamata ku san shari’a,
english: I said, “Please listen, you heads of Jacob, and rulers of the house of Israel: Isn’t it for you to know justice?

hausa: Amma tabbatacce, an tā da Kiristi daga matattu, nunan fari kuwa cikin waɗanda suka yi barci.
english: But now Christ has been raised from the dead. He became the first fruit of those who are asleep.

hausa: Sai Haruna ya ajiye Mannar a gaban Akwatin Alkawari, don a adana ta kamar yadda Ubangiji ya umarci Musa.
english: As Yahweh commanded Moses, so Aaron laid it up before the Testimony, to be kept.

hausa: sai ka ji daga sama, mazauninka. Ka gafarta, ka kuma yi wani abu. Ka yi da kowane mutum bisa ga dukan abin da ya yi, tun da yake ka san zuciyarsa (gama kai kaɗai ka san zukatan dukan mutane),
english: then hear in heaven, your dwelling place, and forgive, and act, and give to every man according to all his ways, whose heart you know (for you, even you only, know the hearts of all the children of men);

hausa: Sai muka sami wani jirgin ruwa da zai ƙetare zuwa Funisiya, sai muka shiga muka kama tafiya.
english: Having found a ship crossing over to Phoenicia, we went aboard and set sail.

hausa: Saboda haka sai sarki ya ba da umarni suka kuma kawo Daniyel suka jefa shi cikin ramin zakoki. Sarki ya ce wa Daniyel, “Bari Allahn nan wanda kake bauta masa kullum, yă cece ka!”
english: Then the king commanded, and they brought Daniel and cast him into the den of lions. The king spoke and said to Daniel, “Your God whom you serve continually, he will deliver you.”

hausa: Bilatus ya yi tambaya ya ce, “Kai ne Sarkin Yahudawa?” Yesu ya amsa ya ce, “I, haka yake, kamar yadda ka faɗa.”
english: Pilate asked him, “Are you the King of the Jews?” He answered, “So you say.”

hausa: tă ci gaba zuwa Zifron, sa’an nan tă ƙarasa a Hazar-Enan. Wannan ce za tă zama iyakarku a arewa.
english: Then the border shall go to Ziphron, and it shall end at Hazar Enan. This shall be your north border.

hausa: Sun yi kasai da ransu saboda ni. Ba ni kaɗai nake musu godiya ba amma har ma da dukan ikkilisiyoyin Al’ummai.
english: who risked their own necks for my life, to whom not only I give thanks, but also all the assemblies of the Gentiles.

hausa: Zan ba su zuciya don su san ni, cewa ni ne Ubangiji. Za su zama mutanena, zan zama Allahnsu, gama za su komo gare ni da dukan zuciyarsu.
english: I will give them a heart to know me, that I am Yahweh. They will be my people, and I will be their God; for they will return to me with their whole heart.

hausa: Sai waɗansu mutane suka zo suka faɗa wa Yehoshafat, “Ga babban runduna tana zuwa a kanka daga Edom, daga ƙetaren Teku, daga Aram. Ta ma kai Hazazon Tamar” (wato, En Gedi).
english: Then some came who told Jehoshaphat, saying, “A great multitude is coming against you from beyond the sea from Syria. Behold, they are in Hazazon Tamar” (that is, En Gedi).

hausa: Ya isa wa ɗalibi yă zama kamar malaminsa, haka ma bawa kamar maigidansa. In har an kira wanda yake kan gida Be’elzebub,me za su ce game da mutanen gidansa?
english: It is enough for the disciple that he be like his teacher, and the servant like his lord. If they have called the master of the house Beelzebul, how much more those of his household!

hausa: duwatsun onis, da sauran duwatsu masu daraja waɗanda za a mammanne a efod da ƙyallen maƙalawa a ƙirji.
english: onyx stones, and stones to be set for the ephod and for the breastplate.

hausa: Amma mutanen ba su kasa kunne ba. Manasse ya ɓad da su, har suka yi muguntar da ta fi ta al’umman da Ubangiji ya hallaka a gaban Isra’ilawa.
english: But they didn’t listen, and Manasseh seduced them to do that which is evil more than the nations did whom Yahweh destroyed before the children of Israel.

hausa: Amma ba su saurara ba, suka nace da ayyukansu na dā.
english: However they didn’t listen, but they did what they did before.

hausa: ta Ater (ta wurin Hezekiya) 98
english: The children of Ater, of Hezekiah, ninety-eight.

hausa: Bayan kun auna ƙasar, ku raba ta kashi bakwai, sai ku kawo mini taswirar ƙasar. Ni kuma in yi muku ƙuri’a a gaban Ubangiji Allahnmu.
english: You shall survey the land into seven parts, and bring the description here to me; and I will cast lots for you here before Yahweh our God.

hausa: Saboda haka, muddin ina raye,” in ji Ubangiji Maɗaukaki, Allah na Isra’ila, “tabbatacce Mowab za tă zama kamar Sodom, Ammonawa kuma kamar Gomorra, ƙasa mai ciyayi da rammukan gishiri, ƙasa marar amfani har abada. Raguwar mutanena za su washe su; waɗanda suka rage na al’ummata za su gāda ƙasarsu.”
english: Therefore, as I live, says Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel, surely Moab will be as Sodom, and the children of Ammon as Gomorrah, a possession of nettles and salt pits, and a perpetual desolation. The remnant of my people will plunder them, and the survivors of my nation will inherit them.

hausa: Sun kewaye ni a kowane gefe, amma a cikin sunan Ubangiji na hallaka su.
english: They surrounded me, yes, they surrounded me. In Yahweh’s name I indeed cut them off.

hausa: Dattawan Diyar Sihiyona sun zauna shiru a ƙasa; suka kuma sa rigar buhu. ’Yan matan Urushalima suka sunkuyar da kawunansu ƙasa.
english: The elders of the daughter of Zion sit on the ground. They keep silence. They have cast up dust on their heads. They have clothed themselves with sackcloth. The virgins of Jerusalem hang down their heads to the ground.

hausa: Yowash ya aikata abin da yake daidai a idon Ubangiji domin Yehohiyada firist ya koya masa.
english: Jehoash did that which was right in Yahweh’s eyes all his days in which Jehoiada the priest instructed him.

hausa: sai ya fara koya musu. Yana cewa,
english: He opened his mouth and taught them, saying,

hausa: Ya naɗa shi sarkin Gileyad, da na Ashuri, da na Yezireyel, da a kan Efraim, da Benyamin, da kuma na dukan Isra’ila.
english: He made him king over Gilead, over the Ashurites, over Jezreel, over Ephraim, over Benjamin, and over all Israel.

hausa: Tabbatacce kuwa, zan ɓoye musu fuskata saboda muguntar da suka aikata, suka kuma bi gumaka.
english: I will surely hide my face in that day for all the evil which they have done, in that they have turned to other gods.

hausa: Bayan an daɗe sai matar Yahuda, ’yar Shuwa ta rasu. Sa’ad da Yahuda ya gama makoki, sai ya haura zuwa Timna, zuwa wurin mutanen da suke askin tumakinsa, abokinsa Hira mutumin Adullam kuwa ya tafi tare da shi.
english: After many days, Shua’s daughter, the wife of Judah, died. Judah was comforted, and went up to his sheep shearers to Timnah, he and his friend Hirah, the Adullamite.

hausa: Game da sauran ayyukan mulkin Solomon, daga farko har zuwa ƙarshe, an rubuta su a cikin tarihin annabi Natan, cikin annabcin Ahiya mutumin Shilo da kuma cikin wahayin Iddo mai gani game da Yerobowam ɗan Nebat.
english: Now the rest of the acts of Solomon, first and last, aren’t they written in the history of Nathan the prophet, and in the prophecy of Ahijah the Shilonite, and in the visions of Iddo the seer concerning Jeroboam the son of Nebat?

hausa: Daga zuriyar Bani, akwai Ma’adai, Amram, Yuwel,
english: Of the sons of Bani: Maadai, Amram, Uel,

hausa: Ayyukan Ubangiji da girma suke; dukan waɗanda suke farin ciki da su suna tunaninsu.
english: Yahweh’s works are great, pondered by all those who delight in them.

hausa: Ahaz shi ne mahaifin Yehowadda, Yehowadda shi ne mahaifin Alemet, Azmawet da Zimri, Zimri kuwa shi ne mahaifin Moza.
english: Ahaz became the father of Jehoaddah. Jehoaddah became the father of Alemeth, Azmaveth, and Zimri. Zimri became the father of Moza.

hausa: Saboda haka Dawuda ya yi kamar yadda Allah ya umarce shi, suka kuma bugi mayaƙan Filistiyawa, tun daga Gibeyon har zuwa Gezer.
english: David did as God commanded him; and they attacked the army of the Philistines from Gibeon even to Gezer.

hausa: Yă yi ta malala har zuwa cikin Yahuda, yă shafe ta, yana ratsa ta ciki har yă kai kafaɗa. Fikafikansa da ya buɗe za su rufe fāɗin ƙasarka, Ya Immanuwel!”
english: It will sweep onward into Judah. It will overflow and pass through. It will reach even to the neck. The stretching out of its wings will fill the width of your land, O Immanuel.

hausa: in ya mayar da jingina, ya mayar da abin da ya sata, ya kiyaye ƙa’idodin da suke ba da rai, ya daina yin mugunta, tabbatacce zai rayu; ba zai mutu ba.
english: if the wicked restore the pledge, give again that which he had taken by robbery, walk in the statutes of life, committing no iniquity, he will surely live. He will not die.

hausa: Sa’an nan mala’ikan ya ce masa, “Ka sa rigunarka da takalmanka.” Bitrus kuwa ya sa. Mala’ikan ya faɗa masa cewa, “Ka yafa mayafinka ka bi ni.”
english: The angel said to him, “Get dressed and put on your sandals.” He did so. He said to him, “Put on your cloak and follow me.”

hausa: Ubangiji mai yaƙi ne Ubangiji ne sunansa.
english: Yahweh is a man of war. Yahweh is his name.

hausa: A rigunanku mutane kan sami jinin matalauta marasa laifi, ko da yake ba ku kama su suna fasawa su shiga ba. Duk da haka
english: Also the blood of the souls of the innocent poor is found in your skirts. You didn’t find them breaking in, but it is because of all these things.

hausa: Ubangiji kuwa ya ce, “Ka saurare su, ka naɗa masu sarki.” Sa’an nan Sama’ila ya ce wa mutanen Isra’ila, “Kowa yă koma garinsa.”
english: Yahweh said to Samuel, “Listen to their voice, and make them a king.” Samuel said to the men of Israel, “Everyone go to your own city.”

hausa: Muna kuwa da maganar annabawa da aka ƙara tabbatar mana, zai fi kyau in kuka lura da ita, kamar hasken da yake haskakawa a wuri mai duhu, har yă zuwa wayewar gari da kuma haskakawar tauraron asubahi a zukatanku.
english: We have the more sure word of prophecy; and you do well that you heed it as to a lamp shining in a dark place, until the day dawns and the morning star arises in your hearts,

hausa: Tsoron Ubangiji yakan koya wa mutum hikima, kuma sauƙinkai kan zo kafin girmamawa.
english: The fear of Yahweh teaches wisdom. Before honor is humility.

hausa: Duba, Ubangiji yana fitowa daga mazauninsa don yă hukunta mutanen duniya saboda zunubansu. Duniya za tă bayyana zub da jinin da aka yi a kanta; ba za tă ƙara ɓoye waɗanda aka kashe a cikinta ba.
english: For, behold, Yahweh comes out of his place to punish the inhabitants of the earth for their iniquity. The earth also will disclose her blood, and will no longer cover her slain.

hausa: Ranar gina katangarka tana zuwa, a ranar za a fadada iyakokinka.
english: A day to build your walls! In that day, he will extend your boundary.

hausa: Sa’ad da dukan Isra’ila suka ji hukuncin da sarki ya zartar, suka girmama sarki sosai, domin sun gane cewa Allah ya ba shi hikimar yin shari’ar adalci.
english: All Israel heard of the judgment which the king had judged; and they feared the king, for they saw that the wisdom of God was in him to do justice.

hausa: Ka sa tebur a gaba labulen, a gefen arewa na tabanakul, ka kuma sa wurin ajiye fitilan ɗaura da shi, a wajen kudu.
english: You shall set the table outside the veil, and the lamp stand opposite the table on the side of the tabernacle toward the south. You shall put the table on the north side.

hausa: Da Yesu ya fita daga can, sai waɗansu makafi biyu suka bi shi, suna kira, suna cewa, “Ka yi mana jinƙai, Ɗan Dawuda!”
english: As Jesus passed by from there, two blind men followed him, calling out and saying, “Have mercy on us, son of David!”

hausa: Gama sa’ad da ka aikata abubuwan bantsoron da ba mu sa tsammani ba, ka sauko, duwatsu kuma suka yi rawar jiki a gabanka.
english: When you did awesome things which we didn’t look for, you came down, and the mountains quaked at your presence.

hausa: Tsayinsu ya fi tsawon duniya da kuma fāɗin teku.
english: Its measure is longer than the earth, and broader than the sea.

hausa: “Duk da haka zan maido da wadatar Mowab a kwanaki masu zuwa,” in ji Ubangiji. A nan hukuncin Mowab ya ƙare.
english: “Yet I will reverse the captivity of Moab in the latter days,” says Yahweh. Thus far is the judgment of Moab.

hausa: kowane ’yan raguna bakwai, kashi ɗaya bisa goma.
english: and one tenth for every lamb of the seven lambs;

hausa: ’Ya’yan Issakar maza su ne, Tola, Fuwa, Yashub da Shimron, su huɗu ne duka.
english: Of the sons of Issachar: Tola, Puah, Jashub, and Shimron, four.

hausa: Sa’ad da suka kama ka da hannuwansu, ka tsattsage, ka kuma buɗu a kafaɗunsu; sa’ad da suka jingina a kanka, sai ka karye, bayansu kuwa ya firgita.
english: When they took hold of you by your hand, you broke and tore all their shoulders. When they leaned on you, you broke and paralyzed all of their thighs.”

hausa: Ka tuna, ya Ubangiji, abin da ya faru da mu; duba, ka ga kunyar da muka sha.
english: Remember, Yahweh, what has come on us. Look, and see our reproach.

hausa: Na zo lambuna, ’yar’uwata, amaryata; na tattara mur nawa da kayan yajina. Na sha zumana da kuma kakinsa na sha ruwan inabina da kuma madarana. Ƙawaye Ku ci, ku kuma sha, ya ku ƙawaye; ku sha ku ƙoshi, ya ƙaunatattu.
english: I have come into my garden, my sister, my bride. I have gathered my myrrh with my spice; I have eaten my honeycomb with my honey; I have drunk my wine with my milk. Friends Eat, friends! Drink, yes, drink abundantly, beloved.

hausa: Ƙarafansu da suka yi kamar zobe sun yi tsayi suna kuma da bantsoro, dukan ƙarafan nan huɗu kuwa da suka yi kamar zobe suna cike da idanu a kewaye.
english: As for their rims, they were high and dreadful; and the four of them had their rims full of eyes all around.

hausa: Zan furta hukunci a kan mutanena saboda muguntarsu na yashe ni, suna ƙona turare ga waɗansu alloli suna kuma bauta wa abin da hannuwansu suka yi.
english: I will utter my judgments against them concerning all their wickedness, in that they have forsaken me, and have burned incense to other gods, and worshiped the works of their own hands.

hausa: Duk inda na tafi tare da Isra’ilawa, na taɓa ce wa wani daga cikin shugabanninsu waɗanda na umarta su yi kiwon mutanena, “Don me ba ku gida mini gidan al’ul ba?” ’
english: In all places in which I have walked with all Israel, did I speak a word with any of the judges of Israel, whom I commanded to be shepherd of my people, saying, ‘Why have you not built me a house of cedar?’”’

hausa: Da Sama’ila ya hangi Shawulu, Ubangiji ya ce masa, “Ga mutumin da na yi maka magana, shi ne zai bi da mutanena.”
english: When Samuel saw Saul, Yahweh said to him, “Behold, the man of whom I spoke to you! He will have authority over my people.”

hausa: Sassan firistoci da na Lawiyawa suna a shirye domin dukan aiki a haikalin Allah, kuma kowane gwani mai niyya a kowace sana’a, zai taimake ka a cikin dukan aikin. Shugabanni da dukan mutane za su yi biyayya da kowane umarninka.”
english: Behold, there are the divisions of the priests and the Levites for all the service of God’s house. Every willing man who has skill for any kind of service shall be with you in all kinds of work. Also the captains and all the people will be entirely at your command.”

hausa: Darajarka tana da haske, fiye da darajar tuddai waɗanda suke cike da namun jeji masu yawa.
english: Glorious are you, and excellent, more than mountains of game.

hausa: Don ba su da tufafi suna yawo tsirara; suna dakon dammunan hatsi amma duk da haka suna cikin shan yunwa.
english: so that they go around naked without clothing. Being hungry, they carry the sheaves.

hausa: Duba, na tace ku, ko da yake ba kamar azurfa ba; na gwada ku cikin wutar wahala.
english: Behold, I have refined you, but not as silver. I have chosen you in the furnace of affliction.

hausa: “Yi wa Isra’ilawa magana ka kuma faɗa musu cewa, ‘Ni ne Ubangiji Allahnku.
english: “Speak to the children of Israel, and say to them, ‘I am Yahweh your God.

hausa: saboda haka sai na aika musu da wannan amsa, na ce, “Ina cikin babban aiki, ba zan kuwa iya gangarawa ba. Don me zan bar aikin yă tsaya don in gangara zuwa wurinku?”
english: I sent messengers to them, saying, “I am doing a great work, so that I can’t come down. Why should the work cease while I leave it and come down to you?”

hausa: Mai ɗaukan makaman ya ce, “Ka yi duk abin da yake zuciyarka. Ci gaba, ina tare da kai gaba da baya.”
english: His armor bearer said to him, “Do all that is in your heart. Go, and behold, I am with you according to your heart.”

hausa: Za a iya yin wani amfani da kitsen dabbar da ta mutu mushe, ko kitsen dabbar da namun jeji su yayyaga, amma kada a kuskura a ci.
english: The fat of that which dies of itself, and the fat of that which is torn of animals, may be used for any other service, but you shall in no way eat of it.

hausa: Yahudawa dai suka nace suna cewa, “Mu fa muna da doka, kuma bisa ga dokar dole yă mutu domin ya mai da kansa Ɗan Allah.”
english: The Jews answered him, “We have a law, and by our law he ought to die, because he made himself the Son of God.”

hausa: Balak ya ce wa Bala’am, “Ban aika maka saƙo cikin gagawa ba? Me ya sa ba ka zo ba? Ko ban isa in sāka maka ba ne?”
english: Balak said to Balaam, “Didn’t I earnestly send for you to summon you? Why didn’t you come to me? Am I not able indeed to promote you to honor?”

hausa: “Don haka ina faɗa muku, ku roƙa, za a ba ku, ku nema za ku samu, ku ƙwanƙwasa za a kuwa buɗe muku ƙofa.
english: “I tell you, keep asking, and it will be given you. Keep seeking, and you will find. Keep knocking, and it will be opened to you.

hausa: Cikin kwana uku, Fir’auna zai fitar da kai, yă maido da kai a matsayinka, za ka kuwa sa kwaf Fir’auna cikin hannunsa, kamar yadda ka saba yi sa’ad da kake mai riƙon kwaf nasa.
english: Within three more days, Pharaoh will lift up your head, and restore you to your office. You will give Pharaoh’s cup into his hand, the way you did when you were his cup bearer.

hausa: Kuka kuma ce, “Ubangiji Allahnmu ya nuna mana ɗaukakarsa da zatinsa, mun kuma ji muryarsa a tsakiyar wutar. A yau mun ga cewa mutum zai iya rayu idan ma Allah ya yi magana da shi.
english: and you said, “Behold, Yahweh our God has shown us his glory and his greatness, and we have heard his voice out of the middle of the fire. We have seen today that God does speak with man, and he lives.

hausa: Amma wanda yake mai arziki, ya kamata yă yi taƙama a matsayinsa na ƙasƙanci, gama ba zai daɗe ba kamar furen jeji.
english: and the rich, in that he is made humble, because like the flower in the grass, he will pass away.

hausa: Saboda haka, ina muku shela a yau cewa ba ni da alhakin kowa a kaina.
english: Therefore I testify to you today that I am clean from the blood of all men,

hausa: Yayinda suna cikin sujada da azumi ga Ubangiji, Ruhu Mai Tsarki ya ce, “Ku keɓe mini Barnabas da Shawulu domin aikin da na kira su.”
english: As they served the Lord and fasted, the Holy Spirit said, “Separate Barnabas and Saul for me, for the work to which I have called them.”

hausa: Saboda haka na faɗa waɗannan abubuwa tuntuni; kafin su faru na yi shelarsu gare ku saboda kada ku ce, ‘Gumakana ne suka yi su; siffar itacena da allahn zinariyana ne ya ƙaddara su.’
english: therefore I have declared it to you from of old; before it came to pass I showed it to you; lest you should say, ‘My idol has done them. My engraved image and my molten image has commanded them.’

hausa: Waɗansu Sadukiyawa da suke cewa, ba tashin matattu, suka zo wurin Yesu da tambaya cewa,
english: Some of the Sadducees came to him, those who deny that there is a resurrection.

hausa: Kun jawo mini kunya a cikin mutanena don a tafa muku sha’ir da ɗan dunƙulen burodi. Ta wurin yin ƙarya wa mutanena, waɗanda suke jin ƙarairayi, kuka kashe waɗanda bai kamata su mutu ba kuka bar waɗanda ya kamata su mutu.
english: You have profaned me among my people for handfuls of barley and for pieces of bread, to kill the souls who should not die and to save the souls alive who should not live, by your lying to my people who listen to lies.’

hausa: Maganar Ubangiji ta zo mini cewa,
english: Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

hausa: Ubangiji ya amsa ya ce, “Na gafarta musu, yadda ka roƙa.
english: Yahweh said, “I have pardoned according to your word;

hausa: Sa’an nan ya ƙwaƙule idanun Zedekiya ya kuma buga masa ƙuƙumi, ya kai shi Babilon.
english: Moreover he put out Zedekiah’s eyes and bound him in fetters, to carry him to Babylon.

hausa: “Amma mutumin da yake wulaƙanta ɗayan, ya tura Musa a gefe ya ce, ‘Wa ya mai da kai mai mulki, da alƙali a kanmu?
english: But he who did his neighbor wrong pushed him away, saying, ‘Who made you a ruler and a judge over us?

hausa: Ku ƙyale su su yi girma tare sai lokacin girbi. A lokacin zan gaya wa masu girbi, da fari ku tara ciyayin ku kuma daure su dami-dami don a ƙone; sa’an nan ku tara alkamar ku kuma kawo su cikin rumbuna.’ ”
english: Let both grow together until the harvest, and in the harvest time I will tell the reapers, “First, gather up the darnel weeds, and bind them in bundles to burn them; but gather the wheat into my barn.”’”

hausa: In sun yi biyayya suka bauta masa, za su yi rayuwa dukan kwanakinsu cikin wadata shekarunsu kuma cikin kwanciyar zuciya.
english: If they listen and serve him, they will spend their days in prosperity, and their years in pleasures.

hausa: A maimakon sarƙaƙƙiya, itacen fir ne zai tsiro, a maimakon ƙayayyuwa kuma, itacen ci-zaƙi ne zai tsiro. Wannan zai zama matuni na abin da Ni Ubangiji na yi, madawwamiyar alama ce, wadda ba za a datse ba.”
english: Instead of the thorn the cypress tree will come up; and instead of the brier the myrtle tree will come up. It will make a name for Yahweh, for an everlasting sign that will not be cut off.”

hausa: Mutanen suka tsaya suna kallo. Har masu mulki ma suka yi masa ba’a, suna cewa, “Ya ceci waɗansu, to, ya ceci kansa in shi ne Kiristi na Allah, Zaɓaɓɓe.”
english: The people stood watching. The rulers with them also scoffed at him, saying, “He saved others. Let him save himself, if this is the Christ of God, his chosen one!”

hausa: Sa’ad da ya hau kursiyin mulkinsa, sai yă rubuta wa kansa a littafin kofin wannan doka da aka ɗauka daga na firistoci, waɗanda suke Lawiyawa.
english: It shall be, when he sits on the throne of his kingdom, that he shall write himself a copy of this law in a book, out of that which is before the Levitical priests.

hausa: Kowace rana mutane suka riƙa zuwa don su taimaki Dawuda, sai da ya kasance da runduna mai girma, kamar mayaƙan Allah.
english: For from day to day men came to David to help him, until there was a great army, like God’s army.

hausa: na uku a kan Harim, na huɗu a kan Seyorim,
english: the third to Harim, the fourth to Seorim,

hausa: Yana zuwa! Tabbatacce zai faru, in ji Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka. Ranar da na yi magana ke nan.
english: Behold, it comes, and it will be done,” says the Lord Yahweh. “This is the day about which I have spoken.

hausa: Don me al’ummai za su ce, “Ina Allahnsu yake?” A idanunmu, ka sanar wa al’ummai cewa kana ɗaukan fansar jinin bayinka da aka zubar.
english: Why should the nations say, “Where is their God?” Let it be known among the nations, before our eyes, that vengeance for your servants’ blood is being poured out.

hausa: A cikin ƙauna, ya ƙaddara mu zama ’ya’yansa na riƙo ta wurin Kiristi Yesu, bisa ga nufinsa na alheri.
english: having predestined us for adoption as children through Jesus Christ to himself, according to the good pleasure of his desire,

hausa: Kamar yadda yake a rubuce a littafin annabi Ishaya. “Muryar mai kira a hamada, ‘Ku shirya wa Ubangiji hanya, ku miƙe hanyoyi dominsa.
english: As it is written in the book of the words of Isaiah the prophet, “The voice of one crying in the wilderness, ‘Make ready the way of the Lord. Make his paths straight.

hausa: Zedekiya yana da shekara ashirin da ɗaya da ya zama sarki, ya kuma yi mulki shekara goma sha ɗaya a Urushalima. Sunan mahaifiyarsa Hamutal ’yar Irmiya; mutuniyar Libna.
english: Zedekiah was twenty-one years old when he began to reign, and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Hamutal the daughter of Jeremiah of Libnah.

hausa: Yanzu ka rantse mini a nan a gaban Allah cewa, ba za ka yaudare ni ko ’ya’yana ko kuma zuriyata ba. Ka nuna mini alheri, kai da ƙasar da kake zama baƙunci kamar yadda na nuna maka.”
english: Now, therefore, swear to me here by God that you will not deal falsely with me, nor with my son, nor with my son’s son. But according to the kindness that I have done to you, you shall do to me, and to the land in which you have lived as a foreigner.”

hausa: A ranan nan Ubangiji zai sa maza su cika da tsoro ƙwarai. Kowane mutum zai kama hannun ɗan’uwansa, za su kai wa juna hari.
english: It will happen in that day that a great panic from Yahweh will be among them; and they will each seize the hand of his neighbor, and his hand will rise up against the hand of his neighbor.

hausa: Ubangiji yă sa ƙaunarku ta ƙaru ta kuma yalwata ga juna da kuma ga kowa, kamar yadda tamu take muku.
english: May the Lord make you to increase and abound in love toward one another and toward all men, even as we also do toward you,

hausa: Ba su kuma tuba daga kisankansu, sihirinsu, fasikancinsu ko kuma daga sace-sacensu ba.
english: They didn’t repent of their murders, their sorceries, their sexual immorality, or their thefts.

hausa: Sunan macen nan Bamidiyana da aka kashe kuwa Kozbi ne, ’yar Zur, wani basaraken iyalin Midiyawa.
english: The name of the Midianite woman who was slain was Cozbi, the daughter of Zur. He was head of the people of a fathers’ house in Midian.

hausa: Ya yi bakina kamar takobi mai kaifi, cikin inuwar hannunsa ya ɓoye ni; ya sa na zama kamar kibiya mai tsini ya kuma ɓoye ni cikin kwarinsa.
english: He has made my mouth like a sharp sword. He has hidden me in the shadow of his hand. He has made me a polished shaft. He has kept me close in his quiver.

hausa: da ’yan’uwansa, su 128 ne muhimman mutane. Babban shugabansu shi ne Zabdiyel ɗan Haggedolim.
english: and their brothers, mighty men of valor, one hundred twenty-eight; and their overseer was Zabdiel, the son of Haggedolim.

hausa: Yonatan ya ce, “Faufau, ba za ka mutu ba! Ka ji nan, mahaifina ba ya yin kome ba tare da ya shawarce da ni ba. Me ya sa ya ɓoye mini wannan? Ba zai yiwu ba.”
english: He said to him, “Far from it; you will not die. Behold, my father does nothing either great or small, but that he discloses it to me. Why would my father hide this thing from me? It is not so.”

hausa: “Har yanzu, mulkin sama yana kama da abin kamun kifin da aka jefa cikin tafki yă kamo kifi iri-iri.
english: “Again, the Kingdom of Heaven is like a dragnet that was cast into the sea and gathered some fish of every kind,

hausa: Amma sa’ad da hatsi suka nuna, za ku ba da kashi ɗaya bisa biyar ga Fir’auna. Sauran kashi huɗu bisa biyar kuma ku riƙe a matsayin iri don gonaki da kuma abinci wa kanku da gidajenku da kuma ’ya’yanku.”
english: It will happen at the harvests, that you shall give a fifth to Pharaoh, and four parts will be your own, for seed of the field, for your food, for them of your households, and for food for your little ones.”

hausa: Gama kowane gida yana da wanda ya gina shi, amma maginin dukan abu Allah ne.
english: For every house is built by someone; but he who built all things is God.

hausa: “ ‘Gama zan fitar da ku daga al’ummai; zan tattara ku daga dukan ƙasashe in komo da ku zuwa ƙasarku.
english: “‘“For I will take you from among the nations and gather you out of all the countries, and will bring you into your own land.

hausa: Gādon ya kuma haɗa da dukan garuruwa da ƙauyuka waɗanda aka keɓe wa mutanen Efraim daga cikin gādon mutanen Manasse.
english: together with the cities which were set apart for the children of Ephraim in the middle of the inheritance of the children of Manasseh, all the cities with their villages.

hausa: Ku lura, ku aikata dukan abin da na umarce ku; kada ku ƙara, kada ku rage daga cikin.
english: Whatever thing I command you, that you shall observe to do. You shall not add to it, nor take away from it.

hausa: A hadayar da nake shirya muku, za ku ci kitse sai kun ƙoshi ku kuma sha jini sai kun bugu.
english: You shall eat fat until you are full, and drink blood until you are drunk, of my sacrifice which I have sacrificed for you.

hausa: Saboda haka firistocin Dagon da waɗanda suke sujada a haikalin Dagon ba sa taka bakin ƙofar Dagon a Ashdod har wa yau.
english: Therefore neither the priests of Dagon nor any who come into Dagon’s house step on the threshold of Dagon in Ashdod to this day.

hausa: Esta ta ce, “Maƙiyi da abokin gāban, shi ne wannan mugun Haman.” Sai Haman ya tsorota a gaban sarki da sarauniya.
english: Esther said, “An adversary and an enemy, even this wicked Haman!” Then Haman was afraid before the king and the queen.

hausa: Saboda su rayu, kada su mutu sa’ad da suka zo kusa da abubuwa mafi tsarki, a yi musu wannan, wato, Haruna da ’ya’yansa za su shiga wuri mai tsarki su ba wa kowane mutum aikinsa da kuma abin da zai ɗauka.
english: but do this to them, that they may live, and not die, when they approach the most holy things: Aaron and his sons shall go in and appoint everyone to his service and to his burden;

hausa: Gama ga abin da Ubangiji ya faɗa, “Zan fadada salama gare ta kamar kogi, wadatar al’ummai kuma kamar rafi mai gudu; za ku tsotsa a kuma riƙe ku a hannunta ku kuma yi wasa a gwiwoyinta.
english: For Yahweh says, “Behold, I will extend peace to her like a river, and the glory of the nations like an overflowing stream, and you will nurse. You will be carried on her side, and will be dandled on her knees.

hausa: Da Hiram ya ji saƙon Solomon, sai ya ji daɗi ƙwarai, ya kuma ce, “Yabo ga Ubangiji a yau, gama ya ba wa Dawuda ɗa mai hikima yă yi mulki a bisa wannan al’umma mai girma.”
english: When Hiram heard the words of Solomon, he rejoiced greatly, and said, “Blessed is Yahweh today, who has given to David a wise son to rule over this great people.”

hausa: Wanda yake na wajen Yaƙub ba kamar waɗannan ba ne, gama shi ne Mahalicci dukan abu, har da kabilar abin gādonsa, Ubangiji Maɗaukaki ne sunansa.
english: The portion of Jacob is not like these, for he formed all things, including the tribe of his inheritance. Yahweh of Armies is his name.

hausa: “Amma fa, kwanaki suna zuwa,” in ji Ubangiji, “da mutane ba za su ƙara cewa, ‘Muddin Ubangiji yana raye, wanda ya fitar da Isra’ilawa daga Masar,’
english: “Therefore behold, the days come,” says Yahweh, “that it will no more be said, ‘As Yahweh lives, who brought up the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt;’

hausa: Za su sa tufafin makoki su kuma rufu da fargaba. Fuskokinsu kuma za su rufu da kunya a kuma aske kawunansu.
english: They will also clothe themselves with sackcloth, and horror will cover them. Shame will be on all faces, and baldness on all their heads.

hausa: Dukan ’yan’uwansa maza da mata da duk waɗanda suka san shi a dā suka zo suka ci abinci tare da shi a cikin gidansa. Suka ta’azantar da shi suka ƙarfafa shi game da duk wahalar da Ubangiji ya auka masa, kowannensu kuma ya ba shi azurfa da zobe na zinariya.
english: Then all his brothers, all his sisters, and all those who had been of his acquaintance before, came to him and ate bread with him in his house. They comforted him, and consoled him concerning all the evil that Yahweh had brought on him. Everyone also gave him a piece of money, and everyone a ring of gold.

hausa: Hannuna ne ya kafa harsashen duniya, hannuna na dama kuma ya shimfiɗa sammai; sa’ad da na kira su, duka suka miƙe tsaye gaba ɗaya.
english: Yes, my hand has laid the foundation of the earth, and my right hand has spread out the heavens. when I call to them, they stand up together.

hausa: Waɗannan su ne mutanen da aka naɗa daga cikin jama’a, shugabannin asalin kabilu. Su ne kuma shugabannin dangogin Isra’ila.
english: These are those who were called of the congregation, the princes of the tribes of their fathers; they were the heads of the thousands of Israel.

hausa: Sai Toma ya ce masa, “Ubangiji, ba mu san inda za ka ba, to, ta yaya za mu san hanyar?”
english: Thomas said to him, “Lord, we don’t know where you are going. How can we know the way?”

hausa: Kashegari da sassafe, yayinda yake kan hanyarsa ta komawa cikin birni, sai ya ji yunwa.
english: Now in the morning, as he returned to the city, he was hungry.

hausa: Da muka tashi kashegari, sai muka isa Kaisariya muka kuma sauka a gidan Filibus mai bishara, ɗaya daga cikin Bakwai ɗin nan.
english: On the next day, we who were Paul’s companions departed and came to Caesarea. We entered into the house of Philip the evangelist, who was one of the seven, and stayed with him.

hausa: Suka yi ihu, suka ce, “A gicciye shi!”
english: They cried out again, “Crucify him!”

hausa: Duk abin da ya taɓa wani sashe na naman, zai zama da tsarki, kuma in wani jini ya ɗiga a riga, dole ka wanke shi a tsattsarkan wuri.
english: Whatever shall touch its flesh shall be holy. When there is any of its blood sprinkled on a garment, you shall wash that on which it was sprinkled in a holy place.

hausa: In waɗannan mutane sun riƙa haurawa don su miƙa hadayu a haikalin Ubangiji a Urushalima. Za su sāke nuna biyayya ga mai girma, Rehobowam, sarkin Yahuda. Za su kashe ni su kuma koma ga Sarki Rehobowam.”
english: If this people goes up to offer sacrifices in Yahweh’s house at Jerusalem, then the heart of this people will turn again to their lord, even to Rehoboam king of Judah; and they will kill me, and return to Rehoboam king of Judah.”

hausa: Mai shaidar ƙarya ba zai tafi babu hukunci ba, kuma duk mai baza ƙarairayi zai hallaka.
english: A false witness shall not be unpunished. He who utters lies shall perish.

hausa: Aka yi shela a duk fāɗin Yahuda da Urushalima cewa dukan waɗanda suka dawo daga bauta su tattaru a Urushalima.
english: They made a proclamation throughout Judah and Jerusalem to all the children of the captivity, that they should gather themselves together to Jerusalem;

hausa: don yă kuɓutar da mu daga hannun abokan gābanmu, yă kuma sa mu iya yin masa hidima babu tsoro,
english: to grant to us that we, being delivered out of the hand of our enemies, should serve him without fear,

hausa: Muddin Ubangiji wanda ya ceci Isra’ila yana raye, ko da ɗana Yonatan ne ya yi zunubin, dole yă mutu.” Amma ba ko ɗaya daga cikinsu da ya ce uffam.
english: For as Yahweh lives, who saves Israel, though it is in Jonathan my son, he shall surely die.” But there was not a man among all the people who answered him.

hausa: Sai fadawa da dukan mutane suka ce wa firistoci da annabawa. “Wannan mutum bai yi abin da ya isa hukuncin kisa ba, gama ya yi magana da sunan Ubangiji Allahnmu.”
english: Then the princes and all the people said to the priests and to the prophets: “This man is not worthy of death; for he has spoken to us in the name of Yahweh our God.”

hausa: Sai ya ce musu, “Sa’ad da kuke yin addu’a ku ce, “ ‘Ya Uba, sunanka mai tsarki ne mulkinka ya zo.
english: He said to them, “When you pray, say, ‘Our Father in heaven, may your name be kept holy. May your Kingdom come. May your will be done on earth, as it is in heaven.

hausa: Dukan abokan gābana za su sha kunya su kuma karaya; za su juya da kunya nan da nan.
english: May all my enemies be ashamed and dismayed. They shall turn back, they shall be disgraced suddenly.

hausa: A shekara ta goma sha bakwai ta mulkin Feka ɗan Remaliya, Ahaz ɗan Yotam sarkin Yahuda ya fara mulki.
english: In the seventeenth year of Pekah the son of Remaliah, Ahaz the son of Jotham king of Judah began to reign.

hausa: Benahiya ɗan Yehohiyada shi ne shugaban Keretawa da Feletiyawa; ’ya’yan Dawuda maza su ne manyan ma’aikata a gefen sarki.
english: and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over the Cherethites and the Pelethites; and the sons of David were chief officials serving the king.

hausa: Hannun Ubangiji ya yi gāba da su sai da ya hallaka su ƙaƙaf daga sansani.
english: Moreover Yahweh’s hand was against them, to destroy them from the middle of the camp, until they were consumed.

hausa: Ubangiji ya ce wa Musa da Haruna,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,

hausa: yă yi masa alheri yă ce, ‘Kada ka bari yă fāɗa cikin rami, na samu fansa dominsa.’
english: then God is gracious to him, and says, ‘Deliver him from going down to the pit, I have found a ransom.’

hausa: Ya Allahnmu, ba za ka hukunta su ba? Gama ba mu da ƙarfin fuskantar wannan babbar rundunar da take so ta yaƙe mu. Ba mu san abin da za mu yi ba, mu dai mun zuba maka ido.”
english: Our God, will you not judge them? For we have no might against this great company that comes against us. We don’t know what to do, but our eyes are on you.”

hausa: Saboda haka, ku lura da kanku. “In ɗan’uwanka ya yi zunubi, ka kwaɓe shi. In ya tuba, ka gafarta masa.
english: Be careful. If your brother sins against you, rebuke him. If he repents, forgive him.

hausa: “ ‘Yanzu fa, bari in yi ciniki da maigidana, sarki Assuriya. Zan ba ka dawakai dubu biyu, in za ka sa mahaya a kansu!
english: Now therefore, please make a pledge to my master the king of Assyria, and I will give you two thousand horses, if you are able on your part to set riders on them.

hausa: Ka tashi da sassafe, kai da bayin shugabanka da suka zo tare da kai. Da gari ya waye sai ku kama hanya.”
english: Therefore now rise up early in the morning with the servants of your lord who have come with you; and as soon as you are up early in the morning and have light, depart.”

hausa: Ga abin da Ubangiji, Allah na Isra’ila, ya faɗa mini, “Ka karɓi kwaf ruwan inabin nan na fushina a wurina, ka sa dukan al’umman da na aike ka gare su, su sha.
english: For Yahweh, the God of Israel, says to me: “Take this cup of the wine of wrath from my hand, and cause all the nations to whom I send you to drink it.

hausa: Sai annabi Shemahiya ya zo wurin Rehobowam da kuma wajen shugabannin Yahuda waɗanda suka taru a Urushalima don tsoron Shishak, ya kuma faɗa musu, “Ga abin da Ubangiji ya ce, ‘Kun yi biris da ni; saboda haka, yanzu na bashe ku ga Shishak.’ ”
english: Now Shemaiah the prophet came to Rehoboam and to the princes of Judah, who were gathered together to Jerusalem because of Shishak, and said to them, “Yahweh says, ‘You have forsaken me, therefore I have also left you in the hand of Shishak.’”

hausa: zai yi mulkin gidan Yaƙub har abada, mulkinsa kuma ba zai taɓa ƙare ba.”
english: and he will reign over the house of Jacob forever. There will be no end to his Kingdom.”

hausa: Yonatan ya ce, “To, zo mu haye zuwa wajen mutanen, mu sa su gan mu.
english: Then Jonathan said, “Behold, we will pass over to the men, and we will reveal ourselves to them.

hausa: Sa’ad da kuka haura don ku fāɗa wa birni, sai ku fara neman garin da salama.
english: When you draw near to a city to fight against it, then proclaim peace to it.

hausa: Saboda haka Bulus ya yi tambaya ya ce, “To, wace baftisma aka yi muku?” Suka ce, “Baftismar Yohanna.”
english: He said, “Into what then were you baptized?” They said, “Into John’s baptism.”

hausa: Yanzu yana mulki a kan dukan masu sarauta, da masu iko, da masu ƙarfi, da kuma masu mulki. Yana mulkin kome a wannan duniya, zai kuma yi mulkin duniya mai zuwa.
english: far above all rule, authority, power, dominion, and every name that is named, not only in this age, but also in that which is to come.

hausa: Da ya sami wannan labari, sai ya bar Yahudiya ya sāke koma Galili.
english: he left Judea and departed into Galilee.

hausa: “Zai amsa, yă ce, ‘Gaskiya nake gaya muku, duk abin da ba ku yi wa ɗaya daga cikin waɗannan mafi ƙanƙanta ba, ba ku yi mini ba ke nan.’
english: “Then he will answer them, saying, ‘Most certainly I tell you, because you didn’t do it to one of the least of these, you didn’t do it to me.’

hausa: Zai ɗibiya hannunsa a kanta yă kuma yanka ta hadaya don zunubi a inda ake yankan hadayar ƙonawa.
english: He shall lay his hand on the head of the sin offering, and kill it for a sin offering in the place where they kill the burnt offering.

hausa: Ubangiji kuwa ya fatattake mutanen Benyamin a gaban Isra’ila; a ranar kuwa Isra’ilawa sun kashe mutum 25,100 na mutanen Benyamin, dukansu ɗauke da takuba.
english: Yahweh struck Benjamin before Israel; and the children of Israel destroyed of Benjamin that day twenty-five thousand one hundred men. All these drew the sword.

hausa: Sai Yoshuwa ya yaga tufafinsa ya fāɗi rubda ciki a gaban akwatin alkawarin Ubangiji, yana can har yamma. Dattawan Isra’ila ma suka yi haka, suka zuba toka a kawunansu.
english: Joshua tore his clothes, and fell to the earth on his face before Yahweh’s ark until the evening, he and the elders of Israel; and they put dust on their heads.

hausa: Har yaushe za ku kwanta a can, ku ragwaye? Yaushe za ku farka daga barcinku?
english: How long will you sleep, sluggard? When will you arise out of your sleep?

hausa: ’Ya’yan Shimeyi maza su ne, Shelomot, Haziyel da Haran, su uku ne duka. Waɗannan su ne kawunan iyalan Ladan.
english: The sons of Shimei: Shelomoth, Haziel, and Haran, three. These were the heads of the fathers’ households of Ladan.

hausa: Ka kula da rayuwarka da kuma koyarwarka da kyau. Ka daure a cikinsu, domin in ka yi, za ka ceci kanka da kuma masu sauraronka.
english: Pay attention to yourself and to your teaching. Continue in these things, for in doing this you will save both yourself and those who hear you.

hausa: “Har yanzu, in mai adalci ya juya daga adalcinsa ya aikata mugunta, na kuma sa abin tuntuɓe a gabansa, zai mutu. Da yake ba ka yi masa kashedi ba, zai mutu saboda zunubinsa. Ba za a tuna da abin adalcin da ya yi ba, zan kuwa nemi hakkin jininsa a hannunka.
english: “Again, when a righteous man turns from his righteousness and commits iniquity, and I lay a stumbling block before him, he will die. Because you have not given him warning, he will die in his sin, and his righteous deeds which he has done will not be remembered; but I will require his blood at your hand.

hausa: Musa ya ba wa kabilan biyu da rabin nan gādonsu gabashin Urdun, amma bai ba wa Lawiyawa gādo a cikin sauran ba,
english: For Moses had given the inheritance of the two tribes and the half-tribe beyond the Jordan; but to the Levites he gave no inheritance among them.

hausa: Tare da su akwai waɗansu Lawiyawa, Shemahiya, Netaniya, Zebadiya, Asahel, Shemiramot, Yehonatan, Adoniya, Tobiya da Tob Adoniya, da kuma firistoci Elishama da Yehoram.
english: and with them Levites, even Shemaiah, Nethaniah, Zebadiah, Asahel, Shemiramoth, Jehonathan, Adonijah, Tobijah, and Tobadonijah, the Levites; and with them Elishama and Jehoram, the priests.

hausa: ’Ya’yansa za su zama manya a ƙasar; tsaran masu aikata gaskiya za su sami albarka.
english: His offspring will be mighty in the land. The generation of the upright will be blessed.

hausa: Na yi zaton bayan ta yi wannan duka, za tă komo wurina amma ba tă yi haka ba, ’yar’uwarta marar aminci nan Yahuda ta gani.
english: I said after she had done all these things, ‘She will return to me;’ but she didn’t return, and her treacherous sister Judah saw it.

hausa: Sa’an nan Bitrus da Yohanna suka ɗibiya hannuwansu a kansu, suka kuwa karɓi Ruhu Mai Tsarki.
english: Then they laid their hands on them, and they received the Holy Spirit.

hausa: Amma bari adalai su yi murna su kuma yi farin ciki a gaban Allah; bari su yi murna da farin ciki.
english: But let the righteous be glad. Let them rejoice before God. Yes, let them rejoice with gladness.

hausa: Cikin tafiyar Isra’ilawa duka, sukan kama tafiyarsu ne a duk sa’ad da girgijen ya tashi daga kan tabanakul.
english: When the cloud was taken up from over the tabernacle, the children of Israel went onward, throughout all their journeys;

hausa: Ya sa a tuna da abubuwa masu banmamaki nasa; Ubangiji mai alheri ne mai tausayi kuma.
english: He has caused his wonderful works to be remembered. Yahweh is gracious and merciful.

hausa: Sai suka yi wa tentin murfi da fatun rago da aka rina ja, a bisa wannan kuwa akwai murfin fatun shanun teku.
english: He made a covering for the tent of rams’ skins dyed red, and a covering of sea cow hides above.

hausa: Zan yi gāba da ku har abokan gābanku su ci ku a yaƙi, su waɗanda suke ƙinku za su yi mulki a kanku, za ku gudu ba tare da wani yana korinku ba.
english: I will set my face against you, and you will be struck before your enemies. Those who hate you will rule over you; and you will flee when no one pursues you.

hausa: Kuna cewa, ‘Da mun kasance a zamanin kakanninmu, ai, da ba mu haɗa hannu da su muka karkashe annabawa ba.’
english: and say, ‘If we had lived in the days of our fathers, we wouldn’t have been partakers with them in the blood of the prophets.’

hausa: Don me muke kamar shanu a wurinka, ka ɗauke mu mutanen wofi?
english: Why are we counted as animals, which have become unclean in your sight?

hausa: Waɗannan kabilai kuma za su tsaya a bisa Dutsen Ebal su furta la’ana, wato, kabilar Ruben, Gad, Asher, Zebulun, Dan da Naftali.
english: These shall stand on Mount Ebal for the curse: Reuben, Gad, Asher, Zebulun, Dan, and Naphtali.

hausa: Ku rubuta dukan waɗannan kalmomin doka a kansu, sa’ad da kuka haye kuka shiga ƙasar da Ubangiji Allahnku yake ba ku, ƙasa mai zub da madara da zuma, kamar dai yadda Ubangiji Allah na kakanninku, ya yi muku alkawari.
english: You shall write on them all the words of this law, when you have passed over, that you may go in to the land which Yahweh your God gives you, a land flowing with milk and honey, as Yahweh, the God of your fathers, has promised you.

hausa: Yoshuwa ya ce musu, “Yanzu sai ku zubar da allolin da suke cikinku, ku miƙa wa Ubangiji, Allah na Isra’ila zuciyarku.”
english: “Now therefore put away the foreign gods which are among you, and incline your heart to Yahweh, the God of Israel.”

hausa: Kada ku yi farin ciki, dukanku Filistiyawa, cewa sandar da ta buge ku ta karye; daga saiwar wannan maciji wani mugun maciji mai dafi zai taso, ’ya’yansa za su zama wani maciji masu dafi mai tashi sama.
english: Don’t rejoice, O Philistia, all of you, because the rod that struck you is broken; for out of the serpent’s root an adder will emerge, and his fruit will be a fiery flying serpent.

hausa: Zan jefar da kai a ƙasa zan jefa ka a fili. Zan sa dukan tsuntsayen sararin sama su zauna a kanka dukan namun jeji na duniya kuma za su ƙosar da kansu a kanka.
english: I will leave you on the land. I will cast you out on the open field, and will cause all the birds of the sky to settle on you. I will satisfy the animals of the whole earth with you.

hausa: Saboda haka ta tashi da tsakar dare ta ɗauki ɗana daga gefena yayinda baiwarka take barci. Sai ta sa shi kusa da ƙirjinta, ta kuma sa mataccen ɗanta kusa da ƙirjina.
english: She arose at midnight, and took my son from beside me while your servant slept, and laid it in her bosom, and laid her dead child in my bosom.

hausa: Yesu ya amsa ya ce, “Mai albarka ne kai Siman ɗan Yunana, gama ba mutum ne ya bayyana maka wannan ba, sai dai Ubana da yake cikin sama.
english: Jesus answered him, “Blessed are you, Simon Bar Jonah, for flesh and blood has not revealed this to you, but my Father who is in heaven.

hausa: Duk wanda yake rayuwa a kan madara, shi kamar jariri ne har yanzu, kuma bai san ainihi mene ne ya dace ba.
english: For everyone who lives on milk is not experienced in the word of righteousness, for he is a baby.

hausa: zaki mai ƙarfi a cikin namun jeji, wanda ba ya ratse wa kowa;
english: The lion, which is mightiest among animals, and doesn’t turn away for any;

hausa: Amma in mugun mutum ya juye daga muguntarsa ya kuma yi abin da yake daidai da kuma gaskiya, zai ceci ransa.
english: Again, when the wicked man turns away from his wickedness that he has committed, and does that which is lawful and right, he will save his soul alive.

hausa: Sau nawa suke zama kamar tattaka a iska, ko kuma kamar ƙura da iskar hadari take kwashewa?
english: How often is it that they are as stubble before the wind, as chaff that the storm carries away?

hausa: Suka ce, “Ba ka cuci ko danne hakkin kowa ba, ba ka ƙwace kome daga hannun kowa ba.”
english: They said, “You have not defrauded us, nor oppressed us, neither have you taken anything from anyone’s hand.”

hausa: Saboda haka, yanzu babu hukunci don waɗanda suke cikin Kiristi Yesu,
english: There is therefore now no condemnation to those who are in Christ Jesus, who don’t walk according to the flesh, but according to the Spirit.

hausa: “A wannan rana ɗaukakar Yaƙub za tă ƙare; kitsen jikinsa zai lalace.
english: “It will happen in that day that the glory of Jacob will be made thin, and the fatness of his flesh will become lean.

hausa: Sai ya kira bawansa ya ce, “Fitar da matan nan daga nan, ka rufe ƙofa.”
english: Then he called his servant who ministered to him, and said, “Now put this woman out from me, and bolt the door after her.”

hausa: Ya rabu da Ubangiji Allah na kakanninsa, bai kuwa yi tafiya a hanyar Ubangiji ba.
english: and he abandoned Yahweh, the God of his fathers, and didn’t walk in the way of Yahweh.

hausa: Sa’ad da mutum ya sayi fili daga abokin zamansa, kuɗin zai kasance bisa ga yawan shekara hamsin ta murna da suka wuce, da kuma bisa ga yawan shekarun noma da suka rage kafin wata shekara hamsin ta murna.
english: According to the number of years after the Jubilee you shall buy from your neighbor. According to the number of years of the crops he shall sell to you.

hausa: Sihon sarkin Amoriyawa, wanda ya yi mulki a Heshbon. Ya yi mulki daga Arower wadda take iyakar kwarin Arnon, daga tsakiyar kwarin har zuwa, Kogin Yabbok, wanda yake iyakar Ammonawa. Wannan ya haɗa da rabin Gileyad.
english: Sihon king of the Amorites, who lived in Heshbon, and ruled from Aroer, which is on the edge of the valley of the Arnon, and the middle of the valley, and half Gilead, even to the river Jabbok, the border of the children of Ammon;

hausa: Waɗannan su ne mazan da Musa da Haruna, tare da shugabanni goma sha biyun nan na Isra’ila suka ƙidaya, kowa a madadin iyalinsa.
english: These are those who were counted, whom Moses and Aaron counted, and the twelve men who were princes of Israel, each one for his fathers’ house.

hausa: da kuma saƙaƙƙun rigunan da ake sawa don hidima a wuri mai tsarki, duk da tsarkakan riguna na Haruna firist da rigunan ’ya’yansa maza, sa’ad da suke hidima a matsayin firistoci.
english: the finely worked garments for ministering in the holy place, the holy garments for Aaron the priest, and the garments of his sons, to minister in the priest’s office.

hausa: Sa’ad da Yaƙub ya ji cewa an ɓata ’yarsa Dina, sai ya yi shiru game da batun sai ’ya’yansa maza sun dawo gida, gama ’ya’yansa suna a jeji tare da dabbobinsa suna kiwo.
english: Now Jacob heard that he had defiled Dinah, his daughter; and his sons were with his livestock in the field. Jacob held his peace until they came.

hausa: ta goma sha bakwai a kan Yoshbekasha, na goma sha biya a kan Yerimot, ’ya’yansa maza da danginsa, 12
english: for the seventeenth to Joshbekashah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

hausa: Yosiya ya yayyanka dukan firistoci na waɗannan masujadan kan tuddai, ya kuma ƙone ƙasusuwan mutane a kansu. Sa’an nan ya koma Urushalima.
english: He killed all the priests of the high places that were there, on the altars, and burned men’s bones on them; and he returned to Jerusalem.

hausa: Saboda haka za a furta sunan Ubangiji a Sihiyona yabonsa kuma a Urushalima
english: that men may declare Yahweh’s name in Zion, and his praise in Jerusalem,

hausa: Suka tashi daga Ritma, suka yi sansani a Rimmon Ferez.
english: They traveled from Rithmah, and encamped in Rimmon Perez.

hausa: Tabbatacce dukan dukiyar da Allah ya kwashe daga mahaifinmu ya zama namu da ’ya’yanmu. Saboda haka ka yi duk abin da Allah ya faɗa maka.”
english: For all the riches which God has taken away from our father are ours and our children’s. Now then, whatever God has said to you, do.”

hausa: Duk wanda ya nemi adalci da ƙauna kan sami rai, wadata da girmamawa.
english: He who follows after righteousness and kindness finds life, righteousness, and honor.

hausa: Kada ka ƙyale surutan ban haushi na maƙiyanka, ihun abokan gābanka, waɗanda suke ci gaba da yi.
english: Don’t forget the voice of your adversaries. The tumult of those who rise up against you ascends continually.

hausa: Rema, ko da yake tana tuƙa, duk da haka ba ta da rababben kofato; saboda haka namanta haram ne gare ku.
english: The hyrax, because it chews the cud but doesn’t have a parted hoof, is unclean to you.

hausa: gama Ubangiji zai zama ƙarfin halinka zai kuwa kiyaye ƙafarka daga fāɗawa a tarko.
english: for Yahweh will be your confidence, and will keep your foot from being taken.

hausa: Yusuf ya ce, “To, ku kawo dabbobinku, zan sayar muku da abinci a madadin dabbobinku, tun da kuɗinku ya ƙare.”
english: Joseph said, “Give me your livestock; and I will give you food for your livestock, if your money is gone.”

hausa: daga iyalin Azgad, Yohanan ɗan Hakkatan ne shugaba, tare da shi akwai mutum 110;
english: Of the sons of Azgad, Johanan the son of Hakkatan; and with him one hundred ten males.

hausa: Amma Sihon bai bar Isra’ila su ratsa ta yankinsa ba. Sai ya tara dukan sojojinsa, suka fita zuwa cikin hamada, su yaƙi Isra’ila. Da ya kai Yahaz, sai ya yaƙi Isra’ila.
english: Sihon would not allow Israel to pass through his border, but Sihon gathered all his people together, and went out against Israel into the wilderness, and came to Jahaz. He fought against Israel.

hausa: In ba haka ba, zan wadace in ƙi ka har in ce, ‘Wane ne Ubangiji?’ Ko kuwa in zama matalauci in yi sata ta haka in kunyata sunan Allahna.
english: lest I be full, deny you, and say, ‘Who is Yahweh?’ or lest I be poor, and steal, and so dishonor the name of my God.

hausa: ‘Ko ƙurar garinku da kuke manne a ƙafafunmu, mun karkaɗe muku. Duk da haka, ku tabbatar da wannan, “Mulkin Allah yana kusa.” ’
english: ‘Even the dust from your city that clings to us, we wipe off against you. Nevertheless know this, that God’s Kingdom has come near to you.’

hausa: In kuka manta da Ubangiji Allahnku, kuka kuma bi waɗansu alloli, kuka yi musu sujada, kuka kuma rusuna musu, to, a yau ina gargaɗe ku cewa tabbatacce za a hallaka ku.
english: It shall be, if you shall forget Yahweh your God, and walk after other gods, and serve them and worship them, I testify against you today that you shall surely perish.

hausa: Sukan yi wa sarakuna ba’a su kuma rena masu mulki. Sukan yi wa dukan birane masu mafaka dariya; sukan tara ƙasa su hau, su cinye abokan gābansu da yaƙi.
english: Yes, they scoff at kings, and princes are a derision to them. They laugh at every stronghold, for they build up an earthen ramp and take it.

hausa: Saboda haka na ce, “Ƙyale ni kurum; bari in yi kuka mai zafi. Kada ka yi ƙoƙarin ta’azantar da ni a kan hallakar mutanena.”
english: Therefore I said, “Look away from me. I will weep bitterly. Don’t labor to comfort me for the destruction of the daughter of my people.

hausa: Yahuda, bawan Yesu Kiristi, ɗan’uwan Yaƙub, Zuwa ga waɗanda aka kira, waɗanda Allah Uba yake ƙauna, waɗanda kuma Yesu Kiristi ya kiyaye.
english: Jude, a servant of Jesus Christ, and brother of James, to those who are called, sanctified by God the Father, and kept for Jesus Christ:

hausa: Sai Yehohiyada ya fito da ɗan sarki ya sa masa rawani a kā; ya ba shi shafin alkawari, ya kuma furta shi sarki. Suka shafe shi da mai, mutane kuma suka yi ta tafi suka ihu, suna cewa, “Ran sarki yă daɗe.”
english: Then he brought out the king’s son, and put the crown on him, and gave him the covenant; and they made him king and anointed him; and they clapped their hands, and said, “Long live the king!”

hausa: Sa’an nan za su zura wa ƙasa idanu, abin da za su gani kawai shi ne matsuwa da duhu da kuma abin banrazana, za a kuma jefa su cikin baƙin duhu.
english: then look to the earth and see distress, darkness, and the gloom of anguish. They will be driven into thick darkness.

hausa: Tun Bitrus yana cikin faɗin waɗannan kalmomi, sai Ruhu Mai Tsarki ya sauka wa duk waɗanda suka ji saƙon.
english: While Peter was still speaking these words, the Holy Spirit fell on all those who heard the word.

hausa: Ba ƙoƙari muke mu yabe kanmu a gare ku ba ne, sai dai muna ba ku damar yin taƙama da mu ne, don ku sami amsar da za ku ba wa waɗanda suke taƙama da abin da ake gani ne, a maimakon abin da yake cikin zuciya.
