english: For we are not commending ourselves to you again, but speak as giving you occasion of boasting on our behalf, that you may have something to answer those who boast in appearance and not in heart.

hausa: Sai aka ba wa macen fikafikai biyu na babban gaggafa, don ta tashi sama zuwa inda aka shirya mata a hamada, inda za a lura da ita na ɗan lokaci, lokuta da rabin lokaci, inda macijin ba zai iya kaiwa ba.
english: Two wings of the great eagle were given to the woman, that she might fly into the wilderness to her place, so that she might be nourished for a time, times, and half a time, from the face of the serpent.

hausa: Mahaifin adali yana da farin ciki sosai; duk wanda yake da ɗa mai hikima yakan ji daɗinsa.
english: The father of the righteous has great joy. Whoever fathers a wise child delights in him.

hausa: Kada ku haura, domin Ubangiji, ba ya tare da ku. Magabtanku za su ci nasara a kanku,
english: Don’t go up, for Yahweh isn’t among you; that way you won’t be struck down before your enemies.

hausa: Daga wannan baki guda yabo da la’ana suke fitowa. ’Yan’uwana, wannan bai kamata yă zama haka ba.
english: Out of the same mouth comes blessing and cursing. My brothers, these things ought not to be so.

hausa: Dawuda ya kame keken yaƙinsa guda dubu, mahayan keken yaƙinsa dubu bakwai, da sojojin ƙasa dubu ashirin. Ya yayyanke agaran dawakan duka amma ya bar dawakai kekunan yaƙi ɗari.
english: David took from him one thousand seven hundred horsemen and twenty thousand footmen. David hamstrung the chariot horses, but reserved enough of them for one hundred chariots.

hausa: Ina gaya muku, a’a! Amma in ba ku tuba ba, ku ma duka za ku hallaka.
english: I tell you, no, but unless you repent, you will all perish in the same way.

hausa: sa’ad da fushinsu ya ƙuna a kanmu, ai, da sun haɗiye mu da rai;
english: then they would have swallowed us up alive, when their wrath was kindled against us,

hausa: Yanzu suna yawo barkatai a tituna kamar makafi. Sun ƙazantu da jini yadda ba wanda zai kuskura ya taɓa rigunansu.
english: They wander as blind men in the streets. They are polluted with blood, So that men can’t touch their garments.

hausa: Ya ce musu, “Girbi na da yawa, amma ma’aikata kaɗan ne. Saboda haka, ku roƙi Ubangijin girbi ya aikar da ma’aikata zuwa gonarsa.
english: Then he said to them, “The harvest is indeed plentiful, but the laborers are few. Pray therefore to the Lord of the harvest, that he may send out laborers into his harvest.

hausa: Bulus, wanda Allah ya zaɓa don yă zama manzon Kiristi Yesu, Zuwa ga tsarkaka da suke a Afisa, da kuma suke amintattu cikin Kiristi Yesu.
english: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus through the will of God, to the saints who are at Ephesus, and the faithful in Christ Jesus:

hausa: Gara matalauci wanda yake marar laifi da wawa wanda leɓunansa masu ƙarya ne.
english: Better is the poor who walks in his integrity than he who is perverse in his lips and is a fool.

hausa: A kansu ne aka cika annabcin Ishaya cewa, “ ‘Za ku yi ta ji amma ba za ku taɓa ganewa ba; za ku yi ta kallo amma ba za ku taɓa gani ba.
english: In them the prophecy of Isaiah is fulfilled, which says, ‘By hearing you will hear, and will in no way understand; Seeing you will see, and will in no way perceive;

hausa: Maganar Ubangiji ta zo mini cewa,
english: Moreover Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

hausa: Da saƙon Yunana ya kai kunnen sarkin Ninebe, sai ya tashi daga kujerar mulkinsa, ya tuɓe alkyabbarsa, ya sa rigar makoki, ya zauna cikin toka.
english: The news reached the king of Nineveh, and he arose from his throne, took off his royal robe, covered himself with sackcloth, and sat in ashes.

hausa: Haka fa Musa ya ɗauki kekunan yaƙi da shanun ya ba wa Lawiyawa.
english: Moses took the wagons and the oxen, and gave them to the Levites.

hausa: “Ga abin da Ubangiji yana cewa, ka tsaya a filin gidan Ubangiji ka kuma yi magana ga dukan mutanen garuruwan Yahuda waɗanda suka zo sujada a gidan Ubangiji. Ka faɗa musu kome da na umarce ka; kada ka bar wata magana.
english: “Yahweh says: ‘Stand in the court of Yahweh’s house, and speak to all the cities of Judah which come to worship in Yahweh’s house, all the words that I command you to speak to them. Don’t omit a word.

hausa: Waɗansu suka zama wawaye ta wurin hanyoyinsu na tayarwa suka kuwa sha wahala saboda laifofinsu.
english: Fools are afflicted because of their disobedience, and because of their iniquities.

hausa: Sa’ad da Ubangiji ya aike ku daga Kadesh Barneya ya ce, “Ku haura ku mallaki ƙasar da na ba ku.” Amma kuka yi tawaye ga umarnin Ubangiji Allahnku. Ba ku amince da shi, ko ku yi masa biyayya ba.
english: When Yahweh sent you from Kadesh Barnea, saying, “Go up and possess the land which I have given you,” you rebelled against the commandment of Yahweh your God, and you didn’t believe him or listen to his voice.

hausa: Amma idan satan dabbar ce aka yi, dole wanda aka bai wa ajiyar yă biya mai dabbar taran da aka ci masa.
english: But if it is stolen from him, the one who stole shall make restitution to its owner.

hausa: Kada ku yi aiki a ranar, gama Ranar Kafara ce, sa’ad da za a yi kafara saboda ku a gaban Ubangiji Allahnku.
english: You shall do no kind of work in that same day, for it is a day of atonement, to make atonement for you before Yahweh your God.

hausa: Harshen adali azurfa ce zalla, amma zuciyar mugu ba ta da wani amfani.
english: The tongue of the righteous is like choice silver. The heart of the wicked is of little worth.

hausa: Yayinda Bulus yake jiransu a Atens, ya damu ƙwarai da ya ga birnin cike da gumaka.
english: Now while Paul waited for them at Athens, his spirit was provoked within him as he saw the city full of idols.

hausa: Ka ji addu’ata, ya Allah; ka saurari maganar bakina.
english: Hear my prayer, God. Listen to the words of my mouth.

hausa: Akan shirya doki domin ranar yaƙi, amma nasara tana ga Ubangiji ne.
english: The horse is prepared for the day of battle; but victory is with Yahweh.

hausa: Ba kawai Malami ya kasance mai hikima ba, amma kuma ya koyar da mutane. Ya yi tunani ya kuma yi binciken da ya tsara karin magana masu yawa.
english: Further, because the Preacher was wise, he still taught the people knowledge. Yes, he pondered, sought out, and set in order many proverbs.

hausa: Wa ya cin nasara a kan duniya? Sai wanda ya gaskata cewa Yesu Ɗan Allah ne.
english: Who is he who overcomes the world, but he who believes that Jesus is the Son of God?

hausa: In matar ba tă yarda tă zo tare da kai ba, za a kuɓutar da kai daga wannan rantsuwa. Sai dai kada ka kai ɗana a can.”
english: If the woman isn’t willing to follow you, then you shall be clear from this oath to me. Only you shall not bring my son there again.”

hausa: Mutum zai kama ɗaya daga cikin ’yan’uwansa a gidan mahaifinsa ya ce, “Kana da abin sawa, ka zama shugabanmu; wannan kango kuma yă zama a ƙarƙashinka!”
english: Indeed a man shall take hold of his brother in the house of his father, saying, “You have clothing, you be our ruler, and let this ruin be under your hand.”

hausa: Akwai wata al’ummar da ta canja allolinta? (Duk da haka su ba alloli ba ne sam.) Amma mutanena sun musayar da ɗaukakarsu da gumakan banza.
english: Has a nation changed its gods, which really are no gods? But my people have changed their glory for that which doesn’t profit.

hausa: Da waɗansu cikin waɗanda suke tsattsaye kusa da wurin suka ji haka, suka ce, “Ku saurara, yana kiran Iliya.”
english: Some of those who stood by, when they heard it, said, “Behold, he is calling Elijah.”

hausa: Hikima mafaka ce takan kāre mutum kamar yadda kuɗi suke yi. Kiyayewar da hikima takan yi wa mai ita ita ce amfanin ilimi.
english: For wisdom is a defense, even as money is a defense; but the excellency of knowledge is that wisdom preserves the life of him who has it.

hausa: Kun ga, a daidai lokaci, yayinda muke marasa ƙarfi, Kiristi ya mutu saboda waɗanda ba su san Allah ba.
english: For while we were yet weak, at the right time Christ died for the ungodly.

hausa: An keɓe shi domina, kada yă ƙazantar da kansa, kada kuwa yă ɓata Tentin Sujada ta wurin shiga gidan da gawa take, ko ta mahaifinsa, ko ta mahaifiyarsa ce. Ni ne Ubangiji.
english: He shall not go out of the sanctuary, nor profane the sanctuary of his God; for the crown of the anointing oil of his God is upon him. I am Yahweh.

hausa: A haka kuwa Lawiyawa suka yi ayyukansu don Tentin Sujada, don Wuri Mai Tsarki da kuma a ƙarƙashin ’yan’uwansu zuriyar Haruna, saboda hidimar haikalin Ubangiji.
english: and that they should keep the duty of the Tent of Meeting, the duty of the holy place, and the duty of the sons of Aaron their brothers for the service of Yahweh’s house.

hausa: Yowab, ɗan Zeruhiya ya gane cewa zuriyar sarki ta koma ga Absalom.
english: Now Joab the son of Zeruiah perceived that the king’s heart was toward Absalom.

hausa: Mutanen Ninebe kuwa suka gaskata Allah. Aka yi shela a yi azumi, sai dukansu daga babba har zuwa ƙaraminsu, suka sa tufafin makoki.
english: The people of Nineveh believed God; and they proclaimed a fast and put on sackcloth, from their greatest even to their least.

hausa: Shi wanda yake Ɗaukakar Isra’ila ba ya ƙarya ko yă canja zuciyarsa, gama shi ba mutum ba ne da zai canja zuciyarsa.”
english: Also the Strength of Israel will not lie nor repent; for he is not a man, that he should repent.”

hausa: Da jin labarinsa, sai wata mace wadda ƙaramar diyarta tana da mugun ruhu, ta zo ta durƙusa a gabansa.
english: For a woman whose little daughter had an unclean spirit, having heard of him, came and fell down at his feet.

hausa: “Maɗaukaki, Allah, Ubangiji! Maɗaukaki, Allah, Ubangiji ya sani! In mun yi wannan cikin tawaye ko rashin biyayya ga Ubangiji ne, kada ku bar mu da rai yau.
english: “The Mighty One, God, Yahweh, the Mighty One, God, Yahweh, he knows; and Israel shall know: if it was in rebellion, or if in trespass against Yahweh (don’t save us today),

hausa: Da kuma Og sarkin Bashan, Ƙaunarsa madawwamiya ce.
english: Og king of Bashan, for his loving kindness endures forever;

hausa: Da ma’aikatan suka gaya wa Dawuda waɗannan abubuwa, sai ya yi murna don zai zama surukin sarki. Amma kafin lokacin yă cika,
english: When his servants told David these words, it pleased David well to be the king’s son-in-law. Before the deadline,

hausa: Azariya mahaifin Amariya, Amariya mahaifin Ahitub,
english: Azariah became the father of Amariah. Amariah became the father of Ahitub.

hausa: Taron mutanen za su jajjefe su, su kuma sassare su da takuba; za su kashe ’ya’yansu maza da mata su kuma ƙone gidajensu.
english: The company will stone them with stones and dispatch them with their swords. They will kill their sons and their daughters, and burn up their houses with fire.

hausa: Ya soke rubutacciyar doka tare da ƙa’idodinta, wadda take gāba da mu, take kuma hamayya da mu; ya kuma kawar da ta, ya kafe ta a kan gicciye.
english: wiping out the handwriting in ordinances which was against us. He has taken it out of the way, nailing it to the cross.

hausa: Saboda haka dukan mutane Isra’ila suka bar Dawuda don su bi Sheba ɗan Bikri. Amma mutanen Yahuda suka kasance a wurin sarki tun daga Urdun har zuwa Urushalima.
english: So all the men of Israel went up from following David, and followed Sheba the son of Bichri; but the men of Judah joined with their king, from the Jordan even to Jerusalem.

hausa: Dokar sarki ta ba wa Yahudawa a kowace birni izini su taru, su kuma kāre kansu, domin su hallaka, su kashe, su kuma hallaka kowace ƙungiyar mayaƙa, na kowace ƙasa, ko lardi, da wataƙila za su kai musu, da matansu, da yaransu hari; su kuma washe mallakar abokan gābansu.
english: In those letters, the king granted the Jews who were in every city to gather themselves together and to defend their lives—to destroy, to kill, and to cause to perish all the power of the people and province that would assault them, their little ones and women, and to plunder their possessions,

hausa: Gama kun kwashe azurfata da zinariyata kun kuma washe dukiyata mafi kyau kun kai cikin haikalinku.
english: Because you have taken my silver and my gold, and have carried my finest treasures into your temples,

hausa: Haruna zai kawo akuyar da ƙuri’a ta fāɗi a kai wa Ubangiji yă miƙa ta na hadaya don zunubi.
english: Aaron shall present the goat on which the lot fell for Yahweh, and offer him for a sin offering.

hausa: “Game da baƙo wanda shi ba na mutanenka Isra’ila ba kuwa amma ya zo daga ƙasa mai nisa saboda sunanka mai girma da kuma hannunka mai iko da hannunka mai ƙarfi, sa’ad da ya zo ya yi addu’a yana duban wannan haikali,
english: “Moreover, concerning the foreigner, who is not of your people Israel, when he comes from a far country for your great name’s sake and your mighty hand and your outstretched arm, when they come and pray toward this house,

hausa: Za ku sami a wadace ku ci, har sai kun ƙoshi, za ku kuma yabi sunan Ubangiji Allahnku, wanda ya yi muku ayyukan banmamaki; mutanena ba za su ƙara shan kunya ba.
english: You will have plenty to eat and be satisfied, and will praise the name of Yahweh, your God, who has dealt wondrously with you; and my people will never again be disappointed.

hausa: Da kowane bijimi, a kasance da hadaya ta lallausan garin da aka kwaɓa da mai na kashi uku bisa goma na efa; da ɗan rago kuwa, a kasance da hadaya ta lallausan garin da aka kwaɓa da mai na kashi biyu bisa goma na efa;
english: and three tenths of an ephah of fine flour for a meal offering mixed with oil, for each bull; and two tenth parts of fine flour for a meal offering mixed with oil, for the one ram;

hausa: A Urushalima kuma, Yehoshafat ya naɗa waɗansu Lawiyawa, firistoci da kawunan iyalan Isra’ilawa don su tabbatar da an bi dokar Ubangiji, su kuma sasanta tsakanin mutane. A Urushalima za su zauna.
english: Moreover in Jerusalem Jehoshaphat appointed certain Levites, priests, and heads of the fathers’ households of Israel to give judgment for Yahweh and for controversies. They returned to Jerusalem.

hausa: “Waɗannan za su zama ƙofofin birnin. “Farawa da gefen arewa, wanda yake da tsawon kamu 4,500
english: “These are the exits of the city: On the north side four thousand five hundred reeds by measure;

hausa: “Amma in mugun mutum ya juya daga dukan zunubin da ya aikata ya kuma kiyaye dukan ƙa’idodina ya kuwa yi abin da yake daidai da kuma gaskiya, tabbatacce zai rayu; ba zai mutu ba.
english: “But if the wicked turns from all his sins that he has committed, and keeps all my statutes, and does that which is lawful and right, he shall surely live. He shall not die.

hausa: Amma kada ku ji tsoronsu; ku tuna da kyau abin da Ubangiji Allahnku ya yi wa Fir’auna da kuma dukan Masar.
english: you shall not be afraid of them. You shall remember well what Yahweh your God did to Pharaoh and to all Egypt:

hausa: A lokacin nan muryarsa ta jijjiga duniya, amma yanzu ya yi alkawari cewa, “Har wa yau sau ɗaya tak zan ƙara jijjiga ba duniya kaɗai ba, amma har ma da sammai.”
english: whose voice shook the earth then, but now he has promised, saying, “Yet once more I will shake not only the earth, but also the heavens.”

hausa: har lokacin da zan zo in kwashe ku, in kai ku wata ƙasa mai kama da taku, ƙasa mai yalwar hatsi, da ruwan inabi, da abinci, da gonakin inabi, da itatuwan zaitun, da zuma, don ku rayu, kada ku mutu! “Kada ku saurari Hezekiya, don karya yake muku, sa’ad da ya ce, ‘Ubangiji zai cece mu.’
english: until I come and take you away to a land like your own land, a land of grain and new wine, a land of bread and vineyards, a land of olive trees and of honey, that you may live and not die. Don’t listen to Hezekiah when he persuades you, saying, “Yahweh will deliver us.”

hausa: Suna ce wa uwayensu, “Ina burodi da ruwan inabi?” Yayinda suke suma kamar mutanen da aka ji masu ciwo a cikin birni, sa’ad da suke mutuwa a hannuwan uwayensu.
english: They ask their mothers, “Where is grain and wine?” when they swoon as the wounded in the streets of the city, when their soul is poured out into their mothers’ bosom.

hausa: Saboda haka Allah ya ce masa, “Da yake ka nemi wannan ne, ba ka kuwa nemi tsawon rai ko arziki wa kanka ba, ba ka kuma nemi mutuwar abokan gābanka ba, amma ka nemi ganewa a aikata gaskiya,
english: God said to him, “Because you have asked this thing, and have not asked for yourself long life, nor have you asked for riches for yourself, nor have you asked for the life of your enemies, but have asked for yourself understanding to discern justice,

hausa: Zan ba da alama in kuma tattara su. Ba shakka zan fanshe su; za su yi yawa kamar yadda suke a dā.
english: I will signal for them and gather them, for I have redeemed them. They will increase as they were before.

hausa: Sun gina masujadai kan tudu wa Ba’al a Kwarin Ben Hinnom don su miƙa ’ya’yansu maza da mata hadaya ga Molek, ko da yake ban taɓa umarce su ba, bai kuma zo mini cewa su yi abin banƙyama irin wannan ba ta haka suka sa Yahuda ya yi zunubi.
english: They built the high places of Baal, which are in the valley of the son of Hinnom, to cause their sons and their daughters to pass through fire to Molech, which I didn’t command them. It didn’t even come into my mind, that they should do this abomination, to cause Judah to sin.”

hausa: Da ta isa wurin mutumin Allah a dutsen, sai ta kama ƙafafunsa. Sai Gehazi ya zo don yă ture ta, amma mutumin Allah ya ce, “Ka bar ta! Tana cikin baƙin ciki ƙwarai, amma Ubangiji ya ɓoye mini, bai kuma faɗa mini me ya sa ba.”
english: When she came to the man of God to the hill, she caught hold of his feet. Gehazi came near to thrust her away; but the man of God said, “Leave her alone, for her soul is troubled within her; and Yahweh has hidden it from me, and has not told me.”

hausa: Yesu ya ce masa, “Ka sami ganin garinka; bangaskiyarka ta warkar da kai.”
english: Jesus said to him, “Receive your sight. Your faith has healed you.”

hausa: Daga baya Yesu ya same shi a haikali ya ce masa, “Ga shi, ka warke. Ka daina yin zunubi, in ba haka ba wani abin da ya fi wannan muni zai iya samunka.”
english: Afterward Jesus found him in the temple and said to him, “Behold, you are made well. Sin no more, so that nothing worse happens to you.”

hausa: Zai share dukan hawaye daga idanunsu. Ba sauran mutuwa ko makoki ko kuka ko azaba, gama tsofaffin al’amura sun shuɗe.”
english: He will wipe away every tear from their eyes. Death will be no more; neither will there be mourning, nor crying, nor pain any more. The first things have passed away.”

hausa: Kin kashe ’ya’yana kika kuma miƙa su ga gumaka.
english: that you have slain my children and delivered them up, in causing them to pass through the fire to them?

hausa: Kakanninmu sun yi sujada a dutsen nan, amma ku Yahudawa kun ce a Urushalima ne ya kamata a yi sujada.”
english: Our fathers worshiped in this mountain, and you Jews say that in Jerusalem is the place where people ought to worship.”

hausa: An bar birnin kango, aka yi kaca-kaca da ƙofofinta.
english: The city is left in desolation, and the gate is struck with destruction.

hausa: Samson kuwa ya ce musu, “A wannan lokaci ina da iko in rama a kan Filistiyawa; tabbatacce zan ji musu.”
english: Samson said to them, “This time I will be blameless in the case of the Philistines when I harm them.”

hausa: dole maigidan ya tafi ya faɗa wa firist ya ce, ‘Na ga wani abu da ya yi kamar cutar fatar jikin da take a riga a cikin gidana.’
english: then he who owns the house shall come and tell the priest, saying, ‘There seems to me to be some sort of plague in the house.’

hausa: In ba shi da diya, sai a ba wa ’yan’uwansa gādonsa.
english: If he has no daughter, then you shall give his inheritance to his brothers.

hausa: Mai haɗama yakan jawo tā-da-na-zaune-tsaye, amma duk wanda ya dogara ga Ubangiji zai yi nasara.
english: One who is greedy stirs up strife; but one who trusts in Yahweh will prosper.

hausa: “Sa’ad da kuma kuna azumi, kada ku ɓata fuska, yadda munafukai suke yi. Sukan ɓata fuskokinsu domin su nuna wa mutane cewa suna azumi. Gaskiya nake gaya muku, sun riga sun sami ladarsu cikakke.
english: “Moreover when you fast, don’t be like the hypocrites, with sad faces. For they disfigure their faces that they may be seen by men to be fasting. Most certainly I tell you, they have received their reward.

hausa: Amma a farkon halitta, Allah ya ‘halicce su miji da mace.’
english: But from the beginning of the creation, God made them male and female.

hausa: “Sa’ad da kuma kuke addu’a, kada ku zama kamar munafukai, gama sun cika son yin addu’a a tsaye a cikin majami’u da kuma a bakin titi, don mutane su gan su. Gaskiya nake gaya muku, sun riga sun sami ladarsu cikakke.
english: “When you pray, you shall not be as the hypocrites, for they love to stand and pray in the synagogues and in the corners of the streets, that they may be seen by men. Most certainly, I tell you, they have received their reward.

hausa: Sai Abimelek ya ce wa Ishaku, “Fita daga cikinmu; ka fi ƙarfinmu.”
english: Abimelech said to Isaac, “Go away from us, for you are much mightier than we.”

hausa: Amma hikimar da ta zo daga sama da fari tana da tsabta gaba ɗaya; sa’an nan mai ƙaunar salama ce, mai sanin ya kamata, mai biyayya, cike da jinƙai da aiki mai kyau, marar nuna bambanci, sahihiya kuma.
english: But the wisdom that is from above is first pure, then peaceful, gentle, reasonable, full of mercy and good fruits, without partiality, and without hypocrisy.

hausa: ya ce, ‘Yabo ga Ubangiji, Allah na Isra’ila, wanda ya bar idanuna suka ga magāji a kan kujerar sarautata a yau.’ ”
english: Also thus said the king, ‘Blessed be Yahweh, the God of Israel, who has given one to sit on my throne today, my eyes even seeing it.’”

hausa: Ubangiji ya ba wa Yoshuwa ɗan Nun wannan umarni, “Ka ƙarfafa, ka kuma yi ƙarfin hali, gama za ka kawo Isra’ilawa cikin ƙasar da na yi musu alkawari da rantsuwa, ni kaina kuwa zan kasance tare da kai.”
english: He commissioned Joshua the son of Nun, and said, “Be strong and courageous; for you shall bring the children of Israel into the land which I swore to them. I will be with you.”

hausa: ’Ya’yan Beker maza su ne, Zemira, Yowash, Eliyezer, Eliyohenai, Omri, Yeremot, Abiya, Anatot da Alemet. Dukan waɗannan ’ya’yan Beker maza ne.
english: The sons of Becher: Zemirah, Joash, Eliezer, Elioenai, Omri, Jeremoth, Abijah, Anathoth, and Alemeth. All these were the sons of Becher.

hausa: Da gari ya waye, sai suka shiga filin haikali, yadda aka faɗa musu, suka kuwa fara koyar da mutane. Sa’ad da babban firist da abokan aikinsa suka iso, sai suka kira Majalisa gaba ɗaya dukan dattawan Isra’ila, suka kuma aika kurkuku a zo da manzannin.
english: When they heard this, they entered into the temple about daybreak and taught. But the high priest and those who were with him came and called the council together, with all the senate of the children of Israel, and sent to the prison to have them brought.

hausa: Amma ban gaskata abin da suka faɗa ba sai da na zo na kuma gani da idanuna. Tabbatacce, ko rabin girman hikimarka ba a faɗa mini ba, ka wuce labarin da na ji nesa ba kusa ba.
english: However I didn’t believe their words until I came, and my eyes had seen it; and behold half of the greatness of your wisdom wasn’t told me. You exceed the fame that I heard!

hausa: “Ranar Ubangiji ta yi kusa don dukan al’ummai. Kamar yadda kuka yi, haka za a yi muku; ayyukanku za su koma a kanku.
english: For the day of Yahweh is near all the nations! As you have done, it will be done to you. Your deeds will return upon your own head.

hausa: Diyar Sihiyona ba ta da sauran daraja. ’Ya’yan sarakunanta sun zama kamar bareyi waɗanda suka rasa wurin kiwo; cikin rashin ƙarfi suka guje wa masu fafararsu.
english: All majesty has departed from the daughter of Zion. Her princes have become like deer that find no pasture. They have gone without strength before the pursuer.

hausa: Ƙasa ta girgiza tana makyarkyata saboda nufin Ubangiji na gāba da Babilon ya tabbata, nufinsa na mai da ƙasar Babilon kufai don kada kowa yă zauna a can.
english: The land trembles and is in pain; for the purposes of Yahweh against Babylon stand, to make the land of Babylon a desolation, without inhabitant.

hausa: “Sauran wurin da ya rage mai fāɗin kamu 5,000 da tsawon kamu 25,000 zai zama don amfanin kowa a birnin, don gidaje da wurin kiwo. Birnin zai kasance a tsakiyar wurin da ya ragen nan
english: “The five thousand cubits that are left in the width, in front of the twenty-five thousand, shall be for common use, for the city, for dwelling and for pasture lands; and the city shall be in the middle of it.

hausa: Sauran Yahudawa suka haɗa kai da shi a munafuncinsa har Barnabas ma ya bauɗe.
english: And the rest of the Jews joined him in his hypocrisy, so that even Barnabas was carried away with their hypocrisy.

hausa: Sai ku gaya musu, “Dā mu bayin Fir’auna ne a Masar, amma Ubangiji ya fitar da mu daga Masar da hannu masu ƙarfi.
english: then you shall tell your son, “We were Pharaoh’s slaves in Egypt. Yahweh brought us out of Egypt with a mighty hand;

hausa: “ ‘Wannan zai zama alama a gare ku cewa zan hukunta ku a wannan wuri,’ in ji Ubangiji, ‘saboda ku san cewa barazanata ta lahani a kanku tabbatacce za tă cika.’
english: “‘This will be the sign to you,’ says Yahweh, ‘that I will punish you in this place, that you may know that my words will surely stand against you for evil.’

hausa: Me ya sa kake baƙin ciki, ya raina? Me ya sa ka damu a cikina? Ka dogara ga Allah, gama zai sāke yabe shi, Mai Cetona da kuma Allahna.
english: Why are you in despair, my soul? Why are you disturbed within me? Hope in God! For I shall still praise him for the saving help of his presence.

hausa: Duk da haka waɗansu suka yi musu ba’a suka ce, “Sun yi tatil da ruwan inabi ne.”
english: Others, mocking, said, “They are filled with new wine.”

hausa: Da fitowarsu daga jirgin, sai mutane suka gane Yesu.
english: When they had come out of the boat, immediately the people recognized him,

hausa: Gama na san cewa bayan rasuwata, tabbatacce za ku lalace gaba ɗaya, ku juye daga hanyar da na umarce ku. A kwanaki masu zuwa, masifa za tă auka muku saboda za ku aikata mugunta a gaban Ubangiji, ku tsokane shi har yă yi fushi ta wurin abin da hannuwanku suka yi.”
english: For I know that after my death you will utterly corrupt yourselves, and turn away from the way which I have commanded you; and evil will happen to you in the latter days, because you will do that which is evil in Yahweh’s sight, to provoke him to anger through the work of your hands.”

hausa: ɗan Abishuwa, ɗan Finehas, ɗan Eleyazar, ɗan Haruna babban firist.
english: the son of Abishua, the son of Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the chief priest—

hausa: Akwai rassa guda shida da suka miƙe daga gefe wurin ajiyar fitilar, uku a wannan gefe, uku kuma a wancan.
english: There were six branches going out of its sides: three branches of the lamp stand out of its one side, and three branches of the lamp stand out of its other side:

hausa: Mefiboshet ya zauna a Urushalima, gama kullum yana ci a teburin sarki, shi kuwa gurgu ne a dukan ƙafafu.
english: So Mephibosheth lived in Jerusalem, for he ate continually at the king’s table. He was lame in both his feet.

hausa: Bayan ’yan shekaru, za su haɗa kai. Diyar sarkin Kudu za tă je wurin sarkin Arewa ta sada zumunci, amma ba za tă riƙe iko ba, shi kuwa da ikonsa ba za su daɗe ba. A waɗannan kwanaki za a bashe ta, da ita da masu rakiyarta da kuma mahaifinta da kuma wanda ya goyi bayanta.
english: At the end of years they will join themselves together; and the daughter of the king of the south will come to the king of the north to make an agreement, but she will not retain the strength of her arm. He will also not stand, nor will his arm; but she will be given up, with those who brought her, and he who became the father of her, and he who strengthened her in those times.

hausa: sai ɗan aika ya zo wurin Ayuba ya ce masa, “Shanu suna huɗa, jakuna kuma suna kiwo nan kusa,
english: that a messenger came to Job, and said, “The oxen were plowing, and the donkeys feeding beside them,

hausa: Kuma, “Zan zama Uba a gare ku, ku kuma za ku zama ’ya’yana, maza da mata, in ji Ubangiji Maɗaukaki.”
english: I will be to you a Father. You will be to me sons and daughters,’ says the Lord Almighty.”

hausa: Isra’ilawa suka sāke aikata mugayen ayyuka a gaban Ubangiji, saboda sun aikata wannan mugunta sai Ubangiji ya ba wa Eglon sarkin Mowab ƙarfi a kan Isra’ila.
english: The children of Israel again did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight, and Yahweh strengthened Eglon the king of Moab against Israel, because they had done that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight.

hausa: Sai Dawuda ya kusato, sa’ad da Ornan ya duba sai ya gan shi, ya bar masussukar ya rusuna a gaban Dawuda da fuskarsa har ƙasa.
english: As David came to Ornan, Ornan looked and saw David, and went out of the threshing floor, and bowed himself to David with his face to the ground.

hausa: “Bayan Lawiyawa sun ɗibiya hannuwansu a kan bijiman, sai ka yi amfani da ɗaya a matsayin hadaya don zunubi ga Ubangiji, ɗayan kuma domin hadaya ta ƙonawa, don yin kafara saboda Lawiyawa.
english: “The Levites shall lay their hands on the heads of the bulls, and you shall offer the one for a sin offering and the other for a burnt offering to Yahweh, to make atonement for the Levites.

hausa: sai ku ma ku ji tsoron takobin; gama fushi yakan kawo hukunci ta wurin takobi, sa’an nan za ku san cewa akwai shari’a.”
english: be afraid of the sword, for wrath brings the punishments of the sword, that you may know there is a judgment.”

hausa: “Ga aikin Kohatawa a Tentin Sujada, kulawa da kayayyaki mafi tsarki.
english: “This is the service of the sons of Kohath in the Tent of Meeting, regarding the most holy things.

hausa: Da Yesu ya ga ya amsa da hikima, sai ya ce masa, “Ba ka da nisa da mulkin Allah.” Daga lokacin, ba wanda ya yi karambani yin masa wata tambaya.
english: When Jesus saw that he answered wisely, he said to him, “You are not far from God’s Kingdom.” No one dared ask him any question after that.

hausa: Ku gini ne wanda manzanni da annabawa suke tushensa, Kiristi kuma shi ne dutse mafi muhimmanci na ginin.
english: being built on the foundation of the apostles and prophets, Christ Jesus himself being the chief cornerstone;

hausa: To, fa, sai ga wani ya zo wurin Yesu ya tambaye shi ya ce, “Malam, wane abu mai kyau ne ya zama mini dole in yi don in sami rai madawwami?”
english: Behold, one came to him and said, “Good teacher, what good thing shall I do, that I may have eternal life?”

hausa: Duk mai ƙaunar ransa, zai rasa shi, duk mai ƙin ransa a wannan duniya, zai kiyaye shi har yă zuwa rai madawwami.
english: He who loves his life will lose it. He who hates his life in this world will keep it to eternal life.

hausa: Suka kakkafa rammuka hamsin a daidai bakin labulen, haka kuma suka yi a kan labule na biyun. Haka aka ɗaɗɗaura rammukan nan da junansu yă zama kamar abu guda.
english: He made fifty loops in the one curtain, and he made fifty loops in the edge of the curtain that was in the second coupling. The loops were opposite to one another.

hausa: Ga mai tunani dukansu daidai ne; ba su da laifi ga waɗanda suke da sani.
english: They are all plain to him who understands, right to those who find knowledge.

hausa: Na ba ku ƙasar da ba ku yi wata wahala kafin ku samu ba, na ba ku kuma biranen da ba ku gina ba; kuka kuma zauna a cikinsu, kuka ci daga ’ya’yan itacensu da ’ya’yan zaitun da ba ku ne kuka shuka ba.’
english: I gave you a land on which you had not labored, and cities which you didn’t build, and you live in them. You eat of vineyards and olive groves which you didn’t plant.’

hausa: Matan da suka gaya wa manzannin waɗannan abubuwa su ne, Maryamu Magdalin, da Yowanna, da Maryamu uwar Yaƙub, da waɗansu da suke tare da su.
english: Now they were Mary Magdalene, Joanna, and Mary the mother of James. The other women with them told these things to the apostles.

hausa: Kafin a haifi duwatsu ko a fid da ƙasa da duniya, daga madawwami zuwa madawwami kai Allah ne.
english: Before the mountains were born, before you had formed the earth and the world, even from everlasting to everlasting, you are God.

hausa: “Za ka iya tsawata wa gizagizai ka kuma rufe kanka da ambaliyar ruwa?
english: “Can you lift up your voice to the clouds, that abundance of waters may cover you?

hausa: haka sarkin Assuriya zai kwashe kamammun Masarawa da Kushawa tsirara kuma ba takalma a ƙafa, yaro da babba, asirinsu a tsiraice, don a kunyata Masar.
english: so the king of Assyria will lead away the captives of Egypt and the exiles of Ethiopia, young and old, naked and barefoot, and with buttocks uncovered, to the shame of Egypt.

hausa: Ga abin da Ubangiji Maɗaukaki ya ce, “Azumin wata na huɗu, da na watan biyar, da na watan bakwai da na watan goma za su zama lokutan farin ciki da murna da kuma bukukkuwa na murna ga Yahuda. Saboda haka sai ku ƙaunaci gaskiya da salama.”
english: Yahweh of Armies says: “The fasts of the fourth, fifth, seventh, and tenth months shall be for the house of Judah joy, gladness, and cheerful feasts. Therefore love truth and peace.”

hausa: Kome kuke yi, ku yi shi da dukan zuciyarku, sai ka ce ga Ubangiji kuke yi, ba ga mutum ba.
english: And whatever you do, work heartily, as for the Lord and not for men,

hausa: Ba zan taɓa manta da farillanka ba, gama ta wurinsu ne ka kiyaye raina.
english: I will never forget your precepts, for with them, you have revived me.

hausa: Ta haka kuna ba da shaida a kanku cewa ku zuriyar waɗanda suka karkashe annabawa ne.
english: Therefore you testify to yourselves that you are children of those who killed the prophets.

hausa: Hannun Ubangiji kuwa yana tare da su, mutane da yawan gaske kuwa suka gaskata suka juya ga Ubangiji.
english: The hand of the Lord was with them, and a great number believed and turned to the Lord.

hausa: Na kuma ga wani abu a duniya. Ba kullum maguji ne yake nasara a tsere ba, ba kullum jarumi ne yake yin nasara ba, ba kullum mai hikima ne da abinci ba ba kullum mai basira ne yake da wadata ba ba kullum gwani ne yake samun tagomashi ba; amma sa’a, da tsautsayi, sukan sami kowannensu.
english: I returned and saw under the sun that the race is not to the swift, nor the battle to the strong, neither yet bread to the wise, nor yet riches to men of understanding, nor yet favor to men of skill; but time and chance happen to them all.

hausa: Daga haihuwa na dogara gare ka; kai ka kawo ni daga cikin mahaifiyata. Kullayaumi zan yabe ka.
english: I have relied on you from the womb. You are he who took me out of my mother’s womb. I will always praise you.

hausa: su ajiye a sawun manzannin, a kuma raba wa kowa gwargwadon bukatarsa.
english: and laid them at the apostles’ feet; and distribution was made to each, according as anyone had need.

hausa: Raguwar Isra’ila ba za su ƙara aikata abin da ba daidai ba, ba za su faɗa ƙarya ba, ba kuwa za a sami ruɗu a bakunansu ba. Za su ci su kuma kwanta kuma babu wanda zai ba su tsoro.”
english: The remnant of Israel will not do iniquity nor speak lies, neither will a deceitful tongue be found in their mouth, for they will feed and lie down, and no one will make them afraid.”

hausa: A lokacin nan sarki Hiridus ya ji labarin Yesu,
english: At that time, Herod the tetrarch heard the report concerning Jesus,

hausa: Duk wanda ya ɗauki lamunin wani tabbatacce zai sha wahala, amma duk wanda ya ƙi ya sa hannu a ɗaukar lamuni ba ruwansa.
english: He who is collateral for a stranger will suffer for it, but he who refuses pledges of collateral is secure.

hausa: Amma zan sa ƙugiyoyi a muƙamuƙanka in sa kifin rafuffukanka su manne wa kamɓorinka. Zan jawo ka daga cikin tsakiyar rafuffukanka, da dukan kifayen rafuffukanka, waɗanda suka manne a ƙamborinka,
english: I will put hooks in your jaws, and I will make the fish of your rivers stick to your scales. I will bring you up out of the middle of your rivers, with all the fish of your rivers which stick to your scales.

hausa: Suka ci gaba suka yaƙi Kan’aniyawan da suke zaune a Hebron (wadda dā ake kira Kiriyat Arba) suka kuma ci Sheshai, Ahiman da Talmai da yaƙi.
english: Judah went against the Canaanites who lived in Hebron. (The name of Hebron before that was Kiriath Arba.) They struck Sheshai, Ahiman, and Talmai.

hausa: A ranan nan suka ci ƙasar da yaƙi, suka buge ta, suka karkashe kowa da takobi kamar dai yadda suka yi a Lakish.
english: They took it on that day, and struck it with the edge of the sword. He utterly destroyed all the souls who were in it that day, according to all that he had done to Lachish.

hausa: kamar Saratu, wadda ta yi biyayya ga Ibrahim, har ta kira shi maigidanta. Ku ’ya’yanta ne mata in kun aikata abin da yake daidai, ba ku kuma ba tsoro dama ba.
english: So Sarah obeyed Abraham, calling him lord, whose children you now are if you do well and are not put in fear by any terror.

hausa: Gama kai ne abin sa zuciyata, ya Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka, ƙarfin zuciyata tun ina yaro.
english: For you are my hope, Lord Yahweh, my confidence from my youth.

hausa: “Ku kanku kun gani, haka ma ɗan’uwana Benyamin, cewa tabbatacce ni ne nake magana da ku.
english: Behold, your eyes see, and the eyes of my brother Benjamin, that it is my mouth that speaks to you.

hausa: Sai taron suka tambaye shi, suka ce “Me za mu yi ke nan?”
english: The multitudes asked him, “What then must we do?”

hausa: cikin cikina zai yi farin ciki in leɓunanka suna maganar abin da yake daidai.
english: Yes, my heart will rejoice when your lips speak what is right.

hausa: Amma da wannan ɗan naka, wanda ya ɓatar da dukiyarka a kan karuwai ya dawo, ka yanka masa ɗan saniya mai ƙiba!’
english: But when this your son came, who has devoured your living with prostitutes, you killed the fattened calf for him.’

hausa: Ka tuna yadda ka yi wa mutane da yawa magana, yadda ka ƙarfafa hannuwa marasa ƙarfi.
english: Behold, you have instructed many, you have strengthened the weak hands.

hausa: Ta haka mai albarka yake wanda yake tsoron Ubangiji.
english: Behold, this is how the man who fears Yahweh is blessed.

hausa: Saboda haka Isra’ilawa suka ba Lawiyawa waɗannan garuruwa da wuraren kiwonsu.
english: The children of Israel gave to the Levites the cities with their pasture lands.

hausa: Duka dai akwai tebur huɗu a gefe ɗaya na hanyar shiga, huɗu kuma a ɗaya gefen, tebur takwas ke nan gaba ɗaya, inda a kan yanka hadayu a kai.
english: Four tables were on this side, and four tables on that side, by the side of the gate: eight tables, on which they killed the sacrifices.

hausa: Ga abin da Ubangiji Maɗaukaki yana cewa, “Kada ku saurari abin da annabawan suke muku annabci; suna cika ku da sa zuciyar ƙarya. Suna maganar wahayi daga tunaninsu, ba daga bakin Ubangiji ba.
english: Yahweh of Armies says, “Don’t listen to the words of the prophets who prophesy to you. They teach you vanity. They speak a vision of their own heart, and not out of the mouth of Yahweh.

hausa: An kafa tushen haikalin Ubangiji a shekara ta huɗu, a watan Zif.
english: The foundation of Yahweh’s house was laid in the fourth year, in the month Ziv.

hausa: Gama saƙon gicciye wauta ne ga waɗanda suke hallaka, amma a gare mu, mu da ake ceto, ikon Allah ne.
english: For the word of the cross is foolishness to those who are dying, but to us who are being saved it is the power of God.

hausa: Da kowane bijimi a kasance da hadaya ta lallausan gari kashi uku bisa goma na efa, kwaɓaɓɓe da mai; da rago kuwa, a kasance da hadaya ta lallausan gari kashi biyu bisa goma na efa, kwaɓaɓɓe da mai;
english: and their meal offering, fine flour mixed with oil, three tenths for each bull, two tenths for the one ram,

hausa: Makafi jagora! Kukan tace ƙwaro ɗan mitsil amma sai ku haɗiye raƙumi.
english: You blind guides, who strain out a gnat, and swallow a camel!

hausa: Ubangiji ya ce wa Musa,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

hausa: Zai tanada a matsayin hadaya ta gari, efa guda tare da bijimi, efa guda tare da ’yan raguna, da kuma ’yan raguna yadda ya ga dama, tare da kwalabar mai don kowace efa.
english: He shall prepare a meal offering: an ephah for the bull, and an ephah for the ram, and for the lambs according as he is able, and a hin of oil to an ephah.

hausa: Domin ƙaunar Ubangiji ba mu hallaka ba; gama jiyejiyanƙansa ba su ƙarewa.
english: It is because of Yahweh’s loving kindnesses that we are not consumed, because his mercies don’t fail.

hausa: Game da Ammonawa. Ga abin da Ubangiji yana cewa, “Isra’ila ba shi da ’ya’ya maza ne? Ba shi da magāda ne? To, me ya sa Molek ya mallaki Gad? Me ya sa mutanensa suka zama a garuruwansa?
english: Of the children of Ammon. Yahweh says: “Has Israel no sons? Has he no heir? Why then does Malcam possess Gad, and his people dwell in its cities?

hausa: Amma ina gaya miki, za a fi jin tausayin Sodom fiye da ke a ranar shari’a.”
english: But I tell you that it will be more tolerable for the land of Sodom on the day of judgment, than for you.”

hausa: Yesu ya ce wa mutumin mai shanyayyen hannun, “Tashi ka tsaya a gaban kowa.”
english: He said to the man whose hand was withered, “Stand up.”

hausa: Sammai za su fallasa laifinsa; duniya za tă yi gāba da shi.
english: The heavens will reveal his iniquity. The earth will rise up against him.

hausa: Kamar yadda yake a rubuce cewa, “Saboda kai ne muke fuskantar mutuwa dukan yini; an ɗauke mu kamar tumakin da za a yanka.”
english: Even as it is written, “For your sake we are killed all day long. We were accounted as sheep for the slaughter.”

hausa: Saboda haka, ku sarakuna, ku yi wayo; ku shiga hankalinku, ku masu mulkin duniya.
english: Now therefore be wise, you kings. Be instructed, you judges of the earth.

hausa: Ba gādon da za a ba wa wata kabila daga wata kabila, gama kowace kabilar Isra’ilawa za tă riƙe mallaka da ta gāda.”
english: So shall no inheritance move from one tribe to another tribe; for the tribes of the children of Israel shall each keep his own inheritance.’”

hausa: Da Yesu ya gane suna shirin su ɗauke shi ƙarfi da yaji su naɗa shi sarki, sai ya sāke komawa kan dutsen shi kaɗai.
english: Jesus therefore, perceiving that they were about to come and take him by force to make him king, withdrew again to the mountain by himself.

hausa: Hannatu ta ce, “Ba haka ba ne, ranka yă daɗe, ni mace ce da take cikin matsala ƙwarai da gaske. Ban sha ruwan inabi ba, ko wani abu mai sa maye, ina dai faɗa wa Ubangiji abin da yake damuna ne.
english: Hannah answered, “No, my lord, I am a woman of a sorrowful spirit. I have not been drinking wine or strong drink, but I poured out my soul before Yahweh.

hausa: Nan da nan Yesu ya gane cewa, iko ya fita daga gare shi. Sai ya juya a cikin taron ya yi tambaya, “Wa ya taɓa rigata?”
english: Immediately Jesus, perceiving in himself that the power had gone out from him, turned around in the crowd and asked, “Who touched my clothes?”

hausa: To, ranan nan fa, ranar Shirye-shirye ce, kashegari kuma muhimmin Asabbaci ne. Domin Yahudawa ba sa so a bar jikunan a kan gicciyoyi a Asabbaci, sai suka roƙi Bilatus a kakkarye ƙafafunsu kuma sauko da jikunan.
english: Therefore the Jews, because it was the Preparation Day, so that the bodies wouldn’t remain on the cross on the Sabbath (for that Sabbath was a special one), asked of Pilate that their legs might be broken and that they might be taken away.

hausa: Bayan ya sallame su, sai ya haura bisan gefen dutse shi kaɗai don yă yi addu’a. Da yamma ta yi, yana can shi kaɗai,
english: After he had sent the multitudes away, he went up into the mountain by himself to pray. When evening had come, he was there alone.

hausa: Hadayar da ya kawo ita ce, faranti guda ɗaya na azurfa, nauyinsa shekel ɗari ɗaya da talatin, da kuma daro na yayyafawa na azurfa, nauyinsa shekel saba’in, dukan biyu, an auna su bisa ga ma’aunin shekel na tsattsarkan wuri, kowannensu cike da lallausan gari, haɗe da mai kamar hadaya ta gari;
english: gave his offering: one silver platter, the weight of which was one hundred thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary, both of them full of fine flour mixed with oil for a meal offering;

hausa: Sunan ɗan’uwansa Yubal, shi ne mahaifin dukan makaɗan garaya da masu hura sarewa.
english: His brother’s name was Jubal, who was the father of all who handle the harp and pipe.

hausa: Shugabannin yankuna, kowanne a watansa yakan yi tanajin abinci domin Sarki Solomon da kuma duk wanda ya zo teburin sarki. Sun tabbatar ba a rasa kome ba.
english: Those officers provided food for King Solomon, and for all who came to King Solomon’s table, every man in his month. They let nothing be lacking.

hausa: Bari a ɗaukaka ka, ya Allah, bisa sammai; bari ɗaukakarka ta kasance a dukan duniya.
english: Be exalted, God, above the heavens. Let your glory be over all the earth.

hausa: “Ya ceci waɗansu, amma ya kāsa ceton kansa! In shi ne Sarkin Isra’ila! To, yă sauko daga kan gicciyen nan, mu kuwa mu gaskata shi.
english: “He saved others, but he can’t save himself. If he is the King of Israel, let him come down from the cross now, and we will believe in him.

hausa: Bari hatsi yă yalwata a duk fāɗin ƙasar; bari yă cika bisan tuddai. Bari ’ya’yan itatuwansa su haɓaka kamar Lebanon; bari yă bazu kamar ciyayi a gona.
english: Abundance of grain shall be throughout the land. Its fruit sways like Lebanon. Let it flourish, thriving like the grass of the field.

hausa: Bayan haka, dole firist yă wanke rigunarsa, yă kuma yi wanka. Sa’an nan zai iya shiga cikin sansani, amma zai kasance da ƙazanta har yamma.
english: Then the priest shall wash his clothes, and he shall bathe his flesh in water, and afterward he shall come into the camp, and the priest shall be unclean until the evening.

hausa: Allah kuwa ya tayar wa Solomon wani abokin gāba, mai suna Rezon, ɗan Eliyada, wanda ya gudu daga maigidansa, Hadadezer sarkin Zoba.
english: God raised up an adversary to him, Rezon the son of Eliada, who had fled from his lord, Hadadezer king of Zobah.

hausa: Ka yi wa labulen rammuka hamsin a ɗayan labule, ka kuma yi haka a ƙarshe ɗayan labulen, rammukan su fuskanci juna.
english: You shall make fifty loops in the one curtain, and you shall make fifty loops in the edge of the curtain that is in the second coupling. The loops shall be opposite one another.

hausa: Ga kamanni da fasalin da’irorin. Suna ƙyalƙyali kamar kirisolit, kuma dukan huɗun sun yi kama da juna. Kowacce ta yi kamar da’ira a cikin da’ira.
english: The appearance of the wheels and their work was like a beryl. The four of them had one likeness. Their appearance and their work was as it were a wheel within a wheel.

hausa: Ku lura kada wani yă ruɗe ku da ilimin banza da wofi. Wannan koyarwa ta mutane ce kawai. Ta fito daga ikokin wannan duniya ne ba daga Kiristi ba.
english: Be careful that you don’t let anyone rob you through his philosophy and vain deceit, after the tradition of men, after the elemental spirits of the world, and not after Christ.

hausa: Suka saƙa doguwar riga da lallausan lilin don Haruna da ’ya’yansa, aikin gwani mai saƙa,
english: They made the tunics of fine linen of woven work for Aaron and for his sons,

hausa: Tabbatacce, doka ta bukaci a tsabtacce kusa kowane abu da jini, kuma in ba tare da zub da jini ba babu gafara.
english: According to the law, nearly everything is cleansed with blood, and apart from shedding of blood there is no remission.

hausa: Yana zama a kan dutse yă zauna a wurin da dare; cikin duwatsu ne wurin zamansa.
english: On the cliff he dwells and makes his home, on the point of the cliff and the stronghold.

hausa: Na rantse da Ubangiji Allahnka, babu al’umma ko masarauta da mai girma sarki bai aika a nemo ka ba. In suka ce ba ka can, sai yă sa mulkin ko al’ummar su rantse, cewa ai, ba su same ka ba.
english: As Yahweh your God lives, there is no nation or kingdom where my lord has not sent to seek you. When they said, ‘He is not here,’ he took an oath of the kingdom and nation that they didn’t find you.

hausa: Har yanzu ya ba su wani misali ya ce, “Mulkin sama yana kama da yisti wanda mace ta ɗauka ta kwaɓa garin alkama mai yawa, har sai da yistin ya gauraye yistin duka.”
english: He spoke another parable to them. “The Kingdom of Heaven is like yeast which a woman took and hid in three measures of meal, until it was all leavened.”

hausa: Ner shi ne mahaifin Kish, Kish mahaifin Shawulu, kuma Shawulu ne mahaifin Yonatan, Malki-Shuwa, Abinadab da Esh-Ba’al.
english: Ner became the father of Kish. Kish became the father of Saul. Saul became the father of Jonathan, Malchishua, Abinadab, and Eshbaal.

hausa: Ina so maza a ko’ina su ɗaga hannuwansu masu tsarki cikin addu’a, ba tare da fushi ko faɗa ba.
english: I desire therefore that the men in every place pray, lifting up holy hands without anger and doubting.

hausa: Gama Isra’ilawa za su yi kwanaki masu yawa ba tare da sarki ko shugaba ba, babu hadaya ko keɓaɓɓun duwatsu, babu efod ko gunki.
english: For the children of Israel shall live many days without king, without prince, without sacrifice, without sacred stone, and without ephod or idols.

hausa: “Ga abin da Ubangiji Maɗaukaki ya ce, ‘In za ka yi tafiya a hanyoyina ka kuma kiyaye abubuwan da nake so, za ka zama shugaban haikalina, ka kuma lura da ɗakunan shari’ata, zan kuma ba ka wuri cikin waɗannan da suke tsaye a nan.
english: “Yahweh of Armies says: ‘If you will walk in my ways, and if you will follow my instructions, then you also shall judge my house, and shall also keep my courts, and I will give you a place of access among these who stand by.

hausa: “Su wane ne waɗannan da suke firiya kamar gizagizai, kamar kurciyoyi suna zuwa sheƙarsu?
english: “Who are these who fly as a cloud, and as the doves to their windows?

hausa: daga kabilar Issakar kuma aka ba su Kishiyon, Daberat,
english: Out of the tribe of Issachar, Kishion with its pasture lands, Daberath with its pasture lands,

hausa: To, ga marasa aure da gwauraye kuwa ina cewa yana da kyau su zauna haka ba aure, yadda nake.
english: But I say to the unmarried and to widows, it is good for them if they remain even as I am.

hausa: Bayan da suka ajiye littafin a ɗakin Elishama magatakarda, sai suka tafi wurin sarki a fili suka sanar da shi kome.
english: They went in to the king into the court, but they had laid up the scroll in the room of Elishama the scribe. Then they told all the words in the hearing of the king.

hausa: Bari yă yi doguwar rayuwa! Bari a ba shi zinariya daga Sheba. Bari mutane su riƙa yin addu’a dominsa su kuma albarkace shi dukan yini.
english: He will live; and Sheba’s gold will be given to him. Men will pray for him continually. They will bless him all day long.

hausa: Saboda haka ta tafi ta fara kala a gonaki a bayan masu girbi. Sai ya zamana, ta sami kanta tana aiki a gonar da take ta Bowaz, wanda yake daga dangin Elimelek.
english: She went, and came and gleaned in the field after the reapers; and she happened to come to the portion of the field belonging to Boaz, who was of the family of Elimelech.

hausa: Nan take da dukan mutanen suka ga Yesu, sai suka cika da mamaki, suka ruga da gudu don su gai da shi.
english: Immediately all the multitude, when they saw him, were greatly amazed, and running to him, greeted him.

hausa: Amma zan kāre gidana daga sojoji masu kai da kawowa. Azzalumi ba zai ƙara cin mutanena da yaƙi ba, gama yanzu ina tsaro.
english: I will encamp around my house against the army, that no one pass through or return; and no oppressor will pass through them any more: for now I have seen with my eyes.

hausa: Ruwa da yawa ba zai iya kashe ƙauna ba, koguna ba za su iya kwashe ta ba. In wani zai bayar da dukan dukiyar gidansa don ƙauna, za a yi masa dariya ne kawai.
english: Many waters can’t quench love, neither can floods drown it. If a man would give all the wealth of his house for love, he would be utterly scorned.

hausa: In ku da kuke mugaye kun san yadda za ku ba da kyautai masu kyau ga ’ya’yanku, balle Ubanku na sama, ba zai fi ku iya ba da abubuwa masu kyau, ga su waɗanda suka roƙe shi ba!
english: If you then, being evil, know how to give good gifts to your children, how much more will your Father who is in heaven give good things to those who ask him!

hausa: Gidaje a Urushalima da waɗannan na sarakunan Yahuda za su ƙazantu kamar wannan wuri, Tofet, dukan gidajen da suke ƙone turare a kan rufi wa duk rundunan taurari suna kuma zuba hadayun sha ga sauran alloli.’ ”
english: The houses of Jerusalem and the houses of the kings of Judah, which are defiled, will be as the place of Topheth, even all the houses on whose roofs they have burned incense to all the army of the sky and have poured out drink offerings to other gods.”’”

hausa: “Ba dukanku nake nufi ba; na san waɗanda na zaɓa. Wannan kuwa don a cika Nassi ne da ya ce, ‘Wanda ya ci burodina tare da ni ya tasar mini.’
english: I don’t speak concerning all of you. I know whom I have chosen; but that the Scripture may be fulfilled, ‘He who eats bread with me has lifted up his heel against me.’

hausa: Ko da mahaifina da mahaifiyata sun yashe ni, Ubangiji zai karɓe ni.
english: When my father and my mother forsake me, then Yahweh will take me up.

hausa: Tabbatacce ba zai taɓa jijjigu ba; za a tuna da mai adalci har abada.
english: For he will never be shaken. The righteous will be remembered forever.

hausa: Sa’ad da na zo, me ya sa babu kowa? Sa’ad da na yi kira, me ya sa babu wani da ya amsa? Hannuna ya kāsa ne sosai don fansarka? Na rasa ƙarfin kuɓutar da kai ne? Ta wurin tsawatawa kawai na busar da teku, na mai da koguna hamada; kifayensu duk sun ruɓe saboda rashin ruwa suka kuma mutu saboda ƙishi.
english: Why, when I came, was there no one? When I called, why was there no one to answer? Is my hand shortened at all, that it can’t redeem? Or have I no power to deliver? Behold, at my rebuke I dry up the sea. I make the rivers a wilderness. Their fish stink because there is no water, and die of thirst.

hausa: Doka ba tă dangana ga bangaskiya ba; a maimakon haka, “Mutumin da ya aikata waɗannan abubuwa zai rayu ta wurinsu.”
english: The law is not of faith, but, “The man who does them will live by them.”

hausa: Ya miƙa su ga al’ummai, maƙiyansu kuma suka yi mulki a kansu.
english: He gave them into the hand of the nations. Those who hated them ruled over them.

hausa: Kai ne Allahna, zan kuwa yi maka godiya; kai ne Allahna, zan kuwa ɗaukaka ka.
english: You are my God, and I will give thanks to you. You are my God, I will exalt you.

hausa: Bayan Hezron ya mutu a Kaleb Efrata, sai Abiya matar Hezron ta haifa masa Asshur mahaifin Tekowa.
english: After Hezron died in Caleb Ephrathah, Abijah, Hezron’s wife, bore him Ashhur the father of Tekoa.

hausa: Na sa ya yi kyau da yalwar rassa, abin ƙyashi na dukan itatuwan Eden a lambun Allah.
english: I made it beautiful by the multitude of its branches, so that all the trees of Eden, that were in the garden of God, envied it.’

hausa: ’ya’yan Ruben ɗan farin Isra’ila maza su ne, Hanok, Fallu, Hezron da Karmi.
english: the sons of Reuben the firstborn of Israel: Hanoch, Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi.

hausa: Dawuda bai ƙirga mutanen da suke ’yan shekara ashirin ko ƙasa ba, domin Ubangiji ya yi alkawari zai sa Isra’ila su yi yawa kamar taurari a sararin sama.
english: But David didn’t take the number of them from twenty years old and under, because Yahweh had said he would increase Israel like the stars of the sky.

hausa: Al’umma za tă tasar wa al’umma, mulki kuma yă tasar wa mulki. Za a yi girgizar ƙasa a wurare dabam-dabam, a kuma yi yunwa. Waɗannan dai mafarin azabar naƙuda.
english: For nation will rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom. There will be earthquakes in various places. There will be famines and troubles. These things are the beginning of birth pains.

hausa: na miƙa shi ga mai mulkin al’ummai, don yă sāka masa gwargwadon muguntarsa. Na jefar da shi a gefe,
english: I will deliver him into the hand of the mighty one of the nations. He will surely deal with him. I have driven him out for his wickedness.

hausa: Daraja da ɗaukaka suna a gabansa; ƙarfi da farin ciki suna a wurin zamansa.
english: Honor and majesty are before him. Strength and gladness are in his place.

hausa: “Ba ka lura ba cewa waɗannan mutane suna cewa, ‘Ubangiji ya ƙi masarautai biyu da ya zaɓa’? Saboda haka suka rena mutanena ba sa ƙara ɗaukansu a matsayin al’umma.
english: “Don’t consider what this people has spoken, saying, ‘Has Yahweh cast off the two families which he chose?’ Thus they despise my people, that they should be no more a nation before them.”

hausa: Ubangiji kuwa ya saurari kukan Isra’ila, ya kuma ba da Kan’aniyawa a gare su. Suka hallaka su da biranensu ƙaf; saboda haka aka sa wa wurin suna Horma.
english: Yahweh listened to the voice of Israel, and delivered up the Canaanites; and they utterly destroyed them and their cities. The name of the place was called Hormah.

hausa: Sa’ad da suka fara zama a can, ba su bauta wa Ubangiji ba; saboda haka ya aika da zakoki a tsakaninsu suka karkashe waɗansu mutane.
english: So it was, at the beginning of their dwelling there, that they didn’t fear Yahweh. Therefore Yahweh sent lions among them, which killed some of them.

hausa: Za a daure laifofina a cikin jaka; za ka rufe zunubaina.
english: My disobedience is sealed up in a bag. You fasten up my iniquity.

hausa: Sa’an nan aka saukar da tabanakul ƙasa, Gershonawa da mutanen Merari da suke ɗauke da shi suka kama hanya.
english: The tabernacle was taken down; and the sons of Gershon and the sons of Merari, who bore the tabernacle, went forward.

hausa: Yusuf kuwa ya ce wa ’yan’uwansa, “Ni ne Yusuf! Mahaifina yana nan da rai har yanzu?” Amma ’yan’uwansa ba su iya amsa masa ba, gama sun firgita ƙwarai a gabansa.
english: Joseph said to his brothers, “I am Joseph! Does my father still live?” His brothers couldn’t answer him; for they were terrified at his presence.

hausa: Farin ciki ya rabu da zuciyarmu; rayuwarmu ta zama makoki.
english: The joy of our heart has ceased. Our dance is turned into mourning.

hausa: Duk wanda aka daƙe, ko yanke gabansa, ba zai shiga taron jama’ar Ubangiji ba.
english: He who is emasculated by crushing or cutting shall not enter into Yahweh’s assembly.

hausa: Waɗansu mutane da yawa da ba Isra’ilawa ba, suka haura tare da su, da garkunan shanu, da na tumaki da awaki.
english: A mixed multitude went up also with them, with flocks, herds, and even very much livestock.

hausa: Na yayyafa turare a gadona da mur, aloyes da kuma kirfa.
english: I have perfumed my bed with myrrh, aloes, and cinnamon.

hausa: Al’umma daga arewa za tă fāɗa mata su mai da ƙasar kango. Ba wanda zai zauna a cikinta; mutane da dabbobi za su gudu.
english: For a nation comes up out of the north against her, which will make her land desolate, and no one will dwell in it. They have fled. They are gone, both man and animal.

hausa: Ku fita, ku fita daga can! Kada ku taɓa wani abu marar tsarki! Ku fita daga cikinta ku zama da tsarki, ku da kuke ɗaukan kayan aikin Ubangiji.
english: Depart! Depart! Go out from there! Touch no unclean thing! Go out from among her! Cleanse yourselves, you who carry Yahweh’s vessels.

hausa: Kada ku ci gaba da yin abin da duniya take yi, sai dai ku bar halinku ya sāke, ta wurin sabunta hankalinku ɗungum, don ku tabbatar da abin da Allah yake so yake, abu mai kyau, mai daɗi da kuma cikakke.
english: Don’t be conformed to this world, but be transformed by the renewing of your mind, so that you may prove what is the good, well-pleasing, and perfect will of God.

hausa: Za su ci masa tara shekel azurfa ɗari, su ba mahaifin yarinyar, domin wannan mutum ya ba wa budurwa mutuniyar Isra’ila mummunan suna. Za tă ci gaba da zama matarsa; ba kuwa zai sake ta ba muddin ransa.
english: They shall fine him one hundred shekels of silver, and give them to the father of the young lady, because he has given a bad name to a virgin of Israel. She shall be his wife. He may not put her away all his days.

hausa: Da suka bar Fir’auna, sai suka sadu da Musa da Haruna suna jira su sadu da su,
english: They met Moses and Aaron, who stood along the way, as they came out from Pharaoh.

hausa: Na kuma ji wata babbar murya daga kursiyin tana cewa, “Yanzu mazaunin Allah yana tare da mutane, zai kuma zauna tare da su. Za su zama mutanensa, Allah kansa kuwa zai kasance tare da su yă kuma zama Allahnsu.
english: I heard a loud voice out of heaven saying, “Behold, God’s dwelling is with people; and he will dwell with them, and they will be his people, and God himself will be with them as their God.

hausa: “Kai da ’ya’yanka maza, ba za ku sha ruwan inabi ko wani abu mai sa jiri ba a duk sa’ad da za ku shiga cikin Tentin Sujada, in ba haka ba za ku mutu. Wannan dawwammamiyar farilla ce wa tsararraki masu zuwa.
english: “You and your sons are not to drink wine or strong drink whenever you go into the Tent of Meeting, or you will die. This shall be a statute forever throughout your generations.

hausa: Sarki zai shiga daga waje ta shirayin hanyar shiga yă tsaya a madogarar ƙofa. Firistoci za su miƙa hadayarsa ta ƙonawa da hadayunsa na salama. Zai yi sujada a madogarar ƙofar hanyar shiga sa’an nan ya fita, amma ba za a rufe ƙofar ba sai da yamma.
english: The prince shall enter by the way of the porch of the gate outside, and shall stand by the post of the gate; and the priests shall prepare his burnt offering and his peace offerings, and he shall worship at the threshold of the gate. Then he shall go out, but the gate shall not be shut until the evening.

hausa: Gama za su gudu su bar ƙasar, ƙasar kuwa ta ji daɗin asabbatanta yayinda take kango muddin ba su ciki. Za su biya hukuncin zunubansu domin sun ƙi dokokina, suka kuma yi ƙyamar farillaina.
english: The land also will be left by them, and will enjoy its Sabbaths while it lies desolate without them; and they will accept the punishment of their iniquity because they rejected my ordinances, and their soul abhorred my statutes.

hausa: Sai Ben-Hadad ya aika da wani saƙo wa Ahab, ya ce, “Bari alloli su yi da ni yadda suke so, su kuma yi haka da tsanani, in isashen ƙura ta rage a Samariya da za a iya ba wa mutanena a tafin hannu.”
english: Ben Hadad sent to him, and said, “The gods do so to me, and more also, if the dust of Samaria will be enough for handfuls for all the people who follow me.”

hausa: Ya yi tebur goma ya kuma sa su cikin haikalin, biyar a gefen kudu, biyar kuma a gefen arewa. Ya kuma yi kwanonin yayyafawa guda ɗari.
english: He made also ten tables, and placed them in the temple, five on the right side and five on the left. He made one hundred basins of gold.

hausa: Gama kamar yadda kaɗaɗɗen madara takan kawo mai, murɗa hanci kuma takan sa a yi haɓo, haka tsokanar fushi takan kawo faɗa.”
english: For as the churning of milk produces butter, and the wringing of the nose produces blood, so the forcing of wrath produces strife.”

hausa: Yanzu fa, a maimako, gara ku yafe masa, ku kuma ta’azantar da shi, don kada baƙin ciki mai yawa yă sha kansa.
english: so that, on the contrary, you should rather forgive him and comfort him, lest by any means such a one should be swallowed up with his excessive sorrow.

hausa: Sa’ad da ya sha ruwan inabin ya kuwa bugu, sai ya kwanta tsirara cikin tentinsa.
english: He drank of the wine and got drunk. He was uncovered within his tent.

hausa: “Sarakuna da mayaƙa suka gudu a gaggauce; cikin sansani mutane sun raba ganima.
english: “Kings of armies flee! They flee!” She who waits at home divides the plunder,

hausa: To, ɗan wata mutuniyar Isra’ila wanda mahaifinsa mutumin Masar ne, ya je cikin Isra’ilawa, sai faɗa ta tashi tsakaninsa da wani mutumin Isra’ila a cikin sansani.
english: The son of an Israelite woman, whose father was an Egyptian, went out among the children of Israel; and the son of the Israelite woman and a man of Israel strove together in the camp.

hausa: Saboda haka suka sallame Rebeka, ’yar’uwarsu, duk da uwar goyonta da bawan Ibrahim da mutanensa.
english: They sent away Rebekah, their sister, with her nurse, Abraham’s servant, and his men.

hausa: Nan da nan da ya gama faɗi wannan, sai ƙasa ta tsage inda Datan da Abiram suke tsaye,
english: As he finished speaking all these words, the ground that was under them split apart.

hausa: Za ka san cewa ’ya’yanka za su zama da yawa, zuriyarka kuma kamar ciyawa a ƙasa.
english: You will know also that your offspring will be great, your offspring as the grass of the earth.

hausa: Ya Ubangiji, ka ga inda aka yi mini ba daidai ba. Ka shari’anta, ka ba ni gaskiya!
english: Yahweh, you have seen my wrong. Judge my cause.

hausa: Suka ƙona turare a kan kowane tudu, kamar dai yadda al’umman da Ubangiji ya kora daga gabansu suka yi. Suka yi muguntan da ya sa Ubangiji ya yi fushi.
english: and there they burned incense in all the high places, as the nations whom Yahweh carried away before them did; and they did wicked things to provoke Yahweh to anger;

hausa: Yesu ya amsa ya ce, “Tabbatacce, Iliya zai zo, zai kuma gyara dukan abubuwa.
english: Jesus answered them, “Elijah indeed comes first, and will restore all things;

hausa: A ƙwanƙoli a kan hanya, inda hanyoyi suka haɗu, ta ɗauki matsayinta;
english: On the top of high places by the way, where the paths meet, she stands.

hausa: wani wanda zai sa Allah yă daina duka na, don yă daina ba ni tsoro.
english: Let him take his rod away from me. Let his terror not make me afraid;

hausa: ba zai ‘girmama mahaifinsa’ da shi ba. Ta haka kun yi banza da maganar Allah saboda al’adarku.
english: he shall not honor his father or mother.’ You have made the commandment of God void because of your tradition.

hausa: Isuwa ya ce wa mahaifinsa, “Iyakar albarkar da kake da ita ke nan, baba? Ka albarkace ni ni ma, baba!” Sai Isuwa ya ɗaga murya ya yi kuka.
english: Esau said to his father, “Do you have just one blessing, my father? Bless me, even me also, my father.” Esau lifted up his voice, and wept.

hausa: sa’ad da kai, ya Allah, ka tashi don ka yi shari’a, don ka cece dukan masu shan wahala a ƙasar. Sela
english: when God arose to judgment, to save all the afflicted ones of the earth. Selah.

hausa: Sai Na’omi ta ce wa surukanta biyu, “Ku koma, kowannenku, zuwa gidan mahaifiyarta. Bari Ubangiji yă nuna muku alheri yadda kuka nuna wa matattun nan da kuma gare ni.
english: Naomi said to her two daughters-in-law, “Go, return each of you to her mother’s house. May Yahweh deal kindly with you, as you have dealt with the dead and with me.

hausa: “Wannan yana bukata hankali da kuma hikima. Kawuna bakwai nan tuddai bakwai ne da macen take zama a kai.
english: Here is the mind that has wisdom. The seven heads are seven mountains on which the woman sits.

hausa: A lokacin, idan wani ya tafi wurin tsibin da zai auna mudu ashirin, sai yă iske mudu goma kawai. Idan kuma wani ya tafi wurin matse ruwan inabi don yă ɗebo lita hamsin, sai yă tarar da lita ashirin kawai.
english: Through all that time, when one came to a heap of twenty measures, there were only ten. When one came to the wine vat to draw out fifty, there were only twenty.

hausa: Amma yanzu ina ƙarfafa ku ku yi ƙarfin hali, domin ba ɗayanku da zai rasa ransa; jirgin ruwan ne kaɗai zai hallaka.
english: Now I exhort you to cheer up, for there will be no loss of life among you, but only of the ship.

hausa: Saboda haka ki ji wannan, ke mai wahala, wadda ta bugu, amma ba da ruwan inabi.
english: Therefore now hear this, you afflicted, and drunken, but not with wine:

hausa: yana jan musu kunne kada su faɗa wa kowa akan ko shi wane ne.
english: and commanded them that they should not make him known,

hausa: Yana da shekara ashirin da biyar da ya zama sarki, ya kuma yi mulki shekara ashirin da tara a Urushalima. Sunan mahaifiyarsa Abiya ’yar Zakariya.
english: He was twenty-five years old when he began to reign, and he reigned twenty-nine years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Abi the daughter of Zechariah.

hausa: Saboda haka na mai da hankalina ga fahimi, don in bincika in nemi hikima da yadda aka tsara abubuwa, in kuma fahimci wawancin mugunta da haukar wauta.
english: I turned around, and my heart sought to know and to search out, and to seek wisdom and the scheme of things, and to know that wickedness is stupidity, and that foolishness is madness.

hausa: A nan aka shirya abincin yamma don girmama Yesu. Marta ta ce yi hidima, Lazarus kuma yana ɗaya cikin waɗanda suke ci tare shi.
english: So they made him a supper there. Martha served, but Lazarus was one of those who sat at the table with him.

hausa: ‘Ka ji maganar Ubangiji, ya sarkin Yahuda, kai da kake zaune kan gadon sarautar Dawuda, kai, da fadawanka da mutanenka waɗanda suke shiga ta waɗannan ƙofofi.
english: ‘Hear Yahweh’s word, king of Judah, who sits on David’s throne—you, your servants, and your people who enter in by these gates.

hausa: Babu wani daga raguwar Yahuda wanda ya tafi Masar da zai kuɓuta ko ya tsira har ya komo zuwa ƙasar Yahuda, wadda za su yi marmari su komo su zauna; babu wani da zai komo sai dai ’yan gudun hijira.”
english: so that none of the remnant of Judah, who have gone into the land of Egypt to live there, will escape or be left to return into the land of Judah, to which they have a desire to return to dwell there; for no one will return except those who will escape.’”

hausa: iska mafificin ƙarfi da ta fito daga gare ni. Yanzu na zartar da hukuncina a kansu.”
english: A full wind from these will come for me. Now I will also utter judgments against them.”

hausa: Tumakina sukan saurari muryata; na sansu, suna kuma bi na.
english: My sheep hear my voice, and I know them, and they follow me.

hausa: Nun da kuma Yoshuwa.
english: Nun his son, and Joshua his son.

hausa: ya ce musu, “A’a, abokaina kada ku yi wannan mummunan abu.
english: He said, “Please, my brothers, don’t act so wickedly.

hausa: Dukan mazan Isra’ilawa da matan da suke da niyya suka kawo wa Ubangiji kyautai na yardar rai, domin dukan aikin da Ubangiji ya umarce su ta bakin Musa.
english: The children of Israel brought a free will offering to Yahweh; every man and woman whose heart made them willing to bring for all the work, which Yahweh had commanded to be made by Moses.

hausa: Saboda haka, ina roƙonku ku yi koyi da ni.
english: I beg you therefore, be imitators of me.

hausa: Haka ma, maƙwabtansu daga nesa har Issakar, Zebulun da Naftali suka zo suka kawo abinci a kan jakuna, raƙuma, alfadarai da shanu. Akwai tanadin mai yawa na gari, kauɗar ɓaure, nonnan busassun ’ya’yan inabi, ruwan inabi, mai, shanu da tumaki. Duk an yi haka don a nuna farin ciki ƙwarai a cikin dukan ƙasar Isra’ila.
english: Moreover those who were near to them, as far as Issachar, Zebulun, and Naphtali, brought bread on donkeys, on camels, on mules, and on oxen: supplies of flour, cakes of figs, clusters of raisins, wine, oil, cattle, and sheep in abundance; for there was joy in Israel.

hausa: Amma Yunana ya gudu daga Ubangiji ya nufi Tarshish. Ya gangara zuwa Yaffa, inda ya sami jirgin ruwa mai shirin tashi daga tashar. Bayan ya biya kuɗin tafiya, sai ya shiga jirgi ya kama hanya zuwa Tarshish don yă tsere wa Ubangiji.
english: But Jonah rose up to flee to Tarshish from the presence of Yahweh. He went down to Joppa, and found a ship going to Tarshish; so he paid its fare, and went down into it, to go with them to Tarshish from the presence of Yahweh.

hausa: Kuka gaji cikin dukan al’amuranku, amma ba ku iya cewa, ‘Aikin banza ne ba.’ Kuka sami sabuntar ƙarfinku, ta haka ba ku suma ba.
english: You were wearied with the length of your ways; yet you didn’t say, ‘It is in vain.’ You found a reviving of your strength; therefore you weren’t faint.

hausa: Natanayel ya yi tambaya ya ce, “A ina ka san ni?” Yesu ya amsa ya ce, “Na gan ka yayinda kake a gindin itacen ɓaure, kafin Filibus yă kira ka.”
english: Nathanael said to him, “How do you know me?” Jesus answered him, “Before Philip called you, when you were under the fig tree, I saw you.”

hausa: Fuskokinsu shaidu ne a kansu; suna nuna zunubinsu a fili kamar yadda Sodom ya yi; ba sa ma ɓoye shi. Kaitonsu! Sun jawo wa kansu masifa.
english: The look of their faces testify against them. They parade their sin like Sodom. They don’t hide it. Woe to their soul! For they have brought disaster upon themselves.

hausa: Su ne kuma manyan ma’aikatan Sarki Solomon, manyan mutane ɗari biyu da hamsin masu lura da mutane.
english: These were the chief officers of King Solomon, even two-hundred fifty, who ruled over the people.

hausa: kashi ɗaya bisa ukunku a fadan sarki, kashi ɗaya bisa uku kuma, a Ƙofar Harsashi, sai kuma dukan sauran mutane su kasance a filayen haikalin Ubangiji.
english: A third part shall be at the king’s house; and a third part at the gate of the foundation. All the people will be in the courts of Yahweh’s house.

hausa: A bisa sassan tsakanin mahaɗan, akwai siffofin zakoki, bijimai da kuma kerubobi, suna a kan mahaɗan su ma. A sama da kuma ƙasan siffofin zakokin da na bijiman kuwa akwai hotunan furanni.
english: and on the panels that were between the ledges were lions, oxen, and cherubim; and on the ledges there was a pedestal above; and beneath the lions and oxen were wreaths of hanging work.

hausa: Ubangiji ya kafa kursiyinsa a sama, masarautarsa kuwa na mulki a bisa duka.
english: Yahweh has established his throne in the heavens. His kingdom rules over all.

hausa: Jimillar maza daga mutanen Zebulun 57,400 ne.
english: those who were counted of them, of the tribe of Zebulun, were fifty-seven thousand four hundred.

hausa: su kasance da kamunkai da kuma tsarki, masu aiki a gida, masu kirki da kuma masu biyayya ga mazansu, don kada wani yă rena maganar Allah.
english: to be sober minded, chaste, workers at home, kind, being in subjection to their own husbands, that God’s word may not be blasphemed.

hausa: Zai yi maganar saɓo a kan Mafi Ɗaukaka, zai kuma tsananta wa tsarkaka yă kuma yi ƙoƙarin sāke lokuta da shari’u. Za a miƙa tsarkaka a hannunsa na wani lokaci, lokuta da kuma rabin lokaci.
english: He will speak words against the Most High, and will wear out the saints of the Most High. He will plan to change the times and the law; and they will be given into his hand until a time and times and half a time.

hausa: Takan farka tun da sauran duhu; ta tanada wa iyalinta abinci ta kuma shirya wa ’yan matan gidanta ayyukan da za su yi.
english: She rises also while it is yet night, gives food to her household, and portions for her servant girls.

hausa: Dawuda ya sāke tattara zaɓaɓɓun mutanen Isra’ila, dubu talatin.
english: David again gathered together all the chosen men of Israel, thirty thousand.

hausa: na furta muku yau cewa tabbatacce za a hallaka ku. Ba za ku zauna a ƙasar da kuke hayewa Urdun don ku shiga ku ci gādonta ba.
english: I declare to you today that you will surely perish. You will not prolong your days in the land where you pass over the Jordan to go in to possess it.

hausa: Ba umarni nake ba ku ba, sai dai ina so in gwada gaskiyar ƙaunarku ne, ta wurin kwatanta ta da aniyar waɗansu.
english: I speak not by way of commandment, but as proving through the earnestness of others the sincerity also of your love.

hausa: Mugaye suna jira su hallaka ni, amma zan yi ta tunani a kan farillanka.
english: The wicked have waited for me, to destroy me. I will consider your statutes.

hausa: Don haka sai Sama’ila ya gaya masa kome bai ɓoye masa kome ba. Sa’an nan Eli ya ce, “Shi ne Ubangiji bari yă yi abin da ya yi kyau a gare shi.”
english: Samuel told him every bit, and hid nothing from him. He said, “It is Yahweh. Let him do what seems good to him.”

hausa: Da suka dawo wurin Elisha, wanda yake a Yeriko, sai ya ce musu, “Ban ce muku kada ku tafi ba?”
english: They came back to him while he stayed at Jericho; and he said to them, “Didn’t I tell you, ‘Don’t go’?”

hausa: Amma in ka ƙi miƙa wuya, ga abin da Ubangiji ya bayyana mini.
english: But if you refuse to go out, this is the word that Yahweh has shown me:

hausa: Tsawon kowanne yă zama kamu talatin, fāɗinsa kuma yă zama kamu huɗu. Labulen za su zama daidai wa daida.
english: The length of each curtain shall be thirty cubits, and the width of each curtain four cubits: the eleven curtains shall have one measure.

hausa: Gaba da kome dai, dole ku gane cewa babu annabcin Nassin da ya fito daga fassarar annabi da kansa.
english: knowing this first, that no prophecy of Scripture is of private interpretation.

hausa: Ka kāre manufata ka kuma fanshe ni, ka cece rai na kamar yadda ka alkawarta!
english: Plead my cause, and redeem me! Revive me according to your promise.

hausa: Ba wani mazauna a Sihiyona da zai ce, “Ina ciwo”; za a kuma gafarta zunuban waɗanda suke zama a can.
english: The inhabitant won’t say, “I am sick.” The people who dwell therein will be forgiven their iniquity.

hausa: Na ce, “Belteshazar, shugaban masu sihiri, na san ruhun alloli suna a kanka, babu wani asirin da zai fi ƙarfin ganewarka. Ga dai mafarkin da na yi, sai ka fassara mini.
english: “Belteshazzar, master of the magicians, because I know that the spirit of the holy gods is in you and no secret troubles you, tell me the visions of my dream that I have seen, and its interpretation.

hausa: Yehohiyacin yana da shekara goma sha takwas da ya zama sarki, ya kuma yi mulki wata uku a Urushalima. Sunan mahaifiyarsa Nehushta ’yar Elnatan, mutuniyar Urushalima.
english: Jehoiachin was eighteen years old when he began to reign, and he reigned in Jerusalem three months. His mother’s name was Nehushta the daughter of Elnathan of Jerusalem.

hausa: Gama mutane da yawa a cikin Yahuda sun rantse wa Tobiya za su goyi bayansa, domin ya auri ’yar Shekaniya, ɗan Ara. Ɗansa kuma, wato, Yehohanan, ya auri ’yar Meshullam, ɗan Berekiya.
english: For there were many in Judah sworn to him because he was the son-in-law of Shecaniah the son of Arah; and his son Jehohanan had taken the daughter of Meshullam the son of Berechiah as wife.

hausa: Wani saurayin da ba ya sanye da kome sai rigar lilin, yana bin Yesu. Da suka yi ƙoƙarin kama shi,
english: A certain young man followed him, having a linen cloth thrown around himself over his naked body. The young men grabbed him,

hausa: Kada ka ji kishin mai tā-da-na-zaune-tsaye ko ka yi sha’awar aikata ayyukansu.
english: Don’t envy the man of violence. Choose none of his ways.

hausa: Sa’ad da kuwa Babban Makiyayin ya bayyana, za ku karɓi rawanin ɗaukaka marar koɗewa.
english: When the chief Shepherd is revealed, you will receive the crown of glory that doesn’t fade away.

hausa: Ta Dawuda. A gare ka Ya Ubangiji, na miƙa raina.
english: By David. To you, Yahweh, I lift up my soul.

hausa: “In ɗan’uwanka ya yi maka laifi, ka je ka nuna masa laifinsa, tsakaninku biyu kaɗai. In ya saurare ka, ka maido da ɗan’uwanka ke nan.
english: “If your brother sins against you, go, show him his fault between you and him alone. If he listens to you, you have gained back your brother.

hausa: Atrot Shofan, Yazer, Yogbeha,
english: Atroth-shophan, Jazer, Jogbehah,

hausa: Amma ga mutanen Ruben da mutanen Gad, na ba da yankin da ya tashi daga Gileyad, ya gangara zuwa Kwarin Arnon (tsakiyar kwarin kuwa shi ne iyaka) ya fita zuwa Kogin Yabbok, wanda yake shi ne iyakar Ammonawa.
english: To the Reubenites and to the Gadites I gave from Gilead even to the valley of the Arnon, the middle of the valley, and its border, even to the river Jabbok, which is the border of the children of Ammon;

hausa: Sa’an nan kowannensu ya kama abokin gābansa a kā ya soki da wuƙa a jiki, sai duka suka fāɗi a ƙasa. Saboda haka ne ake kiran wannan wuri Helkat Hazzurim a Gibeyon.
