english: They each caught his opponent by the head and thrust his sword in his fellow’s side; so they fell down together. Therefore that place in Gibeon was called Helkath Hazzurim.

hausa: Na kuma ga wani mala’ika yana saukowa daga sama, yana da mabuɗin Abis yana kuma riƙe da ƙaton sarƙa a hannunsa.
english: I saw an angel coming down out of heaven, having the key of the abyss and a great chain in his hand.

hausa: Sai suka ce, “Allah na Ibraniyawa ya sadu da mu. Yanzu bari mu ɗauki tafiyar kwana uku cikin hamada domin mu miƙa hadaya ga Ubangiji Allahnmu, don kada yă buga mu da annoba ko takobi.”
english: They said, “The God of the Hebrews has met with us. Please let us go three days’ journey into the wilderness, and sacrifice to Yahweh, our God, lest he fall on us with pestilence, or with the sword.”

hausa: Bayan dukan wannan, sai Ubangiji ya sa wa Yehoram cuta marar warkarwa ta ciki.
english: After all this Yahweh struck him in his bowels with an incurable disease.

hausa: Game da sauran ayyukan mulkin Menahem, duk a rubuce suke a cikin littafin tarihin sarakunan Isra’ila.
english: Now the rest of the acts of Menahem, and all that he did, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

hausa: “ ‘Wannan ita ce bayarwa ta musamman da za ku miƙa, kashi ɗaya bisa shida na efa daga kowace gangan alkama da kashi ɗaya bisa shida na efa daga kowace gangan sha’ir.
english: “‘“This is the offering that you shall offer: the sixth part of an ephah from a homer of wheat, and you shall give the sixth part of an ephah from a homer of barley,

hausa: Sa’an nan suka yi waɗansu ƙarin zobai biyu na zinariya, suka maƙale su daga ƙasa a gaban kafaɗu biyu na efod kusa da mahaɗin a bisa abin ɗamarar efod.
english: They made two more rings of gold, and put them on the two shoulder straps of the ephod underneath, in its front, close by its coupling, above the skillfully woven band of the ephod.

hausa: Sai ya ce, “Mace, don me kike kuka? Wa kike nema?” Ta yi tsammani shi ne mai aikin lambun, sai ta ce, “Ranka yă daɗe, in kai ne ka ɗauke shi, gaya mini inda ka ajiye shi, in je in ɗauke shi.”
english: Jesus said to her, “Woman, why are you weeping? Who are you looking for?” She, supposing him to be the gardener, said to him, “Sir, if you have carried him away, tell me where you have laid him, and I will take him away.”

hausa: Sai Ubangiji ya ce wa Musa, “Ka tashi da sassafe ka sadu da Fir’auna a lokacin da za shi kogi, ka ce masa, ‘Ga abin da Ubangiji yana cewa, bari mutanena su tafi, don su yi mini sujada.
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “Rise up early in the morning, and stand before Pharaoh; behold, he comes out to the water; and tell him, ‘This is what Yahweh says, “Let my people go, that they may serve me.

hausa: “Gama ya kamata leɓunan firist su kiyaye ilimi, ya kamata kuma mutane su nemi umarni daga bakinsa, domin shi ne manzon Ubangiji Maɗaukaki.
english: For the priest’s lips should keep knowledge, and they should seek the law at his mouth; for he is the messenger of Yahweh of Armies.

hausa: Ta yaya za ku gaskata in kuna neman yabon junanku, ba kwa kuwa yin ƙoƙarin neman yabon da yake zuwa daga Allah Makaɗaici?
english: How can you believe, who receive glory from one another, and you don’t seek the glory that comes from the only God?

hausa: Amma Yowab da Abishai suka fafari Abner, kuma da rana tana fāɗuwa sai suka iso tudun Amma, kusa da Giya, a hanyar zuwa jejin Gibeyon.
english: But Joab and Abishai pursued Abner. The sun went down when they had come to the hill of Ammah, that lies before Giah by the way of the wilderness of Gibeon.

hausa: Suka ɗaura sarƙoƙi biyu na zinariya da kusurwoyi na ƙyallen maƙalawa a ƙirji.
english: They put the two braided chains of gold in the two rings at the ends of the breastplate.

hausa: Da a ce ban zo na yi musu magana ba, da ba su da zunubi. Yanzu kam, ba su da wata hujja a kan zunubinsu.
english: If I had not come and spoken to them, they would not have had sin; but now they have no excuse for their sin.

hausa: “ ‘Zan sanar da sunana mai tsarki a cikin mutanena Isra’ila. Ba zan ƙara bari a ɓata sunana mai tsarki ba, kuma al’ummai za su san cewa Ni Ubangiji Mai Tsarki ne a cikin Isra’ila.
english: “‘“I will make my holy name known among my people Israel. I won’t allow my holy name to be profaned any more. Then the nations will know that I am Yahweh, the Holy One in Israel.

hausa: Yesu ya tambaye su, “Burodi guda nawa kuke da shi?” Suka amsa suka ce, “Guda bakwai da ’yan ƙananan kifaye.”
english: Jesus said to them, “How many loaves do you have?” They said, “Seven, and a few small fish.”

hausa: Nuhu, mutumin ƙasa, shi ne farko da ya fara yin gonar inabi.
english: Noah began to be a farmer, and planted a vineyard.

hausa: Wanda yake na Allah, yakan ji abin da Allah yake faɗi. Abin da ya sa ba kwa jin sa kuwa shi ne don ku ba na Allah ba ne.”
english: He who is of God hears the words of God. For this cause you don’t hear, because you are not of God.”

hausa: Mutanen Yahuda da mutanen Isra’ila za su sāke haɗu su zama ɗaya, za su kuma naɗa shugaba guda su kuma fita daga ƙasar, gama ranar za tă zama mai girma wa Yezireyel.
english: The children of Judah and the children of Israel will be gathered together, and they will appoint themselves one head, and will go up from the land; for great will be the day of Jezreel.

hausa: “Ni ba na neman yabon mutane,
english: I don’t receive glory from men.

hausa: Cikin kwana hamsin da biyu aka gama gina katangar, a ranar ashirin da biyar ga watan Elul.
english: So the wall was finished in the twenty-fifth day of Elul, in fifty-two days.

hausa: Duk wanda bai yi mūsun kansa a wannan rana ba, dole a raba shi daga mutanensa.
english: For whoever it is who shall not deny himself in that same day shall be cut off from his people.

hausa: Kun sa Ubangiji Maɗaukaki ya gaji da maganganunku. Sai kuka ce, “Yaya muka sa ya gaji?” Kun yi haka ta wurin cewa, “Duk waɗanda suke aikata mugunta, mutanen kirki ne a gaban Ubangiji, yana kuwa jin daɗinsu,” kuna kuma cewa, “Ina Allah mai adalci yake?”
english: You have wearied Yahweh with your words. Yet you say, ‘How have we wearied him?’ In that you say, ‘Everyone who does evil is good in Yahweh’s sight, and he delights in them;’ or ‘Where is the God of justice?’

hausa: Ina gaya muku, ba zan ƙara shan ruwan inabin nan ba har sai ranar da zan sha shi sabo tare da ku a mulkin Ubana.”
english: But I tell you that I will not drink of this fruit of the vine from now on, until that day when I drink it anew with you in my Father’s Kingdom.”

hausa: In ba ku saurara ba, in kuma ba ku sa zuciyarku ga girmama sunana ba, zan aukar muku da la’ana, zan kuma la’antar da albarkunku. I, na riga na la’anta su, domin ba ku sa zuciyarku ga girmama ni ba, in ji Ubangiji Maɗaukaki.
english: If you will not listen, and if you will not take it to heart, to give glory to my name,” says Yahweh of Armies, “then I will send the curse on you, and I will curse your blessings. Indeed, I have cursed them already, because you do not take it to heart.

hausa: Da ya sami dutse guda mai daraja sosai, sai ya tafi ya sayar da dukan abin da yake da shi ya saye shi.
english: who having found one pearl of great price, he went and sold all that he had and bought it.

hausa: Iddo, Ginneton, Abiya,
english: Iddo, Ginnethoi, Abijah,

hausa: A lokacin ni ne mai tsara abubuwa a gefensa. Na cika da murna kowace rana, kullum ina farin ciki a gabansa,
english: then I was the craftsman by his side. I was a delight day by day, always rejoicing before him,

hausa: Wane alkawari ne tsakanin haikalin Allah da na gumaka? Gama mu haikalin Allah mai rai ne. Kamar yadda Allah ya ce, “Zan zauna tare da su, in yi tafiya a cikinsu, zan zama Allahnsu, su kuma za su zama mutanena.”
english: What agreement does a temple of God have with idols? For you are a temple of the living God. Even as God said, “I will dwell in them and walk in them. I will be their God and they will be my people.”

hausa: Ƙasar a wajen kudu ta Efraim ce, ta wajen arewa kuma ta Manasse ce. Bahar Rum ita ce iyakarsu. Asher yana wajen arewa, Issakar kuma a wajen gabas.
english: Southward it was Ephraim’s, and northward it was Manasseh’s, and the sea was his border. They reached to Asher on the north, and to Issachar on the east.

hausa: Sai ya aika aka kawo shi. Ga shi kuwa kyakkyawan saurayi ne mai kyan gani. Ubangiji ya ce, “Tashi ka shafe shi, shi ne wannan.”
english: He sent, and brought him in. Now he was ruddy, with a handsome face and good appearance. Yahweh said, “Arise! Anoint him, for this is he.”

hausa: Daga baya sa’ad da fushin Sarki Zerzes ya huce, sai ya tuna da Bashti da abin da ta yi, da kuma dokar da ya bayar game da ita.
english: After these things, when the wrath of King Ahasuerus was pacified, he remembered Vashti, and what she had done, and what was decreed against her.

hausa: Amma ba wani a wurin cin abincin da ya fahimci dalilin da ya sa Yesu ya faɗa masa haka.
english: Now nobody at the table knew why he said this to him.

hausa: “ ‘Da mun warkar da Babilon, amma ba za tă warke ba; mu ƙyale ta kowane yă koma garinsu, gama hukuncinta ya kai sammai, ya yi tsawo kamar gizagizai.’
english: “We would have healed Babylon, but she is not healed. Forsake her, and let’s each go into his own country; for her judgment reaches to heaven, and is lifted up even to the skies.

hausa: Ko da yake masu mulki sun zauna tare suna ɓata mini suna, bawanka zai yi tunani a kan ƙa’idodinka.
english: Though princes sit and slander me, your servant will meditate on your statutes.

hausa: “Ubangiji ya kawo ni a matsayi na farko na ayyukansa, kafin ayyukansa na tuntuni;
english: “Yahweh possessed me in the beginning of his work, before his deeds of old.

hausa: Yaƙub ya riga ya kafa tentinsa a yankin tuddan Gileyad sa’ad da Laban ya same shi. Laban da danginsa suka kafa sansani a can su ma.
english: Laban caught up with Jacob. Now Jacob had pitched his tent in the mountain, and Laban with his relatives encamped in the mountain of Gilead.

hausa: Ta haka zan nuna girmana da kuma tsarkina, zan sanar da kaina a gaban al’ummai masu yawa. Sa’an nan za su san cewa ni ne Ubangiji.’
english: I will magnify myself and sanctify myself, and I will make myself known in the eyes of many nations. Then they will know that I am Yahweh.”’

hausa: Idan Akish ya ce, “Ina ka kai hari yau?” Sai Dawuda yă ce, “Na kai hari a Negeb ta Yahuda, ko Negeb ta Yerameyel, ko Negeb na Keniyawa.”
english: Achish said, “Against whom have you made a raid today?” David said, “Against the South of Judah, against the South of the Jerahmeelites, and against the South of the Kenites.”

hausa: Ya auri mata ɗari bakwai, haifaffun gidan sarauta, da kuma ƙwarƙwarai ɗari uku. Matan nan nasa suka karkatar da shi.
english: He had seven hundred wives, princesses, and three hundred concubines. His wives turned his heart away.

hausa: Ƙasa ce da Ubangiji Allahnku yake lura da ita; idanun Ubangiji Allahnku yana a kai daga farkon shekara har zuwa ƙarshenta.
english: a land which Yahweh your God cares for. Yahweh your God’s eyes are always on it, from the beginning of the year even to the end of the year.

hausa: Ko da yake sun san dokar adalcin Allah cewa masu aikata irin waɗannan abubuwa sun cancanci mutuwa, duk da haka ba cin gaba da aikata waɗannan abubuwa kaɗai suke yi ba, har ma suna goyon bayan masu yinsu.
english: who, knowing the ordinance of God, that those who practice such things are worthy of death, not only do the same, but also approve of those who practice them.

hausa: la’ana in ba ku yi biyayya da umarnan Ubangiji Allahnku, kuka kuma juya daga hanyar da na umarce ku, ta wurin bin waɗansu alloli, waɗanda ba ku sani ba.
english: and the curse, if you do not listen to the commandments of Yahweh your God, but turn away out of the way which I command you today, to go after other gods which you have not known.

hausa: Bala’am ya ce wa jakar “Domin kin wulaƙanta ni! Da a ce ina da takobi a hannuna da zan kashe ki nan take.”
english: Balaam said to the donkey, “Because you have mocked me, I wish there were a sword in my hand, for now I would have killed you.”

hausa: Shi ne ya sa Isra’ilawa suka kāsa yin tsayayya da abokan gābansu; suka juya suka gudu domin za a hallaka su. Ba zan sāke kasancewa tare da ku ba sai in kun hallaka duk abin da aka keɓe don hallaka.
english: Therefore the children of Israel can’t stand before their enemies. They turn their backs before their enemies, because they have become devoted for destruction. I will not be with you any more, unless you destroy the devoted things from among you.

hausa: Kada ku durƙusa wa allolinsu, ko ku yi musu sujada, ko kuma ku bi al’adunsu. Za ku hallaka dukan allolinsu, ku kuma farfasa keɓaɓɓun duwatsunsu.
english: You shall not bow down to their gods, nor serve them, nor follow their practices, but you shall utterly overthrow them and demolish their pillars.

hausa: Isra’ilawa suka haura suka yi kuka a gaban Ubangiji, har yamma, suka nemi nufin Ubangiji. Suka ce, “Mu sāke koma yaƙi da mutanen Benyamin, ’yan’uwanmu?” Ubangiji ya ce, “Ku haura ku fāɗa musu.”
english: The children of Israel went up and wept before Yahweh until evening; and they asked of Yahweh, saying, “Shall I again draw near to battle against the children of Benjamin my brother?” Yahweh said, “Go up against him.”

hausa: Ka kasa kunne ka kuma saurara ga maganganu masu hikima; ka yi amfani da abin da nake koyarwa,
english: Turn your ear, and listen to the words of the wise. Apply your heart to my teaching.

hausa: Ko da yake ni ba kome ba ne an kuwa rena ni, ba na manta da farillanka.
english: I am small and despised. I don’t forget your precepts.

hausa: Zan ɗauke ku tamƙar mutanena, in kuma zama Allahnku. Sa’an nan za ku sani Ni ne Ubangiji Allahnku, wanda ya fitar da ku daga wahalar Masarawa.
english: I will take you to myself for a people. I will be your God; and you shall know that I am Yahweh your God, who brings you out from under the burdens of the Egyptians.

hausa: “Wane ne yake so ya koyar? Ga wa yake bayyana saƙonsa? Ga yaran da aka yaye, ga waɗanda ba a daɗe da yayewa ba ne?
english: Whom will he teach knowledge? To whom will he explain the message? Those who are weaned from the milk, and drawn from the breasts?

hausa: “A wannan rana,” in ji Ubangiji “Zan hallaka dawakanku daga cikinku, in kuma rurrushe kekunan yaƙinku.
english: “It will happen in that day”, says Yahweh, “that I will cut off your horses from among you and will destroy your chariots.

hausa: Mutanen fa, makiyaya ne; suna kiwon dabbobi, sun kuma zo tare da garkunansu da shanunsa da kuma kome da suka mallaka.’
english: These men are shepherds, for they have been keepers of livestock, and they have brought their flocks, and their herds, and all that they have.’

hausa: Amma wani mutumin Samariya da yake kan tafiya, da ya kai inda mutumin yake, ya gan shi, sai ya ji tausayinsa.
english: But a certain Samaritan, as he traveled, came where he was. When he saw him, he was moved with compassion,

hausa: Wuyanki ya yi kamar hasumiyar hauren giwa. Idanunki sun yi kamar tafkin Heshbon kusa da ƙofar Bat Rabbim. Hancinki ya yi kamar hasumiyar Lebanon wadda take duban Damaskus.
english: Your neck is like an ivory tower. Your eyes are like the pools in Heshbon by the gate of Bathrabbim. Your nose is like the tower of Lebanon which looks toward Damascus.

hausa: Amma in akwai rauni mai tsanani, sai a ɗauki rai a maimakon rai,
english: But if any harm follows, then you must take life for life,

hausa: Sun haɗa baki, sun ɓoye, suna kallon takawata suna a shirye su ɗauki raina.
english: They conspire and lurk, watching my steps. They are eager to take my life.

hausa: Nakan bi ta a baya in buga ta in kuma ƙwato tunkiyar daga bakinta. In kuma ta taso mini, nakan cafke ta a gashinta in buga ta in kashe.
english: I went out after him, struck him, and rescued it out of his mouth. When he arose against me, I caught him by his beard, struck him, and killed him.

hausa: A wannan rana zan yi fushi da su, in kuma yashe su; zan ɓoye fuskata daga gare su, za a kuwa hallaka su. Masifu masu yawa da wahaloli masu yawa za su auka musu, a wannan rana kuwa za su ce, ‘Masifun nan sun same mu domin Allahnmu ba ya tare da mu’
english: Then my anger shall be kindled against them in that day, and I will forsake them, and I will hide my face from them, and they shall be devoured, and many evils and troubles shall come on them; so that they will say in that day, ‘Haven’t these evils come on us because our God is not among us?’

hausa: Aka kama shi, aka kai shi gaban sarkin Babilon a Ribla, inda aka yanke masa hukunci.
english: Then they captured the king and carried him up to the king of Babylon to Riblah; and they passed judgment on him.

hausa: Yana ta yawo, abinci don ungulaye; ya san ranar duhu tana kusa.
english: He wanders abroad for bread, saying, ‘Where is it?’ He knows that the day of darkness is ready at his hand.

hausa: Bari mu kwanta mu sha kunya, bari kuma kunyarmu ta rufe mu. Mun yi wa Ubangiji Allahnmu zunubi, da mu da kakanninmu; daga ƙuruciyarmu har yă zuwa yau ba mu yi wa Ubangiji Allahnmu biyayya ba.”
english: Let us lie down in our shame, and let our confusion cover us; for we have sinned against Yahweh our God, we and our fathers, from our youth even to this day. We have not obeyed Yahweh our God’s voice.”

hausa: Ku yi kome da ƙauna.
english: Let all that you do be done in love.

hausa: Ta haka ba za mu juye mu bar ka ba; ka rayar da mu, za mu kuwa kira bisa sunanka.
english: So we will not turn away from you. Revive us, and we will call on your name.

hausa: Sai suka haƙa wata rijiya, amma suka yi faɗa a kanta ita ma, saboda haka ya ce da ita Sitna.
english: They dug another well, and they argued over that, also. So he called its name Sitnah.

hausa: Ka cece ni, ina roƙonka daga hannun ɗan’uwana Isuwa, gama ina tsoro zai zo yă fāɗa mini, yă karkashe mu duka, ’ya’ya da iyaye.
english: Please deliver me from the hand of my brother, from the hand of Esau; for I fear him, lest he come and strike me and the mothers with the children.

hausa: “Wannan da ya zo daga sama ya fi kowa; wannan da ya zo daga ƙasa na ƙasa ne, yana kuma magana kamar wanda ya zo daga ƙasa ne. Wannan da ya zo daga sama ya fi kowa.
english: “He who comes from above is above all. He who is from the earth belongs to the earth and speaks of the earth. He who comes from heaven is above all.

hausa: “Duk nisan wurare kewaye da birnin zai zama kamu 18,000 ne. “Sunan birnin kuwa daga wannan lokaci zai zama, ‘Ubangiji yana a nan.’ ”
english: “It shall be eighteen thousand reeds in circumference; and the name of the city from that day shall be, ‘Yahweh is there.’

hausa: A wannan rana aka karanta Littafin Musa da ƙarfi a kunnuwan mutane aka kuma sami an rubuta cewa kada a karɓi mutumin Ammon ko mutumin Mowab cikin taron Allah,
english: On that day they read in the book of Moses in the hearing of the people; and it was found written in it that an Ammonite and a Moabite should not enter into the assembly of God forever,

hausa: Sa’ad da Musa ya sanar wa dukan mutane kowane umarni na doka, sai ya ɗauki jinin maruƙa tare da ruwa, jan ulu da kuma rassan hizzob, ya yayyafa a kan naɗaɗɗen littafin da kuma a kan dukan mutanen.
english: For when every commandment had been spoken by Moses to all the people according to the law, he took the blood of the calves and the goats, with water and scarlet wool and hyssop, and sprinkled both the book itself and all the people,

hausa: Saboda haka, ku ƙasƙantar da kanku a ƙarƙashin hannun Allah mai ƙarfi, don yă ɗaukaka ku a lokacin da ya ga dama.
english: Humble yourselves therefore under the mighty hand of God, that he may exalt you in due time,

hausa: Saboda haka, sai ku fid da duk wani abin da yake kawo sha’awa a zukatanku, fasikanci, ƙazanta, sha’awa, muguwar sha’awa, da kuma kwaɗayi wanda shi ma bautar gumaka ne.
english: Put to death therefore your members which are on the earth: sexual immorality, uncleanness, depraved passion, evil desire, and covetousness, which is idolatry.

hausa: Kamar yadda mutane sukan tattara azurfa, tagulla, ƙarfe, darma da kuza a cikin tanderu don su narkar da su da wuta, haka zan tattara ku cikin fushina da kuma hasalata in sa ku cikin birnin in narkar da ku.
english: As they gather silver, bronze, iron, lead, and tin into the middle of the furnace, to blow the fire on it, to melt it, so I will gather you in my anger and in my wrath, and I will lay you there and melt you.

hausa: Ga wata magana tabbatacciya, “In muka mutu tare da shi, za mu rayu tare da shi;
english: This saying is trustworthy: “For if we died with him, we will also live with him.

hausa: Duk wanda ya gan ki zai gudu daga gare ki yana cewa, ‘Ninebe ta lalace, wa zai yi makoki domin ta?’ Ina zan sami wani wanda zai yi miki ta’aziyya?”
english: It will happen that all those who look at you will flee from you, and say, ‘Nineveh is laid waste! Who will mourn for her?’ Where will I seek comforters for you?”

hausa: Ai, kun san hanyar zuwa inda za ni.”
english: You know where I go, and you know the way.”

hausa: Ta wurin tsayawa da ƙarfi, za ku sami rai.
english: “By your endurance you will win your lives.

hausa: Makaman da muke yaƙi da su, ba makamai na duniya ba ne. Sai dai na ikon Allah ne, masu rushe wuraren mafaka masu ƙarfi.
english: for the weapons of our warfare are not of the flesh, but mighty before God to the throwing down of strongholds,

hausa: ta goma a kan Shimeyi, ’ya’yansa maza da danginsa, 12
english: the tenth to Shimei, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

hausa: Eltolad, Kesil, Horma,
english: Eltolad, Chesil, Hormah,

hausa: Ayyukan hannuwansa masu aminci ne da kuma gaskiya; dukan farillansa abin dogara ne.
english: The works of his hands are truth and justice. All his precepts are sure.

hausa: Yesu Kiristi ba ya sākewa, shi ne a jiya, shi ne a yau, shi ne kuma har abada.
english: Jesus Christ is the same yesterday, today, and forever.

hausa: Su daga duniya ne saboda haka suke magana yadda duniya take ganin abubuwa, duniya kuwa tana sauraronsu.
english: They are of the world. Therefore they speak of the world, and the world hears them.

hausa: Sa’an nan firist ɗin zai zuba jinin a ƙahonin bagaden turare masu ƙanshi da suke a gaban Ubangiji a Tentin Sujada. Sauran jinin bijimin zai zuba a gindin bagaden hadaya ta ƙonawa a ƙofar zuwa Tentin Sujada.
english: The priest shall put some of the blood on the horns of the altar of sweet incense before Yahweh, which is in the Tent of Meeting; and he shall pour out the rest of the blood of the bull at the base of the altar of burnt offering, which is at the door of the Tent of Meeting.

hausa: Sai sarki ya umarci matsaran da suke tsaye kusa da shi ya ce, “Ku kakkashe firistocin Ubangiji, gama su ma sun goyi bayan Dawuda. Sun san yana gudu, duk da haka ba su gaya mini ba.” Amma ma’aikatan sarki ba su yarda su sa hannu su kashe firistocin Ubangiji ba.
english: The king said to the guard who stood about him, “Turn and kill the priests of Yahweh, because their hand also is with David, and because they knew that he fled and didn’t disclose it to me.” But the servants of the king wouldn’t put out their hand to fall on the priests of Yahweh.

hausa: Gaba ɗaya dai, Kenan ya yi shekara 910, sa’an nan ya mutu.
english: and all of the days of Kenan were nine hundred ten years, then he died.

hausa: Zan washe in kwashe ganima in kuma juye hannuna gāba da kufai da aka sāke zaunar da mutanen da aka tattara daga al’ummai, masu yawan shanu da kayayyaki, masu zama a tsakiyar ƙasa.”
english: to take the plunder and to take prey; to turn your hand against the waste places that are inhabited, and against the people who are gathered out of the nations, who have gotten livestock and goods, who dwell in the middle of the earth.’

hausa: Yayinda suke cikin cin abinci, Yesu ya ɗauki burodi, ya yi godiya ya kuma kakkarya, ya ba wa almajiransa yana cewa, “Ku karɓa ku ci; wannan jikina ne.”
english: As they were eating, Jesus took bread, gave thanks for it, and broke it. He gave to the disciples and said, “Take, eat; this is my body.”

hausa: zuriya ta Adonikam ne suka zo daga ƙarshe, sunayensu kuwa su ne Elifelet, Yehiyel da Shemahiya, tare da su akwai mutum 60;
english: Of the sons of Adonikam, who were the last, their names are: Eliphelet, Jeuel, and Shemaiah; and with them sixty males.

hausa: A filayen Mowab kusa da Urdun ɗaura da Yeriko ne Ubangiji ya ce wa Musa,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho, saying,

hausa: kamar shanun da suke gangarawa zuwa kwari, haka Ruhun Ubangiji ya ba su hutu. Ga yadda ka bishe mutanenka don ka ba wa kanka suna mai ɗaukaka.
english: As the livestock that go down into the valley, Yahweh’s Spirit caused them to rest. So you led your people to make yourself a glorious name.

hausa: suka kuma yi rammukan azurfa arba’in don katakan su shiga ƙarƙashinsu, rammuka biyu domin kowane katako, ɗaya ƙarƙashin kowanne da aka fiƙe.
english: He made forty sockets of silver under the twenty boards: two sockets under one board for its two tenons, and two sockets under another board for its two tenons.

hausa: Sai ya aiki mutane su je su kamo Dawuda, amma da suka ga ƙungiyar annabawa suna annabci tare da Sama’ila shugabansu a tsaye, sai Ruhun Allah ya sauko wa mutanen Shawulu, su ma suka fara yin annabci.
english: Saul sent messengers to seize David; and when they saw the company of the prophets prophesying, and Samuel standing as head over them, God’s Spirit came on Saul’s messengers, and they also prophesied.

hausa: yayinda kuke taimakonmu ta wurin addu’o’inku. Mutane da yawa kuwa za su yi godiya ta dalilinmu, saboda albarkar da aka yi mana, ta amsa addu’o’i masu yawa.
english: you also helping together on our behalf by your supplication; that, for the gift given to us by means of many, thanks may be given by many persons on your behalf.

hausa: In babu tashin matattu, to, ba a tā da Kiristi ma ba ke nan.
english: But if there is no resurrection of the dead, neither has Christ been raised.

hausa: Uzziyel ɗan Harhahiya, ɗaya daga cikin masu ƙeran zinariya ne ya yi gyare-gyaren sashe na biye; sai Hananiya, ɗaya daga cikin masu yin turare, ya yi gyare-gyaren biye da wannan. Suka gyara Urushalima har zuwa Katanga Mai Faɗi.
english: Next to him, Uzziel the son of Harhaiah, goldsmiths, made repairs. Next to him, Hananiah, one of the perfumers, made repairs, and they fortified Jerusalem even to the wide wall.

hausa: Waɗannan garuruwa shida za su zama wurin mafaka wa Isra’ilawa, baƙi da duk sauran mutanen da suke zama a cikinsu, saboda duk wanda ya kashe mutum cikin kuskure yă iya gudu zuwa.
english: These six cities shall be refuge for the children of Israel, for the stranger, and for the foreigner living among them, that everyone who kills any person unwittingly may flee there.

hausa: Ben-Hadad sarkin Aram kuwa ya tattara mayaƙansa gaba ɗaya. Sarakuna talatin da biyu suka tafi tare da shi haɗe da dawakansu da kekunan yaƙinsu. Ya haura ya yi wa Samariya kwanto, ya kuma yaƙe ta.
english: Ben Hadad the king of Syria gathered all his army together; and there were thirty-two kings with him, with horses and chariots. He went up and besieged Samaria, and fought against it.

hausa: ’Ya’yan Liyatu maza, Ruben shi ne ɗan fari na Yaƙub. Sauran su ne, Simeyon, Lawi, Yahuda, Issakar da Zebulun.
english: The sons of Leah: Reuben (Jacob’s firstborn), Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, and Zebulun.

hausa: Betlehem, Etam, Tekowa,
english: He built Bethlehem, Etam, Tekoa,

hausa: Na’omi ta ce wa Rut surukarta, “Zai fi miki kyau, ’yata ki riƙa tafiya da ’yan matansa, domin a gonar wani dabam mai yiwuwa a yi miki lahani.”
english: Naomi said to Ruth her daughter-in-law, “It is good, my daughter, that you go out with his maidens, and that they not harm you in any other field.”

hausa: Ga shi fa, sun firgita don tsoro, ko da yake babu dalilin tsoro, gama Allah zai watsar da ƙasusuwan masu ƙinsa, za su sha kunya, gama Allah ya ƙi su.
english: There they were in great fear, where no fear was, for God has scattered the bones of him who encamps against you. You have put them to shame, because God has rejected them.

hausa: Sai dai ku yi girma cikin alheri da sanin Ubangijinmu da Mai Cetonmu Yesu Kiristi. A gare shi ɗaukaka ta tabbata yanzu da har abada! Amin.
english: But grow in the grace and knowledge of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ. To him be the glory both now and forever. Amen.

hausa: Kowace rana suna masa magana, amma ya ƙi yă yi. Saboda haka, suka faɗa wa Haman game da wannan don su ga ko za a jure da halin Mordekai, gama ya faɗa musu cewa shi mutumin Yahuda ne.
english: Now it came to pass, when they spoke daily to him, and he didn’t listen to them, that they told Haman, to see whether Mordecai’s reason would stand; for he had told them that he was a Jew.

hausa: Ahaz ya huta tare da kakanninsa, aka kuma binne shi a birnin Urushalima, amma ba a sa shi a makabartan sarakunan Isra’ila ba. Sai Hezekiya ɗansa ya gāje shi a matsayin sarki.
english: Ahaz slept with his fathers, and they buried him in the city, even in Jerusalem, because they didn’t bring him into the tombs of the kings of Israel; and Hezekiah his son reigned in his place.

hausa: Sarkin Masar ya naɗa Eliyakim, ɗan’uwan Yehoyahaz, sarki a bisa Yahuda da kuma Urushalima, ya kuma canja sunan Eliyakim zuwa Yehohiyakim. Amma Neko ya ɗauki Yehoyahaz ɗan’uwan Eliyakim ya kai Masar.
english: The king of Egypt made Eliakim his brother king over Judah and Jerusalem, and changed his name to Jehoiakim. Neco took Joahaz his brother, and carried him to Egypt.

hausa: Ubangiji ya amsa wa Musa, “Duk wanda ya yi mini zunubi, shi zan shafe daga littafina.
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “Whoever has sinned against me, I will blot him out of my book.

hausa: Amma tukunyar da yake ginawa ta lalace a hannuwansa, sai mai ginin tukwanen ya sāke gina wata tukunya dabam, yana gyara ta yadda ya ga dama.
english: When the vessel that he made of the clay was marred in the hand of the potter, he made it again another vessel, as seemed good to the potter to make it.

hausa: Yabi Ubangiji daga duniya, ku manyan halittun teku da kuma dukan zurfafan teku,
english: Praise Yahweh from the earth, you great sea creatures, and all depths,

hausa: Allah ya kuma ce wa Musa, “Ni ne Ubangiji.
english: God spoke to Moses, and said to him, “I am Yahweh.

hausa: Ahaz ya aika a faɗa wa Tiglat-Fileser sarkin Assuriya cewa, “Ni abokin tarayyarka ne kuma mai dogara da kai. Ka haura ka cece ni daga hannun sarkin Aram da hannun sarkin Isra’ila waɗanda suke kawo mini hari.”
english: So Ahaz sent messengers to Tiglath Pileser king of Assyria, saying, “I am your servant and your son. Come up and save me out of the hand of the king of Syria and out of the hand of the king of Israel, who rise up against me.”

hausa: Idan Balawe ya tashi daga wani garinku, wurin da yake da zama a Isra’ila, ya tafi a wurin da Ubangiji ya zaɓa, zai iya dawo a duk lokacin da ya ga dama.
english: If a Levite comes from any of your gates out of all Israel where he lives, and comes with all the desire of his soul to the place which Yahweh shall choose,

hausa: Ai, Kushawa da Libiyawa rundunar sojoji ne masu yawan gaske, suna kuma da kekunan yaƙi da mahayan dawakai masu yawa ƙwarai. Amma duk da haka, saboda ka dogara ga Ubangiji, ya kuwa ba da su cikin hannunka.
english: Weren’t the Ethiopians and the Lubim a huge army, with chariots and exceedingly many horsemen? Yet, because you relied on Yahweh, he delivered them into your hand.

hausa: Nahash mutumin Ammon ya haura ya kewaye Yabesh Gileyad da yaƙi. Dukan mutanen Yabesh suka ce masa, “Ka ƙulla amana da mu, mu kuwa za mu bauta maka.”
english: Then Nahash the Ammonite came up and encamped against Jabesh Gilead; and all the men of Jabesh said to Nahash, “Make a covenant with us, and we will serve you.”

hausa: “Yi wa taron jama’ar Isra’ila gaba ɗaya magana, ka ce musu, ‘Ku zama masu tsarki, domin Ni, Ubangiji Allahnku, mai tsarki ne.
english: “Speak to all the congregation of the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘You shall be holy; for I, Yahweh your God, am holy.

hausa: Har wa yau, waɗansu daga cikin matanmu sun ba mu mamaki. Sun je kabarin da sassafen nan,
english: Also, certain women of our company amazed us, having arrived early at the tomb;

hausa: Sai Bala’am ya ga Amalek, ya kuma furta maganarsa. “Amalek yana cikin al’ummai na fari, amma zai zama na ƙarshen da za a hallaka.”
english: He looked at Amalek, and took up his parable, and said, “Amalek was the first of the nations, but his latter end shall come to destruction.”

hausa: Ya yi mugunta a gaban Ubangiji, yana tafiya a hanyoyin mahaifinsa da kuma cikin zunubinsa, wanda ya sa Isra’ila suka yi.
english: He did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight, and walked in the way of his father, and in his sin with which he made Israel to sin.

hausa: “Kash, da ma Allah zai ba ni abin da nake fatar samu, da ma Allah zai biya mini bukatata,
english: “Oh that I might have my request, that God would grant the thing that I long for,

hausa: Ka koya mini hanyarka, ya Ubangiji; ka bi da ni a miƙaƙƙiyar hanya saboda masu danne ni.
english: Teach me your way, Yahweh. Lead me in a straight path, because of my enemies.

hausa: Sa’an nan ya gaya mini cewa, “Kada ka rufe kalmomin annabcin littafin nan, domin lokaci ya yi kusa.
english: He said to me, “Don’t seal up the words of the prophecy of this book, for the time is at hand.

hausa: Waɗanda suke rayuwa bisa ga mutuntaka sun kafa hankulansu a kan sha’awace-shawa’acen jiki; amma waɗanda suke rayuwa bisa ga Ruhu sun kafa hankulansu a kan abubuwan da Ruhu yake so.
english: For those who live according to the flesh set their minds on the things of the flesh, but those who live according to the Spirit, the things of the Spirit.

hausa: da Serahiya ɗan Hilkiya, ɗan Meshullam, ɗan Zadok, ɗan Merahiyot, ɗan Ahitub, mai lura da abubuwa a cikin gidan Allah,
english: Seraiah the son of Hilkiah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Zadok, the son of Meraioth, the son of Ahitub, the ruler of God’s house,

hausa: A rana ta goma sha uku na watan goma sha biyu, wato, watan Adar ne za a aiwatar da dokar da sarki ya umarta. A wannan rana, abokan gāban Yahudawa suka sa zuciya za su sha ƙarfinsu, amma yanzu Zerzes ya canja, Yahudawa kuma suka yi galiba a bisa waɗanda suka ƙi jininsu.
english: Now in the twelfth month, which is the month Adar, on the thirteenth day of the month, when the king’s commandment and his decree came near to be put in execution, on the day that the enemies of the Jews hoped to conquer them, (but it turned out that the opposite happened, that the Jews conquered those who hated them),

hausa: Yohanna ya amsa musu duka ya ce, “Ina muku baftisma da ruwa. Amma wani wanda ya fi ni iko yana zuwa, ban ma isa in kunce igiyar takalmansa ba. Shi zai yi muku baftisma da Ruhu Mai Tsarki da wuta kuma.
english: John answered them all, “I indeed baptize you with water, but he comes who is mightier than I, the strap of whose sandals I am not worthy to loosen. He will baptize you in the Holy Spirit and fire.

hausa: A cikin Doka yana a rubuce cewa, “Ta wurin mutane masu baƙin harsuna da kuma ta leɓunan baƙi zan yi magana da waɗannan mutane, amma duk da haka, ba za su saurare ni ba,” in ji Ubangiji.
english: In the law it is written, “By men of strange languages and by the lips of strangers I will speak to this people. They won’t even listen to me that way, says the Lord.”

hausa: Har yă zuwa yau Edom na tawaye a kan Yahuda. Libna ya yi tawaye a lokaci guda, domin Yehoram ya yashe Ubangiji Allah na kakanninsa.
english: So Edom has been in revolt from under the hand of Judah to this day. Then Libnah revolted at the same time from under his hand, because he had forsaken Yahweh, the God of his fathers.

hausa: Ya sāke tafiya sau na biyu, ya yi addu’a ya ce, “Ubana, in ba zai yiwu a ɗauke wannan kwaf ba sai na sha shi, to, bari a aikata nufinka.”
english: Again, a second time he went away and prayed, saying, “My Father, if this cup can’t pass away from me unless I drink it, your desire be done.”

hausa: Sai Yesu ya sāke ce musu, “Salama tă kasance tare da ku! Kamar yadda Uba ya aiko ni, haka ni ma ina aikan ku.”
english: Jesus therefore said to them again, “Peace be to you. As the Father has sent me, even so I send you.”

hausa: Kada ku kasance da mudu iri biyu a jakarku, ɗaya babba, ɗaya ƙarami.
english: You shall not have in your house diverse measures, one large and one small.

hausa: Ya ɗauki siffar ginshiƙin Asherar da ya yi, ya sa a haikalin da Ubangiji ya ce wa Dawuda da ɗansa Solomon, “A cikin wannan haikali, da kuma cikin Urushalima inda na zaɓa daga kabilan Isra’ila, zan sa Sunana har abada.
english: He set the engraved image of Asherah that he had made in the house of which Yahweh said to David and to Solomon his son, “In this house, and in Jerusalem, which I have chosen out of all the tribes of Israel, I will put my name forever;

hausa: “Saboda danniyar marasa ƙarfi da kuma nishin masu bukata, zan tashi yanzu,” in ji Ubangiji. “Zan kāre su daga masu yin musu sharri.”
english: “Because of the oppression of the weak and because of the groaning of the needy, I will now arise,” says Yahweh; “I will set him in safety from those who malign him.”

hausa: Za ku zama masu albarka a cikin birni, za ku kuma zama masu albarka har a ƙauye.
english: You shall be blessed in the city, and you shall be blessed in the field.

hausa: Firistoci suka ɗauki matsayinsu, haka kuma Lawiyawa suka tsaya a matsayinsu riƙe da kayansu na bushe-bushe da na kaɗe-kaɗe na Ubangiji, waɗanda Sarki Dawuda ya yi domin yabon Ubangiji. An yi amfani da su sa’ad da ake godiya, ana kuma cewa, “Ƙaunarsa dawwammamiya ce har abada.” Kurkusa da Lawiyawa, firistoci suka busa ƙahoninsu, dukan Isra’ila kuwa suna a tsaye.
english: The priests stood, according to their positions; the Levites also with instruments of music of Yahweh, which David the king had made to give thanks to Yahweh, when David praised by their ministry, saying “For his loving kindness endures forever.” The priests sounded trumpets before them; and all Israel stood.

hausa: A farkon sarautar Zedekiya ɗan Yosiya sarkin Yahuda, wannan magana ta zo wa Irmiya daga Ubangiji.
english: In the beginning of the reign of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah, this word came to Jeremiah from Yahweh, saying,

hausa: Haruna ya amsa musu ya ce, “Ku tuttuɓe zoban zinariya waɗanda suke kunnuwan matanku, da na ’ya’yanku maza da mata, ku kawo mini.”
english: Aaron said to them, “Take off the golden rings, which are in the ears of your wives, of your sons, and of your daughters, and bring them to me.”

hausa: Sai Elisha ya tafi Damaskus, Ben-Hadad mutumin Aram kuwa yana ciwo. Sa’ad da aka faɗa wa sarki, “Mutumin Allah ya hauro tun daga can zuwa nan,”
english: Elisha came to Damascus; and Benhadad the king of Syria was sick. He was told, “The man of God has come here.”

hausa: Dukanku kuna iya yin annabci bi da bi, domin kowa yă sami koyarwa da ƙarfafawa.
english: For you all can prophesy one by one, that all may learn and all may be exhorted.

hausa: Shirayin da yake gaban haikalin kuma kamun ashirin ne da ya nausa ya ƙetare, fāɗin ginin kuma tsayinsa kamu ashirin ne. Ya shafe cikin da zinariya zalla.
english: The porch that was in front, its length, across the width of the house, was twenty cubits, and the height one hundred twenty; and he overlaid it within with pure gold.

hausa: “Ka ɗauki Lawiyawa a maimakon dukan ’ya’yan fari na Isra’ila, dabbobin Lawiyawa kuma a maimakon dabbobinsu. Lawiyawa za su zama nawa. Ni ne Ubangiji.
english: “Take the Levites instead of all the firstborn among the children of Israel, and the livestock of the Levites instead of their livestock; and the Levites shall be mine. I am Yahweh.

hausa: Uriya mutumin Hitti Zabad ɗan Alai,
english: Uriah the Hittite, Zabad the son of Ahlai,

hausa: don sa’ad da aka yi mana sutura, ba za a same mu tsirara ba.
english: if indeed being clothed, we will not be found naked.

hausa: Sun dai sami labari ne kawai cewa, “Mutumin da dā yake tsananta mana yanzu yana wa’azin bangaskiyar da dā ya yi ƙoƙari yă hallaka.”
english: but they only heard, “He who once persecuted us now preaches the faith that he once tried to destroy.”

hausa: Jawabi game da Ninebe a littafin wahayin Nahum, mutumin Elkosh.
english: A revelation about Nineveh. The book of the vision of Nahum the Elkoshite.

hausa: Ina tsoro kada sa’ad da na sāke zuwa, Allahna zai ƙasƙantar da ni a gabanku, kuma in yi baƙin ciki saboda waɗanda suka yi zunubi a dā, ba su kuma tuba daga aikin ƙazanta, da na fasikanci, da kuma lalata da suka sa kansu a ciki ba.
english: that again when I come my God would humble me before you, and I would mourn for many of those who have sinned before now, and not repented of the uncleanness, sexual immorality, and lustfulness which they committed.

hausa: Da bazara, a lokacin da sarakuna kan tafi yaƙi, Yowab ya jagorance mayaƙa. Ya lalatar da ƙasar Ammonawa ya kuma tafi Rabba ya yi mata kwanto, amma Dawuda ya zauna a Urushalima. Yowab ya yaƙi Rabba, ya kuma bar ta kango.
english: At the time of the return of the year, at the time when kings go out, Joab led out the army and wasted the country of the children of Ammon, and came and besieged Rabbah. But David stayed at Jerusalem. Joab struck Rabbah, and overthrew it.

hausa: Da Finehas firist, da shugabannin mutanen, shugabannin iyalan Isra’ila, suka ji abin da mutanen Ruben, mutanen Gad da kuma rabin mutanen kabilar Manasse suka ce, sai suka ji daɗi.
english: When Phinehas the priest, and the princes of the congregation, even the heads of the thousands of Israel that were with him, heard the words that the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the children of Manasseh spoke, it pleased them well.

hausa: “Yanzu fa Ubangiji, Allah na Isra’ila, ka kiyaye wa bawanka Dawuda mahaifina alkawuran da ka yi masa sa’ad da ka ce, ‘Ba za ka kāsa kasance da mutumin da zai zauna a gabana a kan kujerar sarautar Isra’ila ba, in kawai ’ya’yanka maza za su kula cikin dukan abin da suke yi su yi tafiya a gabana bisa ga dokata, kamar yadda ka yi.’
english: “Now therefore, Yahweh, the God of Israel, keep with your servant David my father that which you have promised him, saying, ‘There shall not fail you a man in my sight to sit on the throne of Israel, if only your children take heed to their way, to walk in my law as you have walked before me.’

hausa: Amma yanzu, kada ka ɗauke shi marar laifi. Kai mutum ne mai hikima; za ka san abin da za ka yi da shi. Ka kawo furfuransa zuwa kabari da jini.”
english: Now therefore don’t hold him guiltless, for you are a wise man; and you will know what you ought to do to him, and you shall bring his gray head down to Sheol with blood.”

hausa: Masassaƙi yakan ƙarfafa maƙerin zinariya, kuma shi mai gyara da guduma ya yi sumul yakan ƙarfafa mai harhaɗawa. Ya ce game da haɗin, “Ya yi kyau.” Yakan buga ƙusoshi su riƙe gunkin don kada yă fāɗi.
english: So the carpenter encourages the goldsmith. He who smooths with the hammer encourages him who strikes the anvil, saying of the soldering, “It is good;” and he fastens it with nails, that it might not totter.

hausa: In wani ɗan sharri ya tashi ya yi wa wani sharri, don a sami wani da laifi,
english: If an unrighteous witness rises up against any man to testify against him of wrongdoing,

hausa: a cikinsa ne aka ɓoye dukkan dukiya ta hikima da ta sani.
english: in whom all the treasures of wisdom and knowledge are hidden.

hausa: To, me ya sa waɗannan mutane suka kauce? Me ya sa Urushalima kullum take kaucewa? Sun manne wa ƙarya; suka ƙi su dawo.
english: Why then have the people of Jerusalem fallen back by a perpetual backsliding? They cling to deceit. They refuse to return.

hausa: Za su iya yin hidima a wurina mai tsarki, suna lura da ƙofofin haikali suna kuma hidima a cikinsu; za su iya yankan hadayun ƙonawa da sadaka don mutane su kuma tsaya a gaban mutane su yi musu hidima.
english: Yet they shall be ministers in my sanctuary, having oversight at the gates of the house, and ministering in the house. They shall kill the burnt offering and the sacrifice for the people, and they shall stand before them to minister to them.

hausa: Abokin gāba na ƙarshen da za a hallaka kuwa, shi ne mutuwa.
english: The last enemy that will be abolished is death.

hausa: firist zai umarta a kawo tsuntsaye biyu masu rai, masu tsabta da itacen al’ul, jan ƙyalle da kuma hizzob saboda mutumin da za a tsabtacce.
english: then the priest shall command them to take for him who is to be cleansed two living clean birds, cedar wood, scarlet, and hyssop.

hausa: Sai Yoshuwa kuwa ya ci nasara a kan Amalekawa da takobi.
english: Joshua defeated Amalek and his people with the edge of the sword.

hausa: suna so a yi ta gaisuwarsu a kasuwa, ana kuma riƙa ce musu, ‘Rabbi.’
english: the salutations in the marketplaces, and to be called ‘Rabbi, Rabbi’ by men.

hausa: Na karɓi umarni in sa albarka; na kuwa sa albarka, ba zan iya janye ta ba.
english: Behold, I have received a command to bless. He has blessed, and I can’t reverse it.

hausa: Bitrus ya tambaye ta ya ce, “Gaya mini, kuɗin da yake da Ananiyas kuka sayar da filin ke nan?” Ta ce, “I, haka ne muka sayar.”
english: Peter answered her, “Tell me whether you sold the land for so much.” She said, “Yes, for so much.”

hausa: Daga can muka tashi muka isa Regiyum. Kashegari iskar kudu ta taso, kashegari kuma muka kai Futeyoli.
english: From there we circled around and arrived at Rhegium. After one day, a south wind sprang up, and on the second day we came to Puteoli,

hausa: “ ‘A rana ta biyar a miƙa bijimai tara, raguna biyu, da ’yan raguna goma sha huɗu, bana ɗaya-ɗaya, dukansu marasa lahani.
english: “‘On the fifth day: nine bulls, two rams, fourteen male lambs a year old without defect;

hausa: Sai ya tafi gidan mahaifinsa a Ofra kuma a dutse guda ya kashe ’yan’uwansa, ’ya’yan Yerub-Ba’al. Amma Yotam, autan ɗan Yerub-Ba’al ya tsira ta wurin ɓuya.
english: He went to his father’s house at Ophrah, and killed his brothers the sons of Jerubbaal, being seventy persons, on one stone; but Jotham the youngest son of Jerubbaal was left, for he hid himself.

hausa: Kada kuma ku yi gunaguni yadda waɗansunsu suka yi, har mala’ika mai hallakarwa ya hallaka su.
english: Don’t grumble, as some of them also grumbled, and perished by the destroyer.

hausa: Sa’ad da suka tafi, zan jefa ragata a kansu; zai janye su ƙasa kamar tsuntsayen sararin sama. Sa’ad da na ji suna tafiya tare, zan kama su.
english: When they go, I will spread my net on them. I will bring them down like the birds of the sky. I will chastise them, as their congregation has heard.

hausa: Sa’ad da Sha’ul ya mutu, Ba’al-Hanan ɗan Akbor ya gāje shi a matsayin sarki.
english: Shaul died, and Baal Hanan the son of Achbor reigned in his place.

hausa: domin kuma ku yi tsawon rai a ƙasar da Ubangiji ya rantse wa kakanninku zai ba su da zuriyarsu, ƙasa mai zub da madara da zuma.
english: and that you may prolong your days in the land which Yahweh swore to your fathers to give to them and to their offspring, a land flowing with milk and honey.

hausa: Kada ranka yă yi saurin tashi, gama fushi yana zama a cinyar wawaye.
english: Don’t be hasty in your spirit to be angry, for anger rests in the bosom of fools.

hausa: Dukan waɗannan yawan kwanaki, har zuwa yau, ba ku yashe ’yan’uwanku Isra’ilawa ba, amma kuka kiyaye umarnin da Ubangiji Allahnku ya ba ku.
english: You have not left your brothers these many days to this day, but have performed the duty of the commandment of Yahweh your God.

hausa: Ƙauna ba ta jin daɗin mugunta, sai dai ta ji daɗin gaskiya.
english: doesn’t rejoice in unrighteousness, but rejoices with the truth;

hausa: Ta Dawuda. Yabo ya tabbata ga Ubangiji dutsena, wanda ya horar da hannuwana don yaƙi, yatsotsina don faɗa.
english: By David. Blessed be Yahweh, my rock, who trains my hands to war, and my fingers to battle—

hausa: Ya lissafta yawan taurari ya kuma kira kowannensu da suna.
english: He counts the number of the stars. He calls them all by their names.

hausa: Wata rana da ta zo wurin Otniyel, sai ya zuga ta ta roƙi mahaifinta fili. Da ta sauka daga kan jakinta sai Kaleb ya tambaye ta ya ce, “Me kike so in yi miki?”
english: When she came, she had him ask her father for a field. She got off her donkey, and Caleb said, “What do you want?”

hausa: wanda ka shirya a gaban dukan mutane,
english: which you have prepared before the face of all peoples;

hausa: Ta haka Allah ya kwashe dabbobin mahaifinku ya ba ni.
english: Thus God has taken away your father’s livestock, and given them to me.

hausa: Sai Hiwiyawa kaɗai waɗanda suke zama a Gibeyon, sauran ba ko birni ɗaya da ta yi yarjejjeniya ta salama da Isra’ilawa, Isra’ilawa kuwa suka ci dukansu da yaƙi.
english: There was not a city that made peace with the children of Israel, except the Hivites, the inhabitants of Gibeon. They took all in battle.

hausa: A ta haka za ku san inda za ku bi, gama ba ku taɓa bin hanyar ba. Sai dai ku ɗan ba da rata wajen yadi ɗari tara tsakaninku da akwatin alkawari, kada ku kusace shi.”
english: Yet there shall be a space between you and it of about two thousand cubits by measure—don’t come closer to it—that you may know the way by which you must go; for you have not passed this way before.”

hausa: Za ku zama kamar mutanen da suka guje wa zaki sai suka fāɗa a hannun beyar, ko kuma kamar wanda ya shiga gida ya dāfa hannu a bango sai maciji ya sare shi.
english: As if a man fled from a lion, and a bear met him; or he went into the house and leaned his hand on the wall, and a snake bit him.

hausa: Amma Sama’ila ya ce, “Ba zan koma tare da kai ba. Ka ƙi maganar Ubangiji, Ubangiji kuma ya ƙi ka da zama sarki a bisa Isra’ila.”
english: Samuel said to Saul, “I will not return with you; for you have rejected Yahweh’s word, and Yahweh has rejected you from being king over Israel.”

hausa: Muka ci gaba da tafiyarmu daga Taya muka sauka a Tolemayis, inda muka gai da ’yan’uwa muka yi kwana ɗaya tare da su.
english: When we had finished the voyage from Tyre, we arrived at Ptolemais. We greeted the brothers and stayed with them one day.

hausa: A wannan rana zan karye ƙarfin Isra’ila a Kwarin Yezireyel.”
english: It will happen in that day that I will break the bow of Israel in the valley of Jezreel.”

hausa: Mai albarka ne mutumin da bai yi tuntuɓe ba saboda ni.”
english: Blessed is he who finds no occasion for stumbling in me.”

hausa: In sarki yana hukunta talakawa da adalci kursiyinsa kullum zai kasance lafiya.
english: The king who fairly judges the poor, his throne shall be established forever.

hausa: “Ga wanda ya ƙazantu kuwa, a ɗiba toka daga hadaya ta ƙonawa ta tsarkakewa, a zuba a cikin tulu, sa’an nan a zuba ruwa mai gudu a kansu.
english: “For the unclean, they shall take of the ashes of the burning of the sin offering; and running water shall be poured on them in a vessel.

hausa: Ku tā da tuta don zuwa Sihiyona! Ku gudu ku nemi mafaka ba tare da jinkiri ba! Gama ina kawowa masifa daga arewa, mummunan hallaka kuwa.”
english: Set up a standard toward Zion. Flee for safety! Don’t wait; for I will bring evil from the north, and a great destruction.”

hausa: Wane ne zai furta manyan ayyukan Ubangiji ko yă furta cikakken yabonsa?
english: Who can utter the mighty acts of Yahweh, or fully declare all his praise?

hausa: Gama zai ceci masu bukatan da suka yi kuka, marasa ƙarfin da ba su da mai taimako.
english: For he will deliver the needy when he cries; the poor, who has no helper.

hausa: sai mijinta na biyu ya ƙi ta, ya ba ta takardan saki, ya kore ta daga gidansa, ko kuwa ya mutu,
english: If the latter husband hates her, and writes her a certificate of divorce, puts it in her hand, and sends her out of his house; or if the latter husband dies, who took her to be his wife;

hausa: Mala’ikan Ubangiji ya ce, “Dole matarka ta kiyaye duk abin da na riga na gaya mata.
english: Yahweh’s angel said to Manoah, “Of all that I said to the woman let her beware.

hausa: Garuruwan da mutane suna ciki za su zama kufai ƙasar kuma za tă zama kango. Sa’an nan za ku san cewa ni ne Ubangiji.’ ”
english: The cities that are inhabited will be laid waste, and the land will be a desolation. Then you will know that I am Yahweh.”’”

hausa: A rana nan Ubangiji ya cece Isra’ila daga hannuwan Masarawa, Isra’ilawa kuwa suka ga gawawwakin Masarawa a bakin teku.
english: Thus Yahweh saved Israel that day out of the hand of the Egyptians; and Israel saw the Egyptians dead on the seashore.

hausa: Bakin mutum mai adalci yakan yi magana da hikima, harshensa kuwa yakan yi maganar abin da yake daidai.
english: The mouth of the righteous talks of wisdom. His tongue speaks justice.

hausa: Ga Allah wanda maganarsa nake yabo ga Allah na dogara; ba zan ji tsoro ba. Me mutum mai mutuwa zai yi mini?
english: In God, I praise his word. In God, I put my trust. I will not be afraid. What can flesh do to me?

hausa: Kamar yadda mahaukaci yake harbin cukwimai ko kibiyoyi masu dafi
english: Like a madman who shoots torches, arrows, and death,

hausa: Da Shawulu ya ga sojojin Filistiyawa sai ya ji tsoro, ya firgita ƙwarai.
english: When Saul saw the army of the Philistines, he was afraid, and his heart trembled greatly.

hausa: Sai Ubangiji ya fito da kai shi waje ya ce, “Ka dubi sammai ka kuma ƙirga taurari, in har za ka iya ƙirga su.” Sa’an nan ya ce masa, “Haka zuriyarka za tă zama.”
english: Yahweh brought him outside, and said, “Look now toward the sky, and count the stars, if you are able to count them.” He said to Abram, “So your offspring will be.”

hausa: Babu abin da Masar za tă yi, kai ko wutsiya, reshen dabino ko iwa.
english: Neither shall there be any work for Egypt, which head or tail, palm branch or rush, may do.

hausa: Dawuda ya rarraba Lawiyawa ƙungiya-ƙungiya bisa ga ’ya’yan Lawi maza. Gershon, Kohat da Merari.
english: David divided them into divisions according to the sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.

hausa: Sai ya tafi Kafarnahum, wani gari a Galili, a ranar Asabbaci kuma, ya fara koya wa mutane.
english: He came down to Capernaum, a city of Galilee. He was teaching them on the Sabbath day,

hausa: ka kuma ce, ‘Ga abin da Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka ya ce ya birnin da take kawo wa kansa hallaka ta wurin kisankai a cikinta kina kuma ƙazantar da kanki ta wurin yin gumaka,
english: You shall say, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “A city that sheds blood within herself, that her time may come, and that makes idols against herself to defile her!

hausa: Na sani tabbatacce za ka zama sarki. Masarautar Isra’ila za tă kahu a hannunka.
english: Now, behold, I know that you will surely be king, and that the kingdom of Israel will be established in your hand.

hausa: kuma dole yă furta zunubin da ya yi. Dole yă yi biya cikakkiyar diyya saboda laifinsa, yă ƙara kashi ɗaya bisa biyar a kai, yă kuma bayar da shi duka ga wanda ya yi wa laifin.
english: then he shall confess his sin which he has done; and he shall make restitution for his guilt in full, add to it the fifth part of it, and give it to him in respect of whom he has been guilty.

hausa: Firistocinki suna karya dokokina, sun ƙazantar da tsarkakan abubuwana; ba sa bambanta tsakanin tsarki da marar tsarki; suna koyarwa cewa babu bambanci tsakanin marar tsarki da mai tsarki; suna kuma rufe idanunsu ga kiyaye Asabbataina, da haka suke saɓon sunana.
english: Her priests have done violence to my law and have profaned my holy things. They have made no distinction between the holy and the common, neither have they caused men to discern between the unclean and the clean, and have hidden their eyes from my Sabbaths. So I am profaned among them.

hausa: Saboda haka zan firgita waɗannan mutane sau ɗaya da abubuwan banmamaki a kan abubuwan banmamaki; hikimar masu hikima za tă lalace, azancin masu azanci zai ɓace.”
english: therefore, behold, I will proceed to do a marvelous work among this people, even a marvelous work and a wonder; and the wisdom of their wise men will perish, and the understanding of their prudent men will be hidden.”

hausa: Amma sa’ad da sabon miki ya bayyana a jikinsa, zai furta shi marar tsarki.
english: But whenever raw flesh appears in him, he shall be unclean.

hausa: Alhali kuwa ba ku ma san abin da zai faru gobe ba. Wane iri ne ranku? Ku kamar hazo ne da yake bayyana na ɗan lokaci sa’an nan yă ɓace.
english: Yet you don’t know what your life will be like tomorrow. For what is your life? For you are a vapor that appears for a little time and then vanishes away.

hausa: Ambaliyar ruwa za tă tafi da gidansa, ruwaye masu gudu a ranar fushin Allah.
english: The increase of his house will depart. They will rush away in the day of his wrath.

hausa: Sa’ad da fuskar sarki ta haska, yana nufin rai ke nan; tagomashinsa yana kamar girgijen ruwa a bazara.
english: In the light of the king’s face is life. His favor is like a cloud of the spring rain.

hausa: Gama wawa maganar wauta yakan yi, zuciyarsa ta cika da mugunta, yana aikata abubuwan rashin sanin Allah yana baza kurakurai game da Ubangiji; yana barin mayunwata da yunwa ya kuma hana masu ƙishirwa ruwan sha.
english: For the fool will speak folly, and his heart will work iniquity, to practice profanity, and to utter error against Yahweh, to make empty the soul of the hungry, and to cause the drink of the thirsty to fail.

hausa: cewa ba zan karɓi kome da yake naka ba, ko zare ko maɗaurin takalma, don kada ka ce, ‘Na azurta Abram.’
english: that I will not take a thread nor a sandal strap nor anything that is yours, lest you should say, ‘I have made Abram rich.’

hausa: Yayinda Absalom yake miƙa hadaya, ya aika a kira Ahitofel mutumin Gilo, mai ba wa Dawuda shawara, yă zo daga Gilo garinsa. Ta haka makircin ya ƙara ƙarfi, masu bin Absalom kuma suka yi ta ƙaruwa.
english: Absalom sent for Ahithophel the Gilonite, David’s counselor, from his city, even from Giloh, while he was offering the sacrifices. The conspiracy was strong, for the people increased continually with Absalom.

hausa: Ba ya fasa duban masu adalci; yana sa su tare da sarakuna yana ɗaukaka su har abada.
english: He doesn’t withdraw his eyes from the righteous, but with kings on the throne, he sets them forever, and they are exalted.

hausa: Za su bi mu har su yi nisa da birnin, gama za su ce, ‘Suna gudu kamar yadda suka yi dā.’ Saboda haka lokacin da muka guje musu,
english: They will come out after us until we have drawn them away from the city; for they will say, ‘They flee before us, like the first time.’ So we will flee before them,

hausa: Gedor, Ahiyo, Zeker
english: Gedor, Ahio, Zecher,

hausa: Amma su mutanenka ne, gādonka da ka fitar ta wurin ikonka mai girma, da kuma hannunka mai ƙarfi.”
english: Yet they are your people and your inheritance, which you brought out by your great power and by your outstretched arm.”

hausa: Sa’an nan su naɗe shi da kuma dukan kayayyakinsa a cikin fatar shanun teku, su sa shi a kan sandan ɗaukarsa.
english: They shall put it and all its vessels within a covering of sealskin, and shall put it on the frame.

hausa: Waɗansu masu hikima za su yi tuntuɓe, don a tsabtacce su, a tsarkake su, su yi tsab, har matuƙar da aka ƙayyade ta yi.
english: Some of those who are wise will fall—to refine them, and to purify, and to make them white, even to the time of the end, because it is yet for the time appointed.

hausa: Ku ɗaukaka Ubangiji Allahnmu ku kuma yi sujada a dutsensa mai tsarki, gama Ubangiji Allahnmu mai tsarki ne.
english: Exalt Yahweh, our God. Worship at his holy hill, for Yahweh, our God, is holy!

hausa: “Ya ƙaramin garke, kada ku ji tsoro, gama ya gamshi Ubanku ya ba ku mulkin.
english: “Don’t be afraid, little flock, for it is your Father’s good pleasure to give you the Kingdom.

hausa: Ya sa bagaden hadaya ta ƙonawa kusa da ƙofar tabanakul, Tentin Sujada, sa’an nan ya miƙa hadaya ta ƙonawa da hadaya ta gari a kansa, yadda Ubangiji ya umarce shi.
english: He set the altar of burnt offering at the door of the tabernacle of the Tent of Meeting, and offered on it the burnt offering and the meal offering, as Yahweh commanded Moses.

hausa: ta kuwa zama gwauruwa sai da ta kai shekaru tamanin da huɗu. Ba ta taɓa barin haikali ba, tana sujada dare da rana, tana kuma azumi da addu’a.
english: and she had been a widow for about eighty-four years), who didn’t depart from the temple, worshiping with fastings and petitions night and day.

hausa: Ni da kaina ne zan zama katangar wuta kewaye da birnin, in kuma zama darajarta,’ in ji Ubangiji.
english: For I,’ says Yahweh, ‘will be to her a wall of fire around it, and I will be the glory in the middle of her.

hausa: Rabin kabilar Manasse, mutanen Ruben da mutanen Gad suka karɓi rabonsu na gādo wanda Musa ya ba su a gabashin Urdun. Abin da Musa bawan Ubangiji ya ba su ke nan.
english: With him the Reubenites and the Gadites received their inheritance, which Moses gave them, beyond the Jordan eastward, even as Moses the servant of Yahweh gave them:

hausa: Gama in kuna rayuwa bisa ga mutuntaka, za ku mutu; amma in ta wurin Ruhu kuka kashe ayyukan jikin nan, za ku rayu.
english: For if you live after the flesh, you must die; but if by the Spirit you put to death the deeds of the body, you will live.

hausa: Masu albarka ne waɗanda ka zaɓa ka kawo kusa don su zauna a filayenka! Mun cika da abubuwa masu kyau na gidanka, na haikalinka mai tsarki.
english: Blessed is the one whom you choose and cause to come near, that he may live in your courts. We will be filled with the goodness of your house, your holy temple.

hausa: Albarka ta tabbata ga waɗanda suke kiyaye ƙa’idodinsa suke kuma nemansa da dukan zuciyarsu.
english: Blessed are those who keep his statutes, who seek him with their whole heart.

hausa: Mai albarka ne shi mai zuwa cikin sunan Ubangiji. Daga gidan Ubangiji muna sa muku albarka.
english: Blessed is he who comes in Yahweh’s name! We have blessed you out of Yahweh’s house.

hausa: Saboda haka zan yabe ka a cikin al’ummai, ya Ubangiji; zan rera yabai ga sunanka.
english: Therefore I will give thanks to you, Yahweh, among the nations, and will sing praises to your name.

hausa: Sai suka ga waɗansu daga cikin almajiransa suna cin abinci da hannuwa marasa tsabta, wato, da ba a wanke ba.
english: Now when they saw some of his disciples eating bread with defiled, that is unwashed, hands, they found fault.

hausa: Ku bar maganar Kiristi ta zauna a cikinku a yalwace yayinda kuke koya, kuna kuma yi wa juna gargaɗi da dukan hikima, da kuma yayinda kuke waƙoƙin zabura, waƙoƙi da waƙoƙin ruhaniya tare da godiya a zukatanku ga Allah.
english: Let the word of Christ dwell in you richly; in all wisdom teaching and admonishing one another with psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs, singing with grace in your heart to the Lord.

hausa: Arzikinku ya ruɓa, asu kuma sun cinye tufafinku.
english: Your riches are corrupted and your garments are moth-eaten.

hausa: Sai Ubangiji ya ce masa, “Ku Farisiyawa, kukan wanke bayan kwano da kwaf, amma a ciki kuna cike da kwaɗayi da mugunta.
english: The Lord said to him, “Now you Pharisees cleanse the outside of the cup and of the platter, but your inward part is full of extortion and wickedness.

hausa: Amma mutane 14,700 ne suka mutu a annobar, ban da waɗanda suka mutu a sanadin Kora.
english: Now those who died by the plague were fourteen thousand seven hundred, in addition to those who died about the matter of Korah.

hausa: Akwai Ziza ɗan Shifi. Shifi ɗan Allon ne. Allon ɗan Yedahiya ne. Yedahiya ɗan Shimri ne. Shimri kuma ɗan Shemahiya ne.
english: and Ziza the son of Shiphi, the son of Allon, the son of Jedaiah, the son of Shimri, the son of Shemaiah—

hausa: Ko zai damu da iyalin da ya bari a baya sa’ad da kwanakinsa suka ƙare?
english: For what does he care for his house after him, when the number of his months is cut off?

hausa: Sa’an nan ne zan iya yin magana ba tare da jin tsoronsa ba, amma a yadda nake a yanzu ba zan iya ba.
english: then I would speak, and not fear him, for I am not so in myself.

hausa: Ragwanci kan sa mutum yă zama matalauci, amma aiki tuƙuru kan ba da dukiya.
english: He becomes poor who works with a lazy hand, but the hand of the diligent brings wealth.

hausa: Zan sa jama’arka su mutu ta wurin takuban ƙarfafan mutane, masu bantsoro na dukan al’ummai. Za su lalatar da girman kan Masar, su kuma tumɓuke dukan jama’arta.
english: I will cause your multitude to fall by the swords of the mighty. They are all the ruthless of the nations. They will bring the pride of Egypt to nothing, and all its multitude will be destroyed.

hausa: “Kada ku yi wa kanku ajiyar dukiya a duniya, inda asu da tsatsa suke ɓatawa, inda kuma ɓarayi sukan fasa, su yi sata.
english: “Don’t lay up treasures for yourselves on the earth, where moth and rust consume, and where thieves break through and steal;

hausa: ya dawo tsakanin sojojin Masar da na Isra’ila. Duk dare, girgijen ya jawo duhu ga gefe ɗaya, haske kuma ga ɗaya gefen; saboda haka ba wanda ya kusaci wani duk dare.
english: It came between the camp of Egypt and the camp of Israel. There was the cloud and the darkness, yet it gave light by night. One didn’t come near the other all night.

hausa: Ku kuma gai da ikkilisiyar da take haɗuwa a gidansu. Ku gai da ƙaunataccen abokina Efenetus, wanda ya zama na farko a karɓar Kiristi a lardin Asiya.
english: Greet the assembly that is in their house. Greet Epaenetus, my beloved, who is the first fruits of Achaia to Christ.

hausa: Musa ya faɗa wa Isra’ilawa dukan abin da Ubangiji ya umarce shi.
english: Moses told the children of Israel according to all that Yahweh commanded Moses.

hausa: A rana ta fari, za ku ɗebi zaɓaɓɓun ’ya’yan itatuwa daga itatuwa, da rassan dabino, rassa masu ganye, da kuma ganyayen itacen wardi na rafi, ku yi farin ciki a gaban Ubangiji Allahnku, kwana bakwai.
english: You shall take on the first day the fruit of majestic trees, branches of palm trees, and boughs of thick trees, and willows of the brook; and you shall rejoice before Yahweh your God seven days.

hausa: Muka shiga jirgin ruwa daga Andiramitiyum wanda yake shirin tashi zuwa tasoshin da suke bakin tekun lardin Asiya, sai muka kama tafiya. Aristarkus, mutumin Makidoniya daga Tessalonika, yana tare da mu.
english: Embarking in a ship of Adramyttium, which was about to sail to places on the coast of Asia, we put to sea, Aristarchus, a Macedonian of Thessalonica being with us.

hausa: Aka karkasa su babu sonkai ta wurin jifa ƙuri’a, gama akwai manyan ma’aikatan wuri mai tsarki da manyan ma’aikatan Allah a cikin zuriyar Eleyazar da Itamar.
english: Thus they were divided impartially by drawing lots; for there were princes of the sanctuary and princes of God, both of the sons of Eleazar, and of the sons of Ithamar.

hausa: Ku aikata abin da yake daidai da kuma mai kyau a idon Ubangiji, don yă zama muka da lafiya, ku kuwa shiga ku mallaki ƙasa mai kyau da Ubangiji ya yi alkawari da rantsuwa ga kakanninku.
english: You shall do that which is right and good in Yahweh’s sight, that it may be well with you and that you may go in and possess the good land which Yahweh swore to your fathers,

hausa: “Ɗan mutum, in wata ƙasa ta yi mini zunubi ta wurin rashin aminci na kuma miƙa hannuna gāba da ita don in toshe hanyar samun abincinta na kuma aika da yunwa a kanta na kashe mutanenta da dabbobinta,
english: “Son of man, when a land sins against me by committing a trespass, and I stretch out my hand on it, and break the staff of its bread and send famine on it, and cut off from it man and animal—

hausa: Ga Abiyatar firist kuwa sarki ya ce, “Tafi gonarka a Anatot. Ka cancanci ka mutu, amma ba zan kashe ka yanzu ba, domin ka ɗauki akwatin alkawarin Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka a gaban mahaifina Dawuda, ka kuma sha wahala tare mahaifina.”
english: To Abiathar the priest the king said, “Go to Anathoth, to your own fields, for you are worthy of death. But I will not at this time put you to death, because you bore the Lord Yahweh’s ark before David my father, and because you were afflicted in all in which my father was afflicted.”

hausa: Sai mutanen nan uku suka daina amsa wa Ayuba, domin a ganinsa shi mai adalci ne.
english: So these three men ceased to answer Job, because he was righteous in his own eyes.

hausa: Dukan sauran annabawan suka yi annabci iri abu ɗaya. Suka ce, “Ka yaƙi Ramot Gileyad, ka kuma yi nasara, gama Ubangiji zai ba da ita cikin hannun sarki.”
english: All the prophets prophesied so, saying, “Go up to Ramoth Gilead and prosper; for Yahweh will deliver it into the hand of the king.”

hausa: da ƙodoji biyu tare da kitsen da yake kansu kusa da kwiɓi, da kuma murfin hanta, waɗanda zai cire tare da ƙodoji.
english: and the two kidneys, and the fat that is on them, which is by the loins, and the cover on the liver, with the kidneys, he shall remove,

hausa: Suka tashi daga Hor Haggidgad, suka yi sansani a Yotbata.
english: They traveled from Hor Haggidgad, and encamped in Jotbathah.

hausa: Saboda haka ya tashi ya ci, ya kuma sha. Ta wurin ƙarfin da ya samu saboda wannan abinci, ya yi tafiya yini arba’in da dare arba’in, sai da ya kai Horeb, dutsen Allah.
english: He arose, and ate and drank, and went in the strength of that food forty days and forty nights to Horeb, God’s Mountain.

hausa: “ ‘Amma in za ku kasa kunne gare ni, ku kuma aikata dukan waɗannan umarnai,
english: “‘But if you will not listen to me, and will not do all these commandments,

hausa: Al’ummai za su ji, su yi rawar jiki tsoro zai kama mutanen Filistiya.
english: The peoples have heard. They tremble. Pangs have taken hold of the inhabitants of Philistia.

hausa: “Kaiton wanda ya gina gidansa ta hanyar rashin adalci, ɗakunansa na sama kuma ta hanyar rashin gaskiya, yana sa mutanen ƙasarsa suna aiki a banza ba ya biyansu wahalarsu.
english: “Woe to him who builds his house by unrighteousness, and his rooms by injustice; who uses his neighbor’s service without wages, and doesn’t give him his hire;

hausa: Gama an ba da doka ta wurin Musa; alheri da gaskiya kuwa sun zo ne ta wurin Yesu Kiristi.
english: For the law was given through Moses. Grace and truth were realized through Jesus Christ.

hausa: Ni na ƙaunataccena ce, ƙaunataccena kuma nawa ne; yana kiwo a cikin furen bi-rana.
english: I am my beloved’s, and my beloved is mine. He browses among the lilies.

hausa: Suka ce mini, “Waɗanda suka tsira daga kwasan zuwa zaman bauta da kuma suka komo cikin yankin suna cikin babban damuwa da wulaƙanci. An rushe katangar Urushalima aka kuma ƙone ƙofofin da wuta.”
english: They said to me, “The remnant who are left of the captivity there in the province are in great affliction and reproach. The wall of Jerusalem is also broken down, and its gates are burned with fire.”

hausa: mariri, barewa, mariya, makwarna, mazo, gada da kuma tunkiyar dutse.
english: the deer, the gazelle, the roebuck, the wild goat, the ibex, the antelope, and the chamois.

hausa: Adalcin masu aikata gaskiya kan cece su, amma rashin aminci tarko ne ga mugayen sha’awace-sha’awace.
english: The righteousness of the upright shall deliver them, but the unfaithful will be trapped by evil desires.

hausa: “A rana ta takwas dole yă kawo su domin tsabtaccewarsa ga firist a ƙofar Tentin Sujada, a gaban Ubangiji.
english: “On the eighth day he shall bring them for his cleansing to the priest, to the door of the Tent of Meeting, before Yahweh.

hausa: Leɓunan adalai sun san abin da ya dace, amma bakunan mugaye sun san abin da yake mugu ne kawai.
english: The lips of the righteous know what is acceptable, but the mouth of the wicked is perverse.

hausa: Zai yanka ɗaya daga cikin tsuntsayen a bisa ruwa mai kyau a cikin tukunyar laka.
english: He shall kill one of the birds in an earthen vessel over running water.

hausa: Game da sauran ayyukan mulkin Yotam da aikin da ya yi, duk a rubuce suke a cikin littafin tarihin sarakunan Yahuda.
english: Now the rest of the acts of Jotham, and all that he did, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

hausa: Luka ne kaɗai yake tare da ni. Ka nemi Markus ku zo tare, domin yana da amfani a gare ni cikin hidimata.
english: Only Luke is with me. Take Mark and bring him with you, for he is useful to me for service.

hausa: To, da yake sun nuna cewa abubuwan da dokar take bukata suna a rubuce a zukatansu, lamirinsu yana kuma ba da shaida, tunaninsu kuwa yanzu yana zarginsu ko kuma yana kāre su.
english: in that they show the work of the law written in their hearts, their conscience testifying with them, and their thoughts among themselves accusing or else excusing them)

hausa: “A ranan nan,” in ji Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka, “Waƙoƙin a haikali za su koma makoki. Za a ga gawawwaki a ko’ina! Shiru!”
english: The songs of the temple will be wailing in that day,” says the Lord Yahweh. “The dead bodies will be many. In every place they will throw them out with silence.

hausa: Ka cece mutanenka ka kuma albarkace gādonka; ka zama mai kiwonsu ka kuma riƙe su har abada.
english: Save your people, and bless your inheritance. Be their shepherd also, and bear them up forever.

hausa: Amma a cikin ikkilisiya zan gwammace in yi magana da kalmomi biyar da za a fahimta don in koyar da waɗansu da a ce in yi magana da kalmomi guda dubu goma a wani harshe.
english: However, in the assembly I would rather speak five words with my understanding, that I might instruct others also, than ten thousand words in another language.

hausa: Ubangiji yă dube ku da idon rahama, yă kuma ba ku salama.” ’
english: Yahweh lift up his face toward you, and give you peace.’

hausa: Suna da bantsoro da firgitarwa; dokoki da ƙa’idodinsu ne kawai suka sani.
english: They are feared and dreaded. Their judgment and their dignity proceed from themselves.

hausa: Bari Ubangiji yă yi wa iyalin Onesiforus jinƙai, domin sau da dama yakan wartsakar da ni, bai kuma ji kunyar sarƙoƙina ba.
english: May the Lord grant mercy to the house of Onesiphorus, for he often refreshed me, and was not ashamed of my chain,

hausa: Sa’ad da zai kawar da rundunar, sarkin Kudu zai cika da girman kai zai kuma kashe mutane dubbai, duk da haka ba zai kasance mai nasara ba.
english: The multitude will be carried off, and his heart will be exalted. He will cast down tens of thousands, but he won’t prevail.

hausa: Daga sararin sama manyan ƙanƙara masu nauyin gaske suka fāɗo a kan mutane. Suka kuma la’anci Allah saboda annobar ƙanƙarar, domin annobar ta yi muni ƙwarai.
english: Great hailstones, about the weight of a talent, came down out of the sky on people. People blasphemed God because of the plague of the hail, for this plague was exceedingly severe.

hausa: Annabi ya yi tambaya ya ce, “Mene ne suka gani a fadanka?” Hezekiya ya ce, “Sun ga kome da kome a fadana. Babu abin da ban nuna musu a cikin ma’ajina ba.”
english: Then he asked, “What have they seen in your house?” Hezekiah answered, “They have seen all that is in my house. There is nothing among my treasures that I have not shown them.”

hausa: Nan da nan, ya sami ganin garinsa, kuma ya bi Yesu, yana yabon Allah. Da dukan mutane suka ga wannan, sai su ma suka yabi Allah.
english: Immediately he received his sight and followed him, glorifying God. All the people, when they saw it, praised God.

hausa: Na yi shelar adalcinka cikin babban taro; ba na rufe leɓunana, kamar yadda ka sani, ya Ubangiji.
english: I have proclaimed glad news of righteousness in the great assembly. Behold, I will not seal my lips, Yahweh, you know.

hausa: Ubangiji ba ya barin mai adalci da yunwa amma yakan lalace burin mugu.
english: Yahweh will not allow the soul of the righteous to go hungry, but he thrusts away the desire of the wicked.

hausa: Ko da yake ta yi ta yin wa Yusuf maganar kowace rana, amma ya ƙi yă kwana da ita, ko ma yă zauna da ita.
english: As she spoke to Joseph day by day, he didn’t listen to her, to lie by her, or to be with her.

hausa: Ya sa ƙaton kwano mai suna Teku a gefen kudu, a kusurwa kudu maso gabas.
english: He set the sea on the right side of the house eastward, toward the south.

hausa: Daga Dutsen Halak wanda ya miƙe zuwa wajajen Seyir, zuwa Ba’al-Gad a Kwarin Lebanon ƙasa da Dutsen Hermon. Ya kama sarakunansu ya karkashe su.
english: from Mount Halak, that goes up to Seir, even to Baal Gad in the valley of Lebanon under Mount Hermon. He took all their kings, struck them, and put them to death.

hausa: Lot ya fita daga cikin gida, ya rufe ƙofar a bayansa. Ya je wurin mutanen
english: Lot went out to them through the door, and shut the door after himself.

hausa: ta wurin sabuwa, rayayyiyar hanya kuma wadda aka buɗe mana ta labulen nan, wato, jikinsa,
english: by the way which he dedicated for us, a new and living way, through the veil, that is to say, his flesh,

hausa: Sa’ad da Maryamu ta ji haka sai ta yi wuf ta tafi wurinsa.
english: When she heard this, she arose quickly and went to him.

hausa: Ka rataye labule daga maɗauri, ka sa akwatin alkawari a bayan labulen. Labulen zai raba Wurin Mai Tsarki da Wurin Mafi Tsarki.
english: You shall hang up the veil under the clasps, and shall bring the ark of the covenant in there within the veil. The veil shall separate the holy place from the most holy for you.

hausa: Ga shi zan aiko da ambaliya ruwa a duniya, in hallaka dukan mai rai da yake a ƙarƙashin sama, kowace halittar da take numfashi a cikinta. Dukan abin da yake a duniya zai hallaka.
english: I, even I, will bring the flood of waters on this earth, to destroy all flesh having the breath of life from under the sky. Everything that is on the earth will die.

hausa: A gabansa dukan al’ummai ba kome ba ne; ya ɗauke su ba a bakin kome ba kuma banza ne kurum.
english: All the nations are like nothing before him. They are regarded by him as less than nothing, and vanity.

hausa: Ibrahim ya yi tunani cewa Allah yana iya tā da matattu, a misalce kuwa, ya sāke karɓan Ishaku daga matattu.
english: concluding that God is able to raise up even from the dead. Figuratively speaking, he also did receive him back from the dead.

hausa: Wutar cikin tentinsa ta zama duhu; fitilar da take kusa da shi ta mutu.
english: The light will be dark in his tent. His lamp above him will be put out.

hausa: “Fito daga jirgin, kai da matarka da ’ya’yanka maza da matansu.
english: “Go out of the ship, you, your wife, your sons, and your sons’ wives with you.

hausa: amma in kuka dawo gare ni kuka kuma yi biyayya da umarnaina, to, ko mutanenku da aka kwasa zuwa zaman bauta suna can wuri mafi nisa, zan tattara su daga can in kawo su wurin da na zaɓa yă zama wurin zama don Sunana.’
english: but if you return to me, and keep my commandments and do them, though your outcasts were in the uttermost part of the heavens, yet I will gather them from there, and will bring them to the place that I have chosen, to cause my name to dwell there.’

hausa: Sa’ad da lokaci ya yi da Esta (yarinyar da Mordekai ya ɗauka tamƙar ’yarsa, ’yar kawunsa Abihayil) za tă shiga wurin sarki, ba tă nemi a ba ta kome ba in ban da abin da Hegai, bābān sarki mai lura da gidan matan kulle, ya ba da shawara. Esta kuwa ta sami tagomashin kowa da ya ganta.
english: Now when the turn of Esther, the daughter of Abihail the uncle of Mordecai, who had taken her for his daughter, came to go in to the king, she required nothing but what Hegai the king’s eunuch, the keeper of the women, advised. Esther obtained favor in the sight of all those who looked at her.

hausa: Gama Allah ya sa a zukatansu su cika nufinsa ta wurin yarda su ba wa dabbar ikonsu tă yi mulki, sai lokacin da kalmomin Allah sun cika.
