english: For God has put in their hearts to do what he has in mind, to be of one mind, and to give their kingdom to the beast, until the words of God should be accomplished.

hausa: ’Ya’yan Asher maza su ne, Imna, Ishba, Ishbi da Beriya. ’Yar’uwarsu ita ce Sera. ’Ya’yan Beriya maza su ne, Heber da Malkiyel.
english: The sons of Asher: Imnah, Ishvah, Ishvi, Beriah, and Serah their sister. The sons of Beriah: Heber and Malchiel.

hausa: Ba zai taɓa zuwa gidansa ba; ba za a sāke san da shi ba.
english: He will return no more to his house, neither will his place know him any more.

hausa: Suka yi efod na zinariya, da shuɗi, da shunayya, da jan zare, da kuma lallausan lilin.
english: He made the ephod of gold, blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen.

hausa: Sai Siman ya amsa ya ce, “Ku yi addu’a ga Ubangiji saboda ni don kada ko ɗaya daga cikin abin da ka faɗa ya same ni.”
english: Simon answered, “Pray for me to the Lord, that none of the things which you have spoken happen to me.”

hausa: Jijiyoyinsa sun bushe a ƙasa rassansa sun mutu a sama.
english: His roots will be dried up beneath. His branch will be cut off above.

hausa: A gare ka, ya Ubangiji, na nemi mafaka; kada ka taɓa sa in sha kunya.
english: In you, Yahweh, I take refuge. Never let me be disappointed.

hausa: ’Yan’uwa, ku ɗauki annabawa da suka yi magana a cikin sunan Ubangiji, a matsayin gurbi na haƙuri a cikin shan wahala.
english: Take, brothers, for an example of suffering and of perseverance, the prophets who spoke in the name of the Lord.

hausa: Eli ya ce, “In haka ne, to, ki sauka lafiya, Allah na Isra’ila kuma yă ba ki abin da kika roƙa daga gare shi.”
english: Then Eli answered, “Go in peace; and may the God of Israel grant your petition that you have asked of him.”

hausa: gama yayinda kuke ci, kowa yakan ci gaba ba tare da jiran wani ba. Wani yă zauna da yunwa, wani kuma yă bugu.
english: For in your eating each one takes his own supper first. One is hungry, and another is drunken.

hausa: Sa’an nan ya faɗa musu abubuwa da yawa cikin misalai, yana cewa, “Wani manomi ya fita don yă shuka irinsa.
english: He spoke to them many things in parables, saying, “Behold, a farmer went out to sow.

hausa: da madubi, da kuma tufafin lilin da adikai, da gyale.
english: the hand mirrors, the fine linen garments, the tiaras, and the shawls.

hausa: Ka san yadda ake mini ba’a, ake kunyatar da ni da kuma yadda nake shan kunya; dukan abokan gābana suna a gabanka.
english: You know my reproach, my shame, and my dishonor. My adversaries are all before you.

hausa: Ta wurin dabararka mai girma cikin kasuwanci ka ƙara dukiyarka, kuma saboda dukiyarka zuciyarka ta cika da alfarma.
english: By your great wisdom and by your trading you have increased your riches, and your heart is lifted up because of your riches—”

hausa: Da Isra’ilawa suka komo daga bin Filistiyawa sai suka washe sansanin Filistiyawa.
english: The children of Israel returned from chasing after the Philistines, and they plundered their camp.

hausa: Shi zai gina gida domin Sunana, zan kuwa kafa gadon sarautarsa har abada.
english: He will build a house for my name, and I will establish the throne of his kingdom forever.

hausa: Za su zama kamar itacen da aka dasa kusa da ruwa wanda ya miƙa saiwoyinsa zuwa cikin rafi. Ba ya jin tsoro sa’ad da zafi ya zo; ganyayensa kullum kore suke. Ba shi da damuwa a shekarar fări ba ya taɓa fasa ba da ’ya’ya.”
english: For he will be as a tree planted by the waters, who spreads out its roots by the river, and will not fear when heat comes, but its leaf will be green, and will not be concerned in the year of drought. It won’t cease from yielding fruit.

hausa: “Gama a ɗan ƙanƙanen lokaci na rabu da ke, amma da ƙauna mai zurfi zan sāke dawo da ke.
english: “For a small moment I have forsaken you, but I will gather you with great mercies.

hausa: Musa ya juya, ya sauka daga kan dutsen da alluna biyu na Alkawari a hannuwansa. An yi rubutun a kowane gefe, gaba da baya.
english: Moses turned, and went down from the mountain, with the two tablets of the covenant in his hand; tablets that were written on both their sides. They were written on one side and on the other.

hausa: Ku naɗa alƙalai da shugabanni don kowace kabila, a kowane birnin da Ubangiji Allahnku yake ba ku, za su kuma shari’anta mutane ba nuna bambanci.
english: You shall make judges and officers in all your gates, which Yahweh your God gives you, according to your tribes; and they shall judge the people with righteous judgment.

hausa: Hadaya ta ƙonawar da sarki ya kawo wa Ubangiji a ranar Asabbaci ’yan raguna shida ne da rago guda, dukansu marasa lahani.
english: The burnt offering that the prince shall offer to Yahweh shall be on the Sabbath day, six lambs without defect and a ram without defect;

hausa: Asirin nan kuwa shi ne cewa ta wurin bishara, Al’ummai sun zama waɗanda za su yi gādo tare da Isra’ila, sun zama gaɓoɓin jiki ɗaya, abokan tarayya kuma ga alkawaran nan a cikin Kiristi Yesu.
english: that the Gentiles are fellow heirs and fellow members of the body, and fellow partakers of his promise in Christ Jesus through the Good News,

hausa: In kuma muka ce, ‘Daga mutane,’ muna tsoron mutane, gama duk sun ɗauka Yohanna annabi ne.”
english: But if we say, ‘From men,’ we fear the multitude, for all hold John as a prophet.”

hausa: Yawan mutanen sashensa 54,400 ne.
english: His division, and those who were counted of it, were fifty-four thousand four hundred.

hausa: tana kira da ƙarfi a kan tituna masu surutu, tana yin jawabinta a hanyoyin shiga gari.
english: She calls at the head of noisy places. At the entrance of the city gates, she utters her words:

hausa: ta huɗu a kan Izri, ’ya’yansa maza da danginsa, 12
english: the fourth to Izri, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

hausa: Bilatus ya yi mamaki da ya ji cewa Yesu ya riga ya mutu. Sai ya kira jarumin ya tambaye shi ko Yesu ya riga ya mutu.
english: Pilate was surprised to hear that he was already dead; and summoning the centurion, he asked him whether he had been dead long.

hausa: Tsayin kowane kerub kamu goma ne.
english: One cherub was ten cubits high, and so was the other cherub.

hausa: Ka gama aikinka ka kuma shirya gonakinka; bayan haka, ka gina gidanka.
english: Prepare your work outside, and get your fields ready. Afterwards, build your house.

hausa: Sai waɗansu daga cikin masu bin da suke na ƙungiyar Farisiyawa suka miƙe tsaye suka ce, “Dole ne a yi wa Al’ummai kaciya a kuma bukace su su yi biyayya da dokokin Musa.”
english: But some of the sect of the Pharisees who believed rose up, saying, “It is necessary to circumcise them, and to command them to keep the law of Moses.”

hausa: Daga farko fari annabawan da suka riga ka da ni sun yi annabcin yaƙi, masifa da annoba a kan ƙasashe masu yawa da kuma manyan mulkoki.
english: The prophets who have been before me and before you of old prophesied against many countries, and against great kingdoms, of war, of evil, and of pestilence.

hausa: Duk masu wucewa suna yi miki tafi na reni; suna yi wa Diyar Urushalima tsaki suna kaɗa kai suna cewa, “Wannan ne birnin da aka ce kyakkyawa ne, mai farantawa dukan duniya rai?”
english: All that pass by clap their hands at you. They hiss and wag their head at the daughter of Jerusalem, saying, “Is this the city that men called ‘The perfection of beauty, the joy of the whole earth’?”

hausa: Ibhar, Elishuwa, Nefeg, Yafiya,
english: Ibhar, Elishua, Nepheg, Japhia,

hausa: Hannun Ubangiji ya kasance a kaina a can, ya kuma ce mini, “Tashi ka fita zuwa fili, a can kuwa zan yi maka magana.”
english: Yahweh’s hand was there on me; and he said to me, “Arise, go out into the plain, and I will talk with you there.”

hausa: Amma ina gaya muku, ku ƙaunaci abokan gābankukuma ku yi wa waɗanda suke tsananta muku addu’a,
english: But I tell you, love your enemies, bless those who curse you, do good to those who hate you, and pray for those who mistreat you and persecute you,

hausa: Yaƙub, bawan Allah da kuma na Ubangiji Yesu Kiristi, Zuwa ga kabilan nan goma sha biyu, da suke warwartse a cikin al’ummai. Gaisuwa mai yawa.
english: James, a servant of God and of the Lord Jesus Christ, to the twelve tribes which are in the Dispersion: Greetings.

hausa: Amma sai kuka kauce hanya, ta wurin koyarwarku kuma kuka sa mutane da yawa suka yi tuntuɓe; kun keta alkawarin da na yi da Lawi,” in ji Ubangiji Maɗaukaki.
english: But you have turned away from the path. You have caused many to stumble in the law. You have corrupted the covenant of Levi,” says Yahweh of Armies.

hausa: Amma Mikahiya ya ce, “Na rantse da Ubangiji mai rai, zan faɗa masa kawai abin da Ubangiji ya faɗa mini.”
english: Micaiah said, “As Yahweh lives, what Yahweh says to me, that I will speak.”

hausa: Saboda haka, ku tuna dā ku Al’ummai ne bisa ga haihuwa, waɗanda kuma ake kira masu “kaciya” sukan kira ku “marasa kaciya” (ga shi kuwa, kaciyar nan ta jiki ce, wadda ake yi da hannu).
english: Therefore remember that once you, the Gentiles in the flesh, who are called “uncircumcision” by that which is called “circumcision” (in the flesh, made by hands),

hausa: Amma na yi addu’a gare ka, ya Ubangiji, a lokacin da ka ga dama; a cikin ƙaunarka mai girma, ya Allah, ka amsa mini da tabbacin ceto.
english: But as for me, my prayer is to you, Yahweh, in an acceptable time. God, in the abundance of your loving kindness, answer me in the truth of your salvation.

hausa: daga kabilar Simeyon, Shelumiyel ɗan Zurishaddai;
english: Of Simeon: Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai.

hausa: Mayaƙan sama suna biye da shi, suna hawan fararen dawakai, saye da fararen tufafi masu tsabta na lallausan lilin.
english: The armies which are in heaven, clothed in white, pure, fine linen, followed him on white horses.

hausa: Gama kamar yadda na sha gaya muku yanzu kuma ina sāke gaya muku har ma da hawaye, waɗansu da yawa suna rayuwa kamar abokan gāban gicciyen Kiristi.
english: For many walk, of whom I told you often, and now tell you even weeping, as the enemies of the cross of Christ,

hausa: Wane ne ya zāna girmanta? Ba shakka ka sani! Wane ne ya ja layin aunawa a kanta?
english: Who determined its measures, if you know? Or who stretched the line on it?

hausa: Wannan shi ne almajirin da ya ba da shaida a kan waɗannan abubuwa ya kuma rubuta su. Mun san cewa shaidarsa gaskiya ce.
english: This is the disciple who testifies about these things, and wrote these things. We know that his witness is true.

hausa: Sa’an nan Musa ya ɗauki man keɓewa ya keɓe tabanakul da kuma kowane abin da yake cikinsa, ta haka ya tsarkake su.
english: Moses took the anointing oil, and anointed the tabernacle and all that was in it, and sanctified them.

hausa: Wata rana uku cikin manyan mutanen nan talatin suka gangara wurin Dawuda zuwa dutse a kogon Adullam, yayinda ƙungiyar Filistiyawa suke sansani a Kwarin Refayim.
english: Three of the thirty chief men went down to the rock to David, into the cave of Adullam; and the army of the Philistines were encamped in the valley of Rephaim.

hausa: Esta ba tă bayyana asalin al’ummarta da na iyalinta ba, domin Mordekai ya hana yin haka.
english: Esther had not made known her people nor her relatives, because Mordecai had instructed her that she should not make it known.

hausa: Ka ba ni rai ka kuma yi mini alheri, kuma cikin tanadinka ka kula da ruhuna.
english: You have granted me life and loving kindness. Your visitation has preserved my spirit.

hausa: A lokacin girbi, uku daga cikin shugabanni talatin suka gangaro zuwa wurin Dawuda a kogon Adullam. A lokacin kuwa sojojin Filistiyawa sun kafa sansani a Kwarin Refayim.
english: Three of the thirty chief men went down, and came to David in the harvest time to the cave of Adullam; and the troop of the Philistines was encamped in the valley of Rephaim.

hausa: “Ta da idanu ki duba tsaunuka ki gani. Akwai wani wurin da ba a kwana da ke ba? A gefen hanya kin zauna kina jiran masoyanki, kin zauna kamar makiyayi a hamada. Kin ƙazantar da ƙasar da karuwancinki da muguntarki.
english: “Lift up your eyes to the bare heights, and see! Where have you not been lain with? You have sat waiting for them by the road, as an Arabian in the wilderness. You have polluted the land with your prostitution and with your wickedness.

hausa: Duk da haka sai ta yi ta ƙara fasikanci tana tuna da kwanakin budurcinta, sa’ad da take karuwa a Masar.
english: Yet she multiplied her prostitution, remembering the days of her youth, in which she had played the prostitute in the land of Egypt.

hausa: Masifa kan masifa; dukan ƙasar ta zama kufai. Cikin ɗan lokaci aka rurrushe tentuna nawa, mafakata ba zato.
english: Destruction on destruction is decreed, for the whole land is laid waste. Suddenly my tents are destroyed, and my curtains gone in a moment.

hausa: Sa’an nan Ubangiji ya ce wa Musa, “Ka faɗa wa Isra’ilawa wannan. ‘Kun gani da kanku cewa na yi magana da ku daga sama.
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “This is what you shall tell the children of Israel: ‘You yourselves have seen that I have talked with you from heaven.

hausa: Sa’ad da almajiran suka ga haka, sai suka yi mamaki suna tambaya, “Yaya itacen ɓauren ya yanƙwane nan da nan haka?”
english: When the disciples saw it, they marveled, saying, “How did the fig tree immediately wither away?”

hausa: Dole a farfashe tukunyar lakar da aka dafa naman a ciki; amma in an dafa a tukunyar tagulla, sai a kankare tukunyar, a kuma ɗauraye da ruwa.
english: But the earthen vessel in which it is boiled shall be broken; and if it is boiled in a bronze vessel, it shall be scoured, and rinsed in water.

hausa: Duba, na zāna ki a tafin hannuwana; katangarki kullum suna a gabana.
english: Behold, I have engraved you on the palms of my hands. Your walls are continually before me.

hausa: Zurfi ya ce, “Ba ta wurina”; teku ya ce, “Ba ta wurina.”
english: The deep says, ‘It isn’t in me.’ The sea says, ‘It isn’t with me.’

hausa: Mutumin da ya yi zunubi shi zai mutu. Ɗa ba zai sami rabo a laifin mahaifi ba, mahaifi ba zai sami rabo a laifi ɗa ba. Adalcin adali zai zama nasa, muguntar mugu za tă koma kansa.
english: The soul who sins, he shall die. The son shall not bear the iniquity of the father, neither shall the father bear the iniquity of the son. The righteousness of the righteous shall be on him, and the wickedness of the wicked shall be on him.

hausa: Ya ce, “Ɗan mutum, ina aikan ka zuwa ga Isra’ilawa, zuwa ga al’ummar ’yan tawayen nan da suka yi mini tayarwa; su da kakanninsu sun yi mini tawaye har yă zuwa yau.
english: He said to me, “Son of man, I send you to the children of Israel, to a nation of rebels who have rebelled against me. They and their fathers have transgressed against me even to this very day.

hausa: ɗan Mattatiyas, ɗan Amos, ɗan Nahum, ɗan Esli, ɗan Naggai,
english: the son of Mattathias, the son of Amos, the son of Nahum, the son of Esli, the son of Naggai,

hausa: Aka bayyana musu cewa ba kansu ne suke bauta wa ba sai ku, sa’ad da suka yi maganar abubuwan da aka faɗa muku ta wurin waɗanda suka yi muku wa’azin bishara, ta wurin Ruhu Mai Tsarki wanda aka aika daga sama. Ko mala’iku ma suna marmari su ga waɗannan abubuwa.
english: To them it was revealed that they served not themselves, but you, in these things, which now have been announced to you through those who preached the Good News to you by the Holy Spirit sent out from heaven; which things angels desire to look into.

hausa: Waɗansu dattawan Isra’ila suka zo wurina suka zauna a ƙasa a gabana.
english: Then some of the elders of Israel came to me and sat before me.

hausa: sai waɗansu mutane da suke tsattsaye a wurin suka ce musu, “Me kuke yi da kuke kunce ɗan jakin nan?”
english: Some of those who stood there asked them, “What are you doing, untying the young donkey?”

hausa: Al’ummai suka ji labarinsa, aka kuma kama shi cikin raminsu. Suka ja shi da ƙugiyoyi zuwa ƙasar Masar.
english: The nations also heard of him. He was taken in their pit; and they brought him with hooks to the land of Egypt.

hausa: ’Ya’yana ƙaunatattu, ku yi nesa da gumaka.
english: Little children, keep yourselves from idols.

hausa: Zan fyaɗe su a kan juna, iyaye da ’ya’yansu maza, in ji Ubangiji. Tausayi ko jinƙai, ko juyayi ba zai hana ni hallaka su ba.’ ”
english: I will dash them one against another, even the fathers and the sons together,” says Yahweh: “I will not pity, spare, or have compassion, that I should not destroy them.”’”

hausa: Ku ba wa Ubangiji ɗaukakar da ta dace da sunansa; ku kawo sadaka ku kuma zo cikin filayen gidansa.
english: Ascribe to Yahweh the glory due to his name. Bring an offering, and come into his courts.

hausa: Game da sauran ayyukan mulkin Amaziya, duk a rubuce suke a cikin littafin tarihin sarakunan Yahuda.
english: Now the rest of the acts of Amaziah, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

hausa: Refahiya ɗan Hur, mai mulkin rabin yankin Urushalima, ya yi gyare-gyaren sashe na biye.
english: Next to them, Rephaiah the son of Hur, the ruler of half the district of Jerusalem, made repairs.

hausa: In shekaru sun ragu, dole yă biya don fansarsa da kuɗi mai yawa fiye da wanda aka saye shi.
english: If there are yet many years, according to them he shall give back the price of his redemption out of the money that he was bought for.

hausa: Ubangiji zai amsa musu ya ce, “Ina aika da hatsi, sabon ruwan inabi, da mai, isashe da zai ƙosar da ku sosai; ba kuma zan ƙara maishe ku abin dariya ga al’ummai ba.
english: Yahweh answered his people, “Behold, I will send you grain, new wine, and oil, and you will be satisfied with them; and I will no more make you a reproach among the nations.

hausa: Ya kama wani saurayin Sukkot ya tambaye shi, saurayin kuwa ya rubuta masa dukan sunayen shugabanni saba’in da bakwai na Sukkot, da dattawan garin.
english: He caught a young man of the men of Succoth, and inquired of him; and he described for him the princes of Succoth, and its elders, seventy-seven men.

hausa: A ƙarshen lokacin da sarki ya sa da za a kawo su ciki, sai sarkin fada ya gabatar da su ga Nebukadnezzar.
english: At the end of the days which the king had appointed for bringing them in, the prince of the eunuchs brought them in before Nebuchadnezzar.

hausa: Duk da haka nufin Ubangiji ne a ƙuje shi yă kuma sa yă sha wahala, kuma ko da yake Ubangiji ya sa ransa ya zama hadaya don zunubi, zai ga zuriyarsa zai kuma kawo masa tsawon rai, nufin Ubangiji kuma zai yi nasara a hannunsa.
english: Yet it pleased Yahweh to bruise him. He has caused him to suffer. When you make his soul an offering for sin, he will see his offspring. He will prolong his days and Yahweh’s pleasure will prosper in his hand.

hausa: “Yanzu kuwa, Ubangiji, bari alkawarin da ka yi game da bawanka da gidansa yă kahu har abada. Yi kamar yadda ka yi alkawari,
english: Now, Yahweh, let the word that you have spoken concerning your servant, and concerning his house, be established forever, and do as you have spoken.

hausa: Gama ba mu zo duniya da kome ba, ba kuwa za mu fita daga cikinta da kome ba.
english: For we brought nothing into the world, and we certainly can’t carry anything out.

hausa: Sai ya ce mini, “Ɗan mutum, ga abin da Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka yana cewa waɗannan su ne za su zama ƙa’idodi don yin hadaya ta ƙonawa da yayyafawar jini a kan bagaden sa’ad da aka gina shi.
english: He said to me, “Son of man, the Lord Yahweh says: ‘These are the ordinances of the altar in the day when they make it, to offer burnt offerings on it, and to sprinkle blood on it.

hausa: amma ba su sami jikinsa ba. Sun dawo sun faɗa mana cewa, sun ga wahayi na mala’iku, da suka ce yana da rai.
english: and when they didn’t find his body, they came saying that they had also seen a vision of angels, who said that he was alive.

hausa: kuma duk wanda yake raye ya kuma gaskata da ni ba zai taɓa mutuwa ba. Kin gaskata wannan?”
english: Whoever lives and believes in me will never die. Do you believe this?”

hausa: “Mutanena wawaye ne; ba su san ni ba. Su ’ya’ya ne marasa azanci; ba su da fahimi. Suna da dabarar aikata mugunta; ba su san yadda za su aikata alheri ba.”
english: “For my people are foolish. They don’t know me. They are foolish children, and they have no understanding. They are skillful in doing evil, but they don’t know how to do good.”

hausa: Ishaya ya ce musu, “Ku faɗa wa maigidanku, in ji Ubangiji, ‘Kada abin da ka ji yă firgita ka, wato, waɗannan kalmomin da karen nan na sarkin Assuriya ya yi saɓo da su.
english: Isaiah said to them, “Tell your master this: ‘Yahweh says, “Don’t be afraid of the words that you have heard, with which the servants of the king of Assyria have blasphemed me.

hausa: ’Ya’yan Yerameyel maza, ɗan farin Hezron su ne, Ram shi ne ɗan fari, sai Buna, Oren, Ozem da Ahiya.
english: The sons of Jerahmeel the firstborn of Hezron were Ram the firstborn, Bunah, Oren, Ozem, and Ahijah.

hausa: sa’ad da aka rufe ƙofofin shiga tituna ƙarar niƙa kuma ya tsagaita; sa’ad da kukan tsuntsaye ta farkar da mutane, ba a kuwa jin waƙoƙinsu,
english: and the doors shall be shut in the street; when the sound of the grinding is low, and one shall rise up at the voice of a bird, and all the daughters of music shall be brought low;

hausa: Sai ɗaya daga cikin halittu huɗun nan masu rai, ya ba wa mala’iku bakwai nan kwanonin zinariya bakwai cike da fushin Allah, wanda yake raye har abada abadin.
english: One of the four living creatures gave to the seven angels seven golden bowls full of the wrath of God, who lives forever and ever.

hausa: Sa’ad da aka ji karar busar kakaki, sai sansanin da yake a gabashi, su kama hanya.
english: When you blow an alarm, the camps that lie on the east side shall go forward.

hausa: Duwatsu suna rawan jiki a gabansa tuddai kuma sun narke. Duniya da dukan abin da yake cikinta suna rawan jiki a gabansa.
english: The mountains quake before him, and the hills melt away. The earth trembles at his presence, yes, the world, and all who dwell in it.

hausa: Ku yi aure ku kuma haifi ’ya’ya maza da mata; ku nemi mata wa ’ya’yanku maza, ku kuma ba da ’ya’yanku mata ga aure, saboda su ma za su haifi ’ya’ya maza da mata. Ku riɓaɓɓanya a can, kada ku ragu.
english: Take wives and father sons and daughters. Take wives for your sons, and give your daughters to husbands, that they may bear sons and daughters. Multiply there, and don’t be diminished.

hausa: Sa’ad da dukan dattawan Isra’ila suka iso, sai firistoci suka ɗauki akwatin alkawarin,
english: All the elders of Israel came, and the priests picked up the ark.

hausa: Su ne da hakkin kula da akwatin alkawari, tebur, wurin ajiye fitila, bagade, kayayyakin wuri mai tsarki da ake amfani da su a sujada, labule, da kuma kome da ya danganci aikinsu.
english: Their duty shall be the ark, the table, the lamp stand, the altars, the vessels of the sanctuary with which they minister, the screen, and all its service.

hausa: Ezri ɗan Kelub shi ne mai lura da ma’aikatan gona waɗanda suke nome ƙasar.
english: Over those who did the work of the field for tillage of the ground was Ezri the son of Chelub.

hausa: Sa’an nan Yesu ya sāke koma ƙetaren Urdun inda dā Yohanna yake baftisma. A can ya zauna
english: He went away again beyond the Jordan into the place where John was baptizing at first, and he stayed there.

hausa: Shawulu ya haifi Shallum, Shallum ya haifi Mibsam. Mibsam ya haifi Mishma.
english: Shallum his son, Mibsam his son, and Mishma his son.

hausa: Da yake ba a kai jininsa cikin wuri mai tsarki ba, ya kamata ku ci akuyar a wuri mai tsarki, kamar yadda na umarta.”
english: Behold, its blood was not brought into the inner part of the sanctuary. You certainly should have eaten it in the sanctuary, as I commanded.”

hausa: Yanzu da kuka san waɗannan abubuwa, ku masu albarka ne, in kuka yi su.
english: If you know these things, blessed are you if you do them.

hausa: Kada ku saurari maganganun annabawa waɗanda suke ce muku, ‘Ba za ku bauta wa sarkin Babilon ba,’ gama annabcin ƙarya suke muku.
english: Don’t listen to the words of the prophets who speak to you, saying, ‘You shall not serve the king of Babylon;’ for they prophesy a lie to you.

hausa: Sai sarki ya ce, “Maza a kawo Haman don mu yi abin da Esta ta roƙa.” Saboda haka, sarki da Haman suka tafi liyafar da Esta ta shirya.
english: Then the king said, “Bring Haman quickly, so that it may be done as Esther has said.” So the king and Haman came to the banquet that Esther had prepared.

hausa: “Suka ce, ‘Ranka yă daɗe, ai, yana da guda goma ko!’
english: “They said to him, ‘Lord, he has ten minas!’

hausa: Sai ya juya wajen macen, ya ce wa Siman, “Ka ga macen nan? Na shigo gidanka, ba ka ba ni ruwa don ƙafafuna ba, amma ta wanke ƙafafuna da hawayenta, ta kuma goge su da gashin kanta.
english: Turning to the woman, he said to Simon, “Do you see this woman? I entered into your house, and you gave me no water for my feet, but she has wet my feet with her tears, and wiped them with the hair of her head.

hausa: Suka kira duwatsu da tsaunuka suna cewa, “Ku fāɗi a kanmu ku kuma ɓoye mu daga fuskar wannan mai zama a kan kursiyi da kuma daga fushin Ɗan Ragon nan!
english: They told the mountains and the rocks, “Fall on us, and hide us from the face of him who sits on the throne, and from the wrath of the Lamb,

hausa: Kamar tumaki an ƙaddara su ga kabari; za su kuwa zama abincin mutuwa amma masu gaskiya za su yi mulki a kansu da safe. Kamanninsu za su ruɓe a cikin kabari, nesa da gidajensu masu tsada.
english: They are appointed as a flock for Sheol. Death shall be their shepherd. The upright shall have dominion over them in the morning. Their beauty shall decay in Sheol, far from their mansion.

hausa: Ina faɗa muku, annabawa da sarakuna da yawa sun so su ga abin nan da kuke gani, amma ba su gani ba. Sun so su ji abin da kuke ji, amma ba su ji ba.”
english: for I tell you that many prophets and kings desired to see the things which you see, and didn’t see them, and to hear the things which you hear, and didn’t hear them.”

hausa: Zai kawo bijimin a ƙofar Tentin Sujada a gaban Ubangiji. Zai ɗibiya hannunsa a kan bijimin, yă kuma yanka shi a gaban Ubangiji.
english: He shall bring the bull to the door of the Tent of Meeting before Yahweh; and he shall lay his hand on the head of the bull, and kill the bull before Yahweh.

hausa: Waɗansu gundumomin Lawiyawan Yahuda sun zauna a Benyamin.
english: Of the Levites, certain divisions in Judah settled in Benjamin’s territory.

hausa: Ga lissafin waɗanda suka dawo daga bauta a Babilon, waɗanda Nebukadnezzar sarkin Babilon ya kwasa zuwa bauta a ƙasar Babilon (sun dawo Urushalima da Yahuda, kowa ya koma garinsu.
english: Now these are the children of the province who went up out of the captivity of those who had been carried away, whom Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon had carried away to Babylon, and who returned to Jerusalem and Judah, everyone to his city;

hausa: Ubangiji mai alheri ne da kuma mai adalci; Allahnmu yana cike da tausayi.
english: Yahweh is gracious and righteous. Yes, our God is merciful.

hausa: Ku yi magana ku kuma yi aiki kamar waɗanda za a yi musu shari’a bisa ga doka mai ba da ’yanci,
english: So speak and so do as men who are to be judged by the law of freedom.

hausa: Sai ya amsa mata, ya ce, “Domin na ce wa Nabot mutumin Yezireyel, ‘Ka sayar mini gonar inabinka; ko kuwa in ka gwammace, zan ba ka wata gonar inabi a maimakonta.’ Amma ya ce, ‘Ba zan ba ka gonar inabina ba.’ ”
english: He said to her, “Because I spoke to Naboth the Jezreelite, and said to him, ‘Give me your vineyard for money; or else, if it pleases you, I will give you another vineyard for it.’ He answered, ‘I will not give you my vineyard.’”

hausa: Ka komar da mutane zuwa ƙura, kana cewa, “Ku koma ƙura, ya ku ’ya’yan mutane.”
english: You turn man to destruction, saying, “Return, you children of men.”

hausa: amma Ubangiji ba zai bar su a ikonsu ba ko ya bari a hukunta su sa’ad da aka kawo su shari’a ba.
english: Yahweh will not leave him in his hand, nor condemn him when he is judged.

hausa: Ben-Hadad ya ce, “Zan mayar da biranen mahaifinka da na ƙwace daga mahaifinka. Za ka iya sa wurin kasuwarka a cikin Damaskus, kamar yadda mahaifinka ya yi a Samariya.” Ahab ya ce, “Bisa wannan yarjejjeniya zan sake ka.” Saboda haka ya yi yarjejjeniya da shi, sai ya bar shi ya tafi.
english: Ben Hadad said to him, “The cities which my father took from your father I will restore. You shall make streets for yourself in Damascus, as my father made in Samaria.” “I”, said Ahab, “will let you go with this covenant.” So he made a covenant with him and let him go.

hausa: Kowace rana kowane firist yakan tsaya yin hidimar ibadarsa; sau da sau yakan miƙa hadayu iri ɗaya, waɗanda ba za su taɓa kawar da zunubai ba.
english: Every priest indeed stands day by day serving and offering often the same sacrifices, which can never take away sins,

hausa: Shawulu yana da shekara talatin sa’ad da ya zama sarki, ya kuma yi sarautar Isra’ila shekara arba’in da biyu.
english: Saul was thirty years old when he became king, and he reigned over Israel forty-two years.

hausa: da shanu biyu, raguna biyar, bunsurai biyar da kuma ’yan raguna biyar, dukansu bana ɗaya-ɗaya, a miƙa su hadaya ta salama. Wannan ita ce hadayar Ahira ɗan Enan.
english: and for the sacrifice of peace offerings, two head of cattle, five rams, five male goats, and five male lambs a year old. This was the offering of Ahira the son of Enan.

hausa: A ranan nan, sa’ad da duk al’umman duniya za su tayar mata, zan sa Urushalima ta zama dutsen da ba a iya matsarwa ga dukan al’ummai. Duk waɗanda suka yi ƙoƙari su matsar da shi za su ji ciwo.
english: It will happen in that day that I will make Jerusalem a burdensome stone for all the peoples. All who burden themselves with it will be severely wounded, and all the nations of the earth will be gathered together against it.

hausa: Duba, zan zuga mutanen Medes su yi gāba da su, su da ba su kula da azurfa ba kuma ba sa damuwa da zinariya.
english: Behold, I will stir up the Medes against them, who will not value silver, and as for gold, they will not delight in it.

hausa: Aka kuwa yi yaƙi a sama. Mika’ilu da mala’ikunsa yaƙi macijin, maciji da mala’ikunsa su ma suka mai da martani.
english: There was war in the sky. Michael and his angels made war on the dragon. The dragon and his angels made war.

hausa: Suka taso daga Midiyan suka tafi Faran. Sa’an nan suka ɗauki mutane daga Faran suka tafi Masar, zuwa wurin Fir’auna wanda ya ba wa Hadad gida da ƙasa, ya kuma tanada masa da abinci.
english: They arose out of Midian and came to Paran; and they took men with them out of Paran, and they came to Egypt, to Pharaoh king of Egypt, who gave him a house, and appointed him food, and gave him land.

hausa: Sa’ad da aka saki gonar a Shekara ta Murna, za tă zama mai tsarki, a matsayin gonar da aka miƙa ga Ubangiji, za tă zama mallakar firistoci.
english: but the field, when it goes out in the Jubilee, shall be holy to Yahweh, as a devoted field. It shall be owned by the priests.

hausa: Rijiyar Yaƙub kuwa tana can, Yesu kuwa, saboda gajiyar tafiya, sai ya zauna a bakin rijiyar. Wajen sa’a ta shida ne.
english: Jacob’s well was there. Jesus therefore, being tired from his journey, sat down by the well. It was about the sixth hour.

hausa: In muka shuka iri na ruhaniya a cikinku, ashe, bai kamata mu yi girbin abin biyan bukatarmu daga gare ku ba?
english: If we sowed to you spiritual things, is it a great thing if we reap your fleshly things?

hausa: Amma zan washe Isuwa sarai; zan bubbuɗe wuraren ɓuyarsa, don kada yă ɓoye kansa. ’Ya’yansa, danginsa da maƙwabtansa za su hallaka, ba kuwa zai ƙara kasancewa ba.
english: But I have made Esau bare, I have uncovered his secret places, and he will not be able to hide himself. His offspring is destroyed, with his brothers and his neighbors; and he is no more.

hausa: Ka gane, ya Ubangiji; ka tuna da ni ka kuma lura da ni. Ka yi mini ramuwa a kan masu tsananta mini. Cikin jimirinka, kada ka ɗauke ni; ka tuna yadda na sha zagi saboda kai.
english: Yahweh, you know. Remember me, visit me, and avenge me of my persecutors. You are patient, so don’t take me away. Know that for your sake I have suffered reproach.

hausa: amma za ku ci har na wata guda cur, sai ya gundure ku a hanci har ku yi ƙyamarsa, domin kun ƙi Ubangiji wanda yake cikinku, kuka yi kuka a gabansa, kuna cewa, “Don me ma muka bar ƙasar Masar?” ’ ”
english: but a whole month, until it comes out at your nostrils, and it is loathsome to you; because you have rejected Yahweh who is among you, and have wept before him, saying, “Why did we come out of Egypt?”’”

hausa: “Ga abin da Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka yana cewa, “Za ki sha kwaf na ’yar’uwarki, kwaf wanda yake da girma da kuma zurfi; zai jawo dariya da kuma reni gama yana ɗauke da abubuwa da yawa.
english: “The Lord Yahweh says: ‘You will drink of your sister’s cup, which is deep and large. You will be ridiculed and held in derision. It contains much.

hausa: A ranar bikin sarkinmu shugabanni sukan bugu da ruwan inabi, yă yi cuɗanya da masu ba’a.
english: On the day of our king, the princes made themselves sick with the heat of wine. He joined his hand with mockers.

hausa: Saboda haka Sama’ila ya yi magana da dukan gidan Isra’ila ya ce, in har da zuciya ɗaya kuke juyowa ga Ubangiji sai ku raba kanku da baƙin alloli da gunkin nan Ashtarot, ku ba da kanku ga Ubangiji. Ku yi masa bauta shi kaɗai, zai kuɓutar da ku daga hannun Filistiyawa.
english: Samuel spoke to all the house of Israel, saying, “If you are returning to Yahweh with all your heart, then put away the foreign gods and the Ashtaroth from among you, and direct your hearts to Yahweh, and serve him only; and he will deliver you out of the hand of the Philistines.”

hausa: Ubangiji zai yi da su, yadda ya yi da Sihon da Og, sarakunan Amoriyawa, waɗanda ya hallaka tare da ƙasarsu.
english: Yahweh will do to them as he did to Sihon and to Og, the kings of the Amorites, and to their land, when he destroyed them.

hausa: Sai Yesu ya ce, masa, “Mai da takobinka kube, gama duk masu zare takobi, a takobi za su mutu.
english: Then Jesus said to him, “Put your sword back into its place, for all those who take the sword will die by the sword.

hausa: Sai na ce, “Hikima ta fi ƙarfe ƙarfi.” Amma aka rena hikimar matalaucin, ba a ma jin maganarsa.
english: Then I said, “Wisdom is better than strength.” Nevertheless the poor man’s wisdom is despised, and his words are not heard.

hausa: Wace irin godiya ce za mu yi wa Allah saboda ku a kan dukan farin cikin da muke da shi a gaban Allahnmu ta dalilinku?
english: For what thanksgiving can we give again to God for you, for all the joy with which we rejoice for your sakes before our God,

hausa: Birnin da aka birkice ta zama kango; an kulle ƙofar shiga kowane gida.
english: The confused city is broken down. Every house is shut up, that no man may come in.

hausa: Saboda haka Ubangiji ya ce wa Solomon, “Da yake halinka ke nan, ba ka kuma kiyaye alkawarina, da ƙa’idodina da na umarce ka ba, tabbatacce zan yage masarautar daga gare ka, in ba da ita ga ɗaya daga cikin bayinka.
english: Therefore Yahweh said to Solomon, “Because this is done by you, and you have not kept my covenant and my statutes, which I have commanded you, I will surely tear the kingdom from you, and will give it to your servant.

hausa: ’Ya’yan Mushi maza su ne, Mali, Eder da Yeremot, su uku ne duka.
english: The sons of Mushi: Mahli, Eder, and Jeremoth, three.

hausa: “Dukan yerima arewa da dukan Sidoniyawa suna can; sun gangara tare da waɗanda aka kashe cikin kunya duk da tsoron da suka haddasa ta wurin ikonsu. Sun kwanta tare da marasa kaciya tare da waɗanda aka kashe da takobi suna kuma shan kunya tare da waɗanda suka gangara zuwa rami.
english: “There are the princes of the north, all of them, and all the Sidonians, who have gone down with the slain. They are put to shame in the terror which they caused by their might. They lie uncircumcised with those who are slain by the sword, and bear their shame with those who go down to the pit.

hausa: Elkana mijinta kuwa yakan ce mata, “Hannatu don me kike kuka? Me ya sa ba za ki ci abinci ba? Don me kika karaya? Ashe, ban fi ’ya’ya goma a gare ki ba?”
english: Elkanah her husband said to her, “Hannah, why do you weep? Why don’t you eat? Why is your heart grieved? Am I not better to you than ten sons?”

hausa: Ya ɗauki shanu biyu, ya yayyanka su gunduwa-gunduwa, ya aika da su ko’ina a ƙasar Isra’ila ta wurin manzanni cewa, “Duk wanda bai fita ya bi Shawulu da Sama’ila ba, haka za a yi da shanunsa.” Mutanen suka ji tsoron Ubangiji suka fita gaba ɗaya kamar mutum guda.
english: He took a yoke of oxen and cut them in pieces, then sent them throughout all the borders of Israel by the hand of messengers, saying, “Whoever doesn’t come out after Saul and after Samuel, so shall it be done to his oxen.” The dread of Yahweh fell on the people, and they came out as one man.

hausa: Kamar tentin makiyayi an rushe gidana aka kuma ƙwace ta daga gare ni. Kamar mai saƙa, na nannaɗe rayuwata, ya kuma yanke ni daga sandar saƙa; dare da rana ka kawo ni ga ƙarshe.
english: My dwelling is removed, and is carried away from me like a shepherd’s tent. I have rolled up my life like a weaver. He will cut me off from the loom. From day even to night you will make an end of me.

hausa: “Amma kwanaki suna zuwa,” in ji Ubangiji, “sa’ad da zan hukunta gumakanta, da kuma a dukan ƙasarta waɗanda aka yi wa rauni, za su yi nishi.
english: “Therefore behold, the days come,” says Yahweh, “that I will execute judgment on her engraved images; and through all her land the wounded will groan.

hausa: Lawiyawa suka ma bar makiyayansu da mallakarsu, suka zo Yahuda da Urushalima domin Yerobowam da ’ya’yansa maza sun ƙi su a matsayin firistocin Ubangiji.
english: For the Levites left their pasture lands and their possessions, and came to Judah and Jerusalem; for Jeroboam and his sons cast them off, that they should not execute the priest’s office to Yahweh.

hausa: sai ya sa aka yi wa Irmiya dūka aka kuma sa shi a turu a Ƙofar Bisa na Benyamin a haikalin Ubangiji.
english: Then Pashhur struck Jeremiah the prophet and put him in the stocks that were in the upper gate of Benjamin, which was in Yahweh’s house.

hausa: Ba su san hanyar salama ba; babu adalci a hanyoyinsu. Sun mai da su karkatattun hanyoyi; babu wanda zai yi tafiya a kansu ya sami salama.
english: They don’t know the way of peace; and there is no justice in their ways. They have made crooked paths for themselves; whoever goes in them doesn’t know peace.

hausa: Zan so kowannenku yă yi magana da harsuna, sai dai zan fi so ku yi annabci. Wanda yake annabci ya fi wanda yake magana da harsuna, sai dai in ya fassara don ikkilisiya ta ginu.
english: Now I desire to have you all speak with other languages, but even more that you would prophesy. For he is greater who prophesies than he who speaks with other languages, unless he interprets, that the assembly may be built up.

hausa: Kabbon, Lahman, Kitlish,
english: Cabbon, Lahmam, Chitlish,

hausa: Ya amsa, ya ce, “Ina kishi dominka Ubangiji, Allah Maɗaukaki. Isra’ilawa sun ƙi alkawarinka, suka rurrushe bagadanka, suka kuma kashe annabawanka da takobi. Ni ne kaɗai na rage, yanzu, ni ma suna ƙoƙari su kashe ni.”
english: He said, “I have been very jealous for Yahweh, the God of Armies; for the children of Israel have forsaken your covenant, thrown down your altars, and killed your prophets with the sword. I, even I only, am left; and they seek my life, to take it away.”

hausa: na Lod, da Hadid da Ono 725
english: The children of Lod, Hadid, and Ono, seven hundred twenty-five.

hausa: Takan yi masa alheri ba mugunta ba, dukan kwanakin ranta.
english: She does him good, and not harm, all the days of her life.

hausa: Ya tambaye ni ya ce, “Me ka gani?” Na amsa, na ce, “Na ga wurin ajiye fitilan zinariya da kwano a kai, da kuma fitilu bakwai a kansa, da butocin kai wa fitilu mai guda bakwai.
english: He said to me, “What do you see?” I said, “I have seen, and behold, a lamp stand all of gold, with its bowl on the top of it, and its seven lamps on it; there are seven pipes to each of the lamps which are on the top of it;

hausa: Saboda haka fa ku dāge, ku sa gaskiya tă zama ɗamararku, adalci yă zama sulkenku,
english: Stand therefore, having the utility belt of truth buckled around your waist, and having put on the breastplate of righteousness,

hausa: Ba shakka waɗannan abubuwa sun faru da Yahuda bisa ga umarnin Ubangiji domin yă kawar da su daga gabansa saboda zunuban Manasse da dukan abin da ya yi,
english: Surely at the commandment of Yahweh this came on Judah, to remove them out of his sight for the sins of Manasseh, according to all that he did,

hausa: Sai Hamor mahaifin Shekem ya je don yă yi magana da Yaƙub.
english: Hamor the father of Shechem went out to Jacob to talk with him.

hausa: Eber, Feleg, Reyu
english: Eber, Peleg, Reu,

hausa: a can ya kai mayunwata su yi zama, ya kuma samo birnin da za su zauna.
english: There he makes the hungry live, that they may prepare a city to live in,

hausa: gama Mai Iko Duka ya yi mini manyan abubuwa, sunansa labudda Mai Tsarki ne.
english: For he who is mighty has done great things for me. Holy is his name.

hausa: Bayan kwana bakwai kuwa ambaliya ruwa ta sauko a bisa duniya.
english: After the seven days, the floodwaters came on the earth.

hausa: Sai mutumin da yake da mugun ruhun ya fāɗa musu ya sha ƙarfinsu duka. Ya yi musu dūkan tsiya har suka fita a guje daga gidan tsirara jini yana zuba.
english: The man in whom the evil spirit was leaped on them, overpowered them, and prevailed against them, so that they fled out of that house naked and wounded.

hausa: Da almajiran Yohanna suka sami labari, sai suka zo suka ɗauki jikinsa suka binne a kabari.
english: When his disciples heard this, they came and took up his corpse and laid it in a tomb.

hausa: “Ubangiji ne ke kawo mutuwa, yă kuma rayar yana kai ga kabari, yă kuma tā da.
english: “Yahweh kills and makes alive. He brings down to Sheol and brings up.

hausa: Saboda haka a ranar dukan mutane da dukan Isra’ila suka gane sarki ba shi da hannu a kisan Abner ɗan Ner.
english: So all the people and all Israel understood that day that it was not of the king to kill Abner the son of Ner.

hausa: A wannan rana Ubangiji ya ce wa Musa,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses that same day, saying,

hausa: Kai ma sai ka lura da shi, domin ya yi gāba sosai da saƙonmu.
english: Beware of him, for he greatly opposed our words.

hausa: Saboda haka sai Adoni-Zedek sarkin Urushalima ya roƙi Hoham sarkin Hebron, Firam sarkin Yarmut, Yafiya sarkin Lakish da Debir sarki Eglon ya ce,
english: Therefore Adoni-Zedek king of Jerusalem sent to Hoham king of Hebron, Piram king of Jarmuth, Japhia king of Lachish, and Debir king of Eglon, saying,

hausa: Saboda haka, zan yabe ka, ya Ubangiji cikin dukan al’ummai; Zan rera waƙoƙin yabo ga sunanka.
english: Therefore I will give thanks to you, Yahweh, among the nations, and will sing praises to your name.

hausa: “ ‘A lokacin kwana bakwai na Bikin, waɗanda za su fara a wata na bakwai a rana ta goma sha biyar, zai ba da abubuwan nan saboda hadayu don zunubi, hadayu na ƙonawa, hadayu na gari da kuma mai.
english: “‘“In the seventh month, on the fifteenth day of the month, during the feast, he shall do like that for seven days. He shall make the same provision for sin offering, the burnt offering, the meal offering, and the oil.”

hausa: Cikin zafin fushi da babbar hasala Ubangiji ya tumɓuke su daga ƙasarsu, ya watsar da su cikin wata ƙasa dabam, kamar yadda suke a yau.”
english: Yahweh rooted them out of their land in anger, in wrath, and in great indignation, and thrust them into another land, as it is today.”

hausa: Saboda wahalar da abokan gābanku za su gasa muku a lokacin kwanto, za ku ci ’ya’yan cikinku, naman ’ya’yanku maza da mata waɗanda Ubangiji Allahnku ya ba ku.
english: You will eat the fruit of your own body, the flesh of your sons and of your daughters, whom Yahweh your God has given you, in the siege and in the distress with which your enemies will distress you.

hausa: Ibrahim kuwa ya ba shi kashi ɗaya bisa goma na kome. Ma’anar sunan Melkizedek ita ce, “sarkin adalci.” Amma da yake Salem yana nufin “salama,” shi kuma “Sarkin salama” ne.
english: to whom also Abraham divided a tenth part of all (being first, by interpretation, “king of righteousness”, and then also “king of Salem”, which means “king of peace”,

hausa: “Suka amsa, ‘Don ba wanda ya ɗauke mu aiki.’ “Ya ce musu, ‘Ku ma ku je ku yi aiki a gonar inabina.’
english: “They said to him, ‘Because no one has hired us.’ “He said to them, ‘You also go into the vineyard, and you will receive whatever is right.’

hausa: Suka yi wa efod kafaɗu, sa’an nan suka haɗa su a gefenta biyu na sama, don a iya ɗaurawa.
english: They made shoulder straps for it, joined together. It was joined together at the two ends.

hausa: Begen da muke da shi dominku kuwa, tabbatacce ne, domin mun san cewa kamar yadda kuke tarayya da mu a cikin wahalolinmu, haka kuma kuke tarayya da mu a cikin ta’aziyyarmu.
english: Our hope for you is steadfast, knowing that, since you are partakers of the sufferings, so you are also of the comfort.

hausa: Sauranku da suka ragu za su lalace a ƙasashen abokan gābansu saboda zunubansu; da kuma saboda zunuban kakanninsu.
english: Those of you who are left will pine away in their iniquity in your enemies’ lands; and also in the iniquities of their fathers they shall pine away with them.

hausa: Ku saurara! Ubangiji yana kira ga birni, a ji tsoron sunana kuwa hikima ce, “Ku kasa kunne ga sandan nan da kuma wannan wanda ya naɗa.
english: Yahweh’s voice calls to the city— and wisdom fears your name— “Listen to the rod, and he who appointed it.

hausa: Shawulu ya ce, “Ubangiji ya yi muku albarka, gama kun damu da ni.
english: Saul said, “You are blessed by Yahweh, for you have had compassion on me.

hausa: Fitilar Allah kuwa tana ci, ba tă mutu ba tukuna, Sama’ila kuma na kwance a haikali na Ubangiji inda akwai akwatin Allah.
english: and God’s lamp hadn’t yet gone out, and Samuel had laid down in Yahweh’s temple where God’s ark was,

hausa: Azel yana da ’ya’ya maza shida, kuma ga sunayensu. Azrikam, Bokeru, Ishmayel, Sheyariya, Obadiya da Hanan. Dukan waɗannan ’ya’yan Azel maza ne.
english: Azel had six sons, whose names are these: Azrikam, Bocheru, Ishmael, Sheariah, Obadiah, and Hanan. All these were the sons of Azel.

hausa: “Yahuda tana makoki biranenta suna fama; suna kuka saboda ƙasar, kuka kuma tana tasowa daga Urushalima.
english: “Judah mourns, and its gates languish. They sit in black on the ground. The cry of Jerusalem goes up.

hausa: Dawuda ya kwashe garkuwoyin zinariya na shugabannin sojojin Hadadezer ya kawo Urushalima.
english: David took the shields of gold that were on the servants of Hadadezer, and brought them to Jerusalem.

hausa: Kada ku ƙulla yarjejjeniya da su, ko da allolinsu.
english: You shall make no covenant with them, nor with their gods.

hausa: Gama annabcin da ya yi ta maganar Ubangiji gāba da bagaden da yake cikin Betel da kuma wuraren sujada a tuddan da suke a biranen Samariya, ba shakka zai cika.”
english: For the saying which he cried by Yahweh’s word against the altar in Bethel, and against all the houses of the high places which are in the cities of Samaria, will surely happen.”

hausa: ta ashirin a kan Eliyata, na goma sha biya a kan Yerimot, ’ya’yansa maza da danginsa, 12
english: for the twentieth to Eliathah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

hausa: Kun ƙi umarnina kuka kuma zubar da kalmomina a bayanku
english: since you hate instruction, and throw my words behind you?

hausa: Amma gaskiya nake gaya muku. Don amfaninku ne zan tafi. Sai ko na tafi, in ba haka ba Mai Taimakon nan ba zai zo muku ba. Amma in na tafi, zan aiko shi gare ku.
english: Nevertheless I tell you the truth: It is to your advantage that I go away; for if I don’t go away, the Counselor won’t come to you. But if I go, I will send him to you.

hausa: Yusuf ya ce musu, “Mene ne wannan da kuka yi? Ba ku san cewa mutum kamar ni yana iya gane abubuwa ta wurin duba ba?”
english: Joseph said to them, “What deed is this that you have done? Don’t you know that such a man as I can indeed do divination?”

hausa: A yayinda kuke karanta wannan, za ku gane abin da na sani game da wannan shirin Kiristi.
english: by which, when you read, you can perceive my understanding in the mystery of Christ,

hausa: Solomon ya miƙa hadaya ta salama ga Ubangiji, shanu dubu ashirin da biyu, tumaki da awaki dubu ɗari da dubu ashirin. Ta haka sarki da dukan Isra’ilawa suka keɓe haikalin Ubangiji.
english: Solomon offered for the sacrifice of peace offerings, which he offered to Yahweh, twenty two thousand head of cattle and one hundred twenty thousand sheep. So the king and all the children of Israel dedicated Yahweh’s house.

hausa: in ba haka ba za ka koyi hanyoyinsa ka kuma sa kanka a tarko.
english: lest you learn his ways and ensnare your soul.

hausa: Duk da haka cikin muguntarta ta yi tayarwa a kan dokokina da ƙa’idodina fiye da al’ummai da ƙasashe kewaye da ita. Ta ƙi dokokina ba tă kuwa bi ƙa’idodina ba.
english: She has rebelled against my ordinances in doing wickedness more than the nations, and against my statutes more than the countries that are around her; for they have rejected my ordinances, and as for my statutes, they have not walked in them.’

hausa: Asa ya kasance da mayaƙa dubu ɗari uku daga Yahuda, kintsatse da manyan garkuwoyi da māsu, da kuma mayaƙa dubu ɗari biyu da dubu tamanin daga Benyamin, riƙe da ƙananan garkuwoyi da kuma baka. Dukan waɗannan jarumawa ne ƙwarai.
english: Asa had an army of three hundred thousand out of Judah who bore bucklers and spears, and two hundred eighty thousand out of Benjamin who bore shields and drew bows. All these were mighty men of valor.

hausa: Kamar yadda Ubangiji ya kasance da ranka yă daɗe, sarki, haka ma bari yă kasance da Solomon, yă kuma mai da kujerar sarautarsa tă fi kujerar sarautar ranka yă daɗe, Sarki Dawuda, girma!”
english: As Yahweh has been with my lord the king, even so may he be with Solomon, and make his throne greater than the throne of my lord King David.”

hausa: sai gwauruwan nan, matar ɗan’uwansa tă haura wurinsa a gaban dattawa, tă tuɓe takalminsa guda, ta tofa masa miyau a fuska, tă ce, “Haka za a yi ga mutumin da zai ƙi kafa gidan ɗan’uwansa.”
english: then his brother’s wife shall come to him in the presence of the elders, and loose his sandal from off his foot, and spit in his face. She shall answer and say, “So shall it be done to the man who does not build up his brother’s house.”

hausa: Ga abin da za ku yi da su, za ku rurrushe bagadansu, ku ragargaza keɓaɓɓun duwatsunsu, ku farfashe ginshiƙan Asheransu, ku kuma ƙona gumakansu da wuta.
english: But you shall deal with them like this: you shall break down their altars, dash their pillars in pieces, cut down their Asherah poles, and burn their engraved images with fire.

hausa: Mutanen Yusuf kuwa suka ce wa Yoshuwa, “Me ya sa ka ba mu rabon gādo ɗaya kawai? Ga shi muna da yawa kuma Ubangiji ya albarkace mu sosai.”
english: The children of Joseph spoke to Joshua, saying, “Why have you given me just one lot and one part for an inheritance, since we are a numerous people, because Yahweh has blessed us so far?”

hausa: Wani mala’ika, da yake da kaskon zinariyar da ake zuba turare, ya zo ya tsaya kusa da bagaden. Aka ba shi turare da yawa don yă miƙa tare da addu’o’in dukan tsarkaka a bisa bagaden zinariya a gaban kursiyin.
english: Another angel came and stood over the altar, having a golden censer. Much incense was given to him, that he should add it to the prayers of all the saints on the golden altar which was before the throne.

hausa: In na manta da ke, ya Urushalima, bari hannuna na dama manta da iyawarsa.
english: If I forget you, Jerusalem, let my right hand forget its skill.

hausa: Shallum ɗan Kore, ɗan Ebiyasaf, ɗan Kora, da ’yan’uwansa matsaran ƙofofi daga iyalin (mutanen Kohat) su suke da hakkin tsaron madogaran ƙofar Tenti kamar dai yadda kakanninsu suka kasance da hakkin tsaron mashigin mazaunin Ubangiji.
english: Shallum was the son of Kore, the son of Ebiasaph, the son of Korah, and his brothers, of his father’s house, the Korahites, were over the work of the service, keepers of the thresholds of the tent. Their fathers had been over Yahweh’s camp, keepers of the entry.

hausa: Sai mai gwajin ya zo wurinsa ya ce, “In kai Ɗan Allah ne, ka ce wa duwatsun nan su zama burodi.”
english: The tempter came and said to him, “If you are the Son of God, command that these stones become bread.”

hausa: A shekara ta goma sha huɗu ta mulkin Sarki Hezekiya, Sennakerib sarkin Assuriya ya kai wa dukan birane masu kagaran Yahuda yaƙi ya kuma kame su.
english: Now in the fourteenth year of King Hezekiah, Sennacherib king of Assyria attacked all of the fortified cities of Judah and captured them.

hausa: Ga abin da Ubangiji ya ce wa gidan Isra’ila. “Ku neme ni ku rayu;
english: For Yahweh says to the house of Israel: “Seek me, and you will live;

hausa: Su marasa aminci ne ga Ubangiji; suna haihuwar shegu. Yanzu bukukkuwar Sabon Watansu za su cinye su da gonakinsu.
english: They are unfaithful to Yahweh; for they have borne illegitimate children. Now the new moon will devour them with their fields.

hausa: Kuma ko su ji ko kada su ji, gama su gida ne mai tawaye, za su san cewa akwai annabi a cikinsu.
english: They, whether they will hear, or whether they will refuse—for they are a rebellious house—yet they will know that there has been a prophet among them.

hausa: Amma in bai wanke rigunansa ya kuma yi wanka ba, alhaki zai kasance a kansa.’ ”
english: But if he doesn’t wash them, or bathe his flesh, then he shall bear his iniquity.’”

hausa: A rana ta bakwai ɗin zai bincike shi, in cutar rigar ta yaɗu, ko a tariyar zaren, ko a wadarin, ko a fatar, ko kuwa a duk abin da ake amfani da shi, to wannan muguwar cutar riga ce; kayan marar tsarki ne.
english: He shall examine the plague on the seventh day. If the plague has spread in the garment, either in the warp, or in the woof, or in the skin, whatever use the skin is used for, the plague is a destructive mildew. It is unclean.

hausa: Kada ka ɓoye fuskarka daga bawanka; ka amsa mini da sauri, gama ina cikin wahala.
english: Don’t hide your face from your servant, for I am in distress. Answer me speedily!

hausa: Musa ya ce, “Ku ci shi yau, saboda yau Asabbaci ne na Ubangiji. Ba za ku same shi a ƙasa a yau ba.
english: Moses said, “Eat that today, for today is a Sabbath to Yahweh. Today you shall not find it in the field.

hausa: Aka ba wa dabbar baki don ta faɗi kalmomin girman kai da na saɓo ta kuma yi amfani da ikonta har watanni arba’in da biyu.
english: A mouth speaking great things and blasphemy was given to him. Authority to make war for forty-two months was given to him.

hausa: Ka duba ƙasa daga sama, mazauninka mai tsarki, ka albarkace mutanenka Isra’ila da kuma ƙasar da ka ba mu kamar yadda ka yi wa kakanninmu alkawari da rantsuwa, ƙasa mai zub da madara da zuma.”
english: Look down from your holy habitation, from heaven, and bless your people Israel, and the ground which you have given us, as you swore to our fathers, a land flowing with milk and honey.”

hausa: Ina addu’a ka zama mai ƙwazo cikin shaida bangaskiyarka, domin ka sami cikakken fahimta ta kowane abin da yake nagarin da muke da shi cikin Kiristi.
english: that the fellowship of your faith may become effective in the knowledge of every good thing which is in us in Christ Jesus.

hausa: Amma ina gaya muku, Kada ku yi rantsuwa sam, ko da sama, domin kursiyin Allah ne;
english: but I tell you, don’t swear at all: neither by heaven, for it is the throne of God;

hausa: “Mu, firistoci, da Lawiyawa da kuma mutane, mun jefa ƙuri’a don a san lokacin da kowane iyalinmu zai kawo sadakar itace don ƙonewa a gidan Allahnmu a ƙayyadaddun lokuta a bagaden Ubangiji Allahnmu, kamar yadda yake a rubuce a cikin Doka.
english: We, the priests, the Levites, and the people, cast lots for the wood offering, to bring it into the house of our God, according to our fathers’ houses, at times appointed year by year, to burn on Yahweh our God’s altar, as it is written in the law;

hausa: Da Yahudawan da suke tare da Maryamu a cikin gida, suke mata ta’aziyya, suka ga ta yi wuf ta fita, sai suka bi ta, suna tsammani za tă kabarin ne tă yi kuka a can.
english: Then the Jews who were with her in the house and were consoling her, when they saw Mary, that she rose up quickly and went out, followed her, saying, “She is going to the tomb to weep there.”

hausa: Jimillar maza daga mutanen Naftali kuwa 53,400 ne.
english: those who were counted of them, of the tribe of Naphtali, were fifty-three thousand four hundred.

hausa: “Yi wa Haruna da ’ya’yansa maza da kuma dukan Isra’ilawa magana ka ce musu, ‘In waninku, ko mutumin Isra’ila, ko baƙon da yake zama a Isra’ila, ya kawo kyauta don hadaya ta ƙonawa ga Ubangiji, ko don yă cika alkawari, ko kuwa a matsayin hadaya ta yardar rai,
english: “Speak to Aaron, and to his sons, and to all the children of Israel, and say to them, ‘Whoever is of the house of Israel, or of the foreigners in Israel, who offers his offering, whether it is any of their vows or any of their free will offerings, which they offer to Yahweh for a burnt offering:

hausa: Farisa, Kush da Fut za su kasance tare da su, duka riƙe da garkuwoyi da hulunan kwano,
english: Persia, Cush, and Put with them, all of them with shield and helmet;

hausa: gama Allah zai cece Sihiyona yă sāke gina biranen Yahuda. Sa’an nan mutane za su zauna a can su mallake ta,
english: For God will save Zion, and build the cities of Judah. They shall settle there, and own it.

hausa: Yesu ya shiga filin haikali, ya kuma kori duk masu saya da sayarwa a can. Ya tutture tebur masu canjin kuɗi da kuma kujerun masu sayar da tattabarai.
english: Jesus entered into the temple of God and drove out all of those who sold and bought in the temple, and overthrew the money changers’ tables and the seats of those who sold the doves.

hausa: Tun da ya same ta a jeji ne, wataƙila yarinyar ta yi kukan neman taimako, amma babu wani da zai cece ta.
english: for he found her in the field, the pledged to be married lady cried, and there was no one to save her.

hausa: “Ga abin da Ubangiji yana cewa, ‘In ka tā da alkawarina na rana da kuma alkawarina na dare, har dare da rana ba za su ƙara bayyana a ƙayyadaddun lokutansu ba,
english: “Yahweh says: ‘If you can break my covenant of the day and my covenant of the night, so that there will not be day and night in their time,

hausa: Sai Ibrahim ya matso wurinsa ya ce, “Za ka hallaka masu adalci tare da masu mugunta?
english: Abraham came near, and said, “Will you consume the righteous with the wicked?

hausa: Amma na ja kunnensu na ce, “Me ya sa kuke kwana kusa da katanga? In kuka ƙara yin haka, zan kama ku.” Daga wannan lokaci har zuwa gaba ba su ƙara zuwa a ranar Asabbaci ba.
english: Then I testified against them, and said to them, “Why do you stay around the wall? If you do so again, I will lay hands on you.” From that time on, they didn’t come on the Sabbath.

hausa: Ka girmama Ubangiji da dukan dukiyarka, ta wurin miƙa masa nunan fari na dukan amfanin gonarka;
english: Honor Yahweh with your substance, with the first fruits of all your increase;

hausa: Ban da haka, a waɗannan kwanakin na ga mutanen Yahuda waɗanda suka auri mata daga Ashdod, Ammon da Mowab.
english: In those days I also saw the Jews who had married women of Ashdod, of Ammon, and of Moab;

hausa: Gama inda dukiyarku take, nan ne zuciyarku ma take.
english: For where your treasure is, there will your heart be also.

hausa: ga tsoron Allah kuma ku ƙara da nuna alheri ga ’yan’uwa; ga nuna alheri ga ’yan’uwa kuma ku ƙara da ƙauna.
english: and in godliness, brotherly affection; and in brotherly affection, love.

hausa: Ba kuma Adamu ne aka yaudara ba; macen ce aka yaudara ta kuma zama mai zunubi.
english: Adam wasn’t deceived, but the woman, being deceived, has fallen into disobedience;

hausa: tare da hadaya ta gari mai laushi, humushi biyu haɗe da mai, wato, hadaya ce da aka ƙone da wuta ga Ubangiji, mai daɗin ƙanshi, da kuma abin sha kwalaba ɗaya na ruwan inabi.
english: The meal offering with it shall be two tenths of an ephah of fine flour mixed with oil, an offering made by fire to Yahweh for a pleasant aroma; and the drink offering with it shall be of wine, the fourth part of a hin.

hausa: Ɗaya daga cikin mala’ikun nan bakwai masu kwanonin nan bakwai cike da annoban nan bakwai na ƙarshe, ya zo ya ce mini “Zo, zan nuna maka amaryar, matar Ɗan Ragon.”
english: One of the seven angels who had the seven bowls which were loaded with the seven last plagues came, and he spoke with me, saying, “Come here. I will show you the bride, the Lamb’s wife.”

hausa: Musa ya ce wa Allah, “A ce ma na tafi wurin Isra’ilawa na ce musu, ‘Allah na kakanninku ya aiko ni wurinku,’ in suka tambaye ni, ‘Mene ne sunansa?’ Me zan ce?”
english: Moses said to God, “Behold, when I come to the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘The God of your fathers has sent me to you,’ and they ask me, ‘What is his name?’ what should I tell them?”

hausa: sai Abimelek da dukan mutanensa suka haura zuwa Dutsen Zalmon. Sai ya ɗauki gatari ya sassare waɗansu rassa, waɗanda ya sa a kafaɗunsa. Ya umarci mutanen da suke tare da shi ya ce, “Sauri, ku yi abin da kuka ga na yi!”
english: Abimelech went up to Mount Zalmon, he and all the people who were with him; and Abimelech took an ax in his hand, and cut down a bough from the trees, and took it up, and laid it on his shoulder. Then he said to the people who were with him, “What you have seen me do, make haste, and do as I have done!”

hausa: Kamar keji cike da tsuntsaye, gidajensu sun cika da ruɗu; sun yi arziki suka kuma zama masu iko
english: As a cage is full of birds, so are their houses full of deceit. Therefore they have become great, and grew rich.

hausa: Ya ba da umarninsa ya kuma warkar da su ya kuɓutar da su daga kabari.
english: He sends his word, and heals them, and delivers them from their graves.

hausa: wanda mahaifiyarsa ta fito daga Dan, mahaifinsa kuma daga Taya. An horar da shi a aikin zinariya, azurfa, tagulla, baƙin ƙarfe, dutse, itace, da kuma shuɗi, shunayya, garura, da lilin mai kyau. Ya gogu a kowane irin zāne-zāne, zai kuma iya yin kowane zānen da aka ba shi. Zai yi aiki tare da masu sana’arka, da kuma tare da waɗanda ranka yă daɗe, Dawuda mahaifinka ya tanada.
english: the son of a woman of the daughters of Dan; and his father was a man of Tyre. He is skillful to work in gold, in silver, in bronze, in iron, in stone, in timber, in purple, in blue, in fine linen, and in crimson, also to engrave any kind of engraving and to devise any device, that there may be a place appointed to him with your skillful men, and with the skillful men of my lord David your father.

hausa: “To, idan mai gonar inabin ya zo, me zai yi da ’yan hayan nan?”
english: When therefore the lord of the vineyard comes, what will he do to those farmers?”

hausa: kuma a rubuce yake cewa, “Ubangiji ya san dukan tunanin masu hikima banza ne.”
english: And again, “The Lord knows the reasoning of the wise, that it is worthless.”

hausa: Wannan fure mai yanƙwanewa, darajarar kyansa, da aka sa a kan kwari mai ba da amfani, zai zama kamar ’ya’yan ɓaure, nunan fari, da zarar wani ya gani ya kuma tsinka, zai haɗiye shi.
english: The fading flower of his glorious beauty, which is on the head of the fertile valley, shall be like the first-ripe fig before the summer, which someone picks and eats as soon as he sees it.

hausa: Yesu ya amsa ya ce, “Ba ka da wani iko a kaina, in ba a ba ka daga sama ba. Saboda haka wanda ya bashe ni gare ka, ya fi na zunubi.”
english: Jesus answered, “You would have no power at all against me, unless it were given to you from above. Therefore he who delivered me to you has greater sin.”

hausa: Je ki faɗa wa Yerobowam cewa ga abin da Ubangiji, Allah na Isra’ila ya ce, ‘Na tā da kai daga cikin mutane, na mai da kai shugaba a bisa mutanena Isra’ila.
english: Go, tell Jeroboam, ‘Yahweh, the God of Israel, says: “Because I exalted you from among the people, and made you prince over my people Israel,

hausa: “Ku komo, mutane marasa bangaskiya; zan warkar da ku daga ja da bayanku.” “I, za mu zo wurinka, gama kai ne Ubangiji Allahnmu.
english: Return, you backsliding children, and I will heal your backsliding. “Behold, we have come to you; for you are Yahweh our God.

hausa: ya ce, “Mutane, ina gani tafiyarmu za tă zama da masifa ta kuma kawo babbar hasara ga jirgin ruwan da kaya, da kuma ga rayukanmu ma.”
english: and said to them, “Sirs, I perceive that the voyage will be with injury and much loss, not only of the cargo and the ship, but also of our lives.”

hausa: Ya fitar da mutanensa da farin ciki, zaɓaɓɓunsa da sowa ta farin ciki;
english: He brought his people out with joy, his chosen with singing.

hausa: Sa’an nan Yesu ya amsa ya ce, “Mace, kina da bangaskiya mai yawa! An biya miki bukatarki.” ’Yarta kuwa ta warke nan take.
english: Then Jesus answered her, “Woman, great is your faith! Be it done to you even as you desire.” And her daughter was healed from that hour.

hausa: Dawuda ya ce, “Ya Ubangiji, Allah na Isra’ila, bawanka ya sami labari cewa tabbatacce Shawulu yana shirin zuwa Keyila yă hallaka garin saboda ni.
english: Then David said, “O Yahweh, the God of Israel, your servant has surely heard that Saul seeks to come to Keilah to destroy the city for my sake.

hausa: Bayan da Musa ya tura matarsa Ziffora gida, sai surukinsa Yetro ya karɓe ta
english: Jethro, Moses’ father-in-law, received Zipporah, Moses’ wife, after he had sent her away,

hausa: Kai kyakkyawa ne, ƙaunataccena! Kai, kana ɗaukan hankali! Gadonmu koriyar ciyawa ce.
english: Behold, you are beautiful, my beloved, yes, pleasant; and our couch is verdant.

hausa: Ƙuri’u don Ƙofar Yamma da kuma Ƙofar Shalleket a hanyar bisa suka fāɗo a kan Shuffim da Hosa. Aikin tsaro bisa ga mai tsaro.
english: To Shuppim and Hosah westward, by the gate of Shallecheth, at the causeway that goes up, watchman opposite watchman.

hausa: Mugaye ba sa iya barci, sai sun aikata mugunta; ba su barci sai sun cuci wani.
english: For they don’t sleep unless they do evil. Their sleep is taken away, unless they make someone fall.

hausa: “Faɗa wa Isra’ilawa, ‘Macen da ta yi ciki ta kuma haihu ɗa namiji za tă ƙazantu kwana bakwai, kamar yadda takan ƙazantu a lokacin al’adarta.
english: “Speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘If a woman conceives, and bears a male child, then she shall be unclean seven days; as in the days of her monthly period she shall be unclean.

hausa: Ku ji wannan, ku da kuke tattake masu bukata kuka kori matalautan ƙasar.
english: Hear this, you who desire to swallow up the needy, and cause the poor of the land to fail,

hausa: Ka amsa mini, ya Ubangiji cikin alherin ƙaunarka; cikin jinƙanka mai girma ka juyo gare ni.
english: Answer me, Yahweh, for your loving kindness is good. According to the multitude of your tender mercies, turn to me.

hausa: Ya fita ya je ya sadu da Asa ya kuma faɗa masa, “Ka saurare ni, Asa da kuma dukan Yahuda da Benyamin. Ubangiji yana tare da ku sa’ad da kuke tare da shi. In kuka neme shi, za ku same shi, amma in kuka yashe shi, zai yashe ku.
english: He went out to meet Asa, and said to him, “Hear me, Asa, and all Judah and Benjamin! Yahweh is with you while you are with him; and if you seek him, he will be found by you; but if you forsake him, he will forsake you.

hausa: Duk da haka waɗansu ba su kula da umarnin Musa ba, suka bar saura har safe, kashegari kuwa ta yi tsutsotsi, ta ruɓe, sai Musa ya yi fushi da su.
english: Notwithstanding they didn’t listen to Moses, but some of them left of it until the morning, so it bred worms and became foul; and Moses was angry with them.

hausa: An ba wa kowane mutum bayyanuwar Ruhu don amfanin kowa.
english: But to each one is given the manifestation of the Spirit for the profit of all.

hausa: Ba abin da yake shiga mutum daga waje ba ne yake ƙazantar da shi. Sai dai abin da ya fita daga cikin mutum ne, yake ƙazantar da shi.”
english: There is nothing from outside of the man that going into him can defile him; but the things which proceed out of the man are those that defile the man.

hausa: A cikin Doka Musa ya umarce mu, mu jajjefe irin waɗannan mata. To, me ka ce?”
english: Now in our law, Moses commanded us to stone such women. What then do you say about her?”

hausa: Daga abubuwan da suke fitowa daga leɓunansa mutum kan cika da abubuwa masu kyau tabbatacce yadda aikin hannuwansa suke ba shi lada.
english: A man shall be satisfied with good by the fruit of his mouth. The work of a man’s hands shall be rewarded to him.

hausa: Amma in ya ji, sa’an nan daga baya ya hana ta, to, zai sha hukuncin laifinta.”
english: But if he makes them null and void after he has heard them, then he shall bear her iniquity.”

hausa: Gama Isra’ilawa bayina ne, waɗanda na saya daga Masar, kada a sayar da su a matsayin bayi.
english: For they are my servants, whom I brought out of the land of Egypt. They shall not be sold as slaves.

hausa: Taku ta ƙare ku da kuke zama a bakin teku, Ya ku mutanen Keretawa; maganar Ubangiji tana gāba da ke, Ya ke Kan’ana, ƙasar Filistiyawa. “Zan hallaka ki kuma babu abin da zai rage.”
english: Woe to the inhabitants of the sea coast, the nation of the Cherethites! Yahweh’s word is against you, Canaan, the land of the Philistines. I will destroy you until there is no inhabitant.

hausa: A daidai sa’ad da Bulus yana shirin yin magana, sai Galliyo ya ce wa Yahudawan, “Da a ce ku Yahudawa kuna gunaguni game da munafunci, ko kuma wani babban laifi, da sai in iya sauraronku.
english: But when Paul was about to open his mouth, Gallio said to the Jews, “If indeed it were a matter of wrong or of wicked crime, you Jews, it would be reasonable that I should bear with you;

hausa: Me ya faru da dukan farin cikinku? Na tabbata, a lokacin, da mai yiwuwa ne da kun ciccire idanunku kun ba ni.
english: What was the blessing you enjoyed? For I testify to you that, if possible, you would have plucked out your eyes and given them to me.

hausa: Isra’ilawa sun tashi daga Rameses a rana ta goma sha biyar, ga watan fari, kashegarin Bikin Ƙetarewa. Suka fita gabagadi a gaban dukan Masarawa,
english: They traveled from Rameses in the first month, on the fifteenth day of the first month; on the next day after the Passover, the children of Israel went out with a high hand in the sight of all the Egyptians,

hausa: Amma ba abin da ya yi niyya ke nan ba, ba abin da yake da shi a zuciya ba; manufarsa shi ne yă hallaka, yă kuma kawo ƙarshen al’ummai da yawa.
english: However, he doesn’t mean so, neither does his heart think so; but it is in his heart to destroy, and to cut off not a few nations.

hausa: Dole mu sayi ruwan da muke sha; sai mun biya mu sami itace.
english: We must pay for water to drink. Our wood is sold to us.

hausa: Ubangiji zai sama sarki bisa dukan duniya. A ranan nan za a kasance da Ubangiji ɗaya, ba wani suna kuma sai nasa.
english: Yahweh will be King over all the earth. In that day Yahweh will be one, and his name one.

hausa: ya kuma kawo kwanon zinariya ɗaya mai nauyin shekel goma, cike da turaren hayaƙi;
english: one golden ladle of ten shekels, full of incense;

hausa: Saboda haka yakan yi hadaya wa abin kamun kifinsa yă kuma ƙona turare wa ragarsa, domin ta wurin abin kamun kifinsa ne yake yin rayuwar jin daɗi yă kuma zaɓi irin abincin da yake so.
english: Therefore he sacrifices to his net and burns incense to his dragnet, because by them his life is luxurious and his food is good.

hausa: da tabbacin cewa wanda ya fara kyakkyawan aikin nan a cikinku, zai kai shi ga kammalawa har yă zuwa ranar Kiristi Yesu.
english: being confident of this very thing, that he who began a good work in you will complete it until the day of Jesus Christ.

hausa: amma kowannensu yana da fuskoki huɗu da fikafikai guda huɗu.
english: Everyone had four faces, and each one of them had four wings.

hausa: Suka yi ta aiko mini da wannan saƙo har sau huɗu, ni kuwa na yi ta ba su amsa irin ta dā.
english: They sent to me four times like this; and I answered them the same way.

hausa: A wannan rana kuma, biyu daga cikinsu suna tafiya zuwa wani ƙauye, da ake kira Emmawus, da suke kusan mil bakwai daga Urushalima.
english: Behold, two of them were going that very day to a village named Emmaus, which was sixty stadia from Jerusalem.

hausa: Mutanen kuwa suka kama Yesu, suka riƙe shi.
english: They laid their hands on him and seized him.

hausa: Sai Yaƙub da Yohanna, ’ya’yan Zebedi maza suka zo wurinsa suka ce, “Malam, muna so ka yi mana duk abin da muka roƙa.”
english: James and John, the sons of Zebedee, came near to him, saying, “Teacher, we want you to do for us whatever we will ask.”

hausa: Ya ba da mutanensa ga takobi; ya yi fushi ƙwarai da gādonsa.
english: He also gave his people over to the sword, and was angry with his inheritance.

hausa: Tabbatacce al’ummai suna kama da ɗigon ruwa a cikin bokiti an ɗauke su a matsayin ƙura a kan magwaji; yakan auna tsibirai sai ka ce ƙura mai laushi.
english: Behold, the nations are like a drop in a bucket, and are regarded as a speck of dust on a balance. Behold, he lifts up the islands like a very little thing.

hausa: Wannan ne ya sa mutum yakan bar mahaifinsa da mahaifiyarsa, yă manne wa matarsa, su kuma zama jiki ɗaya.
english: Therefore a man will leave his father and his mother, and will join with his wife, and they will be one flesh.

hausa: Amma an tsawata masa saboda laifinsa ta wurin jaki, dabbar da ba ta magana, wadda ta yi magana da muryar mutum ta kuma kwaɓi haukan annabin.
english: but he was rebuked for his own disobedience. A speechless donkey spoke with a man’s voice and stopped the madness of the prophet.

hausa: Sai Musa da Haruna suka tafi wurin Fir’auna suka ce masa, “Ga abin da Ubangiji, Allah na Ibraniyawa ya ce, ‘Har yaushe za ka ƙi ƙasƙantar da kanka a gabana? Ka bar mutanena su tafi domin su yi mini sujada.
english: Moses and Aaron went in to Pharaoh, and said to him, “This is what Yahweh, the God of the Hebrews, says: ‘How long will you refuse to humble yourself before me? Let my people go, that they may serve me.

hausa: Sai ya ce musu, “Ku lura fa! Ku tsare kanku daga dukan kowane irin kwaɗayi. Ran mutum ba ya danganta a kan yawan dukiyarsa ba.”
english: He said to them, “Beware! Keep yourselves from covetousness, for a man’s life doesn’t consist of the abundance of the things which he possesses.”

hausa: Bayan sun saurari sarki, sai suka kama hanyarsu, tauraron da suka gani a gabas kuwa yana tafe a gabansu, sai da ya kai inda yaron yake.
english: They, having heard the king, went their way; and behold, the star, which they saw in the east, went before them until it came and stood over where the young child was.

hausa: Da matar ta ga Sama’ila sai ta yi ihu da ƙarfi ta ce wa Shawulu, “Me ya sa ka ruɗe ni? Kai ne Shawulu!”
english: When the woman saw Samuel, she cried with a loud voice; and the woman spoke to Saul, saying, “Why have you deceived me? For you are Saul!”

hausa: Sa’ad da Ubangiji ya cika kowane alherinsa da ya yi wa shugabana alkawari, ya kuma keɓe shi sarki a bisa Isra’ila,
english: It will come to pass, when Yahweh has done to my lord according to all the good that he has spoken concerning you, and has appointed you prince over Israel,

hausa: Sai Allah ya sa sarkin fada ya nuna masa tagomashi ya kuma ƙaunaci Daniyel,
english: Now God made Daniel find kindness and compassion in the sight of the prince of the eunuchs.

hausa: Amma na dogara gare ka, ya Ubangiji; na ce, “Kai ne Allahna.”
english: But I trust in you, Yahweh. I said, “You are my God.”

hausa: Da a ce ban yi ayyuka a cikinsu waɗanda babu wani da ya taɓa yi ba, da ba su da zunubi. Amma yanzu sun ga waɗannan ayyukan banmamaki, duk da haka sun ƙi ni sun kuma ƙi Ubana.
english: If I hadn’t done among them the works which no one else did, they wouldn’t have had sin. But now they have seen and also hated both me and my Father.

hausa: Mutanena sukan zo wurinka, yadda suka saba su zauna a gabanka don su saurari maganarka, amma ba sa aiki da abin da suka ji. Da bakunansu suna nuna ƙauna, amma zukatansu cike da haɗama suke don ƙazamar riba.
english: They come to you as the people come, and they sit before you as my people, and they hear your words, but don’t do them; for with their mouth they show much love, but their heart goes after their gain.

hausa: Ya Ubangiji, mu da sarakunanmu, da masu mulkinmu da iyayenmu kunya ta rufe mu saboda mun yi maka zunubi.
english: Lord, to us belongs confusion of face, to our kings, to our princes, and to our fathers, because we have sinned against you.

hausa: Masu gani za su ji kunya, masu duba kuma za su ji taƙaici. Dukansu za su rufe fuskokinsu gama ba amsa daga Allah.”
english: The seers shall be disappointed, and the diviners confounded. Yes, they shall all cover their lips, for there is no answer from God.”

hausa: “Ka yi magana da Isra’ilawa, ka ce musu, ‘A dukan tsararraki masu zuwa, za ku sa tuntaye a gefen rigunarku, su sa zare mai ruwan shuɗi a bisan kowane tuntu.
english: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them that they should make themselves fringes on the borders of their garments throughout their generations, and that they put on the fringe of each border a cord of blue.

hausa: Bisa ga abin da suka yi, haka za a sāka fushi a kan abokan gābansa ramuwa kuma a kan maƙiyansa; zai sāka wa tsibirai abin da ya dace da su.
english: According to their deeds, he will repay as appropriate: wrath to his adversaries, recompense to his enemies. He will repay the islands their due.

hausa: “A wannan rana duwatsu za su ɗiga da sabon ruwan inabi, tuddai kuma za su malmalo madara; dukan rafuffukan Yahuda za su yi ta gudano da ruwa. Maɓulɓula kuma za tă fito daga gidan Ubangiji haka ma ruwa a kwarin itatuwan ƙirya.
english: It will happen in that day, that the mountains will drop down sweet wine, the hills will flow with milk, all the brooks of Judah will flow with waters; and a fountain will flow out from Yahweh’s house, and will water the valley of Shittim.

hausa: Za su yi maganar ɗaukakar mulkinka za su kuma yi zancen ikonka,
english: They will speak of the glory of your kingdom, and talk about your power,

hausa: A haka kuma, dole matansu su zama matan da suka cancanci girmamawa, ba masu gulma ba, sai dai masu sauƙinkai da kuma masu aminci a cikin kome.
english: Their wives in the same way must be reverent, not slanderers, temperate, and faithful in all things.

hausa: Amma akan tabbatar da hikima ta gaskiya bisa ga dukan ’ya’yanta.”
english: Wisdom is justified by all her children.”

hausa: Yanzu fa, al’ada ce a lokacin Bikin, a saki ɗan kurkuku guda wanda mutane suka roƙa.
english: Now at the feast he used to release to them one prisoner, whomever they asked of him.

hausa: Ana bayyana fushin Allah daga sama a kan dukan rashin sanin Allah da kuma muguntar mutanen da suke danne gaskiya ta wurin muguntarsu,
english: For the wrath of God is revealed from heaven against all ungodliness and unrighteousness of men who suppress the truth in unrighteousness,

hausa: Amma ku ba kome ba ne kuma ayyukanku banza da wofi ne; duk wanda ya zaɓe ku abin ƙyama ne.
english: Behold, you are nothing, and your work is nothing. He who chooses you is an abomination.

hausa: Sukan yi masa ado da azurfa da kuma zinariya; sukan ɗauki guduma su kafa shi da ƙusoshi, don kada yă fāɗi.
