english: They deck it with silver and with gold. They fasten it with nails and with hammers, so that it can’t move.

hausa: “Allah ya fitar da su daga Masar; suna da ƙarfin kutunkun ɓauna. Sun cinye abokan gāban, suka kakkarya ƙasusuwansu; da kibiyoyinsu suka sossoke su.
english: God brings him out of Egypt. He has as it were the strength of the wild ox. He shall consume the nations his adversaries, shall break their bones in pieces, and pierce them with his arrows.

hausa: a yaƙi da Babiloniyawa. ‘Za su cika da gawawwakin mutane waɗanda na kashe da fushina da hasalata. Zan ɓoye fuskata wa wannan birni saboda dukan muguntarsu.
english: ‘While men come to fight with the Chaldeans, and to fill them with the dead bodies of men, whom I have killed in my anger and in my wrath, and for all whose wickedness I have hidden my face from this city,

hausa: Bayan Dawuda ya yi gine-gine wa kansa a Birnin Dawuda, sai ya shirya wuri domin akwatin alkawarin Allah, ya kuma kafa tenti dominsa.
english: David made himself houses in David’s city; and he prepared a place for God’s ark, and pitched a tent for it.

hausa: Suka aiki almajiransu tare da mutanen Hiridus wurinsa. Suka ce, “Malam, mun san kai mutum ne mai mutunci, kuma kana koyar da maganar Allah bisa gaskiya. Mutane ba sa ɗaukan hankalinka, domin ba ka kula ko su wane ne ba.
english: They sent their disciples to him, along with the Herodians, saying, “Teacher, we know that you are honest, and teach the way of God in truth, no matter whom you teach; for you aren’t partial to anyone.

hausa: Ki ji, ya duniya. Zan kawo masifa a kan waɗannan mutane, sakayyar ƙulle-ƙullensu, domin ba su saurari maganata ba suka kuma ƙi dokata.
english: Hear, earth! Behold, I will bring evil on this people, even the fruit of their thoughts, because they have not listened to my words; and as for my law, they have rejected it.

hausa: Amma ba zan yage dukan masarautar daga gare shi ba, zan ba shi kabila ɗaya saboda Dawuda bawana, da kuma saboda Urushalima, wadda na zaɓa.”
english: However, I will not tear away all the kingdom; but I will give one tribe to your son, for David my servant’s sake, and for Jerusalem’s sake which I have chosen.”

hausa: “Gaskiya nake gaya muku, ba shakka, wannan zamani ba zai shuɗe ba, sai dukan waɗannan abubuwa sun cika.
english: Most certainly I tell you, this generation will not pass away until all things are accomplished.

hausa: hankalin mai zunubi na gāba da Allah. Ba ya biyayya da dokar Allah, ba kuwa zai iya yin haka ba.
english: because the mind of the flesh is hostile toward God, for it is not subject to God’s law, neither indeed can it be.

hausa: Gama a cikin Nassi an ce, “Ga shi, na kafa dutse a Sihiyona, zaɓaɓɓen dutse na kusurwar gini mai daraja, wanda kuma ya dogara gare shi ba zai taɓa kunyata ba.”
english: Because it is contained in Scripture, “Behold, I lay in Zion a chief cornerstone, chosen and precious. He who believes in him will not be disappointed.”

hausa: Saboda haka ga abin da Ubangiji yana cewa, “Zan sa abin tuntuɓe gaban mutanena. Mahaifi da ’ya’yansa maza za su yi tuntuɓe a kan juna; maƙwabci da abokansa za su hallaka.”
english: Therefore Yahweh says, “Behold, I will lay stumbling blocks before this people. The fathers and the sons together will stumble against them. The neighbor and his friend will perish.”

hausa: Saboda haka kada ku yar da tabbacinku; za a sāka muku a yalwace.
english: Therefore don’t throw away your boldness, which has a great reward.

hausa: Sa’ad da sauran bayin suka ga abin da ya faru, abin ya ɓata musu rai ƙwarai, sai suka tafi suka faɗa wa maigidansu dukan abin da ya faru.
english: So when his fellow servants saw what was done, they were exceedingly sorry, and came and told their lord all that was done.

hausa: Gama Ubangiji zai zartar da hukuncinsa a bisan duniya da sauri kuma ba da ɓata lokaci ba.”
english: for he will finish the work and cut it short in righteousness, because the Lord will make a short work upon the earth.”

hausa: Ya yi ginshiƙai biyun; dajiyoyi biyu masu fasalin kwano a kan ginshiƙan; ya yi yanar kashi biyu wa dajiyoyi masu fasalin kwano guda biyu a kan ginshiƙai;
english: the two pillars; the two bowls of the capitals that were on the top of the pillars; the two networks to cover the two bowls of the capitals that were on the top of the pillars;

hausa: Sa’an nan ya yi kuka ga Ubangiji ya ce, “Ya Ubangiji Allahna, don me ka kawo wannan masifa a kan gwauruwan nan? Kai ka ce in zauna tare da ita, ga shi yanzu ɗanta ya mutu.”
english: He cried to Yahweh and said, “Yahweh my God, have you also brought evil on the widow with whom I am staying, by killing her son?”

hausa: Yonatan ɗan Shawulu kuwa ya tafi wurin Dawuda a Horesh, ya ƙarfafa shi yă dogara ga Allah.
english: Jonathan, Saul’s son, arose and went to David into the woods, and strengthened his hand in God.

hausa: don zuciyata za tă iya rera gare ka ba kuwa za tă yi shiru ba. Ya Ubangiji Allahna, zan yi maka godiya har abada.
english: to the end that my heart may sing praise to you, and not be silent. Yahweh my God, I will give thanks to you forever!

hausa: A wata na bakwai na shekara ta biyu ta mulkin Dariyus, maganar Ubangiji ta zo wa annabi Zakariya ɗan Berekiya ɗan Iddo.
english: In the eighth month, in the second year of Darius, Yahweh’s word came to the prophet Zechariah the son of Berechiah, the son of Iddo, saying,

hausa: Amma in firist ya sayi bawa da kuɗi, ko kuwa in an haifi bawan a gidansa, wannan bawan zai iya cin tsattsarkan abincin.
english: But if a priest buys a slave, purchased by his money, he shall eat of it; and those who are born in his house shall eat of his bread.

hausa: Sarki Rehobowam ya aiki Hadoram wanda yake lura da aikin dole, amma Isra’ilawa suka jajjefe shi da duwatsu har ya mutu. Sarki Rehobowam kuwa ya gaggauta ya shiga keken yaƙinsa ya gudu zuwa Urushalima.
english: Then King Rehoboam sent Hadoram, who was over the men subject to forced labor; and the children of Israel stoned him to death with stones. King Rehoboam hurried to get himself up to his chariot, to flee to Jerusalem.

hausa: Sai aka faɗa wa sarkin Assuriya cewa, “Mutanen da ka kwashe ka zaunar a garuruwan Samariya fa ba su san abin da allahn ƙasar yake bukata ba. Saboda haka allahn ƙasar ya tura zakoki a cikinsu, waɗanda suke karkashe su, domin mutanen ba su san abin da yake bukata ba.”
english: Therefore they spoke to the king of Assyria, saying, “The nations which you have carried away and placed in the cities of Samaria don’t know the law of the god of the land. Therefore he has sent lions among them; and behold, they kill them, because they don’t know the law of the god of the land.”

hausa: Ku ji ku kuma saurara, kada ku yi girman kai, gama Ubangiji ya yi magana.
english: Hear, and give ear. Don’t be proud, for Yahweh has spoken.

hausa: Farisiyawa da malaman dokoki suka fara yin tunani a zukatansu, “Wane ne wannan mutum da yake saɓo haka? Wa zai iya gafarta zunubai, in ba Allah kaɗai ba?”
english: The scribes and the Pharisees began to reason, saying, “Who is this who speaks blasphemies? Who can forgive sins, but God alone?”

hausa: Ku lura fa, ai, Ubangiji ne ya ba ku Asabbaci; shi ya sa a kan ba ku burodi na kwana biyu, a rana ta shida. Kowa ya kamata yă kasance inda yake a rana ta bakwai; kada kowa yă fita.”
english: Behold, because Yahweh has given you the Sabbath, therefore he gives you on the sixth day the bread of two days. Everyone stay in his place. Let no one go out of his place on the seventh day.”

hausa: “ ‘Dole a farfashe tukunya lakar da mutumin ya taɓa, kuma dole a ɗauraye duk wani abin da aka yi da katako wanda ya taɓa da ruwa.
english: “‘The earthen vessel, which he who has the discharge touches, shall be broken; and every vessel of wood shall be rinsed in water.

hausa: Yesu ya ce, “Yanzu ka gan shi; tabbatacce ma, shi ne yake magana da kai.”
english: Jesus said to him, “You have both seen him, and it is he who speaks with you.”

hausa: “wato, aikin tabanakul da tentinsa tare da murfinsa, maɗauransa, katakansa, sandunansa da tussansa;
english: the tabernacle, its outer covering, its roof, its clasps, its boards, its bars, its pillars, and its sockets;

hausa: Ta haka, za ka sami albarka. Ko da yake ba za su iya biyan ka ba, za a biya ka a ranar tashin masu adalci daga matattu.”
english: and you will be blessed, because they don’t have the resources to repay you. For you will be repaid in the resurrection of the righteous.”

hausa: Cikin ƙoƙarin tserewa daga jirgin, sai masu tuƙin jirgin suka saukar da ɗan ƙaramin jirgin ruwan cikin tekun, suka yi kamar za su saki waɗansu ƙugiyoyi daga sashen gaba na babban jirgin ne.
english: As the sailors were trying to flee out of the ship and had lowered the boat into the sea, pretending that they would lay out anchors from the bow,

hausa: “Ki yi kuka, ya Heshbon, gama an hallaka Ai! Ku tā da murya ku yi kuka, ya mazaunan Rabba! Ku sa tufafin makoki; ku ruga nan da can a cikin katanga, gama Molek zai tafi bauta, tare da firistocinsa da kuma fadawansa.
english: “Wail, Heshbon, for Ai is laid waste! Cry, you daughters of Rabbah! Clothe yourself in sackcloth. Lament, and run back and forth among the fences; for Malcam will go into captivity, his priests and his princes together.

hausa: Bakin mazinaciya rami ne mai zurfi; duk wanda yake a ƙarƙashin fushin Ubangiji zai fāɗa a ciki.
english: The mouth of an adulteress is a deep pit. He who is under Yahweh’s wrath will fall into it.

hausa: A cikin daren, Fir’auna ya aika a kira Musa da Haruna ya ce, “Ku tashi, ku da jama’arku, ku fita daga cikin jama’ata. Ku tafi, ku bauta wa Ubangiji yadda kuka ce.
english: He called for Moses and Aaron by night, and said, “Rise up, get out from among my people, both you and the children of Israel; and go, serve Yahweh, as you have said!

hausa: In ana tuhumarmu ne yau saboda alherin da aka yi wa gurgun nan da kuma yadda aka warkar da shi,
english: if we are examined today concerning a good deed done to a crippled man, by what means this man has been healed,

hausa: Da sassafe suka tashi suka nufi Hamadan Tekowa. Yayinda suka kama hanya, Yehoshafat ya tsaya ya ce, “Ku saurare ni, Yahuda da mutanen Urushalima! Ku amince da Ubangiji Allahnku za a kuwa kafa ku; ku amince da annabawansa za ku kuwa yi nasara.”
english: They rose early in the morning and went out into the wilderness of Tekoa. As they went out, Jehoshaphat stood and said, “Listen to me, Judah and you inhabitants of Jerusalem! Believe in Yahweh your God, so you will be established! Believe his prophets, so you will prosper.”

hausa: Duk kuma wani abin da ake bukata domin haikalin Allahnka, daga ɗakunan ajiya sarki za ka fitar da kuɗin.
english: Whatever more will be needed for the house of your God, which you may have occasion to give, give it out of the king’s treasure house.

hausa: A ranan nan za ku sani ina cikin Uba, ku kuma kuna cikina, ni kuma ina cikinku.
english: In that day you will know that I am in my Father, and you in me, and I in you.

hausa: Raina ya manne maka; hannunka na dama yana riƙe da ni.
english: My soul stays close to you. Your right hand holds me up.

hausa: In kuna da adalci, me kuka ba shi, ko kuma me ya karɓa daga hannunku?
english: If you are righteous, what do you give him? Or what does he receive from your hand?

hausa: Sai ya miƙa ɗayan ɗan ragon, ɗan ragon naɗin, sai Haruna da ’ya’yansa maza suka ɗibiya hannuwansu a kan ɗan ragon.
english: He presented the other ram, the ram of consecration. Aaron and his sons laid their hands on the head of the ram.

hausa: Zai kuwa korin dukan abokan gābanku da suke gabanku, yadda Ubangiji ya faɗa.
english: to thrust out all your enemies from before you, as Yahweh has spoken.

hausa: Sa’ad da kuka ɗaga ido kuka kali sama, kuka ga rana da wata, da taurari, da dukan halittun sama, sai ku kula fa, kada ku jarrabtu, ku ce za ku yi musu sujada, ko ku bauta musu; abubuwan nan Ubangiji Allahnku ne ya rarraba wa dukan al’umman da suke ko’ina a ƙarƙashin sararin sama.
english: and lest you lift up your eyes to the sky, and when you see the sun and the moon and the stars, even all the army of the sky, you are drawn away and worship them, and serve them, which Yahweh your God has allotted to all the peoples under the whole sky.

hausa: Duwatsu suka girgizu a gaban Ubangiji, Wannan na Sinai, a gaban Ubangiji, Allah na Isra’ila.
english: The mountains quaked at Yahweh’s presence, even Sinai at the presence of Yahweh, the God of Israel.

hausa: “Kada ku bar Hezekiya ya ruɗe ku sa’ad da ya ce, ‘Ubangiji zai cece mu.’ Allahn wata al’umma ya taɓa ceci ƙasarsa daga hannun sarkin Assuriya?
english: Beware lest Hezekiah persuade you, saying, “Yahweh will deliver us.” Have any of the gods of the nations delivered their lands from the hand of the king of Assyria?

hausa: Za su kasance a ƙarƙashinka, su ne kuma za su yi dukan hidima ta Tenti, amma kada su je kusa da kayayyakin wuri mai tsarki, ko bagade, in ba haka ba, da kai da su, za ku mutu.
english: They shall keep your commands and the duty of the whole Tent; only they shall not come near to the vessels of the sanctuary and to the altar, that they not die, neither they nor you.

hausa: Sa’an nan za ka sami tagomashi da kuma suna mai kyau a gaban Allah da kuma a gaban mutane.
english: So you will find favor, and good understanding in the sight of God and man.

hausa: Ya Ubangiji, Allahnmu, waɗansu iyayengiji ban da kai sun yi mulki a kanmu, amma sunanka kaɗai muka girmama.
english: Yahweh our God, other lords besides you have had dominion over us, but we will only acknowledge your name.

hausa: Waɗanda Ubangiji ya fansar za su dawo. Za su shiga Sihiyona da waƙoƙi; madawwamin farin ciki zai rufe kansu da rawani. Murna da farin ciki zai cika su, baƙin ciki da nishi zai ɓace.
english: Those ransomed by Yahweh will return, and come with singing to Zion. Everlasting joy shall be on their heads. They will obtain gladness and joy. Sorrow and sighing shall flee away.

hausa: Ni Ubangiji Maɗaukaki, na ce, “Za a baje katangan nan na Babilon mai kauri za a kuma ƙone dogayen ƙyamarenta da wuta; mutane sun wahalar da kansu a banza, al’umma sun yi wahala kawai domin wutar lalata.”
english: Yahweh of Armies says: “The wide walls of Babylon will be utterly overthrown. Her high gates will be burned with fire. The peoples will labor for vanity, and the nations for the fire; and they will be weary.”

hausa: a ranar ashirin da huɗu ga watan shida. A shekara ta biyu ta mulkin Sarki Dariyus,
english: in the twenty-fourth day of the month, in the sixth month, in the second year of Darius the king.

hausa: Saboda haka Gideyon ya mai da sauran Isra’ilawa zuwa tentinsu amma ya riƙe mutum ɗari uku waɗanda suka karɓi guzuri da ƙahonin sauran. To, sansanin Midiyawa yana ƙasa da su a kwarin.
english: So the people took food in their hand, and their trumpets; and he sent all the rest of the men of Israel to their own tents, but retained the three hundred men; and the camp of Midian was beneath him in the valley.

hausa: Ku keɓe wa Ubangiji Allahnku kowane ɗan fari na garkenku na shanu, da na tumaki. Kada ku sa ɗan fari na shanunku aiki, kada kuma ku aske gashin ɗan fari na tumakinku.
english: You shall dedicate all the firstborn males that are born of your herd and of your flock to Yahweh your God. You shall do no work with the firstborn of your herd, nor shear the firstborn of your flock.

hausa: “Akwai abu ɗaya da ba za ku ci ba, wato, nama wanda jininsa yake cikinsa tukuna.
english: But flesh with its life, that is, its blood, you shall not eat.

hausa: Kada ku zama masu ji kawai, ku ruɗi kanku. A maimakon haka ku zama masu yin abin da ta ce.
english: But be doers of the word, and not only hearers, deluding your own selves.

hausa: Yayinda harshen wuta ya yi sama daga bagaden, sai mala’ikan Ubangiji ya haura cikin harshen wutar. Da ganin wannan Manowa da matarsa suka fāɗi da fuskokinsu har ƙasa.
english: For when the flame went up toward the sky from off the altar, Yahweh’s angel ascended in the flame of the altar. Manoah and his wife watched; and they fell on their faces to the ground.

hausa: Amma bin Allah da gamsuwa riba ce mai yawa.
english: But godliness with contentment is great gain.

hausa: Hamada da ƙeƙasasshiyar ƙasa za su yi murna; jeji zai yi farin ciki ya kuma hudo. Kamar fure,
english: The wilderness and the dry land will be glad. The desert will rejoice and blossom like a rose.

hausa: Malami ya ce, “Duba, abin da na gane ke nan. “Na tara abu guda da wani, don in gane tsarin abubuwa,
english: “Behold, I have found this,” says the Preacher, “to one another, to find an explanation

hausa: Amma saboda ka yi haka ka sa abokan gāba suka rena Ubangiji, yaron da aka haifa maka zai mutu.”
english: However, because by this deed you have given great occasion to Yahweh’s enemies to blaspheme, the child also who is born to you will surely die.”

hausa: Annabin ya sami wani mutum ya ce, “Ka buge ni, ina roƙonka.” Sai mutumin ya buge shi, ya ji masa ciwo.
english: Then he found another man, and said, “Please strike me.” The man struck him and wounded him.

hausa: A shekara ta goma sha ɗaya, a watan Bul, wata na takwas ke nan, aka gama haikalin daidai yadda aka tsara shi bisa ga fasalinsa. Solomon ya ɗauki shekara bakwai yana ginin haikalin.
english: In the eleventh year, in the month Bul, which is the eighth month, the house was finished throughout all its parts and according to all its specifications. So he spent seven years building it.

hausa: Sai waɗansu suka fara tattofa masa miyau, suka rufe masa idanu, suka bubbuge shi da hannuwansu, suka ce, “Yi annabci!” Masu gadin kuma suka ɗauke shi, suka yi masa duka.
english: Some began to spit on him, and to cover his face, and to beat him with fists, and to tell him, “Prophesy!” The officers struck him with the palms of their hands.

hausa: “Ya duniya, kada ki ɓoye jinina; bari yă yi kuka a madadina!
english: “Earth, don’t cover my blood. Let my cry have no place to rest.

hausa: Ni, Yohanna, ɗan’uwanku da kuma abokin tarayyarku cikin wahala da mulki, da kuma haƙurin jimrewa da suke namu cikin Yesu, ina can tsibirin Fatmos saboda maganar Allah da kuma saboda shaidar Yesu.
english: I John, your brother and partner with you in the oppression, Kingdom, and perseverance in Christ Jesus, was on the isle that is called Patmos because of God’s Word and the testimony of Jesus Christ.

hausa: Babu riba a kawo mini turare daga Sheba ko rake mai zaƙi daga ƙasa mai nisa? Ba zan karɓi hadayunku na ƙonawa ba; ba na jin daɗin sadakokinku.”
english: To what purpose does frankincense from Sheba come to me, and the sweet cane from a far country? Your burnt offerings are not acceptable, and your sacrifices are not pleasing to me.”

hausa: Sai Haruna ya miƙa hannunsa bisa ruwan Masar, kwaɗi kuwa suka fito, suka mamaye ƙasar Masar.
english: Aaron stretched out his hand over the waters of Egypt; and the frogs came up, and covered the land of Egypt.

hausa: Ka sami ɗaukaka, ya Ubangiji cikin ƙarfinka; za mu rera mu kuma yabi ikonka.
english: Be exalted, Yahweh, in your strength, so we will sing and praise your power.

hausa: Saboda haka ga abin da Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka yana cewa zan ba da Masar ga Nebukadnezzar sarkin Babilon, zai washe dukiyarta. Zai kwashe ya washe ƙasar ganima a matsayin abin biyan sojojinsa.
english: Therefore the Lord Yahweh says: ‘Behold, I will give the land of Egypt to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon. He will carry off her multitude, take her plunder, and take her prey. That will be the wages for his army.

hausa: kamar sa’ad da mai yunwa yana mafarki cewa yana cin abinci, amma sai ya farka, yunwan tana nan; kamar sa’ad da mai ƙishirwa yana mafarki cewa yana shan ruwa, amma sai ya farka yana suma, da ƙishinsa. Haka zai zama da sojoji na dukan al’ummai da suka yi yaƙi da Dutsen Sihiyona.
english: It will be like when a hungry man dreams, and behold, he eats; but he awakes, and his hunger isn’t satisfied; or like when a thirsty man dreams, and behold, he drinks; but he awakes, and behold, he is faint, and he is still thirsty. The multitude of all the nations that fight against Mount Zion will be like that.

hausa: Amsa da tattausar harshe kan kwantar da fushi, amma magana da kakkausan harshe kan kuta fushi.
english: A gentle answer turns away wrath, but a harsh word stirs up anger.

hausa: Da ya tafi, sai Yesu ya ce, “Yanzu ne aka ɗaukaka Ɗan Mutum aka kuma ɗaukaka Allah a cikinsa.
english: When he had gone out, Jesus said, “Now the Son of Man has been glorified, and God has been glorified in him.

hausa: A dukan kwanakin keɓewarsa ga Ubangiji, Banazarin ba zai yi kusa da gawa ba.
english: “‘All the days that he separates himself to Yahweh he shall not go near a dead body.

hausa: Gama yana zuba ido ga birnin nan mai tushe, wanda mai zānen gininsa da kuma mai gininsa Allah ne.
english: For he was looking for the city which has foundations, whose builder and maker is God.

hausa: Sai fadawan sarki suka ce masa, “Barorinka suna a shirye su yi duk abin da ranka yă daɗe, ya zaɓa.”
english: The king’s servants said to the king, “Behold, your servants are ready to do whatever my lord the king chooses.”

hausa: “A ranan nan, in ji Ubangiji Maɗaukaki, turken da aka kafa a tsayayyen wuri zai sumɓule; za a sare shi ya fāɗi, za a kuma datse nauyin da yake rataya a kansa.” Ni Ubangiji na faɗa.
english: “In that day,” says Yahweh of Armies, “the nail that was fastened in a sure place will give way. It will be cut down and fall. The burden that was on it will be cut off, for Yahweh has spoken it.”

hausa: Kashi ɗaya bisa uku na mutanenki za su mutu da annoba ko su mutu da yunwa a cikinki; kashi ɗaya bisa uku takobi ne zai kashe su a waje da katangarki; kashi ɗaya bisa uku kuma zan watsar a iska in kuma fafare su da takobin da aka zāre.
english: A third part of you will die with the pestilence, and they will be consumed with famine within you. A third part will fall by the sword around you. A third part I will scatter to all the winds, and will draw out a sword after them.

hausa: Da suka kai, sai sarki ya tambaye shi, ya ce, “Mikahiya, mu kai yaƙi a kan Ramot Gileyad, ko kada mu kai?” Ya amsa ya ce, “Yaƙe ta, za ka kuwa yi nasara, gama Ubangiji zai ba da ita cikin hannun sarki.”
english: When he had come to the king, the king said to him, “Micaiah, shall we go to Ramoth Gilead to battle, or shall we forbear?” He answered him, “Go up and prosper; and Yahweh will deliver it into the hand of the king.”

hausa: Idanuna sun dushe don yawan kuka, raina na cike da baƙin ciki; zuciyata ta karaya domin mutanena sun hallaka, domin yara da jarirai suna suma a kan hanyoyi a cikin birni.
english: My eyes fail with tears. My heart is troubled. My bile is poured on the earth, because of the destruction of the daughter of my people, because the young children and the infants swoon in the streets of the city.

hausa: Sa’an nan Musa ya ba da kuɗin fansar ga Haruna da ’ya’yansa, yadda maganar Ubangiji ta umarce shi.
english: and Moses gave the redemption money to Aaron and to his sons, according to Yahweh’s word, as Yahweh commanded Moses.

hausa: Yusuf bai ƙara iya daurewa a gaban dukan masu yi masa hidima ba, sai ya yi kuka da ƙarfi ya ce, “Kowa yă tashi daga gabana!” Saboda haka ba kowa a wurin sa’ad da Yusuf ya sanar da kansa ga ’yan’uwansa.
english: Then Joseph couldn’t control himself before all those who stood before him, and he called out, “Cause everyone to go out from me!” No one else stood with him, while Joseph made himself known to his brothers.

hausa: Na faɗa muku wannan, domin in lokacin ya yi, ku tuna na gargaɗe ku. Ban faɗa muku wannan tun da fari ba domin ina tare da ku.
english: But I have told you these things so that when the time comes, you may remember that I told you about them. I didn’t tell you these things from the beginning, because I was with you.

hausa: Ubangiji Maɗaukaki yana tare da mu; Allah na Yaƙub ne kagararmu. Sela
english: Yahweh of Armies is with us. The God of Jacob is our refuge. Selah.

hausa: Mai tsaro kuwa yana tsaye a kan hasumiya a Yezireyel, sai ya hangi rundunar Yehu sa’ad da yake zuwa. Ya ce, “Na ga wata runduna.” Sai Yoram ya umarta, “Nemi mahayin doki a aike shi yă tarye su, yă kuma tambaye su, ‘Lafiya?’ ”
english: Now the watchman was standing on the tower in Jezreel, and he spied the company of Jehu as he came, and said, “I see a company.” Joram said, “Take a horseman, and send to meet them, and let him say, ‘Is it peace?’”

hausa: “Bari maƙiyana su zama kamar mugaye, masu gāba da ni kuma su zama kamar marasa adalci.
english: “Let my enemy be as the wicked. Let him who rises up against me be as the unrighteous.

hausa: Sai ya ce mini, “Wannan ce maganar Ubangiji ga Zerubbabel. ‘Ba ta wurin ƙarfi ba, ko ta wurin iko, sai dai ta wurin Ruhuna,’ in ji Ubangiji Maɗaukaki.
english: Then he answered and spoke to me, saying, “This is Yahweh’s word to Zerubbabel, saying, ‘Not by might, nor by power, but by my Spirit,’ says Yahweh of Armies.

hausa: Sai Sarki Dawuda ya aika da saƙo zuwa wurin Zadok da Abiyatar, firistoci, ya ce, “Ku tambayi dattawan Yahuda, ‘Me ya sa ku ne za ku zama na ƙarshe a yin tunanin komar da sarki zuwa fada, da yake abin da ake faɗi ko’ina a Isra’ila ya kai kunnen sarki a mazauninsa?
english: King David sent to Zadok and to Abiathar the priests, saying, “Speak to the elders of Judah, saying, ‘Why are you the last to bring the king back to his house, since the speech of all Israel has come to the king, to return him to his house?

hausa: Duk wanda ya rena maƙwabci ya yi zunubi, amma mai albarka ne wanda yake alheri ga mabukata.
english: He who despises his neighbor sins, but he who has pity on the poor is blessed.

hausa: To, an yi waɗansu ’yan’uwa bakwai. Na fari ya auri wata mace, ya mutu ba ’ya’ya.
english: There were therefore seven brothers. The first took a wife, and died childless.

hausa: Sai Yesu ya amsa ya ce, “Yanyawa suna da ramummuka, tsuntsayen sararin sama suna da sheƙuna, amma Ɗan Mutum ba shi da wurin da zai sa kansa.”
english: Jesus said to him, “The foxes have holes and the birds of the sky have nests, but the Son of Man has nowhere to lay his head.”

hausa: “Mun sha kunya saboda zargin da ake yi mana kunya ta rufe mu, domin baƙi sun shiga tsarkakan wurare na gidan Ubangiji.”
english: “We are confounded because we have heard reproach. Confusion has covered our faces, for strangers have come into the sanctuaries of Yahweh’s house.”

hausa: Sai suka tafi da sauri, suka tarar da Maryamu da Yusuf, da kuma jaririn kwance a kwami.
english: They came with haste and found both Mary and Joseph, and the baby was lying in the feeding trough.

hausa: Sai sarki da dukan Isra’ila, suka miƙa hadayu a gaban Ubangiji.
english: The king, and all Israel with him, offered sacrifice before Yahweh.

hausa: Yesu ya ce, “Abincina shi ne, in aikata nufin wannan da ya aiko ni, in kuma gama aikinsa.
english: Jesus said to them, “My food is to do the will of him who sent me and to accomplish his work.

hausa: “Ka haura zuwa wurin Hilkiya babban firist ka sa yă shirya kuɗin da aka kawo a haikalin Ubangiji, wanda masu tsaron ƙofa suka tara daga mutane.
english: “Go up to Hilkiah the high priest, that he may count the money which is brought into Yahweh’s house, which the keepers of the threshold have gathered of the people.

hausa: Hafsoshin da suka kashe shi kuwa su ne Yozabad ɗan Shimeyat da Yehozabad ɗan Shomer. Ya mutu, aka kuma binne shi tare da kakanninsa a Birnin Dawuda. Sai Amaziya ɗansa ya gāje shi a matsayin sarki.
english: For Jozacar the son of Shimeath, and Jehozabad the son of Shomer, his servants, struck him, and he died; and they buried him with his fathers in David’s city; and Amaziah his son reigned in his place.

hausa: “Sa’ad da kuka shiga wani gida, ku fara da cewa, ‘Salama a gare ku mutanen gida.’
english: Into whatever house you enter, first say, ‘Peace be to this house.’

hausa: Gara kada ka yi alkawari, da ka yi amma ba ka cika ba.
english: It is better that you should not vow, than that you should vow and not pay.

hausa: Na ga cewa haikalin yana da ɗagaggen tushe kewaye da shi, wanda ya zama harsashin ɗakunan da suke gefe. Tsawonsa kara guda ne mai tsawon kamu shida.
english: I saw also that the house had a raised base all around. The foundations of the side rooms were a full reed of six great cubits.

hausa: ta yi ciki, ta kuma haifi ɗa, wanda aka kira Er.
english: She conceived, and bore a son; and he named him Er.

hausa: Sai muka juya muka kama hanya, muka nufi hamada, ta hanyar Jan Teku yadda Ubangiji ya umarce ni. Da daɗewa muka yi ta yawo kewaye da ƙasar tudun Seyir.
english: Then we turned, and took our journey into the wilderness by the way to the Red Sea, as Yahweh spoke to me; and we encircled Mount Seir many days.

hausa: Saboda haka yayinda Yowab ya kai yaƙi kusa da birnin, sai tura Uriya a inda ya sani akwai jarumawan Ammon na gaske.
english: When Joab kept watch on the city, he assigned Uriah to the place where he knew that valiant men were.

hausa: Kamar birni da katangarsa sun rushe haka yake da mutumin da ba ya iya danne fushinsa.
english: Like a city that is broken down and without walls is a man whose spirit is without restraint.

hausa: Amma Bulus ya karkaɗe macijin a cikin wuta, bai kuwa ji wani ciwo ba.
english: However he shook off the creature into the fire, and wasn’t harmed.

hausa: to, zan yi muku wannan. Zan kawo muku abin bantsoro, cututtuka da zazzaɓin da zai lalatar da idonku, yă kuma sa ranku a wahala. Za ku shuka iri a banza, domin abokan gābanku ne za su ci.
english: I also will do this to you: I will appoint terror over you, even consumption and fever, that shall consume the eyes, and make the soul to pine away. You will sow your seed in vain, for your enemies will eat it.

hausa: Ku juya ku gudu, ku ɓuya a cikin kogwanni masu zurfi, ku da kuke zama a Dedan, gama zan kawo masifa a kan Isuwa a lokacin da zan hukunta shi.
english: Flee! Turn back! Dwell in the depths, inhabitants of Dedan; for I will bring the calamity of Esau on him when I visit him.

hausa: Za su sari kurminta,” in ji Ubangiji, “ko da yake yana maƙare da itatuwa. Sun fi fāra yawa, ba su ƙidayuwa.
english: They will cut down her forest,” says Yahweh, “though it can’t be searched; because they are more than the locusts, and are innumerable.

hausa: Ya faɗi wannan ne lokacin da yake koyarwa a cikin majami’a a Kafarnahum.
english: He said these things in the synagogue, as he taught in Capernaum.

hausa: Ba kai ba ne mutumin Masar nan da ya haddasa tawaye har ya yi jagorar ’yan ta’ada dubu huɗu zuwa hamada a shekarun baya?”
english: Aren’t you then the Egyptian who before these days stirred up to sedition and led out into the wilderness the four thousand men of the Assassins?”

hausa: Maganar Ubangiji ta zo mini, ta ce,
english: Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

hausa: Kada ka ji tsoronsu, gama ina tare da kai kuma zan kiyaye ka,” in ji Ubangiji.
english: Don’t be afraid because of them, for I am with you to rescue you,” says Yahweh.

hausa: Ba kalmomi kurum ba ne dominku, amma har ranku ma. Ta wurinsu za ku yi tsawon rai a ƙasar da kuke haye Urdun ku ci gādonta.”
english: For it is no vain thing for you, because it is your life, and through this thing you shall prolong your days in the land, where you go over the Jordan to possess it.”

hausa: Kai, kun ba ni tsoro, don ya zama kamar duk wahalar da na yi a kanku banza ne!
english: I am afraid for you, that I might have wasted my labor for you.

hausa: Ga shi kun ƙudura, sai kun kashe ni, ni mutumin da ya faɗa muku gaskiyar da na ji daga Allah. Ibrahim bai yi irin waɗannan abubuwa ba.
english: But now you seek to kill me, a man who has told you the truth which I heard from God. Abraham didn’t do this.

hausa: Amma matar ta ce, “Da Ubangiji yana nufin kashe mu ne, da ba zai karɓi hadaya ta ƙonawa da hadaya ta hatsi daga hannunmu, ko yă nuna mana dukan waɗannan abubuwa ko abin da ya gaya mana ba.”
english: But his wife said to him, “If Yahweh were pleased to kill us, he wouldn’t have received a burnt offering and a meal offering at our hand, and he wouldn’t have shown us all these things, nor would he have told us such things as these at this time.”

hausa: “Kamar yadda Uba ya ƙaunace ni, haka ni ma na ƙaunace ku. To, fa, ku kasance cikin ƙaunata.
english: Even as the Father has loved me, I also have loved you. Remain in my love.

hausa: Saboda haka Dawuda ya tattara dukan Isra’ilawa, daga Kogin Shihor a Masar zuwa Lebo Hamat, don su kawo akwatin alkawarin Allah daga Kiriyat Yeyarim.
english: So David assembled all Israel together, from the Shihor River of Egypt even to the entrance of Hamath, to bring God’s ark from Kiriath Jearim.

hausa: Daga cikin wane ne aka haifi ƙanƙara? Wane ne ya haifi jaura daga sammai
english: Whose womb did the ice come out of? Who has given birth to the gray frost of the sky?

hausa: Sa’an nan Isra’ila ta aiki jakadu zuwa ga sarkin Edom cewa, ‘Ka ba mu izini mu ratsa ƙasarka,’ amma sarkin Edom bai saurara ba. Suka kuma aika wa sarkin Mowab, shi ma ya ƙi. Saboda haka Isra’ila ta zauna a Kadesh.
english: then Israel sent messengers to the king of Edom, saying, ‘Please let me pass through your land;’ but the king of Edom didn’t listen. In the same way, he sent to the king of Moab, but he refused; so Israel stayed in Kadesh.

hausa: Ba shakka dole a sami bambanci a tsakaninku don a nuna wa Allah ya amince da shi a cikinku.
english: For there also must be factions among you, that those who are approved may be revealed among you.

hausa: Zan hukunta Bel a Babilon, in sa ya yi aman abin da ya haɗiye. Ƙasashe ba za su ƙara bumbuntowa wurinsa ba. Katangan Babilon kuwa za tă rushe!
english: I will execute judgment on Bel in Babylon, and I will bring out of his mouth that which he has swallowed up. The nations will not flow any more to him. Yes, the wall of Babylon will fall.

hausa: Sai ku yi hankali don ku yi abin da Ubangiji Allahnku ya umarce ku; kada ku juya dama ko hagu.
english: You shall observe to do therefore as Yahweh your God has commanded you. You shall not turn away to the right hand or to the left.

hausa: Sai ya ci gaba, “In kin yarda, ki yi magana da Sarki Solomon, gama ba zai ƙi jinki ba, ki ce yă ba ni yarinyan nan, Abishag, mutuniyar Shunam, tă zama matata.”
english: He said, “Please speak to Solomon the king (for he will not tell you ‘no’), that he give me Abishag the Shunammite as wife.”

hausa: Yanzu ku la’anannu ne. Ba za ku daina zama mana masu yankan itace da kuma masu ɗebo ruwa domin haikalin Allahnmu ba.”
english: Now therefore you are cursed, and some of you will never fail to be slaves, both wood cutters and drawers of water for the house of my God.”

hausa: Sa’ad da Al’ummai suka ji haka, sai suka yi farin ciki suka ɗaukaka maganar Ubangiji; kuma duk waɗanda aka zaɓa don samun rai madawwami, suka gaskata.
english: As the Gentiles heard this, they were glad and glorified the word of God. As many as were appointed to eternal life believed.

hausa: Sarki mai iko ne, yana ƙaunar adalci ka kafa gaskiya; a cikin Yaƙub ka yi abin da yake mai adalci da kuma daidai.
english: The King’s strength also loves justice. You establish equity. You execute justice and righteousness in Jacob.

hausa: Tare da hadayarsa don zumunci ta godiya, zai miƙa dunƙulen burodin da aka yi da yisti.
english: He shall offer his offering with the sacrifice of his peace offerings for thanksgiving with cakes of leavened bread.

hausa: Yowab wanda ake ce mamarsa Zeruhiya tare da waɗansu mutanen Dawuda suka fito suka haɗu da su tafkin Gibeyon, Suka zauna, waɗannan a wannan gefe, waɗancan a wancan gefe.
english: Joab the son of Zeruiah and David’s servants went out, and met them by the pool of Gibeon; and they sat down, the one on the one side of the pool and the other on the other side of the pool.

hausa: Da suka dawo daga kabarin, sai suka faɗa wa Sha Ɗayan nan da sauransu, dukan waɗannan abubuwa.
english: returned from the tomb, and told all these things to the eleven and to all the rest.

hausa: ’Ya’yana ƙaunatattu, kada mu yi ƙauna da fatar baki kawai, sai dai mu nuna ta ta wurin aikatawa da kuma gaskiya.
english: My little children, let’s not love in word only, or with the tongue only, but in deed and truth.

hausa: “Ni, hikima, ina zama tare da hankali; ina da sani da iya rarrabewa.
english: “I, wisdom, have made prudence my dwelling. Find out knowledge and discretion.

hausa: Ta kuma tilasta wa kowa, manya da yara, mawadata da matalauta, ’yantattu da bayi, don a yi musu alama a hannun dama ko a goshi,
english: He causes all, the small and the great, the rich and the poor, and the free and the slave, to be given marks on their right hands or on their foreheads;

hausa: Bari idanunsu su duhunta don kada su iya gani, bayansu kuma yă tanƙware har abada.”
english: Let their eyes be darkened, that they may not see. Always keep their backs bent.”

hausa: Nuhu ya yi kome kamar yadda Allah ya umarce shi.
english: Thus Noah did. He did all that God commanded him.

hausa: Don ya san saboda sonkai ne manyan firistoci suka ba da Yesu a gare shi.
english: For he perceived that for envy the chief priests had delivered him up.

hausa: Amma Isra’ilawa ba su kai musu hari ba domin shugabanninsu sun rantse musu da sunan Ubangiji, Allah na Isra’ila. Mutane Isra’ila duka kuwa suka yi gunaguni a kan shugabannin.
english: The children of Israel didn’t strike them, because the princes of the congregation had sworn to them by Yahweh, the God of Israel. All the congregation murmured against the princes.

hausa: Sai ya tashi ya ɗauki keken yaƙinsa ya tafi Yezireyel gama Yoram yana hutawa a can. Ga kuma Ahaziya sarkin Yahuda ya je don yă gan shi.
english: So Jehu rode in a chariot and went to Jezreel, for Joram lay there. Ahaziah king of Judah had come down to see Joram.

hausa: “Ga ma’anar misalin, irin, shi ne maganar Allah.
english: “Now the parable is this: The seed is the word of God.

hausa: mu kuwa mu mai da halinmu ga yin addu’a da kuma hidimar maganar Allah.”
english: But we will continue steadfastly in prayer and in the ministry of the word.”

hausa: Taron gaba ɗaya na Yahuda suka yi farin ciki, tare da firistoci da kuma Lawiyawa da dukan waɗanda suka taru daga Isra’ila, har ma da baƙi waɗanda suka zo daga Isra’ila da waɗanda suke zama a Yahuda.
english: All the assembly of Judah, with the priests and the Levites, and all the assembly who came out of Israel, and the foreigners who came out of the land of Israel and who lived in Judah, rejoiced.

hausa: Tare da surukanta biyu suka bar inda suka zauna suka kuma kama hanya da za tă komar da su zuwa ƙasar Yahuda.
english: She went out of the place where she was, and her two daughters-in-law with her. They went on the way to return to the land of Judah.

hausa: Sai sarki ya aiki Yehudi ya kawo littafin daga ɗakin Elishama magatakarda ya kuma karanta wa sarki da kuma dukan fadawan da suke tsaye kusa da shi.
english: So the king sent Jehudi to get the scroll, and he took it out of the room of Elishama the scribe. Jehudi read it in the hearing of the king, and in the hearing of all the princes who stood beside the king.

hausa: Kada ka yar da ni sa’ad da na tsufa; kada ka yashe ni sa’ad da ƙarfina ya ƙare.
english: Don’t reject me in my old age. Don’t forsake me when my strength fails.

hausa: Da kai da gidanka, za ku iya cin abin da ya rage a ko’ina, gama ladan aikinku ne a Tentin Sujada.
english: You may eat it anywhere, you and your households, for it is your reward in return for your service in the Tent of Meeting.

hausa: Suka taru a Urushalima a wata na uku na shekara ta goma sha biyar ta mulkin Asa.
english: So they gathered themselves together at Jerusalem in the third month, in the fifteenth year of Asa’s reign.

hausa: maganar mutumin da ya saurari maganar Allah, wanda yake da sani daga Mafi Ɗaukaka, wanda yake ganin wahayi daga Maɗaukaki, wanda ya fāɗi rubda ciki, wanda kuma idanunsa suna a buɗe.
english: he says, who hears the words of God, knows the knowledge of the Most High, and who sees the vision of the Almighty, falling down, and having his eyes open:

hausa: Na tashi kafin fitowar rana na kuma yi kukan neman taimako; na sa zuciyata a maganarka.
english: I rise before dawn and cry for help. I put my hope in your words.

hausa: Ubangiji ya ce, “Ta haka mutanen Isra’ila za su ci ƙazantaccen abinci a cikin al’ummai inda zan kore su in kai.”
english: Yahweh said, “Even thus will the children of Israel eat their bread unclean, among the nations where I will drive them.”

hausa: Kada ka kawar da shaidar iyaka ta dā ko ka ɗiba gonar marayu,
english: Don’t move the ancient boundary stone. Don’t encroach on the fields of the fatherless,

hausa: Na yi shiru; ba zan buɗe bakina ba, gama kai ne wanda ka aikata wannan.
english: I was mute. I didn’t open my mouth, because you did it.

hausa: Ni fa, ina zan sa kaina saboda kunya? Kai kuma za ka zama kamar wani mugun wawa a Isra’ila. Ina roƙonka ka yi wa sarki magana; ba zai hana ni aurenka ba.”
english: As for me, where would I carry my shame? And as for you, you will be as one of the fools in Israel. Now therefore, please speak to the king; for he will not withhold me from you.”

hausa: Ana cikin haka, sai Yowab ya yi yaƙi da Rabba na Ammonawa, ya kuma ƙwace babban birnin.
english: Now Joab fought against Rabbah of the children of Ammon, and took the royal city.

hausa: Sa’an nan Zerubbabel ɗan Sheyaltiyel da Yeshuwa ɗan Yozadak suka yi shiri suka kama aikin sāke gina gidan Allah a Urushalima. Annabawan Allah kuwa suna tare da su, suna taimakonsu.
english: Then Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, and Jeshua the son of Jozadak rose up and began to build God’s house which is at Jerusalem; and with them were the prophets of God, helping them.

hausa: “Sai sarki Kudu zai yi ƙarfi ƙwarai, amma ɗaya daga cikin komandodinsa zai yi ƙarfi fiye da shi, zai kuma yi mulki masarautarsa da iko mai girma.
english: “The king of the south will be strong. One of his princes will become stronger than him, and have dominion. His dominion will be a great dominion.

english: He restores my soul. He guides me in the paths of righteousness for his name’s sake.

english: Bless those who persecute you; bless, and don’t curse.

english: You went out for the salvation of your people, for the salvation of your anointed. You crushed the head of the land of wickedness. You stripped them head to foot. Selah.

english: They rose up some time in the morning, and swore an oath to one another. Isaac sent them away, and they departed from him in peace.

english: Many of those who practiced magical arts brought their books together and burned them in the sight of all. They counted their price, and found it to be fifty thousand pieces of silver.

hausa: Da Ubangiji ya ga Musa ya matso don yă duba, sai Allah ya yi kira daga cikin ƙaramin itacen ya ce, “Musa! Musa!” Sai Musa ya amsa ya ce, “Ga ni.”
english: When Yahweh saw that he came over to see, God called to him out of the middle of the bush, and said, “Moses! Moses!” He said, “Here I am.”

hausa: “Ka faɗa wa gidan ’yan tawayen nan, ‘Ba ka san abin da waɗannan abubuwa suke nufi ba?’ Ka faɗa musu cewa, ‘Sarkin Babilon ya tafi Urushalima ya tafi da sarkinta da kuma manyan garinta, ya dawo da su Babilon.
english: “Say now to the rebellious house, ‘Don’t you know what these things mean?’ Tell them, ‘Behold, the king of Babylon came to Jerusalem, and took its king, and its princes, and brought them to him to Babylon.

hausa: Yanzu fa, ya ku ’ya’yana ƙaunatattu, sai ku ci gaba a cikinsa, domin sa’ad da ya bayyana, mu iya tsaya gabagadi babu kunya a dawowarsa.
english: Now, little children, remain in him, that when he appears, we may have boldness and not be ashamed before him at his coming.

hausa: Sa’an nan ka aika da saƙo zuwa wurin sarakunan Edom, Mowab, Ammon, Taya da Sidon ta bakin jakadu waɗanda suka zo Urushalima wurin Zedekiya sarkin Yahuda.
english: Then send them to the king of Edom, to the king of Moab, to the king of the children of Ammon, to the king of Tyre, and to the king of Sidon, by the hand of the messengers who come to Jerusalem to Zedekiah king of Judah.

hausa: “Edom tana can, sarakunanta da dukan yerimanta; duk da ikonsu, sun kwanta tare da waɗanda aka kashe da takobi. Suna kwance tare da marasa kaciya, tare da waɗanda suka gangara zuwa rami.
english: “There is Edom, her kings, and all her princes, who in their might are laid with those who are slain by the sword. They will lie with the uncircumcised, and with those who go down to the pit.

hausa: “A banza na hukunta mutanenku; ba su yi gyara ba. Takobinku ya cinye annabawanku kamar zaki mai jin yunwa.
english: “I have struck your children in vain. They received no correction. Your own sword has devoured your prophets, like a destroying lion.

hausa: Ya tsaya tsakanin matattu da masu rai, annobar kuwa ta tsaya.
english: He stood between the dead and the living; and the plague was stayed.

english: He said, “Bring the mantle that is on you, and hold it.” She held it; and he measured six measures of barley, and laid it on her; then he went into the city.

english: Or can one walk on hot coals, and his feet not be scorched?

hausa: Yesu ya ce mata, “Ɗan’uwanki zai sāke tashi.”
english: Jesus said to her, “Your brother will rise again.”

english: Now when all the people were baptized, Jesus also had been baptized and was praying. The sky was opened,

english: which none of the rulers of this world has known. For had they known it, they wouldn’t have crucified the Lord of glory.

hausa: Kuka rabu da Dutsen da ya zama mahaifi gare ku; kuka manta da Allahn da ya haife ku.
english: Of the Rock who became your father, you are unmindful, and have forgotten God who gave you birth.

english: that you may crush them, dipping your foot in blood, that the tongues of your dogs may have their portion from your enemies.”

english: He said, “Come in, you blessed of Yahweh. Why do you stand outside? For I have prepared the house, and room for the camels.”

hausa: Sai Ubangiji ya sa lokaci ya ce, “Gobe Ubangiji zai yi wannan a ƙasar.”
english: Yahweh appointed a set time, saying, “Tomorrow Yahweh shall do this thing in the land.”

hausa: Ya mutunta Abram sosai saboda ita, Abram kuwa ya mallaki tumaki da shanu, da jakuna maza da mata, da bayi maza da mata, da kuma raƙuma.
english: He dealt well with Abram for her sake. He had sheep, cattle, male donkeys, male servants, female servants, female donkeys, and camels.

hausa: “Ya ke birni mai shan azaba, wadda hadari ya bulale ki ba a kuma ta’azantar da ke ba, zan gina ke da duwatsu turkuwoyis, zan kafa harsashenki da duwatsun saffaya.
english: “You afflicted, tossed with storms, and not comforted, behold, I will set your stones in beautiful colors, and lay your foundations with sapphires.

hausa: Laifi ke nan ne na yi da na ƙasƙantar da kaina, don a ɗaga ku zuwa babban matsayi ta wurin yin muku wa’azin bisharar Allah kyauta?
english: Or did I commit a sin in humbling myself that you might be exalted, because I preached to you God’s Good News free of charge?

hausa: waɗanda bakunansu sun cika da ƙarya, waɗanda hannuwansu na dama masu ruɗu ne.
english: whose mouths speak deceit, whose right hand is a right hand of falsehood.

english: When the priests enter in, then they shall not go out of the holy place into the outer court until they lay their garments in which they minister there; for they are holy. Then they shall put on other garments, and shall approach that which is for the people.”

english: They lifted up their voices and wept again; then Orpah kissed her mother-in-law, but Ruth stayed with her.

english: Therefore a division arose again among the Jews because of these words.

english: The earth is given into the hand of the wicked. He covers the faces of its judges. If not he, then who is it?

hausa: Inda ba shanu, wurin sa wa dabbobi abinci zai kasance ba kome, amma daga ƙarfin saniya ce yalwar girbi kan fito.
english: Where no oxen are, the crib is clean, but much increase is by the strength of the ox.

english: Jesus, knowing their thoughts, said, “Why do you think evil in your hearts?

english: Forty days were used for him, for that is how many days it takes to embalm. The Egyptians wept for Israel for seventy days.

english: and to give relief to you who are afflicted with us when the Lord Jesus is revealed from heaven with his mighty angels in flaming fire,

hausa: Kai kuma, ɗana, ka yi ƙarfi cikin alherin da yake cikin Kiristi Yesu.
english: You therefore, my child, be strengthened in the grace that is in Christ Jesus.

english: He made from one blood every nation of men to dwell on all the surface of the earth, having determined appointed seasons and the boundaries of their dwellings,

hausa: Amma taron mutane suka ji labari, sai suka bi shi. Ya marabce su, kuma ya yi musu magana a kan mulkin Allah, ya kuma warkar da masu bukatar warkarwa.
english: But the multitudes, perceiving it, followed him. He welcomed them, spoke to them of God’s Kingdom, and he cured those who needed healing.

english: “‘“All the inhabitants of Egypt will know that I am Yahweh, because they have been a staff of reed to the house of Israel.

english: ‘If evil comes on us—the sword, judgment, pestilence, or famine—we will stand before this house, and before you (for your name is in this house), and cry to you in our affliction, and you will hear and save.’

english: I said to you, “I am Yahweh your God. You shall not fear the gods of the Amorites, in whose land you dwell.” But you have not listened to my voice.’”

english: “‘If his offering is a burnt offering from the herd, he shall offer a male without defect. He shall offer it at the door of the Tent of Meeting, that he may be accepted before Yahweh.

english: You shall require from them the number of the bricks which they made before. You shall not diminish anything of it, for they are idle. Therefore they cry, saying, ‘Let’s go and sacrifice to our God.’

english: Israel stretched out his right hand, and laid it on Ephraim’s head, who was the younger, and his left hand on Manasseh’s head, guiding his hands knowingly, for Manasseh was the firstborn.

english: He called to himself his twelve disciples, and gave them authority over unclean spirits, to cast them out, and to heal every disease and every sickness.

english: For the unbelieving husband is sanctified in the wife, and the unbelieving wife is sanctified in the husband. Otherwise your children would be unclean, but now they are holy.

english: We also all once lived among them in the lusts of our flesh, doing the desires of the flesh and of the mind, and were by nature children of wrath, even as the rest.

english: but now we have lost our appetite. There is nothing at all except this manna to look at.”

english: A contemplation by Asaph. God, why have you rejected us forever? Why does your anger smolder against the sheep of your pasture?

english: In the evening, he took Leah his daughter, and brought her to Jacob. He went in to her.

english: Eber lived four hundred thirty years after he became the father of Peleg, and became the father of more sons and daughters.

hausa: “Wani manomi ya fita domin ya shuka irinsa. Da yana watsa irin, sai waɗansu suka fāɗi a kan hanya, aka tattaka su, tsuntsayen sararin sama kuma suka cinye su.
english: “The farmer went out to sow his seed. As he sowed, some fell along the road, and it was trampled under foot, and the birds of the sky devoured it.

english: The younger of them said to his father, ‘Father, give me my share of your property.’ So he divided his livelihood between them.

english: Your gates also shall be open continually; they shall not be shut day nor night, that men may bring to you the wealth of the nations, and their kings led captive.

english: Now a certain Jew named Apollos, an Alexandrian by race, an eloquent man, came to Ephesus. He was mighty in the Scriptures.

english: Then they asked him, “Tell us, please, for whose cause this evil is on us. What is your occupation? Where do you come from? What is your country? Of what people are you?”

english: So neither I, nor my brothers, nor my servants, nor the men of the guard who followed me took off our clothes. Everyone took his weapon to the water.

english: Yahweh’s precepts are right, rejoicing the heart. Yahweh’s commandment is pure, enlightening the eyes.

hausa: “Amma itacen zaitun ya ce, ‘In bar mai nawa, wanda da shi ake girmama alloli da mutane, don in zo in yi ta fama da itatuwa?’
english: “But the olive tree said to them, ‘Should I stop producing my oil, with which they honor God and man by me, and go to wave back and forth over the trees?’

english: I will scatter the Egyptians among the nations and disperse them through the countries. Then they will know that I am Yahweh.’”
