english: So I saw the wicked buried. Indeed they came also from holiness. They went and were forgotten in the city where they did this. This also is vanity.

hausa: ya kuma kawo bunsuru ɗaya domin hadaya don zunubi;
english: one male goat for a sin offering;

hausa: Sa rai da mutum ke yi kan taimake shi sa’ad da yake ciwo, amma in ya karai, to, tasa ta ƙare.
english: A man’s spirit will sustain him in sickness, but a crushed spirit, who can bear?

hausa: Gileyad mugu ne? Mutanensa mutanen banza ne! Suna miƙa bijimai a Gilgal? Bagadansu za su zama tsibin duwatsu. A gonar da aka nome.
english: If Gilead is wicked, surely they are worthless. In Gilgal they sacrifice bulls. Indeed, their altars are like heaps in the furrows of the field.

hausa: Amma bakina zai ƙarfafa ku; ta’aziyyar da za tă fito daga bakina za tă kawar muku da ɓacin zuciyarku.
english: but I would strengthen you with my mouth. The solace of my lips would relieve you.

hausa: “Matsattsaku tana da ’ya’ya mata biyu. Suna kuka suna cewa, ‘Ba ni! Ba ni!’ “Akwai abubuwa uku da ba sa taɓa ƙoshi, guda huɗu ba sa taɓa cewa, ‘Ya isa!’
english: “The leech has two daughters: ‘Give, give.’ “There are three things that are never satisfied; four that don’t say, ‘Enough!’:

hausa: Ya ce, “Wani mutum mai martaba ya tafi wata ƙasa mai nisa don a naɗa shi sarki sa’an nan ya dawo.
english: He said therefore, “A certain nobleman went into a far country to receive for himself a kingdom and to return.

hausa: Amma macen da ta fito daga Tekowa ta ce, “Ranka yă daɗe, sarki! Bari alhakin shari’arka yă kasance a kaina da gidan mahaifina, kai sarki da gidan mulkinka, ba ku da laifi a ciki.”
english: The woman of Tekoa said to the king, “My lord, O king, may the iniquity be on me, and on my father’s house; and may the king and his throne be guiltless.”

hausa: Da suka ga tauraron, sai suka yi farin ciki ƙwarai.
english: When they saw the star, they rejoiced with exceedingly great joy.

hausa: Amma na janye hannuna, kuma saboda sunana na yi abin da zai kiyaye shi daga ƙazantuwa a idanun al’umman da a idonsu na fisshe su.
english: Nevertheless I withdrew my hand and worked for my name’s sake, that it should not be profaned in the sight of the nations, in whose sight I brought them out.

hausa: Ba zai zama kamar irin alkawarin da na yi da kakanni-kakanninsu sa’ad da na kama hannunsu don in fitar da su daga Masar ba, domin ba su yi aminci da alkawarina ba, sai na juya musu baya, in ji Ubangiji.
english: not according to the covenant that I made with their fathers in the day that I took them by the hand to lead them out of the land of Egypt; for they didn’t continue in my covenant, and I disregarded them,” says the Lord.

hausa: “A cikinta ba za a ƙara jin jariri ya rayu na ’yan kwanaki kawai ba, ko kuwa wani tsohon da bai cika kwanakinsa ba; duk wanda ya mutu yana da shekaru ɗari za a ce ya mutu a kurciya ne kawai; duk wanda bai kai ɗari ba za a ɗauka la’antacce ne.
english: “No more will there be an infant who only lives a few days, nor an old man who has not filled his days; for the child will die one hundred years old, and the sinner being one hundred years old will be accursed.

hausa: wato, Allah ya sulhunta duniya zuwa kansa ta wurin Kiristi, ba ya lissafta zunuban mutane a kansu. Ya kuma danƙa mana saƙon sulhu.
english: namely, that God was in Christ reconciling the world to himself, not reckoning to them their trespasses, and having committed to us the word of reconciliation.

hausa: Bikin Ƙetarewan Yahudawa ya yi kusa.
english: Now the Passover, the feast of the Jews, was at hand.

hausa: Bari Ubangiji yă sa yă sami jinƙai daga Ubangiji a wancan ranar! Ka sani sarai yadda ya taimake ni a hanyoyi dabam-dabam a Afisa.
english: (the Lord grant to him to find the Lord’s mercy in that day); and in how many things he served at Ephesus, you know very well.

hausa: Suka yanka ɗan ragon Bikin Ƙetarewa a rana ta goma sha huɗu na wata na biyu. Firistoci da Lawiyawa suka ji kunya suka tsarkake kansu, suka kawo hadayun ƙonawa a haikalin Ubangiji.
english: Then they killed the Passover on the fourteenth day of the second month. The priests and the Levites were ashamed, and sanctified themselves, and brought burnt offerings into Yahweh’s house.

hausa: Taron suka matso, suka ce roƙi Bilatus yă yi musu abin da ya saba yi.
english: The multitude, crying aloud, began to ask him to do as he always did for them.

hausa: Na bauta wa Ubangiji da matuƙar tawali’u har da hawaye, da gwagwarmaya iri-irin da na sha game da makircin Yahudawa.
english: serving the Lord with all humility, with many tears, and with trials which happened to me by the plots of the Jews;

hausa: Ta haka Shawulu da ’ya’yansa maza uku suka mutu, dukan gidansa kuwa suka mutu tare.
english: So Saul died with his three sons; and all his house died together.

hausa: Na biye da su su ne mutanen Benyamin. Shugaban mutanensu kuwa Abidan ɗan Gideyoni.
english: “The tribe of Benjamin: the prince of the children of Benjamin shall be Abidan the son of Gideoni.

hausa: Sa’an nan Yehu ya je Yezireyel. Sa’ad da Yezebel ta sami labari, sai ta sha kwalliya ta gyara gashin kanta, ta zauna tana kallo daga taga.
english: When Jehu had come to Jezreel, Jezebel heard of it; and she painted her eyes, and adorned her head, and looked out at the window.

hausa: Yesu ya amsa ya ce, “Ni ne hanya, ni ne gaskiya, ni ne kuma rai. Ba mai zuwa wurin Uba sai dai ta wurina.
english: Jesus said to him, “I am the way, the truth, and the life. No one comes to the Father, except through me.

hausa: Zan nuna abubuwan banmamaki a cikin sammai da kuma a kan duniya, za a ga jini da wuta da murtukewar hayaƙi.
english: I will show wonders in the heavens and on the earth: blood, fire, and pillars of smoke.

hausa: Sai Ubangiji ya yi ta zuba kibiritu a bisa Sodom da Gomorra daga sama.
english: Then Yahweh rained on Sodom and on Gomorrah sulfur and fire from Yahweh out of the sky.

hausa: “Amma kun ƙazantar da sunana ta wurin cewa ‘Teburin Ubangiji ya ƙazantu,’ kuka kuma yi magana a kan abincinsa kuna cewa, ‘Abin reni ne.’
english: “But you profane it when you say, ‘Yahweh’s table is polluted, and its fruit, even its food, is contemptible.’

hausa: Haka Isra’ila zai zauna lafiya shi kaɗai; zuriyar Yaƙub a tsare a ƙasar hatsi da sabon ruwan inabi, inda sammai za su zuba raɓa.
english: Israel dwells in safety, the fountain of Jacob alone, In a land of grain and new wine. Yes, his heavens drop down dew.

hausa: Saboda haka, ku yi iyakar ƙoƙari ku ƙara wa bangaskiyarku nagarta; ga nagarta kuwa, ku ƙara mata sani;
english: Yes, and for this very cause adding on your part all diligence, in your faith supply moral excellence; and in moral excellence, knowledge;

hausa: Zan kuma zauna a cikin Isra’ilawa, ba kuwa zan taɓa rabuwa da su ba.”
english: I will dwell among the children of Israel, and will not forsake my people Israel.”

hausa: Na ba su ɗaukakar da ka ba ni, don su zama ɗaya kamar yadda muke ɗaya.
english: The glory which you have given me, I have given to them, that they may be one, even as we are one,

hausa: “Yusuf kuringa ce mai ba da amfani. Kuringa mai ba da amfani kusa da rafi wadda rassanta na hawan bango.
english: “Joseph is a fruitful vine, a fruitful vine by a spring. His branches run over the wall.

hausa: In kuma ya fangare haƙorin bawa ko baiwa, dole yă ’yantar da bawan ko baiwar, a maimakon haƙorin.
english: If he strikes out his male servant’s tooth, or his female servant’s tooth, he shall let the servant go free for his tooth’s sake.

hausa: Masu gudu da sauri ba za su tsira ba, masu ƙarfi ba za su iya yin amfani da ƙarfinsu ba, jarumi kuma ba zai iya ceton ransa ba.
english: Flight will perish from the swift. The strong won’t strengthen his force. The mighty won’t deliver himself.

hausa: Tabbatacce cetonsa yana kusa da waɗanda suke tsoronsa, don ɗaukakarsa ta zauna a cikin ƙasarmu.
english: Surely his salvation is near those who fear him, that glory may dwell in our land.

hausa: Daga nan kuma suka ci gaba suka yaƙi mutanen da suke zaune a Debir (da ake kira a dā Kiriyat Sefer).
english: From there he went against the inhabitants of Debir. (The name of Debir before that was Kiriath Sepher.)

hausa: A kawo hatsin da aka yi da waɗannan abubuwa ga Ubangiji; a ba wa firist wanda zai ɗauka yă kai bagade.
english: You shall bring the meal offering that is made of these things to Yahweh. It shall be presented to the priest, and he shall bring it to the altar.

hausa: “Kada ku ba wa kowa laifi, don kada a ba ku laifi ku ma.
english: “Don’t judge, so that you won’t be judged.

hausa: Da ba a ce Ubangiji Maɗaukaki ya bar mana raguwar masu rai ba, da mun zama kamar Sodom, da mun zama kamar Gomorra.
english: Unless Yahweh of Armies had left to us a very small remnant, we would have been as Sodom. We would have been like Gomorrah.

hausa: Ya Ubangiji, ka cece mu; Ya Ubangiji, ka ba mu nasara.
english: Save us now, we beg you, Yahweh! Yahweh, we beg you, send prosperity now.

hausa: Amma mutanen suka yi shiru ba su kuwa ce kome ba, gama sarki ya yi umarni cewa, “Kada ku amsa masa.”
english: But they remained silent, and said nothing in reply, for the king’s commandment was, “Don’t answer him.”

hausa: wanda ya juye dutse ya zama tafki, dutse mai ƙarfi zuwa maɓulɓulan ruwa.
english: who turned the rock into a pool of water, the flint into a spring of waters.

hausa: Saboda haka, sai mu kiyaye Bikin ba da burodi mai tsohon yisti ba, ba kuma da yisti na ƙeta da mugunta ba, sai dai da burodi marar yisti na sahihanci da na gaskiya.
english: Therefore let’s keep the feast, not with old yeast, neither with the yeast of malice and wickedness, but with the unleavened bread of sincerity and truth.

hausa: Ga shi hannun Ubangiji yana gāba da kai. Za ka makance, kuma ba za ka ga rana ba har na wani lokaci.” Nan take, hazo da duhu suka sauko a kansa, ya yi ta lallubawa, yana neman wanda zai yi masa jagora.
english: Now, behold, the hand of the Lord is on you, and you will be blind, not seeing the sun for a season!” Immediately a mist and darkness fell on him. He went around seeking someone to lead him by the hand.

hausa: Na yi farin ciki ƙwarai, da na sami waɗansu ’ya’yanki suna tafiya cikin gaskiya, kamar yadda Uba ya umarce mu.
english: I rejoice greatly that I have found some of your children walking in truth, even as we have been commanded by the Father.

hausa: “Magājinsa zai aiki mai karɓar haraji don darajar masarautarsa. Amma ba da daɗewa ba za a hallaka shi, duk da haka ba da fushi ko cikin yaƙi ba.
english: “Then one who will cause a tax collector to pass through the kingdom to maintain its glory will stand up in his place; but within few days he shall be destroyed, not in anger, and not in battle.

hausa: Ku dawo, ya Isra’ila, ga Ubangiji Allahnku. Zunubanku ne sun zama sanadin fāɗuwarku!
english: Israel, return to Yahweh your God; for you have fallen because of your sin.

hausa: Dawuda da mutanensa ɗari shida suka kama hanya, da suka kai Kwarin Besor, waɗansunsu suka tsaya a can.
english: So David went, he and the six hundred men who were with him, and came to the brook Besor, where those who were left behind stayed.

hausa: Duk abin da ya kasance, to, yana da suna, kuma duk abin da mutum yake, an riga an sani. Ba mutumin da zai iya ƙarawa da wanda ya fi shi ƙarfi.
english: Whatever has been, its name was given long ago; and it is known what man is; neither can he contend with him who is mightier than he.

hausa: “Saboda wannan duka, muna yin zaunannen alkawari, muna sa shi a rubuce, shugabanninmu kuwa da Lawiyawanmu, da firistocinmu suna buga hatimansu a kai.”
english: Yet for all this, we make a sure covenant, and write it; and our princes, our Levites, and our priests, seal it.”

hausa: Ya Ubangiji, ina ƙaunar mai girma ta dā, wadda cikin amincinka ka rantse wa Dawuda?
english: Lord, where are your former loving kindnesses, which you swore to David in your faithfulness?

hausa: Mutanen da suka raka Bulus kuwa suka kawo shi Atens sa’an nan suka dawo da umarnai wa Sila da Timoti cewa su zo wurinsa da gaggawa.
english: But those who escorted Paul brought him as far as Athens. Receiving a commandment to Silas and Timothy that they should come to him very quickly, they departed.

hausa: “Yanzu kuwa na damu, amma me zan ce? ‘Uba, ka cece ni daga wannan sa’a’? A’a, ai, saboda wannan dalili ne musamman na zo.
english: “Now my soul is troubled. What shall I say? ‘Father, save me from this time’? But I came to this time for this cause.

hausa: Bayan muka hangi Saifurus muka wuce shi ta kudu, sai muka ci gaba zuwa Suriya. Muka sauka a Taya, inda jirgin ruwanmu zai sauke kayansa.
english: When we had come in sight of Cyprus, leaving it on the left hand, we sailed to Syria and landed at Tyre, for the ship was there to unload her cargo.

hausa: Daga zuriyar Binnuyi, akwai Shimeyi,
english: Bani, Binnui, Shimei,

hausa: Sa’an nan Hezekiya ya ce, “Yanzu kun keɓe kanku ga Ubangiji. Ku zo ku kuma kawo hadayu da hadayun godiya zuwa ga haikalin Ubangiji.” Saboda haka taron suka kawo hadayu da hadayun godiya, da kuma dukan waɗanda suke da niyya suka kawo hadayun ƙonawa.
english: Then Hezekiah answered, “Now you have consecrated yourselves to Yahweh. Come near and bring sacrifices and thank offerings into Yahweh’s house.” The assembly brought in sacrifices and thank offerings, and as many as were of a willing heart brought burnt offerings.

hausa: Sai Shawulu ya ce, “Na yi zunubi ka dawo Dawuda ɗana. Ba zan yi maka kome ba, domin ka darajarta raina yau. Lalle na yi wawanci! Na yi babban kuskure.”
english: Then Saul said, “I have sinned. Return, my son David; for I will no more do you harm, because my life was precious in your eyes today. Behold, I have played the fool, and have erred exceedingly.”

hausa: Ga zuriyar Lawiyawa. Zuriyar Yeshuwa da Kadmiyel (ta wurin Hodeba) 74.
english: The Levites: the children of Jeshua, of Kadmiel, of the children of Hodevah: seventy-four.

hausa: Da bakina zan ɗaukaka Ubangiji sosai; cikin babban taro zan yabe shi.
english: I will give great thanks to Yahweh with my mouth. Yes, I will praise him among the multitude.

hausa: Ga abin da Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka ya nuna mini. Ubangiji yana shirya cincirindon fāri bayan da aka ƙarasa yankan rabon hatsin da yake na sarki, hatsi na biyu kuma yake tohuwa.
english: Thus the Lord Yahweh showed me: behold, he formed locusts in the beginning of the shooting up of the latter growth; and behold, it was the latter growth after the king’s harvest.

hausa: Suka bayar talenti dubu biyar na zinariya, talenti dubu goma na azurfa, talenti dubu goma sha takwas na tagulla da talenti dubu ɗari na ƙarfe don aiki a haikalin Allah.
english: and they gave for the service of God’s house of gold five thousand talents and ten thousand darics, of silver ten thousand talents, of bronze eighteen thousand talents, and of iron one hundred thousand talents.

hausa: “ ‘Dukan ƙwarin da suke da fikafikai masu tafiya da ƙafafu huɗu abin ƙyama ne gare ku.
english: “‘All flying insects that walk on all fours are an abomination to you.

hausa: Kamar yadda makiyayi yakan lura da tumakinsa da suka watse sa’ad da yake tare da su, haka zan lura da tumakina. Zan cece su daga dukan wuraren da aka watsar da su a ranar gizagizai da baƙin duhu.
english: As a shepherd seeks out his flock in the day that he is among his sheep that are scattered abroad, so I will seek out my sheep. I will deliver them out of all places where they have been scattered in the cloudy and dark day.

hausa: Bari hannunka yă kasance a shirye don yă taimake ni, gama na zaɓi farillanka.
english: Let your hand be ready to help me, for I have chosen your precepts.

hausa: Bayan wannan, zai juya ga kagarar ƙasarsa, amma zai yi tuntuɓe yă fāɗi, ba kuwa za a ƙara ganinsa ba.
english: Then he will turn his face toward the fortresses of his own land; but he will stumble and fall, and won’t be found.

hausa: na ɗayan Elam ɗin 1,254
english: The children of the other Elam, one thousand two hundred fifty-four.

hausa: Shallum ɗan Yabesh ya zama sarki a shekara ta talatin da tara ta mulkin Uzziya sarkin Yahuda, ya kuma yi mulki na wata ɗaya a Samariya.
english: Shallum the son of Jabesh began to reign in the thirty-ninth year of Uzziah king of Judah, and he reigned for a month in Samaria.

hausa: Saurayin ya ce, “Duk waɗannan na kiyaye. Me kuma ya rage mini?”
english: The young man said to him, “All these things I have observed from my youth. What do I still lack?”

hausa: “To, yanzu, ina roƙonka bari bawanka yă zauna a nan a matsayin bawanka, ranka yă daɗe a maimakon saurayin, a kuma bar saurayin yă koma da ’yan’uwansa.
english: Now therefore, please let your servant stay instead of the boy, my lord’s slave; and let the boy go up with his brothers.

hausa: Bet-Nimra, da Bet-Haran a matsayin birane masu katanga, suka kuma gina katanga don dabbobinsu.
english: Beth Nimrah, and Beth Haran: fortified cities and folds for sheep.

hausa: Zan ba da labarin alherin Ubangiji, ayyukan da suka sa a yabe shi, bisa ga dukan abubuwan da Ubangiji ya yi mana, I, ayyuka masu kyan da ya yi domin gidan Isra’ila, bisa ga jinƙansa da yawan alheransa.
english: I will tell of the loving kindnesses of Yahweh and the praises of Yahweh, according to all that Yahweh has given to us, and the great goodness toward the house of Israel, which he has given to them according to his mercies, and according to the multitude of his loving kindnesses.

hausa: Masu ɗaukan kayan yaƙin Yowab goma kuwa sun kewaye Absalom, suka bubbuge shi suka kashe.
english: Ten young men who bore Joab’s armor surrounded and struck Absalom, and killed him.

hausa: Amma in muna begen abin da ba mu riga mun samu tukuna ba, mukan jira da haƙuri.
english: But if we hope for that which we don’t see, we wait for it with patience.

hausa: Tsawon wuri mai tsarki na ciki kamu ashirin, fāɗin kamu ashirin, tsayin kuma kamu ashirin. Ya dalaye cikin da zinariya zalla, ya kuma dalaye bagade al’ul ɗin.
english: Within the inner sanctuary was twenty cubits in length, and twenty cubits in width, and twenty cubits in its height. He overlaid it with pure gold. He covered the altar with cedar.

hausa: Dukiyar da aka samu ta wurin harshe mai yin ƙarya tarin tururi ne da kuma mugun tarko.
english: Getting treasures by a lying tongue is a fleeting vapor for those who seek death.

hausa: Ga abin da Ubangiji yana cewa, “Ku riƙe gaskiya ku yi abin da yake daidai, gama cetona yana kusa za a kuma bayyana adalcina nan da nan.
english: Yahweh says: “Maintain justice and do what is right, for my salvation is near and my righteousness will soon be revealed.

hausa: Sa’an nan ya yi daruna goma don wanki ya sa biyar a gefen kudu, biyar kuma a gefen arewa. A cikinsu kayan da za a yi amfani don ɗauraye hadayun ƙonawa, amma firistoci suna amfani da ƙaton kwano mai suna Teku don wanki.
english: He also made ten basins, and put five on the right hand and five on the left, to wash in them. The things that belonged to the burnt offering were washed in them, but the sea was for the priests to wash in.

hausa: Sa’an nan Ananiyas ya tafi gidan ya kuma shiga ciki. Da ya sa hannuwansa a kan Shawulu, sai ya ce, “Ɗan’uwana Shawulu, Ubangiji, Yesu, wanda ya bayyana gare ka a kan hanya yayinda kake zuwa nan, ya aiko ni domin ka sāke gani a kuma cika ka da Ruhu Mai Tsarki.”
english: Ananias departed and entered into the house. Laying his hands on him, he said, “Brother Saul, the Lord, who appeared to you on the road by which you came, has sent me that you may receive your sight and be filled with the Holy Spirit.”

hausa: Ku ɗaukaka a cikin sunansa mai tsarki; bari zukatan waɗanda suke neman Ubangiji su yi farin ciki.
english: Glory in his holy name. Let the heart of those who seek Yahweh rejoice.

hausa: Ku mazinata, ba ku san cewa abokantaka da duniya gāba ce da Allah ba? Duk wanda ya zaɓa yă zama abokin duniya ya zama abokin gāban Allah ke nan.
english: You adulterers and adulteresses, don’t you know that friendship with the world is hostility toward God? Whoever therefore wants to be a friend of the world makes himself an enemy of God.

hausa: Ya ce mini, ‘Solomon ɗanka shi ne wanda zai gina gidana da filayen da suke kewaye da shi, gama na zaɓe shi yă zama ɗana, ni kuma zan zama mahaifinsa.
english: He said to me, ‘Solomon, your son, shall build my house and my courts; for I have chosen him to be my son, and I will be his father.

hausa: Kada ka zargi mutum ba dalili, sa’ad da bai yi laifi ba.
english: Don’t strive with a man without cause, if he has done you no harm.

hausa: Zabad shi ne mahaifin Eflal, Eflal shi ne mahaifin Obed,
english: and Zabad became the father of Ephlal, and Ephlal became the father of Obed,

hausa: Solomon kuwa ya yi mulki a bisa dukan masarautai daga Kogi zuwa ƙasar Filistiyawa, har zuwa iyakar Masar. Waɗannan ƙasashe sun yi ta kawo haraji, suka kuma zama bayin Solomon dukan kwanakin ransa.
english: Solomon ruled over all the kingdoms from the River to the land of the Philistines, and to the border of Egypt. They brought tribute and served Solomon all the days of his life.

hausa: Sarakuna bakwai ne kuma. Biyar sun fāɗi, ɗaya yana nan, ɗayan kuma bai zo ba tukuna; amma sa’ad da ya zo, zai kasance na ɗan lokaci.
english: They are seven kings. Five have fallen, the one is, and the other has not yet come. When he comes, he must continue a little while.

hausa: domin alkawarin gādo yana aiki ne kawai bayan mai yinsa ya mutu, ba ya taɓa aiki yayinda mai yinsa yana da rai.
english: For a will is in force where there has been death, for it is never in force while he who made it lives.

hausa: Mutumin ya ce, “Macen da ka sa a nan tare da ni, ita ta ba ni waɗansu ’ya’ya daga itacen, na kuwa ci.”
english: The man said, “The woman whom you gave to be with me, she gave me fruit from the tree, and I ate it.”

hausa: Suna cewa, ‘Lokaci bai yi kusa da za a gina gidaje ba? Wannan birni yana tukunyar dahuwa, mu ne kuwa naman.’
english: who say, ‘The time is not near to build houses. This is the cauldron, and we are the meat.’

hausa: A hannunsa na dama ya riƙe taurari bakwai, daga bakinsa kuwa takobi mai kaifi biyu ya fito. Fuskarsa ta yi kamar rana mai haskakawa da dukan haskenta.
english: He had seven stars in his right hand. Out of his mouth proceeded a sharp two-edged sword. His face was like the sun shining at its brightest.

hausa: Yesu ya tambaye su ya ce, “Kun gane dukan waɗannan abubuwa?” Suka amsa, “I.”
english: Jesus said to them, “Have you understood all these things?” They answered him, “Yes, Lord.”

hausa: Sarki Hezekiya da fadawansa suka umarci Lawiyawa su yabi Ubangiji da kalmomin Dawuda da na Asaf mai duba. Saboda haka suka rera yabai da murna, suka sunkuyar da kawunansu suka yi sujada.
english: Moreover Hezekiah the king and the princes commanded the Levites to sing praises to Yahweh with the words of David, and of Asaph the seer. They sang praises with gladness, and they bowed their heads and worshiped.

hausa: Filibus, kamar Andarawus da Bitrus shi ma daga garin Betsaida ne.
english: Now Philip was from Bethsaida, the city of Andrew and Peter.

hausa: Zan tanada maka a nan, domin akwai saura shekaru biyar na yunwa masu zuwa. In ba haka ba, kai da gidanka da dukan mallakarka za ku zama gajiyayyu.’
english: There I will provide for you; for there are yet five years of famine; lest you come to poverty, you, and your household, and all that you have.”’

hausa: Leɓunanki kamar zaren jan garura bakinki yana da kyau. Kumatunki sun yi kamar rumman da aka tsaga biyu a cikin lulluɓinki.
english: Your lips are like scarlet thread. Your mouth is lovely. Your temples are like a piece of a pomegranate behind your veil.

hausa: A wannan dare sai aka bayyana wa Daniyel mafarkin cikin wahayi. Daniyel kuwa ya ɗaukaka Allah na sama.
english: Then the secret was revealed to Daniel in a vision of the night. Then Daniel blessed the God of heaven.

hausa: Amma ya ce musu, “Me na yi da za a iya kwatanta da abin da kuka yi? Ashe, kalar inabin da Efraim ta yi bai fi dukan girbin inabin da Abiyezer suka yi ba?
english: He said to them, “What have I now done in comparison with you? Isn’t the gleaning of the grapes of Ephraim better than the vintage of Abiezer?

hausa: Duk abin da yake a ruwa amma ba shi da ƙege ko kamɓori, za ku yi ƙyamarsa.
english: Whatever has no fins nor scales in the waters is an abomination to you.

hausa: A ƙarshen shekaru ashirin da Solomon ya ɗauka yana gina haikalin Ubangiji da fadan sarki,
english: At the end of twenty years, in which Solomon had built the two houses, Yahweh’s house and the king’s house

hausa: amma ga su waɗanda Allah ya kira, Yahudawa da Hellenawa, Kiristi ikon Allah ne, da kuma hikimar Allah.
english: but to those who are called, both Jews and Greeks, Christ is the power of God and the wisdom of God;

hausa: Bayan da Shawulu ya komo daga fafaran Filistiyawa, sai aka gaya masa cewa, “Dawuda yana can a Jejin En Gedi.”
english: When Saul had returned from following the Philistines, he was told, “Behold, David is in the wilderness of En Gedi.”

hausa: Za tă yi yarjejjeniya da kai don ka ɗauke ta tă zama baiwa gare ka dukan kwanakin ranta?
english: Will he make a covenant with you, that you should take him for a servant forever?

hausa: ’Yan’uwa, ku tuna yadda kuke sa’ad da aka kira ku. Babu masu hikima da yawa a cikinku, bisa ga ganin mutum; babu masu iko da yawa, babu masu martaba da yawa bisa ga haihuwa.
english: For you see your calling, brothers, that not many are wise according to the flesh, not many mighty, and not many noble;

hausa: Suka ƙazantar da kansu ta wurin abin da suka yi; ta wurin ayyukansu suka yi karuwanci.
english: Thus they were defiled with their works, and prostituted themselves in their deeds.

hausa: Saboda haka, sai ku da Majalisa sai ku roƙi shugaban ƙungiyar sojan yă kawo shi a gabanku kamar kuna so ku ƙara samun cikakken bayani game da zancensa. Mu kuwa muna a shirye mu kashe shi kafin yă iso nan.”
english: Now therefore, you with the council inform the commanding officer that he should bring him down to you tomorrow, as though you were going to judge his case more exactly. We are ready to kill him before he comes near.”

hausa: Bowaz ya amsa, “An faɗa mini duka game da abin kika yi domin surukarki tun mutuwar mijinki, yadda kika bar mahaifinki da mahaifiyarki da kuma ƙasarki kika zo ki yi zama da mutanen da ba ki taɓa sani ba.
english: Boaz answered her, “I have been told all about what you have done for your mother-in-law since the death of your husband, and how you have left your father, your mother, and the land of your birth, and have come to a people that you didn’t know before.

hausa: ’Ya’yansu maza suka shiga suka kuma mallaki ƙasar. A gabansu ka rinjayi Kan’aniyawan da suke zama a cikin ƙasar; ka ba da Kan’aniyawa a gare su, tare da sarakunansu da kuma mutanen ƙasar, su yi da su yadda suke so.
english: “So the children went in and possessed the land; and you subdued before them the inhabitants of the land, the Canaanites, and gave them into their hands, with their kings and the peoples of the land, that they might do with them as they pleased.

hausa: ta wurin kwana da wani dabam, wannan kuwa ya kasance a ɓoye ga mijinta, rashin tsarkinta kuwa bai tonu ba (da yake babu shaida, ba a kuma kama ta tana yi ba),
english: and a man lies with her carnally, and it is hidden from the eyes of her husband and this is kept concealed, and she is defiled, there is no witness against her, and she isn’t taken in the act;

hausa: In ka ga ana zaluntar matalauta a wani yanki, ba a yin adalci, ana kuma tauye hakki, kada ka yi mamakin waɗannan abubuwa; domin akwai wani jami’in da yake bisa da wani, a bisansu biyu kuwa akwai wani.
english: If you see the oppression of the poor, and the violent taking away of justice and righteousness in a district, don’t marvel at the matter, for one official is eyed by a higher one, and there are officials over them.

hausa: Suka rera sabuwar waƙa, “Ka cancanci ka karɓi naɗaɗɗen littafin ka kuma buɗe hatimansa, domin an kashe ka, da jininka kuma ka sayi mutane wa Allah, daga kowace kabila da harshe da mutane da kuma al’umma.
english: They sang a new song, saying, “You are worthy to take the book and to open its seals, for you were killed, and bought us for God with your blood out of every tribe, language, people, and nation,

hausa: “Kun aika wajen Yohanna ya kuma yi shaida a kan gaskiya.
english: You have sent to John, and he has testified to the truth.

hausa: da kuma cikin kowace irin muguntar da take ruɗin waɗanda suke hallaka. Sun hallaka ne domin sun ƙi su ƙaunaci gaskiya don su sami ceto.
english: and with all deception of wickedness for those who are being lost, because they didn’t receive the love of the truth, that they might be saved.

hausa: Sa’ad da Afollos ya so ya tafi Akayya, sai ’yan’uwa suka ƙarfafa shi suka kuma rubuta wa almajiran da suke can da su marabce shi. Da isowarsa, ya zama da taimako ƙwarai ga waɗanda ta wurin alheri suka gaskata.
english: When he had determined to pass over into Achaia, the brothers encouraged him; and wrote to the disciples to receive him. When he had come, he greatly helped those who had believed through grace;

hausa: Yanzu mun san cewa dukan abin da doka ta ce, tana magana ne ga waɗanda suke ƙarƙarshin doka, saboda a rufe kowane baki; dukan duniya kuma ta ba da lissafin kanta a gaban Allah.
english: Now we know that whatever things the law says, it speaks to those who are under the law, that every mouth may be closed, and all the world may be brought under the judgment of God.

hausa: Sa’an nan mutumin ya kawo ni ta hanyar ƙofar arewa zuwa gaban haikali. Na duba na kuma ga ɗaukakar Ubangiji tana cika haikalin Ubangiji, sai na fāɗi rubda ciki.
english: Then he brought me by the way of the north gate before the house; and I looked, and behold, Yahweh’s glory filled Yahweh’s house; so I fell on my face.

hausa: Bayan ya yi lalata da ita sai Amnon ya ƙi ta da mummunan ƙiyayya. Zahiri ya ƙi ta fiye da ya ƙaunace ta. Sai Amnon ya ce mata, “Tashi, ki fita!”
english: Then Amnon hated her with exceedingly great hatred; for the hatred with which he hated her was greater than the love with which he had loved her. Amnon said to her, “Arise, be gone!”

hausa: Raƙumar ruwan mutuwa sun kewaye ni; raƙumar ruwan hallaka suna cin ƙarfina.
english: For the waves of death surrounded me. The floods of ungodliness made me afraid.

hausa: Saboda haka a yanzu Ubangiji yana shirin ya bugi mutanenka, ’ya’yanka maza, matanka da kuma kome da yake naka, da bugu mai ƙarfi.
english: behold, Yahweh will strike your people with a great plague, including your children, your wives, and all your possessions;

hausa: kuma a inda ƙurjin yake, wani farin kumburi ko tabo ja-ja, fari-fari ya bayyana, dole yă gabatar da kansa ga firist.
english: and in the place of the boil there is a white swelling, or a bright spot, reddish-white, then it shall be shown to the priest.

hausa: Dawuda ya ce wa Ahimelek, “Ba ka da māshi ko takobi a nan? Ban kawo māshina ko wani makami ba gama saƙon sarki ya zo mini da gaggawa.”
english: David said to Ahimelech, “Isn’t there here under your hand spear or sword? For I haven’t brought my sword or my weapons with me, because the king’s business required haste.”

hausa: Saboda haka Yoshuwa da Isra’ilawa suka hallaka su da yawa ƙwarai, amma ’yan kaɗan ɗin da suka rage suka tsere zuwa cikin biranensu masu kāriya.
english: When Joshua and the children of Israel had finished killing them with a very great slaughter until they were consumed, and the remnant which remained of them had entered into the fortified cities,

hausa: Ni baƙo ne a duniya; kada ka ɓoye mini umarnanka.
english: I am a stranger on the earth. Don’t hide your commandments from me.

hausa: ya ce a gaban dukan mutane, “Ga abin da Ubangiji yana cewa, ‘A haka zan karya karkiyar Nebukadnezzar sarkin Babilon daga wuyan dukan al’ummai a cikin shekaru biyu.’ ” Da wannan, annabi Irmiya ya yi tafiyarsa.
english: Hananiah spoke in the presence of all the people, saying, “Yahweh says: ‘Even so I will break the yoke of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon from off the neck of all the nations within two full years.’” Then the prophet Jeremiah went his way.

hausa: A kan dakalin kuwa akwai Lawiyawa, wato, Yeshuwa, Bani, Kadmiyel, Shebaniya, Bunni, Sherebiya, Bani da Kenani tsaye, waɗanda suka kira da babbar murya ga Ubangiji Allahnsu.
english: Then Jeshua, Bani, Kadmiel, Shebaniah, Bunni, Sherebiah, Bani, and Chenani of the Levites stood up on the stairs, and cried with a loud voice to Yahweh their God.

hausa: “In namiji ko ta mace tana da miki a kai ko kuwa a gemu,
english: “When a man or woman has a plague on the head or on the beard,

hausa: Muna so kowannenku yă nuna ƙwazon nan har zuwa ƙarshe, domin ku tabbatar da begenku.
english: We desire that each one of you may show the same diligence to the fullness of hope even to the end,

hausa: Sam, kada ka bari su kuɓuce; cikin fushinka, ya Allah, ka saukar da al’ummai.
english: Shall they escape by iniquity? In anger cast down the peoples, God.

hausa: za a kuma kawar da gumaka ƙaƙaf.
english: The idols shall utterly pass away.

hausa: Kada ku ji tsoronsu, gama Ubangiji Allahnku zai yi yaƙi dominku.”
english: You shall not fear them; for Yahweh your God himself fights for you.”

hausa: Sai Bulus ya kira ɗaya daga cikin jarumawan ya ce, “Ka kai wannan saurayi wurin shugaban ƙungiyar soja; yana da wani abin da zai faɗa masa.”
english: Paul summoned one of the centurions and said, “Bring this young man to the commanding officer, for he has something to tell him.”

hausa: Kashegari, sa’ad da Fashhur ya fitar da shi daga turu, sai Irmiya ya ce masa, “Ubangiji ba zai kira ka Fashhur ba, amma ya ba ka suna Magor-Missabib.
english: On the next day, Pashhur released Jeremiah out of the stocks. Then Jeremiah said to him, “Yahweh has not called your name Pashhur, but Magormissabib.

hausa: Saboda haka, sai suka yanke shawara su yi amfani da kuɗin suka sayi filin mai yin tukwane, saboda binne baƙi.
english: They took counsel, and bought the potter’s field with them to bury strangers in.

hausa: Da hannuwansu mata masu tausayi sun dafa yaransu, suka zama masu abinci sa’ad da aka hallaka mutanena.
english: The hands of the pitiful women have boiled their own children. They were their food in the destruction of the daughter of my people.

hausa: Duk da haka sa’ad da Ubangiji ya hukunta mu, ana yin mana horo ne don kada a ƙarshe a hallaka mu tare da duniya.
english: But when we are judged, we are disciplined by the Lord, that we may not be condemned with the world.

hausa: Daga kabilar Yahuda mutum 12,000 ne aka sa musu hatimin, daga kabilar Ruben mutum 12,000, daga kabilar Gad mutum 12,000,
english: of the tribe of Judah twelve thousand were sealed, of the tribe of Reuben twelve thousand, of the tribe of Gad twelve thousand,

hausa: A yi wannan bikin ƙayyadadden lokaci da yamma, a rana ta goma sha huɗu ga wannan wata, a yi shi bisa ga dokokinsa da ƙa’idodinsa.”
english: On the fourteenth day of this month, at evening, you shall keep it in its appointed season. You shall keep it according to all its statutes and according to all its ordinances.”

hausa: Amma a shekara ta uku, Yehoshafat sarkin Yahuda ya gangara don yă ga sarki Isra’ila.
english: In the third year, Jehoshaphat the king of Judah came down to the king of Israel.

hausa: Sai ya ce musu, “Ku ba wa Kaisar abin da yake na Kaisar, ku kuma ba wa Allah abin da yake na Allah.”
english: He said to them, “Then give to Caesar the things that are Caesar’s, and to God the things that are God’s.”

hausa: Ba za ka yi wa kanka waɗansu alloli a siffar wani abu a sama a bisa, ko a ƙarƙashin ƙasa, ko a ƙarƙashin ruwa ba.
english: “You shall not make for yourselves an idol, nor any image of anything that is in the heavens above, or that is on the earth beneath, or that is in the water under the earth:

hausa: Lawiyawa. Lawiyawa na zuriyar Yeshuwa da Kadmiyel (ta wurin Hodawiya) mutum 74.
english: The Levites: the children of Jeshua and Kadmiel, of the children of Hodaviah, seventy-four.

hausa: Ya ce, “Zan sanar da sunanka ga ’yan’uwana; a gaban jama’a zan rera yabonka.”
english: saying, “I will declare your name to my brothers. Among the congregation I will sing your praise.”

hausa: Dawuda ya ce wa Solomon, “Ɗana, na yi niyya a zuciyata in gina gida saboda Sunan Ubangiji Allahna.
english: David said to Solomon his son, “As for me, it was in my heart to build a house to the name of Yahweh my God.

hausa: Bari al’ummai su yi murna su kuma rera don farin ciki, gama kana mulkin mutanenka da adalci kana kuma bi da al’umman duniya. Sela
english: Oh let the nations be glad and sing for joy, for you will judge the peoples with equity, and govern the nations on earth. Selah.

hausa: “Sai ya ce wa waɗanda suke tsaye a wajen, ‘Ku karɓi minarsa ku ba wa wanda yake da mina goma.’
english: He said to those who stood by, ‘Take the mina away from him and give it to him who has the ten minas.’

hausa: Sai mai tsaron ya ga wani mutum yana zuwa a guje. Sai ya tā da murya ya kira mai tsaron ƙofa ya ce, “Duba, ga wani mutum kuma yana gudu shi kaɗai!” Sarki ya ce, “Shi ma yana kawo labari mai daɗi ne.”
english: The watchman saw another man running; and the watchman called to the gatekeeper and said, “Behold, a man running alone!” The king said, “He also brings news.”

hausa: Yesu ya ce, “Mace, me ya sa kike haɗa ni a wannan? Lokacina bai yi ba tukuna.”
english: Jesus said to her, “Woman, what does that have to do with you and me? My hour has not yet come.”

hausa: Ba wanda ya taɓa ganin Allah, sai dai Allah da yake Ɗaya da kuma Makaɗaici wanda yake a gefen Uba, shi ne ya bayyana shi.
english: No one has seen God at any time. The only born Son, who is in the bosom of the Father, has declared him.

hausa: Garkuwoyin sojojinsa ja wur ne; jarumawansa suna sanye da kaya masu ruwan jan garura. Ƙarafan kekunan yaƙi suna walƙiya a ranar da aka shirya su; ana kaɗa māsu da bantsoro.
english: The shield of his mighty men is made red. The valiant men are in scarlet. The chariots flash with steel in the day of his preparation, and the pine spears are brandished.

hausa: “Sa’an nan ka sa su yi mini wuri mai tsarki, domin in zauna a cikinsu.
english: Let them make me a sanctuary, that I may dwell among them.

hausa: Gama a rubuce yake cewa, “Ki yi farin ciki, ya ke bakararriya, wadda ba ta haihuwa ki ɓarke da murna, ki kuma tā da murya, ke da ba kya naƙuda; domin da yawa ne ’ya’yan macen da aka yashe, fiye da na mai miji.”
english: For it is written, “Rejoice, you barren who don’t bear. Break out and shout, you who don’t travail. For the desolate women have more children than her who has a husband.”

hausa: da zaɓaɓɓun kyautai na daɗaɗɗun duwatsu, da kyawawan amfani na madawwaman tuddai.
english: for the best things of the ancient mountains, for the precious things of the everlasting hills,

hausa: Dole kuma ka tā da waɗansu mayaƙa kamar waɗanda ka rasa, doki don doki, keken yaƙi kuma don keken yaƙi, saboda mu iya yaƙe Isra’ila a fili. Ta haka tabbatacce za mu fi ƙarfinsu.” Sai ya yarda da su, ya kuma yi haka.
english: Muster an army like the army that you have lost, horse for horse and chariot for chariot. We will fight against them in the plain, and surely we will be stronger than they are.” He listened to their voice and did so.

hausa: Fadawan Amon sukan yi masa maƙarƙashiya, suka kashe shi a fadansa.
english: His servants conspired against him, and put him to death in his own house.

hausa: Yadda yawan magana take haka ƙarancin amfaninta, yaya wannan zai amfane wani?
english: For there are many words that create vanity. What does that profit man?

hausa: Shugaban iyalan Merari shi ne Zuriyel ɗan Abihayil. Za su yi sansani arewa da tabanakul.
english: The prince of the fathers’ house of the families of Merari was Zuriel the son of Abihail. They shall encamp on the north side of the tabernacle.

hausa: Gama mun ji shi yana cewa wannan Yesu Banazare zai rushe wurin nan ya kuma canja al’adun da Musa ya ba mu.”
english: For we have heard him say that this Jesus of Nazareth will destroy this place, and will change the customs which Moses delivered to us.”

hausa: “Amma duk wanda ya sa ɗaya daga cikin ƙananan nan da suka gaskata da ni ya yi zunubi, zai fiye masa a rataya babban dutsen niƙa a wuyarsa, a kuma nutsar da shi a zurfin teku.
english: but whoever causes one of these little ones who believe in me to stumble, it would be better for him if a huge millstone were hung around his neck and that he were sunk in the depths of the sea.

hausa: Zaki ya yi ruri, wa ba zai tsorata ba? Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka ya yi magana, wa ba zai yi annabci ba?
english: The lion has roared. Who will not fear? The Lord Yahweh has spoken. Who can but prophesy?

hausa: Sa’an nan dukan mazan garinsa za su jajjefe shi har yă mutu. Dole ku fid da mugu daga cikinku. Dukan Isra’ila kuwa za su ji wannan su kuma ji tsoro.
english: All the men of his city shall stone him to death with stones. So you shall remove the evil from among you. All Israel shall hear, and fear.

hausa: Na sani ni bawanka na yi maka laifi. Shi ya sa na zama na farko daga dukan Gidan Yusuf, da mutanen Isra’ila wanda ya fito don yă tarye ka yau, ranka yă daɗe, sarki.”
english: For your servant knows that I have sinned. Therefore behold, I have come today as the first of all the house of Joseph to go down to meet my lord the king.”

hausa: Sai ɗaya daga cikin serafofin ya yi firiya zuwa wurina tare da garwashi mai wuta a hannunsa, wanda ya ɗiba da arautaki daga bagade.
english: Then one of the seraphim flew to me, having a live coal in his hand, which he had taken with the tongs from off the altar.

hausa: In kuma ƙafarka tana sa ka yin zunubi, yanke ta. Ai, gwamma ka shiga rai da ƙafa ɗaya, da a jefa ka cikin jahannama ta wuta, da ƙafafunka biyu.
english: If your foot causes you to stumble, cut it off. It is better for you to enter into life lame, rather than having your two feet to be cast into Gehenna, into the fire that will never be quenched—

hausa: An ga Yesu ya cancanci girma fiye da Musa, kamar yadda mai ginin gida ya fi gidan daraja.
english: For he has been counted worthy of more glory than Moses, because he who built the house has more honor than the house.

hausa: Ya furta alkawarinsa gare ku, Dokoki Goma, waɗanda ya umarce ku ku bi, ya kuma rubuta su a alluna biyu.
english: He declared to you his covenant, which he commanded you to perform, even the ten commandments. He wrote them on two stone tablets.

hausa: Kai ne mafakata da garkuwata; na sa zuciyata a maganarka.
english: You are my hiding place and my shield. I hope in your word.

hausa: Suka kuma yi duk kayayyakin teburin da zinariya zalla, farantansa, kwanonin tuya, kwanoninsa, da kuma butoci domin hadaya ta sha.
english: He made the vessels which were on the table, its dishes, its spoons, its bowls, and its pitchers with which to pour out, of pure gold.

hausa: Da suka komo Zora da Eshtawol, ’yan’uwansu suka tambaye su, “Me kuka gano?”
english: They came to their brothers at Zorah and Eshtaol; and their brothers asked them, “What do you say?”

hausa: Bayan da firist ya sa matan ta tsaya a gaban Ubangiji, sai yă kunce gashin kanta, yă kuma sa hadaya ta gari don tunawa a hannuwanta, hadayar gari ce ta kishi, yayinda shi kansa zai riƙe ruwa mai ɗaci, mai jawo la’ana.
english: The priest shall set the woman before Yahweh, and let the hair of the woman’s head go loose, and put the meal offering of memorial in her hands, which is the meal offering of jealousy. The priest shall have in his hand the water of bitterness that brings a curse.

hausa: Sai na ga wani mala’ika yana tashi sama a tsakiyar sararin sama, yana kuma da madawwamiyar bishara wadda zai yi shela ga waɗanda suke zama a duniya, ga kowace al’umma, kabila, harshe, da kuma jama’a.
english: I saw an angel flying in mid heaven, having an eternal Good News to proclaim to those who dwell on the earth—to every nation, tribe, language, and people.

hausa: Dole ne tumakina su ci abin da kuka tattake su kuma sha abin da kuka gurɓata da ƙafafunku?
english: As for my sheep, they eat that which you have trodden with your feet, and they drink that which you have fouled with your feet.’

hausa: Suka tafi Kafarnahum. Da ranar Asabbaci ta kewayo, sai Yesu ya shiga majami’a ya fara koyarwa.
english: They went into Capernaum, and immediately on the Sabbath day he entered into the synagogue and taught.

hausa: Shelumiyel ɗan Zurishaddai ne shugaban ɓangaren kabilar Simeyon,
english: Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai was over the army of the tribe of the children of Simeon.

hausa: Na kasance tare da kai ko’ina ka tafi, na kuma yanke dukan abokan gābanka a gabanka. Yanzu zan sa sunanka kamar sunayen mutane mafi girma na duniya.
english: I have been with you wherever you have gone, and have cut off all your enemies from before you. I will make you a name like the name of the great ones who are on the earth.

hausa: Kada ku ruɗi kanku. In waninku yana tsammani cewa yana da hikima, yadda duniya ta ɗauki hikima, to, sai ya mai da kansa “wawa” don yă zama mai hikima.
english: Let no one deceive himself. If anyone thinks that he is wise among you in this world, let him become a fool that he may become wise.

hausa: Gara a haɗu da beyar da aka ƙwace wa ’ya’ya fiye da a sadu da wawa cikin wautarsa.
english: Let a bear robbed of her cubs meet a man, rather than a fool in his folly.

hausa: Saboda haka sai mutanen Ruben, mutanen Gad da kuma rabin mutanen kabilar Manasse, suka bar Isra’ilawa a Shilo cikin Kan’ana don su koma Gileyad, ƙasarsu, wadda suka samu bisa ga umarnin Ubangiji ta wurin Musa.
english: The children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half-tribe of Manasseh returned, and departed from the children of Israel out of Shiloh, which is in the land of Canaan, to go to the land of Gilead, to the land of their possession, which they owned, according to the commandment of Yahweh by Moses.

hausa: Ban da haka ma, mutanen sun yi ta ba ni labarin ayyuka masu kyau da Tobiya ya yi, sa’an nan kuma suna faɗa masa duk abin da na faɗa. Tobiya kuwa ya aika wasiƙu don yă tsorata ni.
english: Also they spoke of his good deeds before me, and reported my words to him. Tobiah sent letters to put me in fear.

hausa: Sa’an nan Fir’auna ya zare zoben sarauta daga yatsarsa, ya sa shi a yatsan Yusuf. Ya sanya masa rigar lallausan lilin, ya kuma sa masa sarƙar zinariya a wuyansa.
english: Pharaoh took off his signet ring from his hand, and put it on Joseph’s hand, and arrayed him in robes of fine linen, and put a gold chain about his neck.

hausa: Sai sarauniya, da jin muryoyi na sarki da na hakimansa, ta shiga babban ɗakin liyafar. Ta ce, “Ya sarki, ranka yă daɗe! Kada ka firgita! Kada fuskarka ta ruɗe!
english: The queen by reason of the words of the king and his lords came into the banquet house. The queen spoke and said, “O king, live forever; don’t let your thoughts trouble you, nor let your face be changed.

hausa: Suka ce wa Yoshuwa, “Ba shakka Ubangiji ya ba mu ƙasan nan duka, tana hannunmu, mutane can duk sun narke da tsoro saboda mu.”
english: They said to Joshua, “Truly Yahweh has delivered all the land into our hands. Moreover, all the inhabitants of the land melt away before us.”

hausa: “Sarakuna suka zo, suka yi yaƙi; sarakunan Kan’ana sun yi yaƙi a Ta’anak a gefen ruwan Megiddo, amma ba su ɗauki azurfa, ko ganima ba.
english: “The kings came and fought, then the kings of Canaan fought at Taanach by the waters of Megiddo. They took no plunder of silver.

hausa: Duk da haka sa’ad da na duba dukan aikin hannuwana, da abin da na yi fama don in samu, sai kome ya zama ba shi da amfani, naushin iska ne kawai; babu wata riba a duniya.
english: Then I looked at all the works that my hands had worked, and at the labor that I had labored to do; and behold, all was vanity and a chasing after wind, and there was no profit under the sun.

hausa: Mata suka ce wa Na’omi, “Yabo ya tabbata ga Ubangiji, wanda a wannan rana bai bar ki ba tare da dangi mai fansa ba. Allah yă sa yă zama sananne a dukan Isra’ila!
english: The women said to Naomi, “Blessed be Yahweh, who has not left you today without a near kinsman. Let his name be famous in Israel.

hausa: Yesse kuwa ya haifi Sarki Dawuda. Dawuda ya haifi Solomon, wanda matar Uriya ce mahaifiyarsa.
english: Jesse became the father of King David. David the king became the father of Solomon by her who had been Uriah’s wife.

hausa: Kamar yadda yake a rubuce cewa, “Yaƙub ne na so, amma Isuwa ne na ƙi.”
english: Even as it is written, “Jacob I loved, but Esau I hated.”

hausa: Labudda, burina shi ne in yi wa’azin bishara inda ba a san Kiristi ba, don kada yă zama ina gini ne a kan tushen da wani ya kafa.
english: yes, making it my aim to preach the Good News, not where Christ was already named, that I might not build on another’s foundation.

hausa: Wuta ta cinye matasansu maza, ’yan matansu kuma ba su da waƙoƙin aure;
english: Fire devoured their young men. Their virgins had no wedding song.

hausa: sarkin Libna, ɗaya sarkin Adullam, ɗaya
english: the king of Libnah, one; the king of Adullam, one;

hausa: Solomon ya ƙidaya dukan baƙin da suke cikin Isra’ila, bayan ƙidayan da mahaifinsa Dawuda ya yi; aka kuma tarar sun kai 153,600.
english: Solomon counted all the foreigners who were in the land of Israel, after the census with which David his father had counted them; and they found one hundred fifty-three thousand six hundred.

hausa: Zebadiya, Meshullam, Hizki, Heber,
english: Zebadiah, Meshullam, Hizki, Heber,

hausa: daga kabilar ’ya’yan Yusuf, daga Efraim, Elishama ɗan Ammihud; daga Manasse, Gamaliyel ɗan Fedazur;
english: Of the children of Joseph: of Ephraim: Elishama the son of Ammihud; of Manasseh: Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur.

hausa: Zai kawo su wa firist, wanda da fari zai miƙa ɗaya domin hadaya don zunubi. Zai murɗe kan daga wuyanta, ba tare da tsinke kan gaba ɗaya ba,
english: He shall bring them to the priest, who shall first offer the one which is for the sin offering. He shall wring off its head from its neck, but shall not sever it completely.

hausa: “ ‘Sai na aiki Musa da Haruna, na aukar wa Masarawa annobai, ta wurin abin da na yi ne na fitar da ku.
english: “‘I sent Moses and Aaron, and I plagued Egypt, according to that which I did among them: and afterward I brought you out.

hausa: Game da sauran ayyukan mulkin Solomon, da dukan abubuwan da ya yi, da hikimar da ya nuna, an rubuta su a littafin tarihin Solomon.
english: Now the rest of the acts of Solomon, and all that he did, and his wisdom, aren’t they written in the book of the acts of Solomon?

hausa: Daga ciki cikin kifi, Yunana ya yi addu’a ga Ubangiji Allahnsa.
english: Then Jonah prayed to Yahweh, his God, out of the fish’s belly.

hausa: Ubangiji kuwa ya bayyana a Tentin Sujada a cikin ginshiƙin girgije, sai girgijen ya tsaya a ƙofar Tentin Sujada.
english: Yahweh appeared in the Tent in a pillar of cloud, and the pillar of cloud stood over the Tent’s door.

hausa: Sai Iliya ya amsa, “In ni mutumin Allah ne, bari wuta ta sauko daga sama ta cinye ka da sojojinka hamsin!” Sai wutar Allah ta sauko daga sama ta cinye shi da sojojinsa hamsin.
english: Elijah answered them, “If I am a man of God, then let fire come down from the sky and consume you and your fifty!” Then God’s fire came down from the sky, and consumed him and his fifty.

hausa: Sai magatakardar birnin ya sa taron su yi shiru, sa’an nan ya ce, “Mutanen Afisa, ashe duk duniya ba tă san cewa birnin Afisa ce mai lura da haikalin Artemis mai girma da kuma siffarta da ya fāɗi daga sama ba?
english: When the town clerk had quieted the multitude, he said, “You men of Ephesus, what man is there who doesn’t know that the city of the Ephesians is temple keeper of the great goddess Artemis, and of the image which fell down from Zeus?

hausa: Ka mai da su masarauta da kuma firistoci, don su yi wa Allahnmu hidima, kuma za su yi mulki a duniya.”
english: and made us kings and priests to our God; and we will reign on the earth.”

hausa: Sai ta aika a kira mata Barak ɗan Abinowam daga Kedesh a Naftali, ta ce masa, “Ubangiji, Allah na Isra’ila ya umarce ka, ‘Je ka, ka ɗauki mutane Naftali da na Zebulun dubu goma tare da kai, ka yi jagoransu zuwa Dutse Tabor.
english: She sent and called Barak the son of Abinoam out of Kedesh Naphtali, and said to him, “Hasn’t Yahweh, the God of Israel, commanded, ‘Go and lead the way to Mount Tabor, and take with you ten thousand men of the children of Naphtali and of the children of Zebulun?

hausa: “Ku saurare ni da kyau; bari wannan yă zama ta’aziyyar da za ku ba ni.
english: “Listen diligently to my speech. Let this be your consolation.

hausa: Cikin darajarka ka hau zuwa nasara a madadin gaskiya, tawali’u da adalci; bari hannunka na dama yă nuna ayyukan banmamaki.
english: In your majesty ride on victoriously on behalf of truth, humility, and righteousness. Let your right hand display awesome deeds.

hausa: Mutanen Gershom suka sami waɗannan. Daga gidan rabin kabilar Manasse, sun sami Golan a Bashan da kuma Ashtarot, tare da wuraren kiwonsu;
english: To the sons of Gershom were given, out of the family of the half-tribe of Manasseh, Golan in Bashan with its pasture lands, and Ashtaroth with its pasture lands;

hausa: Haƙoranki sun yi kamar garken tumakin da ba a daɗe da yin musu sausaya ba, da suke haurawa daga inda aka yi musu wanka. Kowanne yana tare da ɗan’uwansa; babu waninsu da yake shi kaɗai.
english: Your teeth are like a newly shorn flock, which have come up from the washing, where every one of them has twins. None is bereaved among them.

hausa: Amma da suka gan shi daga nesa, kafin yă kai wurinsu, sai suka ƙulla su kashe shi.
english: They saw him afar off, and before he came near to them, they conspired against him to kill him.

hausa: “ ‘In wani ya bugi wani da makami na ƙarfe har ya mutu, to, shi mai kisankai ne; sai a kashe mai kisankan nan.
english: “‘But if he struck him with an instrument of iron, so that he died, he is a murderer. The murderer shall surely be put to death.

hausa: Na ji saƙo daga Ubangiji cewa; an aiki jakada zuwa ga al’ummai ya ce, “Ku tattara kanku don ku fāɗa mata! Ku tashi don yaƙi!”
english: I have heard news from Yahweh, and an ambassador is sent among the nations, saying, “Gather yourselves together! Come against her! Rise up to the battle!”

hausa: domin kada bangaskiyarku ta dogara a kan hikimar mutane, sai dai a kan ikon Allah.
english: that your faith wouldn’t stand in the wisdom of men, but in the power of God.

hausa: A wannan sabuwar rayuwa babu bambanci ko kai mutumin Al’ummai ne ko mutumin Yahuda, mai kaciya ne ko marar kaciya, baƙo, baƙauye, bawa ne ko ’yantacce, gama Kiristi shi ne kome, kuma yana cikin kome.
english: where there can’t be Greek and Jew, circumcision and uncircumcision, barbarian, Scythian, bondservant, or free person; but Christ is all, and in all.

hausa: Ya nuna maka, ya mutum, abin da yake mai kyau. Me Ubangiji yake bukata daga gare ka kuwa shi ne ka yi gaskiya ka so aikata jinƙai ka kuma yi tafiya da tawali’u a gaban Allah.
english: He has shown you, O man, what is good. What does Yahweh require of you, but to act justly, to love mercy, and to walk humbly with your God?

hausa: Wurin ajiye fitilar yă kasance da rassa shida, rassan nan za su miƙe daga kowane gefe na wurin ajiye fitilan, uku a gefe guda, uku kuma a ɗaya gefen.
english: There shall be six branches going out of its sides: three branches of the lamp stand out of its one side, and three branches of the lamp stand out of its other side;

hausa: In wani mutumin Isra’ila ko kuma wani baƙon da yake zama a cikinsu, ya yi kisankai cikin kuskure, zai iya gudu zuwa biranen da aka keɓe, ba za a bari mai neman ramako yă kashe shi kafin jama’a su yi masa shari’a ba.
english: These were the appointed cities for all the children of Israel, and for the alien who lives among them, that whoever kills any person unintentionally might flee there, and not die by the hand of the avenger of blood, until he stands trial before the congregation.

hausa: Mutanena sun ƙudura su juye daga gare ni. Ko da ma suka yi kira ga Mafi Ɗaukaka, ta ko ƙaƙa ba zai girmama su ba.
english: My people are determined to turn from me. Though they call to the Most High, he certainly won’t exalt them.

hausa: Ubangiji mai alheri da kuma tausayi, mai jinkirin fushi cike kuma da ƙauna.
english: Yahweh is gracious, merciful, slow to anger, and of great loving kindness.

hausa: Ku ma sashe ne na wannan ginin da Kiristi ya yi inda Allah yake zaune ta wurin Ruhunsa.
english: in whom you also are built together for a habitation of God in the Spirit.

hausa: “Hazor za tă zama mazaunin diloli, kufai har abada. Ba wanda zai zauna a can; ba wanda zai zauna a cikinta.”
english: Hazor will be a dwelling place of jackals, a desolation forever. No man will dwell there, neither will any son of man live therein.”

hausa: Ƙahonin nan goma, sarakuna ne goma waɗanda za su taso daga wannan mulki. Bayansu kuma, wani sarki zai taso, wanda ya sha dabam da waɗanda suka riga shi. Zai rinjayi sarakunan nan uku.
english: As for the ten horns, ten kings will arise out of this kingdom. Another will arise after them; and he will be different from the former, and he will put down three kings.

hausa: Ibrahim ya sāke rusuna a gaban mutanen ƙasar
english: Abraham bowed himself down before the people of the land.

hausa: Amma mala’ikan ya ce mata, “Kada ki ji tsoro, Maryamu, kin sami tagomashi a wurin Allah.
english: The angel said to her, “Don’t be afraid, Mary, for you have found favor with God.

hausa: Ga abin da mai girma ya ce mini, “Tafi, ka sa mai tsaro ka kuma sa ya ba da rahoton abin da ya gani.
english: For the Lord said to me, “Go, set a watchman. Let him declare what he sees.

hausa: Hezekiya ya yi magana mai ƙarfafawa ga dukan Lawiyawa waɗanda suka nuna ganewar fasaha a hidimar Ubangiji. Kwana bakwai suka ci rabonsu da aka tsara, suka miƙa hadayun salama, suka kuma yabi Ubangiji Allah na kakanninsu.
english: Hezekiah spoke encouragingly to all the Levites who had good understanding in the service of Yahweh. So they ate throughout the feast for the seven days, offering sacrifices of peace offerings and making confession to Yahweh, the God of their fathers.

hausa: Sai ya ce musu, “Abokai, kuna da kifi kuwa?” Suka amsa suka ce, “A’a.”
english: Jesus therefore said to them, “Children, have you anything to eat?” They answered him, “No.”

hausa: Sarkin Isra’ila ya ce wa Yehoshafat, “Zan ɓad da kama in shiga yaƙin, amma ka sa kayanka na sarauta.” Saboda haka sarkin Isra’ila ya ɓad da kama ya shiga cikin yaƙin.
english: The king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, “I will disguise myself, and go into the battle; but you put on your robes.” So the king of Israel disguised himself; and they went into the battle.

hausa: Ba ku taɓa karanta wannan Nassi ba, “ ‘Dutsen da magina suka ƙi, shi ne kuwa ya zama dutsen kusurwan gini.
english: Haven’t you even read this Scripture: ‘The stone which the builders rejected was made the head of the corner.

hausa: Zan ɗaura ka da igiyoyi don kada ka juya daga wannan gefe zuwa wani gefe sai ka gama kwanakin ƙawanyarka.
english: Behold, I put ropes on you, and you shall not turn yourself from one side to the other, until you have accomplished the days of your siege.

hausa: Yaƙin ya yi tsanani kewaye da Shawulu, kuma sa’ad da maharba suka rutsa shi, sai suka ji masa rauni.
english: The battle went hard against Saul, and the archers overtook him; and he was distressed by reason of the archers.

hausa: Kun san rashin lafiyar da na yi, shi ne ya yi mini hanyar da na kawo muku bishara da farko.
english: but you know that because of weakness in the flesh I preached the Good News to you the first time.

hausa: Yakan gamsar da Ubangiji saboda adalcinsa ya sa dokarsa ta zama mai girma da kuma mai ɗaukaka.
english: It pleased Yahweh, for his righteousness’ sake, to magnify the law and make it honorable.

hausa: ya kuma yi mulki a Urushalima shekara uku. Sunan mahaifiyarsa Ma’aka ne, ’yar Abisalom.
english: He reigned three years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Maacah the daughter of Abishalom.

hausa: Sa’an nan Ubangiji ya ce wa Musa, “Ka rubuta waɗannan kalmomi, gama bisa ga kalmomin nan, na yi alkawari da kai da kuma Isra’ila.”
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “Write these words; for in accordance with these words I have made a covenant with you and with Israel.”

hausa: Ka umarta ka kuma koyar da waɗannan abubuwa.
english: Command and teach these things.

hausa: Jiragen ruwa za su zo daga Kittim; za su murƙushe Asshur da Eber, amma su ma za a hallaka su.”
english: But ships shall come from the coast of Kittim. They shall afflict Asshur, and shall afflict Eber. He also shall come to destruction.”

hausa: In annabi ko firist ko da wani dabam ya ce, ‘Wannan ne abin da Ubangiji yake cewa,’ zan hukunta wannan mutum da kuma gidansa.
english: As for the prophet, the priest, and the people, who say, ‘The message from Yahweh,’ I will even punish that man and his household.

hausa: Ƙarar junanku ma da kuke yi, ai, kāsawa ce a gare ku. Ba gara ku haƙura a cuce ku ba? Ku kuma haƙura ko an zambace ku?
english: Therefore it is already altogether a defect in you that you have lawsuits one with another. Why not rather be wronged? Why not rather be defrauded?

hausa: Yana nan kamar yadda Ishaya ya riga ya faɗa. “Da ba don Ubangiji Maɗaukaki ya bar mana zuriya ba, da mun zama kamar Sodom, da mun kuma zama kamar Gomorra.”
english: As Isaiah has said before, “Unless the Lord of Armies had left us a seed, we would have become like Sodom, and would have been made like Gomorrah.”

hausa: Ƙafafuna suna tsaye daram; cikin taro mai girma zan yabi Ubangiji.
english: My foot stands in an even place. In the congregations I will bless Yahweh.

hausa: Masarawa za su karai, zan kuma sa shirye-shiryensu su zama banza; za su nemi shawarar gumaka da kuma ruhohin matattu, za su nemi shawarar mabiya da na masu duba.
english: The spirit of the Egyptians will fail within them. I will destroy their counsel. They will seek the idols, the charmers, those who have familiar spirits, and the wizards.

hausa: A wannan rana sarki zai tanada bijimi a matsayin hadaya don zunubi domin kansa da kuma domin dukan mutanen ƙasar.
english: On that day the prince shall prepare for himself and for all the people of the land a bull for a sin offering.

hausa: Iyayensa sun faɗa haka ne saboda suna tsoron Yahudawa, gama Yahudawa sun riga sun yanke shawara cewa duk wanda ya yarda cewa Yesu shi ne Kiristi, za a kore shi daga majami’a.
english: His parents said these things because they feared the Jews; for the Jews had already agreed that if any man would confess him as Christ, he would be put out of the synagogue.

hausa: Balawen ya ce, “Muna fito daga Betlehem a Yahuda za mu wani lungu a ƙasar tudu ta Efraim inda nake da zama. Na tafi Betlehem a Yahuda, ga shi kuwa yanzu za ni gidan Ubangiji. Ba wanda ya shigar da ni gidansa.
english: He said to him, “We are passing from Bethlehem Judah to the farther side of the hill country of Ephraim. I am from there, and I went to Bethlehem Judah. I am going to Yahweh’s house; and there is no one who has taken me into his house.

hausa: zage-zagen da abokan gābanka suka yi mini, ya Ubangiji, da suka yi wa kowane matakin da shafaffenka ya ɗauka.
english: With which your enemies have mocked, Yahweh, with which they have mocked the footsteps of your anointed one.

hausa: Allah yă yi wa Abner hukunci mai tsanani, in ban goyi bayan Dawuda ya sami abin da Ubangiji ya yi masa alkawari da rantsuwa ba.
english: God do so to Abner, and more also, if, as Yahweh has sworn to David, I don’t do even so to him:

hausa: (Daga waɗannan mutane ne masu zama a bakin teku suka bazu zuwa cikin ƙasashensu da kuma cikin al’ummansu, kowanne da yarensa.)
english: Of these were the islands of the nations divided in their lands, everyone after his language, after their families, in their nations.

hausa: Kowa ya kauce, gaba ɗaya sun lalace; babu guda da yake aikata abu mai kyau, babu ko ɗaya.
english: Every one of them has gone back. They have become filthy together. There is no one who does good, no, not one.

hausa: Sai Yesu ya ce mata, “An gafarta miki zunubanki.”
english: He said to her, “Your sins are forgiven.”

hausa: da muryoyin mawaƙa a wuraren ruwaye. Suna faɗi ayyukan adalcin Ubangiji, ayyukan adalcin mayaƙansa a Isra’ila. “Sa’an nan mutanen Ubangiji suka gangara zuwa ƙofofin birni.
english: Far from the noise of archers, in the places of drawing water, there they will rehearse Yahweh’s righteous acts, the righteous acts of his rule in Israel. “Then Yahweh’s people went down to the gates.

hausa: Zai ƙwace allolinsu, siffofinsu na ƙarfe da kuma kaya masu daraja na azurfa da na zinariya a kuma kai su Masar. Zai yi ’yan shekaru bai kai wa sarkin Arewa yaƙi ba.
english: He will also carry their gods with their molten images, and with their goodly vessels of silver and of gold, captive into Egypt. He will refrain some years from the king of the north.

hausa: Mala’ikan Allah ya ce masa, “Ka ɗauko naman da burodi marar yisti ka sa su a kan wannan dutse, ka zuba romon a kai.” Gideyon kuwa ya yi haka.
english: The angel of God said to him, “Take the meat and the unleavened cakes, and lay them on this rock, and pour out the broth.” He did so.

hausa: Don me, ya Ubangiji, ka sa muna barin hanyoyinka muka kuma taurare zukatanmu don kada mu girmama ka? Ka komo domin darajar bayinka, kabilan da suke abin gādonka.
english: O Yahweh, why do you make us wander from your ways, and harden our heart from your fear? Return for your servants’ sake, the tribes of your inheritance.

hausa: Amma ka ƙi, ka yi ƙyama ka kuma yi fushi sosai da shafaffenka.
english: But you have rejected and spurned. You have been angry with your anointed.

hausa: da Harim, da Meremot, da Obadiya,
english: Harim, Meremoth, Obadiah,

hausa: “Kamar yadda kake yin gayyata a ranar biki, haka kake kawo mini tsoro a kowane gefe. A ranar fushin Ubangiji ba mai tserewa ba wanda zai tsira; maƙiyina ya kashe waɗanda na yi renonsu, na kuma lura da su.”
english: “You have called, as in the day of a solemn assembly, my terrors on every side. There was no one that escaped or remained in the day of Yahweh’s anger. My enemy has consumed those whom I have cared for and brought up.

hausa: Amma in kuka ga ba za ku iya bauta wa Ubangiji ba, sai ku zaɓa yau wanda za ku bauta masa, ko allolin da kakanninku suka bauta musu a hayin Kogin Yuferites, ko kuma allolin Amoriyawa, waɗanda kuke zama a cikin ƙasarsu. Amma da ni da gidana, Ubangiji ne za mu bauta wa.”
english: If it seems evil to you to serve Yahweh, choose today whom you will serve; whether the gods which your fathers served that were beyond the River, or the gods of the Amorites, in whose land you dwell; but as for me and my house, we will serve Yahweh.”

hausa: A zamanin Artazerzes sarkin Farisa kuma, sai Bishlam, da Mitredat, da Tabeyel, da sauran abokansu suka rubuta wasiƙa zuwa ga Artazerzes. Aka rubuta wasiƙar da harufan Arameyik, aka kuma fassara ta a yaren Arameyik.
english: In the days of Artaxerxes, Bishlam, Mithredath, Tabeel, and the rest of his companions wrote to Artaxerxes king of Persia; and the writing of the letter was written in Syrian and delivered in the Syrian language.

hausa: Saboda nishina mai ƙarfi na rame na bar ƙasusuwa kawai.
english: By reason of the voice of my groaning, my bones stick to my skin.

hausa: Bayan watanni biyu ɗin sai ta komo wurin mahaifinta ya kuwa yi da ita yadda ya yi wa’adi. Ita kuwa ba tă taɓa san namiji ba. Wannan ya zama al’ada a Isra’ila,
english: At the end of two months, she returned to her father, who did with her according to his vow which he had vowed. She was a virgin. It became a custom in Israel

hausa: Bai iya yin ayyukan banmamaki a wurin ba, sai dai ɗibiya hannuwansa da ya yi a kan mutane kima da suke da cututtuka, ya kuwa warkar da su.
english: He could do no mighty work there, except that he laid his hands on a few sick people and healed them.

hausa: “ ‘A wannan rana manzanni za su fito daga wurina a jiragen ruwa don su tsorata Kush daga sake jikinta. Azaba za tă kama su a ranar hallakar Masar, gama tabbatacce za tă zo.
english: “‘“In that day messengers will go out from before me in ships to make the careless Ethiopians afraid. There will be anguish on them, as in the day of Egypt; for, behold, it comes.”

hausa: Ni aboki ne ga duk mai tsoronka, ga duk wanda yake bin farillanka.
english: I am a friend of all those who fear you, of those who observe your precepts.

hausa: Dawuda ya ɗaura māshin Shawulu a sulken, ya yi ƙoƙari yă zaga, sai ya ji ba zai iya ba saboda bai saba ba. Ya cewa Shawulu, “Ba zan iya tafiya da waɗannan ba, domin ban saba ba.” Don haka ya tuɓe su.
english: David strapped his sword on his clothing and he tried to move, for he had not tested it. David said to Saul, “I can’t go with these, for I have not tested them.” Then David took them off.

hausa: Abishuwa mahaifin Bukki, Bukki mahaifin Uzzi,

hausa: Da Ibrahim ya ɗaga ido, sai ya ga mutum uku suna tsaye kusa da shi. Sa’ad da ya gan su, sai ya tashi nan da nan daga mashigin tentinsa, ya tarye su, ya rusuna har ƙasa.
english: He lifted up his eyes and looked, and saw that three men stood near him. When he saw them, he ran to meet them from the tent door, and bowed himself to the earth,

hausa: Bulus, ɗan kurkuku saboda Kiristi Yesu, da kuma Timoti ɗan’uwanmu, Zuwa ga Filemon ƙaunataccen abokinmu da kuma abokin aikinmu,
english: Paul, a prisoner of Christ Jesus, and Timothy our brother, to Philemon, our beloved fellow worker,

hausa: Jimillar maza daga mutanen Efraim 40,500 ne.
english: those who were counted of them, of the tribe of Ephraim, were forty thousand five hundred.

hausa: Ya amsa musu ya ce, “In kuna da bangaskiya da take ƙanƙani kamar ƙwayar mustad, kuna iya ce wa wannan itacen durumi, ‘Ka tumɓuke daga nan, ka dasu a cikin teku.’ Zai kuwa yi muku biyayya.
english: The Lord said, “If you had faith like a grain of mustard seed, you would tell this sycamore tree, ‘Be uprooted and be planted in the sea,’ and it would obey you.

hausa: Kada ku ɓata shari’a, ko ku nuna bambanci. Kada ku karɓi cin hanci, gama cin hanci yakan makanta idanu mai hikima, yă murɗe maganar mai gaskiya.
english: You shall not pervert justice. You shall not show partiality. You shall not take a bribe, for a bribe blinds the eyes of the wise and perverts the words of the righteous.

hausa: Esta ta ce, “In sarki ya yarda, yă ba wa Yahudawa da suke Shusha izini su aikata dokan nan gobe kuma, bari kuma a rataye ’ya’ya maza goma na Haman a kan gumagumai.”
english: Then Esther said, “If it pleases the king, let it be granted to the Jews who are in Susa to do tomorrow also according to today’s decree, and let Haman’s ten sons be hanged on the gallows.”

hausa: Saboda haka, ya yi gaba da gudu, kuma ya hau itacen sikamo, don yă gan shi, tun da Yesu zai bi wannan hanyar ne.
english: He ran on ahead and climbed up into a sycamore tree to see him, for he was going to pass that way.

hausa: da kuma tanade-tanade masu yawa a garuruwan Yahuda. Ya kuma ajiye gogaggu mayaƙa a Urushalima.
english: He had many works in the cities of Judah; and men of war, mighty men of valor, in Jerusalem.

hausa: Gama wautar Allah ta fi hikimar mutum, kuma rashin ƙarfin Allah ya fi ƙarfin mutum.
english: because the foolishness of God is wiser than men, and the weakness of God is stronger than men.

hausa: Ba kuwa za su iya tabbatar maka ƙarar da suke yi yanzu a kaina ba.
english: Nor can they prove to you the things of which they now accuse me.

hausa: Al’ummai za su ji tsoron sunan Ubangiji, dukan sarakunan duniya za su girmama ɗaukakarka.
english: So the nations will fear Yahweh’s name, all the kings of the earth your glory.

hausa: suka ce, “Ka je gidan mutanen da suke marasa kaciya ka kuwa ci tare da su.”
english: saying, “You went in to uncircumcised men and ate with them!”

hausa: Bari yă zauna shiru shi kaɗai, gama haka Ubangiji ya sa yă yi.
english: Let him sit alone and keep silence, because he has laid it on him.

hausa: Gama ga abin da Ubangiji yana cewa, shi da ya halicci sammai, shi ne Allah; shi da ya sarrafa ya kuma yi duniya, ya kafa ta; bai halicce ta don ta zama ba kome ba, amma ya yi ta don a zauna a ciki, ya ce, “Ni ne Ubangiji, kuma babu wani.
english: For Yahweh who created the heavens, the God who formed the earth and made it, who established it and didn’t create it a waste, who formed it to be inhabited says: “I am Yahweh. There is no other.

hausa: Kada ka bar mu mu mutu, ka yi wata dabara! Kada ka bari mu rasa gonakinmu. Ka musaye mu da abinci, mu da gonakinmu. Mu kuwa za mu zama bayin Fir’auna. Ka ba mu iri don mu rayu, kada mu mutu, don kuma kada gonakin ƙasarmu su zama kango.”
english: Why should we die before your eyes, both we and our land? Buy us and our land for bread, and we and our land will be servants to Pharaoh. Give us seed, that we may live, and not die, and that the land won’t be desolate.”

hausa: Wannan ita ce zuriyar Tera. Tera ya haifi Abram, Nahor da Haran. Haran kuma ya haifi Lot.
english: Now this is the history of the generations of Terah. Terah became the father of Abram, Nahor, and Haran. Haran became the father of Lot.

hausa: Sai Musa ya jagoranci Isra’ila daga jan teku zuwa hamadar Shur. Kwana uku suka yi tafiya cikin hamada ba su sami ruwa ba.
english: Moses led Israel onward from the Red Sea, and they went out into the wilderness of Shur; and they went three days in the wilderness, and found no water.

hausa: Sai Yesu ya umarce Bitrus ya ce, “Mai da takobinka kube! Ba zan sha kwaf da Uba ya ba ni ba?”
english: Jesus therefore said to Peter, “Put the sword into its sheath. The cup which the Father has given me, shall I not surely drink it?”

hausa: Alheri da salama daga Allah Ubanmu da Ubangiji Yesu Kiristi, su kasance tare da ku.
english: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

hausa: Kora ɗan Izhar, wanda yake Balawe ne daga dangin Kohatawa, wata rana ya nemi Datan da Abiram ’ya’yan Eliyab, da On ɗan Felet dukansu daga kabilar Ruben, suka haɗa kai
english: Now Korah, the son of Izhar, the son of Kohath, the son of Levi, with Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab, and On, the son of Peleth, sons of Reuben, took some men.

hausa: Da suka yi kusa da ƙauyen da za su, sai Yesu ya yi kamar zai ci gaba.
english: They came near to the village where they were going, and he acted like he would go further.

hausa: Shawulu ya ce, “Ya tabbatar mana cewa an riga an sami jakuna.” Amma bai gaya wa ɗan’uwan mahaifinsa abin da Sama’ila ya ce game da sarauta ba.
english: Saul said to his uncle, “He told us plainly that the donkeys were found.” But concerning the matter of the kingdom, of which Samuel spoke, he didn’t tell him.

hausa: Dole kowa yă yi biyayya ga masu mulki, gama babu wani iko sai ko in Allah ya yarda. Duk hukumomin da muke su, naɗin Allah ne.
english: Let every soul be in subjection to the higher authorities, for there is no authority except from God, and those who exist are ordained by God.

hausa: Sai Siman Bitrus ya hau ya jawo abin kamun kifin gaci. Ya cika da manyan kifi, 153, amma duk da yawansun nan abin kamun kifin bai tsintsinke ba.
english: Simon Peter went up, and drew the net to land, full of one hundred fifty-three great fish. Even though there were so many, the net wasn’t torn.

hausa: Mutuwa da Hallaka ba sa ƙoshi, haka idanun mutum ba sa ƙoshi da gani.
english: Sheol and Abaddon are never satisfied; and a man’s eyes are never satisfied.

hausa: Kamar yadda Nassi ya ce, “Duk wanda ya gaskata da shi ba zai taɓa shan kunya ba.”
english: For the Scripture says, “Whoever believes in him will not be disappointed.”

hausa: Ina kuwa gaya maka, kai ne Bitrus,a kan wannan dutse zan gina ikkilisiyata, kuma ƙofofin Hadesba za su rinjaye ta ba.
english: I also tell you that you are Peter, and on this rock I will build my assembly, and the gates of Hades will not prevail against it.

hausa: Gama Ubangiji ya zaɓi Sihiyona, ya so ta zama mazauninsa,
english: For Yahweh has chosen Zion. He has desired it for his habitation.

hausa: A kuma ba ni wasiƙa zuwa ga Asaf, sarkin daji, yă ba ni katako don yin ƙofofin kagara na kusa da fadar haikali da kuma don katangar birni, da na wurin da zan zauna?” Sarki kuwa ya ba ni abin da na roƙa, gama Allah yana tare da ni.
english: and a letter to Asaph the keeper of the king’s forest, that he may give me timber to make beams for the gates of the citadel by the temple, for the wall of the city, and for the house that I will occupy.” The king granted my requests, because of the good hand of my God on me.

hausa: A maimako, sun bi taurin zuciyarsu; suka bi Ba’al, yadda kakanninsu suka koya musu.”
english: but have walked after the stubbornness of their own heart and after the Baals, which their fathers taught them.”

hausa: Za ki sha madarar al’ummai a kuma shayar da ke da nonon sarauta. Sa’an nan za ki san cewa ni, Ubangiji, ni ne Mai Cetonki, Mai Fansarki, Mai Ikon nan na Yaƙub.
english: You will also drink the milk of the nations, and will nurse from royal breasts. Then you will know that I, Yahweh, am your Savior, your Redeemer, the Mighty One of Jacob.

hausa: Ta haifa masa Zimran, Yokshan, Medan, Midiyan, Ishbak da Shuwa.
english: She bore him Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak, and Shuah.

hausa: Bayan Yaƙub ya zo daga Faddan Aram, ya iso lafiya a birnin Shekem a Kan’ana, ya kuma kafa sansani a ƙofar birni.
english: Jacob came in peace to the city of Shechem, which is in the land of Canaan, when he came from Paddan Aram; and encamped before the city.

hausa: A arewa za a sami sashen sansanin Dan, a ƙarƙashin ƙa’idarsu. Shugabansu shi ne Ahiyezer ɗan Ammishaddai.
english: “On the north side shall be the standard of the camp of Dan according to their divisions. The prince of the children of Dan shall be Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai.

hausa: Saboda haka sai kai shi zuwa gidansa ya ciyar da jakunansa. Bayan sun wanke ƙafafunsu, sai aka ba su abinci da abin sha.
english: So he brought him into his house, and gave the donkeys fodder. Then they washed their feet, and ate and drank.

hausa: Yusuf ya ba wa ɗansa na fari suna Manasse ya ce, “Gama Allah ya sa na mance dukan wahalata da dukan gidan mahaifina.”
english: Joseph called the name of the firstborn Manasseh, “For”, he said, “God has made me forget all my toil, and all my father’s house.”

hausa: Ba za ka yi ƙyashin gidan maƙwabcinka ba. Ba za ka yi ƙyashin matar maƙwabcinka ba, ko bawansa, ko baiwarsa, ko sansa, ko jakinsa, ko duk abin da yake na maƙwabcinka ba.”
english: “You shall not covet your neighbor’s house. You shall not covet your neighbor’s wife, nor his male servant, nor his female servant, nor his ox, nor his donkey, nor anything that is your neighbor’s.”

hausa: Zai yanka ɗan rago domin hadaya don laifi ya kuma ɗibi jinin ya sa a leɓatun kunnen dama na wanda za a tsabtaccen, a babban yatsar hannun damansa da kuma a babban yatsar ƙafarsa na dama.
english: He shall kill the lamb of the trespass offering. The priest shall take some of the blood of the trespass offering and put it on the tip of the right ear of him who is to be cleansed, and on the thumb of his right hand, and on the big toe of his right foot.

hausa: Sa’ad da kwanakinka suka ƙare, za ka huta tare da kakanninka, zan tā da zuriyarka, na cikinka, zan kuma sa mulkinsa ya kahu.
english: When your days are fulfilled and you sleep with your fathers, I will set up your offspring after you, who will proceed out of your body, and I will establish his kingdom.
