hausa: “Ga abin da Ubangiji yana cewa, ‘Daga cikin iyalinka zan kawo masifa a kanka. A idanunka zan ɗauki matanka in ba wa wani da yake kusa da kai, zai kuwa kwana da su da rana tsaka.
english: “This is what Yahweh says: ‘Behold, I will raise up evil against you out of your own house; and I will take your wives before your eyes and give them to your neighbor, and he will lie with your wives in the sight of this sun.

hausa: Kuma in ka ce mini, “Mun dogara ga Ubangiji Allahnmu ne” ba shi ba ne Hezekiya ya rurrushe masujadan kan tudunsa da bagadansa, yana ce wa Yahuda da Urushalima, “Dole ku yi sujada wa gaban wannan bagade”?
english: But if you tell me, ‘We trust in Yahweh our God,’ isn’t that he whose high places and whose altars Hezekiah has taken away, and has said to Judah and to Jerusalem, ‘You shall worship before this altar’?”

hausa: “Maigidan kuwa ya yabi manajan nan marar gaskiya saboda wayonsa. Gama ’yan duniyan nan suna da wayon yin hulɗa da junansu fiye da ’yan haske.
english: “His lord commended the dishonest manager because he had done wisely, for the children of this world are, in their own generation, wiser than the children of the light.

hausa: Ka maido da wadatarmu, ya Ubangiji kamar rafuffuka a Negeb.
english: Restore our fortunes again, Yahweh, like the streams in the Negev.

hausa: Akwai ƙofofin shiga daga fili, ɗaya a arewa ɗaya kuma a kudu; fāɗin tushen da ya yi kusa da filin kamu biyar ne kewaye.
english: The doors of the side rooms were toward an open area that was left, one door toward the north, and another door toward the south. The width of the open area was five cubits all around.

hausa: na kuwa faɗa wa masu zaman bautan dukan abin da Ubangiji ya nuna mini.
english: Then I spoke to the captives all the things that Yahweh had shown me.

hausa: Gama na jimre da ba’a saboda kai, kunya kuma ta rufe fuskata.
english: Because for your sake, I have borne reproach. Shame has covered my face.

hausa: “Dan zai tanada adalci wa mutanensa kamar ɗaya cikin kabilan Isra’ila.
english: “Dan will judge his people, as one of the tribes of Israel.

hausa: Saboda haka sai Ubangiji ya dakatar da nufinsa. “Wannan ba zai faru ba,” in ji Ubangiji.
english: Yahweh relented concerning this. “It shall not be,” says Yahweh.

hausa: Ɗan Obed-Edom, wato, Shemahiya shi ma yana da ’ya’ya maza, waɗanda suke shugabanni a cikin iyalin mahaifinsu, gama su jarumawa ne ƙwarai.
english: Sons were also born to Shemaiah his son, who ruled over the house of their father; for they were mighty men of valor.

hausa: “’Yan’uwa, zan iya tabbatar muku gabagadi cewa kakanmu Dawuda ya mutu aka kuma binne shi, kabarinsa kuwa yana a nan har yă zuwa yau.
english: “Brothers, I may tell you freely of the patriarch David, that he both died and was buried, and his tomb is with us to this day.

hausa: Sarki ya tambayi Daniyel (wanda ake kira Belteshazar), za ka iya faɗa mini mafarkin da na yi ka kuma fassara shi?
english: The king answered Daniel, whose name was Belteshazzar, “Are you able to make known to me the dream which I have seen, and its interpretation?”

hausa: Sa’an nan babban firist ya miƙe tsaye, ya ce wa Yesu, “Ba ka da wata amsa? Shaidar da mutanen nan suke yi a kanka fa?”
english: The high priest stood up and said to him, “Have you no answer? What is this that these testify against you?”

hausa: Yusuf ya ɗauke su biyu, Efraim a damansa zuwa hagun Isra’ila, Manasse kuma a hagunsa zuwa hannun daman Isra’ila, ya kuma kawo su kusa da shi.
english: Joseph took them both, Ephraim in his right hand toward Israel’s left hand, and Manasseh in his left hand toward Israel’s right hand, and brought them near to him.

hausa: “Kowane mutum marar azanci ne kuma ba shi da sani; kowane maƙerin zinariya yakan sha kunya daga wurin gumakansa. Siffofinsa na ƙarya ne; babu numfashi a cikinsu.
english: “Every man has become stupid and without knowledge. Every goldsmith is disappointed by his image, for his molten images are falsehood, and there is no breath in them.

hausa: Ko za ka iya daure shi da igiya a kwarin kunya? Zai yi maka buɗar gonarka?
english: Can you hold the wild ox in the furrow with his harness? Or will he till the valleys after you?

hausa: Mala’ikan ya ce wa matan, “Kada ku ji tsoro, domin na san cewa kuna neman Yesu wanda aka gicciye ne.
english: The angel answered the women, “Don’t be afraid, for I know that you seek Jesus, who has been crucified.

hausa: Waɗannan su ne kabilan Gad, jimillarsu ta kai 40,500.
english: These are the families of the sons of Gad according to those who were counted of them, forty thousand and five hundred.

hausa: ta Hashum 223
english: The children of Hashum, two hundred twenty-three.

hausa: Ya haifi Yobab, Zibiya, Hodesh, Malkam,
english: By Hodesh his wife, he became the father of Jobab, Zibia, Mesha, Malcam,

hausa: Sa’an nan, bari a ba da rigar da kuma dokin wa ɗaya daga cikin manyan sarakuna mafi kirki na sarki. Bari shi kuma yă sa wannan riga wa mutumin da sarki yake jin daɗi yă girmama, a kuma bi da shi a bisan doki ko’ina a titunan birni, ana shela a gabansa ana cewa, ‘Wannan shi ne abin da ake yin wa mutumin da sarki yake jin daɗi yă girmama!’ ”
english: Let the clothing and the horse be delivered to the hand of one of the king’s most noble princes, that they may array the man whom the king delights to honor with them, and have him ride on horseback through the city square, and proclaim before him, ‘Thus it shall be done to the man whom the king delights to honor!’”

hausa: Fir’auna ya kira Musa da Haruna da gaggawa ya ce, “Na yi wa Ubangiji Allahnku zunubi, na kuma yi muku.
english: Then Pharaoh called for Moses and Aaron in haste, and he said, “I have sinned against Yahweh your God, and against you.

hausa: “Amma ’yan hayan suka ce wa juna, ‘Aha! Wannan shi ne magājin. Ku zo mu kashe shi, gādon kuma yă zama namu.’
english: But those farmers said among themselves, ‘This is the heir. Come, let’s kill him, and the inheritance will be ours.’

hausa: Yayinda suke cikin jifansa, sai Istifanus ya yi addu’a ya ce, “Ubangiji Yesu, ka karɓi ruhuna.”
english: They stoned Stephen as he called out, saying, “Lord Jesus, receive my spirit!”

hausa: Yanzu da kuka tsarkake kanku ta wurin yin biyayya ga gaskiyan nan, don ku kasance da ƙauna mai gaskiya wa ’yan’uwanku, sai ku ƙaunaci juna ƙwarai, daga zuciya.
english: Seeing you have purified your souls in your obedience to the truth through the Spirit in sincere brotherly affection, love one another from the heart fervently,

hausa: Zan yi ramuwa cikin fushi da hasala a kan al’umman da ba su yi mini biyayya ba.”
english: I will execute vengeance in anger and wrath on the nations that didn’t listen.”

hausa: Dukan ’yan adam sun gani; mutane sun hanga daga nesa.
english: All men have looked on it. Man sees it afar off.

hausa: Sai ya shiga ciki, ya ce musu, “Mene ne dalilin wannan hayaniya da kuka? Yarinyar ba mutuwa ne ta yi ba, barci take yi.”
english: When he had entered in, he said to them, “Why do you make an uproar and weep? The child is not dead, but is asleep.”

hausa: Ƙaunataccena ya gangara zuwa lambunsa, zuwa inda fangulan kayan yaji suke, don yă yi kiwo a cikin lambun don kuma yă tattara furen bi-rana.
english: My beloved has gone down to his garden, to the beds of spices, to pasture his flock in the gardens, and to gather lilies.

hausa: Na sa ɗan’uwana Hanani tare da Hananiya shugaban fada aikin riƙon Urushalima, domin shi Hananiya mutum mai mutunci ne, mai tsoron Allah fiye da yawancin mutane.
english: I put my brother Hanani, and Hananiah the governor of the fortress, in charge of Jerusalem; for he was a faithful man and feared God above many.

hausa: Ni ne Alfa da kuma Omega, na Fari da kuma na Baya, Farko da kuma Ƙarshe.
english: I am the Alpha and the Omega, the First and the Last, the Beginning and the End.

hausa: Ubangiji kuwa ya ce masa, “Ka saurari dukan maganganun da mutanen suke gaya maka. Ai, ba kai ba ne suka ƙi, ni ne suka ƙi in zama sarkinsu.
english: Yahweh said to Samuel, “Listen to the voice of the people in all that they tell you; for they have not rejected you, but they have rejected me as the king over them.

hausa: Sa’ad da Fir’auna ya bar mutane su tafi, Allah bai bi da su a hanyar da ta bi ta iyakar Filistiyawa ba, ko da yake wannan hanya ce ta fi kusa. Gama Allah ya ce, “In suka fuskanci yaƙi, wataƙila su canja ra’ayinsu su koma Masar.”
english: When Pharaoh had let the people go, God didn’t lead them by the way of the land of the Philistines, although that was near; for God said, “Lest perhaps the people change their minds when they see war, and they return to Egypt”;

hausa: “Mene ne mutum, har da zai zama da tsarki, ko kuma mace ta haife shi, har yă iya zama mai adalci?
english: What is man, that he should be clean? What is he who is born of a woman, that he should be righteous?

hausa: Sa’an nan Ruhu ya ɗaga ni sama ya kawo ni ƙofar gidan Ubangiji wadda take fuskantar gabas. Can a mashigi zuwa ƙofar akwai mutum ashirin da biyar, na kuma ga a cikinsu akwai Ya’azaniya ɗan Azzur da Felatiya ɗan Benahiya, shugabannin jama’a.
english: Moreover the Spirit lifted me up and brought me to the east gate of Yahweh’s house, which looks eastward. Behold, twenty-five men were at the door of the gate; and I saw among them Jaazaniah the son of Azzur, and Pelatiah the son of Benaiah, princes of the people.

hausa: Kwana shida za ka yi dukan aikinka,
english: You shall labor six days, and do all your work,

hausa: Game da dukan sauran abubuwan da suka faru a zamani Ahaziya, da abin da ya yi, ba a rubuce suke a littattafan tarihin sarakuna Isra’ila ba?
english: Now the rest of the acts of Ahaziah which he did, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

hausa: A wannan rana Masarawa za su zama kamar mata. Za su yi rawar jiki lokacin da Ubangiji Maɗaukaki ya ɗaga hannu a kansu.
english: In that day the Egyptians will be like women. They will tremble and fear because of the shaking of Yahweh of Armies’s hand, which he shakes over them.

hausa: Saboda haka Abram ya ce wa Lot, “Kada mu bar rikici yă shiga tsakaninmu, ko kuma tsakanin masu kiwon dabbobinka da nawa, gama mu ’yan’uwa ne.
english: Abram said to Lot, “Please, let there be no strife between you and me, and between your herdsmen and my herdsmen; for we are relatives.

hausa: Wataƙila sarki zai yarda yă ceci baiwarsa daga hannun mutumin nan da yake ƙoƙari yă hallaka ni da ɗana daga gādon da Allah ya ba mu.’
english: For the king will hear, to deliver his servant out of the hand of the man who would destroy me and my son together out of the inheritance of God.

hausa: Sa’ad da dukan waɗanda suka san shi a dā suka gan shi yana annabci tare da annabawa, sai suka tambayi juna, suka ce, “Me ya faru da ɗan Kish? Shawulu ma yana cikin annabawa ne?”
english: When all who knew him before saw that, behold, he prophesied with the prophets, then the people said to one another, “What is this that has come to the son of Kish? Is Saul also among the prophets?”

hausa: Za su jefar da kai cikin rami, za ka kuwa yi muguwar mutuwa a tsakiyar tekuna.
english: They will bring you down to the pit. You will die the death of those who are slain in the heart of the seas.

hausa: “ ‘Kada ku tsattsaga jikunanku saboda matattu, ba kuwa za ku yi wa kanku zāne-zāne a jiki ba. Ni ne Ubangiji.
english: “‘You shall not make any cuttings in your flesh for the dead, nor tattoo any marks on you. I am Yahweh.

hausa: Zo, mu sauka, mu rikitar da harshensu don kada su fahimci juna.”
english: Come, let’s go down, and there confuse their language, that they may not understand one another’s speech.”

hausa: Keros, Siyaha, Fadon,
english: the children of Keros, the children of Siaha, the children of Padon,

hausa: “Mai fansa zai zo Sihiyona, zuwa waɗanda suke cikin Yaƙub da suka tuba daga zunubansu,” in ji Ubangiji.
english: “A Redeemer will come to Zion, and to those who turn from disobedience in Jacob,” says Yahweh.

hausa: Da na ji waɗannan abubuwa, sai na zauna na yi kuka. Na yi kwanaki ina makoki da azumi, na kuma yi addu’a a gaban Allah na sama.
english: When I heard these words, I sat down and wept, and mourned several days; and I fasted and prayed before the God of heaven,

hausa: Mugaye sukan zare takobi su ja baka don su kashe matalauta da masu bukata, don su kashe waɗanda hanyoyinsu daidai suke.
english: The wicked have drawn out the sword, and have bent their bow, to cast down the poor and needy, to kill those who are upright on the path.

hausa: Saboda haka Musa ya ce wa alƙalan Isra’ila, “Dole kowannenku yă kashe mutanen nan da suka haɗa kai cikin bautar Ba’al-Feyor.”
english: Moses said to the judges of Israel, “Everyone kill his men who have joined themselves to Baal Peor.”

hausa: Wannan shi ne ƙarfin halin da muke da shi sa’ad da muke zuwa a gaban Allah, gama mun san cewa kome muka roƙa bisa ga nufinsa, yakan saurare mu.
english: This is the boldness which we have toward him, that if we ask anything according to his will, he listens to us.

hausa: Abin da sarki yake nema yana da wuya matuƙa. Babu wani da zai iya bayyana wannan ga sarki sai dai alloli; kuma ba su zama tare da ’yan adam.”
english: It is a rare thing that the king requires, and there is no other who can show it before the king except the gods, whose dwelling is not with flesh.”

hausa: Na aike shi gare ku musamman don wannan, domin ku san yadda muke, yă kuma ƙarfafa ku.
english: I have sent him to you for this very purpose, that you may know our state and that he may comfort your hearts.

hausa: Suka ƙone dukan garuruwan da Midiyawa suke zama, da dukan sansaninsu.
english: All their cities in the places in which they lived, and all their encampments, they burned with fire.

hausa: Da kaka Urdun yakan cika makil da ruwa. Duk da haka da zarar firistoci masu ɗauke da akwatin alkawari suka tsoma ƙafafunsu a gefen ruwa,
english: and when those who bore the ark had come to the Jordan, and the feet of the priests who bore the ark had dipped in the edge of the water (for the Jordan overflows all its banks all the time of harvest),

hausa: Bayan da Yoshuwa ya rasu, Isra’ilawa suka tambayi Ubangiji suka ce, “Wane ne zai fara tafiya don yă yaƙi Kan’aniyawa dominmu?”
english: After the death of Joshua, the children of Israel asked of Yahweh, saying, “Who should go up for us first against the Canaanites, to fight against them?”

hausa: Gidan Yaƙub zai zama kamar wuta, gidan Yusuf kuma kamar harshen wuta; gidan Isuwa zai zama kamar tattaka, za a kuma sa masa wuta yă ƙone. Babu wanda zai tsira daga gidan Isuwa.” Ni Ubangiji na faɗa.
english: The house of Jacob will be a fire, the house of Joseph a flame, and the house of Esau for stubble. They will burn among them and devour them. There will not be any remaining to the house of Esau.” Indeed, Yahweh has spoken.

hausa: “Ubangiji zai yi mulki har abada abadin.”
english: Yahweh will reign forever and ever.”

hausa: Abokan tafiyata suka ja ni a hannu zuwa cikin Damaskus, saboda ƙarfin hasken ya makanta ni.
english: When I couldn’t see for the glory of that light, being led by the hand of those who were with me, I came into Damascus.

hausa: Saboda haka zan zuba hasalata a kansu in cinye su da wutar fushina, ina ɗora alhakin ayyukansu a bisa kawunansu, in ji Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka.”
english: Therefore I have poured out my indignation on them. I have consumed them with the fire of my wrath. I have brought their own way on their heads,” says the Lord Yahweh.

hausa: Ko da yake wannan haikali yanzu mai girma ne, dukan wanda ya wuce zai kaɗa kai yă ce, ‘Me ya sa Ubangiji ya yi irin wannan abu ga wannan ƙasa da kuma ga wannan haikali?’
english: This house, which is so high, everyone who passes by it will be astonished and say, ‘Why has Yahweh done this to this land and to this house?’

hausa: Ku yi shelar wannan ga al’ummai. Ku yi shirin yaƙi! Ku tā da jarumawa! Bari mayaƙa su ja kusa su kai hari.
english: Proclaim this among the nations: “Prepare for war! Stir up the mighty men. Let all the warriors draw near. Let them come up.

hausa: Sai Ubangiji ya ce wa Yoshuwa, “Ka riƙe māshin da yake hannunka ka nuna wajen Ai, gama zan ba da birnin a hannunka.” Yoshuwa kuwa ya miƙa māshin ta wajen Ai.
english: Yahweh said to Joshua, “Stretch out the javelin that is in your hand toward Ai, for I will give it into your hand.” Joshua stretched out the javelin that was in his hand toward the city.

hausa: Shugaban masu shayarwa fa, bai tuna da Yusuf ba; ya mance da shi.
english: Yet the chief cup bearer didn’t remember Joseph, but forgot him.

hausa: Ki yi ihu, ya Diyar Gallim! Ki saurara, ya Layisha! Kayya, Anatot abin tausayi!
english: Cry aloud with your voice, daughter of Gallim! Listen, Laishah! You poor Anathoth!

hausa: Zinariya akwai ta, lu’ulu’u kuma ga shi a yalwace, amma leɓunan da suke magana da sani suna da wuyan samu kamar duwatsu masu daraja.
english: There is gold and abundance of rubies, but the lips of knowledge are a rare jewel.

hausa: Sa’an nan Ubangiji ya ce wa Abram, “Ka sani tabbatacce cewa shekaru ɗari huɗu, zuriyarka za tă zama baƙi a ƙasar da ba tasu ba, za a mai da su bayi, a kuma wulaƙanta su.
english: He said to Abram, “Know for sure that your offspring will live as foreigners in a land that is not theirs, and will serve them. They will afflict them four hundred years.

hausa: Nan da nan, sai Ruhu ya kai shi cikin hamada,
english: Immediately the Spirit drove him out into the wilderness.

hausa: Sai Fir’auna ya aika aka kira Musa, ya kuma ce, “Ku tafi, ku yi wa Ubangiji sujada. Matanku da yaranku ma za su iya tafiya tare da ku; sai dai ku bar garkunanku na shanu da tumaki.”
english: Pharaoh called to Moses, and said, “Go, serve Yahweh. Only let your flocks and your herds stay behind. Let your little ones also go with you.”

hausa: Ka dalaye dukan katakan da zinariya, ka kuma yi zoban zinariya don su riƙe sandunan. Ka kuma dalaye sandunan da zinariya.
english: You shall overlay the boards with gold, and make their rings of gold for places for the bars. You shall overlay the bars with gold.

hausa: Muna da ciki, mun yi ta murɗewa saboda zafi, amma mun haifi iska. Ba mu kawo ceto ga duniya ba; ba mu haifi mutanen duniya ba.
english: We have been with child. We have been in pain. We gave birth, it seems, only to wind. We have not worked any deliverance on the earth; neither have the inhabitants of the world fallen.

hausa: Ya aika da tarin ƙudajen da suka cinye su, da kwaɗin da suka wahalshe su.
english: He sent among them swarms of flies, which devoured them; and frogs, which destroyed them.

hausa: ’Ya’yan Isuwa maza, su ne, Elifaz, Reyuwel, Yewush, Yalam da Kora
english: The sons of Esau: Eliphaz, Reuel, Jeush, Jalam, and Korah.

hausa: Masu girman kai sun sa mini tarko; sun shimfiɗa igiyoyin ragarsu sun kuma shirya mini tarko a hanyata. Sela
english: The proud have hidden a snare for me, they have spread the cords of a net by the path. They have set traps for me. Selah.

hausa: Manomi mai aiki sosai ya kamata yă zama na fari wajen samun rabon amfanin gona.
english: The farmer who labors must be the first to get a share of the crops.

hausa: Game da sauran ayyukan mulkin Nadab da kuma dukan abin da ya yi, duk a rubuce suke a cikin littafin tarihin sarakunan Isra’ila.
english: Now the rest of the acts of Nadab, and all that he did, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

hausa: Hananiya, Elam, Antotiya,
english: Hananiah, Elam, Anthothijah,

hausa: To, an yi wani mutum mai suna Lazarus wanda ya yi rashin lafiya. Shi daga Betani ne, ƙauyen su Maryamu da ’yar’uwarta Marta.
english: Now a certain man was sick, Lazarus from Bethany, of the village of Mary and her sister, Martha.

hausa: Hikima ta yi wa wawa nisa ƙwarai a cikin taro a ƙofar gari ba shi da ta cewa.
english: Wisdom is too high for a fool. He doesn’t open his mouth in the gate.

hausa: Har yanzu, wani mala’ika mai lura da wuta, ya fito daga bagaden ya yi kira da babbar murya ga wannan wanda yake da lauje mai kaifi ya ce, “Ɗauki laujenka mai kaifi ka tattara kawunan ’ya’yan inabi daga kuringar inabin duniya, domin ’ya’yan inabin sun nuna.”
english: Another angel came out from the altar, he who has power over fire, and he called with a great voice to him who had the sharp sickle, saying, “Send your sharp sickle and gather the clusters of the vine of the earth, for the earth’s grapes are fully ripe!”

hausa: Sa’ad da Ubangiji ya ga sun ƙasƙantar da kansu, sai wannan maganar Ubangiji ta zo wa Shemahiya, “Tun da yake sun ƙasƙantar da kansu, to, ba zan hallaka su ba, amma zan cece su, ba zan kwararo fushina ta hannun Shishak a kan Urushalima ba.
english: When Yahweh saw that they humbled themselves, Yahweh’s word came to Shemaiah, saying, “They have humbled themselves. I will not destroy them, but I will grant them some deliverance, and my wrath won’t be poured out on Jerusalem by the hand of Shishak.

hausa: Elkana, Zofai, Nahat,
english: As for Elkanah, the sons of Elkanah: Zophai his son, Nahath his son,

hausa: Da suna magana, kuma suna tattauna waɗannan abubuwa da junansu, sai Yesu da kansa ya zo yana tafiya tare da su.
english: While they talked and questioned together, Jesus himself came near, and went with them.

hausa: “Sa’ad da yunwa ko annoba ta fāɗo a ƙasar, ko burtuntuna, ko fumfuna, ko fāri, ko tsutsa, ko kuwa abokan gāba sun yi musu kwanto, a wani daga cikin biranensu, duk wata cuta, ko ciwon da ya zo,
english: “If there is famine in the land, if there is pestilence, if there is blight, mildew, locust or caterpillar; if their enemy besieges them in the land of their cities, whatever plague, whatever sickness there is,

hausa: “Ka sa a kawo maka Haruna ɗan’uwanka, tare da ’ya’yansa Nadab da Abihu, Eleyazar da Itamar daga cikin Isra’ilawa, domin su yi mini hidima a matsayin firistoci.
english: “Bring Aaron your brother, and his sons with him, near to you from among the children of Israel, that he may minister to me in the priest’s office: Aaron, with Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar, Aaron’s sons.

hausa: Ya horar da hannuwana don yaƙi; hannuwana za su iya tanƙware bakan tagulla.
english: He teaches my hands to war, so that my arms bend a bow of bronze.

hausa: Kada ka kwanta kana fako kamar ɗan iska don ƙwace gidan adali, kada ka ƙwace masa wurin zama;
english: Don’t lay in wait, wicked man, against the habitation of the righteous. Don’t destroy his resting place;

hausa: Sai suka ce wa junansu, “Mu naɗa wa kanmu shugaba, mu koma Masar.”
english: They said to one another, “Let’s choose a leader, and let’s return into Egypt.”

hausa: Za su tā da muryarsu su yi kuka mai zafi a kanki; za su yayyafa ƙura a kawunansu, su yi ta birgima a cikin toka.
english: and will cause their voice to be heard over you, and will cry bitterly. They will cast up dust on their heads. They will wallow in the ashes.

hausa: “Ya Isra’ila, an kashe darajarki a kan tuddanki. Ga shi, jarumawa sun fāɗi!
english: “Your glory, Israel, was slain on your high places! How the mighty have fallen!

hausa: Da Sama’ila ya ji duk maganganun da mutanen suka faɗa, sai ya mayar wa Ubangiji.
english: Samuel heard all the words of the people, and he rehearsed them in the ears of Yahweh.

hausa: kun ɗauki sabon halin nan da ake sabuntawa ga sani, bisa ga kamannin Mahaliccinsa.
english: and have put on the new man, who is being renewed in knowledge after the image of his Creator,

hausa: Amma a ɗauke shi a matsayin ma’aikacin da aka ɗauka aiki, ko mazaunan da ba na ɗinɗinɗin ba a cikinku, sai yă yi muku aiki sai Shekara ta Murna.
english: As a hired servant, and as a temporary resident, he shall be with you; he shall serve with you until the Year of Jubilee.

hausa: Sa’ad da inuwar yamma ya fāɗo a ƙofofin Urushalima kafin Asabbaci, na umarta a rufe ƙofofi kuma kada a buɗe sai Asabbaci ya wuce. Na kafa waɗansu mutanena a ƙofofin don kada a shigo da wani kaya a ranar Asabbaci.
english: It came to pass that when the gates of Jerusalem began to be dark before the Sabbath, I commanded that the doors should be shut, and commanded that they should not be opened until after the Sabbath. I set some of my servants over the gates, so that no burden should be brought in on the Sabbath day.

hausa: Zai zama kamar ruwan sama mai fāɗuwa a filin ciyayin da aka yanka, kamar yayyafi mai ba wa duniya ruwa.
english: He will come down like rain on the mown grass, as showers that water the earth.

hausa: Sai aka huda katanga sa’an nan dukan sojoji suka tsere da dare a ƙofa tsakanin katanga biyu da suke kusa da lambun sarki, ko da yake Babiloniyawa sun kewaye birnin. Suka tsere suka nufi Araba.
english: Then a breach was made in the city, and all the men of war fled by night by the way of the gate between the two walls, which was by the king’s garden (now the Chaldeans were against the city around it); and the king went by the way of the Arabah.

hausa: Sarki Zedekiya ya yi umarni a ajiye Irmiya a sansanin matsara a kuma ba shi burodi daga titin masu gashin burodi kowace rana sai duka burodi a birnin ya ƙare. Saboda haka Irmiya ya zauna a sansanin matsara.
english: Then Zedekiah the king commanded, and they committed Jeremiah into the court of the guard. They gave him daily a loaf of bread out of the bakers’ street, until all the bread in the city was gone. Thus Jeremiah remained in the court of the guard.

hausa: Danna, Kiriyat Sanna (wato, Debir),
english: Dannah, Kiriath Sannah (which is Debir),

hausa: ’Ya’yan Eliyohenai su ne, Hodawiya, Eliyashib, Felahiya, Akkub, Yohanan, Delahiya da Anani, su bakwai ne duka.
english: The sons of Elioenai: Hodaviah, Eliashib, Pelaiah, Akkub, Johanan, Delaiah, and Anani, seven.

hausa: Ban da haka ma, kana gani cewa na zo in hallaka wannan wuri ne ba tare da na ji daga Ubangiji ba? Ubangiji da kansa ne ya ce da ni in kawo wa wannan ƙasa hari in hallaka ta.’ ”
english: Have I now come up without Yahweh against this place to destroy it? Yahweh said to me, ‘Go up against this land, and destroy it.’”’”

hausa: “Bawan ya durƙusa a gabansa. Ya yi roƙo ya ce, ‘Ka yi mini haƙuri, zan biya ka ƙaf.’
english: The servant therefore fell down and knelt before him, saying, ‘Lord, have patience with me, and I will repay you all!’

hausa: Kada ku bi waɗansu alloli, allolin mutanen da suke kewaye da ku;
english: You shall not go after other gods, of the gods of the peoples who are around you,

hausa: Sai maganar Ubangiji ta zo wa Irmiya cewa,
english: Yahweh’s word came to Jeremiah, saying,

hausa: Ɗan shi ne hasken ɗaukakar Allah, shi ne kuma ainihin kamanninsa, yana riƙe da dukan abubuwa ta wurin kalmarsa mai iko. Bayan ya yi tsarkakewa don zunubai, sai ya zauna a hannun daman Maɗaukaki a sama.
english: His Son is the radiance of his glory, the very image of his substance, and upholding all things by the word of his power, who, when he had by himself purified us of our sins, sat down on the right hand of the Majesty on high,

hausa: Yanzu sai ku gyara hanyoyinku da kuma ayyukanku ku yi biyayya da Ubangiji Allahnku. Sa’an nan Ubangiji zai yi juyayi ya kuma janye masifar da ya furta zai kawo a kanku.
english: Now therefore amend your ways and your doings, and obey Yahweh your God’s voice; then Yahweh will relent from the evil that he has pronounced against you.

hausa: Sai Bitrus ya ce, “Ananiyas, ta yaya Shaiɗan ya cika zuciyarka haka da ka yi wa Ruhu Mai Tsarki ƙarya ka kuma ajiye wa kanka sauran kuɗin da ka karɓa na filin?
english: But Peter said, “Ananias, why has Satan filled your heart to lie to the Holy Spirit and to keep back part of the price of the land?

hausa: A wannan rana Ubangiji Maɗaukaki zai zama rawani mai daraja kyakkyawan rawani wa mutanensa da suka ragu.
english: In that day, Yahweh of Armies will become a crown of glory and a diadem of beauty to the residue of his people,

hausa: Sai suka tottofa masa miyau a fuskarsa, suka kuma bubbuge shi da hannuwansu. Waɗansu kuma suka mammare shi
english: Then they spat in his face and beat him with their fists, and some slapped him,

hausa: Sun yi hidima a kwanakin Yohiyakim ɗan Yeshuwa, ɗan Yozadak, kuma a kwanakin Nehemiya gwamna da kuma na Ezra firist da kuma marubuci.
english: These were in the days of Joiakim the son of Jeshua, the son of Jozadak, and in the days of Nehemiah the governor, and of Ezra the priest and scribe.

hausa: Ya ɗauki kekunan yaƙi ɗari shida mafi kyau duka, tare da duk sauran keken yaƙin Masar, da shugabanni kuma a kan dukansu.
english: and he took six hundred chosen chariots, and all the chariots of Egypt, with captains over all of them.

hausa: “Kash, da ma wani daga cikinku ya rufe ƙofofin haikali don kada ku shiga, ku hura wuta marar amfani a bisa bagadena! Ba na jin daɗinku, ba zan kuwa karɓi hadaya daga hannuwanku ba” in ji Ubangiji Maɗaukaki.
english: “Oh that there were one among you who would shut the doors, that you might not kindle fire on my altar in vain! I have no pleasure in you,” says Yahweh of Armies, “neither will I accept an offering at your hand.

hausa: Don mai bi da kaɗe-kaɗe. Da muryar “Kada Ka Hallaka.” Ta Dawuda. Wani miktam. Ku masu mulki tabbatacce kuna magana daidai? Kuna yin shari’a daidai a cikin mutane?
english: For the Chief Musician. To the tune of “Do Not Destroy.” A poem by David. Do you indeed speak righteousness, silent ones? Do you judge blamelessly, you sons of men?

hausa: Ku kuma yi matuƙar amfani da kowane zarafi, don kwanakin nan mugaye ne.
english: redeeming the time, because the days are evil.

hausa: Kuna yin abubuwan da ubanku yake yi ne.” Suka ce, “Mu fa ba shegu ba ne. Uba guda kaɗai da muke da shi, shi ne Allah kansa.”
english: You do the works of your father.” They said to him, “We were not born of sexual immorality. We have one Father, God.”

hausa: Gama ga abin da Ubangiji ya faɗa, “Wa bābānnin da suna kiyaye Asabbatai, waɗanda suka zaɓi yin abin da ya gamshe ni suna kuma riƙe da alkawarina kankan,
english: For Yahweh says, “To the eunuchs who keep my Sabbaths, choose the things that please me, and hold fast to my covenant,

hausa: Musa ya koma wurin Ubangiji ya ce, “Ya Ubangiji, don me ka kawo wahala a kan mutanen nan? Abin da ya sa ka aiko ni ke nan?
english: Moses returned to Yahweh, and said, “Lord, why have you brought trouble on this people? Why is it that you have sent me?

hausa: Dawuda ya ce, “Da kyau, zan yi yarjejjeniya da kai, amma fa ina bukata abu guda daga gare ka, kada ka zo gabana in ba tare da matata Mikal, ’yar Shawulu ba.”
english: David said, “Good. I will make a treaty with you, but one thing I require of you. That is, you will not see my face unless you first bring Michal, Saul’s daughter, when you come to see my face.”

hausa: Ya kuwa ɓata suna bawanka a gaban ranka yă daɗe, sarki. Ranka yă daɗe, sarki yana kama da mala’ikan Allah, ka yi abin da ka ga ya fi maka kyau.
english: He has slandered your servant to my lord the king, but my lord the king is as an angel of God. Therefore do what is good in your eyes.

hausa: “Yanzu ka tashi, ya Ubangiji Allah, ka zo wurin hutunka,
english: “Now therefore arise, Yahweh God, into your resting place, you, and the ark of your strength. Let your priests, Yahweh God, be clothed with salvation, and let your saints rejoice in goodness.

hausa: Masu wucewa suka zazzage shi. Suka kaɗa kai suna cewa, “To, kai da za ka rushe haikali ka kuma gina shi a kwana uku,
english: Those who passed by blasphemed him, wagging their heads and saying, “Ha! You who destroy the temple and build it in three days,

hausa: Dole mu yi ƙoƙarin zama balagaggu mu kuma fara tunani game da abubuwan da suka fi koyarwan nan mai sauƙi game da Kiristi. Bai kamata mu ci gaba da magana game da me ya sa dole mu juye daga ayyukan da suke kawo mutuwa da kuma me ya sa za mu kasance da bangaskiya a cikin Allah ba.
english: Therefore leaving the teaching of the first principles of Christ, let’s press on to perfection—not laying again a foundation of repentance from dead works, of faith toward God,

hausa: Sa’ad da halittun sun motsa, sai su ma su motsa; sa’ad da halittun sun tsaya cik, su ma sai su tsaya cik, sa’ad da kuma halittun sukan tashi sama, da’irorin suka tashi tare da su, domin ruhun rayayyun halittun nan yana a cikin da’irorin.
english: When those went, these went. When those stood, these stood. When those were lifted up from the earth, the wheels were lifted up beside them; for the spirit of the living creature was in the wheels.

hausa: na Lod, da na Hadid, da na Ono 721
english: The children of Lod, Hadid, and Ono: seven hundred twenty-one.

hausa: Sa’an nan Samson ya yi addu’a ga Ubangiji ya ce, “Ya Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka, ya Allah ka tuna da ni, ka ƙarfafa ni sau ɗaya nan kaɗai, ka bar ni da bugu ɗaya kawai in ɗauki fansa a kan Filistiyawa domin idanuna.”
english: Samson called to Yahweh, and said, “Lord Yahweh, remember me, please, and strengthen me, please, only this once, God, that I may be at once avenged of the Philistines for my two eyes.”

hausa: Ka juye zuciyata wajen farillanka ba wajen riba ta sonkai ba.
english: Turn my heart toward your statutes, not toward selfish gain.

hausa: Sa’an nan sarkin ya umarci Ashfenaz, shugaban fadarsa yă kawo waɗansu daga cikin Isra’ilawan da suka fito daga gidan sarauta da kuma na fitattun mutane.
english: The king spoke to Ashpenaz, the master of his eunuchs, that he should bring in some of the children of Israel, even of the royal offspring and of the nobles:

hausa: Maganar Ubangiji ta zo mini cewa,
english: Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

hausa: Amma nan da nan Yesu ya ce musu, “Ku yi ƙarfin hali! Ni ne. Kada ku ji tsoro.”
english: But immediately Jesus spoke to them, saying, “Cheer up! It is I! Don’t be afraid.”

hausa: ta bakwai a kan Yesarela, ’ya’yansa maza da danginsa, 12
english: the seventh to Jesharelah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

hausa: A ranan nan zan fito don in hallaka dukan al’umman da suka yaƙi Urushalima.
english: It will happen in that day, that I will seek to destroy all the nations that come against Jerusalem.

hausa: Amma ku za ku karɓi iko sa’ad da Ruhu Mai Tsarki ya sauka a kanku; za ku kuma zama shaiduna cikin Urushalima, da kuma cikin dukan Yahudiya da Samariya, zuwa kuma iyakar duniya.”
english: But you will receive power when the Holy Spirit has come upon you. You will be witnesses to me in Jerusalem, in all Judea and Samaria, and to the uttermost parts of the earth.”

hausa: “Ku tattaru, dukanku ku kuma saurara, Wanne a cikin gumakan ya iya faɗa waɗannan abubuwa? Zaɓaɓɓen da Ubangiji yake ƙauna zai aikata nufinsa a kan Babilon; hannunsa zai yi gāba da Babiloniyawa.
english: “Assemble yourselves, all of you, and hear! Who among them has declared these things? He whom Yahweh loves will do what he likes to Babylon, and his arm will be against the Chaldeans.

hausa: “In cutar fatar jiki da take ta rigar ta sāke bayyana a gidan bayan an ciccire duwatsu aka kankare gidan aka kuma yi shafe,
english: “If the plague comes again, and breaks out in the house after he has taken out the stones, and after he has scraped the house, and after it was plastered,

hausa: Kuma ko’ina da suka tafi a cikin al’ummai sun ɓata sunana mai tsarki, gama an yi magana a kansu cewa, ‘Waɗannan mutanen Ubangiji ne, duk da haka dole su bar ƙasarsa.’
english: When they came to the nations where they went, they profaned my holy name, in that men said of them, ‘These are Yahweh’s people, and have left his land.’

hausa: Duka sun kauce, duka gaba ɗaya sun zama lalatattu; babu ɗaya wanda yake yin abu mai kyau, ba ko ɗaya.
english: They have all gone aside. They have together become corrupt. There is no one who does good, no, not one.

hausa: “Ka kai mai saɓon nan waje da sansani. Duk waɗanda suka ji maganar da mai saɓon nan ya yi su ɗibiya hannuwansu a kansa, taron jama’a kuwa gaba ɗaya su jajjefe shi da duwatsu.
english: “Bring him who cursed out of the camp; and let all who heard him lay their hands on his head, and let all the congregation stone him.

hausa: Gidan adali yana da dukiya mai yawa, amma albashin mugaye kan kawo musu wahala.
english: In the house of the righteous is much treasure, but the income of the wicked brings trouble.

hausa: Amma idan ’yar firist ta zama gwauruwa ko sakakkiya, ba ta da ’ya’ya, ta kuwa dawo don tă zauna a gidan mahaifinta kamar matashiya, za tă iya cin abincin.
english: But if a priest’s daughter is a widow, or divorced, and has no child, and has returned to her father’s house as in her youth, she may eat of her father’s bread; but no stranger shall eat any of it.

hausa: Ibrahim shi ne mahaifin Ishaku. ’Ya’yan Ishaku maza su ne, Isuwa da Isra’ila.
english: Abraham became the father of Isaac. The sons of Isaac: Esau and Israel.

hausa: Ya fi kyau in nemi mafaka a wurin Ubangiji da in dogara ga mutum.
english: It is better to take refuge in Yahweh, than to put confidence in man.

hausa: “Ka san cewa saboda yaƙe-yaƙen da abokan gāba suka yi da mahaifina a kowane gefe, ya sa bai iya gina haikali domin Sunan Ubangiji Allahnsa ba, sai da Ubangiji ya sa abokan gābansa a ƙarƙashin ƙafafunsa.
english: “You know that David my father could not build a house for the name of Yahweh his God because of the wars which were around him on every side, until Yahweh put his enemies under the soles of his feet.

hausa: Ubangiji kuwa ya yi haka. Tarin ƙuda suka zubo a fadar Fir’auna da cikin gidajen bayinsa, da ko’ina a Masar, ƙasar kuwa ta lalace saboda ƙudaje.
english: Yahweh did so; and there came grievous swarms of flies into the house of Pharaoh, and into his servants’ houses. In all the land of Egypt the land was corrupted by reason of the swarms of flies.

hausa: Ka cece ni daga dukan laifofina; kada ka sa in zama abin dariya ga wawaye.
english: Deliver me from all my transgressions. Don’t make me the reproach of the foolish.

hausa: Suka sa masa wata riga mai ruwan shunayya, suka kuma tuƙa rawanin ƙaya suka sa masa.
english: They clothed him with purple; and weaving a crown of thorns, they put it on him.

hausa: Bari kawunan waɗanda suka kewaye ni su rufu da masifun da leɓunansu suka jawo.
english: As for the head of those who surround me, let the mischief of their own lips cover them.

hausa: Sa’an nan daga cikin kwandon burodi marar yisti wanda yake a gaban Ubangiji, ya ɗauko dunƙulen burodi, da kuma guda da aka yi da mai, da kuma ƙosai; ya sa waɗannan a sassan kitsen, da kuma a cinya ta dama.
english: and out of the basket of unleavened bread that was before Yahweh, he took one unleavened cake, one cake of oiled bread, and one wafer, and placed them on the fat and on the right thigh.

hausa: Suka ce wa Haruna, ‘Ka yi mana allolin da za su yi mana jagora. Game da wannan Musa ɗin wanda ya fitar da mu daga Masar, ba mu san abin da ya faru da shi ba!’
english: saying to Aaron, ‘Make us gods that will go before us, for as for this Moses who led us out of the land of Egypt, we don’t know what has become of him.’

hausa: Suka kashe Hamor da ɗansa Shekem da takobi, suka ɗauko Dina daga gidan Shekem suka tafi.
english: They killed Hamor and Shechem, his son, with the edge of the sword, and took Dinah out of Shechem’s house, and went away.

hausa: Ana cikin haka Bowaz ya haura zuwa ƙofar gari ya tafi ya zauna a can. Sa’ad da dangi mai fansan da ya yi zance ya iso, Bowaz ya ce, “Zo nan abokina ka zauna.” Saboda haka ya ratso ya zauna.
english: Now Boaz went up to the gate and sat down there. Behold, the near kinsman of whom Boaz spoke came by. Boaz said to him, “Come over here, friend, and sit down!” He came over, and sat down.

hausa: Waɗansu suka ce, “Mu da ’ya’yanmu maza da mata muna da yawa, muna bukatar hatsi domin mu ci mu rayu.”
english: For there were some who said, “We, our sons and our daughters, are many. Let us get grain, that we may eat and live.”

hausa: Bari firistocin da suke yin hidima a gaban Ubangiji, su yi kuka tsakanin filin haikali da bagade. Bari su ce, “Ka cece mutanenka, ya Ubangiji. Kada ka bar gādonka yă zama abin dariya, da abin ba’a a cikin al’ummai. Me zai sa a ce a cikin mutane, ‘Ina Allahnsu yake?’ ”
english: Let the priests, the ministers of Yahweh, weep between the porch and the altar, and let them say, “Spare your people, Yahweh, and don’t give your heritage to reproach, that the nations should rule over them. Why should they say among the peoples, ‘Where is their God?’”

hausa: Sa’an nan Ubangiji ya yi magana ga mala’ikan, ya kuma mayar da takobinsa a kube.
english: Then Yahweh commanded the angel, and he put his sword back into its sheath.

hausa: Gama ikon asirin tawaye ya riga ya fara aiki; sai dai wannan da yake hana shi zai ci gaba da yin haka sai an kau da shi.
english: For the mystery of lawlessness already works. Only there is one who restrains now, until he is taken out of the way.

hausa: Ya kuwa yarda musu, sai mugayen ruhohin suka fita suka shiga cikin aladun. Garken kuwa, yana da kusan aladu dubu biyu, suka gangara daga kan tudun zuwa cikin tafkin, suka nutse.
english: At once Jesus gave them permission. The unclean spirits came out and entered into the pigs. The herd of about two thousand rushed down the steep bank into the sea, and they were drowned in the sea.

hausa: Wannan doka ta shafi batun bijimin da ya kashe ɗa ko ’ya.
english: Whether it has gored a son or has gored a daughter, according to this judgment it shall be done to him.

hausa: Sai na ga wani abu kuma a duniya, a wurin shari’a, akwai mugunta a can, a wurin adalci, akwai mugunta a can.
english: Moreover I saw under the sun, in the place of justice, that wickedness was there; and in the place of righteousness, that wickedness was there.

hausa: Sun yi arangama da ni a ranar masifa, amma Ubangiji ya zama mai taimakona.
english: They came on me in the day of my calamity, but Yahweh was my support.

hausa: Da suka haye, sai suka sauka a Gennesaret, suka daure jirgin a ƙugiya.
english: When they had crossed over, they came to land at Gennesaret and moored to the shore.

hausa: In ’yar firist ta auri wani da ba firist ba, ba za tă ci wani tsarkakakkun sadaka ba.
english: If a priest’s daughter is married to an outsider, she shall not eat of the heave offering of the holy things.

hausa: Amma bari dukan masu nemanka su yi farin ciki su kuma yi murna a cikinka; bari waɗanda suke ƙaunar cetonka kullum su ce, “Ubangiji mai girma ne!”
english: Let all those who seek you rejoice and be glad in you. Let such as love your salvation say continually, “Let Yahweh be exalted!”

hausa: Na yi murna a cikin ƙa’idodinka; ba zan ƙyale maganarka ba.
english: I will delight myself in your statutes. I will not forget your word. GIMEL

hausa: Ka ɓoye fuskarka daga zunubaina ka kuma shafe dukan kurakuraina.
english: Hide your face from my sins, and blot out all of my iniquities.

hausa: Ko ka gane fāɗin duniya? Gaya mini, in ka san wannan duka.
english: Have you comprehended the earth in its width? Declare, if you know it all.

hausa: Sa’ad da aka ƙasƙantar da mutane ka kuma ce, ‘A ɗaga su!’ Sa’an nan zai ceci masu tawali’u.
english: When they cast down, you will say, ‘be lifted up.’ He will save the humble person.

hausa: Nesa da inda mutane suke zama, yakan huda rami yă yi abin lilo, a wurin da mutane ba sa bi.
english: He breaks open a shaft away from where people live. They are forgotten by the foot. They hang far from men, they swing back and forth.

hausa: Yesu ya san abin da suke tunani, sai ya yi tambaya ya ce, “Don me kuke tunanin waɗannan abubuwa a zukatanku?
english: But Jesus, perceiving their thoughts, answered them, “Why are you reasoning so in your hearts?

hausa: Amma daga madawwami zuwa madawwami ƙaunar Ubangiji tana tare da waɗanda suke tsoronsa, adalcinsa kuma tare da ’ya’yansu,
english: But Yahweh’s loving kindness is from everlasting to everlasting with those who fear him, his righteousness to children’s children,

hausa: Za ku kuwa san cewa ni ne Ubangiji, gama ba ku bi ƙa’idodina ba balle ku kiyaye dokokina, amma kuka bi hanyoyin al’ummai kewaye da ku.”
english: You will know that I am Yahweh, for you have not walked in my statutes. You have not executed my ordinances, but have done after the ordinances of the nations that are around you.”’”

hausa: Ai, Hezekiya, ruɗinku yake yi, don yă sa ku mutu da yunwa da ƙishirwa sa’ad da yake ce muku, ‘Ubangiji Allahnmu zai cece mu daga hannun sarkin Assuriya.’
english: Doesn’t Hezekiah persuade you to give you over to die by famine and by thirst, saying, ‘Yahweh our God will deliver us out of the hand of the king of Assyria’?

hausa: Masu adalci suna ƙyamar masu rashin gaskiya; mugaye sukan yi ƙyamar masu aikata gaskiya.
english: A dishonest man detests the righteous, and the upright in their ways detest the wicked.

hausa: Sa’an nan Yahuda ya ce wa Isra’ila mahaifinsa, “Ka aika saurayin tare da ni za mu kuwa tafi nan da nan, saboda mu da ’ya’yanmu mu rayu, kada mu mutu.
english: Judah said to Israel, his father, “Send the boy with me, and we’ll get up and go, so that we may live, and not die, both we, and you, and also our little ones.

hausa: Sai maganar Ubangiji ta zo mini cewa,
english: Yahweh’s word came to me again, saying,

hausa: Ana nan, sa’ad da Ammonawa suka kai wa Isra’ilawa hari,
english: After a while, the children of Ammon made war against Israel.

hausa: suka ce wa dukan taron Isra’ilawa, “Ƙasar da muka ratsa, muka kuma leƙi asirinta, tana da kyau sosai.
english: They spoke to all the congregation of the children of Israel, saying, “The land, which we passed through to spy it out, is an exceedingly good land.

hausa: Ka ji, ya Ubangiji, ka kuwa yi mini jinƙai; Ya Ubangiji, ka zama taimakona.”
english: Hear, Yahweh, and have mercy on me. Yahweh, be my helper.”

hausa: Duk wanda yakan ba da amsa kafin ya saurara, wannan wauta ce da kuma abin kunya.
english: He who answers before he hears, that is folly and shame to him.

hausa: Ni tsarkake ne sa’ad da suka same ni cikin filin haikalin ina yin haka. Babu taro tare da ni, ba kuwa ina tā da hankali ba.
english: amid which certain Jews from Asia found me purified in the temple, not with a mob, nor with turmoil.

hausa: Haka kuma ya gina dukan biranen ajiyarsa, da garuruwa domin kekunan yaƙinsa, da garuruwa domin dawakansa. Ya gina duk abin da ya so yă ginawa a Urushalima, da Lebanon, da kuma ko’ina a dukan yankin da ya yi mulki.
english: all the storage cities that Solomon had, the cities for his chariots, the cities for his horsemen, and that which Solomon desired to build for his pleasure in Jerusalem, and in Lebanon, and in all the land of his dominion.

hausa: Ban fasa bin dokokin da ya bayar ba; na riƙe maganarsa da muhimmanci fiye da abincin yau da gobe.
english: I haven’t gone back from the commandment of his lips. I have treasured up the words of his mouth more than my necessary food.

hausa: Sau da sau na aika dukan bayina annabawa gare ku. Suka ce, “Kowannenku ya juyo daga mugayen hanyoyinsa ya sabunta ayyukansa; kada yă bi waɗansu alloli don yă bauta musu. Ta haka za ku zauna a cikin ƙasar da na ba ku da kuma kakanninku.” Amma ba ku saurara ba, ba ku kuwa ji ni ba.
english: I have sent also to you all my servants the prophets, rising up early and sending them, saying, ‘Every one of you must return now from his evil way, amend your doings, and don’t go after other gods to serve them. Then you will dwell in the land which I have given to you and to your fathers;’ but you have not inclined your ear, nor listened to me.

hausa: Ba za a ƙara jin hayaniyar tashin hankali a ƙasarki ba, balle lalacewa ko hallaka a cikin iyakokinki, amma za ki kira katangarki Ceto ƙofofinki kuma Yabo.
english: Violence shall no more be heard in your land, nor desolation or destruction within your borders; but you will call your walls Salvation, and your gates Praise.

hausa: Amma ku zauna da sani a yau, cewa Ubangiji Allahnku, shi ne wanda ya ƙetare ya sha gabanku kamar wuta mai cinyewa. Zai hallaka su, zai rinjaye su a gabanku. Za ku kore su, ku kuma hallaka su nan da nan, yadda Ubangiji ya yi muku alkawari.
english: Know therefore today that Yahweh your God is he who goes over before you as a devouring fire. He will destroy them and he will bring them down before you. So you shall drive them out and make them perish quickly, as Yahweh has spoken to you.

hausa: Domin kun karya zuciyar masu adalci da ƙarairayinku, sa’ad da na fitar da su babu damuwa, kuma domin kun ƙarfafa mugaye kada su juye daga mugayen hanyoyinsu su ceci rayukansu,
english: Because with lies you have grieved the heart of the righteous, whom I have not made sad; and strengthened the hands of the wicked, that he should not return from his wicked way, and be saved alive.

hausa: Taron da suke tare da shi a sa’ad da ya kira Lazarus daga kabari ya kuma tā da shi daga matattu suka yi ta baza labarin.
english: The multitude therefore that was with him when he called Lazarus out of the tomb and raised him from the dead was testifying about it.

hausa: Wanda ta wurin ganewarsa ya yi sammai, Ƙaunarsa madawwamiya ce.
english: to him who by understanding made the heavens, for his loving kindness endures forever;

hausa: Sa’an nan Balak ya ce masa, “Zo, mu tafi wani wuri inda za ka gan su; a nan kana ganin sashe ne kawai, ba dukansu ba. Daga can kuwa, ka la’anta mini su.”
english: Balak said to him, “Please come with me to another place, where you may see them. You shall see just part of them, and shall not see them all. Curse them from there for me.”

hausa: Haka ma ya kamata ku yi murna ku kuma yi farin ciki tare da ni.
english: In the same way, you also should be glad and rejoice with me.

hausa: Sai Yoshuwa ya sa wa Kaleb ɗan Yefunne albarka, ya ba shi Hebron.
english: Joshua blessed him; and he gave Hebron to Caleb the son of Jephunneh for an inheritance.

hausa: Allah kuwa ya albarkaci kwana ta bakwai, ya kuma mai da ita mai tsarki, saboda a kanta ne ya huta daga dukan aikin halittar da ya yi.
english: God blessed the seventh day, and made it holy, because he rested in it from all his work of creation which he had done.

hausa: Dole mutumin da ya ƙone ta yă wanke rigunarsa, yă kuma yi wanka, shi ma zai kasance da ƙazanta har yamma.
english: He who burns her shall wash his clothes in water, and bathe his flesh in water, and shall be unclean until the evening.

hausa: “Ku ce wa Diyar Sihiyona, ‘Duba, sarkinki yana zuwa gare ki, mai tawali’u yana a kan jaki, a kan aholaki, ɗan jaki.’ ”
english: “Tell the daughter of Zion, behold, your King comes to you, humble, and riding on a donkey, on a colt, the foal of a donkey.”

hausa: Sai Benahiya ɗan Yehohiyada ya haura ya bugi Yowab, ya kashe shi, ya kuwa binne shi a gidansa a ƙauye.
english: Then Benaiah the son of Jehoiada went up and fell on him, and killed him; and he was buried in his own house in the wilderness.

hausa: I, ga abin da Ubangiji Maɗaukaki, Allah na Isra’ila yana cewa, “Kada ku bar annabawa da masu sihiri a cikinku su ruɗe ku. Kada ku saurari mafarkan da dā kuke ƙarfafa su su yi.
english: For Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel says: “Don’t let your prophets who are among you and your diviners deceive you. Don’t listen to your dreams which you cause to be dreamed.

hausa: Bari taurarinta na safe su zama duhu; bari ranar tă yi ta jiran ganin haske amma kada tă gani,
english: Let the stars of its twilight be dark. Let it look for light, but have none, neither let it see the eyelids of the morning,

hausa: Ku kuma tabbata kun ce, ‘Bawanka Yaƙub yana tafe a bayanmu.’ ” Gama Yaƙub ya yi tunani cewa, “Zan kwantar da ran Isuwa da waɗannan kyautai, kafin mu sadu fuska da fuska, wataƙila yă karɓe shi.”
english: You shall say, ‘Not only that, but behold, your servant, Jacob, is behind us.’” For, he said, “I will appease him with the present that goes before me, and afterward I will see his face. Perhaps he will accept me.”

hausa: Kwaf nan na godiya da muke yin godiya da shi, ashe ba tarayya ce a cikin jinin Kiristi ba? Wannan burodi kuma da muke karya mu ci, ashe, ba tarayya ne a cikin jikin Kiristi ba?
english: The cup of blessing which we bless, isn’t it a sharing of the blood of Christ? The bread which we break, isn’t it a sharing of the body of Christ?

hausa: ya yi tukwane, manyan cokula da kwanonin yayyafawa. Dukan waɗannan abubuwan da Huram ya yi wa Sarki Solomon saboda haikalin Ubangiji, an dalaye su da tagulla.
english: the pots; the shovels; and the basins. All of these vessels, which Hiram made for King Solomon for Yahweh’s house, were of burnished bronze.

hausa: Sai ya amsa ya ce, “Mugaye da masu zinan zamanin nan suna neman wata alama mai banmamaki! Amma babu wadda za a nuna musu, sai dai alama ta annabi Yunana.
english: But he answered them, “An evil and adulterous generation seeks after a sign, but no sign will be given to it but the sign of Jonah the prophet.

hausa: A cikin sunan Ubangiji Yesu Kiristi, muna muku umarni, ’yan’uwa, da ku kiyaye kanku daga kowane ɗan’uwa mai zaman banza da ba ya rayuwa bisa ga koyarwar da kuka karɓa daga wurinmu.
english: Now we command you, brothers, in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, that you withdraw yourselves from every brother who walks in rebellion and not after the tradition which they received from us.

hausa: Waɗansu mutane kima suka zama mabiyan Bulus suka kuwa gaskata. A cikinsu kuwa akwai Diyonasiyus ɗan Majalisar Areyofagus, haka kuma wata mace mai suna Damaris, da waɗansu dai haka.
english: But certain men joined with him and believed, including Dionysius the Areopagite, and a woman named Damaris, and others with them.

hausa: Asa kuwa da mayaƙansa suka bi su har Gerar. Mutanen Kush suka mutu a ranan nan har ba a iya ƙidaya, aka buge su a gaban Ubangiji da rundunansa. Mutanen Yahuda suka kwashi ganima sosai.
english: Asa and the people who were with him pursued them to Gerar. So many of the Ethiopians fell that they could not recover themselves, for they were destroyed before Yahweh and before his army. Judah’s army carried away very much booty.

hausa: “ ‘A rana ta huɗu a miƙa bijimai goma, raguna biyu, da ’yan raguna goma sha huɗu, bana ɗaya-ɗaya, dukansu marasa lahani.
english: “‘On the fourth day ten bulls, two rams, fourteen male lambs a year old without defect;

hausa: Suka shirya su sadu da Bulus wata rana, suka ma zo da yawa fiye da dā a wurin da Bulus yake zama. Daga safe har zuwa yamma ya yi ta yin musu bayani, ya kuma shaida musu mulkin Allah yana ƙoƙarin rinjayarsu game da Yesu daga Dokar Musa da kuma daga Annabawa.
english: When they had appointed him a day, many people came to him at his lodging. He explained to them, testifying about God’s Kingdom, and persuading them concerning Jesus, both from the law of Moses and from the prophets, from morning until evening.

hausa: Sarkin Isra’ila ya ce wa Yehoshafat, “Zan ɓad da kama in shiga wurin yaƙi, amma ka sa kayan sarautarka.” Saboda haka sarkin Isra’ila ya ɓad da kama, ya shiga cikin yaƙi.
english: The king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, “I will disguise myself and go into the battle, but you put on your robes.” The king of Israel disguised himself and went into the battle.

hausa: Sa’an nan na ce, “Ga ni, na zo, kamar yadda yake a rubuce game da ni cikin littafi.
english: Then I said, “Behold, I have come. It is written about me in the book in the scroll.

hausa: Sai Ruhu ya sauko a kaina ya kuma ɗaga ni na tsaya a ƙafafuna. Ya yi mini magana ya ce, “Ka fita, ka rufe kanka a cikin gida.
english: Then the Spirit entered into me and set me on my feet. He spoke with me, and said to me, “Go, shut yourself inside your house.

hausa: Ba shi ne ku rarraba abincinku da mayunwata ku kuma tanada wa matalauta masu yawo mahalli, sa’ad da kuka ga wanda yake tsirara, ku yi masa sutura, kada kuma ku ba wa namanku da jininku baya?
english: Isn’t it to distribute your bread to the hungry, and that you bring the poor who are cast out to your house? When you see the naked, that you cover him; and that you not hide yourself from your own flesh?

hausa: Yana zaune a kursiyi a bisa iyakar duniya, kuma mutanenta suna kama da fāra. Ya miƙa sammai kamar rumfa, ya kuma shimfiɗa su kamar tentin da za a zauna a ciki.
english: It is he who sits above the circle of the earth, and its inhabitants are like grasshoppers; who stretches out the heavens like a curtain, and spreads them out like a tent to dwell in,

hausa: Ya kuma zama mahaifin masu kaciya waɗanda ba kaciya kaɗai suke da ita ba amma har ma suna bin gurbin bangaskiyar da mahaifinmu Ibrahim yake da ita kafin aka yi masa kaciya.
english: He is the father of circumcision to those who not only are of the circumcision, but who also walk in the steps of that faith of our father Abraham, which he had in uncircumcision.

hausa: Za a yi lagwaninsa da manyan farantansa da ƙerarriyar zinariya.
english: Its snuffers and its snuff dishes shall be of pure gold.

hausa: Hilkiya tare da waɗanda sarki ya aika, suka tafi suka yi magana da annabiya Hulda, wadda take matar Shallum ɗan Tokhat ɗan Hasra, mai tsaron wurin ajiyar riguna. Tana zama a Urushalima, a Yanki na Biyu.
english: So Hilkiah and those whom the king had commanded went to Huldah the prophetess, the wife of Shallum the son of Tokhath, the son of Hasrah, keeper of the wardrobe (now she lived in Jerusalem in the second quarter), and they spoke to her to that effect.

hausa: Ya Ubangiji. Gama saboda bawanka da kuma bisa ga nufinka, ka yi wannan babban abu, ka kuma sanar da dukan manyan alkawura.
english: Yahweh, for your servant’s sake, and according to your own heart, you have done all this greatness, to make known all these great things.

hausa: amma in suka kai shekaru hamsin da haihuwa, dole su huta daga wannan aiki na yau da kullum, su kuma daina aiki.
english: and from the age of fifty years they shall retire from doing the work, and shall serve no more,

hausa: Bilatus ya tara manyan firistoci, da masu mulki, da mutane,
english: Pilate called together the chief priests, the rulers, and the people,

hausa: Duk mai son tsabtar zuciya wanda kuma jawabinsa mai alheri ne zai zama aminin sarki.
english: He who loves purity of heart and speaks gracefully is the king’s friend.

hausa: Almajiran suka tafi, suka shiga cikin birnin, suka kuwa tarar da kome kamar yadda Yesu ya faɗa musu. Sai suka shirya Bikin Ƙetarewa.
english: His disciples went out, and came into the city, and found things as he had said to them, and they prepared the Passover.

hausa: Da muka isa Roma, sai aka yarda wa Bulus yă zauna shi kaɗai, tare da sojan da zai yi gadinsa.
english: When we entered into Rome, the centurion delivered the prisoners to the captain of the guard, but Paul was allowed to stay by himself with the soldier who guarded him.

hausa: “ ‘Duk mai yin amfani da karin magana zai faɗi wannan karin magana a kanki cewa, “Kamar yadda mahaifiya take haka ’yar take.”
english: “‘“Behold, everyone who uses proverbs will use this proverb against you, saying, ‘As is the mother, so is her daughter.’

hausa: Daga zuriyar Finehas, Gershom ne shugaba; daga zuriyar Itamar, Daniyel ne shugaba; daga zuriyar Dawuda, Hattush
english: Of the sons of Phinehas, Gershom. Of the sons of Ithamar, Daniel. Of the sons of David, Hattush.

hausa: Zan furta cewa ƙaunarka tana nan daram har abada, cewa ka kafa amincinka a sama kanta.
english: I indeed declare, “Love stands firm forever. You established the heavens. Your faithfulness is in them.”

hausa: Game da filin waje ta yamma kuwa, akwai masu tsaro huɗu a hanya da kuma biyu a filin kansa.
english: For Parbar westward, four at the causeway, and two at Parbar.

hausa: Da mutumin nan ba daga Allah ba ne, da ba abin da zai iya yi.”
english: If this man were not from God, he could do nothing.”

hausa: Mahaifina ya sa muku kaya masu nauyi; zan ma sa mafi nauyi. Mahaifina ya bulale ku da bulala; zan bulale ku da kunamai.’ ”
english: Now whereas my father burdened you with a heavy yoke, I will add to your yoke. My father chastised you with whips, but I will chastise you with scorpions.’”

hausa: Saboda haka ya sāke barinsu, ya yi addu’a sau na uku, yana maimaita iri abu guda.
english: He left them again, went away, and prayed a third time, saying the same words.

hausa: A ranan ta huɗu, Elizur ɗan Shedeyur, shugaban mutanen Ruben, ya kawo hadayarsa.
english: On the fourth day Elizur the son of Shedeur, prince of the children of Reuben,

hausa: Saboda haka firistoci da Lawiyawa suka tsarkake kansu don su hauro da akwatin alkawarin Ubangiji, Allah na Isra’ila.
english: So the priests and the Levites sanctified themselves to bring up the ark of Yahweh, the God of Israel.

hausa: Ku ji tsoron Ubangiji Allahnku, ku bauta masa shi kaɗai, ku kuma yi alkawaranku da sunansa.
english: You shall fear Yahweh your God; and you shall serve him, and shall swear by his name.

hausa: Isra’ilawa suka kwashe mata da yaran Midiyawa, a matsayin bayi. Suka kwashe shanunsu da tumakinsu da kuma dukan dukiyarsu, a matsayin ganima.
english: The children of Israel took the women of Midian captive with their little ones; and all their livestock, all their flocks, and all their goods, they took as plunder.

hausa: Ba zai ji daɗin koguna da rafuffuka masu kwarara da zuma da madara ba.
english: He will not look at the rivers, the flowing streams of honey and butter.

hausa: Ubangiji zai buɗe sammai, wurin ajiyarsa mai yalwa, don yă aika da ruwan sama a gonarku a lokacinsa, yă kuma albarkaci dukan aikin hannuwanku. Za ku ba wa al’ummai masu yawa rance, amma ba za ku karɓa bashi daga wurin wani ba.
english: Yahweh will open to you his good treasure in the sky, to give the rain of your land in its season, and to bless all the work of your hand. You will lend to many nations, and you will not borrow.

hausa: wanda ganyayensa masu kyau ne yana da ’ya’yan itace da yawa, wanda yake ba da abinci ga duka, yana ba da wurin hutu ga namun jeji, kuma rassansa suna ɗauke da sheƙar tsuntsayen sama.
english: whose leaves were beautiful and its fruit plentiful, and in it was food for all; under which the animals of the field lived, and on whose branches the birds of the sky had their habitation—

hausa: Ya bi shawarar matasa, ya ce, “Mahaifina ya sa muku kaya masu nauyi; ni zan ma sa su fi haka nauyi. Mahaifina ya hore ku da bulala; ni kuwa zan hore ku da kunamai.”
english: and spoke to them according to the counsel of the young men, saying, “My father made your yoke heavy, but I will add to your yoke. My father chastised you with whips, but I will chastise you with scorpions.”

hausa: Sa’an nan za ku tattake mugaye; za su zama toka a ƙarƙashin tafin ƙafafunku a ranar da zan aikata waɗannan abubuwa, in ji Ubangiji Maɗaukaki.
english: You shall tread down the wicked; for they will be ashes under the soles of your feet in the day that I make,” says Yahweh of Armies.

hausa: Na ba ka gidan maigidanka, da matan maigidanka duka. Na ba ka gidan Isra’ila da Yahuda. Da a ce dukan waɗannan sun kāsa maka, ai, da na ƙara maka.
english: I gave you your master’s house and your master’s wives into your bosom, and gave you the house of Israel and of Judah; and if that would have been too little, I would have added to you many more such things.

hausa: Yana ƙarƙashin iyayen goyonsa da masu riƙon amana har yă zuwa cikar lokacin da mahaifinsa ya sa.
english: but is under guardians and stewards until the day appointed by the father.

hausa: don yă mai da ku jama’arsa yau, shi kuwa yă zama Allahnku kamar yadda ya yi muku alkawari, da yadda kuma ya rantse wa kakanninku, Ibrahim, Ishaku da kuma Yaƙub.
english: that he may establish you today as his people, and that he may be your God, as he spoke to you and as he swore to your fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob.

hausa: Sa’ad da shekaru dubun nan suka cika, za a saki Shaiɗan daga kurkukun da yake,
english: And after the thousand years, Satan will be released from his prison

hausa: lokacin da Maɗaukaki yana tare da ni, kuma ’ya’yana suna kewaye da ni,
english: when the Almighty was yet with me, and my children were around me,

hausa: dole yă keɓe kansa daga ruwan inabi, ko daga waɗansu abubuwa sha masu sa maye, kada kuma yă sha ruwan tsamin da aka yi daga ruwan inabi, ko daga waɗansu abubuwa sha masu sa maye. Ba zai sha ruwan ’ya’yan inabi, ko yă ci ’ya’yan inabi ɗanye ko busasshe ba.
english: he shall separate himself from wine and strong drink. He shall drink no vinegar of wine, or vinegar of fermented drink, neither shall he drink any juice of grapes, nor eat fresh grapes or dried.

hausa: Saboda haka Ubangiji ya yi fushi da mutanensa ya ji ƙyamar gādonsa.
english: Therefore Yahweh burned with anger against his people. He abhorred his inheritance.

hausa: Ɗan Etan shi ne, Azariya.
english: The son of Ethan: Azariah.

hausa: Sa’ad da Ataliya ta ji surutun mutane suna gudu suna yabon sarki, sai ta tafi wurinsu a haikalin Ubangiji.
english: When Athaliah heard the noise of the people running and praising the king, she came to the people into Yahweh’s house.

hausa: Ku yi ƙarfin hali, mu kuma yi yaƙi da ƙarfin zuciya saboda mutanenmu da kuma birane Allahnmu. Ubangiji zai yi abin da yake da kyau a idanunsa.”
english: Be courageous, and let’s be strong for our people and for the cities of our God; and may Yahweh do what seems good to him.”

hausa: Amma da ɗan ’yar’uwar Bulus ya ji wannan makirci, sai ya tafi cikin barikin soja ya gaya wa Bulus.
english: But Paul’s sister’s son heard they were lying in wait, and he came and entered into the barracks and told Paul.

hausa: na iyalin Bilga, Shammuwa; na iyalin Shemahiya, Yehonatan;
english: of Bilgah, Shammua; of Shemaiah, Jehonathan;

hausa: biye da shi, Yehohanan shi ne shugaba, yana da sojoji 280,000;
english: and next to him Jehohanan the captain, and with him two hundred eighty thousand;

hausa: Yakan lura da garkensa kamar makiyayi. Yakan tattara tumaki wuri ɗaya yă riƙe su kurkusa da ƙirjinsa; a hankali kuma yakan bi da masu ba da mama.
english: He will feed his flock like a shepherd. He will gather the lambs in his arm, and carry them in his bosom. He will gently lead those who have their young.

hausa: Ina biyayya da farillanka da kuma koyarwarka, gama dukan hanyoyina sanannu ne gare ka.
english: I have obeyed your precepts and your testimonies, for all my ways are before you. TAV

hausa: Dukan kwaf Solomon zinariya ne, kuma dukan kayayyakin gida a Fadan da ake kira Kurmin Lebanon, zinariya ce zalla. Babu wani abin da aka yi da azurfa, domin ba a ɗauki azurfa a bakin kome ba a zamanin Solomon.
english: All King Solomon’s drinking vessels were of gold, and all the vessels of the House of the Forest of Lebanon were of pure gold. None were of silver, because it was considered of little value in the days of Solomon.

hausa: Sai Hezekiya ya tuba daga girma kan zuciyarsa, haka ma mutanen Urushalima; saboda haka fushin Ubangiji bai zo a kansu a kwanakin Hezekiya ba.
english: However, Hezekiah humbled himself for the pride of his heart, both he and the inhabitants of Jerusalem, so that Yahweh’s wrath didn’t come on them in the days of Hezekiah.

hausa: Bayan wani lokaci aka faɗa wa Yusuf, “Mahaifinka yana ciwo.” Sai ya ɗauki ’ya’yansa maza biyu, Manasse da Efraim suka tafi tare da shi.
english: After these things, someone said to Joseph, “Behold, your father is sick.” He took with him his two sons, Manasseh and Ephraim.

hausa: Ashan, Yutta da Bet-Shemesh, tare da wuraren kiwonsu.
english: Ashan with its pasture lands, and Beth Shemesh with its pasture lands;

hausa: Ina kuma addu’a cewa zuciyarku tă waye don ku gane ko mene ne sa zuciyan nan da ya kira ku a kansa, ku kuma san darajar dukiyan nan wadda take ta mutanen Allah, wato, albarkunsa.
english: having the eyes of your hearts enlightened, that you may know what is the hope of his calling, and what are the riches of the glory of his inheritance in the saints,

hausa: Kada ka ɓoye fuskarka daga gare ni, kada ka kore bawanka daga gare ka cikin fushi; kai ne ka kasance mai taimakona. Kada ka ƙi ni ko ka yashe ni, Ya Allah Mai cetona.
english: Don’t hide your face from me. Don’t put your servant away in anger. You have been my help. Don’t abandon me, neither forsake me, God of my salvation.

hausa: A ƙarshe waɗannan mutane suka ce; “Ba za mu taɓa samun wani laifin da za mu kama Daniyel da shi ba, sai dai ko abin ya shafi dokar Allahnsa.”
english: Then these men said, “We won’t find any occasion against this Daniel, unless we find it against him concerning the law of his God.”

hausa: Ɗan mutuniyar Isra’ila ya saɓi Sunan Ubangiji, ya kuma la’ana shi, saboda haka aka kawo shi wa Musa. (Sunan mahaifiyarsa Shelomit ne, ’yar Dibri na kabilar Dan.)
english: The son of the Israelite woman blasphemed the Name, and cursed; and they brought him to Moses. His mother’s name was Shelomith, the daughter of Dibri, of the tribe of Dan.

hausa: Kifin teku, tsuntsayen sarari, namun jeji, kowace halitta mai rarrafe da kuma dukan mutane a duniya za su yi rawar jiki a gabana. Za a tumɓuke duwatsu, a ragargaza tsaunuka, kuma kowane bango zai fāɗi ƙasa.
english: so that the fish of the sea, the birds of the sky, the animals of the field, all creeping things who creep on the earth, and all the men who are on the surface of the earth will shake at my presence. Then the mountains will be thrown down, the steep places will fall, and every wall will fall to the ground.

hausa: Da farko ya ce, “Hadayu da sadakoki, hadayun ƙonawa da hadayun zunubi ba ka so, ba ka kuwa jin daɗinsu” (ko da yake doka ta bukaci a yi su).
english: Previously saying, “Sacrifices and offerings and whole burnt offerings and sacrifices for sin you didn’t desire, neither had pleasure in them” (those which are offered according to the law),

hausa: Mun san cewa Ɗan Allah ya zo duniya, ya kuma ba mu ganewa domin mu san shi wanda yake na gaskiya. Mu kuwa muna cikinsa, shi da yake Allah na gaskiya wato, cikin Ɗansa Yesu Kiristi. Shi ne Allah na gaskiya da kuma rai na har abada.
english: We know that the Son of God has come and has given us an understanding, that we know him who is true; and we are in him who is true, in his Son Jesus Christ. This is the true God and eternal life.

hausa: Ba’asha ya kashe Nadab a shekara ta uku ta Asa sarkin Yahuda, ya kuma gāje shi a matsayin sarki.
english: Even in the third year of Asa king of Judah, Baasha killed him and reigned in his place.

hausa: Firist da ya miƙa ta zai ci, za a ci ta a tsattsarkan wuri, a harabar Tentin Sujada.
english: The priest who offers it for sin shall eat it. It shall be eaten in a holy place, in the court of the Tent of Meeting.

hausa: Amma ga shi, kuna dogara ga maganganu na ruɗami marasa amfani.
english: Behold, you trust in lying words that can’t profit.

hausa: Sa’an nan ka shafe bagaden hadaya ta ƙonawa da kayansa; ka keɓe bagaden, zai zama mai tsarki.
english: You shall anoint the altar of burnt offering, with all its vessels, and sanctify the altar, and the altar will be most holy.

hausa: Sai Batsheba ta tafi wurin Sarki Solomon don tă yi masa magana a kan Adoniya. Sarki ya miƙe tsaye don yă sadu da ita, ya rusuna mata, ya kuma zauna a kujerar sarautarsa. Ya sa aka kawo wa mahaifiyar sarki kujerar sarauta, ta kuwa zauna a gefen damansa.
english: Bathsheba therefore went to King Solomon, to speak to him for Adonijah. The king rose up to meet her and bowed himself to her, and sat down on his throne and caused a throne to be set for the king’s mother; and she sat on his right hand.

hausa: To, Elisha ya riga ya ce wa matan da ya tā da ɗanta daga matattu, “Ki kwashe iyalinki ku tafi duk inda za ku tafi na ɗan lokaci, domin Ubangiji ya sa a yi yunwa na shekara bakwai a ƙasar.”
english: Now Elisha had spoken to the woman whose son he had restored to life, saying, “Arise, and go, you and your household, and stay for a while wherever you can; for Yahweh has called for a famine. It will also come on the land for seven years.”

hausa: Dole in yi magana in sami lafiya; dole in buɗe baki in ba da amsa.
english: I will speak, that I may be refreshed. I will open my lips and answer.

hausa: Kai kana zama a tsakiyar ruɗu; cikin ruɗunsu sun ƙi su san ni,” in ji Ubangiji.
english: Your habitation is in the middle of deceit. Through deceit, they refuse to know me,” says Yahweh.

hausa: Wataƙila ku ce wa kanku, “Waɗannan al’ummai sun fi mu ƙarfi. Yaya za mu kore su?”
english: If you shall say in your heart, “These nations are more than I; how can I dispossess them?”

hausa: To, dukan Midiyawa, Amalekawa da sauran mutanen gabashi suka haɗa ƙarfi suka ƙetare Urdun suka kafa sansani a Kwarin Yezireyel.
english: Then all the Midianites and the Amalekites and the children of the east assembled themselves together; and they passed over, and encamped in the valley of Jezreel.

hausa: iska kan hura a kansa sai ya ɓace ba a kuwa sāke tuna da inda dā yake.
english: For the wind passes over it, and it is gone. Its place remembers it no more.

hausa: Saboda haka sarki bai saurari mutane ba, gama wannan juyin al’amura daga Allah ne, don a cika maganar Ubangiji da ya yi ga Yerobowam ɗan Nebat ta wurin Ahiya mutumin Shilo.
english: So the king didn’t listen to the people; for it was brought about by God, that Yahweh might establish his word, which he spoke by Ahijah the Shilonite to Jeroboam the son of Nebat.

hausa: Sa’an nan Sarki Asa ya kawo dukan mutanen Yahuda, suka kuma kwashe duwatsu da katako daga Rama waɗanda Ba’asha yake amfani da su. Da su ne Asa ya gina Geba da Mizfa.
english: Then Asa the king took all Judah, and they carried away the stones and timber of Ramah, with which Baasha had built; and he built Geba and Mizpah with them.

hausa: Sai na keɓe manyan firistoci guda goma sha biyu tare da Sherebiya, Hashabiya da kuma ’yan’uwansu guda goma.
english: Then I set apart twelve of the chiefs of the priests, even Sherebiah, Hashabiah, and ten of their brothers with them,

hausa: Kada ka hana mini jinƙanka, ya Ubangiji; bari ƙaunarka da gaskiyarka kullum su kāre ni.
english: Don’t withhold your tender mercies from me, Yahweh. Let your loving kindness and your truth continually preserve me.

hausa: Ya manne wa Ubangiji, bai fasa binsa ba; ya yi biyayya da dokokin da Ubangiji ya ba wa Musa.
english: For he joined with Yahweh. He didn’t depart from following him, but kept his commandments, which Yahweh commanded Moses.

hausa: Da sauri kowannensu ya sauko da buhunsa ƙasa, ya buɗe.
english: Then they hurried, and each man took his sack down to the ground, and each man opened his sack.

hausa: “An jima can, sai ga sauran sun iso. Suka ce, ‘Ranka yă daɗe! Ranka yă daɗe! Ka buɗe mana ƙofa!’
english: Afterward the other virgins also came, saying, ‘Lord, Lord, open to us.’

hausa: ’Ya’yan Yonatan maza su ne, Felet da Zaza. Waɗannan su ne zuriyar Yerameyel.
english: The sons of Jonathan: Peleth and Zaza. These were the sons of Jerahmeel.

hausa: Ya juyo da ransa daga fāɗawa cikin rami, don hasken rai ya haskaka a kansa.
english: to bring back his soul from the pit, that he may be enlightened with the light of the living.

hausa: Ba a kuma halicci namiji don mace ba, sai dai mace don namiji.
english: for man wasn’t created for the woman, but woman for the man.

hausa: Sai dai ku riƙe Ubangiji Allahnku da kyau, yadda kuka yi har zuwa yanzu.
english: but hold fast to Yahweh your God, as you have done to this day.

hausa: Karusan Allah ninkin dubbai goma ne da kuma dubu dubbai; Ubangiji ya zo daga Sinai ya shiga cikin haikalinsa.
english: The chariots of God are tens of thousands and thousands of thousands. The Lord is among them, from Sinai, into the sanctuary.

hausa: in na ajiye burodina don kaina kaɗai, ban kuwa ba wa marayu abinci sa’ad da suke jin yunwa,
english: or have eaten my morsel alone, and the fatherless has not eaten of it

hausa: Sa’ad da aka tumɓuke tushe, me adali zai iya yi?”
english: If the foundations are destroyed, what can the righteous do?

hausa: “Ku tausaya mini, abokaina, ku ji tausayina, gama hannun Allah ya sauko a kaina.
english: “Have pity on me. Have pity on me, you my friends, for the hand of God has touched me.

hausa: Abram ya kawo waɗannan duka a gaban Allah, ya raba kowannensu a tsakiya, ya ajiye su gab da juna, amma bai tsaga tsuntsayen a tsaka ba.
english: He brought him all these, and divided them in the middle, and laid each half opposite the other; but he didn’t divide the birds.

hausa: A cikin garuruwan ƙasar tudu, garuruwan yammancin gindin dutse da na Negeb, a yankin Benyamin, a cikin ƙauyuka kewayen Urushalima da kuma a cikin garuruwan Yahuda, garkuna za su sāke bi a ƙarƙashin hannun mai ƙidayawa,’ in ji Ubangiji.
english: In the cities of the hill country, in the cities of the lowland, in the cities of the South, in the land of Benjamin, in the places around Jerusalem, and in the cities of Judah, the flocks will again pass under the hands of him who counts them,” says Yahweh.

hausa: Mordekai yana da wata ’yar kawunsa mai suna Hadassa, wanda ya yi reno, ba ta da mahaifi ko mahaifiya. Ita ce yarinyar da aka santa da suna Esta. Kyakkyawa ce ƙwarai. Mordekai dai ya ɗauke ta tamƙar ’yarsa sa’ad da mahaifinta da mahaifiyarta suka mutu.
english: He brought up Hadassah, that is, Esther, his uncle’s daughter; for she had neither father nor mother. The maiden was fair and beautiful; and when her father and mother were dead, Mordecai took her for his own daughter.

hausa: Hezekiya ne ya datse ruwan bisa na maɓulɓular Gihon, ya sa ruwan ya gangara zuwa gefe yamma na Birnin Dawuda. Ya yi nasara a kome da ya yi.
english: This same Hezekiah also stopped the upper spring of the waters of Gihon, and brought them straight down on the west side of David’s city. Hezekiah prospered in all his works.

hausa: Abin da ka ji daga gare ni, ka kiyaye shi kamar tsarin sahihiyar koyarwa, cikin bangaskiya da ƙauna cikin Kiristi Yesu.
english: Hold the pattern of sound words which you have heard from me, in faith and love which is in Christ Jesus.

hausa: Zan jawo Sisera, shugaban mayaƙan Yabin, da keken yaƙinsa da mayaƙansa zuwa Kogin Kishon in ba da su a hannunku.’ ”
english: I will draw to you, to the river Kishon, Sisera, the captain of Jabin’s army, with his chariots and his multitude; and I will deliver him into your hand.’”

hausa: Sa’ad da Fir’auna ya kira ku ciki, ya yi tambaya, ‘Mece ce sana’arku?’
english: It will happen, when Pharaoh summons you, and will say, ‘What is your occupation?’

hausa: Ya ce musu, “Ba Ubangiji Allahnku yana tare da ku ba? Bai kuma ba ku hutu a kowane gefe ba? Gama ya ba da mazaunan ƙasar gare ni, ƙasar kuma ta Ubangiji ce da mutanensa.
english: “Isn’t Yahweh your God with you? Hasn’t he given you rest on every side? For he has delivered the inhabitants of the land into my hand; and the land is subdued before Yahweh and before his people.

hausa: Kada zuciyar wani mutum, ko ta wata mata ko na wani iyali, ko wata kabila cikinku yau, ta bar bin Ubangiji Allahnku, tă koma ga bauta wa gumakan waɗannan al’ummai. Kada a sami wani tushe mai ba da ’ya’ya masu dafi, masu ɗaci a cikinku.
english: lest there should be among you man, woman, family, or tribe whose heart turns away today from Yahweh our God, to go to serve the gods of those nations; lest there should be among you a root that produces bitter poison;

hausa: In gatari ya dakushe ba a kuma wasa shi ba, dole a yi amfani da ƙarfi da yawa, amma ƙwarewa yana kawo nasara.
english: If the ax is blunt, and one doesn’t sharpen the edge, then he must use more strength; but skill brings success.

hausa: Sa’an nan Haruna ya ɗaga hannuwansa wajen mutane ya sa musu albarka. Da yake ya miƙa hadaya don zunubi, hadaya ta ƙonawa da kuma hadaya ta salama, sai ya sauka.
english: Aaron lifted up his hands toward the people, and blessed them; and he came down from offering the sin offering, and the burnt offering, and the peace offerings.

hausa: Al’ummai ne marasa azanci, babu ganewa a cikinsu.
english: For they are a nation void of counsel. There is no understanding in them.

hausa: Ka yi abin rufe tentin da fatun raguna da aka rina ja, a kansa kuma ka rufe shi da fatun shanun teku.
