english: You shall make a covering for the tent of rams’ skins dyed red, and a covering of sea cow hides above.

hausa: Saboda haka Sarki Yowash ya kira Yehohiyada firist da sauran firistoci ya tambaye su ya ce, “Me ya sa ba kwa gyaran abubuwan da suka lalace a haikali? Kada ku sāke karɓan kuɗi daga masu ajiya, amma a miƙa su domin gyaran haikali.”
english: Then King Jehoash called for Jehoiada the priest, and for the other priests, and said to them, “Why aren’t you repairing the damage to the house? Now therefore take no more money from your treasurers, but deliver it for repair of the damage to the house.”

hausa: Daga Ƙofar Doki, firistoci ne suka yi gyare-gyaren, kowanne a gaban gidansa.
english: Above the horse gate, the priests made repairs, everyone across from his own house.

hausa: Ya ce wa bawansa Gehazi, “Kira mutuniyar Shunam nan.” Sai ya kira ta, ta zo ta tsaya a gabansa.
english: He said to Gehazi his servant, “Call this Shunammite.” When he had called her, she stood before him.

hausa: Ya sha jefa shi cikin wuta, ko ruwa don yă kashe shi. Amma in za ka iya yin wani abu, ka ji tausayinmu ka taimake mu.”
english: Often it has cast him both into the fire and into the water to destroy him. But if you can do anything, have compassion on us and help us.”

hausa: “ ‘Duk dabba mai rarrafe a ƙasa abin ƙyama ne; ba kuwa za a ci shi ba.
english: “‘Every creeping thing that creeps on the earth is an abomination. It shall not be eaten.

hausa: Maganarsa tana da laushi kamar man zaitun, duk da haka yaƙi yana a cikin zuciyarsa; kalmominsa sun fi mai sulɓi, duk da haka takuba ne zārarru.
english: His mouth was smooth as butter, but his heart was war. His words were softer than oil, yet they were drawn swords.

hausa: “ ‘Amma in mutum ɗaya ne kaɗai ya yi laifi ba da gangan ba, dole yă kawo akuya domin hadaya don zunubi.
english: “‘If a person sins unwittingly, then he shall offer a female goat a year old for a sin offering.

hausa: Ga abin da Musa ya ba kabilar Ruben bisa ga iyalansu.
english: Moses gave to the tribe of the children of Reuben according to their families.

hausa: Bayan mutuwar Ahab, Mowab ta yi wa Isra’ila tawaye.
english: Moab rebelled against Israel after the death of Ahab.

hausa: in ka san nufinsa ka kuma amince da abin da yake mafifici domin an koyar da kai bisa ga doka;
english: know his will, and approve the things that are excellent, being instructed out of the law,

hausa: Yana da ’ya’ya maza arba’in da ’yan taɓa kunne talatin, waɗanda suka hau jakuna saba’in. Ya shugabanci Isra’ila shekara takwas.
english: He had forty sons and thirty sons’ sons who rode on seventy donkey colts. He judged Israel eight years.

hausa: “Da ma za ka ɓoye ni a cikin kabari ka ɓoye ni har sai fushinka ya wuce! In da za ka keɓe mini lokaci sa’an nan ka tuna da ni!
english: “Oh that you would hide me in Sheol, that you would keep me secret until your wrath is past, that you would appoint me a set time and remember me!

hausa: Ta wurin jakadunka ka jibge zage-zage a kan Ubangiji. Ka kuma ce, ‘Da kekunan yaƙina masu yawa na hau ƙwanƙolin duwatsu, ƙwanƙolin mafi tsayi na Lebanon. Na sassare al’ul mafi tsayi fir mafi kyau. Na kai can wuri mafi nisa na kurminsa.
english: By your servants, you have defied the Lord, and have said, “With the multitude of my chariots I have come up to the height of the mountains, to the innermost parts of Lebanon. I will cut down its tall cedars and its choice cypress trees. I will enter into its farthest height, the forest of its fruitful field.

hausa: Dukan tsuntsaye sararin sama suka zauna a itacen da ya fāɗi, dukan namun jeji kuma suna cikin rassansa.
english: All the birds of the sky will dwell on his ruin, and all the animals of the field will be on his branches,

hausa: Mutumin da ba ya abokantaka yakan nema ya cika burinsa ne kaɗai; yakan ƙi yarda da kowace maganar da take daidai.
english: A man who isolates himself pursues selfishness, and defies all sound judgment.

hausa: Sai Dawuda ya ce wa Abiyatar firist, ɗan Ahimelek, “Kawo mini efod.” Sai Abiyatar ya kawo masa.
english: David said to Abiathar the priest, the son of Ahimelech, “Please bring the ephod here to me.” Abiathar brought the ephod to David.

hausa: Tana tsananta wa ’ya’yanta kamar ba nata ba ba tă damu da wahalar da ta sha ba.
english: She deals harshly with her young ones, as if they were not hers. Though her labor is in vain, she is without fear,

hausa: Ga abin da sarki ya faɗa; kada ku bar Hezekiya yă ruɗe ku. Ba zai iya cetonku daga hannuna ba.
english: The king says, ‘Don’t let Hezekiah deceive you, for he will not be able to deliver you out of his hand.

hausa: Mu naka tun fil azal; ba ka taɓa yin mulki a kansu ba, ba a taɓa kira su da sunanka ba.
english: We have become like those over whom you never ruled, like those who were not called by your name.

hausa: ta Adonikam 667
english: The children of Adonikam: six hundred sixty-seven.

hausa: Da Sama’ila ya juya zai tafi, sai Shawulu ya kama bakin rigarsa, sai rigar ta yage.
english: As Samuel turned around to go away, Saul grabbed the skirt of his robe, and it tore.

hausa: Duk suka yabe shi, suka yi mamakin kalmomin alheri da suke fitowa daga bakinsa. Suka yi tambaya, suna cewa, “Anya, wannan ba ɗan Yusuf ba ne?”
english: All testified about him and wondered at the gracious words which proceeded out of his mouth; and they said, “Isn’t this Joseph’s son?”

hausa: Da sarki Hezekiya ya ji haka, sai ya kyakketa tufafinsa, ya sa tufafin makoki, ya shiga haikalin Ubangiji.
english: When King Hezekiah heard it, he tore his clothes, covered himself with sackcloth, and went into Yahweh’s house.

hausa: Mutane da yawa daga Yahudiya, da Urushalima, da Edom, da kuma yankunan da suke ƙetaren Urdun, da kewayen Taya, da Sidon suka zo wurinsa, don sun ji dukan abubuwan da yake yi.
english: from Jerusalem, from Idumaea, beyond the Jordan, and those from around Tyre and Sidon. A great multitude, hearing what great things he did, came to him.

hausa: “Don me ba ku iya auna wa kanku, abin da yake daidai ba?
english: “Why don’t you judge for yourselves what is right?

hausa: Ku tsarkake kowace taguwa da kuma kome da aka yi da fata, da gashin akuya, ko kuwa itace.”
english: You shall purify every garment, and all that is made of skin, and all work of goats’ hair, and all things made of wood.”

hausa: Gama Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka zai taimake ni, ba zan sha kunya ba. Saboda haka na kafa fuskata kamar dutsen ƙanƙara, na kuma sani ba zan sha kunya ba.
english: For the Lord Yahweh will help me. Therefore I have not been confounded. Therefore I have set my face like a flint, and I know that I won’t be disappointed.

hausa: Haka kuma, sa’ad da kun ga dukan waɗannan abubuwa, ku sani ya yi kusan zuwa, yana ma dab da bakin ƙofa.
english: Even so you also, when you see all these things, know that he is near, even at the doors.

hausa: na Bet-Azmawet 42
english: The men of Beth Azmaveth: forty-two.

hausa: “Ka san lokacin da awakin kan dutse suke haihuwa? Ko ka taɓa lura da yadda batsiya take haihuwa?
english: “Do you know the time when the mountain goats give birth? Do you watch when the doe bears fawns?

hausa: Wata rana Samson ya tafi Gaza, inda ya ga wata karuwa. Ya shiga wurinta ya kwana.
english: Samson went to Gaza, and saw there a prostitute, and went in to her.

hausa: ya ce, “Ni ma ku ba ni wannan iyawa don kowa na ɗibiya wa hannuwana yă karɓi Ruhu Mai Tsarki.”
english: saying, “Give me also this power, that whomever I lay my hands on may receive the Holy Spirit.”

hausa: Tsayin labulen ƙofa na gefe ɗaya zai zama kamu goma sha biyar, da katakai uku tare da rammukansu uku,
english: The hangings for the one side of the gate shall be fifteen cubits; their pillars three, and their sockets three.

hausa: Ya kuma kawo kan a tasa ya ba yarinyar. Ita kuma ta ba wa mahaifiyarta.
english: and brought his head on a platter, and gave it to the young lady; and the young lady gave it to her mother.

hausa: A bangaye kewaye da haikali, a ɗakuna ciki da waje, ya zāzzāna kerubobi, itatuwan dabino, da furanni buɗaɗɗu.
english: He carved all the walls of the house around with carved figures of cherubim, palm trees, and open flowers, inside and outside.

hausa: Da ya hangi Yesu daga nesa, sai ya ruga da gudu, ya zo ya durƙusa a gabansa.
english: When he saw Jesus from afar, he ran and bowed down to him,

hausa: Dukan dokokinsa suna a gābana; ban juye daga ƙa’idodinsa ba.
english: For all his ordinances were before me. I didn’t put away his statutes from me.

hausa: “ ‘Saboda haka ga abin da Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka yana cewa zan kawo takobi a kanka in kashe mutane da dabbobi.
english: “‘Therefore the Lord Yahweh says: “Behold, I will bring a sword on you, and will cut off man and animal from you.

hausa: Ta haka aka gama dukan aikin tabanakul da Tentin Sujada. Isra’ilawa suka yi kome yadda Ubangiji ya umarci Musa.
english: Thus all the work of the tabernacle of the Tent of Meeting was finished. The children of Israel did according to all that Yahweh commanded Moses; so they did.

hausa: Ya miƙa ɗansa hadaya ta ƙonawa, ya yi sihiri da tsubu, ya tuntuɓi masu duba da masu ruhohi. Ya aikata mugunta ƙwarai a gaban Ubangiji, ya sa Ubangiji ya yi fushi.
english: He made his son to pass through the fire, practiced sorcery, used enchantments, and dealt with those who had familiar spirits and with wizards. He did much evil in Yahweh’s sight, to provoke him to anger.

hausa: Saboda zunubanmu, yalwar girbin da muke samu yana tafiya wurin sarakunan da ka sa a kanmu. Suna mulki bisa jikunanmu, da bisa garkenmu yadda suka ga dama. Muna cikin baƙin ciki.
english: It yields much increase to the kings whom you have set over us because of our sins. Also they have power over our bodies and over our livestock, at their pleasure, and we are in great distress.

hausa: in tanada wa waɗanda suke baƙin ciki a Sihiyona, in maido musu rawani mai kyau a maimako na toka, man murna a maimako na makoki, da kuma rigar yabo a maimako na ruhun fid da zuciya. Za a ce da su itatuwan oak na adalci, shukin Ubangiji don bayyana darajarsa.
english: to provide for those who mourn in Zion, to give to them a garland for ashes, the oil of joy for mourning, the garment of praise for the spirit of heaviness, that they may be called trees of righteousness, the planting of Yahweh, that he may be glorified.

hausa: Muna da baye-baye dabam-dabam, gwargwadon alherin da aka yi mana. In baiwar mutum ta yin annabci ce, sai yă yi amfani da ita gwargwadon bangaskiyarsa.
english: having gifts differing according to the grace that was given to us: if prophecy, let’s prophesy according to the proportion of our faith;

hausa: Saboda haka sai ya koma zuwa wurin Yahuda ya ce, “Ban same ta ba. Ban da haka ma, mutanen da suke zama a can, sun ce, ‘Ba a taɓa kasance da wata karuwar haikali a nan ba.’ ”
english: He returned to Judah, and said, “I haven’t found her; and also the men of the place said, ‘There has been no prostitute here.’”

hausa: A ranar kuwa, ɗaya daga cikin bayin Shawulu yana can, a tsare a gaban Ubangiji, sunansa Doyeg, mutumin Edom, shugaban makiyayan Shawulu.
english: Now a certain man of the servants of Saul was there that day, detained before Yahweh; and his name was Doeg the Edomite, the best of the herdsmen who belonged to Saul.

hausa: Zabura ta Asaf. Tabbatacce Allah mai alheri ne ga Isra’ila, ga waɗanda suke masu tsabta a zuciya.
english: A Psalm by Asaph. Surely God is good to Israel, to those who are pure in heart.

hausa: Yanzu sau goma ke nan kuna wulaƙanta ni, kuna kai mini hari na rashin kunya.
english: You have reproached me ten times. You aren’t ashamed that you attack me.

hausa: Yayinda mutanen Benyamin suna cewa, “Muna cin nasara a kansu kamar dā,” Isra’ilawa kuwa suna cewa, “Mu yi ta jan da baya mu janye su daga birni zuwa kan hanyoyi.”
english: The children of Benjamin said, “They are struck down before us, as at the first.” But the children of Israel said, “Let’s flee, and draw them away from the city to the highways.”

hausa: In babu mai fassara, sai mai magana yă yi shiru a cikin ikkilisiya, yă yi wa kansa magana da kuma Allah.
english: But if there is no interpreter, let him keep silent in the assembly, and let him speak to himself and to God.

hausa: da Meshezabel, da Zadok, da Yadduwa
english: Meshezabel, Zadok, Jaddua,

hausa: Cikin wahalarsa ya nemi tagomashin Ubangiji Allahnsa ya kuma ƙasƙantar da kansa sosai a gaban Allah na kakanninsa.
english: When he was in distress, he begged Yahweh his God, and humbled himself greatly before the God of his fathers.

hausa: Ɓacin rai da baƙin ciki sun cika shi, kamar sarkin da yake shirin yaƙi,
english: Distress and anguish make him afraid. They prevail against him, as a king ready to the battle.

hausa: Cikin kowane abin da na yi, na nuna muku cewa da irin wannan aiki tuƙuru don mu taimaki marasa ƙarfi, muna tunawa da kalmomin da Ubangiji Yesu kansa ya ce, ‘Bayarwa ta fi karɓa albarka.’ ”
english: In all things I gave you an example, that so laboring you ought to help the weak, and to remember the words of the Lord Jesus, that he himself said, ‘It is more blessed to give than to receive.’ ”

hausa: Wata rana da lokacin aikin firistoci na sashen Zakariya na yin hidima ya kewayo, yana kuma cikin hidimarsa ta firist a gaban Allah,
english: Now while he executed the priest’s office before God in the order of his division

hausa: Ka nemi hutu, ya raina, a wurin Allah kaɗai; dogarata kan zo daga gare shi ne.
english: My soul, wait in silence for God alone, for my expectation is from him.

hausa: Ubangiji ya ce wa Sama’ila, “Duba ina dab da yin wani abu a Isra’ila da zai sa kunne kowa da yake ji, yă ji tsoro.
english: Yahweh said to Samuel, “Behold, I will do a thing in Israel at which both the ears of everyone who hears it will tingle.

hausa: Sai Ubangiji ya ce, “Zan wuce a gabanka, Ni Ubangiji zan yi shelar sunana a gabanka. Zan yi alheri ga duk wanda na so in yi masa alheri, zan nuna jinƙai ga duk wanda na so in yi masa jinƙai.
english: He said, “I will make all my goodness pass before you, and will proclaim Yahweh’s name before you. I will be gracious to whom I will be gracious, and will show mercy on whom I will show mercy.”

hausa: Ni ta ƙaunataccena ce, kuma sha’awarsa domina ne.
english: I am my beloved’s. His desire is toward me.

hausa: Da suna saukowa daga dutsen, Yesu ya umarce su kada su gaya wa kowa abin da suka gani, sai bayan Ɗan Mutum ya tashi daga matattu.
english: As they were coming down from the mountain, he commanded them that they should tell no one what things they had seen, until after the Son of Man had risen from the dead.

hausa: amma Yesu ba zai mutu ba, don haka zai zama firist har abada.
english: But he, because he lives forever, has his priesthood unchangeable.

hausa: sai ku ɗauki ’ya’yan fari na dukan amfanin gonar ƙasar da Ubangiji Allahnku yake ba ku, ku zuba a kwando. Sa’an nan ku je wurin da Ubangiji Allahnku ya zaɓa yă zama mazauni don Sunansa,
english: that you shall take some of the first of all the fruit of the ground, which you shall bring in from your land that Yahweh your God gives you. You shall put it in a basket, and shall go to the place which Yahweh your God shall choose to cause his name to dwell there.

hausa: “Gama sun shuka iska don haka za su girbe guguwa. Hatsin da yake tsaye ba shi da kai, ba zai yi tsaba ba. Ko da ya yi tsaba ma, baƙi ne za su ci.
english: For they sow the wind, and they will reap the whirlwind. He has no standing grain. The stalk will yield no head. If it does yield, strangers will swallow it up.

hausa: Sai ya sa yaransu ne suka taso a maimakonsu, su ne waɗanda Yoshuwa ya yi wa kaciya. Sun kasance ba kaciya gama ba a yi musu ba a hanya.
english: Their children, whom he raised up in their place, were circumcised by Joshua, for they were uncircumcised, because they had not circumcised them on the way.

hausa: Saboda haka in Ɗan ya ’yantar da ku, za ku ’yantu da gaske.
english: If therefore the Son makes you free, you will be free indeed.

hausa: Ka soke alkawarin da ka yi da bawanka ka kuma ƙazantar da rawaninsa a ƙura.
english: You have renounced the covenant of your servant. You have defiled his crown in the dust.

hausa: Me ya sa ka ɓoye fuskarka ka manta da azabanmu da kuma danniyar da ake mana?
english: Why do you hide your face, and forget our affliction and our oppression?

hausa: waɗannan mutanen da suka kawo rahoto mai banrazana a kan ƙasar, annoba ta buge su, suka kuwa mutu a gaban Ubangiji.
english: even those men who brought up an evil report of the land, died by the plague before Yahweh.

hausa: Mala’ikan ya wurga laujensa a duniya, ya tattara ’ya’yan inabin, ya kuma zuba su cikin babbar wurin matsewar inabin fushin Allah.
english: The angel thrust his sickle into the earth, and gathered the vintage of the earth and threw it into the great wine press of the wrath of God.

hausa: Bari sarki yă naɗa komishinoni a kowane yanki na masarautarsa, domin su kawo dukan waɗannan kyawawan ’yan mata cikin harabar mazaunin masarautar a Shusha. Bari a sa su a hannun Hegai, bābān sarki, wanda yake lura da mata, bari kuma a yi musu kulawa ta musamman.
english: Let the king appoint officers in all the provinces of his kingdom, that they may gather together all the beautiful young virgins to the citadel of Susa, to the women’s house, to the custody of Hegai the king’s eunuch, keeper of the women. Let cosmetics be given them;

hausa: Ka tabbatar da lafiyar bawanka; kada ka bar masu girman kai su danne ni.
english: Ensure your servant’s well-being. Don’t let the proud oppress me.

hausa: Ubangiji ya ba ni alluna biyu wanda shi kansa ya yi rubutu da yatsarsa. A kansu akwai dukan umarnan Ubangiji da an furta muku a kan dutse a tsakiyar wuta, a ranar taron jama’a.
english: Yahweh delivered to me the two stone tablets written with God’s finger. On them were all the words which Yahweh spoke with you on the mountain out of the middle of the fire in the day of the assembly.

hausa: Gama kamar yadda walƙiya take wulgawa walai daga gabas zuwa yamma, haka dawowar Ɗan Mutum zai kasance.
english: For as the lightning flashes from the east, and is seen even to the west, so will the coming of the Son of Man be.

hausa: Da wannan, Bulus ya bar Majalisar.
english: Thus Paul went out from among them.

hausa: Sarki Solomon ya amsa wa mahaifiyarsa ya ce, “Me ya sa kika roƙar wa Adoniya Abishag mutuniyar Shunam kawai? Ki ma sa a ba shi mulkin mana. Ai, shi yayana ne. I, ki roƙa dominsa, da domin Abiyatar firist, da kuma domin Yowab ɗan Zeruhiya mana!”
english: King Solomon answered his mother, “Why do you ask Abishag the Shunammite for Adonijah? Ask for him the kingdom also, for he is my elder brother; even for him, and for Abiathar the priest, and for Joab the son of Zeruiah.”

hausa: ‘Da zinariya da azurfa duka nawa ne,’ in ji Ubangiji Maɗaukaki.
english: The silver is mine, and the gold is mine,’ says Yahweh of Armies.

hausa: “Na daddatse al’ummai; an kuma rurrushe kagararsu. Na bar titunansu ba kowa, ba mai ratsawa a ciki. An ragargaza biranensu; ba wanda za a bari, babu ko ɗaya.
english: I have cut off nations. Their battlements are desolate. I have made their streets waste, so that no one passes by. Their cities are destroyed, so that there is no man, so that there is no inhabitant.

hausa: Saboda haka, duk wanda ya ci burodin ko ya sha daga kwaf na Ubangiji da rashin cancanta, ya yi laifin wulaƙanta jiki da jinin Ubangiji ke nan.
english: Therefore whoever eats this bread or drinks the Lord’s cup in a way unworthy of the Lord will be guilty of the body and the blood of the Lord.

hausa: Ga abin da Ubangiji yana cewa, “Mutanen da suka tsere wa takobi za su sami tagomashi a hamada; zan zo don in ba da hutu ga Isra’ila.”
english: Yahweh says, “The people who survive the sword found favor in the wilderness; even Israel, when I went to cause him to rest.”

hausa: A Gibeyon, Ubangiji ya bayyana ga Solomon da dare a mafarki, Allah ya ce, “Ka roƙi abin da kake so in ba ka.”
english: In Gibeon, Yahweh appeared to Solomon in a dream by night; and God said, “Ask for what I should give you.”

hausa: Sai Musa da Haruna suka tafi wurin Fir’auna, suka yi yadda Ubangiji ya umarce su. Haruna ya jefa sandansa ƙasa, a gaban Fir’auna da bayinsa, sai sandan ya zama maciji.
english: Moses and Aaron went in to Pharaoh, and they did so, as Yahweh had commanded. Aaron cast down his rod before Pharaoh and before his servants, and it became a serpent.

hausa: Saboda haka, sai ku lura, ku bi umarnai, ƙa’idodi, da dokokin nan da nake ba ku a yau.
english: You shall therefore keep the commandments, the statutes, and the ordinances which I command you today, to do them.

hausa: Kenan, Mahalalel, Yared,
english: Kenan, Mahalalel, Jared,

hausa: Amma mutanen Dawuda sun kashe mutum ɗari uku da sittin daga kabilar Benyamin da suke tare da Abner.
english: But David’s servants had struck Benjamin and Abner’s men so that three hundred sixty men died.

hausa: Bari tunanina yă gamshe shi, yayinda nake farin ciki a cikin Ubangiji.
english: Let my meditation be sweet to him. I will rejoice in Yahweh.

hausa: Yesu ya ji labari cewa Yahudawa sun ji cewa ya wuce Yohanna samun masu bi, yana kuma yin musu baftisma,
english: Therefore when the Lord knew that the Pharisees had heard that Jesus was making and baptizing more disciples than John

hausa: Da tsakar rana, ya sarki, sa’ad da nake kan hanya, sai na ga wani haske daga sama, fiye da hasken rana, yana haskakawa kewaye da ni da abokan tafiyata.
english: at noon, O king, I saw on the way a light from the sky, brighter than the sun, shining around me and those who traveled with me.

hausa: Ka ba ni ganewa, zan kuwa kiyaye dokarka in kuma yi biyayya da ita da dukan zuciyata.
english: Give me understanding, and I will keep your law. Yes, I will obey it with my whole heart.

hausa: To, ina so ku sani ’yan’uwa, cewa abin da ya faru da ni ya sa cin gaban bishara.
english: Now I desire to have you know, brothers, that the things which happened to me have turned out rather to the progress of the Good News,

hausa: Bayan kwana biyar sai Ananiyas babban firist ya tafi Kaisariya tare da waɗansu daga cikin dattawa da kuma wani lauya mai suna Tertullus, suka kawo ƙararsu game da Bulus a gaban gwamna.
english: After five days, the high priest, Ananias, came down with certain elders and an orator, one Tertullus. They informed the governor against Paul.

hausa: Yakim, Zikri, Zabdi,
english: Jakim, Zichri, Zabdi,

hausa: waɗanda ta magana kawai sukan mai da mutum mai laifi, waɗanda suke kafa tarko wa mai ba da kāriya a ɗakin shari’a da shaidar ƙarya kuma su hana marar laifi samun shari’ar adalci.
english: who cause a person to be indicted by a word, and lay a snare for one who reproves in the gate, and who deprive the innocent of justice with false testimony.

hausa: Maganar Ubangiji ta zo mini cewa,
english: Again Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

hausa: A maimako, Yohanan ɗan Kareya da dukan shugabannin sojoji suka kwashe raguwar Yahuda waɗanda suka dawo su zauna a ƙasar Yahuda daga dukan al’umman inda aka kora su.
english: But Johanan the son of Kareah and all the captains of the forces took all the remnant of Judah, who had returned from all the nations where they had been driven, to live in the land of Judah—

hausa: Sai ya je wajenta, ya kama hannunta, ya ɗaga ta. Zazzaɓin kuwa ya sāke ta, ta kuma yi musu hidima.
english: He came and took her by the hand and raised her up. The fever left her immediately, and she served them.

hausa: Suna fitowa ke nan, sai suka sadu da wani mutumin Sairin, mai suna Siman. Sai suka tilasta shi ya ɗauki gicciyen.
english: As they came out, they found a man of Cyrene, Simon by name, and they compelled him to go with them, that he might carry his cross.

hausa: Saboda haka ya kira Yohanan ɗan Kareya da dukan shugabannin sojoji waɗanda suke tare da shi da dukan jama’a daga ƙarami zuwa babba.
english: Then he called Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the captains of the forces who were with him, and all the people from the least even to the greatest,

hausa: Gama tun dā, a kwanakin Dawuda da Asaf, akwai masu bi da mawaƙa da kuma na waƙoƙin yabo da na godiya ga Allah.
english: For in the days of David and Asaph of old there was a chief of the singers, and songs of praise and thanksgiving to God.

hausa: “ ‘Sa’ad da kwanakin tsabtaccewarta don ɗa namiji ko ’ya ta mace suka cika, sai ta kawo ɗan rago bana ɗaya wa firist a bakin ƙofar Tentin Sujada don hadaya ta ƙonawa da tattabara ko kurciya na hadaya don zunubi.
english: “‘When the days of her purification are completed for a son or for a daughter, she shall bring to the priest at the door of the Tent of Meeting, a year old lamb for a burnt offering, and a young pigeon or a turtledove, for a sin offering.

hausa: Dukan maza daga shekara talatin zuwa hamsin waɗanda sukan zo hidimar aiki a Tentin Sujada,
english: from thirty years old and upward even to fifty years old—everyone who entered into the service for work in the Tent of Meeting,

hausa: Aiyalon da Gat-Rimmon, tare da wuraren kiwonsu.
english: Aijalon with its pasture lands, Gath Rimmon with its pasture lands;

hausa: Yesu kuwa ya san tunaninsu sai ya ce musu, “Duk mulkin da yake gāba da kansa zai lalace, kuma duk birni ko gidan da yake rabe gāba da kansa ba zai ɗore ba.
english: Knowing their thoughts, Jesus said to them, “Every kingdom divided against itself is brought to desolation, and every city or house divided against itself will not stand.

hausa: Sa’an nan Ubangiji ya ce, “Kuka a kan Sodom da Gomorra ta yi yawa, zunubinsu kuma ya yi muni sosai,
english: Yahweh said, “Because the cry of Sodom and Gomorrah is great, and because their sin is very grievous,

hausa: Sai dai akwai ƙwarin da suke da fikafikai masu tafiya da ƙafafu huɗu da za ku ci; waɗanda suke da cinyoyin da suke sa su iya tsalle.
english: Yet you may eat these: of all winged creeping things that go on all fours, which have long, jointed legs for hopping on the earth.

hausa: Zai ɗibiya hannu a kan hadayarsa, yă yanka shi a gaban Tentin Sujada. Sa’an nan ’ya’yan Haruna maza za su yayyafa jinin dabbar a kowane gefe na bagade.
english: and he shall lay his hand on the head of his offering, and kill it before the Tent of Meeting. Aaron’s sons shall sprinkle its blood around on the altar.

hausa: “Gaskiya nake gaya muku, duk abin da kuka daure a duniya, za a daure a sama, duk kuma abin da kuka kunce a duniya, za a kunce shi a sama.
english: Most certainly I tell you, whatever things you bind on earth will have been bound in heaven, and whatever things you release on earth will have been released in heaven.

hausa: Mutanen Isra’ila sun kai dubu ɗari uku. Mutanen Yahuda kuma dubu talatin, sa’ad da Shawulu ya tara su a Bezek.
english: He counted them in Bezek; and the children of Israel were three hundred thousand, and the men of Judah thirty thousand.

hausa: Duk da haka, dole a fyaɗa mu a wani tsibiri.”
english: But we must run aground on a certain island.”

hausa: Suka kulle ƙofofin shirayi, suka kuma kashe fitilu. Ba su ƙone turare ko su miƙa hadayun ƙonawa a wuri mai tsarki ga Allah na Isra’ila ba.
english: Also they have shut up the doors of the porch, and put out the lamps, and have not burned incense nor offered burnt offerings in the holy place to the God of Israel.

hausa: “Na ƙi kisan aure,” in ji Ubangiji, Allah na Isra’ila. “Na kuma ƙi mutumin da ya rufe kansa da tashin hankali kamar riga,” in ji Ubangiji Maɗaukaki. Saboda haka sai ka lura da kanka, kada kuma ka ci amana.
english: One who hates and divorces”, says Yahweh, the God of Israel, “covers his garment with violence!” says Yahweh of Armies. “Therefore pay attention to your spirit, that you don’t be unfaithful.

hausa: Yahuda ya gane su, sai ya ce, “Ai, ta fi ni gaskiya, da yake ban ba da ita ga ɗana Shela ba.” Bai kuwa ƙara kwana da ita ba.
english: Judah acknowledged them, and said, “She is more righteous than I, because I didn’t give her to Shelah, my son.” He knew her again no more.

hausa: Suka yi murna sa’ad da wuri ya kwanta, ya kuma bishe su zuwa inda suka so su kai.
english: Then they are glad because it is calm, so he brings them to their desired haven.

hausa: Na biyun ita ce, ‘Ka ƙaunaci maƙwabcinka kamar kanka.’Ba wata doka da ta fi waɗannan.”
english: The second is like this: ‘You shall love your neighbor as yourself.’ There is no other commandment greater than these.”

hausa: Sai Sama’ila ya roƙi Ubangiji, a ranar kuwa Ubangiji ya aiko da tsawa da ruwan sama. Dukan mutane suka ji tsoron Ubangiji da kuma Sama’ila.
english: So Samuel called to Yahweh, and Yahweh sent thunder and rain that day. Then all the people greatly feared Yahweh and Samuel.

hausa: idanuna ba sa gani sosai saboda baƙin ciki. Ina kira gare ka, ya Ubangiji, kowace rana; na tā da hannuwana zuwa gare ka.
english: My eyes are dim from grief. I have called on you daily, Yahweh. I have spread out my hands to you.

hausa: Amma domin ya kāre kansa, sai ya tambayi Yesu ya ce, “Shin, wane ne maƙwabcina?”
english: But he, desiring to justify himself, asked Jesus, “Who is my neighbor?”

hausa: Har ’yan yara suna rena ni; in sun gan ni sai su fara yi mini riyar reni.
english: Even young children despise me. If I arise, they speak against me.

hausa: Sa’an nan Ruhu ya ɗaga ni sama, a bayana na ji wata karar babban motsi na cewa, Bari a yabi ɗaukakar Ubangiji a wurin zamansa!
english: Then the Spirit lifted me up, and I heard behind me the voice of a great rushing, saying, “Blessed be Yahweh’s glory from his place.”

hausa: Sai Ubangiji ya wuce a gaban Musa, ya yi shela ya ce, “Ni ne Ubangiji Allah mai tausayi, mai alheri, mai jinkirin fushi, cike da ƙauna da aminci,
english: Yahweh passed by before him, and proclaimed, “Yahweh! Yahweh, a merciful and gracious God, slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness and truth,

hausa: ɗaya ɗakin kuma da yake fuskantar arewa ne na firistocin da suke lura da bagade. Waɗannan su ne ’ya’yan Zadok maza, waɗanda su ne kaɗai Lawiyawan da za su iya yin kusa da Ubangiji don su yi hidima a gabansa.”
english: The room which faces toward the north is for the priests who perform the duty of the altar. These are the sons of Zadok, who from among the sons of Levi come near to Yahweh to minister to him.”

hausa: Amma ya ce musu, “Ina da abincin da ba ku san kome a kai ba.”
english: But he said to them, “I have food to eat that you don’t know about.”

hausa: Sai Bitrus da almajirin nan suka nufi kabarin.
english: Therefore Peter and the other disciple went out, and they went toward the tomb.

hausa: Mutanen da nake aikan ka masu ƙin ji ne da kuma taurinkai. Ka faɗa musu cewa, ‘Ga abin da Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka ya faɗa.’
english: The children are impudent and stiff-hearted. I am sending you to them, and you shall tell them, ‘This is what the Lord Yahweh says.’

hausa: In ma lalle ne in yi taƙama, to, sai in yi taƙama da abubuwan da suka nuna rashin ƙarfina.
english: If I must boast, I will boast of the things that concern my weakness.

hausa: “Amma na gaya maka, a nan ba ka yi daidai ba, gama Allah ya fi mutum girma.
english: “Behold, I will answer you. In this you are not just, for God is greater than man.

hausa: Zan ba ka dukiyar duhu, arzikin da aka ajiye a asirtattun wurare, saboda ka san cewa ni ne Ubangiji, Allah na Isra’ila, wanda ya kira ka da suna.
english: I will give you the treasures of darkness and hidden riches of secret places, that you may know that it is I, Yahweh, who calls you by your name, even the God of Israel.

hausa: Suka ce “Malam, Musa ya faɗa mana cewa in mutum ya mutu ba shi da ’ya’ya, dole ɗan’uwansa yă auri gwauruwar yă kuma haifar wa ɗan’uwan ’ya’ya.
english: saying, “Teacher, Moses said, ‘If a man dies, having no children, his brother shall marry his wife and raise up offspring for his brother.’

hausa: bagaden hadaya ta ƙonawa da rigarsa ta tagulla da sandunansa da duk kayayyakinsa, daron tagulla da wurin ajiye shi.
english: the altar of burnt offering, with its grating of bronze, its poles, and all its vessels, the basin and its base;

hausa: Ku yi wa kanku kaciya ga Ubangiji ku yi wa zukatanku kaciya, ku mutanen Yahuda da mutanen Urushalima, in ba haka ba hasalata za tă sauko ta ci kamar wuta saboda muguntar da kuka aikata za tă ci ba wanda zai kashe ta.
english: Circumcise yourselves to Yahweh, and take away the foreskins of your heart, you men of Judah and inhabitants of Jerusalem; lest my wrath go out like fire, and burn so that no one can quench it, because of the evil of your doings.

hausa: Duniya ta cika da ƙaunarka, ya Ubangiji; ka koya mini ƙa’idodinka.
english: The earth is full of your loving kindness, Yahweh. Teach me your statutes. TETH

hausa: Bayan ya faɗa haka, sai kunnuwan mutumin suka buɗe, harshensa kuma ya kunce, sai ya fara magana sarai.
english: Immediately his ears were opened, and the impediment of his tongue was released, and he spoke clearly.

hausa: (Wannan ita ma a ɗauka ta a matsayin ƙasar Refahiyawa waɗanda dā sun zauna a can ne; amma Ammonawa suna ce da su Zamzummawa.
english: (That also is considered a land of Rephaim. Rephaim lived there in the past, but the Ammonites call them Zamzummim,

hausa: na biyar, Shefatiya ɗan Abital; da kuma na shida, Itireyam ta wurin matarsa Egla.
english: the fifth, Shephatiah of Abital; the sixth, Ithream by Eglah his wife:

hausa: “Ɗan mutum, ka faɗa wa ƙasar, ‘Ke ƙasa ce marar ruwan sama ko yayyafi a ranar hasala.’
english: “Son of man, tell her, ‘You are a land that is not cleansed nor rained on in the day of indignation.’

hausa: Addu’ar Dawuda. Ka ji, ya Ubangiji, ka kuma amsa mini, gama ni matalauci ne mai bukata kuma.
english: A Prayer by David. Hear, Yahweh, and answer me, for I am poor and needy.

hausa: Suna ƙyanƙyashe ƙwan kāsā su kuma saƙa yanar gizo-gizo. Duk wanda ya ci ƙwansu zai mutu, kuma sa’ad da ƙwan ya fashe, zai ƙyanƙyashe kububuwa.
english: They hatch adders’ eggs and weave the spider’s web. He who eats of their eggs dies; and that which is crushed breaks out into a viper.

hausa: Yesu ya ce mata, “Maryamu.” Sai ta juya wajensa ta ɗaga murya ta ce da Arameyanci, “Rabboni!” (Wanda yake nufin “Malam”).
english: Jesus said to her, “Mary.” She turned and said to him, “Rabboni!” which is to say, “Teacher!”

hausa: Waɗansu daga cikin dattawan ƙasar suka zo gaba suka ce wa dukan taron jama’a,
english: Then certain of the elders of the land rose up, and spoke to all the assembly of the people, saying,

hausa: To, mece ce ribar zama mutumin Yahuda, ko kuwa mene ne amfanin kaciya?
english: Then what advantage does the Jew have? Or what is the profit of circumcision?

hausa: Mutanen Dawuda suka juya suka koma. Da suka iso sai suka faɗa wa Dawuda abin da Nabal ya ce.
english: So David’s young men turned on their way and went back, and came and told him all these words.

hausa: Ba mai iya zuwa wurina, sai dai in Uban da ya aiko ni ya jawo shi, ni kuwa zan tashe shi a rana ta ƙarshe.
english: No one can come to me unless the Father who sent me draws him; and I will raise him up in the last day.

hausa: Ta Dawuda. Yi hamayya, ya Ubangiji, da waɗanda suke hamayya da ni; yi faɗa da waɗanda suke faɗa da ni.
english: By David. Contend, Yahweh, with those who contend with me. Fight against those who fight against me.

hausa: Da wannan yana nufin Ruhu ke nan, wanda waɗanda suka gaskata da shi za su karɓa daga baya. Har yă zuwa wannan lokaci ba a ba da Ruhu ba tukuna, da yake ba a riga an ɗaukaka Yesu ba.
english: But he said this about the Spirit, which those believing in him were to receive. For the Holy Spirit was not yet given, because Jesus wasn’t yet glorified.

hausa: Mahaifiya ’ya’ya bakwai za tă suma ta ja numfashinta na ƙarshe. Ranarta zai fāɗi tun lokacin bai yi ba; za tă sha kunya a kuma wulaƙanta ta. Zan sa a kashe raguwa da takobi a gaban abokan gābansu,” in ji Ubangiji.
english: She who has borne seven languishes. She has given up the spirit. Her sun has gone down while it was yet day. She has been disappointed and confounded. I will deliver their residue to the sword before their enemies,” says Yahweh.

hausa: Ni kaina zan zauna a Mizfa in zama wakilinku a gaban Babiloniyawa waɗanda za su zo wurinmu, amma ku girbe ruwan inabi, ’ya’yan itatuwa na kaka, da mai, ku zuba su a tulunan ajiyarku, ku kuma zauna a garuruwan da kuka ci.”
english: As for me, behold, I will dwell at Mizpah, to stand before the Chaldeans who will come to us; but you, gather wine and summer fruits and oil, and put them in your vessels, and dwell in your cities that you have taken.”

hausa: Wannan kuwa ya faru ne don a cika kalmomin da Yesu ya yi da suka nuna irin mutuwar da zai yi.
english: that the word of Jesus might be fulfilled, which he spoke, signifying by what kind of death he should die.

hausa: Birnin da dukan abin da yake cikinta za a miƙa su ga Ubangiji. Rahab karuwan nan kaɗai ce, da dukan waɗanda suke tare da ita a gidanta za a bari da rai domin ta ɓoye ’yan leƙen asirin ƙasa da muka aika.
english: The city shall be devoted, even it and all that is in it, to Yahweh. Only Rahab the prostitute shall live, she and all who are with her in the house, because she hid the messengers that we sent.

hausa: Amma kai, ya Ubangiji, kai Allah mai tausayi ne da kuma mai alheri, mai jinkirin fushi, mai yawan ƙauna da aminci.
english: But you, Lord, are a merciful and gracious God, slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness and truth.

hausa: “Kamar kwaruruka suke a shimfiɗe, kamar lambu kusa da rafi, kamar itatuwan aloyes da Ubangiji ya dasa, kamar itatuwa al’ul kusa da ruwaye.
english: As valleys they are spread out, as gardens by the riverside, as aloes which Yahweh has planted, as cedar trees beside the waters.

hausa: Hikima za tă cece ka daga hanyoyin mugayen mutane, daga kalmomin mutane masu ɓatanci,
english: to deliver you from the way of evil, from the men who speak perverse things,

hausa: Ya zo ya yi muku wa’azin salama; ku da kuke nesa da shi, ya kuma yi wa waɗanda suke kusa.
english: He came and preached peace to you who were far off and to those who were near.

hausa: A maimakon haka sai ka naɗa Lawiyawa su lura da tabanakul Shaida, wato, kan dukan kayayyaki da kuma kome da yake na wuri mai tsarki. Za su ɗauko tabanakul da dukan kayayyakinsa; za su lura da shi, su kasance kewaye da shi.
english: but appoint the Levites over the Tabernacle of the Testimony, and over all its furnishings, and over all that belongs to it. They shall carry the tabernacle and all its furnishings; and they shall take care of it, and shall encamp around it.

hausa: Suna cewa, “Allah ya yashe shi; mu fafare shi mu kama shi, gama ba wanda zai kuɓutar da shi.”
english: saying, “God has forsaken him. Pursue and take him, for no one will rescue him.”

hausa: Za su zo su mamaye kwazazzabai da kogwanni cikin duwatsu, a kan dukan ƙayayyuwa da dukan rammukan ruwa.
english: They shall come, and shall all rest in the desolate valleys, in the clefts of the rocks, on all thorn hedges, and on all pastures.

hausa: Za a kulle biranen da suke a Negeb, kuma babu wanda zai buɗe su. Za a kwashe dukan Yahuda zuwa zaman bauta, za a kwashe su tas.
english: The cities of the South are shut up, and there is no one to open them. Judah is carried away captive: all of them. They are wholly carried away captive.

hausa: Sai ’yan leƙen asirin suka tambaye shi, suka ce, “Malam, mun sani kana faɗin, kuma kana koyar da abin da yake daidai, ba ka kuma nuna bambanci, amma kana koyar da hanyar Allah bisa ga gaskiya.
english: They asked him, “Teacher, we know that you say and teach what is right, and aren’t partial to anyone, but truly teach the way of God.

hausa: Ka tabbatar an rarraba ƙasar ta wurin rabo. Abin da kowace ƙungiya ta gāda zai zama bisa ga sunayen kabilar kakanninta.
english: Notwithstanding, the land shall be divided by lot. According to the names of the tribes of their fathers they shall inherit.

hausa: Sai mutumin Allah ya zo ya ce wa sarkin Isra’ila, “Ga abin da Ubangiji ya ce, ‘Domin Arameyawa suna tsammani Ubangiji allahn tuddai ne, ba allahn kwari ba, zan ba da wannan ɗumbun mayaƙa a hannuwanka, za ka kuwa sani ni ne Ubangiji.’ ”
english: A man of God came near and spoke to the king of Israel, and said, “Yahweh says, ‘Because the Syrians have said, “Yahweh is a god of the hills, but he is not a god of the valleys,” therefore I will deliver all this great multitude into your hand, and you shall know that I am Yahweh.’”

hausa: Bitrus ya ƙwanƙwasa ƙofar waje, sai wata mai aiki a gidan da ake kira Roda ta zo tă ji ko wane ne.
english: When Peter knocked at the door of the gate, a servant girl named Rhoda came to answer.

hausa: Bayan wani lokaci, Ben-Hadad sarkin Aram ya tattara dukan rundunarsa, ya je ya kewaye Samariya da yaƙi.
english: After this, Benhadad king of Syria gathered all his army, and went up and besieged Samaria.

hausa: Amma Abram ya ce, “Ya Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka, mene ne za ka ba ni, ganin cewa ba na haihuwa, wanda kuma zai gāji gādon gidana shi ne Eliyezer mutumin Damaskus?”
english: Abram said, “Lord Yahweh, what will you give me, since I go childless, and he who will inherit my estate is Eliezer of Damascus?”

hausa: Haruna zai ɗibiya hannuwansa a kan akuya mai ran, yă furta a kansa dukan mugunta da tawayen Isra’ilawa, dukan zunubansu, yă kuma sa su a kan akuyan. Zai kori akuyan zuwa cikin jeji a hannun mutumin da aka ba shi aikin yin haka.
english: Aaron shall lay both his hands on the head of the live goat, and confess over him all the iniquities of the children of Israel, and all their transgressions, even all their sins; and he shall put them on the head of the goat, and shall send him away into the wilderness by the hand of a man who is ready.

hausa: Har yanzu, akwai wani hutun Asabbacin da ya rage domin mutanen Allah;
english: There remains therefore a Sabbath rest for the people of God.

hausa: Sa’an nan Ibzan ya mutu, aka kuwa binne shi Betlehem.
english: Ibzan died, and was buried at Bethlehem.

hausa: Gama tabbatacce ba mala’iku ne ya taimaka ba, sai dai zuriyar Ibrahim.
english: For most certainly, he doesn’t give help to angels, but he gives help to the offspring of Abraham.

hausa: Zai kuma ƙone kitsen hadaya don zunubi a kan bagade.
english: The fat of the sin offering he shall burn on the altar.

hausa: “Ku yi farin ciki tare da Urushalima ku kuma yi murna saboda ita, dukanku waɗanda kuke ƙaunarta; ku yi farin ciki matuƙa tare da ita, dukanku waɗanda kuke makoki a kanta.
english: “Rejoice with Jerusalem, and be glad for her, all you who love her. Rejoice for joy with her, all you who mourn over her;

hausa: Sai ya fita ya sami an jefar da gawar a hanya, jakin da zakin suna tsaye kusa da shi. Zakin bai ci gawar ko yă yayyage jakin ba.
english: He went and found his body thrown on the path, and the donkey and the lion standing by the body. The lion had not eaten the body nor mauled the donkey.

hausa: (“Kash, da ina da wanda zai ji ni! Na sa hannu ga abin da na faɗa don kāre kaina, bari Maɗaukaki yă amsa mini; bari mai tuhumata da laifi yă yi ƙarata a rubuce.
english: oh that I had one to hear me! Behold, here is my signature! Let the Almighty answer me! Let the accuser write my indictment!

hausa: Waɗanda ba su mutu ba kuwa, sun kamu da marurai. Kukan birnin kuwa ta hau har zuwa sama.
english: The men who didn’t die were struck with the tumors; and the cry of the city went up to heaven.

hausa: Zai ɗibiya hannunsa a kan bunsurun yă kuma yanka shi a inda ake yankan hadayar ƙonawa a gaban Ubangiji. Hadaya ce ta zunubi.
english: He shall lay his hand on the head of the goat, and kill it in the place where they kill the burnt offering before Yahweh. It is a sin offering.

hausa: In mutum ya ga cewa ba ya nuna halin da ya kamata ga budurwar da ya yi alkawarin aure da ita, in kuma shekarunta suna wucewa, shi kuma ya ga ya kamata yă yi aure, to, sai yă yi. Ba zunubi ba ne. Ya kamata su yi aure.
english: But if any man thinks that he is behaving inappropriately toward his virgin, if she is past the flower of her age, and if need so requires, let him do what he desires. He doesn’t sin. Let them marry.

hausa: Duk wanda ya ƙyifce da idonsa yana ƙulla maƙarƙashiya ce; duk wanda ya murguɗa leɓunansa yana niyya aikata mugunta ke nan.
english: One who winks his eyes to plot perversities, one who compresses his lips, is bent on evil.

hausa: Da Dawuda ya gudu ya tsere, sai ya tafi wurin Sama’ila a Rama ya gaya masa dukan abin da Shawulu ya yi masa. Da shi da Sama’ila suka tafi Nayiwot suka zauna a can.
english: Now David fled and escaped, and came to Samuel at Ramah, and told him all that Saul had done to him. He and Samuel went and lived in Naioth.

hausa: Sai ya kira manajan, ya tambaye shi, ‘Me nake ji haka a kanka? Ka kawo lissafin aikinka, domin ba za ka iya cin gaba da aikinka ba.’
english: He called him, and said to him, ‘What is this that I hear about you? Give an accounting of your management, for you can no longer be manager.’

hausa: Amma Yayel, matar Heber, ta ɗauki turken tenti da guduma ta tafi wurinsa da sauri sa’ad da yake barci saboda gajiya. Ta kafa masa turken a gindin kunnensa ta haɗa shi da ƙasa, har ya mutu.
english: Then Jael, Heber’s wife, took a tent peg, and took a hammer in her hand, and went softly to him, and struck the pin into his temples, and it pierced through into the ground, for he was in a deep sleep; so he fainted and died.

hausa: Amma suka gwada Allah suka tayar wa Mafi Ɗaukaka; ba su kiyaye ƙa’idodinsa ba.
english: Yet they tempted and rebelled against the Most High God, and didn’t keep his testimonies,

hausa: Ba kai ba ne, ya Allah, kai da ka ƙi mu ba ka kuwa fita tare da mayaƙanmu?
english: Haven’t you rejected us, God? You don’t go out, God, with our armies.

hausa: Sunan kogi na fari, Fishon. Shi ne yake malala kewaye da dukan ƙasar Hawila, inda akwai zinariya.
english: The name of the first is Pishon: it flows through the whole land of Havilah, where there is gold;

hausa: Ki ɗaukaka Ubangiji, ya Urushalima; ki yabi Allahnki, ya Sihiyona.
english: Praise Yahweh, Jerusalem! Praise your God, Zion!

hausa: Da Yesu ya shiga gidan mai mulkin ya ga masu busan sarewa da taro mai hayaniya,
english: When Jesus came into the ruler’s house and saw the flute players and the crowd in noisy disorder,

hausa: Shelomit da danginsa su ne suke lura da dukan baitulmali don kayayyakin da Sarki Dawuda ya keɓe, ta wajen kawunan iyalai waɗanda suke shugabannin dubu-dubu da shugabannin ɗari-ɗari, da kuma wajen sauran shugabannin mayaƙa.
english: This Shelomoth and his brothers were over all the treasuries of the dedicated things, which David the king, and the heads of the fathers’ households, the captains over thousands and hundreds, and the captains of the army, had dedicated.

hausa: Adama, Rama, Hazor,
english: Adamah, Ramah, Hazor,

hausa: A kara ta biyu, sansanin da yake a kudanci, su kama hanya. Busan kakaki zai zama alama ta kama hanya.
english: When you blow an alarm the second time, the camps that lie on the south side shall go forward. They shall blow an alarm for their journeys.

hausa: Sai Mikal ta ɗauki gunki ta kwantar da shi a gādo, ta sa masa gashin akuya a kansa, sai ta rufe da mayafi.
english: Michal took the teraphim and laid it in the bed, and put a pillow of goats’ hair at its head and covered it with clothes.

hausa: Daga sarki Nebukadnezzar. Zuwa ga mutane da al’ummai da kuma kowane yare, da suke zama a duniya. Salama mai yawa ta tabbata a gare ku!
english: Nebuchadnezzar the king, to all the peoples, nations, and languages, who dwell in all the earth: Peace be multiplied to you.

hausa: Saboda haka Kayinu ya yi tafiyarsa ya rabu da Ubangiji, ya je ya zauna ƙasar Nod a gabashin Eden.
english: Cain left Yahweh’s presence, and lived in the land of Nod, east of Eden.

hausa: Da ya lura da yadda baƙi suna zaɓan wuraren zama masu bangirma a tebur, sai ya faɗa musu wannan misali, ya ce;
english: He spoke a parable to those who were invited, when he noticed how they chose the best seats, and said to them,

hausa: Sai a yi da shi kamar ma’aikacin da aka ɗauka aiki, daga shekara zuwa shekara; dole ku tabbata mai shi bai mallake shi da tsanani ba.
english: As a servant hired year by year shall he be with him. He shall not rule with harshness over him in your sight.

hausa: Yesu ya kuma faɗi wannan misali ga waɗansu masu taƙama da adalcinsu, kuma suna rena sauran mutane ya ce,
english: He also spoke this parable to certain people who were convinced of their own righteousness, and who despised all others:

hausa: Bayan na zazzaga Makidoniya, zan zo wurinku, domin zan ratsa ta Makidoniya.
english: I will come to you when I have passed through Macedonia, for I am passing through Macedonia.

hausa: “Za a hallakar da wuraren sujada na Ishaku kuma tsarkakan wurare na Isra’ila za su zama kango; da takobina zan tayar wa gidan Yerobowam.”
english: The high places of Isaac will be desolate, the sanctuaries of Israel will be laid waste; and I will rise against the house of Jeroboam with the sword.”

hausa: Ibrahim ya haifi Ishaku, Ishaku ya haifi Yaƙub, Yaƙub ya haifi Yahuda da ’yan’uwansa,
english: Abraham became the father of Isaac. Isaac became the father of Jacob. Jacob became the father of Judah and his brothers.

hausa: Amma Yowash ya ce wa taron da suka tayar masa, “Za ku yi hamayya domin Ba’al ne? Kuna ƙoƙari ku cece shi ne? Duk wanda ya yi faɗa saboda shi za a kashe shi kafin safe. In lalle Ba’al allah ne, zai kāre kansa sa’ad da wani ya rushe bagadensa.”
english: Joash said to all who stood against him, “Will you contend for Baal? Or will you save him? He who will contend for him, let him be put to death by morning! If he is a god, let him contend for himself, because someone has broken down his altar!”

hausa: Sai Yoshuwa ya sallami mutane, kowa ya tafi ƙasar da aka ba shi gādo.
english: So Joshua sent the people away, each to his own inheritance.

hausa: Wannan ne yakan kawo ɗaukaka ga Ubana, ku ba da ’ya’ya da yawa, kuna kuma nuna kanku ku almajiraina ne.
english: “In this my Father is glorified, that you bear much fruit; and so you will be my disciples.

hausa: Bari yă ɓoye fuskarsa cikin ƙura kila akwai bege.
english: Let him put his mouth in the dust, if it is so that there may be hope.

hausa: Duba yadda suka hallaka farat ɗaya, razana ta share su gaba ɗaya!
english: How they are suddenly destroyed! They are completely swept away with terrors.

hausa: waɗanda za su yi masa ba’a, su tofa masa miyau, su yi masa bulala, su kuma kashe shi. Bayan kwana uku kuma yă tashi.”
english: They will mock him, spit on him, scourge him, and kill him. On the third day he will rise again.”

hausa: “Ɗan mutum, na mai da kai mai tsaro don gidan Isra’ila; saboda haka ka ji maganar da zan yi ka kuma yi musu kashedin nan da ya fito daga gare ni.
english: “Son of man, I have made you a watchman to the house of Israel. Therefore hear the word from my mouth, and warn them from me.

hausa: da Ma’aziya, da Bilgai, da kuma Shemahiya. Waɗannan su ne Firistocin.
english: Maaziah, Bilgai, and Shemaiah. These were the priests.

hausa: Amma manyan firistoci da dattawa suka shawo kan taron, su ce, a ba su Barabbas, amma a kashe Yesu.
english: Now the chief priests and the elders persuaded the multitudes to ask for Barabbas and destroy Jesus.

hausa: Ya ce, “Duba har yanzu da sauran rana da yawa, lokaci bai kai na tara garkuna ba. Ku shayar da tumaki ku mai da su wurin kiwo.”
english: He said, “Behold, it is still the middle of the day, not time to gather the livestock together. Water the sheep, and go and feed them.”

hausa: Waɗannan su ne shugabannin iyalansu. ’Ya’yan Ruben maza ɗan farin Isra’ila su ne, Hanok da Fallu, Hezron da Karmi. Waɗannan su ne dangin Ruben.
english: These are the heads of their fathers’ houses. The sons of Reuben the firstborn of Israel: Hanoch, and Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi; these are the families of Reuben.

hausa: Mutum ɗari biyu daga Urushalima suka raka Absalom. An gayyace su a matsayin baƙi, suka kuwa tafi cikin rashin sani, ba su san wani abu game da al’amarin ba.
english: Two hundred men went with Absalom out of Jerusalem, who were invited, and went in their simplicity; and they didn’t know anything.

hausa: Wane ne ya rasa ƙarfi, da ban ji shi a jikina ba? Wane ne ya fāɗi cikin zunubi, da ban ji zafin wannan ba?
english: Who is weak, and I am not weak? Who is caused to stumble, and I don’t burn with indignation?

hausa: Kuna duban abubuwa bisa-bisa ne kawai. In wani ya ganin cewa shi na Kiristi ne, ya kamata yă sāke lura cewa kamar yadda yake na Kiristi, haka mu ma muke.
english: Do you look at things only as they appear in front of your face? If anyone trusts in himself that he is Christ’s, let him consider this again with himself, that even as he is Christ’s, so we also are Christ’s.

hausa: Akwai waninku da yake shan wahala? Ya kamata yă yi addu’a. Akwai wani mai murna? Sai yă rera waƙoƙin yabo.
english: Is any among you suffering? Let him pray. Is any cheerful? Let him sing praises.

hausa: Maciji ya ce wa macen, “Tabbatacce ba za ku mutu ba.
english: The serpent said to the woman, “You won’t really die,

hausa: “Ɗan’uwa zai ba da ɗan’uwa a kashe. Mahaifi zai ba da ɗansa. ’Ya’ya za su tayar wa iyayensu, su kuma sa a kashe su.
english: “Brother will deliver up brother to death, and the father his child. Children will rise up against parents and cause them to be put to death.

hausa: Bayan da na yi magana, ba su ƙara ce kome ba. Maganata ta shige su.
english: After my words they didn’t speak again. My speech fell on them.

hausa: Ka kiyaye bawanka daga zunubin ganganci; kada ka bari su yi mulki a kaina. Ta haka zan zama marar laifi; marar laifi na babban tawaye.
english: Keep back your servant also from presumptuous sins. Let them not have dominion over me. Then I will be upright. I will be blameless and innocent of great transgression.

hausa: Su kansu al’ummai da sarakuna masu yawa za su bautar da su; zan sāka musu bisa ga ayyukansu da aikin hannuwansu.”
english: For many nations and great kings will make bondservants of them, even of them. I will recompense them according to their deeds, and according to the work of their hands.”

hausa: Ba za a ƙona wani irin turare dabam a bisa wannan bagade ba, ba kuma za a miƙa hadaya ta ƙonawa, ko ta hatsi, ko ta sha a bisansa ba.
english: You shall offer no strange incense on it, nor burnt offering, nor meal offering; and you shall pour no drink offering on it.

hausa: in ka neme shi yadda ake neman azurfa ka kuma neme shi kamar yadda ake neman ɓoyayyiyar dukiya,
english: if you seek her as silver, and search for her as for hidden treasures;

hausa: Ya rataye sarkin Ai a kan itace, ya bar shi a can har yamma. Da rana ta fāɗi, Yoshuwa ya umarta a ɗauke gawar sarkin a jefa a gaban ƙofar birnin. Suka kuma tara manyan duwatsu a kan gawar, tsibin na nan har wa yau.
english: He hanged the king of Ai on a tree until the evening. At sundown, Joshua commanded, and they took his body down from the tree and threw it at the entrance of the gate of the city, and raised a great heap of stones on it that remains to this day.

hausa: Ka bi umarnin da zai fito daga bakinsa kuma ka riƙe maganarsa a cikin zuciyarka.
english: Please receive instruction from his mouth, and lay up his words in your heart.

hausa: Sa’ad da Samla ya rasu, Sha’ul daga Rehobot na ta kogi ya gāje shi.
english: Samlah died, and Shaul of Rehoboth by the river, reigned in his place.

hausa: Na ɓace rai ƙwarai na kuma zubar da dukan kayan gidan Tobiya daga ɗakin.
english: It grieved me severely. Therefore I threw all Tobiah’s household stuff out of the room.

hausa: Sarki ya kuma rubuta wasiƙu yana zagin Ubangiji, Allah na Isra’ila, yana faɗin wannan a kansa, “Kamar yadda sauran allolin mutanen sauran ƙasashe ba su iya kuɓutar da mutane daga hannuna ba, haka Allahn Hezekiya ba zai kuɓutar da mutanensa daga hannuna ba.”
english: He also wrote letters insulting Yahweh, the God of Israel, and speaking against him, saying, “As the gods of the nations of the lands, which have not delivered their people out of my hand, so shall the God of Hezekiah not deliver his people out of my hand.”

hausa: Amma ya yi mūsu ya ce, “Mace, ban san shi ba!”
english: He denied Jesus, saying, “Woman, I don’t know him.”

hausa: “Ɗauki garaya, ki ratsa birni, Ya ke karuwar da aka manta da ita; kaɗa garaya da kyau, ki rera waƙoƙi masu yawa, saboda a tuna da ke.”
english: Take a harp; go about the city, you prostitute that has been forgotten. Make sweet melody. Sing many songs, that you may be remembered.

hausa: Za su kuwa san cewa ni ne Ubangiji, sa’ad da gawawwakin mutanensu suna kwance a kusa da gumakansu da kewaye da bagadansu, a kowane kan tudu mai tsawo da kuma a kan dukan kan duwatsu, a ƙarƙashin kowane inuwar itace da kuma kowane oak mai ganye, wuraren da suke ƙone turare masu ƙanshi wa dukan gumakansu.
english: You will know that I am Yahweh when their slain men are among their idols around their altars, on every high hill, on all the tops of the mountains, under every green tree, and under every thick oak—the places where they offered pleasant aroma to all their idols.

hausa: Dawuda ya yi tunani a ransa ya ce, “Wata rana Shawulu zai kashe ni, abu mafi kyau da zan yi shi ne in tsere zuwa ƙasar Filistiyawa. Da haka Shawulu zai fid da zuciya ga nemana a ƙasar Isra’ila, a can kuwa zan tsira daga hannunsa.”
english: David said in his heart, “I will now perish one day by the hand of Saul. There is nothing better for me than that I should escape into the land of the Philistines; and Saul will despair of me, to seek me any more in all the borders of Israel. So I will escape out of his hand.”

hausa: Duk wanda ya tara dukiyarsa ta wurin ba da bashi da ruwan da ya wuce misali yana tara wa wani ne wanda zai yi wa talakawa alheri.
english: He who increases his wealth by excessive interest gathers it for one who has pity on the poor.

hausa: Sa’ad da Zedekiya sarkin Yahuda da dukan sojoji suka gan su, sai suka gudu; suka bar birnin da dare ta hanyar lambun sarki, ta ƙofar da take tsakanin katanga biyu, suka nufi waje Araba.
english: When Zedekiah the king of Judah and all the men of war saw them, then they fled and went out of the city by night, by the way of the king’s garden, through the gate between the two walls; and he went out toward the Arabah.

hausa: Amma Ubangiji ya ce wa mahaifina Dawuda, ‘Saboda yana a zuciyarka ka gina haikali domin Sunana, ka yi daidai da ka yi niyyar wannan a zuciyarka.
english: But Yahweh said to David my father, ‘Whereas it was in your heart to build a house for my name, you did well that it was in your heart.

hausa: “Sa’ad da kuke taimakon matan Ibraniyawa lokacin haihuwa, in jaririn namiji ne ku kashe shi, amma in ta mace ce, ku bar ta da rai.”
english: and he said, “When you perform the duty of a midwife to the Hebrew women, and see them on the birth stool, if it is a son, then you shall kill him; but if it is a daughter, then she shall live.”

hausa: Sa’ad da wahala ta zo, za su nemi salama, amma ba za su same ta ba.
english: Destruction comes! They will seek peace, and there will be none.

hausa: Mutumin ya yi kamar yadda Yusuf ya faɗa masa, ya kuwa ɗauki mutanen zuwa gidan Yusuf.
english: The man did as Joseph commanded, and the man brought the men to Joseph’s house.

hausa: Sai Sarauniya Esta ta amsa ta ce, “In na sami tagomashi a wurinka, ya sarki, in kuma mai girma ya yarda, a bar ni da raina, wannan shi ne roƙona. Ka kuma sa kada a kashe mutanena, wannan ita ce bukata.
english: Then Esther the queen answered, “If I have found favor in your sight, O king, and if it pleases the king, let my life be given me at my petition, and my people at my request.

hausa: Ka sa ’ya’yansu maza suka yi yawa kamar taurarin sararin sama, ka kuma kawo su cikin ƙasar da ka faɗa wa kakanninsu su shiga su mallake.
english: You also multiplied their children as the stars of the sky, and brought them into the land concerning which you said to their fathers that they should go in to possess it.

hausa: “Ku tashi ku kuma fāɗa wa al’umma da sauƙi wadda take zama da ƙarfin hali,” in ji Ubangiji, “al’ummar da ba ta da ƙofofi ko ƙyamare; mutanenta suna zama su kaɗai.
english: Arise! Go up to a nation that is at ease, that dwells without care,” says Yahweh; “that has neither gates nor bars, that dwells alone.

hausa: Ka kwarara ta da ruwa ka kuma baje kunyoyinta; ka sa ta yi laushi da yayyafi ka kuma albarkaci tsire-tsirenta.
english: You drench its furrows. You level its ridges. You soften it with showers. You bless it with a crop.

hausa: “Za mu haura zuwa Urushalima, za a kuma bashe Ɗan Mutum ga manyan firistoci da malaman dokoki. Za su yi masa hukuncin kisa
english: “Behold, we are going up to Jerusalem, and the Son of Man will be delivered to the chief priests and scribes, and they will condemn him to death,

hausa: Mutanen Yahuda da na Isra’ila sun yi yawa sai ka ce yashi a bakin teku. Suka ci, suka sha, suka kuma yi farin ciki.
english: Judah and Israel were numerous as the sand which is by the sea in multitude, eating and drinking and making merry.

hausa: Su ne waɗanda suka bi shawarar Bala’am suka kuma zama sanadin sa Isra’ilawa suka juya wa Ubangiji baya, har ya kawo abin da ya faru da Feyor, har annoba ya kashe dukan mutanen Ubangiji.
english: Behold, these caused the children of Israel, through the counsel of Balaam, to commit trespass against Yahweh in the matter of Peor, and so the plague was among the congregation of Yahweh.

hausa: Daidai ne a ce, ya gidan Yaƙub, “Ruhun Ubangiji yana fushi ne? Yana yin irin waɗannan abubuwa?” “Ashe, maganata ba tă amfane wanda ayyukansa suke daidai ba?
english: Shall it be said, O house of Jacob, “Is Yahweh’s Spirit angry? Are these his doings? Don’t my words do good to him who walks blamelessly?”

hausa: walƙiya da ƙanƙara, dusar ƙanƙara da gizagizai, hadirin iskar da suke biyayya da umarnansa,
english: lightning and hail, snow and clouds, stormy wind, fulfilling his word,

hausa: Sai ta zo da gudu wajen Siman Bitrus da ɗayan almajirin, wanda Yesu yake ƙauna, ta ce, “Sun ɗauke Ubangiji daga kabarin, ba mu kuma san inda suka sa shi ba!”
english: Therefore she ran and came to Simon Peter and to the other disciple whom Jesus loved, and said to them, “They have taken away the Lord out of the tomb, and we don’t know where they have laid him!”

hausa: Na yi tankuna don in yi banruwan kurmin itatuwa.
english: I made myself pools of water, to water the forest where trees were grown.

hausa: ya ce, ‘Korneliyus, Allah ya ji addu’arka, ya kuma tuna da kyautanka ga matalauta.
english: and said, ‘Cornelius, your prayer is heard, and your gifts to the needy are remembered in the sight of God.

hausa: gama ta wurin Kiristi Yesu dokar Ruhu mai ba da rai ta ’yantar da ni daga Dokar Musa.
english: For the law of the Spirit of life in Christ Jesus made me free from the law of sin and of death.

hausa: Yaƙub ya tambayi makiyayan ya ce, “’Yan’uwa, ina kuka fito?” Suka amsa, “Mu daga Haran ne.”
english: Jacob said to them, “My relatives, where are you from?” They said, “We are from Haran.”

hausa: Suka kuma yi labule da shuɗi, shunayya, jan zare, da kuma lallausan lilin, suka kuma yi wa labulen zānen kerubobi na gwaninta.
english: He made the veil of blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen, with cherubim. He made it the work of a skillful workman.

hausa: “Amma sa’ad da shekaru saba’in ɗin suka cika, zan hukunta sarkin Babilon da kuma al’ummarsa, ƙasar Babiloniyawa, saboda laifinsu,” in ji Ubangiji, “in kuma mai da ita kango har abada.
english: “It will happen, when seventy years are accomplished, that I will punish the king of Babylon and that nation,” says Yahweh, “for their iniquity. I will make the land of the Chaldeans desolate forever.

hausa: Za ka miƙa su a gaban Ubangiji, firistoci kuma za su barbaɗe gishiri a kansu su kuma miƙa su kamar hadaya ta ƙonawa ga Ubangiji.
english: You shall bring them near to Yahweh, and the priests shall cast salt on them, and they shall offer them up for a burnt offering to Yahweh.

hausa: na kuma cika shi da Ruhun Allah, fasaha, azanci, da kuma sani cikin kowace irin sana’a,
english: I have filled him with the Spirit of God, in wisdom, and in understanding, and in knowledge, and in all kinds of workmanship,

hausa: Bari mutane su yabe ka, ya Allah; bari dukan mutane su yabe.
english: Let the peoples praise you, God. Let all the peoples praise you.

hausa: A maimako, kowa zai mutu saboda zunubinsa; duk wanda ya ci ’ya’yan inabi masu tsami, haƙoransa ne za su mutu.
english: But everyone will die for his own iniquity. Every man who eats the sour grapes, his teeth will be set on edge.

hausa: A wannan lokaci, Hazayel sarkin Aram ya haura, ya kai wa Gat hari, ya kuma ci ta da yaƙi. Sa’an nan ya juya don yă yaƙi Urushalima.
english: Then Hazael king of Syria went up and fought against Gath, and took it; and Hazael set his face to go up to Jerusalem.

hausa: Yanzu dai, kada ku damu, kada kuma ku yi fushi da kanku saboda kun sayar da ni a nan, gama Allah ya aiko ni gabanku ne don in ceci rayuka.
english: Now don’t be grieved, nor angry with yourselves, that you sold me here, for God sent me before you to preserve life.

hausa: Amma mai mulkin majami’ar ya ji haushi da Yesu ya yi warkarwa a ranar Asabbaci. Sai ya ce wa mutanen, “Akwai ranaku shida da ya kamata a yi aiki. Saboda haka, ku zo a ranakun nan a warkar da ku, ba ranar Asabbaci ba.”
english: The ruler of the synagogue, being indignant because Jesus had healed on the Sabbath, said to the multitude, “There are six days in which men ought to work. Therefore come on those days and be healed, and not on the Sabbath day!”

hausa: Kwanan baya, Teyudas ya ɓullo, yana cewa wai shi wani mutum ne, kuma wajen mutane ɗari huɗu suka bi shi. Aka kuwa kashe shi, dukan masu binsa kuwa suka watse, kome ya wargaje.
english: For before these days Theudas rose up, making himself out to be somebody; to whom a number of men, about four hundred, joined themselves. He was slain; and all, as many as obeyed him, were dispersed and came to nothing.

hausa: “Duba, yana zuwa cikin gizagizai, kowane ido kuwa zai gan shi, har da waɗanda suka soke shi”; dukan mutanen duniya kuwa “za su yi makoki dominsa.”
english: Behold, he is coming with the clouds, and every eye will see him, including those who pierced him. All the tribes of the earth will mourn over him. Even so, Amen.

hausa: An karye ƙahon Mowab; an karye hannunta,” in ji Ubangiji.
english: The horn of Moab is cut off, and his arm is broken,” says Yahweh.

hausa: Fir’auna da dukan fadawansa da kuma dukan Masarawa, suka tashi a cikin daren da kuka mai zafi, aka kuma ji kukan a ko’ina a cikin ƙasar Masar, gama ba gidan da ba a yi mutuwa ba.
english: Pharaoh rose up in the night, he, and all his servants, and all the Egyptians; and there was a great cry in Egypt, for there was not a house where there was not one dead.

hausa: Yau a birnin Dawuda an haifa muku Mai Ceto; shi ne Kiristi Ubangiji.
english: For there is born to you today, in David’s city, a Savior, who is Christ the Lord.

hausa: “Ka yi labule mai ruwan shuɗi, shunayya da jan zare da kuma lallausan lilin da aka tuƙa, da zānen kerubobin da mai fasaha ya yi.
english: “You shall make a veil of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, with cherubim. It shall be the work of a skillful workman.

hausa: Rassanta suka yi ƙarfi, suka dace da sandar mai mulki. Ta yi tsayi zuwa sama ana ganin ta saboda tsayinta da kuma saboda yawan rassanta.
english: It had strong branches for the scepters of those who ruled. Their stature was exalted among the thick boughs. They were seen in their height with the multitude of their branches.

hausa: “Sarkin zai yi abin da ya ga dama. Zai ɗaukaka yă kuma girmama kansa gaba da kowane allah zai kuma faɗa munanan abubuwa a kan Allahn alloli. Zai yi nasara har sai lokacin hukunci ya cika, gama abin da aka ƙaddara zai cika.
english: “The king will do according to his will. He will exalt himself and magnify himself above every god, and will speak marvelous things against the God of gods. He will prosper until the indignation is accomplished, for that which is determined will be done.

hausa: “Za a karkashe Assuriyawa da takobin da ba na yin mutum ba; takobi, da ba na yin mutum ba, zai cinye. Za su gudu daga takobi za a kuma sa samarinsu aikin dole.
english: “The Assyrian will fall by the sword, not of man; and the sword, not of mankind, shall devour him. He will flee from the sword, and his young men will become subject to forced labor.

hausa: wane ne mutum da kake tunawa da shi, ɗan mutum da kake lura da shi?
english: what is man, that you think of him? What is the son of man, that you care for him?

hausa: Haka iyayenku suka yi sa’ad da na aike su daga Kadesh Barneya don su dubo ƙasar.
english: Your fathers did so when I sent them from Kadesh Barnea to see the land.

hausa: Kika kuma ɗauki kayan ado masu kyau da na ba ki, kayan adon da aka yi da zinariya da azurfa, kika yi wa kanki gumakan maza kika kuma yi ta yin karuwanci da su.
english: You also took your beautiful jewels of my gold and of my silver, which I had given you, and made for yourself images of men, and played the prostitute with them.

hausa: Ka juye wurina ka kuma yi mini jinƙai, yadda kullum ka yi wa waɗanda suke ƙaunar sunanka.
english: Turn to me, and have mercy on me, as you always do to those who love your name.

hausa: Bayan kun haifi ’ya’ya da jikoki, kuka kuma zauna na dogon lokaci a ƙasar, in har kuka lalace, kuka kuma yi wani irin gunki, kuna aikata mugunta a gaban Ubangiji Allahnku, kuna kuma sa shi fushi.
english: When you father children and children’s children, and you have been long in the land, and then corrupt yourselves, and make a carved image in the form of anything, and do that which is evil in Yahweh your God’s sight to provoke him to anger,

hausa: Gama na rubuta muku ne cikin baƙin ciki mai yawa da ɓacin zuciya har ma da hawaye mai yawa, ba don in sa ku baƙin ciki ba ne, a’a, sai dai domin in nuna muku zurfin ƙaunar da nake yi muku.
english: For out of much affliction and anguish of heart I wrote to you with many tears, not that you should be made to grieve, but that you might know the love that I have so abundantly for you.

hausa: Ya Ubangiji, da gaske ni bawanka ne; ni bawanka ne, ɗan baiwarka; ka ’yantar da ni daga sarƙoƙi.
english: Yahweh, truly I am your servant. I am your servant, the son of your servant girl. You have freed me from my chains.

hausa: Gama dukan al’ummai sun sha ruwan inabin haukan zinace zinacenta. Sarakunan duniya sun yi zina tare da ita, attajiran duniya kuma sun arzuta da almubazzarancinta.”
english: For all the nations have drunk of the wine of the wrath of her sexual immorality, the kings of the earth committed sexual immorality with her, and the merchants of the earth grew rich from the abundance of her luxury.”

hausa: Sai Bitrus ya tafi tare da su, sa’ad da ya iso sai aka kai shi ɗakin saman. Duka gwauraye suka tsaya kewaye da shi, suna kuka suna nunnuna masa riguna da kuma waɗansu tufafin da Dokas ta yi yayinda take tare da su.
english: Peter got up and went with them. When he had come, they brought him into the upper room. All the widows stood by him weeping, and showing the tunics and other garments which Dorcas had made while she was with them.

hausa: Teku nasa ne, gama shi ne ya yi shi, da hannuwansa kuma ya yi busasshiyar ƙasa.
english: The sea is his, and he made it. His hands formed the dry land.

hausa: Su wane ne suka ji suka kuma yi tawaye? Ba su ne duk waɗanda Musa ya bi da su daga Masar ba?
english: For who, when they heard, rebelled? Wasn’t it all those who came out of Egypt led by Moses?

hausa: Ku albarkaci waɗanda suke la’anta ku, ku kuma yi wa waɗanda suke wulaƙanta ku addu’a.
english: bless those who curse you, and pray for those who mistreat you.

hausa: Gama ba zan ƙara jin tausayin mutanen ƙasar ba,” in ji Ubangiji. “Zan ba da kowa ga maƙwabcinsa da kuma sarkinsa. Za su zalunci ƙasar, ba zan kuma cece su daga hannuwansu ba.”
english: For I will no more pity the inhabitants of the land,” says Yahweh; “but, behold, I will deliver every one of the men into his neighbor’s hand and into the hand of his king. They will strike the land, and out of their hand I will not deliver them.”

hausa: Ya ce musu, “Ku jefa abin kamun kifinku dama da jirgin ruwan, za ku samu.” Da suka yi haka, sai suka kāsa jawo abin kamun kifin saboda yawan kifi.
english: He said to them, “Cast the net on the right side of the boat, and you will find some.” They cast it therefore, and now they weren’t able to draw it in for the multitude of fish.

hausa: Ko shamuwa ta sararin sama ma takan san lokutan da aka tsara mata, kurciya, mashirare da kuma zalɓe sukan lura da lokacin ƙauransu. Amma mutanena ba su san abubuwan da Ubangiji yake bukata ba.
english: Yes, the stork in the sky knows her appointed times. The turtledove, the swallow, and the crane observe the time of their coming; but my people don’t know Yahweh’s law.

hausa: Ka kawo ƙarshen darajarsa ka kuma jefar da kursiyinsa ƙasa.
english: You have ended his splendor, and thrown his throne down to the ground.

hausa: Shallum ɗan Hallohesh, mai mulkin ɗayan rabin yankin Urushalima ya yi gyare-gyaren sashe na biye tare da taimakon ’ya’yansa mata.
english: Next to him, Shallum the son of Hallohesh, the ruler of half the district of Jerusalem, he and his daughters made repairs.

hausa: Ku ma kuna cikin waɗanda aka kira ku zama na Yesu Kiristi.
english: among whom you are also called to belong to Jesus Christ;

hausa: Duwatsu sun narke kamar kakin zuma a gaban Ubangiji, a gaban Ubangijin dukan duniya.
english: The mountains melt like wax at the presence of Yahweh, at the presence of the Lord of the whole earth.

hausa: “Ka umarci Isra’ilawa su kori duk wanda yake da ciwon fatan jiki, ko mai ɗiga na kowane iri, ko wanda ya ƙazantu ta wurin taɓa gawa, daga cikin sansani.
english: “Command the children of Israel that they put out of the camp every leper, everyone who has a discharge, and whoever is unclean by a corpse.

hausa: Dukan shugabanni da jarumawa, har ma da dukan ’ya’yan Sarki Dawuda maza, suka yi alkawari za su yi wa Sarki Solomon biyayya.
english: All the princes, the mighty men, and also all of the sons of King David submitted themselves to Solomon the king.

hausa: Sai ka yi wa kanka ado da ɗaukaka da girma, ka yafa daraja da muƙami.
english: “Now deck yourself with excellency and dignity. Array yourself with honor and majesty.

hausa: Amma Yusuf ya ce, “Allah yă sawwaƙe in yi haka! Mutumin da aka sami kwaf ɗin a hannunsa ne kaɗai zai zama bawana. Sauranku, ku koma ga mahaifinku da salama.”
english: He said, “Far be it from me that I should do so. The man in whose hand the cup is found, he will be my slave; but as for you, go up in peace to your father.”

hausa: Dawuda kuwa ya san cewa Ubangiji ya kafa shi a matsayin sarki a bisa Isra’ila kuma cewa an ɗaukaka mulkinsa saboda mutanensa Isra’ila.
english: David perceived that Yahweh had established him king over Israel, for his kingdom was highly exalted, for his people Israel’s sake.

hausa: sa’ad da ya same shi kuwa, sai ya kawo shi Antiyok. Ta haka shekara guda cur Barnabas da Shawulu suka yi suna taruwa da ikkilisiya, suka kuma koya wa mutane masu yawan gaske. A Antiyok ne aka fara kiran almajirai da suna Kirista.
english: When he had found him, he brought him to Antioch. For a whole year they were gathered together with the assembly, and taught many people. The disciples were first called Christians in Antioch.

hausa: “Yaya zan ba da kai, Efraim? Yaya zan miƙa ka, Isra’ila? Yaya zan yi da kai kamar Adma? Yaya zan yi da kai kamar Zeboyim? Zuciyata ta canja a cikina; dukan tausayina ya huru.
english: “How can I give you up, Ephraim? How can I hand you over, Israel? How can I make you like Admah? How can I make you like Zeboiim? My heart is turned within me, my compassion is aroused.

hausa: Abin da nake nufi shi ne, Dokar da aka shigar ita bayan shekaru 430, ba tă kawar da alkawarin da Allah ya yi tun dā ba.
english: Now I say this: A covenant confirmed beforehand by God in Christ, the law, which came four hundred thirty years after, does not annul, so as to make the promise of no effect.

hausa: Ya kamata sarki ya san cewa Yahudawan da suka hauro wurinmu daga wurinka, sun je Urushalima suna sāke gina wannan mugun birni mai tawaye. Suna sāke gyara katangar, suna kuma gyara harsashin katangar.
english: Be it known to the king that the Jews who came up from you have come to us to Jerusalem. They are building the rebellious and bad city, and have finished the walls and repaired the foundations.

hausa: Wani mai mulki ya tambayi Yesu ya ce, “Malam managarci, me zan yi don in gāji rai madawwami?”
english: A certain ruler asked him, saying, “Good Teacher, what shall I do to inherit eternal life?”

hausa: Amma abinci mai kauri na balagaggu ne, waɗanda suka hori kansu don su bambanta tsakanin nagarta da mugunta.
english: But solid food is for those who are full grown, who by reason of use have their senses exercised to discern good and evil.

hausa: Sai ya ce, “Ku rabu da shi, kada wani yă dami ƙasusuwansa.” Saboda haka suka bar kasusuwansa, da na annabin da ya fito Samariya.
english: He said, “Let him be! Let no one move his bones.” So they let his bones alone, with the bones of the prophet who came out of Samaria.

hausa: Sa’an nan Ga’al ɗan Ebed ya ce, “Wane ne Abimelek, kuma wane ne Shekem, da za mu bauta masa? Shi ba ɗan Yerub-Ba’al ba ne, kuma ba Zebul ne mataimakinsa ba? Ku bauta wa mutanen Hamor, mahaifin Shekem! Me ya sa za mu bauta wa Abimelek?
english: Gaal the son of Ebed said, “Who is Abimelech, and who is Shechem, that we should serve him? Isn’t he the son of Jerubbaal? Isn’t Zebul his officer? Serve the men of Hamor the father of Shechem, but why should we serve him?

hausa: in na yi jinkiri, za ka san yadda ya kamata mutane su tafiyar da halayensu a cikin jama’ar Allah, wadda take ikkilisiyar Allah rayayye, ginshiƙi da kuma tushen gaskiya.
english: but if I wait long, that you may know how men ought to behave themselves in God’s house, which is the assembly of the living God, the pillar and ground of the truth.

hausa: Amma Nabot ya amsa wa Ahab ya ce, “Ubangiji yă sawwaƙe in ba ka gādon kakannina.”
english: Naboth said to Ahab, “May Yahweh forbid me, that I should give the inheritance of my fathers to you!”

hausa: Numfashina yana ɓata wa matata rai; ’yan’uwana sun ƙi ni.
english: My breath is offensive to my wife. I am loathsome to the children of my own mother.

hausa: Sai ya yi kuka da ƙarfi har Masarawa suka ji, har labarin ya kai gidan Fir’auna.
english: He wept aloud. The Egyptians heard, and the house of Pharaoh heard.

hausa: Ya kuma sa dukan mutane, kowanne da makaminsa a hannunsa, kewaye da sarki, kusa da bagade da kuma haikali, daga gefen kudu zuwa gefen arewa na haikali.
english: He set all the people, every man with his weapon in his hand, from the right side of the house to the left side of the house, near the altar and the house, around the king.

hausa: Saboda haka Yusuf ya haura don yă binne mahaifinsa. Dukan hafsoshin Fir’auna suka yi masa rakiya tare da manyan mutanen gidan Fir’auna, da kuma dukan manyan mutanen Masar
english: Joseph went up to bury his father; and with him went up all the servants of Pharaoh, the elders of his house, all the elders of the land of Egypt,

hausa: Allah ya ce, “Bari sarari yă kasance tsakanin ruwaye domin yă raba ruwa da ruwa.”
english: God said, “Let there be an expanse in the middle of the waters, and let it divide the waters from the waters.”

hausa: Suka ce wa sarki Nebukadnezzar, “Ran sarki yă daɗe,
english: They answered Nebuchadnezzar the king, “O king, live for ever!

hausa: Ni kaina, na faɗa; I, na kira shi. Zan kawo shi, zai kuma yi nasara a cikin aikinsa.
