english: I, even I, have spoken. Yes, I have called him. I have brought him and he shall make his way prosperous.

hausa: Kwanon ya tsaya a kan siffofin bijimai goma sha biyu, uku suna fuskantar arewa, uku suna fuskantar yamma, uku suna fuskantar kudu, sa’an nan uku suna fuskantar gabas. Kwanon da ya kira Teku ya zauna a kansu, gindin siffofin bijimai goma sha biyun nan suna wajen tsakiya.
english: It stood on twelve oxen, three looking toward the north, and three looking toward the west, and three looking toward the south, and three looking toward the east; and the sea was set on them above, and all their hindquarters were inward.

hausa: Gama roƙon da muke yi bai fito daga kuskure ko munafunci ba, ba kuwa ƙoƙari muke yi mu yaudare ku ba.
english: For our exhortation is not of error, nor of uncleanness, nor in deception.

hausa: Kuma dukan matan da suke da niyya, suke kuma da fasaha, suka kaɗa gashin akuya.
english: All the women whose heart stirred them up in wisdom spun the goats’ hair.

hausa: Ruhun Ubangiji kuwa ya fara iza shi yayinda yake a Mahane Dan, tsakanin Zora da Eshtawol.
english: Yahweh’s Spirit began to move him in Mahaneh Dan, between Zorah and Eshtaol.

hausa: ta kai Abdon, Rehob, Hammon da Kana, har zuwa Sidon Babba.
english: and Ebron, Rehob, Hammon, and Kanah, even to great Sidon.

hausa: Kada ku bar zuciyarku ta juya zuwa hanyoyinta ko ku kauce zuwa hanyoyinta.
english: Don’t let your heart turn to her ways. Don’t go astray in her paths,

hausa: Firistoci suka shiga cikin wuri mai tsarki na Ubangiji suka tsarkake shi. Suka fitar da dukan abin da yake marar tsabta da suka samu a haikalin Ubangiji zuwa filin haikalin Ubangiji. Lawiyawa suka ɗauke su suka kai su Kwarin Kidron.
english: The priests went into the inner part of Yahweh’s house to cleanse it, and brought out all the uncleanness that they found in Yahweh’s temple into the court of Yahweh’s house. The Levites took it from there to carry it out to the brook Kidron.

hausa: Mazanku za su mutu ta wurin takobi, jarumawanku za su mutu a yaƙi.
english: Your men shall fall by the sword, and your mighty in the war.

hausa: Baƙi za su yi kiwon garkunanki; baƙi za su yi miki noman gonaki da gonakin inabinki.
english: Strangers will stand and feed your flocks. Foreigners will work your fields and your vineyards.

hausa: Sa’an nan suka gane ba cewa yake musu su yi hankali da yistin da ake amfani da shi a burodi ba ne, sai dai su yi hankali da koyarwar Farisiyawa da Sadukiyawa ne.
english: Then they understood that he didn’t tell them to beware of the yeast of bread, but of the teaching of the Pharisees and Sadducees.

hausa: To, akwai ’ya’ya maza saba’in na gidan Ahab a Samariya. Saboda haka Yehu ya rubuta wasiƙu, ya aika su Samariya, zuwa ga shugabannin Yezireyel, da kuma ga masu lura da ’ya’yan Ahab. Ya ce,
english: Now Ahab had seventy sons in Samaria. Jehu wrote letters and sent them to Samaria, to the rulers of Jezreel, even the elders, and to those who brought up Ahab’s sons, saying,

hausa: A lokacin, sa’ad da Dawuda ya ga cewa Ubangiji ya amsa masa a masussukar Ornan mutumin Yebus, sai ya miƙa hadayu a can.
english: At that time, when David saw that Yahweh had answered him in the threshing floor of Ornan the Jebusite, then he sacrificed there.

hausa: “Saboda haka, ɗan mutum, ka faɗa wa mutanen ƙasarka, ‘Adalcin adali ba zai cece shi sa’ad da ya ƙi yin biyayya ba, kuma muguntar mugu ba za tă sa ya fāɗi sa’ad da ya juya daga gare ta ba. Adali, in ya yi zunubi, ba za a bari yă rayu saboda adalcinsa na dā ba.’
english: “You, son of man, tell the children of your people, ‘The righteousness of the righteous will not deliver him in the day of his disobedience. And as for the wickedness of the wicked, he will not fall by it in the day that he turns from his wickedness; neither will he who is righteous be able to live by it in the day that he sins.

hausa: Fushi mai zafi na Ubangiji ba zai kawu ba sai ya cika manufofin zuciyarsa gaba ɗaya. A kwanaki masu zuwa za ku gane wannan.
english: The fierce anger of Yahweh will not return until he has accomplished, and until he has performed the intentions of his heart. In the latter days you will understand it.”

hausa: Yesu ya dudduba, sai ya ce wa almajiransa, “Yana da wuya fa masu arziki su shiga mulkin Allah!”
english: Jesus looked around and said to his disciples, “How difficult it is for those who have riches to enter into God’s Kingdom!”

hausa: Dukan maƙwabtansu kuwa suka taimake su da gudummawa na kayan azurfa da na zinariya, da kaya, da dabbobi, da kuma kyautai masu daraja bisa bayarwar yardar rai da suka yi.
english: All those who were around them strengthened their hands with vessels of silver, with gold, with goods, with animals, and with precious things, in addition to all that was willingly offered.

hausa: A Masar, Asenat ’yar Fotifera, firist na On ta haifi Manasse da Efraim wa Yusuf.
english: To Joseph in the land of Egypt were born Manasseh and Ephraim, whom Asenath, the daughter of Potiphera, priest of On, bore to him.

hausa: Buɗaɗɗiyar hanyar masu aikata gaskiya kan guje wa mugunta; duk wanda yake lura da hanyarsa yakan lura da ransa.
english: The highway of the upright is to depart from evil. He who keeps his way preserves his soul.

hausa: Saboda na faɗa waɗannan abubuwa ga shi kun cika da baƙin ciki.
english: But because I have told you these things, sorrow has filled your heart.

hausa: Na tambaya na ce, “Mene ne?” Ya amsa ya ce, “Kwando ne na awo.” Ya ƙara da cewa, “Wannan shi ne laifin mutanen a duk fāɗin ƙasar.”
english: I said, “What is it?” He said, “This is the ephah basket that is appearing.” He said moreover, “This is their appearance in all the land—

hausa: “Da lokaci ya yi kusa da Allah zai cika alkawarin da ya yi wa Ibrahim, sai yawan mutanenmu da suke a Masar ya ƙaru ƙwarai.
english: “But as the time of the promise came close which God had sworn to Abraham, the people grew and multiplied in Egypt,

hausa: ya yi haka domin yă nuna adalcinsa a wannan lokaci, saboda yă zama mai adalci da mai kuɓutar da waɗanda suke ba da gaskiya a cikin Yesu.
english: to demonstrate his righteousness at this present time, that he might himself be just and the justifier of him who has faith in Jesus.

hausa: Abram ya rusuna da fuskarsa har ƙasa, Allah kuma ya ce masa,
english: Abram fell on his face. God talked with him, saying,

hausa: “ ‘In ɗaya daga cikin mutanen ƙasarku ya talauta a cikinku, ya kuma sayar da kansa gare ku, kada ku sa yă yi kamar bawa.
english: “‘If your brother has grown poor among you, and sells himself to you, you shall not make him to serve as a slave.

hausa: Ta wurin kira wannan alkawari “sabo,” ya mai da na farin tsoho ke nan; abin da yake tsoho yana kuma daɗa tsufa, zai shuɗe nan ba da daɗewa ba.
english: In that he says, “A new covenant”, he has made the first obsolete. But that which is becoming obsolete and grows aged is near to vanishing away.

hausa: “Wa zai ji tausayinki, ya Urushalima? Wa zai yi makoki dominki? Wa zai dakata ya tambayi lafiyarki?
english: For who will have pity on you, Jerusalem? Who will mourn you? Who will come to ask of your welfare?

hausa: A ɓoye za tă ci mahaifar da take biyo bayan ta haihu, da ’ya’yan da za tă haifa, saboda ba ta da wani abinci lokacin da abokan gābanku za su kewaye garuruwanku da yaƙi mai tsanani.
english: toward her young one who comes out from between her feet, and toward her children whom she bears; for she will eat them secretly for lack of all things in the siege and in the distress with which your enemy will distress you in your gates.

hausa: Ga yadda za ku gane Ruhun Allah, duk ruhun da ya yarda cewa Yesu Kiristi ya zo cikin jiki, to, daga Allah yake.
english: By this you know the Spirit of God: every spirit who confesses that Jesus Christ has come in the flesh is of God,

hausa: Zai yi mulki daga teku zuwa teku kuma daga Kogi zuwa iyakar duniya.
english: He shall have dominion also from sea to sea, from the River to the ends of the earth.

hausa: Sarki ya ce wa Yowab, “To, da kyau, zan yi haka. Je ka, ka dawo da saurayin nan Absalom.”
english: The king said to Joab, “Behold now, I have granted this thing. Go therefore, and bring the young man Absalom back.”

hausa: Yayinda suke fama jira, Ehud ya riga ya yi gaba. Ya bi ta wajen gumaka zuwa Seyira.
english: Ehud escaped while they waited, passed beyond the stone idols, and escaped to Seirah.

hausa: Gama gaban Ubangiji yana ko’ina a duniya don yă ƙarfafa waɗanda zukatansu suke binsa cikin aminci. Ka yi wauta, daga yanzu nan gaba za ka yi ta yaƙi.”
english: For Yahweh’s eyes run back and forth throughout the whole earth, to show himself strong in the behalf of them whose heart is perfect toward him. You have done foolishly in this; for from now on you will have wars.”

hausa: Maganar Ubangiji ta zo mini cewa,
english: Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

hausa: Ko matasa ma kan gaji su kuma kasala, samari kuma kan yi tuntuɓe su fāɗi;
english: Even the youths faint and get weary, and the young men utterly fall;

hausa: Zan sa su ci naman ’ya’yansu maza da mata, za su kuma ci naman juna a lokacin damuwar ƙawanya da abokan gāban da suke neman ransu za su yi musu.’
english: I will cause them to eat the flesh of their sons and the flesh of their daughters. They will each eat the flesh of his friend in the siege and in the distress with which their enemies, and those who seek their life, will distress them.”’

hausa: Zai tsabtacce gidan da jinin tsuntsun, ruwa mai kyau, tsuntsu mai ran, itacen al’ul, hizzob da kuma jan ƙyalle.
english: He shall cleanse the house with the blood of the bird, and with the running water, with the living bird, with the cedar wood, with the hyssop, and with the scarlet;

hausa: Ga abin da zai faru a ranar. Sa’ad da Gog ya fāɗa wa ƙasar Isra’ila, fushina mai zafi zai ƙuna, in ji Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka.
english: It will happen in that day, when Gog comes against the land of Israel,” says the Lord Yahweh, “that my wrath will come up into my nostrils.

hausa: Suka ce, “Sa’ad da Ubangiji ya umarce ranka yă daɗe, yă raba ƙasar gādo ga Isra’ilawa ta wurin ƙuri’a, ya umarce ka, ka ba wa ’ya’ya matan nan na Zelofehad ɗan’uwanmu gādonsa.
english: They said, “Yahweh commanded my lord to give the land for inheritance by lot to the children of Israel. My lord was commanded by Yahweh to give the inheritance of Zelophehad our brother to his daughters.

hausa: Aka taimake su a yaƙin, Allah kuma ya ba da Hagirawa da dukan abokansu gare su, domin sun yi kuka gare shi a lokacin yaƙin. Ya amsa addu’o’insu, domin sun dogara gare shi.
english: They were helped against them, and the Hagrites were delivered into their hand, and all who were with them; for they cried to God in the battle, and he answered them because they put their trust in him.

hausa: A waɗannan kusurwoyi biyu, an ninka katakan sau biyu daga ƙasa har sama, aka kuma sa su cikin zobe guda; dukansu biyu an yi su daidai.
english: They were double beneath, and in the same way they were all the way to its top to one ring. He did this to both of them in the two corners.

hausa: Ka koya mana yawan kwanakinmu daidai, don mu sami zuciyar hikima.
english: So teach us to count our days, that we may gain a heart of wisdom.

hausa: Suka tashi daga nan, suka sauka kusa da Arnon wanda yake a hamadar da ta miƙe zuwa iyakar Amoriyawa. Arnon shi ne iyakar Mowab, wanda yake tsakanin Mowab da Amoriyawa.
english: From there they traveled, and encamped on the other side of the Arnon, which is in the wilderness that comes out of the border of the Amorites; for the Arnon is the border of Moab, between Moab and the Amorites.

hausa: Bari su yabi sunan Ubangiji, gama ya umarta aka kuwa halicce su.
english: Let them praise Yahweh’s name, for he commanded, and they were created.

hausa: Ga yadda ya tayar wa sarki Solomon. Sarki Solomon ya gina madogaran gini, ya ciccika wurare a katangar birnin Dawuda mahaifinsa da ƙasa.
english: This was the reason why he lifted up his hand against the king: Solomon built Millo, and repaired the breach of his father David’s city.

hausa: Zan ƙosar da firistoci da yalwa, mutanena kuma za su cika da yalwa,” in ji Ubangiji.
english: I will satiate the soul of the priests with fatness, and my people will be satisfied with my goodness,” says Yahweh.

hausa: Daga baya sai dukan Isra’ilawa suka zo kusa da shi, ya kuma ba su dukan dokokin da Ubangiji ya ba shi a Dutsen Sinai.
english: Afterward all the children of Israel came near, and he gave them all the commandments that Yahweh had spoken with him on Mount Sinai.

hausa: An ji karar kuka daga Sihiyona cewa, ‘Duba yadda muka lalace! Duba irin babban kunyar da muka sha! Dole mu bar ƙasar domin gidajenmu sun lalace.’ ”
english: For a voice of wailing is heard out of Zion, ‘How we are ruined! We are greatly confounded because we have forsaken the land, because they have cast down our dwellings.’”

hausa: Mefiboshet ya ce wa sarki, “Bari yă ɗauki kome, yanzu da ranka yă daɗe, sarki ya dawo gida lafiya.”
english: Mephibosheth said to the king, “Yes, let him take all, because my lord the king has come in peace to his own house.”

hausa: Haka ma Yerobowam, ɗan Nebat, shi ma ya yi wa sarki tawaye. Shi ɗaya ne daga shugabannin Solomon, shi mutumin Efraim ne daga Zereda, mahaifiyarsa kuwa gwauruwa ce, mai suna Zeruwa.
english: Jeroboam the son of Nebat, an Ephraimite of Zeredah, a servant of Solomon, whose mother’s name was Zeruah, a widow, also lifted up his hand against the king.

hausa: Ga abin da Ubangiji yana cewa, “Dukan ƙasar za tă zama kufai, ko da yake ba zan hallaka ta gaba ɗaya ba.
english: For Yahweh says, “The whole land will be a desolation; yet I will not make a full end.

hausa: Kashegari da sassafe, Ibrahim ya tashi ya ɗaura wa jakinsa sirdi. Ya ɗauki bayinsa biyu, da ɗansa Ishaku. Bayan ya faskare isashen itace saboda hadaya ta ƙonawa sai ya kama hanya zuwa wurin da Allah ya faɗa masa.
english: Abraham rose early in the morning, and saddled his donkey; and took two of his young men with him, and Isaac his son. He split the wood for the burnt offering, and rose up, and went to the place of which God had told him.

hausa: An ciyar da su sosai, kamar ƙosassun ingarmu, masu jaraba, kowanne yana haniniya, yana neman matar maƙwabcinsa.
english: They were as fed horses roaming at large. Everyone neighed after his neighbor’s wife.

hausa: Sai ya ce wa Yehowash sarkin Isra’ila, “Ka ɗauki baka a hannunka.” Da ya ɗauka, sai Elisha ya sa hannunsa a hannuwan sarki.
english: He said to the king of Israel, “Put your hand on the bow;” and he put his hand on it. Elisha laid his hands on the king’s hands.

hausa: “Duk da haka in na yi magana, ba na samun sauƙi; in ma na yi shiru zafin ba ya tafiya.
english: “Though I speak, my grief is not subsided. Though I forbear, what am I eased?

hausa: Kabilun hamada za su rusuna a gabansa abokan gābansa kuwa za su lashe ƙura.
english: Those who dwell in the wilderness shall bow before him. His enemies shall lick the dust.

hausa: Mutumin ya amsa, “Sun yi gaba daga nan. Na ji su suna cewa, ‘Bari mu je Dotan.’ ” Saboda haka Yusuf ya bi bayan ’yan’uwansa, ya kuwa same su kusa da Dotan.
english: The man said, “They have left here, for I heard them say, ‘Let’s go to Dothan.’” Joseph went after his brothers, and found them in Dothan.

hausa: da ƙaramin bijimi guda ɗaya, tunkiya ɗaya, da rago, dukansu bana ɗaya-ɗaya domin hadaya ta ƙonawa;
english: one young bull, one ram, one male lamb a year old, for a burnt offering;

hausa: Waɗannan su ne firistoci da Lawiyawa waɗanda suka komo tare da Zerubbabel ɗan Sheyaltiyel da kuma Yeshuwa. Serahiya, Irmiya, Ezra,
english: Now these are the priests and the Levites who went up with Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, and Jeshua: Seraiah, Jeremiah, Ezra,

hausa: don kowa yă girmama Ɗan kamar yadda yake girmama Uban. Wanda ba ya girmama Ɗan ba ya girmama Uban, da ya aiko shi ke nan.
english: that all may honor the Son, even as they honor the Father. He who doesn’t honor the Son doesn’t honor the Father who sent him.

hausa: Duk wanda yake wa matalauta ba’a yana zagin Mahaliccinsu ne; duk wanda ya yi murna akan masifar da ta sami wani za a hukunta shi.
english: Whoever mocks the poor reproaches his Maker. He who is glad at calamity shall not be unpunished.

hausa: “Saboda haka, ga abin da Ubangiji yana cewa, kun yi mini rashin biyayya; ba ku yi shelar ’yanci don ’yan’uwanku ba. Saboda haka yanzu na yi muku shelar ’yanci in ji Ubangiji, ’yanci ga mutuwa ta takobi, annoba da kuma yunwa. Zan sa ku zama abin ƙyama ga sauran mulkokin duniya.
english: Therefore Yahweh says: “You have not listened to me, to proclaim liberty, every man to his brother, and every man to his neighbor. Behold, I proclaim to you a liberty,” says Yahweh, “to the sword, to the pestilence, and to the famine. I will make you be tossed back and forth among all the kingdoms of the earth.

hausa: Raina ya tafke da marmari don cetonka, amma na sa zuciyata a maganarka.
english: My soul faints for your salvation. I hope in your word.

hausa: ya kuma auri Basemat ’yar Ishmayel wadda take ’yar’uwar Nebayiwot.
english: and Basemath, Ishmael’s daughter, sister of Nebaioth.

hausa: Ka dogara ga Ubangiji da dukan zuciyarka kada kuma ka dangana ga ganewarka;
english: Trust in Yahweh with all your heart, and don’t lean on your own understanding.

hausa: “Yanzu, ya Ubangiji, Allah na Isra’ila, bari ka cika wa bawanka Dawuda mahaifina alkawaran da ka yi masa sa’ad da ka ce, ‘Ba za ka taɓa rasa wani da zai zauna a gabana a kan kujerar sarautar Isra’ila ba, in kawai ’ya’yanka maza sun yi hankali cikin dukan abubuwan da suke yi, don su yi tafiya a gabana kamar yadda ka yi.’
english: Now therefore, may Yahweh, the God of Israel, keep with your servant David my father that which you have promised him, saying, ‘There shall not fail from you a man in my sight to sit on the throne of Israel, if only your children take heed to their way, to walk before me as you have walked before me.’

hausa: “In sha’awar mace ya shiga mini zuciya, ko kuma na laɓe a ƙofar maƙwabcina,
english: “If my heart has been enticed to a woman, and I have laid wait at my neighbor’s door,

hausa: Kada ku bi waɗansu alloli don ku bauta ku kuma yi musu sujada; kada ku tsokane ni in yi fushi da abin da hannuwanku suka yi. Sa’an nan ba zan kawo muku lahani ba.”
english: Don’t go after other gods to serve them or worship them, and don’t provoke me to anger with the work of your hands; then I will do you no harm.”

hausa: Kafin yaron yă san yadda zai ce ‘Babana’ ko ‘Mamana,’ sarkin Assuriya zai kwashe arzikin Damaskus da ganimar Samariya.”
english: For before the child knows how to say, ‘My father’ and ‘My mother,’ the riches of Damascus and the plunder of Samaria will be carried away by the king of Assyria.”

hausa: “Baƙi za su sāke gina katangarki, sarakunansu kuma za su yi miki hidima. Ko da yake a cikin fushi na buge ki, da tagomashi zan yi miki jinƙai.
english: “Foreigners will build up your walls, and their kings will serve you; for in my wrath I struck you, but in my favor I have had mercy on you.

hausa: “ ‘In ka sayar da gona wa wani daga mutanen ƙasarka, ko ka saya wata gona daga gare shi, kada ku cuci juna.
english: “‘If you sell anything to your neighbor, or buy from your neighbor, you shall not wrong one another.

hausa: Kafin waɗansu mutane su zo daga wurin Yaƙub, yakan ci abinci tare da Al’ummai. Amma da suka iso, sai ya fara janyewa, ya kuma ware kansa daga wajen Al’ummai domin yana tsoron waɗanda suke ƙungiyar masu kaciya.
english: For before some people came from James, he ate with the Gentiles. But when they came, he drew back and separated himself, fearing those who were of the circumcision.

hausa: Aka ba shi mulki, daraja da kuma mafificin iko; dukan mutane, da al’ummai, da mutane daga kowane harshe suka yi masa sujada. Mulkinsa kuwa dawwammamen mulki ne da ba zai ƙare ba, sarautarsa kuma ba ta taɓa lalacewa.
english: Dominion was given him, and glory, and a kingdom, that all the peoples, nations, and languages should serve him. His dominion is an everlasting dominion, which will not pass away, and his kingdom one that will not be destroyed.

hausa: Lawiyawa, wato, su Yeshuwa, Bani, Sherebiya, Yamin, Akkub, Shabbetai, Hodiya, Ma’asehiya, Kelita, Azariya, Yozabad, Hanan da Felahiya, suka koyar da mutane a cikin Dokar yayinda mutane suke a tsaye a can.
english: Also Jeshua, Bani, Sherebiah, Jamin, Akkub, Shabbethai, Hodiah, Maaseiah, Kelita, Azariah, Jozabad, Hanan, Pelaiah, and the Levites, caused the people to understand the law; and the people stayed in their place.

hausa: A tsara ta huɗu zuriyarka za tă komo nan, saboda zunubin Amoriyawa bai riga ya cika ba.”
english: In the fourth generation they will come here again, for the iniquity of the Amorite is not yet full.”

hausa: Shi ya sa Yahudawa suka kama ni a filin haikali suka kuma yi ƙoƙarin kashe ni.
english: For this reason the Jews seized me in the temple and tried to kill me.

hausa: Wani zai iya ce, “In a dalilin ƙaryata, gaskiyar Allah ta ƙara bayyana, har aka ƙara ɗaukaka shi, to, ta yaya zan zama mai zunubi, in ƙaryata tana kawo ɗaukaka ga Allah?”
english: For if the truth of God through my lie abounded to his glory, why am I also still judged as a sinner?

hausa: Ya buɗe sammai ya sauko; baƙaƙen gizagizai suna a ƙarƙashin ƙafafunsa.
english: He bowed the heavens also, and came down. Thick darkness was under his feet.

hausa: Sa’an nan aka dawo da Musa da Haruna wurin Fir’auna. Sai ya ce, “Ku tafi, ku yi wa Ubangiji Allahnku sujada. Amma wa da wa za su tafi?”
english: Moses and Aaron were brought again to Pharaoh, and he said to them, “Go, serve Yahweh your God; but who are those who will go?”

hausa: amma duk wanda ya saurare ni, zai zauna lafiya yă kuma kasance da rai kwance, ba tare da tsoron lahani ba.”
english: But whoever listens to me will dwell securely, and will be at ease, without fear of harm.”

hausa: in aka ɓata mana suna, mukan mayar da alheri. Har yă zuwa wannan lokaci, mu ne kamar jujin duniya, abin ƙyamar kowa.
english: Being defamed, we entreat. We are made as the filth of the world, the dirt wiped off by all, even until now.

hausa: Masar shi ne mahaifin Ludiyawa, Anamawa, Lehabiyawa, Neftuhawa,
english: Mizraim became the father of Ludim, Anamim, Lehabim, Naphtuhim,

hausa: Waɗannan su ne al’umman da Ubangiji ya bari don yă gwada duk waɗannan Isra’ilawan da ba su san yaƙi a Kan’ana ba
english: Now these are the nations which Yahweh left, to test Israel by them, even as many as had not known all the wars of Canaan;

hausa: Sa’ad da Yusuf ya zo gida, sai suka ba shi kyautai da suka kawo, suka rusuna a gabansa har ƙasa.
english: When Joseph came home, they brought him the present which was in their hand into the house, and bowed themselves down to the earth before him.

hausa: Sai ya fara koya musu cewa, dole Ɗan Mutum yă sha wahaloli da yawa, dattawa, manyan firistoci da malaman dokoki kuma su ƙi shi. Dole kuma a kashe shi, bayan kwana uku kuma, yă tashi.
english: He began to teach them that the Son of Man must suffer many things, and be rejected by the elders, the chief priests, and the scribes, and be killed, and after three days rise again.

hausa: In mutum ya sadu da yarinyar da ba a yi alkawarin aurenta ba, ya kuma yi mata fyaɗe, aka kuma kama su,
english: If a man finds a lady who is a virgin, who is not pledged to be married, grabs her and lies with her, and they are found,

hausa: To, an gaya wa Dawuda cewa, “Ahitofel yana cikin waɗanda suka hadasa maƙarƙashiya tare da Absalom.” Saboda haka Dawuda ya yi addu’a ya ce, “Ya Ubangiji ka mai da shawarar Ahitofel ta zama shiririta.”
english: Someone told David, saying, “Ahithophel is among the conspirators with Absalom.” David said, “Yahweh, please turn the counsel of Ahithophel into foolishness.”

hausa: “Zan sa ’yan yara su zama shugabanninsu; ’yan yara kurum za su yi mulkinsu.”
english: I will give boys to be their princes, and children shall rule over them.

hausa: In fa a ganinsa bai canja ba kuma baƙin gashi ya fito a cikinsa, ƙaiƙayin ya warke ke nan. Mutumin tsarkakakke ne, firist ɗin kuwa zai furta shi tsarkakakke.
english: But if in his eyes the itch is arrested and black hair has grown in it, then the itch is healed. He is clean. The priest shall pronounce him clean.

hausa: su da ya tattara daga ƙasashe, daga gabas da yamma, daga arewa da kudu.
english: and gathered out of the lands, from the east and from the west, from the north and from the south.

hausa: Bayan rasuwar Ehud, Isra’ilawa suka sāke aikata mugayen ayyuka a gaban Ubangiji.
english: The children of Israel again did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight, when Ehud was dead.

hausa: Amma wani saurayi ya gan su, ya gaya wa Absalom. Sai dukansu biyu suka tashi da sauri suka shiga gidan wani mutum a Bahurim. Yana da rijiya a cikin gida, sai suka shiga cikinta.
english: But a boy saw them, and told Absalom. Then they both went away quickly and came to the house of a man in Bahurim, who had a well in his court; and they went down there.

hausa: Yowa, Iddo, Zera da Yeyaterai.
english: Joah his son, Iddo his son, Zerah his son, and Jeatherai his son.

hausa: To, Yahuda, wanda ya bashe shi, ya san wurin, domin Yesu ya sha zuwa wurin da almajiransa.
english: Now Judas, who betrayed him, also knew the place, for Jesus often met there with his disciples.

hausa: A shekara ta takwas ta mulkinsa, yayinda yake matashi, sai ya fara neman Allah na kakansa Dawuda. A shekara ta goma sha biyunsa ya fara tsabtacce Yahuda da Urushalima daga masujadan kan tudu, ginshiƙan Ashera, sassaƙaƙƙun gumaka da kuma siffofin da aka yi zubi.
english: For in the eighth year of his reign, while he was yet young, he began to seek after the God of David his father; and in the twelfth year he began to purge Judah and Jerusalem from the high places, the Asherah poles, the engraved images, and the molten images.

hausa: “ ‘A rana ta farko ga wata na bakwai, a yi tsattsarkan taro, kada kuma a yi aikin da aka saba na kullum. Rana ce don busa ƙahoni.
english: “‘In the seventh month, on the first day of the month, you shall have a holy convocation; you shall do no regular work. It is a day of blowing of trumpets to you.

hausa: Daga zuriyar Benyamin. Aka rubuta sunayen dukan maza ɗaya-ɗaya da suka kai shekara ashirin ko fiye da suka isa shiga soja, bisa ga iyalansu da kabilarsu da take a rubuce.
english: Of the children of Benjamin, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war:

hausa: Sa’ad da ya ga wannan ya faranta wa Yahudawa rai, sai ya kama Bitrus shi ma. Wannan ya faru kwanakin Bikin Burodi Marar Yisti.
english: When he saw that it pleased the Jews, he proceeded to seize Peter also. This was during the days of unleavened bread.

hausa: Sai ya ce masa, “Tashi, ka yi tafiyarka, bangaskiyarka ta warkar da kai.”
english: Then he said to him, “Get up, and go your way. Your faith has healed you.”

hausa: “Ba zan daina magana game da gaɓoɓinta ba ƙarfinta da kuma kyan kamanninta ba.
english: “I will not keep silence concerning his limbs, nor his mighty strength, nor his goodly frame.

hausa: “ ‘Akwai waɗanda suke tuƙa ko kuwa suna da rababben kofato kawai, duk da haka ba za ku ci su ba. Waɗannan kuwa su ne, raƙumi, ko da yake yana tuƙa, amma ba shi da rababben kofato; saboda haka cin namansa haram ne gare ku.
english: “‘Nevertheless these you shall not eat of those that chew the cud, or of those who part the hoof: the camel, because it chews the cud but doesn’t have a parted hoof, is unclean to you.

hausa: Saboda sunanka kada ka ƙi mu; kada ka ƙasƙantar da kursiyoyinka mai ɗaukaka. Ka tuna da alkawarinka da mu kada ka tā da shi.
english: Do not abhor us, for your name’s sake. Do not disgrace the throne of your glory. Remember, and don’t break your covenant with us.

hausa: Ka ɗauki man shafewa ka shafe shi, ta wurin zuba man a kansa.
english: Then you shall take the anointing oil, and pour it on his head, and anoint him.

hausa: Ki ja ruwa gama za a kewaye ki da yaƙi. Ki ƙara ƙarfin kagaranki! Ki kwaɓa laka, ki sassaƙa turmi ki gyara abin yin tubali!
english: Draw water for the siege. Strengthen your fortresses. Go into the clay, and tread the mortar. Make the brick kiln strong.

hausa: Suna ganin ’ya’yansu suna girma, suna ganin jikokinsu suna tasowa a kan idanunsu.
english: Their child is established with them in their sight, their offspring before their eyes.

hausa: In kuma wani ya ba wa ɗaya daga cikin ƙananan nan ko da kwaf ruwan sanyi ne kan shi almajirina ne, gaskiya nake gaya muku, ba shakka ba zai rasa ladarsa ba.”
english: Whoever gives one of these little ones just a cup of cold water to drink in the name of a disciple, most certainly I tell you, he will in no way lose his reward.”

hausa: Ka kafa iyakar da ba a iya tsallakawa; ba za su ƙara rufe duniya ba.
english: You have set a boundary that they may not pass over, that they don’t turn again to cover the earth.

hausa: Dukan Lawiyawa waɗanda suke mawaƙa, Asaf, Heman, Yedutun da ’ya’yansu maza da dangoginsu, suka tsaya a gefen gabas na bagaden, saye da lilin mai kyau suna kuma kaɗa ganguna, garayu da molaye. Tare da su akwai firistoci 120 masu busan ƙahoni.
english: also the Levites who were the singers, all of them, even Asaph, Heman, Jeduthun, and their sons and their brothers, arrayed in fine linen, with cymbals and stringed instruments and harps, stood at the east end of the altar, and with them one hundred twenty priests sounding with trumpets);

hausa: Kullum kai mai adalci ne, ya Ubangiji, sa’ad da na kawo ƙara a gabanka. Duk da haka zan yi magana da kai game da shari’arka. Me ya sa mugaye suke nasara? Me ya sa dukan maciya amana suke zama ba damuwa?
english: You are righteous, Yahweh, when I contend with you; yet I would like to plead a case with you. Why does the way of the wicked prosper? Why are they all at ease who deal very treacherously?

hausa: ba ga mutane da yawa na baƙon harshe da yare mai wuya, waɗanda ba ka san kalmominsu ba. Tabbatacce da na aike ka wurin irinsu, da sun saurare ka.
english: not to many peoples of a strange speech and of a hard language, whose words you can’t understand. Surely, if I sent you to them, they would listen to you.

hausa: Ya yi tambaya ya ce, ‘Aboki, yaya ka shigo nan ba tare da rigar aure ba?’ Mutumin ya rasa ta cewa.
english: and he said to him, ‘Friend, how did you come in here not wearing wedding clothing?’ He was speechless.

hausa: Shawulu da yaransa uku da mai ɗaukar makamansa da dukan mutanensa suka mutu a rana ɗaya.
english: So Saul died with his three sons, his armor bearer, and all his men that same day together.

hausa: don yă nuna jinƙai ga kakanninmu, yă kuma tuna da alkawarinsa mai tsarki,
english: to show mercy toward our fathers, to remember his holy covenant,

hausa: Saboda haka, ina sa rai, in aike shi da zarar na ga yadda abubuwa suke a nan.
english: Therefore I hope to send him at once, as soon as I see how it will go with me.

hausa: A gaban kamu ashirin na filin da yake can ciki da kuma a gaban daɓen filin da yake waje, akwai rumfuna a jere waɗanda suke fuskantar juna hawa uku-uku.
english: Opposite the twenty cubits which belonged to the inner court, and opposite the pavement which belonged to the outer court, was gallery against gallery in the three stories.

hausa: Yesu ya ci gaba da cewa, “Jim kaɗan, ba za ku ƙara ganina ba, sa’an nan bayan an jima kaɗan kuma, za ku gan ni.”
english: “A little while, and you will not see me. Again a little while, and you will see me.”

hausa: Amma kai Ubanmu ne, ko Ibrahim bai san mu ba Isra’ila kuma bai yarda da mu ba; kai, ya Ubangiji, kai ne Ubanmu, Mai Fansarmu tun fil azal ne sunanka.
english: For you are our Father, though Abraham doesn’t know us, and Israel does not acknowledge us. You, Yahweh, are our Father. Our Redeemer from everlasting is your name.

hausa: “Sa’ad da kuka shiga ƙasar Kan’ana, wadda nake ba ku kamar gādonku, na kuma sa yaɗuwa cutar fatar jiki a riga a cikin gida a wannan ƙasa,
english: “When you have come into the land of Canaan, which I give to you for a possession, and I put a spreading mildew in a house in the land of your possession,

hausa: Ya ce, “Bisa ga doka, me za a yi wa Sarauniya Bashti? Gama ta ƙi yin biyayya da umarnin sarki Zerzes da bābānni suka kai mata?”
english: “What shall we do to Queen Vashti according to law, because she has not done the bidding of the King Ahasuerus by the eunuchs?”

hausa: Ya so yă ga ko wane ne Yesu, amma saboda taron, bai iya ba, domin shi gajere ne.
english: He was trying to see who Jesus was, and couldn’t because of the crowd, because he was short.

hausa: ’Ya’yan Kush maza su ne, Seba, Hawila, Sabta, Ra’ama da Sabteka. ’Ya’yan Ra’ama maza su ne, Sheba da Dedan
english: The sons of Cush: Seba, Havilah, Sabta, Raama, Sabteca. The sons of Raamah: Sheba and Dedan.

hausa: A daidai wannan lokacin kuwa Shawulu yana dawowa daga gona tare da shanunsa na noma, sai ya ce, “Me ya faru, mutane suna kuka haka?” Sai suka faɗa masa abin da mutanen Yabesh suka faɗa musu.
english: Behold, Saul came following the oxen out of the field; and Saul said, “What ails the people that they weep?” They told him the words of the men of Jabesh.

hausa: Ko kaɗan! Bari Allah yă zama mai gaskiya, kowane mutum kuma yă zama maƙaryaci. Kamar yadda yake a rubuce cewa, “Gama a tabbatar kana da gaskiya, sa’ad da ka yi magana, ka kuma yi nasara sa’ad da ka yi shari’a.”
english: May it never be! Yes, let God be found true, but every man a liar. As it is written, “that you might be justified in your words, and might prevail when you come into judgment.”

hausa: Gama Ubangiji Allahnku yana fitar da ku zuwa cikin ƙasa mai kyau, ƙasa mai rafuffuka da tafkunan ruwa, tare da maɓulɓulai masu gudu a kwari da tuddai;
english: For Yahweh your God brings you into a good land, a land of brooks of water, of springs, and underground water flowing into valleys and hills;

hausa: “A wannan rana,” in jin Ubangiji, “zan hallaka masu hikimar Edom, zan shafe mutane masu fahima a duwatsun Isuwa.
english: “Won’t I in that day”, says Yahweh, “destroy the wise men out of Edom, and understanding out of the mountain of Esau?

hausa: Al’ada ce ga firistoci da mutane cewa in wani ya miƙa hadaya, yayinda nama yake kan wuta, bawan firist zai zo da babban cokali mai yatsu,
english: The custom of the priests with the people was that when anyone offered a sacrifice, the priest’s servant came while the meat was boiling, with a fork of three teeth in his hand;

hausa: za tă kuma tashi daga Dutsen Hor, zuwa Lebo Hamat. Sa’an nan tă miƙe zuwa Zedad,
english: From Mount Hor you shall mark out to the entrance of Hamath; and the border shall pass by Zedad.

hausa: Saboda ka harzuƙa gāba da ni kuma saboda girmankanka ya kai kunnuwana, zan sa ƙugiya a hancinka linzamina a bakinka, zan kuma sa ka koma ta hanyar da ka zo.
english: Because of your raging against me, and because your arrogance has come up into my ears, therefore I will put my hook in your nose and my bridle in your lips, and I will turn you back by the way by which you came.

hausa: Saboda wannan dole a mai da shi kamar ’yan’uwansa ta kowace hanya, domin yă zama babban firist mai aminci da mai jinƙai cikin hidima ga Allah, yă kuma miƙa hadayar sulhu saboda zunuban mutane.
english: Therefore he was obligated in all things to be made like his brothers, that he might become a merciful and faithful high priest in things pertaining to God, to make atonement for the sins of the people.

hausa: Masu albarka ne waɗanda ake tsananta musu don gani an yi adalci, gama mulkin sama nasu ne.
english: Blessed are those who have been persecuted for righteousness’ sake, for theirs is the Kingdom of Heaven.

hausa: Azor ya haifi Zadok, Zadok ya haifi Akim, Akim kuma ya haifi Eliyud,
english: Azor became the father of Zadok. Zadok became the father of Achim. Achim became the father of Eliud.

hausa: tebur da dukan kayayyakinsa, da burodin Kasancewa;
english: the table, all its vessels, the show bread,

hausa: Yerobowam ya huta da kakanninsa, sarakunan Isra’ila. Zakariya ɗansa kuwa ya gāje shi.
english: Jeroboam slept with his fathers, even with the kings of Israel; and Zechariah his son reigned in his place.

hausa: Ya kuma yi gine-gine domin ajiyar hatsi, sabon ruwa inabi da mai; ya kuma yi wuraren ajiyar kowane irin shanu dabam-dabam, da kuma turke domin tumaki.
english: also storehouses for the increase of grain, new wine, and oil; and stalls for all kinds of animals, and flocks in folds.

hausa: Iliya ya amsa, ya ce, “Ban tā-da-na-zaune-tsaye a Isra’ila ba. Amma kai da iyalin mahaifinka, ku kuka tā-da-na-zaune-tsaye. Ka ƙyale umarnai Ubangiji, ka bi Ba’al.
english: He answered, “I have not troubled Israel, but you and your father’s house, in that you have forsaken Yahweh’s commandments and you have followed the Baals.

hausa: Zuciya mai la’akari kan nemi sani; kunnuwan mai hikima kan bincika don yă koya.
english: The heart of the discerning gets knowledge. The ear of the wise seeks knowledge.

hausa: Sa’ad da dukan abokan gābanmu suka ji haka, dukan al’umman da suke kewaye da mu suka ji tsoro, suka rasa ƙarfin halinsu, domin sun gane cewa wannan aiki an yi shi da taimakon Allahnmu ne.
english: When all our enemies heard of it, all the nations that were around us were afraid, and they lost their confidence; for they perceived that this work was done by our God.

hausa: Don me aka ba mutum rai, mutumin da bai san wani abu game da kansa ba, mutumin da Allah ya kange shi.
english: Why is light given to a man whose way is hidden, whom God has hedged in?

hausa: sai shugaban ƙungiyar sojan ya umarta a kai Bulus a barikin soja. Ya ba da umarni a yi masa bulala a kuma tambaye shi abin da ya sa mutane suke masa ihu haka.
english: the commanding officer commanded him to be brought into the barracks, ordering him to be examined by scourging, that he might know for what crime they shouted against him like that.

hausa: Na’aman babban hafsan hafsoshin rundunar sarkin Aram ne, kuma ƙasaitaccen mutum ne mai martaba a idon maigidansa, domin ta wurinsa Ubangiji ya ba Aram nasara. Na’aman jarumi ne ƙwarai, amma yana da kuturta.
english: Now Naaman, captain of the army of the king of Syria, was a great man with his master, and honorable, because by him Yahweh had given victory to Syria; he was also a mighty man of valor, but he was a leper.

hausa: kuna cewa, ‘Ba ni da laifi; ba ya fushi da ni.’ Amma zan zartar da hukunci a kanku domin kun ce, ‘Ban yi zunubi ba.’
english: “Yet you said, ‘I am innocent. Surely his anger has turned away from me.’ “Behold, I will judge you, because you say, ‘I have not sinned.’

hausa: Sa’an nan zan tafi bagaden Allah, ga Allah, farin cikina da murnata. Zan yabe ka da garaya, Ya Allah, Allahna.
english: Then I will go to the altar of God, to God, my exceeding joy. I will praise you on the harp, God, my God.

hausa: Jimillar maza daga mutanen Manasse 32,200 ne.
english: those who were counted of them, of the tribe of Manasseh, were thirty-two thousand two hundred.

hausa: Ku yi hankali da mutane; za su miƙa ku ga majalisa su kuma yi muku bulala a majami’unsu.
english: But beware of men, for they will deliver you up to councils, and in their synagogues they will scourge you.

hausa: Fushi mugun abu ne mai hallakarwa, amma wa zai iya tsaya a gaban kishi?
english: Wrath is cruel, and anger is overwhelming; but who is able to stand before jealousy?

hausa: Ga abin da Ubangiji Maɗaukaki, Allah na Isra’ila, yana cewa ga dukan waɗanda aka kwashe zuwa zaman bauta daga Urushalima zuwa Babilon.
english: Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel, says to all the captives whom I have caused to be carried away captive from Jerusalem to Babylon:

hausa: Kullum muna ɗauke da mutuwar Yesu a jikinmu, domin ran Yesu yă bayyana a jikinmu.
english: always carrying in the body the putting to death of the Lord Jesus, that the life of Jesus may also be revealed in our body.

hausa: Ka kuma shafe Yehu ɗan Nimshi yă zama sarkin Isra’ila, ka shafe Elisha ɗan Shafat daga Abel-Mehola yă gāje ka a matsayin annabi.
english: Anoint Jehu the son of Nimshi to be king over Israel; and anoint Elisha the son of Shaphat of Abel Meholah to be prophet in your place.

hausa: A ƙarshe, dukanku ku zauna lafiya da juna; ku zama masu juyayi, kuna ƙaunar juna kamar ’yan’uwa, ku zama masu tausayi da kuma tawali’u.
english: Finally, all of you be like-minded, compassionate, loving as brothers, tenderhearted, courteous,

hausa: ka kuma tara dukan jama’a a ƙofar Tentin Sujada.”
english: and assemble all the congregation at the door of the Tent of Meeting.”

hausa: Sa’ad da magana ta yi yawa, ba a rasa zunubi a ciki, amma shi da ya ƙame harshensa mai hikima ne.
english: In the multitude of words there is no lack of disobedience, but he who restrains his lips does wisely.

hausa: nakan yi ta yawo ina makoki sai ka ce yadda nake yi wa abokina ko ɗan’uwana. Nakan sunkuyar da kaina cikin baƙin ciki sai ka ce ina kuka domin mahaifiyata.
english: I behaved myself as though it had been my friend or my brother. I bowed down mourning, as one who mourns his mother.

hausa: Ka yi mana jinƙai, ya Ubangiji, ka yi mana jinƙai, gama mun jimre da reni mai yawa.
english: Have mercy on us, Yahweh, have mercy on us, for we have endured much contempt.

hausa: Sauran mutane za su ji wannan su kuma ji tsoro, ba kuwa za a ƙara yin irin wannan mugun abu a cikinku ba.
english: Those who remain shall hear, and fear, and will never again commit any such evil among you.

hausa: Maganar da ta zo wa Irmiya ke nan daga Ubangiji.
english: The word that came to Jeremiah from Yahweh, saying,

hausa: “Mutum mai wannan cuta mai yaɗuwa dole yă sa yagaggun riguna, yă kuma bar gashin kansa ba gyara, yă rufe sashe ƙasa na fuskarsa, sa’an nan yă riga cewa, ‘Marar tsarki! Marar tsarki!’
english: “The leper in whom the plague is shall wear torn clothes, and the hair of his head shall hang loose. He shall cover his upper lip, and shall cry, ‘Unclean! Unclean!’

hausa: Kaiton waɗanda suke tsammani suna da hikima da kuma wayo a idonsu.
english: Woe to those who are wise in their own eyes, and prudent in their own sight!

hausa: Tare za su fāɗa wa Filistiyawa da yaƙi daga yamma; tare za su washe mutane wajen gabas. Za su ɗibiya hannuwa a kan Edom da Mowab, Ammonawa kuma za su yi musu biyayya.
english: They will fly down on the shoulders of the Philistines on the west. Together they will plunder the children of the east. They will extend their power over Edom and Moab, and the children of Ammon will obey them.

hausa: Sa’an nan Solomon ya tafi Urushalima daga masujadar kan tudu a Gibeyon, da kuma daga gaban Tentin Sujada. Ya kuma yi mulki a bisa Isra’ila.
english: So Solomon came from the high place that was at Gibeon, from before the Tent of Meeting, to Jerusalem; and he reigned over Israel.

hausa: Ya albarkace su a wannan rana ya ce, “A cikin sunanku Isra’ila zai sa wannan albarka ‘Bari Allah yă sa ku zama kamar Efraim da Manasse.’ ” Saboda haka ya sa Efraim gaban Manasse.
english: He blessed them that day, saying, “Israel will bless in your name, saying, ‘God make you as Ephraim and as Manasseh’” He set Ephraim before Manasseh.

hausa: Babilon, kayan daraja na mulkoki, abin fariyar Babiloniyawa, Allah zai kaɓantar da ita kamar yadda ya yi da Sodom da Gomorra.
english: Babylon, the glory of kingdoms, the beauty of the Chaldeans’ pride, will be like when God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah.

hausa: Ya kuma ba da ƙasarsu gādo, Ƙaunarsa madawwamiya ce.
english: and gave their land as an inheritance, for his loving kindness endures forever;

hausa: Saboda haka ya yi ta muhawwara a majami’a da Yahudawa da kuma Hellenawa masu tsoron Allah, haka kuma da waɗanda yake tararwa a bakin kasuwa.
english: So he reasoned in the synagogue with the Jews and the devout persons, and in the marketplace every day with those who met him.

hausa: A can, a gaban Ubangiji Allahnku, ku da iyalanku za su ci, su kuma yi farin ciki a kome da kuka sa hannunku a kai, domin Ubangiji Allahnku zai albarkace ku.
english: There you shall eat before Yahweh your God, and you shall rejoice in all that you put your hand to, you and your households, in which Yahweh your God has blessed you.

hausa: “ ‘Waɗannan su ne bukukkuwan da Ubangiji ya kafa da tsarkakakkun taron jama’a za su yi a ƙayyadaddun lokuta.
english: “‘These are the set feasts of Yahweh, even holy convocations, which you shall proclaim in their appointed season.

hausa: Sa’ad da maganganunka suka zo, na cinye su; suka zama abin farin ciki zuciyata kuma ta yi murna, gama ana kirana da sunanka, Ya Ubangiji Allah Maɗaukaki.
english: Your words were found, and I ate them. Your words were to me a joy and the rejoicing of my heart, for I am called by your name, Yahweh, God of Armies.

hausa: Ubangiji yana mulki, yana sanye da ɗaukaka; Ubangiji yana sanye da ɗaukaka yana kuma sanye da ƙarfi. An kafa duniya daram; ba za a iya matsar da ita ba.
english: Yahweh reigns! He is clothed with majesty! Yahweh is armed with strength. The world also is established. It can’t be moved.

hausa: Zan mai da gaskiya igiyar gwaji adalci kuma ɗan katakon gwajin ginin; ƙanƙara za tă share mafakarku, ƙarya, da ruwa kuma za su mamaye maɓuyanku.
english: I will make justice the measuring line, and righteousness the plumb line. The hail will sweep away the refuge of lies, and the waters will overflow the hiding place.

hausa: Daga gabas na kira tsuntsun da yake farauta; daga can ƙasa mai nesa, wani mutumin da zai cika nufina. Abin da na riga na faɗa, shi zan sa ya faru; abin da na shirya, shi zan aikata.
english: I call a ravenous bird from the east, the man of my counsel from a far country. Yes, I have spoken. I will also bring it to pass. I have planned. I will also do it.

hausa: Ya Ubangiji kai ne fitilata; Ubangiji ya mai da duhuna haske.
english: For you are my lamp, Yahweh. Yahweh will light up my darkness.

hausa: Amma kai, Daniyel, ka rufe zancen nan ka kuma liƙe kalmomin littafin nan har sai ƙarshe. Mutane da yawa za su yi ta kai komo don neman sani.”
english: But you, Daniel, shut up the words and seal the book, even to the time of the end. Many will run back and forth, and knowledge will be increased.”

hausa: A duk lokacin da na yi shela cewa za a tumɓuke, a kakkarya a kuma hallaka wata al’umma ko mulki,
english: At the instant I speak concerning a nation, and concerning a kingdom, to pluck up and to break down and to destroy it,

hausa: Waɗansu mutum huɗu suka zo wajensa ɗauke da wani shanyayye.
english: Four people came, carrying a paralytic to him.

hausa: “Na daɗe ina shiru, na yi shiru na kuma ƙame kaina. Amma yanzu, kamar mace mai naƙuda, na yi ƙara, ina nishi ina kuma haki.
english: “I have been silent a long time. I have been quiet and restrained myself. Now I will cry out like a travailing woman. I will both gasp and pant.

hausa: Alherin Ubangiji Yesu yă kasance tare da mutanen Allah. Amin.
english: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ be with all the saints. Amen.

hausa: Duk mai kunnen ji, yă ji abin da Ruhu yake faɗa wa ikkilisiyoyi. Duk wanda ya ci nasara mutuwa ta biyu ba za tă cuce shi ba ko kaɗan.
english: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the assemblies. He who overcomes won’t be harmed by the second death.

hausa: Duk wanda ya gani, sai ya ce, “Ba a taɓa gani ko yin irin wannan abu ba, tun lokacin da Isra’ilawa suka fito daga Masar. Ku yi tunani wannan! Ku kuma yi la’akari! Ku gaya mana abin da za mu yi!”
english: It was so, that all who saw it said, “Such a deed has not been done or seen from the day that the children of Israel came up out of the land of Egypt to this day! Consider it, take counsel, and speak.”

hausa: Ɗa mai hikima kan kawo farin ciki wa mahaifinsa, amma wawa yakan rena mahaifiyarsa.
english: A wise son makes a father glad, but a foolish man despises his mother.

hausa: “ ‘Namiji, ko ta macen da yake mai duba, ko maita a cikinku dole a kashe. Za ku jajjefe su da duwatsu; alhakin jininsu zai zauna a kansu.’ ”
english: “‘A man or a woman that is a medium or is a wizard shall surely be put to death. They shall be stoned with stones. Their blood shall be upon themselves.’”

hausa: Game da sauran ayyukan mulkin Zakariya, duk a rubuce suke a cikin littafin tarihin sarakunan Isra’ila.
english: Now the rest of the acts of Zechariah, behold, they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel.

hausa: Irin wannan babban firist ne muke bukata, shi mai tsarki ne, marar aibi, mai tsabta, ba kamar mu masu zunubi ba sam. An ɗaukaka shi fiye da kome a sama.
english: For such a high priest was fitting for us: holy, guiltless, undefiled, separated from sinners, and made higher than the heavens;

hausa: Zan aika da annoba a kanta in kuma sa jini ya zuba a titunanta. Kisassu za su fāɗi a cikinta, da takobi yana gāba da ita a kowane gefe. Sa’an nan za su san cewa ni ne Ubangiji.
english: For I will send pestilence into her, and blood into her streets. The wounded will fall within her, with the sword on her on every side. Then they will know that I am Yahweh.

hausa: Ya duba kewaye, sai ga wainar burodi kusa da kansa a bisa garwashin wuta mai zafi, da kuma tulun ruwa. Ya ci, ya sha, sa’an nan ya sāke kwanta.
english: He looked, and behold, there was at his head a cake baked on the coals, and a jar of water. He ate and drank, and lay down again.

hausa: Ba a daɗe da rasuwar Gideyon ba, sai Isra’ila ta sāke shiga karuwanci suna bauta wa Ba’al. Suka kafa Ba’al-Berit yă zama musu allahnsu ba kuma
english: As soon as Gideon was dead, the children of Israel turned again and played the prostitute following the Baals, and made Baal Berith their god.

hausa: A rana ta goma, Ahiyezer ɗan Ammishaddai, shugaban mutanen Dan, ya kawo hadayarsa.
english: On the tenth day Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai, prince of the children of Dan,

hausa: A shekara ta tara ta sarautar Hosheya, sarkin Assuriya ya ci Samariya da yaƙi ya kuma kwashe Isra’ilawa zuwa Assuriya. Ya tsugunar da su a Hala, da a Gozan a bakin Kogin Habor da kuma a garuruwan Medes.
english: In the ninth year of Hoshea the king of Assyria took Samaria and carried Israel away to Assyria, and placed them in Halah, and on the Habor, the river of Gozan, and in the cities of the Medes.

hausa: Amma ku, ku yi ta haihuwa, ku ƙaru; ku yaɗu a duniya, ku yi yawa a bisanta.”
english: Be fruitful and multiply. Increase abundantly on the earth, and multiply in it.”

hausa: Ya karanta Dokar da ƙarfi daga safe har tsakar rana yayinda yake a kan dandali da yake fuskantar dandali a gaban Ƙofar Ruwa, gaban maza, mata da kuma sauran mutanen da za su iya fahimta. Dukan mutane kuwa suka saurara a hankali ga karatun Littafin Dokar.
english: He read from it before the wide place that was in front of the water gate from early morning until midday, in the presence of the men and the women, and of those who could understand. The ears of all the people were attentive to the book of the law.

hausa: Tun daga ƙetaren rafuffukan Kush masu yi mini sujada, mutanena da suke a warwatse, za su kawo mini hadayu.
english: From beyond the rivers of Cush, my worshipers, even the daughter of my dispersed people, will bring my offering.

hausa: Namiji kuwa bai kamata ya rufe kansa ba, da yake shi kamannin Allah ne, da kuma darajar Allah, amma mace dai, darajar namiji ne.
english: For a man indeed ought not to have his head covered, because he is the image and glory of God, but the woman is the glory of the man.

hausa: Dukan waɗannan sarakuna na bayan nan suka haɗa kai a Kwarin Siddim (Teku Gishiri).
english: All these joined together in the valley of Siddim (also called the Salt Sea).

hausa: Na sami labari cewa kana iya ba da fassara da kuma warware matsaloli masu wuya. In har ka iya karanta wannan rubutun ka kuma faɗa mini abin da yake nufi, za a sa maka riga shunayya, a kuma sa sarƙar zinariya a wuyanka. Za ka zama na uku a cikin masu mulkin ƙasar.”
english: But I have heard of you, that you can give interpretations and dissolve doubts. Now if you can read the writing and make known to me its interpretation, you shall be clothed with purple, and have a chain of gold around your neck, and shall be the third ruler in the kingdom.”

hausa: Sai suka zo wurin Yohanna suka ce masa, “Rabbi, wancan mutumin da yake tare da kai a ƙetaren Urdun, wannan da ka ba da shaida a kansa sosai nan, yana baftisma, kuma kowa yana zuwa wurinsa.”
english: They came to John and said to him, “Rabbi, he who was with you beyond the Jordan, to whom you have testified, behold, he baptizes, and everyone is coming to him.”

hausa: Gara ka sami kaɗan ta hanyar adalci da sami riba mai yawa ta hanyar rashin gaskiya.
english: Better is a little with righteousness, than great revenues with injustice.

hausa: Dā ma ya riga ya gina dakalin tagulla, mai tsawo kamu biyar, fāɗi kamu biyar da kuma tsayi kamu uku, ya kuma sa shi a tsakiyar filin waje. Ya tsaya a kan dakalin ya kuma durƙusa a gaban dukan taron Isra’ila ya buɗe hannuwansa sama.
english: (for Solomon had made a bronze platform, five cubits long, five cubits wide, and three cubits high, and had set it in the middle of the court; and he stood on it, and knelt down on his knees before all the assembly of Israel, and spread out his hands toward heaven).

hausa: Waɗannan mutane sun zama kamar ƙazanta a taronku na soyayya, suna ta ciye-ciye a cikinku, ba kunya ba tsoro. Su masu kiwo ne da suke ciyar da kansu kawai. Su kamar hadari ne da babu ruwa da iska take kori. Su kamar itatuwa ne, marasa ’ya’ya da rani, waɗanda aka tumɓuke, ko kamar itatuwan da aka tumɓuke suka kuma mutu ƙurmus.
english: These are hidden rocky reefs in your love feasts when they feast with you, shepherds who without fear feed themselves; clouds without water, carried along by winds; autumn trees without fruit, twice dead, plucked up by the roots;

hausa: Saboda haka, kai da kake ba wa wani laifi, ba ka da wata hujja, gama a duk lokacin da kake ba wa wani laifi, kana hukunta kanka ne, domin kai da kake ba wa wani laifi kai ma kana aikata waɗannan abubuwa.
english: Therefore you are without excuse, O man, whoever you are who judge. For in that which you judge another, you condemn yourself. For you who judge practice the same things.

hausa: Waɗansu kuma suka gwada shi, ta wurin neman yă nuna musu wata alama daga sama.
english: Others, testing him, sought from him a sign from heaven.

hausa: Haka kuwa kuka zauna a Kadesh kwanaki masu yawa, kuka ci lokaci a can.
english: So you stayed in Kadesh many days, according to the days that you remained.

hausa: Ku karɓi wanda bangaskiyarsa ba tă yi ƙarfi ba, amma fa kada ku hukunta shi a kan abubuwan da ake da shakka a kai ba.
english: Now accept one who is weak in faith, but not for disputes over opinions.

hausa: Sai ya umarci mutanen su zazzauna a kan ciyawa. Da ya ɗauki burodi biyar da kifin biyun nan ya dubi sama, ya yi godiya ya kuma kakkarya burodin. Sa’an nan ya ba wa almajiransa, almajiran kuwa suka ba wa mutane.
english: He commanded the multitudes to sit down on the grass; and he took the five loaves and the two fish, and looking up to heaven, he blessed, broke and gave the loaves to the disciples; and the disciples gave to the multitudes.

hausa: amma Eli ya kira shi ya ce, “Sama’ila, ɗana.” Sama’ila ya ce, “Ga ni.”
english: Then Eli called Samuel and said, “Samuel, my son!” He said, “Here I am.”

hausa: Amma Yowab ya ce wa sarki, “Ubangiji Allahnka ya sa mayaƙan su ƙaru sau ɗari fiye da yadda suke, har ranka yă daɗe, sarki yă gani da idonsa. Me ya sa ranka yă daɗe, sarki yake so yă yi abu haka?”
english: Joab said to the king, “Now may Yahweh your God add to the people, however many they may be, one hundred times; and may the eyes of my lord the king see it. But why does my lord the king delight in this thing?”

hausa: Zan rera sabuwar waƙa gare ka, ya Allah; a kan molo mai tsirkiya goma zan yi maka kiɗi,
english: I will sing a new song to you, God. On a ten-stringed lyre, I will sing praises to you.

hausa: Aka binne shi a ƙasar gādonsa, a Timnat Heres a ƙasar tudu ta Efraim, arewa da Dutsen Ga’ash.
english: They buried him in the border of his inheritance in Timnath Heres, in the hill country of Ephraim, on the north of the mountain of Gaash.

hausa: Ku riƙa karɓar juna ba da gunaguni ba.
english: Be hospitable to one another without grumbling.

hausa: daga iyalin Yowab, Obadiya ɗan Yehiyel ne shugaba, tare da shi akwai mutum 218;
english: Of the sons of Joab, Obadiah the son of Jehiel; and with him two hundred eighteen males.

hausa: Zai ci gaba da juye abin kamun kifinsu ke nan, suna hallaka al’ummai ba tausayi?
english: Will he therefore continually empty his net, and kill the nations without mercy?

hausa: domin ta yi tunani cewa, “Ko da rigunarsa ma na taɓa, zan warke.”
english: For she said, “If I just touch his clothes, I will be made well.”

hausa: A lokacin nan sai almajirai suka zo wurin Yesu suka yi tambaya suka ce, “Wane ne mafi girma a mulkin sama?”
english: In that hour the disciples came to Jesus, saying, “Who then is greatest in the Kingdom of Heaven?”

hausa: Saboda haka ’ya’yan Zelofehad mata suka yi yadda Ubangiji ya umarci Musa.
english: The daughters of Zelophehad did as Yahweh commanded Moses:

hausa: Duk wanda ya rufe laifi yana inganta ƙauna ne, amma duk wanda ya yi ta maimaita batu yakan raba abokai na kusa.
english: He who covers an offense promotes love; but he who repeats a matter separates best friends.

hausa: Amma irin da suka fāɗi a ƙasa mai kyau kuwa, su ne mutane masu kyakkyawar zuciya, mai kyau, da suka ji, suka riƙe, suka kuma jimre har suka ba da ’ya’ya.”
english: Those in the good ground, these are those who with an honest and good heart, having heard the word, hold it tightly, and produce fruit with perseverance.

hausa: Sunan da aka rubuta a goshinta asiri ne, Babilon mai girma mahaifiyar karuwai da kuma na abubuwa masu banƙyama na duniya.
english: And on her forehead a name was written, “MYSTERY, BABYLON THE GREAT, THE MOTHER OF THE PROSTITUTES AND OF THE ABOMINATIONS OF THE EARTH.”

hausa: Mutanen Gad da mutanen Ruben suka amsa, suka ce, “Barorinka za su yi abin da Ubangiji ya faɗa.
english: The children of Gad and the children of Reuben answered, saying, “As Yahweh has said to your servants, so will we do.

hausa: Gama leɓunan mazinaciya na ɗigan zuma, maganarta tana da sulɓi fiye da mai;
english: For the lips of an adulteress drip honey. Her mouth is smoother than oil,

hausa: Sai mutumin da yana saye da lilin yake kuma rataye da jaka ƙunshe da kayan rubutu a gefensa ya mayar da magana, yana cewa, “Na yi yadda ka umarci ni.”
english: Behold, the man clothed in linen, who had the inkhorn by his side, reported the matter, saying, “I have done as you have commanded me.”

hausa: “Ya amsa ya ce, ‘Garwar mai na zaitun guda ɗari tara.’ “Manajan ya ce, ‘Ga takardarka, ka zauna maza ka mai da shi ɗari huɗu.’
english: He said, ‘A hundred batos of oil.’ He said to him, ‘Take your bill, and sit down quickly and write fifty.’

hausa: Yanzu fa ni, Sarki Artazerzes, ina ba da umarni ga kowane ma’aji na Kewayen Kogin Yuferites su tanada duk abin da Ezra firist, wanda kuma yake malamin Dokar Allah na sama zai bukaci,
english: I, even I, Artaxerxes the king, make a decree to all the treasurers who are beyond the River, that whatever Ezra the priest, the scribe of the law of the God of heaven, requires of you, it shall be done with all diligence,

hausa: Zan aika da baƙi zuwa Babilon su casa ta su kuma yi kaca-kaca da ƙasarta; za su yi hamayya da ita a kowane gefe a ranar masifarta.
english: I will send to Babylon strangers, who will winnow her. They will empty her land; for in the day of trouble they will be against her all around.

hausa: Iliya ya ce, “Na rantse da Ubangiji Maɗaukaki, wanda nake bauta wa, tabbatacce zan gabatar da kaina ga Ahab a yau.”
english: Elijah said, “As Yahweh of Armies lives, before whom I stand, I will surely show myself to him today.”

hausa: Sai Bulus ya ce wa jarumin da kuma sojojin, “In mutanen nan ba su tsaya a cikin jirgin nan ba, ba za ku tsira ba.”
english: Paul said to the centurion and to the soldiers, “Unless these stay in the ship, you can’t be saved.”

hausa: “Ka tafi ka faɗa wa bawana Dawuda, ‘Ga abin da Ubangiji ya ce ba kai ba ne za ka gida mini gidan da zan zauna a ciki.
english: “Go and tell David my servant, ‘Yahweh says, “You shall not build me a house to dwell in;

hausa: amma bai gayyaci annabi Natan, ko Benahiya, ko wani daga matsara na musamman, ko kuwa ɗan’uwansa Solomon ba.
english: but he didn’t call Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah, and the mighty men, and Solomon his brother.

hausa: Waɗanda suke daga kowane kabilar Isra’ila waɗanda suka sa zuciya a kan neman Ubangiji, Allah na Isra’ila, suka bi Lawiyawa zuwa Urushalima don su miƙa hadayu ga Ubangiji Allah na kakanninsu.
english: After them, out of all the tribes of Israel, those who set their hearts to seek Yahweh, the God of Israel, came to Jerusalem to sacrifice to Yahweh, the God of their fathers.

hausa: Zelek mutumin Ammon Naharai Baroti, mai ɗaukar kayan yaƙin Yowab ɗan Zeruhiya,
english: Zelek the Ammonite, Naharai the Berothite (the armor bearer of Joab the son of Zeruiah),

hausa: Sai suka je suka tsare kabarin ta wurin buga masa hatimi, suka kuma sa masu gadi.
english: So they went with the guard and made the tomb secure, sealing the stone.

hausa: Yanzu na san cewa, Ubangiji yakan cece shafaffensa. Yakan amsa masa daga samansa mai tsarki da ikon ceto na hannun damansa.
english: Now I know that Yahweh saves his anointed. He will answer him from his holy heaven, with the saving strength of his right hand.

hausa: ’Ya’yan Merari maza, su ne, Mali da Mushi. Waɗannan su ne dangin Lawi bisa ga abin da aka rubuta.
english: The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. These are the families of the Levites according to their generations.

hausa: Kada ka yi nisa da ni, ya Allah; zo da sauri, ya Allahna, ka taimake ni.
english: God, don’t be far from me. My God, hurry to help me.

hausa: Saboda haka Hamor da ɗansa Shekem suka tafi ƙofar birninsu don su yi magana da mutanen garinsu.
english: Hamor and Shechem, his son, came to the gate of their city, and talked with the men of their city, saying,

hausa: Sai ya aiki biyu daga cikin masu taimakonsa, Timoti da Erastus, zuwa Makidoniya, yayinda shi kuwa ya ɗan dakata a lardin Asiya.
english: Having sent into Macedonia two of those who served him, Timothy and Erastus, he himself stayed in Asia for a while.

hausa: (I, na kuma yi wa iyalin gidan Istifanas baftisma, ban da wannan, ban tuna da wani da na yi masa baftisma ba.)
english: (I also baptized the household of Stephanas; besides them, I don’t know whether I baptized any other.)

hausa: Jimillar dukan jarirai maza daga wata ɗaya ko fiye, 6,200 ne.
english: Those who were counted of them, according to the number of all the males from a month old and upward, were six thousand two hundred.

hausa: Duk inda na kore su zuwa, dukan waɗanda suka ragu na wannan muguwar al’umma za su gwammaci mutuwa da rai, in ji Ubangiji Maɗaukaki.’
english: Death will be chosen rather than life by all the residue that remain of this evil family, that remain in all the places where I have driven them,” says Yahweh of Armies.

hausa: Sai maganar Ubangiji ta zo mini cewa,
english: Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

hausa: Zuriyar Shekaniya su ne, Shemahiya da ’ya’yansa maza. Hattush, Igal, Bariya, Neyariya da Shafat, su shida ne duka.
english: The son of Shecaniah: Shemaiah. The sons of Shemaiah: Hattush, Igal, Bariah, Neariah, and Shaphat, six.

hausa: Amma ku nemi mulkinsa, za a kuwa ƙara muku waɗannan abubuwa.
english: But seek God’s Kingdom, and all these things will be added to you.

hausa: Ga abin da Ubangiji yana cewa, “Sama kursiyina ce, duniya kuma matashin sawuna. Ina gidan da za ku gina mini? Ina wurin hutuna zai kasance?
english: Yahweh says: “Heaven is my throne, and the earth is my footstool. What kind of house will you build to me? Where will I rest?

hausa: Bari mutane su yabe ka, ya Allah; bari dukan mutane su yabe ka.
english: let the peoples praise you, God. Let all the peoples praise you.

hausa: na Nebo 52
english: The children of Nebo, fifty-two.

hausa: “ ‘Abin da kuma ya faru da ’ya’yanka biyu Hofni da Finehas zai zama alama a gare ka; saboda mutuwarsu za tă zama a rana ɗaya.
english: This will be the sign to you that will come on your two sons, on Hophni and Phinehas: in one day they will both die.

hausa: Amma mutanen suka yi fama da ƙishirwa a can, suka yi gunaguni a kan Musa. Suka ce, “Don me ka fitar da mu daga Masar, ka sa mu da ’ya’yanmu da dabbobinmu, mu mutu da ƙishirwa?”
english: The people were thirsty for water there; so the people murmured against Moses, and said, “Why have you brought us up out of Egypt, to kill us, our children, and our livestock with thirst?”

hausa: akwai duwatsu masu daraja a cikin duwatsunta, akwai kuma zinariya a cikin ƙurarta.
english: Sapphires come from its rocks. It has dust of gold.

hausa: Tuntayen za su zama muku abin dubawa don ku riƙa tunawa da dukan umarnan Ubangiji, don kada ku bi son zuciyarku, da sha’awar idanunku yadda kuka taɓa yi.
english: It shall be to you for a fringe, that you may see it, and remember all Yahweh’s commandments, and do them; and that you don’t follow your own heart and your own eyes, after which you used to play the prostitute;

hausa: A lokacin kuwa mutanen Bet-Shemesh suna girbin alkamansu a kwari da suka ɗaga ido suka hangi akwatin alkawarin Ubangiji, sai suka yi farin ciki ganinsa.
english: The people of Beth Shemesh were reaping their wheat harvest in the valley; and they lifted up their eyes and saw the ark, and rejoiced to see it.

hausa: Ubangiji yana ƙyamar leɓunan masu ƙarya, amma yana jin daɗin mutanen da suke masu gaskiya.
english: Lying lips are an abomination to Yahweh, but those who do the truth are his delight.

hausa: Haka ma, ’yan fashin da aka gicciye tare da shi, suka zazzage shi.
english: The robbers also who were crucified with him cast on him the same reproach.

hausa: Ya aika da ’yan aika zuwa cikin birnin wurin Ahab sarkin Isra’ila yana cewa, “Ga abin da Ben-Hadad ya ce,
english: He sent messengers into the city to Ahab king of Israel and said to him, “Ben Hadad says,

hausa: Ga waɗanda ta wurin naciya suna yin nagarta suna neman ɗaukaka, girma da rashin mutuwa, su za a ba su rai madawwami.
english: to those who by perseverance in well-doing seek for glory, honor, and incorruptibility, eternal life;

hausa: Har yanzu, waɗansu irin suka fāɗi a ƙasa mai kyau. Suka tsira, suka yi girma, suka ba da amfani, suka yi riɓi talatin-talatin, waɗansu sittin-sittin, waɗansu kuma ɗari-ɗari.”
english: Others fell into the good ground and yielded fruit, growing up and increasing. Some produced thirty times, some sixty times, and some one hundred times as much.”

hausa: “Sa’ad da kuka ga ‘abin ƙyama, mai kawo hallaka’tsaye indabai kamata ba (mai karatu ya gane), to, sai waɗanda suke a Yahudiya su gudu zuwa duwatsu.
english: “But when you see the abomination of desolation, spoken of by Daniel the prophet, standing where it ought not” (let the reader understand), “then let those who are in Judea flee to the mountains,

hausa: zan kafa kujerar sarautarka, yadda na alkawarta wa Dawuda mahaifinka sa’ad da na ce, ‘Ba za ka taɓa rasa wani mutumin da zai yi mulki a bisa Isra’ila ba.’
english: then I will establish the throne of your kingdom, according as I covenanted with David your father, saying, ‘There shall not fail you a man to be ruler in Israel.’

hausa: Sai dai da yake ba shi da saiwa, yakan ɗan jima kaɗan kawai. Da wata wahala ko tsanani ya auko masa saboda maganar, nan da nan sai yă ja da baya.
english: yet he has no root in himself, but endures for a while. When oppression or persecution arises because of the word, immediately he stumbles.

hausa: Allah mai ƙaunata. Allah zai sha gabana zai kuma sa in yi dariya a kan waɗanda suke magana marar kyau a kaina.
english: My God will go before me with his loving kindness. God will let me look at my enemies in triumph.

hausa: Wane ne cikin waɗannan bai san cewa hannun Ubangiji ne ya yi wannan ba?
english: Who doesn’t know that in all these, Yahweh’s hand has done this,

hausa: Yusuf ya ce masa, “Ga abin da mafarkin yake nufi, ‘Rassan nan uku, kwana uku ne.
english: Joseph said to him, “This is its interpretation: the three branches are three days.

hausa: Ya yayyafa mai a kan bagade sau bakwai, yana keɓe bagade da dukan kayayyaki, da daro, da abin da yake tsaya a kai, don yă tsarkake su.
english: He sprinkled it on the altar seven times, and anointed the altar and all its vessels, and the basin and its base, to sanctify them.

hausa: Bari masu neman raina su sha kunya su kuma rikice; bari dukan masu sha’awar gani lalacewata su juye baya da kunya.
english: Let them be disappointed and confounded who seek my soul. Let those who desire my ruin be turned back in disgrace.

hausa: ɗayan kuma Eliyezer, domin ya ce, “Allah mahaifina ya taimake ni ya cece ni daga takobin Fir’auna.”
english: The name of the other was Eliezer, for he said, “My father’s God was my help and delivered me from Pharaoh’s sword.”

hausa: Zan sa harshenka ya manne wa dasashinka don ka yi shiru ka kuma kāsa tsawata musu, ko da yake su gidan ’yan tawaye ne.
english: I will make your tongue stick to the roof of your mouth so that you will be mute and will not be able to correct them, for they are a rebellious house.

hausa: Ni musamman, ina roƙonku ku yi addu’a, don a komo da ni a gare ku ba da daɗewa ba.
english: I strongly urge you to do this, that I may be restored to you sooner.

hausa: Abokan tafiyata suka ga hasken, amma ba su fahimci muryar mai magana da ni ba.
english: “Those who were with me indeed saw the light and were afraid, but they didn’t understand the voice of him who spoke to me.

hausa: sai ka ji daga sama, ka kuma yi wani abu. Ka shari’anta tsakanin bayinka, ka hukunta mai laifi, ka mai da laifinsa a kansa, mai gaskiya kuma ka nuna shi marar laifi ne bisa ga gaskiyarsa.
english: then hear in heaven, and act, and judge your servants, condemning the wicked, to bring his way on his own head, and justifying the righteous, to give him according to his righteousness.

hausa: Mu ne masu salama da kuma amintattu na Isra’ila. Kana ƙoƙari ka hallaka birnin da yake uwa a Isra’ila. Don me kake so ka hallakar da gādon Ubangiji?”
english: I am among those who are peaceable and faithful in Israel. You seek to destroy a city and a mother in Israel. Why will you swallow up Yahweh’s inheritance?”

hausa: Ƙarfin mutanensu ya tsiyaye, suka razana aka kuma kunyata su. Suna kama da tsirai a gona, kamar sabon toho kamar ciyawa mai tohuwa bisa rufin ɗaki wanda ya bushe saboda zafi, kafin yă yi girma.
english: Therefore their inhabitants had little power. They were dismayed and confounded. They were like the grass of the field and like the green herb, like the grass on the housetops and like grain blasted before it has grown up.

hausa: Wataƙila ku ce wa kanku, “Ikona da ƙarfin hannuwana ne suka ba ni da wannan arziki.”
english: and lest you say in your heart, “My power and the might of my hand has gotten me this wealth.”

hausa: Ta haka Isra’ilawa suka ci Filistiyawa. Daga ranan Filistiyawa ba su ƙara yin nasara a kan Isra’ila ba. Ubangiji ya yi gāba da Filistiyawa har ƙarshen zamanin Sama’ila.
english: So the Philistines were subdued, and they stopped coming within the border of Israel. Yahweh’s hand was against the Philistines all the days of Samuel.

hausa: Sa’ad da dukan garkuna suka taru a can, sai makiyayan su gungurar da dutsen daga bakin rijiyar su shayar da tumaki. Sa’an nan su mai da dutsen a wurinsa a bakin rijiya.
english: There all the flocks were gathered. They rolled the stone from the well’s mouth, and watered the sheep, and put the stone back on the well’s mouth in its place.

hausa: Sai ya amsa ya ce, “Ba ka san mene ne waɗannan ba?” Na amsa, na ce, “A’a, ranka yă daɗe.”
english: Then the angel who talked with me answered me, “Don’t you know what these are?” I said, “No, my lord.”

hausa: Sai Ubangiji ya sauko a cikin ginshiƙin girgije; ya tsaya a bakin ƙofar Tenti, ya kira Haruna da Miriyam. Sa’ad da su biyu suka gusa gaba,
english: Yahweh came down in a pillar of cloud, and stood at the door of the Tent, and called Aaron and Miriam; and they both came forward.

hausa: Gama ga abin da Ubangiji yana cewa game da wannan fadar sarkin Yahuda, “Ko da yake kina kamar Gileyad a gare ni, kamar ƙwanƙolin Lebanon, tabbatacce zan maishe ki hamada, kamar garuruwan da ba mazauna.
english: For Yahweh says concerning the house of the king of Judah: “You are Gilead to me, the head of Lebanon. Yet surely I will make you a wilderness, cities which are not inhabited.

hausa: Umarnina shi ne, Ku ƙaunaci juna kamar yadda na ƙaunace ku.
english: “This is my commandment, that you love one another, even as I have loved you.

hausa: Isra’ilawan da suka kasance a Urushalima suka yi Bikin Burodi Marar Yisti kwana bakwai da farin ciki mai girma, yayinda Lawiyawa da firistoci suke rera ga Ubangiji kowace rana, haɗe da kayan kiɗin yabon Ubangiji.
english: The children of Israel who were present at Jerusalem kept the feast of unleavened bread seven days with great gladness. The Levites and the priests praised Yahweh day by day, singing with loud instruments to Yahweh.

hausa: Tun yana kan hanya, bayinsa suka tarye shi da labari cewa yaron yana warkewa.
english: As he was going down, his servants met him and reported, saying “Your child lives!”

hausa: Sa’an nan Musa ya ce, “Ga abin da Ubangiji ya umarce ku ku yi, domin ɗaukakar Ubangiji za tă bayyana gare ku.”
english: Moses said, “This is the thing which Yahweh commanded that you should do; and Yahweh’s glory shall appear to you.”

hausa: Suka sare kansa suka tuɓe makamansa, suka aika manzanni a dukan ƙasar Filistiyawa, su ba da labarin a haikalin allolinsu da cikin mutanensu.
english: They cut off his head, stripped off his armor, and sent into the land of the Philistines all around, to carry the news to the house of their idols and to the people.

hausa: Suka yi ta tambaya, “Me yake nufi da ‘jim kaɗan’? Ba mu fahimci abin da yake faɗi ba.”
english: They said therefore, “What is this that he says, ‘A little while’? We don’t know what he is saying.”

hausa: Ku yi godiya ga Ubangiji, ku kira bisa sunansa; ku sanar a cikin al’ummai abin da ya yi.
english: Give thanks to Yahweh! Call on his name! Make his doings known among the peoples.

hausa: Kada ka yi ƙyashin matar maƙwabcinka. Kada kuma ka yi sha’awar gidan maƙwabcinka, ko gonarsa, ko bayinsa maza da mata, ko saniyarka, ko jakinsa, ko dai wani abin da yake na maƙwabtanka.”
english: “You shall not covet your neighbor’s wife. Neither shall you desire your neighbor’s house, his field, or his male servant, or his female servant, his ox, or his donkey, or anything that is your neighbor’s.”

hausa: mutanen Issakar, masu fahimtar lokuta suka kuma san abin da ya kamata Isra’ila ya yi, manya 200, tare da danginsu a ƙarƙashin shugabancinsu;
english: Of the children of Issachar, men who had understanding of the times, to know what Israel ought to do, their heads were two hundred; and all their brothers were at their command.

hausa: Ko’ina da kuma a kowace hanya, ya mafifici Felis, mun amince da wannan da godiya marar iyaka.
english: we accept it in all ways and in all places, most excellent Felix, with all thankfulness.

hausa: Ubangiji yana kula da masu sauƙinkai yakan yar da mugaye a ƙasa.
english: Yahweh upholds the humble. He brings the wicked down to the ground.

hausa: Ubangiji Allahnku zai yi wa zukatanku kaciya da kuma zukatan zuriyarku, saboda ku ƙaunace shi da dukan zuciyarku da kuma dukan ranku, ku kuma rayu.
english: Yahweh your God will circumcise your heart, and the heart of your offspring, to love Yahweh your God with all your heart and with all your soul, that you may live.

hausa: Sa’an nan Ubangiji ya ce wa Yoshuwa,
english: Yahweh spoke to Joshua, saying,

hausa: Gaskiyar ita ce, kin auri maza biyar, wanda kuke tare yanzu kuwa ba mijinki ba ne. A nan kam kin yi gaskiya.”
english: for you have had five husbands; and he whom you now have is not your husband. This you have said truly.”

hausa: Siman Bitrus da kuma wani almajiri suna bin Yesu. Domin almajirin nan sananne ne ga babban firist, sai ya shiga tare da Yesu a filin gidan babban firist ɗin,
english: Simon Peter followed Jesus, as did another disciple. Now that disciple was known to the high priest, and entered in with Jesus into the court of the high priest;

hausa: Ka cika kalmomin da ka yi a kanmu da kuma a kan masu mulkinmu ta wurin kawo mana babban bala’i. A duniya duka ba a taɓa yin wani abu kamar yadda aka yi wa Urushalima ba.
english: He has confirmed his words, which he spoke against us and against our judges who judged us, by bringing on us a great evil; for under the whole sky, such has not been done as has been done to Jerusalem.

hausa: To, Bitrus yana nan zaune a filin, sai wata yarinya baiwa, ta zo wurinsa. Ta ce, “Kai ma kana tare da Yesu mutumin Galili.”
english: Now Peter was sitting outside in the court, and a maid came to him, saying, “You were also with Jesus, the Galilean!”

hausa: Sai mutanen Isra’ila suka rabu kashi biyu; rabi guda sun goyi bayan Tibni ɗan Ginat yă zama sarki, ɗayan rabin kuma sun goyi bayan Omri.
english: Then the people of Israel were divided into two parts: half of the people followed Tibni the son of Ginath, to make him king, and half followed Omri.

hausa: Amma da Yohanna ya ga Farisiyawa da Sadukiyawa da yawa suna zuwa inda yake yin baftisma, sai ya ce musu, “Ku macizai! Wa ya gargaɗe ku ku guje wa fushin nan mai zuwa?
english: But when he saw many of the Pharisees and Sadducees coming for his baptism, he said to them, “You offspring of vipers, who warned you to flee from the wrath to come?

hausa: Dawuda ya tambaye shi ya ce, “Wane ne ubangidanka, kuma daga ina ka fito?” Ya ce, “Ni mutumin Masar ne, bawan wani mutumin Amalek. Maigidana ya ƙyale ni sa’ad da na yi rashin lafiya kwanaki ukun da suka wuce.
english: David asked him, “To whom do you belong? Where are you from?” He said, “I am a young man of Egypt, servant to an Amalekite; and my master left me, because three days ago I got sick.

hausa: Waɗansu Farisiyawa suka zo wurinsa don su gwada shi. Suka yi tambaya suka ce, “Daidai ne mutum yă saki matarsa saboda wani dalili da kuma a kan kowane dalili?”
english: Pharisees came to him, testing him and saying, “Is it lawful for a man to divorce his wife for any reason?”

hausa: A haɗa da bunsuru guda, a matsayin hadaya don zunubi, don yin muku kafara.
english: and one male goat for a sin offering, to make atonement for you.

hausa: Sa’an nan za su san cewa ni, Ubangiji Allahnsu, ina tare da su kuma cewa su, gidan Isra’ila, mutanena ne, in ji Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka.
english: They will know that I, Yahweh, their God am with them, and that they, the house of Israel, are my people, says the Lord Yahweh.

hausa: Sukan yin kwanto su harbi marar laifi; sukan yi harbi nan da nan, ba tsoro.
english: to shoot innocent men from ambushes. They shoot at him suddenly and fearlessly.

hausa: don ka sanar da mutanensa ceto, ta wurin gafarar zunubansu,
english: to give knowledge of salvation to his people by the remission of their sins,

hausa: Za ka kasance da madarar awaki mai yawa don ka ciyar da kanka da kuma iyalinka ka kuma inganta bayinka mata.
english: There will be plenty of goats’ milk for your food, for your family’s food, and for the nourishment of your servant girls.

hausa: “ ‘Gama ga abin da Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka yana cewa, “ ‘Takobin sarkin Babilon zai auko maka.
english: For the Lord Yahweh says: “The sword of the king of Babylon will come on you.
