hausa: Ya kori abokan gābansa; ya sa suka sha madawwamiyar kunya.
english: He struck his adversaries backward. He put them to a perpetual reproach.

hausa: Yanzu fa, kana ce in tafi wurin mai girma sarki, in ce, ‘Iliya yana a nan.’ Ai, zai kashe ni!”
english: Now you say, ‘Go, tell your lord, “Behold, Elijah is here”.’ He will kill me.”

hausa: A gare ka, ya Ubangiji, na yi kira; a gare ka Ubangiji na yi kukan neman jinƙai.
english: I cried to you, Yahweh. I made supplication to the Lord:

hausa: maganarsa kuwa ba ta zama a cikinku, gama ba ku gaskata da wanda ya aiko ni ba.
english: You don’t have his word living in you, because you don’t believe him whom he sent.

hausa: Wadata kan kawo abokai da yawa, amma abokin matalauci kan bar shi.
english: Wealth adds many friends, but the poor is separated from his friend.

hausa: Abimelek ya kuma ce wa Ibrahim, “Me ya sa ka yi wannan?”
english: Abimelech said to Abraham, “What did you see, that you have done this thing?”

hausa: Garuruwanta sun zama abin kufai, za tă zama hamada inda ba ruwa, ƙasar da ba mazauna, ba kuma mutumin da zai ratsa ta cikinta.
english: Her cities have become a desolation, a dry land, and a desert, a land in which no man dwells. No son of man passes by it.

hausa: A wannan rana kurame za su ji maganganun littafi, daga duruduru da duhu kuma idanun makafi za su gani.
english: In that day, the deaf will hear the words of the book, and the eyes of the blind will see out of obscurity and out of darkness.

hausa: Ka fi mahaifinmu Yaƙub ne, wanda ya ba mu rijiyar ya kuma sha daga ciki da kansa, haka ma ’ya’yansa da kuma garkunan shanunsa da tumakinsa?”
english: Are you greater than our father Jacob, who gave us the well and drank from it himself, as did his children and his livestock?”

hausa: Irmiya na goma da kuma Makbannai na goma sha ɗaya.
english: Jeremiah the tenth, and Machbannai the eleventh.

hausa: Nikodimus ya yi tambaya ya ce, “Yaya za a haifi mutum sa’ad da ya tsufa? Tabbatacce ba zai sāke koma sau na biyu a cikin mahaifiyarsa don a haife shi kuma ba!”
english: Nicodemus said to him, “How can a man be born when he is old? Can he enter a second time into his mother’s womb and be born?”

hausa: Zan ƙasƙantar da zuriyar Dawuda saboda wannan, amma ba har abada ba.’ ”
english: I will afflict the offspring of David for this, but not forever.’”

hausa: cewa an binne shi an kuma tashe shi a rana ta uku bisa ga Nassi,
english: that he was buried, that he was raised on the third day according to the Scriptures,

hausa: Na ’ya’yan Kora maza. Zabura ce. Waƙa ce. Ya kafa harsashinsa a kan dutse mai tsarki.
english: A Psalm by the sons of Korah; a Song. His foundation is in the holy mountains.

hausa: An haɗa su da juna sun mannu da juna kuma ba za a iya raba su ba.
english: They are joined to one another. They stick together, so that they can’t be pulled apart.

hausa: Gama dukansu an ba ni su daga cikin Isra’ilawa a maimakon dukan waɗanda suka fara buɗe mahaifa, wato, dukan ’ya’yan farin Isra’ilawa. Na karɓi Lawiyawa su zama nawa.
english: For they are wholly given to me from among the children of Israel; instead of all who open the womb, even the firstborn of all the children of Israel, I have taken them to me.

hausa: Bayan sun tafi gonaki suka tattara inabi suka matse su, sai suka yi biki a haikalin allahnsu. Yayinda suke ci da sha, sai suka la’anci Abimelek.
english: They went out into the field, harvested their vineyards, trod the grapes, celebrated, and went into the house of their god and ate and drank, and cursed Abimelech.

hausa: Haka aka fitar da Miriyam bayan sansani kwana bakwai, mutane kuwa ba su ci gaba da tafiya ba sai da aka dawo da ita.
english: Miriam was shut up outside of the camp seven days, and the people didn’t travel until Miriam was brought in again.

hausa: Duk wanda bai saurare shi ba za a ware shi gaba ɗaya daga mutanensa.’
english: It will be that every soul that will not listen to that prophet will be utterly destroyed from among the people.’

hausa: Saboda haka sarkin Isra’ila ya lura da inda mutumin Allah ya ambata. Sau da sau Elisha yakan yi wa sarki kashedi, don haka ya riƙa taka yi tsantsan a wuraren nan.
english: The king of Israel sent to the place which the man of God told him and warned him of; and he saved himself there, not once or twice.

hausa: Bayan wannan, na ga mala’iku huɗu, a tsaye a kusurwoyi huɗu na duniya, suna tsare iskoki huɗu na duniya, domin su hana wani iska hurawa a bisan ƙasa ko a bisan teku ko a bisa wani itace.
english: After this, I saw four angels standing at the four corners of the earth, holding the four winds of the earth, so that no wind would blow on the earth, or on the sea, or on any tree.

hausa: Za a yashe Gaza a kuma bar Ashkelon kango. Da tsakar rana Ashdod za tă zama babu kowa a kuma tumɓuke Ekron.
english: For Gaza will be forsaken, and Ashkelon a desolation. They will drive out Ashdod at noonday, and Ekron will be rooted up.

hausa: Ba zan yi karambani in faɗi kome ba sai dai abin da Kiristi ya aikata ta wurina a jagorantar da Al’ummai su yi biyayya ga Allah ta wurin abin da na faɗa da kuma aikata
english: For I will not dare to speak of any things except those which Christ worked through me for the obedience of the Gentiles, by word and deed,

hausa: Cikin filaye biyu na haikalin Ubangiji kuwa, ya gina bagadai na dukan rundunan taurari.
english: He built altars for all the army of the sky in the two courts of Yahweh’s house.

hausa: Don mai bi da kaɗe-kaɗe. Ta Dawuda. Roƙo. Ka hanzarta, ya Allah, ka cece ni; Ya Ubangiji, zo da sauri ka taimake ni.
english: For the Chief Musician. By David. A reminder. Hurry, God, to deliver me. Come quickly to help me, Yahweh.

hausa: “ ‘Waɗannan ne ƙa’idodi game da dabbobi, tsuntsaye, da kowane abu mai rai da yake motsi a cikin ruwa, da kowace halitta mai rarrafe a ƙasa.
english: “‘This is the law of the animal, and of the bird, and of every living creature that moves in the waters, and of every creature that creeps on the earth,

hausa: Ya faɗi waɗannan kalmomi ne yayinda yake koyarwa a filin haikali, kusa da inda ake ajiye baye-baye. Duk da haka ba wanda ya kama shi, domin lokacinsa bai yi ba tukuna.
english: Jesus spoke these words in the treasury, as he taught in the temple. Yet no one arrested him, because his hour had not yet come.

hausa: Ubangiji yakan tuna da mu zai kuma albarkace mu. Zai albarkace gidan Isra’ila, zai albarkace gidan Haruna,
english: Yahweh remembers us. He will bless us. He will bless the house of Israel. He will bless the house of Aaron.

hausa: Ko da yake za ka fara da kaɗan, duk da haka za ka gama da samu mai yawa.
english: Though your beginning was small, yet your latter end would greatly increase.

hausa: ɗan mutum, kana zama a cikin mutane masu tawaye, Suna da idanun gani amma ba sa gani, suna da kunnuwan ji amma ba sa ji, gama ’yan tawaye ne.
english: “Son of man, you dwell in the middle of the rebellious house, who have eyes to see, and don’t see, who have ears to hear, and don’t hear; for they are a rebellious house.

hausa: Suka ce, “Zo mu shirya wa Irmiya maƙarƙashiya; gama koyarwar doka da firist ya yi ba za tă ɓace ba, haka ma shawara daga mai hikima da kuma magana daga annabawa. Saboda haka ku zo, mu fāɗa masa da harsunanmu kada mu saurari wani abin da zai faɗa.”
english: Then they said, “Come! Let’s devise plans against Jeremiah; for the law won’t perish from the priest, nor counsel from the wise, nor the word from the prophet. Come, and let’s strike him with the tongue, and let’s not give heed to any of his words.”

hausa: Sai ku yi hankali sosai da yadda kuke rayuwa, kada ku zama kamar marasa hikima, sai dai kamar masu hikima.
english: Therefore watch carefully how you walk, not as unwise, but as wise,

hausa: Ubangiji yă sa fuskarsa ta haskaka a kanku, yă kuma yi muku alheri;
english: Yahweh make his face to shine on you, and be gracious to you.

hausa: Duk da haka, bai rabu da zunuban Yerobowam ɗan Nebat, wanda ya sa Isra’ila ta aikata ba, wato, yin sujada ga siffofin maruƙa na zinariya a Betel da kuma Dan.
english: However, Jehu didn’t depart from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, with which he made Israel to sin—the golden calves that were in Bethel and that were in Dan.

hausa: Gara tsawatawar da ake yi a fili da ƙaunar da ake yi a ɓoye.
english: Better is open rebuke than hidden love.

hausa: Saboda haka na sayo abin ɗamara, yadda Ubangiji ya umarce ni, na kuwa sha ɗamara da shi.
english: So I bought a belt according to Yahweh’s word, and put it on my waist.

hausa: Sa’an nan Eleyazar firist zai ɗiba jininta a yatsarsa, yă yayyafa sau bakwai wajen gaban Tentin Sujada.
english: Eleazar the priest shall take some of her blood with his finger, and sprinkle her blood toward the front of the Tent of Meeting seven times.

hausa: “Ni ne Ubangiji Allahnka, wanda ya fitar da ku daga Masar, daga ƙasar bauta.
english: “I am Yahweh your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage.

hausa: Allah yana tare da mu; shi ne shugabanmu. Firistocinsa tare da ƙahoni za su busa kirarin yaƙi a kanku. Mutanen Isra’ila, kada ku yi yaƙi da Ubangiji Allah na kakanninku, gama ba za ku yi nasara ba.”
english: Behold, God is with us at our head, and his priests with the trumpets of alarm to sound an alarm against you. Children of Israel, don’t fight against Yahweh, the God of your fathers; for you will not prosper.”

hausa: Sa’an nan Ubangiji ya ce wa Musa, “Ka rubuta wannan a cikin littafi, yă zama abin tuni, ka kuma faɗa wa Yoshuwa zan hallaka Amalekawa ƙaƙaf daga duniya.”
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “Write this for a memorial in a book, and rehearse it in the ears of Joshua: that I will utterly blot out the memory of Amalek from under the sky.”

hausa: Waƙar haurawa. Ta Dawuda. Na yi farin ciki tare da waɗanda suka ce da ni, “Bari mu tafi gidan Ubangiji.”
english: A Song of Ascents. By David. I was glad when they said to me, “Let’s go to Yahweh’s house!”

hausa: Sa’ad da lokaci ya yi kusa a yi Bikin Ƙetarewa na Yahudawa, da yawa suka haura daga ƙauyuka zuwa Urushalima, don su tsarkake kansu kafin Bikin Ƙetarewa.
english: Now the Passover of the Jews was at hand. Many went up from the country to Jerusalem before the Passover, to purify themselves.

hausa: Ya miƙa shanunsu ga ƙanƙara, tumakinsu ga aradun tsawa.
english: He also gave over their livestock to the hail, and their flocks to hot thunderbolts.

hausa: Ga masu girman kai na ce, ‘Kada ku ƙara taƙama,’ ga mugaye kuma, ‘Kada ku ɗaga ƙahoninku.
english: I said to the arrogant, “Don’t boast!” I said to the wicked, “Don’t lift up the horn.

hausa: Bayan wannan, Yesu da almajiransa suka tafi ƙauyukan Yahudiya, inda ya ɗan jima da su, ya kuma yi baftisma.
english: After these things, Jesus came with his disciples into the land of Judea. He stayed there with them and baptized.

hausa: Bayan kwana uku, Yerobowam da dukan mutane suka dawo wurin Rehobowam yadda sarki ya faɗa, “Ku dawo gare ni cikin kwana uku.”
english: So Jeroboam and all the people came to Rehoboam the third day, as the king asked, saying, “Come to me again the third day.”

hausa: Yanzu yayinda nake yin annabci, sai Felatiya ɗan Benahiya ya mutu. Sai na fāɗi rubda ciki na kuma yi kuka da babbar murya na ce, “Kash, Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka! Za ka hallaka raguwar Isra’ila ƙaƙaf ne?”
english: When I prophesied, Pelatiah the son of Benaiah died. Then I fell down on my face, and cried with a loud voice, and said, “Ah Lord Yahweh! Will you make a full end of the remnant of Israel?”

hausa: yabe shi da kuge mai ƙara, yabe shi da kuge masu ƙara sosai.
english: Praise him with loud cymbals! Praise him with resounding cymbals!

hausa: Akwai sauran irin da ya rage a rumbu? Har yanzu, kuringar inabi da itacen ɓaure, rumman da itacen zaitun ba su ba da ’ya’ya ba tukuna. “ ‘Amma daga wannan rana zuwa gaba zan sa muku albarka.’ ”
english: Is the seed yet in the barn? Yes, the vine, the fig tree, the pomegranate, and the olive tree haven’t produced. From today I will bless you.’”

hausa: Ta wurin hikima Ubangiji ya kafa harsashin duniya, ta wurin fahimi ya shirya sammai inda suke;
english: By wisdom Yahweh founded the earth. By understanding, he established the heavens.

hausa: Yoshuwa ya ci su da yaƙi daga Kadesh Barneya zuwa Gaza, da kuma daga dukan yankin Goshen zuwa Gibeyon.
english: Joshua struck them from Kadesh Barnea even to Gaza, and all the country of Goshen, even to Gibeon.

hausa: Kada kuma ku kira wani a duniya ‘uba,’ gama kuna da Uba ɗaya ne, yana kuwa a sama.
english: Call no man on the earth your father, for one is your Father, he who is in heaven.

hausa: Ka gafarta wa mutanenka, waɗanda suka yi maka zunubi; ka gafarta dukan laifofin da suka yi maka, ka kuma sa waɗanda suka ci su a yaƙi su ji tausayinsu.
english: and forgive your people who have sinned against you, and all their transgressions in which they have transgressed against you; and give them compassion before those who carried them captive, that they may have compassion on them

hausa: Sai mala’ikan Ubangiji ya zo ya zauna a ƙarƙashin itacen oak a Ofra na Yowash mutumin Abiyezer, inda ɗansa Gideyon yake sussukar alkama a wurin matsin inabi don yă ɓoye daga Midiyawa.
english: Yahweh’s angel came and sat under the oak which was in Ophrah, that belonged to Joash the Abiezrite. His son Gideon was beating out wheat in the wine press, to hide it from the Midianites.

hausa: Yakan tā da matalauci daga ƙura, yă kuma ɗaga mai bukata daga tarin toka; yă zaunar da su tare da ’ya’yan sarki; yă kuma sa su gāji mulki na ɗaukaka. “Harsashin duniya na Ubangiji ne; a bisansu ne ya kafa duniya.
english: He raises up the poor out of the dust. He lifts up the needy from the dunghill to make them sit with princes and inherit the throne of glory. For the pillars of the earth are Yahweh’s. He has set the world on them.

hausa: Ta ce, “Kada ka yi wannan ɗan’uwana! Kada ka tilasta ni. Bai kamata a yi irin wannan abu a Isra’ila ba! Kada ka yi wannan mugun abu.
english: She answered him, “No, my brother, do not force me! For no such thing ought to be done in Israel. Don’t you do this folly!

hausa: (A kwanakin nan Ubangiji ya fara aikan Rezin sarkin Aram da Feka ɗan Remaliya, su yi gāba da Yahuda.)
english: In those days, Yahweh began to send Rezin the king of Syria and Pekah the son of Remaliah against Judah.

hausa: Waɗannan su ne suke ƙazantar da mutum; amma cin abinci ba tare da wanke hannuwa ba, ba ya ƙazantar da mutum.”
english: These are the things which defile the man; but to eat with unwashed hands doesn’t defile the man.”

hausa: Akan kuɓutar da mai adalci daga wahala, sai ta dawo wa mugu a maimako.
english: A righteous person is delivered out of trouble, and the wicked takes his place.

hausa: “Ku ratsa cikin sansani, ku gaya wa mutane, ‘Ku shirya guzurinku. Nan da kwana uku za ku ƙetare Urdun a nan, don ku je ka mallaki ƙasar da Ubangiji Allahnku yake ba ku ta zama taku.’ ”
english: “Pass through the middle of the camp, and command the people, saying, ‘Prepare food; for within three days you are to pass over this Jordan, to go in to possess the land which Yahweh your God gives you to possess.’”

hausa: Cikin fushinku kada ku yi zunubi; sa’ad da kuke kan gadajenku, ku bincike zukatanku ku kuma yi shiru. Sela
english: Stand in awe, and don’t sin. Search your own heart on your bed, and be still. Selah.

hausa: Ya rufe sararin sama da gizagizai; yana tanada wa duniya ruwan sama yana kuma sa ciyawa tă yi girma a kan tuddai.
english: who covers the sky with clouds, who prepares rain for the earth, who makes grass grow on the mountains.

hausa: Mutumin da aka warkar kuwa bai ma san ko wane ne ba ne, gama Yesu ya ɓace cikin taron da yake can.
english: But he who was healed didn’t know who it was, for Jesus had withdrawn, a crowd being in the place.

hausa: Duk wanda ya ɓata haikalin Allah, Allah zai ɓata shi, don haikalin Allah mai tsarki ne, ku ne kuwa haikalin nan.
english: If anyone destroys God’s temple, God will destroy him; for God’s temple is holy, which you are.

hausa: Zan sa a hamada ta tsiro da al’ul da itacen ƙirya, da itacen ci-zaƙi, da zaitun. Zan sa itace mai girma a ƙasashe masu sanyi ya tsiro a ƙeƙasasshiyar ƙasa, tare da fir da kuma saifires,
english: I will put cedar, acacia, myrtle, and oil trees in the wilderness. I will set cypress trees, pine, and box trees together in the desert;

hausa: Zuciyar mai hikima takan karkata ga yin abin da yake daidai, amma zuciyar wawa takan karkata ga yin mugun abu.
english: A wise man’s heart is at his right hand, but a fool’s heart at his left.

hausa: Duk da haka, muna sanar da saƙon hikima cikin waɗanda suka balaga, amma ba hikima irin ta wannan zamani ba ne, ko kuwa irin ta masu mulkin zamanin nan, waɗanda za su shuɗe ba.
english: We speak wisdom, however, among those who are full grown, yet a wisdom not of this world nor of the rulers of this world who are coming to nothing.

hausa: Zan yabi Ubangiji dukan kwanakina; zan rera yabo ga Allahna muddin raina.
english: While I live, I will praise Yahweh. I will sing praises to my God as long as I exist.

hausa: Suka haye a mashigin don su ƙetaro da iyalin sarki, su kuma yi duk abin da yake so. Sa’ad da Shimeyi ɗan Gera ya haye Urdun, sai ya fāɗi rubda ciki a gaban sarki
english: A ferry boat went to bring over the king’s household, and to do what he thought good. Shimei the son of Gera fell down before the king when he had come over the Jordan.

hausa: Ya aikata mugunta a gaban Ubangiji ta wurin bin zunuban Yerobowam ɗan Nebat, wanda ya sa Isra’ila ta aikata, bai kuwa guje musu ba.
english: He did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight, and followed the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, with which he made Israel to sin. He didn’t depart from it.

hausa: Sai suka ce wa macen, “Yanzu kam mun gaskata, ba don abin da kika faɗa kawai ba; yanzu mun ji da kanmu, mun kuwa san cewa wannan mutum tabbatacce shi ne Mai Ceton duniya.”
english: They said to the woman, “Now we believe, not because of your speaking; for we have heard for ourselves, and know that this is indeed the Christ, the Savior of the world.”

hausa: Kai ne ka raba teku ta wurin ikonka; ka farfashe kawunan dodo a cikin ruwaye.
english: You divided the sea by your strength. You broke the heads of the sea monsters in the waters.

hausa: Yesu ya ce, “Ku sa mutanen su zauna.” Wurin kuwa akwai ciyawa da sosai, sai maza suka zazzauna, sun kai wajen dubu biyar.
english: Jesus said, “Have the people sit down.” Now there was much grass in that place. So the men sat down, in number about five thousand.

hausa: Gama Yohanna Mai Baftisma ya zo wurinku don yă nuna muku hanyar adalci, ba ku gaskata shi ba, amma masu karɓar haraji da karuwai sun gaskata. Har ma bayan kun ga wannan, ba ku tuba kun gaskata shi ba.”
english: For John came to you in the way of righteousness, and you didn’t believe him; but the tax collectors and the prostitutes believed him. When you saw it, you didn’t even repent afterward, that you might believe him.

hausa: “ ‘Ka shirya sarƙoƙi, domin ƙasar ta cika da alhakin jini, birnin kuma ya cika da rikici.
english: “‘Make chains, for the land is full of bloody crimes, and the city is full of violence.

hausa: wanda yake ƙin mugun mutum amma yakan girmama masu tsoron Ubangiji, yakan cika alkawarinsa ko da ma ya zafe shi,
english: in whose eyes a vile man is despised, but who honors those who fear Yahweh; he who keeps an oath even when it hurts, and doesn’t change;

hausa: Bayan dogon lokaci, a cikin shekara ta uku, maganar Ubangiji ta zo wa Iliya, ta ce, “Tafi, ka gabatar da kanka ga Ahab, zan kuwa aika da ruwan sama a ƙasar.”
english: After many days, Yahweh’s word came to Elijah, in the third year, saying, “Go, show yourself to Ahab; and I will send rain on the earth.”

hausa: kuma gidan Kiriyat Yeyarim su ne, Itrayawa, Futiyawa, Shumatiyawa da Mishratiyawa. Daga waɗannan ne Zoratiyawa da Eshtawoliyawa suka fito.
english: The families of Kiriath Jearim: the Ithrites, the Puthites, the Shumathites, and the Mishraites; from them came the Zorathites and the Eshtaolites.

hausa: Duk gidan da kuka sauka, ku zauna nan sai kun bar garin.
english: Into whatever house you enter, stay there, and depart from there.

hausa: Bitrus ya ce mata, “Ta yaya kuka yarda ku gwada Ruhun Ubangiji? Duba! Sawun mutanen da suka binne mijinki suna bakin ƙofa, za su kuwa ɗauke ki zuwa waje ke ma.”
english: But Peter asked her, “How is it that you have agreed together to tempt the Spirit of the Lord? Behold, the feet of those who have buried your husband are at the door, and they will carry you out.”

hausa: Wanda ya fara mai da jawabi yakan zama kamar shi ne mai gaskiya, sai wani ya fito ya yi masa tambaya tukuna.
english: He who pleads his cause first seems right— until another comes and questions him.

hausa: Sai ɗaya daga cikin hafsoshinsa ya ce, “Babu waninmu, ranka yă daɗe; Elisha, annabin da yake a Isra’ila ne, yake faɗa wa sarkin Isra’ila dukan zancen da ka yi a ɗakinka.”
english: One of his servants said, “No, my lord, O king; but Elisha, the prophet who is in Israel, tells the king of Israel the words that you speak in your bedroom.”

hausa: Sa’an nan mutanen nan biyu, ’yan leƙen asiri suka sauka daga tuddai suka haye kogi zuwa wurin Yoshuwa ɗan Nun, suka gaya masa duk abin da ya faru da su.
english: Then the two men returned, descended from the mountain, crossed the river, and came to Joshua the son of Nun. They told him all that had happened to them.

hausa: Suka ce masa, “Ba gaskiya ba ne, ka dai faɗa mana.” Yehu ya ce, “Ga abin da ya ce mini, ‘Ga abin da Ubangiji ya ce, na naɗa ka sarki a bisa Isra’ila.’ ”
english: They said, “That is a lie. Tell us now.” He said, “He said to me, ‘Yahweh says, I have anointed you king over Israel.’”

hausa: “Wace riba ce a hallakata, a kuma gangarawa ta zuwa cikin rami? Ƙura za tă yabe ka ne? Za tă iya yin shelar amincinka?
english: “What profit is there in my destruction, if I go down to the pit? Shall the dust praise you? Shall it declare your truth?

hausa: Ba wanda ya dawo don yă yabi Allah, sai dai wannan baƙon?”
english: Were there none found who returned to give glory to God, except this foreigner?”

hausa: Sai kowa ya koma garinsa don a rubuta shi.
english: All went to enroll themselves, everyone to his own city.

hausa: Sa’an nan Abram ya tashi ya ci gaba da tafiya zuwa wajen Negeb.
english: Abram traveled, still going on toward the South.

hausa: Na kuma ba da umarni game da abin da za ku yi wa dattawan Yahudawa cikin aikin ginin wannan gidan Allah. Daga asusun sarki a kuɗin da yake shigo wa Kewayen Kogin Yuferites za a biya mutanen nan duka, domin kada aikin yă tsaya.
english: Moreover I make a decree regarding what you shall do for these elders of the Jews for the building of this house of God: that of the king’s goods, even of the tribute beyond the River, expenses must be given with all diligence to these men, that they not be hindered.

hausa: A rana ta bakwai, sa’ad da Sarki Zerzes, ya yi tilis da ruwan inabi, sai ya umarci bābānni bakwai waɗanda suke yin masa hidima, wato, Mehuman, Bizta, Harbona, Bigta, Abagta, Zetar da Karkas,
english: On the seventh day, when the heart of the king was merry with wine, he commanded Mehuman, Biztha, Harbona, Bigtha, and Abagtha, Zethar, and Carcass, the seven eunuchs who served in the presence of Ahasuerus the king,

hausa: In ka ƙi ka bar su su tafi, kana ta riƙonsu,
english: For if you refuse to let them go, and hold them still,

hausa: ko kuma kun taɓa kuɓutar da ni daga hannun maƙiyina, ko kun taɓa ƙwato ni daga hannun marasa kirki’?
english: or, ‘Deliver me from the adversary’s hand’? or, ‘Redeem me from the hand of the oppressors’?

hausa: Yanzu fa, ya Allah na Isra’ila, bari maganarka da ka yi wa bawanka Dawuda mahaifina tă cika.
english: “Now therefore, God of Israel, please let your word be verified, which you spoke to your servant David my father.

hausa: “In ɗayanku yana da tumaki ɗari, sa’an nan ɗayansu ta ɓace. Ashe, ba zai bar tasa’in da tara a fili ya je neman wadda ta ɓace, har sai ya same ta ba?
english: “Which of you men, if you had one hundred sheep and lost one of them, wouldn’t leave the ninety-nine in the wilderness and go after the one that was lost, until he found it?

hausa: Saboda haka ya ba wa ’yan aikan Ben-Hadad amsa, ya ce, “Ku faɗa wa ranka yă daɗe, sarki, ‘Bawanka zai yi dukan abin da ka bukaci da farko, amma wannan na ƙarshe ba zan iya yin ba.’ ” Suka tafi suka kai amsar wa Ben-Hadad.
english: Therefore he said to the messengers of Ben Hadad, “Tell my lord the king, ‘All that you sent for to your servant at the first I will do, but this thing I cannot do.’” The messengers departed and brought him back the message.

hausa: Yanzu ku rubuta wata doka, a sunan sarki, a madadin Yahudawa, yadda kuka ga ya fi kyau ku kuma hatimce ta da zoben hatimin sarki, gama babu takardar da aka rubuta da sunan sarki, aka kuma hatimce da zobensa da za a iya sokewa.”
english: Write also to the Jews as it pleases you, in the king’s name, and seal it with the king’s ring; for the writing which is written in the king’s name, and sealed with the king’s ring, may not be reversed by any man.”

hausa: A shekara ta goma sha ɗaya, a wata na uku a rana ta farko, maganar Ubangiji ta zo mini cewa,
english: In the eleventh year, in the third month, in the first day of the month, Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

hausa: Ka tuna da yadda abokin gāba ya yi maka ba’a, ya Ubangiji, yadda wawaye suka ɓata sunanka.
english: Remember this, that the enemy has mocked you, Yahweh. Foolish people have blasphemed your name.

hausa: Ka san dokokin da suka ce, ‘Kada ka yi kisankai, kada ka yi zina, kada ka yi sata, kada ka ba da shaida ta ƙarya, kada ka cuci wani, ka girmama mahaifinka da mahaifiyarka.’”
english: You know the commandments: ‘Do not murder,’ ‘Do not commit adultery,’ ‘Do not steal,’ ‘Do not give false testimony,’ ‘Do not defraud,’ ‘Honor your father and mother.’”

hausa: Solomon ya bar dukan waɗannan abubuwa ba tare da an auna su ba, domin sun yi yawa sosai; ba a san nauyin tagullar ba.
english: Solomon left all the vessels unweighed, because there were so many of them. The weight of the bronze could not be determined.

hausa: Mahaya dawakai sun kunno kai, takuba suna walƙiya, māsu kuma suna ƙyali; ga ɗumbun da aka kashe ga tsibin matattu, gawawwaki ba iyaka, mutane suna tuntuɓe da gawawwaki,
english: the horseman charging, and the flashing sword, the glittering spear, and a multitude of slain, and a great heap of corpses, and there is no end of the bodies. They stumble on their bodies

hausa: Me kuma ya rage da za a yi wa gonar inabina fiye da abin da na yi mata? Da na nemi inabi masu kyau, me ya sa ta ba da munana ’ya’ya?
english: What could have been done more to my vineyard, that I have not done in it? Why, when I looked for it to yield grapes, did it yield wild grapes?

hausa: To, in haka ne, ai, da ka sa kuɗina a banki, don sa’ad da na dawo da na karɓi abina da riba.
english: You ought therefore to have deposited my money with the bankers, and at my coming I should have received back my own with interest.

hausa: Ba wanda ya dube ki da tausayi ko ya nuna miki isashen jinƙai don yă yi miki ɗaya daga cikin waɗannan abubuwa. A maimako, sai aka jefar da ke a fili, gama a ranar da aka haife ki an ji ƙyamarki.
english: No eye pitied you, to do any of these things to you, to have compassion on you; but you were cast out in the open field, because you were abhorred in the day that you were born.

hausa: ’Ya’yan Oholibama maza matar Isuwa, Shugabannin su ne; Yewush, Yalam da Kora. Waɗannan su ne manya da suka fito daga dangin Oholibama ’yar Ana matar Isuwa.
english: These are the sons of Oholibamah, Esau’s wife: chief Jeush, chief Jalam, chief Korah. These are the chiefs who came of Oholibamah the daughter of Anah, Esau’s wife.

hausa: Amma mutanen suka ce, “Ba za ka fita ba; gama in ya kasance tilas mu gudu, ba za su kula da mu ba. Ko da rabinmu sun mutu, ba za su damu ba; amma kai kanka ka fi mutum dubu goma namu. Zai fi maka ka zauna a cikin gari, ka dinga aika mana da taimako.”
english: But the people said, “You shall not go out, for if we flee away, they will not care for us, neither if half of us die, will they care for us. But you are worth ten thousand of us. Therefore now it is better that you are ready to help us out of the city.”

hausa: Ka yi wa’azin Maganar Allah, ka zama a shirye a kullum, ko da zarafi, ko babu zarafi, ka yi gyara, ka kwaɓe, ka kuma ƙarfafa, da matuƙar haƙuri da koyarwa cikin natsuwa.
english: preach the word; be urgent in season and out of season; reprove, rebuke, and exhort with all patience and teaching.

hausa: Hadoram, Uzal, Dikla,
english: Hadoram, Uzal, Diklah,

hausa: bari hannuna yă guntule daga kafaɗata, bari yă tsinke daga inda aka haɗa shi.
english: then let my shoulder fall from the shoulder blade, and my arm be broken from the bone.

hausa: Sai mala’ikan Allah wanda yake tafiya a gaban sojojin Isra’ila, ya janye, ya koma bayansu. Al’amudin girgije shi ma ya koma, ya tsaya a bayansu,
english: The angel of God, who went before the camp of Israel, moved and went behind them; and the pillar of cloud moved from before them, and stood behind them.

hausa: Dawuda kuwa ya ƙara ƙarfi, domin Ubangiji Maɗaukaki yana tare da shi.
english: David grew greater and greater, for Yahweh of Armies was with him.

hausa: Waɗanda suka fāɗi a kan hanya su ne mutanen da suka ji, amma Iblis, yakan zo ya ɗauke maganar daga zuciyarsu, don kada su gaskata, su sami ceto.
english: Those along the road are those who hear; then the devil comes and takes away the word from their heart, that they may not believe and be saved.

hausa: Saboda haka zan yi kuka a kan Mowab gama dukan Mowab zan yi kuka, Zan yi gurnani don mutanen Kir Hareset.
english: Therefore I will wail for Moab. Yes, I will cry out for all Moab. They will mourn for the men of Kir Heres.

hausa: Dukan mazaunan bakin teku sun giggice saboda masifarki; sarakunansu sun tsorata ƙwarai fuskokinsu kuwa sun yamutse don tsoro.
english: All the inhabitants of the islands are astonished at you, and their kings are horribly afraid. They are troubled in their face.

hausa: Mattaniya, Mattenai da Ya’asu.
english: Mattaniah, Mattenai, Jaasu,

hausa: Tana rena duk masu girman kai. Ita take mulki kan duk masu girman kai.”
english: He sees everything that is high. He is king over all the sons of pride.”

hausa: A ranar da Ubangiji ya ba da Amoriyawa a hannun Isra’ilawa, Yoshuwa ya ce wa Ubangiji a gaban Isra’ilawa, “Ke rana, ki tsaya cik a Gibeyon Kai wata, ka je Kwarin Aiyalon.”
english: Then Joshua spoke to Yahweh in the day when Yahweh delivered up the Amorites before the children of Israel. He said in the sight of Israel, “Sun, stand still on Gibeon! You, moon, stop in the valley of Aijalon!”

hausa: Zan kore ku daga gabana, kamar yadda na yi ga dukan ’yan’uwanku, mutanen Efraim.’
english: I will cast you out of my sight, as I have cast out all your brothers, even the whole offspring of Ephraim.

hausa: Biye da shi, ’yan’uwansu Lawiyawa ne a ƙarƙashin Binnuyi ɗan Henadad, mai mulkin ɗayan rabin yankin Keyila suka yi gyare-gyaren.
english: After him, their brothers, Bavvai the son of Henadad, the ruler of half the district of Keilah made repairs.

hausa: Saboda haka ’yan’uwana, ku da nake ƙauna, nake kuma marmarin ganinku, ku da kuke farin cikina da kuma rawanina, ku dāge ga Ubangiji, ya ku ƙaunatattuna!
english: Therefore, my brothers, beloved and longed for, my joy and crown, stand firm in the Lord in this way, my beloved.

hausa: Sai almajiran Yohanna suka zo suka tambaye shi suka ce, “Me ya sa mu da Farisiyawa muke azumi, amma almajiranka ba sa yi?”
english: Then John’s disciples came to him, saying, “Why do we and the Pharisees fast often, but your disciples don’t fast?”

hausa: Sai suka hau shi da zagi suna cewa, “Kai ne dai almajirin mutumin! Mu almajiran Musa ne!
english: They insulted him and said, “You are his disciple, but we are disciples of Moses.

hausa: Daga zuriyar Bani, akwai Meshullam, Malluk, Adahiya, Yashub, Sheyal, da Ramot.
english: Of the sons of Bani: Meshullam, Malluch, Adaiah, Jashub, Sheal, and Jeremoth.

hausa: “Saboda haka, ka rubuta abin da ka gani, abin da yake yanzu, da abin da zai faru nan gaba.
english: Write therefore the things which you have seen, and the things which are, and the things which will happen hereafter.

hausa: Cikin azabata na yi kuka ga Ubangiji, ya kuwa amsa ta wurin ’yantar da ni.
english: Out of my distress, I called on Yah. Yah answered me with freedom.

hausa: wanda ya saba wa umarnina, har ya yi sujada ga waɗansu alloli, yana rusuna musu, ko ga rana, ko ga wata, ko kuwa ga taurarin sama,
english: and has gone and served other gods and worshiped them, or the sun, or the moon, or any of the stars of the sky, which I have not commanded,

hausa: Suka sa shi a gidan tsaro sai lokacin da nufin Ubangiji ya nuna musu abin da za su yi da shi.
english: They put him in custody until Yahweh’s will should be declared to them.

hausa: Ku yabi Allah cikin taro mai girma; yabi Ubangiji cikin taron Isra’ila.
english: “Bless God in the congregations, even the Lord in the assembly of Israel!”

hausa: Wata rana sa’ad da suka gama ci da sha a Shilo, Hannatu ta miƙe tsaye. Eli firist kuwa yana zaune a kujera a bakin ƙofar haikalin Ubangiji.
english: So Hannah rose up after they had finished eating and drinking in Shiloh. Now Eli the priest was sitting on his seat by the doorpost of Yahweh’s temple.

hausa: ga Wannan wanda yake ba wa sarakuna nasara, wanda ya cece bawansa Dawuda. Daga takobin kisa.
english: You are he who gives salvation to kings, who rescues David, his servant, from the deadly sword.

hausa: Amma da lokacin tashinmu ya yi, sai muka tashi muka ci gaba da tafiyarmu. Dukan almajirai da matansu da ’ya’yansu suka raka mu har bayan birni, a can kuwa a bakin teku muka durƙusa muka yi addu’a.
english: When those days were over, we departed and went on our journey. They all, with wives and children, brought us on our way until we were out of the city. Kneeling down on the beach, we prayed.

hausa: Bari koyarwata tă zubo kamar ruwan sama kalmomina kuma su sauko kamar raɓa, kamar yayyafi a kan sabuwar ciyawa, kamar ruwan sama mai yawa a kan tsirai marasa ƙarfi.
english: My doctrine will drop as the rain. My speech will condense as the dew, as the misty rain on the tender grass, as the showers on the herb.

hausa: Dukan rigunanka suna ƙanshin turaren mur da na aloyes, da na kashiya; daga kowace fadan da aka yi masa ado da hauren giwa kaɗe-kaɗen tsirkiya kan sa ka murna.
english: All your garments smell like myrrh, aloes, and cassia. Out of ivory palaces stringed instruments have made you glad.

hausa: Ba ta yarda cewa ni ne wanda ya ba ta hatsi, sabon ruwan inabi da mai ba, wanda ya jibge mata azurfa da zinariya, waɗanda suka yi amfani wa Ba’al ba.
english: For she didn’t know that I gave her the grain, the new wine, and the oil, and multiplied to her silver and gold, which they used for Baal.

hausa: A wannan sa’a na daren, mai gadin kurkukun ya ɗauke su ya wanke musu raunukansu; nan take aka yi masa baftisma da dukan iyalinsa.
english: He took them the same hour of the night and washed their stripes, and was immediately baptized, he and all his household.

hausa: Masu albarka ne waɗanda suka koyi yin maka kirari waɗanda suke tafiya cikin hasken da yake gabanka, Ubangiji.
english: Blessed are the people who learn to acclaim you. They walk in the light of your presence, Yahweh.

hausa: Karin maganar Solomon ɗan Dawuda, sarkin Isra’ila.
english: The proverbs of Solomon, the son of David, king of Israel:

hausa: Amma suka yi ihu suka ce, “A yi da shi! A yi da shi! A gicciye shi!” Bilatus ya ce, “A! In gicciye sarkinku?” Sai manyan firistoci suka amsa suka ce, “Mu dai, ba mu da wani sarki sai Kaisar.”
english: They cried out, “Away with him! Away with him! Crucify him!” Pilate said to them, “Shall I crucify your King?” The chief priests answered, “We have no king but Caesar!”

hausa: “Mulkin sama yana kama da dukiyar da aka ɓoye a gona. Da wani ya same ta, sai yă sāke ɓoye ta, sa’an nan cikin farin cikinsa yă je yă sayar da duk abin da yake da shi yă sayi gonar.
english: “Again, the Kingdom of Heaven is like treasure hidden in the field, which a man found and hid. In his joy, he goes and sells all that he has and buys that field.

hausa: Bari mutunci da adalci su tsare ni, domin begena yana a kanka.
english: Let integrity and uprightness preserve me, for I wait for you.

hausa: Shugabannin mutanen Gileyad suka cewa juna, “Duk wanda zai fara fāɗa wa Ammonawa shi zai zama shugaban duk waɗanda suke zama a Gileyad.”
english: The people, the princes of Gilead, said to one another, “Who is the man who will begin to fight against the children of Ammon? He shall be head over all the inhabitants of Gilead.”

hausa: Saboda haka zuciyata ta fara karaya a kan dukan faman aikina a duniya.
english: Therefore I began to cause my heart to despair concerning all the labor in which I had labored under the sun.

hausa: Wace al’umma ce mai girma haka wadda take da ƙa’idodi da dokoki masu adalci kamar waɗannan ƙunshin dokokin da nake sa a gabanku a yau?
english: What great nation is there that has statutes and ordinances so righteous as all this law which I set before you today?

hausa: Ka yi alheri, ya Ubangiji, ga waɗanda suke nagartattu, ga waɗanda suke masu aikata gaskiya a zuciyarsu.
english: Do good, Yahweh, to those who are good, to those who are upright in their hearts.

hausa: zuwa Kiriyatayim, Bet-Gamul da Bet-Meyon,
english: on Kiriathaim, on Beth Gamul, on Beth Meon,

hausa: Ka dubi wahalata da kuma azabata ka ɗauke mini dukan zunubaina.
english: Consider my affliction and my travail. Forgive all my sins.

hausa: Sai Shawulu ya ce, “Kai ɗan wane ne, saurayi?” Dawuda ya ce, “Ni ɗan bawanka Yesse ne, na Betlehem.”
english: Saul said to him, “Whose son are you, you young man?” David answered, “I am the son of your servant Jesse the Bethlehemite.”

hausa: Sa’an nan Yotam ya gudu, ya tsere zuwa Beyer ya zauna a can gama yana tsoron ɗan’uwansa Abimelek.
english: Jotham ran away and fled, and went to Beer and lived there, for fear of Abimelech his brother.

hausa: Dukan mutanen ƙasar za su yi wannan bayarwa ta musamman saboda amfanin sarki a Isra’ila.
english: “All the people of the land shall give to this offering for the prince in Israel.

hausa: “In na dogara ga zinariya ko kuma na ce wa zallan zinariya, ‘Gare ki nake dogara,’
english: “If I have made gold my hope, and have said to the fine gold, ‘You are my confidence;’

hausa: Saboda haka suka kama Irmiya suka sa a rijiyar da ba ruwa a ciki ta Malkiya, ɗan sarki, wadda take a sansanin matsara. Suka saukar da Irmiya cikin rijiyar da ba ruwa da igiya; babu ruwa a cikinta, sai laka, Irmiya ya nutse cikin laka.
english: Then they took Jeremiah and threw him into the dungeon of Malchijah the king’s son, that was in the court of the guard. They let down Jeremiah with cords. In the dungeon there was no water, but mire; and Jeremiah sank in the mire.

hausa: “Masu adalci suna gani ana hallaka mugaye, suna jin daɗi; marasa laifi suna yi musu ba’a, suna cewa,
english: The righteous see it, and are glad. The innocent ridicule them,

hausa: “Kaitonku, Farisiyawa, domin kun cika son wuraren zama masu daraja a majami’u, da kuma yawan gaisuwa a wuraren kasuwanci.
english: Woe to you Pharisees! For you love the best seats in the synagogues and the greetings in the marketplaces.

hausa: Mutumin ya gaya wa Eli cewa, “Shigowata ke nan daga bakin dāgā. Na kuɓuce daga can yau ɗin nan.” Eli ya ce, “Me ya faru da ’ya’yana?”
english: The man said to Eli, “I am he who came out of the army, and I fled today out of the army.” He said, “How did the matter go, my son?”

hausa: Wa zai iya buɗe ƙofofin bakinta? Haƙoranta ma abin tsoro ne?
english: Who can open the doors of his face? Around his teeth is terror.

hausa: Bari Allah yă yi duk abin da ya ga dama da ni in na bar ko ɗaya daga mazan da suke da tare shi, gobe da safe.”
english: God do so to the enemies of David, and more also, if I leave of all that belongs to him by the morning light so much as one who urinates on a wall.”

hausa: da yake kuma muna da babban firist mai mulkin gidan Allah,
english: and having a great priest over God’s house,

hausa: Ka nuna mana ƙaunarka marar ƙarewa, ya Ubangiji, ka kuma ba mu cetonka.
english: Show us your loving kindness, Yahweh. Grant us your salvation.

hausa: Ko da yake suna azumi, ba zan saurari kukansu ba, ko da yake suna miƙa hadayun ƙonawa da hadayun gari, ba zan yarda da su ba. A maimako zan hallaka su da takobi, yunwa da annoba.”
english: When they fast, I will not hear their cry; and when they offer burnt offering and meal offering, I will not accept them; but I will consume them by the sword, by famine, and by pestilence.”

hausa: Sa’ad da aka faɗa wa Tamar cewa, “Surukinki yana kan hanyarsa zuwa Timna don askin tumakinsa,”
english: Tamar was told, “Behold, your father-in-law is going up to Timnah to shear his sheep.”

hausa: Kuna fariya cewa, “Mun yi alkawari da mutuwa, mun kuma yi yarjejjeniya da kabari. Sa’ad da zafi ya ratsa, ba zai taɓa mu ba, gama mun mai da ƙarya mafakarmu ruɗu kuma wurin ɓuyanmu.”
english: “Because you have said, ‘We have made a covenant with death, and we are in agreement with Sheol. When the overflowing scourge passes through, it won’t come to us; for we have made lies our refuge, and we have hidden ourselves under falsehood.’”

hausa: “Ka rarraba musu ƙasar a matsayin gādo, bisa ga yawan kabila.
english: “To these the land shall be divided for an inheritance according to the number of names.

hausa: Ku yi hankali kada ku riƙe wannan mugun tunani cewa, “Shekara ta bakwai, shekarar yafewar basusuwa, ta yi kusa,” har ku nuna mugun nufi ga ɗan’uwa mabukaci, ku ƙi ba shi wani abu. Zai yi kuka ga Ubangiji a kanku, abin kuwa zai zama laifi a kanku.
english: Beware that there not be a wicked thought in your heart, saying, “The seventh year, the year of release, is at hand,” and your eye be evil against your poor brother and you give him nothing; and he cry to Yahweh against you, and it be sin to you.

hausa: Da wata mace wadda ta yi rayuwar zunubi a wannan gari ta ji Yesu yana cin abinci a gidan Bafarisiyen, sai ta kawo ɗan tulun turaren alabasta,
english: Behold, a woman in the city who was a sinner, when she knew that he was reclining in the Pharisee’s house, brought an alabaster jar of ointment.

hausa: Sai Musa ya rubuta wannan waƙa a wannan rana, ya kuma koya wa Isra’ilawa.
english: So Moses wrote this song the same day, and taught it to the children of Israel.

hausa: “ ‘Akwai kwanaki shida da za ku iya yin aiki, amma rana ta bakwai, Asabbaci ne na hutu, rana mai tsarki ga jama’a. Kada ku yi wani aiki a ko’ina kuke da zama, Asabbaci ne ga Ubangiji.
english: “‘Six days shall work be done, but on the seventh day is a Sabbath of solemn rest, a holy convocation; you shall do no kind of work. It is a Sabbath to Yahweh in all your dwellings.

hausa: Don haka na ƙi jinin rayuwa, gama aikin da ake yi a duniya yana ɓata mini rai. Dukan abin da yake cikinta kuwa ba shi da amfani, naushin iska ne kawai.
english: So I hated life, because the work that is worked under the sun was grievous to me; for all is vanity and a chasing after wind.

hausa: Sai Musa da firistoci waɗanda suke Lawiyawa suka ce wa dukan Isra’ila, “Ku yi shiru, ya Isra’ila, ku saurara! Yanzu kun zama mutanen Ubangiji Allahnku.
english: Moses and the Levitical priests spoke to all Israel, saying, “Be silent and listen, Israel! Today you have become the people of Yahweh your God.

hausa: “Naftali sakakkiyar barewa ce da take haihuwar kyawawan ’ya’ya.
english: “Naphtali is a doe set free, who bears beautiful fawns.

hausa: Amma mutumin ya ce wa Yowab, “Ko da za a auna mini azurfa dubu a hannuna, ba zan miƙa hannuna in taɓa ɗan sarki ba. A kunnuwanmu fa sarki ya umarce ka, da Abishai, da Ittai cewa, ‘Ku tsare saurayin nan Absalom a madadina.’
english: The man said to Joab, “Though I should receive a thousand pieces of silver in my hand, I still wouldn’t stretch out my hand against the king’s son; for in our hearing the king commanded you and Abishai and Ittai, saying, ‘Beware that no one touch the young man Absalom.’

hausa: Ko ma sa’ad da abin shansu ya ƙare, sai suka ci gaba da karuwancinsu; masu mulkinsu suna ƙaunar abin kunya.
english: Their drink has become sour. They play the prostitute continually. Her rulers dearly love their shameful way.

hausa: Lamek ya auri mata biyu, ana ce da ɗaya Ada, ɗayan kuma Zilla.
english: Lamech took two wives: the name of the first one was Adah, and the name of the second one was Zillah.

hausa: Bayan an kwashe su zuwa bauta a Babilon. Yekoniya ya haifi Sheyaltiyel, Sheyaltiyel ya haifi Zerubbabel,
english: After the exile to Babylon, Jechoniah became the father of Shealtiel. Shealtiel became the father of Zerubbabel.

hausa: Manyan ayarin raƙuma za su cika ƙasar, ƙananan raƙuma ke nan daga Midiyan da Efa. Daga Sheba kuma duka za su zo, suna ɗauke da zinariya da turare suna shelar yabon Ubangiji.
english: A multitude of camels will cover you, the dromedaries of Midian and Ephah. All from Sheba will come. They will bring gold and frankincense, and will proclaim the praises of Yahweh.

hausa: Ba za su ci gaba da zama a ƙasar Ubangiji ba; Efraim zai koma Masar yă kuma ci abinci marar tsarki a Assuriya.
english: They won’t dwell in Yahweh’s land; but Ephraim will return to Egypt, and they will eat unclean food in Assyria.

hausa: Cikin kome da ya yi cikin hidimar haikalin Allah, cikin biyayya kuma ga doka da umarnai, ya nemi Allahnsa, ya kuma yi aiki gabagadi. Ta haka kuwa ya yi nasara.
english: In every work that he began in the service of God’s house, in the law, and in the commandments, to seek his God, he did it with all his heart and prospered.

hausa: Sai Yesu ya zo daga Galili, ya je Urdun don Yohanna yă yi masa baftisma.
english: Then Jesus came from Galilee to the Jordan to John, to be baptized by him.

hausa: Kalmomin bakin mutum suna da zurfi kamar ruwaye, amma maɓulɓulan hikima rafi ne mai gudu.
english: The words of a man’s mouth are like deep waters. The fountain of wisdom is like a flowing brook.

hausa: Sai Ubangiji ya yi magana da Sama’ila ya ce,
english: Then Yahweh’s word came to Samuel, saying,

hausa: Muna aiki da gaske da hannuwanmu. In aka la’anta mu, mukan sa albarka. In aka tsananta mana, mukan jimre;
english: We toil, working with our own hands. When people curse us, we bless. Being persecuted, we endure.

hausa: Sa’ad da kuke shuki, ba tsiron da zai yi girma ba ne kuka shuka, ƙwayar ce kawai, ko ta alkama ko kuma na wani irin dabam.
english: That which you sow, you don’t sow the body that will be, but a bare grain, maybe of wheat, or of some other kind.

hausa: Suka yi aure cikin kabilar zuriyar Manasse ɗan Yusuf, gādonsu kuwa ya kasance a cikin iyali da kuma kabilar mahaifinsu.
english: They were married into the families of the sons of Manasseh the son of Joseph. Their inheritance remained in the tribe of the family of their father.

hausa: Akwai hanyar da ta yi kamar tana daidai ga mutum, amma a ƙarshe takan kai ga mutuwa.
english: There is a way which seems right to a man, but in the end it leads to death.

hausa: Kada ka yi hanzarin tashi daga gaban sarki. Kada ka kāre abin da ba daidai ba, gama zai iya yin duk abin da ya ga dama.
english: Don’t be hasty to go out of his presence. Don’t persist in an evil thing, for he does whatever pleases him,

hausa: Bilatus ya tambaye shi ya ce, “Mece ce gaskiya?” Da ya faɗi haka, sai ya sāke fitowa wurin Yahudawa ya ce, “Ni fa ban sami wani abin zargi game da shi ba.
english: Pilate said to him, “What is truth?” When he had said this, he went out again to the Jews, and said to them, “I find no basis for a charge against him.

hausa: Maimakon haka, ku yi wa Ubangiji Allahnku sujada; shi ne zai cece ku daga hannun abokan gābanku.”
english: But you shall fear Yahweh your God, and he will deliver you out of the hand of all your enemies.”

hausa: Sai mutumin Allah ya koma tare da shi ya kuma ci ya sha a gidansa.
english: So he went back with him, ate bread in his house, and drank water.

hausa: Bayan ’yan kwanaki, da Yesu ya sāke shiga Kafarnahum, sai mutane suka ji labarin zuwansa gida.
english: When he entered again into Capernaum after some days, it was heard that he was at home.

hausa: Sai ruhun ya yi ihu, ya buge shi da ƙarfi da farfaɗiya, ya fita. Yaron ya kwanta kamar matacce, har mutane da yawa suka ce, “Ai, ya mutu.”
english: After crying out and convulsing him greatly, it came out of him. The boy became like one dead, so much that most of them said, “He is dead.”

hausa: Jerin gwanonka ya zo a bayyane, ya Allah, jerin gwanon Allahna da Sarkina zuwa cikin wuri mai tsarki.
english: They have seen your processions, God, even the processions of my God, my King, into the sanctuary.

hausa: Saboda haka maganar Allah ta yaɗu. Yawan almajirai a Urushalima kuwa ya yi saurin ƙaruwa, firistoci masu yawa kuma suka zama masu biyayya ga wannan bangaskiya.
english: The word of God increased and the number of the disciples greatly multiplied in Jerusalem. A great company of the priests were obedient to the faith.

hausa: Dawuda ya ruga ya tsaya a bisan Bafilistin, ya zare takobin Bafilistin daga kubensa, ya datse masa kai da shi. Da Filistiyawa suka ga jaruminsu ya mutu, sai suka juya suka gudu.
english: Then David ran, stood over the Philistine, took his sword, drew it out of its sheath, killed him, and cut off his head with it. When the Philistines saw that their champion was dead, they fled.

hausa: Da Yesu ya gan ta, sai ya kirata gaba, ya ce mata, “Mace, an ’yantar da ke daga rashin lafiyarki.”
english: When Jesus saw her, he called her and said to her, “Woman, you are freed from your infirmity.”

hausa: Nauyin zinariyar da Solomon yake karɓa shekara-shekara talenti 666 ne,
english: Now the weight of gold that came to Solomon in one year was six hundred sixty-six talents of gold,

hausa: Kamar yadda ƙofa kan juya a ƙyaurensa, haka rago yake jujjuya a gadonsa.
english: As the door turns on its hinges, so does the sluggard on his bed.

hausa: “Kafin in gama addu’ar, a zuciyata, sai ga Rebeka ta fito da tulunta a kafaɗarta. Ta gangara zuwa rijiyar ta ɗebo ruwa, na kuma ce mata, ‘Ina roƙonki ki ba ni ɗan ruwa daga tulunki.’
english: Before I had finished speaking in my heart, behold, Rebekah came out with her pitcher on her shoulder. She went down to the spring, and drew. I said to her, ‘Please let me drink.’

hausa: Isra’ila ya yi gaba, ya kafa tentinsa gaba da Migdal Eder.
english: Israel traveled, and spread his tent beyond the tower of Eder.

hausa: Yusuf daga Arimateya, wani sanannen ɗan Majalisa, wanda dā ma yake jiran zuwan mulkin Allah, ya je wajen Bilatus ba tsoro, ya roƙa a ba shi jikin Yesu.
english: Joseph of Arimathaea, a prominent council member who also himself was looking for God’s Kingdom, came. He boldly went in to Pilate, and asked for Jesus’ body.

hausa: Ubangiji kuma zai bugi Isra’ila, har tă zama kamar kyauro mai girgiza a bakin rafi. Zai tumɓuke Isra’ila daga wannan ƙasa mai kyau da ya ba wa kakanninsu, yă watsar da su gaba da Kogin Yuferites domin sun tsokane Ubangiji har ya yi fushi, ta wurin yin ginshiƙan Ashera.
english: For Yahweh will strike Israel, as a reed is shaken in the water; and he will root up Israel out of this good land which he gave to their fathers, and will scatter them beyond the River, because they have made their Asherah poles, provoking Yahweh to anger.

hausa: “Ga abin da Ubangiji Maɗaukaki ya ce, ‘Ku yi shari’ar gaskiya; ku nuna jinƙai da tausayi ga juna.
english: “Thus has Yahweh of Armies spoken, saying, ‘Execute true judgment, and show kindness and compassion every man to his brother.

hausa: A ƙarshen kowace shekara ta bakwai, dole ku yafe basusuwan da kuke bi.
english: At the end of every seven years, you shall cancel debts.

hausa: Yosiya ya yi Bikin Ƙetarewa ga Ubangiji a Urushalima, aka kuma yanka ɗan ragon Bikin Ƙetarewa a ranar goma sha huɗu ga wata na farko.
english: Josiah kept a Passover to Yahweh in Jerusalem. They killed the Passover on the fourteenth day of the first month.

hausa: “Ni kaɗai ne na shafe laifofinku, saboda sunana, ban kuma ƙara tunawa da zunubanku ba.
english: I, even I, am he who blots out your transgressions for my own sake; and I will not remember your sins.

hausa: Hanyar wawa daidai take a gare shi, amma mai hikima kan saurari shawara.
english: The way of a fool is right in his own eyes, but he who is wise listens to counsel.

hausa: An yi wani annabin da kakanninku ba su tsananta wa ba? Sun ma kashe waɗanda suka yi maganar zuwan Mai Adalcin nan. Yanzu kuwa kun bashe shi kuka kuma kashe shi
english: Which of the prophets didn’t your fathers persecute? They killed those who foretold the coming of the Righteous One, of whom you have now become betrayers and murderers.

hausa: Saboda haka, Farisiyawa da malaman dokoki suka tambayi Yesu, suka ce, “Don me almajiranka ba sa bin al’adun dattawa, a maimakon haka suna cin abinci da hannuwa marasa tsabta?”
english: The Pharisees and the scribes asked him, “Why don’t your disciples walk according to the tradition of the elders, but eat their bread with unwashed hands?”

hausa: “ ‘Firist zai rubuta waɗannan la’anoni a littafi, sa’an nan yă wanke su cikin ruwa mai ɗaci.
english: “‘The priest shall write these curses in a book, and he shall wipe them into the water of bitterness.

hausa: don tsara na biye su san su, har da ’ya’yan da ba a riga an haifa ba, su kuma su faɗa wa ’ya’yansu.
english: that the generation to come might know, even the children who should be born; who should arise and tell their children,

hausa: Ya ce musu, “Wannan shi ne abin da aka rubuta, cewa dole Kiristi yă sha wahala, a rana ta uku kuma yă tashi daga matattu.
english: He said to them, “Thus it is written, and thus it was necessary for the Christ to suffer and to rise from the dead the third day,

hausa: Sarki ya ce, “A’a ɗana, bai kamata dukanmu mu tafi ba; don kada nauyi yă yi maka yawa.” Absalom dai ya dāge, duk da haka sarki ya ƙi yă je, sai dai ya albarkace shi.
english: The king said to Absalom, “No, my son, let’s not all go, lest we be burdensome to you.” He pressed him; however he would not go, but blessed him.

hausa: Jin tsoron Ubangiji shi ne ƙin mugunta; ina ƙin girman kai da fariya, halin mugunta da kuma muguwar magana.
english: The fear of Yahweh is to hate evil. I hate pride, arrogance, the evil way, and the perverse mouth.

hausa: Bulus ya so ya ɗauke shi a tafiyar, saboda haka ya yi masa kaciya, domin Yahudawan da suke da zama a wurin, don duk sun san cewa mahaifinsa mutumin Hellenawa ne.
english: Paul wanted to have him go out with him, and he took and circumcised him because of the Jews who were in those parts, for they all knew that his father was a Greek.

hausa: Dukan waɗannan su ne kabilu goma sha biyu na Isra’ila, kuma abin da mahaifinsu ya faɗa musu ke nan sa’ad da ya albarkace su, yana ba kowane albarkar da ta dace da shi.
english: All these are the twelve tribes of Israel, and this is what their father spoke to them, and blessed them. He blessed everyone according to his own blessing.

hausa: Za su ci hadaya ta gari, hadaya don zunubi da hadaya don laifi; da kuma kowane keɓaɓɓen abu a Isra’ila da za a ba wa Ubangiji zai zama nasu.
english: They shall eat the meal offering, and the sin offering, and the trespass offering; and every devoted thing in Israel shall be theirs.

hausa: “Mamaki ya kama su kuma ba su da abin cewa; kalmomi sun kāsa musu.
english: “They are amazed. They answer no more. They don’t have a word to say.

hausa: ‘Ki farka, ki farka, Debora! Ki farka, ki farka, ki tā da waƙa! Ka farka, ya Barak! Ka ta sa kamammunka gaba, ya ɗan Abinowam.’
english: ‘Awake, awake, Deborah! Awake, awake, utter a song! Arise, Barak, and lead away your captives, you son of Abinoam.’

hausa: Zan rera waƙa wa ƙaunataccena waƙa game da gonar inabinsa. Ƙaunataccena yana da gonar inabi a gefen tudu mai dausayi.
english: Let me sing for my well beloved a song of my beloved about his vineyard. My beloved had a vineyard on a very fruitful hill.

hausa: Saboda haka suka warwatse domin babu makiyayi, kuma da suka warwatsu sai suka zama abincin namun jeji.
english: They were scattered, because there was no shepherd. They became food to all the animals of the field, and were scattered.

hausa: Biye da shi, Hananiya ɗan Shelemiya, da Hanun, ɗa na shida na Zalaf, suka gyara wani sashe. Biye da su, Meshullam ɗan Berekiya ya yi gyare-gyaren ɗaura da wurin zamansa.
english: After him, Hananiah the son of Shelemiah, and Hanun, the sixth son of Zalaph, repaired another portion. After him, Meshullam the son of Berechiah made repairs across from his room.

hausa: Mafi girma a cikinku, zai zama bawanku.
english: But he who is greatest among you will be your servant.

hausa: Ƙasarsu da wuraren zamansu sun haɗa da Betel da ƙauyukan kewayenta, Na’aran wajen gabas, Gezer da ƙauyukanta wajen yamma, da kuma Shekem da ƙauyukan da suka nausa har zuwa Aiya da ƙauyukanta.
english: Their possessions and settlements were Bethel and its towns, and eastward Naaran, and westward Gezer with its towns; Shechem also and its towns, to Azzah and its towns;

hausa: “Keɓaɓɓun tufafin nan na Haruna za su zama na zuriyarsa bayan mutuwarsa. Da tufafin nan ne za a zuba musu mai, a keɓe su.
english: “The holy garments of Aaron shall be for his sons after him, to be anointed in them, and to be consecrated in them.

hausa: Sai Elisha ya ce, “Muddin Ubangiji Maɗaukaki yana a raye, wanda nake bauta, da ba don ina ganin girman Yehoshafat Sarkin Yahuda ba, da ko kallonka ba zan yi ba.
english: Elisha said, “As Yahweh of Armies lives, before whom I stand, surely, were it not that I respect the presence of Jehoshaphat the king of Judah, I would not look toward you, nor see you.

hausa: Za su washe dukiyarki, kayan cinikinki kuma su zama ganima; za su rurrushe katangarki su ragargaza gidajenki masu kyau su kuma zubar da duwatsunki, katakanki da kuma tarkacenki a cikin teku.
english: They will make a plunder of your riches and make a prey of your merchandise. They will break down your walls and destroy your pleasant houses. They will lay your stones, your timber, and your dust in the middle of the waters.

hausa: Ubangiji zai buge ku da hauka, makanta, da rikicewar hankali.
english: Yahweh will strike you with madness, with blindness, and with astonishment of heart.

hausa: In na haura zuwa sammai, kana a can; in na yi gado a zurfafa, kana a can.
english: If I ascend up into heaven, you are there. If I make my bed in Sheol, behold, you are there!

hausa: Waɗannan mutane ba su bugu ba, kamar yadda kuka ɗauka. Yanzu ƙarfe tara na safe ne kawai!
english: For these aren’t drunken, as you suppose, seeing it is only the third hour of the day.

hausa: Ku dogara a gare shi a duk lokuta, ya mutane; ku faɗi albarkaci bakin zukatanku a gare shi, gama Allah ne mafakarmu. Sela
english: Trust in him at all times, you people. Pour out your heart before him. God is a refuge for us. Selah.

hausa: Ku tambaya ku ji. Namiji zai iya haifi ’ya’ya? To, me ya sa kuke ganin kowane mai ƙarfi da hannuwansa a kwankwaso kamar mace mai naƙuda, kowace fuska ta koma fari?
english: Ask now, and see whether a man travails with child. Why do I see every man with his hands on his waist, as a woman in travail, and all faces are turned pale?

hausa: Sai ka ce musu, ‘Wannan ya zama haka domin kakanninku sun rabu da ni,’ in ji Ubangiji, ‘suka bi waɗansu alloli suka kuma bauta musu. Suka rabu da ni, ba su kuwa kiyaye dokata ba.
english: then you shall tell them, ‘Because your fathers have forsaken me,’ says Yahweh, ‘and have walked after other gods, have served them, have worshiped them, have forsaken me, and have not kept my law.

hausa: Nan da nan, Yesu ya gane a ruhunsa abin da suke tunani a zuciyarsu, sai ya ce musu, “Me ya sa kuke tunanin waɗannan abubuwa?
english: Immediately Jesus, perceiving in his spirit that they so reasoned within themselves, said to them, “Why do you reason these things in your hearts?

hausa: Waɗannan su ne zuriyar Haruna, Eleyazar, Finehas, Abishuwa,
english: These are the sons of Aaron: Eleazar his son, Phinehas his son, Abishua his son,

hausa: Jimillar dabbobi don hadaya ta ƙonawa, ta kai ƙanana bijimai goma sha biyu, raguna goma sha biyu da ’yan raguna goma sha biyu, dukansu bana ɗaya-ɗaya, tare da hadayarsu ta hatsi. Aka yi amfani da bunsurai goma sha biyu domin hadaya don zunubi.
english: all the cattle for the burnt offering twelve bulls, the rams twelve, the male lambs a year old twelve, and their meal offering; and twelve male goats for a sin offering;

hausa: Sa’ad da dukan dattawan Isra’ila suka zo wurin Sarki Dawuda a Hebron, suka yi yarjejjeniya da shi a gaban Ubangiji, suka kuwa shafe Dawuda ya zama sarki a bisa Isra’ila, yadda Ubangiji ya yi alkawari ta wurin Sama’ila.
english: So all the elders of Israel came to the king to Hebron; and David made a covenant with them in Hebron before Yahweh. They anointed David king over Israel, according to Yahweh’s word by Samuel.

hausa: Kowa a Urushalima ya ji game da wannan, saboda haka suka kira wannan filin Akeldama, da yarensu, wato, Filin Jini.)
english: It became known to everyone who lived in Jerusalem that in their language that field was called ‘Akeldama,’ that is, ‘The field of blood.’

hausa: Yehiyel, Azaziya, Nahat, Asahel, Yerimot, Yozabad, Eliyel, Ismakiya, Mahat da Benahiya su ne shugabanni, mataimakan Konaniya da Shimeyi ɗan’uwansa, waɗanda sarki Hezekiya da Azariya babban shugaban haikalin Allah suka naɗa.
english: Jehiel, Azaziah, Nahath, Asahel, Jerimoth, Jozabad, Eliel, Ismachiah, Mahath, and Benaiah were overseers under the hand of Conaniah and Shimei his brother, by the appointment of Hezekiah the king and Azariah the ruler of God’s house.

hausa: muddin ina raye, in ji Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka, ko da ma waɗannan mutum uku suna a cikinta, ba za su iya ceton ’ya’yansu maza ko mata ba. Su kaɗai za a iya ceto, amma ƙasar za tă zama kufai.
english: though these three men were in it, as I live,” says the Lord Yahweh, “they would deliver neither sons nor daughters. They only would be delivered, but the land would be desolate.

hausa: na zama marar azanci da jahili; na zama kamar dabba a gabanka.
english: I was so senseless and ignorant. I was a brute beast before you.

hausa: Akwai kuma Ibhar, Elishama, Elifelet,
english: and Ibhar, Elishama, Eliphelet,

hausa: Shekaniya, Rehum, Meremot,
english: Shecaniah, Rehum, Meremoth,

hausa: Ka cece ni, ya Allahna, daga hannun mugaye, da kuma daga ikon mugaye da masu mugunta.
english: Rescue me, my God, from the hand of the wicked, from the hand of the unrighteous and cruel man.

hausa: Ka ƙarfafa ni da zabibi ka wartsake ni da gawasa, gama ina suma don ƙauna.
english: Strengthen me with raisins, refresh me with apples; for I am faint with love.

hausa: Sai ɓangarori sansanin Ruben suka biyo, bisa ga ƙa’idar da aka yi, aka kuma umarta. Elizur ɗan Shedeyur ne shugaba.
english: The standard of the camp of Reuben went forward according to their armies. Elizur the son of Shedeur was over his army.

hausa: na iyalin Harim, Adna; na iyalin Merahiyot, Helkai;
english: of Harim, Adna; of Meraioth, Helkai;

hausa: ‘Tun ranar na da fitar da mutanena daga Masar, ban zaɓi wani birni a wata kabilar Isra’ila don a gina haikali domin Sunana ya kasance a can ba, ba kuwa zaɓi wani yă zama shugaba a bisa jama’ata Isra’ila ba.
english: ‘Since the day that I brought my people out of the land of Egypt, I chose no city out of all the tribes of Israel to build a house in, that my name might be there, and I chose no man to be prince over my people Israel;

hausa: cewa in kun yi kuskure sa’ad da kuka aike ni wurin Ubangiji Allahnku kuka kuma ce, ‘Yi mana addu’a ga Ubangiji Allahnmu; ka faɗa mana duk abin da ya faɗa za mu kuwa aikata.’
english: For you have dealt deceitfully against your own souls; for you sent me to Yahweh your God, saying, ‘Pray for us to Yahweh our God; and according to all that Yahweh our God says, so declare to us, and we will do it.’

hausa: Duba! Abin ɗaukar Solomon ne, jarumawa sittin suke rakiya, zaɓaɓɓun sojojin Isra’ila,
english: Behold, it is Solomon’s carriage! Sixty mighty men are around it, of the mighty men of Israel.

hausa: Waɗannan su ne zuriyar Kaleb. ’Ya’yan Hur maza, ɗan farin Efrata su ne, Shobal mahaifin Kiriyat Yeyarim,
english: These were the sons of Caleb, the son of Hur, the firstborn of Ephrathah: Shobal the father of Kiriath Jearim,

hausa: Yesu ya amsa ya ce, “Lokaci ya yi da za a ɗaukaka Ɗan Mutum.
english: Jesus answered them, “The time has come for the Son of Man to be glorified.

hausa: “Kaito ga wanda ya gina masarautarsa da ƙazamar riba don yă kafa sheƙarsa can bisa, don yă tsere wa zama kango!
english: Woe to him who gets an evil gain for his house, that he may set his nest on high, that he may be delivered from the hand of evil!

hausa: Ku miƙa gaisuwata ga ’yan’uwan da suke a Lawodiseya, musamman ga Nimfa da kuma ikkilisiyar da take taru a gidanta.
english: Greet the brothers who are in Laodicea, with Nymphas and the assembly that is in his house.

hausa: Amma ya amsa ya ce, “Mutumin da ya warkar da ni shi ya ce mini, ‘Ɗauki tabarmarka ka yi tafiya.’ ”
english: He answered them, “He who made me well said to me, ‘Take up your mat and walk.’ ”

hausa: Ka kuma yi kerubobi biyu da zinariyar da aka ƙera, ka sa a gefen nan biyu na murfin.
english: You shall make two cherubim of hammered gold. You shall make them at the two ends of the mercy seat.

hausa: Elisha ya amsa ya ce, “Je ka ce masa, ‘Ba shakka za ka warke’; ammaUbangiji ya nuna mini cewa ba shakka zai mutu.”
english: Elisha said to him, “Go, tell him, ‘You will surely recover;’ however Yahweh has shown me that he will surely die.”

hausa: Sa’ad da Azariya babban firist da dukan sauran firistoci suka dube shi, sai suka ga cewa yana da kuturta a goshinsa, saboda haka suka gaggauta tunkuɗa shi waje nan da nan. Tabbatacce, shi kansa ma ya yi marmari yă bar wurin domin Ubangiji ya buge shi.
english: Azariah the chief priest and all the priests looked at him, and behold, he was leprous in his forehead; and they thrust him out quickly from there. Indeed, he himself also hurried to go out, because Yahweh had struck him.

hausa: “To yanzu, ya Allahnmu, mai girma, mai iko, da kuma mai banrazana, wanda yake kiyaye alkawarinsa na ƙauna, kada ka bar dukan wannan wahala ta zama kamar marar muhimmanci a idanunka, wahalar da ta zo a kanmu, a kan sarakunanmu da shugabanni, a kan firistocinmu da annabawa, a kan kakanninmu da kuma dukan mutanenka, daga kwanakin sarakunan Assuriya har yă zuwa yau.
english: Now therefore, our God, the great, the mighty, and the awesome God, who keeps covenant and loving kindness, don’t let all the travail seem little before you that has come on us, on our kings, on our princes, on our priests, on our prophets, on our fathers, and on all your people, since the time of the kings of Assyria to this day.

hausa: Allah mai girma ne, ya wuce ganewarmu! Yawan shekarunsa ba su bincikuwa.
english: Behold, God is great, and we don’t know him. The number of his years is unsearchable.

hausa: “A ranar da na shirya ajiyayyen mallakata, za su zama nawa,” in ji Ubangiji Maɗaukaki. “Zan ji kansu kamar yadda mahaifi cikin tausayi yakan ji kan ɗansa wanda yake masa hidima.
english: They shall be mine,” says Yahweh of Armies, “my own possession in the day that I make. I will spare them, as a man spares his own son who serves him.

hausa: “Mutanen Isra’ila, ku saurari wannan. Yesu Banazare shi ne mutumin da Allah ya tabbatar muku ta wurin mu’ujizai, ayyukan banmamaki, da kuma alamu, waɗanda Allah ya yi a cikinku ta wurinsa, kamar yadda ku kanku kuka sani.
english: “Men of Israel, hear these words! Jesus of Nazareth, a man approved by God to you by mighty works and wonders and signs which God did by him among you, even as you yourselves know,

hausa: Waɗannan duwatsu biyu suna a hayin Urdun, yamma da hanya a ƙasar Kan’aniyawa mazaunan Araba, kusa da Gilgal wajajen manyan itatuwan More.
english: Aren’t they beyond the Jordan, behind the way of the going down of the sun, in the land of the Canaanites who dwell in the Arabah near Gilgal, beside the oaks of Moreh?

hausa: Haka ya hallakar da waɗannan birane da kuma kwarinsu gaba ɗaya, haɗe da dukan waɗanda suke zama a biranen, da kuma dukan shuke-shuke da suke cikin ƙasar.
english: He overthrew those cities, all the plain, all the inhabitants of the cities, and that which grew on the ground.

hausa: Ko da yake kuna cewa, ‘Wannan ce maganar Ubangiji,’ ga abin da Ubangiji yana cewa kuna amfani da kalmomi, ‘Wannan ce maganar Ubangiji,’ ko da yake na ce muku kada ku ce, ‘Wannan ce maganar Ubangiji.’
english: Although you say, ‘The message from Yahweh,’ therefore Yahweh says: ‘Because you say this word, “The message from Yahweh,” and I have sent to you, telling you not to say, “The message from Yahweh,”

hausa: suka kuma ga Allah na Isra’ila. A ƙarƙashin ƙafafunsa akwai wani abu wanda aka yi da saffaya, mai haske kuma kamar sararin sama kansa.
english: They saw the God of Israel. Under his feet was like a paved work of sapphire stone, like the skies for clearness.

hausa: Amma akwai waɗansu Yahudawa daga lardin Asiya, waɗanda ya kamata suna a nan a gabanka su kawo ƙara in suna da wani a kaina.
english: They ought to have been here before you and to make accusation if they had anything against me.

hausa: ’Ya’yan Midiyan maza su ne, Efa, Efer, Hanok, Abida da Elda’a. Dukan waɗannan su ne zuriyar Ketura.
english: The sons of Midian: Ephah, Epher, Hanoch, Abida, and Eldaah. All these were the sons of Keturah.

hausa: ’Yan matan Urushalima, ku yi mini alkawari da bareyi da ƙishimai na jeji. Ba za ku tā da ko ku farka ƙauna ba sai haka ya zama lalle.
english: I adjure you, daughters of Jerusalem, by the roes, or by the hinds of the field, that you not stir up nor awaken love, until it so desires.

hausa: Ya aikata mugunta a gaban Ubangiji. Bai kauce wa zunuban Yerobowam ɗan Nebat, wanda ya sa Isra’ila ta yi ba.
english: He did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight. He didn’t depart from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, with which he made Israel to sin.

hausa: Shi ya sa kake kewaye da tarkuna, shi ya sa ka cika da tsoron mugun abin da zai auko maka.
english: Therefore snares are around you. Sudden fear troubles you,

hausa: Ga abin da Ubangiji yana cewa, “Kamar sa’ad da ruwan ’ya’yan itace yana samuwa a cikin tarin ’ya’yan inabi mutane kuma su ce, ‘Kada a lalace shi, har yanzu akwai abu mai kyau a ciki,’ haka nan zan yi a madadin bayina; ba zan hallaka su duka ba.
english: Yahweh says, “As the new wine is found in the cluster, and one says, ‘Don’t destroy it, for a blessing is in it:’ so I will do for my servants’ sake, that I may not destroy them all.

hausa: Gileyad birni ce ta mugayen mutane, da tabon alamun jini.
english: Gilead is a city of those who work iniquity; it is stained with blood.

hausa: A ƙarshe suka ce, “Wane ne kai? Ka ba mu amsa don mu mayar wa waɗanda suka aike mu. Me kake ce da kanka?”
english: They said therefore to him, “Who are you? Give us an answer to take back to those who sent us. What do you say about yourself?”

hausa: A rana ta uku, sai aka faɗa wa Laban cewa Yaƙub ya gudu.
english: Laban was told on the third day that Jacob had fled.

hausa: Ga yadda haihuwar Yesu Kiristi ta kasance. An yi alkawarin auren mahaifiyarsa Maryamu, ga Yusuf. Amma tun kafin su zama miji da mata, sai aka tarar Maryamu tana da ciki, ta wurin Ruhu Mai Tsarki.
english: Now the birth of Jesus Christ was like this: After his mother, Mary, was engaged to Joseph, before they came together, she was found pregnant by the Holy Spirit.

hausa: saboda haka ina gāba da kai da rafuffukanka, zan kuma maishe ƙasar Masar ta lalace ta kuma zama kango daga Migdol zuwa Aswan, har iyakar Kush.
english: therefore, behold, I am against you and against your rivers. I will make the land of Egypt an utter waste and desolation, from the tower of Seveneh even to the border of Ethiopia.

hausa: Har wa yau Yesu ya ce, “Siman ɗan Yohanna, kana ƙaunata da gaske?” Ya amsa ya ce, “I, Ubangiji, ka san cewa ina sonka.” Yesu ya ce, “Lura da tumakina.”
english: He said to him again a second time, “Simon, son of Jonah, do you love me?” He said to him, “Yes, Lord; you know that I have affection for you.” He said to him, “Tend my sheep.”

hausa: In kuma wani yana so yă yi ƙararka yă ƙwace rigarka, to, ba shi mayafinka ma.
english: If anyone sues you to take away your coat, let him have your cloak also.

hausa: Ta haka kuwa kuka zama gurbi ga dukan masu bi a Makidoniya da Akayya.
english: so that you became an example to all who believe in Macedonia and in Achaia.

hausa: Wanda ya ƙi ni ya ƙi ya ƙi Ubana ma.
english: He who hates me, hates my Father also.

hausa: “Duk waɗanda suke da fasaha a cikinku, su zo su yi dukan abin da Ubangiji ya umarta,
english: “‘Let every wise-hearted man among you come, and make all that Yahweh has commanded:

hausa: Ka fitar da inabi daga Masar; ka kori al’ummai ka kuma dasa shi.
english: You brought a vine out of Egypt. You drove out the nations, and planted it.

hausa: Duba, can a bisa duwatsu, ga ƙafafu mai kawo labari mai daɗi, wanda yake shelar salama! Ki yi bukukkuwanki, ya Yahuda, ki kuma cika wa’adodinki. Mugaye ba za su ƙara mamaye ki ba; domin za a hallaka su ƙaƙaf.
english: Behold, on the mountains the feet of him who brings good news, who publishes peace! Keep your feasts, Judah! Perform your vows, for the wicked one will no more pass through you. He is utterly cut off.

hausa: Sa’an nan na ce, “Har yaushe, ya Ubangiji?” Ya kuma amsa, “Sai an lalatar da biranen ba kowa a ciki, sai an mai da gidaje kangwaye ƙasa kuma ta zama kango ba amfani,
english: Then I said, “Lord, how long?” He answered, “Until cities are waste without inhabitant, houses without man, the land becomes utterly waste,

hausa: Zan hamɓarar da gadajen mulki in kuma ragargaza ƙarfin ƙasashen al’ummai. Zan tumɓuke kekunan yaƙi da mahayansu; dawakai da mahayansu za su mutu, kowane ta wurin takobin ɗan’uwansu.
english: I will overthrow the throne of kingdoms. I will destroy the strength of the kingdoms of the nations. I will overthrow the chariots and those who ride in them. The horses and their riders will come down, everyone by the sword of his brother.

hausa: Gama kun san alherin Ubangijinmu Yesu Kiristi cewa ko da yake shi mawadaci ne, duk da haka, ya zama matalauci saboda ku, domin ta wurin talaucinsa, ku zama mawadata.
english: For you know the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ, that though he was rich, yet for your sakes he became poor, that you through his poverty might become rich.

hausa: Zedekiya sarkin Yahuda ba zai kuɓuta daga hannuwan Babiloniyawa ba amma tabbatacce za a ba da shi ga sarkin Babilon, zai kuwa yi masa magana fuska da fuska ya kuma gan shi da idanunsa.
english: and Zedekiah king of Judah won’t escape out of the hand of the Chaldeans, but will surely be delivered into the hand of the king of Babylon, and will speak with him mouth to mouth, and his eyes will see his eyes;

hausa: Dukan mutanensa suka wuce gabansa, tare da dukan Keretawa da Feletiyawa; da dukan mutane ɗari shida na Gittiyawan da suka raka shi daga Gat, suka wuce gaban sarki.
english: All his servants passed on beside him; and all the Cherethites, and all the Pelethites, and all the Gittites, six hundred men who came after him from Gath, passed on before the king.

hausa: Sama’ila ya ce wa dukan mutane, “Kun ga wanda Ubangiji ya zaɓa ko? Ba wani kamar sa a cikin dukan mutane.” Sai mutane suka tā da murya suka ce, “Ran sarki yă daɗe.”
english: Samuel said to all the people, “Do you see him whom Yahweh has chosen, that there is no one like him among all the people?” All the people shouted and said, “Long live the king!”

hausa: Ka tuna da matsayinka a dā kafin ka fāɗi! Ka tuba ka kuma yi ayyukan da ka yi da fari. In ba ka tuba ba, zan zo wajenka in ɗauke wurin ajiye fitilanka daga inda yake.
english: Remember therefore from where you have fallen, and repent and do the first works; or else I am coming to you swiftly, and will move your lamp stand out of its place, unless you repent.

hausa: Amma duk wanda ya saɓi Ruhu Mai Tsarki, ba za a taɓa gafara masa ba. Ya aikata madawwamin zunubi ke nan.”
english: but whoever may blaspheme against the Holy Spirit never has forgiveness, but is subject to eternal condemnation.”

hausa: Amma Musa ya ce, “Don me kuke rashin biyayya da umarnin Ubangiji? Wannan ba zai yiwu ba!
english: Moses said, “Why now do you disobey the commandment of Yahweh, since it shall not prosper?

hausa: Kamar yadda na lura da su don su tumɓuke su kuma rusar, su lalatar, su hallaka su kuma kawo masifa, haka zan lura da su don su gina su kuma dasa,” in ji Ubangiji.
english: It will happen that, like as I have watched over them to pluck up and to break down and to overthrow and to destroy and to afflict, so I will watch over them to build and to plant,” says Yahweh.

hausa: Ka sa zuciyar mutanen nan ta dushe; kunnuwansu su kurunce, idanunsu kuma su makance. In ba haka ba za su iya gani da idanunsu, su ji da kunnuwansu, su fahimta da zuciyarsu, su kuma juyo a kuma warkar da su.”
english: Make the heart of this people fat. Make their ears heavy, and shut their eyes; lest they see with their eyes, hear with their ears, understand with their heart, and turn again, and be healed.”

hausa: Kowace rana, ya yi ta koyarwa a haikalin. Amma manyan firistoci, da malaman dokoki, da shugabannin mutane, suna ƙoƙarin kashe shi.
english: He was teaching daily in the temple, but the chief priests, the scribes, and the leading men among the people sought to destroy him.

hausa: Haka ma kana da waɗanda suke riƙe da koyarwar Nikolaitawa.
english: So also you likewise have some who hold to the teaching of the Nicolaitans.

hausa: Na yi fama mai kyau, na gama tseren, na riƙe bangaskiya.
english: I have fought the good fight. I have finished the course. I have kept the faith.

hausa: Bitrus kuwa ya dakata a waje a bakin ƙofa. Almajirin nan da yake sananne ga babban firist, ya dawo ya yi magana da yarinyar mai aiki a can, ya kuma shigo da Bitrus.
english: but Peter was standing at the door outside. So the other disciple, who was known to the high priest, went out and spoke to her who kept the door, and brought in Peter.

hausa: “Ya ku ’yan matan Isra’ila, ku yi kuka saboda Shawulu, wanda ya suturta ku da jajjayen kayan ado, wanda ya yi wa rigunarku ado da zinariya.
english: You daughters of Israel, weep over Saul, who clothed you delicately in scarlet, who put ornaments of gold on your clothing.

hausa: Sai maganar Ubangiji ta zo wa Irmiya cewa,
english: Therefore Yahweh’s word came to Jeremiah from Yahweh, saying,

hausa: Gideyon ya haura ta hanyar makiyaya, gabas da Noba, da kuma Yogbeha, ya fāɗa wa mayaƙan ta yadda ba su zata ba.
english: Gideon went up by the way of those who lived in tents on the east of Nobah and Jogbehah, and struck the army; for the army felt secure.

hausa: Duniya za tă zama kufai saboda mazaunanta, saboda ayyukansu.
english: Yet the land will be desolate because of those who dwell therein, for the fruit of their doings.

hausa: bisa Ƙofar Efraim, Ƙofar Yeshana, Ƙofar Kifi, Hasumiyar Hananel da kuma Hasumiya ɗari, har zuwa Ƙofar Tumaki. A Ƙofar Matsara suka tsaya.
english: and above the gate of Ephraim, and by the old gate, and by the fish gate, the tower of Hananel, and the tower of Hammeah, even to the sheep gate; and they stood still in the gate of the guard.
