hausa: Ganin abin da yake gaba, ya yi magana a kan tashin Kiristi daga matattu cewa, ba a bar shi a kabari ba, jikinsa kuma bai ruɓa ba.
english: he foreseeing this, spoke about the resurrection of the Christ, that his soul wasn’t left in Hades, and his flesh didn’t see decay.

hausa: “Faɗa wa Haruna cewa, ‘Don tsararraki masu zuwa, kada ko ɗaya daga cikin zuriyarka, da yake da lahani yă zo kusa domin yă miƙa hadaya ta ci gare ni.
english: “Say to Aaron, ‘None of your offspring throughout their generations who has a defect may approach to offer the bread of his God.

hausa: Ubangiji Maɗaukaki ya rantse, “Tabbatacce, kamar yadda na riga na shirya, haka zai kasance, kuma kamar yadda na nufa, haka zai zama.
english: Yahweh of Armies has sworn, saying, “Surely, as I have thought, so shall it happen; and as I have purposed, so shall it stand:

hausa: Waƙar haurawa. Ta Dawuda. Abu mai kyau ne, mai daɗi kuma sa’ad da ’yan’uwa suna zaman lafiya!
english: A Song of Ascents. By David. See how good and how pleasant it is for brothers to live together in unity!

hausa: Sai Abimelek ya kawo awaki da shanu da bayi maza da mata, ya ba wa Ibrahim, ya kuma komar da Saratu matarsa gare shi.
english: Abimelech took sheep and cattle, male servants and female servants, and gave them to Abraham, and restored Sarah, his wife, to him.

hausa: Ku saurara da kyau ku ji abin da zan faɗa; bari kunnuwanku su ji abin da zan ce.
english: Listen carefully to my speech. Let my declaration be in your ears.

hausa: Waɗanda suke a waje, takobi zai kashe su, a cikin gidajensu kuma tsoro zai mamaye su. ’Yan maza da ’yan mata za su hallaka, haka ma jarirai da maza masu furfura.
english: Outside the sword will bereave, and in the rooms, terror on both young man and virgin, the nursing infant with the gray-haired man.

hausa: Suka tambaye shi suka ce, “Ina kake so mu je mu yi shirin?”
english: They said to him, “Where do you want us to prepare?”

hausa: Mutane za su amsa su ce, ‘Saboda sun yashe Ubangiji Allahnsu, wanda ya fitar da su daga Masar, suka rungumi waɗansu alloli, suna yin musu sujada, suna bauta musu ne, ya sa Ubangiji ya kawo dukan masifan nan a kansu.’ ”
english: and they will answer, ‘Because they abandoned Yahweh their God, who brought their fathers out of the land of Egypt, and embraced other gods, and worshiped them, and served them. Therefore Yahweh has brought all this evil on them.’”

hausa: Sun zauna a Beyersheba, Molada, Hazar Shuwal,
english: They lived at Beersheba, Moladah, Hazarshual,

hausa: In kuma suka tambaye ka, ‘Ina za mu tafi?’ Sai ka faɗa musu, ‘Ga abin da Ubangiji yana cewa, “ ‘Waɗanda aka ƙaddara ga mutuwa, ga mutuwa za su; waɗanda aka ƙaddara ga takobi, ga takobi za su; waɗanda aka ƙaddara ga yunwa, ga yunwa za su; waɗanda aka ƙaddara ga zaman bauta, ga zaman bauta za su.’
english: It will happen when they ask you, ‘Where shall we go out?’ then you shall tell them, ‘Yahweh says: “Such as are for death, to death; such as are for the sword, to the sword; such as are for the famine, to the famine; and such as are for captivity, to captivity.”’

hausa: Amma Farisiyawa da malaman dokokin da suke a ƙungiyarsu, suka yi wa almajiransa gunaguni, suna cewa, “Don me kuke ci, kuke sha tare da masu karɓar haraji da masu zunubi?”
english: Their scribes and the Pharisees murmured against his disciples, saying, “Why do you eat and drink with the tax collectors and sinners?”

hausa: Na kuma umarci alƙalanku a wancan lokaci, na ce, “Ku yi adalci cikin shari’a tsakanin ’yan’uwanku, ko damuwar tana tsakanin ’yan’uwa Isra’ilawa ne, ko kuwa tsakanin Isra’ilawa da baƙin da suke zaune a cikinku.
english: I commanded your judges at that time, saying, “Hear cases between your brothers and judge righteously between a man and his brother, and the foreigner who is living with him.

hausa: Fir’auna ya tambaye shi, ya ce, “Me ka rasa a nan da kake so ka koma garinka?” Ya ce, “Ba kome, amma ka dai bar ni in tafi!”
english: Then Pharaoh said to him, “But what have you lacked with me, that behold, you seek to go to your own country?” He answered, “Nothing, however only let me depart.”

hausa: Sa’an nan sarakunan bakin teku za su sauka daga gadajen sarautarsu, su tuɓe rigunansu, da rigunansu waɗanda aka yi wa ado. Za su zauna a ƙasa suna rawar jiki a kowane lokaci suna razana saboda abin da ya same ki.
english: Then all the princes of the sea will come down from their thrones, and lay aside their robes, and strip off their embroidered garments. They will clothe themselves with trembling. They will sit on the ground, and will tremble every moment, and be astonished at you.

hausa: A rana ta tara, Abidan ɗan Gideyoni, shugaban mutanen Benyamin, ya kawo hadayarsa.
english: On the ninth day Abidan the son of Gideoni, prince of the children of Benjamin,

hausa: Ko da yake mu bayi ne, Allahnmu bai yashe mu cikin daurin talala da muke ciki ba, ya sa sarakunan Farisa suka yi mana kirki. Ya ba mu sabuwar dama don mu sāke gina haikalin Allahnmu, mu kuma gyara katangar, ya kuma ba mu kāriya a Yahuda da Urushalima.
english: For we are bondservants; yet our God has not forsaken us in our bondage, but has extended loving kindness to us in the sight of the kings of Persia, to revive us, to set up the house of our God, and to repair its ruins, and to give us a wall in Judah and in Jerusalem.

hausa: Sai ya ce, “Ku mirgina manyan duwatsu ku rufe bakin kogon, sai ku sa waɗannan mutane su yi tsaron kogon.
english: Joshua said, “Roll large stones to cover the cave’s entrance, and set men by it to guard them;

hausa: Cikin kowane abu ka zama musu misali mai kyau ta wurin aikata abin da yake nagari. A cikin koyarwarka ka nuna mutunci da ƙwazo
english: In all things show yourself an example of good works. In your teaching, show integrity, seriousness, incorruptibility,

hausa: Amma ya ƙi. Ya ce mata, “Ga shi kome yana a ƙarƙashina, don haka ne ma maigidana bai dami kansa da wani abu a cikin gidan nan ba; kome da ya mallaka, ya danƙa ga kulawata.
english: But he refused, and said to his master’s wife, “Behold, my master doesn’t know what is with me in the house, and he has put all that he has into my hand.

hausa: Ka girgiza ƙasar ka kuma tsaga ta; ka daure karayarta, gama tana rawa.
english: You have made the land tremble. You have torn it. Mend its fractures, for it quakes.

hausa: Bayan suka yi addu’a, sai inda suka taru ya jijjigu. Dukansu kuwa suka cika da Ruhu Mai Tsarki, suka yi ta shaidar maganar Allah babu tsoro.
english: When they had prayed, the place was shaken where they were gathered together. They were all filled with the Holy Spirit, and they spoke the word of God with boldness.

hausa: Saboda haka Dawuda ya tattara sauran rundunar sojojin suka tafi Rabba suka fāɗa masa suka kuma ci shi.
english: David gathered all the people together and went to Rabbah, and fought against it and took it.

hausa: Aka yi rufin da al’ul bisa ginshiƙan da suke bisa ginshiƙai arba’in da biyar, goma sha biya a kowane jeri.
english: It was covered with cedar above over the forty-five beams that were on the pillars, fifteen in a row.

hausa: Amma ƙasa ta taimaki macen ta wurin buɗe bakinta ta kuma shanye ruwan kogin da macijin ya kwarara daga bakinsa.
english: The earth helped the woman, and the earth opened its mouth and swallowed up the river which the dragon spewed out of his mouth.

hausa: Shi ne zai juye mutanen Isra’ila da yawa zuwa wurin Ubangiji Allahnsu.
english: He will turn many of the children of Israel to the Lord their God.

hausa: Shi ba Allah na matattu ba ne, amma na masu rai ne, gama a gare shi, duka na da rai.”
english: Now he is not the God of the dead, but of the living, for all are alive to him.”

hausa: Amma sai suka amsa suka ce, “Ba ma shan ruwan inabi, domin kakanmu Yehonadab ɗan Rekab ya umarce mu cewa, ‘Ko ku, ko zuriyarku kada ku sha ruwan inabi.
english: But they said, “We will drink no wine; for Jonadab the son of Rechab, our father, commanded us, saying, ‘You shall drink no wine, neither you nor your children, forever.

hausa: A wannan rana za su ce, “Tabbatacce wannan shi ne Allah; mun dogara a gare shi, ya kuma cece mu. Wannan shi ne Ubangiji, mun dogara a gare shi; bari mu yi murna mu kuma yi farin ciki a cikin cetonsa.”
english: It shall be said in that day, “Behold, this is our God! We have waited for him, and he will save us! This is Yahweh! We have waited for him. We will be glad and rejoice in his salvation!”

hausa: Suka ce masa, “Gaya mana, da wane iko kake yin waɗannan abubuwa. Wa ya ba ka wannan ikon?”
english: They asked him, “Tell us: by what authority do you do these things? Or who is giving you this authority?”

hausa: Sa’ad da Nahor ya yi shekaru 29, sai ya haifi Tera.
english: Nahor lived twenty-nine years, and became the father of Terah.

hausa: Amalekawa suna zama a Negeb; Hittiyawa, Yebusiyawa da kuma Amoriyawa, suna zama ne a ƙasar tudu. Kan’aniyawa kuma suna zama kusa da teku da kuma a bakin Urdun.”
english: Amalek dwells in the land of the South. The Hittite, the Jebusite, and the Amorite dwell in the hill country. The Canaanite dwells by the sea, and along the side of the Jordan.”

hausa: Ta ce, “Ka sha, ranka yă daɗe,” ta yi sauri ta saukar da tulun a hannuwanta, ta kuma ba shi, ya sha.
english: She said, “Drink, my lord.” She hurried, and let down her pitcher on her hand, and gave him a drink.

hausa: Ku ba matalauta abin da yake cikin kwano, kuma kome zai zama muku da tsabta.
english: But give for gifts to the needy those things which are within, and behold, all things will be clean to you.

hausa: “Kwanaki suna zuwa,” in ji Ubangiji, “sa’ad da za a sāke gina wannan birni domina daga Hasumiyar Hananel zuwa Ƙofar Kusurwa.
english: “Behold, the days come,” says Yahweh, “that the city will be built to Yahweh from the tower of Hananel to the gate of the corner.

hausa: Kada ka ji tsoro saboda masu mugunta ko ka yi ƙyashin mugaye,
english: Don’t fret yourself because of evildoers, neither be envious of the wicked;

hausa: Filistiyawa kuma suka aika da siffofin ɓeraye biyar na zinariya. Yawan ɓerayen sun yi daidai da yawan garuruwan sarakunan nan biyar na Filistiyawa. Garuruwan sun ƙunshi waɗanda aka gina katangar birni kewaye da su, da kuma ƙauyukansu. Babban dutsen da suka ajiye akwatin alkawarin Ubangiji, ya zama shaida har wa yau a filin Yoshuwa a Bet-Shemesh.
english: and the golden mice, according to the number of all the cities of the Philistines belonging to the five lords, both of fortified cities and of country villages, even to the great stone on which they set down Yahweh’s ark. That stone remains to this day in the field of Joshua of Beth Shemesh.

hausa: Manasse zai mai da Efraim abinci, Efraim kuma yă cinye Manasse; tare za su yi gāba da Yahuda. Duk da haka, fushinsa bai huce ba, hannunsa har yanzu yana a miƙe.
english: Manasseh eating Ephraim and Ephraim eating Manasseh, and they together will be against Judah. For all this his anger is not turned away, but his hand is stretched out still.

hausa: Yanzu fa, ina roƙonka ka yafe mini zunubina, ka koma tare da ni, domin in yi wa Ubangiji sujada.”
english: Now therefore, please pardon my sin, and turn again with me, that I may worship Yahweh.”

hausa: Ya ajiye ƙungiyoyi sojoji a masarautar Arameyawan Damaskus, Arameyawa kuwa suka zama bayinsa, suka biya shi haraji. Ubangiji ya ba Dawuda nasara a duk inda ya tafi.
english: Then David put garrisons in Syria of Damascus; and the Syrians became servants to David, and brought tribute. Yahweh gave victory to David wherever he went.

hausa: Ko da yake kashi ɗaya bisa goma zai ragu a ƙasar, za tă sāke zama kango. Amma kamar yadda katambiri da itacen oak sukan bar kututturai sa’ad da aka yanke su, haka iri mai tsarkin nan zai zama kututture a ƙasar mai tsarki.”
english: If there is a tenth left in it, that also will in turn be consumed, as a terebinth, and as an oak whose stump remains when they are cut down, so the holy seed is its stump.”

hausa: “Ga abin da Ubangiji yana cewa, shi da ya halicci duniya, Ubangiji wanda ya siffanta ta ya kuma kafa ta, Ubangiji ne sunansa.
english: “Yahweh who does it, Yahweh who forms it to establish it—Yahweh is his name, says:

hausa: Sa’ad da Rehobowam ya iso Urushalima, ya tattara mayaƙa dubu ɗari takwas daga gidan Yahuda da Benyamin, don su yi yaƙi da Isra’ila su sāke mai da mulki wa Rehobowam.
english: When Rehoboam had come to Jerusalem, he assembled the house of Judah and Benjamin, one hundred eighty thousand chosen men who were warriors, to fight against Israel, to bring the kingdom again to Rehoboam.

hausa: Yawan mutanen da suka ci kuwa maza dubu biyar ne.
english: Those who ate the loaves were five thousand men.

hausa: Yakan ci zalin matalauta da mabukata. Yakan yi fashi. Ba ya mayar da abin da aka jinginar masa. Ya dogara ga gumaka. Yana aikata ayyukan banƙyama.
english: has wronged the poor and needy, has taken by robbery, has not restored the pledge, and has lifted up his eyes to the idols, has committed abomination,

hausa: Saboda haka sai ku yafa dukan kayan yaƙi na Allah, domin sa’ad da ranar mugun nan ta zo, ku iya yin tsayin daka, bayan kuma kuka gama kome, ku dāge.
english: Therefore put on the whole armor of God, that you may be able to withstand in the evil day, and having done all, to stand.

hausa: “Gama ga abin da Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka yana cewa balle fa sa’ad da na aika wa Urushalima da hukuntaina guda huɗu masu zafi takobi da yunwa da namun jeji da annoba don su kashe mutanenta da dabbobinsu!
english: For the Lord Yahweh says: “How much more when I send my four severe judgments on Jerusalem—the sword, the famine, the evil animals, and the pestilence—to cut off from it man and animal!

hausa: Saboda haka Sarki Solomon ya umarci Benahiya ɗan Yehohiyada yă kashe Adoniya; ya kuwa kashe shi.
english: King Solomon sent Benaiah the son of Jehoiada; and he fell on him, so that he died.

hausa: Festus, da yake yana so yă yi wa Yahudawa alfarma, sai ya ce wa Bulus, “Ka yarda ka je Urushalima a yi maka shari’a a can a gabana a kan waɗannan zarge?”
english: But Festus, desiring to gain favor with the Jews, answered Paul and said, “Are you willing to go up to Jerusalem and be judged by me there concerning these things?”

hausa: A shekara ta biyu ta mulkin Sarki Dariyus, a rana ta fari ga watan shida, maganar Ubangiji ta zo ta wurin annabi Haggai zuwa ga Zerubbabel ɗan Sheyaltiyel, gwamnan Yahuda, da kuma Yoshuwa ɗan Yehozadak, babban firist.
english: In the second year of Darius the king, in the sixth month, in the first day of the month, Yahweh’s word came by Haggai the prophet, to Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and to Joshua the son of Jehozadak, the high priest, saying,

hausa: Ku yi farin ciki a Bikinku, da ku da ’ya’yanku maza da mata, da bayinku maza da mata, da Lawiyawa, da baƙi, da marayu, da kuma gwaurayen da suke zama a cikin biranenku.
english: You shall rejoice in your feast, you, your son, your daughter, your male servant, your female servant, the Levite, the foreigner, the fatherless, and the widow who are within your gates.

hausa: Suka kuma ba da rabo ga firistocin da aka rubuta ta iyalansu cikin tarihin zuriya, haka kuma ga Lawiyawa masu shekara ashirin ko fiye, bisa ga nawayarsu da kuma sassansu.
english: and those who were listed by genealogy of the priests by their fathers’ houses, and the Levites from twenty years old and upward, in their offices by their divisions;

hausa: Dutsen Sinai kuwa ya tunnuƙe duka da hayaƙi, gama Ubangiji ya sauko a bisan dutsen cikin wuta. Hayaƙin ya hau kamar hayaƙin da yake fitowa daga matoya, duk dutsen ya yi rawa da ƙarfi,
english: All of Mount Sinai smoked, because Yahweh descended on it in fire; and its smoke ascended like the smoke of a furnace, and the whole mountain quaked greatly.

hausa: Sa’an nan Elihu ya ce,
english: Moreover Elihu answered,

hausa: “Ya amsa ya ce, ‘To, ina roƙonka, ya uba, ka aiki Lazarus zuwa gidan mahaifina,
english: “He said, ‘I ask you therefore, father, that you would send him to my father’s house—

hausa: Sai suka kama shi suka kai shi gidan babban firist. Bitrus ya bi su daga nesa.
english: They seized him and led him away, and brought him into the high priest’s house. But Peter followed from a distance.

hausa: Gama zuciyar mutanen nan ta taurare; da ƙyar suke ji da kunnuwansu, sun kuma rufe idanunsu. Da ba haka ba, mai yiwuwa su gani da idanunsu, su kuma ji da kunnuwansu, su gane a zuciyarsu, su kuwa juya, in kuma warkar da su.’
english: for this people’s heart has grown callous, their ears are dull of hearing, and they have closed their eyes; or else perhaps they might perceive with their eyes, hear with their ears, understand with their heart, and would turn again, and I would heal them.’

hausa: Suka ce wa ’yan aikan da suka zo, “Ku faɗa wa mutanen Yabesh Gileyad, ‘Gobe, kafin rana tă yi zafi, za ku sami ceto.’ ” Sa’ad da ’yan aikan suka tafi, suka ba da saƙon nan ga mutanen Yabesh, sai suka farin ciki.
english: They said to the messengers who came, “Tell the men of Jabesh Gilead, ‘Tomorrow, by the time the sun is hot, you will be rescued.’” The messengers came and told the men of Jabesh; and they were glad.

hausa: Ben-Hesed, shi ne a Arubbot (Soko da dukan ƙasar Hefer);
english: Ben Hesed, in Arubboth (Socoh and all the land of Hepher belonged to him);

hausa: A wannan rana za a kasance da bagade ga Ubangiji a tsakiyar Masar, da kuma ginshiƙin dutse Ubangiji a iyakarta.
english: In that day, there will be an altar to Yahweh in the middle of the land of Egypt, and a pillar to Yahweh at its border.

hausa: Sai suka ɗauki bijimin da aka ba su suka shirya shi. Sa’an nan suka kira bisa sunan Ba’al daga safe har tsakar rana. Suna ihu, “Ya Ba’al, ka amsa mana!” Amma babu wata amsa, babu wani da ya amsa. Suka yi ta rawa kewaye da bagaden da suka yi.
english: They took the bull which was given them, and they dressed it, and called on the name of Baal from morning even until noon, saying, “Baal, hear us!” But there was no voice, and nobody answered. They leaped about the altar which was made.

hausa: Suka ƙara nemi bayani daga Ubangiji suka ce, “Mutumin ya zo nan kuwa?” Ubangiji ya ce, “I, ga shi can, ya ɓuya cikin kayayyaki.”
english: Therefore they asked of Yahweh further, “Is there yet a man to come here?” Yahweh answered, “Behold, he has hidden himself among the baggage.”

hausa: “Amma da a ce ni ne, da zan roƙi Allah; zan gaya masa damuwata.
english: “But as for me, I would seek God. I would commit my cause to God,

hausa: “Ku yi Bikin Girbi da nunan fari na amfanin shuke-shuken gonarku. “Ku yi Bikin Tattarawa a ƙarshen shekara, sa’ad da kuka tattara amfani daga gonarku.
english: And the feast of harvest, the first fruits of your labors, which you sow in the field; and the feast of ingathering, at the end of the year, when you gather in your labors out of the field.

hausa: Sai dai in wani ya ce muku, “Ai, wannan an miƙa ne wa gunki,” to, kada ku ci, saboda duban mutuncin wannan da ya gaya muku, don kuma lamiri yă kasance babu laifi
english: But if anyone says to you, “This was offered to idols,” don’t eat it for the sake of the one who told you, and for the sake of conscience. For “the earth is the Lord’s, with all its fullness.”

hausa: Sai Allah ya ce masa a cikin mafarki “I, na san ka yi wannan da kyakkyawan nufi, saboda haka ne na kiyaye ka daga yin mini zunubi. Shi ya sa ban bar ka ka taɓa ta ba.
english: God said to him in the dream, “Yes, I know that in the integrity of your heart you have done this, and I also withheld you from sinning against me. Therefore I didn’t allow you to touch her.

hausa: Mutane suka cika da mamaki, suka ce, “Kai, ya yi kome daidai. Har ma yana sa kurame su ji, bebaye kuma su yi magana.”
english: They were astonished beyond measure, saying, “He has done all things well. He makes even the deaf hear and the mute speak!”

hausa: Sai ya ce, “Wa ya faɗa maka cewa kana tsirara? Ko dai ka ci daga itacen da na umarce ka kada ka ci ne?”
english: God said, “Who told you that you were naked? Have you eaten from the tree that I commanded you not to eat from?”

hausa: Kin ƙi ni,” in ji Ubangiji. “Ki ci gaba da ja da baya. Ta haka zan ɗibiya hannuwana a kanki in hallaka ki; ba zan ƙara nuna miki jinƙai ba.
english: You have rejected me,” says Yahweh. “You have gone backward. Therefore I have stretched out my hand against you and destroyed you. I am weary of showing compassion.

hausa: Amma a bar kututturen da kuma saiwoyinsa, a daure shi da ƙarfe da kuma tagulla, a bar shi a cikin ƙasa, a cikin ciyayin filaye. “ ‘Bari yă jiƙu da raɓar, bari yă zauna cikin dabbobi tare da tsire-tsiren duniya.
english: Nevertheless leave the stump of its roots in the earth, even with a band of iron and bronze, in the tender grass of the field; and let it be wet with the dew of the sky. Let his portion be with the animals in the grass of the earth.

hausa: “Ga shi, ina gāba da kai, ya ke dutse mai hallakarwa, wadda ta hallaka duniya duka,” in ji Ubangiji. “Zan miƙa hannuna gāba da ke, zan mirgina ƙasa daga ƙwanƙolin dutse, zan maishe ki ƙonannen dutse.
english: “Behold, I am against you, destroying mountain,” says Yahweh, “which destroys all the earth. I will stretch out my hand on you, roll you down from the rocks, and will make you a burned mountain.

hausa: Rehobowam ya ƙaunaci Ma’aka ’yar Absalom fiye da sauran matansa da ƙwarƙwaransa. Duka-duka dai ya auri mata goma sha takwas da ƙwarƙwarai sittin, yana da ’ya’ya maza ashirin da takwas da ’ya’ya mata sittin.
english: Rehoboam loved Maacah the granddaughter of Absalom above all his wives and his concubines; for he took eighteen wives and sixty concubines, and became the father of twenty-eight sons and sixty daughters.

hausa: Yesu ya ce, “Ku, ku ba su wani abu su ci.” Sai suka ce masa, “Muna da burodi biyar da kifi biyu kaɗai. Sai dai, in mun je mu sayi abinci domin dukan wannan taron.”
english: But he said to them, “You give them something to eat.” They said, “We have no more than five loaves and two fish, unless we should go and buy food for all these people.”

hausa: Yesu ya tashi daga can ya tafi garinsa, tare da almajiransa.
english: He went out from there. He came into his own country, and his disciples followed him.

hausa: “Domin haka ka faɗa wa gidan Isra’ila, ‘Ga abin da Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka yana cewa za ku ƙazantar da kanku yadda kakanninku suka yi ne ku yi sha’awar mugayen siffofinsu?
english: “Therefore tell the house of Israel, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “Do you pollute yourselves in the way of your fathers? Do you play the prostitute after their abominations?

hausa: Tufafinsa suka zama fari suna ƙyalli, fiye da yadda wani a duniya zai iya yi su.
english: His clothing became glistening, exceedingly white, like snow, such as no launderer on earth can whiten them.

hausa: Ku ɗaga idanunku ku duba sammai. Wane ne ya halicce dukan waɗannan? Wane ne ya fitar da rundunar taurari ɗaya-ɗaya, yana kiransu, kowanne da sunansa. Saboda ikonsa mai girma da kuma ƙarfinsa mai girma, babu ko ɗayansu da ya ɓace.
english: Lift up your eyes on high, and see who has created these, who brings out their army by number. He calls them all by name. By the greatness of his might, and because he is strong in power, not one is lacking.

hausa: Saurara! Zan sa masa wani ruhun da zai sa yă ji wata jita-jitar da za tă sa yă koma ƙasarsa. A can zan sa a kashe shi da takobi a ƙasarsa.’ ”
english: Behold, I will put a spirit in him, and he will hear news, and will return to his own land. I will cause him to fall by the sword in his own land.”’”

hausa: Wannan abu mai sauƙi ne a wurin Ubangiji; zai kuma ba da Mowab a gare ku.
english: This is an easy thing in Yahweh’s sight. He will also deliver the Moabites into your hand.

hausa: Ba ya can sama, balle ku ce, “Wa zai hau sama yă kawo mana, yă kuma furta mana, don mu yi biyayya?”
english: It is not in heaven, that you should say, “Who will go up for us to heaven, bring it to us, and proclaim it to us, that we may do it?”

hausa: Zai yayyafa jinin a kan bagade da yatsarsa sau bakwai, yă tsabtacce shi yă kuma tsarkake shi daga ƙazantar Isra’ilawa.
english: He shall sprinkle some of the blood on it with his finger seven times, and cleanse it, and make it holy from the uncleanness of the children of Israel.

hausa: Ka juye kunnenka gare ni, ka zo da sauri ka cece ni; ka zama dutsen mafakata, mafaka mai ƙarfi na cetona.
english: Bow down your ear to me. Deliver me speedily. Be to me a strong rock, a house of defense to save me.

hausa: Sai na yi akwatin da itacen ƙirya, na kuma sassaƙa alluna biyu na dutse kamar na farko, sai na haura dutse da alluna biyun a hannuwana.
english: So I made an ark of acacia wood, and cut two stone tablets like the first, and went up onto the mountain, having the two tablets in my hand.

hausa: Iyayen suka amsa suka ce, “Mun dai san shi ɗanmu ne, mun kuma san cewa an haife shi makaho.
english: His parents answered them, “We know that this is our son, and that he was born blind;

hausa: Bayan wahala da baƙin ciki, Yahuda ta tafi bauta. Ta zauna a cikin ƙasashe, ba tă samu wurin hutawa ba. Duk masu fafararta sun same ta sa’ad da take cikin matuƙar ɓacin rai.
english: Judah has gone into captivity because of affliction and because of great servitude. She dwells among the nations. She finds no rest. All her persecutors overtook her in her distress.

hausa: Gama da ƙwazo ya ƙaryata Yahudawa a muhawwara a fili, yana tabbatar daga Nassosi cewa Yesu shi ne Kiristi.
english: for he powerfully refuted the Jews, publicly showing by the Scriptures that Jesus was the Christ.

hausa: Ba’al-Hanan mutumin Geder shi ne mai lura da itatuwan zaitun da na al’ul a gindin tuddan yamma. Yowash shi ne mai lura da tanadin man zaitun.
english: Over the olive trees and the sycamore trees that were in the lowland was Baal Hanan the Gederite. Over the cellars of oil was Joash.

hausa: Gama ka ji alkawarina, ya Allah; ka ba ni gādo na waɗanda suke tsoron sunanka.
english: For you, God, have heard my vows. You have given me the heritage of those who fear your name.

hausa: Yehoram ya sami wasiƙa daga Iliya annabi, wadda ta ce, “Ga abin da Ubangiji Allah na kakanka Dawuda ya ce, ‘Ba ka yi tafiya a hanyoyin mahaifinka Yehoshafat ko Asa sarkin Yahuda ba.
english: A letter came to him from Elijah the prophet, saying, “Yahweh, the God of David your father, says, ‘Because you have not walked in the ways of Jehoshaphat your father, nor in the ways of Asa king of Judah,

hausa: a wurin kuwa, akwai wata mace wadda aljani ya gurgunta, har na shekaru goma sha takwas. Duk ta tanƙware, ba ta ma iya miƙewa ko kaɗan.
english: Behold, there was a woman who had a spirit of infirmity eighteen years. She was bent over and could in no way straighten herself up.

hausa: ya kuma kawo bunsuru ɗaya domin hadaya don zunubi;
english: one male goat for a sin offering;

hausa: Shanunsu ba sa fasa haihuwa; suna haihuwa ba sa yin ɓari.
english: Their bulls breed without fail. Their cows calve, and don’t miscarry.

hausa: A cikin zamaninsa za a ceci Yahuda Isra’ila kuma zai zauna lafiya. Sunan da za a kira shi ke nan, Ubangiji Adalcinmu.
english: In his days Judah will be saved, and Israel will dwell safely. This is his name by which he will be called: Yahweh our righteousness.

hausa: Hannuna zai yi gāba da annabawan da suke ganin wahayin ƙarya suna kuma yin duban ƙarya. Ba za su kasance cikin taron mutanena ba, ba kuwa za a rubuta su a littafin gidan Isra’ila ba, ba za su shiga ƙasar Isra’ila ba. Ta haka za ku san cewa ni ne Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka.
english: “My hand will be against the prophets who see false visions and who utter lying divinations. They will not be in the council of my people, neither will they be written in the writing of the house of Israel, neither will they enter into the land of Israel. Then you will know that I am the Lord Yahweh.”

hausa: Sai Shawulu ya ce wa Keniyawa, “Ku tashi ku bar Amalekawa don kada in hallaka ku tare da su, saboda kun yi wa dukan Isra’ilawa kirki, lokacin da suka fito daga Masar.” Saboda haka Keniyawa suka tashi suka bar Amalekawa.
english: Saul said to the Kenites, “Go, depart, go down from among the Amalekites, lest I destroy you with them; for you showed kindness to all the children of Israel when they came up out of Egypt.” So the Kenites departed from among the Amalekites.

hausa: zuwa Masar, wadda taimakonta marar amfani ne. Saboda haka na yi mata laƙabi Rahab Marar Yin Kome.
english: For Egypt helps in vain, and to no purpose; therefore I have called her Rahab who sits still.

hausa: Baƙi sun tsotse ƙarfinsa, amma bai gane ba. Gashi kansa ya cika da furfura, amma bai lura ba.
english: Strangers have devoured his strength, and he doesn’t realize it. Indeed, gray hairs are here and there on him, and he doesn’t realize it.

hausa: Sai ya ɗaga kai ya ce, “Ina ganin mutane, suna kama da itatuwa da suke tafiya.”
english: He looked up, and said, “I see men, but I see them like walking trees.”

hausa: Da mutumin ya ga cewa bai fi ƙarfin Yaƙub ba, sai ya bugi kwarin ƙashin cinyar Yaƙub, sai gaɓar ƙashin cinyarsa ya goce, a sa’ad da yake kokawa da mutumin.
english: When he saw that he didn’t prevail against him, the man touched the hollow of his thigh, and the hollow of Jacob’s thigh was strained as he wrestled.

hausa: Ba kome a cikin akwatin alkawarin, sai dai alluna na dutse guda biyu waɗanda Musa ya ajiye a ciki tun a Horeb, inda Ubangiji ya yi alkawari da Isra’ilawa bayan sun fito Masar.
english: There was nothing in the ark except the two stone tablets which Moses put there at Horeb, when Yahweh made a covenant with the children of Israel, when they came out of the land of Egypt.

hausa: Sai Farisiyawa suka fita, suka fara ƙulla shawara da mutanen Hiridus yadda za su kashe Yesu.
english: The Pharisees went out, and immediately conspired with the Herodians against him, how they might destroy him.

hausa: bagaden turare da sandunansa, man shafewa da turare mai ƙanshi; da labulen ƙofar shiga tabanakul;
english: and the altar of incense with its poles, the anointing oil, the sweet incense, the screen for the door, at the door of the tabernacle;

hausa: Saboda haka gaskiya ta yi nisa da mu, adalci kuma ba ya kaiwa gare mu. Muna neman haske, sai ga duhu; muna neman haske, sai muka yi ta tafiya cikin baƙin inuwa.
english: Therefore justice is far from us, and righteousness doesn’t overtake us. We look for light, but see darkness; for brightness, but we walk in obscurity.

hausa: Almajiran ba su gane da ko ɗaya daga cikin wannan ba. An ɓoye musu ma’anarsa, kuma ba su gane da abin da yake magana a kai ba.
english: They understood none of these things. This saying was hidden from them, and they didn’t understand the things that were said.

hausa: Dole a ci gaba da shirya fitilu a kan wurin ajiye fitila na zinariya, a gaban Ubangiji.
english: He shall keep in order the lamps on the pure gold lamp stand before Yahweh continually.

hausa: Sa’ad da ƙarfina ya kāre a cikina, kai ne wanda ya san hanyata. A hanyar da nake tafiya mutane sun kafa mini tarko.
english: When my spirit was overwhelmed within me, you knew my route. On the path in which I walk, they have hidden a snare for me.

hausa: Siman Bitrus, Toma (wanda ake kira Didaimus), Natanayel daga Kana ta Galili, ’ya’yan Zebedi maza, da kuma waɗansu almajirai guda biyu suna tare.
english: Simon Peter, Thomas called Didymus, Nathanael of Cana in Galilee, and the sons of Zebedee, and two others of his disciples were together.

hausa: Ta fi lu’ulu’u daraja; ba a kwatanta abin da ka fi sha’awa da ita.
english: She is more precious than rubies. None of the things you can desire are to be compared to her.

hausa: abin da masu hikima suka ce, ba tare da sun ɓoye wani abu da suka samu daga wurin iyayensu ba
english: (which wise men have told by their fathers, and have not hidden it;

hausa: Sa’an nan hafsoshin za su ƙara da cewa, “Ko akwai wani da yake tsoro, ko ya karai? Bari yă tafi gida don kada ’yan’uwansa su karai su ma.”
english: The officers shall speak further to the people, and they shall say, “What man is there who is fearful and faint-hearted? Let him go and return to his house, lest his brother’s heart melt as his heart.”

hausa: Saboda haka ya rantse musu ya kuma ɗaga hannu cewa zai sa su mutu a cikin hamada,
english: Therefore he swore to them that he would overthrow them in the wilderness,

hausa: Ashe, ba dole ne in ji tausayin babban birnin nan Ninebe mai mutum sama da dubu ɗari da ashirin (120,000) marasa alhaki, da kuma dabbobi masu yawa ba?”
english: Shouldn’t I be concerned for Nineveh, that great city, in which are more than one hundred twenty thousand persons who can’t discern between their right hand and their left hand, and also many animals?”

hausa: Ɗaukakar Allah ce a ɓoye batun; a bayyana batun kuwa ɗaukakar sarakuna ne.
english: It is the glory of God to conceal a thing, but the glory of kings is to search out a matter.

hausa: Ubangiji kuma ya ce wa Musa,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

hausa: fatun rago da aka rina ja, da fatun shanun teku; da itacen ƙirya
english: rams’ skins dyed red, sea cow hides, acacia wood,

hausa: A tattara mutane; ku tsarkake taron; ku kawo dattawa wuri ɗaya; ku kuma tara yara, da waɗanda suke shan mama. Bari ango yă bar ɗakinsa amarya kuma lolokinta.
english: Gather the people. Sanctify the assembly. Assemble the elders. Gather the children, and those who nurse from breasts. Let the bridegroom go out of his room, and the bride out of her chamber.

hausa: Waɗanda sukan ziyarce ni, da masu yi mini aiki mata sun ɗauke ni baƙo.
english: Those who dwell in my house and my maids consider me a stranger. I am an alien in their sight.

hausa: Ba za ka durƙusa gare su, ko ka yi musu sujada ba. Gama ni, Ubangiji Allahnka mai kishi ne, nakan hukunta ’ya’ya har tsara ta uku da ta huɗu na waɗanda suke ƙina,
english: you shall not bow yourself down to them, nor serve them, for I, Yahweh your God, am a jealous God, visiting the iniquity of the fathers on the children, on the third and on the fourth generation of those who hate me,

hausa: ‘Ba shakka an hallaka maƙiyanmu, wuta kuma ta ƙona dukiyarsu.’
english: saying, ‘Surely those who rose up against us are cut off. The fire has consumed their remnant.’

hausa: Sai Bilatus ya sāke yin musu magana don yana so ya saki Yesu.
english: Then Pilate spoke to them again, wanting to release Jesus,

hausa: Wahayin da na gani ya yi kamar wahayin da na gani sa’ad da ya zo don yă hallaka birnin, kamar kuma wahayin da na gani kusa da Kogin Kebar, na kuwa fāɗi rubda ciki.
english: It was like the appearance of the vision which I saw, even according to the vision that I saw when I came to destroy the city; and the visions were like the vision that I saw by the river Chebar; and I fell on my face.

hausa: An lissafta kwanakin mutum; ka riga ka ɗibar masa watanni, ka yi masa iyaka, ba zai iya wuce iyakar ba.
english: Seeing his days are determined, the number of his months is with you, and you have appointed his bounds that he can’t pass.

hausa: Shawulu ya sami labari game da wannan, sai ya sāke aiken waɗansu da yawa. Su ma suka shiga yin annabci. Shawulu ya sāke aiken mutane sau na uku, su kuma suka shiga yin annabci.
english: When Saul was told, he sent other messengers, and they also prophesied. Saul sent messengers again the third time, and they also prophesied.

hausa: yana cewa, “Yabo ya tabbata ga Ubangiji Allah na maigidana Ibrahim, wanda bai daina nuna alheri da amincinsa ga maigidana ba. Ni kam, Ubangiji ya bishe ni a tafiyata zuwa gidan ’yan’uwan maigidana.”
english: He said, “Blessed be Yahweh, the God of my master Abraham, who has not forsaken his loving kindness and his truth toward my master. As for me, Yahweh has led me on the way to the house of my master’s relatives.”

hausa: A cikin jeji suna tsinkar ganyaye marasa daɗi, jijiyoyin itacen kwakwa ne abincinsu.
english: They pluck salt herbs by the bushes. The roots of the broom tree are their food.

hausa: “Ku ne hasken duniya. Birnin da yake a bisan tudu ba ya ɓoyuwa.
english: “You are the light of the world. A city located on a hill can’t be hidden.

hausa: Ya taimaki bawansa Isra’ila, yana tunawa yă nuna jinƙai
english: He has given help to Israel, his servant, that he might remember mercy,

hausa: Sai Yesu ya sāke kiran taron wurinsa ya ce, “Ku saurare ni dukanku, ku kuma fahimci wannan.
english: He called all the multitude to himself and said to them, “Hear me, all of you, and understand.

hausa: Ubangiji Allah ya kuma ce, “To, fa, mutum ya zama kamar ɗaya daga cikinmu, ya san abin da yake mai kyau da abin da yake mugu. Kada a yarda yă miƙa hannunsa yă ɗiba daga itacen rai yă ci, yă kuma rayu har abada.”
english: Yahweh God said, “Behold, the man has become like one of us, knowing good and evil. Now, lest he reach out his hand, and also take of the tree of life, and eat, and live forever—”

hausa: Ya ce, “Ashe, ba ku da saurin ganewa? Ba ku gane cewa ba abin da yake shiga mutum daga waje ba ne yake ƙazantar da shi.
english: He said to them, “Are you also without understanding? Don’t you perceive that whatever goes into the man from outside can’t defile him,

hausa: Na huɗu, don wata na huɗu, shi ne Asahel ɗan’uwan Yowab; ɗansa Zebadiya shi ne magājinsa. Akwai mutane 24,000 a sashensa.
english: The fourth captain for the fourth month was Asahel the brother of Joab, and Zebadiah his son after him. In his division were twenty-four thousand.

hausa: Lokacin da Dawuda yake a jeji, ya ji labari cewa Nabal yana askin tumaki.
english: David heard in the wilderness that Nabal was shearing his sheep.

hausa: “Babu wanda yakan ƙuna fitila sa’an nan ya ɓoye ta, ko ya rufe ta da murfi ba. A maimako, yakan ajiye ta a kan wurin ajiye fitila, don masu shiga su ga haske.
english: “No one, when he has lit a lamp, puts it in a cellar or under a basket, but on a stand, that those who come in may see the light.

hausa: Ira ɗan Ikkesh daga Tekowa, Abiyezer daga Anatot,
english: Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite, Abiezer the Anathothite,

hausa: Duk sa’ad da wani ya zo ganina, yakan yi maganar ƙarya, yayinda zuciyarsa tana tattare da cin zarafi; sa’an nan yă fita yă yi ta bazawa ko’ina.
english: If he comes to see me, he speaks falsehood. His heart gathers iniquity to itself. When he goes abroad, he tells it.

hausa: Yonatan ya kai wa Filistiyawa hari a Geba, sai Filistiyawa suka sami labarin. Sai Shawulu ya sa aka busa ƙaho ko’ina a ƙasar ya ce, “Bari Ibraniyawa su ji!”
english: Jonathan struck the garrison of the Philistines that was in Geba, and the Philistines heard of it. Saul blew the trumpet throughout all the land, saying, “Let the Hebrews hear!”

hausa: Muddin in raye, in ji Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka, ’yar’uwarki Sodom da ’ya’yanta mata ba su yi abin da ’ya’yanki mata suka yi ba.
english: As I live,” says the Lord Yahweh, “Sodom your sister has not done, she nor her daughters, as you have done, you and your daughters.

hausa: duk da haka za ka jefa ni cikin ƙazamin wuri, yadda ko rigunan jikina ma za su ƙi ni.
english: yet you will plunge me in the ditch. My own clothes will abhor me.

hausa: Zan ba ku duk ƙasar da za ku taka, kamar yadda na yi wa Musa alkawari.
english: I have given you every place that the sole of your foot will tread on, as I told Moses.

hausa: Ku da kuke da nesa, ku ji abin da na yi; ku da kuke kusa, ku san ikona!
english: Hear, you who are far off, what I have done; and, you who are near, acknowledge my might.”

hausa: Ga kuma abin da ya aika wa mahaifinsa, jakuna goma da aka jibge da abubuwa mafi kyau na Masar, da jakuna mata guda goma ɗauke da hatsi da burodi da waɗansu tanade-tanade don tafiyarsa.
english: He sent the following to his father: ten donkeys loaded with the good things of Egypt, and ten female donkeys loaded with grain and bread and provision for his father by the way.

hausa: Akwai takobi a kan dawakanta da kekunan yaƙinta da kuma dukan baƙin da suke cikin mayaƙanta! Za su zama mata. Akwai takobi a kan dukiyarta! Za a washe su.
english: A sword is on their horses, on their chariots, and on all the mixed people who are in the middle of her; and they will become as women. A sword is on her treasures, and they will be robbed.

hausa: In wani ya ɗauki kansa mai addini ne duk da haka bai ƙame harshensa ba, ruɗin kansa yake yi addininsa kuwa banza ne.
english: If anyone among you thinks himself to be religious while he doesn’t bridle his tongue, but deceives his heart, this man’s religion is worthless.

hausa: Sai Yesu ya ce wa Yahudawan da suka gaskata da shi, “In dai kun riƙe koyarwata, ku almajiraina ne da gaske.
english: Jesus therefore said to those Jews who had believed him, “If you remain in my word, then you are truly my disciples.

hausa: Waɗanda nake ƙauna su nake tsawata wa, nake kuma horo. Saboda haka ka yi himma ka tuba.
english: As many as I love, I reprove and chasten. Be zealous therefore, and repent.

hausa: Ya rarraba kyautansa ga matalauta, adalcinsa zai dawwama har abada; za a ɗaga ƙahonsa sama da bangirma.
english: He has dispersed, he has given to the poor. His righteousness endures forever. His horn will be exalted with honor.

hausa: Haka ma Ubangiji ya umarta cewa ya kamata waɗanda suke wa’azin bishara, su sami abin biyan bukatarsu daga bisharar.
english: Even so the Lord ordained that those who proclaim the Good News should live from the Good News.

hausa: “Kome suke yi, suna yi ne don mutane su gani. Sukan yi layunsufantam-fantam bakin rigunarsu kuma sukan kai har ƙasa;
english: But they do all their works to be seen by men. They make their phylacteries broad and enlarge the fringes of their garments,

hausa: Shaiɗan ya amsa ya ce, “Fata don fata! Mutum zai iya rabuwa da duk abin da yake da shi domin ransa.
english: Satan answered Yahweh, and said, “Skin for skin. Yes, all that a man has he will give for his life.

hausa: Akwai kuma tebur huɗu da aka yi da sassaƙaƙƙun duwatsu don hadayun ƙonawa, tsawon kowanne kuwa kamu ɗaya da rabi ne, fāɗinsa kamu ɗaya da rabi, tsayinsa kuma kamu ɗaya. A kansu ne a kan ajiye kayan yanka hadayun ƙonawa da kuma sauran hadayu.
english: There were four cut stone tables for the burnt offering, a cubit and a half long, a cubit and a half wide, and one cubit high. They laid the instruments with which they killed the burnt offering and the sacrifice on them.

hausa: ƙasar Masar kuma tana gabanka, ka zaunar da mahaifinka da ’yan’uwanka a sashe mafi kyau na ƙasar, bari su zauna a Goshen. Idan kuma ka ga waɗansu a cikinsu da suka fi dacewa, sai ka sa su lura mini da shanuna.”
english: The land of Egypt is before you. Make your father and your brothers dwell in the best of the land. Let them dwell in the land of Goshen. If you know any able men among them, then put them in charge of my livestock.”

hausa: Yusuf ya ce wa mahaifinsa, “Su ne ’ya’yan da Allah ya ba ni a nan.” Sa’an nan Isra’ila ya ce, “Kawo mini su saboda in albarkace su.”
english: Joseph said to his father, “They are my sons, whom God has given me here.” He said, “Please bring them to me, and I will bless them.”

hausa: Waɗanda suke waje kuwa karnuka ne, masu sihiri, masu fasikanci, masu kisankai, masu bautar gumaka, da duk wanda yake ƙaunar ƙarya yake kuma aikata ta.
english: Outside are the dogs, the sorcerers, the sexually immoral, the murderers, the idolaters, and everyone who loves and practices falsehood.

hausa: Shawulu ya ce wa Mikal, “Don me kika ruɗe ni har kika bar maƙiyina ya gudu ya tsere?” Mikal ta ce masa, “Ya ce mini, ‘Idan ban bar shi ya tafi ba, zai kashe ni?’ ”
english: Saul said to Michal, “Why have you deceived me like this and let my enemy go, so that he has escaped?” Michal answered Saul, “He said to me, ‘Let me go! Why should I kill you?’”

hausa: Kamar makafi, sai lallubar bango muke yi, muna lallubawar hanyarmu kamar marasa idanu. Da tsakar rana muna tuntuɓe sai ka ce wuri ya fara duhu; cikin ƙarfafa, mun zama kamar matattu.
english: We grope for the wall like the blind. Yes, we grope as those who have no eyes. We stumble at noon as if it were twilight. Among those who are strong, we are like dead men.

hausa: Ya sa masa ƙyallen maƙalawa a ƙirji, ya kuma sa Urim da Tummim a ƙyallen maƙalawa a ƙirjin.
english: He placed the breastplate on him. He put the Urim and Thummim in the breastplate.

hausa: Ya sayi fili daga ’ya’yan Hamor maza, mahaifin Shekem inda ya kafa tentinsa, a bakin azurfa ɗari.
english: He bought the parcel of ground where he had spread his tent, at the hand of the children of Hamor, Shechem’s father, for one hundred pieces of money.

hausa: “Zauna shiru, tafi cikin duhu, Diyar Babiloniya; ba za a ƙara kira ke sarauniyar masarautai.
english: “Sit in silence, and go into darkness, daughter of the Chaldeans. For you shall no longer be called the mistress of kingdoms.

hausa: Ya ce, “Ranku yă daɗe, ina roƙonku ku ratsa zuwa gidan bawanku. Ku wanke ƙafafunku, ku kwana, sa’an nan ku kama hanyarku da sassafe.” Suka ce, “A’a, za mu kwana a dandali.”
english: and he said, “See now, my lords, please come into your servant’s house, stay all night, wash your feet, and you can rise up early, and go on your way.” They said, “No, but we will stay in the street all night.”

hausa: Sai dukansu suka yi tambaya suka ce, “Wato, kai Ɗan Allah ke nan?” Ya amsa ya ce, “Kun faɗa daidai, ni ne.”
english: They all said, “Are you then the Son of God?” He said to them, “You say it, because I am.”

hausa: Idanuna za su kasance a kan amintattu a cikin ƙasar, don su zauna tare da ni; tafiyarsa ba ta da zargi zai yi mini hidima.
english: My eyes will be on the faithful of the land, that they may dwell with me. He who walks in a perfect way, he will serve me.

hausa: Suna kiran juna, “Mai Tsarki, Mai Tsarki, Mai Tsarki! Ubangiji Maɗaukaki ne; duniya ta cika da ɗaukakarsa.”
english: One called to another, and said, “Holy, holy, holy, is Yahweh of Armies! The whole earth is full of his glory!”

hausa: Sa’ad da kwanakin makoki suka wuce, sai Yusuf ya ce wa iyalin gidan Fir’auna, “In na sami tagomashi a idanunku, ku yi magana da Fir’auna domina. Ku faɗa masa,
english: When the days of weeping for him were past, Joseph spoke to Pharaoh’s staff, saying, “If now I have found favor in your eyes, please speak in the ears of Pharaoh, saying,

hausa: Ubangiji ya ce, “Tabbatacce zan cece ka don alheri; tabbatacce zan sa abokan gābanka su yi roƙo gare ka a lokacin masifa da kuma lokacin wahala.
english: Yahweh said, “Most certainly I will strengthen you for good. Most certainly I will cause the enemy to make supplication to you in the time of evil and in the time of affliction.

hausa: Sai Musa ya ɗaga hannu, ya bugi dutsen sau biyu da sandansa. Ruwa kuwa ya yi ta kwararowa, jama’a da dabbobinsu suka sha.
english: Moses lifted up his hand, and struck the rock with his rod twice, and water came out abundantly. The congregation and their livestock drank.

hausa: Amma duk wanda yake jin kalmomin nan nawa bai kuwa aikata su ba, yana kama da wani wawa wanda ya gina gidansa a kan yashi.
english: Everyone who hears these words of mine and doesn’t do them will be like a foolish man who built his house on the sand.

hausa: Kana sāke kawo sababbin waɗanda za su ba da shaida a kaina kana ƙara haushinka a kaina; kana ƙara kawo mini hari.
english: You renew your witnesses against me, and increase your indignation on me. Changes and warfare are with me.

hausa: Cikin waɗannan wasiƙu ta rubuta, “Ku yi shelar ranar azumi, ku zaunar da Nabot a wuri mai martaba a cikin mutane.
english: She wrote in the letters, saying, “Proclaim a fast, and set Naboth on high among the people.

hausa: Sa’ad da Liyatu ta ga cewa ta daina haihuwa, sai ta ɗauki mai hidimarta Zilfa ta ba da ita ga Yaƙub tă zama matarsa.
english: When Leah saw that she had finished bearing, she took Zilpah, her servant, and gave her to Jacob as a wife.

hausa: La’ananne ne fushinsu, mai tsanani ne ƙwarai, hasalarsu kuwa, muguwa ce ƙwarai! Zan warwatsa su cikin Yaƙub in kuma daidaita su cikin Isra’ila.
english: Cursed be their anger, for it was fierce; and their wrath, for it was cruel. I will divide them in Jacob, and scatter them in Israel.

hausa: ’Ya’yan Shemahiya maza su ne, Otni, Rafayel, Obed da Elzabad; danginsa Elihu da Shemahiya su ma jarumawa ne.
english: The sons of Shemaiah: Othni, Rephael, Obed, and Elzabad, whose relatives were valiant men, Elihu, and Semachiah.

hausa: Ƙasar da kuke shiga, ku karɓa, ba kamar ƙasar Masar ba ce, inda kuka fito, inda kuka shuka iri, ku yi ta zuwa kuna banruwa kamar lambu.
english: For the land, where you go in to possess isn’t like the land of Egypt that you came out of, where you sowed your seed and watered it with your foot, as a garden of herbs;

hausa: Da kowane ɗan rago don hadaya ta ƙonawa, a shirya kwalaba ɗaya na ruwan inabi, a matsayin hadaya ta sha.
english: You shall prepare wine for the drink offering, one fourth of a hin, with the burnt offering or for the sacrifice, for each lamb.

hausa: Saboda haka Yesu ya ce, “Sa’ad da kuka ɗaga Ɗan Mutum, a sa’an nan ne za ku san cewa ni ne wannan da na ce nake. Ni kuwa ba na yin kome ni kaɗai, sai in dai faɗi abin da Uba ya koya mini.
english: Jesus therefore said to them, “When you have lifted up the Son of Man, then you will know that I am he, and I do nothing of myself, but as my Father taught me, I say these things.

hausa: Sa’ad da suka fita daga cikin ruwan, sai Ruhun Ubangiji ya fyauce Filibus, bābān kuwa bai ƙara ganinsa ba, amma ya ci gaba da tafiyarsa yana farin ciki.
english: When they came up out of the water, the Spirit of the Lord caught Philip away, and the eunuch didn’t see him any more, for he went on his way rejoicing.

hausa: Sai Bulus ya ce masa, “Allah zai buge ka, kai farin bango! Ka zauna a can kana hukunta ni bisa ga doka, ga shi kai kanka kana ƙetare dokar ta wurin ba da umarni a buge ni!”
english: Then Paul said to him, “God will strike you, you whitewashed wall! Do you sit to judge me according to the law, and command me to be struck contrary to the law?”

hausa: Eliyashib babban firist da ’yan’uwansa firistoci suka tashi suka sāke gina Ƙofar Tumaki. Suka tsarkake ta, suka sa ƙofofinta a wurarensu, suka yi ginin har Hasumiyar Ɗari, wadda suka tsarkake, da kuma Hasumiyar Hananel.
english: Then Eliashib the high priest rose up with his brothers the priests, and they built the sheep gate. They sanctified it, and set up its doors. They sanctified it even to the tower of Hammeah, to the tower of Hananel.

hausa: “Haka zai zama ga duk wanda ya tara wa kansa dukiya, amma ba shi da arziki a gaban Allah.”
english: So is he who lays up treasure for himself, and is not rich toward God.”

hausa: Zan kashe ’ya’yanta. Sa’an nan dukan ikkilisiyoyi za su san cewa ni ne mai bincika zukata da tunani, zan kuwa sāka wa kowannenku gwargwadon ayyukansa.
english: I will kill her children with Death, and all the assemblies will know that I am he who searches the minds and hearts. I will give to each one of you according to your deeds.

hausa: Zan tsarkake su daga dukan zunubin da suka yi mini zan kuma gafarta musu dukan zunubansu na yin mini tawaye.
english: I will cleanse them from all their iniquity by which they have sinned against me. I will pardon all their iniquities by which they have sinned against me and by which they have transgressed against me.

hausa: A maimakon haka ku bayar hannu sake, ku kuma ba shi bashi gwargwadon abin da yake bukata a sauƙaƙe.
english: but you shall surely open your hand to him, and shall surely lend him sufficient for his need, which he lacks.

hausa: Ƙyallen maƙalawa a ƙirjin murabba’i ne, aka ninka shi biyu, tsawonsa da fāɗinsa kamu ɗaya-ɗaya ne.
english: It was square. They made the breastplate double. Its length was a span, and its width a span, being double.

hausa: Amma in ba ku kiyaye waɗannan umarnai ba, in ji Ubangiji, na rantse da kaina cewa wannan fada za tă zama kufai.’ ”
english: But if you will not hear these words, I swear by myself,” says Yahweh, “that this house will become a desolation.”’”

hausa: Mutane dai suka ci gaba da miƙa hadayu a masujadai kan tudu, amma wa Ubangiji Allahnsu kaɗai.
english: Nevertheless the people still sacrificed in the high places, but only to Yahweh their God.

hausa: kwanon zinariya ɗaya mai nauyin shekel goma, cike da turaren hayaƙi;
english: one golden ladle of ten shekels, full of incense;

hausa: Sa’an nan ya ɗauki kwaf, ya yi godiya, ya kuma ba su, yana cewa, “Ku shassha daga cikinsa, dukanku.
english: He took the cup, gave thanks, and gave to them, saying, “All of you drink it,

hausa: Amma in ba ku yi mini biyayya ba, ba ku kiyaye ranar Asabbaci da tsarki ba, kuka ɗauki wani kaya yayinda kuke shiga ƙofofin Urushalima a ranar Asabbaci, to, sai in cinna wa ƙofofin Urushalima wutar da ba a iya kashewa, tă cinye kagaranta.’ ”
english: But if you will not listen to me to make the Sabbath day holy, and not to bear a burden and enter in at the gates of Jerusalem on the Sabbath day, then I will kindle a fire in its gates, and it will devour the palaces of Jerusalem. It will not be quenched.”’”

hausa: Yesu ya juya ya ce wa Bitrus, “Rabu da ni, Shaiɗan! Kai abin sa tuntuɓe ne a gare ni; ba ka tunanin al’amuran Allah, sai dai al’amuran mutane.”
english: But he turned and said to Peter, “Get behind me, Satan! You are a stumbling block to me, for you are not setting your mind on the things of God, but on the things of men.”

hausa: waɗanda kullum idanunsu masu kallon reni ne, waɗanda kallon da suke yi na daurin gira ne;
english: There is a generation, oh how lofty are their eyes! Their eyelids are lifted up.

hausa: Maƙeran zinariya da ’yan kasuwa suka gyara wani sashi tsakanin ɗakin da yake bisa kusurwa da Ƙofar Tumaki.
english: Between the ascent of the corner and the sheep gate, the goldsmiths and the merchants made repairs.

hausa: A cikin annabawan Urushalima kuma na ga wani abin bantsoro. Suna zina suna kuma rayuwar ƙarya. Sun ƙarfafa hannuwa masu aikata mugunta, domin kada wani ya juya daga muguntarsa. Dukansu sun yi kama da Sodom a gare ni; mutanen Urushalima sun yi kama da Gomorra.”
english: In the prophets of Jerusalem I have also seen a horrible thing: they commit adultery and walk in lies. They strengthen the hands of evildoers, so that no one returns from his wickedness. They have all become to me as Sodom, and its inhabitants as Gomorrah.”

hausa: Ba baƙon da ya taɓa kwana a titi, gama koyaushe ƙofata tana buɗe domin matafiya,
english: (the foreigner has not camped in the street, but I have opened my doors to the traveler);

hausa: Birane na cikin ƙasar tuddai kuwa, su ne, Shamir, Yattir, Soko,
english: In the hill country, Shamir, Jattir, Socoh,

hausa: Yabi Ubangiji. Yabi Ubangiji daga sammai, yabe shi a bisa sammai.
english: Praise Yah! Praise Yahweh from the heavens! Praise him in the heights!

hausa: Bayan an haifi Set, Adamu ya yi shekaru 800, ya kuma haifi waɗansu ’ya’ya maza da mata.
english: The days of Adam after he became the father of Seth were eight hundred years, and he became the father of other sons and daughters.

hausa: Yahuda ya haifi Ferez da Zera, waɗanda Tamar ce mahaifiyarsu; Ferez ya haifi Hezron, Hezron ya haifi Ram,
english: Judah became the father of Perez and Zerah by Tamar. Perez became the father of Hezron. Hezron became the father of Ram.

hausa: “Tekel, An kuma auna ka a ma’auni aka tarar ka kāsa.
english: TEKEL: you are weighed in the balances, and are found wanting.

hausa: Bari dukan waɗanda suke farin ciki a kaina a wahalata su sha kunya su kuma ruɗe; bari dukan waɗanda suke ɗaukar kansu sun fi ni su sha kunya da wulaƙanci.
english: Let them be disappointed and confounded together who rejoice at my calamity. Let them be clothed with shame and dishonor who magnify themselves against me.

hausa: Zan gangara zuwa Masar tare da kai, tabbatacce zan sāke dawo da kai. Kuma hannun Yusuf zai rufe idanunka.”
english: I will go down with you into Egypt. I will also surely bring you up again. Joseph’s hand will close your eyes.”

hausa: Yehoshafat ya huta tare da kakanninsa, aka kuma binne shi tare da su a Birnin Dawuda. Sai Yehoram ɗansa ya gāje shi a matsayin sarki.
english: Jehoshaphat slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in David’s city; and Jehoram his son reigned in his place.

hausa: Zaki ya kashe abin da ya ishe ’ya’yansa ya kuma murɗe wuyan dabbobi ya cika wurin zamansa da abin da ya kama ya cika kogwanninsa da abin da ya kashe.
english: The lion tore in pieces enough for his cubs, and strangled prey for his lionesses, and filled his caves with the kill and his dens with prey.

hausa: Yesu kuwa ya yi girma, ya kuma ƙaru cikin hikima, ya kuma sami tagomashi a wurin Allah da mutane.
english: And Jesus increased in wisdom and stature, and in favor with God and men.

hausa: Sai maganar Ubangiji ta zo wa Iliya cewa,
english: Yahweh’s word came to him, saying,

hausa: Ba a yanke abinci a idanunmu, farin ciki da kuma murna daga gidan Allahnmu ba?
english: Isn’t the food cut off before our eyes, joy and gladness from the house of our God?

hausa: Za su koyar da mutanena bambanci tsakanin tsarki da rashin tsarki su kuma nuna musu yadda za su bambanta marar tsarki da mai tsarki.
english: They shall teach my people the difference between the holy and the common, and cause them to discern between the unclean and the clean.

hausa: “Ga iri jerin kayan da za ka karɓo daga hannunsu, “zinariya, da azurfa, tagulla,
english: This is the offering which you shall take from them: gold, silver, bronze,

hausa: “Zan mai da Urushalima tsibin kufai, wurin zaman diloli; zan kuma lalace garuruwan Yahuda saboda haka ba wanda zai zauna a can.”
english: “I will make Jerusalem heaps, a dwelling place of jackals. I will make the cities of Judah a desolation, without inhabitant.”

hausa: Aka ba ta lallausan lilin, mai haske da tsabta ta sanya.” (Lallausan lilin yana misalta ayyukan adalci na tsarkaka.)
english: It was given to her that she would array herself in bright, pure, fine linen, for the fine linen is the righteous acts of the saints.

hausa: Ya kawo mu wannan wuri, ya kuma ba mu wannan ƙasa, ƙasa mai zub da madara da kuma zuma;
english: and he has brought us into this place, and has given us this land, a land flowing with milk and honey.

hausa: Ko kuwa misali, mu dubi jiragen ruwa, mana. Ko da yake suna da girma ƙwarai kuma iska mai ƙarfi ce take tura su, ana tuƙa su da ɗan ƙaramin sandan ƙarfe ne zuwa duk inda mai tuƙin jirgin yake so.
english: Behold, the ships also, though they are so big and are driven by fierce winds, are yet guided by a very small rudder, wherever the pilot desires.

hausa: Duka-duka dai a ba Lawiyawa garuruwa arba’in da takwas, tare da wuraren kiwonsu.
english: All the cities which you shall give to the Levites shall be forty-eight cities together with their pasture lands.

hausa: Sai Tamar ta zuba toka a kanta, ta kuma yayyage doguwar riga mai kayan adon da take sanye da shi. Ta sa hannunta a kai, ta tafi tana kuka da ƙarfi.
english: Tamar put ashes on her head, and tore her garment of various colors that was on her; and she laid her hand on her head and went her way, crying aloud as she went.

hausa: “ ‘In mutum ya kwana da matar mahaifinsa, ya ƙasƙantar da mahaifinsa. Dole a kashe shi da macen, alhakin jininsu zai zauna a kansu.
english: “‘The man who lies with his father’s wife has uncovered his father’s nakedness. Both of them shall surely be put to death. Their blood shall be upon themselves.

hausa: “A zamanin Shamgar ɗan Anat, a zamanin Yayel, an yashe dukan hanyoyi; matafiye suka bi hanyoyin da suka yi kona-kona.
english: “In the days of Shamgar the son of Anath, in the days of Jael, the highways were unoccupied. The travelers walked through byways.

hausa: Ya Diyar Sihiyona, hukuncinki zai ƙare; ba zai sa zaman bautarki yă yi tsayi ba. Amma ya Diyar Edom, zai hukunta zunubinki yă tona tsiraicinki.
english: The punishment of your iniquity is accomplished, daughter of Zion. He will no more carry you away into captivity. He will visit your iniquity, daughter of Edom. He will uncover your sins.

hausa: “Na sha wahala da yawa don in yi tanadi talentin dubu ɗari na zinariya, talenti miliyon na azurfa, ɗumbun tagulla da ƙarfe da suka wuce ƙirge da katako da dutse saboda haikalin Ubangiji. Za ka iya ƙara su.
english: Now, behold, in my affliction I have prepared for Yahweh’s house one hundred thousand talents of gold, one million talents of silver, and bronze and iron without weight; for it is in abundance. I have also prepared timber and stone; and you may add to them.

hausa: Ku kiyaye kanku daga yawan son kuɗi, ku kuma gamsu da abin da kuke da shi, gama Allah ya ce, “Ba zan taɓa bar ka ba; ba zan taɓa yashe ka ba.”
english: Be free from the love of money, content with such things as you have, for he has said, “I will in no way leave you, neither will I in any way forsake you.”

hausa: Cikin wahalata na yi kira ga Ubangiji; Na yi kuka ga Allahna don taimako. A Haikalinsa ya ji muryata, Kukana na neman taimako ya kai kunnensa.
english: In my distress I called on Yahweh, and cried to my God. He heard my voice out of his temple. My cry before him came into his ears.

hausa: Kai, su masu kaciya ma ba su kiyaye Doka ba, duk da haka suna so a yi muku kaciya don su yi taƙama kan an yi muku kaciya.
english: For even they who receive circumcision don’t keep the law themselves, but they desire to have you circumcised, so that they may boast in your flesh.

hausa: Yoshuwa ya ce wa dukan mutanen, “Ga abin da Ubangiji, Allah na Isra’ila ya ce, ‘Dā can, kakanninku, Tera mahaifin Ibrahim, da Nahor sun zauna a hayin Kogin Yuferites suka yi wa waɗansu alloli sujada.
english: Joshua said to all the people, “Yahweh, the God of Israel, says, ‘Your fathers lived of old time beyond the River, even Terah, the father of Abraham, and the father of Nahor. They served other gods.

hausa: Zan mutu a wannan ƙasa; ba zan haye Urdun ba; amma kuna gab da ƙetarewa, ku mallaki wannan ƙasa mai kyau.
english: but I must die in this land. I must not go over the Jordan, but you shall go over and possess that good land.

hausa: Ga Isra’ilawa dai, ɗaukakar Ubangiji ta yi kamar wuta mai ci a kan dutse.
english: The appearance of Yahweh’s glory was like devouring fire on the top of the mountain in the eyes of the children of Israel.

hausa: Aka ƙidaya mazan Gershonawa ta kabilansu da kuma iyalansu.
english: Those who were counted of the sons of Gershon, by their families, and by their fathers’ houses,

hausa: Na kuma kawo shi wurin almajiranka, amma ba su iya warkar da shi ba.”
english: So I brought him to your disciples, and they could not cure him.”

hausa: Dawuda da kansa ya faɗa a cikin Zabura, “ ‘Ubangiji ya ce wa Ubangijina, “Zauna a hannun damana,
english: David himself says in the book of Psalms, ‘The Lord said to my Lord, “Sit at my right hand,

hausa: Duk abin da mushensu ya fāɗa a kai, zai ƙazantu. Ko a kan itace ne, ko a bisa tufafi, ko a fata, ko a buhu, ko cikin kowane irin abu da ake amfani da shi, to, tilas a sa shi cikin ruwa, zai zama ƙazantacce har zuwa yamma, sa’an nan zai tsarkaka.
english: Anything they fall on when they are dead shall be unclean; whether it is any vessel of wood, or clothing, or skin, or sack, whatever vessel it is, with which any work is done, it must be put into water, and it shall be unclean until the evening. Then it will be clean.

hausa: Saboda haka Yowab ya aiki wani zuwa Tekowa, ya sa a zo da wata mace mai hikima. Ya ce mata, “Ki yi kamar kina makoki. Ki sa rigar makoki, kada kuwa ki shafa mai. Ki yi kamar macen da ta yi kwanaki da yawa, tana makokin matattu.
english: Joab sent to Tekoa and brought a wise woman from there, and said to her, “Please act like a mourner, and put on mourning clothing, please, and don’t anoint yourself with oil; but be as a woman who has mourned a long time for the dead.

hausa: ta Gibbar 95.
english: The children of Gibbar, ninety-five.

hausa: Sa’ad da ya ga Sarauniya Esta tsaye a harabar, sai ya ji daɗin ganinta, ya miƙa mata sandan sarauta na zinariya da take hannunsa. Sai Esta ta matsa kusa ta taɓa kan sandan.
english: When the king saw Esther the queen standing in the court, she obtained favor in his sight; and the king held out to Esther the golden scepter that was in his hand. So Esther came near and touched the top of the scepter.

hausa: Ana nan sai Yetro firist na Midiyan, kuma surukin Musa, ya ji duk abin da Allah ya yi wa Musa da mutanensa Isra’ila, da kuma yadda Ubangiji ya fitar da Isra’ila daga Masar.
english: Now Jethro, the priest of Midian, Moses’ father-in-law, heard of all that God had done for Moses and for Israel his people, how Yahweh had brought Israel out of Egypt.

hausa: yabe shi da ganga kuna taka rawa, yabe shi da kayan kiɗi na tsirkiya kuna kuma busa,
english: Praise him with tambourine and dancing! Praise him with stringed instruments and flute!

hausa: Sai na ji muryar wani mutum daga Ulai tana cewa, “Jibra’ilu, faɗa wa wannan mutum ma’anar wahayin.”
english: I heard a man’s voice between the banks of the Ulai, which called and said, “Gabriel, make this man understand the vision.”

hausa: na Mikmash 122
english: The men of Michmas, one hundred twenty-two.

hausa: Tsawon kowane labule, kamu ashirin da takwas ne, fāɗinsa kuma kamu huɗu. Dukan labulen, girmansu ɗaya ne.
english: The length of each curtain was twenty-eight cubits, and the width of each curtain four cubits. All the curtains had one measure.

hausa: Sai tekun ya daɗa rikicewa. Sai suka tambaye shi, “Me za mu yi da kai domin tekun yă daina hauka?”
english: Then they said to him, “What shall we do to you, that the sea may be calm to us?” For the sea grew more and more stormy.

hausa: Da ya shiga cikin gida, sai makafin nan suka zo wurinsa, ya kuma tambaye su, “Kun gaskata cewa ina iya yin wannan?” Suka amsa suka ce, “I, Ubangiji.”
english: When he had come into the house, the blind men came to him. Jesus said to them, “Do you believe that I am able to do this?” They told him, “Yes, Lord.”

hausa: Da Yesu ya iso wurin, sai ya ɗaga ido sama, ya ce masa, “Zakka, ka yi maza ka sauka. Ni kam, dole in sauka a gidanka yau.”
english: When Jesus came to the place, he looked up and saw him, and said to him, “Zacchaeus, hurry and come down, for today I must stay at your house.”

hausa: Wataƙila su saurara kowanne kuma ya juyo daga mugun hanyarsa. Sa’an nan in yi juyayi in kuma janye masifar da nake shirin kawo a kansu saboda muguntar da suka aikata.
english: It may be they will listen, and every man turn from his evil way, that I may relent from the evil which I intend to do to them because of the evil of their doings.’”

hausa: In kuka ga gidan tsuntsu kusa da hanya, ko a kan itace, ko kuma a ƙasa, mahaifiyar tsuntsun kuwa tana kwance a kan ’ya’yanta, ko kuwa a kan ƙwanta, kada ku kama mahaifiyar duk da ’ya’yan.
english: If you come across a bird’s nest on the way, in any tree or on the ground, with young ones or eggs, and the hen sitting on the young, or on the eggs, you shall not take the hen with the young.

hausa: Damaskus ta karai ta juya don ta gudu tsoro kuma ya kama ta; wahala da zafi sun kama ta, zafi kamar na mace mai naƙuda.
english: Damascus has grown feeble, she turns herself to flee, and trembling has seized her. Anguish and sorrows have taken hold of her, as of a woman in travail.

hausa: Sam, ko kaɗan! Mun mutu ga zunubi; ta yaya za mu ci gaba da rayuwa a cikinsa kuma?
english: May it never be! We who died to sin, how could we live in it any longer?

hausa: A rana ta farko ga watan farko, suka gama da bincike duk waɗanda suka auri baƙin mata.
english: They finished with all the men who had married foreign women by the first day of the first month.

hausa: Shin, a kanku ne maganar Allah ta fara? Ko kuma a gare ku ne kaɗai ta iso?
english: What!? Was it from you that the word of God went out? Or did it come to you alone?

hausa: Kada ku miƙa wa Ubangiji Allahnku, saniya ko tunkiyar da take da wani lahani, ko naƙasa a cikinta, gama wannan zai zama abar ƙyama gare shi.
english: You shall not sacrifice to Yahweh your God an ox or a sheep in which is a defect or anything evil; for that is an abomination to Yahweh your God.

hausa: In kuka gafarta wa wani, ni ma na gafarta masa. Abin da na gafarta kuwa, in har ma da abin gafartawa, saboda ku ne na gafarta masa, albarkacin Kiristi,
english: Now I also forgive whomever you forgive anything. For if indeed I have forgiven anything, I have forgiven that one for your sakes in the presence of Christ,

hausa: “Dole ku yi zaman tsaro. Za a ba da ku ga hukuma, a kuma bulale ku a majami’u. Saboda ni kuma, za ku tsaya a gaban gwamnoni da sarakuna, domin ku ba da shaida a gabansu.
english: “But watch yourselves, for they will deliver you up to councils. You will be beaten in synagogues. You will stand before rulers and kings for my sake, for a testimony to them.

hausa: domin ya nuna wa Allah yatsa ya rena Allah Maɗaukaki,
english: Because he has stretched out his hand against God, and behaves himself proudly against the Almighty,

hausa: Saboda haka ’yan’uwana, ku yi marmarin yin annabci, kada kuma ku hana magana da harsuna.
english: Therefore, brothers, desire earnestly to prophesy, and don’t forbid speaking with other languages.

hausa: A wani lokaci can baya mu ma wawaye ne, marasa biyayya, aka ruɗe mu, sha’awace-sha’awace da kwaɗayi iri-iri suka daure mu, muka yi zaman ƙiyayya da kishi, aka ƙi mu, mu kuma muka ƙi juna.
english: For we were also once foolish, disobedient, deceived, serving various lusts and pleasures, living in malice and envy, hateful, and hating one another.

hausa: Kashegari sai Isra’ilawa suka tashi suka kafa sansani kusa da Gibeya.
english: The children of Israel rose up in the morning and encamped against Gibeah.

hausa: Ruwa ya sa ya yi girma, zurfafan maɓulɓulai sun sa ya yi tsayi; rafuffuka suna gudu kewaye da tushensa yana aika da rafuffukansa zuwa dukan itatuwan kurmi.
english: The waters nourished it. The deep made it to grow. Its rivers ran all around its plantation. It sent out its channels to all the trees of the field.

hausa: Akwai wani garin da ake kira Hamona zai kasance a can. Ta haka za su tsabtacce ƙasar.’
english: Hamonah will also be the name of a city. Thus they will cleanse the land.”’

hausa: Sai Mowab ya firgita ƙwarai saboda yawan mutanen. Tsoron Isra’ilawa ya kama su.
english: Moab was very afraid of the people, because they were many. Moab was distressed because of the children of Israel.

hausa: Dā ina zamana lafiya kome yana tafiya daidai; amma ya ragargaza ni; ya shaƙe ni a wuya; ya murƙushe ni na zama abin barata gare shi;
english: I was at ease, and he broke me apart. Yes, he has taken me by the neck, and dashed me to pieces. He has also set me up for his target.

hausa: Saboda haka dukan Isra’ila sukan gangara zuwa wajen Filistiyawa domin su gyara bakin garemaninsu, da fartanansu, da gaturansu, da kuma laujunansu.
english: but all the Israelites went down to the Philistines, each man to sharpen his own plowshare, mattock, ax, and sickle.

hausa: gama ba za ka bar ni cikin kabari ba, ba kuwa za ka yarda Mai Tsarkinka yă ruɓa ba.
english: because you will not leave my soul in Hades, neither will you allow your Holy One to see decay.

hausa: Kada ka gabatar da bawanka a gaban shari’a, gama babu wani mai rai da yake adali a gabanka.
english: Don’t enter into judgment with your servant, for in your sight no man living is righteous.

hausa: Na wajen firistoci kuwa su ne, Zuriyar Hobahiya, da ta Hakkoz, da ta Barzillai (wani mutumin da ya auri ’yar Barzillai mutumin Gileyad, aka kuma kira shi da wannan suna).
english: Of the priests: the children of Hobaiah, the children of Hakkoz, the children of Barzillai, who took a wife of the daughters of Barzillai the Gileadite, and was called after their name.

hausa: Alkawarin dominku ne da ’ya’yanku da kuma dukan waɗanda suke da nesa, domin dukan waɗanda Ubangiji Allahnmu zai kira.”
english: For the promise is to you and to your children, and to all who are far off, even as many as the Lord our God will call to himself.”

hausa: Haka suka yi daga tun daga ranar da na fitar da su daga Masar har zuwa yau, suka ƙi ni, suka bauta wa waɗansu alloli, haka ma suke yi maka.
english: According to all the works which they have done since the day that I brought them up out of Egypt even to this day, in that they have forsaken me and served other gods, so they also do to you.

hausa: Kowane dakali yana da ƙafa huɗu na tagulla kamar na keken yaƙi, da sandunan tagulla don sa kwanon nan da aka kira Teku. A kusurwoyin akwai abubuwan zubi don riƙe kwanon. An zāna furanni a kowane gefensu.
english: Every base had four bronze wheels and axles of bronze; and its four feet had supports. The supports were cast beneath the basin, with wreaths at the side of each.

hausa: To, waɗansu Farisiyawan da aka aika
english: The ones who had been sent were from the Pharisees.

hausa: Ya kuma ce mini, “Ɗan mutum, ka ga abin da suke yi, abubuwan banƙyamar da gidan Isra’ila ke yi a nan, abubuwan da za su kore ni daga wuri mai tsarkina? Amma za ka ga abubuwan da suka ma fi banƙyama.”
english: He said to me, “Son of man, do you see what they do? Even the great abominations that the house of Israel commit here, that I should go far off from my sanctuary? But you will again see yet other great abominations.”

hausa: Suka ce, “Ba a lokacin Biki ba, don kada mutane su yi tawaye.”
english: For they said, “Not during the feast, because there might be a riot among the people.”

hausa: Ka gafarta mana zunubanmu, kamar yadda mu ma ke gafarta wa duk wanda ya yi mana laifi. Kada ka bari a kai mu cikin jarraba.’ ”
english: Forgive us our sins, for we ourselves also forgive everyone who is indebted to us. Bring us not into temptation, but deliver us from the evil one.’”

hausa: Na sa Shelemiya firist, Zadok marubuci, da wani Balawe mai suna Fedahiya su lura da ɗakunan ajiya na kuma sa Hanan ɗan Zakkur, ɗan Mattaniya ya zama mataimakinsu, domin an ɗauka waɗannan mutane amintattu ne. Aka ba su hakkin raban kayayyaki wa ’yan’uwansu.
english: I made treasurers over the treasuries, Shelemiah the priest, and Zadok the scribe, and of the Levites, Pedaiah: and next to them was Hanan the son of Zaccur, the son of Mattaniah; for they were counted faithful, and their business was to distribute to their brothers.

hausa: Da Yahudawa da Hellenawan da suke zama a Afisa suka ji wannan labari sai duk tsoro ya kama su, aka kuwa darjanta sunan Ubangiji Yesu ƙwarai.
english: This became known to all, both Jews and Greeks, who lived at Ephesus. Fear fell on them all, and the name of the Lord Jesus was magnified.

hausa: Sa’an nan Yehu ya tattara dukan jama’a ya ce musu, “Ahab ya bauta wa Ba’al kaɗan ne kawai; amma Yehu zai bauta masa sosai.
english: Jehu gathered all the people together, and said to them, “Ahab served Baal a little, but Jehu will serve him much.

hausa: Ta Dawuda. Zabura ce. Zan rera wa ƙauna da adalcinka; gare ka, ya Ubangiji, zan rera yabo.
english: A Psalm by David. I will sing of loving kindness and justice. To you, Yahweh, I will sing praises.

hausa: Ya yi magana, sai tarin ƙudaje suka fito, cinnaku kuma ko’ina a ƙasar.
english: He spoke, and swarms of flies came, and lice in all their borders.

hausa: Yayinda yake a Masar, Hadad ya ji Dawuda ya huta tare da kakanninsa, ya kuma ji cewa Yowab shugaban mayaƙa ya mutu. Sai Hadad ya ce wa Fir’auna, “Bari in tafi, don in koma ƙasata.”
english: When Hadad heard in Egypt that David slept with his fathers, and that Joab the captain of the army was dead, Hadad said to Pharaoh, “Let me depart, that I may go to my own country.”

hausa: ku kuma jira dawowar Ɗansa daga sama, wanda ya tasa daga matattu, Yesu, wanda ya cece mu daga fushi mai zuwa.
english: and to wait for his Son from heaven, whom he raised from the dead: Jesus, who delivers us from the wrath to come.

hausa: Saboda Ubangiji, ku yi biyayya ga kowace hukumar da aka kafa cikin mutane, ko ga sarki, a matsayi wanda ya fi iko,
english: Therefore subject yourselves to every ordinance of man for the Lord’s sake: whether to the king, as supreme,

hausa: Suka shiga suka mallake ta, amma ba su yi maka biyayya ba, ba su kuma bi dokarka ba; ba su yi abin da ka umarce su ba. Saboda haka ka kawo masifa a kansu.
english: They came in and possessed it, but they didn’t obey your voice and didn’t walk in your law. They have done nothing of all that you commanded them to do. Therefore you have caused all this evil to come upon them.

hausa: Na sami ganewa daga farillanka; saboda haka ina ƙin kowace hanyar da ba daidai ba.
english: Through your precepts, I get understanding; therefore I hate every false way. NUN

hausa: Ubangiji ne ƙarfina da waƙata; ya zama mai cetona.
english: Yah is my strength and song. He has become my salvation.

hausa: Waɗannan su ne farillai, da dokoki, da kuma ƙa’idodin da Ubangiji ya kafa a Dutsen Sinai, tsakaninsa da Isra’ilawa ta wurin Musa.
english: These are the statutes, ordinances, and laws, which Yahweh made between him and the children of Israel in Mount Sinai by Moses.

hausa: Ku zo, bari mu rera don farin ciki ga Ubangiji; bari mu yi sowa da ƙarfi ga Dutsen cetonmu.
english: Oh come, let’s sing to Yahweh. Let’s shout aloud to the rock of our salvation!

hausa: Sai Siman Bitrus ya taɓa wannan almajirin ya ce, “Tambaye shi, wa yake nufi?”
english: Simon Peter therefore beckoned to him, and said to him, “Tell us who it is of whom he speaks.”

hausa: “Ga shi budurwa za tă yi ciki, za tă haifi ɗa, kuma za a kira shi Immanuwel” (wanda yake nufin “Allah tare da mu”).
english: “Behold, the virgin shall be with child, and shall give birth to a son. They shall call his name Immanuel,” which is, being interpreted, “God with us.”

hausa: Za ku iya ba da su ga ’ya’yanku a matsayin kayan gādo, za ku kuma iya mai da su bayi dukan rayuwarsu, amma kada ku yi mulki a bisa ’yan’uwanku Isra’ilawa da tsanani.
english: You may make them an inheritance for your children after you, to hold for a possession. Of them you may take your slaves forever, but over your brothers the children of Israel you shall not rule, one over another, with harshness.

hausa: Ashe, waɗanda suka yi barci a cikin Kiristi ma sun hallaka ke nan.
english: Then they also who are fallen asleep in Christ have perished.

hausa: “ ‘In ’yar firist ta ɓata kanta ta wurin zama karuwa, ta kunyatar da mahaifinta ke nan; dole a ƙone ta da wuta.
english: “‘The daughter of any priest, if she profanes herself by playing the prostitute, she profanes her father. She shall be burned with fire.

hausa: “Ku yi Bikin Burodi Marar Yisti domin a wannan rana ce na fitar da ku ɓangare-ɓangare daga Masar. Ku kiyaye wannan rana ta zama muku dawwammamiyar farilla wa tsara masu zuwa.
english: You shall observe the feast of unleavened bread; for in this same day I have brought your armies out of the land of Egypt. Therefore you shall observe this day throughout your generations by an ordinance forever.

hausa: Zuriyar ma’aikatan haikali da ta bayin Solomon su 392.
english: All the temple servants and the children of Solomon’s servants were three hundred ninety-two.

hausa: Sa’an nan annabi Irmiya ya faɗi dukan wannan wa Zedekiya sarkin Yahuda, a Urushalima,
english: Then Jeremiah the prophet spoke all these words to Zedekiah king of Judah in Jerusalem,

hausa: Kamar kakanninsu suka zama marasa biyayya da marasa aminci, marar tabbas kamar tanƙwararren baka.
english: but turned back, and dealt treacherously like their fathers. They were twisted like a deceitful bow.

hausa: saboda haka zan ba da ku ga mutanen Gabas abin mallaka. Za su kafa sansanoninsu su yi tentunansu a cikinku; za su ci ’ya’yan itatuwanku su kuma sha madararku.
