english: therefore, behold, I will deliver you to the children of the east for a possession. They will set their encampments in you and make their dwellings in you. They will eat your fruit and they will drink your milk.

hausa: Suka ɗebi ’ya’yan itatuwan ƙasar, suka sauko mana da su, suka kuma ba da labari cewa, “Ƙasar da Ubangiji Allahnmu yake ba mu, kyakkyawa ce.”
english: They took some of the fruit of the land in their hands and brought it down to us, and brought us word again, and said, “It is a good land which Yahweh our God gives to us.”

hausa: Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka ya rantse da tsarkinsa. “Tabbatacce lokaci yana zuwa da za a jawo ku da ƙugiyoyi, na ƙarshenku za a kama da ƙugiyar kifi.
english: The Lord Yahweh has sworn by his holiness, “Behold, the days shall come on you that they will take you away with hooks, and the last of you with fish hooks.

hausa: Hadayar da ya kawo ita ce, faranti guda ɗaya na azurfa, nauyinsa shekel ɗari ɗaya da talatin, da kuma daro na yayyafawa na azurfa, nauyinsa shekel saba’in, dukan biyu, an auna su bisa ga ma’aunin shekel na tsattsarkan wuri, kowannensu cike da lallausan gari, haɗe da mai kamar hadaya ta gari;
english: gave his offering: one silver platter, the weight of which was one hundred thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary, both of them full of fine flour mixed with oil for a meal offering;

hausa: Amma za a hallaka dukan masu zunubi; za a yanke sa zuciya ta mugaye.
english: As for transgressors, they shall be destroyed together. The future of the wicked shall be cut off.

hausa: Tagoginta, shirayinta da siffofin itatuwan dabinon da aka yi zāne-zānen adonta duk girmansu ɗaya ne da na ƙofar da take fuskantar gabas. Ɗakin shiga shi ma ya fuskanci filin yana kuma da matakai bakwai waɗanda suka bi zuwa ƙofar shiga, da shirayinta ɗaura da su.
english: Its windows, its arches, and its palm trees were the same as the measure of the gate which faces toward the east. They went up to it by seven steps. Its arches were before them.

hausa: A maimakon haka, ku ɗauki halin Ubangiji Yesu Kiristi, kada kuma ku yi tunani game da yadda za ku gamsar da sha’awace-sha’awacen mutuntaka.
english: But put on the Lord Jesus Christ, and make no provision for the flesh, for its lusts.

hausa: Ubangiji zai kiyaye shigarka da fitarka yanzu da har abada kuma.
english: Yahweh will keep your going out and your coming in, from this time forward, and forever more.

hausa: Da ya zauna a tebur tare da su, sai ya ɗauki burodi, ya yi godiya, ya kakkarya ya fara ba su.
english: When he had sat down at the table with them, he took the bread and gave thanks. Breaking it, he gave it to them.

hausa: Ka dogara ga Ubangiji ka kuma aikata alheri; yi zama cikin ƙasar ka kuma more makiyaya mai lafiya.
english: Trust in Yahweh, and do good. Dwell in the land, and enjoy safe pasture.

hausa: Da ɗaci rai mahara suka fāɗa masa; suka harbe shi babu tausayi.
english: The archers have severely grieved him, shot at him, and persecuted him:

hausa: Cikin sa’a guda irin wannan dukiya mai yawa ta hallaka!’ “Duk matuƙan jirgin ruwa, da dukan waɗanda suke tafiya a jirgin ruwa, ma’aikatanta, da duk masu samun abin zama gari daga teku za su tsaya daga nesa.
english: For in an hour such great riches are made desolate.’ Every ship master, and everyone who sails anywhere, and mariners, and as many as gain their living by sea, stood far away,

hausa: Sa’an nan Nebukadnezzar ya ce, “Yabo ya tabbata ga Allahn Shadrak, Meshak da Abednego wanda ya aiko da mala’ikansa ya ceci bayinsa da suka dogara matuƙa a gare shi, suka ki bin umarnin sarki kuma su na a shirye domin su ba da ransu da suka ƙi bauta ko su yi sujada ga wani allah sai dai Allahnsu.
english: Nebuchadnezzar spoke and said, “Blessed be the God of Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego, who has sent his angel and delivered his servants who trusted in him, and have changed the king’s word, and have yielded their bodies, that they might not serve nor worship any god except their own God.

hausa: Ka fi Balak ɗan Ziffor, sarkin Mowab ne? Ka taɓa ji ya yi hamayya da Isra’ila ko yă yi yaƙi da su?
english: Now are you anything better than Balak the son of Zippor, king of Moab? Did he ever strive against Israel, or did he ever fight against them?

hausa: Alherin Ubangiji Yesu Kiristi yă kasance da ruhunku. Amin.
english: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.

hausa: Ya ko yarda, ya fara neman zarafin da zai ba da Yesu a gare su, sa’ad da taro ba sa nan tare da shi.
english: He consented and sought an opportunity to deliver him to them in the absence of the multitude.

hausa: Kun san cewa zai ba ku gādo a matsayin ladanku. Ubangiji Kiristi ne fa kuke bauta wa.
english: knowing that from the Lord you will receive the reward of the inheritance; for you serve the Lord Christ.

hausa: Sa’an nan wata murya ta fito daga kursiyin, tana cewa, “Ku yabi Allahnmu, dukanku da kuke bayinsa, ku da kuke tsoronsa, babba da yaro!”
english: A voice came from the throne, saying, “Give praise to our God, all you his servants, you who fear him, the small and the great!”

hausa: da Hodiya, da Hashum, da Bezai,
english: Hodiah, Hashum, Bezai,

hausa: don yă fitar da ku a gaban al’ummai da suka fi ku girma da kuma ƙarfi, ya kawo ku cikin ƙasarsu, don yă ba ku ita ta zama gādonku, kamar yadda yake a yau.
english: to drive out nations from before you greater and mightier than you, to bring you in, to give you their land for an inheritance, as it is today.

hausa: ’Ya’yan Kohat maza, su ne, Amram, Izhar, Hebron da Uzziyel. Kohat ya yi shekara 133.
english: The sons of Kohath: Amram, and Izhar, and Hebron, and Uzziel; and the years of the life of Kohath were one hundred thirty-three years.

hausa: Ina da hakki ga Hellenawa da waɗanda ba Hellenawa ba, ga masu hikima da kuma marasa azanci.
english: I am debtor both to Greeks and to foreigners, both to the wise and to the foolish.

hausa: a sa’an nan ne Ubangiji Allahnku zai yi muku jinƙai, yă ji tausayinku, yă kuma sāke tattara ku daga dukan al’ummai inda ya warwatsa ku.
english: that then Yahweh your God will release you from captivity, have compassion on you, and will return and gather you from all the peoples where Yahweh your God has scattered you.

hausa: da aka daddasa a gidan Ubangiji, za su haɓaka a filayen gidan Allahnmu.
english: They are planted in Yahweh’s house. They will flourish in our God’s courts.

hausa: Hannun Ubangiji yana a kaina, ya kuma fitar da ni ta wurin Ruhun Ubangiji ya sa ni a tsakiyar kwarin; yana cike da ƙasusuwa.
english: Yahweh’s hand was on me, and he brought me out in Yahweh’s Spirit, and set me down in the middle of the valley; and it was full of bones.

hausa: Sa’ad da muke zaune a cikin jikin nan na duniya, nishi muke domin matsuwar da muke sha, ba domin muna so mu rabu da jikinmu na wannan duniya ba ne, sai dai don so muke yi a suturta mu da na Sama, domin mai rai ya shafe mai mutuwa.
english: For indeed we who are in this tent do groan, being burdened, not that we desire to be unclothed, but that we desire to be clothed, that what is mortal may be swallowed up by life.

hausa: Zan sassare dukan gumakan da kuka sassaƙa da keɓaɓɓun duwatsunku a cikinku, nan gaba ba za ku ƙara rusuna wa aikin hannuwanku ba.
english: I will cut off your engraved images and your pillars from among you; and you shall no more worship the work of your hands.

hausa: Kaitonka, ya kai mai hallakarwa, kai da ba a hallakar da kai ba! Kaitonka, ya maciya amana, kai da ba a ci amanarka ba! Sa’ad da ka daina hallakarwa, za a hallaka ka; sa’ad da ka daina cin amana, za a ci amanarka.
english: Woe to you who destroy, but you weren’t destroyed, and who betray, but nobody betrayed you! When you have finished destroying, you will be destroyed; and when you have finished betrayal, you will be betrayed.

hausa: Kofatan dawakansa za su tattake dukan titunanki; zai kashe mutanenki da takobi, ginshiƙanki masu ƙarfi kuma za su fāɗi a ƙasa.
english: He will tread down all your streets with the hoofs of his horses. He will kill your people with the sword. The pillars of your strength will go down to the ground.

hausa: Ku yi addu’a don in kuɓuta daga hannun marasa bi a Yahudiya don kuma gudummawar da nake kaiwa Urushalima ta zama abar karɓa ga tsarkaka a can,
english: that I may be delivered from those who are disobedient in Judea, and that my service which I have for Jerusalem may be acceptable to the saints,

hausa: Saboda haka duniya za tă yi kuka sammai a bisa kuma za su yi duhu, domin na yi magana kuma ba zan fasa ba, na yanke shawara ba kuwa zan janye ba.”
english: For this the earth will mourn, and the heavens above be black, because I have spoken it. I have planned it, and I have not repented, neither will I turn back from it.”

hausa: Duk wanda ya ɗauki gawawwakinsu dole yă wanke rigunansa, zai kuma ƙazantu har yamma. Waɗannan dabbobi za su zama marasa tsabta a gare ku.
english: He who carries their carcass shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the evening. They are unclean to you.

hausa: Amma Na’aman ya tashi daga can da fushi yana cewa, “Na yi tsammani zai fito ne wurina yă tsaya, yă yi kira bisa ga sunan Ubangiji Allahnsa, yă kaɗa hannunsa inda kuturtar take, yă warkar da ni.
english: But Naaman was angry, and went away and said, “Behold, I thought, ‘He will surely come out to me, and stand, and call on the name of Yahweh his God, and wave his hand over the place, and heal the leper.’

hausa: Gare shi wanda ya bi da mutanensa cikin hamada, Ƙaunarsa madawwamiya ce.
english: to him who led his people through the wilderness, for his loving kindness endures forever;

hausa: Absalom ya ce wa Yowab, “Kai, na aika, ‘Ka zo nan don in aike ka wurin sarki ka tambaya, “Me ya sa na dawo daga Geshur? Ai, ya fi mini a ce ina can har yanzu!” ’ Yanzu kuwa, ina so in ga sarki, kuma idan na yi wani laifi, to, yă kashe ni.”
english: Absalom answered Joab, “Behold, I sent to you, saying, ‘Come here, that I may send you to the king, to say, “Why have I come from Geshur? It would be better for me to be there still. Now therefore, let me see the king’s face; and if there is iniquity in me, let him kill me.”’”

hausa: Da mala’ikan Ubangiji ya miƙa hannunsa wajen Urushalima, don yă hallaka ta, sai Ubangiji ya tsai da masifar, ya ce wa mala’ikan da yake wahal da mutane, “Ya isa, ka janye hannunka.” A lokacin kuwa Mala’ikan Ubangiji yana tsaye a masussukar Arauna, mutumin Yebus.
english: When the angel stretched out his hand toward Jerusalem to destroy it, Yahweh relented of the disaster, and said to the angel who destroyed the people, “It is enough. Now withdraw your hand.” Yahweh’s angel was by the threshing floor of Araunah the Jebusite.

hausa: “ ‘In wani ya zagi mahaifinsa ko mahaifiyarsa, dole a kashe shi. Domin ya zagi mahaifinsa ko mahaifiyarsa, alhakin jininsa zai zauna a kansa.
english: “‘For everyone who curses his father or his mother shall surely be put to death. He has cursed his father or his mother. His blood shall be upon himself.

hausa: Sai Yesu ya amsa ya ce, “Ka tafi. Ɗanka zai rayu.” Mutumin kuwa ya amince da maganar da Yesu ya yi ya kuwa tafi.
english: Jesus said to him, “Go your way. Your son lives.” The man believed the word that Jesus spoke to him, and he went his way.

hausa: kuma waɗannan su ne yaran da aka haifa masa a can. Shimeya, Shobab, Natan da Solomon. Waɗannan huɗu ne Bat-shuwa ’yar Ammiyel ta haifa.
english: and these were born to him in Jerusalem: Shimea, Shobab, Nathan, and Solomon, four, by Bathshua the daughter of Ammiel;

hausa: Maimakon mutanen su yi haka, sai suka yi ƙoƙari su tura jirgin ruwan zuwa bakin teku. Amma ba su iya ba, saboda iskar ta sa tekun ya yi ta ƙara hauka.
english: Nevertheless the men rowed hard to get them back to the land; but they could not, for the sea grew more and more stormy against them.

hausa: Duk da haka ga abin da Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka ya ce, “ ‘Ba zai faru ba, ba zai auku ba,
english: This is what the Lord Yahweh says: “It shall not stand, neither shall it happen.”

hausa: sarkin Eglon, ɗaya sarkin Gezer, ɗaya
english: the king of Eglon, one; the king of Gezer, one;

hausa: Yowab ya ce, “Muddin Allah yana a raye, da ba a ce ka yi magana ba, da mutanen za su ci gaba da fafaran ’yan’uwansu har gari yă waye.”
english: Joab said, “As God lives, if you had not spoken, surely then in the morning the people would have gone away, and not each followed his brother.”

hausa: Da jin haka sai sarki ya sāke aiken wani kaftin tare da waɗansu sojojinsa hamsin wurin Iliya. Kaftin ya ce wa Iliya, “Mutumin Allah, ga abin da sarki ya ce, ‘Ka sauko, nan take ka zo!’ ”
english: Again he sent to him another captain of fifty with his fifty. He answered him, “Man of God, the king has said, ‘Come down quickly!’”

hausa: Zai kasance a goshin Haruna, ta haka zai ɗauki kurakuran da ya yiwu Isra’ilawa sun yi cikin miƙa baye-bayensu masu tsarki. Zai kasance a goshin Haruna kullayaumin, domin su zama abin karɓa ga Ubangiji.
english: It shall be on Aaron’s forehead, and Aaron shall bear the iniquity of the holy things, which the children of Israel shall make holy in all their holy gifts; and it shall be always on his forehead, that they may be accepted before Yahweh.

hausa: Sa’ad da Musa ya aike su domin su binciki Kan’ana ya ce, “Ku haura, ku ratsa ta Negeb har zuwa ƙasar tudu.
english: Moses sent them to spy out the land of Canaan, and said to them, “Go up this way by the South, and go up into the hill country.

hausa: Nan take ya fara wa’azi cikin majami’u cewa Yesu Ɗan Allah ne.
english: Immediately in the synagogues he proclaimed the Christ, that he is the Son of God.

hausa: Ya zaɓi Dawuda bawansa ya kuma ɗauke shi daga ɗakin tumaki;
english: He also chose David his servant, and took him from the sheepfolds;

hausa: Ikkilisiya ta raka su suka tafi, yayinda suke ratsawa ta Funisiya da Samariya, suka ba da labari yadda Al’ummai suka tuba. Wannan labarin ya sa dukan ’yan’uwa suka yi murna ƙwarai.
english: They, being sent on their way by the assembly, passed through both Phoenicia and Samaria, declaring the conversion of the Gentiles. They caused great joy to all the brothers.

hausa: To, da Daniyel ya ji labarin cewa an fitar da doka, sai ya tafi gidansa a ɗakinsa na sama inda tagogin ɗakin suke duban wajen Urushalima. Sau uku yakan durƙusa yă yi addu’a yana yin godiya ga Allahnsa, kamar yadda ya saba yi.
english: When Daniel knew that the writing was signed, he went into his house (now his windows were open in his room toward Jerusalem) and he kneeled on his knees three times a day, and prayed, and gave thanks before his God, as he did before.

hausa: “Sai wani bawan ya zo ya ce, ‘Ranka yă daɗe, ga minarka. Na ɓoye shi a wani ɗan tsumma.
english: Another came, saying, ‘Lord, behold, your mina, which I kept laid away in a handkerchief,

hausa: Eliyenai, Zilletai, Eliyel,
english: Elienai, Zillethai, Eliel,

hausa: Za a washe raƙumansu, garkunansu mai girma za su zama ganima. Zan watsar da waɗanda suke a wurare masu nesa a ko’ina zan kuma kawo musu masifa a kowane gefe,” in ji Ubangiji.
english: Their camels will be a booty, and the multitude of their livestock a plunder. I will scatter to all winds those who have the corners of their beards cut off; and I will bring their calamity from every side of them,” says Yahweh.

hausa: Ashe, gādona bai zama mini kamar dabbare dabbaren tsuntsu mai cin nama da sauran tsuntsaye masu cin nama suka kewaye shi da faɗa ba? Tafi ka tattaro dukan namun jeji; ka kawo su su ci.
english: Is my heritage to me as a speckled bird of prey? Are the birds of prey against her all around? Go, assemble all the animals of the field. Bring them to devour.

hausa: “ ‘In ɗaya daga cikin mutanen ƙasarku ya talauta, ya kuma sayar da mallakarsa, sai danginsa na kusa yă je yă fanshi abin da mutumin ƙasarsa ya sayar.
english: “‘If your brother becomes poor, and sells some of his possessions, then his kinsman who is next to him shall come, and redeem that which his brother has sold.

hausa: Saboda haka yi annabci a kansu; yi annabci, ɗan mutum.”
english: Therefore prophesy against them. Prophesy, son of man.”

hausa: “Da hankalinsa ya dawo, sai ya ce, ‘Kai, bayin mahaifina guda nawa ne, da suke da abinci fiye da isashe, ni kuma ina nan, zan mutu don yunwa!
english: But when he came to himself, he said, ‘How many hired servants of my father’s have bread enough to spare, and I’m dying with hunger!

hausa: Saboda haka muddin ina a raye, in ji Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka, domin kin ƙazantar da wuri mai tsarkina da dukan mugayen siffofinki da kuma ayyukanki masu banƙyama, ni kaina zan janye alherina; ba zan ji tausayinki ko in haƙura da ke ba.
english: Therefore as I live,’ says the Lord Yahweh, ‘surely, because you have defiled my sanctuary with all your detestable things, and with all your abominations, therefore I will also diminish you. My eye won’t spare, and I will have no pity.

hausa: Yesu ya amsa ya ce, “Yanzu ba ka fahimci abin da nake yi ba, amma nan gaba za ka gane.”
english: Jesus answered him, “You don’t know what I am doing now, but you will understand later.”

hausa: “Saboda haka na so ku san cewa an aika da ceton Allah ga Al’ummai, za su kuwa saurara!”
english: “Be it known therefore to you that the salvation of God is sent to the nations, and they will listen.”

hausa: Ya ajiye kerubobin a ɗaki na can cikin haikalin, da fikafikansu a buɗe. Fiffiken kerub ɗaya ya taɓa bango guda, yayinda fiffiken ɗayan ya taɓa ɗayan bangon, kuma fikafikansu sun taɓa juna a tsakiyar ɗakin.
english: He set the cherubim within the inner house. The wings of the cherubim were stretched out, so that the wing of the one touched the one wall and the wing of the other cherub touched the other wall; and their wings touched one another in the middle of the house.

hausa: Akwai wani mutum a masarautarka wanda yake da ruhun alloli masu tsarki a cikinsa. A zamanin mahaifinka an gane cewa yana da basira da hazaka da hikima kamar na alloli. Sarki Nebukadnezzar mahaifinka, mahaifinka sarki, na ce, ya naɗa shugaban masu dabo, da masu sihiri, masanan taurari da kuma masu duba.
english: There is a man in your kingdom in whom is the spirit of the holy gods; and in the days of your father, light and understanding and wisdom, like the wisdom of the gods, were found in him. The king, Nebuchadnezzar, your father—yes, the king, your father—made him master of the magicians, enchanters, Chaldeans, and soothsayers,

hausa: Gama Ubangiji ne alƙalinmu, Ubangiji ne mai ba mu dokoki, Ubangiji ne sarkinmu; shi ne wanda zai cece mu.
english: For Yahweh is our judge. Yahweh is our lawgiver. Yahweh is our king. He will save us.

hausa: suna riƙe da siffofin ibada, amma suna mūsun ikonta. Kada wani abu yă haɗa ka da su.
english: holding a form of godliness but having denied its power. Turn away from these, also.

hausa: Sai waɗannan mutane suka tafi a ƙungiyance suka kuma iske Daniyel yana addu’a yana roƙon Allah yă taimake shi.
english: Then these men assembled together, and found Daniel making petition and supplication before his God.

hausa: To, Daniyel dai ya yi ficce a cikin shugabannin nan uku har da muƙaddasan ma, saboda waɗansu halaye nagari da yake da su, wanda ya sa sarki ya yi shiri ya ɗora shi a kan dukan mulkinsa.
english: Then this Daniel was distinguished above the presidents and the local governors, because an excellent spirit was in him; and the king thought to set him over the whole realm.

hausa: Mai basira kan ga damuwa tana zuwa yă nemi mafaka, amma marar azanci kan yi ta tafiya yă kuma sha wahala.
english: A prudent man sees danger and hides himself; but the simple pass on, and suffer for it.

hausa: Kuka amsa mini, kuka ce, “Abin da ka ce za ka yi, yana da kyau.”
english: You answered me, and said, “The thing which you have spoken is good to do.”

hausa: Ubangiji kuma ya ba da ƙasar da sarkinta a hannun Yoshuwa. Yoshuwa ya karkashe kowa ya hallaka birnin, bai bar wani da rai ba. Ya kuma yi wa sarkin yadda ya yi wa sarkin Yeriko.
english: Yahweh delivered it also, with its king, into the hand of Israel. He struck it with the edge of the sword, and all the souls who were in it. He left no one remaining in it. He did to its king as he had done to the king of Jericho.

hausa: Ya yi tunani a ransa ya ce, ‘Ba ni da inda zan ajiye amfanin gonana. Me zan yi ke nan?’
english: He reasoned within himself, saying, ‘What will I do, because I don’t have room to store my crops?’

hausa: Mutanen da suke lura da aikin natsattsu ne, kuma gyare-gyaren suka ci gaba a ƙarƙashinsu. Suka sāke gina haikalin Allah bisa ga ainihin fasalinsa suka ƙara masa ƙarfi.
english: So the workmen worked, and the work of repairing went forward in their hands. They set up God’s house as it was designed, and strengthened it.

hausa: ko bala’in da yake aukowa cikin duhu, ko annobar da take hallakarwa da tsakar rana.
english: nor of the pestilence that walks in darkness, nor of the destruction that wastes at noonday.

hausa: Gama nufin Allah ne cewa ta wurin yin nagarta za ku toshe jahilcin marasa azanci.
english: For this is the will of God, that by well-doing you should put to silence the ignorance of foolish men.

hausa: Ya juya teku zuwa busasshiyar ƙasa, sun wuce cikin ruwaye da ƙafa, ku zo, mu yi farin ciki a cikinsa.
english: He turned the sea into dry land. They went through the river on foot. There, we rejoiced in him.

hausa: dukan sarakunan Zimri, Elam da Mediya;
english: and all the kings of Zimri, all the kings of Elam, and all the kings of the Medes;

hausa: Na duba, amma babu wanda zai taimaka, na yi mamaki cewa ba wanda ya goyi baya; saboda haka hannuna ya yi mini ceto, fushina kuma ya rayar da ni.
english: I looked, and there was no one to help; and I wondered that there was no one to uphold. Therefore my own arm brought salvation to me. My own wrath upheld me.

hausa: Na sa kin yi girma kamar tsiro a fili. Kin yi girma kika kuma yi tsayi kika zama mafiya kyau na kayan ado. Nononki suka fito, gashinki kuwa suka yi girma, duk da haka tsirara kike tik.
english: I caused you to multiply as that which grows in the field, and you increased and grew great, and you attained to excellent beauty. Your breasts were formed, and your hair grew; yet you were naked and bare.

hausa: “Kada kuma ka shiga gidan da ake biki ka zauna don ci da sha.
english: “You shall not go into the house of feasting to sit with them, to eat and to drink.”

hausa: “Ka sa a yi akwatin alkawarin da itacen ƙirya, tsawonsa kamu biyu da rabi, fāɗinsa kamu ɗaya da rabi, tsayinsa kuma kamu ɗaya da rabi.
english: “They shall make an ark of acacia wood. Its length shall be two and a half cubits, its width a cubit and a half, and a cubit and a half its height.

hausa: Yana zuwa tare da Onesimus, ƙaunatacce da kuma amintaccen mai bin nan, wanda yake ɗaya daga cikinku. Za su gaya muku dukan abin da yake faruwa a nan.
english: together with Onesimus, the faithful and beloved brother, who is one of you. They will make known to you everything that is going on here.

hausa: Ɗan’uwan mahaifin Shawulu ya ce, “Faɗa mini abin da Sama’ila ya ce maka.”
english: Saul’s uncle said, “Please tell me what Samuel said to you.”

hausa: Kerubobin kuwa suna tsaye a gefen kudu na haikali sa’ad da mutumin ya shiga, sai girgije ya cika filin da yake can ciki.
english: Now the cherubim stood on the right side of the house when the man went in; and the cloud filled the inner court.

hausa: Ga abin da Ubangiji ya ce, “Saboda zunubai uku na Ammon, har guda huɗu ma, ba zan fasa hukunta shi ba. Don ya tsaga cikin matan Gileyad masu juna biyu don kawai yă ƙwace ƙasar.
english: Yahweh says: “For three transgressions of the children of Ammon, yes, for four, I will not turn away its punishment, because they have ripped open the pregnant women of Gilead, that they may enlarge their border.

hausa: Wuta ta ƙuno a cikin mabiyansu; harshen wuta ya cinye mugaye.
english: A fire was kindled in their company. The flame burned up the wicked.

hausa: Da wani ya zo ya faɗa wa Dawuda game da mutanen, sai ya aiki ’yan aika su sadu da su, gama an ƙasƙantar da su ainun. Sarki ya ce, “Ku zauna a Yeriko har sai gemunku sun yi girma, sa’an nan ku dawo.”
english: Then some people went and told David how the men were treated. He sent to meet them; for the men were greatly humiliated. The king said, “Stay at Jericho until your beards have grown, and then return.”

hausa: Sa’an nan a sake shi da ’ya’yansa, yă kuma koma ga danginsa da mallakar kakanninsa.
english: Then he shall go out from you, he and his children with him, and shall return to his own family, and to the possession of his fathers.

hausa: Nonanki biyu sun yi kamar bareyi biyu, kamar tagwayen barewa da suke kiwo a cikin furen bi-rana.
english: Your two breasts are like two fawns that are twins of a roe, which feed among the lilies.

hausa: Sai wani hafsa mataimakin sarki ya ce wa mutumin Allah, “Kai, ko da Ubangiji zai buɗe tagogin sama, wannan abu ba zai yiwu ba!” Sai Elisha ya ce, “Za ka gani da idanunka, zai faru, amma ba za ka ci ba!”
english: Then the captain on whose hand the king leaned answered the man of God, and said, “Behold, if Yahweh made windows in heaven, could this thing be?” He said, “Behold, you will see it with your eyes, but will not eat of it.”

hausa: Yesu ya amsa ya ce, “An ce, ‘Kada ka gwada Ubangiji Allahnka.’”
english: Jesus answering, said to him, “It has been said, ‘You shall not tempt the Lord your God.’”

hausa: ka bi da ni cikin gaskiyarka ka kuma koya mini, gama kai ne Allah Mai cetona, kuma begena yana a kanka dukan yini.
english: Guide me in your truth, and teach me, for you are the God of my salvation. I wait for you all day long.

hausa: Sarkin ya yi tambaya, ya ce, “Wane kabari ke nan nake gani?” Mutanen birnin suka ce, “Ai, kabarin annabin Allah ne wanda ya fito daga Yahuda, shi ne ya yi annabcin waɗannan abubuwan da ka aikata gāba da bagaden Betel.”
english: Then he said, “What monument is that which I see?” The men of the city told him, “It is the tomb of the man of God who came from Judah and proclaimed these things that you have done against the altar of Bethel.”

hausa: yadda Allah ya shafe Yesu Banazare da Ruhu Mai Tsarki da kuma iko, da kuma yadda ya zaga ko’ina yana aikata alheri yana kuma warkar da dukan waɗanda suke ƙarƙashin ikon Iblis, domin Allah yana tare da shi.
english: how God anointed Jesus of Nazareth with the Holy Spirit and with power, who went about doing good and healing all who were oppressed by the devil, for God was with him.

hausa: Amma gonar inabina nawa ne da zan bayar; shekel dubu naka ne, ya Solomon, kuma ɗari biyu na waɗanda suke lura da ’ya’yan itatuwansa ne.
english: My own vineyard is before me. The thousand are for you, Solomon, two hundred for those who tend its fruit.

hausa: Da mutanen suka jawo shi cikin babban jirgin ruwan, sai suka sa igiyoyi ta ƙarƙashin jirgin ruwan kanta don su ɗaɗɗaura shi. Don gudun kada a fyaɗa mu da yashin gaɓar Sirtis, sai suka saukar da ƙugiyar jirgin ruwan, suka bari aka yi ta tura jirgin haka.
english: After they had hoisted it up, they used cables to help reinforce the ship. Fearing that they would run aground on the Syrtis sand bars, they lowered the sea anchor, and so were driven along.

hausa: Na tuna da kai, ya Allah, na kuma yi nishi; na yi nishi, ƙarfina kuwa duk ya raunana. Sela
english: I remember God, and I groan. I complain, and my spirit is overwhelmed. Selah.

hausa: Da ma abin da fadawan suke so su ji ke nan, sai suka yi sauri, suka karɓi maganar a bakinsa, suka ce, “I, ɗan’uwanka, Ben-hadad!” Sarki ya ce, “Ku je ku kawo shi.” Da Ben-Hadad ya fita, sai Ahab ya sa aka kawo shi cikin keken yaƙinsa.
english: Now the men observed diligently and hurried to take this phrase; and they said, “Your brother Ben Hadad.” Then he said, “Go, bring him.” Then Ben Hadad came out to him; and he caused him to come up into the chariot.

hausa: Mutane za su suma don tsoro, za su kuma yi fargaba, a kan abin da yake zuwa a bisan duniya, gama za a girgiza duniyar taurarin sararin sama.
english: men fainting for fear and for expectation of the things which are coming on the world, for the powers of the heavens will be shaken.

hausa: Ni, Bulus, nake rubuta wannan gaisuwa da hannuna, wannan ce shaida a kowace wasiƙata, haka nake rubutu.
english: I, Paul, write this greeting with my own hand, which is the sign in every letter. This is how I write.

hausa: Sa’an nan ya auna tsawon ginin da yake fuskantar filin a bayan haikalin, haɗe da rumfunansa a kowane gefe, kamu ɗari. Wuri mai tsarki da yake waje, wuri mai tsarki da yake can ciki da shirayin da yake fuskantar filin,
english: He measured the length of the building before the separate place which was at its back, and its galleries on the one side and on the other side, one hundred cubits from the inner temple, and the porches of the court,

hausa: Ubangiji yana mulki, bari duniya tă yi murna; bari tsibirai masu nesa su yi farin ciki.
english: Yahweh reigns! Let the earth rejoice! Let the multitude of islands be glad!

hausa: Ka girmama gwauraye waɗanda suke cikin bukata ta ainihi.
english: Honor widows who are widows indeed.

hausa: ’Yan’uwansu mata su ne Zeruhiya da Abigiyel. ’Ya’yan Zeruhiya maza guda uku su ne Abishai, Yowab da Asahel.
english: and their sisters were Zeruiah and Abigail. The sons of Zeruiah: Abishai, Joab, and Asahel, three.

hausa: Yesu ya amsa ya ce, “Wanda ya sa hannunsa a kwano tare da ni ne, zai bashe ni.
english: He answered, “He who dipped his hand with me in the dish will betray me.

hausa: Tabbatacce ba za ka taɓa aikata irin wannan abu ba, ka kashe masu adalci tare da masu mugunta, ka ɗauka masu adalci da masu mugunta daidai? Tabbatacce ba za ka taɓa aikata irin wannan abu ba! Mai hukuncin dukan duniya ba zai aikata gaskiya ba?”
english: May it be far from you to do things like that, to kill the righteous with the wicked, so that the righteous should be like the wicked. May that be far from you. Shouldn’t the Judge of all the earth do right?”

hausa: “Ka tuna da umarnan da ka ba wa bawanka Musa, kana cewa, ‘In kun yi rashin aminci, zan warwatsar da ku a cikin al’ummai,
english: “Remember, I beg you, the word that you commanded your servant Moses, saying, ‘If you trespass, I will scatter you among the peoples;

hausa: Ɗana, ka saurari umarnin mahaifinka kada kuma ka ƙyale koyarwar mahaifiyarka.
english: My son, listen to your father’s instruction, and don’t forsake your mother’s teaching;

hausa: Sai ranar Bikin Burodi Marar Yisti ta kewayo, wato, ranar hadayar ɗan ragon kafara na Bikin Ƙetarewa.
english: The day of unleavened bread came, on which the Passover must be sacrificed.

hausa: Kash, da a ce zukatansu za su zama masu tsorona, su kuma kiyaye dukan dokokina kullum mana, saboda kome yă zama da lafiya gare su, da kuma ’ya’yansu har abada!
english: Oh that there were such a heart in them that they would fear me and keep all my commandments always, that it might be well with them and with their children forever!

hausa: Za ku iya yin muguwar magana a madadin Allah? Ko za ku yi ƙarya a madadinsa?
english: Will you speak unrighteously for God, and talk deceitfully for him?

hausa: Sai shugaban ƙungiyar sojan ya kama hannun saurayin ya ja shi gefe, ya tambaye shi cewa, “Mene ne kake so ka gaya mini?”
english: The commanding officer took him by the hand, and going aside, asked him privately, “What is it that you have to tell me?”

hausa: Yesu ya amsa mata ya ce, “Da kin san kyautar Allah, da kuma wanda yake roƙonki ruwan sha, da kin roƙe shi, shi kuwa da ya ba ki ruwan rai.”
english: Jesus answered her, “If you knew the gift of God, and who it is who says to you, ‘Give me a drink,’ you would have asked him, and he would have given you living water.”

hausa: Sai Yaƙub ya kira ’ya’yansa maza ya ce, “Ku tattaru don in faɗa muku abin da zai faru gare ku, a kwanaki masu zuwa.
english: Jacob called to his sons, and said: “Gather yourselves together, that I may tell you that which will happen to you in the days to come.

hausa: Ruhu Mai Tsarki ma ya yi mana shaida game da wannan. Da farko ya ce,
english: The Holy Spirit also testifies to us, for after saying,

hausa: ko a kamannin wata dabba a duniya, ko na wani tsuntsun da yake tashi a sama,
english: the likeness of any animal that is on the earth, the likeness of any winged bird that flies in the sky,

hausa: A Shekara ta Murna ɗin, gonar za tă dawo ga mutumin da aka saye ta daga wurinsa, wanda yake mai gonar.
english: In the Year of Jubilee the field shall return to him from whom it was bought, even to him to whom the possession of the land belongs.

hausa: Yanzu, ya sarki, sai ka yi umarni ka kuma yi shi a rubuce saboda kada a canja shi, bisa ga dokar Medes da Farisa, waɗanda ba a iya sokewa.”
english: Now, O king, establish the decree and sign the writing, that it not be changed, according to the law of the Medes and Persians, which doesn’t alter.”

hausa: Yesu ya ce musu, “Ku kawo waɗansu kifin da kuka kama yanzu.”
english: Jesus said to them, “Bring some of the fish which you have just caught.”

hausa: Sai shugaban ƙungiyar sojan ya je ya tambayi Bulus ya ce, “Faɗa mini, kai ɗan ƙasar Roma ne?” Bulus ya ce, “I.”
english: The commanding officer came and asked him, “Tell me, are you a Roman?” He said, “Yes.”

hausa: Kun manta da Allah Mai Cetonku; ba ku tuna da Dutse, kagararku ba. Saboda haka, ko da yake kun fita ku shuka tsire-tsire mafi kyau kuka kuma shuka inabin da aka sayo daga waje,
english: For you have forgotten the God of your salvation, and have not remembered the rock of your strength. Therefore you plant pleasant plants, and set out foreign seedlings.

hausa: Sa’an nan yawansu ya ragu, aka kuma ƙasƙantar da su ta wurin danniya, bala’i da kuma baƙin ciki;
english: Again, they are diminished and bowed down through oppression, trouble, and sorrow.

hausa: Za a jefar da waɗanda aka kashe gawawwakinsu za su yi wari; duwatsu za su jiƙu da jininsu.
english: Their slain will also be cast out, and the stench of their dead bodies will come up. The mountains will melt in their blood.

hausa: Sa’ad da kuke gab da kama yaƙi, sai firist yă zo gaba yă yi wa mayaƙan jawabi.
english: It shall be, when you draw near to the battle, that the priest shall approach and speak to the people,

hausa: fushin Allah ya ƙuna a kansu; ya karkashe waɗanda suka fi ƙiba a cikinsu, yana yankan matasan Isra’ila.
english: when the anger of God went up against them, killed some of their strongest, and struck down the young men of Israel.

hausa: Ibrahim ya ware ’yan raguna bakwai daga cikin garke,
english: Abraham set seven ewe lambs of the flock by themselves.

hausa: Yahuda ya ce wa ’yan’uwansa, “Me zai amfane mu in muka kashe ɗan’uwanmu muka ɓoye jininsa?
english: Judah said to his brothers, “What profit is it if we kill our brother and conceal his blood?

hausa: Yayinda nake saurara, sai ya ce wa waɗansu, “Ku bi shi ta birnin ku kuma kashe, babu tausayi ko kuwa jinƙai.
english: To the others he said in my hearing, “Go through the city after him, and strike. Don’t let your eye spare, neither have pity.

hausa: bari gonaki su yi tsalle da murna, da kuma kome da yake cikinsu. Ta haka dukan itatuwan kurmi za su rera don farin ciki;
english: Let the field and all that is in it exult! Then all the trees of the woods shall sing for joy

hausa: Sun ce, “Ku juye yanzu, kowannenku, daga mugayen hanyoyinku da mugayen ayyukanku, za ku kuwa iya zauna a ƙasar da Ubangiji ya ba ku da kuma kakanninku har abada abadin.
english: saying, “Return now everyone from his evil way, and from the evil of your doings, and dwell in the land that Yahweh has given to you and to your fathers, from of old and even forever more.

hausa: Ba zan dube ki da tausayi ko in ƙyale ke ba; zan sāka miki bisa ga halinki da kuma ayyukan masu banƙyama a cikinki. Sa’an nan za ki san cewa ni ne Ubangiji wanda yake bugunki.
english: My eye won’t spare, neither will I have pity. I will punish you according to your ways. Your abominations will be among you. Then you will know that I, Yahweh, strike.

hausa: Ya rushe hasumiyar Fenuwel ya kuma karkashe mutanen garin.
english: He broke down the tower of Penuel, and killed the men of the city.

hausa: Waɗannan mutanen ne suka zo daga garuruwan Tel-Mela, Tel-Harsha, Kerub, Addan da Immer, amma ba su iya nuna ainihin tushensu daga Isra’ila ba.
english: These were those who went up from Tel Melah, Tel Harsha, Cherub, Addan, and Immer; but they could not show their fathers’ houses and their offspring, whether they were of Israel:

hausa: Dukan garuruwan nan goma tare da wuraren kiwonsu ne aka ba sauran iyalan Kohatawa.
english: All the cities of the families of the rest of the children of Kohath were ten with their pasture lands.

hausa: Sa’an nan Isra’ilawa suka ce, “Wace kabila ce cikin kabilan Isra’ila ba tă zo taro a gaban Ubangiji ba?” Gama an yi rantsuwa cewa duk wanda ya kāsa zuwa taro a gaban Ubangiji a Mizfa lalle a kashe shi.
english: The children of Israel said, “Who is there among all the tribes of Israel who didn’t come up in the assembly to Yahweh?” For they had made a great oath concerning him who didn’t come up to Yahweh to Mizpah, saying, “He shall surely be put to death.”

hausa: Ku marabce shi cikin Ubangiji da farin ciki mai yawa, ku kuma girmama mutane irinsa,
english: Receive him therefore in the Lord with all joy, and hold such people in honor,

hausa: Yehu zai kashe duk wani wanda ya tsere wa takobin Hazayel, Elisha kuwa zai kashe duk wani wanda ya tsere wa takobin Yehu.
english: He who escapes from the sword of Hazael, Jehu will kill; and he who escapes from the sword of Jehu, Elisha will kill.

hausa: Da Shawulu ya isa inda ake ajiye garken tumaki a bakin hanya inda akwai kogo, sai ya shiga ciki kogon don yă yi bayan gari. Dawuda da mutanensa kuwa suna can zaune a ƙurewar kogon.
english: He came to the sheep pens by the way, where there was a cave; and Saul went in to relieve himself. Now David and his men were staying in the innermost parts of the cave.

hausa: Sai Daniyel ya ce wa mai gadi wanda sarkin fada ya sa yă kula da Daniyel, Hananiya, Mishayel da Azariya,
english: Then Daniel said to the steward whom the prince of the eunuchs had appointed over Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah:

hausa: Ya zo kan Siman Bitrus, wanda ya ce masa, “Ubangiji, kai za ka wanke ƙafafuna?”
english: Then he came to Simon Peter. He said to him, “Lord, do you wash my feet?”

hausa: gama zai zama mai girma a gaban Ubangiji. Ba kuwa zai taɓa shan ruwan inabi ko wani abu mai sa maye ba. Zai cika da Ruhu Mai Tsarki tun haihuwa.
english: For he will be great in the sight of the Lord, and he will drink no wine nor strong drink. He will be filled with the Holy Spirit, even from his mother’s womb.

hausa: Yanzu an sa wa Yoshuwa tufafi masu dauda sa’ad da yake tsaye a gaban mala’ikan.
english: Now Joshua was clothed with filthy garments, and was standing before the angel.

hausa: Dukan taron Isra’ila suka tashi daga Elim suka zo hamadar Sin, wadda take tsakanin Elim da Sinai, a rana ta goma sha biyar ga wata biyu, bayan sun fito daga Masar.
english: They took their journey from Elim, and all the congregation of the children of Israel came to the wilderness of Sin, which is between Elim and Sinai, on the fifteenth day of the second month after their departing out of the land of Egypt.

hausa: Irin waɗannan mutane muna ba da umarni muna kuma gargaɗe su cikin Ubangiji Yesu Kiristi su natsu su kuma nemi abincin da suke ci.
english: Now those who are that way, we command and exhort in the Lord Jesus Christ, that they work with quietness and eat their own bread.

hausa: Ubangiji yakan yi magana da Musa fuska da fuska, kamar yadda mutum yake magana da abokinsa. Sa’an nan Musa yă koma sansani, amma saurayin nan Yoshuwa ɗan Nun mai taimakonsa ba ya barin tentin.
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses face to face, as a man speaks to his friend. He turned again into the camp, but his servant Joshua, the son of Nun, a young man, didn’t depart from the Tent.

hausa: Tabbatacce, sa’ad da Al’ummai, waɗanda ba su da dokar, suka aikata abubuwan da dokar take bukata, abubuwan sun zama doka ke nan gare su, ko da yake ba su da dokar.
english: (for when Gentiles who don’t have the law do by nature the things of the law, these, not having the law, are a law to themselves,

hausa: Waɗanda suka ga abin da ya faru, suka ba da labarin abin da ya faru da mai aljanun, da kuma aladun.
english: Those who saw it declared to them what happened to him who was possessed by demons, and about the pigs.

hausa: Mutum zai iya ɗiba wuta ya zuba a cinyarsa ba tare da rigunansa sun ƙone ba?
english: Can a man scoop fire into his lap, and his clothes not be burned?

hausa: Daga zuriyar Benyamin akwai, Sallu ɗan Meshullam, ɗan Yowed, ɗan Fedahiya, ɗan Kolahiya, ɗan Ma’asehiya, ɗan Itiyel, ɗan Yeshahiya,
english: These are the sons of Benjamin: Sallu the son of Meshullam, the son of Joed, the son of Pedaiah, the son of Kolaiah, the son of Maaseiah, the son of Ithiel, the son of Jeshaiah.

hausa: Uzzi mahaifin Zerahiya, Zerahiya mahaifin Merahiyot,
english: Uzzi became the father of Zerahiah. Zerahiah became the father of Meraioth.

hausa: Wannan yaron ne na roƙa daga wurin Ubangiji, ya kuwa ba ni abin da na roƙa daga gare shi.
english: I prayed for this child, and Yahweh has given me my petition which I asked of him.

hausa: Yayinda dukan taron Isra’ila suke tsattsaye a can, sai sarki ya juya ya albarkace su.
english: The king turned his face around and blessed all the assembly of Israel; and all the assembly of Israel stood.

hausa: Kadada goma na gonar inabi zai ba da garwan ruwan inabi ɗaya kaɗai, mudu guda na iri kuma zai ba da efa na hatsi guda kurum.”
english: For ten acres of vineyard shall yield one bath, and a homer of seed shall yield an ephah.”

hausa: Uttai ɗan Ammihud, ɗan Omri, ɗan Imri, ɗan Bani, zuriyar Ferez ɗan Yahuda.
english: Uthai the son of Ammihud, the son of Omri, the son of Imri, the son of Bani, of the children of Perez the son of Judah.

hausa: “Duk da haka Isra’ilawa za su zama kamar yashi a bakin teku, da ba za a iya aunawa ko a ƙirga ba. A inda aka ce musu, ‘Ku ba mutanena ba ne,’ za a kira su ‘’ya’yan Allah mai rai.’
english: Yet the number of the children of Israel will be as the sand of the sea, which can’t be measured or counted; and it will come to pass that, in the place where it was said to them, ‘You are not my people,’ they will be called ‘sons of the living God.’

hausa: Amma fa, in ba ku yi biyayya ga Ubangiji Allahnku ba, ba ku kuma lura kun bi dukan umarnansa da ƙa’idodin da nake ba ku a yau ba, dukan la’anan nan za su zo a bisanku, su kuma same ku.
english: But it shall come to pass, if you will not listen to Yahweh your God’s voice, to observe to do all his commandments and his statutes which I command you today, that all these curses will come on you and overtake you.

hausa: Zan kula da su a wurin kiwo mai kyau, kuma ƙwanƙolin duwatsun Isra’ila ne zai zama wurin kiwonsu. Za su kwanta a wurin kiwo mai kyau, a can kuma za su yi kiwo a wurin kiwo mai kyau a kan duwatsun Isra’ila.
english: I will feed them with good pasture, and their fold will be on the mountains of the height of Israel. There they will lie down in a good fold. They will feed on rich pasture on the mountains of Israel.

hausa: Mutane za su je can da baka da kibiyoyi, gama ƙayayyuwa da sarƙaƙƙiya ne za su rufe ƙasar.
english: People will go there with arrows and with bow, because all the land will be briers and thorns.

hausa: Ba nufi nake yi a sawwaƙe wa waɗansu, ku kuwa a jibga muku nauyin ba. Amma ya yi kyau dai
english: For this is not that others may be eased and you distressed,

hausa: Ubangiji zai rubuta a littafin sunayen mutanensa, “An haifi wannan a Sihiyona.” Sela
english: Yahweh will count, when he writes up the peoples, “This one was born there.” Selah.

hausa: Ku kanku za ku shaida cewa na ce, ‘Ba ni ne Kiristi ba, sai dai an aiko ni ne in sha gabansa.’
english: You yourselves testify that I said, ‘I am not the Christ,’ but, ‘I have been sent before him.’

hausa: Sa’an nan Dawuda ya ce, “Babu wani sai ko Lawiyawa kaɗai za su ɗauka akwatin alkawarin Allah, gama Ubangiji ya zaɓe su su ɗauka akwatin alkawarin Ubangiji su kuma yi hidima a gabansa har abada.”
english: Then David said, “No one ought to carry God’s ark but the Levites. For Yahweh has chosen them to carry God’s ark, and to minister to him forever.”

hausa: Allah ya ce masa, “Sunanka Yaƙub ne, amma ba za a ƙara kira ka Yaƙub ba; sunanka zai zama Isra’ila.” Saboda haka ya ba shi suna Isra’ila.
english: God said to him, “Your name is Jacob. Your name shall not be Jacob any more, but your name will be Israel.” He named him Israel.

hausa: Sashe na man da aka ƙayyade, da aka auna da garwa, kashi ɗaya bisa goma ne na garwa daga ganga (wanda yakan ci garwa goma, gama garwa goma suna daidai da ganga guda).
english: and the set portion of oil, of the bath of oil, one tenth of a bath out of the cor, which is ten baths, even a homer (for ten baths are a homer),

hausa: Zan tara dukan al’ummai su yaƙi Urushalima; za a ci birnin da yaƙi, za a washe gidaje, a kuma yi wa mata fyaɗe. Rabin birnin zai je bauta, amma ba za a kwashe sauran mutanen daga birnin ba.
english: For I will gather all nations against Jerusalem to battle; and the city will be taken, the houses rifled, and the women ravished. Half of the city will go out into captivity, and the rest of the people will not be cut off from the city.

hausa: Wannan tsibin shi ne shaida, wannan al’amudi kuma shaida ne, cewa ba zan tsallake wannan tsibi zuwa gefenka don in cuce ka ba, kai kuma ba za ka tsallake wannan tsibi da al’amudi zuwa gefena don ka cuce ni ba.
english: May this heap be a witness, and the pillar be a witness, that I will not pass over this heap to you, and that you will not pass over this heap and this pillar to me, for harm.

hausa: gama ina farin ciki da umarnanka saboda ina ƙaunarsu.
english: I will delight myself in your commandments, because I love them.

hausa: kada ka yi garaje kai ƙara a majalisa, gama me za ka yi a ƙarshe in maƙwabcinka ya ba ka kunya?
english: Don’t be hasty in bringing charges to court. What will you do in the end when your neighbor shames you?

hausa: Mordekai mutumin Yahuda, shi ne na biyu a matsayi bayan Sarki Zerzes, mai farin ciki kuma a cikin Yahudawa, aka kuma ɗauke shi da martaba cikin ’yan’uwansa Yahudawa. Gama ya yi aiki don kyautatawar mutanensa, ya kuma yi magana don a kyautata rayuwar dukan Yahudawa.
english: For Mordecai the Jew was next to King Ahasuerus, and great among the Jews and accepted by the multitude of his brothers, seeking the good of his people and speaking peace to all his descendants.

hausa: A ƙarshen waɗannan kwanaki, ni, Nebukadnezzar, na ɗaga idanuna sama, sai hankalina ya komo mini. Na kuwa yabi Maɗaukaki, na girmama shi, na ɗaukaka shi wanda yake rayayye har abada.
english: At the end of the days I, Nebuchadnezzar, lifted up my eyes to heaven, and my understanding returned to me; and I blessed the Most High, and I praised and honored him who lives forever, for his dominion is an everlasting dominion, and his kingdom from generation to generation.

hausa: Ka yi da shi gwargwadon hikimarka, amma kada ka bari yă gangara kabari da furfura cikin salama.
english: Do therefore according to your wisdom, and don’t let his gray head go down to Sheol in peace.

hausa: Ka cika zuciyata da farin ciki sa’ad da hatsinsu da sabon ruwan inabinsu ya yi yawa.
english: You have put gladness in my heart, more than when their grain and their new wine are increased.

hausa: Jin ƙarfi da ya cika ƙasusuwansa zai kwantar da shi a cikin ƙura.
english: His bones are full of his youth, but youth will lie down with him in the dust.

hausa: Waɗansu mata suna kallo daga nesa. A cikinsu kuwa akwai Maryamu Magdalin, Maryamu mahaifiyar Yaƙub ƙarami da Yusuf, da kuma Salome.
english: There were also women watching from afar, among whom were both Mary Magdalene and Mary the mother of James the less and of Joses, and Salome;

hausa: “ ‘Sa’ad da mutanen ƙasar suka zo gaban Ubangiji a ƙayyadaddun bukukkuwa, duk wanda ya shiga ta ƙofar arewa don yă yi sujada sai ya fita ta ƙofar kudu; kuma duk wanda ya shiga ta ƙofar kudu sai ya fita ta ƙofar arewa. Ba wanda zai koma ta ƙofar da ya shiga, amma kowa zai fita a ƙofar ɗaura da wadda ya shiga.
english: “‘“But when the people of the land come before Yahweh in the appointed feasts, he who enters by the way of the north gate to worship shall go out by the way of the south gate; and he who enters by the way of the south gate shall go out by the way of the north gate. He shall not return by the way of the gate by which he came in, but shall go out straight before him.

hausa: In a wannan rayuwar ce kaɗai muke da bege cikin Kiristi, mun zama abin tausayi fiye da dukan mutane.
english: If we have only hoped in Christ in this life, we are of all men most pitiable.

hausa: Sai ’ya’yan Isra’ila maza suka yi haka. Yusuf ya ba su wagonu kamar yadda Fir’auna ya umarta, ya kuma ba su guzuri don tafiyarsu.
english: The sons of Israel did so. Joseph gave them wagons, according to the commandment of Pharaoh, and gave them provision for the way.

hausa: Ziffora ta haifi wa Musa ɗa, ya kuma raɗa masa suna Gershom cewa, “Na zama baƙo a baƙuwar ƙasa.”
english: She bore a son, and he named him Gershom, for he said, “I have lived as a foreigner in a foreign land.”

hausa: Gama a rubuce yake, “ ‘Zai umarci mala’ikunsa game da kai, su kiyaye ka da kyau;
english: for it is written, ‘He will put his angels in charge of you, to guard you;’

hausa: Ebal, Abimayel, Sheba,
english: Ebal, Abimael, Sheba,

hausa: “Zan aika maka Huram-Abi, wani gwani wanda ya iya aiki, kuma mai hikima,
english: Now I have sent a skillful man, endowed with understanding, Huram-abi,

hausa: A rana ta takwas, za a yi wa yaron kaciya.
english: In the eighth day the flesh of his foreskin shall be circumcised.

hausa: Bari fansassu na Ubangiji su faɗa wannan, su da aka fansa daga hannun maƙiyi,
english: Let the redeemed by Yahweh say so, whom he has redeemed from the hand of the adversary,

hausa: “Mutumin da ya rasa gashi kansa ya zama mai sanƙo ke nan, duk da haka mutumin tsattsarka ne.
english: “If a man’s hair has fallen from his head, he is bald. He is clean.

hausa: tare da hadaya ta lallausan gari kashi ɗaya bisa goma na efan, kwaɓaɓɓe da kwalaba ɗaya na man zaitun mafi kyau.
english: with one tenth of an ephah of fine flour for a meal offering, mixed with the fourth part of a hin of beaten oil.

hausa: Mutane daga Babilon suka ƙera Sukkot Benot, mutane daga Kut suka ƙera Nergal, mutane daga Hamat suka ƙera Ashima;
english: The men of Babylon made Succoth Benoth, and the men of Cuth made Nergal, and the men of Hamath made Ashima,

hausa: Waɗannan mutane kuwa sun yi mana kirki ƙwarai, ba su ba mu wata wahala ba. Babu abu guda da ya ɓace mana dukan lokacin da muke tare da su.
english: But the men were very good to us, and we were not harmed, and we didn’t miss anything as long as we went with them, when we were in the fields.

hausa: A bisa al’arshin a kan kawunansu akwai abin da ya yi kamar saffaya, kuma a can bisa a kan kursiyin akwai siffa kamar na mutum.
english: Above the expanse that was over their heads was the likeness of a throne, as the appearance of a sapphire stone. On the likeness of the throne was a likeness as the appearance of a man on it above.

hausa: Sarakunan Edom za su tsorata, shugabannin Mowab za su yi rawar jiki, mutanen Kan’ana za su narke.
english: Then the chiefs of Edom were dismayed. Trembling takes hold of the mighty men of Moab. All the inhabitants of Canaan have melted away.

hausa: Sai ya kama hannunta ya ce mata, “Talita kum!” (Wato, “Ƙaramar yarinya, na ce miki, tashi!”).
english: Taking the child by the hand, he said to her, “Talitha cumi!” which means, being interpreted, “Girl, I tell you, get up!”

hausa: Suka yi tsaiko biyu na zinariya da zoban zinariya biyu, suka kuma ɗaura zoban a kusurwoyi biyu na ƙyallen maƙalawa a ƙirji.
english: They made two settings of gold, and two gold rings, and put the two rings on the two ends of the breastplate.

hausa: Sai Yesu ya ce musu, “Ku ba wa Kaisar abin da yake na Kaisar, ku ba wa Allah kuma abin da yake na Allah.” Suka yi mamakinsa ƙwarai.
english: Jesus answered them, “Give to Caesar the things that are Caesar’s, and to God the things that are God’s.” They marveled greatly at him.

hausa: Sai mutane ɗari shida daga kabilar Dan suka yi ɗamarar yaƙi, suka tashi daga Zora da Eshtawol.
english: The family of the Danites set out from Zorah and Eshtaol with six hundred men armed with weapons of war.

hausa: Wannan fili zai zama mallakarsa a Isra’ila. Kuma sarakunana ba za su ƙara zaluntar mutanena ba amma za su bar gidan Isra’ila ya mallaki ƙasar bisa ga kabilansu.
english: In the land it shall be to him for a possession in Israel. My princes shall no more oppress my people, but they shall give the land to the house of Israel according to their tribes.”

hausa: Ya Ubangiji, ka ruɗe ni, na kuwa ruɗu; ka fi ni ƙarfi, ka kuwa yi nasara. Na zama abin dariya dukan yini; kowa yana yi mini ba’a.
english: Yahweh, you have persuaded me, and I was persuaded. You are stronger than I, and have prevailed. I have become a laughingstock all day. Everyone mocks me.

hausa: Da shekara ta kewayo, sai Elkana da iyalinsa suka sāke tafi Shilo domin su yi hadaya ga Ubangiji, yă kuma cika alkawarin da ya yi.
english: The man Elkanah, and all his house, went up to offer to Yahweh the yearly sacrifice and his vow.

hausa: Ya Ubangiji, na ji irin shaharar da ka yi; na yi al’ajabi game da ayyukanka, ya Ubangiji. Ka maimaita su a kwanakinmu, ka sanar da su a lokacinmu; ka yi jinƙai ko a lokacin da kake fushi.
english: Yahweh, I have heard of your fame. I stand in awe of your deeds, Yahweh. Renew your work in the middle of the years. In the middle of the years make it known. In wrath, you remember mercy.

hausa: “Na fari ya zo ya ce, ‘Ranka yă daɗe, minarka ya sami ribar goma.’
english: The first came before him, saying, ‘Lord, your mina has made ten more minas.’

hausa: Ya zo ya karɓi naɗaɗɗen littafin daga hannun dama na wannan wanda yake zaune a kursiyin.
english: Then he came, and he took it out of the right hand of him who sat on the throne.

hausa: Sai Bilatus ya ce, “Shi ke nan, ku ɗebi soja, ku je ku tsare kabarin iya ƙoƙarinku.”
english: Pilate said to them, “You have a guard. Go, make it as secure as you can.”

hausa: Kuma kai, ɗan mutum, za su ɗaura ka da igiyoyi; za a daure ka yadda ba za ka iya fita a cikin mutane ba.
english: But you, son of man, behold, they will put ropes on you, and will bind you with them, and you will not go out among them.

hausa: Zan kakkarye ƙofofin Bet-Damaskus; zan hallaka sarkin da yake cikin Kwarin Awen da kuma mai riƙe da sandar mulkin Bet-Eden. Mutanen Aram za su je bauta a ƙasar Kir,” in ji Ubangiji.
english: I will break the bar of Damascus, and cut off the inhabitant from the valley of Aven, and him who holds the scepter from the house of Eden; and the people of Syria shall go into captivity to Kir,” says Yahweh.

hausa: Wawa yakan ƙi kulawa da horon da mahaifinsa yake masa, amma duk wanda ya yarda da gyara kan nuna azanci.
english: A fool despises his father’s correction, but he who heeds reproof shows prudence.

hausa: Me zai sa a wulaƙanta jarumawanka haka? Ba za su iya tsayawa ba, gama Ubangiji zai ture su ƙasa.
english: Why are your strong ones swept away? They didn’t stand, because Yahweh pushed them.

hausa: Da manzannin suka zo Gibeya garin Shawulu, suka gaya wa mutane wannan sharaɗin, suka yi kuka mai zafi.
english: Then the messengers came to Gibeah of Saul, and spoke these words in the ears of the people, then all the people lifted up their voice and wept.

hausa: Ka tashi Ya Ubangiji! Ka cece ni, ya Allahna! Ka bugi dukan abokan gābana a muƙamuƙi; ka kakkarya haƙoran mugaye.
english: Arise, Yahweh! Save me, my God! For you have struck all of my enemies on the cheek bone. You have broken the teeth of the wicked.

hausa: Duk da haka an haifi mutum don wahala ne, kamar yadda ba shakka tartsatsin wuta yake tashi.
english: but man is born to trouble, as the sparks fly upward.

hausa: Buɗe mini ƙofofin adalci; zan shiga in kuma yi godiya ga Ubangiji.
english: Open to me the gates of righteousness. I will enter into them. I will give thanks to Yah.

hausa: Salmon ya haifi Bowaz, wanda Rahab ce mahaifiyarsa, Bowaz ya haifi Obed, wanda Rut ce mahaifiyarsa, Obed ya haifi Yesse,
english: Salmon became the father of Boaz by Rahab. Boaz became the father of Obed by Ruth. Obed became the father of Jesse.

hausa: wurin ajiye fitila na zinariya zalla tare da fitilunsu, don ƙonawa a gaban wuri mai tsarki na ciki kamar yadda aka tsara;
english: and the lamp stands with their lamps to burn according to the ordinance before the inner sanctuary, of pure gold;

hausa: Ni ne Rayayye, dā na mutu, ga shi kuwa ina a raye har abada abadin! Ina kuma riƙe da mabuɗan mutuwa da na Hades.
english: and the Living one. I was dead, and behold, I am alive forever and ever. Amen. I have the keys of Death and of Hades.

hausa: Duniya ba za tă iya ƙinku ba, amma ni take ƙi domin ina shaida cewa ayyukanta mugaye ne.
english: The world can’t hate you, but it hates me, because I testify about it, that its works are evil.

hausa: Sai ya saukar da jikin, ya nannaɗe shi a cikin zanen lilin, ya sa shi a wani kabari da aka fafe a cikin dutse, wadda ba a taɓa sa kowa ba.
english: He took it down and wrapped it in a linen cloth, and laid him in a tomb that was cut in stone, where no one had ever been laid.

hausa: “ ‘Kada ku ba da wani daga cikin ’ya’yanku don a yi hadaya wa Molek, gama ba za ku ƙasƙantar da sunan Allahnku ba. Ni ne Ubangiji.
english: “‘You shall not give any of your children as a sacrifice to Molech. You shall not profane the name of your God. I am Yahweh.

hausa: Sai almajiran suka koma zuwa inda suke zama.
english: So the disciples went away again to their own homes.

hausa: “Dukan jama’ar Ubangiji sun ce yaya za ku juya wa Allah na Isra’ila baya haka? Yaya za ku daina bin Ubangiji ku gina wa kanku bagade, ku yi masa tawaye yanzu?
english: “The whole congregation of Yahweh says, ‘What trespass is this that you have committed against the God of Israel, to turn away today from following Yahweh, in that you have built yourselves an altar, to rebel today against Yahweh?

hausa: Sa’an nan Amaziya ya yi ƙarfin hali ya jagoranci mayaƙansa zuwa Kwarin Gishiri, inda ya kashe mutanen Seyir dubu goma.
english: Amaziah took courage, and led his people out and went to the Valley of Salt, and struck ten thousand of the children of Seir.

hausa: jakuna 30,500, jakunan da aka ware wa Ubangiji kuwa 61 ne;
english: The donkeys were thirty thousand five hundred, of which Yahweh’s tribute was sixty-one.

hausa: Sai Ziba ya ce wa sarki, “Bawanka zai aikata dukan abin da ranka yă daɗe sarki, ya umarce shi.” Saboda haka Mefiboshet ya riƙa ci a teburin Dawuda kamar sauran ’ya’yan sarki.
english: Then Ziba said to the king, “According to all that my lord the king commands his servant, so your servant will do.” So Mephibosheth ate at the king’s table like one of the king’s sons.

hausa: An gama ginin haikalin a rana ta uku na watan Adar a shekara ta shida ta mulkin Sarki Dariyus.
english: This house was finished on the third day of the month Adar, which was in the sixth year of the reign of Darius the king.

hausa: Ubangiji ya yi abin da ya shirya; ya cika maganarsa, wadda ya umarta tun daɗewa. Ya jefar da ke ba tausayi, ya bari maƙiya sun yi nasara da ke, ya ɗaukaka ƙahon maƙiyanki.
english: Yahweh has done that which he planned. He has fulfilled his word that he commanded in the days of old. He has thrown down, and has not pitied. He has caused the enemy to rejoice over you. He has exalted the horn of your adversaries.

hausa: Da asuba sai suka tashi, Sama’ila ya kira Shawulu daga ɗakin sama ya ce, “Ka shirya, zan sallame ka.” Da Shawulu ya shirya, sai Sama’ila da Shawulu suka fita waje tare.
english: They arose early; and about daybreak, Samuel called to Saul on the housetop, saying, “Get up, that I may send you away.” Saul arose, and they both went outside, he and Samuel, together.

hausa: Saɓanin dukan bege, Ibrahim cikin bege ya gaskata, haka kuwa ya zama uban al’ummai masu yawa, kamar yadda aka riga aka faɗa masa cewa, “Haka zuriyarka za tă zama.”
english: Against hope, Abraham in hope believed, to the end that he might become a father of many nations, according to that which had been spoken, “So will your offspring be.”

hausa: Suka ce, ya Ubangiji, Allah na Isra’ila, “Me ya sa wannan abu ya faru da Isra’ila? Don me kabila ɗaya daga Isra’ila za tă ɓace a yau?”
english: They said, “Yahweh, the God of Israel, why has this happened in Israel, that there should be one tribe lacking in Israel today?”

hausa: Aka binne shi a Mowab, a kwarin kusa da Bet-Feyor, amma har wa yau babu wanda ya san inda kabarinsa yake.
english: He buried him in the valley in the land of Moab opposite Beth Peor, but no man knows where his tomb is to this day.

hausa: Sai ya ce musu, “Na yi marmari ƙwarai don in ci wannan Bikin Ƙetarewa tare da ku, kafin in sha wahala.
english: He said to them, “I have earnestly desired to eat this Passover with you before I suffer,

hausa: rantsuwa ce za tă raba tsakaninsu a gaban Ubangiji cewa babu hannunsa a dukiyar maƙwabcinsa. Mai dukiyar kuwa zai yarda da rantsuwar, ba za a bukaci wanda aka bai wa amanar yă biya ba.
english: the oath of Yahweh shall be between them both, he has not put his hand on his neighbor’s goods; and its owner shall accept it, and he shall not make restitution.

hausa: Amma wani ya harba kibiya haka kawai, sai kibiyar ta sami sarki Ahab na Isra’ila a kafaɗa tsakanin rigar yaƙinsa na ƙarfe da ƙarfen ƙirjinsa. Sai sarki ya ce wa mai tuƙan keken yaƙi, “Juya ka fitar da ni daga wurin yaƙin. An ji mini rauni.”
english: A certain man drew his bow at random, and struck the king of Israel between the joints of the armor. Therefore he said to the driver of the chariot, “Turn around and carry me out of the battle, for I am severely wounded.”

hausa: saiwar da hannun damarka ya dasa, ɗan da ka renar wa kanka.
english: the stock which your right hand planted, the branch that you made strong for yourself.

hausa: (Farisiyawa da dukan Yahudawa ba sa cin abinci, sai sun wanke hannuwa sarai tukuna, yadda al’adun dattawa suka ce.
english: (For the Pharisees and all the Jews don’t eat unless they wash their hands and forearms, holding to the tradition of the elders.

hausa: Bari masu girman kai su sha kunya saboda abubuwa marasa kyau da suke yi mini ba dalili; amma zan yi tunani a kan farillanka.
english: Let the proud be disappointed, for they have overthrown me wrongfully. I will meditate on your precepts.

hausa: Amma da yake ba ku gaskata abin da ya rubuta ba, yaya za ku gaskata maganata?”
english: But if you don’t believe his writings, how will you believe my words?”

hausa: Kada ku bar wani yă ruɗe ku ko ta yaya, gama wannan rana ba za tă zo ba sai an yi tawayen nan an kuma bayyana mutumin tawayen nan, mutumin da aka ƙaddara ga hallaka.
english: Let no one deceive you in any way. For it will not be unless the rebellion comes first, and the man of sin is revealed, the son of destruction.

hausa: Amma muka ce, ‘Ba za mu iya gangarawa ba, sai in ƙaramin ɗan’uwanmu yana tare da mu. Ba za mu iya ganin fuskar mutumin ba, sai ƙaramin ɗan’uwanmu yana tare mu.’
english: We said, ‘We can’t go down. If our youngest brother is with us, then we will go down: for we may not see the man’s face, unless our youngest brother is with us.’

hausa: Saboda haka Amaziya ya sallame rundunonin da suka zo daga Efraim, ya kuma mayar da su gida. Suka husata da Yahuda suka koma gida da fushi sosai.
english: Then Amaziah separated them, the army that had come to him out of Ephraim, to go home again. Therefore their anger was greatly kindled against Judah, and they returned home in fierce anger.

hausa: Ya sa ƙafafuna kamar ƙafafun barewa; ya sa na iya tsayawa a kan duwatsu.
english: He makes his feet like hinds’ feet, and sets me on my high places.

hausa: Maganar Ubangiji ta sāke zo mini cewa, “Me ka gani?” Na amsa na ce, “Na ga tukunya tana tafasa, tana juyewa daga arewa.”
english: Yahweh’s word came to me the second time, saying, “What do you see?” I said, “I see a boiling cauldron; and it is tipping away from the north.”

hausa: Ga abin da Ubangiji ya ce, “Kamar yadda makiyayi yakan ceci daga bakin zaki ƙasusuwa ƙafafu biyu kawai ko kunne ɗaya, haka za a ceci Isra’ilawa, masu zama a Samariya da kan gado kawai da kuma a ɗan ƙyalle a kan dogayen kujerunsu.”
english: Yahweh says: “As the shepherd rescues out of the mouth of the lion two legs, or a piece of an ear, so shall the children of Israel be rescued who sit in Samaria on the corner of a couch, and on the silken cushions of a bed.”

hausa: Zan so in san abu guda tak daga gare ku. Kun karɓi Ruhu ta wurin kiyaye Doka ne, ko kuwa ta wurin gaskata abin da kuka ji?
english: I just want to learn this from you: Did you receive the Spirit by the works of the law, or by hearing of faith?

hausa: Ubangiji ya yi tsawa wa shugaban mayaƙansa; sojojinsa sun fi a ƙirge masu ƙarfi ne kuma su waɗanda suke biyayya da umarninsa. Ranar Ubangiji da girma take; mai banrazana. Wa zai iya jure mata?
english: Yahweh thunders his voice before his army, for his forces are very great; for he is strong who obeys his command; for the day of Yahweh is great and very awesome, and who can endure it?

hausa: Su ne Allah ya so yă sanar da yadda irin yalwar ɗaukakar asirin nan take a cikin al’ummai, asirin nan kuwa shi ne Kiristi a cikinku, begen ɗaukakar da za a bayyana.
english: to whom God was pleased to make known what are the riches of the glory of this mystery among the Gentiles, which is Christ in you, the hope of glory.

hausa: Game da Kedar da mulkokin Hazor, waɗanda Nebukadnezzar sarkin Babilon ya fāɗa wa. Ga abin da Ubangiji yana cewa, “Tashi, ku fāɗa wa Kedar ku kuma hallaka mutanen Gabas.
english: Of Kedar, and of the kingdoms of Hazor, which Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon struck, Yahweh says: “Arise, go up to Kedar, and destroy the children of the east.

hausa: Sai annabi Irmiya ya amsa wa annabi Hananiya a gaban firistoci da kuma dukan mutane waɗanda suke tsaye a gidan Ubangiji.
english: Then the prophet Jeremiah said to the prophet Hananiah in the presence of the priests, and in the presence of all the people who stood in Yahweh’s house,

hausa: Allah kuwa ya aiki mala’ika yă hallaka Urushalima. Amma yayinda mala’ikan yana gab da yin haka, sai Ubangiji ya gani ya kuma yi nadama saboda masifar, sai ya ce wa mala’ikan wanda yake hallaka mutane, “Ya isa! Janye hannunka.” Mala’ikan Ubangiji kuwa yana tsaye a masussukar Ornan mutumin Yebus.
english: God sent an angel to Jerusalem to destroy it. As he was about to destroy, Yahweh saw, and he relented of the disaster, and said to the destroying angel, “It is enough. Now withdraw your hand.” Yahweh’s angel was standing by the threshing floor of Ornan the Jebusite.

hausa: Bayan wannan, ɗan’uwansa ya fito, da hannunsa yana riƙe da ɗiɗɗigen Isuwa; don haka aka sa masa suna Yaƙub. Ishaku yana da shekara sittin, lokacin da Rebeka ta haife su.
english: After that, his brother came out, and his hand had hold on Esau’s heel. He was named Jacob. Isaac was sixty years old when she bore them.

hausa: Sai mahaifiyar Yesu tare da ’yan’uwansa suka iso. Suna tsaye a waje, sai suka aiki wani ciki yă kira shi.
english: His mother and his brothers came, and standing outside, they sent to him, calling him.

hausa: Yowab ya ce wa Amasa, “Yaya kake, ɗan’uwana?” Sai Yowab ya kama gemun Amasa da hannun dama don yă yi masa sumba.
english: Joab said to Amasa, “Is it well with you, my brother?” Joab took Amasa by the beard with his right hand to kiss him.

hausa: Ya tsaya cik, amma ban iya sani ko mene ne ba. Wani abu ya tsaya a gabana, na kuma ji murya.
english: It stood still, but I couldn’t discern its appearance. A form was before my eyes. Silence, then I heard a voice, saying,

hausa: Sai Yesu ya ce wa wanda ya gayyace shi, “Lokacin da ka shirya biki ko liyafa, kada ka gayyaci abokanka, ko ’yan’uwanka, ko danginka, ko kuma maƙwabtanka masu arziki, gama in ka yi haka, suna iya gayyatarka, su biya maka alherin da ka yi musu.
english: He also said to the one who had invited him, “When you make a dinner or a supper, don’t call your friends, nor your brothers, nor your kinsmen, nor rich neighbors, or perhaps they might also return the favor, and pay you back.

hausa: Domin fasikancin Isra’ila bai yi tasiri gare ta ba, sai ta ƙazantar da ƙasar ta kuma yi zina da dutse da kuma itace.
english: Because she took her prostitution lightly, the land was polluted, and she committed adultery with stones and with wood.

hausa: Suna da manufa guda za su kuma ba wa dabbar ikonsu da kuma sarautarsu.
english: These have one mind, and they give their power and authority to the beast.

hausa: Don mai bi da kaɗe-kaɗe. Don Yedutun. Na Asaf. Zabura ce. Na yi kuka ga Allah don taimako; na yi kuka ga Allah don yă ji ni.
english: For the Chief Musician. To Jeduthun. A Psalm by Asaph. My cry goes to God! Indeed, I cry to God for help, and for him to listen to me.

hausa: ta Bani 642
english: The children of Bani, six hundred forty-two.

hausa: Mai mutunci yana tafiya lafiya, amma shi da yake tafiya a karkatattun hanyoyi za a kama shi.
english: He who walks blamelessly walks surely, but he who perverts his ways will be found out.

hausa: Sa’ad da Masarawa suka ganki, za su ce, ‘Wannan matarsa ce.’ Za su kuwa kashe ni, su bar ki da rai.
english: It will happen that when the Egyptians see you, they will say, ‘This is his wife.’ They will kill me, but they will save you alive.

hausa: Sa’an nan Gideyon ɗan Yowash ya komo daga yaƙi ta Hanyar Heres.
english: Gideon the son of Joash returned from the battle from the ascent of Heres.

hausa: Zai sa toguwar lilin mai tsarki, tare da ɗan ciki na lilin; zai yi ɗamara da igiya kewaye da shi, yă kuma sa hular lilin. Waɗannan su ne riguna masu tsarki; saboda haka dole yă yi wanka kafin yă sa su.
english: He shall put on the holy linen tunic. He shall have the linen trousers on his body, and shall put on the linen sash, and he shall be clothed with the linen turban. They are the holy garments. He shall bathe his body in water, and put them on.

hausa: Na karɓi ƙaramin naɗaɗɗen littafin daga hannun mala’ikan na kuma ci. Ya yi zaƙi kamar zuma a bakina, amma sa’ad da na cinye, cikina ya yi tsami.
english: I took the little book out of the angel’s hand, and ate it. It was as sweet as honey in my mouth. When I had eaten it, my stomach was made bitter.

hausa: Bayan Hiridus ya neme shi bai same shi ba, sai ya tuhumi masu gadin, ya kuma ba da umarni a kashe su. Sa’an nan Hiridus ya tashi daga Yahudiya ya tafi Kaisariya ya kuma yi ’yan kwanaki a can.
english: When Herod had sought for him and didn’t find him, he examined the guards, then commanded that they should be put to death. He went down from Judea to Caesarea, and stayed there.

hausa: mutanen Isra’ila. Su ne Allah ya mai da su ’ya’yansa, ya bayyana musu ɗaukakarsa, ya ba su alkawarinsa da Dokarsa, ya nuna musu hanyar sujada ta gaske, ya kuma ba su sauran alkawura.
english: who are Israelites; whose is the adoption, the glory, the covenants, the giving of the law, the service, and the promises;

hausa: In wani ya tilasta ka yin tafiya mil ɗaya, to, tafi tare da shi mil biyu.
english: Whoever compels you to go one mile, go with him two.

hausa: Tsawon fikafikan kerubobin duka kamu ashirin ne, fiffike ɗaya, kamu biyar, ya taɓo bangon ɗakin, ɗaya fiffiken kuma wanda shi ma kamu biyar ne, ya taɓo fiffiken kerub ɗaya ɗin.
english: The wings of the cherubim were twenty cubits long: the wing of the one was five cubits, reaching to the wall of the house; and the other wing was five cubits, reaching to the wing of the other cherub.

hausa: Saboda haka, na ga ya dace in roƙi ’yan’uwan nan su ziyarce ku kafin lokacin, su kuma gama shirye-shirye saboda bayarwa ta yardar ran da kuka yi alkawari. Ta haka bayarwar za tă zama a shirye, ta yardar rai ba ta dole ba.
english: I thought it necessary therefore to entreat the brothers that they would go before to you and arrange ahead of time the generous gift that you promised before, that the same might be ready as a matter of generosity, and not of greediness.

hausa: “Mai albarka ne sarki wanda yake zuwa cikin sunan Ubangiji!” “Salama ta kasance a sama, da ɗaukaka kuma a can cikin sama!”
english: saying, “Blessed is the King who comes in the name of the Lord! Peace in heaven, and glory in the highest!”

hausa: Ka sa muka gudu a gaban abokin gāba, kuma abokan gābanmu suka washe mu.
english: You make us turn back from the adversary. Those who hate us take plunder for themselves.

hausa: A kwanakin ƙarshe za a kafa dutsen haikalin Ubangiji yă zama babba a cikin duwatsu. Za a ɗaga shi sama da tuddai, mutane kuma za su riƙa ɗunguma zuwa gare shi.
english: But in the latter days, it will happen that the mountain of Yahweh’s temple will be established on the top of the mountains, and it will be exalted above the hills; and peoples will stream to it.

hausa: “Keɓe Lawiyawa daga sauran Isra’ilawa, ka tsarkake su.
english: “Take the Levites from among the children of Israel, and cleanse them.

hausa: Gama zan zuba ruwa a ƙeƙasasshiyar ƙasa, rafuffuka kuma a busasshiyar ƙasa; zan ba da Ruhuna ga ’ya’yanka, albarkata kuma ga zuriyarka.
english: For I will pour water on him who is thirsty, and streams on the dry ground. I will pour my Spirit on your descendants, and my blessing on your offspring;

hausa: Ta yaya zai saurara sosai ko zai saurara lokacin da kake cewa ba ka ganinsa, cewa ka kawo ƙara a wurinsa kuma dole ka jira shi.
english: How much less when you say you don’t see him. The cause is before him, and you wait for him!

hausa: Sa’an nan zan aiki yaro in ce masa, ‘Je ka nemo kibiyoyin.’ In na ce masa, ‘Duba, kibiyoyin suna wannan gefen da kake, kawo su,’ sai ka fito, wato, tabbatacce muddin Ubangiji yana raye, ka tsira, ba wani hatsari.
english: Behold, I will send the boy, saying, ‘Go, find the arrows!’ If I tell the boy, ‘Behold, the arrows are on this side of you. Take them;’ then come, for there is peace to you and no danger, as Yahweh lives.

hausa: Na gaya musu maganarka duniya kuwa ta ƙi su, don su ba na duniya ba ne yadda ni ma ba na duniya ba ne.
english: I have given them your word. The world hated them because they are not of the world, even as I am not of the world.

hausa: Saboda haka, an binne mu da shi ke nan, ta wurin baftisma cikin mutuwarsa, domin kamar yadda aka tā da Kiristi daga matattu ta wurin ɗaukakar Uba, haka mu ma mu yi zaman sabuwar rayuwa.
english: We were buried therefore with him through baptism into death, that just as Christ was raised from the dead through the glory of the Father, so we also might walk in newness of life.

hausa: Ko kusa, ba na nufin fasikai marasa bi, ko makwaɗaita da mazambata, ko matsafa, don in haka ne, sai yă zama dole ku fita daga duniya.
english: yet not at all meaning with the sexual sinners of this world, or with the covetous and extortionists, or with idolaters, for then you would have to leave the world.

hausa: Gama haka matan masu tsarki na dā waɗanda suka sa begensu ga Allah suka yi wa kansu ado. Sun yi wa mazansu biyayya,
english: For this is how in the past the holy women who hoped in God also adorned themselves, being in subjection to their own husbands.

hausa: Gama an riga an tsiyaye ni kamar hadaya ta sha, kuma lokacin tashina ya yi.
english: For I am already being offered, and the time of my departure has come.

hausa: Ubangiji Maɗaukaki ya rantse da zatinsa, ya ce Tabbatacce zan cika ka da mutane kamar fāra, za su kuwa yi sowa don nasara a kanka.
english: Yahweh of Armies has sworn by himself, saying, ‘Surely I will fill you with men, as with locusts, and they will lift up a shout against you.’

hausa: To, Ubangiji Allah ya yi dukan namun jeji da dukan tsuntsayen sama daga ƙasa. Ya kawo su wurin mutumin don yă ga wanda suna zai kira su; kuma duk sunan da mutumin ya kira kowane mai rai, sunansa ke nan.
english: Out of the ground Yahweh God formed every animal of the field, and every bird of the sky, and brought them to the man to see what he would call them. Whatever the man called every living creature became its name.

hausa: Saboda haka sai Ubangiji ya dakatar da nufinsa. “Wannan ma ba zai faru ba,” in ji Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka.
english: Yahweh relented concerning this. “This also shall not be,” says the Lord Yahweh.

hausa: A Asabbaci, muka fita ƙofar birnin zuwa bakin kogi, inda muke tsammani za mu sami wurin yin addu’a. Muka zauna muka fara yin wa matan da suka taru a can magana.
english: On the Sabbath day we went outside of the city by a riverside, where we supposed there was a place of prayer, and we sat down and spoke to the women who had come together.

hausa: Zai bincike cutar fatar jiki da take a riga a bangaye, in kuma yana da tabon kore-kore ko ja-ja da suka bayyana da suka yi zurfi fiye da saman bangon,
english: He shall examine the plague; and behold, if the plague is in the walls of the house with hollow streaks, greenish or reddish, and it appears to be deeper than the wall,

hausa: “Saboda haka, ina gaya muku, kada ku damu game da rayuwarku, game da abin da za ku ci, ko abin da za ku sha; ko kuma game da jikinku, game da abin da za ku sa. Ashe, rai bai fi abinci ba, jiki kuma bai fi tufafi ba?
english: Therefore I tell you, don’t be anxious for your life: what you will eat, or what you will drink; nor yet for your body, what you will wear. Isn’t life more than food, and the body more than clothing?

hausa: “ ‘Kada a karɓi fansa don ran wanda ya yi kisankai, wanda ya cancanci mutuwa. Lalle ne a kashe shi.
english: “‘Moreover you shall take no ransom for the life of a murderer who is guilty of death. He shall surely be put to death.

hausa: Saboda haka Dawuda ya haura cikin biyayya ga maganar da Allah ya yi da sunan Ubangiji.
english: David went up at the saying of Gad, which he spoke in Yahweh’s name.

hausa: Saboda haka, abokaina ƙaunatattu, da yake kuna zuba ido ga wannan, sai ku yi matuƙar ƙoƙari don a same ku ba tabo, sai dai zaman salama da shi.
english: Therefore, beloved, seeing that you look for these things, be diligent to be found in peace, without defect and blameless in his sight.

hausa: Dawuda ya ce masa, “Yaya ba ka ji tsoro ɗaga hannu ka hallaka shafaffe na Ubangiji ba?”
english: David said to him, “Why were you not afraid to stretch out your hand to destroy Yahweh’s anointed?”

hausa: Sa’ad da Hadad ya rasu, Samla daga Masreka ya gāje shi.
english: Hadad died, and Samlah of Masrekah reigned in his place.

hausa: Zan sa wuta a Mowab da za tă ƙone kagarun Keriyot Mowab za tă gangara cikin hayaniya mai girma cikin kururuwar yaƙi da kuma ƙarar ƙaho.
english: but I will send a fire on Moab, and it will devour the palaces of Kerioth; and Moab will die with tumult, with shouting, and with the sound of the trumpet;

hausa: Shi ma yana da hikima kuma zai iya kawo masifa; ba ya janye kalmominsa. Zai yi gāba da gidan mugu, gāba da waɗanda suke taimakon masu aikata mugunta.
english: Yet he also is wise, and will bring disaster, and will not call back his words, but will arise against the house of the evildoers, and against the help of those who work iniquity.

hausa: Ɓangarorin sansanin Yahuda suka fara tashi, bisa ga ƙa’idar da aka yi, aka kuma umarta. Nashon ɗan Amminadab ne shugaba.
english: First, the standard of the camp of the children of Judah went forward according to their armies. Nahshon the son of Amminadab was over his army.
