hausa: “Ka yi ƙarfin hali ka kuma kasance da rashin tsoro, gama kai za ka bi da mutanen nan har su karɓi ƙasar da na yi wa kakanninsu alkawari zan ba su.
english: “Be strong and courageous; for you shall cause this people to inherit the land which I swore to their fathers to give them.

hausa: Na amince da ku gaya, ina kuma taƙama da ku ƙwarai. Na ƙarfafa sosai. Duk da wahalce wahalcenmu dai ina farin ciki ƙwarai da gaske.
english: Great is my boldness of speech toward you. Great is my boasting on your behalf. I am filled with comfort. I overflow with joy in all our affliction.

hausa: Baƙin ciki ya fi dariya, gama baƙin ciki yakan kawo gyara.
english: Sorrow is better than laughter; for by the sadness of the face the heart is made good.

hausa: Amma za ka haifi ɗa wanda zai zama mutumin salama da kuma hutu, zan kuma ba shi hutu daga dukan abokan gābansa a kowane gefe. Za a kira shi Solomon, zai kuma kawo wa Isra’ila salama da natsuwa a zamanin mulkinsa.
english: Behold, a son shall be born to you, who shall be a man of peace. I will give him rest from all his enemies all around; for his name shall be Solomon, and I will give peace and quietness to Israel in his days.

hausa: To, za mu soke dokar saboda wannan bangaskiyar ne? Ko kaɗan! A maimako, sai ma tabbatar da ita muke yi.
english: Do we then nullify the law through faith? May it never be! No, we establish the law.

hausa: Mutanen Isra’ila sun riga sun shirya da ’yan kwanton cewa su murtuke hayaƙi daga birnin,
english: Now the appointed sign between the men of Israel and the ambushers was that they should make a great cloud of smoke rise up out of the city.

hausa: Bayan sun bi ta Fisidiya, sai suka zo cikin Famfiliya,
english: They passed through Pisidia and came to Pamphylia.

hausa: Zan yabe ka, ya Ubangiji, a cikin al’ummai; zan rera game da kai a cikin mutane.
english: I will give thanks to you, Lord, among the peoples. I will sing praises to you among the nations.

hausa: Allah ya kira hasken “yini,” ya kuma kira duhun “dare.” Yamma ta kasance, safiya kuma ta kasance, kwana ta fari ke nan.
english: God called the light “day”, and the darkness he called “night”. There was evening and there was morning, the first day.

hausa: Bari waɗanda suke sa zuciya gare ka kada su sha kunya saboda ni, Ya Ubangiji, Ubangiji Maɗaukaki; bari waɗanda suke neman ka kada su sha kunya saboda ni, Ya Allah na Isra’ila.
english: Don’t let those who wait for you be shamed through me, Lord Yahweh of Armies. Don’t let those who seek you be brought to dishonor through me, God of Israel.

hausa: gama ina da ’yan’uwana biyar maza. Bari yă ba su gargaɗi, don kada su ma su zo wurin nan mai azaba.’
english: for I have five brothers—that he may testify to them, so they won’t also come into this place of torment.’

hausa: Saboda haka, in abin da nake ci zai sa ɗan’uwana yă yi zunubi, ba zan ƙara cin nama ba, don kada in sa shi yă yi tuntuɓe.
english: Therefore, if food causes my brother to stumble, I will eat no meat forever more, that I don’t cause my brother to stumble.

hausa: Game da sauran ayyukan mulkin Rehobowam kuwa, da kuma dukan abin da ya yi, duk a rubuce suke a cikin littafin tarihin sarakunan Yahuda.
english: Now the rest of the acts of Rehoboam, and all that he did, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

hausa: Ku bar Mowabawa masu gudun hijira su zauna tare da ku; ku zama mafakarsu daga mai neman hallaka su.” Mai danniya zai zo ga ƙarshe hallaka kuma za tă daina; masu lalatar da ƙasa za su kare
english: Let my outcasts dwell with you! As for Moab, be a hiding place for him from the face of the destroyer. For the extortionist is brought to nothing. Destruction ceases. The oppressors are consumed out of the land.

hausa: Ba ku ne kuka kori firistocin Ubangiji, ’ya’yan Haruna maza, da Lawiyawa kuka kuma zaɓi firistocinku kamar yadda sauran al’ummai suke yi ba? Duk wanda ya zo ya miƙa ɗan bijimi da raguna bakwai don yă tsarkake kansa, ya zama firist na gumaka ke nan, ba na Allah ba.
english: Haven’t you driven out the priests of Yahweh, the sons of Aaron, and the Levites, and made priests for yourselves according to the ways of the peoples of other lands? Whoever comes to consecrate himself with a young bull and seven rams may be a priest of those who are no gods.

hausa: Da yake an binne ku tare da shi cikin baftisma haka kuma aka tashe ku tare da shi ta wurin bangaskiyarku a cikin ikon Allah, wanda ya tashe shi daga matattu.
english: having been buried with him in baptism, in which you were also raised with him through faith in the working of God, who raised him from the dead.

hausa: Mutanen suka karantata suka kuma yi farin ciki saboda saƙonta mai ƙarfafawa.
english: When they had read it, they rejoiced over the encouragement.

hausa: Za ku ci gaba da cin girbin bara, har ku fitar da shi don ku sami wurin saboda sabo.
english: You shall eat old supplies long kept, and you shall move out the old because of the new.

hausa: Musa ya ce wa Ubangiji, “Mutanen ba za su hau Dutsen Sinai ba, gama kai da kanka ka gargaɗe mu, ‘Ku sa iyaka kewaye da dutsen ku kuma tsarkake shi.’ ”
english: Moses said to Yahweh, “The people can’t come up to Mount Sinai, for you warned us, saying, ‘Set bounds around the mountain, and sanctify it.’”

hausa: “Ku kasa kunne da kyau ga abin da zan faɗa muku. Za a bashe Ɗan Mutum ga hannun mutane.”
english: “Let these words sink into your ears, for the Son of Man will be delivered up into the hands of men.”

hausa: “Zan gyara ɓatancinsu in kuma ƙaunace su a sake, gama fushina ya juya daga gare su.
english: “I will heal their waywardness. I will love them freely; for my anger is turned away from them.

hausa: Masu hikima na Gebal suna ciki a matsayin masu tattoshe mahaɗan katakon jirginki. Dukan jiragen ruwa da matuƙansu sukan zo wurinki don kasuwanci.
english: The old men of Gebal and its wise men were your repairers of ship seams in you. All the ships of the sea with their mariners were in you to deal in your merchandise.

hausa: Ka gaskata cewa Allah ɗaya ne. To, da kyau! Ai, ko aljanu ma sun gaskata wannan, har da rawan jiki.
english: You believe that God is one. You do well. The demons also believe—and shudder.

hausa: wato, tun daga jinin Habila, har zuwa jinin Zakariya, wanda aka kashe tsakanin bagade da mazauni. I, ina gaya muku, alhakinsu duka yana kan wannan zamani.
english: from the blood of Abel to the blood of Zachariah, who perished between the altar and the sanctuary.’ Yes, I tell you, it will be required of this generation.

hausa: Ka hana kanka barci, ko gyangyaɗi a idanunka ma.
english: Give no sleep to your eyes, nor slumber to your eyelids.

hausa: Hafsoshinsa suka yi masa maƙarƙashiya suka kashe shi a Bet Millo, a kan hanyar da ta gangara zuwa Silla.
english: His servants arose and made a conspiracy, and struck Joash at the house of Millo, on the way that goes down to Silla.

hausa: Bayan kwana goma sai maganar Ubangiji ta zo wa Irmiya.
english: After ten days, Yahweh’s word came to Jeremiah.

hausa: Shawulu yana tafiya a gefe ɗaya na dutsen, Dawuda da mutanensa kuma suna a wancan gefe, suna hanzari su ɓace wa Shawulu. Sa’ad da Shawulu da sojojinsa suka kusa cimma Dawuda da mutanensa don su kama su,
english: Saul went on this side of the mountain, and David and his men on that side of the mountain; and David hurried to get away for fear of Saul, for Saul and his men surrounded David and his men to take them.

hausa: Amma ni ne suke tsokana? In ji Ubangiji Ashe, ba kansu ne suke cuta, suna kunyata kansu ba?
english: Do they provoke me to anger?” says Yahweh. “Don’t they provoke themselves, to the confusion of their own faces?”

hausa: da Ater, da Hezekiya, da Azzur,
english: Ater, Hezekiah, Azzur,

hausa: Sai na aika masa wannan amsa, na ce, “Babu wani abu haka da yake faruwa; ka dai ƙaga wannan daga tunaninka ne.”
english: Then I sent to him, saying, “There are no such things done as you say, but you imagine them out of your own heart.”

hausa: Gama alherin Allah mai kawo ceto ya bayyana ga dukan mutane.
english: For the grace of God has appeared, bringing salvation to all men,

hausa: Dawuda ya riga ya haura da akwatin alkawarin Allah daga Kiriyat Yeyarim zuwa inda ya shirya dominsa, domin yă kafa masa tenti a Urushalima.
english: But David had brought God’s ark up from Kiriath Jearim to the place that David had prepared for it; for he had pitched a tent for it at Jerusalem.

hausa: Ya auna gefen kudu da karan awon; ya samu kamu ɗari biyar.
english: He measured on the south side five hundred reeds with the measuring reed.

hausa: Ya buɗe dutse, sai ruwa ya ɓulɓulo, kamar kogi ya gudu zuwa cikin hamada.
english: He opened the rock, and waters gushed out. They ran as a river in the dry places.

hausa: “Ku wasa kibiyoyi, ku ɗauko garkuwoyi! Ubangiji ya zuga sarakunan Medes, domin niyyarsa ce yă hallaka Babilon. Ubangiji zai yi ramuwa, zai yi ramuwa saboda haikalinsa.
english: “Make the arrows sharp! Hold the shields firmly! Yahweh has stirred up the spirit of the kings of the Medes, because his purpose is against Babylon, to destroy it; for it is the vengeance of Yahweh, the vengeance of his temple.

hausa: suka kuwa yi haka a Hamadar Sinai da yamma, a rana ta sha huɗu ga watan farko. Isra’ilawa suka yi dukan abubuwa yadda Ubangiji ya umarci Musa.
english: They kept the Passover in the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month at evening, in the wilderness of Sinai. According to all that Yahweh commanded Moses, so the children of Israel did.

hausa: Ya auna wani kamu dubu, amma a yanzu ruwan ya zama kogin da ban iya hayewa ba, domin ruwan ya taso ya kuma yi zurfin da ya isa a yi iyo a ciki, kogin da ba za a iya hayewa ba.
english: Afterward he measured one thousand; and it was a river that I could not pass through, for the waters had risen, waters to swim in, a river that could not be walked through.

hausa: Bari wurinsu yă zama kufai; kada ka bar wani yă zauna a tentunansu.
english: Let their habitation be desolate. Let no one dwell in their tents.

hausa: Ya cika su da fasaha don yin kowane irin aikin sana’a, zāne-zāne, ɗinke-ɗinke shuɗi, shunayya da jan zare, da lallausan lilin, da kuma masu yin saƙa, sun gwaninta ƙwarai cikin kowane irin aikin hannu da kuma zāne-zāne.
english: He has filled them with wisdom of heart to work all kinds of workmanship, of the engraver, of the skillful workman, and of the embroiderer, in blue, in purple, in scarlet, and in fine linen, and of the weaver, even of those who do any workmanship, and of those who make skillful works.

hausa: Bayan Yesu ya gama yi wa almajiransa sha biyun nan umarni, sai ya yi gaba daga can don yă koyar yă kuma yi wa’azi a garuruwan Galili.
english: When Jesus had finished directing his twelve disciples, he departed from there to teach and preach in their cities.

hausa: Bitrus ya amsa ya ce, “Kai, ban ma san abin da kake magana a kai ba!” Yana cikin magana, sai zakara ya yi cara.
english: But Peter said, “Man, I don’t know what you are talking about!” Immediately, while he was still speaking, a rooster crowed.

hausa: Mutumin ya ce, “Ai, tun ina ƙarami, na kiyaye duka waɗannan.”
english: He said, “I have observed all these things from my youth up.”

hausa: Serug, Nahor, Tera
english: Serug, Nahor, Terah,

hausa: Suka yi dogayen sanduna huɗu na itacen ƙirya dominsa, suka dalaye su da zinariya. Suka yi ƙugiya na zinariya dominsa, suka yi rammuka huɗu da azurfa.
english: He made four pillars of acacia for it, and overlaid them with gold. Their hooks were of gold. He cast four sockets of silver for them.

hausa: Cikin fushi, maigidan ya miƙa shi ga ma’aikatan kurkuku su gwada masa azaba, har yă biya dukan bashin da ake binsa.
english: His lord was angry, and delivered him to the tormentors until he should pay all that was due to him.

hausa: Gama Adamu ne aka fara halitta, sa’an nan Hawwa’u.
english: For Adam was formed first, then Eve.

hausa: Suka zaga dukan tsibirin har sai da suka kai Bafos. A can suka sadu da wani mutumin Yahuda mai sihiri, annabin ƙarya, mai suna Bar-Yesu,
english: When they had gone through the island to Paphos, they found a certain sorcerer, a false prophet, a Jew whose name was Bar Jesus,

hausa: Abiyatar gaya wa Dawuda cewa, “Shawulu ya hallaka firistocin Ubangiji.”
english: Abiathar told David that Saul had slain Yahweh’s priests.

hausa: Bari sunansa yă dawwama har abada; bari yă ci gaba muddin rana tana nan. Dukan al’ummai za su sami albarka ta wurinsa, za su kuma ce da shi mai albarka.
english: His name endures forever. His name continues as long as the sun. Men shall be blessed by him. All nations will call him blessed.

hausa: Sai ya janye daga wurinsu, misalin nisan jifa, ya durƙusa a ƙasa ya yi addu’a,
english: He was withdrawn from them about a stone’s throw, and he knelt down and prayed,

hausa: ido don ido, haƙori don haƙori, hannu don hannu, ƙafa don ƙafa,
english: eye for eye, tooth for tooth, hand for hand, foot for foot,

hausa: Amma da masu hidima suka ba da umarnin sarki, sai Sarauniya Bashti ta ƙi zuwa. Wannan ya ɓata wa sarki rai, ya kuma yi fushi ƙwarai.
english: But the queen Vashti refused to come at the king’s commandment by the eunuchs. Therefore the king was very angry, and his anger burned in him.

hausa: waɗanda suke ƙyale masu laifi don sun ba da cin hanci, amma su hana a yi gaskiya wa marasa laifi.
english: who acquit the guilty for a bribe, but deny justice for the innocent!

hausa: Duk lokacin da za su gyara bakin garmansu da fartanyarsu sai sun biya tsabar azurfa biyu. Haka ma idan za su gyara gatari ko bakunan abin korar shanun noma sai sun biya tsabar azurfa ɗaya.
english: The price was one payim each to sharpen mattocks, plowshares, pitchforks, axes, and goads.

hausa: Yesu ya amsa, ya ce masa, “Gaskiya nake faɗa maka, yau ɗin nan, za ka kasance tare da ni, a mulkina a sama.”
english: Jesus said to him, “Assuredly I tell you, today you will be with me in Paradise.”

hausa: Yowab ya ba wa sarki jimillar yawan mayaƙan. A Isra’ila akwai mutum dubu ɗari takwas da za su iya riƙe takobi. A Yahuda kuwa mutum dubu ɗari biyar.
english: Joab gave up the sum of the counting of the people to the king; and there were in Israel eight hundred thousand valiant men who drew the sword, and the men of Judah were five hundred thousand men.

hausa: Sa’ad da Metusela ya yi shekara 187, sai ya haifi Lamek.
english: Methuselah lived one hundred eighty-seven years, then became the father of Lamech.

hausa: (To, fa, Uriya ɗan Shemahiya daga Kiriyat Yeyarim wani mutum ne wanda ya yi annabci da sunan Ubangiji; ya yi annabci irin abu ɗaya gāba da wannan birni da wannan ƙasa yadda Irmiya ya yi.
english: There was also a man who prophesied in Yahweh’s name, Uriah the son of Shemaiah of Kiriath Jearim; and he prophesied against this city and against this land according to all the words of Jeremiah.

hausa: Amma me zan ce? Ya riga ya yi mini magana, shi kansa ne kuma ya aikata. Zan yi tafiya da tawali’u dukan kwanakina saboda wahalar raina.
english: What will I say? He has both spoken to me, and himself has done it. I will walk carefully all my years because of the anguish of my soul.

hausa: Za ku iya saya waɗansu mutanen da ba sa zama ɗinɗinɗin a cikinku, da kuma membobin danginsu da aka haifa a ƙasarku.
english: Moreover, of the children of the aliens who live among you, of them you may buy, and of their families who are with you, which they have conceived in your land; and they will be your property.

hausa: ku zuba wuta a ciki, ku kuma zuba musu turaren wuta a gaban Ubangiji. Sa’an nan wanda Ubangiji ya zaɓa a tsakaninmu sh ne mai tsarki. Ku Lawiyawa ku ne kuka wuce gona da iri!”
english: put fire in them, and put incense on them before Yahweh tomorrow. It shall be that the man whom Yahweh chooses, he shall be holy. You have gone too far, you sons of Levi!”

hausa: Musa ya kuma kawo ’ya’yan Haruna gaba, ya sa jini a leɓatun kunnuwansu na dama, ya kuma sa a manyan yatsotsinsu na hannun dama da kuma a manyan yatsotsinsu na ƙafafunsu na dama. Sa’an nan ya yayyafa jinin a kowane gefen bagade.
english: He brought Aaron’s sons; and Moses put some of the blood on the tip of their right ear, and on the thumb of their right hand, and on the great toe of their right foot; and Moses sprinkled the blood around on the altar.

hausa: Uzziya ya tanada garkuwoyi, māsu, hulunan kwano, kayan sulke, baka da majajjawa don mayaƙan gaba ɗaya.
english: Uzziah prepared for them, even for all the army, shields, spears, helmets, coats of mail, bows, and stones for slinging.

hausa: Elihu ya ci gaba,
english: Elihu also continued, and said,

hausa: “Ka yi hankali, Ubangiji yana shirin ya kama ka da ƙarfi ya kuma ɗauke ka, ya kai mai ƙarfi.
english: Behold, Yahweh will overcome you and hurl you away violently. Yes, he will grasp you firmly.

hausa: Saboda haka ka kawar da kanka daga gare shi, ka rabu da shi har sai ya cika lokacinsa kamar mutumin da aka ɗauki hayarsa.
english: Look away from him, that he may rest, until he accomplishes, as a hireling, his day.

hausa: A kwanakin, sa’ad da kuka ƙaru sosai a ƙasar,” in ji Ubangiji, “mutane ba za su ƙara yin magana a kan, ‘Akwatin alkawarin Ubangiji ba.’ Ba zai ƙara shiga zuciyarsu ko su tuna ba; ko su bukace shi, ko kuwa su yi wani irinsa ba.
english: It will come to pass, when you are multiplied and increased in the land in those days,” says Yahweh, “they will no longer say, ‘the ark of Yahweh’s covenant!’ It will not come to mind. They won’t remember it. They won’t miss it, nor will another be made.

hausa: Saboda haka na sauko domin in cece su daga hannun Masarawa, in kuma fitar da su daga ƙasar Masar, in kai su ƙasa mai kyau mai fāɗi, ƙasa mai zub da madara da zuma, inda Kan’aniyawa, Hittiyawa, Amoriyawa, Ferizziyawa, Hiwiyawa da Yebusiyawa suke.
english: I have come down to deliver them out of the hand of the Egyptians, and to bring them up out of that land to a good and large land, to a land flowing with milk and honey; to the place of the Canaanite, the Hittite, the Amorite, the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite.

hausa: Da na yi haka da na sa kaina a halin ƙaƙa-ni-ka-yi, kuma babu abin da zai ɓoyu ga sarki, kai kuwa za ka janye abinka daga gare ni.”
english: Otherwise, if I had dealt falsely against his life (and there is no matter hidden from the king), then you yourself would have set yourself against me.”

hausa: Saboda haka Yaƙub ya kira wurin Feniyel, yana cewa, “Domin na ga Allah fuska da fuska, duk da haka aka bar ni da rai.”
english: Jacob called the name of the place Peniel; for he said, “I have seen God face to face, and my life is preserved.”

hausa: Sarkin Babilon ya ji rahotanni game da su, hannunsa kuma ya yi laƙwas. Wahala ta kama shi, zafi kamar na mace mai naƙuda.
english: The king of Babylon has heard the news of them, and his hands become feeble. Anguish has taken hold of him, pains as of a woman in labor.

hausa: A shekarar da Ewil-Merodak ya zama Sarkin Babilon, sai ya nuna wa Yehohiyacin Sarkin Yahuda alheri. Ya fisshe shi daga kurkuku. Wannan ya faru ran ashirin da biyar ga watan goma sha biyu a shekara ta talatin da bakwai bayan da aka kai Yehohiyacin bauta.
english: In the thirty-seventh year of the captivity of Jehoiachin king of Judah, in the twelfth month, in the twenty-fifth day of the month, Evilmerodach king of Babylon, in the first year of his reign, lifted up the head of Jehoiachin king of Judah, and released him from prison.

hausa: Amma Ishmayel ɗan Netaniya da mutanensa takwas suka tsere daga Yohanan suka gudu zuwa wurin Ammonawa.
english: But Ishmael the son of Nethaniah escaped from Johanan with eight men, and went to the children of Ammon.

hausa: A cikinki mutum guda yakan yi laifi abin ƙyama da matar maƙwabcinsa, wani cikin rashin kunya ya ƙazantar da matar ɗansa, wani kuma ya kwana da ’yar’uwansa, ’yar mahaifinsa.
english: One has committed abomination with his neighbor’s wife, and another has lewdly defiled his daughter-in-law. Another in you has humbled his sister, his father’s daughter.

hausa: Bari teku su yi ruri, da kuma kome da yake cikinsa, duniya da kuma kome da yake cikinta.
english: Let the sea roar with its fullness; the world, and those who dwell therein.

hausa: Ya aika manzanni ko’ina a Manasse, yana kiransu su kintsa, haka ma Asher, Zebulun da Naftali, ta haka su ma suka haura su sadu da su.
english: He sent messengers throughout all Manasseh, and they also were gathered together to follow him. He sent messengers to Asher, to Zebulun, and to Naphtali; and they came up to meet them.

hausa: Babban tsoro ya kama dukan ikkilisiya da kuma duk wanda ya ji game da abubuwan nan.
english: Great fear came on the whole assembly, and on all who heard these things.

hausa: Sa’an nan ku, mutanena, za ku san cewa ni ne Ubangiji, sa’ad da na buɗe kaburburanku na fitar da ku daga cikinsu.
english: You will know that I am Yahweh, when I have opened your graves and caused you to come up out of your graves, my people.

hausa: kamar rafin da yakan cika a lokacin ƙanƙara, yă kuma kumbura kamar ƙanƙarar da ta narke,
english: which are black by reason of the ice, in which the snow hides itself.

hausa: Ba wanda ya taɓa ganin Uban, sai shi wanda ya zo daga Allah; shi ne kaɗai ya taɓa ganin Uban.
english: Not that anyone has seen the Father, except he who is from God. He has seen the Father.

hausa: Wane ne ya isa yă hana shi in ya ƙwace abu? Wa zai ce masa, ‘Me kake yi?’
english: Behold, he snatches away. Who can hinder him? Who will ask him, ‘What are you doing?’

hausa: aka karkashe firistocinsu, gwaurayensu kuwa ba su iya makoki ba.
english: Their priests fell by the sword, and their widows couldn’t weep.

hausa: Ba sa damu da wani abu ko mai kyau ko marar kyau. Rayukansu sun cika da kowace irin ƙazanta da haɗama.
english: They, having become callous, gave themselves up to lust, to work all uncleanness with greediness.

hausa: Sai Iliya ya ce musu, “Ni ne kaɗai annabin Ubangiji da ya rage, amma Ba’al yana da annabawa ɗari huɗu da hamsin.
english: Then Elijah said to the people, “I, even I only, am left as a prophet of Yahweh; but Baal’s prophets are four hundred fifty men.

hausa: Sa’an nan ya tafi ƙofar da take fuskantar gabas. Ya hau matakanta ya auna madogarar ƙofa; zurfinta kamu shida ne.
english: Then he came to the gate which looks toward the east, and went up its steps. He measured the threshold of the gate, one reed wide; and the other threshold, one reed wide.

hausa: “Kaitonku, malaman dokoki da Farisiyawa, munafukai! Kukan gina kaburbura don annabawa, ku kuma yi wa kaburburan mutane masu adalci ado.
english: “Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you build the tombs of the prophets and decorate the tombs of the righteous,

hausa: Mai la’akari kan kiyaye saninsa wa kansa, amma zuciyar wawa kan yi ta tallar wawanci.
english: A prudent man keeps his knowledge, but the hearts of fools proclaim foolishness.

hausa: ’Ya’yan Ulam maza jarumawa ne sosai waɗanda suke iya riƙe baka. Suna da ’ya’ya maza masu yawa da jikoki, 150 gaba ɗaya. Dukan waɗannan zuriyar Benyamin ne.
english: The sons of Ulam were mighty men of valor, archers, and had many sons, and grandsons, one hundred fifty. All these were of the sons of Benjamin.

hausa: Da ƙarfin dutse aka yi ni ne? Ko jikina tagulla ne?
english: Is my strength the strength of stones? Or is my flesh of bronze?

hausa: ka kiyaye abin da Ubangiji Allahnka yake bukata. Yi tafiya a hanyoyinsa, ka kiyaye ƙa’idodi, da umarnai, da dokoki, da kuma farillansa, kamar yadda suke a rubuce a Dokar Musa, don ka yi nasara a cikin kome da za ka yi, da kuma inda za ka tafi.
english: and keep the instruction of Yahweh your God, to walk in his ways, to keep his statutes, his commandments, his ordinances, and his testimonies, according to that which is written in the law of Moses, that you may prosper in all that you do and wherever you turn yourself.

hausa: Duk wanda ba ya horon ɗansa ba ƙaunarsa yake yi ba, amma duk mai ƙaunarsa yakan kula ya hore shi.
english: One who spares the rod hates his son, but one who loves him is careful to discipline him.

hausa: Sau uku a shekara Solomon kan miƙa hadayun ƙonawa da hadayun salama a kan bagaden da ya gina wa Ubangiji, yana ƙone turare a gaban Ubangiji haɗe da su, ta haka ya cika abin da ake bukata na haikali.
english: Solomon offered burnt offerings and peace offerings on the altar which he built to Yahweh three times per year, burning incense with them on the altar that was before Yahweh. So he finished the house.

hausa: Leɓunan wawa kan jawo masa faɗa, bakinsa kuma kan gayyaci dūka.
english: A fool’s lips come into strife, and his mouth invites beatings.

hausa: Saboda haka muka dafa ɗana muka ci. Kashegari na ce mata, ‘Kawo ɗanki mu ci,’ amma ta ɓoye shi.”
english: So we boiled my son and ate him; and I said to her on the next day, ‘Give up your son, that we may eat him;’ and she has hidden her son.”

hausa: Amma ina kuka gare ka neman taimako, ya Ubangiji; da safe addu’ata kan zo gabanka.
english: But to you, Yahweh, I have cried. In the morning, my prayer comes before you.

hausa: Yahudawa suka amsa masa suka ce, “Aha, ai, gaskiyarmu da muka ce kai mutumin Samariya ne, kana kuma da aljani.”
english: Then the Jews answered him, “Don’t we say well that you are a Samaritan, and have a demon?”

hausa: Wani mutum mai kuturta ya zo ya durƙusa a gabansa ya ce, “Ubangiji, in kana so, kana iya tsabtacce ni.”
english: Behold, a leper came to him and worshiped him, saying, “Lord, if you want to, you can make me clean.”

hausa: Ya kuma ga wata gwauruwa matalauciya, ta saka anini biyu.
english: He saw a certain poor widow casting in two small brass coins.

hausa: Ko da yake mutane suna ruri kamar sukuwar raƙuman ruwa, sa’ad da ya tsawata musu za su gudu can da nisa, aka kore su kamar yayinda iska ya hura a kan tuddai, kamar tattake kuma a cikin guguwa.
english: The nations will rush like the rushing of many waters, but he will rebuke them, and they will flee far off, and will be chased like the chaff of the mountains before the wind, and like the whirling dust before the storm.

hausa: Sa’ad da Ubangiji Allahnku ya ba da shi cikin hannunku, sai ku kashe dukan mazan da suke cikinsa da takobi.
english: When Yahweh your God delivers it into your hand, you shall strike every male of it with the edge of the sword;

hausa: An manta da ni sai ka ce na mutu; na zama kamar fasasshen kasko.
english: I am forgotten from their hearts like a dead man. I am like broken pottery.

hausa: Kashegari, Musa ya sadu da Isra’ilawa biyu suna faɗa. Ya yi ƙoƙari ya sasanta su, yana cewa, ‘Ku mutane, ku ’yan’uwa ne, don me kuke so ku cutar da juna?’
english: “The day following, he appeared to them as they fought, and urged them to be at peace again, saying, ‘Sirs, you are brothers. Why do you wrong one another?’

hausa: Refa, Reshef, Tela, Tahan,
english: Rephah was his son, Resheph his son, Telah his son, Tahan his son,

hausa: duk da haka, ban sami salama a zuciyata ba domin ban sami ɗan’uwana Titus a can ba. Sai na yi bankwana da su na wuce zuwa Makidoniya.
english: I had no relief for my spirit, because I didn’t find Titus my brother, but taking my leave of them, I went out into Macedonia.

hausa: Amma Nadab da Abihu suka fāɗi suka mutu a gaban Ubangiji a Hamadar Sinai a sa’ad da suka ƙona turare da haramtacciyar wuta a gabansa. Ba su kuwa da ’ya’ya; saboda haka Eleyazar da Itamar kaɗai suka yi aiki firist a zamanin mahaifinsu Haruna.
english: Nadab and Abihu died before Yahweh when they offered strange fire before Yahweh in the wilderness of Sinai, and they had no children. Eleazar and Ithamar ministered in the priest’s office in the presence of Aaron their father.

hausa: Amma Ubangiji ya tanada wani babban kifi da zai haɗiye Yunana, Yunana kuwa ya yi yini uku da dare uku a ciki cikin kifin.
english: Yahweh prepared a huge fish to swallow up Jonah, and Jonah was in the belly of the fish three days and three nights.

hausa: “Siman, Siman, Shaiɗan ya nemi izini ya sheƙe kakamar alkama.
english: The Lord said, “Simon, Simon, behold, Satan asked to have all of you, that he might sift you as wheat,

hausa: Heshbon da kuma Yazer, tare da wuraren kiwonsu, garuruwa huɗu ke nan.
english: Heshbon with its pasture lands, Jazer with its pasture lands: four cities in all.

hausa: Raina zai yi fariya a cikin Ubangiji; bari waɗanda suke wahala su ji su kuma yi farin ciki.
english: My soul shall boast in Yahweh. The humble shall hear of it and be glad.

hausa: Suna kwanciya su haifi ’ya’yansu; naƙudarsu ta ƙare bayan sun haihu.
english: They bow themselves. They bear their young. They end their labor pains.

hausa: Ya amsa ya ce “I, yana biya.” Da Bitrus ya shiga gida, Yesu ne ya fara magana. Ya ce masa, “Me ka gani, Siman? Daga wurin wane ne sarakunan duniya suke karɓar kuɗin shiga da kuma haraji, daga wurin ’ya’yansu ne ko kuwa daga wurin waɗansu?”
english: He said, “Yes.” When he came into the house, Jesus anticipated him, saying, “What do you think, Simon? From whom do the kings of the earth receive toll or tribute? From their children, or from strangers?”

hausa: Sai ya amsa ya ce, “Ka kama hanyarka, Daniyel, domin a rufe kalmomin aka kuma liƙe su har sai ƙarshen lokaci.
english: He said, “Go your way, Daniel; for the words are shut up and sealed until the time of the end.

hausa: Za a kunyatar da Diyar Masar, da aka bashe ga mutanen arewa.”
english: The daughter of Egypt will be disappointed; she will be delivered into the hand of the people of the north.”

hausa: A ganinmu, masu girman kai suna jin daɗi. Masu aikata mugunta kuwa ba arziki kaɗai suka yi ba, amma sukan gwada Allah da mugayen ayyukansu, su kuwa zauna lafiya.’ ”
english: Now we call the proud happy; yes, those who work wickedness are built up; yes, they tempt God, and escape.’

hausa: Saboda haka Filistiyawa suka yi yaƙi, Isra’ilawa kuwa suka sha ɗibga, kowane mutum kuwa ya gudu zuwa tentinsa. Kisan kuwa ya yi muni ƙwarai. Isra’ilawa sun rasa mayaƙa dubu talatin.
english: The Philistines fought, and Israel was defeated, and each man fled to his tent. There was a very great slaughter; for thirty thousand footmen of Israel fell.

hausa: Abubuwan nan marasa rai ma da sukan yi ƙara, kamar su algaita ko molo, in muryarsu ba tă fita sosai ba, yaya wani zai san abin da ake busawa ko kaɗawa?
english: Even lifeless things that make a sound, whether pipe or harp, if they didn’t give a distinction in the sounds, how would it be known what is piped or harped?

hausa: Yediyayel ɗan Shimri, ɗan’uwansa Yoha mutumin Tiz,
english: Jediael the son of Shimri, and Joha his brother, the Tizite,

hausa: Bayan ya yi ’yan kwanaki a Antiyok, Bulus ya tashi daga can ya zaga ko’ina a yankin Galatiya da Firjiya, yana ƙarfafa dukan almajirai.
english: Having spent some time there, he departed and went through the region of Galatia and Phrygia, in order, establishing all the disciples.

hausa: Matan aure, ku yi biyayya ga mazanku, kamar ga Ubangiji ne kuke yi.
english: Wives, be subject to your own husbands, as to the Lord.

hausa: Sai Ubangiji ya juya wajensa ya ce, “Ka je da ƙarfin da kake da shi ka ceci Isra’ila daga hannun Midiyawa. Ba Ni ne nake aikan ka ba?”
english: Yahweh looked at him, and said, “Go in this your might, and save Israel from the hand of Midian. Haven’t I sent you?”

hausa: Sai Ubangiji ya ji daɗi cewa Solomon ya roƙa wannan.
english: This request pleased the Lord, that Solomon had asked this thing.

hausa: Sa’ad da suka ga hayaƙin ƙunarta, za su yi ihu su ce, ‘An taɓa samun birni kamar wannan babban birnin kuwa?’
english: and cried out as they looked at the smoke of her burning, saying, ‘What is like the great city?’

hausa: Ba haka kaɗai ba ma, mu kanmu da muke da nunan fari na Ruhu, muna nishi a ciki-cikinmu yayinda muke jira da marmari a maishe mu ’ya’yan riƙo na Allah, fansar jikunanmu.
english: Not only so, but ourselves also, who have the first fruits of the Spirit, even we ourselves groan within ourselves, waiting for adoption, the redemption of our body.

hausa: Kwana shida, za a yi aiki, amma a rana ta bakwai, Asabbaci ne na hutu, mai tsarki ga Ubangiji. Duk wanda ya yi wani aiki a Asabbaci, za a kashe shi.
english: Six days shall work be done, but on the seventh day is a Sabbath of solemn rest, holy to Yahweh. Whoever does any work on the Sabbath day shall surely be put to death.

hausa: Benyamin, Malluk da Shemariya.
english: Benjamin, Malluch, and Shemariah.

hausa: Ku zama makiyayan garken Allah da yake a ƙarƙashin kulawarku, kuna hidima kamar masu kula, ba kan dole ba, sai dai da yardar rai, yadda Allah yake so ku zama; ban da kwaɗayin kuɗi, sai dai marmarin yin hidima;
english: shepherd the flock of God which is among you, exercising the oversight, not under compulsion, but voluntarily; not for dishonest gain, but willingly;

hausa: sai ya sa wa acibalbal wuta, ya saki yanyawan suka shiga gonakin Filistiyawa. Suka ƙone dammunan hatsi da hatsin da yake tsaye, tare da gonakin inabi da na zaitun.
english: When he had set the torches on fire, he let them go into the standing grain of the Philistines, and burned up both the shocks and the standing grain, and also the olive groves.

hausa: Na ga cewa dukan waɗanda suka rayu suka kuma yi tafiya a duniya sun bi saurayin, magājin sarkin.
english: I saw all the living who walk under the sun, that they were with the youth, the other, who succeeded him.

hausa: Sarki Nebukadnezzar ya yi gunkin zinariya, tsawonsa kamu tasa’in, fāɗinsa kuma kamu tara ne, ya kafa shi a filin Dura a yankin Babilon.
english: Nebuchadnezzar the king made an image of gold, whose height was sixty cubits and its width six cubits. He set it up in the plain of Dura, in the province of Babylon.

hausa: Ƙaunataccena nawa ne ni kuma tasa ce; yana kiwon garkensa a cikin furannin bi-rana.
english: My beloved is mine, and I am his. He browses among the lilies.

hausa: Zai iya cin abinci mafi tsarki na Allahnsa, haka ma abinci mai tsarki;
english: He shall eat the bread of his God, both of the most holy, and of the holy.

hausa: Sai Ubangiji ya ce mini, “Abin da suka faɗa yana da kyau.
english: Yahweh said to me, “They have well said that which they have spoken.

hausa: Sa’ad da suka ji maganar tashin matattu, waɗansunsu suka yi tsaki, amma waɗansu suka ce, “Muna so mu ƙara jin ka a kan wannan batu.”
english: Now when they heard of the resurrection of the dead, some mocked; but others said, “We want to hear you again concerning this.”

hausa: Sa’ad da aka shirya kome don Bikin Ƙetarewar, sai Firistoci tare da Lawiyawa suka tsaya wurin tsayawarsu bisa ga umarnin sarki.
english: So the service was prepared, and the priests stood in their place, and the Levites by their divisions, according to the king’s commandment.

hausa: Sai Bitrus ya gayyaci mutanen cikin gida su zama baƙinsa. Kashegari Bitrus ya tafi tare da su, waɗansu ’yan’uwa daga Yoffa kuwa suka tafi tare da shi.
english: So he called them in and provided a place to stay. On the next day Peter arose and went out with them, and some of the brothers from Joppa accompanied him.

hausa: Dole ku kasance da ma’aunin da kuma mudun da yake daidai, kuma na gaskiya, saboda ku yi tsawon rai a ƙasar da Ubangiji Allahnku yake ba ku.
english: You shall have a perfect and just weight. You shall have a perfect and just measure, that your days may be long in the land which Yahweh your God gives you.

hausa: Yana tasowa kamar fure yana kuma shuɗewa; kamar inuwa, ba ya daɗewa.
english: He grows up like a flower, and is cut down. He also flees like a shadow, and doesn’t continue.

hausa: Tun ma kafin a ƙona kitse, bawan firist yakan zo yă ce wa mutumin da yake miƙa hadaya, “Ka ba wa firist nama domin yă gasa, ba zai karɓi dafaffen nama daga wurinka ba, sai ɗanye.”
english: Yes, before they burned the fat, the priest’s servant came, and said to the man who sacrificed, “Give meat to roast for the priest; for he will not accept boiled meat from you, but raw.”

hausa: Daga iyalin Zattu, akwai Eliyohenai, Eliyashib, Mattaniya Yeremot da Zabad da Aziza.
english: Of the sons of Zattu: Elioenai, Eliashib, Mattaniah, Jeremoth, Zabad, and Aziza.

hausa: Maigidan bawan ya ji tausayinsa, ya yafe masa bashin, ya kuma sake shi.
english: The lord of that servant, being moved with compassion, released him and forgave him the debt.

hausa: “Ka yi allo na zinariya zalla, ka kuma yi rubutu a kansa kamar na hatimi, haka, Mai tsarki ga Ubangiji.
english: “You shall make a plate of pure gold, and engrave on it, like the engravings of a signet, ‘HOLY TO YAHWEH.’

hausa: Wannan magana tabbatacciya ce wadda ta cancanci cikakkiyar karɓa.
english: This saying is faithful and worthy of all acceptance.

hausa: Ta’aziyyar Allah ba tă ishe ka ba. Maganarsa mai laushi ba tă ishe ka ba?
english: Are the consolations of God too small for you, even the word that is gentle toward you?

hausa: Sai aka ji ƙarar fikafikan kerubobin har a filin waje, kamar muryar Allah Maɗaukaki sa’ad da ya yi magana.
english: The sound of the wings of the cherubim was heard even to the outer court, as the voice of God Almighty when he speaks.

hausa: Daga hasumiya zuwa birni mai katanga, ya ci Filistiyawa da yaƙi, har zuwa Gaza da kewaye.
english: He struck the Philistines to Gaza and its borders, from the tower of the watchmen to the fortified city.

hausa: Sai Ahab ya ce wa Nabot, “Ka ba ni gonar inabinka in yi amfani da ita don kayan lambu, da yake tana kusa da fadana. Zan ba ka wata gonar inabin da ta fi wannan, ko kuma in ka gwammace, sai in biya ka duk abin da ya dace da ita.”
english: Ahab spoke to Naboth, saying, “Give me your vineyard, that I may have it for a garden of herbs, because it is near my house; and I will give you for it a better vineyard than it. Or, if it seems good to you, I will give you its worth in money.”

hausa: Sai suka tashi suka koma Zif, suka sha gaban Shawulu. Dawuda da mutanensa kuwa suna jejin Mawon cikin Araba, kudu da Yeshimon.
english: They arose, and went to Ziph before Saul; but David and his men were in the wilderness of Maon, in the Arabah on the south of the desert.

hausa: Ku yi hankali kada ku manta da alkawarin da Ubangiji Allahnku ya yi da ku; kada fa ku yi wa kanku gunki a kamannin wani abin da Ubangiji Allahnku ya hana.
english: Be careful, lest you forget the covenant of Yahweh your God, which he made with you, and make yourselves a carved image in the form of anything which Yahweh your God has forbidden you.

hausa: “Saboda haka hanyarsu za tă yi santsi; za a jefar da su cikin duhu a can kuwa za su fāɗi. Zan kawo musu masifa a shekarar da za a hukunta su,” in ji Ubangiji.
english: Therefore their way will be to them as slippery places in the darkness. They will be driven on, and fall therein; for I will bring evil on them, even the year of their visitation,” says Yahweh.

hausa: Ya amsa musu ya ce, “Ku ɗauke ni ku jefa a cikin teku, tekun zai kwanta. Na san cewa laifina ne ya jawo wannan babban hadirin da ya auka muku.”
english: He said to them, “Take me up, and throw me into the sea. Then the sea will be calm for you; for I know that because of me this great storm is on you.”

hausa: Abokan gābana sun ja da baya; suka yi tuntuɓe suka hallaka a gabanka.
english: When my enemies turn back, they stumble and perish in your presence.

hausa: Kada ku bar ƙofar Tentin Sujada har kwana bakwai, sai ranakun naɗi suka cika, gama naɗinku zai ɗauki kwana bakwai.
english: You shall not go out from the door of the Tent of Meeting for seven days, until the days of your consecration are fulfilled: for he shall consecrate you seven days.

hausa: Bayan Abimelek ya yi shekara uku yana mulki a Isra’ila,
english: Abimelech was prince over Israel three years.

hausa: Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka ya buɗe kunnuwana, kuma ban yi tayarwa ba; ban ja da baya ba.
english: The Lord Yahweh has opened my ear. I was not rebellious. I have not turned back.

hausa: Ka dasa su, sun kuwa yi saiwa; sun yi girma suna ba da ’ya’ya. Kullum sunanka yana a bakinsu amma kana nesa da zuciyarsu.
english: You have planted them. Yes, they have taken root. They grow. Yes, they produce fruit. You are near in their mouth, and far from their heart.

hausa: “Ga abin da Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka yana cewa har yanzu zan ji roƙon gidan Isra’ila in kuma yi musu wannan. Zan sa mutanensu su yi yawa kamar tumaki,
english: “‘The Lord Yahweh says: “For this, moreover, I will be inquired of by the house of Israel, to do it for them: I will increase them with men like a flock.

hausa: Sai mamacin ya tashi zaune, ya fara magana. Yesu kuma ya ba da shi ga mahaifiyarsa.
english: He who was dead sat up and began to speak. Then he gave him to his mother.

hausa: “Game da wannan rana ko sa’a kuwa, ba wanda ya sani, ko mala’ikun da suke sama, ko Ɗan, sai Uban kaɗai.
english: “But of that day or that hour no one knows—not even the angels in heaven, nor the Son, but only the Father.

hausa: “Ai, abu mai sauƙi ne inuwa tă yi gaba da taki goma.” In ji Hezekiya, “Gwamma dai tă koma baya da taki goma.”
english: Hezekiah answered, “It is a light thing for the shadow to go forward ten steps. No, but let the shadow return backward ten steps.”

hausa: Suna cikin kunce ɗan jakin, sai masu ɗan jakin suka ce musu, “Don me kuke kunce shi?”
english: As they were untying the colt, its owners said to them, “Why are you untying the colt?”

hausa: da Ba’alat, da Tadmor a hamada, na cikin ƙasarsa.
english: Baalath, Tamar in the wilderness,

hausa: Sai ku ce, ‘Na bawanka Yaƙub ne. Kyauta ce wa maigidana Isuwa, yana kuma tafe a bayanmu.’ ”
english: Then you shall say, ‘They are your servant, Jacob’s. It is a present sent to my lord, Esau. Behold, he also is behind us.’”

hausa: Sa’an nan Isuwa ya ɗaga ido ya ga mata da ’ya’ya. Ya yi tambaya, “Su wane ne waɗannan tare da kai?” Yaƙub ya amsa, “Su ne ’ya’yan da Allah cikin alheri ya ba bawanka.”
english: He lifted up his eyes, and saw the women and the children; and said, “Who are these with you?” He said, “The children whom God has graciously given your servant.”

hausa: Tana magana da hikima, kuma umarnai mai aminci yana a harshenta.
english: She opens her mouth with wisdom. Kind instruction is on her tongue.

hausa: Manyan namun jeji ba su taɓa binta ba, ba zakin da ya taɓa binta.
english: The proud animals have not trodden it, nor has the fierce lion passed by there.

hausa: Ya ce, “Ku je ku tsaya a filin haikali ku sanar wa mutane cikakken saƙon wannan sabon rai.”
english: “Go stand and speak in the temple to the people all the words of this life.”

hausa: Suka amsa, “Bawanka mahaifinmu yana da rai har yanzu da kuma ƙoshin lafiya.” Suka kuma rusuna suka yi mubaya’a.
english: They said, “Your servant, our father, is well. He is still alive.” They bowed down humbly.

hausa: Haka ku ma, bayan kun yi duk abin da aka ce muku ku yi, ya kamata ku ce, ‘Mu bayi ne marasa cancanta, mun dai yi aikinmu ne kaɗai.’ ”
english: Even so you also, when you have done all the things that are commanded you, say, ‘We are unworthy servants. We have done our duty.’”

hausa: Rayuwar ƙauye a Isra’ila ta daina, ta daina sai da ni, Debora, na taso, na taso mahaifiya a Isra’ila.
english: The rulers ceased in Israel. They ceased until I, Deborah, arose; Until I arose a mother in Israel.

hausa: “Yahudawa duk sun san yadda na yi rayuwa tun ina yaro, daga farkon rayuwata a ƙasarmu da kuma a Urushalima.
english: “Indeed, all the Jews know my way of life from my youth up, which was from the beginning among my own nation and at Jerusalem;

hausa: Bayan na kauce, sai na tuba; bayan na gane, sai na sunkuyar da kaina. Na ji kunya da ƙasƙanci domin ina ɗauke da kunyar ƙuruciyata.’
english: Surely after that I was turned. I repented. After that I was instructed. I struck my thigh. I was ashamed, yes, even confounded, because I bore the reproach of my youth.’

hausa: Amma in ba haka ba, sai ka saurare ni; yi shiru, zan kuma koya maka hikima.”
english: If not, listen to me. Hold your peace, and I will teach you wisdom.”

hausa: Yana kama da mutumin da ya gina gida, wanda ya haƙa ƙasa da zurfi, sa’an nan ya kafa tushen ginin a kan dutse. Da ambaliyar ruwa ta taso, ƙarfin ruwa kuwa ya buga gidan, wannan bai jijjiga shi ba, domin an yi masa tushen gini na ainihi.
english: He is like a man building a house, who dug and went deep and laid a foundation on the rock. When a flood arose, the stream broke against that house, and could not shake it, because it was founded on the rock.

hausa: Filistiyawa suka ce, “Wace irin hadaya don laifi za mu aika masa?” Suka ce, “Marurai biyar na zinariya da ɓeraye biyar na zinariya bisa ga yawan sarakunan Filistiyawa. Saboda annoba iri ɗaya ce ta buga ku da shugabanninku.
english: Then they said, “What should the trespass offering be which we shall return to him?” They said, “Five golden tumors and five golden mice, for the number of the lords of the Philistines; for one plague was on you all, and on your lords.

hausa: Yesu ya amsa ya ce, “Ku koma ku gaya wa Yohanna abin da kuka ji, kuka kuma gani.
english: Jesus answered them, “Go and tell John the things which you hear and see:

hausa: “ ‘Kada ka nemi yin ramuwa, ko ka riƙe wani cikin mutanenka a zuciya, amma ka ƙaunaci maƙwabcinka kamar kanka. Ni ne Ubangiji.
english: “‘You shall not take vengeance, nor bear any grudge against the children of your people; but you shall love your neighbor as yourself. I am Yahweh.

hausa: Keken shanun ya zo filin Yoshuwa a Bet-Shemesh ya tsaya a gefen wani babban dutse. Mutanen suka faskare keken shanun suka miƙa shanun hadaya ta ƙonawa ga Ubangiji.
english: The cart came into the field of Joshua of Beth Shemesh, and stood there, where there was a great stone. Then they split the wood of the cart and offered up the cows for a burnt offering to Yahweh.

hausa: Da taro suka ji haka, sai suka yi mamakin koyarwarsa.
english: When the multitudes heard it, they were astonished at his teaching.

hausa: Hezekiya kuma ya raba firistoci da Lawiyawa kashi-kashi, kowanne da hidimarsa, firistoci da Lawiyawa, don hadayu na ƙonawa da na salama, su yi hidima, su yi godiya, su kuma rera yabai a ƙofofin mazaunin Ubangiji.
english: Hezekiah appointed the divisions of the priests and the Levites after their divisions, every man according to his service, both the priests and the Levites, for burnt offerings and for peace offerings, to minister, to give thanks, and to praise in the gates of Yahweh’s camp.

hausa: Gama a gare ka akwai maɓulɓular rai cikin haskenka mukan ga haske.
english: For with you is the spring of life. In your light we will see light.

hausa: Hayaƙin azabarsu kuwa zai dinga tashi har abada abadin. Kuma babu hutu dare ko rana wa waɗanda suke wa dabbar da siffarta sujada, ko kuwa ga duk wanda ya sami alamar sunanta.”
english: The smoke of their torment goes up forever and ever. They have no rest day and night, those who worship the beast and his image, and whoever receives the mark of his name.

hausa: Za a ɗauke shi a kai Assuriya kamar gandu wa babban sarki. Efraim zai sha kunya; Isra’ila zai sha kunya saboda gumakan itacensa.
english: It also will be carried to Assyria for a present to a great king. Ephraim will receive shame, and Israel will be ashamed of his own counsel.

hausa: ’Yan tawaye sun yi zurfi cikin kisan gilla. Zan hore su duka.
english: The rebels are deep in slaughter, but I discipline all of them.

hausa: Wata zai yi haske kamar rana, kuma hasken rana zai ma yi sau bakwai na haskenta, kamar hasken cikakku ranaku bakwai, sa’ad da Ubangiji zai ɗaura raunukan mutanensa ya kuma warkar da raunukan da ya yi musu.
english: Moreover the light of the moon will be like the light of the sun, and the light of the sun will be seven times brighter, like the light of seven days, in the day that Yahweh binds up the fracture of his people, and heals the wound they were struck with.

hausa: Ko ma yayinda mutanen nan suke yi wa Ubangiji sujada, ba su daina bauta wa gumakansu ba. Har yă zuwa yau, ’ya’yansu da jikokinsu sun ci gaba da bin gurbin kakanninsu.
english: So these nations feared Yahweh, and also served their engraved images. Their children did likewise, and so did their children’s children. They do as their fathers did to this day.

hausa: Maskil na Etan dangin Ezra. Zan rera game da ƙauna mai girma ta Ubangiji har abada; da bakina zan sanar da amincinka a dukan zamanai.
english: A contemplation by Ethan, the Ezrahite. I will sing of the loving kindness of Yahweh forever. With my mouth, I will make known your faithfulness to all generations.

hausa: Ba ruwanmu da ɓoye-ɓoye na munafuncin da suke abubuwan kunya. Ba ruwanmu da ruɗu, ko yin ƙarya da kalmar Allah. Sai dai muna faɗin gaskiya a fili. Ta haka ne kowa zai yi shaidar gaskiyarmu a gaban Allah cikin zuciyarsa.
english: But we have renounced the hidden things of shame, not walking in craftiness nor handling the word of God deceitfully, but by the manifestation of the truth commending ourselves to every man’s conscience in the sight of God.

hausa: Daga hadaya ta zumuncin zai kawo, sai a miƙa waɗannan hadayu na ƙonawa ga Ubangiji a wuta, wato, kitsen, ƙibabbiya wutsiyar gaba ɗaya da ya yanka gab da ƙashin gadon baya, dukan kitsen da ya rufe kayan ciki, ko kuwa da suka shafe su,
english: He shall offer from the sacrifice of peace offerings an offering made by fire to Yahweh; its fat, the entire tail fat, he shall take away close to the backbone; and the fat that covers the entrails, and all the fat that is on the entrails,

hausa: Sarki Solomon kuwa da taron Isra’ila gaba ɗaya da suka taru kewaye da shi suna a gaban akwatin alkawarin, suna miƙa tumaki da shanu masu yawa da suka wuce ƙirge ko lissafi.
english: King Solomon and all the congregation of Israel who were assembled to him were before the ark, sacrificing sheep and cattle that could not be counted or numbered for multitude.

hausa: Saboda haka, ina gaya muku cewa ba wani mai magana da ikon Ruhun Allah da zai ce, “Yesu la’ananne ne,” haka kuma ba wanda zai ce, “Yesu Ubangiji ne,” sai wanda Ruhu Mai Tsarki yake bi da shi.
english: Therefore I make known to you that no man speaking by God’s Spirit says, “Jesus is accursed.” No one can say, “Jesus is Lord,” but by the Holy Spirit.

hausa: Kun ga abubuwa masu yawa, amma ba ku kula ba; kunnuwanku suna a buɗe, amma ba kwa jin wani abu.”
english: You see many things, but don’t observe. His ears are open, but he doesn’t listen.

hausa: Kwanonin zinariya da na azurfan gidan Allah waɗanda Nebukadnezzar ya kwashe daga haikali a Urushalima ya kawo Babilon, a mayar da su wurinsu a haikali a Urushalima; a sa su cikin gidan Allah.
english: Also let the gold and silver vessels of God’s house, which Nebuchadnezzar took out of the temple which is at Jerusalem and brought to Babylon, be restored and brought again to the temple which is at Jerusalem, everything to its place. You shall put them in God’s house.

hausa: da Negeb da dukan yankin Kwarin Yeriko, Birnin Dabino, har zuwa Zowar.
english: and the south, and the Plain of the valley of Jericho the city of palm trees, to Zoar.

hausa: Ka tuna da shi, kafin igiyar azurfa ta katse, ko tasar zinariya ta fashe; kafin tulu yă ragargaje a maɓulɓula, ko guga ta tsinke a rijiya,
english: before the silver cord is severed, or the golden bowl is broken, or the pitcher is broken at the spring, or the wheel broken at the cistern,

hausa: Ya tuna cewa su naman jiki ne kawai, iska mai wucewa da ba ta dawowa.
english: He remembered that they were but flesh, a wind that passes away, and doesn’t come again.

hausa: An yage shi daga zaman lafiyar da yake yi a cikin tentinsa aka sa shi tsoro sosai.
english: He will be rooted out of the security of his tent. He will be brought to the king of terrors.

hausa: Waɗannan su ne ƙa’idodi domin mutumin da yake da cutar fatar jiki wanda kuma ba zai iya samun abubuwan hadaya ta kullum domin tsabtaccewarsa ba.
english: This is the law for him in whom is the plague of leprosy, who is not able to afford the sacrifice for his cleansing.

hausa: Zan girgiza dukan al’ummai, marmarin kowace al’umma kuma zai taso, sa’an nan zan cika gidan nan da ɗaukaka,’ in ji Ubangiji Maɗaukaki.
english: and I will shake all nations. The treasure of all nations will come, and I will fill this house with glory, says Yahweh of Armies.

hausa: Bayan Ayuba ya yi wa abokansa addu’a, Ubangiji ya sa shi ya sāke zama mai arziki ya ninka abin da yake da shi a dā sau biyu.
english: Yahweh restored Job’s prosperity when he prayed for his friends. Yahweh gave Job twice as much as he had before.

hausa: Ƙahoni huɗu da suka maya wannan da ya karye yana a madadin masarautu huɗu da za su tashi daga cikin al’ummarsa amma ba za su sami irin ikonsa ba.
english: As for that which was broken, in the place where four stood up, four kingdoms will stand up out of the nation, but not with his power.

hausa: Sa’an nan Ruhu ya kai Yesu cikin hamada don Iblis yă gwada shi.
english: Then Jesus was led up by the Spirit into the wilderness to be tempted by the devil.

hausa: Gama da ƙarfi ne aka ɗauke ni daga ƙasar Ibraniyawa, ko a nan ma ban yi wani abin da ya cancanci a sa ni cikin kurkuku ba.’ ”
english: For indeed, I was stolen away out of the land of the Hebrews, and here also I have done nothing that they should put me into the dungeon.”

hausa: Abokaina, ko da yake muna irin maganan nan, mun tabbata kuna yi abubuwan nan masu kyau da waɗanda suka sami ceto suke yi.
english: But, beloved, we are persuaded of better things for you, and things that accompany salvation, even though we speak like this.

hausa: Da sarki Yehohiyakim da dukan fadawansa da ma’aikatansa suka ji wannan magana, sai sarki ya nemi a kashe shi. Amma Uriya ya ji wannan shiri sai ya gudu zuwa Masar don tsoro.
english: When Jehoiakim the king, with all his mighty men and all the princes heard his words, the king sought to put him to death; but when Uriah heard it, he was afraid, and fled, and went into Egypt.

hausa: Hadayar garin da aka bayar tare da ragon efa guda ne, hadayar garin da ’yan ragunan yadda ya ga dama, tare da kwalabar mai don kowace efa.
english: and the meal offering shall be an ephah for the ram, and the meal offering for the lambs as he is able to give, and a hin of oil to an ephah.

hausa: Domin kun tunkuɗe marasa ƙarfi da kafaɗunku, kun kuma tunkuye su da ƙahoninku sai da suka gudu,
english: Because you thrust with side and with shoulder, and push all the diseased with your horns, until you have scattered them abroad,

hausa: a rubuta su da ƙarfe a kan dutse don su dawwama har abada!
english: That with an iron pen and lead they were engraved in the rock forever!

hausa: Ya ce wa dattawan, “Ku jira mu a nan, sai mun dawo wurinku. Haruna da Hur suna tare da ku, in wani yana da wata damuwa, sai yă je wurinsu.”
english: He said to the elders, “Wait here for us, until we come again to you. Behold, Aaron and Hur are with you. Whoever is involved in a dispute can go to them.”

hausa: Sheba da Dedan da ’yan kasuwar Tarshish da dukan ƙauyukanta za su ce maka, “Ka zo ka kwashe ganima ne? Ka tattara jama’arka don ka yi waso, ka kuma kwashe azurfa da zinariya, ka kwashe shanu da kayayyaki ka kuma ƙwace ganima mai yawa?” ’
english: Sheba, Dedan, and the merchants of Tarshish, with all its young lions, will ask you, ‘Have you come to take the plunder? Have you assembled your company to take the prey, to carry away silver and gold, to take away livestock and goods, to take great plunder?’”’

hausa: Amma ba za su taɓa bin baƙo ba; sai dai ma su guje masa don ba su san muryar baƙo ba.”
english: They will by no means follow a stranger, but will flee from him; for they don’t know the voice of strangers.”

hausa: Sai na ce muku, “Kada ku firgita; kada ku ji tsoronsu.
english: Then I said to you, “Don’t be terrified. Don’t be afraid of them.

hausa: Ubangiji zai bashe su gare ku, dole kuma ku yi musu dukan abin da na umarce ku.
english: Yahweh will deliver them up before you, and you shall do to them according to all the commandment which I have commanded you.

hausa: Na ga ya zo kusa da ragon, ya husata da shi ƙwarai, ya kai wa ragon hari. Ya kakkarya ƙahoninsa nan biyu. Ƙarfin ragon ya kāsa, bai iya kāre kansa daga bunsurun ba. Bunsurun ya buge shi ƙasa ya tattake shi. Ba wanda ya iya ceton ragon daga bunsurun.
english: I saw him come close to the ram, and he was moved with anger against him, and struck the ram, and broke his two horns. There was no power in the ram to stand before him; but he cast him down to the ground and trampled on him. There was no one who could deliver the ram out of his hand.

hausa: Suna ƙwace gidajen gwauraye, kuma don nuna iyawa, sukan yi dogayen addu’o’i. Irin mutanen nan, za su sha hukunci mai tsanani sosai.”
english: those who devour widows’ houses, and for a pretense make long prayers. These will receive greater condemnation.”

hausa: Almajiran suka je suka tashe shi, suna cewa, “Ubangiji, ka cece mu! Za mu nutse!”
english: The disciples came to him and woke him up, saying, “Save us, Lord! We are dying!”

hausa: Shin, zai gode wa bawan don yă yi aikin da aka ce ya yi ne?
english: Does he thank that servant because he did the things that were commanded? I think not.

hausa: Wane ne a cikinku ta wurin damuwa zai iya ƙara wa rayuwarsa ko sa’a ɗaya?
english: “Which of you by being anxious, can add one moment to his lifespan?

hausa: Waɗannan garuruwa shida da aka bayar za su zama biranen mafakarku.
english: The cities which you shall give shall be for you six cities of refuge.

hausa: Asirin taurari bakwai da ka gani a hannuna na dama da kuma na alkukan fitilu bakwai na zinariya shi ne, Taurarin bakwai ɗin nan, mala’ikun ikkilisiyoyi bakwai ne; alkukan fitilu bakwai ɗin nan kuma ikkilisiyoyi bakwai ne.
english: The mystery of the seven stars which you saw in my right hand, and the seven golden lamp stands is this: The seven stars are the angels of the seven assemblies. The seven lamp stands are seven assemblies.

hausa: Za a iya ƙirga rundunarsa? A kan wane ne ba ya haska haskensa?
english: Can his armies be counted? On whom does his light not arise?

hausa: Da ita ce sarakunan duniya suka yi zina mazaunan duniya kuma suka bugu da ruwan inabin zinace zinacenta.”
english: with whom the kings of the earth committed sexual immorality. Those who dwell on the earth were made drunken with the wine of her sexual immorality.”

hausa: ta Elam 1,254
english: The children of Elam, one thousand two hundred fifty-four.

hausa: Sai masu gadin suka ce, “Kai, babu wanda ya taɓa magana kamar wannan mutum.”
english: The officers answered, “No man ever spoke like this man!”

hausa: Da gari ya waye, sai Yehu ya fita ya tsaya a gaban dukan jama’a ya ce, “Ba ku da laifi. Ni ne na ƙulla wa maigidana maƙarƙashiya, na kuma kashe shi, amma wa ya karkashe dukan waɗannan?
english: In the morning, he went out and stood, and said to all the people, “You are righteous. Behold, I conspired against my master and killed him, but who killed all these?

hausa: Ba ga dukan ƙasar tana gabanka ba? Bari mu rabu. In ka yi hagu sai ni in yi dama. In ka yi dama, sai ni in yi hagu.”
english: Isn’t the whole land before you? Please separate yourself from me. If you go to the left hand, then I will go to the right. Or if you go to the right hand, then I will go to the left.”

hausa: ’Ya’yan Fedahiya su ne, Zerubbabel da Shimeyi. ’Ya’yan Zerubbabel maza su ne, Meshullam da Hananiya. Shelomit ce ’yar’uwarsu.
english: The sons of Pedaiah: Zerubbabel and Shimei. The sons of Zerubbabel: Meshullam and Hananiah; and Shelomith was their sister;

hausa: Sai sarkin Assuriya ya aiki sarkin yaƙinsa tare da mayaƙa masu yawa daga Lakish zuwa wurin Sarki Hezekiya a Urushalima. Sa’ad da sarkin yaƙi ya tsaya a wuriyar Tafkin Tudu, a hanya zuwa Filin Mai Wanki,
english: The king of Assyria sent Rabshakeh from Lachish to Jerusalem to King Hezekiah with a large army. He stood by the aqueduct from the upper pool in the fuller’s field highway.

hausa: Sai suka rena ƙasa mai ni’ima; ba su gaskata alkawarinsa ba.
english: Yes, they despised the pleasant land. They didn’t believe his word,

hausa: Duk wanda yake ƙaunar ɗan’uwansa, a cikin hasken yake rayuwa ke nan, kuma babu wani abin da yake cikinsa da zai sa yă yi tuntuɓe.
english: He who loves his brother remains in the light, and there is no occasion for stumbling in him.

hausa: Aka yi yunwa a ƙasar; ban da yunwar da aka yi da fari a zamanin Ibrahim, sai Ishaku ya tafi wurin Abimelek sarkin Filistiyawa a Gerar.
english: There was a famine in the land, in addition to the first famine that was in the days of Abraham. Isaac went to Abimelech king of the Philistines, to Gerar.

hausa: Gama zan zama kamar zaki ga Efraim, kamar babban zaki ga Yahuda. Zan yage su kucu-kucu in tafi; zan kwashe su, ba wanda zai kuɓutar da su.
english: For I will be to Ephraim like a lion, and like a young lion to the house of Judah. I myself will tear in pieces and go away. I will carry off, and there will be no one to deliver.

hausa: Amma shugabanni suka amsa musu suka ce, “Mun rantse musu da sunan Ubangiji, Allah na Isra’ila, saboda haka ba za mu taɓa su ba yanzu.
english: But all the princes said to all the congregation, “We have sworn to them by Yahweh, the God of Israel. Now therefore we may not touch them.

hausa: Za a ƙwace tentunansu da garkunansu; za a tafi da mafakanta tare da dukan kayayyakinsu da raƙumansu. Mutane za su yi musu ihu, ‘Razana ko’ina!’
english: They will take their tents and their flocks. they will carry away for themselves their curtains, all their vessels, and their camels; and they will cry to them, ‘Terror on every side!’

hausa: Ko da na wanke jikina duka da sabulu, na wanke hannuwana kuma da soda,
english: If I wash myself with snow, and cleanse my hands with lye,

hausa: Sauran kuma aka kashe su da takobin da ya fito daga bakin wannan wanda yake kan dokin. Dukan tsuntsaye kuwa suka ci namansu iyakar iyawarsu.
english: The rest were killed with the sword of him who sat on the horse, the sword which came out of his mouth. So all the birds were filled with their flesh.

hausa: Ashe, ba ku sani ba cewa ku kanku haikalin Allah ne, Ruhun Allah kuma yana zaune a cikinku?
english: Don’t you know that you are God’s temple and that God’s Spirit lives in you?

hausa: duk da haka kana ba ni tsoro da mafarke-mafarke, kana tsorata ni da wahayi.
english: then you scare me with dreams and terrify me through visions,

hausa: Sa’ad da ya ware Isra’ila daga gidan Dawuda, sai suka naɗa Yerobowam ɗan Nebat sarki a kansu. Yerobowam ya rinjayi Isra’ila daga ƙin Ubangiji, ya sa suka aikata babban zunubi.
english: For he tore Israel from David’s house; and they made Jeroboam the son of Nebat king; and Jeroboam drove Israel from following Yahweh, and made them sin a great sin.

hausa: Ku kiyaye ƙa’idodi da umarnai, waɗanda nake ba ku a yau, domin zaman lafiyarku da kuma na zuriyarku bayan ba ku, domin kuma ku yi tsawon rai a ƙasa wadda Ubangiji Allahnku yake ba ku har abada.
english: You shall keep his statutes and his commandments which I command you today, that it may go well with you and with your children after you, and that you may prolong your days in the land which Yahweh your God gives you for all time.

hausa: A rana ta ƙarshe kuma mafi girma ta Bikin, Yesu ya tsaya ya yi magana da babbar murya ya ce, “Duk mai jin ƙishirwa, yă zo wurina yă sha.
english: Now on the last and greatest day of the feast, Jesus stood and cried out, “If anyone is thirsty, let him come to me and drink!

hausa: “Bayan ka gama haka, ka sāke kwantawa, a wannan lokaci a gefen damarka, ka kuma ɗauki zunubin gidan Yahuda. Na ɗora maka kwanaki 40, kwana guda a madadin shekara guda.
english: “Again, when you have accomplished these, you shall lie on your right side, and shall bear the iniquity of the house of Judah. I have appointed forty days, each day for a year, to you.

hausa: Sai Shawulu ya tattara sojoji, ya ƙidaya su a Telayim, ya sami su dubu ɗari biyu da dubu goma daga Yahuda.
english: Saul summoned the people, and counted them in Telaim, two hundred thousand footmen and ten thousand men of Judah.

hausa: Musa ya ce wa Fir’auna, “Na ba ka dama ka ba da lokacin da zan yi addu’a dominka da kuma bayinka da mutanenka, gidajenku kuwa za su rabu da kwaɗi, amma ban da waɗanda suke cikin Nilu.”
english: Moses said to Pharaoh, “I give you the honor of setting the time that I should pray for you, and for your servants, and for your people, that the frogs be destroyed from you and your houses, and remain in the river only.”

hausa: ya zāna iyakar fuskar ruwa a kan iyakar da take tsakanin duhu da haske.
english: He has described a boundary on the surface of the waters, and to the confines of light and darkness.

hausa: To, Ehud ya riga ya ƙera takobi mai kaifi biyu mai tsawo wajen kamu ɗaya da rabi, wanda ya yi ɗamara da shi a cinyarsa ta dama ƙarƙashin rigarsa.
english: Ehud made himself a sword which had two edges, a cubit in length; and he wore it under his clothing on his right thigh.

hausa: Sun ce muku, “A kwanakin ƙarshe za a kasance da masu ba’a waɗanda za su bi sha’awace-sha’awacensu na rashin tsoron Allah.”
english: They said to you, “In the last time there will be mockers, walking after their own ungodly lusts.”

hausa: Amma Musa ya ce, “Ina roƙonka kada ka rabu da mu. Ka san inda ya kamata mu kafa sansani a hamada, za ka kuma zama idanunmu.
english: Moses said, “Don’t leave us, please; because you know how we are to encamp in the wilderness, and you can be our eyes.

hausa: Ka ce masa ga abin da Ubangiji Maɗaukaki ya ce, ‘Ga mutumin da sunansa ne Reshe, zai kuma ratse daga inda yake yă gina haikalin Ubangiji.
english: and speak to him, saying, ‘Yahweh of Armies says, “Behold, the man whose name is the Branch! He will grow up out of his place; and he will build Yahweh’s temple.

hausa: “Amma ni ne Ubangiji Allahnku, wanda ya fitar da ku daga Masar. Ba za ku yarda da wani Allah ba sai ni, ba wani Mai Ceto in ban da ni.
english: “Yet I am Yahweh your God from the land of Egypt; and you shall acknowledge no god but me, and besides me there is no savior.

hausa: A zamanin Yehoram, Edom ya tayar wa Yahuda ya kuma naɗa sarkinsa.
english: In his days Edom revolted from under the hand of Judah, and made a king over themselves.

hausa: don yanka da shirya duwatsu, yin aikin katako, da kuma yin kowane irin aikin sana’ar hannu.
english: and in cutting of stones for setting, and in carving of wood, to work in all kinds of workmanship.

hausa: Tikikus shi ne ƙaunataccen ɗan’uwan nan, wanda ya yi aiki da aminci a hidimar Ubangiji tare da mu, zai kuwa faɗa muku dukan labari game da ni.
english: All my affairs will be made known to you by Tychicus, the beloved brother, faithful servant, and fellow bondservant in the Lord.

hausa: Za ka kuma tafi da zinariya da azurfa waɗanda sarki da mashawartansa suka ba da kyautar yardar rai ga Allah na Isra’ila, wanda haikalinsa ke a Urushalima,
english: and to carry the silver and gold, which the king and his counselors have freely offered to the God of Israel, whose habitation is in Jerusalem,

hausa: Ba abin da ya fi sa ni farin ciki fiye da in ji cewa ’ya’yana suna cikin gaskiyan nan.
english: I have no greater joy than this: to hear about my children walking in truth.

hausa: da Malluk, da Harim da kuma Ba’ana.
english: Malluch, Harim, and Baanah.

hausa: “Su ma za su amsa, su ce, ‘Ubangiji, yaushe muka gan ka cikin yunwa ko ƙishirwa ko baƙo ko cikin bukatar tufafi ko cikin rashin lafiya ko cikin kurkuku, ba mu taimake ka ba?’
english: “Then they will also answer, saying, ‘Lord, when did we see you hungry, or thirsty, or a stranger, or naked, or sick, or in prison, and didn’t help you?’

hausa: Sai Farisiyawa suka yi waje, suka ƙulla yadda za su yi masa tarko cikin maganarsa.
english: Then the Pharisees went and took counsel how they might entrap him in his talk.

hausa: Kamar ruwan sanyi ga ran da ya gaji haka yake da jin labari mai daɗi daga ƙasa mai nisa.
english: Like cold water to a thirsty soul, so is good news from a far country.

hausa: Saboda haka ba su iya gaskatawa ba, domin, kamar yadda Ishaya ya faɗa a wani wuri cewa,
english: For this cause they couldn’t believe, for Isaiah said again:

hausa: A ranan nan, kada wanda yake kan rufin gidansa ya sauka don yă kwashe dukiyarsa da take cikin gidan. Haka ma duk wanda yake gona, kada yă koma don wani abu.
english: In that day, he who will be on the housetop and his goods in the house, let him not go down to take them away. Let him who is in the field likewise not turn back.

hausa: A cikin wulaƙacinsa aka hana masa gaskiya. Wa zai iya yin zancen zuriyarsa? Gama an ɗauke ransa daga duniya.”
english: In his humiliation, his judgment was taken away. Who will declare His generation? For his life is taken from the earth.”

hausa: Duk da haka a cikin Ubangiji, mace ba a rabe take da namiji ba, namiji kuma ba a rabe yake da mace ba.
english: Nevertheless, neither is the woman independent of the man, nor the man independent of the woman, in the Lord.

hausa: Ubangiji yana ƙyamar mutane masu muguwar zuciya amma yana jin daɗin waɗanda hanyoyinsu ba su da laifi.
english: Those who are perverse in heart are an abomination to Yahweh, but those whose ways are blameless are his delight.

hausa: Amma mutumin kirki kan yi shirye-shirye masu kirki, kuma yakan tsaya a kan ayyukan kirki.
english: But the noble devises noble things, and he will continue in noble things.

hausa: A lokacin ne za su ga Ɗan Mutum yana zuwa cikin girgije, da iko, da ɗaukaka mai girma.
english: Then they will see the Son of Man coming in a cloud with power and great glory.

hausa: Ubangiji ya ce wa Musa,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

hausa: ya ƙone turare mai ƙanshi a kai, yadda Ubangiji ya umarce shi.
english: and he burned incense of sweet spices on it, as Yahweh commanded Moses.

hausa: Ka kawo Lawiyawa a gaban Tentin Sujada, ka kuma kira taron Isra’ilawa duka.
english: You shall present the Levites before the Tent of Meeting. You shall assemble the whole congregation of the children of Israel.

hausa: Sa’an nan Allah ya sa wa Nuhu da ’ya’yansa maza albarka, yana ce musu, “Ku haifi ’ya’ya, ku ƙaru, ku kuma cika duniya.
english: God blessed Noah and his sons, and said to them, “Be fruitful, multiply, and replenish the earth.

hausa: Yosiya ya tanada wa dukan mutanen da ba firistoci ba ne waɗanda suke a wurin, tumaki da awaki dubu talatin don a yanka saboda hadayun Bikin Ƙetarewa, ya kuma ba su shanu dubu uku. Dukan dabbobin kuwa daga garken sarki ne.
english: Josiah gave to the children of the people, of the flock, lambs and young goats, all of them for the Passover offerings, to all who were present, to the number of thirty thousand, and three thousand bulls. These were of the king’s substance.

hausa: Musa, Haruna da kuma dukan taron Isra’ilawa, suka yi da Lawiyawa yadda Ubangiji ya umarci Musa.
english: Moses, and Aaron, and all the congregation of the children of Israel did so to the Levites. According to all that Yahweh commanded Moses concerning the Levites, so the children of Israel did to them.

hausa: Ya fitar da Isra’ila, ɗauke da azurfa da zinariya, kuma daga cikin kabilansu babu wani da ya kāsa.
english: He brought them out with silver and gold. There was not one feeble person among his tribes.

hausa: Yahudawa suna so su ga alama, Hellenawa kuma suna neman hikima,
english: For Jews ask for signs, Greeks seek after wisdom,

hausa: Zai cire su daidai kamar yadda akan cire na bijimin hadaya ta salama. Sai firist ɗin yă ƙone su a kan bagaden ƙona hadaya.
english: as it is removed from the bull of the sacrifice of peace offerings. The priest shall burn them on the altar of burnt offering.

hausa: kada ku saurari kalmomin wannan annabi ko mai mafarki. Ubangiji Allahnku yana gwada ku ne don yă sani ko kuna ƙaunarsa da dukan zuciyarku da kuma dukan ranku.
english: you shall not listen to the words of that prophet, or to that dreamer of dreams; for Yahweh your God is testing you, to know whether you love Yahweh your God with all your heart and with all your soul.

hausa: Sa’an nan Irmiya ya komo daga Tofet, inda Ubangiji ya aike shi don yă yi annabci, ya tsaya a filin haikalin Ubangiji ya ce wa mutane duka,
english: Then Jeremiah came from Topheth, where Yahweh had sent him to prophesy, and he stood in the court of Yahweh’s house, and said to all the people:

hausa: Saboda haka, waɗanda suke shan wahala bisa ga nufin Allah ya kamata su danƙa kansu ga Mahaliccinsu mai aminci, su kuma ci gaba da aikata abin da yake daidai.
english: Therefore let them also who suffer according to the will of God in doing good entrust their souls to him, as to a faithful Creator.

hausa: Sa’an nan Ubangiji Allahnku zai mayar da ku masu arziki ƙwarai a cikin dukan aiki hannuwanku, da kuma cikin ’ya’yanku, da ’ya’yan shanunku, da kuma hatsin gonarku. Ubangiji zai sāke jin daɗinku yă sa ku yi arziki, kamar dai yadda ya ji daɗin kakanninku.
english: Yahweh your God will make you prosperous in all the work of your hand, in the fruit of your body, in the fruit of your livestock, and in the fruit of your ground, for good; for Yahweh will again rejoice over you for good, as he rejoiced over your fathers,

hausa: Dukan azurfa da zinariya, da kwanonin tagulla da na ƙarfe, keɓaɓɓu ne ga Ubangiji, dole a sa su cikin ma’ajin Ubangiji.”
english: But all the silver, gold, and vessels of bronze and iron are holy to Yahweh. They shall come into Yahweh’s treasury.”

hausa: Ƙwallafa rai ga al’amuran halin mutuntaka ƙarshensa mutuwa ne, ƙwallafa rai ga al’amuran Ruhu kuwa rai ne da salama;
english: For the mind of the flesh is death, but the mind of the Spirit is life and peace;

hausa: “Ubangiji zai ƙi ne har abada? Ba zai taɓa nuna alherinsa kuma ba?
english: “Will the Lord reject us forever? Will he be favorable no more?

hausa: Ikkilisiyoyin da suke a lardin Asiya suna gaisuwa. Akwila da Firiskila suna gaishe ku sosai cikin Ubangiji, haka ma ikkilisiyar da takan taru a gidansu.
english: The assemblies of Asia greet you. Aquila and Priscilla greet you warmly in the Lord, together with the assembly that is in their house.

hausa: Gara ka saurari tsawatawar mai hikima da ka saurari waƙar wawaye.
english: It is better to hear the rebuke of the wise than for a man to hear the song of fools.

hausa: Amma Musa ya ce, “Ya Ubangiji, ina roƙonka, ka nemi wani ka aika.”
english: Moses said, “Oh, Lord, please send someone else.”

hausa: “Sa’ad da Fir’auna ya ce muku, ‘Aikata wani al’ajabi,’ sai ka ce wa Haruna, ‘Ɗauki sandanka ka jefa shi a ƙasa, a gaban Fir’auna,’ zai kuwa zama maciji.”
english: “When Pharaoh speaks to you, saying, ‘Perform a miracle!’ then you shall tell Aaron, ‘Take your rod, and cast it down before Pharaoh, and it will become a serpent.’”

hausa: Sai murya daga sama ta ce, “Wannan shi ne Ɗana wanda nake ƙauna; wanda kuma nake jin daɗinsa ƙwarai.”
english: Behold, a voice out of the heavens said, “This is my beloved Son, with whom I am well pleased.”

hausa: Daga kabilan Yahuda da Simeyon ne aka ba su waɗannan garuruwan da aka ambata,
english: They gave out of the tribe of the children of Judah, and out of the tribe of the children of Simeon, these cities which are mentioned by name:

hausa: In tabon a fata jikinsa fari ne amma bai zama ya fi zurfin fatar jikin ba, gashin a cikinsa kuma bai juya ya zama fari ba, firist ɗin zai kaɗaice mai cutar na kwana bakwai.
english: If the bright spot is white in the skin of his body, and its appearance isn’t deeper than the skin, and its hair hasn’t turned white, then the priest shall isolate the infected person for seven days.

hausa: Gama an umarce ni ta wurin kalmar Ubangiji, aka ce, ‘Kada ka ci abinci, ko ka sha ruwa, ko ka koma ta hanyar da ka zo.’ ”
english: for so was it commanded me by Yahweh’s word, saying, ‘You shall eat no bread, drink no water, and don’t return by the way that you came.’”

hausa: In dai kuka canja hanyoyinku da ayyukanku kuma kuna aikata adalci da junanku,
english: For if you thoroughly amend your ways and your doings, if you thoroughly execute justice between a man and his neighbor;

hausa: Sa’an nan Yefta ya tara mutanen Gileyad wuri guda ya kuma yaƙi Efraim. Mutanen Gileyad suka fatattake su domin mutanen Efraim sun ce, “Ku Mutanen Gileyad masu neman mafaka ne cikin Efraim da Manasse.”
english: Then Jephthah gathered together all the men of Gilead, and fought with Ephraim. The men of Gilead struck Ephraim, because they said, “You are fugitives of Ephraim, you Gileadites, in the middle of Ephraim, and in the middle of Manasseh.”

hausa: kuka ga cewa Birnin Dawuda tana da wuraren kāriya masu yawa da suka tsattsage; kuka tattara ruwa a Tafkin Ƙasa.
english: You saw the breaches of David’s city, that they were many; and you gathered together the waters of the lower pool.

hausa: Yoshuwa kuwa ya dawo da dukan Isra’ilawa zuwa sansani a Gilgal.
english: Joshua returned, and all Israel with him, to the camp to Gilgal.

hausa: A ranar da suka miƙa ’ya’yansu ga gumakansu, sai suka shiga wuri mai tsarkina suka kuma ƙazantar da shi. Abin da suka yi a gidana ke nan.
english: For when they had slain their children to their idols, then they came the same day into my sanctuary to profane it; and behold, they have done this in the middle of my house.

hausa: Sama’ila dai bai riga ya san Ubangiji ba tukuna. Ba a kuma taɓa bayyana maganar Ubangiji a gare shi ba tukuna ba.
english: Now Samuel didn’t yet know Yahweh, neither was Yahweh’s word yet revealed to him.

hausa: Kada ka amsa wa wawa bisa ga wautarsa, in ba haka ba kai kanka za ka zama kamar sa.
english: Don’t answer a fool according to his folly, lest you also be like him.

hausa: sai ka ɗauki basilla ka huda kunnensa a bakin ƙofa, zai kuwa zama bawanka dukan rayuwarsa. Ka yi haka ma wa baiwarka.
english: then you shall take an awl, and thrust it through his ear to the door, and he shall be your servant forever. Also to your female servant you shall do likewise.

hausa: Duk itacen da ba ya ba da ’ya’ya masu kyau sai a sare shi a jefa cikin wuta.
english: Every tree that doesn’t grow good fruit is cut down and thrown into the fire.

hausa: Na yi tunani a zuciyata na kuwa koyi darasi daga abin da na gani.
english: Then I saw, and considered well. I saw, and received instruction:

hausa: Hezron ya haifi Ram, Ram ya haifi Amminadab,
english: and Hezron became the father of Ram, and Ram became the father of Amminadab,

hausa: Za a miƙa hadaya ta ƙonawa da bijimai biyu, rago ɗaya, da ’yan raguna bakwai, bana ɗaya-ɗaya; dukansu kuma marasa lahani ga Ubangiji.
english: but you shall offer an offering made by fire, a burnt offering to Yahweh: two young bulls, one ram, and seven male lambs a year old. They shall be without defect,

hausa: Kamar wanda ya tuɓe riga a ranar da ake sanyi, ko kuwa kamar zuba ruwan tsami a kanwa, haka yake da mai rera waƙoƙi ga mai baƙin ciki.
english: As one who takes away a garment in cold weather, or vinegar on soda, so is one who sings songs to a heavy heart.

hausa: Kashegari, ’yar farin ta ce wa ƙanuwar, “Jiya da dare na kwana da mahaifina. Bari mu sa yă sha ruwan inabi kuma yau da dare, ke ma ki shiga ki kwana da shi, domin kada zuriyar mahaifinmu ta ƙare.”
english: It came to pass on the next day, that the firstborn said to the younger, “Behold, I lay last night with my father. Let’s make him drink wine again tonight. You go in, and lie with him, that we may preserve our father’s family line.”

hausa: In naman jeji ne ya kashe ta, zai nuna gawar don shaida, ba za a kuwa sa maƙwabcin yă biya abin da naman jeji ya kashe ba.
english: If it is torn in pieces, let him bring it for evidence. He shall not make good that which was torn.

hausa: Ga wani, mu warin mutuwa ne, amma ga wani kuwa, mu ƙanshin rai ne. Wa ya isa yă yi irin wannan aikin?
english: to the one a stench from death to death, to the other a sweet aroma from life to life. Who is sufficient for these things?
