hausa: A cikin hamada suka bar sha’awarsu ta mamaye su a ƙasar da babu kome suka gwada Allah.
english: but gave in to craving in the desert, and tested God in the wasteland.

hausa: Suka samu a cikin mutanen da suke zaune a Yabesh Gileyad mata ɗari huɗu da ba su taɓa kwana da namiji ba, suka kwashe su zuwa sansani a Shilo a Kan’ana.
english: They found among the inhabitants of Jabesh Gilead four hundred young virgins who had not known man by lying with him; and they brought them to the camp to Shiloh, which is in the land of Canaan.

hausa: Dukan mutane kuwa suka haura suka bi shi, suna busan sarewa, suna farin ciki sosai, har ƙasa ta girgiza saboda sowa.
english: All the people came up after him, and the people piped with pipes, and rejoiced with great joy, so that the earth shook with their sound.

hausa: “Sa’ad da Ɗan Mutum ya zo cikin ɗaukakarsa, tare da dukan mala’iku, zai zauna a kursiyinsa cikin ɗaukakar sama.
english: “But when the Son of Man comes in his glory, and all the holy angels with him, then he will sit on the throne of his glory.

hausa: Bayan shekara goma sha huɗu sai na sāke haurawa zuwa Urushalima, a wannan lokaci na tafi tare da Barnabas. Na kuma ɗauki Titus muka tafi tare.
english: Then after a period of fourteen years I went up again to Jerusalem with Barnabas, taking Titus also with me.

hausa: Amma ya amsa ya ce, “Ubangiji, ina a shirye in tafi tare da kai har kurkuku, ko mutuwa ma.”
english: He said to him, “Lord, I am ready to go with you both to prison and to death!”

hausa: Ubangiji yakan taimake su yă kuma cece su; yakan kuɓutar da su daga mugaye yă kuma cece su, domin sukan nemi mafaka daga gare shi.
english: Yahweh helps them and rescues them. He rescues them from the wicked and saves them, because they have taken refuge in him.

hausa: Sai aka sami takarda a Ekbatana a yankin Mediya, ga kuma abin da yake rubuce a ciki. Abin tunawa.
english: A scroll was found at Achmetha, in the palace that is in the province of Media, and in it this was written for a record:

hausa: Sai suka ɗauke shi suka kawo shi wurin taron Areyofagus, inda suka ce masa, “Ko za mu san mene ne sabon koyarwan nan ya ƙunsa da kake yi?
english: They took hold of him and brought him to the Areopagus, saying, “May we know what this new teaching is, which you are speaking about?

hausa: Domin duk mai son ceton ransa zai rasa shi, amma duk wanda ya rasa ransa saboda ni, da kuma bishara, zai same shi.
english: For whoever wants to save his life will lose it; and whoever will lose his life for my sake and the sake of the Good News will save it.

hausa: Ya ji tsoro, ya kuma ce, “Wane irin wuri ne mai banrazana haka! Lalle wannan gidan Allah ne, kuma nan ne ƙofar sama.”
english: He was afraid, and said, “How awesome this place is! This is none other than God’s house, and this is the gate of heaven.”

hausa: ya ce musu, “Ga abin da Ubangiji, Allah na Isra’ila ya ce, ‘Na fito da Isra’ila daga Masar, na kuma cece ku daga hannun Masarawa da dukan mulkokin da suka wahalshe ku.’
english: and he said to the children of Israel, “Yahweh, the God of Israel, says ‘I brought Israel up out of Egypt and I delivered you out of the hand of the Egyptians, and out of the hand of all the kingdoms that oppressed you.’

hausa: Nan da nan Yesu ya miƙa hannu ya kamo shi ya ce, “Kai mai ƙarancin bangaskiya, don me ka yi shakka?”
english: Immediately Jesus stretched out his hand, took hold of him, and said to him, “You of little faith, why did you doubt?”

hausa: Hanyoyinka, ya Allah, masu tsarki ne. Wanda allah ne yake da girma kamar Allahnmu?
english: Your way, God, is in the sanctuary. What god is great like God?

hausa: Magādan Yehohiyakim su ne, Yekoniya ɗansa, da Zedekiya.
english: The sons of Jehoiakim: Jeconiah his son, and Zedekiah his son.

hausa: Ko da yake kina firiya kamar gaggafa kin kuma yi sheƙarki a can cikin taurari, daga can zan saukar da ke,” in ji Ubangiji.
english: Though you mount on high as the eagle, and though your nest is set among the stars, I will bring you down from there,” says Yahweh.

hausa: Don mai bi da kaɗe-kaɗe. Ta ’ya’yan Kora maza. Maskil ne. Mun ji da kunnuwanmu, ya Allah; kakanninmu sun faɗa mana abin da ka aikata a kwanakinsu, tun dā can.
english: For the Chief Musician. By the sons of Korah. A contemplative psalm. We have heard with our ears, God; our fathers have told us what work you did in their days, in the days of old.

hausa: “ ‘Kada ka kwana da namiji kamar yadda namiji yakan kwana da ta mace, wannan abin ƙyama ne.
english: “‘You shall not lie with a man as with a woman. That is detestable.

hausa: Yana da babbar katanga mai tsayi, mai ƙofofi goma sha biyu, da kuma mala’iku goma sha biyu a ƙofofin. A bisa ƙofofin an rubuta sunayen kabilu goma sha biyu na Isra’ila.
english: having a great and high wall with twelve gates, and at the gates twelve angels, and names written on them, which are the names of the twelve tribes of the children of Israel.

hausa: “A wannan rana,” in ji Ubangiji, “Za a ji kuka daga Ƙofar Kifi, kururuwa daga Sabon Mazauni, da kuma amo mai ƙarfi daga tuddai.
english: In that day, says Yahweh, there will be the noise of a cry from the fish gate, a wailing from the second quarter, and a great crashing from the hills.

hausa: Na kuma ba da su ga farillan da ba su da kyau da dokokin da ba za su rayu ta wurinsu ba;
english: Moreover also I gave them statutes that were not good, and ordinances in which they couldn’t live.

hausa: Ka tattake teku da dawakanka, kana kaɗa manyan ruwaye.
english: You trampled the sea with your horses, churning mighty waters.

hausa: In ɗan’uwanka, ko ɗanka, ko ’yarka, ko matar da kake ƙauna, ko abokinka na kusa, a ɓoye ya ruɗe ka, yana cewa, “Mu je mu yi wa waɗansu alloli sujada” (allolin da ko kai, ko kakanninka ba su sani ba,
english: If your brother, the son of your mother, or your son, or your daughter, or the wife of your bosom, or your friend who is as your own soul, entices you secretly, saying, “Let’s go and serve other gods”—which you have not known, you, nor your fathers;

hausa: Sau uku na roƙi Ubangiji yă raba ni da wannan abu.
english: Concerning this thing, I begged the Lord three times that it might depart from me.

hausa: Sa’ad da aka kai wa Mordekai rahoton maganan Esta,
english: They told Esther’s words to Mordecai.

hausa: Umarnina ke nan. Ku ƙaunaci juna.
english: “I command these things to you, that you may love one another.

hausa: zan gangara in ga ko abin da suka yi ya yi muni kamar yadda kukan ya zo gare ni, zan bincike.”
english: I will go down now, and see whether their deeds are as bad as the reports which have come to me. If not, I will know.”

hausa: Sa’an nan duka mutane za su san cewa Ni Ubangiji na ja takobina daga kubensa; ba zai sāke koma kuma ba.’
english: All flesh will know that I, Yahweh, have drawn my sword out of its sheath. It will not return any more.”’

hausa: “ ‘Sa’an nan a ƙofar Tentin Sujada, dole Banazaren yă aske gashin da ya alamta keɓewarsa, yă kwashe gashin, yă zuba a cikin wutar da take ƙarƙashin hadaya ta salama.
english: The Nazirite shall shave the head of his separation at the door of the Tent of Meeting, take the hair of the head of his separation, and put it on the fire which is under the sacrifice of peace offerings.

hausa: Nuna ƙauna ga Allah da dukan zuciyarka, da dukan ganewarka, da dukan ƙarfinka, da kuma nuna ƙauna ga maƙwabcinka kamar kanka, ya fi dukan hadayun ƙonawa da sadakoki.”
english: and to love him with all the heart, with all the understanding, all the soul, and with all the strength, and to love his neighbor as himself, is more important than all whole burnt offerings and sacrifices.”

hausa: A shirya wuri don a yayyanka ’ya’yansa maza saboda zunuban kakanninsu; kada a reno su su gāji ƙasar su cika duniya da biranensu.
english: Prepare for slaughter of his children because of the iniquity of their fathers, that they not rise up and possess the earth, and fill the surface of the world with cities.

hausa: cikin addu’o’ina a kowane lokaci; ina kuma addu’a cewa a ƙarshe in Allah ya yarda hanya za tă buɗe mini in zo wurinku.
english: requesting, if by any means now at last I may be prospered by the will of God to come to you.

hausa: Da Fir’auna ya yi kusa, Isra’ilawa suka ɗaga idanu sai suka hange Masarawa daga nesa suna tā da ƙura suna zuwa. Sai suka tsorata ƙwarai, suka kuwa yi kuka ga Ubangiji.
english: When Pharaoh came near, the children of Israel lifted up their eyes, and behold, the Egyptians were marching after them; and they were very afraid. The children of Israel cried out to Yahweh.

hausa: Kun ga cewa ashe mutum zai sami kuɓuta ta wurin abin da ya yi ne ba ta wurin bangaskiya kaɗai ba.
english: You see then that by works a man is justified, and not only by faith.

hausa: Dawuda ya ɗauki kan Bafilistin zuwa Urushalima. Sai Dawuda ya ajiye kayan yaƙin Bafilistin a tentinsa.
english: David took the head of the Philistine and brought it to Jerusalem, but he put his armor in his tent.

hausa: Da farko dai, ku nemi mulkin Allah da kuma adalcinsa, za a kuwa ba ku dukan waɗannan abubuwa.
english: But seek first God’s Kingdom and his righteousness; and all these things will be given to you as well.

hausa: Ya ba su rabonsu; hannunsa ya rarraba musu ta wurin awo. Za su mallake ta har abada su kuma zauna a can daga tsara zuwa tsara.
english: He has cast the lot for them, and his hand has divided it to them with a measuring line. They shall possess it forever. From generation to generation they will dwell in it.

hausa: Marar amfanin nan ya ce, “Ranka yă daɗe, ba ni da wanda zai taimaka yă sa ni a cikin tafkin sa’ad da aka motsa ruwan. Yayinda nake ƙoƙarin shiga, sai wani yă riga ni.”
english: The sick man answered him, “Sir, I have no one to put me into the pool when the water is stirred up, but while I’m coming, another steps down before me.”

hausa: Cikin filayen haikalin Ubangiji, ya gina bagadai ga dukan rundunonin taurari.
english: He built altars for all the army of the sky in the two courts of Yahweh’s house.

hausa: Sai Ubangiji ya ce mini,
english: Yahweh spoke to me, saying,

hausa: Ga shi, yau kana kori na daga ƙasar, zan zama a ɓoye daga fuskarka, zan kuma zama mai yawo barkatai, duk wanda ya same ni kuwa zai kashe ni.”
english: Behold, you have driven me out today from the surface of the ground. I will be hidden from your face, and I will be a fugitive and a wanderer on the earth. Whoever finds me will kill me.”

hausa: ku tabbata kun yi biyayya da dukan ƙa’idodi, da kuma dokokin da nake sawa a gabanku a yau.
english: You shall observe to do all the statutes and the ordinances which I set before you today.

hausa: Aka jefa Iblis da ya ruɗe su cikin tafkin farar wuta, inda aka jefa dabban nan da annabin ƙaryan nan. Za a ba su azaba dare da rana har abada abadin.
english: The devil who deceived them was thrown into the lake of fire and sulfur, where the beast and the false prophet are also. They will be tormented day and night forever and ever.

hausa: Za ku sha hukuncin lalacinku ku kuma ɗauki hakkin zunuban bautar gumaka. Sa’an nan za ku san cewa Ni ne Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka.”
english: They will recompense your lewdness on you, and you will bear the sins of your idols. Then you will know that I am the Lord Yahweh.’”

hausa: “Sa’ad da wani yana da kumburi a fatar jikinsa ya kuma warke,
english: “When the body has a boil on its skin, and it has healed,

hausa: Abokaina ƙaunatattu, yanzu, mu ’ya’yan Allah ne, kuma abin da za mu zama nan gaba ba a riga an bayyana ba. Sai dai mun san cewa sa’ad da Kiristi ya bayyana, za mu zama kamar sa, domin za mu gan shi kamar yadda yake.
english: Beloved, now we are children of God. It is not yet revealed what we will be; but we know that when he is revealed, we will be like him, for we will see him just as he is.

hausa: Yeshuwa da ’ya’yansa maza, da ’yan’uwansa, da Kadmiyel da ’ya’yan Yahuda (’yan zuriyar Hodawiya), da ’ya’yan Henadad, da ’ya’yansu da ’yan’uwansu, dukansu Lawiyawa ne, suka haɗa kai cikin duban masu aikin gidan Allah.
english: Then Jeshua stood with his sons and his brothers, Kadmiel and his sons, the sons of Judah, together to have the oversight of the workmen in God’s house: the sons of Henadad, with their sons and their brothers the Levites.

hausa: Ka tsare raina ka kuma kuɓutar da ni; kada ka bari in sha kunya, gama na nemi mafaka daga gare ka.
english: Oh keep my soul, and deliver me. Let me not be disappointed, for I take refuge in you.

hausa: Ka miƙa hannunka don ka warkar ka kuma yi ayyukan banmamaki da alamu masu banmamaki ta wurin sunan bawanka mai tsarki Yesu.”
english: while you stretch out your hand to heal; and that signs and wonders may be done through the name of your holy Servant Jesus.”

hausa: Ko ka san yadda Allah yake iko da gizagizai ya kuma sa walƙiyarsa ta haskaka?
english: Do you know how God controls them, and causes the lightning of his cloud to shine?

hausa: Ɗa mai hikima yakan mai da hankali ga umarnin mahaifinsa, amma mai ba’a ba ya sauraran kwaɓi.
english: A wise son listens to his father’s instruction, but a scoffer doesn’t listen to rebuke.

hausa: “Na kuma tā da annabawa daga cikin ’ya’yanku maza waɗansu kuma su zama keɓaɓɓu daga cikin samarinku. Ba haka ba ne, mutanen Isra’ila?” In ji Ubangiji.
english: I raised up some of your sons for prophets, and some of your young men for Nazirites. Isn’t this true, you children of Israel?” says Yahweh.

hausa: To, ga wane ne za ka kwatanta Allah? Wace siffa za ka kwatanta shi da ita?
english: To whom then will you liken God? Or what likeness will you compare to him?

hausa: Bayansa, Ibzan mutumin Betlehem, ya shugabanci Isra’ila.
english: After him Ibzan of Bethlehem judged Israel.

hausa: Saboda haka, sai ku riƙe waɗannan kalmomina gam a zukatanku da ranku; ku ɗaura su kamar alama a hannuwanku, da goshinku.
english: Therefore you shall lay up these words of mine in your heart and in your soul. You shall bind them for a sign on your hand, and they shall be for frontlets between your eyes.

hausa: Suka ba da kansu ga koyarwar manzanni da kuma ga zumunci, ga gutsuttsura burodin da kuma ga addu’a.
english: They continued steadfastly in the apostles’ teaching and fellowship, in the breaking of bread, and prayer.

hausa: Hankaki suka riƙa kawo masa abinci da nama, safe da yamma, ya kuma sha daga rafin.
english: The ravens brought him bread and meat in the morning, and bread and meat in the evening; and he drank from the brook.

hausa: Duk wanda yake da rai a wannan duniya ta rayayyu, yana sa zuciya, gara rayayyen kare da mataccen zaki!
english: For to him who is joined with all the living there is hope; for a living dog is better than a dead lion.

hausa: Ba wanda yakan dakata ya yi tunani, ba wanda yake da sani ko fahimi ya ce, “Da rabinsa na yi amfani da shi don hura wuta; na ma gasa burodi a kan garwashinsa, na gasa nama na kuma ci. Ya kamata in yi abin ƙyama daga abin da ya rage? Ya kamata in rusuna wa guntun katako?”
english: No one thinks, neither is there knowledge nor understanding to say, “I have burned part of it in the fire. Yes, I have also baked bread on its coals. I have roasted meat and eaten it. Shall I make the rest of it into an abomination? Shall I bow down to a tree trunk?”

hausa: Shi ya sa nake shan wahalar da nake sha. Duk da haka ba na jin kunya, domin na san wanda na gaskata da shi, na kuma tabbata cewa yana iya kiyaye abin da na danƙa masa amana don wancan rana.
english: For this cause I also suffer these things. Yet I am not ashamed, for I know him whom I have believed, and I am persuaded that he is able to guard that which I have committed to him against that day.

hausa: Ƙofar shigar ma tana da ɗakuna uku-uku a kowane gefe. Girman bangayen da suka miƙe, da kuma shirayinta daidai suke da na ƙofa ta fari. Tsawonta kamu hamsin, fāɗinta kuwa kamu ashirin da biyar.
english: The lodges of it were three on this side and three on that side. Its posts and its arches were the same as the measure of the first gate: its length was fifty cubits, and the width twenty-five cubits.

hausa: firist zai bincike shi, in cutar ta riga ta rufe dukan jikinsa, zai furta wannan mutum tsarkakakke ne. Da yake ya juya fari fat, tsarkakakke ne.
english: then the priest shall examine him. Behold, if the leprosy has covered all his flesh, he shall pronounce him clean of the plague. It has all turned white: he is clean.

hausa: Sa’an nan Haruna ya kawo hadayar da take domin mutane. Ya ɗauki akuya ta hadaya don zunubin mutane, ya yanka shi, ya miƙa shi domin hadaya don zunubi kamar yadda ya yi da na farko.
english: He presented the people’s offering, and took the goat of the sin offering which was for the people, and killed it, and offered it for sin, like the first.

hausa: Allah ya yi magana da shi ta haka, ‘Shekara ɗari huɗu, zuriyarka za tă yi baƙunci a wata ƙasar da ba tasu ba, za su yi bauta su kuma sha wulaƙanci.
english: God spoke in this way: that his offspring would live as aliens in a strange land, and that they would be enslaved and mistreated for four hundred years.

hausa: kuma in suka ji kunyar abubuwan da suka aikata, sai ka sanar musu fasalin haikalin da shirye-shiryensa, ƙofofinsa na shiga da fita, dukan fasalinsa da dukan ƙa’idodinsa da dokokinsa. Ka rubuta waɗannan a gabansu saboda su yi aminci da fasalinsa su kuma kiyaye dukan ƙa’idodinsa.
english: If they are ashamed of all that they have done, make known to them the form of the house, its fashion, its exits, its entrances, its structure, all its ordinances, all its forms, and all its laws; and write it in their sight, that they may keep the whole form of it, and all its ordinances, and do them.

hausa: Zai yi gāba yă kuma ɗaukaka kansa a bisa kome da ya shafe sunan Allah, ko kuma ake yi wa sujada, domin yă kafa kansa a haikalin Allah, yana shelar kansa a kan shi Allah ne.
english: He opposes and exalts himself against all that is called God or that is worshiped, so that he sits as God in the temple of God, setting himself up as God.

hausa: Na yi farin ciki da bin farillanka yadda mutum yakan yi farin ciki da arziki mai yawa.
english: I have rejoiced in the way of your testimonies, as much as in all riches.

hausa: Bari harshena yă manne wa rufin bakina in ban tuna da ke ba, in ban so Urushalima farin cikin mafi girma ba.
english: Let my tongue stick to the roof of my mouth if I don’t remember you, if I don’t prefer Jerusalem above my chief joy.

hausa: mutumin da ya mai da duniya ta zama hamada, wanda ya tumɓuke biranenta bai kuma bar kamammunsa suka tafi ba?”
english: who made the world like a wilderness, and overthrew its cities, who didn’t release his prisoners to their home?”

hausa: Za a tuna, a kuma kiyaye waɗannan kwanaki a kowane zamani, cikin kowane iyali, da kuma cikin kowane lardi, da kowace birni. Kuma kada Yahudawa su fasa yin bikin waɗannan kwanakin Furim, ko su bar jikokinsu su manta da kiyaye waɗannan ranaku biyu.
english: and that these days should be remembered and kept throughout every generation, every family, every province, and every city; and that these days of Purim should not fail from among the Jews, nor their memory perish from their offspring.

hausa: Duk wanda ya yi irinsa don jin daɗin ƙanshinsa, dole a ware shi daga mutanensa.”
english: Whoever shall make any like that, to smell of it, he shall be cut off from his people.”

hausa: Ya yi dajiyoyi biyu na zubin tagulla don yă sa a bisa ginshiƙai; kowace dajiya tsayinta kamu biyar ne.
english: He made two capitals of molten bronze to set on the tops of the pillars. The height of the one capital was five cubits, and the height of the other capital was five cubits.

hausa: Ni da waɗanda suke tare da ni za mu nufi birnin, a lokacin da mutanen suka taso mana yadda suka yi dā, sai mu guje musu.
english: I and all the people who are with me will approach the city. It shall happen, when they come out against us, as at the first, that we will flee before them.

hausa: Zai ɗibiya hannunsa a kan hadaya ta ƙonawar, za a kuwa karɓa a madadinsa don a yi kafara dominsa.
english: He shall lay his hand on the head of the burnt offering, and it shall be accepted for him to make atonement for him.

hausa: Bari ƙaunarka marar ƙarewa tă yi mini ta’aziyya, bisa ga alkawarinka ga bawanka.
english: Please let your loving kindness be for my comfort, according to your word to your servant.

hausa: Sai ya ce wa sarki, “Ga abin da Ubangiji ya ce, ‘Ka saki mutumin da na ƙudura yă mutu. Saboda haka ranka zai zama a maimakon ransa, mutanenka a maimakon mutanensa.’ ”
english: He said to him, “Yahweh says, ‘Because you have let go out of your hand the man whom I had devoted to destruction, therefore your life will take the place of his life, and your people take the place of his people.’”

hausa: Duk da haka zan sa su su lura da ayyukan haikali da kuma dukan ayyukan da za a yi a cikinsa.
english: Yet I will make them performers of the duty of the house, for all its service and for all that will be done therein.

hausa: An riga an shirya wurin ƙonawa; an shirya shi saboda sarki. An haƙa ramin wutarsa da zurfi da kuma fāɗi, da isashen wuta da itacen wuta; numfashin Ubangiji, yana kamar kibiritu mai ƙuna, da aka sa masa wuta.
english: For his burning place has long been ready. Yes, it is prepared for the king. He has made its pyre deep and large with fire and much wood. Yahweh’s breath, like a stream of sulfur, kindles it.

hausa: Gonakin Heshbon sun bushe, inabin Sibma ma haka. Masu mulkin al’ummai sun tattake inabi mafi kyau, waɗanda suka taɓa yaɗuwa zuwa Yazer suka bazu ta wajen hamada. Tohonsu sun buɗu suka kai har teku.
english: For the fields of Heshbon languish with the vine of Sibmah. The lords of the nations have broken down its choice branches, which reached even to Jazer, which wandered into the wilderness. Its shoots were spread abroad. They passed over the sea.

hausa: In kuka ga jakin ɗan’uwanku, ko saniyarsa ya fāɗi a kan hanya, kada ku ƙyale shi. Ku taimaka, ku tā da shi.
english: You shall not see your brother’s donkey or his ox fallen down by the way, and hide yourself from them. You shall surely help him to lift them up again.

hausa: “Duk wanda ya saci mutum ya sayar da shi, ko kuwa aka iske shi a hannunsa, lalle kashe shi za a yi.
english: “Anyone who kidnaps someone and sells him, or if he is found in his hand, he shall surely be put to death.

hausa: Gare shi wanda shi kaɗai yake aikata abubuwan banmamaki, Ƙaunarsa madawwamiya ce.
english: to him who alone does great wonders, for his loving kindness endures forever;

hausa: Saboda haka sai nasarar da aka yi a ranar ta zama makoki ga dukan sojoji, gama a ranar, rundunoni sun ji an ce, “Sarki yana baƙin ciki domin ɗansa.”
english: The victory that day was turned into mourning among all the people, for the people heard it said that day, “The king grieves for his son.”

hausa: Gama ta wurina kwanakinka za su yi yawa, za a kuwa ƙara wa ranka shekaru.
english: For by me your days will be multiplied. The years of your life will be increased.

hausa: Wuriyoyi za su yi wari; rafuffukan Masar za su yi ta raguwa har su ƙafe. Iwa da jema za su bushe,
english: The rivers will become foul. The streams of Egypt will be diminished and dried up. The reeds and flags will wither away.

hausa: Yahuda ɗan Yaƙub, da kuma Yahuda Iskariyot, wanda ya bashe Yesu.
english: Judas the son of James; and Judas Iscariot, who also became a traitor.

hausa: Na san ayyukanka. Duba, na sa a gabanka buɗaɗɗen ƙofa wadda ba mai iya rufewa. Na san cewa kana da ɗan ƙarfi, duk da haka ka kiyaye maganata ba ka kuwa yi mūsun sunana ba.
english: “I know your works (behold, I have set before you an open door, which no one can shut), that you have a little power, and kept my word, and didn’t deny my name.

hausa: daga Yashub, kabilar Yashubawa; daga Shimron, kabilar Shimronawa.
english: of Jashub, the family of the Jashubites; of Shimron, the family of the Shimronites.

hausa: Kada ranka yă daɗe, yă kula da Nabal, mugun mutumin nan. Shi dai kamar sunansa ne, sunansa Wawa ne, kuma wawanci yana cikinsa. Amma ni baiwarka, ban ga mutanen da ranka yă daɗe ya aika ba.
english: Please don’t let my lord pay attention to this worthless fellow, Nabal, for as his name is, so is he. Nabal is his name, and folly is with him; but I, your servant, didn’t see my lord’s young men whom you sent.

hausa: “ ‘Idan kuwa daga cikin ’yan tumaki zai ba da hadayarsa, sai ya kawo ’yar tunkiya marar lahani.
english: “‘If he brings a lamb as his offering for a sin offering, he shall bring a female without defect.

hausa: To ina allolin da kuka yi wa kanku? Bari su zo in suna iya cetonku sa’ad da kuke cikin wahala! Gama kuna da alloli masu yawa kamar yadda kuke da garuruwa, ya Yahuda.
english: “But where are your gods that you have made for yourselves? Let them arise, if they can save you in the time of your trouble, for you have as many gods as you have towns, O Judah.

hausa: Waɗannan kaɗan ke nan daga cikin ayyukansa masu yawa. Kaɗan kawai muke ji game da shi! Wane ne kuwa yake iya gane tsawar ikonsa?”
english: Behold, these are but the outskirts of his ways. How small a whisper do we hear of him! But the thunder of his power who can understand?”

hausa: Ya saƙa sarƙoƙi, ya kuma sa su a bisa ginshiƙan. Ya kuma yi rumman ɗari ya rataya wa sarƙoƙin.
english: He made chains in the inner sanctuary, and put them on the tops of the pillars; and he made one hundred pomegranates, and put them on the chains.

hausa: In ba haka ba mai neman ɗaukan fansa jini, zai iya binsa cikin fushi, yă cim masa, saboda nisan hanyar, har ya kashe shi, ko da yake bai cancanci mutuwa ba, tun da yake ba ƙiyayya tsakaninsa da abokinsa a dā.
english: Otherwise, the avenger of blood might pursue the man slayer while hot anger is in his heart and overtake him, because the way is long, and strike him mortally, even though he was not worthy of death, because he didn’t hate him in time past.

hausa: Koyarwar mai hikima maɓulɓulan rai ne, mai juyar da mutum daga tarkon mutuwa.
english: The teaching of the wise is a spring of life, to turn from the snares of death.

hausa: Saboda haka na ji tsoro, na je na ɓoye talentinka a ƙasa. Ga abinka.’
english: I was afraid, and went away and hid your talent in the earth. Behold, you have what is yours.’

hausa: Wanne kuka fi so in na zo? Kuna so in tsananta muku ko in zama mai hankali da kuma sauƙinkai?
english: What do you want? Shall I come to you with a rod, or in love and a spirit of gentleness?

hausa: Bayan Shawulu ya hau karagar mulkin Isra’ila, ya yi yaƙi da abokan gābansu ta kowane gefe. Mowabawa, Ammonawa, mutanen Edom, sarakunan Zoba, da kuma Filistiyawa. Duk wurin da ya juya, ya hore su.
english: Now when Saul had taken the kingdom over Israel, he fought against all his enemies on every side: against Moab, and against the children of Ammon, and against Edom, and against the kings of Zobah, and against the Philistines. Wherever he turned himself, he defeated them.

hausa: Da ya yi kusa da ƙofar garin, sai ga wata gawa ana fitowa da ita. Shi ne ɗa kaɗai ga mahaifiyarsa, ita kuma gwauruwa ce. Taro mai yawa daga garin yana tare da ita.
english: Now when he came near to the gate of the city, behold, one who was dead was carried out, the only born son of his mother, and she was a widow. Many people of the city were with her.

hausa: In wani ya tambaye ku, ‘Don me kuke kunce shi?’ Ku ce masa, ‘Ubangiji yana bukatarsa.’ ”
english: If anyone asks you, ‘Why are you untying it?’ say to him: ‘The Lord needs it.’”

hausa: A waɗannan kwanaki, manyan garin Yahuda suka yi ta aika wasiƙu masu yawa zuwa ga Tobiya, shi kuma ya yi ta aika musu da amsoshi.
english: Moreover in those days the nobles of Judah sent many letters to Tobiah, and Tobiah’s letters came to them.

hausa: Sa’an nan Yowab ya tafi gidan Absalom ya ce masa, “Me ya sa bayinka suka sa wa gonata wuta?”
english: Then Joab arose and came to Absalom to his house, and said to him, “Why have your servants set my field on fire?”

hausa: Ka miƙa ɗaya ragon da yamma, tare da hadaya ta gari da hadaya ta sha kamar aka yi ta safe, mai daɗin ƙanshi, wato, hadaya ce da aka ƙone da wuta ga Ubangiji.
english: The other lamb you shall offer at evening, and shall do to it according to the meal offering of the morning and according to its drink offering, for a pleasant aroma, an offering made by fire to Yahweh.

hausa: An yi wa mata fyaɗe a cikin Sihiyona, da kuma budurwai a cikin garuruwan Yahuda.
english: They ravished the women in Zion, the virgins in the cities of Judah.

hausa: Da lokacin ƙone turare ya yi, duk taron masu sujada suna a waje suna addu’a.
english: The whole multitude of the people were praying outside at the hour of incense.

hausa: “Gama kirayayu da yawa, amma zaɓaɓɓu kaɗan ne zaɓaɓɓu.”
english: For many are called, but few chosen.”

hausa: Saboda haka Sennakerib sarkin Assuriya ya tā da sansanin ya kuma janye. Ya koma Ninebe ya zauna a can.
english: So Sennacherib king of Assyria departed, went home, and lived at Nineveh.

hausa: Ba za a tuna da isashen abincin da aka samu a ƙasar ba, domin yunwar da za tă biyo baya za tă zama da tsanani ƙwarai.
english: and the plenty will not be known in the land by reason of that famine which follows; for it will be very grievous.

hausa: Sa’an nan Dawuda da mutanensa suka tafi Keyila, suka yi yaƙi da Filistiyawa, suka kwashe musu shanunsu, suka jijji wa Filistiyawa ƙwarai, suka cece mutanen Keyila daga hannunsu.
english: David and his men went to Keilah and fought with the Philistines, and brought away their livestock, and killed them with a great slaughter. So David saved the inhabitants of Keilah.

hausa: mahaifinsa da mahaifiyarsa za su kama shi su kawo shi ga dattawa a ƙofar garinsu.
english: then his father and his mother shall take hold of him and bring him out to the elders of his city and to the gate of his place.

hausa: Tun daga nan ba a sāke yin wani annabi a Isra’ila kamar Musa ba, wanda Ubangiji ya san shi fuska da fuska,
english: Since then, there has not arisen a prophet in Israel like Moses, whom Yahweh knew face to face,

hausa: Sa’an nan ya juya zuwa gefen yamma ya auna shi da karan awon, ya samu kamu ɗari biya.
english: He turned about to the west side, and measured five hundred reeds with the measuring reed.

hausa: Amma na san cewa ko yanzu ma Allah zai ba ka duk abin da ka roƙa.”
english: Even now I know that whatever you ask of God, God will give you.”

hausa: Ku haye zuwa Tarshish; ku yi kuka mai zafi, ku mutanen tsibiri.
english: Pass over to Tarshish! Wail, you inhabitants of the coast!

hausa: ta Bigwai 2,056
english: The children of Bigvai, two thousand fifty-six.

hausa: Daga kabilan Yahuda, Simeyon da Benyamin suka ba su rabon sunayen garuruwan da aka ambata.
english: They gave by lot out of the tribe of the children of Judah, and out of the tribe of the children of Simeon, and out of the tribe of the children of Benjamin, these cities which are mentioned by name.

hausa: kashi ɗaya bisa uku na halittu masu rai da suke cikin tekun suka mutu, kashi ɗaya bisa uku kuma na jiragen ruwa kuma suka hallaka.
english: and one third of the living creatures which were in the sea died. One third of the ships were destroyed.

hausa: “Amma itacen ɓauren ya ce, ‘In bar kyawawan ’ya’yana da zaƙinsu, in zo in yi ta fama da itatuwa?’
english: “But the fig tree said to them, ‘Should I leave my sweetness, and my good fruit, and go to wave back and forth over the trees?’

hausa: Wannan yarinya kuwa ta bi Bulus da kuma sauranmu, tana ihu tana cewa, “Waɗannan mutane bayin Allah Mafi Ɗaukaka ne, suna sanar da ku hanyar ceto.”
english: Following Paul and us, she cried out, “These men are servants of the Most High God, who proclaim to us a way of salvation!”

hausa: Sa’ad da aka jarrabci mutum, kada yă ce, “Allah ne yake jarrabtarsa.” Gama ba ya yiwuwa a jarrabci Allah da mugunta, shi kuma ba ya jarrabtar kowa;
english: Let no man say when he is tempted, “I am tempted by God,” for God can’t be tempted by evil, and he himself tempts no one.

hausa: Aka haifa wa Eber ’ya’ya maza biyu. Aka ba wa ɗaya suna Feleg, gama a zamaninsa ne aka raba duniya; aka kuma sa wa ɗan’uwansa suna Yoktan.
english: To Eber were born two sons. The name of the one was Peleg, for in his days the earth was divided. His brother’s name was Joktan.

hausa: Ku rera don farin ciki, ya sammai, gama Ubangiji ya aikata wannan; ku yi sowa, ya duniya a ƙarƙashi. Ku ɓarke da waƙoƙi, ku duwatsu, ku jeji da dukan itatuwanku, gama Ubangiji ya kuɓutar da Yaƙub, ya nuna ɗaukakarsa a cikin Isra’ila.
english: Sing, you heavens, for Yahweh has done it! Shout, you lower parts of the earth! Break out into singing, you mountains, O forest, all of your trees, for Yahweh has redeemed Jacob, and will glorify himself in Israel.

hausa: Sai Shaiɗan ya amsa ya ce, “Haka kawai Ayuba yake tsoron Allah?
english: Then Satan answered Yahweh, and said, “Does Job fear God for nothing?

hausa: Ya kuwa sa su duka a kurkuku na kwana uku.
english: He put them all together into custody for three days.

hausa: In kabari ne begen da nake da shi kaɗai, in na shimfiɗa gadona a cikin duhu,
english: If I look for Sheol as my house, if I have spread my couch in the darkness,

hausa: Haka yake a rubuce cewa, “Adamu, mutumin farko ya zama mai rai”; Adamu na ƙarshe kuwa ruhu ne mai ba da rai.
english: So also it is written, “The first man Adam became a living soul.” The last Adam became a life-giving spirit.

hausa: Zuciyata ta kamu da ciwo ta kuma bushe kamar ciyawa; na manta in ci abinci.
english: My heart is blighted like grass, and withered, for I forget to eat my bread.

hausa: Muka ƙwace ƙasarsu, muka ba da ita gādo ga mutanen Ruben, mutanen Gad, da kuma rabin mutanen Manasse.
english: We took their land, and gave it for an inheritance to the Reubenites, and to the Gadites, and to the half-tribe of the Manassites.

hausa: “ ‘Kada ka yi jima’i da ’yar’uwarka, ko ’yar mahaifinka ko ’yar mahaifiyarka, ko an haife ta a gida ɗaya da kai ko kuwa a wani wuri dabam.
english: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your sister, the daughter of your father, or the daughter of your mother, whether born at home or born abroad.

hausa: Bari safiya ta kawo mini maganar ƙaunarka marar ƙarewa, gama na sa zuciyata a gare ka. Ka nuna mini hanyar da zan bi, gama a gare ka na miƙa raina.
english: Cause me to hear your loving kindness in the morning, for I trust in you. Cause me to know the way in which I should walk, for I lift up my soul to you.

hausa: “Za su ce, ‘Amfanin da kike marmari ya kuɓuce. Dukan arzikinki da darajarki sun ɓace, ba kuwa za a ƙara samunsu ba.’
english: The fruits which your soul lusted after have been lost to you. All things that were dainty and sumptuous have perished from you, and you will find them no more at all.

hausa: Sarki Solomon ya ɗebi ma’aikata daga dukan Isra’ila, su dubu talatin.
english: King Solomon raised a levy out of all Israel; and the levy was thirty thousand men.

hausa: Yesu ya tsaya ya kira su. Ya tambaye su, “Me kuke so in yi muku?”
english: Jesus stood still and called them, and asked, “What do you want me to do for you?”

hausa: don su kiyaye farillansa su kuma kiyaye dokokinsa. Yabo ga Ubangiji.
english: that they might keep his statutes, and observe his laws. Praise Yah!

hausa: Gaba ɗaya dai, Lamek ya yi shekaru 777, sa’an nan ya mutu.
english: All the days of Lamech were seven hundred seventy-seven years, then he died.

hausa: Adoni-Zedek sarkin Urushalima ya ji cewa Yoshuwa ya ci Ai da yaƙi ya kuma hallaka ta sarai, ya yi wa Ai da sarkinta abin da ya yi wa Yeriko da sarkinta, mutanen Gibeyon kuwa sun yi yarjejjeniya ta salama da Isra’ilawa, suna kuma zama kusa da su.
english: Now when Adoni-Zedek king of Jerusalem heard how Joshua had taken Ai, and had utterly destroyed it; as he had done to Jericho and her king, so he had done to Ai and her king; and how the inhabitants of Gibeon had made peace with Israel, and were among them,

hausa: Kada ku hura wuta a cikin duk mazauninku a ranar Asabbaci.”
english: You shall kindle no fire throughout your habitations on the Sabbath day.’”

hausa: Yehoshafat ya yi ta ƙaruwa a ƙarfi; ya gina katanga da biranen ajiya a Yahuda
english: Jehoshaphat grew great exceedingly; and he built fortresses and store cities in Judah.

hausa: Ya mai da kogunansu suka zama jini; ba su iya sha daga rafuffuka ba.
english: he turned their rivers into blood, and their streams, so that they could not drink.

hausa: “ ‘A bukukkuwa da ƙayyadaddun bukukkuwa, hadaya ta gari zai zama efa tare da bijimi, efa da rago, da kuma ’yan raguna da ya ga dama, haɗe da kwalabar mai.
english: “‘“In the feasts and in the appointed holidays, the meal offering shall be an ephah for a bull, and an ephah for a ram, and for the lambs as he is able to give, and a hin of oil to an ephah.

hausa: Tikikus, ƙaunataccen ɗan’uwa da kuma amintaccen bawa cikin Ubangiji, zai faɗa muku kome, domin ku ma ku san yadda nake, da kuma abin da nake yi.
english: But that you also may know my affairs, how I am doing, Tychicus, the beloved brother and faithful servant in the Lord, will make known to you all things.

hausa: Sai bawansa ya ce, “Yaya zan raba wa mutane ɗari wannan?” Amma Elisha ya amsa ya ce, “Ka raba wa mutane su ci, gama haka Ubangiji ya ce, ‘Za su ci har su bar saura.’ ”
english: His servant said, “What, should I set this before a hundred men?” But he said, “Give it to the people, that they may eat; for Yahweh says, ‘They will eat, and will have some left over.’”

hausa: Ina so dukansu su zama ɗaya, ya Uba, kamar yadda kake a cikina, ni kuwa a cikinka. Haka su ma bari su zauna cikinmu, domin duniya ta gaskata cewa kai ka aiko ni.
english: that they may all be one; even as you, Father, are in me, and I in you, that they also may be one in us; that the world may believe that you sent me.

hausa: Da ikonsa ya kwantar da teku; da hikimarsa ya hallaka dodon ruwan nan Rahab.
english: He stirs up the sea with his power, and by his understanding he strikes through Rahab.

hausa: In ya keɓe gonarsa a Shekara ta Murna, darajar da aka kimanta za tă zauna.
english: If he dedicates his field from the Year of Jubilee, according to your valuation it shall stand.

hausa: Suna naɗa sarakuna, ba da izinina ba; sun zaɓa shugabanni ba da yardanta ba. Da azurfa da zinariya sun ƙera gumaka wa kansu wanda zai kai zuwa ga hallakarsu.
english: They have set up kings, but not by me. They have made princes, and I didn’t approve. Of their silver and their gold they have made themselves idols, that they may be cut off.

hausa: Hanyoyin zuwa Sihiyona suna makoki, gama ba wanda ya zo bikin da ta shirya. Ba kowa a hanyoyin shiganta. Firistocinta suna gurnani, ’yan matana kuma suna wahala, kuma tana cikin shan wahala ƙwarai.
english: The roads to Zion mourn, because no one comes to the solemn assembly. All her gates are desolate. Her priests sigh. Her virgins are afflicted, and she herself is in bitterness.

hausa: A kwanakin da mahukunta suke mulki an yi yunwa a ƙasar, sai wani mutum daga Betlehem a Yahuda tare da matarsa da ’ya’yansu maza biyu, suka tafi su yi zama na ɗan lokaci a ƙasar Mowab.
english: In the days when the judges judged, there was a famine in the land. A certain man of Bethlehem Judah went to live in the country of Moab with his wife and his two sons.

hausa: Siman (wanda ya kira Bitrus), ɗan’uwansa Andarawus, Yaƙub, Yohanna, Filibus, Bartolomeyu,
english: Simon, whom he also named Peter; Andrew, his brother; James; John; Philip; Bartholomew;

hausa: Babu wani da ya fi ni a wannan gida. Maigidana bai hana ni kome ba sai ke, saboda ke matarsa ce. Yaya fa, zan yi irin wannan mugun abu, in yi zunubi wa Allah?”
english: No one is greater in this house than I am, and he has not kept back anything from me but you, because you are his wife. How then can I do this great wickedness, and sin against God?”

hausa: Bayansu, sai ga waɗansu shanu bakwai, munana, ramammu, suka fito daga Nilu, suka tsaya kusa da waɗancan masu ƙiban, a bakin kogin.
english: Behold, seven other cattle came up after them out of the river, ugly and thin, and stood by the other cattle on the brink of the river.

hausa: Amma ya yi mūsu a gabansu duka. Ya ce, “Ban san abin da kike magana ba.”
english: But he denied it before them all, saying, “I don’t know what you are talking about.”

hausa: Yabi Ubangiji. Zan ɗaukaka Ubangiji da dukan zuciyata a cikin majalisar masu aikata gaskiya da kuma a cikin taro.
english: Praise Yah! I will give thanks to Yahweh with my whole heart, in the council of the upright, and in the congregation.

hausa: Isra’ilawa suka tashi daga Rameses, suka yi sansani a Sukkot.
english: The children of Israel traveled from Rameses, and encamped in Succoth.

hausa: Da irin abincin da yake kan teburinsa, da irin zaman fadawansa, da irin rigunan masu hidimarsa, da irin masu shayarwarsa, da kuma hadayun ƙonawar da yake yi a haikalin Ubangiji, sai ta yi mamaki ƙwarai.
english: the food of his table, the sitting of his servants, the attendance of his officials, their clothing, his cup bearers, and his ascent by which he went up to Yahweh’s house, there was no more spirit in her.

hausa: Mutumin da ya gani ɗin shi ya ba da shaida, shaidarsa kuwa gaskiya ce. Ya san gaskiya yake faɗa, yana kuma ba da shaidar domin ku ma ku gaskata.
english: He who has seen has testified, and his testimony is true. He knows that he tells the truth, that you may believe.

hausa: Ya ce, “Ya Ubangiji, Allah na Isra’ila, babu Allah kamar ka a sama da kuma ƙasa, kai da kake kiyaye alkawarinka na ƙauna tare da bayinka waɗanda suke cin gaba da zuciya ɗaya a hanyarka.
english: Then he said, “Yahweh, the God of Israel, there is no God like you in heaven or on earth—you who keep covenant and loving kindness with your servants who walk before you with all their heart;

hausa: Amma idanunku ne suka ga dukan waɗannan manyan abubuwan da Ubangiji ya yi.
english: but your eyes have seen all of Yahweh’s great work which he did.

hausa: Kada ku yi mamaki ’yan’uwana, in duniya ta ƙi ku.
english: Don’t be surprised, my brothers, if the world hates you.

hausa: Dubu za su iya fāɗuwa a gefenka, dubu goma a hannun damanka, amma ba abin da zai zo kusa da kai.
english: A thousand may fall at your side, and ten thousand at your right hand; but it will not come near you.

hausa: ’Ya’yan Ferez maza su ne, Hezron da Hamul.
english: The sons of Perez: Hezron and Hamul.

hausa: “Ka gaya wa Isra’ilawa cewa, ‘Sa’ad da kuka haye Urdun zuwa Kan’ana,
english: Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, “When you pass over the Jordan into the land of Canaan,

hausa: Urushalima ta yi zunubi ƙwarai saboda haka ta zama marar tsarki. Dukan masu martaba ta sun raina ta, gama sun ga tsiraicinta; ita ma da kanta tana nishi da ƙyar ta kuma juya baya.
english: Jerusalem has grievously sinned. Therefore she has become unclean. All who honored her despise her, because they have seen her nakedness. Yes, she sighs and turns backward.

hausa: Ubangiji yana tsaronka, Ubangiji ne inuwa a hannun damanka;
english: Yahweh is your keeper. Yahweh is your shade on your right hand.

hausa: “Shekaru kaɗan suka rage in kama hanyar da ba a komawa.
english: For when a few years have come, I will go the way of no return.

hausa: Kiriyat Ba’al (wato, Kiriyat Yeyarim) da Rabba, garuruwa biyu ke nan da ƙauyukansu.
english: Kiriath Baal (also called Kiriath Jearim), and Rabbah; two cities with their villages.

hausa: dole a yi masa aski, sai dai ba zai aske wurin cutar ba, kuma firist zai kaɗaice shi kwana bakwai.
english: then he shall be shaved, but he shall not shave the itch. Then the priest shall isolate the one who has the itch seven more days.

hausa: A sansani suka ji kishin Musa da kuma Haruna, wanda Ubangiji ya keɓe.
english: They envied Moses also in the camp, and Aaron, Yahweh’s saint.

hausa: Za ka zo daga wurinka a can arewa, kai da al’ummai masu yawa tare da kai, dukansu suna hawan dawakai, jama’a mai yawa, babbar runduna.
english: You will come from your place out of the uttermost parts of the north, you, and many peoples with you, all of them riding on horses, a great company and a mighty army.

hausa: ya sayar da wata gonar da ya mallaki ya kuma kawo kuɗin ya ajiye a sawun manzanni.
english: having a field, sold it and brought the money and laid it at the apostles’ feet.

hausa: Yayinda yake kan hanyarsa, sai wani zaki ya sadu da shi ya kashe shi, aka kuma jefar da jikinsa a kan hanya, jakin da zakin suka tsaya kusa da gawar.
english: When he had gone, a lion met him by the way and killed him. His body was thrown on the path, and the donkey stood by it. The lion also stood by the body.

hausa: An san Ubangiji ta wurin gaskiyarsa; an kama mugaye da aikin hannuwansu. Haggayiyon. Sela
english: Yahweh has made himself known. He has executed judgment. The wicked is snared by the work of his own hands. Meditation. Selah.

hausa: Amma wannan ya faru ne domin a cika abin da yake a rubuce cikin Dokarsu cewa, ‘Sun ƙi ni ba dalili.’
english: But this happened so that the word may be fulfilled which was written in their law, ‘They hated me without a cause.’

hausa: Kafin su yi kira zan amsa; yayinda suke cikin magana zan ji.
english: It will happen that before they call, I will answer; and while they are yet speaking, I will hear.

hausa: Yebusiyawa, Amoriyawa, Girgashiyawa,
english: the Jebusites, the Amorites, the Girgashites,

hausa: ƙa’idodi ne kuma ga mace wadda take al’ada, ga namiji ko macen da take ɗiga, ga kuma namijin da ya kwana da mace marar tsarki.
english: and of her who has her period, and of a man or woman who has a discharge, and of him who lies with her who is unclean.

hausa: Amma Ubangiji yana tare da ni kamar babban jarumi; saboda haka masu tsananta mini za su yi tuntuɓe ba kuwa za su yi nasara ba. Za su fāɗi su kuma sha mummunar kunya; ba za a taɓa manta da rashin bangirmansu ba.
english: But Yahweh is with me as an awesome mighty one. Therefore my persecutors will stumble, and they won’t prevail. They will be utterly disappointed because they have not dealt wisely, even with an everlasting dishonor which will never be forgotten.

hausa: Ko kuna so ku gyara abin da na faɗi ne, ku mai da magana wanda yake cikin wahala ta zama ta wofi?
english: Do you intend to reprove words, since the speeches of one who is desperate are as wind?

hausa: Gama ya sami girma da ɗaukaka daga Allah Uba sa’ad da murya ta zo masa daga Mafificiyar Ɗaukaka cewa, “Wannan Ɗana ne, wanda nake ƙauna; da shi nake jin daɗi ƙwarai.”
english: For he received from God the Father honor and glory when the voice came to him from the Majestic Glory, “This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.”

hausa: Mutane suka zuba ido, suna kuma tunani a zuciyarsu, ko Yohanna ne Kiristi wanda ake sauraron zuwansa.
english: As the people were in expectation, and all men reasoned in their hearts concerning John, whether perhaps he was the Christ,

hausa: bisa mutanen Efraim shi ne, Hosheya ɗan Azaziya; bisa rabin kabilar Manasse shi ne, Yowel ɗan Fedahiya;
english: of the children of Ephraim, Hoshea the son of Azaziah; of the half-tribe of Manasseh, Joel the son of Pedaiah;

hausa: In mutum ya yi laifin da ya isa kisa, aka kuwa rataye shi a itace,
english: If a man has committed a sin worthy of death, and he is put to death, and you hang him on a tree,

hausa: Sa’ad da na yanke abincinku, mata goma za su dafa abinci a murhu ɗaya, za su kuma rarraba abincin a ma’auni. Za ku ci amma ba za ku ƙoshi ba.
english: When I break your staff of bread, ten women shall bake your bread in one oven, and they shall deliver your bread again by weight. You shall eat, and not be satisfied.

hausa: Zuriyar Mishma su ne, Hammuwel ɗansa, wanda ya haifi Zakkur, shi Zakkur kuma ya haifi Shimeyi.
english: The sons of Mishma: Hammuel his son, Zaccur his son, Shimei his son.

hausa: Ka shirya katakai ashirin a gefen kudu na tabanakul,
english: You shall make twenty boards for the tabernacle, for the south side southward.

hausa: Kwanakinka kamar na mutane ne, ko shekarunka kamar na mutane ne
english: Are your days as the days of mortals, or your years as man’s years,

hausa: Nan take, sai ya aiki mai aiwatar da kisa da umarni ya kawo kan Yohanna. Mutumin ya je ya yanke kan Yohanna a kurkuku.
english: Immediately the king sent out a soldier of his guard and commanded to bring John’s head; and he went and beheaded him in the prison,

hausa: kowane irin hankaka,
english: every raven of any kind,

hausa: Duk sa’ad da Isra’ila suka fita yaƙi, Ubangiji yakan yi gāba da su don a ci su a yaƙi, kamar dai yadda ya rantse musu. Suka kuwa shiga wahala ƙwarai.
english: Wherever they went out, Yahweh’s hand was against them for evil, as Yahweh had spoken, and as Yahweh had sworn to them; and they were very distressed.

hausa: da sanduna guda huɗu da rammuka guda huɗu na tagulla. Ƙugiyoyinsu da maɗauransu na azurfa ne, aka kuma dalaye bisansu da azurfa.
english: Their pillars were four, and their sockets four, of bronze; their hooks of silver, and the overlaying of their capitals, and their fillets, of silver.

hausa: Ke da kike zaune a cikin lambu da ƙawaye suna lura da ke, bari in ji muryarki!
english: You who dwell in the gardens, with friends in attendance, let me hear your voice!

hausa: Don haka Yehohiyacin ya tuɓe kayan fursuna. Kowace rana kuwa yakan ci abinci a teburin sarki har iyakar ransa.
english: and changed his prison garments. Jehoiachin ate bread before him continually all the days of his life;

hausa: In dai muna da abinci da sutura, ai, sai mu gamsu da su.
english: But having food and clothing, we will be content with that.

hausa: Mutanen suka amsa, “Mun zo ne daga wurin Korneliyus wani jarumin. Shi mutum ne mai adalci mai tsoron Allah kuma, wanda dukan Yahudawa ke girmamawa. Wani mala’ika mai tsarki ya faɗa masa, yă sa ka zo gidansa don yă ji abin da za ka faɗa.”
english: They said, “Cornelius, a centurion, a righteous man and one who fears God, and well spoken of by all the nation of the Jews, was directed by a holy angel to invite you to his house, and to listen to what you say.”

hausa: Bayan Bulus ya ga wahayin, muka shirya nan take mu tashi zuwa Makidoniya, mun tabbata cewa, Allah ya kira mu mu yi musu wa’azin bishara.
english: When he had seen the vision, immediately we sought to go out to Macedonia, concluding that the Lord had called us to preach the Good News to them.

hausa: “Jarumawa sun fāɗi! Makaman yaƙi sun hallaka!”
english: How the mighty have fallen, and the weapons of war have perished!”

hausa: Bayina za su rera da farin cikin zukatansu, amma ku za ku yi kuka daga wahalar zuciya ku kuma yi kururuwa da karayar zuci.
english: Behold, my servants will sing for joy of heart, but you will cry for sorrow of heart, and will wail for anguish of spirit.

hausa: “Ki gangara, ki zauna a ƙura, Budurwa Diyar Babilon; ki zauna a ƙasa ba tare da rawani ba, Diyar Babiloniyawa. Ba za a ƙara kira ke marar ƙarfi ’yar gata ba.
english: “Come down and sit in the dust, virgin daughter of Babylon. Sit on the ground without a throne, daughter of the Chaldeans. For you will no longer be called tender and delicate.

hausa: Ba shakka masu yi mini ba’a suna kewaye da ni; idanuna suna ganin tsokanar da suke yi mini.
english: Surely there are mockers with me. My eye dwells on their provocation.

hausa: “Kun dai ji an faɗa, ‘Ka ƙaunaci maƙwabcinka,ka kuma ƙi abokin gābanka.’
english: “You have heard that it was said, ‘You shall love your neighbor and hate your enemy.’

hausa: Ya tsaya kusa da ni ya ce, ‘Ɗan’uwa Shawulu, ka sami ganin garinka!’ A daidai lokacin kuwa na iya ganinsa.
english: came to me, and standing by me said to me, ‘Brother Saul, receive your sight!’ In that very hour I looked up at him.

hausa: wanda ya shaida dukan abin da ya gani, wato, maganar Allah da kuma shaidar Yesu Kiristi.
english: who testified to God’s word and of the testimony of Jesus Christ, about everything that he saw.

hausa: A yau, ko da yake ni naɗaɗɗen sarki ne, duk da haka na raunana, kuma waɗannan ’ya’yan Zeruhiya sun fi ƙarfina. Ubangiji yă sāka wa mai aikata mugunta da muguntar da ya aikata!”
english: I am weak today, though anointed king. These men, the sons of Zeruiah are too hard for me. May Yahweh reward the evildoer according to his wickedness.”

hausa: Ka yi magana ta wurin Ruhu Mai Tsarki ta bakin bawanka, kakanmu Dawuda cewa, “ ‘Don me ƙasashe suke fushi, mutane kuma suke ƙulla shawara a banza?
english: who by the mouth of your servant David, said, ‘Why do the nations rage, and the peoples plot a vain thing?

hausa: Mikahiya ya ci gaba, “Saboda haka ka ji maganar Ubangiji. I, na ga Ubangiji zaune a kursiyinsa tare da dukan rundunar sama tsaye kewaye da shi a dama da hagunsa.
english: Micaiah said, “Therefore hear Yahweh’s word. I saw Yahweh sitting on his throne, and all the army of heaven standing by him on his right hand and on his left.

hausa: Nan da nan da aka yi wa Yesu baftisma, sai ya fito daga ruwa. A wannan lokaci sama ya buɗe, sai ya ga Ruhun Allah yana saukowa kamar kurciya ya kuwa sauka a kansa.
english: Jesus, when he was baptized, went up directly from the water: and behold, the heavens were opened to him. He saw the Spirit of God descending as a dove, and coming on him.

hausa: Da taron mutane suka ƙaru, sai Yesu ya ce, “Wannan mugun zamani ne. Tana neman wani abin banmamaki, amma ba ko ɗaya da za a ba ta, sai dai ta Yunana.
english: When the multitudes were gathering together to him, he began to say, “This is an evil generation. It seeks after a sign. No sign will be given to it but the sign of Jonah the prophet.

hausa: Haka kuma Naftali bai kori waɗanda suke zaune a Bet-Shemesh ko Bet-Anat; amma mutanen Naftali su ma suna zama a ciki Kan’aniyawa mazaunan ƙasar, waɗanda suke zaune a Bet-Shemesh da Bet-Anat kuwa suka zama masu yi musu aikin gandu.
english: Naphtali didn’t drive out the inhabitants of Beth Shemesh, nor the inhabitants of Beth Anath; but he lived among the Canaanites, the inhabitants of the land. Nevertheless the inhabitants of Beth Shemesh and of Beth Anath became subject to forced labor.

hausa: In kuwa na iso sai in ba da wasiƙun gabatarwa ga mutanen da kuka amince da su, in kuma aike su da taimakonku zuwa Urushalima.
english: When I arrive, I will send whoever you approve with letters to carry your gracious gift to Jerusalem.

hausa: “Zan kawo baƙin ciki a kan mutane za su kuma yi tafiya kamar makafi, domin sun yi wa Ubangiji zunubi. Za a zubar da jininsu kamar ƙura kayan cikinsu kuma kamar najasa.
english: I will bring such distress on men that they will walk like blind men because they have sinned against Yahweh. Their blood will be poured out like dust and their flesh like dung.

hausa: ’Ya’yan Ezer maza su ne, Bilhan, Za’aban da Akan.
english: These are the children of Ezer: Bilhan, Zaavan, and Akan.

hausa: Amma gwauruwar da take zaman jin daɗi, matacciya ce tun tana da rai.
english: But she who gives herself to pleasure is dead while she lives.

hausa: Yehoshafat kuwa ya huta tare da kakanninsa, aka kuma binne shi tare da su a birnin Dawuda kakansa. Sai Yehoram ɗansa ya gāje shi.
english: Jehoshaphat slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in his father David’s city. Jehoram his son reigned in his place.

hausa: Amma ku ji maganar Ubangiji, dukan Yahudawan da suke zama a Masar, ‘Na rantse da sunana,’ in ji Ubangiji, ‘cewa babu wani daga Yahuda wanda yake zama a ko’ina a Masar zai ƙara kira bisa sunana ko ya rantse ya ce, “Muddin Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka yana raye.”
english: “Therefore hear Yahweh’s word, all Judah who dwell in the land of Egypt: ‘Behold, I have sworn by my great name,’ says Yahweh, ‘that my name will no more be named in the mouth of any man of Judah in all the land of Egypt, saying, “As the Lord Yahweh lives.”

hausa: Na goma sha ɗaya, don wata goma sha ɗaya, shi ne Benahiya mutumin Firaton, mutumin Efraim. Akwai mutane 24,000 a sashensa.
english: The eleventh captain for the eleventh month was Benaiah the Pirathonite, of the children of Ephraim. In his division were twenty-four thousand.

hausa: Na horar da su na kuma ƙarfafa su, amma sun ƙulla mini maƙarƙashiya.
english: Though I have taught and strengthened their arms, yet they plot evil against me.

hausa: wadda a gaskiya ba bishara ba ce ko kaɗan. Tabbatacce waɗansu mutane suna birkitar da ku, suna kuma ƙoƙari su karkatar da bisharar Kiristi.
english: but there isn’t another “good news.” Only there are some who trouble you and want to pervert the Good News of Christ.

hausa: Ta haka firist zai yi kafara dominsa saboda dukan waɗannan zunuban da ya yi, za a kuwa gafarta masa. Sauran hadayar za tă zama ta firist, kamar yadda yake bisa ga hadaya ta gari.’ ”
english: The priest shall make atonement for him concerning his sin that he has sinned in any of these things, and he will be forgiven; and the rest shall be the priest’s, as the meal offering.’”

hausa: Kamar iska daga gabas zan warwatsa su a gaban abokan gābansu; zan juya musu bayana, ba zan nuna musu fuskata ba a ranar masifarsu.”
english: I will scatter them as with an east wind before the enemy. I will show them the back, and not the face, in the day of their calamity.

hausa: In kuma muka ce, ‘Daga wurin mutane ne’; suna jin tsoron mutane, don kowa ya ɗauka cewa, Yohanna, annabi ne na gaskiya.”
english: If we should say, ‘From men’”—they feared the people, for all held John to really be a prophet.

hausa: Duk da haka, domin masu mugunta ba su ji tsoron Allah ba, abubuwa ba za su yi musu kyau ba, ransu kamar inuwa yake ba zai yi tsawo ba.
english: But it shall not be well with the wicked, neither shall he lengthen days like a shadow, because he doesn’t fear God.

hausa: Da Yerobowam ɗan Nebat ya ji wannan (a lokacin yana a Masar, inda ya gudu daga Sarki Solomon ya tafi), sai ya dawo daga Masar.
english: When Jeroboam the son of Nebat heard of it (for he was in Egypt, where he had fled from the presence of King Solomon), Jeroboam returned out of Egypt.

hausa: Har barewa a kurmi ma ta gudu ta bar ’ya’yan da ta haihu sababbi saboda babu ciyawa.
english: Yes, the doe in the field also calves and forsakes her young, because there is no grass.

hausa: Kashegari suka bar masu hawan dawakai suka ci gaba da shi, yayinda sojojin suka koma barikin soja.
english: But on the next day they left the horsemen to go with him, and returned to the barracks.

hausa: “Ku ƙarfafa, ku yi ƙarfin hali. Kada ku ji tsoro ko ku yi fargaba saboda sarkin Assuriya, da mayaƙan nan masu yawa da suke tare da shi, gama shi wanda yake tare da mu, ya fi wanda yake tare da su.
english: “Be strong and courageous. Don’t be afraid or dismayed because of the king of Assyria, nor for all the multitude who is with him; for there is a greater one with us than with him.

hausa: Yoram ya aikata mugunta a gaban Ubangiji, amma ba kamar yadda mahaifinsa da mahaifiyarsa suka yi ba. Ya kawar da dutsen tsarkin Ba’al wanda mahaifinsa ya yi.
english: He did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight, but not like his father and like his mother, for he put away the pillar of Baal that his father had made.

hausa: sai suka zo wurin Zerubbabel da kuma wurin shugabannin iyalai, suka ce, “Bari mu taimake ku ginin domin mu ma muna addu’a ga Allahnku yadda kuke yi, muna miƙa masa hadaya tun lokacin Esar-Haddon sarkin Assuriya wanda ya kawo mu nan.”
english: they came near to Zerubbabel, and to the heads of fathers’ households, and said to them, “Let us build with you, for we seek your God as you do; and we have been sacrificing to him since the days of Esar Haddon king of Assyria, who brought us up here.”

hausa: Gama Kiristi bai aike ni yin baftisma ba, sai dai wa’azin bishara ba da kalmomin hikimar mutum ba, domin kada gicciyen Kiristi ya rasa ikonsa.
english: For Christ sent me not to baptize, but to preach the Good News—not in wisdom of words, so that the cross of Christ wouldn’t be made void.

hausa: “Ga alkawarin da zan yi da gidan Isra’ila bayan wannan lokaci,” in ji Ubangiji. “Zan sa dokata a tunaninsu in kuma rubuta ta a zukatansu. Zan zama Allahnsu, za su kuma zama mutanena.
english: “But this is the covenant that I will make with the house of Israel after those days,” says Yahweh: “I will put my law in their inward parts, and I will write it in their heart. I will be their God, and they shall be my people.

hausa: Saboda haka Allah yana nuna jinƙai ga wanda yake so, yana kuma taurara zuciyar wanda yake so.
english: So then, he has mercy on whom he desires, and he hardens whom he desires.

hausa: Bayan haka sai mutane suka bar Hazerot suka sauka a Hamadan Faran.
english: Afterward the people traveled from Hazeroth, and encamped in the wilderness of Paran.

hausa: Sai na je wajen mala’ikan na ce masa yă ba ni ƙaramin naɗaɗɗen littafin. Ya ce mini, “Karɓa ka ci. Zai sa cikinka yă yi tsami, amma ‘a bakinka zai zama da zaƙi kamar zuma.’ ”
english: I went to the angel, telling him to give me the little book. He said to me, “Take it and eat it. It will make your stomach bitter, but in your mouth it will be as sweet as honey.”

hausa: Yesu ya zazzaga dukan Galili, yana koyarwa a cikin majami’unsu, yana wa’azin labari mai daɗi na mulkin sama, yana kuma warkar da kowace cuta da rashin lafiyar mutane.
english: Jesus went about in all Galilee, teaching in their synagogues, preaching the Good News of the Kingdom, and healing every disease and every sickness among the people.

hausa: Sa’ad da ya ji na yi ihu neman taimako, sai ya bar rigarsa kusa da ni, ya gudu ya fita daga gida.”
english: When he heard that I lifted up my voice and cried, he left his garment by me, and ran outside.”

hausa: To, fa, ɗana, yi abin da na ce; gudu nan take zuwa wurin ɗan’uwana Laban a Haran.
english: Now therefore, my son, obey my voice. Arise, flee to Laban, my brother, in Haran.

hausa: Bawa mai hikima zai yi mulki a kan da mai rashin kunya, kuma zai raba gādo kamar ɗaya daga cikin ’yan’uwansa.
english: A servant who deals wisely will rule over a son who causes shame, and shall have a part in the inheritance among the brothers.

hausa: Zai kafa tentin mulkinsa tsakanin tekunan da suke a kyakkyawan tsauni mai tsarki. Duk da haka zai zo ga ƙarshensa, kuma babu wanda zai taimake shi.
english: He will plant the tents of his palace between the sea and the glorious holy mountain; yet he will come to his end, and no one will help him.

hausa: “Ko kuwa in na aika da namun jeji su ratsa cikin wannan ƙasa suka kuma bar ta babu yaro, ta kuma zama kufai har babu wanda zai ratsa cikinta saboda namun jeji,
english: “If I cause evil animals to pass through the land, and they ravage it and it is made desolate, so that no man may pass through because of the animals—

hausa: Ya mai da shi shugaban gidansa, mai mulki a bisa dukan abin da ya mallaka,
english: He made him lord of his house, and ruler of all of his possessions,

hausa: Tun zamanin kakanninku, kun juye wa ƙa’idodina baya, ba ku kuma kiyaye su ba. Ku komo gare ni, ni kuma zan koma gare ku,” in ji Ubangiji Maɗaukaki. “Amma sai kuka ce, ‘Yaya za mu koma gare ka?’
english: From the days of your fathers you have turned away from my ordinances and have not kept them. Return to me, and I will return to you,” says Yahweh of Armies. “But you say, ‘How shall we return?’

hausa: Ku zo, dukanku namun jeji, ku zo ku ci, dukanku namun jeji!
english: All you animals of the field, come to devour, all you animals in the forest.

hausa: Sai suka miƙa masa ruwan inabi gauraye da mur, don yă rage zafi, amma bai sha ba.
english: They offered him wine mixed with myrrh to drink, but he didn’t take it.

hausa: Da rana ka bishe kakanninmu da girgije, da dare kuwa ka bishe su da ginshiƙin wuta don ka ba su haske a hanyar da za su bi.
english: Moreover, in a pillar of cloud you led them by day; and in a pillar of fire by night, to give them light in the way in which they should go.

hausa: da aka ƙidaya, kabila-kabila, su 2,750 ne.
english: Those who were counted of them by their families were two thousand seven hundred fifty.

hausa: Musa ya ce wa Yoshuwa, “Zaɓi waɗansu mazanmu, ka je ka yaƙi Amalekawa. Gobe zan tsaya a bisa tudu, da sandan Allah a hannuwana.”
english: Moses said to Joshua, “Choose men for us, and go out to fight with Amalek. Tomorrow I will stand on the top of the hill with God’s rod in my hand.”

hausa: gama sa’ad da shugabannin keken yaƙi suka ga cewa ba shi ne sarkin Isra’ila ba, sai suka daina binsa.
english: When the captains of the chariots saw that it was not the king of Israel, they turned back from pursuing him.

hausa: Suka isa Afisa, inda Bulus ya bar Firiskila da Akwila. Shi kansa ya shiga majami’a ya kuma yi muhawwara da Yahudawa.
english: He came to Ephesus, and he left them there; but he himself entered into the synagogue and reasoned with the Jews.

hausa: Don mai bi da kaɗe-kaɗe. Da salon “Lili.” Na ’ya’yan Kora maza. Maskil Waƙar Aure. Zuciyata ta cika da kyakkyawan kan magana yayinda nake rera ayoyina wa sarki; harshena ne alƙalamin ƙwararren marubuci.
english: For the Chief Musician. Set to “The Lilies.” A contemplation by the sons of Korah. A wedding song. My heart overflows with a noble theme. I recite my verses for the king. My tongue is like the pen of a skillful writer.

hausa: Ƙasarsu ta yi ta fid da kwaɗi, waɗanda suka haura cikin ɗakunan kwana na masu mulkinsu.
english: Their land swarmed with frogs, even in the rooms of their kings.

hausa: Kuma kuna ji kuna gani yadda Bulus ɗin nan ya shawo kan mutane da yawa ya kuma sa suka bauɗe a nan a Afisa da dukan lardin Asiya. Yana cewa alloli da mutum ya ƙera ba alloli ba ne ko kaɗan.
english: You see and hear that not at Ephesus alone, but almost throughout all Asia, this Paul has persuaded and turned away many people, saying that they are no gods that are made with hands.

hausa: Suna a cikin duhu a fahimtarsu, kuma a rabe suke daga ran Allah saboda jahilcin da yake cikinsu ta dalilin taurarewar zukatansu.
english: being darkened in their understanding, alienated from the life of God because of the ignorance that is in them, because of the hardening of their hearts.

hausa: Abokina ƙaunatacce, kada ka yi koyi da abin da yake mugu sai dai abin da yake nagari. Duk mai yin abin da yake nagari daga Allah yake. Duk mai yin abin da yake mugu bai taɓa sanin Allah ba.
english: Beloved, don’t imitate that which is evil, but that which is good. He who does good is of God. He who does evil hasn’t seen God.

hausa: Bakkunansu za su kashe samari; ba za su ji tausayin jarirai ba ba za su kuwa nuna jinƙai ga ’yan yara ba.
english: Their bows will dash the young men in pieces; and they shall have no pity on the fruit of the womb. Their eyes will not spare children.

hausa: Nan da nan sa’ad da Yezebel ta ji cewa an jajjefe Nabot da dutse ya kuma mutu, sai ta ce wa Ahab, “Tashi ka mallaki gonar inabin Nabot mutumin Yezireyel wanda ya ƙi ya sayar maka. Ba shi da rai, ya mutu.”
english: When Jezebel heard that Naboth had been stoned and was dead, Jezebel said to Ahab, “Arise, take possession of the vineyard of Naboth the Jezreelite, which he refused to give you for money; for Naboth is not alive, but dead.”

hausa: Kuna da alloli masu yawa yadda kuke da garuruwa, ya Yahuda; kuma bagadan da kuka yi don ƙona turare wa allahn nan Ba’al abin kunya sun yi yawa kamar titunan Urushalima.’
english: For according to the number of your cities are your gods, Judah; and according to the number of the streets of Jerusalem you have set up altars to the shameful thing, even altars to burn incense to Baal.’

hausa: Yahudawa dai ba su yarda cewa dā shi makaho ne ya kuma sami ganin gari ba, sai da suka kira iyayen mutumin.
english: The Jews therefore didn’t believe concerning him, that he had been blind and had received his sight, until they called the parents of him who had received his sight,

english: Behold, he was more honorable than the thirty, but he didn’t attain to the three; and David set him over his guard.

hausa: Ubangiji yakan ba wa makafi ido, Ubangiji yakan ɗaga waɗanda aka rusunar da su ƙasa, Ubangiji yana ƙaunar masu adalci.
english: Yahweh opens the eyes of the blind. Yahweh raises up those who are bowed down. Yahweh loves the righteous.

hausa: Cikin dukan mayaƙan nan akwai zaɓaɓɓu mutane ɗari bakwai waɗanda su bahagwai ne, kowanne yana iya harbin gashin guda na kai da majajjawa ba kuskure.
english: Among all these soldiers there were seven hundred chosen men who were left-handed. Every one of them could sling a stone at a hair and not miss.

hausa: hayaniyar yaƙi za tă tashi gāba da mutanenku, saboda a ragargaza kagaranku, kamar yadda Shalman ya ragargaza Bet-Arbel a ranar yaƙi, sa’ad da aka fyaɗa uwaye tare da ’ya’yansu da ƙasa.
english: Therefore a battle roar will arise among your people, and all your fortresses will be destroyed, as Shalman destroyed Beth Arbel in the day of battle. The mother was dashed in pieces with her children.

hausa: Wannan shi ne labarin zuriyar Yaƙub. Yusuf, saurayi ne mai shekara goma sha bakwai. Shi da ’yan’uwansa, wato, ’ya’yan Bilha maza da kuma ’ya’yan Zilfa maza, matan mahaifinsa suna kiwon garkuna tare. Sai Yusuf ya kawo wa mahaifinsu rahoto marar kyau game da ’yan’uwansa.
english: This is the history of the generations of Jacob. Joseph, being seventeen years old, was feeding the flock with his brothers. He was a boy with the sons of Bilhah and Zilpah, his father’s wives. Joseph brought an evil report of them to their father.

hausa: Ko da na ɓata muku rai ta wurin wasiƙata, ba na baƙin ciki da haka. Ko da yake dā kam na yi baƙin ciki, don na lura wasiƙata ta ɓata muku rai, amma na ɗan lokaci ne kawai.
english: For though I grieved you with my letter, I do not regret it, though I did regret it. For I see that my letter made you grieve, though just for a while.

hausa: Maganar Ubangiji ta zo mini cewa,
english: Yahweh’s word came again to me, saying,

hausa: Garkuwata shi ne Allah Mafi Ɗaukaka, wanda yake ceton masu tsabtar zuciya.
english: My shield is with God, who saves the upright in heart.

hausa: Ba mu da wani abin da za mu nuna cewa da iyawarmu ne muke aikin nan. Iyawarmu daga wurin Allah ne.
english: not that we are sufficient of ourselves to account anything as from ourselves; but our sufficiency is from God,

hausa: So suke su zama malaman doka, ba tare da fahimtar abin da suke faɗa ba, balle abubuwan da suke ta nacewa a kai.
english: desiring to be teachers of the law, though they understand neither what they say nor about what they strongly affirm.

hausa: Ga abin da Ubangiji yana cewa, “Kada mai hikima ya yi fariya da hikimarsa ko mai ƙarfi ya yi fariya da ƙarfinsa ko mai arziki ya yi fariya da arzikinsa,
english: Yahweh says, “Don’t let the wise man glory in his wisdom. Don’t let the mighty man glory in his might. Don’t let the rich man glory in his riches.

hausa: Daga gare ka yabona yake zuwa cikin babban taro; a gaban waɗanda suke tsoronka zan cika alkawarina.
english: My praise of you comes in the great assembly. I will pay my vows before those who fear him.

hausa: Tabbatacce ka ci Edom da yaƙi, yanzu kuwa kana ɗaga kai. To, ka gode da darajar da ka samu, amma ka zauna a gida! Don me kake neman faɗa kana neman fāɗuwarka da kuma ta Yahuda?”
english: You have indeed struck Edom, and your heart has lifted you up. Enjoy the glory of it, and stay at home; for why should you meddle to your harm, that you fall, even you, and Judah with you?”

hausa: Gama sun yashe ni suka kuma mai da wannan wuri ya zama na baƙin alloli; sun ƙone hadayu a cikinsa wa allolin da ko su ko kakanninsu ko sarakunan Yahuda ba su taɓa sani ba, suka kuma cika wannan wuri da jini marasa laifi.
english: Because they have forsaken me, and have defiled this place, and have burned incense in it to other gods that they didn’t know—they, their fathers, and the kings of Judah—and have filled this place with the blood of innocents,

hausa: Hazayel sarkin Aram ya musguna wa Isra’ila a duk tsawon mulkin Yehoyahaz.
english: Hazael king of Syria oppressed Israel all the days of Jehoahaz.

hausa: Duka ne suke da baiwar warkarwa? Duka ne suke magana da harsuna? Duka ne suke iya fassara?
english: Do all have gifts of healings? Do all speak with various languages? Do all interpret?

hausa: “Ɗan mutum, ka yi magana da dattawan Isra’ila ka ce musu, ‘Ga abin da Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka yana cewa kun zo ne ku nemi shawarata? Muddin ina raye, ba zan bari ku nemi shawarata ba, in ji Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka.’
english: “Son of man, speak to the elders of Israel, and tell them, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “Is it to inquire of me that you have come? As I live,” says the Lord Yahweh, “I will not be inquired of by you.”’

hausa: Suka yi yaƙi da Hagirawa, Yetur, Nafish da Nodab.
english: They made war with the Hagrites, with Jetur, and Naphish, and Nodab.

hausa: Yesu ya amsa ya ce, “Don me kake kira na managarci? Ai, ba wani nagari, sai Allah kaɗai.
english: Jesus asked him, “Why do you call me good? No one is good, except one: God.

hausa: Mutum yana kama da numfashi; kwanakinsa suna wucewa kamar inuwa.
english: Man is like a breath. His days are like a shadow that passes away.

hausa: Malkiya ɗan Rekab mai mulkin yankin Bet-Hakkerem ne ya yi gyare-gyaren Ƙofar Juji. Ya sāke gina ta ya kuma sa sakatunta, da sanduna ƙarfenta a wurarensu.
english: Malchijah the son of Rechab, the ruler of the district of Beth Haccherem, repaired the dung gate. He built it, and set up its doors, its bolts, and its bars.

hausa: Zo ku ga ayyukan Ubangiji, kangon da ya kawo a kan duniya.
english: Come, see Yahweh’s works, what desolations he has made on the earth.

hausa: Yabo ya tabbata ga Ubangiji, gama ya nuna ƙaunarsa mai banmamaki gare ni sa’ad da aka yi mini kwanto kewaye da birni.
english: Praise be to Yahweh, for he has shown me his marvelous loving kindness in a strong city.

hausa: namiji da ta mace, suka zo wurin Nuhu, suka shiga jirgi, kamar yadda Allah ya umarce Nuhu.
english: went by pairs to Noah into the ship, male and female, as God commanded Noah.

hausa: Kada ku yi wa saniya takunkumi sa’ad da take tattaka hatsi.
english: You shall not muzzle the ox when he treads out the grain.

hausa: ’Ya’yan Ram maza ɗan farin Yerameyel su ne, Ma’az, Yamin da Eker.
english: The sons of Ram the firstborn of Jerahmeel were Maaz, Jamin, and Eker.

hausa: Har yanzu ina da tambaya. Sun yi tuntuɓe har ya kai ga fāɗuwar da ba za su iya tashi ba ne? Sam, ko kaɗan! A maimako, saboda laifinsu ne ceto ya zo ga Al’ummai don a sa mutanen Isra’ila su ji kishi.
english: I ask then, did they stumble that they might fall? May it never be! But by their fall salvation has come to the Gentiles, to provoke them to jealousy.

hausa: Sa’an nan na tuna da abin da Ubangiji ya ce, ‘Yohanna ya yi baftisma da ruwa, amma za a yi muku baftisma daRuhu Mai Tsarki.’
english: I remembered the word of the Lord, how he said, ‘John indeed baptized in water, but you will be baptized in the Holy Spirit.’

hausa: “Ku yi ƙarfin hali, ku yi hankali, ku yi biyayya da dukan abin da aka rubuta a cikin Littafin Dokoki na Musa, ba tare da kun juya hagu ko dama ba.
english: “Therefore be very courageous to keep and to do all that is written in the book of the law of Moses, that you not turn away from it to the right hand or to the left;

hausa: A maimakon haka za su kasance da babban fargabar hukunci da kuma ta ƙunar wuta wadda za tă cinye abokan gāban Allah.
english: but a certain fearful expectation of judgment, and a fierceness of fire which will devour the adversaries.

hausa: ya kuma kora dukan dabbobinsa, suka ja gabansa, tare da dukan abubuwan da ya samu a Faddan Aram, don su tafi wurin mahaifinsa Ishaku a ƙasar Kan’ana.
english: and he took away all his livestock, and all his possessions which he had gathered, including the livestock which he had gained in Paddan Aram, to go to Isaac his father, to the land of Canaan.

hausa: Sa’an nan ya tattara dukan Yahuda da Benyamin da kuma mutane daga Efraim, Manasse da Simeyon waɗanda suke zaune a cikinsu, gama jama’a mai girma ta zo wurinsa daga Isra’ila sa’ad da suka ga cewa Ubangiji Allahnsa yana tare da shi.
english: He gathered all Judah and Benjamin, and those who lived with them out of Ephraim, Manasseh, and Simeon; for they came to him out of Israel in abundance when they saw that Yahweh his God was with him.

hausa: A wannan rana, Isra’ilawa suka sha wahala ƙwarai domin Shawulu ya sa mutane suka yi rantsuwa cewa, “La’ananne ne mutumin da ya ci abinci kafin fāɗuwar rana, kafin in ɗauki fansa a kan abokan gābana.” Don haka ba mutumin da ya ɗanɗana abinci.
english: The men of Israel were distressed that day; for Saul had adjured the people, saying, “Cursed is the man who eats any food until it is evening, and I am avenged of my enemies.” So none of the people tasted food.

hausa: A ƙarshen kwana bakwai ɗin maganar Ubangiji ta zo mini cewa,
english: At the end of seven days, Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

hausa: A lokacin nan, in wani ya ce muku, ‘Duba, ga Kiristi nan!’ Ko kuwa, ‘Duba, ga shi can!’ Kada ku gaskata.
english: Then if anyone tells you, ‘Look, here is the Christ!’ or, ‘Look, there!’ don’t believe it.

hausa: Za a fyaɗa ’ya’yansu a ƙasa su yi kucu-kucu a idanunsu; za a washe gidajensu, a kuma kwana da matansu.
english: Their infants also will be dashed in pieces before their eyes. Their houses will be ransacked, and their wives raped.

hausa: Yahudawa suka karkashe dukan abokan gābansu da takobi, suka karkashe waɗanda suka ƙi jininsu, suka kuma hallaka su yadda suka ga dama.
english: The Jews struck all their enemies with the stroke of the sword, and with slaughter and destruction, and did what they wanted to those who hated them.

hausa: Bayan kwana shida, sai Yesu ya ɗauki Bitrus, Yaƙub da Yohanna ɗan’uwan Yaƙub, ya kai su kan wani dutse mai tsawo, su kaɗai.
english: After six days, Jesus took with him Peter, James, and John his brother, and brought them up into a high mountain by themselves.

hausa: Yanzu fa sai ku sa zuciyarku da ranku ga neman Ubangiji Allahnku. Ku fara ginin wuri mai tsarki na Ubangiji Allah, don ku kawo akwatin alkawarin Ubangiji da kayayyaki masu tsarki na Allah a cikin haikalin da za a gina saboda Sunan Ubangiji.”
english: Now set your heart and your soul to follow Yahweh your God. Arise therefore, and build the sanctuary of Yahweh God, to bring the ark of Yahweh’s covenant and the holy vessels of God into the house that is to be built for Yahweh’s name.”

hausa: cikin baƙin ciki, duk da haka kullum cikin murna muke. Cikin matalauta, duk da haka muna azurtar da mutane da yawa. Ba mu da kome, alhali kuwa kome namu ne.
english: as sorrowful yet always rejoicing, as poor yet making many rich, as having nothing and yet possessing all things.

hausa: sun roƙe mu sosai don su sami damar yin bayarwa a wannan hidima ga tsarkaka.
english: begging us with much entreaty to receive this grace and the fellowship in the service to the saints.

hausa: Gama in kin yi shiru a wannan lokaci, taimako da ceto zai zo daga wani wuri saboda Yahudawa, amma ke da gidanki za ku hallaka. Wa ya san ko saboda irin wannan lokaci ne kika sami wannan muƙami?”
english: For if you remain silent now, then relief and deliverance will come to the Jews from another place, but you and your father’s house will perish. Who knows if you haven’t come to the kingdom for such a time as this?”

hausa: ya daure ƙafafuna da sarƙa; yana tsaron duk inda na bi.’
english: He puts my feet in the stocks. He marks all my paths.’

hausa: Ba za a ƙara ce da wawa mai girma ba ko kuwa a ɗaukaka mazambaci.
english: The fool will no longer be called noble, nor the scoundrel be highly respected.

hausa: Sai mai gadinsu ya janye abinci da ruwan inabi irin na sarki, ya ci gaba da ba su kayan lambu.
english: So the steward took away their delicacies and the wine that they were given to drink, and gave them vegetables.

hausa: Ga maganar da ta zo wa Irmiya daga wurin Ubangiji.
