english: The word that came to Jeremiah from Yahweh, saying,

hausa: Kada yawancinku su so ɗaukan kansu a matsayin malamai, ’yan’uwana, domin kun san cewa mu da muke koyarwa za a yi mana shari’a mafi tsanani.
english: Let not many of you be teachers, my brothers, knowing that we will receive heavier judgment.

hausa: Sai Zadok firist, annabi Natan, Benahiya ɗan Yehohiyada, Keretawa, da Feletiyawa suka gangara, suka sa Solomon a kan dokin Sarki Dawuda, suka raka shi zuwa Gihon.
english: So Zadok the priest, Nathan the prophet, Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and the Cherethites and the Pelethites went down and had Solomon ride on King David’s mule, and brought him to Gihon.

hausa: “Saboda haka duk wanda yake jin kalmomin nan nawa yake kuma aikata su, yana kama da mutum mai hikima wanda ya gina gidansa a kan dutse.
english: “Everyone therefore who hears these words of mine and does them, I will liken him to a wise man who built his house on the rock.

hausa: Da Yesu ya ji haka, sai ya ce masa, “Akwai abu ɗaya har yanzu da ya rage maka. Ka sayar da duk abin da kake da shi, ka ba wa matalauta, sa’an nan za ka sami dukiya a sama. Bayan haka, ka zo ka bi ni.”
english: When Jesus heard these things, he said to him, “You still lack one thing. Sell all that you have and distribute it to the poor. Then you will have treasure in heaven; then come, follow me.”

hausa: Saboda haka sai ya faɗa mata kome ya ce, “Ba a taɓa sa reza a kaina ba, domin ni Naziri ne keɓaɓɓe ga Allah tun haihuwa. In kuwa an aske kaina, ƙarfina zai rabu da ni, sai in zama kamar kowa.”
english: He told her all his heart and said to her, “No razor has ever come on my head; for I have been a Nazirite to God from my mother’s womb. If I am shaved, then my strength will go from me and I will become weak, and be like any other man.”

hausa: ya bar garin ya tafi neman inda zai zauna. A hanyarsa ya zo gidan Mika a ƙasar tudu ta Efraim.
english: The man departed out of the city, out of Bethlehem Judah, to live where he could find a place, and he came to the hill country of Ephraim, to the house of Micah, as he traveled.

hausa: “ ‘Game da ku, tumakina, ga abin da Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka yana cewa zan hukunta tsakanin tunkiya da tunkiya, da tsakanin raguna da awaki.
english: “As for you, O my flock, the Lord Yahweh says: ‘Behold, I judge between sheep and sheep, the rams and the male goats.

hausa: Ka san dokokin da suka ce, ‘Kada ka yi zina, kada ka yi kisankai, kada ka yi sata, kada ka ba da shaida ta ƙarya, ka girmama mahaifinka da mahaifiyarka.’ ”
english: You know the commandments: ‘Don’t commit adultery,’ ‘Don’t murder,’ ‘Don’t steal,’ ‘Don’t give false testimony,’ ‘Honor your father and your mother.’”

hausa: domin kowace doguwar hasumiya da kowace katanga mai ƙarfi,
english: for every lofty tower, for every fortified wall,

hausa: Haka masu hidima a cikin ikkilisiya; su ma, su zama maza da sun cancanci girmamawa, masu gaskiya, ba masu yawan shan ruwan inabi ba, ba masu kwaɗayin ƙazamar riba ba.
english: Servants, in the same way, must be reverent, not double-tongued, not addicted to much wine, not greedy for money,

hausa: Saboda haka dattawan Mowab suka koma wurin Balak suka ce, “Bala’am ya ƙi yă zo tare da mu.”
english: The princes of Moab rose up, and they went to Balak, and said, “Balaam refuses to come with us.”

hausa: Na kuma san cewa wannan mutum, ko a cikin jiki ne, ko kuma ba a cikin jiki ba, ni dai ban sani ba, amma Allah ne ya sani,
english: I know such a man (whether in the body, or outside of the body, I don’t know; God knows),

hausa: Ko da yake ba ku taɓa ganinsa ba, kuna ƙaunarsa; kuma ko da yake ba kwa ganinsa yanzu, kun gaskata shi, kun kuma cika da farin ciki ƙwarai, wanda ya fi gaban faɗi,
english: whom, not having known, you love. In him, though now you don’t see him, yet believing, you rejoice greatly with joy that is unspeakable and full of glory,

hausa: kamar yadda gabas yake daga yamma, haka ya cire laifofinmu daga gare mu.
english: As far as the east is from the west, so far has he removed our transgressions from us.

hausa: Duk kuma wanda ya karɓi ƙaramin yaro kamar wannan a cikin sunana ya karɓe ni ne.
english: Whoever receives one such little child in my name receives me,

hausa: Suka ci suka sha da farin ciki mai girma a gaban Ubangiji a wannan rana. Sa’an nan suka yarda da Solomon ɗan Dawuda a matsayin sarki sau na biyu, suka shafe shi a gaban Ubangiji don yă zama mai mulki, Zadok kuwa ya zama firist.
english: and ate and drank before Yahweh on that day with great gladness. They made Solomon the son of David king the second time, and anointed him before Yahweh to be prince, and Zadok to be priest.

hausa: Suka zo wurin Filibus, wanda yake daga Betsaida ta Galili, da roƙo. Suka ce, “Ranka yă daɗe, muna so mu ga Yesu.”
english: Therefore, these came to Philip, who was from Bethsaida of Galilee, and asked him, saying, “Sir, we want to see Jesus.”

hausa: Abin da za su iya yi miki ke nan kawai, waɗannan da kika yi ta fama da su kika kuma yi ciniki da su tun kina jaririya. Kowannensu zai tafi cikin kuskurensa; babu ko ɗayan da zai cece ki.
english: The things that you labored in will be like this: those who have trafficked with you from your youth will each wander in his own way. There will be no one to save you.

hausa: In ba haka ba, to, me kuka je kallo? Mutum mai sanye da riguna masu kyau ne? A’a, masu sa riguna masu kyau, ai, a fadan sarakuna suke.
english: But what did you go out to see? A man in soft clothing? Behold, those who wear soft clothing are in kings’ houses.

hausa: Saboda haka, zuciyata na farin ciki, harshena kuma na murna, jikina kuma zai kasance da bege,
english: Therefore my heart was glad, and my tongue rejoiced. Moreover my flesh also will dwell in hope,

hausa: ko kuma in ya roƙi ƙwai, ya ba shi kunama?
english: Or if he asks for an egg, he won’t give him a scorpion, will he?

hausa: Mun zama masu wauta saboda Kiristi, ku kuwa kuna da hikima sosai a cikin Kiristi! Ba mu da ƙarfi, amma ku kuna da ƙarfi! Ana girmama ku, mu kuwa ana ƙasƙantar da mu!
english: We are fools for Christ’s sake, but you are wise in Christ. We are weak, but you are strong. You have honor, but we have dishonor.

hausa: Saboda haka suka keɓe Kedesh a Galili a ƙasar kan tudu ta Naftali, Shekem a ƙasar kan tudu ta Efraim, da Kiriyat Arba (wato, Hebron) a ƙasar kan tudu ta Yahuda.
english: They set apart Kedesh in Galilee in the hill country of Naphtali, Shechem in the hill country of Ephraim, and Kiriath Arba (also called Hebron) in the hill country of Judah.

hausa: Nan take ta fāɗi a ƙafafunsa ta mutu. Sai samarin suka shigo ciki, suka kuwa same ta matacciya, suka ɗauke ta suka kai ta waje suka binne ta kusa da mijinta.
english: She fell down immediately at his feet and died. The young men came in and found her dead, and they carried her out and buried her by her husband.

hausa: Farillanka daidai ne har abada; ka ba ni ganewa don in rayu.
english: Your testimonies are righteous forever. Give me understanding, that I may live. QOPH

hausa: Wace amsa ce za a bayar wa jakadun wannan al’umma? “Ubangiji ya kafa Sihiyona, kuma a cikinta mutanensa masu shan azaba za su sami mafaka.”
english: What will they answer the messengers of the nation? That Yahweh has founded Zion, and in her the afflicted of his people will take refuge.

hausa: Zai kai Zedekiya Babilon, inda zai zauna har sai ya magance shi, in ji Ubangiji. In ka yi yaƙi da Babiloniyawa, ba za ka yi nasara ba.’ ”
english: and he will bring Zedekiah to Babylon, and he will be there until I visit him,” says Yahweh, “though you fight with the Chaldeans, you will not prosper”’?”

hausa: Kafin kwana ta bakwai, Allah ya gama aikin da yake yi, saboda haka a kwana ta bakwai, ya huta daga dukan aikinsa.
english: On the seventh day God finished his work which he had done; and he rested on the seventh day from all his work which he had done.

hausa: Ya’areshiya, Iliya da Zikri su ne ’ya’yan Yeroham maza.
english: Jaareshiah, Elijah, Zichri, and the sons of Jeroham.

hausa: Sai ya ce wa ’ya’yansa, “Ku yi wa jakina shimfiɗa.” Da suka yi wa jakin shimfiɗa, sai ya hau.
english: He said to his sons, “Saddle the donkey for me.” So they saddled the donkey for him; and he rode on it.

hausa: Sai ya sāke aiken waɗansu bayi wurinsu, fiye da na dā yawa, amma ’yan hayan suka yi musu kamar yadda suka yi wa na farin.
english: Again, he sent other servants more than the first; and they treated them the same way.

hausa: me zan yi lokacin da Allah ya tuhume ni? Me zan ce lokacin da ya tambaye ni?
english: what then will I do when God rises up? When he visits, what will I answer him?

hausa: Na sa hannu a takarda, na buga hatimi na liƙe, na sami shaidu na kuwa auna shekel a ma’auni.
english: I signed the deed, sealed it, called witnesses, and weighed the money in the balances to him.

hausa: Amma Ɗansa ya zama mutum ya kuma mutu. Saboda haka Allah ya yi sulhu da ku, yanzu kuwa ya bar ku ku tsaya a gabansa da tsarki, marasa aibi, da kuma marasa abin zargi.
english: yet now he has reconciled in the body of his flesh through death, to present you holy and without defect and blameless before him,

hausa: Cikin riguna masu ado aka kai ta wurin sarki; abokanta budurwai suna biye da ita aka kuwa kawo su gare ka.
english: She shall be led to the king in embroidered work. The virgins, her companions who follow her, shall be brought to you.

hausa: To, fa, Filistiyawa suka yi yaƙi da Isra’ilawa; Isra’ilawa kuwa suka gudu a gabansu, da yawa kuma suka mutu a kan Dutsen Gilbowa.
english: Now the Philistines fought against Israel; and the men of Israel fled from before the Philistines, and fell down slain on Mount Gilboa.

hausa: Bayan ya faɗa haka, sai ya nuna musu hannuwansa da gefensa. Sai almajiran suka yi farin ciki ƙwarai da suka ga Ubangiji.
english: When he had said this, he showed them his hands and his side. The disciples therefore were glad when they saw the Lord.

hausa: Sa’an nan ya ba da dunƙulen burodi da wainar dabino da kuma kauɗar zabibi ga kowane mutumin Isra’ila namiji da ta mace.
english: He gave to everyone of Israel, both man and woman, to everyone a loaf of bread, a portion of meat, and a cake of raisins.

hausa: Amma yanzu ba zan yi da waɗanda raguwar mutane yadda na yi da na dā ba,” in ji Ubangiji Maɗaukaki.
english: But now I will not be to the remnant of this people as in the former days,” says Yahweh of Armies.

hausa: “Amma ba su kula ba, suka kama gabansu, ɗaya ya tafi gonarsa, ɗaya kuma ya tafi kasuwancinsa.
english: But they made light of it, and went their ways, one to his own farm, another to his merchandise;

hausa: Shugabannin da suke bisa kabilan Isra’ila, bisa mutanen Ruben su ne, Eliyezer ɗan Zikri; bisa mutanen Simeyon shi ne, Shefatiya ɗan Ma’aka
english: Furthermore over the tribes of Israel: of the Reubenites, Eliezer the son of Zichri was the ruler; of the Simeonites, Shephatiah the son of Maacah;

hausa: Bayan an gargaɗe su cikin mafarki kada su koma wurin Hiridus, sai suka koma ƙasarsu ta wata hanya dabam.
english: Being warned in a dream not to return to Herod, they went back to their own country another way.

hausa: Saboda haka Iliya ya tafi ya gabatar da kansa ga Ahab. Yanzu dai yunwa ta tsananta a Samariya,
english: Elijah went to show himself to Ahab. The famine was severe in Samaria.

hausa: Dare da rana suna yawo a kan katanga; mugun hali da zargi suna a cikinta.
english: Day and night they prowl around on its walls. Malice and abuse are also within her.

hausa: Yesu ya amsa ya ce, “In na faɗi abin da ba daidai ba, ka nuna abin da ba daidai ba. Amma in gaskiya na faɗa, don me ka mare ni?”
english: Jesus answered him, “If I have spoken evil, testify of the evil; but if well, why do you beat me?”

hausa: Mutum mai basira kan kafa idonsa a kan hikima, amma idanun wawa suna a kan ƙarshen duniya.
english: Wisdom is before the face of one who has understanding, but the eyes of a fool wander to the ends of the earth.

hausa: Ka shirya mini irin abinci mai daɗin da nake so, ka kawo mini in ci, domin in sa maka albarka kafin in mutu.”
english: Make me savory food, such as I love, and bring it to me, that I may eat, and that my soul may bless you before I die.”

hausa: Muka iso Urushalima, inda muka huta kwana uku.
english: We came to Jerusalem, and stayed there three days.

hausa: Sa’an nan Ubangiji ya yi wa Ayuba magana ta cikin guguwa,
english: Then Yahweh answered Job out of the whirlwind:

hausa: ’Yan aikan, a kan dawakan fada, suka fita a guje, umarnin sarki yana iza su. Aka kuma ba da dokar a mazaunin masarauta wadda take Shusha.
english: So the couriers who rode on royal horses went out, hastened and pressed on by the king’s commandment. The decree was given out in the citadel of Susa.

hausa: Ku ba shi kyautai hannu sake daga tumakinku, daga masussukarku, da kuma daga wurin matsewar inabinku. Ku ba shi yadda Ubangiji Allahnku ya albarkace ku.
english: You shall furnish him liberally out of your flock, out of your threshing floor, and out of your wine press. As Yahweh your God has blessed you, you shall give to him.

hausa: Sa’an nan dukan dattawan garin da yake kurkusa da gawar za su wanke hannuwansu a bisa karsanan da aka karye wuyar a kwarin,
english: All the elders of that city which is nearest to the slain man shall wash their hands over the heifer whose neck was broken in the valley.

hausa: “Za ka iya farauto wa zakanya nama, ka kuma kawar wa zakoki yunwarsu.
english: “Can you hunt the prey for the lioness, or satisfy the appetite of the young lions,

hausa: “Amma mun tumɓuke su, mun hallaka garuruwan Heshbon har zuwa Dibon. Mun ragargaza su har zuwa Nofa wanda ya miƙe zuwa Medeba.”
english: We have shot at them. Heshbon has perished even to Dibon. We have laid waste even to Nophah, Which reaches to Medeba.”

hausa: Kamar yadda ya saba, Bulus ya shiga majami’ar, ranakun Asabbaci uku ya yi ta yin muhawwara da su daga cikin Nassosi,
english: Paul, as was his custom, went in to them; and for three Sabbath days reasoned with them from the Scriptures,

hausa: Ubangiji yana mulki har abada; ya kafa kujerarsa don shari’a.
english: But Yahweh reigns forever. He has prepared his throne for judgment.

hausa: To, Dina, ’yar da Liyatu ta haifa wa Yaƙub, ta je ta ziyarci matan ƙasar.
english: Dinah, the daughter of Leah, whom she bore to Jacob, went out to see the daughters of the land.

hausa: Sa’ad da Yesu ya gama faɗin waɗannan abubuwa, sai taron mutanen suka yi mamakin koyarwarsa,
english: When Jesus had finished saying these things, the multitudes were astonished at his teaching,

hausa: Bayan an yi musu bulala sosai, sai aka jefa su cikin kurkuku, aka umarci mai gadin kurkukun yă tsare su da kyau.
english: When they had laid many stripes on them, they threw them into prison, charging the jailer to keep them safely.

hausa: Mutum dubu goma sha takwas na mutanen Benyamin suka mutu dukansu kuwa jarumai ne.
english: Eighteen thousand men of Benjamin fell; all these were men of valor.

hausa: Kin saci zuciyata, ’yar’uwata, amaryata; kin saci zuciyata da hararar idanunki, da dutse mai daraja guda na abin wuyanki.
english: You have ravished my heart, my sister, my bride. You have ravished my heart with one of your eyes, with one chain of your neck.

hausa: Gama Nassi ya ce, “Kada ka sa wa bijimi takunkumi yayinda yake sussukar hatsi,” da kuma, “Ma’aikaci ya cancanci hakkinsa.”
english: For the Scripture says, “You shall not muzzle the ox when it treads out the grain.” And, “The laborer is worthy of his wages.”

hausa: Saboda haka, ko da yake cikin Kiristi ina iya yin ƙarfin hali in umarce ka ka yi abin da ya kamata,
english: Therefore though I have all boldness in Christ to command you that which is appropriate,

hausa: Sama’ila ya ce, “Don me kake tambayata bayan Ubangiji ya rabu da kai? Ya zama maƙiyinka?
english: Samuel said, “Why then do you ask me, since Yahweh has departed from you and has become your adversary?

hausa: Amma ni, ta wurin jinƙanka mai girma, zan shiga gidanka; da bangirma zan durƙusa ga haikalinka.
english: But as for me, in the abundance of your loving kindness I will come into your house. I will bow toward your holy temple in reverence of you.

hausa: Ku yi godiya ga Ubangiji, ku yi shelar sunansa; ku sanar a cikin al’ummai abin da ya yi.
english: Oh give thanks to Yahweh. Call on his name. Make what he has done known among the peoples.

hausa: Na kwanta na yi barci; na kuma farka, gama Ubangiji yana kiyaye ni.
english: I laid myself down and slept. I awakened, for Yahweh sustains me.

hausa: Zauna tare da shi na ɗan lokaci sai ɗan’uwanka ya huce.
english: Stay with him a few days, until your brother’s fury turns away—

hausa: ko mai karyayyen ƙafa, ko mai karyayyen hannu,
english: or a man who has an injured foot, or an injured hand,

hausa: Da ɗayansu ya ga ya warke, sai ya koma, yana yabon Allah da babbar murya.
english: One of them, when he saw that he was healed, turned back, glorifying God with a loud voice.

hausa: Domin ƙishirwa harshen jarirai ya manne a rufin bakinsu; yaran suna roƙo a ba su burodi, amma ba wanda ya ba su.
english: The tongue of the nursing child clings to the roof of his mouth for thirst. The young children ask for bread, and no one breaks it for them.

hausa: Bulus, bawan Allah da kuma manzon Yesu Kiristi saboda bangaskiyar zaɓaɓɓu na Allah da kuma sanin gaskiya wadda take kaiwa ga rayuwa ta tsoron Allah
english: Paul, a servant of God and an apostle of Jesus Christ, according to the faith of God’s chosen ones and the knowledge of the truth which is according to godliness,

hausa: Duk da haka bai kashe ’ya’yansu maza ba amma ya yi bisa ga abin da yake a rubuce a cikin Doka, a cikin Littafin Musa, inda Ubangiji ya umarta, “Ba za a kashe iyaye saboda ’ya’yansu ba; ba kuwa za a kashe ’ya’ya saboda iyayensu ba; kowa zai mutu saboda zunubansa ne.”
english: But he didn’t put their children to death, but did according to that which is written in the law in the book of Moses, as Yahweh commanded, saying, “The fathers shall not die for the children, neither shall the children die for the fathers; but every man shall die for his own sin.”

hausa: sai Abimelek ya ce wa Ibrahim, “Mene ne ma’anar ’yan raguna bakwai da ka keɓe?”
english: Abimelech said to Abraham, “What do these seven ewe lambs, which you have set by themselves, mean?”

hausa: ga karuwanci, ga tsoho da kuma sabon ruwan inabi, waɗanda suka ɗauke ganewar mutanena.
english: Prostitution, wine, and new wine take away understanding.

hausa: Kakan tsawata ka kuma hore mutane saboda zunubinsu; kakan cinye wadatarsu kamar yadda asu ke yi, kowane mutum dai shaƙar iska ne. Sela
english: When you rebuke and correct man for iniquity, you consume his wealth like a moth. Surely every man is but a breath.” Selah.

hausa: Saboda irin matsayin da ya ba shi, dukan mutane da al’ummai da kuma dukan harsuna suka ji tsoronsa suka yi rawar jiki a gabansa. Bisa ga ganin damarsa yakan kashe wani, ya bar wani da rai, haka kuma yakan ɗaukaka wani, ya ƙasƙantar da wani.
english: Because of the greatness that he gave him, all the peoples, nations, and languages trembled and feared before him. He killed whom he wanted to, and he kept alive whom he wanted to. He raised up whom he wanted to, and he put down whom he wanted to.

hausa: Dukan hanyoyin Ubangiji ƙaunatattu ne da kuma aminci ga waɗanda suke kiyaye abin da alkawari ya bukaci.
english: All the paths of Yahweh are loving kindness and truth to such as keep his covenant and his testimonies.

hausa: Nebukadnezzar sarkin Babilon ya zaɓi Gedaliya ɗan Ahikam, ɗan Shafan yă zama shugaban sauran mutanen da suka rage a Yahuda.
english: As for the people who were left in the land of Judah whom Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon had left, even over them he made Gedaliah the son of Ahikam, the son of Shaphan, governor.

hausa: Gaskiya nake gaya muku, wannan zamani ba zai shuɗe ba sai dukan abubuwan nan sun faru.
english: Most certainly I tell you, this generation will not pass away until all these things are accomplished.

hausa: Ka yi hankali kada wani yă ruɗe ka da arziki; kada ka bar toshiya ta sa ka juya.
english: Don’t let riches entice you to wrath, neither let the great size of a bribe turn you aside.

hausa: mu ne masu ɗaukaka Ubangiji, yanzu da har abada kuma. Yabi Ubangiji.
english: but we will bless Yah, from this time forward and forever more. Praise Yah!

hausa: Za tă zama kayan ado da za su inganta kanka tă kuma zamar maka rawanin ɗaukaka.”
english: She will give to your head a garland of grace. She will deliver a crown of splendor to you.”

hausa: Suka tambaye, shi suka ce, “Da wane iko kake yin waɗannan abubuwa? Wa kuma ya ba ka ikon yin wannan?”
english: and they began saying to him, “By what authority do you do these things? Or who gave you this authority to do these things?”

hausa: A ranan nan kowa zai faɗa wa ɗanka, ‘Ina yin haka saboda abin da Ubangiji ya yi mini, sa’ad da na fita daga Masar.’
english: You shall tell your son in that day, saying, ‘It is because of that which Yahweh did for me when I came out of Egypt.’

hausa: To, muna roƙonku, ’yan’uwa, ku girmama waɗanda suke aiki sosai a cikinku, waɗanda suke bisanku cikin Ubangiji da kuma waɗanda suke yin muku gargaɗi.
english: But we beg you, brothers, to know those who labor among you, and are over you in the Lord and admonish you,

hausa: Ya zo wurin Yesu da dad dare ya ce, “Rabbi, mun sani kai malami ne daga Allah. Gama ba wanda zai iya yin waɗannan abubuwan banmamaki da kake yi in Allah ba ya tare da shi.”
english: He came to Jesus by night and said to him, “Rabbi, we know that you are a teacher who has come from God, for no one can do these signs that you do, unless God is with him.”

hausa: Amma yanzu kana faɗa mini in tafi wurin mai girma in ce, ‘Iliya yana a nan.’
english: Now you say, ‘Go, tell your lord, “Behold, Elijah is here.”’

hausa: Bayan aka yi muhawwara da sosai, sai Bitrus ya miƙe tsaye ya yi musu jawabi ya ce, “’Yan’uwa, kun san cewa a kwanakin baya Allah ya yi zaɓe a cikinku don Al’ummai su ji daga leɓunana saƙon bishara su kuma gaskata.
english: When there had been much discussion, Peter rose up and said to them, “Brothers, you know that a good while ago God made a choice among you that by my mouth the nations should hear the word of the Good News and believe.

hausa: Ku zo mu kashe shi mu kuma jefa shi a ɗaya daga cikin rijiyoyin nan, mu ce mugun naman jeji ya cinye shi. Mu ga yadda mafarkinsa zai cika.”
english: Come now therefore, and let’s kill him, and cast him into one of the pits, and we will say, ‘An evil animal has devoured him.’ We will see what will become of his dreams.”

hausa: Yarinyar kuwa kyakkyawa ce ƙwarai; ta kuwa lura da sarki, ta kuma yi masa hidima, amma sarki bai yi jima’i da ita ba.
english: The young lady was very beautiful; and she cherished the king, and served him; but the king didn’t know her intimately.

hausa: Zai kiyaye ƙafafun masu tsarki, amma mugaye za su lalace cikin duhu. “Ba bisa ga ƙarfi mutum ba ne mutum ke nasara;
english: He will keep the feet of his holy ones, but the wicked will be put to silence in darkness; for no man will prevail by strength.

hausa: Waɗannan su ne kabilan Asher; jimillarsu ta kai 53,400.
english: These are the families of the sons of Asher according to those who were counted of them, fifty-three thousand four hundred.

hausa: ga almajirin kuwa ya ce, “Ga mahaifiyarka.” Tun daga wannan lokaci fa almajirin nan ya kai ta gidansa.
english: Then he said to the disciple, “Behold, your mother!” From that hour, the disciple took her to his own home.

hausa: Ta wurin miƙa masa sashi mafi kyau, ba za ku zama masu laifi a wannan batu ba; ta haka ba za ku ƙazantar da tsarkakakkun hadayu na Isra’ilawa ba, ba kuwa za ku mutu ba.’ ”
english: You shall bear no sin by reason of it, when you have heaved from it its best. You shall not profane the holy things of the children of Israel, that you not die.’”

hausa: Dukan al’umman da suka san ka sun giggice saboda masifar da ta auko maka; ka zo ga mummunar ƙarshe ba za ka ƙara kasancewa ba har abada.’ ”
english: All those who know you among the peoples will be astonished at you. You have become a terror, and you will exist no more.”’”

hausa: Amma bisa ga labari na bishiya nan, mai cin wuta da Musa ya gani a jeji, ko Musa ma, ya nuna cewa, matattu suna tashi. Gama ya kira Ubangiji, ‘Allah na Ibrahim, da Allah na Ishaku, da kuma Allah na Yaƙub.’
english: But that the dead are raised, even Moses showed at the bush, when he called the Lord ‘The God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob.’

hausa: Sau ɗaya a shekara, Haruna zai yi kafara a bisa ƙahoninsa. Dole a yi wannan kafara ta shekara-shekara da jinin kafara ta hadaya don zunubi daga tsara zuwa tsara. Gama bagaden mafi tsarki ne ga Ubangiji.”
english: Aaron shall make atonement on its horns once in the year; with the blood of the sin offering of atonement once in the year he shall make atonement for it throughout your generations. It is most holy to Yahweh.”

hausa: Kullum muna gode wa Allah, Uban Ubangijinmu Yesu Kiristi, sa’ad da muke addu’a dominku.
english: We give thanks to God the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, praying always for you,

hausa: Kowace rana akan shirya mini saniya ɗaya, zaɓaɓɓun tumaki shida da waɗansu kaji, kuma kowace kwana goma akan tanadar da ruwan inabi na kowane iri a yalwace. Duk da haka, ban taɓa nemi a ba ni abincin da akan ba wa gwamna ba, domin wahala ta yi wa jama’a yawa.
english: Now that which was prepared for one day was one ox and six choice sheep. Also fowls were prepared for me, and once in ten days a store of all sorts of wine. Yet for all this, I didn’t demand the governor’s pay, because the bondage was heavy on this people.

hausa: Sa’an nan sarkin arewa zai zo ya gina mahaurai a jikin katagar birni don yă ci birnin da yaƙi. Sojojin nan na Kudu kuwa ba za su iya tsayawa ba, ko zaɓaɓɓun jarumawansu ma, gama za su rasa ƙarfin tsayawa.
english: So the king of the north will come and cast up a mound, and take a well-fortified city. The forces of the south won’t stand, neither will his select troops, neither will there be any strength to stand.

hausa: Amma ina da baftismar da za a yi mini, na kuwa damu sosai, sai na kammala ta!
english: But I have a baptism to be baptized with, and how distressed I am until it is accomplished!

hausa: “Zan kori sojojin arewa nesa da ku, in tura su cikin busasshiyar ƙasa marar amfani kuma, kuma da sawunsu na gaba zan tura su zuwa gabashin teku da kuma sawunsu na baya tura su zuwa yammanci a Bahar Rum. Warinsu kuma zai bazu; ɗoyinsu zai tashi.” Tabbatacce ya yi al’amura masu girma.
english: But I will remove the northern army far away from you, and will drive it into a barren and desolate land, its front into the eastern sea, and its back into the western sea; and its stench will come up, and its bad smell will rise.” Surely he has done great things.

hausa: Suna miƙa hadayun da aka ba ni su kuma ci nama, amma Ubangiji ba ya jin daɗinsu. Yanzu zai tuna da muguntarsu yă kuma hukunta zunubansu. Za su koma Masar.
english: As for the sacrifices of my offerings, they sacrifice meat and eat it, but Yahweh doesn’t accept them. Now he will remember their iniquity, and punish their sins. They will return to Egypt.

hausa: ku duwatsu da dukan tuddai, itatuwa masu ’ya’ya da dukan al’ul,
english: mountains and all hills, fruit trees and all cedars,

hausa: A wannan taƙamata ba na magana yadda Ubangiji zai yi ba ne, sai dai magana ce irin ta wawa.
english: That which I speak, I don’t speak according to the Lord, but as in foolishness, in this confidence of boasting.

hausa: Suka tashi daga Sukkot, suka yi sansani a Etam, a gefen hamada.
english: They traveled from Succoth, and encamped in Etham, which is in the edge of the wilderness.

hausa: Suna dab da ƙarshen gari, sai Sama’ila ya ce wa Shawulu, “Ka ce wa bawanka yă yi gaba, kai ka ɗan dakata a nan tukuna, domin in ba ka saƙo daga Allah.”
english: As they were going down at the end of the city, Samuel said to Saul, “Tell the servant to go on ahead of us.” He went ahead, then Samuel said, “But stand still first, that I may cause you to hear God’s message.”

hausa: Duk wanda ya sami mace ya sami abu mai kyau ya kuma sami tagomashi daga Ubangiji.
english: Whoever finds a wife finds a good thing, and obtains favor of Yahweh.

hausa: Sa’an nan Solomon ya tafi Eziyon Geber da Elot a bakin tekun Edom.
english: Then Solomon went to Ezion Geber and to Eloth, on the seashore in the land of Edom.

hausa: Sun ce mini, ‘Ka yi mana alloli waɗanda za su yi mana jagora, game da wannan Musa dai, wanda ya fito da mu daga Masar, ba mu san abin da ya faru da shi ba.’
english: For they said to me, ‘Make us gods, which shall go before us. As for this Moses, the man who brought us up out of the land of Egypt, we don’t know what has become of him.’

hausa: Amma da yake mu na rana ne, bari mu zama masu kamunkai, sanye da bangaskiya da ƙauna kamar sulke, begen cetonmu kuma kamar hular kwano.
english: But since we belong to the day, let’s be sober, putting on the breastplate of faith and love, and for a helmet, the hope of salvation.

hausa: Dawuda ya bar kayansa a wajen wani mai lura da kaya, sai ya ruga zuwa bakin dāgā yă gai da ’yan’uwansa.
english: David left his baggage in the hand of the keeper of the baggage and ran to the army, and came and greeted his brothers.

hausa: Cikin damuwarku kun yi kira na kuwa kuɓutar da ku, na amsa muku daga girgijen tsawa; na gwada ku a ruwan Meriba. Sela
english: You called in trouble, and I delivered you. I answered you in the secret place of thunder. I tested you at the waters of Meribah.” Selah.

hausa: Ka ciyar da su da burodin hawaye; ka sa suka sha hawaye ta cikakken kwaf.
english: You have fed them with the bread of tears, and given them tears to drink in large measure.

hausa: Ana yi wa itatuwan Ubangiji banruwa sosai, al’ul na Lebanon da ya shuka.
english: Yahweh’s trees are well watered, the cedars of Lebanon, which he has planted,

hausa: “Bayan Haruna da ’ya’yansa suka gama rufe kayayyaki masu tsarki da dukan abubuwa masu tsarki, sa’ad da kuma aka shirya tashi daga sansani, sai Kohatawa su zo gaba, su ɗauka. Amma kada su taɓa abubuwa masu tsarki, don kada su mutu. Kohatawa za su ɗauki abubuwan da suke cikin Tentin Sujada.
english: “When Aaron and his sons have finished covering the sanctuary and all the furniture of the sanctuary, as the camp moves forward; after that, the sons of Kohath shall come to carry it; but they shall not touch the sanctuary, lest they die. The sons of Kohath shall carry these things belonging to the Tent of Meeting.

hausa: To, sa’ad da na tafi Toruwas don in yi wa’azin bisharar Kiristi, ko da yake na tarar cewa Ubangiji ya buɗe mini ƙofa,
english: Now when I came to Troas for the Good News of Christ, and when a door was opened to me in the Lord,

hausa: Game da sauran ayyukan mulkin Yehoyahaz, dukan abubuwan da ya yi da kuma nasarorinsa, duk a rubuce suke a cikin littafin tarihin sarakunan Isra’ila.
english: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoahaz, and all that he did, and his might, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

hausa: su biyun kuma za su zama jiki ɗaya.’Saboda haka, su ba mutum biyu ba ne, amma mutum ɗaya.
english: and the two will become one flesh, so that they are no longer two, but one flesh.

hausa: Sa’an nan ka gaya wa Fir’auna, ‘Ga abin da Ubangiji ya ce; Isra’ila shi ne ɗan farina,
english: You shall tell Pharaoh, ‘Yahweh says, Israel is my son, my firstborn,

hausa: Kada ka sa ta zama kamar haifaffen mataccen jariri daga cikin mahaifiya wanda rabin jikin ruɓaɓɓe ne.”
english: Let her not, I pray, be as one dead, of whom the flesh is half consumed when he comes out of his mother’s womb.”

hausa: Na sāke yin tunani, “Game da mutane kam, Allah kan gwada su don su san cewa ba su fi dabba ba.
english: I said in my heart, “As for the sons of men, God tests them, so that they may see that they themselves are like animals.

hausa: Sai ya ce, “Ku kawo mini hadaya ta ƙonawa da hadaya ta salama.” Sai Shawulu ya miƙa hadaya ta ƙonawa.
english: Saul said, “Bring the burnt offering to me here, and the peace offerings.” He offered the burnt offering.

hausa: “A ranan nan, zan kawar da sunayen gumaka daga ƙasar, ba kuwa za a ƙara tunawa da su ba,” in ji Ubangiji Maɗaukaki. “Zan kawar da annabawa da kuma ruhu marar tsabta daga ƙasar.
english: It will come to pass in that day, says Yahweh of Armies, that I will cut off the names of the idols out of the land, and they will be remembered no more. I will also cause the prophets and the spirit of impurity to pass out of the land.

hausa: Suka kama hanya, a wannan lokaci, bisa umarnin Ubangiji, ta wurin Musa.
english: They first went forward according to the commandment of Yahweh by Moses.

hausa: Yayinda mutane suke dawowa gida bayan da Dawuda ya kashe Bafilistin, mata suka fito daga dukan biranen Isra’ila don su sadu da Sarki Shawulu, suna waƙoƙi da raye-raye masu farin ciki, da ganguna da sarewa.
english: As they came, when David returned from the slaughter of the Philistine, the women came out of all the cities of Israel, singing and dancing, to meet King Saul with tambourines, with joy, and with instruments of music.

hausa: Gama na umarce ku a yau, ku ƙaunaci Ubangiji Allahnku, don ku yi tafiya a hanyoyinsa, ku kuma kiyaye umarnansa, ƙa’idodinsa da kuma dokokinsa, sa’an nan za ku rayu, ku kuma ƙaru, Ubangiji Allahnku kuwa zai albarkace ku a ƙasar da kuke shiga don ci gādonta.
english: For I command you today to love Yahweh your God, to walk in his ways and to keep his commandments, his statutes, and his ordinances, that you may live and multiply, and that Yahweh your God may bless you in the land where you go in to possess it.

hausa: (waɗanda su ne masu ƙasar kafin baƙi su shigo ƙasar).
english: to whom alone the land was given, and no stranger passed among them):

hausa: ba za su kuma mai da hankalinsu ga tatsuniyoyin Yahudawa ko ga umarnan waɗanda suke ƙin gaskiya ba.
english: not paying attention to Jewish fables and commandments of men who turn away from the truth.

hausa: ’Yan’uwa, abin da nake nufi shi ne, lokaci ya rage kaɗan. Daga yanzu, waɗanda suke da mata ya kamata su yi rayuwa kamar ba su da su;
english: But I say this, brothers: the time is short. From now on, both those who have wives may be as though they had none;

hausa: Sarki kansa ne kaɗai zai zauna a hanyar shiga don yă ci a gaban Ubangiji. Zai shiga ta hanyar shirayin hanyar shiga yă kuma fita a wannan hanya.”
english: As for the prince, he shall sit in it as prince to eat bread before Yahweh. He shall enter by the way of the porch of the gate, and shall go out the same way.”

hausa: A maimako haka, na ba wa Lawiyawa zakka da Isra’ilawa suka kawo domin hadaya ga Ubangiji, a matsayin gādonsu. Shi ya sa na ce game da su, ‘Ba su da gādo a cikin Isra’ilawa.’ ”
english: For the tithe of the children of Israel, which they offer as a wave offering to Yahweh, I have given to the Levites for an inheritance. Therefore I have said to them, ‘Among the children of Israel they shall have no inheritance.’”

hausa: Bala’am ya tashi da safe, ya ɗaura wa jakarsa sirdi, ya tafi tare da dattawan Mowab.
english: Balaam rose up in the morning, and saddled his donkey, and went with the princes of Moab.

hausa: Sa’ad da ka aika da Ruhunka, sai su halittu, su kuma sabunta fuskar duniya.
english: You send out your Spirit and they are created. You renew the face of the ground.

hausa: Na wanke hannuwana cikin rashin laifi, ina yawo a bagadenka Ya Ubangiji,
english: I will wash my hands in innocence, so I will go about your altar, Yahweh,

hausa: Tana da ciki ta kuma yi kuka mai zafi yayinda take gab da haihuwa.
english: She was with child. She cried out in pain, laboring to give birth.

hausa: Ka kewaye ni, gaba da baya; ka sa hannunka a kaina.
english: You hem me in behind and before. You laid your hand on me.

hausa: “Ranka yă daɗe, ka saurare mu. Kai babban yerima ne a cikinmu. Ka binne mataccenka a kabari mafi kyau na kaburburanmu. Babu waninmu da zai hana ka kabarinsa don binne mataccenka.”
english: “Hear us, my lord. You are a prince of God among us. Bury your dead in the best of our tombs. None of us will withhold from you his tomb. Bury your dead.”

hausa: Ko wawa in bai buɗe bakinsa ba, za a zaci shi mai hikima ne, da kuma mai basira inda ya ƙame bakinsa.
english: Even a fool, when he keeps silent, is counted wise. When he shuts his lips, he is thought to be discerning.

hausa: “Ku ji, ya mutanena, zan kuwa yi magana, Ya Isra’ila, zan kuwa ba da shaida a kanku. Ni ne Allah, Allahnku.
english: “Hear, my people, and I will speak. Israel, I will testify against you. I am God, your God.

hausa: Gama lokaci yana zuwa da za ku ce, ‘Masu albarka ne bakararru, wato, mata marasa haihuwa, da mahaihuwar da ba su taɓa haihuwa ba, da kuma mama da ba su taɓa shayar da nono ba!’
english: For behold, the days are coming in which they will say, ‘Blessed are the barren, the wombs that never bore, and the breasts that never nursed.’

hausa: Rai ya fi abinci, jiki kuma ya fi tufafi.
english: Life is more than food, and the body is more than clothing.

hausa: Na gaji da kira ina neman taimako; maƙogwarona ya bushe idanuna sun dushe, suna neman Allahna.
english: I am weary with my crying. My throat is dry. My eyes fail looking for my God.

hausa: “Ya ɗaura zunubaina a wuyana; aka naɗe su a hannuwansa. Aka rataye su a wuyana Ubangiji ya kwashe ƙarfina. Ya bashe ni ga waɗanda suka fi ni ƙarfi.
english: “The yoke of my transgressions is bound by his hand. They are knit together. They have come up on my neck. He made my strength fail. The Lord has delivered me into their hands, against whom I am not able to stand.

hausa: Ba zan hukunta su saboda wannan ba?” In ji Ubangiji. “Bai kamata in yi ramuwa a kan irin al’ummar nan ba?
english: Shouldn’t I punish them for these things?” says Yahweh. “Shouldn’t my soul be avenged on such a nation as this?

hausa: na amsa na ce wa sarki, “Ran sarki yă daɗe! Me zai hana fuskata ta ɓaci, sa’ad da birnin da aka binne kakannina tana zaman kango, aka kuma rushe ƙofofinsa da wuta?”
english: I said to the king, “Let the king live forever! Why shouldn’t my face be sad, when the city, the place of my fathers’ tombs, lies waste, and its gates have been consumed with fire?”

hausa: Kamar yadda kuka sani, mukan ce da waɗanda suka jure, masu albarka ne. Kun ji daurewar Ayuba, kuka kuma ga abin da Ubangiji ya yi a ƙarshe. Ubangiji yana cike da tausayi da jinƙai.
english: Behold, we call them blessed who endured. You have heard of the perseverance of Job and have seen the Lord in the outcome, and how the Lord is full of compassion and mercy.

hausa: Na ba da bayana ga masu dūkana, kumatuna ga masu jan gemuna; ban ɓoye fuskata daga masu ba’a da masu tofa mini miyau ba.
english: I gave my back to those who beat me, and my cheeks to those who plucked off the hair. I didn’t hide my face from shame and spitting.

hausa: ya kuma zarge ta, ya ba ta mummunan suna, yana cewa, “Na auri wannan mata, amma sa’ad da na kusace ta, ban sami tabbaci cewa ita budurwa ba ce,”
english: accuses her of shameful things, gives her a bad name, and says, “I took this woman, and when I came near to her, I didn’t find in her the tokens of virginity;”

hausa: Amma ba ku gaskata ba domin ku ba tumakina ba ne.
english: But you don’t believe, because you are not of my sheep, as I told you.

hausa: I, ina kuma roƙonka, abokin famata, ka taimaki matan nan waɗanda suka yi fama aikin bishara tare da ni, haka ma Kilemen da kuma sauran abokan aikina, waɗanda sunayensu suna cikin littafin rai.
english: Yes, I beg you also, true partner, help these women, for they labored with me in the Good News with Clement also, and the rest of my fellow workers, whose names are in the book of life.

hausa: Suka kwashe tukwanen ƙarfe, da manyan cokula, da hantsuka, da daruna, da tasoshin ƙona turare, da kayayyakin tagulla waɗanda ake amfani da su domin hidimar haikali.
english: They also took away the pots, the shovels, the snuffers, the basins, the spoons, and all the vessels of bronze with which they ministered.

hausa: suka kuma yi ƙiba, suka yi bul-bul. Mugayen ayyukansu ba su da iyaka; ba sa wa marayu shari’ar adalci, ba sa kāre ’yancin matalauta.
english: They have grown fat. They shine; yes, they excel in deeds of wickedness. They don’t plead the cause, the cause of the fatherless, that they may prosper; and they don’t defend the rights of the needy.

hausa: Ƙasashen bakin teku za su girgiza sa’ad da matuƙan jirginki suka yi kuka.
english: At the sound of the cry of your pilots, the pasture lands will shake.

hausa: Ka cece mu ka kuma taimake mu da hannunka na dama, domin waɗanda kake ƙauna su kuɓuta.
english: So that your beloved may be delivered, save with your right hand, and answer us.

hausa: ƙasar da Ubangiji ya ci da yaƙi a gaban mutane Isra’ila, suna da kyau don dabbobi, bayinku kuma suna da dabbobi.”
english: the land which Yahweh struck before the congregation of Israel, is a land for livestock; and your servants have livestock.”

hausa: Sa’an nan na ji muryar Ubangiji tana cewa, “Wa zan aika? Wa zai tafi mana?” Sai na ce, “Ga ni! Ka aike ni!”
english: I heard the Lord’s voice, saying, “Whom shall I send, and who will go for us?” Then I said, “Here I am. Send me!”

hausa: Zan kuwa yi iyakacin ƙoƙari in ga cewa bayan rabuwata kullum za ku iya tuna da waɗannan abubuwa.
english: Yes, I will make every effort that you may always be able to remember these things even after my departure.

hausa: Sa’an nan dukan mutane a duniya za su ga cewa ana kiranku da sunan Ubangiji, za su kuwa ji tsoronku.
english: All the peoples of the earth shall see that you are called by Yahweh’s name, and they will be afraid of you.

hausa: Sa’an nan ya taɓa idanunsu ya ce, “Bisa ga bangaskiyarku a yi muku haka”;
english: Then he touched their eyes, saying, “According to your faith be it done to you.”

hausa: Yefta ya ce musu, “Ba kun ƙi ni kuka kuma kore ni daga gidan mahaifina ba? Me ya sa kuke zuwa wurina yanzu sa’ad da kuke cikin wahala?”
english: Jephthah said to the elders of Gilead, “Didn’t you hate me, and drive me out of my father’s house? Why have you come to me now when you are in distress?”

hausa: Mutanen Edom sun sāke zuwa suka yaƙi Yahuda suka kuma kwashe ’yan kurkuku,
english: For again the Edomites had come and struck Judah, and carried away captives.

hausa: Sa’ad da shugabannin kekunan yaƙi suka ga Yehoshafat, sai suka yi tsammani, “Wannan ne sarkin Isra’ila.” Saboda haka suka juya don su yaƙe shi, amma Yehoshafat ya yi ihu, Ubangiji kuma ya taimake shi. Allah ya janye su daga gare shi,
english: When the captains of the chariots saw Jehoshaphat, they said, “It is the king of Israel!” Therefore they turned around to fight against him. But Jehoshaphat cried out, and Yahweh helped him; and God moved them to depart from him.

hausa: Betuwel, Horma, Ziklag,
english: at Bethuel, at Hormah, at Ziklag,

hausa: Mugunta da ta’adi kamar ci da sha suke a gare su.
english: For they eat the bread of wickedness and drink the wine of violence.

hausa: Duk wanda ya ƙyale horo yakan kai ga talauci da kuma kunya, amma duk wanda ya karɓi gyara yakan sami girma.
english: Poverty and shame come to him who refuses discipline, but he who heeds correction shall be honored.

hausa: saboda muguntar da suka aikata. Sun tsokane ni na yi fushi ta wurin ƙone turare da kuma ta wurin bauta wa waɗansu allolin da su ko ku ko kakanninku ba su taɓa sani ba.
english: because of their wickedness which they have committed to provoke me to anger, in that they went to burn incense, to serve other gods that they didn’t know, neither they, nor you, nor your fathers.

hausa: Amma na ɗauki mahaifinku Ibrahim, daga ƙasar da take can a hayin Kogin Yuferites, na kawo shi ƙasar Kan’ana, na kuma ba shi ’ya’ya masu yawa. Na ba shi Ishaku,
english: I took your father Abraham from beyond the River, and led him throughout all the land of Canaan, and multiplied his offspring, and gave him Isaac.

hausa: Zan kyakketa gyalenku in ceci mutanena daga hannuwanku, ba za su kuma ƙara zama ganima a hannunku ba. Sa’an nan za ku san cewa ni ne Ubangiji
english: I will also tear your veils and deliver my people out of your hand; and they will no longer be in your hand to be ensnared. Then you will know that I am Yahweh.

hausa: Waɗannan su ne manya da suka fito daga zuriyar Isuwa, bisa ga danginsu, bisa kuma ga kabilansu da yankunansu. Sunayensu su ne, Timna, Alwa, Yetet.
english: These are the names of the chiefs who came from Esau, according to their families, after their places, and by their names: chief Timna, chief Alvah, chief Jetheth,

hausa: Lawiyawa ba sa ƙara bukata su ɗauki tabanakul ko kuwa waɗansu kayayyakin da ake amfani da su a hidima.”
english: Also the Levites will no longer need to carry the tabernacle and all its vessels for its service.”

hausa: Amma ya kai bakin ƙofar sarki ne kawai, gama ba a yarda wani sanye da tsummokin makoki yă shiga cikin birni ba.
english: He came even before the king’s gate, for no one is allowed inside the king’s gate clothed with sackcloth.

hausa: Wata rana ’yarsa babba ta ce wa ƙanuwarta, “Mahaifinmu ya tsufa, kuma babu wani mutum kusa a nan da zai yi mana ciki mu haifi ’ya’ya; yadda al’ada take a ko’ina a duniya.
english: The firstborn said to the younger, “Our father is old, and there is not a man on the earth to come in to us in the way of all the earth.

hausa: shanunmu za su ja kaya masu nauyi. Ba za a sami tashin hankali a katangarmu ba, ba zuwan zaman bauta, ba jin kukan damuwa a titunanmu.
english: Our oxen will pull heavy loads. There is no breaking in, and no going away, and no outcry in our streets.

hausa: Yanzu ya Uba, ka ɗaukaka ni a gabanka da ɗaukakar da dā nake da ita tun kafin a kafa duniya.
english: Now, Father, glorify me with your own self with the glory which I had with you before the world existed.

hausa: Sa’an nan Ishaya ɗan Amoz ya aika da saƙo wa Hezekiya cewa, “Ga abin da Ubangiji, Allah na Isra’ila, ya faɗa. Saboda ka yi addu’a gare ni game da Sennakerib sarkin Assuriya,
english: Then Isaiah the son of Amoz sent to Hezekiah, saying, “Yahweh, the God of Israel says, ‘Because you have prayed to me against Sennacherib king of Assyria,

hausa: Suka yashe haikalin Ubangiji Allah na kakanninsu, suka bauta wa ginshiƙan Ashera da kuma gumaka. Saboda laifinsu, fushin Allah ya sauko a kan Yahuda da Urushalima.
english: They abandoned the house of Yahweh, the God of their fathers, and served the Asherah poles and the idols, so wrath came on Judah and Jerusalem for this their guiltiness.

hausa: A maimakon haka ku je wajen ɓatattun tumakin Isra’ila.
english: Rather, go to the lost sheep of the house of Israel.

hausa: Bari duhu da inuwa mai duhu ta sāke rufe ta; gizagizai kuma su rufe ta; duhu kuma ya rufe haskenta.
english: Let darkness and the shadow of death claim it for their own. Let a cloud dwell on it. Let all that makes the day black terrify it.

hausa: To, Ga’al ɗan Ebed ya tafi tare da ’yan’uwansa zuwa Shekem, ’yan ƙasarta kuwa suka dogara da shi.
english: Gaal the son of Ebed came with his brothers and went over to Shechem; and the men of Shechem put their trust in him.

hausa: Ka amsa mana da ayyuka masu banmamaki na adalci, Ya Allah Mai Cetonmu, begen dukan iyakar duniya da kuma na tekuna masu nesa,
english: By awesome deeds of righteousness, you answer us, God of our salvation. You who are the hope of all the ends of the earth, of those who are far away on the sea.

hausa: Kada a lasafta gwauruwa cikin jerin gwauraye sai ta wuce shekara sittin, ta kuma yi zaman aminci ga mijinta,
english: Let no one be enrolled as a widow under sixty years old, having been the wife of one man,

hausa: Mutane suka yi mamakin koyarwarsa, domin ya koyar da su kamar wanda yake da iko, ba kamar malaman dokoki ba.
english: They were astonished at his teaching, for he taught them as having authority, and not as the scribes.

hausa: Wannan zai ci gaba har sai mun zama ɗaya a cikin bangaskiya da kuma ta wurin fahimtarmu na Ɗan Allah. Sa’an nan za mu zama balagaggu, kamar yadda Kiristi yake, mu kuma zama gaba ɗaya cikakku kamar sa.
english: until we all attain to the unity of the faith and of the knowledge of the Son of God, to a full grown man, to the measure of the stature of the fullness of Christ,

hausa: Sai Yaƙub ya albarkaci Fir’auna, ya yi masa bankwana, sa’an nan ya fita.
english: Jacob blessed Pharaoh, and went out from the presence of Pharaoh.

hausa: “ ‘In baƙo, ko wani da yake zama ba na ɗinɗinɗin ba a cikinku, ya wadace, ɗaya daga cikin mutanen ƙasarku kuwa ya talauta, ya kuma sayar da kansa ga baƙon da yake zama a cikinku, ko memba na dangin baƙon,
english: “‘If an alien or temporary resident with you becomes rich, and your brother beside him has grown poor, and sells himself to the stranger or foreigner living among you, or to a member of the stranger’s family,

hausa: Amma Ubangiji ya ce mini, “Kada ka ce, ‘Ni ɗan yaro ne kawai.’ Dole ka je wurin kowane mutumin da na aike ka ka kuma faɗa abin da na umarce ka.
english: But Yahweh said to me, “Don’t say, ‘I am a child;’ for you must go to whomever I send you, and you must say whatever I command you.

hausa: Yesu ya ce musu, “Dukanku za ku ja da baya ku bar ni, gama yana a rubuce cewa, “ ‘Zan bugi makiyayin tumaki, tumakin kuwa za su warwatse.’
english: Jesus said to them, “All of you will be made to stumble because of me tonight, for it is written, ‘I will strike the shepherd, and the sheep will be scattered.’

hausa: Yabi Ubangiji, ya raina. Ya Ubangiji Allahna, kana da girma ƙwarai; kana saye da daraja da ɗaukaka.
english: Bless Yahweh, my soul. Yahweh, my God, you are very great. You are clothed with honor and majesty.

hausa: Ɗan barci, ɗan gyangyaɗi, ɗan naɗin hannuwa don a huta,
english: a little sleep, a little slumber, a little folding of the hands to sleep,

hausa: kwanon zinariya ɗaya mai nauyin shekel goma, cike da turaren hayaƙi;
english: one golden ladle of ten shekels, full of incense;

hausa: wanda ya ba mu babu iyaka tare da dukan hikima da fahimta.
english: which he made to abound toward us in all wisdom and prudence,

hausa: “Kada ku cuci ƙasa ko teku ko kuma itatuwa sai bayan mun sa hatimi a goshin dukan bayin Allahnmu.”
english: saying, “Don’t harm the earth, the sea, or the trees, until we have sealed the bondservants of our God on their foreheads!”

hausa: “Duk wanda ya bayyana yarda a gare ni a gaban mutane, ni ma zan bayyana yarda a gare shi a gaban Ubana da yake cikin sama.
english: Everyone therefore who confesses me before men, I will also confess him before my Father who is in heaven.

hausa: Ku saurara, in gaya muku wani asiri. Ba dukanmu ne za mu yi barci ba, sai dai duk za a sauya kamanninmu
english: Behold, I tell you a mystery. We will not all sleep, but we will all be changed,

hausa: “Sai ya ce mini, ‘Matso kusa ka kashe ni! Ina cikin azabar mutuwa, sai dai har yanzu ina da rai.’
english: He said to me, ‘Please stand beside me, and kill me, for anguish has taken hold of me because my life lingers in me.’

hausa: Lalle za mu aikata duk abin da muka ce za mu yi. Za mu ƙone turare ga Sarauniyar Sama za mu kuma miƙa hadayun sha gare ta kamar dai yadda mu da kakanninmu, sarakunanmu da fadawanmu muka yi a garuruwan Yahuda da kuma kan titunan Urushalima. A lokacin muna da abinci a yalwace muna kuma da arziki ba mu kuma da wata damuwa.
english: But we will certainly perform every word that has gone out of our mouth, to burn incense to the queen of the sky and to pour out drink offerings to her, as we have done, we and our fathers, our kings and our princes, in the cities of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem; for then we had plenty of food, and were well, and saw no evil.

hausa: Allah kuwa ya ji yaron yana kuka, sai mala’ikan Allah ya kira Hagar daga sama ya ce mata, “Mene ne damuwarki, Hagar? Kada ki ji tsoro, Allah ya ji yaron yana kuka yayinda yake kwance a can.
english: God heard the voice of the boy. The angel of God called to Hagar out of the sky, and said to her, “What troubles you, Hagar? Don’t be afraid. For God has heard the voice of the boy where he is.

hausa: Ya kuma faɗa musu wannan misali cewa, “Makaho yana iya jagoran makaho ne? Ba sai dukansu biyu su fāɗa a rami ba?
english: He spoke a parable to them. “Can the blind guide the blind? Won’t they both fall into a pit?

hausa: Ya ba da sababbin riguna ga kowannensu amma ga Benyamin ya ba shi shekel ɗari uku na azurfa da riguna kashi biyar.
english: He gave each one of them changes of clothing, but to Benjamin he gave three hundred pieces of silver and five changes of clothing.

hausa: Akwatin Alkawarin Ubangiji ya kasance a gidan Obed-Edom mutumin Gat har tsawon wata uku, Ubangiji kuwa ya albarkace shi da dukan iyalinsa.
english: Yahweh’s ark remained in Obed-Edom the Gittite’s house three months; and Yahweh blessed Obed-Edom and all his house.

hausa: Mugun mutum kan mai da hankali ga mugayen leɓuna; maƙaryaci yakan kasa kunne ga harshen ƙarairayi.
english: An evildoer heeds wicked lips. A liar gives ear to a mischievous tongue.

hausa: Yowel ɗan Zikri ne babban shugabansu, Yahuda kuma ɗan Hassenuwa, ya shugabanci Yanki na Biyu na birni.
english: Joel the son of Zichri was their overseer; and Judah the son of Hassenuah was second over the city.

hausa: Ya ce mini, “Ɗan mutum, ka ga wannan? Za ka ga abubuwan da suke masu banƙyama fiye da wannan.”
english: Then he said to me, “Have you seen this, son of man? You will again see yet greater abominations than these.”

hausa: “Zan ba shi ita tă zama masa tarko, da haka Filistiyawa za su same shi.” Shawulu ya ce wa Dawuda, “Yanzu kana da dama sau na biyu ka zama surukina.”
english: Saul said, I will give her to him, that she may be a snare to him and that the hand of the Philistines may be against him. Therefore Saul said to David a second time, “You shall today be my son-in-law.”

hausa: Kada ka yi sata.
english: “You shall not steal.

hausa: Nan da nan da ya fara mulki, sai ya kashe dukan iyalin Yerobowam. Bai bar wa Yerobowam wani da rai ba, amma ya hallaka su duka, bisa ga maganar Ubangiji da ya ba wa bawansa Ahiya, mutumin Shilo.
english: As soon as he was king, he struck all the house of Jeroboam. He didn’t leave to Jeroboam any who breathed, until he had destroyed him, according to the saying of Yahweh, which he spoke by his servant Ahijah the Shilonite;

hausa: Sai ya zaɓi sojoji dubu uku daga jama’ar Isra’ila. Ya keɓe dubu biyu su kasance tare da shi a Mikmash da kuma a tuddan yankin Betel. Ya kuma bar dubu ɗaya tare da ɗansa Yonatan a Gibeya a yankin zuriyar Benyamin. Sauran sojojin kuwa Shawulu ya sallame su su koma gidajensu.
english: Saul chose for himself three thousand men of Israel, of which two thousand were with Saul in Michmash and in the Mount of Bethel, and one thousand were with Jonathan in Gibeah of Benjamin. He sent the rest of the people to their own tents.

hausa: “Amma game da ku waɗanda kuka yashe Ubangiji kuka manta da dutsena mai tsarki kuwa, ku da kuka shimfiɗa tebur don sa’a kuka kuma cika darunan ruwan inabin da aka dama don Ƙaddara,
english: “But you who forsake Yahweh, who forget my holy mountain, who prepare a table for Fortune, and who fill up mixed wine to Destiny;

hausa: Gama ya “sa kome a ƙarƙashin ƙafafunsa.” To, da aka ce an sa “kome” a ƙarƙashinsa, a fili yake cewa ba a haɗa da Allah a ciki ba, shi wannan da ya sa kome a ƙarƙashin Kiristi.
english: For, “He put all things in subjection under his feet.” But when he says, “All things are put in subjection”, it is evident that he is excepted who subjected all things to him.

hausa: In na ba wa matalauta dukan abin da nake da shi, na kuma miƙa jikina a ƙone, amma ba ni da ƙauna, ban yi riban kome ba.
english: If I give away all my goods to feed the poor, and if I give my body to be burned, but don’t have love, it profits me nothing.

hausa: Fatar jikina ta yi baƙi tana ɓarewa; jikina yana ƙuna da zazzaɓi.
english: My skin grows black and peels from me. My bones are burned with heat.

hausa: wanda mahaifiyarsa gwauruwa ce daga kabilar Naftali, wanda kuma mahaifinsa mutumin Taya ne, shi Huram, gwani ne a aikin tagulla. Huram gwani ne sosai kuma ya saba da yin kowane irin aikin tagulla. Sai ya zo wurin Sarki Solomon ya kuma yi dukan aikin da aka sa shi.
english: He was the son of a widow of the tribe of Naphtali, and his father was a man of Tyre, a worker in bronze; and he was filled with wisdom and understanding and skill to work all works in bronze. He came to King Solomon and performed all his work.

hausa: “Kaitonku, malaman dokoki da Farisiyawa, munafukai! Kuna kama da kaburburan da aka shafa musu farin fenti, waɗanda suna da kyan gani a waje, amma a ciki, cike suke da ƙasusuwan matattu da kuma kowane irin abu mai ƙazanta.
english: “Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you are like whitened tombs, which outwardly appear beautiful, but inwardly are full of dead men’s bones and of all uncleanness.

hausa: Ya kuma ce, “Tun da farko, ya Ubangiji, ka kafa tushen duniya, sammai kuma aikin hannuwanka ne.
english: And, “You, Lord, in the beginning, laid the foundation of the earth. The heavens are the works of your hands.

hausa: Bayan da Yesu ya tara Sha Biyun wuri ɗaya, sai ya ba su iko da izini na fitar da dukan aljanu, da na warkar da cututtuka.
english: He called the twelve together and gave them power and authority over all demons, and to cure diseases.

hausa: zan hukunta zunubinsu da sanda, laifinsu da bulala;
english: then I will punish their sin with the rod, and their iniquity with stripes.

hausa: “Ka aiki waɗansu mutane zuwa ƙasar Kan’ana, wadda nake ba Isra’ilawa. Daga kowace kabila, ka aiki ɗaya daga cikin shugabanninta.”
english: “Send men, that they may spy out the land of Canaan, which I give to the children of Israel. Of every tribe of their fathers, you shall send a man, every one a prince among them.”

hausa: Sam, ko kusa! Da a ce haka ne, ta yaya Allah zai shari’anta duniya?
english: May it never be! For then how will God judge the world?

hausa: Wannan za tă zama dawwammamiyar farilla ta shafi ɗan ƙasa da kuma baƙon da yake zama a tsakaninku.”
english: One law shall be to him who is born at home, and to the stranger who lives as a foreigner among you.”

hausa: Sai na ce wa manyan gari, da shugabanni, da sauran jama’a, “Aikin nan babba ne kuma mai yawa, ga shi muna a rarrabe nesa da juna a katangar.
english: I said to the nobles, and to the rulers and to the rest of the people, “The work is great and widely spread out, and we are separated on the wall, far from one another.

hausa: Amma in wannan bawa mugu ne, ya kuma ce a ransa, ‘Maigidana ba zai dawo da wuri ba.’
english: But if that evil servant should say in his heart, ‘My lord is delaying his coming,’

hausa: Ba a dai kawar da masujadan kan tudu ba; mutane suka ci gaba da yin hadaya da ƙone turare a can.
english: However the high places were not taken away. The people still sacrificed and burned incense in the high places.

hausa: Da Yesu yana tafiya, sai ya ga wani mutum wanda aka haifa makaho.
english: As he passed by, he saw a man blind from birth.

hausa: Ƙuri’a ta uku ta fāɗa a kan Zebulun bisa ga iyalansu. Iyakar ƙasarsu ta gādo ta kai har Sarid.
english: The third lot came up for the children of Zebulun according to their families. The border of their inheritance was to Sarid.

hausa: Kwana shida za ku yi aiki, amma rana ta bakwai za tă zama rana mai tsarki, Asabbaci ne na hutu ga Ubangiji. Duk wanda ya yi aiki a wannan rana dole a kashe shi.
english: ‘Six days shall work be done, but on the seventh day there shall be a holy day for you, a Sabbath of solemn rest to Yahweh: whoever does any work in it shall be put to death.

hausa: Ba za ku ci shi na kwana ɗaya, ko biyu, ko biyar, ko goma, ko kuma kwana ashirin kaɗai ba,
english: You will not eat just one day, or two days, or five days, or ten days, or twenty days,

hausa: Kada ku girbe abin da ya yi girma ba tare da ku kuka shuka ba, ko ku girbe inabin da ba ku aske ba. Ƙasar za tă kasance da shekarar hutu.
english: What grows of itself in your harvest you shall not reap, and you shall not gather the grapes of your undressed vine. It shall be a year of solemn rest for the land.

hausa: Tana sa zurfin kogi yă tafasa kamar tukunya, ta kuma sa teku yă zama kamar tukunyar man shafawa.
english: He makes the deep to boil like a pot. He makes the sea like a pot of ointment.

hausa: Ammonawa suka fita suka ja dāgār yaƙi a ƙofar shiga birninsu, yayinda Aram-Zoba, da na Rehob, da mutane Tob, da kuma na Ma’aka, suka ja tasu dāgār a karkara.
english: The children of Ammon came out, and put the battle in array at the entrance of the gate. The Syrians of Zobah and of Rehob and the men of Tob and Maacah were by themselves in the field.

hausa: Bayan an wanke kayan da cutar ta shafa, firist zai bincike shi, in kuwa cutar rigar ba tă canja yadda take ba, ko da yake ba tă yaɗu ba, marar tsarki ce.
english: Then the priest shall examine it, after the plague is washed; and behold, if the plague hasn’t changed its color, and the plague hasn’t spread, it is unclean; you shall burn it in the fire. It is a mildewed spot, whether the bareness is inside or outside.

hausa: A can ya tarar da wani mutum mai suna Eniyas, shanyayye wanda yake kwance kan gado shekara takwas.
english: There he found a certain man named Aeneas, who had been bedridden for eight years because he was paralyzed.

hausa: Ni ne burodin rai mai saukowa daga sama. Duk wanda ya ci wannan burodi, zai rayu har abada. Wannan burodin shi ne jikina, da zan bayar don duniya ta sami rai.”
english: I am the living bread which came down out of heaven. If anyone eats of this bread, he will live forever. Yes, the bread which I will give for the life of the world is my flesh.”

hausa: da jin motsin takawar kofatan dawakai, da jin surutun kekunan yaƙin abokin gāba da motsin ƙafafunsu. Ubanni ba za su juye don su taimaki ’ya’yansu ba; hannuwansu za su yi laƙwas.
english: At the noise of the stamping of the hoofs of his strong ones, at the rushing of his chariots, at the rumbling of his wheels, the fathers don’t look back for their children because their hands are so feeble,

hausa: Shi ya sa aka ce, “Ka farka, ya kai mai barci, ka tashi daga matattu, Kiristi kuwa zai haskaka ka.”
english: Therefore he says, “Awake, you who sleep, and arise from the dead, and Christ will shine on you.”

hausa: Gama kishi kan tā da hasalar miji, kuma ba zai ji tausayi ba sa’ad da yake ramawa.
english: For jealousy arouses the fury of the husband. He won’t spare in the day of vengeance.

hausa: A wannan lokaci sai Yesu ya ce, “Ina yabonka, Uba, Ubangijin sama da ƙasa, gama ka ɓoye waɗannan abubuwa ga masu hikima da masu ilimi, ka kuma bayyana su ga ƙananan yara.
english: At that time, Jesus answered, “I thank you, Father, Lord of heaven and earth, that you hid these things from the wise and understanding, and revealed them to infants.

hausa: Hazayel ya ce masa, “Me ya sa ranka yă daɗe yake kuka?” Elisha ya amsa, “Domin na san illar da za ka yi wa Isra’ilawa. Za ka ƙona biranensu masu katanga, ka karkashe majiya ƙarfinsu da takobi, ka fyaffyaɗe ƙananan yaransu da ƙasa, ka tsattsage matansu masu ciki.”
english: Hazael said, “Why do you weep, my lord?” He answered, “Because I know the evil that you will do to the children of Israel. You will set their strongholds on fire, and you will kill their young men with the sword, and will dash their little ones in pieces, and rip up their pregnant women.”

hausa: Ga maganar da ta zo wa Irmiya daga Ubangiji a shekara ta goma ta Zedekiya sarkin Yahuda, wanda ya kasance shekara ta goma sha takwas ta Nebukadnezzar.
english: This is the word that came to Jeremiah from Yahweh in the tenth year of Zedekiah king of Judah, which was the eighteenth year of Nebuchadnezzar.

hausa: Na gode wa Allah wanda nake bauta wa, kamar yadda kakanni-kakannina suka yi da lamiri mai tsabta, yadda kullum dare da rana ina tuna da ku a cikin addu’o’ina.
english: I thank God, whom I serve as my forefathers did, with a pure conscience. How unceasing is my memory of you in my petitions, night and day

hausa: Akwai wani Bafarisiye mai suna Nikodimus, wani ɗan majalisar Yahudawa.
english: Now there was a man of the Pharisees named Nicodemus, a ruler of the Jews.

hausa: wadda nake jakadanta cikin sarƙoƙi. Ku yi addu’a don in iya yin shelarta babu tsoro, yadda ya kamata in yi.
english: for which I am an ambassador in chains; that in it I may speak boldly, as I ought to speak.

hausa: Ya ce musu, “Yayinda yaron yake da rai, na yi azumi, na kuma yi kuka. Na yi tunani na ce, ‘Wa ya sani? Ko Ubangiji zai yi mini alheri yă bar yaron yă rayu.’
english: He said, “While the child was yet alive, I fasted and wept; for I said, ‘Who knows whether Yahweh will not be gracious to me, that the child may live?’

hausa: Suka fitar da aljanu da yawa, suka shafa wa marasa lafiya da yawa mai, suka kuwa warkar da su.
english: They cast out many demons, and anointed many with oil who were sick and healed them.

hausa: Amma za a yi wa Sarki Solomon albarka, sarautar Dawuda kuma za tă kasance a tsare a gaban Ubangiji har abada.”
english: But King Solomon will be blessed, and David’s throne will be established before Yahweh forever.”

hausa: Aka kuwa ba shi naɗaɗɗen littafin annabi Ishaya. Da ya buɗe, sai ya sami wurin da aka rubuta,
english: The book of the prophet Isaiah was handed to him. He opened the book, and found the place where it was written,

hausa: In mutum ya yi wa bawansa shagwaɓa tun yana yaro, zai jawo baƙin ciki a ƙarshe.
english: He who pampers his servant from youth will have him become a son in the end.

hausa: Kashegari Yohanna ya ga Yesu yana zuwa wajensa sai ya ce, “Ku ga, ga Ɗan Rago na Allah mai ɗauke zunubin duniya!
english: The next day, he saw Jesus coming to him, and said, “Behold, the Lamb of God, who takes away the sin of the world!

hausa: Babu wani mai ce a yi adalci; babu wani mai nema a dubi al’amarinsa da mutunci. Sun dogara a gardandamin banza suna ƙarairayi; suna ɗaukar cikin ɓarna, su haifi mugunta.
english: No one sues in righteousness, and no one pleads in truth. They trust in vanity and speak lies. They conceive mischief and give birth to iniquity.

hausa: “Wane ne ya rufe teku a bayan ƙofofi, lokacin da ya burtsatso daga cikin ciki.
english: “Or who shut up the sea with doors, when it broke out of the womb,

hausa: Saboda haka sai Yoshuwa ya umarci shugabannin mutane,
english: Then Joshua commanded the officers of the people, saying,

hausa: sarakuna suka yi shiru suka rufe bakunansu da hannuwansu;
english: The princes refrained from talking, and laid their hand on their mouth.

hausa: Sai ta zura igiya ta taga suka bi, domin gidan da take yana haɗe da katangar birnin.
english: Then she let them down by a cord through the window; for her house was on the side of the wall, and she lived on the wall.

hausa: Ban da haka, tabbatacce ita ’yar’uwata ce, ’yar mahaifina, ko da yake ba daga uwata ba, ta kuma zama matata.
english: Besides, she is indeed my sister, the daughter of my father, but not the daughter of my mother; and she became my wife.

hausa: A ƙasar kan tudu ta Efraim, aka ba su, Shekem (garin masu neman mafaka don sun yi kisa) da Gezer,
english: They gave them Shechem with its pasture lands in the hill country of Ephraim, the city of refuge for the man slayer, and Gezer with its pasture lands,

hausa: Kwana uku bayan sun yi alkawari da Gibeyonawa, sai Isra’ilawa suka ji cewa Gibeyonawa maƙwabtansu ne, waɗanda suke zaune kurkusa da su.
english: At the end of three days after they had made a covenant with them, they heard that they were their neighbors, and that they lived among them.

hausa: Amma Daniyel ya ƙudura a zuciyarsa ba zai ƙazantar da kansa da abinci da ruwan inabin sarki ba, sai ya tambayi sarkin fada don a ba shi izinin kada yă ƙazantar da kansa ta wannan hanya.
english: But Daniel purposed in his heart that he would not defile himself with the king’s delicacies, nor with the wine which he drank. Therefore he requested of the prince of the eunuchs that he might not defile himself.

hausa: Kada ka riƙe zunubai kakanni a kanmu; bari jinƙanka yă zo da sauri yă sadu da mu, gama mun fid da zuciya sarai.
english: Don’t hold the iniquities of our forefathers against us. Let your tender mercies speedily meet us, for we are in desperate need.

hausa: Ubangiji Allah ya yi tufafin fata domin Adamu da Hawwa’u, ya kuma yi musu sutura.
english: Yahweh God made garments of animal skins for Adam and for his wife, and clothed them.

hausa: Sai wannan mai zaune a girgijen ya wurga laujensa a duniya, sai aka kuwa girbe duniya.
english: He who sat on the cloud thrust his sickle on the earth, and the earth was reaped.

hausa: “Gama zan ba da umarni, zan kuma tankaɗe gidan Isra’ila a cikin dukan ƙasashe kamar yadda ake tankaɗe hatsi a cikin matankaɗi kuma ko ƙwaya ɗaya ba za tă fāɗi a ƙasa ba.
english: “For behold, I will command, and I will sift the house of Israel among all the nations as grain is sifted in a sieve, yet not the least kernel will fall on the earth.

hausa: Ka saurari kukan mutanena daga ƙasa mai nisa suna cewa, “Ubangiji ba ya a Sihiyona ne? Sarkinta ba ya can ne kuma?” “Me ya sa suka tsokane ni da gumakansu har na yi fushi, da baƙin gumakansu marasa amfani?”
english: Behold, the voice of the cry of the daughter of my people from a land that is very far off: “Isn’t Yahweh in Zion? Isn’t her King in her?” “Why have they provoked me to anger with their engraved images, and with foreign idols?”

hausa: A wannan rana Ubangiji zai ƙwace abin da suke taƙama da shi, mundayensu, ɗankwalin kansu da abin wuyansu,
english: In that day the Lord will take away the beauty of their anklets, the headbands, the crescent necklaces,

hausa: Aka kai Esta wurin Sarki Zerzes a mazaunin sarauta a wata na goma, watan Tebet, a shekara ta bakwai ta mulkinsa.
english: So Esther was taken to King Ahasuerus into his royal house in the tenth month, which is the month Tebeth, in the seventh year of his reign.

hausa: Haka kuma aka faɗa a wani wuri. “ ‘Ba za ka yarda Mai Tsarkinka ya ruɓa ba.’
english: Therefore he says also in another psalm, ‘You will not allow your Holy One to see decay.’

hausa: “Kwanakina sun fi mai gudu wucewa da sauri; suna firiya babu wani abin jin daɗi a cikinsu.
english: “Now my days are swifter than a runner. They flee away. They see no good.

hausa: To, da Bala’am ya ga cewa Ubangiji yana jin daɗin sa wa Isra’ila albarka, bai koma wajen sihiri kamar dā ba, amma ya juya fuskarsa wajen hamada.
english: When Balaam saw that it pleased Yahweh to bless Israel, he didn’t go, as at the other times, to use divination, but he set his face toward the wilderness.

hausa: Sai ya kawo kabilar Benyamin gaba, iyali-iyali, aka zaɓi iyalin Matri. A ƙarshe aka zaɓi Shawulu ɗan Kish. Amma da aka neme shi sai ba a same shi ba.
english: He brought the tribe of Benjamin near by their families and the family of the Matrites was chosen. Then Saul the son of Kish was chosen; but when they looked for him, he could not be found.

hausa: Ya tambaye su ya ce, “Gardamar me kuke yi da su?”
english: He asked the scribes, “What are you asking them?”

hausa: A maimakon haka ma, sa’ad da yake a Roma, ya neme ni ido a rufe sai da ya same ni.
english: but when he was in Rome, he sought me diligently and found me

hausa: Ba ku san cewa jikin nan naku haikalin Ruhu Mai Tsarki ba ne wanda yake cikinku yake kuma daga Allah? Ku ba na kanku ba ne;
english: Or don’t you know that your body is a temple of the Holy Spirit who is in you, whom you have from God? You are not your own,

hausa: Ka koya mini sani da kuma hukunci mai kyau, gama na gaskata a umarnanka.
english: Teach me good judgment and knowledge, for I believe in your commandments.

hausa: Sai ya kira taron wurinsa tare da almajiransa ya ce, “Duk wanda zai bi ni, dole yă ƙi kansa, yă ɗauki gicciyensa yă bi ni.
english: He called the multitude to himself with his disciples and said to them, “Whoever wants to come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross, and follow me.

hausa: Ina jin daɗin mutuwar mugu ne? In ji Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka. A maimako, ban fi jin daɗi sa’ad da suka juyo daga hanyoyinsu suka rayu ba?
english: Have I any pleasure in the death of the wicked?” says the Lord Yahweh, “and not rather that he should return from his way, and live?

hausa: Shekara ɗari uku Isra’ilawa suka yi zamansu a Heshbon, Arower da ƙauyukan kewayenta da dukan biranen da suke gefen Arnon. Me ya sa ba ka karɓe su a lokacin ba?
english: Israel lived in Heshbon and its towns, and in Aroer and its towns, and in all the cities that are along the side of the Arnon for three hundred years! Why didn’t you recover them within that time?

hausa: Amma Nebuzaradan shugaban matsaran ya bar waɗansu matalauta a ƙasar Yahuda, su da ba su da kome; a lokacin kuwa ya ba su gonakin inabi da kuma filaye.
english: But Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard left of the poor of the people, who had nothing, in the land of Judah, and gave them vineyards and fields at the same time.

hausa: Bari a rubuta wannan don tsara mai zuwa, cewa mutanen da ba a riga an halitta ba za su yabi Ubangiji,
english: This will be written for the generation to come. A people which will be created will praise Yah,

hausa: amma tun suna tasowa na lura da su, kamar yadda mahaifi zai lura da ɗa, kuma tun da aka haife ni ina lura da gwauruwa.
english: (no, from my youth he grew up with me as with a father, I have guided her from my mother’s womb);

hausa: Ba shakka, asirin addini da girma yake. Ya bayyana cikin jiki, Ruhu ya nuna shi adali ne, mala’iku suka gan shi, aka yi wa’azinsa cikin al’ummai, aka gaskata shi a duniya, aka ɗauke shi sama cikin ɗaukaka.
english: Without controversy, the mystery of godliness is great: God was revealed in the flesh, justified in the spirit, seen by angels, preached among the nations, believed on in the world, and received up in glory.

hausa: Ba zan tuhume su har abada ba, ba kuwa kullum zai yi fushi ba, gama a haka ruhun mutumin zan yi suma a gabana, shi numfashin mutumin da na halitta.
english: For I will not contend forever, neither will I always be angry; for the spirit would faint before me, and the souls whom I have made.

hausa: Sai ta ce musu, “Ga abin da Ubangiji, Allah na Isra’ila ya ce, ku faɗa wa mutumin da ya aike ku wurina,
english: She said to them, “Yahweh the God of Israel says, ‘Tell the man who sent you to me,

hausa: Gama Ubangiji mai girma ne ya kuma cancanci yabo; dole a ji tsoronsa fiye da dukan alloli.
english: For great is Yahweh, and greatly to be praised. He also is to be feared above all gods.

hausa: Ƙofofin Yeriko kuwa a kulle suke ciki da waje saboda Isra’ilawa, ba mai fita babu kuma mai shiga.
english: Now Jericho was tightly shut up because of the children of Israel. No one went out, and no one came in.

hausa: Suna yin cikin rikici su kuma haifi mugunta; cikinsu yana cike da ruɗami.”
english: They conceive mischief and produce iniquity. Their heart prepares deceit.”

hausa: “Ku saurari wani misali. An yi wani mai gona wanda ya yi gonar inabi. Ya kewaye ta da katanga, ya haƙa wurin matsin inabi a ciki, ya kuma gina hasumiyar gadi. Sa’an nan ya ba wa waɗansu manoma hayar gonar inabin, ya kuma yi tafiya.
english: “Hear another parable. There was a man who was a master of a household who planted a vineyard, set a hedge about it, dug a wine press in it, built a tower, leased it out to farmers, and went into another country.

hausa: “Babilon za tă fāɗi saboda kisassun mutanen Isra’ila, kamar dai yadda kisassu dukan duniya suka fāɗi saboda Babilon.
english: “As Babylon has caused the slain of Israel to fall, so the slain of all the land will fall at Babylon.

hausa: wanda ya ce wa zurfin ruwaye, ‘Ku bushe, zan kuma busar da rafuffukanku,’
english: who says to the deep, ‘Be dry,’ and ‘I will dry up your rivers,’

hausa: don sa marar azanci yă yi hankali, yă sa matasa su sani, su kuma iya rarrabewa,
english: to give prudence to the simple, knowledge and discretion to the young man—

hausa: Gama na san yadda kuke da taurinkai; jijiyoyin wuyanku ƙarafa ne, goshinku tagulla ne.
english: Because I knew that you are obstinate, and your neck is an iron sinew, and your brow bronze;

hausa: Da mala’ikan Ubangiji bai ƙara bayyana kansa ga Manowa da matarsa ba, sai Manowa ya gane cewa mala’ikan Ubangiji ne.
english: But Yahweh’s angel didn’t appear to Manoah or to his wife any more. Then Manoah knew that he was Yahweh’s angel.

hausa: Yesu ya amsa ya ce, “Ba sa’a goma sha biyu ce yini guda ba? Mutumin da yake tafiya da rana ba zai yi tuntuɓe ba gama yana ganin hasken duniyan nan.
english: Jesus answered, “Aren’t there twelve hours of daylight? If a man walks in the day, he doesn’t stumble, because he sees the light of this world.

hausa: Kada ka sa zuciyarka ga sarakuna, ga mutane masu mutuwa, waɗanda ba sa iya ceto.
english: Don’t put your trust in princes, in a son of man in whom there is no help.

hausa: Sai Liyatu ta yi ciki ta haifi ɗa. Ta sa masa suna Ruben, gama ta ce, “Domin Ubangiji ya ga wahalata. Tabbatacce mijina zai ƙaunace ni yanzu.”
english: Leah conceived, and bore a son, and she named him Reuben. For she said, “Because Yahweh has looked at my affliction; for now my husband will love me.”

hausa: Hezekiya ya juya fuskarsa wajen bango ya yi addu’a ga Ubangiji ya ce,
english: Then he turned his face to the wall, and prayed to Yahweh, saying,

hausa: Ahab ya huta da kakanninsa. Ahaziya ɗansa ya gāje shi a matsayin sarki.
english: So Ahab slept with his fathers; and Ahaziah his son reigned in his place.

hausa: Ka ɗiba kaɗan daga ciki, ka niƙa, ka ajiye a gaban akwatin alkawari a cikin Tentin Sujada, inda zan sadu da kai. Zai zama mafi tsarki a gare ku.
english: You shall beat some of it very small, and put some of it before the covenant in the Tent of Meeting, where I will meet with you. It shall be to you most holy.

hausa: Waɗannan su ne kabilan Issakar; jimillarsu ta kai 64,300.
english: These are the families of Issachar according to those who were counted of them, sixty-four thousand three hundred.

hausa: A rana ta huɗu suka tashi da sassafe ya kuma yi shiri yă tafi, amma mahaifinta yarinyar ya ce wa surukinsa, “Ka ɗan ci wani abu don ka sami ƙarfi; sa’an nan ka tafi.”
english: On the fourth day, they got up early in the morning, and he rose up to depart. The young lady’s father said to his son-in-law, “Strengthen your heart with a morsel of bread, and afterward you shall go your way.”

hausa: Kin ɗauki waɗansu tufafinki don ki yi wa kanki masujadai masu ado, inda kike karuwancinki. Irin waɗannan abubuwa bai kamata su faru ba, bai kuma kamata su taɓa faruwa ba.
english: You took some of your garments, and made for yourselves high places decked with various colors, and played the prostitute on them. This shouldn’t happen, neither shall it be.

hausa: Bawa dai ba shi da wurin zama na ɗinɗinɗin a cikin iyali, amma ɗa na gida ne har abada.
english: A bondservant doesn’t live in the house forever. A son remains forever.

hausa: Ya sa matan nan biyu masu hidima da ’ya’yansu a gaba, Liyatu da ’ya’yanta biye, sa’an nan Rahila da Yusuf a baya.
english: He put the servants and their children in front, Leah and her children after, and Rachel and Joseph at the rear.

hausa: Ya amsa ya ce, “Kun kwashe allolin da na yi, da kuma firist nawa, kuka tafi. Me kuma nake da shi? Yaya za ku ce, ‘Mece ce damuwata?’ ”
english: He said, “You have taken away my gods which I made, and the priest, and have gone away! What more do I have? How can you ask me, ‘What ails you?’”

hausa: Ta Solomon. Ka tanada sarki da shari’arka ta gaskiya, ya Allah, ɗan sarki da adalcinka.
