english: By Solomon. God, give the king your justice; your righteousness to the royal son.

hausa: Ina addu’a dominsu. Ba domin duniya nake addu’a ba, amma domin waɗanda ka ba ni, gama su naka ne.
english: I pray for them. I don’t pray for the world, but for those whom you have given me, for they are yours.

hausa: Amma Yesu ya kama ta a hannu ya ce, “Diyata, tashi.”
english: But he put them all outside, and taking her by the hand, he called, saying, “Child, arise!”

hausa: Na tsawata musu na kuma kira la’ana a kansu. Na bugi waɗansu mutane na kuma ja gashin kansu. Na sa suka yi rantsuwa da sunan Allah na ce, “Kada ku ba da ’ya’yanku mata aure ga ’ya’yansu maza, ba kuwa za ku auri ’ya’yansu mata wa ’ya’yanku maza ko wa kanku ba.
english: I contended with them, cursed them, struck certain of them, plucked off their hair, and made them swear by God, “You shall not give your daughters to their sons, nor take their daughters for your sons, or for yourselves.

hausa: Da taimakon Sila, wanda na ɗauka a matsayin ɗan’uwa mai aminci, na rubuta muku a taƙaice, ina ƙarfafa ku ina kuma shaida muku cewa wannan shi ne alherin Allah na gaske. Ku tsaya daram a cikinsa.
english: Through Silvanus, our faithful brother, as I consider him, I have written to you briefly, exhorting and testifying that this is the true grace of God in which you stand.

hausa: “ ‘Amma in cikin tsautsayi ne ya soke shi, ba don ƙiyayya ba, ko kuma ya jefe shi, ba da gangan ba,
english: “‘But if he shoved him suddenly without hostility, or hurled on him anything without lying in wait,

hausa: Suka miƙa ’ya’yansu maza hadaya ’yan matansu kuma ga aljanu.
english: Yes, they sacrificed their sons and their daughters to demons.

hausa: duk da haka kun ƙi zuwa wurina domin ku sami rai.
english: Yet you will not come to me, that you may have life.

hausa: Abner kuma ya yi magana da mutane Benyamin da kansa. Sa’an nan ya tafi Hebron yă gaya wa Dawuda ko mene ne Isra’ila da kuma dukan gidan Benyamin suke so su yi.
english: Abner also spoke in the ears of Benjamin; and Abner went also to speak in the ears of David in Hebron all that seemed good to Israel and to the whole house of Benjamin.

hausa: Dawuda ya husata ƙwarai da mutumin, ya ce wa Natan, “Muddin Ubangiji yana a raye, mutumin da ya yi wannan ya cancanci yă mutu!
english: David’s anger burned hot against the man, and he said to Nathan, “As Yahweh lives, the man who has done this deserves to die!

hausa: Adina ɗan Shiza mutumin Ruben, wanda shi ne babba na mutanen Ruben, kuma talatin suna tare da shi,
english: Adina the son of Shiza the Reubenite (a chief of the Reubenites), and thirty with him,

hausa: ba zai saurare ku ba. Don haka zan miƙa hannuna a kan Masar, in murƙushe ta da bala’i iri-iri, bayan haka zan fitar da taron mutanen Isra’ila daga ƙasar Masar ta wurin hukuntaina masu girma.
english: But Pharaoh will not listen to you, so I will lay my hand on Egypt, and bring out my armies, my people the children of Israel, out of the land of Egypt by great judgments.

hausa: ya ce, “Ya Ubangiji Allah na kakanninmu, ba kai ne Allah wanda yake sama ba? Kana mulki a bisa dukan mulkokin ƙasashe. Iko da girma suna a hannunka, kuma ba wanda zai iya tsayayya da kai.
english: and he said, “Yahweh, the God of our fathers, aren’t you God in heaven? Aren’t you ruler over all the kingdoms of the nations? Power and might are in your hand, so that no one is able to withstand you.

hausa: Annabin Irmiya ya tsara waƙoƙin makoki domin Yosiya, wanda har wa yau mawaƙa maza da mata suke rera game da Yosiya. Suka sa waɗannan su zama al’ada a Isra’ila, suna kuma a rubuce cikin Littafin Makoki.
english: Jeremiah lamented for Josiah, and all the singing men and singing women spoke of Josiah in their lamentations to this day; and they made them an ordinance in Israel. Behold, they are written in the lamentations.

hausa: Ku koyar da su ga ’ya’yanku, ku yi ta haddace su, sa’ad da kuke zaune a gida, da sa’ad da kuke tafiya, sa’ad da kuke kwance, da sa’ad da kuka tashi.
english: You shall teach them to your children, talking of them when you sit in your house, when you walk by the way, when you lie down, and when you rise up.

hausa: Gama ga abin da Ubangiji, Allah na Isra’ila yana cewa game da gidaje a wannan birni da fadodin Yahuda da aka rurrushe domin a yi amfani da su a kan mahaurai da kuma takobi
english: For Yahweh, the God of Israel, says concerning the houses of this city and concerning the houses of the kings of Judah, which are broken down to make a defense against the mounds and against the sword:

hausa: Za a ragargaje dukan allolinta; za a ƙone dukan baye-bayenta na haikali da wuta; zan lalatar da dukan gumakanta. Tun da ta wurin karuwanci ne ta tattara su, ga karuwanci kuma za su koma.”
english: All her idols will be beaten to pieces, all her temple gifts will be burned with fire, and I will destroy all her images; for of the hire of a prostitute has she gathered them, and to the hire of a prostitute shall they return.”

hausa: Da kuka zo gare shi, rayayyen Dutse, da mutane suka ƙi amma Allah ya zaɓa, kuma mai daraja a gare shi
english: Come to him, a living stone, rejected indeed by men, but chosen by God, precious.

hausa: “ ‘Ga shi ranar ta zo! Ta iso! Ƙaddararki ta keto, sandar ta yi toho, girman kai ya yi fure!
english: “‘Behold, the day! Behold, it comes! Your doom has gone out. The rod has blossomed. Pride has budded.

hausa: Ruwa mai kyau da kuma ruwan gishiri zai iya fito daga maɓulɓula ɗaya?
english: Does a spring send out from the same opening fresh and bitter water?

hausa: Bayan da ya tashi daga matattu, sai almajiransa suka tuna da abin da ya faɗa. Sa’an nan suka gaskata Nassi da kuma kalmomin da Yesu ya yi.
english: When therefore he was raised from the dead, his disciples remembered that he said this, and they believed the Scripture and the word which Jesus had said.

hausa: Sai ma’aikatan suka faɗa wa alƙalan wannan, da suka ji cewa Bulus da Sila Romawa ne, sai suka ji tsoro.
english: The sergeants reported these words to the magistrates, and they were afraid when they heard that they were Romans,

hausa: Ku nace da yin addu’a, kuna zaman tsaro da kuma godiya.
english: Continue steadfastly in prayer, watching in it with thanksgiving,

hausa: wanda yake da bagaden zinariya na turare da kuma akwatin alkawarin da aka dalaye da zinariya. A cikin akwatin alkawarin akwai tulun zinariya mai Manna a ciki, sandan Haruna wanda ya yi toho, da kuma allunan dutsen alkawari.
english: having a golden altar of incense and the ark of the covenant overlaid on all sides with gold, in which was a golden pot holding the manna, Aaron’s rod that budded, and the tablets of the covenant;

hausa: Gama in na sa ku baƙin ciki, wa ya rage yă faranta mini zuciya, in ba ku waɗanda na sa baƙin cikin ba?
english: For if I make you grieve, then who will make me glad but he who is made to grieve by me?

hausa: A cikin Allah muke fariyarmu dukan yini, kuma za mu yabi sunanka har abada. Sela
english: In God we have made our boast all day long. We will give thanks to your name forever. Selah.

hausa: Musa ya yarda yă zauna da mutumin wanda ya ba da ’yarsa Ziffora aure da Musa.
english: Moses was content to dwell with the man. He gave Moses Zipporah, his daughter.

hausa: A lokacin nan hankalina ya komo mini, sai aka mayar mini da masarautata mai daraja, da martabata, da girmana. ’Yan majalisata da fadawana suka nemo ni. Aka maido ni kan gadon sarautata da daraja fiye da ta dā.
english: At the same time my understanding returned to me; and for the glory of my kingdom, my majesty and brightness returned to me. My counselors and my lords sought me; and I was established in my kingdom, and excellent greatness was added to me.

hausa: to, a ranar da zai yi faɗa wane ne a cikin ’ya’yansa zai riƙe gādon da zai bar musu, kada yă sa ɗan matar da yake ƙauna yă zama kamar shi ne ɗan fari, a maimakon ɗan matar da ba ya ƙauna, wanda shi ne ɗan farin.
english: then it shall be, in the day that he causes his sons to inherit that which he has, that he may not give the son of the beloved the rights of the firstborn before the son of the hated, who is the firstborn;

hausa: Mutane ne masu ƙarfi, kuma dogaye, zuriyar Anakawa! Ai, kun ji akan ce, “Wa zai iya tsayayya da Anakawa?”
english: a people great and tall, the sons of the Anakim, whom you know, and of whom you have heard say, “Who can stand before the sons of Anak?”

hausa: Hiridus ya so yă kashe Yohanna, amma yana jin tsoron mutane, don sun ɗauka shi annabi ne.
english: When he would have put him to death, he feared the multitude, because they counted him as a prophet.

hausa: Gama kai, ya Ubangiji, kai ne Mafi Ɗaukaka a bisa dukan duniya; ana darjanta ka fiye da dukan alloli.
english: For you, Yahweh, are most high above all the earth. You are exalted far above all gods.

hausa: Har yaushe zan dubi tutar yaƙi in kuma ji karar ƙaho?
english: How long will I see the standard and hear the sound of the trumpet?

hausa: Ubangiji Maɗaukaki zai zo da tsawa da rawar ƙasa da ƙara mai girma, da hadarin iska da guguwa da harshe na wuta mai ci.
english: She will be visited by Yahweh of Armies with thunder, with earthquake, with great noise, with whirlwind and storm, and with the flame of a devouring fire.

hausa: Sai waɗansu Yahudawa suka zo daga Antiyok da Ikoniyum suka sha kan taron. Suka jajjefi Bulus da duwatsu suka kuma ja shi bayan birni, suna tsammani ya mutu.
english: But some Jews from Antioch and Iconium came there, and having persuaded the multitudes, they stoned Paul and dragged him out of the city, supposing that he was dead.

hausa: ina shelar yabonka da ƙarfi ina faɗin dukan ayyukanka masu banmamaki.
english: that I may make the voice of thanksgiving to be heard and tell of all your wondrous deeds.

hausa: sai ya ba wa Lawiyawa, waɗanda suke ɗaukar akwatin alkawarin Ubangiji wannan umarni,
english: Moses commanded the Levites, who bore the ark of Yahweh’s covenant, saying,

hausa: Sai mutanen suka juya suka nufi wajen Sodom amma Ibrahim ya ci gaba da kasance a gaban Ubangiji.
english: The men turned from there, and went toward Sodom, but Abraham stood yet before Yahweh.

hausa: Sai Siman Bitrus ya amsa ya ce, “Ubangiji wajen wa za mu tafi? Kai ne da kalmomin rai madawwami.
english: Simon Peter answered him, “Lord, to whom would we go? You have the words of eternal life.

hausa: Ku gai da Amfiliyatus, ƙaunataccena a cikin Ubangiji.
english: Greet Amplias, my beloved in the Lord.

hausa: Suka kuma kashe Farshandata, da Dalfon, da Asfata,
english: They killed Parshandatha, Dalphon, Aspatha,

hausa: Sai kuka amsa, kuka ce, “Mun yi zunubi ga Ubangiji. Za mu haura mu yi yaƙi yadda Ubangiji Allahnmu ya umarce mu.” Saboda haka kowannenku ya yi ɗamara da kayan yaƙinsa, kuka yi tsammani zai zama muku da sauƙi ku ci ƙasar tuddai da yaƙi.
english: Then you answered and said to me, “We have sinned against Yahweh. We will go up and fight, according to all that Yahweh our God commanded us.” Every man of you put on his weapons of war, and presumed to go up into the hill country.

hausa: Ya kafa ginshiƙan a gaban haikalin, ɗaya a kudu, ɗaya kuma a arewa. Ya kira wanda yake kudun, Yakin, na arewan kuwa ya kira Bowaz.
english: He set up the pillars before the temple, one on the right hand and the other on the left; and called the name of that on the right hand Jachin, and the name of that on the left Boaz.

hausa: in ba haka ba za su yayyage ni kamar zaki su ɓarke ni kucu-kucu ba tare da wani da zai cece ni ba.
english: lest they tear apart my soul like a lion, ripping it in pieces, while there is no one to deliver.

hausa: Sun yi hidimar Allahnsu da kuma hidimar tsarkakewa, kamar yadda mawaƙa da matsaran ƙofofi suka yi, bisa ga umarnin Dawuda da ɗansa Solomon.
english: They performed the duty of their God and the duty of the purification, and so did the singers and the gatekeepers, according to the commandment of David and of Solomon his son.

hausa: waɗanda suke ginin katanga. Waɗanda suke ɗaukan kaya suka yi aikinsu da hannu ɗaya, suna kuma riƙe da makami a ɗaya hannun,
english: Those who built the wall, and those who bore burdens loaded themselves; everyone with one of his hands did the work, and with the other held his weapon.

hausa: Naftali zai sami rabo; zai yi iyaka da yankin Asher daga gabas zuwa yamma.
english: “By the border of Asher, from the east side even to the west side, Naphtali, one portion.

hausa: Obed ya haifi Yesse, Yesse kuwa ya haifi Dawuda.
english: and Obed became the father of Jesse, and Jesse became the father of David.

hausa: Amma ka hura numfashinka sai teku ya rufe su. Suka nutse kamar darma cikin manyan ruwaye.
english: You blew with your wind. The sea covered them. They sank like lead in the mighty waters.

hausa: Babban shugaban Lawiyawa a Urushalima shi ne Uzzi ɗan Bani, ɗan Hashabiya, ɗan Mattaniya, ɗan Mika. Uzzi yana ɗaya daga zuriyar Asaf, waɗanda suke mawaƙan da suke da nawayar hidima a gidan Allah.
english: The overseer also of the Levites at Jerusalem was Uzzi the son of Bani, the son of Hashabiah, the son of Mattaniah, the son of Mica, of the sons of Asaph, the singers responsible for the service of God’s house.

hausa: Zan yi amfani da su in gwada Isra’ila in ga ko za su bi hanyar Ubangiji su kuma yi tafiya a cikinta kamar yadda kakanninsu suka yi.”
english: that by them I may test Israel, to see if they will keep Yahweh’s way to walk therein, as their fathers kept it, or not.”

hausa: Ku saurari abin da Ubangiji ya ce, “Tashi ku gabatar da ƙararku a gaban duwatsu; bari tuddai su ji abin da kuke so ku faɗa.
english: Listen now to what Yahweh says: “Arise, plead your case before the mountains, and let the hills hear what you have to say.

hausa: Yaƙub ya fusata, ya kuma yi wa Laban faɗa. Ya tambayi Laban, “Mene ne laifina? Wanda zunubi na yi da kake farautata?
english: Jacob was angry, and argued with Laban. Jacob answered Laban, “What is my trespass? What is my sin, that you have hotly pursued me?

hausa: Ta haka ya auna dukan kusurwoyi huɗu. Filin yana da katanga kewaye da shi, tsawon kamu ɗari biyar, fāɗin kuma kamu ɗari biyar don yă raba wuri mai tsarki daga wuri marar tsarki.
english: He measured it on the four sides. It had a wall around it, the length five hundred cubits, and the width five hundred cubits, to make a separation between that which was holy and that which was common.

hausa: Gama kibiyoyinka sun soke ni, hannunka kuma ya fāɗo a kaina.
english: For your arrows have pierced me, your hand presses hard on me.

hausa: Ya sāke tambaya, “Da me zan kwatanta mulkin Allah?
english: Again he said, “To what shall I compare God’s Kingdom?

hausa: Mutane fa suka shiga birni shiru, sai ka ce waɗanda sukan sace jiki don kunya sa’ad da suka gudo daga yaƙi.
english: The people sneaked into the city that day, as people who are ashamed steal away when they flee in battle.

hausa: Kafin a kai kowace yarinya wurin Sarki Zerzes, sai ta gama watanni goma sha biyu cif ana yin mata kwalliyar da aka tsara, akan ɗauki watanni shida ana shafa mata man mur, a ɗauki watanni shida kuma ana shafa mata man ƙanshi da kayan shafe-shafe.
english: Each young woman’s turn came to go in to King Ahasuerus after her purification for twelve months (for so were the days of their purification accomplished, six months with oil of myrrh, and six months with sweet fragrances and with preparations for beautifying women).

hausa: Sa’an nan ya ce, “Ka ɗauki kibiyoyi,” sai sarkin ya ɗauko. Sai Elisha ya ce, “Ka caki ƙasa.” Sai ya caka sau uku sa’an nan ya daina.
english: He said, “Take the arrows;” and he took them. He said to the king of Israel, “Strike the ground;” and he struck three times, and stopped.

hausa: Amma takubansu za su soki zukatansu, kuma bakkunansu za su kakkarye.
english: Their sword shall enter into their own heart. Their bows shall be broken.

hausa: Waɗanda suke ƙina ba dalili sun fi gashin kaina yawa; da yawa ne abokan gābana babu dalili, su da suke nema su hallaka ni. An tilasta mini in mayar da abin da ban sata ba.
english: Those who hate me without a cause are more than the hairs of my head. Those who want to cut me off, being my enemies wrongfully, are mighty. I have to restore what I didn’t take away.

hausa: Bari mu je Urdun, inda kowannenmu zai saro itace; mu gina inda za mu zauna.” Sai ya ce musu, “Ku je.”
english: Please let us go to the Jordan, and each man take a beam from there, and let’s make us a place there, where we may live.” He answered, “Go!”

hausa: Ya miƙa hadayu, ya kuma ƙone turare a masujadan kan tudu, a bisa tuddai da kuma ƙarƙashin kowane itace mai inuwa.
english: He sacrificed and burned incense in the high places, and on the hills, and under every green tree.

hausa: Sa’an nan na ji mala’ikan da yake lura da ruwaye ya ce, “Kai mai adalci ne cikin waɗannan hukuntai, kai da kake yanzu, kake kuma a dā, Mai Tsarki, saboda yadda ka yi hukuncin nan;
english: I heard the angel of the waters saying, “You are righteous, who are and who were, O Holy One, because you have judged these things.

hausa: A rana ta bakwai sai yaron ya rasu. Barorin Dawuda suka ji tsoro su gaya masa cewa yaron ya mutu, gama sun yi tunani cewa, “Yayinda yaron yake da rai, mun yi magana da Dawuda bai ji mu ba. Yaya za mu gaya masa yaron ya mutu? Ai, zai yi wa kansa ɓarna.”
english: On the seventh day, the child died. David’s servants were afraid to tell him that the child was dead, for they said, “Behold, while the child was yet alive, we spoke to him and he didn’t listen to our voice. How will he then harm himself if we tell him that the child is dead?”

hausa: waɗanda suke jin daɗin yin abin da ba shi da kyau suna kuma farin ciki a mugayen ɓatanci,
english: who rejoice to do evil, and delight in the perverseness of evil,

hausa: Matarsa ta ce masa, “Har yanzu kana nan da amincinka? Ka la’anta Allah ka mutu!”
english: Then his wife said to him, “Do you still maintain your integrity? Renounce God, and die.”

hausa: Zan nuna abubuwan banmamaki a sararin sama da alamu a nan ƙasa, jini da wuta da kuma hauhawan hayaƙi.
english: I will show wonders in the sky above, and signs on the earth beneath: blood, and fire, and billows of smoke.

hausa: ban bar bakina yă yi zunubi ta wurin la’anta shi ba,
english: (I have certainly not allowed my mouth to sin by asking his life with a curse);

hausa: Gama ko da yake ba na nan tare da ku a cikin jiki, ina tunaninku kullum, ina kuma farin ciki da gani kuna rayuwa yadda ya kamata, kuna kuma dāgewarku a kan bangaskiyarku a cikin Kiristi.
english: For though I am absent in the flesh, yet I am with you in the spirit, rejoicing and seeing your order, and the steadfastness of your faith in Christ.

hausa: Amma in suka ki su karɓi kwaf ɗin daga hannunka su sha, ka faɗa musu cewa, ‘Ga abin da Ubangiji Maɗaukaki yana cewa dole ku sha!
english: It shall be, if they refuse to take the cup at your hand to drink, then you shall tell them, ‘Yahweh of Armies says: “You shall surely drink.

hausa: Sa’ad da ya zo kuwa, zai kā da duniya a kan zunubi da adalci da kuma hukunci,
english: When he has come, he will convict the world about sin, about righteousness, and about judgment;

hausa: Mika ya ce masa, “Daga ina kake?” Ya ce, “Ni Balawe ne daga Betlehem a Yahuda, ina kuwa neman wurin zauna ne.”
english: Micah said to him, “Where did you come from?” He said to him, “I am a Levite of Bethlehem Judah, and I am looking for a place to live.”

hausa: Bayan Ehud ya ba da harajin, sai ya sallame mutanen da suka ɗauko harajin.
english: When Ehud had finished offering the tribute, he sent away the people who carried the tribute.

hausa: ku zaɓi waɗansu garuruwan da za su zama biranen mafakarku, inda wanda ya kashe mutum cikin kuskure zai iya gudu zuwa.
english: then you shall appoint for yourselves cities to be cities of refuge for you, that the man slayer who kills any person unwittingly may flee there.

hausa: Abin da ya kamata ku ce kawai, shi ne, I, ko A’a. Abin da ya wuce haka kuwa daga wurin Mugun nan yake.
english: But let your ‘Yes’ be ‘Yes’ and your ‘No’ be ‘No.’ Whatever is more than these is of the evil one.

hausa: Ya sāke cewa, “Dole ne Ɗan mutum ya sha wahaloli da yawa, dattawa, da manyan firistoci, da malaman dokoki kuma su ƙi shi, kuma dole a kashe shi, a rana ta uku kuma a tā da shi da rai.”
english: saying, “The Son of Man must suffer many things, and be rejected by the elders, chief priests, and scribes, and be killed, and the third day be raised up.”

hausa: Ka saurari maganar Ubangiji, ya gidan Yaƙub, dukanku zuriyar gidan Isra’ila.
english: Hear Yahweh’s word, O house of Jacob, and all the families of the house of Israel!

hausa: Sai mutanen da suke zama a wurin suka fara yin ƙoƙari su sa mutanen Yahuda su karaya, suka sa su ji tsoron ci gaba da ginin.
english: Then the people of the land weakened the hands of the people of Judah, and troubled them in building.

hausa: Yanzu ina da shekara tamanin. Zan iya bambanta abu mai daɗi da marar daɗi kuma ne? Bawanka zai iya jin ɗanɗano abin da yake ci, ko yake sha ne? Har yanzu zan iya jin muryoyin mawaƙan maza da mata? Don me bawanka zai zama ƙari kaya ga ranka yă daɗe?
english: I am eighty years old, today. Can I discern between good and bad? Can your servant taste what I eat or what I drink? Can I hear the voice of singing men and singing women any more? Why then should your servant be a burden to my lord the king?

hausa: Game da sauran ayyukan mulkin Yehowash, abin da ya yi da kuma nasarorinsa, haɗe da yaƙinsa da Amaziya sarkin Yahuda, duk a rubuce suke a cikin littafin tarihin sarakunan Isra’ila.
english: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoash which he did, and his might, and how he fought with Amaziah king of Judah, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

hausa: Na yi addu’a ga Ubangiji na ce, “Ya Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka, kada ka hallaka mutanenka, gādon kanka, da ka fansa ta wurin ikonka mai girma, ka kuma fitar da su daga Masar da hannu mai ƙarfi.
english: I prayed to Yahweh, and said, “Lord Yahweh, don’t destroy your people and your inheritance that you have redeemed through your greatness, that you have brought out of Egypt with a mighty hand.

hausa: Duk wanda aka naɗa daga ’ya’yan Haruna yă zama firist a madadinsa, shi ne zai miƙa wannan hadayar ga Ubangiji. Zai ƙone hadayar ƙurmus. Wannan za tă zama dawwammamiyar farilla ce har abada.
english: The anointed priest that will be in his place from among his sons shall offer it. By a statute forever, it shall be wholly burned to Yahweh.

hausa: Yana cin toka, zuciyar da ta ruɗe tana ɓad da shi; ba zai iya cece kansa ba, ko ya ce, “Wannan abin da yake hannun dama na ba ƙarya ba ne?”
english: He feeds on ashes. A deceived heart has turned him aside; and he can’t deliver his soul, nor say, “Isn’t there a lie in my right hand?”

hausa: Sa’an nan ya ƙara da cewa, “Ina da ɗan wani abin da zan faɗa miki.” Ta ce, “Faɗa.”
english: He said moreover, I have something to tell you.” She said, “Say on.”

hausa: Ba wani da zai zo tare da kai, ko a gan shi ko’ina a kan dutsen, kada garkunan tumaki ko na shanu su yi kiwo kusa da dutsen.”
english: No one shall come up with you or be seen anywhere on the mountain. Do not let the flocks or herds graze in front of that mountain.”

hausa: Bayan sun gāji tabanakul nan, kakanninmu a ƙarƙashin jagorancin Yoshuwa suka kawo shi tare da su, lokacin da suka ƙwace ƙasar daga al’umman da Allah ya kora a idanunsu. Tabanakul ɗin ya kasance a ƙasar har zamanin Dawuda,
english: which also our fathers, in their turn, brought in with Joshua when they entered into the possession of the nations whom God drove out before the face of our fathers to the days of David,

hausa: Da yake ba su san adalcin da yake fitowa daga Allah ba suka kuma nemi su kafa nasu, sai suka ƙi miƙa kai ga adalcin Allah.
english: For being ignorant of God’s righteousness, and seeking to establish their own righteousness, they didn’t subject themselves to the righteousness of God.

hausa: suka kuma ɗauke shi suka jefa a cikin rijiya. To, rijiyar wofi ce, babu ruwa a ciki.
english: and they took him, and threw him into the pit. The pit was empty. There was no water in it.

hausa: Takan yi zaman shari’a a ƙarƙashin Dabinon Debora tsakanin Rama da Betel, a ƙasar tudu ta Efraim, Isra’ilawa kuwa sukan zo wurinta don tă yi musu shari’a.
english: She lived under Deborah’s palm tree between Ramah and Bethel in the hill country of Ephraim; and the children of Israel came up to her for judgment.

hausa: Ba da daɗewa ba, duniya ba za tă ƙara ganina ba, amma za ku gan ni. Don ina raye, ku ma za ku rayu.
english: Yet a little while, and the world will see me no more; but you will see me. Because I live, you will live also.

hausa: Duk da haka, dole in ci gaba da aikin a yau, da kuma gobe, sa’an nan in ci gaba da yin haka kashegari kuma, gama tabbatacce, ba annabi da yakan mutu a bayan birnin Urushalima!’
english: Nevertheless I must go on my way today and tomorrow and the next day, for it can’t be that a prophet would perish outside of Jerusalem.’

hausa: Ka gayyato Yesse a wurin hadayar, ni kuma zan gaya maka abin da za ka yi. Za ka shafe mini wanda na nuna maka.”
english: Call Jesse to the sacrifice, and I will show you what you shall do. You shall anoint to me him whom I name to you.”

hausa: Amma Musa ya ce wa Ubangiji, “Ni mai nauyin baki ne, ina magana da ƙyar, ƙaƙa Fir’auna zai kasa kunne gare ni?”
english: Moses said before Yahweh, “Behold, I am of uncircumcised lips, and how shall Pharaoh listen to me?”

hausa: A gare ka na dogara, ya Allahna. Kada ka bari in sha kunya, ko ka bar abokan gābana su yi nasara a kaina.
english: My God, I have trusted in you. Don’t let me be shamed. Don’t let my enemies triumph over me.

hausa: Sai matar ta ruga don ta faɗa wa mijinta, ta ce, “Ga shi ya zo! Mutumin da ya bayyana mini ran nan!”
english: The woman hurried and ran, and told her husband, saying to him, “Behold, the man who came to me that day has appeared to me.”

hausa: Daga Dan ana jin tirjin dawakan abokin gāba; da jin haniniyar ingarmunsu dukan ƙasar ta girgiza. Sun zo su cinye ƙasar da kome da yake cikinta, birni da dukan mazaunanta.
english: The snorting of his horses is heard from Dan. The whole land trembles at the sound of the neighing of his strong ones; for they have come, and have devoured the land and all that is in it, the city and those who dwell therein.”

hausa: In kuka yi biyayya da umarnaina, za ku kasance a cikin ƙaunata, kamar dai yadda na yi biyayya da umarnan Ubana na kuma kasance a cikin ƙaunarsa.
english: If you keep my commandments, you will remain in my love, even as I have kept my Father’s commandments and remain in his love.

hausa: Yehoshafat ɗansa ya gāje shi a matsayin sarki ya kuma kahu sosai gāba da Isra’ila.
english: Jehoshaphat his son reigned in his place, and strengthened himself against Israel.

hausa: Kada mutumin Isra’ila ko mutuniyar Isra’ila yă zama karuwar haikali.
english: There shall be no prostitute of the daughters of Israel, neither shall there be a sodomite of the sons of Israel.

hausa: Saboda haka Ubangiji Allahnmu ya ba da Og, sarkin Bashan da dukan mayaƙansa a hannuwanmu. Muka karkashe su, ba mu bar wani da rai ba.
english: So Yahweh our God also delivered into our hand Og, the king of Bashan, and all his people. We struck him until no one was left to him remaining.

hausa: Ya yafa sulke a matsayin rigar ƙirji, da hulan kwanon ceto a kansa; ya sa rigunan ɗaukar fansa ya kuma nannaɗe kansa da kishi kamar a cikin alkyabba.
english: He put on righteousness as a breastplate, and a helmet of salvation on his head. He put on garments of vengeance for clothing, and was clad with zeal as a mantle.

hausa: Kamar yadda saurayi kan auri yarinya, haka ’ya’yanki maza za su aure ki; kamar kuma yadda ango yakan yi farin ciki da amaryarsa, haka Allahnki zai yi farin ciki da ke.
english: For as a young man marries a virgin, so your sons will marry you. As a bridegroom rejoices over his bride, so your God will rejoice over you.

hausa: Amma Ubangiji shi ne Allah na gaskiya; shi ne Allah mai rai, madawwamin sarki. Sa’ad da ya yi fushi, ƙasa takan girgiza; al’ummai ba sa iya jure da hasalarsa.
english: But Yahweh is the true God. He is the living God, and an everlasting King. At his wrath, the earth trembles. The nations aren’t able to withstand his indignation.

hausa: Ku ma, sai ku zauna da shiri, domin Ɗan Mutum zai zo a sa’ar da ba ku yi tsammani ba.”
english: Therefore be ready also, for the Son of Man is coming in an hour that you don’t expect him.”

hausa: (Dā a kan kira wannan Hebron, Kiriyat Arba. Wannan Arba kuwa shi ne wani katon mutum a cikin Anakawa.) Sa’an nan ƙasar ta huta daga yaƙi.
english: Now the name of Hebron before was Kiriath Arba, after the greatest man among the Anakim. Then the land had rest from war.

hausa: “Saboda kuna farin ciki kuna kuma murna, ku da kuka washe gādona, domin kuna tsalle kamar karsana mai sussuka hatsi kuna kuma haniniya kamar ingarmu.
english: “Because you are glad, because you rejoice, O you who plunder my heritage, because you are wanton as a heifer that treads out the grain, and neigh as strong horses,

hausa: Da ƙauna za a kafa kursiyi; da aminci mutum zai zauna a kansa, wani daga gidan Dawuda, wani wanda ta shari’antawa yakan nuna gaskiya ya hanzarta yin adalci.
english: A throne will be established in loving kindness. One will sit on it in truth, in the tent of David, judging, seeking justice, and swift to do righteousness.

hausa: Dukan biyun suka gagara biyansa, sai ya yafe musu. To, a ganinka, wa zai fi ƙaunar mutumin nan?”
english: When they couldn’t pay, he forgave them both. Which of them therefore will love him most?”

hausa: Ubangiji kuwa ya ji kukan Iliya, sai ran yaron ya dawo masa, ya kuma rayu.
english: Yahweh listened to the voice of Elijah; and the soul of the child came into him again, and he revived.

hausa: Suka tafi Gileyad ta yankin Tatim Hodshi, sa’an nan suka tafi Dan Ya’an, suka kuma yi wajen kewaye Sidon.
english: then they came to Gilead and to the land of Tahtim Hodshi; and they came to Dan Jaan and around to Sidon,

hausa: Maryamu ta zauna da Elizabet kusan wata uku sa’an nan ta koma gida.
english: Mary stayed with her about three months, and then returned to her house.

hausa: Ranakun za su auko miki, a lokacin da abokan gābanki za su gina bango gāba da ke, su kuma kewaye inda kike, za su kuma tsare kowane gefenki, su sa ke a tsakiya.
english: For the days will come on you when your enemies will throw up a barricade against you, surround you, hem you in on every side,

hausa: Tabbatacce ya ɗauki cututtukanmu ya kuma daure da baƙin cikinmu duk da haka muka ɗauka Allah ya hukunta shi ne, ya buge shi ya kuma sa ya sha azaba.
english: Surely he has borne our sickness and carried our suffering; yet we considered him plagued, struck by God, and afflicted.

hausa: Makiyaya marasa azanci ne kuma ba sa neman nufin Ubangiji; saboda haka ba sa nasara dukan garkensu kuwa ya watse.
english: For the shepherds have become brutish, and have not inquired of Yahweh. Therefore they have not prospered, and all their flocks have scattered.

hausa: Mutanen da suke tafiya tare da Shawulu suka rasa bakin magana; sun ji muryar amma ba su ga kowa ba.
english: The men who traveled with him stood speechless, hearing the sound, but seeing no one.

hausa: Cikin wahayi ya ga wani mutum mai suna Ananiyas ya zo ya sa hannuwansa a kansa don yă sāke samun ganin gari.”
english: and in a vision he has seen a man named Ananias coming in and laying his hands on him, that he might receive his sight.”

hausa: Sa’ad da kuka haye Urdun, sai waɗannan kabilai su tsaya a bisa Dutsen Gerizim su sa wa jama’a albarka, wato, kabilar Simeyon, Lawi, Yahuda, Issakar, Yusuf da Benyamin.
english: “These shall stand on Mount Gerizim to bless the people, when you have crossed over the Jordan: Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, Joseph, and Benjamin.

hausa: Na gane cewa wannan umarnin da aka nufa ya kawo rai, a gaskiya ya jawo mutuwa ce.
english: The commandment which was for life, this I found to be for death;

hausa: Ya gidan Isra’ila, ku dogara ga Ubangiji, shi ne mai taimakonsu da garkuwarsu.
english: Israel, trust in Yahweh! He is their help and their shield.

hausa: Ba zai yi ihu ko ya tā da murya, ko ya daga muryarsa a tituna ba.
english: He will not shout, nor raise his voice, nor cause it to be heard in the street.

hausa: Sa’ad da suke wata ɗaya da haihuwa, dole a fanshe su a bakin shekel biyar-biyar, bisa ga ma’aunin shekel na tsattsarkan wuri da ake amfani da shi, wanda nauyinsa ya kai gera ashirin.
english: You shall redeem those who are to be redeemed of them from a month old, according to your estimation, for five shekels of money, according to the shekel of the sanctuary, which weighs twenty gerahs.

hausa: Kyashi halittu ne da ba su da ƙarfi sosai, duk da haka suna ajiyar abincinsu da rani;
english: The ants are not a strong people, yet they provide their food in the summer.

hausa: Kada ka shirya kome da zai cuci maƙwabcinka, wanda yake zama da aminci kusa da kai.
english: Don’t devise evil against your neighbor, since he dwells securely by you.

hausa: “Ku tā da tuta a ƙasa! Ku busa ƙahoni a cikin ƙasashe! Ku shirya ƙasashe don yaƙi da ita, ku kira waɗannan mulkokin gāba da ita. Ararat, Minni, da Ashkenaz. A naɗa shugaba gāba da ita; ku shirya dawakai kamar fāra.
english: “Set up a standard in the land! Blow the trumpet among the nations! Prepare the nations against her! Call together against her the kingdoms of Ararat, Minni, and Ashkenaz! Appoint a marshal against her! Cause the horses to come up as the swarming locusts!

hausa: Gedaliya ya tabbatar musu da rantsuwa cewa, “Kada ku ji tsoron jama’ar Babiloniyawa, muddin kun zauna lafiya, kun kuma bauta wa sarkin Babilon, kome zai yi muku kyau.”
english: Gedaliah swore to them and to their men, and said to them, “Don’t be afraid because of the servants of the Chaldeans. Dwell in the land and serve the king of Babylon, and it will be well with you.”

hausa: Sa’ad da yake cikin magana, da yawa suka ba da gaskiya gare shi.
english: As he spoke these things, many believed in him.

hausa: Gama ina tare da kai, ba kuma wanda zai fāɗa maka ya cuce ka, domin ina da mutane da yawa a wannan birni.”
english: for I am with you, and no one will attack you to harm you, for I have many people in this city.”

hausa: amma kada yă yi masa bulala fiye da arba’in. In ya yi masa fiye da haka, za a ƙasƙantar da ɗan’uwanku, zai kuma zama rainanne a idonku.
english: He may sentence him to no more than forty stripes. He shall not give more, lest if he should give more and beat him more than that many stripes, then your brother will be degraded in your sight.

hausa: Amma Yowab bai haɗa da mutanen Lawi da na Benyamin a ƙidayar ba, domin bai ji daɗin umarnin sarki ba.
english: But he didn’t count Levi and Benjamin among them, for the king’s word was abominable to Joab.

hausa: Saboda haka yanzu, ka ɗauki makamanka, kwari da bakanka, ka tafi jeji ka farauto mini nama.
english: Now therefore, please take your weapons, your quiver and your bow, and go out to the field, and get me venison.

hausa: Kai, ko yanzu ma, ya riga ya ɓuya cikin kogo ko kuma a wani wuri. In har ya fara kai wa rundunarka hari duk wanda ya ji, zai ce, ‘An yi kaca-kaca da rundunar da suka bi Absalom.’
english: Behold, he is now hidden in some pit, or in some other place. It will happen, when some of them have fallen at the first, that whoever hears it will say, ‘There is a slaughter among the people who follow Absalom!’

hausa: da cikin magana mai gaskiya, da kuma cikin ikon Allah. Muna riƙe da makaman adalci dama da hagu,
english: in the word of truth, in the power of God, by the armor of righteousness on the right hand and on the left,

hausa: Ba lokacin yankan alkama ke nan ba? Zan roƙi Ubangiji yă aiko da tsawa da ruwan sama, za ku kuwa gane wace irin mugunta kuka yi a gaban Ubangiji sa’ad da kuka roƙa a ba ku sarki.
english: Isn’t it wheat harvest today? I will call to Yahweh, that he may send thunder and rain; and you will know and see that your wickedness is great, which you have done in Yahweh’s sight, in asking for a king.”

hausa: Domin kai ne mai taimakona, ina rera a cikin inuwar fikafikanka.
english: For you have been my help. I will rejoice in the shadow of your wings.

hausa: Sukan daga shi a kafaɗunsu su kuma ɗauke shi; sukan kafa shi a tsaye a wurinsa, a can kuwa zai tsaya. Daga wannan wuri ba zai iya gusawa ba. Ko da wani ya nemi taimakonsa, ba ya amsawa; ba zai iya cetonsa daga wahala ba.
english: They bear it on their shoulder. They carry it, and set it in its place, and it stands there. It cannot move from its place. Yes, one may cry to it, yet it can not answer. It cannot save him out of his trouble.

hausa: “Sa’ad da yamma ta yi, sai mai gonar inabin ya ce wa wakilinsa, ‘Kira ma’aikatan, ka biya su hakkin aikinsu, fara daga waɗanda aka ɗauke su a ƙarshe har zuwa na farko.’
english: “When evening had come, the lord of the vineyard said to his manager, ‘Call the laborers and pay them their wages, beginning from the last to the first.’

hausa: Su za su hallaka, amma kai kana nan; dukansu za su tsufa kamar riga.
english: They will perish, but you continue. They all will grow old like a garment does.

hausa: Waɗannan su ne suka yi wa sarki hidima, ban da waɗanda aka sa a biranen katanga ko’ina a Yahuda.
english: These were those who waited on the king, in addition to those whom the king put in the fortified cities throughout all Judah.

hausa: Wannan ya shaida cewa kun amince da abin da kakannin-kakanninku suka yi. Sun karkashe annabawa, ku kuma kun gina kaburburansu.
english: So you testify and consent to the works of your fathers. For they killed them, and you build their tombs.

hausa: Yakan ƙasƙantar da firistoci yă kuma tumɓuke masu ikon da aka kafa tun da daɗewa.
english: He leads priests away stripped, and overthrows the mighty.

hausa: Ka bulale mai ba’a, marasa azanci kuwa za su yi la’akari; ka tsawata wa mai basira, zai kuwa ƙara sani.
english: Flog a scoffer, and the simple will learn prudence; rebuke one who has understanding, and he will gain knowledge.

hausa: ɗan Ma’at, ɗan Mattatiyas, ɗan Semeyin, ɗan Yosek, ɗan Yoda,
english: the son of Maath, the son of Mattathias, the son of Semein, the son of Joseph, the son of Judah,

hausa: Sai Yesu ya ce, “Ina tare da ku na ɗan ƙanƙanin lokaci ne kawai, sa’an nan zan koma wurin wanda ya aiko ni.
english: Then Jesus said, “I will be with you a little while longer, then I go to him who sent me.

hausa: Suka amsa suka ce, “Ubangiji, muna so mu sami ganin gari.”
english: They told him, “Lord, that our eyes may be opened.”

hausa: “Yanzu, ka faɗa wa bawana Dawuda, ‘Ga abin da Ubangiji Maɗaukaki ya ce, na ɗauke ka daga makiyaya da kuma daga bin garke, don ka zama mai mulki a bisa mutanena Isra’ila.
english: “Now therefore, you shall tell my servant David, ‘Yahweh of Armies says, “I took you from the sheep pen, from following the sheep, to be prince over my people Israel.

hausa: Biranen da suke da katanga su ne Ziddim, Zer, Hammat, Rakkat, Kinneret,
english: The fortified cities were Ziddim, Zer, Hammath, Rakkath, Chinnereth,

hausa: In haka Allah yake yi wa ciyawar jeji sutura, wadda yau tana nan, gobe kuwa a jefa a cikin wuta, ba zai ma fi yi muku sutura ba, ya ku masu ƙarancin bangaskiya?
english: But if God so clothes the grass of the field, which today exists and tomorrow is thrown into the oven, won’t he much more clothe you, you of little faith?

hausa: Gama Ubangiji ba zai ƙi mutanensa ba; ba zai taɓa yashe gādonsa ba.
english: For Yahweh won’t reject his people, neither will he forsake his inheritance.

hausa: Duk da haka zuciyar Fir’auna ta taurare, bai kuwa saurare su ba, kamar dai yadda Ubangiji ya riga ya faɗa.
english: Pharaoh’s heart was hardened, and he didn’t listen to them, as Yahweh had spoken.

hausa: “Ya ku ’yan’uwa, ’ya’yan Ibrahim, da ku kuma Al’ummai masu tsoron Allah, a gare mu ne fa aka aiko wannan saƙon ceto.
english: “Brothers, children of the stock of Abraham, and those among you who fear God, the word of this salvation is sent out to you.

hausa: Ubangiji ya san tunanin mutum; ya san cewa tunaninsu banza ne.
english: Yahweh knows the thoughts of man, that they are futile.

hausa: Dukan Amoriyawa, da Hittiyawa, da Ferizziyawa, da Hiwiyawa da Yebusiyawan da suka ragu a ƙasar (waɗanda ba Isra’ilawa ba ne),
english: As for all the people who were left of the Amorites, the Hittites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites, who were not of the children of Israel—

hausa: “Attajiran duniya za su yi kuka su kuma yi makoki a kanta, domin ba wanda yake ƙara sayen kayayyakinsu
english: The merchants of the earth weep and mourn over her, for no one buys their merchandise any more:

hausa: Amincinka yana cin gaba cikin dukan zamanai; ka kafa duniya ta kuma dawwama.
english: Your faithfulness is to all generations. You have established the earth, and it remains.

hausa: Kalmomin annabawa sun yi daidai da wannan, kamar yadda yake a rubuce cewa,
english: This agrees with the words of the prophets. As it is written,

hausa: duk abin da ya fara fitowa daga ƙofar gidana don yă tarye ni, sa’ad da na komo daga yaƙi da Ammonawa, zai zama na Ubangiji, zan miƙa shi hadaya ta ƙonawa.”
english: then it shall be, that whatever comes out of the doors of my house to meet me when I return in peace from the children of Ammon, it shall be Yahweh’s, and I will offer it up for a burnt offering.”

hausa: Hagar tana a matsayin Dutsen Sinai a Arabiya tana kuma kwatancin birnin Urushalima na yanzu, gama ita baiwa ce tare da ’ya’yanta.
english: For this Hagar is Mount Sinai in Arabia, and answers to the Jerusalem that exists now, for she is in bondage with her children.

hausa: Abokaina ƙaunatattu, ina roƙonku, a matsayin bare da kuma baƙi a duniya, ku rabu da sha’awace-sha’awacen zunubin da suke yaƙi da ranku.
english: Beloved, I beg you as foreigners and pilgrims to abstain from fleshly lusts which war against the soul,

hausa: Sai tsoro ya kama dukan sojojin Filistiyawa, waɗanda suke cikin sansanin da waɗanda suke fili, har da waɗanda suke waje, da kuma waɗanda suke kai hari, ƙasa ta girgiza. Allah ne ya kawo wannan rikicewa.
english: There was a trembling in the camp, in the field, and among all the people; the garrison and the raiders also trembled; and the earth quaked, so there was an exceedingly great trembling.

hausa: Bari daren yă zama marar amfani; kada a ji wata sowa ta farin ciki.
english: Behold, let that night be barren. Let no joyful voice come therein.

hausa: Dare da rana, sai yă dinga kuka yana ƙuƙƙuje jikinsa da duwatsu a cikin kaburbura da kan tuddai.
english: Always, night and day, in the tombs and in the mountains, he was crying out, and cutting himself with stones.

hausa: Sai Daniyel ya amsa wa sarki ya ce, “Za ka iya ajiye kyautar wa kanka ko kuma ka ba wa wani. Duk da haka, zan karanta wa sarki rubutun, in kuma faɗa abin da yake nufi.
english: Then Daniel answered before the king, “Let your gifts be to yourself, and give your rewards to another. Nevertheless, I will read the writing to the king, and make known to him the interpretation.

hausa: “Sa’ad da na dawo Urushalima ina cikin addu’a a haikali, sai na ga wahayi
english: “When I had returned to Jerusalem and while I prayed in the temple, I fell into a trance

hausa: A ciki wasiƙar ya rubuta, “Tura Uriya a gaba inda yaƙi ya fi zafi. Sa’an nan ka janye daga gare shi don a buge shi yă mutu.”
english: He wrote in the letter, saying, “Send Uriah to the forefront of the hottest battle, and retreat from him, that he may be struck and die.”

hausa: Ga shi kuwa, mu da su dangin juna ne, ’ya’yanmu da nasu kuma ɗaya ne, duk da haka an tilasta mu mu sa ’ya’yanmu mata da maza su zama bayi. Har ma an riga an bautar waɗansu daga cikin ’ya’yanmu mata, amma ba mu da iko mu ce kome, domin gonakinmu da gonakin inabinmu suna a hannun waɗansu mutane.”
english: Yet now our flesh is as the flesh of our brothers, our children as their children. Behold, we bring our sons and our daughters into bondage to be servants, and some of our daughters have been brought into bondage. It is also not in our power to help it, because other men have our fields and our vineyards.”

hausa: Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka ya furta cewa, zai tattara korarru na Isra’ila, “Zan ƙara tattaro waɗansu bayan waɗanda na riga na tattara.”
english: The Lord Yahweh, who gathers the outcasts of Israel, says, “I will yet gather others to him, in addition to his own who are gathered.”

hausa: Da Bulus ya bayyana, sai Yahudawan da suka gangaro daga Urushalima suka tsaya kewaye shi, suna kawo ƙarar masu tsanani da yawa a kansa, waɗanda ba su iya tabbatarwa ba.
english: When he had come, the Jews who had come down from Jerusalem stood around him, bringing against him many and grievous charges which they could not prove,

hausa: A inda aka gicciye Yesu, akwai wani lambu, a cikin lambun kuwa akwai sabon kabari, wanda ba a taɓa sa kowa ba.
english: Now in the place where he was crucified there was a garden. In the garden was a new tomb in which no man had ever yet been laid.

hausa: Ba zan ƙara kawar da fuskata daga gare su, gama zan zuba Ruhuna a kan gidan Isra’ila, in ji Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka.”
english: I won’t hide my face from them any more, for I have poured out my Spirit on the house of Israel,’ says the Lord Yahweh.”

hausa: Yesu ya amsa ya ce, “Gaskiya nake gaya maka, a daren nan, kafin zakara yă yi cara, za ka yi mūsun sanina sau uku.”
english: Jesus said to him, “Most certainly I tell you that tonight, before the rooster crows, you will deny me three times.”

hausa: Dawuda ya ce wa Ahimelek firist, “Na zo aikin sarki ne, ya kuwa ce kada in sanar wa kowa abin da ya sa in yi. Na faɗa wa mutanena inda za su same ni.
english: David said to Ahimelech the priest, “The king has commanded me to do something, and has said to me, ‘Let no one know anything about the business about which I send you, and what I have commanded you. I have sent the young men to a certain place.’

hausa: “Kada ku baza rahoton ƙarya. Kada kuma ku haɗa baki da mugayen mutane har da ku zama munafukai ta wurin ba da shaidar ƙarya.
english: “You shall not spread a false report. Don’t join your hand with the wicked to be a malicious witness.

hausa: Wani lokaci daga baya Yowash ya yanke shawara yă gyara haikalin Ubangiji.
english: After this, Joash intended to restore Yahweh’s house.

hausa: Sai suka aika da akwatin alkawarin Allah zuwa Ekron. Yayinda akwatin alkawarin Allah yana shiga cikin Ekron, mutanen Ekron suka yi ihu, suka ce, “An kawo mana akwatin alkawarin Allah na Isra’ila domin yă kashe mu da mutanenmu.”
english: So they sent God’s ark to Ekron. As God’s ark came to Ekron, the Ekronites cried out, saying, “They have brought the ark of the God of Israel here to us, to kill us and our people.”

hausa: Mata suka karɓi ƙaunatattunsu da aka sāke tasar daga matattu. Aka azabtar da yawancin mutanen nan, amma suka ƙi a sake su, domin sun tabbata za su sami lada mafi kyau sa’ad da aka tā da matattu.
english: Women received their dead by resurrection. Others were tortured, not accepting their deliverance, that they might obtain a better resurrection.

hausa: Gulma yakan lalace yarda, amma mutum mai aminci kan kiyaye asiri.
english: One who brings gossip betrays a confidence, but one who is of a trustworthy spirit is one who keeps a secret.

hausa: Zan sa su zama abin ƙyama ga dukan mulkokin duniya saboda abin da Manasse ɗan Hezekiya sarkin Yahuda ya aikata a Urushalima.
english: I will cause them to be tossed back and forth among all the kingdoms of the earth, because of Manasseh, the son of Hezekiah, king of Judah, for that which he did in Jerusalem.

hausa: Sai mutumin ya amsa ya ce, “Ranka yă daɗe, wane ne shi? Gaya mini, don in gaskata da shi.”
english: He answered, “Who is he, Lord, that I may believe in him?”

hausa: Game da sauran ayyukan mulkin Yosiya, da duk abin da ya yi, duk a rubuce suke a cikin littafin tarihin sarakunan Yahuda.
english: Now the rest of the acts of Josiah, and all that he did, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

hausa: Ko kuwa ba ku karanta a Doka cewa a ranar Asabbaci firistoci sukan karya dokar Asabbaci duk da haka ba da yin wani laifi ba?
english: Or have you not read in the law that on the Sabbath day the priests in the temple profane the Sabbath and are guiltless?

hausa: Ba wanda yake aikin soja da zai sa kansa a sha’anin mutumin da ba ya aikin soja, domin yakan so yă gamshi wanda ya ɗauke shi soja.
english: No soldier on duty entangles himself in the affairs of life, that he may please him who enrolled him as a soldier.

hausa: “Zan sāka wa Babilon da dukan mazaunan Babilon a idanunku saboda dukan muguntar da suka aikata a Sihiyona,” in ji Ubangiji.
english: “I will give to Babylon and to all the inhabitants of Chaldea all their evil that they have done in Zion in your sight,” says Yahweh.

hausa: Aka kuma haifa wa Shem, wan Yafet, ’ya’ya maza. Shem shi ne kakan ’ya’yan Eber duka.
english: Children were also born to Shem (the elder brother of Japheth), the father of all the children of Eber.

hausa: Saboda haka Dawuda ya umarci mutanensa, suka kuwa kashe su. Suka yayyanka hannuwansu da ƙafafunsu, suka kuma rataye jikunansu kusa da tafki a Hebron. Amma suka ɗauki kan Ish-Boshet suka binne a kabarin Abner a Hebron.
english: David commanded his young men, and they killed them, cut off their hands and their feet, and hanged them up beside the pool in Hebron. But they took the head of Ishbosheth and buried it in Abner’s grave in Hebron.

hausa: amma da farko zan faɗa maka abin da aka rubuta a cikin Littafin Gaskiya (Babu wanda ya taimake ni yaƙi da waɗannan sai dai Mika’ilu, sarkinku.
english: But I will tell you that which is inscribed in the writing of truth. There is no one who holds with me against these but Michael your prince.

hausa: Zan mai da gidan Ahab kamar gidan Yerobowam ɗan Nebat da kuma kamar gidan Ba’asha ɗan Ahiya.
english: I will make Ahab’s house like the house of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, and like the house of Baasha the son of Ahijah.

hausa: Yaushe kuma muka gan ka cikin rashin lafiya ko a kurkuku muka ziyarce ka?’
english: When did we see you sick or in prison and come to you?’

hausa: Da jin haka sai Ayuba ya tashi ya yayyaga tufafin jikinsa, ya aske kansa. Ya fāɗi a ƙasa ya yi sujada
english: Then Job arose, and tore his robe, and shaved his head, and fell down on the ground, and worshiped.

hausa: sai ku miƙa kowane ɗan fari ga Ubangiji. Duk ɗan farin dabbobinku na Ubangiji ne.
english: that you shall set apart to Yahweh all that opens the womb, and every firstborn that comes from an animal which you have. The males shall be Yahweh’s.

hausa: Gama Allah, ba Allah mai sa rikicewa ba ne, sai dai mai salama. Kamar yadda yake a dukan ikkilisiyoyi na tsarkaka.
english: for God is not a God of confusion but of peace, as in all the assemblies of the saints.

hausa: “ ‘In ya miƙa dabba ce daga garke a matsayin hadaya ta salama ga Ubangiji, zai miƙa namiji ko ta mace marar lahani.
english: “‘If his offering for a sacrifice of peace offerings to Yahweh is from the flock, either male or female, he shall offer it without defect.

hausa: Dileyan, Mizfa, Yokteyel,
english: Dilean, Mizpah, Joktheel,

hausa: Da yake ya ji ƙarar busar amma bai kula ba, jininsa zai zauna a kansa. Da a ce ya kula, da ya ceci kansa.
english: He heard the sound of the trumpet and didn’t take warning. His blood will be on him; whereas if he had heeded the warning, he would have delivered his soul.

hausa: Ya auna gefen arewa da karan awon; ya samu kamu ɗari biyar.
english: He measured on the north side five hundred reeds with the measuring reed all around.

hausa: Kursiyi ba zai tashi daga Yahuda ba, ba kuwa sandan mulki daga tsakani ƙafafunsa ba, sai ya zo ga wanda yake mai shi. Biyayyar al’umma kuwa tasa ce.
english: The scepter will not depart from Judah, nor the ruler’s staff from between his feet, until he comes to whom it belongs. The obedience of the peoples will be to him.

hausa: Ka saurare ni, ya Ubangiji ka ji abin da masu zargina suke cewa!
english: Give heed to me, Yahweh, and listen to the voice of those who contend with me.

hausa: Yesu kuwa yana magana mutuwarsa ce, amma almajiransa suka ɗauka yana nufin barcin gaskiya ne.
english: Now Jesus had spoken of his death, but they thought that he spoke of taking rest in sleep.

hausa: Ba wanda ya taɓa ganin Allah; amma in muna ƙaunar juna, Allah yana raye a cikinmu, ƙaunarsa kuwa ta zama cikakkiya a cikinmu ke nan.
english: No one has seen God at any time. If we love one another, God remains in us, and his love has been perfected in us.

hausa: ya kuma yi ihu da ƙarfi kamar rurin zaki. Da ya yi ihun, sai muryoyin tsawan nan bakwai suka yi magana.
english: He cried with a loud voice, as a lion roars. When he cried, the seven thunders uttered their voices.

hausa: Ya halicce su namiji da ta mace, ya kuma albarkace su. Sa’ad da kuma aka halicce su, ya kira su “Mutum.”
english: He created them male and female, and blessed them. On the day they were created, he named them Adam.

hausa: Tare da su akwai Heman da Yedutun da sauran waɗannan zaɓaɓɓun da aka rubuta sunansu don yin godiya ga Ubangiji, “gama ƙaunarsa madawwamiya ce har abada.”
english: and with them Heman and Jeduthun and the rest who were chosen, who were mentioned by name, to give thanks to Yahweh, because his loving kindness endures forever;

hausa: Ina so ku san irin famar da nake yi saboda ku da kuma waɗanda suke a Lawodiseya, da kuma saboda dukan waɗanda ba su taɓa ganina ido da ido ba.
english: For I desire to have you know how greatly I struggle for you and for those at Laodicea, and for as many as have not seen my face in the flesh;

hausa: Yana jin tsoron duhu domin za a kashe shi da takobi.
english: He doesn’t believe that he will return out of darkness. He is waited for by the sword.

hausa: Yesu ya amsa ya ce, “Duk mai ƙaunata, zai yi biyayya da koyarwata. Ubana zai ƙaunace shi, za mu kuwa zo wurinsa mu zauna tare da shi.
english: Jesus answered him, “If a man loves me, he will keep my word. My Father will love him, and we will come to him and make our home with him.

hausa: Kaciya ba wani abu ba ne, rashin kaciya kuma ba wani abu ba ne. Kiyaye umarnin Allah shi ne muhimmin abu.
english: Circumcision is nothing, and uncircumcision is nothing, but what matters is keeping God’s commandments.

hausa: Amma zan hore ƙasar da suka bauta wa.’ Allah ya ce, ‘Kuma daga baya za su fita daga wannan ƙasa su kuma yi mini sujada a wannan wuri.’
english: ‘I will judge the nation to which they will be in bondage,’ said God, ‘and after that they will come out and serve me in this place.’

hausa: Itatuwan Lebanon ba su isa a yi wutar bagade da su ba, balle dabbobinsa su isa yin hadayun ƙonawa.
english: Lebanon is not sufficient to burn, nor its animals sufficient for a burnt offering.

hausa: Ya sa yaƙoƙi suka yi tsit ko’ina a duniya. Ya kakkarya bakkuna ya kuma ragargaza māsu, ya ƙone garkuwoyi da wuta.
english: He makes wars cease to the end of the earth. He breaks the bow, and shatters the spear. He burns the chariots in the fire.

hausa: Ubangiji Sarkin har abada abadin ne; al’ummai za su hallaka daga ƙasarsa.
english: Yahweh is King forever and ever! The nations will perish out of his land.

hausa: Dukan mutanen suka yi mamaki, suka ce wa junansu, “Wace irin koyarwa ce haka? Da ƙarfi da iko, yana ba wa mugayen ruhohin umarni suna kuma fita!”
english: Amazement came on all and they spoke together, one with another, saying, “What is this word? For with authority and power he commands the unclean spirits, and they come out!”

hausa: Ina sarkin Hamat yake, sarkin Arfad fa, sarkin Sefarfayim, ko na Hena ko na Iffa?”
english: Where is the king of Hamath, and the king of Arpad, and the king of the city of Sepharvaim, of Hena, and Ivvah?’”

hausa: Bari a shafe su sarai daga littafin rai kada a kuma lissafta su tare da adalai.
english: Let them be blotted out of the book of life, and not be written with the righteous.

hausa: To, ku jikin Kiristi ne, kowannenku kuwa gaɓarsa ne.
english: Now you are the body of Christ, and members individually.

hausa: Sa’ad da mutane suka ji wannan doka, sai suka ware daga Isra’ila duk waɗanda suke na baƙon zuriya.
english: It came to pass, when they had heard the law, that they separated all the mixed multitude from Israel.

hausa: Sai Yahuda ya haura zuwa wurinsa ya ce, “Ranka yă daɗe, roƙo nake, bari bawanka yă yi magana da ranka yă daɗe. Kada ka yi fushi da bawanka, ko da yake daidai kake da Fir’auna kansa.
english: Then Judah came near to him, and said, “Oh, my lord, please let your servant speak a word in my lord’s ears, and don’t let your anger burn against your servant; for you are even as Pharaoh.

hausa: Ya ce masa, “Kana tsammani ni kare ne da za ka zo mini da sanda?” Sai ya la’anci Dawuda da sunayen allolin Filistiyawa.
english: The Philistine said to David, “Am I a dog, that you come to me with sticks?” The Philistine cursed David by his gods.

hausa: Ko akwai wata mugunta a bakina? Bakina ba zai iya rarrabewa tsakanin gaskiya da ƙarya ba?
english: Is there injustice on my tongue? Can’t my taste discern mischievous things?

hausa: Yehoyahaz ya huta da kakanninsa, aka binne shi a Samariya, Yehowash ɗansa kuma ya gāje shi.
english: Jehoahaz slept with his fathers; and they buried him in Samaria; and Joash his son reigned in his place.

hausa: Ko kuma burodi bakwai nan na mutum dubu huɗu, cikakku manyan kwanduna nawa kuka ɗauka?
english: or the seven loaves for the four thousand, and how many baskets you took up?

hausa: Ubangiji ya ce wa Musa da Haruna,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,

hausa: “Ba shakka, Allah ba ya ƙin marar laifi, ko kuma yă ƙarfafa masu aikata mugunta.
english: “Behold, God will not cast away a blameless man, neither will he uphold the evildoers.

hausa: Sa’ad da suka kai masussukar Kidon, Uzza ya miƙa hannunsa don yă gyara akwatin alkawarin, gama shanun sun yi tuntuɓe.
english: When they came to Chidon’s threshing floor, Uzza put out his hand to hold the ark, for the oxen stumbled.

hausa: Abu mai kyau zai zo masa shi da yake kyauta yake kuma ba da bashi hannu sake, shi da yake yin al’amuransa cikin gaskiya.
english: It is well with the man who deals graciously and lends. He will maintain his cause in judgment.

hausa: sai Samson ya ce wa bawan da ya riƙe hannunsa, “Ka kai ni inda zan taɓa ginshiƙan da suke ɗauke da wannan haikali, don in jingina a kai.”
english: and Samson said to the boy who held him by the hand, “Allow me to feel the pillars on which the house rests, that I may lean on them.”

hausa: Isra’ila tsattsarka ce ga Ubangiji, nunan fari na girbinsa; dukan waɗanda suka cinye ta an same su da laifi, masifa kuwa ta same su,’ ” in ji Ubangiji.
english: Israel was holiness to Yahweh, the first fruits of his increase. All who devour him will be held guilty. Evil will come on them,”’ says Yahweh.”

hausa: Ira mutumin Yayir kuwa shi ne firist na Dawuda.
english: and Ira the Jairite was chief minister to David.

hausa: Ya yi fili na firistoci da kuma babban fili da ƙofofi domin filin, ya shafe ƙofofin da tagulla.
english: Furthermore he made the court of the priests, the great court, and doors for the court, and overlaid their doors with bronze.

hausa: Saboda haka, daga mutum ɗaya, wanda dā shi ma da matacce kusan ɗaya ne, zuriya masu yawa suka fito kamar taurari a sararin sama da kuma kamar yashin da ba a iya ƙirgawa a bakin teku.
english: Therefore as many as the stars of the sky in multitude, and as innumerable as the sand which is by the sea shore, were fathered by one man, and him as good as dead.

hausa: Hoshahiya da rabin shugabannin Yahuda kuwa suka bi su,
english: and after them went Hoshaiah, with half of the princes of Judah,

hausa: Kada ka yi fushi kada kuma ka yi hasala; kada ka tsorata, wannan yakan kai ga mugunta ne kawai.
english: Cease from anger, and forsake wrath. Don’t fret; it leads only to evildoing.

hausa: “Sarkin da yake a cikinsu zai ɗauki kayansa ya saɓa a kafaɗarsa da dare ya tafi, za a huda masa rami a katanga ya fita. Zai rufe fuskarsa don kada yă ga ƙasar.
english: “‘The prince who is among them will bear his baggage on his shoulder in the dark, and will go out. They will dig through the wall to carry things out that way. He will cover his face, because he will not see the land with his eyes.

hausa: Zuciyarsu masu ruɗu ne, yanzu kuwa dole su ɗauki laifinsu. Ubangiji zai rushe bagadansu yă kuma hallaka keɓaɓɓun duwatsunsu.
english: Their heart is divided. Now they will be found guilty. He will demolish their altars. He will destroy their sacred stones.

hausa: Iskar ta ci ƙarfin jirgin ruwan har ya kāsa fuskantar iskar; saboda haka muka sallamar mata tă yi ta tura mu.
english: When the ship was caught and couldn’t face the wind, we gave way to it and were driven along.

hausa: Da Finehas ɗan Eleyazar, ɗan Haruna, firist, ya ga haka, sai ya bar taron, ya ɗauki māshi
english: When Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest, saw it, he rose up from the middle of the congregation, and took a spear in his hand.

hausa: Mutanen Isra’ila suka koma wurin mutanen Benyamin suka kashe dukan waɗanda suke a birnin, tare da dabbobi da kome da suka samu. Dukan garuruwan da suka samu sun ƙone su ƙaf.
english: The men of Israel turned again on the children of Benjamin, and struck them with the edge of the sword—including the entire city, the livestock, and all that they found. Moreover they set all the cities which they found on fire.

hausa: Da zinariya zalla na talenti ɗaya za ka yi wurin ajiye fitilan da waɗannan abubuwa duka.
english: It shall be made of a talent of pure gold, with all these accessories.

hausa: Rabonku ne wannan, sashen da na auka muku,” in ji Ubangiji “domin kun manta da ni kuka kuma dogara ga allolin ƙarya.
english: This is your lot, the portion measured to you from me,” says Yahweh, “because you have forgotten me, and trusted in falsehood.”

hausa: Bayan dukan wannan ya faru, sai Bulus ya yanke shawara ya ratsa Makidoniya da Akayya in za shi Urushalima. Ya kuma ce, “Bayan na tafi can, dole in ziyarci Roma ita ma.”
english: Now after these things had ended, Paul determined in the Spirit, when he had passed through Macedonia and Achaia, to go to Jerusalem, saying, “After I have been there, I must also see Rome.”

hausa: Yana ba da umarninsa ga duniya; maganarsa tana tafiya da sauri.
english: He sends out his commandment to the earth. His word runs very swiftly.

hausa: “Ku gudu daga cikin Babilon! Bari kowa yă ceci ransa! Kada a hallaka saboda zunubanta. Gama lokaci ne don ramuwar Ubangiji, zai sāka mata bisa ga alhakinta.
english: “Flee out of the middle of Babylon! Everyone save his own life! Don’t be cut off in her iniquity, for it is the time of Yahweh’s vengeance. He will give to her a recompense.

hausa: Ya duba ta wajen Sodom da Gomorra, da wajen dukan filayen ƙasar, sai ya ga hayaƙi baƙin ƙirin yana tashi daga ƙasar kamar hayaƙi daga matoya.
english: He looked toward Sodom and Gomorrah, and toward all the land of the plain, and saw that the smoke of the land went up as the smoke of a furnace.

hausa: “Aƙalla itace yana da bege. In an sare shi, zai sāke tsira, zai tohu da kyau.
english: “For there is hope for a tree if it is cut down, that it will sprout again, that the tender branch of it will not cease.

hausa: Sai suka kwashi ƙasusuwansu suka binne a gindin itace tsamiya a Yabesh, suka kuma yi azumi kwana bakwai.
english: They took their bones and buried them under the tamarisk tree in Jabesh, and fasted seven days.

hausa: In gaskiya ne na yi laifi, kuskurena ya rage nawa.
english: If it is true that I have erred, my error remains with myself.

hausa: Shallum ɗan Kol-Hoze mai mulkin Mizfa ne ya yi gyare-gyaren Ƙofar Maɓuɓɓuga. Ya sāke gina ta, ya yi mata jinƙa yana sa ƙofofinta, da sakatunta, da kuma sandunan ƙarfenta a wurarensu. Ya kuma gyara katangar tafkin Silowam, ta Lambun Sarki, har zuwa matakalan da suka gangara daga Birnin Dawuda.
english: Shallun the son of Colhozeh, the ruler of the district of Mizpah, repaired the spring gate. He built it, covered it, and set up its doors, its bolts, and its bars; and he repaired the wall of the pool of Shelah by the king’s garden, even to the stairs that go down from David’s city.

hausa: Sa’an nan firist zai ɗibi jinin hadaya don zunubi da yatsarsa yă sa a ƙahonin bagaden hadayar ƙonawa, yă kuma zuba sauran jinin a gindin bagade.
english: The priest shall take some of the blood of the sin offering with his finger, and put it on the horns of the altar of burnt offering. He shall pour out the rest of its blood at the base of the altar of burnt offering.

hausa: kuma a cikin kwari, Bet-Haram, Bet-Nimra, Sukkot da Zafon da kuma sauran masarautar Sihon sarkin Heshbon (gabashin Urdun, abin da ya kama har zuwa ƙarshen Tekun Kinneret).
english: and in the valley, Beth Haram, Beth Nimrah, Succoth, and Zaphon, the rest of the kingdom of Sihon king of Heshbon, the Jordan’s bank, to the uttermost part of the sea of Chinnereth beyond the Jordan eastward.

hausa: A ƙarshen waɗannan kwanaki, daga rana ta takwas zuwa gaba, firistoci za su miƙa hadayu na ƙonawa da hadayu na salama a kan bagade. Sa’an nan zan karɓe ku, in ji Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka.”
english: When they have accomplished the days, it shall be that on the eighth day and onward, the priests shall make your burnt offerings on the altar and your peace offerings. Then I will accept you,’ says the Lord Yahweh.”

hausa: Mutumin da ya kawo labarin ya ce, “Isra’ilawa sun gudu a gaban Filistiyawa, mayaƙan kuma sun sha mummunar ɗibga. ’Ya’yanka Hofni da Finehas su ma sun mutu. Aka kuma ƙwace akwatin alkawarin Allah.”
english: He who brought the news answered, “Israel has fled before the Philistines, and there has been also a great slaughter among the people. Your two sons also, Hophni and Phinehas, are dead, and God’s ark has been captured.”

hausa: Musa ya ce, “Wannan shi ne abin da Ubangiji ya umarta, ‘Ku auna mudu guda na Manna, a adana ta dukan zamananku, domin kowane zamani yă ga irin abincin da na ba ku ku ci a hamada, yayinda na fitar da ku daga Masar.’ ”
english: Moses said, “This is the thing which Yahweh has commanded, ‘Let an omer-full of it be kept throughout your generations, that they may see the bread with which I fed you in the wilderness, when I brought you out of the land of Egypt.’”

hausa: Akwai kuma wani abu marar amfani da yake faruwa a duniya, masu adalci sukan sha hukuncin da ya dace da masu mugunta, masu mugunta kuma sukan karɓi sakayyar da ya cancanci masu adalci su samu. Na ce, wannan ma, ba shi da amfani.
english: There is a vanity which is done on the earth, that there are righteous men to whom it happens according to the work of the wicked. Again, there are wicked men to whom it happens according to the work of the righteous. I said that this also is vanity.

hausa: Shi ya sa iyayensa suka ce, “Ai, shi ba yaro ba ne, ku tambaye shi.”
english: Therefore his parents said, “He is of age. Ask him.”

hausa: A ƙarshe ’yan’uwa, sai wata rana. Ku yi ƙoƙari ku zama cikakku. Ku saurari roƙona, ku zama da tunani ɗaya, ku yi zaman salama. Allah na ƙauna da salama kuwa zai kasance tare da ku.
english: Finally, brothers, rejoice! Be perfected. Be comforted. Be of the same mind. Live in peace, and the God of love and peace will be with you.

hausa: A maimako haka, muna magana ne kamar mutanen da Allah ya amince yă danƙa musu amanar wannan bishara. Ba ma ƙoƙari mu gamshi mutane sai dai Allah, mai auna zukatanmu.
english: But even as we have been approved by God to be entrusted with the Good News, so we speak—not as pleasing men, but God, who tests our hearts.

hausa: Ɗaya daga cikin bayin Nabal ya gaya wa Abigiyel matar Nabal cewa, “Dawuda ya aiko da bayinsa daga jeji su gai da maigida, amma maigida ya zazzage su.
english: But one of the young men told Abigail, Nabal’s wife, saying, “Behold, David sent messengers out of the wilderness to greet our master; and he insulted them.

hausa: In kuma mace tana da miji wanda ba mai bi ba ne, kuma yana so yă zauna tare da ita, kada tă kashe auren.
english: The woman who has an unbelieving husband, and he is content to live with her, let her not leave her husband.

hausa: Ran Dawuda ya ɓace domin Ubangiji ya husata a kan Uzza, kuma har wa yau ana ce da wannan wuri Ferez Uzza.
english: David was displeased, because Yahweh had broken out against Uzza. He called that place Perez Uzza, to this day.

hausa: “Bari mu wuce cikin ƙasarka. Za mu bi ta kan hanya ne kaɗai; ba za mu ratse dama ko hagu ba.
english: “Let me pass through your land. I will go along by the highway. I will turn neither to the right hand nor to the left.

hausa: “Ka saurare ni, zan kuma yi maka bayani; bari in gaya maka abin da na gani,
english: “I will show you, listen to me; that which I have seen I will declare

hausa: Godiya ga Allah ta wurin Yesu Kiristi Ubangijinmu! Saboda haka fa, ni kaina a cikin hankalina, ni bawa ne ga dokar Allah, amma a mutuntaka, ni bawa ne ga dokar zunubi.
english: I thank God through Jesus Christ, our Lord! So then with the mind, I myself serve God’s law, but with the flesh, sin’s law.

hausa: Kowane namijin da ya yi addu’a ko annabci da kansa a rufe ya jawo kunya wa kansa.
english: Every man praying or prophesying, having his head covered, dishonors his head.

hausa: “Ka yi wurin ajiye fitilar da zinariya zalla, ka kuma yi gindinsa tare da gorar jikinsa da ƙerarriyar zinariya; kwafunansa da suka yi kamar furanni, tohonsa da furanninsa su yi yadda za su zama ɗaya da shi.
english: “You shall make a lamp stand of pure gold. The lamp stand shall be made of hammered work. Its base, its shaft, its cups, its buds, and its flowers shall be of one piece with it.

hausa: Shirye-shiryen masu adalci daidai ne, amma shawarar mugaye ruɗu ne.
english: The thoughts of the righteous are just, but the advice of the wicked is deceitful.

hausa: Don mai bi da kaɗe-kaɗe. Tare da kayan kiɗi masu tsirkiya. Zabura ta Asaf. Waƙa ce. A cikin Yahuda an san Allah; sunansa da girma yake a cikin Isra’ila.
english: For the Chief Musician. On stringed instruments. A Psalm by Asaph. A song. In Judah, God is known. His name is great in Israel.

hausa: Duka-duka garuruwan da aka ba iyalan mutanen Merari, waɗanda su ne sauran Lawiyawa, garuruwa goma sha biyu ne.
english: All these were the cities of the children of Merari according to their families, even the rest of the families of the Levites. Their lot was twelve cities.

hausa: Rago mai ƙahoni biyu da ka gani, yana a madadin sarakunan Medes da Farisa ne.
english: The ram which you saw, that had the two horns, they are the kings of Media and Persia.

hausa: “ ‘Kada ka yi jima’i da matar ɗan’uwanka; wannan zai ƙasƙanta ɗan’uwanka.
english: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your brother’s wife. It is your brother’s nakedness.

hausa: Shi ne kaɗai dutsena da cetona; shi ne kagarata, ba zan jijjigu ba.
english: He alone is my rock and my salvation, my fortress. I will not be shaken.

hausa: Gama sun aikata munanan abubuwa a Isra’ila; sun yi zina da matan maƙwabtansu kuma da sunana suka yi ƙarya, waɗanda ban faɗa musu su yi ba. Na san wannan kuma ni shaida ne ga haka,” in ji Ubangiji.
english: because they have done foolish things in Israel, and have committed adultery with their neighbors’ wives, and have spoken words in my name falsely, which I didn’t command them. I am he who knows, and am witness,” says Yahweh.

hausa: Sa’ad da kuka ba da rance na kowane iri ga maƙwabcinku, kada ku shiga gidansa don karɓar wani abu a matsayin jingina.
english: When you lend your neighbor any kind of loan, you shall not go into his house to get his pledge.

hausa: za a ba wa ƙofofin birnin sunaye kabilan Isra’ila. Ƙofofi uku a gefen arewa za su zama ƙofar Ruben, ƙofar Yahuda da ƙofar Lawi.
english: and the gates of the city shall be named after the tribes of Israel, three gates northward: the gate of Reuben, one; the gate of Judah, one; the gate of Levi, one.

hausa: Ku ɗaga kai ku dubi sama ku gani; ku dubi gizagizai a samanku.
english: Look to the skies, and see. See the skies, which are higher than you.

hausa: Ubangiji, Ubangiji Maɗaukaki, yana da ranar giggicewa da tattakewa da banrazana a cikin Kwarin Wahayi, ranar ragargazawar katanga da ta yin kuka ga duwatsu.
english: For it is a day of confusion, and of treading down, and of perplexity from the Lord, Yahweh of Armies, in the valley of vision, a breaking down of the walls, and a crying to the mountains.”

hausa: Sa’ad da mutumin da ƙwarƙwaransa da bawansa, suka tashi don su tafi, surukinsa, mahaifin yarinyar ya ce, “Duba, rana ta kusan fāɗuwa, yamma ta riga ta yi, ka kwana a nan. Ka sāke kwana ka ji wa ranka daɗi. Kashegari da sassafe za ka iya tashi ka kama hanyarka zuwa gida.”
english: When the man rose up to depart, he, and his concubine, and his servant, his father-in-law, the young lady’s father, said to him, “Behold, now the day draws toward evening, please stay all night. Behold, the day is ending. Stay here, that your heart may be merry; and tomorrow go on your way early, that you may go home.”

hausa: Ƙarfina ya bushe kamar kasko, harshena kuma ya manne wa dasashina na sama; ka kwantar da ni a ƙurar mutuwa.
english: My strength is dried up like a potsherd. My tongue sticks to the roof of my mouth. You have brought me into the dust of death.

hausa: Za ku ga wannan da idanunku ku kuma ce, ‘Ubangiji da girma yake, har gaba da iyakokin Isra’ila ma!’
english: Your eyes will see, and you will say, “Yahweh is great—even beyond the border of Israel!”

hausa: Amma a dā akwai annabawan ƙarya a cikin mutane, kamar yadda za a sami malaman ƙarya a cikinku. A ɓoye za su shigar da karkataccen koyarwa mai hallaka, har ma su yi mūsun Ubangiji mai iko duka wanda ya saye su suna kawo wa kansu hallaka farat ɗaya.
english: But false prophets also arose among the people, as false teachers will also be among you, who will secretly bring in destructive heresies, denying even the Master who bought them, bringing on themselves swift destruction.

hausa: Amma Bulus da Barnabas kuwa suka dakata a Antiyok, inda su da waɗansu da yawa suka yi koyarwa suka kuma yi wa’azin maganar Ubangiji.
english: But Paul and Barnabas stayed in Antioch, teaching and preaching the word of the Lord, with many others also.

hausa: “Bari a tā da dukan al’ummai; bari su kutsa zuwa Kwarin Yehoshafat gama a can zan zauna in shari’anta dukan al’ummai daga kowane ɓangare.
english: “Let the nations arouse themselves, and come up to the valley of Jehoshaphat; for there I will sit to judge all the surrounding nations.

hausa: Ka gafarta laifin mutanenka ka kuma shafe dukan zunubansu. Sela
english: You have forgiven the iniquity of your people. You have covered all their sin. Selah.

hausa: Na ce wa birnin, ‘Tabbatacce za ki ji tsorona ki kuma yarda da gyara!’ Ta haka ba za a datse wurin zamanki ba, ba kuwa dukan hukuncena za su hau bisa kansu ba. Amma har yanzu suna marmari su yi rashin gaskiya a duk abin da suke yi.
english: I said, “Just fear me. Receive correction,” so that her dwelling won’t be cut off, according to all that I have appointed concerning her. But they rose early and corrupted all their doings.

hausa: Suka ƙarfafa mulkin Yahuda suka kuma goyi bayan Rehobowam ɗan Solomon shekaru uku, suna tafiya a hanyoyin Dawuda da Solomon a wannan lokaci.
english: So they strengthened the kingdom of Judah and made Rehoboam the son of Solomon strong for three years, for they walked three years in the way of David and Solomon.

hausa: Ya miƙa hadayu ga allolin Damaskus, waɗanda suka ci shi a yaƙi; gama ya yi tunani, “Da yake allolin sarakunan Aram sun taimake su, zan miƙa hadayu domin su taimake ni.” Amma suka zama sanadin fāɗuwarsa da kuma fāɗuwar dukan Isra’ila.
english: For he sacrificed to the gods of Damascus which had defeated him. He said, “Because the gods of the kings of Syria helped them, I will sacrifice to them, that they may help me.” But they were the ruin of him and of all Israel.

hausa: Mutane kuma ba za su ce, ‘Ga shi nan,’ ko kuma, ‘Ga shi can’ ba, domin mulkin Allah yana cikinku ne.”
english: neither will they say, ‘Look, here!’ or, ‘Look, there!’ for behold, God’s Kingdom is within you.”

hausa: Ga abin da Ubangiji ya faɗa mini, “Zan yi shiru in kuma duba a hankali daga mazaunina, kamar ƙuna mai zafi a hasken rana, kamar girgijen raba a lokacin girbi.”
english: For Yahweh said to me, “I will be still, and I will see in my dwelling place, like clear heat in sunshine, like a cloud of dew in the heat of harvest.”

hausa: Mismanna na huɗu, Irmiya na biyar,
english: Mishmannah the fourth, Jeremiah the fifth,

hausa: Muguntarka za tă hukunta ka; jan bayanka zai tsawata maka. Sai ka lura ka kuma gane yaya mugu da kuma ɗaci suke a gare ka sa’ad da ka rabu da Ubangiji Allahnka kuma ba ka tsorona,” in ji Ubangiji Maɗaukaki.
english: “Your own wickedness will correct you, and your backsliding will rebuke you. Know therefore and see that it is an evil and bitter thing, that you have forsaken Yahweh your God, and that my fear is not in you,” says the Lord, Yahweh of Armies.

hausa: “Yi magana da Isra’ilawa, ka ce musu, ‘In mace, ko namiji yana so yă yi alkawari na musamman, alkawarin zaman keɓaɓɓe ga Ubangiji, a matsayin Banazare,
english: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them: ‘When either man or woman shall make a special vow, the vow of a Nazirite, to separate himself to Yahweh,

hausa: Solomon ya tara kekunan yaƙi da dawakai; ya kasance da kekunan yaƙi dubu goma sha huɗu, da dawakai dubu goma sha biyu waɗanda ya ajiye a biranen kekunan yaƙi, ya kuma ajiye tare da shi a Urushalima.
english: Solomon gathered together chariots and horsemen. He had one thousand four hundred chariots and twelve thousand horsemen. He kept them in the chariot cities and with the king at Jerusalem.

hausa: Sun gida masujadan Tofet a Kwarin Ben Hinnom don miƙa ’ya’yansu maza da mata a wuta, abin da ban yi umarni ba, ba kuwa yi tunaninsa ba.
english: They have built the high places of Topheth, which is in the valley of the son of Hinnom, to burn their sons and their daughters in the fire, which I didn’t command, nor did it come into my mind.

hausa: Amma mutumin da ya riga ya yanke shawara a ransa, wanda kuma ba lalle ba ne amma yana iya shan kan nufinsa, kuma ya riga ya zartar a zuciyarsa ba zai auri budurwar ba, wannan mutum ma ya yi abin da ya dace.
english: But he who stands steadfast in his heart, having no urgency, but has power over his own will, and has determined in his own heart to keep his own virgin, does well.

hausa: Sa’an nan Fir’auna ya yi wa mutanensa umarni a kan Abram, suka kuwa sallame shi tare da matarsa da kuma dukan abin da yake da shi.
english: Pharaoh commanded men concerning him, and they escorted him away with his wife and all that he had.

hausa: Gama kun san umarnan da muka ba ku ta wurin ikon Ubangiji Yesu.
english: For you know what instructions we gave you through the Lord Jesus.

hausa: Sa’ad da Solomon ya gama ginin haikalin Ubangiji da kuma fadan sarki, ya kuma yi dukan abin da yake so yă yi,
english: When Solomon had finished the building of Yahweh’s house, the king’s house, and all Solomon’s desire which he was pleased to do,

hausa: “ ‘Kullum za ku tanada ɗan rago bana ɗaya marar lahani don hadaya ta ƙonawa ga Ubangiji; kowace safiya za ku tanada shi.
english: “‘“You shall prepare a lamb a year old without defect for a burnt offering to Yahweh daily. Morning by morning you shall prepare it.

hausa: Waɗanda suke daga Yahuda, daga Benyamin, da kuma daga Efraim da Manasse waɗanda suka zauna a Urushalima su ne,
