english: In Jerusalem, there lived of the children of Judah, of the children of Benjamin, and of the children of Ephraim and Manasseh:

hausa: ana iya kama ƙadangare da hannu, duk da haka akan same shi a fadodin sarakuna.
english: You can catch a lizard with your hands, yet it is in kings’ palaces.

hausa: A lokacin girbin alkama, sai Ruben ya je jeji ya ɗebo manta-uwa ya kawo wa mahaifiyarsa Liyatu. Sai Rahila ta ce wa Liyatu, “Ina roƙonki ki ɗan sam mini manta-uwa ɗanki.”
english: Reuben went in the days of wheat harvest, and found mandrakes in the field, and brought them to his mother, Leah. Then Rachel said to Leah, “Please give me some of your son’s mandrakes.”

hausa: Amma aka kama dabbar tare da annabin ƙaryan nan wanda ya aikata alamu masu banmamaki a madadinta. Da waɗannan alamun ne ya ruɗe waɗanda suka sami alamar dabbar suka kuma bauta wa siffarta. Aka jefa dukansu biyu da rai cikin tafkin wuta ta da farar wuta mai ci.
english: The beast was taken, and with him the false prophet who worked the signs in his sight, with which he deceived those who had received the mark of the beast and those who worshiped his image. These two were thrown alive into the lake of fire that burns with sulfur.

hausa: Ba ta bar karuwancin da ta fara a Masar ba, sa’ad da take budurwa maza sun kwana da ita, suka rungumi ƙirjinta suka kuma biya kwaɗayinsu a kanta.
english: She hasn’t left her prostitution since leaving Egypt; for in her youth they lay with her. They caressed her youthful nipples and they poured out their prostitution on her.

hausa: Amma sarki ya ce, “Yă tafi gidansa; kada yă zo yă gan ni.” Saboda haka Absalom ya tafi gidansa, bai kuwa je ganin sarki ba.
english: The king said, “Let him return to his own house, but let him not see my face.” So Absalom returned to his own house, and didn’t see the king’s face.

hausa: Ku yi kururuwar yaƙi, ku ƙasashe, ku kuma ji tsoro! Ku saurara, dukanku manisantan ƙasashe. Ku shirya don yaƙi, ku kuma ji tsoro!
english: Make an uproar, you peoples, and be broken in pieces! Listen, all you from far countries: dress for battle, and be shattered! Dress for battle, and be shattered!

hausa: Saboda haka mutanena za su san sunana; saboda haka a wannan rana za su san cewa ni ne wanda ya faɗa wannan. I, ni ne.”
english: Therefore my people shall know my name. Therefore they shall know in that day that I am he who speaks. Behold, it is I.”

hausa: Yesu ya amsa ya ce, “Koyarwata ba tawa ba ce, ta fito ne daga wurin wanda ya aiko ni.
english: Jesus therefore answered them, “My teaching is not mine, but his who sent me.

hausa: “Saboda haka sai ku zauna a faɗake, gama ba ku san a wace rana ce Ubangijinku zai zo ba.
english: Watch therefore, for you don’t know in what hour your Lord comes.

hausa: Sowa ta farin ciki da nasara sun fito a cikin tentunan adalai, “Hannun dama na Ubangiji ya aikata manyan abubuwa!
english: The voice of rejoicing and salvation is in the tents of the righteous. “The right hand of Yahweh does valiantly.

hausa: sai ya sauka zuwa ɗakin magatakarda a fada, inda dukan fadawa suke zaune, Elishama magatakarda, Delahiya ɗan Shemahiya, Elnatan ɗan Akbor, Gemariya ɗan Shafan, Zedekiya ɗan Hananiya, da dukan sauran fadawa.
english: he went down into the king’s house, into the scribe’s room; and behold, all the princes were sitting there, Elishama the scribe, Delaiah the son of Shemaiah, Elnathan the son of Achbor, Gemariah the son of Shaphan, Zedekiah the son of Hananiah, and all the princes.

hausa: A reshe guda na wurin ajiye fitilan, akwai kwaf uku masu kama da tohon almon, akwai kuma uku a reshe na biye, haka kuma suke a dukan rassa shida da suke daga wurin ajiye fitilan.
english: three cups made like almond blossoms in one branch, a bud and a flower, and three cups made like almond blossoms in the other branch, a bud and a flower; so for the six branches going out of the lamp stand.

hausa: Yesu ya amsa ya ce, “Me aka rubuta a cikin Doka? Yaya kake karanta ta?”
english: He said to him, “What is written in the law? How do you read it?”

hausa: Firist zai bincike shi, in kuma mikin ya juya ya zama fari, firist zai furta mai cutar tsarkakakke; to, zai zama tsarkakakke.
english: The priest shall examine him. Behold, if the plague has turned white, then the priest shall pronounce him clean of the plague. He is clean.

hausa: Muna samun burodi a bakin rayukanmu domin takobin da yake a jeji.
english: We get our bread at the peril of our lives, because of the sword in the wilderness.

hausa: Ba wanda zai iya rabe tsakanin ihun farin ciki da na kuka, domin mutanen sun tā da murya sosai har aka ji su daga nesa.
english: so that the people could not discern the noise of the shout of joy from the noise of the weeping of the people; for the people shouted with a loud shout, and the noise was heard far away.

hausa: domin ina jin labari bangaskiyarka cikin Ubangiji Yesu da kuma ƙaunarka da kake yi saboda dukan tsarkaka.
english: hearing of your love and of the faith which you have toward the Lord Jesus and toward all the saints,

hausa: Saboda haka, kada wani yă yi taƙama da mutum! Gama kome naku ne,
english: Therefore let no one boast in men. For all things are yours,

hausa: Gama ina gab da fāɗuwa, kuma cikin azaba nake kullum.
english: For I am ready to fall. My pain is continually before me.

hausa: Maƙwabta da waɗanda suka saba ganinsa dā yana bara, suka ce, “Kai, ba wannan mutum ne ya saba zama yana bara ba?”
english: Therefore the neighbors and those who saw that he was blind before said, “Isn’t this he who sat and begged?”

hausa: Ubangiji ya ce wa Musa,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

hausa: Sa’an nan Shawulu ya gina wa Ubangiji bagade. Wannan ne bagade na farkon da ya gina.
english: Saul built an altar to Yahweh. This was the first altar that he built to Yahweh.

hausa: Tufafin Yohanna kuwa an yi su da gashin raƙumi ne, yana kuma daure da ɗamara ta fata. Abincinsa kuwa fāri ne da zumar jeji.
english: Now John himself wore clothing made of camel’s hair with a leather belt around his waist. His food was locusts and wild honey.

hausa: Sa’an nan Yesu ya hau gefen dutse ya zauna tare da almajiransa.
english: Jesus went up into the mountain, and he sat there with his disciples.

hausa: Gumakan al’ummai azurfa ne da zinariya, da hannuwan mutane suka yi.
english: The idols of the nations are silver and gold, the work of men’s hands.

hausa: Ba za ƙara kasance da mazauna kuma ba ko a yi zama a cikinta dukan zamanai; Ba wani mutumin Arab da zai kafa tentinsa a can, ba makiyayin da zai taɓa kiwon garkensa a can.
english: It will never be inhabited, neither will it be lived in from generation to generation. The Arabian will not pitch a tent there, neither will shepherds make their flocks lie down there.

hausa: “Sai yayan ya yi fushi, ya ƙi shiga gida. Sai mahaifinsa ya fita ya roƙe shi.
english: But he was angry and would not go in. Therefore his father came out and begged him.

hausa: Saboda haka sai Obadiya ya tafi wurin Ahab ya faɗa masa, Ahab kuwa ya tafi wurin Iliya.
english: So Obadiah went to meet Ahab, and told him; and Ahab went to meet Elijah.

hausa: gama ba su gaskata ga Allah ba ko su dogara ga cetonsa.
english: because they didn’t believe in God, and didn’t trust in his salvation.

hausa: Ubangiji ya ce mini, “Isra’ila marar bangaskiya ta fi Yahuda marar aminci.
english: Yahweh said to me, “Backsliding Israel has shown herself more righteous than treacherous Judah.

hausa: A ranan nan ruwan rai zai kwararo daga Urushalima, rabi zai gangara gabas zuwa teku rabi kuma zai gangara yamma zuwa Bahar Rum, a damina da rani.
english: It will happen in that day that living waters will go out from Jerusalem, half of them toward the eastern sea, and half of them toward the western sea. It will be so in summer and in winter.

hausa: Sa’ad da aka faɗa wa Solomon cewa, “Adoniya yana tsoron Sarki Solomon, kuma ya manne wa ƙahonin bagade. Yana cewa, ‘Bari Sarki Solomon yă rantse mini a yau cewa ba zai kashe bawansa da takobi ba.’ ”
english: Solomon was told, “Behold, Adonijah fears King Solomon; for, behold, he is hanging onto the horns of the altar, saying, ‘Let King Solomon swear to me first that he will not kill his servant with the sword.’”

hausa: Kada ka yi fariya a kan gobe gama ba san abin da ranar za tă kawo ba.
english: Don’t boast about tomorrow; for you don’t know what a day may bring.

hausa: Suka komo suka faɗa wa Yehu, wanda ya ce, “Wannan ita ce maganar da Ubangiji ya faɗa ta bakin bawansa Iliya mutumin Tishbe. A fili, a Yezireyel, karnuka za su cinye naman Yezebel.
english: Therefore they came back, and told him. He said, “This is Yahweh’s word, which he spoke by his servant Elijah the Tishbite, saying, ‘The dogs will eat the flesh of Jezebel on the plot of Jezreel,

hausa: A lokacin bakinka zai buɗe, za ka yi magana da shi ba kuwa za ka ƙara yin shiru ba. Ta haka za ka zama alama gare su, za su kuwa san cewa ni ne Ubangiji.”
english: In that day your mouth will be opened to him who has escaped, and you will speak and be no more mute. So you will be a sign to them. Then they will know that I am Yahweh.”

hausa: ga Allah na dogara; ba zan ji tsoro ba. Me mutum zai iya yi mini?
english: I have put my trust in God. I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?

hausa: Waɗanda suke nesa da kai za su hallaka; kakan hallaka dukan waɗanda suke maka rashin aminci.
english: For, behold, those who are far from you shall perish. You have destroyed all those who are unfaithful to you.

hausa: Ya zaɓar mana gādonmu, abar taƙamar Yaƙub, wanda yake ƙauna. Sela
english: He chooses our inheritance for us, the glory of Jacob whom he loved. Selah.

hausa: Ga Yahudawa na zama kamar mutumin Yahuda, domin in rinjayi Yahudawa. Ga waɗanda suke ƙarƙashin doka kuma, na zama kamar wanda yake ƙarƙashin Dokar (ko da yake ni kaina ba na ƙarƙashin Doka), domin in rinjayi waɗanda suke ƙarƙashin Doka.
english: To the Jews I became as a Jew, that I might gain Jews; to those who are under the law, as under the law, that I might gain those who are under the law;

hausa: Da kuma, “Ku yabi Ubangiji, dukanku Al’ummai, ku kuma rera masa yabo, dukanku mutanen duniya.”
english: Again, “Praise the Lord, all you Gentiles! Let all the peoples praise him.”

hausa: Amma Amaziya bai saurara ba, saboda haka Yehowash sarkin Isra’ila ya kai masa hari. Shi da Amaziya sarkin Yahuda suka fuskanci juna a Bet-Shemesh.
english: But Amaziah would not listen. So Jehoash king of Israel went up; and he and Amaziah king of Judah looked one another in the face at Beth Shemesh, which belongs to Judah.

hausa: Amoriyawan da suke zama a waɗannan tuddai, suka fito kamar tarin ƙudan zuma gāba da ku, suka kore ku, suka fatattake ku daga Seyir har zuwa Horma.
english: The Amorites, who lived in that hill country, came out against you and chased you as bees do, and beat you down in Seir, even to Hormah.

hausa: Sai Isra’ilawa suka rabu da gumakan Ba’al da Ashtarot suka bauta wa Ubangiji kaɗai.
english: Then the children of Israel removed the Baals and the Ashtaroth, and served Yahweh only.

hausa: Ina nan sa’ad da ya kafa sammai a wurarensu, sa’ad da ya shata sararin sama a kan fuskar zurfafa,
english: When he established the heavens, I was there. When he set a circle on the surface of the deep,

hausa: “ ‘Kada ku yi ta yawo kuna yaɗa ƙarya a cikin mutanenku. “ ‘Kada ku yi wani abin da zai sa ran maƙwabcinku cikin hatsari. Ni ne Ubangiji.
english: “‘You shall not go around as a slanderer among your people. “‘You shall not endanger the life of your neighbor. I am Yahweh.

hausa: Dukan yini na sha annoba; an hukunta ni kowace safiya.
english: For all day long I have been plagued, and punished every morning.

hausa: Gibeyonawa suka ce, “Ba mu da ’yanci mu nemi zinariya ko azurfa daga wurin Shawulu ko gidansa, ba mu kuwa da wani ’yanci mu sa a kashe wani a Isra’ila.” Dawuda ya ce, “To, me kuke so in yi muku?”
english: The Gibeonites said to him, “It is no matter of silver or gold between us and Saul or his house; neither is it for us to put any man to death in Israel.” He said, “I will do for you whatever you say.”

hausa: “Kai mene ne, ya babban dutse? A gaban Zerubbabel za a rushe ka ka zama fili. Sa’an nan Zerubbabel yă kawo dutsen da ya fi kyau, a kuma yi ta sowa ana cewa, ‘Allah yă yi masa albarka! Allah yă yi masa albarka!’ ”
english: Who are you, great mountain? Before Zerubbabel you are a plain; and he will bring out the capstone with shouts of ‘Grace, grace, to it!’”

hausa: Sai Dawuda da dukan mutanen da suke tare da shi suka yayyage rigunarsu.
english: Then David took hold of his clothes and tore them; and all the men who were with him did likewise.

hausa: Tsawon abin da ya rage a wurin, dab da tsattsarkan rabo, zai zama kamu 10,000 wajen gabas, kamu 10,000 kuma wajen yamma. Amfanin da zai bayar zai tanada abinci don ma’aikatan birnin.
english: The remainder of the length, alongside the holy offering, shall be ten thousand eastward and ten thousand westward; and it shall be alongside the holy offering. Its increase shall be for food to those who labor in the city.

hausa: Waɗanda suka yi rai na maharba, jarumawan Kedar, za su zama kaɗan.” Ubangiji, Allah na Isra’ila, ya faɗa.
english: and the residue of the number of the archers, the mighty men of the children of Kedar, will be few; for Yahweh, the God of Israel, has spoken it.”

hausa: Allahn kakanninmu ya tā da Yesu daga matattu, wanda kuka kashe ta wurin ratayewa a bisan itace.
english: The God of our fathers raised up Jesus, whom you killed, hanging him on a tree.

hausa: Sai ta amsa ta ce, “Ai, ba ni da miji.” Yesu ya ce mata, “Gaskiyarki da kika ce ba ki da miji.
english: The woman answered, “I have no husband.” Jesus said to her, “You said well, ‘I have no husband,’

hausa: Yanzu kuwa kun san abin da yake hana shi, wannan yana faruwa ne don a bayyana shi a daidai lokaci.
english: Now you know what is restraining him, to the end that he may be revealed in his own season.

hausa: Kai, ko jarumi mai zuciya kamar na zaki ma, zai narke don tsoro, gama dukan Isra’ila sun sani mahaifinka mayaƙi ne, sun kuma san cewa waɗanda suke tare da shi jarumawa ne.
english: Even he who is valiant, whose heart is as the heart of a lion, will utterly melt; for all Israel knows that your father is a mighty man, and those who are with him are valiant men.

hausa: A hannunsa ne zurfafan duniya suke, ƙwanƙolin dutse kuma nasa ne.
english: In his hand are the deep places of the earth. The heights of the mountains are also his.

hausa: Akwai bagaden katako mai tsayi kamu uku, fāɗinsa kamu biyu da kuma tsawonsa kamu biyu; kusurwansa, tushensa da kuma gefe-gefensa duk katako ne. Sai mutumin ya ce mini, “Wannan shi ne tebur da yake a gaban Ubangiji.”
english: The altar was of wood, three cubits high, and its length two cubits. Its corners, its base, and its walls were of wood. He said to me, “This is the table that is before Yahweh.”

hausa: Kada ku haɗa kai da marasa bi. Gama me ya haɗa adalci da mugunta? Ko kuwa me ya haɗa haske da duhu?
english: Don’t be unequally yoked with unbelievers, for what fellowship do righteousness and iniquity have? Or what fellowship does light have with darkness?

hausa: Masu aikin tufafi ransu zai ɓace, kuma dukan masu samun albashi za su damu.
english: The pillars will be broken in pieces. All those who work for hire will be grieved in soul.

hausa: Hukunci ya zo wa tudu, zuwa Holon, Yahza da Mefa’at,
english: Judgment has come on the plain country— on Holon, on Jahzah, on Mephaath,

hausa: Waɗannan su ne ’ya’yan Isra’ila maza. Ruben, Simeyon, Lawi, Yahuda, Issakar, Zebulun,
english: These are the sons of Israel: Reuben, Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, Zebulun,

hausa: Sai suka kawo su a gaban alƙalai suka ce, “Waɗannan Yahudawa ne, suna kuma birkitar mana da gari,
english: When they had brought them to the magistrates, they said, “These men, being Jews, are agitating our city

hausa: “Ubangiji zai ceci wuraren zaman Yahuda da farko, don kada darajar gidan Dawuda da mazaunan Urushalima su fi na Yahuda daraja.
english: Yahweh also will save the tents of Judah first, that the glory of David’s house and the glory of the inhabitants of Jerusalem not be magnified above Judah.

hausa: A shekara ta fari da mulkin Dariyus ɗan Zerzes (wanda yake Bamediye), wanda aka mai da shi sarki a masarautar Babiloniyawa
english: In the first year of Darius the son of Ahasuerus, of the offspring of the Medes, who was made king over the realm of the Chaldeans—

hausa: Ubangiji ya ce wa Musa,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

hausa: Daga Ferga kuwa suka ci gaba zuwa Antiyok na Fisidiya. A ranar Asabbaci sai suka shiga majami’a suka zauna.
english: But they, passing on from Perga, came to Antioch of Pisidia. They went into the synagogue on the Sabbath day and sat down.

hausa: Amma hafsan ya bar waɗansu daga cikin mafiya talauci na ƙasar don su yi aiki a lambunan inabi da kuma gonaki.
english: But the captain of the guard left some of the poorest of the land to work the vineyards and fields.

hausa: Ina saurara da marmari da kuma bege cewa ba zan taɓa shan kunya ba, sai dai zan sami issashen ƙarfin hali yanzu kamar kullum, za a ɗaukaka Kiristi a jikina, ko ta wurin rayuwa ko kuma ta wurin mutuwa.
english: according to my earnest expectation and hope, that I will in no way be disappointed, but with all boldness, as always, now also Christ will be magnified in my body, whether by life or by death.

hausa: Kada ka ja ni tare da mugaye, tare da masu yin mugunta, masu magana kamar ta alheri ce da maƙwabtansu amma suna riƙe da su a zukatansu.
english: Don’t draw me away with the wicked, with the workers of iniquity who speak peace with their neighbors, but mischief is in their hearts.

hausa: Baruk ya amsa ya ce, “I, shi ne ya faɗa mini dukan wannan magana, na kuwa rubuta su a takarda.”
english: Then Baruch answered them, “He dictated all these words to me with his mouth, and I wrote them with ink in the book.”

hausa: Ubangiji ne ya yi haka, kuma abu mai daraja ne a idanunmu.
english: This is Yahweh’s doing. It is marvelous in our eyes.

hausa: Mun zama abin reni ga maƙwabta, abin ba’a da reni ga waɗanda suke kewaye da mu.
english: We have become a reproach to our neighbors, a scoffing and derision to those who are around us.

hausa: Gama dukan Annabawa da kuma Doka sun yi ta annabci har yă zuwa kan Yohanna.
english: For all the prophets and the law prophesied until John.

hausa: Kalmomin Nehemiya ɗan Hakaliya. A cikin watan Kisleb a shekara ta ashirin, yayinda nake a fadar Shusha.
english: The words of Nehemiah the son of Hacaliah. Now in the month Chislev, in the twentieth year, as I was in Susa the palace,

hausa: Yakan ragargaza waɗanda suka shiga hannu, su fāɗi; sukan fāɗi a ƙarƙashin ƙarfinsa.
english: The helpless are crushed. They collapse. They fall under his strength.

hausa: Zadok yana nan tare da su, kuma dukan Lawiyawan da suke tare da shi kuwa suna ɗauke da akwatin alkawarin Allah. Suka sauke akwatin alkawarin Allah, Abiyatar ya miƙa hadaya sai da mutane suka gama fita daga birnin.
english: Behold, Zadok also came, and all the Levites with him, bearing the ark of the covenant of God; and they set down God’s ark; and Abiathar went up until all the people finished passing out of the city.

hausa: Da tsada fa aka saye ku, kada ku zama bayin mutane.
english: You were bought with a price. Don’t become bondservants of men.

hausa: Ku gai da dukan shugabanninku da kuma dukan mutanen Allah. Waɗanda suke Italiya suna gaishe ku.
english: Greet all of your leaders and all the saints. The Italians greet you.

hausa: Sai ya ce mini, “Wannan ce la’anar da za tă ratsa dukan ƙasar; gama bisa ga abin da ya ce a gefe ɗaya, za a kawar da kowane ɓarawo, kuma bisa ga abin da ya ce a ɗaya gefen za a kawar da duk mai rantsuwar ƙarya.
english: Then he said to me, “This is the curse that goes out over the surface of the whole land, for everyone who steals shall be cut off according to it on the one side; and everyone who swears falsely shall be cut off according to it on the other side.

hausa: Zuriyar mutanen Benyamin daga Geba sun zauna a Mikmash, da Aiya, da Betel da ƙauyukanta,
english: The children of Benjamin also lived from Geba onward, at Michmash and Aija, and at Bethel and its towns,

hausa: Sai Ibrahim ya yi addu’a ga Allah, Allah kuma ya warkar da Abimelek, da matarsa da bayinsa mata domin su haihu,
english: Abraham prayed to God. So God healed Abimelech, his wife, and his female servants, and they bore children.

hausa: Abram ya kuma ce, “Ga shi ba ka ba ni ɗa ba, don haka bawan da aka haifa a gidana ne zai zama magājina.”
english: Abram said, “Behold, you have given no children to me: and, behold, one born in my house is my heir.”

hausa: Zakoki suna ruri suna gurnani; duk da haka an karya haƙoran manyan zakoki.
english: The roaring of the lion, and the voice of the fierce lion, the teeth of the young lions, are broken.

hausa: Yawan mutanen sashensa 40,500 ne.
english: His division, and those who were counted of them, were forty thousand five hundred.

hausa: “ ‘In wani ya kwana da mace wadda take baiwa, wadda aka yi wa wani alkawari amma bai fanshe ta ba, ko kuwa ba a ’yantar da ita ba, dole a yi hukuncin da ya dace. Duk da haka ba za a kashe su ba, domin ba a ’yantar da ita ba.
english: “‘If a man lies carnally with a woman who is a slave girl, pledged to be married to another man, and not ransomed or given her freedom; they shall be punished. They shall not be put to death, because she was not free.

hausa: Ga shi kuma ya zo nan da izinin manyan firistoci, don yă kama duk wanda yake kiran bisa sunanka.”
english: Here he has authority from the chief priests to bind all who call on your name.”

hausa: Ku kiyaye umarnaina kuma kada yi ku wata al’ada mai banƙyamar da aka yi kafin ku zo kuma kada ku ƙazantar da kanku da su. Ni ne Ubangiji Allahnku.’ ”
english: Therefore you shall keep my requirements, that you do not practice any of these abominable customs which were practiced before you, and that you do not defile yourselves with them. I am Yahweh your God.’”

hausa: Za ka ci amfanin aikinka; albarku da wadata za su zama naka.
english: For you will eat the labor of your hands. You will be happy, and it will be well with you.

hausa: Aka gaya wa sarkin Yeriko cewa, “Ji fa, waɗansu Isra’ilawa sun shigo nan da dare don su leƙi asirin ƙasar.”
english: The king of Jericho was told, “Behold, men of the children of Israel came in here tonight to spy out the land.”

hausa: Sun yi ƙoƙari su kashe ni a cikin rami suka kuma jajjefe ni da duwatsu;
english: They have cut off my life in the dungeon, and have cast a stone on me.

hausa: Ina so in san Kiristi da ikon tashinsa daga matattu da kuma zumuncin tarayya cikin shan wahalarsa, in kuma zama kamar sa a cikin mutuwarsa,
english: that I may know him and the power of his resurrection, and the fellowship of his sufferings, becoming conformed to his death,

hausa: Hadayar da ya kawo ita ce, faranti guda ɗaya na azurfa, nauyinsa shekel ɗari ɗaya da talatin, da kuma daro na yayyafawa na azurfa, nauyinsa shekel saba’in, dukan biyu, an auna su bisa ga ma’aunin shekel na tsattsarkan wuri, kowannensu cike da lallausan gari, haɗe da mai kamar hadaya ta gari;
english: gave his offering: one silver platter, the weight of which was one hundred thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary, both of them full of fine flour mixed with oil for a meal offering;

hausa: Dukan waɗannan zuriyar Asher ne, kawunan iyalai, zaɓaɓɓun mutane, jarumawa sosai da kuma fitattun shugabanni. Yawan mutanen da suke a shirye don yaƙi, kamar yadda aka lissafta zuriyarsu, 26,000 ne.
english: All these were the children of Asher, heads of the fathers’ houses, choice and mighty men of valor, chief of the princes. The number of them listed by genealogy for service in war was twenty-six thousand men.

hausa: Saboda haka Yesu bai ƙara tafiya a cikin Yahudawa a sarari ba. A maimako haka sai ya janye zuwa yankin kusa da hamada, a wani ƙauye da ake kira Efraim, inda ya zauna da almajiransa.
english: Jesus therefore walked no more openly among the Jews, but departed from there into the country near the wilderness, to a city called Ephraim. He stayed there with his disciples.

hausa: Amma sa’ad da suka je don su binne ta, ba su sami kome ba sai ƙoƙon kanta, ƙafafunta da kuma hannuwanta.
english: They went to bury her, but they found no more of her than the skull, the feet, and the palms of her hands.

hausa: Za a duhunta rana da wata, taurari kuma ba za su ba da haske ba.
english: The sun and the moon are darkened, and the stars withdraw their shining.

hausa: ’Ya’yan Musa maza su ne, Gershom da Eliyezer.
english: The sons of Moses: Gershom and Eliezer.

hausa: A can za ku bauta wa allolin da mutum ya yi, na itace da dutse da ba sa gani, ba sa ji, ba sa ci, ba kuma iya sansanawa.
english: There you will serve gods, the work of men’s hands, wood and stone, which neither see, nor hear, nor eat, nor smell.

hausa: Waɗansu irin suka fāɗi a cikin ƙaya, ƙayan kuwa ta yi girma ta shaƙe su.
english: Others fell among thorns. The thorns grew up and choked them.

hausa: “Ban jibge wannan a ma’ajiya na kuma yimƙe shi a taskokina ba?
english: “Isn’t this laid up in store with me, sealed up among my treasures?

hausa: “Yanzu fa ku shirya sabon keken shanu da shanu biyu masu ba wa ’ya’yansu nono, waɗanda ba a taɓa sa musu karkiya ba. Ku daure keken shanu wa shanun, amma ku tsare ’yan maruƙansu a gida.
english: “Now therefore take and prepare yourselves a new cart and two milk cows on which there has come no yoke; and tie the cows to the cart, and bring their calves home from them;

hausa: Na ba da labari hanyoyina ka kuma amsa mini; ka koya mini ƙa’idodinka.
english: I declared my ways, and you answered me. Teach me your statutes.

hausa: Sai sarki ya kira Ziba bawan Shawulu, ya ce masa, “Na ba wa jikan maigidanka kome da yake na Shawulu da iyalinsa
english: Then the king called to Ziba, Saul’s servant, and said to him, “All that belonged to Saul and to all his house I have given to your master’s son.

hausa: Muddin ɗan Yesse yana da rai a duniya, ba za ka kahu ba. Sarautarka kuma ba za tă kahu ba. Yanzu sai ka je ka kawo mini shi. Dole yă mutu.”
english: For as long as the son of Jesse lives on the earth, you will not be established, nor will your kingdom. Therefore now send and bring him to me, for he shall surely die!”

hausa: Bari Ubangiji yă sa ku ƙaru, da ku da ’ya’yanku.
english: May Yahweh increase you more and more, you and your children.

hausa: Ya tā mana ƙahon ceto a gidan bawansa Dawuda
english: and has raised up a horn of salvation for us in the house of his servant David

hausa: Suka bubbuga zinariya ta zama falle, suka yayyanka ta zare-zare don su yi saƙa da ita, tare da zane na shuɗi, da na shunayya, da na jan zare, da na lallausan lilin, aikin gwani mai fasaha.
english: They beat the gold into thin plates, and cut it into wires, to work it in with the blue, the purple, the scarlet, and the fine linen, the work of the skillful workman.

hausa: Ba shi da jagora ba shugaba ko mai mulki,
english: which having no chief, overseer, or ruler,

hausa: Yesu ya amsa ya ce, “Ai, na gaya muku ni ne shi. In kuma ni ne kuke nema, to, sai ku bar waɗannan su tafi.”
english: Jesus answered, “I told you that I am he. If therefore you seek me, let these go their way,”

hausa: Bari a ɗaukaka ka, ya Allah, bisa sammai; bari ɗaukakarka ta kasance a dukan duniya.
english: Be exalted, God, above the heavens! Let your glory be above all the earth!

hausa: Sa’an nan Yoshuwa ya yi alkawari zaman salama da su, cewa ba zai kashe su ba, sai shugabannin mutanen Isra’ila kuwa suka tabbatar musu da haka ta wurin yin rantsuwa.
english: Joshua made peace with them, and made a covenant with them, to let them live. The princes of the congregation swore to them.

hausa: Sai Musa da Haruna suka fāɗi rubda ciki a gaban jama’ar Isra’ilawa da suka taru a can.
english: Then Moses and Aaron fell on their faces before all the assembly of the congregation of the children of Israel.

hausa: “Zuwa ga mala’ikan ikkilisiya a Fergamum, ka rubuta, Waɗannan su ne kalmomin wannan wanda yake da takobi mai kaifi biyu.
english: “To the angel of the assembly in Pergamum write: “He who has the sharp two-edged sword says these things:

hausa: Sa’an nan Mika ya ce masa, “Ka zauna tare da ni ka zama mini mahaifi da firist, zan kuwa ba ka azurfa goma na shekel a shekara, tufafinka da kuma abincinka.” Sai Balawen ya tafi.
english: Micah said to him, “Dwell with me, and be to me a father and a priest, and I will give you ten pieces of silver per year, a suit of clothing, and your food.” So the Levite went in.

hausa: Ba muguntarka ce ta yi yawa ba? Ba zunubanka ne ba iyaka ba?
english: Isn’t your wickedness great? Neither is there any end to your iniquities.

hausa: In ba ka bar mutanena suka tafi ba, zan turo da tarin ƙuda a kanka da bayinka, a kan mutanenka da cikin gidajenka. Gidajen Masarawa za su cika da ƙudaje, har ma da ƙasa inda za su taka.
english: Else, if you will not let my people go, behold, I will send swarms of flies on you, and on your servants, and on your people, and into your houses. The houses of the Egyptians shall be full of swarms of flies, and also the ground they are on.

hausa: Muna kuma gode wa Allah ba fasawa domin, sa’ad da kuka karɓi maganar Allah, wadda kuka ji daga gare mu, kun karɓe ta ba kamar maganar mutane ba, sai dai kamar yadda take, maganar Allah wadda take aiki a cikinku ku da kuka ba da gaskiya.
english: For this cause we also thank God without ceasing that when you received from us the word of the message of God, you accepted it not as the word of men, but as it is in truth, God’s word, which also works in you who believe.

hausa: Zai kashe mazaunan filin ƙasar da takobi; zai yi miki ƙawanya, ya gina miki mahaurai, sa’an nan ya rufe ki da garkuwoyi.
english: He will kill your daughters in the field with the sword. He will make forts against you, cast up a mound against you, and raise up the buckler against you.

hausa: Yayinda kike can kina magana da sarki, zan shiga in kuma tabbatar da abin da kika faɗa.”
english: Behold, while you are still talking there with the king, I will also come in after you and confirm your words.”

hausa: Sai Ubangiji ya aiki Yerub-Ba’al da Bedan da Yefta da Sama’ila, ya cece ku daga hannun abokan gābanku a kowane gefe domin ku sami cikakken zaman lafiya.
english: Yahweh sent Jerubbaal, Bedan, Jephthah, and Samuel, and delivered you out of the hand of your enemies on every side; and you lived in safety.

hausa: Sa’ad da kuka ji labarun yaƙe-yaƙe da jita-jitar yaƙe-yaƙe, kada hankalinku yă tashi. Dole irin waɗannan abubuwa su faru. Amma ƙarshen tukuna.
english: “When you hear of wars and rumors of wars, don’t be troubled. For those must happen, but the end is not yet.

hausa: Suka tashi daga Obot, suka yi sansani a Iye Abarim, a iyakar Mowab.
english: They traveled from Oboth, and encamped in Iye Abarim, in the border of Moab.

hausa: Sai wani girgije ya bayyana, ya rufe su, wata murya kuma ta fito daga girgijen, ta ce, “Wannan Ɗana ne, wanda nake ƙauna, ku saurare shi!”
english: A cloud came, overshadowing them, and a voice came out of the cloud, “This is my beloved Son. Listen to him.”

hausa: Sai Musa ya ce, “Wannan abin mamaki ne, don me wannan itace bai ƙone ba? Bari in matso kusa in gani.”
english: Moses said, “I will go now, and see this great sight, why the bush is not burned.”

hausa: ga shi na gina haikali mai daraja dominka, inda za ka zauna har abada.”
english: I have surely built you a house of habitation, a place for you to dwell in forever.”

hausa: Ubangiji, ya hana ni in yi miki ɓarna. Da ba don kin zo kin sadu da ni ba, na rantse da Ubangiji, Allah na Isra’ila Mai Rai, babu ko ɗaya daga cikin mazan gidan Nabal da zai rage gobe da safe.”
english: For indeed, as Yahweh the God of Israel lives, who has withheld me from harming you, unless you had hurried and come to meet me, surely there wouldn’t have been left to Nabal by the morning light so much as one who urinates on a wall.”

hausa: da Adoniya, da Bigwai, da Adin,
english: Adonijah, Bigvai, Adin,

hausa: A babban gida akwai kayayyakin da ba na zinariya da na azurfa kaɗai ba, amma har da na katako da na yumɓu ma; waɗansu domin hidima mai daraja waɗansu kuwa domin hidima marar daraja.
english: Now in a large house there are not only vessels of gold and of silver, but also of wood and of clay. Some are for honor and some for dishonor.

hausa: Ina rubuta muku, ’ya’yana ƙaunatattu, domin an gafarta muku zunubanku saboda sunansa.
english: I write to you, little children, because your sins are forgiven you for his name’s sake.

hausa: Kada kowa yă kasance a Tentin Sujada daga lokacin da Haruna ya shiga don yă yi kafara a Wuri Mafi Tsarki har sai ya fita, bayan ya yi kafara domin kansa, gidansa da kuma dukan jama’ar Isra’ila.
english: No one shall be in the Tent of Meeting when he enters to make atonement in the Holy Place, until he comes out, and has made atonement for himself and for his household, and for all the assembly of Israel.

hausa: Amasa kuwa yana kwance cikin tafkin jininsa a kan hanya, sai mutumin ya ga dukan sojoji suka zo suka tsaya cik a can. Da ya gane cewa duk wanda ya haura zuwa wurin Amasa sai ya tsaya, sai ya ja gawar Amasa daga hanyar ya kai can cikin wani fili ya rufe shi da zane.
english: Amasa lay wallowing in his blood in the middle of the highway. When the man saw that all the people stood still, he carried Amasa out of the highway into the field, and cast a garment over him when he saw that everyone who came by him stood still.

hausa: Yesu ya yi kuka.
english: Jesus wept.

hausa: Daga cikin hayaƙin kuwa fāri suka fito zuwa cikin duniya aka kuma ba su iko irin na kunaman duniya.
english: Then out of the smoke came locusts on the earth, and power was given to them, as the scorpions of the earth have power.

hausa: Attajiri zai kwanta, amma daga wannan shi ke nan; lokacin da zai buɗe idanunsa, kome ya tafi.
english: He lies down rich, but he will not do so again. He opens his eyes, and he is not.

hausa: Ke kyakkyawa ce, ƙaunatacciyata! Kai, ke kyakkyawa ce! Idanunki kamar na kurciya ne.
english: Behold, you are beautiful, my love. Behold, you are beautiful. Your eyes are like doves.

hausa: Da yake an tashe ku tare da Kiristi, sai ku sa zukatanku a kan abubuwan da suke sama, inda Kiristi yake zaune a hannun dama na Allah.
english: If then you were raised together with Christ, seek the things that are above, where Christ is, seated on the right hand of God.

hausa: Sa’ad da na ce ga iyakar inda za ka kai, ga inda raƙuman ruwanka za su tsaya?
english: and said, ‘You may come here, but no further. Your proud waves shall be stopped here’?

hausa: Sa’ad da aka faɗa wa Fir’auna cewa Isra’ilawa sun gudu, sai Fir’auna da bayinsa suka canja ra’ayinsu game da su, suka ce, “Me muka yi? Mun bar Isra’ilawa suka tafi, mun kuwa rasa hidimarsu!”
english: The king of Egypt was told that the people had fled; and the heart of Pharaoh and of his servants was changed toward the people, and they said, “What is this we have done, that we have let Israel go from serving us?”

hausa: “In bijimin mutum ya raunana bijimin wani, har ya mutu, sai mutanen biyu su sayar da mai ran, su raba kuɗin daidai, haka ma su yi da mai ran.
english: “If one man’s bull injures another’s, so that it dies, then they shall sell the live bull, and divide its price; and they shall also divide the dead animal.

hausa: Kuna ƙoƙari ku kauce wa wannan muguwar rana kuna kuma jawo mulkin tashin hankali kusa.
english: Alas for you who put far away the evil day, and cause the seat of violence to come near,

hausa: Kabilar Merari ne aka sa su lura da katakan tabanakul, sandunanta, dogayen sandunanta, tarukanta, dukan kayan aiki da kowane abin da ya danganci aikinsu,
english: The appointed duty of the sons of Merari shall be the tabernacle’s boards, its bars, its pillars, its sockets, all its instruments, all its service,

hausa: Sa’an nan ya ce mini, “Ka yi annabci wa numfashi; ka yi annabci, ɗan mutum, ka ce masa, ‘Ga abin da Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka yana cewa ka fito daga kusurwoyi huɗu, ya numfashi, ka kuma numfasa cikin waɗannan matattu, don su rayu.’ ”
english: Then he said to me, “Prophesy to the wind, prophesy, son of man, and tell the wind, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “Come from the four winds, breath, and breathe on these slain, that they may live.”’”

hausa: Yoshuwa ya ce wa mutane, “Ku tsarkake kanku, gama gobe Ubangiji zai yi abubuwan al’ajabi a cikinku.”
english: Joshua said to the people, “Sanctify yourselves; for tomorrow Yahweh will do wonders among you.”

hausa: sai suka sa shi a gidan waƙafi don ba su riga sun san abin da za a yi da shi ba tukuna.
english: They put him in custody, because it had not been declared what should be done to him.

hausa: Sai mala’ikan da ya yi magana da ni ya komo ya farkar da ni, kamar yadda ake farkar da mutum daga barcinsa.
english: The angel who talked with me came again and wakened me, as a man who is wakened out of his sleep.

hausa: Yanzu, a hannunka muke, ka yi duk abin da ka ga ya yi maka kyau.”
english: Now, behold, we are in your hand. Do to us as it seems good and right to you to do.”

hausa: Bari in ji farin ciki da murna; bari ƙasusuwan da ka ragargaza su yi farin ciki.
english: Let me hear joy and gladness, that the bones which you have broken may rejoice.

hausa: Da safe, hargitsin da ya tashi tsakanin sojojin ba ƙarami ba ne, a kan abin da ya sami Bitrus.
english: Now as soon as it was day, there was no small stir among the soldiers about what had become of Peter.

hausa: Gama gidanta yana kai ga mutuwa hanyarta kuma ga ruhohin matattu.
english: for her house leads down to death, her paths to the departed spirits.

hausa: Amma sa’ad da suka kama ku, kada ku damu game da abin da za ku faɗa ko kuwa yadda za ku faɗe shi. A lokacin za a ba ku abin da za ku faɗa,
english: But when they deliver you up, don’t be anxious how or what you will say, for it will be given you in that hour what you will say.

hausa: Sa’an nan za su kasance da garuruwan da za su zauna, su sami fili, da kuma za su yi kiwon garkensu na shanu da tumaki da kuma sauran dabbobinsu.
english: They shall have the cities to dwell in. Their pasture lands shall be for their livestock, and for their possessions, and for all their animals.

hausa: Amma ina gaya muku cewa mutane za su ba da lissafi a ranar shari’a a kan kowace kalmar banza da suka faɗa.
english: I tell you that every idle word that men speak, they will give account of it in the day of judgment.

hausa: Bawanku ya riga ya sami tagomashi daga gare ku, kun kuma nuna mini alheri mai yawa. Ba zan iya in gudu zuwa duwatsu ba, wannan masifa za tă same ni, zan kuma mutu.
english: See now, your servant has found favor in your sight, and you have magnified your loving kindness, which you have shown to me in saving my life. I can’t escape to the mountain, lest evil overtake me, and I die.

hausa: A ce baba ya tattaɓa ni fa? Zai zama kamar ina ruɗunsa ne, wannan fa zai jawo mini la’ana a maimakon albarka.”
english: What if my father touches me? I will seem to him as a deceiver, and I would bring a curse on myself, and not a blessing.”

hausa: Ba wanda zai yi tsayayya da kai dukan kwanakin ranka. Yadda na kasance tare da Musa, haka zan kasance tare da kai; ba zan taɓa rabuwa da kai ba; ba zan yashe ka ba.
english: No man will be able to stand before you all the days of your life. As I was with Moses, so I will be with you. I will not fail you nor forsake you.

hausa: Ku danƙa masa dukan damuwarku, domin shi ne yake lura da ku.
english: casting all your worries on him, because he cares for you.

hausa: Ba na zama tare da masu ruɗu, ko in yi tarayya da masu riya;
english: I have not sat with deceitful men, neither will I go in with hypocrites.

hausa: Adoniya, wanda mahaifiyarsa ce Haggit, ya fito ya ce, “Zan zama sarki.” Saboda haka ya nemi kekunan yaƙi, ya kuma shirya dawakai, tare da mutane hamsin da za su sha gabansa.
english: Then Adonijah the son of Haggith exalted himself, saying, “I will be king.” Then he prepared him chariots and horsemen, and fifty men to run before him.

hausa: Shi ne ya halicci Mafarauci da Kare da Zomo, da Kaza, da ’Ya’yanta da tarin taurari a sama, da taurarin kudu.
english: He makes the Bear, Orion, and the Pleiades, and the rooms of the south.

hausa: Yayinda suke ratsa ƙasar, in waninsu ya ga ƙashin mutum, zai kafa shi kamar alama a gefe sai masu haƙa kabari sun binne shi a Kwarin Haman Gog.
english: Those who search through the land will pass through; and when anyone sees a man’s bone, then he will set up a sign by it, until the undertakers have buried it in the valley of Hamon Gog.

hausa: Adalcinka dawwammame ne dokar kuma gaskiya ce.
english: Your righteousness is an everlasting righteousness. Your law is truth.

hausa: “Kwana bakwai za ka tanada bunsuru kullum domin hadaya don zunubi; za ka kuma tanada ɗan bijimi da rago daga garke, dukansu marasa lahani.
english: “Seven days you shall prepare every day a goat for a sin offering. They shall also prepare a young bull and a ram out of the flock, without defect.

hausa: “Yi magana da Isra’ilawa, ka ce musu, ‘Ga ƙayyadaddun bukukkuwa, ƙayyadaddun bukukkuwan Ubangiji, da za ku sanar wa mutane su riƙa kiyayewa, su zama lokutan tarurruka masu tsarki.
english: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘The set feasts of Yahweh, which you shall proclaim to be holy convocations, even these are my set feasts.

hausa: Saboda haka, da yake muna kewaye da irin wannan taron shaidu mai girma, sai mu yar da duk abin da yake hana mu da kuma zunubin da yake saurin daure mu, mu kuma yi tseren da aka sa a gabanmu da nacewa.
english: Therefore let’s also, seeing we are surrounded by so great a cloud of witnesses, lay aside every weight and the sin which so easily entangles us, and let’s run with perseverance the race that is set before us,

hausa: Ku kuma ɗauki hular kwano na ceto, da takobin Ruhu, wato, Maganar Allah.
english: And take the helmet of salvation, and the sword of the Spirit, which is the word of God;

hausa: A wannan rana, aka ba wa sarki rahoton yawan mutanen da aka kashe a mazaunin masarauta, a Shusha.
english: On that day, the number of those who were slain in the citadel of Susa was brought before the king.

hausa: Bari mu zaɓi abin da yake daidai, bari mu koyi abin da yake mai kyau tare.
english: Let us choose for us that which is right. Let us know among ourselves what is good.

hausa: Bayan ya yi kwanaki takwas ko goma tare da su, sai ya gangara zuwa Kaisariya, kashegari kuma ya kira a yi zaman kotu ya kuma umarta a kawo Bulus a gabansa.
english: When he had stayed among them more than ten days, he went down to Caesarea, and on the next day he sat on the judgment seat, and commanded Paul to be brought.

hausa: Sai ya sa sandunan a cikin rammukan da suke gefen Akwatin don ɗaukarsa.
english: He put the poles into the rings on the sides of the ark, to bear the ark.

hausa: Ka yi hankali ɗana, game da duk wani ƙari a kan waɗannan. Wallafa littattafai ba shi da iyaka, kuma yawan karatu yakan gajiyar da jiki.
english: Furthermore, my son, be admonished: of making many books there is no end; and much study is a weariness of the flesh.

hausa: Zedekiya ɗan Kena’ana kuwa ya yi ƙahonin ƙarfe ya kuma furta, “Ga abin da Ubangiji ya ce, ‘Da waɗannan za ka tunkuyi Arameyawa har su hallaka.’ ”
english: Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah made himself horns of iron, and said, “Yahweh says, ‘With these you will push the Syrians, until they are consumed.’”

hausa: Amma da Yahudawa suka ƙi, sai ya zama mini dole in ɗaukaka ƙara zuwa gaban Kaisar ba don ina da wani zargin da zan kawo game da mutanena ba.
english: But when the Jews spoke against it, I was constrained to appeal to Caesar, not that I had anything about which to accuse my nation.

hausa: Sukan wage mini bakinsu suna cewa, “Allah yă ƙara! Da idanunmu mun gani.”
english: Yes, they opened their mouth wide against me. They said, “Aha! Aha! Our eye has seen it!”

hausa: Amma mutumin da ya yi zina ba shi da hankali; duk wanda ya yi haka yana hallaka kansa ne.
english: He who commits adultery with a woman is void of understanding. He who does it destroys his own soul.

hausa: Isra’ila da Filistiyawa suka ja dāgā suna fuskantar junansu.
english: Israel and the Philistines put the battle in array, army against army.

hausa: Suka ƙetare ta hanya, suka kuma ce, “Za mu kwana a Geba.” Rama ta firgita; Gibeya ta Shawulu ta gudu.
english: They have gone over the pass. They have taken up their lodging at Geba. Ramah trembles. Gibeah of Saul has fled.

hausa: Ya jefar da mayafinsa waje ɗaya, ya yi wuf, ya zo wurin Yesu.
english: He, casting away his cloak, sprang up, and came to Jesus.

hausa: Nebuzaradan, babban hafsan, ya kwashe su duka ya kawo su wurin sarkin Babilon a Ribla.
english: Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard took them, and brought them to the king of Babylon to Riblah.

hausa: A wannan lokaci ne Hezekiya sarkin Yahuda ya ɓaɓɓalle zinariyan da aka dalaye ƙofofi da madogaran ƙofofin haikalin Ubangiji, ya ba sarkin Assuriya.
english: At that time, Hezekiah cut off the gold from the doors of Yahweh’s temple, and from the pillars which Hezekiah king of Judah had overlaid, and gave it to the king of Assyria.

hausa: Yanzu, ya Ubangiji Allahnmu, ka cece mu daga hannunsa, saboda masarautai a duniya su san cewa kai kaɗai ne, ya Ubangiji, Allah.”
english: Now therefore, Yahweh our God, save us from his hand, that all the kingdoms of the earth may know that you are Yahweh, even you only.”

hausa: Na yi tunani, “Waɗannan ne kawai matalauta; su wawaye ne, gama ba su san hanyar Ubangiji ba, ko abubuwan da Allahnsu yake bukata ba.
english: Then I said, “Surely these are poor. They are foolish; for they don’t know Yahweh’s way, nor the law of their God.

hausa: Sai Ahimawaz ya tā da murya ya ce wa sarki, “Kome lafiya yake!” Sai ya rusuna har ƙasa a gaban sarki ya ce, “Yabo ya tabbata ga Ubangiji Allahnka! Ya ba da mutanen da suka tayar wa ranka yă daɗe a hannunsa.”
english: Ahimaaz called, and said to the king, “All is well.” He bowed himself before the king with his face to the earth, and said, “Blessed is Yahweh your God, who has delivered up the men who lifted up their hand against my lord the king!”

hausa: A wannan rana za su cewa Urushalima, “Kada ki ji tsoro, ya Sihiyona; kada ki bar hannuwanki su raunana.
english: In that day, it will be said to Jerusalem, “Don’t be afraid, Zion. Don’t let your hands be weak.”

hausa: Ku gode wa Ubangiji, gama nagari ne shi; ƙaunarsa madawwamiya ce har abada.
english: Give thanks to Yahweh, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.

hausa: Amma in mutumin ya yi dabara har ya kashe wani mutum da gangan, sai a ɗauke shi daga bagadena a kashe shi.
english: If a man schemes and comes presumptuously on his neighbor to kill him, you shall take him from my altar, that he may die.

hausa: Saboda haka Abimelek da dukan mutanensa suka tashi da dare suka ɓuya kusa da Shekem a ƙungiyoyi huɗu.
english: Abimelech rose up, and all the people who were with him, by night, and they laid wait against Shechem in four companies.

hausa: Ka ba mu gudummawa a kan abokin gāba, gama taimakon mutum banza ne.
english: Give us help against the adversary, for the help of man is vain.

hausa: A shirya su jeri biyu, guda shida a kowane jeri a kan teburin da aka yi da zinariya zalla, a gaban Ubangiji.
english: You shall set them in two rows, six on a row, on the pure gold table before Yahweh.

hausa: In suna so su yi tambaya game da wani abu, ya kamata su tambayi mazansu a gida, domin abin kunya ne mace tă yi magana a cikin ikkilisiya.
english: if they desire to learn anything. “Let them ask their own husbands at home, for it is shameful for a wife to be talking in the assembly.”

hausa: Bari mu yi ɗan ɗaki a rufin gida mu kuma sa masa gado da tebur da kujera da kuma fitila. Saboda a duk lokacin da ya zo wurinmu, sai yă sauka a can.”
english: Please, let’s make a little room on the roof. Let’s set a bed, a table, a chair, and a lamp stand for him there. When he comes to us, he can stay there.”

hausa: Sauran ayyukan sauratar Abiya, abin da ya yi da abin da ya faɗa, a rubuce suke a cikin rubuce-rubucen annabi Iddo.
english: The rest of the acts of Abijah, his ways, and his sayings are written in the commentary of the prophet Iddo.

hausa: Don me ka fitar da mu daga Masar zuwa wannan banzan wuri, inda babu hatsi ko ɓaure, inabi ko rumman. Kuma babu ruwan da za a sha?”
english: Why have you made us to come up out of Egypt, to bring us in to this evil place? It is no place of seed, or of figs, or of vines, or of pomegranates; neither is there any water to drink.”

hausa: Sa’ad da Arfakshad ya yi shekara 35, sai ya haifi Shela.
english: Arpachshad lived thirty-five years and became the father of Shelah.

hausa: Ƙasar da ta kama daga hamada zuwa Lebanon, zuwa babban Kogin, wato, Kogin Yuferites, da dukan ƙasar Hittiyawa zuwa Bahar Rum, wajen yamma.
english: From the wilderness and this Lebanon even to the great river, the river Euphrates, all the land of the Hittites, and to the great sea toward the going down of the sun, shall be your border.

hausa: To, da Abner ya komo Hebron, Yowab ya ratse da shi zuwa hanyar shigar gari kamar zai gana da shi a kaɗaice. Amma a can ya soki Abner a ciki, ya kashe shi don yă rama mutuwar ɗan’uwansa Asahel.
english: When Abner had returned to Hebron, Joab took him aside into the middle of the gate to speak with him quietly, and struck him there in the body, so that he died for the blood of Asahel his brother.

hausa: Ya ce, “Bari Allah yă yi mini hukunci mai tsanani har ma fiye da haka, idan ban cire kan Elisha ɗan Shafat yau ba!”
english: Then he said, “God do so to me, and more also, if the head of Elisha the son of Shaphat stays on him today.”

hausa: Mun san cewa mu ’ya’yan Allah ne, duniya duka kuwa tana hannun Mugun.
english: We know that we are of God, and the whole world lies in the power of the evil one.

hausa: tuna da Ubangiji Allahnsu, wanda ya cece su daga hannuwan abokan gābansu a kowane gefe ba.
english: The children of Israel didn’t remember Yahweh their God, who had delivered them out of the hand of all their enemies on every side;

hausa: Zebadiya, Arad, Eder,
english: Zebadiah, Arad, Eder,

hausa: Don mai bi da kaɗe-kaɗe. Zabura ta Dawuda. Wata waƙa. Yabo ya dace da kai, ya Allah, a Sihiyona; a gare ka za mu cika alkawuranmu
english: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. A song. Praise waits for you, God, in Zion. Vows shall be performed to you.

hausa: Za tă bi kwartayenta amma ba za tă kama su ba; za tă neme su amma ba za tă same su ba. Sa’an nan za tă ce, ‘Zan koma ga mijina na fari, gama dā ya fi mini yadda nake a yanzu.’
english: She will follow after her lovers, but she won’t overtake them; and she will seek them, but won’t find them. Then she will say, ‘I will go and return to my first husband, for then it was better with me than now.’

hausa: Ba wanda yake mūsun Ɗan, sa’an nan yă ce yana da Uban; duk wanda ya yarda da Ɗan, yana da Uban a cikinsa ke nan.
english: Whoever denies the Son doesn’t have the Father. He who confesses the Son has the Father also.

hausa: A can, akwai wani bawan wani jarumin yana ciwo, yana kuma a bakin mutuwa. Maigidansa kuwa yana sonsa sosai.
english: A certain centurion’s servant, who was dear to him, was sick and at the point of death.

hausa: Saboda haka ya ɗauki wata hanya, bai kuwa koma ta hanyar da ya zo Betel ba.
english: So he went another way, and didn’t return by the way that he came to Bethel.

hausa: A maimakon haka dole yă zama mai karɓan baƙi, mai son abu nagari, mai kamunkai, mai adalci, mai tsarki da kuma natsattse.
english: but given to hospitality, a lover of good, sober minded, fair, holy, self-controlled,

hausa: Don mai bi da kaɗe-kaɗe. Tare da kayan kiɗi masu tsirkiya. Zabura. Waƙa. Bari Allah yă yi mana alheri yă kuma albarkace mu yă kuma sa fuskarsa ta haskaka a kanmu, Sela
english: For the Chief Musician. With stringed instruments. A Psalm. A song. May God be merciful to us, bless us, and cause his face to shine on us. Selah.

hausa: Sai suka sāke kiran mutumin nan da yake makaho a dā, suka ce masa, “Ka ɗaukaka Allah, mu kam, mun san mutumin nan mai zunubi ne.”
english: So they called the man who was blind a second time, and said to him, “Give glory to God. We know that this man is a sinner.”

hausa: Kiristi ya fanshe mu daga la’anar Doka ta wurin zama la’ana saboda mu, gama a rubuce yake cewa, “La’ananne ne duk wanda aka rataye a kan itace.”
english: Christ redeemed us from the curse of the law, having become a curse for us. For it is written, “Cursed is everyone who hangs on a tree,”

hausa: Sa’an nan ya ce wa mutumin, “Miƙa hannunka.” Sai ya miƙa, hannunsa kuwa ya koma lafiyayye, kamar dai ɗayan.
english: Then he told the man, “Stretch out your hand.” He stretched it out; and it was restored whole, just like the other.

hausa: Ya ce, “Ya Ubangiji, in na sami tagomashi a idanunka, bari Ubangiji yă tafi tare da mu. Ko da yake wannan mutane masu taurinkai ne, ka gafarta muguntanmu da zunubanmu, ka kuma sāke sa mu zama abin gādonka.”
english: He said, “If now I have found favor in your sight, Lord, please let the Lord go among us, even though this is a stiff-necked people; pardon our iniquity and our sin, and take us for your inheritance.”

hausa: Ban da haka ma, ƙwarƙwararsa, mai suna Reyuma, ta haifa masa ’ya’ya maza, Teba, Gaham, Tahash da kuma Ma’aka.
english: His concubine, whose name was Reumah, also bore Tebah, Gaham, Tahash, and Maacah.

hausa: A sa’a ɗaya Allah yake hallaka su, cikin fushinsa yakan hallaka su.
english: By the breath of God they perish. By the blast of his anger are they consumed.

hausa: Ahaziya yana da shekara ashirin da biyu sa’ad da ya zama sarki, ya kuma yi mulki a Urushalima shekara ɗaya. Sunan mahaifiyarsa Ataliya, jikanyar Omri, sarkin Isra’ila.
english: Ahaziah was twenty-two years old when he began to reign; and he reigned one year in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Athaliah the daughter of Omri king of Israel.

hausa: Amma yaya zan ɗauka dukan damuwoyinku da nawayarku da kuma faɗace-faɗacenku duka ni kaɗai?
english: How can I myself alone bear your problems, your burdens, and your strife?

hausa: “Mika mutumin Moreshet, ya yi annabci a kwanakin Hezekiya sarkin Yahuda. Ya ce wa dukan mutanen Yahuda, ‘Ga abin da Ubangiji Maɗaukaki yana cewa, “ ‘Za a nome Sihiyona kamar gona, Urushalima kuwa za tă zama tsibin juji, ƙwanƙolin dutsen haikali kuwa zai zama kurmi.’
english: “Micah the Morashtite prophesied in the days of Hezekiah king of Judah; and he spoke to all the people of Judah, saying, ‘Yahweh of Armies says: “‘Zion will be plowed as a field, and Jerusalem will become heaps, and the mountain of the house as the high places of a forest.’

hausa: game da rijiyar da ’ya’yan sarki suka haƙa, rijiyar da manyan mutane masu sandunan sarauta suka nuna da sandunansu.” Sa’an nan suka tashi daga hamadar, suka tafi Mattana,
english: the well, which the princes dug, which the nobles of the people dug, with the scepter, and with their poles.” From the wilderness they traveled to Mattanah;

hausa: Da yake ku ’ya’ya ne, sai Allah ya aiko da Ruhun Ɗansa a cikin zukatanmu, Ruhun da yake kira, “Abba, Uba.”
english: And because you are children, God sent out the Spirit of his Son into your hearts, crying, “Abba, Father!”

hausa: Aka yanka ragunan Bikin Ƙetarewa, firistoci kuma suka yayyafa jinin da aka ba su, yayinda Lawiyawa suna fiɗan dabbobi.
english: They killed the Passover lambs, and the priests sprinkled the blood which they received from their hands, and the Levites skinned them.

hausa: Sai ya ɗora kansa ya zama mai girma kamar Sarkin runduna; sai aka ɗauke hadaya ta kullayaumi daga gare shi, aka kuma saukar da wurin masujadarsa ƙasa.
english: Yes, it magnified itself, even to the prince of the army; and it took away from him the continual burnt offering, and the place of his sanctuary was cast down.

hausa: Amma Yesu bai ce uffam game da ko ɗaya daga cikin zargin da suka yi masa ba. Har gwamna ya yi mamaki ƙwarai.
english: He gave him no answer, not even one word, so that the governor marveled greatly.

hausa: musamman ma domin ka saba sosai da dukan al’adun Yahudawa da kuma maganganunsu. Saboda haka ina roƙonka ka saurare ni da haƙuri.
english: especially because you are expert in all customs and questions which are among the Jews. Therefore I beg you to hear me patiently.

hausa: Sai ya ce musu, “Duk wanda ya karɓi wannan ƙaramin yaron a cikin sunana, ni ya karɓa, kuma duk wanda ya karɓe ni, ya karɓi wanda ya aiko ni ne. Gama mafi ƙanƙanta duka a cikinku, shi ne kuma mafi girma.”
english: and said to them, “Whoever receives this little child in my name receives me. Whoever receives me receives him who sent me. For whoever is least among you all, this one will be great.”

hausa: Kun san ba ma taɓa yin daɗin baki ko mu yi ƙoƙarin kasance da halin kwaɗayin da muke ɓoyewa, Allah shi ne shaidarmu.
english: For neither were we at any time found using words of flattery, as you know, nor a cloak of covetousness (God is witness),

hausa: Duk da haka waɗansu mutane suka fita a ranar Asabbaci don su tattara, amma ba su sami kome ba.
english: On the seventh day, some of the people went out to gather, and they found none.

hausa: Kun riga kun zama masu tsabta saboda maganar da na yi muku.
english: You are already pruned clean because of the word which I have spoken to you.

hausa: yana ce musu, “Ku je ƙauyen da yake gabanku, nan take za ku ga wata jaka a daure tare da ɗanta kusa da ita, a can. Ku kunce su ku kawo mini.
english: saying to them, “Go into the village that is opposite you, and immediately you will find a donkey tied, and a colt with her. Untie them and bring them to me.

hausa: don da yardar Allah, in iso wurinku da farin ciki in kuma wartsake tare da ku.
english: that I may come to you in joy through the will of God, and together with you, find rest.

hausa: Ayarin Tema sun nemi ruwa, matafiya ’yan kasuwa Sheba sun nema cike da begen samu.
english: The caravans of Tema looked. The companies of Sheba waited for them.

hausa: Bayan shekaru biyu cif, Fir’auna ya yi mafarki. A mafarkin, ya ga yana tsaye kusa da Nilu,
english: At the end of two full years, Pharaoh dreamed, and behold, he stood by the river.

hausa: babu wani mai fahimta, babu wani mai neman Allah.
english: There is no one who understands. There is no one who seeks after God.

hausa: In fa haka ne, ko da yake ku mugaye ne, kun san ba ’ya’yanku kyautai masu kyau, balle fa Ubanku na sama, zai yi fiye da haka, ta wurin ba da Ruhu Mai Tsarki, ga masu roƙonsa!”
english: If you then, being evil, know how to give good gifts to your children, how much more will your heavenly Father give the Holy Spirit to those who ask him?”

hausa: To, da yake kun fiffita a kowane abu cikin bangaskiya, cikin magana, cikin sani, cikin dukan ƙwazo, da kuma cikin ƙaunarku dominmu, sai ku fiffita a wannan aikin alheri ma.
english: But as you abound in everything—in faith, utterance, knowledge, all earnestness, and in your love to us—see that you also abound in this grace.

hausa: Abin da ya sa dukanku kuka gama baki a kaina? Ba wanda ya gaya mini lokacin da ɗana ya yi yarjejjeniya da ɗan Yesse, ba wanda ya kulla da ni, ko ya gaya mini cewa ɗana ya sa bawana yă tayar mini, yana fakona kamar yadda yake a yau.”
english: Is that why all of you have conspired against me, and there is no one who discloses to me when my son makes a treaty with the son of Jesse, and there is none of you who is sorry for me, or discloses to me that my son has stirred up my servant against me, to lie in wait, as it is today?”

hausa: Ya ci gaba daga Betel (wato, Luz), ya zarce zuwa sashen Arkitawa na Atarot,
english: It went out from Bethel to Luz, and passed along to the border of the Archites to Ataroth;

hausa: Ku kwashi garkunanku na tumaki da na awaki, da na shanu, ku yi tafiyarku kamar yadda kuka ce, amma ku sa mini albarka.”
english: Take both your flocks and your herds, as you have said, and be gone; and bless me also!”

hausa: (Manasse ne yake da ƙasar Taffuwa, amma garin Taffuwa kansa, a kan iyakar Manasse ta mutanen Efraim ce.)
english: The land of Tappuah belonged to Manasseh; but Tappuah on the border of Manasseh belonged to the children of Ephraim.

hausa: Gama ni matalauci ne mai bukata kuma, zuciyata kuwa ta yi rauni a cikina.
english: for I am poor and needy. My heart is wounded within me.

hausa: Akwai ƙofa zuwa filin ciki wadda take fuskantar ƙofar arewa, kamar dai yadda take a gabas. Ya auna daga ƙofa zuwa ƙofar da take ɗaura ta ita; ya sami kamu ɗari.
english: There was a gate to the inner court facing the other gate, on the north and on the east. He measured one hundred cubits from gate to gate.

hausa: Ta haka Yusuf ya saya wa Fir’auna ƙasar Masar duka, gama Masarawa duka sun sayar da gonakinsu, saboda yunwa ta tsananta musu. Ƙasar ta zama mallakar Fir’auna.
english: So Joseph bought all the land of Egypt for Pharaoh, for every man of the Egyptians sold his field, because the famine was severe on them, and the land became Pharaoh’s.

hausa: Kuna cewa, “Yaushe Sabon Wata zai wuce don mu sayar da hatsi, Asabbaci ta wuce, don mu sayar da alkama?” Mu yi awo da ma’aunin zalunci mu ƙara kuɗin kaya mu kuma cutar da mai saya,
english: saying, ‘When will the new moon be gone, that we may sell grain? And the Sabbath, that we may market wheat, making the ephah small, and the shekel large, and dealing falsely with balances of deceit;

hausa: Kada ma ku yi tunani a ranku cewa, ‘Ai, Ibrahim ne mahaifinmu.’ Ina gaya muku cewa Allah zai iya tā da ’ya’ya wa Ibrahim daga cikin duwatsun nan.
english: Don’t think to yourselves, ‘We have Abraham for our father,’ for I tell you that God is able to raise up children to Abraham from these stones.

hausa: Mutanen Isra’ila suka ɗiba daga cikin abincin tafiyar amma ba su nemi nufin Ubangiji ba.
english: The men sampled their provisions, and didn’t ask counsel from Yahweh’s mouth.

hausa: Duk wanda ya yi wa mahaifin ko mahaifiyarsa sata ya kuma ce, “Ai, ba laifi ba ne” abokin mai hallakarwa ne shi.
english: Whoever robs his father or his mother and says, “It’s not wrong,” is a partner with a destroyer.

hausa: Ku tattaru, ku tattaru, Ya ku al’umma marar kunya,
english: Gather yourselves together, yes, gather together, you nation that has no shame,

hausa: Amma Allah ya ce wa Yunana, “Daidai ne ka yi fushi saboda wannan kuringa?” Sai Yunana ya ce, “I, daidai ne, ina fushi matuƙa, har ina so da na mutu ma.”
english: God said to Jonah, “Is it right for you to be angry about the vine?” He said, “I am right to be angry, even to death.”

hausa: shanu 36,000, shanun da aka ware wa Ubangiji kuwa 72 ne;
english: The cattle were thirty-six thousand, of which Yahweh’s tribute was seventy-two.

hausa: Yana dagula shirye-shiryen masu wayo don kada su yi nasara cikin abubuwan da suke shirin yi.
english: He frustrates the plans of the crafty, so that their hands can’t perform their enterprise.

hausa: Kursiyi mai daraja, da aka ɗaukaka tun daga farko, shi ne wuri mai tsarkinmu.
english: A glorious throne, set on high from the beginning, is the place of our sanctuary.

hausa: amma ya nemi Allah na kakansa ya kuma bi umarnansa a maimakon ayyukan da Isra’ila ke yi.
english: but sought the God of his father, and walked in his commandments, and not in the ways of Israel.

hausa: Suna magana da juna a kan dukan abubuwan da suka faru.
english: They talked with each other about all of these things which had happened.

hausa: Sa’an nan ya sāke kwana da matarsa, sai ta yi ciki ta haifi ɗa. Ya ba shi suna Beriya, saboda masifar da ta auko a cikin iyalinsa.
english: He went in to his wife, and she conceived and bore a son, and he named him Beriah, because there was trouble with his house.

hausa: Na kiyaye ƙafafuna daga kowace muguwar hanya domin in yi biyayya da maganarka.
english: I have kept my feet from every evil way, that I might observe your word.

hausa: “Tafi ka tattara dattawan Isra’ila, ka ce musu, ‘Ubangiji, Allah na kakanninku, Allah na Ibrahim, Ishaku da Yaƙub, ya bayyana a gare ni ya ce, Na lura da ku, na kuma ga abubuwan da ake yi muku a Masar.
english: Go and gather the elders of Israel together, and tell them, ‘Yahweh, the God of your fathers, the God of Abraham, of Isaac, and of Jacob, has appeared to me, saying, “I have surely visited you, and seen that which is done to you in Egypt.

hausa: Saboda haka ya je gunsa ya sumbace shi. Sa’ad da Ishaku ya ji ƙanshin rigunansa, sai ya sa masa albarka ya ce, “Aha, ƙanshin ɗana yana kama da ƙanshin jejin da Ubangiji ya sa wa albarka ne.
english: He came near, and kissed him. He smelled the smell of his clothing, and blessed him, and said, “Behold, the smell of my son is as the smell of a field which Yahweh has blessed.

hausa: Yayinda Yosiya yake sarki, Fir’auna Neko, sarkin Masar ya haura zuwa Kogin Yuferites don yă taimaki sarkin Assuriya da yaƙi. Sarki Yosiya kuwa ya yi ƙoƙari ya hana shi wucewa, sa’ad da Fir’auna Neko ya gan shi, sai ya kashe shi a filin yaƙi a Megiddo.
english: In his days Pharaoh Necoh king of Egypt went up against the king of Assyria to the river Euphrates; and King Josiah went against him, but Pharaoh Necoh killed him at Megiddo when he saw him.

hausa: Allah bai ƙi mutanensa da ya rigya sani ba. Ba ku san abin da Nassi ya faɗa game da Iliya ba, yadda ya kawo kuka ga Allah a kan Isra’ila ya ce,
english: God didn’t reject his people, whom he foreknew. Or don’t you know what the Scripture says about Elijah? How he pleads with God against Israel:

hausa: Gwamma a ɗaura dutsen niƙa a wuyansa, a jefa shi cikin teku, da ya sa ɗaya daga cikin ƙananan yaran nan ya yi zunubi.
english: It would be better for him if a millstone were hung around his neck, and he were thrown into the sea, rather than that he should cause one of these little ones to stumble.

hausa: ya aike su wurin Ubangiji, su tambaya su ce, “Kai ne wanda zai zo, ko kuma mu saurari wani dabam?”
english: John, calling to himself two of his disciples, sent them to Jesus, saying, “Are you the one who is coming, or should we look for another?”

hausa: Sai fadawa suka ce wa sarki, “Ya kamata a kashe wannan mutum. Yana karya zuciyar sojojin da suka ragu a birnin, da zuciyar sauran mutane, ta wurin abubuwan da yake faɗa musu. Wannan mutum ba ya neman jin daɗin zaman wannan sai dai wahala.”
english: Then the princes said to the king, “Please let this man be put to death, because he weakens the hands of the men of war who remain in this city, and the hands of all the people, in speaking such words to them; for this man doesn’t seek the welfare of this people, but harm.”

hausa: Dukan Isra’ila sun karya dokokinka suka kuma juya maka baya, sun ƙi yi maka biyayya. “Saboda haka la’anoni da rantsuwar hukunce-hukuncen da suke a rubuce a cikin Dokar Musa, bawan Allah, sun kama mu domin mun yi maka zunubi.
english: Yes, all Israel have transgressed your law, turning aside, that they should not obey your voice. “Therefore the curse and the oath written in the law of Moses the servant of God has been poured out on us, for we have sinned against him.

hausa: Da Bilatus ya ga cewa ba ya kaiwa ko’ina, sai ma hargitsi ne yake so yă tashi, sai ya ɗibi ruwa, ya wanke hannuwansa a gaban taron ya ce, “Ni kam, ba ruwana da alhakin jinin mutumin nan. Wannan ruwanku ne!”
english: So when Pilate saw that nothing was being gained, but rather that a disturbance was starting, he took water and washed his hands before the multitude, saying, “I am innocent of the blood of this righteous person. You see to it.”

hausa: dukan waɗannan yanzu suka sadu da manyan gari ’yan’uwansu, suka rantse, cewa la’ana ta same su idan ba su kiyaye Dokar Allah da aka bayar ta wurin Musa bawan Allah su kuma mai da hankali ga yin biyayya da dukan umarnai, ƙa’idodi da farillan Ubangiji shugabanmu ba.
english: joined with their brothers, their nobles, and entered into a curse and into an oath, to walk in God’s law, which was given by Moses the servant of God, and to observe and do all the commandments of Yahweh our Lord, and his ordinances and his statutes;

hausa: Saboda wannan, Allah ya yashe su ga sha’awace-sha’awacensu masu banƙyama. Har matansu suka sauya daga haɗuwar mace da miji wadda ita ce daidai bisa ga halitta zuwa haɗuwa da ’yan’uwansu mata wadda ba daidai ba.
english: For this reason, God gave them up to vile passions. For their women changed the natural function into that which is against nature.

hausa: Suka ragargaza garuruwa, kowane mutum kuwa ya jefa dutse a kowane gona mai kyau har sai da aka rufe gonakin gaba ɗaya. Suka tattoshe duk maɓulɓulan ruwa, suka kuma sare duk itace mai kyau. Kir Hareset ne kaɗai aka bari tare da duwatsunsa yadda suke, amma mutanen da suke da majajjawa suka yi wa birnin zobe, suka kai masa hari shi ma.
english: They beat down the cities; and on every good piece of land each man cast his stone, and filled it. They also stopped all the springs of water and cut down all the good trees, until in Kir Hareseth all they left was its stones; however the men armed with slings went around it and attacked it.

hausa: “Ko kuma in na kawo takobi a kan wannan ƙasa na kuma ce, ‘Bari takobin ya ratsa cikin dukan ƙasar,’ na kuma kashe mutanenta da dabbobinsu,
english: “Or if I bring a sword on that land, and say, ‘Sword, go through the land, so that I cut off from it man and animal’—

hausa: Ka mai da mu tarkace da juji a cikin mutane.
english: You have made us an off-scouring and refuse in the middle of the peoples.

hausa: Yahudawa ma suka goyi bayan zargin, suna tabbatar cewa waɗannan abubuwa haka suke.
english: The Jews also joined in the attack, affirming that these things were so.

hausa: “Je ka faɗa wa Hananiya cewa, ‘Ga abin da Ubangiji yana cewa, ka karya karkiyar katako, amma a wurinsa za ka sami karkiyar ƙarfe.
english: “Go, and tell Hananiah, saying, ‘Yahweh says, “You have broken the bars of wood, but you have made in their place bars of iron.”

hausa: An yi wannan kuwa don kada mu koma zama kamar yara, muna ta canja zukatanmu game da abin da muka gaskata don kawai wani ya faɗa mana wani abu dabam, ko domin wani ya yi wayo ya ruɗe mu, ya sa ƙarya ta zama kamar gaskiya.
english: that we may no longer be children, tossed back and forth and carried about with every wind of doctrine, by the trickery of men, in craftiness, after the wiles of error;

hausa: Za ka tashi ka kuma ji tausayin Sihiyona, gama lokaci ne na nuna alheri gare ta; ƙayyadadden lokacin ya zo.
english: You will arise and have mercy on Zion, for it is time to have pity on her. Yes, the set time has come.

hausa: Mala’iku huɗun nan kuwa da aka shirya musamman don wannan sa’a da kuma don wannan rana da wata da kuma shekara aka sake su domin su kashe kashi ɗaya bisa uku na ’yan Adam.
english: The four angels were freed who had been prepared for that hour and day and month and year, so that they might kill one third of mankind.

hausa: Hezekiya ya riga ya yi tambaya ya ce, “Me zai zama alama ta cewa zan haura zuwa haikalin Ubangiji?”
english: Hezekiah also had said, “What is the sign that I will go up to Yahweh’s house?”

hausa: ga abin da Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka yana cewa ka kunce rawanin, ka ɗauke rawanin nan. Ba zai zama kamar yadda yake ba. Za a ɗaukaka ƙasƙantacce, amma a ƙasƙantar da mai girma.
english: the Lord Yahweh says: “Remove the turban, and take off the crown. This will not be as it was. Exalt that which is low, and humble that which is high.

hausa: Domin waɗanda Ruhun Allah yake bi da su ne ’ya’yan Allah.
english: For as many as are led by the Spirit of God, these are children of God.

hausa: Ruben ya amsa, “Ban faɗa muku cewa kada ku ɗauki alhakin yaron nan ba, sai kuka ƙi ji, to, yau ga alhakin jininsa muke biya.”
english: Reuben answered them, saying, “Didn’t I tell you, saying, ‘Don’t sin against the child,’ and you wouldn’t listen? Therefore also, behold, his blood is required.”

hausa: Dole dukan taron jama’ar Isra’ila su yi bikin.
english: All the congregation of Israel shall keep it.

hausa: Lokacin da akwatin alkawarin Ubangiji ya kai wata bakwai a ƙasar Filistiyawa.
english: Yahweh’s ark was in the country of the Philistines seven months.

hausa: Zan ba da su duka kamar ganima ga baƙi da kuma kamar abin da aka washe ga mugayen duniya, za su kuma ƙazantar da su.
english: I will give it into the hands of the strangers for a prey, and to the wicked of the earth for a plunder; and they will profane it.

hausa: biye da shi, Yehozabad, yana da sojoji 18,000 shiryayyu don yaƙi.
english: and next to him Jehozabad, and with him one hundred eighty thousand ready and prepared for war.

hausa: Ta haka fa aka yi dukan hidimar Ubangiji a wannan rana, domin su kiyaye Bikin Ƙetarewa, domin kuma su miƙa hadayu na ƙonawa a bisa bagaden Ubangiji, yadda sarki Yosiya ya umarta.
english: So all the service of Yahweh was prepared the same day, to keep the Passover, and to offer burnt offerings on Yahweh’s altar, according to the commandment of King Josiah.

hausa: Game da gwauraye masu ƙuruciya kuwa, kada ka sa su cikin wannan lissafi. Gama sa’ad da sha’awar jikinsu ta kāsa daurewa game da wa’adin da suka yi da Kiristi, sai su so yin aure.
english: But refuse younger widows, for when they have grown wanton against Christ, they desire to marry,

hausa: Bayan Ubangiji Allahnku ya kore su a gabanku, kada ku faɗa a zuciyarku, “Ubangiji ya kawo mu a nan, mu mallaki wannan ƙasa saboda adalcinmu ne.” A’a, saboda muguntar waɗannan al’umma ne ya sa Ubangiji ya kore su a gabanku.
english: Don’t say in your heart, after Yahweh your God has thrust them out from before you, “For my righteousness Yahweh has brought me in to possess this land;” because Yahweh drives them out before you because of the wickedness of these nations.

hausa: Amma ku, abokaina ƙaunatattu, ku gina kanku cikin bangaskiyarku mafi tsarki, ku kuma yi addu’a cikin Ruhu Mai Tsarki.
english: But you, beloved, keep building up yourselves on your most holy faith, praying in the Holy Spirit.

hausa: Ƙafafu huɗun suna a ƙarƙashin ɓangarorin, aka kuma haɗa gindin ƙafafun keken da dakalin. Tsayin kowace ƙafa kamu ɗaya da rabi ne.
english: The four wheels were underneath the panels; and the axles of the wheels were in the base. The height of a wheel was a cubit and half a cubit.

hausa: “ ‘A dukan lokacin da yake a kan alkawarin keɓewarsa, reza ba zai taɓa kansa. Dole yă kasance da tsarki har ƙarshen keɓewarsa ga Ubangiji; tilas yă bar gashin kansa yă yi tsawo.
english: “‘All the days of his vow of separation no razor shall come on his head, until the days are fulfilled in which he separates himself to Yahweh. He shall be holy. He shall let the locks of the hair of his head grow long.

hausa: Mutane ba sa ƙyale ɓarawo in ya yi sata don yă ƙosar da yunwarsa sa’ad da yake jin yunwa.
english: Men don’t despise a thief if he steals to satisfy himself when he is hungry,

hausa: Bayan Natan ya tafi gida, sai Ubangiji ya bugi yaron da matar Uriya ta haifa wa Dawuda, ya kuwa kamu da ciwo.
english: Then Nathan departed to his house. Yahweh struck the child that Uriah’s wife bore to David, and he was very sick.

hausa: Shugabannin iyali cikin zuriyar Lawi har zuwa lokacin Yohanan ɗan Eliyashib, an rubuta su a cikin littafin tarihi.
english: The sons of Levi, heads of fathers’ households, were written in the book of the chronicles, even until the days of Johanan the son of Eliashib.

hausa: “Ku zo gare ni, dukanku da kuka gaji kuke kuma fama da kaya, zan kuwa ba ku hutu.
english: “Come to me, all you who labor and are heavily burdened, and I will give you rest.

hausa: An kawo masu hikima da masu dabo a gabana domin su karanta wannan rubutu su kuma faɗa mini abin da yake nufi, amma ba su iya ba.
english: Now the wise men, the enchanters, have been brought in before me, that they should read this writing, and make known to me its interpretation; but they could not show the interpretation of the thing.

hausa: Sa’an nan Ubangiji Allah ya yi mace daga haƙarƙarin da ya ɗauko daga mutumin, ya kuwa kawo ta wurin mutumin.
english: Yahweh God made a woman from the rib which he had taken from the man, and brought her to the man.

hausa: Ubangiji, Ubangiji Maɗaukaki, shi da yakan taɓa ƙasa sai ta narke, kuma dukan mazauna cikinta suna makoki, ƙasar gaba ɗaya takan hau ta kuma sauka kamar Nilu, sa’an nan ta nutse kamar kogin Masar,
english: For the Lord, Yahweh of Armies, is he who touches the land and it melts, and all who dwell in it will mourn; and it will rise up wholly like the River, and will sink again, like the River of Egypt.

hausa: Amma Allah zai harbe su da kibiyoyi; nan da nan za a buge su su fāɗi.
english: But God will shoot at them. They will be suddenly struck down with an arrow.

hausa: Sai ya ƙara da cewa, “Zunubansu da kurakuransu ba zan ƙara tunawa da su ba.”
english: “I will remember their sins and their iniquities no more.”

hausa: Ku wuce, ku wuce ƙofofi! Ku shirya hanya saboda mutane. Ku gina, ku gina babbar hanya! Ku kawar da duwatsu. Ku ɗaga tuta saboda al’ummai.
english: Go through, go through the gates! Prepare the way of the people! Build up, build up the highway! Gather out the stones! Lift up a banner for the peoples.

hausa: Sai ya ba su abin da suka roƙa, amma ya aika musu da muguwar cuta.
english: He gave them their request, but sent leanness into their soul.

hausa: Da suka ga ƙarfin halin Bitrus da Yohanna suka kuma gane cewa su marasa ilimi ne, talakawa kuma, sai suka yi mamaki suka kuma lura cewa waɗannan mutane sun kasance tare da Yesu.
english: Now when they saw the boldness of Peter and John, and had perceived that they were unlearned and ignorant men, they marveled. They recognized that they had been with Jesus.

hausa: Na so in san abin da ya sa suke zarginsa, saboda haka na kawo shi a gaban Majalisarsu.
english: Desiring to know the cause why they accused him, I brought him down to their council.

hausa: ’Ya’yansu za su kasance kamar a kwanakin dā jama’arsu kuma za su kahu a gabana; zan hukunta duk wanda ya zalunce su.
english: Their children also will be as before, and their congregation will be established before me. I will punish all who oppress them.

hausa: Arauna ya ce wa Dawuda, “Bari ranka yă daɗe, sarki yă ɗauki duk abin da ya ga dama yă miƙa shi. Ga shanu, don hadaya ta ƙonawa, ga kuma kayan masussuka da itacen shanu, don itace.”
english: Araunah said to David, “Let my lord the king take and offer up what seems good to him. Behold, the cattle for the burnt offering, and the threshing sledges and the yokes of the oxen for the wood.

hausa: “Ku komo, ku mutane marasa bangaskiya,” in ji Ubangiji, “gama ni ne mijinku. Zan ɗauke ku, ɗaya daga garuruwanku da kuma biyu daga zuriyarku in kawo ku a Sihiyona.
english: “Return, backsliding children,” says Yahweh, “for I am a husband to you. I will take one of you from a city, and two from a family, and I will bring you to Zion.

hausa: A lokacin dai mutane suna miƙa hadaya a wurare a bisa tuddai, domin ba a riga an gina haikali saboda Sunan Ubangiji ba.
english: However, the people sacrificed in the high places, because there was not yet a house built for Yahweh’s name.

hausa: Bulus ya amsa ya ce, “Ni mutumin Yahuda ne, daga Tarshish a Silisiya shahararren birnin nan. In ka yarda bari in yi wa mutane magana.”
english: But Paul said, “I am a Jew from Tarsus in Cilicia, a citizen of no insignificant city. I beg you, allow me to speak to the people.”
