hausa: Duk sa’ad da Lawiyawa suka fito da akwatin zuwa ga hafsoshin sarki, suka kuma ga cewa akwatin yana da kuɗi mai yawa, sai magatakardan fada da hafsan babban firist su zo su juya kuɗin daga akwatin su mai da shi wurinsa. Sun riƙa yin haka kullum suka tara kuɗi mai yawa.
english: Whenever the chest was brought to the king’s officers by the hand of the Levites, and when they saw that there was much money, the king’s scribe and the chief priest’s officer came and emptied the chest, and took it, and carried it to its place again. Thus they did day by day, and gathered money in abundance.

hausa: Ba ku saya wani turaren kalamus domina ba ko ku gamshe ni da kitsen hadayunku. Amma kun nawaita ni da zunubanku kuka kuma gajiyar da ni da laifofinku.
english: You have bought me no sweet cane with money, nor have you filled me with the fat of your sacrifices, but you have burdened me with your sins. You have wearied me with your iniquities.

hausa: “Ga abin da Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka ya ce Urushalima ce wannan, wadda na kafa a tsakiyar al’ummai, da ƙasashe kewaye da ita a ko’ina.
english: “The Lord Yahweh says: ‘This is Jerusalem. I have set her in the middle of the nations, and countries are around her.

hausa: Cikin hasala ka ratsa duniya cikin fushi kuma ka tattake ƙasashe.
english: You marched through the land in wrath. You threshed the nations in anger.

hausa: Sarki ya ba da umarnin da gaggawa kuma wutar ta yi zafi ƙwarai har harshen wutar ya kashe sojojin nan da suka ɗauki Shadrak, Meshak da Abednego,
english: Therefore because the king’s commandment was urgent and the furnace exceedingly hot, the flame of the fire killed those men who took up Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego.

hausa: In waninsu ya fāɗi a cikin tukunyar laka, kome da yake a tukunyar zai ƙazantu, kuma dole a fashe tukunyar.
english: Every earthen vessel into which any of them falls and all that is in it shall be unclean. You shall break it.

hausa: Gama Kiristi ya mutu domin zunubi sau ɗaya tak, mai adalci saboda marasa adalci, don yă kawo ku ga Allah. An kashe shi a cikin jiki, amma an rayar da shi a Ruhu,
english: Because Christ also suffered for sins once, the righteous for the unrighteous, that he might bring you to God, being put to death in the flesh, but made alive in the Spirit,

hausa: Zan zo in furta in kuma yi shelar ayyukanka masu girma, ya Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka; zan yi shelar adalcinka, naka kaɗai.
english: I will come with the mighty acts of the Lord Yahweh. I will make mention of your righteousness, even of yours alone.

hausa: Sai ya ce, “Ina fa zan iya, in ba dai wani ya fassara mini ba?” Saboda haka sai ya gayyaci Filibus yă hau yă zauna tare da shi.
english: He said, “How can I, unless someone explains it to me?” He begged Philip to come up and sit with him.

hausa: Dawuda ya ce wa Ornan, “Ka ba ni masussukarka saboda in gina bagade wa Ubangiji, don annobar da take kan mutane tă daina. Ka sayar mini ita a cikakken kuɗinta.”
english: Then David said to Ornan, “Sell me the place of this threshing floor, that I may build an altar to Yahweh on it. You shall sell it to me for the full price, that the plague may be stopped from afflicting the people.”

hausa: Amma ta wurin bangaskiya muna marmarin jira adalcin da muke bege ta wurin Ruhu.
english: For we through the Spirit, by faith wait for the hope of righteousness.

hausa: Wataƙila za su kawo kukansu a gaban Ubangiji, kowanne kuma ya juya daga muguwar hanyarsa, gama fushi da hasalar da Ubangiji ya furta a kan mutanen nan yana da girma.”
english: It may be they will present their supplication before Yahweh, and will each return from his evil way; for Yahweh has pronounced great anger and wrath against this people.”

hausa: Dawuda ya ce, “To, yanzu me na yi? Ba zan ma yi magana ba?”
english: David said, “What have I now done? Is there not a cause?”

hausa: Sarki Solomon ya yi manyan garkuwoyi ɗari biyu da zinariya; an yi kowane garkuwa da bekas ɗari shida na zinariya.
english: King Solomon made two hundred large shields of beaten gold. Six hundred shekels of beaten gold went to one large shield.

hausa: Ana cikin haka, sai babban firist ya tuhumi Yesu game da almajiransa da kuma koyarwarsa.
english: The high priest therefore asked Jesus about his disciples and about his teaching.

hausa: Ba sa yin wata fama; jikunansu lafiya suke da kuma ƙarfi.
english: For there are no struggles in their death, but their strength is firm.

hausa: Suka kuma kai saƙon sarki zuwa ga wakilansa, da kuma gwamnoni na Kewayen Kogin Yuferites waɗanda suka taimaki mutane da kuma gidan Allah.
english: They delivered the king’s commissions to the king’s local governors and to the governors beyond the River. So they supported the people and God’s house.

hausa: Ta haka zuciyar Fir’auna ta taurare, bai kuwa bar Isra’ilawa suka tafi ba, kamar yadda Ubangiji ya riga ya faɗa ta wurin Musa.
english: The heart of Pharaoh was hardened, and he didn’t let the children of Israel go, just as Yahweh had spoken through Moses.

hausa: A shekara ta goma sha biyu ta mulkin Ahaz sarkin Yahuda, Hosheya ɗan Ela ya zama sarkin Isra’ila a Samariya, ya kuma yi mulki na shekara tara.
english: In the twelfth year of Ahaz king of Judah, Hoshea the son of Elah began to reign in Samaria over Israel for nine years.

hausa: Kyanku bai kamata yă zama na adon jiki ba, kamar kitso da sa kayan ado na zinariya da kuma sa kaya masu tsada.
english: Let your beauty come not from the outward adorning of braiding your hair, and of wearing gold ornaments or of putting on fine clothing,

hausa: Domin wannan zuciyarmu ta yi sanyi; domin waɗannan abubuwa idanunmu sun dushe
english: For this our heart is faint. For these things our eyes are dim:

hausa: Masu albarka ne waɗanda ƙarfinsu yana daga gare ka, waɗanda suka kafa zukatansu a yin tafiya zuwa wuri mai tsarki ne.
english: Blessed are those whose strength is in you, who have set their hearts on a pilgrimage.

hausa: Wa ya tabbatar cewa ruhun mutum yakan tashi sama sa’an nan na dabba yă sauka ƙasa?”
english: Who knows the spirit of man, whether it goes upward, and the spirit of the animal, whether it goes downward to the earth?”

hausa: Mai albarka ne wanda ya jira har yă zuwa ƙarshen kwanakin nan 1,335.
english: Blessed is he who waits, and comes to the one thousand three hundred thirty-five days.

hausa: suka ƙwace dukan yankin Amoriyawa tun daga ƙasar Arnon zuwa Yabbok, daga hamada har zuwa Urdun.
english: They possessed all the border of the Amorites, from the Arnon even to the Jabbok, and from the wilderness even to the Jordan.

hausa: to, sai ku sayar da zakkar, ku tafi da kuɗin wurin da Ubangiji Allahnku ya zaɓa.
english: then you shall turn it into money, bind up the money in your hand, and shall go to the place which Yahweh your God shall choose.

hausa: Yesu ya fita zuwa Dutsen Zaitun kamar yadda ya saba, almajiransa kuma suka bi shi.
english: He came out and went, as his custom was, to the Mount of Olives. His disciples also followed him.

hausa: A hayin Urdun, gabas da Yeriko, suka keɓe Bezer ta jeji a kan tudu a cikin yankin kabilar Ruben, Ramot cikin Gileyad a kabilar Gad, da Golan cikin Bashan a kabilar Manasse.
english: Beyond the Jordan at Jericho eastward, they assigned Bezer in the wilderness in the plain out of the tribe of Reuben, Ramoth in Gilead out of the tribe of Gad, and Golan in Bashan out of the tribe of Manasseh.

hausa: Zan sa a tuna da kai a dukan zamanai; saboda haka al’ummai za su yabe ka har abada abadin.
english: I will make your name to be remembered in all generations. Therefore the peoples shall give you thanks forever and ever.

hausa: ya yi kwanon da ya kira Teku, da bijimai goma sha biyu a ƙarƙashinsa;
english: one sea, and the twelve oxen under it.

hausa: akwatin alkawari da sandunansa, murfin kafara da labulen da ya rufe shi;
english: the ark, and its poles, the mercy seat, the veil of the screen;

hausa: “A’a! Mun yi haka ne don tsoro, kada nan gaba ’ya’yanku su ce wa ’ya’yanmu, ‘Me ya haɗa ku da Ubangiji, Allah na Isra’ila?
english: “If we have not out of concern done this, and for a reason, saying, ‘In time to come your children might speak to our children, saying, “What have you to do with Yahweh, the God of Israel?

hausa: Ba ku ƙarfafa marasa ƙarfi ba, ko ku warkar da marasa lafiya ko ku ɗaura waɗanda suka ji rauni. Ba ku dawo da waɗanda suka yi makuwa ko ku nemi waɗanda suka ɓace ba. Amma sai kuka mallake su ƙarfi da yaji.
english: You haven’t strengthened the diseased. You haven’t healed that which was sick. You haven’t bound up that which was broken. You haven’t brought back that which was driven away. You haven’t sought that which was lost, but you have ruled over them with force and with rigor.

hausa: shi da ya ƙwace jariranki ya fyaɗa su a kan duwatsu.
english: Happy shall he be, who takes and dashes your little ones against the rock.

hausa: Ya washe su da kuma dukan kayayyakinsu, ya kuma dawo da Lot danginsa da mallakarsa, tare da mata da sauran mutane.
english: He brought back all the goods, and also brought back his relative Lot and his goods, and the women also, and the other people.

hausa: Ku daina yin shari’a bisa ga ganin ido, sai dai ku yi shari’a bisa ga adalci.”
english: Don’t judge according to appearance, but judge righteous judgment.”

hausa: Yahuda da Sila, waɗanda su kansu annabawa ne, suka yi magana sosai don su gina su kuma ƙarfafa ’yan’uwa.
english: Judas and Silas, also being prophets themselves, encouraged the brothers with many words and strengthened them.

hausa: A Tentin Sujada, Gershonawa su ne za su lura da mazauni da tabanakul da kuma tentin, abubuwan rufensa, labule a ƙofar Tentin Sujada,
english: The duty of the sons of Gershon in the Tent of Meeting shall be the tabernacle, the tent, its covering, the screen for the door of the Tent of Meeting,

hausa: Ƙafafunsa sun yi kamar ginshiƙan dutsen alabastar da aka kafa su a cikin rammukar zinariya. Kamanninsa ya yi kamar Lebanon, mafi kyau kamar itacen al’ul nasa.
english: His legs are like pillars of marble set on sockets of fine gold. His appearance is like Lebanon, excellent as the cedars.

hausa: A shekara ta goma sha biyar ta mulkin Amaziya ɗan Yowash sarkin Yahuda, Yerobowam ɗan Yehowash sarkin Isra’ila ya zama sarki a Samariya, ya kuma yi mulki na shekaru arba’in da ɗaya.
english: In the fifteenth year of Amaziah the son of Joash king of Judah, Jeroboam the son of Joash king of Israel began to reign in Samaria for forty-one years.

hausa: Sai manzanni da dattawa, tare da dukan ikkilisiya, suka yanke shawara su zaɓi waɗansu daga cikin mutanensu su kuma aike su zuwa Antiyok tare da Bulus da Barnabas. Sai suka zaɓi Yahuda (wanda ake kira Barsabbas) da kuma Sila, mutum biyu da suke shugabanni cikin ’yan’uwa.
english: Then it seemed good to the apostles and the elders, with the whole assembly, to choose men out of their company, and send them to Antioch with Paul and Barnabas: Judas called Barsabbas, and Silas, chief men among the brothers.

hausa: Ina roƙonka ka dakata har in komo in kawo maka hadayata in ajiye a gabanka.” Sai Ubangiji ya ce, “Zan jira har ka dawo.”
english: Please don’t go away until I come to you, and bring out my present, and lay it before you.” He said, “I will wait until you come back.”

hausa: Don mai bi da kaɗe-kaɗe. Zabura ta Dawuda. Har yaushe, ya Ubangiji? Za ka manta da ni har abada ne? Har yaushe za ka ɓoye fuskarka daga gare ni?
english: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. How long, Yahweh? Will you forget me forever? How long will you hide your face from me?

hausa: Don haka, kada ku damu, kuna cewa, ‘Me za mu ci?’ Ko, ‘Me za mu sha?’ Ko kuma, ‘Me za mu sa?’
english: “Therefore don’t be anxious, saying, ‘What will we eat?’, ‘What will we drink?’ or, ‘With what will we be clothed?’

hausa: Sa’ad da kake tafiya, ba abin da zai sa ka tuntuɓe; sa’ad da kake gudu, ba za ka fāɗi ba.
english: When you go, your steps will not be hampered. When you run, you will not stumble.

hausa: Sai Yunana ya fita daga birnin ya yi wajen gabas, ya zauna. A nan ya yi wa kansa rumfa, ya zauna cikin inuwarta yana jira yă ga abin da zai sami birnin.
english: Then Jonah went out of the city and sat on the east side of the city, and there made himself a booth and sat under it in the shade, until he might see what would become of the city.

hausa: Da suka dawo wurin Yoshuwa suka ce, “Ba lalle dukan jama’a su je yaƙi da Ai ba, ka aika mutum dubu biyu ko dubu uku su je su ciwo ƙasar da yaƙi, ba sai ka dami mutane duka ba, gama mutanen wurin kaɗan ne.”
english: They returned to Joshua, and said to him, “Don’t let all the people go up, but let about two or three thousand men go up and strike Ai. Don’t make all the people to toil there, for there are only a few of them.”

hausa: Yefta kuwa ya yi wa’adi da Ubangiji ya ce, “In ka ba da Ammonawa a hannuwana,
english: Jephthah vowed a vow to Yahweh, and said, “If you will indeed deliver the children of Ammon into my hand,

hausa: Ya yi ta koyarwa a majami’unsu, kowa kuwa ya yabe shi.
english: He taught in their synagogues, being glorified by all.

hausa: Ubangiji ya ɗaukaka Solomon sosai a idon dukan Isra’ila, ya kuma ba shi darajar sarauta yadda babu sarki a Isra’ilan da ya taɓa samu.
english: Yahweh magnified Solomon exceedingly in the sight of all Israel, and gave to him such royal majesty as had not been on any king before him in Israel.

hausa: Suna muku annabcin ƙarya da sunana. Ban aike su ba,” in ji Ubangiji.
english: For they prophesy falsely to you in my name. I have not sent them,” says Yahweh.

hausa: Ga abin da Ubangiji yana cewa, ka yi abin da yake gaskiya da kuma daidai. Ka kuɓutar da wannan da aka yi masa ƙwace daga hannun mai zaluntarsa. Kada ka yi abin da ba daidai ba ko ka cuci baƙo, maraya ko gwauruwa, kuma kada ka zub da jini marar laifi a wannan wuri.
english: Yahweh says: “Execute justice and righteousness, and deliver him who is robbed out of the hand of the oppressor. Do no wrong. Do no violence to the foreigner, the fatherless, or the widow. Don’t shed innocent blood in this place.

hausa: Yehoram yana da shekara talatin da biyu sa’ad da ya zama sarki, ya kuma yi mulki a Urushalima shekara takwas.
english: Jehoram was thirty-two years old when he began to reign, and he reigned eight years in Jerusalem.

hausa: Amma muka ce masa, ‘Mu masu gaskiya ne; mu ba ’yan leƙen asiri ba ne.
english: We said to him, ‘We are honest men. We are no spies.

hausa: Bayan haka, sai ya zuba ruwa a cikin kwano, sa’an nan ya fara wanke ƙafafun almajiransa, yana sharewa da tawul wanda ya ɗaura.
english: Then he poured water into the basin, and began to wash the disciples’ feet and to wipe them with the towel that was wrapped around him.

hausa: Fassarar maganganunka sukan ba da haske; sukan ba da ganewa ga marar ilimi.
english: The entrance of your words gives light. It gives understanding to the simple.

hausa: Sai iyakar ta haura zuwa Debir daga Kwarin Akor ta juya arewa da Gilgal, wadda take fuskantar hawan Adummim a kudancin kwari, ta ci gaba zuwa ruwan En Shemesh, ta ɓullo ta En Rogel.
english: The border went up to Debir from the valley of Achor, and so northward, looking toward Gilgal, that faces the ascent of Adummim, which is on the south side of the river. The border passed along to the waters of En Shemesh, and ended at En Rogel.

hausa: Sai Lawi ya shirya wa Yesu wani babban liyafa a gidansa. Wani babban taron na masu karɓar haraji, tare da waɗansu suna cin abinci tare da su.
english: Levi made a great feast for him in his house. There was a great crowd of tax collectors and others who were reclining with them.

hausa: Bari garwashin wuta yă zubo a kansu; bari a jefar da su cikin wuta, cikin rami mai zurfi, kada su sāke tashi.
english: Let burning coals fall on them. Let them be thrown into the fire, into miry pits, from where they never rise.

hausa: suka ce wa Dawuda, “Ba za ka shiga nan ba.” Duk da haka, Dawuda ya ci kagarar Sihiyona, Birnin Dawuda.
english: The inhabitants of Jebus said to David, “You will not come in here!” Nevertheless David took the stronghold of Zion. The same is David’s city.

hausa: Zan ce game da Ubangiji, “Shi ne mafakata da kagarata, Allahna, wanda nake dogara.”
english: I will say of Yahweh, “He is my refuge and my fortress; my God, in whom I trust.”

hausa: Eluzai, Yerimot, Beyaliya, Shemariya da Shefatiya daga Haruf;
english: Eluzai; Jerimoth; Bealiah; Shemariah; Shephatiah the Haruphite;

hausa: Ashe, mai ginin tukwane ba shi da iko yin amfani da yumɓu guda yă gina tukunya domin ayyuka masu daraja da kuma waɗansu don ayyuka marasa daraja?
english: Or hasn’t the potter a right over the clay, from the same lump to make one part a vessel for honor, and another for dishonor?

hausa: mahaifinta kuwa ya ji alkawarin da ta yi, bai kuma ce mata kome ba, to, sai alkawarin da ta yi da wa’adinta su tabbata.
english: and her father hears her vow and her pledge with which she has bound her soul, and her father says nothing to her, then all her vows shall stand, and every pledge with which she has bound her soul shall stand.

hausa: Game da sauran ayyukan mulkin Zimri, da tawayen da ya yi, duk a rubuce suke a cikin littafin tarihin sarakunan Isra’ila.
english: Now the rest of the acts of Zimri, and his treason that he committed, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

hausa: Suka yi ta roƙonsa kada yă umarce su su shiga ramin Abis.
english: They begged him that he would not command them to go into the abyss.

hausa: Efa ƙwarƙwarar Kaleb ita ce mahaifiyar Haran, Moza da Gazez. Haran shi ne mahaifin Gazez.
english: Ephah, Caleb’s concubine, bore Haran, Moza, and Gazez; and Haran became the father of Gazez.

hausa: Ka jure wa shan wahala tare da mu kamar soja mai kyau na Kiristi Yesu.
english: You therefore must endure hardship as a good soldier of Christ Jesus.

hausa: “An kuma umarce ka, ka faɗa musu, ‘Ku yi wannan, ku ɗauki wagonu daga Masar domin ’ya’yanku da matanku, ku ɗauki mahaifinku ku zo.
english: Now you are commanded to do this: Take wagons out of the land of Egypt for your little ones, and for your wives, and bring your father, and come.

hausa: Bakina zai ba da labarin adalcinka, zai yi maganar cetonka dukan yini, ko da yake ban san yawansa ba.
english: My mouth will tell about your righteousness, and of your salvation all day, though I don’t know its full measure.

hausa: “ ‘In mutum ya miƙa gidansa a matsayin wani abu mai tsarki ga Ubangiji, firist zai daidaita dacewar ko mai kyau ne, ko marar kyau. Duk darajar da firist ya kimanta, haka za tă zama.
english: “‘When a man dedicates his house to be holy to Yahweh, then the priest shall evaluate it, whether it is good or bad. As the priest evaluates it, so it shall stand.

hausa: Nikodimus, wanda ya je wurin Yesu dā, wanda kuma yake ɗayansu ya ce,
english: Nicodemus (he who came to him by night, being one of them) said to them,

hausa: Dole su kasance masu tsarki ga Allahnsu, kada kuma su ɓata sunan Allahnsu. Domin sukan miƙa hadayun da aka kawo wa Ubangiji da wuta, abincin Allahnsu, saboda haka sai su kasance da tsarki.
english: They shall be holy to their God, and not profane the name of their God, for they offer the offerings of Yahweh made by fire, the bread of their God. Therefore they shall be holy.

hausa: da Abram (wato, Ibrahim).
english: Abram (also called Abraham).

hausa: Ewil-Merodak ya nuna wa Yehohiyacin alheri, ya ba shi matsayi na daraja fiye da waɗansu sarakunan da aka kai su bautar talala a Babilon tare da shi.
english: He spoke kindly to him, and set his throne above the throne of the kings who were with him in Babylon,

hausa: Amma matanku, yaranku da dabbobinku (na sani kuna da dabbobi masu yawa), su ne za ku bari a garuruwan da na ba ku,
english: But your wives, and your little ones, and your livestock, (I know that you have much livestock), shall live in your cities which I have given you,

hausa: Sai Agiriffa ya ce wa Bulus, “An ba ka izini ka yi magana.” Saboda haka Bulus ya yi alama da hannunsa ya fara kāriyarsa.
english: Agrippa said to Paul, “You may speak for yourself.” Then Paul stretched out his hand, and made his defense.

hausa: Da manyan firistoci da dattawa suka zarge shi, bai ba da amsa ba.
english: When he was accused by the chief priests and elders, he answered nothing.

hausa: Na warwatsa su cikin al’ummai, suka kuwa warwatsu cikin dukan ƙasashe; na hukunta su gwargwadon halinsu da ayyukansu.
english: I scattered them among the nations, and they were dispersed through the countries. I judged them according to their way and according to their deeds.

hausa: Saboda haka bayinsa suka ce masa, “Bari mu nemi wata budurwa wadda za tă yi wa ranka yă daɗe, sarki hidima, tă kuma kula da shi. Za tă dinga kwanta kusa da ranka yă daɗe, yă ji ɗumi.”
english: Therefore his servants said to him, “Let a young virgin be sought for my lord the king. Let her stand before the king, and cherish him; and let her lie in your bosom, that my lord the king may keep warm.”

hausa: Yana shimfiɗa ƙanƙara kamar ulu yă kuma watsar da hazo kamar toka.
english: He gives snow like wool, and scatters frost like ashes.

hausa: na fa san ku. Na san cewa ba ku da ƙaunar Allah a cikin zukatanku.
english: But I know you, that you don’t have God’s love in yourselves.

hausa: don ku sami iko, tare da dukan tsarkaka, ku fahimci fāɗi, tsawo, da kuma zurfin ƙaunar Kiristi take.
english: may be strengthened to comprehend with all the saints what is the width and length and height and depth,

hausa: Bai daɗe ba da kuka tuba, kuka kuma yi abin da yake mai kyau a idona. Kowannenku ya yi shelar ’yanci ga ɗan’uwansa. Kun ma yi yarjejjeniya a gabana a gidan da ake kira da Sunana.
english: You had now turned, and had done that which is right in my eyes, in every man proclaiming liberty to his neighbor. You had made a covenant before me in the house which is called by my name;

hausa: Sai ya ɗauki sandansa, ya zaɓi duwatsu guda biyar masu sulɓi daga cikin rafi, ya sa su a ’yar jakarsa ta makiyaya; ya kuma ɗauki majajjawarsa, ya tafi, yă fuskanci Bafilistin.
english: He took his staff in his hand, and chose for himself five smooth stones out of the brook, and put them in the pouch of his shepherd’s bag which he had. His sling was in his hand; and he came near to the Philistine.

hausa: Sa’ad da Haman ya ga cewa Mordekai ba ya durƙusa ko yă girmama shi, sai ya fusata.
english: When Haman saw that Mordecai didn’t bow down nor pay him homage, Haman was full of wrath.

hausa: Bayan an haifi Yesu a Betlehem, a Yahudiya, a zamanin Sarki Hiridus, sai waɗansu Masana, daga gabas suka zo Urushalima
english: Now when Jesus was born in Bethlehem of Judea in the days of King Herod, behold, wise men from the east came to Jerusalem, saying,

hausa: Ku ji, ya Isra’ila. Kuna gab da haye Urdun, ku shiga, ku kuma kori al’ummai da suka fi ku yawa, suka kuma fi ku ƙarfi, masu manyan biranen da suke da katangar da suka yi tsaye zuwa sama.
english: Hear, Israel! You are to pass over the Jordan today, to go in to dispossess nations greater and mightier than yourself, cities great and fortified up to the sky,

hausa: Ku yi amfani da ma’auni na gaskiya da mudu na gaskiya, da kuma magwaji na gaskiya. Ni ne Ubangiji Allahnku, wanda ya fitar da ku daga Masar.
english: You shall have just balances, just weights, a just ephah, and a just hin. I am Yahweh your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt.

hausa: Suka keɓe hadayun ƙonawa don su ba da su ga ƙungiyoyin iyalan mutane don su miƙa ga Ubangiji, yadda yake a rubuce a Littafin Musa. Suka yi haka da shanun.
english: They removed the burnt offerings, that they might give them according to the divisions of the fathers’ houses of the children of the people, to offer to Yahweh, as it is written in the book of Moses. They did the same with the cattle.

hausa: Sai suka amsa, “Mu biyu, mun yi mafarki, amma babu wani da zai fassara mana su.” Sa’an nan Yusuf ya ce musu, “Fassara ba daga Allah take zuwa ba? Ku faɗa mini mafarkanku.”
english: They said to him, “We have dreamed a dream, and there is no one who can interpret it.” Joseph said to them, “Don’t interpretations belong to God? Please tell it to me.”

hausa: Sai Irmiya ya ce wa dukan mutane, har da mata, “Ku saurari maganar Ubangiji, dukanku mutanen Yahuda a Masar.
english: Moreover Jeremiah said to all the people, including all the women, “Hear Yahweh’s word, all Judah who are in the land of Egypt!

hausa: Sai Samson ya gangara zuwa Timna tare da mahaifinsa da kuma mahaifiyarsa. Da suka yi kusa da gonar inabin Timna, nan da nan sai ga ɗan zaki ya taso ya nufe shi yana ruri.
english: Then Samson went down to Timnah with his father and his mother, and came to the vineyards of Timnah; and behold, a young lion roared at him.

hausa: Amma adalcin da yake ga bangaskiya yana cewa, “Kada ka faɗa a zuciyarka, ‘Wa zai hau sama?’ ” (wato, don yă sauko da Kiristi),
english: But the righteousness which is of faith says this, “Don’t say in your heart, ‘Who will ascend into heaven?’ (that is, to bring Christ down);

hausa: saboda tarayyarku a cikin bishara daga ranar farko har yă zuwa yanzu,
english: for your partnership in furtherance of the Good News from the first day until now;

hausa: A ranar na yi musu rantsuwa cewa zan fitar da su daga Masar zuwa ƙasar da na samo musu, ƙasa mai zub da madara da zuma, ƙasa mafi kyau cikin dukan ƙasashe.
english: in that day I swore to them to bring them out of the land of Egypt into a land that I had searched out for them, flowing with milk and honey, which is the glory of all lands.

hausa: Absalom da dukan mutanen Isra’ila suka ce, “Shawarar Hushai mutumin Arkitawa ta fi ta Ahitofel kyau.” Gama Ubangiji ya ƙudura yă wofinta kyakkyawar shawarar Ahitofel, don yă jawo wa Absalom masifa.
english: Absalom and all the men of Israel said, “The counsel of Hushai the Archite is better than the counsel of Ahithophel.” For Yahweh had ordained to defeat the good counsel of Ahithophel, to the intent that Yahweh might bring evil on Absalom.

hausa: Zan yi tunani a kan dukan ayyukanka in lura da dukan manyan abubuwan da ka aikata.
english: I will also meditate on all your work, and consider your doings.

hausa: Mutum ba mutumin Yahuda ba ne in shi mutumin Yahuda ne kawai a jiki, haka kuma kaciya ba a waje ko a jiki kawai ba.
english: For he is not a Jew who is one outwardly, neither is that circumcision which is outward in the flesh;

hausa: gama rai ne ga waɗanda suke nemansu da kuma lafiya ga dukan jikin mutum.
english: For they are life to those who find them, and health to their whole body.

hausa: amma za su ce, ‘Muddin Ubangiji yana raye, wanda ya fitar da Isra’ilawa daga ƙasar arewa da kuma daga dukan ƙasashe da ya kora su.’ Gama zan komo da su zuwa ƙasar da na ba wa kakanninsu.
english: but, ‘As Yahweh lives, who brought up the children of Israel from the land of the north, and from all the countries where he had driven them.’ I will bring them again into their land that I gave to their fathers.

hausa: Isra’ilawa kuwa suka ƙara ƙarfi gāba da Yabin, sarkin Kan’aniyawa, har suka hallaka shi.
english: The hand of the children of Israel prevailed more and more against Jabin the king of Canaan, until they had destroyed Jabin king of Canaan.

hausa: Ƙasar gaba ɗaya za tă zama gishiri mai ƙuna marar amfani da kuma kibiritu, babu shuki, babu abin da yake tsirowa, babu itatuwan da suke girma a cikinta. Za tă zama kamar yadda aka hallaka Sodom da Gomorra, Adma da Zeboyim, waɗanda Ubangiji ya hallaka cikin zafin fushinsa.
english: that all of its land is sulfur, salt, and burning, that it is not sown, doesn’t produce, nor does any grass grow in it, like the overthrow of Sodom, Gomorrah, Admah, and Zeboiim, which Yahweh overthrew in his anger, and in his wrath.

hausa: Allolin al’umman da kakannina suka hallaka, sun cece su ne, allolin Gozan, da na Haran, da na Rezef, da kuma na mutane Eden da suke a Tel Assar?
english: Have the gods of the nations delivered them, which my fathers have destroyed—Gozan, Haran, Rezeph, and the children of Eden who were in Telassar?

hausa: Ibraniyawan da suke tare da Filistiyawa a dā, waɗanda suka bi Filistiyawan zuwa sansanin yaƙinsu, suka juya, suka goyi bayan Shawulu da Yonatan sa’ad da yaƙin ya taso.
english: Now the Hebrews who were with the Philistines before and who went up with them into the camp from all around, even they also turned to be with the Israelites who were with Saul and Jonathan.

hausa: Sa’ad da Yayir ya mutu, sai aka binne shi a Kamon.
english: Jair died, and was buried in Kamon.

hausa: Mun yi rayuwarmu a cikin tentuna mun kuma yi biyayya ƙwarai da kowane abin da kakanmu Yehonadab ya umarce mu.
english: but we have lived in tents, and have obeyed, and done according to all that Jonadab our father commanded us.

hausa: Dukan maza daga shekara talatin zuwa hamsin waɗanda sukan zo hidimar aiki da kuma ɗaukar Tentin Sujada
english: from thirty years old and upward even to fifty years old, everyone who entered in to do the work of service and the work of bearing burdens in the Tent of Meeting,

hausa: “Ko kuma in na aika da annoba a cikin wannan ƙasa na kuma yi fushi a kanta ta wurin kisa, ina kisan mutanenta da dabbobinsu,
english: “Or if I send a pestilence into that land, and pour out my wrath on it in blood, to cut off from it man and animal—

hausa: gama kun sani sarai cewa ranar Ubangiji za tă zo kamar ɓarawo da dare.
english: For you yourselves know well that the day of the Lord comes like a thief in the night.

hausa: Amma da ya ga haukar iskar, sai ya ji tsoro, ya kuma fara nutsewa, sai ya yi ihu ya ce, “Ubangiji, ka cece ni!”
english: But when he saw that the wind was strong, he was afraid, and beginning to sink, he cried out, saying, “Lord, save me!”

hausa: Ka shimfiɗa farillan da dole a yi biyayya da su.
english: You have commanded your precepts, that we should fully obey them.

hausa: Ya ce wa Shawulu, “Me ya sa kake saurari mutanen da suke cewa, ‘Dawuda ya dāge yă cuce ka’?
english: David said to Saul, “Why do you listen to men’s words, saying, ‘Behold, David seeks to harm you’?

hausa: Ya yi wurin ajiye fitila goma na zinariya bisa ga tsari dominsu ya kuma sa su a haikali, biyar a gefen kudu, biyar kuma a gefen arewa.
english: He made the ten lamp stands of gold according to the ordinance concerning them; and he set them in the temple, five on the right hand and five on the left.

hausa: Saboda haka dukan mutane suka ƙetare Urdun, sa’an nan kuma sarki ma ya ƙetare. Sarki ya yi wa Barzillai sumba ya albarkace shi, sa’an nan Barzillai ya koma gidansa.
english: All the people went over the Jordan, and the king went over. Then the king kissed Barzillai and blessed him; and he returned to his own place.

hausa: Sai Ubangiji ya ce wa Haruna, “Na ba ka aikin lura da hadayun da za a miƙa mini, dukan tsarkakan hadayun da Isra’ilawa suka ba ni, na ba ka su su zama rabonka da na ’ya’yanka har abada.
english: Yahweh spoke to Aaron, “Behold, I myself have given you the command of my wave offerings, even all the holy things of the children of Israel. I have given them to you by reason of the anointing, and to your sons, as a portion forever.

hausa: Ya sāke yin addu’a, sai sammai suka ba da ruwan sama, ƙasa kuma ta ba da amfaninta.
english: He prayed again, and the sky gave rain, and the earth produced its fruit.

hausa: Sa’an nan za su ɗauki jinin, su shafa a gefen da yake saman dogaran ƙofa na gidajen da suke cin naman dabbobin.
english: They shall take some of the blood, and put it on the two door posts and on the lintel, on the houses in which they shall eat it.

hausa: yana hana wanda bai san Allah ba yă yi mulki, ya hana shi sa wa mutane tarko.
english: that the godless man may not reign, that there be no one to ensnare the people.

hausa: Yehu ya ce wa Bidkar, hafsan keken yaƙinsa, “Ka ɗauke shi ka jefar a filin da yake na Nabot mutumin Yezireyel. Ka tuna yadda ni da kai muke a kekunan yaƙi a bayan Ahab mahaifinsa sa’ad da Ubangiji ya yi wannan annabci game da shi,
english: Then Jehu said to Bidkar his captain, “Pick him up, and throw him in the plot of the field of Naboth the Jezreelite; for remember how, when you and I rode together after Ahab his father, Yahweh laid this burden on him:

hausa: A farkon mulkin Zerzes, sai abokan gāba suka kawo ƙarar mutanen Yahuda da na Urushalima.
english: In the reign of Ahasuerus, in the beginning of his reign, they wrote an accusation against the inhabitants of Judah and Jerusalem.

hausa: don a sunan Yesu kowace gwiwa za tă durƙusa, a sama da a ƙasa da kuma a ƙarƙashin ƙasa,
english: that at the name of Jesus every knee should bow, of those in heaven, those on earth, and those under the earth,

hausa: Ubangiji yana ƙin hanyar mugaye amma yana ƙaunar waɗanda suke neman adalci.
english: The way of the wicked is an abomination to Yahweh, but he loves him who follows after righteousness.

hausa: da tsaka, da hawainiya, da ƙadangare, da guza, da damo.
english: the gecko, and the monitor lizard, the wall lizard, the skink, and the chameleon.

hausa: Gama shi da zai tabbatar da ni, marar laifi ne yana kusa. Wane ne zai kawo ƙararraki game da ni? Bari mu je ɗakin shari’a tare! Wane ne mai zargina? Bari yă kalubalance ni!
english: He who justifies me is near. Who will bring charges against me? Let us stand up together. Who is my adversary? Let him come near to me.

hausa: Tare da wannan, ku miƙa ’yan raguna bakwai, kowanne bana ɗaya-ɗaya marar lahani, bijimi da kuma raguna biyu. Za su zama hadaya ta ƙonawa ga Ubangiji, tare da hadayunsu na hatsi, da hadayunsu na sha, hadaya da aka yi da wuta, mai daɗin ƙanshi ga Ubangiji.
english: You shall present with the bread seven lambs without defect a year old, one young bull, and two rams. They shall be a burnt offering to Yahweh, with their meal offering and their drink offerings, even an offering made by fire, of a sweet aroma to Yahweh.

hausa: Haka kika yi ta lalacin budurcinki, sa’ad da a Masar aka rungumi ƙirjinta aka tattaɓa nononta.
english: Thus you called to memory the lewdness of your youth, in the caressing of your nipples by the Egyptians because of your youthful breasts.

english: Then the priest shall examine him. Behold, if the swelling of the plague is reddish-white in his bald head, or in his bald forehead, like the appearance of leprosy in the skin of the body,

hausa: Saboda haka bawan ya sa hannunsa a ƙarƙashin cinyar maigidansa Ibrahim, ya kuma rantse masa game da wannan al’amari.
english: The servant put his hand under the thigh of Abraham his master, and swore to him concerning this matter.

hausa: Saboda ’yan’uwana da kuma abokaina, zan ce, “Salama tă kasance tare da ke.”
english: For my brothers’ and companions’ sakes, I will now say, “Peace be within you.”

hausa: Mugu mai mulki ba shi da azanci, amma duk wanda yake ƙin ƙazamar riba yakan yi tsawon rai.
english: A tyrannical ruler lacks judgment. One who hates ill-gotten gain will have long days.

hausa: Ga wannan ne aka kira ku, domin Kiristi ya sha wahala dominku, ya bar muku gurbin da ya kamata ku bi.
english: For you were called to this, because Christ also suffered for us, leaving you an example, that you should follow his steps,

hausa: Amma da lokacin da aka tsara ya yi sosai, sai Allah ya aiki Ɗansa, haifaffe daga mace, haifaffe a ƙarƙashin Doka,
english: But when the fullness of the time came, God sent out his Son, born to a woman, born under the law,

hausa: Ku kasa kunne ga wannan, ya ku shanun Bashan a kan Dutsen Samariya, ku matan da kuke cin zalin matalauta, kuke kuma danne matalauta, kuna kuma ce wa mazanku, “Ku kawo mana abin sha!”
english: Listen to this word, you cows of Bashan, who are on the mountain of Samaria, who oppress the poor, who crush the needy, who tell their husbands, “Bring us drinks!”

hausa: Dubu za su gudu don barazanar mutum guda; da jin barazanar mutane biyar dukanku za ku yi ta gudu sai an bar ku kamar sandar tuta a kan dutse, kamar tuta a kan tudu.”
english: One thousand will flee at the threat of one. At the threat of five, you will flee until you are left like a beacon on the top of a mountain, and like a banner on a hill.

hausa: Waƙar haurawa. Yabi Ubangiji, dukanku bayin Ubangiji waɗanda kuke hidima da dare a gidan Ubangiji.
english: A Song of Ascents. Look! Praise Yahweh, all you servants of Yahweh, who stand by night in Yahweh’s house!

hausa: Gama babbar ranar fushinsu ta zo, wa kuwa zai iya tsayawa?”
english: for the great day of his wrath has come, and who is able to stand?”

hausa: Saboda haka sai sarki ya aika wannan saƙo zuwa ga Rahab, “Ki fito da mutanen da suka zo suka sauka a gidanki, gama sun zo su leƙi asirin ƙasar ne gaba ɗaya.”
english: Jericho’s king sent to Rahab, saying, “Bring out the men who have come to you, who have entered into your house; for they have come to spy out all the land.”

hausa: Ta wurin wannan bisharar ce kuka sami ceto, muddin kuna riƙe da wa’azin da na yi muku kam-kam. In ba haka ba, kun gaskata a banza ke nan.
english: by which also you are saved, if you hold firmly the word which I preached to you—unless you believed in vain.

hausa: Waɗannan su ne umarnai da ƙa’idodin da Ubangiji ya ba wa Isra’ilawa ta wurin Musa, a filayen Mowab kusa da Urdun, ɗaura da Yeriko.
english: These are the commandments and the ordinances which Yahweh commanded by Moses to the children of Israel in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho.

hausa: Amma mala’ikan Ubangiji ya kira shi daga sama ya ce, “Ibrahim, Ibrahim!” Sai Ibrahim ya amsa ya ce, “Ga ni.”
english: Yahweh’s angel called to him out of the sky, and said, “Abraham, Abraham!” He said, “Here I am.”

hausa: Sa’ad da aka gama raba gādon ƙasar bisa ga ƙuri’a. Sai Isra’ilawa suka ba Yoshuwa ɗan Nun nasa rabo a cikinsu,
english: So they finished distributing the land for inheritance by its borders. The children of Israel gave an inheritance to Joshua the son of Nun among them.

hausa: ya ce musu, “Ku je tsakiyar Urdun inda akwatin alkawari na Ubangiji Allahnku yake. Kowannenku yă ɗauki dutse ɗaya a kafaɗarsa, bisa ga yawan kabilan Isra’ila,
english: Joshua said to them, “Cross before the ark of Yahweh your God into the middle of the Jordan, and each of you pick up a stone and put it on your shoulder, according to the number of the tribes of the children of Israel;

hausa: Wata rana muna tafiya zuwa wurin yin addu’a, sai muka sadu da wata baranya mai ruhun aljani mai duba. Takan samo wa mutanenta kuɗi da yawa, duban da take yi.
english: As we were going to prayer, a certain girl having a spirit of divination met us, who brought her masters much gain by fortune telling.

hausa: Shi da ya sa kunne ba don a ji ba ne? Shi da ya yi ido ba don yă gani ba ne?
english: He who implanted the ear, won’t he hear? He who formed the eye, won’t he see?

hausa: Ko yanzu haka shaidata tana sama; wanda zai tsaya mini yana sama.
english: Even now, behold, my witness is in heaven. He who vouches for me is on high.

hausa: Ranka yă daɗe sarki, idanun dukan Isra’ila suna a kanka, domin su san wa zai zauna a kujerar ranka yă daɗe sarkina, a bayanka.
english: You, my lord the king, the eyes of all Israel are on you, that you should tell them who will sit on the throne of my lord the king after him.

hausa: Lokacin da na yi tunanin wannan, sai in ji tsoro; jikina yă fara rawa.
english: When I remember, I am troubled. Horror takes hold of my flesh.

hausa: gama ku jama’a ce mai tsarki ga Ubangiji Allahnku. Daga dukan mutane a fuskar duniya, Ubangiji ya zaɓe ku, ku zama abin mallakarsa.
english: For you are a holy people to Yahweh your God, and Yahweh has chosen you to be a people for his own possession, above all peoples who are on the face of the earth.

hausa: haka ma a cikin Kiristi mu da muke da yawa mun zama jiki ɗaya, kuma kowace gaɓar ɗan’uwan sauran ne.
english: so we, who are many, are one body in Christ, and individually members of one another,

hausa: Da Farisiyawan da suke tare da shi suka ji ya faɗi haka sai suka yi tambaya suka ce, “Mene? Mu ma makafi ne?”
english: Those of the Pharisees who were with him heard these things, and said to him, “Are we also blind?”

hausa: A lokacin nan na umarci Yoshuwa na ce, “Da idanunka ka ga dukan abin da Ubangiji Allahnku ya yi da waɗannan sarakuna biyu. Haka Ubangiji zai yi da dukan masarautai a can, inda za ku.
english: I commanded Joshua at that time, saying, “Your eyes have seen all that Yahweh your God has done to these two kings. So shall Yahweh do to all the kingdoms where you go over.

hausa: Adalcinka ya kai sararin sama, ya Allah, kai da ka yi manyan abubuwa. Wane ne kamar ka, ya Allah?
english: God, your righteousness also reaches to the heavens. You have done great things. God, who is like you?

hausa: Sa’ad da numfashinsu ya rabu da su sai su koma ƙasa; a wannan rana shirye-shiryensu sun zama banza.
english: His spirit departs, and he returns to the earth. In that very day, his thoughts perish.

hausa: Da ɗaukowar jikin Yesu, sai su biyun suka nannaɗe shi tare da kayan ƙanshi a cikin ƙyallayen lilin bisa ga al’adar Yahudawa ta jana’iza.
english: So they took Jesus’ body, and bound it in linen cloths with the spices, as the custom of the Jews is to bury.

hausa: Duk sa’ad da Ubangiji ya naɗa musu mahukunci, yakan kasance tare da mahukuncin, yă kuma cece su daga hannun abokan gāba, muddin mahukuncin yana a raye; gama Ubangiji yakan ji tausayinsu yayinda suke gunaguni ƙarƙashin waɗanda suka danne su suke kuma gasa musu azaba.
english: When Yahweh raised up judges for them, then Yahweh was with the judge, and saved them out of the hand of their enemies all the days of the judge; for it grieved Yahweh because of their groaning by reason of those who oppressed them and troubled them.

hausa: Duk wanda ya ce yana cikin haske yana kuma ƙin ɗan’uwansa, ashe a duhu yake har yanzu.
english: He who says he is in the light and hates his brother is in the darkness even until now.

hausa: Amma saboda wannan dalilin ne aka nuna mini jinƙai domin ta wurina, mafi zunubi duka, Kiristi Yesu yă iya bayyana matuƙar haƙurinsa a matsayin misali ga waɗanda za su gaskata shi su kuma sami rai madawwami.
english: However, for this cause I obtained mercy, that in me first, Jesus Christ might display all his patience for an example of those who were going to believe in him for eternal life.

hausa: Sai ya tara su wuri ɗaya, tare da masu irin wannan sana’ar ya ce, “Ku jama’a, kun san muna samun kuɗin shiga sosai daga wannan sana’a.
english: whom he gathered together with the workmen of like occupation, and said, “Sirs, you know that by this business we have our wealth.

hausa: daga Arod, kabilar Arodiyawa; daga Areli, kabilar Areliyawa.
english: of Arod, the family of the Arodites; of Areli, the family of the Arelites.

hausa: Saratu ta yi ciki, ta kuma haifa wa Ibrahim ɗa a tsufansa; a daidai lokacin da Allah ya yi masa alkawari.
english: Sarah conceived, and bore Abraham a son in his old age, at the set time of which God had spoken to him.

hausa: Sai wutar Ubangiji ya fāɗo, ya cinye hadayar, itacen, duwatsun da kuma ƙasar, ya lashe ruwan da yake cikin wuriyar.
english: Then Yahweh’s fire fell and consumed the burnt offering, the wood, the stones, and the dust; and it licked up the water that was in the trench.

hausa: Yanzu sai ku gaggauta zuwa wurin mahaifina ku faɗa masa, ‘Abin da ɗanka Yusuf ya ce; Allah ya mai da ni shugaban dukan Masar. Gangaro wurina; kada ka jinkirta.
english: Hurry, and go up to my father, and tell him, ‘This is what your son Joseph says, “God has made me lord of all Egypt. Come down to me. Don’t wait.

hausa: Duk da haka ni matalauci ne da kuma mai bukata; ka zo da sauri gare ni, ya Allah. Kai ne mai taimakona da mai cetona; Ya Ubangiji, kada ka yi jinkiri.
english: But I am poor and needy. Come to me quickly, God. You are my help and my deliverer. Yahweh, don’t delay.

hausa: Rut Amma Rut ta amsa, “Kada ki roƙe ni in bar ki ko in koma daga gare ki. Inda za ki, zan tafi, kuma inda za ki zauna, zan zauna. Mutanenki, za su zama mutanena kuma Allahnki, zai zama Allahna.
english: Ruth said, “Don’t urge me to leave you, and to return from following you, for where you go, I will go; and where you stay, I will stay. Your people will be my people, and your God my God.

hausa: Yana kama da shukar da aka ba ta ruwa sosai lokacin da akwai rana sosai, tana yaɗuwa da kyau;
english: He is green before the sun. His shoots go out along his garden.

hausa: Ƙaddarar mutum ɗaya take da ta dabba; ƙaddara ɗaya ce take jiransu biyu. Yadda ɗayan yake mutuwa, haka ma ɗayan. Dukansu numfashinsu iri ɗaya ne; mutum bai fi dabba ba. Kowane abu ba shi da amfani.
english: For that which happens to the sons of men happens to animals. Even one thing happens to them. As the one dies, so the other dies. Yes, they have all one breath; and man has no advantage over the animals, for all is vanity.

hausa: Sai abin ya ɓata wa Yunana rai ƙwarai har ya yi fushi.
english: But it displeased Jonah exceedingly, and he was angry.

hausa: Zan bayyana adalcinku da kuma ayyukanku, ba kuwa za su amfane ku ba.
english: I will declare your righteousness; and as for your works, they will not benefit you.

hausa: Mutumin ya ce mini, “Ɗan mutum, duba da idanunka, ka ji da kunnuwanka ka kuma lura da kowane abin da zan nuna maka, gama abin da ya sa na kawo ka nan ke nan. Ka faɗa wa gidan Isra’ila duk abin da ka gani.”
english: The man said to me, “Son of man, see with your eyes, and hear with your ears, and set your heart on all that I will show you; for you have been brought here so that I may show them to you. Declare all that you see to the house of Israel.”

hausa: Ku kashe tsofaffi da samari da ’yan mata, mata da yara, amma kada ku taɓa wani wanda yake da shaida. Ku fara a wuri mai tsarkina.” Saboda haka suka fara da dattawan da suke gaban haikali.
english: Kill utterly the old man, the young man, the virgin, little children and women; but don’t come near any man on whom is the mark. Begin at my sanctuary.” Then they began at the old men who were before the house.

hausa: Suna furta zunubansu, ya kuma yi musu baftisma a Kogin Urdun.
english: They were baptized by him in the Jordan, confessing their sins.

hausa: Halhul, Bet-Zur, Gedor,
english: Halhul, Beth Zur, Gedor,

hausa: Tare da Allah za mu yi nasara, zai kuma tattake abokan gābanmu.
english: Through God we will do valiantly, for it is he who will tread down our adversaries.

hausa: Sa’an nan ya ce wa macen, “Zan tsananta naƙudarki ainun, da azaba kuma za ki haifi ’ya’ya. Za ki riƙa yin marmarin mijinki zai kuwa yi mulki a kanki.”
english: To the woman he said, “I will greatly multiply your pain in childbirth. You will bear children in pain. Your desire will be for your husband, and he will rule over you.”

hausa: Da ni da Uba ɗaya ne.”
english: I and the Father are one.”

hausa: Natanayel ya ce, “A Nazaret! Wani abin kirki zai iya fito daga can?” Filibus ya ce, “Zo ka gani.”
english: Nathanael said to him, “Can any good thing come out of Nazareth?” Philip said to him, “Come and see.”

hausa: “Babu wani mai tsarki kamar Ubangiji babu wani, in ban da kai; babu wani dutse kamar Allahnmu.
english: There is no one as holy as Yahweh, for there is no one besides you, nor is there any rock like our God.

hausa: Saboda haka, ga abin da Ubangiji yana cewa, ina gab da ba da wannan birni ga Babiloniyawa da kuma ga Nebukadnezzar sarkin Babilon, wanda zai yaƙe ta.
english: Therefore Yahweh says: Behold, I will give this city into the hand of the Chaldeans, and into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and he will take it.

hausa: Sa’ad da ta ji a Mowab cewa Ubangiji ya zo don yă taimaki mutanensa ta wurin tanada musu da abinci, sai Na’omi tare da surukanta suka shirya su koma gida daga can.
english: Then she arose with her daughters-in-law, that she might return from the country of Moab; for she had heard in the country of Moab how Yahweh had visited his people in giving them bread.

hausa: Sai Yesse ya kira Abinadab yă zo gaban Sama’ila. Amma Sama’ila ya ce, “Ko wannan ma Ubangiji bai zaɓe shi ba.”
english: Then Jesse called Abinadab, and made him pass before Samuel. He said, “Yahweh has not chosen this one, either.”

hausa: “ ‘A rana ta goma sha biyar ga wata na bakwai, za a yi tsattsarkan taro, ba kuwa za a yi aikin da aka saba yi ba. Ku yi biki ga Ubangiji har kwana bakwai.
english: “‘On the fifteenth day of the seventh month you shall have a holy convocation. You shall do no regular work. You shall keep a feast to Yahweh seven days.

hausa: Sojojin nan matasa na shugabannin yankuna suka fara fita. Ben-Hadad kuwa ya riga ya aiki ’yan leƙen asiri, waɗanda suka ce, “Mutane suna zuwa daga Samariya.”
english: The young men of the princes of the provinces went out first; and Ben Hadad sent out, and they told him, saying, “Men are coming out from Samaria.”

hausa: Game da kamanninsu kuwa, huɗu a cikinsu sun yi kama da juna; kowanne ya yi kamar da da’ira a cikin da’ira.
english: As for their appearance, the four of them had one likeness, like a wheel within a wheel.

hausa: “Kaiton mutumin da ya gina birni da jinin da ya zubar ya kuma kafa gari ta wurin mugun aiki!
english: Woe to him who builds a town with blood, and establishes a city by iniquity!

hausa: Sauran ayyukan mulkin Yehoshafat, daga farko zuwa ƙarshe, an rubuta su a tarihin Yehu ɗan Hanani, waɗanda aka rubuta a littafin sarakunan Isra’ila.
english: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoshaphat, first and last, behold, they are written in the history of Jehu the son of Hanani, which is included in the book of the kings of Israel.

hausa: Bayan kwanaki masu yawa za a kira ka. A shekaru masu zuwa za ka kai hari a ƙasar da ta farfaɗo daga yaƙi, wadda aka tattara mutanenta daga al’ummai masu yawa zuwa duwatsun Isra’ila, dā kango ne sosai. An fitar da su daga al’ummai, yanzu kuwa dukansu suna zama lafiya.
english: After many days you will be visited. In the latter years you will come into the land that is brought back from the sword, that is gathered out of many peoples, on the mountains of Israel, which have been a continual waste; but it is brought out of the peoples and they will dwell securely, all of them.

hausa: “Saboda haka, Oholiba, ga abin da Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka yana cewa zan zuga kwartayenki su yi gāba da ke, su waɗanda kika ji ƙyamarsu, zan kuma kawo su su yi gāba da ke daga kowane gefe,
english: “Therefore, Oholibah, the Lord Yahweh says: ‘Behold, I will raise up your lovers against you, from whom your soul is alienated, and I will bring them against you on every side:

hausa: Za a zuba turare a kowane layin dunƙulen burodin don yă kasance abin tunawa a bisa burodin. Turaren zai ƙone a madadin burodin don yă zama kamar hadayar da aka miƙa da wuta ga Ubangiji.
english: You shall put pure frankincense on each row, that it may be to the bread for a memorial, even an offering made by fire to Yahweh.

hausa: Na tabbatar muku, cewa yana aiki ƙwarai dominku da kuma domin waɗanda suke a Lawodiseya da Hiyerafolis.
english: For I testify about him that he has great zeal for you, and for those in Laodicea, and for those in Hierapolis.

hausa: mutanena suna hallaka saboda jahilci. “Domin kun ƙi neman sani, ni ma na ƙi ku a matsayin firistocina; domin kun ƙyale dokar Allahnku, ni ma zan ƙyale ’ya’yanku.
english: My people are destroyed for lack of knowledge. Because you have rejected knowledge, I will also reject you, that you may be no priest to me. Because you have forgotten your God’s law, I will also forget your children.

hausa: Sai mutumin ya kawo ni wuri mai tsarki da yake waje ya kuma auna madogaransa; fāɗin gefe-gefen kamu shida ne a kowane gefe.
english: He brought me to the nave and measured the posts, six cubits wide on the one side and six cubits wide on the other side, which was the width of the tent.

hausa: Zuriyar Simeyon su ne, Nemuwel, Yamin, Yarib, Zera da Shawulu;
english: The sons of Simeon: Nemuel, Jamin, Jarib, Zerah, Shaul;

hausa: ya kuma kawo bunsuru ɗaya domin hadaya don zunubi;
english: one male goat for a sin offering;

hausa: Amma sa’ad da na yi maka magana, zan buɗe bakinka za ka kuwa faɗa musu cewa, ‘Ga abin da Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka ya faɗa.’ Duk mai ji ya ji, kuma duk wanda ya ƙi ji, ya ƙi ji; gama su gida ne na ’yan tawaye.
english: But when I speak with you, I will open your mouth, and you shall tell them, ‘This is what the Lord Yahweh says.’ He who hears, let him hear; and he who refuses, let him refuse; for they are a rebellious house.”

hausa: Yesu ya amsa, “Ku lura fa, kada wani yă ruɗe ku.
english: Jesus answered them, “Be careful that no one leads you astray.

hausa: Amma, ba za ku ɗauki wani abin da za a hallaka ba, idan kuka yi haka, za ku jawo masifa da hallaka a kan mutanen Isra’ila a inda kuka sauka.
english: But as for you, only keep yourselves from what is devoted to destruction, lest when you have devoted it, you take of the devoted thing; so you would make the camp of Israel accursed and trouble it.

hausa: “Ka tsarkake ƙirji na hadaya ta kaɗawa, da cinya ta hadaya ta ɗagawa, waɗanda za a kaɗa a kuma ɗaga na ragon naɗin, wanda yake na Haruna da kuma na ’ya’yansa maza.
english: You shall sanctify the breast of the wave offering and the thigh of the wave offering, which is waved, and which is raised up, of the ram of consecration, even of that which is for Aaron, and of that which is for his sons.

hausa: “Mutanena sun aikata zunubai guda biyu. Sun rabu da ni, ni da nake maɓulɓular ruwan rai, sun kuma haƙa tankunan ruwansu, tankuna ruwan da suka fashe da ba za su iya riƙe ruwa ba.
english: “For my people have committed two evils: they have forsaken me, the spring of living waters, and cut out cisterns for themselves: broken cisterns that can’t hold water.

hausa: “Babu wani a cikin wannan muguwar tsara da zai ga ƙasa mai kyau da na rantse zan ba wa kakanninku,
english: “Surely not one of these men of this evil generation shall see the good land which I swore to give to your fathers,

hausa: Har yanzu ta yi ciki, sa’ad da kuma ta haifi ɗa sai ta ce, “Yanzu, a ƙarshe mijina zai manne mini, gama na haifa masa ’ya’ya maza uku.” Saboda haka ta ba shi suna Lawi.
english: She conceived again, and bore a son. She said, “Now this time my husband will be joined to me, because I have borne him three sons.” Therefore his name was called Levi.

hausa: Ya sunkuya ya duba ciki ya ga ƙyallayen lilin ne kwance a can amma bai shiga ba.
english: Stooping and looking in, he saw the linen cloths lying there; yet he didn’t enter in.

hausa: Amma Yehosheba, ’yar Sarki Yoram, ’yar’uwar Ahaziya, ta ɗauki Yowash ɗan Ahaziya daga cikin ’ya’yan sarkin da ake shiri a kashe, ta ɓoye. Ta ɓoye shi daga Ataliya a wurin mai lura da shi a ɗakin kwana; don kada a kashe shi.
english: But Jehosheba, the daughter of King Joram, sister of Ahaziah, took Joash the son of Ahaziah, and stole him away from among the king’s sons who were slain, even him and his nurse, and put them in the bedroom; and they hid him from Athaliah, so that he was not slain.

hausa: “Nan take sai ga mutum uku da aka aika wurina daga Kaisariya a tsaye a ƙofar gidan da nake.
english: Behold, immediately three men stood before the house where I was, having been sent from Caesarea to me.

hausa: Ko da zai kashe ni ne, begena a cikinsa zai kasance; ba shakka zan kāre kaina a gabansa
english: Behold, he will kill me. I have no hope. Nevertheless, I will maintain my ways before him.

hausa: Bulus ya tattara tarin itace, yayinda kuma yake sa itacen a wuta, sai maciji ya ɓullo saboda zafi, ya dāfe a hannunsa.
english: But when Paul had gathered a bundle of sticks and laid them on the fire, a viper came out because of the heat and fastened on his hand.

hausa: Yakan tuna da alkawarinsa har abada, maganar da ya umarta, har tsararraki dubu,
english: Remember his covenant forever, the word which he commanded to a thousand generations,

hausa: firist zai kimanta darajarta har Shekara ta Murna, dole kuma mutumin yă biya darajarta a ranar, a matsayin wani abu mai tsarki ga Ubangiji.
english: then the priest shall reckon to him the worth of your valuation up to the Year of Jubilee; and he shall give your valuation on that day, as a holy thing to Yahweh.

hausa: Kashegari Agiriffa da Bernis suka yi shiga irin ta sarauta suka shiga ɗakin jama’a tare da manyan sojoji da manyan mutanen birni. Da umarnin Festus, sai aka shigo da Bulus.
english: So on the next day, when Agrippa and Bernice had come with great pomp, and they had entered into the place of hearing with the commanding officers and the principal men of the city, at the command of Festus, Paul was brought in.

hausa: ‘Ni ne Allah na Ibrahim, Allah na Ishaku da kuma Allah na Yaƙub’? Ai, shi ba Allah na matattu ba ne, shi Allah na masu rai ne.”
english: ‘I am the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob’? God is not the God of the dead, but of the living.”

hausa: Ku sani fa, waɗannan waɗanda suka gaskata, ’ya’yan Ibrahim ne.
english: Know therefore that those who are of faith are children of Abraham.

hausa: Ya rurrushe kagaransu ya kuma ragargaza biranensu. Ƙasar da dukan waɗanda suke cikinta sun tsorata da jin rurinsa.
english: He knew their palaces, and laid waste their cities. The land was desolate with its fullness, because of the noise of his roaring.

hausa: suka tayar wa Musa. Sai suka nemi goyon bayan sanannun shugabannin Isra’ilawa da aka naɗa a majalisa su guda 250,
english: They rose up before Moses, with some of the children of Israel, two hundred fifty princes of the congregation, called to the assembly, men of renown.

hausa: Sai ga wani mutum ya zo daga Ba’al-Shalisha, ya kawo wa Elisha dunƙulen burodi guda ashirin na sha’ir da aka gasa daga nunan fari na hatsi, tare da kawunan sababbin hatsi. Sai Elisha ya ce, “Ka ba mutanen su ci.”
english: A man from Baal Shalishah came, and brought the man of God some bread of the first fruits: twenty loaves of barley and fresh ears of grain in his sack. Elisha said, “Give to the people, that they may eat.”

hausa: Saboda haka mutanen Benyamin suka komo a lokacin aka kuma ba su matan Yabesh Gileyad nan da aka bari da rai. Amma matan ba su ishe su duka ba.
english: Benjamin returned at that time; and they gave them the women whom they had saved alive of the women of Jabesh Gilead. There still weren’t enough for them.

hausa: “Sa’an nan ne fushina zai huce hasalata a kanki kuma ta lafa, in kuma wartsake. Kuma sa’ad da na zuba fushina a kansu, a sa’an nan ne za su san cewa Ni Ubangiji na yi magana a cikin fushin kishina a kansu.
english: “‘Thus my anger will be accomplished, and I will cause my wrath toward them to rest, and I will be comforted. They will know that I, Yahweh, have spoken in my zeal, when I have accomplished my wrath on them.

hausa: Duk da haka mutanena sun manta da ni; sun ƙone turare wa gumaka marasa amfani, waɗanda suka sa su tuntuɓe a al’amuransu a hanyoyin dā. Sun sa suka yi tafiya a ɓarayin hanyoyi a hanyoyin da ba a gina ba.
english: For my people have forgotten me. They have burned incense to false gods. They have been made to stumble in their ways in the ancient paths, to walk in byways, in a way not built up,

hausa: Suka tattofa masa miyau, suka karɓe sandan, suka yi ta ƙwala masa shi a kai.
english: They spat on him, and took the reed and struck him on the head.

hausa: Ina tafiya a hanyar adalci, a kan hanyoyin gaskiya,
english: I walk in the way of righteousness, in the middle of the paths of justice,

hausa: A ranar, mutum zai bar karsana ɗaya da awaki biyu da rai.
english: It shall happen in that day that a man shall keep alive a young cow, and two sheep.

hausa: “Yana sa ruwa yă zama tururi yă zubo daga sama.
english: For he draws up the drops of water, which distill in rain from his vapor,

hausa: suka yi rawanin da lallausan lilin, da hulan lilin da rigunan ciki na lallausan lilin.
english: the turban of fine linen, the linen headbands of fine linen, the linen trousers of fine twined linen,

hausa: Sai Yesu ya amsa ya ce, “Ba ni na zaɓe ku Sha Biyu ba? Amma ɗayanku Iblis ne!”
english: Jesus answered them, “Didn’t I choose you, the twelve, and one of you is a devil?”

hausa: Ya kai wa Eglon sarkin Mowab harajin, wanda yake mai ƙiba ne.
english: He offered the tribute to Eglon king of Moab. Now Eglon was a very fat man.

hausa: Bari mu tsaya da ƙarfi a kan ga begen da muka ce namu ne, gama shi da ya yi alkawarin, mai aminci ne.
english: let’s hold fast the confession of our hope without wavering; for he who promised is faithful.

hausa: Dogara a kan doki don ceto banza ne; duk da yawan ƙarfinsa ba ya ceto.
english: A horse is a vain thing for safety, neither does he deliver any by his great power.

hausa: da Beyera, wanda Tiglat-Fileser sarkin Assuriya ya ɗauka zuwa zaman bauta. Beyera shi ne shugaban mutanen Ruben.
english: and Beerah his son, whom Tilgath Pilneser king of Assyria carried away captive. He was prince of the Reubenites.

hausa: Gama na kiyaye hanyoyin Ubangiji; ban yi mugunta ta wurin juyewa daga Allahna ba.
english: For I have kept the ways of Yahweh, and have not wickedly departed from my God.

hausa: Sai dai ba za su yi nisa ba, don rashin hankalinsu zai bayyana ga kowa, kamar na mutanen nan biyu.
english: But they will proceed no further. For their folly will be evident to all men, as theirs also came to be.

hausa: Yoshuwa ya yi musu yadda Ubangiji ya umarta, ya gurgunta dawakansu, ya kuma ƙone keken yaƙinsu.
english: Joshua did to them as Yahweh told him. He hamstrung their horses and burned their chariots with fire.

hausa: Zan hukunta shi da kuma ’ya’yansa da masu hidimarsa saboda muguntarsu; zan kawo kowace masifar da na furta a kansu da kuma waɗanda suke zama a Urushalima da na Yahuda, domin sun ƙi su saurara.’ ”
english: I will punish him, his offspring, and his servants for their iniquity. I will bring on them, on the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and on the men of Judah, all the evil that I have pronounced against them, but they didn’t listen.”’”

hausa: zan yi adawa da ku, zan kuma aukar muku saboda zunubanku har sau bakwai.
english: then I will also walk contrary to you; and I will strike you, even I, seven times for your sins.

hausa: Da kalmomin ƙiyayya sun kewaye ni; sun tasar mini ba dalili.
english: They have also surrounded me with words of hatred, and fought against me without a cause.

hausa: ka faɗa mata, ‘Ga abin da Ubangiji ya ce ina gāba da ke. Zan ja takobina daga kubensa in karkashe adalai da mugaye daga cikinki.
english: Tell the land of Israel, ‘Yahweh says: “Behold, I am against you, and will draw my sword out of its sheath, and will cut off from you the righteous and the wicked.

hausa: Yanzu fa, kada ku bar Hezekiya yă ruɗe ku yă kuma ɓad da ku haka. Kada ku gaskata shi, gama babu allahn wata ƙasa ko masarautar da ya taɓa iya ceton mutanensa daga hannuna ko kuwa hannun kakannina. Balle har Allahnku yă cece ku daga hannuna!”
english: Now therefore don’t let Hezekiah deceive you nor persuade you in this way. Don’t believe him, for no god of any nation or kingdom was able to deliver his people out of my hand, and out of the hand of my fathers. How much less will your God deliver you out of my hand?”

hausa: Mutanen Yahuda, masu riƙe garkuwa da māshi, su 6,800 shiryayyu don yaƙi;
english: The children of Judah who bore shield and spear were six thousand eight hundred, armed for war.

hausa: Sai Eliyakim ɗan Hilkiya, da Shebna, da Yowa suka ce wa jagoran dakarun, “Muna roƙonka ka yi wa bayinka magana da harshen Arameyik da yake muna ji. Kada ka yi mana magana da Yahudanci domin kada mutanen da suke bisa katanga su ji!”
english: Then Eliakim the son of Hilkiah, Shebnah, and Joah, said to Rabshakeh, “Please speak to your servants in the Syrian language, for we understand it. Don’t speak with us in the Jews’ language, in the hearing of the people who are on the wall.”

hausa: Amma war haka gobe zan aika shugabannina su bincika fadanka da kuma gidajen shugabanninka. Za su kwashe dukan abubuwan da kake ganin darajarsu su tafi.’ ”
english: but I will send my servants to you tomorrow about this time, and they will search your house and the houses of your servants. Whatever is pleasant in your eyes, they will put it in their hand, and take it away.”’”

hausa: haka ma Gomer da dukan sojojinsa, da Bet Togarma daga can arewa tare da dukan sojojinsa, al’ummai masu yawa tare da kai.
english: Gomer, and all his hordes; the house of Togarmah in the uttermost parts of the north, and all his hordes—even many peoples with you.

hausa: Kaiton mata masu ciki da mata masu renon ’ya’ya a waɗancan kwanakin!
english: But woe to those who are with child and to nursing mothers in those days!

hausa: Allah ya kuma ce, “Wannan ita ce alamar alkawarin da na yi tsakanina da ku, da kowace halitta tare da ku; alkawari na dukan zamanai masu zuwa.
english: God said, “This is the token of the covenant which I make between me and you and every living creature that is with you, for perpetual generations:

hausa: Shallum mahaifin Hilkiya, Hilkiya mahaifin Azariya,
english: Shallum became the father of Hilkiah. Hilkiah became the father of Azariah.

hausa: Ka tabbata da wannan. Mugaye ba za su tafi babu hukunci ba, amma waɗanda suke masu adalci za su tafi babu hukunci.
english: Most certainly, the evil man will not be unpunished, but the offspring of the righteous will be delivered.

hausa: Yesu ya ce wa almajiransa, “Dole ne a sami abubuwan da suke sa mutane su yi zunubi, amma kaiton mutumin nan wanda suke zuwa ta wurinsa.
english: He said to the disciples, “It is impossible that no occasions of stumbling should come, but woe to him through whom they come!

hausa: Suka tashi daga Jan Teku, suka yi sansani a Hamadan Sin.
english: They traveled from the Red Sea, and encamped in the wilderness of Sin.

hausa: Don mai bi da kaɗe-kaɗe. Zabura ta Dawuda. Sammai suna shelar ɗaukakar Allah; sararin sama suna furta aikin hannuwansa.
english: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. The heavens declare the glory of God. The expanse shows his handiwork.

hausa: Zunuban waɗansu mutane a fili suke, suna shan gabansu zuwa hukunci; zunuban waɗansu kuwa sukan bi su a baya.
english: Some men’s sins are evident, preceding them to judgment, and some also follow later.

hausa: Sai Yoshuwa ya yi wuƙaƙe na duwatsu, ya yi wa Isra’ilawa kaciya a Gibeyat-Ha’aralot.
english: Joshua made himself flint knives, and circumcised the sons of Israel at the hill of the foreskins.

hausa: wanda ya ba da kansa fansa domin dukan mutane, shaidar da aka bayar a daidai lokaci.
english: who gave himself as a ransom for all, the testimony at the proper time,

hausa: Saboda haka zan hukunta su cikin fushi; Ba zan dube su da tausayi ko kuwa in ƙyale su ba. Ko da yake suna ihu a kunnuwana, ba zan saurare su ba.”
english: Therefore I will also deal in wrath. My eye won’t spare, neither will I have pity. Though they cry in my ears with a loud voice, yet I will not hear them.”

hausa: amma ya fi muku muhimmanci in rayu cikin jiki.
english: Yet to remain in the flesh is more needful for your sake.

hausa: Bari alherin shugabanmu Allah yă kasance a kanmu; ka albarkaci mana aikin hannuwanmu, I, ka albarkaci aikin hannuwanmu.
english: Let the favor of the Lord our God be on us. Establish the work of our hands for us. Yes, establish the work of our hands.

hausa: “ ‘Za su zubar da azurfarsu a tituna, zinariyarsu kuma za tă zama ƙazantacciyar aba. Azurfarsu da zinariyarsu ba za su iya cetonsu a ranar hasalar Ubangiji ba. Ba za su ƙosar da yunwansu ko su cika cikinsu da shi ba, gama su ne sanadin tuntuɓensu cikin zunubi.
english: They will cast their silver in the streets, and their gold will be as an unclean thing. Their silver and their gold won’t be able to deliver them in the day of Yahweh’s wrath. They won’t satisfy their souls or fill their bellies; because it has been the stumbling block of their iniquity.

hausa: “A kwanakin nan, a wannan lokaci,” in ji Ubangiji, “mutanen Isra’ila da mutanen Yahuda gaba ɗaya za su tafi cikin hawaye su nemi Ubangiji Allahnsu.
english: “In those days, and in that time,” says Yahweh, “the children of Israel will come, they and the children of Judah together; they will go on their way weeping, and will seek Yahweh their God.

hausa: Dukan masu yin gumaka za su sha kunya; za su fita da kunya gaba ɗaya.
english: They will be disappointed, yes, confounded, all of them. Those who are makers of idols will go into confusion together.

hausa: Daniyel ya amsa, “Babu wani mai hikima, ko mai sihiri, ko mai dabo ko mai duban da zai iya warware wa sarki wannan matsala da ta dame shi,
english: Daniel answered before the king, and said, “The secret which the king has demanded can’t be shown to the king by wise men, enchanters, magicians, or soothsayers;

hausa: Wannan ne zunubin gidan Yerobowam da ya kai ga fāɗuwarsa da kuma hallakarsa daga fuskar duniya.
english: This thing became sin to the house of Jeroboam, even to cut it off and to destroy it from off the surface of the earth.

hausa: A lokacin suka miƙa hadaya bijimai ɗari bakwai da tumaki da kuma awaki dubu bakwai ga Ubangiji daga ganimar da suka dawo da ita.
english: They sacrificed to Yahweh in that day, from the plunder which they had brought, seven hundred head of cattle and seven thousand sheep.

hausa: Mika, Reyahiya, Ba’al,
english: Micah his son, Reaiah his son, Baal his son,

hausa: Duk wanda ya kwana ko ya ci abinci a gidan dole yă wanke rigunansa.
english: He who lies down in the house shall wash his clothes; and he who eats in the house shall wash his clothes.

hausa: Amma a ce mai tsaron ya ga takobi yana zuwa bai kuwa busa ƙaho don yă faɗakar da mutane ba sai takobi ya zo ya ɗauki ran waninsu, za a kawar da wannan mutum saboda zunubinsa, amma zan nemi hakkin jinin mutumin a kan mai tsaron.’
english: But if the watchman sees the sword come and doesn’t blow the trumpet, and the people aren’t warned, and the sword comes and takes any person from among them, he is taken away in his iniquity, but his blood I will require at the watchman’s hand.’

hausa: Kamar tsuntsaye masu firiya da aka kora daga sheƙa, haka matan Mowab suke a kogunan Arnon.
english: For it will be that as wandering birds, as a scattered nest, so will the daughters of Moab be at the fords of the Arnon.

hausa: Kome yawan ’ya’yansa, takobi za tă gama da su; zuriyarsa ba za su taɓa samun isashen abinci ba.
english: If his children are multiplied, it is for the sword. His offspring will not be satisfied with bread.

hausa: Amma bai so ya sāke kwana a can ba, mutumin ya tashi ya tafi ya bi ta Yebus (wato, Urushalima), tare da jakunansa biyu da aka yi musu shimfiɗa da kuma ƙwarƙwaransa.
english: But the man wouldn’t stay that night, but he rose up and went near Jebus (also called Jerusalem). With him were a couple of saddled donkeys. His concubine also was with him.

hausa: “Ni ne Ubangiji Allahnka, wanda ya fitar da ku daga Masar, daga ƙasar bauta.
english: “I am Yahweh your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage.

hausa: kada ku tsokane su da yaƙi, gama ba zan ba ku wata ƙasa daga cikinsu ba, ba ma wadda za tă iya isa ku sa ƙafarku a kai. Na ba wa Isuwa ƙasar tudu ta Seyir, ta zama tasa.
english: Don’t contend with them; for I will not give you any of their land, no, not so much as for the sole of the foot to tread on, because I have given Mount Seir to Esau for a possession.

hausa: Saboda haka kai ba bawa ba ne kuma, kai ɗa ne; da yake kuwa kai ɗa ne, Allah ya mai da kai magāji.
english: So you are no longer a bondservant, but a son; and if a son, then an heir of God through Christ.

hausa: Amma Barnabas ya ɗauke shi ya kawo shi wurin manzanni. Ya gaya musu yadda Shawulu a kan hanyarsa ya ga Ubangiji kuma cewa Ubangiji ya yi magana da shi, da yadda a Damaskus ya yi wa’azi ba tsoro a cikin sunan Yesu.
english: But Barnabas took him and brought him to the apostles, and declared to them how he had seen the Lord on the way, and that he had spoken to him, and how at Damascus he had preached boldly in the name of Jesus.

hausa: “Ɗan mutum, ka yi annabci wa duwatsun Isra’ila ka ce, ‘Ya duwatsun Isra’ila, ku ji maganar Ubangiji.
english: You, son of man, prophesy to the mountains of Israel, and say, “You mountains of Israel, hear Yahweh’s word.

hausa: Yewuz, Sakiya da Mirma ta wurin Hodesh matarsa. Waɗannan su ne ’ya’yansa, kawunan iyalai.
english: Jeuz, Shachia, and Mirmah. These were his sons, heads of fathers’ households.

hausa: Sa’an nan ta wuce zuwa arewancin gangaren Bet-Hogla ta kuma ɓulla a arewancin gaɓar Tekun Gishiri, a bakin Urdun a kudu. Wannan ita ce iyakar a wajen kudu.
english: The border passed along to the side of Beth Hoglah northward; and the border ended at the north bay of the Salt Sea, at the south end of the Jordan. This was the south border.

hausa: Ba zan shiga shawararsu ba, ba zan shiga taronsu ba, gama sun kashe maza cikin fushinsu cikin ganin dama suka kashe bijimai.
english: My soul, don’t come into their council. My glory, don’t be united to their assembly; for in their anger they killed men. In their self-will they hamstrung cattle.

hausa: Dukan mutane za su san shi, Efraim da mazaunan Samariya, waɗanda suke magana da fariya suna kuma ɗaga kai,
english: All the people will know, including Ephraim and the inhabitants of Samaria, who say in pride and in arrogance of heart,

hausa: Sakare da mutumin banza wanda yana yawo da magana banza a baki,
english: A worthless person, a man of iniquity, is he who walks with a perverse mouth,

hausa: “Kamar zaki mai haurawa daga kurmin Urdun zuwa wurin kiwo mai kyau, zan kori Edom daga ƙasarta nan da nan. Wane ne zaɓaɓɓen da zan naɗa don wannan? Wane ne yake kama da ni kuma wa zai kalubalance ni? Kuma wane makiyayi ne zai yi gāba da ni?”
english: “Behold, he will come up like a lion from the pride of the Jordan against the strong habitation; for I will suddenly make them run away from it, and whoever is chosen, I will appoint him over it. For who is like me? Who will appoint me a time? Who is the shepherd who will stand before me?”

hausa: ɗan Etan, ɗan Zimma, ɗan Shimeyi,
english: the son of Ethan, the son of Zimmah, the son of Shimei,

hausa: Ku tafi cikin duwatsu, ku ɓuya cikin ƙasa daga razanar Ubangiji da kuma darajar ɗaukakarsa!
english: Enter into the rock, and hide in the dust, from before the terror of Yahweh, and from the glory of his majesty.

hausa: Sai na juya ga tunanina don in lura da hikima, da kuma hauka da wauta. Me ya rage wa magājin sarki yă yi fiye da abin da aka riga aka yi?
english: I turned myself to consider wisdom, madness, and folly; for what can the king’s successor do? Just that which has been done long ago.

hausa: Kun dai ji saɓon. Me kuka gani?” Duka suka yanke masa hukuncin kisa.
english: You have heard the blasphemy! What do you think?” They all condemned him to be worthy of death.

hausa: Gama mutuntaka yana son abin da Ruhu yake ƙi, Ruhu kuma yana son abin da mutuntaka yake ƙi. Waɗannan biyu kuwa gāba suke da juna, har ku kāsa yin abin da kuke so.
english: For the flesh lusts against the Spirit, and the Spirit against the flesh; and these are contrary to one another, that you may not do the things that you desire.

hausa: Har yaushe mugaye, ya Ubangiji har yaushe mugaye za su yi ta murna?
english: Yahweh, how long will the wicked, how long will the wicked triumph?

hausa: Yaro mai shekara tsakanin wata ɗaya da shekara biyar, za a biya azurfa biyar, ’yar yarinya kuma azurfa uku.
english: If the person is from a month old to five years old, then your valuation shall be for a male five shekels of silver, and for a female your valuation shall be three shekels of silver.

hausa: Bari leɓunana su cika da yabonka, gama ka koya mini ƙa’idodinka.
english: Let my lips utter praise, for you teach me your statutes.

hausa: Duk abin da hannunka yake yi, ka yi shi da dukan ƙarfinka, gama a cikin kabari in da za ka, babu aiki ko shirye-shirye, ko sani, ko hikima.
english: Whatever your hand finds to do, do it with your might; for there is no work, nor plan, nor knowledge, nor wisdom, in Sheol, where you are going.

hausa: Dole mu ƙara mai da hankali sosai ga abubuwan da muka ji, don kada mu kauce.
english: Therefore we ought to pay greater attention to the things that were heard, lest perhaps we drift away.

hausa: To, dā Hiridus ya kama Yohanna ya daure, ya kuma sa shi cikin kurkuku saboda Hiridiyas, matar ɗan’uwansa Filibus,
english: For Herod had arrested John, bound him, and put him in prison for the sake of Herodias, his brother Philip’s wife.

hausa: “Ku mai da hankali, ku yi biyayya da duk abin da na faɗa muku. Kada ku kira sunaye waɗansu alloli; kada a ji su a bakinku.
english: “Be careful to do all things that I have said to you; and don’t invoke the name of other gods or even let them be heard out of your mouth.

hausa: Duk da haka ya manne wa zunuban Yerobowam ɗan Nebat, wanda ya sa Isra’ila ta aikata, bai rabu da su ba.
english: Nevertheless he held to the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, with which he made Israel to sin. He didn’t depart from them.

hausa: “A cikin annabawan Samariya na ga wannan abin banƙyama. Suna annabci ta wurin Ba’al suna ɓad da mutanena Isra’ila.
english: “I have seen folly in the prophets of Samaria. They prophesied by Baal, and caused my people Israel to err.

hausa: Eli ya ce, mene ne ya ce maka? Kada ka ɓoye mini. Allah ya yi da kai har ma fiye in ka ɓoye mini kome da ya ce maka.
english: He said, “What is the thing that he has spoken to you? Please don’t hide it from me. God do so to you, and more also, if you hide anything from me of all the things that he spoke to you.”

hausa: Masar tana tashi kamar Nilu, kamar koguna masu tafasa. Tana cewa, ‘Zan tashi in rufe duniya; zan hallakar da birane da kuma mutanensu.’
english: Egypt rises up like the Nile, like rivers whose waters surge. He says, ‘I will rise up. I will cover the earth. I will destroy cities and its inhabitants.’

hausa: sa’ad da kuma garkunanku na shanu da na tumaki suka ƙaru, azurfanku da zinariyarku kuma suka ƙaru, sa’an nan dukan abin da kuke da shi ya haɓaka,
english: and when your herds and your flocks multiply, and your silver and your gold is multiplied, and all that you have is multiplied;

hausa: Na Lawiyawa su ne, Shemahiya ɗan Hasshub, ɗan Azrikam, ɗan Hashabiya, mutumin Merari;
english: Of the Levites: Shemaiah the son of Hasshub, the son of Azrikam, the son of Hashabiah, of the sons of Merari;

hausa: “Ɗan mutum, ka bayyana haikalin ga mutanen Isra’ila, don su ji kunya saboda zunubansu. Bari su yi la’akari da fasalin,
english: “You, son of man, show the house to the house of Israel, that they may be ashamed of their iniquities; and let them measure the pattern.

hausa: “Kada ku taurare zukatanku kamar yadda kuka yi a Meriba, kamar yadda kuka yi a wancan rana a Massa a hamada,
english: Don’t harden your heart, as at Meribah, as in the day of Massah in the wilderness,

hausa: Sa’an nan Yaƙub ya ba wa Isuwa burodi da ɗan miyan lansir. Ya ci, ya sha, sa’an nan ya tashi ya tafi. Ta haka Isuwa ya yi banza da matsayinsa na ɗan fari.
english: Jacob gave Esau bread and lentil stew. He ate and drank, rose up, and went his way. So Esau despised his birthright.

hausa: Suka yi watsi da farillansa da yarjejjeniyar da ya ƙulla da kakanninsu, da kuma kashedin da ya yi musu. Suka bi gumaka marasa amfani, wannan ya sa su ma kansu suka zama marasa amfani. Suka kwaikwayi sauran ƙasashen da suke kewaye da su, ko da yake Ubangiji ya umarce su cewa, “Kada ku yi rayuwa irin tasu,” suka kuwa yi abin da Ubangiji ya hana su.
english: They rejected his statutes and his covenant that he made with their fathers, and his testimonies which he testified to them; and they followed vanity, and became vain, and followed the nations that were around them, concerning whom Yahweh had commanded them that they should not do like them.

hausa: To, in Dawuda ya kira shi ‘Ubangiji,’ yaya zai zama ɗansa?”
