english: “If then David calls him Lord, how is he his son?”

hausa: Laban ya sa masa suna Yegar Sahaduta, Yaƙub kuwa ya kira shi Galeyed.
english: Laban called it Jegar Sahadutha, but Jacob called it Galeed.

hausa: Amma fa, in mutum ba ya so yă auri matar ɗan’uwansa, sai tă tafi wurin dattawa a ƙofar gari tă ce, “Ɗan’uwan mijina ya ƙi yă wanzar da sunan ɗan’uwansa a Isra’ila. Ya ƙi yă cika abin da ya kamaci ɗan’uwan miji yă yi gare ni.”
english: If the man doesn’t want to take his brother’s wife, then his brother’s wife shall go up to the gate to the elders, and say, “My husband’s brother refuses to raise up to his brother a name in Israel. He will not perform the duty of a husband’s brother to me.”

hausa: Yoram, ɗan Ahab ya zama sarki Isra’ila, a Samariya, a shekara ta goma sha takwas ta mulkin Yehoshafat, sarkin Yahuda, ya kuma yi mulki shekara goma sha biyu.
english: Now Jehoram the son of Ahab began to reign over Israel in Samaria in the eighteenth year of Jehoshaphat king of Judah, and reigned twelve years.

hausa: Tarko ya kama ɗiɗɗigensa; tarko ya riƙe shi kam.
english: A snare will take him by the heel. A trap will catch him.

hausa: “Ga shi, kukan sa rai za ku sami da yawa, amma sai ku ga kun sami kaɗan. Ɗan kaɗan ɗin ma da kukan kawo gida, nakan hura shi yă tafi. Me ya sa yake faruwa haka?” In ji Ubangiji Maɗaukaki. “Saboda gidana da yake zaman kango, yayinda kowannenku yana faman gina gidansa.
english: “You looked for much, and, behold, it came to little; and when you brought it home, I blew it away. Why?” says Yahweh of Armies, “Because of my house that lies waste, while each of you is busy with his own house.

hausa: Nan da nan, ɗaya daga cikinsu ya ruga, ya sami soso, ya jiƙa shi da ruwan tsami, ya sa a sanda, ya miƙa wa Yesu, yă sha.
english: Immediately one of them ran and took a sponge, filled it with vinegar, put it on a reed, and gave him a drink.

hausa: Yayinda Farisiyawa suke a tattare wuri ɗaya, sai Yesu ya tambaye su,
english: Now while the Pharisees were gathered together, Jesus asked them a question,

hausa: In masoyarku kawai kuke ƙauna, wace lada ce gare ku? Ko masu karɓar haraji ma ba haka suke yi ba?
english: For if you love those who love you, what reward do you have? Don’t even the tax collectors do the same?

hausa: Ƙanƙanen abin da mai adalci yake da shi ya fi arzikin mugaye yawa;
english: Better is a little that the righteous has, than the abundance of many wicked.

hausa: Za su ce wa dattawan, “Wannan ɗanmu gagararre ne, mai tawaye. Ba ya mana biyayya. Mai zari ne, kuma mashayi.”
english: They shall tell the elders of his city, “This our son is stubborn and rebellious. He will not obey our voice. He is a glutton and a drunkard.”

hausa: ’Ya’yan Uzziyel maza su ne, Mika na fari da Isshiya na biyu.
english: The sons of Uzziel: Micah the chief, and Isshiah the second.

hausa: Amma me kuka je kallo? Annabi? I, ina kuma faɗa muku, ya ma fi annabi.
english: But what did you go out to see? A prophet? Yes, I tell you, and much more than a prophet.

hausa: Sau nawa mutum ya fi tunkiya daraja! Saboda haka ya dace a aikata alheri ran Asabbaci.”
english: Of how much more value then is a man than a sheep! Therefore it is lawful to do good on the Sabbath day.”

hausa: Bayan kwana uku sai shugabannin suka zazzaga sansani, suna
english: After three days, the officers went through the middle of the camp;

hausa: Shawulu ya tashi daga ƙasa, amma sa’ad da ya buɗe idanunsa bai iya ganin wani abu ba. Saboda haka aka kama hannunsa aka yi masa jagora zuwa cikin Damaskus.
english: Saul arose from the ground, and when his eyes were opened, he saw no one. They led him by the hand and brought him into Damascus.

hausa: Gizagizai da baƙin duhu sun kewaye shi; adalci da gaskiya su ne tushen kursiyinsa.
english: Clouds and darkness are around him. Righteousness and justice are the foundation of his throne.

hausa: Ya ce musu, “Ku tafi!” Sai suka fita suka shiga cikin aladun, dukan garken kuwa ya gangara a guje daga kan tudun zuwa cikin tafkin aladun kuma suka mutu a cikin ruwa.
english: He said to them, “Go!” They came out and went into the herd of pigs; and behold, the whole herd of pigs rushed down the cliff into the sea and died in the water.

hausa: Idan girgijen bai tashi ba, ba za su tashi ba, sai a ranar da ya tashi.
english: but if the cloud wasn’t taken up, then they didn’t travel until the day that it was taken up.

hausa: Ubangiji da girma yake, gama yana zaune a bisa; zai cika Sihiyona cikin gaskiya da adalci.
english: Yahweh is exalted, for he dwells on high. He has filled Zion with justice and righteousness.

hausa: “Lalle, na san wannan gaskiya ne. Amma ta yaya mutum zai iya zama mai adalci a gaban Allah?
english: “Truly I know that it is so, but how can man be just with God?

hausa: Da Yesu ya sauka daga jirgin, sai ga wani mutum mai aljanu daga garin. Mutumin ya daɗe bai sa tufafi ba, kuma ba ya zama a gida. Yana zama a cikin kaburbura.
english: When Jesus stepped ashore, a certain man out of the city who had demons for a long time met him. He wore no clothes, and didn’t live in a house, but in the tombs.

hausa: Saboda haka ga abin da Ubangiji, Allah na Isra’ila yana ce wa makiyayan da suke lura da mutanena, “Domin kun watsar da garkena kuka kuma kore su ba ku kuma lura da su ba, zan kawo hukunci a kanku saboda muguntar da kuka yi,” in ji Ubangiji.
english: Therefore Yahweh, the God of Israel, says against the shepherds who feed my people: “You have scattered my flock, driven them away, and have not visited them. Behold, I will visit on you the evil of your doings,” says Yahweh.

hausa: Na tanada wuri saboda akwatin alkawari, akwatin da ya ƙunshi alkawarin da Ubangiji ya yi da kakanninmu sa’ad da ya fitar da su daga Masar.”
english: There I have set a place for the ark, in which is Yahweh’s covenant, which he made with our fathers when he brought them out of the land of Egypt.”

hausa: Amma in wani ba shi da su, ba shi da hangen nesa ke nan kuma makaho ne, ya kuma manta cewa an tsarkake shi daga zunubansa na dā.
english: For he who lacks these things is blind, seeing only what is near, having forgotten the cleansing from his old sins.

hausa: a can ya yi hadaya da shanu da tumaki, ya kuwa aika wa Bala’am da dattawan da suke tare da shi.
english: Balak sacrificed cattle and sheep, and sent to Balaam, and to the princes who were with him.

hausa: Duk wanda ya zalunci matalauci ya zagi Mahaliccinsu ke nan, amma duk wanda ya yi alheri ga mabukata yana girmama Allah ne.
english: He who oppresses the poor shows contempt for his Maker, but he who is kind to the needy honors him.

hausa: Dole yă keɓe kansa ga Ubangiji, har kwanakin keɓewarsa, kuma dole yă kawo ɗan rago bana ɗaya a matsayin hadayar laifi. Kwanakin baya ba sa cikin lissafi, domin ya ƙazantu a lokacin keɓewarsa.
english: He shall separate to Yahweh the days of his separation, and shall bring a male lamb a year old for a trespass offering; but the former days shall be void, because his separation was defiled.

hausa: Amma zan rera game da ƙarfinka, da safe zan rera game da ƙaunarka; gama kai ne mafakata, kagarata a lokacin wahala.
english: But I will sing of your strength. Yes, I will sing aloud of your loving kindness in the morning. For you have been my high tower, a refuge in the day of my distress.

hausa: ’Yar ƙaramar ma ta haifi ɗa, ta kuwa ba shi suna Ben-Ammi, shi ne mahaifin Ammonawa a yau.
english: The younger also bore a son, and called his name Ben Ammi. He is the father of the children of Ammon to this day.

hausa: ’Ya’ya bakwai maza na Sikeba, wani babban firist na Yahudawa, suna yin haka.
english: There were seven sons of one Sceva, a Jewish chief priest, who did this.

hausa: Suka mallaki ƙasarsa da kuma ƙasar Og sarkin Bashan, sarakuna biyu na Amoriyawa, gabas da Urdun.
english: They took possession of his land and the land of Og king of Bashan, the two kings of the Amorites, who were beyond the Jordan toward the sunrise;

hausa: Haske da yana da kyau, abu mai kyau ne kuma idanu su dubi rana.
english: Truly the light is sweet, and it is a pleasant thing for the eyes to see the sun.

hausa: Ga ni, da yaran da Ubangiji ya ba ni. Mu alamu ne da shaidu a cikin Isra’ila daga Ubangiji Maɗaukaki, wanda yake zama a Dutsen Sihiyona.
english: Behold, I and the children whom Yahweh has given me are for signs and for wonders in Israel from Yahweh of Armies, who dwells in Mount Zion.

hausa: Sai Ubangiji ya ce wa Musa, “Har yaushe za ku ƙi bin dokokina da umarnaina?
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “How long do you refuse to keep my commandments and my laws?

hausa: Attajiran da suka sayar da waɗannan kayayyaki suka kuma sami arzikinsu daga gare ta za su tsaya daga nesa, cike da tsoron ganin azabarta. Za su yi kuka da makoki
english: The merchants of these things, who were made rich by her, will stand far away for the fear of her torment, weeping and mourning,

hausa: Ku hankali, ku bi kowane umarnin da nake ba ku a yau, saboda ku rayu, ku ƙaru, ku kuma shiga, ku mallaki ƙasar da Ubangiji ya alkawarta da rantsuwa ga kakanninku.
english: You shall observe to do all the commandments which I command you today, that you may live, and multiply, and go in and possess the land which Yahweh swore to your fathers.

hausa: duk da haka ko mala’iku ma da suka fi su ƙarfi suka kuma fi su iko, ba sa kawo irin wannan zargi na ɓata suna game da waɗannan talikai a gaban Ubangiji.
english: whereas angels, though greater in might and power, don’t bring a slanderous judgment against them before the Lord.

hausa: “ ‘In da rago ne za a miƙa, to, sai a shirya hadaya ta gari mai laushi, garin yă zama kashi biyu bisa goma na efa. A kwaɓa shi da kashi ɗaya bisa uku na garwan mai,
english: “‘For a ram, you shall prepare for a meal offering two tenths of an ephah of fine flour mixed with the third part of a hin of oil;

hausa: Bisa da kansa kuwa, an kafa rubutun zargin da aka yi masa, da ya ce, Wannan shi ne Yesu Sarkin Yahudawa.
english: They set up over his head the accusation against him written, “THIS IS JESUS, THE KING OF THE JEWS.”

hausa: Sun fi nisan sama tudu, me za ka iya yi? Sun fi zurfin kabari zurfi, me za ka sani?
english: They are high as heaven. What can you do? They are deeper than Sheol. What can you know?

hausa: Kada ku ƙara, kada ku rage daga cikin abin da nake umarce ku. Amma ku kiyaye umarnan nan na Ubangiji Allahnku, da na ba ku.
english: You shall not add to the word which I command you, neither shall you take away from it, that you may keep the commandments of Yahweh your God which I command you.

hausa: A maimakon haka, “In abokin gābanka yana jin yunwa, ka ciyar da shi; in yana jin ƙishirwa, ka ba shi ruwan sha. Ta yin haka, za ka tara garwashin wuta a kansa.”
english: Therefore “If your enemy is hungry, feed him. If he is thirsty, give him a drink; for in doing so, you will heap coals of fire on his head.”

hausa: Sai ga waɗansu mutane suka kawo wani shanyayye a kan tabarma. Suka yi ƙoƙari su shigar da shi cikin gidan, domin su kwantar da shi a gaban Yesu.
english: Behold, men brought a paralyzed man on a cot, and they sought to bring him in to lay before Jesus.

hausa: In kuka juya wa Ubangiji baya, kuka bauta wa waɗansu alloli, zai juya yă kawo muku bala’i, yă hallaka ku, yă kawo ƙarshenku.”
english: If you forsake Yahweh, and serve foreign gods, then he will turn and do you evil, and consume you, after he has done you good.”

hausa: Ta haka mallakar Lawiyawa da mallakar birnin za su kasance a tsakiyar wurin da yake na sarki. Wurin da yake na sarki zai kasance tsakanin iyakar Yahuda da iyakar Benyamin.
english: Moreover, from the possession of the Levites, and from the possession of the city, being in the middle of that which is the prince’s, between the border of Judah and the border of Benjamin, shall be for the prince.

hausa: A waɗancan kwanaki, Kaisar Augustus ya ba da doka cewa ya kamata a yi ƙidaya a dukan masarautar Roma.
english: Now in those days, a decree went out from Caesar Augustus that all the world should be enrolled.

hausa: Sa’ad da kuka ’yantar da shi kada ku damu, gama shekara shida ya yi muku bauta wadda ta ninka ta ɗan ƙodago. Ubangiji Allahnku kuwa zai albarkace ku a kome da kuke yi.
english: It shall not seem hard to you when you let him go free from you, for he has been double the value of a hired hand as he served you six years. Yahweh your God will bless you in all that you do.

hausa: Ubangiji ya ce wa Musa,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

hausa: Ubangiji zai maido da darajar Yaƙub, kamar ta Isra’ila, ko da yake masu washewa sun washe su suka kuma lalatar da inabinsu.
english: For Yahweh restores the excellency of Jacob as the excellency of Israel, for the destroyers have destroyed them and ruined their vine branches.

hausa: Kada ku karɓi riba ta kowace iri daga gare shi, amma ku ji tsoron Allahnku, saboda mutumin ƙasarku yă ci gaba da zama a cikinku.
english: Take no interest from him or profit; but fear your God, that your brother may live among you.

hausa: kamar yadda babban firist da dukan Majalisa za su iya shaida. Na ma karɓi wasiƙu daga gare su zuwa ga ’yan’uwansu a Damaskus, na kuma tafi can don in kawo waɗannan mutane a daure zuwa Urushalima don a hukunta su.
english: as also the high priest and all the council of the elders testify, from whom also I received letters to the brothers, and traveled to Damascus to bring them also who were there to Jerusalem in bonds to be punished.

hausa: Saboda ƙaruwar mugunta, ƙaunar yawanci za tă yi sanyi,
english: Because iniquity will be multiplied, the love of many will grow cold.

hausa: Dukan Isra’ila daga Dan har Beyersheba suka shaida amincin Sama’ila annabi ne na Ubangiji.
english: All Israel from Dan even to Beersheba knew that Samuel was established to be a prophet of Yahweh.

hausa: Zan sa koguna su malalo a ƙeƙasassun tuddai, maɓulɓulan ruwa kuma a kwaruruka. Zan mai da hamada tafkunan ruwa, busasshiyar ƙasa kuma ta zama maɓulɓulan ruwa.
english: I will open rivers on the bare heights, and springs in the middle of the valleys. I will make the wilderness a pool of water, and the dry land springs of water.

hausa: Abin da Hezekiya ya yi ke nan ko’ina a Yahuda, yana yin abin da yake da kyau, daidai da kuma mai aminci a gaban Ubangiji Allahnsa.
english: Hezekiah did so throughout all Judah; and he did that which was good, right, and faithful before Yahweh his God.

hausa: Sai ya shiga filin haikali, ya fara korar masu sayar da kaya.
english: He entered into the temple and began to drive out those who bought and sold in it,

hausa: Yanzu kam, ina hanyata zuwa Urushalima don in kai gudummawa ga tsarkaka a can.
english: But now, I say, I am going to Jerusalem, serving the saints.

hausa: Ya zaɓi firistoci su yi aikinsu, sai ya ƙarfafa su su yi aikin da kyau a hidimar haikalin Ubangiji.
english: He set the priests in their offices and encouraged them in the service of Yahweh’s house.

hausa: Yayinda Dawuda yake zaune tsakanin ƙofofin ciki da na waje, sai mai tsaro ya hau rufin ginin da yake kan hanyar shiga ta wajen katanga. Da ya duba sai ya ga wani mutum shi kaɗai yana gudu.
english: Now David was sitting between the two gates; and the watchman went up to the roof of the gate to the wall, and lifted up his eyes and looked, and, behold, a man running alone.

hausa: Ba a ba mu wata alama mai banmamaki ba; ba sauran annabawan da suka ragu, kuma babu waninmu da ya sani har yaushe wannan zai ci gaba.
english: We see no miraculous signs. There is no longer any prophet, neither is there among us anyone who knows how long.

hausa: Kwanaki 180 cif, ya nuna yawan dukiyar masarautarsa, da ɗaukakarta da kuma darajar girmansa.
english: He displayed the riches of his glorious kingdom and the honor of his excellent majesty many days, even one hundred eighty days.

hausa: Yanzu ku daina ba’arku, in ba haka ba sarƙoƙinku za su ƙara nauyi; Ubangiji, Ubangiji Maɗaukaki, ya faɗa mini game da hallakar da aka ƙaddara a kan dukan ƙasar.
english: Now therefore don’t be scoffers, lest your bonds be made strong; for I have heard a decree of destruction from the Lord, Yahweh of Armies, on the whole earth.

hausa: Manyan firistoci suka zarge shi a kan abubuwa da yawa.
english: The chief priests accused him of many things.

hausa: Mata, ku yi biyayya ga mazanku, yadda ya dace cikin Ubangiji.
english: Wives, be in subjection to your husbands, as is fitting in the Lord.

hausa: Ni ne Allah na Betel, inda ka zuba wa al’amudi mai, da kuma inda ka yi mini alkawari. Yanzu ka bar wannan ƙasa nan take, ka koma ƙasarka ta ainihi.’ ”
english: I am the God of Bethel, where you anointed a pillar, where you vowed a vow to me. Now arise, get out from this land, and return to the land of your birth.’”

hausa: Sai Yesu ya ce, “Ni mai maganan nan da ke, Ni ne shi.”
english: Jesus said to her, “I am he, the one who speaks to you.”

hausa: Ta haka Yusuf ya zaunar da mahaifinsa da ’yan’uwansa a Masar, ya ba su mallaka a sashe mafi kyau na ƙasar, a yankin nan na Rameses, kamar yadda Fir’auna ya umarta.
english: Joseph placed his father and his brothers, and gave them a possession in the land of Egypt, in the best of the land, in the land of Rameses, as Pharaoh had commanded.

hausa: A ƙarshe masu gadin haikali suka koma wurin manyan firistocin da Farisiyawa, waɗanda suka tambaye su cewa, “Don me ba ku kawo shi nan ba?”
english: The officers therefore came to the chief priests and Pharisees; and they said to them, “Why didn’t you bring him?”

hausa: Za ku fita da farin ciki a kuma bi da ku da salama; duwatsu da tuddai za su ɓarke da waƙa a gabanku, dukan itatuwan jeji kuma za su tafa hannuwansu.
english: For you shall go out with joy, and be led out with peace. The mountains and the hills will break out before you into singing; and all the trees of the fields will clap their hands.

hausa: Ta wurin bangaskiya ne katangar Yeriko ta rushe, bayan mutane suka yi ta kewaye ta har kwana bakwai.
english: By faith the walls of Jericho fell down after they had been encircled for seven days.

hausa: duk waɗanda suke da niyya, waɗanda kuma zukatansu suka motsa su, suka kawo kyautai wa Ubangiji, don aikin Tentin Sujada, don duk aikinsa, da don tsarkakakkun riguna.
english: They came, everyone whose heart stirred him up, and everyone whom his spirit made willing, and brought Yahweh’s offering for the work of the Tent of Meeting, and for all of its service, and for the holy garments.

hausa: Yonatan ya ce wa saurayin mai ɗaukan makamai, “Zo mu haye zuwa mashigin mutane marasa kaciyan nan, wataƙila Ubangiji zai yi aiki a madadinmu. Ba abin da zai iya hana Ubangiji yin aikin ceto ta wurin mutane masu yawa, ko ta wurin mutane kaɗan.”
english: Jonathan said to the young man who bore his armor, “Come! Let’s go over to the garrison of these uncircumcised. It may be that Yahweh will work for us, for there is no restraint on Yahweh to save by many or by few.”

hausa: “Sa’ad da za ku ƙidaya Isra’ilawa, dole kowanne yă biya domin yă fanshe kansa ga Ubangiji a lokacin da aka ƙidaya shi. Ta haka babu wata annobar da za tă buge su sa’ad da kuke ƙidaya su.
english: “When you take a census of the children of Israel, according to those who are counted among them, then each man shall give a ransom for his soul to Yahweh when you count them, that there be no plague among them when you count them.

hausa: Ubangiji ya yi umarni, mutane masu yawa ne suka yi shelarsa,
english: The Lord announced the word. The ones who proclaim it are a great company.

hausa: Kaitonki, Mowab! Gunkinki Kemosh ya yashe mutanenki; aka kuma kama su, aka kai su bauta wajen Sihon sarkin Amoriyawa.
english: Woe to you, Moab! You are undone, people of Chemosh! He has given his sons as fugitives, and his daughters into captivity, to Sihon king of the Amorites.

hausa: Da Midiyawa suka matsa musu sosai, sai Isra’ilawa suka yi wa kansu mafakai a rammukan duwatsu, kogona da kuma mafaka.
english: The hand of Midian prevailed against Israel; and because of Midian the children of Israel made themselves the dens which are in the mountains, the caves, and the strongholds.

hausa: Wannan ya ci gaba shekara da shekaru. Duk lokacin da Hannatu ta haura zuwa haikalin Ubangiji, sai kishiyarta tă tsokane ta har tă yi ta kuka tă kuma ƙi cin abinci.
english: So year by year, when she went up to Yahweh’s house, her rival provoked her. Therefore she wept, and didn’t eat.

hausa: Zanowa, En Gannim, Taffuwa, Enam,
english: Zanoah, En Gannim, Tappuah, Enam,

hausa: Na dai san ku zuriyar Ibrahim ne. Duk da haka kuna shiri ku kashe ni, don maganata ba ta da wurin zama a cikinku.
english: I know that you are Abraham’s offspring, yet you seek to kill me, because my word finds no place in you.

hausa: Andarawus, Filibus, Bartolomeyu, Mattiyu, Toma, Yaƙub ɗan Alfayus, Taddayus, Siman wanda ake kira Zilot,
english: Andrew; Philip; Bartholomew; Matthew; Thomas; James, the son of Alphaeus; Thaddaeus; Simon the Zealot;

hausa: Wawa yakan nuna fushinsa a fili, amma mai hikima kan kanne fushinsa.
english: A fool vents all of his anger, but a wise man brings himself under control.

hausa: Zukatansu ta karaya; suka fito da rawan jiki daga kagararsu.
english: The foreigners will fade away, and will come trembling out of their close places.

hausa: Da tsakar rana, Iliya ya fara yin musu ba’a. Ya ce, “Ku yi ihu da ƙarfi, tabbatacce shi allah ne! Mai yiwuwa yana cikin zurfin tunani, ko dai aiki ya yi masa yawa, ko ya yi tafiya. Mai yiwuwa yana barci ne, dole a tashe shi.”
english: At noon, Elijah mocked them, and said, “Cry aloud, for he is a god. Either he is deep in thought, or he has gone somewhere, or he is on a journey, or perhaps he sleeps and must be awakened.”

hausa: Yakan sa masu iko su ji kunya yă kuma ƙwace ƙarfin masu ƙarfi.
english: He pours contempt on princes, and loosens the belt of the strong.

hausa: Da sarkin Isra’ila ya karanta wasiƙar, sai ya yayyage tufafinsa, ya ce, “Ni Allah ne? Zan iya ɗauke rai ko in mai da shi? Me ya sa wannan mutum ya turo mini wannan mutum in warkar da kuturtarsa? Dubi fa yadda yake nemana da faɗa!”
english: When the king of Israel had read the letter, he tore his clothes and said, “Am I God, to kill and to make alive, that this man sends to me to heal a man of his leprosy? But please consider and see how he seeks a quarrel against me.”

hausa: Amma mu ba na waɗanda suke ja da baya, su kuma hallaka ba ne, amma na waɗanda suka gaskata, suka kuma sami ceto ne.
english: But we are not of those who shrink back to destruction, but of those who have faith to the saving of the soul.

hausa: tare da waɗanda suke kiyaye alkawarinsa suna kuma tuna su yi biyayya da farillansa.
english: to those who keep his covenant, to those who remember to obey his precepts.

hausa: “Kaitonku, malaman dokoki da Farisiyawa, ku munafukai! Kun rufe ƙofar mulkin sama a gaban mutane. Ku kanku ba ku shiga ba, ba kuwa bar waɗanda suke ƙoƙarin shiga su shiga ba.
english: “Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you devour widows’ houses, and as a pretense you make long prayers. Therefore you will receive greater condemnation.

hausa: In kuma hannunka na dama yana sa ka yin zunubi, yanke shi ka yar. Zai fiye maka ka rasa ɗaya daga cikin gaɓoɓin jikinka, da a jefa jikinka ɗungum a cikin jahannama ta wuta.
english: If your right hand causes you to stumble, cut it off, and throw it away from you. For it is more profitable for you that one of your members should perish, than for your whole body to be cast into Gehenna.

hausa: Amma ba wani a sama ko a ƙasa ko a ƙarƙashin ƙasan da ya iya buɗe naɗaɗɗen littafin ko ma yă duba cikinsa.
english: No one in heaven above, or on the earth, or under the earth, was able to open the book or to look in it.

hausa: Game da ni dai, ina a hannuwanku; ku yi duk abin da kuka ga ya yi kyau, ya kuma dace a gare ku.
english: But as for me, behold, I am in your hand. Do with me what is good and right in your eyes.

hausa: Da Yesu ya sauka daga jirgin ruwa, sai wani mutum mai mugun ruhu ya fito daga kaburbura, ya tarye shi.
english: When he had come out of the boat, immediately a man with an unclean spirit met him out of the tombs.

hausa: Don haka dukan mutane suka tafi Gilgal, suka tabbatar da Shawulu sarki a gaban Ubangiji. A can suka miƙa hadaya ta salama a gaban Ubangiji, Shawulu kuwa da dukan Isra’ila suka yi babban liyafa.
english: All the people went to Gilgal; and there they made Saul king before Yahweh in Gilgal. There they offered sacrifices of peace offerings before Yahweh; and there Saul and all the men of Israel rejoiced greatly.

hausa: Kusan abu ɗaya ya faru, sa’ad da Kaftorawa daga ƙasar Kaftor suka hallaka Awwiyawa, waɗanda dā suke zaune a yankin ƙauyukan da suke kewaye da Gaza. Suka zauna a wurinsu.)
english: Then the Avvim, who lived in villages as far as Gaza: the Caphtorim, who came out of Caphtor, destroyed them and lived in their place.)

hausa: Da Dawuda ya sami labarin mutuwar Nabal, sai ya ce, “Yabo ya tabbata ga Ubangiji, wanda ya sāka mini a kan irin renin da Nabal ya yi mini. Ya hana bawansa yin mugunta, ga shi ya ɗora wa Nabal muguntar da ya yi.” Sai Dawuda ya aika wa Abigiyel cewa tă zama matarsa.
english: When David heard that Nabal was dead, he said, “Blessed is Yahweh, who has pleaded the cause of my reproach from the hand of Nabal, and has kept back his servant from evil. Yahweh has returned the evildoing of Nabal on his own head.” David sent and spoke concerning Abigail, to take her to himself as wife.

hausa: Ta wurin bangaskiya ne Musa, sa’ad da ya yi girma, ya ƙi a kira shi ɗan diyar Fir’auna.
english: By faith Moses, when he had grown up, refused to be called the son of Pharaoh’s daughter,

hausa: Ya auna wani kamu dubu ya kuma bi da ni a ruwan da zurfinsa ya kai ni gwiwa. Ya sāke auna kamu dubu ya kuma bi da ni a ruwan da zurfinsa kama ni a gindi.
english: Again he measured one thousand, and caused me to pass through the waters, waters that were to the knees. Again he measured one thousand, and caused me to pass through waters that were to the waist.

hausa: “Ko kuma, wane sarki ne, in zai je yaƙi da wani sarki, ai, yakan fara zama ne, ya duba ya ga, ko da mutane dubu goma, shi zai iya ƙarawa da mai zuwa da dubu ashirin?
english: Or what king, as he goes to encounter another king in war, will not sit down first and consider whether he is able with ten thousand to meet him who comes against him with twenty thousand?

hausa: Ɗana, in ka yarda da kalmomina ka kuma ajiye umarnaina a cikinka,
english: My son, if you will receive my words, and store up my commandments within you,

hausa: Da safe sai hankalinsa ya tashi, saboda haka sai ya aika a kawo dukan masu duba da masu hikima na Masar. Fir’auna ya faɗa musu mafarkansa, amma babu wanda ya iya ba shi fassararsu.
english: In the morning, his spirit was troubled, and he sent and called for all of Egypt’s magicians and wise men. Pharaoh told them his dreams, but there was no one who could interpret them to Pharaoh.

hausa: Sai dai ya ce mini, ‘Za ki yi ciki, ki kuma haifi ɗa. To, fa, kada ki sha ruwan inabi ko abu mai sa maye kada kuma ki ci abin da yake marar tsarki, gama ɗan zai zama Banazare na Allah tun daga haihuwa har ranar mutuwarsa.’ ”
english: but he said to me, ‘Behold, you shall conceive and bear a son; and now drink no wine nor strong drink. Don’t eat any unclean thing, for the child shall be a Nazirite to God from the womb to the day of his death.’”

hausa: Ka yanka ragon, ka ɗibi jinin, ka shafa a bisa leɓen kunnen Haruna na dama, da bisa leɓen kunnuwan ’ya’yansa maza na dama, da kan manyan yatsotsin hannuwansu na dama, da kuma a kan manyan yatsotsin ƙafafunsu na dama. Sauran jinin kuwa, sai ka yayyafa shi kewaye da gefen bagaden.
english: Then you shall kill the ram, and take some of its blood, and put it on the tip of the right ear of Aaron, and on the tip of the right ear of his sons, and on the thumb of their right hand, and on the big toe of their right foot; and sprinkle the blood around on the altar.

hausa: Amma mutane suka ce wa Shawulu, “A ce Yonatan yă mutu bayan shi ya kawo babban nasara a Isra’ila? Faufau, muddin Ubangiji yana raye, ko gashin kansa ɗaya ba zai fāɗi a ƙasa ba, gama abin da ya yi yau, Allah ne yana tare da shi.” Ta haka mutane suka ceci Yonatan daga mutuwa.
english: The people said to Saul, “Shall Jonathan die, who has worked this great salvation in Israel? Far from it! As Yahweh lives, there shall not one hair of his head fall to the ground, for he has worked with God today!” So the people rescued Jonathan, so he didn’t die.

hausa: saboda haka, ya ku makiyaya, ku ji maganar Ubangiji,
english: therefore, you shepherds, hear Yahweh’s word!”

hausa: “Ku yi shiru a gabana, ku tsibirai! Bari al’ummai su sabunta ƙarfinsu! Bari su zo gaba su yi magana; bari mu sadu a wurin shari’a.
english: “Keep silent before me, islands, and let the peoples renew their strength. Let them come near, then let them speak. Let’s meet together for judgment.

hausa: Lokacin da Dawuda yake mulki, an yi yunwa shekara uku a jere; saboda haka Dawuda ya nemi nufin Ubangiji. Ubangiji ya ce, “Saboda Shawulu ne da alhakin jinin gidansa; domin ya kashe Gibeyonawa.”
english: There was a famine in the days of David for three years, year after year; and David sought the face of Yahweh. Yahweh said, “It is for Saul, and for his bloody house, because he put the Gibeonites to death.”

hausa: Cikin inuwar kasancewarka ka ɓoye su daga makircin mutane; a wurin zamanka ka kiyaye su lafiya daga harsuna masu zagi.
english: In the shelter of your presence you will hide them from the plotting of man. You will keep them secretly in a dwelling away from the strife of tongues.

hausa: “Daga ƙarami zuwa babba, dukansu masu haɗama ne don riba; har da annabawa da firistoci, dukansu suna aikata rashin gaskiya.
english: “For from their least even to their greatest, everyone is given to covetousness. From the prophet even to the priest, everyone deals falsely.

hausa: A cikin wannan hamadan, jikunanku za su fāɗi, kowanne a cikinku mai shekara ashirin ko fiye, wanda aka ƙirga shi cikin ƙidaya, wanda kuma ya yi gunaguni a kaina, da zai shiga wannan ƙasa.
english: Your dead bodies shall fall in this wilderness; and all who were counted of you, according to your whole number, from twenty years old and upward, who have complained against me,

hausa: Lokacin yunwa yana tsare ka daga mutuwa, a cikin yaƙi kuma yana kāre ka daga sarar takobi.
english: In famine he will redeem you from death; in war, from the power of the sword.

hausa: Sai suka yi tuƙaƙƙun sarƙoƙi na zinariya zalla a kan ƙyallen maƙalawa a ƙirji.
english: They made on the breastplate chains like cords, of braided work of pure gold.

hausa: Wuri guda kaɗai da ba a yi ruwan ƙanƙara ba, shi ne yankin Goshen, inda Isra’ilawa suke.
english: Only in the land of Goshen, where the children of Israel were, there was no hail.

hausa: Wuta ce take ƙuna har ta hallakar; za tă cinye saiwar abin da na shuka ƙurmus.
english: for it is a fire that consumes to destruction, and would root out all my increase.

hausa: Kuma bai kamata mu ci gaba da koyar da umarnai game da baftisma, ɗibiya hannuwa, tashin matattu, da kuma madawwamin hukunci ba.
english: of the teaching of baptisms, of laying on of hands, of resurrection of the dead, and of eternal judgment.

hausa: Na san ayyukanka, ba ka da sanyi ba ka kuma da zafi. Na so da kai ɗaya ne daga ciki, ko sanyi, ko zafi!
english: “I know your works, that you are neither cold nor hot. I wish you were cold or hot.

hausa: Sai Bitrus ya sauka ya ce wa mutanen, “Ni ne kuke nema. Me ya kawo ku?”
english: Peter went down to the men, and said, “Behold, I am he whom you seek. Why have you come?”

hausa: da Forata, da Adaliya, da Aridata,
english: Poratha, Adalia, Aridatha,

hausa: dukan sarakunan Taya da Sidon; sarakunan bakin teku a ƙetaren teku;
english: and all the kings of Tyre, all the kings of Sidon, and the kings of the isle which is beyond the sea;

hausa: Ta Dawuda. Ka nuna rashin laifina, ya Ubangiji, gama na yi rayuwa marar zargi; Na dogara ga Ubangiji ba tare da kaucewa ba.
english: By David. Judge me, Yahweh, for I have walked in my integrity. I have trusted also in Yahweh without wavering.

hausa: ta goma sha uku a kan Shubayel, ’ya’yansa maza da danginsa, 12
english: for the thirteenth, Shubael, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

hausa: Wannan ita ce maganar da Ubangiji ya riga ya yi game da Mowab.
english: This is the word that Yahweh spoke concerning Moab in time past.

hausa: Suka kuma jima a can tare da almajirai.
english: They stayed there with the disciples for a long time.

hausa: Yanzu fa ka tattara saura rundunoni ka fāɗa wa birnin ka ci shi. In ba haka ba zan karɓe birnin, a kuma kira shi da sunana.”
english: Now therefore gather the rest of the people together, and encamp against the city and take it; lest I take the city, and it be called by my name.”

hausa: Ga yawan mutanen shiryayyu don yaƙi waɗanda suka zo wurin Dawuda a Hebron don su mai da mulkin Shawulu gare shi, yadda Ubangiji ya faɗa.
english: These are the numbers of the heads of those who were armed for war, who came to David to Hebron to turn the kingdom of Saul to him, according to Yahweh’s word.

hausa: sa’ad da kwanakinka suka ƙare ka kuma tafi don ka kasance da kakanninka, zan tā da ɗaya cikin ’ya’yanka maza, daga zuriyarka yă gāje ka, zan kuma kafa mulkinka.
english: It will happen, when your days are fulfilled that you must go to be with your fathers, that I will set up your offspring after you, who will be of your sons; and I will establish his kingdom.

hausa: Na ji tsoron fushi da hasalar Ubangiji, gama ya yi fushin da ku da ya isa yă hallaka ku. Amma na yi roƙo a lokacin, Ubangiji kuwa ya saurare ni.
english: For I was afraid of the anger and hot displeasure with which Yahweh was angry against you to destroy you. But Yahweh listened to me that time also.

hausa: Da mala’ikun suka bar su, su suka koma sama, sai makiyayan suka ce wa juna, “Mu je Betlehem mu ga wannan abin da ya faru, wanda Ubangiji ya sanar mana.”
english: When the angels went away from them into the sky, the shepherds said to one another, “Let’s go to Bethlehem, now, and see this thing that has happened, which the Lord has made known to us.”

hausa: Marar azanci kan gāji wauta, amma mai la’akari kan sami rawanin sani.
english: The simple inherit folly, but the prudent are crowned with knowledge.

hausa: Amma duk mai rayuwa bisa ga gaskiya yakan zo cikin haske, domin a gani a sarari cewa ayyukan da ya yi an yi su ne ta wurin Allah.
english: But he who does the truth comes to the light, that his works may be revealed, that they have been done in God.”

hausa: Zabura ta Asaf. Maɗaukaki, Allah, Ubangiji, ya yi magana ya kuma kira duniya daga fitowar rana zuwa inda take fāɗuwa.
english: A Psalm by Asaph. The Mighty One, God, Yahweh, speaks, and calls the earth from sunrise to sunset.

hausa: Sai ya koma wajen almajiransa, ya same su suna barci. Ya ce wa Bitrus, “Siman, kana barci ne? Ka kāsa yin tsaro na sa’a ɗaya?
english: He came and found them sleeping, and said to Peter, “Simon, are you sleeping? Couldn’t you watch one hour?

hausa: suka kuma sha ruwan ruhaniyan nan guda; gama sun sha daga dutsen ruhaniya nan, wanda ya yi tafiya tare da su, wannan dutsen kuwa Kiristi ne.
english: and all drank the same spiritual drink. For they drank of a spiritual rock that followed them, and the rock was Christ.

hausa: Ƙaunataccena kyakkyawa ne ƙaƙƙarfa kuma, da ƙyar a sami irinsa ɗaya a cikin dubu goma.
english: My beloved is white and ruddy. The best among ten thousand.

hausa: Duba, Ubangiji zai wofinta duniya ya kuma yi kaca-kaca da ita; zai ɓata fuskarta ya watsar da mazaunanta,
english: Behold, Yahweh makes the earth empty, makes it waste, turns it upside down, and scatters its inhabitants.

hausa: Sa’ad da Ubangiji ya gama yin wa Musa magana a kan Dutsen Sinai, sai ya ba shi alluna biyu na Alkawari, allunan duwatsu rubutattu da yatsan Allah.
english: When he finished speaking with him on Mount Sinai, he gave Moses the two tablets of the covenant, stone tablets, written with God’s finger.

hausa: Sai Ubangiji ya aiko da annoba a kan Isra’ila, mutane duba saba’in na Isra’ila suka mutu.
english: So Yahweh sent a pestilence on Israel, and seventy thousand men of Israel fell.

hausa: Dukan sarakunan duniya sun nemi su sadu da Solomon don su ji hikimar da Allah ya sa a zuciyarsa.
english: All the kings of the earth sought the presence of Solomon to hear his wisdom, which God had put in his heart.

hausa: Gama na tabbata cewa ko mutuwa ko rai, ko mala’iku ko aljanu, ko abubuwa na yanzu ko abubuwa masu zuwa nan gaba, ko ikoki,
english: For I am persuaded that neither death, nor life, nor angels, nor principalities, nor things present, nor things to come, nor powers,

hausa: “ ‘Amma ba zan ɗauki dukan masarautar daga hannun Solomon ba; na naɗa shi sarki, dukan kwanaki ransa saboda Dawuda bawana, wanda na zaɓa, wanda kuma ya kiyaye umarnai da farillaina.
english: “‘However, I will not take the whole kingdom out of his hand, but I will make him prince all the days of his life for David my servant’s sake whom I chose, who kept my commandments and my statutes,

hausa: Ƙasar da take a bakin teku, inda Keretawa suke zaune, za tă zama wurin da makiyaya da ta garken tumaki.
english: The sea coast will be pastures, with cottages for shepherds and folds for flocks.

hausa: Halitta ta fari tana kama da zaki, ta biyun kuwa tana kama da bijimi, ta ukun kuma tana da fuska kamar ta mutum, ta huɗun kuma tana kama da gaggafa mai tashi sama.
english: The first creature was like a lion, the second creature like a calf, the third creature had a face like a man, and the fourth was like a flying eagle.

hausa: Ta haka ya rinjayi zukatan dukan mutane Yahuda, kamar mutum ɗaya. Suka aika da saƙo wurin sarki suka ce, “Ka dawo, kai da dukan mutanenka.”
english: He bowed the heart of all the men of Judah, even as one man, so that they sent to the king, saying, “Return, you and all your servants.”

hausa: Gama kai ne mafakata, hasumiya mai ƙarfi gāba da maƙiyi.
english: For you have been a refuge for me, a strong tower from the enemy.

hausa: A gidan mai hikima akwai wuraren ajiya na abinci da mai masu kyau, amma wawa kan cinye duk abin da yake da shi.
english: There is precious treasure and oil in the dwelling of the wise, but a foolish man swallows it up.

hausa: Yesu ya amsa masa ya ce, “Kai, wa ya naɗa ni alƙali, ko mai sulhu a tsakaninku?”
english: But he said to him, “Man, who made me a judge or an arbitrator over you?”

hausa: Eliyaba, mutumin Sha’albo, ’Ya’yan Yashen, Yonatan,
english: Eliahba the Shaalbonite, the sons of Jashen, Jonathan,

hausa: Amma ba su san tunanin Ubangiji ba; ba su fahimci shirinsa ba, shi da ya tattara su kamar dammuna a masussuka.
english: But they don’t know the thoughts of Yahweh, neither do they understand his counsel; for he has gathered them like the sheaves to the threshing floor.

hausa: Kada ku danne aikin Ruhu.
english: Don’t quench the Spirit.

hausa: “Ga abin da Ubangiji, Allah na Isra’ila, yana cewa ka faɗa wa sarkin Yahuda, wanda ya aika a neme ni cewa, ‘Sojojin Fir’aunan da suka fito su taimake ka, za su koma ƙasarsu, Masar.
english: “Yahweh, the God of Israel, says, ‘You shall tell the king of Judah, who sent you to me to inquire of me: “Behold, Pharaoh’s army, which has come out to help you, will return to Egypt into their own land.

hausa: Ina kishinku da kishi irin na Allah. Na yi muku alkawarin aure ga miji ɗaya, Kiristi, domin in miƙa ku a gare shi kamar budurwa zalla.
english: For I am jealous over you with a godly jealousy. For I promised you in marriage to one husband, that I might present you as a pure virgin to Christ.

hausa: “An kakkarya bakkuna masu yaƙi, amma su da ka raunana an ba su makaman ƙarfi.
english: “The bows of the mighty men are broken. Those who stumbled are armed with strength.

hausa: ga Ibrahim da zuriyarsa har abada, kamar yadda ya faɗa wa kakanninmu.”
english: as he spoke to our fathers, to Abraham and his offspring forever.”

hausa: “La’ananne ne mutumin da ya kwana da matar mahaifinsa, gama ya ƙasƙantar da gadon mahaifinsa ke nan.” Sai dukan mutane su ce, “Amin!”
english: ‘Cursed is he who lies with his father’s wife, because he dishonors his father’s bed.’ All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’

hausa: Bayan ya wanke fuskarsa, sai ya fito ya daure, ya umarta, “A kawo abinci.”
english: He washed his face, and came out. He controlled himself, and said, “Serve the meal.”

hausa: Yana isowa garinsa, sai ya fara koya wa mutane a cikin majami’arsu, suka kuwa yi mamaki. Suka yi ta tambaya suna cewa, “Ina wannan mutum ya sami irin wannan hikima da kuma ayyukan banmamaki haka?
english: Coming into his own country, he taught them in their synagogue, so that they were astonished and said, “Where did this man get this wisdom and these mighty works?

hausa: Wurin kiwo don birnin zai zama kamu 250 a wajen arewa, kamu 250 a wajen kudu, kamu 250 a wajen gabas da kuma kamu 250 a wajen yamma.
english: The city shall have pasture lands: toward the north two hundred fifty, and toward the south two hundred fifty, and toward the east two hundred fifty, and toward the west two hundred fifty.

hausa: “Duk wanda yakan zo wurina, amma bai ƙi mahaifinsa da mahaifiyarsa, da matarsa da ’ya’yansa, da ’yan’uwansa mata da maza, kai, har ma ransa ba, ba zai iya zama almajirina ba.
english: “If anyone comes to me, and doesn’t disregard his own father, mother, wife, children, brothers, and sisters, yes, and his own life also, he can’t be my disciple.

hausa: Saboda haka Ubangiji ba zai ji daɗin matasa ba, ba kuwa zai ji tausayin marayu da gwauraye ba, gama kowa marar sanin Allah ne da kuma mugu, kowane baki yana faɗin mugayen maganganu. Duk da haka, fushinsa bai huce ba, hannunsa har yanzu yana a miƙe.
english: Therefore the Lord will not rejoice over their young men, neither will he have compassion on their fatherless and widows; for everyone is profane and an evildoer, and every mouth speaks folly. For all this his anger is not turned away, but his hand is stretched out still.

hausa: Sai Allah ya ce wa Nuhu da ’ya’yansa,
english: God spoke to Noah and to his sons with him, saying,

hausa: Amma waɗannan kalmomin Allah suka zo wa Shemahiya, mutumin Allah, cewa,
english: But the word of God came to Shemaiah the man of God, saying,

hausa: A ƙarshen rayuwarku za ku yi ta nishi, sa’ad da namanku da jikinku suka zagwanye.
english: You will groan at your latter end, when your flesh and your body are consumed,

hausa: Dawuda ya ce, “Gaya mini, me ya faru?” Sai ya ce, “Mutane sun gudu daga yaƙi, aka kuma karkashe yawancin mutane. Shawulu da ɗansa Yonatan ma sun mutu.”
english: David said to him, “How did it go? Please tell me.” He answered, “The people have fled from the battle, and many of the people also have fallen and are dead. Saul and Jonathan his son are dead also.”

hausa: zai yi gādon garuruwan da suka lalace, da kuma gidajen da ba wanda yake zama a ciki, gidajen da sun zama tarkace.
english: He has lived in desolate cities, in houses which no one inhabited, which were ready to become heaps.

hausa: da nan da nan sai in rinjayi abokan gābansu in kuma juye hannuna a kan maƙiyansu!
english: I would soon subdue their enemies, and turn my hand against their adversaries.

hausa: Ku tafi! Ina aikan ku kamar tumaki cikin kyarketai.
english: Go your ways. Behold, I send you out as lambs among wolves.

hausa: Kafin zuwan Yesu, Yohanna ya yi wa’azin tuba da baftisma ga dukan mutanen Isra’ila.
english: before his coming, when John had first preached the baptism of repentance to Israel.

hausa: Sai Felis, wanda yake da cikakken sani game da Hanyar, ya ɗaga sauraron ƙarar. Ya ce, “In Lisiyas shugaban ƙungiyar soja ya iso, zan yanke muku shari’a.”
english: But Felix, having more exact knowledge concerning the Way, deferred them, saying, “When Lysias, the commanding officer, comes down, I will decide your case.”

hausa: Sai shugaban masu shayarwa ya faɗa wa Yusuf mafarkinsa. Ya ce masa, “A cikin mafarkina, na ga kuringa a gabana,
english: The chief cup bearer told his dream to Joseph, and said to him, “In my dream, behold, a vine was in front of me,

hausa: Ya amsa ya ce, “Me Musa ya umarce ku?”
english: He answered, “What did Moses command you?”

hausa: Yayinda suke fitowa, sai aka kawo wa Yesu wani mutum mai aljani, da ba ya iya magana.
english: As they went out, behold, a mute man who was demon possessed was brought to him.

hausa: “ ‘Waɗannan su ne za su zama ƙa’idodin da za ku kasance da su, a dukan tsararraki masu zuwa.
english: “‘These things shall be for a statute and ordinance to you throughout your generations in all your dwellings.

hausa: Sai suka ce, “Ranka yă daɗe, daga yanzu ka dinga ba mu wannan burodi.”
english: They said therefore to him, “Lord, always give us this bread.”

hausa: Ƙarfinku zai ƙare a banza domin ƙasarku ba za tă ba da hatsi ba, balle itatuwan ƙasar su ba da ’ya’ya.
english: Your strength will be spent in vain; for your land won’t yield its increase, neither will the trees of the land yield their fruit.

hausa: “Allah ya sawwaƙa mana mu tayar wa Ubangiji mu bar binsa, har mu gina bagade don miƙa hadayu na ƙonawa, da na gari, da na sadaka, ban da bagaden Ubangiji Allahnmu wanda yake tsaye a gaban tabanakul.”
english: “Far be it from us that we should rebel against Yahweh, and turn away today from following Yahweh, to build an altar for burnt offering, for meal offering, or for sacrifice, besides Yahweh our God’s altar that is before his tabernacle!”

hausa: Sai Shaiɗan ya bar Ubangiji, ya je ya sa wa Ayuba ƙuraje masu zafi a jikinsa daga tafin ƙafafunsa har zuwa kansa.
english: So Satan went out from the presence of Yahweh, and struck Job with painful sores from the sole of his foot to his head.

hausa: Sa’ad da macijin ya ga an jefar da shi a duniya, sai ya fafari macen nan da ta haifi ɗa namiji.
english: When the dragon saw that he was thrown down to the earth, he persecuted the woman who gave birth to the male child.

hausa: Ku ce ga abin da sarki ya ce, ‘Ku sa wannan mutum a kurkuku, kuma kada ku ba shi wani abu sai dai burodi da ruwa, sai na dawo lafiya.’ ”
english: Say, ‘The king says, “Put this fellow in the prison, and feed him with bread of affliction and with water of affliction, until I come in peace.”’”

hausa: Yabo ya tabbata ga Ubangiji Allah na kakanninmu, ya taɓa zuciyar sarki don yă kawo ɗaukaka ga haikalin Allah a Urushalima ta wannan hanya.
english: Blessed be Yahweh, the God of our fathers, who has put such a thing as this in the king’s heart, to beautify Yahweh’s house which is in Jerusalem;

hausa: Sa’an nan na ɗaga kai sai na ga mutum a tsaye riƙe da ma’auni a hannunsa!
english: I lifted up my eyes, and saw, and behold, a man with a measuring line in his hand.

hausa: Gama kamar yadda Yunana ya yi yini uku da kuma dare uku a cikin wani babban kifi, haka Ɗan Mutum zai yi yini uku da kuma dare uku a cikin ƙasa.
english: For as Jonah was three days and three nights in the belly of the huge fish, so will the Son of Man be three days and three nights in the heart of the earth.

hausa: Ƙaunarki abar farin ciki ne, ’yar’uwata, amaryata! Ƙaunarki ta fi ruwan inabi gamsuwa, ƙanshin turarenki kuma ya fi duk wani kayan yaji!
english: How beautiful is your love, my sister, my bride! How much better is your love than wine, the fragrance of your perfumes than all kinds of spices!

hausa: Duk masu yin gumaka ba kome ba ne, da kuma abubuwan da suke ɗauka da daraja banza ne. Waɗanda za su yi magana a madadinsu makafi ne; jahilai ne, marasa kunya.
english: Everyone who makes a carved image is vain. The things that they delight in will not profit. Their own witnesses don’t see, nor know, that they may be disappointed.

hausa: Shawulu ya yi sansani a bakin hanyar zuwa tudun Hakila mai fuskantar Yeshimon. Amma Dawuda yana zaune a jeji. Sa’ad da ya ga Shawulu ya biyo shi har zuwa can,
english: Saul encamped in the hill of Hachilah, which is before the desert, by the way. But David stayed in the wilderness, and he saw that Saul came after him into the wilderness.

hausa: Allah ya ga dukan abin da ya yi, yana da kyau ƙwarai. Yamma ta kasance, safiya kuma ta kasance, kwana ta shida ke nan.
english: God saw everything that he had made, and, behold, it was very good. There was evening and there was morning, a sixth day.

hausa: Bari mutum mai adalci yă buge ni, alheri ne; bar shi yă tsawata mini, mai ne a kaina. Kaina ba zai ƙi shi ba, duk da haka addu’ata kullum tana gāba da mugayen ayyuka.
english: Let the righteous strike me, it is kindness; let him reprove me, it is like oil on the head; don’t let my head refuse it; Yet my prayer is always against evil deeds.

hausa: Ka naɗa masa rawani a kai, ka kuma sa kambi mai tsarki a bisa rawanin.
english: You shall set the turban on his head, and put the holy crown on the turban.

hausa: Haka ma fiffiken kerub na biyu ɗin tsawonsa kamu biyar ne, ya taɓo bangon haikalin, ɗaya fiffiken shi ma tsawonsa kamu biyar ne, ya taɓo fiffiken kerub na farko.
english: The wing of the other cherub was five cubits, reaching to the wall of the house; and the other wing was five cubits, joining to the wing of the other cherub.

hausa: to, game da wanda Uba ya keɓe a matsayin nasa ne ya kuma aiko shi duniya. Don me kuke ce saɓo nake, domin na ce, ‘Ni Ɗan Allah ne?’
english: do you say of him whom the Father sanctified and sent into the world, ‘You blaspheme,’ because I said, ‘I am the Son of God’?

hausa: Kun dai ji labarin rayuwata ta dā a cikin Yahudanci, yadda na tsananta wa ikkilisiyar Allah ƙwarai, na kuma yi ƙoƙarin hallaka ta.
english: For you have heard of my way of living in time past in the Jews’ religion, how that beyond measure I persecuted the assembly of God and ravaged it.

hausa: In kana da hikima, hikimarka za tă ba ka lada; in kai mai ba’a ne, kai kaɗai za ka sha wahala.”
english: If you are wise, you are wise for yourself. If you mock, you alone will bear it.

hausa: Saboda haka kabari ya fadada marmarinsa ya kuma buɗe bakinsa babu iyaka; cikinsa manyan mutanensu da talakawansu za su gangara tare da dukan masu hayaniyarsu da masu murnansu.
english: Therefore Sheol has enlarged its desire, and opened its mouth without measure; and their glory, their multitude, their pomp, and he who rejoices among them, descend into it.

hausa: ko ɗaya daga cikinsu da suka ga ɗaukakata da mu’ujizai da na yi a Masar, da kuma a cikin hamada, da suka ƙi yin mini biyayya, suka kuma gwada ni har sau goma,
english: because all those men who have seen my glory and my signs, which I worked in Egypt and in the wilderness, yet have tempted me these ten times, and have not listened to my voice;

hausa: Mala’ikan ya ce wa waɗanda suke tsaye a gabansa, “Ku cire masa tufafinsa masu dauda.” Sai ya ce wa Yoshuwa, “Duba, na ɗauke zunubanka, zan sa maka tufafi masu tsada.”
english: He answered and spoke to those who stood before him, saying, “Take the filthy garments off him.” To him he said, “Behold, I have caused your iniquity to pass from you, and I will clothe you with rich clothing.”

hausa: Sa’an nan ya ɗauki burodi guda bakwai da kuma kifayen nan, da ya yi godiya, sai ya kakkarya su ya ba wa almajiran, su kuma suka ba wa mutane.
english: and he took the seven loaves and the fish. He gave thanks and broke them, and gave to the disciples, and the disciples to the multitudes.

hausa: ya kuma cika shi da Ruhun Allah, da fasaha, azanci da kuma sani cikin dukan sana’ar hannu,
english: He has filled him with the Spirit of God, in wisdom, in understanding, in knowledge, and in all kinds of workmanship;

hausa: Dukan ’yan’uwa a nan suna gaisuwa. Ku gai da juna da sumba mai tsarki.
english: All the brothers greet you. Greet one another with a holy kiss.

hausa: Allah yă ba ka daga raɓar sama da kuma yalwar ƙasa, yalwar hatsi da sabon ruwan inabi.
english: God give you of the dew of the sky, of the fatness of the earth, and plenty of grain and new wine.

hausa: Sarkin Isra’ila ya ce wa shugabanninsa, “Ba ku san cewa Ramot Gileyad namu ne ba, duk da haka ba mu yi kome ba don mu sāke karɓanta daga sarkin Aram?”
english: The king of Israel said to his servants, “You know that Ramoth Gilead is ours, and we do nothing, and don’t take it out of the hand of the king of Syria?”

hausa: “Kwana shida za ku yi aikinku, amma a rana ta bakwai, kada ku yi aiki, saboda saniyarku da jakinku su huta, haka kuma bawan da aka haifa a gidanku, da kuma baƙon da yake a cikinku yă wartsake.
english: “Six days you shall do your work, and on the seventh day you shall rest, that your ox and your donkey may have rest, and the son of your servant, and the alien may be refreshed.

hausa: Sai Yahuda (ba Yahuda Iskariyot ba) ya ce, “Ubangiji, me ya sa za ka bayyana kanka gare mu amma ba ga duniya ba?”
english: Judas (not Iscariot) said to him, “Lord, what has happened that you are about to reveal yourself to us, and not to the world?”

hausa: Za ku kuma bar wurin da hannuwanku a kanku, gama Ubangiji ya ƙi waɗanda kuka amince da su; ba za ku zama abin taimako a gare su ba.
english: You will also leave that place with your hands on your head; for Yahweh has rejected those in whom you trust, and you won’t prosper with them.

hausa: “ ‘Ko da yake suna busa ƙaho suna kuma shirya kome, ba wanda zai tafi yaƙi, gama hasalata tana a kan dukan jama’a.
english: They have blown the trumpet, and have made all ready; but no one goes to the battle, for my wrath is on all its multitude.

hausa: Ishmerai, Izliya da Yobab su ne ’ya’yan Efa’al maza.
english: Ishmerai, Izliah, Jobab, the sons of Elpaal,

hausa: Sunan mutumin Isra’ilan da aka kashe tare da macen nan Bamidiyana kuwa Zimri ne, ɗan Salu, shugaban mutanen Simeyon.
english: Now the name of the man of Israel that was slain, who was slain with the Midianite woman, was Zimri, the son of Salu, a prince of a fathers’ house among the Simeonites.

hausa: Dawuda da dukan Isra’ilawa tare da shi suka tafi Ba’ala na Yahuda (Kiriyat Yeyarim) don su haura daga can su kawo akwatin alkawarin Allah Ubangiji, wanda yake zama tsakanin kerubobi, akwatin alkawarin da ake kira da Sunan.
english: David went up with all Israel to Baalah, that is, to Kiriath Jearim, which belonged to Judah, to bring up from there God Yahweh’s ark that sits above the cherubim, that is called by the Name.

hausa: Hafsan ya riga ya ce wa mutumin Allah, “Kai, ko da Ubangiji zai buɗe tagogin sama, wannan abu ba zai yiwu ba!” Mutumin Allah kuwa ya faɗa masa, “Za ka gani da idanunka sai dai ba za ka ci ba!”
english: and that captain answered the man of God, and said, “Now, behold, if Yahweh made windows in heaven, might such a thing be?” and he said, “Behold, you will see it with your eyes, but will not eat of it.”

hausa: Yabo ya tabbata ga Ubangiji, gama ya ji kukata na neman jinƙai.
english: Blessed be Yahweh, because he has heard the voice of my petitions.

hausa: Suka ce, “Za mu iya.” Yesu ya ce musu, “Za ku sha kwaf da zan sha, a kuma yi muku baftisma da aka yi mini,
english: They said to him, “We are able.” Jesus said to them, “You shall indeed drink the cup that I drink, and you shall be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with;

hausa: Ko da yake bai ga hasken rana ba, bai kuma san kome ba, duk da haka ya dai huta, fiye da mutumin da bai more wa ransa ba,
english: Moreover it has not seen the sun nor known it. This has rest rather than the other.

hausa: Amma lokaci yana zuwa, da za a ɗauke ango daga gare su. A waɗancan kwanakin ne za su yi azumi.”
english: But the days will come when the bridegroom will be taken away from them. Then they will fast in those days.”

hausa: Firistoci daga kewayen yankin ne suka yi gyare-gyaren biye da shi.
english: After him, the priests, the men of the surrounding area made repairs.

hausa: Ga abin da Ubangiji yana cewa, “Sa’ad da shekaru saba’in suka cika a Babilon, zan zo muku in cika alkawarin alherina don in komo da ku zuwa wannan wuri.
english: For Yahweh says, “After seventy years are accomplished for Babylon, I will visit you and perform my good word toward you, in causing you to return to this place.

hausa: Bari su san cewa kai, wanda sunansa ne Ubangiji, cewa kai kaɗai ne Mafi Ɗaukaka a bisa dukan duniya.
english: that they may know that you alone, whose name is Yahweh, are the Most High over all the earth.

hausa: Zan wartsake waɗanda suka gaji in kuma ƙosar da waɗanda ransu ya yi yaushi.”
english: For I have satiated the weary soul, and I have replenished every sorrowful soul.”

hausa: firist ya bincika su, in kuma wuraren toka-toka ne, to, ƙurji marar lahani ne ya faso a fatar jikin; wannan mutum tsarkakakke.
english: then the priest shall examine them. Behold, if the bright spots on the skin of their body are a dull white, it is a harmless rash. It has broken out in the skin. He is clean.

hausa: A lokacin nan Sarki Ahaz ya aika wurin sarkin Assuriya neman taimako.
english: At that time King Ahaz sent to the kings of Assyria to help him.

hausa: Sarki ya ce, “Anya, babu hannun Yowab a cikin dukan wannan?” Matar ta ce, “Muddin kana a raye, ranka yă daɗe sarki, ba wanda zai juya dama ko hagu daga wani abin da ranka yă daɗe sarki ya faɗa. I, bawanka Yowab ne ya umarce ni in yi wannan, shi ne kuma ya sa kalmomin nan a bakin baiwarka.
english: The king said, “Is the hand of Joab with you in all this?” The woman answered, “As your soul lives, my lord the king, no one can turn to the right hand or to the left from anything that my lord the king has spoken; for your servant Joab urged me, and he put all these words in the mouth of your servant.

hausa: Bukukkuwanku na Sabon Wata da na tsarkakan ranaku na ƙi su. Sun zama mini kaya; na gaji da ɗaukansu.
english: My soul hates your New Moons and your appointed feasts. They are a burden to me. I am weary of bearing them.

hausa: Yana yi mini abin da ya shirya yă yi mini, kuma yana da sauran irinsu a ajiye.
english: For he performs that which is appointed for me. Many such things are with him.

hausa: Kowace rana ina tare da ku, ina koyarwa a filin haikali, ba ku kama ni ba. Amma dole a cika Nassi.”
english: I was daily with you in the temple teaching, and you didn’t arrest me. But this is so that the Scriptures might be fulfilled.”

hausa: Wannan ma mugun abu ne, Yadda mutum ya zo, haka zai koma, to, wace riba ce ya ci, da yake ya yi wahalar iska ce kawai?
english: This also is a grievous evil, that in all points as he came, so shall he go. And what profit does he have who labors for the wind?

hausa: Sa’an nan ya ajiye a gabansu, suka kuwa ci har suka bar saura, bisa ga maganar Ubangiji.
english: So he set it before them and they ate and had some left over, according to Yahweh’s word.

hausa: In ba tare da bangaskiya ba kuwa, ba ya yiwuwa a gamshi Allah, domin duk mai zuwa wurin Allah dole yă gaskata cewa yana nan, kuma shi ne yakan sāka wa waɗanda suke nemansa da gaske.
english: Without faith it is impossible to be well pleasing to him, for he who comes to God must believe that he exists, and that he is a rewarder of those who seek him.

hausa: Doka ɗaya da ƙa’ida ɗaya za a yi aiki da ita a kan ku da kuma baƙin da suke zama a cikinku.’ ”
english: One law and one ordinance shall be for you and for the stranger who lives as a foreigner with you.’”

hausa: Dole ku bambanta tsakanin mai tsarki da marar tsarki, tsakanin marar tsabta da mai tsabta,
english: You are to make a distinction between the holy and the common, and between the unclean and the clean.

hausa: Zan sa mahukuntanta da masu hikimarta, gwamnoninta, shugabanninta da sojojinta su sha su bugu; za su dinga yin barcin da ba za su farka ba,” in ji Sarkin, mai suna Ubangiji Maɗaukaki.
english: I will make her princes, her wise men, her governors, her deputies, and her mighty men drunk. They will sleep a perpetual sleep, and not wake up,” says the King, whose name is Yahweh of Armies.

hausa: Farisiyawa da Sadukiyawa suka zo don su gwada Yesu ta wurin neman yă nuna musu wata alama daga sama.
english: The Pharisees and Sadducees came, and testing him, asked him to show them a sign from heaven.

hausa: Ta haka filin Efron a Makfela kusa da Mamre, wato, filin da kogon a cikinsa, da kuma dukan itatuwan da suke cikin iyakoki filin, aka
english: So the field of Ephron, which was in Machpelah, which was before Mamre, the field, the cave which was in it, and all the trees that were in the field, that were in all of its borders, were deeded

hausa: “Bayan na ba da takardun ciniki ga Baruk ɗan Neriya, sai na yi addu’a ga Ubangiji na ce,
english: Now after I had delivered the deed of the purchase to Baruch the son of Neriah, I prayed to Yahweh, saying,

hausa: Sa’ad da Siman ya ga cewa ana ba da Ruhu ta wurin ɗibiya hannuwan manzannin, sai ya miƙa musu kuɗi,
english: Now when Simon saw that the Holy Spirit was given through the laying on of the apostles’ hands, he offered them money,

hausa: In ba ka jin daɗinta, ka bar tă tafi inda take so. Ba za ka sayar da ita ko ka yi da ita kamar baiwa ba, da yake ka ƙasƙantar da ita.
english: It shall be, if you have no delight in her, then you shall let her go where she desires; but you shall not sell her at all for money. You shall not deal with her as a slave, because you have humbled her.

hausa: Amma da, muna sa zuciya cewa, shi ne wanda zai fanshi Isra’ila. Bugu da ƙari kuma yau kwana uku ke nan tun da wannan abin ya faru.
english: But we were hoping that it was he who would redeem Israel. Yes, and besides all this, it is now the third day since these things happened.

hausa: A gabansu ga dattawa saba’in na gidan Isra’ila tsaye a cikinsu, Ya’azaniya ɗan Shafan kuwa yana tsaye a cikinsu. Kowa yana da farantin ƙona turare a hannunsa, tulin hayaƙin turare mai ƙanshi ya tunnuƙe zuwa sama.
english: Seventy men of the elders of the house of Israel stood before them. In the middle of them Jaazaniah the son of Shaphan stood, every man with his censer in his hand; and the smell of the cloud of incense went up.

hausa: Maganganun rashin tunani sukan soki mutum kamar takobi, amma harshen mai hikima kan kawo warkarwa.
english: There is one who speaks rashly like the piercing of a sword, but the tongue of the wise heals.

hausa: Dubi mayaƙanki, duk mata ne! Ƙofofin ƙasarki a buɗe suke ga abokan gābanki, wuta ta cinye madogaransu.
english: Behold, your troops among you are women. The gates of your land are set wide open to your enemies. The fire has devoured your bars.

hausa: sarkin Horma, ɗaya sarkin Arad, ɗaya
english: the king of Hormah, one; the king of Arad, one;

hausa: Bayan sun bar Sukkot sai suka kafa sansani a Etam a bakin hamada.
english: They took their journey from Succoth, and encamped in Etham, in the edge of the wilderness.

hausa: Sai Yehu ya ce wa mai ajiyar tufafi, “Ka kawo riguna domin dukan masu yi wa Ba’al hidima.” Sai ya fito musu da riguna.
english: He said to him who kept the wardrobe, “Bring out robes for all the worshipers of Baal!” So he brought robes out to them.

hausa: A daidai sa’a ta tara na rana, sai Yesu ya ɗaga murya da ƙarfi ya ce, “Eloi, Eloi, lama sabaktani?” (Wato, “Ya Allahna, ya Allahna, don me ka yashe ni?”).
english: At the ninth hour Jesus cried with a loud voice, saying, “Eloi, Eloi, lama sabachthani?” which is, being interpreted, “My God, my God, why have you forsaken me?”

hausa: Amma bai kwana da ita ba, sai bayan da ta haifi ɗan. Ya kuwa sa masa suna Yesu.
english: and didn’t know her sexually until she had given birth to her firstborn son. He named him Jesus.

hausa: “Ku ƙidaya maza daga mai shekara ashirin zuwa gaba yadda Ubangiji ya umarci Musa.” Waɗannan su ne Isra’ilawan da suka fito daga Masar.
english: “Take a census, from twenty years old and upward, as Yahweh commanded Moses and the children of Israel.” These are those who came out of the land of Egypt.

hausa: Sa’an nan guragu za su yi tsalle kamar barewa, bebaye kuma su yi sowa don farin ciki. Ruwa zai kwararo daga jeji rafuffuka kuma a cikin hamada.
english: Then the lame man will leap like a deer, and the tongue of the mute will sing; for waters will break out in the wilderness, and streams in the desert.

hausa: Ina zan tafi daga Ruhunka? Ina zan gudu in tafi daga gabanka?
english: Where could I go from your Spirit? Or where could I flee from your presence?

hausa: Sama’ila kuwa ya bayyana wa mutane ƙa’idodin sarauta. Ya rubuta su cikin littafi ya ajiye a gaban Ubangiji. Sa’an nan ya sallame mutane, kowa ya koma gidansa.
english: Then Samuel told the people the regulations of the kingdom, and wrote it in a book and laid it up before Yahweh. Samuel sent all the people away, every man to his house.

hausa: Yayinda mutumin ya yi wajen gabas da karan awo a hannunsa, sai ya auna kamu dubu ya kuma bi da ni ta ruwan da zurfinsa ya kama ni a idon ƙafa.
english: When the man went out eastward with the line in his hand, he measured one thousand cubits, and he caused me to pass through the waters, waters that were to the ankles.

hausa: Ba za ku yi wa Ubangiji Allahnku sujada a hanyar da suke yi ba.
english: You shall not do so to Yahweh your God.

hausa: Kuka ji tausayin waɗanda suke cikin kurkuku, da farin ciki kuma kuka yarda ku rabu da dukiyar da aka ƙwace muku, domin ku kanku kun san cewa kuna da madawwamiyar dukiya mafi kyau.
english: For you both had compassion on me in my chains and joyfully accepted the plundering of your possessions, knowing that you have for yourselves a better possession and an enduring one in the heavens.

hausa: “ ‘Kada ka ƙasƙantar da ɗan’uwan mahaifinka ta wurin kusaci matarsa don ka yi jima’i da ita, ita bābarka ce.
english: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father’s brother. You shall not approach his wife. She is your aunt.

hausa: Waɗannan su ne zuriya Gileyad, daga Iyezer, kabilar Iyezerawa; daga Helek, kabilar Helekawa;
english: These are the sons of Gilead: of Iezer, the family of the Iezerites; of Helek, the family of the Helekites;

hausa: Haman ya fita a ranan da murna, ya kuma ji daɗi. Amma sa’ad da ya ga Mordekai a bakin ƙofar sarki, ya kuma lura cewa bai tashi, ko yă nuna bangirma a gabansa ba, sai ya cika da fushi.
english: Then Haman went out that day joyful and glad of heart, but when Haman saw Mordecai in the king’s gate, that he didn’t stand up nor move for him, he was filled with wrath against Mordecai.

hausa: In kai da maƙwabcinka kuka yi gardama, kada ka tona asirin wani,
english: Debate your case with your neighbor, and don’t betray the confidence of another,

hausa: Duk za su amsa, za su ce maka, “Ashe kai ma raunana ne, kamar mu; ka zama kamar mu.”
english: They all will answer and ask you, “Have you also become as weak as we are? Have you become like us?”

hausa: Bari Ubangiji ya ba ka basira da fahimi sa’ad da ya sa ka shugaba a bisa Isra’ila, saboda ka kiyaye dokar Ubangiji Allahnka.
english: May Yahweh give you discretion and understanding, and put you in charge of Israel, so that you may keep the law of Yahweh your God.

hausa: Ahimelek ya ce wa sarki, “A cikin bayinka duka, wa ke da aminci iri na Dawuda, surukin sarki, shugaban jarumanka wanda ake girmamawa da gaske a gidanka?
english: Then Ahimelech answered the king, and said, “Who among all your servants is so faithful as David, who is the king’s son-in-law, captain of your body guard, and honored in your house?

hausa: To, me zan yi? Akwai lokutan da zan yi addu’a da ruhuna; akwai kuma lokutan da zan yi addu’a da hankalina. Wani lokaci ya kamata in yi waƙa da ruhuna, a wani lokacin kuma in yi waƙa da hankalina.
english: What should I do? I will pray with the spirit, and I will pray with the understanding also. I will sing with the spirit, and I will sing with the understanding also.

hausa: Sa’an nan Delila ta ce wa Samson, “Ka mai da ni wawiya; ka ruɗe ni. Yanzu, ka gaya mini yadda za a daure ka.”
english: Delilah said to Samson, “Behold, you have mocked me, and told me lies. Now please tell me how you might be bound.”

hausa: “Ka faɗa wa Isra’ilawa su kawo mini hadaya. Za ka karɓi hadaya daga hannun kowane mutum wanda zuciyarsa ta yarda yă bayar.
english: “Speak to the children of Israel, that they take an offering for me. From everyone whose heart makes him willing you shall take my offering.

hausa: Ubangiji ya ce wa Musa,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

hausa: “Waɗanda suka maƙale wa gumaka marasa amfani, sukan ƙyale alherin da zai kasance nasu.
english: Those who regard vain idols forsake their own mercy.

hausa: Labule na gefen yamma kamu hamsin, da sanduna guda goma, da rammuka guda goma, da ƙugiyoyin azurfa da maɗaurai a kan sandunan.
english: For the west side were hangings of fifty cubits, their pillars ten, and their sockets ten; the hooks of the pillars, and their fillets, of silver.

hausa: Ubangiji yana ƙaunar ƙofofin Sihiyona fiye da dukan wuraren zaman Yaƙub.
english: Yahweh loves the gates of Zion more than all the dwellings of Jacob.

hausa: Adahiya, Berahiya da Shimra su ne ’ya’yan Shimeyi maza.
english: Adaiah, Beraiah, Shimrath, the sons of Shimei,

hausa: Sa’ad da Isra’ilawa suka ga wannan, sai suka ce wa junansu, “Mene ne wannan?” Gama ba su san ko mene ne ba. Musa ya ce musu, “Wannan shi ne burodin da Ubangiji ya ba ku ku ci.
english: When the children of Israel saw it, they said to one another, “What is it?” For they didn’t know what it was. Moses said to them, “It is the bread which Yahweh has given you to eat.

hausa: Saboda haka, daga yanzu zuwa nan gaba, ba mu ƙara ɗaukan wani mutum bisa ga ganin duniya ba. Ko da yake a dā, mun ɗauki Kiristi haka, amma yanzu mun daina yin haka.
english: Therefore we know no one according to the flesh from now on. Even though we have known Christ according to the flesh, yet now we know him so no more.

hausa: Yesu ya amsa ya ce, “Gaskiya nake gaya muku, babu wanda zai bar gida, ko ’yan’uwa maza da mata, ko mahaifiya, ko mahaifi, ko ’ya’ya, ko gonaki saboda ni, da kuma bishara,
english: Jesus said, “Most certainly I tell you, there is no one who has left house, or brothers, or sisters, or father, or mother, or wife, or children, or land, for my sake, and for the sake of the Good News,

hausa: Kai kuma za ka kamu da ciwon hanji wanda zai yi ta cinka kowace rana sai har hanjinka sun fito.’ ”
english: and you will have great sickness with a disease of your bowels, until your bowels fall out by reason of the sickness, day by day.’”

hausa: Wannan rana matan hakiman Farisa da na Mediya waɗanda suka ji game da halin sarauniya, za su yi haka wa dukan hakiman sarki. Zai zama babu ƙarshen rashin bangirma da kuma reni.
english: Today, the princesses of Persia and Media who have heard of the queen’s deed will tell all the king’s princes. This will cause much contempt and wrath.

hausa: Na ba wa Isra’ila marar bangaskiya takardar saki na kuwa kore ta saboda duk zinanta. Duk da haka na ga cewa ’yar’uwarta marar amincin nan Yahuda ba ta da tsoro; ita ma ta fita ta yi zina.
english: I saw when, for this very cause, that backsliding Israel had committed adultery, I had put her away and given her a certificate of divorce, yet treacherous Judah, her sister, had no fear, but she also went and played the prostitute.

hausa: Faɗa wa ’yan tawayen gidan Isra’ila, ‘Ga abin da Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka yana cewa ayyukan banƙyamarku sun isa haka, ya gidan Isra’ila!
english: You shall tell the rebellious, even the house of Israel, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “You house of Israel, let that be enough of all your abominations,

hausa: Maƙiyanki duka suna ta surutu game da ke; suna tsaki suna cizon haƙora suna cewa, “Mun hallaka ta. Wannan ce ranar da muke jira; yau mun gan ta.”
english: All your enemies have opened their mouth wide against you. They hiss and gnash their teeth. They say, “We have swallowed her up. Certainly this is the day that we looked for. We have found it. We have seen it.”

hausa: Ka ba ni garkuwar nasararka; ka sauko don ka sa in sami girma.
english: You have also given me the shield of your salvation. Your gentleness has made me great.

hausa: Daga biranensu suka tattaru a Gibeya don su yaƙi Isra’ilawa.
english: The children of Benjamin gathered themselves together out of the cities to Gibeah, to go out to battle against the children of Israel.

hausa: Ko da yake mayaƙan Arameyawa sun zo da mutane kaɗan kawai, Ubangiji ya sa suka ci nasara a kan sojojin Yahuda mafi yawa, don mutanen Yahuda sun rabu da Ubangiji Allah na kakanninsu, aka kuma hukunta Yowash.
english: For the army of the Syrians came with a small company of men; and Yahweh delivered a very great army into their hand, because they had forsaken Yahweh, the God of their fathers. So they executed judgment on Joash.

hausa: za su wanke hannuwansu da ƙafafunsu, don kada su mutu. Wannan za tă zama dawwammamiyar farilla domin Haruna da zuriyarsa daga tsara zuwa tsara.”
english: So they shall wash their hands and their feet, that they not die. This shall be a statute forever to them, even to him and to his descendants throughout their generations.”

hausa: Suka sa ’ya’yansu ƙanana a gaba, dabbobinsu da mallakansu a gabansu, suka juya suka tafi.
english: So they turned and departed, and put the little ones, the livestock, and the goods before them.

hausa: Sai Musa ya ce musu, “In za ku yi haka, in za ku sha ɗamara da makamai a gaban Ubangiji, ku tafi yaƙi,
english: Moses said to them: “If you will do this thing, if you will arm yourselves to go before Yahweh to the war,

hausa: Ya kuma tafi tare da su. Suka tafi Urdun suka fara saran itatuwa.
english: So he went with them. When they came to the Jordan, they cut down wood.

hausa: Na yi lambuna da wuraren shaƙatawa, na shuka itatuwa masu ’ya’ya iri-iri a cikinsu.
english: I made myself gardens and parks, and I planted trees in them of all kinds of fruit.

hausa: Da suka same shi, sai suka ce, “Kowa yana nemanka!”
english: They found him and told him, “Everyone is looking for you.”

hausa: Sai waɗansu malaman dokoki suka amsa suka ce, “Ka faɗi daidai, malam!”
english: Some of the scribes answered, “Teacher, you speak well.”

hausa: Babu wani kamar ka, ya Ubangiji; kai mai girma ne, kuma sunanka yana da girma da kuma iko.
english: There is no one like you, Yahweh. You are great, and your name is great in might.

hausa: Ba kamar baƙi ne yake ɗaukarmu ba? Ba sayar da mu kaɗai ya yi ba, har ma ya yi amfani da abin da aka biya saboda mu.
english: Aren’t we considered as foreigners by him? For he has sold us, and has also used up our money.

hausa: “Mahaifinka ya sa mana kaya mai nauyin gaske, amma yanzu ka sassauta wannan aiki mai zafi, da kuma kaya masu nauyin da ya sa a kanmu, mu kuwa za mu bauta maka.”
english: “Your father made our yoke difficult. Now therefore make the hard service of your father, and his heavy yoke which he put on us, lighter, and we will serve you.”

hausa: Tabbatacce za ku kira al’umman da ba ku sani ba, kuma al’umman da ba ku sani ba za su sheƙo a guje zuwa wurinku, saboda Ubangiji Allahnku, Mai Tsarkin nan na Isra’ila, gama ya darjanta ku.”
english: Behold, you shall call a nation that you don’t know; and a nation that didn’t know you shall run to you, because of Yahweh your God, and for the Holy One of Israel; for he has glorified you.”

hausa: Wane ne yake ba hankaka abinci lokacin da ’ya’yansa suke kuka ga Allah, kuma suna yawo don rashin abinci?
english: Who provides for the raven his prey, when his young ones cry to God, and wander for lack of food?

hausa: Ka yi ƙarfin hali ka kuma kasance da rashin tsoro, ka yi lura fa, ka yi biyayya da dokokin da bawana Musa ya ba ka; kada ka kauce ga bin dokokin ko hagu ko dama, domin ka yi nasara a duk, inda za ka je.
english: Only be strong and very courageous. Be careful to observe to do according to all the law which Moses my servant commanded you. Don’t turn from it to the right hand or to the left, that you may have good success wherever you go.

hausa: Ku bugi ƙirjinku don gonaki masu kyau don ’ya’yan inabi
english: Beat your breasts for the pleasant fields, for the fruitful vine.

hausa: Ku gai da ɗan’uwana, Hirodiyon. Ku gai da iyalin gidan Narkissus da suke cikin Ubangiji.
english: Greet Herodion, my kinsman. Greet them of the household of Narcissus, who are in the Lord.

hausa: Ku yi amfani da garwan da yake daidai, efa da yake daidai da kuma garwa da yake daidai.
english: “You shall have just balances, a just ephah, and a just bath.

hausa: in haka ne, to, Ubangiji ya san yadda zai ceci mutane masu tsoron Allah daga gwaje-gwaje, yă kuma tsare marasa adalci don ranar hukunci, har yă zuwa ranar shari’a.
english: then the Lord knows how to deliver the godly out of temptation and to keep the unrighteous under punishment for the day of judgment,

hausa: Daga haihuwa an jefa ni a kanka; daga cikin mahaifiyata kai ne Allahna.
english: I was thrown on you from my mother’s womb. You are my God since my mother bore me.

hausa: A gaban kowane ɗakin akwai bango mai tsayi kamu ɗaya, ɗakunan kuma kamu shida-shida ne a kowane gefe.
english: and a border before the lodges, one cubit on this side, and a border, one cubit on that side; and the side rooms, six cubits on this side, and six cubits on that side.

hausa: To, fa ’yan’uwa, ga zancen waɗannan abubuwa, na misalta su ne ga kaina, da kuma Afollos saboda ku, don ku yi koyi da mu a kan abin da ake nufi da cewa, “Kada ku zarce abin da yake a rubuce.” Ta haka, ba za ku yi taƙama da wani mutum fiye da wani ba.
english: Now these things, brothers, I have in a figure transferred to myself and Apollos for your sakes, that in us you might learn not to think beyond the things which are written, that none of you be puffed up against one another.

hausa: Ya ce, “A cikin damuwata na yi kira ga Ubangiji, ya kuwa amsa mini. Daga cikin zurfi kabari na yi kiran neman taimako, ka kuwa saurari kukata.
english: He said, “I called because of my affliction to Yahweh. He answered me. Out of the belly of Sheol I cried. You heard my voice.

hausa: Da rana Ubangiji yakan nuna ƙaunarsa, da dare waƙarsa tana tare da ni, addu’a ga Allah na raina.
english: Yahweh will command his loving kindness in the daytime. In the night his song shall be with me: a prayer to the God of my life.

hausa: ga sani kuma ku ƙara masa kamunkai; ga kamunkai kuma ku ƙara da daurewa; ga daurewa kuwa ku ƙara da tsoron Allah;
english: and in knowledge, self-control; and in self-control, perseverance; and in perseverance, godliness;

hausa: “Matalauta da mabukata suna neman ruwa, amma babu kome; harsunansu sun bushe saboda ƙishi. Amma Ni Ubangiji zan amsa musu; Ni, Allah na Isra’ila, ba zan yashe su ba.
english: The poor and needy seek water, and there is none. Their tongue fails for thirst. I, Yahweh, will answer them. I, the God of Israel, will not forsake them.

hausa: “Ana nan, sai mai baran ya mutu, kuma mala’iku suka ɗauke shi zuwa gefen Ibrahim. Mai arzikin ma ya mutu, aka kuma binne shi.
english: The beggar died, and he was carried away by the angels to Abraham’s bosom. The rich man also died and was buried.

hausa: Bai kamata bawan Ubangiji yă zama mai neman faɗa ba; a maimako, dole yă nuna alheri ga kowa, mai iya koyarwa, mai haƙuri kuma.
english: The Lord’s servant must not quarrel, but be gentle toward all, able to teach, patient,

hausa: Sai Ubangiji ya ce wa Shaiɗan, “Ko ka ga bawana Ayuba? A cikin duniya babu wani kamar sa; shi marar laifi ne, adali kuma, mutum ne mai tsoron Allah, ba ruwansa da mugunta.”
english: Yahweh said to Satan, “Have you considered my servant, Job? For there is no one like him on the earth, a blameless and an upright man, one who fears God, and turns away from evil.”

hausa: Ya Ubangiji, mun gane da muguntarmu da kuma laifin kakanninmu; tabbatacce mun yi maka zunubi.
english: We acknowledge, Yahweh, our wickedness, and the iniquity of our fathers; for we have sinned against you.

hausa: In nufinsa ne ya kuma janye ruhunsa da numfashinsa,
