english: If he set his heart on himself, if he gathered to himself his spirit and his breath,

hausa: “ ‘Kada ka yi ƙiyayyar ɗan’uwanka a zuciya. Ka tsawata wa maƙwabcinka da gaske don kada ka sami rabo cikin laifinsa.
english: “‘You shall not hate your brother in your heart. You shall surely rebuke your neighbor, and not bear sin because of him.

hausa: Sai Yahudawa suka ce masa, “Kai, shekarunka har yanzu ba su kai hamsin tukuna ba fa, har ka ga Ibrahim!”
english: The Jews therefore said to him, “You are not yet fifty years old! Have you seen Abraham?”

hausa: Eliyakim ɗan Hilkiya sarkin fada, Shebna magatakarda, da Yowa ɗan Asaf marubuci suka fita zuwa wurinsa.
english: Then Eliakim the son of Hilkiah, who was over the household, and Shebna the scribe, and Joah, the son of Asaph the recorder came out to him.

hausa: Don me kuke fafarata kamar yadda Allah yake yi? Ba ku gaji da yagar fatata ba?
english: Why do you persecute me as God, and are not satisfied with my flesh?

hausa: Masu albarka ne mutanen da wannan zai zama haka; masu albarka ne mutanen da Allah ne Ubangiji.
english: Happy are the people who are in such a situation. Happy are the people whose God is Yahweh.

hausa: Dukan shawarwarin da kika samu sun dai gajiyar da ke ne kawai! Bari masananki na taurari su zo gaba, waɗannan masu zāna taswirar sammai suna kuma faɗa miki dukan abin da zai faru da ke wata-wata, bari su cece ki daga abin da zai faru da ke.
english: You are wearied in the multitude of your counsels. Now let the astrologers, the stargazers, and the monthly prognosticators stand up and save you from the things that will happen to you.

hausa: Da ta ga Bitrus yana jin ɗumi, sai ta dube shi da kyau. Ta ce, “Kai ma kana tare da Yesu, Banazare.”
english: and seeing Peter warming himself, she looked at him and said, “You were also with the Nazarene, Jesus!”

hausa: Saboda haka Musa ya ce wa Haruna, “Ka ɗauki tulu, ka sa mudu guda na Manna a ciki. Sa’an nan ka sa shi a gaban Ubangiji, don a adana don tsararraki masu zuwa.”
english: Moses said to Aaron, “Take a pot, and put an omer-full of manna in it, and lay it up before Yahweh, to be kept throughout your generations.”

hausa: Yayinda sarki yake a teburinsa, turarena ya bazu da ƙanshi.
english: While the king sat at his table, my perfume spread its fragrance.

hausa: macen da ba a ƙauna wadda ta sami miji, da kuma baiwar da ta ɗauki matsayin uwargijiyarta.
english: for an unloved woman when she is married, and a servant who is heir to her mistress.

hausa: Don mai bi da kaɗe-kaɗe. Don busa. Ta Dawuda. A wurin Ubangiji ne nake samun mafaka. Yaya za ku ce mini, “Ka yi firiya kamar tsuntsu zuwa duwatsu.
english: For the Chief Musician. By David. In Yahweh, I take refuge. How can you say to my soul, “Flee as a bird to your mountain”?

hausa: Na bayyana na ceci na kuma furta, Ni ne, ba wani baƙon allah a cikinku. Ku ne shaiduna,” in ji Ubangiji, “cewa ni ne Allah.
english: I have declared, I have saved, and I have shown, and there was no strange god among you. Therefore you are my witnesses”, says Yahweh, “and I am God.

hausa: Fariyar zuciyarki ta yaudare ki, ke da kike zama can bisa duwatsu kika kuma yi gidanki a kan ƙwanƙoli, ke da kike ce wa kanki, ‘Wa zai iya saukar da ni ƙasa?’
english: The pride of your heart has deceived you, you who dwell in the clefts of the rock, whose habitation is high, who says in his heart, ‘Who will bring me down to the ground?’

hausa: Saboda haka Yusuf ma ya haura daga Nazaret a Galili zuwa Yahudiya, ya tafi Betlehem garin Dawuda, don shi daga gida da kuma zuriyar Dawuda ne.
english: Joseph also went up from Galilee, out of the city of Nazareth, into Judea, to David’s city, which is called Bethlehem, because he was of the house and family of David,

hausa: Firist zai bincika mikin da yake a fatar mai cutar, in gashin a mikin ya juya ya zama fari, mikin kuma ya zama kamar ya fi zurfin fatar jiki, wannan cutar kuturta ce. Sa’ad da firist ya bincike shi, zai furta shi marar tsarki.
english: The priest shall examine the plague in the skin of the body. If the hair in the plague has turned white, and the appearance of the plague is deeper than the body’s skin, it is the plague of leprosy; so the priest shall examine him and pronounce him unclean.

hausa: Gama Ubangiji yana jin daɗin mutanensa; yakan darjanta masu sauƙinkai da ceto.
english: For Yahweh takes pleasure in his people. He crowns the humble with salvation.

hausa: gama mu gaɓoɓin jikinsa ne.
english: because we are members of his body, of his flesh and bones.

hausa: Ƙa’ida ɗaya ce ga jama’a da kuma baƙin da suke zama a cikinku, wannan za tă zama dawwammamiyar farilla a dukan tsararraki masu zuwa. Da ku, da baƙi, za ku zama ɗaya a gaban Ubangiji.
english: For the assembly, there shall be one statute for you and for the stranger who lives as a foreigner, a statute forever throughout your generations. As you are, so the foreigner shall be before Yahweh.

hausa: An riga an ɓata lokaci da yawa, tafiya kuwa ta riga ta zama da hatsari domin a lokacin Azumi ya riga ta wuce. Saboda haka Bulus ya gargaɗe su,
english: When much time had passed and the voyage was now dangerous because the Fast had now already gone by, Paul admonished them

hausa: Ba ku son mai yin gaskiya a ɗakin shari’a kuna ƙin mai faɗar gaskiya.
english: They hate him who reproves in the gate, and they abhor him who speaks blamelessly.

hausa: Zai kasance tare da shi, zai kuma karanta shi dukan kwanakin ransa, saboda yă koyi girmama Ubangiji Allahnsa, yă kuma bi dukan kalmomin wannan doka da kuma waɗannan ƙa’idodi a hankali
english: It shall be with him, and he shall read from it all the days of his life, that he may learn to fear Yahweh his God, to keep all the words of this law and these statutes, to do them;

hausa: Sai Isra’ila suka yi alkawari wa Ubangiji suka ce, “In ka ba da waɗannan mutane a hannunmu, za mu hallaka dukan garuruwansu ƙaf.”
english: Israel vowed a vow to Yahweh, and said, “If you will indeed deliver this people into my hand, then I will utterly destroy their cities.”

hausa: “ ‘Ubangiji ya baratar da mu; zo mu tafi mu yi shelarsa a Sihiyona mu faɗa abin da Ubangiji Allahnmu ya yi.’
english: ‘Yahweh has produced our righteousness. Come, and let’s declare in Zion the work of Yahweh our God.’

hausa: Ku rera masa sabuwar waƙa; ku yi kiɗi da gwaninta, ku kuma yi sowa don farin ciki.
english: Sing to him a new song. Play skillfully with a shout of joy!

hausa: Bari mutumin ya zama kamar garuruwan da Ubangiji ya tumɓuke ba tausayi. Bari yă ji kuka da safe kururuwan yaƙi kuma da tsakar rana.
english: Let that man be as the cities which Yahweh overthrew, and didn’t repent. Let him hear a cry in the morning, and shouting at noontime,

hausa: Ku rera gare shi, ku rera yabo gare shi; ku faɗa dukan ayyukan banmamakinsa.
english: Sing to him. Sing praises to him. Tell of all his marvelous works.

hausa: Kuma, “In da ƙyar masu adalci su kuɓuta, me zai faru da marasa tsoron Allah da kuma masu zunubi?”
english: “If it is hard for the righteous to be saved, what will happen to the ungodly and the sinner?”

hausa: Ya ce, “Bari yarjejjeniya ta kasance tsakani na da kai kamar yadda ya kasance tsakanin mahaifina da mahaifinka. Dubi ina aika maka azurfa da zinariya. Yanzu ka yanke yarjejjeniya da Ba’asha sarkin Isra’ila domin yă janye daga gare ni.”
english: “Let there be a treaty between me and you, as there was between my father and your father. Behold, I have sent you silver and gold. Go, break your treaty with Baasha king of Israel, that he may depart from me.”

hausa: amma a inda muka tsaya don mu kwana, da muka buɗe buhunanmu sai kowannenmu ya sami azurfansa daidai a bakin buhunsa. Saboda haka ga kuɗin a hannunmu, mun sāke komowa da su.
english: When we came to the lodging place, we opened our sacks, and behold, each man’s money was in the mouth of his sack, our money in full weight. We have brought it back in our hand.

hausa: Ba ki bi hanyoyinsu da abubuwansu na banƙyama kaɗai ba, sai ka ce wannan ya yi miki kaɗan, amma kin lalace fiye da su.
english: Yet you have not walked in their ways, nor done their abominations; but soon you were more corrupt than they in all your ways.

hausa: Ku ne masu mai da gaskiya ta koma ɗaci ku kuma zubar da adalci.
english: You who turn justice to wormwood, and cast down righteousness to the earth!

hausa: ya kuma ce, ‘Saboda wannan dalili, namiji zai bar mahaifinsa da mahaifiyarsa yă manne wa matarsa, biyun kuwa su zama jiki guda’?
english: and said, ‘For this cause a man shall leave his father and mother, and shall be joined to his wife; and the two shall become one flesh’?

hausa: Ya yi haka cikin garuruwan Manasse, Efraim da Simeyon, har zuwa Naftali, da kuma cikin kangwayen kewayensu,
english: He did this in the cities of Manasseh, Ephraim, and Simeon, even to Naphtali, around in their ruins.

hausa: Sa’an nan duka ’yan ƙasar Shekem da Bet Millo suka taru kusa da babban itacen wajen ginshiƙi a Shekem don a naɗa Abimelek sarki.
english: All the men of Shechem assembled themselves together with all the house of Millo, and went and made Abimelech king by the oak of the pillar that was in Shechem.

hausa: Gama nassi ya ce, “Kai firist ne na har abada, bisa ga tsarin Melkizedek.”
english: for it is testified, “You are a priest forever, according to the order of Melchizedek.”

hausa: Da yake barin haikalin, sai ɗaya daga cikin almajiransa ya ce masa, “Malam! Dubi irin manya-manyan duwatsun nan! Ka ga irin gine-ginen nan masu kyau mana!”
english: As he went out of the temple, one of his disciples said to him, “Teacher, see what kind of stones and what kind of buildings!”

hausa: Shi ne ma ya sa kuke biyan haraji, gama hukumomin nan bayin Allah ne, waɗanda suke ba da dukan lokacinsu don aikin shugabanci.
english: For this reason you also pay taxes, for they are servants of God’s service, continually doing this very thing.

hausa: Daga Kish, ɗan Kish shi ne, Yerameyel.
english: Of Kish, the son of Kish: Jerahmeel.

hausa: “Waɗannan su ne sunayen mutanen da za su raba muku ƙasar gādo. Eleyazar firist, da Yoshuwa ɗan Nun.
english: “These are the names of the men who shall divide the land to you for inheritance: Eleazar the priest, and Joshua the son of Nun.

hausa: Da na kakkarya burodi guda biyar wa mutane dubu biyar, kwanduna nawa kuka kwashe cike da gutsattsarin?” Suka amsa, “Sha biyu.”
english: When I broke the five loaves among the five thousand, how many baskets full of broken pieces did you take up?” They told him, “Twelve.”

hausa: Hawan da yake arewa yana fuskantar Mikmash, wanda yake kudu kuma yana fuskantar Geba.
english: The one crag rose up on the north in front of Michmash, and the other on the south in front of Geba.

hausa: Saboda haka Kiristi kansa ya ba wa waɗansu baiwa su zama manzanni, waɗansu su zama annabawa, waɗansu su zama masu wa’azi, waɗansu kuma su zama fastoci, da kuma malamai.
english: He gave some to be apostles; and some, prophets; and some, evangelists; and some, shepherds and teachers;

hausa: Bayan wannan, suka shirya wa kansu da kuma wa firistoci, saboda firistoci, zuriyar Haruna, suna miƙa hadayun ƙonawa da sashen kitse daga safe har dare. Saboda haka Lawiyawa suka shirya wa kansu da kuma wa firistocin daga zuriyar Haruna.
english: Afterward they prepared for themselves and for the priests, because the priests the sons of Aaron were busy with offering the burnt offerings and the fat until night. Therefore the Levites prepared for themselves and for the priests the sons of Aaron.

hausa: waɗanda suka sa na yi adawa da su har da na aika da su ƙasar abokan gābansu, sa’ad da suka ƙasƙantar da zukatansu marasa kaciya, suka kuma biya hukuncin zunubansu,
english: I also walked contrary to them, and brought them into the land of their enemies; if then their uncircumcised heart is humbled, and they then accept the punishment of their iniquity,

hausa: “Kada ku taɓa shafaffena; kada ku yi wa annabawa lahani.”
english: “Don’t touch my anointed ones! Do my prophets no harm!”

hausa: Duba, Ubangiji yana da wanda yake da iko da kuma ƙarfi. Kamar dutsen ƙanƙara da kuma iska mai ɓarna, kamar kwararowar ruwa da rigyawa mai kirmewa, zai jefa shi har ƙasa da ƙarfi.
english: Behold, the Lord has one who is mighty and strong. Like a storm of hail, a destroying storm, and like a storm of mighty waters overflowing, he will cast them down to the earth with his hand.

hausa: Da jin haka, Dawuda ya tura Yowab da dukan sojojin yaƙi.
english: When David heard of it, he sent Joab and all the army of the mighty men.

hausa: Ga wane daga cikin mala’iku Allah ya taɓa cewa, “Zauna a hannun damana, sai na sa abokan gābanka su zama matashin sawunka”?
english: But which of the angels has he told at any time, “Sit at my right hand, until I make your enemies the footstool of your feet?”

hausa: Ina ƙarƙashin alkawari gare ka, ya Allah; zan miƙa hadayuna na godiya gare ka.
english: Your vows are on me, God. I will give thank offerings to you.

hausa: Kowace mace mai fasaha ta kaɗa zare da hannuwanta, ta kuma kawo abin da ta kaɗa na shuɗi, shunayya, ko jan zare, ko lallausan lilin.
english: All the women who were wise-hearted spun with their hands, and brought that which they had spun: the blue, the purple, the scarlet, and the fine linen.

hausa: Iliya ya ce masa, “In ni mutumin Allah ne, bari wuta tă sauko daga sama tă cinye ka da sojojinka hamsin!” Sai wuta ta sauko daga sama ta cinye kaftin tare da sojojinsa hamsin.
english: Elijah answered to the captain of fifty, “If I am a man of God, then let fire come down from the sky and consume you and your fifty!” Then fire came down from the sky, and consumed him and his fifty.

hausa: Ya yi masa tambayoyi masu yawa, amma Yesu bai ba shi ko amsa ba.
english: He questioned him with many words, but he gave no answers.

hausa: Yana cikin samun arziki, ɓacin rai zai auka masa; ƙunci mai ƙarfi zai zo masa.
english: In the fullness of his sufficiency, distress will overtake him. The hand of everyone who is in misery will come on him.

hausa: Waɗanda suka ji wannan suka yi tambaya suka ce, “To, wa zai iya samun ceto?”
english: Those who heard it said, “Then who can be saved?”

hausa: Ubangiji zai cika manufarsa a kaina; ƙaunarka, ya Ubangiji, madawwamiya ce har abada, kada ka ƙyale ayyukan hannuwanka.
english: Yahweh will fulfill that which concerns me. Your loving kindness, Yahweh, endures forever. Don’t forsake the works of your own hands.

hausa: Waɗansu mutane suka gangara daga Yahudiya zuwa Antiyok suna kuma koya wa ’yan’uwa cewa, “Sai ko an yi muku kaciya bisa ga al’ada da Musa ya koyar, in ba haka ba, ba za ku sami ceto ba.”
english: Some men came down from Judea and taught the brothers, “Unless you are circumcised after the custom of Moses, you can’t be saved.”

hausa: A dakalin daga ciki, akwai bakin da yake da’ira, mai zurfi kamun guda. Bakin da’irar ne, yana da zāne-zānensa da ya kai kamu ɗaya da rabi. Kusa da bakin akwai zāne-zāne. Sassan dakalin murabba’i ne, ba da’ira ba ne.
english: Its opening within the capital and above was a cubit. Its opening was round like the work of a pedestal, a cubit and a half; and also on its opening were engravings, and their panels were square, not round.

hausa: Itacen ɓaure ya fid da ’ya’yansa da sauri; tohon inabi suna ba da ƙanshinsu. Tashi, zo, ƙaunatacciyata; kyakkyawata, zo tare da ni.”
english: The fig tree ripens her green figs. The vines are in blossom. They give out their fragrance. Arise, my love, my beautiful one, and come away.”

hausa: Yesu ya ce, “Je ka, bangaskiyarka ta warkar da kai.” Nan da nan, ya sami ganin gari, ya kuma bi Yesu suka tafi.
english: Jesus said to him, “Go your way. Your faith has made you well.” Immediately he received his sight and followed Jesus on the way.

hausa: turɓaya ta koma ƙasar da ta fito, rai kuma yă koma ga Allah wanda ya ba da shi.
english: and the dust returns to the earth as it was, and the spirit returns to God who gave it.

hausa: Sai Abishai ɗan Zeruhiya ya ce, “Bai kamata a kashe Shimeyi saboda wannan ba? Ya la’anci shafaffe na Ubangiji.”
english: But Abishai the son of Zeruiah answered, “Shouldn’t Shimei be put to death for this, because he cursed Yahweh’s anointed?”

hausa: Daga tudun da yake fuskantar Bet-Horon a kudu, iyakar ta juya kudu ta gefen yamma ta ɓullo a Kiriyat Ba’al (wato, Kiriyat Yeyarim), birnin Yahuda. Wannan ita ce iyakar a wajen yamma.
english: The border extended, and turned around on the west quarter southward, from the mountain that lies before Beth Horon southward; and ended at Kiriath Baal (also called Kiriath Jearim), a city of the children of Judah. This was the west quarter.

hausa: Ni ne Ubangiji Allahnku, da ya fitar da ku daga Masar, don in zama Allahnku. Ni ne Ubangiji Allahnku.’ ”
english: I am Yahweh your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, to be your God: I am Yahweh your God.”

hausa: Dukan tsarkaka suna gaishe ku.
english: All the saints greet you.

hausa: Ka dube ni ba tausayi; Ka kai mini hari da ƙarfin hannunka.
english: You have turned to be cruel to me. With the might of your hand you persecute me.

hausa: Duk waɗanda ba sa bin doka yabon mugaye suke yi, amma waɗanda suke yin biyayya da doka suna gāba da mugaye ke nan.
english: Those who forsake the law praise the wicked; but those who keep the law contend with them.

hausa: Za ka jera su bi da bi, wato, ’ya’yan rumman na biye da ƙararrawar zinariya kewaye da bakin rigar.
english: a golden bell and a pomegranate, a golden bell and a pomegranate, around the hem of the robe.

hausa: zuciyar da take ƙulla mugayen dabaru, ƙafafun da suke sauri zuwa aikata mugunta,
english: a heart that devises wicked schemes, feet that are swift in running to mischief,

hausa: in kuka mai da hankali na musamman ga mutumin da yake da riguna masu tsadan nan kuka kuma ce, “Ga wurin zama mai kyau dominka,” amma kuka ce wa matalaucin nan, “Kai tsaya daga can,” ko kuwa, “Ka zauna a ƙasa kusa da ƙafafuna,”
english: and you pay special attention to him who wears the fine clothing and say, “Sit here in a good place;” and you tell the poor man, “Stand there,” or “Sit by my footstool”

hausa: “Ubangiji mai adalci ne, duk da haka na yi tawaye da umarninsa. Ku saurara, jama’a duka; ku dubi wahalar da nake sha. Samarina da ’yan matana duka sun tafi bauta.
english: “Yahweh is righteous, for I have rebelled against his commandment. Please hear all you peoples, and see my sorrow. My virgins and my young men have gone into captivity.

hausa: “Kai ne mutum na farko da aka fara haihuwa? Ko kai ne aka fara halitta kafin tuddai?
english: “Are you the first man who was born? Or were you brought out before the hills?

hausa: Gama mu abokan aiki ne na Allah; ku kuwa gonar ce ta Allah, ginin Allah kuma.
english: For we are God’s fellow workers. You are God’s farming, God’s building.

hausa: Dole ku kasance a ƙofar Tentin Sujada dare da rana har kwana bakwai, ku kuma yi abin da Ubangiji yake bukata, don kada ku mutu; gama abin da aka umarce ni ke nan.”
english: You shall stay at the door of the Tent of Meeting day and night seven days, and keep Yahweh’s command, that you don’t die: for so I am commanded.”

hausa: Ya yi kerub a iyakar gefe ɗaya, ya yi ɗayan kuma a wancan gefe; a iyakan nan biyu, ya yi su a haɗe da murfin.
english: one cherub at the one end, and one cherub at the other end. He made the cherubim of one piece with the mercy seat at its two ends.

hausa: ’Ya’yansa suna shan jini, inda akwai waɗanda aka kashe nan za a same shi.”
english: His young ones also suck up blood. Where the slain are, there he is.”

hausa: Amma Shawulu ya aurar da Mikal, ’yarsa, matar Dawuda, ga Falti ɗan Layish wanda yake daga Gallim.
english: Now Saul had given Michal his daughter, David’s wife, to Palti the son of Laish, who was of Gallim.

hausa: Mai tumbatsa kamar ruwa, amma ba za ka ƙara zama mai daraja ba, gama ka hau gadon mahaifinka ka hau kujerata, ka kuma ƙazantar da shi.
english: Boiling over like water, you shall not excel, because you went up to your father’s bed, then defiled it. He went up to my couch.

hausa: Saboda haka sarki da Haman suka tafi cin abinci wurin sarauniya Esta.
english: So the king and Haman came to banquet with Esther the queen.

hausa: Suka kawo jakar da ɗanta, suka shimfiɗa mayafansu a kansu, Yesu kuma ya zauna a kansu.
english: and brought the donkey and the colt and laid their clothes on them; and he sat on them.

hausa: Manasse yana da shekara goma sha biyu sa’ad da ya zama sarki, ya yi mulki shekara hamsin da biyar a Urushalima. Sunan mahaifiyarsa Hefziba.
english: Manasseh was twelve years old when he began to reign, and he reigned fifty-five years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Hephzibah.

hausa: Sai Harbona, ɗaya daga cikin bābānni masu yi wa sarki hidima ya ce, “Akwai wurin rataye mai laifi da tsayinsa ya kai ƙafa saba’in da biyar yana nan tsaye kusa da gidan Haman. Ya gyara shi ne domin a rataye Mordekai, wanda ya yi cece sarki wanda ya tone makircin masu niyya su hallaka sarki.” Sai sarki ya ce, “Ku rataye shi a kansa!”
english: Then Harbonah, one of the eunuchs who were with the king, said, “Behold, the gallows fifty cubits high, which Haman has made for Mordecai, who spoke good for the king, is standing at Haman’s house.” The king said, “Hang him on it!”

hausa: Ta wurin bangaskiya Ibrahim, ko da yake shekarunsa sun wuce, Saratu kanta kuma bakararriya ce ya iya zama mahaifi domin ya amince cewa shi wanda ya yi alkawarin mai aminci ne.
english: By faith even Sarah herself received power to conceive, and she bore a child when she was past age, since she counted him faithful who had promised.

hausa: Ya kai wanda yake jin addu’a a gare ka dukan mutane za su zo.
english: You who hear prayer, all men will come to you.

hausa: A kan rana ta tara a watan huɗu na wannan shekara, yunwa ta tsananta ƙwarai a birnin. Mutane suka rasa abin da za su ci.
english: In the fourth month, in the ninth day of the month, the famine was severe in the city, so that there was no bread for the people of the land.

hausa: gama fushin mutum ba ya kawo rayuwar adalcin da Allah yake so.
english: for the anger of man doesn’t produce the righteousness of God.

hausa: Ba za ka yi kisankai ba.
english: “You shall not murder.

hausa: Lokacin da mayaƙan suka komo sansani, dattawan Isra’ilawa suka yi tambaya suka ce, “Me ya sa Ubangiji ya sa muka sha ɗibga a hannun Filistiyawa? Bari mu kawo akwatin alkawarin Ubangiji daga Shilo. Domin yă tafi tare da mu yă ba mu nasara kan abokan gābanmu.”
english: When the people had come into the camp, the elders of Israel said, “Why has Yahweh defeated us today before the Philistines? Let’s get the ark of Yahweh’s covenant out of Shiloh and bring it to us, that it may come among us and save us out of the hand of our enemies.”

hausa: A cikin Dokarku a rubuce yake cewa shaidar mutum biyu tabbatacciya ce.
english: It’s also written in your law that the testimony of two people is valid.

hausa: Ya cinye wani sashe na gaɓar jikinsa; ɗan fari na mutuwa ya cinye ƙafafunsa.
english: The members of his body will be devoured. The firstborn of death will devour his members.

hausa: Ubangiji ba mai jinkiri ba ne wajen cika alkawarinsa, yadda waɗansunku suka fahimci jinkiri. Yana haƙuri da ku, ba ya so wani yă hallaka, sai dai kowa yă kai ga tuba.
english: The Lord is not slow concerning his promise, as some count slowness; but he is patient with us, not wishing that anyone should perish, but that all should come to repentance.

hausa: Saboda haka sai kimanin mutum duba uku suka haura; amma mutanen Ai suka fatattake su,
english: So about three thousand men of the people went up there, and they fled before the men of Ai.

hausa: To, Dawuda dai ɗan wani mutumin Efratawa ne mai suna Yesse, shi mutumin Betlehem ne a cikin Yahudiya. Yesse yana da yara maza takwas, a zamanin Shawulu kuwa, Yesse ya riga ya tsufa.
english: Now David was the son of that Ephrathite of Bethlehem Judah, whose name was Jesse; and he had eight sons. The man was an elderly old man in the days of Saul.

hausa: Ba wanda ya taɓa hawa zuwa sama sai wanda ya sauka daga sama, wato, Ɗan Mutum.
english: No one has ascended into heaven but he who descended out of heaven, the Son of Man, who is in heaven.

hausa: Ran Dawuda ya ɓace gama fushin Ubangiji ya ɓarke a kan Uzza. Shi ya sa har wa yau ana kira wurin Ferez Uzza.
english: David was displeased because Yahweh had broken out against Uzzah; and he called that place Perez Uzzah to this day.

hausa: Tsuntsu yakan fāɗa a tarko a ƙasa inda ba a sa tarko ba, ko tarko yakan zargu daga ƙasa in ba abin da ya taɓa shi?
english: Can a bird fall in a trap on the earth, where no snare is set for him? Does a snare spring up from the ground, when there is nothing to catch?

hausa: Eliyud ya haifi Eleyazar, Eleyazar ya haifi Mattan, Mattan ya haifi Yaƙub,
english: Eliud became the father of Eleazar. Eleazar became the father of Matthan. Matthan became the father of Jacob.

hausa: Wannan shawara ta gamshi Absalom da dukan dattawan Isra’ila.
english: The saying pleased Absalom well, and all the elders of Israel.

hausa: Aka fi ba shi girma fiye da talatin ɗin nan, amma ba ya cikin ukun. Dawuda ya sa shi yă zama ɗaya daga cikin masu tsaron lafiyarsa.
english: He was more honorable than the thirty, but he didn’t attain to the three. David set him over his guard.

hausa: Kada ku ji tausayinsa. Dole ku fid da laifin zub da jinin marar laifi daga Isra’ila, don ku sami zaman lafiya.
english: Your eye shall not pity him, but you shall purge the innocent blood from Israel that it may go well with you.

hausa: Saboda haka fa, in ta auri wani yayinda mijinta yana raye, za a ce da ita mazinaciya. Amma in mijinta ya mutu, an sake ta ke nan daga wannan doka, ita kuwa ba mazinaciya ba ce, ko da yake ta auri wani.
english: So then if, while the husband lives, she is joined to another man, she would be called an adulteress. But if the husband dies, she is free from the law, so that she is no adulteress, though she is joined to another man.

hausa: Alheri da salama daga Allah Ubanmu da kuma Ubangiji Yesu Kiristi, su kasance tare da ku.
english: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

hausa: Me za mu ce ke nan? Za mu ci gaba yin zunubi domin ba ma ƙarƙashin doka sai dai ƙarƙashin alheri? Sam, ko kaɗan!
english: What then? Shall we sin because we are not under law but under grace? May it never be!

hausa: Sa’ad da Yahudawa suka ga taron mutanen, sai suka cika da kishi suka yi ta munanan maganganu a kan abin da Bulus yake faɗi.
english: But when the Jews saw the multitudes, they were filled with jealousy, and contradicted the things which were spoken by Paul, and blasphemed.

hausa: Bari mu sa mahaifinmu yă sha ruwan inabi, sa’an nan sai mu kwana da shi, don kada zuriyar mahaifinmu ta ƙare.”
english: Come, let’s make our father drink wine, and we will lie with him, that we may preserve our father’s family line.”

hausa: Kamar yadda uwa takan ta’azantar da ɗanta haka zan ta’azantar da ku; za ku kuma ta’azantu a Urushalima.”
english: As one whom his mother comforts, so I will comfort you. You will be comforted in Jerusalem.”

hausa: Daga cikin rabin rabon Isra’ilawa, ka zaɓi ɗaya daga kowane hamsin na mutane, shanu, jakuna, tumaki, awaki ko kuma sauran dabbobi. Ka ba wa Lawiyawan da suke lura da tabanakul na Ubangiji.”
english: Of the children of Israel’s half, you shall take one drawn out of every fifty, of the persons, of the cattle, of the donkeys, and of the flocks, of all the livestock, and give them to the Levites, who perform the duty of Yahweh’s tabernacle.”

hausa: Sa’ad da Ubangiji Allahnku ya ba ku hutu daga dukan abokan gābanku kewaye da ku, a ƙasar da yake ba ku ku mallaka a matsayin gādo, sai ku shafe Amalekawa daga duniya, don kada a ƙara tunawa da su. Kada fa ku manta!
english: Therefore it shall be, when Yahweh your God has given you rest from all your enemies all around, in the land which Yahweh your God gives you for an inheritance to possess it, that you shall blot out the memory of Amalek from under the sky. You shall not forget.

hausa: Shefatiya ɗan Mattan, Gedaliya ɗan Fashhur, Yukal ɗan Shelemiya da Fashhur ɗan Malkiya ya ji abin da Irmiya yana faɗa wa dukan mutane sa’ad da ya ce,
english: Shephatiah the son of Mattan, Gedaliah the son of Pashhur, Jucal the son of Shelemiah, and Pashhur the son of Malchijah heard the words that Jeremiah spoke to all the people, saying,

hausa: Aka yi babban yunwa a cikin birnin. Saboda daɗewar wannan kewayewar da aka yi wa birnin, sai yunwa ta ɓarke a birnin, har ana sayar da kan jaki a kan shekel tamanin, kashin kurciya kuma a kan shekel biyar.
english: There was a great famine in Samaria. Behold, they besieged it until a donkey’s head was sold for eighty pieces of silver, and the fourth part of a kab of dove’s dung for five pieces of silver.

hausa: A lokacin za a faɗa wa mutanen nan da kuma Urushalima cewa, “Iska mai zafi daga tuddan hamada za tă hura zuwa wajen mutanena, amma ba don ta sheƙe ko ta rairaye; ba;
english: At that time it will be said to this people and to Jerusalem, “A hot wind blows from the bare heights in the wilderness toward the daughter of my people, not to winnow, nor to cleanse.

hausa: Kada ku bar mugunta ta sha kanku, sai dai ku sha kan mugunta ta wurin aikata nagarta.
english: Don’t be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.

hausa: Jakan jeji suna tsaye a kan tuddai suna haki kamar diloli; idanunsu sun kāsa gani saboda rashin makiyaya.”
english: The wild donkeys stand on the bare heights. They pant for air like jackals. Their eyes fail, because there is no vegetation.

hausa: Duk wanda ya mai da hankali sa’ad da ake tsawata masa ba zai kasance dabam a cikin masu hikima ba.
english: The ear that listens to reproof lives, and will be at home among the wise.

hausa: ya kuma kawo kwanon zinariya ɗaya mai nauyin shekel goma, cike da turaren hayaƙi;
english: one golden ladle of ten shekels, full of incense;

hausa: Da suka haye, sai Iliya ya ce wa Elisha, “Faɗi mini, abin da kake so in yi maka kafin a ɗauke ni daga gare ka!” Elisha ya amsa ya ce, “Bari in gāji ninki biyu na ruhunka.”
english: When they had gone over, Elijah said to Elisha, “Ask what I shall do for you, before I am taken from you.” Elisha said, “Please let a double portion of your spirit be on me.”

hausa: A sa’ad da Gehazi yana cikin ba shi labarin yadda Elisha ya tā da matacce ke nan, sai ga macen da aka tā da ɗanta daga matattu ta shigo don tă roƙi sarki yă mayar mata da gidanta da filinta. Gehazi ya ce, “Ranka yă daɗe, ai, ga macen, ga kuma ɗan da Elisha ya tā da daga matattu.”
english: As he was telling the king how he had restored to life him who was dead, behold, the woman whose son he had restored to life begged the king for her house and for her land. Gehazi said, “My lord, O king, this is the woman, and this is her son, whom Elisha restored to life.”

hausa: wanda ya zubo mana a yalwace ta wurin Yesu Kiristi Mai Cetonmu,
english: whom he poured out on us richly through Jesus Christ our Savior;

hausa: To, wani saurayi, mutumin Ibraniyawa ya kasance a can tare da mu, bawan shugaban masu tsaro. Sai muka faɗa masa mafarkanmu, ya kuwa fassara mana su, yana ba wa kowane mutum fassarar mafarkinsa.
english: There was with us there a young man, a Hebrew, servant to the captain of the guard, and we told him, and he interpreted to us our dreams. He interpreted to each man according to his dream.

hausa: Na ɗauki takardar ciniki, takardar da aka rubuta sharuɗan a ciki, da kuma takardar da ba a liƙe ba,
english: So I took the deed of the purchase, both that which was sealed, containing the terms and conditions, and that which was open;

hausa: Na ga wani mugun abu a duniya, arzikin da aka ajiye don yă cuce mai shi,
english: There is a grievous evil which I have seen under the sun: wealth kept by its owner to his harm.

hausa: suka kuma yi dogayen sanduna biyar da ƙugiya dominsu. Suka dalaye saman dogayen sandunan da abin daurinsu da zinariya, suka kuma yi rammukansu guda biyar da tagulla.
english: and the five pillars of it with their hooks. He overlaid their capitals and their fillets with gold, and their five sockets were of bronze.

hausa: Mutanen Betel sun aika Sharezer da Regem-Melek, tare da mutanensu su nemi tagomashin Ubangiji
english: The people of Bethel sent Sharezer and Regem Melech and their men to entreat Yahweh’s favor,

hausa: “Me zan yi da kai Efraim? Me zan yi da kai Yahuda? Ƙaunarku tana kamar hazon safiya, kamar raɓar safiya da takan ɓace.
english: “Ephraim, what shall I do to you? Judah, what shall I do to you? For your love is like a morning cloud, and like the dew that disappears early.

hausa: Amma duk ruhun da bai yarda da Yesu ba, ba daga Allah ba ne, ruhun magabcin Kiristi ne, wanda kuka ji yana zuwa, har ma ya riga ya shigo duniya.
english: and every spirit who doesn’t confess that Jesus Christ has come in the flesh is not of God; and this is the spirit of the Antichrist, of whom you have heard that it comes. Now it is in the world already.

hausa: Da fadawan Yahuda suka ji haka, sai suka haura daga fada zuwa gidan Ubangiji suka zazzauna a wuraren zamansu a mashigin Sabuwar Ƙofar gidan Ubangiji.
english: When the princes of Judah heard these things, they came up from the king’s house to Yahweh’s house; and they sat in the entry of the new gate of Yahweh’s house.

hausa: Ina dai gaya muku, ba zan ƙara sha daga ’ya’yan inabi ba, sai mulkin Allah ya zo.”
english: for I tell you, I will not drink at all again from the fruit of the vine, until God’s Kingdom comes.”

hausa: Ku kawo mahaifinku da iyalanku zuwa wurina. Zan ba ku mafi kyau na ƙasar Masar, za ku kuwa ci moriyar ƙasar.’
english: Take your father and your households, and come to me, and I will give you the good of the land of Egypt, and you will eat the fat of the land.’

hausa: Da wulaƙanci da kuma hukunci aka ɗauke shi aka tafi. Wa kuwa zai yi maganar zuriyarsa? Gama an kawar da shi daga ƙasar masu rai; saboda laifin mutanena aka kashe shi.
english: He was taken away by oppression and judgment. As for his generation, who considered that he was cut off out of the land of the living and stricken for the disobedience of my people?

hausa: Yanzu sai yin zunubi a kai a kai suke; suna yin gumaka wa kansu daga azurfansu, da wayo suna sarrafa siffofi, dukansu aikin masu aikin hannu ne. Ana magana waɗannan mutane cewa, “Suna miƙa hadayar mutum su kuma sumbaci gumakan maruƙa.”
english: Now they sin more and more, and have made themselves molten images of their silver, even idols according to their own understanding, all of them the work of the craftsmen. They say of them, ‘They offer human sacrifice and kiss the calves.’

hausa: Tawa ta ƙare! Ina kama da wanda yake tattara ’ya’yan itatuwa a lokacin kalar ’ya’yan inabi; babu sauran nonon inabin da za a tsinka a ci, babu kuma ’ya’yan ɓaure na farko-farkon da raina yake marmari.
english: Misery is mine! Indeed, I am like one who gathers the summer fruits, as gleanings of the vineyard. There is no cluster of grapes to eat. My soul desires to eat the early fig.

hausa: Musa ya ce wa Kora, “Da kai da kuma dukan ƙungiyarka za ku bayyana a gaban Ubangiji gobe, kai da su. Haruna ma zai kasance a can.
english: Moses said to Korah, “You and all your company go before Yahweh, you, and they, and Aaron, tomorrow.

hausa: Kaciya ko rashin kaciya ba wani abu ba ne; abin da yake da amfani shi ne sabuwar halitta.
english: For in Christ Jesus neither is circumcision anything, nor uncircumcision, but a new creation.

hausa: ko kuwa saboda ƙiyayya ya naushe shi har ya mutu, sai a kashe wannan mutumin da ya yi haka; shi mai kisankai ne. Sai mai bin hakkin jini yă kashe mai kisankan in ya same shi.
english: or in hostility struck him with his hand, so that he died, he who struck him shall surely be put to death. He is a murderer. The avenger of blood shall put the murderer to death when he meets him.

hausa: Masu sayensu sun yanyanka su, suka kuwa tafi ba hukunci. Masu sayar da su sun ce, ‘Yabi Ubangiji, na yi arziki!’ Makiyayansu ma ba su ji tausayinsu ba.
english: Their buyers slaughter them and go unpunished. Those who sell them say, ‘Blessed be Yahweh, for I am rich;’ and their own shepherds don’t pity them.

hausa: Akan cin abinci marar ɗanɗano ba tare da an sa gishiri ba, ko akwai wani ƙanshin daɗi a cikin farin ruwan ƙwai?
english: Can that which has no flavor be eaten without salt? Or is there any taste in the white of an egg?

hausa: In hadayarku ta hatsin da aka dafa ne a tukunya, sai a yi shi da gari mai laushi da kuma mai.
english: If your offering is a meal offering of the pan, it shall be made of fine flour with oil.

hausa: Matarsa Zeresh, da dukan abokansa suka ce masa, “Ka sa a gina wurin rataye mai laifi, mai tsawo, ƙafa saba’in da biyar, da safe kuwa ka ce wa sarki a rataye Mordekai a kansa. Sa’an nan ka tafi cin abincin dare tare da sarki da murna.” Wannan shawarar ta faranta wa Haman rai, ya kuma sa aka gina wurin rataye mai laifi.
english: Then Zeresh his wife and all his friends said to him, “Let a gallows be made fifty cubits high, and in the morning speak to the king about hanging Mordecai on it. Then go in merrily with the king to the banquet.” This pleased Haman, so he had the gallows made.

hausa: “Mahaifinka ya sa mana kaya masu nauyi a kanmu, amma yanzu ka sauƙaƙa mana aiki mai zafin nan da kuma kaya masu nauyin da ya sa a kanmu, mu kuwa za mu bauta maka.”
english: “Your father made our yoke grievous. Now therefore make the grievous service of your father and his heavy yoke which he put on us, lighter, and we will serve you.”

hausa: Gama raina yana cike da wahala rayuwata tana gab da kabari.
english: For my soul is full of troubles. My life draws near to Sheol.

hausa: “Ku kasa kunne gare ni, ya ku gidan Yaƙub, dukanku waɗanda kuka rage na gidan Isra’ila, ku da na lura da ku tun da aka yi cikinku, na kuma riƙe ku tun haihuwarku.
english: “Listen to me, house of Jacob, and all the remnant of the house of Israel, that have been carried from their birth, that have been carried from the womb.

hausa: Sa’an nan Rebeka da bayinta mata suka shirya suka hau raƙumansu suka koma tare da mutumin. Da haka bawan ya ɗauki Rebeka ya tafi.
english: Rebekah arose with her ladies. They rode on the camels, and followed the man. The servant took Rebekah, and went his way.

hausa: Ina muku baftisma da ruwa, amma shi zai yi muku baftisma da Ruhu Mai Tsarki.”
english: I baptized you in water, but he will baptize you in the Holy Spirit.”

hausa: Mahaifinku na farko ya yi zunubi; masu magana a madadinku suka yi mini tayarwa.
english: Your first father sinned, and your teachers have transgressed against me.

hausa: Daga lambatun da yake a ƙasa har zuwa ƙaramin mahaɗin da yake ƙasa wanda ya kewaye bagade, tsayinsa kamu biyu ne, fāɗinsa kuma kamu guda. Daga ƙaramin mahaɗi zuwa babban mahaɗin wanda ya kewaye bagade, zai zama kamu huɗu, fāɗinsa kuwa kamu ɗaya.
english: From the bottom on the ground to the lower ledge shall be two cubits, and the width one cubit; and from the lesser ledge to the greater ledge shall be four cubits, and the width a cubit.

hausa: Ga abin da Ubangiji ya faɗa mini, “Kamar yadda zaki kan yi ruri babban zaki a kan abin da ya yi farauta, kuma ko da yake dukan ƙungiyar makiyaya sun taru wuri ɗaya a kansa, ba zai jijjigu ta wurin ihunsu ba ko ya damu da kiraye-kirayensu, ta haka Ubangiji Maɗaukaki zai sauko don yă yi yaƙi a kan Dutsen Sihiyona da kuma a kan ƙwanƙolinsa.
english: For Yahweh says to me, “As the lion and the young lion growling over his prey, if a multitude of shepherds is called together against him, will not be dismayed at their voice, nor abase himself for their noise, so Yahweh of Armies will come down to fight on Mount Zion and on its heights.

hausa: An tanƙware ni aka kuma ƙasƙantar da ni; dukan yini ina ta kuka.
english: I am in pain and bowed down greatly. I go mourning all day long.

hausa: domin ta wurin kasancewata tare da ku, farin cikinku cikin Kiristi Yesu zai cika sosai ta dalilina.
english: that your boasting may abound in Christ Jesus in me through my presence with you again.

hausa: Hazor-Hadatta, Keriyot Hezron (wato, Hazor),
english: Hazor Hadattah, Kerioth Hezron (also called Hazor),

hausa: an kuma mai da ku cikakku a cikin Kiristi, wanda yake shi ne kai a kan kowane iko da kuma hukuma.
english: and in him you are made full, who is the head of all principality and power.

hausa: “Ƙasashe da yawa za su haɗa kai da Ubangiji a ranan nan, za su kuma zama mutanena. Zan zauna a cikinku, za ku kuma san cewa Ubangiji Maɗaukaki ne ya aiko ni gare ku.
english: Many nations shall join themselves to Yahweh in that day, and shall be my people; and I will dwell among you, and you shall know that Yahweh of Armies has sent me to you.

hausa: Allah ya ba da Oreb da Zeyib, shugabannin Midiyawa a hannuwanku. Me na yi da ya fi naku? Da ya faɗi haka sai hankalinsu ya kwanta.”
english: God has delivered into your hand the princes of Midian, Oreb and Zeeb! What was I able to do in comparison with you?” Then their anger was abated toward him when he had said that.

hausa: Dawuda ya ce wa Gad, “Na shiga uku. Gara mu fāɗa a hannuwan Ubangiji gama alherinsa da girma yake. Amma fa kada ka bar ni in fāɗa a hannun mutane.”
english: David said to Gad, “I am in distress. Let us fall now into Yahweh’s hand, for his mercies are great. Let me not fall into man’s hand.”

hausa: Sai dukan rundunonin da suke tare da Yowab suka zo suka yi wa Sheba kwanton ɓauna a Abel-Bet-Ma’aka. Suka tara ƙasa kewaye da jikin katangar birnin daidai da tsayinta. Sa’an nan waɗansu kuma suna ƙoƙarin rushe katangar.
english: They came and besieged him in Abel of Beth Maacah, and they cast up a mound against the city, and it stood against the rampart; and all the people who were with Joab battered the wall to throw it down.

hausa: Tumakina suna ta yawo a kan dukan duwatsu da kuma kowane tudu. Sun watsu a dukan duniya, kuma ba wanda ya neme su.
english: My sheep wandered through all the mountains and on every high hill. Yes, my sheep were scattered on all the surface of the earth. There was no one who searched or sought.”

hausa: Bala’am ya ce musu, “Ku kwana a nan, ni kuwa zan faɗa muku abin da Ubangiji ya faɗa mini.” Saboda haka dattawan sarkin Mowab suka zauna da shi.
english: He said to them, “Lodge here this night, and I will bring you word again, as Yahweh shall speak to me.” The princes of Moab stayed with Balaam.

hausa: “Ka ba Haruna da ’ya’yansa maza wannan umarni, ‘Waɗannan su ne ƙa’idodi don hadaya ta ƙonawa. Hadaya ta ƙonawa za tă kasance a bagade dukan dare, sai da safe, kuma dole a bar wutar tă yi ta ci a bisa bagaden.
english: “Command Aaron and his sons, saying, ‘This is the law of the burnt offering: the burnt offering shall be on the hearth on the altar all night until the morning; and the fire of the altar shall be kept burning on it.

hausa: Harshena zai ba da labarin ayyukanka masu adalci dukan yini, gama waɗanda suka so su cutar da ni sun sha kunya suka kuma rikice.
english: My tongue will also talk about your righteousness all day long, for they are disappointed, and they are confounded, who want to harm me.

hausa: Ya roƙe su su roƙi jinƙan Allah na sama domin wannan mafarki, saboda kada a kashe shi da abokansa tare da sauran masu hikima na Babilon.
english: that they would desire mercies of the God of heaven concerning this secret, that Daniel and his companions would not perish with the rest of the wise men of Babylon.

hausa: Waɗansu Isra’ilawa, haɗe da firistoci, da Lawiyawa, da mawaƙa, da masu tsaron ƙofofi, da masu aiki a haikali su ma suka zo Urushalima a shekara ta bakwai a zamanin mulkin sarki Artazerzes.
english: Some of the children of Israel, including some of the priests, the Levites, the singers, the gatekeepers, and the temple servants went up to Jerusalem in the seventh year of Artaxerxes the king.

hausa: “Amma kamar yadda manyan duwatsu suke fāɗuwa su farfashe su kuma gusa daga wurarensu,
english: “But the mountain falling comes to nothing. The rock is removed out of its place.

hausa: Mahaifinku Ibrahim ya yi farin ciki sosai yă sami ganin ranata; ya kuwa gan ta, ya yi murna.”
english: Your father Abraham rejoiced to see my day. He saw it and was glad.”

hausa: Bari su san cewa hannunka ne, cewa kai ne, ya Ubangiji, ka yi shi.
english: that they may know that this is your hand; that you, Yahweh, have done it.

hausa: Sa’an nan ya ce musu, “Da a ce ɗayanku yana da aboki, sa’an nan ya je wurinsa da tsakar dare ya ce, ‘Aboki, ranta mini burodi guda uku,
english: He said to them, “Which of you, if you go to a friend at midnight and tell him, ‘Friend, lend me three loaves of bread,

hausa: Haka ma, bagaden ya rabu, tokarsa kuma ya zuba, bisa ga alamar da mutumin Allah ya bayar, ta wurin kalmar Ubangiji.
english: The altar was also split apart, and the ashes poured out from the altar, according to the sign which the man of God had given by Yahweh’s word.

hausa: Firist da aka keɓe aka kuma naɗa don yă gāji mahaifinsa a matsayin babban firist ne zai yi kafara. Zai sa rigunan lilin masu tsarki
english: The priest, who is anointed and who is consecrated to be priest in his father’s place, shall make the atonement, and shall put on the linen garments, even the holy garments.

hausa: Waɗannan su ne sunayen ’ya’yan Lawi maza bisa ga abin da aka rubuta, Gershon, Kohat da Merari. Lawi ya yi shekara 137.
english: These are the names of the sons of Levi according to their generations: Gershon, and Kohath, and Merari; and the years of the life of Levi were one hundred thirty-seven years.

hausa: Gara ka zama kai ba kome ba ne amma kana da bawa da ka mai da kanka kai wani ne alhali kuwa ba ka da abinci.
english: Better is he who is little known, and has a servant, than he who honors himself and lacks bread.

hausa: “ ‘A rana ta fari ga kowane wata, za a miƙa wa Ubangiji hadayun ’yan bijimai biyu, rago ɗaya, da ’yan tumaki bakwai, bana ɗaya-ɗaya, dukansu kuma marasa lahani.
english: “‘In the beginnings of your months, you shall offer a burnt offering to Yahweh: two young bulls, one ram, seven male lambs a year old without defect,

hausa: Ku ji, ya ku mutane duka, ki saurara, ya ke duniya da dukan mazauna cikinki, bari Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka yă zama shaida a kanku, daga haikalinsa mai tsarki.
english: Hear, you peoples, all of you! Listen, O earth, and all that is therein. Let the Lord Yahweh be witness against you, the Lord from his holy temple.

hausa: sarkin Ta’anak, ɗaya sarkin Megiddo, ɗaya
english: the king of Taanach, one; the king of Megiddo, one;

hausa: Bilatus ya amsa ya ce, “Ni mutumin Yahuda ne? Ai, mutanenka ne da kuma manyan firistoci suka bashe ka gare ni. Me ka yi?”
english: Pilate answered, “I’m not a Jew, am I? Your own nation and the chief priests delivered you to me. What have you done?”

hausa: Da safe, da suke wucewa, sai suka ga itacen ɓauren nan ya yanƙwane tun daga saiwarsa.
english: As they passed by in the morning, they saw the fig tree withered away from the roots.

hausa: Sa’ad da suka haye, sai suka sauka a Gennesaret.
english: When they had crossed over, they came to the land of Gennesaret.

hausa: Sa’ad da Yaƙub ya ga Rahila ’yar Laban, ɗan’uwan mahaifiyarsa, da tumakin Laban, sai ya tafi ya gungurar da dutsen daga bakin rijiyar, ya kuma shayar da tumakin kawunsa.
english: When Jacob saw Rachel the daughter of Laban, his mother’s brother, and the sheep of Laban, his mother’s brother, Jacob went near, and rolled the stone from the well’s mouth, and watered the flock of Laban his mother’s brother.

hausa: Bayan ya haifi Tera, Nahor ya yi shekara 119, ya kuma haifi waɗansu ’ya’ya maza da mata.
english: Nahor lived one hundred nineteen years after he became the father of Terah, and became the father of more sons and daughters.

hausa: Sai Ubangiji ya ce, “Jefa shi ƙasa.” Musa ya jefa shi ƙasa, sai sandan ya zama maciji, Musa kuwa ya gudu daga gare shi.
english: He said, “Throw it on the ground.” He threw it on the ground, and it became a snake; and Moses ran away from it.

hausa: A wannan rana mutane za su zubar wa jaba da jamage gumakansu na azurfa da gumakansu na zinariya da suka yi don su bauta musu.
english: In that day, men shall cast away their idols of silver and their idols of gold, which have been made for themselves to worship, to the moles and to the bats,

hausa: Yusuf yana nan har yanzu a gida sa’ad da Yahuda da ’yan’uwansa suka shiga, suka fāɗi rub da ciki a ƙasa a gabansa.
english: Judah and his brothers came to Joseph’s house, and he was still there. They fell on the ground before him.

hausa: Dukan mala’iku suna tsaye kewaye da kursiyin da kuma kewaye da dattawan tare da halittu huɗun nan masu rai. Suka fāɗi da fuskokinsu ƙasa a gaban kursiyin suka kuma yi wa Allah sujada,
english: All the angels were standing around the throne, the elders, and the four living creatures; and they fell on their faces before his throne, and worshiped God,

hausa: Sun fi zinariya daraja, fiye da zalla zinariya nesa; sun fi zuma zaƙi fiye da zuma daga kaki.
english: They are more to be desired than gold, yes, than much fine gold, sweeter also than honey and the extract of the honeycomb.

hausa: ba su kiyaye alkawarin Allah ba suka kuma ƙi su yi rayuwa ta wurin dokarsa.
english: They didn’t keep God’s covenant, and refused to walk in his law.

hausa: “Yana a hannuwanku” Sarki Zedekiya ya amsa. “Sarki ba zai iya yin kome ya hana ku ba.”
english: Zedekiah the king said, “Behold, he is in your hand; for the king can’t do anything to oppose you.”

hausa: Zan hukunta ku gwargwadon ayyukanku, in ji Ubangiji. Zan sa wuta a kurminku da za tă cinye kome da yake kewaye da ku.’ ”
english: I will punish you according to the fruit of your doings,’ says Yahweh; ‘and I will kindle a fire in her forest, and it will devour all that is around her.’”

hausa: Dole dattijo yă kasance marar aibi, mijin mace guda, mutumin da ’ya’yansa masu bi ne, waɗanda kuma ba a san su da lalata ko rashin biyayya ba.
english: if anyone is blameless, the husband of one wife, having children who believe, who are not accused of loose or unruly behavior.

hausa: Bayan ya sa suka haye rafin, haka ma ya tura dukan mallakarsa zuwa hayen.
english: He took them, and sent them over the stream, and sent over that which he had.

hausa: Ƙayayuwa za su mamaye fadodinta ƙayayyuwa da sarƙaƙƙiya za su cika kagaranta. Za tă zama mazaunin diloli da gida don mujiyoyi.
english: Thorns will come up in its palaces, nettles and thistles in its fortresses; and it will be a habitation of jackals, a court for ostriches.

hausa: A hanyoyin mugu akwai kaya da tarko, amma duk wanda ya kiyaye ransa kan kauce musu.
english: Thorns and snares are in the path of the wicked; whoever guards his soul stays far from them.

hausa: Ku duba Sihiyona, birnin shagulgulanmu; idanunku za su ga Urushalima, mazauni mai lafiya, tentin da ba za a taɓa gusar ba; wanda ba a taɓa tumɓuke turakunsa ba, ko a tsinke igiyoyinta.
english: Look at Zion, the city of our appointed festivals. Your eyes will see Jerusalem, a quiet habitation, a tent that won’t be removed. Its stakes will never be plucked up, nor will any of its cords be broken.

hausa: Ka sa kwanakina suka zama tafin hannu ne kawai; yawan shekaruna kamar ba kome ba ne a gabanka. Duk ran mutum shaƙar iska ne kurum, har ma waɗanda suke tsammani suke da kāriya. Sela
english: Behold, you have made my days hand widths. My lifetime is as nothing before you. Surely every man stands as a breath.” Selah.

hausa: Sai shugabannin zuriyar Yahuda da na Benyamin, da firistoci da Lawiyawa, duk wanda Allah ya taɓa zuciyarsa, suka shirya don su je su gina haikalin Ubangiji a Urushalima.
english: Then the heads of fathers’ households of Judah and Benjamin, the priests and the Levites, all whose spirit God had stirred to go up, rose up to build Yahweh’s house which is in Jerusalem.

hausa: Aladu daga kurmi suna ɓarnatar da shi halittun gonaki kuma suna cinsa.
english: The boar out of the wood ravages it. The wild animals of the field feed on it.

hausa: na kuwa ba wa sarki amsa, na ce, “In ya gamshi sarki, in kuma bawanka ya sami tagomashi a idonka, bari ka aike ni in tafi ƙasar Yahuda, birnin da aka binne kakannina, domin in sāke gina shi.”
english: I said to the king, “If it pleases the king, and if your servant has found favor in your sight, I ask that you would send me to Judah, to the city of my fathers’ tombs, that I may build it.”

hausa: Sa’ad da suka ji wannan, sai suka ɗaga muryoyinsu gaba ɗaya cikin addu’a ga Allah, suka ce, “Ya Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka, kai ka halicci sama da ƙasa da kuma teku, da kome da yake cikinsu.
english: When they heard it, they lifted up their voice to God with one accord and said, “O Lord, you are God, who made the sky, the earth, the sea, and all that is in them;

hausa: Sa’an nan Ubangiji ya ce wa Musa,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

hausa: Sai Yesu ya ce masa, “Tashi! Ɗauki tabarmarka ka yi tafiya.”
english: Jesus said to him, “Arise, take up your mat, and walk.”

hausa: zan kawo baƙi a kanka, waɗanda suka fi mugunta cikin sauran al’ummai; za su zāre takubansu a kan kyakkyawar hikimarka su kuma ɓarke darajarka mai walƙiya.
english: therefore, behold, I will bring strangers on you, the terrible of the nations. They will draw their swords against the beauty of your wisdom. They will defile your brightness.

hausa: Namanta yana da kauri a manne da juna; naman yana da tauri ba ya matsawa.
english: The flakes of his flesh are joined together. They are firm on him. They can’t be moved.

hausa: Duk wanda yake lura da bakinsa da kuma harshensa kan kiyaye kansa daga masifa.
english: Whoever guards his mouth and his tongue keeps his soul from troubles.

hausa: Kada ku yi taurinkai, yadda iyayenku suka yi; ku miƙa kai ga Ubangiji. Ku zo wuri mai tsarki, wanda ya tsarkake har abada. Ku bauta wa Ubangiji Allahnku, domin fushi mai zafi yă juye daga gare ku.
english: Now don’t be stiff-necked, as your fathers were, but yield yourselves to Yahweh, and enter into his sanctuary, which he has sanctified forever, and serve Yahweh your God, that his fierce anger may turn away from you.

hausa: Aka ba wa zuriyar Merari bisa ga iyalansu, garuruwa goma sha biyu daga kabilan Ruben, Gad da Zebulun.
english: The children of Merari according to their families had twelve cities out of the tribe of Reuben, out of the tribe of Gad, and out of the tribe of Zebulun.

hausa: Ubangiji yana aikata adalci da kuma gaskiya ga duk waɗanda aka danne.
english: Yahweh executes righteous acts, and justice for all who are oppressed.

hausa: Ubangiji ya yi fushi da Solomon domin zuciyarsa ya juye daga Ubangiji, Allah na Isra’ila, wanda ya bayyana masa sau biyu.
english: Yahweh was angry with Solomon, because his heart was turned away from Yahweh, the God of Israel, who had appeared to him twice,

hausa: Ƙasa ta tsattsage saboda babu ruwan sama a ƙasar; manoma sun sha kunya suka kuma rufe kawunansu.
english: Because of the ground which is cracked, because no rain has been in the land, the plowmen are disappointed. They cover their heads.

hausa: Ya koya musu abubuwa da yawa da misalai. A koyarwarsa kuwa ya ce,
english: He taught them many things in parables, and told them in his teaching,

hausa: ka kuma ce, ‘Ga abin da Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka yana cewa kaiton matan da suke ɗinka kambuna a hannuwansu suna kuma yin gyale masu tsawo dabam-dabam wa kawunansu don su farauci mutane. Za ku farauci rayukan mutanena ku bar naku?
english: and say, “The Lord Yahweh says: ‘Woe to the women who sew magic bands on all elbows and make veils for the head of persons of every stature to hunt souls! Will you hunt the souls of my people and save souls alive for yourselves?

hausa: Sa’an nan ku zo, mu haura zuwa Betel, inda zan gina bagade wa Allah wanda ya amsa mini a ranar wahalata, wanda kuma ya kasance tare da ni a dukan inda na tafi.”
english: Let’s arise, and go up to Bethel. I will make there an altar to God, who answered me in the day of my distress, and was with me on the way which I went.”

hausa: Ka rufe ta da zurfi kamar da riga ruwaye sun tsaya a bisa duwatsu.
english: You covered it with the deep as with a cloak. The waters stood above the mountains.

hausa: Sai suka yi ta ihu da ƙarfi suna tsattsaga kansu da takuba da māsu, yadda al’adarsu take, sai da jininsu ya yi ta zuba.
english: They cried aloud, and cut themselves in their way with knives and lances until the blood gushed out on them.

hausa: Ka kawo ’ya’yansa, ka sa musu taguwoyi,
english: You shall bring his sons, and put tunics on them.

hausa: in na yi fahariya don yawan dukiyata, arzikin da hannuwana suka samu.
english: If I have rejoiced because my wealth was great, and because my hand had gotten much;

hausa: Da aka sallami jama’a, Yahudawa da yawa da kuma waɗanda suka tuba suka shiga Yahudanci masu ibada suka bi Bulus da Barnabas, waɗanda suka yi magana musu suka kuma ƙarfafa su su ci gaba a cikin alherin Allah.
english: Now when the synagogue broke up, many of the Jews and of the devout proselytes followed Paul and Barnabas; who, speaking to them, urged them to continue in the grace of God.

hausa: Masu albarka ne waɗanda suke jin yunwa da ƙishirwa don gani an yi adalci, gama za a ƙosar da su.
english: Blessed are those who hunger and thirst for righteousness, for they shall be filled.

hausa: Muka hallaka su ƙaƙaf, kamar yadda muka yi wa Sihon sarkin Heshbon, muka hallaka kowace birni, maza, mata da yara.
english: We utterly destroyed them, as we did to Sihon king of Heshbon, utterly destroying every inhabited city, with the women and the little ones.

hausa: tebur da kayansa, wurin ajiye fitila na zinariya zalla, da dukan kayansa, bagaden ƙona turare,
english: the table and its vessels, the pure lamp stand with all its vessels, the altar of incense,

hausa: Da jin motsin mahayan dawakai da maharba kowane gari ya ruga da gudu. Waɗansu suka shiga kurmi; waɗansu suka hau cikin duwatsu. Dukan garuruwan sun fashe tas; babu wani da yake zama a ciki.
english: Every city flees for the noise of the horsemen and archers. They go into the thickets and climb up on the rocks. Every city is forsaken, and not a man dwells therein.

hausa: Ka ji mu, ya Allahnmu, gama an rena mu. Bari zagin da suke yi mana yă koma kansu. Ka sa a kwashe su a kai su bauta a wata ƙasa.
english: “Hear, our God, for we are despised. Turn back their reproach on their own head. Give them up for a plunder in a land of captivity.

hausa: bagaden hadaya ta ƙonawa da dukan kayansa, daro tare da mazauninsa,
english: the altar of burnt offering with all its vessels, the basin and its base,

hausa: “A nan zan sa ƙaho ya yi girma wa Dawuda in kuma kafa fitila saboda shafaffena.
english: I will make the horn of David to bud there. I have ordained a lamp for my anointed.

hausa: Ubangiji Allahnku yana a gabanku, zai yi yaƙi saboda ku, kamar yadda ya yi a kan idanunku a Masar,
english: Yahweh your God, who goes before you, he will fight for you, according to all that he did for you in Egypt before your eyes,

hausa: Manasse zai sami rabo; zai yi iyaka da yankin Naftali daga gabas zuwa yamma.
english: “By the border of Naphtali, from the east side to the west side, Manasseh, one portion.

hausa: “’Ya’yana, zan kasance da ku na ɗan ƙanƙani lokaci ne. Za ku neme ni. Kuma kamar yadda na gaya wa Yahudawa, haka nake gaya muku yanzu. Inda zan tafi, ba za ku iya zuwa ba.
english: Little children, I will be with you a little while longer. You will seek me, and as I said to the Jews, ‘Where I am going, you can’t come,’ so now I tell you.

hausa: Bari fuskarka ta haskaka a kan bawanka; ka cece ni da ƙaunarka marar ƙarewa.
english: Make your face to shine on your servant. Save me in your loving kindness.

hausa: A shekara ta talatin da ɗaya na Asa sarkin Yahuda, Omri ya zama sarkin Isra’ila, ya kuma yi mulki shekara goma sha biyu, shekaru shida a Tirza.
english: In the thirty-first year of Asa king of Judah, Omri began to reign over Israel for twelve years. He reigned six years in Tirzah.

hausa: “Amma yanzu zan aiko a kira masunta masu yawa su zo,” in ji Ubangiji, “za su kuma kama su. Bayan wannan zan aiko a kira mafarauta su zo, su farauce su daga kowane dutse da tudu da kuma daga kogwannin duwatsu.
english: “Behold, I will send for many fishermen,” says Yahweh, “and they will fish them up. Afterward I will send for many hunters, and they will hunt them from every mountain, from every hill, and out of the clefts of the rocks.

hausa: Kalmar da aka faɗa daidai tana kamar zubin zinariyar da aka yi a mazubin azurfa.
english: A word fitly spoken is like apples of gold in settings of silver.

hausa: Siman da abokansa suka fita nemansa.
english: Simon and those who were with him searched for him.

hausa: Ya yi marmarin cin dusan da aladun suke ci, amma ba wanda ya ba shi wani abu.
english: He wanted to fill his belly with the pods that the pigs ate, but no one gave him any.

hausa: “Yanzu kuma ga mutanen Ammon, da na Mowab, da na Dutsen Seyir, waɗanda ka hana Isra’ilawa su kai musu yaƙi sa’ad da suka fito daga ƙasar Masar, su ne mutanen da Isra’ila suka ƙyale, ba su hallaka su ba.
english: Now, behold, the children of Ammon and Moab and Mount Seir, whom you would not let Israel invade when they came out of the land of Egypt, but they turned away from them, and didn’t destroy them;

hausa: Amma Ubangiji Allahnku bai saurari Bala’am ba, sai ya mai da la’anar ta koma albarka gare ku, domin Ubangiji Allahnku yana ƙaunarku.
english: Nevertheless Yahweh your God wouldn’t listen to Balaam, but Yahweh your God turned the curse into a blessing to you, because Yahweh your God loved you.

hausa: “Idan mutum ya ruɗe budurwa, wadda ba wanda yake nemanta, ya kuma kwanta da ita, dole yă biya kuɗin aurenta, za tă kuma zama matarsa.
english: “If a man entices a virgin who isn’t pledged to be married, and lies with her, he shall surely pay a dowry for her to be his wife.

hausa: “Yanzu fa ku mazauna cikin Urushalima da mutanen Yahuda, ku shari’anta tsakanina da gonar inabina.
english: “Now, inhabitants of Jerusalem and men of Judah, please judge between me and my vineyard.

hausa: Shaidar mutum guda ba tă isa a tabbatar cewa mutum yana da laifi game da laifin da ake tuhumarsa ba, ko kuwa a kan wani laifin da ake zaginsa da aikata ba. Dole a tabbata da batun ta bakin shaidu biyu, ko uku.
english: One witness shall not rise up against a man for any iniquity, or for any sin that he sins. At the mouth of two witnesses, or at the mouth of three witnesses, shall a matter be established.

hausa: Sai Yusuf ya ce wa Fir’auna, “Mafarkan Fir’auna, ɗaya ne. Allah ya bayyana wa Fir’auna abin da yake shirin yi.
english: Joseph said to Pharaoh, “The dream of Pharaoh is one. What God is about to do he has declared to Pharaoh.

hausa: Yabe shi, ku bisa sammai da kuma ku ruwan bisa sarari.
english: Praise him, you heavens of heavens, you waters that are above the heavens.

hausa: “ ‘Ka saurara, ya babban firist Yoshuwa, kai da abokanka da suke zaune a gabanka, ku da kuke alamun abubuwan da za su zo. Zan kawo bawana, wanda yake Reshe.
english: Hear now, Joshua the high priest, you and your fellows who sit before you, for they are men who are a sign; for, behold, I will bring out my servant, the Branch.

hausa: A can cikin haikalin rana a Masar zai rushe al’amudan duwatsu yă kuma ƙone haikalan allolin Masar.’ ”
english: He will also break the pillars of Beth Shemesh that is in the land of Egypt; and he will burn the houses of the gods of Egypt with fire.’”

hausa: Amma waɗanda suka dogara ga gumaka, waɗanda suke ce wa siffofi, ‘Ku ne allolinmu,’ za a mai da su baya da kunya.
english: “Those who trust in engraved images, who tell molten images, ‘You are our gods,’ will be turned back. They will be utterly disappointed.

hausa: Yowab ya tashi daga gaban Dawuda ya tafi ya aika manzanni su bi Abner. Suka same shi a rijiyar Sira suka komo da shi, Dawuda kuwa bai sani ba.
english: When Joab had come out from David, he sent messengers after Abner, and they brought him back from the well of Sirah; but David didn’t know it.

hausa: Mutanen Benyamin suka fito daga Gibeya suka kashe mutum dubu ashirin da biyu na Isra’ilawa a dāgār yaƙi a ranar.
english: The children of Benjamin came out of Gibeah, and on that day destroyed twenty-two thousand of the Israelite men down to the ground.

hausa: Bayan an sāke gina katangar na kuma sa ƙofofi a wurarensu, sai aka naɗa masu tsaro, da mawaƙa, da Lawiyawa.
english: Now when the wall was built and I had set up the doors, and the gatekeepers and the singers and the Levites were appointed,

hausa: Kuka kashe tushen rai, amma Allah ya tashe shi daga matattu. Mu shaidu ne ga wannan.
english: and killed the Prince of life, whom God raised from the dead, to which we are witnesses.

hausa: Saboda haka mutanen Absalom suka yi wa Amnon abin da Absalom ya umarta. Sai dukan sauran ’ya’yan sarki maza suka hau dawakansu suka gudu.
english: The servants of Absalom did to Amnon as Absalom had commanded. Then all the king’s sons arose, and every man got up on his mule and fled.

hausa: Amma Sihon sarkin Heshbon ya ƙi yă bar mu mu wuce a ciki. Gama Ubangiji Allahnku ya sa ruhunsa ya taurare don yă ba da shi a hannuwanku kamar yadda ya yi yanzu.
english: But Sihon king of Heshbon would not let us pass by him, for Yahweh your God hardened his spirit and made his heart obstinate, that he might deliver him into your hand, as it is today.

hausa: Bari mutuwa ta ɗauki abokan gābana ba labari; bari su gangara da rai zuwa cikin kabari, gama mugunta tana samun masauƙi a cikinsu.
english: Let death come suddenly on them. Let them go down alive into Sheol. For wickedness is among them, in their dwelling.

hausa: Sai ya ce, “Gaskiya nake gaya muku, in ba kun canja kuka zama kamar ƙananan yara ba, labudda, ba za ku shiga mulkin sama ba.
english: and said, “Most certainly I tell you, unless you turn and become as little children, you will in no way enter into the Kingdom of Heaven.

hausa: Yanzu sai ku kira dukan annabawan Ba’al, dukan masu yin masa hidima da kuma dukan firistocinsa. Ku tabbata ba a manta da wani ba, gama zan yi wa Ba’al babbar hadaya. Duk wanda bai zo ba, a bakin ransa.” Amma Yehu yana wayo ne domin yă hallaka masu yi wa Ba’al sujada.
english: Now therefore call to me all the prophets of Baal, all of his worshipers, and all of his priests. Let no one be absent, for I have a great sacrifice to Baal. Whoever is absent, he shall not live.” But Jehu did deceptively, intending to destroy the worshipers of Baal.

hausa: A Ƙofar Maɓuɓɓuga suka ci gaba kai tsaye suka haura matakalan Birnin Dawuda a kan hawa zuwa katangar suka wuce a bisa gidan Dawuda zuwa Ƙofar Ruwa wajen gabas.
english: By the spring gate, and straight before them, they went up by the stairs of David’s city, at the ascent of the wall, above David’s house, even to the water gate eastward.

hausa: domin a bincika a littattafan tarihin kakanninka. Za ka ga cewa wannan birni mai tawaye ne. Tun daga zamanin dā wannan birnin yana ba sarakuna da yankuna damuwa. Wannan ne ya sa aka ragargazar da birnin.
english: that search may be made in the book of the records of your fathers. You will see in the book of the records, and know that this city is a rebellious city, and hurtful to kings and provinces, and that they have started rebellions within it in the past. That is why this city was destroyed.

hausa: Game da sauran ayyukan mulkin Yowash, da dukan abubuwan da ya yi, da kuma nasarorinsa, haɗe da yaƙin da ya yi da Amaziya sarkin Yahuda, duk a rubuce suke a cikin littafin tarihin sarakunan Isra’ila.
english: Now the rest of the acts of Joash, and all that he did, and his might with which he fought against Amaziah king of Judah, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

hausa: Dube su! A zaune ko a tsaye, suna yi mini ba’a cikin waƙoƙinsu.
english: You see their sitting down and their rising up. I am their song.

hausa: Kai ba Allahn da yake jin daɗin mugu ba ne; gama kana gāba da dukan masu aikata mugunta.
english: For you are not a God who has pleasure in wickedness. Evil can’t live with you.

hausa: Sa’ad da kerubobin suka tsaya cik, su ma sukan tsaya cik; kuma sa’ad da kerubobin suka tashi, sai su ma su tashi tare da su, domin ruhun rayayyun halittun yana a cikinsu.
english: When they stood, these stood. When they mounted up, these mounted up with them; for the spirit of the living creature was in them.

hausa: Gedor, Ahiyo, Zakariya da Miklot.
english: Gedor, Ahio, Zechariah, and Mikloth.

hausa: Bayan ƙarin barazana sai suka bar su su tafi. Ba su iya yanke shawara yadda za a hore su ba, domin dukan mutane suna yabon Allah saboda abin da ya faru.
english: When they had further threatened them, they let them go, finding no way to punish them, because of the people; for everyone glorified God for that which was done.

hausa: Mugayen ruhohi suka fiffito suna kururuwa daga cikin mutane da yawa, shanyayyu da guragu masu yawa suka sami warkarwa.
english: For unclean spirits came out of many of those who had them. They came out, crying with a loud voice. Many who had been paralyzed and lame were healed.

hausa: Sojojin suka tafi da Yesu cikin fadar gwamna (wato, Firetoriyum), suka kira dukan kamfanin sojoji wuri ɗaya.
english: The soldiers led him away within the court, which is the Praetorium; and they called together the whole cohort.

hausa: suna cewa, “Amin! Yabo da ɗaukaka, da hikima da godiya da girma da iko da ƙarfi sun tabbata ga Allahnmu har abada abadin. Amin!”
english: saying, “Amen! Blessing, glory, wisdom, thanksgiving, honor, power, and might, be to our God forever and ever! Amen.”

hausa: Daga leɓunan yara da jarirai ka kafa yabo domin su sa abokan gābanka da masu ɗaukan fansa su yi shiru.
english: From the lips of babes and infants you have established strength, because of your adversaries, that you might silence the enemy and the avenger.

hausa: Ba abin da ya faɗa musu, da ba da misali ba. Amma lokacin da yake shi kaɗai tare da almajiransa, sai yă bayyana kome.
english: Without a parable he didn’t speak to them; but privately to his own disciples he explained everything.

hausa: Ka kafa mutanenka Isra’ila kamar naka na kanka har abada, kai kuma, ya Ubangiji, ka zama Allahnsu.
english: You established for yourself your people Israel to be your people forever; and you, Yahweh, became their God.

hausa: Duk da haka duhun bai sa in yi shiru ba, duhun da ya rufe mini fuska.
english: Because I was not cut off before the darkness, neither did he cover the thick darkness from my face.

hausa: Ya kawo hadaya ta ƙonawa ya kuma miƙa ta yadda aka tsara.
english: He presented the burnt offering, and offered it according to the ordinance.

hausa: Ya Ubangiji Allah na Isra’ila, kai mai adalci ne! Yau an bar mu da sauran da ya tsira. Ga mu nan a gabanka masu zunubi, gama ba wanda zai iya tsayawa a gabanka.”
english: Yahweh, the God of Israel, you are righteous; for we are left a remnant that has escaped, as it is today. Behold, we are before you in our guiltiness; for no one can stand before you because of this.”

hausa: Masu kisankai sukan ƙi mutum mai mutunci su kuma nema su kashe mai aikata gaskiya.
english: The bloodthirsty hate a man of integrity; and they seek the life of the upright.

hausa: don a juyar da su daga abin da yake yi da ba daidai ba a kuma hana su daga girman kai,
english: that he may withdraw man from his purpose, and hide pride from man.

hausa: Ubangiji Allahnmu ya yi alkawari da mu a Horeb.
english: Yahweh our God made a covenant with us in Horeb.

hausa: In kuwa haka ne, wanda ya gayyace duk biyunku, zai zo ya ce maka, ‘Ka ba wa mutumin nan wurin zamanka.’ Ka ga, an ƙasƙantar da kai, kuma dole ka ɗauki wuri mafi ƙasƙanci.
english: and he who invited both of you would come and tell you, ‘Make room for this person.’ Then you would begin, with shame, to take the lowest place.

hausa: Sai Musa ya ce wa jama’ar, “Ga abin da Ubangiji ya umarta a yi.”
english: Moses said to the congregation, “This is the thing which Yahweh has commanded to be done.”

hausa: Sa’an nan Allah ya ce, “Bari mu yi mutum cikin siffarmu, cikin kamanninmu, bari kuma su yi mulki a bisa kifin teku, tsuntsayen sama, da kuma dabbobi, su yi mulki a bisa dukan duniya, da kuma a bisa dukan halittu, da masu rarrafe a ƙasa.”
english: God said, “Let’s make man in our image, after our likeness. Let them have dominion over the fish of the sea, and over the birds of the sky, and over the livestock, and over all the earth, and over every creeping thing that creeps on the earth.”

hausa: Amma Yesu ya tambaye shi ya ce, “Yahuda, ashe, da sumba za ka bashe Ɗan Mutum?”
english: But Jesus said to him, “Judas, do you betray the Son of Man with a kiss?”

hausa: Kora, Gatam da kuma Amalek. Waɗannan ne manya da suka fito daga dangin Elifaz a Edom; su ne jikokin Ada.
english: chief Korah, chief Gatam, chief Amalek. These are the chiefs who came of Eliphaz in the land of Edom. These are the sons of Adah.

hausa: Ya kuma ce mini, “Ɗan mutum, ka ji da kyau ka kuma lura da dukan kalmomin da nake maka magana.
english: Moreover he said to me, “Son of man, receive in your heart and hear with your ears all my words that I speak to you.

hausa: Ka juya fuskarka wajen ƙawanyar Urushalima da hannunka a buɗe ka yi annabci a kanta.
english: You shall set your face toward the siege of Jerusalem, with your arm uncovered; and you shall prophesy against it.

hausa: Amma in na ce wa yaron, ‘Duba, kibiyoyin suna gaba da kai,’ sai ka tafi, gama Ubangiji ya sallame ka.
english: But if I say this to the boy, ‘Behold, the arrows are beyond you,’ then go your way, for Yahweh has sent you away.

hausa: Sa’an nan Ubangiji ya ce wa Musa,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

hausa: In mutumin ba shi da wanda zai fansa masa ita, shi kansa kuwa ya wadace, ya kuma sami isashen halin fansarta,
english: If a man has no one to redeem it, and he becomes prosperous and finds sufficient means to redeem it,

hausa: Saboda haka shugabannin nan suka haɗu da muƙaddasan nan suka tafi wurin sarki a ƙungiyance suka ce, “Ya Sarki Dariyus, ranka yă daɗe!
english: Then these presidents and local governors assembled together to the king, and said this to him, “King Darius, live forever!

hausa: Ubangiji ya ce masa, “Wa ya ba mutum bakinsa? Wa yake maishe shi kurma ko bebe? Wa yake ba shi gani ko yă makanta shi? Ashe ba Ni Ubangiji ba ne?
english: Yahweh said to him, “Who made man’s mouth? Or who makes one mute, or deaf, or seeing, or blind? Isn’t it I, Yahweh?

hausa: Adoniya tare da dukan baƙin da suke tare da shi kuwa suka ji wannan sa’ad da suke gama bikinsu. Da jin busan ƙaho, sai Yowab ya yi tambaya, ya ce, “Me ya jawo surutu haka a birni?”
english: Adonijah and all the guests who were with him heard it as they had finished eating. When Joab heard the sound of the trumpet, he said, “Why is this noise of the city being in an uproar?”

hausa: Sarki Solomon kuwa ya miƙa hadayar bijimai dubu ashirin da biyu da kuma tumaki da awaki dubu ɗari da dubu ashirin. Ta haka sarki da dukan mutane suka keɓe haikalin Allah.
english: King Solomon offered a sacrifice of twenty-two thousand head of cattle and a hundred twenty thousand sheep. So the king and all the people dedicated God’s house.

hausa: Mutanen Urushalima da masu mulkinsu ba su gane da Yesu ba, duk da haka cikin hukunta shi suka cika kalmomin annabawan da ake karantawa kowane Asabbaci.
english: For those who dwell in Jerusalem, and their rulers, because they didn’t know him, nor the voices of the prophets which are read every Sabbath, fulfilled them by condemning him.

hausa: Eshton shi ne mahaifin Bet-Rafa, Faseya da Tehinna wanda ya haifi Ir Nahash. Waɗannan su ne mutanen Reka.
english: Eshton became the father of Beth Rapha, Paseah, and Tehinnah the father of Ir Nahash. These are the men of Recah.

hausa: Ga shawarata a kan abin da ya fi muku kyau a wannan al’amari. Bara ku kuka fara bayarwa, kuka kuma zama na farko wajen niyyar yin haka.
english: I give advice in this: it is expedient for you who were the first to start a year ago, not only to do, but also to be willing.

hausa: Haka ma Hiridus, shi ya sa ya dawo da shi nan wurinmu. Kamar yadda ku ma kun gani, ba abin da mutumin nan ya yi, da ya isa mutuwa.
english: Neither has Herod, for I sent you to him, and see, nothing worthy of death has been done by him.

hausa: Ubangiji Maɗaukaki ya bayyana wannan a kunnena cewa, “Har ranar mutuwarka ba za a yi kafarar wannan zunubi ba,” in ji mai girma Ubangiji Maɗaukaki.
english: Yahweh of Armies revealed himself in my ears, “Surely this iniquity will not be forgiven you until you die,” says the Lord, Yahweh of Armies.

hausa: in yawan masu adalci sun kāsa hamshin da mutum biyar fa? Za ka hallaka dukan birnin saboda rashin mutum biyar ɗin?” Ya ce, “In na sami mutum arba’in da biyar a wurin, ba zan hallaka shi ba.”
english: What if there will lack five of the fifty righteous? Will you destroy all the city for lack of five?” He said, “I will not destroy it if I find forty-five there.”

hausa: Kada fa wani yă ƙi karɓansa. Ku sallame shi lafiya, domin yă koma wurina. Ina duban hanyarsa tare da ’yan’uwa.
english: Therefore let no one despise him. But set him forward on his journey in peace, that he may come to me; for I expect him with the brothers.

hausa: ɗaya kamar hadaya don zunubi ɗayan kuma kamar hadaya ta ƙonawa, tare da hadaya ta gari. Ta haka firist zai yi kafara a gaban Ubangiji a madadin wanda za a tsabtacce.”
english: of the kind he is able to afford, the one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering, with the meal offering. The priest shall make atonement for him who is to be cleansed before Yahweh.”

hausa: Waɗanda suke da hikima za su haskaka kamar hasken samaniya, waɗanda kuma suka jagoranci waɗansu da yawa zuwa adalci, za su zama kamar taurari har abada abadin.
english: Those who are wise will shine as the brightness of the expanse. Those who turn many to righteousness will shine as the stars forever and ever.

hausa: To, tsaye kusa da gicciyen Yesu kuwa akwai mahaifiyarsa, tare da ’yar’uwar mahaifiyarsa, Maryamu matar Kilofas, da kuma Maryamu Magdalin.
english: But standing by Jesus’ cross were his mother, his mother’s sister, Mary the wife of Clopas, and Mary Magdalene.

hausa: Waɗannan su ne ’ya’yan Shem maza bisa ga zuriyarsu da yarurrukansu, cikin ƙasashensu da kuma al’ummominsu.
english: These are the sons of Shem, by their families, according to their languages, lands, and nations.

hausa: Wannan ne kaɗai abin da na gane. Allah ya yi mutum tsab amma sai muka rikitar da kanmu.”
english: Behold, I have only found this: that God made mankind upright; but they search for many inventions.”

hausa: gama bugaggu da ruwan inabi da masu yawan ci sukan zama matalauta, gama jiri yakan yi musu sutura da tsummoki.
english: for the drunkard and the glutton shall become poor; and drowsiness clothes them in rags.

hausa: Kabilar Lawiyawa ne kaɗai Musa bai ba ta gādo ba, gama hadayun ƙonawa da ake miƙa wa Ubangiji, Allah na Isra’ila ne gādonsu, kamar yadda ya yi musu alkawari.
english: Only he gave no inheritance to the tribe of Levi. The offerings of Yahweh, the God of Israel, made by fire are his inheritance, as he spoke to him.

hausa: wato, kafintoci, da magina, da masu tsara gini. Ka kuma sa su sayi katakai da sassaƙaƙƙun duwatsu don a gyara haikalin.
english: to the carpenters, and to the builders, and to the masons, and for buying timber and cut stone to repair the house.

hausa: A wannan rana zai ɗauke nauyi daga kafaɗarku, nauyinsu daga wuyanku; za a karye karkiya domin kun yi ƙiba ƙwarai.
english: It will happen in that day that his burden will depart from off your shoulder, and his yoke from off your neck, and the yoke shall be destroyed because of the anointing oil.
