hausa: Al’ummai da yawa za su zo su ce, “Ku zo, bari mu haura zuwa dutsen Ubangiji, zuwa gidan Allah na Yaƙub. Zai koya mana hanyoyinsa, don mu yi tafiya cikin hanyoyinsa.” Doka za tă fita daga Sihiyona, maganar Ubangiji kuma daga Urushalima.
english: Many nations will go and say, “Come! Let’s go up to the mountain of Yahweh, and to the house of the God of Jacob; and he will teach us of his ways, and we will walk in his paths.” For the law will go out of Zion, and Yahweh’s word from Jerusalem;

hausa: Ubangiji yakan yi farin ciki a waɗanda suke tsoronsa, waɗanda suke sa zuciya a ƙaunarsa marar ƙarewa.
english: Yahweh takes pleasure in those who fear him, in those who hope in his loving kindness.

hausa: “An ƙayyade wa jama’arka da tsattsarkan birninka shekara ɗari huɗu da tasa’in domin a kawo ƙarshen laifi da zunubi, domin a yi kafarar laifi, sa’an nan a shigo da adalci madawwami, a rufe wahayi da annabci, a tsarkake haikali.
english: “Seventy weeks are decreed on your people and on your holy city, to finish disobedience, to make an end of sins, to make reconciliation for iniquity, to bring in everlasting righteousness, to seal up vision and prophecy, and to anoint the most holy.

hausa: Ga abin da Ubangiji Maɗaukaki ya ce, “Zan ceci mutanena daga ƙasashen gabas da yamma.
english: Yahweh of Armies says: “Behold, I will save my people from the east country and from the west country.

hausa: Wanda mutum ne zai rayu da ba zai ga mutuwa ba, ko yă cece kansa daga ikon kabari? Sela
english: What man is he who shall live and not see death, who shall deliver his soul from the power of Sheol? Selah.

hausa: Suka ce masa, “Zauna, ka karanta mana littafin.” Sai Baruk ya karanta musu littafin.
english: They said to him, “Sit down now, and read it in our hearing.” So Baruch read it in their hearing.

hausa: Yesu ya tashi daga nan ya bi ta gefen Tekun Galili. Sa’an nan ya haura gefen wani dutse ya zauna.
english: Jesus departed from there and came near to the sea of Galilee; and he went up on the mountain and sat there.

hausa: Sa’ad da Ubangiji Allahnku ya kawo ku cikin ƙasar da ya rantse ga kakanninku, ga Ibrahim, Ishaku da Yaƙub, yă ba ku, ƙasa mai girma, mai manyan biranen da ba ku kuka gina ba,
english: It shall be, when Yahweh your God brings you into the land which he swore to your fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, to give you, great and goodly cities which you didn’t build,

hausa: In kuwa ba su nace cikin rashin bangaskiya ba, za a sāke ɗaura aure da su, domin Allah yana iya sāke haɗa su.
english: They also, if they don’t continue in their unbelief, will be grafted in, for God is able to graft them in again.

hausa: “Sa’an nan zai fita zuwa bagade da yake a gaban Ubangiji, yă yi kafara dominsa. Zai ɗibi jinin bijimi da na akuya yă zuba a ƙahonin bagade.
english: “He shall go out to the altar that is before Yahweh and make atonement for it, and shall take some of the bull’s blood, and some of the goat’s blood, and put it around on the horns of the altar.

hausa: Sai wani mutum daga cikin taron ya ce masa, “Malam, ka ce wa ɗan’uwana ya raba gādon da ni.”
english: One of the multitude said to him, “Teacher, tell my brother to divide the inheritance with me.”

hausa: Ubangiji Maɗaukaki yana da rana ajiye domin dukan masu girman kai da masu fariya domin dukan waɗanda aka ɗaukaka (zai kuwa ƙasƙantar da su),
english: For there will be a day of Yahweh of Armies for all that is proud and arrogant, and for all that is lifted up, and it shall be brought low—

hausa: Ku rera ga Ubangiji, ku duniya duka; ku yi shelar cetonsa kowace rana.
english: Sing to Yahweh, all the earth! Display his salvation from day to day.

hausa: amma kurciyata, cikakkiyata, dabam take, tilo kuwa ga mahaifiyarta, ’yar lele ga wadda ta haife ta. ’Yan mata sun gan ta suka ce da ita mai albarka; sarauniyoyi da ƙwarƙwarai sun yabe ta.
english: My dove, my perfect one, is unique. She is her mother’s only daughter. She is the favorite one of her who bore her. The daughters saw her, and called her blessed. The queens and the concubines saw her, and they praised her.

hausa: Waɗannan ma za su zama zunubin da za a shari’anta ke nan don zai zama na yi wa Allah na sama rashin aminci.
english: this also would be an iniquity to be punished by the judges, for I would have denied the God who is above.

hausa: sai ya gamu da waɗansu daga dangin Ahaziya sarkin Yahuda, sai ya tambaye su, ya ce, “Ku, su wane ne?” Suka ce, “Mu dangin Ahaziya ne, mun kuma zo ne mu gai da iyalan sarki da kuma mahaifiyar sarauniya.”
english: Jehu met with the brothers of Ahaziah king of Judah, and said, “Who are you?” They answered, “We are the brothers of Ahaziah. We are going down to greet the children of the king and the children of the queen.”

hausa: “ ‘Mutanen Isra’ila ba za su ƙara kasance da mugayen maƙwabta waɗanda za su zama sarƙaƙƙiya masu zafi da ƙaya mai tsini ba. Sa’an nan za su san cewa ni ne Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka.
english: “‘“There will no longer be a pricking brier to the house of Israel, nor a hurting thorn of any that are around them that scorned them. Then they will know that I am the Lord Yahweh.”

hausa: Ya Allah mai adalci, wanda yake binciken tunani da zukata, ka kawo ƙarshen rikicin mugaye ka kuma sa adalai su zauna lafiya.
english: Oh let the wickedness of the wicked come to an end, but establish the righteous; their minds and hearts are searched by the righteous God.

hausa: Ga shi, kuna fariya da taƙama. Duk irin wannan taƙama mugun abu ne.
english: But now you glory in your boasting. All such boasting is evil.

hausa: “Ka kawo mutanen Lawi, ka kuma gabatar da su ga Haruna firist, don su taya shi aiki.
english: “Bring the tribe of Levi near, and set them before Aaron the priest, that they may minister to him.

hausa: Sa’an nan Gideyon ya ce wa Allah, “Kada ka yi fushi da ni. Bari in ƙara yin wani gwaji kuma da ulun. A wannan lokaci ka sa ulun yă bushe, ƙasar kuma ta rufu da raɓa.”
english: Gideon said to God, “Don’t let your anger be kindled against me, and I will speak but this once. Please let me make a trial just this once with the fleece. Let it now be dry only on the fleece, and on all the ground let there be dew.”

hausa: Bayan wannan sai ƙarar rurinsa ta biyo; Ya tsawata da muryarsa mai girma. Sa’ad da ya sāke yin tsawa ba ya rage wani abu.
english: After it a voice roars. He thunders with the voice of his majesty. He doesn’t hold back anything when his voice is heard.

hausa: “Kada ku bar maiya da rai.
english: “You shall not allow a sorceress to live.

hausa: Sa’an nan Ubangiji ya naɗa mahukunta, waɗanda suka cece su daga hannun waɗannan musu hari.
english: Yahweh raised up judges, who saved them out of the hand of those who plundered them.

hausa: Duk da haka mutanen Manasse ba su iya mallakar garuruwan nan ba, domin Kan’aniyawa sun nace da zama a wannan yanki.
english: Yet the children of Manasseh couldn’t drive out the inhabitants of those cities; but the Canaanites would dwell in that land.

hausa: Shimeyi ya amsa wa sarki ya ce, “Abin da ka faɗa yana da kyau. Bawanka zai yi kamar yadda ranka yă daɗe sarki, ya faɗa.” Shimeyi kuwa ya yi zama a Urushalima na dogon lokaci.
english: Shimei said to the king, “What you say is good. As my lord the king has said, so will your servant do.” Shimei lived in Jerusalem many days.

hausa: Na kalli yayinda Ɗan Ragon ya buɗe hatimin farko na hatimai bakwai ɗin nan. Sai na ji ɗaya daga cikin halittu huɗun nan masu rai ya yi magana da murya mai kama da tsawa ya ce, “Zo!”
english: I saw that the Lamb opened one of the seven seals, and I heard one of the four living creatures saying, as with a voice of thunder, “Come and see!”

hausa: Ta haka kowa zai san cewa ku almajiraina ne, in kuna ƙaunar juna.”
english: By this everyone will know that you are my disciples, if you have love for one another.”

hausa: Kowa ya ci, ya ƙoshi,
english: They all ate and were filled.

hausa: Yesu ya tashi ya tafi tare da shi, haka ma almajiransa.
english: Jesus got up and followed him, as did his disciples.

hausa: Ku zauna a faɗake; ku dāge cikin bangaskiya; ku zauna da ƙarfafawa; ku yi ƙarfi.
english: Watch! Stand firm in the faith! Be courageous! Be strong!

hausa: Sa’an nan mutanen Yahuda suka tafi tare da ’yan’uwansu mutanen Simeyon suka fāɗa wa Kan’aniyawan da suke zaune cikin Zefat, suka kuwa hallaka birnin gaba ɗaya. Saboda haka aka kira wurin Horma.
english: Judah went with Simeon his brother, and they struck the Canaanites who inhabited Zephath, and utterly destroyed it. The name of the city was called Hormah.

hausa: Har ƙotar ma ta shige ciki, takobin kuma ya fito ta bayansa. Ehud bai zare takobin ba, kitse kuwa ya rufe shi.
english: The handle also went in after the blade; and the fat closed on the blade, for he didn’t draw the sword out of his body; and it came out behind.

hausa: Yehohiyacin yana da shekara goma sha takwas sa’ad da ya zama sarki, ya kuma yi mulki a Urushalima wata uku da kwana goma. Ya yi abin da yake mugu a gaban Ubangiji.
english: Jehoiachin was eight years old when he began to reign, and he reigned three months and ten days in Jerusalem. He did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight.

hausa: Amma bayinka, kowane mutum a cikinmu zai haye a gaban Ubangiji, zuwa yaƙi kamar yadda ranka yă daɗe ya faɗa.”
english: but your servants will pass over, every man who is armed for war, before Yahweh to battle, as my lord says.”

hausa: Ka yi dajiya mai fāɗin tafin hannu, ka kuma yi wa dajiyar ado da gurun zinariya.
english: You shall make a rim of a hand width around it. You shall make a golden molding on its rim around it.

hausa: Gama sa’ad da nake zagawa, na lura da kyau da abubuwan da kuke bauta wa, har ma na tarar da wani bagade da wannan rubutu, Ga Allahn da ba a sani ba. To, abin nan da kuke yi wa sujada a matsayin abin da ba ku sani nan ba shi ne zan sanar da ku.
english: For as I passed along and observed the objects of your worship, I also found an altar with this inscription: ‘TO AN UNKNOWN GOD.’ What therefore you worship in ignorance, I announce to you.

hausa: Sai almajiran Yesu suka ce, “Haba, yanzu ne fa kake magana a sarari ba tare da misalai ba.
english: His disciples said to him, “Behold, now you are speaking plainly, and using no figures of speech.

hausa: Ko Allah yana sauraron kukansa lokacin da ƙunci ya auko masa?
english: Will God hear his cry when trouble comes on him?

hausa: Kwana arba’in cif, Bafilistin nan ya yi ta fitowa kowane safe da kuma kowace yamma.
english: The Philistine came near morning and evening, and presented himself forty days.

hausa: Ya ce wa danginsa. “Ku tattara waɗansu duwatsu.” Sai suka kwashe duwatsu suka tsiba, suka kuwa ci abinci a can kusa da tsibin.
english: Jacob said to his relatives, “Gather stones.” They took stones, and made a heap. They ate there by the heap.

hausa: Allah ya yi wannan domin mutane su neme shi mai yiwuwa kuma su lalluba su same shi, ko da yake ba shi da nisa daga kowannenmu.
english: that they should seek the Lord, if perhaps they might reach out for him and find him, though he is not far from each one of us.

hausa: Da Hiridus ya gane cewa Masanan nan sun yi masa wayo, sai ya husata ƙwarai, ya yi umarni cewa a karkashe dukan ’yan yara maza da suke a Betlehem da kewayenta, daga masu shekara biyu zuwa ƙasa, bisa ga lokacin da ya sami labarin daga Masanan nan.
english: Then Herod, when he saw that he was mocked by the wise men, was exceedingly angry, and sent out and killed all the male children who were in Bethlehem and in all the surrounding countryside, from two years old and under, according to the exact time which he had learned from the wise men.

hausa: Ya ɗauki wulaƙancin da yake sha saboda Kiristi ya fi dukiyar Masar daraja, domin ya sa ido ga ladansa.
english: considering the reproach of Christ greater riches than the treasures of Egypt; for he looked to the reward.

hausa: Da filin da kuma kogon da yake cikinsa, Hittiyawa suka tabbatar wa Ibrahim a matsayin makabarta.
english: The field, and the cave that is in it, were deeded to Abraham by the children of Heth as a possession for a burial place.

hausa: Salmon ya haifi Bowaz, Bowaz ya haifi Obed,
english: and Salmon became the father of Boaz, and Boaz became the father of Obed,

hausa: Dan zai zama maciji a gefen hanya, kububuwa a bakin hanya, da take saran ɗiɗɗigen doki domin mahayinsa yă fāɗi da baya.
english: Dan will be a serpent on the trail, an adder in the path, that bites the horse’s heels, so that his rider falls backward.

hausa: Ka kiyaye umarnaina za ka kuwa rayu; ka tsare koyarwata kamar ƙwayar idonka.
english: Keep my commandments and live! Guard my teaching as the apple of your eye.

hausa: Domin Yabin sarkin Kan’ana yana da kekunan yaƙin ƙarfe ɗari tara, ya ji wa Isra’ilawa ƙwarai har shekara ashirin, sai suka yi kuka ga Ubangiji, don taimako.
english: The children of Israel cried to Yahweh, for he had nine hundred chariots of iron; and he mightily oppressed the children of Israel for twenty years.

hausa: Isra’ila ya manta da Mahaliccinsa ya kuma gina fadodi; Yahuda ya gina katanga a yawancin garuruwansa. Amma zan aiko da wuta a bisa biranensu da zai cinye kagaransu.”
english: For Israel has forgotten his Maker and built palaces; and Judah has multiplied fortified cities; but I will send a fire on his cities, and it will devour its fortresses.”

hausa: Amma suka kama shi, suka yi masa dūka, suka kore shi hannun wofi.
english: They took him, beat him, and sent him away empty.

hausa: Sai suka bugi mutanen da suke a bakin ƙofar gidan da makanta, ƙanana da manya duka, har suka gajiyar da kansu, suna lalluba inda ƙofar take.
english: They struck the men who were at the door of the house with blindness, both small and great, so that they wearied themselves to find the door.

hausa: A ruwan Meriba suka ba Ubangiji fushi, sai wahala ta zo wa Musa saboda su;
english: They angered him also at the waters of Meribah, so that Moses was troubled for their sakes;

hausa: Duk da haka saboda kai mun fuskanci mutuwa dukan yini; aka ɗauke mu kamar tumakin da za a yanka.
english: Yes, for your sake we are killed all day long. We are regarded as sheep for the slaughter.

hausa: biyar domin katakai wancan gefe, biyar kuma domin na gefe wajen yamma, can ƙarshen tabanakul.
english: and five bars for the boards of the other side of the tabernacle, and five bars for the boards of the side of the tabernacle, for the far side westward.

hausa: Sai ya amsa wa almajiran Yohanna ya ce, “Ku koma ku faɗa wa Yohanna abin da kuka ji, da abin da kuka gani. Makafi suna ganin gari, guragu suna tafiya, ana warkar da waɗanda suke da kuturta, kurame suna ji, ana tā da matattu, ana kuma yi wa matalauta wa’azin bishara.
english: Jesus answered them, “Go and tell John the things which you have seen and heard: that the blind receive their sight, the lame walk, the lepers are cleansed, the deaf hear, the dead are raised up, and the poor have good news preached to them.

hausa: Ɗaya daga cikin mala’iku bakwai masu ɗauke da kwanoni bakwai nan, ya zo ya ce mini, “Zo, zan nuna maka hukuncin babbar karuwan nan da take zaune a bisan ruwaye masu yawa.
english: One of the seven angels who had the seven bowls came and spoke with me, saying, “Come here. I will show you the judgment of the great prostitute who sits on many waters,

hausa: Gama gaskiya nake gaya muku, annabawa da mutane masu adalci da yawa sun yi marmarin ganin abin da kuke gani amma ba su gani ba, su kuma ji abin da kuke ji amma ba su ji ba.
english: For most certainly I tell you that many prophets and righteous men desired to see the things which you see, and didn’t see them; and to hear the things which you hear, and didn’t hear them.

hausa: Wasiƙar da ya kai wa sarkin Isra’ila ta ce, “Da wannan wasiƙa ina aika Na’aman gare ka don ka warkar da kuturtarsa.”
english: He brought the letter to the king of Israel, saying, “Now when this letter has come to you, behold, I have sent Naaman my servant to you, that you may heal him of his leprosy.”

hausa: A rana ta goma ga wata na farko, mutane suka haura daga Urdun suka sauka a Gilgal a gabashin iyakar Yeriko.
english: The people came up out of the Jordan on the tenth day of the first month, and encamped in Gilgal, on the east border of Jericho.

hausa: rana ce ta busa ƙaho da kururuwar yaƙi gāba da birane masu mafaka, da kuma kusurwar hasumiyoyi.
english: a day of the trumpet and alarm against the fortified cities and against the high battlements.

hausa: Tsoro da rawan jiki sun kama ni; razana ta sha kaina.
english: Fearfulness and trembling have come on me. Horror has overwhelmed me.

hausa: Firistoci ba su iya yin hidimarsu ba saboda girgijen, gama ɗaukakar Ubangiji ta cika haikalin Allah.
english: so that the priests could not stand to minister by reason of the cloud; for Yahweh’s glory filled God’s house.

hausa: Yayinda matan nan suna cikin tafiya, sai waɗansu daga cikin masu gadin suka shiga gari, suka ba wa manyan firistoci labarin duk abin da ya faru.
english: Now while they were going, behold, some of the guards came into the city and told the chief priests all the things that had happened.

hausa: Don me Ubangiji yana kawo mu wannan ƙasa yă bar mu kawai mu mutu da takobi? A kuma kwashe matanmu da ’ya’yanmu ganima. Ashe, bai fi mana mu koma Masar ba?”
english: Why does Yahweh bring us to this land, to fall by the sword? Our wives and our little ones will be captured or killed! Wouldn’t it be better for us to return into Egypt?”

hausa: Ban da haka, Yosiya ya kawar da masu duba, da masu maita, da allolin gidaje, da gumaka, da duk wani abin banƙyaman da ya gani a Yahuda da Urushalima. Ya yi wannan domin yă cika wa’adodin shari’a yadda suke a littafin da Hilkiya firist ya samu a haikalin Ubangiji.
english: Moreover, Josiah removed those who had familiar spirits, the wizards, and the teraphim, and the idols, and all the abominations that were seen in the land of Judah and in Jerusalem, that he might confirm the words of the law which were written in the book that Hilkiah the priest found in Yahweh’s house.

hausa: Barkos, Sisera, Tema,
english: the children of Barkos, the children of Sisera, the children of Temah,

hausa: “Sa’ad da mutum ya yi abin da ba daidai ba ga maƙwabcinsa, an kuma bukace shi yă yi rantsuwa, sai ya zo ya rantse a gaban bagade a cikin haikalin nan,
english: “If a man sins against his neighbor, and an oath is laid on him to cause him to swear, and he comes and swears before your altar in this house,

hausa: da waɗansu firistoci kuma da ƙahoni, da kuma Zakariya ɗan Yonatan, ɗan Shemahiya, ɗan Mattaniya, ɗan Mikahiya, ɗan Zakkur, ɗan Asaf,
english: and some of the priests’ sons with trumpets: Zechariah the son of Jonathan, the son of Shemaiah, the son of Mattaniah, the son of Micaiah, the son of Zaccur, the son of Asaph;

hausa: Ka sa kanka a hanyar Ubangiji; ka kuma dogara gare shi zai kuwa yi wannan.
english: Commit your way to Yahweh. Trust also in him, and he will do this:

hausa: “Yana so yă rinjaye ka daga haƙoran ƙunci, zuwa wuri mai sauƙi inda ba matsi zuwa teburinka cike da abincin da kake so.
english: Yes, he would have allured you out of distress, into a wide place, where there is no restriction. That which is set on your table would be full of fatness.

hausa: Maryamun nan kuwa, wadda ɗan’uwanta Lazarus yake rashin lafiya, ita ce ta zuba wa Ubangiji turare ta kuma goge ƙafafunsa da gashin kanta.
english: It was that Mary who had anointed the Lord with ointment and wiped his feet with her hair, whose brother Lazarus was sick.

hausa: Bari idanunka su dubi gaba sosai, ka kafa idanunka kai tsaye a gabanka.
english: Let your eyes look straight ahead. Fix your gaze directly before you.

hausa: Saboda haka ikkilisiyoyi suka ginu cikin bangaskiya suka kuma yi girma suka yi ta ƙaruwa kowace rana.
english: So the assemblies were strengthened in the faith, and increased in number daily.

hausa: Zan auna Urushalima da ma’aunin da na yi amfani da shi a kan Samariya, zan kuma yi amfani da magwajin da na yi amfani da shi a kan gidan Ahab. Zan shafe Urushalima yadda mutum yake wanke kwano yă kife.
english: I will stretch over Jerusalem the line of Samaria, and the plumb line of Ahab’s house; and I will wipe Jerusalem as a man wipes a dish, wiping it and turning it upside down.

hausa: Kashegari Bulus da sauranmu muka tafi domin mu ga Yaƙub, dukan dattawan kuwa suna nan.
english: The day following, Paul went in with us to James; and all the elders were present.

hausa: Yokmeyam, Bet-Horon,
english: Jokmeam with its pasture lands, Beth Horon with its pasture lands,

hausa: Ya umarce su cewa, “Ga abin da za ku yi sa’ad da kuka zo aiki a Asabbaci, ku raba kanku kashi uku. Kashi ɗaya za su yi gadin gidan sarki,
english: He commanded them, saying, “This is what you must do: a third of you, who come in on the Sabbath, shall be keepers of the watch of the king’s house;

hausa: Bari girma da ɗaukaka su tabbata har abada abadin ga Sarki madawwami, wanda ba ya mutuwa, wanda ba a ganinsa, wanda kuma shi ne kaɗai Allah! Amin.
english: Now to the King eternal, immortal, invisible, to God who alone is wise, be honor and glory forever and ever. Amen.

hausa: Amma ba su fahimci abin da yake nufi ba, suka kuma ji tsoro su tambaye shi game da wannan.
english: But they didn’t understand the saying, and were afraid to ask him.

hausa: An rufe bayanta da jerin garkuwoyi aka manne su sosai.
english: Strong scales are his pride, shut up together with a close seal.

hausa: Gama kai kanka ka sani cewa sau da yawa ka zagi waɗansu.
english: for often your own heart knows that you yourself have likewise cursed others.

hausa: Maryamu Magdalin da ɗayan Maryamun, suna zaune a wurin, ɗaura da kabarin.
english: Mary Magdalene was there, and the other Mary, sitting opposite the tomb.

hausa: Daga zuriyar Fashhur, akwai Eliyohenai, Ma’asehiya, Ishmayel, Netanel, Yozabad da Eleyasa.
english: Of the sons of Pashhur: Elioenai, Maaseiah, Ishmael, Nethanel, Jozabad, and Elasah.

hausa: Abram ya ce, “Baiwarki tana a hannunki? Ki yi da ita yadda kika ga ya fi kyau.” Sai Saira ta wulaƙanta Hagar; saboda haka ta gudu daga gare ta.
english: But Abram said to Sarai, “Behold, your maid is in your hand. Do to her whatever is good in your eyes.” Sarai dealt harshly with her, and she fled from her face.

hausa: Ya ɗauki shugabannin ɗari-ɗari, manyan gari, shugabannin mutane da dukan mutanen ƙasar tare da shi ya saukar da sarki daga haikalin Ubangiji. Suka shiga fada ta Ƙofar Bisa suka kuma zaunar da sarki a kujerar sarauta,
english: He took the captains of hundreds, the nobles, the governors of the people, and all the people of the land, and brought the king down from Yahweh’s house. They came through the upper gate to the king’s house, and set the king on the throne of the kingdom.

hausa: Ya yi masa zubi huɗu na zoban zinariya, ya kuma ɗaura su a ƙafafunsa huɗu, zobai biyu a wannan gefe da kuma biyu a wancan.
english: He cast four rings of gold for it in its four feet—two rings on its one side, and two rings on its other side.

hausa: “ ‘Amma zan keɓe yankin Goshen, inda mutanena suke don kada ƙudaje su taɓa wurin, domin ka sani cewa Ni, Ubangiji, ina cikin wannan ƙasa.
english: I will set apart in that day the land of Goshen, in which my people dwell, that no swarms of flies shall be there, to the end you may know that I am Yahweh on the earth.

hausa: Mai tsaron kuma ya yi ihu, “Kowace rana, ranka yă daɗe, nakan tsaya a hasumiyar tsaro; kowane dare nakan tsaya a wurin aikina.
english: He cried like a lion: “Lord, I stand continually on the watchtower in the daytime, and every night I stay at my post.

hausa: Ya zo ya fāɗi a gaban Yesu, ya gode masa. Shi kuwa mutumin Samariya ne.
english: He fell on his face at Jesus’ feet, giving him thanks; and he was a Samaritan.

hausa: Zai jimre muddin rana tana nan, muddin akwai wata, har dukan zamanai.
english: They shall fear you while the sun endures; and as long as the moon, throughout all generations.

hausa: kada ku taurare zukatanku, yadda kuka yi a tawayen nan, a lokacin gwaji a hamada,
english: don’t harden your hearts as in the rebellion, in the day of the trial in the wilderness,

hausa: Ku ji maganar Ubangiji, ku da kuke rawar jiki ga maganarsa, “’Yan’uwanku da suke ƙinku, suna kuma ware ku saboda sunana, sun ce, ‘Bari a ɗaukaka Ubangiji, don mu ga farin cikinku!’ Duk da haka za su sha kunya.
english: Hear Yahweh’s word, you who tremble at his word: “Your brothers who hate you, who cast you out for my name’s sake, have said, ‘Let Yahweh be glorified, that we may see your joy;’ but it is those who shall be disappointed.

hausa: Wannan ya faru har sau uku, sai nan da nan aka ɗauke mayafin zuwa sama.
english: This was done three times, and immediately the thing was received up into heaven.

hausa: Elkana mijinta ya ce mata, “Ki yi abin da kika ga ya fi miki kyau. Ki jira har sai bayan kin yaye shi. Ubangiji dai ya cika maganarsa.” Saboda haka matar ta tsaya a gida, ta yi ta renon ɗanta har ta yaye shi.
english: Elkanah her husband said to her, “Do what seems good to you. Wait until you have weaned him; only may Yahweh establish his word.” So the woman waited and nursed her son until she weaned him.

hausa: In mutum rago ne, sai tsaiko yă lotsa, in hannuwansa ba masa yin kome, ɗaki yakan yi yoyo.
english: By slothfulness the roof sinks in; and through idleness of the hands the house leaks.

hausa: Na tuna da kwanakin baya na yi tunani a kan dukan ayyukanka na kuma lura da abin da hannuwanka suka yi.
english: I remember the days of old. I meditate on all your doings. I contemplate the work of your hands.

hausa: A ƙarƙashin shugabancinsu akwai mayaƙa 307,500 horarru don yaƙi, mayaƙa masu ƙarfi don su taimaki sarki a kan abokan gābansa.
english: Under their hand was an army, three hundred seven thousand five hundred, who made war with mighty power, to help the king against the enemy.

hausa: Gama babban firist da muke da shi ba marar juyayin kāsawarmu ba ne, amma muna da wanda aka gwada ta kowace hanya, kamar dai yadda akan yi mana, duk da haka bai yi zunubi ba.
english: For we don’t have a high priest who can’t be touched with the feeling of our infirmities, but one who has been in all points tempted like we are, yet without sin.

hausa: “Yanzu kuwa, ya Ubangiji Allah, ka cika alkawarin da ka yi game da bawanka da gidansa. Ka yi kamar yadda ka alkawarta,
english: “Now, Yahweh God, the word that you have spoken concerning your servant, and concerning his house, confirm it forever, and do as you have spoken.

hausa: Ni, Malami, sarki ne bisa Isra’ila a Urushalima.
english: I, the Preacher, was king over Israel in Jerusalem.

hausa: Sa’an nan ɗan’uwansa wanda yake da jan zare a hannunsa ya fito, aka kuma ba shi suna Zera.
english: Afterward his brother came out, who had the scarlet thread on his hand, and his name was called Zerah.

hausa: da kuma Asaf ’yan’uwan Heman, waɗanda suka yi hidima a hannun damansa. Asaf ɗan Berekiya, ɗan Shimeya,
english: His brother Asaph, who stood on his right hand, even Asaph the son of Berechiah, the son of Shimea,

hausa: Me ya sa ka yi annabci da sunan Ubangiji cewa wannan gida zai zama kamar Shilo, wannan birni kuma zai zama kango da hamada?” Sai duk mutane suka tattaru kewaye da Irmiya a cikin gidan Ubangiji.
english: Why have you prophesied in Yahweh’s name, saying, ‘This house will be like Shiloh, and this city will be desolate, without inhabitant’?” All the people were crowded around Jeremiah in Yahweh’s house.

hausa: “Tashi, ya takobi, gāba da makiyayina, mutumin da yake kusa da ni sosai!” In ji Ubangiji Maɗaukaki. “Kashe makiyayin, sai tumakin su watse, in kuma tayar wa ƙananan.
english: “Awake, sword, against my shepherd, and against the man who is close to me,” says Yahweh of Armies. “Strike the shepherd, and the sheep will be scattered; and I will turn my hand against the little ones.

hausa: Dukan sarakuna larduna, da hakimai, da gwamnoni da kuma ma’aikatan sarki suka taimaki Yahudawa, domin tsoron Mordekai ya kama su.
english: All the princes of the provinces, the local governors, the governors, and those who did the king’s business helped the Jews, because the fear of Mordecai had fallen on them.

hausa: Zai sassare itatuwan jeji da gatari har ƙasa; Lebanon zai fāɗi a gaban Mai Iko.
english: He will cut down the thickets of the forest with iron, and Lebanon will fall by the Mighty One.

hausa: Yayinda yake cikin magana, sai wani girgije ya bayyana ya rufe su, sai suka ji tsoro, yayinda suke shiga cikin girgijen.
english: While he said these things, a cloud came and overshadowed them, and they were afraid as they entered into the cloud.

hausa: Zan yi farin ciki a kan Urushalima in kuma yi murna saboda mutanena; a can ba za a ƙara jin karar makoki da na kuka ba.
english: I will rejoice in Jerusalem, and delight in my people; and the voice of weeping and the voice of crying will be heard in her no more.

hausa: Amma mutum yana mutuwa a bizne shi; daga ya ja numfashinsa na ƙarshe, shi ke nan.
english: But man dies, and is laid low. Yes, man gives up the spirit, and where is he?

hausa: Masu kiwon aladun kuwa suka ruga da gudu zuwa cikin gari da ƙauyuka, suka ba da wannan labari. Sai mutanen suka fito, domin su ga abin da ya faru.
english: Those who fed the pigs fled, and told it in the city and in the country. The people came to see what it was that had happened.

hausa: Sa’an nan ya komo wurin almajiransa, ya ce musu, “Har yanzu kuna barci kuna hutawa ba? Ga shi, sa’a ta yi kusa, an kuma bashe Ɗan Mutum a hannuwan masu zunubi.
english: Then he came to his disciples and said to them, “Are you still sleeping and resting? Behold, the hour is at hand, and the Son of Man is betrayed into the hands of sinners.

hausa: Shi wanda ya ba da kansa saboda zunubanmu don yă cece mu daga wannan mugun zamani na yanzu, bisa ga nufin Allah wanda yake kuma Ubanmu,
english: who gave himself for our sins, that he might deliver us out of this present evil age, according to the will of our God and Father—

hausa: Akwai Mai ba da doka da kuma Alƙali guda ɗaya tak, shi ne yake da ikon ceto da kuma hallakarwa. Amma kai, wane ne da za ka hukunta maƙwabcinka?
english: Only one is the lawgiver, who is able to save and to destroy. But who are you to judge another?

hausa: Yanzu mun san cewa hukuncin Allah a kan masu aikata waɗannan abubuwa daidai ne.
english: We know that the judgment of God is according to truth against those who practice such things.

hausa: Ashe, Rebeka tana ji sa’ad da Ishaku ya yi wa ɗansa Isuwa magana. Da Isuwa ya tafi jeji don yă farauto nama yă kawo,
english: Rebekah heard when Isaac spoke to Esau his son. Esau went to the field to hunt for venison, and to bring it.

hausa: Jimillar maza daga mutanen Yahuda 74,600 ne.
english: those who were counted of them, of the tribe of Judah, were seventy-four thousand six hundred.

hausa: Zan mai da ƙasar kango, kuma fariyar ƙarfinta zai ƙare, duwatsun Isra’ila za su zama kufai don kada wani ya ratsa su.
english: I will make the land a desolation and an astonishment. The pride of her power will cease. The mountains of Israel will be desolate, so that no one will pass through.

hausa: Wane ne shi, wannan Sarkin ɗaukaka? Ubangiji Maɗaukaki, shi ne Sarkin ɗaukaka. Sela
english: Who is this King of glory? Yahweh of Armies is the King of glory! Selah.

hausa: Yana mulki har abada ta wurin ikonsa, idanunsa suna duban al’ummai, kada ’yan tawaye su tayar masa. Sela
english: He rules by his might forever. His eyes watch the nations. Don’t let the rebellious rise up against him. Selah.

hausa: Shugabannin kuwa su ne, Shammuwa ɗan Zakkur, daga kabilar Ruben;
english: These were their names: Of the tribe of Reuben, Shammua the son of Zaccur.

hausa: Suka tambaye shi, suka ce, “Don me malaman dokoki suke cewa, sai Iliya ya fara zuwa?”
english: They asked him, saying, “Why do the scribes say that Elijah must come first?”

hausa: Fir’auna ya tambayi ’yan’uwan, “Mece ce sana’arku?” Suka amsa wa Fir’auna suka ce, “Bayinka makiyaya ne, kamar yadda kakanninmu suke.”
english: Pharaoh said to his brothers, “What is your occupation?” They said to Pharaoh, “Your servants are shepherds, both we, and our fathers.”

hausa: Bayan wahalarsa, ya bayyana kansa ga waɗannan mutane ya kuma ba da tabbatattun alamu masu yawa cewa yana da rai. Ya bayyana a gare su har kwana arba’in ya kuma yi musu magana game da mulkin Allah.
english: To these he also showed himself alive after he suffered, by many proofs, appearing to them over a period of forty days and speaking about God’s Kingdom.

hausa: Dawuda ya ce wa Akish, “Me na yi? Ka taɓa samun bawanka da laifi tun daga ranar da na zo har zuwa yanzu? Ina dalilin da ba zan tafi tare da kai in yaƙi maƙiyin ranka yă daɗe, sarki ba?”
english: David said to Achish, “But what have I done? What have you found in your servant so long as I have been before you to this day, that I may not go and fight against the enemies of my lord the king?”

hausa: Yau, ga ku nan tsaye, dukanku a gaban Ubangiji Allahnku, shugabanninku da manyan mutanenku, dattawanku da hafsoshinku, da kuma dukan sauran mutanen Isra’ila,
english: All of you stand today in the presence of Yahweh your God: your heads, your tribes, your elders, and your officers, even all the men of Israel,

hausa: Duk da haka, sa’ad da ina wa’azin bishara, ba na taƙama, domin tilas ne a gare ni in yi wa’azi. Kaitona, in ban yi wa’azin bishara ba!
english: For if I preach the Good News, I have nothing to boast about, for necessity is laid on me; but woe is to me if I don’t preach the Good News.

hausa: Ka fadada al’umma, ya Ubangiji; ka fadada al’umma. Ka samo wa kanka ɗaukaka; ka fadada dukan iyakokin ƙasar.
english: You have increased the nation, O Yahweh. You have increased the nation! You are glorified! You have enlarged all the borders of the land.

hausa: Ga abin da Ubangiji ya ce, “Saboda zunubai uku na Mowab, har guda huɗu ma, ba zan fasa hukunta su ba. Gama ya ƙone ƙasusuwan sarkin Edom suka zama sai ka ce toka.
english: Yahweh says: “For three transgressions of Moab, yes, for four, I will not turn away its punishment, because he burned the bones of the king of Edom into lime;

hausa: A can kuwa akwai wata mace, wadda ta yi shekaru goma sha biyu tana zub da jini.
english: A certain woman who had a discharge of blood for twelve years,

hausa: Sa’an nan ya ɗauki ɗansa na fari, wanda zai gāje shi, ya yi hadaya da shi a bisa katangan birnin. Isra’ilawa suka firgita ƙwarai; sai suka janye suka koma ƙasarsu.
english: Then he took his oldest son who would have reigned in his place, and offered him for a burnt offering on the wall. There was great wrath against Israel; and they departed from him, and returned to their own land.

hausa: Na duba, can gabana kuwa ga farin girgije, zaune kuma a kan girgijen kuwa ga wani da ya yi kamar “ɗan mutum” tare da rawanin zinariya a kansa da kuma lauje mai kaifi a hannunsa.
english: I looked, and saw a white cloud, and on the cloud one sitting like a son of man, having on his head a golden crown, and in his hand a sharp sickle.

hausa: Ben-Geber, shi ne a Ramot Gileyad (Mazaunan Yayir ɗan Manasse a Gileyad suna a ƙarƙashinsa, haka ma yankin Argob a Bashan tare da manyan biranen sittin masu katanga da suke da ƙyamare na tagulla);
english: Ben Geber, in Ramoth Gilead (the towns of Jair the son of Manasseh, which are in Gilead, belonged to him; and the region of Argob, which is in Bashan, sixty great cities with walls and bronze bars, belonged to him);

hausa: Game da sauran ayyukan mulkin Hezekiya, dukan nasarorinsa da yadda ya yi tafki da kuma bututun ruwa inda ya kawo ruwa cikin birni, duk a rubuce suke a cikin littafin tarihin sarakunan Yahuda.
english: Now the rest of the acts of Hezekiah, and all his might, and how he made the pool, and the conduit, and brought water into the city, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

hausa: Zan juye fuskata daga gare su, za su kuwa ƙazantar da wurina mai daraja; ’yan fashi za su shiga su kuma ƙazantar da shi.
english: I will also turn my face from them, and they will profane my secret place. Robbers will enter into it, and profane it.

hausa: Ku fito da lauje, gama girbi ya nuna. Ku zo, ku tattaka inabin, gama wurin matsewar ruwan inabi ya cika randunan tarawa kuma sun cika har suna zuba, muguntarsu da girma take!”
english: Put in the sickle; for the harvest is ripe. Come, tread, for the wine press is full, the vats overflow, for their wickedness is great.”

hausa: Da sojojin suka gicciye Yesu, sai suka ɗibi tufafinsa suka kasa kashi huɗu, kowanne ya ɗauki kashi ɗaya. Suka kuma ɗauki taguwarsa, taguwar kuwa ba ɗinki, saƙa ɗaya ce gudanta daga sama har ƙasa.
english: Then the soldiers, when they had crucified Jesus, took his garments and made four parts, to every soldier a part; and also the tunic. Now the tunic was without seam, woven from the top throughout.

hausa: Batsheba ta rusuna ta kuma durƙusa a gaban sarki. Sai sarki ya tambaye ta ya ce, “Me kike so?”
english: Bathsheba bowed and showed respect to the king. The king said, “What would you like?”

hausa: Yoshuwa kuwa ya aika aka kira Gibeyonawa ya ce musu, “Don me kuka ruɗe mu kuka ce, ‘Mun zo ne daga wuri mai nisa,’ bayan kuwa kuna nan kurkusa da mu?
english: Joshua called for them, and he spoke to them, saying, “Why have you deceived us, saying, ‘We are very far from you,’ when you live among us?

hausa: Amma a shekara ta biyar, za ku iya cin ’ya’yan itatuwan. Ta haka girbinku zai ƙaru. Ni ne Ubangiji Allahnku.
english: In the fifth year you shall eat its fruit, that it may yield its increase to you. I am Yahweh your God.

hausa: “ ‘Duk wanda ya kashe mutum, dole a kashe shi.
english: “‘He who strikes any man mortally shall surely be put to death.

hausa: Ku daina kawo hadayu marasa amfani! Turarenku abin ƙyama ne gare ni. Ina ƙin bukukkuwanku na Sabon Wata, da na ranakun Asabbaci, da taronku na addini, ba zan iya jure wa mugun taronku ba.
english: Bring no more vain offerings. Incense is an abomination to me. New moons, Sabbaths, and convocations— I can’t stand evil assemblies.

hausa: Ba’ana ɗan Ahilud, shi ne a Ta’anak da Megiddo, da kuma dukan Bet-Sheyan biye da Zaretan ƙasa da Yezireyel, daga Bet-Sheyan zuwa Abel-Mehola a ƙetaren Yokmeyam;
english: Baana the son of Ahilud, in Taanach and Megiddo, and all Beth Shean which is beside Zarethan, beneath Jezreel, from Beth Shean to Abel Meholah, as far as beyond Jokmeam;

hausa: Hikima ta fi kayan yaƙi, amma mai zunubi ɗaya yakan rushe alheri mai yawa.
english: Wisdom is better than weapons of war; but one sinner destroys much good.

hausa: Da suka ji haka, sai suka yi mamaki. Saboda haka suka ƙyale shi, suka yi tafiyarsu.
english: When they heard it, they marveled, and left him and went away.

hausa: Kai ne rabona, ya Ubangiji; na yi alkawarin in kiyaye maganarka.
english: Yahweh is my portion. I promised to obey your words.

hausa: Sai hamayya ta taso daga ’yan ƙungiyar Majami’a na ’Yantattu (kamar yadda ake kiransu), Yahudawan Sairin da Alekzandariya da kuma lardunan Silisiya da Asiya. Mutanen nan suka fara muhawwara da Istifanus,
english: But some of those who were of the synagogue called “The Libertines”, and of the Cyrenians, of the Alexandrians, and of those of Cilicia and Asia arose, disputing with Stephen.

hausa: “Sa’ad da Mai Taimako ya zo, wanda zan aiko muku daga wurin Uba, Ruhun gaskiya wanda yake fitowa daga wurin Uba, zai ba da shaida game da ni.
english: “When the Counselor has come, whom I will send to you from the Father, the Spirit of truth, who proceeds from the Father, he will testify about me.

hausa: Sai Liyatu ta ce, “Allah ya ba ni kyauta mai daraja. A wannan lokaci mijina zai darajarta ni, domin na haifa masa ’ya’ya maza shida.” Saboda haka ta ba shi suna Zebulun.
english: Leah said, “God has endowed me with a good dowry. Now my husband will live with me, because I have borne him six sons.” She named him Zebulun.

hausa: Ya Ubangiji, ka ji muryata. Bari kunnuwanka su saurara ga kukata ta neman jinƙai.
english: Lord, hear my voice. Let your ears be attentive to the voice of my petitions.

hausa: Ubangiji yana riƙe da dukan waɗanda suka faɗi yana kuma ɗaga dukan waɗanda aka rusunar da su ƙasa.
english: Yahweh upholds all who fall, and raises up all those who are bowed down.

hausa: Zan kawo wa wannan ƙasa dukan abubuwan na yi magana a kanta, dukan abubuwan da aka rubuta a wannan littafi, abubuwan da Irmiya kuma ya yi annabci a kan dukan al’ummai.
english: I will bring on that land all my words which I have pronounced against it, even all that is written in this book, which Jeremiah has prophesied against all the nations.

hausa: Sai Filibus ya je ya gaya wa Andarawus, Andarawus da kuma Filibus suka gaya wa Yesu.
english: Philip came and told Andrew, and in turn, Andrew came with Philip, and they told Jesus.

hausa: wanda ya yi ƙoƙari yă kwanta a gajeren gado, yă kuma rufa da ɗan siririn bargo.
english: For the bed is too short to stretch out on, and the blanket is too narrow to wrap oneself in.

hausa: Ka faɗa wa sarki da kuma mahaifiyar sarauniya cewa, “Ku sauko daga kursiyinku, gama rawaninku na ɗaukaka za su fāɗi daga kawunanku.”
english: Say to the king and to the queen mother, “Humble yourselves. Sit down, for your crowns have come down, even the crown of your glory.

hausa: Ubangiji Allahnku kansa zai kore su a madadinku. Zai fafare su a gabanku, za ku kuwa mallaki ƙasarsu, yadda Ubangiji Allah ya yi muku alkawari.
english: Yahweh your God will thrust them out from before you, and drive them from out of your sight. You shall possess their land, as Yahweh your God spoke to you.

hausa: Ta haka zan tsai da marmari da kuma karuwancin da kika fara a Masar. Ba za ki dubi waɗannan abubuwa da marmari ko ki ƙara tuna da Masar ba.
english: Thus I will make your lewdness to cease from you, and remove your prostitution from the land of Egypt, so that you will not lift up your eyes to them, nor remember Egypt any more.’

hausa: Sai aka ba da dokar da za a kashe masu hikima, sa’an nan aka aika mutane su je su nemo Daniyel da abokansa domin a kashe su.
english: So the decree went out, and the wise men were to be slain. They sought Daniel and his companions to be slain.

hausa: Ka guji mugunta, kada ka yi tafiya a kanta; juya daga gare ta ka yi tafiyarka.
english: Avoid it, and don’t pass by it. Turn from it, and pass on.

hausa: Sa’an nan suka ɗauko abin da Mika ya yi, da firist nasa, suka tafi Layish, suka fāɗa wa mutanen da suke zaman lafiya, ransu kuma a kwance. Suka fāɗa musu suka kuma ƙone birninsu.
english: They took that which Micah had made, and the priest whom he had, and came to Laish, to a people quiet and unsuspecting, and struck them with the edge of the sword; then they burned the city with fire.

hausa: ku da kuke ƙin abu mai kyau kuke ƙaunar mugunta, ku da kuke feɗe mutanena kuke tuge nama daga ƙasusuwansu;
english: You who hate the good, and love the evil; who tear off their skin, and their flesh from off their bones;

hausa: Shanun nan da suke munana ramammu, suka cinye shanu bakwai nan masu ƙiba mulmul. Sai Fir’auna ya farka.
english: The ugly and thin cattle ate up the seven sleek and fat cattle. So Pharaoh awoke.

hausa: kafin a kafa duwatsu a wurarensu, kafin tuddai ma, an haife ni,
english: Before the mountains were settled in place, before the hills, I was born;

hausa: Sukan ƙarfafa juna a mugayen ƙulle-ƙullensu, sukan yi magana yadda za su ɓoye tarkunansu; su ce, “Wa zai gan su?”
english: They encourage themselves in evil plans. They talk about laying snares secretly. They say, “Who will see them?”

hausa: Wanda yake ragwanci a aikinsa ɗan’uwa ne ga wanda yakan lalatar da abubuwa.
english: One who is slack in his work is brother to him who is a master of destruction.

hausa: Dole mai zafin rai yă biya tara; in ka fisshe shi sau ɗaya, to, sai ka sāke yin haka.
english: A hot-tempered man must pay the penalty, for if you rescue him, you must do it again.

hausa: Dawuda ya tattara mutanen da suke tare da shi, ya naɗa musu komandodi na dubu-dubu, da na ɗari-ɗari.
english: David counted the people who were with him, and set captains of thousands and captains of hundreds over them.

hausa: A can kan dutsen da ka hau za ka mutu a kuma tara ka ga mutanenka, kamar yadda ɗan’uwanka Haruna ya mutu a Dutsen Hor aka kuma tara shi ga mutanensa.
english: Die on the mountain where you go up, and be gathered to your people, as Aaron your brother died on Mount Hor, and was gathered to his people;

hausa: Suka kuma albarkaci Rebeka suka ce mata, “’Yar’uwarmu, bari ki zama mahaifiyar dubu dubbai, bari zuriyarki su mallaki ƙofofin abokan gābansu.”
english: They blessed Rebekah, and said to her, “Our sister, may you be the mother of thousands of ten thousands, and let your offspring possess the gate of those who hate them.”

hausa: “ ‘Duk da haka mutanen Isra’ila suka yi mini tawaye a cikin hamada. Ba su bi ƙa’idodina ba amma suka ki dokokina, ko da yake mutumin da ya yi biyayya da su zai rayu ta wurinsu, suka ɓata Asabbataina ƙwarai. Saboda haka na ce zan zuba hasalata a kansu in kuma hallaka su a hamada.
english: “‘“But the house of Israel rebelled against me in the wilderness. They didn’t walk in my statutes and they rejected my ordinances, which if a man keeps, he shall live in them. They greatly profaned my Sabbaths. Then I said I would pour out my wrath on them in the wilderness, to consume them.

hausa: “Ni, Yesu, na aiko mala’ikana ya ba ka wannan shaida saboda ikkilisiyoyi. Ni ne Tushe da kuma Zuriyar Dawuda, da kuma Tauraron Asubahi mai haske.”
english: I, Jesus, have sent my angel to testify these things to you for the assemblies. I am the root and the offspring of David, the Bright and Morning Star.”

hausa: Amma a kan Dutsen Sihiyona za a sami ceto; Dutsen zai zama mai tsarki, gidan Yaƙub kuma zai mallaki gādonsa.
english: But in Mount Zion, there will be those who escape, and it will be holy. The house of Jacob will possess their possessions.

hausa: Duka-duka, garuruwan iyalan Gershonawa goma sha uku ne, tare da wuraren kiwonsu.
english: All the cities of the Gershonites according to their families were thirteen cities with their pasture lands.

hausa: Tun ina yaro, ya Allah, ka koya mini har wa yau ina furta ayyukanka masu banmamaki.
english: God, you have taught me from my youth. Until now, I have declared your wondrous works.

hausa: Musa ya bayyana adalcin da yake ga Doka cewa, “Mutumin da ya aikata waɗannan abubuwa zai rayu ta wurinsu.”
english: For Moses writes about the righteousness of the law, “The one who does them will live by them.”

hausa: an ɗauke shi ne zuwa aljanna. Ya ji waɗansu abubuwa waɗanda ba zai iya faɗarsu da kalmomi ba, abubuwan da ba a ba wa mutum damar faɗi.
english: how he was caught up into Paradise and heard unspeakable words, which it is not lawful for a man to utter.

hausa: Suka ɗaura zoban ƙyallen maƙalawa a ƙirjin a zoban efod da shuɗiyar igiya don ƙyallen maƙalawa a ƙirji, ya kwanta lif a bisa kan abin ɗamarar efod don kada yă kunce daga efod, sun yi yadda Ubangiji ya umarci Musa.
english: They bound the breastplate by its rings to the rings of the ephod with a lace of blue, that it might be on the skillfully woven band of the ephod, and that the breastplate might not come loose from the ephod, as Yahweh commanded Moses.

hausa: Zai kai wa kagarai mafi ƙarfi hari da taimakon baƙon allah zai kuma girmama waɗanda suka yarda da shi zai ba su girma, ya kuma shugabantar da su a kan mutane da yawa, zai raba musu ƙasa ta zama ladansu.
english: He will deal with the strongest fortresses by the help of a foreign god. He will increase with glory whoever acknowledges him. He will cause them to rule over many, and will divide the land for a price.

hausa: An ka da Efraim, saiwarsu ta bushe, ba sa ba da amfani. Ko da sun haifi ’ya’ya zan kashe waɗanda suka fi ƙauna.”
english: Ephraim is struck. Their root has dried up. They will bear no fruit. Even though they give birth, yet I will kill the beloved ones of their womb.”

hausa: Sa’an nan zai shafe mayaƙa masu yawa a gabansa; zai hallaka har da waɗanda suke mulki na alkawari.
english: The overwhelming forces will be overwhelmed from before him, and will be broken. Yes, also the prince of the covenant.

hausa: Za su yi wa Haruna da dukan al’umma aikace-aikace a Tentin Sujada, ta wurin yin aikin tabanakul.
english: They shall keep his requirements, and the requirements of the whole congregation before the Tent of Meeting, to do the service of the tabernacle.

hausa: Kada kuma ku manta yin aikin nagari da kuma taimakon waɗansu, gama da irin waɗannan hadayu ne Allah yake jin daɗi.
english: But don’t forget to be doing good and sharing, for with such sacrifices God is well pleased.

hausa: Rabbat, Kishiyon, Ebez,
english: Rabbith, Kishion, Ebez,

hausa: Daga bisani sai Musa da Haruna suka tafi wurin Fir’auna suka ce, “Ga abin da Ubangiji, Allah na Isra’ila ya ce, ‘Bari mutanena su tafi domin su yi mini biki a hamada.’ ”
english: Afterward Moses and Aaron came, and said to Pharaoh, “This is what Yahweh, the God of Israel, says, ‘Let my people go, that they may hold a feast to me in the wilderness.’”

hausa: A ranar zan cika dukan maganar da na yi game da Eli da iyalinsa, daga farko har ƙarshe.
english: In that day I will perform against Eli all that I have spoken concerning his house, from the beginning even to the end.

hausa: Bayan an ɗauke Amasa daga hanya, sai dukan mutane suka bi Yowab don fafaran Sheba ɗan Bikri.
english: When he was removed out of the highway, all the people went on after Joab to pursue Sheba the son of Bichri.

hausa: A rana ta bakwai, za ku yi tsattsarkan taro, amma ba za a yi aikin da aka saba yi kullum ba.
english: On the seventh day you shall have a holy convocation. You shall do no regular work.

hausa: Ƙasa tana kuka an kuma gudu an bar ta, Lebanon ta sha kunya ta kuma yanƙwane; Sharon ta zama kamar Araba, Bashan da Karmel sun kakkaɓe ganyayensu.
english: The land mourns and languishes. Lebanon is confounded and withers away. Sharon is like a desert, and Bashan and Carmel are stripped bare.

hausa: Ubangiji ya taurare zuciyar Fir’auna sarkin Masar, domin yă bi Isra’ilawa waɗanda suke tafiya ba tsoro.
english: Yahweh hardened the heart of Pharaoh king of Egypt, and he pursued the children of Israel; for the children of Israel went out with a high hand.

hausa: Sa’ad da Musa ya nemi sani game da akuyar hadaya don zunubi, ya kuwa gane cewa an ƙone shi, sai ya yi fushi da Eleyazar da kuma Itamar, ’ya’yan Haruna maza da suka ragu, ya kuma yi tambaya,
english: Moses diligently inquired about the goat of the sin offering, and, behold, it was burned. He was angry with Eleazar and with Ithamar, the sons of Aaron who were left, saying,

hausa: Amma da gangan suke manta cewa tun dā can ta wurin maganar Allah sammai suka kasance aka kuma yi ƙasa daga ruwa ta wurin ruwa kuma.
english: For they willfully forget that there were heavens from of old, and an earth formed out of water and amid water by the word of God,

hausa: A waɗancan kwanakin Bitrus ya miƙe tsaye cikin ’yan’uwa masu bi (taron da ya yi kusan mutum ɗari da ashirin)
english: In these days, Peter stood up in the middle of the disciples (and the number of names was about one hundred twenty), and said,

hausa: Suka amsa suka ce, “Ubangiji ne na bukatarsa.”
english: They said, “The Lord needs it.”

hausa: Ya ku mutanena, ku tuna abin da Balak sarkin Mowab ya ƙulla da kuma amsar da Bala’am ɗan Beyor ya bayar. Ku tuna da tafiyarku daga Shittim zuwa Gilgal, don ku san ayyukan adalcin Ubangiji.”
english: My people, remember now what Balak king of Moab devised, and what Balaam the son of Beor answered him from Shittim to Gilgal, that you may know the righteous acts of Yahweh.”

hausa: Waɗannan su ne ’ya’yan Seyir Bahore maza, waɗanda suke zaune a yankin, Lotan, Shobal, Zibeyon, Ana,
english: These are the sons of Seir the Horite, the inhabitants of the land: Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah,

hausa: Amma ba wanda ya ce kome a fili game da shi don tsoron Yahudawa.
english: Yet no one spoke openly of him for fear of the Jews.

hausa: “Kai kuma ɗana Solomon, ka san Allah na mahaifinka, ka kuma yi masa hidima da dukan zuciya da kuma yardar rai, gama Ubangiji yana binciken zuciya, yana kuma gane dukan aniyar tunani. In ka neme shi, za ka same shi; amma in ka yashe shi, zai ƙi ka har abada.
english: You, Solomon my son, know the God of your father, and serve him with a perfect heart and with a willing mind; for Yahweh searches all hearts, and understands all the imaginations of the thoughts. If you seek him, he will be found by you; but if you forsake him, he will cast you off forever.

hausa: Sai Balak ya ce wa Bala’am, “Kada ka la’anta su, kada kuma ka sa musu albarka!”
english: Balak said to Balaam, “Neither curse them at all, nor bless them at all.”

hausa: Gama dā kuna kama da tumakin da suka ɓace, amma yanzu kun dawo ga Makiyayi da kuma Mai lura da rayukanku.
english: For you were going astray like sheep; but now you have returned to the Shepherd and Overseer of your souls.

hausa: Abishai ɗan Zeruhiya ya bugi mutanen Edom dubu goma sha takwas a Kwarin Gishiri.
english: Moreover Abishai the son of Zeruiah struck eighteen thousand of the Edomites in the Valley of Salt.

hausa: Amma wata matalauciya gwauruwa, ta zo ta saka anini biyu, da suka yi daidai da rabin kobo.
english: A poor widow came and she cast in two small brass coins, which equal a quadrans coin.

hausa: amma muka kasance masu sauƙinkai a cikinku, kamar yadda mahaifiya take lura da ƙananan ’ya’yanta.
english: But we were gentle among you, like a nursing mother cherishes her own children.

hausa: Elifaz ɗan Isuwa kuma yana da ƙwarƙwara mai suna Timna, wadda ta haifa masa Amalek. Waɗannan su ne jikokin Ada matar Isuwa.
english: Timna was concubine to Eliphaz, Esau’s son; and she bore to Eliphaz Amalek. These are the descendants of Adah, Esau’s wife.

hausa: Gama da a ce masu kiyaye doka ne magāda, ai, da bangaskiya ba ta da amfani, alkawarin kuma ya zama banza,
english: For if those who are of the law are heirs, faith is made void, and the promise is made of no effect.

hausa: Saboda haka suka kawar da dutsen. Sa’an nan Yesu ya dubi sama ya ce, “Uba, na gode maka da ka saurare ni.
english: So they took away the stone from the place where the dead man was lying. Jesus lifted up his eyes and said, “Father, I thank you that you listened to me.

hausa: Da abokan gābanmu suka ji muna sane da shirinsu, Allah kuma ya wargaje shirin nan, sai duk muka dawo ga katangar, kowa ya kama aikinsa.
english: When our enemies heard that it was known to us, and God had brought their counsel to nothing, all of us returned to the wall, everyone to his work.

hausa: Ubangiji ne yake bi da matakan mutum, Ta yaya wani zai fahimci hanyarsa?
english: A man’s steps are from Yahweh; how then can man understand his way?

hausa: Da Abram ya ji cewa an kama danginsa, sai ya tara horarrun mutane 318, da aka haifa a gidansa, ya bi sawun sarakunan da suka tafi da Lot, har Dan.
english: When Abram heard that his relative was taken captive, he led out his three hundred eighteen trained men, born in his house, and pursued as far as Dan.

hausa: Gare ku duk wannan wahayi ba kome ba ne sai dai maganganun da aka rufe a cikin littafi. In kuma kun ba da littafin ga wani wanda zai iya karanta, kuka kuma ce masa, “Karanta wannan, muna roƙonka,” zai amsa ya ce, “Ba zan iya ba; an rufe shi.”
english: All vision has become to you like the words of a book that is sealed, which men deliver to one who is educated, saying, “Read this, please;” and he says, “I can’t, for it is sealed;”

hausa: Ashe, rashin azancinku har ya kai ga haka? Bayan kun fara da Ruhu, a yanzu kuma da halin mutuntaka za ku ƙarasa?
english: Are you so foolish? Having begun in the Spirit, are you now completed in the flesh?

hausa: Bayan da suka tashi daga Refidim, suka shiga Hamadar Sinai, sai Isra’ilawa suka yi sansani a gaban dutsen.
english: When they had departed from Rephidim, and had come to the wilderness of Sinai, they encamped in the wilderness; and there Israel encamped before the mountain.

hausa: Amma fa, in kuka sha wahala a matsayin ku Kirista ne, kada ku ji kunya, sai dai ku yabi Allah cewa kuna amsa wannan suna.
english: But if one of you suffers for being a Christian, let him not be ashamed; but let him glorify God in this matter.

hausa: A rana ta uku, da ta bakwai kuma mai tsarkakewa zai yayyafa wa marar tsarkin ruwa, a rana ta bakwai kuma yă tsarkake shi. Wanda aka tsarkaken kuwa, dole yă wanke rigunarsa, yă kuma yi wanka da yamma, zai kuma tsarkaka.
english: The clean person shall sprinkle on the unclean on the third day, and on the seventh day. On the seventh day, he shall purify him. He shall wash his clothes and bathe himself in water, and shall be clean at evening.

hausa: “Sa’an nan, mutane za su ga Ɗan Mutum yana zuwa cikin gizagizai da iko, da ɗaukaka mai girma.
english: Then they will see the Son of Man coming in clouds with great power and glory.

hausa: Sai na ji ƙara daga sama kamar motsin ruwaye masu gudu, kamar kuma tsawa. Ƙarar da na ji ta yi kamar ta masu garaya da suke kiɗin garayarsu.
english: I heard a sound from heaven like the sound of many waters and like the sound of a great thunder. The sound which I heard was like that of harpists playing on their harps.

hausa: Yesu ya hau gefen wani dutse, ya kira waɗanda yake so, suka kuma zo wurinsa.
english: He went up into the mountain and called to himself those whom he wanted, and they went to him.

hausa: Ashe, bai ishe ku ba, cewa Allah na Isra’ila, ya keɓe ku daga sauran jama’ar Isra’ilawa, ya kuma kawo ku kusa da shi don ku yi aiki a tabanakul na Ubangiji, ku kuma tsaya a gaba jama’a don ku yi musu aiki?
english: Is it a small thing to you that the God of Israel has separated you from the congregation of Israel, to bring you near to himself, to do the service of Yahweh’s tabernacle, and to stand before the congregation to minister to them;

hausa: Amma wata rana da dad dare Allah ya zo wa Abimelek a cikin mafarki ya ce masa, “Kai da matacce ɗaya kuke, saboda matar da ka ɗauka. Ita matar aure ce.”
english: But God came to Abimelech in a dream of the night, and said to him, “Behold, you are a dead man, because of the woman whom you have taken; for she is a man’s wife.”

hausa: Da ya tashi daga addu’a, ya koma inda almajiransa suke, sai ya iske su suna barci, daga gajiyar baƙin ciki.
english: When he rose up from his prayer, he came to the disciples and found them sleeping because of grief,

hausa: duhu ma ba zai zama duhu gare ka ba; dare zai haskaka kamar rana, gama duhu ya yi kamar haske gare ka.
english: even the darkness doesn’t hide from you, but the night shines as the day. The darkness is like light to you.

hausa: Gama babu wani wanda ya taɓa nuna iko mai ƙarfi, ko yă aikata ayyukan banrazana waɗanda Musa ya yi a gaban dukan Isra’ila.
english: and in all the mighty hand, and in all the awesome deeds, which Moses did in the sight of all Israel.

hausa: Lalaci marar ƙarewa ya cimma abokan gābanmu, ka tuttumɓuke biranensu; yadda ma ba aka ƙara tunaninsu.
english: The enemy is overtaken by endless ruin. The very memory of the cities which you have overthrown has perished.

hausa: Sa’an nan ka sa Shaidar da zan ba ka, a cikin akwatin.
english: You shall put the covenant which I shall give you into the ark.

hausa: “Ga abin da Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka yana cewa sa’ad da na maishe ki kufai, kamar sauran biranen da ba a ƙara zama a ciki, sa’ad da kuma na kawo zurfafan teku a kanki da yawan ruwansa suka rufe ki,
english: “For the Lord Yahweh says: ‘When I make you a desolate city, like the cities that are not inhabited, when I bring up the deep on you, and the great waters cover you,

hausa: Duk wannan kuwa ya faru da sarki Nebukadnezzar.
english: All this came on the King Nebuchadnezzar.

hausa: daga kabilar Yahuda, Nashon ɗan Amminadab;
english: Of Judah: Nahshon the son of Amminadab.

hausa: Abin da Allah ya faɗa game da Duma, Wani ya kira ni daga Seyir, “Mai tsaro, me ya rage a daren? Mai tsaro, me ya rage a daren?”
english: The burden of Dumah. One calls to me out of Seir, “Watchman, what of the night? Watchman, what of the night?”

hausa: Gama an ba ku zarafi a madadin Kiristi cewa ba gaskatawa da shi kaɗai ba kuka yi ba, har ma ku sha wahala dominsa,
english: Because it has been granted to you on behalf of Christ, not only to believe in him, but also to suffer on his behalf,

hausa: Suka amsa suka ce, “Ka bar ɗayanmu yă zauna a damarka, ɗayan kuma a hagunka, a cikin ɗaukakarka.”
english: They said to him, “Grant to us that we may sit, one at your right hand and one at your left hand, in your glory.”

hausa: remaye halittu ne da ba su da ƙarfi sosai, duk da haka sukan yi gidajensu a duwatsu;
english: The hyraxes are but a feeble folk, yet make they their houses in the rocks.

hausa: Sa’an nan Isra’ila ya shiga Masar; Yaƙub ya yi zama kamar baƙo a ƙasar Ham.
english: Israel also came into Egypt. Jacob lived in the land of Ham.

hausa: Kai kuwa, don me kake ganin laifin ɗan’uwanka? Ko kuma don me kake rena ɗan’uwanka? Gama duk za mu tsaya a gaban kujerar shari’ar Allah.
english: But you, why do you judge your brother? Or you again, why do you despise your brother? For we will all stand before the judgment seat of Christ.

hausa: Suka ratsa cikin Yahuda suka tattara Lawiyawa da shugabannin iyalan Isra’ilawa daga dukan garuruwa. Sa’ad da suka zo Urushalima,
english: They went around in Judah and gathered the Levites out of all the cities of Judah, and the heads of fathers’ households of Israel, and they came to Jerusalem.

hausa: Ya kuma yi tukwane da manyan cokula da kwanonin yayyafawa. Ta haka Huram ya gama aikin da ya yi wa Sarki Solomon a cikin haikalin Allah.
english: Huram made the pots, the shovels, and the basins. So Huram finished doing the work that he did for King Solomon in God’s house:

hausa: Da ta kama hanya za tă tafi tă kawo, sai ya sāke kiranta ya ce, “Ina roƙonki, ki kuma kawo mini ɗan abinci.”
english: As she was going to get it, he called to her and said, “Please bring me a morsel of bread in your hand.”

hausa: Ta haka, ya zama sananne ga dukan masu gadin fada da kuma ga kowa cewa an daure ni da sarƙoƙi saboda Kiristi.
english: so that it became evident to the whole palace guard, and to all the rest, that my bonds are in Christ,

hausa: Sa’an nan dukan mutanen Yahuda suka ɗauki Azariya, wanda yake ɗan shekaru goma sha shida da haihuwa, suka naɗa shi sarki a madadin mahaifinsa Amaziya.
english: All the people of Judah took Azariah, who was sixteen years old, and made him king in the place of his father Amaziah.

hausa: Sa’ad da aka sanar da shi game da zunubin da ya yi, dole yă kawo bunsuru marar lahani a matsayin hadayarsa.
english: if his sin in which he has sinned is made known to him, he shall bring as his offering a goat, a male without defect.

hausa: Sai ka tashi, gama wannan hakkinka ne, za mu ba ka goyon baya. Saboda haka ka yi ƙarfin hali ka aikata shi.”
english: Arise, for the matter belongs to you and we are with you. Be courageous, and do it.”

hausa: A kan tudu, gabas da Urushalima, Solomon ya gina masujada a can domin Kemosh, allahn da aka hana na Mowab, da Molek, allahn da aka hana na Ammonawa.
english: Then Solomon built a high place for Chemosh the abomination of Moab, on the mountain that is before Jerusalem, and for Molech the abomination of the children of Ammon.

hausa: Amma yanzu an cika ka da hukuncin da ya kamata a yi wa mugaye; shari’a da kuma gaskiya sun kama ka.
english: “But you are full of the judgment of the wicked. Judgment and justice take hold of you.

hausa: Ubangiji yana cikin haikalinsa mai tsarki; Ubangiji yana a kursiyinsa a sama. Yana kallon ’ya’yan mutane; idanunsa suna bincike su.
english: Yahweh is in his holy temple. Yahweh is on his throne in heaven. His eyes observe. His eyes examine the children of men.

hausa: Na dubi duniya, na ga cewa marar siffa ce babu kome; sammai kuma, haskensu ya tafi.
english: I saw the earth and, behold, it was waste and void, and the heavens, and they had no light.

hausa: A shekara ta bakwai Yehohiyada ya nuna ƙarfinsa. Ya yi alkawari da shugabanni na ɗari-ɗari, Azariya ɗan Yeroham, Ishmayel ɗan Yehohanan, Azariya ɗan Obed, Ma’asehiya ɗan Adahiya, da Elishafat ɗan Zikri.
english: In the seventh year, Jehoiada strengthened himself, and took the captains of hundreds—Azariah the son of Jeroham, Ishmael the son of Jehohanan, Azariah the son of Obed, Maaseiah the son of Adaiah, and Elishaphat the son of Zichri—into a covenant with him.

hausa: Kamar sababbin jarirai, ku yi marmarin madara zalla ta ruhaniya, domin ta wurinta za ku yi girma cikin cetonku,
english: as newborn babies, long for the pure spiritual milk, that with it you may grow,

hausa: Sa’an nan Fir’auna ya ce wa Yusuf, “A cikin mafarkina, na ga ina tsaye a bakin Nilu,
english: Pharaoh spoke to Joseph, “In my dream, behold, I stood on the brink of the river;

hausa: Kabilar Yahuda za su yi sansani bisa ga ƙa’idarsu a gabas, wajen fitowar rana. Shugaban mutanen Yahuda kuwa shi ne Nashon ɗan Amminadab.
english: “Those who encamp on the east side toward the sunrise shall be of the standard of the camp of Judah, according to their divisions. The prince of the children of Judah shall be Nahshon the son of Amminadab.

hausa: Ku tuna da kwanakin dā, ku tuna da tsararrakin da suka wuce tun tuni, Ku tambayi iyayenku, za su faɗa muku, dattawanku, za su kuma bayyana muku.
english: Remember the days of old. Consider the years of many generations. Ask your father, and he will show you; your elders, and they will tell you.

hausa: Saboda haka sarkin Isra’ila ya tattara annabawa duka, mutane ɗari huɗu, ya kuma tambaye su, “Mu tafi yaƙi a kan Ramot Gileyad ko kada mu tafi?” Suka amsa “Tafi, gama Allah zai ba da shi cikin hannun sarki.”
english: Then the king of Israel gathered the prophets together, four hundred men, and said to them, “Shall we go to Ramoth Gilead to battle, or shall I forbear?” They said, “Go up, for God will deliver it into the hand of the king.”

hausa: Solomon ya amsa ya ce, “Ka nuna alheri mai girma ga bawanka, mahaifina Dawuda domin ya yi aminci gare ka da adalci, ya kuma kasance da zuciya mai gaskiya. Ka ci gaba da wannan alheri mai girma gare shi, ka ba shi ɗa don yă zauna a kujerar sarautarsa a wannan rana.
english: Solomon said, “You have shown to your servant David my father great loving kindness, because he walked before you in truth, in righteousness, and in uprightness of heart with you. You have kept for him this great loving kindness, that you have given him a son to sit on his throne, as it is today.

hausa: Yohanan ɗan Kareya da dukan manyan sojoji da suke a karkara suka zo wurin Gedaliya a Mizfa
english: Moreover Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the captains of the forces who were in the fields, came to Gedaliah to Mizpah,

hausa: Masarawa suka bi su da dukan dawakan Fir’auna, da kekunan yaƙi, da mahayan, suka bi su cikin teku.
english: The Egyptians pursued, and went in after them into the middle of the sea: all of Pharaoh’s horses, his chariots, and his horsemen.

hausa: Ka ɗauki bakwai na kowace iri tsabtaccen dabba tare da kai, namiji da ta mace, da kuma biyu na kowace dabba marar tsabta, namiji da ta mace,
english: You shall take seven pairs of every clean animal with you, the male and his female. Of the animals that are not clean, take two, the male and his female.

hausa: Shekara goma sha biyu suna bauta wa Kedorlayomer, amma a shekara ta sha uku sai suka yi tawaye.
english: They served Chedorlaomer for twelve years, and in the thirteenth year they rebelled.

hausa: In mutum ya sadu da budurwa a gari wadda aka yi alkawarin aure, ya kuma kwana da ita
english: If there is a young lady who is a virgin pledged to be married to a husband, and a man finds her in the city, and lies with her,

hausa: Dole a kashe wannan annabi ko mai mafarki, domin ya yi wa’azin tawaye ga Ubangiji Allahnku, wanda ya fitar da ku daga Masar, ya fanshe ku daga ƙasar bauta; gama annabin nan ya yi ƙoƙari yă juye daga hanyar da Ubangiji Allahnku ya umarce ku, ku bi. Dole ku fid da mugu daga cikinku.
english: That prophet, or that dreamer of dreams, shall be put to death, because he has spoken rebellion against Yahweh your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt and redeemed you out of the house of bondage, to draw you aside out of the way which Yahweh your God commanded you to walk in. So you shall remove the evil from among you.

hausa: Wannan ya zama zunubi, gama mutane suna tafiya yin wa wannan da yake a Betel sujada, su kuma je har Dan don su yi wa ɗayan sujada.
english: This thing became a sin, for the people went even as far as Dan to worship before the one there.

hausa: A ranan nan ba za a kasance da haske ko sanyi ba, ko hazo mai duhu ba.
english: It will happen in that day that there will not be light, cold, or frost.

hausa: Za ka zauna lafiya a cikin tenti naka, za ka ƙirga kayanka za ka samu kome na nan.
english: You will know that your tent is in peace. You will visit your fold, and will miss nothing.

hausa: In saboda ƙiyayya, mutum ya laɓe, ya soke wani, ko ya jefe shi da wani abu da gangan har ya mutu,
english: If he shoved him out of hatred, or hurled something at him while lying in wait, so that he died,

hausa: Bari dukan sarakunan duniya su yabe ka, ya Ubangiji, sa’ad da suka ji maganganun bakinka.
english: All the kings of the earth will give you thanks, Yahweh, for they have heard the words of your mouth.

hausa: Kada ka ce, “Me ya sa kwanakin dā sun fi waɗannan?” Gama ba daidai ba ne a yi irin waɗannan tambayoyi.
english: Don’t say, “Why were the former days better than these?” For you do not ask wisely about this.

hausa: sarki Tirza, ɗaya. Duka-duka dai sarakuna talatin da ɗaya ne.
english: the king of Tirzah, one: all the kings thirty-one.

hausa: Ya sa sauran mutanen a ƙarƙashin Abishai ɗan’uwansa, ya sa su gabza da Ammonawa.
english: The rest of the people he committed into the hand of Abishai his brother; and he put them in array against the children of Ammon.

hausa: A haka Hiram ya ci gaba da aika wa Solomon al’ul da kuma fir da yake bukata.
english: So Hiram gave Solomon cedar timber and cypress timber according to all his desire.

hausa: Suka kewaye mutanen Benyamin, suka kore su, suka fatattake su a wajajen Gibeya a gabashi.
english: They surrounded the Benjamites, chased them, and trod them down at their resting place, as far as near Gibeah toward the sunrise.

hausa: Dukan al’umman da ka yi za su zo su yi sujada a gabanka, ya Ubangiji; za su kawo ɗaukaka ga sunanka.
english: All nations you have made will come and worship before you, Lord. They shall glorify your name.

hausa: Ku miƙa hadayunku na ƙonawa a bagaden Ubangiji Allahnku, da naman da kuma jinin. Dole a zub da jinin hadayunku a gindin bagaden Ubangiji Allahnku, amma za ku iya cin naman.
english: You shall offer your burnt offerings, the meat and the blood, on Yahweh your God’s altar. The blood of your sacrifices shall be poured out on Yahweh your God’s altar, and you shall eat the meat.

hausa: Suka yi ta jira har suka gaji. Da suka ga dai bai buɗe ƙofar ba, sai suka ɗauki mabuɗi, suka buɗe. Sai ga shugabansu a ƙasa matacce.
english: They waited until they were ashamed; and behold, he didn’t open the doors of the upper room. Therefore they took the key and opened them, and behold, their lord had fallen down dead on the floor.

hausa: Sa’ad da dukan Isra’ilawa a cikin kwari suka ga cewa mayaƙansu suna gudu, kuma cewa Shawulu da ’ya’yansa maza sun mutu, sai suka bar garuruwansu suka gudu. Filistiyawa kuwa suka zo suka zauna a cikinsu.
english: When all the men of Israel who were in the valley saw that they fled, and that Saul and his sons were dead, they abandoned their cities, and fled; and the Philistines came and lived in them.

hausa: (Rama da sha’ir suka lalace, gama sha’ir ya riga ya nuna, rama kuwa tana fid da kai.
english: The flax and the barley were struck, for the barley had ripened and the flax was blooming.

hausa: Yanzu ba wanda zai iya kallon rana, yadda take da haske a sararin sama bayan iska ta share ta.
english: Now men don’t see the light which is bright in the skies, but the wind passes, and clears them.

hausa: Duba! Yana zuwa kamar gizagizai, kekunan yaƙinsa suna zuwa kamar guguwa, dawakansa sun fi gaggafa sauri. Kaiton mu! Mun shiga uku!
english: Behold, he will come up as clouds, and his chariots will be as the whirlwind. His horses are swifter than eagles. Woe to us! For we are ruined.

hausa: Ya yi babban zaure mai ginshiƙai, tsawonsa kamu hamsin, fāɗinsa kuwa kamu talatin. A gabansa kuwa akwai shirayi, kuma a gaban wannan shirayi akwai ginshiƙai da kuma rufin da yake a shimfiɗe.
english: He made the hall of pillars. Its length was fifty cubits and its width thirty cubits, with a porch before them, and pillars and a threshold before them.

hausa: Ai, duk wanda yake aikata nufin Ubana wanda yake cikin sama, shi ne ɗan’uwana da ’yar’uwata da kuma mahaifiyata.”
english: For whoever does the will of my Father who is in heaven, he is my brother, and sister, and mother.”

hausa: Lokacin warwatsa duwatsu da lokacin tara su, lokacin runguma da lokacin dainawa.
english: a time to cast away stones, and a time to gather stones together; a time to embrace, and a time to refrain from embracing;

hausa: Bayan kwana uku sai ya kira taron shugabannin Yahudawa. Da suka taru, Bulus ya ce musu, “’Yan’uwana, ko da yake ban yi wa mutanenmu wani laifi ba ko kuma wani abu game da al’adun kakanninmu, aka kama ni a Urushalima aka kuma ba da ni ga Romawa.
english: After three days Paul called together those who were the leaders of the Jews. When they had come together, he said to them, “I, brothers, though I had done nothing against the people or the customs of our fathers, still was delivered prisoner from Jerusalem into the hands of the Romans,

hausa: Kullayaumi zan yi biyayya da dokokinka, har abada abadin.
english: So I will obey your law continually, forever and ever.

hausa: Ku yi hankali, kada ku manta da Lawiyawa, muddin kuna zaune a ƙasarku.
english: Be careful that you don’t forsake the Levite as long as you live in your land.

hausa: ’Yan’uwanka, iyalinka har su ma sun bashe ka; sun tā da kuka mai ƙarfi a kanka. Kada ka amince da su, ko da yake suna faɗa maganganu masu kyau game da kai.
english: For even your brothers, and the house of your father, even they have dealt treacherously with you! Even they have cried aloud after you! Don’t believe them, though they speak beautiful words to you.

hausa: Wanda yake magana da wani harshe kuwa, kansa yake gina, amma mai annabci, ikkilisiya ce yake gina.
english: He who speaks in another language edifies himself, but he who prophesies edifies the assembly.

hausa: Saboda haka ku tuba, ku juyo ga Allah, don a shafe zunubanku, don lokutan wartsakewa su zo daga wurin Ubangiji,
english: “Repent therefore, and turn again, that your sins may be blotted out, so that there may come times of refreshing from the presence of the Lord,

hausa: Zan sayar da ’ya’yanku maza da mata ga mutanen Yahuda, su kuma za su sayar da su ga mutanen Sabenawa, al’umma da take nesa da ku.” Ubangiji ya faɗa.
english: and I will sell your sons and your daughters into the hands of the children of Judah, and they will sell them to the men of Sheba, to a faraway nation, for Yahweh has spoken it.”

hausa: Saboda haka ku jira ni,” in ji Ubangiji; “a ranar da zan tsaya in ba da shaida, Na yanke shawara in tattara dukan al’ummai, in tattara mulkoki in kuma zuba fushina a kansu, da dukan zafin haushina. Za a mamaye dukan duniya da zafin fushina.
english: “Therefore wait for me”, says Yahweh, “until the day that I rise up to the prey, for my determination is to gather the nations, that I may assemble the kingdoms to pour on them my indignation, even all my fierce anger, for all the earth will be devoured with the fire of my jealousy.

hausa: Ka ba ni ƙarfi don yaƙi; ka sa maƙiyina suka rusuna a ƙafafuna.
english: For you have armed me with strength for the battle. You have subdued under me those who rose up against me.

hausa: Ya sa ƙungiyoyin sojoji a masarautar Arameyawan Damaskus. Arameyawan kuwa suka zama bayinsa, suka kuma kawo haraji. Ubangiji ya ba Dawuda nasara a ko’ina da ya tafi.
english: Then David put garrisons in Syria of Damascus; and the Syrians became servants to David and brought tribute. Yahweh gave victory to David wherever he went.

hausa: A shekara ta biyar ta Sarki Rehobowam, Shishak sarkin Masar ya kai wa Urushalima yaƙi.
english: In the fifth year of King Rehoboam, Shishak king of Egypt came up against Jerusalem;

hausa: Ɗaya daga cikin bayin ya ce, “Na san wani yaro, ɗan Yesse na Betlehem, ya iya kiɗan molo, yana da hikima, shi kuma ya iya yaƙi. Ya iya magana, ga shi kuma kyakkyawa, Ubangiji kuwa yana tare da shi.”
english: Then one of the young men answered and said, “Behold, I have seen a son of Jesse the Bethlehemite who is skillful in playing, a mighty man of valor, a man of war, prudent in speech, and a handsome person; and Yahweh is with him.”

hausa: Yonatan ya ce wa Dawuda, “Sauka lafiya, mun riga mun yi rantsuwar abokantaka da juna a cikin sunan Ubangiji cewa, ‘Ubangiji ne shaida tsakanina da kai, tsakanin zuriyarka da zuriyata har abada.’ ” Sai Dawuda ya tafi, Yonatan kuwa ya koma gari.
english: Jonathan said to David, “Go in peace, because we have both sworn in Yahweh’s name, saying, ‘Yahweh is between me and you, and between my offspring and your offspring, forever.’” He arose and departed; and Jonathan went into the city.

hausa: Ubangiji ya umarce mu mu yi biyayya da dukan waɗannan ƙa’idodi, mu kuma ji tsoron Ubangiji Allahnmu, saboda kullum mu ci gaba, a kuma bar mu da rai, kamar yadda yake a yau.
english: Yahweh commanded us to do all these statutes, to fear Yahweh our God, for our good always, that he might preserve us alive, as we are today.

hausa: Za a miƙa kitsen abin hadaya duka, da wutsiya mai kitse, da kitsen da yake rufe da kayan ciki,
english: He shall offer all of its fat: the fat tail, and the fat that covers the innards,

hausa: Ubangiji yana ƙyamar tunanin mugaye, amma waɗanda suke da tunani masu tsabta yakan ji daɗinsu.
english: Yahweh detests the thoughts of the wicked, but the thoughts of the pure are pleasing.

hausa: Sai wani almajiri ya ce masa, “Ubangiji, da farko bari in je in binne mahaifina.”
english: Another of his disciples said to him, “Lord, allow me first to go and bury my father.”

hausa: Wannan ya faru har sau uku, sa’an nan duk aka sāke ɗauke shi zuwa sama.
english: This was done three times, and all were drawn up again into heaven.

hausa: Allah yakan ba mutum dukiya, da wadata da kuma girma, don kada yă rasa abin da ransa yake so, amma Allah bai ba shi zarafin more su ba, a maimakon haka ma sai baƙo ne yă more su. Wannan ba shi da amfani, mugun abu ne ƙwarai.
english: a man to whom God gives riches, wealth, and honor, so that he lacks nothing for his soul of all that he desires, yet God gives him no power to eat of it, but an alien eats it. This is vanity, and it is an evil disease.

hausa: Kamar dai yadda Uba mai rai ya aiko ni, ina kuma rayuwa ta saboda shi, haka ma wanda yake ni ne abincinsa zai rayu saboda ni.
english: As the living Father sent me, and I live because of the Father, so he who feeds on me will also live because of me.

hausa: Bayan ’yan kwanaki da dama sai Felis ya zo da matarsa Durusilla, mutuniyar Yahuda. Sai ya aika a zo da Bulus ya kuma saurare shi da yake magana game da bangaskiya cikin Kiristi Yesu.
english: After some days, Felix came with Drusilla his wife, who was a Jewess, and sent for Paul and heard him concerning the faith in Christ Jesus.

hausa: wanda ya tafi sama, yana kuma a hannun dama na Allah, mala’iku, mulkoki da kuma masu iko suna masa biyayya.
