english: who is at the right hand of God, having gone into heaven, angels and authorities and powers being made subject to him.

hausa: Gama Allah wanda ya yi aiki a cikin hidimar Bitrus a matsayin manzo ga Yahudawa, haka ma ya yi aiki a cikin hidimata a matsayin manzo ga Al’ummai.
english: for he who worked through Peter in the apostleship with the circumcised also worked through me with the Gentiles—

hausa: Dawuda ya yabi Ubangiji a gaban dukan taron, yana cewa, “Yabo gare ka, ya Ubangiji, Allah na mahaifinmu Isra’ila, har abada abadin.
english: Therefore David blessed Yahweh before all the assembly; and David said, “You are blessed, Yahweh, the God of Israel our father, forever and ever.

hausa: Za a kuma kira ku firistocin Ubangiji, za a kira ku masu hidimar Allahnmu. Za ku ci wadatar waɗansu al’ummai, kuma a cikin dukiyarsu za ku yi taƙama.
english: But you will be called Yahweh’s priests. Men will call you the servants of our God. You will eat the wealth of the nations. You will boast in their glory.

hausa: Sai Yesu ya miƙe tsaye ya tambaye ta ya ce, “Mace, ina suke? Ba wanda ya hukunta ki?”
english: Jesus, standing up, saw her and said, “Woman, where are your accusers? Did no one condemn you?”

hausa: Da macen da ta fito daga Tekowa ta je wajen sarki, sai ta rusuna har ƙasa don bangirma, sai ta ce, “Ka taimake ni, ya sarki!”
english: When the woman of Tekoa spoke to the king, she fell on her face to the ground, showed respect, and said, “Help, O king!”

hausa: Game da Rehabiya kuwa, daga ’ya’yansa maza. Isshiya shi ne na fari.
english: Of Rehabiah: of the sons of Rehabiah, Isshiah the chief.

hausa: Sai Yaƙub yă ware ƙananan garken dabam, amma sai yă sa sauran su fuskanci dabbobin da suke dabbare-dabbare da kuma baƙaƙe da suke na Laban. Ta haka ya ware garkuna dabam domin kansa bai kuwa haɗa su da dabbobin Laban ba.
english: Jacob separated the lambs, and set the faces of the flocks toward the streaked and all the black in Laban’s flock. He put his own droves apart, and didn’t put them into Laban’s flock.

hausa: Game da Heman kuwa, daga ’ya’yansa maza. Bukkiya, Mattaniya, Uzziyel, Shebuwel, Yerimot; Hananiya, Hanani, Eliyata, Giddalti, Romamti-Ezer, Yoshbekasha, Malloti, Hotir da Mahaziyot.
english: Of Heman, the sons of Heman: Bukkiah, Mattaniah, Uzziel, Shebuel, Jerimoth, Hananiah, Hanani, Eliathah, Giddalti, Romamti-Ezer, Joshbekashah, Mallothi, Hothir, and Mahazioth.

hausa: Da yawa za su bi hanyoyinsu na rashin kunya su kuma sa a rena hanyar gaskiya.
english: Many will follow their immoral ways, and as a result, the way of the truth will be maligned.

hausa: Ka farka! Ka ƙarfafa abin da ya rage wanda kuma yake bakin mutuwa, don ban ga ayyukanka cikakke ne ba a gaban Allahna.
english: Wake up and strengthen the things that remain, which you were about to throw away, for I have found no works of yours perfected before my God.

hausa: Gama kamar yadda wahalar Kiristi ta cika har tana zuba a cikin rayuwarmu, haka nan kuma ta wurin Kiristi ta’aziyyarmu ta cika har tana zuba.
english: For as the sufferings of Christ abound to us, even so our comfort also abounds through Christ.

hausa: Da a ce za tă iya, da ba su daina miƙa hadayu ba? Ai, da an riga an tsabtacce masu yin sujada sau ɗaya tak, da kuma ba za su ƙara damuwa da zunubansu ba.
english: Or else wouldn’t they have ceased to be offered, because the worshipers, having been once cleansed, would have had no more consciousness of sins?

hausa: Mazaunan Marot sun ƙosa su ga alheri, amma Ubangiji ya sauko da azaba, har zuwa ƙofar Urushalima.
english: For the inhabitant of Maroth waits anxiously for good, because evil has come down from Yahweh to the gate of Jerusalem.

hausa: Waɗansu shugabannin iyalai suka ba da kyautai domin taimakon aiki. Gwamna ya ba da darik 1,000 na zinariya, kwanoni 50, da riguna 530 don firistoci.
english: Some from among the heads of fathers’ households gave to the work. The governor gave to the treasury one thousand darics of gold, fifty basins, and five hundred thirty priests’ garments.

hausa: Da suna ihu suna kaɗa mayafansu suna da tā da ƙura sama,
english: As they cried out, threw off their cloaks, and threw dust into the air,

hausa: Sai sarki Zedekiya ya aiki Yehukal ɗan Shelemiya tare da firist nan Zefaniya ɗan Ma’asehiya da wannan saƙo cewa, “Ina roƙonka ka yi addu’a ga Ubangiji Allahnmu saboda mu.”
english: Zedekiah the king sent Jehucal the son of Shelemiah and Zephaniah the son of Maaseiah, the priest, to the prophet Jeremiah, saying, “Pray now to Yahweh our God for us.”

hausa: Waɗanda suke hidima da kyau suna samar wa kansu kyakkyawan suna da kuma cikakken tabbatarwa a cikin bangaskiyarsu cikin Kiristi Yesu.
english: For those who have served well gain for themselves a good standing and great boldness in the faith which is in Christ Jesus.

hausa: jirgin ruwan kuwa ya riga ya yi nesa da gaci, yana fama da raƙuman ruwa domin iska tana gāba da shi.
english: But the boat was now in the middle of the sea, distressed by the waves, for the wind was contrary.

hausa: Wane ne ba zai ji tsoronka, yă kuma kawo ɗaukaka ga sunanka ba, ya Ubangiji? Gama kai kaɗai ne mai tsarki. Dukan al’ummai za su zo su yi sujada a gabanka, gama an bayyana ayyukan adalcinka.”
english: Who wouldn’t fear you, Lord, and glorify your name? For you only are holy. For all the nations will come and worship before you. For your righteous acts have been revealed.”

hausa: Wani mala’ika kuma ya fito daga haikali a sama, shi ma yana da lauje mai kaifi.
english: Another angel came out of the temple which is in heaven. He also had a sharp sickle.

hausa: Yoshuwa da dukan sojojin suka fita su kai wa Ai hari. Sai ya zaɓi sojojinsa waɗanda suka fi saura duka iya yaƙi guda dubu talatin, ya tura su da dad dare
english: So Joshua arose, with all the warriors, to go up to Ai. Joshua chose thirty thousand men, the mighty men of valor, and sent them out by night.

hausa: “Mutum haihuwar mace kwanakinsa kaɗan ne, kuma cike da wahala.
english: “Man, who is born of a woman, is of few days, and full of trouble.

hausa: Dawuda ya ce, “Kada ka ji tsoro, gama tabbatacce zan nuna maka alheri saboda mahaifinka Yonatan. Zan mayar maka da dukan ƙasar da take ta kakanka Shawulu, kullum kuma za ka ci a teburina.”
english: David said to him, “Don’t be afraid, for I will surely show you kindness for Jonathan your father’s sake, and will restore to you all the land of Saul your father. You will eat bread at my table continually.”

hausa: da kuma a zamanin Yehohiyakim ɗan Yosiya sarkin Yahuda, har zuwa watan biyar na shekara goma sha ɗaya na Zedekiya ɗan Yosiya sarkin Yahuda, sa’ad da aka kai mutanen Urushalima zaman bauta.
english: It came also in the days of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah, to the end of the eleventh year of Zedekiah, the son of Josiah, king of Judah, to the carrying away of Jerusalem captive in the fifth month.

hausa: Za su hallaka katangar Taya su kuma rurrushe hasumiyoyinta; zan kankare tarkacenta, in maishe ta fā.
english: They will destroy the walls of Tyre, and break down her towers. I will also scrape her dust from her, and make her a bare rock.

hausa: Amma Yaƙub ya ce, “Ɗana ba zai gangara zuwa can tare da ku ba, ɗan’uwansa ya rasu, shi ne kaɗai ya rage. In wani abu ya faru da shi a tafiyar da za ku yi, za ku sa furfurata ta gangara zuwa kabari cikin baƙin ciki.”
english: He said, “My son shall not go down with you; for his brother is dead, and he only is left. If harm happens to him along the way in which you go, then you will bring down my gray hairs with sorrow to Sheol.”

hausa: Sai ya juya daga gare su ya yi kuka, sa’an nan ya dawo ya yi musu magana kuma. Ya sa aka ɗauke Simeyon daga gare su, aka daure shi a idanunsu.
english: He turned himself away from them, and wept. Then he returned to them, and spoke to them, and took Simeon from among them, and bound him before their eyes.

hausa: Arbadiyawa, Zemarawa, da Hamawa. Daga baya zuriyar Kan’aniyawa suka yaɗu
english: the Arvadites, the Zemarites, and the Hamathites. Afterward the families of the Canaanites were spread abroad.

hausa: Rundunar mayaƙa uku suka fito daga sansani Filistiyawa. Ɗaya ta nufi Ofra, zuwa ƙasar Shuwal.
english: The raiders came out of the camp of the Philistines in three companies: one company turned to the way that leads to Ophrah, to the land of Shual;

hausa: Haura zuwa ƙwanƙolin Fisga, ka dubi ƙasar da idanunka daga kowane gefe, yamma, da arewa, da kudu, da kuma gabas, gama ba za ka ƙetare wannan Urdun ba.
english: Go up to the top of Pisgah, and lift up your eyes westward, and northward, and southward, and eastward, and see with your eyes; for you shall not go over this Jordan.

hausa: Da Dawuda ya gama wannan magana, sai Shawulu ya ce, “Muryarka ke nan ɗana Dawuda?” Sai ya fasa da kuka.
english: It came to pass, when David had finished speaking these words to Saul, that Saul said, “Is that your voice, my son David?” Saul lifted up his voice and wept.

hausa: ya janye ni daga kan hanya ya ɓatar da ni ya bar ni ba taimako.
english: He has turned away my path, and pulled me in pieces. He has made me desolate.

hausa: Fartiyawa, Medes da Elamawa; mazaunan Mesofotamiya, Yahudiya da Kaffadokiya, Fontus da Asiya,
english: Parthians, Medes, Elamites, and people from Mesopotamia, Judea, Cappadocia, Pontus, Asia,

hausa: Dole ’ya’yansa su mayar wa matalauta abin da ya kamata; dole hannuwansa su mayar da dukiyarsa.
english: His children will seek the favor of the poor. His hands will give back his wealth.

hausa: Dukan waɗanda suke bauta wa siffofi sun sha kunya, waɗanda suke fariya da gumaka, ku yi masa sujada, dukanku alloli!
english: Let all them be shamed who serve engraved images, who boast in their idols. Worship him, all you gods!

hausa: A can muka tarar da waɗansu ’yan’uwa waɗanda suka gayyaci mu mu yi mako ɗaya da su. Da haka dai muka kai Roma.
english: where we found brothers, and were entreated to stay with them for seven days. So we came to Rome.

hausa: Ku yi ihu, gama ranar Ubangiji ta yi kusa za tă zo kamar hallaka daga Maɗaukaki.
english: Wail, for Yahweh’s day is at hand! It will come as destruction from the Almighty.

hausa: Bowaz kuwa ya kira dattawa guda goma na garin ya ce, “Ku zauna a nan,” suka kuwa zauna.
english: Boaz took ten men of the elders of the city, and said, “Sit down here,” and they sat down.

hausa: Gama daga Urushalima za a sami ragowa, daga Dutsen Sihiyona kuma za a sami waɗanda suka tsira. Himmar Ubangiji Maɗaukaki za tă cika wannan.
english: For out of Jerusalem a remnant will go out, and out of Mount Zion those who shall escape. Yahweh’s zeal will perform this.

hausa: Zan tattara ku zan kuma hura muku wutar hasalata, za ku kuma narke a cikinta.
english: Yes, I will gather you, and blow on you with the fire of my wrath, and you will be melted in the middle of it.

hausa: Ya sauko da nama a kansu kamar ƙura, tsuntsaye masu firiya kamar yashi a bakin teku.
english: He also rained meat on them as the dust, winged birds as the sand of the seas.

hausa: Daga zuriyar Simeyon. Aka rubuta sunayen dukan maza ɗaya-ɗaya da suka kai shekara ashirin ko fiye da suka isa shiga soja, bisa ga iyalansu da kabilarsu da take a rubuce.
english: Of the children of Simeon, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, those who were counted of it, according to the number of the names, one by one, every male from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war:

hausa: Waɗannan su ne kabilan Efraim; jimillarsu ta kai 32,500. Waɗannan su ne kabilan Yusuf ta wurin kabilansu.
english: These are the families of the sons of Ephraim according to those who were counted of them, thirty-two thousand five hundred. These are the sons of Joseph after their families.

hausa: Ka yi bagaden da katakai, sa’an nan ka robe cikinsa. Ka yi shi bisa ga fasalin da aka nuna maka a bisa dutsen.
english: You shall make it hollow with planks. They shall make it as it has been shown you on the mountain.

hausa: In wani yana jin yunwa, sai yă ci abinci a gida, saboda in kuka taru kada yă jawo hukunci. Sa’ad da na zo kuma zan ba da ƙarin umarnai.
english: But if anyone is hungry, let him eat at home, lest your coming together be for judgment. The rest I will set in order whenever I come.

hausa: Ku ji kukan makiyaya; an ɓata musu wuraren kiwonsu masu ciyayi! Ku ji rurin zakoki; an lalatar da jejin Urdun!
english: A voice of the wailing of the shepherds! For their glory is destroyed—a voice of the roaring of young lions! For the pride of the Jordan is ruined.

hausa: “Ku zo, ku ga mutumin da ya gaya mini duk abin da na taɓa yi. Shin, ko shi ne Kiristi?”
english: “Come, see a man who told me everything that I have done. Can this be the Christ?”

hausa: Yayinda nake tunani game da wannan, farat ɗaya sai ga bunsurun da yake da sanannen ƙaho tsakanin idanunsa ya ɓullo daga wajen yamma, yana ratsa dukan duniya ba ya ko taɓa ƙasa.
english: As I was considering, behold, a male goat came from the west over the surface of the whole earth, and didn’t touch the ground. The goat had a notable horn between his eyes.

hausa: Duk da haka, suka yi tsammani ba zai zama haka ba, sai suka haura ta wajen ƙasa mai tudu, Musa da akwatin alkawarin Ubangiji dai ba su gusa daga sansanin ba.
english: But they presumed to go up to the top of the mountain. Nevertheless, the ark of Yahweh’s covenant and Moses didn’t depart out of the camp.

hausa: Me zai yi maka, me kuma ya fi, ya kai harshe mai yaudara?
english: What will be given to you, and what will be done more to you, you deceitful tongue?

hausa: Cikin matsuwa da yunwa, za su yi ta kai komo ko’ina a ƙasar; sa’ad da suka ji yunwa, za su yi fushi su tā da idanu sama, su zagi sarkinsu da Allahnsu.
english: They will pass through it, very distressed and hungry. It will happen that when they are hungry, they will worry, and curse their king and their God. They will turn their faces upward,

hausa: in har kun aikata wannan cikin bangirma da kuma aminci wajen Yerub-Ba’al da iyalinsa a yau, bari Abimelek yă zama farin cikinku, ku kuma nasa!
english: if you then have dealt truly and righteously with Jerubbaal and with his house today, then rejoice in Abimelech, and let him also rejoice in you;

hausa: Ni kaɗai dai ba na iya yin kome, ina shari’a ne bisa ga abin da na ji. Shari’ata kuwa mai adalci ce. Gama ba na neman gamsar da kaina, sai dai in gamshi shi wanda ya aiko ni.
english: I can of myself do nothing. As I hear, I judge; and my judgment is righteous, because I don’t seek my own will, but the will of my Father who sent me.

hausa: Da dad dare mutanen Gibeya suka bi ni suka kewaye gidan da niyya su kashe ni. Suka yi wa ƙwarƙwarata fyaɗe, har ta mutu.
english: The men of Gibeah rose against me, and surrounded the house by night. They intended to kill me and they raped my concubine, and she is dead.

hausa: Saboda haka na yi niyya ƙwarai in aike shi wurinku, don sa’ad da kuka sāke ganinsa za ku yi murna, ni kuma in rage damuwa.
english: I have sent him therefore the more diligently, that when you see him again, you may rejoice, and that I may be the less sorrowful.

hausa: Da Abigiyel ta kai gida sai ta sami Nabal cikin gida yana ta fama biki iri na sarakuna. Yana ji wa ransa daɗi, ya kuma bugu tilis, saboda haka ba tă ce masa kome ba sai da gari ya waye.
english: Abigail came to Nabal; and behold, he held a feast in his house like the feast of a king. Nabal’s heart was merry within him, for he was very drunk. Therefore she told him nothing until the morning light.

hausa: An bar diyar Sihiyona kamar rumfar mai ƙumu a gonar inabi, kamar bukka a gonar kabewa, kamar birnin da aka kewaye da yaƙi.
english: The daughter of Zion is left like a shelter in a vineyard, like a hut in a field of melons, like a besieged city.

hausa: Babban firist yakan ɗauki jinin dabbobi yă shiga cikin Wuri Mafi Tsarki a matsayin hadaya ta zunubi, amma jikunan dabbobin akan ƙone su a bayan sansani.
english: For the bodies of those animals, whose blood is brought into the holy place by the high priest as an offering for sin, are burned outside of the camp.

hausa: Kamar ’ya’ya masu biyayya, kada ku bi mugayen sha’awace-sha’awacen da dā kuke da su sa’ad da kuke rayuwa a cikin jahilci.
english: as children of obedience, not conforming yourselves according to your former lusts as in your ignorance,

hausa: Haka ku ma, a waje, a idon mutane, ku masu adalci ne, amma a ciki, cike kuke da munafunci da mugunta.
english: Even so you also outwardly appear righteous to men, but inwardly you are full of hypocrisy and iniquity.

hausa: Hadadezer sarkin Zoba ya aika a kawo Arameyawan da suke ƙetaren Kogin Yuferites. Suka iso Helam a ƙarƙashin shugabancin Shobak, shugaban dukan sojojin Hadadezer.
english: Hadadezer sent and brought out the Syrians who were beyond the River; and they came to Helam, with Shobach the captain of the army of Hadadezer at their head.

hausa: Amma don kada mu ɓata musu rai, ka je tafki ka jefa ƙugiyarka. Ka ɗauki kifin da ka fara kama; ka buɗe bakinsa, za ka sami shekel guda. Ka kawo ka ba su, harajina da naka ke nan.”
english: But, lest we cause them to stumble, go to the sea, cast a hook, and take up the first fish that comes up. When you have opened its mouth, you will find a stater coin. Take that, and give it to them for me and you.”

hausa: Ashe, ba kalmomin da Ubangiji ya faɗi ke nan ta bakin annabawan farko ba sa’ad da Urushalima da garuruwan da suke kewaye da ita suke hutawa, suke cikin wadata, akwai kuma mutane a Negeb da yammancin gindin tuddai?’ ”
english: Aren’t these the words which Yahweh proclaimed by the former prophets when Jerusalem was inhabited and in prosperity, and its cities around her, and the South and the lowland were inhabited?’”

hausa: “Yana yiwuwa mahaifiya ta manta da jariri a ƙirjinta ta kuma kāsa nuna tausayi ga yaron da ta haifa? Mai yiwuwa ta manta, amma ba zan taɓa manta da ke ba!
english: “Can a woman forget her nursing child, that she should not have compassion on the son of her womb? Yes, these may forget, yet I will not forget you!

hausa: Dawuda ya yi tunani, “Zan nuna jinƙai ga Hanun ɗan Nahash, domin mahaifinsa ya nuna alheri gare ni.” Saboda haka Dawuda ya aika da tawaga don yă yi wa Hanun ta’aziyya game da mahaifinsa. Sa’ad da mutanen Dawuda suka iso wurin Hanun a ƙasar Ammonawa don su ta’azantar da shi,
english: David said, “I will show kindness to Hanun the son of Nahash, because his father showed kindness to me.” So David sent messengers to comfort him concerning his father. David’s servants came into the land of the children of Ammon to Hanun to comfort him.

hausa: Sai na juya wurin Ubangiji Allah na roƙe shi ta wurin addu’a da koke-koke, cikin azumi, ina saye da tsummoki, na kuma zauna a cikin toka.
english: I set my face to the Lord God, to seek by prayer and petitions, with fasting and sackcloth and ashes.

hausa: Yayinda suke tafiya daga gari zuwa gari, suka dinga ba da shawarwarin da manzanni da dattawa a Urushalima suka zartar domin mutane su kiyaye.
english: As they went on their way through the cities, they delivered the decrees to them to keep which had been ordained by the apostles and elders who were at Jerusalem.

hausa: ya tasar masa da faɗa da garkuwa mai kauri da kuma ƙarfi.
english: he runs at him with a stiff neck, with the thick shields of his bucklers,

hausa: Ƙaddararsu hallaka ce, allahnsu cikinsu ne, rashin kunyarsu shi ne abin fahariyarsu. Hankalinsu yana kan kayan duniya.
english: whose end is destruction, whose god is the belly, and whose glory is in their shame, who think about earthly things.

hausa: “Ko da yake kun yi zina, ya Isra’ila, kada Yahuda ya yi laifi. “Kada ku tafi Gilgal; kada ku haura zuwa Bet-Awen. Kuma kada ku rantse cewa, ‘Muddin Ubangiji yana a raye!’
english: “Though you, Israel, play the prostitute, yet don’t let Judah offend; and don’t come to Gilgal, neither go up to Beth Aven, nor swear, ‘As Yahweh lives.’

hausa: Waɗannan hadayu, ƙari ne a kan waɗannan na Asabbatan Ubangiji, haɗe kuma da kyautanku, da kome da kuka yi alkawari, da kuma hadayu yardar ran da za ku ba wa Ubangiji.)
english: in addition to the Sabbaths of Yahweh, and in addition to your gifts, and in addition to all your vows, and in addition to all your free will offerings, which you give to Yahweh.

hausa: Waɗanda suke sāka alherina da mugunta, suna cin zarafina sa’ad da nake bin abin da yake daidai.
english: They who give evil for good are also adversaries to me, because I follow what is good.

hausa: Daga nan ya wuce zuwa Fenuwel ya yi irin roƙon nan, amma suka amsa yadda mutanen Sukkot suka yi.
english: He went up there to Penuel, and spoke to them in the same way; and the men of Penuel answered him as the men of Succoth had answered.

hausa: Fir’auna Neko ya naɗa Eliyakim ɗan Yosiya sarki a maimakon mahaifinsa, ya kuma canja masa suna zuwa Yehohiyakim. Ya ɗauki Yehoyahaz ya kai Masar, a can ya mutu.
english: Pharaoh Necoh made Eliakim the son of Josiah king in the place of Josiah his father, and changed his name to Jehoiakim; but he took Jehoahaz away, and he came to Egypt and died there.

hausa: Amma Allah ya husata sa’ad da ya tafi, mala’ikan Ubangiji kuwa ya tsaya a hanya don yă hana shi. Bala’am kuwa yana kan jakarsa tare da bayinsa biyu.
english: God’s anger burned because he went; and Yahweh’s angel placed himself in the way as an adversary against him. Now he was riding on his donkey, and his two servants were with him.

hausa: Ku yi wa shugabanninku biyayya ku kuma miƙa kanku ga ikonsu. Suna lura da ku kuma za su ba da lissafi a gaban Allah. Saboda haka kada ku sa su yi fushi saboda aikinsu, ku sa su yi farin ciki. In ba haka ba za su iya taimakonku ba ko kaɗan.
english: Obey your leaders and submit to them, for they watch on behalf of your souls, as those who will give account, that they may do this with joy and not with groaning, for that would be unprofitable for you.

hausa: Da Bitrus yake zazzaga ƙasar, sai ya je ya ziyarci tsarkakan da suke a Lidda.
english: As Peter went throughout all those parts, he came down also to the saints who lived at Lydda.

hausa: “Ko za ka iya gane al’amuran Allah? Ko za ka iya gane girman asirin Maɗaukaki?
english: “Can you fathom the mystery of God? Or can you probe the limits of the Almighty?

hausa: Fushi yana kashe wawa, ƙyashi kuma yana kashe marar azanci.
english: For resentment kills the foolish man, and jealousy kills the simple.

hausa: Waƙar haurawa. Na tā da idanuna zuwa wajen tuddai, ta ina ne taimakona zai zo?
english: A Song of Ascents. I will lift up my eyes to the hills. Where does my help come from?

hausa: To, sai aka faɗa wa Sarki Dawuda cewa, “Ubangiji ya sa wa gidan Obed-Edom albarka da dukan abin da yake da shi, saboda akwatin alkawarin Allah.” Saboda haka sai Dawuda ya gangara ya hauro da akwatin alkawarin Allah daga gidan Obed-Edom zuwa Birnin Dawuda da farin ciki.
english: King David was told, “Yahweh has blessed the house of Obed-Edom, and all that belongs to him, because of God’s ark.” So David went and brought up God’s ark from the house of Obed-Edom into David’s city with joy.

hausa: Sai Abner ya kira Yowab ya ce, har abada ne māshi zai yi ta hallakarwa? Ba ka sani cewa ƙarshen zai zama da ɗaci ba. Sai yaushe za ka umarci mutanenka su daina fafaran ’yan’uwansu?
english: Then Abner called to Joab, and said, “Shall the sword devour forever? Don’t you know that it will be bitterness in the latter end? How long will it be then, before you ask the people to return from following their brothers?”

hausa: Har ma akwai maza karuwai na masujada. Mutane suka sa kansu ga yin kowane abin ƙyama na al’umman da Ubangiji ya kora kafin Isra’ilawa.
english: There were also sodomites in the land. They did according to all the abominations of the nations which Yahweh drove out before the children of Israel.

hausa: Maƙiyanka sun yi ruri a inda ka sadu da mu; suka kakkafa tutotinsu a matsayin alamu.
english: Your adversaries have roared in the middle of your assembly. They have set up their standards as signs.

hausa: Bayan muka rabu da su da ƙyar, sai muka shiga jirgin ruwa, muka miƙe zuwa Kos. Kashegari muka tafi Rods daga can kuma muka je Fatara.
english: When we had departed from them and had set sail, we came with a straight course to Cos, and the next day to Rhodes, and from there to Patara.

hausa: don kuma ya iya aika da Kiristi, wanda aka naɗa tun dā saboda ku, Yesu ke nan.
english: and that he may send Christ Jesus, who was ordained for you before,

hausa: Kabilar Naftali za su zama na biye da su. Shugaban mutanen kuwa shi ne Ahira ɗan Enan.
english: “The tribe of Naphtali: the prince of the children of Naphtali shall be Ahira the son of Enan.

hausa: Ya cece su daga hannun maƙiyi; daga hannun abokin gāba ya fanshe su.
english: He saved them from the hand of him who hated them, and redeemed them from the hand of the enemy.

hausa: Filistiyawa suka yashe allolinsu, Dawuda kuma ya ba da umarnai a ƙone su a wuta.
english: They left their gods there; and David gave a command, and they were burned with fire.

hausa: To, ina da tambaya. Allah ya ƙi mutanensa ne? Sam, ko kaɗan! Ni mutumin Isra’ila ne kaina, zuriyar Ibrahim kuwa, daga kabilar Benyamin.
english: I ask then, did God reject his people? May it never be! For I also am an Israelite, a descendant of Abraham, of the tribe of Benjamin.

hausa: Yakan bayyana zurfafa da ɓoyayyun abubuwa; ya san abin da yake cikin dare, haske kuwa yana zaune tare da shi.
english: He reveals the deep and secret things. He knows what is in the darkness, and the light dwells with him.

hausa: An ɗauke su kafin lokacinsu yă cika, ruwa ya share tushensu.
english: who were snatched away before their time, whose foundation was poured out as a stream,

hausa: In dai kuka yi biyayya ga Ubangiji Allahnku, kuka kuma kiyaye umarnansa da ƙa’idodin da aka rubuta a wannan Littafin Doka, kuka juyo ga Ubangiji Allahnku da dukan zuciyarku da kuma dukan ranku.
english: if you will obey Yahweh your God’s voice, to keep his commandments and his statutes which are written in this book of the law, if you turn to Yahweh your God with all your heart and with all your soul.

hausa: Gama da zuciyarka ce kakan gaskata a kuma kuɓutar da kai, da bakinka ne kuma kake furta a kuma cece ka.
english: For with the heart one believes resulting in righteousness; and with the mouth confession is made resulting in salvation.

hausa: kada ka yarda da shi, kada ma ka saurare shi. Kada ka ji tausayinsa. Kada ka haƙura da shi, ko ka tsare shi.
english: you shall not consent to him nor listen to him; neither shall your eye pity him, neither shall you spare, neither shall you conceal him;

hausa: “ ‘Bayinku maza da mata, za su zo daga al’ummai da suke kewaye da ku, daga gare su za ku iya saya bayi.
english: “‘As for your male and your female slaves, whom you may have from the nations that are around you, from them you may buy male and female slaves.

hausa: sai Ubangiji ya ce mini,
english: Yahweh spoke to me, saying,

hausa: Yana takawa da ƙarfi yana jin daɗin ƙarfinsa yana shiga filin yaƙi gabagadi.
english: He paws in the valley, and rejoices in his strength. He goes out to meet the armed men.

hausa: Sarki ya yi amfani da almug don yă yi kayan ado wa haikalin Ubangiji da kuma don fadan sarki, don kuma yă yi molaye, da garayu saboda mawaƙa. Ba a taɓa yin jigilar katakon almug ko a gani irin yawan katakai haka ba har wa yau.)
english: The king made of the almug trees pillars for Yahweh’s house and for the king’s house, harps also and stringed instruments for the singers; no such almug trees came or were seen to this day.

hausa: A matsayin hakki kuwa, dole yă kawo wa firist, wato, ga Ubangiji, hadaya rago marar lahani kuma wanda aka kimanta tamaninsa daga garke don laifinsa.
english: He shall bring his trespass offering to Yahweh: a ram without defect from the flock, according to your estimation, for a trespass offering, to the priest.

hausa: Allah ya ji Manowa, sai mala’ikan Allah ya sāke zuwa wurin matar yayinda take gona; amma Manowa mijinta ba ya tare da ita.
english: God listened to the voice of Manoah, and the angel of God came again to the woman as she sat in the field; but Manoah, her husband, wasn’t with her.

hausa: Suka tuhume ni suka kuma so su sake ni, domin ba a same ni da wani laifin da ya cancanci kisa ba.
english: who, when they had examined me, desired to set me free, because there was no cause of death in me.

hausa: amma bari shi wanda yake taƙama ya yi taƙama da wannan, cewa ya fahimci ya kuma san ni, cewa ni ne Ubangiji, wanda yake yin alheri, gaskiya da kuma adalci a duniya, gama a waɗannan ne nake jin daɗi,” in ji Ubangiji.
english: But let him who glories glory in this, that he has understanding, and knows me, that I am Yahweh who exercises loving kindness, justice, and righteousness on the earth, for I delight in these things,” says Yahweh.

hausa: Adalci na tafiya a gabansa yana shirya hanya domin ƙafafunsa.
english: Righteousness goes before him, and prepares the way for his steps.

hausa: “Har yaushe za ku yi ta ba ni azaba ku kuma murƙushe ni da maganganunku?
english: “How long will you torment me, and crush me with words?

hausa: Kada a zuba a jikunan mutane, kada kuma a yi wani mai irinsa. Wannan mai, mai tsarki ne, za ku kuma ɗauke shi a matsayi mai tsarki.
english: It shall not be poured on man’s flesh, and do not make any like it, according to its composition. It is holy. It shall be holy to you.

hausa: Kada in taɓa yin taƙama ga kome sai dai a cikin gicciyen Ubangijinmu Yesu Kiristi, wanda ta wurinsa aka gicciye duniya a gare ni, aka kuma gicciye ni ga duniya.
english: But far be it from me to boast except in the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ, through which the world has been crucified to me, and I to the world.

hausa: Labari game da shi ya bazu nan da nan ko’ina a dukan yankin Galili.
english: The report of him went out immediately into all the region of Galilee and its surrounding area.

hausa: Ka dubi wahalata ka cece ni, gama ban manta da dokarka ba.
english: Consider my affliction, and deliver me, for I don’t forget your law.

hausa: Amma Rehobowam ya ƙi shawarar da dattawa suka ba shi ya kuma nemi shawarar matasan da suka yi girma tare, suke kuma yin masa hidima.
english: But he abandoned the counsel of the old men which they had given him, and took counsel with the young men who had grown up with him, who stood before him.

hausa: Za a tumɓuke dukan taurarin sammai za a kuma nannaɗe sararin sama kamar littafi; dukan rundunar sama za su fāffāɗi kamar ganyayen da suka yanƙwane daga kuringa, kamar ’ya’yan ɓauren da suka bushe daga itacen ɓaure.
english: All of the army of the sky will be dissolved. The sky will be rolled up like a scroll, and all its armies will fade away, as a leaf fades from off a vine or a fig tree.

hausa: A kome da Dawuda ya yi yakan yi nasara gama Ubangiji yana tare da shi.
english: David behaved himself wisely in all his ways; and Yahweh was with him.

hausa: Raina yana cikin wahala. Har yaushe, ya Ubangiji, har yaushe?
english: My soul is also in great anguish. But you, Yahweh—how long?

hausa: “Tabbatacce zan tattara ku duka, ya gidan Yaƙub; zan tattara ku raguwar Isra’ila. Zan kawo su wuri ɗaya kamar tumaki a cikin garke, kamar garke a wajen kiwonsa; wurin zai cika da mutane.
english: I will surely assemble all of you, Jacob. I will surely gather the remnant of Israel. I will put them together as the sheep of Bozrah, as a flock in the middle of their pasture. They will swarm with people.

hausa: Itace mai kyau ba ya ba da munanan ’ya’ya, haka kuma mummunan itace ba ya ba da ’ya’ya masu kyau.
english: A good tree can’t produce evil fruit, neither can a corrupt tree produce good fruit.

hausa: da ’ya’yanta biyu maza. Ana kira ɗaya Gershom, domin Musa ya ce, “Na zama baƙo a baƙuwar ƙasa”;
english: and her two sons. The name of one son was Gershom, for Moses said, “I have lived as a foreigner in a foreign land”.

hausa: Matankaɗinsa yana a hannunsa don yă tankaɗe sussukarsa ya kuma tattara alkama cikin rumbunsa, amma zai ƙone yayin da wutar da ba a iya kashewa.”
english: His winnowing fan is in his hand, and he will thoroughly cleanse his threshing floor, and will gather the wheat into his barn; but he will burn up the chaff with unquenchable fire.”

hausa: Sai Dawuda ya rantse wa Shawulu. Sa’an nan Shawulu ya koma gida, amma Dawuda da mutanensa suka haura zuwa wurin ɓuya.
english: David swore to Saul. Saul went home, but David and his men went up to the stronghold.

hausa: “Ku yi ihu da ƙarfi, ba ƙaƙƙautawa. Ku tā da muryarku kamar busar ƙaho. Ku furta wa mutanena tawayensu da kuma ga gidan Yaƙub zunubansu.
english: “Cry aloud! Don’t spare! Lift up your voice like a trumpet! Declare to my people their disobedience, and to the house of Jacob their sins.

hausa: Wata da taurari kuma don su yi mulkin dare; Ƙaunarsa madawwamiya ce.
english: the moon and stars to rule by night, for his loving kindness endures forever;

hausa: Yaya zan koma ga mahaifina, in saurayin ba ya tare da ni? A’a! Kada ka bari in ga baƙin cikin da zai auko wa mahaifina.”
english: For how will I go up to my father, if the boy isn’t with me?—lest I see the evil that will come on my father.”

hausa: da ƙaramin bijimi guda ɗaya, tunkiya ɗaya, da rago, dukansu bana ɗaya-ɗaya domin hadaya ta ƙonawa;
english: one young bull, one ram, one male lamb a year old, for a burnt offering;

hausa: Sa’ad da muƙaddas ɗin ya ga abin da ya faru, sai ya ba da gaskiya, gama ya yi mamaki a kan da koyarwa game Ubangiji.
english: Then the proconsul, when he saw what was done, believed, being astonished at the teaching of the Lord.

hausa: Ibrahim ya bar wa Ishaku kome da ya mallaka.
english: Abraham gave all that he had to Isaac,

hausa: Wani iska ya taɓa mini fuska, sai tsigar jikina ta tashi.
english: Then a spirit passed before my face. The hair of my flesh stood up.

hausa: Ubangiji ya ba su hutawa a kowane gefe kamar yadda ya yi wa kakanninsu alkawari, ba ko ɗaya daga cikin abokan gābansu da ya iya cinsu da yaƙi.
english: Yahweh gave them rest all around, according to all that he swore to their fathers. Not a man of all their enemies stood before them. Yahweh delivered all their enemies into their hand.

hausa: Ku lura da kanku da dukan garken da Ruhu Mai Tsarki ya sa ku ku zama masu kula da shi. Ku zama masu kiwon ikkilisiyar Allah, wadda ya saya da jininsa.
english: Take heed, therefore, to yourselves and to all the flock, in which the Holy Spirit has made you overseers, to shepherd the assembly of the Lord and God which he purchased with his own blood.

hausa: Amma Elihu ɗan Barakel mutumin Buz na iyalin Ram, ya ji haushi da Ayuba don yă nuna shi ne mai gaskiya ba Allah ba.
english: Then the wrath of Elihu the son of Barachel, the Buzite, of the family of Ram, was kindled against Job. His wrath was kindled because he justified himself rather than God.

hausa: Irin waɗannan dokoki suna magana a kan abubuwan da ba sa daɗewa. Su ayyukan mutane ne, sun kuma fito daga koyarwar mutane.
english: (all of which perish with use), according to the precepts and doctrines of men?

hausa: Na zama kamar mutumin da ba ya ji, wanda bakinsa ba ya iya ba da amsa.
english: Yes, I am as a man who doesn’t hear, in whose mouth are no reproofs.

hausa: Ba tare da tambaya ba yana ragargaza masu iko, yă kuma sa waɗansu a wurinsu.
english: He breaks mighty men in pieces in ways past finding out, and sets others in their place.

hausa: waɗanda sukan ɗauka su tsarkaka ne a ganinsu alhali kuwa ƙazamai ne su;
english: There is a generation that is pure in their own eyes, yet are not washed from their filthiness.

hausa: Haka kuma ina ƙara sanar wa kowane mutumin da ya yarda aka yi masa kaciya cewa dole yă kiyaye dukan Doka.
english: Yes, I testify again to every man who receives circumcision that he is a debtor to do the whole law.

hausa: “Ku sammai, ku sauko da adalci kamar ruwan sama; bari gizagizai su zubar da yayyafi kamar adalci. Bari ƙasa ta buɗe, bari ceto ya tsiro, bari adalci ya yi girma tare da shi; ni, Ubangijine, na sa ya faru.
english: Rain, you heavens, from above, and let the skies pour down righteousness. Let the earth open, that it may produce salvation, and let it cause righteousness to spring up with it. I, Yahweh, have created it.

hausa: Tsawon kowane ginshiƙi kamu goma sha takwas ne, kewayensa kuwa kamu goma sha biyu ne, kaurinsa kuma huɗu ne. Kowannensu yana da rami a ciki.
english: As for the pillars, the height of the one pillar was eighteen cubits; and a line of twelve cubits encircled it; and its thickness was four fingers. It was hollow.

hausa: shi da ya gina kyakkyawar fadarsa a cikin sammai ya kuma kafa harsashenta a duniya, shi da yakan kira ruwan teku yă kuma kwarara su a bisa duniya, Ubangiji ne sunansa.
english: It is he who builds his rooms in the heavens, and has founded his vault on the earth; he who calls for the waters of the sea, and pours them out on the surface of the earth—Yahweh is his name.

hausa: na goma sha shida a kan Hezir, na goma sha takwas a kan Haffizzez,
english: the seventeenth to Hezir, the eighteenth to Happizzez,

hausa: Gaddiyel ɗan Sodi, daga kabilar Zebulun;
english: Of the tribe of Zebulun, Gaddiel the son of Sodi.

hausa: Amma Shem da Yafet suka ɗauki mayafi, suka shimfiɗa a kafaɗarsu, sa’an nan suka shiga suna tafiya da baya har zuwa inda mahaifinsu yake kwance, suka rufe tsiraicinsa. Suka kau da fuskokinsu domin kada su ga tsiraicin mahaifinsu.
english: Shem and Japheth took a garment, and laid it on both their shoulders, went in backwards, and covered the nakedness of their father. Their faces were backwards, and they didn’t see their father’s nakedness.

hausa: Bari alhakin jininsu yă koma a kan Yowab da kuma zuriyarsa har abada. Amma bari salamar Ubangiji tă kasance a kan Dawuda da zuriyarsa, da gidansa, da kuma mulkinsa, har abada.”
english: So their blood will return on the head of Joab and on the head of his offspring forever. But for David, for his offspring, for his house, and for his throne, there will be peace forever from Yahweh.”

hausa: Saboda haka Delila ta ce wa Samson, “Ka faɗa miki asirin ƙarfinka da yadda za a ɗaura ka a yi nasara a kanka.”
english: Delilah said to Samson, “Please tell me where your great strength lies, and what you might be bound to afflict you.”

hausa: “Dubi dorina, wadda na halicce ku tare kuma ciyawa take ci kamar sa.
english: “See now behemoth, which I made as well as you. He eats grass as an ox.

hausa: Wane ne ya nuna masa hanyar da zai bi, ko kuma wane ne ya ce masa, ‘Ba ka yi daidai ba?’
english: Who has prescribed his way for him? Or who can say, ‘You have committed unrighteousness’?

hausa: Bari Ubangiji yă nuna muku ƙaunarsa da amincinsa, ni kuma zan nuna muku irin wannan alherin saboda kun yi haka.
english: Now may Yahweh show loving kindness and truth to you. I also will reward you for this kindness, because you have done this thing.

hausa: Amma mutanen ba su juyo wurin wanda ya buge su ba, balle su nemi Ubangiji Maɗaukaki.
english: Yet the people have not turned to him who struck them, neither have they sought Yahweh of Armies.

hausa: Da jin haka, Yahudawa suka fara gunaguni a kansa, domin ya ce, “Ni ne burodin da ya sauka daga sama.”
english: The Jews therefore murmured concerning him, because he said, “I am the bread which came down out of heaven.”

hausa: Cikin lokacin wahalarsa Sarki Ahaz ya ƙara zama marar aminci ga Ubangiji.
english: In the time of his distress, he trespassed yet more against Yahweh, this same King Ahaz.

hausa: Sai ga Barak mai bin sawun Sisera, Yayel kuwa ta fito don marabtarsa, ta ce, “Shigo, zan nuna maka mutumin da kake nema.” Saboda haka ya shiga ciki tare da ita, sai ga Sisera kwance da turken a gindin kunnensa, matacce.
english: Behold, as Barak pursued Sisera, Jael came out to meet him, and said to him, “Come, and I will show you the man whom you seek.” He came to her; and behold, Sisera lay dead, and the tent peg was in his temples.

hausa: Da suka kawo manzannin, sai suka sa su suka bayyana a gaban Majalisar don babban firist ya tuhume su.
english: When they had brought them, they set them before the council. The high priest questioned them,

hausa: Mikal ’yar Shawulu kuwa tana ƙaunar Dawuda sosai. Da aka gaya wa Shawulu labarin, sai ya yi farin ciki, ya yi tunani ya ce,
english: Michal, Saul’s daughter, loved David; and they told Saul, and the thing pleased him.

hausa: Sa’an nan sojojin dukan al’umman da suka yi yaƙi da Ariyel, da suka fāɗa mata da kagararta suka kuma yi mata kwanto, za su zama kamar yadda yake da mafarki, wahayi da dare,
english: The multitude of all the nations that fight against Ariel, even all who fight against her and her stronghold, and who distress her, will be like a dream, a vision of the night.

hausa: Bulus, manzon Kiristi Yesu ta wurin umarnin Allah Mai Cetonmu da kuma na Yesu Kiristi begenmu,
english: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ according to the commandment of God our Savior and the Lord Jesus Christ our hope,

hausa: Da Yesu ya ɗaga ido, sai ya ga waɗansu masu arziki suna sa baikonsu a ma’ajin haikalin.
english: He looked up and saw the rich people who were putting their gifts into the treasury.

hausa: Amma saboda sunana na yi abin da zai kiyaye shi daga ƙazantuwa a idanun al’umman da suka zauna a ciki da kuma a idanun al’ummai da na bayyana kaina ga Isra’ilawa ta wurin fitar da su daga Masar.
english: But I worked for my name’s sake, that it should not be profaned in the sight of the nations among which they were, in whose sight I made myself known to them in bringing them out of the land of Egypt.

hausa: (ga garuruwan da aka ba wa zuriyar Haruna waɗanda suke daga iyalan Kohatawa na Lawiyawa, domin ƙuri’a ta farko ta fāɗa a kansu),
english: and they were for the children of Aaron, of the families of the Kohathites, who were of the children of Levi; for theirs was the first lot.

hausa: Ƙugin kukansu ya kai ko’ina a iyakar Mowab; kururuwarsu ta kai har zuwa Eglayim, makokinsu ya kai har zuwa Beyer-Elim.
english: For the cry has gone around the borders of Moab, its wailing to Eglaim, and its wailing to Beer Elim.

hausa: Me ya sa ka rena maganar Ubangiji ta wurin yin mugunta haka a idonsa? Ka kashe Uriya mutumin Hitti da takobi, ka kuma ɗauki matarsa tă zama matarka. Ka kashe shi da takobin Ammonawa.
english: Why have you despised Yahweh’s word, to do that which is evil in his sight? You have struck Uriah the Hittite with the sword, have taken his wife to be your wife, and have slain him with the sword of the children of Ammon.

hausa: Mutumin farko daga turɓaya ce ya fito, mutum na biyu kuwa daga sama ne ya fito.
english: The first man is of the earth, made of dust. The second man is the Lord from heaven.

hausa: Da suka bar majami’ar, sai suka tafi gidan su Siman da Andarawus, tare da Yaƙub da Yohanna.
english: Immediately, when they had come out of the synagogue, they came into the house of Simon and Andrew, with James and John.

hausa: Hikima, kamar gādo, abu mai kyau ne tana kuma da amfani ga waɗanda suka ga rana.
english: Wisdom is as good as an inheritance. Yes, it is more excellent for those who see the sun.

hausa: Yadda Ubangiji ya rufe Diyar Sihiyona da gizagizan fushi! Ya jefar da darajar Isra’ila daga sama zuwa ƙasa; bai tuna da wurin ɗora ƙafafunsa ba a ranar fushinsa.
english: How has the Lord covered the daughter of Zion with a cloud in his anger! He has cast the beauty of Israel down from heaven to the earth, and hasn’t remembered his footstool in the day of his anger.

hausa: Wani babban taron mutane suka shimfiɗa mayafansu a kan hanya, yayinda waɗansu suka sassari rassan itatuwa suka shisshimfiɗa a kan hanya.
english: A very great multitude spread their clothes on the road. Others cut branches from the trees and spread them on the road.

hausa: “Ga sunayen da za su taimake ku. “Daga kabilar Ruben, Elizur ɗan Shedeyur;
english: These are the names of the men who shall stand with you: Of Reuben: Elizur the son of Shedeur.

hausa: Ina shirin kiran dukan mutanen masarautar arewanci,” in ji Ubangiji. “Sarakunansu za su zo su kafa kursiyoyinsu a mashigin ƙofofin Urushalima; za su zo su kewaye dukan katangarta su kewaye dukan garuruwan Yahuda.
english: For behold, I will call all the families of the kingdoms of the north,” says Yahweh. “They will come, and they will each set his throne at the entrance of the gates of Jerusalem, and against all its walls all around, and against all the cities of Judah.

hausa: Duk waɗanda suka yi zunubi a rashi sanin doka, a rashin doka za su hallaka, waɗanda kuma suka yi zunubi ƙarƙashin doka, a ƙarƙashin doka za a hukunta su.
english: For as many as have sinned without the law will also perish without the law. As many as have sinned under the law will be judged by the law.

hausa: Dubi yadda abokan gābana sun ƙaru da kuma yadda suka ƙara ƙina!
english: Consider my enemies, for they are many. They hate me with cruel hatred.

hausa: ’Ya’yan Merari su ne, daga Ya’aziya, Beno, Shoham, Zakkur da Ibri.
english: The sons of Merari by Jaaziah: Beno, Shoham, Zaccur, and Ibri.

hausa: Sa’ad da ƙanƙara ta fāɗi, ba ta jin tsoro saboda gidanta; gama dukansu suna da tufafi masu kauri.
english: She is not afraid of the snow for her household, for all her household are clothed with scarlet.

hausa: Sama’ila dai ya riga ya rasu, dukan Isra’ila suka yi makokinsa suka binne shi a garinsa a Rama. Shawulu kuma ya kori duk masu duba da masu maitanci daga ƙasar.
english: Now Samuel was dead, and all Israel had mourned for him and buried him in Ramah, even in his own city. Saul had sent away those who had familiar spirits and the wizards out of the land.

hausa: sai wata mata ta saki ɗan dutsen niƙa a kan Abimelek ta fasa ƙoƙon kansa.
english: A certain woman cast an upper millstone on Abimelech’s head, and broke his skull.

hausa: Masu girman kai sun haƙa mini rami, sun ƙetare dokarka.
english: The proud have dug pits for me, contrary to your law.

hausa: Da zarar waɗannan alamu sun cika, sai ka aikata duk abin da kana iya yi gama Allah yana tare da kai.
english: Let it be, when these signs have come to you, that you do what is appropriate for the occasion; for God is with you.

hausa: Su ne suka zama sanadin baƙin ciki ga Ishaku da Rebeka.
english: They grieved Isaac’s and Rebekah’s spirits.

hausa: “Ka tafi ka faɗa wa Hezekiya, ‘Ga abin da Ubangiji Allah na kakanka Dawuda, ya ce na ji addu’arka na kuma ga hawayenka; zan ƙara maka shekaru goma sha biyar ga rayuwarka.
english: “Go, and tell Hezekiah, ‘Yahweh, the God of David your father, says, “I have heard your prayer. I have seen your tears. Behold, I will add fifteen years to your life.

hausa: In na tashi a fikafikan safiya, in na sauka a gefe mai nisa na teku,
english: If I take the wings of the dawn, and settle in the uttermost parts of the sea,

hausa: Sai suka ba wa wurin suna, Massa da Meriba, saboda Isra’ilawa sun yi jayayya, suka kuma gwada Ubangiji cewa, “Ubangiji yana tsakaninmu ko babu?”
english: He called the name of the place Massah, and Meribah, because the children of Israel quarreled, and because they tested Yahweh, saying, “Is Yahweh among us, or not?”

hausa: Amma fa, in macen ba tă ƙazantar da kanta ba, ba tă kuma da ƙazanta, za a kuɓutar da ita daga laifin, za tă kuma iya haihuwa.
english: If the woman isn’t defiled, but is clean; then she shall be free, and shall conceive offspring.

hausa: Sa’an nan mutanen Benyamin suka haɗa kansu suka koyi bayan Abner. Suka zama ƙungiya guda, suka tsaya daram a kan tudu.
english: The children of Benjamin gathered themselves together after Abner and became one band, and stood on the top of a hill.

hausa: Da suka gwada a mudu, wanda ya tattara da yawa bai sami mafi yawa ba, wanda kuma ya tattara kaɗan bai sami ƙanƙani ba. Kowane mutum ya tattara daidai bukatarsa.
english: When they measured it with an omer, he who gathered much had nothing over, and he who gathered little had no lack. They each gathered according to his eating.

hausa: Yaƙub ya ce wa Yusuf, “Allah Maɗaukaki ya bayyana gare ni a Luz a ƙasar Kan’ana, a can ya albarkace ni
english: Jacob said to Joseph, “God Almighty appeared to me at Luz in the land of Canaan, and blessed me,

hausa: Isra’ilawa suka sāke yin kuka ga Ubangiji, ya kuwa ba su mai ceto, Ehud, wani bahago, ɗan Gera daga kabilar Benyamin. Isra’ilawa suka aike shi da haraji wurin Eglon sarkin Mowab.
english: But when the children of Israel cried to Yahweh, Yahweh raised up a savior for them: Ehud the son of Gera, the Benjamite, a left-handed man. The children of Israel sent tribute by him to Eglon the king of Moab.

hausa: Yawanci suna cewa, “Wa zai yi mana alheri?” Bari hasken fuskarka yă haskaka a kanmu, ya Ubangiji.
english: Many say, “Who will show us any good?” Yahweh, let the light of your face shine on us.

hausa: “ ‘Ni Ubangiji na faɗa. Lokaci ya zo da zan aikata. Ba zan janye ba; ba zan ji tausayi ba, ba kuwa zan bari ba. Za a hukunta ki bisa ga hali da ayyukanki, in ji Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka.’ ”
english: “‘“I, Yahweh, have spoken it. It will happen, and I will do it. I won’t go back. I won’t spare. I won’t repent. According to your ways and according to your doings, they will judge you,” says the Lord Yahweh.’”

hausa: Fuskokinsu sun yi kamar haka. Kowanne a cikin huɗun yana da fuskar mutum, kuma a gefen dama kowanne yana da fuskar zaki, a hagu kuma fuskar maraƙi; kowanne yana kuma da fuskar gaggafa.
english: As for the likeness of their faces, they had the face of a man. The four of them had the face of a lion on the right side. The four of them had the face of an ox on the left side. The four of them also had the face of an eagle.

hausa: A lokacin da kake dubawa, sai aka yanko wani dutse, amma ba da hannun mutum ba. Ya fāɗa a kan ƙafafun siffar na ƙarfen da aka haɗa da yumɓu aka kuma ragargaje su.
english: You saw until a stone was cut out without hands, which struck the image on its feet that were of iron and clay, and broke them in pieces.

hausa: Da Siman Bitrus ya ga wannan, sai ya fāɗi a gaban Yesu ya ce, “Rabu da ni, Ubangiji. Ni mai zunubi ne!”
english: But Simon Peter, when he saw it, fell down at Jesus’ knees, saying, “Depart from me, for I am a sinful man, Lord.”

hausa: Sai dai yă cika bakinka da dariya, yă sa ka yi sowa ta murna.
english: He will still fill your mouth with laughter, your lips with shouting.

hausa: Bawan ya ce masa, “Me zai faru in matar ba tă yarda tă zo tare da ni zuwa wannan ƙasa ba? In komar da ɗanka a ƙasar da ka fito ne ke nan?”
english: The servant said to him, “What if the woman isn’t willing to follow me to this land? Must I bring your son again to the land you came from?”

hausa: Sai Bitrus ya tuna da maganar da Yesu ya yi cewa, “Kafin zakara yă yi cara, za ka yi mūsun sani na sau uku.” Sai ya fita waje, ya yi ta kuka.
english: Peter remembered the word which Jesus had said to him, “Before the rooster crows, you will deny me three times.” Then he went out and wept bitterly.

hausa: “In bijimi ya kashe namiji ko ta mace, dole a jajjefe bijimin har yă mutu, ba za a kuma ci namansa ba. Amma mai bijimin ba shi da laifi.
english: “If a bull gores a man or a woman to death, the bull shall surely be stoned, and its meat shall not be eaten; but the owner of the bull shall not be held responsible.

hausa: Ya yi tafiya a hanyoyin mahaifinsa Asa bai kuwa kauce daga gare su ba; ya yi abin da yake daidai a gaban Ubangiji.
english: He walked in the way of Asa his father, and didn’t turn away from it, doing that which was right in Yahweh’s eyes.

hausa: Yana ɗaukaka masu sauƙinkai, yana kāre waɗanda suke makoki.
english: so that he sets up on high those who are low, those who mourn are exalted to safety.

hausa: Ya kamata irin waɗannan mutane su gane cewa abin da muke faɗa a cikin wasiƙunmu sa’ad da ba ma nan tare da ku, shi muke aikatawa sa’ad da muke nan.
english: Let such a person consider this, that what we are in word by letters when we are absent, such are we also in deed when we are present.

hausa: Gama waɗanda Allah ya rigyasani ya kuma ƙaddara su dace da kamannin Ɗansa, don yă zama ɗan fari cikin ’yan’uwa masu yawa.
english: For whom he foreknew, he also predestined to be conformed to the image of his Son, that he might be the firstborn among many brothers.

hausa: Sa’an nan wani sarki, wanda bai san kome game da Yusuf ba, ya zama mai mulkin Masar.
english: until there arose a different king who didn’t know Joseph.

hausa: Kai! Ke kyakkyawa ce kuma kina sa ni jin daɗi, Ya ƙaunatacciya, da farin cikin da kike kawo!
english: How beautiful and how pleasant you are, love, for delights!

hausa: Ya kuma bi shawararsu sa’ad da ya tafi tare da Yoram ɗan Ahab sarkin Isra’ila don yă yaƙi Hazayel sarkin Aram a Ramot Gileyad. Sai Arameyawa suka yi wa Yoram rauni;
english: He also followed their counsel, and went with Jehoram the son of Ahab king of Israel to war against Hazael king of Syria at Ramoth Gilead; and the Syrians wounded Joram.

hausa: Dawuda ya faɗa wa shugabannin Lawiyawa su sa ’yan’uwansu su zama mawaƙa don su rera waƙoƙi masu farin ciki, da kayayyakin bushe-bushe, da kaɗe-kaɗe, molaye, garayu da ganguna.
english: David spoke to the chief of the Levites to appoint their brothers as singers with instruments of music, stringed instruments, harps, and cymbals, sounding aloud and lifting up their voices with joy.

hausa: Ku saurari umarnina ku kuma zama masu hikima; kada ku ƙyale ta.
english: Hear instruction, and be wise. Don’t refuse it.

hausa: Da suka isa kan iyakar Misiya, suka yi ƙoƙari su shiga Bitiniya, amma Ruhun Yesu bai yarda musu ba.
english: When they had come opposite Mysia, they tried to go into Bithynia, but the Spirit didn’t allow them.

hausa: Bayan ya haifi Lamek, Metusela ya yi shekaru 782, ya kuma haifi waɗansu ’ya’ya maza da mata.
english: Methuselah lived after he became the father of Lamech seven hundred eighty-two years, and became the father of other sons and daughters.

hausa: “Dattawan Isra’ila za su saurare ka. Sa’an nan da kai da dattawan Isra’ila, za ku tafi wurin sarkin Masar, ku ce masa, ‘Ubangiji, Allah na Ibraniyawa, ya sadu da mu. Bari mu yi tafiyar kwana uku zuwa cikin hamada domin mu yi hadaya wa Ubangiji Allahnmu.’
english: They will listen to your voice. You shall come, you and the elders of Israel, to the king of Egypt, and you shall tell him, ‘Yahweh, the God of the Hebrews, has met with us. Now please let us go three days’ journey into the wilderness, that we may sacrifice to Yahweh, our God.’

hausa: Sai na je Urushalima, bayan na zauna a can na kwanaki uku,
english: So I came to Jerusalem, and was there three days.

hausa: Kamar yadda aka tumɓuke Sodom da Gomorra, tare da garuruwan da suke maƙwabtaka da su,” in ji Ubangiji, “haka ba wanda zai zauna a can; ba wani da zai zauna a cikinta.
english: As in the overthrow of Sodom and Gomorrah and its neighbor cities,” says Yahweh, “no man will dwell there, neither will any son of man live therein.

hausa: Kash, da ceton Isra’ila zai fito daga Sihiyona mana! Sa’ad da Ubangiji zai maido da sa’ar mutanensa, bari Yaƙub yă yi farin ciki Isra’ila kuma yă yi murna!
english: Oh that the salvation of Israel would come out of Zion! When Yahweh restores the fortunes of his people, then Jacob shall rejoice, and Israel shall be glad.

hausa: An zubar da ni kamar ruwa, kuma dukan ƙasusuwana sun fiffito daga mahaɗai. Zuciyata ta zama kaki; ta narke a cikina.
english: I am poured out like water. All my bones are out of joint. My heart is like wax. It is melted within me.

hausa: Duk da haka, lokaci yana zuwa har ma ya riga ya yi, da masu sujada na gaskiya za su yi wa Uba sujada a Ruhu da kuma gaskiya, gama irin waɗannan masu sujada ne Uba yake nema.
english: But the hour comes, and now is, when the true worshipers will worship the Father in spirit and truth, for the Father seeks such to be his worshipers.

hausa: Sa’ad da taron mutane suka ji Filibus suka kuma ga abubuwan banmamakin da ya yi, sai duk suka mai da hankali sosai ga abin da ya faɗa.
english: The multitudes listened with one accord to the things that were spoken by Philip when they heard and saw the signs which he did.

hausa: Samariyawa da yawa daga wannan gari suka gaskata da shi saboda shaidar macen da ta ce, “Ya gaya mini duk abin da na taɓa yi.”
english: From that city many of the Samaritans believed in him because of the word of the woman, who testified, “He told me everything that I have done.”

hausa: bautar gumaka da sihiri; ƙiyayya, faɗa, kishi, fushi mai zafi, sonkai, tsattsaguwa, hamayya,
english: idolatry, sorcery, hatred, strife, jealousies, outbursts of anger, rivalries, divisions, heresies,

hausa: Sai ya ce mini, “Ɗan mutum, ka ci wannan littafin da nake ba ka, ka kuma cika cikinka da shi.” Sai na ci shi, ya kuma yi zaki kamar zuma a bakina.
english: He said to me, “Son of man, eat this scroll that I give you and fill your belly and your bowels with it.” Then I ate it. It was as sweet as honey in my mouth.

hausa: To, fa, Ubangiji Allah ya yi lambu a gabas, a Eden, a can kuwa ya sa mutumin da ya yi.
english: Yahweh God planted a garden eastward, in Eden, and there he put the man whom he had formed.

hausa: Ya ba ku Manna don ku ci a cikin hamada, wani abin da kakanninku ba su taɓa sani ba, don yă ƙasƙantar yă kuma gwada ku, saboda yă yi muku alheri daga baya.
english: who fed you in the wilderness with manna, which your fathers didn’t know, that he might humble you, and that he might prove you, to do you good at your latter end;

hausa: Za a tsarkake mutane da yawa, za a maishe su marasa aibi a kuma tace su; amma mugaye za su ci gaba da mugunta. Babu wani mugun da zai fahimta, amma waɗanda za su zama masu hikima za su fahimta.
english: Many will purify themselves, and make themselves white, and be refined, but the wicked will do wickedly; and none of the wicked will understand, but those who are wise will understand.

hausa: sai an zubo Ruhu a kanmu daga sama, hamada kuma ta zama ƙasar mai taƙi, gona mai taƙi kuma ta zama kamar kurmi.
english: until the Spirit is poured on us from on high, and the wilderness becomes a fruitful field, and the fruitful field is considered a forest.

hausa: Isra’ilawa suka ce musu, “Da ma a hannun Ubangiji ne muka mutu a Masar, inda muka zauna kewaye da tukwanen nama, muna cin duk abincin da muke so, amma kun kawo mu cikin wannan hamada don ku kashe dukan wannan taro da yunwa.”
english: and the children of Israel said to them, “We wish that we had died by Yahweh’s hand in the land of Egypt, when we sat by the meat pots, when we ate our fill of bread, for you have brought us out into this wilderness to kill this whole assembly with hunger.”

hausa: “Kamar yadda sabuwar duniya da sabuwar sama za su tabbata a gabana,” in ji Ubangiji, “haka sunanku da zuriyarku za su tabbata.
english: “For as the new heavens and the new earth, which I will make, shall remain before me,” says Yahweh, “so your offspring and your name shall remain.

hausa: Filistiyawa suka tattaru suka yi sansani a Shunem. Shawulu ya tattara dukan Isra’ila suka yi sansani a Gilbowa.
english: The Philistines gathered themselves together, and came and encamped in Shunem; and Saul gathered all Israel together, and they encamped in Gilboa.

hausa: Ko da yake Elnatan, Delahiya da Gemariya sun roƙi sarki kada yă ƙone littafin, bai saurare su ba.
english: Moreover Elnathan and Delaiah and Gemariah had made intercession to the king that he would not burn the scroll; but he would not listen to them.

hausa: “Yanzu kuwa baiwarka tana cewa, ‘Bari magana ranka yă daɗe sarki yă ba ni hutu, gama ranka yă daɗe sarki yana kama da mala’ikan Allah cikin rarrabe nagarta da mugunta. Bari Ubangiji Allahnka yă kasance tare da kai.’ ”
english: Then your servant said, ‘Please let the word of my lord the king bring rest; for as an angel of God, so is my lord the king to discern good and bad. May Yahweh, your God, be with you.’”

hausa: “ ‘Sai kuka ƙetare Urdun kuka isa Yeriko. Mutanen Yeriko suka yi faɗa da ku, kamar yadda Amoriyawa, Ferizziyawa, Kan’aniyawa, Hittiyawa, Girgashiyawa, Hiwiyawa, da Yebusiyawa suka yi, amma na ba da su a hannunku.
english: “‘You went over the Jordan, and came to Jericho. The men of Jericho fought against you, the Amorite, the Perizzite, the Canaanite, the Hittite, the Girgashite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite; and I delivered them into your hand.

hausa: Ya jira har kwana bakwai bisa ga lokacin da Sama’ila ya bayar. Amma Sama’ila bai zo Gilgal ba, mutanen Shawulu suka fara watsewa.
english: He stayed seven days, according to the time set by Samuel; but Samuel didn’t come to Gilgal, and the people were scattering from him.

hausa: Da ma a ce masu tā da hankalinku ɗin nan su yanke gabansu gaba ɗaya mana!
english: I wish that those who disturb you would cut themselves off.

hausa: Za a miƙa hadaya ta ƙonawa da bijimi guda, rago guda, da kuma ’yan raguna bakwai, ’yan bana ɗaya-ɗaya, dukansu marasa lahani don daɗin ƙanshi ga Ubangiji.
english: but you shall offer a burnt offering to Yahweh for a pleasant aroma: one young bull, one ram, seven male lambs a year old, all without defect;

hausa: Zuciya mai farin ciki kan sa fuska tă yi haske, amma ciwon zuciya kan ragargaza rai.
english: A glad heart makes a cheerful face, but an aching heart breaks the spirit.

hausa: Game da sauran ayyukan mulkin Yehu, da dukan abin da ya yi, a rubuce suke a cikin littafin tarihin sarakunan Isra’ila.
english: Now the rest of the acts of Jehu, and all that he did, and all his might, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

hausa: ku fita zuwa Kwarin Ben Hinnom, kusa da mashigin Ƙofar Kasko. A can ka furta maganganun da na faɗa maka,
english: and go out to the valley of the son of Hinnom, which is by the entry of the gate Harsith, and proclaim there the words that I will tell you.

hausa: “Can tsakar dare, sai aka ji kira, ana cewa, ‘Ga ango nan! Ku fito, ku tarye shi!’
english: But at midnight there was a cry, ‘Behold! The bridegroom is coming! Come out to meet him!’

hausa: saboda haka muddin ina raye, in ji Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka, zan sa a zub da jininka zan kuwa fafare ka. Da yake ba ka ƙi zub da jini ba, zub da jini zai fafare ka.
english: therefore, as I live,” says the Lord Yahweh, “I will prepare you for blood, and blood will pursue you. Since you have not hated blood, therefore blood will pursue you.

hausa: Mutum yakan yi farin ciki a ba da amsar da take daidai, kuma ina misali a yi magana a lokacin da ya dace!
english: Joy comes to a man with the reply of his mouth. How good is a word at the right time!

hausa: Sammai sun yi shelar adalcinsa, dukan mutane kuma suka ga ɗaukakarsa.
english: The heavens declare his righteousness. All the peoples have seen his glory.

hausa: “Ni kaina na faɗa, “ ‘Da farin ciki zan ɗauke ki kamar ’ya’yana maza in ba ki ƙasa mai daɗi, gādo mafi kyau da wata al’umma.’ Na zaci za ki kira ni ‘Mahaifi’ ba za ki ƙara rabuwa da bina ba.
english: “But I said, ‘How I desire to put you among the children, and give you a pleasant land, a goodly heritage of the armies of the nations!’ and I said, ‘You shall call me “My Father”, and shall not turn away from following me.’

hausa: Amma bayan sun kai shi can, sai hannun Ubangiji ya yi gāba da birnin, aka jefa shi cikin wani mawuyacin hali. Ya buga mutanen birnin da marurai, babba da yaro.
english: It was so, that after they had carried it there, Yahweh’s hand was against the city with a very great confusion; and he struck the men of the city, both small and great, so that tumors broke out on them.

hausa: “Maigidansa ya amsa ya ce, ‘Madalla, bawan kirki mai aminci! Ka yi aminci a kan abubuwa kaɗan, zan sa ka lura da abubuwa masu yawa. Zo ka yi farin ciki tare da maigidanka!’
english: “His lord said to him, ‘Well done, good and faithful servant. You have been faithful over a few things, I will set you over many things. Enter into the joy of your lord.’

hausa: Firist zai kaɗa ’yan raguna biyun a gaban Ubangiji, a matsayin hadaya ta kaɗawa, tare da burodin sababbin ’ya’yan fari na itatuwan. Tsarkaken hadaya ce ga Ubangiji ga firist.
english: The priest shall wave them with the bread of the first fruits for a wave offering before Yahweh, with the two lambs. They shall be holy to Yahweh for the priest.

hausa: A shekara ta uku ta mulkin sarki Belshazar, ni, Daniyel, na ga wahayi, bayan wancan da na riga gani.
english: In the third year of the reign of King Belshazzar, a vision appeared to me, even to me, Daniel, after that which appeared to me at the first.

hausa: Yayinda Haruna yake magana da dukan taron Isra’ila, sai suka duba wajen hamada, sai ga ɗaukakar Ubangiji tana bayyana a girgije.
english: As Aaron spoke to the whole congregation of the children of Israel, they looked toward the wilderness, and behold, Yahweh’s glory appeared in the cloud.

hausa: Sai dai kun san cewa Kiristi ya bayyana ne domin yă ɗauke zunubanmu. A cikinsa kuwa babu zunubi.
english: You know that he was revealed to take away our sins, and no sin is in him.

hausa: Ya yi aminci ga wanda ya naɗa shi, kamar yadda Musa ya yi aminci ga dukan gidan Allah.
english: who was faithful to him who appointed him, as also Moses was in all his house.

hausa: na tuna da waƙoƙina da dare. Zuciyata ta yi nishi, ƙarfina kuwa ya nemi yă sani.
english: I remember my song in the night. I consider in my own heart; my spirit diligently inquires:

hausa: Ba cewa na riga na sami dukan wannan ba ne, ko kuma an riga an mai da ni cikakke ba, sai dai ina nacewa don in kai ga samun abin da Kiristi Yesu ya riƙe ni saboda shi.
english: Not that I have already obtained, or am already made perfect; but I press on, that I may take hold of that for which also I was taken hold of by Christ Jesus.

hausa: Ya ce musu, “Ku saurari wannan mafarkin da na yi.
english: He said to them, “Please hear this dream which I have dreamed:

hausa: Sa’an nan yă fara dūkan ’yan’uwansa bayi, yana ci yana kuma sha tare da mashaya.
english: and begins to beat his fellow servants, and eat and drink with the drunkards,

hausa: Duk mai la’akari da iska, ba zai yi shuka ba, mai la’akari da gizagizai kuma, ba zai yi girbi ba.
english: He who observes the wind won’t sow; and he who regards the clouds won’t reap.

hausa: har ma da dogayen sandunan kewayen filin da rammukansu, turakun tenti, igiyoyi, da dukan kayayyaki, da kuma dukan abubuwan da suke dangane da amfaninsu. Ka ba wa kowane mutum ayyuka na musamman da zai yi.
english: the pillars of the court around it, their sockets, their pins, their cords, with all their instruments, and with all their service. You shall appoint the instruments of the duty of their burden to them by name.

hausa: A dukan lokutan da take kango, ƙasar za tă sami hutun da ba tă samu a lokutan asabbatan da kuke zama a cikinta ba.
english: As long as it lies desolate it shall have rest, even the rest which it didn’t have in your Sabbaths when you lived on it.

hausa: za ku jira sai sun yi girma? Za ku ci gaba da kasance babu aure saboda su? A’a, ’ya’yana mata. Ina da baƙin ciki ƙwarai fiye da ku, domin hannun Ubangiji ya yi gāba da ni!”
english: would you then wait until they were grown? Would you then refrain from having husbands? No, my daughters, for it grieves me seriously for your sakes, for Yahweh’s hand has gone out against me.”

hausa: Ta ce wa sarki, “Labarin da na ji a ƙasata game da abin da ka yi da kuma hikimarka gaskiya ne.
english: She said to the king, “It was a true report that I heard in my own land of your acts and of your wisdom.

hausa: To, fa, sai Ubangiji ya ce wa Musa, “Zan ƙara kawo annoba guda a kan Fir’auna da kan Masar. Bayan haka, zai bar ku, ku fita daga nan. Sa’ad da ya yi haka kuwa, zai kore ku gaba ɗaya.
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “I will bring yet one more plague on Pharaoh, and on Egypt; afterwards he will let you go. When he lets you go, he will surely thrust you out altogether.

hausa: Allah ruhu ne, masu yi masa sujada kuwa dole su yi masa sujada a ruhu, da gaskiya kuma.”
english: God is spirit, and those who worship him must worship in spirit and truth.”

hausa: “Gama ta wurin Doka na mutu ga Doka saboda in rayu ga Allah.
english: For I through the law died to the law, that I might live to God.

hausa: Sai ma ya zama mun zama masu ba da shaidar ƙarya game da Allah ke nan, domin mun shaida game da Allah cewa ya tashe Kiristi daga matattu. Bai tashe Kiristi ba ke nan, in lalle ba a tā da matattu.
english: Yes, we are also found false witnesses of God, because we testified about God that he raised up Christ, whom he didn’t raise up if it is true that the dead are not raised.

hausa: Ba za a ɗauki dutsen yin kusurwa daga gare ki ba ko na kafa harsashen gini, gama za ki zama marar amfani har abada,” in ji Ubangiji.
english: They won’t take a cornerstone from you, nor a stone for foundations; but you will be desolate forever,” says Yahweh.

hausa: Kada ku damu game da kome sai dai a cikin abu duka, ku gabatar da roƙe-roƙenku ga Allah ta wurin addu’a da roƙo, tare da godiya.
english: In nothing be anxious, but in everything, by prayer and petition with thanksgiving, let your requests be made known to God.

hausa: Shi kuma ya ce musu, “Wannan shi ne umarnin Ubangiji, ‘Gobe za tă zama ranar hutu, Asabbaci mai tsarki ga Ubangiji. Domin haka sai ku toya abin da kuke so ku toya, ku kuma dafa abin da kuke so ku dafa. Abin da ya rage ku ajiye har safe.’ ”
english: He said to them, “This is that which Yahweh has spoken, ‘Tomorrow is a solemn rest, a holy Sabbath to Yahweh. Bake that which you want to bake, and boil that which you want to boil; and all that remains over lay up for yourselves to be kept until the morning.’”

hausa: Ubangiji ya ga irin muguwar wahalar da ta shafi kowa a Isra’ila, ko bawa ko ’yantacce, babu mai taimakonsu.
english: For Yahweh saw the affliction of Israel, that it was very bitter for all, slave and free; and there was no helper for Israel.

hausa: Kada ku sa rigar ulu da aka gauraye da lilin aka saƙa.
english: You shall not wear clothes of wool and linen woven together.

hausa: Ruhu da kuma amarya suna cewa, “Zo!” Duk wanda ya ji kuwa, yă ce, “Zo!” Duk mai jin ƙishirwa, yă zo; duk mai bukata kuma, yă ɗibi ruwan rai kyauta.
english: The Spirit and the bride say, “Come!” He who hears, let him say, “Come!” He who is thirsty, let him come. He who desires, let him take the water of life freely.

hausa: ya ce, “Kowa yakan kawo ruwan inabi mafi kyau da fari, sa’an nan marar kyan bayan baƙin sun sha da yawa; amma ka ajiye ruwan inabi mafi kyau sai yanzu.”
english: and said to him, “Everyone serves the good wine first, and when the guests have drunk freely, then that which is worse. You have kept the good wine until now!”

hausa: Ban da hadaya ta ƙonawa ta kullum tare da hadaya ta sha, za a miƙa bunsuru ɗaya ga Ubangiji, hadaya ce don zunubi.
english: Also, one male goat for a sin offering to Yahweh shall be offered in addition to the continual burnt offering and its drink offering.

hausa: suka ce masa, “Ba ka san cewa Ba’alis sarkin Ammonawa ya aiki Ishmayel ɗan Netaniya ya ɗauke ranka ba?” Amma Gedaliya ɗan Ahikam bai gaskata su ba.
english: and said to him, “Do you know that Baalis the king of the children of Ammon has sent Ishmael the son of Nethaniah to take your life?” But Gedaliah the son of Ahikam didn’t believe them.

hausa: A cikin waɗancan al’ummai ba za ku sami hutu ba, ba wurin hutu wa tafin ƙafanku. A can Ubangiji zai sa fargaba a zuciyarku, yă sa idanunku su lalace, ranku zai yi suwu.
english: Among these nations you will find no ease, and there will be no rest for the sole of your foot; but Yahweh will give you there a trembling heart, failing of eyes, and pining of soul.

hausa: Sai Yesu ya ce wa bayin, “Ku ciccika tulunan da ruwa.” Suka kuwa ciccika su fal.
english: Jesus said to them, “Fill the water pots with water.” So they filled them up to the brim.

hausa: Yesu ya ce masa, “Zan je in warkar da shi.”
english: Jesus said to him, “I will come and heal him.”

hausa: Faranta mana zuciya kamar yawan kwanakin da muka sha azaba, kamar yawan shekarun da muka ga wahala.
english: Make us glad for as many days as you have afflicted us, for as many years as we have seen evil.

hausa: a gaban Efraim, Benyamin da Manasse. Ka tā da ƙarfinka; ka zo ka cece mu.
english: Before Ephraim, Benjamin, and Manasseh, stir up your might! Come to save us!

hausa: Dukan sarakunan duniya suna kwance a mace, kowa a kabarinsa.
english: All the kings of the nations sleep in glory, everyone in his own house.

hausa: Suka yi hadaya ga aljanu, waɗanda ba Allah ba, ga allolin da ba su sani ba, ga allolin da aka shigo da su daga baya, allolin da kakanninku ba su ji tsoronsu ba.
english: They sacrificed to demons, not God, to gods that they didn’t know, to new gods that came up recently, which your fathers didn’t dread.

hausa: Sa’ad da kuka taru, ba Cimar Ubangiji kuke ci ba,
english: When therefore you assemble yourselves together, it is not the Lord’s supper that you eat.

hausa: ƙasa mai alkama da sha’ir, inabi da ɓaure, rumman, man zaitun da zuma;
english: a land of wheat, barley, vines, fig trees, and pomegranates; a land of olive trees and honey;

hausa: Sa’ad da aka fitar da aljanin kuwa, sai beben ya yi magana. Taron suka yi mamaki suka ce, “Ba a taɓa ganin irin wannan abu a Isra’ila ba.”
english: When the demon was cast out, the mute man spoke. The multitudes marveled, saying, “Nothing like this has ever been seen in Israel!”

hausa: Amma da a ce bawan ya yi tunani a zuciyarsa ya ce, ‘Ai, maigidana ya yi jinkirin dawowa,’ sa’an nan ya fara dūkan bayin, maza da mata, ya kuma shiga ci, da sha, har da buguwa.
english: But if that servant says in his heart, ‘My lord delays his coming,’ and begins to beat the menservants and the maidservants, and to eat and drink and to be drunken,

hausa: Sai suka ɗauki rigar Yusuf, suka yanka akuya suka tsoma rigar a cikin jinin.
english: They took Joseph’s tunic, and killed a male goat, and dipped the tunic in the blood.

hausa: In Ubangiji Allahnku ya fadada yankinku, kamar yadda ya alkawarta da rantsuwa wa kakanninku, ya kuma ba ku ƙasar gaba ɗaya kamar yadda ya yi musu alkawari,
english: If Yahweh your God enlarges your border, as he has sworn to your fathers, and gives you all the land which he promised to give to your fathers;

hausa: Shanu masu kyau nan, shekaru bakwai ne, kawunan dawa bakwai ƙosassun nan kuwa shekaru bakwai ne; mafarkan iri ɗaya ne.
english: The seven good cattle are seven years; and the seven good heads of grain are seven years. The dream is one.

hausa: Amma waɗansunsu suka taurara; suka ƙi su gaskata kuma a gaban jama’a suka yi baƙar magana game da Hanyar. Bulus kuwa ya bar su. Ya tafi tare da almajirai ya dinga tattaunawa da su kullum a babban ɗakin jawabi na Tirannus.
english: But when some were hardened and disobedient, speaking evil of the Way before the multitude, he departed from them and separated the disciples, reasoning daily in the school of Tyrannus.

hausa: “A lokacin nan aka haifi Musa, shi kuwa ba kamar sauran jarirai ba ne. Wata uku aka yi renonsa a gidan mahaifinsa.
english: At that time Moses was born, and was exceedingly handsome to God. He was nourished three months in his father’s house.

hausa: Ku zauna cikin ƙaunar Allah yayinda kuke jira jinƙan Ubangijinmu Yesu Kiristi don yă kawo ku ga rai madawwami.
english: Keep yourselves in God’s love, looking for the mercy of our Lord Jesus Christ to eternal life.

hausa: saboda haka ka faɗa wa waɗanda suka shafe da farar ƙasa cewa za tă fāɗi. Ruwan sama zai sauko da rigyawa, zan kuma aika da ƙanƙara, kuma babbar iska za tă ɓarke.
english: Tell those who plaster it with whitewash that it will fall. There will be an overflowing shower; and you, great hailstones, will fall. A stormy wind will tear it.

hausa: In har wata da taurari ba su da tsarki a idanunsa,
english: Behold, even the moon has no brightness, and the stars are not pure in his sight;

hausa: Wannan haikali zai zama tarin juji. Duk wanda ya wuce ta hanyan nan kuwa zai ji tausayi, yă kuma yi tsaki yana cewa, ‘Me ya sa Ubangiji ya yi haka ga wannan ƙasa da kuma wannan haikali?’
english: Though this house is so high, yet everyone who passes by it will be astonished and hiss; and they will say, ‘Why has Yahweh done this to this land and to this house?’

hausa: ’Ya’yan Shimeyi maza kuwa su ne, Yahat, Zina, Yewush da Beriya. Waɗannan su ne ’ya’yan Shimeyi maza, su huɗu ne duka.
english: The sons of Shimei: Jahath, Zina, Jeush, and Beriah. These four were the sons of Shimei.

hausa: To, sai ki lura kada ki sha ruwan inabi ko wani abu mai sa maye, kada kuma ki ci wani abu marar tsarki,
english: Now therefore please beware and drink no wine nor strong drink, and don’t eat any unclean thing;

hausa: Da adalci za a kafa ke. Zalunci zai yi nesa da ke; ba za ki kasance da wani abin da za ki ji tsoro ba. Za a kawar da duk wani abin banrazana; ba zai yi kusa da ke ba.
english: You will be established in righteousness. You will be far from oppression, for you will not be afraid, and far from terror, for it shall not come near you.

hausa: ya kuma aika zuwa ga Kan’aniyawa a gabas da yamma; da kuma zuwa ga Amoriyawa, Hittiyawa da Ferizziyawa, da Yebusiyawa da suke kan tuddai; da kuma Hiwiyawa masu zama a gindin dutsen Hermon a yankin Mizfa.
english: to the Canaanite on the east and on the west, the Amorite, the Hittite, the Perizzite, the Jebusite in the hill country, and the Hivite under Hermon in the land of Mizpah.

hausa: Amma mu kam, ba za mu yi taƙama mu zarce iyakarmu ba, sai dai za mu yi taƙama cikin filin da Allah ya ƙayyade mana, filin kuwa ya kai har zuwa wurinku.
english: But we will not boast beyond proper limits, but within the boundaries with which God appointed to us, which reach even to you.

hausa: Sa’ad da sarki ya ba da hadaya ta yardar rai ga Ubangiji, ko hadaya ta ƙonawa ce ko hadayun salama ne, sai a buɗe masa ƙofar da take fuskantar gabas. Zai miƙa hadayarsa ta ƙonawa ko hadayarsa ta salama yadda yakan yi a ranar Asabbaci. Sa’an nan ya fita, bayan kuma ya fita, sai a rufe ƙofar.
english: When the prince prepares a free will offering, a burnt offering or peace offerings as a free will offering to Yahweh, one shall open for him the gate that looks toward the east; and he shall prepare his burnt offering and his peace offerings, as he does on the Sabbath day. Then he shall go out; and after his going out one shall shut the gate.

hausa: Zan hallaka dukan dabbobinta da suke kusa da ruwaye masu yawa ƙafar mutum ba zai ƙara damunsa ko kofaton dabba ya gurɓata shi.
english: I will destroy also all its animals from beside many waters. The foot of man won’t trouble them any more, nor will the hoofs of animals trouble them.

hausa: Ku mai da wannan burinku na yi natsattsiyar rayuwa, kuna mai da hankali ga sha’anin da yake gabanku, kuna kuma yin aiki da hannuwanku, kamar dai yadda muka gaya muku,
english: and that you make it your ambition to lead a quiet life, and to do your own business, and to work with your own hands, even as we instructed you,

hausa: Amma in ya ce, ‘Ina baƙin ciki da kai,’ to, ina a shirye; bari yă yi abin da ya fi masa.”
english: but if he says, ‘I have no delight in you,’ behold, here I am. Let him do to me as seems good to him.”

hausa: Lawiyawan su ne Yeshuwa, Binnuyi, Kadmiyel, Sherebiya, Yahuda, da kuma Mattaniya, wanda tare da ’yan’uwansa yake lura da waƙoƙin godiya.
english: Moreover the Levites were Jeshua, Binnui, Kadmiel, Sherebiah, Judah, and Mattaniah, who was over the thanksgiving songs, he and his brothers.

hausa: A wannan lokaci sai waɗansu masanan taurari suka zo gaba suka yi karar Yahudawa.
english: Therefore at that time certain Chaldeans came near and brought accusation against the Jews.

hausa: Suna kuma da ƙananan kifaye kaɗan, ya ba da godiya dominsu, ya kuma ce wa almajiran su rarraba musu.
