english: They also had a few small fish. Having blessed them, he said to serve these also.

hausa: A ɗaukaka ka, ya Allah, a bisa sammai, bari kuma ɗaukakarka ta kasance a bisa dukan duniya.
english: Be exalted, God, above the heavens! Let your glory be over all the earth.

hausa: A kansu karin maganan nan gaskiya ce, “Kare ya koma kan amansa,” da kuma, “Alade da aka yi wa wanka, ya koma birgimarsa cikin laka.”
english: But it has happened to them according to the true proverb, “The dog turns to his own vomit again,” and “the sow that has washed to wallowing in the mire.”

hausa: “Saboda haka Ubangiji Allah na Isra’ila ya ce, ‘Na yi alkawari cewa gidanka da gidan mahaifinka za su yi mini hidima a gabana har abada.’ Amma, yanzu Allah ya ce, ba zai yiwu ba; waɗanda suke girmama ni; Ni ma zan girmama su. Amma waɗanda suke ƙasƙantar da ni, haka za a ƙasƙantar da su.
english: “Therefore Yahweh, the God of Israel, says, ‘I said indeed that your house and the house of your father should walk before me forever.’ But now Yahweh says, ‘Far be it from me; for those who honor me I will honor, and those who despise me will be cursed.

hausa: Maskil ne ta Dawuda. Sa’ad da yake cikin kogo. Addu’a ce. Na yi kuka mai ƙarfi ga Ubangiji; na tā da muryata ga Ubangiji neman jinƙai.
english: A contemplation by David, when he was in the cave. A Prayer. I cry with my voice to Yahweh. With my voice, I ask Yahweh for mercy.

hausa: To, ka gaya mana, a ra’ayinka? Ya dace a biya Kaisar haraji ko a’a?”
english: Tell us therefore, what do you think? Is it lawful to pay taxes to Caesar, or not?”

hausa: ‘Ubangiji ya kāsa kai waɗannan mutane a ƙasar da ya yi alkawari da rantsuwa ne, shi ya sa ya kashe su a hamada.’
english: ‘Because Yahweh was not able to bring this people into the land which he swore to them, therefore he has slain them in the wilderness.’

hausa: can ma hannunka zai bishe ni, hannunka na dama zai riƙe ni gam.
english: even there your hand will lead me, and your right hand will hold me.

hausa: Saboda haka ku yi hankali, kwanaki suna zuwa in ji Ubangiji, sa’ad da mutane ba za su ƙara kira wurin Tofet ko Kwarin Ben Hinnom ba, amma Kwarin Kisa, gama za su binne matattu a Tofet sai har ba sauran wuri.
english: Therefore behold, the days come”, says Yahweh, “that it will no more be called ‘Topheth’ or ‘The valley of the son of Hinnom’, but ‘The valley of Slaughter’; for they will bury in Topheth until there is no place to bury.

hausa: “ ‘Wannan ita ce dokar Banazare wanda ya yi alkawari ga Ubangiji bisa ga keɓewarsa, tare da duk abin da zai iya bayarwa. Tilas yă cika alkawarin da ya yi bisa ga dokar zaman Banazare.’ ”
english: “‘This is the law of the Nazirite who vows and of his offering to Yahweh for his separation, in addition to that which he is able to afford. According to his vow which he vows, so he must do after the law of his separation.’”

hausa: Saboda haka suka je suka kira masu tsaron ƙofar birni, suka ce musu, “Mun je sansanin Arameyawa, ga shi kuwa ba mu iske kowa a can ba, babu ko motsin wani, sai dai dawakai da jakuna a daure, tentunan kuwa suna nan yadda suke.”
english: So they came and called to the city gatekeepers; and they told them, “We came to the camp of the Syrians, and, behold, there was no man there, not even a man’s voice, but the horses tied, and the donkeys tied, and the tents as they were.”

hausa: Ubangiji zai yi wa Yaƙub jinƙai; zai sāke zaɓi Isra’ila yă kuma zaunar da su a ƙasarsu. Baƙi ma za su zo su zauna tare da su su haɗa kai da gidan Yaƙub.
english: For Yahweh will have compassion on Jacob, and will yet choose Israel, and set them in their own land. The foreigner will join himself with them, and they will unite with the house of Jacob.

hausa: ka ce, ‘Ya ku duwatsun Isra’ila, ku ji maganar Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka. Ga abin da Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka ya ce wa duwatsu da tuddai, ga rafuffuka da kuma kwaruruka. Ina shirin kawo takobi a kanku, kuma zan hallaka masujadanku.
english: and say, ‘You mountains of Israel, hear the word of the Lord Yahweh! The Lord Yahweh says to the mountains and to the hills, to the watercourses and to the valleys: “Behold, I, even I, will bring a sword on you, and I will destroy your high places.

hausa: Bayan tsaran nan duka suka rasu, sai wata tsara ta taso wadda ba tă san Ubangiji ko abin da ya yi wa Isra’ila ba.
english: After all that generation were gathered to their fathers, another generation arose after them who didn’t know Yahweh, nor the work which he had done for Israel.

hausa: kazar ruwa, kwasakwasa, da ungulu,
english: the white owl, the desert owl, the osprey,

hausa: “Ɗa yakan girmama mahaifinsa, bawa kuma yakan girmama maigidansa. In ni mahaifi ne, ina girman da ya dace da ni? In ni maigida ne, ina girman da ya dace da ni?” In ji Ubangiji Maɗaukaki. “Ku firistoci, ku ne kuka rena sunana. “Amma sai kuka ce, ‘Yaya muka rena sunanka?’
english: “A son honors his father, and a servant his master. If I am a father, then where is my honor? And if I am a master, where is the respect due me?” says Yahweh of Armies to you priests who despise my name. “You say, ‘How have we despised your name?’

hausa: To, in babu tashin matattu, mene ne waɗanda ake musu baftisma saboda matattu za su yi? In ba a tā da matattu sam, me ya sa ake yin wa mutane baftisma saboda su?
english: Or else what will they do who are baptized for the dead? If the dead aren’t raised at all, why then are they baptized for the dead?

hausa: Ishaku yana da shekara arba’in sa’ad da ya auri Rebeka ’yar Betuwel, mutumin Aram, daga Faddan Aram, ’yar’uwar Laban mutumin Aram.
english: Isaac was forty years old when he took Rebekah, the daughter of Bethuel the Syrian of Paddan Aram, the sister of Laban the Syrian, to be his wife.

hausa: Sai Ishaku ya matsa daga can ya sāke haƙa wata rijiyar, babu wani kuma da yi faɗa a kanta. Sai ya ba ta suna Rehobot, yana cewa, “Yanzu Ubangiji ya ba mu wuri, za mu kuwa yi ta haihuwa a ƙasar.”
english: He left that place, and dug another well. They didn’t argue over that one. So he called it Rehoboth. He said, “For now Yahweh has made room for us, and we will be fruitful in the land.”

hausa: Game da ceton nan, annabawa, waɗanda suka yi maganar alherin da za tă zo gare ku, sun yi bincike mai zurfi, a natse,
english: Concerning this salvation, the prophets sought and searched diligently. They prophesied of the grace that would come to you,

hausa: Sai Ubangiji ya ce wa Gad, mai duba na Dawuda,
english: Yahweh spoke to Gad, David’s seer, saying,

hausa: Kai da dukan sojojinka da kuma al’ummai masu yawa da suke tare da kai za ku haura, kuna cin gaba kamar hadari; za ku zama kamar girgijen da yake rufewa ƙasa.
english: You will ascend. You will come like a storm. You will be like a cloud to cover the land, you and all your hordes, and many peoples with you.”

hausa: Ubangiji kuma ya kasance tare da shi, ya yi nasara a duk abin da ya sa hannu. Ya yi tawaye ga sarkin Assuriya, ya ƙi yă bauta masa.
english: Yahweh was with him. Wherever he went, he prospered. He rebelled against the king of Assyria, and didn’t serve him.

hausa: “Ku roƙa za a ba ku; ku nema za ku samu; ku ƙwanƙwasa za a kuwa buɗe muku ƙofa.
english: “Ask, and it will be given you. Seek, and you will find. Knock, and it will be opened for you.

hausa: sai na sami wuri wa Ubangiji, mazauni domin Maɗaukaki na Yaƙub.”
english: until I find out a place for Yahweh, a dwelling for the Mighty One of Jacob.”

hausa: Shugabannin Yahuda da Urushalima, fadawa, firistoci da kuma dukan mutanen ƙasar waɗanda suka bi tsakanin ɗan maraƙin da aka yanka,
english: the princes of Judah, the princes of Jerusalem, the eunuchs, the priests, and all the people of the land, who passed between the parts of the calf.

hausa: Zai kawo wa firist, firist kuwa zai ɗiba da hannu don yă kasance abin tunawa, sai yă ƙone a bisan bagaden kamar hadayar da ake ƙona da wuta ga Ubangiji. Hadaya ce ta zunubi.
english: He shall bring it to the priest, and the priest shall take his handful of it as the memorial portion, and burn it on the altar, on the offerings of Yahweh made by fire. It is a sin offering.

hausa: Sa’an nan zai ɗauki itacen al’ul, hizzob, jan ƙyalle da kuma tsuntsu mai ran ya tsoma su cikin jinin tsuntsun da aka yanka da kuma cikin ruwa mai kyau, ya yayyafa wa gida sau bakwai.
english: He shall take the cedar wood, the hyssop, the scarlet, and the living bird, and dip them in the blood of the slain bird, and in the running water, and sprinkle the house seven times.

hausa: Firist ɗin zai bincike cutar fatar jikin da take a rigar, yă kuma kaɗaice kayan da abin ya shafe shi kwana bakwai.
english: The priest shall examine the plague, and isolate the plague seven days.

hausa: Daga sama taurari suka yi faɗa, daga bakin tekuna suka yi yaƙi da Sisera.
english: From the sky the stars fought. From their courses, they fought against Sisera.

english: You will bring them in, and plant them in the mountain of your inheritance, the place, Yahweh, which you have made for yourself to dwell in: the sanctuary, Lord, which your hands have established.

hausa: Amma Amnon ya ƙi yă saurare ta, da yake ya fi ta ƙarfi, sai ya yi mata fyaɗe.
english: However, he would not listen to her voice; but being stronger than she, he forced her and lay with her.

He broke the Asherah poles, the engraved images, and the molten images in pieces, made dust of them, and scattered it on the graves of those who had sacrificed to them.

hausa: Maganarka fitila ce ga ƙafafuna haske kuma a kan hanyata.
english: Your word is a lamp to my feet, and a light for my path.

hausa: Babu haifaffe na Allah da zai ci gaba da yin zunubi, domin iri na Allah yana a cikinsa; ba zai iya ci gaba da yin zunubi ba, domin haifaffe ne na Allah.
english: Whoever is born of God doesn’t commit sin, because his seed remains in him, and he can’t sin, because he is born of God.

english: The man shall be free from iniquity, and that woman shall bear her iniquity.’”

hausa: Ku bauta wa Ubangiji da tsoro ku kuma yi farin ciki kuna rawar jiki.
english: Serve Yahweh with fear, and rejoice with trembling.

english: However, no accounting shall be asked of them for the money delivered into their hand, for they deal faithfully.”

english: Now Elihu had waited to speak to Job, because they were older than he.

hausa: Amma in kuka duƙufa cikin aikin mugunta da ku da sarkinku za a hallaka ku.

english: The priest shall sprinkle the blood on Yahweh’s altar at the door of the Tent of Meeting, and burn the fat for a pleasant aroma to Yahweh.

hausa: Amma Ubangiji ya ce masa, “Ba haka ba ne! Duk wanda ya kashe Kayinu, za a ninƙa hukuncinsa har sau bakwai.” Sa’an nan Ubangiji ya sa wa Kayinu alama don duk wanda ya same shi kada yă kashe shi.
english: Yahweh said to him, “Therefore whoever slays Cain, vengeance will be taken on him sevenfold.” Yahweh appointed a sign for Cain, so that anyone finding him would not strike him.

hausa: Sa’ad da suka ci iyakar abin da suke so, sai suka rage nauyin jirgin ta wurin zubar da hatsin a cikin tekun.
english: When they had eaten enough, they lightened the ship, throwing out the wheat into the sea.

hausa: Ina so ku sani ’yan’uwa, cewa bisharar da nake wa’azi, ba mutum ne ya ƙago ta ba.
english: But I make known to you, brothers, concerning the Good News which was preached by me, that it is not according to man.

hausa: Sa’ad da aka yi adalci, yakan kawo farin ciki ga mai adalci amma fargaba ga masu aikata mugunta.
english: It is joy to the righteous to do justice; but it is a destruction to the workers of iniquity.

hausa: Sai suka kawo sarakunan biyar daga cikin kogo; sarakunan Urushalima, Hebron, Yarmut, Lakish da Eglon.

hausa: Ya ɗaga ni daga rami marar fāɗi, daga laka da taɓo; ya sa ƙafafuna a kan dutse ya kuma ba ni tsayayyen wuri don in tsaya.

hausa: Ba sa maganar salama sukan ƙirƙiro zage-zagen ƙarya a kan waɗanda suka zama shiru a ƙasar.

hausa: “Na aiko muku annoba yadda na yi a Masar. Na karkashe samarinku da takobi, tare da kamammun dawakanku. Na cika hancinku da warin sansaninku, duk da haka ba ku juyo gare ni ba” in ji Ubangiji.

hausa: Sarki Hiridus ya ji wannan labari, gama sunan Yesu ya bazu a ko’ina. Waɗansu suna cewa, “An tashe Yohanna Mai Baftisma daga matattu ne, shi ya sa yana da ikon yin ayyukan banmamakin nan.”
english: King Herod heard this, for his name had become known, and he said, “John the Baptizer has risen from the dead, and therefore these powers are at work in him.”

english: There is one who is alone, and he has neither son nor brother. There is no end to all of his labor, neither are his eyes satisfied with wealth. “For whom then do I labor and deprive my soul of enjoyment?” This also is vanity. Yes, it is a miserable business.

hausa: Sa’an nan ya aika saƙo ko’ina a Isra’ila, dukan masu yi wa Ba’al hidima kuwa suka tattaru, ba mutumin da bai zo ba. Suka yi cincirindo a haikalin Ba’al har sai da ya cika makil.

english: for a righteous man falls seven times and rises up again, but the wicked are overthrown by calamity.

english: Another angel came out of the temple, crying with a loud voice to him who sat on the cloud, “Send your sickle and reap, for the hour to reap has come; for the harvest of the earth is ripe!”

english: for I know your readiness, of which I boast on your behalf to those of Macedonia, that Achaia has been prepared for the past year. Your zeal has stirred up very many of them.

english: He also gave him the copy of the writing of the decree that was given out in Susa to destroy them, to show it to Esther, and to declare it to her, and to urge her to go in to the king to make supplication to him, and to make request before him for her people.

english: “‘“But you trusted in your beauty, and played the prostitute because of your renown, and poured out your prostitution on everyone who passed by. It was his.

hausa: Bayan ’yan kwanaki, sai Dawuda ya nemi nufin Ubangiji ya ce, “In haura zuwa ɗaya daga cikin biranen Yahuda?” Ubangiji ya ce, “Haura.” Dawuda ya ce, “Wanne zan tafi?” Ubangiji ya ce, “Je Hebron.”
english: After this, David inquired of Yahweh, saying, “Shall I go up into any of the cities of Judah?” Yahweh said to him, “Go up.” David said, “Where shall I go up?” He said, “To Hebron.”

hausa: Dukan maza daga shekara talatin zuwa hamsin waɗanda sukan zo hidimar aiki a Tentin Sujada,
english: from thirty years old and upward even to fifty years old—everyone who entered into the service for work in the Tent of Meeting,

hausa: Ya bishe su da girgije da rana da kuma haske daga wuta dukan dare.
english: In the daytime he also led them with a cloud, and all night with a light of fire.

hausa: “Ni mutumin Yahuda ne haifaffen Tarshish na Silisiya, amma a nan birnin ne aka rene ni. Aka horar da ni sosai cikin dokokin kakanninmu a ƙarƙashin Gamaliyel ni ma dā mai himma ne cikin bauta wa Allah kamar yadda kowannenku yake a yau.
english: “I am indeed a Jew, born in Tarsus of Cilicia, but brought up in this city at the feet of Gamaliel, instructed according to the strict tradition of the law of our fathers, being zealous for God, even as you all are today.

hausa: Ta kuma ƙara da cewa, “Dā, wa zai iya ce wa Ibrahim, Saratu za tă yi renon yara? Duk da haka na haifar masa ɗa cikin tsufansa.”
english: She said, “Who would have said to Abraham that Sarah would nurse children? For I have borne him a son in his old age.”

hausa: A kwanakinsa adalai za su haɓaka wadata za tă yalwata har sai babu sauran wata.
english: In his days, the righteous shall flourish, and abundance of peace, until the moon is no more.

hausa: Za a mai da rana duhu, wata kuma ya zama jini, kafin zuwa rana mai girma da kuma ta ɗaukaka ta Ubangiji.
english: The sun will be turned into darkness, and the moon into blood, before the great and glorious day of the Lord comes.

hausa: Kada ka yi dariya sa’ad da abokin gāba ya fāɗi; sa’ad da ya yi tuntuɓe, kada ka yi farin ciki,
english: Don’t rejoice when your enemy falls. Don’t let your heart be glad when he is overthrown,

hausa: Kowace Asabbaci kuwa yakan yi muhawwara a majami’a, yana ƙoƙari yă rinjayi Yahudawa da Hellenawa.
english: He reasoned in the synagogue every Sabbath and persuaded Jews and Greeks.

hausa: Yesu ya ce, “Ina jagoran wani tawaye ne da kuka fito da takuba da kuma sanduna domin ku kama ni?
english: Jesus answered them, “Have you come out, as against a robber, with swords and clubs to seize me?

hausa: Kowace rana, a filin haikali da kuma gida-gida, ba su fasa koyarwa da kuma shelar labari mai daɗi cewa Yesu shi ne Kiristi ba.
english: Every day, in the temple and at home, they never stopped teaching and preaching Jesus, the Christ.

hausa: ku lura da katangarta da kyau, ku dubi fadodinta, don ku faɗe su ga tsara mai zuwa.
english: Notice her bulwarks. Consider her palaces, that you may tell it to the next generation.

hausa: Bari salama ta kasance a katangarki zaman lafiya kuma a fadodinki.”
english: Peace be within your walls, and prosperity within your palaces.

hausa: “Ga bawana, wanda na ɗaukaka, zaɓaɓɓen nan nawa wanda nake jin daɗi; Zan sa Ruhuna a cikinsa zai kuwa kawo adalci ga al’ummai.
english: “Behold, my servant, whom I uphold, my chosen, in whom my soul delights: I have put my Spirit on him. He will bring justice to the nations.

hausa: Saboda haka Ubangiji ya watsar da su daga wurin zuwa ko’ina a doron ƙasa, suka kuwa daina gina birnin.
english: So Yahweh scattered them abroad from there on the surface of all the earth. They stopped building the city.

hausa: Duk da haka ma, shaidarsu ba tă zo ɗaya ba.
english: Even so, their testimony didn’t agree.

hausa: Sa’an nan Abner ya ce wa Yowab, “Bari mu bar waɗansu samari su tashi su yi faɗa hannu da hannu a gabanmu.” Yowab ya ce, “To, su tashi.”
english: Abner said to Joab, “Please let the young men arise and compete before us!” Joab said, “Let them arise!”

hausa: ‘Ubangiji mai jinkiri fushi ne, mai yawan ƙauna, mai gafarta zunubi da tawaye. Duk da haka ba ya ƙyale mai laifi, babu horo. Yana horin ’ya’ya saboda zunubin iyayensu har tsara ta uku, da ta huɗu.’
english: ‘Yahweh is slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness, forgiving iniquity and disobedience; and he will by no means clear the guilty, visiting the iniquity of the fathers on the children, on the third and on the fourth generation.’

hausa: Tabbatacce akwai sa zuciya ta nan gaba dominka, kuma sa zuciyarka ba za tă zama a banza ba.
english: Indeed surely there is a future hope, and your hope will not be cut off.

hausa: Jimillar maza daga mutanen Dan 62,700 ne.
english: those who were counted of them, of the tribe of Dan, were sixty-two thousand seven hundred.

hausa: Abokaina ƙaunatattu, kada ku yi mamakin gwaji mai tsananin da kuke sha, sai ka ce wani baƙon abu ne yake faruwa da ku.
english: Beloved, don’t be astonished at the fiery trial which has come upon you to test you, as though a strange thing happened to you.

hausa: Amma fa ka san wannan, za a yi lokutan shan wahala a kwanakin ƙarshe.
english: But know this: that in the last days, grievous times will come.

hausa: Ganin haka sai dukan mutane, babba da ƙarami, tare da shugabannin sojoji, suka tashi suka gudu zuwa ƙasar Masar, gama suna tsoron mutanen Babilon.
english: All the people, both small and great, and the captains of the forces arose and came to Egypt; for they were afraid of the Chaldeans.

hausa: Mutumin da aka fitar da aljanun daga cikinsa, ya roƙi Yesu don yă tafi tare da shi, amma Yesu ya sallame shi ya ce,
english: But the man from whom the demons had gone out begged him that he might go with him, but Jesus sent him away, saying,

hausa: A lokutan masifu ba za su yanƙwane ba; a kwanakin yunwa za su sami a yalwace.
english: They shall not be disappointed in the time of evil. In the days of famine they shall be satisfied.

hausa: Ya amsa ya ce, “Ba ku taɓa karantawa ba ne cewa, a farkon halitta, Mahalicci ‘ya yi su namiji da ta mace,’
english: He answered, “Haven’t you read that he who made them from the beginning made them male and female,

hausa: “Ko kai ne kake ba doki ƙarfinsa kai kake rufe wuyansa da geza mai yawa?
english: “Have you given the horse might? Have you clothed his neck with a quivering mane?

hausa: Ana cikin haka, sai rundunar da Amaziya ya mai da su gida, waɗanda ba a bari suka tafi yaƙin ba, suka kai wa garuruwan Yahuda daga Samariya zuwa Bet-Horon hari. Suka kashe mutane dubu uku suka kwashe ganima mai yawan gaske.
english: But the men of the army whom Amaziah sent back, that they should not go with him to battle, fell on the cities of Judah from Samaria even to Beth Horon, and struck of them three thousand, and took much plunder.

hausa: Yesu ya ce, “Ya ku zamani marar bangaskiya, har yaushe zan kasance tare da ku? Har yaushe zan yi haƙuri da ku? Kawo mini yaron.”
english: He answered him, “Unbelieving generation, how long shall I be with you? How long shall I bear with you? Bring him to me.”

hausa: Dattawan Yahuda kuwa suka ci gaba da ginin suna yin nasara ta wurin wa’azin Haggai annabi da Zakariya ɗan Iddo. Suka kuma gama ginin haikalin bisa ga umarnin Allah na Isra’ila da kuma umarnin Sairus da Artazerzes, sarakunan Farisa.
english: The elders of the Jews built and prospered, through the prophesying of Haggai the prophet and Zechariah the son of Iddo. They built and finished it, according to the commandment of the God of Israel, and according to the decree of Cyrus, Darius, and Artaxerxes king of Persia.

hausa: Akwai wani kogi mai ba da ruwa ga lambun wanda ya gangaro daga Eden, daga nan ya rarrabu, ya zama koguna huɗu.
english: A river went out of Eden to water the garden; and from there it was parted, and became the source of four rivers.

hausa: Bari su yabi sunansa tare da rawa suna kuma yin kiɗi gare shi da ganga da garaya.
english: Let them praise his name in the dance! Let them sing praises to him with tambourine and harp!

hausa: Ana cikin cin abincin yamma, Iblis kuwa ya riga ya zuga Yahuda Iskariyot, ɗan Siman yă bashe Yesu.
english: During supper, the devil having already put into the heart of Judas Iscariot, Simon’s son, to betray him,

hausa: rantsuwar da ya yi wa mahaifinmu Ibrahim,
english: the oath which he swore to Abraham our father,

hausa: Duk da haka ya cece su saboda sunansa, don yă sanar da ikonsa mai girma.
english: Nevertheless he saved them for his name’s sake, that he might make his mighty power known.

hausa: Ya bishe su ta miƙaƙƙiyar hanya zuwa birnin da za su zauna.
english: He led them also by a straight way, that they might go to a city to live in.

hausa: Bayan kwana uku, sai suka same shi a filin haikali zaune a tsakiyar malamai, yana sauraronsu yana kuma yi musu tambayoyi.
english: After three days they found him in the temple, sitting in the middle of the teachers, both listening to them and asking them questions.

hausa: Ubangiji ya aiki Natan wurin Dawuda. Da ya tafi wajensa, sai ya ce, “An yi waɗansu mutum biyu a wani gari, ɗaya mai arziki, ɗayan kuma matalauci.
english: Yahweh sent Nathan to David. He came to him, and said to him, “There were two men in one city: the one rich, and the other poor.

hausa: Sai Sama’ila ya tafi Rama, amma Shawulu ya haura zuwa gidansa a Gibeya na Shawulu.
english: Then Samuel went to Ramah; and Saul went up to his house to Gibeah of Saul.

hausa: Sa’ad da na yi ƙoƙari in gane wannan, sai ya zama danniya a gare ni
english: When I tried to understand this, it was too painful for me—

hausa: Ganin haka sai mutanen suka cika da tsoron Ubangiji, suka kuma miƙa wa Ubangiji hadaya, suka yi wa’adi da shi.
english: Then the men feared Yahweh exceedingly; and they offered a sacrifice to Yahweh and made vows.

hausa: A cikin waɗanda aka kashe kuwa akwai Ewi, Rekem, Zur, Hur da Reba; sarakuna biyar na Mediyawa. Suka kuma kashe Bala’am ɗan Beyor da takobi.
english: They killed the kings of Midian with the rest of their slain: Evi, Rekem, Zur, Hur, and Reba, the five kings of Midian. They also killed Balaam the son of Beor with the sword.

hausa: Firist wanda yake daga zuriyar Haruna zai raka Lawiyawa sa’ad da suke karɓan zakka, Lawiyawan kuma za su kawo kashi ɗaya bisa goma na zakka zuwa gidan Allahnmu, su kawo a ɗakunan ajiya na baitulmali.
english: The priest, the descendent of Aaron, shall be with the Levites when the Levites take tithes. The Levites shall bring up the tithe of the tithes to the house of our God, to the rooms, into the treasure house.

hausa: Amma Abiyatar ɗan Ahimelek jikan Ahitub ya tsere, ya gudu zuwa wurin Dawuda.
english: One of the sons of Ahimelech the son of Ahitub, named Abiathar, escaped and fled after David.

hausa: “Mun ji labarin girman kan Mowab mun ji alfarma girmankanta da kumburinta girmankanta da fariyarta da renin zuciyarta.
english: “We have heard of the pride of Moab. He is very proud in his loftiness, his pride, his arrogance, and the arrogance of his heart.

hausa: Ya ce mini, “Kai bawana ne, Isra’ila, a cikinka zan bayyana darajata.”
english: He said to me, “You are my servant, Israel, in whom I will be glorified.”

hausa: Gidan da ya gina kamar gidan gizo-gizo, kamar bukkar mai tsaro.
english: He builds his house as the moth, as a booth which the watchman makes.

hausa: Ka warkar da ni, ya Ubangiji, zan kuwa warke; ka cece ni zan kuwa cetu, gama kai ne nake yabo.
english: Heal me, O Yahweh, and I will be healed. Save me, and I will be saved; for you are my praise.

hausa: Gama tawaye yana kama da zunubi na duba, girman kai kuma yana kama da bautar gumaka. Saboda ka ƙi maganar Ubangiji, shi ma ya ƙi ka da zaman sarki.”
english: For rebellion is as the sin of witchcraft, and stubbornness is as idolatry and teraphim. Because you have rejected Yahweh’s word, he has also rejected you from being king.”

hausa: Da Ammonawa suka gane cewa Dawuda ya ji fushi da su sosai saboda abin da suka yi, sai suka yi hayar sojojin ƙasar Arameyawa dubu ashirin daga Bet Rehob da Aram-Zoba, suka kuma yi hayar sarkin Ma’aka tare da mutum dubu ɗaya, suka kuma yi hayar maza dubu goma sha biyu daga Tob.
english: When the children of Ammon saw that they had become odious to David, the children of Ammon sent and hired the Syrians of Beth Rehob and the Syrians of Zobah, twenty thousand footmen, and the king of Maacah with one thousand men, and the men of Tob twelve thousand men.

hausa: Sai Shawulu ya ce wa Yonatan, “Gaya mini mene ne ka yi.” Yonatan ya ce masa, “Na ɗanɗana zuma kaɗan daga gindin sandanta. Yanzu kuwa dole in mutu!”
english: Then Saul said to Jonathan, “Tell me what you have done!” Jonathan told him, and said, “I certainly did taste a little honey with the end of the rod that was in my hand; and behold, I must die.”

hausa: Za ku ci naman ’ya’yanku maza da na ’ya’yanku mata.
english: You will eat the flesh of your sons, and you will eat the flesh of your daughters.

hausa: “Ka faɗa wa Isra’ilawa, su juya su kafa sansani a Fi Hahirot, a tsakanin Migdol da teku. Za su kafa sansanin kai tsaye kusa da teku, wanda ya fuskanci Ba’al-Zafon.
english: “Speak to the children of Israel, that they turn back and encamp before Pihahiroth, between Migdol and the sea, before Baal Zephon. You shall encamp opposite it by the sea.

hausa: Gama zan kuta in kuma kawo a kan Babilon haɗinkan manyan al’ummai na arewa. Za su ja dāgār gāba da ita, kuma daga arewa za a ci ta da yaƙi. Kibiyoyinsu za su zama kamar na gwanayen jarumawa waɗanda ba sa dawowa hannu wofi.
english: For, behold, I will stir up and cause to come up against Babylon a company of great nations from the north country; and they will set themselves in array against her. She will be taken from there. Their arrows will be as of an expert mighty man. None of them will return in vain.

hausa: Zan aika da mala’ika a gabanka in kuma kori Kan’aniyawa, Amoriyawa, Hittiyawa, Ferizziyawa, Hiwiyawa da Yebusiyawa.
english: I will send an angel before you; and I will drive out the Canaanite, the Amorite, and the Hittite, and the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite.

hausa: A ƙarshe, ’yan’uwa, duk abin da yake na gaskiya, duk abin da yake na girmamawa, duk abin da yake daidai, duk abin da yake da tsarki, duk abin da yake kyakkyawa, duk abin da yake na sha’awa, in ma wani abu mafifici ne, ko ya cancanci yabo, ku yi tunani a kan irin abubuwan nan.
english: Finally, brothers, whatever things are true, whatever things are honorable, whatever things are just, whatever things are pure, whatever things are lovely, whatever things are of good report: if there is any virtue and if there is anything worthy of praise, think about these things.

hausa: Bayan Yesu ya gama gaya wa mutanen dukan waɗannan abubuwa, sai ya shiga Kafarnahum.
english: After he had finished speaking in the hearing of the people, he entered into Capernaum.

hausa: Ma’auni zai miƙe daga can ya nausa kai tsaye zuwa tudun Gareb sa’an nan ya juya zuwa Gowa.
english: The measuring line will go out further straight onward to the hill Gareb, and will turn toward Goah.

hausa: Bilatus ya ce, “Ba za ka yi mini magana ba? Ba ka san cewa ina da ikon sakinka, ko gicciye ka ba?”
english: Pilate therefore said to him, “Aren’t you speaking to me? Don’t you know that I have power to release you and have power to crucify you?”

hausa: “ ‘Kada ku ƙazantar da ƙasar da kuke zama a ciki. Zub da jini yakan ƙazantar da ƙasa, ba a kuma iya yin kafara saboda wannan ƙasa da aka zub da jini, sai dai ta wurin jinin mutumin da ya zub da jinin.
english: “‘So you shall not pollute the land where you live; for blood pollutes the land. No atonement can be made for the land for the blood that is shed in it, but by the blood of him who shed it.

hausa: Ina so ka rantse da sunan Ubangiji Allah na sama da ƙasa, cewa ba za ka samo wa ɗana mata daga ’yan matan Kan’aniyawa, waɗanda nake zama cikinsu ba.
english: I will make you swear by Yahweh, the God of heaven and the God of the earth, that you shall not take a wife for my son of the daughters of the Canaanites, among whom I live.

hausa: “Tashi, ka je ka tsarkake mutane. Ka ce musu su tsarkake kansu, su yi shiri domin gobe; gama ga abin da Ubangiji, Allah na Isra’ila ya ce, a cikinku akwai abubuwan da aka keɓe, ya Isra’ilawa. Ba za ku iya yin tsayayya da abokan gābanku ba sai in kun rabu da abubuwan nan da aka haramta.
english: Get up! Sanctify the people, and say, ‘Sanctify yourselves for tomorrow, for Yahweh, the God of Israel, says, “There is a devoted thing among you, Israel. You cannot stand before your enemies until you take away the devoted thing from among you.”

hausa: Sa’ad da Marta ta ji cewa Yesu yana zuwa, sai ta fita don ta tarye shi, amma Maryamu ta zauna a gida.
english: Then when Martha heard that Jesus was coming, she went and met him, but Mary stayed in the house.

hausa: Eltolad, Betul, Horma,
english: Eltolad, Bethul, Hormah,

hausa: Amma bayan mutuwar Ahab, sai sarkin Mowab ya yi wa sarkin Isra’ila tawaye.
english: But when Ahab was dead, the king of Moab rebelled against the king of Israel.

hausa: Duk da haka Yerobowam ɗan Nebat, ma’aikacin Solomon ɗan Dawuda, ya tayar wa maigidansa,
english: Yet Jeroboam the son of Nebat, the servant of Solomon the son of David, rose up, and rebelled against his lord.

hausa: “Amma kada ka fanshe ɗan fari na saniya, tunkiya, ko akuya; gama suna da tsarki. Ka yayyafa jininsu a bisan bagade, ka kuma ƙone kitsensu kamar hadayar da ka yi da wuta, mai daɗin ƙanshi ga Ubangiji.
english: “But you shall not redeem the firstborn of a cow, or the firstborn of a sheep, or the firstborn of a goat. They are holy. You shall sprinkle their blood on the altar, and shall burn their fat for an offering made by fire, for a pleasant aroma to Yahweh.

hausa: Sai manyan firistocin Yahudawa suka ce, “A’a! Kada ka rubuta, ‘Sarkin Yahudawa,’ ka dai rubuta, wannan mutum ya ce shi sarkin Yahudawa ne.”
english: The chief priests of the Jews therefore said to Pilate, “Don’t write, ‘The King of the Jews,’ but, ‘he said, “I am King of the Jews.”’”

hausa: Sai Iliya ya ce wa Ahab, “Ka haura gida, ka ci, ka sha, gama ina jin motsin ruwan sama mai yawa.”
english: Elijah said to Ahab, “Get up, eat and drink; for there is the sound of abundance of rain.”

hausa: Haka kuwa Yaƙub ya yi. Ya gama mako guda da Liyatu, sa’an nan Laban ya ba shi ’yarsa Rahila tă zama matarsa.
english: Jacob did so, and fulfilled her week. He gave him Rachel his daughter as wife.

hausa: Zai karɓi gonakinku mafi kyau da gonakin inabinku da gonakin zaitunku yă ba wa ma’aikatansa.
english: He will take your fields, your vineyards, and your olive groves, even your best, and give them to his servants.

hausa: Zai hukunta duniya da adalci; zai yi mulkin mutane cikin gaskiya.
english: He will judge the world in righteousness. He will administer judgment to the peoples in uprightness.

hausa: Wannan ya kammala addu’o’in Dawuda ɗan Yesse.
english: This ends the prayers by David, the son of Jesse.

hausa: To, a lokacin, sai shugabannin iyalan Lawiyawa suka je wurin Eleyazar firist, Yoshuwa ɗan Nun da kuma shugabannin sauran iyalan kabilu na Isra’ila a
english: Then the heads of fathers’ houses of the Levites came near to Eleazar the priest, and to Joshua the son of Nun, and to the heads of fathers’ houses of the tribes of the children of Israel.

hausa: Ka haɗa su su zama sanda guda saboda su kasance ɗaya a hannunka.
english: Then join them for yourself to one another into one stick, that they may become one in your hand.

hausa: Sai kerubobin suka tashi sama. Waɗannan ne halittu masu ran da na gani kusa da Kogin Kebar.
english: The cherubim mounted up. This is the living creature that I saw by the river Chebar.

hausa: Ya ce, “Ubangiji, ka yi wa ɗana jinƙai. Yana da farfaɗiya yana kuma shan wahala ƙwarai. Ya sha fāɗuwa cikin wuta ko ruwa.
english: “Lord, have mercy on my son, for he is epileptic and suffers grievously; for he often falls into the fire, and often into the water.

hausa: Duk wanda ba a sami sunansa a rubuce a cikin littafin rai ba, an jefar da shi cikin tafkin wutar nan.
english: If anyone was not found written in the book of life, he was cast into the lake of fire.

hausa: “Zan fanshe su daga ikon kabari; zan cece su daga mutuwa. Ina annobanki, ya mutuwa? Ina hallakarka, ya kabari? “Ba zan ji tausayi ba,
english: I will ransom them from the power of Sheol. I will redeem them from death! Death, where are your plagues? Sheol, where is your destruction? “Compassion will be hidden from my eyes.

hausa: Ga abin da Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka ya ce, “Duba, zan yi alama wa Al’ummai, zan ɗaga tutana wa mutane; za su kawo ’ya’yanki maza a hannuwansu su riƙe ’ya’yanki mata a kafaɗunsu.
english: The Lord Yahweh says, “Behold, I will lift up my hand to the nations, and lift up my banner to the peoples. They shall bring your sons in their bosom, and your daughters shall be carried on their shoulders.

hausa: Sa’an nan Elisha ya ɗauki rigar da ta fāɗo daga Iliya ya bugi ruwan da shi. Ya ce, “Yanzu ina Ubangiji Allah na Iliya?” Da ya bugi ruwan sai ruwan ya dāre gida biyu, sai ya haye.
english: He took Elijah’s mantle that fell from him, and struck the waters, and said, “Where is Yahweh, the God of Elijah?” When he also had struck the waters, they were divided apart, and Elisha went over.

hausa: Kada tă ci kowane iri abin da ya fito daga inabi, ba kuwa za tă sha ruwan inabi, ko abu mai sa maye ko ta ci abu marar tsarki ba. Dole tă kiyaye duk abin da na umarce mata.”
english: She may not eat of anything that comes of the vine, neither let her drink wine or strong drink, nor eat any unclean thing. Let her observe all that I commanded her.”

hausa: Yayinda suke cikin tafiya a kan hanya, sai suka iso wani wurin ruwa bābān nan ya ce, “Duba, ga ruwa. Me zai hana a yi mini baftisma?”
english: As they went on the way, they came to some water; and the eunuch said, “Behold, here is water. What is keeping me from being baptized?”

hausa: Al’amarin ya ɓata wa Ibrahim rai sosai domin zancen ya shafi ɗansa.
english: The thing was very grievous in Abraham’s sight on account of his son.

hausa: Sai wuta ta fito daga gaban Ubangiji ta cinye hadaya ta ƙonawa da sassan kitsen a kan bagaden. Sa’ad da dukan mutane suka ga haka, sai suka yi ihu suna farin ciki, suka fāɗi rubda ciki, suka yi sujada.
english: Fire came out from before Yahweh, and consumed the burnt offering and the fat upon the altar. When all the people saw it, they shouted, and fell on their faces.

hausa: Ya ƙara da cewa, “Don me ranka yă daɗe, yake fafarata? Mene ne na yi? Wane abu ne aka same ni da laifi a kai?
english: He said, “Why does my lord pursue his servant? For what have I done? What evil is in my hand?

hausa: Amma Dawuda ya ce wa Shawulu, “Wane ni, wa ya san iyayena ko kabilar iyayena a Isra’ila da zan zama surukin sarki?”
english: David said to Saul, “Who am I, and what is my life, or my father’s family in Israel, that I should be son-in-law to the king?”

hausa: Ba za ku danne hakkin baƙon da yake zama a cikinku ko na marayu ba, ba za ku ɗauki rigar matar da mijinta ya mutu a matsayin jingina ba.
english: You shall not deprive the foreigner or the fatherless of justice, nor take a widow’s clothing in pledge;

hausa: Amoriyawa suka matsa wa mutanen Dan a ƙasar tudu, ba su yarda musu su gangaro zuwa filaye ba.
english: The Amorites forced the children of Dan into the hill country, for they would not allow them to come down to the valley;

hausa: Ko da ma an kore ku zuwa ƙasa mafi nisa a ƙarƙashin sammai, daga can Ubangiji Allahnku zai tattara ku, yă dawo da ku.
english: If your outcasts are in the uttermost parts of the heavens, from there Yahweh your God will gather you, and from there he will bring you back.

hausa: Saboda haka ’yan’uwana, ku ƙara aniya wajen tabbatar da kiranku da zaɓenku da aka yi. Gama in kuka yi waɗannan abubuwa, ba za ku taɓa fāɗuwa ba,
english: Therefore, brothers, be more diligent to make your calling and election sure. For if you do these things, you will never stumble.

hausa: Za a zauna a cikinka; ba za a ƙara hallaka ta ba. Urushalima za tă zauna lafiya.
english: Men will dwell therein, and there will be no more curse; but Jerusalem will dwell safely.

hausa: Amma ba ku yi niyya ku haura ba, kuka yi tawaye gāba da umarnin Ubangiji Allahnku.
english: Yet you wouldn’t go up, but rebelled against the commandment of Yahweh your God.

hausa: Ka ba wa duk wanda ya roƙe ka abu, kada kuma ka hana wa wanda yake neman bashi daga gare ka.
english: Give to him who asks you, and don’t turn away him who desires to borrow from you.

hausa: A wannan dare, suka sa mahaifinsu ya sha ruwan inabi, ’yar farin ta shiga ta kwana da shi. Shi kuwa bai san sa’ad da ta kwanta ko sa’ad da ta tashi ba.
english: They made their father drink wine that night: and the firstborn went in, and lay with her father. He didn’t know when she lay down, nor when she arose.

hausa: “ ‘In kuka kawo hadaya ta gari na ’ya’yan fari ga Ubangiji, sai ku miƙa ɓarzajjen kawunan sabon hatsin da aka gasa a wuta.
english: “‘If you offer a meal offering of first fruits to Yahweh, you shall offer for the meal offering of your first fruits fresh heads of grain parched with fire and crushed.

hausa: Masu zunubi a Sihiyona sun firgita; rawar jiki ya kama marasa sanin Allah suna cewa, “Wane ne a cikinmu zai iya zama da wuta mai ci? Wane ne a cikinmu zai iya zama da madawwamiyar ƙonewa?”
english: The sinners in Zion are afraid. Trembling has seized the godless ones. Who among us can live with the devouring fire? Who among us can live with everlasting burning?

hausa: a cikin kuwa Musa da Haruna da ’ya’yansa maza sukan wanke hannunsa da ƙafafunsu.
english: Moses, Aaron, and his sons washed their hands and their feet there.

hausa: Elisha ya ce wa Gehazi, “Ka yi ɗamara, ka ɗauki sandana ka ruga a guje. Idan ka sadu da wani, kada ka gaishe shi, idan kuma wani ya gaishe ka, kada ka amsa. Ka shimfiɗa sandana a fuskar yaron.”
english: Then he said to Gehazi, “Tuck your cloak into your belt, take my staff in your hand, and go your way. If you meet any man, don’t greet him; and if anyone greets you, don’t answer him again. Then lay my staff on the child’s face.”

hausa: saboda haka a cikin yunwa da ƙishirwa, cikin tsiraici da mugun talauci, za ku bauta wa abokan gāban da Ubangiji ya aiko muku. Zai sa karkiyar ƙarfe a wuyanku har sai ya hallaka ku ƙaf.
english: therefore you will serve your enemies whom Yahweh sends against you, in hunger, in thirst, in nakedness, and in lack of all things. He will put an iron yoke on your neck until he has destroyed you.

hausa: “Sa’ad da maƙwabta suka kawo kayayyaki ko hatsi don su sayar a ranar Asabbaci, ba za mu saya daga gare su a ranar Asabbaci ko a rana mai tsarki ba. Kowace shekarar Asabbaci ba za mu nome ƙasa ba kuma za mu yafe kowane irin bashi.
english: and if the peoples of the land bring wares or any grain on the Sabbath day to sell, that we would not buy from them on the Sabbath, or on a holy day; and that we would forego the seventh year crops and the exaction of every debt.

hausa: “Wannan ne makokin da za a yi mata. ’Yan matan al’ummai za su rera shi; gama Masar da dukan jama’arta za su rera shi, in ji Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka.”
english: “‘“This is the lamentation with which they will lament. The daughters of the nations will lament with this. They will lament with it over Egypt, and over all her multitude,” says the Lord Yahweh.’”

hausa: Kaiton waɗanda suke jan zunubi da igiyar ruɗu, da kuma mugunta da igiyoyin keken yaƙin,
english: Woe to those who draw iniquity with cords of falsehood, and wickedness as with cart rope,

hausa: “Faɗa wa Haruna da ’ya’yansa maza, ‘Waɗannan su ne ƙa’idodi domin hadaya don zunubi. Za a yanka hadaya don zunubi a gaban Ubangiji a inda ake yankan hadaya ta ƙonawa; dole tă kasance mai tsarki.
english: “Speak to Aaron and to his sons, saying, ‘This is the law of the sin offering: in the place where the burnt offering is killed, the sin offering shall be killed before Yahweh. It is most holy.

hausa: A gaban haikalin ya yi ginshiƙai biyu, waɗanda tsawonsu ya kai kamu talatin da biyar, ya yi wa ginshiƙan dajiya, tsayin kowace dajiya kamu biyar ne.
english: Also he made before the house two pillars thirty-five cubits high, and the capital that was on the top of each of them was five cubits.

hausa: Malami ya yi bincike don yă sami kalmomin da suka dace, kuma abin da ya rubuta daidai ne da kuma gaskiya.
english: The Preacher sought to find out acceptable words, and that which was written blamelessly, words of truth.

hausa: Lokacin da na kwanta ina tunani, ‘Har sai yaushe zan tashi?’ Gari ya ƙi wayewa, ina ta jujjuyawa har safe.
english: When I lie down, I say, ‘When will I arise, and the night be gone?’ I toss and turn until the dawning of the day.

hausa: Wannan shi ne taƙamarmu. Lamirinmu yana ba da shaida cewa mun yi zamanmu a duniya, musamman a dangantakarmu da ku cikin tsarki, tsakani da Allah. Mun yi haka ta wurin bishewar alherin Allah, ba bisa ga hikimar duniya ba.
english: For our boasting is this: the testimony of our conscience that in holiness and sincerity of God, not in fleshly wisdom but in the grace of God, we behaved ourselves in the world, and more abundantly toward you.

hausa: Kamar yadda ya yi a Betel, Yosiya ya kawar da dukan ɗakunan gumaka a kan tuddan da sarakunan Isra’ila suka gina a garuruwan Samariya, waɗanda suka tozarta Ubangiji.
english: All the houses also of the high places that were in the cities of Samaria, which the kings of Israel had made to provoke Yahweh to anger, Josiah took away, and did to them according to all the acts that he had done in Bethel.

hausa: don su yi hukuncin da aka rubuta a kansu. Wannan ne ɗaukakar dukan tsarkakansa. Yabi Ubangiji.
english: to execute on them the written judgment. All his saints have this honor. Praise Yah!

hausa: A shekara ta talatin da takwas ta mulkin Azariya sarkin Yahuda, Menahem ɗan Gadi ya zama sarkin Isra’ila, ya yi mulki a Samariya shekara goma.
english: In the thirty ninth year of Azariah king of Judah, Menahem the son of Gadi began to reign over Israel for ten years in Samaria.

hausa: ya ce musu, “Ku riƙe dukan kalmomin da na furta muku a yau, don ku umarce ’ya’yanku su lura, su yi biyayya da dukan kalmomin wannan doka.
english: He said to them, “Set your heart to all the words which I testify to you today, which you shall command your children to observe to do, all the words of this law.

hausa: In an sami wani namiji ko ta mace mai zama a cikinku, a ɗaya daga biranen da Ubangiji ya ba ku yana aikata abin da yake mugu a gaban Ubangiji Allahnku ta wurin karya alkawarinsa,
english: If there is found among you, within any of your gates which Yahweh your God gives you, a man or woman who does that which is evil in Yahweh your God’s sight in transgressing his covenant,

hausa: “Wannan za tă zama dawwammamiyar farilla a gare ku. A rana ta goma ga wata na bakwai, dole ku yi mūsu kanku, ba kuwa za ku yi wani aiki ba, ko da mutum baƙo ne a cikinku ko kuwa ɗan ƙasa,
english: “It shall be a statute to you forever: in the seventh month, on the tenth day of the month, you shall afflict your souls, and shall do no kind of work, whether native-born or a stranger who lives as a foreigner among you;

hausa: A can, a gaban Isra’ilawa, Yoshuwa ya rubuta dokokin Musa a kan duwatsun.
english: He wrote there on the stones a copy of Moses’ law, which he wrote in the presence of the children of Israel.

hausa: Ta fāɗi a ƙafafunsa ta ce, “Bari laifin yă zama nawa, ranka yă daɗe. Ina roƙonka ka bar baiwarka ta yi magana, ka ji abin da baiwarka za tă ce.
english: She fell at his feet and said, “On me, my lord, on me be the blame! Please let your servant speak in your ears. Hear the words of your servant.

hausa: Sa’an nan Ishaya ya ce, “To, ku saurara, ya ku gidan Dawuda! Abin kirki kuke yi ne da kuka ƙure haƙurin jama’a? Ko haƙurin Allah ne kuma kuke so ku ƙure?
english: He said, “Listen now, house of David. Is it not enough for you to try the patience of men, that you will try the patience of my God also?

hausa: In ɗan’uwan ba ya zama kusa da ku, ko kuwa ba ku san shi ba, sai ku kai ta gida ku ajiye ta sai ya zo nemanta. Sa’an nan ku ba shi ita.
english: If your brother isn’t near to you, or if you don’t know him, then you shall bring it home to your house, and it shall be with you until your brother comes looking for it, and you shall restore it to him.

hausa: A maimakon haka, duk abin da muke yi, muna yin shi ne don mu nuna cewa mu masu hidimar Allah ne. Muna yin haka cikin jimrewa, da shan wahala, da shan wuya, har da shan masifu.
english: but in everything commending ourselves as servants of God: in great endurance, in afflictions, in hardships, in distresses,

hausa: da dukan garuruwan Sihon sarkin Amoriyawa, wanda ya yi mulkin Heshbon, har zuwa iyakar Ammonawa.
english: and all the cities of Sihon king of the Amorites, who reigned in Heshbon, to the border of the children of Ammon;

hausa: Za su tsiro kamar ciyawa a wuriyar ruwa, kamar kurmi kusa da rafuffuka masu gudu.
english: and they will spring up among the grass, as willows by the watercourses.

hausa: Sa’an nan Ibrahim ya ce, “Kada Ubangiji yă yi fushi, amma bari in ƙara magana sau ɗaya tak. In aka sami mutum goma kaɗai a can fa?” Ubangiji ya ce, “Saboda goma nan, ba zan hallaka shi ba.”
english: He said, “Oh don’t let the Lord be angry, and I will speak just once more. What if ten are found there?” He said, “I will not destroy it for the ten’s sake.”

hausa: Kerubobin suka buɗe fikafikansu a bisa wurin akwatin alkawari suka kuma rufe akwatin alkawarin da sandunan ɗaukonsa.
english: For the cherubim spread out their wings over the place of the ark, and the cherubim covered the ark and its poles above.

hausa: Sai Shawulu ya ce wa mai riƙe masa kayan yaƙi, “Zare takobinka ka soke ni, in ba haka ba waɗannan marasa kaciya za su zo su yi mini ba’a.” Amma mai ɗaukar masa kayan yaƙi ya ji tsoro bai kuwa yi haka ba; saboda haka Shawulu ya zāre takobinsa ya fāɗi a kansa.
english: Then Saul said to his armor bearer, “Draw your sword, and thrust me through with it, lest these uncircumcised come and abuse me.” But his armor bearer would not, for he was terrified. Therefore Saul took his sword and fell on it.

hausa: mai shaidar ƙarya wanda yake zuba ƙarairayi, da kuma mutumin da yake tā-da-na-zaune-tsaye a cikin ’yan’uwa.
english: a false witness who utters lies, and he who sows discord among brothers.

hausa: Sai ya kira ƙaramin yaro ya sa shi yă tsaya a tsakiyarsu.
english: Jesus called a little child to himself, and set him in the middle of them

hausa: da man zaitun don fitila; da kayan yaji don man shafewa, da kuma turare mai ƙanshi;
english: oil for the light, spices for the anointing oil and for the sweet incense,

hausa: Idan ina da laifi, kaitona! Ko da ba ni da laifi, ba zan iya ɗaga fuskata ba, gama kunya ta ishe ni duk ɓacin rai ya ishe ni.
english: If I am wicked, woe to me. If I am righteous, I still will not lift up my head, being filled with disgrace, and conscious of my affliction.

hausa: Amma ko bayan da suka cinye su, babu wanda zai iya faɗa cewa sun yi haka; suna nan dai munana kamar yadda suke a dā. Sai na farka.
english: and when they had eaten them up, it couldn’t be known that they had eaten them, but they were still ugly, as at the beginning. So I awoke.

hausa: In ka ga jakin wani maƙiyinka ya fāɗi a ƙarƙashin kayan da ya ɗauka, kada ka bar shi can, ka yi ƙoƙari ka taimake shi.
english: If you see the donkey of him who hates you fallen down under his burden, don’t leave him. You shall surely help him with it.

hausa: Yana zuba ruwan sama a ƙasa; yana zuba ruwa a gonaki.
english: who gives rain on the earth, and sends waters on the fields;

hausa: “To, ɗan mutum, ka kafa idonka a kan ’yan matan mutanenka waɗanda suke annabci bisa ga ra’ayinsu. Yi annabci a kansu
english: You, son of man, set your face against the daughters of your people, who prophesy out of their own heart; and prophesy against them,

hausa: ya kuma san cewa Yaƙub ya yi biyayya da mahaifinsa da kuma mahaifiyarsa, ya kuwa tafi Faddan Aram.
english: and that Jacob obeyed his father and his mother, and was gone to Paddan Aram.

hausa: “A wannan rana “kyawawan ’yan mata da kuma samari masu ji da ƙarfi za su suma don ƙishirwa.
english: In that day the beautiful virgins and the young men will faint for thirst.

hausa: Sa’an nan ya bar taron ya shiga gida. Almajiransa kuwa suka zo wurinsa suka ce, “Bayyana mana misalin ciyayin nan a gona.”
english: Then Jesus sent the multitudes away, and went into the house. His disciples came to him, saying, “Explain to us the parable of the darnel weeds of the field.”

hausa: Yayinda take cikin magana tare da sarki, sai annabi Natan ya iso.
english: Behold, while she was still talking with the king, Nathan the prophet came in.

hausa: Ubangiji ya yi amfani da annabi don yă fitar da Isra’ila daga Masar ta wurin annabi ya lura da shi.
english: By a prophet Yahweh brought Israel up out of Egypt, and by a prophet he was preserved.

hausa: Da jin haka sai suka tattoshe kunnuwansu, suka kuma yi ihu da ƙarfi sosai, suka aukar masa gaba ɗaya.
english: But they cried out with a loud voice and stopped their ears, then rushed at him with one accord.

hausa: sai wata iska mai ƙarfi daga hamada ta auka ta rushe gidan, gidan kuwa ya fāɗi a kan ’ya’yanka ya kashe su, ni kaɗai na tsira na zo in gaya maka!”
english: and behold, there came a great wind from the wilderness, and struck the four corners of the house, and it fell on the young men, and they are dead. I alone have escaped to tell you.”

hausa: daga zuriyar Merari Asahiya shugaba da dangi 220;
english: of the sons of Merari, Asaiah the chief, and his brothers two hundred twenty;

hausa: Amma ga waɗanda suke tsoronka, ka ɗaga tuta don a buɗe gāba da baka. Sela
english: You have given a banner to those who fear you, that it may be displayed because of the truth. Selah.

hausa: Amma a shekara ta goma sha takwas ta mulkin sarki Yosiya, aka yi Bikin Ƙetarewan nan ga Ubangiji a Urushalima.
english: but in the eighteenth year of King Josiah, this Passover was kept to Yahweh in Jerusalem.

hausa: Suka ce musu, “Ga abin da za ku yi. Ku karkashe duk namiji da kowace macen da ta riga ta san namiji.”
english: This is the thing that you shall do: you shall utterly destroy every male, and every woman who has lain with a man.”

hausa: Ku tsare mutuncin marasa ƙarfi da marayu; ku kāre hakkin matalauta da waɗanda ake danniya.
english: “Defend the weak, the poor, and the fatherless. Maintain the rights of the poor and oppressed.

hausa: Irin wannan sanin game da ni ya fi ƙarfin magana, ya fi ƙarfi in gane.
english: This knowledge is beyond me. It’s lofty. I can’t attain it.

hausa: Sai ya tambaye, su ya ce, “In wani a cikinku yana da ɗa, ko bijimi da ya faɗa a rijiya a ranar Asabbaci, ba za ku cire shi nan da nan ba?”
english: He answered them, “Which of you, if your son or an ox fell into a well, wouldn’t immediately pull him out on a Sabbath day?”

hausa: Da yake maganar sarki ita ce mafificiya, wa zai iya ce masa, “Me kake yi?”
english: for the king’s word is supreme. Who can say to him, “What are you doing?”

hausa: “Ko da yake an yashe ki aka kuma ƙi ki, har babu wani da ya ratsa a cikinki, zan mai da ke madawwamiyar abar taƙama da kuma farin cikin dukan zamanai.
english: “Whereas you have been forsaken and hated, so that no one passed through you, I will make you an eternal excellency, a joy of many generations.

hausa: Gama mun so mu zo wurinku, tabbatacce ni, Bulus, na yi ƙoƙari sau da sau, amma Shaiɗan ya hana mu.
english: because we wanted to come to you—indeed, I, Paul, once and again—but Satan hindered us.

hausa: Ba za ku ci jini ba, ku zubar da shi a ƙasa kamar ruwa.
english: You shall not eat it. You shall pour it out on the earth like water.

hausa: Ga waɗanda ba su da ƙarfi, na zama marar ƙarfi, domin in rinjayi waɗanda ba su da ƙarfi. Na zama dukan abu ga dukan mutane, domin ko ta yaya in zai yiwu, in ceci waɗansu.
english: To the weak I became as weak, that I might gain the weak. I have become all things to all men, that I may by all means save some.

hausa: Da Musa ya gaya wa dukan Isra’ilawa wannan labari, sai suka yi baƙin ciki ƙwarai.
english: Moses told these words to all the children of Israel, and the people mourned greatly.

hausa: Saboda haka, samarinta za su fāɗi a tituna; za a kawar da dukan sojojinta a wannan rana,” in ji Ubangiji.
english: Therefore her young men will fall in her streets. All her men of war will be brought to silence in that day,” says Yahweh.

hausa: Amma waɗannan ba za ku ci ba, gaggafa, ungulu, ungulun kwakwa,
english: But these are they of which you shall not eat: the eagle, the vulture, the osprey,

hausa: Yawan mutanen sashensa 46,500 ne.
english: His division, and those who were counted of it, were forty-six thousand five hundred.

hausa: domin kada wani ya yi taƙama a gabansa.
english: that no flesh should boast before God.

hausa: Duk da haka ka san ni, ya Ubangiji; kana ganina ka kuma gwada tunanina game da kai. Ka ja su kamar tumakin da za a yanka! Ka ware su don ranar yanka!
english: But you, Yahweh, know me. You see me, and test my heart toward you. Pull them out like sheep for the slaughter, and prepare them for the day of slaughter.

hausa: Ya ce musu, “A rubuce, yake cewa, ‘Gidana, zai zama gidan addu’a,’amma ga shi kun mai da shi ‘kogon ’yan fashi.’ ”
english: saying to them, “It is written, ‘My house is a house of prayer,’ but you have made it a ‘den of robbers’!”

hausa: Sa’an nan zan cika rantsuwar da na yi wa kakanni-kakanninku, da zan ba su ƙasa mai zub da madara da kuma zuma’ ƙasar da kuka mallaka a yau.” Sai na amsa na ce, “Amin, Ubangiji.”
english: that I may establish the oath which I swore to your fathers, to give them a land flowing with milk and honey,’ as it is today.” Then I answered, and said, “Amen, Yahweh.”

hausa: Ƙasar ta cika da mazinata; saboda la’ana ƙasar ta zama kango makiyaya a hamada ta bushe. Annabawa suna bin mugayen muradu suna kuma amfani da ƙarfinsu a hanyar marar kyau.
english: “For the land is full of adulterers; for because of the curse the land mourns. The pastures of the wilderness have dried up. Their course is evil, and their might is not right;

hausa: sai Irmiya ya bar birnin don yă je yankin Benyamin ya sami rabon mallaka a cikin mutane a can.
english: then Jeremiah went out of Jerusalem to go into the land of Benjamin, to receive his portion there, in the middle of the people.

hausa: Ka sāka a cinyoyin maƙwabtanmu sau bakwai zage-zagen da suka yi ta yi maka, ya Ubangiji.
english: Pay back to our neighbors seven times into their bosom their reproach with which they have reproached you, Lord.

hausa: In yana yaɗuwa a cikin fatar jikin, firist zai furta shi marar tsarki; cuta mai yaɗuwa ce.
english: If it spreads in the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean. It is a plague.

hausa: Sai mala’ikan Ubangiji ya tsaya a wata matsattsiyar hanya tsakanin gonaki inabi biyu, da bango a kowane gefe.
english: Then Yahweh’s angel stood in a narrow path between the vineyards, a wall being on this side, and a wall on that side.

hausa: Dūka da kunya ne za su zama rabonsa, kuma kunyarsa za tă dawwama.
english: He will get wounds and dishonor. His reproach will not be wiped away.

hausa: Sa’an nan Mowab za tă ji kunyar Kemosh, yadda gidan Isra’ila ya ji kunya sa’ad da suka dogara ga Betel.
english: Moab will be ashamed of Chemosh, as the house of Israel was ashamed of Bethel, their confidence.

hausa: Zuriyar Yaƙub duka sun kai mutum saba’in. Yusuf ya riga ya kasance a Masar.
english: All the souls who came out of Jacob’s body were seventy souls, and Joseph was in Egypt already.

hausa: Ibrahim ya sa wa ɗan da Saratu ta haifa masa suna Ishaku.
english: Abraham called his son who was born to him, whom Sarah bore to him, Isaac.

hausa: Ranar kuwa ita ce ranar Shirye-shirye (wato, ana kashegari Asabbaci). Saboda haka, da yamma ta yi, sai
english: When evening had now come, because it was the Preparation Day, that is, the day before the Sabbath,

hausa: Suna cewa, ‘Waɗannan mutanen da aka ɗauka a ƙarshe sun yi aikin sa’a ɗaya ne kawai, ka kuma mai da su daidai da mu da muka yini muna faman aiki, muka kuma sha zafin rana.’
english: saying, ‘These last have spent one hour, and you have made them equal to us who have borne the burden of the day and the scorching heat!’

hausa: Sai Ruhun Allah ya sauko a kan Zakariya ɗan Yehohiyada firist. Ya tsaya a gaban mutane ya ce, “Ga abin da Allah ya ce, ‘Me ya sa ba ku yi biyayya da umarnan Ubangiji ba? Ba za ku yi nasara ba. Domin kun yashe Ubangiji, shi ma ya yashe ku.’ ”
english: The Spirit of God came on Zechariah the son of Jehoiada the priest; and he stood above the people, and said to them, “God says, ‘Why do you disobey Yahweh’s commandments, so that you can’t prosper? Because you have forsaken Yahweh, he has also forsaken you.’”

hausa: wanda shi kaɗai ne marar mutuwa wanda kuma yake zaune cikin hasken da ba ya kusatuwa, wanda babu wanda ya taɓa gani ko zai iya gani. A gare shi girma da iko su tabbata har abada. Amin.
english: He alone has immortality, dwelling in unapproachable light, whom no man has seen nor can see, to whom be honor and eternal power. Amen.

hausa: To, ina so ku gane cewa shugaban kowane namiji Kiristi ne, shugaban mace namiji ne, shugaban Kiristi kuma Allah ne.
english: But I would have you know that the head of every man is Christ, and the head of the woman is man, and the head of Christ is God.

hausa: Mai ba’a kan nemi hikima amma ba ya samun kome, amma sani kan zo a sawwaƙe ga mai basira.
english: A scoffer seeks wisdom, and doesn’t find it, but knowledge comes easily to a discerning person.

hausa: Ka tuna fa, dā kai bawa ne a ƙasar Masar amma Ubangiji Allahnka ya fitar da kai daga can da iko da kuma ƙarfi. Saboda haka Ubangiji Allahnka ya umarce ka ka kiyaye ranar Asabbaci.
english: You shall remember that you were a servant in the land of Egypt, and Yahweh your God brought you out of there by a mighty hand and by an outstretched arm. Therefore Yahweh your God commanded you to keep the Sabbath day.

hausa: A kewayen bakin ƙaton kwanon akwai layi biyu na siffofin goran ƙarfen tagulla, akwai gora shida cikin kowane ƙafa. An yi zubinsu haɗe da kwanon nan da kira Teku.
english: Under its brim around there were buds which encircled it for ten cubits, encircling the sea. The buds were in two rows, cast when it was cast.

hausa: Yanzu kam muna ganin abubuwa kamar a madubi sai dai ba sosai ba, amma a ranan nan za mu gani fuska da fuska. Yanzu kam sanina ba cikakke ba ne, amma a ranan nan zan kasance da cikakken sani, kamar dai yadda Allah ya san ni a yanzu.
english: For now we see in a mirror, dimly, but then face to face. Now I know in part, but then I will know fully, even as I was also fully known.

hausa: Tare da su kuwa, akwai kowane naman jeji bisa ga irinsa, da dukan dabbobin gida bisa ga irinsu, da kowace halitta mai rarrafe a ƙasa bisa ga irinta, da kowane tsuntsun gida da na jeji bisa ga irinsa, da dukan abu mai fiffike.
english: they, and every animal after its kind, all the livestock after their kind, every creeping thing that creeps on the earth after its kind, and every bird after its kind, every bird of every sort.

hausa: Yana da ’ya’ya saba’in maza da ya haifa, gama yana da mata da yawa.
english: Gideon had seventy sons conceived from his body, for he had many wives.

hausa: sai Filistiyawa suka ji tsoro, suka ce, “Wani allah ya shiga cikin sansanin. Mun shiga uku! Ba a taɓa yin wani abu haka ba.
english: The Philistines were afraid, for they said, “God has come into the camp.” They said, “Woe to us! For there has not been such a thing before.

hausa: Yesu bai ce mata uffam ba. Saboda haka almajiransa suka zo wurinsa suka roƙe shi suka ce, “Ka kore ta tă tafi, tana ta binmu tana damunmu da ihu.”
english: But he answered her not a word. His disciples came and begged him, saying, “Send her away; for she cries after us.”

hausa: Ubangiji Maɗaukaki kuma zai tsare su. Za su hallakar su kuma yi nasara da duwatsun majajjawa. Za su sha su yi kururuwa kamar sun sha ruwan inabi; za su cika kamar kwanon da ake amfani don a yayyafa jini a kusurwoyin bagade.
english: Yahweh of Armies will defend them. They will destroy and overcome with sling stones. They will drink, and roar as through wine. They will be filled like bowls, like the corners of the altar.

hausa: Bayansa kuma sai Yayir daga Gileyad, wanda ya shugabanci Isra’ila shekara ashirin da biyu.
english: After him Jair, the Gileadite, arose. He judged Israel twenty-two years.

hausa: Ku yafa dukan kayan yaƙin da Allah yake bayarwa, don ku iya kāre kanku daga dabarun Shaiɗan.
english: Put on the whole armor of God, that you may be able to stand against the wiles of the devil.

hausa: Amma godiya ga Allah, wanda kullum yake bi da mu da nasara cikin Kiristi, kuma ta wurinmu, yana baza ƙanshin nan na sanin Kiristi a ko’ina.
english: Now thanks be to God who always leads us in triumph in Christ, and reveals through us the sweet aroma of his knowledge in every place.

hausa: Ubangiji ya amsa ya ce, “Zan tafi tare da kai, zan kuma rage maka nauyin kaya.”
english: He said, “My presence will go with you, and I will give you rest.”

hausa: ’Ya’yan Neyariya maza su ne, Eliyohenai, Hezekiya da Azrikam, su uku ne duka.
english: The sons of Neariah: Elioenai, Hizkiah, and Azrikam, three.

hausa: Sai ga mace ta fito don ta sadu da shi, saye da riga kamar karuwa shirye kuma don ta yaudare shi.
english: Behold, there a woman met him with the attire of a prostitute, and with crafty intent.

hausa: A shekara ta biyu ta mulkinsa, Nebukadnezzar ya yi mafarkai; hankalinsa ya tashi har ya kāsa barci.
english: In the second year of the reign of Nebuchadnezzar, Nebuchadnezzar dreamed dreams; and his spirit was troubled, and his sleep went from him.

hausa: Sa’an nan Nehemiya gwamna, Ezra firist da kuma wanda yake malamin Doka, da Lawiyawa waɗanda suke koyar da mutane, suka ce musu duka, “Wannan rana mai tsarki ce ga Ubangiji Allahnku. Kada ku yi makoki ko kuka.” Gama dukan mutane suna ta kuka yayinda suke sauraran kalmomin Dokar.
english: Nehemiah, who was the governor, Ezra the priest and scribe, and the Levites who taught the people said to all the people, “Today is holy to Yahweh your God. Don’t mourn, nor weep.” For all the people wept when they heard the words of the law.

hausa: Ba za su yi wahalar zuwa jeji don neman itacen hura wuta ba, domin za su yi amfani da makamai don hura wuta. Za su kuma washe waɗanda suka washe su ganima, in ji Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka.
english: so that they will take no wood out of the field, and not cut down any out of the forests; for they will make fires with the weapons. They will plunder those who plundered them, and rob those who robbed them,” says the Lord Yahweh.

hausa: I, Ubangiji, cikin tafiya a hanyar dokokinka, muna sa zuciya gare ka; sunanka da tunani a kanka su ne marmarin zukatanmu.
english: Yes, in the way of your judgments, Yahweh, we have waited for you. Your name and your renown are the desire of our soul.

hausa: Sa’an nan ya sa kowa a Urushalima da Benyamin ya yi alkawari ga wannan; mutanen Urushalima suka aikata wannan bisa ga alkawarin Allah, Allah na kakanninsu.
english: He caused all who were found in Jerusalem and Benjamin to stand. The inhabitants of Jerusalem did according to the covenant of God, the God of their fathers.

hausa: Alkawarin farko ya ƙunshi ƙa’idodi don sujada da kuma tsattsarkan wuri a duniya.
english: Now indeed even the first covenant had ordinances of divine service and an earthly sanctuary.

hausa: “A ce yana da ɗa wanda yana kisa ko yana yin ɗaya daga cikin waɗannan abubuwa
english: “If he fathers a son who is a robber who sheds blood, and who does any one of these things,

hausa: “ ‘A ranar zan yi wa Gog makabarta a cikin Isra’ila, a kwarin waɗanda suke tafiya wajen gabashin Teku. Za tă tare hanyar matafiya, domin za a binne Gog da dukan mutanensa a can. Ta haka za a kira wurin Kwarin Haman Gog.
english: “‘“It will happen in that day, that I will give to Gog a place for burial in Israel, the valley of those who pass through on the east of the sea; and it will stop those who pass through. They will bury Gog and all his multitude there, and they will call it ‘The valley of Hamon Gog’.

hausa: Sai Hannatu ta yi addu’a ta ce, “Zuciyata tana farin ciki a cikin Ubangiji; a cikin Ubangiji an sa ina jin daɗi ƙwarai. Na buɗe bakina na yi wa abokan gābana dariya. Kai! Ina murna domin ka cece ni!
english: Hannah prayed, and said, “My heart exults in Yahweh! My horn is exalted in Yahweh. My mouth is enlarged over my enemies, because I rejoice in your salvation.

hausa: Ku lura da kalmomina! Ni Bulus ina gaya muku cewa in kuka yarda aka yi muku kaciya, wannan ya nuna Kiristi ba shi da amfani a gare ku ba ko kaɗan.
english: Behold, I, Paul, tell you that if you receive circumcision, Christ will profit you nothing.

hausa: Suka ce wa juna, “Ga mai mafarkin nan can zuwa!
english: They said to one another, “Behold, this dreamer comes.

hausa: Bisa ga farillar mahaifinsa Dawuda, ya naɗa ɓangarori na firistoci don ayyukansu da Lawiyawa don su jagoranci yabo su kuma taimaki firistoci bisa ga bukace-bukacen kowace rana. Ya kuma naɗa matsara ƙofofi ɓangarori, ɓangarori don ƙofofi dabam-dabam domin abin da Dawuda mutumin Allah ya umarta ke nan.
english: He appointed, according to the ordinance of David his father, the divisions of the priests to their service, and the Levites to their offices, to praise and to minister before the priests, as the duty of every day required, the doorkeepers also by their divisions at every gate, for David the man of God had so commanded.

hausa: “Ku yi ta kai da kawowa a titunan Urushalima, ku dudduba ko’ina ku kuma lura, ku bincika cikin dandalinta. Ko za ku sami mutum guda wanda yake aikata adalci wanda yake kuma son bin gaskiya, sai in gafarta wa wannan birni.
english: “Run back and forth through the streets of Jerusalem, and see now, and know, and seek in its wide places, if you can find a man, if there is anyone who does justly, who seeks truth, then I will pardon her.

hausa: “Ya raba ni da ’yan’uwana maza; abokaina sun zama baƙi gare ni.
english: “He has put my brothers far from me. My acquaintances are wholly estranged from me.

hausa: Kada ka ba da shaidar ƙarya a kan maƙwabcinka.
english: “You shall not give false testimony against your neighbor.

hausa: Sa’an nan Musa ya kira dukan dattawan Isra’ila ya ce musu, “Ku je da sauri ku zaɓi dabbobin iyalanku, ku yanka ragon Bikin Ƙetarewa.
english: Then Moses called for all the elders of Israel, and said to them, “Draw out, and take lambs according to your families, and kill the Passover.

hausa: ya kuma kawo bunsuru ɗaya domin hadaya don zunubi;
english: one male goat for a sin offering;

hausa: Sukan kwana a kewayen gidan Allah, domin dole su tsare shi; kuma su suke lura da mabuɗi don buɗewa a kowace safiya.
english: They stayed around God’s house, because that was their duty; and it was their duty to open it morning by morning.

hausa: Sa’ad da Ruben ya dawo wurin rijiyar, sai ya tarar cewa Yusuf ba ya can, sai ya kyakkece tufafinsa.
english: Reuben returned to the pit, and saw that Joseph wasn’t in the pit; and he tore his clothes.

hausa: In kuwa ta rabu da shi, sai ta kasance ba aure, ko kuma ta sāke shiryawa da mijinta. Kada miji kuma yă saki matarsa.
english: (but if she departs, let her remain unmarried, or else be reconciled to her husband), and that the husband not leave his wife.

hausa: To, ana sanyi, bayi da ma’aikatan suna tsattsaye kewaye da wutar da suka hura don su ji ɗumi. Bitrus ma yana tsaye tare da su, yana jin ɗumi.
english: Now the servants and the officers were standing there, having made a fire of coals, for it was cold. They were warming themselves. Peter was with them, standing and warming himself.

hausa: Sa’an nan ya tafi ƙasar Hittiyawa, inda ya gina birni ya kuma kira shi Luz, haka ake kira birnin har wa yau.
english: The man went into the land of the Hittites, built a city, and called its name Luz, which is its name to this day.

hausa: Kada a ruɗe ku. Ba a yi wa Allah ba’a. Mutum yakan girbe abin da ya shuka ne.
english: Don’t be deceived. God is not mocked, for whatever a man sows, that he will also reap.

hausa: Saboda haka na ce wa Isra’ilawa, “Babu waninku da zai ci jini, babu wani baƙon da yake zama a cikinku da zai ci jini.”
english: Therefore I have said to the children of Israel, “No person among you may eat blood, nor may any stranger who lives as a foreigner among you eat blood.”

hausa: Sa’ad da ta zuba turaren nan a jikina, ta shirya ni ne don jana’izata.
english: For in pouring this ointment on my body, she did it to prepare me for burial.

hausa: Saboda hasalarka babu lafiya a jikina; ƙasusuwana ba lafiya saboda zunubina.
english: There is no soundness in my flesh because of your indignation, neither is there any health in my bones because of my sin.

hausa: Yakan ba sarkinsa nasarori; yakan nuna alheri marar ƙarewa ga shafaffensa, ga Dawuda da zuriyarsa har abada.
english: He gives great deliverance to his king, and shows loving kindness to his anointed, to David and to his offspring, forever more.

hausa: Na ɓace kamar inuwar yamma; ana kakkaɓe ni kamar fāra.
english: I fade away like an evening shadow. I am shaken off like a locust.

hausa: “Ku fito yanzu ku ƙetare Kwarin Arnon. Duba, na ba da Sihon mutumin Amoriyawa a hannunku, na kuma ba da sarkin Heshbon da ƙasarsa. Ku fara mallake ta, ku kuma yi yaƙi da shi.
english: “Rise up, take your journey, and pass over the valley of the Arnon. Behold, I have given into your hand Sihon the Amorite, king of Heshbon, and his land; begin to possess it, and contend with him in battle.

hausa: Sai zuciyar sarki Dawuda ya komo kan Absalom, gama an yi masa ta’aziyya game da mutuwar Amnon.
english: King David longed to go out to Absalom, for he was comforted concerning Amnon, since he was dead.

hausa: Sai sarki ya ce wa mutumin Allah, “Ka roƙi Ubangiji Allahnka, ka kuma yi addu’a domina don hannuna ya warke.” Saboda haka mutumin Allah ya yi roƙo ga Ubangiji, hannun sarki kuwa ya warke, ya kuma zama kamar yadda yake a dā.
english: The king answered the man of God, “Now intercede for the favor of Yahweh your God, and pray for me, that my hand may be restored to me.” The man of God interceded with Yahweh, and the king’s hand was restored to him, and became as it was before.

hausa: da zai kāsa samun riɓi mai yawa, a wannan zamani, ya kuma sami rai madawwami a zamani mai zuwa.”
english: who will not receive many times more in this time, and in the world to come, eternal life.”

hausa: Ga wa zan yi magana in kuma gargaɗar? Wa zai saurare ni? Kunnuwansu sun toshe don kada su ji. Maganar Ubangiji ta zama abin zargi a gare su; ba sa jin daɗinta.
english: To whom should I speak and testify, that they may hear? Behold, their ear is uncircumcised, and they can’t listen. Behold, Yahweh’s word has become a reproach to them. They have no delight in it.

hausa: Sai muka sāke ginin katangar sai da duka ta kai rabin tsayinta, gama mutane sun yi aiki da dukan ƙarfinsu.
english: So we built the wall; and all the wall was joined together to half its height, for the people had a mind to work.

hausa: Mala’ikan Ubangiji ya ce, “Ko kun sa na tsaya, ba zan ci abincinku ba. Amma in kun shirya hadaya ta ƙonawa, ku miƙa wa Ubangiji.” (Manowa bai gane cewa mala’ikan Ubangiji ne ba.)
english: Yahweh’s angel said to Manoah, “Though you detain me, I won’t eat your bread. If you will prepare a burnt offering, you must offer it to Yahweh.” For Manoah didn’t know that he was Yahweh’s angel.

hausa: wato, azurfa da zinariyan mutanen Edom, da na Mowabawa, da na Ammonawa, da na Filistiyawa, da na Amalekawa, da ganimar Hadadezer ɗan Rehob, sarkin Zoba.
english: of Syria, of Moab, of the children of Ammon, of the Philistines, of Amalek, and of the plunder of Hadadezer, son of Rehob, king of Zobah.

hausa: Waɗannan su ne sarakuna da kuma ƙasashen da Yoshuwa da Isra’ilawa suka ci da yaƙi a yammancin Urdun, daga Ba’al-Gad a Kwarin Lebanon zuwa Dutsen Halak wanda ya miƙe zuwa Seyir. Yoshuwa ya raba ƙasarsu ta zama gādo ga Isra’ilawa bisa ga yadda aka raba su kabila-kabila.
english: These are the kings of the land whom Joshua and the children of Israel struck beyond the Jordan westward, from Baal Gad in the valley of Lebanon even to Mount Halak, that goes up to Seir. Joshua gave it to the tribes of Israel for a possession according to their divisions;

hausa: Kada mu gaji da yin nagarta, gama a daidai lokaci za mu girbe amfani, in ba mu fid da zuciya ba.
english: Let’s not be weary in doing good, for we will reap in due season if we don’t give up.

hausa: Suka haɗa kai da Ba’al-Feyor suka kuma ci hadayun da aka miƙa wa allolin da ba su da rai;
english: They joined themselves also to Baal Peor, and ate the sacrifices of the dead.

hausa: Ba za ka rusuna musu, ko ka yi musu sujada ba. Gama Ni, Ubangiji Allahnka, Allah ne mai kishi, nakan hukunta ’ya’ya saboda zunuban iyaye har tsara ta uku da ta huɗu na waɗanda suka ƙi ni.
english: You shall not bow yourself down to them, nor serve them, for I, Yahweh your God, am a jealous God, visiting the iniquity of the fathers on the children and on the third and on the fourth generation of those who hate me

hausa: Ya umarci wanda yake jagorar ya ce, “Sa’ad da ɗan’uwana Isuwa ya sadu da ku ya kuma yi tambaya, ‘Ku na wane ne, ina za ku, kuma wane ne mai dukan dabbobin nan da suke gabanku?’
english: He commanded the foremost, saying, “When Esau, my brother, meets you, and asks you, saying, ‘Whose are you? Where are you going? Whose are these before you?’

hausa: Sa’an nan ya zuba ɓararre rassan cikin dukan kwamame na banruwa saboda su kasance a gaban garkunan sa’ad da suka zo shan ruwa. A sa’ad da garkunan suke barbara suka kuma zo shan ruwa,
english: He set the rods which he had peeled opposite the flocks in the watering troughs where the flocks came to drink. They conceived when they came to drink.

hausa: Sun sa mini ido, yanzu sun kewaye ni, a shirye suke, su jefa ni a ƙasa.
english: They have now surrounded us in our steps. They set their eyes to cast us down to the earth.

hausa: Kada yă ci wani abin da ya mutu mushe, ko wanda namun jeji suka yayyaga, don kada yă ƙazantar da kansa. Ni ne Ubangiji.
english: He shall not eat that which dies of itself or is torn by animals, defiling himself by it. I am Yahweh.

hausa: hana ta yana kamar yin ƙoƙari tsai da iska ne ko yin ƙoƙarin cafke mai a tafin hannunka.
english: restraining her is like restraining the wind, or like grasping oil in his right hand.

hausa: “Ka yi magana da Zerubbabel ɗan Sheyaltiyel wanda yake gwamna a Yahuda, da Yoshuwa ɗan Yehozadak, babban firist, da kuma dukan raguwar mutane. Ka tambaye su ka ce,
english: “Speak now to Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and to Joshua the son of Jehozadak, the high priest, and to the remnant of the people, saying,

hausa: Asaf shi ne babba, sai Zakariya na biye, sa’an nan Ya’aziyel, Shemiramot, Yehiyel, Mattitiya, Eliyab, Benahiya, Obed-Edom da Yehiyel. Su ne za su kaɗa molaye, da garayu, Asaf kuwa zai buga ganguna,
english: Asaph the chief, and second to him Zechariah, then Jeiel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Mattithiah, Eliab, Benaiah, Obed-Edom, and Jeiel, with stringed instruments and with harps; and Asaph with cymbals, sounding aloud;

hausa: Ku saurari masu gudun hijira da masu neman mafaka daga Babilon suna furtawa a Sihiyona yadda Ubangiji Allahnmu ya ɗauki fansa, fansa domin haikalinsa.
english: Listen to those who flee and escape out of the land of Babylon, to declare in Zion the vengeance of Yahweh our God, the vengeance of his temple.

hausa: Za tă kuma zama alama a hannunku da kuma shaida a goshinku cewa Ubangiji ya fito da mu daga Masar da hannunsa mai iko.”
english: It shall be for a sign on your hand, and for symbols between your eyes; for by strength of hand Yahweh brought us out of Egypt.”

hausa: Ka karye hannun mugaye da kuma mugun mutum; ka nemi hakki daga gare shi saboda muguntar da ba za a gane ba.
english: Break the arm of the wicked. As for the evil man, seek out his wickedness until you find none.

hausa: Sai Ubangiji ya fitar da mu daga Masar da hannu mai ƙarfi da kuma iko, da razana mai girma da kuma alamu banmamaki da al’ajabai.
english: Yahweh brought us out of Egypt with a mighty hand, with an outstretched arm, with great terror, with signs, and with wonders;

hausa: sai suka tambaye juna suka ce, “Wane ne zai gungura mana dutsen daga bakin kabarin?”
english: They were saying among themselves, “Who will roll away the stone from the door of the tomb for us?”

hausa: Ku shaidu ne, haka ma Allah, na yadda muka yi zaman tsarki, adalci da kuma marar aibi a cikinku, ku da kuka ba da gaskiya.
english: You are witnesses with God how holy, righteously, and blamelessly we behaved ourselves toward you who believe.

hausa: Zan kafa masa tarkona, zai kuma fāɗi a tarkona. Zan kawo shi a Babilon in kuma hukunta shi a can domin ya yi mini rashin aminci.
english: I will spread my net on him, and he will be taken in my snare. I will bring him to Babylon, and will enter into judgment with him there for his trespass that he has trespassed against me.

hausa: Sai sarkin Isra’ila da Yehoshafat sarkin Yahuda suka haura zuwa Ramot Gileyad.
english: So the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat the king of Judah went up to Ramoth Gilead.

hausa: Yoshuwa ya daɗe yana yaƙi da dukan waɗannan sarakuna.
english: Joshua made war a long time with all those kings.

hausa: ɗan Amariya, ɗan Azariya, ɗan Merahiyot,
english: the son of Amariah, the son of Azariah, the son of Meraioth,

hausa: Da Yesu ya gan shi kwance a can ya kuma sami labari cewa ya daɗe a wannan hali, sai ya tambaye shi, “Kana so ka warke?”
english: When Jesus saw him lying there, and knew that he had been sick for a long time, he asked him, “Do you want to be made well?”
