hausa: Saboda haka kashegari, mutane suka tashi da sassafe suka miƙa hadaya ta ƙonawa, da hadaya ta salama. Bayan haka suka zauna suka ci, suka sha, suka kuma tashi suka yi rawa.
english: They rose up early on the next day, and offered burnt offerings, and brought peace offerings; and the people sat down to eat and to drink, and rose up to play.

hausa: Yesu ya amsa ya ce, “Ku gaskata da Allah.
english: Jesus answered them, “Have faith in God.

hausa: Amma kai ne kaɗai da ’ya’yanka za ku yi aiki a matsayin firistoci game da kowane abu a Tentin Sujada da kuma bayan labule. Ina ba ka aikin firist, yă zama naka. Duk wani kuma da ya zo kusa da wuri mai tsarki, dole a kashe shi.”
english: You and your sons with you shall keep your priesthood for everything of the altar, and for that within the veil. You shall serve. I give you the service of the priesthood as a gift. The stranger who comes near shall be put to death.”

hausa: Yehoram yana da shekara talatin da biyu sa’ad da ya zama sarki, ya kuma yi mulki a Urushalima shekara takwas. Ya mutu, ba ma wanda ya kula, aka kuma binne shi a Birnin Dawuda, amma ba a makabartan sarakuna ba.
english: He was thirty-two years old when he began to reign, and he reigned in Jerusalem eight years. He departed with no one’s regret. They buried him in David’s city, but not in the tombs of the kings.

hausa: An kawar da masu tsoron Allah daga ƙasar; babu sauran mai adalcin da ya rage. Dukan mutane suna kwanto don su zub da jini; kowa yana farautar ɗan’uwansa da tarko.
english: The godly man has perished out of the earth, and there is no one upright among men. They all lie in wait for blood; every man hunts his brother with a net.

hausa: Ubangiji ya rantse da hannunsa na dama ta hannunsa kuma mai iko cewa, “Ba zan ƙara ba da hatsinki ya zama abinci ga abokan gābanki ba, baƙi kuma ba za su ƙara shan ruwan inabin wanda kika sha wahala samu ba;
english: Yahweh has sworn by his right hand, and by the arm of his strength, “Surely I will no more give your grain to be food for your enemies, and foreigners will not drink your new wine, for which you have labored,

hausa: Abin hura wutar mutum ne; yakan ɗebi waɗansu yă hura wuta don yă ji ɗumi, ya hura wuta yă gasa burodi. Amma yakan ƙera zinariya yă kuma yi masa sujada; yakan yi gunki sa’an nan yă rusuna masa.
english: Then it will be for a man to burn; and he takes some of it and warms himself. Yes, he burns it and bakes bread. Yes, he makes a god and worships it; he makes it a carved image, and falls down to it.

hausa: cewa zai cece mu daga abokan gābanmu daga kuma hannun dukan waɗanda suke ƙinmu
english: salvation from our enemies and from the hand of all who hate us;

hausa: Dukan mazaunan duniya za su yi wa dabbar sujada, dukan waɗanda ba a rubuta sunayensu a cikin littafin ran da yake na Ɗan Ragon da aka yanka tun kafin halittar duniya ba.
english: All who dwell on the earth will worship him, everyone whose name has not been written from the foundation of the world in the book of life of the Lamb who has been killed.

hausa: Za tă zama wurin shanya abin kamun kifi a tsakiyar teku, gama na faɗa, in ji Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka. Za tă zama ganima ga sauran al’ummai,
english: She will be a place for the spreading of nets in the middle of the sea; for I have spoken it,’ says the Lord Yahweh. ‘She will become plunder for the nations.

hausa: Sai ta gangara daga Yanowa zuwa Atarot da Na’ara, ta bi ta Yeriko, ta kuma fito ta Urdun.
english: It went down from Janoah to Ataroth, to Naarah, reached to Jericho, and went out at the Jordan.

hausa: “Ka ɗauki Midiyawa a matsayin abokan gāba, ka kuma kashe su,
english: “Harass the Midianites, and strike them;

hausa: ko boka, ko mabiya, ko maye, ko mai sha’ani da matattu.
english: or a charmer, or someone who consults with a familiar spirit, or a wizard, or a necromancer.

hausa: “Kada ki ji tsoro, ya Diyar Sihiyona; duba, ga sarkinki yana zuwa, zaune a kan aholaki jaki.”
english: “Don’t be afraid, daughter of Zion. Behold, your King comes, sitting on a donkey’s colt.”

hausa: Gaskiya ce kaɗai za ku bi don ku rayu, ku kuma mallaki ƙasar da Ubangiji Allahnku yake ba ku.
english: You shall follow that which is altogether just, that you may live and inherit the land which Yahweh your God gives you.

hausa: Yayinda Yesu yake ɗaya daga cikin garuruwan nan, sai ga wani mutum wanda kuturta ta ci ƙarfinsa. Da ganin Yesu, sai ya fāɗi da fuskarsa a ƙasa, ya roƙe shi ya ce, “Ubangiji, in ka yarda, kana iya ka tsabtacce ni.”
english: While he was in one of the cities, behold, there was a man full of leprosy. When he saw Jesus, he fell on his face and begged him, saying, “Lord, if you want to, you can make me clean.”

hausa: Ubangiji ya yi magana da Musa a kan Dutsen Sinai ya ce,
english: Yahweh said to Moses on Mount Sinai,

hausa: Yonatan ya ce wa mahaifinsa, “Me ya sa zai mutu? Me ya yi?”
english: Jonathan answered Saul his father, and said to him, “Why should he be put to death? What has he done?”

hausa: Bari duk ra’ayin da kake da shi game da wannan sha’ani yă kasance tsakaninka da Allah. Mai albarka ne wanda zuciyarsa ba tă ba shi laifi game da abin da shi da kansa ya ɗauka cewa daidai ne ba.
english: Do you have faith? Have it to yourself before God. Happy is he who doesn’t judge himself in that which he approves.

hausa: Ubangiji ya saki fushinsa; ya zuba zafin fushinsa. Ya hura wuta a Sihiyona ta kuma cinye harsashin gininta.
english: Yahweh has accomplished his wrath. He has poured out his fierce anger. He has kindled a fire in Zion, which has devoured its foundations.

hausa: Ta haka na saye ta da shekel goma sha biyar na azurfa da kuma wajen buhu na sha’ir.
english: So I bought her for myself for fifteen pieces of silver and a homer and a half of barley.

hausa: Mutum ne nagari, cike da Ruhu Mai Tsarki da bangaskiya, mutane masu yawan gaske kuwa suka juya ga Ubangiji.
english: For he was a good man, and full of the Holy Spirit and of faith, and many people were added to the Lord.

hausa: Wata rana, Farisiyawa suka tambaye shi lokacin da mulkin Allah zai zo, Yesu ya amsa ya ce, “Ai, mulkin Allah ba takan zo ta wurin yin kallon ku ba.
english: Being asked by the Pharisees when God’s Kingdom would come, he answered them, “God’s Kingdom doesn’t come with observation;

hausa: Zai cire dukan kitsen daga gare shi yă ƙone a kan bagade,
english: All its fat he shall take from it, and burn it on the altar.

hausa: Sa’an nan jama’a suka fita suka kwashi ganima a sansanin Arameyawa. Aka kuwa sayar da gari mai laushi a farashin shekel guda, mudu biyu na sha’ir kuma a shekel guda, yadda Ubangiji ya faɗi.
english: The people went out and plundered the camp of the Syrians. So a seah of fine flour was sold for a shekel, and two measures of barley for a shekel, according to Yahweh’s word.

hausa: Za a la’anta ’ya’yan cikinku, haka ma hatsin gonarku, da ’ya’yan shanunku da ’yan tumakinku.
english: The fruit of your body, the fruit of your ground, the increase of your livestock, and the young of your flock will be cursed.

hausa: Ƙasa ta sāke siffa kamar laka da aka yi wa hatimi; ta fito a fili kamar riga.
english: It is changed as clay under the seal, and presented as a garment.

hausa: “ ‘Sa’ad da shugaba ya yi zunubi ba da gangan ba, har ya aikata ɗaya daga cikin abubuwan da Ubangiji Allahnsa ya umarta, to, ya yi laifi.
english: “‘When a ruler sins, and unwittingly does any one of all the things which Yahweh his God has commanded not to be done, and is guilty,

hausa: Kafin in sha wahala na kauce, amma yanzu ina biyayya da maganarka.
english: Before I was afflicted, I went astray; but now I observe your word.

hausa: Daga Kibrot Hatta’awa, mutane suka yi tafiya zuwa Hazerot, a can suka sauka.
english: From Kibroth Hattaavah the people traveled to Hazeroth; and they stayed at Hazeroth.

hausa: Ta ci gaba ta ce, “A dā can, akan ce, ‘Sami amsarka a Abel,’ shi ke nan an gama.
english: Then she spoke, saying, “They used to say in old times, ‘They shall surely ask counsel at Abel,’ and so they settled a matter.

hausa: Mala’ika na biyu ya juye kwanonsa a bisan teku, sai tekun ya zama jini kamar na mataccen mutum, kuma kowane abu mai rai da yake cikin tekun ya mutu.
english: The second angel poured out his bowl into the sea, and it became blood as of a dead man. Every living thing in the sea died.

hausa: Sa’an nan ya yi kerubobi biyu da ƙeraren zinariya a ƙarshen murfin jinƙan.
english: He made two cherubim of gold. He made them of beaten work, at the two ends of the mercy seat:

hausa: Duk wanda ya kashe dabbar wani, dole yă biya, rai domin rai.
english: He who strikes an animal mortally shall make it good, life for life.

hausa: Na tarar cewa zargin da ake masa ya shafi waɗansu abubuwan da suka shafi dokarsu ne, amma ba wani zargi a kansa da ya isa kisa ko a daure shi.
english: I found him to be accused about questions of their law, but not to be charged with anything worthy of death or of imprisonment.

hausa: Za ku kiyaye bikin nan har kwana bakwai a kowace shekara ga Ubangiji. Wannan za tă zama dawwammamiyar farilla wa tsarraraki masu zuwa, ku kiyaye ta a wata na bakwai.
english: You shall keep it as a feast to Yahweh seven days in the year. It is a statute forever throughout your generations. You shall keep it in the seventh month.

hausa: Kada ku yi farin ciki, ya Isra’ila; kada ku yi murna kamar waɗansu al’ummai. Gama kun yi rashin aminci ga Allahnku; kuna son hakkokin karuwa a kowace masussuka.
english: Don’t rejoice, Israel, to jubilation like the nations; for you were unfaithful to your God. You love the wages of a prostitute at every grain threshing floor.

hausa: Yayinda yana gab da shiga Masar, sai ya ce wa matarsa Saira, “Na sani ke kyakkyawar mace ce.
english: When he had come near to enter Egypt, he said to Sarai his wife, “See now, I know that you are a beautiful woman to look at.

hausa: Mutum mai sani yakan yi la’akari da amfani da kalmomi, mutum mai basira kuma natsattse ne.
english: He who spares his words has knowledge. He who is even tempered is a man of understanding.

hausa: “Ka ɗan ƙara haƙuri da ni kaɗan, zan kuma nuna maka cewa akwai sauran abubuwan da zan faɗa a madadin Allah.
english: “Bear with me a little, and I will show you; for I still have something to say on God’s behalf.

hausa: Ubangiji ya yi magana da Musa a Hamadar Sinai ya ce,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, saying,

hausa: “Ku gina gidaje ku zauna; ku dasa gonaki ku kuma ci abin da suka haifar.
english: “Build houses and dwell in them. Plant gardens and eat their fruit.

hausa: Heman da Yedutun su ne da hakkin busa ƙahoni da kaɗa kuge da sauran kayan bushe-bushe da na kaɗe-kaɗe, waɗanda ake amfani da su lokacin da ake rera waƙoƙi masu tsarki. ’Ya’yan Yedutun maza, su aka ba wa aikin tsaron ƙofa.
english: and with them Heman and Jeduthun with trumpets and cymbals for those that should sound aloud, and with instruments for the songs of God, and the sons of Jeduthun to be at the gate.

hausa: “Sa’ad da wani yana da cutar fatar jiki, dole a kawo shi ga firist.
english: “When the plague of leprosy is in a man, then he shall be brought to the priest;

hausa: Ubangiji, ka ba ni rabona da kwaf ɗin na; ka kiyaye rabona,
english: Yahweh assigned my portion and my cup. You made my lot secure.

hausa: “Kada ki ji tsoro; ba za ki sha kunya ba. Kada ki ji tsoron wulaƙanci, ba za a ƙasƙantar da ke ba. Za ki manta da kunyar ƙuruciyarki ba kuwa za ki tuna da zargin zaman gwauruwarki ba.
english: “Don’t be afraid, for you will not be ashamed. Don’t be confounded, for you will not be disappointed. For you will forget the shame of your youth. You will remember the reproach of your widowhood no more.

hausa: In ya auri wata mace, ba zai hana wa baiwar abinci da sutura ba, ba kuma zai ƙi kwana da ita ba.
english: If he takes another wife to himself, he shall not diminish her food, her clothing, and her marital rights.

hausa: Domin sun yi rashin biyayya ga Ubangiji, saboda haka Shishak sarkin Masar ya yaƙi Urushalima a shekara ta biyar ta Sarki Rehobowam.
english: In the fifth year of King Rehoboam, Shishak king of Egypt came up against Jerusalem, because they had trespassed against Yahweh,

hausa: “Daga can suka ci gaba ta hamada, suka zaga ƙasashen Edom da Mowab, suka wuce ta gabashin ƙasar Mowab, sa’an nan suka yi sansani a ɗaya gefen Arnon. Ba su shiga yankin Mowab ba, gama Arnon ce iyakarta.
english: Then they went through the wilderness, and went around the land of Edom, and the land of Moab, and came by the east side of the land of Moab, and they encamped on the other side of the Arnon; but they didn’t come within the border of Moab, for the Arnon was the border of Moab.

hausa: Ya ɗibi kitsen, da wutsiya mai kitse, da kuma dukan kitsen da ke kewaye da kayan ciki, da wanda ya rufe hanta, ƙodoji biyu da kitsensu da kuma cinya ta dama.
english: He took the fat, the fat tail, all the fat that was on the innards, the cover of the liver, the two kidneys and their fat, and the right thigh;

hausa: A cikin kwanakin da take shan wahala take kuma yawo Urushalima ta tuna da dukan dukiyar da take da ita a kwanakin dā can. Sa’ad da mutanenta suka faɗa cikin hannun abokan gābanta, ba wanda ya taimake ta. Maƙiyanta suka dube ta suka yi mata dariya don hallakar da ta auko mata.
english: Jerusalem remembers in the days of her affliction and of her miseries all her pleasant things that were from the days of old; when her people fell into the hand of the adversary, and no one helped her. The adversaries saw her. They mocked at her desolations.

hausa: Hadayun Yahuda da na Urushalima za su zama yardajje ga Ubangiji, za su zama kamar a kwanakin da suka wuce, kamar a shekarun baya.
english: Then the offering of Judah and Jerusalem will be pleasant to Yahweh as in the days of old and as in ancient years.

hausa: Ya kuma yi ƙanana garkuwoyi zinariya ɗari uku, da bekas ɗari uku na zinariya a kowanne. Sarki ya sa su a cikin Fadan da ake kira Kurmin Lebanon.
english: He made three hundred shields of beaten gold. Three hundred shekels of gold went to one shield. The king put them in the House of the Forest of Lebanon.

hausa: Amma bayan da almajiran suka taru kewaye da shi, sai ya tashi ya koma cikin birni. Kashegari shi da Barnabas suka tashi zuwa Derbe.
english: But as the disciples stood around him, he rose up, and entered into the city. On the next day he went out with Barnabas to Derbe.

hausa: Wannan ma yana da ma’ana wa mutane a yau. Ya nuna cewa ba za mu iya wanke lamirinmu ta wurin miƙa baye-baye da hadayu ba.
english: This is a symbol of the present age, where gifts and sacrifices are offered that are incapable, concerning the conscience, of making the worshiper perfect,

hausa: Sai Ishaya ɗan Amoz ya aika da saƙo zuwa wurin Hezekiya cewa, “Ga abin da Ubangiji, Allah na Isra’ila ya ce, na ji addu’arka game da Sennakerib sarkin Assuriya.
english: Then Isaiah the son of Amoz sent to Hezekiah, saying, “Yahweh, the God of Israel, says ‘You have prayed to me against Sennacherib king of Assyria, and I have heard you.

hausa: Sai ya ɗauki ɗan maraƙin da suka yi, ya ƙone a wuta; sa’an nan ya niƙa shi ya zama gari, ya barbaɗa garin a ruwa, ya sa Isra’ilawa suka sha.
english: He took the calf which they had made, and burned it with fire, ground it to powder, and scattered it on the water, and made the children of Israel drink it.

hausa: A kwanakin Isra’ila ba ta da sarki; kowa yana yin abin da ya ga dama.
english: In those days there was no king in Israel. Everyone did that which was right in his own eyes.

hausa: ya kuma kasance da shugabanni dubu uku da ɗari uku waɗanda suke lura da aikin, su ne kuma suke bi da ma’aikatan.
english: besides Solomon’s chief officers who were over the work: three thousand three hundred who ruled over the people who labored in the work.

hausa: Sa’an nan ya ce wa Toma, “Sa yatsarka nan; dubi hannuwana. Miƙa hannunka ka sa a gefena. Ka daina shakka ka gaskata.”
english: Then he said to Thomas, “Reach here your finger, and see my hands. Reach here your hand, and put it into my side. Don’t be unbelieving, but believing.”

hausa: Abubuwan kuwa suka kasance daidai yadda ya fassara su gare mu; aka mai da ni a matsayina, ɗaya mutumin kuwa aka rataye shi.”
english: As he interpreted to us, so it was. He restored me to my office, and he hanged him.”

hausa: Ƙaunarka ta sa ni farin ciki ƙwarai ta kuma ƙarfafa ni, domin kai, ɗan’uwa, ka wartsake zukatan tsarkaka.
english: For we have much joy and comfort in your love, because the hearts of the saints have been refreshed through you, brother.

hausa: Sa’an nan Shawulu ya yi addu’a ga Ubangiji, Allah na Isra’ila ya ce, “Me ya sa ba ka amsa mini addu’ata a yau ba? Idan wannan laifina ne, ko kuwa na ɗana, Yonatan, ka nuna mana ta wurin Urim, amma idan laifin mutanen ne ka amsa ta wurin Tummim.” Ba a sami mutane da laifi ba, amma ƙuri’a ta fāɗa a kan Yonatan da Shawulu.
english: Therefore Saul said to Yahweh, the God of Israel, “Show the right.” Jonathan and Saul were chosen, but the people escaped.

hausa: Sai shugabannin da suka shugabancin rundunar yaƙin, shugabanni na dubu-dubu da shugabanni na ɗari-ɗari, suka zo wurin Musa
english: The officers who were over the thousands of the army, the captains of thousands, and the captains of hundreds, came near to Moses.

hausa: Masar ba za tă ƙara zama abin dogara ga mutanen Isra’ila ba amma za tă zama abin tunin zunubinsu na juyawa gare ta don taimako. Sa’an nan za su san cewa ni ne Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka.’ ”
english: It will no longer be the confidence of the house of Israel, bringing iniquity to memory, when they turn to look after them. Then they will know that I am the Lord Yahweh.”’”

hausa: Amma bari gaskiya ta kwararo kamar kogi, adalci kuma kamar rafin da ba ya taɓa bushewa!
english: But let justice roll on like rivers, and righteousness like a mighty stream.

hausa: Ba zan dube ki da tausayi; ko in ƙyale ki ba. Tabbatacce zan sāka miki saboda halinki da kuma ayyukanki masu banƙyama a cikinki. Sa’an nan za ki san cewa ni ne Ubangiji.’
english: My eye will not spare you, neither will I have pity; but I will bring your ways on you, and your abominations will be among you. Then you will know that I am Yahweh.’

hausa: Da jarumin da yake tsaye a gaban Yesu ya ji muryarsa, ya kuma ga yadda ya mutu, sai ya ce, “Gaskiya, wannan mutum Ɗan Allah ne!”
english: When the centurion, who stood by opposite him, saw that he cried out like this and breathed his last, he said, “Truly this man was the Son of God!”

hausa: “Ya Ubangiji, sun karkashe annabawanka suka kuma rurrushe bagadanka; ni kaɗai na ragu, suna kuma neman raina”?
english: “Lord, they have killed your prophets. They have broken down your altars. I am left alone, and they seek my life.”

hausa: Ta ce, “Bari in ci gaba da samun tagomashi a idanunka ranka yă daɗe. Ka ta’azantar da ni ka kuma yi wa baranyarka magana mai alheri ko da yake ban kai matsayi ɗaya daga cikin bayinka ’yan mata ba.”
english: Then she said, “Let me find favor in your sight, my lord, because you have comforted me, and because you have spoken kindly to your servant, though I am not as one of your servants.”

hausa: Yesu ya amsa ya ce, “Gaskiya nake gaya muku, kuna nemana ne ba don kun ga abubuwan banmamaki ba, sai dai domin kun ci burodi kun ƙoshi.
english: Jesus answered them, “Most certainly I tell you, you seek me, not because you saw signs, but because you ate of the loaves and were filled.

hausa: Amma Sama’ila ya ce, “Yaya zan yi haka? Ai, in Shawulu ya ji labari, zai kashe ni.” Ubangiji ya ce, “To, sai ka tafi tare da ’yar karsana ka ce, ‘Na zo don in yi wa Ubangiji hadaya.’
english: Samuel said, “How can I go? If Saul hears it, he will kill me.” Yahweh said, “Take a heifer with you, and say, ‘I have come to sacrifice to Yahweh.’

hausa: “Mutumin da yake da tsarki, zai tara tokar karsanar, yă sa ta a wurin da yake da tsabta a bayan sansani. Jama’ar Isra’ilawa ne za su adana shi don amfani a ruwan tsabtaccewa; wannan domin tsarkakewa ne daga zunubi.
english: “A man who is clean shall gather up the ashes of the heifer, and lay them up outside of the camp in a clean place; and it shall be kept for the congregation of the children of Israel for use in water for cleansing impurity. It is a sin offering.

hausa: To, dukan Mowabawa suka ji cewa sarakuna suna tafe don su yaƙe su; saboda haka aka kira kowane namiji, babba da yaro, wanda ya isa ɗaukan makami, aka jera su a bakin iyaka.
english: Now when all the Moabites heard that the kings had come up to fight against them, they gathered themselves together, all who were able to put on armor, young and old, and stood on the border.

hausa: Gideyon ya ce, “Ranka yă daɗe, in Ubangiji yana tare da mu, me ya sa waɗannan abubuwa suka faru da mu? Ina dukan abubuwan al’ajabinsa waɗanda kakanninmu suka gaya mana game su sa’ad da suka ce, ‘Ashe, ba Ubangiji ne ya fitar da mu daga Masar ba?’ Amma yanzu Ubangiji ya rabu da mu ya kuma sa mu hannun Midiyawa.”
english: Gideon said to him, “Oh, my lord, if Yahweh is with us, why then has all this happened to us? Where are all his wondrous works which our fathers told us of, saying, ‘Didn’t Yahweh bring us up from Egypt?’ But now Yahweh has cast us off, and delivered us into the hand of Midian.”

hausa: Sa’an nan ya kawo ni mashigin arewa na ƙofar gidan Ubangiji, sai na ga mata zaune a can, suna makokin Tammuz.
english: Then he brought me to the door of the gate of Yahweh’s house which was toward the north; and I saw the women sit there weeping for Tammuz.

hausa: duban reni, harshe mai ƙarya, hannuwa masu zub da jinin marar laifi,
english: arrogant eyes, a lying tongue, hands that shed innocent blood,

hausa: “ ‘Sa’ad da kuka miƙa hadaya ta salama ga Ubangiji, ku miƙa ta yadda za tă karɓu a madadinku.
english: “‘When you offer a sacrifice of peace offerings to Yahweh, you shall offer it so that you may be accepted.

hausa: Kai kam, ka san kome game da koyarwata, da halina, da niyyata, bangaskiya, haƙuri, ƙauna, jimiri,
english: But you followed my teaching, conduct, purpose, faith, patience, love, steadfastness,

hausa: gama leɓunansu suna maganar tā-da-na-zaune-tsaye ne.
english: for their hearts plot violence and their lips talk about mischief.

hausa: Shi da irinsa za su sha kunya; masu sassaƙa ba kome ba mutane ne kurum. Bari su tattaru su ɗauki matsayinsu; za su firgita su kuma sha mummunan kunya.
english: Behold, all his fellows will be disappointed; and the workmen are mere men. Let them all be gathered together. Let them stand up. They will fear. They will be put to shame together.

hausa: ’Ya’yan Hebron maza su ne, Yeriya na fari, Amariya na biyu, Yahaziyel na uku da Yekameyam na huɗu.
english: The sons of Hebron: Jeriah, Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third, and Jekameam the fourth.

hausa: Suka ci har suka sami fiye da abin da ya ishe su, gama ya ba su abin da suka yi kwaɗayi.
english: So they ate, and were well filled. He gave them their own desire.

hausa: Saboda haka akwai sa zuciya domin nan gaba,” in ji Ubangiji. “’Ya’yanki za su komo ƙasarsu.
english: There is hope for your latter end,” says Yahweh. “Your children will come again to their own territory.

hausa: “Sa’an nan za ka ci gaba daga nan sai ka kai wajen babban itace na Tabor. Waɗansu mutum uku za su sadu da kai a hanyarsu zuwa wurin yin wa Allah sujada a Betel. Ɗaya yana ɗauke da ’yan awaki uku, ɗaya yana ɗauke da burodi uku, ɗayan kuma yana ɗauke da salkar ruwan inabi.
english: “Then you will go on forward from there, and you will come to the oak of Tabor. Three men will meet you there going up to God to Bethel: one carrying three young goats, and another carrying three loaves of bread, and another carrying a container of wine.

hausa: “Kai kuwa, in ka yi tafiya a gabana da mutunci a zuci da kuma gaskiya, kamar yadda Dawuda mahaifinka ya yi, ka yi dukan abin da na umarta, ka kuma yi biyayya da ƙa’idodina da kuma dokokina,
english: As for you, if you will walk before me as David your father walked, in integrity of heart and in uprightness, to do according to all that I have commanded you, and will keep my statutes and my ordinances,

hausa: Saboda haka, ku miƙa kanku ga Allah. Ku yi tsayayya da Iblis, zai kuwa guje ku.
english: Be subject therefore to God. Resist the devil, and he will flee from you.

hausa: Sai shugabannin iyalai, shugabannin kabilan Isra’ila, manyan hafsoshin mayaƙa dubu-dubu da manyan hafsoshi mayaƙa ɗari-ɗari, da shugabannin lura da ayyukan sarki suka yi bayarwa da yardar rai.
english: Then the princes of the fathers’ households, and the princes of the tribes of Israel, and the captains of thousands and of hundreds, with the rulers over the king’s work, offered willingly;

hausa: ruwaye suka rufe kaina, sai na yi tunani cewa na kusa mutuwa.
english: Waters flowed over my head. I said, “I am cut off.”

hausa: Ku sani fa, ba kalmar da Ubangiji ya faɗa game da gidan Ahab da ba za tă cika ba. Ubangiji ya yi abin da ya alkawarta ta bakin bawansa Iliya.”
english: Know now that nothing will fall to the earth of Yahweh’s word, which Yahweh spoke concerning Ahab’s house. For Yahweh has done that which he spoke by his servant Elijah.”

hausa: Sa’an nan sai maganar Ubangiji ta zo wa Yunana sau na biyu.
english: Yahweh’s word came to Jonah the second time, saying,

hausa: Ƙasusuwana suna jin jiki da wahala yayinda maƙiyana suna mini ba’a, suna ce mini dukan yini, “Ina Allahnka ɗin?”
english: As with a sword in my bones, my adversaries reproach me, while they continually ask me, “Where is your God?”

hausa: Za ka ɗibi jininsa ka zuba shi a ƙahoni huɗu na bagaden a gefen bisa da kuma kewaye da da’irar, ta haka za ka tsarkake bagaden ka kuma yi kafara dominsa.
english: You shall take of its blood and put it on its four horns, and on the four corners of the ledge, and on the border all around. You shall cleanse it and make atonement for it that way.

hausa: Yayinda yake faɗin mini haka, sai na sunkuyar da kaina ƙasa shiru, ba magana.
english: When he had spoken these words to me, I set my face toward the ground and was mute.

hausa: Amma ka riga ka faɗa, ‘Tabbatacce zan sa ka yi albarka. Zan kuma sa zuriyarka su zama kamar yashin teku da ba a iya ƙirgawa.’ ”
english: You said, ‘I will surely do you good, and make your offspring as the sand of the sea, which can’t be counted because there are so many.’”

hausa: Bawanka Yowab ne ya yi haka don yă daidaita al’amura. Ranka yă daɗe yana da hikima iri ta mala’ikan Allah, ya san dukan kome da yake faruwa a ƙasar.”
english: Your servant Joab has done this thing to change the face of the matter. My lord is wise, according to the wisdom of an angel of God, to know all things that are on the earth.”

hausa: Ya kasance kafin dukan abu, kuma a cikinsa ne dukan abubuwa suke a harhaɗe.
english: He is before all things, and in him all things are held together.

hausa: ka ce, ‘Ga abin da Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka yana cewa ina gāba da kai, ya Gog, babban sarkin Meshek da Tubal.
english: and say, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “Behold, I am against you, Gog, prince of Rosh, Meshech, and Tubal.

hausa: Annabin ya yi tambaya, “Me suka gani a fadanka?” Hezekiya ya ce, “Ba abin da yake a ma’ajina da ban nuna musu ba.”
english: He said, “What have they seen in your house?” Hezekiah answered, “They have seen all that is in my house. There is nothing among my treasures that I have not shown them.”

hausa: Gama Dawuda ya riga ya ce masa, “Alhakin jininka yana bisa kanka tun da yake da bakinka ka ce, ‘Ni ne na kashe shafaffe na Ubangiji.’ ”
english: David said to him, “Your blood be on your head, for your mouth has testified against you, saying, ‘I have slain Yahweh’s anointed.’”

hausa: Duwatsu za su kawo wadata ga mutane, tuddai kuma su ba da amfani na adalci.
english: The mountains shall bring prosperity to the people. The hills bring the fruit of righteousness.

hausa: Kafin suka shiga barci, sai ga dukan mutane, ƙanana da manya daga kowane ɓangare na birnin Sodom, suka kewaye gidan.
english: But before they lay down, the men of the city, the men of Sodom, surrounded the house, both young and old, all the people from every quarter.

hausa: ko wani daga cikin umarnan da Ubangiji ya ba ku ta wurinsa, daga ranar da Ubangiji ya ba da su, har zuwa tsararraki masu zuwa,
english: even all that Yahweh has commanded you by Moses, from the day that Yahweh gave commandment and onward throughout your generations—

hausa: Na biye suna yin haka cikin ƙauna, da sanin cewa an sa ni a nan ne domin kāriyar bishara.
english: The former insincerely preach Christ from selfish ambition, thinking that they add affliction to my chains;

hausa: da yake kuna shan faman da kuka gan na sha, kuna kuma jin cewa har yanzu ina sha.
english: having the same conflict which you saw in me and now hear is in me.

hausa: Ku yi farin ciki cikin bege, haƙuri cikin shan wuya, aminci cikin addu’a.
english: rejoicing in hope, enduring in troubles, continuing steadfastly in prayer,

hausa: Ka kuma ga an yi ƙafafun da yatsotsin da baƙin ƙarfe gauraye da yumɓu, wato, mulkin zai rabu, amma zai kasance da ƙarfi kamar na baƙin ƙarfe da yake gauraye da yumɓu.
english: Whereas you saw the feet and toes, part of potters’ clay and part of iron, it will be a divided kingdom; but there will be in it of the strength of the iron, because you saw the iron mixed with miry clay.

hausa: Amma dukan mutanen da suka san Yesu, tare da mata da suka bi shi daga Galili, suka tsaya daga nesa suna kallon abubuwan nan.
english: All his acquaintances and the women who followed with him from Galilee stood at a distance, watching these things.

hausa: Cikin wahayin, Allah ya kai ni ƙasar Isra’ila ya sa ni a kan wani dutse mai tsayi ƙwarai, inda a gefen kudunsa akwai gine-ginen da suka yi kamar birni.
english: In the visions of God he brought me into the land of Israel, and set me down on a very high mountain, on which was something like the frame of a city to the south.

hausa: “Ɗan mutum, gidan ’yan tawayen nan na Isra’ila ba su tambaye ka, ‘Me kake yi ba?’
english: “Son of man, hasn’t the house of Israel, the rebellious house, said to you, ‘What are you doing?’

hausa: Sai ta ce, “To, bari sarki yă rantse da Ubangiji Allahnsa don yă hana mai ramako yin ƙarin hallakawar da aka yi, domin kada a hallaka ɗana.” Sai ya ce, “Muddin Ubangiji yana a raye, babu gashi guda na ɗanki da zai fāɗi ƙasa.”
english: Then she said, “Please let the king remember Yahweh your God, that the avenger of blood destroy not any more, lest they destroy my son.” He said, “As Yahweh lives, not one hair of your son shall fall to the earth.”

hausa: to, zan bar ku ku zauna a wannan wuri, a ƙasar da na ba kakanninku har abada abadin.
english: then I will cause you to dwell in this place, in the land that I gave to your fathers, from of old even forever more.

hausa: Bari mu yabi girmanka da sunanka mai banrazana, shi mai tsarki ne.
english: Let them praise your great and awesome name. He is Holy!

hausa: Yerobowam ya naɗa firistocinsa domin masujadan kan tudu da kuma domin gumakan nan na akuya da maraƙin da ya yi.
english: He himself appointed priests for the high places, for the male goat and calf idols which he had made.

hausa: kuma kowace hadaya ta gari wadda aka kwaɓa da mai, ko wadda ba a kwaɓa ba, ita ma, ta dukan ’ya’ya Haruna ne maza.
english: Every meal offering, mixed with oil or dry, belongs to all the sons of Aaron, one as well as another.

hausa: Bela ɗan Beyor ya zama sarkin Edom. Sunan birninsa shi ne Dinhaba.
english: Bela, the son of Beor, reigned in Edom. The name of his city was Dinhabah.

hausa: Sa’an nan mutanen ƙasar suka kashe dukan waɗanda suka yi wa Sarki Amon maƙarƙashiya, suka naɗa Yosiya ɗansa sarki a maimakonsa.
english: But the people of the land killed all those who had conspired against King Amon; and the people of the land made Josiah his son king in his place.

hausa: Saboda haka, ku rabu da kowace ƙeta da dukan ruɗu, munafunci, kishi, da kuma kowace irin ɓata suna.
english: Putting away therefore all wickedness, all deceit, hypocrisies, envies, and all evil speaking,

hausa: Ku yi addu’a, kada wannan yă faru a lokacin sanyi.
english: Pray that your flight won’t be in the winter.

hausa: Gama kafin a ba da doka, zunubi yana nan a duniya. Amma ba a lissafin zunubi inda babu doka.
english: For until the law, sin was in the world; but sin is not charged when there is no law.

hausa: ya ce, ‘Kada ka ji tsoro, Bulus. Lalle za ka tsaya a gaban Kaisar a yi maka shari’a; Allah kuma cikin alherinsa ya ba ka dukan rayukan mutanen da suke tafiya tare da kai.’
english: saying, ‘Don’t be afraid, Paul. You must stand before Caesar. Behold, God has granted you all those who sail with you.’

hausa: Ka tsawata wa ƙasashe ka kuma hallakar da mugaye; ka shafe sunansu har abada abadin.
english: You have rebuked the nations. You have destroyed the wicked. You have blotted out their name forever and ever.

hausa: Biyar daga cikinsu wawaye ne, biyar kuma masu hikima.
english: Five of them were foolish, and five were wise.

hausa: ’Yan zuriyar Delahiya, Tobiya, da Nekoda 652.
english: the children of Delaiah, the children of Tobiah, the children of Nekoda, six hundred fifty-two.

hausa: Amma bai gayyace ni bawanka, da Zadok firist, da Benahiya ɗan Yehohiyada, da kuma bawanka Solomon ba.
english: But he hasn’t called me, even me your servant, Zadok the priest, Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and your servant Solomon.

hausa: Amma daƙiƙin mutum ba ya taɓa zama mai hikima kamar dai a ce ba a taɓa haihuwar ɗan aholaki horarre.
english: An empty-headed man becomes wise when a man is born as a wild donkey’s colt.

hausa: Lalle Ibrahim zai zama al’umma mai girma da kuma mai iko, kuma ta wurinsa dukan al’umman duniya za su sami albarka.
english: since Abraham will surely become a great and mighty nation, and all the nations of the earth will be blessed in him?

hausa: “Ku je ƙauyen da yake gaba da ku. Da kuna shiga, za ku tarar da wani ɗan jaki, wadda ba wanda ya taɓa hawa, a daure a wurin. Ku kunce shi ku kawo nan.
english: saying, “Go your way into the village on the other side, in which, as you enter, you will find a colt tied, which no man has ever sat upon. Untie it and bring it.

hausa: amma bai yi farin ciki da sadakar da Kayinu ya kawo ba. Saboda haka Kayinu ya ji fushi sosai, fuskarsa kuma ta ɓace.
english: but he didn’t respect Cain and his offering. Cain was very angry, and the expression on his face fell.

hausa: “Masu albarka ne waɗanda suka wanke tufafinsu, don su sami izinin ci daga itacen rai su kuma shiga birnin ta ƙofofi.
english: Blessed are those who do his commandments, that they may have the right to the tree of life, and may enter in by the gates into the city.

hausa: Haka ma wani daga kabilar Lawi, mai hidima cikin haikali, da ya zo wurin, ya gan shi, sai shi ma ya bi gefe ɗaya, ya wuce abinsa.
english: In the same way a Levite also, when he came to the place and saw him, passed by on the other side.

hausa: kayayyakin zinariya, azurfa, duwatsu masu daraja da lu’ulu’ai; lallausan lilin, tufa masu ruwan shunayya, siliki da jan tufa; da kowane irin katakai masu ƙanshi da kayayyaki na kowane iri da aka yi da hauren giwa, katakai masu tsada, tagulla, baƙin ƙarfe da dutse mai sheƙi;
english: merchandise of gold, silver, precious stones, pearls, fine linen, purple, silk, scarlet, all expensive wood, every vessel of ivory, every vessel made of most precious wood, and of brass, and iron, and marble;

hausa: amma na ƙi Isuwa, na kuma mai da ƙasarsa da take kan duwatsu kango, na ba da gādonsa ga dilolin hamada.”
english: but Esau I hated, and made his mountains a desolation, and gave his heritage to the jackals of the wilderness.”

hausa: Da Zimri ya ga cewa an kame birnin, sai ya je ya shiga hasumiya fadan sarki ya sa wa fadan wuta wutar kuwa ta ƙone shi ya mutu.
english: When Zimri saw that the city was taken, he went into the fortified part of the king’s house and burned the king’s house over him with fire, and died,

hausa: Cikin yunwansu ka ba su burodi daga sama, cikin ƙishirwansu kuma ka fitar musu ruwa daga dutse. Ka faɗa musu su shiga su mallaki ƙasar da ka rantse ta wurin ɗaga hannu cewa za ka ba su.
english: and gave them bread from the sky for their hunger, and brought water out of the rock for them for their thirst, and commanded them that they should go in to possess the land which you had sworn to give them.

hausa: Da wayewar gari, sai dukan manyan firistoci da dattawan mutane suka yanke shawara su kashe Yesu.
english: Now when morning had come, all the chief priests and the elders of the people took counsel against Jesus to put him to death.

hausa: Kowane da namiji cikin iyalin firistoci zai iya ci. Sai a tsattsarkan wuri ne za a ci; gama abu mafi tsarki ne.
english: Every male among the priests may eat of it. It shall be eaten in a holy place. It is most holy.

hausa: Saboda haka zan tura ku zaman bauta gaba da Damaskus,” in ji Ubangiji, wanda sunansa ne Allah Mai Iko.
english: Therefore I will cause you to go into captivity beyond Damascus,” says Yahweh, whose name is the God of Armies.

hausa: Amma sarkin nan ya yi tawaye a kan sarkin Babilon ta wurin aika jakadunsa zuwa Masar don a ba shi dawakai da sojoji masu yawa. Zai ci nasara? Shi da ya yi wannan abu zai tsira? Zai iya taka yarjejjeniya har ya tsere?
english: But he rebelled against him in sending his ambassadors into Egypt, that they might give him horses and many people. Will he prosper? Will he who does such things escape? Will he break the covenant, and still escape?

hausa: Ku ɓace yanzu daga nan, ku koma wurin aikinku. Ba za a ba ku tattaka ba, kuma dole ku fid da tubula kamar yadda kuka saba.”
english: Go therefore now, and work; for no straw shall be given to you; yet you shall deliver the same number of bricks!”

hausa: A watan fari, dukan jama’ar Isra’ilawa suka iso Hamadan Zin. Suka sauka a Kadesh. A nan ne Miriyam ta mutu, aka kuma bizne ta.
english: The children of Israel, even the whole congregation, came into the wilderness of Zin in the first month. The people stayed in Kadesh. Miriam died there, and was buried there.

hausa: Daga zuriyar Fahat-Mowab, akwai Adna, Kelal, Benahiya, Ma’asehiya, Mattaniya, Bezalel, Binnuyi, da Manasse.
english: Of the sons of Pahathmoab: Adna, Chelal, Benaiah, Maaseiah, Mattaniah, Bezalel, Binnui, and Manasseh.

hausa: Dattawanmu da duk mazaunan ƙasar, suka ce mana, ‘Ku ɗauki abincin tafiyar da za ku riƙe; ku je ku same su ku ce musu, “Mu bayinku ne, ku yi alkawari da mu.” ’
english: Our elders and all the inhabitants of our country spoke to us, saying, ‘Take supplies in your hand for the journey, and go to meet them. Tell them, “We are your servants. Now make a covenant with us.”’

hausa: Ana nan, sai Dawuda ya ci Filistiyawa da yaƙi, ya kawo ƙarshen mulkinsu a ƙasar, ya kuma ƙwace ƙasar Meteg Amma daga hannun Filistiyawa.
english: After this, David struck the Philistines and subdued them; and David took the bridle of the mother city out of the hand of the Philistines.

hausa: Kada ka bar rigyawa yă sha kaina ko zurfafa su haɗiye ni ko rami yă rufe bakinsa a kaina.
english: Don’t let the flood waters overwhelm me, neither let the deep swallow me up. Don’t let the pit shut its mouth on me.

hausa: Rebeka ma ta ɗaga ido sai ta ga Ishaku. Ta sauka daga raƙuminta da sauri,
english: Rebekah lifted up her eyes, and when she saw Isaac, she got off the camel.

hausa: Iblis ya ce masa, “In kai Ɗan Allah ne, ka faɗa wa wannan dutse yă zama burodi.”
english: The devil said to him, “If you are the Son of God, command this stone to become bread.”

hausa: Sa’ad da ya ga yadda wurin hutunsa yana da kyau da kuma daɗin da ƙasarsa take, zan tanƙware kafaɗarsa ga nauyi yă miƙa kai ga aikin dole.
english: He saw a resting place, that it was good, the land, that it was pleasant. He bows his shoulder to the burden, and becomes a servant doing forced labor.

hausa: Gaba ɗaya dai, Metusela ya yi shekaru 969, sa’an nan ya mutu.
english: All the days of Methuselah were nine hundred sixty-nine years, then he died.

hausa: wannan ƙa’ida ce domin Isra’ila, farilla ta Allah na Yaƙub.
english: For it is a statute for Israel, an ordinance of the God of Jacob.

hausa: Saboda haka, zan hallaka ku in lalace ku saboda zunubanku.
english: Therefore I also have struck you with a grievous wound. I have made you desolate because of your sins.

hausa: Duk mai kunnen ji, yă ji abin da Ruhu yake faɗa wa ikkilisiyoyi.
english: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the assemblies.

hausa: Ku kanku duba mana. Ya yi kyau mace tă yi addu’a ga Allah da kanta a buɗe?
english: Judge for yourselves. Is it appropriate that a woman pray to God unveiled?

hausa: Ya kamata sarki yă sani cewa mun je yankin Yahuda, zuwa gidan Allah mai girma. Muka ga mutanen suna ginin haikalin da manyan duwatsu, suna sa katakai a bangon. Ana aikin da ƙwazo, aikin kuma yana cin gaba sosai, suna kuma lura da shi.
english: Be it known to the king that we went into the province of Judah, to the house of the great God, which is being built with great stones and timber is laid in the walls. This work goes on with diligence and prospers in their hands.

hausa: Duk wanda yake kirki ga matalauta yana ba wa Ubangiji bashi ne, zai kuwa sami lada game da abin da ya yi.
english: He who has pity on the poor lends to Yahweh; he will reward him.

hausa: Amma kada fa ku ci jinin, ku zubar da shi a ƙasa kamar ruwa.
english: Only you shall not eat its blood. You shall pour it out on the ground like water.

hausa: “Ku tafi Betel ku yi ta aikata zunubi; ku je Gilgal ku ƙara yin zunubi. Ku kawo hadayunku kowace safiya, zakkarku kowace shekara uku.
english: “Go to Bethel, and sin; to Gilgal, and sin more. Bring your sacrifices every morning, your tithes every three days,

hausa: Sai Iblis, ya kai shi Urushalima ya sa ya tsaya a kan wuri mafi tsayi na haikali ya ce, “In kai Ɗan Allah ne, ka yi tsalle daga nan zuwa ƙasa.
english: He led him to Jerusalem and set him on the pinnacle of the temple, and said to him, “If you are the Son of God, cast yourself down from here,

hausa: Shi ne Ubangiji Allahnmu; kuma hukunce-hukuncensa suna a cikin dukan duniya.
english: He is Yahweh, our God. His judgments are in all the earth.

hausa: Zan rusuna ta wajen haikalinka mai tsarki zan kuma yabi sunanka saboda ƙaunarka da amincinka, saboda ka ɗaukaka a bisa kome sunanka da kuma maganarka.
english: I will bow down toward your holy temple, and give thanks to your Name for your loving kindness and for your truth; for you have exalted your Name and your Word above all.

hausa: ya miƙa ta a bagade, tare da hadaya ta gari, ya kuma yi kafara dominsa, zai kuwa tsabtacce.
english: then the priest shall offer the burnt offering and the meal offering on the altar. The priest shall make atonement for him, and he shall be clean.

hausa: Ka tuna da bayinka Ibrahim, Ishaku da Isra’ila, waɗanda ka rantse da kanka cewa, ‘Zan mai da zuriyarka kamar taurarin sama kuma zan ba wa zuriyarka wannan ƙasa wadda na yi musu alkawari, za tă kuma zama abin gādonsu har abada.’ ”
english: Remember Abraham, Isaac, and Israel, your servants, to whom you swore by your own self, and said to them, ‘I will multiply your offspring as the stars of the sky, and all this land that I have spoken of I will give to your offspring, and they shall inherit it forever.’”

hausa: Ina tare da kai, zan lura da kai duk inda ka tafi, zan kuma dawo da kai zuwa wannan ƙasa. Ba zan rabu da kai ba sai na cika abin da na yi maka alkawari.”
english: Behold, I am with you, and will keep you, wherever you go, and will bring you again into this land. For I will not leave you until I have done that which I have spoken of to you.”

hausa: Ba zai zama kamar alkawarin da na yi da kakanni kakanninsu ba sa’ad da na kama su da hannu na bishe su daga Masar, domin sun take alkawarina, ko da yake na zama miji a gare su,” in ji Ubangiji.
english: not according to the covenant that I made with their fathers in the day that I took them by the hand to bring them out of the land of Egypt, which covenant of mine they broke, although I was a husband to them,” says Yahweh.

hausa: Suka fito da dukan rundunansu da keken yaƙi masu yawan gaske, babbar runduna, yawansu ya yi kamar yashin bakin teku.
english: They went out, they and all their armies with them, many people, even as the sand that is on the seashore in multitude, with very many horses and chariots.

hausa: Yana yiwuwa saurayin yă fito daga kurkuku yă hau gadon sarauta, ko kuma dai an haife shi cikin talauci a ƙasarsa.
english: For out of prison he came out to be king; yes, even in his kingdom he was born poor.

hausa: Daga zuriyar Immer, akwai Hanani da Zebadiya.
english: Of the sons of Immer: Hanani and Zebadiah.

hausa: Kuringar inabin ta bushe itacen ɓaure kuma ya yi yaushi, ’ya’yan rumman, itacen dabino da itacen gawasa, dukan itatuwan filaye, sun bushe. Tabbatacce farin cikin ’yan adam ya bushe.
english: The vine has dried up, and the fig tree withered— the pomegranate tree, the palm tree also, and the apple tree, even all of the trees of the field are withered; for joy has withered away from the sons of men.

hausa: Zan kuma ci gaba da yin abin da nake yi, domin in toshe kafar mutanen nan da suke fariya, suna nema mu daidaita da su.
english: But what I do, that I will continue to do, that I may cut off opportunity from those who desire an opportunity, that in which they boast, they may be recognized just like us.

hausa: Sa’ad da kakanninmu suke a Masar, ba su damu da mu’ujizanka ba; ba su tuna yawan alheranka ba, suka kuma yi tayarwa a teku, Jan Teku.
english: Our fathers didn’t understand your wonders in Egypt. They didn’t remember the multitude of your loving kindnesses, but were rebellious at the sea, even at the Red Sea.

hausa: Yaƙub ya samo ɗanyen reshen itatuwan aduruku, da na katambiri, da na durumi, ya ɓare ya bar fararen cikin katakon rassan.
english: Jacob took to himself rods of fresh poplar, almond, and plane tree, peeled white streaks in them, and made the white appear which was in the rods.

hausa: In Timoti ya zo, ku tabbata ya sami sakewa a cikinku, domin aikin Ubangiji yake yi kamar yadda nake yi.
english: Now if Timothy comes, see that he is with you without fear, for he does the work of the Lord, as I also do.

hausa: “Na gaji da rayuwa; saboda haka bari in faɗi zuciyata gabagadi yadda raina yake jin ba daɗi.
english: “My soul is weary of my life. I will give free course to my complaint. I will speak in the bitterness of my soul.

hausa: ‘Ban aike su ba,’ in ji Ubangiji. ‘Suna annabcin ƙarya ne da sunana. Saboda haka, zan kore ku za ku kuwa hallaka, da ku da kuma annabawan da suke muku annabci.’ ”
english: For I have not sent them,” says Yahweh, “but they prophesy falsely in my name; that I may drive you out, and that you may perish, you, and the prophets who prophesy to you.”

hausa: Ina roƙonka saboda ɗana Onesimus, wanda ya zama ɗana yayinda nake cikin sarƙoƙi.
english: I appeal to you for my child Onesimus, whom I have become the father of in my chains,

hausa: ko kuwa a kamannin wata halittar da take rarrafe a ƙasa, ko na wani kifi a cikin ruwaye a ƙarƙashi.
english: the likeness of anything that creeps on the ground, the likeness of any fish that is in the water under the earth;

hausa: Duk da haka ina riƙe da wannan game da kai. Ka watsar da ƙaunarka ta farko.
english: But I have this against you, that you left your first love.

hausa: Zuciyata tana tare da ’ya’yan sarakunan Isra’ila, tare da masu niyyar ba da kansu da yardan rai cikin mutane. Yabo ya tabbata ga Ubangiji!
english: My heart is toward the governors of Israel, who offered themselves willingly among the people. Bless Yahweh!

hausa: zan albarkace ta da tanade-tanade masu yawa; matalautanta za su ƙoshi da abinci.
english: I will abundantly bless her provision. I will satisfy her poor with bread.

hausa: Mutumin yakan gudu don shi ɗan haya ne kawai, bai kuwa damu da tumakin ba.
english: The hired hand flees because he is a hired hand and doesn’t care for the sheep.

hausa: Yonatan, kawun Dawuda, shi ne mashawarci, mutum mai hangen nesa kuma marubuci. Yehiyel ɗan Hakmoni ne ya lura da ’ya’yan sarki maza.
english: Also Jonathan, David’s uncle, was a counselor, a man of understanding, and a scribe. Jehiel the son of Hachmoni was with the king’s sons.

hausa: saboda haka sai na saye filin a Anatot daga hannun Hananel yaron ɗan’uwan mahaifina na kuma auna masa shekel goma sha bakwai na azurfa.
english: I bought the field that was in Anathoth of Hanamel my uncle’s son, and weighed him the money, even seventeen shekels of silver.

hausa: Suka ɗauki akwatin alkawarin Allah daga gidan Abinadab a kan sabon keken shanu, Uzza da Ahiyo ne suke lura da shi.
english: They carried God’s ark on a new cart, and brought it out of Abinadab’s house; and Uzza and Ahio drove the cart.

hausa: Zunubi ne yake ba wa mutuwa dafi, Doka kuma take ba wa zunubi iko.
english: The sting of death is sin, and the power of sin is the law.

hausa: Daga cikin firistoci kuma, zuriyar Hobahiya, Hakkoz da Barzillai (wanda ya auri diyar Barzillai mutumin Gileyad da ake kuma kira da wannan suna).
english: Of the children of the priests: the children of Habaiah, the children of Hakkoz, and the children of Barzillai, who took a wife of the daughters of Barzillai the Gileadite, and was called after their name.

hausa: Bayan wata goma sha biyu, a sa’ad da sarki yake takawa a bisan saman ɗakin fadar Babilon,
english: At the end of twelve months he was walking in the royal palace of Babylon.

hausa: Sai sarki ya kira dukan dattawan Yahuda da Urushalima.
english: Then the king sent and gathered together all the elders of Judah and Jerusalem.

hausa: Manyan ’ya’yansa maza uku, sun bi Shawulu wajen yaƙi. Ɗansa na fari shi ne Eliyab, na biyu shi ne Abinadab, na uku kuwa shi ne Shamma.
english: The three oldest sons of Jesse had gone after Saul to the battle; and the names of his three sons who went to the battle were Eliab the firstborn, and next to him Abinadab, and the third Shammah.

hausa: Saboda haka zan tafi wurin shugabanni in yi musu magana; tabbatacce sun san hanyar Ubangiji, da abubuwan da Allahnsu yake bukata.” Amma da nufi guda su ma suka karye karkiyar suka tsintsinke sarƙoƙin.
english: I will go to the great men and will speak to them, for they know the way of Yahweh, and the law of their God.” But these with one accord have broken the yoke, and burst the bonds.

hausa: Sa’an nan ki je wurin sarki, ki ce masa haka.” Sai Yowab ya faɗa mata duk abin da za tă faɗa.
english: Go in to the king and speak like this to him.” So Joab put the words in her mouth.

hausa: A cikinmu an yi ’yan’uwa guda bakwai. Na fari ya yi aure, ya mutu, da yake bai sami ’ya’ya ba, sai ya bar matarsa wa ɗan’uwansa.
english: Now there were with us seven brothers. The first married and died, and having no offspring left his wife to his brother.

hausa: In kuwa na tafi na shirya muku wuri, sai in dawo in ɗauke ku ku kasance tare da ni don ku kasance inda nake.
english: If I go and prepare a place for you, I will come again and will receive you to myself; that where I am, you may be there also.

hausa: Kwaf Fir’auna kuwa yana a hannuna, na kuma ɗiba inabin na matse su cikin kwaf Fir’auna, na kuma sa kwaf ɗin a hannunsa.”
english: Pharaoh’s cup was in my hand; and I took the grapes, and pressed them into Pharaoh’s cup, and I gave the cup into Pharaoh’s hand.”

hausa: Ta ce masa, “Ranka yă daɗe, kai kanka ka rantse mini ni baiwarka da sunan Ubangiji Allahnka cewa, ‘Solomon ɗanka zai zama sarki bayana, zai kuma zauna a kujerar sarautata.’
english: She said to him, “My lord, you swore by Yahweh your God to your servant, ‘Assuredly Solomon your son shall reign after me, and he shall sit on my throne.’

hausa: Amma yanzu an bayyana wani adalci daga Allah, wannan adalcin bai danganta ga doka ba, Doka da Annabawa suna ba da shaida game da wannan adalci.
english: But now apart from the law, a righteousness of God has been revealed, being testified by the law and the prophets;

hausa: bari kuma ka rayu ka ga ’ya’ya ’ya’yanka. Salama tă kasance tare da Isra’ila.
english: Yes, may you see your children’s children. Peace be upon Israel.

hausa: ƙayayyuwa sun yi girma ko’ina, ciyayi sun rufe ƙasar, katangar duwatsu duk ta rushe.
english: Behold, it was all grown over with thorns. Its surface was covered with nettles, and its stone wall was broken down.

hausa: Masu yin gaskiya suka gani suka yi farin ciki amma dukan mugaye suka rufe bakunansu.
english: The upright will see it, and be glad. All the wicked will shut their mouths.

hausa: Sane da wannan, Yesu ya ce musu, “Me ya sa kuke damun macen nan? Ta yi mini abu mai kyau ne.
english: However, knowing this, Jesus said to them, “Why do you trouble the woman? She has done a good work for me.

hausa: Aka kuma ba wa sauran Kohatawa, iyalan Lawiyawa, garuruwa daga kabilar Efraim.
english: The families of the children of Kohath, the Levites, even the rest of the children of Kohath, had the cities of their lot out of the tribe of Ephraim.

hausa: Zan dasa Isra’ila a ƙasarsu, ba kuwa za a ƙara tumɓuke su daga ƙasar da na ba su ba,” in ji Ubangiji Allahnku.
english: I will plant them on their land, and they will no more be plucked up out of their land which I have given them,” says Yahweh your God.

hausa: Idanuna sun rasa ƙarfi da baƙin ciki; sun rasa ƙarfi saboda dukan abokan gābana.
english: My eye wastes away because of grief. It grows old because of all my adversaries.

hausa: “Ɗan mutum, ka fuskanci Dutsen Seyir; ka yi annabci a kansa
english: “Son of man, set your face against Mount Seir, and prophesy against it,

hausa: Yana kamar raɓar Hermon da take zubowa a kan Dutsen Sihiyona. Gama a can Ubangiji ya tabbatar da albarkarsa, har ma rai na har abada.
english: like the dew of Hermon, that comes down on the hills of Zion; for there Yahweh gives the blessing, even life forever more.

hausa: kuma cewa duk wanda bai rusuna ya yi sujadar ba za a jefa shi cikin tanderun wuta.
english: and whoever doesn’t fall down and worship shall be cast into the middle of a burning fiery furnace.

hausa: Zan sāke gina ki za ki kuwa sāke ginuwa, ya Budurwar Isra’ila. Za ki kuma ɗauki ganganki ki fita don ki yi rawa da masu farin ciki.
english: I will build you again, and you will be built, O virgin of Israel. You will again be adorned with your tambourines, and will go out in the dances of those who make merry.

hausa: Yesu ya amsa ya ce, “A rubuce yake, ‘Ka yi wa Ubangiji Allahnka sujada, kuma shi kaɗai za ka bauta wa.’”
english: Jesus answered him, “Get behind me, Satan! For it is written, ‘You shall worship the Lord your God, and you shall serve him only.’”

hausa: ’Ya’yan sarki mata suna cikin matan da ake girmama; a hannun damarka kuwa ga amarya, sarauniya saye da ofir zinariya.
english: Kings’ daughters are among your honorable women. At your right hand the queen stands in gold of Ophir.

hausa: Na takwas, don wata na takwas, shi ne Sibbekai mutumin Husha, mutumin Zera. Akwai mutane 24,000 a sashensa.
english: The eighth captain for the eighth month was Sibbecai the Hushathite, of the Zerahites. In his division were twenty-four thousand.

hausa: Dukan waɗanda suke tare da ni suna gaishe ka. Ka gaggai mini da masoyanmu, masu bangaskiya. Alheri yă kasance tare da ku duka.
english: All who are with me greet you. Greet those who love us in faith. Grace be with you all. Amen.

hausa: Ba waɗanda suke ƙulla mugunta sukan kauce ba? Amma waɗanda suke ƙulla abin da yake mai kyau sukan sami ƙauna da aminci.
english: Don’t they go astray who plot evil? But love and faithfulness belong to those who plan good.

hausa: Sau ɗaya kuma ragowar masarautar Yahuda za tă yi saiwoyi a ƙasa ta kuma ba da ’ya’ya a bisa.
english: The remnant that has escaped of the house of Judah will again take root downward, and bear fruit upward.

hausa: Kaurin kwanon ya kai tafin hannu, kuma da’iransa ya yi kamar da’iran kwaf, kamar bi-ranar da ta buɗe. Wannan kwanon da aka kira Teku yakan ci garwa dubu biyu.
english: It was a hand width thick. Its brim was worked like the brim of a cup, like the flower of a lily. It held two thousand baths.

hausa: Da jin wannan, waɗansu malaman dokoki suka ce wa juna, “Wannan mutum yana yin saɓo!”
english: Behold, some of the scribes said to themselves, “This man blasphemes.”

hausa: Gama Allah bai kira mu ga zaman marasa tsarki ba, sai dai ga zaman tsarki.
english: For God called us not for uncleanness, but in sanctification.

hausa: Zan kawo al’ummai mafi mugunta su mallaki gidajenku; zan kawo ƙarshen fariyar masu ƙarfi, Wurare Masu Tsarkinsu za su ƙazantu.
english: Therefore I will bring the worst of the nations, and they will possess their houses. I will also make the pride of the strong to cease. Their holy places will be profaned.

hausa: A rana ta bakwai, suka tashi da sassafe suka zaga birnin sau bakwai yadda suka saba. A wannan rana kaɗai ne suka zaga birnin sau bakwai.
english: On the seventh day, they rose early at the dawning of the day, and marched around the city in the same way seven times. On this day only they marched around the city seven times.

hausa: Suka zo wurinsa suka ce, “Malam, mun san kai mutum ne mai mutunci. Ba ka bin ra’ayin mutane, don ba ka nuna bambanci. Amma kana koyar da hanyar Allah bisa ga gaskiya. Daidai ne a biya wa Kaisar haraji, ko babu?
english: When they had come, they asked him, “Teacher, we know that you are honest, and don’t defer to anyone; for you aren’t partial to anyone, but truly teach the way of God. Is it lawful to pay taxes to Caesar, or not?

hausa: Har wa yau ina gaya muku, zai fi sauƙi raƙumi yă shiga ta kafar allura, da mai arziki yă shiga mulkin Allah.”
english: Again I tell you, it is easier for a camel to go through a needle’s eye than for a rich man to enter into God’s Kingdom.”

hausa: Abubuwan da Allah ya yi magana a kai game da Babilon da Ishaya ɗan Amoz ya gani.
english: The burden of Babylon, which Isaiah the son of Amoz saw.

hausa: in maganarka ta taɓa kama ka, ko kalmomin bakinka sun zama maka tarko,
english: you are trapped by the words of your mouth; you are ensnared with the words of your mouth.

hausa: Gama Allah bai ba mu ruhun tsoro ba, sai dai ruhun iko, na ƙauna da kuma na kamunkai.
english: For God didn’t give us a spirit of fear, but of power, love, and self-control.

hausa: Sai ƙarfen da yambun da tagulla da azurfan da kuma zinariyan suka ragargaje a lokaci ɗaya ya zama kamar ƙaiƙayi a masussuka a lokacin kaka. Sai iska ta kwashe su ta tafi, har ba a iya ganin ko alamarsu. Amma dutsen da ya fāɗo a siffar ya girke ya zama tsauni ya kuma cika dukan duniya.
english: Then the iron, the clay, the bronze, the silver, and the gold were broken in pieces together, and became like the chaff of the summer threshing floors. The wind carried them away, so that no place was found for them. The stone that struck the image became a great mountain and filled the whole earth.

hausa: Sai Sarki Zedekiya ya aika a kawo Irmiya annabi, ya sa aka kawo shi a ƙofa ta uku ta haikalin Ubangiji. Sai sarki ya ce wa Irmiya, “Zan tambaye ka wani abu, kada ka ɓoye mini wani abu.”
english: Then Zedekiah the king sent and took Jeremiah the prophet to himself into the third entry that is in Yahweh’s house. Then the king said to Jeremiah, “I will ask you something. Hide nothing from me.”

hausa: In mutum ya toshe kunnuwansa ga kukan matalauci, shi ma zai yi kukan neman taimako ba kuwa zai sami amsa ba.
english: Whoever stops his ears at the cry of the poor, he will also cry out, but shall not be heard.

hausa: Sai ya wanke kayan ciki da ƙafafun, ya kuwa ƙone su tare da hadaya ta ƙonawa a kan bagade.
english: He washed the innards and the legs, and burned them on the burnt offering on the altar.

hausa: Ruhunta ya dawo, kuma ta tashi, nan take. Yesu ya ce musu, su ba ta wani abu tă ci.
english: Her spirit returned, and she rose up immediately. He commanded that something be given to her to eat.

hausa: Sai Musa ya karanta kalmomin waƙar daga farko zuwa ƙarshe a kunnuwan dukan taron jama’ar Isra’ila.
english: Moses spoke in the ears of all the assembly of Israel the words of this song, until they were finished.

hausa: Gama ba da mutane da suke nama da jini ne muke yaƙi ba. Muna yaƙi ne da ikoki, da hukumomi, da masu mulkin duhu, da kuma a ikokin da suke cikin a sararin sama.
english: For our wrestling is not against flesh and blood, but against the principalities, against the powers, against the world’s rulers of the darkness of this age, and against the spiritual forces of wickedness in the heavenly places.

hausa: Ƙasusuwana ba a ɓoye suke a gare ka ba sa’ad da aka yi ni asirce. Sa’ad da saƙa ni gaba ɗaya a zurfafan duniya.
english: My frame wasn’t hidden from you, when I was made in secret, woven together in the depths of the earth.

hausa: Sa’ad da rayayyun halittun suke tafiya, da’irorin da suke kusa da su kan motsa; kuma sa’ad da rayayyun halittun sun tashi sama, da’irorin su ma sukan tashi sama.
english: When the living creatures went, the wheels went beside them. When the living creatures were lifted up from the earth, the wheels were lifted up.

hausa: Cinyar da aka miƙa da kuma ƙirjin da aka kaɗa, dole a kawo su tare da ɓangarori kitsen hadayun da aka yi ta wuri wuta, don a kaɗa a gaban Ubangiji a matsayin hadaya ta kaɗawa. Wannan zai zama na kullayaumi gare ka da ’ya’yanka, yadda Ubangiji ya umarta.”
english: They shall bring the heaved thigh and the waved breast with the offerings made by fire of the fat, to wave it for a wave offering before Yahweh. It shall be yours, and your sons’ with you, as a portion forever, as Yahweh has commanded.”

hausa: Saniya ta san maigidanta, jaki ya san wurin sa wa dabbobi abinci maigidansa, amma Isra’ila ba su sani, mutanena ba su gane ba.”
english: The ox knows his owner, and the donkey his master’s crib; but Israel doesn’t know. My people don’t consider.”

hausa: Sa’an nan zan zauna a cikin Isra’ilawa, in kuma zama Allahnsu.
english: I will dwell among the children of Israel, and will be their God.

hausa: Ku dube ni, ku kuma yi mamaki; ku rufe bakina da hannunku.
english: Look at me, and be astonished. Lay your hand on your mouth.

hausa: Ya kuma tanada gumaguman al’ul masu yawa fiye da ƙirge, gama Sidoniyawa da mutanen Taya sun kawo su wa Dawuda da yawa.
english: and cedar trees without number, for the Sidonians and the people of Tyre brought cedar trees in abundance to David.

hausa: Ya zuba man keɓewa a kan Haruna, ya kuma keɓe shi don yă tsarkake shi.
english: He poured some of the anointing oil on Aaron’s head, and anointed him, to sanctify him.

hausa: Iyakarsu ta kama daga Helef, daga babban itacen Mamre nan da yake a Za’anannim, ta wuce Adami Nekeb da Yabneyel zuwa Lakkum, ta kuma ƙarasa a Urdun.
english: Their border was from Heleph, from the oak in Zaanannim, Adami-nekeb, and Jabneel, to Lakkum. It ended at the Jordan.

hausa: Zan sa mutanena Isra’ila su yi tafiya a kanku. Za su mallake ku, za ku kuma zama gādonsu; ba za ku ƙara sa su rasa ’ya’yansu ba.
english: Yes, I will cause men to walk on you, even my people Israel. They will possess you, and you will be their inheritance, and you will never again bereave them of their children.”

hausa: sarakunan duniya da dukan al’ummai, ku sarakuna da dukan masu mulkin duniya,
english: kings of the earth and all peoples, princes and all judges of the earth,

hausa: ya kuma shirya fitilun a gaban Ubangiji, yadda Ubangiji ya umarce shi.
english: He lit the lamps before Yahweh, as Yahweh commanded Moses.

hausa: Mattiyu, Toma, Yaƙub ɗan Alfayus, Siman wanda ake kira Zilot,
english: Matthew; Thomas; James the son of Alphaeus; Simon who was called the Zealot;

hausa: Ba tsofaffi ne kaɗai suke da hikima ba, ba masu yawan shekaru ne suke gane abin da yake daidai ba.
english: It is not the great who are wise, nor the aged who understand justice.

hausa: Ninebe tana kama da tafki, wanda ruwanta yana yoyo. Suna kuka suna cewa, “Ku tsaya! Ku tsaya,” amma ba wanda ya waiga.
english: But Nineveh has been from of old like a pool of water, yet they flee away. “Stop! Stop!” they cry, but no one looks back.

hausa: da Zanowa, da Adullam da ƙauyukansu, da Lakish da gonakinta, da kuma Azeka da ƙauyukanta. Saboda haka sun yi zama tun daga Beyersheba har zuwa Kwarin Hinnom.
english: Zanoah, Adullam, and their villages, Lachish and its fields, and Azekah and its towns. So they encamped from Beersheba to the valley of Hinnom.

hausa: Dawuda ya ce wa manzon, “Ka gaya wa Yowab, ‘Kada ka bar wannan yă dame ka; yadda takobi ya lamushe wannan, haka zai lamushe wancan ma. Ku ƙara matsa wa garin lamba, ku hallaka shi.’ Ka faɗa haka don ka ƙarfafa Yowab.”
english: Then David said to the messenger, “Tell Joab, ‘Don’t let this thing displease you, for the sword devours one as well as another. Make your battle stronger against the city, and overthrow it.’ Encourage him.”

hausa: Ba zai yi faɗa ko yă ɗaga murya ba, ba kuwa wanda zai ji muryarsa a kan tituna.
english: He will not strive, nor shout, neither will anyone hear his voice in the streets.

hausa: Sai Natanayel ya ce, “Rabbi, kai Ɗan Allah ne. Kai ne Sarkin Isra’ila.”
english: Nathanael answered him, “Rabbi, you are the Son of God! You are King of Israel!”

hausa: Tun daga zamanin kakanninmu har zuwa yanzu, zunubanmu suna da yawa. Domin zunubanmu, mu da sarakunanmu, da firistocinmu aka kama mu, aka wulaƙanta mu, muka zama bayi a hannun sarakuna waɗansu ƙasashe.
english: Since the days of our fathers we have been exceedingly guilty to this day; and for our iniquities we, our kings, and our priests have been delivered into the hand of the kings of the lands, to the sword, to captivity, to plunder, and to confusion of face, as it is this day.

hausa: Musa ya amsa wa mutane ya ce, “Kada ku ji tsoro. Ku tsaya dai ku ga ceton da Ubangiji zai kawo muku yau. Masarawan da kuke gani yau, ba za ku ƙara ganinsu ba.
english: Moses said to the people, “Don’t be afraid. Stand still, and see the salvation of Yahweh, which he will work for you today; for you will never again see the Egyptians whom you have seen today.

hausa: Suna da bakuna, amma ba sa magana, idanu, amma ba sa gani;
english: They have mouths, but they can’t speak. They have eyes, but they can’t see.

hausa: Sai Bildad mutumin Shuwa ya amsa,
english: Then Bildad the Shuhite answered,

hausa: gama ta fi azurfa riba tana kuma da amfani fiye da zinariya.
english: For her good profit is better than getting silver, and her return is better than fine gold.

hausa: Tagullar da aka bayar daga hadaya ta kaɗawa ya kai talenti 70 da shekel 2,400.
english: The bronze of the offering was seventy talents and two thousand four hundred shekels.

hausa: A sa’ad da ɗaukakata tana wucewa, zan sa ka a cikin tsaguwar dutsen, in rufe ka da hannuna har sai na wuce.
english: It will happen, while my glory passes by, that I will put you in a cleft of the rock, and will cover you with my hand until I have passed by;

hausa: Waɗannan sandunan sun yi tsawo har ana iya ganin bakinsu daga Wuri Mai Tsarki a gaban wuri mai tsarki na can ciki, amma ba a iya ganinsu daga waje na Wuri Mai Tsarki ba. Suna nan kuwa a can har wa yau.
english: The poles were so long that the ends of the poles were seen from the holy place before the inner sanctuary, but they were not seen outside. They are there to this day.

hausa: Cikin lokaci, a ƙarshen shekara ta biyu, sai hanjin cikinsa suka fito saboda cutar, ya kuma mutu cikin tsananin zafi. Mutanensa suka hura wuta don girmama shi, kamar yadda suka yi wa kakanninsa.
english: In process of time, at the end of two years, his bowels fell out by reason of his sickness, and he died of severe diseases. His people made no burning for him, like the burning of his fathers.

hausa: A ƙarshen gefen gabas, wajen fitowar rana, shi ma fāɗinsa kamu hamsin ne.
english: For the east side eastward fifty cubits,

hausa: Igiyoyin mutuwa sun shaƙe ni; rigyawan hallaka sun sha kaina.
english: The cords of death surrounded me. The floods of ungodliness made me afraid.

hausa: “Ga shi na ɗauki Lawiyawa daga cikin Isra’ilawa a maimakon ɗan fari na kowace mace a Isra’ila. Lawiyawa nawa ne,
english: “Behold, I have taken the Levites from among the children of Israel instead of all the firstborn who open the womb among the children of Israel; and the Levites shall be mine,

hausa: Duk sa’ad da Sama’ila ya yi magana dukan Isra’ila sukan saurare shi. Isra’ilawa suka fita yaƙi da Filistiyawa. Isra’ilawa suka kafa sansani a Ebenezer, Filistiyawa kuma a Afek.
english: The word of Samuel came to all Israel. Now Israel went out against the Philistines to battle, and encamped beside Ebenezer; and the Philistines encamped in Aphek.

hausa: Yesu ya ce wa almajiransa, “An yi wani mai arziki wanda aka yi wa manajansa zargin yin banza da dukiyarsa.
english: He also said to his disciples, “There was a certain rich man who had a manager. An accusation was made to him that this man was wasting his possessions.

hausa: Sa’ad da mutane suka ji wannan, sai suka soku a zuci sai suka ce wa Bitrus da sauran manzanni, “’Yan’uwa, me za mu yi?”
english: Now when they heard this, they were cut to the heart, and said to Peter and the rest of the apostles, “Brothers, what shall we do?”

hausa: “ko kuwa ‘Wa zai gangara can zurfin ƙasa?’ ” (wato, don yă hauro da Kiristi daga matattu).
english: or, ‘Who will descend into the abyss?’ (that is, to bring Christ up from the dead.)”

hausa: Amma da a ce sun tsaya a majalisata, da sun yi shelar maganata ga mutanena sun kuma juyar da su daga mugayen hanyoyinsu da kuma daga mugayen ayyukansu.
english: But if they had stood in my council, then they would have caused my people to hear my words, and would have turned them from their evil way, and from the evil of their doings.

hausa: Ubangiji kuwa ya ce wa Musa, “Ina zuwa wurinka a cikin baƙin hadari, domin mutane su ji ni ina maganar da kai, domin su amince da kai koyaushe.” Sa’an nan Musa ya faɗa wa Ubangiji abin da mutane suka ce.
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “Behold, I come to you in a thick cloud, that the people may hear when I speak with you, and may also believe you forever.” Moses told the words of the people to Yahweh.

hausa: wanda yake ma’aikacin muƙaddas Sergiyus Bulus ne. Muƙaddas ɗin kuwa mai azanci ne ƙwarai, ya sa aka kira Barnabas da Shawulu don yana so ya ji maganar Allah.
english: who was with the proconsul, Sergius Paulus, a man of understanding. This man summoned Barnabas and Saul, and sought to hear the word of God.

hausa: Ka bar marayunka; zan tsare ransu. Gwaurayenka kuma za su dogara a gare ni.”
english: Leave your fatherless children. I will preserve them alive. Let your widows trust in me.”

hausa: Kai kaɗai ne za a ji tsoro. Wane ne zai iya tsayawa sa’ad da ka yi fushi?
english: You, even you, are to be feared. Who can stand in your sight when you are angry?

hausa: saboda haka muddin ina raye, in ji Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka, zan sāka maka gwargwadon fushi da kuma kishin da ka nuna a ƙiyayyarsu da ka yi zan kuma sanar da kaina a cikinsu sa’ad da na hukunta ka.
english: therefore, as I live,” says the Lord Yahweh, “I will do according to your anger, and according to your envy which you have shown out of your hatred against them; and I will make myself known among them when I judge you.

hausa: Ya ce musu, “Mutanen Benyamin, ku saurara; ɗan Yesse zai iya ba dukanku filaye da gonakin inabi ne? Zai ba dukanku shugabanci na dubbai ko shugabanci na ɗari-ɗari?
english: Saul said to his servants who stood around him, “Hear now, you Benjamites! Will the son of Jesse give everyone of you fields and vineyards? Will he make you all captains of thousands and captains of hundreds?

hausa: Duk wanda ya ci kitsen dabbar da aka miƙa ta wuta ga Ubangiji, za a fid da shi daga mutanensa.
english: For whoever eats the fat of the animal which men offer as an offering made by fire to Yahweh, even the soul who eats it shall be cut off from his people.

hausa: “Amma kai ɗansa, Ya Belshazar, ba ka ƙasƙantar da kanka ba, ko da yake ka san wannan duka.
english: “You, his son, Belshazzar, have not humbled your heart, though you knew all this,

hausa: A haɗa da bunsuru guda a matsayin hadaya don zunubi, ban da hadaya ta ƙonawa ta kullum, tare da hadayarta ta hatsi da hadayarta ta sha.
english: and one male goat for a sin offering, in addition to the continual burnt offering, with its meal offering, and its drink offering.

hausa: Yahudawa suka ce, “Sai fa da aka shekara arba’in da shida ana ginin haikalin nan, kai kuwa a cikin kwana uku za ka tā da shi?”
english: The Jews therefore said, “It took forty-six years to build this temple! Will you raise it up in three days?”

hausa: “Bari mu kai wa Yahuda hari; bari mu yayyage su mu rarraba su a tsakaninmu, mu naɗa Tabeyel sarki a kansu.”
english: “Let’s go up against Judah, and tear it apart, and let’s divide it among ourselves, and set up a king within it, even the son of Tabeel.”

hausa: sa’ad da mutane suke jin tsoron tudu da kuma hatsarori a tituna; sa’ad da itacen almon ya toho, fāra kuma ya yi ta jan jikinsa da ƙyar, sha’awace-sha’awace sun kafe. Daga nan mutum ya tafi madawwamiyar gidansa ya bar masu makoki suna ta yi.
english: yes, they shall be afraid of heights, and terrors will be on the way; and the almond tree shall blossom, and the grasshopper shall be a burden, and desire shall fail; because man goes to his everlasting home, and the mourners go about the streets;

hausa: Eliyel mutumin Ma’aha, Yeribai da Yoshawiya ’ya’yan Elna’am maza, Itma mutumin Mowab,
english: Eliel the Mahavite, and Jeribai, and Joshaviah, the sons of Elnaam, and Ithmah the Moabite,

hausa: Sun yi wa Ubangiji sujada, amma kuma sun bauta wa allolinsu bisa ga al’adun ƙasashen da suka fito.
english: They feared Yahweh, and also served their own gods, after the ways of the nations from among whom they had been carried away.

hausa: “A cikin biranen da za a ba Lawiyawa, shida daga cikin garuruwan za su zama biranen mafaka, inda wanda ya kashe mutum zai gudu yă je. Ban da wannan, a ba su waɗansu garuruwa arba’in da biyu.
english: “The cities which you shall give to the Levites, they shall be the six cities of refuge, which you shall give for the man slayer to flee to. Besides them you shall give forty-two cities.

hausa: Bayin Dawuda suka tafi Karmel suka ce wa Abigiyel, “Dawuda ya aike mu gare ki, mu zo mu ɗauke ki ki zama matarsa.”
english: When David’s servants had come to Abigail to Carmel, they spoke to her, saying, “David has sent us to you, to take you to him as wife.”

hausa: Toho zai fito daga kututturen Yesse; daga saiwarsa Reshe zai ba da ’ya’ya.
english: A shoot will come out of the stock of Jesse, and a branch out of his roots will bear fruit.

hausa: saboda su ya tuna da alkawarinsa kuma daga yawan ƙaunarsa ya ji tausayi.
english: He remembered for them his covenant, and repented according to the multitude of his loving kindnesses.

hausa: Ni Bulus ne nake rubuta muku wannan gaisuwa da hannuna. Ku tuna da sarƙoƙina. Alherin Allah yă kasance tare da ku.
english: I, Paul, write this greeting with my own hand. Remember my chains. Grace be with you. Amen.

hausa: ka cinye su da hasala, ka cinye su sarai. Sa’an nan za a sani a iyakar duniya cewa Allah yana mulki a bisa Yaƙub. Sela
english: Consume them in wrath. Consume them, and they will be no more. Let them know that God rules in Jacob, to the ends of the earth. Selah.

hausa: Ahaz ya zama sarki yana da shekara ashirin, ya kuma yi mulki shekara goma sha shida a Urushalima ba kamar Dawuda mahaifinsa ba. Ahaz bai yi abin da yake daidai a gaban Ubangiji Allahnsa ba.
english: Ahaz was twenty years old when he began to reign, and he reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem. He didn’t do that which was right in Yahweh his God’s eyes, like David his father.

hausa: Amma da lokacin da zuciyarsa ta cika da girman kai ta kuma taurare, sai aka kore shi daga gadon sarautarsa, aka raba shi kuma da darajarsa.
english: But when his heart was lifted up, and his spirit was hardened so that he dealt proudly, he was deposed from his kingly throne, and they took his glory from him.

hausa: Ta haka ’ya’yan Lot biyu mata duk suka yi ciki daga mahaifinsu.
english: Thus both of Lot’s daughters were with child by their father.

hausa: Amma don ku san cewa Ɗan Mutum yana da iko a duniya yă gafarta zunubai.” Sai ya ce wa shanyayyen, “Tashi, ɗauki tabarmarka ka tafi gida.”
english: But that you may know that the Son of Man has authority on earth to forgive sins—” (then he said to the paralytic), “Get up, and take up your mat, and go to your house.”

hausa: A rana ta goma sha biyar na wannan wata, za a fara Bikin Burodi Marar Yisti na Ubangiji. Za ku yi kwana bakwai kuna cin burodi marar yisti.
english: On the fifteenth day of the same month is the feast of unleavened bread to Yahweh. Seven days you shall eat unleavened bread.

hausa: Amma babban firist ne kaɗai yakan shiga ɗaki na ciki-ciki, sau ɗaya tak a shekara, kuma sai da jini, wanda yakan miƙa domin zunubansa da kuma domin zunuban da mutane suka yi a cikin rashin sani.
english: but into the second the high priest alone, once in the year, not without blood, which he offers for himself and for the errors of the people.

hausa: Shi ma ya yi tafiya a hanyoyin gidan Ahab, gama mahaifiyarsa ta ƙarfafa shi yă yi abin da ba shi da kyau.
english: He also walked in the ways of Ahab’s house, because his mother was his counselor in acting wickedly.

hausa: in kuma ka kira ga tsinkaya ka kuma kira da ƙarfi don ganewa,
english: yes, if you call out for discernment, and lift up your voice for understanding;

hausa: don ka ci gaba da yin kome daidai leɓunanka za su adana sani.
english: that you may maintain discretion, that your lips may preserve knowledge.

hausa: Na ƙasaita fiye da kowane mutumin da ya riga ni zama a Urushalima. Cikin dukan wannan, hikimata ba tă rabu da ni ba.
english: So I was great, and increased more than all who were before me in Jerusalem. My wisdom also remained with me.

hausa: Ubangiji zai kore ku, ku da sarkin da kuka naɗa a bisanku zuwa al’ummar da ku, ko kakanninku ba su sani ba. A can za ku yi wa waɗansu alloli sujada, allolin itace da na dutse.
english: Yahweh will bring you, and your king whom you will set over yourselves, to a nation that you have not known, you nor your fathers. There you will serve other gods of wood and stone.

hausa: Yoram ya juya, ya gudu, yana ce wa Ahaziya, “Cin amana, Ahaziya!”
english: Joram turned his hands and fled, and said to Ahaziah, “This is treason, Ahaziah!”

hausa: Amma waɗanda ba su kula da maganar Ubangiji ba, suka bar bayinsu da dabbobi a gona.
english: Whoever didn’t respect Yahweh’s word left his servants and his livestock in the field.

hausa: Sai manyan firistoci da dattawan mutane, suka taru a fadan babban firist, mai suna Kayifas,
english: Then the chief priests, the scribes, and the elders of the people were gathered together in the court of the high priest, who was called Caiaphas.

hausa: Masarawa kuwa za su san cewa ni ne Ubangiji sa’ad da na miƙa hannuna a kan Masar, na kuma fitar da Isra’ilawa daga gare ta.”
english: The Egyptians shall know that I am Yahweh when I stretch out my hand on Egypt, and bring the children of Israel out from among them.”

hausa: Kursiyinka, ya Allah, zai kasance har abada abadin; sandar adalci zai zama sandar mulkinka.
english: Your throne, God, is forever and ever. A scepter of equity is the scepter of your kingdom.

hausa: Daga ’ya’yan fari na Isra’ilawa, ya karɓi azurfa masu nauyin shekel 1,365, bisa ga ma’aunin shekel na tsattsarkan wuri.
english: from the firstborn of the children of Israel he took the money, one thousand three hundred sixty-five shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary;

hausa: Kuka zauna a gado mai daraja, da tebur a shirye a gabanku wanda kun ajiye turare da maina.
