english: and sat on a stately bed, with a table prepared before it, whereupon you set my incense and my oil.

hausa: Ana nan sai ɗan matan, wato, gwauruwan nan ya fara ciwo. Ciwon ya ƙara muni, daga ƙarshe sai ya daina numfashi.
english: After these things, the son of the woman, the mistress of the house, became sick; and his sickness was so severe that there was no breath left in him.

hausa: su kuma jefa su cikin wuta mai zafi, inda za a yi kuka da cizon haƙora.”
english: and will cast them into the furnace of fire. There will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.”

hausa: To, da Yesu yana haurawa zuwa Urushalima, sai ya ja almajiran nan goma sha biyu gefe, ya ce musu,
english: As Jesus was going up to Jerusalem, he took the twelve disciples aside, and on the way he said to them,

hausa: Na bishe ka a hanyar hikima na kuma jagorance ka a miƙaƙƙun hanyoyi.
english: I have taught you in the way of wisdom. I have led you in straight paths.

hausa: Sun nemi taimako, amma ba su sami wanda zai cece su ba, ga Ubangiji, amma bai amsa ba.
english: They cried, but there was no one to save; even to Yahweh, but he didn’t answer them.

hausa: masu gini, da masu fasa duwatsu. Suka sayi katakai da sassaƙaƙƙun duwatsu domin gyaran haikalin Ubangiji, suka kuma biya duk waɗansu kuɗin gyaran haikalin.
english: and to the masons and the stone cutters, and for buying timber and cut stone to repair the damage to Yahweh’s house, and for all that was laid out for the house to repair it.

hausa: Ya yi wannan tambayar don yă gwada shi ne kawai, gama ya riga ya san abin da zai yi.
english: He said this to test him, for he himself knew what he would do.

hausa: Matakan mazambaci mugaye ne, yana ƙulla mugayen shirye-shirye don yă hallaka talakawa da ƙarairayi, ko sa’ad da roƙon mai bukata da gaskiya ne.
english: The ways of the scoundrel are evil. He devises wicked plans to destroy the humble with lying words, even when the needy speaks right.

hausa: Ba ko ɗayansu da yake cikin waɗanda Musa da Haruna firist, suka ƙidaya sa’ad da suka ƙidaya Isra’ilawa a Hamadar Sinai.
english: But among these there was not a man of them who were counted by Moses and Aaron the priest, who counted the children of Israel in the wilderness of Sinai.

hausa: Ɗan saƙon da ya tafi don yă kawo Mikahiya kuwa ya ce masa, “Duba, kowannen a cikin annabawa ya yi faɗin nasara wa sarki. Don haka kai ma ka yi maganar da za tă gamshi sarki kamar yadda suka yi.”
english: The messenger who went to call Micaiah spoke to him, saying, “Behold, the words of the prophets declare good to the king with one mouth. Let your word therefore, please be like one of theirs, and speak good.”

hausa: Ya kuma ce mata, “Hagar, baiwar Saira, daga ina kika fito, kuma ina za ki?” Ta amsa ta ce, “Ina gudu ne daga wurin uwargijiyata Saira.”
english: He said, “Hagar, Sarai’s servant, where did you come from? Where are you going?” She said, “I am fleeing from the face of my mistress Sarai.”

hausa: Na biye da shi a matsayi cikin jarumawa ukun nan, shi ne Eleyazar ɗan Dodo, mutumin Aho. Eleyazar ya kasance tare da Dawuda sa’ad da suka fuskanci Filistiyawa waɗanda suka taru a Fas Dammim don yaƙi. Mutanen Isra’ila suka gudu,
english: After him was Eleazar the son of Dodai the son of an Ahohite, one of the three mighty men with David when they defied the Philistines who were there gathered together to battle, and the men of Israel had gone away.

hausa: “Waɗansu mutane biyu sun tafi haikali don yin addu’a. Ɗaya Bafarisiye ne, ɗayan kuma mai karɓar haraji.
english: “Two men went up into the temple to pray; one was a Pharisee, and the other was a tax collector.

hausa: Ubangiji da yake cikinki mai adalci ne; ba ya yin abin da ba daidai ba. Kowace safiya yakan bayyana dokokinsa a fili, kowace sabuwar rana kuma ba ya kāsawa, duk da haka marasa adalci ba sa jin kunya.
english: Yahweh, within her, is righteous. He will do no wrong. Every morning he brings his justice to light. He doesn’t fail, but the unjust know no shame.

hausa: Nehemiya ya ce, “Ku koma gidajenku ku ci abinci mai kyau, ku sha abin sha mai zaƙi, ku kuma aika wa wanda ba shi da shi. Wannan rana mai tsarki ce ga Ubangijinmu. Kada ku yi baƙin ciki, gama farin cikin Ubangiji shi ne ƙarfinku.”
english: Then he said to them, “Go your way. Eat the fat, drink the sweet, and send portions to him for whom nothing is prepared, for today is holy to our Lord. Don’t be grieved, for the joy of Yahweh is your strength.”

hausa: Na tafi ne bisa ga wani wahayi. Da na kai can, sai na bayyana musu bisharar da nake wa’azi a cikin Al’ummai. Na yi haka a keɓance a gaban waɗanda suke shugabanni, don tsoro kada gudun da nake yi, ko kuwa na riga na yi, yă zama a banza.
english: I went up by revelation, and I laid before them the Good News which I preach among the Gentiles, but privately before those who were respected, for fear that I might be running, or had run, in vain.

hausa: saboda haka sai ya tafi wurin Ishmayel ya auri Mahalat, ’yar’uwar Nebayiwot da kuma ’yar Ishmayel ɗan Ibrahim, ban da matan da yake da su.
english: So Esau went to Ishmael, and took, in addition to the wives that he had, Mahalath the daughter of Ishmael, Abraham’s son, the sister of Nebaioth, to be his wife.

hausa: Saratu matar maigidana ta haifa masa ɗa a tsufanta, ya kuma ba shi duk mallakarsa.
english: Sarah, my master’s wife, bore a son to my master when she was old. He has given all that he has to him.

hausa: da dukan baƙin da suke can; dukan sarakunan Uz; dukan sarakunan Filistiyawa (waɗannan na Ashkelon, Gaza, Ekron da mutanen da aka bari a Ashdod);
english: and all the mixed people, and all the kings of the land of Uz, all the kings of the Philistines, Ashkelon, Gaza, Ekron, and the remnant of Ashdod;

hausa: In ba haka ba zai tuɓe ta tsirara in bar ta kamar yadda take a ranar da aka haife ta; zan sa ta zama kamar hamada, in mayar da ita busasshiyar ƙasar, in kashe ta da ƙishirwa.
english: lest I strip her naked, and make her bare as in the day that she was born, and make her like a wilderness, and set her like a dry land, and kill her with thirst.

hausa: Amma ban saurari Bala’am ba, saboda haka sai ya ma sa muku albarka, na kuɓutar da ku daga hannunsa.
english: but I would not listen to Balaam; therefore he blessed you still. So I delivered you out of his hand.

hausa: Yana tona rami a cikin duwatsu idanunsa suna ganin dukan dukiyar da ke cikin duwatsun.
english: He cuts out channels among the rocks. His eye sees every precious thing.

hausa: Ka ɗaga sandanka, ka miƙa shi bisa teku don ruwa yă rabu domin Isra’ilawa su wuce cikin teku a kan busasshiyar ƙasa.
english: Lift up your rod, and stretch out your hand over the sea and divide it. Then the children of Israel shall go into the middle of the sea on dry ground.

hausa: Gama bayan suka haura Kwarin Eshkol suka hangi ƙasar, sai suka karya zuciyar Isra’ilawa daga shigar ƙasar da Ubangiji ya ba su.
english: For when they went up to the valley of Eshcol, and saw the land, they discouraged the heart of the children of Israel, that they should not go into the land which Yahweh had given them.

hausa: waɗanda haƙoransu takuba ne waɗanda kuma muƙamuƙansu tarin wuƙaƙe ne don su cinye matalauta daga duniya da kuma mabukata daga cikin mutane.
english: There is a generation whose teeth are like swords, and their jaws like knives, to devour the poor from the earth, and the needy from among men.

hausa: A ƙarshe, wani ruhu ya zo gaba, ya tsaya a gaban Ubangiji ya ce, ‘Zan ruɗe shi.’ “Ubangiji ya yi tambaya, ‘Ta wace hanya?’
english: A spirit came out, stood before Yahweh, and said, ‘I will entice him.’ “Yahweh said to him, ‘How?’

hausa: Kun kawo mutanen nan a nan, gashi kuwa ba su yi fashin haikali ba, ba su kuwa saɓa wa alliyarmu ba.
english: For you have brought these men here, who are neither robbers of temples nor blasphemers of your goddess.

hausa: Ya tambaye su, “Mece ce shawararku? Yaya za mu amsa wa waɗannan mutane masu cewa, ‘Ka sassauta nauyin da mahaifinka ya sa a kanmu’?”
english: He said to them, “What counsel do you give, that we may answer these people who have spoken to me, saying, ‘Make the yoke that your father put on us lighter’?”

hausa: Sun rufe ni kamar ƙudan zuma, amma suka mutu nan da nan kamar ƙayayyuwa masu cin wuta; a cikin sunan Ubangiji na hallaka su.
english: They surrounded me like bees. They are quenched like the burning thorns. In Yahweh’s name I cut them off.

hausa: To, da Yoshuwa ya yi kusa da Yeriko, ya tā da idanunsa ya duba, sai ya ga wani mutum tsaye a gabansa riƙe da takobi, sai Yoshuwa ya je wurinsa ya ce masa, “Kai namu ne ko na abokan gābanmu?”
english: When Joshua was by Jericho, he lifted up his eyes and looked, and behold, a man stood in front of him with his sword drawn in his hand. Joshua went to him and said to him, “Are you for us, or for our enemies?”

hausa: “Malam, wace doka ce mafi girma a cikin dokoki?”
english: “Teacher, which is the greatest commandment in the law?”

hausa: Bitrus ya fara yin musu bayani dalla-dalla yadda ya faru cewa,
english: But Peter began, and explained to them in order, saying,

hausa: “Muryar kukansu na tashi daga Heshbon zuwa Eleyale da Yahaz, daga Zowar har zuwa Horonayim da Eglat Shelishiya, gama har ruwan Nimrim ma sun bushe.
english: From the cry of Heshbon even to Elealeh, even to Jahaz they have uttered their voice, from Zoar even to Horonaim, to Eglath Shelishiyah; for the waters of Nimrim will also become desolate.

hausa: Amma ko da ana tsiyaye jinina kamar hadaya ta sha a kan hadaya da kuma hidimar da take fitowa daga bangaskiyarku, ina murna ina kuma farin ciki da ku duka.
english: Yes, and if I am poured out on the sacrifice and service of your faith, I am glad and rejoice with you all.

hausa: Sai ya ce musu, “Ku da kanku kun san cewa dokarmu ta hana mutumin Yahuda yin cuɗanya, ko ya ziyarci Ba’al’umme. Amma Allah ya nuna mini cewa kada in kira wani mutum marar tsarki ko marar tsabta.
english: He said to them, “You yourselves know how it is an unlawful thing for a man who is a Jew to join himself or come to one of another nation, but God has shown me that I shouldn’t call any man unholy or unclean.

hausa: kuma kowane abin da ake zuba kaya, wanda ba shi da murfi a kansa, zai zama da ƙazanta.
english: Every open vessel, which has no covering bound on it, is unclean.

hausa: tă kuma tuɓe tufafin da ta sa sa’ad da aka kama ta. Bayan ta zauna a gidanka ta kuma yi makokin mahaifinta da mahaifiyarta wata ɗaya cif, sai ka shiga wurinta ka zama mijinta, za tă kuwa zama matarka.
english: She shall take off the clothing of her captivity, and shall remain in your house, and bewail her father and her mother a full month. After that you shall go in to her and be her husband, and she shall be your wife.

hausa: Don mai bi da kaɗe-kaɗe. Zabura ta Dawuda. Ya Ubangiji, sarki yana farin ciki cikin ƙarfinka. Yana farin cikinsa ƙwarai cikin nasarorin da ka ba shi!
english: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. The king rejoices in your strength, Yahweh! How greatly he rejoices in your salvation!

hausa: Ka hori ɗanka, gama yin haka akwai sa zuciya; kada ka goyi baya lalacewarsa.
english: Discipline your son, for there is hope; don’t be a willing party to his death.

hausa: Zan kuma komo da Yekoniya ɗan Yehohiyakim sarkin Yahuda da kuma dukan sauran masu zaman bauta daga Yahuda waɗanda suka tafi Babilon,’ in ji Ubangiji, ‘gama zan karya karkiyar sarkin Babilon.’ ”
english: I will bring again to this place Jeconiah the son of Jehoiakim, king of Judah, with all the captives of Judah, who went to Babylon,’ says Yahweh; ‘for I will break the yoke of the king of Babylon.’”

hausa: Sa’ad da Abram ya yi shekaru 99, sai Ubangiji ya bayyana a gare shi ya ce, ni “Ni ne Allah Maɗaukaki, ka yi tafiya a gabana ka kuma zama marar abin zargi.
english: When Abram was ninety-nine years old, Yahweh appeared to Abram and said to him, “I am God Almighty. Walk before me and be blameless.

hausa: Saboda haka Gideyon ya gina wa Ubangiji bagade a can, ya kuma kira shi, Ubangiji Salama ne. Har wa yau bagaden yana a Ofra ta mutanen Abiyezer.
english: Then Gideon built an altar there to Yahweh, and called it “Yahweh is Peace.” To this day it is still in Ophrah of the Abiezrites.

hausa: Sai Ibrahim ya tashi ya rusuna a gaban mutanen ƙasar, wato, Hittiyawan.
english: Abraham rose up, and bowed himself to the people of the land, to the children of Heth.

hausa: Kashegari da sassafe, Yerub-Ba’al (wato, Gideyon) da dukan mutanensa suka kafa sansani a maɓulɓulan Harod. Sansanin Midiyawa kuma yana arewa da su a kwari kusa da tudu na More.
english: Then Jerubbaal, who is Gideon, and all the people who were with him, rose up early and encamped beside the spring of Harod. Midian’s camp was on the north side of them, by the hill of Moreh, in the valley.

hausa: Sai Ruhu ya ce wa Filibus, “Matsa wurin kekunan yaƙin nan ka yi kusa da ita.”
english: The Spirit said to Philip, “Go near, and join yourself to this chariot.”

hausa: Miyamin, Mowadiya, Bilga,
english: Mijamin, Maadiah, Bilgah,

hausa: “Na zama abin dariya ga abokaina, ko da yake na yi kira ga Allah ya kuwa amsa mini, duk da haka suka yi mini riya ko da yake ni mai adalci ne kuma marar laifi!
english: I am like one who is a joke to his neighbor, I, who called on God, and he answered. The just, the blameless man is a joke.

hausa: Amma yana cikin wannan tunani, sai wani mala’ikan Ubangiji ya bayyana masa cikin mafarki ya ce, “Yusuf ɗan Dawuda, kada ka ji tsoron ɗaukan Maryamu zuwa gidanka a matsayin matarka, gama cikin nan nata, daga wurin Ruhu Mai Tsarki ne.
english: But when he thought about these things, behold, an angel of the Lord appeared to him in a dream, saying, “Joseph, son of David, don’t be afraid to take to yourself Mary as your wife, for that which is conceived in her is of the Holy Spirit.

hausa: Hannatu kuwa ba tă bi su ba. Ta gaya wa mijinta cewa, “Sai bayan na yaye yaron, zan kai shi in miƙa shi a gaban Ubangiji, yă kuma kasance a wurin koyaushe.”
english: But Hannah didn’t go up, for she said to her husband, “Not until the child is weaned; then I will bring him, that he may appear before Yahweh, and stay there forever.”

hausa: Amma fa, in tun can, an san bijimin yana da wannan halin faɗa, duk da haka mai shi bai ɗaura shi ba, dole mai shi yă biya, dabba domin dabba, matacciyar dabbar kuwa tă zama nasa.
english: Or if it is known that the bull was in the habit of goring in the past, and its owner has not kept it in, he shall surely pay bull for bull, and the dead animal shall be his own.

hausa: Ka shafe su yadda ka shafe mahaifinsu, don su yi mini hidima a matsayin firistoci. Shafe musu man, zai sa su zama firistoci na ɗinɗinɗin, dukan zamanansu.”
english: You shall anoint them, as you anointed their father, that they may minister to me in the priest’s office. Their anointing shall be to them for an everlasting priesthood throughout their generations.”

hausa: Sama’ila ya ce, “Dakata, bari in faɗa maka abin da Ubangiji ya ce mini jiya da dare.” Shawulu ya ce, “Gaya mini.”
english: Then Samuel said to Saul, “Stay, and I will tell you what Yahweh said to me last night.” He said to him, “Say on.”

hausa: ’Yan’uwansu Lawiyawa kuwa su ne suke lura da ma’ajin gidan Allah da kuma baitulmali don kayayyakin da aka keɓe.
english: Of the Levites, Ahijah was over the treasures of God’s house and over the treasures of the dedicated things.

hausa: “Sa’an nan kuma sai na so in san ma’anar wannan dabba ta huɗu, wadda ta yi dabam da sauran dabbobin da suke da matuƙar bantsoro, da take da haƙoran ƙarfe da kuma farcen tagulla, dabbar ta ragargaje ta cinye abin da ta kama, ta kuma tattaka duk abin da ya rage a ƙarƙashin ƙafafunta.
english: “Then I desired to know the truth concerning the fourth animal, which was different from all of them, exceedingly terrible, whose teeth were of iron, and its nails of bronze; which devoured, broke in pieces, and stamped the residue with its feet;

hausa: Dole ka yi maganata gare su, ko su ji ko kada su ji, gama su ’yan tawaye ne.
english: You shall speak my words to them, whether they will hear or whether they will refuse; for they are most rebellious.

hausa: Na ƙi in taɓa shi; irin wannan abinci zai sa ni rashin lafiya.
english: My soul refuses to touch them. They are as loathsome food to me.

hausa: Hazayel ya ce, “Yaya bawanka, wanda yake kare kawai, zai iya aikata wannan irin abu?” Elisha ya ce, “Ubangiji ya nuna mini cewa za ka zama sarkin Aram.”
english: Hazael said, “But what is your servant, who is but a dog, that he could do this great thing?” Elisha answered, “Yahweh has shown me that you will be king over Syria.”

hausa: saboda haka sai ta ce wa Abram, “Ubangiji ya hana mini haihuwar ’ya’ya. Tafi ka kwana da baiwata; wataƙila in sami iyali ta wurinta.” Abram kuwa ya yarda da abin da Saira ta faɗa.
english: Sarai said to Abram, “See now, Yahweh has restrained me from bearing. Please go in to my servant. It may be that I will obtain children by her.” Abram listened to the voice of Sarai.

hausa: sa’ad da ka kwanta, ba za ka ji tsoro ba; sa’ad da ka kwanta, barci zai yi maka daɗi.
english: When you lie down, you will not be afraid. Yes, you will lie down, and your sleep will be sweet.

hausa: Amma sojojin Babiloniyawa suka bi sarki, suka cin masa a filayen Yeriko. Dukan sojojinsa kuwa suka rabu da shi suka watse.
english: But the Chaldean army pursued the king, and overtook him in the plains of Jericho; and all his army was scattered from him.

hausa: wanda ya cece mu ya kuma kira mu ga rayuwar tsarki ba saboda wani abin da muka yi ba sai dai saboda nufinsa da kuma alherinsa. An ba mu wannan alheri cikin Kiristi Yesu tun fil azal,
english: who saved us and called us with a holy calling, not according to our works, but according to his own purpose and grace, which was given to us in Christ Jesus before times eternal,

hausa: Na kwanta rubda ciki a gaban Ubangiji waɗannan yini arba’in da dare arba’in domin Ubangiji ya ce zai hallaka ku.
english: So I fell down before Yahweh the forty days and forty nights that I fell down, because Yahweh had said he would destroy you.

hausa: Da dad dare, Abram ya rarraba mutanensa don su fāɗa wa sarakunan nan, ya ɗibge su, ya kore su har zuwa Hoba, arewa da Damaskus.
english: He divided himself against them by night, he and his servants, and struck them, and pursued them to Hobah, which is on the left hand of Damascus.

hausa: Na umarce ka, a gaban Allah mai ba da rai ga kome, da kuma Kiristi Yesu wanda yayinda yake ba da shaida a gaban Buntus Bilatus ya yi kyakkyawar shaida,
english: I command you before God who gives life to all things, and before Christ Jesus who before Pontius Pilate testified the good confession,

hausa: To, mene ne ladana? Ladana kaɗai shi ne, in yi wa’azin bishara, in kuma yi shi a kyauta, yadda ba zan yi amfani da ’yancina cikin wa’azin ba.
english: What then is my reward? That when I preach the Good News, I may present the Good News of Christ without charge, so as not to abuse my authority in the Good News.

hausa: Shi ne Allah mai sāka mini, wanda yake sa al’ummai a ƙarƙashina,
english: even the God who executes vengeance for me, and subdues peoples under me.

hausa: Gama yaya zan jure da ganin masifa ta faɗa a kan mutanena? Yaya zan jure in ga an hallaka iyalina?”
english: For how can I endure to see the evil that would come to my people? How can I endure to see the destruction of my relatives?”

hausa: Suka shiga gidan, suka kuwa ga yaron tare da mahaifiyarsa Maryamu. Suka durƙusa har ƙasa, suka yi masa sujada. Sa’an nan suka kunce dukiyarsu, suka miƙa masa kyautai na zinariya da na turare da na mur.
english: They came into the house and saw the young child with Mary, his mother, and they fell down and worshiped him. Opening their treasures, they offered to him gifts: gold, frankincense, and myrrh.

hausa: Yawan mutanen sashensa 53,400 ne
english: His division, and those who were counted of them, were fifty-three thousand four hundred.

hausa: Wanda kuwa ya haɗa jikinsa da Ubangiji ya zama ɗaya da shi ke nan a ruhu.
english: But he who is joined to the Lord is one spirit.

hausa: Da asubahin fāri, sai Ubangiji ya dubi ƙasa a kan sojojin Masarawa daga al’amudin wuta da kuma girgije, sai ya sa suka ruɗe.
english: In the morning watch, Yahweh looked out on the Egyptian army through the pillar of fire and of cloud, and confused the Egyptian army.

hausa: Saboda haka, da yake muna da babban firist mai girma wanda ya ratsa sama, Yesu Ɗan Allah, bari mu riƙe bangaskiyan nan wadda muke shaidawa da ƙarfi.
english: Having then a great high priest who has passed through the heavens, Jesus, the Son of God, let’s hold tightly to our confession.

hausa: “Ga shi, zan aika muku da annabi Iliya kafin babbar ranan nan mai banrazana ta Ubangiji tă zo.
english: Behold, I will send you Elijah the prophet before the great and terrible day of Yahweh comes.

hausa: “Har yaushe wannan muguwar al’umma za tă yi gunaguni a kaina? Na ji koke-koken waɗannan Isra’ilawa masu gunaguni.
english: “How long shall I bear with this evil congregation that complain against me? I have heard the complaints of the children of Israel, which they complain against me.

hausa: (Sauran matattu ba su sāke rayuwa ba, sai da shekaru dubun nan suka cika.) Wannan fa shi ne tashin matattu na farko.
english: The rest of the dead didn’t live until the thousand years were finished. This is the first resurrection.

hausa: Yesu ya amsa ya ce, “Wanda ya riga ya yi wanka yana bukata yă wanke ƙafafunsa ne kawai; dukan jikinsa yana da tsabta. Ku kuwa kuna da tsabta, ko da yake ba kowannenku ba.”
english: Jesus said to him, “Someone who has bathed only needs to have his feet washed, but is completely clean. You are clean, but not all of you.”

hausa: “Daidai kamar yadda ya faru a zamanin Nuhu, haka zai zama a zamanin Ɗan Mutum.
english: As it was in the days of Noah, even so it will also be in the days of the Son of Man.

hausa: Zan mai da ƙasar Masar kufai a cikin ƙasashen da aka ragargaza, biranenta kuma za su zama kango har shekaru arba’in a cikin biranen da aka lalace. Zan watsar da Masarawa a cikin al’ummai in warwatsa su cikin ƙasashe.
english: I will make the land of Egypt a desolation in the middle of the countries that are desolate. Her cities among the cities that are laid waste will be a desolation forty years. I will scatter the Egyptians among the nations, and will disperse them through the countries.”

hausa: ko kuma idan ya sami abin da ya ɓace amma ya yi ƙarya cewa bai samu ba. Ko ya yi rantsuwar ƙarya a kan duk irin abubuwan da akan aikata na laifi,
english: or has found that which was lost, and lied about it, and swearing to a lie—in any of these things that a man sins in his actions—

hausa: “ ‘Ushirin kome daga gona, ko hatsi daga ƙasa, ko ’ya’yan itatuwa daga itatuwa, na Ubangiji ne, mai tsarki ne ga Ubangiji.
english: “‘All the tithe of the land, whether of the seed of the land or of the fruit of the trees, is Yahweh’s. It is holy to Yahweh.

hausa: Kalmomin masu hikima kamar tsinken tsokanar dabba ne, tarin maganganunsu kuma kamar ƙusoshi ne da aka kafa daram, da aka ba wa Makiyayi guda.
english: The words of the wise are like goads; and like nails well fastened are words from the masters of assemblies, which are given from one shepherd.

hausa: Sa’ad da mutane suka ce muku ku nemi shawarar ’yan bori da masu sihiri, waɗanda suke shaƙe murya har ba a jin abin da suke faɗi, bai kamata mutane su nemi shawara daga Allahnsu ba? Me zai sa ku nemi shawara daga matattu a madadin masu rai?
english: When they tell you, “Consult with those who have familiar spirits and with the wizards, who chirp and who mutter,” shouldn’t a people consult with their God? Should they consult the dead on behalf of the living?

hausa: A haɗa da bunsuru guda a matsayin hadaya don zunubi, don yin muku kafara da kuma hadaya ta ƙonawa ta kullum; tare da hadaya ta garinta, da kuma hadayu na shansu.
english: one male goat for a sin offering, in addition to the sin offering of atonement, and the continual burnt offering, and its meal offering, and their drink offerings.

hausa: Hadoram, Uzal, Dikla,
english: Hadoram, Uzal, Diklah,

hausa: Allah ba ya karya! Haka ma alkawuransa da rantsuwarsa abubuwa biyu ne da ba a iya canjawa. Mun gudu zuwa wurin Allah domin kāriya. Ya kamata alkawuransa su ƙarfafawa sosai mu riƙe begen nan da yake gabanmu.
english: that by two immutable things, in which it is impossible for God to lie, we may have a strong encouragement, who have fled for refuge to take hold of the hope set before us.

hausa: Ka ce, “Ga abin da Ubangiji ya furta, “ ‘Gawawwakin mutane za su fāɗi kamar juji a fili, kamar hatsin da aka yanka a bayan mai girbi, da ba mai tara su.’ ”
english: Speak, “Yahweh says, “‘The dead bodies of men will fall as dung on the open field, and as the handful after the harvester. No one will gather them.’”

hausa: Sai Yesu ya amsa ya ce, “Ko na shaidi kaina, ai, shaidata tabbatacciya ce, gama na san inda na fito da kuma inda za ni. Amma ku ba ku san inda na fito ko inda za ni ba.
english: Jesus answered them, “Even if I testify about myself, my testimony is true, for I know where I came from, and where I am going; but you don’t know where I came from, or where I am going.

hausa: kuna gode wa Uba, wanda ya sa kuka cancanci ku sami rabo a gādon tsarkaka a cikin mulkin haske.
english: giving thanks to the Father, who made us fit to be partakers of the inheritance of the saints in light,

hausa: “Ku tattaru, ku saurara, ’ya’yan Yaƙub maza; ku saurari mahaifinku, Isra’ila.
english: Assemble yourselves, and hear, you sons of Jacob. Listen to Israel, your father.

hausa: Bari addu’ata ta zo a gabanka; ka kasa kunne ga kukata.
english: Let my prayer enter into your presence. Turn your ear to my cry.

hausa: Mu kanmu mun ji wannan muryar da ta zo daga sama sa’ad da muke tare da shi a kan dutse mai tsarki.
english: We heard this voice come out of heaven when we were with him on the holy mountain.

hausa: Duk zuriyar kakana ba su cancanci kome ba sai mutuwa daga ranka yă daɗe, amma ka ba wa bawanka wuri cikin mutanen da suke ci a teburinka. Saboda haka, wanda ’yanci nake da shi da zan yi wani ƙarin roƙo a wurin sarki?”
english: For all my father’s house were but dead men before my lord the king; yet you set your servant among those who ate at your own table. What right therefore have I yet that I should appeal any more to the king?”

hausa: haka ma zanen binnewar da aka naɗe kan Yesu da shi. Zanen a naɗe yake shi kaɗai, a keɓe da lilin ɗin.
english: and the cloth that had been on his head, not lying with the linen cloths, but rolled up in a place by itself.

hausa: da kuma suka yi tun lokacin da na sa shugabanni a bisa mutanen Isra’ila. Zan rinjaye dukan abokan gābanka. “ ‘Na furta maka cewa Ubangiji zai gina maka gida,
english: and from the day that I commanded judges to be over my people Israel. I will subdue all your enemies. Moreover I tell you that Yahweh will build you a house.

hausa: Saboda haka, Mordekai ya tafi, ya aikata dukan umarnan Esta.
english: So Mordecai went his way, and did according to all that Esther had commanded him.

hausa: A maimakon haka, sai ku ci su a gaban Ubangiji Allahnku a wurin da Ubangiji Allahnku ya zaɓa, da ku da ’ya’yanku maza da mata, da bayinku maza da mata, da kuma Lawiyawa daga biranenku, ku kuwa yi farin ciki a gaban Ubangiji Allahnku a kowane abin da kuka sa hannunku.
english: but you shall eat them before Yahweh your God in the place which Yahweh your God shall choose: you, your son, your daughter, your male servant, your female servant, and the Levite who is within your gates. You shall rejoice before Yahweh your God in all that you put your hand to.

hausa: Amma Yohanna ya so yă hana shi, yana cewa, “Ina bukata ka yi mini baftisma, yaya kake zuwa wurina?”
english: But John would have hindered him, saying, “I need to be baptized by you, and you come to me?”

hausa: Kamar ƙarar ƙayar da take karce gindin tukunya, haka dariyar wawaye take. Wannan ma ba shi da amfani.
english: For as the crackling of thorns under a pot, so is the laughter of the fool. This also is vanity.

hausa: Haka kuwa Haruna ya yi; ya shisshirya fitilun yadda za su fuskanci gaba a kan wurin ajiye fitilan, kamar dai yadda Ubangiji ya umarci Musa.
english: Aaron did so. He lit its lamps to light the area in front of the lamp stand, as Yahweh commanded Moses.

hausa: Ku yi addu’a don salamar Urushalima, “Bari waɗanda suke ƙaunarki su zauna lafiya.
english: Pray for the peace of Jerusalem. Those who love you will prosper.

hausa: Nilu zai cika da kwaɗi. Za su haura zuwa cikin fadanka da kan gadonka, cikin gidajen bayinka da kan mutanenka, cikin kwanonin toye-toyenka da na cin abincinka.
english: The river will swarm with frogs, which will go up and come into your house, and into your bedroom, and on your bed, and into the house of your servants, and on your people, and into your ovens, and into your kneading troughs.

hausa: “Sa’an nan zan tsarkake leɓunan mutanen, don dukansu su kira bisa ga sunan Ubangiji su kuma yi masa hidima kafaɗa da kafaɗa.
english: For then I will purify the lips of the peoples, that they may all call on Yahweh’s name, to serve him shoulder to shoulder.

hausa: “Kada ku yi abin da ba daidai ba, don galibin mutane suna yin haka. Sa’ad da kuke ba da shaida a gaban shari’a, kada ku ba da shaidar ƙarya a kauce wa gaskiya don ku faranta wa taron jama’a rai.
english: “You shall not follow a crowd to do evil. You shall not testify in court to side with a multitude to pervert justice.

hausa: Kowa zai zauna a tushen kuringar inabinsa da tushen ɓaurensa, kuma ba wanda zai tsoratar da su, gama Ubangiji Maɗaukaki ne ya faɗa.
english: But every man will sit under his vine and under his fig tree. No one will make them afraid, for the mouth of Yahweh of Armies has spoken.

hausa: da kuma dukan membobin gidan Yusuf, da ’yan’uwansa da kuma waɗanda suke na gidan mahaifinsa. Yara kaɗai da garkunansu da kuma shanunsu ne aka bari a Goshen.
english: all the house of Joseph, his brothers, and his father’s house. Only their little ones, their flocks, and their herds, they left in the land of Goshen.

hausa: “Ku zo kusa da ni ku kuma saurari wannan. “Daga farkon shela ban yi magana a ɓoye ba; a lokacin da ya faru, ina nan a wurin.” Yanzu kuwa Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka ya aiko ni, da Ruhunsa.
english: “Come near to me and hear this: “From the beginning I have not spoken in secret; from the time that it happened, I was there.” Now the Lord Yahweh has sent me with his Spirit.

hausa: Dukanmu, muna kama da tumakin da suka ɓata, kowannenmu ya kama hanyarsa; Ubangiji kuwa ya sa hukunci ya auko a kansa hukuncin da ya wajaba a kanmu.
english: All we like sheep have gone astray. Everyone has turned to his own way; and Yahweh has laid on him the iniquity of us all.

hausa: Waɗanda suka tsira annoba za tă kashe su, kuma gwaurayensu ba za su yi kukan mutuwarsu ba.
english: Those who remain of him will be buried in death. His widows will make no lamentation.

hausa: Sarkin Assuriya ya kawo mutane daga Babilon, Kuta, Afa, Hamat da Sefarfayim ya zaunar da su a garuruwan Samariya don su maya gurbin Isra’ilawa. Suka mallaki Samariya suka kuma zauna a garuruwansu.
english: The king of Assyria brought people from Babylon, from Cuthah, from Avva, and from Hamath and Sepharvaim, and placed them in the cities of Samaria instead of the children of Israel; and they possessed Samaria and lived in its cities.

hausa: Suna nan kuma a En Rimmon, da Zora, da Yarmut,
english: in En Rimmon, in Zorah, in Jarmuth,

hausa: Yanzu kam abubuwan nan uku sun tabbata, bangaskiya, bege, da kuma ƙauna. Sai dai mafi girma a cikinsu ita ce ƙauna.
english: But now faith, hope, and love remain—these three. The greatest of these is love.

hausa: Amma bagaden tagullar da Bezalel ɗan Uri, ɗan Hur, ya yi a Gibeyon a gaba tabanakul na Ubangiji; saboda haka Solomon da taron suka neme nufin Ubangiji a can.
english: Moreover the bronze altar that Bezalel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, had made was there before Yahweh’s tabernacle; and Solomon and the assembly were seeking counsel there.

hausa: Sa’an nan Ubangiji zai sa girgijen hayaƙi da rana da harshen wuta da dare a bisa dukan Dutsen Sihiyona da kuma bisa waɗanda suka tattaru a can; a bisa duka kuwa ɗaukakar za tă zama rumfa.
english: Yahweh will create over the whole habitation of Mount Zion and over her assemblies, a cloud and smoke by day, and the shining of a flaming fire by night, for over all the glory will be a canopy.

hausa: Haka ma ka auna kashi ɗaya bisa shida na garwan ruwa ka sha shi a ƙayyadadden lokaci.
english: You shall drink water by measure, the sixth part of a hin. From time to time you shall drink.

hausa: ’Ya’yan Elifaz maza su ne, Teman, Omar, Zefi, Gatam, Kenaz, da Timna wanda aka haifa wa Amalek.
english: The sons of Eliphaz: Teman, Omar, Zephi, Gatam, Kenaz, Timna, and Amalek.

hausa: Waɗannan ne aka nemi sunayensu a cikin tarihin asalin iyalai, amma ba a same su a ciki ba, saboda haka aka hana su shiga cikin firistoci, sun zama kamar marasa tsarki.
english: These searched for their genealogical records, but couldn’t find them. Therefore they were deemed disqualified and removed from the priesthood.

hausa: Zan kwanta in kuma yi barci lafiya, gama kai kaɗai, ya Ubangiji, kake sa mazaunina yă kasance lafiya lau.
english: In peace I will both lay myself down and sleep, for you alone, Yahweh, make me live in safety.

hausa: Amma da suna cikin cin naman, tun ba su ma haɗiye ba, sai Ubangiji ya husata sosai a kan jama’ar, ya buge su da annoba mai zafi.
english: While the meat was still between their teeth, before it was chewed, Yahweh’s anger burned against the people, and Yahweh struck the people with a very great plague.

hausa: (A shekara ta goma sha ɗaya ta Yoram ɗan Ahab, Ahaziya ya zama sarkin Yahuda.)
english: In the eleventh year of Joram the son of Ahab, Ahaziah began to reign over Judah.

hausa: Sa’an nan Musa ya rabu da Fir’auna, ya kuma yi addu’a ga Ubangiji,
english: Moses went out from Pharaoh, and prayed to Yahweh.

hausa: Na kuma yi tanadi don sadakokin itace a ƙayyadaddun lokuta, da kuma don nunan fari. Ka tuna da ni da alheri, ya Allahna.
english: and for the wood offering, at appointed times, and for the first fruits. Remember me, my God, for good.

hausa: Ka yanka shi a gaban Ubangiji a ƙofar Tentin Sujada.
english: You shall kill the bull before Yahweh at the door of the Tent of Meeting.

hausa: da kuma firistoci, Eliyakim, Ma’asehiya, Miniyamin, Mikahiya, Eliyohenai, Zakariya da Hananiya tare da ƙahoninsu,
english: and the priests, Eliakim, Maaseiah, Miniamin, Micaiah, Elioenai, Zechariah, and Hananiah, with trumpets;

hausa: Mu da ba mu da lulluɓi a fuskokinmu duk muna nuna ɗaukakar Ubangiji, ana sauya mu mu ɗauki kamanninsa cikin ɗaukaka mai hauhawa. Ubangiji wanda yake ruhu kuwa shi ne mai zartar da haka.
english: But we all, with unveiled face seeing the glory of the Lord as in a mirror, are transformed into the same image from glory to glory, even as from the Lord, the Spirit.

hausa: Wa zai iya ƙidaya ƙurar Yaƙub ko yă ƙidaya kashi ɗaya bisa huɗu na Isra’ila? Bari in mutu, mutuwar adali ƙarshena kuma yă zama kamar nasu!”
english: Who can count the dust of Jacob, or count the fourth part of Israel? Let me die the death of the righteous! Let my last end be like his!”

hausa: An yi wa katakan itacen al’ul na cikin haikalin zāne mai fasalin gora da na buɗaɗɗun furanni. An rufe bangon ciki duka da itacen al’ul, har ba a ganin duwatsun ginin.
english: There was cedar on the house within, carved with buds and open flowers. All was cedar. No stone was visible.

hausa: “ ‘Game da ku, ya gidan Isra’ila, ga abin da Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka yana cewa ku tafi ku bauta wa gumakanku, kowannenku! Amma daga baya tabbatacce za ku saurare ni ba kuwa za ku ƙara ɓata sunana mai tsarki da hadayunku da gumakanku ba.
english: “‘As for you, house of Israel, the Lord Yahweh says: “Go, everyone serve his idols, and hereafter also, if you will not listen to me; but you shall no more profane my holy name with your gifts and with your idols.

hausa: A tagar gidana na leƙa ta labule mai rammuka.
english: For at the window of my house, I looked out through my lattice.

hausa: Tare da bijiman, ragunan da ’yan ragunan a miƙa hadayarsu da gari da hadaya ta sha, bisa ga adadin da aka ƙayyade.
english: and their meal offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, according to their number, after the ordinance;

hausa: Suka dinga bugunsa a kā da sanda, suka tattofa masa miyau. Suka durƙusa suka yi masa bangirma na ba’a.
english: They struck his head with a reed and spat on him, and bowing their knees, did homage to him.

hausa: Za su ma sami isashe in har aka yanka musu garkuna tumaki da na shanu? Za su sami isashe in aka kama musu dukan kifin teku?”
english: Shall flocks and herds be slaughtered for them, to be sufficient for them? Shall all the fish of the sea be gathered together for them, to be sufficient for them?”

hausa: Haka kuma ya so yă sanar da wadatar ɗaukakarsa ga waɗanda suka cancanci jinƙansa, waɗanda ya shirya tun kafin lokaci don ɗaukaka
english: and that he might make known the riches of his glory on vessels of mercy, which he prepared beforehand for glory—

hausa: mutanen Benyamin, ’yan’uwan Shawulu, su 3,000, yawanci waɗanda suke biyayya ga gidan Shawulu sai lokacin;
english: Of the children of Benjamin, Saul’s relatives: three thousand, for until then, the greatest part of them had kept their allegiance to Saul’s house.

hausa: Ba kuwa haka kaɗai ba, har ma ikkilisiyoyi sun zaɓe shi yă riƙa tafiya tare da mu kan wannan aikin alheri da muke yi saboda ɗaukakar Ubangiji, da kuma nuna kyakkyawar niyyarmu.
english: Not only so, but he was also appointed by the assemblies to travel with us in this grace, which is served by us to the glory of the Lord himself, and to show our readiness.

hausa: “Amma ku, ku matso nan, ku ’ya’ya maza na masu sihiri, ku zuriyar mazinata da karuwai!
english: “But draw near here, you sons of a sorceress, you offspring of adulterers and prostitutes.

hausa: Yi tafiya cikin Sihiyona, ku kewaye ta, ku ƙirga hasumiyoyinta,
english: Walk about Zion, and go around her. Number its towers.

hausa: Da jin maganar Sama’ila sai Shawulu ya faɗi ƙasa warwas. Tsoro ya kama shi ƙwarai. Ba shi kuma da ƙarfi domin bai ci kome ba dukan yini da kuma dukan dare.
english: Then Saul fell immediately his full length on the earth, and was terrified, because of Samuel’s words. There was no strength in him, for he had eaten no bread all day long or all night long.

hausa: Saboda haka Ubangiji zai kawo gyambuna a kawunan matan Sihiyona; Ubangiji zai sa a aske kawunansu, a bar su ƙwal.”
english: therefore the Lord brings sores on the crown of the head of the women of Zion, and Yahweh will make their scalps bald.”

hausa: Amma Allah ya yi duniya ta wurin ikonsa; ya kafa duniya ta wurin hikimarsa ya shimfiɗa sammai ta wurin fahiminsa.
english: God has made the earth by his power. He has established the world by his wisdom, and by his understanding has he stretched out the heavens.

hausa: Sa’ad da aka kama ku, aka kuma kai ku don a yi muku shari’a, kada ku damu da abin da za ku faɗa. Sai dai ku faɗi abin da aka ba ku a lokacin. Gama ba ku kuke magana ba, Ruhu Mai Tsarki ne.
english: When they lead you away and deliver you up, don’t be anxious beforehand or premeditate what you will say, but say whatever will be given you in that hour. For it is not you who speak, but the Holy Spirit.

hausa: Na Gershom su ne, Libni, Yahat, Zimma,
english: Of Gershom: Libni his son, Jahath his son, Zimmah his son,

hausa: Waɗanda aka aika su yi gaba suka tafi, suka kuwa tarar kamar yadda ya gaya musu.
english: Those who were sent went away and found things just as he had told them.

hausa: Ubangiji zai sa a rinjaye ku a gaban abokan gābanku. Ta hanya guda za ku auka musu, amma ta hanyoyi bakwai za ku gudu daga gabansu. Za ku zama abin ƙi ga dukan mulkokin duniya.
english: Yahweh will cause you to be struck before your enemies. You will go out one way against them, and will flee seven ways before them. You will be tossed back and forth among all the kingdoms of the earth.

hausa: Ubangiji ya ce, “Zan kawo su daga Bashan; zan kawo su daga zurfafan teku,
english: The Lord said, “I will bring you again from Bashan, I will bring you again from the depths of the sea,

hausa: Da Dawuda ya zo wurin mutum ɗari biyu ɗin nan waɗanda suka tafke, suka kāsa binsa, waɗanda aka bari a bakin Kwarin Besor, sai suka taryi Dawuda da mutanensa da suka tafi tare da shi. Sa’ad da Dawuda ya zo kusa da su, sai ya gaishe su.
english: David came to the two hundred men, who were so faint that they could not follow David, whom also they had made to stay at the brook Besor; and they went out to meet David, and to meet the people who were with him. When David came near to the people, he greeted them.

hausa: Wannan yana bukata hikima. Duk mai hankali, sai yă lissafta lambar dabbar, gama lamban nan ta mutum ne. Lambarta kuwa ita ce 666.
english: Here is wisdom. He who has understanding, let him calculate the number of the beast, for it is the number of a man. His number is six hundred sixty-six.

hausa: “Ɗan mutum, ka fuskanci Gog, na ƙasar Magog, babban sarkin Meshek da Tubal; ka yi annabci a kansa
english: “Son of man, set your face toward Gog, of the land of Magog, the prince of Rosh, Meshech, and Tubal, and prophesy against him,

hausa: za ku kuma koyar da Isra’ilawa dukan farillan da Ubangiji ya ba su ta wurin Musa.”
english: You are to teach the children of Israel all the statutes which Yahweh has spoken to them by Moses.”

hausa: Alheri, jinƙai da kuma salama daga Allah Uba da kuma Yesu Kiristi, Ɗan Uba, su kasance tare da mu cikin gaskiya da ƙauna.
english: Grace, mercy, and peace will be with us, from God the Father and from the Lord Jesus Christ, the Son of the Father, in truth and love.

hausa: Yakan yi kwanto a ɓoye kamar zaki. Yakan yi kwanto don yă kama marasa ƙarfi; yakan kama marasa ƙarfi yă ja su cikin ragarsa.
english: He lurks in secret as a lion in his ambush. He lies in wait to catch the helpless. He catches the helpless when he draws him in his net.

hausa: Sa’an nan Ubangiji ya amsa wa Ayuba. Ya ce,
english: Then Yahweh answered Job out of the whirlwind,

hausa: Amma cikin wahalarsu suka juya ga Ubangiji, Allah na Isra’ila, suka kuma neme shi, suka kuwa same shi.
english: But when in their distress they turned to Yahweh, the God of Israel, and sought him, he was found by them.

hausa: Daga can suka tashi zuwa Gudgoda, daga Gudgoda kuma suka tafi Yotbata, ƙasa mai rafuffukan ruwa.
english: From there they traveled to Gudgodah; and from Gudgodah to Jotbathah, a land of brooks of water.

hausa: Ya ce, “In kun kasa kunne ga muryar Ubangiji Allahnku kuka yi abin da yake daidai a idanunsa, in kun mai da hankali ga umarnansa, kuka kiyaye dukan farillansa, ba zan kawo muku wani ciwon da na kawo a kan Masarawa ba, gama ni ne Ubangiji da nake warkar da ku.”
english: He said, “If you will diligently listen to Yahweh your God’s voice, and will do that which is right in his eyes, and will pay attention to his commandments, and keep all his statutes, I will put none of the diseases on you which I have put on the Egyptians; for I am Yahweh who heals you.”

hausa: Mugunta zai kashe mugu; za a hukunta abokan gāban adalai.
english: Evil shall kill the wicked. Those who hate the righteous shall be condemned.

hausa: Ni, Tertiyus, wanda ya rubuta wannan wasiƙa, ina gai da ku cikin Ubangiji.
english: I, Tertius, who write the letter, greet you in the Lord.

hausa: Sai Yahuda ya ce wa surukarsa Tamar, “Ki yi zama kamar gwauruwa a gidan mahaifinki sai ɗana Shela ya yi girma.” Gama ya yi tunani, “Shi ma zai mutu, kamar ’yan’uwansa.” Saboda haka Tamar ta je ta zauna a gidan mahaifinta.
english: Then Judah said to Tamar, his daughter-in-law, “Remain a widow in your father’s house, until Shelah, my son, is grown up;” for he said, “Lest he also die, like his brothers.” Tamar went and lived in her father’s house.

hausa: Sai ya kawo ni cikin filin ciki ta ƙofar kudu, ya kuma auna ƙofar kudu; ita ma tana da girma ɗaya da sauran ƙofofin shiga.
english: Then he brought me to the inner court by the south gate. He measured the south gate according to these measurements;

hausa: Kaitona da nake zama a Meshek, da nake zama a ciki tentunan Kedar!
english: Woe is me, that I live in Meshech, that I dwell among the tents of Kedar!

hausa: Sa’an nan suka kama hanya, tsoron Allah kuwa ya kama dukan garuruwan da suke kewayensu har babu wanda ya iya bin su.
english: They traveled, and a terror of God was on the cities that were around them, and they didn’t pursue the sons of Jacob.

hausa: Ba mai karɓe mini rai, ina dai ba da shi. Ina da iko in ba da shi, ina da iko in ɗauko shi kuma. Wannan umarni kuwa daga wurin Ubana na karɓo shi.”
english: No one takes it away from me, but I lay it down by myself. I have power to lay it down, and I have power to take it again. I received this commandment from my Father.”

hausa: Kowa yakan amfana da bunkasar amfanin ƙasa, sarki kansa yana samun riba daga gonaki.
english: Moreover the profit of the earth is for all. The king profits from the field.

hausa: Sai Musa ya zo da Yoshuwa ɗan Nun suka faɗa dukan waɗannan kalmomi wannan waƙa a kunnen mutane.
english: Moses came and spoke all the words of this song in the ears of the people, he and Joshua the son of Nun.

hausa: Abin da mugu ke tsoro shi ne zai same shi; abin da adali ke bukata yakan sami biyan bukata.
english: What the wicked fear will overtake them, but the desire of the righteous will be granted.

hausa: suka haɗa kansu don su yaƙi Yoshuwa da Isra’ila.
english: they gathered themselves together to fight with Joshua and with Israel, with one accord.

hausa: Yana sa su saurari gyara yă kuma umarce su su tuba daga muguntarsu.
english: He also opens their ears to instruction, and commands that they return from iniquity.

hausa: Masarawa za su sani ni ne Ubangiji sa’ad da na sami nasara bisa kan Fir’auna, da keken yaƙinsa, da mahayan dawakansa.”
english: The Egyptians shall know that I am Yahweh when I have gotten myself honor over Pharaoh, over his chariots, and over his horsemen.”

hausa: Filistiyawa suka kira firistoci da bokaye suka ce, “Me za mu yi da akwatin alkawarin Ubangiji? Ku gaya mana yadda za mu komar da shi inda ya fito.”
english: The Philistines called for the priests and the diviners, saying, “What shall we do with Yahweh’s ark? Show us how we should send it to its place.”

hausa: Saboda haka suka ba Yaƙub dukan baƙin allolin da suke da su, da zoban da suke kunnuwansu, sai Yaƙub ya binne su a ƙarƙashin itacen oak a Shekem.
english: They gave to Jacob all the foreign gods which were in their hands, and the rings which were in their ears; and Jacob hid them under the oak which was by Shechem.

hausa: Dattawa da dukan mutane suka amsa, suka ce, “Kada ka saurare shi ko ka yarda da abin da yake bukata.”
english: All the elders and all the people said to him, “Don’t listen, and don’t consent.”

hausa: Dukan waɗanda suka ji shi suka yi mamaki suka ce, “Ba shi ne mutumin da ya tā-da-na-zaune-tsaye a kan masu kira bisa ga wannan sunan a Urushalima ba? Ba ya zo nan ne don yă kai su a matsayin ’yan kurkuku ga manyan firistoci ba?”
english: All who heard him were amazed, and said, “Isn’t this he who in Jerusalem made havoc of those who called on this name? And he had come here intending to bring them bound before the chief priests!”

hausa: amma waɗanda suka dogara ga Ubangiji za su sabunta ƙarfinsu. Za su yi firiya da fikafikai kamar gaggafa; za su kuma yi gudu ba kuwa za su gaji ba, za su yi tafiya ba kuwa za su kasala ba.
english: but those who wait for Yahweh will renew their strength. They will mount up with wings like eagles. They will run, and not be weary. They will walk, and not faint.

hausa: “Duba, abokin gāba ya cika da ɗaga kai; sha’awarsa ba daidai ba ce, amma mai adalci zai rayu ta wurin bangaskiyarsa,
english: Behold, his soul is puffed up. It is not upright in him, but the righteous will live by his faith.

hausa: Ba ku sani ba cewa mugaye ba za su gāji mulkin Allah ba? Kada fa a ruɗe ku. Ba masu fasikanci ko masu bautar gumaka ko masu zina ko karuwan maza, ko ’yan daudu,
english: Or don’t you know that the unrighteous will not inherit God’s Kingdom? Don’t be deceived. Neither the sexually immoral, nor idolaters, nor adulterers, nor male prostitutes, nor homosexuals,

hausa: amma in kuka yi tsayayya kuka kuma yi tayarwa, za a kashe ku da takobi.” Ni Ubangiji na faɗa.
english: but if you refuse and rebel, you will be devoured with the sword; for Yahweh’s mouth has spoken it.”

hausa: Manyan mutanen al’ummai sun taru a matsayin mutanen Allah na Ibrahim, gama sarkunan duniya na Allah ne; ana ɗaukaka shi ƙwarai.
english: The princes of the peoples are gathered together, the people of the God of Abraham. For the shields of the earth belong to God. He is greatly exalted!

hausa: Yanzu an shuka ta a hamada, a busasshiyar ƙasa marar ruwa.
english: Now it is planted in the wilderness, in a dry and thirsty land.

hausa: An yi hayarsa don yă sa in ji tsoro in yi zunubi ta yin haka, sa’an nan za su ba ni mugun suna, su wofinta ni.
english: He was hired so that I would be afraid, do so, and sin, and that they might have material for an evil report, that they might reproach me.

hausa: Sa’ad da sarauniyar Sheba ta ji shahararr Solomon, sai ta zo Urushalima tă gwada shi da tambayoyi masu wuya. Ta iso tare da ayari mai girma, da raƙuma ɗauke da kayan yaji, zinariya mai yawa, da kuma duwatsu masu daraja, ta zo wurin Solomon ta kuma yi magana da shi game da dukan abin da yake zuciyarta.
english: When the queen of Sheba heard of the fame of Solomon, she came to test Solomon with hard questions at Jerusalem, with a very great caravan, including camels that bore spices, gold in abundance, and precious stones. When she had come to Solomon, she talked with him about all that was in her heart.

hausa: Mutanen Sodom kuwa mugaye ne, sun aikata zunubi ƙwarai ga Ubangiji.
english: Now the men of Sodom were exceedingly wicked and sinners against Yahweh.

hausa: Da jin haka, da yawa daga cikin almajiransa suka ce, “Wannan koyarwa tana da wuya. Wa zai iya yarda da ita?”
english: Therefore many of his disciples, when they heard this, said, “This is a hard saying! Who can listen to it?”

hausa: zinariya da azurfa, tagulla da ƙarfe, masu sana’a waɗanda suka wuce ƙirge. Yanzu ka fara aiki, Ubangiji kuma ya kasance tare da kai.”
english: of the gold, the silver, the bronze, and the iron, there is no number. Arise and be doing, and may Yahweh be with you.”

hausa: Mutane da yawa suka kwaɓe shi, suka ce yă yi shiru, amma ya ƙara ɗaga murya yana cewa, “Ɗan Dawuda, ka yi mini jinƙai!”
english: Many rebuked him, that he should be quiet, but he cried out much more, “You son of David, have mercy on me!”

hausa: Babu mabukata a cikinsu. Lokaci-lokaci waɗanda suke da gonaki ko gidaje sukan sayar da su, su kawo kuɗi daga abin da suka sayar,
english: For neither was there among them any who lacked, for as many as were owners of lands or houses sold them, and brought the proceeds of the things that were sold,

hausa: Ubangiji ya aiki maharan Babiloniyawa, da na Arameyawa, da na Mowabawa, da na Ammonawa. Ya aike su su hallaka Yahuda bisa ga maganar Ubangiji wadda ya furta ta bakin bayinsa annabawa.
english: Yahweh sent against him bands of the Chaldeans, bands of the Syrians, bands of the Moabites, and bands of the children of Ammon, and sent them against Judah to destroy it, according to Yahweh’s word which he spoke by his servants the prophets.

hausa: Sai tsuntsaye masu cin nama suka sauko a kan gawawwakin, amma Abram ya kore su.
english: The birds of prey came down on the carcasses, and Abram drove them away.

hausa: hannun Ubangiji zai kawo muguwar annoba a kan dabbobinka a gona, a kan dawakanka, da jakuna da raƙuma, da kuma a kan shanunka da tumaki da awaki.
english: behold, Yahweh’s hand is on your livestock which are in the field, on the horses, on the donkeys, on the camels, on the herds, and on the flocks with a very grievous pestilence.

hausa: Sa’an nan Yowab ya busa ƙaho, sai sojoji suka bar fafaran Isra’ila, gama Yowab ya tsai da su.
english: Joab blew the trumpet, and the people returned from pursuing after Israel; for Joab held the people back.

hausa: Ba ku san cewa tsarkaka ne za su yi wa duniya shari’a ba? In kuwa za ku yi wa duniya shari’a, ai, kun isa ku yi shari’a a kan ƙananan damuwoyi ke nan.
english: Don’t you know that the saints will judge the world? And if the world is judged by you, are you unworthy to judge the smallest matters?

hausa: Ka tashi, ya Allah, ka kāre muradinka; ka tuna yadda wawaye suka yi maka ba’a dukan yini.
english: Arise, God! Plead your own cause. Remember how the foolish man mocks you all day.

hausa: Gama fushina ya kama wuta, tana ci har ƙurewar zurfin lahira. Za tă cinye duniya da girbinta, tă kuma sa wuta a tussan duwatsu.
english: For a fire is kindled in my anger, that burns to the lowest Sheol, devours the earth with its increase, and sets the foundations of the mountains on fire.

hausa: ya cika mana, mu zuriyarsu, ta wurin tā da Yesu daga matattu. Kamar yadda yake a rubuce a cikin Zabura ta biyu cewa, “ ‘Kai Ɗana ne, yau na zama Uba a gare ka.’
english: that God has fulfilled this to us, their children, in that he raised up Jesus. As it is also written in the second psalm, ‘You are my Son. Today I have become your father.’

hausa: “ ‘A ranar Asabbaci, za a miƙa ’yan raguna biyu, bana ɗaya-ɗaya marasa lahani, tare da hadaya ta sha, da hadaya ta lallausan gari kashi biyu bisa goma na efa, kwaɓaɓɓe da mai.
english: “‘On the Sabbath day, you shall offer two male lambs a year old without defect, and two tenths of an ephah of fine flour for a meal offering mixed with oil, and its drink offering:

hausa: Amma ku abokaina ƙaunatattu, ku tuna da abin da manzannin Ubangijinmu Yesu Kiristi suka faɗa a dā.
english: But you, beloved, remember the words which have been spoken before by the apostles of our Lord Jesus Christ.

hausa: In za ka aika da ɗan’uwanmu tare da mu, za mu gangara mu sayo maka abinci.
english: If you’ll send our brother with us, we’ll go down and buy you food;

hausa: Tare da Allah za mu yi nasara, zai kuma tattaka abokan gābanmu.
english: Through God, we will do valiantly, for it is he who will tread down our enemies.

hausa: A ranan nan kin tsaya kawai kina zuba ido yayinda baƙi suke washe dukiyar ɗan’uwanki, baƙi kuma suka shiga ta ƙofofinsa suka jefa ƙuri’a don a rarraba Urushalima, kin tsaya kina kallo kamar ɗaya daga cikin abokan gābansa.
english: In the day that you stood on the other side, in the day that strangers carried away his substance and foreigners entered into his gates and cast lots for Jerusalem, even you were like one of them.

hausa: A wannan lokaci, Yesu, cike da murna ta wurin Ruhu Mai Tsarki ya ce, “Na yabe ka, ya Uba, Ubangijin sama da ƙasa, domin ka ɓoye waɗannan abubuwa ga masu hikima, da masu ilimi, ka kuma bayyana su ga ƙananan yara. I, ya Uba, gama wannan shi ne nufinka mai kyau.
english: In that same hour, Jesus rejoiced in the Holy Spirit, and said, “I thank you, O Father, Lord of heaven and earth, that you have hidden these things from the wise and understanding, and revealed them to little children. Yes, Father, for so it was well-pleasing in your sight.”

hausa: Ku yi tsayayya da shi, kuna tsayawa daram cikin bangaskiya, domin kun san cewa ’yan’uwanku ko’ina a duniya suna shan irin wahalolin nan.
english: Withstand him steadfast in your faith, knowing that your brothers who are in the world are undergoing the same sufferings.

hausa: Shema shi ne mahaifin Raham, Raham kuma shi ne mahaifin Yorkeyam. Rekem shi ne mahaifin Shammai.
english: Shema became the father of Raham, the father of Jorkeam; and Rekem became the father of Shammai.

hausa: Amma sa’ad da shi, Ruhun gaskiya ya zo, zai bi da ku zuwa ga dukan gaskiya. Ba zai yi magana don kansa ba; zai faɗi abin da ya ji ne kaɗai, zai kuma faɗa muku abin da bai faru ba tukuna.
english: However, when he, the Spirit of truth, has come, he will guide you into all truth, for he will not speak from himself; but whatever he hears, he will speak. He will declare to you things that are coming.

hausa: Saboda haka bayin suka bi titi-titi, suka tattaro duk mutanen da suka samu, masu kirki da marasa kirki, zauren bikin ya cika makil da baƙi.
english: Those servants went out into the highways and gathered together as many as they found, both bad and good. The wedding was filled with guests.

hausa: Ya raba mutum ɗari uku ɗin kashi uku, ya ba kowannensu ƙaho da tulu da acibalbal a ciki.
english: He divided the three hundred men into three companies, and he put into the hands of all of them trumpets and empty pitchers, with torches within the pitchers.

hausa: Noga, Nefeg, Yafiya,
english: Nogah, Nepheg, Japhia,

hausa: Daga sa’a ta shida, har zuwa sa’a ta tara, duhu ya rufe ƙasa duka.
english: Now from the sixth hour there was darkness over all the land until the ninth hour.

hausa: Mun miƙa kanmu ga Masar da Assuriya don mu sami isashen abinci.
english: We have given our hands to the Egyptians, and to the Assyrians, to be satisfied with bread.

hausa: Ba magana, ba kalmar da aka hurta, ba wani amon da aka ji daga gare su.
english: There is no speech nor language where their voice is not heard.

hausa: sai Fir’auna ya tambaye shi, “Shekarunka nawa da haihuwa?”
english: Pharaoh said to Jacob, “How old are you?”

hausa: In kuwa na alheri ne, ba sauran cewa ya dogara ga ayyuka ke nan. In ba haka ba, ashe, alheri ba alheri ba ne kuma.
english: And if by grace, then it is no longer of works; otherwise grace is no longer grace. But if it is of works, it is no longer grace; otherwise work is no longer work.

hausa: Allah, “Zai sāka wa kowane mutum gwargwadon aikin da ya yi.”
english: who “will pay back to everyone according to their works:”

hausa: Yashi mai ƙuna zai zama tafki, ƙeƙasasshiyar ƙasa kuma za tă cika da maɓulɓulan rafuffuka. A mazaunin diloli, inda suka taɓa zama, ciyawa da iwa da kyauro za su yi girma.
english: The burning sand will become a pool, and the thirsty ground springs of water. Grass with reeds and rushes will be in the habitation of jackals, where they lay.

hausa: Sa’ad da suka kai masussukar Atad, kusa da Urdun, sai suka yi kuka da ƙarfi da kuma mai zafi, a can Yusuf ya yi makoki kwana bakwai saboda mahaifinsa.
english: They came to the threshing floor of Atad, which is beyond the Jordan, and there they lamented with a very great and severe lamentation. He mourned for his father seven days.

hausa: da shanu biyu, raguna biyar, bunsurai biyar da kuma ’yan raguna biyar, dukansu bana ɗaya-ɗaya, a miƙa su hadaya ta salama. Wannan ita ce hadayar Ahiyezer ɗan Ammishaddai.
english: and for the sacrifice of peace offerings, two head of cattle, five rams, five male goats, and five male lambs a year old. This was the offering of Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai.

hausa: Sukan auka kamar jarumawa; sukan hau katanga kamar sojoji. Kowa yana takawa bisa ga tsari, ba mai kaucewa.
english: They run like mighty men. They climb the wall like warriors. They each march in his line, and they don’t swerve off course.

hausa: Dukan al’ummai sun kewaye ni, amma a cikin sunan Ubangiji na hallaka su.
english: All the nations surrounded me, but in Yahweh’s name I cut them off.

hausa: Ubangiji ya yi magana da Musa bayan mutuwar ’ya’yan Haruna biyu maza waɗanda suka mutu sa’ad da suka kusaci Ubangiji.
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses after the death of the two sons of Aaron, when they came near before Yahweh, and died;

hausa: Da almajiran nan biyu suka ji ya faɗi haka, sai suka bi Yesu.
english: The two disciples heard him speak, and they followed Jesus.

hausa: Da aka gaya wa Dawuda abin da Rizfa ’yar Aiya ƙwarƙwaran Shawulu ta yi,
english: David was told what Rizpah the daughter of Aiah, the concubine of Saul, had done.

hausa: Mutanen da suke gadin Yesu suka fara masa ba’a da dūka.
english: The men who held Jesus mocked him and beat him.

hausa: Saboda haka ga abin da Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka ya ce, “Duba, na kafa dutse a Sihiyona, dutsen da aka gwada, dutsen kusurwa mai daraja don tabbataccen tushe; wanda ya dogara gare shi ba zai taɓa shan kunya ba.
english: Therefore the Lord Yahweh says, “Behold, I lay in Zion for a foundation a stone, a tried stone, a precious cornerstone of a sure foundation. He who believes shall not act hastily.

hausa: Waɗannan abubuwa ne nakan tuna sa’ad da nake faɗin abin da yake a raina, yadda dā nakan tafi tare da taron jama’a, ina bishe su a jere zuwa gidan Allah, da sowa ta farin ciki da kuma godiya a cikin taron biki.
english: These things I remember, and pour out my soul within me, how I used to go with the crowd, and led them to God’s house, with the voice of joy and praise, a multitude keeping a holy day.

hausa: Ya umarce su ya ce, “Ku bi ni, gama Ubangiji ya ba Mowab abokin gābanku a hannunku.” Haka suka gangaro tare da shi suna mallaki mashigin Urdun da ta shiga zuwa Mowab, ba su yarda wani ya haye ba.
english: He said to them, “Follow me; for Yahweh has delivered your enemies the Moabites into your hand.” They followed him, and took the fords of the Jordan against the Moabites, and didn’t allow any man to pass over.

hausa: Sai dukan Masarawa suka yi ta tonon gefen Nilu don su sami ruwan sha, domin ba su iya shan ruwan kogin ba.
english: All the Egyptians dug around the river for water to drink; for they couldn’t drink the river water.

hausa: Mazan aure, ku ma, ku yi zaman sanin ya kamata yayinda kuke zama da matanku, ku girmama su a matsayin abokan zama marasa ƙarfi da kuma a matsayin magādan kyautar rai na alheri tare da ku, don kada wani abu yă hana addu’o’inku.
english: You husbands, in the same way, live with your wives according to knowledge, giving honor to the woman as to the weaker vessel, as also being joint heirs of the grace of life, that your prayers may not be hindered.

hausa: A rana ta goma sha huɗu ga watan farko, sai waɗanda suka dawo daga bauta suka yi Bikin Ƙetarewa.
english: The children of the captivity kept the Passover on the fourteenth day of the first month.

hausa: Sai Sarki Solomon ya yi mulki a bisa dukan Isra’ila.
english: King Solomon was king over all Israel.

hausa: Solomon ya yi mulki a Urushalima, a bisa dukan Isra’ila, shekaru arba’in.
english: The time that Solomon reigned in Jerusalem over all Israel was forty years.

hausa: (Amma ya zama wa mutanen kabilar Dan da wahala su mallaki ƙasar da aka ba su gādo, saboda haka sai suka nufi Leshem suka ci su da yaƙi, suka karkashe mutanen wurin, suka mallake ta, suka zauna a ciki. Suka kuma sa wa Leshem, sunan kakansu, wato, Dan.)
english: The border of the children of Dan went out beyond them; for the children of Dan went up and fought against Leshem, and took it, and struck it with the edge of the sword, and possessed it, and lived therein, and called Leshem, Dan, after the name of Dan their forefather.

hausa: Ina faɗin wannan bisa ga ra’ayin mutum kawai ne? Ashe, Doka ma ba tă faɗa haka ba?
english: Do I speak these things according to the ways of men? Or doesn’t the law also say the same thing?

hausa: Shi ne mai ƙarfi da kuma mai nasara; mai ruɗi da wanda aka ruɗa, duk nasa ne.
english: With him is strength and wisdom. The deceived and the deceiver are his.

hausa: gama ko sa’ad da nake a Tessalonika ma, kun aiko mini da taimako sau da sau sa’ad da nake cikin bukata.
english: For even in Thessalonica you sent once and again to my need.

hausa: Bai kuwa yi abubuwan banmamaki da yawa a can ba saboda rashin bangaskiyarsu.
english: He didn’t do many mighty works there because of their unbelief.

hausa: Kafin ’yan leƙen asirin su kwanta, sai ta tafi wurinsu a bisa rufin ɗakin
english: Before they had lain down, she came up to them on the roof.

hausa: Saboda haka ku yi farin ciki, ku sammai, da ku da kuke zaune a cikinsu! Amma kaiton duniya da kuma teku, gama Iblis ya sauko gare ku! Ya cika da fushi, domin ya san cewa lokacinsa ya rage kaɗan.”
english: Therefore rejoice, heavens, and you who dwell in them. Woe to the earth and to the sea, because the devil has gone down to you, having great wrath, knowing that he has but a short time.”

hausa: Da Azuba ta mutu, Kaleb ya auri Efrat, wadda ta haifa masa Hur.
english: Azubah died, and Caleb married Ephrath, who bore him Hur.

hausa: Suna magana game da kai da mugun nufi; maƙiyanka suna ɗaukan sunanka a banza.
english: For they speak against you wickedly. Your enemies take your name in vain.

hausa: Kakan nuna wa matattu ayyukanka na banmamaki ne? Waɗanda suka mutu sukan tashi su yabe ka ne? Sela
english: Do you show wonders to the dead? Do the departed spirits rise up and praise you? Selah.

hausa: Saboda haka zan ba shi rabo tare da manya, zai kuma raba ganima tare da masu ƙarfi, domin ya ba da ransa har mutuwa, aka kuma lissafta shi tare da masu laifofi. Gama ya ɗauki zunubin mutane masu yawa, ya kuma yi roƙo saboda laifofinsu.
english: Therefore I will give him a portion with the great. He will divide the plunder with the strong, because he poured out his soul to death and was counted with the transgressors; yet he bore the sins of many and made intercession for the transgressors.

hausa: “Ka umarci Isra’ilawa su kawo tsabtataccen mai, tatacce daga zaitun domin fitilu, saboda fitilun su yi ta ci a koyaushe.
english: “You shall command the children of Israel, that they bring to you pure olive oil beaten for the light, to cause a lamp to burn continually.

hausa: talenti dubu uku na zinariya (zinariyar Ofir) da tacecciyar azurfa dubu bakwai; don adon bangon gine-ginen,
english: even three thousand talents of gold, of the gold of Ophir, and seven thousand talents of refined silver, with which to overlay the walls of the houses;

hausa: Na ce wa kaina, “Ubangiji shi ne nawa; saboda haka zan jira shi.”
english: “Yahweh is my portion,” says my soul. “Therefore I will hope in him.”

hausa: A rana ta goma sha biyu, Ahira ɗan Enan, shugaban mutanen Naftali, ya kawo hadayarsa.
english: On the twelfth day Ahira the son of Enan, prince of the children of Naphtali,

hausa: Ya umarci manzon ya ce, “Da ka gama yin wa sarki wannan batun yaƙin,
english: and he commanded the messenger, saying, “When you have finished telling all the things concerning the war to the king,

hausa: “Kada ka kama! Kada ka ɗanɗana! Kada ka taɓa”?
english: “Don’t handle, nor taste, nor touch”

hausa: ’Ya’yan Ibrahim maza su ne, Ishaku da Ishmayel.
english: The sons of Abraham: Isaac and Ishmael.

hausa: Amma na ce, “A, Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka, annabawa sun riƙa ce musu, ‘Ba za ku ga takobi ko ku yi fama da yunwa ba. A maimako, zan ba ku madawwamiyar salama.’ ”
english: Then I said, “Ah, Lord Yahweh! Behold, the prophets tell them, ‘You will not see the sword, neither will you have famine; but I will give you assured peace in this place.’”

hausa: Tana haurawa wurinsu ke nan a wannan lokaci, sai ta yi wa Allah godiya ta kuma yi magana game da yaron nan ga dukan waɗanda suke sauraron fansar Urushalima.
english: Coming up at that very hour, she gave thanks to the Lord, and spoke of him to all those who were looking for redemption in Jerusalem.

hausa: Zan kāre birnin nan in cece ta, saboda kaina da kuma bawana Dawuda.”
english: ‘For I will defend this city to save it, for my own sake and for my servant David’s sake.’”

hausa: Shawulu ya gane muryar Dawuda, sai ya ce, “Muryarka ke nan ɗana Dawuda?” Dawuda ya ce, “I, muryata ce ya ranka yă daɗe, sarki.”
english: Saul recognized David’s voice, and said, “Is this your voice, my son David?” David said, “It is my voice, my lord, O king.”

hausa: Haruna zai jefa ƙuri’a don awaki biyun ɗin, ƙuri’a ɗaya domin Ubangiji, ɗayan kuma don azazel
english: Aaron shall cast lots for the two goats: one lot for Yahweh, and the other lot for the scapegoat.

hausa: Sai na yi tunani a kan wannan na kuma gane cewa masu adalci da masu hikima da kuma abubuwan da suke yi suna a hannun Allah ne, amma ba wanda ya san ko ƙauna ko ƙiyayya ce take jiransa.
english: For all this I laid to my heart, even to explore all this: that the righteous, and the wise, and their works, are in the hand of God; whether it is love or hatred, man doesn’t know it; all is before them.

hausa: Zuriyar Gershom su ne, Shebuwel ne ɗan fari.
english: The sons of Gershom: Shebuel the chief.

hausa: Saboda haka suka kawo dabbobinsu wa Yusuf, ya kuma ba su abinci a madadin dawakai, tumaki da awaki, shanu da jakunansu. Ya kuwa ba su abinci a madadin dabbobinsu, a wannan shekara.
english: They brought their livestock to Joseph, and Joseph gave them bread in exchange for the horses, and for the flocks, and for the herds, and for the donkeys: and he fed them with bread in exchange for all their livestock for that year.

hausa: in na ɓoye zunubina yadda mutane suke yi, ta wurin ɓoye laifina a cikin zuciyata,
english: if like Adam I have covered my transgressions, by hiding my iniquity in my heart,

hausa: Halitta tana jira da marmari ta ƙosa ta ga bayyanuwar ’ya’yan Allah.
english: For the creation waits with eager expectation for the children of God to be revealed.

hausa: Ba ka kāre shi da iyalinsa gaba ɗaya da duk mallakarsa ba? Ka Albarkaci ayyukan hannunsa yadda dabbobinsa duk sun cika ko’ina.
english: Haven’t you made a hedge around him, and around his house, and around all that he has, on every side? You have blessed the work of his hands, and his substance is increased in the land.

hausa: Kowace hadaya ta gari ta firist, za a ƙone ta ƙurmus, ba za a ci ba.”
english: Every meal offering of a priest shall be wholly burned. It shall not be eaten.”

hausa: Kuna cike da muguwar sha’awa mai ƙonawa a cikin itatuwan oak da kuma a ƙarƙashin kowane itace mai inuwa; kuna miƙa hadayar ’ya’yanku a rafuffuka da kuma a ƙarƙashin tsagaggun duwatsu.
english: you who inflame yourselves among the oaks, under every green tree; who kill the children in the valleys, under the clefts of the rocks?

hausa: Mutane kan yi allolinsu ne? I, amma waɗannan ba alloli ba ne!”
english: Should a man make to himself gods which yet are no gods?”

hausa: Saboda haka nake jure kome saboda zaɓaɓɓu, domin su ma su sami ceton da yake cikin Kiristi Yesu, tare da madawwamiyar ɗaukaka.
english: Therefore I endure all things for the chosen ones’ sake, that they also may obtain the salvation which is in Christ Jesus with eternal glory.

hausa: “ ‘Amma ku, ya duwatsun Isra’ila, za ku miƙa rassanku ku ba da amfani ga mutanena Isra’ila, gama ba da daɗewa ba za su komo gida.
english: “‘“But you, mountains of Israel, you shall shoot out your branches and yield your fruit to my people Israel; for they are at hand to come.

hausa: “Ka ɗauki ɗaya daga cikin ragunan, Haruna kuwa da ’ya’yan maza za su ɗora hannuwansa a kansa.
english: “You shall also take the one ram, and Aaron and his sons shall lay their hands on the head of the ram.

hausa: Duniya ta ƙazantu ta wurin mutanenta sun ƙi yin biyayya da dokoki, sun keta farillai suka kuma karya madawwamin alkawari.
english: The earth also is polluted under its inhabitants, because they have transgressed the laws, violated the statutes, and broken the everlasting covenant.

hausa: Ya tsage duwatsu a cikin hamada ya kuma ba su ruwaye a yalwace kamar tekuna;
english: He split rocks in the wilderness, and gave them drink abundantly as out of the depths.

hausa: da Ayin, da Yutta, da kuma Bet-Shemesh, tare da wuraren kiwonsu, garuruwa tara ke nan daga kabilun nan biyu, Yahuda da Simeyon.
english: Ain with its pasture lands, Juttah with its pasture lands, and Beth Shemesh with its pasture lands: nine cities out of those two tribes.

hausa: Ayuba kuwa ya ci gaba da magana,
english: Job again took up his parable, and said,

hausa: Sai na tambayi mala’ikan da yake magana da ni na ce, “Mene ne waɗannan, ranka yă daɗe?”
english: Then I asked the angel who talked with me, “What are these, my lord?”

hausa: Bayan kwana biyu zai rayar da mu, a rana ta uku zai tashe mu, don mu rayu a gabansa.
english: After two days he will revive us. On the third day he will raise us up, and we will live before him.

hausa: Da lokacin mutuwar Dawuda ya yi kusa, sai ya gargaɗe Solomon ɗansa, ya ce,
english: Now the days of David came near that he should die; and he commanded Solomon his son, saying,

hausa: Kwana bakwai za ku miƙa hadayun da aka yi da wuta ga Ubangiji, a rana ta takwas, ku yi taro mai tsarki, ku kuma miƙa hadayar da aka yi da wuta ga Ubangiji. Wannan ranar rufewar taro ce; kada ku yi aiki na kullum.
english: Seven days you shall offer an offering made by fire to Yahweh. On the eighth day shall be a holy convocation to you. You shall offer an offering made by fire to Yahweh. It is a solemn assembly; you shall do no regular work.

hausa: Ubangiji ya ce wa Shaiɗan, “Daga ina ka fito?” Shaiɗan ya amsa wa Ubangiji ya ce, “Daga yawo a duniya ina kai da kawowa a cikinta.”
english: Yahweh said to Satan, “Where have you come from?” Then Satan answered Yahweh, and said, “From going back and forth on the earth, and from walking up and down in it.”

hausa: Amma ina tambaya, “Ba su ji ba ne? Tabbatacce sun ji. “Muryarsu ta tafi ko’ina a cikin duniya, kalmominsu kuma har iyakar duniya.”
english: But I say, didn’t they hear? Yes, most certainly, “Their sound went out into all the earth, their words to the ends of the world.”

hausa: Aka ba zuriyar Gershom, gida-gida, rabon garuruwa goma sha uku daga kabilan Issakar, Asher da Naftali, da kuma daga sashen rabi kabilar Manasse da yake a Bashan.
english: To the sons of Gershom, according to their families, out of the tribe of Issachar, and out of the tribe of Asher, and out of the tribe of Naphtali, and out of the tribe of Manasseh in Bashan, thirteen cities.

hausa: Sa’an nan ka ce, ‘Haka Babilon za tă nutse, ba za tă ƙara tashi ba saboda masifar da zan kawo mata. Mutanenta kuwa za su fāɗi.’ ” Wannan shi ne ƙarshen kalmomin Irmiya.
english: Then you shall say, ‘Thus will Babylon sink, and will not rise again because of the evil that I will bring on her; and they will be weary.’” Thus far are the words of Jeremiah.

hausa: Kai mai gafartawa da kuma mai alheri ne, ya Ubangiji, cike da ƙauna ga dukan waɗanda suke kira gare ka.
english: For you, Lord, are good, and ready to forgive, abundant in loving kindness to all those who call on you.

hausa: Kash, da za a gwada Ayuba har ƙarshe, domin yana ba da amsa kamar mugun mutum.
english: I wish that Job were tried to the end, because of his answering like wicked men.

hausa: Ga wasiƙar da sarki Artazerzes ya ba Ezra wanda yake firist da kuma malami, mutumin da yake cike da sani game da dokoki da kuma umarnan Ubangiji wa Isra’ila.
english: Now this is the copy of the letter that King Artaxerxes gave to Ezra the priest, the scribe, even the scribe of the words of Yahweh’s commandments, and of his statutes to Israel:

hausa: Saboda haka Bezalel, Oholiyab da kowane mutumin da Ubangiji ya ba shi basira da iyawa, na sanin yadda za a yi duk aikin shirya wuri mai tsarki, za su yi aiki yadda Ubangiji ya umarta.”
english: “Bezalel and Oholiab shall work with every wise-hearted man, in whom Yahweh has put wisdom and understanding to know how to do all the work for the service of the sanctuary, according to all that Yahweh has commanded.”

hausa: Mala’ikan da ya yi magana da ni yana da sandan awo na zinariya don awon birnin, ƙofofinsa, da kuma katangarsa.
english: He who spoke with me had for a measure a golden reed to measure the city, its gates, and its walls.

hausa: Wannan ita ce albarkar da Musa mutumin Allah ya furta a kan Isra’ilawa, kafin yă rasu.
english: This is the blessing with which Moses the man of God blessed the children of Israel before his death.

hausa: Tabbatacce, ku ne ɗaukakarmu da kuma farin cikinmu.
english: For you are our glory and our joy.

hausa: Ka rikitar da mugaye, ya Ubangiji, ka birkitar da maganarsu, gama na ga rikici da faɗa a cikin birni.
english: Confuse them, Lord, and confound their language, for I have seen violence and strife in the city.

hausa: Sa’an nan ya ɗauki Littafin Alkawari ya karanta wa mutane. Suka amsa suka ce, “Za mu yi duk abin da Ubangiji ya faɗa; za mu yi biyayya.”
english: He took the book of the covenant and read it in the hearing of the people, and they said, “We will do all that Yahweh has said, and be obedient.”

hausa: “Abin da ya rage a kowane gefe na wurin zai zama tsattsarkan rabo kuma mallakar birnin za tă zama ta sarki. Zai miƙe wajen gabas daga kamu 25,000 na tsattsarkan rabo zuwa iyakar da take wajen gabashin iyaka, da kuma a wajen yamma kamu 25,000 zuwa iyakar da take a wajen yamma. Dukan wuraren nan da suke hannun riga da rabon kabilan zai zama na sarki, tsattsarkan rabon tare da wuri mai tsarkin za su kasance a tsakiyarsu.
english: “The remainder shall be for the prince, on the one side and on the other of the holy offering and of the possession of the city; in front of the twenty-five thousand of the offering toward the east border, and westward in front of the twenty-five thousand toward the west border, alongside the portions, it shall be for the prince. The holy offering and the sanctuary of the house shall be in the middle of it.

hausa: Da Hushai ya zo wurinsa, sai Absalom ya ce, “Ahitofel ya ba da wannan shawara. Mu yi abin da ya ce? In ba haka ba, sai ka ba mu ra’ayinka.”
english: When Hushai had come to Absalom, Absalom spoke to him, saying, “Ahithophel has spoken like this. Shall we do what he says? If not, speak up.”

hausa: Ta Dawuda. Zabura ce. Ubangiji ya ce wa Ubangijina, “Zauna a hannun damana, sai na sa abokan gābanka su zama matashin sawunka.”
english: A Psalm by David. Yahweh says to my Lord, “Sit at my right hand, until I make your enemies your footstool for your feet.”

hausa: Annabci, wannan ita ce maganar Ubangiji ga Isra’ila ta wurin Malaki.
english: A revelation, Yahweh’s word to Israel by Malachi.

hausa: Amma da yake fasikanci ya yi yawa, ya kamata kowane mutum yă kasance da matarsa, kowace mace kuma da mijinta.
english: But, because of sexual immoralities, let each man have his own wife, and let each woman have her own husband.

hausa: Amma daga yanzu, Ɗan Mutum zai zauna a hannun dama na Allah Mai Iko.”
english: From now on, the Son of Man will be seated at the right hand of the power of God.”

hausa: “ ‘Kada ka ƙasƙantar da mahaifinka ta wurin kwana da mahaifiyarka. Ita mahaifiyarka ce; kada ka yi jima’i da ita.
english: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father, nor the nakedness of your mother: she is your mother. You shall not uncover her nakedness.

hausa: Sai Shawulu, wanda kuma ake kira Bulus, cike da Ruhu Mai Tsarki, ya kafa wa Elimas ido ya ce,
english: But Saul, who is also called Paul, filled with the Holy Spirit, fastened his eyes on him

hausa: Ina ƙaunar gidan da kake zama, ya Ubangiji, wurin da ɗaukakarka ke zaune.
english: Yahweh, I love the habitation of your house, the place where your glory dwells.

hausa: In gizagizai sun cika da ruwa, sukan zub da ruwan sama bisa duniya. Itace ya fāɗi, ko wajen kudu ne, ko wajen arewa, inda ya fāɗi a nan zai kwanta.
english: If the clouds are full of rain, they empty themselves on the earth; and if a tree falls toward the south, or toward the north, in the place where the tree falls, there shall it be.

hausa: “Mun iske kurkukun a kulle sosai, da masu gadi suna tsaye a bakin ƙofofin; amma da muka buɗe su, sai muka tarar ba kowa a ciki.”
english: “We found the prison shut and locked, and the guards standing before the doors, but when we opened them, we found no one inside!”
