hausa: Duk da haka, da yawa har daga cikin shugabanni ma suka gaskata da shi. Amma saboda Farisiyawa ba su furta bangaskiyarsu ba, don tsoron kada a kore su daga majami’a;
english: Nevertheless, even many of the rulers believed in him, but because of the Pharisees they didn’t confess it, so that they wouldn’t be put out of the synagogue,

hausa: Rahila fa ta kwashe gumakan gidan ta sa su cikin sirdin raƙumi, ta kuma zauna a kansu. Laban ya bincika cikin kowane abu a tentin amma bai sami kome ba.
english: Now Rachel had taken the teraphim, put them in the camel’s saddle, and sat on them. Laban felt around all the tent, but didn’t find them.

hausa: Natan ya ce, “Ranka yă daɗe, sarki, ko ka furta cewa Adoniya ne zai zama sarki a bayanka, yă kuma zauna a kujerar sarautarka?
english: Nathan said, “My lord, King, have you said, ‘Adonijah shall reign after me, and he shall sit on my throne’?

hausa: Zan nemi in san abin da zai ce mini, in kuma auna abin da zai ce mini.
english: I would know the words which he would answer me, and understand what he would tell me.

hausa: Yesu ya tambayi mahaifin yaron ya ce, “Tun yaushe yake haka?” Ya ce, “Tun yana ƙarami.
english: He asked his father, “How long has it been since this has been happening to him?” He said, “From childhood.

hausa: Nibshan, Birnin gishiri da En Gedi, garuruwa shida ke nan da ƙauyukansu.
english: Nibshan, the City of Salt, and En Gedi; six cities with their villages.

hausa: Saboda haka suka kafa wa Absalom tenti a bisa rufin ɗaki, a can ya kwana da ƙwarƙwaran mahaifinsa a gaban dukan Isra’ila.
english: So they spread a tent for Absalom on the top of the house, and Absalom went in to his father’s concubines in the sight of all Israel.

hausa: Lokaci ya yi! Ranar ta gabato! Kada mai saya ya yi farin ciki ko kuwa mai sayarwa ya yi baƙin ciki, gama hasala tana a kan dukan jama’a.
english: The time has come! The day draws near. Don’t let the buyer rejoice, nor the seller mourn; for wrath is on all its multitude.

hausa: Sai Ubangiji ya ce mini, “Annabawa suna ta annabcin ƙarya da sunana. Ban aike su ba, ban kuma naɗa su ba, ban yi musu magana ba. Suna muku annabci wahayin ƙarya, suna muku duba marar amfani, suna bautar gumaka suna kuma bayyana tunanin kansu ne.
english: Then Yahweh said to me, “The prophets prophesy lies in my name. I didn’t send them. I didn’t command them. I didn’t speak to them. They prophesy to you a lying vision, divination, and a thing of nothing, and the deceit of their own heart.

hausa: Wannan zai zama alama a gare ku. Za ku tarar da jariri a nannaɗe a zane kwance a kwami.”
english: This is the sign to you: you will find a baby wrapped in strips of cloth, lying in a feeding trough.”

hausa: Suka tattauna wannan da juna, suna cewa, “Don ba mu da burodi ne.”
english: They reasoned with one another, saying, “It’s because we have no bread.”

hausa: Za a ba da ’ya’yanku maza da mata ga wata al’umma, za ku kuma yi ta zuba idanunku kuna neman su kullayaumi, amma a banza, domin ba ku da ikon yin kome.
english: Your sons and your daughters will be given to another people. Your eyes will look and fail with longing for them all day long. There will be no power in your hand.

hausa: Yanzu na zo domin in bayyana maka abin da zai faru da mutanenka nan gaba, gama wahayin ya shafi lokacin da bai riga ya zo ba ne.”
english: Now I have come to make you understand what will happen to your people in the latter days, for the vision is yet for many days.”

hausa: Ishaya ya riga ya ce, “Ku shirya curin da aka yi da ’ya’yan ɓaure ku kuma shafa a marurun, zai kuwa warke.”
english: Now Isaiah had said, “Let them take a cake of figs, and lay it for a poultice on the boil, and he shall recover.”

hausa: Ka nuna mini hanyoyinka, ya Ubangiji, ka koya mini hanyoyinka;
english: Show me your ways, Yahweh. Teach me your paths.

hausa: Saboda haka Fir’auna ya ce wa Yusuf, “Ga shi na sa ka zama shugaban dukan ƙasar Masar.”
english: Pharaoh said to Joseph, “Behold, I have set you over all the land of Egypt.”

hausa: Duk waɗanda suka ƙetare, waɗanda shekarunsu ya kai ashirin ko fiye, za su ba da hadaya ga Ubangiji.
english: Everyone who passes over to those who are counted, from twenty years old and upward, shall give the offering to Yahweh.

hausa: Sarkin Isra’ila ya amsa, ya ce, “Kamar dai yadda ka faɗa, ranka yă daɗe, sarki. Ni da dukan abin da nake da shi, naka ne.”
english: The king of Israel answered, “It is according to your saying, my lord, O king. I am yours, and all that I have.”

hausa: In ka ƙi barinsu, zan hore ka da annoban kwaɗi a dukan ƙasarka.
english: If you refuse to let them go, behold, I will plague all your borders with frogs.

hausa: Suka ce, “In mun sami tagomashi daga gare ka bari a ba da wannan ƙasa ga bayinka, tă zama mallakanmu. Kada ka sa mu haye Urdun.”
english: They said, “If we have found favor in your sight, let this land be given to your servants for a possession. Don’t bring us over the Jordan.”

hausa: Waɗannan su ne ƙa’idodi game da cutar fatar jiki na rigar ulu, ko rigar lilin, tariyar zare, ko kayan da aka saƙa, ko kuwa duk wani abin da aka yi da fata, don furta su tsarkakakke, ko kuwa marar tsarki.
english: This is the law of the plague of mildew in a garment of wool or linen, either in the warp, or the woof, or in anything of skin, to pronounce it clean, or to pronounce it unclean.

hausa: “Ku yi shela a Yahuda ku kuma furta a Urushalima ku ce, ‘Ku busa ƙaho a ko’ina a ƙasar!’ Ku tā da murya da ƙarfi ku ce, ‘Ku tattaru! Bari mu gudu zuwa birane masu katanga!’
english: Declare in Judah, and publish in Jerusalem; and say, ‘Blow the trumpet in the land!’ Cry aloud and say, ‘Assemble yourselves! Let’s go into the fortified cities!’

hausa: Tagullar ginshiƙai biyun nan, da ta ƙaton kwanon da ake ce da shi Teku, da ta dukan amalanke masu riƙe ruwa waɗanda Sarki Solomon ya yi domin haikalin Ubangiji, sun fi gaba a auna su.
english: The two pillars, the one sea, and the bases, which Solomon had made for Yahweh’s house, the bronze of all these vessels was not weighed.

hausa: Gera, Shefufan da Huram.
english: Gera, Shephuphan, and Huram.

hausa: Sa’an nan Abimelek ya ce, “Me ke nan ka yi mana? Da a ce wani daga mazanmu ya kwana da matarka, ai, da ka jawo laifi a kanmu.”
english: Abimelech said, “What is this you have done to us? One of the people might easily have lain with your wife, and you would have brought guilt on us!”

hausa: Amma Yesu ya ce, “Wani ya taɓa ni, na san cewa iko ya fita daga wurina.”
english: But Jesus said, “Someone did touch me, for I perceived that power has gone out of me.”

hausa: Ita kamar jirgin ’yan kasuwa ne tana kawo abincinta daga nesa.
english: She is like the merchant ships. She brings her bread from afar.

hausa: Hadayun hatsi da hadayun sha an yanke su daga gidan Ubangiji. Firistoci suna makoki, su waɗanda suke yi wa Ubangiji hidima.
english: The meal offering and the drink offering are cut off from Yahweh’s house. The priests, Yahweh’s ministers, mourn.

hausa: Halittun suna gaggauta kai da kawowa kamar walƙiya.
english: The living creatures ran and returned as the appearance of a flash of lightning.

hausa: Gaskiya nake gaya muku, duk wanda ya ba ku ruwan sha a sunana, saboda ku na Kiristi ne, lalle, ba zai rasa ladarsa ba.
english: For whoever will give you a cup of water to drink in my name because you are Christ’s, most certainly I tell you, he will in no way lose his reward.

hausa: Ku yi kuka, ku ce, “Cece mu, ya Allah Mai Cetonmu; tara mu ka kuma cece mu daga al’ummai, don mu yi godiya ga sunanka mai tsarki, don mu ɗaukaka a cikin yabonka.”
english: Say, “Save us, God of our salvation! Gather us together and deliver us from the nations, to give thanks to your holy name, to triumph in your praise.”

hausa: Na kuma ji, amma ban fahimta ba. Don haka sai na yi tambaya, “Ranka yă daɗe, mene ne ƙarshen waɗannan abubuwa?”
english: I heard, but I didn’t understand. Then I said, “My lord, what will be the outcome of these things?”

hausa: Ubangiji ya ce wa Musa,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

hausa: Daga wurin Ubangiji ne ceto kan zo. Bari albarkanka yă kasance a kan mutanenka. Sela
english: Salvation belongs to Yahweh. May your blessing be on your people. Selah.

hausa: Dukanmu mun zama kamar wanda yake marar tsabta, kuma dukan ayyukanmu masu adalci sun zama kamar ƙazaman tsummoki; duk mun zama kamar busasshen ganye, kamar iska haka zunubanmu sukan share mu.
english: For we have all become like one who is unclean, and all our righteousness is like a polluted garment. We all fade like a leaf; and our iniquities, like the wind, take us away.

hausa: Kowace safiya, kowanne mutum yakan tattara daidai bukatarsa, lokacin da rana ta yi zafi, sai ta narke.
english: They gathered it morning by morning, everyone according to his eating. When the sun grew hot, it melted.

hausa: Yesu ya ce musu, “Ashe, ba ku taɓa karanta a cikin Nassi cewa, “ ‘Dutsen da magina suka ƙi shi ne ya zama dutsen kusurwar gini. Ubangiji ne ya aikata wannan, kuma abin mamaki ne a idanunmu’?
english: Jesus said to them, “Did you never read in the Scriptures, ‘The stone which the builders rejected was made the head of the corner. This was from the Lord. It is marvelous in our eyes’?

hausa: Dukan gidan Ahab zai hallaka. Zan kashe dukan ’ya’yan Ahab maza a Isra’ila, bayi ko ’yantattu.
english: For the whole house of Ahab will perish. I will cut off from Ahab everyone who urinates against a wall, both him who is shut up and him who is left at large in Israel.

hausa: Amma a ranakun da mala’ika na bakwai na dab da busa ƙahonsa, za a cika asirin Allah, kamar yadda ya sanar wa bayinsa annabawa.”
english: but in the days of the voice of the seventh angel, when he is about to sound, then the mystery of God is finished, as he declared to his servants the prophets.

hausa: Da ya dawo, ya sāke tarar da su suna barci, domin barci ya cika musu ido. Suka rasa abin da za su ce masa.
english: Again he returned and found them sleeping, for their eyes were very heavy; and they didn’t know what to answer him.

hausa: Sai Fir’auna ya ce wa Yusuf, “Da yake Allah ya ba ka sanin dukan waɗannan, babu wani mai basira da kuma hikima kamar ka.
english: Pharaoh said to Joseph, “Because God has shown you all of this, there is no one so discreet and wise as you.

hausa: Bayan ɗan lokaci, sai mai riƙon kwaf da mai tuyan sarkin Masar suka yi wa maigidansu, sarkin Masar laifi.
english: After these things, the butler of the king of Egypt and his baker offended their lord, the king of Egypt.

hausa: Wata rana da Yesu yana koyar da mutane, yana musu wa’azin bishara a filin haikalin, sai manyan firistoci da malaman dokoki, tare da dattawan suka zo wurinsa.
english: On one of those days, as he was teaching the people in the temple and preaching the Good News, the priests and scribes came to him with the elders.

hausa: Sa’ad da na ciyar da su sun ƙoshi; sa’ad da suka ƙoshi, sai suka fara taƙama; sai suka manta da ni.
english: According to their pasture, so were they filled; they were filled, and their heart was exalted. Therefore they have forgotten me.

hausa: Ban rufe idanuna ba dukan dare, don in yi tunani a kan alkawuranka.
english: My eyes stay open through the night watches, that I might meditate on your word.

hausa: Aka yi yaƙi tsakanin Asa da Ba’asha sarkin Isra’ila dukan kwanakin mulkinsu.
english: There was war between Asa and Baasha king of Israel all their days.

hausa: Sai macen ta zo ta durƙusa a gabansa ta ce, “Ubangiji, ka taimake ni!”
english: But she came and worshiped him, saying, “Lord, help me.”

hausa: yawansu ya yi kamar garken tumaki don hadaya a Urushalima a ƙayyadaddun lokuta bukukkuwarta. Haka biranen da suke kufai za su cika da ɗumbun mutane. Sa’an nan za su san cewa ni ne Ubangiji.”
english: As the flock for sacrifice, as the flock of Jerusalem in her appointed feasts, so the waste cities will be filled with flocks of men. Then they will know that I am Yahweh.’”

hausa: Suka ce wa sarki, “Mutumin da ya hallaka mu ya kuma yi mana makirci don kada mu kasance tare da Isra’ilawa ko’ina a cikin ƙauyukansu,
english: They said to the king, “The man who consumed us and who plotted against us, that we should be destroyed from remaining in any of the borders of Israel,

hausa: Babu shakka, ya yi maganan nan saboda mu ne. Ko ba haka ba? I, an rubuta wannan saboda mu ne, domin sa’ad da mai noma yake noma, mai sussuka kuma yana sussuka, suna wannan ne da bege za su sami rabonsu daga girbin.
english: or does he say it assuredly for our sake? Yes, it was written for our sake, because he who plows ought to plow in hope, and he who threshes in hope should partake of his hope.

hausa: da Fashhur, da Amariya, da Malkiya,
english: Pashhur, Amariah, Malchijah,

hausa: Sa’an nan sai dukan masu hikima suka zo ciki, amma ba su iya karanta rubutun ba ko su faɗa wa sarki abin da yake nufi.
english: Then all the king’s wise men came in; but they could not read the writing, and couldn’t make known to the king the interpretation.

hausa: Da Yesu ya ga taron suna zuwa can a guje, sai ya tsawata wa mugun ruhun ya ce, “Kai ruhun kurma, da na bebe, na umarce ka, ka fita daga cikinsa, kada kuma ka ƙara shigarsa.”
english: When Jesus saw that a multitude came running together, he rebuked the unclean spirit, saying to him, “You mute and deaf spirit, I command you, come out of him, and never enter him again!”

hausa: Bari mu auna tafiyarmu mu gwada ta, sai mu kuma koma ga Ubangiji.
english: Let us search and try our ways, and turn again to Yahweh.

hausa: Masu tsaro da makamai kuma suna gaban firistoci waɗanda suke busa ƙahoni, masu tsaro daga baya kuma suna bin akwatin alkawari, ana ta busa ƙahoni.
english: The armed men went before the priests who blew the trumpets, and the ark went after them. The trumpets sounded as they went.

hausa: Ni Ubangiji zan zama Allahnsu, bawana kuma Dawuda zai zama yerima a cikinsu. Ni Ubangiji na faɗa.
english: I, Yahweh, will be their God, and my servant David prince among them. I, Yahweh, have spoken it.

hausa: “Tafi babban birnin nan Ninebe, ka yi masa shelar saƙon da na ba ka.”
english: “Arise, go to Nineveh, that great city, and preach to it the message that I give you.”

hausa: “ ‘Duk wanda ya taɓa mushen waɗannan dabbobi, zai ƙazantu har fāɗuwar rana.
english: “‘By these you will become unclean: whoever touches their carcass shall be unclean until the evening.

hausa: Sai Dawuda ya ce wa Ahimelek mutumin Hitti da Abishai ɗan Zeruhiya ɗan’uwan Yowab, “Wa zai gangara tare da ni zuwa sansanin Shawulu?” Sai Abishai ya ce, “Zan tafi tare da kai.”
english: Then David answered and said to Ahimelech the Hittite, and to Abishai the son of Zeruiah, brother of Joab, saying, “Who will go down with me to Saul to the camp?” Abishai said, “I will go down with you.”

hausa: Remet, En Gannim, En Hadda da Bet-Fazez.
english: Remeth, Engannim, En Haddah, and Beth Pazzez.

hausa: Na yi fama, na shan wuya, ga kuma rashin barci sau da yawa. Na san abin da ake nufin da jin yunwa da ƙishirwa, sau da yawa kuwa na kasance da rashin abinci, na sha sanyi da zaman tsirara.
english: in labor and travail, in watchings often, in hunger and thirst, in fastings often, and in cold and nakedness.

hausa: Na riga na tara dukan kayayyakin da na tanada saboda haikalin Allahna, zinariya saboda dukan ayyukan zinariya, azurfa saboda ayyukan azurfa, tagulla saboda ayyukan tagulla, ƙarfe saboda ayyukan ƙarfe da kuma katako saboda ayyukan katako, da onis don ado, turkuwoyis, duwatsu masu launi dabam-dabam, da kuma dukan duwatsu masu kyau da mabul, dukan waɗannan suna nan jingim.
english: Now I have prepared with all my might for the house of my God the gold for the things of gold, the silver for the things of silver, the bronze for the things of bronze, iron for the things of iron, and wood for the things of wood, also onyx stones, stones to be set, stones for inlaid work of various colors, all kinds of precious stones, and marble stones in abundance.

hausa: Zan umarce ka in kuma koyar da kai a hanyar da za ka bi; Zan ba ka shawara in kuma lura da kai.
english: I will instruct you and teach you in the way which you shall go. I will counsel you with my eye on you.

hausa: Sa’ad da aka faɗa wa Yaƙub, “Ɗanka Yusuf ya zo gare ka,” sai Isra’ila ya ƙoƙarta ya tashi ya zauna a kan gado.
english: Someone told Jacob, and said, “Behold, your son Joseph comes to you,” and Israel strengthened himself, and sat on the bed.

hausa: Bai yi wannan ga wata al’umma ba; ba su san dokokinsa ba. Yabi Ubangiji.
english: He has not done this for just any nation. They don’t know his ordinances. Praise Yah!

hausa: Bayan suka yi ’yan kwanaki a can, sai ’yan’uwa suka sallame su da albarkar salama su dawo wurin waɗanda suka aike su.
english: After they had spent some time there, they were dismissed in peace from the brothers to the apostles.

hausa: Tana sa ƙwai nata a ƙasa kuma ta bar su su yi ɗumi a cikin ƙasa,
english: For she leaves her eggs on the earth, warms them in the dust,

hausa: Daga rabin kabilar Manasse kuwa aka ba su, Ta’anak da Gat-Rimmon, tare da wuraren kiwonsu, garuruwa biyu ke nan.
english: Out of the half-tribe of Manasseh, Taanach with its pasture lands, and Gath Rimmon with its pasture lands: two cities.

hausa: ku kira gare ni a ranar wahala; zan cece ku, za ku kuwa girmama ni.”
english: Call on me in the day of trouble. I will deliver you, and you will honor me.”

hausa: Sai Isra’ilawa suka yi mugaye abubuwa a gaban Ubangiji suka kuma bauta Ba’al.
english: The children of Israel did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight, and served the Baals.

hausa: Bai bar a kawo namiji ko mace da rai a Gat ba, gama yana tunani, “Za su ba da sanarwa a kanmu su ce, ‘Ga abin da Dawuda ya yi.’ ” Haka ya yi ta yi dukan rayuwarsa a ƙasar Filistiyawa.
english: David saved neither man nor woman alive to bring them to Gath, saying, “Lest they should tell about us, saying, ‘David did this, and this has been his way all the time he has lived in the country of the Philistines.’”

hausa: Yayinda suke tafiya, sukan nufi duk wani gefe guda cikin gefe huɗun da halittun suka nufa; da’irorin ba za su juya ba sa’ad da halittun suke tafiya.
english: When they went, they went in their four directions. They didn’t turn when they went.

hausa: Ko da waɗannan kalmomi ma, da ƙyar suka hana jama’an nan yin musu hadaya.
english: Even saying these things, they hardly stopped the multitudes from making a sacrifice to them.

hausa: Don mai bi da kaɗe-kaɗe. Da muryar “Lilin.” Ta Dawuda. Ka cece ni, ya Allah, gama ruwa ya kai wuyata
english: For the Chief Musician. To the tune of “Lilies.” By David. Save me, God, for the waters have come up to my neck!

hausa: Kada ka yarda da maƙwabci; kada ka sa begenka ga abokai. Ko ma wadda take kwance a ƙirjinka, ka yi hankali da kalmominka.
english: Don’t trust in a neighbor. Don’t put confidence in a friend. With the woman lying in your embrace, be careful of the words of your mouth!

hausa: Saboda haka taron suka ɗauke shi zuwa bayan sansani, suka kuma jajjefe shi har ya mutu, yadda Ubangiji ya umarci Musa.
english: All the congregation brought him outside of the camp, and stoned him to death with stones, as Yahweh commanded Moses.

hausa: Yoshuwa kuwa ya ƙone Ai, ya mai da ita tarin ƙasa, ta zama kufai har wa yau.
english: So Joshua burned Ai and made it a heap forever, even a desolation, to this day.

hausa: Sai sarki Rehobowam ya ƙera garkuwoyin tagulla a madadin na zinariya, ya sa su a hannun shugabannin matsara na mashigin gidan sarki.
english: King Rehoboam made shields of bronze in their place, and committed them to the hands of the captains of the guard, who kept the door of the king’s house.

hausa: Suka ƙwace dabbobin Hagirawa, raƙuma dubu hamsin, tumaki dubu ɗari biyu da hamsin da kuma jakuna dubu biyu. Suka kuma kame mutane dubu ɗari ɗaya,
english: They took away their livestock: of their camels fifty thousand, and of sheep two hundred fifty thousand, and of donkeys two thousand, and of men one hundred thousand.

hausa: Sama’ila kuwa ya kwanta har safe, sa’an nan ya buɗe ƙofofin gidan Ubangiji. Ya ji tsoro yă gaya wa Eli wahayin,
english: Samuel lay until the morning, and opened the doors of Yahweh’s house. Samuel was afraid to show Eli the vision.

hausa: Otniyel ɗan Kenaz, ɗan’uwan Kaleb, ya ci Kiriyat Sefer da yaƙi; saboda haka Kaleb ya ba wa Aksa ’yarsa, ya kuwa aure ta.
english: Othniel the son of Kenaz, the brother of Caleb, took it: and he gave him Achsah his daughter as wife.

hausa: saboda dukan mutanen duniya su san cewa Ubangiji, shi ne Allah, babu kuma wani.
english: that all the peoples of the earth may know that Yahweh himself is God. There is no one else.

hausa: Ko da ma ya tafi ya yi faɗa da ƙwazo a cikin yaƙi, Allah zai tumɓuke shi a gaban abokan gāba, gama Allah yana da iko yă taimaka ko yă tumɓuke.”
english: But if you will go, take action, and be strong for the battle. God will overthrow you before the enemy; for God has power to help, and to overthrow.”

hausa: Dusar ƙanƙarar Lebanon ta taɓa rabuwa da kan duwatsun Lebanon? Ruwan mai sanyinsa daga rafuffukansa masu nesa sun taɓa daina gudu?
english: Will the snow of Lebanon fail from the rock of the field? Will the cold waters that flow down from afar be dried up?

hausa: “Amma ba ku saurare ni ba,” in ji Ubangiji, “kun tsokane ni da abin da kuka yi da hannuwanku, kuka kuma kawo lahani wa kanku.”
english: “Yet you have not listened to me,” says Yahweh, “that you may provoke me to anger with the work of your hands to your own hurt.”

hausa: Ku rera sabuwar waƙa ga Ubangiji, ku yi yabonsa daga iyakar duniya, ku da kuka gangara zuwa teku, da kome da yake cikinsa, ku tsibirai, da waɗanda suke zama a cikinsu.
english: Sing to Yahweh a new song, and his praise from the end of the earth, you who go down to the sea, and all that is therein, the islands and their inhabitants.

hausa: “Wannan ne hadayar da Haruna da ’ya’yansa maza za su kawo ga Ubangiji a ranar da za a naɗa su firistoci, humushin garwan gari mai laushi a matsayin hadaya ta gari na kullum, rabinsa da safe, rabinsa kuma da yamma.
english: “This is the offering of Aaron and of his sons, which they shall offer to Yahweh in the day when he is anointed: one tenth of an ephah of fine flour for a meal offering perpetually, half of it in the morning, and half of it in the evening.

hausa: Kowane namijin da ba a yi masa kaciya a jiki ba, za a fid da shi daga cikin mutanensa; domin ya karya alkawarina.”
english: The uncircumcised male who is not circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin, that soul shall be cut off from his people. He has broken my covenant.”

hausa: Ka ɗibi jinin bijimin ka zuba a kan ƙahoni na bagade da yatsanka, sauran jinin kuwa ka zuba a gindin bagaden.
english: You shall take of the blood of the bull, and put it on the horns of the altar with your finger; and you shall pour out all the blood at the base of the altar.

hausa: Kada ku bauta wa wani allah, gama Ubangiji, wanda sunansa Kishi, Allah ne mai kishi.
english: for you shall worship no other god; for Yahweh, whose name is Jealous, is a jealous God.

hausa: Abishai ɗan’uwan Yowab shi ma babba ne cikin Ukun nan. Ya ɗaga māshinsa a kan mutum ɗari uku, waɗanda ya kashe, ya kuma zama sananne kamar Ukun.
english: Abishai, the brother of Joab, was chief of the three; for he lifted up his spear against three hundred and killed them, and had a name among the three.

hausa: “Yanzu zan tafi wurin wanda ya aiko ni, duk da haka ba waninku da ya tambaye ni, ‘Ina za ka?’
english: But now I am going to him who sent me, and none of you asks me, ‘Where are you going?’

hausa: Girgijen da yake bisanku zai zama tagulla, ƙasar da take ƙarƙashinku za tă zama ƙarfe.
english: Your sky that is over your head will be bronze, and the earth that is under you will be iron.

hausa: Yabi Ubangiji, dukanku rundunarsa ta sama, ku bayinsa waɗanda kuke aikata nufinsa.
english: Praise Yahweh, all you armies of his, you servants of his, who do his pleasure.

hausa: Sa’an nan Bala’am ya tashi ya koma gidan, Balak kuma ya yi tafiyarsa.
english: Balaam rose up, and went and returned to his place; and Balak also went his way.

hausa: Saboda haka kada ka ji kunyar ba da shaida game da Ubangijinmu, ko kuwa ka ji kunyata, ni da nake ɗan sarƙa saboda shi. Sai dai ka haɗa kai tare da ni cikin shan wahala saboda bishara ta wurin ikon Allah,
english: Therefore don’t be ashamed of the testimony of our Lord, nor of me his prisoner; but endure hardship for the Good News according to the power of God,

hausa: ka hana idanuna rufewa; na damu ƙwarai har ba na iya magana.
english: You hold my eyelids open. I am so troubled that I can’t speak.

hausa: Zan cika alkawurana ga Ubangiji a gaban dukan mutanensa.
english: I will pay my vows to Yahweh, yes, in the presence of all his people.

hausa: “ ‘Kada ku zalunci maƙwabcinku, ko ku yi masa ƙwace. “ ‘Kada ku riƙe albashin ma’aikaci yă kwana.
english: “‘You shall not oppress your neighbor, nor rob him. “‘The wages of a hired servant shall not remain with you all night until the morning.

hausa: Yanzu fa sai ku saurara, ku da kuke cewa, “Yau ko gobe za mu je wannan ko wancan birni, mu yi shekara a can, mu yi kasuwanci, mu ci riba.”
english: Come now, you who say, “Today or tomorrow let’s go into this city and spend a year there, trade, and make a profit.”

hausa: Kuka gina matarar ruwa tsakanin katanga biyu saboda ruwan Tsohon Tafki, amma ba ku yi la’akari da Wannan da ya yi su ba, ko ku kula da Wannan da ya shirya shi tuntuni.
english: You also made a reservoir between the two walls for the water of the old pool. But you didn’t look to him who had done this, neither did you have respect for him who planned it long ago.

hausa: Amma da Yohanna ya tsawata wa Hiridus mai mulki saboda Hiridiyas, matar ɗan’uwansa, da kuma dukan sauran mugayen abubuwan da ya yi,
english: but Herod the tetrarch, being reproved by him for Herodias, his brother’s wife, and for all the evil things which Herod had done,

hausa: na biyar a kan Malkiya, na shida a kan Miyamin,
english: the fifth to Malchijah, the sixth to Mijamin,

hausa: In kun ɗauki mayafi maƙwabcinku a matsayin jingina, ku mayar masa kafin fāɗuwar rana,
english: If you take your neighbor’s garment as collateral, you shall restore it to him before the sun goes down,

hausa: Duk da haka ina gaya muku ko Solomon cikin dukan darajarsa bai sa kayan adon da ya kai na ko ɗaya a cikinsu ba.
english: yet I tell you that even Solomon in all his glory was not dressed like one of these.

hausa: “ ‘’Yan kasuwan Sheba da Ra’ama sun yi ciniki da ke; suka sayi kayanki da kayan yaji mafi kyau iri-iri, da duwatsu masu daraja iri-iri, da zinariya.
english: “‘“The traders of Sheba and Raamah were your traders. They traded for your wares with the best of all spices, all precious stones, and gold.

hausa: Saboda ku Ubangiji ya husata da ni, ya kuma ce, “Kai ma, ba za ka shiga ƙasar ba.
english: Also Yahweh was angry with me for your sakes, saying, “You also shall not go in there.

hausa: Kashegari mutanen Shekem suka tafi gonaki, aka kuwa gaya wa Abimelek.
english: On the next day, the people went out into the field; and they told Abimelech.

hausa: Bilatus ya yi tambaya ya ce, “Kuna so in sakar muku Sarkin Yahudawa?”
english: Pilate answered them, saying, “Do you want me to release to you the King of the Jews?”

hausa: Suna ta yin maganganun fariya; dukan masu aikata mugunta sun cika da fariya.
english: They pour out arrogant words. All the evildoers boast.

hausa: Wata rana da dad dare, Ubangiji ya yi magana da Bulus a cikin wahayi ya ce, “Kada ka ji tsoro; ka ci gaba da yin magana, kada ka yi shiru.
english: The Lord said to Paul in the night by a vision, “Don’t be afraid, but speak and don’t be silent;

hausa: A lokacin bayyanarka za ka sa su zama kamar wutar matoya. Cikin fushinsa Ubangiji zai haɗiye su, kuma wutarsa za tă cinye su.
english: You will make them as a fiery furnace in the time of your anger. Yahweh will swallow them up in his wrath. The fire shall devour them.

hausa: Allah ya ɗaukaka shi zuwa hannun damansa a matsayin Yerima da Mai Ceto don yă kawo tuba da gafarar zunubai ga Isra’ila.
english: God exalted him with his right hand to be a Prince and a Savior, to give repentance to Israel, and remission of sins.

hausa: Madmena tana gudu; mutanen Gebim sun ɓuya.
english: Madmenah is a fugitive. The inhabitants of Gebim flee for safety.

hausa: kwanonin zinariya guda 20 da darajarsu ya kai darik 1,000, da kwanoni biyu na gogaggen tagulla, wanda yake darajarsa daidai da zinariya.
english: twenty bowls of gold weighing one thousand darics, and two vessels of fine bright bronze, precious as gold.

hausa: Maganganun Agur ɗan Yake, magana ce horarriya. Wannan mutum ya furta wa Itiyel da kuma ga Ukal,
english: The words of Agur the son of Jakeh, the revelation: the man says to Ithiel, to Ithiel and Ucal:

hausa: Ta haka Yusuf ya kafa wannan ya zama doka game da ƙasa a Masar, har yă zuwa yau cewa kashi ɗaya bisa biyar na amfani gona ya zama na Fir’auna. Gonakin firistoci ne kaɗai ba su zama na Fir’auna ba.
english: Joseph made it a statute concerning the land of Egypt to this day, that Pharaoh should have the fifth. Only the land of the priests alone didn’t become Pharaoh’s.

hausa: Tare da shi akwai mutum biyu masu laifi, da aka tafi da su don a gicciye.
english: There were also others, two criminals, led with him to be put to death.

hausa: Duba, Sunan Ubangiji yana zuwa daga nesa, tare da fushi mai ƙuna da kuma baƙin hayaƙi; leɓunansa sun cika da fushi, harshensa kuma wuta ce mai cinyewa.
english: Behold, Yahweh’s name comes from far away, burning with his anger, and in thick rising smoke. His lips are full of indignation. His tongue is as a devouring fire.

hausa: Muryar Ubangiji ta girgiza hamada Ubangiji ya girgiza Hamadan Kadesh.
english: Yahweh’s voice shakes the wilderness. Yahweh shakes the wilderness of Kadesh.

hausa: Dawakai da masu hawansu da na gani cikin wahayina sun yi kamar. Sulkunansu ja wur ne, baƙin shuɗi, da kuma rawaya kamar farar wuta. Kawunan dawakan sun yi kamar kawunan zakoki, daga bakunansu kuwa wuta, hayaƙi, da farar wuta suna fitowa.
english: Thus I saw the horses in the vision and those who sat on them, having breastplates of fiery red, hyacinth blue, and sulfur yellow; and the horses’ heads resembled lions’ heads. Out of their mouths proceed fire, smoke, and sulfur.

hausa: Abin da ya fi sa su baƙin ciki shi ne maganarsa da ya ce, ba za su ƙara ganin fuskarsa ba. Sai suka raka shi zuwa wajen jirgin ruwa.
english: sorrowing most of all because of the word which he had spoken, that they should see his face no more. Then they accompanied him to the ship.

hausa: Ma’aikacin hukuman ya ce, “Ranka yă daɗe, ka zo kafin ɗana yă mutu.”
english: The nobleman said to him, “Sir, come down before my child dies.”

hausa: Gama hannuwanku sun ƙazantu da jini, yatsotsinku kuma da alhaki. Leɓunanku suna faɗin ƙarairayi, harshenku kuma yana raɗar mugayen abubuwa.
english: For your hands are defiled with blood, and your fingers with iniquity. Your lips have spoken lies. Your tongue mutters wickedness.

hausa: To, ina begena yake? Wane ne zai iya ganin wani bege domina?
english: where then is my hope? As for my hope, who will see it?

hausa: “Kamar yadda kuka sani, Bikin Ƙetarewa sauran kwana biyu, za a kuma ba da Ɗan Mutum don a gicciye shi.”
english: “You know that after two days the Passover is coming, and the Son of Man will be delivered up to be crucified.”

hausa: A rubuce yake a cikin Annabawa cewa, ‘Allah zai koyar da dukansu.’Duk wanda ya saurari Uba, ya kuma koyi daga wurinsa, zai zo wurina.
english: It is written in the prophets, ‘They will all be taught by God.’ Therefore everyone who hears from the Father and has learned, comes to me.

hausa: A ranar shari’a, mutanen Ninebe za su tashi tsaye tare da wannan zamani, su yanke wa wannan zamani hukunci. Gama sun tuba sa’ad da Yunana ya yi musu wa’azi. Ga shi yanzu, shi wanda ya fi Yunana girma, na nan.
english: The men of Nineveh will stand up in the judgment with this generation, and will condemn it, for they repented at the preaching of Jonah; and behold, one greater than Jonah is here.

hausa: Da Rehobowam ya isa Urushalima, ya tattara dukan gidan Yahuda da kabilar Benyamin, ya sami sun kai mayaƙa dubu da tamanin. Sai aka shirya don su yaƙi gidan Isra’ila, su kuma mayar da masarautar wa Rehobowam ɗan Solomon.
english: When Rehoboam had come to Jerusalem, he assembled all the house of Judah and the tribe of Benjamin, a hundred and eighty thousand chosen men who were warriors, to fight against the house of Israel, to bring the kingdom again to Rehoboam the son of Solomon.

hausa: Ba ku kawo mini tumaki don hadaya ta ƙonewa ba, balle ku girmama ni da hadayunku. Ban nawaita muku da hadaya ta gari ba balle in gajiyar da ku da bukatar turare.
english: You have not brought me any of your sheep for burnt offerings, neither have you honored me with your sacrifices. I have not burdened you with offerings, nor wearied you with frankincense.

hausa: Sa’an nan Ibrahim ya koma wurin bayinsa, suka kuma kama hanya tare zuwa Beyersheba. Ibrahim kuwa ya yi zamansa a Beyersheba.
english: So Abraham returned to his young men, and they rose up and went together to Beersheba. Abraham lived at Beersheba.

hausa: Manasse ya huta tare da kakanninsa, aka kuma binne shi a fadansa. Sai Amon ɗansa ya gāje shi a matsayin sarki.
english: So Manasseh slept with his fathers, and they buried him in his own house; and Amon his son reigned in his place.

hausa: Da manyan firistoci da dattawa suka taru, sai suka ƙulla wata dabara, suka ba wa sojojin kuɗi mai yawa.
english: When they were assembled with the elders and had taken counsel, they gave a large amount of silver to the soldiers,

hausa: in na kwashe amfaninta ban biya ba ko kuma na kashe masu ita,
english: if I have eaten its fruits without money, or have caused its owners to lose their life,

hausa: Aka kawar da kowane abu mai rai, mutane da dabbobi da halittu masu rarrafe a ƙasa, da tsuntsayen sama a doron ƙasa, duka aka kawar da su daga duniya. Nuhu kaɗai aka bari da waɗanda suke tare da shi a cikin jirgi.
english: Every living thing was destroyed that was on the surface of the ground, including man, livestock, creeping things, and birds of the sky. They were destroyed from the earth. Only Noah was left, and those who were with him in the ship.

hausa: gama dalilinsa Yahudawa da yawa suna komawa ga Yesu suna kuma ba da gaskiya gare shi.
english: because on account of him many of the Jews went away and believed in Jesus.

hausa: “Ɗan mutum, domin Taya ta yi magana a kan Urushalima ta ce, ‘Yauwa! Ƙofar zuwa al’ummai ta karye, an kuma buɗe mini ƙofofinta; yanzu da take kufai zan wadace,’
english: “Son of man, because Tyre has said against Jerusalem, ‘Aha! She is broken! She who was the gateway of the peoples has been returned to me. I will be replenished, now that she is laid waste;’

hausa: “Na ƙaunace ku, in ji Ubangiji. “Amma sai kuka ce, ‘Yaya ka ƙaunace mu?’ “Isuwa ba ɗan’uwan Yaƙub ba ne?” In ji Ubangiji. “Duk da haka na ƙaunaci Yaƙub,
english: “I have loved you,” says Yahweh. Yet you say, “How have you loved us?” “Wasn’t Esau Jacob’s brother?” says Yahweh, “Yet I loved Jacob;

hausa: Saboda haka kada ka ji tsoro, gama ina tare da kai; kada ka karai, gama ni ne Allahnka. Zan ƙarfafa ka in kuma taimake ka; zan riƙe ka da hannun damana mai adalci.
english: Don’t you be afraid, for I am with you. Don’t be dismayed, for I am your God. I will strengthen you. Yes, I will help you. Yes, I will uphold you with the right hand of my righteousness.

hausa: “Kaiton makiyayan da suka hallakar suka kuma warwatsar da tumakin makiyayanta!” In ji Ubangiji.
english: “Woe to the shepherds who destroy and scatter the sheep of my pasture!” says Yahweh.

hausa: Ka halitta zuciya mai tsabta a cikina, ya Allah, ka kuma sabunta tsayayyen ruhu a cikina.
english: Create in me a clean heart, O God. Renew a right spirit within me.

hausa: “Babu tsoron Allah a idanunsu.”
english: “There is no fear of God before their eyes.”

hausa: Zan sa Ruhuna a cikinku za ku kuwa rayu, zan kuma zaunar da ku a ƙasarku. Sa’an nan za ku san cewa Ni Ubangiji na faɗa, zan kuma aikata, in ji Ubangiji.’ ”
english: I will put my Spirit in you, and you will live. Then I will place you in your own land; and you will know that I, Yahweh, have spoken it and performed it,” says Yahweh.’”

hausa: Ku zama masu koyi da Allah, kamar ƙaunatattun ’ya’ya,
english: Be therefore imitators of God, as beloved children.

hausa: cewa kowace shekara ’yan mata sukan fita kwana huɗu don yin bikin tunawa da ’yar Yefta mutumin Gileyad.
english: that the daughters of Israel went yearly to celebrate the daughter of Jephthah the Gileadite four days in a year.

hausa: Rehobowam ɗan Solomon ya zama sarki a Yahuda. Yana da shekara arba’in da ɗaya sa’ad da ya zama sarki, ya kuma yi mulki shekaru goma sha bakwai a Urushalima, birnin da Ubangiji ya zaɓa daga cikin dukan kabilan Isra’ila don yă sa Sunansa. Sunan mahaifiyarsa Na’ama, ita mutuniyar Ammon ce.
english: Rehoboam the son of Solomon reigned in Judah. Rehoboam was forty-one years old when he began to reign, and he reigned seventeen years in Jerusalem, the city which Yahweh had chosen out of all the tribes of Israel, to put his name there. His mother’s name was Naamah the Ammonitess.

hausa: Shewa kuwa magatakarda; Zadok da Abiyatar su ne firistoci;
english: Sheva was scribe, Zadok and Abiathar were priests,

hausa: Dawuda shi ne ɗan autansu. Manyan ’yan mazan nan uku suka bi Shawulu.
english: David was the youngest; and the three oldest followed Saul.

hausa: to, sai ku bincike labarin sosai a hankali. In kuwa gaskiya ne, an kuma tabbatar wannan abin ƙyama ya faru a cikinku,
english: then you shall inquire, investigate, and ask diligently. Behold, if it is true, and the thing certain, that such abomination was done among you,

hausa: Hikimar mutum kan ba shi haƙuri; ɗaukakarsa ce ya ƙyale laifi.
english: The discretion of a man makes him slow to anger. It is his glory to overlook an offense.

hausa: Allah ba mutum ba ne, da zai yi ƙarya, shi ba ɗan mutum ba ne, da zai canja tunaninsa. Yana maganar abin da ba zai iya aikata ba ne? Yakan kuma yi alkawarin da ba zai iya cikawa ba?
english: God is not a man, that he should lie, nor a son of man, that he should repent. Has he said, and he won’t do it? Or has he spoken, and he won’t make it good?

hausa: Wannan zai ba wa jikinka lafiya yă kuma adana ƙasusuwanka.
english: It will be health to your body, and nourishment to your bones.

hausa: Babu horon da yake da daɗi a lokacin da ake yinsa, sai dai zafi. Amma daga baya waɗanda suka horu ta haka sukan sami kwanciyar rai wadda aikin adalci yake bayarwa.
english: All chastening seems for the present to be not joyous but grievous; yet afterward it yields the peaceful fruit of righteousness to those who have been trained by it.

hausa: To, sarki ya so Esta fiye da duk sauran matan, ta kuma sami tagomashinsa da kuma yardarsa fiye da duk sauran budurwai. Saboda haka ya sa rawanin sarauta a kanta, ya kuma mai da ita sarauniya a maimakon Bashti.
english: The king loved Esther more than all the women, and she obtained favor and kindness in his sight more than all the virgins; so that he set the royal crown on her head, and made her queen instead of Vashti.

hausa: Saboda haka na husata da su domin sun yi kisankai a ƙasar kuma domin sun ƙazantar da ita da gumakansu.
english: Therefore I poured out my wrath on them for the blood which they had poured out on the land, and because they had defiled it with their idols.

hausa: ta Azgad 2,322
english: The children of Azgad: two thousand three hundred twenty-two.

hausa: Sun sa abin ɗaci cikin abincina suka kuma ba ni ruwan inabi mai tsami sa’ad da nake jin ƙishi.
english: They also gave me poison for my food. In my thirst, they gave me vinegar to drink.

hausa: Sarki ya aika da wannan amsa. Zuwa ga Rehum shugaban sojoji, Shimshai marubuci da kuma sauran abokansu waɗanda suke zama a Samariya da kuma sauran wurare a Kewayen Kogin Yuferites. Gaisuwa.
english: Then the king sent an answer to Rehum the chancellor, and to Shimshai the scribe, and to the rest of their companions who live in Samaria, and in the rest of the country beyond the River: Peace.

hausa: Waƙar haurawa. Ya Ubangiji, ka tuna da Dawuda da kuma dukan irin wuyan da ya jimre.
english: A Song of Ascents. Yahweh, remember David and all his affliction,

hausa: ’Yan baka ba za su iya dāgewa ba, masu saurin gudu ba za su tsira ba mahayin dawakai kuma ba zai tsere da ransa ba.
english: He who handles the bow won’t stand. He who is swift of foot won’t escape. He who rides the horse won’t deliver himself.

hausa: da sarakuna da dukan masu mulki, domin mu zauna lafiya, rai kuma kwance, muna bin Allah sosai a cikin natsuwa.
english: for kings and all who are in high places, that we may lead a tranquil and quiet life in all godliness and reverence.

hausa: In har akan yayyafa jinin awaki da na bijimai da kuma tokar karsanar a kan waɗanda suke marasa tsabta bisa ga al’ada, a tsarkake su yadda za su zama masu tsabta a waje,
english: For if the blood of goats and bulls, and the ashes of a heifer sprinkling those who have been defiled, sanctify to the cleanness of the flesh,

hausa: Hiram ya ƙara da cewa, “Yabo ga Ubangiji, Allah na Isra’ila, wanda ya yi sama da ƙasa! Ya ba Sarki Dawuda ɗa mai hikima, cike da wayo da kuma sani, wanda zai gina haikali domin Ubangiji da kuma fada wa kansa.
english: Huram continued, “Blessed be Yahweh, the God of Israel, who made heaven and earth, who has given to David the king a wise son, endowed with discretion and understanding, who would build a house for Yahweh and a house for his kingdom.

hausa: Gama an sa halitta a cikin wulaƙanci, ba da son ta ba, sai dai ta wurin nufin wannan da ya mai da ita haka, da bege
english: For the creation was subjected to vanity, not of its own will, but because of him who subjected it, in hope

hausa: To, game da budurwai. Ba ni da wani umarni daga Ubangiji, sai dai na yanke hukunci a matsayi wanda yake amintacce ta wurin jinƙan Ubangiji.
english: Now concerning virgins, I have no commandment from the Lord, but I give my judgment as one who has obtained mercy from the Lord to be trustworthy.

hausa: Ku rera da farin ciki ga Ubangiji ku adalai; daidai ne masu gaskiya su yabe shi.
english: Rejoice in Yahweh, you righteous! Praise is fitting for the upright.

hausa: A zamani Yehohiyakim, Nebukadnezzar sarkin Babilon ya kawo wa ƙasar farmaki, Yehohiyakim dai ya zama abokin tarayyarsa na tsawon shekara uku. Daga baya kuma sai ya canja ra’ayi ya yi wa Nebukadnezzar tawaye.
english: In his days Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came up, and Jehoiakim became his servant for three years. Then he turned and rebelled against him.

hausa: Saboda haka ya bar su a wurin sarkin Mowab, suka zauna da shi duk tsawon lokacin da Dawuda yake ta ɓuya a kogwannin duwatsu.
english: He brought them before the king of Moab; and they lived with him all the time that David was in the stronghold.

hausa: Dubi yadda amintacciyar birni ta zama karuwa! Dā ta cika da yin gaskiya; dā masu adalci a can suke zama, amma yanzu sai masu kisankai kaɗai!
english: How the faithful city has become a prostitute! She was full of justice. Righteousness lodged in her, but now there are murderers.

hausa: “In ta yi aure, sai daga baya ta yi alkawari ko kuwa leɓunanta sun furta alkawari da garaje, cewa za tă yi wani abu,
english: “If she has a husband, while her vows are on her, or the rash utterance of her lips with which she has bound her soul,

hausa: ya ce, “Tashi, ka ɗauki yaron da mahaifiyarsa ku tafi ƙasar Isra’ila, domin waɗanda suke neman ran yaron sun mutu.”
english: “Arise and take the young child and his mother, and go into the land of Israel, for those who sought the young child’s life are dead.”

hausa: Zai kaɗa damin a gaban Ubangiji domin yă zama yardajje a madadinku; firist ɗin zai kaɗa shi a kashegarin Asabbaci.
english: He shall wave the sheaf before Yahweh, to be accepted for you. On the next day after the Sabbath the priest shall wave it.

hausa: Allah, wanda nake bauta wa da dukan zuciyata cikin wa’azin bisharar Ɗansa, shi ne shaidata a kan yadda kullum ina tunawa da ku
english: For God is my witness, whom I serve in my spirit in the Good News of his Son, how unceasingly I make mention of you always in my prayers,

hausa: Da zarar kuka ji karar ƙaho, da sarewa, da garaya da goge da molo da algaita da kowane irin kaɗe-kaɗe da bushe-bushe ku rusuna ku yi sujada ga wannan gunkin da sarki Nebukadnezzar ya kafa.
english: that whenever you hear the sound of the horn, flute, zither, lyre, harp, pipe, and all kinds of music, you fall down and worship the golden image that Nebuchadnezzar the king has set up.

hausa: Domin dogarawarka ta kasance ga Ubangiji, ina koya maka yau, har kai ma.
english: I teach you today, even you, so that your trust may be in Yahweh.

hausa: Yadda yake a yanzu, muna a hatsarin amsa zargin ta da hargitsi saboda abin da ya faru yau. Da yake ba za mu iya ba da dalilin da ya sa aka yi wannan hargitsi ba.”
english: For indeed we are in danger of being accused concerning today’s riot, there being no cause. Concerning it, we wouldn’t be able to give an account of this commotion.”

hausa: Ga shi, an bar muku gidanku a yashe.
english: Behold, your house is left to you desolate.

hausa: Waɗannan huɗu zuriyar Rafa ne a Gat, suka kuwa mutu ta hannu Dawuda da mutanensa.
english: These four were born to the giant in Gath; and they fell by the hand of David and by the hand of his servants.

hausa: Ubangiji ya kasance tare da shi; ya nuna masa alheri, ya kuma sa ya sami tagomashi a idanun mai gadin kurkukun.
english: But Yahweh was with Joseph, and showed kindness to him, and gave him favor in the sight of the keeper of the prison.

hausa: Al’umma za tă tasar wa al’umma, mulki yă tasar wa mulki. Za a yi yunwa da girgizar ƙasa a wurare dabam-dabam.
english: For nation will rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom; and there will be famines, plagues, and earthquakes in various places.

hausa: Sai ta yi sauri ta juye ruwan da yake tulunta cikin kwami, ta koma zuwa rijiyar da gudu don ta ƙara ɗebo ruwa, ta kuma ɗebo isashe saboda dukan raƙumansa.
english: She hurried, and emptied her pitcher into the trough, and ran again to the well to draw, and drew for all his camels.

hausa: Ta haka Rahila ta rasu, aka kuma binne ta a hanya zuwa Efrata (wato, Betlehem).
english: Rachel died, and was buried on the way to Ephrath (also called Bethlehem).

hausa: Elisha ya kira Gehazi ya ce, “Kirawo mutuniyar Shunam.” Ya kuwa kira ta. Sa’ad da ta zo, sai Elisha ya ce mata, “Ɗauki ɗanki.”
english: He called Gehazi, and said, “Call this Shunammite!” So he called her. When she had come in to him, he said, “Take up your son.”

hausa: Akwai shaidu uku, wato,
english: For there are three who testify:

hausa: “ ‘Babu wani da aka keɓe don hallaka da za a fansa; dole a kashe shi.
english: “‘No one devoted to destruction, who shall be devoted from among men, shall be ransomed. He shall surely be put to death.

hausa: Sai suka yi masa dariya, da yake sun san cewa, ta mutu.
english: They were ridiculing him, knowing that she was dead.

hausa: Zan kuwa jira a mashigai a hamada, sai na ji daga gare ku.”
english: Behold, I will stay at the fords of the wilderness until word comes from you to inform me.”

hausa: Sai Yesu ya ce musu, “Ku lura fa kada wani yă ruɗe ku.
english: Jesus, answering, began to tell them, “Be careful that no one leads you astray.

hausa: Haikalin da Sarki Solomon ya gina wa Ubangiji, tsawonsa kamu sittin, fāɗinsa kamu ashirin, tsayinsa kuma kamu talatin ne.
english: The house which King Solomon built for Yahweh had a length of sixty cubits, and its width twenty, and its height thirty cubits.

hausa: Amma Solomon bai mai da Isra’ilawa bayi ba; su ne mayaƙansa, shugabannin gwamnatinsa, dogarawansa, shugabannin sojojinsa, da shugabanninsa na kekunan yaƙi da mahayan kekunan yaƙinsa.
english: But of the children of Israel Solomon made no bondservants; but they were the men of war, his servants, his princes, his captains, and rulers of his chariots and of his horsemen.

hausa: Ibrahim ya rusuna da fuskarsa har ƙasa, ya yi dariya, ya ce wa kansa, “Za a haifi ɗa wa mutum mai shekaru ɗari? Saratu za tă haifi ɗa tana da shekaru tasa’in?”
english: Then Abraham fell on his face, and laughed, and said in his heart, “Will a child be born to him who is one hundred years old? Will Sarah, who is ninety years old, give birth?”

hausa: Zaman da Isra’ilawa suka yi a Masar, ya kai shekara 430.
english: Now the time that the children of Israel lived in Egypt was four hundred thirty years.

hausa: “Itacen ƙaya ya ce wa itatuwan, ‘In da gaske ne kuke so ku naɗa ni sarkinku, ku zo ku sha inuwana; in ba haka ba, bari wuta ta fito daga itacen ƙaya ta cinye itacen al’ul na Lebanon!’
english: “The bramble said to the trees, ‘If in truth you anoint me king over you, then come and take refuge in my shade; and if not, let fire come out of the bramble, and devour the cedars of Lebanon.’

hausa: Ba za ka yi wa kanka gunki, ko wata siffar abin da take a sama a bisa, ko siffar abin da yake a duniya a ƙasa, ko siffar abin da yake a cikin ruwa a ƙarƙashin ƙasa ba.
english: “You shall not make a carved image for yourself—any likeness of what is in heaven above, or what is on the earth beneath, or that is in the water under the earth.

hausa: tabbatacce, shi da yake tsaron Isra’ila ba ya gyangyaɗi ko barci.
english: Behold, he who keeps Israel will neither slumber nor sleep.

hausa: Sa’an nan ka yi jeri huɗu na duwatsu masu daraja a kansa. A jeri na fari, a sa yakutu, da tofaz, da zumurrudu.
english: You shall set in it settings of stones, four rows of stones: a row of ruby, topaz, and beryl shall be the first row;

hausa: Dukan shugabanninki sun gudu gaba ɗaya; an kama su ba tare da an yi amfani da baka ba. Dukanku da aka kama an kwashe ku ɗaurarru gaba ɗaya, kun gudu tun abokin gāba yana da nisa.
english: All your rulers fled away together. They were bound by the archers. All who were found by you were bound together. They fled far away.

hausa: Ya aikata mugunta a gaban Ubangiji, yadda kakanninsa suka yi.
english: He did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight, according to all that his fathers had done.

hausa: Amma kamar mace marar aminci ga mijinta, haka kika kasance marar aminci gare ni, ya gidan Isra’ila,” in ji Ubangiji.
english: “Surely as a wife treacherously departs from her husband, so you have dealt treacherously with me, house of Israel,” says Yahweh.

hausa: Ta ce, bari baiwarka tă sami tagomashi a idonka. Sai ta yi tafiyarta ta je ta ci wani abu, fuskarta kuwa ba tă ƙara kasance da baƙin ciki ba.
english: She said, “Let your servant find favor in your sight.” So the woman went her way and ate; and her facial expression wasn’t sad any more.

hausa: Suka sa shi kishi saboda baƙin allolinsu, suka husata shi da gumakan banƙyamarsu.
english: They moved him to jealousy with strange gods. They provoked him to anger with abominations.

hausa: Yonatan ya tuɓe doguwar taguwarsa da ya sa, ya ba wa Dawuda, tare da sulkensa, har ma da māshi da kibiyarsa, da kuma bel nasa.
english: Jonathan stripped himself of the robe that was on him and gave it to David with his clothing, even including his sword, his bow, and his sash.

hausa: Dukan waɗannan ’ya’yan Heman ne mai duba na sarki. An ba shi su ta wurin alkawarin Allah don yă ɗaukaka shi. Allah ya ba Heman ’ya’ya maza goma sha huɗu da ’ya’ya mata uku.
english: All these were the sons of Heman the king’s seer in the words of God, to lift up the horn. God gave to Heman fourteen sons and three daughters.

hausa: Tsawon labulen tenti zai zama kamu ɗaya a kowane gefe, abin da ya rage kuma sai a bar shi ya yi ta lilo a kowane gefe don yă rufe tabanakul.
english: The cubit on the one side and the cubit on the other side, of that which remains in the length of the curtains of the tent, shall hang over the sides of the tabernacle on this side and on that side, to cover it.

hausa: Ku rera sabuwar waƙa ga Ubangiji; ku rera ga Ubangiji, ku duniya duka.
english: Sing to Yahweh a new song! Sing to Yahweh, all the earth.

hausa: Duk lokacin da suke da gardama, akan kawo su a wurina, ni kuma sai in raba tsakaninsu, in kuma koya musu dokokin Allah da farillansa.”
english: When they have a matter, they come to me, and I judge between a man and his neighbor, and I make them know the statutes of God, and his laws.”

hausa: Kafin nan muna nishi, da marmari a yi mana sutura da gidanmu na sama,
english: For most certainly in this we groan, longing to be clothed with our habitation which is from heaven,

hausa: Ishaku ya ce, “Yanzu na tsufa kuma ban san ranar mutuwata ba.
english: He said, “See now, I am old. I don’t know the day of my death.

hausa: Ta haka suka tā da hankalin mutane da dattawa da kuma malaman dokoki. Suka kama Istifanus suka kawo shi a gaban Majalisa.
english: They stirred up the people, the elders, and the scribes, and came against him and seized him, then brought him in to the council,

hausa: Shi ne, “ ‘dutsen da ku magina kuka ƙi, wanda kuwa ya zama dutsen kusurwar gini.’
english: He is ‘the stone which was regarded as worthless by you, the builders, which has become the head of the corner.’

hausa: Tsakar rana ta wuce, suka ci gaba da ƙoƙari, suna annabci har lokacin miƙa hadayar yamma ya yi. Amma babu wani da ya tanƙa, babu wani da ya amsa, babu wanda ya kula.
english: When midday was past, they prophesied until the time of the evening offering; but there was no voice, no answer, and nobody paid attention.

hausa: “Yau za ku wuce ta yankin Mowab a Ar.
english: “You are to pass over Ar, the border of Moab, today.

hausa: Babu ko kalma guda daga bakinsu da za a dogara da ita; marmarinsu kawai shi ne su hallakar da waɗansu. Maƙogwaronsu buɗaɗɗen kabari ne; da harshensu suna faɗin ƙarya.
english: For there is no faithfulness in their mouth. Their heart is destruction. Their throat is an open tomb. They flatter with their tongue.

hausa: Ya ci gaba, da ce musu, “Gaskiya nake gaya muku, babu annabin da ake yarda da shi a garinsa.
english: He said, “Most certainly I tell you, no prophet is acceptable in his hometown.

hausa: Me ya sa kake baƙin ciki, ya raina? Me ya sa ka damu a cikina? Ka dogara ga Allah, gama zai sāke yabe shi, Mai Cetona da Allahna.
english: Why are you in despair, my soul? Why are you disturbed within me? Hope in God! For I shall still praise him: my Savior, my helper, and my God.

hausa: Yana sa amintattun mashawarta su yi shiru yakan kawar da hikimar dattawa.
english: He removes the speech of those who are trusted, and takes away the understanding of the elders.

hausa: Suka fara tsarkakewar a rana ta farko na farkon wata, a rana ta takwas na watan kuwa suka kai shirayin Ubangiji. Karin kwana takwas kuma suka tsarkake haikalin Ubangiji kansa, suka gama a rana ta goma sha shida na farkon wata.
english: Now they began on the first day of the first month to sanctify, and on the eighth day of the month they came to Yahweh’s porch. They sanctified Yahweh’s house in eight days, and on the sixteenth day of the first month they finished.

hausa: “Saboda haka, mulkin sama yana kama da wani sarki wanda ya so yă yi ƙididdigar dukiyarsa da take a hannun bayinsa.
english: Therefore the Kingdom of Heaven is like a certain king who wanted to settle accounts with his servants.

hausa: Wa ya gaskata saƙonmu kuma ga wa hannun Ubangiji ya bayyana?
english: Who has believed our message? To whom has Yahweh’s arm been revealed?

hausa: “Bari Ubangiji, Allah na ruhohin ’yan adam, yă naɗa wani a kan wannan jama’a
english: “Let Yahweh, the God of the spirits of all flesh, appoint a man over the congregation,

hausa: gama ƙafafunsu kan yi sauri ga yin zunubi, suna saurin yin kisankai.
english: for their feet run to evil. They hurry to shed blood.

hausa: To, me za mu yi ke nan? Lalle za su ji cewa ka iso,
english: What then? The assembly must certainly meet, for they will hear that you have come.

hausa: “Sai ya ce, ‘Abokin gāba ne ya yi wannan.’ “Bayin suka tambaye shi suka ce, ‘Kana so mu je mu tuttumɓuke su?’
english: “He said to them, ‘An enemy has done this.’ “The servants asked him, ‘Do you want us to go and gather them up?’

hausa: Ku ƙirga makoni bakwai, wato, ku fara ƙirga mako bakwai ɗin daga lokacin da kuka sa lauje don ku yanke hatsinku da suke tsaye.
english: You shall count for yourselves seven weeks. From the time you begin to put the sickle to the standing grain you shall begin to count seven weeks.

hausa: yă kuma yi da wannan bijimi kamar yadda ya yi da bijimi na hadaya don zunubi. Ta haka firist zai yi kafara dominsu, za a kuwa gafarta musu.
english: He shall do this with the bull; as he did with the bull of the sin offering, so he shall do with this; and the priest shall make atonement for them, and they shall be forgiven.

hausa: Ka miƙa ɗaya da safe, ɗaya kuma da yamma.
english: The one lamb you shall offer in the morning; and the other lamb you shall offer at evening;

hausa: Dattijon nan, Zuwa ga ƙaunataccen abokina Gayus, wanda nake ƙauna ƙwarai da gaske.
english: The elder to Gaius the beloved, whom I love in truth.

hausa: Bayan wannan, suka miƙa hadayu na ƙonawa yadda aka saba. Suka miƙa hadayu na Sabon Wata, da hadayu na bukukkuwan Ubangiji, da kuma hadayun da aka bayar da yardar rai ga Ubangiji.
english: and afterward the continual burnt offering, the offerings of the new moons, of all the set feasts of Yahweh that were consecrated, and of everyone who willingly offered a free will offering to Yahweh.

hausa: “Ku kira ’yan baka a kan Babilon, dukan waɗanda suke jan baka. Ku yi sansani kewaye da ita duka; kada ku bar wani ya tsira. Ku sāka mata don ayyukanta; ku yi mata yadda ta yi. Gama ta tayar wa Ubangiji, Mai Tsarkin nan na Isra’ila.
english: “Call together the archers against Babylon, all those who bend the bow. Encamp against her all around. Let none of it escape. Pay her back according to her work. According to all that she has done, do to her; for she has been proud against Yahweh, against the Holy One of Israel.

hausa: ɗan Melki, ɗan Addi, ɗan Kosam, ɗan Elmadam, ɗan Er,
english: the son of Melchi, the son of Addi, the son of Cosam, the son of Elmodam, the son of Er,

hausa: Yefta ya sāke aikan jakadu wurin sarki,
english: Jephthah sent messengers again to the king of the children of Ammon;

hausa: don kada fushin Ubangiji yă ƙuna a kanku, yă rufe sammai, ku rasa ruwa, ƙasa kuma ta kāsa ba da amfaninta, da haka za ku murmutu nan da nan a kyakkyawar ƙasar da Ubangiji yake ba ku.
english: and Yahweh’s anger be kindled against you, and he shut up the sky so that there is no rain, and the land doesn’t yield its fruit; and you perish quickly from off the good land which Yahweh gives you.

hausa: Sai Yahuda ya zubar da kuɗin a cikin haikalin ya tafi. Sa’an nan ya je ya rataye kansa.
english: He threw down the pieces of silver in the sanctuary and departed. Then he went away and hanged himself.

hausa: Sa’an nan sai waɗanda suka dawo daga bauta suka miƙa hadaya ta ƙonawa ga Allah na Isra’ila. Wato, bijimai guda goma sha biyu don Isra’ilawa duka, raguna tasa’in da shida, ’yan raguna saba’in da bakwai, bunsurai kuma guda goma sha biyu. Aka miƙa su hadaya don zunubi. Wannan duka hadaya ta ƙonawa ce ga Ubangiji.
english: The children of the captivity, who had come out of exile, offered burnt offerings to the God of Israel: twelve bulls for all Israel, ninety-six rams, seventy-seven lambs, and twelve male goats for a sin offering. All this was a burnt offering to Yahweh.

hausa: Shawulu ya yi tambaya ya ce, “Wane ne kai, ya Ubangiji?” Ya amsa ya ce, “Ni ne Yesu wanda kake tsananta wa.
english: He said, “Who are you, Lord?” The Lord said, “I am Jesus, whom you are persecuting.

hausa: Shirayin ƙofar yana fuskantar filin waje; an yi zāne-zānen adon itatuwan dabino a madogarar bangayen hanyar shiga. Yana kuma da matakai takwas.
english: Its arches were toward the outer court. Palm trees were on its posts. The ascent to it had eight steps.

hausa: Ba za a ƙara yabi Mowab ba; a Heshbon mutane za su shirya mata maƙarƙashiya. ‘Zo, mu tafi mu kawo ƙarshe ga wannan al’umma.’ Ke kuma, ya Madmen za ki yi shiru; takobi zai fafare ki.
english: The praise of Moab is no more. In Heshbon they have devised evil against her: ‘Come! Let’s cut her off from being a nation.’ You also, Madmen, will be brought to silence. The sword will pursue you.

hausa: da rammukan azurfa arba’in, biyu a ƙarƙashin kowane katako.
english: and their forty sockets of silver; two sockets under one board, and two sockets under another board.

hausa: Zai zama wa bawan nan da kyau in maigidan ya dawo ya same shi yana yin haka.
english: Blessed is that servant whom his lord finds doing so when he comes.

hausa: Kowane ɗan farin haihuwa, ko mutum, ko dabba a Isra’ila, nawa ne. Sa’ad da na kashe ’ya’yan fari a Masar, na keɓe ’ya’yan fari na Isra’ilawa wa kaina.
english: For all the firstborn among the children of Israel are mine, both man and animal. On the day that I struck all the firstborn in the land of Egypt, I sanctified them for myself.

hausa: Sai suka ce wa juna, “Tabbatacce ana hukunta mu ne saboda ɗan’uwanmu. Mun ga yadda ya yi wahala sa’ad da ya roƙe mu saboda ransa, amma ba mu saurare shi ba, shi ya sa wannan wahala ta zo mana.”
english: They said to one another, “We are certainly guilty concerning our brother, in that we saw the distress of his soul, when he begged us, and we wouldn’t listen. Therefore this distress has come upon us.”

hausa: Kuna matsa wa matalauta kuna sa su dole su ba ku hatsi. Saboda haka, ko da yake kun gina gidajen duwatsu, ba za ku zauna a cikinsu ba; ko da yake kun nome gonaki masu kyau, ba za ku sha ruwan inabinsu ba.
english: Therefore, because you trample on the poor and take taxes from him of wheat, you have built houses of cut stone, but you will not dwell in them. You have planted pleasant vineyards, but you shall not drink their wine.

hausa: “Ko don kana tsoron Allah shi ya sa ya kwaɓe ka ya kuma bari haka yă same ka?
english: Is it for your piety that he reproves you, that he enters with you into judgment?

hausa: Zan tabbatar da alkawarina tsakanina da kai, zan kuma ƙara zuriyarka ta yi yawa.”
english: I will make my covenant between me and you, and will multiply you exceedingly.”

hausa: Ubangiji ya ce wa Musa,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

hausa: A cikinsa, kuma ta wurin bangaskiya a cikinsa ne muke da ƙarfin halin zuwa kusa da Allah gabagadi.
english: In him we have boldness and access in confidence through our faith in him.

hausa: Sai na ga wata dabba tana fitowa daga ƙasa. Tana da ƙahoni biyu kamar ɗan rago, amma ta yi magana kamar maciji.
english: I saw another beast coming up out of the earth. He had two horns like a lamb and it spoke like a dragon.

hausa: Sai ya ce wa almajiransa, “Lokaci yana zuwa da za ku yi marmarin ganin rana ɗaya cikin ranakun Ɗan Mutum, amma ba za ku gani ba.
english: He said to the disciples, “The days will come when you will desire to see one of the days of the Son of Man, and you will not see it.

hausa: ya kuma ce, “Ga abin da Ubangiji ya ce, zan cika kwarin nan da tafkunan ruwa.
english: He said, “Yahweh says, ‘Make this valley full of trenches.’

hausa: Sai suka ce, “To, yaya aka yi idanunka suka buɗe?”
english: They therefore were asking him, “How were your eyes opened?”

hausa: Za ka tankaɗe su, iska kuma ta kwashe su, guguwa kuma za tă warwatsa su. Amma za ka yi farin ciki a cikin Ubangiji ka kuma ɗaukaka a cikin Mai Tsarkin nan na Isra’ila.
english: You will winnow them, and the wind will carry them away, and the whirlwind will scatter them. You will rejoice in Yahweh. You will glory in the Holy One of Israel.

hausa: Filistiyawa suka abka wa Shawulu da ’ya’yansa maza, suka kashe ’ya’yan Shawulu. Yonatan da Abinadab da Malki-Shuwa.
english: The Philistines overtook Saul and his sons; and the Philistines killed Jonathan, Abinadab, and Malchishua, the sons of Saul.

hausa: “Ka yi wa Lawiyawa magana, ka ce musu, ‘Sa’ad da kuka karɓi zakka daga Isra’ila da na ba ku gādo, dole ku miƙa kashi ɗaya bisa goma na wannan zakka a matsayin hadaya ga Ubangiji.
english: “Moreover you shall speak to the Levites, and tell them, ‘When you take of the children of Israel the tithe which I have given you from them for your inheritance, then you shall offer up a wave offering of it for Yahweh, a tithe of the tithe.

hausa: Duk waɗanda suka ji wannan kuwa sun yi mamaki suna cewa, “To, me yaron nan zai zama?” Gama hannun Ubangiji yana tare da shi.
english: All who heard them laid them up in their heart, saying, “What then will this child be?” The hand of the Lord was with him.

hausa: Furanni sun hudo a duniya; lokaci yin waƙa ya zo, ana jin kukan kurciyoyi ko’ina a ƙasarmu.
english: The flowers appear on the earth. The time of the singing has come, and the voice of the turtledove is heard in our land.

hausa: Isra’ilawa da Absalom suka kafa sansani a ƙasar Gileyad.
english: Israel and Absalom encamped in the land of Gilead.

hausa: Absalom ya ce wa Hushai, “Ƙaunar da kake nuna wa abokinka ke nan? Me ya sa ba ka tafi tare da abokinka ba?”
english: Absalom said to Hushai, “Is this your kindness to your friend? Why didn’t you go with your friend?”

hausa: Sa’ad da ya mayar da azurfa dubu ɗaya da ɗari ɗaya na shekel wa mahaifiyarsa, sai ta ce, “Na ba da azurfata ga Ubangiji don ɗana yă sassaƙa sura yă kuma yi zubin gunki. Zan mayar maka.”
english: He restored the eleven hundred pieces of silver to his mother, then his mother said, “I most certainly dedicate the silver to Yahweh from my hand for my son, to make a carved image and a molten image. Now therefore I will restore it to you.”

hausa: Amma game da ni, ina cike da iko ta wurin Ruhun Ubangiji da kuma adalci da ƙarfi, don a sanar da Yaƙub laifofinsa, ga Isra’ila kuma zunubinsa.
english: But as for me, I am full of power by Yahweh’s Spirit, and of judgment, and of might, to declare to Jacob his disobedience, and to Israel his sin.

hausa: Sama’ila ya ce, “I, lafiya ƙalau. Na zo ne domin in yi wa Ubangiji hadaya. Ku tsarkake kanku sa’an nan ku zo mu tafi wurin yin hadaya tare.” Ya kuma sa Yesse da ’ya’yansa maza su tsarkake kansu, su je wurin hadayar.
english: He said, “Peaceably; I have come to sacrifice to Yahweh. Sanctify yourselves, and come with me to the sacrifice.” He sanctified Jesse and his sons, and called them to the sacrifice.

hausa: Elishama, Beyeliyada da Elifelet.
english: Elishama, Beeliada, and Eliphelet.

hausa: Da girgijen ya tashi daga bisa Tentin, sai ga Miriyam tsaye, kuturwa, fari fat. Haruna kuwa ya juya wajenta ya ga ta kuturce;
english: The cloud departed from over the Tent; and behold, Miriam was leprous, as white as snow. Aaron looked at Miriam, and behold, she was leprous.

hausa: Mai albarka ne mutumin da ya mai da Ubangiji abin dogararsa, wanda ba ya kula da masu girman kai, waɗanda suka juya ga allolin ƙarya.
english: Blessed is the man who makes Yahweh his trust, and doesn’t respect the proud, nor such as turn away to lies.

hausa: Amma har abada ba za a manta da mai bukata ba, ba kuwa sa zuciyar mai wahala zai taɓa hallaka.
english: For the needy shall not always be forgotten, nor the hope of the poor perish forever.

hausa: sai suka ce, “Bari Ubangiji yă duba, yă kuma hukunta ku! Kun maishe mu abin ƙyama ga Fir’auna da bayinsa, kuka kuma sa musu takobi a hannunsu don su kashe mu.”
english: They said to them, “May Yahweh look at you and judge, because you have made us a stench to be abhorred in the eyes of Pharaoh, and in the eyes of his servants, to put a sword in their hand to kill us!”

hausa: Ya kafa bagade domin Ba’al a haikalin Ba’al da ya gina a Samariya.
english: He raised up an altar for Baal in the house of Baal, which he had built in Samaria.

hausa: In mutum ya zargi mahaifinsa ko mahaifiyarsa, fitilarsa za tă mutu a tsakiyar duhu.
english: Whoever curses his father or his mother, his lamp shall be put out in blackness of darkness.

hausa: Ku ji wannan, ku wawaye marasa azanci, waɗanda suke da idanu amma ba sa gani, waɗanda suke da kunnuwa amma ba sa ji.
english: ‘Hear this now, foolish people without understanding, who have eyes, and don’t see, who have ears, and don’t hear:

hausa: Cikin dukan ’ya’yana maza, Ubangiji kuwa ya ba ni su da yawa, ya zaɓi ɗana Solomon yă zauna a kujerar mulkin Ubangiji a bisa Isra’ila.
english: Of all my sons (for Yahweh has given me many sons), he has chosen Solomon my son to sit on the throne of Yahweh’s kingdom over Israel.

hausa: Ka ba da Ruhunka mai kyau don yă koyar da su. Ba ka janye Manna naka daga bakunansu ba, ka kuma ba su ruwa don ƙishirwansu.
english: You gave also your good Spirit to instruct them, and didn’t withhold your manna from their mouth, and gave them water for their thirst.

hausa: “Zan aiki razanata a gabanku, in kuma sa ruɗami a cikin kowace al’ummar da za ku sadu da ita. Zan sa duk abokan gābanku su juye da baya, su gudu.
english: I will send my terror before you, and will confuse all the people to whom you come, and I will make all your enemies turn their backs to you.

hausa: wasasshe don kisa, gogagge har yana walwal kamar walƙiya! “ ‘Kada ku yi farin ciki, hukunci yana zuwa, domin kowa ya ƙi jin abin da na yi gargaɗi a kai.
english: It is sharpened that it may make a slaughter. It is polished that it may be as lightning. Should we then make mirth? The rod of my son condemns every tree.

hausa: Da ya iso ya kuma ga tabbacin alherin Allah, sai ya yi farin ciki ya kuma ƙarfafa su duka su tsaya da gaskiya cikin Ubangiji da dukan zukatansu.
english: who, when he had come, and had seen the grace of God, was glad. He exhorted them all, that with purpose of heart they should remain near to the Lord.

hausa: Saboda haka Musa ya miƙa sandansa bisa Masar, Ubangiji kuwa ya sa iskar gabas ta hura a kan ƙasar dukan dare da kuma dukan yini. Da safe kuwa iskar ta kawo fāra;
english: Moses stretched out his rod over the land of Egypt, and Yahweh brought an east wind on the land all that day, and all night; and when it was morning, the east wind brought the locusts.

hausa: A lokacin da na kāre kaina da farko, ba wanda ya goyi bayana, sai ma kowa ya yashe ni. Ina fata ba za a lasafta wannan laifi a kansu ba.
english: At my first defense, no one came to help me, but all left me. May it not be held against them.

hausa: Kuma bayan an hallaka fatata, duk da haka a cikin jiki zan ga Allah.
english: After my skin is destroyed, then I will see God in my flesh,

hausa: Sai Ubangiji ya ce mini, “Ka yi shelar dukan maganan nan a biranen Yahuda da titunan Urushalima duka cewa, ‘Su saurari zancen alkawarin nan, su aikata.
english: Yahweh said to me, “Proclaim all these words in the cities of Judah, and in the streets of Jerusalem, saying, ‘Hear the words of this covenant, and do them.

hausa: ‘Waɗannan manyan dabbobi huɗu, Masarautai ne huɗu waɗanda za su taso a duniya.
english: ‘These great animals, which are four, are four kings, who will arise out of the earth.

hausa: Sarki Solomon ya kuma gina jiragen ruwa a Eziyon Geber, wadda take kusa da Elot a Edom, a bakin Jan Teku.
english: King Solomon made a fleet of ships in Ezion Geber, which is beside Eloth, on the shore of the Red Sea, in the land of Edom.

hausa: Suka tarar a rubuce a cikin Doka wadda Ubangiji ya umarta ta wurin Musa, cewa Isra’ilawa su zauna a bukkoki a lokaci bikin watan bakwai
english: They found written in the law how Yahweh had commanded by Moses that the children of Israel should dwell in booths in the feast of the seventh month;

hausa: Suka dawo wurin Musa, da Haruna, da dukan jama’ar Isra’ilawa, a Kadesh, a Hamadan Faran. A can suka ba da rahoton ga dukan taron da yake wurin, suka kuma nuna musu amfanin ƙasar.
english: They went and came to Moses, to Aaron, and to all the congregation of the children of Israel, to the wilderness of Paran, to Kadesh; and brought back word to them and to all the congregation. They showed them the fruit of the land.

hausa: Eleyazar ɗan Haruna, ya auri ɗaya daga cikin ’yan matan Futiyel, sai ta haifa masa Finehas. Waɗannan su ne shugabannin iyalan Lawi, dangi, dangi.
english: Eleazar Aaron’s son took one of the daughters of Putiel as his wife; and she bore him Phinehas. These are the heads of the fathers’ houses of the Levites according to their families.

hausa: “ ‘An ba da wannan takobi don a goge, don a kama da hannu; an washe shi aka kuma goge, shiryayye don a yi kisa da shi.
english: It is given to be polished, that it may be handled. The sword is sharpened. Yes, it is polished to give it into the hand of the killer.”’

hausa: Sa’an nan Ubangiji ya ce masa, “Wannan ce ƙasar da na yi alkawari da rantsuwa wa Ibrahim, Ishaku da Yaƙub, sa’ad da na ce, ‘Zan ba da ita ga zuriyarku.’ Na bar ka ka gani da idanunka, amma ba za ka haye zuwa cikinta ba.”
english: Yahweh said to him, “This is the land which I swore to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, saying, ‘I will give it to your offspring.’ I have caused you to see it with your eyes, but you shall not go over there.”

hausa: Sauransu suka tsere zuwa birnin Afek, inda katangar ya fāɗa a kan mutum dubu ashirin da bakwai. Sai Ben-Hadad ya gudu zuwa birni ya ɓuya a ciki cikin ɗaki.
english: But the rest fled to Aphek, into the city; and the wall fell on twenty-seven thousand men who were left. Ben Hadad fled and came into the city, into an inner room.

hausa: Zan sa kursiyina a Elam in kuma hallaka sarkinta da fadawanta,” in ji Ubangiji.
english: I will set my throne in Elam, and will destroy from there king and princes,’ says Yahweh.

hausa: Na ga wani mugu, azzalumi, yana yaɗuwa kamar ɗanyen itace a asalin ƙasarsa,
english: I have seen the wicked in great power, spreading himself like a green tree in its native soil.

hausa: Sau biyar Yahudawa suka yi mini bulala arba’in ɗaya babu.
english: Five times I received forty stripes minus one from the Jews.

hausa: Amma Yoshuwa ya umarci mutane ya ce, “Kada ku yi kururuwar yaƙi, kada ku tā da murya, kada ku ce kome, sai ranar da na ce ku yi ihu, a sa’an nan ne sai ku yi ihu!”
english: Joshua commanded the people, saying, “You shall not shout nor let your voice be heard, neither shall any word proceed out of your mouth until the day I tell you to shout. Then you shall shout.”

hausa: Mutanen nan sun juya rana ta zama dare. A tsakiyar duhu suka ce, ‘Haske yana kusa.’
english: They change the night into day, saying ‘The light is near’ in the presence of darkness.

hausa: Gamaliyel ɗan Fedazur ne shugaban ɓangaren kabilar Manasse,
english: Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur was over the army of the tribe of the children of Manasseh.

hausa: “Faɗa wa Rehobowam ɗan Solomon sarkin Yahuda da kuma dukan Isra’ilawan da suke a Yahuda da Benyamin,
english: “Speak to Rehoboam the son of Solomon, king of Judah, and to all Israel in Judah and Benjamin, saying,

hausa: Sa’ad da Ishaku ya tsufa idanunsa suka raunana har ba ya iya gani, sai ya kira Isuwa babban ɗansa ya ce masa, “Ɗana.” Isuwa kuwa ya amsa, ya ce “Ga ni.”
english: When Isaac was old, and his eyes were dim, so that he could not see, he called Esau his elder son, and said to him, “My son?” He said to him, “Here I am.”

hausa: Kuringarsu ta fito daga kuringar Sodom ne, daga gonakin Gomorra kuma. ’Ya’yan inabinsu dafi ne, nonnansu masu ɗaci ne.
english: For their vine is of the vine of Sodom, of the fields of Gomorrah. Their grapes are poison grapes. Their clusters are bitter.

hausa: (Jiragen ruwan Hiram suka kawo zinariya daga Ofir. Daga can kuma suka kawo kaya masu yawa na katakon almug, da kuma duwatsu masu daraja.
english: The fleet of Hiram that brought gold from Ophir also brought in from Ophir great quantities of almug trees and precious stones.

hausa: Amma suka matsa masa suka ce, “Sauka wurinmu, don dare ya kusa, rana ta kusa fāɗuwa.” Sai ya sauka wurinsu.
english: They urged him, saying, “Stay with us, for it is almost evening, and the day is almost over.” He went in to stay with them.

hausa: daga Yezer, kabilar Yezerawa; daga Shillem, kabilar Shillemawa.
english: of Jezer, the family of the Jezerites; of Shillem, the family of the Shillemites.

hausa: ’Ya’yan Ham maza su ne, Kush, Masar, Fut, da Kan’ana.
english: The sons of Ham were: Cush, Mizraim, Put, and Canaan.

hausa: Da suka kai Gelilot kusa da Urdun cikin ƙasar Kan’ana, sai mutanen Ruben, mutanen Gad da kuma rabin mutanen kabilar Manasse suka gina bagade a can, a Urdun.
english: When they came to the region near the Jordan, that is in the land of Canaan, the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half-tribe of Manasseh built an altar there by the Jordan, a great altar to look at.

hausa: Kada wani yă ruɗe ku da kalmomin wofi, gama saboda waɗannan abubuwa ne fushin Allah yake zuwa a kan marasa biyayya.
english: Let no one deceive you with empty words, for because of these things the wrath of God comes on the children of disobedience.

hausa: In ba ku lura kuka bi dukan kalmomi wannan doka, waɗanda an rubuta a wannan littafi ba, ba ku kuma girmama wannan suna mai ɗaukaka da kuma mai banrazana na Ubangiji Allahnku ba,
english: If you will not observe to do all the words of this law that are written in this book, that you may fear this glorious and fearful name, YAHWEH your God,

hausa: “A rana ta biyu za ka miƙa bunsuru marar lahani domin hadaya don zunubi, za a kuma tsarkake bagaden yadda aka yi da bijimin.
english: “On the second day you shall offer a male goat without defect for a sin offering; and they shall cleanse the altar, as they cleansed it with the bull.

hausa: Duk mai kunnen ji, bari yă ji.”
english: If any man has ears to hear, let him hear.”

hausa: Kashegari dukan taron Isra’ilawa suka yi gunaguni a kan Musa da Haruna suka ce, “Kun kashe mutanen Ubangiji.”
english: But on the next day all the congregation of the children of Israel complained against Moses and against Aaron, saying, “You have killed Yahweh’s people!”

hausa: Yoshuwa ya ce wa firistoci, “Ku ɗauki akwatin alkawari ku sha gaba.” Sai suka ɗauki akwatin alkawari suka wuce gaban sauran jama’a.
english: Joshua spoke to the priests, saying, “Take up the ark of the covenant, and cross over before the people.” They took up the ark of the covenant, and went before the people.

hausa: da ta Keros, da ta Siya, da ta Fadon,
english: the children of Keros, the children of Sia, the children of Padon,

hausa: “Ɗan mutum, ka yi annabci a kan makiyayan Isra’ila; ka yi annabci ka ce musu, ‘Ga abin da Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka yana cewa kaiton makiyayan Isra’ila waɗanda suke kula da kansu ne kawai! Ashe, bai kamata makiyaya ne su lura da tumaki ba?
english: “Son of man, prophesy against the shepherds of Israel. Prophesy, and tell them, even the shepherds, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “Woe to the shepherds of Israel who feed themselves! Shouldn’t the shepherds feed the sheep?

hausa: mutanen da suke zama cikin duhu sun ga babban haske; haske kuma ya haskaka a kan waɗanda suke zama a inuwar mutuwa.”
english: the people who sat in darkness saw a great light; to those who sat in the region and shadow of death, to them light has dawned.”

hausa: Libna, Eter, Ashan,
english: Libnah, Ether, Ashan,

hausa: Bayan kamar sa’a ɗaya, sai wani mutum ya ce, “Ba shakka, mutumin nan ma yana tare da shi, don shi mutumin Galili ne.”
english: After about one hour passed, another confidently affirmed, saying, “Truly this man also was with him, for he is a Galilean!”

hausa: Saboda haka Shawulu ya zauna tare da su yana kai da kawowa a sake a cikin Urushalima, yana magana gabagadi a cikin sunan Ubangiji.
english: He was with them entering into Jerusalem,
