hausa: Saboda haka Musa ya fita ya gaya wa jama’a abin da Ubangiji ya faɗa. Ya tattaro dattawansu saba’in, ya sa suka tsaya kewaye da Tentin Sujada.
english: Moses went out, and told the people Yahweh’s words; and he gathered seventy men of the elders of the people, and set them around the Tent.

hausa: Ya yi hikima, ya watsar da waɗansu ’ya’yansa a dukan yankunan Yahuda da Benyamin, da kuma a dukan birane masu katanga. Ya ba su tanadi mai yawa ya kuma aurar musu mata masu yawa.
english: He dealt wisely, and dispersed some of his sons throughout all the lands of Judah and Benjamin, to every fortified city. He gave them food in abundance; and he sought many wives for them.

hausa: Bayan wannan sai na ga wani mala’ika yana saukowa daga sama. Yana da iko mai girma, aka haskaka duniya da darajarsa.
english: After these things, I saw another angel coming down out of the sky, having great authority. The earth was illuminated with his glory.

hausa: Biyu sun fi ɗaya, gama suna samun riba mai kyau na aikinsu.
english: Two are better than one, because they have a good reward for their labor.

hausa: Yakan fisshe ni lafiya daga yaƙin da ake yi da ni, ko da yake da yawa suna gāba da ni.
english: He has redeemed my soul in peace from the battle that was against me, although there are many who oppose me.

hausa: Bari harshena yă rera game da maganarka, gama dukan umarnanka masu adalci ne.
english: Let my tongue sing of your word, for all your commandments are righteousness.

hausa: In ba tă gamshi maigida wanda ya zaɓe ta domin kansa ba, dole yă bari a fanshe ta. Ba shi da dama yă sayar da ita ga baƙi, tun da yake bai kyauta mata ba.
english: If she doesn’t please her master, who has married her to himself, then he shall let her be redeemed. He shall have no right to sell her to a foreign people, since he has dealt deceitfully with her.

hausa: “Duk wanda ya zub da jinin mutum, ta hannun mutum za a zub da jininsa; gama a cikin siffar Allah ne, Allah ya yi mutum.
english: Whoever sheds man’s blood, his blood will be shed by man, for God made man in his own image.

hausa: Hur shi ne mahaifin Uri, Uri kuma shi ne mahaifin Bezalel.
english: Hur became the father of Uri, and Uri became the father of Bezalel.

hausa: Na rasa masu hauka ne da za ku kawo mini wannan mutum yă yi ta hauka a gabana? Dole ne wannan mutum yă shiga gidana?”
english: Do I lack madmen, that you have brought this fellow to play the madman in my presence? Should this fellow come into my house?”

hausa: Biyu-biyu daga dabbobi masu tsabta da marasa tsabta, da tsuntsaye da kuma dukan halittu masu rarrafe a ƙasa,
english: Clean animals, unclean animals, birds, and everything that creeps on the ground

hausa: “In mutanen ƙasarka suka tambaye ka cewa, ‘Ba za ka faɗa mana abin da kake nufi da wannan ba?’
english: “When the children of your people speak to you, saying, ‘Won’t you show us what you mean by these?’

hausa: Sai maganar Ubangiji ta zo mini cewa,
english: Then Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

hausa: Ka yi masa rufi, ka kuma ba da fili inci 18 tsakanin rufin a kowane gefen jirgin. Ka sa ƙofa a gefen jirgin. Ka yi shi hawa uku, ka yi ƙofa a gefe.
english: You shall make a roof in the ship, and you shall finish it to a cubit upward. You shall set the door of the ship in its side. You shall make it with lower, second, and third levels.

hausa: Ka hori mai ba’a, hatsaniya kuwa za tă yi waje; fitina da zargi kuma za su ƙare.
english: Drive out the mocker, and strife will go out; yes, quarrels and insults will stop.

hausa: Waɗannan su ne dokokin da Ubangiji ya furta da babbar murya ga taronku gaba ɗaya, a can dutse ta tsakiyar wuta, girgije da kuma baƙin duhu; bai kuma ƙara kome ba. Sa’an nan ya rubuta su a kan alluna biyu na dutse, ya kuma ba ni su.
english: Yahweh spoke these words to all your assembly on the mountain out of the middle of the fire, of the cloud, and of the thick darkness, with a great voice. He added no more. He wrote them on two stone tablets, and gave them to me.

hausa: Yayinda suke kallo, ka huda katanga ka fitar da kayanka daga ciki.
english: Dig through the wall in their sight, and carry your baggage out that way.

hausa: Ana cikin haka, sai Abimelek ya zo wurinsa daga Gerar, tare da Ahuzzat mai ba shi shawara da Fikol shugaban mayaƙansa.
english: Then Abimelech went to him from Gerar with Ahuzzath his friend, and Phicol the captain of his army.

hausa: Na murƙushe su, suka yi laushi kamar ƙura; na daka na kuma tattake su kamar caɓi a kan tituna.
english: Then I beat them as small as the dust of the earth. I crushed them as the mire of the streets, and spread them abroad.

hausa: Dawuda kuwa ya ƙara zama shahararre bayan ya dawo daga kai wa ƙasar Aram hari, daga nan sai ya je ya karkashe mutanen Edom dubu goma sha takwas a Kwarin Gishiri.
english: David earned a reputation when he returned from striking down eighteen thousand men of the Syrians in the Valley of Salt.

hausa: A rana ta farko a cikin watan uku bayan da Isra’ilawa suka bar Masar, a wannan rana, suka iso Hamadar Sinai.
english: In the third month after the children of Israel had gone out of the land of Egypt, on that same day they came into the wilderness of Sinai.

hausa: Suka ɗauki gawar Asahel suka binne a kabarin mahaifinsa a Betlehem. Sa’an nan Yowab da mutanensa suka bi dare har suka iso Hebron da safe.
english: They took up Asahel and buried him in the tomb of his father, which was in Bethlehem. Joab and his men went all night, and the day broke on them at Hebron.

hausa: Magana ta zo wa Irmiya daga Ubangiji sa’ad da Sarki Zedekiya ya aiki Fashhur ɗan Malkiya da firist Zefaniya ɗan Ma’asehiya gare shi. Suka ce masa,
english: The word which came to Jeremiah from Yahweh, when King Zedekiah sent to him Pashhur the son of Malchijah, and Zephaniah the son of Maaseiah, the priest, saying,

hausa: Timoti, abokin aikina, yana gai da ku, haka ma Lusiyus, Yason, da Sosifater, dangina.
english: Timothy, my fellow worker, greets you, as do Lucius, Jason, and Sosipater, my relatives.

hausa: Kamar dai yadda ba shakka Allah yake mai aminci, haka ma maganar da muka yi muku, ba “I” da kuma “A’a” ba ce.
english: But as God is faithful, our word toward you was not “Yes and no.”

hausa: Ashe, ranar Ubangiji ba duhu ba ce, a maimakon haske, duhu wuluk, ba tare da ko ɗan haske ba.
english: Won’t the day of Yahweh be darkness, and not light? Even very dark, and no brightness in it?

hausa: Kaurin bangon waje na ɗakunan da suke gefe kamu biyar ne. Faɗin filin da yake tsakanin ɗakunan da suke gefen haikalin
english: The thickness of the outer wall of the side rooms was five cubits. That which was left was the place of the side rooms that belonged to the house.

hausa: Ina roƙonku cewa sa’ad da na zo kada ku tilasta ni in matsa muku, gama na tabbata zan iya tsaya wa waɗanda suka ce abin da muke yi sha’anin duniya ne.
english: Yes, I beg you that I may not, when present, show courage with the confidence with which I intend to be bold against some, who consider us to be walking according to the flesh.

hausa: Za ka kira zan kuwa amsa maka; za ka yi marmarin abin da hannunka ya halitta.
english: You would call, and I would answer you. You would have a desire for the work of your hands.

hausa: Dawuda ya ce wa Abigiyel, “Yabo ya tabbata ga Ubangiji, Allah na Isra’ila, wanda ya aiko ki don ki same ni yau.
english: David said to Abigail, “Blessed is Yahweh, the God of Israel, who sent you today to meet me!

hausa: Haka Efraim ma bai kori Kan’aniyawa da suke zaune a Gezer ba, amma Kan’aniyawa suka ci gaba da zama tare da su.
english: Ephraim didn’t drive out the Canaanites who lived in Gezer, but the Canaanites lived in Gezer among them.

hausa: Da yake ba su yi tunani cewa ya dace su riƙe sanin Allah da suke da shi ba, sai ya yashe su ga tunanin banza da wofi, su aikata abin da bai kamata a yi ba.
english: Even as they refused to have God in their knowledge, God gave them up to a reprobate mind, to do those things which are not fitting;

hausa: suka kuma ja shi sama da igiya suka fid da shi daga rijiyar. Irmiya kuwa ya zauna a sansanin matsara.
english: So they lifted Jeremiah up with the cords, and took him up out of the dungeon; and Jeremiah remained in the court of the guard.

hausa: Wata rana da dare Eli da idanunsa sun kusa makancewa har ba ya iya gani sosai yana kwance a inda ya saba.
english: At that time, when Eli was laid down in his place (now his eyes had begun to grow dim, so that he could not see),

hausa: Ka mai da maza kamar kifin teku, kamar halittun tekun da ba su da shugaba.
english: and make men like the fish of the sea, like the creeping things that have no ruler over them?

hausa: Sa’an nan Yehohiyada ya yi alkawari cewa shi da mutane da kuma sarki za su zama mutanen Ubangiji.
english: Jehoiada made a covenant between himself, all the people, and the king, that they should be Yahweh’s people.

hausa: Da suka yanke ƙugiyoyin, sai suka bar su a cikin teku a lokaci guda kuma suka ɓalle maɗaurin abin juya jirgin. Sai suka tā da filafilan gaban jirgin daidai yadda iska za tă tura shi gaba, sa’an nan suka nufi gaci.
english: Casting off the anchors, they left them in the sea, at the same time untying the rudder ropes. Hoisting up the foresail to the wind, they made for the beach.

hausa: Bitrus ya ce, “Ko da duka sun ja da baya suka bar ka, ba zan bar ka ba.”
english: But Peter said to him, “Although all will be offended, yet I will not.”

hausa: Za su cika gidajenka, da na fadawanka, da na dukan Masarawa, abin da iyayenka da kakanninka ba su taɓa gani ba, tun daga ranar da suka sami kansu a duniya, har yă zuwa yau.’ ” Sa’an nan Musa ya juya, ya rabu da Fir’auna.
english: Your houses shall be filled, and the houses of all your servants, and the houses of all the Egyptians, as neither your fathers nor your fathers’ fathers have seen, since the day that they were on the earth to this day.’” He turned, and went out from Pharaoh.

hausa: Bitrus, manzon Yesu Kiristi, Zuwa ga zaɓaɓɓu na Allah, baƙi a duniya, da suke a warwatse ko’ina a Fontus, Galatiya, Kaffadokiya, Asiya da kuma Bitiniya,
english: Peter, an apostle of Jesus Christ, to the chosen ones who are living as foreigners in the Dispersion in Pontus, Galatia, Cappadocia, Asia, and Bithynia,

hausa: Ba a yi amfani da kuɗin da aka kawo a haikali don yin manyan kwanonin azurfa, lagwani, abin yayyafa ruwa, kakaki ko wani abu na zinariya, ko na azurfa domin haikalin Ubangiji ba;
english: But there were not made for Yahweh’s house cups of silver, snuffers, basins, trumpets, any vessels of gold or vessels of silver, of the money that was brought into Yahweh’s house;

hausa: Ruhun Ubangiji kuwa ya sauko masa da ƙarfi, ya sa ya yaga zakin kashi biyu da hannu kamar yadda akan yayyage ɗan akuya. Sai dai bai gaya wa iyayensa abin da ya yi ba.
english: Yahweh’s Spirit came mightily on him, and he tore him as he would have torn a young goat with his bare hands, but he didn’t tell his father or his mother what he had done.

hausa: Ubangiji ya yi wa Isra’ila da Yahuda kashedi ta bakin dukan annabawansa da kuma masu duba, cewa, “Ku juyo daga mugayen ayyukanku. Ku yi biyayya da umarnai da farillaina, bisa ga dukan Dokar da na dokaci kakanninku su bi, waɗanda na kuma bayar ta wurin bayina, annabawa.”
english: Yet Yahweh testified to Israel and to Judah, by every prophet and every seer, saying, “Turn from your evil ways, and keep my commandments and my statutes, according to all the law which I commanded your fathers, and which I sent to you by my servants the prophets.”

hausa: A wajen gabas iyakar za tă kama tsakanin Hauran da Damaskus, ta bi ta Urdun tsakanin Gileyad da ƙasar Isra’ila, zuwa tekun gabas har zuwa Tamar. Wannan ita ce iyakar a wajen gabas.
english: “The east side, between Hauran, Damascus, Gilead, and the land of Israel, shall be the Jordan; from the north border to the east sea you shall measure. This is the east side.

hausa: Yayinda ina a cikin duniya, ni ne hasken duniya.”
english: While I am in the world, I am the light of the world.”

hausa: ka tashi, ya Ubangiji, ka kuma zo wurin hutunka, kai da akwatin alkawarin ƙarfinka.
english: Arise, Yahweh, into your resting place, you, and the ark of your strength.

hausa: Saboda haka Na’aman ya je ya nutse sau bakwai a Urdun, yadda mutumin Allah ya ce masa, sai fatarsa ta koma kamar ta ɗan yaro.
english: Then went he down and dipped himself seven times in the Jordan, according to the saying of the man of God; and his flesh was restored like the flesh of a little child, and he was clean.

hausa: “ ‘Ku kiyaye dukan farillaina da dokokina duka, don kada ƙasar da nake kai ku ta amayar da ku.
english: “‘You shall therefore keep all my statutes and all my ordinances, and do them, that the land where I am bringing you to dwell may not vomit you out.

hausa: Sai Yesu ya kira taron wurinsa ya ce, “Ku saurara ku kuma gane.
english: He summoned the multitude, and said to them, “Hear, and understand.

hausa: Sai ya ce masa, “Na yarda da abin da ka ce, ba zan hallakar da garin da ka ambata ba.
english: He said to him, “Behold, I have granted your request concerning this thing also, that I will not overthrow the city of which you have spoken.

hausa: Wannan ya sa har ƙasar ba tă ishe su yayinda suke zama tare ba, saboda mallakarsu ta yi yawa har ba za su iya zama tare ba.
english: The land was not able to bear them, that they might live together; for their possessions were so great that they couldn’t live together.

hausa: Kamar yadda iskar arewa kan kawo ruwan sama, haka jita-jita kan kawo fushi.
english: The north wind produces rain; so a backbiting tongue brings an angry face.

hausa: “Ka tsawata wa mahaifiyarka, ka tsawata mata, gama ita ba matata ba ce, ni kuma ba mijinta ba ne. Ku roƙe ta tă daina karuwancinta da kuma rashin aminci a tsakanin nononta.
english: Contend with your mother! Contend, for she is not my wife, neither am I her husband; and let her put away her prostitution from her face, and her adulteries from between her breasts;

hausa: Ku yi tsaro, ku kuma yi addu’a, don kada ku fāɗi cikin jarraba. Ruhu yana so, sai dai jiki raunana ne.”
english: Watch and pray, that you don’t enter into temptation. The spirit indeed is willing, but the flesh is weak.”

hausa: “Ga shi, na halicci sabuwar sama da kuma sabuwar duniya. Abubuwa na dā za a manta da su, ba kuwa za a ƙara tuna da su ba.
english: “For, behold, I create new heavens and a new earth; and the former things will not be remembered, nor come into mind.

hausa: Da ya faɗa haka, sai ya dakata a Galili.
english: Having said these things to them, he stayed in Galilee.

hausa: Na duba, sai na ga ƙasa mai amfani ta zama hamada; dukan garuruwanta sun zama kufai a gaban Ubangiji, a gaban zafin fushinsa.
english: I saw, and behold, the fruitful field was a wilderness, and all its cities were broken down at the presence of Yahweh, before his fierce anger.

hausa: abin da ya tara masu adalci za su sa marasa laifi za su raba azurfarsa.
english: he may prepare it, but the just will put it on, and the innocent will divide the silver.

hausa: Elisha ya ce masa, “Ka ce mata, ‘Kin yi duk wannan ɗawainiya saboda mu. Yanzu, me kike so a yi miki? Kina so mu yi magana a madadinki wa sarki ko babban hafsan mayaƙa?’ ” Sai ta ce, “A’a, ina da dukan abin da nake bukata a cikin jama’ata.”
english: He said to him, “Say now to her, ‘Behold, you have cared for us with all this care. What is to be done for you? Would you like to be spoken for to the king, or to the captain of the army?’” She answered, “I dwell among my own people.”

hausa: dukan ayyukan, daga farko har zuwa ƙarshe, suna a rubuce cikin littafin sarakunan Isra’ila da na Yahuda.
english: and his acts, first and last, behold, they are written in the book of the kings of Israel and Judah.

hausa: mutanen da suna cin gaba da tsokanata a fuskata, suna miƙa hadayu a gonaki suna ƙone turare a bagadan tubali;
english: a people who provoke me to my face continually, sacrificing in gardens, and burning incense on bricks;

hausa: Tabbatacce ka ba shi madawwamiyar albarka ka kuma sa shi murna da farin cikin kasancewarka.
english: For you make him most blessed forever. You make him glad with joy in your presence.

hausa: Wannan abin da Allah ya yi magana ya zo ne a shekarar da Sarki Ahaz ya mutu.
english: This burden was in the year that King Ahaz died.

hausa: Birnin Urushalima kuwa tana da fāɗi da girma, amma mutanen da suke zama a cikinta kaɗan ne, ba a kuma gina gidaje da yawa ba tukuna.
english: Now the city was wide and large; but the people were few therein, and the houses were not built.

hausa: Yesu ya amsa ya ce, “Don me kake tambayata game da abin da yake mai kyau? Akwai Mai kyau Ɗaya kaɗai. In kana so ka sami rai madawwami, ka kiyaye dokokin nan.”
english: He said to him, “Why do you call me good? No one is good but one, that is, God. But if you want to enter into life, keep the commandments.”

hausa: Tun Bitrus yana cikin tunani game da ma’anar wahayin nan, sai ga mutanen da Korneliyus ya aika sun sami gidan Siman suna kuma tsaye a ƙofar.
english: Now while Peter was very perplexed in himself what the vision which he had seen might mean, behold, the men who were sent by Cornelius, having made inquiry for Simon’s house, stood before the gate,

hausa: Sa’ad da kerubobin suka motsa, sai da’irorin da suke kusa da su su motsa; kuma sa’ad da kerubobin suka buɗe fikafikansu don su tashi daga ƙasa, da’irorin ba sa barin wurarensu.
english: When the cherubim went, the wheels went beside them; and when the cherubim lifted up their wings to mount up from the earth, the wheels also didn’t turn from beside them.

hausa: Amma mutanen ƙauyen ba su karɓe shi ba, don yana kan hanyar zuwa Urushalima ne.
english: They didn’t receive him, because he was traveling with his face set toward Jerusalem.

hausa: Sa’an nan maganar Ubangiji ta zo wa Irmiya cewa,
english: Then Yahweh’s word came to Jeremiah, saying,

hausa: Sai Ubangiji ya ce wa Musa,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

hausa: Kuma ga abin da Ubangiji yana cewa, ‘Tabbatacce za a ba da wannan birni ga sojojin sarkin Babilon, wanda zai ci shi.’ ”
english: Yahweh says, ‘This city will surely be given into the hand of the army of the king of Babylon, and he will take it.’”

hausa: Sa’an nan aka ajiye abinci a gabansa, amma ya ce, “Ba zan ci ba, sai na faɗi abin da yake tafe da ni.” Sai Laban ya ce, “Faɗa mana.”
english: Food was set before him to eat, but he said, “I will not eat until I have told my message.” Laban said, “Speak on.”

hausa: Na shuka ka kamar zaɓaɓɓen inabi iri mai kyau da kuma wanda za a dogara a kai. Yaya kuma ka juya kana gāba da ni ka lalace, ka zama inabin jeji?
english: Yet I had planted you a noble vine, a pure and faithful seed. How then have you turned into the degenerate branches of a foreign vine to me?

hausa: ka ajiye daron tsakanin Tentin Sujada da bagaden, ka kuma zuba ruwa a cikinsa.
english: You shall set the basin between the Tent of Meeting and the altar, and shall put water therein.

hausa: Ka sa murfin a bisa akwatin ka kuma sa allunan dokokin alkawarin da zan ba ka a ciki.
english: You shall put the mercy seat on top of the ark, and in the ark you shall put the covenant that I will give you.

hausa: Amma yanzu ka ƙi mu ka kuma ƙasƙantar da mu; ba ka ƙara fita tare da mayaƙanmu.
english: But now you rejected us, and brought us to dishonor, and don’t go out with our armies.

hausa: Sai Yoshuwa ya ce wa Akan, “Ɗana, sai ka ba Ubangiji, Allah na Isra’ila ɗaukaka, ka yi masa yabo. Ka gaya mini abin da ka yi; kada ka ɓoye mini.”
english: Joshua said to Achan, “My son, please give glory to Yahweh, the God of Israel, and make confession to him. Tell me now what you have done! Don’t hide it from me!”

hausa: Abokaina ƙaunatattu, ba sabon umarni nake rubuta muku ba, a’a, daɗaɗɗen umarnin nan ne, wanda kuke da shi tun farko. Wannan tsohon umarni shi ne saƙon da kuka riga kuka ji.
english: Brothers, I write no new commandment to you, but an old commandment which you had from the beginning. The old commandment is the word which you heard from the beginning.

hausa: daga zuriyar Bigwai, Uttai da Zakkur ne shugabanni, tare da su akwai mutum 70.
english: Of the sons of Bigvai, Uthai and Zabbud; and with them seventy males.

hausa: Sai ka juya ka koma ka isa lafiya ba tare da ɓata wa masu mulkin Filistiyawa rai ba.”
english: Therefore now return, and go in peace, that you not displease the lords of the Philistines.”

hausa: Firist zai miƙa ɗayan matsayin hadaya ta ƙonawa bisa ga yadda aka tsara, yă kuma yi kafara dominsa saboda zunubin da ya yi, za a kuwa gafarta masa.
english: He shall offer the second for a burnt offering, according to the ordinance; and the priest shall make atonement for him concerning his sin which he has sinned, and he shall be forgiven.

hausa: Muryar Ubangiji ta murɗa itatuwan oak ya kakkaɓe itatuwan kurmi. Kuma a cikin haikalinsa kowa ya ce, “Ɗaukaka!”
english: Yahweh’s voice makes the deer calve, and strips the forests bare. In his temple everything says, “Glory!”

hausa: Sai ’yan aikan suka sāke dawo suka ce, “Ga abin da Ben-Hadad ya ce, ‘Na aika ka ba da azurfarka da zinariyarka, matanka da kuma ’ya’yanka.
english: The messengers came again and said, “Ben Hadad says, ‘I sent indeed to you, saying, “You shall deliver me your silver, your gold, your wives, and your children;

hausa: Kuma dukan mutane suka yi ƙoƙari su taɓa shi, domin iko yana fitowa daga gare shi, ya kuwa warkar da su duka.
english: All the multitude sought to touch him, for power came out of him and healed them all.

hausa: Ɗaya daga cikin kawunan dabbar ya yi kamar yana da raunin da zai iya kashe shi, amma raunin nan da zai iya kashe shi ya riga ya warke. Dukan duniya ta yi mamaki ta kuma bi dabbar.
english: One of his heads looked like it had been wounded fatally. His fatal wound was healed, and the whole earth marveled at the beast.

hausa: “Ki fadada wurin tentinki, ki miƙe labulen tentinki da fāɗi, kada ki janye; ƙara tsawon igiyoyinta, ki kuma ƙara ƙarfin turakunta.
english: “Enlarge the place of your tent, and let them stretch out the curtains of your habitations; don’t spare; lengthen your cords, and strengthen your stakes.

hausa: Ga abin da kowannenku yana cin gaba da ce wa abokinsa ko danginsa, ‘Mece ce amsar Ubangiji?’ Ko kuwa ‘mene ne Ubangiji ya faɗa?’
english: You will say everyone to his neighbor, and everyone to his brother, ‘What has Yahweh answered?’ and, ‘What has Yahweh said?’

hausa: In kun san cewa shi mai adalci ne, to, kun dai san cewa duk mai aikata abin da yake daidai haifaffensa ne.
english: If you know that he is righteous, you know that everyone who practices righteousness has been born of him.

hausa: Faɗin filin haikalin a wajen gabas, haɗe da gaban haikalin, kamu ɗari ne.
english: also the width of the face of the temple, and of the separate place toward the east, one hundred cubits.

hausa: Ka ƙulla lalacin mutane masu yawa, ta haka ka kunyatar da gidanka ka kuma hallaka ranka.
english: You have devised shame to your house by cutting off many peoples, and have sinned against your soul.

hausa: Ubangiji ya ce wa Musa da Haruna, “Waɗannan ne ƙa’idodin Bikin Ƙetarewa. “Ba baƙon da zai ci shi.
english: Yahweh said to Moses and Aaron, “This is the ordinance of the Passover. No foreigner shall eat of it,

hausa: Daniyel kuwa ya bunkasa a lokacin mulkin Dariyus da kuma mulkin Sairus na Farisa.
english: So this Daniel prospered in the reign of Darius and in the reign of Cyrus the Persian.

hausa: Ku shirya dawakai, ku sa musu sirdi! Ku tsaya a wurarenku saye da hulunan kwano a kai! Ku wasa māsunku, ku yafa kayan yaƙinku!
english: Harness the horses, and get up, you horsemen, and stand up with your helmets. Polish the spears, put on the coats of mail.

hausa: Sa’ad da Ahab ya ji waɗannan kalmomi, sai ya yage rigarsa, ya sa rigunan makoki, ya kuma yi azumi. Ya kwanta a kayan makoki, ya kuma yi tafiya cikin sauƙinkai.
english: When Ahab heard those words, he tore his clothes, put sackcloth on his body, fasted, lay in sackcloth, and went about despondently.

hausa: Da me zan zo a gaban Ubangiji in rusuna a gaban Maɗaukaki Allah? Shin, zan zo ne a gabansa da hadaya ta ƙonawa, da ɗan maraƙi bana ɗaya?
english: How shall I come before Yahweh, and bow myself before the exalted God? Shall I come before him with burnt offerings, with calves a year old?

hausa: Ban koyi hikima ba, ba ni kuma da sani game da Mai Tsarkin nan,
english: I have not learned wisdom, neither do I have the knowledge of the Holy One.

hausa: Kaitona, mahaifiyata, da kika haife ni, mutumin da dukan ƙasa take faɗa take kuma gardama da shi! Ban ba da bashi ko in ci bashi ba, duk da haka kowa yana zagina.
english: Woe is me, my mother, that you have borne me, a man of strife, and a man of contention to the whole earth! I have not lent, neither have men lent to me; yet every one of them curses me.

hausa: Ya raba teku ya kuma bi da su ciki; ya sa ruwa ya tsaya daram kamar bango.
english: He split the sea, and caused them to pass through. He made the waters stand as a heap.

hausa: Uzziya mutumin Ashtarot, Shama da Yehiyel ’ya’yan Hotam mutumin Arower maza,
english: Uzzia the Ashterathite, Shama and Jeiel the sons of Hotham the Aroerite,

hausa: Da Yesu ya kama hanya, sai wani mutum ya ruga da gudu ya zo wajensa, ya durƙusa a gabansa ya ce, “Malam nagari, me zan yi domin in gāji rai madawwami?”
english: As he was going out into the way, one ran to him, knelt before him, and asked him, “Good Teacher, what shall I do that I may inherit eternal life?”

hausa: Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka shi ne ƙarfina; yakan mai da ƙafafuna kamar na barewa, yakan sa in yi tafiya a wurare masu tsayi. Domin mai bi da kaɗe-kaɗe. A kan kayan kiɗi masu tsirkiyata.
english: Yahweh, the Lord, is my strength. He makes my feet like deer’s feet, and enables me to go in high places. For the music director, on my stringed instruments.

hausa: Don ba su da tufafi, sukan kwana tsirara; ba su da wani abin da zai rufe su cikin sanyi.
english: They lie all night naked without clothing, and have no covering in the cold.

hausa: Ka koya wa tsofaffin maza su kasance masu sauƙinkai, waɗanda suka cancanci girmamawa, masu kamunkai, sahihai wajen bangaskiya, da ƙauna da kuma jimiri.
english: that older men should be temperate, sensible, sober minded, sound in faith, in love, and in perseverance,

hausa: Fir’auna ya kira Musa da Haruna ya ce, “Yi addu’a ga Ubangiji yă ɗauke kwaɗi daga gare ni da mutanena, zan kuwa bar mutanenku su tafi su yi hadaya ga Ubangiji.”
english: Then Pharaoh called for Moses and Aaron, and said, “Entreat Yahweh, that he take away the frogs from me and from my people; and I will let the people go, that they may sacrifice to Yahweh.”

hausa: amma mahaifiyar yaron ta ce, “A’a! Za a ce da shi Yohanna.”
english: His mother answered, “Not so; but he will be called John.”

hausa: Sai Festus ya ce, “Sarki Agiriffa, da kuma dukan waɗanda suke tare da mu, kun ga wannan mutum! Dukan jama’ar Yahudawa sun kawo mini kararsa a Urushalima da kuma a nan Kaisariya, suna kururuwa suna cewa bai kamata a bar shi da rai ba.
english: Festus said, “King Agrippa, and all men who are here present with us, you see this man about whom all the multitude of the Jews petitioned me, both at Jerusalem and here, crying that he ought not to live any longer.

hausa: Sai na sa shugabannin Yahuda suka haura zuwa bisan katangar. Na kuma sa manyan ƙungiyoyi biyu na mawaƙa su miƙa godiya. Ɗaya ya haura zuwa bisan katangar zuwa dama, wajen Ƙofar Juji.
english: Then I brought the princes of Judah up on the wall, and appointed two great companies who gave thanks and went in procession. One went on the right hand on the wall toward the dung gate;

hausa: “Ido shi ne fitilar jiki. In idanunka suna da kyau, dukan jikinka zai cika da haske.
english: “The lamp of the body is the eye. If therefore your eye is sound, your whole body will be full of light.

hausa: Kada ka bar waɗanda ake danniya su sha kunya; bari matalauta da mabukata su yabe sunanka.
english: Don’t let the oppressed return ashamed. Let the poor and needy praise your name.

hausa: Ta haka suka kashe shi, tare da ’ya’yansa maza da kuma dukan sojojinsa, ba wanda ya ragu. Suka kuma mamaye ƙasarsa.
english: So they struck him, with his sons and all his people, until there were no survivors; and they possessed his land.

hausa: Sai almajiran suka zo wurinsa suka ce, “Ka san cewa Farisiyawa ba su ji daɗi sa’ad da suka ji wannan ba?”
english: Then the disciples came and said to him, “Do you know that the Pharisees were offended when they heard this saying?”

hausa: Saboda haka Allah na Isra’ila ya zuga ruhun Ful sarkin Assuriya (wato, Tiglat-Fileser sarkin Assuriya), wanda ya kwashe mutanen Ruben, mutanen Gad da rabin kabilar Manasse zuwa zaman bauta. Ya kwashe su zuwa Hala, Habor, Hara da kuma kogin Gozan, inda suke har wa yau.
english: So the God of Israel stirred up the spirit of Pul king of Assyria, and the spirit of Tilgath Pilneser king of Assyria, and he carried away the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh, and brought them to Halah, Habor, Hara, and to the river of Gozan, to this day.

hausa: daga mazauninsa yana lura da dukan waɗanda suke zama a duniya,
english: From the place of his habitation he looks out on all the inhabitants of the earth,

hausa: Mutanen Keyila za su bashe ni a gare shi? Shawulu zai gangaro nan kamar yadda bawanka ya sami labari? Ya Ubangiji, Allah na Isra’ila, ka gaya wa bawanka.” Ubangiji ya ce, “Zai zo.”
english: Will the men of Keilah deliver me up into his hand? Will Saul come down, as your servant has heard? Yahweh, the God of Israel, I beg you, tell your servant.” Yahweh said, “He will come down.”

hausa: Abokaina ƙaunatattu, ko da yake na yi marmari ƙwarai in rubuta muku game da ceton nan namu, sai na ga ya dace in rubuta, in gargaɗe ku ku tsaya da ƙarfi cikin bangaskiya wadda aka danƙa wa mutane masu tsarki na Allah sau ɗaya tak.
english: Beloved, while I was very eager to write to you about our common salvation, I was constrained to write to you exhorting you to contend earnestly for the faith which was once for all delivered to the saints.

hausa: Hiridus dai ya ƙara ɓata al’amarin. Ya sa a kulle Yohanna a kurkuku.
english: added this also to them all, that he shut up John in prison.

hausa: Ba ni da salama, ba natsuwa; ba ni da hutu, sai wahala kawai.”
english: I am not at ease, neither am I quiet, neither do I have rest; but trouble comes.”

hausa: Suka gina masujadai na kan tudu na Ba’al don su ƙona ’ya’yansu maza a cikin wuta a matsayin hadaya ga Ba’al abin da ban umarta ba, ban ambata ba, bai kuma zo mini ba.
english: and have built the high places of Baal to burn their children in the fire for burnt offerings to Baal, which I didn’t command, nor speak, which didn’t even enter into my mind.

hausa: Da ya juya wajen Yeter, ɗan farinsa, sai ya ce, “Ka kashe su!” Amma Yeter bai zāre takobinsa ba, domin shi yaro ne kawai kuma yana tsoro.
english: He said to Jether his firstborn, “Get up and kill them!” But the youth didn’t draw his sword; for he was afraid, because he was yet a youth.

hausa: Sa’an nan ya karkashe dukan ’yan fari a cikin ƙasarsu, nunan fari na dukan mazantakarsu.
english: He struck also all the firstborn in their land, the first fruits of all their manhood.

hausa: Set ma ya haifi ɗa, ya kuma kira shi Enosh. A lokaci ne, mutane suka fara kira ga sunan Ubangiji.
english: A son was also born to Seth, and he named him Enosh. At that time men began to call on Yahweh’s name.

hausa: Sama’ila ya ce, “Ku tattara dukan Isra’ila a Mizfa, ni kuwa zan yi addu’a ga Ubangiji dominku.”
english: Samuel said, “Gather all Israel to Mizpah, and I will pray to Yahweh for you.”

hausa: Gama duk wanda yake magana da wani harshe ba da mutane yake magana ba, sai dai da Allah. Tabbatacce, ba wanda yake fahimtarsa; yana faɗin asirai ta wurin ruhu ne.
english: For he who speaks in another language speaks not to men, but to God, for no one understands, but in the Spirit he speaks mysteries.

hausa: Gama namiji bai fito daga mace ba, sai dai mace ce ta fito daga namiji.
english: For man is not from woman, but woman from man;

hausa: Wedan da Yaban kusa da Uzal, suka sayi kayanki; wato gyararren ƙarfe da kayan yaji.
english: “‘“Vedan and Javan traded with yarn for your wares; wrought iron, cassia, and calamus were among your merchandise.

hausa: Sai ya sauka nan da nan, ya karɓe shi da murna.
english: He hurried, came down, and received him joyfully.

hausa: Ko da yake itace ɓaure bai tohu ba, ba kuma ’ya’ya a kuringar inabi, ko da yake zaitun bai ba da amfani ba, gonaki kuma ba su ba da abinci ba, ko da yake babu tumaki a garke, ba kuma shanu a turaku,
english: For even though the fig tree doesn’t flourish, nor fruit be in the vines, the labor of the olive fails, the fields yield no food, the flocks are cut off from the fold, and there is no herd in the stalls,

hausa: Sa’ad da wannan ya faru, sauran marasa lafiya a tsibirin suka zo aka kuma warkar da su.
english: Then when this was done, the rest also who had diseases in the island came and were cured.

hausa: a can Barak ya kira Zebulun da Naftali. Mutum dubu goma suka kuma bi shi, Debora kuma tana tare da shi.
english: Barak called Zebulun and Naphtali together to Kedesh. Ten thousand men followed him; and Deborah went up with him.

hausa: “Ga abin da Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka yana cewa kawo taron mutane a kansu a kuma miƙa su don a firgitar da su a kuma washe su.
english: “For the Lord Yahweh says: ‘I will bring up a mob against them, and will give them to be tossed back and forth and robbed.

hausa: kuma duk wanda ya taɓa wani abu cikin abubuwan da suke a ƙarƙashin sirdin zai ƙazantu har yamma; duk wanda ya ɗauki abubuwan nan dole yă wanke rigunansa, yă kuma yi wanka, zai kuwa ƙazantu har yamma.
english: Whoever touches anything that was under him shall be unclean until the evening. He who carries those things shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening.

hausa: sai ya aiki ɗansa Hadoram zuwa wurin Sarki Dawuda yă gaishe shi yă kuma yi masa barka da nasara a yaƙi a kan Hadadezer, wanda yake yaƙi da Towu. Hadoram ya kawo kowane irin kayayyakin zinariya da na azurfa da na tagulla.
english: he sent Hadoram his son to King David to greet him and to bless him, because he had fought against Hadadezer and struck him (for Hadadezer had wars with Tou); and he had with him all kinds of vessels of gold and silver and bronze.

hausa: dokar Musa ta ba mu dokoki, mallakar taron Yaƙub.
english: Moses commanded us a law, an inheritance for the assembly of Jacob.

hausa: Amma dole kullum mu gode wa Allah dominku, ’yan’uwa waɗanda Ubangiji ya ƙaunace, domin daga farko Allah ya zaɓe ku don a cece ku ta wurin aikin tsarkakewar Ruhu da kuma ta wurin gaskatawa da gaskiya.
english: But we are bound to always give thanks to God for you, brothers loved by the Lord, because God chose you from the beginning for salvation through sanctification of the Spirit and belief in the truth,

hausa: “Zan kafa alama a cikinsu, zan kuma aika waɗansu da suka tsira zuwa al’ummai, zuwa Tarshish, zuwa Libiya da Lidiya (sanannun ’yan aika), zuwa Tubal da kuma Girka, da kuma zuwa manisantan tsibirai da ba su taɓa jin labarin sunana ba ko su ga ɗaukakata. Za su yi shelar ɗaukakata a cikin al’ummai.
english: “I will set a sign among them, and I will send those who escape of them to the nations, to Tarshish, Pul, and Lud, who draw the bow, to Tubal and Javan, to far-away islands, who have not heard my fame, nor have seen my glory; and they shall declare my glory among the nations.

hausa: Gideyon ya iso daidai wani yana faɗa wa wani aboki mafarkinsa, yana cewa, “Na yi mafarki, na ga dunƙule burodin sha’ir ya fāɗo a tsakiyar sansanin Midiyawa. Ya bugi tentin da ƙarfin da ya sa tenti ta kife a ƙasa.”
english: When Gideon had come, behold, there was a man telling a dream to his fellow. He said, “Behold, I dreamed a dream; and behold, a cake of barley bread tumbled into the camp of Midian, came to the tent, and struck it so that it fell, and turned it upside down, so that the tent lay flat.”

hausa: Ko da mutum yana so yă yi gardama da shi, ba zai taɓa amsa masa ba ko da sau ɗaya cikin dubu.
english: If he is pleased to contend with him, he can’t answer him one time in a thousand.

hausa: Sun jefar da gumakansu cikin wuta suka kuma hallaka su, gama su ba alloli ba ne itace ne kawai da dutse, da hannuwan mutane suka sarrafa.
english: and have cast their gods into the fire; for they were no gods, but the work of men’s hands, wood and stone; therefore they have destroyed them.

hausa: Saboda haka mun kawo wa Ubangiji hadaya na kayan zinariya da kowannenmu ya samu, mundaye, ƙawane, ’yan kunne da duwatsun wuya, don yin wa kanmu kafara a gaban Ubangiji.”
english: We have brought Yahweh’s offering, what every man found: gold ornaments, armlets, bracelets, signet rings, earrings, and necklaces, to make atonement for our souls before Yahweh.”

hausa: Daga wannan lokaci da yawa daga cikin almajiransa suka ja da baya, suka daina bin sa.
english: At this, many of his disciples went back and walked no more with him.

hausa: Hazar Shuwal, Beyersheba, Biziyotiya,
english: Hazar Shual, Beersheba, Biziothiah,

hausa: Sarki kuwa yana magana da Gehazi bawan mutumin Allah, ya ce masa, “Ba ni labarin dukan abubuwan banmamakin da Elisha ya yi.”
english: Now the king was talking with Gehazi the servant of the man of God, saying, “Please tell me all the great things that Elisha has done.”

hausa: da na yi baƙunci, ba ku karɓe ni ba, da nake bukatar tufafi, ba ku yi mini sutura ba, da na yi rashin lafiya kuma ina a kurkuku, ba ku lura da ni ba.’
english: I was a stranger, and you didn’t take me in; naked, and you didn’t clothe me; sick, and in prison, and you didn’t visit me.’

hausa: Za a tsarkake kowa da wuta.
english: For everyone will be salted with fire, and every sacrifice will be seasoned with salt.

hausa: Maganar Ubangiji ta zo mini cewa,
english: Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

hausa: Yabo ya tabbata ga Ubangiji, Allah na Isra’ila, har abada abadin.
english: Blessed be Yahweh, the God of Israel, from everlasting and to everlasting! Amen and amen.

hausa: Kada ka fid da ni daga gabanka ko ka ɗauke Ruhunka Mai Tsarki daga gare ni.
english: Don’t throw me from your presence, and don’t take your Holy Spirit from me.

hausa: Tana lura da sha’anin gidanta kuma ba ta cin abincin ƙyuya.
english: She looks well to the ways of her household, and doesn’t eat the bread of idleness.

hausa: Bayan kwana biyun nan sai ya bar can zuwa Galili.
english: After the two days he went out from there and went into Galilee.

hausa: da ƙodoji biyu tare da kitsen da yake kansu kusa da kwiɓi, da kuma murfin hanta waɗanda zai cire tare da ƙodoji.
english: and the two kidneys, and the fat that is on them, which is by the loins, and the cover on the liver, with the kidneys, he shall take away.

hausa: A ƙarƙashin fikafikansu huɗu suna da hannuwan mutum a kowane gefe. Dukansu huɗu suna da fuskoki da fikafikai,
english: They had the hands of a man under their wings on their four sides. The four of them had their faces and their wings like this:

hausa: Amma ’ya’yansa ba su bi hanyar mahaifinsu ba. Suka mai da hankalinsu ga neman kuɗi da cin hanci, suna kuma danne gaskiya.
english: His sons didn’t walk in his ways, but turned away after dishonest gain, took bribes, and perverted justice.

hausa: Sa’ad da tsawan nan bakwai kuwa suka yi magana, ina dab da rubutawa; amma na ji wata murya daga sama ta ce, “Rufe abin da tsawan nan bakwai suka faɗa kada ka rubuta.”
english: When the seven thunders sounded, I was about to write; but I heard a voice from the sky saying, “Seal up the things which the seven thunders said, and don’t write them.”

hausa: “Mene ne mutum har da ka kula da shi haka, har ka mai da hankali a kansa,
english: What is man, that you should magnify him, that you should set your mind on him,

hausa: An kuma haɗa ku a cikin Kiristi lokacin da kuka ji saƙon nan na gaskiya, wanda yake labari mai daɗi na cetonku. Da kuka ba da gaskiya, sai aka yi muku alamar shaida a cikinsa da Ruhu Mai Tsarki.
english: In him you also, having heard the word of the truth, the Good News of your salvation—in whom, having also believed, you were sealed with the promised Holy Spirit,

hausa: sa’ad da ƙura ta yi yawa ta daskare a wuri ɗaya?
english: when the dust runs into a mass, and the clods of earth stick together?

hausa: An faɗa mini ta wurin maganar Ubangiji, ‘Kada ka ci abinci, ko ka sha ruwa a can, ko ka koma ta hanyar da ka zo.’ ”
english: For it was said to me by Yahweh’s word, ‘You shall eat no bread or drink water there, and don’t turn again to go by the way that you came.’”

hausa: Suka bi sawunsu har Urdun, suka ga tufafi da makamai barjat ko’ina a hanya waɗanda Arameyawa suka zubar yayinda suke gudu. Sai ’yan aika suka dawo suka ba wa sarki labari.
english: They went after them to the Jordan; and behold, all the path was full of garments and equipment which the Syrians had cast away in their haste. The messengers returned and told the king.

hausa: “Ka ɗauki sandanka, kai da Haruna, ɗan’uwanka, ku tara jama’a, ku yi magana da dutsen a gabansu ya ba da ruwan da yake cikinsa. Za ka sa ruwa ya ɓuɓɓugo musu daga dutsen. Ta haka za ka ba taron jama’a da garkunansu ruwan sha.”
english: “Take the rod, and assemble the congregation, you, and Aaron your brother, and speak to the rock before their eyes, that it pour out its water. You shall bring water to them out of the rock; so you shall give the congregation and their livestock drink.”

hausa: Sai ya ce, “Ku ne aka ba sanin asirin mulkin Allah, amma ga sauran mutane kam, ina magana da misalai, saboda, “ ‘ko da yake suna kallo, ba za su gani ba, ko da yake suna ji, ba za su gane ba.’
english: He said, “To you it is given to know the mysteries of God’s Kingdom, but to the rest it is given in parables, that ‘seeing they may not see, and hearing they may not understand.’

hausa: Za su cinye amfanin gonakinku da abincinku, za su cinye ’ya’yanku maza da mata; za su cinye garkunan tumakinku da na awakinku, za su cinye ’ya’yan inabinku da na ɓaurenku. Da takobi za su hallaka biranenku masu katanga.
english: They will eat up your harvest and your bread, which your sons and your daughters should eat. They will eat up your flocks and your herds. They will eat up your vines and your fig trees. They will beat down your fortified cities in which you trust with the sword.

hausa: “A wannan rana zan maido da tentin Dawuda da ya fāɗi. Zan gyaggyara wuraren da suka yayyage, in kuma maido da kufansa in gina shi kamar yadda yake a dā,
english: In that day I will raise up the tent of David who is fallen and close up its breaches, and I will raise up its ruins, and I will build it as in the days of old,

hausa: Waɗansunsu su ne suke lura da kayayyakin da ake amfani da su a hidimar haikali; sukan ƙirga su sa’ad da ake shigar da su da sa’ad da ake fitar da su.
english: Certain of them were in charge of the vessels of service, for these were brought in by count, and these were taken out by count.

hausa: Wata rana sa’ad da Yesu yana addu’a a ɓoye, almajiransa kuma suna tare da shi, sai ya tambaye, su ya ce, “Wa, taron mutane ke ce da ni?”
english: As he was praying alone, the disciples were near him, and he asked them, “Who do the multitudes say that I am?”

hausa: “Ku shirya hanyoyi marasa gargaɗa saboda ƙafafunku,” don kada guragu su daɗa gurguntawa, sai dai su warke.
english: and make straight paths for your feet, so what is lame may not be dislocated, but rather be healed.

hausa: Ham, mahaifin Kan’ana ya ga tsiraici mahaifinsa, ya kuma faɗa wa ’yan’uwansa biyu a waje.
english: Ham, the father of Canaan, saw the nakedness of his father, and told his two brothers outside.

hausa: Amma bayan na tumɓuke su, zan sāke jin tausayi in komo da kowannensu zuwa gādonsa da kuma ƙasarsa.
english: It will happen that after I have plucked them up, I will return and have compassion on them. I will bring them again, every man to his heritage, and every man to his land.

hausa: Ashe, ba ku san cewa waɗanda suke hidima a haikali suna samun abincinsu daga haikali ba ne, waɗanda kuma suke hidima a bagade suna samun rabo a hadayar da suka miƙa ba ne?
english: Don’t you know that those who serve around sacred things eat from the things of the temple, and those who wait on the altar have their portion with the altar?

hausa: Aka kafa tushen da manyan duwatsu masu kyau, tsayin waɗansunsu ya kai kamu goma, waɗansu kuma kamu takwas.
english: The foundation was of costly stones, even great stones, stones of ten cubits and stones of eight cubits.

hausa: Saboda haka na yi rantsuwa a cikin fushina, ‘Ba za su taɓa shiga hutuna ba.’ ”
english: As I swore in my wrath, ‘They will not enter into my rest.’”

hausa: Me za ku yi a ƙayyadaddiyar ranar bukukkuwarku, a ranakun bikin Ubangiji?
english: What will you do in the day of solemn assembly, and in the day of the feast of Yahweh?

hausa: Ina gaya maka, ba za ka fita ba, sai ka biya kobo na ƙarshe.”
english: I tell you, you will by no means get out of there until you have paid the very last penny.”

hausa: Dukanku ’ya’yan Allah ne ta wurin bangaskiya cikin Kiristi Yesu.
english: For you are all children of God, through faith in Christ Jesus.

hausa: Azaban mugu da yawa suke, amma ƙaunar Ubangiji marar ƙarewa kan kewaye mutumin da ya dogara gare shi.
english: Many sorrows come to the wicked, but loving kindness shall surround him who trusts in Yahweh.

hausa: Sa’ad da dukan Isra’ilawan da suka ɓuya a duwatsu a ƙasar Efraim suka ji labari cewa Filistiyawa suna gudu, sai suka fito suka fafare su.
english: Likewise all the men of Israel who had hidden themselves in the hill country of Ephraim, when they heard that the Philistines fled, even they also followed hard after them in the battle.

hausa: Ko da ya ƙasaita ya kai sararin sama, kansa kuma yana taɓa gizagizai.
english: Though his height mount up to the heavens, and his head reach to the clouds,

hausa: Duk da haka ka fitar da ni daga ciki; ka sa na dogara gare ka, ko ma a ƙirjin mahaifiyata.
english: But you brought me out of the womb. You made me trust while at my mother’s breasts.

hausa: turakun tenti don tabanakul da kuma don filin, da igiyoyinsu;
english: the pins of the tabernacle, the pins of the court, and their cords;

hausa: Ɓangarorin Matsaran Ƙofofi su ne, Daga Korayawa, Meshelemiya ɗan Kore, ɗaya daga cikin ’ya’yan Asaf maza.
english: For the divisions of the doorkeepers: of the Korahites, Meshelemiah the son of Kore, of the sons of Asaph.

hausa: Sai ya naɗa masa rawani, daga gaban rawanin ya sa allon zinariya, wato, kambi tsattsarka, kamar yadda Ubangiji ya umarce shi.
english: He set the turban on his head. He set the golden plate, the holy crown, on the front of the turban, as Yahweh commanded Moses.

hausa: Suka amsa, suka ce, “Waɗansu suna cewa, Yohanna Mai Baftisma, waɗansu Iliya, waɗansu kuma har wa yau sun ce, ɗaya daga cikin annabawa.”
english: They told him, “John the Baptizer, and others say Elijah, but others, one of the prophets.”

hausa: Amma mabiyan Omri suka nuna sun fi na Tibni ɗan Ginat ƙarfi. Sai Tibni ya mutu, Omri kuwa ya zama sarki.
english: But the people who followed Omri prevailed against the people who followed Tibni the son of Ginath; so Tibni died, and Omri reigned.

hausa: Yusuf yana zuwa shekara talatin sa’ad da ya shiga hidimar Fir’auna sarkin Masar. Yusuf kuwa ya fita daga gaban Fir’auna, ya zaga ko’ina a Masar.
english: Joseph was thirty years old when he stood before Pharaoh king of Egypt. Joseph went out from the presence of Pharaoh, and went throughout all the land of Egypt.

hausa: Mutane suka bauta wa Ubangiji duk tsawon kwanakin Yoshuwa da na dattawan da suka rayu bayansa waɗanda suka ga manyan abubuwan da Ubangiji ya yi wa Isra’ila.
english: The people served Yahweh all the days of Joshua, and all the days of the elders who outlived Joshua, who had seen all the great work of Yahweh that he had worked for Israel.

hausa: Zai zama mutum mai halin jakin jeji. Hannunsa zai yi gāba da kowa, hannun kowa kuma zai yi gāba da shi. Zai yi zama gāba ga dukan ’yan’uwansa.”
english: He will be like a wild donkey among men. His hand will be against every man, and every man’s hand against him. He will live opposed to all of his brothers.”

hausa: Na zama kamar abin sa zuciya ga yawanci, amma kai ne katangata mai ƙarfi.
english: I am a marvel to many, but you are my strong refuge.

hausa: Saboda haka zan sa sammai su yi rawar jiki; duniya kuma za tă girgiza daga inda take a fushin Ubangiji Maɗaukaki, a ranar fushinsa mai ƙuna.
english: Therefore I will make the heavens tremble, and the earth will be shaken out of its place in Yahweh of Armies’ wrath, and in the day of his fierce anger.

hausa: Mutum ɗari uku sun tanɗi ruwa, dukan sauran kuwa suka durƙusa suka sha ruwan.
english: The number of those who lapped, putting their hand to their mouth, was three hundred men; but all the rest of the people bowed down on their knees to drink water.

hausa: Abimelek ya zauna a Aruma, Zebul kuwa ya kori Ga’al da ’yan’uwansa daga Shekem.
english: Abimelech lived at Arumah; and Zebul drove out Gaal and his brothers, that they should not dwell in Shechem.

hausa: Amma mutanen Dawuda suka ce masa, “Ga shi, a nan ma a Yahuda muna jin tsoro, balle mu tafi Keyila mu yi yaƙi da sojojin Filistiyawa!”
english: David’s men said to him, “Behold, we are afraid here in Judah. How much more then if we go to Keilah against the armies of the Philistines?”

hausa: Kowa ya riga ya ji game da biyayyarku, don haka ina cike da farin ciki game da ku; amma ina so ku zama masu hikima game da abin da yake nagari, ku kuma zama marasa laifi ga abin da yake mugu.
english: For your obedience has become known to all. I rejoice therefore over you. But I desire to have you wise in that which is good, but innocent in that which is evil.

hausa: Sa’an nan ni, Daniyel, na duba, a gabana kuwa ga waɗansu mutum biyu tsaye, ɗaya a wannan hayen kogi ɗaya kuma a ƙetaren kogin.
english: Then I, Daniel, looked, and behold, two others stood, one on the river bank on this side, and the other on the river bank on that side.

hausa: Sa’an nan Ubangiji ya ce wa Musa, “Zuciyar Fir’auna taurariya ce, ya ƙi yă bar mutanen su tafi.
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “Pharaoh’s heart is stubborn. He refuses to let the people go.

hausa: Haruna ya amsa ya ce, “Kada ka yi fushi da ni ranka yă daɗe, ka san yadda mutanen nan suke da saurin yin mugunta.
english: Aaron said, “Don’t let the anger of my lord grow hot. You know the people, that they are set on evil.

hausa: a shekara ta farko ta mulkinsa, ni, Daniyel na gane daga cikin littattafai, bisa ga maganar Ubangiji da aka faɗa wa annabi Irmiya, cewa zaman Urushalima kango zai kai shekara saba’in.
english: in the first year of his reign I, Daniel, understood by the books the number of the years about which Yahweh’s word came to Jeremiah the prophet for the accomplishing of the desolations of Jerusalem, even seventy years.

hausa: Zan sa shi a hannuwan masu gwada miki azaba, waɗanda suke ce miki, ‘Fāɗi rubda ciki don mu iya taka a kanki.’ Kika kuma mai da bayanki kamar ƙasa, kamar titin da ake takawa a kai.”
english: I will put it into the hand of those who afflict you, who have said to your soul, ‘Bow down, that we may walk over you;’ and you have laid your back as the ground, like a street to those who walk over.”

hausa: Sa’ad da ka zauna domin cin abinci da mai mulki, ka lura sosai da abin da yake gabanka,
english: When you sit to eat with a ruler, consider diligently what is before you;

hausa: Wane ne yake da hikima? Zai gane waɗannan abubuwa. Hanyoyin Ubangiji daidai ne; masu adalci sukan yi tafiya a kansu, amma ’yan tawaye sukan yi tuntuɓe a kansu.
english: Who is wise, that he may understand these things? Who is prudent, that he may know them? For the ways of Yahweh are right, and the righteous walk in them, but the rebellious stumble in them.

hausa: Obed-Edom shi ma yana da ’ya’ya maza. Shemahiya ɗan fari, Yehozabad na biyu, Yowa na uku, Sakar na huɗu Netanel na biyar,
english: Obed-Edom had sons: Shemaiah the firstborn, Jehozabad the second, Joah the third, Sacar the fourth, Nethanel the fifth,

hausa: kogon da yake cikin filin Makfela, kusa da Mamre a Kan’ana, wanda Ibrahim ya saya tare da filin, yă zama makabarta daga Efron mutumin Hitti.
english: in the cave that is in the field of Machpelah, which is before Mamre, in the land of Canaan, which Abraham bought with the field from Ephron the Hittite as a burial place.

hausa: haka yake da mutumin da ya ruɗe maƙwabci sa’an nan ya ce, “Wasa ne kawai nake yi!”
english: is the man who deceives his neighbor and says, “Am I not joking?”

hausa: Na mutanen Shilo kuwa su ne, Asahiya ɗan fari da ’ya’yansa maza.
english: Of the Shilonites: Asaiah the firstborn and his sons.

hausa: Abimelek da ƙungiyoyin da suke tare da shi suka yi maza suka yi tsaya a ƙofar birnin. Sa’an nan ƙungiyoyi biyu suka ruga suka fāɗa wa waɗanda suke a gonaki suka karkashe su.
english: Abimelech and the companies that were with him rushed forward and stood in the entrance of the gate of the city; and the two companies rushed on all who were in the field and struck them.

hausa: Ku tuna fa, duk wanda ya yi shuki kaɗan zai girbe kaɗan, kuma duk wanda ya yi shuki da yawa, zai girbe a yalwace.
english: Remember this: he who sows sparingly will also reap sparingly. He who sows bountifully will also reap bountifully.

hausa: sai ka ji daga sama ka kuma gafarta zunubin bayinka, mutanenka Isra’ila. Ka koya musu hanyar da ta dace da za su yi zama, ka kuma aika ruwan sama a ƙasar da ka ba mutanenka gādo.
english: then hear in heaven, and forgive the sin of your servants, your people Israel, when you teach them the good way in which they should walk, and send rain on your land, which you have given to your people for an inheritance.

hausa: Lokacin da bala’i ya kawo ga mutuwa, yakan yi dariyar baƙin cikin marasa laifi.
english: If the scourge kills suddenly, he will mock at the trial of the innocent.

hausa: Ayyukansa masu ɗaukaka da kuma daraja ne, adalcinsa kuma zai dawwama har abada.
english: His work is honor and majesty. His righteousness endures forever.

hausa: Amma ba su saurara ba, ba su kuwa kula ba; a maimako, suka bi shawarar kansu da ta taurare muguwar zukatansu. Su ja da baya a maimakon yin gaba.
english: But they didn’t listen or turn their ear, but walked in their own counsels and in the stubbornness of their evil heart, and went backward, and not forward.

hausa: Ku gai da Firiskila da Akwila, abokan aikina cikin Kiristi Yesu.
english: Greet Prisca and Aquila, my fellow workers in Christ Jesus,

hausa: Dukan ’yan ƙwari masu fikafikai masu rarrafe, haram ne a gare ku, kada ku ci su.
english: All winged creeping things are unclean to you. They shall not be eaten.

hausa: “Saboda haka ɗan mutum, ka tattara kayanka don zuwa zaman bauta, ka tashi da rana suna gani ka ƙaura a inda kake zuwa wani wuri. Mai yiwuwa za su gane, ko da yake su gidan ’yan tawaye ne.
english: “Therefore, you son of man, prepare your baggage for moving, and move by day in their sight. You shall move from your place to another place in their sight. It may be they will consider, though they are a rebellious house.

hausa: Da tsakar dare nakan tashi in gode maka saboda dokokinka masu adalci.
english: At midnight I will rise to give thanks to you, because of your righteous ordinances.

hausa: saboda haka zan tattara dukan kwartayenki, waɗanda kike jin daɗinsu, waɗanda kike ƙauna da waɗanda kike ƙi. Zan tattara su gāba da ke daga dukan kewaye zan kuma tuɓe ki a gabansu, za su kuwa ga dukan tsiraicinki.
english: therefore see, I will gather all your lovers, with whom you have taken pleasure, and all those whom you have loved, with all those whom you have hated. I will even gather them against you on every side, and will uncover your nakedness to them, that they may see all your nakedness.

hausa: Sarki Dawuda ya miƙe tsaye ya ce, “Ku saurare ni, ’yan’uwana da kuma mutanena. Na yi niyya in gina gida a matsayin wurin hutu domin akwatin alkawarin Ubangiji, domin zatin Allahnmu, na kuma yi shiri don in gina shi.
english: Then David the king stood up on his feet and said, “Hear me, my brothers and my people! As for me, it was in my heart to build a house of rest for the ark of Yahweh’s covenant, and for the footstool of our God; and I had prepared for the building.

hausa: Mawadaci yakan yi mulki a kan matalauci, mai cin bashi kuwa bawan mai ba da bashi ne.
english: The rich rule over the poor. The borrower is servant to the lender.

hausa: Yanzu ka bar ni kurum fushina yă yi ƙuna a kansu, in hallaka su. Sa’an nan in maishe ka al’umma mai girma.
english: Now therefore leave me alone, that my wrath may burn hot against them, and that I may consume them; and I will make of you a great nation.”

hausa: Waɗanda suka juya daga bin Ubangiji, ba sa kuma neman Ubangiji ko su nemi nufinsa.”
english: those who have turned back from following Yahweh, and those who haven’t sought Yahweh nor inquired after him.

hausa: Waɗansu sukan zubar da zinariya daga jaka su kuma auna azurfa a ma’auni; sukan yi haya maƙerin zinariya don yă ƙera allah, su kuma rusuna su yi masa sujada.
english: Some pour out gold from the bag, and weigh silver in the balance. They hire a goldsmith, and he makes it a god. They fall down— yes, they worship.

hausa: Mutum ba zai ƙara koya wa maƙwabci ba, ko ya koya wa ɗan’uwansa cewa, ‘Ka san Ubangiji,’ domin duk za su san ni, daga ƙaraminsu har zuwa babba,” in ji Ubangiji. “Gama zan gafarta muguntarsu ba zan kuwa ƙara tuna da zunubansu ba.”
english: They will no longer each teach his neighbor, and every man teach his brother, saying, ‘Know Yahweh;’ for they will all know me, from their least to their greatest,” says Yahweh, “for I will forgive their iniquity, and I will remember their sin no more.”

hausa: Ba shi da amfani a kafa tarko a idanun dukan tsuntsaye!
english: For the net is spread in vain in the sight of any bird;

hausa: “Ni Ubangiji, na kira ka cikin adalci; zan riƙe hannunka. Zan kiyaye ka in kuma sa ka zama alkawari ga mutane haske kuma ga Al’ummai,
english: “I, Yahweh, have called you in righteousness. I will hold your hand. I will keep you, and make you a covenant for the people, as a light for the nations,

hausa: Sai na ce wa firistoci da dukan waɗannan mutane, “Ga abin da Ubangiji yana cewa, kada ku saurari annabawan da suke cewa, ‘Ba daɗewa ba za a komo da kayan gidan Ubangiji daga Babilon.’ Suna muku annabcin ƙarya ne.
english: Also I spoke to the priests and to all this people, saying, Yahweh says, “Don’t listen to the words of your prophets who prophesy to you, saying, ‘Behold, the vessels of Yahweh’s house will now shortly be brought again from Babylon;’ for they prophesy a lie to you.

hausa: Wane ne ya auna ruwaye a tafin hannunsa, ko kuwa ya gwada tsawon sammai da fāɗin tafin hannunsa? Wane ne ya riƙe ƙurar ƙasa a kwando, ko kuwa ya auna nauyin duwatsu a magwaji, tuddai kuma a ma’auni?
english: Who has measured the waters in the hollow of his hand, and marked off the sky with his span, and calculated the dust of the earth in a measuring basket, and weighed the mountains in scales, and the hills in a balance?

hausa: Zuciyar mutane ta yi kuka ga Ubangiji. Ya bangon Diyar Urushalima, bar hawayenki su zuba kamar rafi dare da rana; kada ki huta, kada idanunki su huta.
english: Their heart cried to the Lord. O wall of the daughter of Zion, let tears run down like a river day and night. Give yourself no relief. Don’t let your eyes rest.

hausa: Bayan shekaru biyu, sa’ad da masu askin tumakin Absalom suna Ba’al-Hazor, kusa da iyakar Efraim, sai ya gayyaci dukan ’ya’yan sarki maza a can.
english: After two full years, Absalom had sheep shearers in Baal Hazor, which is beside Ephraim; and Absalom invited all the king’s sons.

hausa: Ashe, Amana da Farfa, kogunan da suke Damaskus, ba su fi dukan ruwan da suke Isra’ila ba? Me zai sa ba zan nutse cikinsu in tsarkaka ba?” Sai ya juya ya yi tafiyarsa da fushi.
english: Aren’t Abanah and Pharpar, the rivers of Damascus, better than all the waters of Israel? Couldn’t I wash in them and be clean?” So he turned and went away in a rage.

hausa: “Kada ku ci zalin gwauruwa, ko maraya.
english: “You shall not take advantage of any widow or fatherless child.

hausa: “ ‘Ga abin da Ubangiji Maɗaukaki, Allah na Isra’ila yana cewa ci gaba, ku ƙara hadayun ƙonawarku da sauran sadakoki ku kuma yi ta cin naman!
english: Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel says: “Add your burnt offerings to your sacrifices and eat meat.

hausa: Amma Yesu da yake ya san mugun nufinsu, sai ya ce, “Ku munafukai, don me kuke ƙoƙarin sa mini tarko?
english: But Jesus perceived their wickedness, and said, “Why do you test me, you hypocrites?

hausa: Za a albarkace ku fiye da waɗansu mutane; babu wani cikin maza ko matanku da zai kasance babu haihuwa, ba kuwa wata dabbarku da za tă kasance babu haihuwa.
english: You will be blessed above all peoples. There won’t be male or female barren among you, or among your livestock.

hausa: Sai Musa ya umarci Isra’ilawa ya ce, “Ku raba wannan ƙasa da za ku gāda ta hanyar jefa ƙuri’a. Ubangiji ya umarta cewa a ba da ita ga kabilu tara da rabi,
english: Moses commanded the children of Israel, saying, “This is the land which you shall inherit by lot, which Yahweh has commanded to give to the nine tribes, and to the half-tribe;

hausa: Amma ya fid da mabukata daga wahalarsu ya kuma ƙara iyalansu da tumakinsu.
english: Yet he lifts the needy out of their affliction, and increases their families like a flock.

hausa: Ke lambun maɓulɓula ne, rijiya mai ruwan da yake gudu yana gangarawa daga Lebanon.
english: a fountain of gardens, a well of living waters, flowing streams from Lebanon.

hausa: Kuna ce da ni ‘Malam’ da kuma ‘Ubangiji,’ daidai ne kuwa, gama haka nake.
english: You call me, ‘Teacher’ and ‘Lord.’ You say so correctly, for so I am.

hausa: Bulala don doki, linzami don jaki, sanda kuma don bayan wawaye!
english: A whip is for the horse, a bridle for the donkey, and a rod for the back of fools!

hausa: Zenan, Hadasha, Migdal Gad,
english: Zenan, Hadashah, Migdal Gad,

hausa: Ba kai ba ne, ya Allah, kai da ka ƙi mu ba ka kuwa fita tare da mayaƙanmu?
english: Haven’t you, God, rejected us? You don’t go out with our armies, God.

hausa: Ka hukunta shi da sanda ka ceci ransa daga mutuwa.
english: Punish him with the rod, and save his soul from Sheol.

hausa: “ ‘Ku duba, ku masu ba’a, ku yi mamaki, ku hallaka, gama zan yi wani abu a zamaninku da ba za ku taɓa gaskatawa ba ko da wani ya gaya muku.’”
english: ‘Behold, you scoffers! Wonder and perish, for I work a work in your days, a work which you will in no way believe, if one declares it to you.’”

hausa: Suka yi haka. Suka ɗauki shanun tatsa guda biyu suka ɗaura musu keken shanu, suka tsare ’yan maruƙansu a gida.
english: The men did so, and took two milk cows and tied them to the cart, and shut up their calves at home.

hausa: “ ‘Amma in suka tuba daga zunubansu da zunuban kakanninsu, da cin amanar da suka yi mini, da kuma adawar da suka yi da ni,
english: “‘If they confess their iniquity and the iniquity of their fathers, in their trespass which they trespassed against me; and also that because they walked contrary to me,

hausa: Bege kuwa ba ya ba mu kunya, domin Allah ya zuba ƙaunarsa a zukatanmu ta wurin Ruhu Mai Tsarkin da ya ba mu.
english: and hope doesn’t disappoint us, because God’s love has been poured into our hearts through the Holy Spirit who was given to us.

hausa: Ubangiji ya ce wa Musa,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

hausa: bari a kawo rigar sarautar da sarki ya taɓa sawa, da kuma dokin da sarki ya taɓa hawa, wanda aka sa kambin sarauta a kai.
english: let royal clothing be brought which the king uses to wear, and the horse that the king rides on, and on the head of which a royal crown is set.

hausa: Sa’an nan suka dalaye shi da zinariya zalla, suka kuma yi zubi na zinariya kewaye da shi.
english: He overlaid it with pure gold, and made a gold molding around it.

hausa: Suka hallaka dukan ƙauyukan kewaye da Gerar, gama tsoron Ubangiji ya kama su. Suka kwashi ganima na dukan ƙauyukan nan, da yake akwai ganima sosai a can.
english: They struck all the cities around Gerar, for the fear of Yahweh came on them. They plundered all the cities, for there was much plunder in them.

hausa: Duba! Gaggafa tana firiya tana kuma saukowa, tana buɗe fikafikanta a bisa Bozra. A wannan rana zukatan jarumawan Edom za su zama kamar macen da take naƙuda.
english: Behold, he will come up and fly as the eagle, and spread out his wings against Bozrah. The heart of the mighty men of Edom at that day will be as the heart of a woman in her pangs.

hausa: Ku kuma san cewa, ba ku da ikon sa firistoci, da Lawiyawa, da mawaƙa, da masu tsaron ƙofofin haikali, da masu aiki a gidan Allah, ko waɗansu masu aiki a haikali su biya haraji, ko kuɗin shiga.
english: Also we inform you that it shall not be lawful to impose tribute, custom, or toll on any of the priests, Levites, singers, gatekeepers, temple servants, or laborers of this house of God.

hausa: Har wa yau a wani yaƙin da aka yi a Gat, akwai wani ƙaton mutum mai yatsotsi shida a kowane hannu, da kuma yatsotsi shida a kowane ƙafa, yatsotsi ashirin da huɗu ke nan. Shi ma daga zuriya Rafa ne.
english: There was again war at Gath, where there was a man of great stature, who had six fingers on every hand and six toes on every foot, twenty-four in number, and he also was born to the giant.

hausa: Alheri da salama daga Allah Ubanmu da kuma Ubangiji Yesu Kiristi, su kasance tare ku.
english: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

hausa: Isuwa ya ce, “Duba, ina gab da mutuwa, me matsayina na ɗan fari zai yi mini?”
english: Esau said, “Behold, I am about to die. What good is the birthright to me?”

hausa: Da taron suka lura cewa Yesu da almajiransa ba sa can, sai suka shiga jiragen ruwa suka tafi Kafarnahum neman Yesu.
english: When the multitude therefore saw that Jesus wasn’t there, nor his disciples, they themselves got into the boats and came to Capernaum, seeking Jesus.

hausa: Na yi tunani a kan farillanka na kuma lura da hanyoyinka.
english: I will meditate on your precepts, and consider your ways.

hausa: Dukan wannan yana tabbatar cewa hukuncin Allah daidai ne, saboda haka kuma za a lissafta ku a kan kun cancanci mulkin Allah, wanda dominsa ne kuke shan wahala.
english: This is an obvious sign of the righteous judgment of God, to the end that you may be counted worthy of God’s Kingdom, for which you also suffer.

hausa: Efraim ya haɗa kai da gumaka; ku ƙyale shi kurum!
english: Ephraim is joined to idols. Leave him alone!

hausa: “Zuwa ga mala’ikan ikkilisiya a Sardis, ka rubuta, Waɗannan su ne kalmomi, na wanda yake riƙe da ruhohi bakwai na Allah da kuma taurari bakwai. Na san ayyukanka; ana ganinka kamar rayayye, amma kai matacce ne.
english: “And to the angel of the assembly in Sardis write: “He who has the seven Spirits of God and the seven stars says these things: “I know your works, that you have a reputation of being alive, but you are dead.

hausa: “Ga ƙa’idar da za a bi in mutum ya mutu a cikin tenti. Duk wanda ya shiga tentin, kuma duk wanda yake cikinsa, za su zama da ƙazanta har kwana bakwai,
english: “This is the law when a man dies in a tent: everyone who comes into the tent, and everyone who is in the tent, shall be unclean seven days.

hausa: Kakan cece mai sauƙinkai amma kakan ƙasƙantar da masu girman kai.
english: For you will save the afflicted people, but the arrogant eyes you will bring down.

hausa: “Muddin ina raye, in ji Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka, ba za ku ƙara faɗar wannan karin magana a Isra’ila ba.
english: “As I live,” says the Lord Yahweh, “you shall not use this proverb any more in Israel.

hausa: Ƙanshin turarenka mai daɗi ne; sunanka kuwa kamar turaren da aka tsiyaye ne. Shi ya sa mata suke ƙaunarka!
english: Your oils have a pleasing fragrance. Your name is oil poured out, therefore the virgins love you.

hausa: Za a ƙyale kagarar, a gudu a bar birnin da dā ake hayaniya; mafaka da hasumiyar tsaro za su zama kango har abada, jin daɗin jakuna, makiyaya don garkuna,
english: For the palace will be forsaken. The populous city will be deserted. The hill and the watchtower will be for dens forever, a delight for wild donkeys, a pasture of flocks,

hausa: Sai Esta ta kira Hatak, ɗaya daga cikin bābānnin sarkin da aka ba shi aikin lura da ita, ta umarce shi yă yi tambaya me ke damun Mordekai da kuma me ya jawo haka.
english: Then Esther called for Hathach, one of the king’s eunuchs, whom he had appointed to attend her, and commanded him to go to Mordecai, to find out what this was, and why it was.

hausa: Game da sauran ayyukan mulkin Ahab, haɗe da dukan abin da ya yi, da fadan da ya gina ya kuma shimfiɗa da hauren giwa, da biranen da ya gina, duk a rubuce suke a cikin littafin tarihin sarakunan Isra’ila.
english: Now the rest of the acts of Ahab, and all that he did, and the ivory house which he built, and all the cities that he built, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

hausa: Za ku zauna a ƙasar da na ba wa kakanninku; za ku zama mutanena, ni kuwa zan zama Allahnku.
english: You will dwell in the land that I gave to your fathers. You will be my people, and I will be your God.

hausa: arautaki; kwanonin yayyafawa, kwanoni da hantsuka; da kuma ƙofofin zinariya na haikali, ƙofofi na ciki zuwa Wuri Mafi Tsarki da kuma ƙofofin babban zaure.
english: and the snuffers, the basins, the spoons, and the fire pans of pure gold. As for the entry of the house, its inner doors for the most holy place and the doors of the main hall of the temple were of gold.

hausa: Da tsoro mai yawa da kuma damuwa, Yaƙub ya rarraba mutanen da suke tare da shi ƙungiyoyi biyu, haka ma garkunan tumaki da awaki, da garkunan shanu da raƙuma.
english: Then Jacob was greatly afraid and was distressed. He divided the people who were with him, along with the flocks, the herds, and the camels, into two companies.

hausa: Ta bangon waje na shirayin hanyar shiga, kusa da matakai a mashigin zuwa hanyar shiga da take arewa akwai tebur biyu, akwai kuma tebur biyu a gefe ɗaya na matakan.
english: On the one side outside, as one goes up to the entry of the gate toward the north, were two tables; and on the other side, which belonged to the porch of the gate, were two tables.

hausa: “Domin me Maɗaukaki ba zai sa ranar shari’a ba? Don me waɗanda suka san shi suke faman samun irin ranakun nan?
english: “Why aren’t times laid up by the Almighty? Why don’t those who know him see his days?

hausa: Makafi suna gani, guragu suna tafiya, ana warkar da waɗanda suke da kuturta, kurame suna ji, ana tā da matattu, ana kuma yi wa matalauta wa’azin labari mai daɗi.
english: the blind receive their sight, the lame walk, the lepers are cleansed, the deaf hear, the dead are raised up, and the poor have good news preached to them.

hausa: Na ba ta lokaci tă tuba daga fasikancinta, amma ba ta da niyya.
english: I gave her time to repent, but she refuses to repent of her sexual immorality.

hausa: Amma ina so in yi magana da Maɗaukaki, in kai kukana wurin Allah kai tsaye.
english: “Surely I would speak to the Almighty. I desire to reason with God.

hausa: ‘Daga wannan rana zuwa gaba, wato, rana ta ashirin da huɗu ga watan tara, ku lura da ranar da aka kafa harsashin haikalin Ubangiji. Ku lura da kyau.
english: ‘Consider, please, from this day and backward, from the twenty-fourth day of the ninth month, since the day that the foundation of Yahweh’s temple was laid, consider it.

hausa: Shi kansa ya ɗauki zunubanmu a jikinsa a kan itace, domin mu mutu ga zunubai mu kuma rayu ga adalci; ta wurin raunukansa ne kuka sami warkarwa.
english: He himself bore our sins in his body on the tree, that we, having died to sins, might live to righteousness. You were healed by his wounds.

hausa: A ranan nan sai Yesu ya fita daga gida ya je ya zauna a bakin tafkin.
english: On that day Jesus went out of the house and sat by the seaside.

hausa: Sojoji su ma, suka zo suka yi masa ba’a. Suka miƙa masa ruwan tsami.
english: The soldiers also mocked him, coming to him and offering him vinegar,

hausa: zan tuna da alkawari tsakanina da ku da kuma dukan halittu masu rai na kowane iri. Ruwa ba zai sāke yin ambaliyar da za tă hallaka dukan masu rai ba.
english: I will remember my covenant, which is between me and you and every living creature of all flesh, and the waters will no more become a flood to destroy all flesh.

hausa: Sai na tsawata wa manyan Yahuda na ce musu, “Wanda irin mugun abu ke nan kuke yi, kuna ƙazantar da ranar Asabbaci?
english: Then I contended with the nobles of Judah, and said to them, “What evil thing is this that you do, and profane the Sabbath day?

hausa: A bisansa akwai serafofi, kowanne yana da fikafikai shida. Fikafikai biyu sun rufe fuskokinsu, da biyu suka rufe ƙafafunsu, biyu kuma da su suke tashi.
english: Above him stood the seraphim. Each one had six wings. With two he covered his face. With two he covered his feet. With two he flew.

hausa: Hannatu tana addu’a a zuci, ba a jin muryarta, sai leɓunanta ne kawai suna motsi. Eli kuwa ya yi tsammani ta bugu ne.
english: Now Hannah spoke in her heart. Only her lips moved, but her voice was not heard. Therefore Eli thought she was drunk.

hausa: Ku matso kusa da Allah shi kuwa zai matso kusa da ku. Ku wanke hannuwanku, ku masu zunubi, ku kuma tsarkake zukatanku, ku masu zuciya biyu.
english: Draw near to God, and he will draw near to you. Cleanse your hands, you sinners. Purify your hearts, you double-minded.

hausa: Nabi ɗan Bofsi, daga kabilar Naftali;
english: Of the tribe of Naphtali, Nahbi the son of Vophsi.

hausa: Ko da umarninka ne shaho yake firiya ya kuma yi sheƙarsa a can sama?
english: Is it at your command that the eagle mounts up, and makes his nest on high?

hausa: Amma Masar za tă zama kango, Edom kuma hamada marar amfani, saboda kama-karyar da aka yi wa mutanen Yahuda, a ƙasar da aka zub da jinin marasa laifi.
english: Egypt will be a desolation and Edom will be a desolate wilderness, for the violence done to the children of Judah, because they have shed innocent blood in their land.

hausa: Zan maido da alƙalanki kamar yadda suke a dā can, mashawartanki kamar yadda suke da fari. Bayan haka za a ce da ke Birnin Masu Adalci, Amintacciyar Birni.”
english: I will restore your judges as at the first, and your counselors as at the beginning. Afterward you shall be called ‘The city of righteousness, a faithful town.’

hausa: (Wannan kuwa kafin a sa Yohanna a kurkuku.)
english: for John was not yet thrown into prison.

hausa: Aikin wawa yakan gajiyar da shi, har bai san hanyar zuwa gari ba.
english: The labor of fools wearies every one of them; for he doesn’t know how to go to the city.

hausa: Da Yehu ya koma wurin sauran hafsoshin sai ɗaya daga cikinsu ya tambaye shi, “Lafiya? Me ya kawo wannan mahaukaci a wurinka?” Sai Yehu ya ce, “Ka san mahaukacin nan da irin maganganunsa.”
english: When Jehu came out to the servants of his lord and one said to him, “Is all well? Why did this madman come to you?” He said to them, “You know the man and how he talks.”

hausa: Wani lokaci girgijen yakan yi ’yan kwanaki ne kawai a bisa tabanakul; da umarnin Ubangiji sukan kafa sansani da umarninsa kuma su tashi.
english: Sometimes the cloud was a few days on the tabernacle; then according to the commandment of Yahweh they remained encamped, and according to the commandment of Yahweh they traveled.

hausa: Sai Haggai, ɗan saƙon Ubangiji, ya ba da wannan saƙo na Ubangiji ga mutane cewa, “Ina tare da ku” in ji Ubangiji.
english: Then Haggai, Yahweh’s messenger, spoke Yahweh’s message to the people, saying, “I am with you,” says Yahweh.

hausa: Kada ka manta da abokinka da kuma abokin mahaifinka, kuma kada ka tafi gidan ɗan’uwanka sa’ad da masifa ta same ka, gara ka je wurin maƙwabci na kusa da ka je wurin ɗan’uwan da yake da nisa.
english: Don’t forsake your friend and your father’s friend. Don’t go to your brother’s house in the day of your disaster. A neighbor who is near is better than a distant brother.

hausa: Sa’ad da almajiran suka gan shi yana takawa a kan tafkin, sai tsoro ya kama su. Suka yi ihu don tsoro suka ce, “Fatalwa ce.”
english: When the disciples saw him walking on the sea, they were troubled, saying, “It’s a ghost!” and they cried out for fear.

hausa: alamun da ya aikata da abubuwan da ya yi a cikin Masar, ga Fir’auna sarkin Masar da kuma ga dukan ƙasarsa ba;
english: his signs, and his works, which he did in the middle of Egypt to Pharaoh the king of Egypt, and to all his land;

hausa: “Sai manajan ya ce cikin tunaninsa, ‘Maigidana zai kore ni daga aiki, me zan yi? Ba ni da ƙarfin noma, kuma ina jin kunyan yin bara.
english: “The manager said within himself, ‘What will I do, seeing that my lord is taking away the management position from me? I don’t have strength to dig. I am ashamed to beg.

hausa: Da kowane bijimai goma sha uku nan, a miƙa hadaya ta gari, kashi uku bisa goma na efa, kwaɓaɓɓe da mai; da ragunan biyu ɗin, a miƙa hadaya ta gari kashi biyu bisa goma na efa, kwaɓaɓɓe da mai;
english: and their meal offering, fine flour mixed with oil: three tenths for every bull of the thirteen bulls, two tenths for each ram of the two rams,

hausa: Sa’an nan ta ba wa ɗanta Yaƙub abinci mai daɗi da kuma burodin da ta yi.
english: She gave the savory food and the bread, which she had prepared, into the hand of her son Jacob.

hausa: Masu adalci sukan ci isashen abinci, amma cikin mugaye na fama da yunwa.
english: The righteous one eats to the satisfying of his soul, but the belly of the wicked goes hungry.

hausa: An horar da shi a hanyar Ubangiji, ya kuma himma ƙwarai a magana, ya kuma yi koyarwa game da Yesu, daidai, ko da yake baftismar Yohanna ce kaɗai ya sani.
english: This man had been instructed in the way of the Lord; and being fervent in spirit, he spoke and taught accurately the things concerning Jesus, although he knew only the baptism of John.

hausa: Ba za ku ci wani burodi, ko gasasshen hatsi, ko sabon hatsi ba, sai ran nan da kuka kawo wannan hadaya ga Allahnku. Wannan za tă zama dawwammamiyar farilla wa tsararraki masu zuwa, a duk inda kuke zama.
english: You must not eat bread, or roasted grain, or fresh grain, until this same day, until you have brought the offering of your God. This is a statute forever throughout your generations in all your dwellings.

hausa: Sai ya fara la’antar kansa, yana ta rantsuwa yana ce musu, “Ban ma san mutumin nan ba!” Nan da take, sai zakara ya yi cara.
english: Then he began to curse and to swear, “I don’t know the man!” Immediately the rooster crowed.

hausa: Sai Musa da Haruna suka je gaban Tentin Sujada,
english: Moses and Aaron came to the front of the Tent of Meeting.

hausa: Ɗana, me ya sa za ka bari mazinaciya ta ɗauke maka hankali? Don me za ka rungume matar wani?
english: For why should you, my son, be captivated with an adulteress? Why embrace the bosom of another?

hausa: Dole a ɗauki jini, fata, nama da kuma ƙashin bijimi da akuyan hadaya don zunubi, waɗanda aka kawo jininsu cikin Wuri Mafi Tsarki don kafara, a kai waje da sansani a ƙone.
english: The bull for the sin offering, and the goat for the sin offering, whose blood was brought in to make atonement in the Holy Place, shall be carried outside the camp; and they shall burn their skins, their flesh, and their dung with fire.

hausa: Dukan mayaƙan Babilon a ƙarƙashin umarnin babban hafsan matsaran sarki, suka rushe katangar Urushalima.
