english: All the army of the Chaldeans, who were with the captain of the guard, broke down the walls around Jerusalem.

hausa: A rana ta bakwai ɗin dole yă aske dukan gashinsa; dole yă aske kansa, gemunsa, gashin girarsa da sauran gashinsa. Dole yă wanke rigunansa ya kuma yi wanka, zai kuwa tsabtacce.
english: It shall be on the seventh day, that he shall shave all his hair off his head and his beard and his eyebrows. He shall shave off all his hair. He shall wash his clothes, and he shall bathe his body in water. Then he shall be clean.

hausa: Ubangiji Allahnmu mai jinƙai ne, mai gafartawa ne kuma, ko da yake mun yi masa tawaye;
english: To the Lord our God belong mercies and forgiveness, for we have rebelled against him.

hausa: waɗanda suke saye da shunayya, gwamnoni da manyan sojoji, dukansu samari ne masu bansha’awa, suna bisa kan dawakai.
english: who were clothed with blue—governors and rulers, all of them desirable young men, horsemen riding on horses.

hausa: Da Ananiyas ya ji wannan, sai ya fāɗi ya mutu. Sai babban tsoro kuwa ya kama duk waɗanda suka ji abin da ya faru.
english: Ananias, hearing these words, fell down and died. Great fear came on all who heard these things.

hausa: “Na ƙi, ina kuma ƙyamar bukukkuwanku na addini; ba na son ganin tarurrukanku.
english: I hate, I despise your feasts, and I can’t stand your solemn assemblies.

hausa: Ya sa shi ya hau keken yaƙi a matsayi mai binsa na biyu, mutane kuwa suka yi shela a gabansa suna cewa, “A ba da hanya!” Ta haka ya sa shi shugaba a kan dukan ƙasar Masar.
english: He made him ride in the second chariot which he had. They cried before him, “Bow the knee!” He set him over all the land of Egypt.

hausa: Sai Musa ya rubuta wannan doka ya kuma ba da ita ga firistoci, ’ya’yan Lawi maza, waɗanda sukan ɗauka akwatin alkawarin Ubangiji, da kuma dukan dattawan Isra’ila.
english: Moses wrote this law and delivered it to the priests the sons of Levi, who bore the ark of Yahweh’s covenant, and to all the elders of Israel.

hausa: “Sa’ad da mutanenka suka tafi yaƙi da abokan gābansu, a duk inda ka aike su, sa’ad da kuma suka yi addu’a ga Ubangiji suna fuskantar birnin da ka zaɓa, da kuma haikalin da na gina domin Sunanka,
english: “If your people go out to battle against their enemy, by whatever way you shall send them, and they pray to Yahweh toward the city which you have chosen, and toward the house which I have built for your name,

hausa: ’Ya’yan Bela maza su ne, Ezbon, Uzzi, Uzziyel, Yerimot da Iri, su ne kawunan iyalai, kuma su biyar ne duka. Rubutaccen tarihin zuriyarsu ya nuna suna mazan da sun isa yaƙi 22,034.
english: The sons of Bela: Ezbon, Uzzi, Uzziel, Jerimoth, and Iri, five; heads of fathers’ houses, mighty men of valor; and they were listed by genealogy twenty-two thousand thirty-four.

hausa: domin kowane jirgin ruwan kasuwanci da kuma jirgi mafi girma mafi kyau.
english: for all the ships of Tarshish, and for all pleasant imagery.

hausa: Ku miƙa irin wannan mutum ga Shaiɗan, don a hallaka halin nan na mutuntaka, ruhunsa kuma yă sami ceto a ranar da Ubangiji zai dawo.
english: you are to deliver such a one to Satan for the destruction of the flesh, that the spirit may be saved in the day of the Lord Jesus.

hausa: Da aka gaya wa Dawuda wannan, sai ya tattara dukan Isra’ila, ya ƙetare Urdun, ya je Helam. Arameyawa suka ja dāgār yaƙinsu, suka kara da Dawuda.
english: David was told that; and he gathered all Israel together, passed over the Jordan, and came to Helam. The Syrians set themselves in array against David and fought with him.

hausa: Shawulu ya mutu domin rashin aminci ga Ubangiji; bai kiyaye maganar Ubangiji ba, ya ma nemi shawarar mace mai duba,
english: So Saul died for his trespass which he committed against Yahweh, because of Yahweh’s word, which he didn’t keep, and also because he asked counsel of one who had a familiar spirit, to inquire,

hausa: Ku tā da murya ku kuma rera don farin ciki, ya ku mutanen Sihiyona, gama Mai Tsarki na Isra’ila da girma yake a cikinku.”
english: Cry aloud and shout, you inhabitant of Zion, for the Holy One of Israel is great among you!”

hausa: Amma kada ku ci jini, ku zubar da shi a ƙasa kamar ruwa.
english: Only you shall not eat the blood. You shall pour it out on the earth like water.

hausa: Sa’ad da Yesu ya sāke magana da mutanen, sai ya ce, “Ni ne hasken duniya. Duk wanda ya bi ni ba zai yi tafiya cikin duhu ba, sai dai yă sami hasken rayuwa.”
english: Again, therefore, Jesus spoke to them, saying, “I am the light of the world. He who follows me will not walk in the darkness, but will have the light of life.”

hausa: kuma, “Dutse ne da yake sa mutane tuntuɓe kuma fā ne da yake sa su fāɗi.” Sun yi tuntuɓe domin sun ƙi su yi biyayya da saƙon, wanda kuma yake abin da aka ƙaddara musu.
english: and, “a stumbling stone and a rock of offense.” For they stumble at the word, being disobedient, to which also they were appointed.

hausa: Hanun da mazaunan Zanowa ne suka gyara Ƙofar Kwari. Suka sāke gina ta suka sa ƙofofinta, da sakatunta, da sandunan ƙarfenta a wurarensu. Suka kuma gyara yadi ɗari biyar na katangar har zuwa Ƙofar Juji.
english: Hanun and the inhabitants of Zanoah repaired the valley gate. They built it, and set up its doors, its bolts, and its bars, and one thousand cubits of the wall to the dung gate.

hausa: Dukan labule goma sha ɗayan girmansu ɗaya ne, tsawonsa kamu talatin, fāɗinsa kuma kamu huɗu ne.
english: The length of each curtain was thirty cubits, and four cubits the width of each curtain. The eleven curtains had one measure.

hausa: Abin da ya kama daga Arower a gefen kwarin Arnon, da kuma daga garin da yake tsakiyar kwarin, da dukan ƙasar tudu kusa da Medeba
english: Their border was from Aroer, that is on the edge of the valley of the Arnon, and the city that is in the middle of the valley, and all the plain by Medeba;

hausa: Aka wulaƙanta shi aka kuma yi masa azaba, duk da haka bai buɗe bakinsa ba; aka kai shi kamar ɗan rago zuwa wurin yanka, kuma kamar tunkiya a gaban masu askinta tana shiru, haka bai buɗe bakinsa ba.
english: He was oppressed, yet when he was afflicted he didn’t open his mouth. As a lamb that is led to the slaughter, and as a sheep that before its shearers is silent, so he didn’t open his mouth.

hausa: Suna aika ’ya’yansu kamar garke; ’ya’yansu suna guje-guje da tsalle-tsalle.
english: They send out their little ones like a flock. Their children dance.

hausa: Maigidansa ya ce, “A’a. Ba za mu shiga birnin baƙi waɗanda mutanensu ba Isra’ilawa ba. Za mu ci gaba zuwa Gibeya.”
english: His master said to him, “We won’t enter into the city of a foreigner that is not of the children of Israel; but we will pass over to Gibeah.”

hausa: Gama da girma Ubangiji yake, ya kuma cancanci yabo; tilas a ji tsoronsa fiye da dukan alloli.
english: For Yahweh is great, and greatly to be praised! He is to be feared above all gods.

hausa: A duk sa’ad da ƙarfafa dabbobi mata suke barbara, Yaƙub yakan zuba rassan a kwamame a gaban dabbobin saboda su yi barbara kusa da rassan,
english: Whenever the stronger of the flock conceived, Jacob laid the rods in front of the eyes of the flock in the watering troughs, that they might conceive among the rods;

hausa: Hefer mutumin Mekerat, Ahiya mutumin Felon,
english: Hepher the Mecherathite, Ahijah the Pelonite,

hausa: Me ya sa ba a tafi aka bar sanannen birnin nan ba, birnin da nake jin daɗi?
english: How is the city of praise not forsaken, the city of my joy?

hausa: Saboda haka suka aika a zo da Yerobowam, sai shi da dukan Isra’ila suka je wurin Rehobowam suka ce masa.
english: They sent and called him; and Jeroboam and all Israel came, and they spoke to Rehoboam, saying,

hausa: sai in aika da ruwan sama a ƙasarku a lokacinsa, ruwan saman bazara da kuma na kaka, don ku tattara hatsinku, sabon inabinku da kuma manku.
english: that I will give the rain for your land in its season, the early rain and the latter rain, that you may gather in your grain, your new wine, and your oil.

hausa: Hezekiya ya ce, “Maganar Ubangiji da ka yi tana da kyau.” Gama ya yi tunani a ransa cewa, “Salama da kāriya za su kasance a zamanina.”
english: Then Hezekiah said to Isaiah, “Yahweh’s word which you have spoken is good.” He said moreover, “For there will be peace and truth in my days.”

hausa: a sa’an nan zan sauko da ke ƙasa tare da waɗanda suke gangarawa zuwa rami, zuwa wurin mutanen dā. Zan sa ki zauna ƙarƙashin ƙasa, kamar a kufai na tun dā, tare da waɗanda suke gangarawa zuwa rami, ba kuwa za ki ƙara dawowa ba ko ki ɗauki matsayinki a ƙasar masu rai.
english: then I will bring you down with those who descend into the pit, to the people of old time, and will make you dwell in the lower parts of the earth, in the places that are desolate of old, with those who go down to the pit, that you be not inhabited; and I will set glory in the land of the living.

hausa: Suka karɓa daga wurin Musa dukan kyautai da Isra’ilawa suka kawo don su yi aikin shirya wuri mai tsarki. Mutane suka ci gaba da kawo kyautai yardar rai kowace safiya.
english: They received from Moses all the offering which the children of Israel had brought for the work of the service of the sanctuary, with which to make it. They kept bringing free will offerings to him every morning.

hausa: Yadda hannuna ya ƙwace mulkokin gumaka, mulkokin da siffofinsu suka fi na Urushalima da Samariya,
english: As my hand has found the kingdoms of the idols, whose engraved images exceeded those of Jerusalem and of Samaria,

hausa: Ubangiji ya riga ya gaya wa Musa cewa,
english: For Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

hausa: Sa’an nan Fir’auna ya ce wa Yusuf, “Ni ne Fir’auna, amma in ba tare da umarninka ba, ba wanda zai ɗaga hannu ko ƙafa a cikin dukan Masar.”
english: Pharaoh said to Joseph, “I am Pharaoh. Without you, no man shall lift up his hand or his foot in all the land of Egypt.”

hausa: Bayan ɗan lokaci, sai ya shiga ƙaunar wata mace, mai suna Delila a Kwarin Sorek.
english: It came to pass afterward that he loved a woman in the valley of Sorek, whose name was Delilah.

hausa: Mutane da yawa sun ɗau niyyar rubuta labarin abubuwan da aka cika a cikinmu,
english: Since many have undertaken to set in order a narrative concerning those matters which have been fulfilled among us,

hausa: Amma zan kuɓutar da kai a wannan rana, in ji Ubangiji; ba zan ba da kai ga waɗanda kake tsoronsu ba.
english: But I will deliver you in that day,” says Yahweh; “and you will not be given into the hand of the men of whom you are afraid.

hausa: “Sa’an nan ka yi fitilu bakwai, ka sa su a bisa wurin ajiye fitilan ta yadda za su haskaka wajen da suka fuskanta.
english: You shall make its lamps seven, and they shall light its lamps to give light to the space in front of it.

hausa: Ba wanda yakan kai kansa a wannan matsayi mai girma; sai ko Allah ya kira shi, kamar yadda aka yi wa Haruna.
english: Nobody takes this honor on himself, but he is called by God, just like Aaron was.

hausa: Amma makiyayan Gerar suka yi faɗa da na Ishaku suka ce, “Ruwan namu ne!” Saboda haka Ishaku ya ba wa rijiyar suna Esek, domin sun yi faɗa da shi.
english: The herdsmen of Gerar argued with Isaac’s herdsmen, saying, “The water is ours.” So he called the name of the well Esek, because they contended with him.

hausa: (Omer guda, daidai ne da kashi ɗaya bisa goma na Efa.)
english: Now an omer is one tenth of an ephah.

hausa: Isra’ila kuwa, ban da Benyamin, sun tara mayaƙa masu takobi dubu ɗari huɗu, dukansu gwanayen yaƙi ne.
english: The men of Israel, besides Benjamin, were counted four hundred thousand men who drew sword. All these were men of war.

hausa: Maganar Ubangiji kuwa ta bazu a dukan yankin.
english: The Lord’s word was spread abroad throughout all the region.

hausa: Uban yana ƙaunar Ɗan ya kuma danƙa kome a hannuwansa.
english: The Father loves the Son, and has given all things into his hand.

hausa: Ba bambanci; shi ya sa na ce, ‘Yana hallaka marasa laifi da kuma mugaye.’
english: “It is all the same. Therefore I say he destroys the blameless and the wicked.

hausa: “Shekara shida za ku nome gonakinku ku girbe amfanin gonar,
english: “For six years you shall sow your land, and shall gather in its increase,

hausa: Zuriyar Manasse, daga Makir, kabilar Makiriyawa (Makir shi ne mahaifin Gileyad); daga Gileyad, kabilar Gileyadawa.
english: The sons of Manasseh: of Machir, the family of the Machirites; and Machir became the father of Gilead; of Gilead, the family of the Gileadites.

hausa: Duk da haka, mutuwa ta yi mulki tun Adamu har yă zuwa Musa, ta yi mulki har ma a kan waɗanda ba su yi zunubi ta wurin taka umarni kamar yadda Adamu ya yi ba. A wata hanya dai Adamu shi ne kwatancin wani mutumin nan mai zuwa.
english: Nevertheless death reigned from Adam until Moses, even over those whose sins weren’t like Adam’s disobedience, who is a foreshadowing of him who was to come.

hausa: “Gaskiya nake gaya muku, akwai waɗansu da suke tsaitsaye a nan da ba za su mutu ba sai sun ga Ɗan Mutum yana zuwa cikin mulkinsa.”
english: Most certainly I tell you, there are some standing here who will in no way taste of death until they see the Son of Man coming in his Kingdom.”

hausa: A ce zan iya ƙirgansu, za su fi yashin teku yawa. Sa’ad da na farka, ina nan tare da kai har yanzu.
english: If I would count them, they are more in number than the sand. When I wake up, I am still with you.

hausa: Ya yashe tabanakul na Shilo, tentin da ya kafa a cikin mutane.
english: so that he abandoned the tent of Shiloh, the tent which he placed among men,

hausa: Ko da zan so yin gadara ma, ba zan zama wawa ba, gama gaskiya zan faɗa. Amma na bar zancen haka, don kada wani ya ɗauke ni fiye da yadda yake ganina, ko yadda yake jin maganata.
english: For if I would desire to boast, I will not be foolish; for I will speak the truth. But I refrain, so that no man may think more of me than that which he sees in me or hears from me.

hausa: Muddin Ubangiji yana a raye, Ubangiji da kansa zai buge shi, ko yă mutu a lokacinsa, ko kuma yă mutu a wurin yaƙi.
english: David said, “As Yahweh lives, Yahweh will strike him; or his day shall come to die, or he shall go down into battle and perish.

hausa: da kowane tunkiya kuma, a kasance da hadaya ta lallausan garin da aka kwaɓa da mai, na kashi ɗaya bisa goma na efa. Wannan hadaya ce da aka ƙone da wuta ga Ubangiji.
english: and one tenth part of fine flour mixed with oil for a meal offering to every lamb, as a burnt offering of a pleasant aroma, an offering made by fire to Yahweh.

hausa: Sa’ad da zunubai suka sha ƙarfinmu, ka gafarta laifofinmu.
english: Sins overwhelmed me, but you atoned for our transgressions.

hausa: suna cewa, “Gaskiya ne! Ubangiji ya tashi, ya kuma bayyana ga Siman”
english: saying, “The Lord is risen indeed, and has appeared to Simon!”

hausa: A shekara ta ashirin ta Yerobowam sarkin Isra’ila, Asa ya zama sarkin Yahuda,
english: In the twentieth year of Jeroboam king of Israel, Asa began to reign over Judah.

hausa: Sai suka nuna kansu a sansanin Filistiyawa. Sai Filistiyawa suka ce, “Ku duba ga Ibraniyawa suna fitowa daga cikin ramummuka inda suka ɓuya.”
english: Both of them revealed themselves to the garrison of the Philistines; and the Philistines said, “Behold, the Hebrews are coming out of the holes where they had hidden themselves!”

hausa: da duwatsun Onis, da duwatsun da za a mammanne a efod da ƙyallen maƙalawa a ƙirji.
english: onyx stones, and stones to be set for the ephod and for the breastplate.

hausa: Duk da haka kullum ina tare da kai; ka riƙe ni a hannun damana.
english: Nevertheless, I am continually with you. You have held my right hand.

hausa: Ku bar garuruwanku ku zauna a cikin duwatsu, ku da kuke zama a Mowab. Ku zama kamar kurciyar da take sheƙarta a bakin kogo.
english: You inhabitants of Moab, leave the cities, and dwell in the rock. Be like the dove that makes her nest over the mouth of the abyss.

hausa: Zukatanmu ba su juya baya; ƙafafunmu ba su kauce daga hanyarka ba.
english: Our heart has not turned back, neither have our steps strayed from your path,

hausa: “Ɗan mutum, gidan Isra’ila suna cewa, ‘Wahayin da yake gani na shekaru masu yawa ne nan gaba, yana kuma annabce-annabce game da wani zamani ne can.’
english: “Son of man, behold, they of the house of Israel say, ‘The vision that he sees is for many days to come, and he prophesies of times that are far off.’

hausa: ’Ya’yansa suna cikin hatsari, ba wanda zai tsaya musu a gaban alƙali,
english: His children are far from safety. They are crushed in the gate. Neither is there any to deliver them,

hausa: Sukan wāsa harsunansu kamar takuba su harba kalmominsu kamar kibiyoyi masu kisa.
english: who sharpen their tongue like a sword, and aim their arrows, deadly words,

hausa: in mutanena, waɗanda ake kira da sunana, sun ƙasƙantar da kansu, suka kuma yi addu’a, suka nemi fuskata, suka kuma juye daga mugayen hanyoyinsu, zan ji daga sama in kuma gafarta zunubinsu in kuwa warkar da ƙasarsu.
english: if my people who are called by my name will humble themselves, pray, seek my face, and turn from their wicked ways, then I will hear from heaven, will forgive their sin, and will heal their land.

hausa: “Dole mutumin da aka tsabtaccen ya wanke rigunansa, ya aske dukan gashinsa ya kuma yi wanka; sa’an nan zai tsabtacce. Bayan wannan zai iya zo cikin sansani, amma dole yă tsaya waje da tentinsa kwana bakwai.
english: “He who is to be cleansed shall wash his clothes, and shave off all his hair, and bathe himself in water; and he shall be clean. After that he shall come into the camp, but shall dwell outside his tent seven days.

hausa: na ga Ubangiji yana magana. Ya ce mini, ‘Maza! Ka bar Urushalima, gama ba za su yarda da shaidarka game da ni ba.’
english: and saw him saying to me, ‘Hurry and get out of Jerusalem quickly, because they will not receive testimony concerning me from you.’

hausa: Amma in idanunka suna da lahani, dukan jikinka ma zai cika da duhu. To, in hasken da yake a cikinka duhu ne, duhun ya wuce misali ke nan!
english: But if your eye is evil, your whole body will be full of darkness. If therefore the light that is in you is darkness, how great is the darkness!

hausa: Zan yi muku dariya sa’ad da masifa ta same ku, zan yi muku ba’a sa’ad da bala’i ya same ku,
english: I also will laugh at your disaster. I will mock when calamity overtakes you,

hausa: Game da ku kuma ’yan’uwa, kada ku gaji da yin abin da yake daidai.
english: But you, brothers, don’t be weary in doing what is right.

hausa: Kuna amfani da bakunanku don mugunta kuna kuma gyara harshenku don ruɗu.
english: “You give your mouth to evil. Your tongue frames deceit.

hausa: daga Bebai, Zakariya ɗan Bebai ne shugaba, tare da shi akwai mutum 28;
english: Of the sons of Bebai, Zechariah the son of Bebai; and with him twenty-eight males.

hausa: In, har an san bijimin da wannan hali, an kuma yi wa mai shi gargaɗi, amma bai ɗaura shi ba, har ya kashe namiji ko ta mace, za a jajjefe bijimin tare da mai shi, har su mutu.
english: But if the bull had a habit of goring in the past, and this has been testified to its owner, and he has not kept it in, but it has killed a man or a woman, the bull shall be stoned, and its owner shall also be put to death.

hausa: ’Yan’uwa, ku zaɓi mutum bakwai daga cikinku waɗanda aka sani suna cike da Ruhu da kuma hikima. Mu kuwa za mu danƙa musu wannan aiki
english: Therefore, select from among you, brothers, seven men of good report, full of the Holy Spirit and of wisdom, whom we may appoint over this business.

hausa: Saboda haka na yayyaga ku kucu-kucu tare da annabawana, na kashe ku da kalmomin bakina; hukuntaina sun haskaka kamar walƙiya a kanku.
english: Therefore I have cut them to pieces with the prophets; I killed them with the words of my mouth. Your judgments are like a flash of lightning.

hausa: Yi magana mai kwantar da rai ga Urushalima, ku kuma furta mata cewa aiki mai zafinta ya isa, cewa an fanshi zunubinta, cewa ta karɓi daga hannun Ubangiji ninki biyu saboda dukan zunubanta.
english: “Speak comfortably to Jerusalem, and call out to her that her warfare is accomplished, that her iniquity is pardoned, that she has received of Yahweh’s hand double for all her sins.”

hausa: Ba shakka zai kwaɓe ku in kun nuna sonkai a ɓoye.
english: He will surely reprove you if you secretly show partiality.

hausa: Jimillar waɗanda suke na kabilar Gershonawa ke nan, waɗanda suka yi hidimar aiki a Tentin Sujada. Musa da Haruna sun ƙidaya su bisa ga umarnin Ubangiji.
english: These are those who were counted of the families of the sons of Gershon, all who served in the Tent of Meeting, whom Moses and Aaron counted according to the commandment of Yahweh.

hausa: Gama wannan zai zama abin kunya, zunubin da za a yi shari’a a kai.
english: For that would be a heinous crime. Yes, it would be an iniquity to be punished by the judges,

hausa: Ya saki mutumin da aka jefa a kurkuku saboda tā da hankali, da kisankai, shi wanda suka roƙa. Sa’an nan ya ba da Yesu ga nufinsu.
english: He released him who had been thrown into prison for insurrection and murder, for whom they asked, but he delivered Jesus up to their will.

hausa: “ ‘Ubangiji ya ce wa Ubangijina, “Zauna a hannun damana, sai na sa abokan gābanka su zama matashin sawunka.” ’
english: ‘The Lord said to my Lord, sit on my right hand, until I make your enemies a footstool for your feet’?

hausa: Ana nan sai Dawuda ya ci Filistiyawa ya kuma rinjaye su, ya ƙwace Gat da ƙauyukan kewayenta daga mulkin Filistiyawa.
english: After this, David defeated the Philistines and subdued them, and took Gath and its towns out of the hand of the Philistines.

hausa: Ku tafi ku nemo wa kanku tattaka duk inda za ku samu, amma ba za a rage aikinku ba ko kaɗan.’ ”
english: Go yourselves, get straw where you can find it, for nothing of your work shall be diminished.’”

hausa: Amma da Amasa ya tafi kiran mutanen Yahuda, ya ɗauki lokaci fiye da lokacin da sarki ya ba shi.
english: So Amasa went to call the men of Judah together, but he stayed longer than the set time which had been appointed to him.

hausa: Dukan mutane suka tafi haikalin Ba’al suka rurrushe shi. Suka farfashe bagadan da gumakan, suka kuma kashe Mattan firist na Ba’al a gaban bagadan.
english: All the people went to the house of Baal, broke it down, broke his altars and his images in pieces, and killed Mattan the priest of Baal before the altars.

hausa: Za a fanshi Sihiyona da adalci, masu tubanta kuma da aikin gaskiya.
english: Zion shall be redeemed with justice, and her converts with righteousness.

hausa: Saboda haka, Haman ya karɓo rigar da dokin. Ya sa wa Mordekai rigar, ya kuma bi da shi a kan doki ko’ina a titunan birnin, yana shela a gabansa yana cewa, “Wannan shi ne abin da ake yi wa mutumin da sarki yake jin daɗi yă girmama!”
english: Then Haman took the clothing and the horse, and arrayed Mordecai, and had him ride through the city square, and proclaimed before him, “Thus it shall be done to the man whom the king delights to honor!”

hausa: Da Musa ya miƙa sandansa sama, sai Ubangiji ya aiko da tsawa da ƙanƙara, da walƙiya har ƙasa. Ta haka Ubangiji ya yi ruwan ƙanƙara a bisa ƙasar Masar;
english: Moses stretched out his rod toward the heavens, and Yahweh sent thunder and hail; and lightning flashed down to the earth. Yahweh rained hail on the land of Egypt.

hausa: Benahiya, ɗan Yehohiyada mutumin Kabzeyel shi ma jarumi ne sosai, ya yi nasarori masu yawa. Ya bugi ƙwararrun jarumawan Mowab guda biyu. Ya kuma shiga rami wata ranar da ake ƙanƙara, ya kashe zaki.
english: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, the son of a valiant man of Kabzeel, who had done mighty deeds, killed the two sons of Ariel of Moab. He also went down and killed a lion in the middle of a pit in a time of snow.

hausa: Bari nishe-nishen ’yan kurkuku su zo gabanka; ta wurin ƙarfin hannunka ka kiyaye waɗanda aka yanke wa hukuncin mutuwa.
english: Let the sighing of the prisoner come before you. According to the greatness of your power, preserve those who are sentenced to death.

hausa: Da a ce ina jin yunwa ai, ba sai na faɗa muku ba, gama duniyar nawa ne, da kome da yake cikinta.
english: If I were hungry, I would not tell you, for the world is mine, and all that is in it.

hausa: Ka sa murfin kafara a bisa akwatin alkawari a Wuri Mafi Tsarki.
english: You shall put the mercy seat on the ark of the covenant in the most holy place.

hausa: Sa’an nan na ji mai tsarkin nan yana magana, wani mai tsarki kuma ya ce da wancan, “Har yaushe wannan wahayi zai tabbata, wahayi game da hadaya ta kullayaumi, da tawayen da yake kawo lalacewa, da kuma miƙa wuri mai tsarki da kuma na rundunar da za a tattake a ƙarƙashin sawu?”
english: Then I heard a holy one speaking; and another holy one said to that certain one who spoke, “How long will the vision about the continual burnt offering, and the disobedience that makes desolate, to give both the sanctuary and the army to be trodden under foot be?”

hausa: Almajiran Yohanna suka gaya masa dukan waɗannan abubuwa. Sai ya kira biyu daga cikinsu,
english: The disciples of John told him about all these things.

hausa: “ ‘A ranar nunan fari, sa’ad da za ku miƙa wa Ubangiji hadayar sabon hatsi, a lokacin Bikin Makoni, za a yi tsattsarkan taro, ba kuwa za a yi aikin da aka saba yi ba.
english: “‘Also in the day of the first fruits, when you offer a new meal offering to Yahweh in your feast of weeks, you shall have a holy convocation. You shall do no regular work;

hausa: Ya bi Ashtarot, alliyar Sidoniyawa, da Molek, allahn da aka hana na Ammonawa.
english: For Solomon went after Ashtoreth the goddess of the Sidonians, and after Milcom the abomination of the Ammonites.

hausa: Biye da shi, Lawiyawa a ƙarƙashin Rehum ɗan Bani ne suka yi gyare-gyaren. Kusa da su, Hashabiya mai mulkin rabin yankin Keyila ne ya yi gyare-gyaren don yankinsa.
english: After him, the Levites—Rehum the son of Bani made repairs. Next to him, Hashabiah, the ruler of half the district of Keilah, made repairs for his district.

hausa: Sarki ya kuma ce wa Daniyel, “Tabbatacce Allahnka shi ne Allahn alloli da kuma Sarkin sarakuna da mai bayyana asirai, gama ka iya bayyana wannan asiri.”
english: The king answered to Daniel, and said, “Of a truth your God is the God of gods, and the Lord of kings, and a revealer of secrets, since you have been able to reveal this secret.”

hausa: Gara tafin hannu guda cike da kwanciyar rai da tafin hannu biyu cike da tashin hankali da harbin iska kawai.
english: Better is a handful, with quietness, than two handfuls with labor and chasing after wind.

hausa: Sa’an nan ya ce wa Yerobowam, “Ɗauki gida goma wa kanka, gama abin da Ubangiji, Allah na Isra’ila ya ce ke nan, ‘Duba, zan yage masarauta daga hannun Solomon in ba ka kabilu goma.
english: He said to Jeroboam, “Take ten pieces; for Yahweh, the God of Israel, says, ‘Behold, I will tear the kingdom out of the hand of Solomon and will give ten tribes to you

hausa: Hanyar shiga da shirayinta suna da tagogi duk a kewaye, kamar tagogin sauran. Tsawonta kamu hamsin ne fāɗinta kuma kamu ashirin da biyar ne.
english: There were windows in it and in its arches all around, like the other windows: the length was fifty cubits, and the width twenty-five cubits.

hausa: Bisa ga maganar Ubangiji kansa, muna gaya muku cewa mu da muke raye har yanzu, waɗanda aka bari har dawowar Ubangiji, tabbatacce ba za mu riga waɗanda suka yi barci tashi ba.
english: For this we tell you by the word of the Lord, that we who are alive, who are left until the coming of the Lord, will in no way precede those who have fallen asleep.

hausa: Ubangiji kuma ya zo ya tsaya a wurin, yana kira ya ce, “Sama’ila, Sama’ila!” Kamar yadda ya kira a lokutan baya. Sai Sama’ila ya ce, “Yi magana gama bawanka yana saurara.”
english: Yahweh came, and stood, and called as at other times, “Samuel! Samuel!” Then Samuel said, “Speak; for your servant hears.”

hausa: “ ‘A duk wani rashin jituwa, firistoci za su zama alƙalai su kuma yanke magana bisa ga farillaina. Za su kiyaye dokokina da ƙa’idodina a dukan ƙayyadaddun bukukkuwana, su kuma kiyaye Asabbataina da tsarki.
english: “‘“In a controversy they shall stand to judge. They shall judge it according to my ordinances. They shall keep my laws and my statutes in all my appointed feasts. They shall make my Sabbaths holy.

hausa: Sai ƙungiyar annabawa suka ce wa Elisha, “Duba, wurin da muke taruwa ya kāsa mana.
english: The sons of the prophets said to Elisha, “See now, the place where we live and meet with you is too small for us.

hausa: Sai aljanun suka roƙi Yesu, suka ce, “Tura mu cikin aladun nan, ka bari mu shiga cikinsu.”
english: All the demons begged him, saying, “Send us into the pigs, that we may enter into them.”

hausa: Solomon ya haifi Rehobowam, Rehobowam ya haifi Abiya, Abiya ya haifi Asa,
english: Solomon became the father of Rehoboam. Rehoboam became the father of Abijah. Abijah became the father of Asa.

hausa: Iyayenta suka yi mamaki, amma ya ba su umarni kada su faɗa wa kowa abin da ya faru.
english: Her parents were amazed, but he commanded them to tell no one what had been done.

hausa: Amma ku amince za ku ji tsoron Ubangiji, ku bauta masa da aniya da dukan zuciyarku, kuna da manyan abubuwan da ya yi muku.
english: Only fear Yahweh, and serve him in truth with all your heart; for consider what great things he has done for you.

hausa: Ubangiji zai yi ruri daga Sihiyona tsawa kuma daga Urushalima; duniya da sararin sama za su yi rawan jiki. Amma Ubangiji zai zama mafakar mutanensa, mafaka ga mutanensa Isra’ila.
english: Yahweh will roar from Zion, and thunder from Jerusalem; and the heavens and the earth will shake; but Yahweh will be a refuge to his people, and a stronghold to the children of Israel.

hausa: Mahaifinsa kuwa yana kwanciya a gado yana fama da zazzaɓi da atuni. Bulus ya shiga ciki don yă gan shi, bayan ya yi masa addu’a, sai ya ɗibiya masa hannuwa ya warkar da shi.
english: The father of Publius lay sick of fever and dysentery. Paul entered in to him, prayed, and laying his hands on him, healed him.

hausa: Sa’ad da Yoram ya ga Yehu sai ya tambaye shi, “Lafiya kuwa ka zo, Yehu?” Yehu ya ce, “Ina kuwa lafiya, da yake dukan bautar gumaka da bokancin mahaifiyarka Yezebel sun bazu ko’ina?”
english: When Joram saw Jehu, he said, “Is it peace, Jehu?” He answered, “What peace, so long as the prostitution of your mother Jezebel and her witchcraft abound?”

hausa: daga zuriyar Hebron, Eliyel shugaba da dangi 80;
english: of the sons of Hebron, Eliel the chief, and his brothers eighty;

hausa: Ku rubuta su a kan madogaran ƙofofin gidajenku, da a kan ƙofofinku,
english: You shall write them on the door posts of your house and on your gates;

hausa: Sai Yohanna ya ba da wannan shaida, “Na ga Ruhu ya sauko kamar kurciya daga sama ya zauna a kansa.
english: John testified, saying, “I have seen the Spirit descending like a dove out of heaven, and it remained on him.

hausa: Kashegari da Musa ya shiga cikin Tentin Sujada sai ga sandan Haruna na gidan Lawiyawa ya yi toho, ya yi furanni, ya kuma yi ’ya’yan almon.
english: On the next day, Moses went into the Tent of the Testimony; and behold, Aaron’s rod for the house of Levi had sprouted, budded, produced blossoms, and bore ripe almonds.

hausa: Mashaidin gaskiya kan ba da shaidar gaskiya, amma mashaidin ƙarya yana baza ƙarairayi ne.
english: He who is truthful testifies honestly, but a false witness lies.

hausa: Suna rawa suna cewa, “Shawulu ya kashe dubbansa, Dawuda kuwa ya kashe dubun dubbai.”
english: The women sang to one another as they played, and said, “Saul has slain his thousands, and David his ten thousands.”

hausa: Sai Yusuf ya kawo zanen lilin, ya saukar da jikin, ya nannaɗe shi da lilin ɗin, sa’an nan ya sa shi a kabarin da aka fafe a cikin dutse. Sai ya gungura wani dutse ya rufe bakin kabarin.
english: He bought a linen cloth, and taking him down, wound him in the linen cloth and laid him in a tomb which had been cut out of a rock. He rolled a stone against the door of the tomb.

hausa: Saboda haka, ya abokaina ƙaunatattu, kamar yadda kullum kuke biyayya ba kawai sa’ad da ina nan ba, amma yanzu da ba na nan tare da ku, ku ci gaba da yin ayyukan cetonku da tsoro da kuma rawan jiki,
english: So then, my beloved, even as you have always obeyed, not only in my presence, but now much more in my absence, work out your own salvation with fear and trembling.

hausa: Saboda haka sai mu matso kusa da kursiyin alheri da ƙarfi zuciya, don mu sami jinƙai mu kuma sami alherin da zai taimake mu a lokacin bukata.
english: Let’s therefore draw near with boldness to the throne of grace, that we may receive mercy and may find grace for help in time of need.

hausa: na Harim 320
english: The children of Harim, three hundred twenty.

hausa: Abram ya zauna a ƙasar Kan’ana, yayinda Lot ya zauna cikin biranen kwari, ya kafa tentunansa kusa da Sodom.
english: Abram lived in the land of Canaan, and Lot lived in the cities of the plain, and moved his tent as far as Sodom.

hausa: Na sa maganata a bakinka na kuma rufe ka da inuwar hannuna, Na shimfiɗa sammai, na kafa harsashen duniya, na kuma ce wa Sihiyona, ‘Ku mutanena ne.’ ”
english: I have put my words in your mouth and have covered you in the shadow of my hand, that I may plant the heavens, and lay the foundations of the earth, and tell Zion, ‘You are my people.’”

hausa: Matar ta ce, “To, don me ka yi wa mutanen Allah irin wannan abu? Sa’ad da sarki ya ce haka, ashe, ba ka hukunta kanka ke nan ba, tun da yake sarki bai yarda ɗansa yă komo gida ba?
english: The woman said, “Why then have you devised such a thing against the people of God? For in speaking this word the king is as one who is guilty, in that the king does not bring home again his banished one.

hausa: Zai sa turaren a wuta a gaban Ubangiji, hayaƙin turaren kuwa zai rufe murfin kafarar a bisa Akwatin Alkawari, don kada yă mutu.
english: He shall put the incense on the fire before Yahweh, that the cloud of the incense may cover the mercy seat that is on the covenant, so that he will not die.

hausa: Tsoro duk ya kewaye shi ta kowane gefe yana bin shi duk inda ya je.
english: Terrors will make him afraid on every side, and will chase him at his heels.

hausa: Sa’an nan ya nuna mini Yoshuwa babban firist a tsaye a gaban mala’ikan Ubangiji, Shaiɗan kuma yana tsaye a damansa don yă tuhume shi.
english: He showed me Joshua the high priest standing before Yahweh’s angel, and Satan standing at his right hand to be his adversary.

hausa: Duk da haka Ubangiji ya ƙaunaci kakanninku, ya kuma zaɓe ku, ku zuriyarsu, a bisa dukan al’ummai, yadda yake a yau.
english: Only Yahweh had a delight in your fathers to love them, and he chose their offspring after them, even you above all peoples, as it is today.

hausa: Masu busan ƙahonin da mawaƙa suka haɗu da baki ɗaya sai ka ce murya guda ce, don su yabi su kuma yi godiya ga Ubangiji. Haɗe da busan ƙahoni, ganguna da sauran kayayyaki, suka tā da muryoyinsu cikin yabo ga Ubangiji suka rera, “Yana da kyau; ƙaunarsa dawwammamiya ce har abada.” Sai haikalin Ubangiji ya cika da girgije,
english: when the trumpeters and singers were as one, to make one sound to be heard in praising and thanking Yahweh; and when they lifted up their voice with the trumpets and cymbals and instruments of music, and praised Yahweh, saying, “For he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever!” then the house was filled with a cloud, even Yahweh’s house,

hausa: Ku sāka mata kamar yadda ta sāka muku; ku sāka mata sau biyu na abin da ta yi. Ku dama mata sau biyu na abin da yake cikin kwaf nata.
english: Return to her just as she returned, and repay her double as she did, and according to her works. In the cup which she mixed, mix to her double.

hausa: A can aka sāke kamanninsa a gabansu. Fuskarsa ta haskaka kamar rana, tufafinsa kuwa suka zama fari fat suna walƙiya.
english: He was changed before them. His face shone like the sun, and his garments became as white as the light.

hausa: Ya Ubangiji, ka dawo da ni daga kabari; ka kiyaye ni daga gangarawa zuwa cikin rami.
english: Yahweh, you have brought up my soul from Sheol. You have kept me alive, that I should not go down to the pit.

hausa: Ya ce mini, “Ɗan mutum, yanzu ka haƙa cikin bangon.” Da na haƙa cikin bangon sai na ga ƙofar shiga a can.
english: Then he said to me, “Son of man, dig now in the wall.” When I had dug in the wall, I saw a door.

hausa: Ka miƙa wa Ubangiji dukan abin da kake yi, shirye-shiryenka kuwa za su yi nasara.
english: Commit your deeds to Yahweh, and your plans shall succeed.

hausa: Haka kuma wajen sassaƙar duwatsu na jerawa, da sassaƙar itace, da kowane irin aiki na gwaninta.
english: in cutting of stones for setting, and in carving of wood, to work in all kinds of skillful workmanship.

hausa: Mutumin ya sa wa matarsa suna, Hawwa’u, gama za tă zama mahaifiyar masu rai duka.
english: The man called his wife Eve because she would be the mother of all the living.

hausa: Masu aikata mugunta ba sa taɓa koyo? Suna cin mutanena kamar yadda ake cin burodi, ba sa kuma kira ga Allah.
english: Have the workers of iniquity no knowledge, who eat up my people as they eat bread, and don’t call on God?

hausa: “Saboda haka ka faɗa musu cewa, ‘Ga abin da Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka yana cewa ba dominku ba ne, ya gidan Isra’ila da nake yin waɗannan abubuwa, amma saboda sunana ne mai tsarki, wanda kuka ɓata a cikin al’ummai inda kuka tafi.
english: “Therefore tell the house of Israel, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “I don’t do this for your sake, house of Israel, but for my holy name, which you have profaned among the nations where you went.

hausa: Ubangiji ya ce wa Musa da Haruna,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,

hausa: Akwai wahala da baƙin ciki ga duk mutumin da yake aikata mugunta, da farko Yahudawa, sa’an nan Al’ummai,
english: oppression, and anguish on every soul of man who does evil, to the Jew first, and also to the Greek.

hausa: “Ga abin da Ubangiji yana cewa, “ ‘Ana jin kukan tsoro, razana, ba salama ba.
english: For Yahweh says: “We have heard a voice of trembling; a voice of fear, and not of peace.

hausa: Suka tara manyan duwatsu a kan Akan, tarin duwatsun na nan a can har wa yau. Sa’an nan Ubangiji ya huce daga fushinsa mai zafi. Saboda haka ake kiran wurin Kwarin Akor.
english: They raised over him a great heap of stones that remains to this day. Yahweh turned from the fierceness of his anger. Therefore the name of that place was called “The valley of Achor” to this day.

hausa: Dukan itatuwan jeji za su san cewa Ni Ubangiji ne mai sa manyan itatuwa su zama ƙanana in kuma sa ƙananan itatuwa su zama manya. Nakan sa ɗanyen itace ya bushe, busasshen itace kuma ya zama ɗanye. “ ‘Ni Ubangiji na faɗa, zan kuma aikata.’ ”
english: All the trees of the field will know that I, Yahweh, have brought down the high tree, have exalted the low tree, have dried up the green tree, and have made the dry tree flourish. “‘I, Yahweh, have spoken and have done it.’”

hausa: suka mamaye ƙasar duka, suka sauka a ko’ina a ƙasar. Ba a taɓa ganin annobar fāra haka ba, ba kuwa za a ƙara ganin fāra kamar haka ba.
english: The locusts went up over all the land of Egypt, and rested in all the borders of Egypt. They were very grievous. Before them there were no such locusts as they, nor will there ever be again.

hausa: Da Yesu ya ji haka, sai ya yi mamaki sosai. Ya juya ya wa taron da yake bin sa, “Ina faɗa muku, ban taɓa samun irin bangaskiya mai girma haka ko cikin Isra’ila ba.”
english: When Jesus heard these things, he marveled at him, and turned and said to the multitude who followed him, “I tell you, I have not found such great faith, no, not in Israel.”

hausa: Hannun Ubangiji zai zauna a kan wannan dutse; amma za a tattake Mowab a ƙarƙashinsa kamar yadda ake tattaka kara a cikin taki.
english: For Yahweh’s hand will rest in this mountain. Moab will be trodden down in his place, even like straw is trodden down in the water of the dunghill.

hausa: Suka yi maɗaurin tagulla hamsin don su ɗaura tenti yă zama ɗaya.
english: He made fifty clasps of bronze to couple the tent together, that it might be a unit.

hausa: Ina so ku tuna da kalmomin da annabawa masu tsarki na dā suka faɗa da kuma umarnin da Ubangijinmu da Mai Cetonmu ya bayar ta wurin manzanninku.
english: that you should remember the words which were spoken before by the holy prophets and the commandment of us, the apostles of the Lord and Savior,

hausa: Game da tashin matattu kuwa, ashe, ba ku karanta a cikin littafin Musa ba, game da labarin ɗan kurmin nan mai cin wuta da Musa ya gani a jeji, yadda Allah ya yi magana da shi ya ce, ‘Ni ne Allah na Ibrahim, Allah na Ishaku da kuma Allah na Yaƙub’?
english: But about the dead, that they are raised, haven’t you read in the book of Moses about the Bush, how God spoke to him, saying, ‘I am the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob’?

hausa: Da yake muna da waɗannan alkawura, ya ku ƙaunatattu, sai mu tsarkake kanmu daga kowane abu da yake ƙazantar da jiki, da ruhu, mu zama da cikakken tsarki, saboda bangirma ga Allah.
english: Having therefore these promises, beloved, let’s cleanse ourselves from all defilement of flesh and spirit, perfecting holiness in the fear of God.

hausa: “ ‘Ga abin da Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka yana cewa a ranar da aka yi ƙasa da shi zuwa kabari na rufe zurfafa maɓulɓulai da makoki dominsa; na janye rafuffukansa, aka kuma hana yalwan ruwansa. Saboda shi na rufe Lebanon da baƙin ciki, dukan itatuwan kurmi suka bushe.
english: “The Lord Yahweh says: ‘In the day when he went down to Sheol, I caused a mourning. I covered the deep for him, and I restrained its rivers. The great waters were stopped. I caused Lebanon to mourn for him, and all the trees of the field fainted for him.

hausa: Mutuwa da Hallaka suna nan a fili a gaban Ubangiji, balle fa zukatan mutane!
english: Sheol and Abaddon are before Yahweh— how much more then the hearts of the children of men!

hausa: Kash, ga yadda nake ƙaunar dokarka! Ina tunani a kanta dukan yini.
english: How I love your law! It is my meditation all day.

hausa: Zuriyar Farosh mutum 2,172
english: The children of Parosh, two thousand one hundred seventy-two.

hausa: Sai mala’ikan Ubangiji ya ce wa Iliya, “Sauka, ka tafi tare da shi; kada ka ji tsoro.” Saboda haka Iliya ya tashi ya sauko, ya tafi tare da shi wajen sarki.
english: Yahweh’s angel said to Elijah, “Go down with him. Don’t be afraid of him.” Then he arose and went down with him to the king.

hausa: Zan aika wuta a Teman da za tă ƙone kagarun Bozra.”
english: but I will send a fire on Teman, and it will devour the palaces of Bozrah.”

hausa: (Babu wani mutum kamar Ahab, wanda ya ba da kansa ga aikata mugunta a gaban Ubangiji. Yezebel matarsa ce ta zuga shi.
english: But there was no one like Ahab, who sold himself to do that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight, whom Jezebel his wife stirred up.

hausa: Game da sauran ayyukan mulkin Manasse, da duk abin da ya yi, har da zunubin da ya aikata, duk a rubuce suke a cikin littafin tarihin sarakunan Yahuda.
english: Now the rest of the acts of Manasseh, and all that he did, and his sin that he sinned, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

hausa: To, fa, Dawuda yana saye da kyakkyawar rigar lilin, kamar yadda dukan Lawiyawa waɗanda suke ɗaukar akwatin alkawarin suka sa, da kuma yadda mawaƙa, da Kenaniya, wanda yake bi da waƙar mawaƙan ya sa. Dawuda kuma ya sa efod lilin.
english: David was clothed with a robe of fine linen, as were all the Levites who bore the ark, the singers, and Chenaniah the choir master with the singers; and David had an ephod of linen on him.

hausa: Bitrus ya ce wa Yesu, “Rabbi, ya yi kyau da muke nan. Bari mu kafa bukkoki guda uku, ɗaya dominka, ɗaya domin Musa, ɗaya kuma domin Iliya.”
english: Peter answered Jesus, “Rabbi, it is good for us to be here. Let’s make three tents: one for you, one for Moses, and one for Elijah.”

hausa: Haka kuma, manyan firistoci da malaman dokoki suka yi masa ba’a a junansu, suna cewa, “Ya ceci waɗansu, amma ya kāsa ceton kansa!
english: Likewise, also the chief priests mocking among themselves with the scribes said, “He saved others. He can’t save himself.

hausa: Ina addu’a domin Kiristi yă zauna a cikin zukatanku ta wurin bangaskiya. Ina kuma addu’a saboda ku da kuka kahu sosai cikin ƙauna,
english: that Christ may dwell in your hearts through faith, to the end that you, being rooted and grounded in love,

hausa: “Sai sarkin ya ce wa fadawa, ‘Ku daure shi hannu da ƙafa, ku jefar da shi waje, cikin duhu, inda za a yi kuka da cizon haƙora.’
english: Then the king said to the servants, ‘Bind him hand and foot, take him away, and throw him into the outer darkness. That is where the weeping and grinding of teeth will be.’

hausa: Sai sarkin Sodom, sarkin Gomorra, sarkin Adma, sarkin Zeboyim da sarkin Bela (wato, Zowar), suka fita suka ja dāgā a Kwarin Siddim
english: The king of Sodom, and the king of Gomorrah, the king of Admah, the king of Zeboiim, and the king of Bela (also called Zoar) went out; and they set the battle in array against them in the valley of Siddim

hausa: Labarinsa kuwa ya bazu ko’ina a cikin ƙasar.
english: News about him went out into every place of the surrounding region.

hausa: Sai na ce muku, “Kun iso ƙasar tudun Amoriyawa, wadda Ubangiji, Allahnmu yake ba mu.
english: I said to you, “You have come to the hill country of the Amorites, which Yahweh our God gives to us.

hausa: gama Ubangiji Allahnku, wanda yake cikinku, Allah ne mai kishi, fushinsa kuma zai yi ƙuna gāba da ku, zai kuma hallaka ku daga fuskar ƙasar.
english: for Yahweh your God among you is a jealous God, lest the anger of Yahweh your God be kindled against you, and he destroy you from off the face of the earth.

hausa: Sai dai da rana ta ɗaga, sai tsire-tsiren suka ƙone, suka kuma yanƙwane domin ba su da saiwa sosai.
english: When the sun had risen, they were scorched. Because they had no root, they withered away.

hausa: “Mutane daga al’ummai da yawa za su ratsa cikin wannan birni su kuma tambayi juna suna cewa, ‘Me ya sa Ubangiji ya yi haka da wannan babban birni?’
english: “Many nations will pass by this city, and they will each ask his neighbor, ‘Why has Yahweh done this to this great city?’

hausa: Waƙa ce, Zabura ta ’ya’yan Kora maza. Don mai bi da kaɗe-kaɗe. Bisa ga mahalat leyannotmaskil na Heman dangin Ezra. Ya Ubangiji, Allah wanda ya cece ni, dare da rana ina kuka a gabanka.
english: A Song. A Psalm by the sons of Korah. For the Chief Musician. To the tune of “The Suffering of Affliction.” A contemplation by Heman, the Ezrahite. Yahweh, the God of my salvation, I have cried day and night before you.

hausa: Amma in ya keɓe gonar bayan Shekara ta Murnan, firist zai kimanta darajar bisa ga yawan shekarun da suka rage har zuwa Shekara ta Murna mai zuwa, sai a rage darajar da aka kimanta a kanta.
english: But if he dedicates his field after the Jubilee, then the priest shall reckon to him the money according to the years that remain to the Year of Jubilee; and an abatement shall be made from your valuation.

hausa: Sai wani ya zo ya ce, “Ga shi! Mutanen da kuka sa a kurkuku suna tsaye a filin haikali suna koya wa mutane.”
english: One came and told them, “Behold, the men whom you put in prison are in the temple, standing and teaching the people.”

hausa: Saboda haka aka kira wannan wuri Kibrot Hatta’awa, gama a can ne aka binne mutanen nan makwaɗaita.
english: The name of that place was called Kibroth Hattaavah, because there they buried the people who lusted.

hausa: “Gaya wa Haruna da ’ya’yansa, ‘Ga yadda za ku albarkaci Isra’ilawa. Za ku ce musu,
english: “Speak to Aaron and to his sons, saying, ‘This is how you shall bless the children of Israel.’ You shall tell them,

hausa: (A duk rayuwarsa mahaifinsa bai taɓa tsawata masa yă ce, “Me ya sa kake yin haka ba?” Shi kuwa mai kyan gani ne ƙwarai, shi ne aka haifa bayan Absalom.)
english: His father had not displeased him at any time in saying, “Why have you done so?” and he was also a very handsome man; and he was born after Absalom.

hausa: Sai ta ce, “Ka yi mini alheri na musamman. Da yake ka ba ni ƙasa a Negeb, to, sai ka ba ni maɓulɓulan ruwa kuma.” Sai Kaleb ya ba ta maɓulɓulan bisa da kuma na ƙasa.
english: She said to him, “Give me a blessing; because you have set me in the land of the South, give me also springs of water.” Then Caleb gave her the upper springs and the lower springs.

hausa: Isra’ila ta yi mini kuka, ‘Ya Allahnmu, mun yarda da kai!’
english: They cry to me, ‘My God, we, Israel, acknowledge you!’

hausa: “A faɗa wa al’ummai wannan, a furta wannan game Urushalima. ‘Sojoji masu ƙawanya suna zuwa daga ƙasa mai nisa, suna tā da kirarin yaƙi a kan biranen Yahuda.
english: “Tell the nations, behold, publish against Jerusalem, ‘Watchers come from a far country, and raise their voice against the cities of Judah.

hausa: Sa’an nan ya miƙa ɗan rago domin hadaya ta ƙonawa, sai Haruna da ’ya’yansa maza suka ɗibiya hannuwansu a kan ɗan rago.
english: He presented the ram of the burnt offering. Aaron and his sons laid their hands on the head of the ram.

hausa: Maryamu ta damu ƙwarai da kalmominsa, tana tunani wace irin gaisuwa ce haka?
english: But when she saw him, she was greatly troubled at the saying, and considered what kind of salutation this might be.

hausa: Saboda haka sarkin Isra’ila ya kira ɗaya daga cikin shugabanninsa ya ce, “Kawo Mikahiya ɗan Imla nan take.”
english: Then the king of Israel called an officer, and said, “Quickly get Micaiah the son of Imlah.”

hausa: Bayan Abram ya dawo daga cin Kedorlayomer da sarakunan da suka haɗa kai da shi a yaƙi, sai sarkin Sodom ya fito don yă tarye Abram a Kwarin Shabe (wato, Kwarin Sarki).
english: The king of Sodom went out to meet him after his return from the slaughter of Chedorlaomer and the kings who were with him, at the valley of Shaveh (that is, the King’s Valley).

hausa: Amma ku, Ubangiji ya ɗauke ku, ya fid da ku daga matuya mai narken ƙarfe, wato, daga Masar, domin ku zama jama’arsa ta musamman kamar yadda kuke a yau.
english: But Yahweh has taken you, and brought you out of the iron furnace, out of Egypt, to be to him a people of inheritance, as it is today.

hausa: Yayinda Shawulu yake kallon Dawuda sa’ad da za shi yă yaƙi Bafilistin, sai ya tambayi Abner, komandan rundunarsa ya ce, “Abner, ɗan wane ne wannan saurayi?” Abner ya ce ran sarki yă daɗe, “Ban sani ba.”
english: When Saul saw David go out against the Philistine, he said to Abner, the captain of the army, “Abner, whose son is this youth?” Abner said, “As your soul lives, O king, I can’t tell.”

hausa: Yesu ya ce mata, “Ni ne tashin matattu da kuma rai. Duk wanda ya gaskata da ni zai rayu, ko ya mutu;
english: Jesus said to her, “I am the resurrection and the life. He who believes in me will still live, even if he dies.

hausa: “In kuna ƙaunata za ku yi biyayya da umarnina.
english: If you love me, keep my commandments.

hausa: Kowa a cikinsu, bisa ga lokacin da aka ba shi, yakan kai hatsin sha’ir da ciyawa domin dawakan-kekunan yaƙi, da sauran dawakai a inda aka ajiye su.
english: They also brought barley and straw for the horses and swift steeds to the place where the officers were, each man according to his duty.

hausa: kuma zuciyarsa ba tă gode mini ba don na yi masa sutura da gashin tumakina,
english: if his heart hasn’t blessed me, if he hasn’t been warmed with my sheep’s fleece;

hausa: Me zai kai yin hukunci ga waɗanda ba ’yan ikkilisiya ba. Ai, waɗanda suke ’yan ikkilisiya ne za ku hukunta.
english: For what do I have to do with also judging those who are outside? Don’t you judge those who are within?

hausa: Murhun bagaden murabba’i ne, tsawonsa kamu goma sha biyu, fāɗinsa kuma kamu goma sha biyu.
english: The altar hearth shall be twelve cubits long by twelve wide, square in its four sides.

hausa: A waɗannan kwanaki, sa’ad da yawan almajirai suke ƙaruwa, sai Yahudawan masu jin Hellenanci a cikinsu suka yi gunaguni a kan Yahudawan da suke Ibraniyawa domin ba a kula da gwaurayensu a wajen raba abinci na yau da kullum.
english: Now in those days, when the number of the disciples was multiplying, a complaint arose from the Hellenists against the Hebrews, because their widows were neglected in the daily service.

hausa: Ina roƙon Yuwodiya ina kuma roƙon Sintike, su yi zaman lafiya da juna saboda su na Ubangiji ne.
english: I exhort Euodia, and I exhort Syntyche, to think the same way in the Lord.

hausa: Ku farka, garaya da molo! Zan farkar da rana.
english: Wake up, harp and lyre! I will wake up the dawn.

hausa: Kada ku ƙi kwana da juna sai ko kun yarda a junanku kuma na ɗan lokaci, don ku himmantu ga addu’a. Sa’an nan ku sāke haɗuwa don kada Shaiɗan yă jarrabce ku saboda rashin ƙamewarku.
english: Don’t deprive one another, unless it is by consent for a season, that you may give yourselves to fasting and prayer, and may be together again, that Satan doesn’t tempt you because of your lack of self-control.

hausa: Ina tabbatar muku a gaban Allah cewa abin da nake rubuta muku ba ƙarya ba ne.
english: Now about the things which I write to you, behold, before God, I’m not lying.

hausa: sauƙinkai, da kuma kamunkai. Ai, ba ruwan Doka da waɗannan abubuwa.
english: gentleness, and self-control. Against such things there is no law.

hausa: Sai dai kamar yadda yake a rubuce, “Waɗanda ba a faɗa musu labarinsa ba za su gani, waɗanda kuma ba su ji ba za su fahimta.”
english: But, as it is written, “They will see, to whom no news of him came. They who haven’t heard will understand.”

hausa: Ubangiji ya ce wa Musa da Haruna,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,

hausa: Sun aikata mugunta a gabansa; saboda abin kunyarsu, su ba ’ya’yansa ba ne, amma wata muguwar tsara ce, karkatacciya.
english: They have dealt corruptly with him. They are not his children, because of their defect. They are a perverse and crooked generation.

hausa: ku tabbata kun naɗa sarki a kanku wanda Ubangiji Allahnku ya zaɓa ne. Dole yă zama daga cikin ’yan’uwanku. Kada ku sa baƙo a kanku, wanda ba mutumin Isra’ila ɗan’uwanku ba.
english: you shall surely set him whom Yahweh your God chooses as king over yourselves. You shall set as king over you one from among your brothers. You may not put a foreigner over you, who is not your brother.

hausa: Zabura ce. Don yin godiya. Ku yi sowa don farin ciki ga Ubangiji, dukan duniya.
english: A Psalm of thanksgiving. Shout for joy to Yahweh, all you lands!

hausa: “ ‘An sanar da wannan matsayi ne ta bakin ’yan saƙo, masu tsarki ne kuwa suka sanar da hukuncin, domin masu rai su sani Mafi Ɗaukaka ne mai iko duka a bisa kowane mulkin mutane, yakan kuma ba wa duk wanda ya ga dama, yakan sanya talaka yă zama sarki.’
english: “‘The sentence is by the decree of the watchers and the demand by the word of the holy ones, to the intent that the living may know that the Most High rules in the kingdom of men, and gives it to whomever he will, and sets up over it the lowest of men.’

hausa: “Ka umarci Isra’ilawa, ka ce musu, ‘Sa’ad da kuka shiga Kan’ana, ƙasar da aka ba ku gādo za tă kasance da waɗannan iyakoki.
english: “Command the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘When you come into the land of Canaan (this is the land that shall fall to you for an inheritance, even the land of Canaan according to its borders),

hausa: Zan kuma ba wa shaiduna nan biyu iko, za su kuwa yi annabci na kwanaki 1,260, saye da gwadon makoki.”
english: I will give power to my two witnesses, and they will prophesy one thousand two hundred sixty days, clothed in sackcloth.”

hausa: To, ya zama dole yă bi ta Samariya.
english: He needed to pass through Samaria.

hausa: Da ya gan ta, sai ya yayyage tufafinsa ya yi kuka ya ce, “Kaito! ’Yata! Kin karya mini gwiwa, kuma na lalace, domin na yi wa’adi ga Ubangiji da ba zan iya in karya ba.”
english: When he saw her, he tore his clothes, and said, “Alas, my daughter! You have brought me very low, and you are one of those who trouble me; for I have opened my mouth to Yahweh, and I can’t go back.”

hausa: Sai sarki ya amsa ya ce, “In Ubangiji bai taimake ki ba, me zan iya yi? Ina da hatsi ko ruwan inabin da zan ba ki ne?”
english: He said, “If Yahweh doesn’t help you, where could I get help for you? From the threshing floor, or from the wine press?”

hausa: “Amma da sarkin ya shigo don yă ga baƙin, sai ya ga wani can da ba ya sanye da kayan auren.
english: “But when the king came in to see the guests, he saw there a man who didn’t have on wedding clothing,

hausa: zai umarta a ciccire duwatsun da suke da cutar a zubar a wuri marar tsarki waje da birnin.
english: then the priest shall command that they take out the stones in which is the plague, and cast them into an unclean place outside of the city.

hausa: “Ga abin da Ubangiji Maɗaukaki, Allah na Isra’ila yana cewa kun ga masifa mai girmar da na kawo a kan Urushalima da kuma a kan dukan garuruwan Yahuda. A yau sun zama hamada da kuma kango
english: “Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel, says: ‘You have seen all the evil that I have brought on Jerusalem, and on all the cities of Judah. Behold, today they are a desolation, and no man dwells in them,

hausa: Ubangiji ya yi magana da Musa ya ce,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

hausa: a matsayin lokacin da Yahudawa suka sami huta daga abokan gābansu, da kuma a matsayin watan da aka mai da baƙin cikinsu ya zama farin ciki, makokinsu kuma ya zama ranar biki. Ya rubuta musu su kiyaye ranakun a matsayin ranakun biki da na farin ciki. Su kuma ba da kyautai na abinci ga juna, da kuma kyautai ga matalauta.
english: as the days in which the Jews had rest from their enemies, and the month which was turned to them from sorrow to gladness, and from mourning into a holiday; that they should make them days of feasting and gladness, and of sending presents of food to one another, and gifts to the needy.

hausa: Mala’ikun nan biyu suka iso Sodom da yamma. Lot kuwa yana zama a hanyar shiga birnin. Da ya gan su, sai ya tashi don yă tarye su, ya kuma rusuna da fuskarsa har ƙasa.
english: The two angels came to Sodom at evening. Lot sat in the gate of Sodom. Lot saw them, and rose up to meet them. He bowed himself with his face to the earth,

hausa: Ubangiji ya sanar da cetonsa ya kuma bayyana adalcinsa ga al’ummai.
english: Yahweh has made known his salvation. He has openly shown his righteousness in the sight of the nations.

hausa: “Zan nuna ɗaukakata a cikin al’ummai, kuma dukan al’ummai za su ga hukuncin da zan yi da kuma hannu mai nauyin da zan ɗora a kansu.
english: “I will set my glory among the nations. Then all the nations will see my judgment that I have executed, and my hand that I have laid on them.

hausa: Bai bar kowa ya bi shi ba, sai Bitrus, Yaƙub da Yohanna ɗan’uwan Yaƙub.
english: He allowed no one to follow him except Peter, James, and John the brother of James.

hausa: kuma daga gabashin Urdun, mutanen Ruben, Gad da kuma rabin kabilar Manasse, masu kayan yaƙi iri-iri, su 120,000.
english: On the other side of the Jordan, of the Reubenites, the Gadites, and of the half-tribe of Manasseh, with all kinds of instruments of war for the battle: one hundred twenty thousand.

hausa: Sa’ad da Ubangiji ya gama dukan aikinsa gāba da Dutsen Sihiyona da Urushalima, zai ce, “Zan hukunta sarkin Assuriya saboda fariya na gangancin zuciyarsa da kuma kallon reni na idanunsa.
english: Therefore it will happen that when the Lord has performed his whole work on Mount Zion and on Jerusalem, I will punish the fruit of the willful proud heart of the king of Assyria, and the insolence of his arrogant looks.

hausa: Da ya faɗi haka, sai gardama ta tashi tsakanin Farisiyawa da Sadukiyawa, taron kuwa ya rabu biyu.
english: When he had said this, an argument arose between the Pharisees and Sadducees, and the crowd was divided.

hausa: “Ka yi efod da zinariya, da shuɗi, da shunayya, da jan zare, da kuma lallausan lilin, aikin gwani mai sana’a.
english: “They shall make the ephod of gold, blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen, the work of the skillful workman.

hausa: Isra’ilawa suka yi haka; suka kore su daga sansanin. Suka aikata yadda dai Ubangiji ya umarci Musa.
english: The children of Israel did so, and put them outside of the camp; as Yahweh spoke to Moses, so the children of Israel did.

hausa: Zan kira takobi a kan Gog a dukan duwatsuna, in ji Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka. Kowane takobin mutum zai yi gāba da ɗan’uwansa.
english: I will call for a sword against him to all my mountains,” says the Lord Yahweh. “Every man’s sword will be against his brother.

hausa: in har bai ƙyale duniya ta dā ba sa’ad da ya kawo ambaliya a kan mutanenta marasa tsoron Allah, amma ya kiyaye Nuhu, mai wa’azin adalci, da kuma waɗansu bakwai;
english: and didn’t spare the ancient world, but preserved Noah with seven others, a preacher of righteousness, when he brought a flood on the world of the ungodly,

hausa: Kaleb ɗan Hezron ya haifi yara ta wurin matarsa Azuba (da kuma ta wurin Yeriyot). Waɗannan su ne ’ya’yan Azuba maza. Yesher, Shobab da Ardon.
english: Caleb the son of Hezron became the father of children by Azubah his wife, and by Jerioth; and these were her sons: Jesher, Shobab, and Ardon.

hausa: Ya lalace inabinsu da ƙanƙara itatuwan al’ul nasu kuma da jaura.
english: He destroyed their vines with hail, their sycamore fig trees with frost.

hausa: Tun da ba za ku iya yin wannan ƙanƙanin abu ba, me ya sa kuke damuwa a kan sauran?
english: If then you aren’t able to do even the least things, why are you anxious about the rest?

hausa: Suka ɗauki Absalom, suka jefa shi cikin wani babban rami a kurmin, suka kuwa tula tsibin duwatsu a kansa. Ana cikin haka, sai dukan Isra’ilawa suka tsere zuwa gidajensu.
english: They took Absalom and cast him into a great pit in the forest, and raised over him a very great heap of stones. Then all Israel fled, each to his own tent.

hausa: Rabon da aka ba wa Yusuf ya fara tun daga Urdun kusa da Yeriko, gabas da ruwan Yeriko, sai ya miƙe zuwa jeji, ya haura har zuwa cikin ƙasar tudu na Betel.
english: The lot came out for the children of Joseph from the Jordan at Jericho, at the waters of Jericho on the east, even the wilderness, going up from Jericho through the hill country to Bethel.

hausa: Yesu ya amsa ya ce, “ ‘Ka ƙaunaci Ubangiji Allahnka da dukan zuciyarka da dukan ranka da kuma dukan hankalinka.’
english: Jesus said to him, “‘You shall love the Lord your God with all your heart, with all your soul, and with all your mind.’

hausa: “ ‘In kuka kiyaye farillaina, kuka yi biyayya da umarnaina,
english: “‘If you walk in my statutes and keep my commandments, and do them,

hausa: Sa’an nan Solomon ya tsaya a gaban bagaden Ubangiji a gaban dukan taron Isra’ila ya ɗaga hannuwansa sama.
english: He stood before Yahweh’s altar in the presence of all the assembly of Israel, and spread out his hands

hausa: Kada mace ta sa suturar maza, kada kuma namiji ya sa suturar mata, gama Ubangiji Allahnku yana ƙyamar duk mai yin haka.
english: A woman shall not wear men’s clothing, neither shall a man put on women’s clothing; for whoever does these things is an abomination to Yahweh your God.

hausa: gama karuwa rami ne mai zurfi mace marar aminci matsattsiyar rijiya ce.
english: For a prostitute is a deep pit; and a wayward wife is a narrow well.

hausa: Amma zai ɗauki kayan cikin tsuntsun da gashin yă zubar da su a gefen bagaden a wajen gabas a wurin zuba toka.
english: and he shall take away its crop and its feathers, and cast it beside the altar on the east part, in the place of the ashes.

hausa: Igiyoyin mutuwa sun shaƙe ni, wahalar kabari sun zo a kaina; na cika da wahala da ɓacin rai.
english: The cords of death surrounded me, the pains of Sheol got a hold of me. I found trouble and sorrow.

hausa: “Ga abin da Ubangiji yana cewa, ‘Haka zan lalatar da alfarmar Yahuda da yawan alfarmar Urushalima.
english: “Yahweh says, ‘In this way I will ruin the pride of Judah, and the great pride of Jerusalem.

hausa: Za a cike kowane kwari, a farfashe kowane dutse da kowane tudu. Za a miƙe hanyoyin da suka karkace, a gyaggyara hanyoyi masu gargaɗa su zama sumul.
english: Every valley will be filled. Every mountain and hill will be brought low. The crooked will become straight, and the rough ways smooth.

hausa: Jarumawanki, ya Teman, za su razana, za a kashe kowane mutum a duwatsun Isuwa.
english: Your mighty men, Teman, will be dismayed, to the end that everyone may be cut off from the mountain of Esau by slaughter.

hausa: Amma tsofaffin firistoci, da Lawiyawa, da shugabannin iyalai da yawa, waɗanda dā suka ga yadda haikali na farko yake, suka fashe da kuka mai ƙarfi sa’ad da suka ga an aza harsashin ginin wannan haikali, yayinda waɗansu kuma suka yi ihu da farin ciki.
english: But many of the priests and Levites and heads of fathers’ households, the old men who had seen the first house, when the foundation of this house was laid before their eyes, wept with a loud voice. Many also shouted aloud for joy,

hausa: Ubangiji ya ji ku, sa’ad da kuka yi magana da ni, sai Ubangiji ya ce mini, “Na ji abin da wannan mutane suka faɗa maka. Abin da suka faɗa daidai ne.
english: Yahweh heard the voice of your words when you spoke to me; and Yahweh said to me, “I have heard the voice of the words of this people which they have spoken to you. They have well said all that they have spoken.

hausa: Ko girgijen ya yi kwana biyu a bisa tabanakul, ko wata guda, ko shekara, Isra’ilawa za su zauna a sansani ba kuwa za su tashi ba; amma sa’ad da aka ɗaga shi, sai su kuma su tashi.
english: Whether it was two days, or a month, or a year that the cloud stayed on the tabernacle, remaining on it, the children of Israel remained encamped, and didn’t travel; but when it was taken up, they traveled.

hausa: Gama in ƙinsu da aka yi ya zama sulhu ga duniya, me karɓarsu za tă zama in ba rai daga matattu ba?
english: For if the rejection of them is the reconciling of the world, what would their acceptance be, but life from the dead?

hausa: Sai dukan masu fasaha waɗanda suke aikin wuri mai tsarki suka ɗan dakata
english: All the wise men, who performed all the work of the sanctuary, each came from his work which he did.

hausa: Da yake ba su kula da ayyukan Ubangiji da abin da hannuwansa suka yi ba, zai rushe su ba kuwa zai ƙara gina su ba.
english: Because they don’t respect the works of Yahweh, nor the operation of his hands, he will break them down and not build them up.

hausa: Gama an sāke haihuwarku, ba da iri da yake lalacewa ba, sai dai marar lalacewa, ta wurin rayayyiya da kuma madawwamiyar maganar Allah.
english: having been born again, not of corruptible seed, but of incorruptible, through the word of God, which lives and remains forever.

hausa: Ga maganar da ta zo wa Irmiya daga wurin Ubangiji.
english: The word which came to Jeremiah from Yahweh, saying,

hausa: dakalai da darunansu;
english: He also made the bases, and he made the basins on the bases—

hausa: Ka ɗauke ni mu gudu, mu yi sauri! Bari sarki yă kai ni gidansa. Ƙawaye Muna farin ciki muna kuma murna tare da kai, za mu yabi ƙaunarka fiye da ruwan inabi. Ƙaunatacciya Daidai ne su girmama ka!
english: Take me away with you. Let’s hurry. The king has brought me into his rooms. Friends We will be glad and rejoice in you. We will praise your love more than wine! Beloved They are right to love you.

hausa: Ku ɗaukaka Ubangiji Allahnmu ku kuma yi masa sujada a wurin sa ƙafafunsa; shi mai tsarki ne.
english: Exalt Yahweh our God. Worship at his footstool. He is Holy!

hausa: Kada ka yi fushi fiye da kima, ya Ubangiji; kada ka tuna da zunubanmu har abada. Da ma ka dube mu, muna roƙonka, gama dukanmu mutanenka ne.
english: Don’t be furious, Yahweh. Don’t remember iniquity forever. Look and see, we beg you, we are all your people.

hausa: Zan dasa ta wa kaina a ƙasar; zan shuka ƙaunata ga wanda na ce ‘Ba ƙaunatacciyata ba.’ Zan faɗa wa waɗanda a ce ‘Ba mutanena ba,’ ‘Ku mutanena ne’; za su kuwa ce, ‘Kai ne Allahna.’ ”
english: I will sow her to me in the earth; and I will have mercy on her who had not obtained mercy; and I will tell those who were not my people, ‘You are my people;’ and they will say, ‘You are My God!’”

hausa: wanda Allah zai kawo a daidai lokaci, Allah, mai albarka wanda yake kaɗai Mai Mulki, Sarkin sarakuna da Ubangijin iyayengiji,
english: which at the right time he will show, who is the blessed and only Ruler, the King of kings and Lord of lords.

hausa: waɗanda suka hallaka a En Dor suka zama kamar juji a ƙasa.
english: who perished at Endor, who became as dung for the earth.

hausa: Mordekai kuwa ya fita a gaban sarki da rigunan sarauta, masu ruwan shuɗi, da fari, da babban kambi na zinariya, da alkyabba ta lilin mai ruwan shunayya. Aka yi sowa don murna a birnin Shusha.
english: Mordecai went out of the presence of the king in royal clothing of blue and white, and with a great crown of gold, and with a robe of fine linen and purple; and the city of Susa shouted and was glad.

hausa: Saboda haka sarki bai saurare mutane ba, gama wannan abin da ya faru daga wurin Ubangiji ne, don a cika maganar Ubangiji da ya yi wa Yerobowam ɗan Nebat ta wurin Ahiya, mutumin Shilo.
english: So the king didn’t listen to the people; for it was a thing brought about from Yahweh, that he might establish his word, which Yahweh spoke by Ahijah the Shilonite to Jeroboam the son of Nebat.

hausa: Amma da rana ta taso, sai tsire-tsiren suka ƙone, suka yanƙwane, domin ba su da saiwa.
english: When the sun had risen, it was scorched; and because it had no root, it withered away.

hausa: Sai dai ku riƙe abin da kuke da shi har sai na zo.’
english: Nevertheless, hold that which you have firmly until I come.

hausa: “Kada ku ƙara ba wa mutanen ciyawar tattaka domin su yi tubula, bari su tafi su tattara tattaka da kansu.
english: “You shall no longer give the people straw to make brick, as before. Let them go and gather straw for themselves.

hausa: Sai ya ce wa ’yan’uwansa, “An mayar mini da azurfata. Ga shi a cikin buhuna.” Zuciyarsu ta karai, suka dubi juna suna rawan jiki, suka ce, “Mene ne wannan da Allah ya yi mana?”
english: He said to his brothers, “My money is restored! Behold, it is in my sack!” Their hearts failed them, and they turned trembling to one another, saying, “What is this that God has done to us?”

hausa: Amma ko da za ku sha wahala saboda abin da yake daidai, ku masu albarka ne. “Kada ku ji tsoron abin da suke tsoro; kada kuma ku firgita.”
english: But even if you should suffer for righteousness’ sake, you are blessed. “Don’t fear what they fear, neither be troubled.”

hausa: Ta haka sarki ya kama hanya da dukan mutane suna biye da shi, suka yi sansani a wani wuri mai ɗan nisa da Urushalima.
english: The king went out, and all the people after him; and they stayed in Beth Merhak.

hausa: Annabin ya amsa ya ce, “Muddin Ubangiji wanda nake bauta masa yana a raye, ba zan karɓi kome ba.” Ko da yake Na’aman ya yi ta roƙonsa, amma ya ƙi.
english: But he said, “As Yahweh lives, before whom I stand, I will receive none.” He urged him to take it; but he refused.

hausa: “Ɗan mutum, yi annabci a kan annabawan Isra’ila waɗanda suke annabci yanzu. Ka faɗa wa waɗanda suke annabci bisa ga ra’ayinsu cewa, ‘Ku ji maganar Ubangiji!
english: “Son of man, prophesy against the prophets of Israel who prophesy, and say to those who prophesy out of their own heart, ‘Hear Yahweh’s word:

hausa: Ana cikin haka, sarari ya ƙara duhunta da girgije, iska ta taso, sai ruwan sama kamar da bakin kwarya ya sauko, Ahab kuwa ya hau zuwa Yezireyel.
english: In a little while, the sky grew black with clouds and wind, and there was a great rain. Ahab rode, and went to Jezreel.

hausa: Mordekai babban mutum ne a fada, sunansa ya kai ko’ina a lardunan, ikonsa ya yi ta ƙasaita gaba-gaba.
english: For Mordecai was great in the king’s house, and his fame went out throughout all the provinces, for the man Mordecai grew greater and greater.

hausa: a can ne kuma za ku kawo hadayun ƙonawa da sadakoki, zakkarku da kyautai na musamman, da abin da kuka yi alkawari za ku bayar, da hadayunku na yardar rai, da kuma ’ya’yan farin garkunanku na shanu da na tumaki.
english: You shall bring your burnt offerings, your sacrifices, your tithes, the wave offering of your hand, your vows, your free will offerings, and the firstborn of your herd and of your flock there.

hausa: Duk da haka, ƙaƙƙarfan tushen nan na Allah yana nan daram, an hatimce shi da wannan rubutu, “Ubangiji ya san waɗanda suke nasa,” da kuma, “Duk wanda ya bayyana yarda ga sunan Ubangiji, to, dole yă yi nesa da aikata mugunta.”
english: However, God’s firm foundation stands, having this seal: “The Lord knows those who are his,” and, “Let every one who names the name of the Lord depart from unrighteousness.”

hausa: Ebed-Melek mutumin Kush ya ce wa Irmiya, “Ka sa waɗannan tsummoki da tsofaffin rigunan a hammatarka, ya zarga igiya.” Irmiya ya yi haka,
english: Ebedmelech the Ethiopian said to Jeremiah, “Now put these rags and worn-out garments under your armpits under the cords.” Jeremiah did so.

hausa: Yotam ya huta tare da kakanninsa, aka kuma binne shi a Birnin Dawuda. Sai Ahaz ɗansa ya gāje shi a matsayin sarki.
english: Jotham slept with his fathers, and they buried him in David’s city; and Ahaz his son reigned in his place.

hausa: Zedekiya yana da shekara ashirin da ɗaya sa’ad da ya ci sarauta. Ya yi mulki a Urushalima shekara goma sha ɗaya. Sunan uwarsa Hamutal, ’yar Irmiya, wanda yake zaune a Libna.
english: Zedekiah was twenty-one years old when he began to reign. He reigned eleven years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Hamutal the daughter of Jeremiah of Libnah.

hausa: Sai suka yi addu’a suka ce, “Ubangiji, ka san zuciyar kowa. Nuna mana wanne a cikin waɗannan biyu da ka zaɓa
english: They prayed and said, “You, Lord, who know the hearts of all men, show which one of these two you have chosen

hausa: gun wata budurwar da aka yi alkawarin aurenta ga wani mutum mai suna Yusuf daga zuriyar Dawuda. Sunan budurwar Maryamu.
english: to a virgin pledged to be married to a man whose name was Joseph, of David’s house. The virgin’s name was Mary.

hausa: Bala’am ya amsa ya ce, “To, ai, ga shi, na zo yanzu. Ina da wani ikon yin wata magana ne? Dole in faɗa abin da Allah ya ce in faɗa ne kawai.”
english: Balaam said to Balak, “Behold, I have come to you. Have I now any power at all to speak anything? I will speak the word that God puts in my mouth.”

hausa: Amma ka zaɓi mutane masu iyawa daga dukan mutane, maza masu tsoron Allah, amintattu, masu ƙin rashawa, ka sanya su shugabanni na dubbai, ɗari-ɗari, hamsin-hamsin da goma-goma.
english: Moreover you shall provide out of all the people able men which fear God: men of truth, hating unjust gain; and place such over them, to be rulers of thousands, rulers of hundreds, rulers of fifties, and rulers of tens.

hausa: Suka yaƙi Yahuda, suka kai masa hari, suka kwashe dukan abubuwa masu kyau da suka samu a fadan sarki, tare da ’ya’yansa maza da kuma matansa. Ba wanda aka bari, sai dai Ahaziya autansa.
english: and they came up against Judah, broke into it, and carried away all the possessions that were found in the king’s house, including his sons and his wives, so that there was no son left to him except Jehoahaz, the youngest of his sons.

hausa: Sa’ad da yankuna mafi arziki suke ji kome lafiya yake, zai kai musu hari kuma Zai aikata abin da kakanninsa ba su taɓa yi ba. Zai rarraba abin da aka kwaso daga yaƙi, da ganima, da dukiya ga dukan mabiyansa. Zai kuma yi shiri yă kai wa mafaka hari, amma na ɗan lokaci ne kawai.
english: In time of security he will come even on the fattest places of the province. He will do that which his fathers have not done, nor his fathers’ fathers. He will scatter among them prey, plunder, and wealth. Yes, he will devise his plans against the strongholds, but only for a time.

hausa: Saboda haka da taron suka taru, sai Bilatus ya tambaye su ya ce, “Wane ne a cikinsu kuke so in sakar muku. Barabbas ko Yesu wanda ake kira Kiristi?”
english: When therefore they were gathered together, Pilate said to them, “Whom do you want me to release to you? Barabbas, or Jesus who is called Christ?”

hausa: Sai na ji ya yi kira da babbar murya yana cewa, “Kawo matsaran birni a nan, kowanne da makami a hannunsa.”
english: Then he cried in my ears with a loud voice, saying, “Cause those who are in charge of the city to draw near, each man with his destroying weapon in his hand.”

hausa: Ƙasarsu ta gādo ta haɗa da, Zora, Eshtawol, Ir Shemesh,
english: The border of their inheritance was Zorah, Eshtaol, Irshemesh,

hausa: To, sai maza da matansu suka tā da fara gunaguni mai tsanani a kan ’yan’uwansu Yahudawa.
english: Then there arose a great cry of the people and of their wives against their brothers the Jews.

hausa: Sa’ad da firist ɗin ya ga sabon miki, zai furta shi marar tsarki. Sabon mikin marar tsarki, yana da cuta mai yaɗuwa.
english: The priest shall examine the raw flesh, and pronounce him unclean: the raw flesh is unclean. It is leprosy.

hausa: Ubangiji ya ba da Lakish a hannun Isra’ilawa, a rana ta biyu kuwa Yoshuwa ya ci nasara a kansu. Ya karkashe duk mutanen birnin ya kuma hallaka birnin, kamar yadda ya yi a Libna.
english: Yahweh delivered Lachish into the hand of Israel. He took it on the second day, and struck it with the edge of the sword, with all the souls who were in it, according to all that he had done to Libnah.

hausa: Amma sa’ad da Yahudawa suka yi hamayya da Bulus suka kuma shiga zaginsa, sai ya karkaɗe tufafinsa a cikin rashin yarda, ya ce musu, “Alhakinku yana a kanku! Ba ni da wani laifi. Daga yanzu zan tafi wajen Al’ummai.”
english: When they opposed him and blasphemed, he shook out his clothing and said to them, “Your blood be on your own heads! I am clean. From now on, I will go to the Gentiles!”

hausa: Tare da bijimin za a kuma miƙa hadaya ta gari na kashi ɗaya bisa goma na efa na lallausan gari, kwaɓaɓɓe da mai; da rago guda, kashi biyu bisa goma na efa na lallausan gari, kwaɓaɓɓe da mai;
english: and their meal offering, fine flour mixed with oil: three tenths for the bull, two tenths for the ram,

hausa: Gama Ubangiji Allahnku yana ƙyamar duk mai yi waɗannan abubuwa, da kuma mai rashin gaskiya.
english: For all who do such things, all who do unrighteously, are an abomination to Yahweh your God.

hausa: Ofir, Hawila da Yobab. Dukan waɗannan ’ya’yan Yoktan maza ne.
english: Ophir, Havilah, and Jobab. All these were the sons of Joktan.

hausa: Ku lura kada abubuwan da annabawa suka faɗa su faru muku.
english: Beware therefore, lest that come on you which is spoken in the prophets:

hausa: Suka kuma kwashe ƙananan kwanonin sha, da farantan wuta, da daruna, da tukwane, da alkukai, da tasoshin ƙona turare, da kwanonin miƙa hadayar sha. Duk abin da yake na zinariya da azurfa, shugaban matsara ya kwashe.
english: The captain of the guard took away the cups, the fire pans, the basins, the pots, the lamp stands, the spoons, and the bowls; that which was of gold, as gold, and that which was of silver, as silver.

hausa: Zerubbabel ya haifi Abiyud, Abiyud ya haifi Eliyakim, Eliyakim ya haifi Azor,
english: Zerubbabel became the father of Abiud. Abiud became the father of Eliakim. Eliakim became the father of Azor.

hausa: zan tuna da alkawarina da Yaƙub, da alkawarina da Ishaku, da kuma alkawarina da Ibrahim, zan tuna da ƙasar.
english: then I will remember my covenant with Jacob, my covenant with Isaac, and also my covenant with Abraham; and I will remember the land.

hausa: Yiron, Migdal El, Horem, Bet-Anat da Bet-Shemesh. Garuruwa goma sha tara ke nan da ƙauyukansu.
