english: Iron, Migdal El, Horem, Beth Anath, and Beth Shemesh; nineteen cities with their villages.

hausa: “Kada ka yi aure ka haifi ’ya’ya maza da mata a wannan wuri.”
english: “You shall not take a wife, neither shall you have sons or daughters, in this place.”

hausa: Game da sauran ayyukan mulkin Fekahiya, duk a rubuce suke a cikin littafin tarihin sarakunan Isra’ila.
english: Now the rest of the acts of Pekahiah, and all that he did, behold, they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel.

hausa: don kada yă ɗauki kansa ya fi ’yan’uwansa, yă kuma juya daga dokar zuwa dama, ko zuwa hagu. Sa’an nan shi da kuma zuriyarsa za su daɗe suna mulki a Isra’ila.
english: that his heart not be lifted up above his brothers, and that he not turn away from the commandment to the right hand, or to the left, to the end that he may prolong his days in his kingdom, he and his children, in the middle of Israel.

hausa: ku kuma da kuke a sauran ƙungiyoyi biyu da kun saba hutu a Asabbaci, duk za ku yi gadin haikali don sarki.
english: The two companies of you, even all who go out on the Sabbath, shall keep the watch of Yahweh’s house around the king.

hausa: A kowane lardi da kowace birni, ko’ina da dokar sarki ta kai, aka yi farin ciki a cikin Yahudawa, cike da bukukkuwa. Yawan mutane da waɗansu ƙasashe suka zama Yahudawa, don tsoron Yahudawa ya kama su.
english: In every province and in every city, wherever the king’s commandment and his decree came, the Jews had gladness, joy, a feast and a holiday. Many from among the peoples of the land became Jews, for the fear of the Jews had fallen on them.

hausa: Waɗanda suke tsaye kusa da Bulus kuwa suka ce masa, “Babban firist na Allah za ka zaga?”
english: Those who stood by said, “Do you malign God’s high priest?”

hausa: Sa’an nan shugabannin Filistiyawa suka kawo mata sababbin igiyoyi guda bakwai da ba su bushe ba, sai ta daure shi da su.
english: Then the lords of the Philistines brought up to her seven green cords which had not been dried, and she bound him with them.

hausa: Mutanen Ammon da Mowab suka tasar wa mazaunan Dutsen Seyir, suka hallaka su ƙaƙaf. Sa’ad da suka karkashe mazaunan Seyir sai suka fāɗa wa juna, suka yi ta hallaka juna.
english: For the children of Ammon and Moab stood up against the inhabitants of Mount Seir to utterly kill and destroy them. When they had finished the inhabitants of Seir, everyone helped to destroy each other.

hausa: Sun fito daga al’ummai da Ubangiji ya ce wa Isra’ilawa, “Kada ku yi aurayya da su, domin tabbatacce za su juye zukatanku zuwa ga waɗansu alloli.” Duk da haka Solomon ya manne musu, ya nace, yana ƙaunarsu.
english: of the nations concerning which Yahweh said to the children of Israel, “You shall not go among them, neither shall they come among you, for surely they will turn away your heart after their gods.” Solomon joined to these in love.

hausa: ku da kuka karɓi dokar da aka sa a aiki ta wurin mala’iku amma ba ku yi biyayya da ita ba.”
english: You received the law as it was ordained by angels, and didn’t keep it!”

hausa: A rana ta bakwai ɗin firist zai bincika mikin in kuwa ƙaiƙayin bai bazu ba, ba rawayan gashi kuma a ciki, babu zurfin da yake fiye da fatar jiki,
english: On the seventh day the priest shall examine the plague; and behold, if the itch hasn’t spread, and there is no yellow hair in it, and the appearance of the itch isn’t deeper than the skin,

hausa: “Wani zai iya hana a yi wa waɗannan mutane baftisma da ruwa? Sun karɓi Ruhu Mai Tsarki kamar yadda muka karɓa.”
english: “Can anyone forbid these people from being baptized with water? They have received the Holy Spirit just like us.”

hausa: Na yi addu’a ga Ubangiji Allahna na furta laifina. “Ya Ubangiji, mai alfarma da kuma Allah mai banrazana, wanda yake cika alkawarinsa na ƙauna ga duk wanda ya ƙaunace shi ya kuma kiyaye dokokinsa,
english: I prayed to Yahweh my God, and made confession, and said, “Oh, Lord, the great and dreadful God, who keeps covenant and loving kindness with those who love him and keep his commandments,

hausa: Ta wurin maganar Ubangiji aka yi sammai, rundunar taurarinsu kuwa da numfashin bakinsa.
english: By Yahweh’s word, the heavens were made: all their army by the breath of his mouth.

hausa: Suka manta da abin da ya aikata, abubuwan banmamakin da ya nuna musu.
english: They forgot his doings, his wondrous deeds that he had shown them.

hausa: Suka ci gaba da amfani da gumakan da Mika ya yi, a duk wannan lokacin gidan Allah yana a Shilo.
english: So they set up for themselves Micah’s engraved image which he made, and it remained all the time that God’s house was in Shiloh.

hausa: Gama ba mu rubuta muku abin da ba za ku iya karatu ko ku kāsa fahimta ba. Ina kuma fata cewa,
english: For we write no other things to you than what you read or even acknowledge, and I hope you will acknowledge to the end—

hausa: Sauran ayyukan sarautar Yerobowam, da yaƙe-yaƙensa, da yadda ya yi mulki, ba a rubuce suke a littafin tarihi na sarakunan Isra’ila ba?
english: The rest of the acts of Jeroboam, how he fought and how he reigned, behold, they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel.

hausa: “Mai neman sa wa wani laifi zai iya ja da Maɗaukaki? Bari mai tuhumar Allah yă amsa masa.”
english: “Shall he who argues contend with the Almighty? He who argues with God, let him answer it.”

hausa: Sai suka sāke amsa masa suka ce, “Ran sarki yă daɗe, faɗa wa bayinka mafarkin, mu kuma za mu fassara shi.”
english: They answered the second time and said, “Let the king tell his servants the dream, and we will show the interpretation.”

hausa: Shi wanda ya tuna da mu cikin ƙasƙancinmu Ƙaunarsa madawwamiya ce.
english: who remembered us in our low estate, for his loving kindness endures forever;

hausa: haɗe da zub da jinin marasa laifi. Gama ya ƙazantar da Urushalima da jinin marasa laifi. Ubangiji kuwa bai yi niyyar yafewa ba.
english: and also for the innocent blood that he shed; for he filled Jerusalem with innocent blood, and Yahweh would not pardon.

hausa: An ƙidaya aka kuma haɗa ’ya’yan Musa maza mutumin Allah a sashen kabilar Lawi.
english: But as for Moses the man of God, his sons were named among the tribe of Levi.

hausa: Bayan ya haifi Arfakshad, Shem ya yi shekara 500, ya haifi waɗansu ’ya’ya maza da mata.
english: Shem lived five hundred years after he became the father of Arpachshad, and became the father of more sons and daughters.

hausa: Ubangiji ya ga wannan ya kuma ƙi su, domin ’ya’yansa maza da mata sun husata shi.
english: Yahweh saw and abhorred, because of the provocation of his sons and his daughters.

hausa: Saboda haka sai ku zama cikakku, yadda Ubanku na sama yake cikakke.
english: Therefore you shall be perfect, just as your Father in heaven is perfect.

hausa: Sa’ad da aka gaya wa Dawuda game da wannan, sai ya aiki manzanni su taryi waɗannan mutanen da aka ci mutuncinsu, gama an wulaƙanta su ƙwarai. Sai sarki ya ce musu, “Ku dakata a Yeriko har sai gemunku ya sāke girma, sa’an nan ku dawo.”
english: When they told David this, he sent to meet them, for the men were greatly ashamed. The king said, “Wait at Jericho until your beards have grown, and then return.”

hausa: Sai Laban ya ɗauki danginsa tare da shi, ya bi bayan Yaƙub har kwana bakwai, ya kuma same shi a yankin tuddan Gileyad.
english: He took his relatives with him, and pursued him seven days’ journey. He overtook him in the mountain of Gilead.

hausa: Sai ya aika da dawakai da kekunan yaƙi da babban rukunin soja zuwa can. Suka bi dare, suka kewaye birnin.
english: Therefore he sent horses, chariots, and a great army there. They came by night and surrounded the city.

hausa: Wawa ba ya sha’awa ya sami fahimta amma abin da yake so ya yi kaɗai, shi ne ya ba da ra’ayinsa.
english: A fool has no delight in understanding, but only in revealing his own opinion.

hausa: Waɗanda suka gan shi, suka kawo shi wurin Musa da Haruna da dukan taro,
english: Those who found him gathering sticks brought him to Moses and Aaron, and to all the congregation.

hausa: da kuma bakwai na kowane iri tsuntsu, namiji da ta mace, domin a bar kowane irinsu da rai a dukan duniya.
english: Also of the birds of the sky, seven and seven, male and female, to keep seed alive on the surface of all the earth.

hausa: Ka zuba fushinka a kan al’umman da ba su yarda da kai ba, a kan mulkokin da ba sa kira bisa sunanka;
english: Pour out your wrath on the nations that don’t know you, on the kingdoms that don’t call on your name,

hausa: “Mutum dai shirim ne kawai yayinda yake kai da komowa. Yana ta yawo, amma a banza ne kawai; yakan tara dukiya, ba tare da sanin wa zai more ta ba.
english: “Surely every man walks like a shadow. Surely they busy themselves in vain. He heaps up, and doesn’t know who shall gather.

hausa: Yaƙub ya kira inda Allah ya yi magana da shi, Betel.
english: Jacob called the name of the place where God spoke with him “Bethel”.

hausa: Mala’ikana zai sha gabanku, yă kawo ku cikin ƙasar Amoriyawa, da Hittiyawa, da Ferizziyawa, da Kan’aniyawa, da Hiwiyawa, da kuma Yebusiyawa, zan kuma kawar da su.
english: For my angel shall go before you, and bring you in to the Amorite, the Hittite, the Perizzite, the Canaanite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite; and I will cut them off.

hausa: “Me kuka gani? An yi wani mutum wanda yake da ’ya’ya biyu maza. Sai ya je wajen ɗan farin ya ce, ‘Ɗana, yau tafi gonar inabi ka yi aiki.’
english: But what do you think? A man had two sons, and he came to the first, and said, ‘Son, go work today in my vineyard.’

hausa: Sarki Rehobowam ya aiki Adoniram wanda yake shugaban aikin gandu, amma Isra’ila suka jajjefe shi da dutse har ya mutu. Sarki Rehobowam, ya sullale ya hau keken yaƙinsa ya tsere zuwa Urushalima.
english: Then King Rehoboam sent Adoram, who was over the men subject to forced labor; and all Israel stoned him to death with stones. King Rehoboam hurried to get himself up to his chariot, to flee to Jerusalem.

hausa: Ana nan sai sojojin Filistiyawa suka fita zuwa mashigin Mikmash.
english: The garrison of the Philistines went out to the pass of Michmash.

hausa: zan ba da su ga abokan gābansu waɗanda suke neman ransu. Gawawwakinsu za su zama abincin tsuntsayen sararin sama da na namun jeji.
english: I will even give them into the hand of their enemies and into the hand of those who seek their life. Their dead bodies will be food for the birds of the sky and for the animals of the earth.

hausa: Duk wanda ya yi irin wannan mai, duk wanda kuma ya shafa shi a kan wani wanda yake ba firist ba, za a ware shi daga mutanensa.’ ”
english: Whoever compounds any like it, or whoever puts any of it on a stranger, he shall be cut off from his people.’”

hausa: Wa yake kama da mai hikima? Wa ya san bayanin abubuwa? Hikima takan haskaka fuskar mutum, ta kuma kawo sakin fuska.
english: Who is like the wise man? And who knows the interpretation of a thing? A man’s wisdom makes his face shine, and the hardness of his face is changed.

hausa: Saboda haka Ubangiji ya ce, “Zan kawar da mutum, da dabbobi, da halittu masu rarrafe a ƙasa da kuma tsuntsayen sama waɗanda na halitta, daga doron ƙasa, saboda na damu da na yi su.”
english: Yahweh said, “I will destroy man whom I have created from the surface of the ground—man, along with animals, creeping things, and birds of the sky—for I am sorry that I have made them.”

hausa: Obal, Abimayel, Sheba,
english: Obal, Abimael, Sheba,

hausa: Ban da haka, Dawuda ya yaƙi Hadadezer sarkin Zoba, har can Hamat, sa’ad da ya je don yă kafa mulkinsa a wajen Kogin Yuferites.
english: David defeated Hadadezer king of Zobah, toward Hamath, as he went to establish his dominion by the river Euphrates.

hausa: “Tafi ka faɗa wa Dawuda, ‘Ga abin da Ubangiji ya ce ina ba ka abubuwa uku. Ka zaɓi ɗaya daga cikinsu don in aikata a kanka.’ ”
english: “Go and speak to David, saying, ‘Yahweh says, “I offer you three things. Choose one of them, that I may do it to you.”’”

hausa: Wannan za tă zama musu dawwammamiyar farilla. “Mutumin da ya yayyafa ruwa na tsarkakewa, shi ma dole yă wanke rigarsa. Duk wanda kuma ya taɓa ruwan tsarkakewa, zai kasance da ƙazanta har yamma.
english: It shall be a perpetual statute to them. He who sprinkles the water for impurity shall wash his clothes, and he who touches the water for impurity shall be unclean until evening.

hausa: Gama sarki ya dogara gare ka Ubangiji ta wurin ƙauna marar ƙarewa ta Mafi Ɗaukaka ba zai jijjigu ba.
english: For the king trusts in Yahweh. Through the loving kindness of the Most High, he shall not be moved.

hausa: Amma Saratu ta ga cewa yaron da Hagar, mutuniyar Masar ta haifa wa Ibrahim yana wa ɗanta Ishaku gori,
english: Sarah saw the son of Hagar the Egyptian, whom she had borne to Abraham, mocking.

hausa: “Idanuna sun ga waɗannan duka, kunnuwana sun ji sun kuma gane.
english: “Behold, my eye has seen all this. My ear has heard and understood it.

hausa: Dokokinka sun dawwama har yă zuwa yau, gama dukan abubuwa suna maka hidima.
english: Your laws remain to this day, for all things serve you.

hausa: A gabanku, Ubangiji zai sa ku fatattaki abokan gāban da za su taso suna gāba da ku. Ta hanya guda za su auka muku, amma ta hanyoyi bakwai za su gudu daga gabanku.
english: Yahweh will cause your enemies who rise up against you to be struck before you. They will come out against you one way, and will flee before you seven ways.

hausa: Wannan shi ne abin da muke sanarwa, ba da kalmomin da muka koya ta wurin hikimar mutum ba, amma da kalmomin da Ruhu yake koyarwa, muna faɗin gaskiya ta ruhaniya da kalmomin ruhaniya.
english: We also speak these things, not in words which man’s wisdom teaches but which the Holy Spirit teaches, comparing spiritual things with spiritual things.

hausa: Kamar yadda yake a rubuce cewa, “Na mai da kai uban al’ummai masu yawa.” Shi ubanmu ne a gaban Allah, wanda a cikinsa ya gaskata, Allahn da yake ba da rai ga matattu, yake kuma kiran abubuwan da ba su kasance ba su zama kamar sun kasance.
english: As it is written, “I have made you a father of many nations.” This is in the presence of him whom he believed: God, who gives life to the dead, and calls the things that are not, as though they were.

hausa: Amma duk wanda yake ƙin ɗan’uwansa, cikin duhu yake, yana kuma tafiya cikin duhu ke nan; bai ma san inda za shi ba, domin duhun ya makanta shi.
english: But he who hates his brother is in the darkness, and walks in the darkness, and doesn’t know where he is going, because the darkness has blinded his eyes.

hausa: Ka san inda ƙafafunka suke takawa ka bi hanyoyin da suke daram kawai.
english: Make the path of your feet level. Let all of your ways be established.

hausa: A matsayinmu na abokan aikin Allah, muna roƙonku kada ku karɓi alherin Allah a banza.
english: Working together, we entreat also that you do not receive the grace of God in vain.

hausa: Amma an jefar da kabarinka kamar reshen da aka ƙi; an rufe ka da waɗanda aka kashe, tare da waɗanda aka soke da takobi, waɗanda suka gangara zuwa duwatsun rami. Kamar gawar da aka tattake da ƙafa,
english: But you are cast away from your tomb like an abominable branch, clothed with the slain who are thrust through with the sword, who go down to the stones of the pit; like a dead body trodden under foot.

hausa: Abin da kuka sani, ni ma na sani; ba ku fi ni ba.
english: What you know, I know also. I am not inferior to you.

hausa: Kada ka zama mai ɗaukar lamuni ko ka ba da jingina saboda bashi;
english: Don’t you be one of those who strike hands, of those who are collateral for debts.

hausa: Ya yi tagogin da suka fi fāɗi daga ciki fiye da waje a haikalin.
english: He made windows of fixed lattice work for the house.

hausa: In na ɗaga kaina, za ka neme ni kamar zaki ka sāke nuna al’ajabin ikonka a kaina.
english: If my head is held high, you hunt me like a lion. Again you show yourself powerful to me.

hausa: Saboda haka na fisshe su daga Masar na kawo su cikin hamada.
english: So I caused them to go out of the land of Egypt and brought them into the wilderness.

hausa: Za su lashi ƙura kamar maciji, kamar dabbobi masu rarrafe a ƙasa. Za su fito daga maɓuyarsu da rawan jiki, za su juya cikin tsoro ga Ubangiji Allahnmu su kuma ji tsoronku.
english: They will lick the dust like a serpent. Like crawling things of the earth, they will come trembling out of their dens. They will come with fear to Yahweh our God, and will be afraid because of you.

hausa: Bari su zo da sauri su yi kuka a kanmu sai idanunmu sun cika da hawaye giranmu kuma su jiƙe sharkaf.
english: Let them make haste and take up a wailing for us, that our eyes may run down with tears and our eyelids gush out with waters.

hausa: Kada ku koma gonar inabinku kuna kala, ko ku tattara ’ya’yan inabin da suka fāffāɗi. Ku bar su domin matalauta da kuma baƙi. Ni ne Ubangiji Allahnku.
english: You shall not glean your vineyard, neither shall you gather the fallen grapes of your vineyard. You shall leave them for the poor and for the foreigner. I am Yahweh your God.

hausa: Da jin haka, sai ya tashi ya shimfiɗa wa jakinsa abin zama, ya hau, ya tafi Gat wurin Akish domin neman bayinsa. Shimeyi kuwa ya dawo da su gida daga Gat.
english: Shimei arose, saddled his donkey, and went to Gath to Achish to seek his slaves; and Shimei went and brought his slaves from Gath.

hausa: Kai wane ne har da za ka ga laifin bawan wani? Ko bawan yă yi aiki mai kyau, ko yă kāsa, ai, wannan ruwan maigidansa ne. Za a ma tsai da shi, domin Ubangiji yana da ikon tsai da shi.
english: Who are you who judge another’s servant? To his own lord he stands or falls. Yes, he will be made to stand, for God has power to make him stand.

hausa: kamar yadda yake a rubuce cewa, “Wanda ya tara da yawa, bai tara fiye da bukatarsa ba, wanda kuma ya tara kaɗan, bai kāsa masa ba.”
english: As it is written, “He who gathered much had nothing left over, and he who gathered little had no lack.”

hausa: Sai na ce musu, “Kun ga matsalar da muke ciki, yadda Urushalima ta zama kango, an kuma ƙone ƙofofinta da wuta. Ku zo mu sāke gina katangar Urushalima, ba za mu ƙara shan kunya ba.”
english: Then I said to them, “You see the bad situation that we are in, how Jerusalem lies waste, and its gates are burned with fire. Come, let’s build up the wall of Jerusalem, that we won’t be disgraced.”

hausa: Aka ba ta iko tă ba da numfashi ga siffar dabban nan ta fari, don tă yi magana tă kuma sa a kashe duk waɗanda suka ƙi yi wa siffar sujada.
english: It was given to him to give breath to the image of the beast, that the image of the beast should both speak, and cause as many as wouldn’t worship the image of the beast to be killed.

hausa: Kada ku yi zama bisa ga al’adun al’umman da zan kora a gabanku. Domin sun aikata dukan waɗannan abubuwa, na yi ƙyamarsu.
english: You shall not walk in the customs of the nation which I am casting out before you; for they did all these things, and therefore I abhorred them.

hausa: Ishaku ya tambaye su, “Me ya kawo ku gare ni, da yake kun yi gāba da ni, kuka kuma kore ni?”
english: Isaac said to them, “Why have you come to me, since you hate me, and have sent me away from you?”

hausa: Na kuma kafa alkawari da su don in ba su ƙasar Kan’ana, inda suka yi zaman baƙunci.
english: I have also established my covenant with them, to give them the land of Canaan, the land of their travels, in which they lived as aliens.

hausa: “Za ka iya daure kyakkyawar kaza da ’ya’yanta? Ko za ka iya kunce igiyoyin mafarauci da kare da zomo?
english: “Can you bind the cluster of the Pleiades, or loosen the cords of Orion?

hausa: Bisa ga umarnin ƙarshe na Dawuda, za a ƙidaya Lawiyawa daga ’yan shekara ashirin ko fiye.
english: For by the last words of David the sons of Levi were counted, from twenty years old and upward.

hausa: Duk wanda ya ƙoshi da zuma, ba ya marmarinsa kuma amma wanda yake yunwa ko abin da yake da ɗaci ma zai ji shi da zaƙi.
english: A full soul loathes a honeycomb; but to a hungry soul, every bitter thing is sweet.

hausa: Da ya hangi wani itacen ɓaure mai ganye, sai ya je domin yă ga ko yana da ’ya’ya. Amma da ya kai can, bai tarar da kome ba sai ganye, domin ba lokacin ’ya’yan ɓaure ba ne.
english: Seeing a fig tree afar off having leaves, he came to see if perhaps he might find anything on it. When he came to it, he found nothing but leaves, for it was not the season for figs.

hausa: Amma in ina fitar da aljanu ta wurin Ruhun Allah ne, to, fa, mulkin Allah ya zo muku ke nan.
english: But if I by the Spirit of God cast out demons, then God’s Kingdom has come upon you.

hausa: Bet-Markabot, Hazar-Susim, Bet-Biri da Sha’arayim. Waɗannan su ne garuruwansu har lokacin mulkin Dawuda.
english: at Beth Marcaboth, Hazar Susim, at Beth Biri, and at Shaaraim. These were their cities until David’s reign.

hausa: Bari tausayinka yă zo mini don in rayu, gama dokarka ce farin cikina.
english: Let your tender mercies come to me, that I may live; for your law is my delight.

hausa: Dukan mazan da suka fito ƙofar birnin suka yarda da Hamor da kuma ɗansa Shekem, aka kuwa yi wa kowane namiji a birnin kaciya.
english: All who went out of the gate of his city listened to Hamor, and to Shechem his son; and every male was circumcised, all who went out of the gate of his city.

hausa: Wawayen sun ɗauki fitilunsu, sai dai ba su riƙe mai ba.
english: Those who were foolish, when they took their lamps, took no oil with them,

hausa: Ubangiji zai juye ruwan saman ƙasarku yă zama ƙura da gari; zai sauko daga gizagizai har sai kun hallaka.
english: Yahweh will make the rain of your land powder and dust. It will come down on you from the sky, until you are destroyed.

hausa: Aka yi yaƙi tsakanin Asa da Ba’asha sarkin Isra’ila dukan kwanakin mulkinsu.
english: There was war between Asa and Baasha king of Israel all their days.

hausa: haka kuma suka gina Nebo da Ba’al-Meyon (an canja waɗannan sunaye) suka kuma gina Sibma. Suka ba wa biranen da suka sāke ginawa sunaye.
english: Nebo, and Baal Meon, (their names being changed), and Sibmah. They gave other names to the cities which they built.

hausa: Sai ya kai Sha Biyun gefe ɗaya, ya ce musu, “Za mu Urushalima, kuma dukan abin da annabawa suka rubuta a kan Ɗan Mutum zai cika.
english: He took the twelve aside and said to them, “Behold, we are going up to Jerusalem, and all the things that are written through the prophets concerning the Son of Man will be completed.

hausa: Ko za a wahalar da ganye wanda iska take hurawa? Ko za ka bi busasshiyar ciyawa?
english: Will you harass a driven leaf? Will you pursue the dry stubble?

hausa: Waɗannan su ne zuriyar Rafa a Gat, Dawuda da mutanensa sun kashe su.
english: These were born to the giant in Gath; and they fell by the hand of David and by the hand of his servants.

hausa: wato, don ni da ku mu ƙarfafa juna ta wurin bangaskiyarmu.
english: that is, that I with you may be encouraged in you, each of us by the other’s faith, both yours and mine.

hausa: “Saboda ku zan tsawata wa zuriyarku; zan watsa kashin dabbobin hadayunku a fuskokinku, a kuma kwashe ku tare da shi.
english: Behold, I will rebuke your offspring, and will spread dung on your faces, even the dung of your feasts; and you will be taken away with it.

hausa: Kishina ya cinye ni ɗungum, gama abokan gābana sun yi biris da maganganunka.
english: My zeal wears me out, because my enemies ignore your words.

hausa: Bari koguna su tafa hannuwansu, bari duwatsu su rera tare don farin ciki;
english: Let the rivers clap their hands. Let the mountains sing for joy together.

hausa: suna cewa, “Muna maka godiya ya Ubangiji Allah, Maɗaukaki, wanda yake a yanzu, shi ne kuma a dā, domin ka karɓi ikonka mai girma ka kuma fara mulki.
english: saying: “We give you thanks, Lord God, the Almighty, the one who is and who was, because you have taken your great power and reigned.

hausa: Sai suka yabi Allah saboda ni.
english: So they glorified God in me.

hausa: daga Shemida, kabilar Shemadawa; daga Hefer, kabilar Heferawa.
english: and Shemida, the family of the Shemidaites; and Hepher, the family of the Hepherites.

hausa: Sa’an nan ka ce wa Isra’ilawa, ‘Ku ɗauki bunsuru na yin hadaya don zunubi, da ɗan maraƙi bana ɗaya, da ɗan rago bana ɗaya marasa lahani, don hadaya ta ƙonawa,
english: You shall speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘Take a male goat for a sin offering; and a calf and a lamb, both a year old, without defect, for a burnt offering;

hausa: Sai sojojin suka yayyanke igiyoyin da suke riƙe da ɗan ƙaramin jirgin, suka bar shi ya bi ruwa.
english: Then the soldiers cut away the ropes of the boat and let it fall off.

hausa: Saboda haka Yowab ya tafi wurin sarki ya gaya masa wannan. Sai sarki ya aika aka zo da Absalom, ya kuma rusuna da fuskarsa har ƙasa a gaban sarki. Sarki kuwa ya sumbaci Absalom.
english: So Joab came to the king and told him; and when he had called for Absalom, he came to the king and bowed himself on his face to the ground before the king; and the king kissed Absalom.

hausa: Saboda Sunan nan ne suka fito, ba sa karɓan wani taimako daga waɗanda ba masu bi ba.
english: because for the sake of the Name they went out, taking nothing from the Gentiles.

hausa: Da suka ji cewa Yesu yana da rai, har ma ta gan shi, ba su gaskata ba.
english: When they heard that he was alive and had been seen by her, they disbelieved.

hausa: sai suka zo wurin Gedaliya a Mizfa, Ishmayel ɗan Netaniya, Yohanan da Yonatan ’ya’yan Kareya, da Serahiya ɗan Tanhumet maza, ’ya’yan Efai maza, mutumin Netofa, da Yezaniya ɗan mutumin Ma’aka da mutanensu.
english: then Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, and Johanan and Jonathan the sons of Kareah, and Seraiah the son of Tanhumeth, and the sons of Ephai the Netophathite, and Jezaniah the son of the Maacathite, they and their men came to Gedaliah to Mizpah.

hausa: Ubangiji ya ce wa Musa,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

hausa: Sai ya ci gaba da cewa, in kuma ka ce mini “Muna dogara ga Ubangiji Allahnmu ne,” ba masujadansa da bagadansa ne Hezekiya ya ciccire, yana ce wa Urushalima da Yahuda, “Dole ku yi sujada a gaban wannan bagade a Urushalima”?
english: But if you tell me, ‘We trust in Yahweh our God,’ isn’t that he whose high places and whose altars Hezekiah has taken away, and has said to Judah and to Jerusalem, ‘You shall worship before this altar in Jerusalem’?

hausa: Sai Yesu ya ce, “Uwargida, ina tabbatar miki, lokaci yana zuwa da ba za ku yi wa Uba sujada ko a dutsen nan, ko kuwa a Urushalima ba.
english: Jesus said to her, “Woman, believe me, the hour is coming when neither in this mountain nor in Jerusalem will you worship the Father.

hausa: Duk wanda bai zo a cikin kwana uku ba, za a washe shi, a kuma ware shi daga jama’ar da suka dawo daga bauta. Haka shugabanni da dattawa suka zartar.
english: and that whoever didn’t come within three days, according to the counsel of the princes and the elders, all his possessions should be forfeited, and he himself separated from the assembly of the captivity.

hausa: Sa’an nan za su ce, “Ba mu da sarki domin ba mu girmama Ubangiji ba. Amma ko da ma muna da sarki, me zai yi mana?”
english: Surely now they will say, “We have no king; for we don’t fear Yahweh; and the king, what can he do for us?”

hausa: Amma sa’ad da suka gane shi mutumin Yahuda ne, sai duk suka yi ihu gaba ɗaya na kusa sa’a biyu, suna cewa, “Girma ta tabbata ga Artemis ta Afisawa!”
english: But when they perceived that he was a Jew, all with one voice for a time of about two hours cried out, “Great is Artemis of the Ephesians!”

hausa: Ana cikin haka, dukan mutanen kuma sai kuka da makoki suke ta yi, domin yarinyar. Sai Yesu ya ce, “Ka daina yin kuka, ba tă mutu ba, tana barci ne.”
english: All were weeping and mourning her, but he said, “Don’t weep. She isn’t dead, but sleeping.”

hausa: Yayinda yana cikin magana, sai Yahuda, ɗaya daga cikin Sha Biyun nan, ya iso. Tare da shi kuwa ga taro mai yawa riƙe da takuba da sanduna, manyan firistoci da dattawan mutane ne suka turo su.
english: While he was still speaking, behold, Judas, one of the twelve, came, and with him a great multitude with swords and clubs, from the chief priests and elders of the people.

hausa: Sa’an nan Sama’ila ya ce, “Kawo mini Agag sarkin Amalekawa.” Agag kuwa ya zo wurinsa daure da sarƙa, yana tunani cewa, “Tabbatacce zancen mutuwa dai ya wuce.”
english: Then Samuel said, “Bring Agag the king of the Amalekites here to me!” Agag came to him cheerfully. Agag said, “Surely the bitterness of death is past.”

hausa: sa’ad da mutane da mulkoki suka tattaru don su yi wa Ubangiji sujada.
english: when the peoples are gathered together, the kingdoms, to serve Yahweh.

hausa: Yakan sa mashawarta su zama marasa hikima yă kuma sa wawaye su zama masu shari’a.
english: He leads counselors away stripped. He makes judges fools.

hausa: Sai maganar Ubangiji ta zo mini,
english: Moreover Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

hausa: Natan ya gaya wa Dawuda dukan abin da Allah ya bayyana masa.
english: Nathan spoke to David all these words, and according to all this vision.

hausa: A lokacin nan Ubangiji ya ce wa Yoshuwa, “Ka yi wuƙaƙe na duwatsu ka yi wa Isra’ilawa kaciya.”
english: At that time, Yahweh said to Joshua, “Make flint knives, and circumcise again the sons of Israel the second time.”

hausa: Da Musa ya ji haka, sai ya gamsu.
english: When Moses heard that, it was pleasing in his sight.

hausa: daga kabilar Issakar suka sami Kedesh, Daberat,
english: and out of the tribe of Issachar, Kedesh with its pasture lands, Daberath with its pasture lands,

hausa: a cikin wutar kuwa akwai abin da ya yi kamar halittu guda huɗu. A bayyane kamanninsu ya yi kamar siffar mutum,
english: Out of its center came the likeness of four living creatures. This was their appearance: They had the likeness of a man.

hausa: Ba haka zai kasance da ku ba. Maimakon haka, duk mai son zama babba a cikinku, dole yă zama bawanku,
english: It shall not be so among you; but whoever desires to become great among you shall be your servant.

hausa: Saboda haka Irmiya annabi ya ce wa dukan mutanen Yahuda da dukan mazaunan Urushalima.
english: which Jeremiah the prophet spoke to all the people of Judah, and to all the inhabitants of Jerusalem:

hausa: Matalauci kan yi roƙo da taushi, amma mawadaci kan amsa da kakkausar murya.
english: The poor plead for mercy, but the rich answer harshly.

hausa: Ubangiji ya albarkaci maigidana sosai, ya kuma zama mai arziki. Ya ba shi tumaki, shanu, azurfa, zinariya, bayi maza da mata, raƙuma, da kuma jakuna.
english: Yahweh has blessed my master greatly. He has become great. Yahweh has given him flocks and herds, silver and gold, male servants and female servants, and camels and donkeys.

hausa: Saboda haka Dawuda ya haura, yadda Ubangiji ya umarta ta wurin Gad.
english: David went up according to the saying of Gad, as Yahweh commanded.

hausa: Muryar wani tana kira cewa, “A cikin hamada ku shirya hanya saboda Ubangiji; ku miƙe manyan hanyoyi domin Allahnmu a cikin jeji.
english: The voice of one who calls out, “Prepare the way of Yahweh in the wilderness! Make a level highway in the desert for our God.

hausa: Game da Mowab. Ga abin da Ubangiji Maɗaukaki, Allah na Isra’ila, yana cewa, “Kaito ga Nebo, gama za tă lalace. Kiriyatayim za su kunyata a kuma kame ta; katagar za tă sha kunya ta kuma wargaje.
english: Of Moab. Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel, says: “Woe to Nebo! For it is laid waste. Kiriathaim is disappointed. It is taken. Misgab is put to shame and broken down.

hausa: A kusurwoyi huɗu na filin da yake waje akwai waɗansu filaye a haɗe, tsawonsu kamu arba’in fāɗinsu kuwa kamu talatin; kowane fili a kusurwoyi huɗun nan girmansu ɗaya ne.
english: In the four corners of the court there were courts enclosed, forty cubits long and thirty wide. These four in the corners were the same size.

hausa: Saboda haka mutumin ya sa wa dukan dabbobi, da tsuntsayen sama da dukan namun jeji sunaye. Amma ba a sami mataimakin da ya dace da Adamu ba.
english: The man gave names to all livestock, and to the birds of the sky, and to every animal of the field; but for man there was not found a helper comparable to him.

hausa: Kada kuwa ya zaɓa mai kyau daga marar kyau, ko yă yi musaya. In ya yi musaya kuwa, dabbar da wadda ya musayar, za su zama masu tsarki, ba kuma za a fanshe su ba.’ ”
english: He shall not examine whether it is good or bad, neither shall he exchange it. If he exchanges it at all, then both it and that for which it is exchanged shall be holy. It shall not be redeemed.’”

hausa: Sai suka ce mata, “Kina hauka.” Da ta nace cewa shi ne, sai suka ce, “To, lalle, mala’ikansa ne.”
english: They said to her, “You are crazy!” But she insisted that it was so. They said, “It is his angel.”

hausa: Saboda haka Ubangiji Allah ya ce wa macijin, “Saboda ka yi haka, “Na la’anta ka cikin dukan dabbobi da kuma cikin dukan namun jeji! Daga yanzu rubda ciki za ka yi tafiya turɓaya kuma za ka ci dukan kwanakin rayuwarka.
english: Yahweh God said to the serpent, “Because you have done this, you are cursed above all livestock, and above every animal of the field. You shall go on your belly and you shall eat dust all the days of your life.

hausa: Ɗaya daga cikinsu, wani masanin Doka, ya gwada shi da wannan tambaya.
english: One of them, a lawyer, asked him a question, testing him.

hausa: Sukan yi ƙulle-ƙullen rashin adalci su ce, “Mun gama ƙulla cikakkiyar maƙarƙashiya tsab!” Zuciyar mutum da tunaninsa, suna da wuyar ganewa.
english: They plot injustice, saying, “We have made a perfect plan!” Surely man’s mind and heart are cunning.

hausa: Ina roƙonku ku karɓe ta a cikin Ubangiji yadda ya dace a karɓi tsarkaka a kuma ba ta kowane irin taimakon da take bukata daga wurinku, gama ta zama mai taimako ƙwarai ga mutane masu yawa, haɗe da ni ma.
english: that you receive her in the Lord in a way worthy of the saints, and that you assist her in whatever matter she may need from you, for she herself also has been a helper of many, and of my own self.

hausa: Aka sāke yin wani yaƙin kuma, wanda ya faru a Gat, akwai wani ƙaton mutum mai yatsotsi shida a kowane hannu da kuma yatsotsi shida a kowace ƙafa, yatsotsi ashirin da huɗu ke nan. Shi ma daga zuriyar Rafa ce.
english: There was again war at Gath, where there was a man of great stature, who had twenty-four fingers and toes, six on each hand and six on each foot; and he also was born to the giant.

hausa: Dukan ƙoƙarin da mutum yake yi, yana yi ne domin bakinsa, duk da haka bai taɓa gamsar da abin da yake marmari.
english: All the labor of man is for his mouth, and yet the appetite is not filled.

hausa: Sa’an nan Ubangiji ya ce wa Musa, “Ka ɗauki kayan yaji mai ƙanshi, resin na gum, da onika, da galbanum, da kuma zallan lubban, duk nauyinsu yă zama daidai.
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “Take to yourself sweet spices, gum resin, onycha, and galbanum: sweet spices with pure frankincense. There shall be an equal weight of each.

hausa: Sa’an nan Ayuba ya amsa wa Ubangiji,
english: Then Job answered Yahweh:

hausa: Karin maganan nan gaskiya ne cewa, ‘Wani da shuka, wani kuma da girbi.’
english: For in this the saying is true, ‘One sows, and another reaps.’

hausa: Kada ka ci abincin mai rowa, kada ka yi marmarin abincinsa mai daɗi;
english: Don’t eat the food of him who has a stingy eye, and don’t crave his delicacies,

hausa: “Ba mai iya bauta wa iyayengiji biyu. Ko dai yă ƙi ɗaya, yă ƙaunaci ɗaya, ko kuwa yă yi aminci ga ɗaya, sa’an nan yă rena ɗayan. Ba dama ku bauta wa Allah, ku kuma bauta wa kuɗi gaba ɗaya.”
english: “No one can serve two masters, for either he will hate the one and love the other, or else he will be devoted to one and despise the other. You can’t serve both God and Mammon.

hausa: Mutanen Dan ɗari shida da suka sha ɗamarar yaƙi suka tsaya a bakin ƙofa.
english: The six hundred men armed with their weapons of war, who were of the children of Dan, stood by the entrance of the gate.

hausa: Ɗaura shaidar nan ta gargadi ka kuma yimƙe umarnin Allah a cikin almajiraina.
english: Wrap up the covenant. Seal the law among my disciples.

hausa: Shi kuma ya yi tafiya yini guda zuwa cikin hamada. Ya zo wurin wani itacen tsintsiya, ya zauna a ƙarƙashinsa, ya roƙa yă mutu. Ya ce, “Ya ishe ni haka, Ubangiji, ka ɗauki raina; ban fi kakannina ba.”
english: But he himself went a day’s journey into the wilderness, and came and sat down under a juniper tree. Then he requested for himself that he might die, and said, “It is enough. Now, O Yahweh, take away my life; for I am not better than my fathers.”

hausa: Sai ya kawo akwatin a cikin tabanakul, ya kuma rataye labulen rufewa ya tsare akwatin Alkawarin, yadda Ubangiji ya umarce shi.
english: He brought the ark into the tabernacle, and set up the veil of the screen, and screened the ark of the covenant, as Yahweh commanded Moses.

hausa: Suka amsa suka ce, “Ba za mu iya ba, sai dukan garkunan sun taru, aka kuma gungurar da dutsen daga bakin rijiyar. Sa’an nan za mu shayar da tumakin.”
english: They said, “We can’t, until all the flocks are gathered together, and they roll the stone from the well’s mouth. Then we will water the sheep.”

hausa: Suka kawo masa kuɗin, sai ya tambaye, su ya ce, “Hoton wane ne wannan? Kuma rubutun wane ne wannan?” Suka ce, “Na Kaisar.”
english: They brought it. He said to them, “Whose is this image and inscription?” They said to him, “Caesar’s.”

hausa: Duk abin da yana nan ya taɓa kasancewa, kuma abin da zai kasance, ya taɓa kasancewa; Allah kuma zai nemi bayanin abubuwan da suka wuce.
english: That which is has been long ago, and that which is to be has been long ago. God seeks again that which is passed away.

hausa: Ba shakka shukar ta mutu ke nan, kuma waɗansu za su tsiro a wurin.
english: Behold, this is the joy of his way. Out of the earth, others will spring.

hausa: Maƙiya ya kwashe dukiyarta duka; ta ga mutanen da ba su san Allah ba sun shiga wuri mai tsarkinta waɗanda ka hana su shiga taron jama’arka.
english: The adversary has spread out his hand on all her pleasant things; for she has seen that the nations have entered into her sanctuary, concerning whom you commanded that they should not enter into your assembly.

hausa: A cikin ƙaunarka marar iyaka, za ka bishe mutanen da ka fansa. A cikin ƙarfinka, za ka bishe su zuwa mazauninka mai tsarki.
english: “You, in your loving kindness, have led the people that you have redeemed. You have guided them in your strength to your holy habitation.

hausa: To, yanzu, ya Ubangiji Allah, ka cika alkawarin da ka yi ga mahaifina Dawuda yă tabbata, gama ka naɗa ni sarki a bisa mutanen da suka wuce ƙirge kamar ƙurar ƙasa.
english: Now, Yahweh God, let your promise to David my father be established; for you have made me king over a people like the dust of the earth in multitude.

hausa: Sa’an nan Bulus ya kāre kansa ya ce, “Ban aikata wani laifi game da dokokin Yahudawa ko game da haikali ko kuma game da Kaisar ba.”
english: while he said in his defense, “Neither against the law of the Jews, nor against the temple, nor against Caesar, have I sinned at all.”

hausa: Fiye da waɗannan duka, ku yi ƙaunar juna, gama ƙauna ce take haɗa kome gaba ɗaya.
english: Above all these things, walk in love, which is the bond of perfection.

hausa: Ki tare da ni daga Lebanon, amaryata, zo tare da ni daga Lebanon. Ki gangara daga ƙwanƙolin Amana, daga ƙwanƙolin Senir, ƙwanƙolin Hermon, daga ramin zaki da kuma dutsen da damisoshi suke zama.
english: Come with me from Lebanon, my bride, with me from Lebanon. Look from the top of Amana, from the top of Senir and Hermon, from the lions’ dens, from the mountains of the leopards.

hausa: ’Ya’yan Merari maza su ne, Mali da Mushi. Waɗannan suke gidajen Lawiyawan da aka jera bisa ga kakanninsu.
english: The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. These are the families of the Levites according to their fathers’ households.

hausa: Ya ɗauki ’ya’yansa maza da jikokinsa da ’ya’yansa mata da jikokinsa mata, dukan zuriyarsa zuwa Masar.
english: his sons, and his sons’ sons with him, his daughters, and his sons’ daughters, and he brought all his offspring with him into Egypt.

hausa: Ana furta ƙaunar a cikin kabari ne, ana zancen amincinka a cikin Hallaka ne?
english: Is your loving kindness declared in the grave? Or your faithfulness in Destruction?

hausa: Shimeyi ɗan Gera, mutumin Benyamin daga Bahurim ya gaggauta, ya gangara tare da mutanen Yahuda don su taryi Sarki Dawuda.
english: Shimei the son of Gera, the Benjamite, who was of Bahurim, hurried and came down with the men of Judah to meet King David.

hausa: To, fa, sarkin Aram ya umarce shugabannin keken yaƙinsa ya ce, “Kada ku yaƙi kowa, ƙarami ko babba, sai dai sarkin Isra’ila.”
english: Now the king of Syria had commanded the captains of his chariots, saying, “Don’t fight with small nor great, except only with the king of Israel.”

hausa: Yesu ya ce musu, “Ku yi hankali, ku yi taka zallan da yistin Farisiyawa da Sadukiyawa.”
english: Jesus said to them, “Take heed and beware of the yeast of the Pharisees and Sadducees.”

hausa: Masu hikima sukan sami kyakkyawan suna, amma wawaye sukan ƙara wa kansu shan kunya.
english: The wise will inherit glory, but shame will be the promotion of fools.

hausa: Allahn zamanin nan ya makanta hankulan marasa ba da gaskiya, yadda har ba za su iya ganin hasken bishara ta ɗaukakar Kiristi ba, wanda yake kamannin Allah.
english: in whom the god of this world has blinded the minds of the unbelieving, that the light of the Good News of the glory of Christ, who is the image of God, should not dawn on them.

hausa: Na’aman, da Ahiya, da Gera. Gera ne shugabansu lokacin da aka kai su bauta, shi ne ya haifi Uzza da Ahilud.
english: Naaman, Ahijah, and Gera, who carried them captive; and he became the father of Uzza and Ahihud.

hausa: Sa’an nan suka ɗauki Yunana suka jefar da shi daga jirgin, sai tekun ya kwanta.
english: So they took up Jonah and threw him into the sea; and the sea ceased its raging.

hausa: In su Ibraniyawa ne, ni ma haka. In su Isra’ilawa ne, ni ma haka. In su zuriyar Ibrahim ne, ni ma haka.
english: Are they Hebrews? So am I. Are they Israelites? So am I. Are they the offspring of Abraham? So am I.

hausa: Ya ratsa wurin yana ƙarfafa mutanen da kalmomi masu yawa, a ƙarshe kuma ya kai Giris,
english: When he had gone through those parts and had encouraged them with many words, he came into Greece.

hausa: Jawabinsa ya rinjaye su. Suka kira manzannin suka sa aka yi musu bulala. Sa’an nan suka kwaɓe su kada su ƙara magana a cikin sunan Yesu, suka kuma bar su suka tafi.
english: They agreed with him. Summoning the apostles, they beat them and commanded them not to speak in the name of Jesus, and let them go.

hausa: Sa’ad da suka cinye kome, sai na yi kira, na ce, “Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka, ka gafarta! Ta yaya Yaƙub zai tsira? Ga shi ɗan ƙarami ne!”
english: When they finished eating the grass of the land, then I said, “Lord Yahweh, forgive, I beg you! How could Jacob stand? For he is small.”

hausa: In ku mutane masu gaskiya ne, ku bar ɗaya daga cikin ’yan’uwanku yă zauna a kurkuku, yayinda sauranku su tafi, su kai hatsi don gidajenku da suke yunwa.
english: If you are honest men, then let one of your brothers be bound in your prison; but you go, carry grain for the famine of your houses.

hausa: “Saboda haka da yake mu zuriyar Allah ce, kada mu yi tsammani cewa kamannin Allah yana kama da zinariya ko azurfa ko dutse, siffar da mutum ya ƙago ta wurin dabararsa.
english: Being then the offspring of God, we ought not to think that the Divine Nature is like gold, or silver, or stone, engraved by art and design of man.

hausa: Bulus ya amsa ya ce, “Ko a ɗan lokaci, ko a lokaci mai yawa, ina addu’a ga Allah cewa, ba kai kaɗai ba amma duk waɗanda suke saurare ni a yau su zama abin da nake, sai dai ban da sarƙoƙin nan.”
english: Paul said, “I pray to God, that whether with little or with much, not only you, but also all that hear me today, might become such as I am, except for these bonds.”

hausa: Mai tsaro ya sāke cewa, “Ya kai wurinsu, amma shi ma ba ya dawowa. Ina ganin sukuwar kamar irin ta Yehu, jikan Nimshi, gama yakan yi sukuwa kamar mahaukaci.”
english: The watchman said, “He came to them, and isn’t coming back. The driving is like the driving of Jehu the son of Nimshi, for he drives furiously.”

hausa: Sai suka ji haushinsa. Amma Yesu ya ce musu, “Sai a garinsa da kuma a gidansa na kaɗai annabi ba ya samun girma.”
english: They were offended by him. But Jesus said to them, “A prophet is not without honor, except in his own country and in his own house.”

hausa: Ya yi haka domin yă cika bukatun adalcin doka a cikinmu, mu da ba ma rayuwa bisa ga mutuntaka, sai dai bisa ga Ruhu.
english: that the ordinance of the law might be fulfilled in us who don’t walk according to the flesh, but according to the Spirit.

hausa: Bayan Arameyawa suka ga Isra’ila ta ci su da yaƙi, sai suka sāke tattara kansu.
english: When the Syrians saw that they were defeated by Israel, they gathered themselves together.

hausa: Ishaku ya sāke tona rijiyoyi waɗanda dā aka haƙa a zamanin Ibrahim mahaifinsa, gama Filistiyawa suka tattoshe bayan mutuwar Ibrahim, ya kuma sa musu sunayen da mahaifinsa ya ba su.
english: Isaac dug again the wells of water, which they had dug in the days of Abraham his father, for the Philistines had stopped them after the death of Abraham. He called their names after the names by which his father had called them.

hausa: yă kai wa ’ya’yan Haruna maza waɗanda suke firistoci. Firist zai ɗiba gari mai laushin a tafin hannu da kuma man, tare da dukan turaren, yă ƙone wannan a sashen tunawa a kan bagade, hadaya ce da aka yi da wuta, mai daɗin ƙanshi ga Ubangiji.
english: He shall bring it to Aaron’s sons, the priests. He shall take his handful of its fine flour, and of its oil, with all its frankincense, and the priest shall burn its memorial on the altar, an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to Yahweh.

hausa: Gama duk wanda ya ci ya kuma sha ba tare da fahimtar jikin Ubangiji ba, ya ci ya kuma sha wa kansa hukunci ne.
english: For he who eats and drinks in an unworthy way eats and drinks judgment to himself if he doesn’t discern the Lord’s body.

hausa: Ya tuna da alkawarinsa mai tsarki da ya ba wa bawansa Ibrahim.
english: For he remembered his holy word, and Abraham, his servant.

hausa: Gaskiyata kuwa za tă zama mini shaida nan gaba, duk sa’ad da ka bincika a kan albashin da ka biya ni. Duk akuyar da take tawa da ba dabbare-dabbare ko babare-babare, ko ɗan ragon da ba baƙi ba, zai kasance sata na yi.”
english: So my righteousness will answer for me hereafter, when you come concerning my hire that is before you. Every one that is not speckled and spotted among the goats, and black among the sheep, that might be with me, will be considered stolen.”

hausa: Ya taɓa hannunta sai zazzaɓin ya sake ta, ta kuwa tashi ta fara yin masa hidima.
english: He touched her hand, and the fever left her. So she got up and served him.

hausa: “Babu wanda ya san wannan rana ko sa’a, ko mala’ikun da suke sama ma, ko Ɗan, sai dai Uban kaɗai.
english: “But no one knows of that day and hour, not even the angels of heaven, but my Father only.

hausa: Kwarinsu kamar buɗaɗɗen kabari ne; dukansu jarumawa ne.
english: Their quiver is an open tomb. They are all mighty men.

hausa: A wannan rana zan fara sa tsoro da fargabanku a kan dukan al’ummai, a ƙarƙashin sama. Za su ji labarinku, za su yi rawan jiki, su kuma damu saboda ku.”
english: Today I will begin to put the dread of you and the fear of you on the peoples who are under the whole sky, who shall hear the report of you, and shall tremble and be in anguish because of you.”

hausa: Bari masu adalci su yi farin ciki a cikin Ubangiji su kuma nemi mafaka a gare shi; bari dukan masu gaskiya a zuciya su yabe shi!
english: The righteous shall be glad in Yahweh, and shall take refuge in him. All the upright in heart shall praise him!

hausa: Akwai allahn wata al’ummar da ya taɓa ceton ƙasarsa daga hannun sarkin Assuriya?
english: Has any of the gods of the nations ever delivered his land out of the hand of the king of Assyria?

hausa: Hilkiya ne na biyu, Tabaliya ne na uku sai kuma Zakariya na huɗu. ’Ya’ya da dangin Hosa su 13 ne duka.
english: Hilkiah the second, Tebaliah the third, and Zechariah the fourth. All the sons and brothers of Hosah were thirteen.

hausa: “Amma kafin duk abubuwa nan, za a kama ku a tsananta muku. Za a kai ku majami’u, da kurkuku. Za a kuma kai ku gaban sarakuna da gwamnoni, kuma dukan waɗannan saboda sunana.
english: But before all these things, they will lay their hands on you and will persecute you, delivering you up to synagogues and prisons, bringing you before kings and governors for my name’s sake.

hausa: Zai tsoma yatsarsa cikin jini yă kuma yayyafa shi a gaban Ubangiji sau bakwai a gaban labule.
english: The priest shall dip his finger in the blood and sprinkle it seven times before Yahweh, before the veil.

hausa: Amma jarumin, a maimakon ya saurari abin da Bulus ya ce, sai ya bi shawarar matuƙi da kuma mai jirgin ruwan.
english: But the centurion gave more heed to the master and to the owner of the ship than to those things which were spoken by Paul.

hausa: Haɗe da ɗan rago na farkon, ka miƙa mudun gari mai laushi wanda an gauraye da kwalaba ɗaya na tataccen mai zaitun, da kwalaba ɗaya na ruwan inabi don hadaya ta sha.
english: and with the one lamb a tenth part of an ephah of fine flour mixed with the fourth part of a hin of beaten oil, and the fourth part of a hin of wine for a drink offering.

hausa: Duba na riga na ba ku wannan ƙasa. Ku shiga ku mallaki ƙasar da Ubangiji ya rantse zai ba wa kakanninku, ga Ibrahim, Ishaku da kuma Yaƙub, da kuma ga zuriyarsu bayansu.”
english: Behold, I have set the land before you. Go in and possess the land which Yahweh swore to your fathers—to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob—to give to them and to their offspring after them.’”

hausa: Saboda haka yanzu zan buɗe tsiraicinta a idanun kwartayenta; ba wani da zai ƙwace ta daga hannuwana.
english: Now I will uncover her lewdness in the sight of her lovers, and no one will deliver her out of my hand.

hausa: Sa’ad da Yusuf ya zo wurinsu kashegari, sai ya ga duk sun damu.
english: Joseph came in to them in the morning, and saw them, and saw that they were sad.

hausa: Ku tafi, ku ba ni wuri! Gama wannan ba wurin hutunku ba ne, gama ya ƙazantu, ya zama kangon da ya wuce gyara.
english: Arise, and depart! For this is not your resting place, because of uncleanness that destroys, even with a grievous destruction.

hausa: In aka kawo ƙarar da yake da wuya sosai ga alƙali a kotunanku, ko wadda aka zub da jini ne, ko ta faɗa ce, ko kuwa ta wadda aka ci mutunci ce, ku kai su wurin da Ubangiji Allahnku zai zaɓa.
english: If there arises a matter too hard for you in judgment, between blood and blood, between plea and plea, and between stroke and stroke, being matters of controversy within your gates, then you shall arise, and go up to the place which Yahweh your God chooses.

hausa: Wahayi game da Yahuda da Urushalima wanda Ishaya ɗan Amoz ya gani a zamanin da Uzziya, Yotam, Ahaz da Hezekiya, suka yi mulkin Yahuda.
english: The vision of Isaiah the son of Amoz, which he saw concerning Judah and Jerusalem, in the days of Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, kings of Judah.

hausa: Sai ya tafi ya kamo su, ya kawo wa mahaifiyarsa, ta kuwa shirya abinci mai daɗi, yadda mahaifinsa yake so.
english: He went, and got them, and brought them to his mother. His mother made savory food, such as his father loved.

hausa: Urushalima da garuruwan Yahuda, sarakunan da fadawanta, don su mai da su kufai da kuma abin bantsoro da ba’a da la’ana, yadda suke a yau;
english: Jerusalem, and the cities of Judah, with its kings and its princes, to make them a desolation, an astonishment, a hissing, and a curse, as it is today;

hausa: Kewaye da cikin kowane filin huɗun nan akwai ginin dutse, da murhu da aka gina a kewaye a ƙarƙashin ginin.
english: There was a wall around in them, around the four, and boiling places were made under the walls all around.

hausa: Wanda ya yi manyan haskoki, Ƙaunarsa madawwamiya ce.
english: to him who made the great lights, for his loving kindness endures forever;

hausa: Kowace ƙofa tana da murfi biyu masu buɗewa ciki da waje.
english: The doors had two leaves each, two turning leaves: two for the one door, and two leaves for the other.

hausa: Mawaƙa. Zuriyar Asaf mutum 148.
english: The singers: the children of Asaph: one hundred forty-eight.

hausa: “Ku ƙidaya dukan jama’ar Isra’ila daga mai shekaru ashirin zuwa gaba da za su iya aikin sojan Isra’ila.”
english: “Take a census of all the congregation of the children of Israel, from twenty years old and upward, by their fathers’ houses, all who are able to go out to war in Israel.”

hausa: Kai nagari ne, kuma abin da kake yi yana da kyau; ka koya mini ƙa’idodinka.
english: You are good, and do good. Teach me your statutes.

hausa: Sai Yehu ya tashi ya shiga cikin gida. Sa’an nan annabin ya zuba wa Yehu mai a kā, ya ce, “Ga abin da Ubangiji, Allah na Isra’ila ya ce, ‘Na naɗa ka sarki a bisa jama’ar Ubangiji, wato, Isra’ila.
english: He arose, and went into the house. Then he poured the oil on his head, and said to him, “Yahweh, the God of Israel, says, ‘I have anointed you king over the people of Yahweh, even over Israel.

hausa: Ga shi! Zaluncin da kuka yi na hakkin ma’aikatan gonakinku yana ta ƙara. Kukan masu girbi ya kai kunnuwan Ubangiji Maɗaukaki.
english: Behold, the wages of the laborers who mowed your fields, which you have kept back by fraud, cry out; and the cries of those who reaped have entered into the ears of the Lord of Armies.

hausa: Nan da nan sai ga yatsotsin hannun mutum sun bayyana, suna yin rubutu a kan shafen bangon, kusa da wurin da ake ajiye fitilar fadar sarki. Sarki kuwa yana ganin hannun yayinda yake rubutu.
english: In the same hour, the fingers of a man’s hand came out and wrote near the lamp stand on the plaster of the wall of the king’s palace. The king saw the part of the hand that wrote.

hausa: Sai ta ce wa bawanta, “Yi gaba, zan bi ka”. Amma ba tă gaya wa Nabal, mijinta ba.
english: She said to her young men, “Go on before me. Behold, I am coming after you.” But she didn’t tell her husband, Nabal.

hausa: Shi da ya tattara hatsi da rani ɗa ne mai hikima, amma shi da yakan yi barci a lokacin girbi ɗa ne wanda ya zama abin kunya.
english: He who gathers in summer is a wise son, but he who sleeps during the harvest is a son who causes shame.

hausa: Sa’an nan ya yi musu jawabi ya ce, “Mutanen Isra’ila, ku yi kula da kyau da abin da kuke niyyar yi wa mutanen nan.
english: He said to them, “You men of Israel, be careful concerning these men, what you are about to do.

hausa: Ashdod da garuruwa da kuma ƙauyukan da suke kewaye da ita, Gaza da garuruwanta da ƙauyukanta har zuwa Rafin Masar da kuma Bahar Rum.
english: Ashdod, its towns and its villages; Gaza, its towns and its villages; to the brook of Egypt, and the great sea with its coastline.

hausa: Ya yi abin da yake mugu a gaban Ubangiji Allahnsa kuma bai ƙasƙantar da kansa a gaban Irmiya annabi, wanda ya yi magana kalmar Ubangiji ba.
english: He did that which was evil in Yahweh his God’s sight. He didn’t humble himself before Jeremiah the prophet speaking from Yahweh’s mouth.

hausa: Saboda haka Dawuda ya aika saƙo wa Yowab ya ce, “Ka aiko mini da Uriya mutumin Hitti.” Yowab kuwa ya aika da shi wajen Dawuda.
english: David sent to Joab, “Send me Uriah the Hittite.” Joab sent Uriah to David.

hausa: ku tsaya daram ku kuma ginu a cikinsa, ku sami ƙarfafawa a cikin bangaskiya kamar yadda aka koya muku, kuna kuma cike da godiya.
english: rooted and built up in him and established in the faith, even as you were taught, abounding in it in thanksgiving.

hausa: Sa’an nan suka ce masa, “Muna roƙonka ka nemi mana nufin Allah don mu sani ko tafiyarmu tana da nasara.”
english: They said to him, “Please ask counsel of God, that we may know whether our way which we go shall be prosperous.”

hausa: Ina gaya muku, zai tabbatar sun sami adalci, ban da ɓatan lokaci. Amma sa’ad da Ɗan Mutum ya dawo, zai sami bangaskiya a duniya ke nan?”
english: I tell you that he will avenge them quickly. Nevertheless, when the Son of Man comes, will he find faith on the earth?”

hausa: Sai ya ɗibiya hannuwansa a kanta, nan da nan sai ta miƙe, ta yabi Allah.
english: He laid his hands on her, and immediately she stood up straight and glorified God.

hausa: Kada ku ce, ‘Mun sami hikima; Allah ne kaɗai yake da ikon yin nasara da shi ba mutum ba.’
english: Beware lest you say, ‘We have found wisdom. God may refute him, not man;’

hausa: Mugun mutum zai gani yă kuma yi fushi, zai ciza haƙora yă kuma lalace; sha’awace-sha’awacen mugaye za su zo ga ƙarshe.
english: The wicked will see it, and be grieved. He shall gnash with his teeth, and melt away. The desire of the wicked will perish.

hausa: Saboda an jawo mutum ƙasa aka kuma ƙasƙantar da ɗan adam, kada ku gafarta musu.
english: Man is brought low, and mankind is humbled; therefore don’t forgive them.

hausa: Saboda haka na karɓi kwaf daga hannun Ubangiji na sa dukan al’ummai waɗanda ya aiko ni wurinsu su sha.
english: Then I took the cup at Yahweh’s hand, and made all the nations to drink, to whom Yahweh had sent me:

hausa: Za a fitar da dukan matan da suka ragu a fadan sarkin Yahuda wa hafsoshin sarkin Babilon. Waɗannan mata za su ce maka, “ ‘Sun ruɗe ka suka kuma rinjaye ka, waɗannan abokanka. Ƙafafunka sun nutse a cikin laka; abokanka sun yashe ka.’
english: ‘Behold, all the women who are left in the king of Judah’s house will be brought out to the king of Babylon’s princes, and those women will say, “Your familiar friends have turned on you, and have prevailed over you. Your feet are sunk in the mire, they have turned away from you.”

hausa: Tare da bijiman, ragunan da kuma ’yan ragunan, a miƙa hadayu na gari, da hadayu na sha bisa ga adadin da aka ƙayyade.
english: and their meal offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, according to their number, after the ordinance,

hausa: Ahab sarkin Isra’ila ya tambayi Yehoshafat sarkin Yahuda ya ce, “Za ka tafi tare da ni mu yaƙi Ramot Gileyad?” Yehoshafat ya amsa ya ce, “Ni kamar kai ne, kuma mutanena kamar naka ne; za mu tafi tare da kai a yaƙin.”
english: Ahab king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat king of Judah, “Will you go with me to Ramoth Gilead?” He answered him, “I am as you are, and my people as your people. We will be with you in the war.”

hausa: Ya kafa biki a rana ta goma sha biyar ta watan takwas, kamar bikin da ake yi a Yahuda, ya kuma miƙa hadayu a bisa bagade. Ya yi haka a Betel, yana miƙa wa siffofin maruƙan da ya yi hadayu. A Betel kuma ya naɗa firistoci a wuraren tudun da ya yi.
english: Jeroboam ordained a feast in the eighth month, on the fifteenth day of the month, like the feast that is in Judah, and he went up to the altar. He did so in Bethel, sacrificing to the calves that he had made, and he placed in Bethel the priests of the high places that he had made.

hausa: “Eleyazar ɗan Haruna firist zai lura da man fitila da turare da hadaya ta gari na kullum da kuma keɓaɓɓen mai. Shi ne zai lura da dukan tabanakul da duk abin da yake cikinsa da kuma kayayyaki da abubuwan masu tsarki.”
english: “The duty of Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest shall be the oil for the light, the sweet incense, the continual meal offering, and the anointing oil, the requirements of all the tabernacle, and of all that is in it, the sanctuary, and its furnishings.”

hausa: in dai kun yi cikakken biyayya ga Ubangiji Allahnku, kuka kuma lura, kuna kiyaye dukan waɗannan umarnan da nake ba ku yau.
english: if only you diligently listen to Yahweh your God’s voice, to observe to do all this commandment which I command you today.

hausa: Kamar dai yadda kowannenmu yake da jiki ɗaya da gaɓoɓi da yawa, gaɓoɓin nan kuwa ba aiki iri ɗaya suke yi ba,
english: For even as we have many members in one body, and all the members don’t have the same function,

hausa: In fa da gaske ne Ibrahim ya sami kuɓuta ta wurin ayyuka, yana da abin da zai yin taƙama da shi ke nan, amma ba a gaban Allah ba.
english: For if Abraham was justified by works, he has something to boast about, but not toward God.

hausa: ka yanke wuya a tsakiyarta don sawa. A kuma naɗe wuyan rigar yă yi kauri domin kada yă yage.
english: It shall have a hole for the head in the middle of it. It shall have a binding of woven work around its hole, as it were the hole of a coat of mail, that it not be torn.

hausa: Ubangiji yakan ji masu bukata ba ya kuwa ƙyale kamammun mutanensa.
english: For Yahweh hears the needy, and doesn’t despise his captive people.

hausa: “Ka sa Isra’ilawa su yi Bikin Ƙetarewa a ƙayyadadden lokaci.
english: “Let the children of Israel keep the Passover in its appointed season.

hausa: Sa’ad da ya faɗa wa mahaifinsa da kuma ’yan’uwansa, sai mahaifinsa ya kwaɓe shi ya ce, “Wanne irin mafarki ne haka da ka yi? Kana nufin ni da mahaifiyarka da ’yan’uwanka za mu zo gabanka mu rusuna maka?”
english: He told it to his father and to his brothers. His father rebuked him, and said to him, “What is this dream that you have dreamed? Will I and your mother and your brothers indeed come to bow ourselves down to the earth before you?”

hausa: Hafsoshi za su ce wa mayaƙa, “Ko akwai wanda ya gina sabon gida bai kuma buɗe shi ba? Bari yă tafi gida, kada yă mutu a yaƙi, wani dabam yă buɗe shi.
english: The officers shall speak to the people, saying, “What man is there who has built a new house, and has not dedicated it? Let him go and return to his house, lest he die in the battle, and another man dedicate it.

hausa: Zai sami rabo daidai da sauran, ko da yake ya karɓi kuɗin mallaka na iyali da ya sayar.
english: They shall have like portions to eat, in addition to that which comes from the sale of his family possessions.

hausa: Zan kawo ƙarshen waƙoƙinki masu surutu, ba kuwa za a ƙara jin kaɗe-kaɗen garayunki ba.
english: I will cause the noise of your songs to cease. The sound of your harps won’t be heard any more.

hausa: Sun jefar da allolinsu cikin wuta, suka hallaka su, gama ba alloli ba ne, katakai ne da kuma duwatsu, ayyukan hannuwan mutane.
english: and have cast their gods into the fire; for they were no gods, but the work of men’s hands, wood and stone. Therefore they have destroyed them.

hausa: Za su zama mutanena, ni kuwa in zama Allahnsu.
english: Then they will be my people, and I will be their God.

hausa: Yotam ya ƙaru a iko saboda ya daidaita al’amuransa a gaban Ubangiji Allahnsa.
english: So Jotham became mighty, because he ordered his ways before Yahweh his God.

hausa: ‘Ɗaukakar gidan nan na yanzu za tă fi ɗaukakar gidan nan na dā,’ in ji Ubangiji Maɗaukaki. ‘A wannan wuri kuma zan ba da salama,’ in ji Ubangiji Maɗaukaki.”
english: ‘The latter glory of this house will be greater than the former,’ says Yahweh of Armies; ‘and in this place I will give peace,’ says Yahweh of Armies.”

hausa: Babu wani sarki kafin Yosiya, ko kuma a bayansa, wanda ya juya ga Ubangiji da dukan zuciyarsa, da dukan ransa, da dukan ƙarfinsa bisa ga shari’ar Musa, kamar yadda ya yi.
english: There was no king like him before him, who turned to Yahweh with all his heart, and with all his soul, and with all his might, according to all the law of Moses; and there was none like him who arose after him.

hausa: “Mai albarka ne wanda Allah yake yi masa gyara in mutumin ya yi kuskure; saboda haka kada ka guje wa horon Maɗaukaki.
english: “Behold, happy is the man whom God corrects. Therefore do not despise the chastening of the Almighty.

hausa: Kada ka biya wa mugaye bukatunsu, ya Ubangiji; kada ka bar shirinsu su yi nasara, in ba haka ba za su yi fariya. Sela
english: Yahweh, don’t grant the desires of the wicked. Don’t let their evil plans succeed, or they will become proud. Selah.

hausa: amma ba mutumin da zai iya ya sarrafa harshe. Mugu ne marar hutu, cike da dafi mai kisa.
english: but nobody can tame the tongue. It is a restless evil, full of deadly poison.

hausa: Ubangiji zai kāre shi yă kuma kiyaye ransa; zai albarkace shi a cikin ƙasar ba kuwa zai miƙa shi ga hannun maƙiyansa ba.
english: Yahweh will preserve him, and keep him alive. He shall be blessed on the earth, and he will not surrender him to the will of his enemies.

hausa: Kalmomi daga bakin mai hikima alheri ne, amma maganganun wawa za su hallaka shi.
english: The words of a wise man’s mouth are gracious; but a fool is swallowed by his own lips.

hausa: Ubangiji Allahnku zai tayar muku da wani annabi kamar ni daga cikin ’yan’uwanku. Dole ku saurare shi.
english: Yahweh your God will raise up to you a prophet from among you, of your brothers, like me. You shall listen to him.

hausa: Ka sa abokan gābana suka juya a guje, na kuwa hallaka maƙiyina.
english: You have also made my enemies turn their backs to me, that I might cut off those who hate me.

hausa: Gama ba su saurari maganata ba,” in ji Ubangiji, “maganar da na aika gare su sau da sau ta bayina annabawa. Ku kuma masu zaman bauta ba ku saurara ba,” in ji Ubangiji.
english: because they have not listened to my words,” says Yahweh, “with which I sent to them my servants the prophets, rising up early and sending them; but you would not hear,” says Yahweh.

hausa: Ɓarawo yakan zo don yă yi sata ne kawai da kisa da kuma ɓarna. Ni kuwa na zo ne don su sami rai, su kuma same shi a yalwace.
english: The thief only comes to steal, kill, and destroy. I came that they may have life, and may have it abundantly.

hausa: “In mutum ya dūke bawansa ko baiwarsa da sanda, sai bawan ko baiwar ta mutu saboda dūkan, dole a hukunta shi,
english: “If a man strikes his servant or his maid with a rod, and he dies under his hand, the man shall surely be punished.

hausa: Suka yi murna da jin haka, suka yi alkawari za su ba shi kuɗi. Don haka, ya fara neman zarafi yă ba da shi.
english: They, when they heard it, were glad, and promised to give him money. He sought how he might conveniently deliver him.

hausa: A rana ta uku kuma suka miƙa manyan hadayu, suna farin ciki domin Allah ya ba su farin ciki mai girma. Mata da yara suka yi farin ciki su ma. An ji ƙarar farin ciki da ake yi a Urushalima daga nesa.
english: They offered great sacrifices that day, and rejoiced, for God had made them rejoice with great joy; and the women and the children also rejoiced, so that the joy of Jerusalem was heard even far away.

hausa: Ya rinjayi al’ummai a ƙarƙashinmu, mutane kuma a ƙarƙashin ƙafafunmu.
english: He subdues nations under us, and peoples under our feet.

hausa: Gama duniya za tă cika da sanin ɗaukakar Ubangiji, yadda ruwaye suka rufe teku.
english: For the earth will be filled with the knowledge of Yahweh’s glory, as the waters cover the sea.

hausa: Har ya zama muku abin taƙama! Ashe, bai kamata ku cika da baƙin ciki ku kuma daina zumunci da mutumin da yake aikata wannan ba?
english: You are arrogant, and didn’t mourn instead, that he who had done this deed might be removed from among you.

hausa: An haifa wa Dawuda ’ya’ya maza a Hebron. Ɗansa na fari shi ne Amnon, ɗan Ahinowam mutuniyar Yezireyel;
english: Sons were born to David in Hebron. His firstborn was Amnon, of Ahinoam the Jezreelitess;

hausa: Ba zato ba tsammani sai aka ji motsi kamar ta babbar iska tana hurowa daga sama ta kuma cika dukan gidan da suke zaune.
english: Suddenly there came from the sky a sound like the rushing of a mighty wind, and it filled all the house where they were sitting.

hausa: Ga maganar Ubangiji da ta zo wa Irmiya annabi game da al’ummai.
english: Yahweh’s word which came to Jeremiah the prophet concerning the nations.

hausa: In shekarun sun rage kaɗan ne kafin Shekara ta Murna, sai yă yi lissafin wannan, yă kuma biya fansarsa daidai wa daida.
english: If there remain but a few years to the year of jubilee, then he shall reckon with him; according to his years of service he shall give back the price of his redemption.

hausa: Amma da Farisiyawa suka ji haka, sai suka ce, “Ahab, da Be’elzebub sarkin aljanu ne kaɗai, wannan mutum yake fitar da aljanu.”
english: But when the Pharisees heard it, they said, “This man does not cast out demons except by Beelzebul, the prince of the demons.”

hausa: Dawuda ya ji tsoron Allah a wannan rana ya kuma yi tambaya, “Yaya zan taɓa kawo akwatin alkawarin Allah gare ni?”
english: David was afraid of God that day, saying, “How can I bring God’s ark home to me?”

hausa: Gama damuwoyin da suka wuce misali sun kewaye ni; zunubaina sun mamaye ni, kuma ba na iya gani. Sun fi gashin kaina yawa, har ma na fid da zuciya.
english: For innumerable evils have surrounded me. My iniquities have overtaken me, so that I am not able to look up. They are more than the hairs of my head. My heart has failed me.

hausa: Da safe sa’ad da Nabal ya natsu, sai matarsa ta gaya masa dukan abin da ya faru. Sai zuciyarsa ta tsinke, ya zama kamar dutse.
english: In the morning, when the wine had gone out of Nabal, his wife told him these things; and his heart died within him, and he became as a stone.

hausa: Ka ba ni garkuwar nasara, kuma hannunka na dama yana riƙe ni; ya sunkuya don ka mai da ni mai girma.
english: You have also given me the shield of your salvation. Your right hand sustains me. Your gentleness has made me great.

hausa: Ya fi sauƙi raƙumi yă shiga ta kafar allura, da mai arziki yă shiga mulkin Allah.”
english: It is easier for a camel to go through a needle’s eye than for a rich man to enter into God’s Kingdom.”

hausa: Ku ƙetare zuwa tsibiran Kittim ku gani, ku aika zuwa Kedar ku duba da kyau; ku ga ko an taɓa yin wani abu haka.
english: For pass over to the islands of Kittim, and see. Send to Kedar, and consider diligently, and see if there has been such a thing.

hausa: cikin fushina, sai in yi adawa da ku, in kuma hukunta ku saboda zunubanku har sau bakwai.
english: then I will walk contrary to you in wrath. I will also chastise you seven times for your sins.

hausa: Cikinsa kuwa akwai kowace irin dabba mai ƙafa huɗu da masu ja da ciki na duniya da kuma tsuntsayen sararin sama.
english: in which were all kinds of four-footed animals of the earth, wild animals, reptiles, and birds of the sky.

hausa: Ba wanda zai cece su domin suna nesa da Bet-Sidon kuma ba sa hulɗa da kowa. Birnin yana a kwari kusa da Bet-Rekob. Mutanen Dan suka sāke gina birnin suka zauna a can.
english: There was no deliverer, because it was far from Sidon, and they had no dealings with anyone else; and it was in the valley that lies by Beth Rehob. They built the city and lived in it.

hausa: Don mai bi da kaɗe-kaɗe. Da kayan kiɗi. Bisa ga sheminit. Zabura ta Dawuda. Ka taimaka, Ubangiji, gama masu tsoron Allah ba sa nan kuma; masu aminci sun ɓace daga cikin mutane.
english: For the Chief Musician; upon an eight-stringed lyre. A Psalm of David. Help, Yahweh; for the godly man ceases. For the faithful fail from among the children of men.

hausa: amma waɗanda suka girbe shi za su ci shi su kuma yabi Ubangiji, waɗanda kuma suka tattara ’ya’yan inabi za su sha shi a filayen wurina mai tsarki.”
english: but those who have harvested it will eat it, and praise Yahweh. Those who have gathered it will drink it in the courts of my sanctuary.”

hausa: Suka tashi daga Iyim, suka yi sansani a Dibon Gad.
english: They traveled from Iyim, and encamped in Dibon Gad.

hausa: Sai ga Yesu a filin haikali yana zagawa a Shirayin Solomon,
english: It was winter, and Jesus was walking in the temple, in Solomon’s porch.

hausa: (Shi wanda ya yi Taurarin nan da ake ce Kaza da ’Ya’yanta da kuma Mai Farauta da Kare, wanda ya mai da duhu ya zama haske ya kuma baƙanta rana ta zama dare, yakan kwashe ruwan teku ya zubar a ƙasa, Ubangiji ne sunansa,
english: Seek him who made the Pleiades and Orion, and turns the shadow of death into the morning, and makes the day dark with night; who calls for the waters of the sea, and pours them out on the surface of the earth, Yahweh is his name,

hausa: Dubi dutsen da na ajiye a gaban Yoshuwa! Akwai idanu bakwai a kan wannan dutse guda, zan kuma yi rubutu a kansa,’ in ji Ubangiji Maɗaukaki, ‘zan kuma kawar da zunubin ƙasan nan a rana ɗaya.
english: For, behold, the stone that I have set before Joshua: on one stone are seven eyes; behold, I will engrave its inscription,’ says Yahweh of Armies, ‘and I will remove the iniquity of that land in one day.

hausa: Aikin nan naku na alheri tabbatar bangaskiyarku ne, za a kuwa ɗaukaka Allah saboda kun bayyana yarda, cewa kun yi na’am da bisharar Kiristi, saboda kuma gudummawa da kuka yi musu da saura duka, hannu sake.
english: seeing that through the proof given by this service, they glorify God for the obedience of your confession to the Good News of Christ and for the generosity of your contribution to them and to all,

hausa: Zebulun ta ƙunshi garuruwa goma sha biyu da ƙauyukansu. Garuruwan sun haɗa da Kattat, Nahalal, Shimron, Idala da Betlehem.
english: Kattath, Nahalal, Shimron, Idalah, and Bethlehem: twelve cities with their villages.

hausa: Gama kowa yana lura da al’amuran kansa ne kawai, ba na Kiristi Yesu ba.
english: For they all seek their own, not the things of Jesus Christ.

hausa: Ina gaishe ku duka, gaisuwar ƙaunata cikin Kiristi Yesu. Amin.
english: My love to all of you in Christ Jesus. Amen.

hausa: Yana miƙewa tsaye, sai Bulus ya yi musu alama da hannu ya ce, “Mutanen Isra’ila da kuma ku Al’ummai da kuke wa Allah sujada, ku saurare ni!
english: Paul stood up, and gesturing with his hand said, “Men of Israel, and you who fear God, listen.

hausa: Kwaɗin nan za su yi ta tsalle a kanka, da kan mutanenka, da kuma kan dukan bayinka.’ ”
english: The frogs shall come up both on you, and on your people, and on all your servants.”’”

hausa: To, fa, akwai dattawa biyu da suka kasance a sansani, wato, Eldad da Medad. Su ma an lasafta su cikin dattawan, amma ba su fita zuwa Tentin Sujada ba. Duk da haka Ruhun ya sauka a kansu, suka kuma yi annabci a cikin sansanin.
english: But two men remained in the camp. The name of one was Eldad, and the name of the other Medad; and the Spirit rested on them. They were of those who were written, but had not gone out to the Tent; and they prophesied in the camp.

hausa: Zai kuwa zama, kamar yadda mutane suke, haka firistoci suke. Zan hukunta dukansu saboda al’amuransu in kuma sāka musu saboda ayyukansu.
english: It will be like people, like priest; and I will punish them for their ways, and will repay them for their deeds.

hausa: Yanzu fa, ana bukatar waɗanda aka ba su riƙon amana, dole su zama masu aminci.
english: Here, moreover, it is required of stewards that they be found faithful.

hausa: Ba na ɓoye adalcinka cikin zuciyata; ina maganar amincinka da cetonka. Ban ɓoye ƙaunarka da gaskiyarka a gaban taron jama’arka mai girma ba.
english: I have not hidden your righteousness within my heart. I have declared your faithfulness and your salvation. I have not concealed your loving kindness and your truth from the great assembly.

hausa: “Ƙahonin nan goma da ka gani sarakuna goma ne da ba su riga sun karɓi mulki ba, amma waɗanda na sa’a guda za su karɓi iko a matsayin sarakuna tare da dabbar.
english: The ten horns that you saw are ten kings who have received no kingdom as yet, but they receive authority as kings with the beast for one hour.

hausa: Amma suka fita suka yi ta baza labari game da shi ko’ina a wannan yankin.
english: But they went out and spread abroad his fame in all that land.

hausa: Suka tashi daga duwatsun Abarim, suka yi sansani a filayen Mowab kusa da Urdun, ɗaura da Yeriko.
english: They traveled from the mountains of Abarim, and encamped in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho.

hausa: Yanzu teku ta farfashe ki cikin zurfafan ruwaye; kayan cinikinki da dukan kamfaninki sun nutse tare da ke.
english: In the time that you were broken by the seas, in the depths of the waters, your merchandise and all your company fell within you.

hausa: Yana magana da su ke nan, sai ga ɗan aikan ya gangaro wajensa. Sarki kuma ya ce, “Wannan bala’in daga wurin Ubangiji ya fito. Don me zan sa zuciya ga Ubangiji kuma?”
english: While he was still talking with them, behold, the messenger came down to him. Then he said, “Behold, this evil is from Yahweh. Why should I wait for Yahweh any longer?”

hausa: Sa’ad da kuka kawo makauniyar dabba don ku miƙa mini hadaya, wannan daidai ne? Sa’ad da kuka miƙa gurguwar dabba ko marar lafiya, wannan daidai ne? Ku gwada ba wa gwamnanku irin wannan ku gani! Kuna gani zai ji daɗinku? Zai karɓe ku ne?” In ji Ubangiji Maɗaukaki.
english: When you offer the blind for sacrifice, isn’t that evil? And when you offer the lame and sick, isn’t that evil? Present it now to your governor! Will he be pleased with you? Or will he accept your person?” says Yahweh of Armies.

hausa: in kai mai tsarki ne, kuma mai adalci, ko yanzu ma zai taimake ka, yă mayar maka iyalinka da farin cikinka.
english: If you were pure and upright, surely now he would awaken for you, and make the habitation of your righteousness prosperous.

hausa: Da yake yanzu mun sami zama marasa laifi ta wurin jininsa, ashe kuwa za a cece mu daga fushin Allah ta wurinsa!
english: Much more then, being now justified by his blood, we will be saved from God’s wrath through him.

hausa: Suka zub da jini marar laifi, jinin ’ya’yansu maza da mata, waɗanda suka miƙa hadaya ga gumakan Kan’ana, ƙasar kuwa ta ƙazantu ta wurin jininsu.
english: They shed innocent blood, even the blood of their sons and of their daughters, whom they sacrificed to the idols of Canaan. The land was polluted with blood.

hausa: Asher zai sami rabo; zai yi iyaka da yankin Dan daga gabas zuwa yamma.
english: “By the border of Dan, from the east side to the west side, Asher, one portion.

hausa: Sama da ƙasa za su shuɗe, amma kalmomina ba za su taɓa shuɗewa ba.
english: Heaven and earth will pass away, but my words will not pass away.

hausa: Sai Yoshuwa ya umarci firistoci ya ce, “Ku fito daga cikin Urdun.”
english: Joshua therefore commanded the priests, saying, “Come up out of the Jordan!”

hausa: Za a wadatar da ku ta kowace hanya, domin ku riƙa bayarwa hannu sake a kowane lokaci. Ta wurinmu kuma bayarwarku hannu sake za tă zama sanadin godiya ga Allah.
english: you being enriched in everything for all generosity, which produces thanksgiving to God through us.

hausa: Dawuda kuwa ya haura daga can ya zauna a kogwannin duwatsun En Gedi.
english: David went up from there and lived in the strongholds of En Gedi.

hausa: “Ki kafa alamun hanya; ki sa shaidun bishewa. Ki lura da babbar hanya da kyau, hanyar da kika bi. Ki komo, ya Budurwar Isra’ila, ki komo zuwa garuruwanki.
english: “Set up road signs. Make guideposts. Set your heart toward the highway, even the way by which you went. Turn again, virgin of Israel. Turn again to these your cities.

hausa: Sa’an nan Ruhun Ubangiji ya sauko wa Gideyon, ya kuma busa ƙaho, ya kira mutanen Abiyezer su bi shi.
english: But Yahweh’s Spirit came on Gideon, and he blew a trumpet; and Abiezer was gathered together to follow him.

hausa: Zan ɗaura aure da ke har abada; zan ɗaura aure da yake cikin adalci da gaskiya, cikin ƙauna da jinƙai.
english: I will betroth you to me forever. Yes, I will betroth you to me in righteousness, in justice, in loving kindness, and in compassion.

hausa: Duniya tana tangaɗi kamar mashayi, tana lilo kamar rumfa a cikin iska; laifin tayarwarta ya yi nauyi sosai har ta fāɗi ba kuwa za tă ƙara tashi ba.
english: The earth will stagger like a drunken man, and will sway back and forth like a hammock. Its disobedience will be heavy on it, and it will fall and not rise again.
