hausa: Sa’ad da Hezekiya da fadawansa suka zo suka ga tsibin, sai suka yabi Ubangiji, suka kuma albarkace mutanensa Isra’ila.
english: When Hezekiah and the princes came and saw the heaps, they blessed Yahweh and his people Israel.

hausa: Yabi Ubangiji. Yabi sunan Ubangiji; yabe shi, ku bayin Ubangiji,
english: Praise Yah! Praise Yahweh’s name! Praise him, you servants of Yahweh,

hausa: sai Musa kaɗai zai kusaci Ubangiji. Amma sauran kada su zo kusa, kada kuma jama’a su hau tare da shi.”
english: Moses alone shall come near to Yahweh, but they shall not come near. The people shall not go up with him.”

hausa: Na yi jira da haƙuri har safiya, amma kamar zaki ya kakkarya ƙasusuwana duka; dare da rana ka kawo ni ga ƙarshe.
english: I waited patiently until morning. He breaks all my bones like a lion. From day even to night you will make an end of me.

hausa: mutane 16,000, mutanen da aka ware wa Ubangiji kuwa 32 ne.
english: The persons were sixteen thousand, of whom Yahweh’s tribute was thirty-two persons.

hausa: Saboda haka, duk wanda ya rantse da bagade, ya rantse ne da bagaden tare da abin da yake bisansa.
english: He therefore who swears by the altar, swears by it and by everything on it.

hausa: Allah kuwa ya naɗa shi yă zama babban firist, bisa ga tsarin Melkizedek.
english: named by God a high priest after the order of Melchizedek.

hausa: Mai farin ciki ce al’ummar da Allah ne Ubangijinta, mutanen da ya zaɓa don gādonsa.
english: Blessed is the nation whose God is Yahweh, the people whom he has chosen for his own inheritance.

hausa: Ki yi wanka ki fesa turare, ki kuma sa tufafinki mafi kyau. Sa’an nan ki gangara zuwa masussuka, amma kada ki bari yă san cewa kina a can sai ya gama ci da sha.
english: Therefore wash yourself, anoint yourself, get dressed, and go down to the threshing floor; but don’t make yourself known to the man until he has finished eating and drinking.

hausa: In kun ci gaba da cizo, kuna kuma cin naman juna, ku yi hankali in ba haka ba za ku hallaka juna.
english: But if you bite and devour one another, be careful that you don’t consume one another.

hausa: Zai kuɓutar da su daga danniya da rikici, gama jininsu yake a gabansa.
english: He will redeem their soul from oppression and violence. Their blood will be precious in his sight.

hausa: Amma goma daga cikinsu suka ce wa Ishmayel, “Kada ka kashe mu, muna da alkama da sha’ir, mai da kuma zuma, a ɓoye a gona.” Saboda haka ka bar mu kada ka kashe mu tare da sauran.
english: But ten men were found among those who said to Ishmael, “Don’t kill us; for we have stores hidden in the field, of wheat, and of barley, and of oil, and of honey.” So he stopped, and didn’t kill them among their brothers.

hausa: Ka mai da mutanenka Isra’ila na kanka har abada, kuma kai, ya Ubangiji, ka zama Allahnsu.
english: For you made your people Israel your own people forever; and you, Yahweh, became their God.

hausa: Kyautar Allah kuwa ba kamar sakamakon da ya bi zunubin mutum gudan nan ba ne, Hukuncin ya bi zunubin mutum gudan nan, ya kuma kawo hallaka, amma kyautar ta bi laifofin masu yawa ta kuma sa Allah ya gan mu a matsayin marasa laifi.
english: The gift is not as through one who sinned; for the judgment came by one to condemnation, but the free gift followed many trespasses to justification.

hausa: Kamar yadda ya faɗa a Hosiya. “Zan kira su ‘mutanena,’ su da ba mutanena ba; zan kuma kira ta ‘ƙaunatacciyata,’ ita da ba ƙaunatacciyata ba,”
english: As he says also in Hosea, “I will call them ‘my people,’ which were not my people; and her ‘beloved,’ who was not beloved.”

hausa: Da motsi kamar na kekunan yaƙi sun tsallake ƙwanƙolin duwatsu, kamar ƙarar harshen wuta mai cin tattaka, kamar runduna mai ƙarfi wadda ta ja dāgār yaƙi.
english: Like the noise of chariots on the tops of the mountains, they leap, like the noise of a flame of fire that devours the stubble, like a strong people set in battle array.

hausa: Yowab ya ce, “Ba zan ɓata lokaci da kai ba.” Saboda haka sai ya ɗauki māsu uku a hannunsa ya zura su a ƙahon zuciyar Absalom, tun Absalom yana da sauran rai a maƙale a itacen oak.
english: Then Joab said, “I’m not going to wait like this with you.” He took three darts in his hand and thrust them through Absalom’s heart while he was still alive in the middle of the oak.

hausa: Gama daga gare shi, ta wurinsa, da kuma saboda shi ne dukan abubuwa suka kasance. Ɗaukaka ta tabbata a gare shi har abada! Amin.
english: For of him and through him and to him are all things. To him be the glory for ever! Amen.

hausa: Abokan gābanmu sun ce, “Ba za su sani ba, ba kuwa za su gan mu ba, sai dai kawai su gan mu a cikinsu, za mu karkashe su, mu tsai da aikin.”
english: Our adversaries said, “They will not know or see, until we come in among them and kill them, and cause the work to cease.”

hausa: Amaziya ɗan Yowash sarkin Yahuda ya yi shekaru goma sha biyar bayan mutuwar Yehowash ɗan Yehoyahaz sarkin Isra’ila.
english: Amaziah the son of Joash king of Judah lived after the death of Jehoash son of Jehoahaz, king of Israel, fifteen years.

hausa: “Dukan hafsoshin sarki da mutanen lardunan sarki sun san cewa duk wanda ya tafi wurin sarki a shirayi na ciki, mace ko namiji, ba tare da an kira shi ba, doka ɗaya ce take kan mutum, wato, kisa. Abu guda kawai da ya sha bamban shi ne sai wanda sarki ya miƙa wa sandan sarauta na zinariya don yă rayu. Kwana talatin ke nan ba a kira ni in tafi wurin sarki ba.”
english: “All the king’s servants and the people of the king’s provinces know that whoever, whether man or woman, comes to the king into the inner court without being called, there is one law for him, that he be put to death, except those to whom the king might hold out the golden scepter, that he may live. I have not been called to come in to the king these thirty days.”

hausa: Har wa yau, Iblis ya kai shi bisa wani dutse mai tsawo sosai, ya nunnuna masa dukan mulkokin duniya da darajarsu.
english: Again, the devil took him to an exceedingly high mountain, and showed him all the kingdoms of the world and their glory.

hausa: Ya Ubangiji, ka kasa kunne ga addu’ar wannan bawanka da kuma ga addu’ar bayinka waɗanda suke farin cikin girmama sunanka. Ka ba wa bawanka nasara a yau ta wurinsa yă sami tagomashi a gaban wannan mutum.” Ni ne mai riƙon kwaf sarki.
english: Lord, I beg you, let your ear be attentive now to the prayer of your servant, and to the prayer of your servants who delight to fear your name; and please prosper your servant today, and grant him mercy in the sight of this man.” Now I was cup bearer to the king.

hausa: Waɗanda suka mutu a wannan annoba, sun kai mutum 24,000.
english: Those who died by the plague were twenty-four thousand.

hausa: don a san hanyoyinka a duniya, cetonka kuma a cikin dukan al’ummai.
english: That your way may be known on earth, and your salvation among all nations,

hausa: Sai sarki ya ce, “Saurayin nan Absalom yana nan da rai?” Ahimawaz ya ce, “Na ga wani babban rikicewar a daidai lokacin da Yowab yake gab da aikan bawan sarki da kuma ni, sai dai ban san ko mene ne ba.”
english: The king said, “Is it well with the young man Absalom?” Ahimaaz answered, “When Joab sent the king’s servant, even me your servant, I saw a great tumult, but I don’t know what it was.”

hausa: Gama a cikin Kiristi cikin jiki dukkan cikar Allahntaka take tabbata,
english: For in him all the fullness of the Deity dwells bodily,

hausa: Har itatuwan fir ma da kuma al’ul na Lebanon suna murna a kanka suna cewa, “Yanzu da aka ƙasƙantar da kai, babu wani mai yankan katakon da ya zo yă yanka mu.”
english: Yes, the cypress trees rejoice with you, with the cedars of Lebanon, saying, “Since you are humbled, no lumberjack has come up against us.”

hausa: Iyakar Amoriyawa kuwa daga Mashigin Kunama zuwa Sela da kuma zuwa gaba.
english: The border of the Amorites was from the ascent of Akrabbim, from the rock, and upward.

hausa: Ko an taɓa nuna maka ƙofar mutuwa? Ko ka taɓa ganin ƙofar inuwar duhun mutuwa?
english: Have the gates of death been revealed to you? Or have you seen the gates of the shadow of death?

hausa: Sai Ubangiji ya ce wa Musa, “Zan zubo muku burodi kamar ruwa daga sama. Mutanen za su fita kowace rana su tattara abin da zai ishe su na ranan. Ta haka zan gwada su in ga ko za su bi umarnaina.
english: Then Yahweh said to Moses, “Behold, I will rain bread from the sky for you, and the people shall go out and gather a day’s portion every day, that I may test them, whether they will walk in my law or not.

hausa: Sai Hezekiya ya aika wa dukan Isra’ila da Yahuda, ya kuma rubuta wasiƙu zuwa Efraim da Manasse, yana gayyatarsu su zo haikalin Ubangiji a Urushalima, su kuma yi Bikin Ƙetarewa ga Ubangiji, Allah na Isra’ila.
english: Hezekiah sent to all Israel and Judah, and wrote letters also to Ephraim and Manasseh, that they should come to Yahweh’s house at Jerusalem, to keep the Passover to Yahweh, the God of Israel.

hausa: Kamar yadda Ubangiji Allahnku kuwa ya cika kowane alkawari mai kyau, haka ma ba zai fasa kawo muku bala’in da ya faɗi ba, sai ya hallaka ku daga wannan ƙasa mai kyau da ya ba ku.
english: It shall happen that as all the good things have come on you of which Yahweh your God spoke to you, so Yahweh will bring on you all the evil things, until he has destroyed you from off this good land which Yahweh your God has given you,

hausa: Musa ya ɗauki ƙasusuwan Yusuf tare da shi, gama Yusuf ya sa Isra’ilawa su rantse masa. Ya ce, “Tabbatacce Allah zai taimake ku, sai ku ɗibi ƙasusuwana tare da ku daga wannan wuri.”
english: Moses took the bones of Joseph with him, for he had made the children of Israel swear, saying, “God will surely visit you, and you shall carry up my bones away from here with you.”

hausa: Mutane suka zo wurinsa daga Urushalima da dukan Yahudiya da kuma dukan yankin Urdun.
english: Then people from Jerusalem, all of Judea, and all the region around the Jordan went out to him.

hausa: Gaskiyar kuwa ita ce, kuna ƙaunar dukan ’yan’uwa ko’ina a Makidoniya. Duk da haka muna ƙara gargaɗe ku, ’yan’uwa, ku yi haka sau da sau.
english: for indeed you do it toward all the brothers who are in all Macedonia. But we exhort you, brothers, that you abound more and more;

hausa: Don mai bi da kaɗe-kaɗe. Zabura ta Dawuda. Ubangiji ya amsa maka sa’ad da ka yi kira cikin wahala; bari sunan Allah na Yaƙub yă kiyaye ka.
english: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. May Yahweh answer you in the day of trouble. May the name of the God of Jacob set you up on high,

hausa: Hayaƙin turaren tare da addu’o’in tsarkaka, suka hau zuwa gaban Allah daga hannun mala’ikan.
english: The smoke of the incense, with the prayers of the saints, went up before God out of the angel’s hand.

hausa: Yaƙub ya gudu zuwa ƙasar Aram; Isra’ila ya yi bauta don yă sami mata, domin kuma yă biya, sai da ya yi kiwon tumaki.
english: Jacob fled into the country of Aram. Israel served to get a wife. For a wife he tended flocks and herds.

hausa: Amma don a hana wannan abu daga ƙara bazuwa cikin mutane, dole mu kwaɓe mutanen nan kada su ƙara yi wa kowa magana cikin wannan suna.”
english: But so that this spreads no further among the people, let’s threaten them, that from now on they don’t speak to anyone in this name.”

hausa: yana da kyau ka jira shiru domin samun ceton Ubangiji.
english: It is good that a man should hope and quietly wait for the salvation of Yahweh.

hausa: Ya yi tafiya a hanyoyin sarakunan Isra’ila har ya miƙa ɗansa hadaya a wuta, yana bin hanyoyin banƙyama na al’ummai da Ubangiji ya kora a gaban Isra’ilawa.
english: But he walked in the way of the kings of Israel, and even made his son to pass through the fire, according to the abominations of the nations whom Yahweh cast out from before the children of Israel.

hausa: Alhakin jininsa yă kasance a kan Yowab da kuma a kan dukan iyalin mahaifinsa! Kada gidan Yowab yă rasa mai ɗiga, ko kuturu, ko mai jingina ga sanda, ko wanda aka kashe da takobi, ko kuma wanda ba shi da abinci.”
english: Let it fall on the head of Joab and on all his father’s house. Let there not fail from the house of Joab one who has a discharge, or who is a leper, or who leans on a staff, or who falls by the sword, or who lacks bread.”

hausa: Sa’an nan firist zai sa tă yi rantsuwa, yă kuma ce mata, “In ba wani mutumin da ya kwana da ke kuma ba ki kauce kin ƙazantar da kanki yayinda kike auren mijinki ba, kada wannan ruwa mai ɗaci, mai jawo la’ana, yă cuce ki.
english: The priest shall cause her to take an oath and shall tell the woman, “If no man has lain with you, and if you haven’t gone aside to uncleanness, being under your husband’s authority, be free from this water of bitterness that brings a curse.

hausa: “Ya ku mutanena, me na yi muku? Ta yaya na nawaita muku? Ku amsa mini.
english: My people, what have I done to you? How have I burdened you? Answer me!

hausa: na kuma sa miki zobe a hancinki, abin kunne a kunnuwanki da rawani mai kyau a kanki.
english: I put a ring on your nose, earrings in your ears, and a beautiful crown on your head.

hausa: Kurciyata a kogon dutse, a wuraren ɓuya a gefen dutse, nuna mini fuskarki, bari in ji muryarki; gama muryarki da daɗi take, fuskarki kuma kyakkyawa ce.
english: My dove in the clefts of the rock, in the hiding places of the mountainside, let me see your face. Let me hear your voice; for your voice is sweet and your face is lovely.

hausa: Shi ya sa dole yă miƙa hadayu domin zunubansa, da kuma domin zunuban mutane.
english: Because of this, he must offer sacrifices for sins for the people, as well as for himself.

hausa: A rana ta goma sha biyar ta watan takwas, watan da ya zaɓa, ya miƙa hadayu a bisa bagaden da ya gina a Betel. Saboda haka ya kafa biki don Isra’ilawa, ya kuma haura zuwa bagade don yă miƙa hadayu.
english: He went up to the altar which he had made in Bethel on the fifteenth day in the eighth month, even in the month which he had devised of his own heart; and he ordained a feast for the children of Israel, and went up to the altar to burn incense.

hausa: zan cece tumakina ba za su ƙara zama ganima ba. Zan hukunta tsakanin tunkiya da tunkiya.
english: therefore I will save my flock, and they will no more be a prey. I will judge between sheep and sheep.

hausa: Gideyon ya cewa Allah, “In za ka ceci Isra’ila ta hannuna yadda ka yi alkawari,
english: Gideon said to God, “If you will save Israel by my hand, as you have spoken,

hausa: An ji kuka a filayen tuddai, kuka da roƙon mutanen Isra’ila, domin sun lalace hanyoyinsu sun kuma manta da Ubangiji Allahnsu.
english: A voice is heard on the bare heights, the weeping and the petitions of the children of Israel; because they have perverted their way, they have forgotten Yahweh their God.

hausa: Sai suka kawo kayan zinariyan nan da aka kwaso daga haikalin Allah a Urushalima, sarki kuwa da hakimansa, da matansa, da ƙwarƙwaransa suka yi ta sha da su.
english: Then they brought the golden vessels that were taken out of the temple of God’s house which was at Jerusalem; and the king and his lords, his wives and his concubines, drank from them.

hausa: Sa’ad da ranar ta zo, za ku yi kuka ku nemi a fishe ku daga sarkin da kuka zaɓa, Ubangiji kuwa ba zai ji ku ba.”
english: You will cry out in that day because of your king whom you will have chosen for yourselves; and Yahweh will not answer you in that day.”

hausa: Sai sarki ya ce mata, “Me kike so, Sarauniya Esta? Mene ne roƙonki? Kai, ko rabin masarautata ce, za a ba ki.”
english: Then the king asked her, “What would you like, queen Esther? What is your request? It shall be given you even to the half of the kingdom.”

hausa: Sa’an nan suka yi ta wajen kagarar Taya da dukan garuruwan Hiwiyawa da Kan’aniyawa. A ƙarshe, suka ci gaba zuwa Beyersheba a Negeb na Yahuda.
english: and came to the stronghold of Tyre, and to all the cities of the Hivites and of the Canaanites; and they went out to the south of Judah, at Beersheba.

hausa: “Don me ake ba da haske ga waɗanda suke cikin ƙunci, rai kuma ga masu ɗacin rai
english: “Why is light given to him who is in misery, life to the bitter in soul,

hausa: Sai Ubangiji ya ce, “Ku ji fa abin da alƙalin nan, marar gaskiya, ya ce.
english: The Lord said, “Listen to what the unrighteous judge says.

hausa: Ku da kuke tsoron Ubangiji, ku yabe shi! Dukanku zuriyar Yaƙub, ku girmama shi! Ku girmama shi, dukanku zuriyar Isra’ila!
english: You who fear Yahweh, praise him! All you descendants of Jacob, glorify him! Stand in awe of him, all you descendants of Israel!

hausa: Yakan cika sha’awar waɗanda suke tsoronsa; yakan ji kukansu yă kuma cece su.
english: He will fulfill the desire of those who fear him. He also will hear their cry, and will save them.

hausa: Da yake muna rayuwa ta Ruhu ne, bari mu ci gaba da al’amuranmu ta wurin Ruhu.
english: If we live by the Spirit, let’s also walk by the Spirit.

hausa: Bayan Arameyawa suka ga cewa Isra’ila sun ci su da yaƙi, sai suka aiki ’yan aika suka sa aka kawo Arameyawan da suke hayen Kogi waɗanda Shobak shugaban mayaƙan Hadadezer yake shugabanta.
english: When the Syrians saw that they were defeated by Israel, they sent messengers and called out the Syrians who were beyond the River, with Shophach the captain of the army of Hadadezer leading them.

hausa: Da Elisha ya ga haka sai ya yi ihu yana cewa, “Babana! Babana! Kekunan yaƙin da mahayan dawakan Isra’ila!” Elisha kuwa bai sāke ganinsa ba. Sai ya kama tufafinsa ya yayyage.
english: Elisha saw it, and he cried, “My father, my father, the chariots of Israel and its horsemen!” He saw him no more. Then he took hold of his own clothes and tore them in two pieces.

hausa: Sai Dawuda ya gudu daga Nayiwot a Rama ya je wurin Yonatan ya ce, “Me na yi? Wane laifi ne na yi? Ta wace hanya ce na yi wa mahaifinka laifi har da yake neman yă kashe ni?”
english: David fled from Naioth in Ramah, and came and said to Jonathan, “What have I done? What is my iniquity? What is my sin before your father, that he seeks my life?”

hausa: bawan da ya zama sarki, wawan da ya ƙoshi da abinci,
english: For a servant when he is king, a fool when he is filled with food,

hausa: Aljanun suka roƙi Yesu suka ce, “In ka fitar da mu, tura mu cikin garken aladun nan.”
english: The demons begged him, saying, “If you cast us out, permit us to go away into the herd of pigs.”

hausa: Harshe ma wuta ne! A cikin duk gaɓoɓinmu, harshe shi ne tushen kowace irin mugunta, mai ɓata mutum gaba ɗaya, mai zuga zuciyar mutum ta tafasa, shi kuwa jahannama ce take zuga shi.
english: And the tongue is a fire. The world of iniquity among our members is the tongue, which defiles the whole body, and sets on fire the course of nature, and is set on fire by Gehenna.

hausa: Musa kuwa ya faɗa wa surukinsa duk abubuwan da Ubangiji ya yi wa Fir’auna da Masarawa domin Isra’ila, da batun wahalolin da suka sha a hanya, da yadda Ubangiji ya cece su.
english: Moses told his father-in-law all that Yahweh had done to Pharaoh and to the Egyptians for Israel’s sake, all the hardships that had come on them on the way, and how Yahweh delivered them.

hausa: Duk wanda ya same su ya cinye su; abokan gābansu suka ce, ‘Ba mu da laifi, gama sun yi zunubi wa Ubangiji, wurin kiwonsu na gaske, Ubangiji, abin sa zuciyar kakanninsu.’
english: All who found them have devoured them. Their adversaries said, ‘We are not guilty, because they have sinned against Yahweh, the habitation of righteousness, even Yahweh, the hope of their fathers.’

hausa: Cikin ɗan lokaci ƙasa da shekara guda ku da kuke tsammani kuna da kāriya za ku yi rawar jiki; girbin ’ya’yan inabi zai kāsa, girbin ’ya’yan itatuwa kuma ba zai zo ba.
english: For days beyond a year you will be troubled, you careless women; for the vintage will fail. The harvest won’t come.

hausa: In aka haɗa da ’ya’yan nan maza guda biyu waɗanda aka haifa wa Yusuf a Masar, membobin iyalin Yaƙub, waɗanda suka tafi Masar, duka su saba’in ne.
english: The sons of Joseph, who were born to him in Egypt, were two souls. All the souls of the house of Jacob, who came into Egypt, were seventy.

hausa: Kuna ta nazarin Nassosi da himma don kuna tsammani ta wurinsu ne kuna samun rai madawwami. Nassosin nan ne suke ba da shaida a kaina,
english: “You search the Scriptures, because you think that in them you have eternal life; and these are they which testify about me.

hausa: “Yanzu, ɗan mutum, ka ɗauki takobi mai kaifi ka kuma yi amfani da shi kamar rezan mai aski don askin kanka da gemunka. Sa’an nan ka ɗauki ma’auni ka kuma raba gashin.
english: “You, son of man, take a sharp sword. You shall take it as a barber’s razor to yourself, and shall cause it to pass over your head and over your beard. Then take balances to weigh and divide the hair.

hausa: Sa’an nan ya yanka hadaya ta ƙonawa. ’Ya’yan Haruna maza suka miƙa masa jinin, ya kuwa yayyafa shi a kowane gefe na bagaden.
english: He killed the burnt offering; and Aaron’s sons delivered the blood to him, and he sprinkled it around on the altar.

hausa: Ka san sa’ad da na zauna da sa’ad da na tashi; ka san tunanina daga nesa.
english: You know my sitting down and my rising up. You perceive my thoughts from afar.

hausa: Ba ma haka yake kawai ba, har muna farin ciki da Allah ta wurin Ubangijinmu Yesu Kiristi, wanda ta wurinsa yanzu muka sami sulhu.
english: Not only so, but we also rejoice in God through our Lord Jesus Christ, through whom we have now received the reconciliation.

hausa: A shekara ta ashirin da bakwai, a wata na fari a rana ta farko, maganar Ubangiji ta zo mini cewa,
english: It came to pass in the twenty-seventh year, in the first month, in the first day of the month, Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

hausa: “A wannan rana zan sa ƙaho ya tsiro wa gidan Isra’ila, zan kuma buɗe bakinka a cikinsu. Sa’an nan za su san cewa ni ne Ubangiji.”
english: “In that day I will cause a horn to sprout for the house of Israel, and I will open your mouth among them. Then they will know that I am Yahweh.”

hausa: Hezekiya sarkin Yahuda ya tanada bijimai dubu ɗaya da tumaki da kuma awaki dubu bakwai wa taron, fadawa kuma suka tanada musu bijimai dubu da kuma tumaki da awaki dubu goma. Firistoci masu yawa suka tsarkake kansu.
english: For Hezekiah king of Judah gave to the assembly for offerings one thousand bulls and seven thousand sheep; and the princes gave to the assembly a thousand bulls and ten thousand sheep; and a great number of priests sanctified themselves.

hausa: Ya kore ni, ya sa na yi tafiya a cikin duhu maimakon a cikin haske;
english: He has led me and caused me to walk in darkness, and not in light.

hausa: Dukan mutane kuwa za su ji, su kuma ji tsoro, ba kuwa za su ƙara yin rashin hankali kuma ba.
english: All the people shall hear and fear, and do no more presumptuously.

hausa: sai kowanne a cikin mutum biyun nan, mai riƙon kwaf da mai tuya na sarkin Masar, waɗanda aka sa a kurkuku, suka yi mafarki a dare ɗaya, kuma kowane mafarki ya kasance da fassara irin tasa.
english: They both dreamed a dream, each man his dream, in one night, each man according to the interpretation of his dream, the cup bearer and the baker of the king of Egypt, who were bound in the prison.

hausa: In kuwa mu ’ya’ya ne, to, mu magāda ne, magādan Allah da kuma abokan gādo tare da Kiristi, in kuwa muna tarayya a cikin shan wuyarsa to, za mu yi tarayya a cikin ɗaukakarsa.
english: and if children, then heirs—heirs of God and joint heirs with Christ, if indeed we suffer with him, that we may also be glorified with him.

hausa: Yahuda zai sami rabo; zai yi iyaka da yankin Ruben daga gabas zuwa yamma.
english: “By the border of Reuben, from the east side to the west side, Judah, one portion.

hausa: waɗanda ta wurin bangaskiya ne suka ci nasara a kan mulkoki, suka aikata adalci, suka kuma sami abin da aka yi alkawari; waɗanda suka rurrufe bakunan zakoki,
english: who through faith subdued kingdoms, worked out righteousness, obtained promises, stopped the mouths of lions,

hausa: Suka dawo da Uriya daga Masar suka kawo shi wurin Sarki Yehohiyakim, wanda ya kashe shi da takobi aka kuma jefar da gawarsa a makabartar talakawa.)
english: They fetched Uriah out of Egypt and brought him to Jehoiakim the king, who killed him with the sword and cast his dead body into the graves of the common people.

hausa: Domin dukan alkawaran Allah cikarsu a gare shi suke, ta wurinsa ne kuma muke faɗar “Amin”, domin a ɗaukaka Allah.
english: For however many are the promises of God, in him is the “Yes.” Therefore also through him is the “Amen”, to the glory of God through us.

hausa: Allah mai dukan alheri, wanda ya kira ku ga madawwamiyar ɗaukaka cikin Kiristi, bayan kun sha wahala na ɗan lokaci, shi da kansa zai raya ku, yă kuma sa ku yi ƙarfi, ku kahu, ku kuma tsaya daram.
english: But may the God of all grace, who called you to his eternal glory by Christ Jesus, after you have suffered a little while, perfect, establish, strengthen, and settle you.

hausa: Aka kawo kansa cikin kwano aka ba yarinyar, ita kuma ta kai wa mahaifiyarta.
english: His head was brought on a platter and given to the young lady; and she brought it to her mother.

hausa: Merahiyot, Amariya, Ahitub,
english: Meraioth his son, Amariah his son, Ahitub his son,

hausa: Assuriya ba za su iya cece mu ba; ba za mu hau dawakan yaƙi ba. Ba za mu ƙara ce, ‘Allolinmu’ wa abin da hannuwanmu suka yi ba, gama a gare ka ne maraya yakan sami jinƙai.”
english: Assyria can’t save us. We won’t ride on horses; neither will we say any more to the work of our hands, ‘Our gods!’ for in you the fatherless finds mercy.”

hausa: Sai na tafi don in kawo Ya’azaniya ɗan Irmiya, ɗan Habazziniya, da ’yan’uwansa da kuma dukan ’ya’yansa maza, dukan iyalin Rekabawa.
english: Then I took Jaazaniah the son of Jeremiah, the son of Habazziniah, with his brothers, all his sons, and the whole house of the Rechabites;

hausa: sai ka ji daga sama ka kuma yi wani abu. Ka shari’anta tsakanin bayinka, kana sāka wa mai laifi ta wurin kawo a kansa hakkin abin da ya yi. Ka nuna cewa marar laifi ba shi da laifi, ta haka a fiffita rashin laifinsa.
english: then hear from heaven, act, and judge your servants, bringing retribution to the wicked, to bring his way on his own head; and justifying the righteous, to give him according to his righteousness.

hausa: “Ba shakka ba zai samu abin da yake ƙoƙarin samu ba, dukiyarsa ba za tă cece shi ba.
english: “Because he knew no quietness within him, he will not save anything of that in which he delights.

hausa: Za a ce da shi Tsattsarkar Mutane, Fansassu na Ubangiji; za a kuma ce da ke Wadda Aka Nema Birnin da Ba Za a Ƙara Yashe ta ba.
english: They will call them “The Holy People, Yahweh’s Redeemed”. You will be called “Sought Out, A City Not Forsaken”.

hausa: Ka rurrushe dukan katangansa ka sa kagaransa suka zama kufai.
english: You have broken down all his hedges. You have brought his strongholds to ruin.

hausa: In kun juye daga binsa, zai sāke barin dukan wannan mutane a hamada, ku ne kuwa za ku zama sanadin hallakarsu.”
english: For if you turn away from after him, he will yet again leave them in the wilderness; and you will destroy all these people.”

hausa: Na ce wa Ubangiji, “Kai ne shugabana; in ba tare da kai ba, ba ni da wani abu mai kyau.”
english: My soul, you have said to Yahweh, “You are my Lord. Apart from you I have no good thing.”

hausa: Sai Dawuda ya ce masa, “In ka tafi tare da ni, za ka zama mini kaya.
english: David said to him, “If you pass on with me, then you will be a burden to me;

hausa: Zan ce wa Allah, kada ka hukunta ni, amma ka gaya mini laifin da na yi maka.
english: I will tell God, ‘Do not condemn me. Show me why you contend with me.

hausa: Firist ɗin zai ɗiba daga moɗan mai ɗin ya zuba a tafin hannunsa na hagu,
english: The priest shall take some of the log of oil, and pour it into the palm of his own left hand.

hausa: Tun da an riga an ɗauke ni mai laifi, duk ƙoƙarina a banza yake.
english: I will be condemned. Why then do I labor in vain?

hausa: “Wanda ya karɓe ku, ya karɓe ni ne, wanda kuma ya karɓe ni, ya karɓi wanda ya aiko ni ne.
english: “He who receives you receives me, and he who receives me receives him who sent me.

hausa: ka yi shela ga mutane yanzu cewa, ‘Duk wanda ya yi rawan jiki don tsoro, sai yă juya yă bar Dutsen Gileyad.’ ” Saboda haka mutum dubu ashirin da biyu suka koma, sai mutum dubu goma suka rage.
english: Now therefore proclaim in the ears of the people, saying, ‘Whoever is fearful and trembling, let him return and depart from Mount Gilead.’” So twenty-two thousand of the people returned, and ten thousand remained.

hausa: Manasse ya huta tare da kakanninsa, aka kuma binne shi a lambun fadansa, lambun Uzza. Sai Amon ɗansa ya gāje shi.
english: Manasseh slept with his fathers, and was buried in the garden of his own house, in the garden of Uzza; and Amon his son reigned in his place.

hausa: Amma waɗancan hadayu abin tunawa da zunubai ne na kowace shekara,
english: But in those sacrifices there is a yearly reminder of sins.

hausa: Waɗannan su ne ’ya’yan Liyatu maza da ta haifa wa Yaƙub a Faddan Aram, ban da ’yarsa Dina. ’Ya’yansa maza da mata duka, mutum talatin da uku ne.
english: These are the sons of Leah, whom she bore to Jacob in Paddan Aram, with his daughter Dinah. All the souls of his sons and his daughters were thirty-three.

hausa: Ka nuna ni marar laifi ne, ya Allah, ka kuma nemi hakkina a kan al’ummai marasa sanin Allah. Ka kuɓutar da ni daga masu ruɗu da mugayen mutane.
english: Vindicate me, God, and plead my cause against an ungodly nation. Oh, deliver me from deceitful and wicked men.

hausa: Abin da ya sa ke nan kakanninmu suka fāɗi ta takobi, kuma shi ya sa aka kai ’ya’yanmu maza da ’ya’yanmu mata da matanmu bauta.
english: For behold, our fathers have fallen by the sword, and our sons and our daughters and our wives are in captivity for this.

hausa: Ya je wurin Bilatus, ya roƙe shi yă ba shi jikin Yesu. Sai Bilatus ya umarta a ba shi.
english: This man went to Pilate and asked for Jesus’ body. Then Pilate commanded the body to be given up.

hausa: Muddin ina raye, in ji Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka, domin tumaki sun rasa makiyayi ta haka aka washe su suka kuma zama abincin dukan namun jeji, kuma domin makiyayana ba su nemi tumakina ba amma suka kula da kansu a maimakon tumakina,
english: “As I live,” says the Lord Yahweh, “surely because my sheep became a prey, and my sheep became food to all the animals of the field, because there was no shepherd, and my shepherds didn’t search for my sheep, but the shepherds fed themselves, and didn’t feed my sheep,

hausa: Ku ji tsoron Ubangiji, ku tsarkakansa, gama masu tsoronsa ba sa rasa kome.
english: Oh fear Yahweh, you his saints, for there is no lack with those who fear him.

hausa: Ya yi mu’ujizai a idanun kakanninsu a ƙasar Masar, a yankin Zowan.
english: He did marvelous things in the sight of their fathers, in the land of Egypt, in the field of Zoan.

hausa: Nan da nan sa’ad da Yehu ya gama yin hadayar, sai ya umarci masu gadin da hafsoshi, “Ku shiga ku karkashe su; kada ku bar wani yă tsere.” Saboda haka suka karkashe su da takobi. Masu gadin da hafsoshin suka wuwwurga gawawwakinsu waje, suka kuma shiga ciki cikin haikalin Ba’al ɗin,
english: As soon as he had finished offering the burnt offering, Jehu said to the guard and to the captains, “Go in and kill them! Let no one escape.” So they struck them with the edge of the sword. The guard and the captains threw the bodies out, and went to the inner shrine of the house of Baal.

hausa: Dawuda kuma ya ce, “Bari teburin cin abincinsu yă zama musu tarko, sanadin fāɗuwa da dutsen sa tuntuɓe da kuma ramuwa a kansu.
english: David says, “Let their table be made a snare, a trap, a stumbling block, and a retribution to them.

hausa: Sa’ad da kuka yi wa birni ƙawanya kuka daɗe, kuka yi ta yaƙi don ku ci shi, kada ku sassare itatuwansa da gatari, domin za ku ci ’ya’yansu. Kada ku sassare su. Gama itatuwan da suke cikin gonaki, ba mutane ne da za ku yi musu ƙawanya?
english: When you shall besiege a city a long time, in making war against it to take it, you shall not destroy its trees by wielding an ax against them; for you may eat of them. You shall not cut them down, for is the tree of the field man, that it should be besieged by you?

hausa: Ƙasa da da’ira kuwa, akwai siffofin bijimai kewaye da ita, goma ga kowane kamu guda. An yi zubin bijiman a jeri biyu a gefe guda na kwatarniya.
english: Under it was the likeness of oxen, which encircled it, for ten cubits, encircling the sea. The oxen were in two rows, cast when it was cast.

hausa: ina ba da wadata ga waɗanda suke ƙaunata ina sa wuraren ajiyarsu su cika.
english: that I may give wealth to those who love me. I fill their treasuries.

hausa: Jimillar maza daga mutanen Simeyon 59,300 ne.
english: those who were counted of them, of the tribe of Simeon, were fifty-nine thousand three hundred.

hausa: A ranar babban kisa, sa’ad da hasumiyoyi za su fāɗi, rafuffukan ruwa za su malalo a kan kowane dutse da kowane tudu mai tsawo.
english: There will be brooks and streams of water on every lofty mountain and on every high hill in the day of the great slaughter, when the towers fall.

hausa: Saboda haka, da zarar suka ji karar ƙaho, da sarewa, garaya da goge da kowane irin kaɗe-kaɗe da bushe-bushe da kowane irin kaɗe-kaɗe kowane mutum da ko wace al’umma da kowane irin yare suka sunkuya suka yi sujada ga wannan siffa ta zinariya da sarki Nebukadnezzar ya kafa.
english: Therefore at that time, when all the peoples heard the sound of the horn, flute, zither, lyre, harp, pipe, and all kinds of music, all the peoples, the nations, and the languages fell down and worshiped the golden image that Nebuchadnezzar the king had set up.

hausa: Sai mutum biyar da suka leƙi asirin ƙasar suka shiga ciki suka ɗauke gunkin da aka sassaƙa, efod, sauran allolin gida da kuma gunki na zubi yayinda firist ɗin tare da mutane ɗari shida da suka yi ɗamarar yaƙi suna tsaye a bakin ƙofa.
english: The five men who went to spy out the land went up, and came in there, and took the engraved image, the ephod, the teraphim, and the molten image; and the priest stood by the entrance of the gate with the six hundred men armed with weapons of war.

hausa: Da gama karanta wasiƙar sarki Artazerzes wa Rehum da Shimshai marubuci, da abokansu, sai suka yi sauri suka je wurin Yahudawa a Urushalima, suka hana su aikin ƙarfi da yaji.
english: Then when the copy of King Artaxerxes’ letter was read before Rehum, Shimshai the scribe, and their companions, they went in haste to Jerusalem to the Jews, and made them to cease by force of arms.

hausa: Shawulu ya ce wa Ahiya, “Kawo akwatin alkawarin Allah.” (A lokacin akwatin alkawarin yana tare da Isra’ilawa.)
english: Saul said to Ahijah, “Bring God’s ark here.” For God’s ark was with the children of Israel at that time.

hausa: Ka ji tsoron Ubangiji da kuma sarki, ɗana, kuma kada ka haɗa kai da masu tayarwa,
english: My son, fear Yahweh and the king. Don’t join those who are rebellious,

hausa: Amma Dawuda yakan tafi sansanin Shawulu lokaci-lokaci yă kuma koma Betlehem don yă yi kiwon tumakin mahaifinsa.
english: Now David went back and forth from Saul to feed his father’s sheep at Bethlehem.

hausa: Dukan iyakokin duniya za su tuna su kuma juya ga Ubangiji, kuma dukan iyalan al’ummai za su rusuna a gabansa,
english: All the ends of the earth shall remember and turn to Yahweh. All the relatives of the nations shall worship before you.

hausa: To, Isra’ilawa suka zauna a Masar a yankin Goshen. Suka mallaki filaye a can, suka riɓaɓɓanya suka ƙaru ƙwarai.
english: Israel lived in the land of Egypt, in the land of Goshen; and they got themselves possessions therein, and were fruitful, and multiplied exceedingly.

hausa: A wannan dutse zai kawar da baƙin cikin da ya lulluɓe dukan mutane, ƙyallen da ya rufe dukan al’ummai;
english: He will destroy in this mountain the surface of the covering that covers all peoples, and the veil that is spread over all nations.

hausa: Kada ku kafa wani ginshiƙin itacen Ashera kusa da bagaden da kuka gina wa Ubangiji Allahnku,
english: You shall not plant for yourselves an Asherah of any kind of tree beside Yahweh your God’s altar, which you shall make for yourselves.

hausa: Zan ƙarfafa su a cikin Ubangiji kuma a cikin sunansa za su yi tafiya,” in ji Ubangiji.
english: I will strengthen them in Yahweh. They will walk up and down in his name,” says Yahweh.

hausa: Bayan haka, Yoshuwa ya karanta duk abin da yake a cikin Dokoki, albarku da la’anoni, kamar yadda suke a rubuce a cikin Littafin Dokoki.
english: Afterward he read all the words of the law, the blessing and the curse, according to all that is written in the book of the law.

hausa: Ba ku sani ba? Ba ku taɓa ji ba? Ba a faɗa muku daga farko ba? Ba ku fahimta ba tun kafawar duniya?
english: Haven’t you known? Haven’t you heard? Haven’t you been told from the beginning? Haven’t you understood from the foundations of the earth?

hausa: Ya sarki kai ne itacen nan! Ka yi girma da ƙarfi; girmanka kuma ta kai har sama, mulkinka kuma ya kai ko’ina a duniya.
english: it is you, O king, that have grown and become strong; for your greatness has grown, and reaches to the sky, and your dominion to the end of the earth.

hausa: Ya kamata fa, sarki ya san cewa in aka sāke gina wannan birni duk da katangar birnin, mutanen birnin ba za su dinga biyan haraji, da kuɗin shiga, da na fitar da kaya ba, wannan zai sa aljihun masarauta yă bushe.
english: Be it known now to the king that if this city is built and the walls finished, they will not pay tribute, custom, or toll, and in the end it will be hurtful to the kings.

hausa: Da saurayin ya ji haka, sai ya tafi rai a ɓace, don yana da arziki sosai.
english: But when the young man heard this, he went away sad, for he was one who had great possessions.

hausa: Filibus ya sami Natanayel ya kuma gaya masa, “Mun sami wanda Musa ya rubuta game da shi a cikin Doka, kuma wanda annabawa suka rubuta a kansa, Yesu Banazare, ɗan Yusuf.”
english: Philip found Nathanael, and said to him, “We have found him of whom Moses in the law and also the prophets, wrote: Jesus of Nazareth, the son of Joseph.”

hausa: shi da ya sha gabanku a tafiyarku, cikin wuta da dad dare da kuma girgije da rana, don yă nemi wurare domin ku kafa sansani, don kuma yă nuna muku hanyar da za ku bi.
english: who went before you on the way, to seek out a place for you to pitch your tents in: in fire by night, to show you by what way you should go, and in the cloud by day.

hausa: “Kada a wulaƙanta, ko a zalunci baƙo, domin dā ku baƙi ne a ƙasar Masar.
english: “You shall not wrong an alien or oppress him, for you were aliens in the land of Egypt.

hausa: Da dare Bulus ya ga wahayin wani mutumin Makidoniya yana tsaye yana roƙonsa cewa, “Ka zo Makidoniya ka taimake mu.”
english: A vision appeared to Paul in the night. There was a man of Macedonia standing, begging him and saying, “Come over into Macedonia and help us.”

hausa: Wane ne Maɗaukaki har da za mu bauta masa? Wace riba za mu samu ta wurin yin addu’a gare shi?
english: What is the Almighty, that we should serve him? What profit should we have, if we pray to him?’

hausa: Ina gaya muku, haka za a yi murna sosai a sama, a kan mai zunubi guda ɗaya da ya tuba, fiye da masu adalci tasa’in da tara, waɗanda ba su bukatan tuba.
english: I tell you that even so there will be more joy in heaven over one sinner who repents, than over ninety-nine righteous people who need no repentance.

hausa: masu cewa, “Da harsunanmu za mu yi nasara; leɓunanmu za su kāre mu, wane ne maigidanmu?”
english: who have said, “With our tongue we will prevail. Our lips are our own. Who is lord over us?”

hausa: Ya kakkarya haƙorana da tsakuwa; ya tattake ni cikin ƙura.
english: He has also broken my teeth with gravel. He has covered me with ashes.

hausa: Ku zo ku saurara, dukanku waɗanda suke tsoron Allah; bari in faɗa muku abin da ya yi mini.
english: Come and hear, all you who fear God. I will declare what he has done for my soul.

hausa: Sai wani mala’ikan Ubangiji ya bayyana gare su, ɗaukakar Ubangiji kuma ta haskaka kewaye da su, suka kuwa tsorata ƙwarai.
english: Behold, an angel of the Lord stood by them, and the glory of the Lord shone around them, and they were terrified.

hausa: ’Ya’ya maza gādo ne daga Ubangiji, yara lada ne daga gare shi.
english: Behold, children are a heritage of Yahweh. The fruit of the womb is his reward.

hausa: Ga abin da Ubangiji yana cewa, “Tafi ka sayo tulu a wurin mai ginin tukwane. Ka ɗauki waɗansu dattawan jama’a da kuma na firistoci
english: Thus said Yahweh, “Go, and buy a potter’s earthen container, and take some of the elders of the people and of the elders of the priests;

hausa: Suna ture matalauta daga hanya suna kuma sa dole matalautan ƙasar su ɓoye.
english: They turn the needy out of the way. The poor of the earth all hide themselves.

hausa: Shawulu ya ce, “Bari hukunci mai tsanani na Allah yă kasance a kaina, in ba ka mutu ba, Yonatan.”
english: Saul said, “God do so and more also; for you shall surely die, Jonathan.”

hausa: Gama na san shirye-shiryen da na yi muku,” in ji Ubangiji, “shirye-shiryen cin gaba ba na cutarwa ba, shirye-shiryen ba ku sa zuciya da kuma na nan gaba.
english: For I know the thoughts that I think toward you,” says Yahweh, “thoughts of peace, and not of evil, to give you hope and a future.

hausa: “Duk surutun nan ba za a amsa maka ba? Ko mai surutun nan marar laifi ne?
english: “Shouldn’t the multitude of words be answered? Should a man full of talk be justified?

hausa: “Annabi da firist dukansu biyu marasa sanin Allah ne; har ma a cikin haikalina na tarar da muguntarsu,” in ji Ubangiji.
english: for both prophet and priest are profane. Yes, in my house I have found their wickedness,” says Yahweh.

hausa: Ta haka ne za ku san cewa Allah mai rai yana tare da ku, kuma ba shakka a gabanku za ku gani zai kore Kan’aniyawa, Hittiyawa, Hiwiyawa, Ferizziyawa, Girgashiyawa, Amoriyawa da Yebusiyawa.
english: Joshua said, “By this you shall know that the living God is among you, and that he will without fail drive the Canaanite, the Hittite, the Hivite, the Perizzite, the Girgashite, the Amorite, and the Jebusite out from before you.

hausa: Allah kuma ya ce, “Bari haskoki su kasance a sararin sama domin su raba yini da dare, bari su zama alamu domin su nuna yanayi, da ranaku, da kuma shekaru,
english: God said, “Let there be lights in the expanse of the sky to divide the day from the night; and let them be for signs to mark seasons, days, and years;

hausa: Ya ce, “Ga shi, na ga sama a buɗe da kuma Ɗan Mutum tsaye a hannun dama na Allah.”
english: and said, “Behold, I see the heavens opened and the Son of Man standing at the right hand of God!”

hausa: tare da hadayu na hatsi da hadayu na sha, da kuma kwando burodi marar yisti, ƙosai da aka yi da lallausan gari kwaɓaɓɓe da mai, da kuma wainan da aka barbaɗa da mai.
english: a basket of unleavened bread, cakes of fine flour mixed with oil, and unleavened wafers anointed with oil with their meal offering and their drink offerings.

hausa: Musa bai iya shiga Tentin Sujada ba domin girgije ya riga ya sauka a kansa, ɗaukakar Ubangiji kuwa ta cika tabanakul.
english: Moses wasn’t able to enter into the Tent of Meeting, because the cloud stayed on it, and Yahweh’s glory filled the tabernacle.

hausa: Suka sa aka kawo Bitrus da Yohanna a gabansu suka kuma fara yin musu tambayoyi cewa, “Da wane iko ko da wane suna kuka yi wannan?”
english: When they had stood Peter and John in the middle of them, they inquired, “By what power, or in what name, have you done this?”

hausa: Saboda haka aka samo mayaƙa dubu goma sha biyu shiryayyu don yaƙi, maza dubu ɗaya daga kowace kabilar Isra’ila.
english: So there were delivered, out of the thousands of Israel, a thousand from every tribe, twelve thousand armed for war.

hausa: Ladan, Ammihud, Elishama,
english: Ladan his son, Ammihud his son, Elishama his son,

hausa: Me kuma ya fi, na ɗauki dukan abubuwa hasara ne in aka kwatanta da mafificiyar girman sanin Kiristi Yesu Ubangijina, wanda saboda shi ne na yi hasarar kome. Na mai da su kayan wofi, domin in sami Kiristi
english: Yes most certainly, and I count all things to be a loss for the excellency of the knowledge of Christ Jesus, my Lord, for whom I suffered the loss of all things, and count them nothing but refuse, that I may gain Christ

hausa: Ka girmama mahaifinka da mahaifiyarka, domin ka yi tsawon rai a ƙasar da Ubangiji Allahnka yake ba ka.
english: “Honor your father and your mother, that your days may be long in the land which Yahweh your God gives you.

hausa: Duk wanda ba ya ƙauna, bai san Allah ba, domin Allah ƙauna ne.
english: He who doesn’t love doesn’t know God, for God is love.

hausa: Ku dubi Ibrahim mana, “Ya gaskata Allah, aka kuwa lissafta wannan adalci ne a gare shi.”
english: Even so, Abraham “believed God, and it was counted to him for righteousness.”

hausa: ’Ya’yansu suna girma kuma suna girma cikin ƙarfi a jeji; sukan tafi ba su dawowa.
english: Their young ones become strong. They grow up in the open field. They go out, and don’t return again.

hausa: Amma kai, ya Ubangiji, kada ka yi nisa; Ya Ƙarfina zo da sauri don ka taimake ni.
english: But don’t be far off, Yahweh. You are my help. Hurry to help me!

hausa: Sa’an nan Bala’am ya ce wa Balak, “Tsaya nan kusa da hadayarka, ni kuwa in koma wani wurin da yake a kaɗaice. Wataƙila Ubangiji zai sadu da ni. Duk abin da ya bayyana mini, zan faɗa maka.” Sai ya haura kan wani wurin da yake a kaɗaice a tudun.
english: Balaam said to Balak, “Stand by your burnt offering, and I will go. Perhaps Yahweh will come to meet me. Whatever he shows me I will tell you.” He went to a bare height.

hausa: Bari duhu mai yawa yă rufe daren nan; kada a haɗa ta cikin kwanakin shekara, ko kuma cikin kwanakin watanni.
english: As for that night, let thick darkness seize on it. Let it not rejoice among the days of the year. Let it not come into the number of the months.

hausa: Sai wani daga cikin almajiransa Andarawus, ɗan’uwan Bitrus, ya yi magana,
english: One of his disciples, Andrew, Simon Peter’s brother, said to him,

hausa: wanda ya ce, “Zan yanke ƙahonin dukan mugaye, amma za a ɗaga ƙahonin adalai sama.”
english: I will cut off all the horns of the wicked, but the horns of the righteous shall be lifted up.

hausa: “Wayyo! Ina ruwanka da mu, Yesu Banazare? Ka zo ne don ka hallaka mu? Na san wane ne kai, Mai Tsarki na Allah!”
english: saying, “Ah! what have we to do with you, Jesus of Nazareth? Have you come to destroy us? I know who you are: the Holy One of God!”

hausa: “Koma gida, ka shaida babban alherin da Allah ya yi maka.” Sai mutumin ya tafi yana faɗin abin da Yesu ya yi masa a duk garin.
english: “Return to your house, and declare what great things God has done for you.” He went his way, proclaiming throughout the whole city what great things Jesus had done for him.

hausa: Ta goyi ɗaya daga cikin kwiyakwiyanta, ya yi girma ya zama zaki mai ƙarfi. Ya koyi yayyage abin da ya yi farauta yakan kuma cinye mutane.
english: She brought up one of her cubs. He became a young lion. He learned to catch the prey. He devoured men.

hausa: Suka tambaye shi suka ce, “Ina Uban nan naka?” Sai Yesu ya ce, “Ba ku san ni ko Ubana ba. Da kun san ni, da za ku san Ubana ma.”
english: They said therefore to him, “Where is your Father?” Jesus answered, “You know neither me nor my Father. If you knew me, you would know my Father also.”

hausa: Sa’ad da ka ɓoye fuskarka, sai su razana; sa’ad da ka ɗauke numfashinsu, sai su mutu su kuma koma ga ƙura.
english: You hide your face; they are troubled. You take away their breath; they die and return to the dust.

hausa: “Wannan rana za tă zama muku abin tunawa dukan zamananku masu zuwa, za ku kiyaye ta kamar biki ga Ubangiji, dawwammamiyar farilla ce har abada.
english: This day shall be a memorial for you. You shall keep it as a feast to Yahweh. You shall keep it as a feast throughout your generations by an ordinance forever.

hausa: Da sauran goman suka ji wannan, sai suka yi fushi da Yaƙub da Yohanna.
english: When the ten heard it, they began to be indignant toward James and John.

hausa: Ya yarda yă biya su dinari guda a yini, sai ya tura su gonar inabinsa.
english: When he had agreed with the laborers for a denarius a day, he sent them into his vineyard.

hausa: A cikin zafin fushi ya fasa kowane ƙaho na Isra’ila. Ya janye hannun damansa sa’ad da maƙiyi ya zo. Ya yi ƙuna a cikin Yaƙub kamar wuta mai ƙone duk abin da yake kusa da ita.
english: He has cut off all the horn of Israel in fierce anger. He has drawn back his right hand from before the enemy. He has burned up Jacob like a flaming fire, which devours all around.

hausa: Ofir, Hawila da Yobab. Dukan waɗannan ’ya’yan Yoktan maza ne.
english: Ophir, Havilah, and Jobab. All these were the sons of Joktan.

hausa: Babu laifin da ya yi da za a tuna da su. Saboda abubuwan adalcin da ya aikata, zai rayu.
english: None of his transgressions that he has committed will be remembered against him. In his righteousness that he has done, he shall live.

hausa: har ma ya yi ƙoƙari ya ƙazantar da haikali; shi ya sa muka kama shi.
english: He even tried to profane the temple, and we arrested him.

hausa: In kuka lura, kuka kuma kiyaye dukan umarnai da nake ba ku, ku ƙaunaci Ubangiji Allahnku, ku yi tafiya a hanyoyinsa, ku kuma riƙe shi gam,
english: For if you shall diligently keep all these commandments which I command you—to do them, to love Yahweh your God, to walk in all his ways, and to cling to him—

hausa: Ya yi jaruntaka sosai, ya ci Amalekawa da yaƙi, ya kuma ceci Isra’ila daga hannuwan waɗanda suka ƙwace musu kaya.
english: He did valiantly and struck the Amalekites, and delivered Israel out of the hands of those who plundered them.

hausa: Mutum bai gane muhimmancinta ba, ba a samunta a ƙasar masu rai.
english: Man doesn’t know its price, and it isn’t found in the land of the living.

hausa: ta wurinsa ne muka sami shiga wannan alherin da muke tsaye yanzu, ta wurin bangaskiya. Muna kuma farin ciki a begen ɗaukakar Allah.
english: through whom we also have our access by faith into this grace in which we stand. We rejoice in hope of the glory of God.

hausa: “ ‘Duk wanda yake ɗan ƙasa, ta haka ne dole zai aikata waɗannan abubuwa sa’ad da ya kawo hadaya da akan yi da wuta mai daɗin ƙanshi ga Ubangiji.
english: “‘All who are native-born shall do these things in this way, in offering an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to Yahweh.

hausa: in ta ƙarfafawa ce, sai yă ƙarfafa; in kuma ta ba da taimako ce don biyan bukatun waɗansu, sai yă yi haka hannu sake; in ta shugabanci ce, sai yă yi shugabanci da himma; in ta nuna jinƙai ce, sai yă yi haka da fara’a.
english: or he who exhorts, to his exhorting; he who gives, let him do it with generosity; he who rules, with diligence; he who shows mercy, with cheerfulness.

hausa: Waɗannan irin mutane kansu suke kafa wa tarko; ba sa kama kome, sai rayukansu!
english: but these lay in wait for their own blood. They lurk secretly for their own lives.

hausa: A lokacin nan Yesu ya bi ta gonakin hatsi a ranar Asabbaci. Almajiransa kuwa suna jin yunwa, sai suka fara kakkarya kan hatsi suna ci.
english: At that time, Jesus went on the Sabbath day through the grain fields. His disciples were hungry and began to pluck heads of grain and to eat.

hausa: “Can wajen ƙarshe mulkinsu, sa’ad da muguntarsu ta kai intaha, wani mugun sarki mai rashin hankali, uban makirci, zai fito.
english: “In the latter time of their kingdom, when the transgressors have come to the full, a king of fierce face, and understanding riddles, will stand up.

hausa: In maganar ƙarfi ne, shi babban mai ƙarfi ne! In kuma maganar shari’a ne, wa zai kai kararsa?
english: If it is a matter of strength, behold, he is mighty! If of justice, ‘Who,’ says he, ‘will summon me?’

hausa: Tarin halittu masu rai za su rayu a duk inda ruwan ya malalo. Za a kasance da kifi masu yawa, domin wannan ruwa yana malalowa a can yana kuma mai da ruwan gishiri yă zama ruwa mai daɗi; saboda haka duk inda ruwan ya malalo, kome zai rayu.
english: It will happen that every living creature which swarms, in every place where the rivers come, will live. Then there will be a very great multitude of fish; for these waters have come there, and the waters of the sea will be healed, and everything will live wherever the river comes.

hausa: Yaziz mutumin Hagiri shi ne mai lura da tumaki. Dukan waɗannan shugabanni ne masu lura da mallakar Sarki Dawuda.
english: All these were the rulers of the property which was King David’s.

hausa: Gama rabon Ubangiji shi ne mutanensa, Yaƙub shi ne rabon gādonsa.
english: For Yahweh’s portion is his people. Jacob is the lot of his inheritance.

hausa: Gama ba daga cikin ƙasa wahala take fitowa ba, ko kuma bala’i daga ƙasa.
english: For affliction doesn’t come out of the dust, neither does trouble spring out of the ground;

hausa: Suka amsa suka ce, “A Betlehem ne, cikin Yahudiya, gama haka annabin ya rubuta.
english: They said to him, “In Bethlehem of Judea, for this is written through the prophet,

hausa: Yanum, Bet-Taffuwa, Afeka,
english: Janim, Beth Tappuah, Aphekah,

hausa: Ba mu da ’yancin tafiya tare da matar da muka aura mai bi kamar sauran manzanni da ’yan’uwan Ubangiji da kuma Kefas suke yi?
english: Have we no right to take along a wife who is a believer, even as the rest of the apostles, and the brothers of the Lord, and Cephas?

hausa: Fir’auna ya ce, “Zan bar ku ku tafi, don ku miƙa hadayu ga Ubangiji Allahnku, a cikin hamada, amma ba za ku tafi da nisa ba. Yanzu ku yi mini addu’a.”
english: Pharaoh said, “I will let you go, that you may sacrifice to Yahweh your God in the wilderness, only you shall not go very far away. Pray for me.”

hausa: Abin da Allah ya faɗa game da Masar, Duba, Ubangiji yana a kan girgije a sukwane yana kuwa zuwa Masar. Gumakan Masar sun firgita a gabansa, zukatan Masarawa sun karai.
english: The burden of Egypt. “Behold, Yahweh rides on a swift cloud, and comes to Egypt. The idols of Egypt will tremble at his presence; and the heart of Egypt will melt within it.

hausa: Ga shi, hadarin Ubangiji zai taso cikin hasala guguwa tana kaɗawa a kan kawunan mugaye.
english: Behold, Yahweh’s storm, his wrath, has gone out. Yes, a whirling storm! It will burst on the head of the wicked.

hausa: Sa’ad da rana ta yi sama, sai Allah ya sa iskar gabas mai zafi ta huro, zafin ranar kuma ya buga kan Yunana, har ya ji sai ka ce zai suma. Ya so a ce ya mutu ma, sai ya ce, “Gara in mutu da a ce ina zaune da rai.”
english: When the sun arose, God prepared a sultry east wind; and the sun beat on Jonah’s head, so that he was faint and requested for himself that he might die. He said, “It is better for me to die than to live.”

hausa: Da misalai da yawa irin waɗannan, Yesu ya yi magana da su, daidai yadda za su iya fahimta.
english: With many such parables he spoke the word to them, as they were able to hear it.

hausa: Na gangara zuwa cikin itatuwan almon don in ga ƙananan itatuwan da suke girma a kwari, don in ga ko inabi sun yi ’ya’ya ko rumman suna fid da furanni.
english: I went down into the nut tree grove, to see the green plants of the valley, to see whether the vine budded, and the pomegranates were in flower.

hausa: “Amma da wannan bawa ya fita, sai ya gamu da wani abokin bautarsa wanda yake binsa bashin dinari ɗari. Sai ya cafke shi, ya shaƙe shi a wuya yana cewa, ‘Biya ni abin da nake binka!’
english: “But that servant went out and found one of his fellow servants who owed him one hundred denarii, and he grabbed him and took him by the throat, saying, ‘Pay me what you owe!’

hausa: “ ‘Saboda wannan, zan kawo masifa a gidan Yerobowam. Zan yanke kowane ɗa na ƙarshe a Isra’ila, bawa ko ’yantacce. Zan ƙone gidan Yerobowam kamar yadda mutum yakan ƙone juji, sai duk ya ƙone ƙurmus.
english: therefore, behold, I will bring evil on the house of Jeroboam, and will cut off from Jeroboam everyone who urinates on a wall, he who is shut up and he who is left at large in Israel, and will utterly sweep away the house of Jeroboam, as a man sweeps away dung until it is all gone.

hausa: “Akwai waɗanda suke yi wa haske tawaye, waɗanda ba su san hanyoyinsa ba ko kuma ba su taɓa bin hanyoyinsa ba.
english: “These are of those who rebel against the light. They don’t know its ways, nor stay in its paths.

hausa: “ ‘Duk da haka ka ji alkawarin Ubangiji, ya Zedekiya sarkin Yahuda. Ga abin da Ubangiji yake cewa game da kai. Ba za ka mutu ta takobi ba;
english: “Yet hear Yahweh’s word, O Zedekiah king of Judah. Yahweh says concerning you, ‘You won’t die by the sword.

hausa: Ku sa takalma, amma ban da riga fiye da waɗanda kuka sa.
english: but to wear sandals, and not put on two tunics.

hausa: Yaron kuwa ya yi girma ya kuma ƙarfafa a ruhu; ya zauna a hamada sai lokacin da ya fito a fili ga mutanen Isra’ila.
english: The child was growing and becoming strong in spirit, and was in the desert until the day of his public appearance to Israel.

hausa: To, me ya sa ba ka tsawata wa Irmiya daga Anatot, wanda yana ɗauka kansa annabi a cikinku ba?
english: Now therefore, why have you not rebuked Jeremiah of Anathoth, who makes himself a prophet to you,

hausa: Da Yesu ya bar wurin, sai Farisiyawa da malaman dokoki suka fara gaba mai tsanani da shi, kuma suna tsokanansa da tambayoyi.
english: As he said these things to them, the scribes and the Pharisees began to be terribly angry, and to draw many things out of him,

hausa: Ban da waɗannan kuma, ku ɗauki garkuwar bangaskiya, wadda za ku iya kashe dukan kibiyoyin wutar Mugun nan da ita.
english: above all, taking up the shield of faith, with which you will be able to quench all the fiery darts of the evil one.

hausa: “Babu wani kamar Allah na Yeshurun, wanda yake hawa a bisa sammai don yă taimake ka a kan gizagizai kuma a cikin darajarsa.
english: “There is no one like God, Jeshurun, who rides on the heavens for your help, in his excellency on the skies.

hausa: Saboda haka, abin da na yi wa Shilo shi ne yanzu zan yi wa gidan da ake kira da Sunana, haikalin da kuka dogara a kai, wurin da na ba ku da kuma kakanninku.
english: therefore I will do to the house which is called by my name, in which you trust, and to the place which I gave to you and to your fathers, as I did to Shiloh.

hausa: Shugabannin Zowan sun zama wawaye, an ruɗe shugabannin Memfis dutsen kan kusurwa na mutanenta su sa Masar ta kauce.
english: The princes of Zoan have become fools. The princes of Memphis are deceived. They have caused Egypt to go astray, those who are the cornerstone of her tribes.

hausa: Dole yă riƙe tabbataccen saƙon nan kam-kam yadda aka koyar, don yă iya ƙarfafa waɗansu da sahihiyar koyarwa yă kuma ƙaryata waɗanda suke gāba da shi.
english: holding to the faithful word which is according to the teaching, that he may be able to exhort in the sound doctrine, and to convict those who contradict him.

hausa: “Wannan ya shafi Lawiyawa ne, wato, mazan da suka kai shekara ashirin da biyar, ko fiye, za su zo su yi aiki a Tentin Sujada,
english: “This is what is assigned to the Levites: from twenty-five years old and upward they shall go in to wait on the service in the work of the Tent of Meeting;

hausa: don ka zauna lafiya, ka kuma yi tsawon rai a duniya.”
english: “that it may be well with you, and you may live long on the earth.”

hausa: Sai Bafilistin ya ce, “A wannan rana, na kalubalanci sojojin Isra’ila, ku ba ni mutum ɗaya mu yi faɗa.”
english: The Philistine said, “I defy the armies of Israel today! Give me a man, that we may fight together!”

hausa: ko kuma sa’ad da mijin yana kishi domin yana shakkar matarsa. Firist zai sa tă tsaya a gaban Ubangiji, yă kuma yi amfani da wannan doka gaba ɗaya a kanta.
english: or when the spirit of jealousy comes on a man, and he is jealous of his wife; then he shall set the woman before Yahweh, and the priest shall execute on her all this law.

hausa: Yi magana a kuma yi shari’ar adalci; a tsare hakkin talakawa da masu bukata.”
english: Open your mouth, judge righteously, and serve justice to the poor and needy.”

hausa: Ya ce, “Ubangiji ya yi ruri daga Sihiyona ya kuma yi tsawa daga Urushalima; wuraren kiwo duk sun bushe, dutsen Karmel kuma ya yi yaushi.”
english: He said: “Yahweh will roar from Zion, and utter his voice from Jerusalem; and the pastures of the shepherds will mourn, and the top of Carmel will wither.”

hausa: Sa’an nan Elon ya mutu, aka kuwa binne shi a Aiyalon a ƙasar Zebulun.
english: Elon the Zebulunite died, and was buried in Aijalon in the land of Zebulun.

hausa: Shallum da Amariya da Yusuf.
english: Shallum, Amariah, and Joseph.

hausa: Saboda haka ga abin da Ubangiji ya ce, “Duba, zan tsaya muku, zan ɗaukar muku fansa, zan sa tekunta kafe in kuma sa maɓulɓulanta su ƙafe.
english: Therefore Yahweh says: “Behold, I will plead your cause, and take vengeance for you. I will dry up her sea, and make her fountain dry.

hausa: ina ƙirƙiro yabo a leɓunan masu makoki a Isra’ila. Salama, salama, ga waɗanda suke nesa da kuma kusa,” in ji Ubangiji. “Zan kuma warkar da su.”
english: I create the fruit of the lips: Peace, peace, to him who is far off and to him who is near,” says Yahweh; “and I will heal them.”

hausa: Mala’ika na fari ya je ya juye kwanonsa a bisan ƙasa, sai munanan gyambuna masu zafi suka fito a jikin mutanen da suke da alamar dabbar suka kuma yi wa siffarta sujada.
english: The first went, and poured out his bowl into the earth, and it became a harmful and painful sore on the people who had the mark of the beast, and who worshiped his image.

hausa: Zai kuma zama salamarsu. Sa’ad da Assuriyawa suka kawo wa ƙasarmu hari suka tattake kagarunmu, za mu tā da makiyaya bakwai, har ma shugabannin mutane takwas su yi gāba da su.
english: He will be our peace when Assyria invades our land and when he marches through our fortresses, then we will raise against him seven shepherds, and eight leaders of men.

hausa: Na ga kursiyoyi inda waɗanda aka ba su ikon shari’a suke zama a kai. Sai na ga rayukan waɗanda aka yanke kawunansu saboda shaidarsu don Yesu saboda kuma maganar Allah. Ba su yi wa dabban nan ko siffarta sujada ba, ba su kuma sami alamarta a goshinsu ko a hannuwansu ba. Suka sāke rayuwa daga matattu, suka yi mulki tare da Kiristi shekaru dubu.
english: I saw thrones, and they sat on them, and judgment was given to them. I saw the souls of those who had been beheaded for the testimony of Jesus and for the word of God, and such as didn’t worship the beast nor his image, and didn’t receive the mark on their forehead and on their hand. They lived and reigned with Christ for a thousand years.

hausa: Gama Allah shi ne Sarkin dukan duniya; ku rera zabura ta yabo gare shi.
english: For God is the King of all the earth. Sing praises with understanding.

hausa: Amma sa’ad da ya kai Ƙofar Benyamin, sai hafsa mai tsaro, wanda ake kira Iriya ɗan Shelemiya, ɗan Hananiya, ya kama shi ya kuma ce, “Kana gudu daga Babiloniyawa ne!”
english: When he was in Benjamin’s gate, a captain of the guard was there, whose name was Irijah, the son of Shelemiah, the son of Hananiah; and he seized Jeremiah the prophet, saying, “You are defecting to the Chaldeans!”

hausa: na huɗu shi ne Adoniya, ɗan Haggit; na biyar shi ne Shefatiya, ɗan Abital;
english: and the fourth, Adonijah the son of Haggith; and the fifth, Shephatiah the son of Abital;

hausa: Ina zuwa ba da daɗewa ba. Ka riƙe abin da kake da shi, don kada wani ya karɓe rawaninka.
english: I am coming quickly! Hold firmly that which you have, so that no one takes your crown.

hausa: Da safe maganar Ubangiji ta zo mini cewa,
english: In the morning, Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

hausa: Sa’an nan ya ce wa Isra’ilawa, “Duba Ubangiji ya zaɓi Bezalel ɗan Uri, ɗan Hur, daga kabilar Yahuda,
english: Moses said to the children of Israel, “Behold, Yahweh has called by name Bezalel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah.

hausa: Sai Solomon ya fara ginin haikalin Ubangiji a Urushalima, a kan Dutsen Moriya, inda Ubangiji ya taɓa bayyana ga mahaifinsa Dawuda, inda kuma Dawuda ya riga ya shirya a daidai masussukar Ornan mutumin Yebus.
english: Then Solomon began to build Yahweh’s house at Jerusalem on Mount Moriah, where Yahweh appeared to David his father, which he prepared in the place that David had appointed, on the threshing floor of Ornan the Jebusite.

hausa: “Addu’ata ba saboda masu bina kaɗai ba ne. Ina addu’a kuma saboda waɗanda za su gaskata da ni ta wurin maganarsu.
english: “Not for these only do I pray, but for those also who will believe in me through their word,

hausa: Za a la’anta kwandonku da kwanon kwaɓan kullunku.
english: Your basket and your kneading trough will be cursed.

hausa: Alheri da salama daga Allah Ubanmu da kuma Ubangiji Yesu Kiristi, su kasance tare da ku.
english: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

hausa: ba ya kuwa ɓata sunan wani da harshensa, wanda ba ya yi wa maƙwabcinsa mugunta ba ya kuwa baza jita-jita a kan ɗan’uwansa,
english: he who doesn’t slander with his tongue, nor does evil to his friend, nor casts slurs against his fellow man;

hausa: Kullum ku kasance masu sauƙinkai da kuma hankali; ku zama masu haƙuri, kuna jimrewa da juna cikin ƙauna.
english: with all lowliness and humility, with patience, bearing with one another in love,

hausa: Gama a ganina fa, Allah ya baje mu manzanni a ƙarshen jerin gwanon, a matsayin mutanen da aka hukunta ga mutuwa a filin wasanni. Mun zama abin kallo ga dukan duniya, ga mala’iku da kuma mutane.
english: For I think that God has displayed us, the apostles, last of all, like men sentenced to death. For we are made a spectacle to the world, both to angels and men.

hausa: Sai Yaƙub ya ce, “A’a, ina roƙonka, in na sami tagomashi a idanunka, sai ka karɓi wannan kyautai daga gare ni. Gama ganin fuskarka kamar ganin fuskar Allah ne, yanzu da ka karɓe ni da farin ciki.
english: Jacob said, “Please, no, if I have now found favor in your sight, then receive my present at my hand, because I have seen your face, as one sees the face of God, and you were pleased with me.

hausa: Zan kwarara hasalata a kan Felusiyum, kagarar Masar, in kuma datse mutanen Tebes.
english: I will pour my wrath on Sin, the stronghold of Egypt. I will cut off the multitude of No.

hausa: Da zinariya zalla kuma za ka yi farantansa, da kwanoninsa na tuya, da butocinsa, da kwanoninsa domin zuban hadayu.
english: You shall make its dishes, its spoons, its ladles, and its bowls with which to pour out offerings. You shall make them of pure gold.

hausa: Sai malaman dokoki da Farisiyawa suka kawo wata macen da aka kama a zina. Suka sa ta tsaya a gaban taron
english: The scribes and the Pharisees brought a woman taken in adultery. Having set her in the middle,

hausa: Mutane kuma ba sa zuba sabon ruwan inabi a cikin tsofaffin salkuna. In suka yi haka, salkunan za su farfashe, ruwan inabin kuwa yă zube salkunan kuma su lalace. A’a, ai, sukan zuba sabon ruwan inabi ne a cikin sababbin salkuna, don a kiyaye dukan biyun.”
english: Neither do people put new wine into old wineskins, or else the skins would burst, and the wine be spilled, and the skins ruined. No, they put new wine into fresh wineskins, and both are preserved.”

hausa: A maimakon haka, bari Ruhu yă sabunta tunaninku da kuma halayenku.
english: and that you be renewed in the spirit of your mind,

hausa: Sarki Zerzes ya amsa wa Esta da Mordekai mutumin Yahuda, “Domin Haman ya kai wa Yahudawa hari, na ba da mallakarsa ga Esta, an kuma rataye shi a wurin rataye mai laifi.
english: Then King Ahasuerus said to Esther the queen and to Mordecai the Jew, “See, I have given Esther the house of Haman, and they have hanged him on the gallows because he laid his hand on the Jews.

hausa: Yeriya yana da ’yan’uwa guda dubu biyu da ɗari bakwai, jarumawa da kuma kawunan iyalai, sai Sarki Dawuda ya sa su lura da mutanen Ruben, Gad da rabin kabilar Manasse game da kome da ya shafi Allah da kuma al’amuran sarki.
english: His relatives, men of valor, were two thousand seven hundred, heads of fathers’ households, whom King David made overseers over the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of the Manassites, for every matter pertaining to God and for the affairs of the king.

hausa: Ina fata za ku gane cewa ba mu fāɗi gwajin ba.
english: But I hope that you will know that we aren’t disqualified.

hausa: to, sai ku lura, kada ku jarrabtu ku kwaikwaye su bayan da an riga an shafe su daga gabanku, kada ku tambayi kome game da allolinsu, kuna cewa, “Yaya waɗannan al’ummai suke bauta wa allolinsu? Mu ma za mu yi kamar yadda suka yi.”
english: be careful that you are not ensnared to follow them after they are destroyed from before you, and that you not inquire after their gods, saying, “How do these nations serve their gods? I will do likewise.”

hausa: tawaye da mūsun Ubangiji, mun juye bayanmu ga Allahnmu, zugawa a yi zalunci da tayarwa, faɗin ƙarairayi da zukatanmu suka shirya.
english: transgressing and denying Yahweh, and turning away from following our God, speaking oppression and revolt, conceiving and uttering from the heart words of falsehood.

hausa: Mala’ikan ya ce, “Kada ka yi wa yaron nan rauni. Kada kuma ka ji masa ciwo. Yanzu na san cewa kana tsoron Allah, gama ba ka hana ni ɗanka, makaɗaicin ɗanka ba.”
english: He said, “Don’t lay your hand on the boy or do anything to him. For now I know that you fear God, since you have not withheld your son, your only son, from me.”

hausa: Da matar Uriya ta ji cewa mijinta ya mutu, sai ta yi makoki saboda shi.
english: When Uriah’s wife heard that Uriah her husband was dead, she mourned for her husband.

hausa: Gama Ubangiji Allahnku wuta ne mai ƙuna, Allah ne mai kishi.
english: For Yahweh your God is a devouring fire, a jealous God.

hausa: Zai tafa hannu yă yi tsaki yă kawar da shi daga wurinsa.”
english: Men will clap their hands at him, and will hiss him out of his place.

hausa: Kamar dai yadda yake, ba ni kaina nake yinsa ba, sai dai zunubin da yake zaune a cikina ne.
english: So now it is no more I that do it, but sin which dwells in me.

hausa: Sai suka bar saura har safe, kamar yadda Musa ya umarta, bai kuwa yi wari ko yă yi tsutsa ba.
english: They laid it up until the morning, as Moses ordered, and it didn’t become foul, and there were no worms in it.

hausa: Sai waɗansu daga cikin Farisiyawa suka ce, “Mutumin nan ba daga Allah yake ba, don ba ya kiyaye ranar Asabbaci.” Amma waɗansu suka yi tambaya suka ce, “Yaya mutum mai zunubi zai yi irin abubuwan banmamaki haka?” Sai ra’ayinsu ya sha bamban.
english: Some therefore of the Pharisees said, “This man is not from God, because he doesn’t keep the Sabbath.” Others said, “How can a man who is a sinner do such signs?” So there was division among them.

hausa: Yaron yana kan zuwa ke nan, sai aljanin ya buga shi ƙasa, cikin farfaɗiya. Amma Yesu ya kwaɓe mugun ruhun, ya warkar da yaron, sai ya miƙa shi ga mahaifinsa.
english: While he was still coming, the demon threw him down and convulsed him violently. But Jesus rebuked the unclean spirit, healed the boy, and gave him back to his father.

hausa: Ahab ya ce, “Amma wa zai yi haka?” Annabin ya amsa, “Ga abin da Ubangiji ya ce, ‘Sojoji matasa na shugabannin yankuna za su yi haka.’ ” Ya tambaya, “Wa kuma zai fara yaƙin?” Annabin ya amsa, “Kai za ka fara.”
english: Ahab said, “By whom?” He said, “Yahweh says, ‘By the young men of the princes of the provinces.’” Then he said, “Who shall begin the battle?” He answered, “You.”

hausa: wannan ya kasance haka domin an haifi Lawi daga baya a iyalin Ibrahim wanda ya ba wa Melkizedek kashi ɗaya bisa goma.
english: for he was yet in the body of his father when Melchizedek met him.

hausa: Sun juya mini bayansu ba fuskokinsu ba; ko da yake na koyar da su sau da sau, ba su saurara ko bi horo na ba.
english: They have turned their backs to me, and not their faces. Although I taught them, rising up early and teaching them, yet they have not listened to receive instruction.

hausa: Bai isa ba a ce kun yi kiwo a wuri mai kyau? Sai kun tattake sauran wurin kiwonku da ƙafafunku tukuna? Bai isa ba a ce kun sha ruwa mai tsabta? Sai kun kuma gurɓata sauran da ƙafafunku?
english: Does it seem a small thing to you to have fed on the good pasture, but you must tread down with your feet the residue of your pasture? And to have drunk of the clear waters, but must you foul the residue with your feet?

hausa: “ ‘In mace ta kusaci dabba don tă yi jima’i da ita, ku kashe macen da dabbar. Dole a kashe su; alhakin jininsu zai zauna a kansu.
english: “‘If a woman approaches any animal and lies with it, you shall kill the woman and the animal. They shall surely be put to death. Their blood shall be upon them.

hausa: Zan nuna masa wahalar da dole zai sha saboda sunana.”
english: For I will show him how many things he must suffer for my name’s sake.”

hausa: A idanunmu Ubangiji ya aikata manyan alamu masu banmamaki, da al’ajabai gāba da Masarawa, da Fir’auna, da kuma dukan gidansa.
english: and Yahweh showed great and awesome signs and wonders on Egypt, on Pharaoh, and on all his house, before our eyes;

hausa: Ta wurin hikimarka da ganewarka ka sami dukiya wa kanka ka kuma tara zinariya da azurfa cikin wuraren ajiyarka.
english: By your wisdom and by your understanding you have gotten yourself riches, and have gotten gold and silver into your treasuries.

hausa: Shi ya sa ban ma ga na isa in zo wurinka ba. Amma ka yi magana kawai, bawana zai warke.
english: Therefore I didn’t even think myself worthy to come to you; but say the word, and my servant will be healed.

hausa: Sai ya kawo ni shirayin haikalin ya kuma auna madogaran shirayin; fāɗinsu a kowane gefe kamu biyar-biyar ne. Fāɗin mashigin kamu goma sha huɗu ne, bangayenta kuma kamu uku-uku ne a kowane gefe.
english: Then he brought me to the porch of the house, and measured each post of the porch, five cubits on this side, and five cubits on that side. The width of the gate was three cubits on this side and three cubits on that side.

hausa: gaɓoɓi masu kyan gani kuwa, ba su bukatar yawan girmamawa. Allah ya harhaɗa jikunanmu yadda gaɓoɓin da ake gani kamar ba su da muhimmanci suna da amfani,
english: while our presentable parts have no such need. But God composed the body together, giving more abundant honor to the inferior part,

hausa: Amma suka yi kuka ga Ubangiji don taimako, ya kuwa sa duhu ya raba tsakaninsu da Masarawa; ya sa teku ya rufe Masarawa. Kun gani da idanunku abin da na yi wa Masarawa, sa’an nan kuka zauna a jeji na tsawon lokaci.
english: When they cried out to Yahweh, he put darkness between you and the Egyptians, and brought the sea on them, and covered them; and your eyes saw what I did in Egypt. You lived in the wilderness many days.

hausa: Bai zama masa wani abu mai wuya ba, yă yi zunuban Yerobowam ɗan Nebat, har ma ya auri Yezebel ’yar Etba’al sarkin Sidoniyawa, ya kuma fara bauta wa Ba’al, ya yi masa sujada.
english: As if it had been a light thing for him to walk in the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, he took as wife Jezebel the daughter of Ethbaal king of the Sidonians, and went and served Baal and worshiped him.

hausa: Dole mutanen Samariya su ɗauki laifinsu, domin sun tayar wa Allahnsu. Za a kashe su da takobi; za a fyaɗa ƙananansu da ƙasa, za a ɓarke matansu masu ciki.”
english: Samaria will bear her guilt, for she has rebelled against her God. They will fall by the sword. Their infants will be dashed in pieces, and their pregnant women will be ripped open.”

hausa: Sa’ad da na tuna da hawayenka, nakan yi marmarin ganinka, don in cika da farin ciki.
english: longing to see you, remembering your tears, that I may be filled with joy;

hausa: Sa’an nan Allah ya ce, “Ga shi, na ba ku kowane tsiro mai ba da ’ya’ya masu kwaya da suke a fāɗin duniya, da dukan itatuwa masu ba da ’ya’ya, don su zama abinci a gare ku.
english: God said, “Behold, I have given you every herb yielding seed, which is on the surface of all the earth, and every tree, which bears fruit yielding seed. It will be your food.

hausa: Sai Agiriffa ya ce wa Festus, “Da ba don wannan mutum ya ɗaukaka ƙara zuwa gaban Kaisar ba da an sake shi.”
english: Agrippa said to Festus, “This man might have been set free if he had not appealed to Caesar.”

hausa: Masu bayi, ku riƙe bayinku da kyau da kuma daidai, domin kun san cewa ku ma kuna da Ubangiji a sama.
english: Masters, give to your servants that which is just and equal, knowing that you also have a Master in heaven.

hausa: Ya kuma ba mu wannan umarni cewa duk wanda yake ƙaunar Allah, dole yă ƙaunaci ɗan’uwansa.
english: This commandment we have from him, that he who loves God should also love his brother.

hausa: Ubangiji Maɗaukaki ya ƙulla shi, don yă kawo ƙarshen girman kan dukan darajarta ya kuma ƙasƙantar da dukan waɗanda suke sanannu a duniya.
english: Yahweh of Armies has planned it, to stain the pride of all glory, to bring into contempt all the honorable of the earth.

hausa: Bayan an ɗan jima, sai Yesu ya haura zuwa Urushalima don wani bikin Yahudawa.
english: After these things, there was a feast of the Jews, and Jesus went up to Jerusalem.

hausa: Sai bawan ya ɗibi raƙuma goma na maigidansa ya tafi, ɗauke da kowane irin abubuwa masu kyau daga wurin maigidansa. Ya fita don yă tafi Aram-Naharayim, ya kama hanyarsa zuwa garin Nahor.
english: The servant took ten of his master’s camels, and departed, having a variety of good things of his master’s with him. He arose, and went to Mesopotamia, to the city of Nahor.

hausa: Sheshan ya ba da ’yarsa aure ga bawansa Yarha, ta kuwa haifa masa Attai.
english: Sheshan gave his daughter to Jarha his servant as wife; and she bore him Attai.

hausa: Amma shugabannin Sukkot suka ce, “Ka kama Zeba da Zalmunna ko ne? Don me za mu ba wa mayaƙanka burodi?”
english: The princes of Succoth said, “Are the hands of Zebah and Zalmunna now in your hand, that we should give bread to your army?”

hausa: Yesu ya ce musu, “Sai a garinsa kaɗai, da kuma cikin ’yan’uwansa, da cikin gidansa ne, annabi ba shi da daraja.”
english: Jesus said to them, “A prophet is not without honor, except in his own country, and among his own relatives, and in his own house.”

hausa: na Sena’a 3,930.
english: The children of Senaah: three thousand nine hundred thirty.

hausa: Sa’an nan sarkin Isra’ila ya umarta, “Ku kama Mikahiya, ku kai shi wurin Amon, shugaban birnin, da wurin Yowash ɗan sarki.
english: The king of Israel said, “Take Micaiah, and carry him back to Amon the governor of the city and to Joash the king’s son.

hausa: Fushin Shawulu ya ƙuna a kan Yonatan, sai ya ce masa, “Kai shege ne, haihuwar banzan mace; ai, na san kana goyon bayan ɗan Yesse don ka wulaƙantar da kanka da mahaifinka.
english: Then Saul’s anger burned against Jonathan, and he said to him, “You son of a perverse rebellious woman, don’t I know that you have chosen the son of Jesse to your own shame, and to the shame of your mother’s nakedness?

hausa: “Don me kake duban ɗan tsinke da yake idon ɗan’uwanka, amma ba ka kula da gungumen da yake a naka ido ba?
english: Why do you see the speck of chaff that is in your brother’s eye, but don’t consider the beam that is in your own eye?

hausa: Sa’an nan, waɗansu abokanmu suka je kabarin, suka kuma tarar da kome kamar yadda matan suka faɗa, amma shi, ba su gan shi ba.”
english: Some of us went to the tomb and found it just like the women had said, but they didn’t see him.”

hausa: Kafin wannan lokaci babu albashi domin mutum ko dabba. Ba wanda yake iya sakewa yă yi hidimominsa saboda maƙiya, domin na sa kowa yă zama maƙiyi maƙwabcinsa.
