english: For before those days there was no wages for man nor any wages for an animal, neither was there any peace to him who went out or came in, because of the adversary. For I set all men everyone against his neighbor.

hausa: Gara a tafi gidan makoki da a je gidan biki, gama mutuwa ce ƙaddarar kowane mutum; ya kamata masu rai su lura da haka.
english: It is better to go to the house of mourning than to go to the house of feasting; for that is the end of all men, and the living should take this to heart.

hausa: Amma in da ikon Allah ne ni nake fitar da aljanu, ashe, mulkin Allah ya zo muku ke nan.
english: But if I by God’s finger cast out demons, then God’s Kingdom has come to you.

hausa: “ ‘Sa’ad da na yi kira, ba su saurara ba; saboda haka sa’ad da suka kira, ba zan saurara ba,’ in ji Ubangiji Maɗaukaki.
english: It has come to pass that, as he called and they refused to listen, so they will call and I will not listen,” said Yahweh of Armies;

hausa: Akwai Eliyohenai da Ya’akoba, da Yeshohahiya, da Asahiya, da Adiyel, da Yesimiyel, da Benahiya.
english: Elioenai, Jaakobah, Jeshohaiah, Asaiah, Adiel, Jesimiel, Benaiah,

hausa: Waɗannan ma maganganun masu hikima ne, Nunan sonkai a shari’a ba shi da kyau.
english: These also are sayings of the wise: To show partiality in judgment is not good.

hausa: Sai Yesu ya shiga filin haikali, yayinda yake koyarwa, sai manyan firistoci da dattawan mutane suka zo wurinsa suka yi tambaya, “Da wane iko kake yin waɗannan abubuwa? Kuma wa ya ba ka wannan iko?”
english: When he had come into the temple, the chief priests and the elders of the people came to him as he was teaching, and said, “By what authority do you do these things? Who gave you this authority?”

hausa: Hannuna zai kasance tare da shi; tabbatacce hannuna zai ƙarfafa shi.
english: with whom my hand shall be established. My arm will also strengthen him.

hausa: ba mu yi biyayya ga Ubangiji Allahnmu ba, ba mu kuma kiyaye shari’unsa da ya ba mu ta wuri bayinsa annabawa ba.
english: We haven’t obeyed Yahweh our God’s voice, to walk in his laws, which he set before us by his servants the prophets.

hausa: Amma ba su sami hanyar yin haka ba, domin kalmominsa sun kama hankalin dukan mutanen.
english: They couldn’t find what they might do, for all the people hung on to every word that he said.

hausa: Sai Ful sarkin Assuriya ya kai wa ƙasar hari, Menahem kuwa ya ba shi talenti dubu na azurfa don yă sami goyon bayansa, yă kuma ƙarfafa kahuwa mulkin.
english: Pul the king of Assyria came against the land, and Menahem gave Pul one thousand talents of silver, that his hand might be with him to confirm the kingdom in his hand.

hausa: Saira kuwa bakararriya ce, ba ta da yara.
english: Sarai was barren. She had no child.

hausa: Haruna da ’ya’yansa maza za su ci sauran, amma za a ci shi ba tare da yisti ba a tsattsarkan wuri; za su ci shi a harabar Tentin Sujada.
english: That which is left of it Aaron and his sons shall eat. It shall be eaten without yeast in a holy place. They shall eat it in the court of the Tent of Meeting.

hausa: Kowa ya ’yantar da bayinsa da suke Ibraniyawa, maza da mata; kada kowa ya riƙe bawa wanda yake mutumin Yahuda.
english: that every man should let his male servant, and every man his female servant, who is a Hebrew or a Hebrewess, go free, that no one should make bondservants of them, of a Jew his brother.

hausa: Da mutane suka ji wannan mugun magana, sai suka fara makoki. Ba kuma wanda ya sa kayan ado.
english: When the people heard this evil news, they mourned; and no one put on his jewelry.

hausa: A tsakiyar alkukan kuwa akwai wani “kama da ɗan mutum,” saye da rigar da ya kai har ƙafafunsa da kuma ɗamarar zinariya daure a ƙirjinsa.
english: And among the lamp stands was one like a son of man, clothed with a robe reaching down to his feet, and with a golden sash around his chest.

hausa: Ubangiji yakan rushe gidan mai girman kai amma yakan kiyaye iyakokin gwauruwa daidai.
english: Yahweh will uproot the house of the proud, but he will keep the widow’s borders intact.

hausa: Mutuwa tsirara take a gaban Allah; haka kuma hallaka take a buɗe.
english: Sheol is naked before God, and Abaddon has no covering.

hausa: Shawulu ya ce, “Na yi zunubi. Amma ina roƙonka ka ba ni girma a gaban dattawan mutanena da kuma a gaban Isra’ila, ka koma tare da ni domin in yi wa Ubangiji Allahnka sujada.”
english: Then he said, “I have sinned; yet please honor me now before the elders of my people and before Israel, and come back with me, that I may worship Yahweh your God.”

hausa: Ba namijin da ya rage a Ai ko Betel da bai fita don yă fafari Isra’ilawa ba. Suka bar birnin a buɗe, suka tafi fafarar Isra’ilawa.
english: There was not a man left in Ai or Bethel who didn’t go out after Israel. They left the city open, and pursued Israel.

hausa: Da Yesu ya yi kusa da Yeriko, akwai wani makaho da yake zaune a gefen hanya, yana bara.
english: As he came near Jericho, a certain blind man sat by the road, begging.

hausa: Ba ka shafa mai a kaina ba, amma ta zubo turare a ƙafafuna.
english: You didn’t anoint my head with oil, but she has anointed my feet with ointment.

hausa: Sai Yahudawa suka ce wa juna, “Ina mutumin nan yake niyyar tafiya da ba za mu iya samunsa ba? Zai je wurin mutanenmu da suke zaune warwatse a cikin Hellenawa, yă kuma koya wa Hellenawa ne?
english: The Jews therefore said among themselves, “Where will this man go that we won’t find him? Will he go to the Dispersion among the Greeks and teach the Greeks?

hausa: Sa’an nan Iliya ya ce wa dukan mutane, “Ku zo nan wurina.” Suka zo wurinsa, ya kuma shirya bagaden Ubangiji, da ya riga ya zama kufai.
english: Elijah said to all the people, “Come near to me!”; and all the people came near to him. He repaired Yahweh’s altar that had been thrown down.

hausa: “Saboda haka sa’ad da kuka ga ‘abin ƙyama mai kawo hallaka,’wanda annabi Daniyel ya yi magana a kai, yana tsaye a tsattsarkan wuri (mai karatu yă gane),
english: “When, therefore, you see the abomination of desolation, which was spoken of through Daniel the prophet, standing in the holy place (let the reader understand),

hausa: Sai Ubangiji ya ce mini, “Jefar da shi cikin ma’aji,” Lada mai kyau da aka yi cinikina ne! Saboda haka sai na ɗauki azurfa talatin ɗin na jefa su cikin gidan Ubangiji don a sa cikin ma’aji.
english: Yahweh said to me, “Throw it to the potter—the handsome price that I was valued at by them!” I took the thirty pieces of silver and threw them to the potter in Yahweh’s house.

hausa: Taimakona zai zo daga wurin Ubangiji, wanda ya kafa sama da ƙasa.
english: My help comes from Yahweh, who made heaven and earth.

hausa: Ba abin da mutum zai yi da ya fi yă ci, yă sha, yă ji wa ransa daɗi daga aikinsa. Na lura cewa wannan ma, ya fito daga hannun Allah ne,
english: There is nothing better for a man than that he should eat and drink, and make his soul enjoy good in his labor. This also I saw, that it is from the hand of God.

hausa: “Ina gāba da ke,” in ji Ubangiji Maɗaukaki. “Zan ƙone kekunan yaƙinki, takobi kuma zai fafare ’ya’yan zakokinki. Ba kuma zan bar miki namun jejin da za ki kashe a duniya ba. Ba kuwa za a ƙara jin muryar ’yan saƙonki ba.”
english: “Behold, I am against you,” says Yahweh of Armies, “and I will burn her chariots in the smoke, and the sword will devour your young lions; and I will cut off your prey from the earth, and the voice of your messengers will no longer be heard.”

hausa: “In mutum ya saci saniya ko tunkiya ya yanka, ko ya sayar, zai biya shanu biyar, a maimakon saniyar da ya sata, ko kuma tumaki huɗu, maimakon tunkiyar da ya sata.
english: “If a man steals an ox or a sheep, and kills it or sells it, he shall pay five oxen for an ox, and four sheep for a sheep.

hausa: Abin da dai suka roƙa shi ne ya kamata mu riƙa tuna da matalauta, abin nan da nake marmarin yi.
english: They only asked us to remember the poor—which very thing I was also zealous to do.

hausa: Kada ka ba da shaida a kan maƙwabcinka ba tare da isashen dalili ba, ko ka yi amfani da leɓunanka ka yi ruɗu.
english: Don’t be a witness against your neighbor without cause. Don’t deceive with your lips.

hausa: Ki nome ƙasarki har zuwa wajen Nilu, Ya Diyar Tarshish, gama ba ki da tashan jirgin ruwa kuma.
english: Pass through your land like the Nile, daughter of Tarshish. There is no restraint any more.

hausa: In kuma wani dangi ya shiga don yă fitar da gawawwakin yă ƙone ya kuwa tambayi wani wanda yake ɓoye a can, yana cewa, “Akwai wani tare da kai?” Ya kuwa ce, “Babu,” sai yă ce, “Kul! Kada mu ambaci sunan Ubangiji.”
english: “When a man’s relative carries him, even he who burns him, to bring bodies out of the house, and asks him who is in the innermost parts of the house, ‘Is there yet any with you?’ And he says, ‘No;’ then he will say, ‘Hush! Indeed we must not mention Yahweh’s name.’

hausa: Sa’an nan ya kawo ni cikin fili na cikin gidan Ubangiji, a can kuwa a ƙofar haikali, tsakanin shirayi da bagade, akwai kamar mutum ashirin da biyar. Suka ba haikalin Ubangiji baya suna fuskanta wajen gabas, suna rusuna wa rana a gabas.
english: He brought me into the inner court of Yahweh’s house; and I saw at the door of Yahweh’s temple, between the porch and the altar, there were about twenty-five men with their backs toward Yahweh’s temple and their faces toward the east. They were worshiping the sun toward the east.

hausa: don a tabbatar sa’ad da wani abu mai tsarki da marar tsarki. Waɗannan su ne ƙa’idodi domin cutar fatar jiki mai yaɗuwa da cutar fatar jikin da take a riga.
english: to teach when it is unclean, and when it is clean. This is the law of leprosy.

hausa: Wannan shi ne alkawarin da kabilanmu goma sha biyu suke bege su ga cikawarsa, yayinda suke bauta wa Allah da himma dare da rana. Ya Sarki, saboda wannan bege ne fa Yahudawa suke zargena.
english: which our twelve tribes, earnestly serving night and day, hope to attain. Concerning this hope I am accused by the Jews, King Agrippa!

hausa: Za ku kuma rubuta a fayyace dukan kalmomin wannan doka a kan waɗannan duwatsun da kuka kakkafa.”
english: You shall write on the stones all the words of this law very plainly.”

hausa: Sa’ad da sarakuna suka haɗa rundunoni, sa’ad da suka yi gaba tare,
english: For, behold, the kings assembled themselves, they passed by together.

hausa: Yonatan ya ce, “Mahaifina ya jefa ƙasar cikin matsala. Duba yadda na ji ƙarfin jiki sa’ad da na ɗanɗana wannan ’yar zuma mana.
english: Then Jonathan said, “My father has troubled the land. Please look how my eyes have brightened because I tasted a little of this honey.

hausa: Yanzu zan tara ka da kakanninka, za a kuma binne ka cikin salama. Idanunka ba za su ga dukan masifar da zan kawo a kan wannan wuri da kuma a kan waɗanda suke zama a nan ba.’ ” Sai suka kai amsar wa sarki.
english: “Behold, I will gather you to your fathers, and you will be gathered to your grave in peace. Your eyes won’t see all the evil that I will bring on this place and on its inhabitants.”’” They brought back this message to the king.

hausa: Dabbar da ka gani, a dā ta taɓa kasancewa, a yanzu, ba ta, za tă kuma fito daga Abis zuwa ga hallakarta. Mazaunan duniya waɗanda ba a rubuta sunayensu a littafin rai tun kafin halittar duniya ba za su yi mamaki sa’ad da suka ga dabbar, domin a dā ta taɓa kasancewa, yanzu kuwa ba ta, duk da haka za tă dawo.
english: The beast that you saw was, and is not; and is about to come up out of the abyss and to go into destruction. Those who dwell on the earth and whose names have not been written in the book of life from the foundation of the world will marvel when they see that the beast was, and is not, and shall be present.

hausa: Sa’ad da Bela ya rasu, Yobab ɗan Zera daga Bozra ya gāje shi.
english: Bela died, and Jobab, the son of Zerah of Bozrah, reigned in his place.

hausa: Bilatus ya tambaye su ya ce, “To, me zan yi da wanda kuke ce da shi, sarkin Yahudawa?”
english: Pilate again asked them, “What then should I do to him whom you call the King of the Jews?”

hausa: Mai ramin zai biya rashin da aka yi wa mai shi, matacciyar saniyan ko jakin, zai zama na mai ramin.
english: the owner of the pit shall make it good. He shall give money to its owner, and the dead animal shall be his.

hausa: Wannan ya faru bayan ya ci Sihon sarkin Amoriyawa wanda ya yi mulki a Heshbon da yaƙi. A Edireyi kuma ya ci Og sarkin Bashan wanda ya yi mulki a Ashtarot da yaƙi.
english: after he had struck Sihon the king of the Amorites who lived in Heshbon, and Og the king of Bashan who lived in Ashtaroth, at Edrei.

hausa: Sarakunan Tarshish da na bakin kogi masu nisa za su ba da gandu gare shi; sarakunan Sheba da Seba za su ba shi kyautai.
english: The kings of Tarshish and of the islands will bring tribute. The kings of Sheba and Seba shall offer gifts.

hausa: sai suka gaskata. Sa’ad da suka ji cewa Ubangiji ya damu da su, ya kuma ga azabarsu, sai suka durƙusa suka yi sujada.
english: The people believed, and when they heard that Yahweh had visited the children of Israel, and that he had seen their affliction, then they bowed their heads and worshiped.

hausa: Muna kuma samun dukan abin da muka roƙa daga gare shi, domin muna biyayya da umarnansa, muna kuma yin abin da ya gamshe shi.
english: so whatever we ask, we receive from him, because we keep his commandments and do the things that are pleasing in his sight.

hausa: Musa ya amsa, “Za mu tafi tare da ƙanananmu, da tsofaffinmu, da ’ya’yanmu maza da mata, da kuma garkunanmu na shanu da tumaki, gama dole ne mu yi bikin ga Ubangiji.”
english: Moses said, “We will go with our young and with our old. We will go with our sons and with our daughters, with our flocks and with our herds; for we must hold a feast to Yahweh.”

hausa: “ ‘Kullum, Lawiyawa suna da izini su fanshi gidajensu a biranen Lawiyawa waɗanda suka mallaka.
english: “‘Nevertheless, in the cities of the Levites, the Levites may redeem the houses in the cities of their possession at any time.

hausa: Wannan shi ne shirin da na yi domin dukan duniya; wannan shi ne hannun da aka miƙa a bisa dukan al’ummai ke nan.
english: This is the plan that is determined for the whole earth. This is the hand that is stretched out over all the nations.

hausa: sai ka ji daga sama, mazauninka, ka kuma yi duk abin da baƙon ya nemi ka yi, saboda dukan mutanen duniya su san sunanka su kuma ji tsoronka, kamar yadda mutanenka Isra’ila suke yi, su kuma san cewa wannan gidan da na gina na Sunanka ne.
english: then hear from heaven, even from your dwelling place, and do according to all that the foreigner calls to you for; that all the peoples of the earth may know your name and fear you, as do your people Israel, and that they may know that this house which I have built is called by your name.

hausa: Mutane za su zauna tare a Yahuda da dukan garuruwansa, manoma da waɗanda suke yawo da garkunansu.
english: Judah and all its cities will dwell therein together, the farmers, and those who go about with flocks.

hausa: Haka Ubangiji ya kuɓutar da Isra’ila a wannan rana. Yaƙin kuwa ya ci gaba har gaba da Bet-Awen.
english: So Yahweh saved Israel that day; and the battle passed over by Beth Aven.

hausa: ɗan Amminadab, ɗan Ram, ɗan Hezron, ɗan Ferez, ɗan Yahuda,
english: the son of Amminadab, the son of Aram, the son of Hezron, the son of Perez, the son of Judah,

hausa: “La’ananne ne mutumin da ya kwana da mahaifiyar matarsa.” Sai dukan mutane su ce, “Amin!”
english: ‘Cursed is he who lies with his mother-in-law.’ All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’

hausa: Shebuwel ɗan Gershom, daga zuriyar Musa, shi ne babban jami’i mai lura da baitulmali.
english: Shebuel the son of Gershom, the son of Moses, was ruler over the treasuries.

hausa: Mutane da yawa sosai suka bi shi, a cikinsu ma da mata waɗanda suka yi makoki da kuka dominsa.
english: A great multitude of the people followed him, including women who also mourned and lamented him.

hausa: Mutane daga Negeb za su mamaye duwatsun Isuwa, mutane kuma daga gindin tuddai za su mallaki ƙasar Filistiyawa. Za su mamaye filayen Efraim da Samariya, Benyamin kuwa zai mallaki Gileyad.
english: Those of the South will possess the mountain of Esau, and those of the lowland, the Philistines. They will possess the field of Ephraim, and the field of Samaria. Benjamin will possess Gilead.

hausa: Ya ce musu, “To, ta yaya Dawuda ya yi magana ta wurin Ruhu Mai Tsarki, ya kira shi ‘Ubangiji’? Gama ya ce,
english: He said to them, “How then does David in the Spirit call him Lord, saying,

hausa: Sai Shaiɗan ya tashi gāba da Isra’ila, ya zuga Dawuda ya ƙidaya Isra’ila.
english: Satan stood up against Israel, and moved David to take a census of Israel.

hausa: Don me kuke rena hadayata da sadakokina da na ƙayyade domin mazaunina? Don me kake girmama ’ya’yanka fiye da ni ta wurin cinye sashe mafi kyau na kowane hadayar da mutanena Isra’ila suka miƙa?’
english: Why do you kick at my sacrifice and at my offering, which I have commanded in my habitation, and honor your sons above me, to make yourselves fat with the best of all the offerings of Israel my people?’

hausa: A maimakon, sai ka nuna wa Ubangiji na sama girman kai. Ka sa aka kawo maka su kwaf na zinariya daga haikalinsa, da kai da hakimanka, da matanka da ƙwarƙwaranka kuka sha ruwan inabi da su. Kuka yabi allolin zinariya da na azurfa, da na tagulla, da na baƙin ƙarfe, da na itace, da na dutse waɗanda ba sa ji, ba sa gani, ba sa da gane kome. Amma ba ka girmama Allah ba, wanda ranka da dukan harkokinka suna a hannunsa.
english: but have lifted up yourself against the Lord of heaven; and they have brought the vessels of his house before you, and you and your lords, your wives, and your concubines, have drunk wine from them. You have praised the gods of silver and gold, of bronze, iron, wood, and stone, which don’t see, or hear, or know; and you have not glorified the God in whose hand your breath is, and whose are all your ways.

hausa: Na buɗe wa ƙaunataccena ƙofa, amma ƙaunataccena ba ya nan, ya riga ya tafi. Zuciyata ta damu da tafiyarsa. Na neme shi amma ban same shi ba. Na yi ta kiransa amma bai amsa ba.
english: I opened to my beloved; but my beloved left, and had gone away. My heart went out when he spoke. I looked for him, but I didn’t find him. I called him, but he didn’t answer.

hausa: Sai na ɗauki sandana mai suna Tagomashi na karya shi, na janye alkawarin da na yi da dukan al’ummai.
english: I took my staff Favor and cut it apart, that I might break my covenant that I had made with all the peoples.

hausa: Na aike shi gāba da al’umma marar sanin Allah, na tura shi gāba da mutanen da suka ba ni fushi, don yă kwashe ganima yă kuma yi wason ganima, yă tattake su kamar laka a tituna.
english: I will send him against a profane nation, and against the people who anger me I will give him a command to take the plunder and to take the prey, and to tread them down like the mire of the streets.

hausa: Saboda haka ka yi annabci game da ƙasar Isra’ila ka kuma ce wa duwatsu da tuddai, wa kwazazzabai da kwaruruka, ‘Ga abin da Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka yana cewa ga shi, na yi magana da kishina da hasalata saboda sun sha zargi wurin al’ummai.
english: Therefore prophesy concerning the land of Israel, and tell the mountains, the hills, the watercourses and the valleys, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “Behold, I have spoken in my jealousy and in my wrath, because you have borne the shame of the nations.”

hausa: Ya ratsa ta Suriya da Silisiya, yana ƙarfafa ikkilisiyoyi.
english: He went through Syria and Cilicia, strengthening the assemblies.

hausa: Wani sashi kuma mai tsawo kamu 25,000 da fāɗi 10,000 zai zama na Lawiyawa, waɗanda suke hidima a cikin haikali, zai zama mallakarsu don su zauna a ciki.
english: Twenty-five thousand cubits in length and ten thousand in width shall be for the Levites, the ministers of the house, as a possession for themselves, for twenty rooms.

hausa: ’Yan’uwa, bari in yi muku misali da rayuwarmu ta yau da kullum. Kamar dai yadda ba mai kawarwa ko yă ƙara wani abu cikin alkawarin da mutane suka kafa, haka yake a wannan batu.
english: Brothers, speaking of human terms, though it is only a man’s covenant, yet when it has been confirmed, no one makes it void or adds to it.

hausa: Solomon ya ba da umarni don a gina haikali domin sunan Ubangiji da kuma fada wa kansa.
english: Now Solomon decided to build a house for Yahweh’s name, and a house for his kingdom.

hausa: Tsoro zai kama su, zafi da azaba za su ci ƙarfinsu; za su yi ta murɗewa kamar mace mai naƙuda. Za su dubi juna a tsorace, fuskokinsu a ɓace.
english: They will be dismayed. Pangs and sorrows will seize them. They will be in pain like a woman in labor. They will look in amazement one at another. Their faces will be faces of flame.

hausa: Uzziya yana da shekara goma sha shida sa’ad da ya zama sarki, ya kuma yi mulki a Urushalima shekara hamsin da biyu. Sunan mahaifiyarsa Yekoliya ce; ita daga Urushalima ce.
english: Uzziah was sixteen years old when he began to reign; and he reigned fifty-two years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Jechiliah, of Jerusalem.

hausa: “Ga shi, ina gāba da ke, ya ke mai girman kai,” in ji Ubangiji, Ubangiji Maɗaukaki, “gama ranarki ta zo, lokacin da za a hukunta ki.
english: “Behold, I am against you, you proud one,” says the Lord, Yahweh of Armies; “for your day has come, the time that I will visit you.

hausa: Ko da yake shi ɗa ne, ya yi biyayya ta wurin shan wahala
english: though he was a Son, yet learned obedience by the things which he suffered.

hausa: Amma kun shuka mugunta, kuka girbe mugu kuka ci ’ya’yan ruɗu. Domin kun dogara da ƙarfinku da kuma a jarumawanku masu yawa,
english: You have plowed wickedness. You have reaped iniquity. You have eaten the fruit of lies, for you trusted in your way, in the multitude of your mighty men.

hausa: Zan watsar da ku cikin al’ummai, in kuma ja takobina in kore ku. Ƙasarku za tă zama kufai, biranenku kuma su zama kango.
english: I will scatter you among the nations, and I will draw out the sword after you. Your land will be a desolation, and your cities shall be a waste.

hausa: Ibrahim ya ce, “Yanzu fa da na yi karambani har na yi magana da Ubangiji, in ashirin kaɗai aka samu a can fa?” Ya ce, “Saboda ashirin ɗin, ba zan hallaka shi ba.”
english: He said, “See now, I have taken it on myself to speak to the Lord. What if there are twenty found there?” He said, “I will not destroy it for the twenty’s sake.”

hausa: Yaƙub kuwa ya matsa kusa da mahaifinsa Ishaku, wanda ya tattaɓa shi, sa’an nan ya ce, “Muryan nan dai, muryar Yaƙub ce, amma hannuwan, hannuwan Isuwa ne.”
english: Jacob went near to Isaac his father. He felt him, and said, “The voice is Jacob’s voice, but the hands are the hands of Esau.”

hausa: Sai ya ja numfashi mai zurfi ya ce, “Don me wannan zamani yake neman ganin abin banmamaki? Gaskiya nake gaya muku, ba wata alamar da za a ba su.”
english: He sighed deeply in his spirit and said, “Why does this generation seek a sign? Most certainly I tell you, no sign will be given to this generation.”

hausa: Akwai mai hukunci saboda wanda ya ƙi ni, bai kuma karɓi kalmomina ba; wannan maganar da na faɗa ita ce za tă hukunta shi a rana ta ƙarshe.
english: He who rejects me, and doesn’t receive my sayings, has one who judges him. The word that I spoke will judge him in the last day.

hausa: Bowaz shi ne mahaifin Obed kuma Obed shi ne mahaifin Yesse.
english: and Boaz became the father of Obed, and Obed became the father of Jesse;

hausa: Na kuma ba da dukan dabbobin ƙasa, da dukan tsuntsayen sama, da dukan abin da yake rarrafe a ƙasa, da dai iyakar abin da yake numfashi; haka kuma na ba da ganyaye su zama abinci.” Haka kuwa ya kasance.
english: To every animal of the earth, and to every bird of the sky, and to everything that creeps on the earth, in which there is life, I have given every green herb for food;” and it was so.

hausa: Ya mai da iska suka zama ’yan saƙonsa harsunan wuta kuma bayinsa.
english: He makes his messengers winds, and his servants flames of fire.

hausa: Masu albarka ne waɗanda suke masu tsabtar zuciya, gama za su ga Allah.
english: Blessed are the pure in heart, for they shall see God.

hausa: Sa’ad da Sarki Dawuda ya tsufa ya kuma ƙara shekaru, ba ya iya jin ɗumi ko an rufe shi da abin rufuwa.
english: Now King David was old and advanced in years; and they covered him with clothes, but he couldn’t keep warm.

hausa: Suka sami makiyaya mai ciyawa mai kyau, ƙasar kuma tana da fāɗi, da salama, kuma zaman lafiya. A dā waɗansu mutanen Ham sun zauna a can.
english: They found rich, good pasture, and the land was wide, and quiet, and peaceful, for those who lived there before were descended from Ham.

hausa: Shin, a tashin matattu, matar wa za tă zama? Tun da su bakwan nan, sun aure ta.”
english: Therefore in the resurrection whose wife of them will she be? For the seven had her as a wife.”

hausa: In kana da abin da za ka ce, ka amsa mini; yi magana, domin ina so in ’yantar da kai.
english: If you have anything to say, answer me. Speak, for I desire to justify you.

hausa: Ko kuna tsammani a banza ne Nassi ya ce ruhun da ya sa yă zauna a cikinmu yana kishi sosai?
english: Or do you think that the Scripture says in vain, “The Spirit who lives in us yearns jealously”?

hausa: Nesa kaɗan da su kuwa akwai babban garken aladu da yake kiwo.
english: Now there was a herd of many pigs feeding far away from them.

hausa: “ ‘Lawiyawan da suka yi nesa da ni sa’ad da Isra’ila suka kauce da kuma waɗanda suka karkata daga gare ni suka bi gumakansu, dole su ɗauki alhakin zunubinsu.
english: “‘“But the Levites who went far from me when Israel went astray, who went astray from me after their idols, they will bear their iniquity.

hausa: Yaya ni bawanka zan iya magana da kai, ranka yă daɗe? Ƙarfina ya ƙare kuma ina numfashi da ƙyar.”
english: For how can the servant of this my lord talk with this my lord? For as for me, immediately there remained no strength in me. There was no breath left in me.”

hausa: inda kakanninku suka gwada suka kuma jarraba ni, ko da yake sun ga abin da na yi.
english: when your fathers tempted me, tested me, and saw my work.

hausa: Saboda haka ya ɗauki mutanensa, ya raba su ƙungiya uku, sa’an nan ya yi kwanto a gonakin. Sa’ad da ya ga mutanen suna fitowa daga birni, sai ya yi wuf ya fāɗa musu.
english: He took the people and divided them into three companies, and laid wait in the field; and he looked, and behold, the people came out of the city. So, he rose up against them and struck them.

hausa: Alherin Ubangiji Yesu yă kasance tare da ku.
english: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ be with you.

hausa: wanda waɗansu suka furta kuma ta yin haka suka bauɗe daga bangaskiya. Alheri yă kasance tare da ku.
english: which some profess, and thus have wandered from the faith. Grace be with you. Amen.

hausa: Ina yin dukan waɗannan ne saboda bishara, domin in sami rabo a cikin albarkarta.
english: Now I do this for the sake of the Good News, that I may be a joint partaker of it.

hausa: Sai na iske wani abin da ya fi mutuwa ɗaci mace wadda take tarko ne, wadda zuciyarta tarko ne wadda kuma hannuwanta sarƙa ne. Mutumin da ya gamshi Allah zai tsere mata, amma za tă kama mai zunubi.
english: I find more bitter than death the woman whose heart is snares and traps, whose hands are chains. Whoever pleases God shall escape from her; but the sinner will be ensnared by her.

hausa: Ba za mu yi ƙarfin halin lissafta kanmu, ko mu kwatanta kanmu da waɗansu masu yabon kansu ba. Sa’ad da suke gwada kansu da kansu, da kuma kwatanta kansu da kansu, ba su da hikima.
english: For we are not bold to number or compare ourselves with some of those who commend themselves. But they themselves, measuring themselves by themselves, and comparing themselves with themselves, are without understanding.

hausa: Isra’ilawa suka sāke yin mugayen ayyuka a gaban Ubangiji. Suka shiga bautar Ba’al da Ashtarot, da kuma allolin Aram, allolin Sidon, allolin Mowab, Ammonawa da kuma allolin Filistiyawa. Kuma domin Isra’ilawa sun bar Ubangiji ba su ƙara bauta masa ba,
english: The children of Israel again did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight, and served the Baals, the Ashtaroth, the gods of Syria, the gods of Sidon, the gods of Moab, the gods of the children of Ammon, and the gods of the Philistines. They abandoned Yahweh, and didn’t serve him.

hausa: Kada ku yi ramuwa, abokaina, sai dai ku bar wa Allah. Gama a rubuce yake cewa, “Ramuwa tawa ce; zan kuwa sāka,” in ji Ubangiji.
english: Don’t seek revenge yourselves, beloved, but give place to God’s wrath. For it is written, “Vengeance belongs to me; I will repay, says the Lord.”

hausa: Sa’an nan ’ya’yan Haruna maza waɗanda suke firistoci za su shirya gunduwa-gunduwar haɗe da kan da kuma kitsen a kan itace mai cin wuta wanda yake a kan bagaden.
english: and Aaron’s sons, the priests, shall lay the pieces, the head, and the fat in order on the wood that is on the fire which is on the altar;

hausa: Yabo ya tabbata ga Allah Uban Ubangijinmu Yesu Kiristi! Cikin jinƙansa mai girma ya ba mu sabuwar haihuwa cikin bege mai rai ta wurin tashin Yesu Kiristi daga matattu,
english: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who according to his great mercy caused us to be born again to a living hope through the resurrection of Jesus Christ from the dead,

hausa: Sa’an nan Ruhu ya ɗaga ni sama ya kuma tafi da ni, na kuwa tafi da ɓacin rai da kuma fushin ruhuna, tare da hannu mai ƙarfi na Ubangiji a bisa na.
english: So the Spirit lifted me up, and took me away; and I went in bitterness, in the heat of my spirit; and Yahweh’s hand was strong on me.

hausa: wajen himma kuwa, ni mai tsananta wa ikkilisiya ne, wajen aikin adalci bisa ga hanyar doka, ni marar laifi ne.
english: concerning zeal, persecuting the assembly; concerning the righteousness which is in the law, found blameless.

hausa: Na neme ka da dukan zuciyata; kada ka bar ni in kauce daga umarnanka.
english: With my whole heart I have sought you. Don’t let me wander from your commandments.

hausa: Sa’ad da Isra’ilawa suka yi kuka ga Ubangiji saboda Midiyawa,
english: When the children of Israel cried to Yahweh because of Midian,

hausa: Bayan shekara ɗari huɗu da talatin da huɗu, za a datse Shafaffen nan zai kuma kasance ba shi da kome. Mutanen mai mulkin za su zo su hallaka birnin da kuma wuri mai tsarki. Ƙarshen zai zo kamar rigyawa. Yaƙi zai ci gaba har ƙarshe, a kuma hallakar kamar yadda aka ƙaddara.
english: After the sixty-two weeks the Anointed One will be cut off, and will have nothing. The people of the prince who come will destroy the city and the sanctuary. Its end will be with a flood, and war will be even to the end. Desolations are determined.

hausa: In kuma ka yi tafiya a hanyoyina, ka kuma yi biyayya da farillaina da umarnaina kamar yadda Dawuda mahaifinka ya yi, zan ba ka tsawon rai.”
english: If you will walk in my ways, to keep my statutes and my commandments, as your father David walked, then I will lengthen your days.”

hausa: “Saboda haka ga abin da Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka yana cewa, ‘Domin ku mutanen nan kun tuna da laifinku ta wurin tawaye, kun kuma bayyana zunubanku cikin dukan abin da kuke yi, domin kun yi haka, za a kama ku.
english: “Therefore the Lord Yahweh says: ‘Because you have caused your iniquity to be remembered, in that your transgressions are uncovered, so that in all your doings your sins appear; because you have come to memory, you will be taken with the hand.

hausa: Bayan Festus ya yi shawara da majalisarsa sai ya ce, “Ka ɗaukaka ƙara zuwa gaban Kaisar. To, ga Kaisar kuwa za ka tafi!”
english: Then Festus, when he had conferred with the council, answered, “You have appealed to Caesar. To Caesar you shall go.”

hausa: Mutane ba sa ƙuna fitila su rufe ta da murfi. A maimako, sukan ajiye ta a kan wurin ajiye fitila, takan kuma ba da haske ga kowa a cikin gida.
english: Neither do you light a lamp and put it under a measuring basket, but on a stand; and it shines to all who are in the house.

hausa: Sa’an nan Mikahiya ya amsa, “Na ga dukan Isra’ila a warwatse a kan tuddai kamar tumakin da ba su da makiyayi, kuma Ubangiji ya ce, ‘Waɗannan mutane ba su da maigida. Bari kowa yă tafi gida cikin salama.’ ”
english: He said, “I saw all Israel scattered on the mountains, as sheep that have no shepherd. Yahweh said, ‘These have no master. Let them each return to his house in peace.’”

hausa: “ ‘Mutanen Farisa, Lidiya da Fut su ne suka zama sojoji a cikin mayaƙanki. Sun rataye garkuwoyinsu da hulunan kwano a katangarki, suna kawo miki daraja.
english: “‘“Persia, Lud, and Put were in your army, your men of war. They hung the shield and helmet in you. They showed your beauty.

hausa: Da suka ji haka, sai suka yabi Allah. Sa’an nan suka ce wa Bulus, “Ka gani ɗan’uwa, yawan dubban Yahudawan da suka gaskata, kuma dukansu masu himma ne a wajen bin doka.
english: They, when they heard it, glorified God. They said to him, “You see, brother, how many thousands there are among the Jews of those who have believed, and they are all zealous for the law.

hausa: Wannan ƙasa ta tashi daga Arower a kewayen Kwarin Arnon zuwa Dutsen Siyon (wato, Hermon),
english: from Aroer, which is on the edge of the valley of the Arnon, even to Mount Siyon (also called Hermon),

hausa: Saboda haka, sa’ad da Kiristi ya shigo duniya ya ce, “Hadaya da sadaka kam ba ka so, sai dai ka tanadar mini jiki;
english: Therefore when he comes into the world, he says, “You didn’t desire sacrifice and offering, but you prepared a body for me.

hausa: Za su zama kango a cikin ƙasashen da suke kango, biranensu kuwa za su zama kufai a cikin biranen da suka lalace.
english: “They will be desolate in the middle of the countries that are desolate. Her cities will be among the cities that are wasted.

hausa: Saboda haka, duk wanda yake magana da harshe, sai yă yi addu’a a yi masa baiwar fassara.
english: Therefore let him who speaks in another language pray that he may interpret.

hausa: In akwai mai gardama da wannan, to, mu dai ba mu da wata al’ada, haka ma ikkilisiyoyin Allah.
english: But if any man seems to be contentious, we have no such custom, neither do God’s assemblies.

hausa: Ubangiji zai kiyaye ku daga kowace cuta. Ba zai wahalshe ku da mugayen cututtukan da kuka sani a Masar ba, amma zai aukar wa dukan maƙiyanku.
english: Yahweh will take away from you all sickness; and he will put none of the evil diseases of Egypt, which you know, on you, but will lay them on all those who hate you.

hausa: Ba su iya kama shi a kan abin da ya faɗa a fili ba. Amsarsa ya ba su mamaki, shi ya sa suka yi shiru.
english: They weren’t able to trap him in his words before the people. They marveled at his answer and were silent.

hausa: Don mai bi da kaɗe-kaɗe. Da muryar “Kada Ka Hallaka.” Ta Dawuda. Wani miktam. Sa’ad da Shawulu ya aiki mutane su yi tsaron gidan Dawuda don yă kashe shi. Ka cece ni daga abokan gābana, ya Allah; ka tsare ni daga waɗanda suka tayar mini.
english: For the Chief Musician. To the tune of “Do Not Destroy.” A poem by David, when Saul sent, and they watched the house to kill him. Deliver me from my enemies, my God. Set me on high from those who rise up against me.

hausa: A nan fa, dukan baƙin Adoniya suka taso da rawar jiki suka watse.
english: All the guests of Adonijah were afraid, and rose up, and each man went his way.

hausa: Ana cikin haka, Midiyawa suka sayar da Yusuf a Masar wa Fotifar, ɗaya daga cikin shugabannin ’yan gadin fadar Fir’auna.
english: The Midianites sold him into Egypt to Potiphar, an officer of Pharaoh’s, the captain of the guard.

hausa: Kashegari da sassafe Yoshuwa ya sa Isra’ilawa suka fito kabila-kabila, aka ware kabilar Yahuda.
english: So Joshua rose up early in the morning and brought Israel near by their tribes. The tribe of Judah was selected.

hausa: Yesu ya zauna ɗaura da inda ake bayarwa, ya kuma dubi yadda taron suke sa kuɗinsu a cikin ɗakunan ajiya haikali. Masu arziki da yawa suka zuba kuɗaɗe masu yawa.
english: Jesus sat down opposite the treasury and saw how the multitude cast money into the treasury. Many who were rich cast in much.

hausa: Duk mutumin da ya yi rashin hankali wa alƙali, ko ga firist wanda yake aiki a nan wa Ubangiji Allahnku, dole a kashe shi. Dole ku fid da mugu daga Isra’ila.
english: The man who does presumptuously in not listening to the priest who stands to minister there before Yahweh your God, or to the judge, even that man shall die. You shall put away the evil from Israel.

hausa: Amma da kuka ga Nahash sarkin Ammonawa yana matsowa yă yaƙe, sai kuka ce mini, “Sam, muna so sarki yă shugabance mu.” Ko da yake Ubangiji Allahnku ne yake mulkinku.
english: “When you saw that Nahash the king of the children of Ammon came against you, you said to me, ‘No, but a king shall reign over us,’ when Yahweh your God was your king.

hausa: Sai Yoshuwa ya yaƙi Amalekawa kamar yadda Musa ya umarta, Musa, Haruna da Hur kuwa suka tafi bisa tudu.
english: So Joshua did as Moses had told him, and fought with Amalek; and Moses, Aaron, and Hur went up to the top of the hill.

hausa: Duk da haka, saboda bawansa Dawuda, Ubangiji bai ragargaza Yahuda ba. Ya riga ya yi alkawari zai bar wa Dawuda magāji har abada.
english: However, Yahweh would not destroy Judah, for David his servant’s sake, as he promised him to give to him a lamp for his children always.

hausa: Da Iblis ya gama dukan wannan gwajin, ya bar shi sai lokacin da wata dama ta samu.
english: When the devil had completed every temptation, he departed from him until another time.

hausa: Yanzu, ya Ubangiji, ka ɗauki raina, domin ya fi sauƙi a gare ni in mutu da in rayu.”
english: Therefore now, Yahweh, take, I beg you, my life from me, for it is better for me to die than to live.”

hausa: Aboki kan ruɗi aboki, ba mai faɗar gaskiya. Sun koya wa harshensu faɗar ƙarya; sun gajiyar da kansu da yin zunubi.
english: Friends deceive each other, and will not speak the truth. They have taught their tongue to speak lies. They weary themselves committing iniquity.

hausa: Amma ku yi ƙuduri, wato, ku shirya zuciyarku, a kan ba za ku damu ba kafin lokacin, game da yadda za ku kāre kanku.
english: Settle it therefore in your hearts not to meditate beforehand how to answer,

hausa: Aka ba ni ƙara kamar sandan awo aka kuma ce mini, “Tafi ka auna haikalin Allah da bagaden, ka kuma ƙirga waɗanda suke sujada a can.
english: A reed like a rod was given to me. Someone said, “Rise and measure God’s temple, and the altar, and those who worship in it.

hausa: Kuna da idanu, amma kun kāsa gani, kuna da kunnuwa, amma kun kāsa ji? Ba ku tuna ba?
english: Having eyes, don’t you see? Having ears, don’t you hear? Don’t you remember?

hausa: “Wani ya ce, ‘Na sayi shanun noma guda goma yanzun nan, ina kan hanyata ke nan in gwada su, ina roƙonka, ka yi mini haƙuri.’
english: “Another said, ‘I have bought five yoke of oxen, and I must go try them out. Please have me excused.’

hausa: “ ‘Duba yadda kowane yerima Isra’ila waɗanda suke cikinki yake yin amfani da ikonsa yana kisankai.
english: “‘“Behold, the princes of Israel, everyone according to his power, have been in you to shed blood.

hausa: Sai Abiyam ya huta tare da kakanninsa, aka kuma binne shi a Birnin Dawuda. Asa kuwa ya gāje shi a matsayin sarki.
english: Abijam slept with his fathers, and they buried him in David’s city; and Asa his son reigned in his place.

hausa: “A cikin wahayin da gani sa’ad da nake kwance a kan gadona, Na duba, a gabana kuwa ga wani ɗan saƙo, mai tsarki, yana saukowa daga sama.
english: “I saw in the visions of my head on my bed, and behold, a holy watcher came down from the sky.

hausa: Makiyaya masu yawa za su lalace gonar inabina su tattake gonata; za su mai da gonata mai kyau kango marar amfani.
english: Many shepherds have destroyed my vineyard. They have trodden my portion under foot. They have made my pleasant portion a desolate wilderness.

hausa: Gama ka sa na yi murna ta wurin ayyukanka, ya Ubangiji; na rera don farin ciki saboda ayyukan hannuwanka.
english: For you, Yahweh, have made me glad through your work. I will triumph in the works of your hands.

hausa: Yesu ya amsa ya ce, “Ku ma me ya sa kuke karya dokar Allah saboda al’adarku?
english: He answered them, “Why do you also disobey the commandment of God because of your tradition?

hausa: A rubuta sunayen ’ya’yan Isra’ila a kan duwatsu biyun, yadda mai yin aiki da dutse mai daraja yakan zāna hatimi. Sa’an nan a sa kowane dutse a cikin tsaiko na zinariya
english: With the work of an engraver in stone, like the engravings of a signet, you shall engrave the two stones, according to the names of the children of Israel. You shall make them to be enclosed in settings of gold.

hausa: Duk da haka, ba kai ba ne za ka gina haikalin, amma ɗanka wanda yake namanka da jininka, shi ne wanda zai gina haikali domin Sunana.’
english: nevertheless you shall not build the house, but your son who will come out of your body, he shall build the house for my name.’

hausa: Sojoji suka kawo tumaki da shanu mafi kyau daga cikin ganimar domin a miƙa hadaya ga Ubangiji Allahnka a Gilgal.”
english: But the people took of the plunder, sheep and cattle, the best of the devoted things, to sacrifice to Yahweh your God in Gilgal.”

hausa: Barin wurin ke nan, sai Yesu ya janye zuwa yankin Taya da Sidon.
english: Jesus went out from there and withdrew into the region of Tyre and Sidon.

hausa: Da ya gama magana da Ibrahim, sai Allah ya tashi daga gare shi.
english: When he finished talking with him, God went up from Abraham.

hausa: Wannan Melkizedek sarkin Salem ne da kuma firist na Allah Mafi Ɗaukaka. Shi ne ya sadu da Ibrahim ya albarkace shi sa’ad da Ibrahim ya dawowa daga cin nasara a bisa sarakuna,
english: For this Melchizedek, king of Salem, priest of God Most High, who met Abraham returning from the slaughter of the kings and blessed him,

hausa: Dukan ƙasashe suna hutawa suna kuma cikin salama; sun ɓarke da waƙa.
english: The whole earth is at rest, and is quiet. They break out in song.

hausa: ya lalace inabinsu da itatuwan ɓaurensu ya ragargaza itatuwan ƙasarsu.
english: He struck their vines and also their fig trees, and shattered the trees of their country.

hausa: da mutane 16,000.
english: and sixteen thousand persons),

hausa: Sarki zai yi makoki, yerima zai fid da zuciya, hannuwan mutanen ƙasar kuma za su yi rawa. Zan sāka musu bisa ga ayyukansu, zan kuma hukunta su bisa ga ma’auninsu. Sa’an nan za su san cewa ni ne Ubangiji.’ ”
english: The king will mourn, and the prince will be clothed with desolation. The hands of the people of the land will be troubled. I will do to them after their way, and according to their own judgments I will judge them. Then they will know that I am Yahweh.’”

hausa: Tare da shi za ku tanada hadaya ta gari kowace safiya, da ya haɗa da kashi ɗaya bisa shida na efa tare da kashi ɗaya bisa uku na mai ga garin da aka cuɗa. Miƙawar wannan hadaya ta gari ga Ubangiji dawwammamiyar farilla ce.
english: You shall prepare a meal offering with it morning by morning, the sixth part of an ephah, and the third part of a hin of oil to moisten the fine flour; a meal offering to Yahweh continually by a perpetual ordinance.

hausa: Zan bautar da ku ga abokan gābanku a ƙasar da ba ku sani ba, gama fushina zai yi ƙuna kamar wuta da za tă yi ƙuna a kanku.”
english: I will make them to pass with your enemies into a land which you don’t know; for a fire is kindled in my anger, which will burn on you.”

hausa: Ina nan da ƙarfina kamar yadda nake da ƙarfi a lokacin da Musa ya aike ni; zan iya fita zuwa yaƙi da ƙwazo yanzu kamar yadda nake zuwa a dā.
english: As yet I am as strong today as I was in the day that Moses sent me. As my strength was then, even so is my strength now for war, to go out and to come in.

hausa: ku tabbata cewa Ubangiji Allahnku ba zai kore muku mutanen ƙasashen nan ba, sai ma su zama muku dutsen tuntuɓe da tarko, za su zama bulala a bayanku, ƙayayyuwa a idanunku, har sai kun hallaka daga wannan ƙasa mai kyau wadda Ubangiji Allahnku ya ba ku.
english: know for a certainty that Yahweh your God will no longer drive these nations from out of your sight; but they shall be a snare and a trap to you, a scourge in your sides, and thorns in your eyes, until you perish from off this good land which Yahweh your God has given you.

hausa: Zan gode wa Ubangiji saboda adalcinsa zan kuma rera yabo ga sunan Ubangiji Mafi Ɗaukaka.
english: I will give thanks to Yahweh according to his righteousness, and will sing praise to the name of Yahweh Most High.

hausa: Ba gādon Isra’ilan da za a ba wa wata kabila daga wata kabila, gama kowane mutumin Isra’ila zai riƙe gādonsa na kabilar da ya gāda daga kakanninsa.
english: So shall no inheritance of the children of Israel move from tribe to tribe; for the children of Israel shall all keep the inheritance of the tribe of his fathers.

hausa: Ka yi tunani a kan abin da nake faɗi, gama Ubangiji zai ba ka ganewa cikin dukan wannan.
english: Consider what I say, and may the Lord give you understanding in all things.

hausa: yayinda sauran mutane daga Yahuda da Benyamin suka zauna a Urushalima). Daga zuriyar Yahuda akwai, Atahiya ɗan Uzziya, ɗan Zakariya, ɗan Amariya, ɗan Shefatiya, ɗan Mahalalel, wani zuriyar Ferez;
english: Some of the children of Judah and of the children of Benjamin lived in Jerusalem. Of the children of Judah: Athaiah the son of Uzziah, the son of Zechariah, the son of Amariah, the son of Shephatiah, the son of Mahalalel, of the children of Perez;

hausa: Ya fi kyau, in nufin Allah ne, a sha wahala don yin nagarta fiye da yin mugunta.
english: For it is better, if it is God’s will, that you suffer for doing what is right than for doing evil.

hausa: Kada ka bari su rabu da kai, ka kiyaye su a cikin zuciyarka;
english: Let them not depart from your eyes. Keep them in the center of your heart.

hausa: Sai sojoji suka zo suka karya ƙafafun mutum na farko da aka gicciye tare da Yesu, da kuma na ɗayan.
english: Therefore the soldiers came and broke the legs of the first and of the other who was crucified with him;

hausa: Sa’ad da suke kima, kima sosai, da kuma baƙi a cikinta,
english: when you were but a few men in number, yes, very few, and foreigners in it.

hausa: Ubangiji ya ce wa Musa,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

hausa: To, ’yan’uwa, a ce na zo wurinku ina kuma yin magana da waɗansu harsuna, amfanin me zan yi muku in ban zo muku da wani bayani ko sani ko annabci, ko kuma kalmar koyarwa ba?
english: But now, brothers, if I come to you speaking with other languages, what would I profit you unless I speak to you either by way of revelation, or of knowledge, or of prophesying, or of teaching?

hausa: ina kuma da irin bege ɗaya ga Allah yadda mutanen nan suke da shi, cewa akwai tashin matattu masu adalci da masu mugunta duka.
english: having hope toward God, which these also themselves look for, that there will be a resurrection of the dead, both of the just and unjust.

hausa: Sa’an nan Sama’ila ya ɗauki dutse ya kafa tsakanin Mizfa da Shen, ya sa masa suna, Ebenezer ma’ana, “Har zuwa wannan lokaci Ubangiji ya taimake mu.”
english: Then Samuel took a stone and set it between Mizpah and Shen, and called its name Ebenezer, saying, “Yahweh helped us until now.”

hausa: Aka ba sauran zuriyar Kohat rabon garuruwa goma daga gidajen rabin kabilar Manasse.
english: To the rest of the sons of Kohath were given by lot, out of the family of the tribe, out of the half-tribe, the half of Manasseh, ten cities.

hausa: sai suka kwashe dukan mutanensu suka tafi don su yaƙi Ishmayel ɗan Netaniya. Suka iske shi kusa da babban tafki a Gibeyon.
english: then they took all the men, and went to fight with Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, and found him by the great waters that are in Gibeon.

hausa: Daga Attaliya kuma suka shiga jirgin ruwa suka koma Antiyok, inda dā aka danƙa su ga alherin Allah saboda aikin da suka kammala yanzu.
english: From there they sailed to Antioch, from where they had been committed to the grace of God for the work which they had fulfilled.

hausa: Damuwar da ya ja yakan sāke nannaɗe a kansa; fitinarsa takan sauka a kansa.
english: The trouble he causes shall return to his own head. His violence shall come down on the crown of his own head.

hausa: Sai Dawuda ya ce masa, “Ka ƙara dakata a nan kwana ɗaya, gobe kuwa in sallame ka.” Saboda haka Uriya ya dakata a Urushalima a ranar, da kuma ta biye.
english: David said to Uriah, “Stay here today also, and tomorrow I will let you depart.” So Uriah stayed in Jerusalem that day and the next day.

hausa: Da an sayar da shi, ai, da an sami kuɗi fiye da albashi ma’aikaci na shekara guda, a ba wa matalauta. Sai suka tsawata mata da zafi.”
english: For this might have been sold for more than three hundred denarii and given to the poor.” So they grumbled against her.

hausa: Jikinsa kamar lu’ulu’u yake, fuskarsa kuma kamar walƙiya, idanunsa kamar harshen wuta, hannuwansa da ƙafafunsa kamar gogaggiyar tagulla, muryarsa kuma kamar amon babban taron jama’a.
english: His body also was like beryl, and his face as the appearance of lightning, and his eyes as flaming torches. His arms and his feet were like burnished bronze. The voice of his words was like the voice of a multitude.

hausa: Waɗannan su ne ƙa’idodin da Ubangiji ya ba wa Musa game da dangantakar miji da matarsa, da kuma tsakanin mahaifi da ’yarsa wadda har yanzu tana a gidansa.
english: These are the statutes which Yahweh commanded Moses, between a man and his wife, between a father and his daughter, being in her youth, in her father’s house.

hausa: In kuwa ya same ta, ina gaya muku gaskiya, zai yi murna saboda ɗayan fiye da tasa’in da taran da ba su ɓace ba.
english: If he finds it, most certainly I tell you, he rejoices over it more than over the ninety-nine which have not gone astray.

hausa: Ya ce mata, “Ki tsaya a ƙofar tenti, in wani ya zo ya tambaye ki, ‘Akwai wani a nan?’ Ki ce masa ‘a’a.’ ”
english: He said to her, “Stand in the door of the tent, and if any man comes and inquires of you, and says, ‘Is there any man here?’ you shall say, ‘No.’”

hausa: Sa’an nan mala’ikan ya ɗauke ni cikin Ruhu zuwa hamada. A can na ga mace zaune a kan wata jan dabbar da aka rufe da sunayen saɓo tana kuma da kawuna bakwai da ƙahoni goma.
english: He carried me away in the Spirit into a wilderness. I saw a woman sitting on a scarlet-colored beast, full of blasphemous names, having seven heads and ten horns.

hausa: Asabbaci ne don hutawa, kuma dole ku yi mūsun kanku; wannan dawwammamiyar farilla ce.
english: It is a Sabbath of solemn rest to you, and you shall afflict your souls. It is a statute forever.

hausa: Gama Allah yana magana, yanzu ga wannan hanya, yanzu kuma ga wata hanya ko da yake ba lalle mutum yă lura ba.
english: For God speaks once, yes twice, though man pays no attention.

hausa: Abin da ya sa na rubuta muku shi ne don in ga ko za ku jimre da gwajin nan, kuna kuma yin biyayya ta kowace hanya.
english: For to this end I also wrote, that I might know the proof of you, whether you are obedient in all things.

hausa: gama za mu hallaka wannan wuri. Kukan da aka yi ga Ubangiji game da mutanen birnin nan ya yi yawa sosai, ya sa har ya aiko mu domin mu hallaka birnin.”
english: for we will destroy this place, because the outcry against them has grown so great before Yahweh that Yahweh has sent us to destroy it.”

hausa: Amma ya faru domin zunuban annabawanta da muguntar firistocinta, waɗanda suka zub da jinin masu adalci a cikinsu.
english: It is because of the sins of her prophets and the iniquities of her priests, that have shed the blood of the just in the middle of her.

hausa: Wata ƙasa takan murƙushe wata, wani birni kuma yakan murƙushe wani, domin Allah ya wahalshe su da kowace irin damuwa.
english: They were broken in pieces, nation against nation, and city against city; for God troubled them with all adversity.

hausa: Sa’ad da katangar ta fāɗi, mutane ba za su tambaye ku ba cewa, “Ina shafen farar ƙasar da kuka yi mata?”
english: Behold, when the wall has fallen, won’t it be said to you, “Where is the plaster with which you have plastered it?”

hausa: Gama wane ne Allah, in ba Ubangiji ba? Wane ne dutse kuma in ba Allahnmu ba?
english: For who is God, besides Yahweh? Who is a rock, besides our God?

hausa: Sai Yesu ya bar wurin, ya kuma tafi wajajen Taya. Ya shiga wani gida, bai kuwa so kowa yă sani ba. Duk da haka, bai iya ɓoye kasancewarsa ba.
english: From there he arose and went away into the borders of Tyre and Sidon. He entered into a house and didn’t want anyone to know it, but he couldn’t escape notice.

hausa: Za mu haye a gaban Ubangiji zuwa Kan’ana, amma mallakarmu ta gādo, za tă kasance a wannan hayi na Urdun.”
english: We will pass over armed before Yahweh into the land of Canaan, and the possession of our inheritance shall remain with us beyond the Jordan.”

hausa: Masu mulkinki ’yan tawaye ne, abokan ɓarayi; dukansu suna ƙaunar cin hanci suna bin kyautai. Ba sa taɓa tsare marayu a ɗakin shari’a; ba sa taimakon gwauruwa.
english: Your princes are rebellious and companions of thieves. Everyone loves bribes and follows after rewards. They don’t defend the fatherless, neither does the cause of the widow come to them.

hausa: ta Binnuyi 648
english: The children of Binnui: six hundred forty-eight.

hausa: aikin zai bayyana kansa, domin za a nuna shi a sarari a Ranar. Wuta ce za tă bayyana aikin, wutar kuwa za tă gwada ingancin aikin kowa.
english: each man’s work will be revealed. For the Day will declare it, because it is revealed in fire; and the fire itself will test what sort of work each man’s work is.

hausa: Za ka kwanta, ba wanda zai sa ka ji tsoro, da yawa za su zo neman taimako a wurinka.
english: Also you will lie down, and no one will make you afraid. Yes, many will court your favor.

hausa: Za ku zama la’anannu a birni da kuma a ƙauye.
english: You will be cursed in the city, and you will be cursed in the field.

hausa: Sarki ya ce wa Shimeyi, “Ka sani a zuciyarka dukan muguntar da ka yi wa mahaifina Dawuda. Yanzu Ubangiji zai sāka maka saboda muguntarka.
english: The king said moreover to Shimei, “You know in your heart all the wickedness that you did to David my father. Therefore Yahweh will return your wickedness on your own head.

hausa: Solomon ya mayar da wannan saƙo ga Hiram ya ce,
english: Solomon sent to Hiram, saying,

hausa: ya ce musu, “Kun yi duk abin da Musa bawan Ubangiji ya umarta, kun kuma yi mini biyayya cikin dukan umarnan da na ba ku.
english: and said to them, “You have kept all that Moses the servant of Yahweh commanded you, and have listened to my voice in all that I commanded you.

hausa: Dukiya ba ta da amfani a ranar fushi, amma adalci kan yi ceto daga mutuwa.
english: Riches don’t profit in the day of wrath, but righteousness delivers from death.

hausa: Da taimakonka zan iya auka wa rundunar sojoji; tare da Allahna zan iya hawan katanga.
english: For by you, I run against a troop. By my God, I leap over a wall.

hausa: To, yabo yă tabbata a gare shi, shi wanda yake da iko yă tsare ku daga fāɗuwa, yă kuma miƙa ku marasa laifi a gaban ɗaukakarsa da matuƙar farin ciki.
english: Now to him who is able to keep them from stumbling, and to present you faultless before the presence of his glory in great joy,

hausa: Amma ƙasar da kuke haye Urdun ku mallaki, ƙasa ce ta duwatsu da kwaruruka wadda ruwan sama ne yake jiƙe ta.
english: but the land that you go over to possess is a land of hills and valleys which drinks water from the rain of the sky,

hausa: A ƙarshe, sai Daniyel ya zo gabana na kuma faɗa masa mafarkin. (Ana ce da shi Belteshazar, wanda aka ba shi sunan allahna kuma ruhun alloli masu tsarki suna a bisansa.)
english: But at last, Daniel came in before me, whose name was Belteshazzar according to the name of my god, and in whom is the spirit of the holy gods. I told the dream before him, saying,

hausa: za su sami sakayyar abubuwan da suka yi su kuma ƙoshi da sakayyar makircinsu.
english: Therefore they will eat of the fruit of their own way, and be filled with their own schemes.

hausa: Amma in tabon bai canja ba, bai kuma yaɗu ba, tabo ne kawai daga ƙurji, kuma firist zai furta shi tsarkakakke.
english: But if the bright spot stays in its place, and hasn’t spread, it is the scar from the boil; and the priest shall pronounce him clean.

hausa: In mutum ya mutu, ko zai sāke rayuwa? In haka ne zan daure kwanakin da nake shan wahala har su wuce.
english: If a man dies, will he live again? I would wait all the days of my warfare, until my release should come.

hausa: Yahuda ya juya sai ya ga cewa ana yaƙe su gaba da baya. Sai suka yi kuka ga Ubangiji. Firistoci suka busa ƙahoni
english: When Judah looked back, behold, the battle was before and behind them; and they cried to Yahweh, and the priests sounded with the trumpets.

hausa: Da Filistiyawa suka ji cewa Isra’ila sun taru a Mizfa, sai shugabanninsu suka zo don su yaƙe Isra’ila. Da Isra’ilawa suka ji labarin, sai suka tsorata saboda Filistiyawa.
english: When the Philistines heard that the children of Israel were gathered together at Mizpah, the lords of the Philistines went up against Israel. When the children of Israel heard it, they were afraid of the Philistines.

hausa: Sai ya ɗauki yaran a hannuwansa, ya ɗibiya musu hannuwansa, ya kuma albarkace su.
english: He took them in his arms and blessed them, laying his hands on them.

hausa: Don haka kowannenmu zai ba da lissafin kansa ga Allah.
english: So then each one of us will give account of himself to God.

hausa: Kada ku sa wani yă yi tuntuɓe, ko mutumin Yahuda ne, ko mutumin Al’ummai ko kuma ikkilisiyar Allah
english: Give no occasion for stumbling, whether to Jews, to Greeks, or to the assembly of God;

hausa: Mun san cewa kowane haifaffe na Allah ba ya cin gaba da yin zunubi; kasancewarsa haifaffe na Allah ita takan kāre shi, mugun kuwa ba zai iya cuce shi ba.
english: We know that whoever is born of God doesn’t sin, but he who was born of God keeps himself, and the evil one doesn’t touch him.

hausa: “Mahaifina Dawuda ya yi niyya a cikin zuciyarsa yă gina haikali saboda Sunan Ubangiji, Allah na Isra’ila.
english: “Now it was in the heart of David my father to build a house for the name of Yahweh, the God of Israel.

hausa: Sai Bowaz ya ɗauki Rut ta kuwa zama matarsa. Sa’an nan ya kwana da ita, Ubangiji kuma ya sa ta yi ciki, ta haifi ɗa.
english: So Boaz took Ruth and she became his wife; and he went in to her, and Yahweh enabled her to conceive, and she bore a son.

hausa: Abubuwa nawa na yi waɗanda ba daidai ba, kuma zunubi ne? Ka nuna mini laifina da zunubina.
english: How many are my iniquities and sins? Make me know my disobedience and my sin.

hausa: Ga sha biyun da ya naɗa. Siman (wanda ya ba shi suna Bitrus);
english: Simon (to whom he gave the name Peter);

hausa: To, fa, Balak ɗan Ziffor ya ga duk abin da Isra’ila suka yi da Amoriyawa.
english: Balak the son of Zippor saw all that Israel had done to the Amorites.

hausa: Ina roƙonka, bari in ƙetare in ga ƙasa mai kyau ɗin nan a ƙetaren Urdun, wannan ƙasar mai kyau ta tuddai, da kuma Lebanon.”
english: Please let me go over and see the good land that is beyond the Jordan, that fine mountain, and Lebanon.”

hausa: Har yaushe wannan zai ci gaba a cikin zukata annabawa masu ƙarya, waɗanda suke annabcin ruɗun tunaninsu?
english: How long will this be in the heart of the prophets who prophesy lies, even the prophets of the deceit of their own heart?

hausa: Yesu ya amsa ya ce, “Ya karkataccen zamani marar bangaskiya, har yaushe ne zan kasance tare da ku, ina kuma haƙuri da ku? Kawo yaronka nan.”
english: Jesus answered, “Faithless and perverse generation, how long shall I be with you and bear with you? Bring your son here.”

hausa: Na yi farin ciki sosai ga Ubangiji don yanzu kun sāke nuna kun kula da ni. Ko da yake dā ma kun kula da ni sai dai ba ku sami dama ku nuna mini ba.
english: But I rejoice in the Lord greatly that now at length you have revived your thought for me; in which you did indeed take thought, but you lacked opportunity.

hausa: Ubangiji ya bayyana ga Ibrahim kusa da manyan itatuwan Mamre yayinda yake zaune a mashigin tentinsa da tsakar rana.
english: Yahweh appeared to him by the oaks of Mamre, as he sat in the tent door in the heat of the day.

hausa: Ku dubi tsuntsayen sararin sama mana; ba sa shuki ko girbi ko ajiya a rumbuna, duk da haka, Ubanku na sama yana ciyar da su. Ashe, ba ku fi su daraja nesa ba?
english: See the birds of the sky, that they don’t sow, neither do they reap, nor gather into barns. Your heavenly Father feeds them. Aren’t you of much more value than they?

hausa: “Kaitonku, makafi jagora! Kukan ce, ‘In wani ya rantse da haikali, ba damuwa; amma in ya rantse da zinariyar haikali, sai rantsuwar ta kama shi.’
english: “Woe to you, you blind guides, who say, ‘Whoever swears by the temple, it is nothing; but whoever swears by the gold of the temple, he is obligated.’

hausa: Sa’ad da Yaƙub ya gan su sai ya ce, “Wannan sansanin Allah ne!” Saboda haka ya kira wannan wuri Mahanayim.
english: When he saw them, Jacob said, “This is God’s army.” He called the name of that place Mahanaim.

hausa: “Ka faɗa wa Isra’ilawa, ‘Dole ku kiyaye Asabbataina. Wannan zai zama alama tsakanina da ku daga tsara zuwa tsara, saboda ku sani ni ne Ubangiji, wanda ya mai da ku masu tsarki.
english: “Speak also to the children of Israel, saying, ‘Most certainly you shall keep my Sabbaths; for it is a sign between me and you throughout your generations, that you may know that I am Yahweh who sanctifies you.

hausa: Kada ka cika ziyarar gidan maƙwabcinka yawan ganinka zai sa ya ƙi ka.
english: Let your foot be seldom in your neighbor’s house, lest he be weary of you, and hate you.

hausa: A shekaru talatin da bakwai ta Yowash sarkin Yahuda, Yehowash ɗan Yehoyahaz ya zama sarkin Isra’ila a Samariya, ya kuma yi mulki shekaru goma sha shida.
english: In the thirty-seventh year of Joash king of Judah, Jehoash the son of Jehoahaz began to reign over Israel in Samaria for sixteen years.

hausa: wanda ya yi zancen Sairus ya ce, ‘Shi ne makiyayina zan kuma cika dukan abin da na gan dama; zai yi zancen Urushalima cewa, “Bari a sāke gina ta,” game da haikali kuma cewa, “Bari a kafa harsashinsa.” ’
english: who says of Cyrus, ‘He is my shepherd, and shall perform all my pleasure,’ even saying of Jerusalem, ‘She will be built;’ and of the temple, ‘Your foundation will be laid.’”

hausa: Da gangan suka gwada Allah ta wurin neman abincin da suke kwaɗayi.
english: They tempted God in their heart by asking food according to their desire.

hausa: Sa’an nan ya fara yi musu magana da misalai ya ce, “Wani mutum ya shuka gonar inabi. Ya kewaye ta da katanga, ya haƙa rami domin matsin inabin, ya kuma gina ɗakin gadi. Sai ya ba wa waɗansu manoma hayar gonar inabin, sa’an nan ya yi tafiya.
english: He began to speak to them in parables. “A man planted a vineyard, put a hedge around it, dug a pit for the wine press, built a tower, rented it out to a farmer, and went into another country.

hausa: Suka ɗauke tukwane, da manyan cokula, da acibalbal, da kwanoni, da dai dukan kayan da aka yi da tagulla don hidima a haikalin Ubangiji.
english: They took away the pots, the shovels, the snuffers, the spoons, and all the vessels of bronze with which they ministered.

hausa: Yabo ya tabbata ga Ubangiji Allah, Allah na Isra’ila, wanda shi kaɗai ya aikata abubuwa masu banmamaki.
english: Praise be to Yahweh God, the God of Israel, who alone does marvelous deeds.

hausa: Sai sarki ya zartar da hukuncinsa ya ce, “A ba da jariri mai ran ga mata ta fari. Kada a kashe shi; ita ce ainihin mahaifiyarsa.”
english: Then the king answered, “Give the first woman the living child, and definitely do not kill him. She is his mother.”

hausa: Na kawo ku zuwa ƙasa mai albarka don ku ci amfaninta da abubuwa masu yalwar da take bayarwa. Amma kuka zo kuka ƙazantar da ƙasata kuka kuma mai da gādona abin ƙyama.
english: I brought you into a plentiful land to eat its fruit and its goodness; but when you entered, you defiled my land, and made my heritage an abomination.

hausa: Zinariya da madubi ba za su iya gwada kansu da ita ba, ba kuwa za a iya musayarta da abubuwan da aka yi da zinariya ba.
english: Gold and glass can’t equal it, neither will it be exchanged for jewels of fine gold.

hausa: “Yayinda Yahudawa suna kallo, ka ɗauki waɗansu manyan duwatsu tare da kai ka kuma binne su cikin yumɓu a tubalin dakalin ƙofar shiga fadar Fir’auna a Tafanes.
english: “Take great stones in your hand and hide them in mortar in the brick work which is at the entry of Pharaoh’s house in Tahpanhes, in the sight of the men of Judah.

hausa: Mutanen Tekowa ne suka yi gyare-gyare biye da shi, amma manyan garinsu suka ƙi su sa hannu cikin aikin da shugabanninsu suka bayar.
english: Next to them, the Tekoites made repairs; but their nobles didn’t put their necks to the Lord’s work.

hausa: Bari a ji kuka daga gidajensu sa’ad da ka kawo masu hari a kansu farat ɗaya, gama sun haƙa rami don su kama ni suka kuma kafa tarko wa ƙafafuna.
english: Let a cry be heard from their houses when you bring a troop suddenly on them; for they have dug a pit to take me and hidden snares for my feet.

hausa: Sa’an nan ku ƙone sauran naman da kuma burodin.
english: What remains of the meat and of the bread you shall burn with fire.

hausa: Saboda haka almajiran suka yi yadda Yesu ya umarce su, suka kuwa shirya Bikin Ƙetarewa.
english: The disciples did as Jesus commanded them, and they prepared the Passover.

hausa: Sarki ya tambayi macen game da al’amarin, ita kuwa ta faɗa masa. Sa’an nan ya sa wani hafsa yă dubi damuwarta ya kuma ce masa, “Ka mayar mata kome da yake nata, haɗe da dukan kuɗin da aka samo daga filin, daga ranar da ta bar ƙasar har yă zuwa yanzu.”
english: When the king asked the woman, she told him. So the king appointed to her a certain officer, saying, “Restore all that was hers, and all the fruits of the field since the day that she left the land, even until now.”

hausa: ’Ya’yan Seyir maza su ne, Lotan, Shobal, Zibeyon, Ana, Dishon, Ezer da Dishan.
english: The sons of Seir: Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah, Dishon, Ezer, and Dishan.

hausa: suke kuma mafi kusa da sarki. Waɗannan masu hikima kuwa su ne, Karshena, Shetar, Admata, Tarshish, Meres, Marsena da kuma Memukan. Su hakimai bakwai ne na Farisa da Mediya waɗanda suke da dama ta musamman ta kaiwa ga sarki, suke kuma da matsayi mafi girma a masarautar.
english: and next to him were Carshena, Shethar, Admatha, Tarshish, Meres, Marsena, and Memucan, the seven princes of Persia and Media, who saw the king’s face, and sat first in the kingdom),

hausa: Ɗaya daga cikin masu laifin da aka gicciye a wurin ya zazzage shi ya ce, “Shin, ba kai ne Kiristi ba? To, ka ceci kanka, ka kuma cece mu mana!”
english: One of the criminals who was hanged insulted him, saying, “If you are the Christ, save yourself and us!”

hausa: Kaiton waɗanda suke tashi da sassafe don su nufi wurin shaye-shaye, waɗanda suke raba dare har sai sun bugu da ruwan inabi.
english: Woe to those who rise up early in the morning, that they may follow strong drink, who stay late into the night, until wine inflames them!

hausa: Ku tsaya kewaye da sarki, kowane mutum da makaminsa a hannu. Duk wanda ya kusace ku, ku kashe shi. Ku manne wa sarki duk inda ya tafi.”
english: You shall surround the king, every man with his weapons in his hand; and he who comes within the ranks, let him be slain. Be with the king when he goes out, and when he comes in.”

hausa: Sa’an nan ka yi mata ƙawanya. Ka kafa mata katangar ƙawanya, ka gina katangar da ɗan tudu ka kewaye ta da dundurusai.
english: Lay siege against it, build forts against it, and cast up a mound against it. Also set camps against it and plant battering rams against it all around.

hausa: Gama duk abin da yake na duniya, kamar sha’awace-sha’awacen mutuntaka, sha’awar idanunsa, da kuma taƙama da abin da yake da shi, yake kuma yi, ba daga wurin Uba suke fitowa ba sai dai daga duniya.
english: For all that is in the world—the lust of the flesh, the lust of the eyes, and the pride of life—isn’t the Father’s, but is the world’s.

hausa: Za a tattara su tare kamar ɗaurarru a kurkuku; za a rufe su a kurkuku a kuma hukunta su bayan kwanaki masu yawa.
english: They will be gathered together, as prisoners are gathered in the pit, and will be shut up in the prison; and after many days they will be visited.

hausa: Mu ma don me muke sa kanmu cikin hatsari a kowace sa’a?
english: Why do we also stand in jeopardy every hour?

hausa: Sa’an nan firist zai ɗibi jinin da yatsarsa yă zuba a ƙahoni a bagaden hadaya ta ƙonawa, yă kuma zuba sauran jinin a ƙasan bagade.
english: The priest shall take some of its blood with his finger, and put it on the horns of the altar of burnt offering; and the rest of its blood he shall pour out at the base of the altar.

hausa: Taimakonmu yana a sunan Ubangiji, Wanda ya yi sama da ƙasa.
english: Our help is in Yahweh’s name, who made heaven and earth.

hausa: Laban ya ba da baranyarsa Bilha wa ’yarsa Rahila ta zama mai hidimarta.
english: Laban gave Bilhah, his servant, to his daughter Rachel to be her servant.

hausa: “Ba ku san abin da ni da kuma kakannina suka yi wa dukan mutanen sauran ƙasashe ba? Allolin ƙasashen nan sun taɓa iya ceton ƙasarsu daga hannuna ne?
english: Don’t you know what I and my fathers have done to all the peoples of the lands? Were the gods of the nations of those lands in any way able to deliver their land out of my hand?

hausa: Wane ne ya taɓa yin haka ya kuma sa ya faru, yana kira ga tsararraki daga farko? Ni, Ubangiji ina can tun farkonsu ni kuma ina can har ƙarshe, Ni ne shi.”
english: Who has worked and done it, calling the generations from the beginning? I, Yahweh, the first, and with the last, I am he.”

hausa: “Ku kiyaye waɗannan dokokin a matsayin dawwammamiyar farilla, da ku da ’ya’yanku har abada.
english: You shall observe this thing for an ordinance to you and to your sons forever.

hausa: Yanzu ina roƙonku ku rantse mini da Ubangiji cewa za ku yi wa iyalina alheri kamar yadda na yi muku alheri. Ku ba ni ƙwaƙƙwarar shaida cewa
english: Now therefore, please swear to me by Yahweh, since I have dealt kindly with you, that you also will deal kindly with my father’s house, and give me a true sign;

hausa: “ ‘Kada ku ci wani abinci tare da jini a cikinsa. “ ‘Kada ku yi duba ko sihiri.
english: “‘You shall not eat any meat with the blood still in it. You shall not use enchantments, nor practice sorcery.

hausa: Amma sa’ad da kuka shiga garin, kuma ba a karɓe ku ba, ku bi titi-titi ku ce,
english: But into whatever city you enter and they don’t receive you, go out into its streets and say,

hausa: ’Ya’yan Nuhu maza, waɗanda suka fito daga cikin jirgi, su ne, Shem, Ham da Yafet. (Ham shi ne mahaifin Kan’ana.)
english: The sons of Noah who went out from the ship were Shem, Ham, and Japheth. Ham is the father of Canaan.

hausa: Gama asu za su cinye su kamar riga; tsutsotsi za su cinye su kamar ulu. Amma adalcina zai dawwama har abada, cetona har dukan zamanai.”
english: For the moth will eat them up like a garment, and the worm will eat them like wool; but my righteousness will be forever, and my salvation to all generations.”

hausa: Suka yi rantsuwa ga Ubangiji da babbar murya, da ihu da garayu da ƙahoni.
english: They swore to Yahweh with a loud voice, with shouting, with trumpets, and with cornets.

hausa: Saboda haka dukan rijiyoyin da bayin mahaifinsa suka haƙa a kwanakin da mahaifinsa Ibrahim yake da rai, Filistiyawa sun toshe su, suka kuma ciccike su da ƙasa.
english: Now all the wells which his father’s servants had dug in the days of Abraham his father, the Philistines had stopped, and filled with earth.

hausa: Amma Laban ya ce masa, “In na sami tagomashi daga gare ka, ina roƙonka ka zauna. Na gane ta wurin duba cewaUbangiji ya albarkace ni saboda kai.”
english: Laban said to him, “If now I have found favor in your eyes, stay here, for I have divined that Yahweh has blessed me for your sake.”

hausa: Kada ku bugu da ruwan inabi, wanda yake kai ga lalaci. A maimako haka, ku cika da Ruhu.
english: Don’t be drunken with wine, in which is dissipation, but be filled with the Spirit,

hausa: Ku gaggauta, dukanku al’ummai daga kowane ɓangare, ku tattaru a can. Ka sauko da mayaƙanka, ya Ubangiji!
english: Hurry and come, all you surrounding nations, and gather yourselves together.” Cause your mighty ones to come down there, Yahweh.

hausa: Gama Yesu ya riga ya ce masa, “Ka fita daga jikin mutumin nan, kai mugun ruhu!”
english: For he said to him, “Come out of the man, you unclean spirit!”

hausa: Ya mutu saboda mu domin, ko muna a faɗake ko muna barci, mu kasance tare da shi.
english: who died for us, that, whether we wake or sleep, we should live together with him.

hausa: Don mai bi da kaɗe-kaɗe. Da muryar “Kada Ka Hallaka.” Ta Dawuda. Wani miktam. Sa’ad da ya gudu daga Shawulu zuwa cikin kogo. Ka yi mini jinƙai, ya Allah, ka yi mini jinƙai, gama a gare ka raina yake samun mafaka. Zan sami mafaka a inuwar fikafikanka sai masifar ta wuce.
english: For the Chief Musician. To the tune of “Do Not Destroy.” A poem by David, when he fled from Saul, in the cave. Be merciful to me, God, be merciful to me, for my soul takes refuge in you. Yes, in the shadow of your wings, I will take refuge, until disaster has passed.

hausa: Sai Musa ya koma ya aika a kira dukan dattawan mutane, ya bayyana dukan kalmomin da Ubangiji ya umarta, ya faɗa.
english: Moses came and called for the elders of the people, and set before them all these words which Yahweh commanded him.

hausa: in ’ya’yanka maza za su kiyaye alkawari da farillan da na koya musu, to ’ya’yansu maza za su zauna a kan kursiyinka har abada abadin.”
english: If your children will keep my covenant, my testimony that I will teach them, their children also will sit on your throne forever more.”

hausa: Duba ko akwai wani laifi a cikina, ka bishe ni a madawwamiyar hanya.
english: See if there is any wicked way in me, and lead me in the everlasting way.

hausa: Suka ci birnin da yaƙi, suka karkashe mazaunanta, da sarkin, har da ƙauyukan, ba wanda ya tsira kamar yadda ya yi wa Eglon. Ya hallakar da ita sarai duk da kowane mutum da yake cikinta.
english: They took it, and struck it with the edge of the sword, with its king and all its cities, and all the souls who were in it. He left no one remaining, according to all that he had done to Eglon; but he utterly destroyed it, and all the souls who were in it.

hausa: daga zuriyar Beriya kuwa, daga Heber, kabilar Heberawa; daga Malkiyel, kabilar Malkiyelawa.
english: Of the sons of Beriah: of Heber, the family of the Heberites; of Malchiel, the family of the Malchielites.

hausa: Inda za ki mutu zan mutu, zan mutu a can kuma za a binne ni. Bari Ubangiji ya hukunta ni da tsanani sosai, in wani abu in ba mutuwa ce ta raba ke da ni ba.”
english: Where you die, I will die, and there I will be buried. May Yahweh do so to me, and more also, if anything but death parts you and me.”

hausa: Za su iya la’anta, amma kai za ka sa albarka; sa’ad da suka tasar za su sha kunya, amma bawanka zai yi farin ciki.
english: They may curse, but you bless. When they arise, they will be shamed, but your servant shall rejoice.

hausa: Ko da yake ba ni da laifi, ba zan iya amsa masa ba; sai dai roƙon jinƙai zan iya yi ga mahukuncina.
english: Though I were righteous, yet I wouldn’t answer him. I would make supplication to my judge.

hausa: Ka yi iyakacin ƙoƙarinka ka gabatar da kanka a gaban Allah a matsayin wanda aka amince da shi, ma’aikaci wanda ba shi da dalilin jin kunya wanda kuma yake fassara kalmar gaskiya daidai.
english: Give diligence to present yourself approved by God, a workman who doesn’t need to be ashamed, properly handling the Word of Truth.

hausa: da Koz. Koz ne mahaifin Anub da Hazzobeba, shi ne kuma kakan iyalin da suka fito daga zuriyar Aharhel ɗan Harum.
english: Hakkoz became the father of Anub, Zobebah, and the families of Aharhel the son of Harum.

hausa: in ba haka ba in Ubangiji ya gani ba zai amince ba ya kuma juye fushinsa daga gare shi.
english: lest Yahweh see it, and it displease him, and he turn away his wrath from him.

hausa: Sai ya yi tambaya, “Waɗanne abubuwa?” Suka amsa suka ce, “Game da Yesu Banazare. Shi annabi ne, mai iko ne kuma cikin ayyukansa da maganarsa, a gaban Allah da kuma dukan mutane.
english: He said to them, “What things?” They said to him, “The things concerning Jesus the Nazarene, who was a prophet mighty in deed and word before God and all the people;

hausa: Amma Neko ya aiki ’yan saƙo ga Yosiya, yana cewa, “Me ya gama ni da kai, ya Sarkin Yahuda? Ban zo in yi yaƙi da kai ba. Na zo ne in yi yaƙi da gidan da yake gāba da ni! Ka ƙyale ni! Allah ne ya riga ya faɗa mini in hanzarta. Kada ka yi gāba da Allah, wanda yake tare da ni, don kada yă hallaka ka.”
english: But he sent ambassadors to him, saying, “What have I to do with you, you king of Judah? I come not against you today, but against the house with which I have war. God has commanded me to make haste. Beware that it is God who is with me, that he not destroy you.”

hausa: Ruwayen Nimrim sun ƙafe ciyayin kuma sun bushe; tsire-tsire duk sun ɓace babu sauran ɗanyen abu.
english: For the waters of Nimrim will be desolate; for the grass has withered away, the tender grass fails, there is no green thing.

hausa: Da idanunku, kun ga abin da Ubangiji ya yi a Ba’al-Feyor. Yadda Ubangiji Allahnku ya hallaka waɗansu daga cikinku waɗanda suka yi wa Ba’al-Feyor sujada,
english: Your eyes have seen what Yahweh did because of Baal Peor; for Yahweh your God has destroyed all the men who followed Baal Peor from among you.

hausa: Ya zo wajen rago mai ƙahoni biyu ɗin nan da na riga na gani tsaye a gefen mashigin kogin nan ya tasar masa da fushi mai zafi.
english: He came to the ram that had the two horns, which I saw standing before the river, and ran on him in the fury of his power.

hausa: Ba zai yi ta zargi ba ba kuwa zai yi ta jin fushi har abada ba;
english: He will not always accuse; neither will he stay angry forever.

hausa: Saboda haka ya mayar da azurfan wa mahaifiyarsa, ita kuwa ta ɗauki azurfa ɗari biyu na shekel ta ba wa maƙeri, wanda ya mai da su sura da kuma gunki. Aka kuwa sa su a gidan Mika.
english: When he restored the money to his mother, his mother took two hundred pieces of silver, and gave them to a silversmith, who made a carved image and a molten image out of it. It was in the house of Micah.

hausa: Na san alfarmanta amma a banza ne,” in ji Ubangiji, “kuma taƙamarta ba ya cimma kome.
english: I know his wrath,” says Yahweh, “that it is nothing; his boastings have done nothing.

hausa: Kada ku gwada musu azaba, amma ku ji tsoron Allahnku.
english: You shall not rule over him with harshness, but shall fear your God.

hausa: Sa’an nan suka danƙa su ga mutanen da aka naɗa su lura da aiki a kan haikalin Ubangiji. Waɗannan mutane ne suke biyan ma’aikatan da suka gyara suka kuma mai da haikalin.
english: They delivered it into the hands of the workmen who had the oversight of Yahweh’s house; and the workmen who labored in Yahweh’s house gave it to mend and repair the house.

hausa: Kuma cikin rikicewana na ce, “Dukan mutane maƙaryata ne.”
english: I said in my haste, “All people are liars.”

hausa: Zilfa baranyar Liyatu ta haifa wa Yaƙub ɗa na biyu.
english: Zilpah, Leah’s servant, bore Jacob a second son.

hausa: Ku yi shiru, ku mutanen tsibiri da ku ’yan kasuwan Sidon waɗanda masu ciniki a teku suka azurta.
english: Be still, you inhabitants of the coast, you whom the merchants of Sidon that pass over the sea have replenished.
