hausa: Za a binne shi kamar jaki za a ja shi a ƙasa a jefar a bayan ƙofofin Urushalima.”
english: He will be buried with the burial of a donkey, drawn and cast out beyond the gates of Jerusalem.”

hausa: Ramot da Anem, tare da wuraren kiwonsu;
english: Ramoth with its pasture lands, and Anem with its pasture lands;

hausa: Ku yi godiya ga Allahn alloli. Ƙaunarsa madawwamiya ce.
english: Give thanks to the God of gods, for his loving kindness endures forever.

hausa: Ka kawo mu cikin kurkuku ka kuma jibga kaya masu nauyi a bayanmu.
english: You brought us into prison. You laid a burden on our backs.

hausa: Da yake za su yi kwanaki da dama a can, sai Festus ya tattauna batun Bulus da sarki. Ya ce, “Akwai mutumin da Felis ya bari a daure.
english: As he stayed there many days, Festus laid Paul’s case before the king, saying, “There is a certain man left a prisoner by Felix;

hausa: Duk wanda aka haifa ta wurin cikin shege, har tsara ta goma, zuriyarsa ba za su shiga taron jama’ar Ubangiji ba, har zuwa tsara ta goma.
english: A person born of a forbidden union shall not enter into Yahweh’s assembly; even to the tenth generation shall no one of his enter into Yahweh’s assembly.

hausa: Ka tuna ka ɗaukaka aikinsa, waɗanda mutane suka yaba a cikin waƙa.
english: “Remember that you magnify his work, about which men have sung.

hausa: Amma yanzu, ranka yă daɗe, sarkina, ka saurara. Bari in kawo kukata a gabanka. Kada ka mai da ni gidan Yonatan magatakarda, in ba haka zan mutu a can.”
english: Now please hear, my lord the king: please let my supplication be presented before you, that you not cause me to return to the house of Jonathan the scribe, lest I die there.”

hausa: Duk mai kunnen ji, yă ji abin da Ruhu yake faɗa wa ikkilisiyoyi.”
english: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the assemblies.”

hausa: Masu aikata mugunta za su taɓa koyo. Suna cin mutane yadda mutane ke cin gurasa kuma waɗanda ba sa kira bisa Ubangiji?
english: Have all the workers of iniquity no knowledge, who eat up my people as they eat bread, and don’t call on Yahweh?

hausa: Suka sa kayan yaƙinsa a haikalin allahnsu suka kuma rataye kansa a haikalin Dagon.
english: They put his armor in the house of their gods, and fastened his head in the house of Dagon.

hausa: ya yi kwanonin zinariya zalla, hantsuka, kwanonin yayyafawa, kwanoni, da kuma farantan wuta; ya yi wurin ajiye fitila na zinariya domin ƙofofi na ɗakin can ciki-ciki, da na ƙofofin Wuri Mafi Tsarki, da kuma domin ƙofofin babban zauren haikali.
english: the cups, the snuffers, the basins, the spoons, and the fire pans, of pure gold; and the hinges, both for the doors of the inner house, the most holy place, and for the doors of the house, of the temple, of gold.

hausa: Yehowash sarkin Isra’ila ya kama Amaziya sarkin Yahuda, ɗan Yowash, ɗan Ahaziya a Bet-Shemesh. Sa’an nan Yehowash ya kawo shi Urushalima ya farfasa katangar Urushalima daga Ƙofar Efraim har zuwa Ƙofar Kusurwa, wani sashe mai tsawon ƙafa ɗari shida.
english: Joash king of Israel took Amaziah king of Judah, the son of Joash the son of Jehoahaz, at Beth Shemesh and brought him to Jerusalem, and broke down the wall of Jerusalem from the gate of Ephraim to the corner gate, four hundred cubits.

hausa: Rundunar hallaka suna aiki a cikin birni; barazana da ƙarairayi ba sa taɓa barin titunanta.
english: Destructive forces are within her. Threats and lies don’t depart from her streets.

hausa: Ya kuma ce, “Zo, mu yi ƙoƙari mu kai Gibeya ko Rama mu kwana a ɗaya cikinsu.”
english: He said to his servant, “Come and let’s draw near to one of these places; and we will lodge in Gibeah, or in Ramah.”

hausa: Sai Sarki Dawuda ya shiga ya zauna a gaban Ubangiji ya ce, “Wane ne ni, ya Ubangiji Allah, kuma wane ne iyalina, da ka kawo ni har zuwa nan?
english: Then David the king went in and sat before Yahweh; and he said, “Who am I, Yahweh God, and what is my house, that you have brought me this far?

hausa: Suka yi abin ɗamara da lallausan lilin da shuɗi, shunayya da jan zare, aikin gwanin mai ɗinki, yadda Ubangiji ya umarci Musa.
english: the sash of fine twined linen, blue, purple, and scarlet, the work of the embroiderer, as Yahweh commanded Moses.

hausa: Sai sarkin ya yi fushi. Ya aiki mayaƙansa suka karkashe masu kisankan nan, aka kuma ƙone birninsu.
english: When the king heard that, he was angry, and sent his armies, destroyed those murderers, and burned their city.

hausa: Ta wurin aikinsu za ku gane su. Mutane suna iya tsinkan inabi a jikin ƙaya, ko kuwa ɓaure a jikin sarƙaƙƙiya?
english: By their fruits you will know them. Do you gather grapes from thorns or figs from thistles?

hausa: Saboda haka Farisiyawa suka ce wa juna, “Duba, wannan ba ya kai mu ko’ina. Ga shi, duk duniya tana bin sa!”
english: The Pharisees therefore said among themselves, “See how you accomplish nothing. Behold, the world has gone after him.”

hausa: “Duk wanda ya taɓa gawa, zai kasance da ƙazanta har kwana bakwai.
english: “He who touches the dead body of any man shall be unclean seven days.

hausa: In ta haifi ’ya ta mace ce, makoni biyu macen za tă ƙazantu kamar yadda takan kasance a lokacin al’adarta. Sa’an nan dole tă jira kwana sittin don a tsabtacce ta daga zub da jininta.
english: But if she bears a female child, then she shall be unclean two weeks, as in her period; and she shall continue in the blood of purification sixty-six days.

hausa: Na jira sa’ad da kuke magana, na ji muhawwararku lokacin da kuke neman abin da za ku faɗa,
english: “Behold, I waited for your words, and I listened for your reasoning, while you searched out what to say.

hausa: Za a sayi filaye da azurfa, a kuma sa hannu a takardan ciniki, a liƙe a kuma shaida a yankin Benyamin, a ƙauyukan kewayen Urushalima, a garuruwan Yahuda da kuma a garuruwan ƙasar tudu, na yammancin gindin dutse da na Negeb, domin zan maido da wadatarsu, in ji Ubangiji.”
english: Men will buy fields for money, sign the deeds, seal them, and call witnesses, in the land of Benjamin, and in the places around Jerusalem, in the cities of Judah, in the cities of the hill country, in the cities of the lowland, and in the cities of the South; for I will cause their captivity to be reversed,” says Yahweh.

hausa: “A cikin irin tafiye-tafiyen nan ne ina kan hanya zuwa Damaskus tare da izini daga manyan firistoci.
english: “Whereupon as I traveled to Damascus with the authority and commission from the chief priests,

hausa: Iliya ya ɗauki yaron ya sauko da shi daga ɗakin sama zuwa cikin gida. Ya ba da shi ga mahaifiyarsa, ya ce, “Duba, ɗanki yana da rai!”
english: Elijah took the child and brought him down out of the room into the house, and delivered him to his mother; and Elijah said, “Behold, your son lives.”

hausa: Sai ya ce wa almajiransa, “Girbi yana da yawa, amma ma’aikata kaɗan ne.
english: Then he said to his disciples, “The harvest indeed is plentiful, but the laborers are few.

hausa: da ƙaramin bijimi guda ɗaya, tunkiya ɗaya, da rago, dukansu bana ɗaya-ɗaya domin hadaya ta ƙonawa;
english: one young bull, one ram, one male lamb a year old, for a burnt offering;

hausa: Solomon kuwa ya zauna a kan kujerar sarautar mahaifinsa Dawuda, mulkinsa kuwa ya kahu sosai.
english: Solomon sat on David his father’s throne; and his kingdom was firmly established.

hausa: Daga zuriyar Naftali. Aka rubuta sunayen dukan maza ɗaya-ɗaya da suka kai shekara ashirin ko fiye da suka isa shiga soja, bisa ga iyalansu da kabilarsu da take a rubuce.
english: Of the children of Naphtali, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war:

hausa: In kuma ba ku iya ba ni amsar ba, dole ku ba ni rigunan lilin talatin da tufafi talatin.” Suka ce, “Ka gaya mana kacici-kacicin.”
english: but if you can’t tell me the answer, then you shall give me thirty linen garments and thirty changes of clothing.” They said to him, “Tell us your riddle, that we may hear it.”

hausa: (Amma ta kai su saman rufin ɗaki ta ɓoye su a ƙarƙashin karan rama da ta baza a rufin ɗaki.)
english: But she had brought them up to the roof, and hidden them under the stalks of flax which she had laid in order on the roof.

hausa: Waɗannan alamu za su kasance tare da waɗanda suka gaskata. A cikin sunana za su fitar da aljanu, za su yi magana da sababbin harsuna.
english: These signs will accompany those who believe: in my name they will cast out demons; they will speak with new languages;

hausa: saboda haka ga abin da Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka yana cewa zan miƙa hannuna a kan Edom in kashe mutanenta da dabbobinsu. Zan sa ta zama kufai, kuma tun daga Teman har zuwa Dedan za a kashe su da takobi.
english: therefore the Lord Yahweh says, “I will stretch out my hand on Edom, and will cut off man and animal from it; and I will make it desolate from Teman. They will fall by the sword even to Dedan.

hausa: Sau bakwai a rana ina yabonka saboda dokokinka masu adalci.
english: Seven times a day, I praise you, because of your righteous ordinances.

hausa: Kada ka cika yin adalci, fiye da kima, kada kuma ka cika yin hikima, don me za ka hallaka kanka!
english: Don’t be overly righteous, neither make yourself overly wise. Why should you destroy yourself?

hausa: Ahab fa ya faɗa wa Yezebel kome da Iliya ya yi, da yadda ya karkashe dukan annabawan da takobi.
english: Ahab told Jezebel all that Elijah had done, and how he had killed all the prophets with the sword.

hausa: Ka kula da alkawarinka, domin akwai tashin hankali a kowane lungu mai duhu na ƙasar.
english: Honor your covenant, for haunts of violence fill the dark places of the earth.

hausa: Ya gane makircinsu, sai ya ce musu,
english: But he perceived their craftiness, and said to them, “Why do you test me?

hausa: Saboda haka babu wanda Allah zai ce da shi mai adalci ta wurin kiyaye doka kawai; a maimako, ta wurin doka ne muke sane da zunubi.
english: Because by the works of the law, no flesh will be justified in his sight; for through the law comes the knowledge of sin.

hausa: “Ga abin da Ubangiji, Maɗaukaki, Allah na Isra’ila, yana cewa ka tafi ka faɗa wa mutanen Yahuda da kuma mutanen Urushalima cewa, ‘Ba za ku koyi darasi ku kuma yi biyayya da maganata ba?’ In ji Ubangiji.
english: “Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel, says: ‘Go and tell the men of Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem, “Will you not receive instruction to listen to my words?” says Yahweh.

hausa: A wannan rana mata guda bakwai za su cafke namiji guda su ce, “Ma ciyar da kanmu mu kuma yi wa kanmu sutura; ka dai bari mu ce kai ne mijinmu. Ka ɗauke mana kunyar da za mu sha.”
english: Seven women shall take hold of one man in that day, saying, “We will eat our own bread, and wear our own clothing. Just let us be called by your name. Take away our reproach.”

hausa: don su miƙa hadayun ƙonawa ga Ubangiji a kan bagaden hadaya ta ƙonawa kullum, da safe da kuma yamma, bisa ga kome da yake a rubutacce a cikin Dokar Ubangiji, da ya ba wa Isra’ila.
english: to offer burnt offerings to Yahweh on the altar of burnt offering continually morning and evening, even according to all that is written in Yahweh’s law, which he commanded to Israel;

hausa: Bayansu, sai ga waɗansu kawuna bakwai suka fito, yanƙwananne sirara waɗanda iskar gabas ta yanƙwane.
english: and behold, seven heads of grain, withered, thin, and blasted with the east wind, sprung up after them.

hausa: Ka bishe ni da shawararka, bayan haka kuma za ka kai ni cikin ɗaukaka.
english: You will guide me with your counsel, and afterward receive me to glory.

hausa: Yaƙub ya amsa wa Laban, “Na ji tsoro ne, domin na yi tsammani za ka ƙwace ’ya’yanka mata daga gare ni ƙarfi da yaji.
english: Jacob answered Laban, “Because I was afraid, for I said, ‘Lest you should take your daughters from me by force.’

hausa: “ ‘Amma in ba ku kori mazaunan ƙasar ba, waɗanda kuka bari su ci gaba da zama, za su zama muku hakki a idanunku, da kuma ƙayayyuwa a bayanku. Za su ba ku wahala a ƙasar da kuke zama.
english: “But if you do not drive out the inhabitants of the land from before you, then those you let remain of them will be like pricks in your eyes and thorns in your sides. They will harass you in the land in which you dwell.

hausa: amma in ya faru bayan wayewar gari, to, za a nemi alhakin jinin ɓarawon a hannun wanda ya bugi ɓarawon. “Ɓarawon da aka kama da abin da ya sata, dole yă yi cikakkiyar ramuwa, amma in ba shi da kome, dole a sayar da shi a biya abin da ya sata.
english: If the sun has risen on him, he is guilty of bloodshed. He shall make restitution. If he has nothing, then he shall be sold for his theft.

hausa: Kai da kake cewa wa mutane kada su yi zina, kana yin zina? Kai da kake ƙyamar gumaka, kana wa haikali fashi?
english: You who say a man shouldn’t commit adultery, do you commit adultery? You who abhor idols, do you rob temples?

hausa: Yana hana shugabannin duniya ganewa; Ya bar su su yi ta makuwa, su ruɗe, su ɓata.
english: He takes away understanding from the chiefs of the people of the earth, and causes them to wander in a wilderness where there is no way.

hausa: Zakoki sun yi ruri; sun yi masa ruri. Sun lalatar da ƙasarsa; an ƙone garuruwansa aka kuma watse daga ciki.
english: The young lions have roared at him and raised their voices. They have made his land waste. His cities are burned up, without inhabitant.

hausa: Amma idan wani mutum yana ƙin maƙwabcinsa, ya kuma yi kwanto yana fakonsa, ya yi masa rauni, har ya kashe shi, sa’an nan ya gudu zuwa ɗaya daga cikin waɗannan birane,
english: But if any man hates his neighbor, lies in wait for him, rises up against him, strikes him mortally so that he dies, and he flees into one of these cities;

hausa: Ka faɗa wa Isra’ilawa, ‘Wannan mai, zai zama mai tsarki ne a gare ni don shafewa, daga tsara zuwa tsara.
english: You shall speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘This shall be a holy anointing oil to me throughout your generations.

hausa: Sai Yehoyahaz ya nemi tagomashin Ubangiji, Ubangiji kuwa ya saurare shi, domin ya gan irin matsin da sarkin Aram yake yi wa Isra’ila.
english: Jehoahaz begged Yahweh, and Yahweh listened to him; for he saw the oppression of Israel, how the king of Syria oppressed them.

hausa: Ko da yake wani mutum yana fafaranka domin yă kashe ka, Ubangiji Allahnka zai kiyaye ranka. Amma za a wurgar da rayukan maƙiyanka kamar yadda ake wurga dutsen majajjawa.
english: Though men may rise up to pursue you and to seek your soul, yet the soul of my lord will be bound in the bundle of life with Yahweh your God. He will sling out the souls of your enemies as from a sling’s pocket.

hausa: Ba wata hadayar da za a yi don mutanen da suka yanke shawara su yi ci gaba da yin zunubi da gangan bayan sun sami sanin gaskiya.
english: For if we sin willfully after we have received the knowledge of the truth, there remains no more a sacrifice for sins,

hausa: Mika’ilu, Isfa da Yoha su ne ’ya’yan Beriya maza.
english: Michael, Ishpah, Joha, the sons of Beriah,

hausa: Matsaran ƙofofi su ne, Shallum, Akkub, Talmon, Ahiman da ’yan’uwansu. Shallum ne babbansu
english: The gatekeepers: Shallum, Akkub, Talmon, Ahiman, and their brothers (Shallum was the chief),

hausa: “To, yanzu fa, ki kasa kunne, ke mai ƙaunar nishaɗi, mai zama da rai kwance kina kuma ce wa kanki, ‘Ni ce, kuma babu wani in ban da ni. Ba zan taɓa zama gwauruwa ko in sha wahalar rashin ’ya’ya ba.’
english: “Now therefore hear this, you who are given to pleasures, who sit securely, who say in your heart, ‘I am, and there is no one else besides me. I won’t sit as a widow, neither will I know the loss of children.’

hausa: Wannan burodin zai zama na Haruna da ’ya’yansa maza, waɗanda za su ci a tsattsarkan wuri, gama sashe ne mafi tsarki na rabonsu na kullum na hadayar da aka yi da wuta ga Ubangiji.”
english: It shall be for Aaron and his sons. They shall eat it in a holy place; for it is most holy to him of the offerings of Yahweh made by fire by a perpetual statute.”

hausa: gama ta wurin hadayan nan guda ɗaya ya kammala har abada waɗanda ake tsarkake.
english: For by one offering he has perfected forever those who are being sanctified.

hausa: Sai Yoshuwa ya koma sansanin Gilgal tare da dukan Isra’ilawa.
english: Joshua returned, and all Israel with him, to the camp to Gilgal.

hausa: Kowa ya san cewa Ubangijinmu ya fito ne daga zuriyar Yahuda ne, kuma Musa bai taɓa ce firistoci za su fito daga wannan kabila ba.
english: For it is evident that our Lord has sprung out of Judah, about which tribe Moses spoke nothing concerning priesthood.

hausa: A gefen yamma, wanda yake da tsawon kamun 4,500, zai kasance da ƙofofi uku, ƙofar Gad, ƙofar Asher da kuma ƙofar Naftali.
english: “At the west side four thousand five hundred reeds, with their three gates: the gate of Gad, one; the gate of Asher, one; the gate of Naphtali, one.

hausa: Saboda haka fushin Ubangiji ya yi ƙuna a kan mutanensa; ya ɗaga hannunsa ya kuma buge su. Duwatsu sun jijjigu, gawawwaki kuwa suka zama kamar juji a tituna. Saboda wannan duka, fushinsa bai huce ba, bai kuwa janye hannunsa ba.
english: Therefore Yahweh’s anger burns against his people, and he has stretched out his hand against them and has struck them. The mountains tremble, and their dead bodies are as refuse in the middle of the streets. For all this, his anger is not turned away, but his hand is still stretched out.

hausa: Yayinda suke kisan sai aka bar ni kaɗai, na fāɗi rubda ciki, na yi kuka na ce, “Kash, Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka! Za ka hallaka dukan raguwar Isra’ila a wannan zafin fushinka a Urushalima?”
english: While they were killing, and I was left, I fell on my face, and cried, and said, “Ah Lord Yahweh! Will you destroy all the residue of Israel in your pouring out of your wrath on Jerusalem?”

hausa: saboda ba’ar waɗanda suke zagi suke kuma ƙina, saboda abokan gābana, waɗanda suka sha alwashi sai sun yi ramuwa.
english: at the taunt of one who reproaches and verbally abuses, because of the enemy and the avenger.

hausa: Ka sa bagaden zinariya na ƙona turare a gaban akwatin Alkawari, ka kuma sa labule a ƙofar shiga tabanakul.
english: You shall set the golden altar for incense before the ark of the covenant, and put the screen of the door to the tabernacle.

hausa: da kuma daga Heshbon zuwa Ramat Mizfa da Betonim, da kuma daga Mahanayim zuwa sashen Debir,
english: and from Heshbon to Ramath Mizpeh, and Betonim; and from Mahanaim to the border of Debir;

hausa: Sai Yehu ya sāke rubuta musu wasiƙa ta biyu, ya ce, “In a gefena kuke, to, sai ku yi biyayya da ni, ku fille kawunan ’ya’yan maigidanku, ku kawo mini a Yezireyel war haka gobe.” To, ’ya’yan sarki, su saba’in, suna tare da manyan birni waɗanda suke lura da su.
english: Then he wrote a letter the second time to them, saying, “If you are on my side, and if you will listen to my voice, take the heads of the men who are your master’s sons, and come to me to Jezreel by tomorrow this time.” Now the king’s sons, being seventy persons, were with the great men of the city, who brought them up.

hausa: A rana ta biyar, Shelumiyel ɗan Zurishaddai, shugaban mutanen Simeyon, ya kawo hadayarsa.
english: On the fifth day Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai, prince of the children of Simeon,

hausa: Ruhun Ubangiji zai kasance a kansa, Ruhun hikima da na fahimta, Ruhun shawara da na iko, Ruhun sani da na tsoron Ubangiji,
english: Yahweh’s Spirit will rest on him: the spirit of wisdom and understanding, the spirit of counsel and might, the spirit of knowledge and of the fear of Yahweh.

hausa: To, Yesu kansa yana da shekaru kusan talatin da haihuwa sa’ad da ya fara aikinsa. An ɗauka shi ɗan Yusuf ne, ɗan Heli,
english: Jesus himself, when he began to teach, was about thirty years old, being the son (as was supposed) of Joseph, the son of Heli,

hausa: Mace mai hikima kan gina gidanta, amma da hannunta wawiya takan rushe shi ƙasa.
english: Every wise woman builds her house, but the foolish one tears it down with her own hands.

hausa: Mai Fansarmu, Ubangiji Maɗaukaki shi ne sunansa, shi ne Mai Tsarkin nan na Isra’ila.
english: Our Redeemer, Yahweh of Armies is his name, is the Holy One of Israel.

hausa: Daga cikin haikalin mala’iku bakwai tare da annobai bakwai suka fito. Suna saye da tufafin lilin masu tsabta masu walƙiya, suna kuma saye da ɗamarar zinariya a ƙirjinsu.
english: The seven angels who had the seven plagues came out, clothed with pure, bright linen, and wearing golden sashes around their chests.

hausa: Sai sarki ya aika aka kira masa Ahimelek firist ɗan Ahitub da dukan iyalin mahaifinsa. Dukansu suka zo wurin sarki.
english: Then the king sent to call Ahimelech the priest, the son of Ahitub, and all his father’s house, the priests who were in Nob; and they all came to the king.

hausa: Saboda haka Isra’ilawa suka tuttuɓe kayan adonsu a Dutsen Horeb.
english: The children of Israel stripped themselves of their jewelry from Mount Horeb onward.

hausa: Amma ga mugaye, Allah ya ce, “Wace dama ce kuke da ita na haddace dokokina ko na yin maganar alkawarina a leɓunanku?
english: But to the wicked God says, “What right do you have to declare my statutes, that you have taken my covenant on your lips,

hausa: A zamanin Sarki Yosiya, Ubangiji ya ce mini, “Ka ga abin da marar amincin nan, Isra’ila ta yi? Ta haura kan kowane tudu mai tsayi da kowane gindin itace mai duhuwa ta yi zina a can.
english: Moreover, Yahweh said to me in the days of Josiah the king, “Have you seen that which backsliding Israel has done? She has gone up on every high mountain and under every green tree, and has played the prostitute there.

hausa: Sai Nuhu ya gina bagaden hadaya ga Ubangiji, ya ɗiba waɗansu dabbobi da tsuntsaye masu tsabta, ya yi hadaya ta ƙonawa da su a kan bagaden.
english: Noah built an altar to Yahweh, and took of every clean animal, and of every clean bird, and offered burnt offerings on the altar.

hausa: Aka kashe kashi ɗaya bisa uku na ’yan Adam da annobai uku na wuta, hayaƙi da farar wuta da suka fito daga bakunansu.
english: By these three plagues, one third of mankind was killed: by the fire, the smoke, and the sulfur, which proceeded out of their mouths.

hausa: Waƙa ce. Zabura ta Dawuda. Zuciyata tsayayyiya ce, ya Allah; zan rera in kuma yi kiɗi da dukan raina.
english: A Song. A Psalm by David. My heart is steadfast, God. I will sing and I will make music with my soul.

hausa: “Yanzu na san cewa ba ko ɗaya daga cikinku wanda na zazzaga ina muku wa’azin mulkin Allah da zai sāke ganina.
english: “Now, behold, I know that you all, among whom I went about preaching God’s Kingdom, will see my face no more.

hausa: amma za a fid da mugaye daga ƙasar, za a tumɓuke marasa aminci kuma daga gare ta.
english: But the wicked will be cut off from the land. The treacherous will be rooted out of it.

hausa: “Ɗan mutum, da me itacen kuringa ya fi reshen waɗansu itatuwa kyau a cikin kurmi?
english: “Son of man, what is the vine tree more than any tree, the vine branch which is among the trees of the forest?

hausa: Gatari ya taɓa fin wanda yake amfani da shi girma, ko zarto yă yi wa wanda yake amfani da shi taƙama? Sanda za tă girgiza mutumin da yake riƙe da ita, ko kuwa kulki yă jijjiga mutumin da yake riƙe da katako!
english: Should an ax brag against him who chops with it? Should a saw exalt itself above him who saws with it? As if a rod should lift those who lift it up, or as if a staff should lift up someone who is not wood.

hausa: Ƙofofinta sun nutse a cikin ƙasa; ya kakkarya ƙarafanta. Sarakunanta da ’ya’yan sarakunanta duk an kai su bauta cikin waɗansu ƙasashe, babu sauran doka, annabawa kuma ba su samun wahayi daga wurin Ubangiji.
english: Her gates have sunk into the ground. He has destroyed and broken her bars. Her king and her princes are among the nations where the law is not. Yes, her prophets find no vision from Yahweh.

hausa: Shi da yake yi wa al’ummai horo ba ya hukunci ne? Shi da yake koya wa mutum ba shi da sani ne?
english: He who disciplines the nations, won’t he punish? He who teaches man knows.

hausa: Duk lokacin da suka shiga Tentin Sujada, za su yi wanka, don kada su mutu. Duk lokacin da suka yi kusa da bagade don hidima ta miƙa hadayar da aka yi wa Ubangiji da wuta,
english: When they go into the Tent of Meeting, they shall wash with water, that they don’t die; or when they come near to the altar to minister, to burn an offering made by fire to Yahweh.

hausa: Amma Farisiyawa da malaman Doka suka fusata, suka fara tattauna da junansu a kan abin da za su yi wa Yesu.
english: But they were filled with rage, and talked with one another about what they might do to Jesus.

hausa: Bulus, Sila da Timoti, Zuwa ga ikkilisiyar Tessalonikawa ta Allah Uba da Ubangiji Yesu Kiristi. Alheri da salama su kasance tare da ku.
english: Paul, Silvanus, and Timothy, to the assembly of the Thessalonians in God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

hausa: Ya gane shi, sai ya ce, “Rigar ɗana ne! Waɗansu mugayen namun jeji sun cinye shi. Tabbatacce an yayyaga Yusuf.”
english: He recognized it, and said, “It is my son’s tunic. An evil animal has devoured him. Joseph is without doubt torn in pieces.”

hausa: Ta wurin bangaskiya Habila ya miƙa wa Allah hadayar da ta fi wadda Kayinu ya miƙa. Ta wurin bangaskiya aka yabe shi cewa shi mai adalci ne, sa’ad da Allah ya yi magana mai kyau game da bayarwarsa. Ta wurin bangaskiya kuma har yanzu yana magana, ko da yake ya riga ya mutu.
english: By faith Abel offered to God a more excellent sacrifice than Cain, through which he had testimony given to him that he was righteous, God testifying with respect to his gifts; and through it he, being dead, still speaks.

hausa: Suka amsa, “Mun ga a zahiri cewa Ubangiji yana tare da kai; saboda haka muka ce, ‘Dole rantsuwa ta kasance tsakaninmu da kai.’ Bari mu yi yarjejjeniya da kai
english: They said, “We saw plainly that Yahweh was with you. We said, ‘Let there now be an oath between us, even between us and you, and let’s make a covenant with you,

hausa: Za a washe dukiyarsu, a rurrushe gidajensu. Za su gina gidaje amma ba za su zauna a ciki ba; za su shuka inabi amma ba za su sha ruwansa ba.”
english: Their wealth will become a plunder, and their houses a desolation. Yes, they will build houses, but won’t inhabit them. They will plant vineyards, but won’t drink their wine.

hausa: Sai ya ce, “To da kyau, zan bari ka gasa burodin a kan kashin shanu a maimakon najasar mutane.”
english: Then he said to me, “Behold, I have given you cow’s dung for man’s dung, and you shall prepare your bread on it.”

hausa: to, sai waɗanda suke cikin Yahudiya, su gudu zuwa cikin duwatsu.
english: then let those who are in Judea flee to the mountains.

hausa: Ku bi halin ƙauna kuna kuma marmarin neman baye-bayen ruhaniya, musamman baiwar annabci.
english: Follow after love and earnestly desire spiritual gifts, but especially that you may prophesy.

hausa: Zaki yakan yi ruri a jeji in bai sami kama nama ba? Zai yi gurnani a cikin kogonsa in bai kama kome ba?
english: Will a lion roar in the thicket, when he has no prey? Does a young lion cry out of his den, if he has caught nothing?

hausa: da gangaren kwaruruka, wanda ya nausa zuwa garin Ar, ya kuma dangana da kan iyakar Mowab.”
english: the slope of the valleys that incline toward the dwelling of Ar, leans on the border of Moab.”

hausa: Dawuda ya ce wa Bafilistin, “Kana zuwa ka yaƙe ni da māshi da takobi da kere, amma ni ina zuwa in yaƙe ka a cikin sunan Ubangiji Maɗaukaki, Allah na rundunar Isra’ila, wanda ka rena.
english: Then David said to the Philistine, “You come to me with a sword, with a spear, and with a javelin; but I come to you in the name of Yahweh of Armies, the God of the armies of Israel, whom you have defied.

hausa: Zan lalatar da inabinta da kuma itatuwan ɓaurenta, waɗanda take cewa su ne abin da kwartayenta suka biya; zan mayar da su kurmi, namun jeji kuwa za su ci su.
english: I will lay waste her vines and her fig trees, about which she has said, ‘These are my wages that my lovers have given me,’ and I will make them a forest, and the animals of the field shall eat them.

hausa: da yake shi ma mai ɗinkin tenti ne kamar su, sai ya zauna ya yi aiki tare da su.
english: and because he practiced the same trade, he lived with them and worked, for by trade they were tent makers.

hausa: Ubangiji ya sa wa sarki ciwon kuturta har mutuwarsa, ya kuma zauna a keɓe. Yotam ɗan sarki, shi ne ya gudanar da sha’anin fada, ya kuma shugabanci mutanen ƙasar.
english: Yahweh struck the king, so that he was a leper to the day of his death, and lived in a separate house. Jotham, the king’s son, was over the household, judging the people of the land.

hausa: Zuciyar masu hikima tana a gidan makoki, amma zuciya wawaye tana a gidan shagali.
english: The heart of the wise is in the house of mourning; but the heart of fools is in the house of mirth.

hausa: Daga can Dawuda ya tafi Mizfa a Mowab. Ya ce wa sarkin Mowab, “Za ka yarda mahaifina da mahaifiyata su zo su zauna a wurinka kafin in san abin da Allah zai yi da ni?”
english: David went from there to Mizpeh of Moab; and he said to the king of Moab, “Please let my father and my mother come out to you, until I know what God will do for me.”

hausa: Wata rana Elisha ya tafi Shunem. Akwai wata mai arziki a can wadda ta gayyace shi cin abinci. Sai ya zama duk lokacin da yake wucewa, yakan tsaya a can don cin abinci.
english: One day Elisha went to Shunem, where there was a prominent woman; and she persuaded him to eat bread. So it was, that as often as he passed by, he turned in there to eat bread.

hausa: Kada ka bari su ce wa kansu, “Allah yă ƙara, dā ma abin da mun so ke nan!” Ko su ce, “Mun haɗiye shi.”
english: Don’t let them say in their heart, “Aha! That’s the way we want it!” Don’t let them say, “We have swallowed him up!”

hausa: Kashegari, da suke barin Betani, Yesu kuwa ya ji yunwa.
english: The next day, when they had come out from Bethany, he was hungry.

english: Now let them put away their prostitution, and the dead bodies of their kings far from me. Then I will dwell among them forever.

english: He arose and departed, and went to Samaria. As he was at the shearing house of the shepherds on the way,

english: They reported to Yahweh’s angel who stood among the myrtle trees, and said, “We have walked back and forth through the earth, and behold, all the earth is at rest and in peace.”

hausa: Ya yi mulki shekaru ashirin da biyu, sai ya huta tare da kakanninsa. Sai Nadab ɗansa ya gāje shi a matsayin sarki.
english: The days which Jeroboam reigned were twenty two years; then he slept with his fathers, and Nadab his son reigned in his place.

hausa: A lokacin Dawuda yana cikin mafaka, sojojin Filistiyawa kuma suna a Betlehem.
english: David was then in the stronghold, and the garrison of the Philistines was in Bethlehem at that time.

english: and changed his prison garments. Jehoiachin ate bread before him continually all the days of his life.

english: When Aaron and all the children of Israel saw Moses, behold, the skin of his face shone; and they were afraid to come near him.

english: I will lay your cities waste, and will bring your sanctuaries to desolation. I will not take delight in the sweet fragrance of your offerings.

english: Every garment and every skin which the semen is on shall be washed with water, and be unclean until the evening.

hausa: Sai ta wuce ta yi arewancin gangaren Bet-Araba, ta wuce har zuwa cikin Araba.
english: It passed along to the side opposite the Arabah northward, and went down to the Arabah.

hausa: Yana saye da rigar da aka tsoma a jini, sunansa kuwa Kalman Allah ne.
english: He is clothed in a garment sprinkled with blood. His name is called “The Word of God.”

english: Yahweh opened the mouth of the donkey, and she said to Balaam, “What have I done to you, that you have struck me these three times?”

hausa: Saboda haka ta wurin sanin nan naka sai ka sa wannan ɗan’uwa marar ƙarfi wanda Kiristi ya mutu dominsa yă hallaka.
english: And through your knowledge, he who is weak perishes, the brother for whose sake Christ died.

english: I chattered like a swallow or a crane. I moaned like a dove. My eyes weaken looking upward. Lord, I am oppressed. Be my security.”

hausa: Na goma sha biyu don wata goma sha biyu, shi ne Heldai mutumin Netofa, daga iyalin Otniyel. Akwai mutane 24,000 a sashensa.
english: The twelfth captain for the twelfth month was Heldai the Netophathite, of Othniel. In his division were twenty-four thousand.

hausa: “Ku lura, kada ku rena ɗaya daga cikin waɗannan ƙanana. Gama ina faɗa muku mala’ikunsu a sama kullum suna duban fuskar Ubana da yake cikin sama.
english: See that you don’t despise one of these little ones, for I tell you that in heaven their angels always see the face of my Father who is in heaven.

hausa: Yohanna ya amsa da kalmomin annabi Ishaya, “Ni murya ne mai kira a hamada, ‘Ku miƙe hanya domin Ubangiji.’ ”
english: He said, “I am the voice of one crying in the wilderness, ‘Make straight the way of the Lord,’ as Isaiah the prophet said.”

hausa: Ya ce, “Gama an ɗaga hannuwa sama zuwa kursiyin Ubangiji, Ubangiji zai yaƙi Amalekawa daga tsara zuwa tsara.”
english: He said, “Yah has sworn: ‘Yahweh will have war with Amalek from generation to generation.’”

hausa: Bayan wannan, mutanen Yahuda suka gangara suka yaƙi Kan’aniyawan da suke zaune a ƙasar tudu, Negeb, da gindin tuddai a yammanci.
english: After that, the children of Judah went down to fight against the Canaanites who lived in the hill country, and in the South, and in the lowland.

hausa: Musa ya amsa ya ce, “Ba ƙarar nasara ba ce, ba ƙarar wanda yaƙi ya ci ba ne; ƙarar waƙa ce nake ji.”
english: He said, “It isn’t the voice of those who shout for victory. It is not the voice of those who cry for being overcome; but the noise of those who sing that I hear.”

english: David sent and inquired after the woman. One said, “Isn’t this Bathsheba, the daughter of Eliam, Uriah the Hittite’s wife?”

hausa: “Kaitonki, Korazin! Kaitonki, Betsaida! Da a ce ayyukan banmamakin da aka yi a cikinki ne aka yi a Taya da Sidon, da tuni sun tuba sanye da rigar makoki da toka.
english: “Woe to you, Chorazin! Woe to you, Bethsaida! For if the mighty works had been done in Tyre and Sidon which were done in you, they would have repented long ago in sackcloth and ashes.

english: As for the earth, out of it comes bread. Underneath it is turned up as it were by fire.

Ku kuma naɗa mazaunan Urushalima a matsayin masu tsaro, waɗansunsu a wuraren aiki, waɗansun kuma kusa da gidajensu.”
english: I said to them, “Don’t let the gates of Jerusalem be opened until the sun is hot; and while they stand guard, let them shut the doors, and you bar them; and appoint watches of the inhabitants of Jerusalem, everyone in his watch, with everyone near his house.”

hausa: Iliya ya ce wa sarki, “Ga abin da Ubangiji ya ce, don babu Allah a Isra’ila ne wanda za ka tuntuɓa da ka aika a tuntuɓi Ba’al-Zebub, allahn Ekron? Domin ka yi haka, ba za ka tashi daga gadon da kake kwance ba, ba shakka za ka mutu!”
english: He said to him, “Yahweh says, ‘Because you have sent messengers to inquire of Baal Zebub, the god of Ekron, is it because there is no God in Israel to inquire of his word? Therefore you will not come down from the bed where you have gone up, but you will surely die.’”

hausa: Suna cewa, “Bari mu tsittsinke sarƙoƙinsu, mu kuma ’yantar da kamammu daga kangin bautar Allah.”
english: “Let’s break their bonds apart, and cast their cords from us.”

hausa: Me mutum zai amfana, in ya ribato duniya duka a bakin ransa?
english: For what does it profit a man to gain the whole world and forfeit his life?

hausa: Ka ba ni hikima da sani, don in iya jagorance wannan mutane, gama wa zai iya shugabance wannan jama’arka mai girma?”
english: Now give me wisdom and knowledge, that I may go out and come in before this people; for who can judge this great people of yours?”

english: Behold, I will stand before you there on the rock in Horeb. You shall strike the rock, and water will come out of it, that the people may drink.” Moses did so in the sight of the elders of Israel.

english: He led me toward the south; and behold, there was a gate toward the south. He measured its posts and its arches according to these measurements.

english: Didn’t he who made me in the womb make him? Didn’t one fashion us in the womb?

english: I went out by night by the valley gate toward the jackal’s well, then to the dung gate; and I inspected the walls of Jerusalem, which were broken down, and its gates were consumed with fire.

hausa: Allammelek, Amad da Mishal. A arewanci kuma iyakar ta taɓa Karmel da Shihor Libnat.
english: Allammelech, Amad, Mishal. It reached to Carmel westward, and to Shihorlibnath.

english: “Whoever receives one such little child in my name receives me; and whoever receives me, doesn’t receive me, but him who sent me.”

english: A Psalm by David. The earth is Yahweh’s, with its fullness; the world, and those who dwell in it.

english: Therefore concerning the eating of things sacrificed to idols, we know that no idol is anything in the world, and that there is no other God but one.

english: He said, “Now hear my words. If there is a prophet among you, I, Yahweh, will make myself known to him in a vision. I will speak with him in a dream.

english: He made the altar of burnt offering of acacia wood. It was square. Its length was five cubits, its width was five cubits, and its height was three cubits.

hausa: Shi wanda yake zama a wurin Mafi Ɗaukaka zai huta a cikin inuwar Maɗaukaki.
english: He who dwells in the secret place of the Most High will rest in the shadow of the Almighty.

english: Every moving thing that lives will be food for you. As I gave you the green herb, I have given everything to you.

english: God remembered Rachel, and God listened to her, and opened her womb.

english: But he stood in the middle of the plot and defended it, and killed the Philistines; and Yahweh worked a great victory.

english: For their princes are at Zoan, and their ambassadors have come to Hanes.

english: So I spoke to you, and you didn’t listen; but you rebelled against the commandment of Yahweh, and were presumptuous, and went up into the hill country.

english: For as the body is one and has many members, and all the members of the body, being many, are one body; so also is Christ.

english: “Remember now, Yahweh, I beg you, how I have walked before you in truth and with a perfect heart, and have done that which is good in your sight.” And Hezekiah wept bitterly.

english: “‘Each one of you shall respect his mother and his father. You shall keep my Sabbaths. I am Yahweh your God.

english: Jeremiah commanded Baruch, saying, “I am restricted. I can’t go into Yahweh’s house.

hausa: Tare za su zama kamar mutane masu ƙarfi suna tattake lakar tituna a cikin yaƙi. Domin Ubangiji yana tare da su, za su yi faɗa su kuma yi nasara a kan masu yaƙi a kan dawakai.
english: They will be as mighty men, treading down muddy streets in the battle. They will fight, because Yahweh is with them. The riders on horses will be confounded.

hausa: Fahimta mai kyau kan sami tagomashi, amma hanyar marar aminci tana da wuya.
english: Good understanding wins favor, but the way of the unfaithful is hard.

hausa: Da suna ihu suna binsu, sai mutanen Dan suka waiga suka cewa Mika, “Mece ce damuwarka da ka kira mutanenka su zo su fāɗa mana?”
english: As they called to the children of Dan, they turned their faces, and said to Micah, “What ails you, that you come with such a company?”

hausa: Maganar ta zo wa Irmiya daga Ubangiji bayan Sarki Zedekiya ya yi yarjejjeniya da duka mutane a Urushalima ya yi shelar ’yanci wa bayi.
english: The word came to Jeremiah from Yahweh, after King Zedekiah had made a covenant with all the people who were at Jerusalem, to proclaim liberty to them,

hausa: Ubangiji ya hore ni sosai, amma bai ba da ni ga mutuwa ba.
english: Yah has punished me severely, but he has not given me over to death.

hausa: Kada ka ƙi yin alheri ga duk wanda ya dace, sa’ad da kana iya yin haka.
english: Don’t withhold good from those to whom it is due, when it is in the power of your hand to do it.

hausa: Gama marasa sanin Allah suna fama neman dukan waɗannan abubuwa, Ubanku na sama kuwa ya san kuna bukatarsu.
english: For the Gentiles seek after all these things; for your heavenly Father knows that you need all these things.

hausa: Dukan Yahuda suka kawo zakan hatsi, sabon ruwan inabi da mai cikin ɗakunan ajiya.
english: Then all Judah brought the tithe of the grain, the new wine, and the oil to the treasuries.

hausa: Sa’ad da ya buɗe hatimi na biyar, sai na ga a ƙarƙashin bagaden rayukan waɗanda aka kashe saboda maganar Allah da kuma shaidar da suka yi.
english: When he opened the fifth seal, I saw underneath the altar the souls of those who had been killed for the Word of God, and for the testimony of the Lamb which they had.

hausa: Na dogara gare ka, ya Ubangiji; za ka amsa, ya Ubangiji Allahna.
english: For I hope in you, Yahweh. You will answer, Lord my God.

hausa: Sa’ad da kuka iso kusa da Ammonawa, kada ku dame su, ko ku tsokane su da yaƙi, gama ba zan ba ku mallakar wata ƙasar da take ta Ammonawa ba. Na riga na ba da ita mallaka ga zuriyar Lot.”
english: When you come near the border of the children of Ammon, don’t bother them, nor contend with them; for I will not give you any of the land of the children of Ammon for a possession, because I have given it to the children of Lot for a possession.”

hausa: Mun ga Nefilimawa a can (zuriyar Anak sun fito ne daga Nefilim). Sai muka ga kanmu kamar fāra ne kawai, haka kuwa muke a gare su.”
english: There we saw the Nephilim, the sons of Anak, who come from the Nephilim. We were in our own sight as grasshoppers, and so we were in their sight.”

hausa: na saurare ku da kyau. Amma ba waninku da ya nuna Ayuba yana da laifi; ba ko ɗayanku da ya amsa muhawwararsa.
english: Yes, I gave you my full attention, but there was no one who convinced Job, or who answered his words, among you.

hausa: Bayan ya tsarkaka, dole yă jira har kwana bakwai.
english: After he is cleansed, they shall reckon to him seven days.

hausa: Sai Musa ya aika ’yan leƙen asiri zuwa Yazer. Daga baya, sai Isra’ilawa suka ci ƙauyukan da suke kewaye, suka kuma kori Amoriyawa da suke zaune a can.
english: Moses sent to spy out Jazer. They took its villages, and drove out the Amorites who were there.

hausa: Tabbatacce ka ji abin da sarakunan Assuriya suka aikata ga dukan ƙasashe, suna hallaka su tas. Kai kuwa za ka tsira ne?
english: Behold, you have heard what the kings of Assyria have done to all lands, by destroying them utterly. Shall you be delivered?

hausa: Maganar Ubangiji ta zo mini cewa,
english: Moreover Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

hausa: Kamar yadda muka yi wa Musa biyayya, haka za mu yi maka biyayya. Ubangiji Allahnka ya kasance tare da Musa.
english: Just as we listened to Moses in all things, so will we listen to you. Only may Yahweh your God be with you, as he was with Moses.

hausa: Saboda haka Rut ta yi kala a gonar har yamma. Sa’an nan ta sussuka hatsin sha’ir da ta kalata ta sami kamar efa.
english: So she gleaned in the field until evening; and she beat out that which she had gleaned, and it was about an ephah of barley.

hausa: Gama na gaya masa zan hukunta gidansa har abada saboda zunubin da yake sane da shi; ’ya’yansa sun wulaƙantar da kansu, shi kuma bai tsawata musu ba.
english: For I have told him that I will judge his house forever for the iniquity which he knew, because his sons brought a curse on themselves, and he didn’t restrain them.

hausa: Daga cikin ƙasa ake ciro ƙarfe, ana kuma narkar da tagulla daga cikin dutse.
english: Iron is taken out of the earth, and copper is smelted out of the ore.

hausa: “A sa’an nan ne alamar dawowar Ɗan Mutum zai bayyana a sararin sama, dukan al’umman duniya kuwa za su yi kuka. Za su ga Ɗan Mutum yana zuwa kan gizagizan sararin sama, da iko da kuma ɗaukaka mai girma.
english: and then the sign of the Son of Man will appear in the sky. Then all the tribes of the earth will mourn, and they will see the Son of Man coming on the clouds of the sky with power and great glory.

hausa: Da Sarki Hiridus ya ji wannan, sai hankalinsa ya tashi haka ma na dukan Urushalima.
english: When King Herod heard it, he was troubled, and all Jerusalem with him.

hausa: Ga abin da Irmiya annabi ya faɗa wa Baruk ɗan Neriya a shekara ta huɗu ta Yehohiyakim ɗan Yosiya sarkin Yahuda, bayan Baruk ya rubuta maganar da Irmiya ya shibta masa a kan littafi cewa,
english: The message that Jeremiah the prophet spoke to Baruch the son of Neriah, when he wrote these words in a book at the mouth of Jeremiah, in the fourth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah, saying,

hausa: Sa’an nan Daniyel ya komo gida ya kuma sanar wa abokansa Hananiya, Mishayel da Azariya, batun nan duka.
english: Then Daniel went to his house and made the thing known to Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah, his companions:

hausa: An ɓoye masa igiya da za tă zarge shi a ƙasa; an sa masa tarko a kan hanyar da zai bi.
english: A noose is hidden for him in the ground, a trap for him on the path.

hausa: Ya zamana wani firist ya bi kan wannan hanya. Da ya ga mutumin, sai ya bi gefe ya wuce abinsa.
english: By chance a certain priest was going down that way. When he saw him, he passed by on the other side.

hausa: Ga wanda ya zo ta wurin ruwa da jini, wato, Yesu Kiristi. Bai zo ta wurin ruwa kaɗai ba, sai dai ta wurin ruwa da kuma jini. Ruhu ne kuwa yake ba da shaida, gama Ruhu shi ne gaskiya.
english: This is he who came by water and blood, Jesus Christ; not with the water only, but with the water and the blood. It is the Spirit who testifies, because the Spirit is the truth.

hausa: Allah ya manta yă yi jinƙai? Cikin fushinsa ya janye tausayinsa ne?” Sela
english: Has God forgotten to be gracious? Has he, in anger, withheld his compassion?” Selah.

hausa: A shekarar da Sarki Uzziya ya mutu, na ga Ubangiji zaune a kan kujerar sarauta a sama cike da ɗaukaka, zatinsa ya cika haikali.
english: In the year that King Uzziah died, I saw the Lord sitting on a throne, high and lifted up; and his train filled the temple.

hausa: In na yi zunubi, me na yi maka, kai mai lura da mutane? Don me ka sa ni a gaba? Na zame maka kaya mai nauyi ne?
english: If I have sinned, what do I do to you, you watcher of men? Why have you set me as a mark for you, so that I am a burden to myself?

hausa: Amma yanzu ga abin da za mu yi wa Gibeya. Za mu haura mu fāɗa yadda ƙuri’a ta nunar.
english: But now this is the thing which we will do to Gibeah: we will go up against it by lot;

hausa: Za su ɗauki macizai da hannuwansu. In kuwa suka sha mugun dafi, ba zai cuce su ba ko kaɗan. Za su ɗibiya hannuwansu a kan marasa lafiya, su kuwa warke.”
english: they will take up serpents; and if they drink any deadly thing, it will in no way hurt them; they will lay hands on the sick, and they will recover.”

hausa: “Kada ka kira wani abu makirci game da kome da waɗannan mutane suke kira makirci; kada ji tsoron abin da suke tsoro, kada kuma ka firgita game da shi.
english: “Don’t call a conspiracy all that this people call a conspiracy. Don’t fear their threats or be terrorized.

hausa: “ ‘Ga abin da Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka yana cewa in sarkin ya ba wa ɗaya daga cikin ’ya’yansa kyauta daga gādonsa, zai kuwa zama na zuriyar; zai kuwa zama mallakarsu ta wurin gādo.
english: “‘The Lord Yahweh says: “If the prince gives a gift to any of his sons, it is his inheritance. It shall belong to his sons. It is their possession by inheritance.

hausa: Bayan ranar Asabbaci, da sassafe, a ranar farko ta mako, Maryamu Magdalin tare da ɗaya Maryamun, suka je don su ga kabarin.
english: Now after the Sabbath, as it began to dawn on the first day of the week, Mary Magdalene and the other Mary came to see the tomb.

hausa: Sa’ad da sarki ya ƙetare zuwa Gilgal, Kimham ma ya ƙetare tare da shi. Dukan sojojin Yahuda da rabin sojojin Isra’ila suka ƙetare da sarki.
english: So the king went over to Gilgal, and Chimham went over with him. All the people of Judah brought the king over, and also half the people of Israel.

hausa: Sa’an nan ya ce, “Ku tafi ku faɗa wa jama’a duka, su kawo shanu da tumaki a nan, su yayyanka, su ci a nan, don kada su yi wa Ubangiji zunubi da cin nama ɗanye.” Haka nan kowa ya kawo saniyarsa a daren, ya yanka a can.
english: Saul said, “Disperse yourselves among the people, and tell them, ‘Every man bring me here his ox, and every man his sheep, and kill them here, and eat; and don’t sin against Yahweh in eating meat with the blood.’” All the people brought every man his ox with him that night, and killed them there.

hausa: Ya bishe ku cikin hamada mai fāɗi, mai bantsoro, wannan busasshiyar ƙasa wadda ba ta da ruwa, ga macizai masu dafi da kuma kunamai. Ya ba ku ruwa daga dutsen ƙanƙara.
english: who led you through the great and terrible wilderness, with venomous snakes and scorpions, and thirsty ground where there was no water; who poured water for you out of the rock of flint;

hausa: Da Yowab ya dawo daga fafaran Abner, sai ya tattara dukan mutanensa. Ban da Asahel, sai ya gane an rasa mutum goma sha tara na Dawuda.
english: Joab returned from following Abner; and when he had gathered all the people together, nineteen men of David’s and Asahel were missing.

hausa: da Yokim, mutanen Kozeba, da Yowash da Saraf wanda ya yi mulkin Mowab da kuma Yashubi Lehem (Waɗannan rubutattun tarihi ne na tun dā.)
english: and Jokim, and the men of Cozeba, and Joash, and Saraph, who had dominion in Moab, and Jashubilehem. These records are ancient.

hausa: “Ga abin da Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka yana cewa wa Taya. Ƙasashen da suke a bakin teku ba za su girgiza saboda ƙarar fāɗuwarki, sa’ad da nishin waɗanda aka yi wa rauni da kashe-kashen da aka yi a cikinki suka faru ba?
english: “The Lord Yahweh says to Tyre: ‘Won’t the islands shake at the sound of your fall, when the wounded groan, when the slaughter is made within you?

hausa: Saboda wannan rantsuwa, Yesu ya zama tabbacin alkawari mafi kyau.
english: By so much, Jesus has become the guarantee of a better covenant.

hausa: Yesu ya miƙa hannunsa ya taɓa mutumin ya ce, “Na yarda, ka zama da tsabta!” Nan da nan, sai kuturtar ta rabu da shi.
english: He stretched out his hand and touched him, saying, “I want to. Be made clean.” Immediately the leprosy left him.

hausa: Saboda haka in na kammala wannan aiki na kuma tabbata cewa sun karɓi wannan amfani, zan tafi Sifen in kuma ziyarce ku a hanyata.
english: When therefore I have accomplished this, and have sealed to them this fruit, I will go on by way of you to Spain.

hausa: Zuriyar Naftali bisa ga kabilansu, daga Yazeyel, kabilar Yazeyelawa; daga Guni, kabilar Guniyawa;
english: The sons of Naphtali after their families: of Jahzeel, the family of the Jahzeelites; of Guni, the family of the Gunites;

hausa: shugaban sojojin hamsin da mutum mai makami, mai ba da shawara, gwanin sarrafa abubuwa da mai gwanintan dabo.
english: the captain of fifty, the honorable man, the counselor, the skilled craftsman, and the clever enchanter.

hausa: Sai na yi magana a kan wadda ta ƙare ƙarfi ta wurin karuwanci na ce, ‘Yanzu bari su yi amfani da ita kamar karuwa, gama abin da take ke nan.’
english: Then I said of her who was old in adulteries, ‘Now they will play the prostitute with her, and she with them.’

hausa: Yayinda Bitrus yana cikin tunani game da wahayin, sai Ruhu ya ce masa, “Siman, ga mutum uku suna nemanka.
english: While Peter was pondering the vision, the Spirit said to him, “Behold, three men seek you.

hausa: Kada ka haɗa kai da waɗanda suke shan ruwan inabi da yawa ko masu haɗama kansu da abinci,
english: Don’t be among ones drinking too much wine, or those who gorge themselves on meat;

hausa: Cikin rayuwata, ya karye ƙarfina; ya gajartar da kwanakina.
english: He weakened my strength along the course. He shortened my days.

hausa: “Koma ka ce wa Fir’auna sarkin Masar, yă bar Isra’ilawa su fita daga ƙasarsa.”
english: “Go in, speak to Pharaoh king of Egypt, that he let the children of Israel go out of his land.”

hausa: Sai ya ce, “Ranka yă daɗe sarki, da yake bawanka gurgu ne, na ce, ‘A sa mini sirdi a kan jakina don in hau in tafi tare da sarki.’ Amma Ziba bawana ya bashe ni.
english: He answered, “My lord, O king, my servant deceived me. For your servant said, ‘I will saddle a donkey for myself, that I may ride on it and go with the king,’ because your servant is lame.

hausa: Saboda haka ya kira bayinsa goma ya ba su mina goma. Ya ce, ‘Ku yi kasuwanci da kuɗin nan, sai na dawo.’
english: He called ten servants of his and gave them ten mina coins, and told them, ‘Conduct business until I come.’

hausa: “Ku kula, kada ku yi yarjejjeniya da mazaunan wannan ƙasa, don kada sa’ad da suke yi wa allolinsu sujada, suna miƙa musu hadaya, su gayyace ku, ku ci hadayar da suka miƙa wa allolinsu.
english: “Don’t make a covenant with the inhabitants of the land, lest they play the prostitute after their gods, and sacrifice to their gods, and one call you and you eat of his sacrifice;

hausa: ’Yan’uwana, itacen ɓaure yana iya haifar ’ya’yan zaitun, ko kuma itacen inabi yă haifi ’ya’yan ɓaure? Haka ma, maɓulɓular ruwan gishiri ba zai iya ba da ruwa mai kyau ba.
english: Can a fig tree, my brothers, yield olives, or a vine figs? Thus no spring yields both salt water and fresh water.

hausa: Amma Ya Ubangiji, ka san duk maƙarƙashiyarsu, na neman su kashe ni. Kada ka gafarta musu laifofinsu ko ka shafe zunubansu daga gabanka. Bari a tumɓuke su a gabanka; ka yi da su sa’ad da kake fushi.
english: Yet, Yahweh, you know all their counsel against me to kill me. Don’t forgive their iniquity. Don’t blot out their sin from your sight, Let them be overthrown before you. Deal with them in the time of your anger.

hausa: Sai suka zo suka ɗauke su, suna nan cikin taguwoyinsu, zuwa waje da sansani yadda Musa ya umarta.
english: So they came near, and carried them in their tunics out of the camp, as Moses had said.

hausa: Sai Ubangiji ya kira Sama’ila. Sama’ila ya amsa ya ce, “Ga ni.”
english: Yahweh called Samuel. He said, “Here I am.”

hausa: ruhuna kuma yana farin ciki da Allah Mai Cetona,
english: My spirit has rejoiced in God my Savior,

hausa: An kunyata Mowab, gama ta wargaje. Ku yi kuka ku kuma tā da murya! Ku yi shela kusa da Arnon cewa an hallaka Mowab.
english: Moab is disappointed; for it is broken down. Wail and cry! Tell it by the Arnon, that Moab is laid waste.

hausa: Musa ya kuma ce, “Za ku san cewa shi ne Ubangiji, sa’ad da ya ba ku nama ku ci da yamma, da kuma duk burodin da kuke so da safe, saboda ya ji gunagunin da kuka yi a kansa. Namu a wane? Ai, gunaguninku ba a kanmu ba, amma a kan Ubangiji ne.”
english: Moses said, “Now Yahweh will give you meat to eat in the evening, and in the morning bread to satisfy you, because Yahweh hears your murmurings which you murmur against him. And who are we? Your murmurings are not against us, but against Yahweh.”

hausa: Aka kakkafa ƙugiyoyi kewaye a bangon, tsawon kowanne ya yi fāɗin tafin hannu. An yi amfani da teburin don a riƙa ajiye naman hadayu.
english: The hooks, a hand width long, were fastened within all around. The meat of the offering was on the tables.

hausa: “Ɗauki gari mai laushi a gasa dunƙulen burodi goma sha biyu, a yi amfani da humushi biyu na garwan gari don kowace burodi.
english: “You shall take fine flour, and bake twelve cakes of it: two tenths of an ephah shall be in one cake.

hausa: “Saboda haka na matso kusa da shi na kashe shi, domin na san cewa ba zai yi rai ba, da yake ya riga ya fāɗi. Sai na cire rawanin da yake kansa, na kuma cire warwaron hannunsa, na kuwa kawo maka su duka, ranka yă daɗe!”
english: So I stood beside him and killed him, because I was sure that he could not live after he had fallen. I took the crown that was on his head and the bracelet that was on his arm, and have brought them here to my lord.”

hausa: Suka bar ɗakin, kuma yayinda suke magana da juna, sai suka ce, “Wannan mutum ba ya yin kome da ya isa kisa ko dauri.”
english: When they had withdrawn, they spoke to one another, saying, “This man does nothing worthy of death or of bonds.”

hausa: Gideyon ɗan Yowash ya rasu da kyakkyawan tsufa aka kuma binne shi a kabarin Yowash mahaifinsa a Ofra na mutanen Abiyezer.
english: Gideon the son of Joash died in a good old age, and was buried in the tomb of Joash his father, in Ophrah of the Abiezrites.

hausa: Saboda haka na ga babu abin da ya fi kyau wa mutum fiye da yă more wahalar aikinsa, domin wannan ne rabonsa. Gama wa zai kawo shi yă ga abin da zai faru a bayansa?
english: Therefore I saw that there is nothing better than that a man should rejoice in his works, for that is his portion; for who can bring him to see what will be after him?

hausa: Ku tashi daga nan da surutan waƙoƙinku! Ba zan saurari kaɗe-kaɗe da bushe bushenku ba.
english: Take away from me the noise of your songs! I will not listen to the music of your harps.

hausa: Za su haɗa hannu tare da kai su ɗauki nauyin lura da Tentin Sujada, dukan ayyuka a Tenti, ba kuma wanda zai zo kusa da inda kake.
english: They shall be joined to you and keep the responsibility of the Tent of Meeting, for all the service of the Tent. A stranger shall not come near to you.

hausa: Sai fushin Ubangiji ya yi ƙuna a kansu, ya kuma rabu da su.
english: Yahweh’s anger burned against them; and he departed.

hausa: Gama in kuna yafe wa mutane sa’ad da suka yi muku laifi, Ubanku da yake cikin sama ma zai gafarta muku.
english: “For if you forgive men their trespasses, your heavenly Father will also forgive you.

hausa: Bilatus ya ce, “Ku tafi da shi da kanku mana, ku hukunta shi bisa ga dokarku.” Sai Yahudawa suka ƙi suka ce, “Ba mu da ikon yanke wa wani hukuncin kisa.”
english: Pilate therefore said to them, “Take him yourselves, and judge him according to your law.” Therefore the Jews said to him, “It is illegal for us to put anyone to death,”

hausa: Sa’ad da suka fāɗi, za su sami ɗan taimako, mutane da yawa za su haɗa kai da su, amma da munafunci.
english: Now when they fall, they will be helped with a little help; but many will join themselves to them with flatteries.

hausa: Ya mai da ikkilisiya ta zama mai tsarki ta wurin ikon maganarsa, ya kuma tsabtacce ta ta wurin wanke ta da ruwa.
english: that he might sanctify her, having cleansed her by the washing of water with the word,

hausa: Ubangiji ya ce wa Musa,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

hausa: A can bisa akwai duwatsu masu tsada da aka yayyanka bisa ga ma’auni, da kuma ginshiƙan al’ul.
english: Above were costly stones, even cut stone, according to measure, and cedar wood.

hausa: Ba za a iske wani daga cikin abubuwan nan da aka haramta a hannuwanku ba, saboda Ubangiji yă juya daga fushinsa mai ƙuna, yă nuna jinƙai, yă ji tausayinku, yă kuma ƙara yawanku, kamar yadda ya alkawarta da rantsuwa ga kakanninku,
english: Nothing of the devoted thing shall cling to your hand, that Yahweh may turn from the fierceness of his anger and show you mercy, and have compassion on you and multiply you, as he has sworn to your fathers,

hausa: Kuma in kuka ƙazantar da ƙasar, za tă amayar da ku kamar yadda ta amayar da al’umman da suka riga ku.
english: that the land not vomit you out also, when you defile it, as it vomited out the nation that was before you.

hausa: Amma ba su gaskata matan ba, domin sun ɗauki kalmominsu wani zancen banza ne.
english: These words seemed to them to be nonsense, and they didn’t believe them.

hausa: an naɗa ni tun fil azal, daga farko, kafin duniya ta kasance.
english: I was set up from everlasting, from the beginning, before the earth existed.

hausa: Ka ƙidaya maza daga masu shekara talatin zuwa hamsin waɗanda sukan zo hidimar aiki a Tentin Sujada.
english: you shall count them from thirty years old and upward even to fifty years old—everyone who enters on the service, to do the work of the Tent of Meeting.

hausa: Ku yi nagarta, ba mugunta ba; don ku rayu sa’an nan Ubangiji Allah Maɗaukaki zai kasance da ku, kamar yadda kuka ce zai yi.
english: Seek good, and not evil, that you may live; and so Yahweh, the God of Armies, will be with you, as you say.

hausa: Bayan suka yi shawara tare da shugabanni, sai ya zaɓi mutanen da za su ja gaban sojoji suna waƙa ga Ubangiji suna yabonsa saboda tsarkinsa suna cewa, “Ku yi godiya ga Ubangiji, gama ƙaunarsa dawwammamiya ce har abada.”
english: When he had taken counsel with the people, he appointed those who were to sing to Yahweh and give praise in holy array as they go out before the army, and say, “Give thanks to Yahweh, for his loving kindness endures forever.”

hausa: Saboda haka da waɗanda aka ɗauka da fari suka zo, sun zaci za su sami fiye da haka. Amma kowannensu ma ya karɓi dinari guda.
english: When the first came, they supposed that they would receive more; and they likewise each received a denarius.

hausa: sai Yerobowam ya ce wa matarsa, “Ki tafi, ki ɓad da kama, don kada a gane ke a matsayin matar Yerobowam. Ki je Shilo. Annabi Ahiya yana a can, wannan wanda ya ce mini zan zama sarki a bisa wannan mutane.
english: Jeroboam said to his wife, “Please get up and disguise yourself, so that you won’t be recognized as Jeroboam’s wife. Go to Shiloh. Behold, Ahijah the prophet is there, who said that I would be king over this people.

hausa: “Ya ce, ‘Zan tafi in zama ruhun ƙarya a bakunan dukan annabawansa.’ “Ubangiji ya ce, ‘Za ka yi nasara a ruɗinsa. Ka tafi, ka yi haka.’
english: “He said, ‘I will go, and will be a lying spirit in the mouth of all his prophets.’ “He said, ‘You will entice him, and will prevail also. Go and do so.’

hausa: Sa’an nan zan koma wurina sai sun yarda da laifinsu. Za su kuma nemi fuskata; cikin azabansu za su nace da nemana.”
english: I will go and return to my place, until they acknowledge their offense, and seek my face. In their affliction they will seek me earnestly.”

hausa: sai dukan fadawan suka aiki Yehudi ɗan Netaniya, ɗan Shelemiya, ɗan Kushi, ya ce wa Baruk, “Ka zo tare da littafin da ka karanta wa mutane.” Saboda haka Baruk ɗan Neriya ya tafi wurinsu tare da littafin a hannunsa.
english: Therefore all the princes sent Jehudi the son of Nethaniah, the son of Shelemiah, the son of Cushi, to Baruch, saying, “Take in your hand the scroll in which you have read in the ears of the people, and come.” So Baruch the son of Neriah took the scroll in his hand, and came to them.

hausa: Na ƙwace ku daga ikon Masarawa da kuma daga dukan hannuwan masu danniya. Na kore su a gabanku na kuma ba ku ƙasarsu.
english: I delivered you out of the hand of the Egyptians and out of the hand of all who oppressed you, and drove them out from before you, and gave you their land.

hausa: Ubangiji ya ƙi ma’aunin da ba daidai ba, da kuma magwajin da ba su gamshe shi ba.
english: Yahweh detests differing weights, and dishonest scales are not pleasing.

hausa: Bayan suka ƙetare Urdun, sai suka yi sansani kusa da Arower, kudu da garin da yake cikin kwari, sa’an nan suka ratsa ta wajen Gad, suka ci gaba zuwa Yazer.
english: They passed over the Jordan and encamped in Aroer, on the right side of the city that is in the middle of the valley of Gad, and to Jazer;

hausa: Yusuf ya amsa wa Fir’auna ya ce, “Ba ni ne da iyawar ba, Allah zai iya ba wa Fir’auna amsar da yake nema.”
english: Joseph answered Pharaoh, saying, “It isn’t in me. God will give Pharaoh an answer of peace.”

hausa: Suka wuce masu gadi na fari da na biyu, suka kuma isa ƙofar ƙarfe ta shiga birni. Ƙofar kuwa ta buɗe musu da kanta, suka kuma wuce. Sa’ad da suka yi tafiya tsawon wani titi, nan take mala’ikan ya bar shi.
english: When they were past the first and the second guard, they came to the iron gate that leads into the city, which opened to them by itself. They went out and went down one street, and immediately the angel departed from him.

hausa: Mutanen suka tabbatar mata suka ce, “Ranmu a bakin ranki! In ba ki faɗa wa kowa abin da ya kawo mu ba, za mu yi miki alheri da aminci lokacin da Ubangiji ya ba mu ƙasar.”
english: The men said to her, “Our life for yours, if you don’t talk about this business of ours; and it shall be, when Yahweh gives us the land, that we will deal kindly and truly with you.”

hausa: Daga can muka tafi Filibbi, wata babbar alkaryar Roma wadda kuma take babban birni a gundumar Makidoniya. Muka zauna a can kwanaki masu yawa.
english: and from there to Philippi, which is a city of Macedonia, the foremost of the district, a Roman colony. We were staying some days in this city.

hausa: Allah ya shirya mana wani abu mafi kyau. Kuma bai so su kai ga maƙasudin bangaskiyarsu ba sai tare da mu.
english: God having provided some better thing concerning us, so that apart from us they should not be made perfect.

hausa: domin yă sayar mini da kogon Makfela, wanda yake nasa, wannan da yake a ƙarshen filinsa. Ku ce masa yă sayar mini a cikakken farashi, yă zama mallakata domin makabarta tsakaninku.”
english: that he may sell me the cave of Machpelah, which he has, which is in the end of his field. For the full price let him sell it to me among you as a possession for a burial place.”

hausa: Saboda haka annabin ya ɗauki gawar mutumin Allah, ya shimfiɗa shi a kan jaki, ya koma da shi cikin birninsa don yă yi makokinsa yă kuma binne shi.
english: The prophet took up the body of the man of God, and laid it on the donkey, and brought it back. He came to the city of the old prophet to mourn, and to bury him.

hausa: Bayan suka gangaro daga tudu zuwa cikin gari, Sai Sama’ila ya yi magana da Shawulu a ɗakin samansa.
english: When they had come down from the high place into the city, he talked with Saul on the housetop.

hausa: Da gari ya waye, sai ya kira almajiransa zuwa wurinsa, ya zaɓi guda goma sha biyu daga cikinsu, waɗanda ya kira su, Manzanni.
english: When it was day, he called his disciples, and from them he chose twelve, whom he also named apostles:

hausa: “Ubangiji ya yi fushi sosai da kakanninku.
english: “Yahweh was very displeased with your fathers.

hausa: Ku koyi yin nagarta; ku nemi adalci. Ku ƙarfafa waɗanda aka zalunta. Ku ba wa marayu hakkinsu, ku taimaki gwauruwa.
english: Learn to do well. Seek justice. Relieve the oppressed. Defend the fatherless. Plead for the widow.”

hausa: Saboda haka sai Iliya ya yi abin da Ubangiji ya faɗa masa. Ya tafi Rafin Kerit, gabas da Urdun, ya zauna a can.
english: So he went and did according to Yahweh’s word, for he went and lived by the brook Cherith that is before the Jordan.

hausa: Ni mahaifi ne ga masu bukata; na tsaya wa baƙo.
english: I was a father to the needy. I researched the cause of him whom I didn’t know.

hausa: Zan mai da su abin ƙyama da masifa ga dukan mulkokin duniya, abin zargi da abin karin magana, abin ba’a da abin la’ana a duk inda zan kore su zuwa.
english: I will even give them up to be tossed back and forth among all the kingdoms of the earth for evil, to be a reproach and a proverb, a taunt and a curse, in all places where I will drive them.

hausa: Sa’ad da Efraim ya yi magana, mutane sun yi rawan jiki; an girmama shi a cikin Isra’ila. Amma sai ya zama mai laifi na yin wa Ba’al sujada, ya kuwa mutu.
english: When Ephraim spoke, there was trembling. He exalted himself in Israel, but when he became guilty through Baal, he died.

hausa: Dole yă ƙone rigar, ko tariyar zaren, ko kayan da aka saƙa na ulu ko lilin, ko kuwa na kaya da aka yi da fatar, wanda cutar ta fāɗa wa, domin cutar rigar muguwa ce, dole a ƙone kayan.
english: He shall burn the garment, whether the warp or the woof, in wool or in linen, or anything of leather, in which the plague is, for it is a destructive mildew. It shall be burned in the fire.

hausa: A can ya gina bagade, ya kuma kira wurin El Betel, gama a can ne Allah ya bayyana kansa gare shi sa’ad da yake gudu daga ɗan’uwansa.
english: He built an altar there, and called the place El Beth El; because there God was revealed to him, when he fled from the face of his brother.

hausa: Ko da yake firistocin masujadan kan tuddai ba su yi hidima a bagaden Ubangiji a Urushalima ba, sun ci burodi marar yisti tare da sauran firistoci.
english: Nevertheless the priests of the high places didn’t come up to Yahweh’s altar in Jerusalem, but they ate unleavened bread among their brothers.

hausa: Da jin wannan labari, sai shugaban masu gadin haikali da manyan firistocin suka ruɗe, suna tunanin abin da wannan al’amari zai zama.
english: Now when the high priest, the captain of the temple, and the chief priests heard these words, they were very perplexed about them and what might become of this.

hausa: Zan zama kamar raɓa ga Isra’ila zai yi fure kamar lili. Kamar al’ul na Lebanon zai sa saiwarsa zuwa ƙasa;
english: I will be like the dew to Israel. He will blossom like the lily, and send down his roots like Lebanon.

hausa: “Tsawon rabo na musamman da za ku bayar ga Ubangiji zai zama kamu 25,000, fāɗinsa kuma kamu 10,000.
english: “The offering that you shall offer to Yahweh shall be twenty-five thousand reeds in length, and ten thousand in width.

hausa: Sai Yonatan ya gaya wa Dawuda cewa, “Gobe ne Bikin Sabon Wata, za a rasa ka, da yake kujerarka za tă kasance ba kowa a kai.
english: Then Jonathan said to him, “Tomorrow is the new moon, and you will be missed, because your seat will be empty.

hausa: “A wannan rana,” in ji Ubangiji, “zan tattara guragu; zan kuma tara masu zaman bauta, da waɗanda na sa suka damu.
english: “In that day,” says Yahweh, “I will assemble that which is lame, and I will gather that which is driven away, and that which I have afflicted;

hausa: In hankalin mai mulki ya tashi game da kai, kada ka bar inda kake, gama kwantar da hankali yakan sa a yafe manyan laifofi.
english: If the spirit of the ruler rises up against you, don’t leave your place; for gentleness lays great offenses to rest.

hausa: Amma mutum, kome arzikinsa, ba ya dawwama; shi kamar dabbobi ne da suke mutuwa.
english: But man, despite his riches, doesn’t endure. He is like the animals that perish.

hausa: Allolin al’umman da kakannina suka hallaka sun cece su ne, allolin Gozan, Haran, Rezef da kuma na mutanen Eden waɗanda suke zama a Tel Assar?
english: Have the gods of the nations delivered them, which my fathers have destroyed, Gozan, Haran, Rezeph, and the children of Eden who were in Telassar?

hausa: Gama Ubangiji Allahnku ya sa ruwan Urdun ya yanke a gabanku, har sai da kuka gama wucewa, kamar yadda ya yi a Jan Teku, a lokacin da ya busar da shi a gabanmu har sai da muka gama wucewa.
english: For Yahweh your God dried up the waters of the Jordan from before you until you had crossed over, as Yahweh your God did to the Red Sea, which he dried up from before us, until we had crossed over,

hausa: Saboda haka dole ku yi musu biyayya, ku kuma yi duk abin da suka faɗa muku. Sai dai kada ku yi abin da suke yi, gama ba sa yin abin da suke wa’azi.
english: All things therefore whatever they tell you to observe, observe and do, but don’t do their works; for they say, and don’t do.

hausa: Gama yawan hikima yakan kawo yawan baƙin ciki; yawan sani, yawan ɓacin rai.
english: For in much wisdom is much grief; and he who increases knowledge increases sorrow.

hausa: A Kaisariya akwai wani mutum mai suna Korneliyus, wani jarumin Roma ne, a ƙungiyar soja da ake kira Bataliyar Italiya.
english: Now there was a certain man in Caesarea, Cornelius by name, a centurion of what was called the Italian Regiment,

hausa: Ku tuna da abubuwan da suka riga suka faru, waɗannan na tun dā; ni ne Allah, kuma babu wani; ni ne Allah kuma babu wani kamar ni.
english: Remember the former things of old; for I am God, and there is no other. I am God, and there is none like me.

hausa: Ya kimanta yawan zinariya don dukan kayayyakin zinariyar da za a yi amfani a kowane irin hidima, da yawan azurfa don dukan kayayyakin azurfan da za a yi amfani a kowace irin hidima.
english: of gold by weight for the gold for all vessels of every kind of service, for all the vessels of silver by weight, for all vessels of every kind of service;

hausa: Ta Dawuda. Maskil ne. Mai farin ciki ne shi wanda aka gafarta masa laifofinsa, wanda aka shafe zunubansa.
english: By David. A contemplative psalm. Blessed is he whose disobedience is forgiven, whose sin is covered.

hausa: Allah ya ce wa Solomon, “Da yake wannan ne sha’awar zuciyarka, ba ka kuwa nemi wadata, arziki ko girma ba, ba ka kuma nemi mutuwar abokan gābanka ba, da yake kuma ba ka nemi tsawon rai ba, amma ka nemi hikima da sani don ka shugabanci jama’ata wadda na naɗa ka sarki,
english: God said to Solomon, “Because this was in your heart, and you have not asked riches, wealth, honor, or the life of those who hate you, nor yet have you asked for long life; but have asked for wisdom and knowledge for yourself, that you may judge my people, over whom I have made you king,

hausa: Ta shirya abincinta gauraye da ruwan inabinta; ta kuma shirya teburinta.
english: She has prepared her meat. She has mixed her wine. She has also set her table.

hausa: Bala’i zai fāɗo a kanki, kuma ba za ki san yadda za ki rinjaye shi yă janye ba. Masifa za tă fāɗo a kanki da ba za ki iya tsai da ita da kuɗin fansa ba; lalacewar da ba ki taɓa mafarkinta ba za tă auko miki nan da nan.
english: Therefore disaster will come on you. You won’t know when it dawns. Mischief will fall on you. You won’t be able to put it away. Desolation will come on you suddenly, which you don’t understand.

hausa: Saboda haka, ga abin da Ubangiji ya ce, ‘Ba za ka tashi daga inda kake kwance ba, ba shakka za ka mutu!’ ” Iliya ya yi kamar yadda Ubangiji ya umarce shi, sai ya tafi.
english: Now therefore Yahweh says, “You will not come down from the bed where you have gone up, but you will surely die.”’” Then Elijah departed.

hausa: Ko da yake ina sa zuciya zo wurinka nan ba da daɗewa ba, ina rubuta muka waɗannan umarnai domin,
english: These things I write to you, hoping to come to you shortly,

hausa: shuɗi, shunayya da jan zare, lallausan lilin, da gashin akuya;
english: blue, purple, scarlet, fine linen, goats’ hair,

hausa: Absalom kuwa bai yi wa Amnon wata magana ta alheri ko ta mugunta ba; ya ƙi jinin Amnon domin ya ci mutuncin ƙanuwarsa Tamar.
english: Absalom spoke to Amnon neither good nor bad; for Absalom hated Amnon, because he had forced his sister Tamar.

hausa: “ ‘In mutum ya kwana da mutum kamar yadda ake kwana da mace, su biyun sun yi abin ƙyama. Dole a kashe su, alhakin jininsu zai zauna a kansu.
english: “‘If a man lies with a male, as with a woman, both of them have committed an abomination. They shall surely be put to death. Their blood shall be upon themselves.

hausa: “Amma ina faɗa muku, ku da kuke ji na, ku ƙaunaci abokan gābanku, ku yi wa masu ƙinku alheri.
english: “But I tell you who hear: love your enemies, do good to those who hate you,

hausa: sai ka ji daga sama, mazauninka, ka ji addu’a da roƙonsu, ka kuma biya musu bukatansu.
english: then hear their prayer and their supplication in heaven, your dwelling place, and maintain their cause;

hausa: In kuwa Allah ya sami ɗaukaka a cikin Ɗan, Allah kuwa zai ɗaukaka Ɗan zuwa ga zatinsa, zai kuma ɗaukaka shi nan take.
english: If God has been glorified in him, God will also glorify him in himself, and he will glorify him immediately.

hausa: Ta kuma haifi wani ɗa har yanzu, aka kuwa ba shi suna Shela. A Kezib ne ta haife shi.
english: She yet again bore a son, and named him Shelah. He was at Chezib when she bore him.

hausa: Saboda haka sojojin, don cika umarni, suka ɗauki Bulus da dad dare suka kawo shi har Antifatiris.
english: So the soldiers, carrying out their orders, took Paul and brought him by night to Antipatris.

hausa: Sai murya ta fito daga sama ta ce, “Kai ne Ɗana, wanda nake ƙauna, da kai kuma nake fari ciki ƙwarai.”
english: A voice came out of the sky, “You are my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.”

hausa: Masu fariya ba za su iya tsaya a gabanka ba. Kana ƙin duk masu aikata abin da ba daidai ba.
english: The arrogant will not stand in your sight. You hate all workers of iniquity.

hausa: Sa’an nan Ibrahim ya ja numfashinsa na ƙarshe, ya kuma mutu da kyakkyawar tsufa, tsoho da kuma shekaru masu yawa; aka kuma tara shi ga mutanensa.
english: Abraham gave up his spirit, and died at a good old age, an old man, and full of years, and was gathered to his people.

hausa: Saboda haka Tattenai, gwamnan Kewayen Kogin Yuferites, da Shetar-Bozenai, da ku masu muƙami na yankin, ku bar wurin.
english: Now therefore, Tattenai, governor beyond the River, Shetharbozenai, and your companions the Apharsachites, who are beyond the River, you must stay far from there.

hausa: Ku ƙidaya dukan maza daga shekara talatin zuwa hamsin da suka zo domin aiki a Tentin Sujada.
english: from thirty years old and upward even until fifty years old, all who enter into the service to do the work in the Tent of Meeting.

hausa: Ni kamar mujiyar jeji ne, kamar mujiya a kufai.
english: I am like a pelican of the wilderness. I have become as an owl of the waste places.

hausa: Ga yadda aka yi wurin ajiye fitilan. An ƙera shi da zinariya daga gindinsa har zuwa sama inda ya buɗu. Aka ƙera wurin ajiye fitilan yadda Ubangiji ya nuna wa Musa.
english: This was the workmanship of the lamp stand, beaten work of gold. From its base to its flowers, it was beaten work. He made the lamp stand according to the pattern which Yahweh had shown Moses.

hausa: Sai Ubangiji ya miƙa hannunsa ya taɓa bakina ya ce mini, “Yanzu na sa kalmomina a bakinka.
english: Then Yahweh stretched out his hand and touched my mouth. Then Yahweh said to me, “Behold, I have put my words in your mouth.

hausa: Amma matan ta yi ciki, a shekara ta biye kuwa a daidai lokacin, sai ta haifi ɗa kamar yadda Elisha ya faɗa mata.
english: The woman conceived, and bore a son at that season when the time came around, as Elisha had said to her.

hausa: Ba a daɗe ba, sai Yesu ya tafi wani garin da ake kira Nayin. Almajiransa da taro mai yawa suka tafi tare da shi.
english: Soon afterwards, he went to a city called Nain. Many of his disciples, along with a great multitude, went with him.

hausa: Na kuma yi alkawari, zan fitar da ku daga azabarku a Masar zuwa ƙasar Kan’aniyawa, Hittiyawa, Amoriyawa, Ferizziyawa, Hiwiyawa da Yebusiyawa, ƙasa mai zub da madara da zuma.’
english: I have said, I will bring you up out of the affliction of Egypt to the land of the Canaanite, the Hittite, the Amorite, the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite, to a land flowing with milk and honey.”’

hausa: Bai isa ba ne da ka fitar da mu daga ƙasar mai zub da madara da zuma, ka kawo mu nan hamada don ka kashe mu? Yanzu kuma so kake ka mai da kanka sarki a bisanmu?
english: Is it a small thing that you have brought us up out of a land flowing with milk and honey, to kill us in the wilderness, but you must also make yourself a prince over us?

hausa: Gama Ubangiji zai fanshi Yaƙub zai cece su daga hannun waɗanda suka fi su ƙarfi.
english: For Yahweh has ransomed Jacob, and redeemed him from the hand of him who was stronger than he.

hausa: Razana da rami da tarko suna jiranku, Ya mutanen Mowab,” in ji Ubangiji.
english: Terror, the pit, and the snare are on you, inhabitant of Moab,” says Yahweh.

hausa: An ba da wannan mutum gare ku bisa ga nufin Allah da kuma rigyasaninsa, ku kuma tare da taimakon mugayen mutane, kuka kashe shi ta wurin kafa shi a kan gicciye.
english: him, being delivered up by the determined counsel and foreknowledge of God, you have taken by the hand of lawless men, crucified and killed;
