hausa: Tabbatacce, gare su ba ka fi mai waƙar ƙauna da murya mai daɗi kana kuma yin kiɗa sosai ba, gama sukan ji maganarka amma ba sa amfani da ita.
english: Behold, you are to them as a very lovely song of one who has a pleasant voice, and can play well on an instrument; for they hear your words, but they don’t do them.

hausa: Sai ya tambaye ni ya ce, “Me ka gani?” Sai na amsa na ce, “Na ga naɗaɗɗen littafi mai firiya, tsawonsa ƙafa talatin da fāɗinsa kuma ƙafa goma sha biyar.”
english: He said to me, “What do you see?” I answered, “I see a flying scroll; its length is twenty cubits, and its width ten cubits.”

hausa: Yakan tsawata wa teku yă kuma busar da shi; yakan sa dukan koguna su kafe. Bashan da Karmel sun yi yaushi tohon Lebanon kuma ya koɗe.
english: He rebukes the sea and makes it dry, and dries up all the rivers. Bashan and Carmel languish. The flower of Lebanon languishes.

hausa: Kun san saƙon da Allah ya aika wa mutanen Isra’ila, yana shelar labari mai daɗi na salama ta wurin Yesu Kiristi, shi ne kuwa Ubangijin kowa.
english: The word which he sent to the children of Israel, preaching good news of peace by Jesus Christ—he is Lord of all—

hausa: an ba su, Kiriyat Arba (wato, Hebron), da wurin kiwon da yake kewaye da ƙasar kan tudu ta Yahuda. (Arba shi ne kakan Anak.)
english: They gave them Kiriath Arba, named after the father of Anak (also called Hebron), in the hill country of Judah, with its pasture lands around it.

hausa: waɗanda suke cewa, “Bari Allah yă gaggauta, bari yă hanzarta aikinsa don mu gani. Bari yă iso, bari shirin Mai Tsarkin nan na Isra’ila yă zo, don mu sani.”
english: who say, “Let him make haste, let him hasten his work, that we may see it; let the counsel of the Holy One of Israel draw near and come, that we may know it!”

hausa: Nan da nan Yesu ya sa almajiransa su shiga jirgin ruwa, su sha gabansa zuwa Betsaida, shi kuma yă sallami taron.
english: Immediately he made his disciples get into the boat and go ahead to the other side, to Bethsaida, while he himself sent the multitude away.

hausa: Daga Mali, Eleyazar, wanda ba shi da ’ya’ya maza.
english: Of Mahli: Eleazar, who had no sons.

hausa: Bayansa, Yahuda mutumin Galili ya ɓullo a kwanakin ƙidaya, ya jagoranci mutane cikin tawaye. Shi ma aka kashe shi, dukan mabiyansa kuma aka watsar da su.
english: After this man, Judas of Galilee rose up in the days of the enrollment, and drew away some people after him. He also perished, and all, as many as obeyed him, were scattered abroad.

hausa: Ubangiji ya gina Urushalima; ya tattara kamammu na Isra’ilan da aka kai bauta.
english: Yahweh builds up Jerusalem. He gathers together the outcasts of Israel.

hausa: Ya kwashe dattawan garin ya koya wa mutanen Sukkot hankali ta wurin hukunta su da ƙayayyuwan hamada.
english: He took the elders of the city, and thorns of the wilderness and briers, and with them he taught the men of Succoth.

hausa: Ni kam ba zai taɓa yiwu in yi wa Ubangiji zunubi ta wurin ƙin yin addu’a dominku ba. Zan koya muku hanyar da tana da kyau da ta kuma cancanta.
english: Moreover, as for me, far be it from me that I should sin against Yahweh in ceasing to pray for you; but I will instruct you in the good and the right way.

hausa: Shi kuma ya aika, ya umarce ka cewa, ‘Tafi ka hallaka Amalekawa mugayen mutanen nan duka, ka yaƙe su sai ka share su ƙaf.’
english: and Yahweh sent you on a journey, and said, ‘Go, and utterly destroy the sinners the Amalekites, and fight against them until they are consumed.’

hausa: “Amma ya amsa ya ce, ‘Gaskiya nake gaya muku, ban san ku ba.’
english: But he answered, ‘Most certainly I tell you, I don’t know you.’

hausa: To, ga rabon da jama’a za su ba firistoci daga hadayun da suka miƙa ta bijimi ne, ko ta tunkiya ce; sai su ba firistoci kafaɗar, kumatun, da kuma kayan cikin.
english: This shall be the priests’ due from the people, from those who offer a sacrifice, whether it be ox or sheep, that they shall give to the priest: the shoulder, the two cheeks, and the inner parts.

hausa: Sai ya fitar da ni ta ƙofar arewa ya kewaye da ni ta waje zuwa ƙofar da take waje mai fuskantar gabas, ruwan kuwa yana malalowa daga wajen kudu.
english: Then he brought me out by the way of the gate northward, and led me around by the way outside to the outer gate, by the way of the gate that looks toward the east. Behold, waters ran out on the right side.

hausa: Shawulu ya saurari Yonatan sai ya rantse ya ce, “Muddin Ubangiji yana a raye, ba za a kashe Dawuda ba.”
english: Saul listened to the voice of Jonathan; and Saul swore, “As Yahweh lives, he shall not be put to death.”

hausa: Bayan wannan sai na ji abin da ya yi kamar ƙasaitaccen taron mutane a sama, suna cewa, “Halleluya! Ceto da ɗaukaka da iko sun tabbata ga Allahnmu,
english: After these things I heard something like a loud voice of a great multitude in heaven, saying, “Hallelujah! Salvation, power, and glory belong to our God;

hausa: to, sai ku lura, kada ku ɗaukaka kanku, har ku manta da Ubangiji Allahnku, wanda ya fitar da ku daga Masar, daga ƙasar bauta kuma.
english: then your heart might be lifted up, and you forget Yahweh your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage;

hausa: Saboda haka ya ce musu, “Don me kuke yin waɗannan abubuwa? Na sami labari daga wurin mutane a kan duk ayyukan muguntanku.
english: He said to them, “Why do you do such things? For I hear of your evil dealings from all these people.

hausa: Ku ne shaidun waɗannan abubuwa.
english: You are witnesses of these things.

hausa: ta kuma ɗaura su da akwasha. Ta sāke yin ihu ta ce, “Samson ga Filistiyawa sun zo su kama ka.” Ya tashi daga barcinsa ya tumɓuke akwashan tare da zaren da aka ɗaura gashin kansa da su.
english: She fastened it with the pin, and said to him, “The Philistines are on you, Samson!” He awakened out of his sleep, and plucked away the pin of the beam and the fabric.

hausa: ko da waɗannan mutum uku Nuhu, Daniyel da kuma Ayuba suna a cikinta, za su iya ceton kansu ne kawai ta wurin adalcinsu, in ji Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka.
english: though these three men, Noah, Daniel, and Job, were in it, they would deliver only their own souls by their righteousness,” says the Lord Yahweh.

hausa: Sarki ya cire zobensa na hatimi, wanda ya karɓo daga Haman ya ba Mordekai. Esta kuma ta naɗa shi a kan mallakar Haman.
english: The king took off his ring, which he had taken from Haman, and gave it to Mordecai. Esther set Mordecai over the house of Haman.

hausa: Da suka ɗaga kai, ba su ga kowa ba sai Yesu kaɗai.
english: Lifting up their eyes, they saw no one, except Jesus alone.

hausa: Addu’ar da aka yi cikin bangaskiya, za tă warkar da marar lafiya, Ubangiji zai tashe shi. In ya yi zunubi kuwa za a gafarta masa.
english: and the prayer of faith will heal him who is sick, and the Lord will raise him up. If he has committed sins, he will be forgiven.

hausa: Saboda haka, da yake ni da kaina na binciko kome a hankali daga farko, na ga ya yi kyau in rubuta maka labarin dalla-dalla, ya mafifici Tiyofilus,
english: it seemed good to me also, having traced the course of all things accurately from the first, to write to you in order, most excellent Theophilus;

hausa: Za a hallakar da Mowab a matsayin al’umma domin ta tayar wa Ubangiji.
english: Moab will be destroyed from being a people, because he has magnified himself against Yahweh.

hausa: da na tafi can da nisa na zauna a hamada; Sela
english: Behold, then I would wander far off. I would lodge in the wilderness.” Selah.

hausa: Domin zuciyarka mai tuba ce, ka kuma ƙasƙantar da kanka a gaban Allah sa’ad da ka ji abin da ya yi magana a kan wannan wuri da mutanensa, domin kuma ka ƙasƙantar da kanka a gabana, ka yage rigunanka ka kuma yi kuka a gabana, na ji ka, in ji Ubangiji.
english: because your heart was tender, and you humbled yourself before God when you heard his words against this place and against its inhabitants, and have humbled yourself before me, and have torn your clothes and wept before me, I also have heard you,” says Yahweh.

hausa: Dukan wannan hikimar takan zo daga Ubangiji Maɗaukaki ne, shi da yake mashawarci mai banmamaki, mafifici kuma cikin hikima.
english: This also comes out from Yahweh of Armies, who is wonderful in counsel, and excellent in wisdom.

hausa: Yusuf kuwa ya sa ’ya’yan Isra’ila maza suka yi rantsuwa, ya kuma ce, “Tabbatacce Allah zai taimake ku, ku kuma dole ku ɗauki ƙasusuwana, ku haura da su daga wannan wuri.”
english: Joseph took an oath from the children of Israel, saying, “God will surely visit you, and you shall carry up my bones from here.”

hausa: Zan ƙara maka shekara goma sha biyar. Zan kuma cece ka daga hannun sarkin Assuriya. Zan kāre birnin nan saboda kaina da kuma bawana Dawuda.’ ”
english: I will add to your days fifteen years. I will deliver you and this city out of the hand of the king of Assyria. I will defend this city for my own sake, and for my servant David’s sake.”’”

hausa: Sai yă je yă ɗebo waɗansu ruhohi bakwai da suka fi shi mugunta, su kuwa zo su shiga su zauna a can. Ƙarshen mutumin nan fa zai fi farkonsa muni. Haka zai zama ga wannan mugun zamani.”
english: Then he goes and takes with himself seven other spirits more evil than he is, and they enter in and dwell there. The last state of that man becomes worse than the first. Even so will it be also to this evil generation.”

hausa: Sai waninsu, mai suna Kayifas, wanda ya kasance babban firist a shekarar ya ce, “Ku dai ba ku san kome ba!
english: But a certain one of them, Caiaphas, being high priest that year, said to them, “You know nothing at all,

hausa: Masu wucewa, suka zazzage shi, suna kaɗa kai,
english: Those who passed by blasphemed him, wagging their heads

hausa: Sa’ad da aka hukunta mai ba’a marasa azanci suka yi wayo; sa’ad da aka yi wa mai hikima umarni yakan sami sani.
english: When the mocker is punished, the simple gains wisdom. When the wise is instructed, he receives knowledge.

hausa: Kaitonsu! Gama sun kama hanyar Kayinu; sun ruga a guje garin neman riba cikin kuskure kamar Bala’am; aka kuma hallaka su cikin tawayen Kora.
english: Woe to them! For they went in the way of Cain, and ran riotously in the error of Balaam for hire, and perished in Korah’s rebellion.

hausa: A haɗa da bunsuru guda a matsayin hadaya don zunubi, ban da hadaya ta ƙonawa ta kullum, tare da hadayarta ta gari da hadaya ta sha.
english: and one male goat for a sin offering, in addition to the continual burnt offering, and its meal offering, and its drink offering.

hausa: Akan mai da ƙasa a kan gawarsa a hankali; dukan jama’a suna binsa, da yawa kuma suna gabansa.
english: The clods of the valley will be sweet to him. All men will draw after him, as there were innumerable before him.

hausa: Allah ya kira sararin “sama.” Yamma ta kasance, safiya kuma ta kasance, kwana ta biyu ke nan.
english: God called the expanse “sky”. There was evening and there was morning, a second day.

hausa: Ya takobi, yi sara zuwa dama ka yi kuma zuwa hagu, duk inda aka juya ka.
english: Gather yourselves together. Go to the right. Set yourselves in array. Go to the left, wherever your face is set.

hausa: Ku yi hankali cewa ba ku manta da Ubangiji Allahnku, har ku kāsa kiyaye umarnansa, dokokinsa da ƙa’idodinsa da nake ba ku a wannan rana ba.
english: Beware lest you forget Yahweh your God, in not keeping his commandments, his ordinances, and his statutes, which I command you today;

hausa: gama mulki na Ubangiji ne kuma yana mulki a bisa al’ummai.
english: For the kingdom is Yahweh’s. He is the ruler over the nations.

hausa: Ka saurara! Ka saurari rurin muryarsa, tsawar da take fita daga bakinsa.
english: Hear, oh, hear the noise of his voice, the sound that goes out of his mouth.

hausa: ‘Ga abin da Ubangiji ya ce, “Kada ku haura don ku yi yaƙi da ’yan’uwanku, Isra’ilawa. Ku koma gida, kowannenku, gama wannan aikina ne.” ’ ” Saboda haka suka yi biyayya da maganar Ubangiji, suka sāke watse zuwa gida, yadda Ubangiji ya umarta.
english: ‘Yahweh says, “You shall not go up or fight against your brothers, the children of Israel. Everyone return to his house; for this thing is from me.”’” So they listened to Yahweh’s word, and returned and went their way, according to Yahweh’s word.

hausa: Dukan mazan Yahuda, tare da matansu da yaransu da ƙananansu, suka tsaya a gaban Ubangiji.
english: All Judah stood before Yahweh, with their little ones, their wives, and their children.

hausa: Ta haka za mu tabbata cewa mun san shi in muna yin biyayya da umarnansa.
english: This is how we know that we know him: if we keep his commandments.

hausa: Yayinda Yesu yake a Betani, a gidan wani mutumin da ake kira Siman Kuturu,
english: Now when Jesus was in Bethany, in the house of Simon the leper,

hausa: Zukatansu sun yi tauri da kuma marasa tausayi amma ina farin ciki a dokarka.
english: Their heart is as callous as the fat, but I delight in your law.

hausa: Suka fa kawo akwatin alkawarin Allah, suka sa a cikin tentin da Dawuda ya kafa dominsa, suka kuma miƙa hadayun ƙonawa da hadayu na salama a gaban Allah.
english: They brought in God’s ark, and set it in the middle of the tent that David had pitched for it; and they offered burnt offerings and peace offerings before God.

hausa: Ina kallo yayinda ya buɗe hatimi na shida. Sai aka yi babban girgizar ƙasa. Rana ta zama baƙa kamar gwado na gashin akuya, wata kuma gaba ɗaya ya zama ja wur kamar jini,
english: I saw when he opened the sixth seal, and there was a great earthquake. The sun became black as sackcloth made of hair, and the whole moon became as blood.

hausa: Ka janye hannunka nesa da ni, ka daina ba ni tsoro da bantsoronka.
english: withdraw your hand far from me, and don’t let your terror make me afraid.

hausa: Da lokaci ya yi, sai Yesu ya zauna tare da manzanninsa don cin abinci.
english: When the hour had come, he sat down with the twelve apostles.

hausa: Mefiboshet, jikan Shawulu, shi ma ya gangara don yă taryi sarki. Tun daga ranar da sarki ya gudu har ran da ya komo lafiya, Mefiboshet bai lura da ƙafafunsa, ko yă aske gemunsa, ko yă wanke tufafinsa ba.
english: Mephibosheth the son of Saul came down to meet the king; and he had neither groomed his feet, nor trimmed his beard, nor washed his clothes, from the day the king departed until the day he came home in peace.

hausa: Jiragen ruwa yammancin bakin teku za su yi gāba da shi, zuciyarsa kuwa za tă yi sanyi. Sa’an nan zai juya ya huce haushinsa a kan tsattsarkan alkawari. Zai komo yă nuna jinƙai ga waɗanda suka juya wa tsattsarkan alkawari baya.
english: For ships of Kittim will come against him. Therefore he will be grieved, and will return, and have indignation against the holy covenant, and will take action. He will even return, and have regard to those who forsake the holy covenant.

hausa: Tabbatacce Allah zai kai ka ga madawwamiyar hallaka. Zai fizge ka yă yayyage ka daga tentinka; zai tumɓuke ka daga ƙasar masu rai. Sela
english: God will likewise destroy you forever. He will take you up, and pluck you out of your tent, and root you out of the land of the living. Selah.

hausa: Kyauta kan buɗe hanya wa mai bayarwa yakan kuma kai shi a gaban babban mutum.
english: A man’s gift makes room for him, and brings him before great men.

hausa: Rehobowam ya auri Mahalat, ’yar Yerimot ɗan Dawuda wadda Abihayil ’yar Eliyab ɗan Yesse ta haifa.
english: Rehoboam took a wife for himself, Mahalath the daughter of Jerimoth the son of David and of Abihail the daughter of Eliab the son of Jesse.

hausa: Sai ya ba komandodin māsu da garkuwoyi da dā suke na Dawuda, waɗanda suke a cikin haikalin Ubangiji.
english: The priest delivered to the captains over hundreds the spears and shields that had been King David’s, which were in Yahweh’s house.

hausa: Saboda haka Dawuda ya ce wa Yowab da shugabannin mayaƙa, “Ku tafi ku ƙidaya Isra’ilawa daga Beyersheba zuwa Dan. Ku kawo mini labarin saboda in san su nawa ne.”
english: David said to Joab and to the princes of the people, “Go, count Israel from Beersheba even to Dan; and bring me word, that I may know how many there are.”

hausa: Sa’ad da Yerobowam ɗan Nebat ya ji labari (gama har yanzu yana a Masar, inda ya gudu daga Sarki Solomon), sai ya dawo daga Masar.
english: When Jeroboam the son of Nebat heard of it (for he was yet in Egypt, where he had fled from the presence of King Solomon, and Jeroboam lived in Egypt;

hausa: Ku sa hankulanku a kan abubuwan sama, ba kan abubuwan duniya ba.
english: Set your mind on the things that are above, not on the things that are on the earth.

hausa: Ku ci kowane abin da ake sayarwa a kasuwar nama ba sai kun tambaya ba don kada lamiri yă damu da inda abin ya fito,
english: Whatever is sold in the butcher shop, eat, asking no question for the sake of conscience,

hausa: domin an tsarkake shi ta wurin maganar Allah da kuma addu’a.
english: For it is sanctified through the word of God and prayer.

hausa: A haɗa da bunsuru guda a matsayin hadaya don zunubi, ban da hadaya ta ƙonawa ta kullum, tare da hadayarta ta gari da hadaya ta sha.
english: and one male goat for a sin offering, in addition to the continual burnt offering, and its meal offering, and its drink offering.

hausa: Sa’ad da na ce, “Ƙafata na santsi,” ƙaunarka, ya Ubangiji, ta riƙe ni.
english: When I said, “My foot is slipping!” Your loving kindness, Yahweh, held me up.

hausa: to, zan shimfiɗa ulu a masussuka, inda safe akwai raɓa a kan ulun kaɗai, ƙasa kuwa a bushe, to, zan san cewa za ka ceci Isra’ila ta hannuna, yadda ka ce.”
english: behold, I will put a fleece of wool on the threshing floor. If there is dew on the fleece only, and it is dry on all the ground, then I’ll know that you will save Israel by my hand, as you have spoken.”

hausa: kada ka yi taƙama cewa ka fi waɗancan rassan da aka sassare. In kuwa ka yi haka, to, ka yi la’akari da wannan. Ba kai ne kake taimakon saiwar ba, saiwar ce take taimakonka.
english: don’t boast over the branches. But if you boast, remember that it is not you who support the root, but the root supports you.

hausa: Da Yesu ya tashi daga matattu da safe, a ranar farko ta mako, ya fara bayyana ga Maryamu Magdalin, wadda ya fitar da aljanu bakwai daga cikinta.
english: Now when he had risen early on the first day of the week, he appeared first to Mary Magdalene, from whom he had cast out seven demons.

hausa: Bai kamata in hukunta su saboda wannan ba?” In ji Ubangiji. “Bai kamata in ɗau fansa a kan irin al’umma kamar wannan ba?”
english: Shouldn’t I punish them for these things?” says Yahweh. “Shouldn’t my soul be avenged on a nation such as this?

hausa: Zan ba da ɗaya ga ɗansa don kullum Dawuda bawana yă kasance da fitila a gabana a Urushalima, birnin da na zaɓa in sa Sunana.
english: I will give one tribe to his son, that David my servant may have a lamp always before me in Jerusalem, the city which I have chosen for myself to put my name there.

hausa: Da Isra’ilawa suka yi ƙarfi, sai suka sa Kan’aniyawa suka zama masu yin musu aiki, amma ba su iya korarsu duka ba.
english: When the children of Israel had grown strong, they put the Canaanites to forced labor, and didn’t utterly drive them out.

hausa: Yesu ya ce, “Ku ƙyale ta, an nufa ta ajiye wannan turaren don ranar jana’izata.
english: But Jesus said, “Leave her alone. She has kept this for the day of my burial.

hausa: Yesse ya ce wa ɗansa Dawuda, “Ka ɗauki wannan gasasshen hatsi da waɗannan curin burodi goma, ka kai wa ’yan’uwanka a sansani da sauri.
english: Jesse said to David his son, “Now take for your brothers an ephah of this parched grain and these ten loaves, and carry them quickly to the camp to your brothers;

hausa: To, aka kai Yusuf Masar, Fotifar wani mutumin Masar wanda yake ɗaya daga cikin hafsoshin Fir’auna, shugaban masu tsaro, ya saye shi daga mutanen Ishmayel waɗanda suka kai shi can.
english: Joseph was brought down to Egypt. Potiphar, an officer of Pharaoh’s, the captain of the guard, an Egyptian, bought him from the hand of the Ishmaelites that had brought him down there.

hausa: Karar fikafikan rayayyun halittun nan ne suke goge junansu da kuma karar da’irorin nan da suke kusa da su, ƙarar babban motsi.
english: I heard the noise of the wings of the living creatures as they touched one another, and the noise of the wheels beside them, even the noise of a great rushing.

hausa: “ ‘Babban firist, wanda yake ɗaya cikin ’yan’uwansa wanda aka shafe da mai a kansa, wanda kuma aka naɗa don yă sa rigunan firistoci, kada yă bar gashin kansa buzu-buzu, ko ya kyakketa rigunansa.
english: “‘He who is the high priest among his brothers, upon whose head the anointing oil is poured, and who is consecrated to put on the garments, shall not let the hair of his head hang loose, or tear his clothes.

hausa: Amma Allah zai ceci raina daga kabari; tabbatacce zai ɗauke ni zuwa wurinsa. Sela
english: But God will redeem my soul from the power of Sheol, for he will receive me. Selah.

hausa: Kashegari ya fita, sai ya ga Ibraniyawa biyu suna faɗa. Ya tambayi mai laifin ya ce, “Don me kake bugun ɗan’uwanka, mutumin Ibraniyawa?”
english: He went out the second day, and behold, two men of the Hebrews were fighting with each other. He said to him who did the wrong, “Why do you strike your fellow?”

hausa: Ubangiji ya damu da ya yi mutum a duniya, abin ya zafe shi ƙwarai.
english: Yahweh was sorry that he had made man on the earth, and it grieved him in his heart.

hausa: Bayan Filistiyawa sun ƙwace akwatin alkawarin Allah, sai suka ɗauke shi daga Ebenezer suka kai shi Ashdod.
english: Now the Philistines had taken God’s ark, and they brought it from Ebenezer to Ashdod.

hausa: Al’ummai za su ga adalcinki, sarakuna kuma za su ga ɗaukakarki; za a kira ki da sabon suna sunan da bakin Ubangiji zai ambata.
english: The nations will see your righteousness, and all kings your glory. You will be called by a new name, which Yahweh’s mouth will name.

hausa: Gama mene ne rabon mutum daga Allah a sama, gādonsa daga Maɗaukaki a sama?
english: For what is the portion from God above, and the heritage from the Almighty on high?

hausa: Za ku iya cin kowane irin fāra, gyare, ƙwanso da danginsu.
english: Even of these you may eat: any kind of locust, any kind of katydid, any kind of cricket, and any kind of grasshopper.

hausa: “Sa’an nan za a bashe ku don a tsananta muku a kuma kashe ku, dukan al’ummai za su ƙi ku saboda ni.
english: “Then they will deliver you up to oppression and will kill you. You will be hated by all of the nations for my name’s sake.

hausa: Haka waɗansu a cikinku ma suke a dā. Amma an wanke ku, an tsarkake ku, aka kuma sa kuka zama marasa laifi cikin sunan Ubangijinmu Yesu Kiristi da kuma ta wurin Ruhun Allahnmu.
english: Some of you were such, but you were washed. You were sanctified. You were justified in the name of the Lord Jesus, and in the Spirit of our God.

hausa: Za a karye Mowab; ƙanananta za su yi kuka.
english: Moab is destroyed. Her little ones have caused a cry to be heard.

hausa: Ka zo kusa lokacin da na kira ka, kuma ka ce mini, “Kada ka ji tsoro.”
english: You came near in the day that I called on you. You said, “Don’t be afraid.”

hausa: sai ga shanu bakwai masu ƙiba mulmul, suka fito daga kogin, suna kiwo a cikin kyauro.
english: Behold, seven cattle came up out of the river. They were sleek and fat, and they fed in the marsh grass.

hausa: Don mai bi da kaɗe-kaɗe. Don Yedutun. Zabura ta Dawuda. Na ce, “Zan lura da hanyoyina zan kuma kiyaye harshena daga zunubi; zan sa linzami a bakina muddin mugaye suna a gabana.”
english: For the Chief Musician. For Jeduthun. A Psalm by David. I said, “I will watch my ways, so that I don’t sin with my tongue. I will keep my mouth with a bridle while the wicked is before me.”

hausa: Waƙar haurawa. Ta Solomon. In ba Ubangiji ne ya gina gida ba, masu gininta suna wahala a banza ne. In ba Ubangiji ne yake tsaron birni ba, masu tsaro suna yin tsaro a banza.
english: A Song of Ascents. By Solomon. Unless Yahweh builds the house, they who build it labor in vain. Unless Yahweh watches over the city, the watchman guards it in vain.

hausa: “Babu salama ga mugaye” in ji Ubangiji.
english: “There is no peace”, says Yahweh, “for the wicked.”

hausa: Sai Isra’ilawa suka amsa, suka ce, “Za mu bi ta babbar hanya, in mu, ko dabbobinmu suka sha ruwanku, za mu biya. Mu dai muna so mu wuce ne kawai.”
english: The children of Israel said to him, “We will go up by the highway; and if we drink your water, I and my livestock, then I will give its price. Only let me, without doing anything else, pass through on my feet.”

hausa: don aikin zinariya da kuma aikin azurfa, don kuma dukan aikin da gwanaye za su yi. Yanzu fa wa yake da niyya yă miƙa kansa a yau don Ubangiji?”
english: of gold for the things of gold, and of silver for the things of silver, and for all kinds of work to be made by the hands of artisans. Who then offers willingly to consecrate himself today to Yahweh?”

hausa: Duk mutane za su ƙi ku saboda ni.
english: You will be hated by all men for my name’s sake.

hausa: Akwai Yowel, da Yehu ɗan Yoshibiya. Yoshibiya ɗan Seraya ne. Serahiya kuma ɗan Asiyel ne.
english: Joel, Jehu the son of Joshibiah, the son of Seraiah, the son of Asiel,

hausa: (Isra’ilawa suka kama hanya daga rijiyoyin Beyerot Bene Ya’akan zuwa Mosera. A can Haruna ya rasu, aka kuma binne shi. Sai Eleyazar ɗansa ya gāje shi a matsayin firist.
english: (The children of Israel traveled from Beeroth Bene Jaakan to Moserah. There Aaron died, and there he was buried; and Eleazar his son ministered in the priest’s office in his place.

hausa: Ta wurin nasarorin da ka ba shi, ɗaukakarsa mai girma ce; ka mayar masa ɗaukaka da kuma suna.
english: His glory is great in your salvation. You lay honor and majesty on him.

hausa: Kamannin halittun ya yi kamar garwashi mai cin wuta ko kuwa kamar fitilu. Wuta tana kai da kawowa a cikin halittun; ta yi haske ƙwarai, walƙiya kuma tana wulgawa daga cikinta.
english: As for the likeness of the living creatures, their appearance was like burning coals of fire, like the appearance of torches. The fire went up and down among the living creatures. The fire was bright, and lightning went out of the fire.

hausa: Da ƙarfafa dawakan suka fito, sai suka yi marmari su ratsa dukan duniya. Sai ya ce, “Ku ratsa dukan duniya!” Saboda haka suka ratsa dukan duniya.
english: The strong went out, and sought to go that they might walk back and forth through the earth. He said, “Go around and through the earth!” So they walked back and forth through the earth.

hausa: Baftismar Yohanna, daga ina ta fito? Daga sama ce, ko daga mutane?” Sai suka tattauna a junansu suka ce, “In muka ce, ‘Daga sama,’ zai ce, ‘To, me ya sa ba mu gaskata shi ba?’
english: The baptism of John, where was it from? From heaven or from men?” They reasoned with themselves, saying, “If we say, ‘From heaven,’ he will ask us, ‘Why then did you not believe him?’

hausa: gama sun ɗauke ku a matsayin abokan gāba, sa’ad da suka ruɗe ku a kan al’amuran Feyor da ’yar’uwarsu Kozbi ’yar shugaban Midiyawa, macen da aka kashe a annoba ta dalili Feyor.”
english: for they harassed you with their wiles, wherein they have deceived you in the matter of Peor, and in the incident regarding Cozbi, the daughter of the prince of Midian, their sister, who was slain on the day of the plague in the matter of Peor.”

hausa: Bisa ga umarnin sarki, sai ’yan aika suka tafi ko’ina a Isra’ila da Yahuda da wasiƙu daga sarki da kuma daga fadawansa, wasiƙar tana cewa, “Mutanen Isra’ila, ku dawo ga Ubangiji Allah na Ibrahim, Ishaku da Isra’ila, domin yă dawo gare ku, ku da kuka tafi, ku da kuka kuɓuce daga hannun sarakuna Assuriya.
english: So the couriers went with the letters from the king and his princes throughout all Israel and Judah, according to the commandment of the king, saying, “You children of Israel, turn again to Yahweh, the God of Abraham, Isaac, and Israel, that he may return to the remnant of you that have escaped out of the hand of the kings of Assyria.

hausa: Kuna bukata ku jimre don sa’ad da kuka aikata nufin Allah, za ku karɓi abin da ya yi alkawari.
english: For you need endurance so that, having done the will of God, you may receive the promise.

hausa: Labulen haikali kuwa ya yage kashi biyu, daga sama har ƙasa.
english: The veil of the temple was torn in two from the top to the bottom.

hausa: To, Yerobowam mutum ne mai fasaha. Sa’ad da Solomon ya ga yadda matashin yake aiki da himma, sai ya sa shi yă lura da dukan aikin gandu na gidan Yusuf.
english: The man Jeroboam was a mighty man of valor; and Solomon saw that the young man was industrious, and he put him in charge of all the labor of the house of Joseph.

hausa: Cike da tausayi, sai Yesu ya miƙa hannunsa ya taɓa mutumin ya ce, “Na yarda, ka tsabtacce!”
english: Being moved with compassion, he stretched out his hand, and touched him, and said to him, “I want to. Be made clean.”

hausa: Gideyon da mutum ɗari da suke tare da shi suka kai sansanin da tsakar dare bayan an sauya matsara. Suka busa ƙahoninsu, suka farfashe tulunansu da suke hannuwansu.
english: So Gideon and the hundred men who were with him came to the outermost part of the camp in the beginning of the middle watch, when they had but newly set the watch. Then they blew the trumpets and broke in pieces the pitchers that were in their hands.

hausa: Dukan Isra’ila kuwa za su yi makoki dominsa. Shi ne kaɗai na Yerobowam wanda za a binne, domin shi ne kaɗai a gidan Yerobowam wanda Ubangiji, Allah na Isra’ila ya sami wani ɗan abu mai kyau a kansa.
english: All Israel will mourn for him and bury him; for he only of Jeroboam will come to the grave, because in him there is found some good thing toward Yahweh, the God of Israel, in the house of Jeroboam.

hausa: Wata rana mugun ruhu ya amsa musu ya ce, “Yesu kam na sani, Bulus kuma na sani, amma ku kuma su wane ne?”
english: The evil spirit answered, “Jesus I know, and Paul I know, but who are you?”

hausa: sa’an nan yă kāsa samun ninkinsu ɗari a zamanin yanzu (na gidaje, da ’yan’uwa mata, da ’yan’uwa maza, da uwaye, da ’ya’ya, da gonaki amma tare da tsanani) a lahira kuma yă sami rai madawwami.
english: but he will receive one hundred times more now in this time: houses, brothers, sisters, mothers, children, and land, with persecutions; and in the age to come eternal life.

hausa: “Saboda haka ga abin da Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka yana cewa gawawwakin da kuka zubar a can su ne naman, wannan birni kuwa ita ce tukunya, amma zan kore ku daga cikinta.
english: “‘Therefore the Lord Yahweh says: “Your slain whom you have laid in the middle of it, they are the meat, and this is the cauldron; but you will be brought out of the middle of it.

hausa: da Hadid, da Zeboyim, da Neballat,
english: Hadid, Zeboim, Neballat,

hausa: Sai Yesu ya ce mata, “Diyata, bangaskiyarki ta warkar da ke. Ki sauka lafiya.”
english: He said to her, “Daughter, cheer up. Your faith has made you well. Go in peace.”

hausa: Sai ya ce wa Kora da dukan waɗannan da suke tare shi, “Da safe, Ubangiji zai nuna wane ne yake nasa, da kuma wane ne yake da tsarki. Zai kuma sa mutumin yă zo kusa da shi. Mutumin da ya zaɓa kuwa zai sa yă zo kusa da shi.
english: He said to Korah and to all his company, “In the morning, Yahweh will show who are his, and who is holy, and will cause him to come near to him. Even him whom he shall choose, he will cause to come near to him.

hausa: Gama ko da yake sun san Allah, ba su ɗaukaka shi a matsayin Allah ko su gode masa ba, sai dai tunaninsu ya zama banza, zukatansu masu wauta kuma suka duhunta.
english: Because knowing God, they didn’t glorify him as God, and didn’t give thanks, but became vain in their reasoning, and their senseless heart was darkened.

hausa: Da aka yi shelar umarni da dokar sarki, sai aka kawo ’yan mata masu yawa a mazaunin masarauta a Shusha, aka kuma sa su ƙarƙashin kulawar Hegai. Aka kawo Esta ma zuwa fadar sarki, aka danƙa ta wa Hegai, wanda yake lura da mata.
english: So, when the king’s commandment and his decree was heard, and when many maidens were gathered together to the citadel of Susa, to the custody of Hegai, Esther was taken into the king’s house, to the custody of Hegai, keeper of the women.

hausa: Ka koya wa bayi su yi wa iyayengijinsu biyayya cikin kowane abu, su yi ƙoƙari su gamshe su, kada su mayar musu da magana,
english: Exhort servants to be in subjection to their own masters and to be well-pleasing in all things, not contradicting,

hausa: gama yana da daɗi sa’ad da ka kiyaye su a zuciyarka ka kuma kasance da su a shirye a leɓunanka.
english: For it is a pleasant thing if you keep them within you, if all of them are ready on your lips.

hausa: Sa’an nan dole macen ta jira kwana talatin don a tsabtacce ta daga zub da jini. Ba za tă taɓa wani abu mai tsarki, ko ta je wuri mai tsarki ba sai kwanakin tsabtaccewarta sun cika.
english: She shall continue in the blood of purification thirty-three days. She shall not touch any holy thing, nor come into the sanctuary, until the days of her purifying are completed.

hausa: Ya ce, “Mun kwaɓe ku da gaske kada ku ƙara koyarwa cikin wannan suna, duk da haka kun cika Urushalima da koyarwarku, har ma kuna so ku ɗora mana laifin jinin mutumin nan.”
english: saying, “Didn’t we strictly command you not to teach in this name? Behold, you have filled Jerusalem with your teaching, and intend to bring this man’s blood on us.”

hausa: “Da hannuwanka ka ƙera ni, kai ka halicce ni. Yanzu kuma kai za ka juya ka hallaka ni?
english: “‘Your hands have framed me and fashioned me altogether, yet you destroy me.

hausa: ’Ya’yansa maza kuwa Ishaku da Ishmayel suka binne shi cikin kogon Makfela, kusa da Mamre, a cikin filin Efron ɗan Zohar mutumin Hitti,
english: Isaac and Ishmael, his sons, buried him in the cave of Machpelah, in the field of Ephron, the son of Zohar the Hittite, which is near Mamre,

hausa: Ya kuma kawo hadaya ta gari, ya ɗiba a tafi hannu ya ƙone a kan bagade tare da hadaya ta ƙonawa ta safe.
english: He presented the meal offering, and filled his hand from there, and burned it upon the altar, in addition to the burnt offering of the morning.

hausa: “Na ji irin zagin da Mowab take yi, da kuma ba’ar Ammonawa, waɗanda suka zagi mutanena suna kuma yi barazana a kan ƙasarsu.
english: I have heard the reproach of Moab and the insults of the children of Ammon, with which they have reproached my people and magnified themselves against their border.

hausa: Ga abin da Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka yake faɗa, Kaiton wawaye annabawan da suke bin ruhunsu kuma ba su ga kome ba!
english: The Lord Yahweh says, “Woe to the foolish prophets, who follow their own spirit, and have seen nothing!

hausa: “Ku zo, dukanku masu jin ƙishi, ku zo wurin ruwaye; ku kuma da ba ku da kuɗi, ku zo, ku saya ku kuma ci! Ku zo, ku saya ruwan inabi da madara ba tare da kuɗi ba ba za ku kuma biya kome ba.
english: “Hey! Come, everyone who thirsts, to the waters! Come, he who has no money, buy, and eat! Yes, come, buy wine and milk without money and without price.

hausa: Suka taurare zukatansu kamar dutse, suka ƙi jin abin da doka ko kuma maganar Ubangiji Maɗaukaki take faɗi wadda ya aika ta wurin Ruhunsa ta wurin annabawan farko. Saboda haka Ubangiji Maɗaukaki ya ji fushi ƙwarai.
english: Yes, they made their hearts as hard as flint, lest they might hear the law and the words which Yahweh of Armies had sent by his Spirit by the former prophets. Therefore great wrath came from Yahweh of Armies.

hausa: Ka faɗa wa kurmin kudanci, ‘Ji maganar Ubangiji. Ga abin da Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka yana cewa ina gab da sa maka wuta, za tă kuwa cinye dukan itatuwanki sarai, da ɗanye da busasshe. Ba za a kashe wutar da take ci ba, kuma kowace fuska a kudu zuwa arewa za tă ƙone.
english: Tell the forest of the south, ‘Hear Yahweh’s word: The Lord Yahweh says, “Behold, I will kindle a fire in you, and it will devour every green tree in you, and every dry tree. The burning flame will not be quenched, and all faces from the south to the north will be burned by it.

hausa: Sai Dawuda ya ce wa Allah, “Na yi zunubi ƙwarai ta wurin yin wannan. Yanzu, na roƙe ka, ka ɗauke laifin bawanka. Na yi wauta sosai.”
english: David said to God, “I have sinned greatly, in that I have done this thing. But now put away, I beg you, the iniquity of your servant, for I have done very foolishly.”

hausa: Amma Ubangiji zai raba tsakanin dabbobin Isra’ila da na Masar, saboda kada wata dabbar Isra’ilawa ta mutu.’ ”
english: Yahweh will make a distinction between the livestock of Israel and the livestock of Egypt; and nothing shall die of all that belongs to the children of Israel.”’”

hausa: Kenaz, Teman, Mibzar,
english: chief Kenaz, chief Teman, chief Mibzar,

hausa: Domin sun yashe ni suka kuma ƙone turare wa waɗansu alloli, suka tsokane ni in yi fushi ta wurin dukan abin da hannuwansu suka yi, fushina zai zuba a kan wannan wuri, ba kuma za a kwantar da shi ba.’
english: Because they have forsaken me, and have burned incense to other gods, that they might provoke me to anger with all the works of their hands, therefore my wrath is poured out on this place, and it will not be quenched.’”’

hausa: Saboda haka mutane suka warwatsu ko’ina a Masar domin tattara bunnun da za su yi amfani da su, maimakon tattaka.
english: So the people were scattered abroad throughout all the land of Egypt to gather stubble for straw.

hausa: Ka ce kana da dabara da ƙarfin soji, amma bagu kawai kake yi. Da wa ka dogara har da za ka yi mini tawaye?
english: You say (but they are but vain words), ‘There is counsel and strength for war.’ Now on whom do you trust, that you have rebelled against me?

hausa: Sa’ad da Feleg ya yi shekaru 30, sai ya haifi Reyu.
english: Peleg lived thirty years, and became the father of Reu.

hausa: Shi babban maharbi ne a gaban Ubangiji. Shi ya sa akan ce, kamar Nimrod babban maharbi a gaban Ubangiji.
english: He was a mighty hunter before Yahweh. Therefore it is said, “like Nimrod, a mighty hunter before Yahweh”.

hausa: Suka bi shi domin ya daɗe yana ba su mamaki da sihirinsa.
english: They listened to him because for a long time he had amazed them with his sorceries.

hausa: Gama lokaci ya yi da za a fara yi wa iyalin Allah shari’a; in kuwa ya fara da mu, to, me zai faru da waɗanda ba sa biyayya da bisharar Allah?
english: For the time has come for judgment to begin with the household of God. If it begins first with us, what will happen to those who don’t obey the Good News of God?

hausa: Sai suka je wurin Yoshuwa a sansanin Gilgal suka ce masa da mutanen Isra’ila, “Daga ƙasa mai nisa muka fito, yanzu fa, sai ku yi alkawari da mu.”
english: They went to Joshua at the camp at Gilgal, and said to him and to the men of Israel, “We have come from a far country. Now therefore make a covenant with us.”

hausa: “Yabo ya tabbata ga Ubangiji, Allah na Isra’ila, domin ya zo ya kuma fanshe mutanensa.
english: “Blessed be the Lord, the God of Israel, for he has visited and redeemed his people;

hausa: Ubangiji kuwa ya ba Isra’ilawa nasara a kan su, suka ci su da yaƙi, suka fafare su har zuwa Sidon Babba, zuwa Misrefot Mayim, har zuwa Kwarin Mizfa a gabas, ba wanda suka bari da rai.
english: Yahweh delivered them into the hand of Israel, and they struck them, and chased them to great Sidon, and to Misrephoth Maim, and to the valley of Mizpah eastward. They struck them until they left them no one remaining.

hausa: Suka zo wurin Bala’am suka ce, “Ga abin da Balak ɗan Ziffor ya ce, Kada ka bar wani abu yă hana ka zuwa wurina,
english: They came to Balaam, and said to him, “Balak the son of Zippor says, ‘Please let nothing hinder you from coming to me,

hausa: Waɗannan su ne sunayen ’ya’yan Haruna, shafaffun firistocin da aka naɗa domin su yi aiki firist.
english: These are the names of the sons of Aaron, the priests who were anointed, whom he consecrated to minister in the priest’s office.

hausa: In yi shelar shekarar tagomashin Ubangiji.”
english: and to proclaim the acceptable year of the Lord.”

hausa: Ubangiji kuwa ya cika kowane alkawarin alherin da ya yi wa mutanen Isra’ila.
english: Nothing failed of any good thing which Yahweh had spoken to the house of Israel. All came to pass.

hausa: amma in mace tana da dogon gashi, ai, daraja ce a gare ta. Gama an ba ta dogon gashi saboda rufe kanta ne.
english: But if a woman has long hair, it is a glory to her, for her hair is given to her for a covering.

hausa: Sa’ad da Allah ya ji su, ya yi fushi ƙwarai; ya ƙi Isra’ila gaba ɗaya.
english: When God heard this, he was angry, and greatly abhorred Israel,

hausa: Kai ka sami zuciyarsa da aminci a gare ka, ka kuma yi alkawari da shi cewa za ka ba zuriyarsa ƙasar Kan’aniyawa, da ta Hittiyawa, da ta Amoriyawa, da ta Ferizziyawa, da ta Yebusiyawa, da kuma ta Girgashiyawa. Ka kiyaye alkawarinka domin kai mai adalci ne.
english: found his heart faithful before you, and made a covenant with him to give the land of the Canaanite, the Hittite, the Amorite, the Perizzite, the Jebusite, and the Girgashite, to give it to his offspring, and have performed your words, for you are righteous.

hausa: Saboda haka na ci gaba na ce, “Abin da kuke yi a yanzu ba daidai ba ne. Bai kamata ku yi tafiya cikin tsoron Allahnmu don mu guji ba’ar Al’ummai abokan gābanmu ba?
english: Also I said, “The thing that you do is not good. Shouldn’t you walk in the fear of our God because of the reproach of the nations, our enemies?

hausa: “In mutum ya sa dabbobinsa su yi kiwo a fili ko a gonar inabi, ya kuma bar dabbobinsa suka yi ɓarna a cikin gonar wani, sai a sa mai dabbar yă biya tara daga amfanin gonarsa mafi kyau duka.
english: “If a man causes a field or vineyard to be eaten by letting his animal loose, and it grazes in another man’s field, he shall make restitution from the best of his own field, and from the best of his own vineyard.

hausa: Siman Bitrus ya amsa ya ce, “Kai ne Kiristi, Ɗan Allah mai rai.”
english: Simon Peter answered, “You are the Christ, the Son of the living God.”

hausa: Shekaru arba’in da na jagorance ku cikin hamada, tufafinku ba su yage ba, haka kuwa takalman da suke a ƙafafunku.
english: I have led you forty years in the wilderness. Your clothes have not grown old on you, and your sandals have not grown old on your feet.

hausa: (Wannan ya faru bayan Sarki Yekoniya da mahaifiyar sarauniya, shugabannin fada da kuma dukan shugabannin Yahuda da Urushalima, gwanayen sana’a da masu sassaƙa suka tafi zaman bauta daga Urushalima.)
english: (after Jeconiah the king, the queen mother, the eunuchs, the princes of Judah and Jerusalem, the craftsmen, and the smiths had departed from Jerusalem),

hausa: Da yake mutuwa ta zo ta wurin mutum, haka tashin matattu ma ya zo ta wurin mutum.
english: For since death came by man, the resurrection of the dead also came by man.

hausa: Mawadaci da matalauci suna da abu guda. Ubangiji ne Mahaliccinsu duka.
english: The rich and the poor have this in common: Yahweh is the maker of them all.

hausa: Waɗannan mutane masu tawaye, ’ya’ya masu ruɗu, ’ya’yan da ba sa niyya su saurara ga umarnan Ubangiji.
english: For it is a rebellious people, lying children, children who will not hear Yahweh’s law;

hausa: Duk wanda ya nome gonarsa zai sami amfani a yalwace, amma duk wanda yake zaman banza zai zama matalauci a koyaushe.
english: One who works his land will have an abundance of food; but one who chases fantasies will have his fill of poverty.

hausa: Amma Yesu ya ci gaba da dubawa don yă ga wa ya taɓa shi.
english: He looked around to see her who had done this thing.

hausa: “Amma suka ƙi su saurara; da taurinkai suka juya bayansu suka kuma toshe kunnuwansu.
english: But they refused to listen, and turned their backs, and stopped their ears, that they might not hear.

hausa: Saboda haka ku zauna a faɗake! Ku tuna cewa shekara uku, dare da rana ban taɓa fasa yin wa kowannenku gargaɗi ba, har da hawaye.
english: Therefore watch, remembering that for a period of three years I didn’t cease to admonish everyone night and day with tears.

hausa: Da a ce haka ne, ai, da Kiristi ya sha wahala sau da yawa tun halittar duniya. Amma yanzu ya bayyana sau ɗaya tak a ƙarshen zamanai domin yă kawar da zunubi ta wurin miƙa kansa hadaya.
english: or else he must have suffered often since the foundation of the world. But now once at the end of the ages, he has been revealed to put away sin by the sacrifice of himself.

hausa: mijinta kuwa ya ji game da wannan, amma bai ce mata kome ba, bai kuma hana ta ba, to, dukan alkawari da kuma rantsuwar da ta yi su tabbata a kanta.
english: and her husband heard it, and held his peace at her and didn’t disallow her, then all her vows shall stand, and every pledge with which she bound her soul shall stand.

hausa: Tun da daɗewa Isra’ila ba su da Allah na gaskiya, babu firist da zai koyar, kuma babu doka.
english: Now for a long time Israel was without the true God, without a teaching priest, and without law.

hausa: Bari su miƙa hadaya ta godiya su kuma ba da labarin ayyukansa da waƙoƙin farin ciki.
english: Let them offer the sacrifices of thanksgiving, and declare his deeds with singing.

hausa: Dukansu makomarsu ɗaya ce, masu adalci da masu mugunta, masu kirki da marasa kirki, masu tsabta da marasa tsabta, masu miƙa hadaya da waɗanda ba sa yi. Kamar yadda yake ga mutumin kirki, haka yake ga mai zunubi. Kamar yadda yake ga masu yin rantsuwa, haka ma da masu tsoron yi.
english: All things come alike to all. There is one event to the righteous and to the wicked; to the good, to the clean, to the unclean, to him who sacrifices, and to him who doesn’t sacrifice. As is the good, so is the sinner; he who takes an oath, as he who fears an oath.

hausa: Ya bugi al’ummai masu yawa ya kuma karkashe manyan sarakuna,
english: He struck many nations, and killed mighty kings—

hausa: Ya ce wa Isra’ilawa, “Nan gaba in yaranku suka tambayi iyayensu suka ce, ‘Mece ce ma’anar waɗannan duwatsun?’
english: He spoke to the children of Israel, saying, “When your children ask their fathers in time to come, saying, ‘What do these stones mean?’

hausa: An danne Efraim, an murƙushe ta a shari’a ta ƙudura ga bin gumaka.
english: Ephraim is oppressed, he is crushed in judgment, because he is intent in his pursuit of idols.

hausa: Na yi kuka gare shi da bakina; yabonsa yana a harshena.
english: I cried to him with my mouth. He was extolled with my tongue.

hausa: Dā ban san shi ba, sai dai wanda ya aiko ni in yi baftisma da ruwa ya gaya mini cewa, ‘Mutumin da ka ga Ruhu ya sauko ya kuma zauna a kansa shi ne wanda zai yi baftisma da Ruhu Mai Tsarki.’
english: I didn’t recognize him, but he who sent me to baptize in water said to me, ‘On whomever you will see the Spirit descending and remaining on him is he who baptizes in the Holy Spirit.’

hausa: Sai ya ce wa bayinsa, “Duba, gonar Yowab tana gab da tawa, kuma yana da sha’ir a can. Ku je ku sa mata wuta.” Sai bayin Absalom suka sa wa gonar wuta.
english: Therefore he said to his servants, “Behold, Joab’s field is near mine, and he has barley there. Go and set it on fire.” So Absalom’s servants set the field on fire.

hausa: To, fa, sai ka tafi. Ina aikan ka wurin Fir’auna don ka fitar da mutanena Isra’ilawa daga Masar.”
english: Come now therefore, and I will send you to Pharaoh, that you may bring my people, the children of Israel, out of Egypt.”

hausa: Dukan tsarkaka suna gaishe ku, musamman waɗanda suke na gidan Kaisar.
english: All the saints greet you, especially those who are of Caesar’s household.

hausa: Ku yi godiya ga Ubangiji, gama nagari ne shi; ƙaunarsa madawwamiya ce har abada.
english: Give thanks to Yahweh, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.

hausa: bari masu hikima su saurara, su kuma ƙara ga saninsu, bari masu tunani kuma su sami jagora,
english: that the wise man may hear, and increase in learning; that the man of understanding may attain to sound counsel;

hausa: To, in haka ne, in Demetiriyus da abokan sana’arsa suna da wata magana game da wani ai, kotuna suna nan a buɗe, akwai kuma muƙaddasai. Suna iya kai ƙara.
english: If therefore Demetrius and the craftsmen who are with him have a matter against anyone, the courts are open and there are proconsuls. Let them press charges against one another.

hausa: Sai sarki ya tattara Gibeyonawa ya yi musu magana. (To, Gibeyonawa ba sashen Isra’ilawa ba ne, amma mutanen Amoriyawa ne da suka ragu, waɗanda Isra’ila ta rantse za tă bari da rai, amma Shawulu cikin kishinsa don Isra’ila da Yahuda ya yi ƙoƙari yă hallaka su duka.)
english: The king called the Gibeonites and said to them (now the Gibeonites were not of the children of Israel, but of the remnant of the Amorites, and the children of Israel had sworn to them; and Saul sought to kill them in his zeal for the children of Israel and Judah);

hausa: “Ku ji, ya mutanena, zan kuwa gargaɗe ku, in ba za ku saurare ni ba, ya Isra’ila!
english: “Hear, my people, and I will testify to you, Israel, if you would listen to me!

hausa: ɗan Enosh, ɗan Shitu, ɗan Adamu, ɗan Allah.
english: the son of Enos, the son of Seth, the son of Adam, the son of God.

hausa: Yayinda ake fitar da ita, sai ta aika saƙo zuwa wurin surukinta, ta ce, “Mutumin da yake da waɗannan kayan ne ya yi mini ciki.” Ta kuma ƙara da cewa, “Duba ko za ka gane da hatimin nan, da abin ɗamaran nan, da kuma sandan nan, ko na wane ne?”
english: When she was brought out, she sent to her father-in-law, saying, “I am with child by the man who owns these.” She also said, “Please discern whose these are—the signet, and the cords, and the staff.”

hausa: sai ’yan’uwan Yesu suka ce masa, “Ya kamata ka bar nan ka tafi Yahudiya, don almajiranka su ga ayyukan banmamaki da kake yi.
english: His brothers therefore said to him, “Depart from here and go into Judea, that your disciples also may see your works which you do.

hausa: Yana cikin sa musu albarka, sai ya rabu da su. Aka ɗauke shi zuwa cikin sama.
english: While he blessed them, he withdrew from them and was carried up into heaven.

hausa: Da hannuwansa zai kawo hadayar da za a ƙona ga Ubangiji; zai kawo kitsen tare da ƙirjin, yă kuma kaɗa ƙirjin a gaban Ubangiji a matsayin hadaya ta kaɗawa.
english: With his own hands he shall bring the offerings of Yahweh made by fire. He shall bring the fat with the breast, that the breast may be waved for a wave offering before Yahweh.

hausa: Irin azumin da na zaɓa ke nan, rana guda kawai don mutum ya ƙasƙantar da kansa? Sunkuyar da kanku kamar iwa kawai kuna kuma kwance a tsummoki da toka? Abin da kuke kira azumi ke nan rana yardajje ga Ubangiji?
english: Is this the fast that I have chosen? A day for a man to humble his soul? Is it to bow down his head like a reed, and to spread sackcloth and ashes under himself? Will you call this a fast, and an acceptable day to Yahweh?

hausa: Da kaɗan da kaɗan zan kore muku su, har yawanku yă kai yadda za ku mallaki ƙasar.
english: Little by little I will drive them out from before you, until you have increased and inherit the land.

hausa: A bangayen da suke gefen shirayin akwai matsattsun tagogi da aka zāna siffar itatuwan dabino a kowane gefe. Gefe-gefen ɗakunan haikalin ma suna da rumfuna.
english: There were closed windows and palm trees on the one side and on the other side, on the sides of the porch. This is how the side rooms of the temple and the thresholds were arranged.

hausa: Amma da fari, dole yă sha wahaloli masu yawa, kuma mutanen zamanin nan su ƙi shi.
english: But first, he must suffer many things and be rejected by this generation.

hausa: Daga Miletus, Bulus ya aika zuwa Afisa a kira dattawan ikkilisiya.
english: From Miletus he sent to Ephesus and called to himself the elders of the assembly.

hausa: Ta yi ta kuka har kwana bakwai na bikin. Saboda haka a rana ta bakwai sai ya gaya mata, don ta dame shi. Ita kuwa ta bayyana kacici-kacicin wa mutanenta.
english: She wept before him the seven days, while their feast lasted; and on the seventh day, he told her, because she pressed him severely; and she told the riddle to the children of her people.

hausa: Bari ɗaukaka ta tabbata a gare shi shi wanda yake da ikon yin aiki a cikinmu, yana kuma aikata abubuwa fiye da dukan abin da muke roƙo, ko muke tunani.
english: Now to him who is able to do exceedingly abundantly above all that we ask or think, according to the power that works in us,

hausa: Ga wanda ya gamshe shi, Allah yakan ba da hikima da sani da farin ciki, amma ga mai zunubi yakan ba shi aikin tarawa da ajiyar dukiya domin yă miƙa wa wanda ya gamshi Allah. Wannan ma ba shi da amfani, naushin iska ne kawai.
english: For to the man who pleases him, God gives wisdom, knowledge, and joy; but to the sinner he gives travail, to gather and to heap up, that he may give to him who pleases God. This also is vanity and a chasing after wind.

hausa: A cikinta aka sami jinin annabawa, da na tsarkaka, da kuma na dukan waɗanda aka kashe a duniya.”
english: In her was found the blood of prophets and of saints, and of all who have been slain on the earth.”

hausa: Bayan an yanka bijimin, sai suka kawo yaron wurin Eli.
english: They killed the bull, and brought the child to Eli.

hausa: “Budurwa Isra’ila ta fāɗi, ba za tă ƙara tashi ba, an yashe ta a ƙasarta, ba wanda zai ɗaga ta.”
english: “The virgin of Israel has fallen; She shall rise no more. She is cast down on her land; there is no one to raise her up.”

hausa: Da yamma ta yi, jirgin ruwan yana tsakiyar tafkin, Yesu kuma yana can a ƙasa shi kaɗai.
english: When evening had come, the boat was in the middle of the sea, and he was alone on the land.

hausa: Ƙafafunsu miƙaƙƙu ne; kuma ƙafafunsu sun yi kamar na maraƙi suna kuma walƙiya kamar tagullar da aka goge.
english: Their feet were straight feet. The sole of their feet was like the sole of a calf’s foot; and they sparkled like burnished bronze.

hausa: Nan da nan, sai yarinyar ta yi hanzari zuwa wajen sarki da roƙon, “Ina so ka ba ni kan Yohanna Mai Baftisma a cikin tasa, yanzu-yanzu nan.”
english: She came in immediately with haste to the king and requested, “I want you to give me right now the head of John the Baptizer on a platter.”

hausa: Ya yi magana ya kuma yi muhawwara da Yahudawa masu jin Hellenanci, amma suka yi ƙoƙarin kashe shi.
english: preaching boldly in the name of the Lord Jesus. He spoke and disputed against the Hellenists, but they were seeking to kill him.

hausa: Game da sauran ayyukan mulkin Amaziya, daga farko zuwa ƙarshe, an rubuta su a littafin sarakunan Yahuda da Isra’ila.
english: Now the rest of the acts of Amaziah, first and last, behold, aren’t they written in the book of the kings of Judah and Israel?

hausa: Ubangiji ya ce wa Musa da Haruna,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,

hausa: To, akwai wani mutum mai suna Siman wanda ya kwana biyu yana yin sihiri a birnin har ya ba wa duk mutanen Samariya mamaki. Ya kuma yi taƙama cewa shi wani mai girma ne,
english: But there was a certain man, Simon by name, who used to practice sorcery in the city and amazed the people of Samaria, making himself out to be some great one,

hausa: Ƙungiyar annabawa daga Yeriko, waɗanda suke kallo, suka ce, “Ruhun Iliya yana a kan Elisha.” Sai suka je su tarye shi, suka rusuna har ƙasa a gabansa.
english: When the sons of the prophets who were at Jericho facing him saw him, they said, “The spirit of Elijah rests on Elisha.” They came to meet him, and bowed themselves to the ground before him.

hausa: Sa’an nan maganar Ubangiji ta zo wa Irmiya cewa,
english: Then Yahweh’s word came to Jeremiah, saying,

hausa: Sai maganar Ubangiji ta zo wa Irmiya cewa,
english: Then Yahweh’s word came to Jeremiah, saying,

hausa: Kaburbura suka bubbuɗe, jikunan tsarkaka da yawa kuwa cikin waɗanda da suka mutu, suka tashi.
english: The tombs were opened, and many bodies of the saints who had fallen asleep were raised;

hausa: Ya mutanena, ku sanya tufafin makoki ku yi birgima a toka; ku yi kuka mai zafi irin wanda akan yi wa ɗa tilo, gama nan da nan mai hallakarwa zai auko mana.
english: Daughter of my people, clothe yourself with sackcloth, and wallow in ashes! Mourn, as for an only son, most bitter lamentation, for the destroyer will suddenly come on us.

hausa: kamar dai yadda nake ƙoƙarin faranta wa kowa rai, ta kowace hanya. Gama ba don kaina kaɗai nake yi ba, sai dai don amfanin mutane da yawa, don su sami ceto.
english: even as I also please all men in all things, not seeking my own profit, but the profit of the many, that they may be saved.

hausa: don ragowar mutane su nemi Ubangiji, kuma duk Al’umman da suke kira bisa sunana, in ji Ubangiji, wanda yake yin waɗannan abubuwa’
english: that the rest of men may seek after the Lord: all the Gentiles who are called by my name, says the Lord, who does all these things.’

hausa: Ya gina bagadai cikin haikalin Ubangiji, waɗanda Ubangiji ya ce, “Sunana zai kasance cikin Urushalima har abada.”
english: He built altars in Yahweh’s house, of which Yahweh said, “My name shall be in Jerusalem forever.”

hausa: A’a, kalmar tana nan dab da ku, tana cikin bakinku da cikin zuciyarku, don ku yi biyayya.
english: But the word is very near to you, in your mouth and in your heart, that you may do it.

hausa: Sai mutanen Ruben da mutanen Gad suka ba wa wannan bagaden sunan, Shaida Tsakaninmu, cewa Ubangiji Allah ne.
english: The children of Reuben and the children of Gad named the altar “A Witness Between Us that Yahweh is God.”

hausa: Sai Hazayel ya tafi taryen Elisha, ya ɗauka kyauta na kowane irin kaya masu kyau na Damaskus tare da shi a raƙuma arba’in. Ya shiga ya tsaya a gaban Elisha ya ce, “Ɗanka Ben-Hadad na Aram ya aike ni in tambaye ka, ‘Zan warke daga ciwon nan?’ ”
english: So Hazael went to meet him and took a present with him, even of every good thing of Damascus, forty camels’ burden, and came and stood before him and said, “Your son Benhadad king of Syria has sent me to you, saying, ‘Will I recover from this sickness?’”

hausa: Bakbukiya da Unni, ’yan’uwansu sun tsaya ɗaura da su a hidimomi.
english: Also Bakbukiah and Unno, their brothers, were close to them according to their offices.

hausa: To, a kwanakin nan Isra’ila ba ta da sarki. A kwanakin kuwa zuriyar Dan tana neman wurinsu na zama, gama ba su riga sun sami gādo tare da kabilan Isra’ila ba.
english: In those days there was no king in Israel. In those days the tribe of the Danites sought an inheritance to dwell in; for to that day, their inheritance had not fallen to them among the tribes of Israel.

hausa: Ina da shekara arba’in lokacin da Musa bawan Ubangiji ya aike ni zuwa Kadesh Barneya in leƙi asirin ƙasar. Na kuwa kawo masa rahoto daidai yadda na ga ƙasar,
english: I was forty years old when Moses the servant of Yahweh sent me from Kadesh Barnea to spy out the land. I brought him word again as it was in my heart.

hausa: Sa’an nan za ku tuna mugayen hanyoyinku da mugayen ayyukanku, za ku kuwa ji ƙyamar kanku saboda zunubanku da kuma ayyukanku na banƙyama.
english: “‘“Then you will remember your evil ways, and your deeds that were not good; and you will loathe yourselves in your own sight for your iniquities and for your abominations.

hausa: Mun shirya muka kuma tsarkake dukan kayayyakin da Sarki Ahaz ya cire cikin rashin amincinsa yayinda yake sarki. Yanzu suna a gaban bagaden Ubangiji.”
english: Moreover, we have prepared and sanctified all the vessels which King Ahaz threw away in his reign when he was unfaithful. Behold, they are before Yahweh’s altar.”

hausa: Shin, duka ne manzanni? Duka ne annabawa? Duka ne malamai? Duka ne suke da baiwar yin ayyukan banmamaki?
english: Are all apostles? Are all prophets? Are all teachers? Are all miracle workers?

hausa: Zai ce, ‘Ni ba annabi ba ne. Ni manomi ne; ƙasa ce nake samun abin zaman gari tun ina matashi.’
english: but he will say, ‘I am no prophet, I am a tiller of the ground; for I have been made a bondservant from my youth.’

hausa: na biyar onis, na shida yakutu, na bakwai kirisolit, na takwas beril, na tara tofaz, na goma kirisofuras, na goma sha ɗaya yasin, na goma sha biyu kuma ametis.
english: the fifth sardonyx, the sixth sardius, the seventh chrysolite, the eighth beryl, the ninth topaz, the tenth chrysoprase, the eleventh jacinth, and the twelfth amethyst.

hausa: Ka ƙara zobai biyu, ka kuma ɗaura su a bakin ƙyallen da ya sauka daga kafaɗa ta gaban efod, kusa da mahaɗin ƙyallaye biyu a bisa ɗamara na efod.
english: You shall make two rings of gold, and shall put them on the two shoulder straps of the ephod underneath, in its forepart, close by its coupling, above the skillfully woven band of the ephod.

hausa: Ba abin da yake ɓoye da ba za a fallasa ba. Kuma ba abin da yake rufe, da ba za a sani ba, ko a fitar da shi a fili ba.
english: For nothing is hidden that will not be revealed, nor anything secret that will not be known and come to light.

hausa: Kun kori matan mutanena daga gidajensu masu daɗi. Kuka kawar da albarkata har abada daga wurin ’ya’yansu.
english: You drive the women of my people out from their pleasant houses; from their young children you take away my blessing forever.

hausa: In mulki yana gāba da kansa, wannan mulki ba zai tsaya ba.
english: If a kingdom is divided against itself, that kingdom cannot stand.

hausa: Za ka yi masa magana. Ka kuma sa masa maganata a baki; zan kuma taimake ku magana, in koya muku abin da za ku yi.
english: You shall speak to him, and put the words in his mouth. I will be with your mouth, and with his mouth, and will teach you what you shall do.

hausa: Mala’ikan Ubangiji ya kuma ce mata, “Ga shi kina da ciki za ki kuwa haifi ɗa. Za ki ba shi suna Ishmayel, gama Ubangiji ya ga wahalarki.
english: Yahweh’s angel said to her, “Behold, you are with child, and will bear a son. You shall call his name Ishmael, because Yahweh has heard your affliction.

hausa: Na mai da aikin da kuka sha wahala kuka yi ya zama banza ta wurin saukar da burtuntuna, da fumfuna, da ƙanƙara, duk da haka ba ku juyo gare ni ba,’ in ji Ubangiji.
english: I struck you with blight, mildew, and hail in all the work of your hands; yet you didn’t turn to me,’ says Yahweh.

hausa: Saboda haka mutumin ya mai da hankalinsa a kansu, yana fata samun wani abu daga gare su.
english: He listened to them, expecting to receive something from them.

hausa: A wannan karo na farko Yonatan da mai ɗaukan makamansa suka kashe mutum wajen ashirin a wani fili mai fāɗi rabin kadada.
english: That first slaughter, which Jonathan and his armor bearer made, was about twenty men, within as it were half a furrow’s length in an acre of land.

hausa: kuma saboda wannan ne mutanen Asher suke zaune cikin mazaunan ƙasar Kan’aniyawa.
english: but the Asherites lived among the Canaanites, the inhabitants of the land, for they didn’t drive them out.

hausa: Sai ɗan’uwan mahaifin Shawulu ya tambaye shi da baransa ya ce, “Ina kuka je?” Shawulu ya ce, “Mun tafi neman jakuna, amma da ba mu same su ba sai muka tafi wurin Sama’ila.”
english: Saul’s uncle said to him and to his servant, “Where did you go?” He said, “To seek the donkeys. When we saw that they were not found, we came to Samuel.”

hausa: Sa’ad da Mahalalel ya yi shekara 65, sai ya haifi Yared.
english: Mahalalel lived sixty-five years, then became the father of Jared.

hausa: Dukan waɗannan sun shiga tarihin zuriya a lokacin mulkin Yotam sarkin Yahuda da Yerobowam sarkin Isra’ila.
english: All these were listed by genealogies in the days of Jotham king of Judah, and in the days of Jeroboam king of Israel.

hausa: Sai ya ce, “Ina roƙonki, ki ba ni ruwa in sha, ina jin ƙishirwa.” Sai ta buɗe salkar madara, ta ba shi ya sha, sai ta kuma rufe shi.
english: He said to her, “Please give me a little water to drink; for I am thirsty.” She opened a container of milk, and gave him a drink, and covered him.

hausa: Amma ku, ’yan’uwa, ba kwa cikin duhu da wannan rana za tă zo muku ba zato kamar ɓarawo.
english: But you, brothers, aren’t in darkness, that the day should overtake you like a thief.

hausa: Amma ta ce mata, “Bai ishe ki ba ne da kika ƙwace mijina? Yanzu kuma kina so ki ƙwace manta-uwa na yarona?” Sai Rahila ta ce “Shi ke nan, mijina zai iya kwana da ke yau saboda manta-uwa na ɗanki.”
english: Leah said to her, “Is it a small matter that you have taken away my husband? Would you take away my son’s mandrakes, also?” Rachel said, “Therefore he will lie with you tonight for your son’s mandrakes.”

hausa: Shekaru biyu cif Bulus ya zauna a can a gidansa na haya yana marabtar duk wanda ya je wurinsa.
english: Paul stayed two whole years in his own rented house and received all who were coming to him,

hausa: “Na bayyana ka ga waɗanda ka ba ni a duniya. Su naka ne; kai ka ba ni su sun kuma yi biyayya da maganarka.
english: “I revealed your name to the people whom you have given me out of the world. They were yours, and you have given them to me. They have kept your word.

hausa: Saboda haka Gideyon ya kai mutanen cikin ruwa. A can Ubangiji ya ce masa, “Ka ware waɗanda suka tanɗi ruwa kamar kare daga waɗanda suka durƙusa suka sha ruwan.”
english: So he brought down the people to the water; and Yahweh said to Gideon, “Everyone who laps of the water with his tongue, like a dog laps, you shall set him by himself; likewise everyone who bows down on his knees to drink.”

hausa: Sai Shawulu ya daina bin Filistiyawa, suka koma ƙasarsu.
english: Then Saul went up from following the Philistines; and the Philistines went to their own place.

hausa: suka kwashe mata, yara da tsofaffi da dukan abubuwan da suke cikin garin. Ba su kashe kowa ba, amma suka kwashe su, suka tafi.
english: and had taken captive the women and all who were in it, both small and great. They didn’t kill any, but carried them off and went their way.

hausa: da akwatin alkawarin Allah yake ciki. Ahiyo kuwa yana tafiya a gaban Abinadab.
english: They brought it out of Abinadab’s house which was in the hill, with God’s ark; and Ahio went before the ark.

hausa: karaya don karaya, ido don ido, haƙori don haƙori. Kamar yadda ya yi wa wani rauni, shi ma a yi masa.
english: fracture for fracture, eye for eye, tooth for tooth. It shall be done to him as he has injured someone.

hausa: Ya ja kwarinsa ya sa in zama abin baratarsa.
english: He has bent his bow, and set me as a mark for the arrow.

hausa: Sa’ad da suka gan shi daga nesa, da ƙyar suka gane shi; sai suka fara kuka da ƙarfi, suka yayyaga tufafinsu suka zuba toka a kawunansu,
english: When they lifted up their eyes from a distance, and didn’t recognize him, they raised their voices, and wept; and they each tore his robe, and sprinkled dust on their heads toward the sky.

hausa: Ya gina biranen katanga na Yahuda, da yake ƙasar tana zaman lafiya. Babu wanda yake yaƙi da shi a waɗannan shekaru, gama Ubangiji ya ba shi hutu.
english: He built fortified cities in Judah; for the land was quiet, and he had no war in those years, because Yahweh had given him rest.

hausa: Na ƙi waɗanda suke manne wa gumakan banza; na dogara ga Ubangiji.
english: I hate those who regard lying vanities, but I trust in Yahweh.

hausa: Da sauran itacen yakan yi allah, gunkinsa; yă rusuna masa yă kuma yi sujada. Yakan yi masa addu’a yă ce, “Ka cece ni; kai ne allahna.”
english: The rest of it he makes into a god, even his engraved image. He bows down to it and worships, and prays to it, and says, “Deliver me, for you are my god!”

hausa: Wannan ne yankin da aka ba wa Manasse da Efraim zuriyar Yusuf gādonsu.
english: The children of Joseph, Manasseh and Ephraim, took their inheritance.

hausa: Haka ma ayyuka nagari a fili suke, ko ba ma a fili suke ba, ba a iya ɓoye su.
english: In the same way also there are good works that are obvious, and those that are otherwise can’t be hidden.

hausa: Zuriyar Merari su ne, Mali, Libni, Shimeyi, Uzza,
english: The sons of Merari: Mahli, Libni his son, Shimei his son, Uzzah his son,

hausa: Saboda haka Ubangiji ya wofinta mutanen Isra’ila; ya azabtar da su, ya kuma ba da su a hannun masu kwasar ganima, sai da ya shafe su ƙaƙaf daga gabansa.
english: Yahweh rejected all the offspring of Israel, afflicted them, and delivered them into the hands of raiders, until he had cast them out of his sight.

hausa: A cikin baƙin ciki, Hannatu ta yi kuka mai zafi ta yi addu’a ga Ubangiji.
english: She was in bitterness of soul, and prayed to Yahweh, weeping bitterly.

hausa: Mai mulkin da ya danne talakawa yana kama da ruwan saman da ya lalatar da hatsi.
english: A needy man who oppresses the poor is like a driving rain which leaves no crops.

hausa: Sa’ad da Isra’ilawa a cikin sansani suka ji cewa Zimri ya yi maƙarƙashiya a kan sarki, ya kuma kashe shi, sai suka yi shela, suka naɗa Omri, shugaban mayaƙa ya zama sarki a bisa Isra’ila, a wannan rana a cikin sansani.
english: The people who were encamped heard that Zimri had conspired, and had also killed the king. Therefore all Israel made Omri, the captain of the army, king over Israel that day in the camp.

hausa: Daga sama ya sa kuka ji muryarsa, don yă hore ku. A duniya ya nuna muku wutarsa mai girma, kuka kuma ji kalmominsa daga wuta.
english: Out of heaven he made you to hear his voice, that he might instruct you. On earth he made you to see his great fire; and you heard his words out of the middle of the fire.

hausa: Da sassafe kashegari, Ibrahim ya tashi ya koma wurin da dā ya tsaya a gaban Ubangiji.
english: Abraham went up early in the morning to the place where he had stood before Yahweh.

hausa: Da Yesu ya koma, taron suka marabce shi, don dā ma duk suna jiransa.
english: When Jesus returned, the multitude welcomed him, for they were all waiting for him.

hausa: “Ku gudu neman mafaka, mutanen Benyamin! Ku gudu daga Urushalima! Ku busa ƙaho a Tekowa! Ku ba da alama a Bet-Hakkerem! Gama masifa tana zuwa daga arewa, mummunar hallaka ce kuwa.
english: “Flee for safety, you children of Benjamin, out of the middle of Jerusalem! Blow the trumpet in Tekoa and raise up a signal on Beth Haccherem, for evil looks out from the north with a great destruction.

hausa: Bulus ya kai Derbe sa’an nan kuma zuwa Listira, inda wani almajiri mai suna Timoti yake da zama, wanda mahaifiyarsa mutuniyar Yahuda ce kuma mai bi ce, amma mahaifinsa mutumin Hellenawa ne.
english: He came to Derbe and Lystra; and behold, a certain disciple was there, named Timothy, the son of a Jewess who believed, but his father was a Greek.

hausa: Ta haka za a sami katakai takwas da rammukansu na azurfa guda goma sha shida, kowane katako yana da rammuka biyu.
english: There shall be eight boards, and their sockets of silver, sixteen sockets; two sockets under one board, and two sockets under another board.

hausa: ko da ƙasa, domin matashin ƙafafunsa ne; ko kuma da Urushalima, domin birnin Babban Sarki ne.
english: nor by the earth, for it is the footstool of his feet; nor by Jerusalem, for it is the city of the great King.

hausa: Kada ku ci wani haramtaccen abu.
english: You shall not eat any abominable thing.

hausa: Saboda haka Musa ya ba da Gileyad ga mutanen Makir, zuriyar Manasse, suka kuma zauna a can.
english: Moses gave Gilead to Machir the son of Manasseh; and he lived therein.

hausa: Daga mawaƙa, akwai Eliyashib. Daga masu tsaron ƙofofin haikali, akwai Shallum, Telem da Uri.
english: Of the singers: Eliashib. Of the gatekeepers: Shallum, Telem, and Uri.

hausa: “ ‘Kada wani ya kusaci wani dangi na kusa don yă yi jima’i. Ni ne Ubangiji.
english: “‘None of you shall approach any close relatives, to uncover their nakedness: I am Yahweh.

hausa: Sai Bilatus ya biya bukatarsu da ya ji roƙonsu.
english: Pilate decreed that what they asked for should be done.

hausa: “Amma nan da nan, da suka sami hutu, sai suka sāke aikata abin da yake mugu a idonka. Sai ka yashe su ga hannun abokan gābansu don su yi mulki a kansu. Sa’ad da suka yi kuka kuma gare ka, ka ji daga sama, cikin jinƙanka kuma ka fisshe su sau da sau.
english: But after they had rest, they did evil again before you; therefore you left them in the hands of their enemies, so that they had the dominion over them; yet when they returned and cried to you, you heard from heaven; and many times you delivered them according to your mercies,

hausa: Hittiyawa suka ce wa Ibrahim,
english: The children of Heth answered Abraham, saying to him,

hausa: Amma Shawulu da sojojinsa suka bar Agag, da tumaki, da shanu, da ’yan maruƙa masu ƙiba da kuma duk abin da yake mai kyau da rai. Waɗannan ba su so su hallaka su gaba ɗaya ba, amma duk abin da ba a so da kuma marar amfani suka hallaka.
english: But Saul and the people spared Agag and the best of the sheep, of the cattle, of the fat calves, of the lambs, and all that was good, and were not willing to utterly destroy them; but everything that was vile and refuse, that they destroyed utterly.

hausa: Zakariya ɗan Meshelemiya shi ne mai tsaro a mashigin Tentin Sujada.
english: Zechariah the son of Meshelemiah was gatekeeper of the door of the Tent of Meeting.

hausa: Elisha ya ce wa sarkin Isra’ila, “Ina ruwana da kai? Tafi wurin annabawan mahaifinka da annabawa mahaifiyarka.” Sai sarkin Isra’ila ya ce, “A’a, ai Ubangiji ne ya kira mu, mu sarakunan nan uku don yă bashe mu ga Mowab.”
english: Elisha said to the king of Israel, “What have I to do with you? Go to the prophets of your father, and to the prophets of your mother.” The king of Israel said to him, “No, for Yahweh has called these three kings together to deliver them into the hand of Moab.”

hausa: Sa’ad da Dawuda ya tsufa yana kuma da cikakken shekaru, ya sa ɗansa Solomon sarki bisa Isra’ila.
english: Now David was old and full of days; and he made Solomon his son king over Israel.

hausa: Zan sa mutum yă fi zinariya zalla wuyar samuwa, fiye da zinariyar Ofir wuyan gani.
english: I will make people more rare than fine gold, even a person than the pure gold of Ophir.

hausa: Ɗan Uzzi shi ne, Izrahiya. ’Ya’yan Izrahiya maza su ne, Mika’ilu, Obadiya, Yowel da Isshiya. Dukansu biyar manya ne.
english: The son of Uzzi: Izrahiah. The sons of Izrahiah: Michael, Obadiah, Joel, and Isshiah, five; all of them chief men.

hausa: Sai Zofar mutumin Na’ama ya amsa,
english: Then Zophar the Naamathite answered,

hausa: Duk waɗanda Uba ya ba ni za su zo wurina, kuma duk wanda ya zo wurina ba zan kore shi ba ko kaɗan.
english: All those whom the Father gives me will come to me. He who comes to me I will in no way throw out.

hausa: Humta, Kiriyat Arba (wato, Hebron) da Ziyor, garuruwa tara ke nan da ƙauyukansu.
english: Humtah, Kiriath Arba (also called Hebron), and Zior; nine cities with their villages.

hausa: Zan yi gāba da mutumin in kuma sa ya zama misali da kuma abin karin magana. Zan ware shi daga mutanena. Sa’an nan za ku san cewa ni ne Ubangiji.
english: I will set my face against that man and will make him an astonishment, for a sign and a proverb, and I will cut him off from among my people. Then you will know that I am Yahweh.

hausa: Barorinsa suka ɗauke shi cikin keken yaƙi zuwa Urushalima suka binne shi a kabarinsa tare da kakanninsa a birnin Dawuda.
english: His servants carried him in a chariot to Jerusalem, and buried him in his tomb with his fathers in David’s city.

hausa: Gama masu aikata gaskiya za su zauna a cikin ƙasar, marasa laifi kuma za su kasance a cikinta;
english: For the upright will dwell in the land. The perfect will remain in it.

hausa: Ya ce, ‘Ɗaga idanunka ka gani, dukan bunsuran da suke hawan garken, masu dabbare-dabbare, ko babare-babare, ko masu zāne-zāne ne, gama na ga dukan abin da Laban yake yin maka.
english: He said, ‘Now lift up your eyes, and behold, all the male goats which leap on the flock are streaked, speckled, and grizzled, for I have seen all that Laban does to you.

hausa: Ya tabbatar da shi ga Yaƙub a matsayin ƙa’ida, Isra’ila a matsayin madawwamin alkawari,
english: and confirmed it to Jacob for a statute; to Israel for an everlasting covenant,

hausa: Don mai bi da kaɗe-kaɗe. Ta Dawuda. Zabura ce. Ya Ubangiji, ka bincike ni ka kuwa san ni.
english: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. Yahweh, you have searched me, and you know me.

hausa: Ka ji roƙe-roƙen bawanka da na mutanenka Isra’ila sa’ad da suka yi addu’a suna duban wajen wannan wuri. Ka ji daga sama, mazauninka; kuma sa’ad da ka ji, ka gafarta.
english: Listen to the petitions of your servant and of your people Israel, when they pray toward this place. Yes, hear from your dwelling place, even from heaven; and when you hear, forgive.

hausa: Sa’an nan ƙasa za tă ba da girbinta Allah kuma, Allahnmu, zai albarkace mu.
english: The earth has yielded its increase. God, even our own God, will bless us.

hausa: Za a kore ka daga cikin mutane, za ka kuma zauna cikin namun jeji; za ka ci ciyawa kamar shanu, za ka jiƙe da raɓa har shekara bakwai cif sa’an nan za ka sani cewa Mafi Ɗaukaka ne mai iko duka a kan dukan mulkoki a duniya, yake kuma ba da mulki ga duk wanda ya ga dama.
english: You will be driven from men and your dwelling shall be with the animals of the field. You will be made to eat grass as oxen, and will be wet with the dew of the sky, and seven times shall pass over you, until you know that the Most High rules in the kingdom of men, and gives it to whomever he will.

hausa: Zan hukunta duniya saboda muguntarta, mugaye saboda zunubansu. Zan kawo ƙarshe ga girman kan masu taƙama in kuma ƙasƙantar da ɗaga kan marasa tausayi.
english: I will punish the world for their evil, and the wicked for their iniquity. I will cause the arrogance of the proud to cease, and will humble the arrogance of the terrible.

hausa: Da jakar ta hangi mala’ikan Ubangiji tsaye a hanya da takobi a hannunsa, sai ta kauce daga hanya, ta shiga jeji. Bala’am kuwa ya buge ta don tă koma hanya.
english: The donkey saw Yahweh’s angel standing in the way, with his sword drawn in his hand; and the donkey turned out of the path, and went into the field. Balaam struck the donkey, to turn her into the path.

hausa: Waɗannan su ne kabilan Yahuda; jimillarsu ta kai 76,500.
english: These are the families of Judah according to those who were counted of them, seventy-six thousand five hundred.

hausa: Eliyasaf ɗan Deyuwel kuma shi ne shugaban ɓangaren kabilar Gad.
english: Eliasaph the son of Deuel was over the army of the tribe of the children of Gad.

hausa: Shekaru bakwai na yalwar abinci suna zuwa a dukan ƙasar Masar,
english: Behold, seven years of great plenty throughout all the land of Egypt are coming.

hausa: Kowace tsarkakakkiyar kyauta da mutum ya kawo nasa ne, sai dai abin da ya ba wa firist, zai zama na firist.’ ”
english: Every man’s holy things shall be his; whatever any man gives the priest, it shall be his.’”

hausa: Ya kai ni babban zauren da ake liyafa, ƙauna ita ce tutarsa a gare ni.
english: He brought me to the banquet hall. His banner over me is love.

hausa: Sarki Solomon ya fi arziki da hikima in aka kwatanta da dukan sauran sarakunan duniya.
english: So King Solomon exceeded all the kings of the earth in riches and wisdom.

hausa: An kafa tabanakul. A cikin ɗakinsa na farko akwai wurin ajiye fitila, tebur da kuma keɓaɓɓen burodi; an kira wannan Wuri Mai Tsarki.
english: For a tabernacle was prepared. In the first part were the lamp stand, the table, and the show bread, which is called the Holy Place.

hausa: Nan da nan sai ya fara mulki ya kuwa zauna a kujerar sarauta, ya kashe dukan iyalin Ba’asha. Bai bar namiji guda ɗaya ba, ko dangi, ko aboki.
english: When he began to reign, as soon as he sat on his throne, he attacked all the house of Baasha. He didn’t leave him a single one who urinates on a wall among his relatives or his friends.

hausa: Laban ya kuma ce wa Yaƙub, “Ga wannan tsibi, ga kuma wannan al’amudin da na kafa tsakaninka da ni.
english: Laban said to Jacob, “See this heap, and see the pillar, which I have set between me and you.
