hausa: A’a! Mun gaskata cewa ta wurin alherin Ubangiji Yesu ne muka sami ceto, kamar yadda su ma suka samu.”
english: But we believe that we are saved through the grace of the Lord Jesus, just as they are.”

hausa: Yesu ya yi musu wannan misali, amma ba su fahimci abin da yake faɗa musu ba.
english: Jesus spoke this parable to them, but they didn’t understand what he was telling them.

hausa: Sai Musa ya ɗibi man keɓewa da jini daga bagade, ya yayyafa su a kan Haruna da rigunansa, da kuma a kan ’ya’yansa da rigunansu, don yă tsarkake Haruna da rigunansa da kuma ’ya’yansa da rigunansu.
english: Moses took some of the anointing oil, and some of the blood which was on the altar, and sprinkled it on Aaron, on his garments, and on his sons, and on his sons’ garments with him, and sanctified Aaron, his garments, and his sons, and his sons’ garments with him.

hausa: Za a hallaka masujadai kan tudu na mugunta zunubin Isra’ila ne. Ƙayayuwa da sarƙaƙƙiya za su yi girma su rufe bagadansu. Sa’an nan za su ce wa duwatsu, “Ku rufe mu!” Ga tuddai kuma, “Ku fāɗo a kanmu!”
english: The high places also of Aven, the sin of Israel, will be destroyed. The thorn and the thistle will come up on their altars. They will tell the mountains, “Cover us!” and the hills, “Fall on us!”

hausa: gama sun fi son yabon mutane, fiye da yabon Allah.
english: for they loved men’s praise more than God’s praise.

hausa: Yanzu ku kashe dukan yara maza, ku kuma kashe kowace macen da ta yi lalata da namiji,
english: Now therefore kill every male among the little ones, and kill every woman who has known man by lying with him.

hausa: Ubangiji kuwa ya yi abin da Musa ya roƙa. Ƙudaje suka rabu da Fir’auna da fadawansa da kuma mutanensa; ba ƙudan da ya rage.
english: Yahweh did according to the word of Moses, and he removed the swarms of flies from Pharaoh, from his servants, and from his people. There remained not one.

hausa: Kamannin fārin nan kuwa yana kama da dawakan da aka shirya don yaƙi. A kawunansu kuwa da wani abu da ya yi kamar rawanin zinariya, fuskokinsu kuma sun yi kamar fuskokin mutane.
english: The shapes of the locusts were like horses prepared for war. On their heads were something like golden crowns, and their faces were like people’s faces.

hausa: A shekara ta goma sha huɗu, Kedorlayomer da sarakunan da suka haɗa kai da shi suka tafi suka cinye Refahiyawa a Ashterot Karnayim, Zuziyawa a Ham, Emawa a Shabe Kiriyatayim,
english: In the fourteenth year Chedorlaomer and the kings who were with him came and struck the Rephaim in Ashteroth Karnaim, the Zuzim in Ham, the Emim in Shaveh Kiriathaim,

hausa: Da suka tashi da sassafe, rana tana haska ruwa. Sai ruwan ya yi ja kamar jini a idanun Mowabawan da suke a ƙetare.
english: They rose up early in the morning, and the sun shone on the water, and the Moabites saw the water opposite them as red as blood.

hausa: Ina ba ku sahihiyar koyarwa, saboda haka kada ku ƙyale koyarwata.
english: for I give you sound learning. Don’t forsake my law.

hausa: Na goma, don wata na goma, shi ne Maharai mutumin Netofa, mutumin Zera. Akwai mutane 24,000 a sashensa.
english: The tenth captain for the tenth month was Maharai the Netophathite, of the Zerahites. In his division were twenty-four thousand.

hausa: asirin zuciyarsa kuma su bayyana a fili. Don haka, zai fāɗi a ƙasa yă yi wa Allah sujada yana cewa, “Lalle, Allah yana cikinku!”
english: And thus the secrets of his heart are revealed. So he will fall down on his face and worship God, declaring that God is among you indeed.

hausa: Nuhu yana da ’ya’ya maza uku, Shem, Ham da Yafet.
english: Noah became the father of three sons: Shem, Ham, and Japheth.

hausa: Yesu ya ce, “Mulkina ba na duniyan nan ba ne. Da na duniyan nan ne da bayina sun yi yaƙi su hana Yahudawa kama ni. Amma fa mulkina daga wani waje ne.”
english: Jesus answered, “My Kingdom is not of this world. If my Kingdom were of this world, then my servants would fight, that I wouldn’t be delivered to the Jews. But now my Kingdom is not from here.”

hausa: Sarkin ba zai auri mata masu yawa ba, in ba haka ba zuciyarsa za tă karkata. Ba zai tara azurfa da zinariya da yawa ba.
english: He shall not multiply wives to himself, that his heart not turn away. He shall not greatly multiply to himself silver and gold.

hausa: Ga yadda za ka gina shi; jirgin zai kasance mai tsawon ƙafa 45, fāɗinsa ƙafa 75, tsayinsa kuma ƙafa 45.
english: This is how you shall make it. The length of the ship shall be three hundred cubits, its width fifty cubits, and its height thirty cubits.

hausa: ’ya’yan Eliyab maza kuwa su ne, Nemuwel, Datan da Abiram. Datan da Abiram nan, su ne shugabannin mutanen da suka tayar wa Musa da Haruna, suna kuma cikin waɗanda suka bi Kora sa’ad da ya tayar wa Ubangiji.
english: The sons of Eliab: Nemuel, Dathan, and Abiram. These are that Dathan and Abiram who were called by the congregation, who rebelled against Moses and against Aaron in the company of Korah when they rebelled against Yahweh;

hausa: Da ya ga taron mutane, sai ya ji tausayinsu, domin an wulaƙanta su ba su kuma da mai taimako, kamar tumaki marasa makiyayi.
english: But when he saw the multitudes, he was moved with compassion for them because they were harassed and scattered, like sheep without a shepherd.

hausa: Na yi ƙoƙari in sa raina yă yi farin ciki da ruwan inabi, in kuma rungumi wauta, hankalina kuma yana yin mini jagora da hikima. Na so in ga abin da yake da daraja ga mutane a duniya a ’yan kwanakinsu.
english: I searched in my heart how to cheer my flesh with wine, my heart yet guiding me with wisdom, and how to lay hold of folly, until I might see what it was good for the sons of men that they should do under heaven all the days of their lives.

hausa: Yabi Ubangiji. Yana da kyau a rera yabai ga Allahnmu, abu mai daɗi ne daidai ne kuma a yabe shi!
english: Praise Yah, for it is good to sing praises to our God; for it is pleasant and fitting to praise him.

hausa: Baftismar Yohanna, daga sama ce, ko daga mutane? Ku faɗa mini!”
english: The baptism of John—was it from heaven, or from men? Answer me.”

hausa: Ya yi addu’a ga Allah ya kuwa samu alheri a wurinsa, yana ganin fuskar Allah yana kuma yin sowa don murna; Allah ya mayar da shi ya zama mai adalci.
english: He prays to God, and he is favorable to him, so that he sees his face with joy. He restores to man his righteousness.

hausa: Zai kawo ɗaukaka gare ni ta wurin ɗaukan abin da yake nawa, ya bayyana muku.
english: He will glorify me, for he will take from what is mine and will declare it to you.

hausa: Yowab ya ga cewa akwai dāgā a gabansa da bayansa; sai ya zaɓi waɗansu mayaƙa mafi kyau a Isra’ila ya sa su a kan Arameyawa.
english: Now when Joab saw that the battle was set against him before and behind, he chose some of all the choice men of Israel, and put them in array against the Syrians.

hausa: Sa’an nan Yesu ya ce wa almajiransa, “Gaskiya nake gaya muku, yana da wuya mai arziki yă shiga mulkin sama.
english: Jesus said to his disciples, “Most certainly I say to you, a rich man will enter into the Kingdom of Heaven with difficulty.

hausa: In mutanen ƙasar suka kau da idanunsu sa’ad da wannan mutum ya miƙa ’ya’yansa ga Molek, suka kāsa kashe shi,
english: If the people of the land all hide their eyes from that person when he gives of his offspring to Molech, and don’t put him to death,

hausa: gama kowace dabbar kurmi nawa ne, da kuma shanu a kan dubban tuddai.
english: For every animal of the forest is mine, and the livestock on a thousand hills.

hausa: “ ‘Ba za su aske kawunansu ko su bar gashin kansu ya yi tsayi ba, amma sai su sausaye gashin kansu.
english: “‘“They shall not shave their heads, or allow their locks to grow long. They shall only cut off the hair of their heads.

hausa: Tsawon fikafikan kerubobin ya kai kamu ashirin. Su kerubobin a tsaye suke, suna fuskantar babban zauren.
english: The wings of these cherubim spread themselves out twenty cubits. They stood on their feet, and their faces were toward the house.

hausa: Za su sāke gina kufai na dā su raya wurare da aka lalace tun da daɗewa; za su sabunta biranen da aka rurrushe da aka lalace tun zamanai masu yawa da suka wuce.
english: They will rebuild the old ruins. They will raise up the former devastated places. They will repair the ruined cities that have been devastated for many generations.

hausa: Ba a kuma yin masa hidima da hannun mutum, sai ka ce mai bukatan wani abu, domin shi kansa ne ke ba wa dukan mutane rai da numfashi da kuma kome.
english: He isn’t served by men’s hands, as though he needed anything, seeing he himself gives to all life and breath and all things.

hausa: Bayan Amaziya sarkin Yahuda ya nemi shawara mashawartansa, sai ya kalubalanci Yowash ɗan Yehoyahaz, ɗan Yehu, sarkin Isra’ila, “Zo mu gamu fuska da fuska.”
english: Then Amaziah king of Judah consulted his advisers, and sent to Joash, the son of Jehoahaz, the son of Jehu, king of Israel, saying, “Come! Let’s look one another in the face.”

hausa: Saratu ta ce, “Allah ya sa na yi dariya, kuma duk wanda ya ji game da wannan, zai yi dariya tare da ni.”
english: Sarah said, “God has made me laugh. Everyone who hears will laugh with me.”

hausa: “In mutum ya yi zunubi, ya aikata ɗaya daga cikin abubuwan da Ubangiji ya umarta kada a yi, ko da yake bai sani ba, shi mai laifi ne. Za a kuwa nemi hakki daga gare shi.
english: “If anyone sins, doing any of the things which Yahweh has commanded not to be done, though he didn’t know it, he is still guilty, and shall bear his iniquity.

hausa: Za ku yi shuki amma ba za ku girba ba; za ku matse zaitun amma ba za ku yi amfani da mai wa kanku ba, za ku tattaka ’ya’yan inabi amma ba za ku sha ruwan inabin ba.
english: You will sow, but won’t reap. You will tread the olives, but won’t anoint yourself with oil; and crush grapes, but won’t drink the wine.

hausa: Duk da haka kuwa shi ne ya cika gidajensu da abubuwa masu kyau, saboda haka ba ruwana da shawarar mugaye.
english: Yet he filled their houses with good things, but the counsel of the wicked is far from me.

hausa: In an gafarta zunubai, babu sauran bukatar miƙa hadaya.
english: Now where remission of these is, there is no more offering for sin.

hausa: Sai Musa ya hau kan dutsen don yă sadu da Allah, Ubangiji kuwa ya kira shi daga dutsen ya ce, “Wannan shi ne abin da za ka faɗa wa gidan Yaƙub, da kuma abin da za ka faɗa wa mutanen Isra’ila.
english: Moses went up to God, and Yahweh called to him out of the mountain, saying, “This is what you shall tell the house of Jacob, and tell the children of Israel:

hausa: Mutane suka yi wa macijin sujada domin ya ba wa dabbar ikonsa, suka yi wa dabbar sujada, suka kuma yi tambaya cewa, “Wane ne yake kama da dabban nan? Wa zai iya yaƙe ta?”
english: They worshiped the dragon because he gave his authority to the beast; and they worshiped the beast, saying, “Who is like the beast? Who is able to make war with him?”

hausa: In akwai mutum mai salama a gidan, salamarku za tă kasance tare da shi, in kuwa babu, salamarku za tă koma muku.
english: If a son of peace is there, your peace will rest on him; but if not, it will return to you.

hausa: A tituna suna kukan neman ruwan inabi; dukan farin ciki ya dawo baƙin ciki, an hana dukan kaɗe-kaɗe a duniya.
english: There is a crying in the streets because of the wine. All joy is darkened. The mirth of the land is gone.

hausa: “Na yi alkawari da idanuna kada su dubi budurwa da muguwar sha’awa.
english: “I made a covenant with my eyes; how then should I look lustfully at a young woman?

hausa: Mai hikima kan yi ajiyar sani, amma bakin wawa kan gayyaci lalaci.
english: Wise men lay up knowledge, but the mouth of the foolish is near ruin.

hausa: Gama son kuɗi shi ne tushen kowane irin mugun abu. Waɗansu mutane, don tsananin son kuɗi, sun bauɗe daga bangaskiya suka kuma jawo wa kansu da baƙin ciki iri-iri.
english: For the love of money is a root of all kinds of evil. Some have been led astray from the faith in their greed, and have pierced themselves through with many sorrows.

hausa: Sai ya sāke ziyarci Kana ta Galili inda ya juya ruwa ya zama ruwan inabi. Akwai wani ma’aikacin hukuma a can wanda ɗansa yake kwance da rashin lafiya a Kafarnahum.
english: Jesus came therefore again to Cana of Galilee, where he made the water into wine. There was a certain nobleman whose son was sick at Capernaum.

hausa: Ubangiji yakan soke shirye-shiryen al’ummai; yakan wofintar da manufofin mutane.
english: Yahweh brings the counsel of the nations to nothing. He makes the thoughts of the peoples to be of no effect.

hausa: “Haruna zai kawo bijimi domin hadayarsa ta zunubi don yă yi kafara wa kansa da kuma domin gidansa, zai kuma yanka bijimin domin nasa hadaya don zunubi.
english: “Aaron shall present the bull of the sin offering, which is for himself, and shall make atonement for himself and for his house, and shall kill the bull of the sin offering which is for himself.

hausa: ka kiyaye wannan umarni ba tare da wani aibi ko abin zargi ba har yă bayyanuwar Ubangijinmu Yesu Kiristi,
english: that you keep the commandment without spot, blameless until the appearing of our Lord Jesus Christ,

hausa: “Ya Ubangijinmu da Allahnmu, ka cancanci ɗaukaka da girma da iko, domin ka halicci dukan abubuwa, kuma ta wurin nufinka aka halicce su suka kuma kasance.”
english: “Worthy are you, our Lord and God, the Holy One, to receive the glory, the honor, and the power, for you created all things, and because of your desire they existed and were created!”

hausa: Ba a sami ƙarya a bakunansu ba; su kuma marasa aibi ne.
english: In their mouth was found no lie, for they are blameless.

hausa: Kafin tukwanenka su ji zafin ƙayayyuwa, ko su kore ne ko busasshe, za a shafe mugaye.
english: Before your pots can feel the heat of the thorns, he will sweep away the green and the burning alike.

hausa: Ruwan inabi mai yin ba’a ne, barasa kuma mai rikici ne; duk wanda suka sa ya kauce marar hikima ne.
english: Wine is a mocker and beer is a brawler. Whoever is led astray by them is not wise.

hausa: Sa’ad da Ubangiji ya kawo ku cikin ƙasar Kan’aniyawa, Hittiyawa, Amoriyawa, Hiwiyawa da Yebusiyawa, ƙasar da ya rantse wa kakanninku cewa zai ba ku, ƙasar da take zub da madara da zuma, za ku kiyaye wannan biki a wannan wata.
english: It shall be, when Yahweh brings you into the land of the Canaanite, and the Hittite, and the Amorite, and the Hivite, and the Jebusite, which he swore to your fathers to give you, a land flowing with milk and honey, that you shall keep this service in this month.

hausa: Farisiyawa da waɗansu malaman dokoki waɗanda suka zo daga Urushalima, suka taru kewaye da Yesu.
english: Then the Pharisees and some of the scribes gathered together to him, having come from Jerusalem.

hausa: Na yi kira da dukan zuciyata; ka amsa mini, ya Ubangiji, zan kuwa yi biyayya da ƙa’idodinka.
english: I have called with my whole heart. Answer me, Yahweh! I will keep your statutes.

hausa: inda za tă juya tă haɗu da Rafin Masar, tă kuma ƙarasa a Bahar Rum.
english: The border shall turn about from Azmon to the brook of Egypt, and it shall end at the sea.

hausa: Abner ɗan Ner, tare da mutanen Ish-Boshet ɗan Shawulu, suka bar Mahanayim suka tafi Gibeyon.
english: Abner the son of Ner, and the servants of Ishbosheth the son of Saul, went out from Mahanaim to Gibeon.

hausa: A waɗannan kwanaki, na ga mutane a Yahuda suna matse ruwan inabi a ranar Asabbaci suna kuma kawo hatsi suna labta su a kan jakuna, tare da ruwan inabi, ’ya’yan inabi, ɓaure da kaya iri-iri. Suna kuma kawowa dukan wannan cikin Urushalima a ranar Asabbaci. Saboda haka na gargaɗe su a kan sayar da abinci a wannan rana.
english: In those days I saw some men treading wine presses on the Sabbath in Judah, bringing in sheaves, and loading donkeys with wine, grapes, figs, and all kinds of burdens which they brought into Jerusalem on the Sabbath day; and I testified against them in the day in which they sold food.

hausa: Amma domin kana tsaka-tsaka ba zafi ba, ba kuma sanyi ba, ina dab da tofar da kai daga bakina.
english: So, because you are lukewarm, and neither hot nor cold, I will vomit you out of my mouth.

hausa: Jagoranci waɗanda suke da idanu amma suke makafi, waɗanda suke da kunnuwa amma suke kurame.
english: Bring out the blind people who have eyes, and the deaf who have ears.

hausa: da kuma Uriya, mutumin Hitti. Su talatin da bakwai ne duka.
english: and Uriah the Hittite: thirty-seven in all.

hausa: Amma muka yi addu’a ga Allahnmu muka kuma sa masu tsaro da rana da kuma dare don mu magance wannan barazana.
english: But we made our prayer to our God, and set a watch against them day and night because of them.

hausa: Ta wurin yawan kasuwancinka ka cika da rikici, ka kuma yi zunubi. Saboda haka na kore ka da kunya daga dutsen Allah, na kore ka, ya kerub mai tsaro, daga cikin duwatsun wuta.
english: By the abundance of your commerce, your insides were filled with violence, and you have sinned. Therefore I have cast you as profane out of God’s mountain. I have destroyed you, covering cherub, from the middle of the stones of fire.

hausa: Ishmayel ɗan Netaniya ya fito daga Mizfa don yă sadu da su. Sa’ad da ya sadu da su, sai ya ce, “Ku zo wurin Gedaliya ɗan Ahikam.”
english: Ishmael the son of Nethaniah went out from Mizpah to meet them, weeping all along as he went, and as he met them, he said to them, “Come to Gedaliah the son of Ahikam.”

hausa: Amma Kiristi mai aminci ne kamar ɗa a gidan Allah. Mu kuwa gidansa ne, in muka tsaya gabanmu gadi da kuma begen da muke taƙama a kai.
english: but Christ is faithful as a Son over his house. We are his house, if we hold fast our confidence and the glorying of our hope firm to the end.

hausa: Kada sarki ya ƙwace gādon mutane, yana korinsu daga mallakarsu. Zai ba wa ’ya’yansa maza gādonsu daga cikin mallakarsa, don kada a raba wani daga mutanena da mallakarsa.’ ”
english: Moreover the prince shall not take of the people’s inheritance, to thrust them out of their possession. He shall give inheritance to his sons out of his own possession, that my people not each be scattered from his possession.”’”

hausa: A cikin yanki mai tsarki, ka auna tsawo kamu 25,000 da kuma fāɗi kamu 10,000. A cikinsa wuri mai tsarki zai kasance, Wuri Mafi Tsarki.
english: Of this measure you shall measure a length of twenty-five thousand, and a width of ten thousand. In it shall be the sanctuary, which is most holy.

hausa: Bari dukan waɗanda suke ƙin Sihiyona a juye da su baya da kunya.
english: Let them be disappointed and turned backward, all those who hate Zion.

hausa: “Mun ji shi ya ce, ‘Zan rushe wannan haikali da mutum ya gina, cikin kwana uku, in sāke gina wani wanda ba ginin mutum ba.’ ”
english: “We heard him say, ‘I will destroy this temple that is made with hands, and in three days I will build another made without hands.’”

hausa: Gama ina cin toka a matsayin abincina ina kuma gauraye abin sha nawa da hawaye
english: For I have eaten ashes like bread, and mixed my drink with tears,

hausa: Gādona ya zama mini kamar zaki a kurmi. Yana mini ruri; saboda haka na ƙi shi.
english: My heritage has become to me as a lion in the forest. She has uttered her voice against me. Therefore I have hated her.

hausa: Suka miƙa wa Ubangiji birnin, suka hallaka kowane abu mai ran da yake cikin birnin da takobi, maza da mata, yara da tsofaffi, shanu, tumaki da jakuna.
english: They utterly destroyed all that was in the city, both man and woman, both young and old, and ox, sheep, and donkey, with the edge of the sword.

hausa: Kowane soja, ya kwashi ganima wa kansa.
english: The men of war had taken booty, every man for himself.

hausa: don yă ƙirƙiro zāne-zāne na gwaninta waɗanda za yi da zinariya, da azurfa da kuma tagulla.
english: and to make skillful works, to work in gold, in silver, in bronze,

hausa: Ina hakkin da bakina a buɗe, ina marmarin umarnanka.
english: I opened my mouth wide and panted, for I longed for your commandments.

hausa: Ahitofel shi ne mashawarcin sarki. Hushai mutumin Arkitawa shi ne abokin sarki na kud da kud.
english: Ahithophel was the king’s counselor. Hushai the Archite was the king’s friend.

hausa: Gama Ezra ya miƙa kansa ga bincike da kuma kiyaye Dokar Ubangiji, da kuma koya wa Isra’ilawa dokoki da kuma umarnan Ubangiji.
english: For Ezra had set his heart to seek Yahweh’s law, and to do it, and to teach statutes and ordinances in Israel.

hausa: Waɗanda suke son nuna bajinta a fili suna ƙoƙari su tilasta muku ku yi kaciya ne. Dalilin kaɗai da suke yin haka shi ne don gudu kada a tsananta musu saboda gicciyen Kiristi ne.
english: As many as desire to make a good impression in the flesh compel you to be circumcised, just so they may not be persecuted for the cross of Christ.

hausa: Sai Iblis ya kai shi birni mai tsarki, ya kai shi can wuri mafi tsayi duka na haikali.
english: Then the devil took him into the holy city. He set him on the pinnacle of the temple,

hausa: Ta wurinsa kowa da ya gaskata an kuɓutar da shi daga dukan abin da Dokar Musa ba tă iya kuɓutar ba.
english: and by him everyone who believes is justified from all things, from which you could not be justified by the law of Moses.

hausa: Yesu ya amsa ya ce, “Na faɗa muku, amma ba ku gaskata ba. Ayyukan da nake yi cikin sunan Ubana su suke nuna ko wane ne ni.
english: Jesus answered them, “I told you, and you don’t believe. The works that I do in my Father’s name, these testify about me.

hausa: Sa’an nan zai ɗebi ruwa mai tsarki a tulun laka, yă zuba ƙurar da ya ɗebo daga daɓen tabanakul a cikin ruwan.
english: The priest shall take holy water in an earthen vessel; and the priest shall take some of the dust that is on the floor of the tabernacle and put it into the water.

hausa: Dukan mutane za su ƙi ku saboda ni, amma wanda ya tsaya da ƙarfi har ƙarshe, zai sami ceto.
english: You will be hated by all men for my name’s sake, but he who endures to the end will be saved.

hausa: Ba ko ɗaya daga cikinku da zai shiga ƙasar da na ɗaga hannu na rantse, za tă zama gidanku, sai dai Kaleb ɗan Yefunne da Yoshuwa ɗan Nun.
english: surely you shall not come into the land concerning which I swore that I would make you dwell therein, except Caleb the son of Jephunneh, and Joshua the son of Nun.

hausa: Saboda haka ina aika muku da annabawa, da masu hikima da malamai. Waɗansunsu za ku kashe ku kuma gicciye; waɗansu kuma za ku yi musu bulala a majami’unku kuna kuma binsu gari-gari.
english: Therefore, behold, I send to you prophets, wise men, and scribes. Some of them you will kill and crucify; and some of them you will scourge in your synagogues and persecute from city to city,

hausa: Amma yanzu ka ƙarfafa, ya Zerubbabel,’ in ji Ubangiji. ‘Ka ƙarfafa, ya Yoshuwa ɗan Yehozadak, babban firist. Ku ƙarfafa, dukanku mutanen ƙasar,’ in ji Ubangiji, ‘ku yi aiki. Gama ina tare da ku,’ in ji Ubangiji Maɗaukaki.
english: Yet now be strong, Zerubbabel,’ says Yahweh. ‘Be strong, Joshua son of Jehozadak, the high priest. Be strong, all you people of the land,’ says Yahweh, ‘and work, for I am with you,’ says Yahweh of Armies.

hausa: Don haka sa’ad da aka aika in zo, na zo ba wata faɗa. To, ko zan san abin da ya sa ka aika in zo?”
english: Therefore I also came without complaint when I was sent for. I ask therefore, why did you send for me?”

hausa: “Ba su ma san yadda za su yi abin da yake daidai ba,” in ji Ubangiji, “sun ɓoye ganima da abubuwan da suka washe a cikin kagarunsu.”
english: “Indeed they don’t know to do right,” says Yahweh, “Who hoard plunder and loot in their palaces.”

hausa: Ya zaɓi abubuwa marasa martaba na wannan duniya da kuma abubuwan da aka rena da abubuwan da ba a ɗauka a bakin kome ba, domin a wofinta abubuwan da ake ganinsu da daraja,
english: God chose the lowly things of the world, and the things that are despised, and the things that don’t exist, that he might bring to nothing the things that exist,

hausa: Suka haura zuwa birnin, da shigarsu sai ga Sama’ila ya nufo su a hanyarsa ta zuwa kan tudu.
english: They went up to the city. As they came within the city, behold, Samuel came out toward them to go up to the high place.

hausa: kada su zama masu ɓata sunan kowa, su zama masu salama da kulawa, su kuma zama masu matuƙar tawali’u ga dukan mutane.
english: to speak evil of no one, not to be contentious, to be gentle, showing all humility toward all men.

hausa: Dukan mutanen Isra’ila kuwa suka tattaru gaba ɗaya suka zo wurin sarki a lokacin biki a wata na bakwai.
english: So all the men of Israel assembled themselves to the king at the feast, which was in the seventh month.

hausa: Ɗana, ka kiyaye umarnan mahaifinka kada kuma ka ƙyale koyarwar mahaifiyarka.
english: My son, keep your father’s commandment, and don’t forsake your mother’s teaching.

hausa: sai Dawuda ya sāke roƙi Allah, Allah kuwa ya amsa masa, “Kada ka tafi kai tsaye, amma ka yi zobe kewaye da su, ka kuma fāɗa musu a gaban itatuwan tsamiya.
english: David inquired again of God; and God said to him, “You shall not go up after them. Turn away from them, and come on them opposite the mulberry trees.

hausa: Ta haka kuke rushe maganar Allah ta wurin al’adun da kuke miƙa wa ’ya’yanku. Haka kuma kuke yin abubuwa da yawa.”
english: making void the word of God by your tradition which you have handed down. You do many things like this.”

hausa: Manufofin zuciyar mutum zurfafan ruwaye ne, amma mutum mai basira yakan jawo su.
english: Counsel in the heart of man is like deep water, but a man of understanding will draw it out.

hausa: Saboda haka na gane wannan ƙa’ida ce take aiki a cikina. Sa’ad da nake so in yi abu mai kyau, sai in ga cewa mugun nan ne nake yi.
english: I find then the law that, while I desire to do good, evil is present.

hausa: Yanzu Yehohiyada ya tsufa kuma cike da shekaru, ya kuwa mutu yana da shekara ɗari da talatin.
english: But Jehoiada grew old and was full of days, and he died. He was one hundred thirty years old when he died.

hausa: A maimakon yă saurara, sai ya juya ya koma fadarsa, bai ma damu da abin da aka yi ba.
english: Pharaoh turned and went into his house, and he didn’t even take this to heart.

hausa: Amma in ba ku saurara ba, zan yi kuka a ɓoye saboda girmankanku; idanuna za su yi kuka mai zafi, suna zub da hawaye ƙwarai, domin zan kwashe garken Ubangiji zuwa zaman bauta.
english: But if you will not hear it, my soul will weep in secret for your pride. My eye will weep bitterly, and run down with tears, because Yahweh’s flock has been taken captive.

hausa: A kwanakin nan sai Hezekiya ya kamu da rashin lafiya har ya kusa mutuwa. Sai annabi Ishaya ɗan Amoz ya zo wurinsa ya ce, “Ga abin da Ubangiji ya ce, ka kintsa gidanka domin za ka mutu, ba za ka warke ba.”
english: In those days Hezekiah was sick and dying. Isaiah the prophet the son of Amoz came to him, and said to him, “Yahweh says, ‘Set your house in order; for you will die, and not live.’”

hausa: Gama ni ne Ubangiji, Allahnku, Mai Tsarkin nan na Isra’ila, Mai Cetonku; na bayar da Masar don fansa, Kush da Seba a maimakonku.
english: For I am Yahweh your God, the Holy One of Israel, your Savior. I have given Egypt as your ransom, Ethiopia and Seba in your place.

hausa: Sau ɗaya ba ƙari, na rantse da tsarkina, ba kuwa zan yi ƙarya wa Dawuda ba,
english: Once I have sworn by my holiness, I will not lie to David.

hausa: ta ashirin da uku a kan Mahaziyot, na goma sha biya a kan Yerimot, ’ya’yansa maza da danginsa, 12
english: for the twenty-third to Mahazioth, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

hausa: Za ku mutu a cikin al’ummai, ƙasar abokan gābanku za tă cinye ku.
english: You will perish among the nations. The land of your enemies will eat you up.

hausa: Za su kawo taron jama’a a kanki, waɗanda za su jajjefe ki da dutse su sassare ki gunduwa-gunduwa da takubansu.
english: They will also bring up a company against you, and they will stone you with stones, and thrust you through with their swords.

hausa: Sa’ad da wani yana da laifi a kowanne cikin waɗannan hanyoyi, dole yă furta a hanyar da ya yi zunubin
english: It shall be, when he is guilty of one of these, he shall confess that in which he has sinned;

hausa: amma duk wanda ya sha ruwan da zan ba shi, ba zai ƙara jin ƙishirwa ba. Tabbatacce, ruwan da zan ba shi, zai zama masa maɓuɓɓugan ruwa da yake ɓuɓɓugowa har yă zuwa rai madawwami.”
english: but whoever drinks of the water that I will give him will never thirst again; but the water that I will give him will become in him a well of water springing up to eternal life.”

hausa: Bitrus ya ce, “Gama yana a rubuce a cikin Littafin Zabura cewa, “ ‘Bari wurinsa yă zama babu kowa; kada kowa ya zauna a cikinsa,’ kuma, “ ‘Bari wani ya ɗauki matsayinsa na shugabanci.’
english: For it is written in the book of Psalms, ‘Let his habitation be made desolate. Let no one dwell in it;’ and, ‘Let another take his office.’

hausa: Ban da haka ma, daga shekara ta ashirin ta Sarki Artazerzes, sa’ad da aka naɗa ni in zama gwamnansu a ƙasar Yahuda, har zuwa shekara ta talatin da biyu na mulkinsa, shekara sha biyu ke nan, ko ni, ko ’yan’uwana, ba wanda ya ci abincin da akan ba wa gwamna.
english: Moreover from the time that I was appointed to be their governor in the land of Judah, from the twentieth year even to the thirty-second year of Artaxerxes the king, that is, twelve years, I and my brothers have not eaten the bread of the governor.

hausa: Zo, mu sha zurfin ƙauna har safe; bari mu ji wa ranmu daɗi da ƙauna!
english: Come, let’s take our fill of loving until the morning. Let’s solace ourselves with loving.

hausa: domin abinci da ruwa za su kāsa. Za su damu da ganin juna za su kuma lalace saboda zunubinsu.
english: that they may lack bread and water, be dismayed one with another, and pine away in their iniquity.

hausa: Kishin Efraim zai ɓace, za a kuma kau da abokan gāban Yahuda; Efraim ba zai yi kishin Yahuda ba, haka ma Yahuda ba zai yi gāba da Efraim ba.
english: The envy also of Ephraim will depart, and those who persecute Judah will be cut off. Ephraim won’t envy Judah, and Judah won’t persecute Ephraim.

hausa: Gama in har Allah bai ƙyale mala’iku sa’ad da suka yi zunubi ba, amma ya tura su cikin lahira, domin a tsare su don hukunci;
english: For if God didn’t spare angels when they sinned, but cast them down to Tartarus, and committed them to pits of darkness to be reserved for judgment;

hausa: Wanda bisa ga Ruhun tsarki, an shaida shi da iko cewa shi Ɗan Allah ne ta wurin tashinsa daga matattu. Wannan bishara kuwa game da Yesu Kiristi Ubangijinmu ne.
english: who was declared to be the Son of God with power according to the Spirit of holiness, by the resurrection from the dead, Jesus Christ our Lord,

hausa: Tare da ni akwai wadata da girmamawa, dukiya da wadata masu dawwama.
english: With me are riches, honor, enduring wealth, and prosperity.

hausa: Kafin rana ta fāɗi a rana ta bakwai mutane garin suka ce masa, “Me ya fi zuma zaki? Me ya fi zaki ƙarfi?” Samson ya ce musu, “Da ba don kun haɗa baki da matata ba, da ba za ku san amsar kacici-kacici ba.”
english: The men of the city said to him on the seventh day before the sun went down, “What is sweeter than honey? What is stronger than a lion?” He said to them, “If you hadn’t plowed with my heifer, you wouldn’t have found out my riddle.”

hausa: Ya kakkarya ƙarfin masu mulki; sarakunan duniya suna tsoronsa.
english: He will cut off the spirit of princes. He is feared by the kings of the earth.

hausa: Ɗakunan da suke a hawa na uku ba su da ginshiƙai, yadda filayen suka kasance da su, saboda haka suka matsu fiye da waɗanda suke a hawa na ƙasa da na tsakiya.
english: For they were in three stories, and they didn’t have pillars as the pillars of the courts. Therefore the uppermost was set back more than the lowest and the middle from the ground.

hausa: Saboda haka dole a zaɓi ɗaya daga cikin mutanen da suke tare da mu duk lokacin da Ubangiji Yesu yake shiga da fita a cikinmu,
english: “Of the men therefore who have accompanied us all the time that the Lord Jesus went in and out among us,

hausa: Ka kwantar da hankali, ya raina, gama Ubangiji mai alheri ne a gare ka.
english: Return to your rest, my soul, for Yahweh has dealt bountifully with you.

hausa: Za a haɗa katakan nan a kusurwa daga ƙasa zuwa sama a daure su. Haka za a yi da katakan kusurwa na biyu.
english: They shall be double beneath, and in the same way they shall be whole to its top to one ring: thus shall it be for them both; they shall be for the two corners.

hausa: Zan cika duwatsunka da matattu; waɗanda aka kashe da takobi za su fāɗi a kan tuddanka, da cikin kwarurukanka, da cikin dukan kwazazzabanka.
english: I will fill its mountains with its slain. The slain with the sword will fall in your hills and in your valleys and in all your watercourses.

hausa: Da yake dole kowane babban firist da aka naɗa yă miƙa baye-baye da hadayu, haka ma wannan ya bukaci yă kasance da abin da zai miƙa.
english: For every high priest is appointed to offer both gifts and sacrifices. Therefore it is necessary that this high priest also have something to offer.

hausa: amma suka yi cuɗanya da al’ummai suka ɗauki al’adunsu.
english: but mixed themselves with the nations, and learned their works.

hausa: Ku samo mana bijimai biyu. Bari su zaɓa ɗaya wa kansu, bari kuma su yanka shi kucu-kucu su sa a itace, sai dai, kada su sa wuta a kansa. Ni kuwa zan shirya ɗaya bijimin in sa a kan itace, ni ma, ba zan sa wuta a kansa ba.
english: Let them therefore give us two bulls; and let them choose one bull for themselves, and cut it in pieces, and lay it on the wood, and put no fire under; and I will dress the other bull, and lay it on the wood, and put no fire under it.

hausa: Yana biyan mutum bisa ga abin da ya yi; yana kawo masa abin da ayyukansa suka jawo.
english: For the work of a man he will give to him, and cause every man to find according to his ways.

hausa: Dukan biranen nan masu katanga da suke da tsayi masu ƙofofi da ƙyamare, akwai kuma manya ƙauyukan da ba su da katanga.
english: All these were cities fortified with high walls, gates, and bars, in addition to a great many villages without walls.

hausa: da kuma wanda ya fitar da ku daga Masar don in zama Allahnku. Ni ne Ubangiji.”
english: who brought you out of the land of Egypt, to be your God. I am Yahweh.”

hausa: “Ubangiji bai tuna ya kuma yi tunani game da turaren da aka ƙone a garuruwan Yahuda da kan titunan Urushalima wanda ku da kakanninku, sarakunanku da fadawanku da mutanen ƙasar ba ne?
english: “The incense that you burned in the cities of Judah, and in the streets of Jerusalem, you and your fathers, your kings and your princes, and the people of the land, didn’t Yahweh remember them, and didn’t it come into his mind?

hausa: “Ga abin da Ubangiji Maɗaukaki ya ce, ‘Ku tambayi firist abin da doka ta ce.
english: “Yahweh of Armies says: Ask now the priests concerning the law, saying,

hausa: Takobina ya sha zararsa a cikin sammai; duba, ya sauko cikin hukunci a kan Edom, mutanen da zan hallaka tas.
english: For my sword has drunk its fill in the sky. Behold, it will come down on Edom, and on the people of my curse, for judgment.

hausa: da tuƙaƙƙun sarƙoƙi biyu kamar igiya, na zinariya zalla, ka kuma ɗaura wa tsaikunan nan biyu tuƙaƙƙun sarƙoƙi.
english: and two chains of pure gold; you shall make them like cords of braided work. You shall put the braided chains on the settings.

hausa: Sai Shawulu ya umarci ma’aikatansa cewa, “Ku yi magana da Dawuda asirce ku ce, ‘Duba, sarki yana farin ciki da kai, dukan ma’aikatansa kuma suna sonka, ka yarda ka zama surukinsa.’ ”
english: Saul commanded his servants, “Talk with David secretly, and say, ‘Behold, the king has delight in you, and all his servants love you. Now therefore be the king’s son-in-law.’”

hausa: Yayinda suke juyewa hatsi daga buhunansu, sai ga ƙunshin azurfan kowane mutum a buhunsa! Sa’ad da su da mahaifinsu suka ga ƙunshe-ƙunshen kuɗi, suka firgita.
english: As they emptied their sacks, behold, each man’s bundle of money was in his sack. When they and their father saw their bundles of money, they were afraid.

hausa: An zaɓe ni in bayyana wa dukan mutane shirin asirin nan wanda Allah, mahaliccin kome, ya ɓoye shekara da shekaru.
english: and to make all men see what is the administration of the mystery which for ages has been hidden in God, who created all things through Jesus Christ,

hausa: Kerubobin sun buɗe fikafikansu a bisa wurin da akwatin alkawarin yake, suka inuwartar da akwatin alkawarin da sandunan ɗaukansa.
english: For the cherubim spread their wings out over the place of the ark, and the cherubim covered the ark and its poles above.

hausa: Ta haka maganar Ubangiji da ya yi wa Yehu ta cika, wadda ya ce, “Zuriyarka za tă zauna a kursiyin Isra’ila har tsara ta huɗu.”
english: This was Yahweh’s word which he spoke to Jehu, saying, “Your sons to the fourth generation shall sit on the throne of Israel.” So it came to pass.

hausa: Ya naɗe ruwaye a cikin gizagizansa, duk da haka girgijen bai yage saboda nauyi ba.
english: He binds up the waters in his thick clouds, and the cloud is not burst under them.

hausa: Ba masifa ba ne domin mugaye, hallaka kuma ga waɗanda suka yi ba daidai ba?
english: Is it not calamity to the unrighteous, and disaster to the workers of iniquity?

hausa: Tsayayyu ne har abada abadin, ana yinsu cikin aminci da kuma gaskiya.
english: They are established forever and ever. They are done in truth and uprightness.

hausa: Da Yesu ya sāke ƙetarewa cikin jirgin ruwa zuwa ɗaya hayen tafkin, sai taro mai yawa ya taru kewaye da shi yayinda yake a bakin tafkin.
english: When Jesus had crossed back over in the boat to the other side, a great multitude was gathered to him; and he was by the sea.

hausa: Sandar gyara kan ba da hikima, amma yaron da aka bari ba horo kan jawo kunya ga mahaifiyarsa.
english: The rod of correction gives wisdom, but a child left to himself causes shame to his mother.

hausa: Zuriyar Kohat su ne, Amminadab, Kora, Assir,
english: The sons of Kohath: Amminadab his son, Korah his son, Assir his son,

hausa: Mutane sukan nemi samun farin jini daga wurin sarki, amma daga wurin Ubangiji ne mutum kan sami adalci.
english: Many seek the ruler’s favor, but a man’s justice comes from Yahweh.

hausa: Yana abokantaka da masu aikata mugunta; yana cuɗanya da mugaye.
english: who goes in company with the workers of iniquity, and walks with wicked men?

hausa: Akan ce da masu hikima a zuciya hazikai, kuma kalmomi masu daɗi kan inganta umarni.
english: The wise in heart shall be called prudent. Pleasantness of the lips promotes instruction.

hausa: Ko da yake mayaƙa sun kewaye ni, zuciyata ba za tă ji tsoro ba; ko da yake ya ɓarke a kaina, duk da haka zan ƙarfafa.
english: Though an army should encamp against me, my heart shall not fear. Though war should rise against me, even then I will be confident.

hausa: Ko ɗigar ta ci gaba da fitowa daga azzakarinsa ko an tsere ta, za tă sa mutumin yă zama marar tsarki. Ga yadda ɗigarsa za tă kawo ƙazantuwa,
english: This shall be his uncleanness in his discharge: whether his body runs with his discharge, or his body has stopped from his discharge, it is his uncleanness.

hausa: Ga mai aminci ka nuna kanka mai aminci, ga marar laifi ka nuna kanka marar laifi,
english: With the merciful you will show yourself merciful. With the perfect man, you will show yourself perfect.

hausa: Amma ba su fahimci abin da yake faɗin musu ba.
english: They didn’t understand the saying which he spoke to them.

hausa: Zan ba ɗan baiwan nan al’umma shi ma, domin shi zuriyarka ne.”
english: I will also make a nation of the son of the servant, because he is your child.”

hausa: don kada rarrabuwa ta kasance a jiki, sai dai gaɓoɓin jiki su kula da juna.
english: that there should be no division in the body, but that the members should have the same care for one another.

hausa: Zan kore ku daga birnin in miƙa ku a hannuwan baƙi in kuma azabtar da ku.
english: “I will bring you out of the middle of it, and deliver you into the hands of strangers, and will execute judgments among you.

hausa: Bayan wannan, Yusuf ya aika a zo da mahaifinsa Yaƙub da dukan iyalinsa, gaba ɗaya dai mutum saba’in da biyar ne.
english: Joseph sent and summoned Jacob his father and all his relatives, seventy-five souls.

hausa: Sai sarki ya yi baƙin ciki ƙwarai, amma saboda rantsuwar da kuma baƙinsa, bai so yă hana ta ba.
english: The king was exceedingly sorry, but for the sake of his oaths and of his dinner guests, he didn’t wish to refuse her.

hausa: Ba za a ƙara ce da ke Yasasshiya ba, ko a kira ƙasarki Kango. Amma za a ce da ke Hefziba ƙasarki kuma Bewula; gama Ubangiji zai ji daɗinki, ƙasarki kuma za tă yi aure.
english: You will not be called Forsaken any more, nor will your land be called Desolate any more; but you will be called Hephzibah, and your land Beulah; for Yahweh delights in you, and your land will be married.

hausa: Sai Na’aman ya je wurin maigidansa ya faɗa masa abin da yarinyan nan daga Isra’ila ta faɗa.
english: Someone went in and told his lord, saying, “The girl who is from the land of Israel said this.”

hausa: In wani ya yi kunnuwa ƙashi ga doka ko addu’arsa ma abar ƙyama ce.
english: He who turns away his ear from hearing the law, even his prayer is an abomination.

hausa: Waɗansu cikin zuriyarka, nama da jininka waɗanda za a haifa maka, za a kwashe su a tafi, za su zama bābānni a fadan sarkin Babilon.”
english: ‘They will take away your sons who will issue from you, whom you shall father, and they will be eunuchs in the king of Babylon’s palace.’”

hausa: Sa’an nan masu hidimar da suke a ƙofar sarki suka tambaye Mordekai, “Me ya sa ba ka yin biyayya da umarnin sarki?”
english: Then the king’s servants who were in the king’s gate said to Mordecai, “Why do you disobey the king’s commandment?”

hausa: Amma Hiridus ya ce, “Yohanna dai na yanke kansa, amma wanne mutum ne nake jin labarin abubuwan nan a kansa?” Sai ya yi ƙoƙari ya ga Yesu.
english: Herod said, “I beheaded John, but who is this about whom I hear such things?” He sought to see him.

hausa: A ce wani ya shigo cikin taronku saye da zoben zinariya da riguna masu tsada, wani matalauci kuma saye da tsummoki shi ma ya shigo,
english: For if a man with a gold ring, in fine clothing, comes into your synagogue, and a poor man in filthy clothing also comes in,

hausa: In kuwa a wani wuri ba a karɓe ku, ba a kuwa saurare ku ba, sai ku karkaɗe ƙurar ƙafafunku sa’ad da kuka fita, a matsayin shaida a kansu.”
english: Whoever will not receive you nor hear you, as you depart from there, shake off the dust that is under your feet for a testimony against them. Assuredly, I tell you, it will be more tolerable for Sodom and Gomorrah in the day of judgment than for that city!”

hausa: Don mai bi da kaɗe-kaɗe. Ta Dawuda. Zabura ce. Na jira da haƙuri ga Ubangiji; ya juya wurina ya kuma ji kukata.
english: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. I waited patiently for Yahweh. He turned to me, and heard my cry.

hausa: Ga abin da Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka yana cewa abokin gāba yana magana game da ku cewa, “Yauwa! Tsofaffin tuddai sun zama mallakarmu yanzu.” ’
english: The Lord Yahweh says: ‘Because the enemy has said against you, “Aha!” and, “The ancient high places are ours in possession!”’

hausa: Jimillar Lawiyawan da Musa da Haruna suka ƙidaya bisa ga umarnin Ubangiji bisa ga danginsu, haɗe da kowane jariri daga wata ɗaya ko fiye, 22,000 ne.
english: All who were counted of the Levites, whom Moses and Aaron counted at the commandment of Yahweh, by their families, all the males from a month old and upward, were twenty-two thousand.

hausa: da shanu biyu, raguna biyar, bunsurai biyar da kuma ’yan raguna biyar, dukansu bana ɗaya-ɗaya, a miƙa su hadaya ta salama. Wannan ita ce hadayar Eliyasaf ɗan Deyuwel.
english: and for the sacrifice of peace offerings, two head of cattle, five rams, five male goats, and five male lambs a year old. This was the offering of Eliasaph the son of Deuel.

hausa: Sa’an nan za ku san cewa ni ne Ubangiji sa’ad da na kawo ku cikin ƙasar Isra’ila, ƙasar da na ɗaga hannu na rantse zan ba wa kakanninku.
english: You will know that I am Yahweh when I bring you into the land of Israel, into the country which I swore to give to your fathers.

hausa: Bayan da ya kori mutumin, sai ya sa kerubobi da takobi mai harshen wuta yana jujjuyawa baya da gaba a gabashin Lambun Eden don yă tsare hanya zuwa itacen rai.
english: So he drove out the man; and he placed cherubim at the east of the garden of Eden, and a flaming sword which turned every way, to guard the way to the tree of life.

hausa: Ubangiji ya ƙuduri niyya yă rushe bangon da yake kewaye da Diyar Sihiyona. Ya auna da igiyar awo bai fasa hallaka ta ba. Ya sa katanga da katanga duk suka lalace.
english: Yahweh has purposed to destroy the wall of the daughter of Zion. He has stretched out the line. He has not withdrawn his hand from destroying; He has made the rampart and wall lament. They languish together.

hausa: Guguwa za tă share su, hadayunsu kuma za su jawo musu abin kunya.
english: The wind has wrapped her up in its wings; and they shall be disappointed because of their sacrifices.

hausa: Ka gaya musu, ‘Ga hadaya ta ƙonawa ta kowace rana, da za ku miƙa wa Ubangiji, raguna biyu, bana ɗaya-ɗaya, marasa lahani.
english: You shall tell them, ‘This is the offering made by fire which you shall offer to Yahweh: male lambs a year old without defect, two day by day, for a continual burnt offering.

hausa: Suka yi magana a kan Allah, suna cewa, “Allah zai iya shimfiɗa tebur a cikin hamada?
english: Yes, they spoke against God. They said, “Can God prepare a table in the wilderness?

hausa: yayinda shi da dukan gidan Isra’ila suka hauro da akwatin alkawarin Ubangiji da sowa da kuma busar ƙahoni.
english: So David and all the house of Israel brought up Yahweh’s ark with shouting and with the sound of the trumpet.

hausa: Ya kuma hallaka Nob birnin firistoci, ya kashe dukan mata, da maza, da yara, da jarirai, da shanu, da jakuna, da kuma tumaki.
english: He struck Nob, the city of the priests, with the edge of the sword—both men and women, children and nursing babies, and cattle, donkeys, and sheep, with the edge of the sword.

hausa: Bayan ’yan shekaru sai ya gangara don yă ziyarci Ahab a Samariya. Ahab kuwa ya yanka tumaki da shanu masu yawa dominsa da kuma mutanen da suke tare da shi, ya kuma lallashe shi yă yaƙi Ramot Gileyad.
english: After some years, he went down to Ahab to Samaria. Ahab killed sheep and cattle for him in abundance, and for the people who were with him, and moved him to go up with him to Ramoth Gilead.

hausa: Na san inda kake da zama, inda Shaiɗan yana da gadon sarautarsa. Duk da haka ka riƙe sunana da gaske. Ba ka yi mūsun bangaskiyarka gare ni ba, har ma a kwanakin Antifas, amintaccen mashaidina, wanda aka kashe a birninku, inda Shaiɗan yake zama.
english: “I know your works and where you dwell, where Satan’s throne is. You hold firmly to my name, and didn’t deny my faith in the days of Antipas my witness, my faithful one, who was killed among you, where Satan dwells.

hausa: Yesu ya amsa ya ce, “Kun ɓata, domin ba ku san Nassi ko ikon Allah ba.
english: But Jesus answered them, “You are mistaken, not knowing the Scriptures, nor the power of God.

hausa: Rurinsu ya yi kamar na zaki, suna ruri kamar ’yan zakoki; suna yin gurnani yayinda suke kamun abin da suke farauta su ɗauke shi ba mai ƙwace shi.
english: Their roaring will be like a lioness. They will roar like young lions. Yes, they shall roar, and seize their prey and carry it off, and there will be no one to deliver.

hausa: Kowanne yakan ce, “Zo, bari in samo ruwan inabi! Bari mu cika cikinmu da barasa! Gobe ma zai zama kamar yau, ko ma fiye da haka.”
english: “Come,” they say, “I will get wine, and we will fill ourselves with strong drink; and tomorrow will be as today, great beyond measure.”

hausa: Sai ya ce mini, “Ɗakunan arewa da na kudu waɗanda suke fuskantar filin haikali ɗakunan firistoci ne, inda firistocin da suke kusaci Ubangiji za su ci hadayu mafi tsarki. A can za su ajiye hadayu mafi tsarki, hadayu na gari, hadayu na zunubi da hadayu na laifi, gama wuri mai tsarki ne.
english: Then he said to me, “The north rooms and the south rooms, which are opposite the separate place, are the holy rooms, where the priests who are near to Yahweh shall eat the most holy things. There they shall lay the most holy things, with the meal offering, the sin offering, and the trespass offering; for the place is holy.

hausa: Dukan kalmomin bakina suna da adalci; babu waninsu da ya karkace ko kuwa ƙarya ne.
english: All the words of my mouth are in righteousness. There is nothing crooked or perverse in them.

hausa: Karusa ta farko tana da jajjayen dawakai, ta biyu kuma baƙaƙen dawakai,
english: In the first chariot were red horses. In the second chariot were black horses.

hausa: A can bisantaUbangiji ya tsaya, ya kuma ce, “Ni ne Ubangiji Allah na mahaifinka Ibrahim da kuma Allah na Ishaku. Zan ba ka, kai da kuma zuriyarka, ƙasar da kake kwance a kai.
english: Behold, Yahweh stood above it, and said, “I am Yahweh, the God of Abraham your father, and the God of Isaac. I will give the land you lie on to you and to your offspring.

hausa: Lokacin da aka gaya wa Yoshuwa cewa an sami sarakunan nan biyar a ɓoye a cikin kogo a Makkeda.
english: Joshua was told, saying, “The five kings have been found, hidden in the cave at Makkedah.”

hausa: Ba wani lahanin da zai sami masu adalci, amma mugaye suna da nasu cike da wahala.
english: No mischief shall happen to the righteous, but the wicked shall be filled with evil.

hausa: Sai Yusuf ya yi mafarki, sa’ad da ya faɗa wa ’yan’uwansa, suka ƙara ƙin jininsa.
english: Joseph dreamed a dream, and he told it to his brothers, and they hated him all the more.

hausa: A ƙarshen shekara bakwai ɗin sai ta dawo daga ƙasar Filistiyawa, ta kuma tafi wajen sarki ta roƙa a mayar mata da gidanta da filinta.
english: At the end of seven years, the woman returned from the land of the Philistines. Then she went out to beg the king for her house and for her land.

hausa: Ko haifaffe a gidanka ko an sayo da kuɗi, dole a yi musu kaciya. Alkawarina cikin jikinku zai kasance madawwamin alkawari.
english: He who is born in your house, and he who is bought with your money, must be circumcised. My covenant shall be in your flesh for an everlasting covenant.

hausa: A ranan nan za a rubuta TSARKI GA Ubangiji a jikin ƙararrawar dawakai, kuma tukwanen dahuwa a gidan Ubangiji za su zama kamar kwanoni masu tsarki a gaban bagade.
english: In that day there will be inscribed on the bells of the horses, “HOLY TO YAHWEH”; and the pots in Yahweh’s house will be like the bowls before the altar.

hausa: Rehobowam ya naɗa Abiya ɗan Ma’aka yă zama babba yerima a cikin ’yan’uwansa, don dai yă naɗa shi sarki.
english: Rehoboam appointed Abijah the son of Maacah to be chief, the prince among his brothers, for he intended to make him king.

hausa: Ba wani daga gabas ko yamma ko hamada da zai ɗaukaka mutum.
english: For neither from the east, nor from the west, nor yet from the south, comes exaltation.

hausa: sai manyan Ammonawa suka ce wa Hanun, “Kana tsammani Dawuda yana girmama mahaifinka ne da ya aika mutanen nan wurinka su ta’azantar da kai? Ba mutanensa sun zo ne su bincika su kuma leƙi ƙasar su tumɓuke ta ba?”
english: But the princes of the children of Ammon said to Hanun, “Do you think that David honors your father, in that he has sent comforters to you? Haven’t his servants come to you to search, to overthrow, and to spy out the land?”

hausa: “Mai albarka ne mulkin nan mai zuwa na mahaifinmu Dawuda!” “Hosanna a can cikin samaniya!”
english: Blessed is the kingdom of our father David that is coming in the name of the Lord! Hosanna in the highest!”

hausa: Ben-Hadad ya ji wannan saƙo yayinda shi da sarakunan suke sha a cikin tentunansu, sai ya umarce mutanensa, ya ce, “Ku shirya don yaƙi.” Saboda haka suka shirya don su yaƙi birnin.
english: When Ben Hadad heard this message as he was drinking, he and the kings in the pavilions, he said to his servants, “Prepare to attack!” So they prepared to attack the city.

hausa: Ku aiki maza dubu ɗaya daga kowace kabilar Isra’ila.
english: You shall send one thousand out of every tribe, throughout all the tribes of Israel, to the war.”

hausa: Ku rubuta su a dogaran ƙofofin gidajenku, da ƙofofinku.
english: You shall write them on the door posts of your house and on your gates.

hausa: zai zama muku da albarka, ku da kuke shuki iri kusa da kowane rafi, kuna kuma barin lafiyayyiyar makiyaya domin shanu da jakunanku.
english: Blessed are you who sow beside all waters, who send out the feet of the ox and the donkey.

hausa: Iska za tă koro dukan makiyayanka abokanka kuma za su tafi zaman bauta. Sa’an nan za ka sha kunya a kuma walaƙanta ka saboda dukan muguntarka.
english: The wind will feed all your shepherds, and your lovers will go into captivity. Surely then you will be ashamed and confounded for all your wickedness.

hausa: Yusuf ya zauna a Masar tare da dukan iyalin mahaifinsa. Ya rayu shekara ɗari da goma.
english: Joseph lived in Egypt, he, and his father’s house. Joseph lived one hundred ten years.

hausa: Sai ta ce masa, “Ranka yă daɗe, ba ka gane ni ba? Ai, ni ce matar da ta taɓa tsayawa a gabanka, tana addu’a ga Ubangiji.
english: She said, “Oh, my lord, as your soul lives, my lord, I am the woman who stood by you here, praying to Yahweh.

hausa: Lot wanda yake tafiya tare da Abram, shi ma yana da garken shanu da tumaki da kuma tentuna.
english: Lot also, who went with Abram, had flocks, herds, and tents.

hausa: Amma ka ɗauki wannan sanda a hannunka domin yă aikata mu’ujizan.”
english: You shall take this rod in your hand, with which you shall do the signs.”

hausa: “Yaya za ka ce, ‘Ban ƙazantu ba; ban bi Ba’al ba’? Duba yadda ka yi a cikin kwari; ka ga abin da ka yi. Kai kamar makwaɗaciyar raƙuma ce mai zafin gudu kana gudu nan da can,
english: “How can you say, ‘I am not defiled. I have not gone after the Baals’? See your way in the valley. Know what you have done. You are a swift dromedary traversing her ways,

hausa: a gare shi ɗaukaka ta tabbata har abada abadin. Amin.
english: to whom be the glory forever and ever. Amen.

hausa: Ubangiji Maɗaukaki zai albarkace su, yana cewa, “Albarka ta tabbata ga Masar, mutanena, Assuriya aikin hannuna, da kuma Isra’ila gādona.”
english: because Yahweh of Armies has blessed them, saying, “Blessed be Egypt my people, Assyria the work of my hands, and Israel my inheritance.”

hausa: Ya yi mulki bisa dukan sarakuna daga Kogi Yuferites zuwa ƙasar Filistiyawa, har zuwa iyakar Masar.
english: He ruled over all the kings from the River even to the land of the Philistines, and to the border of Egypt.

hausa: Sa’an nan Yusuf ya ce wa ’yan’uwansa da gidan mahaifinsa, “Zan haura in yi magana da Fir’auna, zan kuwa ce masa, ‘’Yan’uwana da gidan mahaifina, waɗanda suke zaune a ƙasar Kan’ana, sun zo wurina.
english: Joseph said to his brothers, and to his father’s house, “I will go up, and speak with Pharaoh, and will tell him, ‘My brothers, and my father’s house, who were in the land of Canaan, have come to me.

hausa: domin ya kusa yă mutu saboda aikin Kiristi, ya yi kasai da ransa don yă cikasa taimakon da ba ku iya yi mini ba.
english: because for the work of Christ he came near to death, risking his life to supply that which was lacking in your service toward me.

hausa: Sai Musa ya yi kuka ga Ubangiji, Ubangiji kuwa ya nuna masa wani itace. Sai ya jefa shi cikin ruwan, sai ruwan ya zama mai daɗi. A can Ubangiji ya yi musu doka da farilla, a can kuma ya gwada su.
english: Then he cried to Yahweh. Yahweh showed him a tree, and he threw it into the waters, and the waters were made sweet. There he made a statute and an ordinance for them, and there he tested them.

hausa: Sai Isra’ilawa waɗanda suka dawo daga bauta suka ci tare da duk waɗanda suka keɓe kansu daga halin ƙazanta na Al’ummai maƙwabtansu, don su nemi Ubangiji, Allah na Isra’ila.
english: The children of Israel who had returned out of the captivity, and all who had separated themselves to them from the filthiness of the nations of the land to seek Yahweh, the God of Israel, ate,

hausa: Abu na fari da Andarawus ya yi shi ne ya sami ɗan’uwansa Siman ya gaya masa cewa, “Mun sami Almasihu” (wato, Kiristi).
english: He first found his own brother, Simon, and said to him, “We have found the Messiah!” (which is, being interpreted, Christ).

hausa: Suka ce masa, “Almajiran Yohanna sukan yi azumi da addu’a, haka ma almajiran Farisiyawa, amma naka sai ci da sha.”
english: They said to him, “Why do John’s disciples often fast and pray, likewise also the disciples of the Pharisees, but yours eat and drink?”

hausa: Waɗanda ba a kashe ba kuwa Nebukadnezzar ya kwashe su, ya kai Babilon, suka zama bayinsa da na ’ya’yansa maza har zuwa kahuwar mulkin Farisa.
english: He carried those who had escaped from the sword away to Babylon, and they were servants to him and his sons until the reign of the kingdom of Persia,

hausa: Wace irin ƙasa ce suke zama a ciki, Mai kyau ce, ko mummuna? Waɗanne irin birane ne suke zama a ciki? Suna da katanga, ko babu?
english: and what the land is that they dwell in, whether it is good or bad; and what cities they are that they dwell in, whether in camps, or in strongholds;

hausa: Ka kuɓutar da ni daga masu aikata mugunta ka kuma cece ni daga masu kisa.
english: Deliver me from the workers of iniquity. Save me from the bloodthirsty men.

hausa: da kindirmo da madara daga shanu da tumaki da ƙibabbun tumaki da awaki, da zaɓaɓɓun ragunan Bashan da kuma ƙwayoyin alkama mafi kyau. Ka sha ruwan inabi ja wur mai kumfa.
english: butter from the herd, and milk from the flock, with fat of lambs, rams of the breed of Bashan, and goats, with the finest of the wheat. From the blood of the grape, you drank wine.

hausa: “Ni ne Alfa da kuma Omega,” in ji Ubangiji Allah, “wanda yake a yanzu, wanda yake a dā, da kuma wanda zai zo, Maɗaukaki.”
english: “I am the Alpha and the Omega,” says the Lord God, “who is and who was and who is to come, the Almighty.”

hausa: Game da Asher ya ce, “Mafi albarka na ’ya’yan, shi ne Asher; bari yă sami tagomashi daga ’yan’uwansa, bari kuma yă wanke ƙafafunsa a cikin mai.
english: About Asher he said, “Asher is blessed with children. Let him be acceptable to his brothers. Let him dip his foot in oil.

hausa: “Da wa za ku kwatanta ni ko ku ɗauka daidai da ni? Da wa nake kama da har da za ku kwatanta ni?
english: “To whom will you compare me, and consider my equal, and compare me, as if we were the same?

hausa: To, Rekab da Ba’ana, ’ya’yan Rimmon mutumin Beyerot, suka tafi gidan Ish-Boshet, suka isa can da tsakar rana yayinda yake hutun tsakar rana.
english: The sons of Rimmon the Beerothite, Rechab and Baanah, went out and came at about the heat of the day to the house of Ishbosheth as he took his rest at noon.

hausa: ko ga gwamnoni, waɗanda ya aika domin su hukunta masu laifi su kuma yabi masu aikata abin da yake daidai.
english: or to governors, as sent by him for vengeance on evildoers and for praise to those who do well.

hausa: Saboda haka Dawuda ya ɗauki māshin da butar ruwan da take kusa da Shawulu suka tafi. Ba wanda ya gan su, ba wanda ya san abin da ya faru, ba kuwa wanda ya farka, dukansu suna barci gama Ubangiji ya sa barci mai nauyi ya ɗauke su.
english: So David took the spear and the jar of water from Saul’s head, and they went away. No man saw it, or knew it, nor did any awake; for they were all asleep, because a deep sleep from Yahweh had fallen on them.

hausa: “Ga kabilan, a jere bisa ga sunayensu. “A iyaka ta arewa, Dan zai sami rabo; zai bi hanyar Hetlon zuwa Lebo Hamat. Hazar-Enan da iyakar arewancin Damaskus kusa da Hamat za tă zama sashen iyakarsa a wajen gabas zuwa wajen yamma.
english: “Now these are the names of the tribes: From the north end, beside the way of Hethlon to the entrance of Hamath, Hazar Enan at the border of Damascus, northward beside Hamath (and they shall have their sides east and west), Dan, one portion.

hausa: Hannunka zai kakkama dukan abokan gābanka; hannunka na dama zai kakkama masu ƙinka.
english: Your hand will find out all of your enemies. Your right hand will find out those who hate you.

hausa: Sarki Zerzes ya tambayi Sarauniya Esta ya ce, “Wane ne shi? Ina mutumin da ya yi ƙarfin halin yin wannan karambani?”
english: Then King Ahasuerus said to Esther the queen, “Who is he, and where is he who dared presume in his heart to do so?”

hausa: ka ji daga sama, ka gafarta zunubin mutanenka, ka kuma dawo da su ƙasar da ka ba wa kakanninsu.
english: then hear in heaven, and forgive the sin of your people Israel, and bring them again to the land which you gave to their fathers.

hausa: Yowab ya ce, “In Arameyawa suka fi ƙarfina, sai ku kawo mini gudummawa; amma in Ammonawa suka fi ƙarfinku, sai mu kawo muku gudummawa.
english: He said, “If the Syrians are too strong for me, then you shall help me; but if the children of Ammon are too strong for you, then I will come and help you.

hausa: Bayan annobar, sai Ubangiji ya yi magana da Musa da Eleyazar ɗan Haruna, firist ya ce,
english: After the plague, Yahweh spoke to Moses and to Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest, saying,

hausa: kuma shi Absalom, da muka naɗa yă yi mulkinmu, ya mutu a yaƙi. Saboda haka don me ba kwa ce wani abu game da dawo da sarki?”
english: Absalom, whom we anointed over us, is dead in battle. Now therefore why don’t you speak a word of bringing the king back?”

hausa: Za ku yi wa Ai yadda kuka yi wa Yeriko da sarkinta, sai dai za ku kwashe ganima da dabbobinta su zama naku. Ku yi kwanto a bayan birnin.”
english: You shall do to Ai and her king as you did to Jericho and her king, except you shall take its goods and its livestock for yourselves. Set an ambush for the city behind it.”

hausa: Ku bauta wa Ubangiji da darajar tsarkinsa; ku yi rawar jiki a gabansa, dukan duniya.
english: Worship Yahweh in holy array. Tremble before him, all the earth.

hausa: Ubangiji kuwa yana tare da Sama’ila har girmansa bai kuma bar ko ɗaya daga maganarsa ta kāsa cika ba.
english: Samuel grew, and Yahweh was with him and let none of his words fall to the ground.

hausa: Amma duk al’ummar da ba tă saurara ba, zan tumɓuke ta ɗungum in kuma hallaka ta,” in ji Ubangiji.
english: But if they will not hear, then I will pluck up that nation, plucking up and destroying it,” says Yahweh.

hausa: Babana, duba, ga shafin rigarka a hannuna, na yanke shafin rigarka amma ban kashe ka ba. Yanzu ka gane ka kuma sani cewa ba ni da laifin aikata kome ko tayarwa, ban yi maka laifi ba, amma kana farautar raina.
english: Moreover, my father, behold, yes, see the skirt of your robe in my hand; for in that I cut off the skirt of your robe and didn’t kill you, know and see that there is neither evil nor disobedience in my hand. I have not sinned against you, though you hunt for my life to take it.

hausa: An yi rammukan sandunan da tagulla. An dalaye ƙugiyoyi da maɗauran da suke kan sandunan da azurfa; saboda haka dukan sandunan filin Tentin Sujada suna da maɗaurai na azurfa.
english: The sockets for the pillars were of bronze. The hooks of the pillars and their fillets were of silver. Their capitals were overlaid with silver. All the pillars of the court had silver bands.

hausa: Na yi baƙi ƙirin, amma ba rana ce ta ƙona ni ba. Na tsaya a cikin mutane, na kuma yi kuka don taimako.
english: I go mourning without the sun. I stand up in the assembly, and cry for help.

hausa: Danginsa na wajen Eliyezer su ne, Rehabiya, Yeshahiya, Yoram, Zikri da Shelomit.
english: His brothers: of Eliezer, Rehabiah his son, and Jeshaiah his son, and Joram his son, and Zichri his son, and Shelomoth his son.

hausa: ’Yan matan suka ce, “I, yana nan, ai, ga shi ma a gabanku, ku hanzarta. Shigowarsa ke nan a garin, domin yau mutane za su ba da sadaka a bagade a kan tudu.
english: They answered them and said, “He is. Behold, he is before you. Hurry now, for he has come today into the city; for the people have a sacrifice today in the high place.

hausa: Za a kashe su da takobi, a kuma ɗauke su ’yan kurkuku, zuwa dukan al’ummai. Al’ummai za su tattaka Urushalima, har sai lokacin Al’ummai ya cika.
english: They will fall by the edge of the sword, and will be led captive into all the nations. Jerusalem will be trampled down by the Gentiles until the times of the Gentiles are fulfilled.

hausa: Akwai su kuma a Yeshuwa, da Molada, da Bet-Felet,
english: in Jeshua, in Moladah, Beth Pelet,

hausa: Ya sa na zauna a cikin duhu kamar waɗanda suka mutu da jimawa.
english: He has made me dwell in dark places, as those who have been long dead.

hausa: Ka sanar da ni hanyoyin rai, za ka cika ni da farin ciki a gabanka.’
english: You made known to me the ways of life. You will make me full of gladness with your presence.’

hausa: Za ku iya cin kowane tsuntsu mai tsabta.
english: Of all clean birds you may eat.

hausa: Ishaku ya amsa wa Isuwa, “Na mai da shi shugaba a kanka, na sa dukan dangoginsa su zama bayinsa, na kuma ba shi hatsi da sabon ruwan inabi. Saboda haka me kuma zan yi maka ɗana?”
english: Isaac answered Esau, “Behold, I have made him your lord, and all his brothers I have given to him for servants. I have sustained him with grain and new wine. What then will I do for you, my son?”

hausa: Ya kamata kowa yă kasance a matsayin da yake ciki sa’ad da Allah ya kira shi.
english: Let each man stay in that calling in which he was called.

hausa: Haka yake mulkin al’ummai yana kuma tanada abinci a wadace.
english: For by these he judges the people. He gives food in abundance.

hausa: Masu hikimar kuwa suka riƙo tulunan mai da fitilunsu.
english: but the wise took oil in their vessels with their lamps.

hausa: Gama kwana shida Ubangiji ya halicci sama da ƙasa, da teku, da duk abin da yake cikinsu, amma ya huta a rana ta bakwai. Saboda haka Ubangiji ya albarkaci ranar Asabbaci, ya kuma mai da ita mai tsarki.
english: for in six days Yahweh made heaven and earth, the sea, and all that is in them, and rested the seventh day; therefore Yahweh blessed the Sabbath day, and made it holy.

hausa: Ka tuna, ya Ubangiji da jinƙai da kuma ƙaunarka mai girma, gama suna nan tun dā.
english: Yahweh, remember your tender mercies and your loving kindness, for they are from old times.

hausa: Dukan Jama’ar Isra’ilawa suka tashi daga Kadesh, suka zo Dutsen Hor.
english: They traveled from Kadesh, and the children of Israel, even the whole congregation, came to Mount Hor.

hausa: Yesu ya faɗa wa taron dukan waɗannan abubuwa cikin misalai; bai faɗa musu kome ba, sai tare da yin amfani da misalai.
english: Jesus spoke all these things in parables to the multitudes; and without a parable, he didn’t speak to them,

hausa: Ku tumakina, tumakin wurin kiwona, mutanena ne, ni kuwa Allahnku ne, in ji Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka.’ ”
english: You my sheep, the sheep of my pasture, are men, and I am your God,’ says the Lord Yahweh.”

hausa: Sa’an nan dukan shugabannin sojoji, haɗe da Yohanan ɗan Kareya da Yezaniya ɗan Hoshahiya, da dukan mutane daga ƙarami zuwa babba, suka zo wurin
english: Then all the captains of the forces, and Johanan the son of Kareah, and Jezaniah the son of Hoshaiah, and all the people from the least even to the greatest, came near,

hausa: Irmiya ya ce, “Maganar Ubangiji ta zo mini cewa,
english: Jeremiah said, “Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

hausa: Ya Ubangiji, ƙarfina da katangana, mafakata a lokacin damuwa, gare ka al’ummai za su zo daga iyakokin duniya su ce, “Kakanninmu ba su mallaki kome ba sai allolin ƙarya, gumakan banza da ba su yi musu amfani ba.
english: Yahweh, my strength, my stronghold, and my refuge in the day of affliction, the nations will come to you from the ends of the earth, and will say, “Our fathers have inherited nothing but lies, vanity and things in which there is no profit.

hausa: Ku yi zaman sanin cewa haƙurin Ubangijinmu yana nufin ceto ne, kamar yadda ƙaunataccen ɗan’uwanmu Bulus ma ya rubuta muku da hikimar da Allah ya ba shi.
english: Regard the patience of our Lord as salvation; even as our beloved brother Paul also, according to the wisdom given to him, wrote to you,

hausa: Isra’ila suka fatattaki Yahuda, kowa kuwa ya tsere zuwa gidansa.
english: Judah was defeated by Israel; and each man fled to his tent.

hausa: Idanun Ubangiji suna a kan masu adalci kuma kunnuwansa suna sauraran kukansu;
english: Yahweh’s eyes are toward the righteous. His ears listen to their cry.

hausa: Sarki Belshazar ya yi babban biki domin dubban hakimansa ya kuma sha ruwan inabi tare da su.
english: Belshazzar the king made a great feast to a thousand of his lords, and drank wine before the thousand.

hausa: Ke kyakkyawa ce, ƙaunatacciyata! Kai, ke kyakkyawa ce! Idanunki sun yi kamar na kurciya a cikin lulluɓinki. Gashinki ya yi kamar garken awaki da suke gangarawa daga Dutsen Gileyad.
english: Behold, you are beautiful, my love. Behold, you are beautiful. Your eyes are like doves behind your veil. Your hair is as a flock of goats, that descend from Mount Gilead.

hausa: Mutanen Efraim za su zama kamar mutane masu ƙarfi, zukatansu kuwa za su yi murna kamar sun sha ruwan inabi. ’Ya’yansu za su gani su yi murna; zuciyarsu za tă yi farin ciki a cikin Ubangiji.
english: Ephraim will be like a mighty man, and their heart will rejoice as through wine. Yes, their children will see it and rejoice. Their heart will be glad in Yahweh.

hausa: Na suturar da sararin sama da duhu na kuma mai da tsummoki abin rufuwarsa.”
english: I clothe the heavens with blackness. I make sackcloth their covering.”

hausa: Babban hafsan ya kwashi Serahiya babban firist, da Zefaniya na biye da shi a girma, da matsara ƙofofi uku.
english: The captain of the guard took Seraiah the chief priest, Zephaniah the second priest, and the three keepers of the threshold;

hausa: Maigidan zai farfasa masa jiki da bulala, yă kuma ba shi wuri tare da munafukai, inda za a yi kuka da cizon haƙora.
english: and will cut him in pieces and appoint his portion with the hypocrites. That is where the weeping and grinding of teeth will be.

hausa: Waɗannan su ne sunayen ’ya’yan Isra’ila maza, waɗanda suka tafi Masar tare da Yaƙub; kowanne da iyalinsa.
english: Now these are the names of the sons of Israel, who came into Egypt (every man and his household came with Jacob):

hausa: Sai Isra’ilawa suka tashi daki-daki daga Hamadar Sinai, suna tafiya daga wuri zuwa wuri, har sai da girgijen ya tsaya a Hamadar Faran.
english: The children of Israel went forward on their journeys out of the wilderness of Sinai; and the cloud stayed in the wilderness of Paran.

hausa: Masu salama da suke shuki cikin salama sukan girbe adalci.
english: Now the fruit of righteousness is sown in peace by those who make peace.

hausa: “Ka saurare ni, ranka yă daɗe; darajan filin ya kai shekel ɗari huɗu na azurfa, amma mene ne wannan a tsakanina da kai? Ka binne mataccenka.”
english: “My lord, listen to me. What is a piece of land worth four hundred shekels of silver between me and you? Therefore bury your dead.”

hausa: Saboda haka Yoshuwa ya tashi da rundunarsa duka, tare da dukan jarumawansa.
english: So Joshua went up from Gilgal, he and the whole army with him, including all the mighty men of valor.

hausa: Sarki ya tsaya dab da ginshiƙi ya kuma sabunta alkawarin a gaban Ubangiji, ya ce zai bi Ubangiji, yă kiyaye dokokinsa, da ƙa’idodinsa, da farillansa, da dukan zuciyarsa da dukan ransa, ta haka ya tabbatar da kalmomin alkawarin da yake a rubuce a cikin littafin nan. Sa’an nan dukan mutane ma suka yi alkawari yin haka.
english: The king stood by the pillar and made a covenant before Yahweh to walk after Yahweh and to keep his commandments, his testimonies, and his statutes with all his heart and all his soul, to confirm the words of this covenant that were written in this book; and all the people agreed to the covenant.

hausa: Dukan kagarunki suna kama da itatuwan ɓaure da ’ya’yansu da suka nuna. Da an girgiza, sai ɓaure su zuba a bakin mai sha.
english: All your fortresses will be like fig trees with the first-ripe figs. If they are shaken, they fall into the mouth of the eater.

hausa: Sa’ad da mutum ya yi wa Ubangiji alkawari, ko kuwa ya rantse zai yi wani abu, kada yă ƙi cika maganarsa, amma yă cika kome da ya faɗa.
english: When a man vows a vow to Yahweh, or swears an oath to bind his soul with a bond, he shall not break his word. He shall do according to all that proceeds out of his mouth.

hausa: Ga abin da zan yi wa wannan wuri da waɗanda suke zaune a nan, in ji Ubangiji. Zan mai da wannan birni kamar Tofet.
english: This is what I will do to this place,” says Yahweh, “and to its inhabitants, even making this city as Topheth.

hausa: Wannan labarin game da Yesu, ya bazu ko’ina a Yahudiya da kewayenta.
english: This report went out concerning him in the whole of Judea and in all the surrounding region.

hausa: Saboda haka, sai Bala’am ya koma wurin Balak ya same shi tsaye a kusa da hadayarsa, tare da dukan dattawan Mowab.
english: He returned to him, and behold, he was standing by his burnt offering, he, and all the princes of Moab.

hausa: Saboda haka ya tafi ya same Balak tsaye a kusa da hadayarsa, tare da dattawan Mowab. Balak ya tambaye Bala’am ya ce, “Mene ne Ubangiji ya ce?”
english: He came to him, and behold, he was standing by his burnt offering, and the princes of Moab with him. Balak said to him, “What has Yahweh spoken?”

hausa: Ba mu wuce gona da iri a taƙamarmu ba, kamar yadda zai zama, da a ce ba mu zo wurinku ba, gama mun kai har wurinku da bisharar Kiristi.
english: For we don’t stretch ourselves too much, as though we didn’t reach to you. For we came even as far as to you with the Good News of Christ,

hausa: “ ‘Amma zan bar waɗansu, gama waɗansunku za su tsere wa takobi sa’ad da aka watsar da ku a cikin ƙasashe da al’ummai.
english: “‘“Yet I will leave a remnant, in that you will have some that escape the sword among the nations, when you are scattered through the countries.

hausa: Gaskiya nake gaya muku, wanda ya gaskata yana da rai madawwami.
english: Most certainly, I tell you, he who believes in me has eternal life.

hausa: Shugabannin gandu suka dinga matsa musu suna cewa, “Ku cika aikin da aka bukace ku na kowace rana kamar yadda kuke yi sa’ad da kuke da tattaka.”
english: The taskmasters were urgent saying, “Fulfill your work quota daily, as when there was straw!”

hausa: Bayan Bulus da Sila suka fita daga kurkukun, sai suka tafi gidan Lidiya, inda suka sadu da ’yan’uwa suka kuma ƙarfafa su. Sa’an nan suka tafi.
english: They went out of the prison and entered into Lydia’s house. When they had seen the brothers, they encouraged them, then departed.

hausa: Mutanen da suke musu annabcin kuwa za a kore su zuwa titunan Urushalima saboda yunwa da kuma takobi. Babu wanda zai binne su, ko ya binne matansu, ko ’ya’yansu maza da mata. Zan aukar musu da masifar da ya dace da su.
english: The people to whom they prophesy will be cast out in the streets of Jerusalem because of the famine and the sword. They will have no one to bury them—them, their wives, their sons, or their daughters, for I will pour their wickedness on them.

hausa: Zai sabunta rayuwarki yă adana ki a tsufanki. Gama surukarki wadda take ƙaunarki wadda kuma take mafi kyau gare ki fiye da ’ya’ya maza bakwai, ta haife shi.”
english: He shall be to you a restorer of life and sustain you in your old age; for your daughter-in-law, who loves you, who is better to you than seven sons, has given birth to him.”

hausa: Musa ya amsa, “Madalla, kamar yadda ka faɗa, ba zan ƙara bayyana a gabanka ba.”
english: Moses said, “You have spoken well. I will see your face again no more.”

hausa: Ƙaddara ta auko miki, ya ke wadda ke zama cikin ƙasar. Lokaci ya yi, rana ta gabato; akwai fargaba, ba farin ciki ba, a kan duwatsu.
english: Your doom has come to you, inhabitant of the land! The time has come! The day is near, a day of tumult, and not of joyful shouting, on the mountains.

hausa: Yesu ya koma Galili cikin ikon Ruhu. Labarinsa kuwa ya bazu ko’ina a ƙauyuka.
english: Jesus returned in the power of the Spirit into Galilee, and news about him spread through all the surrounding area.

hausa: An yi sandunan da ake ɗaukan tebur da itacen ƙirya, aka kuma dalaye su da zinariya.
english: He made the poles of acacia wood, and overlaid them with gold, to carry the table.

hausa: Har yayinda kuke barci a cikin garken tumaki, an dalaye fikafikan kurciya da azurfa, fikafikanta da zinariya mai ƙyalli.”
english: while you sleep among the camp fires, the wings of a dove sheathed with silver, her feathers with shining gold.

hausa: Kada ka bar yaro ba horo; in ka yi masa horo da sanda, ba zai mutu ba.
english: Don’t withhold correction from a child. If you punish him with the rod, he will not die.

hausa: Yerobowam ya yi tunani a ransa ya ce, “Mai yiwuwa mulkin yă koma gidan Dawuda.
english: Jeroboam said in his heart, “Now the kingdom will return to David’s house.

hausa: Zakoki goma sha biyu suna tsaye a matakai shida, ɗaya a kowane gefen ƙarshen mataki. Babu ƙasar da an taɓa gina irin wannan kujerar mulki.
english: Twelve lions stood there on the one side and on the other on the six steps. Nothing like it was made in any kingdom.

hausa: Wani saurayi Balawe daga Betlehem a Yahuda, wanda yake zama cikin zuriyar Yahuda,
english: There was a young man out of Bethlehem Judah, of the family of Judah, who was a Levite; and he lived there.

hausa: (Bai san abin da zai faɗa ba ne, gama sun tsorata ƙwarai.)
english: For he didn’t know what to say, for they were very afraid.

hausa: Yonatan ya ce, “Labudda! In na ji ƙishin-ƙishin, cewa mahaifina yana neman yă kashe ka ashe, ba zan gaya maka ba?”
english: Jonathan said, “Far be it from you; for if I should at all know that evil were determined by my father to come on you, then wouldn’t I tell you that?”

hausa: Taron mutane suka amsa, “Wannan shi ne Yesu, annabin nan daga Nazaret a Galili.”
english: The multitudes said, “This is the prophet, Jesus, from Nazareth of Galilee.”

hausa: Da dare, na ga wahayi, a gabana kuwa ga mutum a kan jan doki! Yana tsaye a cikin itatuwa masu furanni, a bayansa a cikin itatuwan ci-zaƙi, a bayansa kuwa akwai dawakai masu ruwan ja, ruwan ƙasa-ƙasa da kuma ruwan fari.
english: “I had a vision in the night, and behold, a man riding on a red horse, and he stood among the myrtle trees that were in a ravine; and behind him there were red, brown, and white horses.

hausa: A cewa waɗansu baƙi suna cikin sujadarku, sa’ad da kuke yabon Allah da ruhunku, yaya waɗanda suke tare ku za su fahimta, har su ce, “Amin,” da yake ba su san abin da kuke faɗi ba?
english: Otherwise, if you bless with the spirit, how will he who fills the place of the unlearned say the “Amen” at your giving of thanks, seeing he doesn’t know what you say?

hausa: Ezra ya yabi Ubangiji, Allah mai girma; dukan mutane kuwa suka tā da hannuwansu suka amsa, “Amin! Amin!” Sa’an nan suka sunkuya suka yi wa Ubangiji sujada da fuskokinsu har ƙasa.
english: Then Ezra blessed Yahweh, the great God. All the people answered, “Amen, Amen,” with the lifting up of their hands. They bowed their heads, and worshiped Yahweh with their faces to the ground.

hausa: Korneliyus ya amsa ya ce, “Kwana huɗu da suka wuce ina a gidana ina addu’a a wannan lokaci, wajen ƙarfe uku na yamma. Ba zato ba tsammani sai ga wani mutum cikin tufafi masu walƙiya ya tsaya a gabana
english: Cornelius said, “Four days ago, I was fasting until this hour; and at the ninth hour, I prayed in my house, and behold, a man stood before me in bright clothing

hausa: Sa’an nan ya yi sanduna na itacen ƙirya, ya dalaye shi da zinariya.
