english: He made poles of acacia wood and overlaid them with gold.

hausa: Sai Dawuda ya ce, “Gidan Ubangiji Allah zai kasance a nan, haka kuma bagaden hadaya ta ƙonawa don Isra’ila.”
english: Then David said, “This is the house of Yahweh God, and this is the altar of burnt offering for Israel.”

hausa: Kashin da aka ba wa Isra’ilawa, wanda Musa ya ware daga cikin na waɗanda suka tafi yaƙi,
english: Of the children of Israel’s half, which Moses divided off from the men who fought

hausa: Ya kuma rufe ƙasan ɗakuna ciki da wajen haikali da zinariya.
english: He overlaid the floor of the house with gold, inside and outside.

hausa: Masu mulki suna tsananta mini ba dalili, amma zuciyata na rawan jiki game da maganarka.
english: Princes have persecuted me without a cause, but my heart stands in awe of your words.

hausa: In da za ku yi shiru gaba ɗaya! Zai zama muku hikima.
english: Oh that you would be completely silent! Then you would be wise.

hausa: Sa’an nan Dawuda ya ce wa Uriya, “Gangara gidanka ka wanke ƙafafunka.” Saboda haka Uriya ya bar fadar, sarki kuma ya aika masa da kyauta.
english: David said to Uriah, “Go down to your house and wash your feet.” Uriah departed out of the king’s house, and a gift from the king was sent after him.

hausa: Ya sauko da yunwa a kan ƙasa ya kuma lalace dukan tanadinsu na abinci;
english: He called for a famine on the land. He destroyed the food supplies.

hausa: Ku ci zakkar hatsinku, da na sabon ruwan inabinku, da na manku, da kuma na ’ya’yan fari na garkunanku na shanu da na tumaki a gaban Ubangiji Allahnku, a wurin da ya zaɓa a matsayin mazauni don Sunansa, don ku koyi girmama Ubangiji Allahnku kullum.
english: You shall eat before Yahweh your God, in the place which he chooses to cause his name to dwell, the tithe of your grain, of your new wine, and of your oil, and the firstborn of your herd and of your flock; that you may learn to fear Yahweh your God always.

hausa: An sa waɗansu su lura da kayayyakin da kuma dukan waɗansu kayan wuri mai tsarki, da kuma gari da ruwan inabi, da mai, turare da kuma kayan yaji.
english: Some of them also were appointed over the furniture, and over all the vessels of the sanctuary, over the fine flour, the wine, the oil, the frankincense, and the spices.

hausa: Sun yi dukan katakanki daga itatuwan fir daga Senir; sun kwaso itatuwan al’ul daga Lebanon don su yi miki jigon jirgin ruwa.
english: They have made all your planks of cypress trees from Senir. They have taken a cedar from Lebanon to make a mast for you.

hausa: Ya kuma kwashe kwanonin zinariya da azurfa na gidan Allah daga haikalin Babilon waɗanda Nebukadnezzar ya kwasa daga haikali a Urushalima. Sa’an nan sarki Sairus ya ba wa wani mutum mai suna Sheshbazzar umarni wanda ya sa ya zama gwamna,
english: The gold and silver vessels of God’s house, which Nebuchadnezzar took out of the temple that was in Jerusalem and brought into the temple of Babylon, those Cyrus the king also took out of the temple of Babylon, and they were delivered to one whose name was Sheshbazzar, whom he had made governor.

hausa: A duk sa’ad da Allah ya kashe su, sai su neme shi; sukan juyo a natse gare shi.
english: When he killed them, then they inquired after him. They returned and sought God earnestly.

hausa: Bayan kwana uku sai Yerobowam da dukan mutane suka dawo wurin Rehobowam, yadda sarki ya ce, “Ku dawo gare ni cikin kwana uku.”
english: So Jeroboam and all the people came to Rehoboam the third day, as the king asked, saying, “Come to me again the third day.”

hausa: Saboda haka, alkawari yakan zo ta wurin bangaskiya ne, domin yă zama ta wurin alheri, don a tabbatar wa dukan zuriyar Ibrahim ba kawai ga waɗanda suke na doka ba amma har ma ga waɗanda suke na bangaskiyar Ibrahim. Shi ne kuwa mahaifinmu duka.
english: For this cause it is of faith, that it may be according to grace, to the end that the promise may be sure to all the offspring, not to that only which is of the law, but to that also which is of the faith of Abraham, who is the father of us all.

hausa: Da me mai hikima ya fi wawa? Wace riba ce matalauci yakan samu don yă iya zama da mutane?
english: For what advantage has the wise more than the fool? What has the poor man, that knows how to walk before the living?

hausa: Sai mai gadin kurkukun ya gaya wa Bulus cewa, “Alƙalai sun ba da umarni a sake ku kai da Sila. Yanzu sai ku tafi. Ku sauka lafiya.”
english: The jailer reported these words to Paul, saying, “The magistrates have sent to let you go; now therefore come out and go in peace.”

hausa: ’Ya’yan Hassenaya ne suka gina Ƙofar Kifi. Suka kafa ginshiƙan, suka kuma sa ƙofofinta, da sakatunta, da kuma sandunan ƙarfenta a wurarensu.
english: The sons of Hassenaah built the fish gate. They laid its beams, and set up its doors, its bolts, and its bars.

hausa: sai in kin ɗaura jan ƙyalle a tagar da kika zura mu, kuma sai in kin kawo mahaifinki da mahaifiyarki, da ’yan’uwanki, da dukan iyalinki cikin gidanki.
english: Behold, when we come into the land, tie this line of scarlet thread in the window which you used to let us down. Gather to yourself into the house your father, your mother, your brothers, and all your father’s household.

hausa: “ ‘Duk wanda ba daga cikin iyalin firistoci ba, ko da yake yana zama tare da su, ko kuwa an ɗauke shi yana yin musu aiki, ba zai ci daga cikin tsarkakakkun hadayun ba.
english: “‘No stranger shall eat of the holy thing: a foreigner living with the priests, or a hired servant, shall not eat of the holy thing.

hausa: Yonadab ya ce, “Je gado ka kwanta kamar ba ka da lafiya. Sa’ad da mahaifinka ya zo ganinka, sai ka ce masa, ‘Ina so ƙanuwata Tamar tă kawo mini wani abu in ci. Bari tă shirya abincin a gabana don in ganta, in kuma ci daga hannunta.’ ”
english: Jonadab said to him, “Lay down on your bed and pretend to be sick. When your father comes to see you, tell him, ‘Please let my sister Tamar come and give me bread to eat, and prepare the food in my sight, that I may see it and eat it from her hand.’”

hausa: Sa’an nan Allah ya buɗe idanunta ta ga wata rijiyar ruwa. Don haka sai ta tafi ta cika salkan da ruwa, ta kuma ba wa yaron ruwa ya sha.
english: God opened her eyes, and she saw a well of water. She went, filled the container with water, and gave the boy a drink.

hausa: Ta haifi ɗa, namiji, wanda zai yi mulkin dukan al’ummai da sandar ƙarfe. Aka fyauce ɗanta zuwa wurin Allah da kuma kursiyinsa.
english: She gave birth to a son, a male child, who is to rule all the nations with a rod of iron. Her child was caught up to God and to his throne.

hausa: Kada ka yi magana da wawa, gama zai yi wa maganar hikimarka ba’a.
english: Don’t speak in the ears of a fool, for he will despise the wisdom of your words.

hausa: Kashegari Bala’am ya tashi ya ce wa dattawan Balak, “Ku koma ƙasarku, domin Ubangiji ya hana ni in tafi tare da ku.”
english: Balaam rose up in the morning, and said to the princes of Balak, “Go to your land; for Yahweh refuses to permit me to go with you.”

hausa: Babu ko ɗayansu da ya gaji ko ya yi tuntuɓe, babu ko ɗaya da ya yi gyangyaɗi ko barci; babu abin ɗamarar da ya kunce a gindi, ba igiyar takalmin da ta tsinke.
english: No one shall be weary nor stumble among them; no one shall slumber nor sleep, neither shall the belt of their waist be untied, nor the strap of their sandals be broken,

hausa: Mutanen Ninebe za su tashi a ranar shari’a tare da wannan zamani, su kuwa hukunta shi; don sun tuba saboda wa’azin Yunana, yanzu kuwa ga wanda ya fi Yunana girma a nan.
english: The men of Nineveh will stand up in the judgment with this generation and will condemn it, for they repented at the preaching of Jonah; and behold, someone greater than Jonah is here.

hausa: Duk da haka kada ku mai da shi abokin gāba, sai dai ku gargaɗe shi a matsayin ɗan’uwa.
english: Don’t count him as an enemy, but admonish him as a brother.

hausa: Sai a sa’ad da yake tafiya da dare ne zai yi tuntuɓe, don ba shi da haske.”
english: But if a man walks in the night, he stumbles, because the light isn’t in him.”

hausa: Duk wanda zai bauta mini dole yă bi ni, inda kuma nake, a can bawana zai kasance. Ubana zai girmama wanda yake bauta mini.
english: If anyone serves me, let him follow me. Where I am, there my servant will also be. If anyone serves me, the Father will honor him.

hausa: Sai sarki ya yi rantsuwa, “Muddin Ubangiji yana a raye, wanda ya cece ni daga kowace damuwa,
english: The king vowed and said, “As Yahweh lives, who has redeemed my soul out of all adversity,

hausa: Wata rana, ya shiga cikin gida don yă yi ayyukansa, ba wani daga cikin bayin gidan da yake ciki.
english: About this time, he went into the house to do his work, and there were none of the men of the house inside.

hausa: Da Yesu ya shiga gida, almajiransa suka tambaye shi a ɓoye, suka ce, “Me ya sa ba mu iya fitar da shi ba?”
english: When he had come into the house, his disciples asked him privately, “Why couldn’t we cast it out?”

hausa: Solomon ya kuma yi dukan kayayyakin da suke a cikin haikalin Allah. Bagaden zinariya; teburin da ake ajiye burodin Kasancewa;
english: Solomon made all the vessels that were in God’s house: the golden altar, the tables with the show bread on them,

hausa: Amma mutanen da suke ciki suka miƙa hannunsu, suka ja Lot zuwa cikin gida, suka rufe ƙofar.
english: But the men reached out their hand, and brought Lot into the house to them, and shut the door.

hausa: “In mutum ya saki matarsa ta kuwa bar shi ta auri wani mutum, zai iya komo da ita kuma? Ƙasar ba za tă ƙazantu gaba ɗaya ba? Amma kun yi rayuwa kamar karuwa da masoya masu yawa yanzu za ki komo wurina?” In ji Ubangiji.
english: “They say, ‘If a man puts away his wife, and she goes from him, and becomes another man’s, should he return to her again?’ Wouldn’t that land be greatly polluted? But you have played the prostitute with many lovers; yet return again to me,” says Yahweh.

hausa: da yake kun ƙi dukan shawarata ba ku kuma yarda da tsawatata ba,
english: but you have ignored all my counsel, and wanted none of my reproof;

hausa: Musa ya kuma ce wa Kora, “Yanzu ku saurara, ku Lawiyawa!
english: Moses said to Korah, “Hear now, you sons of Levi!

hausa: Sai mutumin Allah ya ce, “Daidai ina ya fāɗa?” Da ya nuna masa wurin, sai Elisha ya yanka ɗan sanda ya jefa a wurin, ya sa kan gatarin ya taso sama.
english: The man of God asked, “Where did it fall?” He showed him the place. He cut down a stick, threw it in there, and made the iron float.

hausa: Ku ci gaba da ƙaunar juna kamar ’yan’uwa.
english: Let brotherly love continue.

hausa: Mutumin da yake sanye da tufafin lilin, wanda yake a saman ruwan kogin, ya ɗaga hannun damansa da kuma na hagunsa sama, sai na ji yana rantsuwa da wannan da yake raye har abada, yana cewa, “Zai kasance na ɗan lokaci, lokuta da rabin lokaci. Za a kammala waɗannan abubuwa, sa’ad da aka gama ragargaje ikon tsarkakan mutane.”
english: I heard the man clothed in linen, who was above the waters of the river, when he held up his right hand and his left hand to heaven, and swore by him who lives forever that it will be for a time, times, and a half; and when they have finished breaking in pieces the power of the holy people, all these things will be finished.

hausa: Sa’an nan Ubangiji ya sauko a cikin girgije ya tsaya can tare da shi, ya kuma yi shelar sunansa.
english: Yahweh descended in the cloud, and stood with him there, and proclaimed Yahweh’s name.

hausa: Ba wanda zai ba da abinci don yă ta’azantar da waɗanda suke makoki saboda matattu, kai, ko saboda mahaifi ko mahaifiya ma ba kuwa wani da zai ba da abin sha don yă ta’azantar da su.
english: Men won’t break bread for them in mourning, to comfort them for the dead. Men won’t give them the cup of consolation to drink for their father or for their mother.

hausa: In kuma ta saki mijinta ta auri wani, ta yi zina ke nan.”
english: If a woman herself divorces her husband and marries another, she commits adultery.”

hausa: Dukan rundunar kuma suka dawo sansanin Makkeda tare da Yoshuwa, ba abin da ya same su. Ba wanda ya sāke tsokanar Isra’ilawa.
english: all the people returned to the camp to Joshua at Makkedah in peace. None moved his tongue against any of the children of Israel.

hausa: Ban da haka ma, dukanmu mun kasance da ubannin jiki waɗanda suka hore mu muka kuma yi musu ladabi. Ashe, bai kamata mu yi wa Uban ruhohinmu biyayya mu kuwa rayu ba!
english: Furthermore, we had the fathers of our flesh to chasten us, and we paid them respect. Shall we not much rather be in subjection to the Father of spirits and live?

hausa: Zai mai da abin da ya yi rantsuwar ƙarya a kai. Zai mayar wa mai abin da abinsa a yadda yake, har yă ƙara kashi ashirin bisa ɗari na abin. A ranar da zai yi hadaya don laifinsa, a ranar ce zai mayar wa mai abin da abinsa.
english: or any thing about which he has sworn falsely: he shall restore it in full, and shall add a fifth part more to it. He shall return it to him to whom it belongs in the day of his being found guilty.

hausa: Wannan umarnin mugu ne a gaban Allah; saboda haka ya hukunta Isra’ila.
english: God was displeased with this thing; therefore he struck Israel.

hausa: “ ‘Kada firistoci su aske kansu ƙwal ko su kwakkwafe gemunsu, ko su tsattsage jikunansu.
english: “‘They shall not shave their heads or shave off the corners of their beards or make any cuttings in their flesh.

hausa: Sai na gangara zuwa gidan mai ginin tukwane, na gan shi yana aiki a na’urar ginin tukwanen.
english: Then I went down to the potter’s house, and behold, he was making something on the wheels.

hausa: Ya kuɓutar da ni daga hannun abokin gāba mai iko, daga maƙiyina da suka fi ƙarfina.
english: He delivered me from my strong enemy, from those who hated me, for they were too mighty for me.

hausa: Gama saninmu ba cikakke ba ne, annabcinmu kuma ba cikakke ba ne.
english: For we know in part and we prophesy in part;

hausa: Dukan yini aka yi ta yaƙi, aka kuma riƙe sarki a keken yaƙinsa yana fuskanci Arameyawa. Jini daga mikinsa ya yi ta zuba a ƙasan keken yaƙin, a wannan yamma kuwa ya mutu.
english: The battle increased that day. The king was propped up in his chariot facing the Syrians, and died at evening. The blood ran out of the wound into the bottom of the chariot.

hausa: Saboda haka Na’aman ya tafi da dawakansa da keken yaƙinsa, ya tsaya a ƙofar gidan Elisha.
english: So Naaman came with his horses and with his chariots, and stood at the door of the house of Elisha.

hausa: Sa’an nan Yehoshafat ya jagoranci dukan mutanen Yahuda da Urushalima suka dawo da farin ciki zuwa Urushalima, gama Ubangiji ya ba su dalilin farin ciki a kan abokan gābansu.
english: Then they returned, every man of Judah and Jerusalem, with Jehoshaphat in front of them, to go again to Jerusalem with joy; for Yahweh had made them to rejoice over their enemies.

hausa: In kana ba da bashi ga mutanen da za su iya biyan ka ne kawai, ina ribar wannan? Ko masu zunubi ma, suna ba da bashi ga masu zunubi, da fata za a biya su tsab.
english: If you lend to those from whom you hope to receive, what credit is that to you? Even sinners lend to sinners, to receive back as much.

hausa: Tare da taimakon Zadok zuriyar Eleyazar da Ahimelek wani zuriyar Itamar. Dawuda ya karkasa su zuwa ɓangarori don aikinsu bisa ga hidima.
english: David, with Zadok of the sons of Eleazar and Ahimelech of the sons of Ithamar, divided them according to their ordering in their service.

hausa: Gama Allah bai aiki Ɗansa duniya don yă yi wa duniya hukunci ba, sai dai domin yă ceci duniya ta wurinsa.
english: For God didn’t send his Son into the world to judge the world, but that the world should be saved through him.

hausa: Sai na duba, na kuma ga hannu ya miƙe zuwa wurina. A cikinsa akwai littafi,
english: When I looked, behold, a hand was stretched out to me; and behold, a scroll of a book was in it.

hausa: Albarkun mahaifi suna da girma fiye da albarkun daɗaɗɗun duwatsu fiye da yalwar madawwaman tuddai. Bari dukan waɗannan su zauna a kan Yusuf, a goshin ɗan sarki a cikin ’yan’uwansa.
english: The blessings of your father have prevailed above the blessings of my ancestors, above the boundaries of the ancient hills. They will be on the head of Joseph, on the crown of the head of him who is separated from his brothers.

hausa: Sa’an nan mutanensa suka tuna kwanakin dā, kwanakin Musa da mutanensa, ina yake shi wanda ya fitar da su ta teku, da makiyayan garkensa? Ina shi yake wanda ya sa Ruhunsa Mai Tsarki a cikinsu,
english: Then he remembered the days of old, Moses and his people, saying, “Where is he who brought them up out of the sea with the shepherds of his flock? Where is he who put his Holy Spirit among them?”

hausa: “ ‘In duk da waɗannan abubuwa, ba ku yarda da gyaran da nake yi muku ba, kuka ci gaba da yin adawa da ni,
english: “‘If by these things you won’t be turned back to me, but will walk contrary to me,

hausa: ko ya yi tuntuɓe, ba zai fāɗi ba, gama Ubangiji yakan riƙe shi da hannunsa.
english: Though he stumble, he shall not fall, for Yahweh holds him up with his hand.

hausa: Gileyad nawa ne, Manasse nawa ne; Efraim shi hulan kwanona, Yahuda ne sandana na sarauta.
english: Gilead is mine. Manasseh is mine. Ephraim also is my helmet. Judah is my scepter.

hausa: Saboda Sihiyona ba zan yi shiru ba, saboda Urushalima ba zan huta ba, sai adalcinta ya haskaka kamar hasken safiya, cetonta kuma ya haskaka kamar fitila mai haske.
english: For Zion’s sake I will not hold my peace, and for Jerusalem’s sake I will not rest, until her righteousness shines out like the dawn, and her salvation like a burning lamp.

hausa: “Wanne cikin yaran nan biyu ya yi abin da mahaifinsa yake so?” Suka amsa, “Na farin.” Yesu ya ce musu, “Gaskiya nake gaya muku, masu karɓar haraji da karuwai suna riga ku shiga mulkin Allah.
english: Which of the two did the will of his father?” They said to him, “The first.” Jesus said to them, “Most certainly I tell you that the tax collectors and the prostitutes are entering into God’s Kingdom before you.

hausa: Har ma da bagaden Betel, masujadan kan tudun da Yerobowam ɗan Nebat ya yi, wanda ya sa Isra’ila suka yi zunubi. Wannan bagade da masujadan kan tudun ma ya kawar, ya ƙone masujadan kan tudun, ya niƙa su, ya kuma ƙone ginshiƙin Ashera.
english: Moreover the altar that was at Bethel and the high place which Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Israel to sin, had made, even that altar and the high place he broke down; and he burned the high place and beat it to dust, and burned the Asherah.

hausa: Bayan kwana arba’in, sai Nuhu ya buɗe tagar jirgin da ya yi,
english: At the end of forty days, Noah opened the window of the ship which he had made,

hausa: ’Ya’yan Ladan maza su ne, Yehiyel na farko, Zetam da Yowel, su uku ne duka.
english: The sons of Ladan: Jehiel the chief, Zetham, and Joel, three.

hausa: Na so in riƙe shi a wurina a madadinka domin yă taimake ni yayinda nake cikin sarƙoƙi saboda bishara.
english: whom I desired to keep with me, that on your behalf he might serve me in my chains for the Good News.

hausa: Zai ce, “Ku ji, ya Isra’ila, yau kuna gab da kama da abokan gābanku. Kada ku karai, ko ku ji tsoro; kada ku firgita, ko ku yi rawar jiki a gabansu.
english: and shall tell them, “Hear, Israel, you draw near today to battle against your enemies. Don’t let your heart faint! Don’t be afraid, nor tremble, neither be scared of them;

hausa: Ma’aikatan Shawulu suka ce masa, “Duba, ga mugun ruhu daga Allah yana ba ka wahala.
english: Saul’s servants said to him, “See now, an evil spirit from God troubles you.

hausa: Shi ne ya maido da iyakokin Isra’ila daga Lebo Hamat zuwa Tekun Araba, bisa ga maganar Ubangiji, Allah na Isra’ila, da ya yi ta bakin bawansa Yunana ɗan Amittai, annabi daga Gat-Hefer.
english: He restored the border of Israel from the entrance of Hamath to the sea of the Arabah, according to Yahweh, the God of Israel’s word, which he spoke by his servant Jonah the son of Amittai, the prophet, who was from Gath Hepher.

hausa: Ku lura da su da kyau har sai kun isa Urushalima. Ku auna su a shirayin haikalin Ubangiji a Urushalima, a gaban manyan firistoci, da Lawiyawa, da shugabannin iyalai na Isra’ila.”
english: Watch and keep them until you weigh them before the chiefs of the priests, the Levites, and the princes of the fathers’ households of Israel at Jerusalem, in the rooms of Yahweh’s house.”

hausa: To, Sennakerib ya sami labari cewa Tirhaka, mutumin Kush sarkin Masar, yana zuwa masa da yaƙi. Saboda haka ya sāke aika manzanni zuwa wurin Hezekiya cewa,
english: When he heard it said of Tirhakah king of Ethiopia, “Behold, he has come out to fight against you,” he sent messengers again to Hezekiah, saying,

hausa: Kai, ba ku da gidajen da za ku ci ku sha ne? Ko dai kun rena ikkilisiyar Allah ne, kuna kuma wulaƙanta waɗanda ba su da kome? Me zan ce muku? In yabe ku ne game da wannan? A’a, ko kaɗan!
english: What, don’t you have houses to eat and to drink in? Or do you despise God’s assembly and put them to shame who don’t have enough? What shall I tell you? Shall I praise you? In this I don’t praise you.

hausa: Wannan ba shi ne ɗan kafinta nan ba? Ba mahaifiyarsa ba ce Maryamu, ’yan’uwansa kuma Yaƙub, Yusuf, Siman da Yahuda ba?
english: Isn’t this the carpenter’s son? Isn’t his mother called Mary, and his brothers James, Joses, Simon, and Judas?

hausa: Ka cece ni daga harin mutane; ka mai da ni kan al’ummai. Mutanen da ban sani ba sun zama bayina,
english: You have delivered me from the strivings of the people. You have made me the head of the nations. A people whom I have not known shall serve me.

hausa: Sa’ad da Sama’ila ya kawo dukan Isra’ila gaba, kabila-kabila, sai aka zaɓi kabilar Benyamin ta wurin jefa ƙuri’a.
english: So Samuel brought all the tribes of Israel near, and the tribe of Benjamin was chosen.

hausa: Duk da haka za su zama bayinsa, don su san bambanci tsakanin yin mini bauta da kuma yin wa sarakunan sauran ƙasashe bauta.”
english: Nevertheless they will be his servants, that they may know my service, and the service of the kingdoms of the countries.”

hausa: Ya shirya itace, ya yayyanka bijimin kucu-kucu, ya shimfiɗa shi a itacen. Sa’an nan ya ce musu, “Ku cika manyan tuluna da ruwa, ku zuba a kan hadayar da kuma a kan itacen.” Suka zuba.
english: He put the wood in order, and cut the bull in pieces and laid it on the wood. He said, “Fill four jars with water, and pour it on the burnt offering and on the wood.”

hausa: Ubangiji ya ba wa Bala’am saƙo ya ce, “Ka koma wurin Balak, ka faɗa masa wannan saƙo.”
english: Yahweh put a word in Balaam’s mouth, and said, “Return to Balak, and thus you shall speak.”

hausa: “ ‘Waɗannan su ne ƙa’idodi domin hadaya ta gari. ’Ya’yan Haruna za su kawo ta a gaban Ubangiji, a gaban bagaden.
english: “‘This is the law of the meal offering: the sons of Aaron shall offer it before Yahweh, before the altar.

hausa: amma duk wanda ya tsaya da ƙarfi har ƙarshe, zai sami ceto.
english: But he who endures to the end will be saved.

hausa: Sa’an nan Ibrahim ya ɗauko dambu da madara da naman ɗan maraƙin da aka gyara, ya kawo a gabansu. Yayinda suke ci, ya tsaya a gindin itace kusa da su.
english: He took butter, milk, and the calf which he had dressed, and set it before them. He stood by them under the tree, and they ate.

hausa: Bari wannan yă zama sakayyar Ubangiji ga masu zargina, ga waɗanda suke mugayen maganganu a kaina.
english: This is the reward of my adversaries from Yahweh, of those who speak evil against my soul.

hausa: Ya yi abin da yake daidai a gaban Ubangiji, kamar dai yadda kakansa Dawuda ya yi.
english: He did that which was right in Yahweh’s eyes, according to all that David his father had done.

hausa: Bayan ya bar wurin, sai ya gamu da Yehonadab ɗan Rekab wanda yake kan hanyarsa don yă sadu da shi. Sai Yehu ya gaishe shi, ya ce, “Ka amince da ni yadda na amince da kai?” Yehonadab ya ce, “I.” Yehu ya ce, “To, in haka ne ka ba ni hannunka.” Sai ya miƙa masa, Yehu kuwa ya ja shi cikin keken yaƙin.
english: When he had departed from there, he met Jehonadab the son of Rechab coming to meet him. He greeted him, and said to him, “Is your heart right, as my heart is with your heart?” Jehonadab answered, “It is.” “If it is, give me your hand.” He gave him his hand; and he took him up to him into the chariot.

hausa: A hannun damana ’yan tā-da-na-zaune-tsaye sun tayar; sun sa tarko a ƙafafuna, sun yi shirin hallaka ni.
english: On my right hand rise the rabble. They thrust aside my feet. They cast their ways of destruction up against me.

hausa: Luka ƙaunataccen likitan nan, da kuma Demas suna gaishe ku.
english: Luke the beloved physician and Demas greet you.

hausa: Me kuka gani?” Suka amsa, suka ce, “Ya cancanci mutuwa.”
english: What do you think?” They answered, “He is worthy of death!”

hausa: Zai iya yin hidima a cikin sunan Ubangiji Allahnsa kamar dukan sauran ’yan’uwansa Lawiyawa waɗanda suke hidima a can, a gaban Ubangiji.
english: then he shall minister in the name of Yahweh his God, as all his brothers the Levites do, who stand there before Yahweh.

hausa: Yana dariyar hargitsin da yake faruwa a cikin gari; ba ya jin tsawar mai tuƙa shi.
english: He scorns the tumult of the city, neither does he hear the shouting of the driver.

hausa: Suna farin ciki a cikin sunanka dukan yini; suna samun ɗaukaka cikin adalcinka.
english: In your name they rejoice all day. In your righteousness, they are exalted.

hausa: Ni ne na siffanta haske na kuma halicci duhu, ni ne nake ba da nasara in kuma jawo bala’i; ni, Ubangiji ne ke aikata dukan waɗannan abubuwa.
english: I form the light and create darkness. I make peace and create calamity. I am Yahweh, who does all these things.

hausa: Amma Allah bai yi wa shugabannin Isra’ila wani abu ba; suka ga Allah, suka ci suka kuma sha.
english: He didn’t lay his hand on the nobles of the children of Israel. They saw God, and ate and drank.

hausa: A shekara ta bakwai ta Yehu, Yowash ya zama sarki, ya kuma yi mulki a Urushalima na tsawon shekaru arba’in. Sunan mahaifiyarsa Zibiya ce; daga Beyersheba.
english: Jehoash began to reign in the seventh year of Jehu, and he reigned forty years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Zibiah of Beersheba.

hausa: Ya’ala, Darkon, Giddel,
english: the children of Jaalah, the children of Darkon, the children of Giddel,

hausa: Yayinda tsawon jerin ɗakunan da suke a gefe kusa da filin da yake waje kamu hamsin ne, tsawon jerin ɗakunan da suke a gefen da yake kurkusa da wuri mai tsarki kamu ɗari ne.
english: For the length of the rooms that were in the outer court was fifty cubits. Behold, those facing the temple were one hundred cubits.

hausa: “Ubangiji ya yi tambaya ‘Ta wace hanya?’ Ya ce, “ ‘Zan tafi in zama ruhun ƙarya a bakunan dukan annabawansa.’ “Ubangiji ya ce, ‘Za ka yi nasara a ruɗinsa. Ka tafi, ka yi haka.’
english: Yahweh said to him, ‘How?’ He said, ‘I will go out and will be a lying spirit in the mouth of all his prophets.’ He said, ‘You will entice him, and will also prevail. Go out and do so.’

hausa: Solomon ɗan Dawuda ya kafa kansa sosai a bisa masarautarsa, gama Ubangiji Allahnsa yana tare da shi ya kuma sa ya zama mai girma sosai.
english: Solomon the son of David was firmly established in his kingdom, and Yahweh his God was with him, and made him exceedingly great.

hausa: Kun nuna cewa ku wasiƙa ce daga Kiristi, sakamakon hidimarmu, ba wadda aka rubuta da inki ba, sai dai da Ruhun Allah mai rai. Ba kuma a kan allunan dutse ba, sai dai a kan allunan zukatan mutane.
english: being revealed that you are a letter of Christ, served by us, written not with ink, but with the Spirit of the living God; not in tablets of stone, but in tablets that are hearts of flesh.

hausa: Sai ya je ya sami aiki a wurin wani mutumin ƙasar, wanda ya aike shi a gonakinsa, ya yi kiwon aladu.
english: He went and joined himself to one of the citizens of that country, and he sent him into his fields to feed pigs.

hausa: Suka yi hayar mashawarta don su ga cewa sun ɓata ƙoƙarinsu dukan kwanakin mulkin Sairus sarkin Farisa har zuwa kwanakin mulkin Dariyus sarkin Farisa.
english: They hired counselors against them to frustrate their purpose all the days of Cyrus king of Persia, even until the reign of Darius king of Persia.

hausa: Wadata da girma daga gare ka suke; kai ne mai mulkin dukan abubuwa. A hannuwanka ne ƙarfi da iko suke don ka ɗaukaka da kuma ba da ƙarfi ga duka.
english: Both riches and honor come from you, and you rule over all! In your hand is power and might! It is in your hand to make great, and to give strength to all!

hausa: (Sadukiyawa suna cewa babu tashin matattu, babu mala’iku ko ruhohi. Amma Farisiyawa kuwa sun tsaya a kan cewa duk akwai.)
english: For the Sadducees say that there is no resurrection, nor angel, nor spirit; but the Pharisees confess all of these.

hausa: Mutanen suka yi kwana uku a can tare da Dawuda, suna ci suna sha, gama iyalansu sun yi musu tanadi.
english: They were there with David three days, eating and drinking; for their brothers had supplied provisions for them.

hausa: A ranar farko ta watan bakwai, sai suka fara miƙa hadaya ta ƙonawa ga Ubangiji, ko da yake ba a riga an aza harsashin ginin haikalin Ubangiji ba.
english: From the first day of the seventh month, they began to offer burnt offerings to Yahweh; but the foundation of Yahweh’s temple was not yet laid.

hausa: Kamar yadda yake a rubuce cikin Dokar Musa, dukan wannan bala’i ya sauko a kanmu, duk da haka ba mu nemi tagomashin Ubangiji Allahnmu ta wurin barin aikatawa zunubanmu, mu kuma mai da hankali a kan gaskiyarka ba.
english: As it is written in the law of Moses, all this evil has come on us. Yet we have not entreated the favor of Yahweh our God, that we should turn from our iniquities and have discernment in your truth.

hausa: “Wane ne sarkin Isra’ila, ka fito kake bi? Wa kake kora? Kana bin mataccen kare ko kuɗin cizo?
english: Against whom has the king of Israel come out? Whom do you pursue? A dead dog? A flea?

hausa: “Na kuma hana muku ruwan sama tun shuke-shuken suna wata uku kafin lokacin girbi. Na sa aka yi ruwan sama a wani gari, sai na hana a yi a wani gari. Wata gona ta sami ruwan sama; wata gona kuma ta bushe.
english: “I also have withheld the rain from you, when there were yet three months to the harvest; and I caused it to rain on one city, and caused it not to rain on another city. One field was rained on, and the field where it didn’t rain withered.

hausa: Da jama’ar suka yi wa Musa kuka, sai ya yi addu’a ga Ubangiji, wutar kuwa ta mutu.
english: The people cried to Moses; and Moses prayed to Yahweh, and the fire abated.

hausa: Dukan waɗannan fa, mafarin azabar naƙudar haihuwa ne.
english: But all these things are the beginning of birth pains.

hausa: Duk waɗannan mugayen abubuwa daga cikin suke fitowa, suna kuma ƙazantar da mutum.”
english: All these evil things come from within and defile the man.”

hausa: filin da Ibrahim ya saya daga Hittiyawa. A nan aka binne Ibrahim tare da matarsa Saratu.
english: the field which Abraham purchased from the children of Heth. Abraham was buried there with Sarah, his wife.

hausa: Ga Allah, wanda nake yabon maganarsa, ga Ubangiji, wanda nake yabon maganarsa,
english: In God, I will praise his word. In Yahweh, I will praise his word.

hausa: An miƙa shi ga mutuwa saboda zunubanmu, aka kuma tashe shi zuwa rai saboda Allah zai same mu marasa laifi.
english: who was delivered up for our trespasses, and was raised for our justification.

hausa: Za su fāɗi matattu a ƙasar Babilon, da munanan raunuka a titunanta.
english: They will fall down slain in the land of the Chaldeans, and thrust through in her streets.

hausa: Gideyon ya ce, “Amma Ubangiji, yaya zan iya ceci Isra’ila? Kabilata ce marar ƙarfi duka a Manasse, kuma ni ne ƙarami a iyalina.”
english: He said to him, “O Lord, how shall I save Israel? Behold, my family is the poorest in Manasseh, and I am the least in my father’s house.”

hausa: Sai Isra’ilawa suka kama hanya, suka tafi filayen Mowab, a wajen Urdun, a ƙetare Yeriko, suka yi sansani a can.
english: The children of Israel traveled, and encamped in the plains of Moab beyond the Jordan at Jericho.

hausa: Saboda haka ga abin da Ubangiji Maɗaukaki yana cewa, “Ga shi zan tace in kuma gwada su, gama me kuwa zan yi saboda zunubin mutanena?
english: Therefore Yahweh of Armies says, “Behold, I will melt them and test them; for how should I deal with the daughter of my people?

hausa: Sa’ad da aka gaya wa Yotam wannan, sai ya hau Dutsen Gerizim ya yi kira da ƙarfi ya ce, “Ku saurare ni, ’yan ƙasar Shekem, don Allah yă saurare ku.
english: When they told it to Jotham, he went and stood on the top of Mount Gerizim and lifted up his voice, cried out, and said to them, “Listen to me, you men of Shechem, that God may listen to you.

hausa: Za ka yi addu’a zuwa gare shi, zai kuwa ji ka, kuma za ka cika alkawuranka.
english: You will make your prayer to him, and he will hear you. You will pay your vows.

hausa: In haka za ka yi da ni, ka kashe ni yanzu, in na sami tagomashi daga gare ka, kada ka bar ni in rayu in ga wannan baƙin ciki.”
english: If you treat me this way, please kill me right now, if I have found favor in your sight; and don’t let me see my wretchedness.”

hausa: Rebeka fa tana da wani ɗan’uwa mai suna Laban, sai ya yi hanzari ya fita zuwa wurin mutumin a rijiyar.
english: Rebekah had a brother, and his name was Laban. Laban ran out to the man, to the spring.

hausa: Karɓi wannan kafara saboda mutanenka Isra’ila, wanda ka fansar, ya Ubangiji, kada kuma ka ɗaura wa mutanenka alhakin jinin mutumin nan marar laifi.” Za a kuwa yi kafarar zub da jinin da aka yi.
english: Forgive, Yahweh, your people Israel, whom you have redeemed, and don’t allow innocent blood among your people Israel.” The blood shall be forgiven them.

hausa: Ta haka Yehu ya hallaka butar Ba’al a Isra’ila.
english: Thus Jehu destroyed Baal out of Israel.

hausa: Ba su tuna da ikonsa, a ranar da ya fanshe su daga mai danniya,
english: They didn’t remember his hand, nor the day when he redeemed them from the adversary;

hausa: Da yamma ta yi, sai Yesu ya zo tare da Sha Biyun.
english: When it was evening he came with the twelve.

hausa: Sai Manowa ya yi addu’a ga Ubangiji ya ce, “Ya Ubangiji, ina roƙonka, bari mutumin Allahn da ka aiko mana yă sāke zuwa don yă koya mana yadda za mu goyi yaron da za a haifa.”
english: Then Manoah entreated Yahweh, and said, “Oh, Lord, please let the man of God whom you sent come again to us, and teach us what we should do to the child who shall be born.”

hausa: Yana kama da ƙwayar mustad, wadda wani mutum ya ɗauka, kuma ya shuka a gonarsa. Ta yi girma, ta zama itace, kuma tsuntsayen sararin sama suka huta a rassansa.”
english: It is like a grain of mustard seed which a man took and put in his own garden. It grew and became a large tree, and the birds of the sky live in its branches.”

hausa: Amma Ubangiji ya ce wa Gideyon, “Har yanzu mutanen sun yi yawa. Ka kai cikin ruwa, in kuma tankaɗe maka su a can. In na ce, ‘Wannan zai tafi da kai,’ to, zai tafi; amma in na ce, ‘Wannan ba zai tafi da kai ba,’ to, ba zai tafi ba.”
english: Yahweh said to Gideon, “There are still too many people. Bring them down to the water, and I will test them for you there. It shall be, that those whom I tell you, ‘This shall go with you,’ shall go with you; and whoever I tell you, ‘This shall not go with you,’ shall not go.”

hausa: Ya ce musu, “In waninku yana da tunkiya, ta kuma fāɗa a rami ran Asabbaci, ba zai cire ta daga ramin ba?
english: He said to them, “What man is there among you who has one sheep, and if this one falls into a pit on the Sabbath day, won’t he grab on to it and lift it out?

hausa: Sa’ad da sarki zai shiga, zai shiga ta shirayin hanyar shiga, zai kuma fita ta nan.
english: When the prince enters, he shall go in by the way of the porch of the gate, and he shall go out by its way.

hausa: Jariran suka kama kokawa da juna a cikinta, sai ta ce, “Me ya sa wannan yake faruwa da ni?” Saboda haka ta tafi don ta nemi nufin Ubangiji.
english: The children struggled together within her. She said, “If it is like this, why do I live?” She went to inquire of Yahweh.

hausa: Wanne ya fi sauƙi, a ce, ‘An gafarta maka zunubanka,’ ko kuwa a ce, ‘Tashi ka yi tafiya?’
english: For which is easier, to say, ‘Your sins are forgiven;’ or to say, ‘Get up, and walk’?

hausa: Waɗannan garuruwan da ƙauyukansu duka, gādon mutanen Gad ne, bisa ga iyalansu.
english: This is the inheritance of the children of Gad according to their families, the cities and its villages.

hausa: “Ɗan mutum, ka sa Urushalima ta san ayyukanta masu banƙyama
english: “Son of man, cause Jerusalem to know her abominations;

hausa: Taron da suke a wurin suka ji, suka ce an yi tsawa; waɗansu kuwa suka ce mala’ika ne ya yi masa magana.
english: Therefore the multitude who stood by and heard it said that it had thundered. Others said, “An angel has spoken to him.”

hausa: A shekara ta uku ta mulkin Hosheya ɗan Ela sarkin Isra’ila, Hezekiya ɗan Ahaz sarkin Yahuda ya fara mulki.
english: Now in the third year of Hoshea son of Elah king of Israel, Hezekiah the son of Ahaz king of Judah began to reign.

hausa: Hannunsa na hagu yana a ƙarƙashin kaina, hannunsa na dama kuma ya rungume ni.
english: His left hand would be under my head. His right hand would embrace me.

hausa: Amma ƙasar da take ba da ƙaya da sarƙaƙƙiya ba ta da amfani tana kuma cikin hatsarin la’ana. A ƙarshe za a ƙone ta.
english: but if it bears thorns and thistles, it is rejected and near being cursed, whose end is to be burned.

hausa: Na ɗaga idona sama, sai ga mata biyu a gabana, iska tana hura fikafikansu! Suna da fikafikai kamar na shamuwa, suka kuma ɗaga kwandon sama.
english: Then I lifted up my eyes and saw, and behold, there were two women; and the wind was in their wings. Now they had wings like the wings of a stork, and they lifted up the ephah basket between earth and the sky.

hausa: Dukan waɗannan gine-gine, daga waje zuwa babban fili, da kuma daga tushen zuwa rufin, an yi su da duwatsun da aka yanka, aka kuma gyara da zarto a fuskokinsu na ciki da waje.
english: All these were of costly stones, even of stone cut according to measure, sawed with saws, inside and outside, even from the foundation to the coping, and so on the outside to the great court.

hausa: Sidoniyawa, Amalekawa da kuma mutanen Mawon suka wulaƙanta ku kuka kuwa yi mini kuka, ban cece ku daga hannunsu ba?
english: The Sidonians also, and the Amalekites, and the Maonites, oppressed you; and you cried to me, and I saved you out of their hand.

hausa: Allahnsa ya umarce shi ya kuma koya masa hanyar da take daidai.
english: For his God instructs him in right judgment and teaches him.

hausa: Hukuncin shi ne, Haske ya zo cikin duniya, amma mutane suka so duhu a maimakon haske domin ayyukansu mugaye ne.
english: This is the judgment, that the light has come into the world, and men loved the darkness rather than the light, for their works were evil.

hausa: Raina na jiran Ubangiji fiye da yadda mai tsaro yakan jira safiya, fiye da yadda mai tsaro yakan jira safiya.
english: My soul longs for the Lord more than watchmen long for the morning, more than watchmen for the morning.

hausa: Ka ce musu, ‘Ni alama ne a gare ku.’ “Kamar yadda na yi, haka za a yi da su. Za a kai su zaman bauta kamar kamammu.
english: “Say, ‘I am your sign. As I have done, so will it be done to them. They will go into exile, into captivity.

hausa: Ta hanyar da ya zo ne zai koma; ba zai shiga birnin nan ba, in ji Ubangiji.
english: He will return the same way that he came, and he will not come to this city,’ says Yahweh.

hausa: Firist ɗin zai miƙa su, ɗaya domin hadaya don zunubi, ɗayan kuma domin hadaya ta ƙonawa. Ta haka zai yi kafara a gaban Ubangiji saboda mai ɗigar.
english: The priest shall offer them, the one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering. The priest shall make atonement for him before Yahweh for his discharge.

hausa: Sai Kaleb ya sa mutane suka yi shiru a gaban Musa, sai ya ce, “Ya kamata mu tafi mu mallaki ƙasar, gama lalle za mu iya cinta.”
english: Caleb stilled the people before Moses, and said, “Let’s go up at once, and possess it; for we are well able to overcome it!”

hausa: Cikin jin daɗinka ka sa Sihiyona ta yi nasara; ka gina katangar Urushalima.
english: Do well in your good pleasure to Zion. Build the walls of Jerusalem.

hausa: Sa’ad da waɗanda suke tsattsaye a wurin suka ji haka, sai suka ce, “Yana kiran Iliya.”
english: Some of them who stood there, when they heard it, said, “This man is calling Elijah.”

hausa: Ubangiji ya ce wa Musa,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

hausa: Gama kamar yadda abin ɗamara kan kame gindin mutum tam, haka zan daure dukan gidan Isra’ila da dukan gidan Yahuda gare ni,’ in ji Ubangiji, ‘domin su zama jama’a, da suna, da yabo, da daraja a gare ni, amma sun ƙi ji.’
english: For as the belt clings to the waist of a man, so I have caused the whole house of Israel and the whole house of Judah to cling to me,’ says Yahweh; ‘that they may be to me for a people, for a name, for praise, and for glory; but they would not hear.’

hausa: Don mai bi da kaɗe-kaɗe. Ta Dawuda bawan Ubangiji. Akwai magana a cikin zuciyata game da zunubin mugu. Babu tsoron Allah a idanunsa.
english: For the Chief Musician. By David, the servant of Yahweh. A revelation is within my heart about the disobedience of the wicked: There is no fear of God before his eyes.

hausa: Yesu ya bar haikali ke nan, yana cikin tafiya sai almajiransa suka zo wurinsa don su ja hankalinsa ga gine-ginen haikali.
english: Jesus went out from the temple, and was going on his way. His disciples came to him to show him the buildings of the temple.

hausa: Daga ƙasa zuwa daurin ƙofa, an zāna siffofin kerubobi da na itatuwan dabino a waje na wuri mai tsarki.
english: Cherubim and palm trees were made from the ground to above the door. The wall of the temple was like this.

hausa: Ubangiji ya ce wa Musa,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

hausa: Amma ya amsa wa mahaifinsa ya ce, ‘Duba! Duk waɗannan shekaru, ina yin maka aiki kamar bawa, ban taɓa maka rashin biyayya ba. Duk da haka, ba ka taɓa ba ni ko ɗan akuya domin in yi shagali da abokaina ba.
english: But he answered his father, ‘Behold, these many years I have served you, and I never disobeyed a commandment of yours, but you never gave me a goat, that I might celebrate with my friends.

hausa: Bayin Yosiya suka ɗauko gawarsa daga Megiddo suka kai Urushalima, suka binne shi a kabarinsa. Sai mutanen ƙasar suka ɗauki Yehoyahaz ɗan Yosiya suka naɗa shi sarki a madadin mahaifinsa.
english: His servants carried him dead in a chariot from Megiddo, brought him to Jerusalem, and buried him in his own tomb. The people of the land took Jehoahaz the son of Josiah, and anointed him, and made him king in his father’s place.

hausa: Ba ga mala’iku ba ne ya sa su yi mulkin duniya mai zuwa, wanda muke magana a kai ba.
english: For he didn’t subject the world to come, of which we speak, to angels.

hausa: daga Bet-Gilgal, da kuma daga wuraren Geba da Azmawet, gama mawaƙan sun gina wa kansu ƙauyuka kewaye da Urushalima.
english: also from Beth Gilgal and out of the fields of Geba and Azmaveth, for the singers had built themselves villages around Jerusalem.

hausa: “Ɗan mutum, ka yi makoki domin Taya.
english: “You, son of man, take up a lamentation over Tyre;

hausa: Mowab shi ne kwanon wankina, a kan Edom zan jefa takalmina; a bisa Filistiya zan yi kirarin nasara.”
english: Moab is my wash basin. I will throw my sandal on Edom. I shout in triumph over Philistia.”

hausa: Amma hidimar da Yesu ya karɓa tana da fifiko a kan tasu, kamar yadda alkawarin da shi ne yake matsakanci ya fi na dā fifiko nesa, an kuma kafa shi a kan alkawura mafi kyau.
english: But now he has obtained a more excellent ministry, by as much as he is also the mediator of a better covenant, which on better promises has been given as law.

hausa: Duk wanda ya fāɗi a kan dutsen nan, zai kakkarye. Kuma in dutsen nan ya fāɗi a kan wani, zai murƙushe shi.”
english: Everyone who falls on that stone will be broken to pieces, but it will crush whomever it falls on to dust.”

hausa: Game da sauran ayyukan mulkin Yehohiyakim da abubuwan da ya aikata, duk a rubuce suke a cikin littafin tarihin sarakunan Yahuda.
english: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoiakim, and all that he did, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

hausa: Amma bari dukan masu nemanka su yi farin ciki su kuma yi murna a cikinka; bari waɗanda suke ƙaunar cetonka kullum su ce, “Bari Allah yă sami ɗaukaka!”
english: Let all those who seek you rejoice and be glad in you. Let those who love your salvation continually say, “Let God be exalted!”

hausa: ya ba su umarni ya ce, “Ku ji da kyau, za ku yi kwanto a bayan birnin, kada ku yi nisa da birnin. Kowannenku yă kasance a faɗake.
english: He commanded them, saying, “Behold, you shall lie in ambush against the city, behind the city. Don’t go very far from the city, but all of you be ready.

hausa: Lebana, Hagaba, Akkub,
english: the children of Lebanah, the children of Hagabah, the children of Akkub,

hausa: Yanzu ina shirin ginin haikali domin Sunan Ubangiji Allahna, in kuma keɓe shi gare shi don ƙona turare mai ƙanshi a gabansa, don kuma ajiyar burodi mai tsarki kullum, da kuma don miƙa hadayun ƙonawa kowace safiya, kowace yamma, da a Asabbatai da Sababbin Wata, da kuma a ƙayyadaddun bukukkuwan Ubangiji Allahnmu. Wannan dawwammamiyar farilla ce don Isra’ila.
english: Behold, I am about to build a house for the name of Yahweh my God, to dedicate it to him, to burn before him incense of sweet spices, for the continual show bread, and for the burnt offerings morning and evening, on the Sabbaths, on the new moons, and on the set feasts of Yahweh our God. This is an ordinance forever to Israel.

hausa: Zan mai da Rabba wurin kiwo don raƙuma, Ammon kuma wurin hutu don tumaki. Sa’an nan za ku san cewa ni ne Ubangiji.
english: I will make Rabbah a stable for camels and the children of Ammon a resting place for flocks. Then you will know that I am Yahweh.”

hausa: Sai Yonatan ya hau dutsen da rarrafe, mai ɗaukan makamansa kuwa yana biye. Yonatan ya yi ta fyaɗa Filistiyawa da ƙasa, mai ɗaukan makamansa kuma ya yi ta karkashe su.
english: Jonathan climbed up on his hands and on his feet, and his armor bearer after him, and they fell before Jonathan; and his armor bearer killed them after him.

hausa: Saboda haka ba zan dube su da tausayi ko kuwa in ƙyale su ba, amma zan kawo wa kansu abin da suka yi.”
english: As for me also, my eye won’t spare, neither will I have pity, but I will bring their way on their head.”

hausa: Sam! Wannan ba zai taɓa yiwu ba, sai ko maza kaɗai su tafi su yi wa Ubangiji sujada, gama abin da kuke so ke nan.” Sa’an nan aka kori Musa da Haruna daga gaban Fir’auna.
english: Not so! Go now you who are men, and serve Yahweh; for that is what you desire!” Then they were driven out from Pharaoh’s presence.

hausa: Ubangiji ya ce wa Musa,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

hausa: Lebayot, Shilhim, Ayin, Rimmon, jimillarsu, garuruwa da ƙauyukansu duka ashirin da tara ne.
english: Lebaoth, Shilhim, Ain, and Rimmon. All the cities are twenty-nine, with their villages.

hausa: amma su waɗanda aka ga sun cancantar kasancewa a zamanin can, da kuma na tashin matattu, ba za su yi aure, ko su ba da aure ba.
english: But those who are considered worthy to attain to that age and the resurrection from the dead neither marry nor are given in marriage.

hausa: Gama Ubangiji yana ƙyama mai aikata mugunta amma yakan rungumi adalin da ya amince da shi.
english: For the perverse is an abomination to Yahweh, but his friendship is with the upright.

hausa: “Sa’ad da ’ya’yan sarki a Isra’ila suka yi jagora, sa’ad da mutane suka niyya su ba da kansu, suna yabon Ubangiji!
english: “Because the leaders took the lead in Israel, because the people offered themselves willingly, be blessed, Yahweh!

hausa: Mutanen Urushalima suka mai da Ahaziya, autan Yehoram, sarki a madadinsa, da yake ’yan hari, waɗanda suka zo tare da Larabawa cikin sansani, sun kashe dukan manyan ’ya’yansa. Saboda haka Ahaziya ɗan Yeroham sarkin Yahuda ya fara mulki.
english: The inhabitants of Jerusalem made Ahaziah his youngest son king in his place, because the band of men who came with the Arabians to the camp had slain all the oldest. So Ahaziah the son of Jehoram king of Judah reigned.

hausa: Mishma, Duma, Massa,
english: Mishma, Dumah, Massa,

hausa: “ ‘Kada ku yi gumaka, ko ku kafa siffa, ko al’amudi wa kanku, kada kuma ku sa sassaƙaƙƙun duwatsu a ƙasarku don ku rusuna musu. Ni ne Ubangiji Allahnku.
english: “‘You shall make for yourselves no idols, and you shall not raise up a carved image or a pillar, and you shall not place any figured stone in your land, to bow down to it; for I am Yahweh your God.

hausa: “A cikin girman kwarjininka ka kā da waɗanda sun yi gāba da kai. Ka aiki fushinka mai zafi ya cinye su kamar tattaka.
english: In the greatness of your excellency, you overthrow those who rise up against you. You send out your wrath. It consumes them as stubble.

hausa: Sai ya ce mini, “Wannan ruwa yana malalowa zuwa yankin gabas ya kuma gangaro zuwa cikin Araba, inda zai shiga Teku. Sa’ad da ya shiga cikin Tekun sai ruwan a can ya zama mai daɗi.
english: Then he said to me, “These waters flow out toward the eastern region and will go down into the Arabah. Then they will go toward the sea and flow into the sea which will be made to flow out; and the waters will be healed.

hausa: Zai kawo wa firist rago daga garke, marar lahani. Za a kimanta tamanin rago daidai da tamanin hadaya don laifi. Firist kuwa zai yi kafara don kuskuren da mutumin ya yi ba da saninsa ba, za a gafarta masa.
english: He shall bring a ram without defect from of the flock, according to your estimation, for a trespass offering, to the priest; and the priest shall make atonement for him concerning the thing in which he sinned and didn’t know it, and he will be forgiven.

hausa: Amma Yaƙub ya ce, “Ka rantse mini tukuna.” Don haka ya rantse masa, ya sayar da matsayinsa na ɗan fari ga Yaƙub.
english: Jacob said, “Swear to me first.” He swore to him. He sold his birthright to Jacob.

hausa: Saboda haka da Allah ya so yă bayyana nufinsa marar canjawa a sarari ga magādan abin da aka yi alkawari, sai ya tabbatar da shi da rantsuwa.
english: In this way God, being determined to show more abundantly to the heirs of the promise the immutability of his counsel, interposed with an oath,

hausa: “A lokaci ƙarshe sarkin Kudu zai tasar masa da yaƙi, sarkin Arewa kuwa zai tunzura, yă tasar masa da kekunan yaƙi da mahayan dawakai, da jiragen ruwa da yawa. Zai ratsa ƙasashe, yă ci su da yaƙi, yă wuce.
english: “At the time of the end the king of the south will contend with him; and the king of the north will come against him like a whirlwind, with chariots, with horsemen, and with many ships. He will enter into the countries, and will overflow and pass through.

hausa: Waɗannan su ne wuraren zamansu da aka ba su rabo su zama yankunansu (aka ba wa zuriyar Haruna waɗanda suke daga gidan Kohat, domin rabo na fari nasu ne):
english: Now these are their dwelling places according to their encampments in their borders: to the sons of Aaron, of the families of the Kohathites (for theirs was the first lot),

hausa: Saboda haka a rana ta farko ga watan bakwai, Ezra firist, ya kawo Doka a gaban taro, wanda ya ƙunshi maza da mata da dukan waɗanda za su iya fahimta.
english: Ezra the priest brought the law before the assembly, both men and women, and all who could hear with understanding, on the first day of the seventh month.

hausa: Masu kiwon aladun suka ruga, suka je cikin gari suka ba da labarin dukan wannan, haɗe da abin da ya faru da mutanen nan masu aljanu.
english: Those who fed them fled and went away into the city and told everything, including what happened to those who were possessed with demons.

hausa: Game da sauran ayyukan mulkin Shallum, duk a rubuce suke a cikin littafin tarihin sarakunan Isra’ila.
english: Now the rest of the acts of Shallum, and his conspiracy which he made, behold, they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel.

hausa: Ruwa yana ta kwararowa bisa duniya, yini arba’in da dare arba’in.
english: It rained on the earth forty days and forty nights.

hausa: Jimillar waɗanda suke na kabilar Merari ke nan. Musa da Haruna suka ƙidaya su bisa ga umarnin Ubangiji.
english: These are those who were counted of the families of the sons of Merari, whom Moses and Aaron counted according to the commandment of Yahweh by Moses.

hausa: Kada ka yi sakaci da baiwarka, wadda aka ba ka ta wurin saƙon annabci sa’ad da ƙungiyar dattawa suka ɗibiya hannuwa a kanka.
english: Don’t neglect the gift that is in you, which was given to you by prophecy with the laying on of the hands of the elders.

hausa: Dukan labulen, girmansu zai zama kamu ashirin da takwas, fāɗinsu kuwa kamu huɗu. Labulen su zama daidai wa daida.
english: The length of each curtain shall be twenty-eight cubits, and the width of each curtain four cubits: all the curtains shall have one measure.

hausa: Sai Bildad mutumin Shuwa ya amsa,
english: Then Bildad the Shuhite answered,

hausa: Gama horon jiki yana da amfani, amma tsoron Allah yana da amfani ga kowane abu, yana da albarka ga rai na yanzu da kuma rai mai zuwa.
english: For bodily exercise has some value, but godliness has value in all things, having the promise of the life which is now and of that which is to come.

hausa: Mu daga Allah ne, kuma duk wanda ya san Allah yakan saurare mu. Amma duk wanda ba daga Allah ba, ba ya sauraronmu. Ta haka ne muke gane Ruhun gaskiya, da kuma ruhun ƙarya.
english: We are of God. He who knows God listens to us. He who is not of God doesn’t listen to us. By this we know the spirit of truth, and the spirit of error.

hausa: da kuma dukan ƙauyuka kewaye da waɗannan garuruwa har zuwa Ba’al. Waɗannan ne wuraren zamansu. Suka kuma ajiye tarihin zuriya.
english: and all their villages that were around the same cities, as far as Baal. These were their settlements, and they kept their genealogy.

hausa: Ba a taɓa yin Bikin Ƙetarewa haka ba tun zamanin annabi Sama’ila; kuma babu sarkin Isra’ilan da ya taɓa yin irin Bikin Ƙetarewa kamar yadda Yosiya ya yi, tare da firistoci, Lawiyawa da kuma dukan Yahuda da Isra’ila, waɗanda suke can tare da mutanen Urushalima.
english: There was no Passover like that kept in Israel from the days of Samuel the prophet, nor did any of the kings of Israel keep such a Passover as Josiah kept—with the priests, the Levites, and all Judah and Israel who were present, and the inhabitants of Jerusalem.

hausa: “ ‘A wannan rana kowannenku zai gayyaci maƙwabcinsa yă zauna a ƙarƙashin itacen inabi da kuma na ɓaure,’ in ji Ubangiji Maɗaukaki.”
english: In that day,’ says Yahweh of Armies, ‘you will invite every man his neighbor under the vine and under the fig tree.’”

hausa: Maza biyu za su kasance a gona; za a ɗau ɗaya a bar ɗaya.
english: Then two men will be in the field: one will be taken and one will be left.

hausa: Allah ya bashe ni ga mugayen mutane, ya jefa ni hannun mugaye.
english: God delivers me to the ungodly, and casts me into the hands of the wicked.

hausa: Yau ya gangara, ya kuma miƙa hadayun shanu, da shanun da ake kiwo a gida, da tumaki masu yawa. Ya gayyaci dukan ’ya’yan sarki maza, da shugaban mayaƙa, da kuma Abiyatar firist. A yanzu haka suna ci, suna sha, tare da shi, suna cewa, ‘Ran Sarki Adoniya yă daɗe!’
english: For he has gone down today, and has slain cattle, fatlings, and sheep in abundance, and has called all the king’s sons, the captains of the army, and Abiathar the priest. Behold, they are eating and drinking before him, and saying, ‘Long live King Adonijah!’

hausa: Na kuma kakkaɓe hannuna, na ce, “Duk wanda ya karya wannan alkawari, haka Allah zai kakkaɓe shi daga gidansa da aikinsa. Allah zai kakkaɓe shi, yă wofintar da shi!” Da jin wannan, sai dukan taron suka ce, “Amin,” suka kuma yabi Ubangiji. Mutane kuwa suka yi kamar yadda suka yi alkawari.
english: Also I shook out my lap, and said, “So may God shake out every man from his house, and from his labor, that doesn’t perform this promise; even may he be shaken out and emptied like this.” All the assembly said, “Amen,” and praised Yahweh. The people did according to this promise.

hausa: Game da ni dai, zan furta wannan har abada; zan rera yabo ga Allah na Yaƙub,
english: But I will declare this forever: I will sing praises to the God of Jacob.

hausa: Yefta mutumin Gileyad, jarumi ne ƙwarai. Mahaifinsa ne Gileyad; mahaifiyar kuwa karuwa ce.
english: Now Jephthah the Gileadite was a mighty man of valor. He was the son of a prostitute. Gilead became the father of Jephthah.

hausa: Za su ɗauki labulen tabanakul, Tentin Sujada, kayan da za a rufe shi, da kuma kayan da za a rufe shi daga waje na fatun rufuwa na shanun teku, labulen ƙofar Tentin Sujada,
english: they shall carry the curtains of the tabernacle and the Tent of Meeting, its covering, the covering of sealskin that is on it, the screen for the door of the Tent of Meeting,

hausa: Sa’an nan suka yi maɗaurai hamsin na zinariya, suka yi amfani da su don daurin kashi biyu na labulen saboda tabanakul yă zama ɗaya.
english: He made fifty clasps of gold, and coupled the curtains to one another with the clasps: so the tabernacle was a unit.

hausa: Dawuda ya gane bayinsa suna wa juna raɗan wani abu, sai ya gane yaron ya mutu. Sai ya ce, “Yaron ya rasu ko?” Suka ce, “I, ya rasu.”
english: But when David saw that his servants were whispering together, David perceived that the child was dead; and David said to his servants, “Is the child dead?” They said, “He is dead.”

hausa: Yesu ya amsa ya ce, “Shi ne wanda zan ba shi gutsurin burodin nan sa’ad da na tsoma cikin kwanon.” Da ya tsoma gutsurin burodin, sai ya ba wa Yahuda Iskariyot, ɗan Siman.
english: Jesus therefore answered, “It is he to whom I will give this piece of bread when I have dipped it.” So when he had dipped the piece of bread, he gave it to Judas, the son of Simon Iscariot.

hausa: Mutanen Gileyad suka ƙwace mashigan Urdun masu zuwa Efraim, duk sa’ad da wani daga Efraim da ya tsira ya ce, “Bari in haye,” sai mutane Gileyad su ce “Kai mutumin Efraim ne?” In ya ce, “A’a,”
english: The Gileadites took the fords of the Jordan against the Ephraimites. Whenever a fugitive of Ephraim said, “Let me go over,” the men of Gilead said to him, “Are you an Ephraimite?” If he said, “No;”

hausa: “Kai, ya yi tsada, ya yi tsada!” In ji mai saya; sa’ad da ya tafi yana taƙama a kan ya iya ciniki.
english: “It’s no good, it’s no good,” says the buyer; but when he is gone his way, then he boasts.

hausa: almajiran suka kwashe gutsattsarin burodin da na kifin cike da kwanduna goma sha biyu.
english: They took up twelve baskets full of broken pieces and also of the fish.

hausa: Sa’ad da masu adalci suke cin nasara, mutane kan yi farin ciki sa’ad da mugaye suke mulki, mutane kan yi nishi.
english: When the righteous thrive, the people rejoice; but when the wicked rule, the people groan.

hausa: “Tafi babban birnin nan Ninebe ka yi mata wa’azi, saboda muguntarta ta haura zuwa gabana.”
english: “Arise, go to Nineveh, that great city, and preach against it, for their wickedness has come up before me.”

hausa: Daga ya ji ƙanshin ruwa zai tohu yă yi tsiro kamar shuka.
english: yet through the scent of water it will bud, and sprout boughs like a plant.

hausa: In ba a fanshe shi a ƙarshen shekara ba, gidan da yake a birni mai katanga, zai zama mallakar na ɗinɗinɗin na mai sayan da kuma zuriyarsa. Ba za a mai da shi a Shekara ta Murna ba.
english: If it isn’t redeemed within the space of a full year, then the house that is in the walled city shall be made sure in perpetuity to him who bought it, throughout his generations. It shall not be released in the Jubilee.

hausa: kamar yadda wuta ke cin kurmi ko harshen wutar da take ci a kan duwatsu,
english: As the fire that burns the forest, as the flame that sets the mountains on fire,

hausa: ta uku a kan Zakkur, ’ya’yansa da danginsa, 12
english: the third to Zaccur, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

hausa: Amma bai kawar da masujadan kan tudu ba; mutane kuwa suka yi ta yin hadaya da ƙona turare a can.
english: However, the high places were not taken away. The people still sacrificed and burned incense in the high places.

hausa: Na yi ayyuka masu girma. Na gina gidaje wa kaina na kuma shuka gonakin inabi.
english: I made myself great works. I built myself houses. I planted myself vineyards.

hausa: “Amma sai dukansu suka fara ba da hujjoji. Na farkon ya ce, ‘Na sayi gona yanzun nan, dole in je in ga yadda take, ina roƙonka ka yi mini haƙuri.’
english: They all as one began to make excuses. “The first said to him, ‘I have bought a field, and I must go and see it. Please have me excused.’

hausa: Dukan zinariya da shugabannin dubu-dubu da shugabannin ɗari-ɗari, waɗanda Musa da Eleyazar suka karɓa, suka kuma miƙa hadaya ga Ubangiji, nauyinta ta kai shekel 16,750.
english: All the gold of the wave offering that they offered up to Yahweh, of the captains of thousands, and of the captains of hundreds, was sixteen thousand seven hundred fifty shekels.

hausa: Ɗan Mutum ya zo yana ciye-ciye, yana shaye-shaye, sai suka ce, ‘Ga mai haɗama da kuma mashayi, abokin masu karɓar haraji da masu zunubi.’ Amma akan tabbatar da hikima ta wurin ayyukanta.”
english: The Son of Man came eating and drinking, and they say, ‘Behold, a gluttonous man and a drunkard, a friend of tax collectors and sinners!’ But wisdom is justified by her children.”

hausa: Umarninsa kuwa shi ne, mu gaskata da sunan Ɗansa, Yesu Kiristi, mu kuma ƙaunaci juna kamar yadda ya umarce mu.
english: This is his commandment, that we should believe in the name of his Son, Jesus Christ, and love one another, even as he commanded.

hausa: ta biyar a kan Netaniya, ’ya’yansa maza da danginsa, 12
english: the fifth to Nethaniah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

hausa: Ya faɗa musu, “Ku lura da abin da kuke yi, gama shari’ar da kuke yi ba ta mutum ba ce, amma ta Ubangiji ce, yana tare da ku sa’ad da kuke yanke shari’a.
english: and said to the judges, “Consider what you do, for you don’t judge for man, but for Yahweh; and he is with you in the judgment.

hausa: ’Ya’yan matar Hodiya, ’yar’uwar Naham su ne, suka haifi Keyila Bagarme, da Eshtemowa mutumin Ma’aka.
english: The sons of the wife of Hodiah, the sister of Naham, were the fathers of Keilah the Garmite and Eshtemoa the Maacathite.

hausa: Ina dai gaya muku cewa Kiristi ya zama bawan Yahudawa a madadin gaskiyar Allah, don yă tabbatar da alkawaran da aka yi wa kakannin kakanninmu
english: Now I say that Christ has been made a servant of the circumcision for the truth of God, that he might confirm the promises given to the fathers,

hausa: Ga ɗan gari can ya fi kusa inda zan gudu in fake. Bari in gudu zuwa can, in tsirar da raina.”
english: See now, this city is near to flee to, and it is a little one. Oh let me escape there (isn’t it a little one?), and my soul will live.”

hausa: Na sami Dawuda bawana; da mai na mai tsarki na shafe shi.
english: I have found David, my servant. I have anointed him with my holy oil,

hausa: Zuriyar Eliyezer su ne, Rehabiya ne ɗan fari. Eliyezer ba shi da waɗansu ’ya’ya maza, amma ’ya’yan Rehabiya maza sun yi yawa.
english: The son of Eliezer was Rehabiah the chief; and Eliezer had no other sons, but the sons of Rehabiah were very many.

hausa: Idanuna sun gaji, suna jiran alkawarinka; Na ce, “Yaushe za ka ta’azantar da ni?”
english: My eyes fail for your word. I say, “When will you comfort me?”

hausa: “Sauko daga darajarku ku zauna a busasshiyar ƙasa, Ya mazaunan Diyar Dibon, gama shi mai hallaka Mowab zai haura a kanku zai kuma lalace biranenku masu kagarai.
english: “You daughter who dwells in Dibon, come down from your glory, and sit in thirst; for the destroyer of Moab has come up against you. He has destroyed your strongholds.

hausa: ku ci gaba da yin addu’a;
english: Pray without ceasing.

hausa: Sai suka ji wata babbar murya daga sama tana ce musu, “Ku hauro nan.” Suka kuwa haura zuwa sama cikin girgije, yayinda abokan gābansu suna kallo.
english: I heard a loud voice from heaven saying to them, “Come up here!” They went up into heaven in a cloud, and their enemies saw them.

hausa: da ƙawanen da suka sa a yatsotsinsu da hancinsu,
english: the signet rings, the nose rings,

hausa: In aka sami an kashe mutum kwance a fili, a ƙasar da Ubangiji Allahnku yake ba ku ku mallaka, ba a kuma san wanda ya kashe shi ba,
english: If someone is found slain in the land which Yahweh your God gives you to possess, lying in the field, and it isn’t known who has struck him,

hausa: Gama da a ce Yoshuwa ya ba su hutu, da Allah bai yi magana daga baya a kan wata rana dabam ba.
english: For if Joshua had given them rest, he would not have spoken afterward of another day.

hausa: Maƙiya masu yawa ne suke tsananta mini, amma ban rabu da farillanka ba.
english: Many are my persecutors and my adversaries. I haven’t swerved from your testimonies.

hausa: Suka bauta wa gumaka, ko da yake Ubangiji ya ce, “Ba za ku yi wannan ba.”
english: and they served idols, of which Yahweh had said to them, “You shall not do this thing.”

hausa: Amma sa’ad da Hiram ya zo daga Taya don yă ga garuruwan da Solomon ya ba shi, sai bai ji daɗi ba.
english: Hiram came out of Tyre to see the cities which Solomon had given him; and they didn’t please him.

hausa: Yahudawa suka yi mamaki suna tambaya, “Yaya wannan mutum ya sami wannan sani haka ba tare da ya yi wani karatu ba?”
english: The Jews therefore marveled, saying, “How does this man know letters, having never been educated?”

hausa: Sai mutumin ya ce, “Sunanka ba zai ƙara zama Yaƙub ba, amma Isra’ila, gama ka yi kokawa da Allah da mutane, ka kuwa yi rinjaye.”
english: He said, “Your name will no longer be called Jacob, but Israel; for you have fought with God and with men, and have prevailed.”

hausa: Jimillar dukan jarirai maza daga wata ɗaya zuwa gaba da haihuwa su kai 7,500.
english: Those who were counted of them, according to the number of all the males from a month old and upward, even those who were counted of them were seven thousand five hundred.

hausa: “Abin da ’ya’yan nan mata na Zelofehad suke faɗi gaskiya ne. Dole ka ba su mallaka a matsayin gādo cikin ’yan’uwan mahaifinsu, ka kuma mayar musu da gādon mahaifinsu.
english: “The daughters of Zelophehad speak right. You shall surely give them a possession of an inheritance among their father’s brothers. You shall cause the inheritance of their father to pass to them.

hausa: Ubangiji yana ƙyamar ma’aunan zamba, amma ma’aunin da suke daidai ne abin farin cikinsa.
english: A false balance is an abomination to Yahweh, but accurate weights are his delight.

hausa: Da yake an danƙa wa mai kula da ikkilisiya riƙon amana saboda Allah, dole yă zama marar aibi ba mai girman kai ba, ba mai saurin fushi ba, ba mai buguwa ba, ba mai rikici ba, ba kuma mai son ƙazamar riba ba.
english: For the overseer must be blameless, as God’s steward, not self-pleasing, not easily angered, not given to wine, not violent, not greedy for dishonest gain;

hausa: Sai Ubangiji ya canja iska zuwa iska mai ƙarfi ta yamma wadda ta ɗibi fārar zuwa Jan Teku. Babu fāran da suka rage a wani wuri a Masar.
english: Yahweh sent an exceedingly strong west wind, which took up the locusts, and drove them into the Red Sea. There remained not one locust in all the borders of Egypt.

hausa: Har yanzu, waɗansu irin suka fāffāɗi a ƙasa mai kyau, inda suka ba da amfani riɓi ɗari, sittin ko kuma talatin na abin da aka shuka.
english: Others fell on good soil and yielded fruit: some one hundred times as much, some sixty, and some thirty.

hausa: Bayan Ehud, sai Shamgar ɗan Anat, wanda ya karkashe Filistiyawa ɗari shida da sandar korar shanun noma, shi ma ya ceci Isra’ila.
english: After him was Shamgar the son of Anath, who struck six hundred men of the Philistines with an ox goad. He also saved Israel.

hausa: Amma waɗansunsu kuwa, mutane daga Saifurus da Sairin, suka je Antiyok suka fara yi wa Hellenawa magana su ma, suna ba da labari mai daɗi game da Ubangiji Yesu.
english: But there were some of them, men of Cyprus and Cyrene, who, when they had come to Antioch, spoke to the Hellenists, preaching the Lord Jesus.

hausa: Ubangiji ya ce wa Musa,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

hausa: In mutum ya tsabtacce kansa daga na farkon zai zama kayan aikin hidima mai daraja, mai amfani ga Maigida, kuma shiryayye domin yin kowane aiki mai kyau.
english: If anyone therefore purges himself from these, he will be a vessel for honor, sanctified, and suitable for the master’s use, prepared for every good work.

hausa: wanda ya sassāke alamun annabawan ƙarya ya masu duba suka zama wawaye, wanda ya tumɓuke koyon masu hikima ya mai da shi banza,
english: who frustrates the signs of the liars, and makes diviners mad; who turns wise men backward, and makes their knowledge foolish;

hausa: Musa da Haruna suna cikin firistocinsa, Sama’ila yana cikin waɗanda suka kira bisa sunansa; sun kira ga Ubangiji ya kuwa amsa musu.
english: Moses and Aaron were among his priests, Samuel was among those who call on his name. They called on Yahweh, and he answered them.

hausa: Kuma ba wanda yakan zuba sabon ruwan inabi a cikin tsofaffin salkuna. In ya yi haka, sabon ruwan inabi zai farfashe salkunan, ruwan inabin yă zube, salkunan kuma su lalace.
english: No one puts new wine into old wineskins, or else the new wine will burst the skins, and it will be spilled and the skins will be destroyed.

hausa: Taki ta ƙare, ke birnin mai danniya, mai ’yan tawaye da kuma masu ƙazanta!
english: Woe to her who is rebellious and polluted, the oppressing city!

hausa: Ku ji wannan, ku shugabannin gidan Yaƙub, ku masu mulkin gidan Isra’ila, ku da kuke ƙyamar gaskiya, kuka karkatar duk abin da yake na gaskiya;
english: Please listen to this, you heads of the house of Jacob, and rulers of the house of Israel, who abhor justice, and pervert all equity,

hausa: “Sai ya ce, ‘A’a, ya uba, Ibrahim, in dai wani ya tashi daga matattu ya je wurinsu, za su tuba.’
english: “He said, ‘No, father Abraham, but if one goes to them from the dead, they will repent.’

hausa: Bayan sun yi tuƙi wajen mil uku ko uku da rabi, sai suka ga Yesu ya kusato jirgin ruwan, yana takawa a kan ruwan; sai suka tsorata.
english: When therefore they had rowed about twenty-five or thirty stadia, they saw Jesus walking on the sea and drawing near to the boat; and they were afraid.

hausa: sa’ad da ya ba wa teku iyakarsa domin kada ruwaye su zarce umarninsa, da kuma sa’ad da ya shata tussan duniya.
english: when he gave to the sea its boundary, that the waters should not violate his commandment, when he marked out the foundations of the earth,

hausa: Ubangiji mai jinkirin fushi ne, mai iko duka kuma. Ubangiji ba zai bar masu zunubi babu horo ba. Hanyarsa tana cikin guguwa da kuma hadari, gizagizai kuwa su ne ƙurar ƙafafunsa.
english: Yahweh is slow to anger, and great in power, and will by no means leave the guilty unpunished. Yahweh has his way in the whirlwind and in the storm, and the clouds are the dust of his feet.

hausa: Ubangiji ya buge shi kamar yadda ya bugi waɗanda suka buge shi? An kashe shi kamar yadda aka kashe waɗanda suka kashe shi?
english: Has he struck them as he struck those who struck them? Or are they killed like those who killed them were killed?

hausa: Amma Elisha ya ce masa, “Ashe, ba ina tare da kai a ruhu ba sa’ad da mutumin ya sauko daga keken yaƙinsa ya tarye ka. Kana gani wannan lokaci ne da za a karɓi kuɗi, da riguna, da gonar inabi, da tumaki, da bijimai, da bayi maza da mata?
english: He said to him, “Didn’t my heart go with you when the man turned from his chariot to meet you? Is it a time to receive money, and to receive garments, and olive groves and vineyards, and sheep and cattle, and male servants and female servants?

hausa: Gama a kwanaki kafin ruwan tsufana, mutane sun yi ta ci, sun kuma yi ta sha, suna aure, suna kuma aurarwa, har zuwa ranar da Nuhu ya shiga jirgi;
english: For as in those days which were before the flood they were eating and drinking, marrying and giving in marriage, until the day that Noah entered into the ship,

hausa: Ka yi addu’a cewa Ubangiji Allahnka zai faɗa mana inda za mu tafi da kuma abin da za mu yi.”
english: that Yahweh your God may show us the way in which we should walk, and the things that we should do.”

hausa: Allah ya zo daga Teman, Mai Tsarkin nan daga Dutsen Faran. Sela Ɗaukakarsa ta rufe sammai yabonsa kuma ya cika duniya.
english: God came from Teman, the Holy One from Mount Paran. Selah. His glory covered the heavens, and his praise filled the earth.

hausa: Da Delila ta gane ya gaya mata kome yanzu, sai ta aika saƙo zuwa ga shugabannin Filistiyawa ta ce, “Ku ƙara zuwa sau ɗayan nan, ai, ya gaya mini kome.” Saboda haka shugabannin Filistiyawa suka dawo tare da azurfa a hannuwansu.
english: When Delilah saw that he had told her all his heart, she sent and called for the lords of the Philistines, saying, “Come up this once, for he has told me all his heart.” Then the lords of the Philistines came up to her and brought the money in their hand.

hausa: “Ubangiji ya kiyaye alkawarin da ya yi. Na gāje Dawuda mahaifina, yanzu kuma ga shi na zauna a kujerar sarautar Isra’ila, kamar dai yadda Ubangiji ya yi alkawari, na kuma gina haikali domin Sunan Ubangiji, Allah na Isra’ila.
english: Yahweh has established his word that he spoke; for I have risen up in the place of David my father, and I sit on the throne of Israel, as Yahweh promised, and have built the house for the name of Yahweh, the God of Israel.

hausa: da ’yan’uwansa waɗanda suke shugabannin iyalai, su 242. Sai kuma Amashsai ɗan Azarel, ɗan Ahzai, ɗan Meshillemot, ɗan Immer,
english: and his brothers, chiefs of fathers’ households, two hundred forty-two; and Amashsai the son of Azarel, the son of Ahzai, the son of Meshillemoth, the son of Immer,

hausa: Ya ce, “Na kau da nauyi daga kafaɗunku; an ’yantar da hannuwansu daga kwando.
english: “I removed his shoulder from the burden. His hands were freed from the basket.

hausa: Sukan ce wa masu gani, “Kada ku ƙara ganin wahayi!” Ga annabawa kuwa sukan ce, “Kada ku ƙara ba mu wahayin abin da yake daidai! Faɗa mana abubuwan da muke so mu ji ne kawai, ku yi annabcin abin da zai ruɗe mu.
english: who tell the seers, “Don’t see!” and the prophets, “Don’t prophesy to us right things. Tell us pleasant things. Prophesy deceits.

hausa: Sa’an nan a lokacin miƙa hadaya na yamma, na tashi da ɓacin raina, da yagaggun kayana, na durƙusa na miƙa hannuwana sama ga Ubangiji Allahna
english: At the evening offering I rose up from my humiliation, even with my garment and my robe torn; and I fell on my knees, and spread out my hands to Yahweh my God;

hausa: Shirayinta yana fuskantar filin da yake waje; tana da zāne-zānen adon itatuwan dabino a madogararta. Tana kuma da matakai takwas.
english: Its arches were toward the outer court. Palm trees were on its posts on this side and on that side. The ascent to it had eight steps.

hausa: kuke tsattsaye a nan tare da mu a yau a gaban Ubangiji Allahnmu ba, amma har da waɗanda ba sa nan yau.
english: but with those who stand here with us today before Yahweh our God, and also with those who are not here with us today

hausa: Haka za a yi da kowane bijimi, ko rago, ko ɗan rago, ko bunsuru.
english: Thus it shall be done for each bull, for each ram, for each of the male lambs, or of the young goats.

hausa: “Kaito wanda ya ba wa maƙwabtansa abin sha, yana ta zubawa daga salkan ruwan inabi har sai sun bugu, don dai yă ga tsiraicinsu.
english: “Woe to him who gives his neighbor drink, pouring your inflaming wine until they are drunk, so that you may gaze at their naked bodies!

hausa: Firist zai bincike shi, in kuma ya zama ya fi fatar jiki zurfi kuma gashinsa ya juya ya zama fari, firist ɗin zai furta shi marar tsarki. Cuta ce mai yaɗuwa da ta fasu a inda ƙurjin yake.
english: The priest shall examine it. Behold, if its appearance is deeper than the skin, and its hair has turned white, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean. It is the plague of leprosy. It has broken out in the boil.

hausa: Ta haka Solomon ya kiyaye bikin a wannan lokaci har kwana bakwai, dukan Isra’ila kuwa tare da shi, babban taro, mutane daga Lebo Hamat har zuwa Rafin Masar.
english: So Solomon held the feast at that time for seven days, and all Israel with him, a very great assembly, from the entrance of Hamath to the brook of Egypt.

hausa: Ka sāka musu da ayyukansu da kuma don mugun aikinsu; ka sāka musu saboda abin da hannuwansu suka yi ka kuma mayar musu abin da ya dace da su.
english: Give them according to their work, and according to the wickedness of their doings. Give them according to the operation of their hands. Bring back on them what they deserve.

hausa: Ya kuma aika da wannan saƙo ga Yehoshafat sarkin Yahuda cewa, “Sarkin Mowab ya yi mini tawaye. Za ka tafi tare da ni mu yaƙi Mowab?” Sai sarkin Yahuda ya ce, “I, ina shirye mu tafi. Ai, sojojina sojojinka ne, dawakaina kuma dawakanka ne.”
english: He went and sent to Jehoshaphat the king of Judah, saying, “The king of Moab has rebelled against me. Will you go with me against Moab to battle?” He said, “I will go up. I am as you are, my people as your people, my horses as your horses.”

hausa: Lokacin da Akan ɗan Zera ya yi rashin aminci game da kayan da aka keɓe, fushinsa Ubangiji bai auko a kan mutanen Isra’ila duka ba? Ai, ba shi kaɗai ya mutu don zunubinsa ba.”
english: Didn’t Achan the son of Zerah commit a trespass in the devoted thing, and wrath fell on all the congregation of Israel? That man didn’t perish alone in his iniquity.’”

hausa: Sai ya ƙara da cewa, “Gaskiya nake gaya muku, za ku ga sama a buɗe, mala’ikun Allah kuma suna hawa suna kuma sauka a kan Ɗan Mutum.”
english: He said to him, “Most certainly, I tell you all, hereafter you will see heaven opened, and the angels of God ascending and descending on the Son of Man.”

hausa: Sa’an nan na tafi na yi jima’i da annabiya, ta kuwa yi ciki ta haifi ɗa. Ubangiji kuma ya ce mini, “Raɗa masa suna, Maher-Shalal-Hash-Baz.
english: I went to the prophetess, and she conceived, and bore a son. Then Yahweh said to me, “Call his name ‘Maher Shalal Hash Baz.’

hausa: Ga abin da Musa ya ba kabilar Gad, bisa ga iyalansu.
english: Moses gave to the tribe of Gad, to the children of Gad, according to their families.

hausa: Suka karkashe duk mazaunan ƙasar da takobi, ba su bar wani mai numfashi ba, suka kuma ƙona Hazor.
english: They struck all the souls who were in it with the edge of the sword, utterly destroying them. There was no one left who breathed. He burned Hazor with fire.

hausa: Waƙa ce. Zabura ta Asaf. Ya Allah, kada ka yi shiru; kada ka tsaya cik, ya Allah, kada ka daina motsi.
english: A song. A Psalm by Asaph. God, don’t keep silent. Don’t keep silent, and don’t be still, God.

hausa: Ku kawo waina daga nunan fari na ɓarzajjen hatsinku, ku kuma miƙa shi a matsayin hadaya daga masussuka.
english: Of the first of your dough you shall offer up a cake for a wave offering. As the wave offering of the threshing floor, so you shall heave it.

hausa: suna ƙoƙarin hana mu yin magana ga Al’ummai don kada su sami ceto. Ta haka kullum suke ƙara tara tsibin zunubansu. Fushin Allah ya aukar musu a ƙarshe.
english: forbidding us to speak to the Gentiles that they may be saved, to fill up their sins always. But wrath has come on them to the uttermost.
