hausa: A wannan rana, Ubangiji zai yi hukunci da takobi, takobinsa mai tsanani, mai ƙarfi da kuma mai muguwar ɓarna, zai hukunta dodon ruwa macijin nan da ya kanannaɗe, dodon ruwa macijin nan mai murɗewa; zai kashe dodon nan na teku.
english: In that day, Yahweh with his hard and great and strong sword will punish leviathan, the fleeing serpent, and leviathan, the twisted serpent; and he will kill the dragon that is in the sea.

hausa: “Saboda haka, a ganina, kada mu matsa wa Al’ummai waɗanda suke juyowa ga Allah.
english: Therefore my judgment is that we don’t trouble those from among the Gentiles who turn to God,

hausa: ya kuma jure da halinsu har shekara arba’in a cikin hamada,
english: For a period of about forty years he put up with them in the wilderness.

hausa: Yabo ya tabbata ga Ubangiji, wanda bai bari aka yayyage mu da haƙoransu ba.
english: Blessed be Yahweh, who has not given us as a prey to their teeth.

hausa: Sa’ad da Hezekiya ya ga Sennakerib ya zo yana kuma niyya yă yaƙi Urushalima,
english: When Hezekiah saw that Sennacherib had come, and that he was planning to fight against Jerusalem,

hausa: “Ka ƙidaya mutanen Gershon bisa ga iyalansu da kabilarsu.
english: “Take a census of the sons of Gershon also, by their fathers’ houses, by their families;

hausa: Abiya ya kori Yerobowam ya kuma ƙwace garuruwan Betel, Yeshana da Efron, tare da ƙauyukan da suke kewaye daga gare shi.
english: Abijah pursued Jeroboam, and took cities from him: Bethel with its villages, Jeshanah with its villages, and Ephron with its villages.

hausa: Kamar yadda karin maganan nan na dā ya ce, ‘Daga cikin masu mugunta, mugunta ke fitowa,’ hannuna dai ba zai taɓa ka ba.
english: As the proverb of the ancients says, ‘Out of the wicked comes wickedness;’ but my hand will not be on you.

hausa: Sa’an nan Yahudawa suka fitar da Yesu daga wurin Kayifas zuwa fadar gwamnar Roma. A yanzu dai, safiya ta yi, don gudu kada su ƙazantar da kansu Yahudawa ba su shiga cikin fadar ba; sun so su iya ci Bikin Ƙetarewa.
english: They led Jesus therefore from Caiaphas into the Praetorium. It was early, and they themselves didn’t enter into the Praetorium, that they might not be defiled, but might eat the Passover.

hausa: Dole yă kasance a sama, sai lokaci ya yi da Allah zai mai da kome sabo, yadda ya yi alkawari tun dā ta wurin annabawansa masu tsarki.
english: whom heaven must receive until the times of restoration of all things, which God spoke long ago by the mouth of his holy prophets.

hausa: Mutane suna kawo jarirai wurin Yesu don yă taɓa su. Da almajiransa suka ga haka, sai suka kwaɓe su.
english: They were also bringing their babies to him, that he might touch them. But when the disciples saw it, they rebuked them.

hausa: Ba za ku yi wa Ubangiji Allahnku sujada a hanyar da suke yi ba, gama a cikin yin sujada wa allolinsu, sun yi dukan abubuwan banƙyaman da Ubangiji yake ƙi. Har ma sukan ƙone ’ya’yansu maza da mata a wuta a matsayin hadayu.
english: You shall not do so to Yahweh your God; for every abomination to Yahweh, which he hates, they have done to their gods; for they even burn their sons and their daughters in the fire to their gods.

hausa: Kada wani da yake gona kuma yă koma don ɗaukar rigarsa.
english: Let him who is in the field not return back to take his cloak.

hausa: Zai hukunta al’ummai, yana tarawa gawawwaki yana kuma murƙushe masu mulkin dukan duniya.
english: He will judge among the nations. He will heap up dead bodies. He will crush the ruler of the whole earth.

hausa: ta Zattu 945
english: The children of Zattu, nine hundred forty-five.

hausa: In ka sami zuma, ka sha isashe kawai, in ya yi yawa, za ka yi amai.
english: Have you found honey? Eat as much as is sufficient for you, lest you eat too much, and vomit it.

hausa: gama hikima ta fi lu’ulu’ai daraja, kuma ba abin da kake sha’awa da za a kwatanta da ita.
english: For wisdom is better than rubies. All the things that may be desired can’t be compared to it.

hausa: Gaskiyar ita ce, kuna haƙuri da duk wanda ya sa ku bauta ko ya cuce ku ko ya more ku ko ya nuna muku isa ko kuma ya mare ku a fuska.
english: For you bear with a man if he brings you into bondage, if he devours you, if he takes you captive, if he exalts himself, or if he strikes you on the face.

hausa: Sai kuma ta gangara zuwa Kwarin Ben Hinnom a gangaren kudancin birnin Yebusiyawa (wato, Urushalima). Daga can ta haura zuwa kan tudun a yammancin Kwarin Hinnom, a arewancin ƙarshen Kwarin Refayim.
english: The border went up by the valley of the son of Hinnom to the side of the Jebusite (also called Jerusalem) southward; and the border went up to the top of the mountain that lies before the valley of Hinnom westward, which is at the farthest part of the valley of Rephaim northward.

hausa: Ko za ka dogara da shi don yawan ƙarfinsa? Za ka bar masa nauyin aikinka?
english: Will you trust him, because his strength is great? Or will you leave to him your labor?

hausa: Haka ku ma, yanzu ne lokacin baƙin cikinku, amma zan sāke ganinku za ku kuma yi farin ciki, ba kuwa wanda zai ɗauke muku farin cikinku.
english: Therefore you now have sorrow, but I will see you again, and your heart will rejoice, and no one will take your joy away from you.

hausa: Daga baya, Yehoshafat sarkin Yahuda ya haɗa kai da Ahaziya sarkin Isra’ila, wanda yake da laifin mugunta.
english: After this, Jehoshaphat king of Judah joined himself with Ahaziah king of Israel. The same did very wickedly.

hausa: Da hannunka mai ƙarfi ka fanshi mutanenka, zuriyar Yaƙub da Yusuf. Sela
english: You have redeemed your people with your arm, the sons of Jacob and Joseph. Selah.

hausa: Zan sa ki yi mummunan ƙarshe kuma ba za ki ƙara kasancewa ba. Za a neme ki, amma ba za a ƙara same ki ba, in ji Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka.”
english: I will make you a terror, and you will no more have any being. Though you are sought for, yet you will never be found again,’ says the Lord Yahweh.”

hausa: Kai mai sa kaya don ka ji ɗumi lokacin da iska mai sanyi take hurawa,
english: You whose clothing is warm when the earth is still by reason of the south wind?

hausa: “ ‘Duk abin da ta kwanta a kai a lokacin al’adarta zai ƙazantu, kuma duk abin da ta zauna a kai zai ƙazantu.
english: “‘Everything that she lies on in her impurity shall be unclean. Everything also that she sits on shall be unclean.

hausa: Mala’ika na huɗu ya busa ƙahonsa, sai aka bugi kashi ɗaya bisa uku na rana, kashi ɗaya bisa uku na wata, da kashi ɗaya bisa uku na taurari, har kashi ɗaya bisa uku nasu ya duhunta. Kashi ɗaya bisa uku na yini ya kasance babu haske, haka ma kashi ɗaya bisan uku na dare.
english: The fourth angel sounded, and one third of the sun was struck, and one third of the moon, and one third of the stars, so that one third of them would be darkened; and the day wouldn’t shine for one third of it, and the night in the same way.

hausa: Duk sa’ad da akwatin ya sauka kuma, sai Musa ya ce, “Ka komo, ya Ubangiji, a wurin dubban da ba a iya ƙidayawa na iyalan Isra’ila.”
english: When it rested, he said, “Return, Yahweh, to the ten thousands of the thousands of Israel.”

hausa: Ina sarkinku, da zai cece ku? Ina masu mulkinku cikin dukan garuruwanku, waɗanda kuka ce, ‘Ba mu sarki da shugabanni’?
english: Where is your king now, that he may save you in all your cities? And your judges, of whom you said, ‘Give me a king and princes’?

hausa: Alherin Ubangiji Yesu Kiristi yă kasance da ruhunku.
english: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit. Amen.

hausa: Sarki ya tashi cikin fushi, ya bar ruwan inabinsa, ya fita zuwa cikin lambun fada. Amma da Haman ya gane cewa sarki ya riga ya yanke shawara a kan ƙaddararsa, ya dakata domin yă roƙi sarauniya Esta saboda ransa.
english: The king arose in his wrath from the banquet of wine and went into the palace garden. Haman stood up to make request for his life to Esther the queen, for he saw that there was evil determined against him by the king.

hausa: Yakan tā da matalauta daga ƙura yakan ɗaga mabukata daga tarin toka;
english: He raises up the poor out of the dust, and lifts up the needy from the ash heap,

hausa: Ubangiji zai yi yaƙi dominku, ku dai tsaya kurum.”
english: Yahweh will fight for you, and you shall be still.”

hausa: Amma da dogarawan suka iso kurkukun, ba su same su a can ba. Saboda haka suka dawo suka ba da labari, suka ce,
english: But the officers who came didn’t find them in the prison. They returned and reported,

hausa: “Ƙasar Zebulun da ƙasar Naftali, da kuke a hanyar zuwa tekun Galili, a ƙetaren Urdun, wannan yankin Galili ta Al’ummai,
english: “The land of Zebulun and the land of Naphtali, toward the sea, beyond the Jordan, Galilee of the Gentiles,

hausa: Omri ya huta tare da kakanninsa, aka kuma binne shi a Samariya. Sai Ahab ya gāje shi a matsayin sarki.
english: So Omri slept with his fathers, and was buried in Samaria; and Ahab his son reigned in his place.

hausa: Elteke, Gibbeton, Ba’alat,
english: Eltekeh, Gibbethon, Baalath,

hausa: Don me ba ka sa kuɗina a wajen ajiya, don in na dawo, in sami riba a kai ba?’
english: Then why didn’t you deposit my money in the bank, and at my coming, I might have earned interest on it?’

hausa: Sarki Dawuda kuwa ya keɓe waɗannan kayayyaki wa Ubangiji, yadda ya yi da zinariya, da kuma azurfa daga dukan al’umman da ya mallaka,
english: King David also dedicated these to Yahweh, with the silver and gold that he dedicated of all the nations which he subdued—

hausa: Mahaifina ya sa muku kaya masu nauyi; ni zan ma sa su fi haka nauyi. Mahaifina ya hore ku da bulala; ni kuwa zan hore ku da kunamai.’ ”
english: Now my father burdened you with a heavy yoke, but I will add to your yoke. My father chastised you with whips, but I will chastise you with scorpions.’”

hausa: Amma game da waɗanda zukatansu suka karkata ga bin mugayen siffofi da gumakan banƙyama, zan sāka musu gwargwadon ayyukansu, in ji Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka.”
english: But as for them whose heart walks after the heart of their detestable things and their abominations, I will bring their way on their own heads,’ says the Lord Yahweh.”

hausa: Ku keɓe wuri waje da sansani inda za ku iya zuwa don yin bayan gari.
english: You shall have a place also outside of the camp where you go relieve yourself.

hausa: Duwatsun katanga za su yi kuka, ginshiƙan katako kuma za su amsa.
english: For the stone will cry out of the wall, and the beam out of the woodwork will answer it.

hausa: Har yaushe za ku tasar wa mutum guda? Dukanku ne za ku kā da shi wannan jinganannen bango, wannan rusasshen katanga?
english: How long will you assault a man? Would all of you throw him down, like a leaning wall, like a tottering fence?

hausa: Esta ta sāke roƙon sarki, ta fāɗi a ƙafafunsa tana kuka. Ta roƙe shi yă kawo ƙarshen mugun shirin nan na Haman, mutumin Agag; wanda ya shirya a kan Yahudawa.
english: Esther spoke yet again before the king, and fell down at his feet and begged him with tears to put away the mischief of Haman the Agagite, and his plan that he had planned against the Jews.

hausa: Ku na ubanku ne, Iblis, kuna kuwa so ku aikata abin da ubanku yake so. Shi mai kisankai ne tun farko. Ba ruwansa da gaskiya, gama gaskiya ba ta cikinsa. Yayinda yake ƙarya, yana yin halinsa ne, gama shi maƙaryaci ne, uban ƙarairayi kuma.
english: You are of your father the devil, and you want to do the desires of your father. He was a murderer from the beginning, and doesn’t stand in the truth, because there is no truth in him. When he speaks a lie, he speaks on his own; for he is a liar, and the father of lies.

hausa: “Saboda haka ina gaya maka, zunubanta masu yawa, an gafarta mata, gama ƙaunarta mai yawa ce. Amma wanda aka gafarta wa kaɗan kuwa, yakan nuna ƙauna kaɗan.”
english: Therefore I tell you, her sins, which are many, are forgiven, for she loved much. But one to whom little is forgiven, loves little.”

hausa: Yanzu fa ku ji tsoron Ubangiji. Ku yi hankali a kan abin da kuke yi, gama Ubangiji Allahnmu ba ya sonkai ko nuna wariya ko cin hanci.”
english: Now therefore let the fear of Yahweh be on you. Take heed and do it; for there is no iniquity with Yahweh our God, nor respect of persons, nor taking of bribes.”

hausa: Da Haruna ya ga haka, sai ya gina bagade a gaban ɗan maraƙi, ya yi shela ya ce, “Gobe akwai biki ga Ubangiji.”
english: When Aaron saw this, he built an altar before it; and Aaron made a proclamation, and said, “Tomorrow shall be a feast to Yahweh.”

hausa: Wannan ya faru saboda dukan zunuban Ba’asha da waɗanda ɗansa Ela ya yi, da ya sa Isra’ila suka yi, har suka tsokane Ubangiji, Allah na Isra’ila, yă yi fushi ta wurin gumakansu marasa amfani.
english: for all the sins of Baasha, and the sins of Elah his son, which they sinned and with which they made Israel to sin, to provoke Yahweh, the God of Israel, to anger with their vanities.

hausa: ya kuma sa aka yanke kan Yohanna a kurkuku.
english: and he sent and beheaded John in the prison.

hausa: Suna muku annabcin ƙaryar ne kawai da za tă kau da ku daga ƙasarku; zan kore ku za ku kuwa hallaka.
english: for they prophesy a lie to you, to remove you far from your land, so that I would drive you out, and you would perish.

hausa: Saboda haka Solomon ya cire Abiyatar daga aikin firist na Ubangiji, ya cika maganar da Ubangiji ya yi a Shilo game da gidan Eli.
english: So Solomon thrust Abiathar out from being priest to Yahweh, that he might fulfill Yahweh’s word which he spoke concerning the house of Eli in Shiloh.

hausa: “Sa’an nan Isra’ila ta aiki jakadu zuwa ga Sihon sarkin Amoriyawa, wanda yake mulki a Heshbon, ta ce masa, ‘Ka bar mu mu ratsa ƙasarka mu wuce zuwa wurinmu.’
english: Israel sent messengers to Sihon king of the Amorites, the king of Heshbon; and Israel said to him, ‘Please let us pass through your land to my place.’

hausa: “Ku yi hankali da annabawan ƙarya. Sukan zo muku da kamannin tumaki, amma daga ciki mugayen kyarketai ne.
english: “Beware of false prophets, who come to you in sheep’s clothing, but inwardly are ravening wolves.

hausa: Gama Yohanna Mai Baftisma ya zo ba ya ciye-ciye, ba ya shaye-shaye, sai suka ce, ‘Ai, yana da aljani.’
english: For John came neither eating nor drinking, and they say, ‘He has a demon.’

hausa: Zan dawo da waɗanda aka kai zaman bauta mutanena Isra’ila. “Za su sāke gina biranen da suke kango su kuma zauna a cikinsu. Za su shuka gonakin inabi su kuma sha ruwan inabinsu; za su yi lambuna su kuma ci amfaninsu.
english: I will bring my people Israel back from captivity, and they will rebuild the ruined cities, and inhabit them; and they will plant vineyards, and drink wine from them. They shall also make gardens, and eat their fruit.

hausa: Game da mutum dai, kwanakinsa suna kamar ciyawa da suke haɓaka kamar fure a gona;
english: As for man, his days are like grass. As a flower of the field, so he flourishes.

hausa: Labulen filin tenti da sandunansa da tussansa, da kuma labulen ƙofar shiga fili;
english: the hangings of the court, its pillars, their sockets, and the screen for the gate of the court;

hausa: Waɗanda suka kuɓuta wa takobi suka komo zuwa ƙasar Yahuda daga Masar za su zama kima kawai. Sa’an nan dukan raguwar Yahuda waɗanda suka zo don su yi zama a Masar za su san maganar wane ne za tă tabbata, tawa ko tasu.
english: Those who escape the sword will return out of the land of Egypt into the land of Judah few in number. All the remnant of Judah, who have gone into the land of Egypt to live there, will know whose word will stand, mine or theirs.

hausa: Ba da wannan kwaf ne maigidana yake sha daga ciki yana kuma yin amfani da shi don duba? Wannan mugun abu ne da kuka yi.’ ”
english: Isn’t this that from which my lord drinks, and by which he indeed divines? You have done evil in so doing.’”

hausa: Sa’ad da ruwan da yake cikin salkan ya ƙare, sai ta ajiye yaron a ƙarƙashin wani ƙaramin itace.
english: The water in the container was spent, and she put the child under one of the shrubs.

hausa: Game da sauran ayyukan mulkin Asa, dukan nasarorinsa, dukan abin da ya yi, da kuma biranen da ya gina, duk a rubuce suke a cikin littafin tarihin sarakunan Yahuda. A tsufansa, sai ƙafafunsa suka kamu da cuta.
english: Now the rest of all the acts of Asa, and all his might, and all that he did, and the cities which he built, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah? But in the time of his old age he was diseased in his feet.

hausa: Abu mai daraja a gaban Ubangiji shi ne mutuwar tsarkakansa.
english: Precious in Yahweh’s sight is the death of his saints.

hausa: Na san cewa bayan na tafi, mugayen kyarketai za su shigo cikinku ba za su kuwa ƙyale garken ba.
english: For I know that after my departure, vicious wolves will enter in among you, not sparing the flock.

hausa: Toma kuwa (wanda ake kira Didaimus), ɗaya daga cikin Sha Biyun, ba ya tare da almajiran sa’ad da Yesu ya zo.
english: But Thomas, one of the twelve, called Didymus, wasn’t with them when Jesus came.

hausa: Haka kuma a nassin nan ya ce, “Ba za su taɓa shiga hutuna ba.”
english: and in this place again, “They will not enter into my rest.”

hausa: Ta zama wofi, an washe ta, an tuɓe ta! Zukata sun narke, gwiwoyi suna kaɗuwa, jikuna suna rawa, fuskoki duk sun kwantsare!
english: She is empty, void, and waste. The heart melts, the knees knock together, their bodies and faces have grown pale.

hausa: “Saboda haka fa, na ƙarshe za su zama na farko, na farko kuma su zama na ƙarshe.”
english: So the last will be first, and the first last. For many are called, but few are chosen.”

hausa: Na zama bawan wannan bishara ta wurin baiwar alherin Allah da aka yi mini ta wurin ikonsa da yake aiki a cikina.
english: of which I was made a servant according to the gift of that grace of God which was given me according to the working of his power.

hausa: Gama mulkin Allah ba cika baki ba ne, sai dai ga iko.
english: For God’s Kingdom is not in word, but in power.

hausa: Ga Adamu kuwa ya ce, “Saboda ka saurari matarka, ka kuma ci daga itacen da na ce, ‘Kada ka ci,’ “Za a la’anta ƙasa saboda kai. Da wahala za ka ci daga cikinta dukan kwanakin rayuwarka.
english: To Adam he said, “Because you have listened to your wife’s voice, and have eaten from the tree, about which I commanded you, saying, ‘You shall not eat of it,’ the ground is cursed for your sake. You will eat from it with much labor all the days of your life.

hausa: In mahaifinsa ba shi da ’yan’uwa, a ba da gādonsa ga danginsa na kusa, a kabilarsa don yă mallaka. Wannan ya zama ƙa’ida wa Isra’ilawa, yadda Ubangiji ya umarci Musa.’ ”
english: If his father has no brothers, then you shall give his inheritance to his kinsman who is next to him of his family, and he shall possess it. This shall be a statute and ordinance for the children of Israel, as Yahweh commanded Moses.’”

hausa: Yawanci mutane suka kawo hadayun ƙonawa zuwa Urushalima wa Ubangiji da kuma kyautai masu daraja wa Hezekiya sarkin Yahuda. Daga lokacin zuwa gaba dukan ƙasashe suka girmama shi.
english: Many brought gifts to Yahweh to Jerusalem, and precious things to Hezekiah king of Judah, so that he was exalted in the sight of all nations from then on.

hausa: Sai sarki ya amsa wa masanan taurarin ya ce, “Na mance da abin, idan ba ku tuno mini mafarkin, duk da fassararsa ba, to, za a daddatse ku gunduwa-gunduwa, a mai da gidajenku juji.
english: The king answered the Chaldeans, “The thing has gone from me. If you don’t make known to me the dream and its interpretation, you will be cut in pieces, and your houses will be made a dunghill.

hausa: Ya gina bagadai a haikalin Ubangiji, wurin da Ubangiji ya ce, “A Urushalima ne zan sa Sunana.”
english: He built altars in Yahweh’s house, of which Yahweh said, “I will put my name in Jerusalem.”

hausa: “Na fara magana ke nan, sai Ruhu Mai Tsarki ya sauko musu yadda ya sauko mana a farko.
english: As I began to speak, the Holy Spirit fell on them, even as on us at the beginning.

hausa: Gama saboda maganarka da kuma bisa ga nufinka, ka aikata wannan babban abu, ka kuma sanar da bawanka.
english: For your word’s sake, and according to your own heart, you have worked all this greatness, to make your servant know it.

hausa: Yesu bai kula da abin da suka faɗa ba, sai ya ce wa mai mulkin majami’ar, “Kada ka ji tsoro, ka gaskata kawai.”
english: But Jesus, when he heard the message spoken, immediately said to the ruler of the synagogue, “Don’t be afraid, only believe.”

hausa: Waɗansu dai sun riga sun bauɗe sun bi Shaiɗan.
english: For already some have turned away after Satan.

hausa: Suka tambaya, suka ce, “A ina ne, ya Ubangiji?” Ya ce musu, “Ai, inda gawa take, nan ne ungulai za su taru.”
english: They, answering, asked him, “Where, Lord?” He said to them, “Where the body is, there the vultures will also be gathered together.”

hausa: ya ce, “’Yan’uwana, dole a cika Nassin nan da Ruhu Mai Tsarki ya yi magana tun da daɗewa ta bakin Dawuda game da Yahuda, wanda ya zama jagora ga waɗanda suka kama Yesu
english: “Brothers, it was necessary that this Scripture should be fulfilled, which the Holy Spirit spoke before by the mouth of David concerning Judas, who was guide to those who took Jesus.

hausa: Ta haka ya yayyafa jinin a kan tabanakul da kuma a kan dukan kayayyakin da ake amfani da su don yin hidima.
english: He sprinkled the tabernacle and all the vessels of the ministry in the same way with the blood.

hausa: In kun shiga gonar inabin maƙwabcinku, za ku iya cin inabin da kuke so, amma kada ku sa wani a kwandonku.
english: When you come into your neighbor’s vineyard, then you may eat your fill of grapes at your own pleasure; but you shall not put any in your container.

hausa: Gama ku mutane masu tsarki ne ga Ubangiji Allahnku. Ubangiji Allahnku ya zaɓe ku daga dukan mutane a fuskar duniya, don ku zama mutanensa, kayan gādonsa.
english: For you are a holy people to Yahweh your God. Yahweh your God has chosen you to be a people for his own possession, above all peoples who are on the face of the earth.

hausa: Amma mutumin Allah ya zo wurinsa ya ce, “Ya sarki, waɗannan runduna daga Isra’ila ba za su tafi tare da kai ba, gama Ubangiji ba ya tare da Isra’ila, ba ya nan da wani cikin mutanen Efraim.
english: A man of God came to him, saying, “O king, don’t let the army of Israel go with you, for Yahweh is not with Israel, with all the children of Ephraim.

hausa: Zelofehad kuwa ɗan Hefer, ɗan Gileyad, ɗan Makir, ɗan Manasse ba shi da ’ya’ya maza, sai dai mata. Ga sunayensu, Mala, Nowa, Hogla, Milka da Tirza.
english: But Zelophehad, the son of Hepher, the son of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, had no sons, but daughters. These are the names of his daughters: Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.

hausa: Musa tare da dattawan Isra’ila suka umarci mutane suka ce, “Ku kiyaye dukan umarnai da na ba ku a yau.
english: Moses and the elders of Israel commanded the people, saying, “Keep all the commandment which I command you today.

hausa: Abokina ƙaunatacce, kana da aminci cikin abin da kake yi wa ’yan’uwa, ko da yake su baƙi ne a gare ka.
english: Beloved, you do a faithful work in whatever you accomplish for those who are brothers and strangers.

hausa: Amma ga abin da Ubangiji yana cewa game da sarki, wanda yake zaune a kursiyin Dawuda da kuma dukan mutanen da suka ragu a wannan birni, ’yan’uwanku waɗanda ba su tafi tare da ku zuwa zaman bauta ba.
english: Yahweh says concerning the king who sits on David’s throne, and concerning all the people who dwell in this city, your brothers who haven’t gone with you into captivity,

hausa: Mutane garin suka ce wa Elisha, “Ranka yă daɗe, duba, garin yana da kyan gani, amma ruwan ba shi da kyau, ƙasar kuma ba ta ba da amfani.”
english: The men of the city said to Elisha, “Behold, please, the situation of this city is pleasant, as my lord sees; but the water is bad, and the land is barren.”

hausa: Aka bi da su cikin farin ciki da murna; suka shiga fadan sarki.
english: With gladness and rejoicing they shall be led. They shall enter into the king’s palace.

hausa: Saboda haka Kiristi shi ne matsakancin sabon alkawari, don waɗanda aka kira su sami madawwamin gādon da aka yi alkawari, yanzu da ya mutu a matsayin mai fansa don yă ’yantar da su daga zunuban da aka aikata a ƙarƙashin alkawari na farko.
english: For this reason he is the mediator of a new covenant, since a death has occurred for the redemption of the transgressions that were under the first covenant, that those who have been called may receive the promise of the eternal inheritance.

hausa: Ba sa turin juna, kowane yakan miƙe gaba. Sukan kutsa cikin abokan gāba ba mai tsai da su.
english: One doesn’t jostle another. They each march in their own path. They burst through the defenses and don’t break ranks.

hausa: Farisiyawa suka ji taron suna raɗe-raɗen waɗannan abubuwa game da shi. Sai manyan firistoci da Farisiyawa suka aiki masu gadin haikalin su kama shi.
english: The Pharisees heard the multitude murmuring these things concerning him, and the chief priests and the Pharisees sent officers to arrest him.

hausa: Yabo ya tabbata ga Ubangiji, ga Allah Mai Cetonmu, wanda kullum yake ɗaukan nauyinmu. Sela
english: Blessed be the Lord, who daily bears our burdens, even the God who is our salvation. Selah.

hausa: Maigidan bawan nan zai dawo a ranar da wannan bawan bai yi tsammaninsa ba, kuma a sa’ar da bai sani ba. Maigidan zai yayyanka shi, ya kuma ba shi rabonsa tare da marasa bangaskiya.
english: then the lord of that servant will come in a day when he isn’t expecting him and in an hour that he doesn’t know, and will cut him in two, and place his portion with the unfaithful.

hausa: Bayansa, Elon mutumin Zebulun, ya shugabanci Isra’ila shekara goma.
english: After him, Elon the Zebulunite judged Israel; and he judged Israel ten years.

hausa: Ba sa yin mini kuka da zuciyarsu amma suna ihu a kan gadajensu. Sukan taru wurin ɗaya don hatsi da ruwan inabi amma su juya mini baya.
english: They haven’t cried to me with their heart, but they howl on their beds. They assemble themselves for grain and new wine. They turn away from me.

hausa: Sa’ad da Ammonawa suka gane cewa sun zama abin wurin a kafan hancin Dawuda, Hanun da Ammonawa suka aika da talenti dubu na azurfa don su yi haya da kekunan yaƙi da mahayan kekunan yaƙi daga Aram-Naharayim, Aram Ma’aka da Zoba.
english: When the children of Ammon saw that they had made themselves odious to David, Hanun and the children of Ammon sent one thousand talents of silver to hire chariots and horsemen out of Mesopotamia, out of Aram-maacah, and out of Zobah.

hausa: Efraim horarriyar karsana ce mai son sussuka; saboda haka zan sa karkiya a kyakkyawan wuyanta. Zan bi da Efraim, Dole Yahuda yă yi noma, dole kuma Yaƙub yă ja garman noma.
english: Ephraim is a trained heifer that loves to thresh, so I will put a yoke on her beautiful neck. I will set a rider on Ephraim. Judah will plow. Jacob will break his clods.

hausa: Ubangiji ya ce wa Musa, “Faɗa wa ɗan’uwanka Haruna, kada yă riƙa shiga Wuri Mafi Tsarki bayan labule koyaushe, wato, a gaban murfi wanda yake bisa akwatin alkawari, domin kada yă mutu, gama zan bayyana a cikin girgije a kan murfin.
english: and Yahweh said to Moses, “Tell Aaron your brother not to come at just any time into the Most Holy Place within the veil, before the mercy seat which is on the ark; lest he die; for I will appear in the cloud on the mercy seat.

hausa: In kuwa kuna gai da ’yan’uwanku ne kaɗai, me kuke yi fiye da waɗansu? Marasa bin Allah ma ba haka suke yi ba?
english: If you only greet your friends, what more do you do than others? Don’t even the tax collectors do the same?

hausa: da Holon, da Debir,
english: Holon with its pasture lands, Debir with its pasture lands,

hausa: ta takwas a kan Yeshahiya, ’ya’yansa maza da danginsa, 12
english: the eighth to Jeshaiah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

hausa: Ga maganar Ubangiji da ta zo wa Irmiya game da fări cewa,
english: This is Yahweh’s word that came to Jeremiah concerning the drought:

hausa: da nake bukatar tufafi, kun yi mini sutura, da na yi rashin lafiya, kun lura da ni, da nake kurkuku, kun ziyarce ni.’
english: I was naked and you clothed me. I was sick and you visited me. I was in prison and you came to me.’

hausa: Gehazi ya amsa ya ce, “Lafiya ƙalau. Maigidana ne ya aiko ni cewa, ‘Samari biyu daga ƙungiyar annabawa sun ziyarce ni daga ƙasa mai duwatsu na yankin Efraim. Ina roƙonka ka ba su talenti na azurfa da tufafi kashi biyu.’ ”
english: He said, “All is well. My master has sent me, saying, ‘Behold, even now two young men of the sons of the prophets have come to me from the hill country of Ephraim. Please give them a talent of silver and two changes of clothing.’”

hausa: Ka kiyaye alkawarinka ga bawanka Dawuda mahaifina; da bakinka ka yi alkawari kuma da hannunka ka cika shi, yadda yake a yau.
english: who have kept with your servant David my father that which you promised him. Yes, you spoke with your mouth, and have fulfilled it with your hand, as it is today.

hausa: Ƙauyukan da suke kewayensu su ne Etam, Ayin, Rimmon, Token da Ashan, garuruwa biyar;
english: Their villages were Etam, Ain, Rimmon, Tochen, and Ashan, five cities;

hausa: A shekara ta talatin da tara ta mulkinsa, Asa ya kamu da wata cuta a ƙafarsa. Ko da yake cutar ta yi tsanani, duk d haka ma a cikin ciwonsa bai nemi taimako daga Ubangiji ba, sai dai daga likitoci.
english: In the thirty-ninth year of his reign, Asa was diseased in his feet. His disease was exceedingly great; yet in his disease he didn’t seek Yahweh, but just the physicians.

hausa: Sarki Isra’ila ya amsa wa Yehoshafat, “Akwai guda har yanzu mai suna Mikahiya ɗan Imla, za mu iya nemi nufin Ubangiji daga gare shi, sai dai ba na sonsa domin bai taɓa yin annabci wani abu mai kyau game da ni ba, sai kullum masifa.” Yehoshafat ya amsa ya ce, “Kada sarki yă faɗa haka.”
english: The king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, “There is yet one man by whom we may inquire of Yahweh; but I hate him, for he never prophesies good concerning me, but always evil. He is Micaiah the son of Imla.” Jehoshaphat said, “Don’t let the king say so.”

hausa: Ba za su zama kamar kakanni kakanninsu ba, masu taurinkai da kuma tsara masu tayarwa, waɗanda zukatansu ba su yi biyayya ga Allah ba, waɗanda zukatansu ba su yi aminci ga Allah ba.
english: and might not be as their fathers— a stubborn and rebellious generation, a generation that didn’t make their hearts loyal, whose spirit was not steadfast with God.

hausa: In abokin gābanka yana jin yunwa, ka ba shi abinci ya ci; in yana jin ƙishi, ka ba shi ruwa ya sha.
english: If your enemy is hungry, give him food to eat. If he is thirsty, give him water to drink;

hausa: Raguwar Yaƙub za tă kasance a tsakiyar mutane masu yawa kamar raɓa daga Ubangiji, kamar yayyafi a kan ciyawa, wanda ba ya jiran mutum ko kuma yă dakata wa ɗan adam.
english: The remnant of Jacob will be among many peoples like dew from Yahweh, like showers on the grass, that don’t wait for man nor wait for the sons of men.

hausa: Sa’an nan Yahuda ya ce, “Bari tă riƙe kayan kiɗa garin nema mu zama abin dariya. Ni kam, na aika da tunkiyar amma ba a same ta ba.”
english: Judah said, “Let her keep it, lest we be shamed. Behold, I sent this young goat, and you haven’t found her.”

hausa: Fir’auna da yawan sojojinsa da kuma yawan jama’arsa ba zai zama da taimako gare shi a yaƙi ba, sa’ad da sarkin Babilon zai gina mahaurai ya kuma yi ƙawanya don yă hallaka rayuka masu yawa.
english: Pharaoh with his mighty army and great company won’t help him in the war, when they cast up mounds and build forts to cut off many persons.

hausa: Yayinda Bilatus yake zaune a kan kujerar shari’a, sai matarsa ta aika masa da wannan saƙo cewa, “Kada ka sa hannunka a kan marar laifin nan, domin na sha wahala ƙwarai, a cikin mafarki yau game da shi.”
english: While he was sitting on the judgment seat, his wife sent to him, saying, “Have nothing to do with that righteous man, for I have suffered many things today in a dream because of him.”

hausa: Duba yadda suka kwanta suna jirana! Mugaye suna ƙulle-ƙullen gāba da ni ba saboda wani dalili ko na yi wa wani zunubi ba, ya Ubangiji.
english: For, behold, they lie in wait for my soul. The mighty gather themselves together against me, not for my disobedience, nor for my sin, Yahweh.

hausa: Kamar maharbi wanda yake jin wa kowa rauni haka yake da duk wanda ya yi hayan wawa ko wani mai wucewa.
english: As an archer who wounds all, so is he who hires a fool or he who hires those who pass by.

hausa: Gama da aka yi ƙidaya mutane, sai aka gane cewa babu wani daga mutanen Yabesh Gileyad da yake a can.
english: For when the people were counted, behold, there were none of the inhabitants of Jabesh Gilead there.

hausa: Sun ci nasara a kansa ta wurin jinin Ɗan Ragon da ta wurin kalmar shaidarsu; ba su ƙaunaci rayukansu sosai har da za su ja da baya daga mutuwa.
english: They overcame him because of the Lamb’s blood, and because of the word of their testimony. They didn’t love their life, even to death.

hausa: kuka gina Sihiyona ta wurin zub da jini, Urushalima kuma ta wurin mugunta.
english: who build up Zion with blood, and Jerusalem with iniquity.

hausa: Saboda haka, ka fid da tsoro daga zuciyarka ka kakkaɓe duk wani abin da ya dami rayuwarka, gama ƙuruciya da ƙarfi ba su da amfani.
english: Therefore remove sorrow from your heart, and put away evil from your flesh; for youth and the dawn of life are vanity.

hausa: “Sa’an nan Ubangiji, Allah na Isra’ila, ya ba da Sihon da dukan mutanensa a hannun Isra’ila, suka kuwa ci nasara a kansu. Isra’ila ta ƙwace dukan ƙasar Amoriyawa da suke zaune a ƙasar,
english: Yahweh, the God of Israel, delivered Sihon and all his people into the hand of Israel, and they struck them. So Israel possessed all the land of the Amorites, the inhabitants of that country.

hausa: Yesu ya amsa, “Aikin Allah shi ne, a gaskata da wanda ya aiko.”
english: Jesus answered them, “This is the work of God, that you believe in him whom he has sent.”

hausa: Kalmomin bakinsa mugaye ne da kuma ruɗu; ya daina zama mai hikima da yin alheri.
english: The words of his mouth are iniquity and deceit. He has ceased to be wise and to do good.

hausa: Ina jiran cetonka, ya Ubangiji, ina kuma bin umarnanka.
english: I have hoped for your salvation, Yahweh. I have done your commandments.

hausa: da ɗamara a gindinsu da rawuna a kansu suna kaɗawa falfal; dukansu sun yi kamar jarumawan kekunan yaƙin Babiloniyawa ’yan Kaldiya.
english: dressed with belts on their waists, with flowing turbans on their heads, all of them looking like princes, after the likeness of the Babylonians in Chaldea, the land of their birth.

hausa: Gama mun san shi, wannan wanda ya ce, “Ramuwa tawa ce; zan rama,” da kuma, “Ubangiji zai yi wa mutanensa hukunci.”
english: For we know him who said, “Vengeance belongs to me. I will repay,” says the Lord. Again, “The Lord will judge his people.”

hausa: Gama Ubangiji mai adalci ne, yana ƙaunar gaskiya masu adalci za su ga fuskarsa.
english: For Yahweh is righteous. He loves righteousness. The upright shall see his face.

hausa: Shi ya sa muka gwaninta a matsayinmu na masu hidimar sabon alkawari ba ta rubutacciyar Dokar ba, amma ta Ruhu; don Dokar, kisa take yi, Ruhu kuwa yana ba da rai.
english: who also made us sufficient as servants of a new covenant, not of the letter but of the Spirit. For the letter kills, but the Spirit gives life.

hausa: An cinye mu ta wurin fushinka mun kuma razana ta wurin hasalarka.
english: For we are consumed in your anger. We are troubled in your wrath.

hausa: Da rana Ubangiji yakan ja gabansu a cikin al’amudin girgije domin yă bishe su a kan hanyarsu, da dare kuma a cikin al’amudin wuta domin yă ba su haske, domin su iya tafiya dare da rana.
english: Yahweh went before them by day in a pillar of cloud, to lead them on their way, and by night in a pillar of fire, to give them light, that they might go by day and by night:

hausa: A can, suka ba shi ruwan inabi gauraye da wani abu mai ɗaci yă sha. Amma da ya ɗanɗana, sai ya ƙi sha.
english: they gave him sour wine to drink mixed with gall. When he had tasted it, he would not drink.

hausa: Bayan wannan, Mowabawa da Ammonawa tare da waɗansu Meyunawa suka zo su yaƙi Yehoshafat.
english: After this, the children of Moab, the children of Ammon, and with them some of the Meunites, came against Jehoshaphat to battle.

hausa: (Da ladar da ya samu saboda muguntarsa Yahuda ya sayi wani fili; a can ya fāɗi da kā, jikinsa ya fashe, hanjinsa kuma duk suka zubo.
english: Now this man obtained a field with the reward for his wickedness; and falling headlong, his body burst open and all his intestines gushed out.

hausa: Almajiransa suka tambaye shi ma’anar wannan misali.
english: Then his disciples asked him, “What does this parable mean?”

hausa: Firist da ya furta shi tsarkakakke zai miƙa da wanda za a tsabtaccen da kuma hadayunsa a gaban Ubangiji a ƙofar Tentin Sujada.
english: The priest who cleanses him shall set the man who is to be cleansed, and those things, before Yahweh, at the door of the Tent of Meeting.

hausa: Ka tsare raina, gama na ba da kaina gare ka. Kai ne Allahna; ka ceci bawanka wanda ya dogara gare ka.
english: Preserve my soul, for I am godly. You, my God, save your servant who trusts in you.

hausa: Dukan rabon zai zama murabba’i, kamu 25,000 kowane gefe. A matsayin kyauta ta musamman za ku keɓe tsattsarkan rabo, haka ma za ku yi da mallakar birnin.
english: All the offering shall be a square of twenty-five thousand by twenty-five thousand. You shall offer it as a holy offering, with the possession of the city.

hausa: Amma har zuwa shekara ta ashirin da uku ta mulkin Yowash, firistocin ba su yi gyara haikalin ba.
english: But it was so, that in the twenty-third year of King Jehoash the priests had not repaired the damage to the house.

hausa: Saboda haka Hanun ya kama mutanen Dawuda ya aske rabin gemun kowannensu, ya yayyage rigunarsu daidai ɗuwawu, sa’an nan ya sallame su.
english: So Hanun took David’s servants, shaved off one half of their beards, and cut off their garments in the middle, even to their buttocks, and sent them away.

hausa: Sa’ad Mowab ta bayyana a masujadar bisa tudu, tana gajiyar da kanta ne kawai; sa’ad da ta tafi wurin tsafinta don tă yi addu’a, babu wani amfani.
english: It will happen that when Moab presents himself, when he wearies himself on the high place, and comes to his sanctuary to pray, that he will not prevail.

hausa: Gama Ubangiji Maɗaukaki ya ƙudura ya yi wannan, wa kuwa zai hana shi? Ya riga ya miƙa hannunsa, wa zai komar da shi?
english: For Yahweh of Armies has planned, and who can stop it? His hand is stretched out, and who can turn it back?”

hausa: A shekara ta uku ta mulkinsa, ya aiki ma’aikatansa Ben-Hayil, Obadiya, Zakariya, Netanel da Mikahiya su yi koyarwa a garuruwan Yahuda.
english: Also in the third year of his reign he sent his princes, even Ben Hail, Obadiah, Zechariah, Nethanel, and Micaiah, to teach in the cities of Judah;

hausa: Kada ka bar bakinka ya kai ga yin zunubi. Kada kuma ka kai ƙara wurin ɗan saƙon haikali cewa, “Alkawarin da na yi kuskure ne.” Me ya sa Allah yake fushi a kan abin da ka faɗa har yă lalatar da aikin hannuwanka?
english: Don’t allow your mouth to lead you into sin. Don’t protest before the messenger that this was a mistake. Why should God be angry at your voice, and destroy the work of your hands?

hausa: In an toya hadaya ta garinku a kasko, sai a yi shi da gari mai laushi haɗe da mai, ba kuwa da yisti ba.
english: If your offering is a meal offering made on a griddle, it shall be of unleavened fine flour, mixed with oil.

hausa: Daga Teba da Berotai, garuruwan da suke ƙarƙashin Hadadezer, Sarki Dawuda ya kwashe tagulla masu yawan gaske.
english: From Betah and from Berothai, cities of Hadadezer, King David took a great quantity of bronze.

hausa: Ana ma iya cewa zuriyar Lawi, mai karɓar kashi ɗaya bisa goma daga mutane, ya ba da kashi ɗaya bisa goma ta wurin Ibrahim,
english: We can say that through Abraham even Levi, who receives tithes, has paid tithes,

hausa: Ka cece ni daga bakin zakoki; ka cece ni daga ƙahonin ɓauna.
english: Save me from the lion’s mouth! Yes, you have rescued me from the horns of the wild oxen.

hausa: Me ya sa ƙasashe suke haɗa baki mutane kuma suke ƙulla shawarwarin banza?
english: Why do the nations rage, and the peoples plot a vain thing?

hausa: Allahnmu shi ne Allah wanda yake ceto; daga Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka kuɓuta yake zuwa daga mutuwa.
english: God is to us a God of deliverance. To Yahweh, the Lord, belongs escape from death.

hausa: Za mu yarda da wannan kaɗai ta wannan sharaɗi, cewa za ku zama kamar mu ta wurin yin wa dukan ’ya’yanku maza kaciya.
english: Only on this condition will we consent to you. If you will be as we are, that every male of you be circumcised,

hausa: Me za mu ce ke nan? Za mu ci gaba da yin zunubi domin alheri yă haɓaka?
english: What shall we say then? Shall we continue in sin, that grace may abound?

hausa: Bayan ƙulla yarjejjeniya da shi, zai yi zamba cikin aminci, kuma zai sami damar hawan mulki da goyon baya mutane kaɗan.
english: After the treaty made with him he will work deceitfully; for he will come up and will become strong with few people.

hausa: Sai abin da aka faɗa ta bakin annabi Irmiya ya cika, cewa,
english: Then that which was spoken by Jeremiah the prophet was fulfilled, saying,

hausa: Sa’an nan ya shiga ya tsaya a gaban maigidansa Elisha. Sai Elisha ya tambaye shi ya ce, “Ina ka je, Gehazi?” Sai Gehazi ya amsa ya ce, “Bawanka bai je ko’ina ba.”
english: But he went in, and stood before his master. Elisha said to him, “Where did you come from, Gehazi?” He said, “Your servant went nowhere.”

hausa: Ban taɓa zama a gida daga ranar da na fito da Isra’ila daga Masar ba har wa yau. Na yi ta yawo daga gefen da aka kafa tenti zuwa wani, daga wannan wuri zuwa wancan.
english: for I have not lived in a house since the day that I brought up Israel to this day, but have gone from tent to tent, and from one tent to another.

hausa: Sa’an nan Isra’ilawa, dukan mutane, suka haura zuwa Betel, a can suka zauna suna kuka a gaban Ubangiji. Suka yi azumi a wannan rana har yamma suka miƙa hadayun ƙonawa da hadayun salama ga Ubangiji.
english: Then all the children of Israel and all the people went up, and came to Bethel, and wept, and sat there before Yahweh, and fasted that day until evening; then they offered burnt offerings and peace offerings before Yahweh.

hausa: Ya bashe su ga sarkin Babiloniyawa wanda ya karkashe samarinsu da takobi a wuri mai tsarki, bai yi juyayin saurayi, ko budurwa, ko tsoho, ko gajiyayye ba. Allah ya bashe su duka ga Nebukadnezzar.
english: Therefore he brought on them the king of the Chaldeans, who killed their young men with the sword in the house of their sanctuary, and had no compassion on young man or virgin, old man or infirm. He gave them all into his hand.

hausa: Kuma gare ka, a matsayi wanda yake kan ’yan’uwanka, na ba da gonar da na karɓe daga Amoriyawa da takobi da kuma bakana.”
english: Moreover I have given to you one portion above your brothers, which I took out of the hand of the Amorite with my sword and with my bow.”

hausa: “Dukan kome Ubana ya danƙa mini. Ba wanda ya san Ɗan sai dai Uban, ba kuma wanda ya san Uban, sai dai Ɗan da kuma waɗanda Ɗan ya so yă bayyana musu shi.
english: All things have been delivered to me by my Father. No one knows the Son, except the Father; neither does anyone know the Father, except the Son and he to whom the Son desires to reveal him.

hausa: Ga abin da Ubangiji Maɗaukaki, Allah na Isra’ila yana cewa, “Sa’ad da na komo da su daga bauta mutane a ƙasar Yahuda da cikin garuruwanta za su sāke yi amfani da waɗannan kalmomi. ‘Ubangiji ya albarkace ka, ya mazauni mai adalci, ya tsarkakan dutse.’
english: Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel, says: “Yet again they will use this speech in the land of Judah and in its cities, when I reverse their captivity: ‘Yahweh bless you, habitation of righteousness, mountain of holiness.’

hausa: In masu tsinkar ’ya’yan inabi suka zo maka, ba za su rage ’ya’yan inabi kaɗan ba? In ɓarayi suka zo da dare, ba za su sata abin da kawai suke bukata ba?
english: If grape gatherers came to you, would they not leave some gleaning grapes? If thieves came by night, wouldn’t they steal until they had enough?

hausa: “Mugun ciwo ya kama shi; ba zai taɓa tashi daga inda yake kwanciya ba.”
english: “An evil disease”, they say, “has afflicted him. Now that he lies he shall rise up no more.”

hausa: Da suka ji haka, sai suka yi fushi ƙwarai suka fara ihu suna cewa, “Girma ta tabbata ga Artemis ta Afisawa!”
english: When they heard this they were filled with anger, and cried out, saying, “Great is Artemis of the Ephesians!”

hausa: Akwai wata annabiya ma, mai suna Anna, diyar Fanuwel, na kabilar Asher. Ta tsufa kutuf; ta yi zama da mijinta shekaru bakwai bayan sun yi aure,
english: There was one Anna, a prophetess, the daughter of Phanuel, of the tribe of Asher (she was of a great age, having lived with a husband seven years from her virginity,

hausa: Efraim yana fariya yana cewa, “Ni mai arziki ne ƙwarai; na azurta. Da dukan wadatata ba za a sami wani laifi ko zunubi a gare ni ba.”
english: Ephraim said, “Surely I have become rich. I have found myself wealth. In all my wealth they won’t find in me any iniquity that is sin.”

hausa: Waɗansu sun bauɗe daga waɗannan al’amura, suka koma ga maganganu marasa ma’ana.
english: from which things some, having missed the mark, have turned away to vain talking,

hausa: Mishma, Duma, Massa, Hadad, Tema
english: Mishma, Dumah, Massa, Hadad, Tema,

hausa: Ka ci abinci yadda za ka ci ƙosai sha’ir, ka gasa shi a gaban mutane, ka yi amfani da najasar mutane kamar itacen wuta.”
english: You shall eat it as barley cakes, and you shall bake it in their sight with dung that comes out of man.”

hausa: Yusuf ya ce, “Ga abin da mafarkin yake nufi, ‘Kwanduna uku, kwanaki uku ne.
english: Joseph answered, “This is its interpretation. The three baskets are three days.

hausa: Amma Ubangiji ya tsaya tare da ni, ya kuma ba ni ƙarfi, don ta wurina a yi cikakkiyar shelar saƙon har Al’ummai duka su ji. Aka kuma cece ni daga bakin zaki.
english: But the Lord stood by me and strengthened me, that through me the message might be fully proclaimed, and that all the Gentiles might hear. So I was delivered out of the mouth of the lion.

hausa: Kowane gari ko ƙauyen da kuka shiga, ku nemi mai mutunci a wurin, ku kuma zauna a gidansa har sai kun tashi.
english: Into whatever city or village you enter, find out who in it is worthy, and stay there until you go on.

hausa: alkawarin da ya yi wa Ibrahim rantsuwar da ya yi ga Ishaku.
english: the covenant which he made with Abraham, his oath to Isaac.

hausa: Zera mutumin Kush ya taka ya fita don yă yaƙe su da babban runduna da kuma kekunan yaƙi ɗari uku, ya kuma zo har Maresha.
english: Zerah the Ethiopian came out against them with an army of a million troops and three hundred chariots, and he came to Mareshah.

hausa: Issakar zai sami rabo; zai yi iyaka da yankin Simeyon daga gabas zuwa yamma.
english: “By the border of Simeon, from the east side to the west side, Issachar, one portion.

hausa: Masussukai za su cika da hatsi; randuna za su cika da sabon ruwan inabi da mai suna zuba.
english: The threshing floors will be full of wheat, and the vats will overflow with new wine and oil.

hausa: Zan lura da ku yayinda kuke wucewa ƙarƙashin sanda, zan kuma kawo ku cikin daurin alkawari.
english: “I will cause you to pass under the rod, and I will bring you into the bond of the covenant.

hausa: Ni ne Ubangiji, kuma babu wani; in ban da ni babu wani Allah. Zan ƙarfafa ka, ko da yake ba ka san ni ba,
english: I am Yahweh, and there is no one else. Besides me, there is no God. I will strengthen you, though you have not known me,

hausa: sai na fita da dare tare da mutane kalila. Ban faɗa wa wani abin da Allahna ya sa a zuciyata in yi don Urushalima ba. Ba waɗansu dabbobi kuma tare da ni, sai dai dabbar da na hau.
english: I arose in the night, I and a few men with me. I didn’t tell anyone what my God put into my heart to do for Jerusalem. There wasn’t any animal with me except the animal that I rode on.

hausa: Zan shimfiɗa gawawwakin Isra’ilawa a gaban gumakansu, in kuma watsar da ƙasusuwanku kewaye da bagadanku.
english: I will lay the dead bodies of the children of Israel before their idols. I will scatter your bones around your altars.

hausa: Bazara na biye Ben-Hadad ya tattara Arameyawa, ya haura zuwa Afek don yă yaƙi Isra’ila.
english: At the return of the year, Ben Hadad mustered the Syrians and went up to Aphek to fight against Israel.

hausa: Sa’an nan waɗansu Farisiyawa da malaman dokoki suka ce masa, “Malam, muna so mu ga wata alama mai banmamaki daga gare ka.”
english: Then certain of the scribes and Pharisees answered, “Teacher, we want to see a sign from you.”

hausa: Sa’ad da adalai suka yi nasara, kowa yakan yi biki; amma sa’ad da mugu ya samu shugabanci, mutane sukan yi ta ɓuya.
english: When the righteous triumph, there is great glory; but when the wicked rise, men hide themselves.

hausa: Gama sun wartsake ruhuna da kuma naku. Ya kamata ku girmama irin waɗannan mutane.
english: For they refreshed my spirit and yours. Therefore acknowledge those who are like that.

hausa: Amma ya share Fir’auna da mayaƙansa cikin Jan Teku; Ƙaunarsa madawwamiya ce.
english: but overthrew Pharaoh and his army in the Red Sea, for his loving kindness endures forever;

hausa: Zai sha gaban Ubangiji, a ruhu da kuma iko irin na Iliya, domin yă juye zukatan iyaye ga ’ya’yansu, marasa biyayya kuma ga zama masu biyayya don yă kintsa mutane su zama shiryayyu domin Ubangiji.”
english: He will go before him in the spirit and power of Elijah, ‘to turn the hearts of the fathers to the children,’ and the disobedient to the wisdom of the just; to prepare a people prepared for the Lord.”

hausa: Bitrus ya zauna a Yoffa na ɗan lokaci tare da wani mai aikin fatu mai suna Siman.
english: He stayed many days in Joppa with a tanner named Simon.

hausa: Ban cancanci dukan alheri da amincin da ka nuna wa bawanka ba. Da sanda kaɗai nake sa’ad da na ƙetare wannan Urdun, amma ga shi yanzu na zama ƙungiyoyi biyu.
english: I am not worthy of the least of all the loving kindnesses, and of all the truth, which you have shown to your servant; for with just my staff I crossed over this Jordan; and now I have become two companies.

hausa: Da Dawuda ya tafi Ziklag, waɗannan mutanen Manasse ne suka haɗa kai da shi. Adna, Yozabad, Yediyayel, Mika’ilu, Yozabad, Elihu da Zilletai, shugabannin ƙungiyoyi na dubu a cikin Manasse.
english: As he went to Ziklag, some from Manasseh joined him: Adnah, Jozabad, Jediael, Michael, Jozabad, Elihu, and Zillethai, captains of thousands who were of Manasseh.

hausa: Wawaye kan yi ba’a a gyaran zunubi, amma fatan alheri yana samuwa a cikin masu aikata gaskiya.
english: Fools mock at making atonement for sins, but among the upright there is good will.

hausa: Kun yi ta tawaye wa Ubangiji tun ran da na san ku.
english: You have been rebellious against Yahweh from the day that I knew you.

hausa: “In mutum ya ba maƙwabcinsa azurfa, ko kaya ajiya, aka kuma sace su daga gidan maƙwabcin, in an kama ɓarawon, sai ɓarawon yă biya abin da ya sata har sau biyu.
english: “If a man delivers to his neighbor money or stuff to keep, and it is stolen out of the man’s house, if the thief is found, he shall pay double.

hausa: To, haikalin ya cika da mutane maza da mata; dukan shugabannin Filistiyawa kuwa suna a can, a bisan rufin kuwa akwai mutum wajen dubu uku maza da mata suna kallon Samson yana wasa.
english: Now the house was full of men and women; and all the lords of the Philistines were there; and there were on the roof about three thousand men and women, who saw while Samson performed.

hausa: Waɗannan su ne tufafin da za su ɗinka, ƙyallen maƙalawa a ƙirji, da efod, da taguwa, da doguwar riga, da rawani, da abin ɗamara. Za su yi wa ɗan’uwanka, Haruna da ’ya’yansa, waɗannan tsarkaka tufafi, don su zama firistoci masu yi mini hidima.
english: These are the garments which they shall make: a breastplate, an ephod, a robe, a fitted tunic, a turban, and a sash. They shall make holy garments for Aaron your brother and his sons, that he may minister to me in the priest’s office.

hausa: Dukan mutane suka amsa gaba ɗaya suka ce, “Za mu yi duk abin da Ubangiji ya faɗa.” Sai Musa ya mayar wa Ubangiji amsar da mutane suka bayar.
english: All the people answered together, and said, “All that Yahweh has spoken we will do.” Moses reported the words of the people to Yahweh.

hausa: gama yana shayar da masu ƙishirwa yana kuma ƙosar da mayunwata da abubuwa masu kyau.
english: For he satisfies the longing soul. He fills the hungry soul with good.

hausa: “Me ya sa ka fito da ni daga cikin uwata? Da ma na mutu kafin a haife ni.
english: “‘Why, then, have you brought me out of the womb? I wish I had given up the spirit, and no eye had seen me.

hausa: “La’ananne ne mutumin da ya yi rashin adalci ga baƙo, maraya ko gwauruwa.” Sai dukan mutane su ce, “Amin!”
english: ‘Cursed is he who withholds justice from the foreigner, fatherless, and widow.’ All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’

hausa: Takobi zai zo a kan Masar, azaba za tă zo a kan Kush. Sa’ad da kisassu za su fāɗi a Masar, za a kwashe dukiyarta a tafi a rushe harsashinta.
english: A sword will come on Egypt, and anguish will be in Ethiopia, when the slain fall in Egypt. They take away her multitude, and her foundations are broken down.

hausa: Yanzu ga abin da za ku yi, shi ne, kashi ɗaya bisa uku na firistoci da Lawiyawa waɗanda za su yi aiki a Asabbaci su yi tsaro a ƙofofi,
english: This is the thing that you must do: a third part of you, who come in on the Sabbath, of the priests and of the Levites, shall be gatekeepers of the thresholds.

hausa: Saboda haka Abram ya haura daga Masar zuwa Negeb tare da matarsa, da dukan abin da yake da shi tare da Lot.
english: Abram went up out of Egypt—he, his wife, all that he had, and Lot with him—into the South.

hausa: Daga kan tudun, iyakar ta nufi maɓulɓular ruwa na Neftowa, ta ɓullo a garuruwan da suke a Dutsen Efron, ta gangara zuwa Ba’ala (wato, Kiriyat Yeyarim).
english: The border extended from the top of the mountain to the spring of the waters of Nephtoah, and went out to the cities of Mount Ephron; and the border extended to Baalah (also called Kiriath Jearim);

hausa: Bala’i na fari ya wuce, sauran bala’i biyu suna nan zuwa.
english: The first woe is past. Behold, there are still two woes coming after this.

hausa: “Biye da wannan, sai itatuwan suka ce wa itacen ɓaure, ‘Zo ka zama sarkinmu.’
english: “The trees said to the fig tree, ‘Come and reign over us.’

hausa: Ta wurin bangaskiya ne Ibrahim, sa’ad da aka kira shi ya fita zuwa wata ƙasar da zai karɓi gādo daga baya, ya kuwa yi biyayya ya tafi, ko da yake bai san inda za shi ba.
english: By faith Abraham, when he was called, obeyed to go out to the place which he was to receive for an inheritance. He went out, not knowing where he went.

hausa: Ya kewaye ni yadda ba zan iya gudu ba; Ya daure ni da sarƙa mai nauyi.
english: He has walled me about, so that I can’t go out. He has made my chain heavy.

hausa: Sa’ad da na iso can, sai na ga itatuwa masu yawa a kowane gefen kogin.
english: Now when I had returned, behold, on the bank of the river were very many trees on the one side and on the other.

hausa: Ga kalmomin Ubangiji da ya yi game da Isra’ila da Yahuda,
english: These are the words that Yahweh spoke concerning Israel and concerning Judah.

hausa: In kuma aba mai shuɗewa ta zo da ɗaukaka, ashe, abin da yake dawwammame, lalle ne yă kasance da ɗaukakar da ta fi haka nesa!
english: For if that which passes away was with glory, much more that which remains is in glory.

hausa: Da na ga cewa ba sa yin daidai da gaskiyar bishara, sai na ce wa Bitrus a gabansu duka, “Kai mutumin Yahuda ne, duk da haka kana rayuwa kamar Ba’al’umme ba kamar mutumin Yahuda ba. To, yaya aka yi, kana tilasta Al’ummai su bi al’adun Yahudawa?
english: But when I saw that they didn’t walk uprightly according to the truth of the Good News, I said to Peter before them all, “If you, being a Jew, live as the Gentiles do, and not as the Jews do, why do you compel the Gentiles to live as the Jews do?

hausa: Saboda suna mai girma da Ubangiji yake da shi, ba zai taɓa ƙin mutanensa ba. Gama Ubangiji ya ji daɗi da ya yi ku mutanensa.
english: For Yahweh will not forsake his people for his great name’s sake, because it has pleased Yahweh to make you a people for himself.

hausa: Hayaƙi ya taso daga kafaffen hancinsa; harshen wuta mai cinyewa daga bakinsa, garwashi mai ƙuna daga bakinsa.
english: Smoke went up out of his nostrils. Consuming fire came out of his mouth. Coals were kindled by it.

hausa: Yahudawa da yawa kuwa suka zo wurin Marta da Maryamu don su yi musu ta’aziyya, saboda rasuwar ɗan’uwansu.
english: Many of the Jews had joined the women around Martha and Mary, to console them concerning their brother.

hausa: takobin da kuke tsoro zai same ku a can, kuma yunwar da kuke tsoro za tă bi ku zuwa Masar, a can kuwa za ku mutu.
english: then it will happen that the sword, which you fear, will overtake you there in the land of Egypt; and the famine, about which you are afraid, will follow close behind you there in Egypt; and you will die there.

hausa: Amma Absalom ya ce, “A kira mini Hushai mutumin Arkitawan nan shi ma, mu ji abin da zai ce.”
english: Then Absalom said, “Now call Hushai the Archite also, and let’s hear likewise what he says.”

hausa: Kun ce, ‘A’a, za mu gudu a kan dawakai.’ Saboda haka za ku gudu! Kun ce, ‘Za mu hau dawakai masu sauri mu gudu.’ Saboda haka masu fafararku za su fi ku gudu!
english: but you said, “No, for we will flee on horses;” therefore you will flee; and, “We will ride on the swift;” therefore those who pursue you will be swift.

hausa: “Ya dogara ga Ubangiji; bari Ubangiji yă cece shi. Bari yă cece shi, da yake yana jin daɗinsa.”
english: “He trusts in Yahweh. Let him deliver him. Let him rescue him, since he delights in him.”

hausa: “Yanzu zan mai da kai ƙanƙani a cikin al’ummai abin reni a cikin mutane.
english: “For, behold, I have made you small among the nations, and despised among men.

hausa: In mutumin da ya keɓe gonar, yana so yă fanshe ta, to, dole yă ƙara kashi ɗaya bisa biyar na darajarta, gonar kuwa tă zama nasa.
english: If he who dedicated the field will indeed redeem it, then he shall add the fifth part of the money of your valuation to it, and it shall remain his.

hausa: Zan kuɓutar da mutumin da yake da ma’auni na rashin gaskiya, da kuma buhun ma’aunan ƙarya?
english: Shall I tolerate dishonest scales, and a bag of deceitful weights?

hausa: An kewaye birnin da yaƙi har shekara ta goma sha ɗaya ta mulkin Zedekiya.
english: So the city was besieged to the eleventh year of King Zedekiah.

hausa: Har wa yau ya ce, “Zan dogara gare shi.” Ya kuma ce, “Ga ni, da ’ya’yan da Allah ya ba ni.”
english: Again, “I will put my trust in him.” Again, “Behold, here I am with the children whom God has given me.”

hausa: Zadok ɗan Ahitub da Abimelek ɗan Abiyatar su ne firistoci; Shafsha shi ne magatakarda;
english: Zadok the son of Ahitub and Abimelech the son of Abiathar were priests; Shavsha was scribe;

hausa: A daidai wannan lokaci, sai labulen haikali ya tsage gida biyu, daga sama har ƙasa. Ƙasa ta jijjiga, duwatsu kuma suka farfashe.
english: Behold, the veil of the temple was torn in two from the top to the bottom. The earth quaked and the rocks were split.

hausa: ta goma sha biya a kan Yeremot, ’ya’yansa maza da danginsa, 12
english: for the fifteenth to Jeremoth, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

hausa: Ku ɗauki ninki biyu na yawan azurfa tare da ku, gama dole ku mayar da azurfan da aka sa a cikin bakunan buhunanku. Mai yiwuwa an yi haka a kuskure ne.
english: and take double money in your hand, and take back the money that was returned in the mouth of your sacks. Perhaps it was an oversight.

hausa: na iyalin Ezra, Meshullam; na iyalin Amariya, Yehohanan;
english: of Ezra, Meshullam; of Amariah, Jehohanan;

hausa: Babilon za tă zama tarin juji, wurin zaman diloli, abin ƙyama da abar ba’a, inda ba kowa.
english: Babylon will become heaps, a dwelling place for jackals, an astonishment, and a hissing, without inhabitant.

hausa: Ga abin da Ubangiji yana cewa, “Ku rera don farin ciki wa Yaƙub; ku yi sowa don al’ummai da suke nesa. Ka sa a ji yabanku, ku kuma ce, ‘Ya Ubangiji ka ceci mutanenka, raguwar Isra’ila.’
english: For Yahweh says, “Sing with gladness for Jacob, and shout for the chief of the nations. Publish, praise, and say, ‘Yahweh, save your people, the remnant of Israel!’

hausa: Kamar dodon gona cikin gonar kabewa, haka gumakansu ba sa iya magana; dole a yi ta ɗaukansu domin ba za su iya tafiya ba. Kada ku ji tsoronsu; ba za su iya yi wa wani lahani ba ba sa iya yin wani abin kirki.”
english: They are like a palm tree, of turned work, and don’t speak. They must be carried, because they can’t move. Don’t be afraid of them; for they can’t do evil, neither is it in them to do good.”

hausa: Sa’an nan Yefta ya haye zuwa wajen Ammonawa don yaƙi da su. Ubangiji kuwa ya ba da su a hannuwansa.
english: So Jephthah passed over to the children of Ammon to fight against them; and Yahweh delivered them into his hand.

hausa: don zuriyarku tă san cewa na sa Isra’ilawa suka zauna a bukkoki sa’ad da na fitar da su daga Masar. Ni ne Ubangiji Allahnku.’ ”
english: that your generations may know that I made the children of Israel to dwell in temporary shelters when I brought them out of the land of Egypt. I am Yahweh your God.’”

hausa: Hayaniya za tă taso har iyakar duniya, gama Ubangiji zai kawo tuhume-tuhume a kan al’ummai; zai kawo shari’a a kan dukan ’yan adam ya kuma kashe mugaye da takobi,’ ” in ji Ubangiji.
english: A noise will come even to the end of the earth; for Yahweh has a controversy with the nations. He will enter into judgment with all flesh. As for the wicked, he will give them to the sword,”’ says Yahweh.”

hausa: Kada ku manta da yin alheri ga baƙi, gama ta yin haka ne waɗansu suka yi wa mala’iku hidima, ba da saninsu ba.
english: Don’t forget to show hospitality to strangers, for in doing so, some have entertained angels without knowing it.

hausa: Gaskiya nake gaya muku, kafin sama da ƙasa sun shuɗe, babu ko ɗan wasali, babu wani ɗigo ta kowace hanya da zai ɓace daga Dokar, sai an cika kome.
english: For most certainly, I tell you, until heaven and earth pass away, not even one smallest letter or one tiny pen stroke shall in any way pass away from the law, until all things are accomplished.

hausa: Sa’an nan masu adalci za su haskaka kamar rana a mulkin Ubansu. Duk mai kunnen ji, yă ji.”
english: Then the righteous will shine like the sun in the Kingdom of their Father. He who has ears to hear, let him hear.

hausa: Bari a rufe leɓunan ƙarairayinsu, gama da fariya da reni suna magana da girman kai a kan adalai.
english: Let the lying lips be mute, which speak against the righteous insolently, with pride and contempt.

hausa: Fir’auna zai yi tsammani, ‘Aha, Isra’ilawa sun rikice cikin ƙasar, hamada kuwa ta yimƙe su.’
english: Pharaoh will say of the children of Israel, ‘They are entangled in the land. The wilderness has shut them in.’

hausa: Amma Shawulu ya jefe shi da māshi don yă kashe shi. A nan ne Yonatan ya san lalle mahaifinsa ya yi niyya yă kashe Dawuda.
english: Saul cast his spear at him to strike him. By this Jonathan knew that his father was determined to put David to death.

hausa: Ana cikin haka, shugabannin sarkin Aram suka ba shi shawara, “Allolinsu, allolin tuddai ne. Shi ya sa suka fi mu ƙarfi. Amma in mun yaƙe su a fili, tabbatacce za mu fi su ƙarfi.
english: The servants of the king of Syria said to him, “Their god is a god of the hills; therefore they were stronger than we. But let’s fight against them in the plain, and surely we will be stronger than they.

hausa: sai ya cece mu, ba saboda abubuwan adalcin da muka aikata ba, sai dai saboda jinƙansa. Ya cece mu ta wurin wankan nan na sāke haihuwa da kuma sabuntawan nan ta Ruhu Mai Tsarki,
english: not by works of righteousness which we did ourselves, but according to his mercy, he saved us through the washing of regeneration and renewing by the Holy Spirit,

hausa: Da mai ɗaukar makamai ya ga Shawulu ya mutu, sai shi ma ya zāre takobinsa ya soki kansa ya mutu.
english: When his armor bearer saw that Saul was dead, he likewise fell on his sword, and died with him.

hausa: In ɗan’uwa mutumin Ibraniyawa, namiji ko ta mace, ya sayar da kansa gare ka, ya kuma bauta maka shekaru shida, a shekara ta bakwai dole ka ’yantar da shi.
english: If your brother, a Hebrew man, or a Hebrew woman, is sold to you and serves you six years, then in the seventh year you shall let him go free from you.

hausa: Da suka shiga ciki kurmin, suka ga zuma tana zubowa, duk da haka ba wanda ya sa yatsansa ya lasa saboda tsoron rantsuwar da suka yi.
english: When the people had come to the forest, behold, honey was dripping, but no one put his hand to his mouth, for the people feared the oath.

hausa: Gama an sha daure shi hannu da ƙafa da sarƙa, amma yakan tsintsinke sarƙar, yă kuma karye ƙarafan da suke ƙafafunsa. Ba wanda yake da ƙarfin da zai iya yă riƙe shi.
english: because he had been often bound with fetters and chains, and the chains had been torn apart by him, and the fetters broken in pieces. Nobody had the strength to tame him.

hausa: Dawuda kuwa ya zama makiyayinsu da mutuncin zuciya; da hannuwa masu gwaninta ya bi da su.
english: So he was their shepherd according to the integrity of his heart, and guided them by the skillfulness of his hands.

hausa: Ka kiyaye ni daga tarkon da aka sa mini, daga tarkon da mugaye suka sa.
english: Keep me from the snare which they have laid for me, from the traps of the workers of iniquity.

hausa: Ubangiji ya ce wa Musa,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

hausa: “Kada ku miƙa mini jinin hadaya tare da wani abin da yana da yisti, kada kuma ku bar kowace hadaya ta Bikin Ƙetarewa ta kwana.
english: “You shall not offer the blood of my sacrifice with leavened bread. The sacrifice of the feast of the Passover shall not be left to the morning.

hausa: Ki rera, ya Diyar Sihiyona; ki tā da murya, ya Isra’ila! Ki yi murna ki kuma yi farin ciki da dukan zuciyarki, Ya Diyar Urushalima!
english: Sing, daughter of Zion! Shout, Israel! Be glad and rejoice with all your heart, daughter of Jerusalem.

hausa: “Kaito ga banzan makiyayin nan, wanda ya bar garken! Bari takobi yă sare hannunsa da idonsa na dama! Bari hannunsa yă shanye gaba ƙaf, idonsa na dama kuma yă makance sarai!”
english: Woe to the worthless shepherd who leaves the flock! The sword will strike his arm and his right eye. His arm will be completely withered, and his right eye will be totally blinded!”

hausa: “Ya sarki, ka ga wata babbar siffa, mai girma, siffa ce mai haske, abar bantsoro tana tsaye a gabanka.
english: “You, O king, saw, and behold, a great image. This image, which was mighty, and whose brightness was excellent, stood before you; and its appearance was terrifying.

hausa: Mu biya ko kada mu biya?” Amma Yesu ya san munafuncinsu, sai ya yi tambaya ya ce, “Don me kuke ƙoƙarin sa mini tarko? Ku kawo mini dinari in ga.”
english: Shall we give, or shall we not give?” But he, knowing their hypocrisy, said to them, “Why do you test me? Bring me a denarius, that I may see it.”

hausa: Ta haka aka kawar da ƙa’ida marar ƙarfi da kuma marar amfani
english: For there is an annulling of a foregoing commandment because of its weakness and uselessness

hausa: Saboda haka kada ku haɗa kai da su.
english: Therefore don’t be partakers with them.

hausa: Adali yakan yi hankali a abokantaka, amma hanyar mugaye kan kai su ga kaucewa.
english: A righteous person is cautious in friendship, but the way of the wicked leads them astray.

hausa: Bari masu tsananta mini su sha kunya, amma ka kiyaye ni daga shan kunya; bari su tsorata, amma ka kiyaye ni da razana. Ka kawo musu ranar masifa; ka hallaka su da hallaka riɓi biyu.
english: Let them be disappointed who persecute me, but don’t let me be disappointed. Let them be dismayed, but don’t let me be dismayed. Bring on them the day of evil, and destroy them with double destruction.

hausa: Gonar inabin Ubangiji Maɗaukaki ita ce gidan Isra’ila, mutanen Yahuda kuma su ne lambun farin cikinsa. Yana kuma nema ganin gaskiya, amma sai ga zub da jini; yana neman adalci, amma sai ga shi kukan azaba yake ji.
english: For the vineyard of Yahweh of Armies is the house of Israel, and the men of Judah his pleasant plant. He looked for justice, but behold, oppression, for righteousness, but behold, a cry of distress.

hausa: Iyakar kudu ta Gad za tă miƙe kudu daga Tamar zuwa ruwan Meriba Kadesh, sa’an nan ta bi Rafin Masar zuwa Bahar Rum.
english: “By the border of Gad, at the south side southward, the border shall be even from Tamar to the waters of Meribath Kadesh, to the brook, to the great sea.

hausa: Bari a tuna da laifin kakanninsa a gaban Ubangiji; bari kada a taɓa shafe zunubin mahaifiyarsa.
english: Let the iniquity of his fathers be remembered by Yahweh. Don’t let the sin of his mother be blotted out.

hausa: “Zuwa ga mala’ikan ikkilisiya a Tiyatira, ka rubuta, Waɗannan su ne kalmomin Ɗan Allah, wanda idanunsa suna kama da harshen wuta wanda kuma ƙafafunsa suna kama da tagullar da aka goge.
english: “To the angel of the assembly in Thyatira write: “The Son of God, who has his eyes like a flame of fire, and his feet are like burnished brass, says these things:

hausa: Saboda haka ya zuba musu zafin fushinsa, yaƙi mai tsanani. Ya rufe su cikin harsunan wuta, duk da haka ba su gane ba; ya cinye su, amma ba su koyi kome ba.
english: Therefore he poured the fierceness of his anger on him, and the strength of battle. It set him on fire all around, but he didn’t know. It burned him, but he didn’t take it to heart.”

hausa: Ɓarnar da ka yi wa Lebanon zai komo kanka, kuma hallakar dabbobin da ka yi zai sa dabbobi su tsorata ka. Gama ka zub da jinin mutum; ka hallaka ƙasashe, da birane, da kuma kowa da yake cikinsu.
english: For the violence done to Lebanon will overwhelm you, and the destruction of the animals will terrify you, because of men’s blood and for the violence done to the land, to every city and to those who dwell in them.

hausa: Yau Ubangiji Allahnku ya umarce ku ku bi waɗannan ƙa’idodi da kuma dokoki, cikin natsuwa ku kiyaye su da dukan zuciyarku da kuma dukan ranku.
english: Today Yahweh your God commands you to do these statutes and ordinances. You shall therefore keep and do them with all your heart and with all your soul.

hausa: ’Yan’uwa, in an kama wani yana cikin yin zunubi, ku da kuke masu ruhaniya ya kamata ku komo da shi a kan hanya a hankali. Amma ku lura da kanku, domin kada maimakon dawowa da ɗan’uwanku, ku ma ku fāɗi cikin jarraba.
english: Brothers, even if a man is caught in some fault, you who are spiritual must restore such a one in a spirit of gentleness, looking to yourself so that you also aren’t tempted.

hausa: Amma ku yi hankali, ku kiyaye umarnai da kuma dokokin da Musa bawan Ubangiji ya ba ku. Ku ƙaunaci Ubangiji Allahnku, ku yi tafiya kan hanyarsa, ku yi biyayya da umarnansa, ku riƙe shi sosai, ku bauta masa da dukan zuciyarku da kuma dukan ranku.”
english: Only take diligent heed to do the commandment and the law which Moses the servant of Yahweh commanded you, to love Yahweh your God, to walk in all his ways, to keep his commandments, to hold fast to him, and to serve him with all your heart and with all your soul.”

hausa: Sai na ce, “Dariya hauka ce. Kuma me jin daɗi yake kawowa?”
english: I said of laughter, “It is foolishness;” and of mirth, “What does it accomplish?”

hausa: Yana ceton matalauta daga takobin da za tă kashe su da shi; yana cetonsu daga hannun waɗanda suka fi su ƙarfi.
english: But he saves from the sword of their mouth, even the needy from the hand of the mighty.

hausa: Yamma ta kasance, safiya kuma ta kasance, kwana ta uku ke nan.
english: There was evening and there was morning, a third day.

hausa: In aka ci ta a rana ta uku, marar tsabta ce, ba kuma za a karɓe ta ba.
english: If it is eaten at all on the third day, it is an abomination. It will not be accepted;

hausa: “Sa’ad da mutum ya yi wa maƙwabcinsa laifi aka kuma bukaci ya yi rantsuwa, ya kuma zo ya rantse a gaban bagadenka a cikin wannan haikali,
english: “If a man sins against his neighbor, and an oath is laid on him to cause him to swear, and he comes and swears before your altar in this house,

hausa: Saboda haka Gehazi ya bi Na’aman a guje. Da Na’aman ya hango shi yana zuwa a guje, sai ya sauka daga keken yaƙinsa ya tarye shi ya ce, “Lafiya?”
english: So Gehazi followed after Naaman. When Naaman saw one running after him, he came down from the chariot to meet him, and said, “Is all well?”

hausa: ‘Saboda haka za ku zama mutanena, ni kuwa in zama Allahnku.’ ”
english: “You shall be my people, and I will be your God.

hausa: Ba wata maitar da za tă ci Yaƙub, ba sihiri da zai cuci Isra’ila. Yanzu za a ce game da Yaƙub da Isra’ila, ‘Duba abin da Allah ya yi!’
english: Surely there is no enchantment with Jacob; neither is there any divination with Israel. Now it shall be said of Jacob and of Israel, ‘What has God done!’

hausa: Ubangiji ya ce mini, “Kada ka ji tsoronsa, gama na riga na miƙa shi da dukan mayaƙansa da kuma ƙasarsa gare ka. Yi masa abin da ka yi wa Sihon sarkin Amoriyawa, wanda ya yi mulkin Heshbon.”
english: Yahweh said to me, “Don’t fear him; for I have delivered him, with all his people and his land, into your hand. You shall do to him as you did to Sihon king of the Amorites, who lived at Heshbon.”

hausa: zan tumɓuke Isra’ila daga ƙasata, wadda na ba su, zan kuma ƙi wannan haikalin da na tsarkake domin Sunana. Zan mai da shi abin karin magana da abin ba’a cikin dukan mutane.
english: then I will pluck them up by the roots out of my land which I have given them; and this house, which I have made holy for my name, I will cast out of my sight, and I will make it a proverb and a byword among all peoples.

hausa: Irin wannan “hikima” ba daga sama ta sauko ba, ta duniya ce, ta rashin ruhaniya, ta Iblis kuma.
english: This wisdom is not that which comes down from above, but is earthly, sensual, and demonic.

hausa: Fir’auna ya ce wa Yusuf, “Na yi mafarki, kuma babu wanda ya iya fassara shi. Amma na ji an ce sa’ad da ka ji mafarki, kana iya fassara shi.”
english: Pharaoh said to Joseph, “I have dreamed a dream, and there is no one who can interpret it. I have heard it said of you, that when you hear a dream you can interpret it.”

hausa: “Ban da haka ma, za mu kawo wa ɗakunan ajiyar gidan Allahnmu, abincinmu na farko daga ƙasa, na hadayun hatsinmu, na ’ya’yan dukan itatuwanmu da kuma na sabon ruwan inabinmu da mai namu wa firistoci. Za mu kuma kawo zakkar hatsinmu wa Lawiyawa, gama Lawiyawa ne ke karɓan Zakka cikin dukan garuruwan da muke noma.
english: and that we should bring the first fruits of our dough, our wave offerings, the fruit of all kinds of trees, and the new wine and the oil, to the priests, to the rooms of the house of our God; and the tithes of our ground to the Levites; for they, the Levites, take the tithes in all our farming villages.

hausa: Sa’ad da ya yi tsawa ruwan da suke sammai sukan yi ruri; yakan sa gizagizai su tashi daga ƙarshen duniya. Yakan tura walƙiya tare da ruwan sama yakan kuma saki iska daga cikin taskokinsa.
english: When he utters his voice, there is a roar of waters in the heavens, and he causes the vapors to ascend from the ends of the earth. He makes lightning for the rain, and brings the wind out of his treasuries.

hausa: Amma kada ka kashe su, ya Ubangiji garkuwarmu, in ba haka mutanena za su manta. Cikin ikonka ka sa su yi ta yawo barkatai, ka kuma kawar da su.
english: Don’t kill them, or my people may forget. Scatter them by your power, and bring them down, Lord our shield.

hausa: Yesu kuwa yana can baya, yana barci a kan katifa. Sai almajiran suka tashe shi suka ce masa, “Malam, ba ka kula ba ko mu nutse?”
english: He himself was in the stern, asleep on the cushion; and they woke him up and asked him, “Teacher, don’t you care that we are dying?”

hausa: “Abu biyu ina roƙonka, ya Ubangiji; kada ka hana ni kafin in mutu.
english: “Two things I have asked of you. Don’t deny me before I die.

hausa: “A bisa teburin Burodin Ajiyewa, za su shimfiɗa zane mai ruwan shuɗi, a kansa kuma su sa farantai, kwanoni da manyan kwanoni, da tuluna don hadayun sha; da burodin da zai ci gaba da kasancewa a kansa.
english: “On the table of show bread they shall spread a blue cloth, and put on it the dishes, the spoons, the bowls, and the cups with which to pour out; and the continual bread shall be on it.

hausa: Nan take sai ga mutane Isra’ila suna zuwa wurin sarki, suna cewa, “Don me ’yan’uwanmu, mutanen Yahuda, suka saci sarki, suka kawo shi da iyalinsa a ƙetaren Urdun, tare da dukan mutanensa?”
english: Behold, all the men of Israel came to the king, and said to the king, “Why have our brothers the men of Judah stolen you away, and brought the king and his household, over the Jordan, and all David’s men with him?”

hausa: Amma Lawiyawa za su kafa sansaninsu kewaye da tabanakul na Shaida. Don kada fushi yă fāɗo a kan al’ummar Isra’ilawa. Hakkin Lawiyawa ne su kula da tabanakul na Shaida.”
english: But the Levites shall encamp around the Tabernacle of the Testimony, that there may be no wrath on the congregation of the children of Israel. The Levites shall be responsible for the Tabernacle of the Testimony.”

hausa: Ya Ubangiji, har yaushe za ka ci gaba da zuba ido kawai? Ka kuɓutar da raina daga farmakinsu, raina mai daraja daga waɗannan zakoki.
english: Lord, how long will you look on? Rescue my soul from their destruction, my precious life from the lions.

hausa: Sai ya ce wa itacen, “Kada kowa yă ƙara cin ’ya’yanka.” Almajiransa kuwa suka ji ya faɗi haka.
english: Jesus told it, “May no one ever eat fruit from you again!” and his disciples heard it.

hausa: Ya rufe fuskar wata, ya shimfiɗa gizagizai a kan shi,
english: He encloses the face of his throne, and spreads his cloud on it.

hausa: Yanzu ku gafarta mini zunubina a wannan karo, ku kuma yi addu’a ga Ubangiji Allahnku yă ɗauke wannan muguwar annoba daga gare ni.”
english: Now therefore please forgive my sin again, and pray to Yahweh your God, that he may also take away from me this death.”

hausa: haka ma ƙofofin ɗakunan a wajen kudu. Akwai ƙofa a farkon hanyar da ta yi hannun riga da ɗayan katangar da ta miƙe wajen gabas, inda za a iya shiga ɗakunan.
english: Like the doors of the rooms that were toward the south was a door at the head of the way, even the way directly before the wall toward the east, as one enters into them.

hausa: Sa’a ta uku na safe ce kuwa aka gicciye shi.
english: It was the third hour when they crucified him.

hausa: waɗansu kuma suna cewa, annabi Iliya ne ya sāke bayyana. Waɗansu kuma har wa yau, suna cewa, ɗaya daga cikin annabawa na dā ne, ya tashi.
english: and by some that Elijah had appeared, and by others that one of the old prophets had risen again.

hausa: Amma in firist ɗin ya bincike shi bai kuwa ga wani farin gashi a wurin ba, in kuma bai yi zurfi fiye da fatar jikin ba, ya kuma bushe, to, firist ɗin zai kaɗaice shi na kwana bakwai.
english: But if the priest examines it, and behold, there is no white hair in the bright spot, and it isn’t deeper than the skin, but has faded, then the priest shall isolate him seven days.
