hausa: Sai dukan jama’ar Isra’ilawa suka janye daga fuskar Musa,
english: All the congregation of the children of Israel departed from the presence of Moses.

hausa: Amma ta yaya zai huta sa’ad da Ubangiji ya umarta, sa’ad da ya umarta shi don yă faɗa wa Ashkelon da kuma bakin teku?”
english: “How can you be quiet, since Yahweh has given you a command? Against Ashkelon, and against the seashore, there he has appointed it.”

hausa: Igal, ɗan Natan mutumin Zoba, ɗan Hagiri,
english: Igal the son of Nathan of Zobah, Bani the Gadite,

hausa: Ku yanka ragunan Bikin Ƙetarewa, ku tsarkake kanku, ku kuma shirya raguna domin ’yan’uwanku, kuna yin abin da Ubangiji ya umarta ta wurin Musa.”
english: Kill the Passover lamb, sanctify yourselves, and prepare for your brothers, to do according to Yahweh’s word by Moses.”

hausa: Firistoci da Lawiyawa daga dukan yankuna ko’ina a Isra’ila suka haɗa kai da shi.
english: The priests and the Levites who were in all Israel stood with him out of all their territory.

hausa: Ubangiji ya ce wa Musa,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

hausa: Gama ya riga ya cece mu daga mulkin duhu ya kuma kawo mu cikin mulkin Ɗan da yake ƙauna,
english: who delivered us out of the power of darkness, and translated us into the Kingdom of the Son of his love,

hausa: Ya sāke cewa, “In mutum arba’in kaɗai aka samu a can fa?” Ya ce, “Saboda mutum arba’in ɗin, ba zan aikata ba.”
english: He spoke to him yet again, and said, “What if there are forty found there?” He said, “I will not do it for the forty’s sake.”

hausa: Suka bi ta ƙasar tudu ta Efraim, suka ratsa ta ƙasar Shalisha amma ba su same su ba. Suka bi ta ƙasar Shalim, a can ma ba su same su ba sai suka bi ta ƙasar Benyamin, a can ma ba su same su ba.
english: He passed through the hill country of Ephraim, and passed through the land of Shalishah, but they didn’t find them. Then they passed through the land of Shaalim, and they weren’t there. Then he passed through the land of the Benjamites, but they didn’t find them.

hausa: ya kuma fitar da mutanen da suke can, ya sa su aiki da zartuna da makamai masu kaifi da kuma gatura. Dawuda ya yi haka da dukan garuruwan Ammonawa. Sa’an nan Dawuda da mayaƙansa gaba ɗaya suka koma Urushalima.
english: He brought out the people who were in it, and had them cut with saws, with iron picks, and with axes. David did so to all the cities of the children of Ammon. Then David and all the people returned to Jerusalem.

hausa: A duk lokacin da kuke tsaye cikin addu’a, in kuna riƙe da wani mutum a zuciyarku, ku gafarta masa, domin Ubanku da yake sama shi ma yă gafarta muku zunubanku.”
english: Whenever you stand praying, forgive, if you have anything against anyone; so that your Father, who is in heaven, may also forgive you your transgressions.

hausa: Bayan wannan sai Yesu ya zazzaga gari da ƙauye, yana wa’azin bisharar mulkin Allah. Sha Biyun nan kuwa suna tare da shi,
english: Soon afterwards, he went about through cities and villages, preaching and bringing the good news of God’s Kingdom. With him were the twelve,

hausa: “ ‘Ba ka taɓa ji ba? Tun da daɗewa na ƙaddara haka. Tuntuni kuwa na shirya shi; yanzu kuma na sa ya faru, cewa ka mai da birane masu katanga tarin duwatsu.
english: Haven’t you heard how I have done it long ago, and formed it of ancient times? Now I have brought it to pass, that it should be yours to lay waste fortified cities into ruinous heaps.

hausa: Dole ne yă yi ta ƙaruwa, ni kuma in yi ta raguwa.
english: He must increase, but I must decrease.

hausa: Jikina da zuciyata za su iya raunana, amma Allah ne ƙarfin zuciyata da kuma rabona har abada.
english: My flesh and my heart fails, but God is the strength of my heart and my portion forever.

hausa: Sai Ubangiji Allah ya sa wata ’yar kuringa ta tsiro, ta yi girma a inda Yunana yake, don ta inuwantar da shi, yă ji daɗi. Yunana kuwa ya yi murna matuƙa da wannan kuringa.
english: Yahweh God prepared a vine and made it to come up over Jonah, that it might be a shade over his head to deliver him from his discomfort. So Jonah was exceedingly glad because of the vine.

hausa: A shekara ta huɗu, dukan ’ya’yansu za su zama tsarkakakku, hadaya ta yabo ga Ubangiji.
english: But in the fourth year all its fruit shall be holy, for giving praise to Yahweh.

hausa: Zan tafa hannuwana, fushina kuwa zai sauka. Ni Ubangiji na faɗa.”
english: I will also strike my hands together, and I will cause my wrath to rest. I, Yahweh, have spoken it.”

hausa: Ya yi ginshiƙan tagulla, kowanne tsayinsa kamu goma sha takwas, ya kuma yi guru mai kamu goma sha biyu, kewaye da shi.
english: For he fashioned the two pillars of bronze, eighteen cubits high apiece; and a line of twelve cubits encircled either of them.

hausa: Muka kuwa amsa, ‘Muna da mahaifi tsoho, akwai kuma ɗa matashi, wanda aka haifa masa cikin tsufarsa. Ɗan’uwansa ya rasu, shi ne kuwa ɗa kaɗai na mahaifiyarsa da ya rage, mahaifinsa kuwa yana ƙaunarsa.’
english: We said to my lord, ‘We have a father, an old man, and a child of his old age, a little one; and his brother is dead, and he alone is left of his mother; and his father loves him.’

hausa: Gama sun tsananta wa waɗanda ka hukunta suna kuma taɗin wahalar waɗanda ka ji musu rauni.
english: For they persecute him whom you have wounded. They tell of the sorrow of those whom you have hurt.

hausa: Ya naɗa alƙalai a kowanne daga cikin biranen katanga na Yahuda a ƙasar.
english: He set judges in the land throughout all the fortified cities of Judah, city by city,

hausa: Ubangiji ya ce, “Ga shi, zan zuga ruhun mai hallakarwa a kan Babilon da mutanen Leb Kamai.
english: Yahweh says: “Behold, I will raise up against Babylon, and against those who dwell in Lebkamai, a destroying wind.

hausa: Amma ga waɗanda suke sonkai waɗanda suke ƙin gaskiya suke kuma bin mugunta, akwai fushi da haushi dominsu.
english: but to those who are self-seeking and don’t obey the truth, but obey unrighteousness, will be wrath, indignation,

hausa: Sa’ad da al’amura suke tafiya daidai, ka yi farin ciki, amma sa’ad da suka lalace, ka tuna, Allah ne ya yi wancan shi ne kuma ya yi wannan. Saboda haka, mutum ba zai san wani abu game da nan gabansa ba.
english: In the day of prosperity be joyful, and in the day of adversity consider; yes, God has made the one side by side with the other, to the end that man should not find out anything after him.

hausa: Waɗannan su ne garuruwan da kabilar Benyamin suke da su na gādo. Yeriko, Bet-Hogla, Emek Keziz,
english: Now the cities of the tribe of the children of Benjamin according to their families were Jericho, Beth Hoglah, Emek Keziz,

hausa: Amma kai, ya Allah, kana gani wahala da baƙin ciki; kana lura da yadda suke ɗaukansu a hannu. Marar taimako kan danƙa kansa gare ka; kai ne mai taimakon marayu
english: But you do see trouble and grief. You consider it to take it into your hand. You help the victim and the fatherless.

hausa: Amma yana jin daɗin bin dokar Ubangiji, kuma yana ta nazarinta dare da rana.
english: but his delight is in Yahweh’s law. On his law he meditates day and night.

hausa: Maryamu Magdalin da Maryamu uwar Yusuf sun ga inda aka kwantar da shi.
english: Mary Magdalene and Mary the mother of Joses, saw where he was laid.

hausa: Na san Efraim ƙaf; Isra’ila ba a ɓoye take a gare ni ba. Efraim, yanzu ka juya ka shiga karuwanci; Isra’ila ta lalace.
english: I know Ephraim, and Israel is not hidden from me; for now, Ephraim, you have played the prostitute. Israel is defiled.

hausa: Sa’ad da Rut ta koma wurin surukarta Na’omi ta tambaye ta “Yaya aka yi ’yata?” Sai ta faɗa mata dukan abin da Bowaz ya yi mata
english: When she came to her mother-in-law, she said, “How did it go, my daughter?” She told her all that the man had done for her.

hausa: Zan kuma naɗa shi ɗan farina, mafi ɗaukaka cikin sarakunan duniya.
english: I will also appoint him my firstborn, the highest of the kings of the earth.

hausa: A ranar ashirin da huɗu ga watan tara, a shekara ta biyu ta mulkin Dariyus, maganar Ubangiji ta zo wa annabi Haggai cewa,
english: In the twenty-fourth day of the ninth month, in the second year of Darius, Yahweh’s word came by Haggai the prophet, saying,

hausa: Saboda haka bawansa ya fitar da ita, ya kuma sa aka rufe ƙofa. Tana sanye da doguwar riga mai kayan ado masu tsada, gama wannan ne irin kayan da budurwai ’ya’yan sarki mata suke sawa.
english: She had a garment of various colors on her, for the king’s daughters who were virgins dressed in such robes. Then his servant brought her out and bolted the door after her.

hausa: Matar, da yake ta san abin da ya faru da ita, sai ta zo ta durƙusa a gabansa, da tsoro da rawan jiki, ta kuma gaya masa dukan abin da ya faru.
english: But the woman, fearing and trembling, knowing what had been done to her, came and fell down before him, and told him all the truth.

hausa: Bayan wannan Ayuba ya buɗe baki ya la’anta ranar da aka haife shi.
english: After this Job opened his mouth, and cursed the day of his birth.

hausa: Bayan ya haifi Nahor, Serug ya yi shekara 200, ya kuma haifi waɗansu ’ya’ya maza da mata.
english: Serug lived two hundred years after he became the father of Nahor, and became the father of more sons and daughters.

hausa: To, fa, don me kuke ƙoƙari ku gwada Allah ta wurin ɗora wa almajiran nan kayan da mu ko kakanninmu ba mu iya ɗauka ba?
english: Now therefore why do you tempt God, that you should put a yoke on the neck of the disciples which neither our fathers nor we were able to bear?

hausa: A wannan lokaci sai Yesu ya ce wa taron, “Ina jagoran wani tawaye ne, da kuka fito da takuba da kuma sanduna domin ku kama ni? Kowace rana ina zama a filin haikali ina koyarwa, ba ku kuwa kama ni ba.
english: In that hour Jesus said to the multitudes, “Have you come out as against a robber with swords and clubs to seize me? I sat daily in the temple teaching, and you didn’t arrest me.

hausa: An zaɓe shi kafin halittar duniya, amma an bayyana shi a zamanin ƙarshe saboda ku.
english: who was foreknown indeed before the foundation of the world, but was revealed in this last age for your sake,

hausa: sai ko wannan abu ɗaya kaɗai da na ɗaga murya na faɗi yayinda nake tsaye a gabansu cewa, ‘A game da tashin matattu ake mini shari’a a gabanku yau.’ ”
english: unless it is for this one thing that I cried standing among them, ‘Concerning the resurrection of the dead I am being judged before you today!’”

hausa: Mun ji labari a kansu, hannuwanmu kuwa suka yi laƙwas. Azaba ta kama mu, zafi kamar na mace mai naƙuda.
english: We have heard its report. Our hands become feeble. Anguish has taken hold of us, and pains as of a woman in labor.

hausa: ya aika manzanni su zo da Bala’am ɗan Beyor, wanda yake a Fetor, kusa da Kogi, a ƙasar haihuwarsa. Balak ya ce, “Ga mutane sun fito daga Masar; sun mamaye ƙasar, suka kuma yi sansani kusa da ni.
english: He sent messengers to Balaam the son of Beor, to Pethor, which is by the River, to the land of the children of his people, to call him, saying, “Behold, there is a people who came out of Egypt. Behold, they cover the surface of the earth, and they are staying opposite me.

hausa: ka kuma sa kome a ƙarƙashin ƙafafunsa.” Ta wurin sa kome a ƙarƙashinsa, Allah bai bar wani abu da bai sa a ƙarƙashinsa ba. Duk da haka a yanzu ba mu ga kowane abu a ƙarƙashinsa ba.
english: You have put all things in subjection under his feet.” For in that he subjected all things to him, he left nothing that is not subject to him. But now we don’t yet see all things subjected to him.

hausa: Ka ba wa mutane waɗannan umarnai, ka ce, ‘Kuna gab da wucewa cikin yankin ’yan’uwanku, zuriyar Isuwa, wanda yake zama a Seyir. Za su ji tsoronku, amma ku yi hankali
english: Command the people, saying, ‘You are to pass through the border of your brothers, the children of Esau, who dwell in Seir; and they will be afraid of you. Therefore be careful.

hausa: Yana da mata biyu, ɗaya sunanta Hannatu, ɗayan kuwa ana kiranta Feninna. Ita Feninna tana da ’ya’ya, amma Hannatu ba ta da ’ya’ya.
english: He had two wives. The name of one was Hannah, and the name of the other Peninnah. Peninnah had children, but Hannah had no children.

hausa: Yakan ba da ƙarfi ga waɗanda suka gaji yă kuma ƙara ƙarfi ga marasa ƙarfi.
english: He gives power to the weak. He increases the strength of him who has no might.

hausa: Amma sa’ad da ya janye hannunsa, sai ɗan’uwansa ya fito, sai ta ce, “Wato, haka ne ka keta ka fito!” Sai aka ba shi suna Ferez.
english: As he drew back his hand, behold, his brother came out, and she said, “Why have you made a breach for yourself?” Therefore his name was called Perez.

hausa: Sai ɗaya daga cikin masanan dokoki ya ce wa Yesu, “Malam, in ka faɗi waɗannan abubuwa haka, kai kuma ka zage mu ke nan.”
english: One of the lawyers answered him, “Teacher, in saying this you insult us also.”

hausa: Ibrahim ya ce wa bayinsa, “Ku tsaya a nan da jakin, ni da yaron kuwa mu haura can. Za mu yi sujada sa’an nan mu komo wurinku.”
english: Abraham said to his young men, “Stay here with the donkey. The boy and I will go over there. We will worship, and come back to you.”

hausa: Dubi yadda abokan gābanka suke fariya, dubi yadda maƙiyanka suke ɗaga kansu.
english: For, behold, your enemies are stirred up. Those who hate you have lifted up their heads.

hausa: Sai Musa ya fita ya kuma faɗa waɗannan kalmomi ga dukan Isra’ila cewa,
english: Moses went and spoke these words to all Israel.

hausa: Ko da yake Ubangiji yana bisa, yakan dubi kāsassu, amma tun da nesa ya san masu girman kai.
english: For though Yahweh is high, yet he looks after the lowly; but he knows the proud from afar.

hausa: Ta wurina sarakuna suke mulki masu mulki kuma suke yin dokokin da suke da adalci;
english: By me kings reign, and princes decree justice.

hausa: ta Hashum 328
english: The children of Hashum: three hundred twenty-eight.

hausa: Sarki ya yi amfani da gungumen algum don matakalan haikalin Ubangiji da kuma na fadan sarki, ya kuma yi garayu da molaye don mawaƙa. Ba a taɓa gani irinsu a Yahuda ba.)
english: The king used algum tree wood to make terraces for Yahweh’s house and for the king’s house, and harps and stringed instruments for the singers. There were none like these seen before in the land of Judah.

hausa: Sun yi kuka gare ka suka kuma sami ceto; a gare ka suka dogara kuma ba su sha kunya ba.
english: They cried to you, and were delivered. They trusted in you, and were not disappointed.

hausa: firist zai bincike mikin, in ya yi zurfi fiye da fatar jiki, gashin ya zama rawaya, ya kuma zama siriri, firist zai furta wannan mutum marar tsarki; ƙaiƙayi ne, cuta mai yaɗuwa ce na kai ko na gemu.
english: then the priest shall examine the plague; and behold, if its appearance is deeper than the skin, and the hair in it is yellow and thin, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean. It is an itch. It is leprosy of the head or of the beard.

hausa: Ya kuwa ba da umarni a tsai da keken yaƙin. Sa’an nan da Filibus da bābān suka gangara zuwa cikin ruwan Filibus kuwa ya yi masa baftisma.
english: He commanded the chariot to stand still, and they both went down into the water, both Philip and the eunuch, and he baptized him.

hausa: Ku sa rai ga Ubangiji da kuma ƙarfinsa; ku nemi fuskarsa kullum.
english: Seek Yahweh and his strength. Seek his face forever more.

hausa: Zan kawar da jini daga bakinsu, zan kuma cire abincin da aka haramta daga tsakanin haƙoransu. Waɗanda za a bari za su zama na Allahnmu, su kuma zama shugabanni a Yahuda, Ekron kuma za tă zama kamar Yebusiyawa.
english: I will take away his blood out of his mouth, and his abominations from between his teeth; and he also will be a remnant for our God; and he will be as a chieftain in Judah, and Ekron as a Jebusite.

hausa: Amma da suka gaskata da Filibus sa’ad da yake wa’azin labari mai daɗi na mulkin Allah da kuma sunan Yesu Kiristi, sai aka yi musu baftisma, maza da mata.
english: But when they believed Philip preaching good news concerning God’s Kingdom and the name of Jesus Christ, they were baptized, both men and women.

hausa: Ka yanka ragon, ka ɗibi jinin, ka yayyafa shi kewaye da gefen bagaden.
english: You shall kill the ram, and you shall take its blood, and sprinkle it around on the altar.

hausa: Ko da ka daka wawa a turmi, kana daka shi kamar hatsi da taɓarya, ba za ka fid da wauta daga gare shi ba.
english: Though you grind a fool in a mortar with a pestle along with grain, yet his foolishness will not be removed from him.

hausa: amma Allah ya tashe shi daga matattu a rana ta uku, ya sa kuma aka gan shi.
english: God raised him up the third day and gave him to be revealed,

hausa: Bayan da aka sa Yohanna a kurkuku, sai Yesu ya shigo cikin Galili, yana shelar bisharar Allah.
english: Now after John was taken into custody, Jesus came into Galilee, preaching the Good News of God’s Kingdom,

hausa: da na ukun suka aure ta. Haka nan dukansu bakwai suka mutu babu ’ya’ya.
english: The third took her, and likewise the seven all left no children, and died.

hausa: Wannan kuwa ita ce shaidar; cewa Allah ya ba mu rai madawwami, wannan rai kuwa yana cikin Ɗansa.
english: The testimony is this: that God gave to us eternal life, and this life is in his Son.

hausa: Kada ku ɗaga ƙahoninku gāba da sama; kada ku yi magana da miƙaƙƙen wuya.’ ”
english: Don’t lift up your horn on high. Don’t speak with a stiff neck.”

hausa: Horonmu, daidai aka yi mana, sakamakon abin da muka yi ne. Amma wannan mutum, bai yi wani laifi ba.”
english: And we indeed justly, for we receive the due reward for our deeds, but this man has done nothing wrong.”

hausa: Ba a daɗe ba bayan annabi Hananiya ya karya karkiya daga wuyan annabi Irmiya, sai maganar Ubangiji ta zo wa Irmiya cewa,
english: Then Yahweh’s word came to Jeremiah, after Hananiah the prophet had broken the bar from off the neck of the prophet Jeremiah, saying,

hausa: da fata zan rura kabilata a ta kowace hanya su ji kishi har ma yă sa in ceci waɗansunsu.
english: if by any means I may provoke to jealousy those who are my flesh, and may save some of them.

hausa: Saboda haka za a tanada ɗan rago da hadaya ta gari da kuma mai kowace safiya don hadaya ta ƙonawa ta kullum.
english: Thus they shall prepare the lamb, the meal offering, and the oil, morning by morning, for a continual burnt offering.”

hausa: Waɗannan su ne ruwan Meriba, inda Isra’ilawa suka yi wa Ubangiji gunaguni, inda kuma ya nuna kansa mai tsarki a cikinsu.
english: These are the waters of Meribah; because the children of Israel strove with Yahweh, and he was sanctified in them.

hausa: Ya sa daro tsakanin Tentin Sujada da bagade, ya kuma zuba ruwa a cikinsa don wanki,
english: He set the basin between the Tent of Meeting and the altar, and put water therein, with which to wash.

hausa: Dukan maza daga shekara talatin zuwa hamsin waɗanda sukan zo hidimar aiki a Tentin Sujada,
english: from thirty years old and upward even to fifty years old, everyone who entered into the service for work in the Tent of Meeting.

hausa: Bari kowane firist yă karɓi kuɗi daga masu ajiya, sa’an nan a yi amfani da su a gyara duk wani abin da ya lalace a haikali.”
english: let the priests take it to them, each man from his donor; and they shall repair the damage to the house, wherever any damage is found.”

hausa: Kai ka zama mafakar matalauta, mafaka don mabukata cikin damuwa, wurin ɓuya daga hadari, inuwa kuma daga zafin rana. Gama numfashin mugaye yana kamar da hadari mai bugun bango
english: For you have been a stronghold to the poor, a stronghold to the needy in his distress, a refuge from the storm, a shade from the heat, when the blast of the dreaded ones is like a storm against the wall.

hausa: manyan firistoci da malaman dokoki kuma suna neman yadda za su kashe Yesu a ɓoye, don suna tsoron mutane.
english: The chief priests and the scribes sought how they might put him to death, for they feared the people.

hausa: “Za ku kasance mutanena masu tsarki. Saboda kada ku ci naman da namun jeji suka kashe; ku jefa wa karnuka.
english: “You shall be holy men to me, therefore you shall not eat any meat that is torn by animals in the field. You shall cast it to the dogs.

hausa: Ya ma fi kyau ka sami hikima fiye da zinariya, ka zaɓi fahimi a maimakon azurfa!
english: How much better it is to get wisdom than gold! Yes, to get understanding is to be chosen rather than silver.

hausa: Yabo ga Ubangiji Allahnka, wanda ya ji daɗinka, ya kuma sa ka a kujerar sarautar Isra’ila. Ubangiji ya naɗa ka sarki saboda madawwamiyar ƙaunar wa Isra’ila, don ka yi shari’a da adalci.”
english: Blessed is Yahweh your God, who delighted in you, to set you on the throne of Israel. Because Yahweh loved Israel forever, therefore he made you king, to do justice and righteousness.”

hausa: a can kuma zan sadu da Isra’ilawa, in kuma tsarkake wurin da ɗaukakata.
english: There I will meet with the children of Israel; and the place shall be sanctified by my glory.

hausa: Wannan shi ne wanda nake nufi sa’ad da na ce, ‘Mutum mai zuwa bayana ya fi ni girma, domin yana nan kafin ni.’
english: This is he of whom I said, ‘After me comes a man who is preferred before me, for he was before me.’

hausa: Sa’ad da mazaunan Yabesh Gileyad suka ji dukan abin da Filistiyawa suka yi wa Shawulu,
english: When all Jabesh Gilead heard all that the Philistines had done to Saul,

hausa: Ɗana, ka ba ni zuciyarka bari kuma idanunka su kiyaye hanyoyina,
english: My son, give me your heart; and let your eyes keep in my ways.

hausa: Dawuda ya tambaye shi ya ce, “Daga ina ka fito?” Ya amsa ya ce, “Na tsere ne daga sansanin Isra’ila.”
english: David said to him, “Where do you come from?” He said to him, “I have escaped out of the camp of Israel.”

hausa: Da suka ƙetare tafkin, almajiran sun manta su riƙe burodi.
english: The disciples came to the other side and had forgotten to take bread.

hausa: Za a jera manyan duwatsu jeri uku, da jeri ɗaya na katako. Daga asusun sarki kuma za a biya kuɗin aikin.
english: with three courses of great stones and a course of new timber. Let the expenses be given out of the king’s house.

hausa: Ka ji mu, ya Ubangiji! Har yaushe zai ci gaba? Ka ji tausayin bayinka.
english: Relent, Yahweh! How long? Have compassion on your servants!

hausa: Ya ke ƙasa, ƙasa, ƙasa, ki ji maganar Ubangiji!
english: O earth, earth, earth, hear Yahweh’s word!

hausa: Ya yi wa haikalin ado da duwatsu masu daraja. Zinariyar da ya yi amfani da su kuwa zinariya Farwayim ne.
english: He decorated the house with precious stones for beauty. The gold was gold from Parvaim.

hausa: Yonatan ya tashi daga tebur cin abincin da fushi. A rana ta biyun kuwa bai ci abinci ba, gama yana baƙin ciki game da rashin kunyar mahaifinsa game da Dawuda.
english: So Jonathan arose from the table in fierce anger, and ate no food the second day of the month; for he was grieved for David, because his father had treated him shamefully.

hausa: Bayan haka, ya bayyana ga fiye da ɗari biyar daga cikin ’yan’uwa a lokaci guda. Yawancinsu kuwa suna nan da rai, ko da yake waɗansu sun riga sun yi barci.
english: Then he appeared to over five hundred brothers at once, most of whom remain until now, but some have also fallen asleep.

hausa: Ubangiji zai shari’anta mutanensa yă kuma ji tausayin bayinsa sa’ad da ya ga ƙarfinsu ya ƙare babu kowa kuma da ya rage, bawa ko ’yantacce.
english: For Yahweh will judge his people, and have compassion on his servants, when he sees that their power is gone, that there is no one remaining, shut up or left at large.

hausa: Saboda haka, bai danganta ga sha’awar mutum ko ƙoƙarinsa ba, sai dai ga jinƙan Allah.
english: So then it is not of him who wills, nor of him who runs, but of God who has mercy.

hausa: Nabal ya ce wa mutanen Dawuda, “Wane ne wannan Dawuda? Wane ne wannan ɗan Yesse? Yawancin bayi suna tayar wa iyayengijinsu a kwanakin nan.
english: Nabal answered David’s servants and said, “Who is David? Who is the son of Jesse? There are many servants who break away from their masters these days.

hausa: Da farko dai, dole ku fahimci wannan cewa a kwanakin ƙarshe masu ba’a za su zo suna ba’a, suna bin mugayen sha’awace-sha’awacensu.
english: knowing this first, that in the last days mockers will come, walking after their own lusts

hausa: Haka muka yi ta shan bugun guguwar hadarin nan kashegari suka fara jajjefar da kayan da jirgin yake ɗauke da su a cikin teku.
english: As we labored exceedingly with the storm, the next day they began to throw things overboard.

hausa: Sarki yana da jerin jiragen ruwa na kasuwanci waɗanda mutanen Hiram ne suke kula da su. Sau ɗaya kowace shekara uku sukan dawo ɗauke da zinariya, azurfa, hauren giwa, gogo da kuma birai.
english: For the king had ships that went to Tarshish with Huram’s servants. Once every three years, the ships of Tarshish came bringing gold, silver, ivory, apes, and peacocks.

hausa: ’Ya’yanka maza za su maye matsayin kakanninka; za ka sa su yi mulki a duk fāɗin ƙasar.
english: Your sons will take the place of your fathers. You shall make them princes in all the earth.

hausa: Isra’ilawan da suka kasance a can suka yi Bikin Ƙetarewa a wannan rana, suka kuma kiyaye Bikin Burodi Marar Yisti kwana bakwai.
english: The children of Israel who were present kept the Passover at that time, and the feast of unleavened bread seven days.

hausa: A ranar da aka keɓe su, Ubangiji ya umarta cewa Isra’ilawa su ba da wannan a gare su a matsayin rabonsu na kullum, a dukan tsararraki masu zuwa.
english: which Yahweh commanded to be given them of the children of Israel, in the day that he anointed them. It is their portion forever throughout their generations.

hausa: Kaiton waɗanda suke zuwa manyan zurfafa don su ɓoye shirye-shiryensu daga Ubangiji, waɗanda suke aikinsu cikin duhu su yi tunani, “Wa yake ganinmu? Wa zai sani?”
english: Woe to those who deeply hide their counsel from Yahweh, and whose deeds are in the dark, and who say, “Who sees us?” and “Who knows us?”

hausa: Fiye da kome duka, ka tsare zuciyarka, gama maɓulɓulan ruwan rijiyar rai ne.
english: Keep your heart with all diligence, for out of it is the wellspring of life.

hausa: Bai bar wani ya zalunce su ba; saboda su ya tsawata wa sarakuna.
english: He allowed no man to do them wrong. Yes, he reproved kings for their sakes,

hausa: A Hebron ya yi mulki a bisa Yahuda shekara bakwai da wata shida, a Urushalima kuma ya yi mulki a bisa Isra’ila da Yahuda shekara talatin da uku.
english: In Hebron he reigned over Judah seven years and six months, and in Jerusalem he reigned thirty-three years over all Israel and Judah.

hausa: Da suka kai masussukar Nakon, sai Uzza ya miƙa hannu don yă riƙe akwatin alkawarin Allah, gama shanun sun yi tuntuɓe.
english: When they came to the threshing floor of Nacon, Uzzah reached for God’s ark and took hold of it, for the cattle stumbled.

hausa: alkawarin da ya yi da Ibrahim, rantsuwar da ya yi wa Ishaku.
english: the covenant which he made with Abraham, his oath to Isaac,

hausa: ’Yan’uwan da suke can sun sami labari cewa muna zuwa, sai suka tashi tun daga Kasuwar Affiyus da Masauƙi Uku don su tarye mu. Da ganin mutanen nan sai Bulus ya gode wa Allah ya kuma sami ƙarfafawa.
english: From there the brothers, when they heard of us, came to meet us as far as The Market of Appius and The Three Taverns. When Paul saw them, he thanked God and took courage.

hausa: Sarkin Masar ya tumɓuke shi a Urushalima, ya tilasta Yahuda su biya haraji talenti ɗari na azurfa da kuma talentin zinariya.
english: The king of Egypt removed him from office at Jerusalem, and fined the land one hundred talents of silver and a talent of gold.

hausa: Ba shakka zan tā da hannuna a kansu domin bayinsu su washe su. Sa’an nan za ku san cewa Ubangiji Maɗaukaki ne ya aiko ni.
english: For, behold, I will shake my hand over them, and they will be a plunder to those who served them; and you will know that Yahweh of Armies has sent me.

hausa: Gama raunin Samariya ba mai warkewa ba ne; ya bazu har Yahuda. Ya ma kai bakin ƙofar mutanena, har ma Urushalima da kanta.
english: For her wounds are incurable; for it has come even to Judah. It reaches to the gate of my people, even to Jerusalem.

hausa: Azariya ɗan Natan, shi ne mai lura da shugabannin yanki. Zabud ɗan Natan, shi ne firist da kuma mai wa sarki shawara.
english: Azariah the son of Nathan was over the officers; Zabud the son of Nathan was chief minister, the king’s friend;

hausa: An gina katangar birnin a kan tushen gini goma sha biyu, a kansu kuwa akwai sunayen manzannin sha biyu na Ɗan Ragon.
english: The wall of the city had twelve foundations, and on them twelve names of the twelve Apostles of the Lamb.

hausa: Ga maganar Ubangiji da ya yi ta wurin Irmiya annabi game da Babilon da kuma ƙasar Babiloniyawa.
english: The word that Yahweh spoke concerning Babylon, concerning the land of the Chaldeans, by Jeremiah the prophet.

hausa: “ ‘Yanzu ku fita zuwa Shilo inda na fara maishe shi wurin zama don Sunana, ku ga abin da na yi masa saboda muguntar mutanen Isra’ila.
english: “But go now to my place which was in Shiloh, where I caused my name to dwell at the first, and see what I did to it for the wickedness of my people Israel.

hausa: domin ina tsoron taron mutane kuma ina tsoron wulaƙancin da dangina za su yi mini, sai na yi shiru kuma ban fita waje ba.
english: because I feared the great multitude, and the contempt of families terrified me, so that I kept silence, and didn’t go out of the door—

hausa: Sai suka tuna da maganarsa.
english: They remembered his words,

hausa: da Amaziya, da Azariya, da Yotam,
english: Amaziah his son, Azariah his son, Jotham his son,

hausa: Ko da yake Yusuf ya gane ’yan’uwansa, su ba su gane shi ba.
english: Joseph recognized his brothers, but they didn’t recognize him.

hausa: Musa ya ce wa mutanen Gad da mutanen Ruben, “Wato, sai ’yan’uwanku su yi ta yaƙi ku kuwa ku zauna nan?
english: Moses said to the children of Gad, and to the children of Reuben, “Shall your brothers go to war while you sit here?

hausa: Bet-Lebayot da Sharuhen, garuruwa goma sha uku ke nan da ƙauyukansu.
english: Beth Lebaoth, and Sharuhen; thirteen cities with their villages;

hausa: shanun da aka yi kiwo a gida guda goma, shanu ashirin da suka ƙoshi daga kiwo, tumaki da awaki ɗari; ban da ƙishimai, bareyi, batsiyoyi, da kaji masu ƙiba.
english: ten head of fat cattle, twenty head of cattle out of the pastures, and one hundred sheep, in addition to deer, gazelles, roebucks, and fattened fowl.

hausa: ya kuwa yi toho ya zama kuringa gajeruwa mai yaɗuwa. Rassanta suka tanƙwasa wajen gaggafar, amma saiwoyinta suka zauna a ƙarƙashinta. Ta haka ta zama kuringa, ta yi rassa ta kuma fid da ganyaye.
english: It grew and became a spreading vine of low stature, whose branches turned toward him, and its roots were under him. So it became a vine, produced branches, and shot out sprigs.

hausa: A ƙarshe, ’yan’uwa, mun umarce ku yadda za ku yi rayuwa domin ku gamshi Allah, kamar yadda kuke yi. Yanzu muna roƙonku muna kuma gargaɗe ku a cikin Ubangiji Yesu ku yi haka sau da sau.
english: Finally then, brothers, we beg and exhort you in the Lord Jesus, that as you received from us how you ought to walk and to please God, that you abound more and more.

hausa: aikin zānen furannin zinariya da fitilu da abin ɗiban wuta (an yi su da zinariya zalla);
english: and the flowers, the lamps, and the tongs of gold that was purest gold;

hausa: Duk mai kunnen ji, yă ji.
english: He who has ears to hear, let him hear.

hausa: Saboda haka ya ɗauke shi zuwa filin Zofim a ƙwanƙolin Fisga, a can ya gina bagadai bakwai, ya kuma miƙa bijimi da rago a kan kowane bagade.
english: He took him into the field of Zophim, to the top of Pisgah, and built seven altars, and offered up a bull and a ram on every altar.

hausa: Sai Musa ya je ya ɗauki sandan kamar yadda Ubangiji ya umarce shi.
english: Moses took the rod from before Yahweh, as he commanded him.

hausa: Wa zai kawo wani zargi a kan waɗanda Allah ya zaɓa? Allah ne mai kuɓutarwa.
english: Who could bring a charge against God’s chosen ones? It is God who justifies.

hausa: Sauƙinkai da tsoron Ubangiji sukan kawo wadata da girmamawa da kuma rai.
english: The result of humility and the fear of Yahweh is wealth, honor, and life.

hausa: Har ya zama kamar wannan bai isa ba a gabanka, ya Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka, ka kuma yi magana game da nan gaba na gidan bawanka. Haka ka saba yi da mutane, ya Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka?
english: This was yet a small thing in your eyes, Lord Yahweh, but you have spoken also of your servant’s house for a great while to come; and this among men, Lord Yahweh!

hausa: Da ya iso sai ga Eli zaune a kujera kusa da hanya yana kallo, domin tsoron da yake da shi saboda akwatin alkawarin Allah. Da mutumin ya shigo a garin ya ba da labarin abin da ya faru sai dukan gari ya ruɗe da ihu.
english: When he came, behold, Eli was sitting on his seat by the road watching, for his heart trembled for God’s ark. When the man came into the city and told about it, all the city cried out.

hausa: Wannan wasiƙa za tă faɗa muku kaɗan game da yadda Allah ya bayyana mini shirinsa na asiri.
english: how that by revelation the mystery was made known to me, as I wrote before in few words,

hausa: ‘Ko da a ce Balak zai ba ni gidansa cike da azurfa da zinariya, ba zan yi wani abu ko kaɗan saɓanin umarnin Ubangiji Allahna ba, kuma dole in faɗa abin da Ubangiji ya ce ne kawai’?
english: ‘If Balak would give me his house full of silver and gold, I can’t go beyond Yahweh’s word, to do either good or bad from my own mind. I will say what Yahweh says’?

hausa: Fushin sarki yana kama da rurin zaki, amma tagomashinsa yana kama da raba a kan ciyawa.
english: The king’s wrath is like the roaring of a lion, but his favor is like dew on the grass.

hausa: Zuriyar Elkana su ne, Amasai, Ahimot,
english: The sons of Elkanah: Amasai and Ahimoth.

hausa: Ina aikansa shi a gare ku musamman domin ku san yadda muke, yă kuma ƙarfafa muku zuciya.
english: I am sending him to you for this very purpose, that he may know your circumstances and comfort your hearts,

hausa: Firistoci, annabawa da dukan mutane suka ji Irmiya yana waɗannan maganganu a gidan Ubangiji.
english: The priests and the prophets and all the people heard Jeremiah speaking these words in Yahweh’s house.

hausa: Maƙwabtanta da ’yan’uwanta suka ji cewa Ubangiji ya nuna mata jinƙai mai yawa, suka kuma taya ta farin ciki.
english: Her neighbors and her relatives heard that the Lord had magnified his mercy toward her, and they rejoiced with her.

hausa: “Sa’an nan ya ce wa bayinsa, ‘Bikin aure fa ya shiryu, sai dai mutanen da na gayyata ba su dace ba.
english: “Then he said to his servants, ‘The wedding is ready, but those who were invited weren’t worthy.

hausa: Damuwoyin zuciyata sun ninka; ka ’yantar da ni daga wahalata.
english: The troubles of my heart are enlarged. Oh bring me out of my distresses.

hausa: Sauran ayyukan mulkinsa da dukan hanyoyinsa, daga farko zuwa ƙarshe, suna a rubuce a littafin sarakunan Yahuda da Isra’ila.
english: Now the rest of his acts, and all his ways, first and last, behold, they are written in the book of the kings of Judah and Israel.

hausa: Bayan dukan abin da Hezekiya ya yi cikin aminci, sai Sennakerib sarkin Assuriya ya zo ya yaƙi Yahuda. Ya yi kwanto wa biranen katanga, yana zato zai ci su da yaƙi wa kansa.
english: After these things and this faithfulness, Sennacherib king of Assyria came, entered into Judah, encamped against the fortified cities, and intended to win them for himself.

hausa: In kuma idonka yana sa ka zunubi, ƙwaƙule shi ka yar. Zai fiye maka ka shiga rai da ido ɗaya, da ka shiga jahannama ta wuta da idanunka biyu.
english: If your eye causes you to stumble, pluck it out and cast it from you. It is better for you to enter into life with one eye, rather than having two eyes to be cast into the Gehenna of fire.

hausa: Ka tuna da mutanen da ka saya tun da daɗewa, kabilar gādonka, wadda ka fansa, Dutsen Sihiyona, inda ka zauna.
english: Remember your congregation, which you purchased of old, which you have redeemed to be the tribe of your inheritance: Mount Zion, in which you have lived.

hausa: Duk sukan karai; suna zuwa da rawan jiki daga mafakansu.
english: The foreigners shall fade away, and shall come trembling out of their strongholds.

hausa: Masu albarka ne sa’ad da mutane suka ƙi ku, suka ware ku, suka zage ku, suna ce da ku mugaye, saboda Ɗan Mutum.
english: Blessed are you when men hate you, and when they exclude and mock you, and throw out your name as evil, for the Son of Man’s sake.

hausa: Efron ya ce wa Ibrahim,
english: Ephron answered Abraham, saying to him,

hausa: dubi Ibrahim, mahaifinku, da Saratu, wadda ta haife ku. Sa’ad da na kira shi kaɗai ne, na kuma albarkace shi na kuma mai da shi da yawa.
english: Look to Abraham your father, and to Sarah who bore you; for when he was but one I called him, I blessed him, and made him many.

hausa: Har wa yau, Yesu ya fara koyarwa a bakin tafki. Domin taron da yake kewaye da shi mai girma ne sosai, sai ya shiga cikin jirgin ruwa, ya zauna a ciki a tafkin, dukan mutanen kuwa suna a gaɓar ruwan.
english: Again he began to teach by the seaside. A great multitude was gathered to him, so that he entered into a boat in the sea and sat down. All the multitude were on the land by the sea.

hausa: Haka fa Hagar ta haifa wa Abram ɗa, Abram kuwa ya ba da suna Ishmayel ga ɗan da ta haifa.
english: Hagar bore a son for Abram. Abram called the name of his son, whom Hagar bore, Ishmael.

hausa: Dawuda ya ce wa Abishai, “Ina gani Sheba ɗan Bikri zai ba mu wuya fiye da Absalom. Ka ɗauki mutanen maigidanka ka fafare shi, don kada yă sami garuruwa masu katanga yă tsere mana.”
english: David said to Abishai, “Now Sheba the son of Bichri will do us more harm than Absalom did. Take your lord’s servants and pursue after him, lest he get himself fortified cities, and escape out of our sight.”

hausa: Ka sa bagaden a gaban labulen da yake gaban akwatin alkawari, a gaba murfin kafara wanda yake bisa akwatin alkawari, inda zan sadu da kai.
english: You shall put it before the veil that is by the ark of the covenant, before the mercy seat that is over the covenant, where I will meet with you.

hausa: Zan yi hadayar godiya gare ka in kuma kira bisa sunan Ubangiji.
english: I will offer to you the sacrifice of thanksgiving, and will call on Yahweh’s name.

hausa: Kowace a cikin halittu huɗu masu rai ɗin nan tana da fikafikai guda shida, tana kuma cike da idanu a ko’ina, har ma ƙarƙashin fikafikanta. Dare da rana ba sa fasa cewa,
english: The four living creatures, each one of them having six wings, are full of eyes around and within. They have no rest day and night, saying, “Holy, holy, holy is the Lord God, the Almighty, who was and who is and who is to come!”

hausa: Buɗe ƙofofinki, ya Lebanon, don wuta ta cinye itatuwan al’ul naki.
english: Open your doors, Lebanon, that the fire may devour your cedars.

hausa: Da yake da yawa cikin taron ba su tsarkake kansu ba, dole Lawiyawa su yanka ’yan ragunan Bikin Ƙetarewa domin dukan waɗanda ba su da tsarki, ba su kuma iya tsarkake ragunansu ga Ubangiji ba.
english: For there were many in the assembly who had not sanctified themselves; therefore the Levites were in charge of killing the Passovers for everyone who was not clean, to sanctify them to Yahweh.

hausa: Sa’ad da ya yi haka, sa’an nan Ɗan kansa yă koma a ƙarƙashin shi wanda ya sa kome a ƙarƙashinsa, domin Allah yă zama kome da kome.
english: When all things have been subjected to him, then the Son will also himself be subjected to him who subjected all things to him, that God may be all in all.

hausa: Amma fa, za ku iya sassare itatuwan da kuka sani ba sa ba da ’ya’ya, ku kuma yi amfani da su don ayyukan gina ƙawanyar, sai an ci birnin da yaƙi.
english: Only the trees that you know are not trees for food, you shall destroy and cut them down. You shall build bulwarks against the city that makes war with you, until it falls.

hausa: Sa’ad da dukan Masar ta fara jin yunwa, sai mutane suka yi wa Fir’auna kuka don abinci. Sai Fir’auna ya ce wa dukan Masarawa, “Ku tafi wurin Yusuf, ku kuma yi abin da ya faɗa muku.”
english: When all the land of Egypt was famished, the people cried to Pharaoh for bread, and Pharaoh said to all the Egyptians, “Go to Joseph. What he says to you, do.”

hausa: Ko da yake gaskiya ne ni dangi ne na kusa, amma akwai dangi mai fansa mafi kusa fiye da ni.
english: Now it is true that I am a near kinsman. However, there is a kinsman nearer than I.

hausa: Efraim za tă zama kango a ranar hukunci. A cikin kabilan Isra’ila na yi shelar abin da yake tabbatacce.
english: Ephraim will become a desolation in the day of rebuke. Among the tribes of Israel, I have made known that which will surely be.

hausa: Ka dubi Assuriya, ta taɓa zama kamar al’ul a Lebanon da rassa masu kyau suna inuwartar da kurmi; ya yi tsayi ainun kansa ya kai cikin gizagizai.
english: Behold, the Assyrian was a cedar in Lebanon with beautiful branches, and with a forest-like shade, of high stature; and its top was among the thick boughs.

hausa: Sojojin sarkin Babilon a lokacin suna ƙawanya wa Urushalima annabi Irmiya kuwa yana a tsare a sansanin matsara a fadar Yahuda.
english: Now at that time the king of Babylon’s army was besieging Jerusalem. Jeremiah the prophet was shut up in the court of the guard, which was in the king of Judah’s house.

hausa: Ubangiji ya ce wa Musa,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

hausa: Ban da haka, maganar Ubangiji ta zo ta wurin annabi Yehu ɗan Hanani wa Ba’asha da gidansa, saboda dukan muguntar da ya aikata a gaban Ubangiji, ya tsokane shi yă yi fushi ta wurin abubuwan da ya yi, da kuma zama kamar gidan Yerobowam, da kuma domin ya hallaka gidan Yerobowam.
english: Moreover Yahweh’s word came by the prophet Jehu the son of Hanani against Baasha and against his house, both because of all the evil that he did in Yahweh’s sight, to provoke him to anger with the work of his hands, in being like the house of Jeroboam, and because he struck him.

hausa: saboda haka Dawuda ya nemi nufin Ubangiji ya ce, “In tafi in kai wa Filistiya hari? Za ka bashe su a hannuna?” Ubangiji ya amsa masa ya ce, “Je ka, gama tabbatacce zan bashe Filistiyawa a hannunka.”
english: David inquired of Yahweh, saying, “Shall I go up against the Philistines? Will you deliver them into my hand?” Yahweh said to David, “Go up; for I will certainly deliver the Philistines into your hand.”

hausa: An gina Urushalima kamar birnin da aka yi a harhaɗe wuri guda.
english: Jerusalem is built as a city that is compact together,

hausa: Wanda yake da nisa zai mutu da annoba, shi da yake kusa kuma zai mutu ta takobi, wanda kuma ya tsira aka kuma bari zai mutu da yunwa. Ta haka zan aukar da fushina a kansu.
english: He who is far off will die of the pestilence. He who is near will fall by the sword. He who remains and is besieged will die by the famine. Thus I will accomplish my wrath on them.

hausa: Ku ɗauki wani akwati ku sa siffofin zinariyan nan a ciki, waɗanda za su zama kyautai na shafen laifi, ku ajiye kusa da Akwati na UBANGIJI. Bayan haka sai ku sa keken shanun da akwatin a hanya, ku bar shi yă tafi.
english: and take Yahweh’s ark and lay it on the cart. Put the jewels of gold, which you return him for a trespass offering, in a box by its side; and send it away, that it may go.

hausa: Zadok firist ya ɗauki ƙahon mai daga tenti mai tsarki, ya shafe Solomon. Sa’an nan suka busa ƙaho, sai dukan mutane suka yi ihu, suna cewa “Ran Sarki Solomon yă daɗe!”
english: Zadok the priest took the horn of oil from the Tent, and anointed Solomon. They blew the trumpet; and all the people said, “Long live King Solomon!”

hausa: Mun san cewa dukan halitta tana nishi sai ka ce mace mai naƙuda har yă zuwa wannan lokaci.
english: For we know that the whole creation groans and travails in pain together until now.

hausa: Keyila, Akzib, Maresha, garuruwa tara ke nan da ƙauyukansu.
english: Keilah, Achzib, and Mareshah; nine cities with their villages.

hausa: Sa’an nan ɗayansu ya ce, “Lalle zan komo wurinka war haka shekara mai zuwa. Saratu matarka kuwa za tă haifi ɗa.” Saratu kuwa tana a bayansu tana ji daga mashigin tenti.
english: He said, “I will certainly return to you at about this time next year; and behold, Sarah your wife will have a son.” Sarah heard in the tent door, which was behind him.

hausa: Hezekiya ya karɓi jakadun, ya nuna musu dukan abin da yake a ɗakunan ajiyarsa, azurfa, zinariya, kayan ƙanshi da mai, wurin ajiye makamansa da kuma dukan abin da aka samu a ɗakin ajiyarsa. Babu wani abu a fadansa ko a dukan mulkinsa da Hezekiya bai nuna musu ba.
english: Hezekiah listened to them, and showed them all the storehouse of his precious things—the silver, the gold, the spices, and the precious oil, and the house of his armor, and all that was found in his treasures. There was nothing in his house, or in all his dominion, that Hezekiah didn’t show them.

hausa: Dole a fara gwada su tukuna; sa’an nan in ba a sami wani abin zargi game da su ba, sai su shiga aikin masu hidima.
english: Let them also first be tested; then let them serve if they are blameless.

hausa: Daga cikin mutanen da suka leƙo asirin ƙasar, Yoshuwa ɗan Nun, da Kaleb ɗan Yefunne ne, kaɗai suka rayu.
english: But Joshua the son of Nun and Caleb the son of Jephunneh remained alive of those men who went to spy out the land.

hausa: Ka ƙosar da mu da safe da ƙaunarka marar ƙarewa, don mu rera don yabo, mu kuma yi murna dukan kwanakinmu.
english: Satisfy us in the morning with your loving kindness, that we may rejoice and be glad all our days.

hausa: Sai ga mutum biyu, Musa da Iliya, suka bayyana cikin kyakkyawar daraja, suna magana da Yesu.
english: Behold, two men were talking with him, who were Moses and Elijah,

hausa: Na fitar da ku daga ƙasar Masar, na kuma bishe ku tsawon shekaru arba’in a cikin hamada don in ba ku ƙasar Amoriyawa.
english: Also I brought you up out of the land of Egypt and led you forty years in the wilderness, to possess the land of the Amorite.

hausa: Allah na Ibrahim, Ishaku, da Yaƙub, Allah na kakanninmu, ya ɗaukaka bawansa Yesu. Ku kuka ba da shi domin a kashe, kuka yi mūsun saninsa a gaban Bilatus, ko da yake ya yi niyya ya sake shi.
english: The God of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, the God of our fathers, has glorified his Servant Jesus, whom you delivered up and denied in the presence of Pilate, when he had determined to release him.

hausa: Sai Hezekiya sarkin Yahuda ya aika saƙo ga sarkin Assuriya a Lakish cewa, “Na yi laifi, ka janye daga gare ni, zan kuma biya ka duk abin da ake bukata daga gare ni.” Sarkin Assuriya ya karɓi talenti ɗari uku na azurfa, da talenti talatin na zinariya daga hannun Hezekiya sarkin Yahuda.
english: Hezekiah king of Judah sent to the king of Assyria at Lachish, saying, “I have offended you. Withdraw from me. That which you put on me, I will bear.” The king of Assyria appointed to Hezekiah king of Judah three hundred talents of silver and thirty talents of gold.

hausa: ɗan Yesse, ɗan Obed, ɗan Bowaz, ɗan Salmon, ɗan Nashon,
english: the son of Jesse, the son of Obed, the son of Boaz, the son of Salmon, the son of Nahshon,

hausa: Filistiyawa suka yi tambaya suka ce, “Wane ne ya yi wannan abu?” Sai aka ce musu, “Ai, Samson ne surukin mutumin Timna, domin an ba wa abokinsa matarsa.” Saboda haka Filistiyawa suka haura suka je suka ƙone ta da mahaifinta ƙurmus da wuta.
english: Then the Philistines said, “Who has done this?” They said, “Samson, the son-in-law of the Timnite, because he has taken his wife and given her to his companion.” The Philistines came up, and burned her and her father with fire.

hausa: Duk wanda ya lura da itacen ɓaure, zai ci ’ya’yansa, kuma duk wanda ya lura da maigidansa za a girmama shi.
english: Whoever tends the fig tree shall eat its fruit. He who looks after his master shall be honored.

hausa: za su kiyaye ka daga mazinaciya, daga mace marar aminci da kalmominta masu ɗaukan hankali.
english: that they may keep you from the strange woman, from the foreigner who flatters with her words.

hausa: Sai Natan ya ce wa Dawuda, “Kai ne mutumin! Ga abin da Ubangiji, Allah ya ce, ‘Na naɗa ka sarki bisa Isra’ila, na kuma cece ka daga hannun Shawulu.
english: Nathan said to David, “You are the man! This is what Yahweh, the God of Israel, says: ‘I anointed you king over Israel, and I delivered you out of the hand of Saul.

hausa: Suka ƙetare tafkin suka je yankin Gerasenawa.
english: They came to the other side of the sea, into the country of the Gadarenes.

hausa: Mutumin nagari yakan nuna abubuwa nagari daga cikin nagarta da yake a ɓoye a zuciyarsa, mugun mutum kuwa yakan nuna mugayen abubuwa daga muguntar da take a ɓoye a zuciyarsa. Gama baki yakan faɗa abin da ya cika zuciya ne.”
english: The good man out of the good treasure of his heart brings out that which is good, and the evil man out of the evil treasure of his heart brings out that which is evil, for out of the abundance of the heart, his mouth speaks.

hausa: Da ya gane wannan, sai Yesu ya janye daga wurin. Da yawa suka bi shi, ya kuwa warkar da dukan masu ciwonsu,
english: Jesus, perceiving that, withdrew from there. Great multitudes followed him; and he healed them all,

hausa: Akwai makiyaya masu zama a fili kusa da wurin, suna tsaron garkunan tumakinsu da dare.
english: There were shepherds in the same country staying in the field, and keeping watch by night over their flock.

hausa: Sa’ad da nake tare da ku kuma nake zaman rashi, ban nawaita wa kowa ba, gama ’yan’uwan da suka zo daga Makidoniya sun biya bukata. Na kiyaye kaina daga nawaita muku ta kowace hanya, zan kuma ci gaba da yin haka.
english: When I was present with you and was in need, I wasn’t a burden on anyone, for the brothers, when they came from Macedonia, supplied the measure of my need. In everything I kept myself from being burdensome to you, and I will continue to do so.

hausa: (Barabbas yana kurkuku saboda laifin tā da hankali a birnin, da kuma don kisankai.)
english: one who was thrown into prison for a certain revolt in the city, and for murder.

hausa: raƙuma mata talatin tare da ƙananansu, shanu arba’in da bijimai goma, jakuna mata ashirin da kuma jakuna maza goma.
english: thirty milk camels and their colts, forty cows, ten bulls, twenty female donkeys and ten foals.

hausa: An ce ‘Allah yana tara wa ’ya’yan mutum horon da zai ba mutumin.’ Bari yă ba mutumin horo don yă san ya yi haka!
english: You say, ‘God lays up his iniquity for his children.’ Let him recompense it to himself, that he may know it.

hausa: Ku fara kaɗe-kaɗe, ku buga ganga, ku kaɗa garaya da molo masu daɗi.
english: Raise a song, and bring here the tambourine, the pleasant lyre with the harp.

hausa: Fir’auna ya ce wa Musa, “Fita, ka ba ni wuri! Ka mai da hankali, kada ka ƙara bayyana a gabana, gama ran da ka sāke ganin fuskata, a ran nan za ka mutu.”
english: Pharaoh said to him, “Get away from me! Be careful to see my face no more; for in the day you see my face you shall die!”

hausa: “A wannan dare, zan ratsa Masar, in bugi kowane ɗan fari, na mutum da na dabba, zan kuma hukunta dukan gumakan Masar. Ni ne Ubangiji.
english: For I will go through the land of Egypt in that night, and will strike all the firstborn in the land of Egypt, both man and animal. I will execute judgments against all the gods of Egypt. I am Yahweh.

hausa: Da yake kun dogara ga ayyukanku da arzikinku, ku ma za a kwashe ku bayi, Kemosh zai tafi bauta, tare da firistocinsa da fadawansa.
english: For, because you have trusted in your works and in your treasures, you also will be taken. Chemosh will go out into captivity, his priests and his princes together.

hausa: Gama idanun Ubangiji suna a kan masu adalci kunnuwansa kuma suna jin addu’arsu, amma fuskar Ubangiji tana gāba da masu mugunta.”
english: For the eyes of the Lord are on the righteous, and his ears open to their prayer; but the face of the Lord is against those who do evil.”

hausa: Sai ta yi ciki ta kuma haifi ɗa ta ce, “Allah ya ɗauke mini kunyata.”
english: She conceived, bore a son, and said, “God has taken away my reproach.”

hausa: ya kuma kawo bunsuru ɗaya domin hadaya don zunubi;
english: one male goat for a sin offering;

hausa: Ga sunayen manzannin nan goma sha biyu, da fari, Siman (wanda ake kira Bitrus) da ɗan’uwansa Andarawus; Yaƙub ɗan Zebedi da ɗan’uwansa Yohanna;
english: Now the names of the twelve apostles are these. The first, Simon, who is called Peter; Andrew, his brother; James the son of Zebedee; John, his brother;

hausa: A wannan rana, a kowane wuri inda akwai kuringa dubu da kuɗinsu ya kai shekel dubu na azurfa, ƙayayyuwa da sarƙaƙƙiya ne kawai za su kasance a can.
english: It will happen in that day that every place where there were a thousand vines worth a thousand silver shekels, will be for briers and thorns.

hausa: Waɗansu suka sha ba’a da bulala, har da dauri da sarƙa, da kuma jefa su cikin kurkuku.
english: Others were tried by mocking and scourging, yes, moreover by bonds and imprisonment.

hausa: Sai ya naɗe naɗaɗɗen littafin ya mayar wa mai hidimar, ya kuma zauna. Dukan idanun waɗanda suke a majami’ar, suka koma a kansa.
english: He closed the book, gave it back to the attendant, and sat down. The eyes of all in the synagogue were fastened on him.

hausa: Yaƙub kuwa ya ruɗe Laban mutumin Aram da bai sanar da shi zai gudu ba.
english: Jacob deceived Laban the Syrian, in that he didn’t tell him that he was running away.

hausa: amma akwai ɗaukaka, girma da salama ga duk mutumin da yake aikata alheri, da farko Yahudawa, sa’an nan Al’ummai.
english: But glory, honor, and peace go to every man who does good, to the Jew first, and also to the Greek.

hausa: Asshur mahaifin Tekowa yana da mata biyu, Hela da Na’ara.
english: Ashhur the father of Tekoa had two wives, Helah and Naarah.

hausa: Amma godiya ga Allah don ko da yake a dā ku bayi ne ga ikon zunubi, da dukan zuciyarku kun yi biyayya ga irin koyarwar da aka danƙa muku.
english: But thanks be to God that, whereas you were bondservants of sin, you became obedient from the heart to that form of teaching to which you were delivered.

hausa: Ka ɗaura shi da igiyar ruwa bula domin a haɗa shi da rawani; zai kasance a gaban rawanin.
english: You shall put it on a lace of blue, and it shall be on the sash. It shall be on the front of the sash.

hausa: Sa’an nan Rahila ta ce, “Allah ya baratar da ni; ya saurari roƙona ya kuma ba ni ɗa.” Saboda wannan ta ba shi suna Dan.
english: Rachel said, “God has judged me, and has also heard my voice, and has given me a son.” Therefore she called his name Dan.

hausa: Ka ji roƙona, “Kada ka toshe kunnuwanka ka ƙi jin roƙona na neman taimako.”
english: You heard my voice: “Don’t hide your ear from my sighing, and my cry.”

hausa: Balle fa, sa’ad da mugayen mutane suka kashe marar laifi a gidansa, a bisa gadonsa, ashe, ba zan nemi jininsa daga hannunku in kawar da ku a duniya ba!”
english: How much more, when wicked men have slain a righteous person in his own house on his bed, should I not now require his blood from your hand, and rid the earth of you?”

hausa: To, Iliya mutumin Tishbe, daga Tishbe a Gileyad, ya ce wa Ahab, “Muddin Ubangiji, Allah na Isra’ila wanda nake bauta wa yana a raye, ba za a yi raɓa ko ruwan sama a ’yan shekaru masu zuwa ba, sai ko na faɗa haka.”
english: Elijah the Tishbite, who was one of the settlers of Gilead, said to Ahab, “As Yahweh, the God of Israel, lives, before whom I stand, there shall not be dew nor rain these years, but according to my word.”

hausa: Sai ya ci gaba da cewa, “Kada ka ji tsoro, Daniyel. Gama tun daga ran da ka fara sa zuciya ga neman ganewa, ka kuma ƙasƙantar da kanka a gaban Allahnka, an ji addu’arka, amsar addu’arka ce ta kawo ni.
english: Then he said to me, “Don’t be afraid, Daniel; for from the first day that you set your heart to understand, and to humble yourself before your God, your words were heard. I have come for your words’ sake.

hausa: Daga Sarid, ta juya gabas zuwa harabar Kislot Tabor, ta kuma wuce zuwa Daberat har zuwa Yafiya.
english: It turned from Sarid eastward toward the sunrise to the border of Chisloth Tabor. It went out to Daberath, and went up to Japhia.

hausa: Mutane kan la’anci mai ɓoye hatsi yana jira ya yi tsada, amma albarka kan zauna a kan wanda yake niyya ya sayar.
english: People curse someone who withholds grain, but blessing will be on the head of him who sells it.

hausa: Ka faɗa wa wannan gidan ’yan tawaye wani misali ka kuma faɗa musu cewa, ‘Ga abin da Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka yana cewa, “ ‘Ka sa tukunyar dahuwa; ka sa ta a kan wuta ka kuma zuba ruwa a cikinta.
english: Utter a parable to the rebellious house, and tell them, ‘The Lord Yahweh says, “Put the cauldron on the fire. Put it on, and also pour water into it.

hausa: Ya yi abar ƙyama ƙwarai ta wurin bin gumaka, kamar Amoriyawan da Ubangiji ya kora a gaban Isra’ila.)
english: He did very abominably in following idols, according to all that the Amorites did, whom Yahweh cast out before the children of Israel.

hausa: Abokan gābana suna muguwar magana a kaina cewa, “Yaushe zai mutu sunansa yă ɓace ne?”
english: My enemies speak evil against me: “When will he die, and his name perish?”

hausa: A ƙarshe, macen ta mutu.
english: After them all, the woman died.

hausa: Da haka Isra’ilawa suka mallaki Midiyawa ba su kuma sāke tā da kai ba. A zamanin Gideyon ƙasar ta sami zaman lafiya har shekara arba’in.
english: So Midian was subdued before the children of Israel, and they lifted up their heads no more. The land had rest forty years in the days of Gideon.

hausa: Saboda haka ya kama hanya, a kan hanyarsa kuwa sai ya sadu da wani mutumin Itiyofiya, wanda yake bābā, hafsa mai muhimmanci wanda yake lura da dukan ma’ajin Kandas (wanda yake nufin “sarauniyar mutanen Itiyofiya”). Mutumin nan ya tafi Urushalima ne domin yin sujada,
english: He arose and went; and behold, there was a man of Ethiopia, a eunuch of great authority under Candace, queen of the Ethiopians, who was over all her treasure, who had come to Jerusalem to worship.

hausa: Haka ku ma, ku yi haƙuri, ku tsaya da ƙarfi, gama dawowar Ubangiji ya yi kusa.
english: You also be patient. Establish your hearts, for the coming of the Lord is at hand.

hausa: Yesu ya ce musu, “Ina tambayarku, me ya kamata a yi bisa ga doka, a ranar Asabbaci, a aikata alheri ko a aikata mugunta, a ceci rai, ko a hallaka shi?”
english: Then Jesus said to them, “I will ask you something: Is it lawful on the Sabbath to do good, or to do harm? To save a life, or to kill?”

hausa: Ni mutum ne mai salama; amma sa’ad da na yi magana, su sai su yi ta yaƙi.
english: I am for peace, but when I speak, they are for war.

hausa: “Ku tsaya a tsattsarkan wuri, bisa ga ƙungiyoyin gidajen kakannin ’yan’uwanku, waɗanda su ba firistoci ba ne. Kowanne ya sami kashi daga cikin gidan Lawiyawa.
english: Stand in the holy place according to the divisions of the fathers’ houses of your brothers the children of the people, and let there be for each a portion of a fathers’ house of the Levites.

hausa: Ga abin da Ubangiji yana cewa, ku yi hankali kada ku ɗauki kaya a ranar Asabbaci ko ku shigar da shi ta ƙofofin Urushalima.
english: Yahweh says, “Be careful, and bear no burden on the Sabbath day, nor bring it in by the gates of Jerusalem.

hausa: Da zinariya zalla suka yi fitilu bakwai, da hantsuka da farantansa.
english: He made its seven lamps, and its snuffers, and its snuff dishes, of pure gold.

hausa: Kuna jin tsoron takobi, kuma takobi ne zan kawo muku, in ji Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka.
english: You have feared the sword; and I will bring the sword on you,” says the Lord Yahweh.

hausa: Ba dukan nama ne iri ɗaya ba. Mutane da irin nasu, dabbobi da irin nasu, tsuntsaye da irin nasu, kifaye kuma da irin nasu.
english: All flesh is not the same flesh, but there is one flesh of men, another flesh of animals, another of fish, and another of birds.

hausa: Wannan jinina ne na sabon alkawari, wanda aka zubar saboda mutane da yawa, don gafarar zunubai.
english: for this is my blood of the new covenant, which is poured out for many for the remission of sins.

hausa: Sa’ad da Ubangiji yake ratsa ƙasar don yă bugi Masarawa, zai ga jinin a bisa da kuma gefen madogaran ƙofa, zai ƙetare ƙofar, ba zai bar mai hallakawa yă shiga gidajenku, yă buge ku ba.
english: For Yahweh will pass through to strike the Egyptians; and when he sees the blood on the lintel, and on the two door posts, Yahweh will pass over the door, and will not allow the destroyer to come in to your houses to strike you.

hausa: Tabbatacce fushinka a kan mutane kan jawo maka yabo, waɗanda suka tsira daga fushinka za su zama kamar rawaninka.
english: Surely the wrath of man praises you. The survivors of your wrath are restrained.

hausa: Mutumin da talauci ya sha kansa da ba zai iya miƙa irin hadayar nan ba kan zaɓi itacen da ba zai ruɓe ba. Yakan nemi gwanin sassaƙa don yă sassaƙa masa gunkin da ba zai fāɗi ba.
english: He who is too impoverished for such an offering chooses a tree that will not rot. He seeks a skillful workman to set up a carved image for him that will not be moved.

hausa: Daga sama Ubangiji ya duba ya kuwa ga dukan ’yan adam;
english: Yahweh looks from heaven. He sees all the sons of men.

hausa: Idan aka busa ƙaho a ciki birni mutane ba sa yin rawar jiki? Sa’ad da bala’i ya auko wa birni, ba Ubangiji ne ya sa a kawo shi ba?
english: Does the trumpet alarm sound in a city, without the people being afraid? Does evil happen to a city, and Yahweh hasn’t done it?

hausa: Ka kafa katakai shida don can ƙarshen katakan, wato, a wajen yamma na ƙarshen tabanakul,
english: For the far side of the tabernacle westward you shall make six boards.

hausa: Zai kāre marasa ƙarfi a cikin mutane yă kuma cece ’ya’yan masu bukata; zai murƙushe masu danniya.
english: He will judge the poor of the people. He will save the children of the needy, and will break the oppressor in pieces.

hausa: Musa ya faɗa wa Isra’ilawa wannan magana, amma ba su kasa kunne a gare shi ba, don ɓacin rai saboda tsananin aikin bauta.
english: Moses spoke so to the children of Israel, but they didn’t listen to Moses for anguish of spirit, and for cruel bondage.

hausa: Ya ce, “Ɗaya daga cikin Sha Biyun ne, wanda yake ci tare da ni a kwano.
english: He answered them, “It is one of the twelve, he who dips with me in the dish.

hausa: Ga abin da Ubangiji Maɗaukaki yana cewa, “Ku lura yanzu! Ku kira mata masu makoki su zo ku aika wa gwanaye a cikinsu su zo.
english: Yahweh of Armies says, “Consider, and call for the mourning women, that they may come. Send for the skillful women, that they may come.

hausa: ’Ya’yan Shobal maza su ne, Alwan, Manahat, Ebal, Shefo da Onam. ’Ya’yan Zibeyon maza su ne, Aiya da Ana.
english: The sons of Shobal: Alian, Manahath, Ebal, Shephi, and Onam. The sons of Zibeon: Aiah and Anah.

hausa: Yoshuwa da duk Isra’ilawa suka bari aka fafare su, sai suka gudu zuwa cikin jeji.
english: Joshua and all Israel made as if they were beaten before them, and fled by the way of the wilderness.

hausa: Ba cewa ina neman kyauta ba ne, sai dai ina neman abin da za a ƙara a kan ribarku.
english: Not that I seek for the gift, but I seek for the fruit that increases to your account.

hausa: Addu’ar Musa Mutumin Allah. Ubangiji kai ne mazauninmu cikin dukan zamanai.
english: A Prayer by Moses, the man of God. Lord, you have been our dwelling place for all generations.

hausa: Ruwan sama ya sauko, rafuffuka suka cika, iska kuma ta hura ta bugi gidan; duk da haka bai fāɗi ba, gama yana da harsashinsa a kan dutse.
english: The rain came down, the floods came, and the winds blew and beat on that house; and it didn’t fall, for it was founded on the rock.

hausa: Bari idanunka su buɗu ta wajen wannan haikali dare da rana, wannan wurin da ka ce za ka sa Sunanka a can. Bari ka ji addu’ar da bawanka ke yi ta wajen wannan wuri.
english: that your eyes may be open toward this house day and night, even toward the place where you have said that you would put your name, to listen to the prayer which your servant will pray toward this place.

hausa: Na ji kunya in roƙi sarki yă haɗa mu da sojoji da masu dawakai don su yi mana rakiya su kāre mu daga magabta a kan hanya, gama mun ce wa sarki, “Alherin Allah yana tare da duk wanda yake dogara gare shi, amma kuma fushinsa yana kan duk wanda ya juya masa baya.”
english: For I was ashamed to ask of the king a band of soldiers and horsemen to help us against the enemy on the way, because we had spoken to the king, saying, “The hand of our God is on all those who seek him, for good; but his power and his wrath is against all those who forsake him.”

hausa: “Saboda haka ka ce, ‘Ga abin da Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka yana cewa ko da yake na kore su zuwa cikin al’ummai na kuma warwatsa su cikin ƙasashe, duk da haka na zama wuri mai tsarki a gare su a ƙasashen da suka tafi.’
english: “Therefore say, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “Whereas I have removed them far off among the nations, and whereas I have scattered them among the countries, yet I will be to them a sanctuary for a little while in the countries where they have come.”’

hausa: Me ya sa, ya teku, kika gudu, Ya Urdun, ka juya baya,
english: What was it, you sea, that you fled? You Jordan, that you turned back?

hausa: Yaƙub ya bar Beyersheba ya kama hanyar Haran.
english: Jacob went out from Beersheba, and went toward Haran.

hausa: amma damuwar wannan duniya, da son dukiya, da kuma kwaɗayin waɗansu abubuwa, sukan shiga, su shaƙe maganar, har su mai da ita marar amfani.
english: and the cares of this age, and the deceitfulness of riches, and the lusts of other things entering in choke the word, and it becomes unfruitful.

hausa: Suna jin kunyar halinsu na banƙyama? A’a, ba sa jin kunya sam; ba su ma san yadda za su soke kai ba. Saboda haka za su fāɗi tare da fāɗaɗɗu; za a hamɓarar da su sa’ad da na hukunta su,” in ji Ubangiji.
english: Were they ashamed when they had committed abomination? No, they were not at all ashamed, neither could they blush. Therefore they will fall among those who fall. When I visit them, they will be cast down,” says Yahweh.

hausa: “Ku natsu ku kuma san cewa ni ne Allah; za a ɗaukaka ni a cikin al’ummai, za a ɗaukaka ni cikin duniya.”
english: “Be still, and know that I am God. I will be exalted among the nations. I will be exalted on the earth.”

hausa: Mala’ika na bakwai ya juye kwanonsa cikin iska, daga haikalin kuwa sai aka ji wata babbar murya daga kursiyin, tana cewa, “An gama!”
english: The seventh poured out his bowl into the air. A loud voice came out of the temple of heaven, from the throne, saying, “It is done!”

hausa: To, me za mu yi taƙama a kai? Babu wani abin da zamu yi taƙama a kai. A kan wace ƙa’ida ce za mu yi taƙama? Ta hanyar bin doka ne? A’a, sai dai ta wurin bangaskiya.
english: Where then is the boasting? It is excluded. By what kind of law? Of works? No, but by a law of faith.

hausa: Amma wane ne kai, ya mutum, da za ka mayar wa Allah magana? “Ashe, abin da aka gina zai iya ce wa wanda ya gina shi, ‘Don me ka gina ni haka?’ ”
english: But indeed, O man, who are you to reply against God? Will the thing formed ask him who formed it, “Why did you make me like this?”

hausa: “Ka ɗauki man shafewa ka shafe tabanakul da duka abin da yake cikinsa; ka keɓe shi da dukan kayayyakinsa, zai zama tsarkake.
english: “You shall take the anointing oil, and anoint the tabernacle and all that is in it, and shall make it holy, and all its furniture, and it will be holy.

hausa: Yezireyel, Yokdeyam, Zanowa,
english: Jezreel, Jokdeam, Zanoah,

hausa: Firist ɗin ba zai ƙasƙantar da tsarkakakkun hadayun da Isra’ilawa suka kawo ga Ubangiji
english: The priests shall not profane the holy things of the children of Israel, which they offer to Yahweh,

hausa: Sunayen mutanen Kohat kuwa su ne, Amram, Izhar, Hebron da Uzziyel.
english: The sons of Kohath by their families: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.

hausa: Yanzu kuma kuna niyya ku mai da maza da matan Yahuda da Urushalima bayinku. Amma ku ɗin ba ku da laifin zunubi ga Ubangiji Allahnku ne?
english: Now you intend to degrade the children of Judah and Jerusalem as male and female slaves for yourselves. Aren’t there even with you trespasses of your own against Yahweh your God?

hausa: Don haka ya ce zai hallaka su, amma Musa, zaɓaɓɓensa, ya yi godo a gabansa don yă kau da hasalarsa daga hallaka su.
english: Therefore he said that he would destroy them, had Moses, his chosen, not stood before him in the breach, to turn away his wrath, so that he wouldn’t destroy them.

hausa: Kun dogara ga takobinku, kuka aikata abubuwan banƙyama, kowannenku kuma ya ƙazantar da matar maƙwabcinsa. Kuna gani za ku mallaki ƙasar?’
english: You stand on your sword, you work abomination, and every one of you defiles his neighbor’s wife. So should you possess the land?”’

hausa: Yesu ya ce, “Ina gaya maka Bitrus, kafin zakara ya yi cara yau, za ka yi mūsun sanina sau uku.”
english: He said, “I tell you, Peter, the rooster will by no means crow today until you deny that you know me three times.”

hausa: Mulkin Yehoshafat kuwa ya zauna lafiya, gama Allahnsa ya ba shi hutu a kowane gefe.
english: So the realm of Jehoshaphat was quiet, for his God gave him rest all around.

hausa: Amma ku tafi ku gaya wa almajiransa da kuma Bitrus cewa, ‘Ya sha gabanku zuwa Galili. Can za ku gan shi, kamar yadda ya faɗa muku.’ ”
english: But go, tell his disciples and Peter, ‘He goes before you into Galilee. There you will see him, as he said to you.’”

hausa: Ba za ka yi sata ba.
english: “You shall not steal.

hausa: A filayen Mowab, wajen Urdun, ɗaura da Yeriko, Ubangiji ya yi magana da Musa ya ce,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho, saying,

hausa: sai Ubangiji ya ba da hutu ga sauran ’yan’uwanku, yadda ya yi da ku, su ma suka sami ƙasar da Ubangiji Allahnku yake ba su, a ƙetaren Urdun, sa’an nan kowannenku zai komo ga mallakar da na ba ku.”
english: until Yahweh gives rest to your brothers, as to you, and they also possess the land which Yahweh your God gives them beyond the Jordan. Then you shall each return to his own possession, which I have given you.”

hausa: To, da yake kun karɓi Kiristi Yesu a matsayin Ubangiji, sai ku ci gaba da rayuwa a cikinsa,
english: As therefore you received Christ Jesus the Lord, walk in him,

hausa: Sai Sarki Dariyus ya ba da umarnin a rubuce.
english: Therefore King Darius signed the writing and the decree.

hausa: waɗanda akwai mugayen dabaru a hannuwansu, waɗanda hannuwansu na dama suna cike da cin hanci.
english: in whose hands is wickedness; their right hand is full of bribes.

hausa: “Ka taɓa shiga rumbunan dusar ƙanƙara ko ka taɓa ganin rumbunan ƙanƙara
english: Have you entered the storehouses of the snow, or have you seen the storehouses of the hail,

hausa: Kesed, Hazo, Fildash; Yidlaf, da kuma Betuwel.”
english: Chesed, Hazo, Pildash, Jidlaph, and Bethuel.”

hausa: waɗanda suke barin miƙaƙƙun hanyoyi don su yi tafiya a hanyoyi masu duhu,
english: who forsake the paths of uprightness, to walk in the ways of darkness,

hausa: Na damu da ku kuma zan dube ku da tausayi; za ku nome ku kuma shuka,
english: For, behold, I am for you, and I will come to you, and you will be tilled and sown.

hausa: Sai maganar Ubangiji ta zo wa Solomon ta ce,
english: Yahweh’s word came to Solomon, saying,

hausa: saboda haka na haura ta kwarin da dad dare, ina dudduba katangar. A ƙarshe, na juya na sāke shiga ta Ƙofar Kwari.
english: Then I went up in the night by the brook and inspected the wall; and I turned back, and entered by the valley gate, and so returned.

hausa: Gaskiya nake gaya muku, duk wanda bai karɓi mulkin Allah kamar ƙaramin yaro ba, ba zai taɓa shiga mulkin ba.”
english: Most certainly I tell you, whoever will not receive God’s Kingdom like a little child, he will in no way enter into it.”

hausa: Da gari ya waye, sai na yi magana da mutane, da yamma kuwa matata ta rasu. Kashegari na yi yadda aka umarce ni.
english: So I spoke to the people in the morning, and at evening my wife died. So I did in the morning as I was commanded.

hausa: Sai ya dubi waɗanda suke zaune kewaye da shi ya ce, “Ga mahaifiyata da ’yan’uwana!
english: Looking around at those who sat around him, he said, “Behold, my mother and my brothers!

hausa: “Mafi albarka a ciki mata ta zama Yayel matar Heber Bakene, mafi albarka na mata masu zama a alfarma.
english: “Jael shall be blessed above women, the wife of Heber the Kenite; blessed shall she be above women in the tent.

hausa: Gidan Isra’ila da gidan Yahuda sun zama marasa aminci gaba ɗaya gare ni” in ji Ubangiji.
english: For the house of Israel and the house of Judah have dealt very treacherously against me,” says Yahweh.

hausa: Sai ya ce musu, “Wannan jinina ne na alkawari, wanda aka zubar da shi saboda mutane da yawa.
english: He said to them, “This is my blood of the new covenant, which is poured out for many.

hausa: An yi wannan Bikin Ƙetarewa a shekara ta goma sha takwas ta mulkin Yosiya.
english: This Passover was kept in the eighteenth year of the reign of Josiah.

hausa: Ai, ka gani cewa bangaskiyarsa da ayyukansa sun yi aiki tare, bangaskiyarsa kuma ta zama cikakkiya ta wurin abin da ya yi.
english: You see that faith worked with his works, and by works faith was perfected.

hausa: da abubuwa masu kyau da rana take kawo, da kuma abubuwa mafi kyau da wata zai iya haifar;
english: for the precious things of the fruits of the sun, for the precious things that the moon can yield,

hausa: Sai Yesu ya zo wurinsu ya ce, “An ba ni dukan iko a sama da kuma ƙasa.
english: Jesus came to them and spoke to them, saying, “All authority has been given to me in heaven and on earth.

hausa: Yawan mutanen sashensa 45,650 ne.
english: His division, and those who were counted of them, were forty-five thousand six hundred fifty.

hausa: Ka saye gaskiya kada kuwa ka sayar da ita; ka nemi hikima, horo da fahimi.
english: Buy the truth, and don’t sell it. Get wisdom, discipline, and understanding.

hausa: Wuta ta fito daga jikin rassanta ta cinye ’ya’yanta. Babu sauran reshe mai ƙarfin da ya rage a kanta da ya dace da sandar mai mulki.’ Wannan waƙa ce kuma za a yi amfani da ita a matsayin makoki.”
english: Fire has gone out of its branches. It has devoured its fruit, so that there is in it no strong branch to be a scepter to rule.’ This is a lamentation, and shall be for a lamentation.”

hausa: “ ‘Dole macen da zai aura ta kasance budurwa.
english: “‘He shall take a wife in her virginity.

hausa: “Ana da dama a yi kome” sai dai ba kome ba ne yake da amfani. “Ana da dama a yi kome” sai dai ba kome ba ne mai ginawa.
english: “All things are lawful for me,” but not all things are profitable. “All things are lawful for me,” but not all things build up.

hausa: Amma Isra’ila sun ƙi abin da yake mai kyau; abokin gāba zai fafare su.
english: Israel has cast off that which is good. The enemy will pursue him.

hausa: Bet-Zur, Soko, Adullam,
english: Beth Zur, Soco, Adullam,

hausa: To, bari ranka yă daɗe, sarkina yă kasa kunne yă ji abin da zan faɗa. Idan Ubangiji ne ya sa ka yi fushi da ni, bari yă karɓi hadaya ta hatsi. Amma idan mutane ne suka sa ka, bari a la’anta su, Ubangiji ne shaidata. Gama sun kore ni don kada in sami rabo cikin gādon Ubangiji, suna cewa, ‘Ka je ka bauta wa waɗansu alloli.’
english: Now therefore, please let my lord the king hear the words of his servant. If it is so that Yahweh has stirred you up against me, let him accept an offering. But if it is the children of men, they are cursed before Yahweh; for they have driven me out today that I shouldn’t cling to Yahweh’s inheritance, saying, ‘Go, serve other gods!’

hausa: Barzillai mutumin Gileyad shi ma ya zo daga Rogelim don yă ƙetare Urdun tare da sarki, yă kuma sallame shi daga can.
english: Barzillai the Gileadite came down from Rogelim; and he went over the Jordan with the king to conduct him over the Jordan.

hausa: Suna da wutsiyoyi da ƙari kamar kunamai, kuma a wutsiyoyinsu suna da iko su ba wa mutane azaba na wata biyar.
english: They have tails like those of scorpions, with stingers. In their tails they have power to harm men for five months.

hausa: Ku zaɓi waɗansu masu hikima, masu ganewa, da kuma mutanen da ake girmama daga kowace kabilarku, zan kuma sa su a kanku.”
english: Take wise men of understanding who are respected among your tribes, and I will make them heads over you.”

hausa: Babu hikima, babu tunani, babu shirin da zai yi nasara a kan Ubangiji.
english: There is no wisdom nor understanding nor counsel against Yahweh.

hausa: Amma ni ma ina da hankali kamar ku; ba ku fi ni ba. Wane ne bai san duk waɗannan abubuwan ba?
english: But I have understanding as well as you; I am not inferior to you. Yes, who doesn’t know such things as these?

hausa: Sa’an nan Samson ya ce, “Da muƙamuƙin jaki na mai da su jakuna. Da muƙamuƙin jaki na kashe mutum dubu.”
english: Samson said, “With the jawbone of a donkey, heaps on heaps; with the jawbone of a donkey I have struck a thousand men.”

hausa: Ya yi yaƙi da Filistiyawa ya kuma rushe katangar Gat, Yabne da kuma Ashdod. Sa’an nan ya sāke gina garuruwa kusa da Ashdod da sauran wurare a cikin Filistiyawa.
english: He went out and fought against the Philistines, and broke down the wall of Gath, the wall of Jabneh, and the wall of Ashdod; and he built cities in the country of Ashdod, and among the Philistines.

hausa: Wane ne zai iya rabe kurakuransa? Ya gafarta ɓoyayyun laifofinsa.
english: Who can discern his errors? Forgive me from hidden errors.

hausa: Sai Yesu ya ce wa manyan firistoci, da ma’aikatan ’yan gadin haikali, da dattawa, waɗanda suka zo don su kama shi, “Ina jagoran wani tawaye ne, da za ku zo da takuba da sanduna?
english: Jesus said to the chief priests, captains of the temple, and elders, who had come against him, “Have you come out as against a robber, with swords and clubs?

hausa: Ka sa mai tsaro a bakina, ya Ubangiji; ka yi tsaron ƙofar leɓunana.
english: Set a watch, Yahweh, before my mouth. Keep the door of my lips.

hausa: Sai Elifaz mutumin Teman ya amsa,
english: Then Eliphaz the Temanite answered,

hausa: Na umarta a tsarkake ɗakunan, sa’an nan na mayar da kayan gidan Allah a cikin ɗakunan, tare da hadayun hatsi da kuma turare.
english: Then I commanded, and they cleansed the rooms. I brought into them the vessels of God’s house, with the meal offerings and the frankincense again.

hausa: Da lokacin girbi ya yi, sai ya aiki wani bawa wajen ’yan hayan, don yă karɓo masa ’ya’yan inabin daga wurinsu.
english: When it was time, he sent a servant to the farmer to get from the farmer his share of the fruit of the vineyard.

hausa: An kawo ƙeraren azurfa daga Tarshish zinariya kuma daga Ufaz. Abin da gwani da maƙerin zinariya suka yi sa’an nan aka yi masa ado da mulufi da shunayya dukan aikin gwanaye.
english: There is silver beaten into plates, which is brought from Tarshish, and gold from Uphaz, the work of the engraver and of the hands of the goldsmith. Their clothing is blue and purple. They are all the work of skillful men.

hausa: A rana ta takwas sai suka yi taro, gama sun yi bikin keɓewar bagade na kwana bakwai da kuma biki na ƙarin kwana bakwai.
english: On the eighth day, they held a solemn assembly; for they kept the dedication of the altar seven days, and the feast seven days.

hausa: In ina iya yin magana da harsunan mutane, da na mala’iku, amma ba ni da ƙauna, na zama kamar kuge mai yawan ƙara, ko kuma ƙararrawa mai amo kawai.
english: If I speak with the languages of men and of angels, but don’t have love, I have become sounding brass or a clanging cymbal.
