hausa: Amma Edom ya amsa ya ce, “Ba za ku bi ta nan ba; in kuka kuskura, za mu fito, mu yaƙe ku da takobi.”
english: Edom said to him, “You shall not pass through me, lest I come out with the sword against you.”

hausa: Ku faɗa wa ’ya’yanku, bari kuma ’ya’yanku su faɗa wa ’ya’yansu, ’ya’yansu kuma su faɗa wa tsara ta gaba.
english: Tell your children about it, and have your children tell their children, and their children, another generation.

hausa: Salama na bari tare da ku; salamata nake ba ku. Ba kamar yadda duniya take bayarwa nake ba ku ba. Kada zuciyarku ta ɓaci kada kuma ku ji tsoro.
english: Peace I leave with you. My peace I give to you; not as the world gives, I give to you. Don’t let your heart be troubled, neither let it be fearful.

hausa: Ahaz ya huta tare da kakanninsa, aka kuma binne shi da su a Birnin Dawuda. Hezekiya ɗansa kuma ya gāje shi.
english: Ahaz slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in David’s city; and Hezekiah his son reigned in his place.

hausa: Da dare ya yi, sai ’yan’uwa suka sallami Bulus da Sila su tafi Bereya. Da suka isa can, sai suka shiga majami’ar Yahudawa.
english: The brothers immediately sent Paul and Silas away by night to Beroea. When they arrived, they went into the Jewish synagogue.

hausa: “Sau uku a shekara, maza duka za su bayyana a gaban Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka.
english: Three times in the year all your males shall appear before the Lord Yahweh.

hausa: Na tambayi mala’ikan da yake magana da ni na ce, “Ina za ku kai kwandon?”
english: Then I said to the angel who talked with me, “Where are these carrying the ephah basket?”

hausa: Bari Allah da kansa, Allah na salama, yă tsarkake ku sarai. Bari dukan ruhunku, ranku, da kuma jikinku su zama marar aibi a dawowar Ubangijinmu Yesu Kiristi.
english: May the God of peace himself sanctify you completely. May your whole spirit, soul, and body be preserved blameless at the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ.

hausa: Haka ma bangaskiya ita kaɗai, in ba tare da ayyuka ba, matacciya ce.
english: Even so faith, if it has no works, is dead in itself.

hausa: shi wannan ya zama firist ta wurin rantsuwar da Allah ya yi da ya ce masa, “Ubangiji ya rantse, ba kuwa zai canja zuciyarsa ba, ‘Kai firist ne na har abada.’ ”
english: (for they indeed have been made priests without an oath), but he with an oath by him that says of him, “The Lord swore and will not change his mind, ‘You are a priest forever, according to the order of Melchizedek.’”

hausa: Ubangiji zai fadada ikon sandan mulkinka daga Sihiyona za ka yi mulki a tsakiyar abokan gābanka.
english: Yahweh will send out the rod of your strength out of Zion. Rule among your enemies.

hausa: Shawulu ya ji tsoron Dawuda don Ubangiji yana tare da shi, amma Ubangiji ya riga ya bar Shawulu.
english: Saul was afraid of David, because Yahweh was with him, and had departed from Saul.

hausa: Ta sāke yin ciki, ta haifi wani ɗa, ta kira shi Onan.
english: She conceived again, and bore a son; and she named him Onan.

hausa: Ko kuwa in ya taɓa rashin tsabta na mutane, wani abin da zai sa shi rashin tsabta; ko da yake bai sani ba, sa’ad da ya gane, zai zama mai laifi.
english: “‘Or if he touches the uncleanness of man, whatever his uncleanness is with which he is unclean, and it is hidden from him; when he knows of it, then he shall be guilty.

hausa: Har yaushe, ya Ubangiji za ka ɓoye? Za ka ɓoye har abada ne? Har yaushe fushinka zai yi ta ci kamar wuta?
english: How long, Yahweh? Will you hide yourself forever? Will your wrath burn like fire?

hausa: Dukan Isra’ilawan da suka kai shekara ashirin ko fiye da suka isa shiga soja, an ƙidaya su bisa ga iyalansu.
english: So all those who were counted of the children of Israel by their fathers’ houses, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war in Israel—

hausa: “Amma a ce wannan ɗa yana da ɗa wanda ya ga dukan zunuban da mahaifinsa yake aikata, kuma ko da yake ya gan su, bai yi ko ɗaya daga cikin irin abubuwan nan ba, wato,
english: “Now, behold, if he fathers a son who sees all his father’s sins which he has done, and fears, and doesn’t do likewise,

hausa: Sarki Solomon ya yi suna a wadata fiye da dukan sarakunan duniya.
english: So King Solomon exceeded all the kings of the earth in riches and in wisdom.

hausa: In na sallame su gida da yunwa, za su kāsa a hanya, don waɗansu daga cikinsu sun zo daga nesa.”
english: If I send them away fasting to their home, they will faint on the way, for some of them have come a long way.”

hausa: Da yawan zinariya don wurin ajiye fitilan fitilu da fitilunsu, da yawan zinariyan da za a yi amfani don kowace fitila da wurin ajiye fitilanta; da kuma yawan azurfa don kowane wurin ajiye fitila da fitilunsa bisa ga yadda za a yi amfani da kowane wurin ajiye fitila;
english: by weight also for the lamp stands of gold, and for its lamps, of gold, by weight for every lamp stand and for its lamps; and for the lamp stands of silver, by weight for every lamp stand and for its lamps, according to the use of every lamp stand;

hausa: Duk da haka za a sami mutanen da za su ragu ’ya’ya maza da matan da za a fitar daga cikinta. Za su zo wurinka, kuma sa’ad da ka gan halinsu da ayyukansu, za ka ta’azantu game da bala’in da na kawo a kan Urushalima kowane bala’in da na kawo a kanta.
english: Yet, behold, there will be left a remnant in it that will be carried out, both sons and daughters. Behold, they will come out to you, and you will see their way and their doings. Then you will be comforted concerning the evil that I have brought on Jerusalem, even concerning all that I have brought on it.

hausa: Sai fushin Ubangiji ya ƙuna a kan Uzza, ya kuma buge shi domin ya sa hannunsa a kan akwatin alkawarin. Sai ya mutu a can a gaban Allah.
english: Yahweh’s anger burned against Uzza, and he struck him because he put his hand on the ark; and he died there before God.

hausa: Gama Hiridus da kansa ya ba da umarni a kama Yohanna, ya kuma sa aka daure shi, aka sa shi a kurkuku. Ya yi haka saboda Hiridiyas, matar ɗan’uwansa Filibus, wadda ya aura.
english: For Herod himself had sent out and arrested John and bound him in prison for the sake of Herodias, his brother Philip’s wife, for he had married her.

hausa: Kun yi niyya ku yi mini lahani, amma Allah ya nufe wannan ya zama alheri don yă cika abin da yanzu yake faruwa, ceton rayuka masu yawa.
english: As for you, you meant evil against me, but God meant it for good, to save many people alive, as is happening today.

hausa: Na amsa na ce, “Ranka yă daɗe, kai ka sani.” Sai ya ce, “Waɗannan su ne waɗanda suka fito daga matsananciyar wahala; sun wanke tufafinsu suka kuma mai da su farare da jinin Ɗan Ragon nan.
english: I told him, “My lord, you know.” He said to me, “These are those who came out of the great suffering. They washed their robes and made them white in the Lamb’s blood.

hausa: Yawan mutanen sashensa 32,200 ne.
english: His division, and those who were counted of them, were thirty-two thousand two hundred.

hausa: Kada wani da yake kan rufin gidansa yă sauka, ko yă shiga gida don yă ɗauki wani abu.
english: and let him who is on the housetop not go down, nor enter in, to take anything out of his house.

hausa: Abin da nake nufi shi ne, muddin magāji yana ɗan yaro ne tukuna, babu bambanci tsakaninsa da bawa, ko da yake shi ne da mallakar kome.
english: But I say that so long as the heir is a child, he is no different from a bondservant, though he is lord of all,

hausa: Ku tuna da abin da Amalekawa suka yi muku a hanya, sa’ad da kuka fito Masar.
english: Remember what Amalek did to you by the way as you came out of Egypt,

hausa: Mai gulma yakan lalace yarda; saboda haka ka guji mutum mai yawan surutu.
english: He who goes about as a tale-bearer reveals secrets; therefore don’t keep company with him who opens wide his lips.

hausa: Ku zo ku yi gāba da ita daga nesa. Ku buɗe rumbunanta; ku jibga ta kamar tsibin hatsi. Ku hallaka ta sarai kada ku bar mata raguwa.
english: Come against her from the farthest border. Open her storehouses. Cast her up as heaps. Destroy her utterly. Let nothing of her be left.

hausa: Suka gasa dabbobin Bikin Ƙetarewa a bisa wuta yadda aka tsara, suka dafa hadayu masu tsarki a tukwane, da manyan tukwane, da kuma kwanoni, suka raba su nan da nan ga dukan mutane.
english: They roasted the Passover with fire according to the ordinance. They boiled the holy offerings in pots, in cauldrons, and in pans, and carried them quickly to all the children of the people.

hausa: Sa’an nan na ji kowace halitta a sama da ƙasa da ƙarƙashin ƙasa da kuma bisan teku, da kome da yake cikinsu yana rerawa, “Gare shi mai zama a kan kursiyin da kuma ga Ɗan Ragon yabo da girma da ɗaukaka da iko,
english: I heard every created thing which is in heaven, on the earth, under the earth, on the sea, and everything in them, saying, “To him who sits on the throne and to the Lamb be the blessing, the honor, the glory, and the dominion, forever and ever! Amen!”

hausa: Ubangiji shi ne dutsena, kagarata da kuma mai cetona; Allahna shi ne dutsena, a gare shi nake neman mafaka. Shi ne garkuwata da ƙahon cetona, mafakata.
english: Yahweh is my rock, my fortress, and my deliverer; my God, my rock, in whom I take refuge; my shield, and the horn of my salvation, my high tower.

hausa: Yanzu za ku daina bin Ubangiji ne? “In kuka yi wa Ubangiji tawaye yau, gobe zai yi fushi da dukan mutanen Isra’ila.
english: that you must turn away today from following Yahweh? It will be, since you rebel today against Yahweh, that tomorrow he will be angry with the whole congregation of Israel.

hausa: Ka taɓa yin magana cikin wahayi, ga mutanenka masu aminci ka ce, “Na ba wa jarumi ƙarfi; na ɗaukaka saurayi daga cikin mutane.
english: Then you spoke in vision to your saints, and said, “I have given strength to the warrior. I have exalted a young man from the people.

hausa: Sai Dawuda ya tattauna da kowane ɗaya daga cikin shugabanninsa, shugabannin sojoji na dubu-dubu da na ɗari-ɗari.
english: David consulted with the captains of thousands and of hundreds, even with every leader.

hausa: Ku tabbata cewa kada kowa yă rama mugunta da mugunta, sai dai kullum ku yi ƙoƙarin yin wa juna alheri da kuma dukan mutane.
english: See that no one returns evil for evil to anyone, but always follow after that which is good for one another and for all.

hausa: Sai Yahudawa suka fara gardama mai tsanani a junansu suna cewa, “Yaya wannan mutum zai ba mu naman jikinsa mu ci?”
english: The Jews therefore contended with one another, saying, “How can this man give us his flesh to eat?”

hausa: Haka ma, manyan firistoci da malaman dokoki da kuma dattawa, suka yi ta yin masa ba’a, suna cewa,
english: Likewise the chief priests also mocking with the scribes, the Pharisees, and the elders, said,

hausa: Ya ce, “In sun fito don salama, ku kamo su da rai; in sun fito yaƙi ne, ku kamo su da rai.”
english: He said, “If they have come out for peace, take them alive; or if they have come out for war, take them alive.”

hausa: ’Yar farin ta haifi ɗa, ta kuma ba shi suna Mowab, shi ne mahaifin Mowabawa a yau.
english: The firstborn bore a son, and named him Moab. He is the father of the Moabites to this day.

hausa: Saboda haka Isra’ila ya ce wa Yusuf, “Jeka ka ga ko kome lafiya yake da ’yan’uwanka da kuma garkunan, ka kawo mini labari.” Sa’an nan ya sallame shi daga Kwarin Hebron. Sa’ad da Yusuf ya kai Shekem,
english: He said to him, “Go now, see whether it is well with your brothers, and well with the flock; and bring me word again.” So he sent him out of the valley of Hebron, and he came to Shechem.

hausa: raƙuma 435, da jakuna 6,720.
english: their camels, four hundred thirty-five; their donkeys, six thousand seven hundred twenty.

hausa: Anatot da Almon, tare da wuraren kiwonsu, garuruwa huɗu ke nan.
english: Anathoth with its pasture lands, and Almon with its pasture lands: four cities.

hausa: ’Ya’yan Simeyon maza su ne, Yemuwel, Yamin, Ohad, Yakin, Zohar da Sha’ul ɗan mutuniyar Kan’ana. Waɗannan su ne dangin Simeyon.
english: The sons of Simeon: Jemuel, and Jamin, and Ohad, and Jachin, and Zohar, and Shaul the son of a Canaanite woman; these are the families of Simeon.

hausa: Wataƙila ya ɓoye ƙiyayyarsa da ƙarya, duk da haka za a tone muguntarsa a cikin taro.
english: His malice may be concealed by deception, but his wickedness will be exposed in the assembly.

hausa: Daga wannan ƙasa, sai ya tafi Assuriya, inda ya gina Ninebe, Rehobot Ir, Kala
english: Out of that land he went into Assyria, and built Nineveh, Rehoboth Ir, Calah,

hausa: Haka, Musa ya karɓi kuɗin fansar waɗanda suka haura yawan Lawiyawa.
english: Moses took the redemption money from those who exceeded the number of those who were redeemed by the Levites;

hausa: A bisa akwatin alkawarin kuwa akwai kerubobi na Ɗaukaka, waɗanda suka inuwantar da murfin kafara da fikafikansu. Sai dai ba za mu tattauna waɗannan abubuwa dalla-dalla a yanzu ba.
english: and above it cherubim of glory overshadowing the mercy seat, of which things we can’t speak now in detail.

hausa: Masar za tă zama kufai. Sa’an nan za su san cewa ni ne Ubangiji. “ ‘Domin ka ce, “Nilu nawa ne; ni na yi shi,”
english: The land of Egypt will be a desolation and a waste. Then they will know that I am Yahweh. “‘“Because he has said, ‘The river is mine, and I have made it,’

hausa: Ubangiji zai aukar maka da kwanakin wahala, kai da jama’arka, da dukan iyalin gidan sarauta, waɗanda suka fi muni tun lokacin da aka raba mulkin Efraim daga na Yahuda, zai kawo sarkin Assuriya.”
english: Yahweh will bring on you, on your people, and on your father’s house days that have not come, from the day that Ephraim departed from Judah, even the king of Assyria.

hausa: kada ku ɗauki jaka don tafiya, ko ƙarin riga, ko takalma ko sanda; domin ma’aikaci ya cancanci hakkinsa.
english: Take no bag for your journey, neither two coats, nor sandals, nor staff: for the laborer is worthy of his food.

hausa: har ya yi alkawari da rantsuwa cewa zai ba ta duk abin da ta roƙa.
english: Therefore he promised with an oath to give her whatever she should ask.

hausa: “Ga abin da Ubangiji yana cewa, kada ku ruɗe kanku, kuna tsammani, ‘Tabbatacce Babiloniyawa sun bar mu.’ Ba za su bari ba!
english: “Yahweh says, ‘Don’t deceive yourselves, saying, “The Chaldeans will surely depart from us;” for they will not depart.

hausa: Yabi Ubangiji. Mai albarka ne mutumin da yake tsoron Ubangiji, wanda yakan sami farin ciki mai girma a umarnansa.
english: Praise Yah! Blessed is the man who fears Yahweh, who delights greatly in his commandments.

hausa: Yowab ɗan Zeruhiya shi ne shugaban mayaƙa; Yehoshafat ɗan Ahilud shi ne marubuci;
english: Joab the son of Zeruiah was over the army; Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud was recorder;

hausa: Sa’ad da dukan Yahudawan da suke a Mowab, Ammon, Edom da sauran ƙasashe suka ji cewa sarkin Babilon ya bar raguwa a Yahuda ya kuma naɗa Gedaliya ɗan Ahikam, ɗan Shafan gwamna a kansu,
english: Likewise when all the Jews who were in Moab, and among the children of Ammon, and in Edom, and who were in all the countries, heard that the king of Babylon had left a remnant of Judah, and that he had set over them Gedaliah the son of Ahikam, the son of Shaphan,

hausa: Kuma duk wanda ya faɗi kalmar zagi a kan Ɗan Mutum, za a gafarta masa, amma duk wanda ya saɓa wa Ruhu Mai Tsarki, ba za a gafarta masa ba.
english: Everyone who speaks a word against the Son of Man will be forgiven, but those who blaspheme against the Holy Spirit will not be forgiven.

hausa: Zai ƙwace bayinku maza da mata, da shanunku, da jakunanku mafi kyau domin su yi masa aiki.
english: He will take your male servants, your female servants, your best young men, and your donkeys, and assign them to his own work.

hausa: A’a, ina horon jikina in mai da shi bawana, saboda bayan na yi wa waɗansu wa’azi, ni kaina kada in kāsa cancantar samun lada.
english: but I beat my body and bring it into submission, lest by any means, after I have preached to others, I myself should be disqualified.

hausa: Ya ce musu, “Amma yanzu, in kuna da jakar kuɗi, ko jaka, ku ɗauka. In kuma ba ku da takobi, ku sayar da rigarku, ku saya.
english: Then he said to them, “But now, whoever has a purse, let him take it, and likewise a bag. Whoever has none, let him sell his cloak, and buy a sword.

hausa: Ka tuna da Mahaliccinka a kwanakin ƙuruciyarka, kafin lokacin wahala ta zo shekaru kuma su ƙarato sa’ad da za ka ce, “Ba na jin daɗinsu,”
english: Remember also your Creator in the days of your youth, before the evil days come, and the years draw near, when you will say, “I have no pleasure in them;”

hausa: Batsheba ta ce, “Da kyau, zan yi magana da sarki dominka.”
english: Bathsheba said, “All right. I will speak for you to the king.”

hausa: ’Ya’yan Yafet maza su ne, Gomer, Magog, Madai, Yaban, Tubal, Meshek da Tiras.
english: The sons of Japheth: Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshech, and Tiras.

hausa: Gama Allah bai naɗa mu don mu sha fushi ba, sai dai mu sami ceto ta wurin Ubangijinmu Yesu Kiristi.
english: For God didn’t appoint us to wrath, but to the obtaining of salvation through our Lord Jesus Christ,

hausa: Amma ba tă yi aminci ba. Ta bar shi ta komo gidan mahaifiyarta a Betlehem, a Yahuda. Bayan ta zauna a can wajen wata huɗu,
english: His concubine played the prostitute against him, and went away from him to her father’s house to Bethlehem Judah, and was there for four months.

hausa: Akwai waninku da yake ciwo? Ya kamata yă kira dattawan ikkilisiya su yi masa addu’a, su kuma shafa masa mai cikin sunan Ubangiji.
english: Is any among you sick? Let him call for the elders of the assembly, and let them pray over him, anointing him with oil in the name of the Lord;

hausa: Zan tuna da ayyukan Ubangiji; I, zan tuna mu’ujizanka na tun dā.
english: I will remember Yah’s deeds; for I will remember your wonders of old.

hausa: Sai Yunana ya yi biyayya da maganar Ubangiji, ya tafi Ninebe. Ninebe birni ne da yake da muhimmanci, wanda sai an ɗauki kwana uku kafin a iya zaga shi.
english: So Jonah arose, and went to Nineveh, according to Yahweh’s word. Now Nineveh was an exceedingly great city, three days’ journey across.

hausa: Zan sa mutane da dabbobi su yi yawa a kanku, za su kuma ba da ’ya’ya su kuma yi yawa. Zan zaunar da mutane a kanku kamar dā zan kuma sa ku wadaita fiye da dā. Sa’an nan za ku san cewa ni ne Ubangiji.
english: I will multiply man and animal on you. They will increase and be fruitful. I will cause you to be inhabited as you were before, and you will do better than at your beginnings. Then you will know that I am Yahweh.

hausa: Solomon ya kasance da ’yan ɗauko guda dubu saba’in da masu yankan duwatsu guda dubu tamanin a cikin tuddai,
english: Solomon had seventy thousand who bore burdens, and eighty thousand who were stone cutters in the mountains,

hausa: Ga abin da ya faru a zamanin Zerzes. Zerzes ya yi mulki bisan larduna 127 daga Indiya zuwa Kush.
english: Now in the days of Ahasuerus (this is Ahasuerus who reigned from India even to Ethiopia, over one hundred twenty-seven provinces),

hausa: Ina misalin ƙaunarka marar ƙarewa! Mutane manya da ƙanana kan sami mafaka cikin inuwar fikafikanka.
english: How precious is your loving kindness, God! The children of men take refuge under the shadow of your wings.

hausa: Da ya tsotsi abin sha ɗin, sai Yesu ya ce, “An gama.” Da wannan fa, ya sunkuyar da kansa ya saki ruhunsa.
english: When Jesus therefore had received the vinegar, he said, “It is finished!” Then he bowed his head and gave up his spirit.

hausa: ’Ya’yanmu da matanmu, garkunan shanunmu da na tumakinmu, za su kasance a nan biranen Gileyad.
english: Our little ones, our wives, our flocks, and all our livestock shall be there in the cities of Gilead;

hausa: In kuka yi haka, idan kuma suka yi kuka gare ni, zan ji kukansu.
english: If you take advantage of them at all, and they cry at all to me, I will surely hear their cry;

hausa: Suna tare da Shawulu da kuma dukan mutanen Isra’ila a Kwarin Ela, suna can suna yaƙi da Filistiyawa.”
english: Now Saul, and they, and all the men of Israel were in the valley of Elah, fighting with the Philistines.

hausa: Sai Dawuda ya ce wa dukan fadawansa da suke tare da shi a Urushalima, “Ku zo! Mu gudu, in ba haka ba, babu wanda zai tsira daga hannun Absalom. Dole mu bar nan, nan da nan, in ba haka ba zai tashi da sauri yă fāɗa mana, yă kuma hallaka garin da takobi.”
english: David said to all his servants who were with him at Jerusalem, “Arise! Let’s flee, or else none of us will escape from Absalom. Hurry to depart, lest he overtake us quickly and bring down evil on us, and strike the city with the edge of the sword.”

hausa: “To yanzu, Ubangiji ya sa ruhun ruɗu a bakunan waɗannan annabawanka. Ubangiji ya ƙayyade masifa dominka.”
english: “Now therefore, behold, Yahweh has put a lying spirit in the mouth of these your prophets; and Yahweh has spoken evil concerning you.”

hausa: Saboda haka Ubangiji zai sanar da kansa ga Masarawa, kuma a wannan rana za su yarda da Ubangiji. Za su yi masa sujada da hadayu da hadayun hatsi; za su yi alkawura ga Ubangiji su kuma kiyaye su.
english: Yahweh will be known to Egypt, and the Egyptians will know Yahweh in that day. Yes, they will worship with sacrifice and offering, and will vow a vow to Yahweh, and will perform it.

hausa: Sai Annas ya aika da shi, a daure, wurin Kayifas babban firist.
english: Annas sent him bound to Caiaphas, the high priest.

hausa: Sai muka zauna a kwari kusa da Bet-Feyor.
english: So we stayed in the valley near Beth Peor.

hausa: Firist na Zeyus, wanda haikalinsa ke bayan birni, ya kawo bijimai da furanni a ƙofofin birni domin shi da taron mutanen sun so su miƙa musu hadayu.
english: The priest of Jupiter, whose temple was in front of their city, brought oxen and garlands to the gates, and would have made a sacrifice along with the multitudes.

hausa: Muna wannan addu’a don sunan Ubangijinmu Yesu yă sami ɗaukaka a cikinku, ku kuma a cikinsa, bisa ga alherin Allahnmu da na Ubangiji Yesu Kiristi.
english: that the name of our Lord Jesus may be glorified in you, and you in him, according to the grace of our God and the Lord Jesus Christ.

hausa: Ahab ya cika da fushi saboda Nabot, mutumin Yezireyel ya ce, “Ba zan ba ka gādon kakannina ba.” Ya kwanta a gadonsa yana zub da hawaye, ya kuma ƙi cin abinci.
english: Ahab came into his house sullen and angry because of the word which Naboth the Jezreelite had spoken to him, for he had said, “I will not give you the inheritance of my fathers.” He laid himself down on his bed, and turned away his face, and would eat no bread.

hausa: Shugaban ƙungiyar sojan ya zo ya kama shi ya ba da umarni a daure shi da sarƙoƙi biyu. Sa’an nan ya yi tambaya ko shi wane ne, da kuma abin da ya yi.
english: Then the commanding officer came near, arrested him, commanded him to be bound with two chains, and inquired who he was and what he had done.

hausa: Dukan Nassi numfashin Allah ne yana kuma da amfani don koyarwa, tsawatarwa, gyara da kuma horarwa cikin adalci,
english: Every Scripture is God-breathed and profitable for teaching, for reproof, for correction, and for instruction in righteousness,

hausa: Ba naka ba ne kafin ka sayar da shi? Bayan da ka sayar da shi kuma, kuɗin ba naka ba ne? Me ya sa ka yi tunanin yin irin wannan abu? Ba mutum ne ka yi wa ƙarya ba, Allah ne ka yi masa.”
english: While you kept it, didn’t it remain your own? After it was sold, wasn’t it in your power? How is it that you have conceived this thing in your heart? You haven’t lied to men, but to God.”

hausa: Tsakanin safe da yamma mai yiwuwa ne ragargaza su; farat ɗaya, su mutu har abada.
english: Between morning and evening they are destroyed. They perish forever without any regarding it.

hausa: Ya Ubangiji, ka yi mana jinƙai; muna marmarinka. Ka zama ƙarfinmu kowace safiya, cetonmu a lokacin damuwa.
english: Yahweh, be gracious to us. We have waited for you. Be our strength every morning, our salvation also in the time of trouble.

hausa: saboda haka za a ba ka hikima da sani. Zan kuma ba ka wadata, arziki da girma, waɗanda babu wani sarki kafin kai da ya taɓa kasance da su kuma babu wani a bayanka da zai kasance da su.”
english: therefore wisdom and knowledge is granted to you. I will give you riches, wealth, and honor, such as none of the kings have had who have been before you, and none after you will have.”

hausa: Saboda laifinku za ku rasa gādon da na ba ku. Zan bautar da ku ga abokan gābanku a ƙasar da ba ku sani ba, domin kun husata ni, zai kuwa ci har abada.”
english: You, even of yourself, will discontinue from your heritage that I gave you. I will cause you to serve your enemies in the land which you don’t know, for you have kindled a fire in my anger which will burn forever.”

hausa: Haka kuma Dawuda ya ci Mowabawa. Ya sa suka kwanta a ƙasa, ya kuma auna su da igiya. Kowane awo biyu ya sa a kashe su, amma awo na uku sai yă sa a bar su da rai. Saboda haka Mowabawa suka zama bayin Dawuda, suka kuma kawo masa haraji.
english: He defeated Moab, and measured them with the line, making them to lie down on the ground; and he measured two lines to put to death, and one full line to keep alive. The Moabites became servants to David, and brought tribute.

hausa: Haka kuma Zebulun bai kori Kan’aniyawa da suke zaune a Kitron da Nahalol, waɗanda suka rage a cikinsu ba; sai dai sun sa su aikin gandu.
english: Zebulun didn’t drive out the inhabitants of Kitron, nor the inhabitants of Nahalol; but the Canaanites lived among them, and became subject to forced labor.

hausa: Bayan da ya faɗi haka, sai ya sallami taron.
english: When he had thus spoken, he dismissed the assembly.

hausa: Suka ce, “To, ai, Ibrahim ne mahaifinmu.” Yesu ya ce, “Da ku ’ya’yan Ibrahim ne, da za ku aikata abubuwan da Ibrahim ya yi.
english: They answered him, “Our father is Abraham.” Jesus said to them, “If you were Abraham’s children, you would do the works of Abraham.

hausa: gara ya ce maka, “Ka hauro nan,” da a ƙasƙantar da kai a gaban wani mai makami. Abin da ka gani da idanunka
english: for it is better that it be said to you, “Come up here,” than that you should be put lower in the presence of the prince, whom your eyes have seen.

hausa: Yesu ya ce, “Kai ma da kake malami na Isra’ila, ba ka fahimci waɗannan abubuwa ba?
english: Jesus answered him, “Are you the teacher of Israel, and don’t understand these things?

hausa: Da Arauna ya hangi Dawuda da mutanensa suna zuwa wajensa, sai ya fita a guje, ya je ya rusuna a gaban sarki.
english: Araunah looked out, and saw the king and his servants coming on toward him. Then Araunah went out and bowed himself before the king with his face to the ground.

hausa: Sarki ya ce, “Kimham zai ƙetare tare da ni, zan kuwa yi masa abin da ya gamshe ka. Kuma duk abin da kake bukata a wurina, zan yi maka.”
english: The king answered, “Chimham shall go over with me, and I will do to him that which shall seem good to you. Whatever you request of me, that I will do for you.”

hausa: An yi ajiyar laifin Efraim, aka lissafta zunubansa.
english: The guilt of Ephraim is stored up. His sin is stored up.

hausa: Sai Musa ya yi kuka ga Ubangiji ya ce, “Me zan yi da wannan jama’a? Suna shiri su jajjefe ni da duwatsu.”
english: Moses cried to Yahweh, saying, “What shall I do with these people? They are almost ready to stone me.”

hausa: Saboda haka na ce, “Darajata ta ƙare da kuma duk abin da nake begen samu daga wurin Ubangiji.”
english: I said, “My strength has perished, along with my expectation from Yahweh.”

hausa: Gama ina lura da su don lahani, ba alheri ba; mutanen Yahuda da suke a Masar za su hallaka ta wurin takobi da yunwa sai dukansu sun hallaka.
english: Behold, I watch over them for evil, and not for good; and all the men of Judah who are in the land of Egypt will be consumed by the sword and by the famine, until they are all gone.

hausa: Saboda haka ba a bin doka, shari’a kuma ba ta aiki. Mugaye sun kewaye masu adalci don a hana gaskiya tă yi aiki.
english: Therefore the law is paralyzed, and justice never prevails; for the wicked surround the righteous; therefore justice comes out perverted.

hausa: Bayan ’yar Fir’auna ta haura daga Birnin Dawuda zuwa fadan da Solomon ya gina mata, sai ya gina madogaran gini.
english: But Pharaoh’s daughter came up out of David’s city to her house which Solomon had built for her. Then he built Millo.

hausa: Zai karɓi zakan dabbobinku, ku kanku za ku zama bayinsa.
english: He will take one tenth of your flocks; and you will be his servants.

hausa: Za su zuba ƙura a kawunansu, da kuka da makoki za su yi ta kururuwa, “ ‘Kaito! Kaito, ya birni mai girma, inda dukan waɗanda suke da jiragen ruwa a teku suka arzuta da ɗumbun dukiyarsa! Cikin sa’a ɗaya ta hallaka!’
english: They cast dust on their heads, and cried, weeping and mourning, saying, ‘Woe, woe, the great city, in which all who had their ships in the sea were made rich by reason of her great wealth!’ For she is made desolate in one hour.

hausa: Kowace shekara, iyayen Yesu sukan je Urushalima don Bikin Ƙetarewa.
english: His parents went every year to Jerusalem at the feast of the Passover.

hausa: suka kawo wa Dawuda da mutanensa tabarmai, da kwanoni, da kayayyakin da aka yi da yumɓu. Suka kuma kawo alkama da sha’ir, da gari, da soyayyen hatsi, da wake, da waken barewa,
english: brought beds, basins, earthen vessels, wheat, barley, meal, parched grain, beans, lentils, roasted grain,

hausa: Natan ya faɗa wa Dawuda dukan kalmomin wahayin nan.
english: According to all these words, and according to all this vision, so Nathan spoke to David.

hausa: “Za a yi kuka a can, da cizon haƙora, sa’ad da kuka ga Ibrahim, da Ishaku, da Yaƙub, da dukan annabawa a mulkin Allah, amma ku kuwa, za a jefar da ku a waje.
english: There will be weeping and gnashing of teeth when you see Abraham, Isaac, Jacob, and all the prophets in God’s Kingdom, and yourselves being thrown outside.

hausa: Mugaye suna sha’awar ganimar mugayen mutane, amma saiwar masu adalci kan haɓaka.
english: The wicked desires the plunder of evil men, but the root of the righteous flourishes.

hausa: ta wurin tambayar firistocin da kuma annabawan gidan Ubangiji Maɗaukaki, “Ko ya kamata in yi makoki da azumi a wata na biyar, yadda na yi a shekaru masu yawa?”
english: and to speak to the priests of the house of Yahweh of Armies and to the prophets, saying, “Should I weep in the fifth month, separating myself, as I have done these so many years?”

hausa: Duk mai ƙaunar kuɗi ba ya samun isashe; duk ma ƙaunar dukiya ba ya ƙoshi da abin da yake samu. Wannan ma ba shi da amfani.
english: He who loves silver shall not be satisfied with silver, nor he who loves abundance, with increase. This also is vanity.

hausa: Mutumin kuwa ya tashi ya tafi gida.
english: He arose and departed to his house.

hausa: Sai suka yi kuka ga Ubangiji cikin wahalarsu, ya kuwa fitar da su daga damuwarsu.
english: Then they cry to Yahweh in their trouble, and he brings them out of their distress.

hausa: “Zan mayar muku da abin da fāra suka ci a waɗannan shekaru waɗanda ɗango da fāra masu gaigayewa, da kuma sauran fāra da tarin fāra babban mayaƙan da na aika don su fāɗa muku.
english: I will restore to you the years that the swarming locust has eaten, the great locust, the grasshopper, and the caterpillar, my great army, which I sent among you.

hausa: Ƙaunataccena ya turo hannunsa ta cikin ramin ƙofar; zuciyata ta fara juyayi a kansa.
english: My beloved thrust his hand in through the latch opening. My heart pounded for him.

hausa: Abigiyel ta tashi da sauri ta hau jaki, ta kuma sa ’yan mata biyar da suke mata hidima su bi ta, suka tafi tare da ’yan saƙon Dawuda. Ta kuwa zama matarsa.
english: Abigail hurriedly arose and rode on a donkey with her five maids who followed her; and she went after the messengers of David, and became his wife.

hausa: Hikima tana kira da ƙarfi a kan titi, tana ɗaga muryarta a dandalin taron jama’a;
english: Wisdom calls aloud in the street. She utters her voice in the public squares.

hausa: Ta haka aka sami katakai takwas da rammukan azurfa goma sha shida, biyu-biyu a ƙarƙashin kowane katako.
english: There were eight boards and their sockets of silver, sixteen sockets—under every board two sockets.

hausa: Ya tafi can don a rubuta shi tare da Maryamu, wadda aka yi masa alkawari zai aura, tana kuwa da ciki.
english: to enroll himself with Mary, who was pledged to be married to him as wife, being pregnant.

hausa: Irmiya ya rubuta a littafi dukan masifun da za su auko wa Babilon, wato, dukan wannan magana da aka rubuta a kan Babilon.
english: Jeremiah wrote in a book all the evil that should come on Babylon, even all these words that are written concerning Babylon.

hausa: Bari su yi godiya ga Ubangiji saboda ƙaunarsa marar ƙarewa da kuma ayyukansa masu banmamaki saboda mutane,
english: Let them praise Yahweh for his loving kindness, for his wonderful deeds to the children of men!

hausa: da tebur da kuma dukan kayansa, da wurin ajiye fitila da dukan kayansa, da bagaden ƙona turare,
english: the table and all its articles, the lamp stand and its accessories, the altar of incense,

hausa: Sun juya, suka bauta wa waɗansu alloli, suka rusuna musu, allolin da ba su sani ba, allolin da Ubangiji bai ba su ba.
english: and went and served other gods and worshiped them, gods that they didn’t know and that he had not given to them.

hausa: kuma da aka mai da shi cikakke, sai ya zama hanyar samun madawwamin ceto ga dukan waɗanda suke masa biyayya.
english: Having been made perfect, he became to all of those who obey him the author of eternal salvation,

hausa: Sarki ya ce mata, “Mece ce matsalarki?” Sai ta ce, “Tabbatacce, ni gwauruwa ce; mijina ya mutu.
english: The king said to her, “What ails you?” She answered, “Truly I am a widow, and my husband is dead.

hausa: Ku lura fa kada wani yă kāsa samun alherin Allah, kada kuma wani tushen ɗacin rai yă tsira har yă kawo rikici, yă kuma ƙazantar da mutane da yawa.
english: looking carefully lest there be any man who falls short of the grace of God, lest any root of bitterness springing up trouble you and many be defiled by it,

hausa: Saboda haka sa’ad da Bitrus ya haura zuwa Urushalima, masu bin da suke da kaciya suka zarge shi
english: When Peter had come up to Jerusalem, those who were of the circumcision contended with him,

hausa: Gwiwoyina suna mutuwa saboda azumi; jikina ya rame ba kuma ƙarfi.
english: My knees are weak through fasting. My body is thin and lacks fat.

hausa: Amma Dawuda ya ce wa Shawulu, “Bawanka yana kiwon tumakin mahaifinsa. Sa’ad da zaki ko beyar ta zo ta kama tunkiya, ta tafi da ita.
english: David said to Saul, “Your servant was keeping his father’s sheep; and when a lion or a bear came and took a lamb out of the flock,

hausa: Waɗannan su ne manyan Horiyawa, Lotan, Shobal, Zibeyon, Ana,
english: These are the chiefs who came of the Horites: chief Lotan, chief Shobal, chief Zibeon, chief Anah,

hausa: Wata rana da yamma ya fita zuwa fili domin yă yi tunani, sa’ad da ya ɗaga ido, sai ya ga raƙuma suna zuwa.
english: Isaac went out to meditate in the field at the evening. He lifted up his eyes and looked. Behold, there were camels coming.

hausa: ba ta wurin ayyuka ba sai dai ta wurin shi wanda ya kira, aka faɗa mata cewa, “Babban zai bauta wa ƙaramin.”
english: it was said to her, “The elder will serve the younger.”

hausa: Saboda haka Ubangiji Allahnsa ya miƙa shi ga sarkin Aram. Arameyawa suka ci shi a yaƙi, suka kuma kwashe mutanensa da yawa a matsayin ’yan kurkuku, suka kawo Damaskus. Ya kuma ba da shi ga sarkin Isra’ila, wanda ya jijji masa a yaƙi.
english: Therefore Yahweh his God delivered him into the hand of the king of Syria. They struck him, and carried away from him a great multitude of captives, and brought them to Damascus. He was also delivered into the hand of the king of Israel, who struck him with a great slaughter.

hausa: Ka tsawata wa naman jejin nan a cikin kyauro, garken bijimai a cikin ’yan maruƙan al’ummai. Ka ƙasƙantar, bari yă kawo sandunan azurfa. Ka watsar da al’ummai waɗanda suke jin daɗin yaƙi.
english: Rebuke the wild animal of the reeds, the multitude of the bulls with the calves of the peoples. Trample under foot the bars of silver. Scatter the nations who delight in war.

hausa: Ku yi kome ba tare da gunaguni ko gardama ba,
english: Do all things without complaining and arguing,

hausa: Da ya gama wanke ƙafafunsu, sai ya sa tufafinsa ya koma wurin zamansa. Ya tambaye su ya ce, “Kun fahimci abin da na yi muku?
english: So when he had washed their feet, put his outer garment back on, and sat down again, he said to them, “Do you know what I have done to you?

hausa: Ba mutumin Ammon, ko mutumin Mowab, ko kuwa wani zuriyarsu da zai shiga taron jama’ar Ubangiji, har tsara ta goma.
english: An Ammonite or a Moabite shall not enter into Yahweh’s assembly; even to the tenth generation shall no one belonging to them enter into Yahweh’s assembly forever,

hausa: Ango ya yi jinkirin zuwa, sai duk suka shiga gyangyaɗi har barci ya kwashe su.
english: Now while the bridegroom delayed, they all slumbered and slept.

hausa: Ka ci gaba da ƙaunarka ga waɗanda suka san ka, adalcinka ga masu gaskiyar zuciya.
english: Oh continue your loving kindness to those who know you, your righteousness to the upright in heart.

hausa: Duba, Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka yana zuwa da iko, hannunsa kuma yana yin mulki dominsa. Duba, ladarsa tana tare da shi, sakamakonsa kuma na rakiyarsa.
english: Behold, the Lord Yahweh will come as a mighty one, and his arm will rule for him. Behold, his reward is with him, and his recompense before him.

hausa: Kada ka yi kisankai.
english: “You shall not murder.

hausa: shanu 72,000
english: seventy-two thousand head of cattle,

hausa: Dukan waɗannan su ne kawunan iyalan Lawiyawa, manya kamar yadda aka lissafta su a zuriyarsu, kuma suna zama a Urushalima.
english: These were heads of fathers’ households of the Levites, throughout their generations, chief men. They lived at Jerusalem.

english: The children of Zaccai, seven hundred sixty.

hausa: Zan sa makiyaya a kansu waɗanda za su lura da su, ba za su ƙara jin tsoro ko razana ba, ba kuwa waninsu da zai ɓace,” in ji Ubangiji.
english: I will set up shepherds over them who will feed them. They will no longer be afraid or dismayed, neither will any be lacking,” says Yahweh.

hausa: Idanuna sun gaji, da jiran cetonka, da jiran alkawarinka mai adalci.
english: My eyes fail looking for your salvation, for your righteous word.

hausa: “Na gaya musu cewa ba al’adar Romawa ba ce a hukunta mutum kafin ya fuskanci masu ƙararsa ya kuma sami damar kāre kansa game da ƙararsu.
english: I answered them that it is not the custom of the Romans to give up any man to destruction before the accused has met the accusers face to face and has had opportunity to make his defense concerning the matter laid against him.

hausa: Shugabannin Lawiyawa kuwa su ne Hashabiya, Sherebiya, Yeshuwa ɗan Kadmiyel, da ’yan’uwansu, waɗanda suka tsaya ɗaura da su don su yi yabo da kuma godiya, sashe ɗaya kan ba da amsa ga ɗaya sashen, kamar yadda Dawuda mutumin Allah ya umarta.
english: The chiefs of the Levites: Hashabiah, Sherebiah, and Jeshua the son of Kadmiel, with their brothers close to them, to praise and give thanks according to the commandment of David the man of God, section next to section.

hausa: “Ubangiji ya sāka mini bisa ga adalcina; bisa ga tsabtar hannuwana ya sāka mini.
english: Yahweh rewarded me according to my righteousness. He rewarded me according to the cleanness of my hands.

hausa: Don mai bi da kaɗe-kaɗe. Da kayan kiɗi masu tsirkiya. Ta Dawuda. Ka ji kukata, ya Allah; ka saurari addu’ata.
english: For the Chief Musician. For a stringed instrument. By David. Hear my cry, God. Listen to my prayer.

hausa: Duk wanda ya yi wa maganarka tawaye, ya ƙi yă yi biyayya da maganarka, ko da umarnin da ka ba shi, za a kashe shi. Ka dai ƙarfafa ka kuma yi ƙarfi hali!”
english: Whoever rebels against your commandment, and doesn’t listen to your words in all that you command him shall himself be put to death. Only be strong and courageous.”

hausa: Eliyab ɗan Helon kuma shi ne shugaban ɓangaren kabilar Zebulun.
english: Eliab the son of Helon was over the army of the tribe of the children of Zebulun.

hausa: Duk da haka bai kashe ’ya’yan masu kisan ba, bisa ga abin da yake a rubuce a Dokar Musa inda Ubangiji ya umarta, “Ba za a kashe iyaye saboda laifin ’ya’ya ba, ko kuma ’ya’ya saboda laifin iyayensu ba, kowa zai mutu don zunubansa.”
english: but the children of the murderers he didn’t put to death, according to that which is written in the book of the law of Moses, as Yahweh commanded, saying, “The fathers shall not be put to death for the children, nor the children be put to death for the fathers; but every man shall die for his own sin.”

hausa: “Haruna zai miƙa bijimi hadaya don zunubinsa yă kuma yi kafara don kansa da gidansa.
english: “Aaron shall offer the bull of the sin offering, which is for himself, and make atonement for himself and for his house.

hausa: Yahudawa da Al’ummai tare da shugabanninsu suka ƙulla shawara a tsakaninsu, domin su wulaƙanta su su kuma jajjefe su da duwatsu.
english: When some of both the Gentiles and the Jews, with their rulers, made a violent attempt to mistreat and stone them,

hausa: Waƙa ce. Zabura ta ’ya’yan Kora maza. Ubangiji mai girma ne, kuma mafificin yabo, a birnin Allahnmu, dutsensa mai tsarki.
english: A Song. A Psalm by the sons of Korah. Great is Yahweh, and greatly to be praised, in the city of our God, in his holy mountain.

hausa: Ta haka firist zai yi kafara dominsa a gaban Ubangiji, za a kuwa gafarta masa irin laifin da ya yi.”
english: The priest shall make atonement for him before Yahweh, and he will be forgiven concerning whatever he does to become guilty.”

hausa: A shekara ta ɗari huɗu da tamani bayan fitowar Isra’ilawa daga Masar, a shekara ta huɗu ta mulkin Solomon a bisa Isra’ila, a watan Zif, wata na biyu, Solomon ya fara gina haikalin Ubangiji.
english: In the four hundred and eightieth year after the children of Israel had come out of the land of Egypt, in the fourth year of Solomon’s reign over Israel, in the month Ziv, which is the second month, he began to build Yahweh’s house.

hausa: Sa’an nan dukan mutanen suka tashi, kowa ya koma gidansa, Dawuda ya koma gida yă sa wa iyalinsa albarka.
english: All the people departed, each man to his house; and David returned to bless his house.

hausa: Ka cece ni, gama ni naka ne; na yi ƙoƙarin neman farillanka.
english: I am yours. Save me, for I have sought your precepts.

hausa: Ko ma a sa’ad da muke tare da ku, mun ba ku wannan umarni cewa, “In mutum ya ƙi yin aiki, kada a ba shi abinci.”
english: For even when we were with you, we commanded you this: “If anyone is not willing to work, don’t let him eat.”

hausa: A can ne iyakar ta kewaya zuwa Hannaton, sa’an nan ta ƙarasa a Kwarin Ifta El.
english: The border turned around it on the north to Hannathon; and it ended at the valley of Iphtah El;

hausa: Nebuzaradan shugaban matsaran sarki ya kwashi mutanen da suka rage a birnin zuwa zaman bauta a Babilon, tare da waɗanda suka riga suka tafi wurinsa, da kuma sauran mutanen.
english: Then Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard carried away captive into Babylon the rest of the people who remained in the city, the deserters also who fell away to him, and the rest of the people who remained.

hausa: ta wurin zuriyarka kuma dukan al’umman duniya za su sami albarka, domin ka yi mini biyayya.”
english: All the nations of the earth will be blessed by your offspring, because you have obeyed my voice.’”

hausa: ta wurin Kiristi ne ya komar da kome zuwa ga kansa. Ya kawo salama ga abubuwan da suke ƙasa da abubuwan da suke sama, ta wurin jinin Kiristi da ya zubar a kan gicciye.
english: and through him to reconcile all things to himself by him, whether things on the earth or things in the heavens, having made peace through the blood of his cross.

hausa: Za a kira zuriyarsa a Isra’ila Iyalin da aka tuɓe masa takalmi.
english: His name shall be called in Israel, “The house of him who had his sandal removed.”

hausa: Bala’am ya ce, “Ba dole in faɗa abin da Ubangiji ya sa a bakina ba?”
english: He answered and said, “Must I not take heed to speak that which Yahweh puts in my mouth?”

hausa: Idanunka irin na mutum ne? Kana gani yadda mutum yake gani ne?
english: Do you have eyes of flesh? Or do you see as man sees?

hausa: Yanzu kuwa saboda begena cikin abin da Allah ya yi wa kakanninmu alkawari ne, ake mini shari’a yau.
english: Now I stand here to be judged for the hope of the promise made by God to our fathers,

hausa: Ba za su sami gādo a cikin ’yan’uwansu ba; Ubangiji ne gādonsu, kamar yadda ya yi musu alkawari.
english: They shall have no inheritance among their brothers. Yahweh is their inheritance, as he has spoken to them.

hausa: Idan an ce duk wanda ya zo kusa da tabanakul na Ubangiji zai mutu, ai rayuwarmu kamar mun mutu ke nan.”
english: Everyone who keeps approaching Yahweh’s tabernacle, dies! Will we all perish?”

hausa: Wani ruhu yakan kama shi, sai ya yi ihu farar ɗaya. Yakan sa shi farfaɗiya, har bakinsa ya yi kumfa. Da ƙyar yake barinsa, yana kuwa kan hallakar da shi.
english: Behold, a spirit takes him, he suddenly cries out, and it convulses him so that he foams; and it hardly departs from him, bruising him severely.

hausa: “A bayanka, za a yi wani mulki, wanda bai kai naka ba. A gaba kuma, za a yi mulki na uku wanda yake na tagulla, zai yi mulkin dukan duniya.
english: “After you, another kingdom will arise that is inferior to you; and another third kingdom of bronze, which will rule over all the earth.

hausa: ɗan Kainan, ɗan Arfakshad, ɗan Shem, ɗan Nuhu, ɗan Lamek,
english: the son of Cainan, the son of Arphaxad, the son of Shem, the son of Noah, the son of Lamech,

hausa: Ka raya ni bisa ga alkawarinka, zan kuwa rayu; kada ka bari a gwale sa zuciyata.
english: Uphold me according to your word, that I may live. Let me not be ashamed of my hope.

hausa: Harshena zai yi zancen adalcinka da kuma yabonka dukan yini.
english: My tongue shall talk about your righteousness and about your praise all day long.

hausa: Amma Ebed-Melek mutumin Kush, wani hafsa a fada, ya ji cewa sun sa Irmiya a rijiyar da ba ruwa. Yayinda sarki yana zama a Ƙofar Benyamin,
english: Now when Ebedmelech the Ethiopian, a eunuch, who was in the king’s house, heard that they had put Jeremiah in the dungeon (the king was then sitting in Benjamin’s gate),

hausa: Amma ga shi ku da kanku kuna cuta, kuna kuma zamba, har ma ga ’yan’uwanku ne kuke yi wannan.
english: No, but you yourselves do wrong and defraud, and that against your brothers.

hausa: Sai Ubangiji ya ce wa Musa, “Ka ce wa Haruna, ‘Ka miƙa hannunka da sandanka bisa koguna da rafuffuka da kuma kududdufai, ka sa kwaɗi su fito su mamaye ƙasar Masar.’ ”
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “Tell Aaron, ‘Stretch out your hand with your rod over the rivers, over the streams, and over the pools, and cause frogs to come up on the land of Egypt.’”

hausa: Da taimakonka zan iya fāɗa wa runduna; tare da Allahna zan iya rinjayi katanga.
english: For by you, I advance through a troop. By my God, I leap over a wall.

hausa: Amma muna da wannan dukiya a cikin tulunan yumɓu, don a nuna wannan mafificin ikon nan daga Allah ne, ba daga gare mu ba.
english: But we have this treasure in clay vessels, that the exceeding greatness of the power may be of God and not from ourselves.

hausa: Zan karɓe ku kamar turare mai ƙanshi sa’ad da na fitar da ku daga al’ummai na kuma tattara ku daga ƙasashe inda aka warwatsa ku, zan kuma nuna kaina mai tsarki a cikinku a idon al’ummai.
english: I will accept you as a pleasant aroma when I bring you out from the peoples and gather you out of the countries in which you have been scattered. I will be sanctified in you in the sight of the nations.

hausa: A ƙarshen shekaru saba’in, Ubangiji zai magance Taya. Za tă koma ga aikinta na karuwanci za tă kuma yi kasuwancinta da dukan mulkokin duniya.
english: It will happen after the end of seventy years that Yahweh will visit Tyre. She will return to her wages, and will play the prostitute with all the kingdoms of the world on the surface of the earth.

hausa: Kada ku ci shi, don ku zauna lafiya, da ku da ’ya’yanku bayanku, gama za ku riƙa aikata abin da yake daidai a gaban Ubangiji.
english: You shall not eat it, that it may go well with you and with your children after you, when you do that which is right in Yahweh’s eyes.

hausa: Don haka, da wanda ya yi shuki, da wanda ya yi banruwa, ba a bakin kome suke ba, sai dai Allah kaɗai, mai sa abubuwa su yi girma.
english: So then neither he who plants is anything, nor he who waters, but God who gives the increase.

hausa: Da suka zo nan tare da ni, ban yi wani jinkiri ba, na kira zaman kotu kashegari kuma na umarta a kawo mutumin.
english: When therefore they had come together here, I didn’t delay, but on the next day sat on the judgment seat and commanded the man to be brought.

hausa: Za ku yi kaciya, za tă kuma zama alamar alkawari tsakanina da kai.
english: You shall be circumcised in the flesh of your foreskin. It will be a token of the covenant between me and you.

hausa: A can Ribla, a ƙasar Hamat, sarkin Babilon ya sa aka kashe su. Haka Yahuda ta tafi bauta daga ƙasarta.
english: The king of Babylon attacked them and put them to death at Riblah in the land of Hamath. So Judah was carried away captive out of his land.

hausa: Waɗanda dā suke shirin yin masa tambayoyi suka ja da baya nan da nan. Shugaban ƙungiyar sojan kansa ya tsorata da ya fahimci cewa ya sa wa Bulus, ɗan ƙasar Roma sarƙa.
english: Immediately those who were about to examine him departed from him, and the commanding officer also was afraid when he realized that he was a Roman, because he had bound him.

hausa: Tsawon kowane katako zai zama kamu goma, fāɗinsa kuma kamu ɗaya da rabi,
english: Ten cubits shall be the length of a board, and one and a half cubits the width of each board.

hausa: Za tă zama kango, busasshiya da kuma kango a gabana; ƙasar duka za tă zama kango domin ba wanda ya kula.
english: They have made it a desolation. It mourns to me, being desolate. The whole land is made desolate, because no one cares.

hausa: gāba da Kedorlayomer sarkin Elam, Tidal sarkin Goyim, Amrafel sarkin Shinar da Ariyok sarkin Ellasar; sarakuna huɗu gāba da biyar.
english: against Chedorlaomer king of Elam, Tidal king of Goiim, Amraphel king of Shinar, and Arioch king of Ellasar; four kings against the five.

hausa: Ba zan ji tsoro ko dubu goma suka ja dāgā gāba da ni a kowane gefe ba.
english: I will not be afraid of tens of thousands of people who have set themselves against me on every side.

hausa: Ka buɗe hannunka ka kuma ƙosar da sha’awar kowane abu mai rai.
english: You open your hand, and satisfy the desire of every living thing.

hausa: Teku ya kalla ya kuma gudu, Urdun ya juye da baya;
english: The sea saw it, and fled. The Jordan was driven back.

hausa: Sa’an nan, muka kama hanya daga Horeb muka ratsa wajen ƙasar tudun Amoriyawa ta dukan hamadarta mai fāɗi, da kuma mai bantsoron da kuka gani, muka kuma kai Kadesh Barneya yadda Ubangiji, Allahnmu ya umarce mu.
english: We traveled from Horeb and went through all that great and terrible wilderness which you saw, by the way to the hill country of the Amorites, as Yahweh our God commanded us; and we came to Kadesh Barnea.

hausa: Ga zuriyar Firistoci. Zuriyar Yedahiya (ta wurin iyalin Yeshuwa) 973
english: The priests: The children of Jedaiah, of the house of Jeshua: nine hundred seventy-three.

hausa: Sa’an nan na sauko daga dutsen, na kuma ajiye allunan a cikin akwatin da na yi, yadda Ubangiji ya umarce ni, kuma suna can a yanzu.
english: I turned and came down from the mountain, and put the tablets in the ark which I had made; and there they are as Yahweh commanded me.

hausa: “Amma in kuka juya baya kuka zama abokai ga waɗanda suka ragu suke zama a cikinku a ƙasashen nan, har kuka yi auratayya da su, kuka haɗa kai da su,
english: “But if you do at all go back, and hold fast to the remnant of these nations, even these who remain among you, and make marriages with them, and go in to them, and they to you;

hausa: “Ga abin da Sairus sarkin Farisa ya ce, “ ‘Ubangiji Allah na sama, ya ba ni dukan mulkokin duniya, ya kuma naɗa ni in gina masa haikali a Urushalima a Yahuda. Duk wani na mutanensa a cikinku, bari yă haura yă tafi, bari kuma Ubangiji Allahnsa yă kasance tare da shi.’ ”
english: “Cyrus king of Persia says, ‘Yahweh, the God of heaven, has given all the kingdoms of the earth to me; and he has commanded me to build him a house in Jerusalem, which is in Judah. Whoever there is among you of all his people, Yahweh his God be with him, and let him go up.’”

hausa: Zuriyar Simeyon ta ƙunshi Meshobab, da Yamlek, da Yosha ɗan Amaziya.
english: Meshobab, Jamlech, Joshah the son of Amaziah,

hausa: Ga aikinsu sa’ad da suke hidima a Tentin Sujada, za su ɗauki katakan tabanakul, sandunansa da dogayen sandunansa, da rammukansa,
english: This is the duty of their burden, according to all their service in the Tent of Meeting: the tabernacle’s boards, its bars, its pillars, its sockets,

hausa: Ku ci shi a tsattsarkan wuri, gama rabonka ne da na ’ya’yanka daga cikin hadayun da akan ƙone da wuta ga Ubangiji; gama haka aka umarce ni.
english: and you shall eat it in a holy place, because it is your portion, and your sons’ portion, of the offerings of Yahweh made by fire; for so I am commanded.

hausa: Duk mai ƙaunar horo yana ƙaunar sani, amma duk mai ƙin gyara wawa ne.
english: Whoever loves correction loves knowledge, but he who hates reproof is stupid.

hausa: Sai sarki ya kira masu dabo, masanan taurari da masu duba, a kawo su, ya kuma ce wa masu hikima na Babilon, “Duk wanda ya karanta wannan rubutu ya kuma faɗa mini abin da yake nufi, za a sa masa rigar shunayya, a kuma sa masa sarƙar zinariya a wuyansa, zai zama na uku a cikin masu mulkin ƙasar.”
english: The king cried aloud to bring in the enchanters, the Chaldeans, and the soothsayers. The king spoke and said to the wise men of Babylon, “Whoever reads this writing and shows me its interpretation shall be clothed with purple, and have a chain of gold about his neck, and shall be the third ruler in the kingdom.”

hausa: Ga abin da yake cikin wasiƙar annabi Irmiya da ya aika daga Urushalima zuwa ga sauran dattawan da suka ragu a cikin masu zaman bauta da kuma zuwa ga firistoci, annabawa da kuma dukan sauran mutanen da Nebukadnezzar ya kwashe zuwa zaman bauta daga Urushalima zuwa Babilon.
english: Now these are the words of the letter that Jeremiah the prophet sent from Jerusalem to the residue of the elders of the captivity, and to the priests, to the prophets, and to all the people whom Nebuchadnezzar had carried away captive from Jerusalem to Babylon,

hausa: Amma kai, ya Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka, ka yi da ni da kyau saboda sunanka; ta alherin ƙaunarka, ka cece ni.
english: But deal with me, Yahweh the Lord, for your name’s sake, because your loving kindness is good, deliver me;

hausa: Ku miƙa hadayun da suka dace ku kuma dogara ga Ubangiji.
english: Offer the sacrifices of righteousness. Put your trust in Yahweh.

hausa: A maimako, sai ɗaya daga cikin sojojin ya soki Yesu a gefe da māshi, nan take jini da ruwa suka fito.
english: However, one of the soldiers pierced his side with a spear, and immediately blood and water came out.

hausa: Ya yi mulki a bisa Isra’ila shekaru arba’in, shekaru bakwai a Hebron da kuma shekaru talatin da uku a Urushalima.
english: The time that he reigned over Israel was forty years; he reigned seven years in Hebron, and he reigned thirty-three years in Jerusalem.

hausa: Ya ce, “Zan ba ka dukan wannan, in za ka durƙusa ka yi mini sujada.”
english: He said to him, “I will give you all of these things, if you will fall down and worship me.”

hausa: Leɓunan gaskiya kan dawwama har abada, amma harshen ƙarya yakan dawwama na ɗan lokaci ne kawai.
english: Truth’s lips will be established forever, but a lying tongue is only momentary.

hausa: Amma Yesu ya ce masa, “Ka bi ni, ka bar matattu su binne matattunsu.”
english: But Jesus said to him, “Follow me, and leave the dead to bury their own dead.”

hausa: Saboda haka, gobe war haka, zan sa a yi ƙanƙara mai tsananin gaske, irin wadda Masar ba tă taɓa gani ba tun kahuwarta, har yă zuwa yanzu.
english: Behold, tomorrow about this time I will cause it to rain a very grievous hail, such as has not been in Egypt since the day it was founded even until now.

hausa: Kohatawa za su yi sansani a kudu da tabanakul.
english: The families of the sons of Kohath shall encamp on the south side of the tabernacle.

hausa: Sunan babbar Ohola, ƙanuwarta kuwa Oholiba. Sun zama nawa suka kuma haifi ’ya’ya maza da mata. Ohola ita ce Samariya, Oholiba kuwa ita ce Urushalima.
english: Their names were Oholah the elder, and Oholibah her sister. They became mine, and they bore sons and daughters. As for their names, Samaria is Oholah, and Jerusalem Oholibah.

hausa: Don kuwa, a wurin Allah mu ƙanshin Kiristi ne cikin waɗanda ake ceto, da kuma waɗanda suke hanyar hallaka.
english: For we are a sweet aroma of Christ to God in those who are being saved and in those who perish:

hausa: Bari Allah Maɗaukaki yă albarkace ka, yă kuma sa ka yi ta haihuwa ka riɓaɓɓanya har ka zama ƙungiyar jama’o’i.
english: May God Almighty bless you, and make you fruitful, and multiply you, that you may be a company of peoples,

hausa: “ ‘Ga abin da Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka yana cewa zan hukunta kamar yadda ya dace da ke, domin kin ƙyale rantsuwana ta wurin karya alkawari.
english: “‘For the Lord Yahweh says: “I will also deal with you as you have done, who have despised the oath in breaking the covenant.

hausa: Masu mugunta za su rusuna a gaban masu kirki, mugaye kuma za su yi haka a ƙofofin adalai.
english: The evil bow down before the good, and the wicked at the gates of the righteous.

hausa: Za ku zama masu albarka sa’ad da kuka shiga, za ku kuma zama masu albarka sa’ad da kuka fita.
english: You shall be blessed when you come in, and you shall be blessed when you go out.

hausa: Shawulu da Yonatan, a raye ƙaunatattu ne da kuma bansha’awa, a mace kuma ba su rabu ba. Sun fi gaggafa sauri, sun fi zaki ƙarfi.
english: Saul and Jonathan were lovely and pleasant in their lives. In their death, they were not divided. They were swifter than eagles. They were stronger than lions.

hausa: Sai dai kada ka haɗa da harabar waje; kada ka auna ta, domin an ba da ita ga Al’ummai. Za su tattaka birni mai tsarki har watanni 42.
english: Leave out the court which is outside of the temple, and don’t measure it, for it has been given to the nations. They will tread the holy city under foot for forty-two months.

hausa: Saboda haka ku tashi, bari mu fāɗa mata da dare mu rurrushe kagaranta!”
english: Arise! Let’s go up by night, and let’s destroy her palaces.”

hausa: dukan garuruwan da suke kan tudu da dukan masarautar Sihon sarkin Amoriyawa, wanda ya yi mulki a Heshbon. Musa ya yi nasara da shi, da shugabannin Midiyawa, wato, Ewi, Rekem, Zur, Hur, da Reba, sarakunan Sihon, waɗanda suka zauna a ƙasar.
english: all the cities of the plain, and all the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorites, who reigned in Heshbon, whom Moses struck with the chiefs of Midian, Evi, Rekem, Zur, Hur, and Reba, the princes of Sihon, who lived in the land.

hausa: Suka yi baƙin ciki ƙwarai, suka fara ce masa da ɗaya-ɗaya, “Gaskiya nake gaya muku, ɗayanku zai bashe ni.”
english: They were exceedingly sorrowful, and each began to ask him, “It isn’t me, is it, Lord?”

hausa: suka kashe Isra’ilawa wajen mutum talatin da shida, suka fafari Isra’ilawa tun daga bakin ƙofar birnin har zuwa wurin da ake fasa duwatsu. Suka karkashe su a gangare. Wannan ya sa zuciyar Isra’ilawa ta narke suka zama kamar ruwa.
english: The men of Ai struck about thirty-six men of them. They chased them from before the gate even to Shebarim, and struck them at the descent. The hearts of the people melted, and became like water.

hausa: Haƙoranki suna kama da garken tumakin da suke haurawa daga inda aka yi musu wanka. Kowanne yana tare da ɗan’uwansa; babu waninsu da yake shi kaɗai.
english: Your teeth are like a flock of ewes, which have come up from the washing, of which every one has twins; not one is bereaved among them.

hausa: A cikinsu, akwai Maryamu Magdalin, da Maryamu uwar Yaƙub da Yoses, da kuma uwar ’ya’yan Zebedi.
english: Among them were Mary Magdalene, Mary the mother of James and Joses, and the mother of the sons of Zebedee.

hausa: Sai Sarki Solomon ya tattara dattawan Urushalima a gabansa, da dukan shugabannin kabilu, da shugabannin iyalan Isra’ilawa, domin su kawo akwatin alkawarin Ubangiji daga Sihiyona, Birnin Dawuda.
english: Then Solomon assembled the elders of Israel with all the heads of the tribes, the princes of the fathers’ households of the children of Israel, to King Solomon in Jerusalem, to bring up the ark of Yahweh’s covenant out of David’s city, which is Zion.

hausa: ’Ya’yana ƙaunatattu, kada ku yarda wani yă ruɗe ku. Duk mai yin abin da yake daidai mai adalci ne, yadda Kiristi yake mai adalci.

hausa: Laban dai yana da ’ya’ya mata biyu; sunan babbar Liyatu, sunan ƙaramar kuwa Rahila.
english: Laban had two daughters. The name of the elder was Leah, and the name of the younger was Rachel.

hausa: “Bari idanunka su buɗe ga roƙon bawanka, ga roƙon mutanenka Isra’ila, bari kuma ka saurare su sa’ad da suka yi kuka gare ka.
english: that your eyes may be open to the supplication of your servant and to the supplication of your people Israel, to listen to them whenever they cry to you.

hausa: Sai Haruna ya komo wurin Musa a ƙofar Tentin Sujada, gama annobar ta ƙare.
english: Aaron returned to Moses to the door of the Tent of Meeting, and the plague was stopped.

hausa: Gama ru’uyar tana jiran ƙayyadadden lokaci; tana zancen ƙarshe kuma ba za tă zama ƙarya ba. Ko da ka ga kamar tana jinkiri, ka jira ta; lalle za tă zo, ba za tă makara ba.
english: For the vision is yet for the appointed time, and it hurries toward the end, and won’t prove false. Though it takes time, wait for it, because it will surely come. It won’t delay.

hausa: Yayinda kuke yin dukan waɗannan abubuwa, in ji Ubangiji, na yi muku magana sau da sau, amma ba ku ji ba; na kira ku, amma ba ku amsa ba.
english: Now, because you have done all these works,” says Yahweh, “and I spoke to you, rising up early and speaking, but you didn’t hear; and I called you, but you didn’t answer;

hausa: Solomon ya yi mulki a Urushalima a bisa dukan Isra’ila shekaru arba’in.
english: Solomon reigned in Jerusalem over all Israel forty years.

hausa: Yau ga yadda suke so su biya mu. Su suke so su kore mu daga ƙasar da ka ba mu gādo.
english: behold, how they reward us, to come to cast us out of your possession, which you have given us to inherit.

hausa: Jinƙai, salama da kuma ƙauna, su kasance tare da ku a yalwace.
english: May mercy, peace, and love be multiplied to you.

hausa: Ta ba shi suna Yusuf, ta kuma ce, “Bari Ubangiji yă ƙara mini wani ɗa.”
english: She named him Joseph, saying, “May Yahweh add another son to me.”

hausa: Gama na ce, “Kada ka bar su su yi farin ciki a kaina ko su yi kirari a kaina sa’ad da ƙafata ta yi santsi.”
english: For I said, “Don’t let them gloat over me, or exalt themselves over me when my foot slips.”

hausa: Na ɓoye maganarka a cikin zuciyata don kada in yi maka zunubi.
english: I have hidden your word in my heart, that I might not sin against you.

hausa: Akwai wani mai tā-da-na-zaune-tsaye, sunansa Sheba, ɗan Bikri, daga kabilar Benyamin, a wurin. Sai ya busa ƙaho, ya yi ihu ya ce, “Ba mu da rabo a wurin Dawuda, ba mu da sashe a wurin ɗan Yesse! Kowa yă nufi tentinsa, ya Isra’ila!”
english: There happened to be there a wicked fellow, whose name was Sheba the son of Bichri, a Benjamite; and he blew the trumpet, and said, “We have no portion in David, neither have we inheritance in the son of Jesse. Every man to his tents, Israel!”

hausa: “Yanzu, ɗana, Ubangiji ya kasance tare da kai, bari kuma ka yi nasara ka kuma gina gidan Ubangiji Allahnka, kamar yadda ya ce za ka yi.
english: Now, my son, may Yahweh be with you and prosper you, and build the house of Yahweh your God, as he has spoken concerning you.

hausa: Sa’ad da Mikahiya ɗan Gemariya, ɗan Shafan, ya ji dukan maganar Ubangiji daga littafin,
english: When Micaiah the son of Gemariah, the son of Shaphan, had heard out of the book all Yahweh’s words,

hausa: Yanzu na zama abokin gābanku don na faɗa muku gaskiya ke nan?
english: So then, have I become your enemy by telling you the truth?

hausa: Kowane haihuwar fari, ta mutum, ko ta dabba da suka miƙa wa Ubangiji, naka ne. Amma ka fanshi kowace haihuwar fari ta mutum, ko ta dabbar da take haram.
english: Everything that opens the womb, of all flesh which they offer to Yahweh, both of man and animal, shall be yours. Nevertheless, you shall surely redeem the firstborn of man, and you shall redeem the firstborn of unclean animals.

hausa: Ku faɗa wa masu adalci cewa kome zai zama musu da kyau, gama za su ji daɗin aikin da hannuwansu suka yi.
english: Tell the righteous that it will be well with them, for they will eat the fruit of their deeds.

hausa: Ubangiji ya ce masa, “Na ji addu’arka da kuma roƙon da ka yi a gabana; na tsarkake wannan haikali wanda ka gina, ta wurinsa Sunana zai kasance a can har abada. Idanuna da zuciyata kullum za su kasance a can.
english: Yahweh said to him, “I have heard your prayer and your supplication that you have made before me. I have made this house holy, which you have built, to put my name there forever; and my eyes and my heart shall be there perpetually.

hausa: Mutane masu mugun zuciya za su nesa da ni; ba abin da zai haɗa ni da mugunta.
english: A perverse heart will be far from me. I will have nothing to do with evil.

hausa: suka ce wa Musa, “Ka yi magana da mu da kanka, za mu kasa kunne. Amma kada Allah ya yi mana magana, don kada mu mutu.”
english: They said to Moses, “Speak with us yourself, and we will listen; but don’t let God speak with us, lest we die.”

hausa: Sa’an nan Sarki Dariyus ya rubuta wa dukan mutane, da al’ummai da kuma mutanen dukan harsunan a duk fāɗin ƙasar. “Bari yă yi nasara sosai!
english: Then King Darius wrote to all the peoples, nations, and languages who dwell in all the earth: “Peace be multiplied to you.

hausa: Don me wani a cikinku zai yi shakka cewa Allah yana tā da matattu?
english: Why is it judged incredible with you if God does raise the dead?

hausa: Ubangiji kuwa ya sa Isra’ilawa suka yi farin jini a wurin Masarawa, Masarawa kuma suka saki hannu wa mutanen, suka ba su duk abin da suka roƙa; ta haka Isra’ilawa suka washe Masarawa.
english: Yahweh gave the people favor in the sight of the Egyptians, so that they let them have what they asked. They plundered the Egyptians.

hausa: Dukansu suka ƙulla su zo, su yi yaƙi da Urushalima, su tā da hankali a cikinta.
english: and they all conspired together to come and fight against Jerusalem, and to cause confusion among us.

hausa: Hiram kuwa ya aika wa sarki talenti 120 na zinariya.
english: Hiram sent to the king one hundred twenty talents of gold.

hausa: Sa’ad da hayaniyar ta kwanta, sai Bulus ya aika a kira almajiran, kuma bayan ya ƙarfafa su, sai ya yi bankwana ya tafi Makidoniya.
english: After the uproar had ceased, Paul sent for the disciples, took leave of them, and departed to go into Macedonia.

hausa: Demetiriyus yana da shaida mai kyau daga wurin kowa, har gaskiya kanta ma ta shaide shi. Mu ma muna ba da shaida mai kyau a kansa, ka kuma san cewa shaidarmu gaskiya ce.
english: Demetrius has the testimony of all, and of the truth itself; yes, we also testify, and you know that our testimony is true.

hausa: Duk ’yan’uwansa mata kuma ba tare da mu suke ba? To, a ina wannan mutum ya sami dukan waɗannan abubuwa?”
english: Aren’t all of his sisters with us? Where then did this man get all of these things?”

hausa: Ga abin da Ubangiji Allahna ya ce, “Yi kiwon garken tumakin da za a yanka.
english: Yahweh my God says: “Feed the flock of slaughter.

hausa: Tana kāriya kullum, tana amincewa kullum, tana bege kullum, tana jimrewa kullum.
english: bears all things, believes all things, hopes all things, and endures all things.

hausa: Mijinta yana da cikakken amincewa da ita kuma ba ya rasa wani abu mai daraja.
english: The heart of her husband trusts in her. He shall have no lack of gain.

hausa: Mutum ya kawo ƙarshen duhu; yakan bincike zuzzurfar iyaka, yana neman duwatsu a wuri mafi duhu.
english: Man sets an end to darkness, and searches out, to the furthest bound, the stones of obscurity and of thick darkness.

hausa: Matasan da suka yi girma tare shi suka amsa, “Faɗa wa mutanen da suke ce maka, ‘Mahaifinka ya sa kaya masu nauyi a kanmu, amma ka sauƙaƙa nauyinmu.’ Ka faɗa musu, ‘Ƙaramin yatsana ya fi ƙugun mahaifina kauri.
english: The young men who had grown up with him spoke to him, saying, “Thus you shall tell the people who spoke to you, saying, ‘Your father made our yoke heavy, but make it lighter on us;’ thus you shall say to them, ‘My little finger is thicker than my father’s waist.

hausa: “Daga jinin waɗanda aka kashe, daga tsokar naman jarumi, bakan Yonatan bai juye baya ba, takobin Shawulu bai komo ba tare da gamsuwa ba.
english: From the blood of the slain, from the fat of the mighty, Jonathan’s bow didn’t turn back. Saul’s sword didn’t return empty.

hausa: An kama matan Dawuda, wato, Ahinowam daga Yezireyel da Abigiyel matar Nabal mutumin Karmel wanda ya rasu.
english: David’s two wives were taken captive, Ahinoam the Jezreelitess, and Abigail the wife of Nabal the Carmelite.

hausa: Yaya wani zai sani ko ka ji daɗina da kuma mutanenka, in ba ka tafi tare da mu ba? Mene ne kuma zai bambanta ni da mutanenka daga sauran jama’ar da suke a duniya?”
english: For how would people know that I have found favor in your sight, I and your people? Isn’t it that you go with us, so that we are separated, I and your people, from all the people who are on the surface of the earth?”

hausa: Gama Ubangiji yana da ranar ɗaukar fansa, shekarar ramuwa, don biya wa Sihiyona bukata.
english: For Yahweh has a day of vengeance, a year of recompense for the cause of Zion.

hausa: Me ya sa ba za ka gafarta mini laifofina ba? Gama na kusa kwantawa cikin ƙasa; za ka neme ni, amma ba za ka same ni ba.”
english: Why do you not pardon my disobedience, and take away my iniquity? For now will I lie down in the dust. You will seek me diligently, but I will not be.”

hausa: “Ɗan mutum, ka kafa fuskarka wajen kudu; ka yi wa’azi a kan kudu ka kuma yi annabci a kan kurmin ƙasar kudu.
english: “Son of man, set your face toward the south, and preach toward the south, and prophesy against the forest of the field in the south.

hausa: Ubangiji ya kafa mulkin a ƙarƙashin ikonsa; dukan Yahuda kuwa suka kawo kyautai wa Yehoshafat, ta haka ya yi arziki sosai da kuma girma.
english: Therefore Yahweh established the kingdom in his hand. All Judah brought tribute to Jehoshaphat, and he had riches and honor in abundance.

hausa: A dama za su ci, amma su ci gaba da jin yunwa; a hagu za su ci, amma ba za su ƙoshi ba. Kowa zai mai da naman ’ya’yansa abinci.
english: One will devour on the right hand, and be hungry; and he will eat on the left hand, and they will not be satisfied. Everyone will eat the flesh of his own arm:

hausa: Ku gode wa Ubangiji, gama nagari ne shi; ƙaunarsa madawwamiya ce har abada.
english: Oh give thanks to Yahweh, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.

hausa: Sai ya kira ta Shiba, don haka har wa yau ana kira garin Beyersheba.
english: He called it “Shibah”. Therefore the name of the city is “Beersheba” to this day.

hausa: “Ku ratsa cikin gonakin inabinta ku cinye su, amma kada ku hallaka su gaba ɗaya. Ku kakkaɓe rassanta, gama waɗannan mutane ba na Ubangiji ba ne.
english: “Go up on her walls, and destroy, but don’t make a full end. Take away her branches, for they are not Yahweh’s.

hausa: Elihoref da Ahiya, ’ya’yan Shisha maza, su ne marubuta. Yehoshafat ɗan Ahilud, shi ne mai lura da takardu.
english: Elihoreph and Ahijah, the sons of Shisha, scribes; Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud, the recorder;

hausa: Baranyar Liyatu, Zilfa ta haifa wa Yaƙub ɗa.
english: Zilpah, Leah’s servant, bore Jacob a son.

hausa: In kuwa ina da wani laifin da ya isa kisa, ban ƙi in mutu ba. Amma in ƙarar da waɗannan Yahudawa suka kawo a kaina ba gaskiya ba ne, ba wanda yake da iko ya ba da ni a gare su. Na ɗaukaka ƙara zuwa gaban Kaisar!”
english: For if I have done wrong and have committed anything worthy of death, I don’t refuse to die; but if none of those things is true that they accuse me of, no one can give me up to them. I appeal to Caesar!”

hausa: Ibrahim ya ɗaga ido, ya duba, sai ya ga rago da ƙahoninsa a kafe a wani ɗan kurmi. Sai Ibrahim ya tafi ya kamo ragon ya miƙa shi hadaya ta ƙonawa a maimakon ɗansa.
english: Abraham lifted up his eyes, and looked, and saw that behind him was a ram caught in the thicket by his horns. Abraham went and took the ram, and offered him up for a burnt offering instead of his son.

hausa: Sai Liyatu ta ce, “Allah ya sāka mini saboda na ba da mai hidimata ga mijina.” Saboda haka ta ba shi suna Issakar.
english: Leah said, “God has given me my hire, because I gave my servant to my husband.” She named him Issachar.

hausa: “Ni ne makiyayi mai kyau; na san tumakina, tumakina kuma sun san ni,
english: I am the good shepherd. I know my own, and I’m known by my own;

hausa: Sa’an nan Ayuba ya amsa,
english: Then Job answered,

hausa: Yesu ya kira su wuri ɗaya ya ce, “Kun san cewa masu mulkin Al’ummai sukan nuna musu iko, hakimansu kuma sukan gasa musu iko.
english: But Jesus summoned them, and said, “You know that the rulers of the nations lord it over them, and their great ones exercise authority over them.

hausa: Mutanen Betlehem da na Netofa 188
english: The men of Bethlehem and Netophah: one hundred eighty-eight.

hausa: Ya kasance a ɓoye, shi da mai lura da shi, a haikalin Ubangiji shekara shida yayinda Ataliya take mulkin ƙasar.
english: He was with her hidden in Yahweh’s house six years while Athaliah reigned over the land.

hausa: Ka naɗa mugun mutum yă yi hamayya da shi; bari mai zargi yă tsaya a hannun damansa.
english: Set a wicked man over him. Let an adversary stand at his right hand.

hausa: Ka bi da ni, ya Ubangiji, cikin adalcinka saboda abokan gābana, ka fayyace hanyarka a gabana.
english: Lead me, Yahweh, in your righteousness because of my enemies. Make your way straight before my face.

hausa: Waɗannan su ne mutanen da Dawuda ya sa su lura da waƙa a cikin gidan Ubangiji bayan da aka kawo akwatin alkawari yă huta a can.
english: These are they whom David set over the service of song in Yahweh’s house after the ark came to rest there.

hausa: Ya zo a matsayin mai shaida domin yă ba da shaida game da wannan haske, don ta wurinsa dukan mutane su ba da gaskiya.
english: The same came as a witness, that he might testify about the light, that all might believe through him.

hausa: “Saboda haka, ya gidan Isra’ila, zan hukunta ku, kowa bisa ga hanyarsa, in ji Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka. Ku tuba! Ku juye daga dukan laifofinku; sa’an nan zunubi ba zai zama sanadin fāɗuwarku ba.
english: “Therefore I will judge you, house of Israel, everyone according to his ways,” says the Lord Yahweh. “Return, and turn yourselves from all your transgressions, so iniquity will not be your ruin.

hausa: In ɗaya ne kaɗai aka busa, sai shugabannin kabilan Isra’ila, su taru a gabanka.
english: If they blow just one, then the princes, the heads of the thousands of Israel, shall gather themselves to you.

hausa: “Akwai abubuwa uku da suke jan jiki da kuma taƙama a tafiyarsu abubuwa huɗu waɗanda suke kwarjini da taƙama a tafiyarsu,
english: “There are three things which are stately in their march, four which are stately in going:

hausa: Ya kamata a adana abincin nan don ƙasar, kāriya shekaru bakwai na yunwa, domin a yi amfani da shi a lokacin shekarun yunwan da za su zo wa Masar, saboda kada ƙasar ta lalace da yunwa.”
english: The food will be to supply the land against the seven years of famine, which will be in the land of Egypt; so that the land will not perish through the famine.”

hausa: Ka ɗauke bulalarka daga gare ni; na ji jiki ta wurin bugun da hannunka ya yi mini.
english: Remove your scourge away from me. I am overcome by the blow of your hand.

hausa: Ka ji haushin koguna ne, ya Ubangiji? Ko kuwa ka hasala da rafuffuka ne? Ko ka yi fushi da teku ne sa’ad da ka hau dawakanka da kuma kekunan yaƙinka masu nasara?
english: Was Yahweh displeased with the rivers? Was your anger against the rivers, or your wrath against the sea, that you rode on your horses, on your chariots of salvation?

hausa: don su ɗau fansa a kan al’ummai da kuma hukunci a kan mutane,
english: to execute vengeance on the nations, and punishments on the peoples;

hausa: Ruwayen da suke kewaye da ni sun yi mini barazana, zurfi kuma ya kewaye ni, ciyayin ruwa suna nannaɗe kewaye da ni.
english: The waters surrounded me, even to the soul. The deep was around me. The weeds were wrapped around my head.

hausa: Sa’an nan ya ce mini, “Ɗan mutum, zan yanke tanadin abinci a Urushalima. Mutane za su auna abincin da za su ci da tsoro su kuma auna ruwan da za su sha cikin fargaba,
english: Moreover he said to me, “Son of man, behold, I will break the staff of bread in Jerusalem. They will eat bread by weight, and with fearfulness. They will drink water by measure, and in dismay;

hausa: Sai maganar Ubangiji ta zo mini sau na biyu cewa,
english: Yahweh’s word came to me the second time, saying,

hausa: ’Ya’yan Gomer maza su ne, Ashkenaz, Rifat da Togarma.
english: The sons of Gomer: Ashkenaz, Diphath, and Togarmah.

hausa: ’Ya’yan Haruna maza waɗanda suke firistoci za su hura wuta a bagade, su kuma shirya itace a kan wutar.
english: The sons of Aaron the priest shall put fire on the altar, and lay wood in order on the fire;

hausa: Miktam ne na Dawuda. Ka kiyaye ni, ya Allah, gama a cikinka nake samun mafaka.
english: A Poem by David. Preserve me, God, for I take refuge in you.

hausa: Amma ni, sa’ad da aka ɗaga ni daga ƙasa, zan ja dukan mutane gare ni.”
english: And I, if I am lifted up from the earth, will draw all people to myself.”

hausa: Za su yi mulkin ƙasar Assuriya da takobi, ƙasar Nimrod kuma da zaran takobi. Zai cece mu daga hannun Assuriyawa sa’ad da suka kawo wa ƙasarmu hari suka kuma tattake zuwa cikin iyakokinmu.
english: They will rule the land of Assyria with the sword, and the land of Nimrod in its gates. He will deliver us from the Assyrian, when he invades our land, and when he marches within our border.

hausa: Ba za ku kuma karɓi irin waɗannan dabbobi daga hannun baƙi ku miƙa su a matsayin abinci ga Allahnku ba. Ba za su zama yardajje a madadinku ba, domin sun naƙasa, suna kuma da lahani.’ ”
english: You must not offer any of these as the bread of your God from the hand of a foreigner, because their corruption is in them. There is a defect in them. They shall not be accepted for you.’”

hausa: Ina yabonku saboda kuna tunawa da ni a cikin kowane abu, kuna kuma riƙe da koyarwar, yadda na ba ku.
english: Now I praise you, brothers, that you remember me in all things, and hold firm the traditions, even as I delivered them to you.

hausa: “Ku ji maganata, ku masu hikima; ku saurare ni, ku masu ilimi.
english: “Hear my words, you wise men. Give ear to me, you who have knowledge.
