hausa: Baƙin ciki zai ƙaru wa waɗanda suke bin waɗansu alloli. Ba zan zuba musu hadayarsu ta jini ba ko in ambaci sunayensu da bakina.
english: Their sorrows shall be multiplied who give gifts to another god. Their drink offerings of blood I will not offer, nor take their names on my lips.

hausa: Da masu bin Yesu suka ga abin da zai faru, sai suka ce, “Ubangiji, mu yi sara da takubanmu ne?”
english: When those who were around him saw what was about to happen, they said to him, “Lord, shall we strike with the sword?”

hausa: Jarumawa sun zube kamar ganima sun yi barcinsu na ƙarshe; ba ko jarumi guda da zai iya ɗaga hannuwansa.
english: Valiant men lie plundered, they have slept their last sleep. None of the men of war can lift their hands.

hausa: Don mai bi da kaɗe-kaɗe. Da kayan kiɗi masu tsirkiya. Wani maskil ta Dawuda. Ka ji addu’ata, ya Allah, kada ka ƙyale roƙona;
english: For the Chief Musician. On stringed instruments. A contemplation by David. Listen to my prayer, God. Don’t hide yourself from my supplication.

hausa: Waɗannan ƙa’idodi sun shafi sha’anin abinci da abin sha ne kawai da kuma ƙa’idodi tsarkake kanmu. Dokoki game da abubuwa na waje da ake amfani da su za su kasance ne sai lokacin ya yi da za a kawo abu mafi kyau.
english: being only (with foods and drinks and various washings) fleshly ordinances, imposed until a time of reformation.

hausa: Sa’an nan Bitrus ya fara magana ya ce, “Yanzu na gane yadda gaskiya ne cewa Allah ba ya sonkai
english: Peter opened his mouth and said, “Truly I perceive that God doesn’t show favoritism;

hausa: Amma na kira ga Allah, Ubangiji kuwa ya cece ni.
english: As for me, I will call on God. Yahweh will save me.

hausa: Sa’ad da aka yanki ingirci sabon toho kuma ya bayyana aka kuma tattara ciyawa daga tuddai,
english: The hay is removed, and the new growth appears, the grasses of the hills are gathered in.

hausa: Amma in ka faɗakar da mugun mutumin don yă juye daga hanyoyinsa bai kuwa yi haka ba, zai mutu saboda zunubinsa, amma kai za ka kuɓutar da kanka.
english: Nevertheless, if you warn the wicked of his way to turn from it, and he doesn’t turn from his way; he will die in his iniquity, but you have delivered your soul.

hausa: Saboda girmana, saboda girmana, na yi haka. Yaya zan ƙyale a ƙazantar da kaina? Ba zan raba ɗaukakata da wani ba.
english: For my own sake, for my own sake, I will do it; for how would my name be profaned? I will not give my glory to another.

hausa: Ubangiji Maɗaukaki ya furta a kunnuwana, “Tabbatacce manyan gidajen za su zama kango, za a bar kyawawan gidajen nan ba kowa.
english: In my ears, Yahweh of Armies says: “Surely many houses will be desolate, even great and beautiful, unoccupied.

hausa: “To, daga ina ke nan hikima ta fito? Ina fahimta take zama?
english: Where then does wisdom come from? Where is the place of understanding?

hausa: Duk wanda ya ce wa mai laifi, “Ba ka da laifi”, mutane za su la’ance shi al’umma kuma za tă ce ba a san shi ba.
english: He who says to the wicked, “You are righteous,” peoples will curse him, and nations will abhor him—

hausa: Ganin taron mutane, sai ya hau kan gefen dutse ya zauna. Almajiransa kuwa suka zo wurinsa,
english: Seeing the multitudes, he went up onto the mountain. When he had sat down, his disciples came to him.

hausa: Daniyel ya ce, “A cikin wahayina da dare na duba, a gabana kuwa ga kusurwoyi huɗu na sama suna gurɓata babban teku.
english: Daniel spoke and said, “I saw in my vision by night, and, behold, the four winds of the sky broke out on the great sea.

hausa: “Tubalai sun zube a ƙasa, amma za mu sāke gina su da dutse; an sassare itatuwan ɓaure, amma za mu maya su da al’ul.”
english: “The bricks have fallen, but we will build with cut stone. The sycamore fig trees have been cut down, but we will put cedars in their place.”

hausa: Tarko ne ga mutum ya keɓe wani abu da ba tunani daga baya kuma ya yi la’akari da alkawarinsa.
english: It is a snare to a man to make a rash dedication, then later to consider his vows.

hausa: “Wani daga cikin zuriyarta zai taso yă ɗauki matsayinta. Zai kai wa sojojin sarkin Arewa hari yă kuma shiga kagararsa; zai yi yaƙi da su yă kuma yi nasara.
english: “But out of a shoot from her roots one will stand up in his place, who will come to the army and will enter into the fortress of the king of the north, and will deal against them and will prevail.

hausa: Gama kamar yadda ta wurin rashin biyayyar mutum guda, mutane masu yawa suka zama masu zunubi, haka kuma ta wurin biyayyar mutum guda, mutane da yawa za su zama masu adalci.
english: For as through the one man’s disobedience many were made sinners, even so through the obedience of the one, many will be made righteous.

hausa: ’Ya’yan Zibeyon maza su ne, Aiya da Ana. Wannan shi ne Ana wanda ya sami maɓulɓulan ruwan zafi a hamada yayinda yake kiwon jakuna na mahaifinsa Zibeyon.
english: These are the children of Zibeon: Aiah and Anah. This is Anah who found the hot springs in the wilderness, as he fed the donkeys of Zibeon his father.

hausa: Saboda haka zan haɗa ka da kakanninka, za a kuma binne ka cikin salama. Idanunka kuma ba za su ga dukan wannan masifan da zan jawo wa wurin nan ba.’ ” Sai suka kai wa sarki abin da ta faɗa.
english: ‘Therefore behold, I will gather you to your fathers, and you will be gathered to your grave in peace. Your eyes will not see all the evil which I will bring on this place.’”’” So they brought this message back to the king.

hausa: In kuma wurin bai canja ba, bai kuma yaɗu cikin fatar jikin ba amma ya bushe, kumburi ne daga ƙuna, firist ɗin kuwa zai furta shi tsarkakakke; tabo ne kawai daga ƙuna.
english: If the bright spot stays in its place, and hasn’t spread in the skin, but is faded, it is the swelling from the burn, and the priest shall pronounce him clean, for it is the scar from the burn.

hausa: Sa’ad da kuka ga wannan, zuciyarku za tă yi farin ciki za ku kuma haɓaka kamar ciyawa; za a sanar da hannun Ubangiji ga bayinsa, amma za a nuna wa maƙiyansa fushinsa.
english: You will see it, and your heart shall rejoice, and your bones will flourish like the tender grass. Yahweh’s hand will be known among his servants; and he will have indignation against his enemies.

hausa: Ya kuma tattara dukan shugabannin Isra’ila a wuri ɗaya, haka kuma ya yi da firistoci da Lawiyawa.
english: He gathered together all the princes of Israel, with the priests and the Levites.

hausa: “Duk wannan na faɗa ne yayinda ina tare da ku.
english: “I have said these things to you while still living with you.

hausa: Suka ce, “Ranka yă daɗe, mun zo nan ƙaro na farko don mu saya abinci,
english: and said, “Oh, my lord, we indeed came down the first time to buy food.

hausa: Ya sāke yin barci, sai ya yi mafarki na biyu; ya ga kawuna bakwai na dawa, ƙosassu masu kyau, suka yi girma a kara guda.
english: He slept and dreamed a second time; and behold, seven heads of grain came up on one stalk, healthy and good.

hausa: Sa’an nan ya auna hanyar shiga daga saman bangon ɗaki a baya zuwa saman ɗakin da yake ɗaura da shi; nisansu kamu ashirin da biyar ne daga bango zuwa bango.
english: He measured the gate from the roof of the one side room to the roof of the other, a width of twenty-five cubits, door against door.

hausa: Zan yi maganar farillanka a gaban sarakuna ba kuwa za a kunyata ni ba,
english: I will also speak of your statutes before kings, and will not be disappointed.

hausa: “Ga abin da za ka yi don ka keɓe su, don su yi mini hidima a matsayin firistoci. Ka ɗauki ɗan bijimi da raguna biyu marasa lahani.
english: “This is the thing that you shall do to them to make them holy, to minister to me in the priest’s office: take one young bull and two rams without defect,

hausa: Yoktan shi ne mahaifin Almodad, Shelef, Hazarmawet, Yera
english: Joktan became the father of Almodad, Sheleph, Hazarmaveth, Jerah,

hausa: Elizafan ɗan Farnak, shugaba daga kabilar Zebulun;
english: Of the tribe of the children of Zebulun a prince, Elizaphan the son of Parnach.

hausa: Kada yă ruɗi kansa ta wurin dogara ga abin da ba shi da amfani domin ba zai samu wani abu ba daga ciki.
english: Let him not trust in emptiness, deceiving himself, for emptiness will be his reward.

hausa: Sai maganar Ubangiji ta sāke zuwa wa Zakariya cewa,
english: Yahweh’s word came to Zechariah, saying,

hausa: “Daga zuriyar mutumin nan ne Allah ya kawo wa Isra’ila Mai Ceto Yesu, kamar yadda ya yi alkawari.
english: From this man’s offspring, God has brought salvation to Israel according to his promise,

hausa: Ya sa su a wurarensu har abada abadin; ya ba da umarnin da ba zai taɓa shuɗe ba.
english: He has also established them forever and ever. He has made a decree which will not pass away.

hausa: “Haruna zai ƙone turare a bisa bagaden kowace safiya, sa’ad da yake shirya fitilu.
english: Aaron shall burn incense of sweet spices on it every morning. When he tends the lamps, he shall burn it.

hausa: gama za a kakkarya ikon mugaye, amma Ubangiji zai riƙe mai adalci.
english: For the arms of the wicked shall be broken, but Yahweh upholds the righteous.

hausa: Daga can sai Kaleb ya kori ’ya’yan Anak, maza su uku daga Hebron, wato, Sheshai, Ahiman da Talmai.
english: Caleb drove out the three sons of Anak: Sheshai, and Ahiman, and Talmai, the children of Anak.

hausa: Sai ya fara magana gabagadi a majami’a. Sa’ad da Firiskila da Akwila suka ji shi, sai suka gayyace shi gidansu suka ƙara bayyana masa hanyar Allah sosai.
english: He began to speak boldly in the synagogue. But when Priscilla and Aquila heard him, they took him aside, and explained to him the way of God more accurately.

hausa: Gama ga abin da Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka yana cewa domin kun tafa hannuwanku kuka kuma buga ƙafafunku, kuna farin ciki don nuna dukan ƙiyayyarku a kan ƙasar Isra’ila,
english: For the Lord Yahweh says: “Because you have clapped your hands, stamped with the feet, and rejoiced with all the contempt of your soul against the land of Israel,

hausa: don a cika abin da aka faɗa ta bakin annabi Ishaya cewa,
english: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through Isaiah the prophet, saying,

hausa: A ba da uku a wannan gefe na Urdun, a kuma ba da uku a Kan’ana, su zama biranen mafaka.
english: You shall give three cities beyond the Jordan, and you shall give three cities in the land of Canaan. They shall be cities of refuge.

hausa: Waɗansunku suna tsammani ba zan zo wurinku ba har suna ɗagankai.
english: Now some are puffed up, as though I were not coming to you.

hausa: An hana ni salama; na manta da ko mene ne ake kira wadata.
english: You have removed my soul far away from peace. I forgot prosperity.

hausa: Gama mutane da yawa za su zo cikin sunana, suna cewa, ‘Ni ne Kiristi,’ za su kuwa ruɗi mutane da yawa.
english: For many will come in my name, saying, ‘I am the Christ,’ and will lead many astray.

hausa: ’Yan aika suka tafi gari-gari a cikin Efraim da Manasse, har zuwa Zebulun, amma mutane suka yi musu dariyar reni, suka kuma yi musu ba’a.
english: So the couriers passed from city to city through the country of Ephraim and Manasseh, even to Zebulun, but people ridiculed them and mocked them.

hausa: Wace ce wannan da ta bayyana sai ka ce ketowar alfijir? Kyakkyawa kamar wata, mai haske kamar rana, mai daraja kamar taurari a jere?
english: Who is she who looks out as the morning, beautiful as the moon, clear as the sun, and awesome as an army with banners?

hausa: Sai Ubangiji ya bashe Yehohiyakim sarkin Yahuda a hannunsa, tare da waɗansu kayayyakin haikalin Allah. Ya ɗauki waɗannan kayan zuwa cikin haikalin allahnsa a Babilon cikin ma’ajin gidan allahnsa.
english: The Lord gave Jehoiakim king of Judah into his hand, with some of the vessels of the house of God; and he carried them into the land of Shinar to the house of his god. He brought the vessels into the treasure house of his god.

hausa: Sai ya ce, “Gaskiya ina faɗa muku, wacce nan gwauruwa matalauciya ta sa fiye da dukan sauran.
english: He said, “Truly I tell you, this poor widow put in more than all of them,

hausa: Amma Sama’ila ya ce, “Ubangiji yana murna da sadaka da hadaya fiye da biyayya ga maganar Ubangiji? Yin biyayya ta fi hadaya a kula kuma ta fi ƙibabbun raguna.
english: Samuel said, “Has Yahweh as great delight in burnt offerings and sacrifices, as in obeying Yahweh’s voice? Behold, to obey is better than sacrifice, and to listen than the fat of rams.

hausa: ’Ya’yansa maza sukan yi biki a gidajensu, wannan yă yi yă ba wancan, sai su kira ’yan’uwansu mata ukun su ci, su sha tare.
english: His sons went and held a feast in the house of each one on his birthday; and they sent and called for their three sisters to eat and to drink with them.

hausa: Ya mai da ruwaye suka zama jini, ya sa kifayensu suka mutu.
english: He turned their waters into blood, and killed their fish.

hausa: Gama ga abin da Ubangiji yana cewa game da ’ya’ya maza da matan da aka haifa a wannan ƙasa da kuma game da matan da suke iyayensu da suke mazan da iyayensu.
english: For Yahweh says concerning the sons and concerning the daughters who are born in this place, and concerning their mothers who bore them, and concerning their fathers who became their father in this land:

hausa: Eliyasaf ɗan Layel shi ne shugaban iyalan Gershonawa.
english: Eliasaph the son of Lael shall be the prince of the fathers’ house of the Gershonites.

hausa: kuma bakinki ya yi kamar ruwan inabi mafi kyau. Ƙaunatacciya Bari ruwan inabi yă wuce kai tsaye zuwa ga ƙaunataccena, yana gudu a hankali a leɓuna da kuma haƙora.
english: Your mouth is like the best wine, that goes down smoothly for my beloved, gliding through the lips of those who are asleep.

hausa: Duk wanda yake nasa a cikinku bari Allahnsa yă kasance tare da shi, bari yă tafi Urushalima cikin Yahuda yă gina haikalin Ubangiji, Allah na Isra’ila, Allah wanda yake a Urushalima.
english: Whoever there is among you of all his people, may his God be with him, and let him go up to Jerusalem, which is in Judah, and build the house of Yahweh, the God of Israel (he is God), which is in Jerusalem.

hausa: A ranar da yaƙi ya tashi, ba a sami wanda yake da takobi ko māshi ba a cikin mutanen da suke tare da Shawulu da Yonatan. Sai dai Shawulu da ɗansa Yonatan kaɗai.
english: So it came to pass in the day of battle that neither sword nor spear was found in the hand of any of the people who were with Saul and Jonathan; but Saul and Jonathan his son had them.

hausa: Wata rana Na’omi surukar Rut ta ce mata, “’Yata, bai kamata in nema miki gida, inda za a tanada miki da kyau?
english: Naomi her mother-in-law said to her, “My daughter, shall I not seek rest for you, that it may be well with you?

hausa: Ina cikin dubawa, sai ga wannan ƙaho yana yaƙi da tsarkaka yana kuma cin nasara a kansu,
english: I saw, and the same horn made war with the saints, and prevailed against them,

hausa: Amma za a karye ’yan tawaye da masu zunubi, waɗanda suka rabu da Ubangiji kuma za su hallaka.
english: But the destruction of transgressors and sinners shall be together, and those who forsake Yahweh shall be consumed.

hausa: Da Filistiyawa suka ji labari an shafe Dawuda sarki a bisa Isra’ila, sai suka haura da ƙarfi sosai don su nema shi, amma Dawuda ya ji labarin sai ya gangara zuwa mafaka.
english: When the Philistines heard that they had anointed David king over Israel, all the Philistines went up to seek David, but David heard about it and went down to the stronghold.

hausa: Tobiya wakilin mutanen Ammon wanda yake a gefensa ya ce, “Abin nan da suke gini, ko dila ma ya hau, zai rushe shi!”
english: Now Tobiah the Ammonite was by him, and he said, “What they are building, if a fox climbed up it, he would break down their stone wall.”

hausa: “Ni baƙo ne, kuma baƙo a cikinku. Ku sayar mini da wani wuri yă zama wurin binnewa a nan, domin in binne mataccena.”
english: “I am a stranger and a foreigner living with you. Give me a possession of a burying-place with you, that I may bury my dead out of my sight.”

hausa: Garuruwan nan da ƙauyukansu su ne gādon da kabilar Zebulun ta samu, bisa ga iyalansu.
english: This is the inheritance of the children of Zebulun according to their families, these cities with their villages.

hausa: rana ba za tă buge ka cikin yini ba balle wata da dare.
english: The sun will not harm you by day, nor the moon by night.

hausa: Tun daga wannan lokaci Yesu ya fara bayyana wa almajiransa cewa dole yă tafi Urushalima yă sha wahaloli da yawa a hannun dattawa, manyan firistoci da kuma malaman dokoki, dole a kashe shi, a rana ta uku kuma a tashe shi.
english: From that time, Jesus began to show his disciples that he must go to Jerusalem and suffer many things from the elders, chief priests, and scribes, and be killed, and the third day be raised up.

hausa: Yaƙub, Bitrus da Yohanna waɗanda suke fitattun ginshiƙai, sun karɓe ni da Barnabas da hannu biyu biyu sa’ad da suka gane alherin da aka ba ni. Suka kuma yarda cewa ya kamata mu tafi wajen Al’ummai, su kuwa su tafi wajen Yahudawa.
english: and when they perceived the grace that was given to me, James and Cephas and John, those who were reputed to be pillars, gave to Barnabas and me the right hand of fellowship, that we should go to the Gentiles, and they to the circumcision.

hausa: sai Yusuf ya kintsa keken yaƙinsa ya haura zuwa Goshen don yă taryi mahaifinsa, Isra’ila. Nan da nan da isowar Yusuf a wurin mahaifinsa, sai ya rungumi mahaifinsa, ya yi kuka na dogon lokaci.
english: Joseph prepared his chariot, and went up to meet Israel, his father, in Goshen. He presented himself to him, and fell on his neck, and wept on his neck a good while.

hausa: Mahaifiyarsu ta yi rashin aminci ta kuma ɗauki cikinsu ta wurin yi abin kunya. Ta ce, ‘Zan bi kwartayena, waɗanda suke ba ni abinci da ruwa, ulu nawa da lilina, mai nawa da kuma abin sha na.’
english: For their mother has played the prostitute. She who conceived them has done shamefully; for she said, ‘I will go after my lovers, who give me my bread and my water, my wool and my flax, my oil and my drink.’

hausa: Amma laifofinku sun raba ku da Allahnku; zunubanku sun ɓoye fuskarsa daga gare ku, saboda kada yă ji.
english: But your iniquities have separated you and your God, and your sins have hidden his face from you, so that he will not hear.

hausa: Sarakunanta ba za su kasance da wani abin da ake kira masarauta ba, dukan sarakunanta za su ɓace.
english: They shall call its nobles to the kingdom, but none shall be there; and all its princes shall be nothing.

hausa: Ka shirya mini tebur a gaban abokan gābana. Ka shafe kaina da mai; kwaf nawa ya cika har yana zuba.
english: You prepare a table before me in the presence of my enemies. You anoint my head with oil. My cup runs over.

hausa: Gama Ubangiji ya zaɓi Yaƙub ya zama nasa, Isra’ila ya zama mallakarsa mai daraja.
english: For Yah has chosen Jacob for himself, Israel for his own possession.

hausa: Ba kai ne ba ka jawo wa kanka ba ta wurin rabuwa da Ubangiji Allahnka sa’ad da ya bi da kai a hanya?
english: “Haven’t you brought this on yourself, in that you have forsaken Yahweh your God, when he led you by the way?

hausa: waɗanda suka ce, “Bari mu mallaki wuraren kiwon Allah.”
english: who said, “Let’s take possession of God’s pasture lands.”

hausa: Gama ta fi sauƙi sama da ƙasa su shuɗe, da a ce ɗigo guda ɗaya na rubutun, ya fita ya fāɗi daga cikin Doka.
english: But it is easier for heaven and earth to pass away than for one tiny stroke of a pen in the law to fall.

hausa: Ko da yake ba ku san shi ba, ni dai na san shi. In kuwa na ce ban san shi ba, na zama maƙaryaci kamar ku ke nan, amma na san shi, kuma ina kiyaye maganarsa.
english: You have not known him, but I know him. If I said, ‘I don’t know him,’ I would be like you, a liar. But I know him and keep his word.

hausa: Domin haka ina ba da doka cewa duk mutane da kowace al’umma ko kowane yaren da ya ce wani abu mummuna a kan Allahn Shadrak, Meshak da Abednego za a yanka shi gunduwa-gunduwa kuma gidansu zai zama wurin zuba shara, domin babu wani allahn da zai iya ceto ta irin wannan hanya.”
english: Therefore I make a decree that every people, nation, and language which speak anything evil against the God of Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego shall be cut in pieces, and their houses shall be made a dunghill, because there is no other god who is able to deliver like this.”

hausa: “ ‘A wata na fari a rana ta goma sha huɗu za ku kiyaye Bikin Ƙetarewa, bikin da yakan ɗauki kwana bakwai, a lokacin ne za ku riƙa cin burodi marar yisti.
english: “‘“In the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month, you shall have the Passover, a feast of seven days; unleavened bread shall be eaten.

hausa: “Ka ɗauki littafi ka rubuta dukan maganganun da na yi maka game da Isra’ila, Yahuda da kuma dukan sauran al’ummai daga lokacin da na fara maka magana a mulkin Yosiya har zuwa yanzu.
english: “Take a scroll of a book, and write in it all the words that I have spoken to you against Israel, against Judah, and against all the nations, from the day I spoke to you, from the days of Josiah even to this day.

hausa: Sa’an nan wata zai ruɗe, rana ta ji kunya; gama Ubangiji Maɗaukaki zai yi mulki a kan Dutsen Sihiyona da kuma a cikin Urushalima, da kuma a gaban dattawanta, da ɗaukaka.
english: Then the moon will be confounded, and the sun ashamed; for Yahweh of Armies will reign on Mount Zion and in Jerusalem; and glory will be before his elders.

hausa: Musa ya ɗauki rabin jinin ya zuba a cikin kwanoni, rabin kuma ya yayyafa a kan bagaden.
english: Moses took half of the blood and put it in basins, and half of the blood he sprinkled on the altar.

hausa: ya kuma kawo bunsuru ɗaya domin hadaya don zunubi;
english: one male goat for a sin offering;

hausa: An tsananta mana, amma ba a yashe mu ba, an fyaɗe mu da ƙasa, amma ba a hallaka mu ba.
english: pursued, yet not forsaken; struck down, yet not destroyed;

hausa: Ka kuɓutar da waɗanda ake ja zuwa inda za a kashe su; ka riƙe waɗanda suke tangaɗi zuwa wajen yanka.
english: Rescue those who are being led away to death! Indeed, hold back those who are staggering to the slaughter!

hausa: Waɗanda suka haife su za su manta da su, tsutsotsi za su cinye su; ba za a sāke tunawa da mugaye ba amma an sare su kamar itace.
english: The womb will forget him. The worm will feed sweetly on him. He will be no more remembered. Unrighteousness will be broken as a tree.

hausa: Sa’an nan Yesu ya ce wa jarumin, “Je ka! Za a yi bisa ga bangaskiyarka.” A daidai wannan lokaci bawansa kuwa ya warke.
english: Jesus said to the centurion, “Go your way. Let it be done for you as you have believed.” His servant was healed in that hour.

hausa: Sai Melkizedek sarkin Salem ya kawo burodi da ruwan inabi. Shi firist ne na Allah Mafi Ɗaukaka,
english: Melchizedek king of Salem brought out bread and wine. He was priest of God Most High.

hausa: Haka kuwa ya kasance kamar yadda mutumin Allah ya ce wa sarki, “Gobe war haka, za a sayar da mudun gari shekel guda, mudun sha’ir biyu ma a shekel guda, a ƙofar Samariya.”
english: It happened as the man of God had spoken to the king, saying, “Two seahs of barley for a shekel, and a seah of fine flour for a shekel, shall be tomorrow about this time in the gate of Samaria;”

hausa: Suka gicciye ’yan fashi biyu tare da shi, ɗaya a damansa, ɗayan kuma a hagunsa.
english: With him they crucified two robbers, one on his right hand, and one on his left.

hausa: Sai Yusuf ya tashi, ya ɗauki yaron da mahaifiyarsa da dad dare suka tafi Masar,
english: He arose and took the young child and his mother by night and departed into Egypt,

hausa: ya kuma ’yantar da waɗanda dukan rayuwarsu tsoron mutuwa ya riƙe su cikin bauta.
english: and might deliver all of them who through fear of death were all their lifetime subject to bondage.

hausa: sai su ga fuskarsa tana ƙyalli. Sa’an nan Musa yă sāke lulluɓe fuskarsa, har sai ya shiga don yă yi magana da Ubangiji.
english: The children of Israel saw Moses’ face, that the skin of Moses’ face shone; so Moses put the veil on his face again, until he went in to speak with him.

hausa: Ku ji wannan maganar da Ubangiji ya yi game da ku, ya ku jama’ar Isra’ila, a kan dukan iyalin da na fitar daga Masar.
english: Hear this word that Yahweh has spoken against you, children of Israel, against the whole family which I brought up out of the land of Egypt, saying:

hausa: Sai Yaƙub ya ce wa Simeyon da Lawi, “Kun jawo mini wahala ta wurin sa in zama abin ƙi ga Kan’aniyawa da Ferizziyawa, mazaunan wannan ƙasa. Mu kima ne, in kuwa suka haɗa kai gāba da ni, suka fāɗa mini, za su hallaka ni da gidana.”
english: Jacob said to Simeon and Levi, “You have troubled me, to make me odious to the inhabitants of the land, among the Canaanites and the Perizzites. I am few in number. They will gather themselves together against me and strike me, and I will be destroyed, I and my house.”

hausa: Sai ya ce mini, “Zai ɗauki safiya da yamma 2,300; sa’an nan za a sāke tsarkake wuri mai tsarki.”
english: He said to me, “To two thousand and three hundred evenings and mornings. Then the sanctuary will be cleansed.”

hausa: Kada ku bar Hezekiya ya rarashe ku ku dogara ga Ubangiji sa’ad da ya ce, ‘Tabbatacce Ubangiji zai cece mu; ba za a ba da wannan birni a hannun sarkin Assuriya ba.’
english: Don’t let Hezekiah make you trust in Yahweh, saying, “Yahweh will surely deliver us. This city won’t be given into the hand of the king of Assyria.”’

hausa: Sa’ad da na sami labari cewa akwai wani makircin da aka ƙulla masa, sai na aika shi wurinka nan da nan. Na kuma umarci masu zarginsa su kai ƙararsu gare ka.
english: When I was told that the Jews lay in wait for the man, I sent him to you immediately, charging his accusers also to bring their accusations against him before you. Farewell.”

hausa: Gama na san yawan laifofinku da kuma girman zunubanku. Kuna danne masu adalci kuna kuma cin hanci kuna kuma hana a yi wa matalauta shari’ar adalci a majalisa.
english: For I know how many are your offenses, and how great are your sins— you who afflict the just, who take a bribe, and who turn away the needy in the courts.

hausa: Ya harbi zuciyata da kibiyoyin kwarinsa.
english: He has caused the shafts of his quiver to enter into my kidneys.

hausa: Ka dogara ga Ubangiji, ka yi ƙarfin hali ka yi ƙarfin zuciya ka kuma dogara ga Ubangiji.
english: Wait for Yahweh. Be strong, and let your heart take courage. Yes, wait for Yahweh.

hausa: ga yadda ma’aunin biyan zai kasance, mutum mai shekara tsakanin ashirin da sittin, za a biya azurfa hamsin.
english: your valuation of a male from twenty years old to sixty years old shall be fifty shekels of silver, according to the shekel of the sanctuary.

hausa: bayan an ɗan jima sai matar maigidansa ta fara sha’awar Yusuf, sai ta ce, “Zo ka kwana da ni!”
english: After these things, his master’s wife set her eyes on Joseph; and she said, “Lie with me.”

hausa: “Na faɗa muku wannan duka, domin kada ku bauɗe.
english: “I have said these things to you so that you wouldn’t be caused to stumble.

hausa: Lokacin kuka da lokacin dariya, lokacin makoki da lokacin rawa.
english: a time to weep, and a time to laugh; a time to mourn, and a time to dance;

hausa: Ku ƙirƙiro dabarunku, amma ba za su yi nasara ba; ku ƙulla shirye-shiryenku, amma ba za su yi amfani ba, gama Allah yana tare da mu.
english: Take counsel together, and it will be brought to nothing; speak the word, and it will not stand, for God is with us.”

hausa: Ba daga bakin Maɗaukaki ne bala’i da abubuwa masu kyau suke fitowa ba?
english: Doesn’t evil and good come out of the mouth of the Most High?

hausa: Sa’an nan ’yan’uwansa da dukan dangin mahaifinsa suka gangaro don su ɗauke shi. Suka kawo shi suka binne tsakanin Zora da Eshtawol a kabarin Manowa mahaifinsa. Ya yi mulkin Isra’ila shekara ashirin.
english: Then his brothers and all the house of his father came down and took him, and brought him up and buried him between Zorah and Eshtaol in the burial site of Manoah his father. He judged Israel twenty years.

hausa: Waɗanda suka yi shuka da hawaye za su yi girbi da waƙoƙin farin ciki.
english: Those who sow in tears will reap in joy.

hausa: Sai aka kira wurin Kwarin Eshkol saboda nonon inabin da suka yi cunkus, wanda Isra’ilawa suka yanko a wurin.
english: That place was called the valley of Eshcol, because of the cluster which the children of Israel cut down from there.

hausa: Sa’an nan mutanen Isra’ila ba za su ƙara kauce daga gare ni ba, ba kuwa za su ƙara ƙazantar da kansu da dukan zunubansu ba. Za su zama mutanena, ni kuma zan zama Allahnsu, in ji Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka.’ ”
english: that the house of Israel may no more go astray from me, neither defile themselves any more with all their transgressions; but that they may be my people, and I may be their God,” says the Lord Yahweh.’”

hausa: sa’ad da wani mutum ya ce mini, ‘Shawulu ya mutu,’ yana tsammani ya kawo labari mai daɗi ne, na kama shi na kashe a Ziklag. Ladar da na ba shi ke nan saboda labarinsa!
english: when someone told me, ‘Behold, Saul is dead,’ thinking that he brought good news, I seized him and killed him in Ziklag, which was the reward I gave him for his news.

hausa: Masu adalci za su gāji ƙasar su kuma zauna a cikinta har abada.
english: The righteous shall inherit the land, and live in it forever.

hausa: Gama ka tabbata da gaskiyata da kuma abin da nake yi; ka zauna a kujerarka, kana yin shari’a da adalci.
english: For you have maintained my just cause. You sit on the throne judging righteously.

hausa: Daga lokacin da na fitar da kakanni-kakanninku daga Masar har yă zuwa yau, na gargaɗe su sau da sau, ina cewa, “Ku yi mini biyayya.”
english: For I earnestly protested to your fathers in the day that I brought them up out of the land of Egypt, even to this day, rising early and protesting, saying, “Obey my voice.”

hausa: Masu albarka ne waɗanda suke makoki, gama za a yi musu ta’aziyya.
english: Blessed are those who mourn, for they shall be comforted.

hausa: Sa’an nan firistoci da annabawa suka ce wa fadawan da dukan mutane, “Mutumin nan ya cancanci hukuncin kisa gama ya yi annabci gāba da wannan birni. Ku kun ji da kunnuwanku!”
english: Then the priests and the prophets spoke to the princes and to all the people, saying, “This man is worthy of death, for he has prophesied against this city, as you have heard with your ears.”

hausa: Kamar gizagizai da kuma iska marar ruwan sama haka mutumin da yake fariya a kan kyautan da ba ya bayarwa.
english: As clouds and wind without rain, so is he who boasts of gifts deceptively.

hausa: Ga ƙaramar kabilar Benyamin, suna jagorance su, ga babbar ƙungiya shugabannin Yahuda, ga kuma shugabannin Zebulun da na Naftali.
english: There is little Benjamin, their ruler, the princes of Judah, their council, the princes of Zebulun, and the princes of Naphtali.

hausa: Sarki ya ce wa Ziba, “Me ya sa ka kawo waɗannan?” Ziba ya ce, “Jakuna domin iyalin gidan sarki su hau ne, burodi da ’ya’yan itace domin mutane su ci, ruwan inabi kuma domin waɗanda suka gaji a hamada.”
english: The king said to Ziba, “What do you mean by these?” Ziba said, “The donkeys are for the king’s household to ride on; and the bread and summer fruit for the young men to eat; and the wine, that those who are faint in the wilderness may drink.”

hausa: Tsawon babban zaure a gaban wannan ɗaki, kamu arba’in ne.
english: In front of the temple sanctuary was forty cubits long.

hausa: A lokacin sai Maryamu ta shirya ta gaggauta zuwa wani gari a ƙasar tudu ta Yahudiya,
english: Mary arose in those days and went into the hill country with haste, into a city of Judah,

hausa: Saboda haka Shawulu bai yarda Dawuda yă zauna tare da shi ba, amma ya maishe shi shugaban sojoji dubu. Dawuda kuwa ya riƙa bi da su yana kaiwa yana kuma da tare da su.
english: Therefore Saul removed him from his presence, and made him his captain over a thousand; and he went out and came in before the people.

hausa: Samari suna faman yin niƙa; yara kuma suna fama da ƙyar da nauyin kayan itace.
english: The young men carry millstones. The children stumbled under loads of wood.

hausa: Ubangiji zai kiyaye ka daga dukan masifa, zai tsare ranka;
english: Yahweh will keep you from all evil. He will keep your soul.

hausa: Kamar yadda a dā can ku da kuke marasa biyayya ga Allah kuka sami jinƙai yanzu ta dalilin rashin biyayyarsu,
english: For as you in time past were disobedient to God, but now have obtained mercy by their disobedience,

hausa: Zai kira bisa sunana, zan kuma amsa masa; zan kasance tare da shi a lokacin wahala, zan kuɓutar da shi in kuma girmama shi.
english: He will call on me, and I will answer him. I will be with him in trouble. I will deliver him, and honor him.

hausa: sai ka ji daga sama ka kuma gafarta zunubin mutanenka Isra’ila ka kuma dawo da su zuwa ƙasar da ka ba su da kuma kakanninsu.
english: then hear from heaven, and forgive the sin of your people Israel, and bring them again to the land which you gave to them and to their fathers.

hausa: Gama an sayar da ni da mutanena don a hallaka, a karkashe mu, a kuma ƙi mu. Da a ce an sayar da mu kamar bayi maza da mata ne, da na yi shiru, domin wannan zai zama abin da bai taka kara ya karye ba, har da za a dami sarki a kai.”
english: For we are sold, I and my people, to be destroyed, to be slain, and to perish. But if we had been sold for male and female slaves, I would have held my peace, although the adversary could not have compensated for the king’s loss.”

hausa: Bari waɗanda suke murna saboda nasarata su yi sowa don farin ciki da murna; bari kullum su riƙa cewa, “A ɗaukaka Ubangiji, wanda yake farin ciki da zaman lafiyar bawansa.”
english: Let those who favor my righteous cause shout for joy and be glad. Yes, let them say continually, “May Yahweh be magnified, who has pleasure in the prosperity of his servant!”

hausa: Asa ya haifi Yehoshafat, Yehoshafat ya haifi Yehoram, Yehoram ya haifi Azariya,
english: Asa became the father of Jehoshaphat. Jehoshaphat became the father of Joram. Joram became the father of Uzziah.

hausa: Na ba su ƙa’idodina na kuma sanar musu da dokokina, gama mutumin da ya yi biyayya da su zai rayu ta wurinsu.
english: I gave them my statutes and showed them my ordinances, which if a man does, he will live in them.

hausa: Fadawan Amon suka ƙulla maƙarƙashiya suka kashe shi a cikin fadarsa.
english: The servants of Amon conspired against him, and put the king to death in his own house.

hausa: Haka almajiran suka yi, kowa kuwa ya zauna.
english: They did so, and made them all sit down.

hausa: Amma ina cike da fushin Ubangiji, kuma ba na iya kannewa. “Ka kwararo shi a kan yara a titi da kuma a kan samarin da suka tattaru; za a kama miji da mata a cikinsa, tsofaffi da suka tsufa tukub.
english: Therefore I am full of Yahweh’s wrath. I am weary with holding it in. “Pour it out on the children in the street, and on the assembly of young men together; for even the husband with the wife will be taken, the aged with him who is full of days.

hausa: Ɗaya daga cikinsu mai suna Agabus, ya miƙe tsaye ya yi annabci ta wurin Ruhu cewa za a yi yunwa mai tsanani wadda za tă bazu a dukan duniyar Romawa (Wannan ya faru a zamanin mulkin Kalaudiyus.)
english: One of them named Agabus stood up and indicated by the Spirit that there should be a great famine all over the world, which also happened in the days of Claudius.

hausa: Ku yi alkawari wa Ubangiji Allahnku ku kuma cika su; bari dukan ƙasashen maƙwabta su kawo kyautai ga Wannan da za a ji tsoro.
english: Make vows to Yahweh your God, and fulfill them! Let all of his neighbors bring presents to him who is to be feared.

hausa: Sarki Solomon ya ƙaunaci baƙin mata. Ban da ’yar Fir’auna, ya auri Mowabawa, Ammonawa, mutanen Edom, Sidoniyawa da Hittiyawa.
english: Now King Solomon loved many foreign women, together with the daughter of Pharaoh: women of the Moabites, Ammonites, Edomites, Sidonians, and Hittites,

hausa: Na san mene ne zaman rashi, na kuma san mene ne zaman samu. Zan iya zama cikin kowane hali, ko cikin ƙoshi ko cikin yunwa, ko cikin yalwa ko kuma cikin fatara.
english: I know how to be humbled, and I also know how to abound. In any and all circumstances I have learned the secret both to be filled and to be hungry, both to abound and to be in need.

hausa: Ta yin haka, za ka tara garwashin wuta mai ci a kansa, Ubangiji kuma zai sāka maka.
english: for you will heap coals of fire on his head, and Yahweh will reward you.

hausa: wato, dukan masarautar Og a Bashan, wanda ya yi mulkin Ashtarot da Edireyi, yana cikin waɗanda suke na ƙarshe da ba a kashe ba a cikin Refahiyawa. Musa ya ci su da yaƙi, ya ƙwace ƙasarsu.
english: all the kingdom of Og in Bashan, who reigned in Ashtaroth and in Edrei (who was left of the remnant of the Rephaim); for Moses attacked these, and drove them out.

hausa: Har yanzu kana gāba da mutanena, ba ka kuma bar su su tafi ba.
english: because you still exalt yourself against my people, that you won’t let them go.

hausa: Amma Abram ya ce, wa sarkin Sodom, “Na ɗaga hannu ga Ubangiji Allah Mafi Ɗaukaka, Mahaliccin sama da ƙasa, na riga na rantse
english: Abram said to the king of Sodom, “I have lifted up my hand to Yahweh, God Most High, possessor of heaven and earth,

hausa: Amma ya nace musu ƙwarai, sai suka tafi tare da shi, suka kuma shiga gidansa. Ya shirya musu abinci, ya gasa burodi marasa yisti, suka ci.
english: He urged them greatly, and they came in with him, and entered into his house. He made them a feast, and baked unleavened bread, and they ate.

hausa: “Yadda za a ci Sheshak, taƙamar duniya duka za tă daina! Babilon za tă zama abar ƙyama a cikin al’ummai!
english: “How Sheshach is taken! How the praise of the whole earth is seized! How Babylon has become a desolation among the nations!

hausa: Amma Elimas mai sihirin nan (domin ma’anar sunansa ke nan) ya yi hamayya da maganarsu ya kuma yi ƙoƙari ya juyar da muƙaddas ɗin daga bangaskiya.
english: But Elymas the sorcerer (for so is his name by interpretation) withstood them, seeking to turn the proconsul away from the faith.

hausa: Bitrus ya yi musu alama da hannunsa su yi shiru sai ya bayyana yadda Ubangiji ya fitar da shi daga kurkuku. Ya ce, “Ku gaya wa Yaƙub da kuma ’yan’uwa game da wannan,” sa’an nan ya tashi ya tafi wani wuri.
english: But he, beckoning to them with his hand to be silent, declared to them how the Lord had brought him out of the prison. He said, “Tell these things to James and to the brothers.” Then he departed and went to another place.

hausa: Amma a ganina waɗancan da kuke ce da su “manyan manzanni” ba su fi ni da wani abu ba.
english: For I reckon that I am not at all behind the very best apostles.

hausa: Amma sarkin Assuriya ya gane cewa Hosheya mai cin amana ne, gama ya aika da wakilai wurin So sarkin Masar, ya kuma daina aika wa sarkin Assuriya haraji yadda ya saba yi kowace shekara. Saboda haka Shalmaneser ya kama shi ya sa a kurkuku.
english: The king of Assyria discovered a conspiracy in Hoshea; for he had sent messengers to So king of Egypt, and offered no tribute to the king of Assyria, as he had done year by year. Therefore the king of Assyria seized him, and bound him in prison.

hausa: “Ka kuma aika mini al’ul, fir da gumaguman algum daga Lebanon, gama na san cewa mutanenka sun gwanince a yakan katakai a can. Mutanena kuwa za su yi aiki tare da naka
english: “Send me also cedar trees, cypress trees, and algum trees out of Lebanon, for I know that your servants know how to cut timber in Lebanon. Behold, my servants will be with your servants,

hausa: A kan ƙofofin katakan zaitun kuwa ya zāzzāna kerubobi, itatuwa dabino, da furanni buɗaɗɗu, ya kuma dalaye kerubobin, da kuma itatuwan dabinon da zinariya.
english: So he made two doors of olive wood; and he carved on them carvings of cherubim, palm trees, and open flowers, and overlaid them with gold. He spread the gold on the cherubim and on the palm trees.

hausa: An yi haka ne a Ranar Shirye-shirye, ranar Asabbaci kuma yana dab da farawa.
english: It was the day of the Preparation, and the Sabbath was drawing near.

hausa: Dafinsu ya yi kamar dafin maciji, kamar na gamsheƙan da ya toshe kunnuwansa,
english: Their poison is like the poison of a snake, like a deaf cobra that stops its ear,

hausa: ina farin ciki da dukan duniyarsa ina murna da ’yan adam.
english: rejoicing in his whole world. My delight was with the sons of men.

hausa: Suka ce wa juna, “Ku zo, mu yi tubula, mu gasa su sosai.” Suka yi amfani da tubula a maimakon duwatsu, kwalta kuma a maimakon laka.
english: They said to one another, “Come, let’s make bricks, and burn them thoroughly.” They had brick for stone, and they used tar for mortar.

hausa: “Faɗa musu, ‘Duk wani mutumin Isra’ila ko wani baƙon da yake zama a cikinsu wanda ya miƙa hadaya ta ƙonawa ko sadaka
english: “You shall say to them, ‘Any man there is of the house of Israel, or of the strangers who live as foreigners among them, who offers a burnt offering or sacrifice,

hausa: Amma in bawanka ya ce maka, “Ba na so in bar ka,” saboda yana ƙaunarka da iyalinka, ya kuma fiye masa yă zauna da kai,
english: It shall be, if he tells you, “I will not go out from you,” because he loves you and your house, because he is well with you,

hausa: Suka yi ihu gaba ɗaya suka ce, “A yi gaba da wannan mutum! A sake mana Barabbas!”
english: But they all cried out together, saying, “Away with this man! Release to us Barabbas!”—

hausa: A sa’ad da kuma Musa ya fita zuwa Tentin, dukan mutanen sukan tashi su tsaya a ƙofofin tentinsu, suna kallon Musa, sai ya shiga tentin.
english: When Moses went out to the Tent, all the people rose up, and stood, everyone at their tent door, and watched Moses, until he had gone into the Tent.

hausa: Bitrus kuwa ya kafa masa ido, haka ma Yohanna. Sai Bitrus ya ce, “Dube mu!”
english: Peter, fastening his eyes on him, with John, said, “Look at us.”

hausa: Waɗanda suka zauna a inuwarsa, dukan masu tarayyarsa a cikin al’ummai, su ma sun gangara zuwa kabari tare da shi, sun haɗu da waɗanda aka kashe da takobi.
english: They also went down into Sheol with him to those who are slain by the sword; yes, those who were his arm, who lived under his shadow in the middle of the nations.

hausa: Shugaban kabilar Kohatawa shi ne Elizafan ɗan Uzziyel.
english: The prince of the fathers’ house of the families of the Kohathites shall be Elizaphan the son of Uzziel.

hausa: Yesu ya ce, “Kada ku hana shi, gama duk wanda ba ya gāba da ku, naku ne.”
english: Jesus said to him, “Don’t forbid him, for he who is not against us is for us.”

hausa: Bayan ya bar taron, ya shiga gida, sai almajiransa suka tambaye shi ma’anar wannan misali.
english: When he had entered into a house away from the multitude, his disciples asked him about the parable.

hausa: Shimeyi yana da ’ya’ya maza goma sha shida da ’ya’ya mata shida, amma ’yan’uwansa ba su da ’ya’ya da yawa; saboda haka gidansu gaba ɗaya ba tă zama mai mutane da yawa kamar mutanen Yahuda ba.
english: Shimei had sixteen sons and six daughters; but his brothers didn’t have many children, and all their family didn’t multiply like the children of Judah.

hausa: Zuwa ga Timoti ɗana na gaske cikin bangaskiya. Alheri, jinƙai da kuma salama daga Allah Uba da Kiristi Yesu Ubangijinmu, su kasance tare da kai.
english: to Timothy, my true child in faith: Grace, mercy, and peace from God our Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.

hausa: “ ‘Kada ka yi jima’i da ’yar’uwar mahaifinka, ita dangin mahaifinka ne na kusa.
english: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father’s sister. She is your father’s near kinswoman.

hausa: Bayan Dawuda ya ƙidaya mayaƙan, lamirinsa ya kāshe shi, sai ya ce wa Ubangiji, “Ya Ubangiji na yi laifi ƙwarai a kan abin da na yi. Ina roƙonka ka gafarta wa bawanka. Na yi wauta ƙwarai.”
english: David’s heart struck him after he had counted the people. David said to Yahweh, “I have sinned greatly in that which I have done. But now, Yahweh, put away, I beg you, the iniquity of your servant; for I have done very foolishly.”

hausa: Farisiyawa suka zo suka fara yin wa Yesu tambayoyi. Don su gwada shi, sai suka nemi yă nuna musu wata alama daga sama.
english: The Pharisees came out and began to question him, seeking from him a sign from heaven and testing him.

hausa: Yason kuwa ya karɓe su a gidansa. Dukansu suna karya dokokin Kaisar, suna cewa akwai wani sarki, wanda ake kira Yesu.”
english: whom Jason has received. These all act contrary to the decrees of Caesar, saying that there is another king, Jesus!”

hausa: Suka binne Abner a Hebron, sarki kuwa ya ɗaga murya ya yi kuka a kabarin Abner.
english: They buried Abner in Hebron; and the king lifted up his voice and wept at Abner’s grave; and all the people wept.

hausa: In kun ga saniya ko tunkiyar ɗan’uwanku wadda ta ɓace, kada ku ƙyale ta, amma ku tabbata kun komar da ita gare shi.
english: You shall not see your brother’s ox or his sheep go astray and hide yourself from them. You shall surely bring them again to your brother.

hausa: Birnin murabba’i ne, tsayinsa daidai ne da fāɗinsa. Ya auna birnin da sandarsa ya kuwa sami mil 1,400 (wajen kilomita 2,200) tsawonsa, fāɗinsa da kuma tsayinsa daidai suke.
english: The city is square. Its length is as great as its width. He measured the city with the reed: twelve thousand twelve stadia. Its length, width, and height are equal.

hausa: Sun kintsa sosai su tumɓuke shi daga matsayinsa mai martaba; suna jin daɗi yin ƙarairayi. Sukan sa wa mutum albarka da bakinsu, amma a zuciyarsu la’antawa suke yi. Sela
english: They fully intend to throw him down from his lofty place. They delight in lies. They bless with their mouth, but they curse inwardly. Selah.

hausa: Na hallaka su ƙaƙaf, ba kuwa za su ƙara tashi ba, sun fāɗi a ƙarƙashin sawuna.
english: I have consumed them, and struck them through, so that they can’t arise. Yes, they have fallen under my feet.

hausa: “Ba za ka kasance da waɗansu alloli a gabana ba.
english: “You shall have no other gods before me.

hausa: Ba shakka, Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka ba ya yin wani abu ba tare da ya sanar wa bayinsa annabawa ba.
english: Surely the Lord Yahweh will do nothing, unless he reveals his secret to his servants the prophets.

hausa: Ya hori hannuwana don yaƙi, hannuwana za su iya tanƙware bakan tagulla.
english: He teaches my hands to war, so that my arms bend a bow of bronze.

hausa: Ka yi shirye-shirye ta wurin neman shawara; in kana yaƙi, ka sami bishewa.
english: Plans are established by advice; by wise guidance you wage war!

hausa: Wutsiyarsa ta share kashi ɗaya bisa uku na taurari daga sararin sama ta kuma zubar da su ƙasa. Ƙaton jan macijin ya tsaya a gaban macen wadda take gab da haihuwa, don yă cinye ɗanta nan take bayan an haife shi.
english: His tail drew one third of the stars of the sky, and threw them to the earth. The dragon stood before the woman who was about to give birth, so that when she gave birth he might devour her child.

hausa: Wannan ita ce hadaya ta ƙonawa ta kullum wadda aka kafa a Dutsen Sinai, don daɗin ƙanshi, wato, hadaya ce da aka ƙone da wuta ga Ubangiji.
english: It is a continual burnt offering which was ordained in Mount Sinai for a pleasant aroma, an offering made by fire to Yahweh.

hausa: Kada ku zama masu bautar gumaka, yadda waɗansunsu suka zama; kamar yadda yake a rubuce cewa, “Mutanen suka zauna don su ci su kuma sha, suka kuma tashi suka shiga rawa ta rashin kunya.”
english: Don’t be idolaters, as some of them were. As it is written, “The people sat down to eat and drink, and rose up to play.”

hausa: Farisiyawa suka ce masa, “Duba, me ya sa suke yin abin da doka ta hana a yi, a ranar Asabbaci?”
english: The Pharisees said to him, “Behold, why do they do that which is not lawful on the Sabbath day?”

hausa: Ka ƙaunace ta, za tă ɗaukaka ka; ka rungume ta, za tă kuwa girmama ka.
english: Esteem her, and she will exalt you. She will bring you to honor when you embrace her.

hausa: Mala’ika na fari ya busa ƙahonsa, sai ga ƙanƙara da wuta haɗe da jini, aka kuma wurga su bisan duniya. Kashi ɗaya bisa uku na duniya ya ƙone, kashi ɗaya bisa uku na itatuwa suka ƙone, dukan ɗanyar ciyawa kuma ta ƙone.
english: The first sounded, and there followed hail and fire, mixed with blood, and they were thrown to the earth. One third of the earth was burned up, and one third of the trees were burned up, and all green grass was burned up.

hausa: Mai gadin kurkukun ya farka daga barci, sa’ad da ya ga ƙofofin kurkukun a buɗe, sai ya zāre takobinsa yana shirin kashe kansa domin ya ɗauka ’yan kurkukun sun gudu.
english: The jailer, being roused out of sleep and seeing the prison doors open, drew his sword and was about to kill himself, supposing that the prisoners had escaped.

hausa: Ina masu hikima suke yanzu? Bari su nuna maka su kuma sanar da abin da Ubangiji Maɗaukaki ya shirya a kan Masar.
english: Where then are your wise men? Let them tell you now; and let them know what Yahweh of Armies has purposed concerning Egypt.

hausa: Sai Kohatawa suka kama hanya, ɗauke da kayayyaki masu tsarki, domin kafin su kai wurin da za a kafa sansani, a riga an kafa tabanakul.
english: The Kohathites set forward, bearing the sanctuary. The others set up the tabernacle before they arrived.

hausa: A shekara ta biyu ta mulkin Feka ɗan Remaliya sarkin Isra’ila, Yotam ɗan Uzziya sarkin Yahuda ya fara mulki.
english: In the second year of Pekah the son of Remaliah king of Israel, Jotham the son of Uzziah king of Judah began to reign.

hausa: Zan miƙa hadaya ta yardar rai gare ka; zan yabe sunanka, ya Ubangiji, gama yana da kyau.
english: With a free will offering, I will sacrifice to you. I will give thanks to your name, Yahweh, for it is good.

hausa: Sa’ad da Na’omi ta gane cewa Rut ta ƙudura tă tafi tare da ita, sai ta daina nema tă koma.
english: When Naomi saw that she was determined to go with her, she stopped urging her.

hausa: Game da umarnan nan dai, ban yaba muku ba, domin taruwarku ba ta kirki ba ce, ɓarna ce.
english: But in giving you this command I don’t praise you, because you come together not for the better but for the worse.

hausa: A cikin zuriyar firistoci, ga waɗanda suka auri mata baƙi. Daga zuriyar Yeshuwa ɗan Yozadak da ’yan’uwansa, akwai Ma’asehiya, da Eliyezer, da Yarib, da Gedaliya.
english: Among the sons of the priests there were found who had married foreign women: of the sons of Jeshua, the son of Jozadak, and his brothers: Maaseiah, Eliezer, Jarib, and Gedaliah.

hausa: Saboda haka zuciyata tana murna harshena kuma yana farin ciki; jikina kuma zai zauna lafiya,
english: Therefore my heart is glad, and my tongue rejoices. My body shall also dwell in safety.

hausa: Ana nan, sai yaƙi ya ɓarke a Gezer tsakanin Isra’ila da Filistiyawa. Sai Sibbekai mutumin Husha ya kashe Siffai, ɗaya daga cikin zuriyar Refahiyawa, ta haka kuma aka ci Filistiyawa da yaƙi.
english: After this, war arose at Gezer with the Philistines. Then Sibbecai the Hushathite killed Sippai, of the sons of the giant; and they were subdued.

hausa: Yanzu in sarki yana so, bari a duba cikin littattafan tarihi na sarakuna na Babilon a gani ko lalle sarki Sairus ya ba da umarni a sāke gina gidan Allah a Urushalima. Bari sarki yă aiko mana da abin da ya gani game da wannan abu.
english: Now therefore, if it seems good to the king, let a search be made in the king’s treasure house, which is there at Babylon, whether it is so that a decree was made by Cyrus the king to build this house of God at Jerusalem; and let the king send his pleasure to us concerning this matter.”

hausa: saboda zai kahu kuma sunanka zai zama mai girma har abada. Sa’an nan mutane za su ce, ‘Ubangiji Maɗaukaki, Allah a bisa Isra’ila, Allahn Isra’ila ne!’ Kuma gidan bawanka Dawuda zai kahu a gabanka.
english: Let your name be established and magnified forever, saying, ‘Yahweh of Armies is the God of Israel, even a God to Israel. The house of David your servant is established before you.’

hausa: Bari su ɗaukaka shi cikin taron mutane su kuma yabe shi cikin taron dattawa.
english: Let them exalt him also in the assembly of the people, and praise him in the seat of the elders.

hausa: Amma Onan ya san cewa ’ya’yan ba za su zama nasa ba; saboda haka a duk sa’ad da ya kwana da matar ɗan’uwansa, sai yă zub da maniyyinsa a ƙasa don kada yă samar wa ɗan’uwansa ’ya’ya.
english: Onan knew that the offspring wouldn’t be his; and when he went in to his brother’s wife, he spilled his semen on the ground, lest he should give offspring to his brother.

hausa: Ya ce, “Sarki Agiriffa, na yi sa’a da na tsaya a gabanka yau yayinda nake kāriyata game da dukan zargin Yahudawa,
english: “I think myself happy, King Agrippa, that I am to make my defense before you today concerning all the things the Jews accuse me of,

hausa: Zan sa mata albarka, ban da haka ma, zan ba ka ɗa ta wurinta, zan sa mata albarka, za tă kuwa zama mahaifiyar al’ummai; sarakunan mutane za su fito daga gare ta.”
english: I will bless her, and moreover I will give you a son by her. Yes, I will bless her, and she will be a mother of nations. Kings of peoples will come from her.”

hausa: Amma Yesu ya san abin da suke tunani. Sai ya ce wa mutumin mai shanyayyen hannun, “Tashi ka tsaya a gaban kowa.” Sai ya tashi ya tsaya.
english: But he knew their thoughts; and he said to the man who had the withered hand, “Rise up and stand in the middle.” He arose and stood.

hausa: Manowa ya ce wa mala’ikan Ubangiji, “Muna roƙonka ka jira mu yanka maka ɗan akuya.”
english: Manoah said to Yahweh’s angel, “Please stay with us, that we may make a young goat ready for you.”

hausa: Dole ka kashe shi. Dole hannunka yă zama na farko a kisansa, sa’an nan hannuwan sauran dukan mutane.
english: but you shall surely kill him. Your hand shall be first on him to put him to death, and afterwards the hands of all the people.

hausa: A lokacin cin abinci Bowaz ya ce mata, “Zo nan. Ki ɗebo burodi ki tsoma cikin ruwan inabi.” Da ta zauna tare da masu girbin, sai ya ba ta gasasshe hatsi. Ta ci duk abin da take so har ta bar ragowa.
english: At meal time Boaz said to her, “Come here, and eat some bread, and dip your morsel in the vinegar.” She sat beside the reapers, and they passed her parched grain. She ate, was satisfied, and left some of it.

hausa: “Babu salama ga mugaye,” in ji Allahna.
english: “There is no peace”, says my God, “for the wicked.”

hausa: Sai mai shela ya daga murya da ƙarfi ya ce, “Wannan shi ne abin da aka umarce ku ku yi, ya ku mutane da al’umma da kowane yare.
english: Then the herald cried aloud, “To you it is commanded, peoples, nations, and languages,

hausa: A cikinsa ne kuma aka yi muku kaciya, ba kuwa yin mutum ba, amma wadda Kiristi ya yi muku, ta wurin tuɓe halinku na mutuntaka.
english: In him you were also circumcised with a circumcision not made with hands, in the putting off of the body of the sins of the flesh, in the circumcision of Christ,

hausa: ‘Dole a ba da Ɗan Mutum ga hannun masu zunubi, a kuma gicciye shi, a rana ta uku kuma a tashe shi.’ ”
english: saying that the Son of Man must be delivered up into the hands of sinful men and be crucified, and the third day rise again?”

hausa: To, sa’ad da mutum ya yi aiki, ba a lissafta ladan aikinsa a matsayin kyauta, sai dai a matsayin hakkinsa.
english: Now to him who works, the reward is not counted as grace, but as something owed.

hausa: sai Allah ya aiko da mugun ruhu tsakanin Abimelek da ’yan ƙasar Shekem, waɗanda suka ci amanar Abimelek.
english: Then God sent an evil spirit between Abimelech and the men of Shechem; and the men of Shechem dealt treacherously with Abimelech,

hausa: Ta haka akwai zuriya goma sha huɗu ke nan duka-duka daga lokacin Ibrahim zuwa lokacin Dawuda, goma sha huɗu kuma daga Dawuda zuwa bauta a Babilon, goma sha huɗu kuma daga bauta a Babilon zuwa Kiristi.
english: So all the generations from Abraham to David are fourteen generations; from David to the exile to Babylon fourteen generations; and from the carrying away to Babylon to the Christ, fourteen generations.

hausa: Mai albarka ne wanda Allah na Yaƙub ne taimakonsa, wanda sa zuciyarsa yana a kan Ubangiji Allahnsa.
english: Happy is he who has the God of Jacob for his help, whose hope is in Yahweh, his God,

hausa: Ya tambaye su ya ce, “Mece ce shawararku? Yaya zan amsa wa waɗannan mutanen da suke ce mini, ‘Ka sauƙaƙa nauyin da mahaifinka ya sa a kanmu’?”
english: He said to them, “What counsel do you give, that we may give an answer to these people, who have spoken to me, saying, ‘Make the yoke that your father put on us lighter’?”

hausa: Yowab ya aika wa Dawuda cikakken labari batun yaƙin.
english: Then Joab sent and told David all the things concerning the war;

hausa: “Za ka hukunta su? Za ka hukunta su, ɗan mutum? To, sai ka kalubalance su da ayyukan banƙyamar kakanninsu
english: “Will you judge them, son of man? Will you judge them? Cause them to know the abominations of their fathers.

hausa: Rana da wata suka tsaya cik a sammai da ganin kibiyoyinka masu wucewa fyu, da ganin hasken māshinka mai walƙiya.
english: The sun and moon stood still in the sky at the light of your arrows as they went, at the shining of your glittering spear.

hausa: Amma ka ƙone naman bijimin, da fatarsa, da kayan cikin, a bayan sansani. Hadaya ce ta zunubi.
english: But the meat of the bull, and its skin, and its dung, you shall burn with fire outside of the camp. It is a sin offering.

hausa: Yanzu zan koma wajen mutanena, amma bari in gargaɗe ka game da abin da mutanen nan za su yi wa mutanenka cikin kwanaki masu zuwa.”
english: Now, behold, I go to my people. Come, I will inform you what this people shall do to your people in the latter days.”

hausa: ’Yan kasuwa za su saye ta ko za su raba ta a tsakaninsu?
english: Will traders barter for him? Will they part him among the merchants?

hausa: Da yake ni da nake Ubangijinku da kuma Malaminku, na wanke ƙafafunku, haka ku ma ya kamata ku wanke ƙafafun juna.
english: If I then, the Lord and the Teacher, have washed your feet, you also ought to wash one another’s feet.

hausa: Ita ma ta yi ta kai da kawowa cikin Assuriyawa, gwamnoni da manyan sojoji; mayaƙa masu saye da kayan yaƙi, suna bisa dawakai, dukansu samari ne masu bansha’awa.
english: She lusted after the Assyrians, governors and rulers—her neighbors, clothed most gorgeously, horsemen riding on horses, all of them desirable young men.

hausa: Sai ya amsa ya ce, “Ko shi mai zunubi ne ko babu, ni dai ban sani ba. Abu ɗaya fa na sani, dā ni makaho ne, amma yanzu ina gani!”
english: He therefore answered, “I don’t know if he is a sinner. One thing I do know: that though I was blind, now I see.”

hausa: Ya mai da duhu abin rufuwarsa, rumfa kewaye da shi, baƙaƙen gizagizan ruwan sama na sarari,
english: He made darkness his hiding place, his pavilion around him, darkness of waters, thick clouds of the skies.

hausa: Da jin haka, sai dangin nan mai fansa ya ce, “To, ba zan iya fanshe shi ba don kada in yi wa nawa mallakar rauni. Za ka iya fanshe shi wa kanka. Ni dai ba zan iya ba.”
english: The near kinsman said, “I can’t redeem it for myself, lest I endanger my own inheritance. Take my right of redemption for yourself; for I can’t redeem it.”

hausa: “Na amsa na ce, ‘Sam, Ubangiji! Ban taɓa cin wani abu marar tsarki ko marar tsabta ba.’
english: But I said, ‘Not so, Lord, for nothing unholy or unclean has ever entered into my mouth.’

hausa: “ ‘Saboda haka, ku makiyaya, ku ji maganar Ubangiji,
english: “‘Therefore, you shepherds, hear Yahweh’s word:

hausa: Mutum mai zafin rai kan kawo faɗa, amma mutum mai haƙuri kan kwantar da faɗa.
english: A wrathful man stirs up contention, but one who is slow to anger appeases strife.

hausa: Bayan mun yi bankwana da juna, sai muka shiga jirgin ruwa, su kuwa suka koma gida.
english: After saying goodbye to each other, we went on board the ship, and they returned home again.

hausa: Waɗansu almajirai daga Kaisariya suka raka mu suka kawo mu gidan Minason, inda za mu sauka. Shi mutumin Saifurus ne kuma ɗaya daga cikin almajirai na farko.
english: Some of the disciples from Caesarea also went with us, bringing one Mnason of Cyprus, an early disciple, with whom we would stay.

hausa: Ya kuma ce, “Ku yi farin ciki, ya Al’ummai, tare da mutanensa.”
english: Again he says, “Rejoice, you Gentiles, with his people.”

hausa: Mazaunina zai kasance da su; zan kuwa zama Allahnsu, za su kuma zama mutanena.
english: My tent also will be with them. I will be their God, and they will be my people.

hausa: Ya zaɓa yă sha wahala tare da mutanen Allah, maimakon yă ji daɗin sha’awace-sha’awacen zunubi na ɗan lokaci.
english: choosing rather to share ill treatment with God’s people than to enjoy the pleasures of sin for a time,

hausa: Yayinda Obadiya yana tafiya, sai Iliya ya sadu da shi. Obadiya ya gane shi, ya rusuna har ƙasa, ya ce, “Kai ne, shugabana, Iliya?”
english: As Obadiah was on the way, behold, Elijah met him. He recognized him, and fell on his face, and said, “Is it you, my lord Elijah?”

hausa: Saboda haka Ayuba ya buɗe baki yana magana barkatai; yana ta yawan magana ba tare da sani ba.”
english: therefore Job opens his mouth with empty talk, and he multiplies words without knowledge.”

hausa: “Ni kaina zan tattara raguwar garkena daga ƙasashen da na kore su zuwa zan kuma dawo da su ga makiyayansu, inda za su yi ta haihuwa su riɓaɓɓanya.
english: “I will gather the remnant of my flock out of all the countries where I have driven them, and will bring them again to their folds; and they will be fruitful and multiply.

hausa: Ba ’ya’yanku ba ne suka gani abin da ya yi dominku a hamada har sai da kuka kai wannan wuri ba,
english: and what he did to you in the wilderness until you came to this place;

hausa: Kowannensu kuwa ya buge abokin gābansa. Ganin wannan, sai Arameyawa suka gudu, Isra’ilawa suna bi. Amma Ben-Hadad na Aram ya tsere a kan dokinsa tare da waɗansu mahayan dawakansa.
english: They each killed his man. The Syrians fled, and Israel pursued them. Ben Hadad the king of Syria escaped on a horse with horsemen.

hausa: To, almajiran Yohanna da na Farisiyawa suna azumi, sai waɗansu mutane suka zo suka tambayi Yesu, suka ce, “Yaya almajiran Yohanna da na Farisiyawa suna azumi, amma almajiranka ba sa yi?”
english: John’s disciples and the Pharisees were fasting, and they came and asked him, “Why do John’s disciples and the disciples of the Pharisees fast, but your disciples don’t fast?”

hausa: Mace mai hankali na samu bangirma, amma azzalumai za su sami dukiya.
english: A gracious woman obtains honor, but violent men obtain riches.

hausa: Ba za ka tsere daga hannunsa ba amma tabbatacce za a kama ka a kuma ba da kai gare shi. Za ka ga sarkin Babilon da idanunka, zai kuwa yi magana da kai fuska da fuska. Za ka kuwa tafi Babilon.
english: You won’t escape out of his hand, but will surely be taken and delivered into his hand. Your eyes will see the eyes of the king of Babylon, and he will speak with you mouth to mouth. You will go to Babylon.”’

hausa: Sarakuna suna ƙyamar abin da ba shi da kyau, gama an kafa kujerar sarauta ta wurin adalci ne.
english: It is an abomination for kings to do wrong, for the throne is established by righteousness.

hausa: Ku gaya mini, ku da kuke so ku zauna a ƙarƙashin Doka, ba ku san abin da Doka ta ce ba ne?
english: Tell me, you that desire to be under the law, don’t you listen to the law?

hausa: Da mutane suka ga tsawa da walƙiya, suka ji karar ƙaho, suka kuma ga dutsen yana hayaƙi, sai suka yi rawar jiki don tsoro. Suka tsaya da nisa
english: All the people perceived the thunderings, the lightnings, the sound of the trumpet, and the mountain smoking. When the people saw it, they trembled, and stayed at a distance.

hausa: Ƙasar da take kango a dā za ku nome ta a maimakon zama kango a idon dukan masu ratsawa a cikinta.
english: The land that was desolate will be tilled instead of being a desolation in the sight of all who passed by.

hausa: Sa’ad da Musa ya shiga Tentin Sujada don yă yi magana da Ubangiji, sai ya ji murya tana magana da shi daga tsakanin kerubobi biyu a bisa murfin akwatin Alkawari. A ta haka Ubangiji ya yi masa magana.
english: When Moses went into the Tent of Meeting to speak with Yahweh, he heard his voice speaking to him from above the mercy seat that was on the ark of the Testimony, from between the two cherubim; and he spoke to him.

hausa: Suka yi wurin ajiye fitila da zinariya zalla, suka yi gindinsa da kuma gorar jikinsa, da ƙerarriyar zinariya. Kwaf wurin ajiye fitila da mahaɗansa, da furanninsa, a haɗe aka yi su da wurin ajiye fitilan.
english: He made the lamp stand of pure gold. He made the lamp stand of beaten work. Its base, its shaft, its cups, its buds, and its flowers were of one piece with it.

hausa: don in yi shelar shekarar tagomashin Ubangiji da kuma ranar ɗaukan fansar Allahnmu, don in ta’azantar da dukan waɗanda suke makoki,
english: to proclaim the year of Yahweh’s favor and the day of vengeance of our God, to comfort all who mourn,

hausa: Sai suka ce, “Mutumin ya sa riga mai gashi, ya kuma yi ɗamara da fata.” Sarkin ya ce, “Ai, Iliya mutumin Tishbe nan ne.”
english: They answered him, “He was a hairy man, and wearing a leather belt around his waist.” He said, “It’s Elijah the Tishbite.”

hausa: Ya kawar da masujadan kan tudu, ya farfasa keɓaɓɓun duwatsu, ya sassare ginshiƙan Ashera. Ya fashe macijin tagullan da Musa ya yi, gama har zuwa lokacin nan Isra’ilawa suna ƙona turare gare shi. (An ba shi suna Nehushtan.)
english: He removed the high places, broke the pillars, and cut down the Asherah. He also broke in pieces the bronze serpent that Moses had made, because in those days the children of Israel burned incense to it; and he called it Nehushtan.

hausa: Sa’ad da Isra’ila ya fito daga Masar, gidan Yaƙub daga mutane masu baƙon harshe,
english: When Israel went out of Egypt, the house of Jacob from a people of foreign language,

hausa: Amma mala’ikan ya ce masa, “Kada ka ji tsoro, Zakariya; an ji addu’arka. Matarka Elizabet za tă haifa maka ɗa, za ka kuma ba shi suna Yohanna.
english: But the angel said to him, “Don’t be afraid, Zacharias, because your request has been heard. Your wife, Elizabeth, will bear you a son, and you shall call his name John.

hausa: bagade na zinariya, da man shafewa, da turare mai ƙanshi, da labulen ƙofar shiga tenti,
english: the golden altar, the anointing oil, the sweet incense, the screen for the door of the Tent,

hausa: Amma akwai mutane da yawa, kuma lokacin damina ne; saboda haka ba za mu iya tsayawa a waje ba. Ban da haka ma, aikin nan ba na kwana ɗaya ko biyu ba ne, domin ba ƙaramin laifi muka yi ba.
english: But the people are many, and it is a time of much rain, and we are not able to stand outside. This is not a work of one day or two, for we have greatly transgressed in this matter.

hausa: Ga maganar da ta zo wa Irmiya daga Ubangiji.
english: The word that came to Jeremiah from Yahweh, saying,

hausa: Kiristi shi ne ƙarshen doka domin a sami adalci wa kowane mai bangaskiya.
english: For Christ is the fulfillment of the law for righteousness to everyone who believes.

hausa: Bilatus ya sa aka rubuta wata sanarwa aka kafa a kan gicciyen. Abin da aka rubuta kuwa shi ne, Yesu Banazare, Sarkin Yahudawa.
english: Pilate wrote a title also, and put it on the cross. There was written, “JESUS OF NAZARETH, THE KING OF THE JEWS.”

hausa: Sai Allah ya ce, “Zan kasance da tare kai. Wannan kuwa za tă zama alama a gare ka cewa Ni na aike ka. Bayan ka fitar da mutanen daga Masar, za ku yi sujada ga Allah a kan dutsen nan.”
english: He said, “Certainly I will be with you. This will be the token to you, that I have sent you: when you have brought the people out of Egypt, you shall serve God on this mountain.”

hausa: Sa’ad da dukan Isra’ilawa suka ga wutar na saukowa, ɗaukakar Ubangiji kuma tana a bisa haikalin, sai suka durƙusa a dakali da fuskokinsu a ƙasa, suka yi sujada suka kuma yi godiya ga Ubangiji suna cewa, “Ubangiji mai alheri ne, ƙaunarsa dawwammamiya ce har abada.”
english: All the children of Israel looked on, when the fire came down, and Yahweh’s glory was on the house. They bowed themselves with their faces to the ground on the pavement, worshiped, and gave thanks to Yahweh, saying, “For he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever!”

hausa: Amma Yehoshafat ya ce wa sarkin Isra’ila, “Da farko mu nemi nufin Ubangiji.”
english: Jehoshaphat said to the king of Israel, “Please inquire first for Yahweh’s word.”

hausa: Waɗanda mutuntaka yake mulkinsu ba za su iya su gamshi Allah ba.
english: Those who are in the flesh can’t please God.

hausa: Za mu yi sowa ta farin ciki sa’ad da ka yi nasara mu kuma ɗaga tutotinmu a cikin sunan Allahnmu. Bari Ubangiji yă biya maka dukan bukatunka.
english: We will triumph in your salvation. In the name of our God, we will set up our banners. May Yahweh grant all your requests.

hausa: Wannan ne ya sa na umarce ku ku keɓe wa kanku birane uku.
english: Therefore I command you to set apart three cities for yourselves.

hausa: Makafi da guragu suka zo wurinsa a haikali, ya kuwa warkar da su.
english: The lame and the blind came to him in the temple, and he healed them.

hausa: Saboda haka la’ana za tă auko wa duniya; dole mutanenta su ɗauki hakkin laifinsu. Saboda haka aka ƙone mazaunan duniya, kuma kaɗan ne kurum suka rage.
english: Therefore the curse has devoured the earth, and those who dwell therein are found guilty. Therefore the inhabitants of the earth are burned, and few men are left.

hausa: Sa’ad da ya bayyana, sai aka haɗa shi abokai talatin.
english: When they saw him, they brought thirty companions to be with him.

hausa: Farisiyawa da malaman dokoki suka zuba wa Yesu ido, su ga ko zai warkar a ranar Asabbaci, don su sami dalilin zarginsa.
english: The scribes and the Pharisees watched him, to see whether he would heal on the Sabbath, that they might find an accusation against him.

hausa: Bayan da ya jawo shi gefe, sai Yesu ya sa yatsotsinsa a kunnuwan mutumin, ya tofa miyau ya kuma taɓa harshen mutumin.
english: He took him aside from the multitude privately and put his fingers into his ears; and he spat and touched his tongue.

hausa: Sun sa ni kishi ta wurin abin da ba allah ba, suka kuma husata ni da gumakansu na wofi. Zan sa su yi kishi ta wurin waɗanda ba mutane ba; zan sa su yi fushi ta wurin al’ummar da ba ta da sani.
english: They have moved me to jealousy with that which is not God. They have provoked me to anger with their vanities. I will move them to jealousy with those who are not a people. I will provoke them to anger with a foolish nation.

hausa: Kamar zaki zai bar wurin ɓuyarsa, ƙasarsu kuma za tă zama kufai saboda takobin masu danniya da kuma saboda zafin fushin Ubangiji.
english: He has left his covert, as the lion; for their land has become an astonishment because of the fierceness of the oppression, and because of his fierce anger.

hausa: Suka kwashe kayan daga tenti ɗin suka kawo wa Yoshuwa da sauran Isra’ilawa, suka baza su a gaban Ubangiji.
english: They took them from the middle of the tent, and brought them to Joshua and to all the children of Israel. They laid them down before Yahweh.

hausa: Dubun dubbai suna a cikin kwarin yanke shawara! Gama ranar Ubangiji ta yi kusa a cikin kwarin yanke shawara.
english: Multitudes, multitudes in the valley of decision! For the day of Yahweh is near in the valley of decision.

hausa: amma Bulus ya zaɓi Sila suka kuwa tashi, bayan ’yan’uwa suka danƙa su ga alherin Ubangiji.
english: but Paul chose Silas and went out, being commended by the brothers to the grace of God.

hausa: “Kada ku yi mamakin wannan, gama lokaci yana zuwa da duk waɗanda suke cikin kaburbura za su ji muryarsa
english: Don’t marvel at this, for the hour comes in which all who are in the tombs will hear his voice

hausa: Bayan waɗannan abubuwa, Yoshuwa ɗan Nun, bawan Ubangiji, ya mutu yana da shekaru ɗari da goma.
english: After these things, Joshua the son of Nun, the servant of Yahweh, died, being one hundred ten years old.

hausa: Duk wanda ya ci naman jikina ya kuma sha jinina, yana da rai madawwami. Ni kuwa zan tashe shi a rana ta ƙarshe.
english: He who eats my flesh and drinks my blood has eternal life, and I will raise him up at the last day.

hausa: Ina iya yin kome ta wurin wannan wanda yake ba ni ƙarfi.
english: I can do all things through Christ who strengthens me.

hausa: Ya mai da koguna suka zama hamada, maɓulɓulai masu gudu suka zama ƙasa mai ƙishirwa,
english: He turns rivers into a desert, water springs into a thirsty ground,

hausa: Ben-Hadad ya yarda da Sarki Asa ya kuma aika da manyan hafsoshin mayaƙansa a kan garuruwan Isra’ila. Suka ci Iyon, Dan, Abel-Mayim da kuma dukan biranen ajiya na Naftali.
english: Ben Hadad listened to King Asa, and sent the captains of his armies against the cities of Israel; and they struck Ijon, Dan, Abel Maim, and all the storage cities of Naphtali.

hausa: Amma suka sami labari suka kuma gudu zuwa biranen Ikoniyum na Listira da Derbe da kuma ƙauyukan kewaye,
english: they became aware of it and fled to the cities of Lycaonia, Lystra, Derbe, and the surrounding region.

hausa: Dukansu biyu suna gudu, amma ɗayan almajirin ya tsere wa Bitrus ya kuma fara kai kabarin.
english: They both ran together. The other disciple outran Peter and came to the tomb first.

hausa: “Saboda haka, ɗan mutum, ka yi magana da mutanen Isra’ila ka faɗa musu cewa, ‘Ga abin da Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka yana cewa a wannan kuma kakanninku suka saɓe ni ta wurin yashe ni.
english: “Therefore, son of man, speak to the house of Israel, and tell them, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “Moreover, in this your fathers have blasphemed me, in that they have committed a trespass against me.

hausa: Duk da haka ya kasance mai jinƙai; ya gafarta laifofinsu bai kuwa hallaka su ba. Sau da sau ya janye fushinsa bai kuwa sa fushinsa yă ƙuna ba.
english: But he, being merciful, forgave iniquity, and didn’t destroy them. Yes, many times he turned his anger away, and didn’t stir up all his wrath.

hausa: Sa’an nan almajiran suka gane cewa yana musu zancen Yohanna Mai Baftisma ne.
english: Then the disciples understood that he spoke to them of John the Baptizer.

hausa: Bisa ga tarihin iyalinsu, sun kai mutane 36,000 shiryayyu don yaƙi, gama suna da mata da ’ya’ya da yawa.
english: With them, by their generations, after their fathers’ houses, were bands of the army for war, thirty-six thousand; for they had many wives and sons.

hausa: Dukan haskokin sammai za su zama duhu a kanka; zan kawo duhu a kan ƙasarka, in ji Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka.
english: I will make all the bright lights of the sky dark over you, and set darkness on your land,” says the Lord Yahweh.

hausa: Ku rarraba ƙasar ta wurin jefan ƙuri’a, bisa ga kabilanku. Kabilar da take babba, a ba ta babban gādo, ƙarami kabila kuwa, a ba ta ƙaramin gādo. Duk abin da ƙuri’a ta ba su, shi zai zama nasu. Ku rarraba wannan bisa zuriyar kakanninku.
english: You shall inherit the land by lot according to your families; to the larger groups you shall give a larger inheritance, and to the smaller you shall give a smaller inheritance. Wherever the lot falls to any man, that shall be his. You shall inherit according to the tribes of your fathers.

hausa: Na aikata abin da yake mai adalci da kuma daidai; kada ka ni a hannun masu danne ni.
english: I have done what is just and righteous. Don’t leave me to my oppressors.

hausa: Sama da ƙasa za su shuɗe, amma kalmomina ba za su taɓa shuɗewa ba.
english: Heaven and earth will pass away, but my words will by no means pass away.

hausa: Laban da Betuwel suka ce, “Wannan daga wurin Ubangiji ne, ba abin da za mu ce I, ko a’a ba.
english: Then Laban and Bethuel answered, “The thing proceeds from Yahweh. We can’t speak to you bad or good.

hausa: Maganar Ubangiji Maɗaukaki ta sāke zuwa gare ni.
english: The word of Yahweh of Armies came to me.

hausa: Ina da ganewa fiye da dattawa, gama ina biyayya da farillanka.
english: I understand more than the aged, because I have kept your precepts.

hausa: Suka tambaye su, “Wannan ɗanku ne? Shi ne wanda kuka ce an haife shi makaho? To, ta yaya yake gani yanzu?”
english: and asked them, “Is this your son, whom you say was born blind? How then does he now see?”

hausa: Yakan kuɓutar ya kuma ceci;
english: He delivers and rescues. He works signs and wonders in heaven and in earth, who has delivered Daniel from the power of the lions.”

hausa: “Issakar doki mai ƙarfi, kwance tsakanin buhunan sirdi.
english: “Issachar is a strong donkey, lying down between the saddlebags.

hausa: Gaskiya nake gaya muku, za a fi jin tausayin Sodom da Gomorra a ranar shari’a fiye da wannan gari.
english: Most certainly I tell you, it will be more tolerable for the land of Sodom and Gomorrah in the day of judgment than for that city.

hausa: Sa’an nan idanun dukansu biyu suka buɗe, suka kuma gane tsirara suke; saboda haka suka ɗinɗinka ganyayen ɓaure suka yi wa kansu sutura.
english: Their eyes were opened, and they both knew that they were naked. They sewed fig leaves together, and made coverings for themselves.

hausa: Noba kuma ya ci Kenat da ƙauyukanta da yaƙi, ya kuma ba ta suna Noba, bisa ga sunansa.
english: Nobah went and took Kenath and its villages, and called it Nobah, after his own name.

hausa: Fedahel ɗan Ammihud, shugaba daga kabilar Naftali.”
english: Of the tribe of the children of Naphtali a prince, Pedahel the son of Ammihud.”

hausa: Saboda haka ina gab da cinye Ba’asha da gidansa, zan kuma mai da gidanka kamar na Yerobowam ɗan Nebat.
english: behold, I will utterly sweep away Baasha and his house; and I will make your house like the house of Jeroboam the son of Nebat.

hausa: Sai Elihu ya ce,
english: Moreover Elihu answered,

hausa: Sai aka faɗa wa sarki, “Ga annabi Natan.” Da Natan ya je gaban sarki, sai ya rusuna da fuskarsa har ƙasa.
english: They told the king, saying, “Behold, Nathan the prophet!” When he had come in before the king, he bowed himself before the king with his face to the ground.

hausa: Don haka ne aka sa ni mai wa’azi, da manzo kuma, gaskiya nake faɗa, ba ƙarya ba, na kuma zama malami mai koya wa al’ummai al’amarin bangaskiya da kuma na gaskiya.
english: to which I was appointed a preacher and an apostle—I am telling the truth in Christ, not lying—a teacher of the Gentiles in faith and truth.

hausa: Ya ɗauki Solomon shekaru goma sha uku kafin yă gama gina fadarsa.
english: Solomon was building his own house thirteen years, and he finished all his house.

hausa: Saboda haka masifa za tă fāɗa farat ɗaya; za a hallaka shi nan da nan, ba makawa.
english: Therefore his calamity will come suddenly. He will be broken suddenly, and that without remedy.

hausa: ’Yar’uwarsa ta tsaya da ɗan rata tana lura da abin da zai faru da shi.
english: His sister stood far off, to see what would be done to him.

hausa: Ka farka, raina! Ku farka, garaya da molo! Zan sa safe yă farka.
english: Wake up, my glory! Wake up, lute and harp! I will wake up the dawn.

hausa: Daga tafin ƙafarku zuwa saman kanku ba lafiya, sai miyaku da ƙujewa da manyan gyambuna, ba a tsabtacce su ba ko a daure ko shafa musu magani.
english: From the sole of the foot even to the head there is no soundness in it, but wounds, welts, and open sores. They haven’t been closed, bandaged, or soothed with oil.

hausa: Ta amsa, ta ce, “I, Ubangiji, ko karnuka ma da suke ƙarƙashin tebur, sukan ci burbuɗin da suke fāɗuwa daga abincin yara.”
english: But she answered him, “Yes, Lord. Yet even the dogs under the table eat the children’s crumbs.”

hausa: Sai Yesu ya ɗauki burodin biyar da kifin biyun, ya ɗaga kansa sama, ya yi godiya, ya kuma kakkarya su. Ya ba wa almajiransa, domin su rarraba wa mutanen.
