english: He took the five loaves and the two fish, and looking up to the sky, he blessed them, broke them, and gave them to the disciples to set before the multitude.

hausa: Solomon ya rufe cikin haikalin da zinariya zalla, ya kuma gifta sarƙoƙin zinariya a gaban wuri mai tsarki na ciki, wanda aka dalaye da zinariya.
english: So Solomon overlaid the house within with pure gold. He drew chains of gold across before the inner sanctuary, and he overlaid it with gold.

hausa: Duk wanda ya taɓa gadonsa dole yă wanke rigunansa, yă kuma yi wanka, zai kuwa ƙazantu har yamma.
english: Whoever touches his bed shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening.

hausa: Saboda haka Ibrahim ya ruga zuwa wurin Saratu a cikin tenti ya ce, “Yi sauri, ki shirya mudu uku na gari mai laushi, ki cuɗa shi, ki yi burodi.”
english: Abraham hurried into the tent to Sarah, and said, “Quickly prepare three seahs of fine meal, knead it, and make cakes.”

hausa: Haka yake sa’ad da kuka yi magana da waɗansu harsunan da ba a fahimta. In babu wanda zai san abin da kuke faɗi, za ka dai yi wa iska magana ne kawai.
english: So also you, unless you uttered by the tongue words easy to understand, how would it be known what is spoken? For you would be speaking into the air.

hausa: Amma Yehoshafat ya yi tambaya, ya ce, “Babu wani annabin Ubangiji a nan da za mu tambaya?”
english: But Jehoshaphat said, “Isn’t there here a prophet of Yahweh, that we may inquire of him?”

hausa: Dawuda ya bar Gat, ya tsere zuwa kogon Adullam. Da ’yan’uwansa da kuma iyalan mahaifinsa suka ji labari, sai suka tafi can wurinsa.
english: David therefore departed from there and escaped to Adullam’s cave. When his brothers and all his father’s house heard it, they went down there to him.

hausa: Sa’an nan Ubangiji zai bayyana a bisansu; kibiyarsa za tă wulga kamar walƙiya. Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka zai busa ƙaho; zai taho ta cikin guguwa daga kudu,
english: Yahweh will be seen over them. His arrow will flash like lightning. The Lord Yahweh will blow the trumpet, and will go with whirlwinds of the south.

hausa: Sai ya yi tambaya ya ce, “Ke wace ce?” Ta amsa ta ce, “Ni ce baranyarka Rut, ka rufe ni ta mayafinka da yake kai dangi, mai fansa ne na kusa.”
english: He said, “Who are you?” She answered, “I am Ruth your servant. Therefore spread the corner of your garment over your servant; for you are a near kinsman.”

hausa: A duk sa’ad da ya zo; ko da safiya, ko dare ko kuma da rana, zai yi ta ratsawa yana kwasanku.” Za ku zama kamar mutumin da ya zama abin karin magana,
english: As often as it passes through, it will seize you; for morning by morning it will pass through, by day and by night; and it will be nothing but terror to understand the message.”

hausa: Lawiyawa suka saukar da akwatin alkawarin Ubangiji tare da babban akwati mai siffofin zinariya na ɓeraye da marurai suka ajiye su a kan ƙaton dutse. A wannan rana mutanen Bet-Shemesh suka miƙa hadaya ta ƙonawa da waɗansu hadayu ga Ubangiji.
english: The Levites took down Yahweh’s ark and the box that was with it, in which the jewels of gold were, and put them on the great stone; and the men of Beth Shemesh offered burnt offerings and sacrificed sacrifices the same day to Yahweh.

hausa: Zan ragargazar da Assuriya a cikin ƙasata; a kan duwatsuna zan tattake shi. Za a ɗauke nauyin da ya sa wa mutanena, a kuma ɗauke nauyinsa daga kafaɗunsu.”
english: that I will break the Assyrian in my land, and tread him under foot on my mountains. Then his yoke will leave them, and his burden leave their shoulders.

hausa: Ubangiji ya ce wa Musa, “Har yaushe mutanen nan za su rena ni? Har yaushe za su ƙi gaskata da ni, duk da yawan mu’ujizan da nake yi a cikinsu?
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “How long will this people despise me? How long will they not believe in me, for all the signs which I have worked among them?

hausa: don kuma su miƙa hadaya bisa ga abin da aka faɗa a Dokar Ubangiji cewa, “kurciyoyi biyu ko ’yan tattabarai biyu.”
english: and to offer a sacrifice according to that which is said in the law of the Lord, “A pair of turtledoves, or two young pigeons.”

hausa: Bakina zai yi magana cikin yabon Ubangiji. Bari kowace halitta ta yabi sunansa mai tsarki har abada abadin.
english: My mouth will speak the praise of Yahweh. Let all flesh bless his holy name forever and ever.

hausa: Yesu ya juya, ya ce musu, “’Yan matan Urushalima, kada ku yi kuka saboda ni, amma ku yi kuka saboda kanku, da kuma saboda ’ya’yanku.
english: But Jesus, turning to them, said, “Daughters of Jerusalem, don’t weep for me, but weep for yourselves and for your children.

hausa: Zan yi musu babbar sakayya da hukunci mai tsanani cikin hasalata. Sa’an nan za su san cewa ni ne Ubangiji, sa’ad da na ɗauki fansa a kansu.’ ”
english: I will execute great vengeance on them with wrathful rebukes. Then they will know that I am Yahweh, when I lay my vengeance on them.”’”

hausa: Ya ce wa bawansa, “Tafi ka dubi wajen teku.” Sai bawan ya haura ya duba. Ya ce, “Ba kome a can.” Sau bakwai Iliya ya ce, “Koma.”
english: He said to his servant, “Go up now and look toward the sea.” He went up and looked, then said, “There is nothing.” He said, “Go again” seven times.

hausa: Zan dawo da su daga al’ummai in kuma tattara su daga ƙasashe, zan kuma kawo su cikin ƙasarsu. Zan yi kiwonsu a kan duwatsun Isra’ila, a maɓulɓulai da kuma cikin wuraren zamansu a ƙasar.
english: I will bring them out from the peoples, and gather them from the countries, and will bring them into their own land. I will feed them on the mountains of Israel, by the watercourses, and in all the inhabited places of the country.

hausa: Amma sai ku nemi wurin da Ubangiji Allahnku zai zaɓa daga cikin dukan kabilanku, inda zai sa Sunansa, yă mai wurin mazauninsa. A wannan wuri ne za ku tafi;
english: But to the place which Yahweh your God shall choose out of all your tribes, to put his name there, you shall seek his habitation, and you shall come there.

hausa: Aram, Efraim da ɗan Remaliya sun ƙulla maƙarƙashiya, suna cewa,
english: Because Syria, Ephraim, and the son of Remaliah, have plotted evil against you, saying,

hausa: Ayyukan mulkin Asa, daga farko zuwa ƙarshe, suna a rubuce a littafin sarakunan Yahuda da Isra’ila.
english: Behold, the acts of Asa, first and last, behold, they are written in the book of the kings of Judah and Israel.

hausa: Kada ku kawo kuɗin a cikin gida Ubangiji Allahnku da aka samu ta wurin karuwanci wanda mace ko namiji ya yi don biyan wani alkawari, domin Ubangiji Allahnku yana ƙyamar su duka.
english: You shall not bring the hire of a prostitute, or the wages of a male prostitute, into the house of Yahweh your God for any vow; for both of these are an abomination to Yahweh your God.

hausa: Kada ku kauce zuwa dama ko zuwa hagu daga umarnan da na ba ku a yau, har ku bi waɗansu alloli kuna yin musu sujada.
english: and shall not turn away from any of the words which I command you today, to the right hand or to the left, to go after other gods to serve them.

hausa: Wannan zai sa ku zama shaidu a gare su.
english: It will turn out as a testimony for you.

hausa: In mutumin da ya keɓe gidansa ya fanshe shi, dole yă ƙara kashi ɗaya bisa biyar na darajar, gidan kuma zai zama nasa.
english: If he who dedicates it will redeem his house, then he shall add the fifth part of the money of your valuation to it, and it shall be his.

hausa: Aka ba su Hebron a Yahuda tare da wuraren kiwon da suke kewayenta.
english: to them they gave Hebron in the land of Judah, and its pasture lands around it;

hausa: Iyakar ta taɓa Tabor Shahazuma da Bet-Shemesh ta kuma ƙarasa a Urdun. Duka-duka garuruwa goma sha shida ke nan da ƙauyukansu.
english: The border reached to Tabor, Shahazumah, and Beth Shemesh. Their border ended at the Jordan: sixteen cities with their villages.

hausa: da Meshullam, da Abiya, da Miyamin,
english: Meshullam, Abijah, Mijamin,

hausa: Isra’ilawa sun yi zunubi, sun karya sharaɗin da na yi musu. Sun ɗauki waɗansu abubuwan da aka keɓe; sun yi sata, sun yi ƙarya, sun ɓoye su cikin kayansu.
english: Israel has sinned. Yes, they have even transgressed my covenant which I commanded them. Yes, they have even taken some of the devoted things, and have also stolen, and also deceived. They have even put it among their own stuff.

hausa: Ki yi murna ƙwarai, ya Diyar Urushalima! Ki yi sowa, Diyar Urushalima! Duba, ga sarkinki yana zuwa wurinki, mai adalci yana kuma da ceto, mai tawali’u yana kuma hawan jaki, yana a kan ɗan aholaki, a kan ’yar jaka.
english: Rejoice greatly, daughter of Zion! Shout, daughter of Jerusalem! Behold, your King comes to you! He is righteous, and having salvation; lowly, and riding on a donkey, even on a colt, the foal of a donkey.

hausa: Dukan yini sun yi ta juya maganata; kullum suna ƙulle-ƙulle su cuce ni.
english: All day long they twist my words. All their thoughts are against me for evil.

hausa: Aka jera ƙararrawan da ’ya’yan rumman bi da bi. Haka aka jera su kewaye da gefe-gefen taguwar aiki, yadda Ubangiji ya umarci Musa.
english: a bell and a pomegranate, a bell and a pomegranate, around the skirts of the robe, to minister in, as Yahweh commanded Moses.

hausa: “ ‘Gwaji tabbatacce zai zo. Kuma a ce sandan Yahuda, wanda takobi ya ƙi, ya ci gaba? In ji Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka.’
english: “For there is a trial. What if even the rod that condemns will be no more?” says the Lord Yahweh.

hausa: Yayinda suke kan hanyarsu, sai labari ya kai kunnen Dawuda cewa, “Absalom ya kashe dukan ’ya’yan sarki maza; ko ɗayansu Absalom bai rage ba.”
english: While they were on the way, the news came to David, saying, “Absalom has slain all the king’s sons, and there is not one of them left!”

hausa: Kirisbus, shugaban majami’a, da dukan iyalinsa suka gaskata Ubangiji; Korintiyawa masu yawa kuwa da suka ji shi suka gaskata, aka kuwa yi musu baftisma.
english: Crispus, the ruler of the synagogue, believed in the Lord with all his house. Many of the Corinthians, when they heard, believed and were baptized.

hausa: “La’ananne ne mutumin da ya karɓi cin hanci don yă kashe marar laifi.” Sai dukan mutane su ce, “Amin!”
english: ‘Cursed is he who takes a bribe to kill an innocent person.’ All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’

hausa: Amma Nahash ya ce, “Zan ƙulla amana da ku kawai a kan sharaɗin cewa zan ƙwaƙulo idon dama na kowannenku, ta haka za a kunyata Isra’ila.”
english: Nahash the Ammonite said to them, “On this condition I will make it with you, that all your right eyes be gouged out. I will make this dishonor all Israel.”

hausa: sunan matan Amram shi ne Yokebed, ita zuriyar Lawi ce, wadda aka haifa wa Lawiyawa a Masar. A wajen Amram kuwa ta haifi Haruna, Musa da kuma ’yar’uwarsu Miriyam.
english: The name of Amram’s wife was Jochebed, the daughter of Levi, who was born to Levi in Egypt. She bore to Amram Aaron and Moses, and Miriam their sister.

hausa: A shekara ta fari ta Dariyus mutumin Mede, na ɗauki matsayina domin in goyi baya in kuma kāre shi.)
english: “As for me, in the first year of Darius the Mede, I stood up to confirm and strengthen him.

hausa: Duk da haka, ba a aiki Iliya ga ko ɗaya a cikinsu ba. Sai dai zuwa ga wata gwauruwa da take a Zarefat, a yankin Sidon.
english: Elijah was sent to none of them, except to Zarephath, in the land of Sidon, to a woman who was a widow.

hausa: Ku ji wannan, ku dattawa, ku kasa kunne, dukan waɗanda suke zaune a ƙasar. Ko wani abu makamancin haka ya taɓa faruwa a kwanakinku ko a kwanakin kakanninku?
english: Hear this, you elders, and listen, all you inhabitants of the land! Has this ever happened in your days, or in the days of your fathers?

hausa: Sai Shawulu ya ce, “Ku gaya wa Dawuda, ‘Sarki ba ya bukatan kuɗin auren ’yarsa, sai dai loɓar Filistiyawa domin ramako a kan abokan gābansa.’ ” Shawulu yana shiri ne domin Dawuda yă fāɗa a hannun Filistiyawa.
english: Saul said, “Tell David, ‘The king desires no dowry except one hundred foreskins of the Philistines, to be avenged of the king’s enemies.’” Now Saul thought he would make David fall by the hand of the Philistines.

hausa: “ ‘Mutanen Dedan sun yi kasuwanci da ke, bakin teku masu yawa abokan cinikinki ne; sun biya ki da hauren giwa da katakon kanya.
english: “‘“The men of Dedan traded with you. Many islands were the market of your hand. They brought you horns of ivory and ebony in exchange.

hausa: Sa’an nan suka yi masa maganar Ubangiji shi da kuma dukan sauran da suke a gidansa.
english: They spoke the word of the Lord to him, and to all who were in his house.

hausa: Sai Rahila ta ce, “Na yi kokawa sosai da ’yar’uwata, na kuwa yi nasara.” Saboda haka ta kira shi Naftali.
english: Rachel said, “I have wrestled with my sister with mighty wrestlings, and have prevailed.” She named him Naphtali.

hausa: Ko da yake mugaye sun ɗaura ni da igiyoyi, ba zan manta da dokokinka ba.
english: The ropes of the wicked bind me, but I won’t forget your law.

hausa: Kifi a ciki Nilu za su mutu, ruwan kuma zai yi ɗoyi; Masarawa ba za su iya shan ruwansa ba.’ ”
english: The fish that are in the river will die and the river will become foul. The Egyptians will loathe to drink water from the river.”’”

hausa: Sa’an nan za ku ƙazantar da gumakanku da kuka dalaye da zinariya; za ku zubar da su kamar rigar al’adar mace ku kuma ce musu, “Ku ɓace mana da gani!”
english: You shall defile the overlaying of your engraved images of silver, and the plating of your molten images of gold. You shall cast them away as an unclean thing. You shall tell it, “Go away!”

hausa: Mutanenta duk suna ruri kamar zakoki, suna gurnani kamar ’ya’yan zaki.
english: They will roar together like young lions. They will growl as lions’ cubs.

hausa: “Zuwa ga mala’ikan ikkilisiya a Simirna, ka rubuta, Waɗannan su ne kalmomin wannan da yake na Farko da na Ƙarshe, wanda ya mutu ya kuma sāke tashi da rai.
english: “To the angel of the assembly in Smyrna write: “The first and the last, who was dead, and has come to life says these things:

hausa: “Har yanzu wani ya ce, ‘Na yi aure yanzun nan, don haka ni ba zan iya zuwa ba.’
english: “Another said, ‘I have married a wife, and therefore I can’t come.’

hausa: Amma saboda bawana Dawuda da kuma birnin Urushalima, wadda na zaɓa daga dukan kabilan Isra’ila, zai sami kabila guda.
english: (but he shall have one tribe, for my servant David’s sake and for Jerusalem’s sake, the city which I have chosen out of all the tribes of Israel),

hausa: Zai zama da albarka in maigida ya dawo, ya tarar da bayinsa suna zaman tsaro. Gaskiya ni faɗa muku, zai sa kayan hidima da kansa, ya sa bayinsa su zauna kan tebur, sa’an nan ya yi musu hidimar abinci.
english: Blessed are those servants whom the lord will find watching when he comes. Most certainly I tell you that he will dress himself, make them recline, and will come and serve them.

hausa: Yesu ya amsa ya ce, “Gaskiya ne, Iliya zai zo da fari, yă kuma mayar da dukan abubuwa. Don me kuma aka rubuta cewa, dole Ɗan Mutum yă sha wahala sosai, kuma a ƙi shi?
english: He said to them, “Elijah indeed comes first, and restores all things. How is it written about the Son of Man, that he should suffer many things and be despised?

hausa: Saboda haka dukan fadawa da mutane suka yi yarjejjeniyar cewa za su ’yantar da bayinsu maza da mata ba za su kuwa ƙara riƙe su bayi ba. Suka yarda, suka kuma sake su.
english: All the princes and all the people obeyed who had entered into the covenant, that everyone should let his male servant and everyone his female servant go free, that no one should make bondservants of them any more. They obeyed and let them go,

hausa: Da masu ginin suka aza harsashin ginin haikalin Ubangiji, sai firistoci suka sa kayansu na firistoci suka riƙe ƙahonin busa, Lawiyawa (’ya’yan Asaf) kuwa suka riƙe kuge, suka yi shiri domin su rera yabo ga Ubangiji kamar yadda Dawuda Sarkin Isra’ila ya ba da umarni.
english: When the builders laid the foundation of Yahweh’s temple, they set the priests in their vestments with trumpets, with the Levites the sons of Asaph with cymbals, to praise Yahweh, according to the directions of David king of Israel.

hausa: “Sa’an nan itatuwan suka ce wa kuringar inabi, ‘Ki zo ki zama sarkinmu.’
english: “The trees said to the vine, ‘Come and reign over us.’

hausa: Wane ne kuke yi wa ba’a? Ga wa kuke masa gwalo kuna kuma fitar da harshe? Ashe, ku ba tarin ’yan tawaye ba ne, zuriyar maƙaryata?
english: Whom do you mock? Against whom do you make a wide mouth and stick out your tongue? Aren’t you children of disobedience and offspring of falsehood,

hausa: Na kawo su cikin gidan Ubangiji, a cikin ɗakin ’ya’yan Hanan ɗan Igdaliya maza mutumin Allah. Ɗakin ne kusa da ɗakin fadawa, wanda yake bisa na Ma’asehiya ɗan Shallum mai tsaron ƙofa.
english: and I brought them into Yahweh’s house, into the room of the sons of Hanan the son of Igdaliah, the man of God, which was by the room of the princes, which was above the room of Maaseiah the son of Shallum, the keeper of the threshold.

hausa: Ba zan ƙara bari ƙafafun Isra’ilawa su bar ƙasar da na ba wa kakanninku ba, in dai suka yi hankali ga yin kome da na umarce su game da duka dokoki, ƙa’idodi da kuma farillai da na bayar ta wurin Musa.”
english: I will not any more remove the foot of Israel from off the land which I have appointed for your fathers, if only they will observe to do all that I have commanded them, even all the law, the statutes, and the ordinances given by Moses.”

hausa: Ku kiyaye farillaina, ku kuma bi su. Ni ne Ubangiji, wanda ya mai da ku masu tsarki.
english: You shall keep my statutes, and do them. I am Yahweh who sanctifies you.

hausa: Amma ka faɗa wa bayinka, ‘Sai kun kawo ƙaramin ɗan’uwanku tare da ku, in ba haka ba, ba za ku sāke ganin fuskata ba.’
english: You said to your servants, ‘Unless your youngest brother comes down with you, you will see my face no more.’

hausa: Saboda haka zai tare hanyarta da ƙaya; zan yi mata katanga don kada tă sami hanya.
english: Therefore behold, I will hedge up your way with thorns, and I will build a wall against her, that she can’t find her way.

hausa: Haka ma abincin da na tanada miki, lallausan gari, man zaitun, da zuman da na ba ki ki ci, kin miƙa su kamar turare mai ƙanshi a gabansu, in ji Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka.
english: My bread also which I gave you, fine flour, oil, and honey, with which I fed you, you even set it before them for a pleasant aroma; and so it was,” says the Lord Yahweh.

hausa: Shilo cikin Kan’ana, suka ce musu, “Ubangiji ya yi umarni ta wurin Musa cewa a ba mu garuruwan da za mu zauna a ciki, da wurin kiwo mai kyau don dabbobinmu.”
english: They spoke to them at Shiloh in the land of Canaan, saying, “Yahweh commanded through Moses to give us cities to dwell in, with their pasture lands for our livestock.”

hausa: Kawu ko yaron ɗan’uwan mahaifin wannan mutum, ko kuwa wani dangi a cikin zuriyarsa, zai iya fanshe shi. Ko kuma in ya azurta, zai iya fansar kansa.
english: or his uncle, or his uncle’s son, may redeem him, or any who is a close relative to him of his family may redeem him; or if he has grown rich, he may redeem himself.

hausa: Yohanan na takwas, Elzabad na tara,
english: Johanan the eighth, Elzabad the ninth,

hausa: Ubangiji, ta waɗannan abubuwa ne mutane suke rayuwa; ruhuna kuma yana samun rai a cikinsu shi ma. Ka maido mini da lafiya ka kuma sa na rayu.
english: Lord, men live by these things; and my spirit finds life in all of them. You restore me, and cause me to live.

hausa: Kada ka yi marmari dare yă yi, don a fitar da mutane daga gidajensu.
english: Don’t desire the night, when people are cut off in their place.

hausa: Saboda haka fushin Ubangiji ya yi ƙuna a kan wannan ƙasa, har ya kawo dukan la’anoni da aka rubuta a wannan littafi a kanta.
english: Therefore Yahweh’s anger burned against this land, to bring on it all the curses that are written in this book.

hausa: Ko da Babilon za tă kai sararin sama ne, ta gina kagaranta mai ƙarfi, duk da haka zan aiki masu hallakarwa a kanta,” in ji Ubangiji.
english: Though Babylon should mount up to the sky, and though she should fortify the height of her strength, yet destroyers will come to her from me,” says Yahweh.

hausa: ’Ya’yan Sama’ila maza su ne, Yowel ɗan fari da Abiya ɗa na biyu.
english: The sons of Samuel: the firstborn, Joel, and the second, Abijah.

hausa: to, kai mai koya wa waɗansu, ba kanka kake koya wa ba? Kai da kake wa’azi kada a yi sata, kana sata?
english: You therefore who teach another, don’t you teach yourself? You who preach that a man shouldn’t steal, do you steal?

hausa: Da yake kun ji duka game da shi, kuka kuma koyi gaskiyar da take cikin Yesu,
english: if indeed you heard him and were taught in him, even as truth is in Jesus:

hausa: Ba za ku ci wani halittar da take rarrafe a ƙasa, ko tana jan ciki, ko tana tafiya a kan ƙafafu huɗu, ko a kan ƙafafu da yawa ba; abin ƙyama ne.
english: Whatever goes on its belly, and whatever goes on all fours, or whatever has many feet, even all creeping things that creep on the earth, them you shall not eat; for they are an abomination.

hausa: A kudu, a nan ne sashe sansanin mutanen Ruben a ƙarƙashin ƙa’idarsu, za su yi sansani. Shugaban mutanen Ruben shi ne Elizur ɗan Shedeyur.
english: “On the south side shall be the standard of the camp of Reuben according to their divisions. The prince of the children of Reuben shall be Elizur the son of Shedeur.

hausa: Abin da yake dogara a kai ba shi da ƙarfi; abin da yake dogara a kai yanar gizo ce.
english: whose confidence will break apart, whose trust is a spider’s web.

hausa: Ku tuna da ranar da kuka tsaya a gaban Ubangiji Allahnku a Horeb, sa’ad da ya ce mini, “Ka tara mutane a gabana, don su ji maganata, su koya yin mini bangirma muddin ransu a ƙasar, su kuma iya koyar da su ga ’ya’yansu.”
english: the day that you stood before Yahweh your God in Horeb, when Yahweh said to me, “Assemble the people to me, and I will make them hear my words, that they may learn to fear me all the days that they live on the earth, and that they may teach their children.”

hausa: Na zaɓi na kuma tsarkake wannan haikali saboda Sunana yă kasance a can har abada. Idanuna da kuma zuciyata kullum za su kasance a can.
english: For now I have chosen and made this house holy, that my name may be there forever; and my eyes and my heart will be there perpetually.

hausa: Haka ya dalaye dukan cikin da zinariya. Ya kuma dalaye bagade na cikin wuri mai tsarki da zinariya.
english: He overlaid the whole house with gold, until all the house was finished. He also overlaid the whole altar that belonged to the inner sanctuary with gold.

hausa: Don ya san saboda sonkai ne suka ba da Yesu a gare shi.
english: For he knew that because of envy they had delivered him up.

hausa: Wannan fa shi ne sau na uku da Yesu ya bayyana kansa ga almajiransa bayan an tashe shi daga matattu.
english: This is now the third time that Jesus was revealed to his disciples after he had risen from the dead.

hausa: Kuna ƙarƙashin la’ana, dukan al’ummarku, domin kuna yin mini fashi.
english: You are cursed with the curse; for you rob me, even this whole nation.

hausa: Allah na Isra’ila ya yi magana, Dutsen Isra’ila ya ce mini, ‘Sa’ad da wani ya yi mulkin mutane da adalci, sa’ad da ya yi mulki da tsoron Allah,
english: The God of Israel said, the Rock of Israel spoke to me, ‘One who rules over men righteously, who rules in the fear of God,

hausa: Ko hannunka irin na Allah ne, kuma ko muryarka za tă iya tsawa kamar ta Allah?
english: Or do you have an arm like God? Can you thunder with a voice like him?

hausa: “Ku zo ku taimake ni in kai wa Gibeyon hari. Domin sun yi yarjejjeniya ta salama da Yoshuwa da Isra’ilawa.”
english: “Come up to me and help me. Let’s strike Gibeon; for they have made peace with Joshua and with the children of Israel.”

hausa: Takobi ba ta iya yankanta, kibiya ko māshi ba sa iya huda ta.
english: If one attacks him with the sword, it can’t prevail; nor the spear, the dart, nor the pointed shaft.

hausa: Allah, wanda ya san zuciya, ya nuna cewa ya karɓe su ta wurin ba su Ruhu Mai Tsarki, kamar yadda ya ba mu.
english: God, who knows the heart, testified about them, giving them the Holy Spirit, just like he did to us.

hausa: Gidan Yahuda suka zo gaba, sai aka ware gidan Zera, aka sa suka fito iyali-iyali, sai aka ware Zabdi.
english: He brought near the family of Judah, and he selected the family of the Zerahites. He brought near the family of the Zerahites man by man, and Zabdi was selected.

hausa: Sarki ya ce wa Barzillai, “Ka ƙetaro tare da ni ka zauna tare da ni a Urushalima, zan kuwa tanada maka.”
english: The king said to Barzillai, “Come over with me, and I will sustain you with me in Jerusalem.”

hausa: Ƙungiyoyi uku ɗin nan suka busa ƙahonin, suka fasa tuluna. Suka ɗauki acibalbal a hannuwansu na hagu da ƙahonin busawa a hannuwansu na dama, sai suka yi ihu, “Takobi don Ubangiji da kuma don Gideyon!”
english: The three companies blew the trumpets, broke the pitchers, and held the torches in their left hands and the trumpets in their right hands with which to blow; and they shouted, “The sword of Yahweh and of Gideon!”

hausa: Ka ƙi Yahuda ɗungum ke nan? Kana ƙyamar Sihiyona ne? Me ya sa ka buge mu don kada mu warke? Mun sa zuciya ga salama babu abin alherin da ya zo, mun sa rai ga lokacin warkarwa amma sai ga razana.
english: Have you utterly rejected Judah? Has your soul loathed Zion? Why have you struck us, and there is no healing for us? We looked for peace, but no good came; and for a time of healing, and behold, dismay!

hausa: Gama ba masu jin dokar ne suke da adalci a gaban Allah ba, amma waɗanda suke yin biyayya da dokar, su za a ce da su masu adalci.
english: For it isn’t the hearers of the law who are righteous before God, but the doers of the law will be justified

hausa: Bisa ga umarnin sarki, aka bar kowane baƙo yă sha yadda ya ga dama, gama sarki ya umarci dukan bayin da suke rarraba ruwan inabin su ba wa kowa abin da yake so.
english: In accordance with the law, the drinking was not compulsory; for so the king had instructed all the officials of his house, that they should do according to every man’s pleasure.

hausa: Yehoshafat ya rusuna da fuskarsa har ƙasa, dukan mutanen Yahuda da Urushalima suka fāɗi rubda ciki suka yi sujada a gaban Ubangiji.
english: Jehoshaphat bowed his head with his face to the ground; and all Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem fell down before Yahweh, worshiping Yahweh.

hausa: Amma Hamor ya ce musu, “Ɗana Shekem ya sa zuciyarsa a kan ’yarku. Ina roƙonku ku ba shi ita yă aura.
english: Hamor talked with them, saying, “The soul of my son, Shechem, longs for your daughter. Please give her to him as a wife.

hausa: abokan gāban mutum, za su zama mutanen gidansa ne.’
english: A man’s foes will be those of his own household.

hausa: domin ya koyar kamar wani wanda yake da iko, ba kamar malamansu na dokoki ba.
english: for he taught them with authority, and not like the scribes.

hausa: “Saboda haka bari dukan Isra’ila su tabbatar da wannan. Allah ya mai da wannan Yesu, da kuka gicciye, Ubangiji da kuma Kiristi.”
english: “Let all the house of Israel therefore know certainly that God has made him both Lord and Christ, this Jesus whom you crucified.”

hausa: Haka Isra’ilawa suka raba ƙasar, yadda Ubangiji ya umarci Musa.
english: The children of Israel did as Yahweh commanded Moses, and they divided the land.

hausa: “Sa’an nan zai yanka akuya na hadaya don zunubi saboda mutane, yă kai jinin bayan labule, yă yi da shi yadda ya yi da jinin bijimin. Zai yayyafa shi a kan murfin kafarar da kuma a gabansa.
english: “Then he shall kill the goat of the sin offering that is for the people, and bring his blood within the veil, and do with his blood as he did with the blood of the bull, and sprinkle it on the mercy seat and before the mercy seat.

hausa: Nan da nan aka kira magatakardun fada, a ranar ashirin da uku ga watan uku, wato, watan Siban. Suka rubuta dukan umarnan Mordekai ga Yahudawa, da kuma ga shugabanni, da gwamnoni, da hakiman larduna 127 tun daga Indiya har zuwa Kush. Aka rubuta waɗannan umarnan a rubutun kowane lardi, da kuma cikin harshen kowane mutane. Aka kuma rubuta ga Yahudawa a rubutunsu da harshensu.
english: Then the king’s scribes were called at that time, in the third month, which is the month Sivan, on the twenty-third day of the month; and it was written according to all that Mordecai commanded to the Jews, and to the local governors, and the governors and princes of the provinces which are from India to Ethiopia, one hundred twenty-seven provinces, to every province according to its writing, and to every people in their language, and to the Jews in their writing, and in their language.

hausa: Allah, wanda ya kira ku zuwa ga zumunci tare da Ɗansa Yesu Kiristi Ubangijinmu, shi mai aminci ne.
english: God is faithful, through whom you were called into the fellowship of his Son, Jesus Christ our Lord.

hausa: Ubangiji ya ce wa Musa,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

hausa: Da Gideyon ya ji mafarkin da fassararsa, sai ya yi wa Allah sujada. Ya koma sansanin Isra’ila ya yi kira da ƙarfi ya ce, “Ku tashi! Ubangiji ya ba da sansanin Midiyawa a hannuwanku.”
english: It was so, when Gideon heard the telling of the dream and its interpretation, that he worshiped. Then he returned into the camp of Israel and said, “Arise, for Yahweh has delivered the army of Midian into your hand!”

hausa: Ya yi girma sai da ya kai rundunar sammai, ya kuma fid da waɗansu rundunar taurari zuwa ƙasa ya kuma tattake su.
english: It grew great, even to the army of the sky; and it cast down some of the army and of the stars to the ground and trampled on them.

hausa: Sai Ubangiji ya tambaye ni, “Me kake gani, Amos?” Sai na amsa, “Igiyar gwada gini.” Sa’an nan Ubangiji ya ce, “Duba, zan sa igiyan nan a cikin mutanena Isra’ila; ba zan ƙara barinsu ba.
english: Yahweh said to me, “Amos, what do you see?” I said, “A plumb line.” Then the Lord said, “Behold, I will set a plumb line in the middle of my people Israel. I will not again pass by them any more.

hausa: Amma nan da nan suka manta abin da ya yi ba su kuwa jira shawararsa ba.
english: They soon forgot his works. They didn’t wait for his counsel,

hausa: Akish ya amince da Dawuda sosai, har ya ce wa kansa, “Ga shi ya mai da kansa abin ƙi ga mutanensa Isra’ilawa, zai zama bawana har abada.”
english: Achish believed David, saying, “He has made his people Israel utterly to abhor him. Therefore he will be my servant forever.”

hausa: Da suka isa Salamis, sai suka yi shelar maganar Allah a majami’un Yahudawa. Yohanna yana tare da su a matsayin mai taimakonsu.
english: When they were at Salamis, they proclaimed God’s word in the Jewish synagogues. They also had John as their attendant.

hausa: Sai waɗanda suka dawo daga bauta suka yi yadda aka zartar. Ezra firist ya zaɓi mutane waɗanda su ne shugabannin iyalai, ɗaya daga kowane sashe, aka rubuta sunan kowannensu. A ranar ɗaya ga watan goma kuwa suka zauna don su yi binciken waɗannan abubuwa.
english: The children of the captivity did so. Ezra the priest, with certain heads of fathers’ households, after their fathers’ houses, and all of them by their names, were set apart; and they sat down in the first day of the tenth month to examine the matter.

hausa: Sai Mordekai ya rubuta waɗannan abubuwa, ya kuma aika wasiƙu ga dukan Yahudawa ko’ina a lardunan Sarki Zerzes, na kusa da na nesa.
english: Mordecai wrote these things, and sent letters to all the Jews who were in all the provinces of the King Ahasuerus, both near and far,

hausa: da Ahaz, da Hezekiya da Manasse,
english: Ahaz his son, Hezekiah his son, Manasseh his son,

hausa: Sai kuma Mattaniya ɗan Mika, ɗan Zabdi, ɗan Asaf, shugaban da yake bi da hidimar godiya da kuma addu’a. Sai Bakbukiya, na biyu a cikin ’yan’uwansa; da Abda ɗan Shammuwa, ɗan Galal, ɗan Yedutun.
english: and Mattaniah the son of Mica, the son of Zabdi, the son of Asaph, who was the chief to begin the thanksgiving in prayer, and Bakbukiah, the second among his brothers; and Abda the son of Shammua, the son of Galal, the son of Jeduthun.

hausa: Da Yobab ya mutu, Husham daga ƙasar Temaniyawa ya gāje shi a matsayin sarki.
english: Jobab died, and Husham of the land of the Temanites reigned in his place.

hausa: Duniya ta bushe ta kuma yanƙwane, duniya tana shan azaba ta kuma raunana, masu daraja na duniya suna shan azaba.
english: The earth mourns and fades away. The world languishes and fades away. The lofty people of the earth languish.

hausa: Sa’ad da ka fito a gaban mutanenka, ya Allah, sa’ad da ka taka ta cikin ƙasar da take wofi, Sela
english: God, when you went out before your people, when you marched through the wilderness... Selah.

hausa: Ku ɗauki nawayar juna, a haka kuwa za ku cika dokar Kiristi.
english: Bear one another’s burdens, and so fulfill the law of Christ.

hausa: ya ce, “Ɗan ƙaramin abu ne ka zama bawana don ka maido da kabilar Yaƙub ka kuma dawo da waɗannan na Isra’ilawan da na kiyaye. Zan kuma mai da kai haske ga Al’ummai, don ka kawo cetona zuwa iyakokin duniya.”
english: Indeed, he says, “It is too light a thing that you should be my servant to raise up the tribes of Jacob, and to restore the preserved of Israel. I will also give you as a light to the nations, that you may be my salvation to the end of the earth.”

hausa: Ya gina Wuri Mafi Tsarki, tsawonsa daidai da fāɗin haikalin. Tsawonsa kamu ashirin, fāɗinsa kuwa kamu ashirin. Ya shafe cikin da talenti ɗari shida na zinariya zalla.
english: He made the most holy place. Its length, according to the width of the house, was twenty cubits, and its width twenty cubits; and he overlaid it with fine gold, amounting to six hundred talents.

hausa: Arfakshad shi ne mahaifin Shela, Shela kuwa shi ne mahaifin Eber.
english: Arpachshad became the father of Shelah, and Shelah became the father of Eber.

hausa: Sai Yoshuwa ɗan Nun, wanda yake mataimakin Musa tun yana saurayi, ya amsa ya ce, “Ranka yă daɗe, Musa, ka hana su!”
english: Joshua the son of Nun, the servant of Moses, one of his chosen men, answered, “My lord Moses, forbid them!”

hausa: Yaƙub ya ce wa mahaifiyarsa Rebeka, “Amma ɗan’uwana Isuwa mutum ne mai gashi a jiki, ni kuma jikina sumul yake.
english: Jacob said to Rebekah his mother, “Behold, Esau my brother is a hairy man, and I am a smooth man.

hausa: Da yamma ta yi, sai almajiransa suka zo wurinsa suka ce, “Wurin nan fa ba kowa, ga shi kuma rana ta kusa fāɗuwa. Ka sallami taron don su shiga ƙauyuka su nemi wa kansu abinci.”
english: When evening had come, his disciples came to him, saying, “This place is deserted, and the hour is already late. Send the multitudes away, that they may go into the villages, and buy themselves food.”

hausa: Amma ni, da waƙar godiya, zan miƙa tawa hadaya gare ka. Abin da na yi alkawari, shi ne zan yi. Ceto yakan zo ne kawai daga wurin Ubangiji.”
english: But I will sacrifice to you with the voice of thanksgiving. I will pay that which I have vowed. Salvation belongs to Yahweh.”

hausa: Zan sa ka azurta sosai, zan yi al’ummai daga cikinka, sarakuna kuma za su fito daga cikinka,
english: I will make you exceedingly fruitful, and I will make nations of you. Kings will come out of you.

hausa: A wajen kudu za tă fara daga Tamar har zuwa ruwan Meriba Kadesh, sa’an nan ta bi Rafin Masar zuwa Bahar Rum. Wannan ita ce iyakar a wajen kudu.
english: “The south side southward shall be from Tamar as far as the waters of Meriboth Kadesh, to the brook, to the great sea. This is the south side southward.

hausa: Ku shirya kanku iyali-iyali a sassanku, bisa ga umarnan da Dawuda sarkin Isra’ila da kuma ɗansa Solomon suka rubuta.
english: Prepare yourselves after your fathers’ houses by your divisions, according to the writing of David king of Israel, and according to the writing of Solomon his son.

hausa: Ya Ubangiji an ɗaga hannunka sama, amma ba sa ganinsa. Bari su ga himmarka don mutanenka su kuma sha kunya; bari wutar da aka ajiye don abokan gābanka ta cinye su.
english: Yahweh, your hand is lifted up, yet they don’t see; but they will see your zeal for the people and be disappointed. Yes, fire will consume your adversaries.

hausa: To, ba a yi jiki da gaɓa ɗaya kawai ba, amma da gaɓoɓi da yawa.
english: For the body is not one member, but many.

hausa: “Ka yi hankali da abokanka; kada ka amince da ’yan’uwanka. Gama kowane ɗan’uwa munafuki ne, kowane aboki kuma mai kushe ne.
english: “Everyone beware of his neighbor, and don’t trust in any brother; for every brother will utterly supplant, and every neighbor will go around like a slanderer.

hausa: Sunan matarsa kuwa Ahinowam, ’yar Ahimawaz. Sunan shugaban ƙungiyar sojan Shawulu kuwa Abner ne ɗan Ner, shi Ner kuwa ɗan’uwan mahaifin Shawulu ne.
english: The name of Saul’s wife was Ahinoam the daughter of Ahimaaz. The name of the captain of his army was Abner the son of Ner, Saul’s uncle.

hausa: A ƙafafunsa kuwa ya sa ƙarafar tagulla, rataye a bayansa kuma māshi ne na tagulla.
english: He had bronze shin armor on his legs and a bronze javelin between his shoulders.

hausa: Wane mutum ne yana da isashiyar hikimar fahimtar wannan? Wa Ubangiji ya umarta da zai iya yin bayani? Me ya sa aka lalace ƙasar ta zama kufai kamar hamada da ba wanda zai iya ratsa ta?
english: Who is wise enough to understand this? Who is he to whom the mouth of Yahweh has spoken, that he may declare it? Why has the land perished and burned up like a wilderness, so that no one passes through?

hausa: Sai Rahila ta ce wa mahaifinta, “Kada ka yi fushi, ranka yă daɗe da ban tashi tsaye a gabanka ba; gama ina al’adar mata ne.” Saboda haka ya bincika amma bai sami gumakan gidan ba.
english: She said to her father, “Don’t let my lord be angry that I can’t rise up before you; for I’m having my period.” He searched, but didn’t find the teraphim.

hausa: To, Isra’ilawa suka yi juyayin ’yan’uwansu, mutanen Benyamin. “Yau an hallaka kabila daga cikin Isra’ila.
english: The children of Israel grieved for Benjamin their brother, and said, “There is one tribe cut off from Israel today.

hausa: Ku zaɓi umarnina a maimakon azurfa, sani a maimakon zinariya zalla,
english: Receive my instruction rather than silver, knowledge rather than choice gold.

hausa: Saboda haka, kada ku ji tsoro. Zan tanada muku da kuma ’ya’yanku.” Ya sāke tabbatar musu, ya kuma yi musu magana ta alheri.
english: Now therefore don’t be afraid. I will provide for you and your little ones.” He comforted them, and spoke kindly to them.

hausa: “Daga sama ya miƙo hannu ya ɗauke ni, ya tsamo ni daga zurfafa ruwaye.
english: He sent from on high and he took me. He drew me out of many waters.

hausa: Hadad shi ma ya mutu. Manyan Edom su ne, Timna, Alwa, Yetet
english: Then Hadad died. The chiefs of Edom were: chief Timna, chief Aliah, chief Jetheth,

hausa: Sai ya tashi ya kama hanya ya koma wurin mahaifinsa. “Amma tun yana nesa, mahaifinsa ya hange shi. Tausayi kuma ya kama shi, sai ya tashi ya ruga da gudu wurinsa, ya rungume shi, ya yi masa sumba.
english: “He arose and came to his father. But while he was still far off, his father saw him and was moved with compassion, and ran, fell on his neck, and kissed him.

hausa: Ku saurara, ’yan’uwana ƙaunatattu. Ashe, Allah bai zaɓi waɗanda suke matalauta a idon duniya don su zama masu wadata cikin bangaskiya, su kuma gāji mulkin da ya yi wa masu ƙaunarsa alkawari ba?
english: Listen, my beloved brothers. Didn’t God choose those who are poor in this world to be rich in faith and heirs of the Kingdom which he promised to those who love him?

hausa: Suka je wurin Eleyazar firist, da Yoshuwa ɗan Nun, da kuma shugabannin, suka ce musu, “Ubangiji ya umarci Musa cewa yă ba mu gādonmu tare da ’yan’uwanmu maza.” Saboda haka Yoshuwa ya ba su gādo tare da ’yan’uwan mahaifinsu maza bisa ga umarnin Ubangiji.
english: They came to Eleazar the priest, and to Joshua the son of Nun, and to the princes, saying, “Yahweh commanded Moses to give us an inheritance among our brothers.” Therefore according to the commandment of Yahweh he gave them an inheritance among the brothers of their father.

hausa: Su ne suka haye Urdun a wata na farko sa’ad da kogin ya yi ambaliya, suka kuma kori duk mai rai a kwarin, na wajen gabas da na wajen yamma.
english: These are those who went over the Jordan in the first month, when it had overflowed all its banks; and they put to flight all who lived in the valleys, both toward the east and toward the west.

hausa: To, in hidimar da ta kawo mutuwa, wadda an rubuta a kan allon dutse, ta zo da ɗaukaka har Isra’ilawa suka kāsa duban fuskar Musa saboda tsananin haskenta, ko da yake mai shuɗewa ce,
english: But if the service of death, written engraved on stones, came with glory, so that the children of Israel could not look steadfastly on the face of Moses for the glory of his face, which was passing away,

hausa: Rawani ya fāɗi daga kanmu. Kaiton mu gama mun yi zunubi!
english: The crown has fallen from our head. Woe to us, for we have sinned!

hausa: Zan fitar da ku daga al’ummai in tattara ku daga ƙasashe inda aka warwatsa ku, da hannu mai iko da kuma hannu mai ƙarfi da kuma fushi.
english: I will bring you out from the peoples, and will gather you out of the countries in which you are scattered with a mighty hand, with an outstretched arm, and with wrath poured out.

hausa: Gaskiya ce cewa waɗansu suna yin wa’azin Kiristi saboda kishi da neman faɗa, amma waɗansu da nufi mai kyau suke yi.
english: Some indeed preach Christ even out of envy and strife, and some also out of good will.

hausa: “Ga abin da Ubangiji yana cewa, Mai Tsarkin nan na Isra’ila, da kuma Mahaliccinsa. Game da abubuwan da ke zuwa, kun tambaye ni game da ’ya’yana, ko kuwa kun ba ni umarni game da aikin hannuwana?
english: Yahweh, the Holy One of Israel and his Maker says: “You ask me about the things that are to come, concerning my sons, and you command me concerning the work of my hands!

hausa: kuma, “Zai zama cewa a daidai inda aka ce musu, ‘Ku ba mutanena ba,’ za a ce da su, ‘’ya’yan Allah mai rai.’ ”
english: “It will be that in the place where it was said to them, ‘You are not my people,’ there they will be called ‘children of the living God.’”

hausa: Maganar Ubangiji ta zo mini cewa,
english: Moreover Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

hausa: Wahayoyinsu ƙarya ne suna yin dubansu na ƙarya ne. Sukan ce, Ubangiji ya furta, alhali kuwa Ubangiji bai aike su ba; duk da haka sukan sa zuciya ga cikawar maganarsu.
english: They have seen falsehood and lying divination, who say, ‘Yahweh says;’ but Yahweh has not sent them. They have made men to hope that the word would be confirmed.

hausa: Ta haka za ku fid da laifin zub da jinin marar laifi daga cikinku, da yake kun yi abin da yake daidai a gaban Ubangiji.
english: So you shall put away the innocent blood from among you, when you shall do that which is right in Yahweh’s eyes.

hausa: Ta wurinsa ne dukan ginin yake a haɗe, shi ne kuma yake sa ginin yă yi girma, yă zama haikali mai tsarki domin Ubangiji.
english: in whom the whole building, fitted together, grows into a holy temple in the Lord;

hausa: Hezekiya ya karɓi wasiƙar daga jakadun ya karanta ta. Sa’an nan ya haura zuwa haikalin Ubangiji ya shimfiɗa ta a gaban Ubangiji.
english: Hezekiah received the letter from the hand of the messengers and read it. Then Hezekiah went up to Yahweh’s house, and spread it before Yahweh.

hausa: Kada ka yi zina.
english: “You shall not commit adultery.

hausa: Zan ba ku sabuwa zuciya in kuma sa sabon ruhu a cikinku; zan fid da zuciyar dutse in kuma ba ku zuciyar nama.
english: I will also give you a new heart, and I will put a new spirit within you. I will take away the stony heart out of your flesh, and I will give you a heart of flesh.

hausa: Ku roƙi Ubangiji, yă tsai da tsawar da ƙanƙarar. Ni kuwa na yi alkawari zan bar ku ku tafi, ba za ku ƙara tsayawa a nan ba.”
english: Pray to Yahweh; for there has been enough of mighty thunderings and hail. I will let you go, and you shall stay no longer.”

hausa: Dukan hannuwansu sun gwaninta wajen yin mugunta; shugabanni suna nema a ba su kyautai, alƙalai suna nema a ba su cin hanci, masu iko suna faɗar son zuciyarsu, duk suna ƙulla makirci tare.
english: Their hands are on that which is evil to do it diligently. The ruler and judge ask for a bribe. The powerful man dictates the evil desire of his soul. Thus they conspire together.

hausa: Sai ya shiga ɗaya jirgin ruwan da yake na Siman, ya kuma roƙe shi yă tura shi kaɗan daga gaci. Sai ya zauna a jirgin ruwan, ya koyar da mutane daga ciki.
english: He entered into one of the boats, which was Simon’s, and asked him to put out a little from the land. He sat down and taught the multitudes from the boat.

hausa: “Ka ce da ’yan’uwanka maza, ‘Mutanena,’ ka kuma ce da ’yan’uwanka mata, ‘Ƙaunatacciyata.’
english: “Say to your brothers, ‘My people!’ and to your sisters, ‘My loved one!’

hausa: in na sami tagomashi a wurin sarki, in kuma sarki ya yarda yă biya mini bukatata, yă kuma ji roƙona, bari sarki da Haman su zo gobe wurin liyafar da zan shirya musu. Sa’an nan zan amsa tambayar sarki.”
english: If I have found favor in the sight of the king, and if it pleases the king to grant my petition and to perform my request, let the king and Haman come to the banquet that I will prepare for them, and I will do tomorrow as the king has said.”

hausa: “Saboda haka nake ce muku, ku saurare ni; ni ma zan gaya muku abin da na sani.
english: Therefore I said, ‘Listen to me; I also will show my opinion.’

hausa: Game da sauran ayyukan mulkin Yowash da duk abin da ya yi, duk a rubuce suke a cikin littafin tarihin sarakunan Yahuda.
english: Now the rest of the acts of Joash, and all that he did, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

hausa: Duk da haka mutanen nan suna maganar banza a kan kome da ba su gane ba; kuma abubuwan da suka fahimta bisa ga jiki, kamar dabbobi marasa hankali, waɗannan abubuwa ne suke hallaka su.
english: But these speak evil of whatever things they don’t know. They are destroyed in these things that they understand naturally, like the creatures without reason.

hausa: Duk mai son adana ransa zai rasa shi, duk wanda kuwa ya rasa ransa saboda ni zai same shi.
english: He who seeks his life will lose it; and he who loses his life for my sake will find it.

hausa: sai ya aiki ’yan leƙen asiri su tabbata lalle Shawulu ya iso can.
english: David therefore sent out spies, and understood that Saul had certainly come.

hausa: “Ta haka zan tsarkake Tentin Sujada da bagaden, in kuma tsarkake Haruna da ’ya’yansa maza su yi mini hidima a matsayin firistoci.
english: I will sanctify the Tent of Meeting and the altar. I will also sanctify Aaron and his sons to minister to me in the priest’s office.

hausa: Hiram kuwa ya aiki mutanensa, masu tuƙan jirgin ruwa waɗanda suka san teku, don su yi hidima a jerin jiragen ruwa tare da mutanen Solomon.
english: Hiram sent in the fleet his servants, sailors who had knowledge of the sea, with the servants of Solomon.

hausa: da aka ƙidaya kabila-kabila da kuma iyali-iyali, su 2,630 ne.
english: even those who were counted of them, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, were two thousand six hundred thirty.

hausa: Al’amarin ya zama da muni ƙwarai a cikin Isra’ila da Yahuda, don haka Ubangiji ya husata har ya sa aka kai mutanen bautar talala. Zedekiya kuwa ya tayar wa Sarkin Babilon.
english: For through Yahweh’s anger this happened in Jerusalem and Judah, until he had cast them out from his presence. Zedekiah rebelled against the king of Babylon.

hausa: Ana nan sai sarkin Ammonawa ya rasu, ɗansa Hanun kuwa ya gāje shi a matsayin sarki.
english: After this, the king of the children of Ammon died, and Hanun his son reigned in his place.

hausa: Sai waɗansu suka miƙe tsaye, suka ba da wannan shaida ƙarya a kansa, suka ce,
english: Some stood up and gave false testimony against him, saying,

hausa: (Saboda haka, aka kira ranakun nan Furim, daga kalma fur). Saboda dukan abin da aka rubuta cikin wannan wasiƙa da kuma abin da suka gani, da abin da ya same su.
english: Therefore they called these days “Purim”, from the word “Pur.” Therefore because of all the words of this letter, and of that which they had seen concerning this matter, and that which had come to them,

hausa: Ka ba su saƙo wa iyayengijinsu su ce, ‘Ga abin da Ubangiji Maɗaukaki, Allah na Isra’ila, yana cewa, “Ku faɗa wa iyayengijinku wannan.
english: Give them a command to their masters, saying, ‘Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel says, “You shall tell your masters:

hausa: Bayan haka, Yusuf mutumin Arimateya ya roƙi Bilatus a ba shi jikin Yesu. Yusuf dai almajirin Yesu ne, amma a ɓoye domin yana tsoron Yahudawa. Da izinin Bilatus, ya zo ya ɗauki jikin.
english: After these things, Joseph of Arimathaea, being a disciple of Jesus, but secretly for fear of the Jews, asked of Pilate that he might take away Jesus’ body. Pilate gave him permission. He came therefore and took away his body.

hausa: Duk kuma sa’ad da akwatin ya kama hanya, sai Musa ya ce, “Ka tashi, ya Ubangiji! Ka sa maƙiyanka su warwatse; masu ƙinka kuma su gudu a gabanka.”
english: When the ark went forward, Moses said, “Rise up, Yahweh, and let your enemies be scattered! Let those who hate you flee before you!”

hausa: Zai zama hakkin sarki ne ya tanada hadayu na ƙonawa, hadayu na gari da hadayu na sha a bukukkuwa, Sabuwar Wata da Asabbatai, a duk ƙayyadaddun bukukkuwa na gidan Isra’ila. Zai tanada hadayu don zunubi, hadayu na gari, hadayu na ƙonawa da hadayu na salama don yin kafara saboda gidan Isra’ila.
english: It shall be the prince’s part to give the burnt offerings, the meal offerings, and the drink offerings, in the feasts, and on the new moons, and on the Sabbaths, in all the appointed feasts of the house of Israel. He shall prepare the sin offering, the meal offering, the burnt offering, and the peace offerings, to make atonement for the house of Israel.”

hausa: Sa’an nan Abimelek ya kira Ibrahim ciki ya ce, “Me ke nan ka yi mana? Ta wace hanya ce na yi maka laifi har da ka kawo irin wannan babban laifi a kaina da kuma masarautata? Ka yi mini abubuwan da bai kamata a yi ba.”
english: Then Abimelech called Abraham, and said to him, “What have you done to us? How have I sinned against you, that you have brought on me and on my kingdom a great sin? You have done deeds to me that ought not to be done!”

hausa: Da tsakar rana za ku riƙa lallubawa kamar makaho. Za ku zama marasa nasara a cikin kome da kuka yi; kowace rana za a zalunce ku, a kuma yi muku ƙwace, ba tare da wani ya cece ku ba.
english: You will grope at noonday, as the blind gropes in darkness, and you shall not prosper in your ways. You will only be oppressed and robbed always, and there will be no one to save you.

hausa: Har wa yau Yesu ya sāke ce musu, “Zan tafi, za ku kuwa neme ni, za ku kuma mutu cikin zunubinku. Inda za ni, ba za ku iya zuwa ba.”
english: Jesus said therefore again to them, “I am going away, and you will seek me, and you will die in your sins. Where I go, you can’t come.”

hausa: Saboda haka, ni Bulus, na zama ɗan kurkuku na Kiristi Yesu saboda ku Al’ummai.
english: For this cause I, Paul, am the prisoner of Christ Jesus on behalf of you Gentiles,

hausa: wanda ya yi duwatsu ta wurin ikonka, bayan ka kintsa kanka da ƙarfi,
english: By your power, you form the mountains, having armed yourself with strength.

hausa: Saboda haka ya tambayi Yehoshafat, ya ce, “Za ka tafi tare da ni don in yi yaƙi da Ramot Gileyad?” Yehoshafat ya amsa wa sarkin Isra’ila, ya ce, “Ni ma kamar ka ne, mutanena kuwa kamar mutanenka, dawakaina kamar dawakanka.”
english: He said to Jehoshaphat, “Will you go with me to battle to Ramoth Gilead?” Jehoshaphat said to the king of Israel, “I am as you are, my people as your people, my horses as your horses.”

hausa: Biye da shi, shi ne Eleyazar ɗan Dodo mutumin Aho, ɗaya daga cikin jarumawa uku.
english: After him was Eleazar the son of Dodo, the Ahohite, who was one of the three mighty men.

hausa: Sai Bitrus ya amsa masa, “Ga shi mun bar kome don mu bi ka! Me za mu samu ke nan?”
english: Then Peter answered, “Behold, we have left everything and followed you. What then will we have?”

hausa: Saboda haka, dole a yi biyayya ga hukumomi, ba don gudun horo kawai ba amma don lamirinku.
english: Therefore you need to be in subjection, not only because of the wrath, but also for conscience’ sake.

hausa: Za ku iya cin dabbobin da suke da rababben kofato, waɗanda suke kuma tuƙa.
english: Whatever parts the hoof, and is cloven-footed, and chews the cud among the animals, that you may eat.

hausa: Jarumawan nan su ne, Asahel ɗan’uwan Yowab, Elhanan ɗan Dodo daga Betlehem,
english: The mighty men of the armies also include Asahel the brother of Joab, Elhanan the son of Dodo of Bethlehem,

hausa: Duk ’yan wasan gasa sukan hori kansu sosai. Sukan yi haka domin su sami rawanin da ba zai daɗe ba. Amma mu muna yi ne domin mu sami rawanin da zai dawwama.
english: Every man who strives in the games exercises self-control in all things. Now they do it to receive a corruptible crown, but we an incorruptible.

hausa: Sa’an nan idanun makafi za su buɗe kunnuwan kurame kuma su ji.
english: Then the eyes of the blind will be opened, and the ears of the deaf will be unstopped.

hausa: Mutane marasa hankali marasa suna, an kore su daga ƙasar.
english: They are children of fools, yes, children of wicked men. They were flogged out of the land.

hausa: Haka ma Yesu ya sha wahala a bayan gari don yă tsarkake mutane ta wurin jininsa.
english: Therefore Jesus also, that he might sanctify the people through his own blood, suffered outside of the gate.

hausa: Bari waɗanda suke tsoron Ubangiji su ce, “Ƙaunarsa madawwamiya ce har abada.”
english: Now let those who fear Yahweh say that his loving kindness endures forever.

hausa: Ko akwai wani da aka yi masa alkawarin mata, bai kuwa aure ta ko ba? Bari yă tafi gida, kada yă mutu a yaƙi, wani dabam yă aure ta.”
english: What man is there who has pledged to be married to a wife, and has not taken her? Let him go and return to his house, lest he die in the battle, and another man take her.”

hausa: Hanyar mai laifi karkatacciya ce, amma halin marar laifi sukan aikata gaskiya.
english: The way of the guilty is devious, but the conduct of the innocent is upright.

hausa: “Ba shakka ku ne mutanen nan, hikima za tă mutu tare da ku!
english: “No doubt, but you are the people, and wisdom will die with you.

hausa: Za ka ce “Sun buge ni, amma ban ji ciwo ba! Sun daddoke ni, amma ba na jin zafinsa! Yaushe zan farka don in ƙara shan wani?”
english: “They hit me, and I was not hurt! They beat me, and I don’t feel it! When will I wake up? I can do it again. I will look for more.”

hausa: Amma za a washe Isuwa ƙaƙaf, a kuma yaye ɓoyayyiyar dukiyarsa!
english: How Esau will be ransacked! How his hidden treasures are sought out!

hausa: Masu zargina ba su same ni ina gardama da kowa a haikali, ko kuma ina tā da hankalin jama’a a majami’u ko kuwa wani wuri dabam a cikin birni ba.
english: In the temple they didn’t find me disputing with anyone or stirring up a crowd, either in the synagogues or in the city.

hausa: Akwai wani daga cikin gumaka marasa amfani na al’ummai da ya kawo ruwan sama? Sararin sama kansu sukan yi yayyafi? A’a, kai ne, ya Ubangiji Allahnmu. Saboda haka sa zuciyarmu tana a kanka, gama kai ne kake yi wannan duka.
english: Are there any among the vanities of the nations that can cause rain? Or can the sky give showers? Aren’t you he, Yahweh our God? Therefore we will wait for you; for you have made all these things.

hausa: Amma in mahaifina ya sa zuciya yă cuce ka, Ubangiji yă hukunta ni da hukunci mai tsanani in ban gaya maka ba, in kuma sa ka ka tafi lafiya. Ubangiji yă kasance tare da kai kamar yadda ya kasance da mahaifina.
english: Yahweh do so to Jonathan and more also, should it please my father to do you evil, if I don’t disclose it to you and send you away, that you may go in peace. May Yahweh be with you as he has been with my father.

hausa: yana cewa, ‘Wannan mutum ya fara gini, amma bai iya gamawa ba.’
english: saying, ‘This man began to build and wasn’t able to finish.’

hausa: Sa’an nan ka sa kwaf nawa, wannan na azurfa a bakin buhun autan, tare da kuɗinsa na hatsi.” Sai mai hidimar ya yi kamar yadda Yusuf ya umarta.
english: Put my cup, the silver cup, in the sack’s mouth of the youngest, with his grain money.” He did according to the word that Joseph had spoken.

hausa: “Wane ƙarfi nake da shi, har da zan ci gaba da sa zuciya? Wane sa zuciya ne zai sa in yi haƙuri?
english: What is my strength, that I should wait? What is my end, that I should be patient?

hausa: Da yake Amalekawa da Kan’aniyawa suna zama a kwarin, gobe sai ka koma baya, ka nufi wajen hamada ta hanyar Jan Teku.”
english: Since the Amalekite and the Canaanite dwell in the valley, tomorrow turn and go into the wilderness by the way to the Red Sea.”

hausa: Sa’an nan firistoci suka janye daga Wuri Mai Tsarki. Dukan firistocin da suke can sun tsarkake kansu, ko daga wace ɓangarori suka fito.
english: When the priests had come out of the holy place (for all the priests who were present had sanctified themselves, and didn’t keep their divisions;

hausa: Ka ɗaga ni sama ka ɗora ni a kan iska; ka jujjuya ni cikin hadari.
english: You lift me up to the wind, and drive me with it. You dissolve me in the storm.

hausa: Amma fa in zarge gaskiya ne, ba a kuwa sami shaidar budurcin yarinyar ba,
english: But if this thing is true, that the tokens of virginity were not found in the young lady,

hausa: Ya kamata mace ta riƙa koyo cikin natsuwa da cikakkiyar biyayya.
english: Let a woman learn in quietness with full submission.

hausa: Ta wurin Kalman ne aka halicci dukan abubuwa. In ba tare da shi ba, babu abin da aka yi wanda aka yi.
english: All things were made through him. Without him, nothing was made that has been made.

hausa: Sai Ubangiji ya ce wa Shaiɗan, “Ko ka ga bawana Ayuba? A cikin duniya babu wani kamar sa; shi marar laifi ne, adali kuma, mutum ne mai tsoron Allah ba ruwansa da mugunta. Kuma har yanzu bai fasa zama mai aminci ba duk da wahalar da ka sa na bari ka ba shi ba tare da wani dalili ba.”
english: Yahweh said to Satan, “Have you considered my servant Job? For there is no one like him on the earth, a blameless and an upright man, one who fears God, and turns away from evil. He still maintains his integrity, although you incited me against him, to ruin him without cause.”

hausa: ko kuwa dukiyar da ta ɓace ta wata hasara, har ya zama sa’ad da ya haifi ɗa, babu abin da ya bar masa.
english: Those riches perish by misfortune, and if he has fathered a son, there is nothing in his hand.

hausa: “Saboda haka zan mai da Samariya tarin juji, wurin noman inabi. Zan zubar da duwatsunta a cikin kwari in kuma bar harsashin gininta a bayyane.
english: Therefore I will make Samaria like a rubble heap of the field, like places for planting vineyards; and I will pour down its stones into the valley, and I will uncover its foundations.

hausa: Na kuma so in gane game da ƙahonin nan guda goma da suke a kanta da kuma game da ƙahon nan da ya fito, wanda aka tumɓuke ƙahoni uku a gabansa, ƙahon nan da yake da idanu da bakin da yake furta manyan maganganun fariya, wanda ya yi kamar ya fi sauran girma.
english: and concerning the ten horns that were on its head and the other horn which came up, and before which three fell, even that horn that had eyes and a mouth that spoke arrogantly, whose look was more stout than its fellows.

hausa: Za ka yi zama a yankin Goshen, ka kasance kusa da ni. Kai, ’ya’yanka da kuma jikokinka, garkunanka da shanunka, da kuma dukan abin da kake da shi.
english: You shall dwell in the land of Goshen, and you will be near to me, you, your children, your children’s children, your flocks, your herds, and all that you have.

hausa: Saboda haka abokaina ƙaunatattu, ku guje wa bautar gumaka.
english: Therefore, my beloved, flee from idolatry.

hausa: Mun jimre da wulaƙanci daga masu girman kai, reni mai yawa daga masu fariya.
english: Our soul is exceedingly filled with the scoffing of those who are at ease, with the contempt of the proud.

hausa: Ya yi ƙofofi biyu na itacen fir, kowanne yana da shafi biyu da suke juyewa a maɗaurai.
english: and two doors of cypress wood. The two leaves of the one door were folding, and the two leaves of the other door were folding.

hausa: Da gari ya waye, sai aka sallami mutanen tare da jakunansu.
english: As soon as the morning was light, the men were sent away, they and their donkeys.

hausa: Ayuba ya ci gaba da jawabinsa,
english: Job again took up his parable, and said,

hausa: Aka yi jana’izarsa tare da mugaye, aka binne shi tare da masu arziki, ko da yake bai taɓa yin wani tashin hankali ba, ko a sami ƙarya a bakinsa.
english: They made his grave with the wicked, and with a rich man in his death, although he had done no violence, nor was any deceit in his mouth.

hausa: Musa ya amsa, “To, da kyau, da zarar na fita daga birnin, zan yi addu’a ga Ubangiji, tsawar za tă tsaya, ƙanƙarar kuma za tă daina, don ku sani cewa duniya ta Ubangiji ce.
english: Moses said to him, “As soon as I have gone out of the city, I will spread out my hands to Yahweh. The thunders shall cease, and there will not be any more hail; that you may know that the earth is Yahweh’s.

hausa: Ina ƙaunataccenki ya tafi, yake mafiya kyau cikin mata? Wace hanya ce ƙaunataccenki ya bi, don mu taimake ki nemansa.
english: Where has your beloved gone, you fairest among women? Where has your beloved turned, that we may seek him with you?

hausa: Ban da haka ma, sa’ad da Allah ya ba wa mutum dukiya da wadata, ya kuma ba shi zarafi yă ji daɗinsu, ya kuma amince da rabonsa, sai yă ji daɗin aikinsa, wannan kyauta ce ta Allah.
english: Every man also to whom God has given riches and wealth, and has given him power to eat of it, and to take his portion, and to rejoice in his labor—this is the gift of God.

hausa: Amaziya ya tambayi mutumin Allah ya ce, “Amma game da talenti ɗarin da na biya saboda waɗannan rundunonin Isra’ila fa?” Mutumin Allah ya amsa, “Ubangiji zai ba ka fiye da wannan.”
english: Amaziah said to the man of God, “But what shall we do for the hundred talents which I have given to the army of Israel?” The man of God answered, “Yahweh is able to give you much more than this.”

hausa: Ubangiji ya ce mata, “Al’ummai biyu suna a cikin mahaifarki mutum biyu da za ki haifa, za su rabu da juna, ɗayan zai fi ɗayan ƙarfi, babban kuma zai bauta wa ƙaramin.”
english: Yahweh said to her, “Two nations are in your womb. Two peoples will be separated from your body. The one people will be stronger than the other people. The elder will serve the younger.”

hausa: Sai na ce, “Kayya, Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka, ban iya magana ba; ni ɗan yaro ne kawai.”
english: Then I said, “Ah, Lord Yahweh! Behold, I don’t know how to speak; for I am a child.”

hausa: Shekaru ashirin da uku, daga shekara ta goma sha uku ta Yosiya ɗan Amon sarkin Yahuda har zuwa wannan rana, maganar Ubangiji ta zo mini na kuma yi muku magana sau da sau, amma ba ku saurara ba.
english: From the thirteenth year of Josiah the son of Amon, king of Judah, even to this day, these twenty-three years, Yahweh’s word has come to me, and I have spoken to you, rising up early and speaking; but you have not listened.

hausa: Sa’an nan ka gina bagade irin da ya dace wa Ubangiji Allahnka a kan wannan tudu. Ka yi amfani da itacen katakon ginshiƙin Ashera da ka sare, ka miƙa bijiman nan biyu hadaya ta ƙonawa.”
english: Then build an altar to Yahweh your God on the top of this stronghold, in an orderly way, and take the second bull, and offer a burnt offering with the wood of the Asherah which you shall cut down.”

hausa: A lokacin Ubangiji ya keɓe kabilar Lawi don su riƙa ɗaukar akwatin alkawarin Ubangiji, su tsaya a gaban Ubangiji, su riƙa yin masa hidima, su kuma sa albarka a cikin sunansa, yadda suke yi har wa yau.
english: At that time Yahweh set apart the tribe of Levi to bear the ark of Yahweh’s covenant, to stand before Yahweh to minister to him, and to bless in his name, to this day.

hausa: Yohanna ya amsa ya ce, “Ni dai ina baftisma da ruwa ne, amma a cikinku akwai wani tsaye da ba ku sani ba.
english: John answered them, “I baptize in water, but among you stands one whom you don’t know.

hausa: sai ya tambaye su ya ce, “Hoton wane ne wannan? Kuma rubutun wane ne?”
english: He asked them, “Whose is this image and inscription?”

hausa: Yi amfani da kuɗin ku saya duk abin da kuke so, ko shanu, ko tumaki, ko ruwan inabi, ko dai wani abin shan da ya yi tsami, ko kuwa duk abin da kuke so. Sai ku da gidanku, ku ci a can, a gaban Ubangiji Allahnku, ku kuma yi farin ciki.
english: You shall trade the money for whatever your soul desires: for cattle, or for sheep, or for wine, or for strong drink, or for whatever your soul asks of you. You shall eat there before Yahweh your God, and you shall rejoice, you and your household.

hausa: Saboda haka ya ɗauke shi ya kai wajen shugaban ƙungiyar sojan. Jarumin ya ce, “Bulus, ɗan kurkukun nan ya kira ni, ya roƙe ni in kawo wannan saurayi a wurinka domin yana da wani abin da zai faɗa maka.”
english: So he took him and brought him to the commanding officer and said, “Paul, the prisoner, summoned me and asked me to bring this young man to you. He has something to tell you.”

hausa: “Na ɗaga ka daga ƙura na mai da kai shugaban mutanena Isra’ila, amma ka yi tafiya a hanyoyin Yerobowam, ka kuma sa mutanena Isra’ila suka yi zunubi, ka tsokane ni na yi fushi ta wurin zunubansu.
english: “Because I exalted you out of the dust and made you prince over my people Israel, and you have walked in the way of Jeroboam and have made my people Israel to sin, to provoke me to anger with their sins,

hausa: Mayaƙa na jiki ne kawai suke tare da shi, amma Ubangiji Allahnmu ne yake tare da mu, zai kuwa taimake mu yă kuma yi yaƙinmu.” Mutane kuwa suka amince da maganar Hezekiya, Sarkin Yahuda.
english: An arm of flesh is with him, but Yahweh our God is with us to help us and to fight our battles.” The people rested themselves on the words of Hezekiah king of Judah.

hausa: Abram kuwa ya kwana da Hagar, ta kuma yi ciki. Sa’ad da Hagar ta gane tana da ciki, sai ta fara rena uwargijiyarta.
english: He went in to Hagar, and she conceived. When she saw that she had conceived, her mistress was despised in her eyes.

hausa: wanda ya kwantar da rurin tekuna, rurin raƙumansu, da kuma tumbatsar al’ummai.
english: You still the roaring of the seas, the roaring of their waves, and the turmoil of the nations.

hausa: domin ki sha ƙasƙancinki ki kuma sha kunyar dukan abin da kika aikata ta wurin ta’azantar da su.
english: that you may bear your own shame, and may be ashamed because of all that you have done, in that you are a comfort to them.

hausa: Sa’ad da Kan’aniyawa waɗanda suke zama a can suka ga makokin a masussukan Atad, sai suka ce, “Masarawa suna bikin makoki na musamman.” Shi ya sa ake kira wannan wurin da yake kusa da Urdun, Abel-Mizrayim.
english: When the inhabitants of the land, the Canaanites, saw the mourning in the floor of Atad, they said, “This is a grievous mourning by the Egyptians.” Therefore its name was called Abel Mizraim, which is beyond the Jordan.

hausa: Ya aikata abin da yake daidai a gaban Ubangiji yadda mahaifinsa Uzziya ya yi.
english: He did that which was right in Yahweh’s eyes. He did according to all that his father Uzziah had done.

hausa: Sai Ruhun Ubangiji ya sauko a kaina, ya kuma faɗa mini in ce, “Ga abin da Ubangiji yana cewa, haka kuke cewa, ya gidan Isra’ila, amma na san abin da yake a zuciyarku.
english: Yahweh’s Spirit fell on me, and he said to me, “Speak, ‘Yahweh says: “Thus you have said, house of Israel; for I know the things that come into your mind.

hausa: Duk kuwa suka ci, suka ƙoshi. Daga baya almajiran suka kwashe ragowar gutsattsarin cike da kwanduna bakwai.
english: They all ate and were filled. They took up seven baskets full of the broken pieces that were left over.

hausa: Ubangiji ya ce wa Musa,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

hausa: Ka sa ragar a ƙarƙashin bagade domin tă kai tsakiyar bagade.
english: You shall put it under the ledge around the altar beneath, that the net may reach halfway up the altar.

hausa: Bari yă sumbace ni da sumbar bakinsa, gama ƙaunarka ta fi ruwan inabi zaƙi.
english: Let him kiss me with the kisses of his mouth; for your love is better than wine.

hausa: ’Ya’yan ɗan’uwansa Eshek su ne, Ulam ɗan farinsa, Yewush ɗansa na biyu da Elifelet na uku.
english: The sons of Eshek his brother: Ulam his firstborn, Jeush the second, and Eliphelet the third.

hausa: Natan ya amsa wa sarki ya ce, “Duk abin da yake a zuciyarka, sai ka yi, gama Ubangiji yana tare da kai.”
english: Nathan said to the king, “Go, do all that is in your heart, for Yahweh is with you.”

hausa: An shuka ta a ƙasa mai kyau kusa da ruwa mai yawa don tă yi rassa masu yawa, ta ba da ’ya’ya ta kuma zama kuringa mai daraja.’
english: It was planted in a good soil by many waters, that it might produce branches and that it might bear fruit, that it might be a good vine.”’

hausa: “Ka lura da yadda Ahab ya ƙasƙantar da kansa a gabana kuwa? Domin ya ƙasƙantar da kansa, ba zan kawo wannan masifa a kwanakinsa ba, amma zan kawo ta a kan gidansa a kwanakin ɗansa.”
english: “See how Ahab humbles himself before me? Because he humbles himself before me, I will not bring the evil in his days; but I will bring the evil on his house in his son’s day.”

hausa: Mai tsaro ya tā da murya ya faɗa wa sarki. Sarki ya ce, “In shi kaɗai ne, ya kawo labari mai kyau ke nan.” Mutumin ya matso kusa-kusa.
english: The watchman shouted and told the king. The king said, “If he is alone, there is news in his mouth.” He came closer and closer.

hausa: Sa’ad da na yi kuka na kuma yi azumi dole in jimre da ba’a;
english: When I wept and I fasted, that was to my reproach.

hausa: Allah ya shirya masu kaɗaici a cikin iyalai, ya jagorance ’yan kurkuku da waƙoƙi; amma ’yan tawaye suna zama a ƙasa mai zafin rana.
english: God sets the lonely in families. He brings out the prisoners with singing, but the rebellious dwell in a sun-scorched land.

hausa: Gama hanyar mutum a bayyane take a gaban Ubangiji, yana kuma lura da dukan hanyoyinsa.
english: For the ways of man are before Yahweh’s eyes. He examines all his paths.

hausa: Amma hanyar mugaye kamar zurfin duhu ne; ba sa sanin abin da ya sa suke tuntuɓe.
english: The way of the wicked is like darkness. They don’t know what they stumble over.

hausa: Ku tattara dukan dattawan kabilanku, da kuma dukan hafsoshinku a gabana, saboda in faɗa waɗannan kalmomi a kunnuwansu, in kuma kira ga sama da ƙasa su zama shaida a kansu.
english: Assemble to me all the elders of your tribes and your officers, that I may speak these words in their ears, and call heaven and earth to witness against them.

hausa: a ranar da zai dawo don a ɗaukaka shi a cikin mutanensa masu tsarki, yă kuma zama abin banmamaki ga dukan waɗanda suka gaskata. Wannan ya haɗa har da ku, domin kun gaskata shaidar da muka yi muku.
english: when he comes in that day to be glorified in his saints and to be admired among all those who have believed, because our testimony to you was believed.

hausa: Saboda haka ɗaya daga cikin firistocin da aka kawo bauta daga Samariya ya dawo ya zauna a Betel, ya koya musu yadda za su yi sujada ga Ubangiji.
english: So one of the priests whom they had carried away from Samaria came and lived in Bethel, and taught them how they should fear Yahweh.

hausa: Sa’an nan Ubangiji ya ce wa Musa, “Don me kake mini kuka? Ka faɗa wa Isra’ilawa su ci gaba da tafiya.
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “Why do you cry to me? Speak to the children of Israel, that they go forward.

hausa: Da mutanen Absalom suka zo wurin matan a gidan, suka ce, “Ina Yonatan da Ahimawaz?” Matar ta ce, “Tuni, sun haye rafi.” Sai mutanen suka yi ta nemansu amma ba su ga kowa, sai suka koma Urushalima.
english: Absalom’s servants came to the woman to the house; and they said, “Where are Ahimaaz and Jonathan?” The woman said to them, “They have gone over the brook of water.” When they had sought and could not find them, they returned to Jerusalem.

hausa: Kamar yadda ruwa yake bushewa a teku ko a gaɓar rafi sai wurin yă bushe,
english: As the waters fail from the sea, and the river wastes and dries up,

hausa: Amma ga shi yanzu Timoti ya dawo mana daga wurinku ya kuma kawo labari mai daɗi game da bangaskiyarku da kuma ƙaunarku. Ya faɗa mana yadda kullum kuke da tunani mai kyau a kanmu, yadda kuke marmari ku gan mu, kamar dai yadda mu ma muke marmari mu gan ku.
english: But Timothy has just now come to us from you, and brought us glad news of your faith and love, and that you have good memories of us always, longing to see us, even as we also long to see you.

hausa: Saboda haka Yowash sarkin Isra’ila ya kai yaƙi. Shi da Amaziya sarkin Yahuda suka fuskanci juna a Bet-Shemesh a Yahuda.
english: So Joash king of Israel went up, and he and Amaziah king of Judah looked one another in the face at Beth Shemesh, which belongs to Judah.

hausa: Filistiyawa suka tattara dukan rundunoninsu a Afek. Isra’ila kuwa suka yi sansani kusa da maɓulɓular da take Yezireyel.
english: Now the Philistines gathered together all their armies to Aphek; and the Israelites encamped by the spring which is in Jezreel.

hausa: “Ka hau Duwatsun Abarim zuwa Dutsen Nebo a Mowab, tsallake daga Yeriko, ka hangi Kan’ana, ƙasar da nake ba wa Isra’ilawa gādo.
english: “Go up into this mountain of Abarim, to Mount Nebo, which is in the land of Moab, that is across from Jericho; and see the land of Canaan, which I give to the children of Israel for a possession.

hausa: Wani shiggayiyon ta Dawuda, wanda Ya Rera wa Ubangiji game da Kush mutumin Benyamin. Ya Ubangiji Allahna, na zo neman mafaka a wurinka; ka cece ni ka kuɓutar da ni daga dukan waɗanda suke bi na,
english: A meditation by David, which he sang to Yahweh, concerning the words of Cush, the Benjamite. Yahweh, my God, I take refuge in you. Save me from all those who pursue me, and deliver me,

hausa: Musa ya amsa, “Da zarar na bar ka, zan yi addu’a ga Ubangiji, gobe kuwa ƙudaje za su bar Fir’auna da fadawansa da kuma mutanensa. Sai dai a tabbata Fir’auna bai sāke yin ruɗi ta wurin ƙin barin mutane su tafi su miƙa hadayu ga Ubangiji ba.”
english: Moses said, “Behold, I am going out from you. I will pray to Yahweh that the swarms of flies may depart from Pharaoh, from his servants, and from his people, tomorrow; only don’t let Pharaoh deal deceitfully any more in not letting the people go to sacrifice to Yahweh.”

hausa: Ku sa gishiri a kan Mowab, gama za tă zama kango; garuruwanta za su zama kufai, ba mazauna a cikinsu.
english: Give wings to Moab, that she may fly and get herself away: and her cities will become a desolation, without anyone to dwell in them.

hausa: Amma filaye da ƙauyukan da suke kewayen birnin aka ba wa Kaleb ɗan Yefunne.
english: but the fields of the city and its villages, they gave to Caleb the son of Jephunneh.

hausa: ko da yake da safe takan yi sabuwar huda da yamma sai ta bushe ta kuma yanƙwane.
english: In the morning it sprouts and springs up. By evening, it is withered and dry.

hausa: Dawuda ya ce wa Mikal, “Na yi rawana domin in girmama Ubangiji ne, wanda ya zaɓe ni a maimakon mahaifinki ko wani daga cikin dukan gidansa, shi ne kuma ya sa ni sarki a kan Isra’ila, mutanen Ubangiji, zan yi biki a gaban Ubangiji.
english: David said to Michal, “It was before Yahweh, who chose me above your father, and above all his house, to appoint me prince over the people of Yahweh, over Israel. Therefore I will celebrate before Yahweh.

hausa: Kyarkeci zai zauna tare da ɗan rago damisa za tă kwanta tare da akuya, ɗan maraƙi da zaki da ɗan saniya za su yi kiwo tare; ɗan yaro ne zai lura da su.
english: The wolf will live with the lamb, and the leopard will lie down with the young goat, the calf, the young lion, and the fattened calf together; and a little child will lead them.

hausa: In adali ya juye daga adalcinsa ya yi mugunta, zai mutu saboda haka.
english: When the righteous turns from his righteousness and commits iniquity, he will even die therein.

hausa: Suka yi hidima da waƙa a gaban tabanakul, Tentin Sujada, sai da Solomon ya gina haikalin Ubangiji a Urushalima. Suka yi ayyukansu bisa ga ƙa’idodin da aka shimfiɗa musu.
english: They ministered with song before the tabernacle of the Tent of Meeting until Solomon had built Yahweh’s house in Jerusalem. They performed the duties of their office according to their order.

hausa: da ƙodoji biyu tare da kitsen da yake kansu kusa da kwiɓi, da kuma murfin hanta waɗanda zai cire tare da ƙodoji.
english: and the two kidneys, and the fat that is on them, which is by the loins, and the cover on the liver, with the kidneys, he shall take away.

hausa: Ga yadda muka san cewa muna ƙaunar ’ya’yan Allah. Muna yin haka ta wurin ƙaunar Allah da kuma aikata umarnansa.
english: By this we know that we love the children of God, when we love God and keep his commandments.

hausa: Kana ƙaunar kowace kalmar cutarwa, Ya kai harshe mai ruɗu!
english: You love all devouring words, you deceitful tongue.

hausa: kuma a kuringar, akwai rassa uku. Nan da nan kuringar ta yi toho, ta huda, ta kuma yi nonna har suka nuna, suka zama inabi.
english: and in the vine were three branches. It was as though it budded, it blossomed, and its clusters produced ripe grapes.

hausa: Amma zan bar kaɗan daga cikinsu su tsere wa takobi, yunwa da annoba, saboda a cikin al’umman da suka tafi su furta dukan ayyukansu masu banƙyama. Sa’an nan za su san cewa ni ne Ubangiji.”
english: But I will leave a few men of them from the sword, from the famine, and from the pestilence, that they may declare all their abominations among the nations where they come. Then they will know that I am Yahweh.’”

hausa: zuwa kudancin Hanyar Kunama, ta ci gaba har zuwa Zin, zuwa kudancin Kadesh Barneya. Sa’an nan ta kurɗa zuwa Hezron har zuwa Addar, ta kuma karkata zuwa Karka.
english: and it went out southward of the ascent of Akrabbim, and passed along to Zin, and went up by the south of Kadesh Barnea, and passed along by Hezron, went up to Addar, and turned toward Karka;

hausa: Sai ya ƙone haikalin Ubangiji, da gidan sarki, da dukan gine-gine masu alfarman da suke Urushalima.
english: He burned Yahweh’s house, and the king’s house; and all the houses of Jerusalem, even every great house, he burned with fire.

hausa: Da safe Yonatan ya tafi domin yă sadu da Dawuda a fili. Ya tafi tare da wani ƙaramin yaro.
english: In the morning, Jonathan went out into the field at the time appointed with David, and a little boy with him.

hausa: mijin zai kai matansa a gaban firist, yă kuma kawo hadayar abubuwan da ake bukata; abubuwa kamar, garin sha’ir garwa ɗaya, amma kada yă zuba mai a kan garin sha’ir, kada kuma yă sa turaren wuta a kansa, domin hadaya ce ta miji mai tuhumar matarsa da aka kawo domin gaskiya tă fito fili.
english: then the man shall bring his wife to the priest, and shall bring her offering for her: one tenth of an ephah of barley meal. He shall pour no oil on it, nor put frankincense on it, for it is a meal offering of jealousy, a meal offering of memorial, bringing iniquity to memory.

hausa: Kuma zan yi duk abin da kuka roƙa cikin sunana, don Ɗan ya kawo ɗaukaka ga Uban.
english: Whatever you will ask in my name, I will do it, that the Father may be glorified in the Son.

hausa: Sa’ad da kuka tafi yaƙi da abokan gābanku, sai Ubangiji Allahnku ya bashe su a hannuwanku kuka kuma kama su a matsayin bayi,
