english: When you go out to battle against your enemies, and Yahweh your God delivers them into your hands and you carry them away captive,

hausa: Kamar sanda ko takobi ko kibiya mai tsini haka yake da mutumin da yake ba da shaidar ƙarya a kan maƙwabcinsa.
english: A man who gives false testimony against his neighbor is like a club, a sword, or a sharp arrow.

hausa: ku nemi abin da zai gamshi Ubangiji.
english: proving what is well pleasing to the Lord.

hausa: Azariya shi ne mahaifin Helez, Helez shi ne mahaifin Eleyasa,
english: and Azariah became the father of Helez, and Helez became the father of Eleasah,

hausa: Filistiyawa suka bar gumakansu a can, Dawuda da mutanensa kuwa suka kwashe su.
english: They left their images there, and David and his men took them away.

hausa: “Kai ne kulkin yaƙina, kayan yaƙina, da kai ne na ragargaza ƙasashe, da kai ne na hallaka mulkoki,
english: “You are my battle ax and weapons of war. With you I will break the nations into pieces. With you I will destroy kingdoms.

hausa: Daga rabin kashi na Isra’ilawa, Musa ya ɗauki ɗaya daga cikin hamsin na mutane da na dabbobi, yadda Ubangiji ya umarce shi, ya ba wa Lawiyawan da suke lura da tabanakul na Ubangiji.
english: even of the children of Israel’s half, Moses took one drawn out of every fifty, both of man and of animal, and gave them to the Levites, who performed the duty of Yahweh’s tabernacle, as Yahweh commanded Moses.

hausa: ’Ya’yan Yahuda maza su ne, Er, Onan da Shela. Waɗannan mutum uku Bat-shuwa mutuniyar Kan’ana ce ta haifa masa. Er, ɗan farin Yahuda mugu ne a gaban Ubangiji, saboda haka Ubangiji ya kashe shi.
english: The sons of Judah: Er, Onan, and Shelah, which three were born to him of Shua’s daughter the Canaanitess. Er, Judah’s firstborn, was wicked in Yahweh’s sight; and he killed him.

hausa: Ga abin da Ubangiji yana cewa, “La’ananne ne mutumin da yake dogara ga mutum, wanda ya dogara ga jiki don ƙarfi wanda kuma zuciyarsa ta juya wa Ubangiji baya.
english: Yahweh says: “Cursed is the man who trusts in man, relies on strength of flesh, and whose heart departs from Yahweh.

hausa: “Da me zan kwatanta wannan zamani? Suna kama da yara da suke zaune a kasuwa, suna kiran juna, suna cewa,
english: “But to what shall I compare this generation? It is like children sitting in the marketplaces, who call to their companions

hausa: Kusan a wannan lokaci ne Sarki Hiridus ya kama waɗansu da suke na ikkilisiya, da niyya ya tsananta musu.
english: Now about that time, King Herod stretched out his hands to oppress some of the assembly.

hausa: Duk da haka, ina da wannan game da kai. Kana haƙuri da matan nan Yezebel, wadda take kira kanta annabiya. Ta wurin koyarwarta tana ɓad da bayina ga yin fasikanci suka kuma ci abincin da aka miƙa wa gumaka.
english: But I have this against you, that you tolerate your woman Jezebel, who calls herself a prophetess. She teaches and seduces my servants to commit sexual immorality and to eat things sacrificed to idols.

hausa: Ya kuma ɗauki ƙirjin; rabon Musa na ɗan ragon naɗi, ya kaɗa shi a gaban Ubangiji, a matsayin hadaya ta kaɗawa, yadda Ubangiji ya umarce shi.
english: Moses took the breast, and waved it for a wave offering before Yahweh. It was Moses’ portion of the ram of consecration, as Yahweh commanded Moses.

hausa: Iliya ya ce, “Ki miƙa mini ɗanki.” Sai ya ɗauke shi daga hannuwanta, ya kai shi ɗakin sama inda yake zama, ya kwantar da shi a gadonsa.
english: He said to her, “Give me your son.” He took him out of her bosom, and carried him up into the room where he stayed, and laid him on his own bed.

hausa: Amma in bai sami halin sāke biyansa ba, abin nan da ya sayar zai ci gaba da zama mallakar mai sayan, sai Shekara ta Murna. Za a maido masa da ita a Shekara ta Murna, sa’an nan zai iya koma ga mallakarsa.
english: But if he isn’t able to get it back for himself, then what he has sold shall remain in the hand of him who has bought it until the Year of Jubilee. In the Jubilee it shall be released, and he shall return to his property.

hausa: haka mutum zai kwanta ba zai tashi ba; har sai duniya ta shuɗe mutane ba za su farka ba, ba za su tashi daga barcinsu ba.
english: so man lies down and doesn’t rise. Until the heavens are no more, they will not awake, nor be roused out of their sleep.

hausa: Mutanen birnin suka rarrabu, waɗansu suka goyi bayan Yahudawa, waɗansu kuma suka goyi bayan manzannin.
english: But the multitude of the city was divided. Part sided with the Jews and part with the apostles.

hausa: Dawuda ya riƙe waɗannan kalmomi a zuciyarsa, ya kuma ji tsoron Akish sarkin Gat sosai.
english: David laid up these words in his heart, and was very afraid of Achish the king of Gath.

hausa: Ba ya amsawa lokacin da mutane suka yi kira don taimako domin girman kan mugaye.
english: There they cry, but no one answers, because of the pride of evil men.

hausa: Suka miƙa masa hadaya ta ƙonawa gunduwa-gunduwa, haɗe da kan, ya kuwa ƙone su a bisa bagaden.
english: They delivered the burnt offering to him, piece by piece, and the head. He burned them upon the altar.

hausa: “Gaya mana abin da ya kamata mu ce masa; ba za mu iya kawo ƙara ba domin duhunmu.
english: Teach us what we will tell him, for we can’t make our case by reason of darkness.

hausa: Bari masu neman raina su sha kunya su kuma rikice; bari dukan waɗanda suke neman lalacewata su koma baya da kunya.
english: Let them be disappointed and confounded together who seek after my soul to destroy it. Let them be turned backward and brought to dishonor who delight in my hurt.

hausa: Ta mayar da kuringar inabina kango ta kuma lalatar da itatuwan ɓaurena. Ta ɓamɓare bayansu duka ta kuma jefar da su ta bar rassansu fari fat.
english: He has laid my vine waste, and stripped my fig tree. He has stripped its bark, and thrown it away. Its branches are made white.

hausa: “Gishiri fa yana da kyau, amma in gishiri ya rabu da daɗin ɗanɗanonsa, ta yaya za a sāke mai da daɗin ɗanɗanonsa?
english: “Salt is good, but if the salt becomes flat and tasteless, with what do you season it?

hausa: Zai tsaya yă yi kiwon garkensa da ƙarfin Ubangiji, cikin girman sunan Ubangiji Allahnsa. Za su kuma zauna lafiya, gama girmansa za tă kai har ƙarshen duniya.
english: He shall stand, and shall shepherd in the strength of Yahweh, in the majesty of the name of Yahweh his God. They will live, for then he will be great to the ends of the earth.

hausa: kada yă zama cewa zuciyarka ta ba ka laifi ko ka damu cewa kana da alhakin jini, kada ka yi ramuwa da kanka. Sa’ad da Ubangiji ya nuna maka alheri, ka tuna da ni, baiwarka.”
english: that this shall be no grief to you, nor offense of heart to my lord, either that you have shed blood without cause, or that my lord has avenged himself. When Yahweh has dealt well with my lord, then remember your servant.”

hausa: Sai Musa ya yi yadda Ubangiji ya umarce shi, jama’a kuwa suka taru a ƙofar Tentin Sujada.
english: Moses did as Yahweh commanded him; and the congregation was assembled at the door of the Tent of Meeting.

hausa: “ ‘A rana ta goma ga wannan watan bakwai, za a yi tsattsarkan taro. Ba za ku ci abinci ba, ba kuma za ku yi aiki ba.
english: “‘On the tenth day of this seventh month you shall have a holy convocation. You shall afflict your souls. You shall do no kind of work;

hausa: Ga abin da Ubangiji Maɗaukaki ya ce, “Mutane da yawa da kuma mazaunan birane da yawa har yanzu za su zo,
english: Yahweh of Armies says: “Many peoples and the inhabitants of many cities will yet come.

hausa: “Ku yi shiru zan yi magana; sa’an nan abin da zai same ni yă same ni.
english: “Be silent! Leave me alone, that I may speak. Let come on me what will.

hausa: Ka ce, ‘Kin fi sauran tagomashi ne? Ki gangara, ki kwanta cikin marasa kaciya.’
english: Whom do you pass in beauty? Go down, and be laid with the uncircumcised.

hausa: Sa’an nan za mu ba da ’ya’yanmu mata aure gare ku, mu kuma mu aure ’ya’yanku mata wa kanmu. Za mu zauna a cikinku mu kuma zama mutane ɗaya da ku.
english: then will we give our daughters to you; and we will take your daughters to us, and we will dwell with you, and we will become one people.

hausa: Ya yi kyau da na sha wahala don in koyi ƙa’idodinka.
english: It is good for me that I have been afflicted, that I may learn your statutes.

hausa: Sa’an nan ya ce, “Ɗana, kawo mini naman da ka farauto in ci, domin in sa maka albarka.” Yaƙub ya kawo masa ya kuwa ci; ya kuma kawo masa ruwan inabi ya kuma sha.
english: He said, “Bring it near to me, and I will eat of my son’s venison, that my soul may bless you.” He brought it near to him, and he ate. He brought him wine, and he drank.

hausa: Sa’ad da wannan shekara ta ƙare, sai suka zo wurinsa a shekara ta biye suka ce, “Ba za mu ɓoye maka ba ranka yă daɗe, kuɗinmu sun ƙare, dabbobinmu kuma sun zama naka. Ranka yă daɗe, in ban da jikunanmu da gonakinmu, ba abin da ya rage mana.
english: When that year was ended, they came to him the second year, and said to him, “We will not hide from my lord how our money is all spent, and the herds of livestock are my lord’s. There is nothing left in the sight of my lord, but our bodies, and our lands.

hausa: Bala’am ya ce wa Balak, “Ban faɗa wa ’yan aikan da ka aiko wurina ba cewa,
english: Balaam said to Balak, “Didn’t I also tell your messengers whom you sent to me, saying,

hausa: Kai makaho Bafarisiye! Ka fara wanke cikin kwaf da kwano, sa’an nan bayan ma zai zama da tsabta.
english: You blind Pharisee, first clean the inside of the cup and of the platter, that its outside may become clean also.

hausa: Da jin gaisuwarki, sai jaririn da yake cikina ya yi motsi don murna.
english: For behold, when the voice of your greeting came into my ears, the baby leaped in my womb for joy!

hausa: Tsinkaya za tă tsare ka, ganewa kuma za tă yi maka jagora.
english: Discretion will watch over you. Understanding will keep you,

hausa: Amma kowace halittar da take cikin tekuna da koguna da ba ta da ƙege da kamɓori, ko cikin dukan abubuwa masu rai a ruwa ko kuma sauran halittu a cikin ruwa za ku ɗauka su marasa tsaki ne gare ku.
english: All that don’t have fins and scales in the seas and rivers, all that move in the waters, and all the living creatures that are in the waters, they are an abomination to you,

hausa: Taron mutanen da suke gabansa da kuma waɗanda suke binsa a baya suka yi ihu suna cewa, “Hosanna ga Ɗan Dawuda!” “Mai albarka ne wanda yake zuwa cikin sunan Ubangiji!” “Hosanna a cikin sama!”
english: The multitudes who went in front of him, and those who followed, kept shouting, “Hosanna to the son of David! Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord! Hosanna in the highest!”

hausa: Saboda haka sai mu yi iya ƙoƙari mu aikata abin da zai kawo salama da kuma ingantawa ga juna.
english: So then, let’s follow after things which make for peace, and things by which we may build one another up.

hausa: Amma suka razana suka ce, “Idan sarakuna biyu ba su iya yin tsayayya da shi ba, wane mu?”
english: But they were exceedingly afraid, and said, “Behold, the two kings didn’t stand before him! How then shall we stand?”

hausa: don kada Shaiɗan yă rinjaye mu. Da yake muna sane da dabarunsa.
english: that no advantage may be gained over us by Satan, for we are not ignorant of his schemes.

hausa: “To, sai ku yi koyi da itacen ɓaure. Da zarar rassansa suka yi taushi, ganyayensa kuma suka toho, kun san cewa damina ta yi kusa ke nan.
english: “Now from the fig tree, learn this parable. When the branch has now become tender and produces its leaves, you know that the summer is near;

hausa: ta wurin barinsu su ci tsarkakakkun hadayu, ta yin haka su jawo wa kansu laifin da zai bukaci biya ba. Ni ne Ubangiji, wanda ya mai da ku masu tsarki.’ ”
english: and so cause them to bear the iniquity that brings guilt when they eat their holy things; for I am Yahweh who sanctifies them.’”

hausa: Sa’ad da Ubangiji ya gama magana da Ibrahim, ya tafi, Ibrahim kuma ya koma gida.
english: Yahweh went his way as soon as he had finished communing with Abraham, and Abraham returned to his place.

hausa: Zan watsar da Masarawa a cikin al’ummai in warwatsa su cikin ƙasashe.
english: I will scatter the Egyptians among the nations, and will disperse them through the countries.

hausa: Sai sarkin yaƙin ya ce musu, “Ku faɗa wa Hezekiya. “ ‘Ga abin da babban sarki, sarkin Assuriya, ya faɗa. A kan me kake dangana wannan ƙarfin halinka?
english: Rabshakeh said to them, “Now tell Hezekiah, ‘The great king, the king of Assyria, says, “What confidence is this in which you trust?

hausa: Ƙarfe kamar kara ne a wurinta tagulla kuma kamar ruɓaɓɓen katako ne a wurinta.
english: He counts iron as straw, and bronze as rotten wood.

hausa: Waɗannan su ne kayayyakin da aka yi amfani da su domin aikin tabanakul, da tabanakul na Shaida, waɗanda aka rubuta bisa ga umarnin Musa ta wurin Lawiyawa, a ƙarƙashin jagorancin Itamar ɗan Haruna, firist.
english: These are the amounts of materials used for the tabernacle, even the Tabernacle of the Testimony, as they were counted, according to the commandment of Moses, for the service of the Levites, by the hand of Ithamar, the son of Aaron the priest.

hausa: “A waɗancan kwanaki da kuma a wancan lokaci, sa’ad da zan maido da arzikin Yahuda da Urushalima,
english: “For, behold, in those days, and in that time, when I restore the fortunes of Judah and Jerusalem,

hausa: gama za ki yi ciki, ki haifi ɗa. Aska ba za tă taɓa kansa ba, domin yaron zai zama Banazare, keɓaɓɓe ga Allah tun daga haihuwa, shi ne kuwa zai soma ceton Isra’ilawa daga hannuwan Filistiyawa.”
english: for, behold, you shall conceive and give birth to a son. No razor shall come on his head, for the child shall be a Nazirite to God from the womb. He shall begin to save Israel out of the hand of the Philistines.”

hausa: Amma a tsawatawarka ruwaye suka gudu da jin ƙarar tsawanka suka ruga da gudu;
english: At your rebuke they fled. At the voice of your thunder they hurried away.

hausa: Ka amsa wa wawa bisa ga wautarsa, in ba haka ba zai ga kansa mai hikima ne.
english: Answer a fool according to his folly, lest he be wise in his own eyes.

hausa: Daga Lawiyawa kuwa akwai, Shemahiya ɗan Hasshub, ɗan Azrikam, ɗan Hashabiya, ɗan Bunni,
english: Of the Levites: Shemaiah the son of Hasshub, the son of Azrikam, the son of Hashabiah, the son of Bunni;

hausa: Sa’an nan ya auna bangon haikalin; kaurinsa kamu shida ne, kuma kowane ɗakin da yake a gefe kewaye da haikalin fāɗinsa kamu huɗu ne.
english: Then he measured the wall of the house, six cubits; and the width of every side room, four cubits, all around the house on every side.

hausa: Ku ba wa kowa hakkinsa. In kuna da bashin haraji, sai ku biya; in kuɗin shiga ne, ku biya kuɗin shiga; in ladabi ne, ku yi ladabi; in kuma girmamawa ne, ku ba da girma.
english: Therefore give everyone what you owe: if you owe taxes, pay taxes; if customs, then customs; if respect, then respect; if honor, then honor.

hausa: Ku faɗa wa sarkin Yahuda, wanda ya aike ku ku nemi nufin Ubangiji, ‘Ga abin da Ubangiji, Allah na Isra’ila yake cewa game da kalmomin da ka ji.
english: But to the king of Judah, who sent you to inquire of Yahweh, you shall tell him this, ‘Yahweh, the God of Israel says: “About the words which you have heard,

hausa: Sauran mutanen Benyamin da waɗansu mutanen Yahuda su ma suka zo wurin Dawuda a kagararsa.
english: Some of the children of Benjamin and Judah came to the stronghold to David.

hausa: Ku shirya wannan tare da hadaya ta ƙonawa ta kowace safiya.
english: You shall offer these in addition to the burnt offering of the morning, which is for a continual burnt offering.

hausa: don kuma a hukunta dukan waɗanda ba su gaskata gaskiyar ba sai dai suke jin daɗin mugunta.
english: that they all might be judged who didn’t believe the truth, but had pleasure in unrighteousness.

hausa: Saboda rashin jagora al’umma takan fāɗi, amma masu ba da shawara da yawa kan tabbatar da nasara.
english: Where there is no wise guidance, the nation falls, but in the multitude of counselors there is victory.

hausa: Sa’ad da kuma ’ya’yanku suka tambaye ku, ‘Mece ce manufar wannan biki?’
english: It will happen, when your children ask you, ‘What do you mean by this service?’

hausa: Sai Ubangiji ya ce, “Ga shi na yi alkawari da kai. A gaban dukan mutanenka zan yi abubuwan banmamakin da ba a taɓa yinsa a cikin wata al’umma a duniya ba. Mutanen da kuke zaune cikinsu za su ga aikin bantsoro, da Ni Ubangiji zan yi muku.
english: He said, “Behold, I make a covenant: before all your people I will do marvels, such as have not been worked in all the earth, nor in any nation; and all the people among whom you are shall see the work of Yahweh; for it is an awesome thing that I do with you.

hausa: Na san cewa Ubangiji ya shirya wa matalauta adalci yana kuma yi wa mabukata adalci.
english: I know that Yahweh will maintain the cause of the afflicted, and justice for the needy.

hausa: A maimako, suna marmarin wata ƙasa mafi kyau, ta sama. Saboda haka Allah ba ya kunya a kira shi Allahnsu, domin ya riga ya shirya musu birni.
english: But now they desire a better country, that is, a heavenly one. Therefore God is not ashamed of them, to be called their God, for he has prepared a city for them.

hausa: duk saboda yawan sha’awace-sha’awacen karuwa, mai daɗin baki, uwargidan maita, wadda ta ɓad da al’ummai ta wurin karuwancinta ta kuma ɓad da mutane ta wurin maitancinta.
english: because of the multitude of the prostitution of the alluring prostitute, the mistress of witchcraft, who sells nations through her prostitution, and families through her witchcraft.

hausa: Fekahiya ya aikata mugunta a gaban Ubangiji, bai rabu da zunuban Yerobowam ɗan Nebat wanda ya sa Isra’ila ya aikata ba.
english: He did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight. He didn’t depart from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, with which he made Israel to sin.

hausa: “A ranar hadayar Ubangiji zan hukunta sarakuna da kuma ’ya’yan sarakuna da duk waɗanda suke sanye da rigunan ƙasashen waje.
english: It will happen in the day of Yahweh’s sacrifice that I will punish the princes, the king’s sons, and all those who are clothed with foreign clothing.

hausa: Amma manyan matsara huɗu, waɗanda suke Lawiyawa, an danƙa musu hakkin lura da ɗakuna da kuma wuraren ajiya a gidan Allah.
english: for the four chief gatekeepers, who were Levites, were in an office of trust, and were over the rooms and over the treasuries in God’s house.

hausa: Wata rana da ta zo wurin Otniyel, sai ta zuga shi yă roƙi mahaifinta fili. Sa’ad da ta sauko daga jakinta, sai Kaleb ya ce mata, “Me zan yi miki?”
english: When she came, she got him to ask her father for a field. She got off her donkey; and Caleb said to her, “What would you like?”

hausa: “Ga shi, zan aika mala’ika a gabanku, yă tsare ku a tafiyarku, yă kuma kawo ku wurin da na shirya.
english: “Behold, I send an angel before you, to keep you by the way, and to bring you into the place which I have prepared.

hausa: Tentin Sujada, akwatin Alkawari tare da murfin kafara a bisansa, da dukan kayan aiki na tentin,
english: the Tent of Meeting, the ark of the covenant, the mercy seat that is on it, all the furniture of the Tent,

hausa: Ko a cikin duhu haske kan haskaka wa mai aikata gaskiya, mai alheri mai tausayi da kuma mai adalci.
english: Light dawns in the darkness for the upright, gracious, merciful, and righteous.

hausa: wanda zai yanke hukunci dacewarta, ko mai kyau ce, ko marar kyau. Duk darajar da firist ya kimanta, haka za tă zama.
english: and the priest shall evaluate it, whether it is good or bad. As the priest evaluates it, so it shall be.

hausa: Zan buɗe bakina da misalai, zan faɗi ɓoyayyun abubuwa, abubuwan dā,
english: I will open my mouth in a parable. I will utter dark sayings of old,

hausa: Duk da haka muryarsu tana kaiwa ga dukan duniya, kalmominsu zuwa iyakokin duniya. A sammai Allah ya kafa tenti domin rana,
english: Their voice has gone out through all the earth, their words to the end of the world. In them he has set a tent for the sun,

hausa: Kashegari, daidai lokacin hadaya, sai ga ruwa yana gangarowa daga gefen Edom! Ƙasar kuwa ta cika da ruwa.
english: In the morning, about the time of offering the sacrifice, behold, water came by the way of Edom, and the country was filled with water.

hausa: ta kuma ƙara da cewa, “Ya ba ni waɗannan mudu shida na sha’ir, yana cewa, ‘Kada ki koma wurin surukarki hannu wofi.’ ”
english: She said, “He gave me these six measures of barley; for he said, ‘Don’t go empty to your mother-in-law.’”

hausa: Ku yi godiya ga Allah na sama. Ƙaunarsa madawwamiya ce.
english: Oh give thanks to the God of heaven, for his loving kindness endures forever.

hausa: In wani ya yi muku wata magana, ku ce masa Ubangiji yana bukatarsu, zai kuwa mai da su nan da nan.”
english: If anyone says anything to you, you shall say, ‘The Lord needs them,’ and immediately he will send them.”

hausa: Macijin kuwa ya tsaya a bakin teku. Sai na ga wata dabba tana fitowa daga teku. Tana da ƙahoni goma da kawuna bakwai, da kuma rawani goma a ƙahoninta, a kowane kai kuwa akwai sunan saɓo.
english: Then I stood on the sand of the sea. I saw a beast coming up out of the sea, having ten horns and seven heads. On his horns were ten crowns, and on his heads, blasphemous names.

hausa: Saboda haka ina ce muku, ku yi rayuwa ta wurin Ruhu, ba za ku kuwa gamsar da sha’awace-sha’awacen mutuntaka ba.
english: But I say, walk by the Spirit, and you won’t fulfill the lust of the flesh.

hausa: Sai suka yi aiki tuƙuru suna gyaran dukan sassan katangar da suka fāɗi, suna kuma gina hasumiya a kai. Ya gina wata katanga a waje da wannan, ya kuma ƙara ƙarfin madogaran gini na Birnin Dawuda. Ya yi makamai masu yawa da kuma garkuwoyi.
english: He took courage, built up all the wall that was broken down, and raised it up to the towers, with the other wall outside, and strengthened Millo in David’s city, and made weapons and shields in abundance.

hausa: Sarki ya sa azurfa da zinariya suka zama barkatai a Urushalima kamar duwatsu, al’ul kuma kamar itatuwan fir a gindin tsaunuka.
english: The king made silver and gold to be as common as stones in Jerusalem, and he made cedars to be as common as the sycamore trees that are in the lowland.

hausa: ’Ya’yan Yaƙub maza waɗanda Rahila ta haifa su ne, Yusuf da Benyamin.
english: The sons of Rachel, Jacob’s wife: Joseph and Benjamin.

hausa: Asabbaci ne na hutu dominku, kuma dole ku yi mūsun kanku. Daga yamman rana ta tara ga wata, har zuwa yamma na biye, za ku kiyaye Asabbacinku.”
english: It shall be a Sabbath of solemn rest for you, and you shall deny yourselves. In the ninth day of the month at evening, from evening to evening, you shall keep your Sabbath.”

hausa: Sa’an nan suka ɗauki matsayinsu na kullum yadda yake a Dokar Musa mutumin Allah. Firistoci suka yayyafa jinin da Lawiyawa suka ba su.
english: They stood in their place after their order, according to the law of Moses the man of God. The priests sprinkled the blood which they received of the hand of the Levites.

hausa: Amma yanzu da kuka san Allah, ko kuma a ce Allah ya san ku, yaya kuke sāke komawa ga ƙa’idodin duniya marasa ƙarfi, abin tausayi kuma? Kuna so ku sāke komawa ga bautarsu ne?
english: But now that you have come to know God, or rather to be known by God, why do you turn back again to the weak and miserable elemental principles, to which you desire to be in bondage all over again?

hausa: “Me kuka gani? In wani yana da tumaki ɗari, sai ɗaya daga cikinsu ta ɓace, ba sai yă bar tasa’in da taran a kan tuddai yă je neman guda ɗayan da ta ɓace ba?
english: “What do you think? If a man has one hundred sheep, and one of them goes astray, doesn’t he leave the ninety-nine, go to the mountains, and seek that which has gone astray?

hausa: Sai ya ce masa, “Ka ɗauko.” Sai mutumin ya miƙa hannu ya ɗauka.
english: He said, “Take it.” So he put out his hand and took it.

hausa: Saboda haka, in dukan ikkilisiya ta taru, kowa kuma yana magana da waɗansu harsuna, sai waɗansu jahilai ko waɗansu marasa bi suka shigo, ashe, ba za su ce kuna hauka ba?
english: If therefore the whole assembly is assembled together and all speak with other languages, and unlearned or unbelieving people come in, won’t they say that you are crazy?

hausa: Duk wanda ya kiyaye doka ɗa ne mai la’akari, amma wanda yake abokantaka da masu zari yakan jawo wa mahaifinsa kunya.
english: Whoever keeps the law is a wise son; but he who is a companion of gluttons shames his father.

hausa: Ku gai da Filologus, Yuliya, Nereyus da ’yar’uwarsa, da kuma Olimfas da dukan tsarkakan da suke tare da su.
english: Greet Philologus and Julia, Nereus and his sister, and Olympas, and all the saints who are with them.

hausa: Na sāke tambaye shi na ce, “Mene ne waɗannan rassa biyun nan na zaitun a gefen bututu biyu na zinariya da suke zuba man zinariya?”
english: I asked him the second time, “What are these two olive branches, which are beside the two golden spouts that pour the golden oil out of themselves?”

hausa: Ku ji tausayin waɗanda suke shakka;
english: On some have compassion, making a distinction,

hausa: Sa’an nan mala’ikan Ubangiji ya ce, “Ya Ubangiji Maɗaukaki, har yaushe za ka ci gaba da ƙi nuna wa Urushalima da kuma garuruwan Yahuda jinƙai, waɗanda kake fushi da su shekarun nan saba’in?”
english: Then Yahweh’s angel replied, “O Yahweh of Armies, how long will you not have mercy on Jerusalem and on the cities of Judah, against which you have had indignation these seventy years?”

hausa: Ina tare da kai zan kuma cece ka,’ in ji Ubangiji. ‘Ko da yake na hallakar da dukan al’umma gaba ɗaya a inda na warwatsa ku, ba zan hallaka ku gaba ɗaya ba. Zan hore ku amma da adalci kaɗai; ba zan ƙyale ku ku tafi gaba ɗaya ba hukunci ba.’
english: For I am with you, says Yahweh, to save you; for I will make a full end of all the nations where I have scattered you, but I will not make a full end of you; but I will correct you in measure, and will in no way leave you unpunished.”

hausa: Ni Bulus da kaina, ina roƙonku albarkacin tawali’u da sanyin hali na Kiristi, ni da ake yi wa kirari “marar tsanani” a cikinku, amma “mai matsawa” sa’ad da nake rabe da ku!
english: Now I Paul, myself, entreat you by the humility and gentleness of Christ, I who in your presence am lowly among you, but being absent am bold toward you.

hausa: Wane ne a cikinku zai saurari wannan ko ya kasa kunne sosai a cikin kwanaki masu zuwa?
english: Who is there among you who will give ear to this? Who will listen and hear for the time to come?

hausa: Ka yi wa waɗansu abin da kai kake so su yi maka.
english: “As you would like people to do to you, do exactly so to them.

hausa: “Mahaifina Dawuda ya yi niyya a zuciyarsa yă gina haikali domin Sunan Ubangiji, Allah na Isra’ila.
english: Now it was in the heart of David my father to build a house for the name of Yahweh, the God of Israel.

hausa: Saboda haka ga abin da Ubangiji yana cewa game da Yehohiyakim ɗan Yosiya sarkin Yahuda, “Ba za su yi kuka dominsa ba, ‘Kaito, ɗan’uwana! Kaito, ’yar’uwata!’ Ba za su yi kuka dominsa ba, ‘Kaito, maigidana! Kaito, darajarsa!’
english: Therefore Yahweh says concerning Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah: “They won’t lament for him, saying, ‘Ah my brother!’ or, ‘Ah sister!’ They won’t lament for him, saying ‘Ah lord!’ or, ‘Ah his glory!’

hausa: Dole kullum ku mai da hankali ga kiyaye ƙa’idodi da farillan, dokoki da umarnan da ya rubuta muku. Kada ku yi wa waɗansu alloli sujada.
english: The statutes and the ordinances, and the law and the commandment which he wrote for you, you shall observe to do forever more. You shall not fear other gods.

hausa: “Kaitonku, masanan dokoki, domin kun ɗauke mabuɗin ilimi. Ku kanku ba ku shiga ba, kuma kun hana wa waɗanda suke shiga, su shiga.”
english: Woe to you lawyers! For you took away the key of knowledge. You didn’t enter in yourselves, and those who were entering in, you hindered.”

hausa: Waɗannan su ne ’ya’yan Nuhu maza uku, daga gare su ne kuma duniya za tă cika da mutane.
english: These three were the sons of Noah, and from these the whole earth was populated.

hausa: Ubangiji ya bar waɗannan al’ummai su kasance; bai kore su nan take ta wurin ba da su a hannun Yoshuwa ba.
english: So Yahweh left those nations, without driving them out hastily. He didn’t deliver them into Joshua’s hand.

hausa: A wannan rana biranensu masu ƙarfi, waɗanda suka bari saboda Isra’ilawa, za su zama kamar wuraren da aka ƙyale suka zama kufai a jeji. Za su kuma zama kango.
english: In that day, their strong cities will be like the forsaken places in the woods and on the mountain top, which were forsaken from before the children of Israel; and it will be a desolation.

hausa: Ya sa sabuwar waƙa a bakina, waƙar yabo ga Allahna. Da yawa za su gani su tsorata su kuma dogara ga Ubangiji.
english: He has put a new song in my mouth, even praise to our God. Many shall see it, and fear, and shall trust in Yahweh.

hausa: Mun tuna da kifin da muka ci kyauta a Masar, haka ma kayan lambu irin su kukumba, guna, safa, albasa da kuma tafarnuwa.
english: We remember the fish, which we ate in Egypt for nothing; the cucumbers, and the melons, and the leeks, and the onions, and the garlic;

hausa: Daga nan fa, Bilatus ya yi nemi yă saki Yesu, sai dai Yahudawa suka yi ta ihu suna cewa, “In ka saki wannan mutum, kai ba abokin Kaisar ba ne. Duk wanda ya ɗauka kansa a matsayin sarki, ai, yana gāba da Kaisar ne.”
english: At this, Pilate was seeking to release him, but the Jews cried out, saying, “If you release this man, you aren’t Caesar’s friend! Everyone who makes himself a king speaks against Caesar!”

hausa: Sa’ad da kuka ci, kuka ƙoshi, sai ku yabi Ubangiji Allahnku saboda ƙasa mai kyau da ya ba ku.
english: You shall eat and be full, and you shall bless Yahweh your God for the good land which he has given you.

hausa: Suka yi yaƙi da Midiyawa, suka kashe kowane mutum yadda Ubangiji ya umarci Musa.
english: They fought against Midian, as Yahweh commanded Moses. They killed every male.

hausa: Duk sa’ad da Yehudi ya karanta sashi uku ko huɗu na littafin, sai sarkin ya sa wuƙa ya yanke su, ya zuba a wutar da take ci a kasko, da haka ya ƙone dukan littafin.
english: When Jehudi had read three or four columns, the king cut it with the penknife, and cast it into the fire that was in the brazier, until all the scroll was consumed in the fire that was in the brazier.

hausa: ‘Ayuba ya yi magana cikin rashin sani; maganganunsa na marar hikima ne.’
english: ‘Job speaks without knowledge. His words are without wisdom.’

hausa: Sau na uku ya ce masa, “Siman ɗan Yohanna, kana ƙaunata?” Sai Bitrus ya ɓata rai saboda Yesu ya tambaye shi sau na uku, “Kana ƙaunata?” Ya ce, “Ubangiji ka san kome duka; ka san cewa, ina ƙaunarka.” Yesu ya ce, “Ciyar da tumakina.
english: He said to him the third time, “Simon, son of Jonah, do you have affection for me?” Peter was grieved because he asked him the third time, “Do you have affection for me?” He said to him, “Lord, you know everything. You know that I have affection for you.” Jesus said to him, “Feed my sheep.

hausa: sai ga shanu bakwai masu ƙiba mulmul, suka fito daga kogin, suna kiwo a cikin kyauro.
english: and behold, seven fat and sleek cattle came up out of the river. They fed in the marsh grass;

hausa: Ku yi sukuwar hauka, ya dawakai! Ku tashi a guje, ya mahayan kekunan yaƙi! Ku yi ta fitowa, ya jarumawa, mutanen Kush da kuma Ludim masu riƙon garkuwoyi, mutanen Lidiya, masu iya jan baka.
english: Go up, you horses! Rage, you chariots! Let the mighty men go out: Cush and Put, who handle the shield; and the Ludim, who handle and bend the bow.

hausa: Dā da ba ku san Allah ba, ku bayi ne ga waɗanda a ainihi ba alloli ba ne.
english: However at that time, not knowing God, you were in bondage to those who by nature are not gods.

hausa: A daidai lokacin nan, Yesu ya warkar da mutane da yawa masu ciwo, masu cututtuka, da kuma masu mugayen ruhohi. Ya kuma ba makafi da yawa ganin gari.
english: In that hour he cured many of diseases and plagues and evil spirits; and to many who were blind he gave sight.

hausa: Kaito ga wannan rawani, girman kai na mashayan Efraim, ga fure mai yanƙwanewa, darajar kyansa, da aka sa a kan kwari mai ba da amfani, ga birnin nan, wadda take girman kan waɗanda aka ƙasƙantar da ruwan inabinsu!
english: Woe to the crown of pride of the drunkards of Ephraim, and to the fading flower of his glorious beauty, which is on the head of the fertile valley of those who are overcome with wine!

hausa: Kamar haƙori mai ciwo ko yin tafiya da gurguwar ƙafa haka yake ga mai dogara da marasa aminci a lokacin wahala.
english: Confidence in someone unfaithful in time of trouble is like a bad tooth or a lame foot.

hausa: sai ya hangi jiragen ruwa biyu a bakin tafkin, waɗanda masu kamun kifi suka bari suna wankin abin kamun kifinsu.
english: He saw two boats standing by the lake, but the fishermen had gone out of them and were washing their nets.

hausa: Gama irin waɗannan mutane manzannin ƙarya ne, ma’aikata ne masu ruɗi, sun ɓad da kamanni kamar su manzannin Kiristi ne.
english: For such men are false apostles, deceitful workers, masquerading as Christ’s apostles.

hausa: Ta wurin kawo ’ya’ya masu yawa zuwa ga ɗaukaka, ya dace cewa Allah, wanda dominsa da kuma ta wurinsa ne kome yake kasancewa, ya sa tushen cetonsu yă zama cikakke ta wurin shan wahala.
english: For it became him, for whom are all things and through whom are all things, in bringing many children to glory, to make the author of their salvation perfect through sufferings.

hausa: Solomon ya haɗa kai da Fir’auna sarkin Masar, ya kuwa auri ’yarsa. Ya kawo ta cikin Birnin Dawuda kafin yă gama ginin fadarsa, da haikalin Ubangiji, da kuma katanga kewaye da Urushalima.
english: Solomon made a marriage alliance with Pharaoh king of Egypt. He took Pharaoh’s daughter and brought her into David’s city until he had finished building his own house, Yahweh’s house, and the wall around Jerusalem.

hausa: Sa’an nan duk wanda ya rage a zuriyarka zai zo yă durƙusa a gabansa yă roƙi kuɗi da abinci, zai kuma roƙa a yardar masa yă taimaki firistoci da aiki domin yă sami abin da zai ci.’ ”
english: It will happen that everyone who is left in your house will come and bow down to him for a piece of silver and a loaf of bread, and will say, “Please put me into one of the priests’ offices, that I may eat a morsel of bread.”’”

hausa: Yonatan kuma ya yi yarjejjeniya da Dawuda saboda yana ƙaunarsa kamar ransa.
english: Then Jonathan and David made a covenant, because he loved him as his own soul.

hausa: Ka dubi garkuwarmu, ya Allah; ka duba da alheri a kan shafaffenka.
english: Behold, God our shield, look at the face of your anointed.

hausa: ’Yar’uwarki Elizabet ma za tă haifi ɗa a tsufanta, ita da aka ce bakararriya, ga shi tana a watanta na shida.
english: Behold, Elizabeth your relative also has conceived a son in her old age; and this is the sixth month with her who was called barren.

hausa: “Saboda haka ga abin da Ubangiji ya ce game da sarkin Assuriya, “Ba zai shiga birnin nan ba ko yă harba kibiya a nan. Ba zai kusace ta da garkuwa ko yă yi mata zoben yaƙi ba.
english: “Therefore Yahweh says concerning the king of Assyria, ‘He will not come to this city, nor shoot an arrow there. He will not come before it with shield, nor cast up a mound against it.

hausa: Da suka iso gunduman Zuf, sai Shawulu ya ce wa bawan da yake tare da shi, “Zo mu koma kada mahaifina yă bar damuwa a kan jakuna, yă shiga damuwa game da mu.”
english: When they had come to the land of Zuph, Saul said to his servant who was with him, “Come! Let’s return, lest my father stop caring about the donkeys and be anxious for us.”

hausa: “ ‘Ga alamar Ubangiji gare ka cewa Ubangiji zai aikata kamar yadda ya yi alkawari.
english: This shall be the sign to you from Yahweh, that Yahweh will do this thing that he has spoken.

hausa: Bisa ga ƙarfinsu suka bayar da darik 61,000 na zinariya, da maina 5,000 na azurfa, da rigunan firistoci guda 100.
english: They gave according to their ability into the treasury of the work sixty-one thousand darics of gold, five thousand minas of silver, and one hundred priests’ garments.

hausa: Suka amsa kamar yadda Yesu ya ce su yi. Mutanen kuwa suka ƙyale su.
english: They said to them just as Jesus had said, and they let them go.

hausa: Ba addu’ata ba ce ka ɗauke su daga duniya ba, sai dai ka kāre su daga mugun nan.
english: I pray not that you would take them from the world, but that you would keep them from the evil one.

hausa: “Ga abin da Ubangiji yana cewa, ‘Kuna cewa game da wannan wuri, “Kango ne, babu mutane ko dabbobi.” Duk da haka a cikin garuruwan Yahuda da titunan Urushalima da aka yashe, inda ba mutane ko dabbobi, za a sāke jin
english: Yahweh says: “Yet again there will be heard in this place, about which you say, ‘It is waste, without man and without animal, even in the cities of Judah, and in the streets of Jerusalem, that are desolate, without man and without inhabitant and without animal,’

hausa: domin sun ƙi dokokina ba su kuwa bi ƙa’idodina ba suka kuma ƙazantar da Asabbataina. Gama zukatansu sun fi so su bauta wa gumakansu.
english: because they rejected my ordinances, and didn’t walk in my statutes, and profaned my Sabbaths; for their heart went after their idols.

hausa: Sa’an nan ya auri Ma’aka ’yar Absalom, wadda ta haifa masa Abiya, Attai, Ziza da kuma Shelomit.
english: After her, he took Maacah the granddaughter of Absalom; and she bore him Abijah, Attai, Ziza, and Shelomith.

hausa: Idan mutum ya auri mata, daga baya ba tă gamshe shi ba domin ya gano wani abu marar kyau game da ita, ya ba ta takardar saki, ya kuma kore ta daga gidansa,
english: When a man takes a wife and marries her, then it shall be, if she finds no favor in his eyes because he has found some unseemly thing in her, that he shall write her a certificate of divorce, put it in her hand, and send her out of his house.

hausa: Aka sa Irmiya a can cikin kurkuku, inda ya kasance kwanaki masu yawa.
english: When Jeremiah had come into the dungeon house and into the cells, and Jeremiah had remained there many days,

hausa: Saboda haka Lot ya tafi ya yi magana da surukansa waɗanda suka yi alkawari za su aure ’ya’yansa mata. Ya ce, “Ku yi sauri ku fita daga wannan wuri, gama Ubangiji yana gab da hallaka birnin.” Amma surukansa suka ɗauka wasa yake yi.
english: Lot went out, and spoke to his sons-in-law, who were pledged to marry his daughters, and said, “Get up! Get out of this place, for Yahweh will destroy the city!” But he seemed to his sons-in-law to be joking.

hausa: Tsuntsaye sarari suna sheƙunansu kusa da ruwan; suna rera cikin rassa.
english: The birds of the sky nest by them. They sing among the branches.

hausa: A gabansu wuta tana ci, a bayansu ga harshen wuta yana ci, A gabansu ƙasa ta yi kamar gonar Eden, a bayansu kuma jeji ne wofi, babu abin da ya kuɓuce musu.
english: A fire devours before them, and behind them, a flame burns. The land is as the garden of Eden before them, and behind them, a desolate wilderness. Yes, and no one has escaped them.

hausa: Dole ku kiyaye wannan farilla kowace shekara a lokacinta.
english: You shall therefore keep this ordinance in its season from year to year.

hausa: “Ka saƙa doguwar riga, abin ɗamara da kuma huluna domin ’ya’yan Haruna, don yă ba su girma da ɗaukaka.
english: “You shall make tunics for Aaron’s sons. You shall make sashes for them. You shall make headbands for them, for glory and for beauty.

hausa: Da yake koya musu, sai ya ce, “Ashe, ba a rubuce yake ba cewa, ‘Za a kira gidana, gidan addu’a na dukan al’ummai ba’?Amma ga shi kun mai da shi ‘kogon ’yan fashi.’”
english: He taught, saying to them, “Isn’t it written, ‘My house will be called a house of prayer for all the nations’? But you have made it a den of robbers!”

hausa: “Sai ya ba ni wannan bayani, ‘Dabbar nan ta huɗu, ita ce mulki na huɗu da zai bayyana a duniya. Zai bambanta da dukan sauran mulkoki, zai kuma cinye dukan duniya, yă tattake ta, yă kuma ragargaje ta.
english: “So he said, ‘The fourth animal will be a fourth kingdom on earth, which will be different from all the kingdoms, and will devour the whole earth, and will tread it down and break it in pieces.

hausa: Kuma ba wanda yakan so shan sabon ruwan inabi bayan ya sha tsohon, don yakan ce, ‘Ai, tsohon ya fi kyau.’ ”
english: No man having drunk old wine immediately desires new, for he says, ‘The old is better.’”

hausa: Sa’ad da ka gama karanta wannan littafi, sai ka ɗaura wa littafin dutse, sa’an nan ka jefar da shi tsakiyar Kogin Yuferites.
english: It will be, when you have finished reading this book, that you shall bind a stone to it, and cast it into the middle of the Euphrates.

hausa: Akwai ƙarfi a cikin wuyanta; razana tana wucewa a gabanta.
english: There is strength in his neck. Terror dances before him.

hausa: Macen da za tă haihu takan yi naƙuda domin lokacinta ya yi; amma sa’ad da ta haihu, sai ta manta da wahalar domin farin ciki an haifi jariri a duniya.
english: A woman, when she gives birth, has sorrow because her time has come. But when she has delivered the child, she doesn’t remember the anguish any more, for the joy that a human being is born into the world.

hausa: Ka juye sawunka wajen waɗannan madawwamin kufai, dukan wannan hallakar da abokin gāba ya yi wa wuri mai tsarki.
english: Lift up your feet to the perpetual ruins, all the evil that the enemy has done in the sanctuary.

hausa: “Ɗan mutum, yi kuka saboda jama’ar Masar ka kuma tura ta da ’yan matan manyan al’ummai zuwa ƙarƙashin ƙasa, tare da waɗanda suka gangara zuwa rami.
english: “Son of man, wail for the multitude of Egypt, and cast them down, even her and the daughters of the famous nations, to the lower parts of the earth, with those who go down into the pit.

hausa: Kusa da su kuma, Meremot ɗan Uriya, ɗan Hakkoz ne ya yi gyare-gyaren. Biye da shi kuma sai Meshullam ɗan Berekiya, ɗan Meshezabel ya yi gyare-gyare. Kusa da shi Zadok ɗan Ba’ana shi ma ya yi gyare-gyare.
english: Next to them, Meremoth the son of Uriah, the son of Hakkoz made repairs. Next to them, Meshullam the son of Berechiah, the son of Meshezabel made repairs. Next to them, Zadok the son of Baana made repairs.

hausa: don kada baƙi su yi biki a kan dukiyarku wahalarku ta azurta gidan wani mutum dabam.
english: lest strangers feast on your wealth, and your labors enrich another man’s house.

hausa: rana ce ta baƙin duhu ƙirin, ranar gizagizai ce baƙi ƙirin. Babbar rundunar mayaƙa mai ƙarfi tana zuwa kamar ketowar alfijir a kan duwatsu yadda ba a taɓa ganin irinta ba, ba kuwa za a ƙara ganin irinta ba har tsararraki masu zuwa.
english: A day of darkness and gloominess, a day of clouds and thick darkness. As the dawn spreading on the mountains, a great and strong people; there has never been the like, neither will there be any more after them, even to the years of many generations.

hausa: Ka yi duk kayan aikinsa da tagulla, tukwanensa na ɗiban toka, da manyan cokula, da kwanonin yayyafawa, da cokula masu yatsotsi don nama da kuma farantai domin wuta.
english: You shall make its pots to take away its ashes; and its shovels, its basins, its meat hooks, and its fire pans. You shall make all its vessels of bronze.

hausa: Ya mutanen Sihiyona, waɗanda suke zama a Urushalima, ba za ku ƙara kuka ba. Zai zama mai alheri sa’ad da kuka yi kukan neman taimako! Da zarar ya ji, zai amsa muku.
english: For the people will dwell in Zion at Jerusalem. You will weep no more. He will surely be gracious to you at the voice of your cry. When he hears you, he will answer you.

hausa: Ya shafe ginshiƙan saman ɗaki, madogaran ƙofofi, bangaye da kuma ƙofofin haikalin da zinariya, ya sassaƙa kerubobi a bangayen.
english: He also overlaid the house, the beams, the thresholds, its walls, and its doors with gold, and engraved cherubim on the walls.

hausa: Bari ƙaunarka marar ƙarewa ta zauna a kanmu, ya Ubangiji, ko ma da muke sa begenmu a gare ka.
english: Let your loving kindness be on us, Yahweh, since we have hoped in you.

hausa: Amma suka yi wa ’yan saƙon Allah ba’a, suka rena maganarsa, suka yi wa annabawansa dariyar reni, har sai da fushin Ubangiji ya tasar a kan mutanensa babu makawa.
english: but they mocked the messengers of God, despised his words, and scoffed at his prophets, until Yahweh’s wrath arose against his people, until there was no remedy.

hausa: Ka auna shekel ashirin na abinci don kowace rana ka kuma ci shi a ƙayyadadden lokaci.
english: Your food which you shall eat shall be by weight, twenty shekels a day. From time to time you shall eat it.

hausa: “Kwanaki suna zuwa,” in ji Ubangiji, “sa’ad da zan tā da wa Dawuda Reshen adalci, Sarki wanda zai yi mulki da hikima ya kuma yi abin da yake gaskiya da kuma daidai a ƙasar.
english: “Behold, the days come,” says Yahweh, “that I will raise to David a righteous Branch; and he will reign as king and deal wisely, and will execute justice and righteousness in the land.

hausa: Sa’an nan Ubangiji ya umarce ni a wannan lokaci, in koya muku ƙa’idodi da dokokin da za ku bi a ƙasar da kuke hayewa Urdun don mallake.
english: Yahweh commanded me at that time to teach you statutes and ordinances, that you might do them in the land where you go over to possess it.

hausa: Don me ka ruɗe ni cewa, ‘Ita ’yar’uwata ce,’ har na ɗauke ta tă zama matata? To, ga matarka. Ɗauke ta ka tafi.”
english: Why did you say, ‘She is my sister,’ so that I took her to be my wife? Now therefore, see your wife, take her, and go your way.”

hausa: sai shugabannin kekunan yaƙin suka ga ashe ba sarkin Isra’ila ba ne, sai suka daina binsa.
english: When the captains of the chariots saw that it was not the king of Israel, they turned back from pursuing him.

hausa: Duk wanda ya taɓa gawar wani, bai kuma tsarkake kansa ba, ya ƙazantar da tabanakul na Ubangiji ke nan. Dole a ware wannan mutum daga cikin Isra’ilawa. Gama ba a yayyafa ruwan tsabtaccewa a kansa ba; ya ƙazantu, ya kasance da ƙazanta ke nan.
english: Whoever touches a dead person, the body of a man who has died, and doesn’t purify himself, defiles Yahweh’s tabernacle; and that soul shall be cut off from Israel; because the water for impurity was not sprinkled on him, he shall be unclean. His uncleanness is yet on him.

hausa: “Yanzu ka roƙi mana Ubangiji saboda Nebukadnezzar sarkin Babilon yana kawo mana yaƙi. Wataƙila Ubangiji zai yi mana waɗansu abubuwa banmamaki kamar a lokacin baya don yă janye daga gare mu.”
english: “Please inquire of Yahweh for us; for Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon makes war against us. Perhaps Yahweh will deal with us according to all his wondrous works, that he may withdraw from us.”

hausa: Ta wurin bangaskiya ya yi zama a ƙasar da aka yi masa alkawari kamar baƙo a baƙuwar ƙasa; ya zauna a tentuna, haka ma Ishaku da Yaƙub, waɗanda su ma magādan alkawarin nan ne tare da shi.
english: By faith he lived as an alien in the land of promise, as in a land not his own, dwelling in tents with Isaac and Jacob, the heirs with him of the same promise.

hausa: Sa’an nan ya ce musu, “Ga abin da Ubangiji, Allah na Isra’ila ya ce, ‘Kowane mutum yă rataya takobinsa, yă kai yă kawo daga wannan gefe zuwa wancan cikin sansani, kowa yă kashe ɗan’uwansa, da abokinsa, da kuma maƙwabcinsa.’ ”
english: He said to them, “Yahweh, the God of Israel, says, ‘Every man put his sword on his thigh, and go back and forth from gate to gate throughout the camp, and every man kill his brother, and every man his companion, and every man his neighbor.’”

hausa: Ya auna katangarsa ya kuma sami ƙaurinta kamun 144, bisa ga ma’aunin mutum, wanda mala’ikan ya yi amfani da shi.
english: Its wall is one hundred forty-four cubits, by the measure of a man, that is, of an angel.

hausa: To, Yoshuwa ɗan Nun ya cika da ruhun hikima, gama Musa ya ɗibiya hannuwansa a kansa. Saboda haka Isra’ilawa suka saurare shi, suka kuma aikata abin da Ubangiji ya umarci Musa.
english: Joshua the son of Nun was full of the spirit of wisdom, for Moses had laid his hands on him. The children of Israel listened to him, and did as Yahweh commanded Moses.

hausa: don yă cece su daga mutuwa ya bar su da rai a lokacin yunwa.
english: to deliver their soul from death, to keep them alive in famine.

hausa: a nan kuwa akwai wani mutum mai shanyayyen hannu. Don neman dalili su zargi Yesu, sai suka tambaye shi suka ce, “Ya dace a warkar a ranar Asabbaci?”
english: And behold, there was a man with a withered hand. They asked him, “Is it lawful to heal on the Sabbath day?” so that they might accuse him.

hausa: Su da zuriyarsu, su suke lura da tsaron ƙofofin gidan Ubangiji, gidan da ake kira Tenti.
english: So they and their children had the oversight of the gates of Yahweh’s house, even the house of the tent, as guards.

hausa: ɗan Tahat, ɗan Assir, ɗan Ebiyasaf, ɗan Kora,
english: the son of Tahath, the son of Assir, the son of Ebiasaph, the son of Korah,

hausa: Ta wurin waɗannan ya ba mu alkawaransa masu girma da kuma masu daraja, domin ta wurinsu ku iya yin tarayya cikin Allahntakarsa, ku kuma kuɓuta daga lalatar da take cikin duniya wadda mugayen sha’awace-sha’awace suke jawowa.
english: by which he has granted to us his precious and exceedingly great promises; that through these you may become partakers of the divine nature, having escaped from the corruption that is in the world by lust.

hausa: wata mace ta zo wurinsa da wani ɗan tulun alabasta na turaren mai tsada sosai, wanda ta zuba a kansa a lokacin da yake cin abinci.
english: a woman came to him having an alabaster jar of very expensive ointment, and she poured it on his head as he sat at the table.

hausa: Amma sojojin Babiloniyawa suka bi su, suka ci wa Zedekiya a filayen Yeriko. Suka kama shi suka kai shi wurin Nebukadnezzar a Ribla a ƙasar Hamat, inda aka yanke masa hukunci.
english: But the army of the Chaldeans pursued them, and overtook Zedekiah in the plains of Jericho. When they had taken him, they brought him up to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon to Riblah in the land of Hamath; and he pronounced judgment on him.

hausa: Sa’an nan Ubangiji ya ce wa Musa,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

hausa: Ko da yake ya tara azurfa kamar ƙasa, tufafi kuma kamar tarin ƙasa,
english: Though he heap up silver as the dust, and prepare clothing as the clay;

hausa: Ka fid da ni daga laka, kada ka bari in nutse; ka cece ni daga waɗanda suke ƙina, daga rurin ruwaye.
english: Deliver me out of the mire, and don’t let me sink. Let me be delivered from those who hate me, and out of the deep waters.

hausa: Ya kuma ƙwato garkunan tumaki, da na awaki, da na shanu. Mutanensa suka koro shanun, suka yi gaba, suka ce, “Wannan shi ne ganimar Dawuda.”
english: David took all the flocks and the herds, which they drove before those other livestock, and said, “This is David’s plunder.”

hausa: Musa ya sami ilimi cikin dukan hikimar Masarawa ya kuma zama mai iko cikin magana da ayyuka.
english: Moses was instructed in all the wisdom of the Egyptians. He was mighty in his words and works.

hausa: Suka toya burodi marar yisti da garin da aka kwaɓa wanda suka kawo daga Masar. Garin da aka kwaɓan ba shi da yisti, domin an kore su daga Masar, ba su kuwa sami damar shirya wa kansu abinci ba.
english: They baked unleavened cakes of the dough which they brought out of Egypt; for it wasn’t leavened, because they were thrust out of Egypt, and couldn’t wait, and they had not prepared any food for themselves.

hausa: “Amma ka tambayi dabbobi, za su kuma koya maka, ko kuma tsuntsayen sararin sama kuma za su gaya maka.
english: “But ask the animals now, and they will teach you; the birds of the sky, and they will tell you.

hausa: Irmiya ya ce, “Ba za su ba da kai ba, ka yi biyayya ga Ubangiji ta wurin yin abin da na faɗa maka. Ta haka zai zama maka da amfani, za ka kuwa rayu.
english: But Jeremiah said, “They won’t deliver you. Obey, I beg you, Yahweh’s voice, in that which I speak to you; so it will be well with you, and your soul will live.

hausa: A can na ajiye akwatin alkawari, inda alkawarin Ubangiji da ya yi da mutanen Isra’ila yake.”
english: There I have set the ark, in which is Yahweh’s covenant, which he made with the children of Israel.”

hausa: To, kana iya cewa, “An sassare rassan ne don a ɗaura aure da ni.”
english: You will say then, “Branches were broken off, that I might be grafted in.”

hausa: Zai rushe katangarki da dundurusai, ya rurrushe hasumiyoyinki da makamai.
english: He will set his battering engines against your walls, and with his axes he will break down your towers.

hausa: Sukan ɗaura mikin mutanena sai ka ce mikin ba shi da matsala. Suna cewa, “Lafiya, Lafiya,” alhali kuwa ba lafiya.
english: They have healed the hurt of the daughter of my people slightly, saying, “Peace, peace,” when there is no peace.

hausa: Ubangiji shi ne ƙarfina da garkuwata; zuciyata ta amince da shi, kuma na sami taimako. Zuciyata ta yi tsalle don farin ciki zan kuwa yi godiya gare shi cikin waƙa.
english: Yahweh is my strength and my shield. My heart has trusted in him, and I am helped. Therefore my heart greatly rejoices. With my song I will thank him.

hausa: Dawuda ya tafi ya ɓuya a fili. Sa’ad da ranar Bikin Sabon Wata ta zo, sarki ya zauna don yă ci.
english: So David hid himself in the field. When the new moon had come, the king sat himself down to eat food.

hausa: Da ta buɗe kwandon, sai ta ga yaro yana kuka, ta kuwa ji tausayinsa. Ta ce, “Wannan ɗaya daga cikin jariran Ibraniyawa ne.”
english: She opened it, and saw the child, and behold, the baby cried. She had compassion on him, and said, “This is one of the Hebrews’ children.”

hausa: Kun yi waɗannan abubuwa na kuwa yi shiru; kun ɗauka gaba ɗaya ni kamar ku ne. Amma zan tsawata muku in kuma zarge ku a fuskarku.
english: You have done these things, and I kept silent. You thought that I was just like you. I will rebuke you, and accuse you in front of your eyes.

hausa: A rana ta uku, Yusuf ya ce musu, “Ku yi wannan za ku kuwa rayu, gama ina tsoron Allah.
english: Joseph said to them the third day, “Do this, and live, for I fear God.

hausa: Al’ummai kuma za su san cewa mutanen Isra’ila sun tafi zaman bauta saboda zunubinsu, domin sun yi rashin aminci gare ni. Saboda haka na kawar da fuskata daga gare su na miƙa su ga abokan gābansu, suka kuwa mutu ta takobi.
english: The nations will know that the house of Israel went into captivity for their iniquity, because they trespassed against me, and I hid my face from them; so I gave them into the hand of their adversaries, and they all fell by the sword.

hausa: Haka ma maza suka bar al’adar kwana da mata suka tunzura cikin sha’awar kwana da juna, abin da ba daidai ba bisa ga halitta. Maza suka aikata rashin kunya da waɗansu maza, suka jawo wa kansu sakamako daidai da bauɗewarsu.
english: Likewise also the men, leaving the natural function of the woman, burned in their lust toward one another, men doing what is inappropriate with men, and receiving in themselves the due penalty of their error.

hausa: Kashegari bayan da suka ci amfanin ƙasar kuwa, Manna ta yanke, mutanen Isra’ila kuma ba su ƙara samunta ba. A wannan shekara suka fara cin amfanin ƙasar Kan’ana.
english: The manna ceased on the next day, after they had eaten of the produce of the land. The children of Israel didn’t have manna any more, but they ate of the fruit of the land of Canaan that year.

hausa: “Ya Allah, ka ba ni abin da ka yi mini alkawari. Wane ne zai kāre ni?
english: “Now give a pledge. Be collateral for me with yourself. Who is there who will strike hands with me?

hausa: Dukanmu muka fāɗi ƙasa, na kuwa ji wata murya tana ce mini da harshen Arameyik, ‘Shawulu, Shawulu, don me kake tsananta mini? Yana da wuya ka shuri tsinken tsokanar dabba.’
english: When we had all fallen to the earth, I heard a voice saying to me in the Hebrew language, ‘Saul, Saul, why are you persecuting me? It is hard for you to kick against the goads.’

hausa: Gama haka yake. Yi ka kuma yi, yi ka kuma yi, mulki a kan mulki, mulki a kan mulki; nan kaɗan, can kaɗan.”
english: For it is precept on precept, precept on precept; line on line, line on line; here a little, there a little.

hausa: Sai Musa ya ce wa Hobab ɗan Reyuwel Bamidiyane surukinsa, “Yanzu fa, muna shirin tashi ne daga nan, domin mu tafi inda Ubangiji ya ce, ‘Zan ba ku.’ Ka zo tare da mu, za mu kuwa yi maka alheri, gama Ubangiji ya yi wa Isra’ilawa alkawari abubuwa masu kyau.”
english: Moses said to Hobab, the son of Reuel the Midianite, Moses’ father-in-law, “We are journeying to the place of which Yahweh said, ‘I will give it to you.’ Come with us, and we will treat you well; for Yahweh has spoken good concerning Israel.”

hausa: Saboda haka, Ubangiji ya ce, “Ina shirya wa waɗannan mutane bala’i, yadda ba za ku iya ceton kanku ba. Ba za ku ƙara tafiya kuna taƙama ba, gama zai zama lokacin bala’i ne.
english: Therefore Yahweh says: “Behold, I am planning against these people a disaster, from which you will not remove your necks, neither will you walk haughtily, for it is an evil time.

hausa: Sai ta yi gabas zuwa Bet-Dagon, ta taɓa Zebulun da kuma Kwarin Ifta El, ta wuce arewa zuwa Bet-Emek da Neyiyel, ta wuce Kabul a hagu,
english: It turned toward the sunrise to Beth Dagon, and reached to Zebulun, and to the valley of Iphtah El northward to Beth Emek and Neiel. It went out to Cabul on the left hand,

hausa: Ta Dawuda. Sa’ad da ya yi kamar ya haukace a gaban Abimelek, Wanda ya kore shi, ya kuwa tafi. Zan gode wa Ubangiji kullayaumi; yabonsa kullum za su kasance a leɓunana.
english: By David; when he pretended to be insane before Abimelech, who drove him away, and he departed. I will bless Yahweh at all times. His praise will always be in my mouth.

hausa: “ ‘In farat ɗaya wani ya mutu kusa da shi, to, keɓewarsa ta ƙazantu, dole yă aske kansa a ranar tsarkakewarsa, a rana ta bakwai.
english: “‘If any man dies very suddenly beside him, and he defiles the head of his separation, then he shall shave his head in the day of his cleansing. On the seventh day he shall shave it.

hausa: Ka sa yana ta rufe zuciyarsu, kuma bari la’anarka ta bi su.
english: You will give them hardness of heart, your curse to them.

hausa: Za ka ce, “Zan kai hari wa ƙasar da ƙauyukanta ba su da katanga; zan fāɗa wa mutanen da suke zamansu kurum cikin salama, dukansu suna zama babu katanga babu ƙofofi ko ƙyamare.
english: You will say, ‘I will go up to the land of unwalled villages. I will go to those who are at rest, who dwell securely, all of them dwelling without walls, and having neither bars nor gates,

hausa: Bari Ubangiji yă yanke dukan zaƙin bakinsu da kuma kowane harshe mai fariya,
english: May Yahweh cut off all flattering lips, and the tongue that boasts,

hausa: Sai Ubangiji ya ce wa Musa, “Sauka, gama mutanenka, waɗanda ka fitar da su daga Masar sun ƙazantu.
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, “Go, get down; for your people, whom you brought up out of the land of Egypt, have corrupted themselves!

hausa: Ba za mu ci gādo tare da su a wancan hayin Urdun ba, domin mun sami gādonmu a wannan hayin gabashin Urdun.”
english: For we will not inherit with them on the other side of the Jordan and beyond, because our inheritance has come to us on this side of the Jordan eastward.”

hausa: Sa’ad da shugaban masu tuya ya ga cewa Yusuf ya ba da fassara mai gamsarwa, sai ya ce, wa Yusuf, “Ni ma na yi mafarki. A kaina, akwai kwanduna uku na burodi.
english: When the chief baker saw that the interpretation was good, he said to Joseph, “I also was in my dream, and behold, three baskets of white bread were on my head.

hausa: Sa’an nan sai Zerubbabel ɗan Sheyaltiyel, da Yoshuwa ɗan Yehozadak, wanda yake babban firist, da kuma dukan raguwar jama’ar suka yi biyayya da muryar Ubangiji Allahnsu da kuma saƙon annabi Haggai, domin Ubangiji Allahnsu ne ya aiko shi. Mutane kuwa suka ji tsoron Ubangiji.
english: Then Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel and Joshua the son of Jehozadak, the high priest, with all the remnant of the people, obeyed Yahweh their God’s voice, and the words of Haggai the prophet, as Yahweh their God had sent him; and the people feared Yahweh.

hausa: Ka yi zoban zinariya huɗu domin teburin, ka daure su a kusurwoyi huɗu, inda ƙafafu huɗun suke.
english: You shall make four rings of gold for it, and put the rings in the four corners that are on its four feet.

hausa: Shi da masu yin masa hidima da mutanen ƙasar ba su kula da maganar da Ubangiji ya yi ta wurin Irmiya annabi ba.
english: But neither he, nor his servants, nor the people of the land, listened to Yahweh’s words, which he spoke by the prophet Jeremiah.

hausa: Ta wurin maganar Ubangiji, ɗaya daga cikin ’ya’ya maza na annabawa ya ce wa abokinsa, “Ka buge ni da makaminka,” amma mutumin ya ƙi.
english: A certain man of the sons of the prophets said to his fellow by Yahweh’s word, “Please strike me!” The man refused to strike him.

hausa: Mun dai san Nassi ba ya ƙarya, In har ya kira su waɗanda maganar Allah ta zo musu, ‘alloli,’
english: If he called them gods, to whom the word of God came (and the Scripture can’t be broken),

hausa: Zan juye kunnena ga karin magana; da garaya zan ƙarfafa kacici-kacicina.
english: I will incline my ear to a proverb. I will solve my riddle on the harp.

hausa: Na zo wurinku cikin rashin ƙarfi da tsoro, da rawan jiki ƙwarai.
english: I was with you in weakness, in fear, and in much trembling.

hausa: Sai ya ce musu, “Na ga cewa halin mahaifinku gare ni ba kamar yadda dā yake ba, amma Allah na mahaifina yana tare da ni.
english: and said to them, “I see the expression on your father’s face, that it is not toward me as before; but the God of my father has been with me.

hausa: Wata gardama ta tashi a tsakanin almajiran, a kan ko wane ne a cikinsu zai zama mafi girma
english: An argument arose among them about which of them was the greatest.

hausa: Gama jinƙai nake bukata, ba hadaya ba, ku kuma san Allah a maimakon hadayun ƙonawa.
english: For I desire mercy, and not sacrifice; and the knowledge of God more than burnt offerings.

hausa: Sa’an nan Absalom ya ce, to, “In ba za ka ba, ina roƙonka bari Amnon ɗan’uwana yă zo tare da mu.” Sarki ya ce masa, “Don me zai tafi tare da kai?”
english: Then Absalom said, “If not, please let my brother Amnon go with us.” The king said to him, “Why should he go with you?”

hausa: Sa’ad da macen ta ga ’ya’yan itacen suna da kyau don abinci, abin sha’awa ga ido, abin marmari kuma don samun hikima, sai ta tsinka ta ci, ta kuma ba da waɗansu wa mijinta wanda yake tare da ita, shi ma ya ci.
english: When the woman saw that the tree was good for food, and that it was a delight to the eyes, and that the tree was to be desired to make one wise, she took some of its fruit, and ate. Then she gave some to her husband with her, and he ate it, too.

hausa: Gama tun da na tafi wurin Fir’auna, na yi masa magana da sunanka, sai ya fara gasa wa mutanen nan azaba, ba ka kuma ceci mutanenka.”
english: For since I came to Pharaoh to speak in your name, he has brought trouble on this people. You have not rescued your people at all!”

hausa: taurarin sararin sama suka fāffāɗi a ƙasa, kamar yadda ɗanyun ’ya’yan ɓaure suke fāɗuwa daga itacen ɓaure sa’ad da iska mai ƙarfi ta jijjiga shi.
english: The stars of the sky fell to the earth, like a fig tree dropping its unripe figs when it is shaken by a great wind.

hausa: Gama a cikin bishara an bayyana adalci daga Allah wanda yake ta wurin bangaskiya daga farko zuwa ƙarshe, kamar yadda yake a rubuce cewa, “Mai adalci zai rayu ta wurin bangaskiya.”
english: For in it is revealed God’s righteousness from faith to faith. As it is written, “But the righteous shall live by faith.”

hausa: “ ‘Waɗannan su ne ƙa’idodin hadaya don zumuncin da mutum zai iya miƙa ga Ubangiji.
english: “‘This is the law of the sacrifice of peace offerings, which one shall offer to Yahweh:

hausa: Ka sanar da ni hanyar rai; za ka cika ni da farin ciki a gabanka, da madawwamin jin daɗi a hannun damarka.
english: You will show me the path of life. In your presence is fullness of joy. In your right hand there are pleasures forever more.

hausa: Yaƙi kuma ya sāke tashi tsakanin Isra’ilawa da Filistiyawa, Elhanan ɗan Yayir ya kashe Lahmi ɗan’uwan Goliyat mutumin Gat, wanda yake riƙe da māshi mai sandan masaƙa.
english: Again there was war with the Philistines; and Elhanan the son of Jair killed Lahmi the brother of Goliath the Gittite, the staff of whose spear was like a weaver’s beam.

hausa: Amma in rashin adalcinmu ya bayyana adalcin Allah a fili, me za mu ce ke nan? Za mu ce Allah ya yi rashin adalci ke nan da ya saukar da fushinsa a kanmu? (Ina magana kamar yadda mutum zai yi ne.)
english: But if our unrighteousness commends the righteousness of God, what will we say? Is God unrighteous who inflicts wrath? I speak like men do.

hausa: Amma wanda yake da shakka yakan jawo wa kansa hukunci ne in ya ci, domin yana ci ne ba bisa ga bangaskiya ba; kuma duk abin da bai zo daga bangaskiya ba zunubi ne.
english: But he who doubts is condemned if he eats, because it isn’t of faith; and whatever is not of faith is sin.

hausa: Ku bi gurbina, kamar yadda ni nake bin gurbin Kiristi.
english: Be imitators of me, even as I also am of Christ.

hausa: Wajen tsaro na huɗu na dare, sai Yesu ya nufe su, yana takawa a kan tafkin.
english: In the fourth watch of the night, Jesus came to them, walking on the sea.

hausa: Mata biyu za su kasance suna niƙa; za a ɗau ɗaya a bar ɗaya.
english: Two women will be grinding at the mill: one will be taken and one will be left.

hausa: Zan ce wa arewa, ‘Ku miƙa su!’ Ga kudu kuma, ‘Kada ku riƙe su.’ Kawo ’ya’yana maza daga nesa ’ya’yana mata kuma daga iyakar duniya,
english: I will tell the north, ‘Give them up!’ and tell the south, ‘Don’t hold them back! Bring my sons from far away, and my daughters from the ends of the earth—

hausa: ’Ya’yan Ruben maza su ne, Hanok, Fallu, Hezron da Karmi.
english: The sons of Reuben: Hanoch, Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi.

hausa: ‘Mahaifina ya sa na yi rantsuwa, ya kuma ce, “Ina gab da mutuwa, ka binne ni a kabarin da na haƙa wa kaina a ƙasar Kan’ana.” Yanzu fa bari in haura in binne mahaifina, sa’an nan in dawo.’ ”
english: ‘My father made me swear, saying, “Behold, I am dying. Bury me in my grave which I have dug for myself in the land of Canaan.” Now therefore, please let me go up and bury my father, and I will come again.’”

hausa: suka rera waƙar Musa bawan Allah da kuma waƙar Ɗan Ragon suna cewa, “Ayyukanka suna da girma da kuma banmamaki, ya Ubangiji Maɗaukaki. Al’amuranka suna da aminci da kuma gaskiya, ya Sarkin zamanai.
english: They sang the song of Moses, the servant of God, and the song of the Lamb, saying, “Great and marvelous are your works, Lord God, the Almighty! Righteous and true are your ways, you King of the nations.

hausa: Yehu ya ce, “Ku kira jama’a don a girmama Ba’al.” Saboda haka suka yi shela.
english: Jehu said, “Sanctify a solemn assembly for Baal!” So they proclaimed it.

hausa: Sa’ad da Ariyok, shugaban ƙungiyar matsaran sarki, ya fita domin yă kashe masu hikima na Babilon, sai Daniyel ya yi masa magana cikin hikima da dabara.
english: Then Daniel returned answer with counsel and prudence to Arioch the captain of the king’s guard, who had gone out to kill the wise men of Babylon.

hausa: Mutane masu faɗin irin abubuwan nan sun nuna cewa suna neman ƙasar da take tasu.
english: For those who say such things make it clear that they are seeking a country of their own.

hausa: Na duba, sai na ga ba kowa; kowane tsuntsu a sarari da ya tsere.
english: I saw, and behold, there was no man, and all the birds of the sky had fled.

hausa: Mai farin ciki ne mutumin da ba ya aiki da shawarar mugaye ko yă yi abin da masu zunubi suke yi ko yă zauna tare da masu yin ba’a.
english: Blessed is the man who doesn’t walk in the counsel of the wicked, nor stand on the path of sinners, nor sit in the seat of scoffers;

hausa: In mutum yana da mata biyu, yana kuwa ƙaunar ɗaya, ba ya kuma ƙaunar ɗayan, su biyun kuwa suka haifi masa ’ya’ya maza, sai ya zamana cewa ɗan farin ya kasance na wadda ba ya ƙauna,
english: If a man has two wives, the one beloved and the other hated, and they have borne him children, both the beloved and the hated, and if the firstborn son is hers who was hated,

hausa: ta Ara 775
english: The children of Arah, seven hundred seventy-five.

hausa: Nefilimawa suna nan a duniya a waɗancan kwanaki, da kuma kwanakin da suka bi baya, a sa’ad da ’ya’yan Allah suka kwana da ’ya’yan mutane mata, suka kuma hahhaifi musu ’ya’ya. Ai, su ne jarumawan dā, mutanen da suka shahara.
english: The Nephilim were on the earth in those days, and also after that, when God’s sons came in to men’s daughters and had children with them. Those were the mighty men who were of old, men of renown.

hausa: Tera ya ɗauki ɗansa Abraham, jikansa Lot ɗan Haran, da surukarsa Saira, matar Abram, tare kuwa suka bar Ur ta Kaldiyawa, don su tafi Kan’ana. Amma sa’ad da suka zo Haran sai suka zauna a can.
english: Terah took Abram his son, Lot the son of Haran, his son’s son, and Sarai his daughter-in-law, his son Abram’s wife. They went from Ur of the Chaldees, to go into the land of Canaan. They came to Haran and lived there.

hausa: Kome tsawon rayuwar mutum, bari yă more su duka. Amma bari kuma yă tuna da kwanakin duhu, gama su ma za su yi yawa. Duk abin da zai faru ba shi da amfani.
english: Yes, if a man lives many years, let him rejoice in them all; but let him remember the days of darkness, for they shall be many. All that comes is vanity.

hausa: Akish ya ce wa bayinsa, “Duba, wannan mutum yana hauka. Me ya sa kuka kawo shi a wurina?
english: Then Achish said to his servants, “Look, you see the man is insane. Why then have you brought him to me?

hausa: Dawuda ya rera wannan makoki saboda Shawulu da ɗansa Yonatan.
english: David lamented with this lamentation over Saul and over Jonathan his son

hausa: Duk sa’ad da na yi magana, nakan tā da murya ina furta hargitsi da hallaka. Haka maganar Ubangiji ta kawo mini zagi da reni dukan yini.
english: For as often as I speak, I cry out; I cry, “Violence and destruction!” because Yahweh’s word has been made a reproach to me, and a derision, all day.

hausa: Ai, a tashin matattu, mutane ba za su yi aure ko su ba da aure ba; za su zama kamar mala’iku a sama.
english: For in the resurrection they neither marry nor are given in marriage, but are like God’s angels in heaven.

hausa: Hikima masu la’akari shi ne su yi tunani a kan hanyoyinsu, amma wautar wawaye ruɗu ne.
english: The wisdom of the prudent is to think about his way, but the folly of fools is deceit.

hausa: gama kan Aram shi ne Damaskus, kan Damaskus kuma kawai shi ne Rezin. Cikin shekaru sittin da biyar za a wargaje Efraim har ba za tă iya rayuwa ta zama al’umma ba.
english: For the head of Syria is Damascus, and the head of Damascus is Rezin. Within sixty-five years Ephraim shall be broken in pieces, so that it shall not be a people.

hausa: in ka ga wata kyakkyawar mace wadda ta ɗauki hankalinka a cikin bayin, za ka iya aure ta tă zama matarka.
english: and see among the captives a beautiful woman, and you are attracted to her, and desire to take her as your wife,

hausa: Dukan mutane suka yi mamaki, suna tambayar juna suna cewa, “Mene ne haka? Tabɗi! Yau ga sabuwar koyarwa kuma da iko! Yana ma ba wa mugayen ruhohi umarni, suna kuma yin masa biyayya.”
english: They were all amazed, so that they questioned among themselves, saying, “What is this? What can this new doctrine be? For with authority he commands even the unclean spirits, and they obey him!”

hausa: Kwana bakwai daga yanzu zan aiko da ruwa a duniya yini arba’in da dare arba’in, zan kuma kawar da kowace halitta mai rai da na yi daga doron ƙasa.”
english: In seven days, I will cause it to rain on the earth for forty days and forty nights. I will destroy every living thing that I have made from the surface of the ground.”

hausa: Zuciyata ta yi kuka a kan Mowab; mutanenta sun gudu har zuwa Zowar, har zuwa Eglat Shelishiya. Sun haura zuwa Luhit, suna tafe suna kuka; a kan hanyar zuwa Horonayim suna makoki saboda hallakawarsu.
english: My heart cries out for Moab! Her nobles flee to Zoar, to Eglath Shelishiyah; for they go up by the ascent of Luhith with weeping; for on the way to Horonaim, they raise up a cry of destruction.

hausa: Suna kwantar da shi ke nan domin a yi masa bulala, sai Bulus ya ce wa jarumin da yake tsaye a nan, “Ashe, daidai ne bisa ga doka a yi wa ɗan ƙasar Roma bulala wanda ba a ma tabbatar da laifi a kansa ba?”
english: When they had tied him up with straps, Paul asked the centurion who stood by, “Is it lawful for you to scourge a man who is a Roman, and not found guilty?”

hausa: Mawaƙa zuriyar Asaf, suna a wuraren da Dawuda, Asaf, Heman da Yedutun mai duba na sarki suka tsara. Bai zama lalle matsaran ƙofofi a kowace ƙofa su bar wuraren aikinsu ba, domin ’yan’uwansu Lawiyawa sun yi shiri dominsu.
english: The singers, the sons of Asaph, were in their place, according to the commandment of David, Asaph, Heman, and Jeduthun the king’s seer; and the gatekeepers were at every gate. They didn’t need to depart from their service, because their brothers the Levites prepared for them.

hausa: Sai ya umarta ya ce, “A kama su da rai!” Aka kuwa kama su aka yayyanka kusa da rijiyar Bet-Eked, su arba’in da biyu. Ba a bar wani da rai ba.
english: He said, “Take them alive!” They took them alive, and killed them at the pit of the shearing house, even forty-two men. He didn’t leave any of them.

hausa: “ ‘Tarshish ta yi ciniki da ke saboda yawan wadatar kayayyakinki; sun sayi kayan cinikinki da azurfa, ƙarfe, kuza da dalma.
english: “‘“Tarshish was your merchant by reason of the multitude of all kinds of riches. They traded for your wares with silver, iron, tin, and lead.

hausa: A shirya shi da mai a kwanon tuya, a kawo shi kwaɓaɓɓe sosai, a miƙa shi hadaya ta gari dunƙule-dunƙule don ƙanshi mai daɗi ga Ubangiji.
english: It shall be made with oil in a griddle. When it is soaked, you shall bring it in. You shall offer the meal offering in baked pieces for a pleasant aroma to Yahweh.

hausa: Ni baƙo ne a cikin ’yan’uwana, bare kuma ga ’ya’yan mahaifiyata maza;
english: I have become a stranger to my brothers, an alien to my mother’s children.

hausa: Saboda wannan, sa’ad da ban iya jimrewa ba, sai na aika domin in sami labarin bangaskiyarku, da fata kada yă zama mai jarraban nan ya riga ya jarrabce ku, ƙoƙarinmu kuma yă zama banza.
english: For this cause I also, when I couldn’t stand it any longer, sent that I might know your faith, for fear that by any means the tempter had tempted you, and our labor would have been in vain.

hausa: “Wajen sa’a ta uku, ya fita sai ya ga waɗansu suna tsattsaye a bakin kasuwa ba sa kome.
english: He went out about the third hour, and saw others standing idle in the marketplace.

hausa: Na ja maka kunne sa’ad da kake zama lafiya, amma sai ka ce, ‘Ba zan saurara ba!’ Wannan halinka ne tun kana matashi; ba ka yi mini biyayya ba.
english: I spoke to you in your prosperity, but you said, ‘I will not listen.’ This has been your way from your youth, that you didn’t obey my voice.

hausa: don cutar fatar jiki da take a riga ko a cikin gida,
english: and for the destructive mildew of a garment, and for a house,

hausa: Ya yi kira da babbar murya ya ce, “Ta fāɗi! Babilon Mai Girma ta fāɗi. Ta zama gidan aljanu da kuma wurin zaman kowace irin mugun ruhu, wurin zaman kowane irin tsuntsu marar tsabta da mai banƙyama.
english: He cried with a mighty voice, saying, “Fallen, fallen is Babylon the great, and she has become a habitation of demons, a prison of every unclean spirit, and a prison of every unclean and hated bird!

hausa: Sai sarki ya tashi da daren nan ya ce wa hafsoshinsa, “Na san abin da Arameyawan suke shiri! Sun san game da yunwar da muke ciki a nan, domin haka sun bar sansaninsu suka shiga jeji suka ɓuya, suna nufin sa’ad da muka fita daga birni, sai su kama mu da rai, sa’an nan su shiga birnin.”
english: The king arose in the night, and said to his servants, “I will now show you what the Syrians have done to us. They know that we are hungry. Therefore they have gone out of the camp to hide themselves in the field, saying, ‘When they come out of the city, we shall take them alive, and get into the city.’”

hausa: Ga abin da Ubangiji Maɗaukaki ya ce, “Tsofaffi maza da mata za su sāke zauna a titunan Urushalima, kowanne da sanda a hannu saboda tsufa.
english: Yahweh of Armies says: “Old men and old women will again dwell in the streets of Jerusalem, every man with his staff in his hand because of their old age.

hausa: Ku koma gida ’ya’yana mata; na tsufa ainun da zan sāke samun wani miji. Ko ma na yi tsammani har yanzu ina da bege, ko ma na sami miji a wannan dare na kuma haifi ’ya’ya maza,
english: Go back, my daughters, go your way; for I am too old to have a husband. If I should say, ‘I have hope,’ if I should even have a husband tonight, and should also bear sons,

hausa: Ya kafa ƙa’idodi wa Yaƙub ya kuma kafa doka a cikin Isra’ila, wadda ya umarce kakanni-kakanninmu su koya wa ’ya’yansu,
english: For he established a covenant in Jacob, and appointed a teaching in Israel, which he commanded our fathers, that they should make them known to their children;

hausa: Yayinda bawanka yake zama a Geshur, a Aram, na yi wannan alkawari, na ce, ‘In Ubangiji ya komo da ni Urushalima, zan yi wa Ubangiji sujada a Hebron.’ ”
english: For your servant vowed a vow while I stayed at Geshur in Syria, saying, ‘If Yahweh shall indeed bring me again to Jerusalem, then I will serve Yahweh.’”

hausa: Rehobowam ya zauna a Urushalima ya kuma gina garuruwa don kāriya a cikin Yahuda.
english: Rehoboam lived in Jerusalem, and built cities for defense in Judah.

hausa: Ruwa zai kwararo daga bokitinsu; irinsu za su sami ruwa a yalwace. “Sarkinsu zai fi sarkin Agag; mulkinsu zai ɗaukaka.
english: Water shall flow from his buckets. His seed shall be in many waters. His king shall be higher than Agag. His kingdom shall be exalted.

hausa: Ko ni da Barnabas ne kawai ba mu da ’yanci a ɗauke mana aikin ci da kai?
english: Or have only Barnabas and I no right to not work?

hausa: In ta same shi, sai ta kira ƙawayenta da maƙwabtanta wuri ɗaya, ta ce musu, ‘Ku taya ni murna, na sami kuɗina da ya ɓata.’
english: When she has found it, she calls together her friends and neighbors, saying, ‘Rejoice with me, for I have found the drachma which I had lost!’

hausa: Ina kuma so mata su lura su yi wa kansu adon da ya cancanta, da rigunan da suka dace, ba da adon kitso ko sa kayan zinariya ko lu’ulu’u ko kuma tufafi masu tsada ba,
english: In the same way, that women also adorn themselves in decent clothing, with modesty and propriety, not with braided hair, gold, pearls, or expensive clothing,

hausa: Za ku raba ƙasar kashi bakwai. Mutanen Yahuda za su ci gaba da kasancewa a wurin da suke a kudu, sai kuma mutanen Yusuf a wurin da suke a arewa.
english: They shall divide it into seven portions. Judah shall live in his borders on the south, and the house of Joseph shall live in their borders on the north.

hausa: Zuciyata na bugu, ƙarfina kuma ya ƙare, har ma haske ya rabu da idanuna.
english: My heart throbs. My strength fails me. As for the light of my eyes, it has also left me.

hausa: ya ci biranen katanga na Yahuda har zuwa Urushalima.
english: He took the fortified cities which belonged to Judah, and came to Jerusalem.

hausa: Yayinda suke wuce ta Kwarin Baka, sukan mai da shi wurin maɓulɓulai; ruwan sama na farko kuma kan rufe shi da tafkuna.
english: Passing through the valley of Weeping, they make it a place of springs. Yes, the autumn rain covers it with blessings.
