hausa: kowa na taimakon wani yana ce wa ɗan’uwansa, “Ka ƙarfafa!”
english: Everyone helps his neighbor. They say to their brothers, “Be strong!”

hausa: Ka saurara, akwai surutu a kan duwatsu, sai ka ce na babban taron jama’a! Ka saurara, akwai hayaniya a cikin mulkoki, sai ka ce al’ummai ne suna ta tattaruwa! Ubangiji Maɗaukaki yana shirya mayaƙa don yaƙi.
english: The noise of a multitude is in the mountains, as of a great people; the noise of an uproar of the kingdoms of the nations gathered together! Yahweh of Armies is mustering the army for the battle.

hausa: Na yage mulki daga gidan Dawuda na ba da shi gare ka, amma ba ka zama kamar bawana Dawuda wanda ya kiyaye umarnaina ya kuma bi ni da dukan zuciyarsa, yana yin abin da yake daidai kaɗai a idanuna ba.
english: and tore the kingdom away from David’s house, and gave it to you; and yet you have not been as my servant David, who kept my commandments, and who followed me with all his heart, to do that only which was right in my eyes,

hausa: da yawan tankiya tsakanin mutane masu mugun hali, waɗanda aka raba su da gaskiya, suke kuma tsammani cewa bin Allah wata hanya ce ta samun kuɗi.
english: constant friction of people of corrupt minds and destitute of the truth, who suppose that godliness is a means of gain. Withdraw yourself from such.

hausa: sarkin Madon, ɗaya sarkin Hazor, ɗaya
english: the king of Madon, one; the king of Hazor, one;

hausa: Ubangiji ya ce wa Haruna, “Ba ka da gādo a ƙasarsu, ba kuwa za ka sami rabo daga cikinsu ba; ni ne rabonka da gādonka a cikin Isra’ilawa.
english: Yahweh said to Aaron, “You shall have no inheritance in their land, neither shall you have any portion among them. I am your portion and your inheritance among the children of Israel.

hausa: Sarkin Masar bai sāke fita daga ƙasarsa don yaƙi ba domin sarkin Babilon ya mamaye yankin, daga Rafin Masar har zuwa Kogin Yuferites.
english: The king of Egypt didn’t come out of his land any more; for the king of Babylon had taken, from the brook of Egypt to the river Euphrates, all that belonged to the king of Egypt.

hausa: Dukan kwanakinsa aikinsa damuwa ce da ɓacin zuciya; ko da dare ma hankalinsa ba a kwance yake ba. Wannan ma ba shi da amfani.
english: For all his days are sorrows, and his travail is grief; yes, even in the night his heart takes no rest. This also is vanity.

hausa: Na ɗauka ya kamata ‘shekaru su yi magana; ya kamata yawan shekaru su koyar da hikima.’
english: I said, ‘Days should speak, and multitude of years should teach wisdom.’

hausa: Rezon ya tattara mutane kewaye da shi, ya zama kuma shugaban ’yan tawaye sa’ad da Dawuda ya hallaka mayaƙan Zoba; ’yan tawayen suka tafi Damaskus, inda suka zauna, suka kuma yi mulki.
english: He gathered men to himself, and became captain over a troop, when David killed them of Zobah. They went to Damascus and lived there, and reigned in Damascus.

hausa: Sa’ad da kwanakin ƙawanyarka sun ƙare, sai ka ƙone kashi ɗaya bisa uku na gashin da wuta a cikin birnin. Ka ɗauki kashi ɗaya bisa uku ka yayyanka shi da takobi kewaye da birnin. Ka kuma watsar da kashi ɗaya bisa uku a iska. Gama zan fafare su da takobin da aka zāre.
english: A third part you shall burn in the fire in the middle of the city, when the days of the siege are fulfilled. You shall take a third part, and strike with the sword around it. A third part you shall scatter to the wind, and I will draw out a sword after them.

hausa: Gama duk wanda ya roƙa, yana karɓa, mai nema yana samu, wanda ya ƙwanƙwasa kuma, za a buɗe masa ƙofa.
english: For everyone who asks receives. He who seeks finds. To him who knocks it will be opened.

hausa: Bari Ubangiji ya albarkace ka daga Sihiyona dukan kwanakin ranka; bari ka ga wadatar Urushalima,
english: May Yahweh bless you out of Zion, and may you see the good of Jerusalem all the days of your life.

hausa: Sa’ad da Isra’ila ta yi ƙarfi, sai suka tilasta Kan’aniyawa yin aikin gandu amma ba su kore su gaba ɗaya ba.
english: When Israel had grown strong, they put the Canaanites to forced labor, and didn’t utterly drive them out.

hausa: Bayi, ku yi biyayya ga iyayengijinku na duniya cikin kome; kada ku yi aikin ganin ido kamar masu neman yabon mutane, sai dai ku yi aiki tsakaninku da Allah, kamar masu tsoron Ubangiji.
english: Servants, obey in all things those who are your masters according to the flesh, not just when they are looking, as men pleasers, but in singleness of heart, fearing God.

hausa: Wane ne ya yanka hanyar wucewar ruwa, da kuma hanyar walƙiyar tsawa
english: Who has cut a channel for the flood water, or the path for the thunderstorm,

hausa: sai ya yi shawara da fadawansa da hafsoshin mayaƙansa cewa su datse ruwa daga maɓulɓulan ruwan da yake waje da birnin, suka kuwa taimake shi.
english: he took counsel with his princes and his mighty men to stop the waters of the springs which were outside of the city, and they helped him.

hausa: Zai kuma mamaye Kyakkyawa Ƙasa. Ƙasashe masu yawa za su fāɗi, amma Edom, Mowab da kuma shugabannin Ammon za su kuɓuta daga hannunsa.
english: He will enter also into the glorious land, and many countries will be overthrown; but these will be delivered out of his hand: Edom, Moab, and the chief of the children of Ammon.

hausa: “Ka umarci firistocin da suke ɗauke da akwatin Shaida su fito daga cikin Urdun.”
english: “Command the priests who bear the ark of the covenant, that they come up out of the Jordan.”

hausa: Masanin dokoki ya amsa ya ce, “Wanda ya nuna masa jinƙai.” Yesu ya ce masa, “Je ka, ka yi haka nan.”
english: He said, “He who showed mercy on him.” Then Jesus said to him, “Go and do likewise.”

hausa: Ana girmama mijinta a ƙofar shiga birni inda yakan zauna a cikin dattawan gari.
english: Her husband is respected in the gates, when he sits among the elders of the land.

hausa: Yesu ya yi kira da babbar murya ya ce, “Ya Uba, na danƙa ruhuna a hannunka.” Da ya faɗi haka, sai ya ja numfashi na ƙarshe.
english: Jesus, crying with a loud voice, said, “Father, into your hands I commit my spirit!” Having said this, he breathed his last.

hausa: Allah ya ba Solomon hikima da hangen nesa mai girma, da kuma fāɗin fahimta marar iyaka, kamar yashi a bakin teku.
english: God gave Solomon abundant wisdom, understanding, and breadth of mind like the sand that is on the seashore.

hausa: Ƙauna tana da haƙuri, ƙauna tana da kirki. Ba ta kishi, ba ta burga, ba ta da girman kai.
english: Love is patient and is kind. Love doesn’t envy. Love doesn’t brag, is not proud,

hausa: In kuma wani lokaci na yi shela cewa za a gina wata al’umma ko mulki a kuma kafa ta,
english: At the instant I speak concerning a nation, and concerning a kingdom, to build and to plant it,

hausa: Igiyoyin mutuwa sun nannaɗe ni; tarkuna kuma suka auka mini.
english: The cords of Sheol were around me. The snares of death caught me.

hausa: Yusuf mijinta, da yake shi mai adalci ne, bai so yă ba ta kunya, yă tone mata asiri a fili ba, sai ya yi tunani yă sake ta a ɓoye.
english: Joseph, her husband, being a righteous man, and not willing to make her a public example, intended to put her away secretly.

hausa: Na duba, sai na ga siffa kamar na mutum. Daga kwankwaso zuwa ƙasa ya yi kamar wuta, kuma daga kwankwaso zuwa sama kamanninsa ya yi haske yana ƙyalli kamar ƙarfe mai haske.
english: Then I saw, and behold, a likeness as the appearance of fire—from the appearance of his waist and downward, fire, and from his waist and upward, as the appearance of brightness, as it were glowing metal.

hausa: Sa’ad da suke a kwari kusa da Bet-Feyor, gabas da Urdun, a ƙasar Sihon sarkin Amoriyawa, wanda ya yi mulki a Heshbon, da Musa da Isra’ilawa suka ci da yaƙi sa’ad da suka fito daga Masar.
english: beyond the Jordan, in the valley opposite Beth Peor, in the land of Sihon king of the Amorites, who lived at Heshbon, whom Moses and the children of Israel struck when they came out of Egypt.

hausa: Marmarin da aka cika yana da daɗi ga rai, amma wawa yana ƙyamar juyewa daga mugunta.
english: Longing fulfilled is sweet to the soul, but fools detest turning from evil.

hausa: na huɗun Netanel, na biyar Raddai,
english: Nethanel the fourth, Raddai the fifth,

hausa: Zan ɗauke masarautar daga hannuwan ɗansa ne, in ba ka kabilu goma.
english: but I will take the kingdom out of his son’s hand and will give it to you, even ten tribes.

hausa: Ba zan nuna wa wani sonkai ba, ko kuma in yi wa wani daɗin baki ba;
english: Please don’t let me respect any man’s person, neither will I give flattering titles to any man.

hausa: Kowace rana suka ci gaba da taruwa a filin haikali. Suka gutsuttsura burodi a gidajensu suna cin abinci tare da farin ciki da zuciya ɗaya,
english: Day by day, continuing steadfastly with one accord in the temple, and breaking bread at home, they took their food with gladness and singleness of heart,

hausa: Zai yi ƙarfi ƙwarai da gaske, amma ba da ikonsa ba. Zai jawo mummunar hallakarwa kuma zai yi nasara a duk abin da ya sa gaba. Zai hallakar da majiya ƙarfi da kuma tsarkaka.
english: His power will be mighty, but not by his own power. He will destroy awesomely, and will prosper in what he does. He will destroy the mighty ones and the holy people.

hausa: Da Musa ya kusato sansanin, sai ya ga ɗan maraƙin da kuma mutane suna rawa. Sai fushinsa ya yi ƙuna, ya kuwa jefar da allunan da suke hannuwansa, allunan kuwa suka farfashe a gindin dutsen.
english: As soon as he came near to the camp, he saw the calf and the dancing. Then Moses’ anger grew hot, and he threw the tablets out of his hands, and broke them beneath the mountain.

hausa: Midiyawa, Amalekawa da dukan sauran mutane gabashi suka yi sansani a kwari, kamar fāra. Raƙumansu kuma kamar yashi a bakin teku don sun wuce ƙirge.
english: The Midianites and the Amalekites and all the children of the east lay along in the valley like locusts for multitude; and their camels were without number, as the sand which is on the seashore for multitude.

hausa: gashin raguna za su tanada maka tufafi, za ka iya sayi gonaki masu kyau da kuɗin awaki.
english: The lambs are for your clothing, and the goats are the price of a field.

hausa: gama, “Duk wanda ya kira bisa sunan Ubangiji zai sami ceto.”
english: For, “Whoever will call on the name of the Lord will be saved.”

hausa: ‘Ba nema suke su raba ganima ba, yarinya guda ko biyu wa kowane mutum, riguna masu launi a matsayin ganima don Sisera, riguna masu ado, riguna masu ado sosai don wuyata, dukan wannan a matsayin ganima?’
english: ‘Have they not found, have they not divided the plunder? A lady, two ladies to every man; to Sisera a plunder of dyed garments, a plunder of dyed garments embroidered, of dyed garments embroidered on both sides, on the necks of the plunder?’

hausa: “Ga shi, kamar yadda Ubangiji ya yi alkawari, ya bar ni da rai har na ƙara shekaru arba’in da biyar tun daga lokacin da ya gaya wa Musa wannan, a lokacin da Isra’ilawa suke yawo a cikin jeji. Ga ni nan yau shekaruna tamanin da biyar!
english: “Now, behold, Yahweh has kept me alive, as he spoke, these forty-five years, from the time that Yahweh spoke this word to Moses, while Israel walked in the wilderness. Now, behold, I am eighty-five years old, today.

hausa: Ɗaya daga cikin ’ya’yan Yohiyada maza, ɗan Eliyashib babban firist, surukin Sanballat mutumin Horon ne. Na kuwa kore shi daga wurina.
english: One of the sons of Joiada, the son of Eliashib the high priest, was son-in-law to Sanballat the Horonite; therefore I chased him from me.

hausa: Ka ji kukata ta neman jinƙai yayinda nake kira ka don neman taimako, yayinda nake daga hannuwana wajen Wurinka Mafi Tsarki.
english: Hear the voice of my petitions, when I cry to you, when I lift up my hands toward your Most Holy Place.

hausa: Dawuda ya rera wannan waƙa ga Ubangiji, sa’ad da Ubangiji ya cece shi daga hannun dukan abokan gābansa, da kuma daga hannun Shawulu.
english: David spoke to Yahweh the words of this song in the day that Yahweh delivered him out of the hand of all his enemies, and out of the hand of Saul,

hausa: Sa’ad da sarauniyar Sheba ta ga hikimar Solomon da kuma fadan da ya gina,
english: When the queen of Sheba had seen the wisdom of Solomon, the house that he had built,

hausa: Aka gaya wa mutanen Gaza, “Ai, Samson yana a nan!” Saboda haka suka zo suka kewaye wurin suka yi kwanto dukan dare a bakin ƙofar birni. A daren nan ba su motsa nan da can ba, suna cewa, “Gari yana wayewa za mu kashe shi.”
english: The Gazites were told, “Samson is here!” They surrounded him and laid wait for him all night in the gate of the city, and were quiet all the night, saying, “Wait until morning light; then we will kill him.”

hausa: Amma Doyeg mutumin Edom da yake tsaye tare da fadawan Shawulu ya ce, “Na ga ɗan Yesse ya zo wurin Ahimelek ɗan Ahitub a Nob.
english: Then Doeg the Edomite, who stood by the servants of Saul, answered and said, “I saw the son of Jesse coming to Nob, to Ahimelech the son of Ahitub.

hausa: In ka ƙi ka bari su tafi, gobe zan aiko da fāra a ƙasarka.
english: Or else, if you refuse to let my people go, behold, tomorrow I will bring locusts into your country,

hausa: Tafiyar ta ɗauki kwanaki da yawa muna yi kaɗan-kaɗan da ƙyar muka iso kusa da gaɓar Kinidus. Da iskar ta hana mu ci gaba, sai muka bi ta bayan tsibirin Kirit ɗaura da Salmone.
english: When we had sailed slowly many days, and had come with difficulty opposite Cnidus, the wind not allowing us further, we sailed under the lee of Crete, opposite Salmone.

hausa: Amma da mutanen Gibeyon suka ji abin da Yoshuwa ya yi wa Yeriko da Ai,
english: But when the inhabitants of Gibeon heard what Joshua had done to Jericho and to Ai,

hausa: Da aka gaya wa Dawuda, “Uriya bai tafi gida ba,” sai Dawuda ya tambaye shi ya ce, “Ba ka zo daga wuri mai nisa ba? Me ya sa ba ka je gida ba?”
english: When they had told David, saying, “Uriah didn’t go down to his house,” David said to Uriah, “Haven’t you come from a journey? Why didn’t you go down to your house?”

hausa: “Za su kuma fita su ga gawawwakin mutanen da suka yi mini tayarwa; tsutsotsin da suke cinsu ba za su taɓa mutuwa ba, balle wutar da take ƙona su ta mutu, za su kuma zama abin ƙyama ga dukan mutane.”
english: “They will go out, and look at the dead bodies of the men who have transgressed against me; for their worm will not die, nor will their fire be quenched, and they will be loathsome to all mankind.”

hausa: ta Fashhur 1,247
english: The children of Pashhur, one thousand two hundred forty-seven.

hausa: Saboda haka Allah ya ce wa Nuhu, “Wannan ita ce alamar alkawarin da na kafa tsakanina da dukan masu rai a duniya.”
english: God said to Noah, “This is the token of the covenant which I have established between me and all flesh that is on the earth.”

hausa: Mutumin da matarsa, dukansu biyu tsirara suke, ba su kuwa ji kunya ba.
english: The man and his wife were both naked, and they were not ashamed.

hausa: wanda ya ba da kansa dominmu don yă fanshe mu daga dukan mugunta yă kuma tsarkake wa kansa mutanen da suke nasa, waɗanda suke marmarin yin abin da yake nagari.
english: who gave himself for us, that he might redeem us from all iniquity and purify for himself a people for his own possession, zealous for good works.

hausa: Da ya yi gaba kaɗan, sai ya fāɗi a ƙasa, ya yi addu’a ya ce, “Ubana, in mai yiwuwa ne, a ɗauke mini wannan kwaf. Amma ba nufina ba, sai naka.”
english: He went forward a little, fell on his face, and prayed, saying, “My Father, if it is possible, let this cup pass away from me; nevertheless, not what I desire, but what you desire.”

hausa: Kibiyoyinsu masu tsini ne, an ɗaura dukan bakkunansu; kofatan dawakansu sun yi kamar dutsen ƙanƙara, ƙafafun keken yaƙinsu kamar guguwa ne.
english: whose arrows are sharp, and all their bows bent. Their horses’ hoofs will be like flint, and their wheels like a whirlwind.

hausa: Sai rana ta tsaya cik, wata kuma ya tsaya, har sai da al’ummar ta ɗauki fansa a kan abokan gābanta, kamar yadda aka rubuta a cikin littafin Yashar. Rana ta tsaya a sararin sama, ba tă fāɗi ba har kusan yini guda.
english: The sun stood still, and the moon stayed, until the nation had avenged themselves of their enemies. Isn’t this written in the book of Jashar? The sun stayed in the middle of the sky, and didn’t hurry to go down about a whole day.

hausa: Ku lura fa! Ku zauna a shirye! Don ba ku san lokacin da shi zai zo ba.
english: Watch, keep alert, and pray; for you don’t know when the time is.

hausa: Toma ya ce masa, “Ya Ubangijina da Allahna!”
english: Thomas answered him, “My Lord and my God!”

hausa: Kaitonku masu son ganin ranar Ubangiji! Don me kuke son ganin ranar Ubangiji? Za a duhunta ranan nan, ba haske ba.
english: “Woe to you who desire the day of Yahweh! Why do you long for the day of Yahweh? It is darkness, and not light.

hausa: Bayan Nebukadnezzar ya kwashi Yekoniya ɗan Yehohiyakim sarkin Yahuda da fadawa, da masu sana’a da masu zane zanen Yahuda daga Urushalima zuwa Babilon zaman bauta, Ubangiji ya nuna mini kwanduna biyu na ’ya’yan ɓaure ajiye a gaban haikalin Ubangiji.
english: Yahweh showed me, and behold, two baskets of figs were set before Yahweh’s temple, after Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon had carried away captive Jeconiah the son of Jehoiakim, king of Judah, and the princes of Judah, with the craftsmen and smiths, from Jerusalem, and had brought them to Babylon.

hausa: “Wannan shi ne rubutun da aka yi, Mene, mene, tekel, farsin
english: “This is the writing that was inscribed: ‘MENE, MENE, TEKEL, UPHARSIN.’

hausa: Sun yi ƙungiya tare a kan mai adalci suka yanke wa marar laifi hukuncin mutuwa.
english: They gather themselves together against the soul of the righteous, and condemn the innocent blood.

hausa: ya dawo gida. Sa’an nan zai kira abokansa da maƙwabtansa wuri ɗaya ya ce, ‘Ku taya ni murna, na sami tunkiyana da ta ɓata.’
english: When he comes home, he calls together his friends and his neighbors, saying to them, ‘Rejoice with me, for I have found my sheep which was lost!’

hausa: “Ki ɗaga idanunki ki duba kewaye da ke. Duka sun tattaru suka kuma zo wurinki; ’ya’yanki maza daga nesa, ana kuma ɗaukan ’ya’yanki mata a hannu.
english: “Lift up your eyes all around, and see: they all gather themselves together. They come to you. Your sons will come from far away, and your daughters will be carried in arms.

hausa: Bulus da Barnabas suka naɗa musu dattawa a kowace ikkilisiya, tare da addu’a da azumi, suka miƙa su ga Ubangiji, wanda suka dogara da shi.
english: When they had appointed elders for them in every assembly, and had prayed with fasting, they commended them to the Lord on whom they had believed.

hausa: Sai Musa ya ce wa Haruna, “Ka faɗa wa dukan taron Isra’ila, ‘Ku zo gaban Ubangiji, gama ya ji gunaguninku.’ ”
english: Moses said to Aaron, “Tell all the congregation of the children of Israel, ‘Come close to Yahweh, for he has heard your murmurings.’”

hausa: Sa’an nan sarakunan duniya, hakimai, jarumawa, masu arziki, masu ƙarfi, da kowane bawa da kuma kowane ’yantacce ya ɓoye a cikin koguna da kuma cikin duwatsun tsaunuka.
english: The kings of the earth, the princes, the commanding officers, the rich, the strong, and every slave and free person, hid themselves in the caves and in the rocks of the mountains.

hausa: ’Ya’yan Shela ɗan Yahuda maza su ne, Er mahaifin Leka, La’ada mahaifin Maresha da kuma gidajen masu aikin lilin a Bet-Ashbeya,
english: The sons of Shelah the son of Judah: Er the father of Lecah, Laadah the father of Mareshah, and the families of the house of those who worked fine linen, of the house of Ashbea;

hausa: Abokina ya kai wa abokansa hari; ya tā da alkawarinsa.
english: He raises his hands against his friends. He has violated his covenant.

hausa: Ka rabu da mutanenka, gidan Yaƙub. Sun cika da ayyukan sihiri da aka kawo daga Gabas; suna yin duba kamar Filistiyawa suna tafa hannuwa tare da marasa sanin Allah.
english: For you have forsaken your people, the house of Jacob, because they are filled from the east, with those who practice divination like the Philistines, and they clasp hands with the children of foreigners.

hausa: Sai mutumin ya bi da ni ta hanyar shiga zuwa filin waje, inda na ga ɗakuna talatin da aka gina kewaye a filin waje na filin. An gina waɗannan ɗakunan gefe a jikin bangon waje, a gabansu kuwa akwai daɓe kewaye da filin.
english: Then he brought me into the outer court. Behold, there were rooms and a pavement made for the court all around. Thirty rooms were on the pavement.

hausa: Haka ma mala’ikun da ba su riƙe matsayinsu na iko ba, waɗanda suka bar ainihin mazauninsu, su ne ya tsare a duhu daure da dawwammamun sarƙoƙi don hukunci ta babbar Ranan nan.
english: Angels who didn’t keep their first domain, but deserted their own dwelling place, he has kept in everlasting bonds under darkness for the judgment of the great day.

hausa: Zeba da Zalmunna suka ce masa, “Zo, ka yi da kanka. ‘Yadda mutum yake haka ƙarfinsa.’ ” Ta haka Gideyon ya matso gaba ya kashe su, ya ɗauki kayan ado daga wuyar raƙumansu.
english: Then Zebah and Zalmunna said, “You rise and fall on us; for as the man is, so is his strength.” Gideon arose, and killed Zebah and Zalmunna, and took the crescents that were on their camels’ necks.

hausa: “Duk wanda ya saki matarsa ya auri wata mace, zina ne yake yi. Kuma mutumin da ya auri macen da aka sake, zina ne yake yi.
english: “Everyone who divorces his wife and marries another commits adultery. He who marries one who is divorced from a husband commits adultery.

hausa: A wannan rana Ubangiji zai yi amfani da rezan da aka yi haya daga ƙetaren Kogi, sarkin Assuriya ke nan, yă aske kanku da gashin ƙafafunku, zai kuma aske gemunku.
english: In that day the Lord will shave with a razor that is hired in the parts beyond the River, even with the king of Assyria, the head and the hair of the feet; and it shall also consume the beard.

hausa: sai ya ce, “Kan’ana la’ananne ne, zai zama bawa mafi ƙanƙanta ga ’yan’uwansa.”
english: He said, “Canaan is cursed. He will be a servant of servants to his brothers.”

hausa: Akwai lokaci domin kowane abu, da kuma lokaci domin kowane aiki a duniya.
english: For everything there is a season, and a time for every purpose under heaven:

hausa: “Ci gaba da yin shela, ga abin da Ubangiji Maɗaukaki ya ce, ‘Garuruwana za su sāke kwarara da wadata, Ubangiji kuma zai sāke yi wa Sihiyona ta’aziyya, yă kuma zaɓi Urushalima.’ ”
english: “Proclaim further, saying, ‘Yahweh of Armies says: “My cities will again overflow with prosperity, and Yahweh will again comfort Zion, and will again choose Jerusalem.”’”

hausa: Na yafa adalci ya zama suturata; gaskiya ita ce rigata da rawanina.
english: I put on righteousness, and it clothed me. My justice was as a robe and a diadem.

hausa: “Saboda haka, ka ce wa Isra’ilawa, ‘Ni ne Ubangiji, zan kuma fitar da ku daga bauta ta Masarawa. Zan ’yantar da ku daga zama bayinsu, da ƙarfina zan fanshe ku, in kawo hukunci mai zafi a kansu, don in cece ku.
english: Therefore tell the children of Israel, ‘I am Yahweh, and I will bring you out from under the burdens of the Egyptians, and I will rid you out of their bondage, and I will redeem you with an outstretched arm, and with great judgments.

hausa: Bai faɗa haka bisa nufinsa ba, sai dai a matsayinsa na babban firist a shekarar, ya yi annabci ne cewa Yesu zai mutu saboda ƙasar Yahudawa,
english: Now he didn’t say this of himself, but being high priest that year, he prophesied that Jesus would die for the nation,

hausa: Kwana bakwai za ku miƙa hadaya ga Ubangiji da wuta. A rana ta bakwai ɗin ku yi taro mai tsarki, ba za ku kuwa yi aiki na kullum ba.’ ”
english: But you shall offer an offering made by fire to Yahweh seven days. In the seventh day is a holy convocation. You shall do no regular work.’”

hausa: Eleyasa shi ne mahaifin Sismai, Sismai shi ne mahaifin Shallum
english: and Eleasah became the father of Sismai, and Sismai became the father of Shallum,

hausa: Saboda haka, ku ji abin da Ubangiji ya shirya a kan Edom, abin da ya nufa wa waɗanda suke zama a Teman. Za a ja ƙanana na garken tumaki a tafi; zai hallaka wurin kiwonsu sarai saboda su.
english: Therefore hear the counsel of Yahweh, that he has taken against Edom, and his purposes that he has purposed against the inhabitants of Teman: Surely they will drag them away, the little ones of the flock. Surely he will make their habitation desolate over them.

hausa: Ku ƙyale su, ai, makafin jagorai ne.In makaho ya yi wa makaho jagora, dukansu za su fāɗa a rami.”
english: Leave them alone. They are blind guides of the blind. If the blind guide the blind, both will fall into a pit.”

hausa: Yayinda Belshazar yake shan ruwan inabi, sai ya umarta a kawo zinariya da azurfan da Nebukadnezzar mahaifinsa ya kwaso daga haikali a Urushalima, saboda sarki da hakimansa, da matansa da ƙwarƙwaransa su sha da su.
english: Belshazzar, while he tasted the wine, commanded that the golden and silver vessels which Nebuchadnezzar his father had taken out of the temple which was in Jerusalem be brought to him, that the king and his lords, his wives and his concubines, might drink from them.

hausa: Amma da alamar hayaƙi ya fara murtukewa daga birnin, sai mutanen Benyamin suka juya suka ga hayaƙi yana murtukewa ko’ina a cikin birnin zuwa sararin sama.
english: But when the cloud began to arise up out of the city in a pillar of smoke, the Benjamites looked behind them; and behold, the whole city went up in smoke to the sky.

hausa: Suka amsa, suka ce, “Waɗansu suna cewa, Yohanna Mai Baftisma, waɗansu kuma annabi Iliya, har wa yau waɗansu suna cewa, kai ɗaya daga cikin annabawan da ne, da ya tashi da rai.”
english: They answered, “‘John the Baptizer,’ but others say, ‘Elijah,’ and others, that one of the old prophets has risen again.”

hausa: Amma kai, ya Ubangiji, kana zaune a kursiyinka har abada; sunan da ka yi zai dawwama a dukan zamanai.
english: But you, Yahweh, will remain forever; your renown endures to all generations.

hausa: Firist zai bincike shi, in kuwa farin kumburi a fatar jikin ya juyar da gashin fari in kuma akwai sabon miki a kumburi,
english: and the priest shall examine him. Behold, if there is a white swelling in the skin, and it has turned the hair white, and there is raw flesh in the swelling,

hausa: Sai Ubangiji ya ce, “Yahuda zai tafi. Na riga na ba da ƙasar a hannunsu.”
english: Yahweh said, “Judah shall go up. Behold, I have delivered the land into his hand.”

hausa: Amma fa, game da mutumin da ba ya aiki sai dai dogara ga Allah wanda yake kuɓutar da masu mugunta, akan lissafta bangaskiyarsa a matsayin adalci ne.
english: But to him who doesn’t work, but believes in him who justifies the ungodly, his faith is accounted for righteousness.

hausa: Kada ku kasance da baƙon allah a cikinku; ba za ku rusuna ga baƙon allah ba.
english: There shall be no strange god in you, neither shall you worship any foreign god.

hausa: Kowa ya yi mamaki, ya kuma yabi Allah. Suka cika da tsoro, suna cewa, “Mun ga abubuwan banmamaki yau.”
english: Amazement took hold on all, and they glorified God. They were filled with fear, saying, “We have seen strange things today.”

hausa: Sai Allah ya faɗi waɗannan kalmomi ya ce,
english: God spoke all these words, saying,

hausa: Allah ya haura a cikin sowa ta farin ciki, Ubangiji ya haura a cikin ƙarar ƙahoni.
english: God has gone up with a shout, Yahweh with the sound of a trumpet.

hausa: Bayan wannan, sai Yesu ya yi ta zagawa a cikin Galili, da ganga bai yarda yă je Yahudiya ba domin Yahudawa a can suna nema su kashe shi.
english: After these things, Jesus was walking in Galilee, for he wouldn’t walk in Judea, because the Jews sought to kill him.

hausa: Bayan Yesu ya faɗi haka, sai ya yi juyayi a ruhu, ya kuma furta cewa, “Gaskiya nake gaya muku, ɗayanku zai bashe ni.”
english: When Jesus had said this, he was troubled in spirit, and testified, “Most certainly I tell you that one of you will betray me.”

hausa: a yi tunani cewa mahaifina ya yi yaƙi saboda ku, ya yi kasai da ransa don yă cece ku daga hannun Midiyawa
english: (for my father fought for you, risked his life, and delivered you out of the hand of Midian;

hausa: Ruwa ya mamaye duniya har kwana ɗari da hamsin.
english: The waters flooded the earth one hundred fifty days.

hausa: Yesu ya fita daga majami’ar, ya tafi gidan Siman. Surukar Siman kuwa tana fama da zazzaɓi mai tsanani, sai suka roƙi Yesu yă taimake ta.
english: He rose up from the synagogue and entered into Simon’s house. Simon’s mother-in-law was afflicted with a great fever, and they begged him to help her.

hausa: Suna hana mutane yin aure suna kuma umarce su kada su ci waɗansu irin abinci, waɗanda Allah ya halitta don waɗanda suka gaskata suka kuma san gaskiya, su karɓa da godiya.
english: forbidding marriage and commanding to abstain from foods which God created to be received with thanksgiving by those who believe and know the truth.

hausa: Da abokan tarayyar Hadadezer suka ga Isra’ila sun ci su da yaƙi, sai suka nemi salama da Dawuda suka kuma zama bayinsa. Saboda haka Arameyawa ba su ƙara yarda su taimaki Ammonawa ba.
english: When the servants of Hadadezer saw that they were defeated by Israel, they made peace with David and served him. The Syrians would not help the children of Ammon any more.

hausa: saboda haka zan buɗe ƙofar shiga Mowab, farawa daga garuruwan da suke kan iyaka, Bet-Yeshimot, Ba’al-Meyon da Kiriyatayim, darajar ƙasar.
english: therefore, behold, I will open the side of Moab from the cities, from his cities which are on its frontiers, the glory of the country, Beth Jeshimoth, Baal Meon, and Kiriathaim,

hausa: Sai Sarki Asa ya ba da umarni ga dukan Yahuda, kuma babu wanda aka ware, kowa yă taimaka a kwashe duwatsu da katakan da Ba’asha yake amfani da su daga Rama. Da duwatsu da katakan ne Sarki Asa ya gina Geba a Benyamin da kuma Mizfa.
english: Then King Asa made a proclamation to all Judah. No one was exempted. They carried away the stones of Ramah, and its timber, with which Baasha had built; and King Asa used it to build Geba of Benjamin, and Mizpah.

hausa: Gonar matalauci za tă iya ba da abinci a yalwace, amma rashin adalci kan share shi tas.
english: An abundance of food is in poor people’s fields, but injustice sweeps it away.

hausa: Kamar yadda bawa yakan jira yamma ta yi, ko kuma kamar yadda wanda aka yi hayarsa yakan jira a biya shi kuɗin aikin da ya yi.
english: As a servant who earnestly desires the shadow, as a hireling who looks for his wages,

hausa: sai ɗaukakar Ubangiji ta sauka a kan Dutsen Sinai, kwana shida girgije ya rufe dutsen, a rana ta bakwai, sai Ubangiji ya kira Musa daga cikin girgijen.
english: Yahweh’s glory settled on Mount Sinai, and the cloud covered it six days. The seventh day he called to Moses out of the middle of the cloud.

hausa: Yana da ’ya’ya huɗu ’yan mata da ba su yi aure ba, waɗanda suka yi annabci.
english: Now this man had four virgin daughters who prophesied.

hausa: Ku yi haka don kada a zub da jinin marar laifi a ƙasar da Ubangiji Allahnku yake ba ku gādo, don kada ku kuma zama masu laifin zub da jini.
english: This is so that innocent blood will not be shed in the middle of your land which Yahweh your God gives you for an inheritance, leaving blood guilt on you.

hausa: Bitrus ya yi tambaya ya ce, “Ya Ubangiji, mu ne kake faɗa wa wannan misali, ko kuwa ga kowa da kowa ne?”
english: Peter said to him, “Lord, are you telling this parable to us, or to everybody?”

hausa: Amma Masarawa mutane ne ba Allah ba; dawakansu nama da jini ne ba ruhu ba. Sa’ad da Ubangiji ya miƙa hannunsa, shi da yake taimako zai yi tuntuɓe shi da aka taimaka zai fāɗi; dukansu biyu za su hallaka tare.
english: Now the Egyptians are men, and not God; and their horses flesh, and not spirit. When Yahweh stretches out his hand, both he who helps shall stumble, and he who is helped shall fall, and they all shall be consumed together.

hausa: ’Ya’ya maza da aka haifa wa Hezron su ne, Yerameyel, Ram da Kaleb.
english: The sons also of Hezron, who were born to him: Jerahmeel, Ram, and Chelubai.

hausa: ya fid da rafuffuka daga dutsen da ya tsaga ya sa ruwa ya gudu kamar koguna.
english: He brought streams also out of the rock, and caused waters to run down like rivers.

hausa: Suna mamaye gidajen gwauraye, kuma don burga, suna dogayen addu’o’i. Ga irin waɗannan mutane, za a yi musu hukunci mai tsanani sosai.”
english: who devour widows’ houses, and for a pretense make long prayers. These will receive greater condemnation.”

hausa: Duk da haka an tafi da ita ta kuma tafi bauta. Aka fyaɗa ƙanananta da ƙasa aka yayyanka su gunduwa-gunduwa a kan kowane titi. Aka jefa ƙuri’a a kan manyan mutanenta, aka daure manyan mutanenta da sarƙoƙi.
english: Yet was she carried away. She went into captivity. Her young children also were dashed in pieces at the head of all the streets, and they cast lots for her honorable men, and all her great men were bound in chains.

hausa: Ya kafa duniya a kan tussanta; ba za a iya matsar da ita ba.
english: He laid the foundations of the earth, that it should not be moved forever.

hausa: Wani manzo ya zo wurin Dawuda ya ce masa, “Zukatan mutanen Isra’ila sun koma wajen Absalom.”
english: A messenger came to David, saying, “The hearts of the men of Israel are after Absalom.”

hausa: Ahaz ya ɗauki waɗansu abubuwa daga haikalin Ubangiji da kuma daga fadan sarki da kuma daga sarakuna, ya ba da su ga sarkin Assuriya, amma wannan bai taimake shi ba.
english: For Ahaz took away a portion out of Yahweh’s house, and out of the house of the king and of the princes, and gave it to the king of Assyria; but it didn’t help him.

hausa: A rana ta bakwai, Elishama ɗan Ammihud, shugaban mutanen Efraim, ya kawo hadayarsa.
english: On the seventh day Elishama the son of Ammihud, prince of the children of Ephraim,

hausa: Idanunsa sun yi kamar na kurciyoyin da suke kusa da ruwan rafi, da aka wanke da madara aka kuma kafa kamar kayan ado masu daraja.
english: His eyes are like doves beside the water brooks, washed with milk, mounted like jewels.

hausa: Ka tuna da su, ya Allahna, domin sun ƙazantar da aikin firist da kuma alkawarin aikin firist da na Lawiyawa.
english: Remember them, my God, because they have defiled the priesthood and the covenant of the priesthood and of the Levites.

hausa: “Manasse, sarkin Yahuda ya aikata waɗannan ƙazantattun zunubai. Ya aikata mugunta fiye da ta Amoriyawan da suka riga shi, ya kuma sa Yahuda ta bauɗe ta wurin yin zunubi saboda gumakansa.
english: “Because Manasseh king of Judah has done these abominations, and has done wickedly above all that the Amorites did, who were before him, and has also made Judah to sin with his idols;

hausa: “Ni kaɗai ne na ta’azantar da ku. Wane ne ku da kuke tsoron mutane masu mutuwa, ’ya’yan mutane waɗanda suke ciyawa ne kawai,
english: “I, even I, am he who comforts you. Who are you, that you are afraid of man who shall die, and of the son of man who will be made as grass?

hausa: Sa’ad da ya yi girma, sai ta kawo shi wajen ’yar Fir’auna, ya kuwa zama ɗanta, ta kuma ba shi suna Musa, tana cewa, “Na tsamo shi daga ruwa.”
english: The child grew, and she brought him to Pharaoh’s daughter, and he became her son. She named him Moses, and said, “Because I drew him out of the water.”

hausa: Yesu ya kira su ya ce musu, “Kun sani waɗanda aka san su da mulkin al’ummai sukan nuna musu iko, hakimansu ma sukan gasa musu iko.
english: Jesus summoned them and said to them, “You know that they who are recognized as rulers over the nations lord it over them, and their great ones exercise authority over them.

hausa: kuma kwanaki da yawa waɗanda suka yi tafiya tare da shi daga Galili zuwa Urushalima suka gan shi. Su ne yanzu shaidu ga mutanenmu.
english: and he was seen for many days by those who came up with him from Galilee to Jerusalem, who are his witnesses to the people.

hausa: Sun kusa gama da ni a duniya, amma ban bar bin farillanka ba.
english: They had almost wiped me from the earth, but I didn’t forsake your precepts.

hausa: Ka fafare su cikin fushi ka hallaka su daga cikin duniya ta Ubangiji.
english: You will pursue them in anger, and destroy them from under the heavens of Yahweh.

hausa: Ko gado ne, ko kuwa wani abin da ta zauna a kai, sa’ad da wani ya taɓa shi, zai ƙazantu har yamma.
english: If it is on the bed, or on anything she sits on, when he touches it, he shall be unclean until the evening.

hausa: sai a ɗauki namijin, ko ta mace wanda ya aikata wannan mugun abu zuwa ƙofar birni, a jajjefe wannan mutum sai ya mutu.
english: then you shall bring out that man or that woman who has done this evil thing to your gates, even that same man or woman; and you shall stone them to death with stones.

hausa: Mutum da ba shi da azanci kan ki maƙwabci, amma mutum mai fahimi kan ƙame harshensa.
english: One who despises his neighbor is void of wisdom, but a man of understanding holds his peace.

hausa: Mala’ikan Ubangiji ya bayyana gare ta ya ce, “Ga shi ke bakararriya ce ba kya haihuwa, amma za ki yi ciki ki kuma haifi ɗa.
english: Yahweh’s angel appeared to the woman, and said to her, “See now, you are barren and childless; but you shall conceive and bear a son.

hausa: Da waɗansu kalmomi masu yawa ya gargaɗe su; ya kuma roƙe su cewa, “Ku ceci kanku daga wannan lalataccen zamani.”
english: With many other words he testified and exhorted them, saying, “Save yourselves from this crooked generation!”

hausa: Wuyanki ya yi kamar hasumiyar Dawuda, da aka gina da daraja; a kansa an rataye garkuwoyi dubu, dukansu garkuwoyin jarumawa ne.
english: Your neck is like David’s tower built for an armory, on which a thousand shields hang, all the shields of the mighty men.

hausa: Sai wani mutum mai suna Yayirus, wani mai mulkin majami’a, ya zo ya fāɗi a gaban Yesu, yana roƙonsa ya zo gidansa,
english: Behold, a man named Jairus came. He was a ruler of the synagogue. He fell down at Jesus’ feet and begged him to come into his house,

hausa: Yowab ɗan Zeruhiya ya fara ƙirgan mutanen amma bai gama ba. Hasala ta sauko a kan Isra’ila saboda wannan ƙirge, ba a kuma shigar da adadin a littafin tarihin Sarki Dawuda ba.
english: Joab the son of Zeruiah began to take a census, but didn’t finish; and wrath came on Israel for this. The number wasn’t put into the account in the chronicles of King David.

hausa: “Masu albarka ne waɗanda aka gafarta laifofinsu, waɗanda aka kuma rufe zunubansu.
english: “Blessed are they whose iniquities are forgiven, whose sins are covered.

hausa: Sa’ad da suka aikata duk abin da aka rubuta game da shi, sai suka saukar da shi daga itacen suka kuma sa shi a kabari.
english: When they had fulfilled all things that were written about him, they took him down from the tree and laid him in a tomb.

hausa: ta goma sha huɗu a kan Mattitiya, ’ya’yansa maza da danginsa, 12
english: for the fourteenth, Mattithiah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

hausa: “Malaman dokoki da Farisiyawa suke zama a kujerar Musa.
english: saying, “The scribes and the Pharisees sit on Moses’ seat.

hausa: Sarki ya sa aka yi zubinsu a katakon yin tubali a filin Urdun tsakanin Sukkot da Zereda.
english: The king cast them in the plain of the Jordan, in the clay ground between Succoth and Zeredah.

hausa: Suka tashi daga Hashmona, suka yi sansani a Moserot.
english: They traveled from Hashmonah, and encamped in Moseroth.

hausa: Ka yi sandunan nan da itacen ƙirya, ka dalaye su da zinariya.
english: You shall make the poles of acacia wood, and overlay them with gold.

hausa: da ƙaramin bijimi guda ɗaya, tunkiya ɗaya, da rago, dukansu bana ɗaya-ɗaya domin hadaya ta ƙonawa;
english: one young bull, one ram, one male lamb a year old, for a burnt offering;

hausa: Bazlut, Mehida, Harsha,
english: the children of Bazluth, the children of Mehida, the children of Harsha,

hausa: Sai mutanen garin suka kama hanyar Urdun don su nemi ’yan leƙen asirin, daga fitar su sai aka rufe ƙofar garin.
english: The men pursued them along the way to the fords of the Jordan River. As soon as those who pursued them had gone out, they shut the gate.

hausa: Kuma bayan da aka yi wa al’ummar kaciya dukansu, sai suka dakata a nan, sai da suka warke.
english: When they were done circumcising the whole nation, they stayed in their places in the camp until they were healed.

hausa: Yabe shi, rana da wata, yabe shi, dukanku taurari masu haskakawa.
english: Praise him, sun and moon! Praise him, all you shining stars!

hausa: Bari hannunka yă zauna a kan mutumin da yake hannun damarka, ɗan mutum da ka renar wa kanka.
english: Let your hand be on the man of your right hand, on the son of man whom you made strong for yourself.

hausa: Amma kashegari da safe sai Allah ya sa tsutsa ta cinye ’yar kuringar har ta mutu.
english: But God prepared a worm at dawn the next day, and it chewed on the vine so that it withered.

hausa: Yaƙub mahaifinsu, ya ce musu, “Kun sa ni rashin ’ya’yana. Yusuf ya rasu, Simeyon kuma ba ya nan, yanzu kuma kuna so ku ɗauki Benyamin. Kome yana gāba da ni!”
english: Jacob, their father, said to them, “You have bereaved me of my children! Joseph is no more, Simeon is no more, and you want to take Benjamin away. All these things are against me.”

hausa: “Ku juyo gare ni ku sami ceto, dukanku iyakokin duniya; gama ni ne Allah, kuma babu wani.
english: “Look to me, and be saved, all the ends of the earth; for I am God, and there is no other.

hausa: Amma za a jefar da ’ya’yan mulki waje, zuwa cikin baƙin duhu, inda za a yi kuka da cizon haƙora.”
english: but the children of the Kingdom will be thrown out into the outer darkness. There will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.”

hausa: Yesu ya yi tambaya, “Wa ya taɓa ni?” Bayan kowa ya yi musu, sai Bitrus ya ce, “Ubangiji, ai, mutane da yawa suna matsinka ta kowane gefe.”
english: Jesus said, “Who touched me?” When all denied it, Peter and those with him said, “Master, the multitudes press and jostle you, and you say, ‘Who touched me?’”

hausa: Akwai ɗumbun shugabanni a cikin zuriyar Eleyazar fiye da zuriyar Itamar, aka kuma karkasa su haka, kawuna goma sha shida daga zuriyar Eleyazar da kuma kawuna iyalai takwas daga zuriyar Itamar.
english: There were more chief men found of the sons of Eleazar than of the sons of Ithamar; and they were divided like this: of the sons of Eleazar there were sixteen, heads of fathers’ houses; and of the sons of Ithamar, according to their fathers’ houses, eight.

hausa: Hanyarka ta bi ta cikin teku, hanyarka ta bi cikin manyan ruwaye, duk da haka ba a ga sawunka ba.
english: Your way was through the sea, your paths through the great waters. Your footsteps were not known.

hausa: A can ya kafa bagade ya kuma kira shi El Elohe Isra’ila.
english: He erected an altar there, and called it El Elohe Israel.

hausa: Dawuda ya bar Asaf da ’yan’uwansa a gaban akwatin alkawarin Ubangiji don su yi hidima a can kullum, bisa ga tsari na kowace rana.
english: So he left Asaph and his brothers there before the ark of Yahweh’s covenant, to minister before the ark continually, as every day’s work required;

hausa: Sai suka juya suka haura kan hanya ta zuwa Bashan, inda Og yake sarauta, ya kuwa fito tare da dukan sojojinsa suka yi yaƙi da Isra’ila a Edireyi.
english: They turned and went up by the way of Bashan. Og the king of Bashan went out against them, he and all his people, to battle at Edrei.

hausa: Masu adalci sun damu game da adalci don talakawa, amma mugaye ba su da wannan damuwa.
english: The righteous care about justice for the poor. The wicked aren’t concerned about knowledge.

hausa: “Amon kakaki a Gibeya, ƙaho a Rama. Ku yi kirarin yaƙi a Bet-Awen; ku ja gaba, ya Benyamin.
english: “Blow the cornet in Gibeah, and the trumpet in Ramah! Sound a battle cry at Beth Aven, behind you, Benjamin!

hausa: Ya mai da hamada ya zama tafkunan ruwa busasshiyar ƙasa kuma zuwa maɓulɓulai masu gudu;
english: He turns a desert into a pool of water, and a dry land into water springs.

hausa: Amma ka umarci Yoshuwa, ka ƙarfafa shi, ka kuma ba shi ƙarfin gwiwa, gama shi ne zai jagoranci wannan mutane su haye, yă kuma ba su gādon ƙasar da za ka gani.”
english: But commission Joshua, and encourage him, and strengthen him; for he shall go over before this people, and he shall cause them to inherit the land which you shall see.”

hausa: sarkin Yarmut, ɗaya sarkin Lakish, ɗaya
english: the king of Jarmuth, one; the king of Lachish, one;

hausa: Jarumin sojan ya ji labarin Yesu, sai ya aiki waɗansu dattawan Yahudawa wajensa, yana roƙonsa yă zo yă warkar da bawansa.
english: When he heard about Jesus, he sent to him elders of the Jews, asking him to come and save his servant.

hausa: Kada wani abu yă haɗa ka da gardandamin banza da wofi, domin ka san yadda suke jawo faɗa.
english: But refuse foolish and ignorant questionings, knowing that they generate strife.

hausa: Yanzu, Ubangiji, ka dubi barazanansu ka kuma sa bayinka su furta maganarka da iyakar ƙarfin hali.
english: Now, Lord, look at their threats, and grant to your servants to speak your word with all boldness,

hausa: Bitrus ya ce, “Sam, Ubangiji! Ban taɓa cin wani abu marar tsarki ko marar tsabta ba.”
english: But Peter said, “Not so, Lord; for I have never eaten anything that is common or unclean.”

hausa: Zan tanada musu ƙasar da aka sani don hatsinta, ba za su kuma ƙara zama abin da yunwa za tă fara musu a ƙasa ba ko su sha zargin sauran al’ummai.
english: I will raise up to them a plantation for renown, and they will no more be consumed with famine in the land, and not bear the shame of the nations any more.

hausa: Amma da alheri da kuma ƙaunar Allah Mai Cetonmu suka bayyana,
english: But when the kindness of God our Savior and his love toward mankind appeared,

hausa: Ubangiji ya hallakar da wurin zaman Yaƙub ba tausayi; A cikin fushinsa kuma zai rurrushe kagaran Diyar Yahuda. Ya ƙasƙantar da mulki da masu mulki.
english: The Lord has swallowed up all the dwellings of Jacob without pity. He has thrown down in his wrath the strongholds of the daughter of Judah. He has brought them down to the ground. He has profaned the kingdom and its princes.

hausa: Ko da yake suna shirya maka mugunta suna kuma ƙirƙiro mugayen dabaru, ba za su yi nasara ba;
english: For they intended evil against you. They plotted evil against you which cannot succeed.

hausa: Malaman dokoki da manyan firistoci, suka nemi hanyar kama shi nan da nan, domin sun san cewa, ya yi wannan misali a kansu ne, amma suna jin tsoron mutane.
english: The chief priests and the scribes sought to lay hands on him that very hour, but they feared the people—for they knew he had spoken this parable against them.

hausa: Da ta faɗin haka, sai ta juya ta ga Yesu tsaye, sai dai ba tă gane cewa Yesu ne ba.
english: When she had said this, she turned around and saw Jesus standing, and didn’t know that it was Jesus.

hausa: Sai Ubangiji ya ƙyale shi. (A lokacin ta ce “angon jini,” tana nufin kaciya.)
english: So he let him alone. Then she said, “You are a bridegroom of blood,” because of the circumcision.

hausa: A wajen gabas can ƙarshe, wajen fitowar rana, fāɗin filin zai zama kamu hamsin.
english: The width of the court on the east side eastward shall be fifty cubits.

hausa: Ku haɗa kai da waɗansu cikin bin gurbina, ku kuma lura da waɗanda suke rayuwa bisa ga ƙa’idar da muka ba ku.
english: Brothers, be imitators together of me, and note those who walk this way, even as you have us for an example.

hausa: Ana nan sai Hannatu ta yi ciki, ta kuma haifi ɗa. Ta ba shi suna Sama’ila; tana cewa, “Domin na roƙe shi daga wurin Ubangiji.”
english: When the time had come, Hannah conceived, and bore a son; and she named him Samuel, saying, “Because I have asked him of Yahweh.”

hausa: Tun da yake mukan yarda da shaida mutane, ai, shaidar Allah ta fi ƙarfi. Wannan ita ce shaidar Allah, wato, ya shaidi Ɗansa.
english: If we receive the witness of men, the witness of God is greater; for this is God’s testimony which he has testified concerning his Son.

hausa: Sa’ad da girgijen ya ci gaba da kasancewa a bisan tabanakul na dogon lokaci, Isra’ilawa sukan bi umarnin Ubangiji, ba kuwa za su tashi ba.
english: When the cloud stayed on the tabernacle many days, then the children of Israel kept Yahweh’s command, and didn’t travel.

hausa: Da Towu sarkin Hamat ya ji cewa Dawuda ya ci dukan rundunar Hadadezer,
english: When Toi king of Hamath heard that David had struck all the army of Hadadezer,

hausa: Elishama, Eliyada da Elifelet.
english: Elishama, Eliada, and Eliphelet.

hausa: Waɗanda suka rage a Sihiyona, waɗanda suka rage a Urushalima, za a ce da su masu tsarki, wato, dukan waɗanda aka rubuta a cikin masu rai a Urushalima.
english: It will happen that he who is left in Zion and he who remains in Jerusalem shall be called holy, even everyone who is written among the living in Jerusalem,

hausa: Sa’ad da Arameyawa suka janye, suka bar Yowash da mummunan rauni. Hafsoshinsa suka haɗa baki a kansa saboda kisan ɗan Yehohiyada firist da ya yi, suka kashe shi a kan gadonsa. Ta haka ya mutu aka kuma binne shi makabartan sarakuna.
english: When they had departed from him (for they left him seriously wounded), his own servants conspired against him for the blood of the sons of Jehoiada the priest, and killed him on his bed, and he died. They buried him in David’s city, but they didn’t bury him in the tombs of the kings.

hausa: Da yake wawa yakan kawo baƙin ciki ga mahaifinsa da ɓacin rai ga wanda ya haife shi.
english: A foolish son brings grief to his father, and bitterness to her who bore him.

hausa: in wannan al’ummar da na yi wa gargaɗi ta tuba daga muguntarta, sai in janye in kuma fasa kawo mata masifar da na yi niyya aukar mata.
english: if that nation, concerning which I have spoken, turns from their evil, I will repent of the evil that I thought to do to them.

hausa: Da ma’aikatan Shawulu suka gaya masa abin da Dawuda ya faɗa.
english: The servants of Saul told him, saying, “David spoke like this.”

hausa: Balak ya yi yadda Bala’am ya ce, ya kuwa miƙa bijimi da rago a kan kowane bagade.
english: Balak did as Balaam had said, and offered up a bull and a ram on every altar.

hausa: Ubangiji Allahnku zai sa dukan waɗannan la’anoni a kan abokan gābanku waɗanda suke ƙinku, suke kuma tsananta muku.
english: Yahweh your God will put all these curses on your enemies and on those who hate you, who persecuted you.

hausa: Saboda dukan gumakan banƙyamarki, zan yi abin da ban taɓa yi ba, ba kuwa zan ƙara yinsa ba.
english: I will do in you that which I have not done, and which I will not do anything like it any more, because of all your abominations.

hausa: Dukan shekarun da muka yi a tafiyarmu daga Kadesh Barneya zuwa lokacin da muka ƙetare Kwarin Zered, sun kai shekaru talatin da takwas. A lokacin, wannan tsara gaba ɗaya ta mutanen da suka isa yaƙi sun mutu daga sansani, yadda Ubangiji ya rantse musu.
english: The days in which we came from Kadesh Barnea until we had come over the brook Zered were thirty-eight years, until all the generation of the men of war were consumed from the middle of the camp, as Yahweh swore to them.

hausa: Ayari sukan bar hanyarsu; sukan yi ta neman wurin da za su sami ruwa, su kāsa samu har su mutu.
english: The caravans that travel beside them turn away. They go up into the waste, and perish.

hausa: Mu da muke da ƙarfi ya kamata mu yi haƙuri da kāsawar marasa ƙarfi ba kawai mu gamshi kanmu ba.
english: Now we who are strong ought to bear the weaknesses of the weak, and not to please ourselves.

hausa: Ka ba mu kowace rana abincin yini.
english: Give us day by day our daily bread.

hausa: Ga abin da za ku ce wa Yusuf, ‘Na roƙe ka, ka gafarta wa ’yan’uwanka zunubai da laifofin da suka aikata na abubuwa marasa kyau da suka yi maka.’ Yanzu muna roƙonka ka gafarta zunuban bayin Allah na mahaifinka.” Sa’ad da saƙonsu ya zo masa, sai Yusuf ya yi kuka.
english: ‘You shall tell Joseph, “Now please forgive the disobedience of your brothers, and their sin, because they did evil to you.”’ Now, please forgive the disobedience of the servants of the God of your father.” Joseph wept when they spoke to him.

hausa: Da shi wanda yake tsarkake mutane da kuma su waɗanda ake tsarkakewa duk ’yan iyali ɗaya ne. Saboda haka Yesu ba ya kunyan kiransu ’yan’uwansa.
english: For both he who sanctifies and those who are sanctified are all from one, for which cause he is not ashamed to call them brothers,

hausa: Mai rowa yana alla-alla ya yi arziki bai san cewa talauci ne ke jiransa ba.
english: A stingy man hurries after riches, and doesn’t know that poverty waits for him.

hausa: A waɗancan kwanaki akwai hatsari a yin tafiye-tafiye, gama dukan mazaunan ƙasashe suna cikin babbar damuwa.
english: In those times there was no peace to him who went out, nor to him who came in; but great troubles were on all the inhabitants of the lands.

hausa: “Ga abin da Ubangiji yana cewa, “ ‘Zan mayar da wadatar tentin Yaƙub in kuma ji tausayin wuraren zamansa; za a sāke gina birnin a kufansa, fadar kuwa za tă tsaya a wurin da ya dace da ita.
english: Yahweh says: “Behold, I will reverse the captivity of Jacob’s tents, and have compassion on his dwelling places. The city will be built on its own hill, and the palace will be inhabited in its own place.

hausa: Ƙaunar Allah ita ce, a yi biyayya da umarnansa. Umarnansa kuwa ba masu nauyi ba ne;
english: For this is loving God, that we keep his commandments. His commandments are not grievous.

hausa: “ ‘In wani memba a cikin jama’a ya yi zunubi ba da gangan ba, ya aikata ɗaya daga cikin abubuwan da Ubangiji ya umarta kada a yi, to, ya yi laifi.
english: “‘If anyone of the common people sins unwittingly, in doing any of the things which Yahweh has commanded not to be done, and is guilty,

hausa: “Mulki na Allah ne, dole a ji tsoronsa; yana tafiyar da kome yadda ya kamata a cikin sama.
english: “Dominion and fear are with him. He makes peace in his high places.

hausa: Matalauta za su kasance tare da ku kullum, amma ni ba zan kasance tare da ku kullum ba.
english: For you always have the poor with you, but you don’t always have me.

hausa: “Da kawai za a iya auna wahalata a kuma sa ɓacin raina a ma’auni!
english: “Oh that my anguish were weighed, and all my calamity laid in the balances!

hausa: Ka yi kerubobi biyu, ɗaya a wannan gefe, ɗaya kuma a ɗayan gefen; za ka manne su a kan murfin, su zama abu ɗaya.
english: Make one cherub at the one end, and one cherub at the other end. You shall make the cherubim on its two ends of one piece with the mercy seat.

hausa: Ya zama firist ne ba saboda ya cika wata ƙa’ida ta zama zuriyar Lawi ba, sai dai bisa ga ikon ran da ba a iya hallakawa.
english: who has been made, not after the law of a fleshly commandment, but after the power of an endless life;

hausa: Gardama ta tashi a tsakaninsu, a kan ko wane ne a cikinsu ya fi girma.
english: A dispute also arose among them, which of them was considered to be greatest.

hausa: Na tuɓe rigata, sai in sāke sa ta kuma? Na wanke ƙafafuna, sai in sāke ɓata su?
english: I have taken off my robe. Indeed, must I put it on? I have washed my feet. Indeed, must I soil them?

hausa: Dole ku bambanta tsakanin haramtacce da halaltacce, tsakanin halittu masu ran da za a iya ci da waɗanda ba za a iya ci ba.’ ”
english: to make a distinction between the unclean and the clean, and between the living thing that may be eaten and the living thing that may not be eaten.’”

hausa: Ranar Ubangiji tana zuwa sa’ad da za a raba muku ganimar da aka washe daga gare ku.
english: Behold, a day of Yahweh comes, when your plunder will be divided within you.

hausa: dukan shanu da tumaki, da kuma namun jeji,
english: All sheep and cattle, yes, and the animals of the field,

hausa: Saboda haka ina gaya muku, za a gafarta wa mutane kowane zunubi da kuma saɓo, amma saɓo game da Ruhu, ba za a gafarta ba.
english: Therefore I tell you, every sin and blasphemy will be forgiven men, but the blasphemy against the Spirit will not be forgiven men.

hausa: Amma yakan ba mu alheri a yalwace. Shi ya sa Nassi ya ce, “Allah yana gāba da masu girman kai amma yakan ba da alheri ga masu tawali’u.”
english: But he gives more grace. Therefore it says, “God resists the proud, but gives grace to the humble.”

hausa: Saboda haka Yesse ya ɗauki jaki tare da burodi da ruwan inabi da ɗan ƙarami bunsuru ya ba wa ɗansa Dawuda yă kai wa Shawulu.
english: Jesse took a donkey loaded with bread, a container of wine, and a young goat, and sent them by David his son to Saul.

hausa: Taurarin sama da ƙungiyoyinsu ba za su ba da haskensu ba. Rana za tă yi duhu wata kuma ba zai ba da haskensa ba.
english: For the stars of the sky and its constellations will not give their light. The sun will be darkened in its going out, and the moon will not cause its light to shine.

hausa: Kaiton waɗanda suke ce da mugunta nagarta nagarta kuma mugunta, waɗanda suke mai da duhu haske haske kuma duhu, waɗanda suke mai da ɗaci zaƙi zaƙi kuma ɗaci.
english: Woe to those who call evil good, and good evil; who put darkness for light, and light for darkness; who put bitter for sweet, and sweet for bitter!

hausa: amma Isra’ilawa sun riɓaɓɓanya, suka kuma yi ta haihuwa sosai, suka yi yawan sosai, har ƙasar ta cika da su.
english: The children of Israel were fruitful, and increased abundantly, and multiplied, and grew exceedingly mighty; and the land was filled with them.

hausa: Kada kuma ka yanke alherinka ga iyalina ko da Ubangiji ya hallaka dukan maƙiyin Dawuda a duniya.”
english: but you shall also not cut off your kindness from my house forever, no, not when Yahweh has cut off every one of the enemies of David from the surface of the earth.”

hausa: Matan suka ƙara da cewa, “Sa’ad da muka ƙone turare ga Sarauniyar Sama muka kuma miƙa mata hadayun sha, mazanmu ba su san muna yin waina kamar siffarta muna kuma miƙa mata hadayun sha ba?”
english: The women said, “When we burned incense to the queen of the sky and poured out drink offerings to her, did we make her cakes to worship her, and pour out drink offerings to her, without our husbands?”

hausa: Ubangiji ya ce wa Musa,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

hausa: Zan yi kuka saboda kai, yadda Yazer ya yi kuka Ya kuringar Sibma. Rassanki sun kai har teku; sun kai har tekun Yazer. Mai hallakarwa ya fāɗo a kan ’ya’yan itatuwanku da kuma inabinku da suka nuna.
english: With more than the weeping of Jazer I will weep for you, vine of Sibmah. Your branches passed over the sea. They reached even to the sea of Jazer. The destroyer has fallen on your summer fruits and on your vintage.

hausa: Yin abin da yake daidai da kuma nagari Ubangiji ya fi yarda da shi fiye da hadaya.
english: To do righteousness and justice is more acceptable to Yahweh than sacrifice.

hausa: Ta ce wa mijinta, “Na san cewa wannan mutum da kullum yake zuwa nan mai tsarki ne na Allah.
english: She said to her husband, “See now, I perceive that this is a holy man of God who passes by us continually.

hausa: Na kasance marar laifi a gabansa na kuma kiyaye kaina daga zunubi.
english: I was also blameless with him. I kept myself from my iniquity.

hausa: Gama ni ne Ubangiji Allahnku, wanda ya dama teku domin raƙumansa su yi ruri, Ubangiji Maɗaukaki ne sunansa.
english: For I am Yahweh your God, who stirs up the sea so that its waves roar. Yahweh of Armies is his name.

hausa: Ka yi fariya a kaina, ka kuma yi magana a kaina ba gaggautawa, na ji shi sarai.
english: You have magnified yourselves against me with your mouth, and have multiplied your words against me. I have heard it.”

hausa: Tabbatacce, game da Sihiyona za a ce, “Wannan da wancan an haifa a cikinta, Mafi Ɗaukaka kansa zai kafa ta.”
english: Yes, of Zion it will be said, “This one and that one was born in her;” the Most High himself will establish her.

hausa: Amma mutumin da yake da aure yakan damu ne da al’amuran wannan duniya, yadda zai gamshi matarsa
english: but he who is married is concerned about the things of the world, how he may please his wife.

hausa: A kan sandan Lawi kuwa ka rubuta sunan Haruna, gama dole a sami sanda ɗaya saboda shugaban gidan kakanninsu.
english: You shall write Aaron’s name on Levi’s rod. There shall be one rod for each head of their fathers’ houses.

hausa: Suna kama da zaki mai yunwan abinci, kamar babban zaki mai fako a maɓuya.
english: He is like a lion that is greedy of his prey, as it were a young lion lurking in secret places.

hausa: Kamar Adamu, sun tā da alkawari, sun yi mini rashin aminci a can.
english: But they, like Adam, have broken the covenant. They were unfaithful to me there.

hausa: Ubangiji yă zama tare da ruhunka. Alheri yă zama tare da ku.
english: The Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit. Grace be with you. Amen.

hausa: Haka yake da wanda ya kwana da matar wani; babu wanda ya taɓa ta da zai tafi babu hukunci.
english: So is he who goes in to his neighbor’s wife. Whoever touches her will not be unpunished.

hausa: Ashe, wahaloli dabam-dabam da kuka sha sun zama a banza ke nan? Haka zai yiwu kuwa?
english: Did you suffer so many things in vain, if it is indeed in vain?

hausa: Waɗannan duka an yabe su saboda bangaskiyarsu, duk da haka babu waninsu da ya sami abin da aka yi alkawari.
english: These all, having been commended for their faith, didn’t receive the promise,

hausa: Duk lokacin da ya yaƙi wani wuri, ba ya barin namiji ko mace da rai, amma sai ya kwashe tumaki, da shanu, da jakuna, da raƙuma, da riguna, sa’an nan yă koma wurin Akish.
english: David struck the land, and saved no man or woman alive, and took away the sheep, the cattle, the donkeys, the camels, and the clothing. Then he returned, and came to Achish.

hausa: ko busar ƙaho, ko ga irin wata murya mai magana da kalmomin da masu jinta suka yi roƙo kada su ƙara ji,
english: the sound of a trumpet, and the voice of words; which those who heard it begged that not one more word should be spoken to them,

hausa: Yesu ya ce, “Ai, da ku makafi ne ma, da ba ku da zunubi, amma da yake kun ce, kuna gani, zunubanku suna nan daram.
english: Jesus said to them, “If you were blind, you would have no sin; but now you say, ‘We see.’ Therefore your sin remains.

hausa: Kana ƙirga watanni nawa suke yi kafin su haihu? Ka san lokacin da suke haihuwa?
english: Can you count the months that they fulfill? Or do you know the time when they give birth?

hausa: Wace riba ce ma’aikaci yake da ita saboda wahalarsa?
english: What profit has he who works in that in which he labors?

hausa: Kamar yadda jikin da babu ruhu matacce ne, haka ma bangaskiyar da babu ayyuka matacciya ce.
english: For as the body apart from the spirit is dead, even so faith apart from works is dead.

hausa: Je garke ka kawo mini awaki biyu kyawawa, domin in shirya abinci mai daɗi wa mahaifinka, kamar yadda dai yake so.
english: Go now to the flock and get me two good young goats from there. I will make them savory food for your father, such as he loves.

hausa: Wannan magana tabbatacciya ce, ina kuma so ka nanata waɗannan abubuwa ƙwarai, domin waɗanda suka dogara ga Allah su himmantu ga aiki mai kyau. Waɗannan abubuwa suna da kyau sosai suna kuma da amfani ga kowane mutum.
english: This saying is faithful, and concerning these things I desire that you insist confidently, so that those who have believed God may be careful to maintain good works. These things are good and profitable to men;

hausa: Da mala’ikan Ubangiji ya faɗa wa dukan Isra’ilawa waɗannan abubuwa, sai mutane suka yi kuka mai zafi,
english: When Yahweh’s angel spoke these words to all the children of Israel, the people lifted up their voice and wept.

hausa: Da ya faɗi haka, ya durƙusa tare da dukansu ya yi addu’a.
english: When he had spoken these things, he knelt down and prayed with them all.

hausa: Sai mutanen da aka aika, suka koma gida, suka tarar bawan ya warke.
english: Those who were sent, returning to the house, found that the servant who had been sick was well.

hausa: “ ‘Waɗannan su ne ƙa’idodi na hadaya don laifi, hadaya ce tsattsarka.
english: “‘This is the law of the trespass offering: It is most holy.

hausa: Mutanen Kiriyat Yeyarim suka ɗauki akwatin alkawarin Ubangiji. Suka kai a gidan Abinadab da ke kan tudu, suka keɓe Eleyazar ɗansa yă lura da akwatin alkawarin Ubangiji.
english: The men of Kiriath Jearim came and took Yahweh’s ark, and brought it into Abinadab’s house on the hill, and consecrated Eleazar his son to keep Yahweh’s ark.

hausa: “Ga abin da Sairus sarkin Farisa yake shela, “ ‘Ubangiji Allah na sama ya ba ni iko in yi mulkin duniya duka, ya kuma zaɓe ni in gina masa haikali a Urushalima cikin Yahuda.
english: “Cyrus king of Persia says, ‘Yahweh, the God of heaven, has given me all the kingdoms of the earth; and he has commanded me to build him a house in Jerusalem, which is in Judah.

hausa: Gama ina tsoro, in na zo, in tarar da ku dabam da yadda nake so, ku ma ku tarar da ni dabam da yadda kuke so. Ina tsoro kada yă zama akwai faɗa, da kishi, da fushi mai zafi, da tsattsaguwa, da ɓata suna, da gulma, da girman kai, da hargitsi.
english: For I am afraid that perhaps when I come, I might find you not the way I want to, and that I might be found by you as you don’t desire, that perhaps there would be strife, jealousy, outbursts of anger, factions, slander, whisperings, proud thoughts, or riots,

hausa: Saboda haka Yoshuwa ya cinye ƙasar duka da yaƙi, dukan Negeb, duka yankin Goshen, filayen kwari na yamma, Araba da tuddai na Isra’ila da kwarinta.
english: So Joshua captured all that land, the hill country, all the South, all the land of Goshen, the lowland, the Arabah, the hill country of Israel, and the lowland of the same,

hausa: Suka yi zubin zoban tagulla don riƙe sanduna a kusurwoyi huɗu na ragar tagullar.
english: He cast four rings for the four corners of bronze grating, to be places for the poles.

hausa: “A waccan rana zan amsa,” in ji Ubangiji, “zan amsa wa sararin sama, za su kuwa amsa wa ƙasa;
english: It will happen in that day, that I will respond,” says Yahweh. “I will respond to the heavens, and they will respond to the earth;

hausa: sai Sisera ya tattara keken yaƙinsa na ƙarfe ɗari tara wuri ɗaya da dukan mutanen da suke tare da shi daga Haroshet Haggoyim zuwa Kogin Kishon.
english: Sisera gathered together all his chariots, even nine hundred chariots of iron, and all the people who were with him, from Harosheth of the Gentiles, to the river Kishon.

hausa: A jeri na huɗu, a sa kirisolit, da onis, da yasfa. Ka sa su a tsaiko na zinariya.
english: and the fourth row a chrysolite, an onyx, and a jasper. They shall be enclosed in gold in their settings.

hausa: Ga mutum ne shirye-shiryen zuciya suke, amma daga Ubangiji ne amshin harshe kan zo.
english: The plans of the heart belong to man, but the answer of the tongue is from Yahweh.

hausa: Ya amsa ya ce,“Sa’ad da yamma ta yi, kukan ce, ‘Yanayi zai yi kyau, gama sararin sama ya yi ja,’
english: But he answered them, “When it is evening, you say, ‘It will be fair weather, for the sky is red.’

hausa: Za a rushe gidan mugu, amma tentin mai aikata gaskiya zai haɓaka.
english: The house of the wicked will be overthrown, but the tent of the upright will flourish.

hausa: In marasa kaciya suna kiyaye dokar, ashe, ba za a ɗauke su kamar an yi musu kaciya ba?
english: If therefore the uncircumcised keep the ordinances of the law, won’t his uncircumcision be accounted as circumcision?

hausa: har in dawo lafiya zuwa gidan mahaifina, to, Ubangiji zai zama Allahna
english: so that I come again to my father’s house in peace, and Yahweh will be my God,

hausa: Sai Dawuda ya ce wa Natan, “Na yi wa Ubangiji zunubi.” Natan ya ce, “Ubangiji ya yafe maka zunubin. Ba za ka mutu ba.
english: David said to Nathan, “I have sinned against Yahweh.” Nathan said to David, “Yahweh also has put away your sin. You will not die.

hausa: “To, firistoci yanzu ku gwada ku roƙi Allah yă yi mana alheri. Da irin hadayun nan a hannuwanku ne zai ji ku?” In ji Ubangiji Maɗaukaki.
english: “Now, please entreat the favor of God, that he may be gracious to us. With this, will he accept any of you?” says Yahweh of Armies.

hausa: ’Ya’yan Kenaz maza su ne, Otniyel da Serahiya. ’Ya’yan Otniyel maza su ne, Hatat da Meyonotai.
english: The sons of Kenaz: Othniel and Seraiah. The sons of Othniel: Hathath.

hausa: Amma Allah yă sawwaƙa in sa hannu a shafaffen Ubangiji, ka ɗauki māshin da butar ruwan da take kusa da kansa mu tafi.”
english: Yahweh forbid that I should stretch out my hand against Yahweh’s anointed; but now please take the spear that is at his head and the jar of water, and let’s go.”

hausa: Ku zo, mu sayar da shi wa mutanen Ishmayelawan nan, kada mu sa hannuwanmu a kansa; ban da haka ma, shi ɗan’uwanmu ne, jiki da jininmu.” Sai ’yan’uwansa suka yarda.
english: Come, and let’s sell him to the Ishmaelites, and not let our hand be on him; for he is our brother, our flesh.” His brothers listened to him.

hausa: Sa’ad da kuka sake shi, kada ku bar shi yă tafi hannu wofi.
english: When you let him go free from you, you shall not let him go empty.

hausa: Abner ya tattauna da dattawan Isra’ila ya ce, “An daɗe kuna nema ku naɗa Dawuda sarkinku.
english: Abner had communication with the elders of Israel, saying, “In times past, you sought for David to be king over you.

hausa: Sai Ubangiji ya ce wa Musa, “Za ka huta tare da kakanninka, waɗannan mutane kuwa ba da daɗewa ba za su yi karuwanci ga baƙin alloli na ƙasar da za su shiga. Za su yashe ni su kuma karya alkawarin da na yi da su.
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “Behold, you shall sleep with your fathers. This people will rise up and play the prostitute after the strange gods of the land where they go to be among them, and will forsake me and break my covenant which I have made with them.

hausa: Da suka zauna don cin abinci, sai suka tā da idanu, suka ga ayarin mutanen Ishmayel suna zuwa daga Gileyad. An yi wa raƙumansu labtu da kayan yaji da na ƙanshi, suna kan hanyarsu za su Masar.
english: They sat down to eat bread, and they lifted up their eyes and looked, and saw a caravan of Ishmaelites coming from Gilead, with their camels bearing spices and balm and myrrh, going to carry it down to Egypt.

hausa: Suka ba shi saura wainan ’ya’yan ɓaure da kuma wainan ’ya’yan inabi, ya ci ya sami ƙarfi. Gama bai ci ba, bai sha ba, har yini uku da dare uku.
english: They gave him a piece of a cake of figs and two clusters of raisins. When he had eaten, his spirit came again to him; for he had eaten no bread, and drank no water for three days and three nights.

hausa: Mala’ikan Ubangiji ya kira Ibrahim daga sama sau na biyu
english: Yahweh’s angel called to Abraham a second time out of the sky,

hausa: Amma kada ku tsaya a can! Ku fafari abokan gābanku, ku kai musu hari ta baya, kada ku bari su kai biranensu, gama Ubangiji Allahnku ya ba da su a hannunku.”
english: but don’t stay there. Pursue your enemies, and attack them from the rear. Don’t allow them to enter into their cities; for Yahweh your God has delivered them into your hand.”

hausa: “Tunanin da ya dame ni ya sa dole in amsa domin abin ya dame ni sosai.
english: “Therefore my thoughts answer me, even by reason of my haste that is in me.

hausa: amma maganar Ubangiji tana nan har abada.” Wannan kuwa ita ce kalmar da aka yi muku wa’azi.
english: but the Lord’s word endures forever.” This is the word of Good News which was preached to you.

hausa: Saboda haka Batsheba ta je don tă ga sarki. A yanzu dai sarki ya tsufa, yana nan kuma a cikin ɗakinsa, inda Abishag mutuniya Shunam take masa hidima.
english: Bathsheba went in to the king in his room. The king was very old; and Abishag the Shunammite was serving the king.

hausa: “ ‘Kaito! Kaitonki, in ji Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka. Bugu da ƙari a kan dukan waɗansu muguntarki,
english: “‘“It has happened after all your wickedness—woe, woe to you!” says the Lord Yahweh—

hausa: Ubangiji ya ce wa Musa da Haruna a Masar,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses and Aaron in the land of Egypt, saying,

hausa: Bari tă zama kamar mayafin da aka ɗaura kewaye da shi, kamar ɗamara da aka ɗaura kewaye da shi har abada.
english: Let it be to him as the clothing with which he covers himself, for the belt that is always around him.

hausa: Tare da bijiman, ragunan da kuma ’yan raguna, a miƙa hadayunsu na gari, da hadayun sha bisa ga adadin da a ƙayyade.
english: and their meal offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, according to their number, after the ordinance,

hausa: Yabo ya tabbata ga Ubangiji Allahnka, wanda ya ji daɗi a cikinka ya sa ka a kan kujerar sarautarsa a matsayin sarki don ka yi mulkin domin Ubangiji Allahnka. Saboda ƙaunar Allahnka wa Isra’ila da kuma sha’awarsa na riƙe su har abada, ya naɗa ka sarki a bisansu, don ka yi adalci da kuma gaskiya.”
english: Blessed be Yahweh your God, who delighted in you and set you on his throne to be king for Yahweh your God, because your God loved Israel, to establish them forever. Therefore he made you king over them, to do justice and righteousness.”

hausa: “Saboda haka ba zan yi shiru ba; zan yi magana cikin ɓacin raina, zan nuna ɓacin raina cikin ruhu, cikin ƙuncin raina.
english: “Therefore I will not keep silent. I will speak in the anguish of my spirit. I will complain in the bitterness of my soul.

hausa: Sai ya yi ta roƙon Yesu, kada yă kore su daga wurin.
english: He begged him much that he would not send them away out of the country.

hausa: “Ba ka ji ba cewa tun dā can na shirya ya zama haka? A kwanakin dā na kafa shi; yanzu na sa ya faru, cewa ka mai da birane masu mafaka zuwa tsibin ɓuraguzai.
english: “‘Have you not heard how I have done it long ago, and formed it in ancient times? Now I have brought it to pass, that it should be yours to destroy fortified cities, turning them into ruinous heaps.

hausa: Waɗannan mutanen ne, suke kawo rabe-rabe, masu bin abin da jiki yake so, marasa Ruhu.
english: These are those who cause divisions and are sensual, not having the Spirit.

hausa: Ga zuriyar bayin Solomon. Zuriyar Sotai, da ta Soferet, da ta Ferida,
english: The children of Solomon’s servants: the children of Sotai, the children of Sophereth, the children of Perida,

hausa: “Ɗan mutum, ka nuna hanyoyi biyu inda takobin sarkin Babilon zai bi, duka biyun su fara daga ƙasa guda. Ka kafa shaida inda hanyar za tă rabu zuwa cikin birni.
english: “Also, you son of man, appoint two ways, that the sword of the king of Babylon may come. They both will come out of one land, and mark out a place. Mark it out at the head of the way to the city.

hausa: Yabi Ubangiji, Allah na Isra’ila, daga madawwami zuwa madawwami. Sai dukan mutane suka ce, “Amin.” Suka kuma “Yabi Ubangiji.”
english: Blessed be Yahweh, the God of Israel, from everlasting even to everlasting. All the people said, “Amen,” and praised Yahweh.

hausa: Da suka same shi a wancan ƙetaren tafkin, sai suka tambaye shi suka ce, “Rabbi, yaushe ka kai nan?”
english: When they found him on the other side of the sea, they asked him, “Rabbi, when did you come here?”

hausa: Kada ka yi subul da bakinka, kada zuciyarka tă yi garajen furta wani abu a gaban Allah. Allah yana sama kai kuma kana duniya, saboda haka, kada kalmominka su zama da yawa.
english: Don’t be rash with your mouth, and don’t let your heart be hasty to utter anything before God; for God is in heaven, and you on earth. Therefore let your words be few.

hausa: mujiya mai ƙaho, jimina, shaho, da kowane irin shaho,
english: the horned owl, the screech owl, the gull, any kind of hawk,

hausa: Hezekiya ya juye fuskarsa wajen bango ya kuma yi addu’a ga Ubangiji,
english: Then Hezekiah turned his face to the wall and prayed to Yahweh,

hausa: Ya ce mata, “Ki tafi,” Ya bar ta tă tafi har wata biyu. Ita da ’yan matan suka tafi a kan duwatsu suka yi ta makoki domin ba za tă taɓa aure ba.
english: He said, “Go.” He sent her away for two months; and she departed, she and her companions, and mourned her virginity on the mountains.

hausa: Za su yi zance game da ni su ce, ‘A cikin Ubangiji kaɗai akwai adalci da kuma ƙarfafawa.’ ” Duk wanda ya yi fushi da shi zai zo wurinsa ya kuma sha kunya.
english: They will say of me, ‘There is righteousness and strength only in Yahweh.’” Even to him will men come. All those who raged against him will be disappointed.

hausa: Sarki ya ce, “Ka tambaya mini ko yaron wane ne wannan saurayi.”
english: The king said, “Inquire whose son the young man is!”

hausa: Ba jarrabar da ta taɓa samunku, wadda ba a saba yi wa mutum ba. Allah mai aminci ne; ba zai bari a jarrabce ku fiye da ƙarfinku ba. Amma in aka jarrabce ku, zai nuna muku mafita, domin ku iya cin nasara.
english: No temptation has taken you except what is common to man. God is faithful, who will not allow you to be tempted above what you are able, but will with the temptation also make the way of escape, that you may be able to endure it.

hausa: Mutanen Yeriko kuwa suka kama ginin daga mahaɗin, Zakkur ɗan Imri kuma ya fara ginin biye da su.
english: Next to him the men of Jericho built. Next to them Zaccur the son of Imri built.

hausa: Saboda haka cikin karuwancinki kin sha bamban da saura; babu wanda yake binki saboda alheranki. Ke dai dabam ce, gama kikan biya kuma ba mai biyanki.
english: You are different from other women in your prostitution, in that no one follows you to play the prostitute; and whereas you give hire, and no hire is given to you, therefore you are different.”’

hausa: A shekara ta sha takwas ta sarautar Yerobowam, Abiya ya zama sarkin Yahuda,
english: In the eighteenth year of King Jeroboam, Abijah began to reign over Judah.

hausa: Gama wannan da Allah ya aiko yakan faɗi kalmomin Allah ne, gama Allah yana ba da Ruhu babu iyaka.
english: For he whom God has sent speaks the words of God; for God gives the Spirit without measure.

hausa: Saboda haka Abram ya cire tentunansa, ya zo ya zauna kusa da manyan itatuwan Mamre a Hebron, inda ya gina bagade ga Ubangiji.
english: Abram moved his tent, and came and lived by the oaks of Mamre, which are in Hebron, and built an altar there to Yahweh.

hausa: Mutumin ya tambaye shi ya ce, “Mene ne sunanka?” Yaƙub ya amsa ya ce, “Yaƙub.”
english: He said to him, “What is your name?” He said, “Jacob”.

hausa: Sa’an nan Shafan ya ɗauki littafin zuwa wurin sarki, ya faɗa masa, “Manyan ma’aikatanka suna yin kome da aka sa su.
english: Shaphan carried the book to the king, and moreover brought back word to the king, saying, “All that was committed to your servants, they are doing.

hausa: Dabbobin da za ku zaɓa, dole su zama bana ɗaya, namiji marar tabo, za ku kuma kamo su daga cikin tumaki ko awaki.
english: Your lamb shall be without defect, a male a year old. You shall take it from the sheep or from the goats.

hausa: ’Ya’yan Ulla maza su ne, Ara, Hanniyel da Riziya.
english: The sons of Ulla: Arah, Hanniel, and Rizia.

hausa: Sai Musa ya fitar wa dukan Isra’ilawa dukan sandunan da suke daga gaban Ubangiji. Suka duba, kowa kuma ya ɗauki sandansa.
english: Moses brought out all the rods from before Yahweh to all the children of Israel. They looked, and each man took his rod.

hausa: Ka zo, ƙaunataccena, bari mu je bayan gari, bari mu kwana a ƙauye.
english: Come, my beloved! Let’s go out into the field. Let’s lodge in the villages.

hausa: Sa’an nan shafaffen firist zai ɗiba jinin bijimin yă kai cikin Tentin Sujada.
english: The anointed priest shall take some of the blood of the bull, and bring it to the Tent of Meeting.

hausa: Lawiyawan da suke cikin birni mai tsarki sun kai 284.
english: All the Levites in the holy city were two hundred eighty-four.

hausa: Idonka shi ne fitilar jikinka. Sa’ad da idanunka suna da lafiya, dukan jikinka ma na cike da haske, amma sa’ad da idanunka suna da lahani, dukan jikinka ma na cike da duhu.
