english: The lamp of the body is the eye. Therefore when your eye is good, your whole body is also full of light; but when it is evil, your body also is full of darkness.

hausa: A rana ta goma sha bakwai ga watan bakwai, jirgin ya sauka a duwatsun Ararat.
english: The ship rested in the seventh month, on the seventeenth day of the month, on Ararat’s mountains.

hausa: Mikal ’yar Shawulu kuwa ba tă haifi ɗa ba har mutuwarta.
english: Michal the daughter of Saul had no child to the day of her death.

hausa: Ko da ni marar ƙarfi ne, bakina ya isa yă sa in zama mai laifi; in ba ni da laifi, zai sa in yi laifi.
english: Though I am righteous, my own mouth will condemn me. Though I am blameless, it will prove me perverse.

hausa: “Kada ka ji tsoro, ya Yaƙub bawana; kada ka karai, ya Isra’ila. Tabbatacce zan cece ka daga wuri mai nisa, zuriyarka daga ƙasar bautarsu. Yaƙub zai sāke kasance cikin salama, rai kwance, babu kuma wanda zai sa ya ji tsoro.
english: “But don’t you be afraid, Jacob my servant. Don’t be dismayed, Israel; for, behold, I will save you from afar, and your offspring from the land of their captivity. Jacob will return, and will be quiet and at ease. No one will make him afraid.

hausa: Ta haka Isra’ila suka zauna a ƙasar Amoriyawa.
english: Thus Israel lived in the land of the Amorites.

hausa: Sai mala’ikan da yake yi mini magana ya tafi, sai wani mala’ika ya zo ya same shi
english: Behold, the angel who talked with me went out, and another angel went out to meet him,

hausa: Amma wani Bafarisiyen da ake kira Gamaliyel, wani malamin doka, wanda dukan mutane ke girmamawa, ya miƙe tsaye a Majalisar ya umarta a fitar da mutanen waje na ɗan lokaci.
english: But one stood up in the council, a Pharisee named Gamaliel, a teacher of the law, honored by all the people, and commanded to put the apostles out for a little while.

hausa: (Yohanna ya ba da shaida game da shi. Ya ɗaga murya yana cewa, “Wannan shi ne wanda na ce, ‘Mai zuwa bayana ya fi ni girma domin yana nan kafin ni.’ ”)
english: John testified about him. He cried out, saying, “This was he of whom I said, ‘He who comes after me has surpassed me, for he was before me.’”

hausa: Da jin ƙarar ƙaho sai ya ce, ‘Yauwa!’ Ya ji ƙanshin yaƙi daga nesa, da ihun shugabannin yaƙi.
english: As often as the trumpet sounds he snorts, ‘Aha!’ He smells the battle afar off, the thunder of the captains, and the shouting.

hausa: Gama a idanunsa yana ganin kansa wani abu ne wanda ya sha ƙarfi a gane ko ya ƙi zunubinsa.
english: For he flatters himself in his own eyes, too much to detect and hate his sin.

hausa: Duk inda kuka ji an busa ƙaho, sai ku taru a wurin. Allahnmu zai yi yaƙi dominmu!”
english: Wherever you hear the sound of the trumpet, rally there to us. Our God will fight for us.”

hausa: Dawuda kuwa ya tafi Mahanayim. Absalom kuma ya ƙetare Urdun tare da dukan mutanen Isra’ila.
english: Then David came to Mahanaim. Absalom passed over the Jordan, he and all the men of Israel with him.

hausa: Dawuda da dukan gidan Isra’ila suka yi biki sosai da dukan ƙarfinsu a gaban Ubangiji, da waƙoƙi, da molaye, da garayu, da ganguna, da kacau-kacau da kuma kuge.
english: David and all the house of Israel played before Yahweh with all kinds of instruments made of cypress wood, with harps, with stringed instruments, with tambourines, with castanets, and with cymbals.

hausa: Duk bawan da kuka sayo, yana iya ci, in dai an yi masa kaciya,
english: but every man’s servant who is bought for money, when you have circumcised him, then shall he eat of it.

hausa: Ko kuwa waɗannan da suke a nan su faɗi laifin da suka same ni da shi sa’ad da na tsaya a gaban Majalisa,
english: Or else let these men themselves say what injustice they found in me when I stood before the council,

hausa: Yaƙin ya yi zafi ƙwarai kewaye da Shawulu, har maharba suka ji masa ciwo sosai bayan sun sha ƙarfinsa.
english: The battle went hard against Saul, and the archers overtook him; and he was greatly distressed by reason of the archers.

hausa: Bari waɗanda suke neman raina su sha kunya a kuma kunyatar da su; bari waɗanda suke shirya lalacewata su juya da baya su ruɗe.
english: Let those who seek after my soul be disappointed and brought to dishonor. Let those who plot my ruin be turned back and confounded.

hausa: Da bazara, Sarki Nebukadnezzar ya aika a kawo Yehohiyacin, aka kuma kawo shi Babilon, tare da kayayyaki masu daraja daga haikalin Ubangiji, sai Sarki Nebukadnezzar ya naɗa kawunsa Zedekiya, sarki a bisa Yahuda da Urushalima.
english: At the return of the year, King Nebuchadnezzar sent and brought him to Babylon, with the valuable vessels of Yahweh’s house, and made Zedekiah his brother king over Judah and Jerusalem.

hausa: Hezekiya ya tambayi Ishaya, “Wace alama ce za tă nuna cewa Ubangiji zai warkar da ni, kuma cewa in tafi haikalin Ubangiji kwana uku daga yanzu?”
english: Hezekiah said to Isaiah, “What will be the sign that Yahweh will heal me, and that I will go up to Yahweh’s house the third day?”

hausa: Ya kasance a ɓoye tare da su a haikalin Allah shekara shida, yayinda Ataliya take mulkin ƙasar.
english: He was with them hidden in God’s house six years while Athaliah reigned over the land.

hausa: Saboda haka Gideyon ya ɗebi bayinsa bakwai ya yi yadda Ubangiji ya ce masa. Amma saboda yana tsoron iyalinsa da mutanen gari, ya yi haka da dare a maimako da rana.
english: Then Gideon took ten men of his servants, and did as Yahweh had spoken to him. Because he feared his father’s household and the men of the city, he could not do it by day, but he did it by night.

hausa: Da sai in bi da kai in kawo ka gidan mahaifiyata, ita da ta koyar da ni. Da na ba ka ruwan inabi gaurayayye da kayan yaji ka sha, zaƙin rumman nawa.
english: I would lead you, bringing you into the house of my mother, who would instruct me. I would have you drink spiced wine, of the juice of my pomegranate.

hausa: Tsohon ya ce, “Na marabce ku a gidana. Bari ni ba ku duk abin da kuke bukata. Kada ku dai kwana a dandali.”
english: The old man said, “Peace be to you! Just let me supply all your needs, but don’t sleep in the street.”

hausa: Yana aiko da ruwa domin horon mutane, ko kuma don yă jiƙa duniya yă kuma nuna ƙaunarsa.
english: whether it is for correction, or for his land, or for loving kindness, that he causes it to come.

hausa: Ƙarshe yanzu yana a kanki. Zan fashe fushina a kanki. Zan shari’anta ki bisa ga halinki in sāka miki kuma saboda dukan ayyukan banƙyamar da kika yi.
english: Now the end is on you, and I will send my anger on you, and will judge you according to your ways. I will bring on you all your abominations.

hausa: Azurfarki ta zama jebu, an gauraye ruwan inabinki mafi kyau da ruwa.
english: Your silver has become dross, your wine mixed with water.

hausa: Da ma a ce dukan maza kamar ni suke mana. Sai dai kowa da irin baiwar da Allah ya yi masa; wani yana da wannan baiwa, wani kuwa wancan.
english: Yet I wish that all men were like me. However, each man has his own gift from God, one of this kind, and another of that kind.

hausa: Suka ce, “Za mu yi farin cikin ba ka su.” Saboda haka suka shimfiɗa mayafi, kowanne ya sa ɗan kunne ɗaya daga ganimar.
english: They answered, “We will willingly give them.” They spread a garment, and every man threw the earrings of his plunder into it.

hausa: Yana da shekara ashirin da biyar sa’ad da ya zama sarki, ya kuma yi mulki a Urushalima shekara goma sha shida.
english: He was twenty-five years old when he began to reign, and reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem.

hausa: Duba, Ubangiji Maɗaukaki, zai ragargaza rassa da iko mai girma. Za a sassare itatuwa masu ganyaye, za a yanke dogayen itatuwa har ƙasa.
english: Behold, the Lord, Yahweh of Armies, will lop the boughs with terror. The tall will be cut down, and the lofty will be brought low.

hausa: Sa’an nan haskenku zai keto kamar ketowar alfijir, warkarwarku kuma zai bayyana nan da nan; sa’an nan adalcinku zai tafi a gabanku, ɗaukakar Ubangiji kuma zai tsare ku daga baya.
english: Then your light will break out as the morning, and your healing will appear quickly; then your righteousness shall go before you, and Yahweh’s glory will be your rear guard.

hausa: Ya fito da mutanen da suke a can, ya sa su su yi aiki da zarto, da diga, da kuma gatari, ya kuma sa su bugan bulok. Haka ya yi wa dukan garuruwan Ammonawa. Sa’an nan Dawuda da dukan sojoji suka koma Urushalima.
english: He brought out the people who were in it, and put them to work under saws, under iron picks, under axes of iron, and made them go to the brick kiln; and he did so to all the cities of the children of Ammon. Then David and all the people returned to Jerusalem.

hausa: Amma daga can in kuka nemi Ubangiji Allahnku, da dukan zuciyarku da kuma dukan ranku, za ku same shi.
english: But from there you shall seek Yahweh your God, and you will find him when you search after him with all your heart and with all your soul.

hausa: wanda ya bishe su cikin zurfafa? Kamar doki a fili, ba su yi tuntuɓe ba;
english: Who led them through the depths, like a horse in the wilderness, so that they didn’t stumble?

hausa: Bulus, wanda aka kira domin yă zama manzon Kiristi Yesu, bisa ga nufin Allah, da kuma ɗan’uwanmu Sostenes,
english: Paul, called to be an apostle of Jesus Christ through the will of God, and our brother Sosthenes,

hausa: Ya kira ku ga wannan ta wurin bishararmu, don ku sami rabo a cikin ɗaukakar Ubangijinmu Yesu Kiristi.
english: to which he called you through our Good News, for the obtaining of the glory of our Lord Jesus Christ.

hausa: Sa’an nan ya aika a kira hakimai da wakilai da gwamnoni da mashawarta, da ma’aji, da alƙalai, da marubutan kotu, da dukan sauran ma’aikatan yankunan, suka hallara domin a rusuna wa wannan siffar da ya kafa.
english: Then Nebuchadnezzar the king sent to gather together the local governors, the deputies, and the governors, the judges, the treasurers, the counselors, the sheriffs, and all the rulers of the provinces, to come to the dedication of the image which Nebuchadnezzar the king had set up.

hausa: Firist zai yi kafara a gaban Ubangiji saboda mutumin nan da ya aikata laifi ba da gangan ba, in kuwa an yi kafara saboda shi, za a gafarta masa.
english: The priest shall make atonement for the soul who errs when he sins unwittingly before Yahweh. He shall make atonement for him; and he shall be forgiven.

hausa: Kin fi Tebes ne da take a bakin Nilu, da ruwa yake kewaye da ita? Rafi shi ne kāriyarta, ruwanta kuma katanga.
english: Are you better than No-Amon, who was situated among the rivers, who had the waters around her, whose rampart was the sea, and her wall was of the sea?

hausa: Labari wannan abu ya kai kunnuwan ikkilisiya a Urushalima, sai suka aiki Barnabas zuwa Antiyok.
english: The report concerning them came to the ears of the assembly which was in Jerusalem. They sent out Barnabas to go as far as Antioch,

hausa: Ana nan sai rafin ya bushe saboda ba a yi ruwan sama a ƙasar ba.
english: After a while, the brook dried up, because there was no rain in the land.

hausa: Duk da haka waɗansu kala za su ragu, sai ka ce sa’ad da an karkaɗe itace zaitun, aka bar ’ya’yan zaitun biyu ko uku a can ƙwanƙolin rassan, ko kuma aka bar huɗu ko biyar a rassa na gefe na itace mai ’ya’ya,” in ji Ubangiji, Allah na Isra’ila.
english: Yet gleanings will be left there, like the shaking of an olive tree, two or three olives in the top of the uppermost bough, four or five in the outermost branches of a fruitful tree,” says Yahweh, the God of Israel.

hausa: Gama ina jin tsoron hallaka daga Allah, kuma domin tsoron ɗaukakarsa ba zan iya yin waɗannan abubuwa ba.
english: For calamity from God is a terror to me. Because of his majesty, I can do nothing.

hausa: A rana ta goma ga wata na goma, a shekara ta tara ta mulkin Zedekiya ne Nebukadnezzar sarkin Babilon tare da dukan rundunan yaƙinsa, ya tasam wa Urushalima. Ya yi sansani a bayan birnin, ya kewaye ta da shirin yaƙi.
english: In the ninth year of his reign, in the tenth month, in the tenth day of the month, Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came, he and all his army, against Jerusalem, and encamped against it; and they built forts against it around it.

hausa: A lokacin Debora annabiya, matar Laffidot ce take bi da Isra’ila.
english: Now Deborah, a prophetess, the wife of Lappidoth, judged Israel at that time.

hausa: Wahayin Yesu Kiristi, wanda Allah ya ba shi yă nuna wa bayinsa abin da lalle zai faru nan ba da daɗewa ba. Ya bayyana shi ta wurin aiko da mala’ikansa zuwa ga bawansa Yohanna,
english: This is the Revelation of Jesus Christ, which God gave him to show to his servants the things which must happen soon, which he sent and made known by his angel to his servant, John,

hausa: Me ya sa al’ummai suke cewa, “Ina Allahnsu?”
english: Why should the nations say, “Where is their God, now?”

hausa: Kamar yadda mutum yakan miƙa hannu cikin sheƙar tsuntsu haka hannuna ya je ya washe dukiyar al’ummai; kamar yadda mutane sukan tattara ƙwai, haka na tattara dukan ƙasashe; ba tsuntsun da ya kakkaɓe fikafiki, ko yă buɗe baki don yă yi kuka.’ ”
english: My hand has found the riches of the peoples like a nest, and like one gathers eggs that are abandoned, I have gathered all the earth. There was no one who moved their wing, or that opened their mouth, or chirped.”

hausa: Sukan yi wanka a duk sa’ad da suka shiga Tentin Sujada, ko in suka kusaci bagade, yadda Ubangiji ya umarci Musa.
english: When they went into the Tent of Meeting, and when they came near to the altar, they washed, as Yahweh commanded Moses.

hausa: Yesu da almajiransa suka janye zuwa tafkin, taro mai yawa kuwa daga Galili ya bi shi.
english: Jesus withdrew to the sea with his disciples; and a great multitude followed him from Galilee, from Judea,

hausa: To, sa’ad da kuka ci, kuka ƙoshi, sa’ad da kuka gina gidaje masu kyau, kuka zauna,
english: lest, when you have eaten and are full, and have built fine houses and lived in them;

hausa: Helkat da Rehob, tare da wuraren kiwonsu, garuruwa huɗu ke nan;
english: Helkath with its pasture lands, and Rehob with its pasture lands: four cities.

hausa: “Sauran mutane, wato, firistoci, Lawiyawa, matsaran ƙofofi, mawaƙa, ma’aikatan haikali da dukan waɗanda suka ware kansu daga maƙwabta saboda Dokar Allah, tare da matansu da dukan ’ya’yansu maza da mata waɗanda za su iya fahimta,
english: The rest of the people, the priests, the Levites, the gatekeepers, the singers, the temple servants, and all those who had separated themselves from the peoples of the lands to the law of God, their wives, their sons, and their daughters—everyone who had knowledge and understanding—

hausa: Ubangiji ya ce wa Musa, “Fir’auna zai ƙi kasa kunne gare ka, sai na ƙara aikata waɗansu mu’ujizai cikin Masar.”
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “Pharaoh won’t listen to you, that my wonders may be multiplied in the land of Egypt.”

hausa: Za su bi Ubangiji; zai yi ruri kamar zaki. Sa’ad da ya yi ruri, ’ya’yansa za su zo da rawan jiki daga yamma.
english: They will walk after Yahweh, who will roar like a lion; for he will roar, and the children will come trembling from the west.

hausa: Rezin, Nekoda, Gazzam,
english: the children of Rezin, the children of Nekoda, the children of Gazzam,

hausa: Ana cikin haka, sai saura Yahudawa waɗanda suke lardunan sarki su ma suka taru domin su kāre kansu su kuma sami hutu daga abokan gābansu. Suka karkashe mutum dubu saba’in da biyar amma ba su taɓa dukiyarsu ba.
english: The other Jews who were in the king’s provinces gathered themselves together, defended their lives, had rest from their enemies, and killed seventy-five thousand of those who hated them; but they didn’t lay their hand on the plunder.

hausa: “Wa ya rena ranar ƙananan abubuwa? Mutane za su yi murna sa’ad da suka ga igiyar gwaji a hannun Zerubbabel. “Waɗannan guda bakwai ɗin su ne idanun Ubangiji, masu jujjuyawa cikin dukan duniya.”
english: Indeed, who despises the day of small things? For these seven shall rejoice, and shall see the plumb line in the hand of Zerubbabel. These are Yahweh’s eyes, which run back and forth through the whole earth.”

hausa: Hukunce-hukuncen shugabannin ƙasar na cin hanci ne, firistocinta kuma suna koyarwa don a biya su, annabawanta kuwa suna yin annabci don neman kuɗi. Duk da haka suna jingina a kan Ubangiji suna cewa, “Ba Ubangiji yana tare da mu ba? Ba bala’in da zai zo mana.”
english: Her leaders judge for bribes, and her priests teach for a price, and her prophets tell fortunes for money; yet they lean on Yahweh, and say, “Isn’t Yahweh among us? No disaster will come on us.”

hausa: Mun gani, mun kuma shaida cewa Uba ya aiko Ɗansa domin yă zama Mai Ceton duniya.
english: We have seen and testify that the Father has sent the Son as the Savior of the world.

hausa: “Ruhun Ubangiji yana kaina, domin ya shafe ni, in yi wa matalauta wa’azin bishara. Ya aiko ni in yi shelar ’yanci ga ’yan kurkuku, in kuma buɗe idanun makafi, in ba da ’yanci ga waɗanda aka danne.
english: “The Spirit of the Lord is on me, because he has anointed me to preach good news to the poor. He has sent me to heal the broken hearted, to proclaim release to the captives, recovering of sight to the blind, to deliver those who are crushed,

hausa: “Amma waɗancan kwanaki, bayan baƙin azaban nan, “ ‘rana za tă yi duhu, wata kuma ba zai ba da haskensa ba;
english: But in those days, after that oppression, the sun will be darkened, the moon will not give its light,

hausa: Akwai waɗansu mutanen da suka taɓa jin muryar Allah yana magana daga wuta, kamar yadda kuka ji har suka rayu?
english: Did a people ever hear the voice of God speaking out of the middle of the fire, as you have heard, and live?

hausa: Sa’an nan Menahem ɗan Gadi ya gangara daga Tirza ya haura zuwa Samariya. Ya tasam wa Shallum ɗan Yabesh a Samariya, ya kashe shi, ya kuma gāje shi.
english: Menahem the son of Gadi went up from Tirzah, came to Samaria, struck Shallum the son of Jabesh in Samaria, killed him, and reigned in his place.

hausa: Suna miƙa hadaya a kan ƙwanƙolin duwatsu suna kuma ƙone hadayu a kan tuddai, a ƙarƙashin itatuwa oak, aduruku da katambiri, inda inuwa take da daɗi. Saboda haka ’ya’yanku mata suka juya wa karuwanci surukanku mata kuma suka shiga yin zina.
english: They sacrifice on the tops of the mountains, and burn incense on the hills, under oaks, poplars, and terebinths, because its shade is good. Therefore your daughters play the prostitute, and your brides commit adultery.

hausa: “Ka yi shela ka kuma furta a cikin al’ummai, ka tā da tuta ka kuma furta; kada ku ɓoye kome, amma ku ce, ‘Za a ci Babilon da yaƙi; za a kunyata Bel, Marduk ya cika da tsoro. Siffofinta za su sha kunya gumakanta za su cika da tsoro.’
english: “Declare among the nations and publish, and set up a standard; publish, and don’t conceal; say, ‘Babylon has been taken, Bel is disappointed, Merodach is dismayed! Her images are disappointed. Her idols are dismayed.’

hausa: Wani yakan ɗauki wata rana da daraja fiye da sauran ranaku; wani kuma yana ganin dukan ranakun ɗaya ne. Ya kamata kowa yă kasance da tabbaci a cikin zuciyarsa.
english: One man esteems one day as more important. Another esteems every day alike. Let each man be fully assured in his own mind.

hausa: Sai Shawulu ya ce wa Dawuda, “Allah yă albarkace ka ɗana, Dawuda, za ka yi manyan abubuwa, tabbatacce kuma ka yi nasara.” Sai Dawuda ya yi tafiyarsa, Shawulu kuwa ya koma gida.
english: Then Saul said to David, “You are blessed, my son David. You will both do mightily, and will surely prevail.” So David went his way, and Saul returned to his place.

hausa: Aboki yakan yi ƙauna a koyaushe, ɗan’uwa kuma, ai, don ɗaukar nawayar juna ne aka haife shi.
english: A friend loves at all times; and a brother is born for adversity.

hausa: Sa’an nan tumaki za su yi kiwo kamar yadda suke yi a wurin kiwonsu; raguna za su yi kiwo cikin abubuwa masu kyau da suka lalace.
english: Then the lambs will graze as in their pasture, and strangers will eat the ruins of the rich.

hausa: “Elam tana can, tare da dukan jama’arta kewaye da kabarinta. Dukansu sun mutu, an kashe su da takobi. Dukan waɗanda suka haddasa tsoro a ƙasar masu rai sun gangara wurin marasa kaciya a duniyar da take ƙarƙashi. Suna shan kunya tare da waɗanda suka gangara zuwa rami.
english: “There is Elam and all her multitude around her grave; all of them slain, fallen by the sword, who have gone down uncircumcised into the lower parts of the earth, who caused their terror in the land of the living, and have borne their shame with those who go down to the pit.

hausa: Sa’ad da Gideyon ya gane mala’ikan Ubangiji ne, sai ya ce, “Ya Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka! Na ga mala’ikan Ubangiji ido da ido.”
english: Gideon saw that he was Yahweh’s angel; and Gideon said, “Alas, Lord Yahweh! Because I have seen Yahweh’s angel face to face!”

hausa: ka ce, ‘Ku ji maganar Ubangiji, ya sarakunan Yahuda da kuma mutanen Urushalima. Ga abin da Ubangiji Maɗaukaki, Allah na Isra’ila, yana cewa ku saurara! Zan kawo masifa a wannan wuri, wanda duk ya ji, kunnuwansa za su kaɗa.
english: Say, ‘Hear Yahweh’s word, kings of Judah and inhabitants of Jerusalem: Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel says, “Behold, I will bring evil on this place, which whoever hears, his ears will tingle.

hausa: Sa’an nan sarki ya dawo, ya kuma tafi har zuwa Urdun. To, mutanen Yahuda suka zo Gilgal don su fita su taryi sarki, su kuma kawo shi ƙetaren Urdun.
english: So the king returned, and came to the Jordan. Judah came to Gilgal, to go to meet the king, to bring the king over the Jordan.

hausa: Bari kalmomin bakina da tunanin zuciyata su zama abin gamsuwa a gabanka, Ya Ubangiji, Dutsena da Mai fansata.
english: Let the words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart be acceptable in your sight, Yahweh, my rock, and my redeemer.

hausa: daga kabilar Benyamin, Falti ɗan Rafu;
english: Of the tribe of Benjamin, Palti the son of Raphu.

hausa: Babu ƙaunar da ta fi wannan, a ce mutum ya ba da ransa saboda abokansa.
english: Greater love has no one than this, that someone lay down his life for his friends.

hausa: Gama ko da akwai abubuwan da ake ce da su alloli, a sama ko a ƙasa (don kuwa akwai “alloli” da “iyayengiji” da yawa),
english: For though there are things that are called “gods”, whether in the heavens or on earth—as there are many “gods” and many “lords”—

hausa: “Zan so in ba ka amsa kai tare da abokanka.
english: I will answer you, and your companions with you.

hausa: Kuna gani na yi wannan shirin ba da sanin abin da nake yi ba ne? Ko kuwa, kuna gani na yi shirin nan da halin mutuntaka ne, don in ce, “I” in koma in ce, “A’a”?
english: When I therefore planned this, did I show fickleness? Or the things that I plan, do I plan according to the flesh, that with me there should be the “Yes, yes” and the “No, no?”

hausa: Kan’ana shi ne mahaifin, Sidon ɗan farinsa, da na Hittiyawa,
english: Canaan became the father of Sidon (his firstborn), Heth,

hausa: Amma Yaƙub ya ce masa, “Ranka yă daɗe, ka san cewa ’ya’yan ƙanana ne, dole in lura da tumaki da shanun da suke shayar da jariransu. In aka kore su da gaggawa a rana guda kaɗai, dukan dabbobin za su mutu.
english: Jacob said to him, “My lord knows that the children are tender, and that the flocks and herds with me have their young, and if they overdrive them one day, all the flocks will die.

hausa: Jin haka, sai ta rusuna da fuskata har ƙasa ta ce, “Me ya sa na sami irin wannan tagomashi a idanunka da har ka lura da ni, ni da nake baƙuwa?”
english: Then she fell on her face and bowed herself to the ground, and said to him, “Why have I found favor in your sight, that you should take knowledge of me, since I am a foreigner?”

hausa: Bayan da aka yi yarjejjeniya a Beyersheba, sai Abimelek da Fikol, komandan rundunoninsa suka koma ƙasar Filistiyawa.
english: So they made a covenant at Beersheba. Abimelech rose up with Phicol, the captain of his army, and they returned into the land of the Philistines.

hausa: Yoshuwa kuwa ya sa iyalin Zabdi suka fito mutum-mutum, sai kuwa aka ware Akan ɗan Karmi, ɗan Zimri, ɗan Zera na kabilar Yahuda.
english: He brought near his household man by man, and Achan, the son of Carmi, the son of Zabdi, the son of Zerah, of the tribe of Judah, was selected.

hausa: Da firist nan Fashhur ɗan Immer, babban ma’aikaci a cikin haikalin Ubangiji, ya ji Irmiya yana annabcin waɗannan abubuwa,
english: Now Pashhur, the son of Immer the priest, who was chief officer in Yahweh’s house, heard Jeremiah prophesying these things.

hausa: Saboda haka, duk abin da kuke so mutane su yi muku, ku ma sai ku yi musu, domin wannan shi ne Doka da koyarwar Annabawa sun ƙunsa.
english: Therefore, whatever you desire for men to do to you, you shall also do to them; for this is the law and the prophets.

hausa: “Kada ku taɓa shafaffuna; kada ku yi wa annabawana lahani.”
english: “Don’t touch my anointed ones! Do my prophets no harm!”

hausa: ka sa kunne ka kuma buɗe idanunka ka ji addu’ar da bawanka yake yi a gabanka dare da rana saboda bayinka, mutanen Isra’ila. Na furta zunuban da mu Isra’ilawa, har da ni da kuma gidan mahaifina muka yi maka.
english: let your ear now be attentive and your eyes open, that you may listen to the prayer of your servant which I pray before you at this time, day and night, for the children of Israel your servants, while I confess the sins of the children of Israel which we have sinned against you. Yes, I and my father’s house have sinned.

hausa: Sa’an nan za ku san gaskiya, gaskiyar kuwa za tă ’yantar da ku.”
english: You will know the truth, and the truth will make you free.”

hausa: Sa’an nan Iblis ya bar shi, mala’iku kuwa suka zo suka yi masa hidima.
english: Then the devil left him, and behold, angels came and served him.

hausa: Kamar duwatsun da sun kewaye Urushalima, haka Ubangiji ya kewaye mutanensa yanzu da har abada kuma.
english: As the mountains surround Jerusalem, so Yahweh surrounds his people from this time forward and forever more.

hausa: Kabilar Merari su ne Maliyawa da Mushiyawa; waɗannan su ne kabilar Merari.
english: Of Merari was the family of the Mahlites and the family of the Mushites. These are the families of Merari.

hausa: Sauran kuwa suka ce, “Ƙyale shi mu ga, ko Iliya zai zo yă cece shi.”
english: The rest said, “Let him be. Let’s see whether Elijah comes to save him.”

hausa: “Ɗan mutum, ka rubuta wannan rana, wannan rana, domin sarkin Babilon ya yi ƙawanya wa Urushalima a wannan rana.
english: “Son of man, write the name of the day, this same day. The king of Babylon drew close to Jerusalem this same day.

hausa: Suka ce, “Burodi biyar da kifi biyu ne kawai muke da su a nan.”
english: They told him, “We only have here five loaves and two fish.”

hausa: “Karnuka za su cinye waɗanda suke na Ahab waɗanda suka mutu a cikin birni, tsuntsayen sararin sama kuma za su cinye waɗanda suka mutu a jeji.”
english: The dogs will eat whoever dies of Ahab in the city; and the birds of the sky will eat whoever dies in the field.”

hausa: Ka kau da muguwar magana daga bakinka; ka yi nesa da magana marar kyau daga leɓunanka.
english: Put away from yourself a perverse mouth. Put corrupt lips far from you.

hausa: Amma kashegari kuma da safe suka farka sai ga Dagon ya fāɗi a ƙasa a gaban akwatin alkawarin Ubangiji! Kansa ya fashe, hannuwansa kuma sun kakkarye sun zube a madogarar ƙofa; jikinsa ne kaɗai ya rage.
english: When they arose early on the following morning, behold, Dagon had fallen on his face to the ground before Yahweh’s ark; and the head of Dagon and both the palms of his hands were cut off on the threshold. Only Dagon’s torso was intact.

hausa: Ki yi rawar jiki, ya duniya, a gaban Ubangiji, a gaban Allah na Yaƙub,
english: Tremble, you earth, at the presence of the Lord, at the presence of the God of Jacob,

hausa: Ya amsa masa ya ce, “Wace ce mahaifiyata, su wane ne kuma ’yan’uwana?”
english: But he answered him who spoke to him, “Who is my mother? Who are my brothers?”

hausa: Domin ko ’yan’uwansa ma ba su gaskata da shi ba.
english: For even his brothers didn’t believe in him.

hausa: Ku lura fa kada ku ƙi wanda yake magana. Gama in su ba su tsira sa’ad da suka ƙi wanda ya gargaɗe su a wannan duniya ba, to, ƙaƙa mu za mu tsira, in mun ƙi jin wannan da yake yi mana gargaɗi daga Sama?
english: See that you don’t refuse him who speaks. For if they didn’t escape when they refused him who warned on the earth, how much more will we not escape who turn away from him who warns from heaven,

hausa: amma ka tafi wajen gidan mahaifina da kuma dangina, ka ɗauko wa ɗana mata.’
english: but you shall go to my father’s house, and to my relatives, and take a wife for my son.’

hausa: Bitrus da sauran manzannin suka amsa suka ce, “Dole ne mu yi wa Allah biyayya a maimakon mutane!
english: But Peter and the apostles answered, “We must obey God rather than men.

hausa: Ya ce, “Ubangiji, bawana yana kwance a gida shanyayye, yana kuma shan azaba ƙwarai.”
english: saying, “Lord, my servant lies in the house paralyzed, grievously tormented.”

hausa: Kin yi karuwanci da Masarawa, maƙwabtanki masu kwaɗayi, kika tsokane ni har na yi fushi da ƙarin fasikancinki.
english: You have also committed sexual immorality with the Egyptians, your neighbors, great of flesh; and have multiplied your prostitution, to provoke me to anger.

hausa: Saboda haka, ina roƙonku, ku sāke nuna masa ƙaunarku.
english: Therefore I beg you to confirm your love toward him.

hausa: “Darajar Lebanon za tă zo wurinki, itatuwan fir da dai ire-irensu da kuma itatuwan saifires duka za su zo don su ƙayatar da wurina mai tsarki; zan kuma ɗaukaka wurin ƙafafuna.
english: “The glory of Lebanon shall come to you, the cypress tree, the pine, and the box tree together, to beautify the place of my sanctuary; and I will make the place of my feet glorious.

hausa: Sa’an nan mala’ikan Ubangiji ya umarci Gad yă faɗa wa Dawuda yă haura yă gina bagade wa Ubangiji a masussukar Ornan mutumin Yebus.
english: Then Yahweh’s angel commanded Gad to tell David that David should go up and raise an altar to Yahweh on the threshing floor of Ornan the Jebusite.

hausa: Ku aske kanku ƙwal don makoki, ku yi wa kanku ƙwalƙwal kamar ungulu. Gama za a ja ’ya’yan da kuke farin ciki a kai su bauta.
english: Shave your heads, and cut off your hair for the children of your delight. Enlarge your baldness like the vulture, for they have gone into captivity from you!

hausa: Ga abin da Ubangiji yana cewa, Mai Fansarku, Mai Tsarkin nan na Isra’ila, “Saboda ku zan aika Babilon in kawo dukan Babiloniyawa kamar masu gudun hijira, a cikin jiragen ruwa waɗanda suke taƙama da su.
english: Yahweh, your Redeemer, the Holy One of Israel says: “For your sake, I have sent to Babylon, and I will bring all of them down as fugitives, even the Chaldeans, in the ships of their rejoicing.

hausa: Yanzu sun san cewa duk abin da ka ba ni daga gare ka ya fito.
english: Now they have known that all things whatever you have given me are from you,

hausa: domin kada mutane su ga alama cewa kana azumi, sai dai Ubanka kaɗai wanda ba a gani; Ubanka kuwa mai ganin abin da ake yi a ɓoye, zai sāka maka.
english: so that you are not seen by men to be fasting, but by your Father who is in secret; and your Father, who sees in secret, will reward you.

hausa: Idan mūsu ya tashi tsakanin mutum biyu har abin ya kai su kotu, alƙalai kuwa suka yanke hukunci a kan batun, suka kuɓutar da marar laifi sa’an nan suka hukunta mai laifi,
english: If there is a controversy between men, and they come to judgment and the judges judge them, then they shall justify the righteous and condemn the wicked.

hausa: Duba, jarumawansu suna kuka da ƙarfi a tituna; jakadun salama suna kuka mai zafi.
english: Behold, their valiant ones cry outside; the ambassadors of peace weep bitterly.

hausa: Ga sunayen ’ya’yan Lawi, Gershon, Kohat da Merari.
english: These were the sons of Levi by their names: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.

hausa: Ya umarce ni ya kuma ce mini, “Daniyel, yanzu na zo domin in ba ka hikima da ganewa.
english: He instructed me and talked with me, and said, “Daniel, I have now come to give you wisdom and understanding.

hausa: Dole mutumin da ya kwana da ita yă kawo rago a ƙofar Tentin Sujada domin hadaya don laifi ga Ubangiji.
english: He shall bring his trespass offering to Yahweh, to the door of the Tent of Meeting, even a ram for a trespass offering.

hausa: Saboda sunanka, ya Ubangiji, ka kiyaye raina; a cikin adalcinka, ka fid da ni daga wahala.
english: Revive me, Yahweh, for your name’s sake. In your righteousness, bring my soul out of trouble.

hausa: Duk da haka, kada ku yi farin ciki da cewa, kun sha ƙarfin ruhohi, amma ku yi farin ciki, domin an rubuta sunayenku a sama.”
english: Nevertheless, don’t rejoice in this, that the spirits are subject to you, but rejoice that your names are written in heaven.”

hausa: Hezekiya ya karɓi wasiƙar daga manzannin ya karanta. Sa’an nan ya tashi ya tafi haikalin Ubangiji ya shimfiɗa wasiƙar a gaban Ubangiji.
english: Hezekiah received the letter from the hand of the messengers and read it. Then Hezekiah went up to Yahweh’s house, and spread it before Yahweh.

hausa: Sai na duba, can a gabana kuwa ga Ɗan Rago, tsaye a kan Dutsen Sihiyona, tare da shi akwai kuma mutane 144,000 waɗanda suke da sunansa da sunan Ubansa a rubuce a goshinsu.
english: I saw, and behold, the Lamb standing on Mount Zion, and with him a number, one hundred forty-four thousand, having his name and the name of his Father written on their foreheads.

hausa: Bayan ya gama yin hadaya ta ƙonawa da hadaya ta salama, sai ya albarkaci mutane a cikin sunan Ubangiji Maɗaukaki.
english: When David had finished offering the burnt offering and the peace offerings, he blessed the people in the name of Yahweh of Armies.

hausa: Kaito wanda ya ce da katako, ‘Rayu!’ Ko kuwa dutse marar rai, ‘Farka!’ Zai iya bishewa ne? An dalaye shi da zinariya da azurfa; ba numfashi a cikinsa.”
english: Woe to him who says to the wood, ‘Awake!’ or to the mute stone, ‘Arise!’ Shall this teach? Behold, it is overlaid with gold and silver, and there is no breath at all within it.

hausa: “Sai muryar daga sama ta yi magana sau na biyu, ta ce, ‘Kada ka ce da abin da Allah ya tsarkake marar tsarki.’
english: But a voice answered me the second time out of heaven, ‘What God has cleansed, don’t you call unclean.’

hausa: Kada ku bar kome yă kai gobe, abin da ya kai gobe kuwa, sai ku ƙone shi.
english: You shall let nothing of it remain until the morning; but that which remains of it until the morning you shall burn with fire.

hausa: Suna ta yawo neman abinci su kuwa yi haushi in ba su ƙoshi ba.
english: They shall wander up and down for food, and wait all night if they aren’t satisfied.

hausa: Sai suka amsa suka ce, “Kai da aka haifa cike da zunubi; za ka yi karambanin koyarwar da mu!” Sai suka kore shi.
english: They answered him, “You were altogether born in sins, and do you teach us?” Then they threw him out.

hausa: Kunnuwan da suke ji da kuma idanun da suke gani, Ubangiji ne ya yi su duka.
english: The hearing ear, and the seeing eye, Yahweh has made even both of them.

hausa: Ubangiji ya ce wa Musa,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

hausa: In haka ne Allah yake yi wa ciyayin jeji sutura, wadda yau suna nan, sa’an nan gobe kuma a jefa cikin wuta, Allah ba zai yi muku sutura fiye da ciyayin jeji ba, ya ku masu ƙarancin bangaskiya!
english: But if this is how God clothes the grass in the field, which today exists and tomorrow is cast into the oven, how much more will he clothe you, O you of little faith?

hausa: ya ce wa Efron a kunnuwansu, “Ka ji, in ka yarda. Zan biya farashin filin. Ka karɓa daga gare ni don in iya binne mataccena a can.”
english: He spoke to Ephron in the audience of the people of the land, saying, “But if you will, please hear me. I will give the price of the field. Take it from me, and I will bury my dead there.”

hausa: Ku kiyaye farillaina da dokokina, gama mutumin da ya aikata waɗannan abubuwa zai rayu ta wurinsu. Ni ne Ubangiji.
english: You shall therefore keep my statutes and my ordinances, which if a man does, he shall live in them. I am Yahweh.

hausa: Da safe za ku ga ɗaukakar Ubangiji, saboda ya ji gunaguninku a kansa. Wane mu, da za ku yi gunaguni a kanmu?”
english: In the morning, you shall see Yahweh’s glory; because he hears your murmurings against Yahweh. Who are we, that you murmur against us?”

hausa: Yanzu an ji kome; ga ƙarshen magana. Ka ji tsoron Allah ka kuma kiyaye umarnansa, gama wannan shi ne dukan hakkin mutum.
english: This is the end of the matter. All has been heard. Fear God and keep his commandments; for this is the whole duty of man.

hausa: Dukan wannan ya ɗauki kusan shekaru 450. “Bayan wannan, Allah ya ba su alƙalai har zuwa zamanin annabi Sama’ila.
english: After these things, he gave them judges until Samuel the prophet.

hausa: Sarki ya aika aka kuma sake shi, mai mulkin mutane ya ’yantar da shi.
english: The king sent and freed him, even the ruler of peoples, and let him go free.

hausa: Suka kai Yesu wajen babban firist, sai dukan manyan firistoci, dattawa da kuma malaman dokoki suka taru.
english: They led Jesus away to the high priest. All the chief priests, the elders, and the scribes came together with him.

hausa: don su tanada mini katakai da yawa, domin haikalin da zan gina dole yă zama mai girma da kuma ƙasaitacce.
english: even to prepare timber in abundance for me; for the house which I am about to build will be great and wonderful.

hausa: Suka kuma kama shugabannin biyu na Midiyawa, Oreb da Zeyib suka kashe Oreb a dutsen Oreb, Zeyib kuma a wurin matsin ruwa inabin Zeyib. Suka fatattaki Midiyawa suka kawo kawunan Oreb da Zeba wurin Gideyon, wanda yake kusa da Urdun.
english: They took the two princes of Midian, Oreb and Zeeb. They killed Oreb at Oreb’s rock, and Zeeb they killed at Zeeb’s wine press, as they pursued Midian. Then they brought the heads of Oreb and Zeeb to Gideon beyond the Jordan.

hausa: Na nutse cikin laka mai zurfi, inda babu wurin tsayawa. Na shiga cikin ruwaye masu zurfi; rigyawa ya sha kaina.
english: I sink in deep mire, where there is no foothold. I have come into deep waters, where the floods overflow me.

hausa: Darajar Efraim za tă yi firiya tă tafi kamar tsuntsu, ba haihuwa, ba juna biyu, ba ɗaukar ciki.
english: As for Ephraim, their glory will fly away like a bird. There will be no birth, no one with child, and no conception.

hausa: Taron mutane mai girma kuwa suka zo wurinsa, suna kawo masa guragu, makafi, shanyayyu, kurame da dai waɗansu da yawa, suka kuwa kwantar da su a gabansa; ya kuma warkar da su.
english: Great multitudes came to him, having with them the lame, blind, mute, maimed, and many others, and they put them down at his feet. He healed them,

hausa: ta ashirin da biyu a kan Giddalti, na goma sha biya a kan Yerimot, ’ya’yansa maza da danginsa, 12
english: for the twenty-second to Giddalti, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

hausa: Aka kawo awaki domin hadaya don zunubi a gaban sarki da taron, suka kuwa ɗibiya hannuwansu a kansu.
english: They brought near the male goats for the sin offering before the king and the assembly; and they laid their hands on them.

hausa: Wuta tana tafiya a gabansa tana kuma cinye maƙiyansa a kowane gefe.
english: A fire goes before him, and burns up his adversaries on every side.

hausa: Elidad ɗan Kislon, daga kabilar Benyamin;
english: Of the tribe of Benjamin, Elidad the son of Chislon.

hausa: To, Dokar ce tana gāba da alkawaran Allah ke nan? Sam, ko kaɗan! Gama da a ce an ba da Dokar da tana iya ba da rai, tabbatacce, da sai a sami adalci ta wurin Doka.
english: Is the law then against the promises of God? Certainly not! For if there had been a law given which could make alive, most certainly righteousness would have been of the law.

hausa: Ka tambayi bayinka za su kuwa gaya maka. Saboda haka ka yi wa mutanena kirki, gama yau ranar biki ce. Ina roƙonka ka ba wa samarina, wato, bayinka, da ni ɗanka Dawuda, duk abin da kake iya ba su.”
english: Ask your young men, and they will tell you. Therefore let the young men find favor in your eyes, for we come on a good day. Please give whatever comes to your hand to your servants and to your son David.’”

hausa: Ya aikata abin da yake daidai a gaban Ubangiji ya kuma bi dukan gurbin kakansa Dawuda, bai bauɗe hagu ko dama ba.
english: He did that which was right in Yahweh’s eyes, and walked in all the ways of David his father, and didn’t turn away to the right hand or to the left.

hausa: Mala’ika na shida ya busa ƙahonsa, sai na ji murya tana fitowa daga ƙahonin bagaden zinariya da suke a gaban Allah.
english: The sixth angel sounded. I heard a voice from the horns of the golden altar which is before God,

hausa: Za a yanka hadaya don laifi a inda ake yanka hadaya ta ƙonawa, za a kuma yayyafa jinin a kowane gefe na bagade.
english: In the place where they kill the burnt offering, he shall kill the trespass offering; and its blood he shall sprinkle around on the altar.

hausa: balle jinin Kiristi, wanda ta wurin Ruhu madawwami ya miƙa kansa marar aibi ga Allah, ai, zai tsabtacce lamirinmu daga ayyukan da suke kai ga mutuwa, don mu bauta wa Allah mai rai!
english: how much more will the blood of Christ, who through the eternal Spirit offered himself without defect to God, cleanse your conscience from dead works to serve the living God?

hausa: Sai ku ce musu, ruwan Urdun ya yanke a gaban akwatin alkawari na Ubangiji, a lokacin da akwatin alkawarin ya ƙetare Urdun. Waɗannan duwatsu za su zama abin tuni ga Isra’ilawa har abada.”
english: then you shall tell them, ‘Because the waters of the Jordan were cut off before the ark of Yahweh’s covenant. When it crossed over the Jordan, the waters of the Jordan were cut off. These stones shall be for a memorial to the children of Israel forever.’”

hausa: Dare farai a kan gadona na nemi wanda zuciyata take ƙauna; na neme shi amma ban same shi ba.
english: By night on my bed, I sought him whom my soul loves. I sought him, but I didn’t find him.

hausa: Sai matar Yerobowam ta tashi ta tafi, ta kuwa tafi Tirza. Nan da nan da ta taka madogarar ƙofar gidan, sai yaron ya mutu.
english: Jeroboam’s wife arose and departed, and came to Tirzah. As she came to the threshold of the house, the child died.

hausa: Yowab ya ce wa mutumin da ya ba shi labarin, “Mene! Ka ga shi? Don me ba ka buge shi har ƙasa nan da nan ba? Ai, da na ba ka shekel goma na azurfa da abin ɗamarar jarumi.”
english: Joab said to the man who told him, “Behold, you saw it, and why didn’t you strike him there to the ground? I would have given you ten pieces of silver and a sash.”

hausa: “Je, ka faɗa musu su koma tentunansu.
english: “Go tell them, ‘Return to your tents.’

hausa: Sai suka ce, “Mutanen Galili, don me kuke tsaye a nan kuna duban sararin sama? Wannan Yesu, wanda aka ɗauke daga gare ku zuwa sama, zai komo daidai yadda kuka ga ya tafi sama.”
english: who also said, “You men of Galilee, why do you stand looking into the sky? This Jesus, who was received up from you into the sky, will come back in the same way as you saw him going into the sky.”

hausa: Sa’an nan za ki ce a zuciyarki, ‘Wa ya haifa waɗannan? Na yi baƙin ciki na kuma zama wadda ba ta haihuwa; an yi mini daurin talala aka kuma ƙi ni. Wane ne ya yi renon waɗannan? An bar ni ni kaɗai, amma waɗannan, ina suka fito?’ ”
english: Then you will say in your heart, ‘Who has conceived these for me, since I have been bereaved of my children and am alone, an exile, and wandering back and forth? Who has brought these up? Behold, I was left alone. Where were these?’”

hausa: Sai ya zaɓi samari goma ya aike su wurin Nabal a Karmel su gaishe shi a madadinsa,
english: David sent ten young men; and David said to the young men, “Go up to Carmel, and go to Nabal, and greet him in my name.

hausa: sai ya ce musu, “Na yi mafarkin da ya dame ni kuma ina so in san me yake nufi.”
english: The king said to them, “I have dreamed a dream, and my spirit is troubled to know the dream.”

hausa: da Ahiya, da Hanan, da Anan,
english: Ahiah, Hanan, Anan,

hausa: Lokacin da ya gudu zuwa ɗaya daga cikin biranen nan, sai yă tsaya a ƙofar birnin yă gaya wa dattawan wannan birni damuwarsa. Sa’an nan su karɓe shi su ba shi wurin zama a cikin birninsu.
english: He shall flee to one of those cities, and shall stand at the entrance of the gate of the city, and declare his case in the ears of the elders of that city. They shall take him into the city with them, and give him a place, that he may live among them.

hausa: “Idanunsa suna kan al’amuran mutane; yana ganin tafiyarsu duka.
english: “For his eyes are on the ways of a man. He sees all his goings.

hausa: Elkana, Ebiyasaf, Assir,
english: Elkanah his son, Ebiasaph his son, Assir his son,

hausa: Zan yi murna in kuma yi farin ciki a cikinka; zan rera yabo ga sunanka, ya Mafi Ɗaukaka.
english: I will be glad and rejoice in you. I will sing praise to your name, O Most High.

hausa: Aristarkus yana a kurkuku tare da ni. Yana gaishe ku, haka ma Markus, wanda kakansa ɗaya ne da Barnabas. (Shi ne na riga na yi magana a kansa, na ce muku in ya zo, ku karɓe shi hannu biyu-biyu.)
english: Aristarchus, my fellow prisoner, greets you, and Mark the cousin of Barnabas (concerning whom you received instructions, “if he comes to you, receive him”),

hausa: Zai zama abin murna da farin ciki a gare ka, mutane da yawa kuwa za su yi murna don haihuwarsa,
english: You will have joy and gladness, and many will rejoice at his birth.

hausa: Bari a kawo ruwa ku wanke ƙafafunku, ku huta a ƙarƙashin wannan itace.
english: Now let a little water be fetched, wash your feet, and rest yourselves under the tree.

hausa: duk da haka mahaifinku ya cuce ni ta wurin sauya albashina sau goma. Amma dai, Allah bai yardar masa yă yi mini lahani ba.
english: Your father has deceived me, and changed my wages ten times, but God didn’t allow him to hurt me.

hausa: Yowab ɗan Zeruhiya ya zama shugaban sojoji; Yehoshafat ɗan Ahilud kuwa shi ne marubucin tarihi;
english: Joab the son of Zeruiah was over the army, Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud was recorder,

hausa: A fili yake ba wanda zai kuɓuta a gaban Allah ta wurin Doka, domin “Mai adalci zai rayu ta wurin bangaskiya.”
english: Now that no man is justified by the law before God is evident, for, “The righteous will live by faith.”

hausa: Ya ce wa taron, “Sa’ad da kuka ga hadari ya fito daga yamma, nan da nan kukan ce, ‘Za a yi ruwan sama,’ sai a kuwa yi.
english: He said to the multitudes also, “When you see a cloud rising from the west, immediately you say, ‘A shower is coming,’ and so it happens.

hausa: Siman ya amsa ya ce, “Ranka yă daɗe, duk dare mun yi ta fama ba mu kama kome ba, amma tun da ka ce haka, zan saki abin kamun kifin.”
english: Simon answered him, “Master, we worked all night and caught nothing; but at your word I will let down the net.”

hausa: daga kabilar Gad, Eliyasaf ɗan Deyuwel;
english: Of Gad: Eliasaph the son of Deuel.

hausa: Gama Ubangiji yana ƙaunar masu aikata daidai kuma ba zai yashe amintattunsa ba. Za a hallaka masu aikata mugunta gaba ɗaya, ’ya’yan mugaye za su hallaka.
english: For Yahweh loves justice, and doesn’t forsake his saints. They are preserved forever, but the children of the wicked shall be cut off.

hausa: kuma fikafikansu suna taɓan juna. Kowanne ya miƙe gaba; ba sa juyawa sa’ad da suke tafiya.
english: Their wings were joined to one another. They didn’t turn when they went. Each one went straight forward.

hausa: Akwai wani mai ba da shaida mai kyau a kaina, na kuma san cewa shaidarsa game da ni gaskiya ce.
english: It is another who testifies about me. I know that the testimony which he testifies about me is true.

hausa: Ya harbe kibiyoyi, ya wartsar da abokan gāba, da walƙiya kuma ya sa suka gudu.
english: He sent out arrows and scattered them, lightning and confused them.

hausa: Sa’an nan Musa ya keɓe birane uku gabas da Urdun,
english: Then Moses set apart three cities beyond the Jordan toward the sunrise,

hausa: Saboda halin kama-karyar da kika yi wa ɗan’uwanka Yaƙub, za ki sha kunya; za a hallaka ki har abada.
english: For the violence done to your brother Jacob, shame will cover you, and you will be cut off forever.

hausa: Shi da ya fita yana kuka, riƙe da iri don shuki, zai dawo da waƙoƙin farin ciki, ɗauke da dammuna.
english: He who goes out weeping, carrying seed for sowing, will certainly come again with joy, carrying his sheaves.

hausa: Yana koya mana mu ce, “A’a” ga rashin tsoron Allah da kuma sha’awace-sha’awacen duniya, mu kuma yi rayuwa ta kamunkai, ta adalci da kuma ta tsoron Allah a cikin wannan zamani,
english: instructing us to the intent that, denying ungodliness and worldly lusts, we would live soberly, righteously, and godly in this present age;

hausa: Na duba, sai na ga kusa da kerubobin akwai da’irori huɗu, kowanne kusa da kerub guda; da’irorin suna ƙyalli kamar wani dutse mai daraja.
english: I looked, and behold, there were four wheels beside the cherubim, one wheel beside one cherub, and another wheel beside another cherub. The appearance of the wheels was like a beryl stone.

hausa: Yanzu fa idanun Isra’ila sun fara rasa ƙarfi saboda tsufa, har ba ya iya gani sosai. Saboda haka Yusuf ya kawo ’ya’yansa maza kusa da shi, sai mahaifinsa ya sumbace su ya rungume su.
english: Now the eyes of Israel were dim for age, so that he couldn’t see well. Joseph brought them near to him; and he kissed them, and embraced them.

hausa: sai taro mai yawa na mutane suka bi shi domin sun ga abubuwan banmamakin da ya yi ga marasa lafiya.
english: A great multitude followed him, because they saw his signs which he did on those who were sick.

hausa: Wani saurayi ya sheƙa a guje zuwa wajen Musa ya ce, “Eldad da Medad suna can suna annabci a sansani.”
english: A young man ran, and told Moses, and said, “Eldad and Medad are prophesying in the camp!”

hausa: Za ku ci amma ba za ku ƙoshi ba, cikinku zai zama babu kome Za ku tattara amma ba za ku yi ajiyar kome ba, gama abin da kuka yi ajiya zan ba wa takobi.
english: You shall eat, but not be satisfied. Your hunger will be within you. You will store up, but not save, and that which you save I will give up to the sword.

hausa: Wace riba ce kuka samu a lokacin, daga abubuwan nan da yanzu suka zama muku abin kunya? Ƙarshen irin abubuwan nan dai, mutuwa ne!
english: What fruit then did you have at that time in the things of which you are now ashamed? For the end of those things is death.

hausa: Ya bi gurbin sarakunan Isra’ila, yadda gidan Ahab ta yi, gama ya auri ’yar Ahab. Ya yi mugunta a gaban Ubangiji.
english: He walked in the way of the kings of Israel, as did Ahab’s house, for he married Ahab’s daughter. He did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight.

hausa: Sa’an nan Ruhun Ubangiji ya sauko a kan Yahaziyel ɗan Zakariya, ɗan Benahiya, ɗan Yehiyel, ɗan Mattaniya, wani Balawe kuma zuriyar Asaf, yayinda yake tsaye a cikin taron.
english: Then Yahweh’s Spirit came on Jahaziel the son of Zechariah, the son of Benaiah, the son of Jeiel, the son of Mattaniah, the Levite, of the sons of Asaph, in the middle of the assembly;

hausa: Shawulu ya yi ƙoƙari yă kafe shi da bango da māshinsa, amma Dawuda ya goce sa’ad da Shawulu jefa māshin a bango. A daren nan Dawuda ya nemi hanya ya gudu.
english: Saul sought to pin David to the wall with the spear, but he slipped away out of Saul’s presence; and he stuck the spear into the wall. David fled and escaped that night.

hausa: Sai ya yi tambaya ya ce, “Ina kuka sa shi?” Suka amsa suka ce, “Ubangiji zo ka gani.”
english: and said, “Where have you laid him?” They told him, “Lord, come and see.”

hausa: Sai Ubangiji ya ce, “Mene ne wannan a hannunka?” Musa ya amsa ya ce, “Sanda.”
english: Yahweh said to him, “What is that in your hand?” He said, “A rod.”

hausa: “Ku kiyaye Bikin Makoni wato, bikin girbin nunan fari na alkama, da Bikin Gama Tattara amfanin gonaki, a ƙarshen shekara.
english: “You shall observe the feast of weeks with the first fruits of wheat harvest, and the feast of harvest at the year’s end.

hausa: kowane irin hankaka,
english: any kind of raven,

hausa: Amma a shekara ta bakwai, ƙasar za tă sami hutun Asabbaci, Asabbaci ga Ubangiji. Kada ku yi shuki a gonakinku, ko kuwa ku aske gonakinku na inabi.
english: but in the seventh year there shall be a Sabbath of solemn rest for the land, a Sabbath to Yahweh. You shall not sow your field or prune your vineyard.

hausa: In idonka na dama yana sa ka yin zunubi, ƙwaƙule shi ka yar. Zai fiye maka ka rasa ɗaya daga cikin gaɓoɓin jikinka, da a jefa jikinka ɗungum a cikin jahannama ta wuta.
english: If your right eye causes you to stumble, pluck it out and throw it away from you. For it is more profitable for you that one of your members should perish than for your whole body to be cast into Gehenna.

hausa: Ezer shi ne babba, Obadiya shi ne mai binsa a shugabanci, Eliyab na uku,
english: Ezer the chief, Obadiah the second, Eliab the third,

hausa: Yanzu sai ku ƙarasa aikin da irin niyyar da kuka fara, ku yi haka gwargwadon ƙarfinku.
english: But now complete the doing also, that as there was the readiness to be willing, so there may be the completion also out of your ability.

hausa: Kwarurukanku mafi kyau sun cika da kekunan yaƙi, an kuma tsai da mahayan dawakai a ƙofofin birni.
english: Your choicest valleys were full of chariots, and the horsemen set themselves in array at the gate.

hausa: “Sa’ad da wani yana da kumburi, ko ɓamɓaroki, ko tabo a fatar jikinsa da zai iya zama cutar fatar jiki, dole a kawo shi ga Haruna firist, ko kuwa ga ɗaya a cikin ’ya’yansa maza wanda yake firist.
english: “When a man shall have a swelling in his body’s skin, or a scab, or a bright spot, and it becomes in the skin of his body the plague of leprosy, then he shall be brought to Aaron the priest or to one of his sons, the priests.

hausa: Yanzu, bari Ubangiji mai salama kansa yă ba ku salama a kowane lokaci da kuma a ta kowace hanya. Ubangiji yă kasance tare da ku duka.
english: Now may the Lord of peace himself give you peace at all times in all ways. The Lord be with you all.

hausa: Game da sauran ayyukan mulkin Omri, abin da ya yi, da kuma abubuwan da ya yi, duk a rubuce suke a cikin littafin tarihin sarakunan Isra’ila.
english: Now the rest of the acts of Omri which he did, and his might that he showed, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

hausa: Mai hari yana matsowa a kanki, Ninebe. Ki tsare mafaka, ki yi gadin hanya ki sha ɗamara ki tattaro dukan ƙarfinki!
english: He who dashes in pieces has come up against you. Keep the fortress! Watch the way! Strengthen your waist! Fortify your power mightily!

hausa: “Wannan zai zama alama gare ka, ya Hezekiya, “Wannan shekara za ka ci abin da ya yi girma da kansa, shekara ta biyu kuma abin da ya tsiro daga wancan. Amma a shekara ta uku za ka yi shuki ka kuma girba, za ka dasa gonakin inabi ka kuma ci ’ya’yansu.
english: “‘This shall be the sign to you: You will eat this year that which grows of itself, and in the second year that which springs from it; and in the third year sow and reap and plant vineyards, and eat their fruit.

hausa: A shekara ta talatin, a wata na huɗu a rana biyar, yayinda nake cikin ’yan zaman bauta kusa da Kogin Kebar, sai sammai suka buɗe na kuwa ga wahayoyin Allah.
english: Now in the thirtieth year, in the fourth month, in the fifth day of the month, as I was among the captives by the river Chebar, the heavens were opened, and I saw visions of God.

hausa: Sai Ayuba ya amsa,
english: Then Job answered,

hausa: Ba a taɓa ganin abu haka ba ko dā can, ranar da Ubangiji ya saurari mutum. Ba shakka Ubangiji yana yaƙi domin Isra’ilawa.
english: There was no day like that before it or after it, that Yahweh listened to the voice of a man; for Yahweh fought for Israel.

hausa: daga kabilar Zebulun, Eliyab ɗan Helon;
english: Of Zebulun: Eliab the son of Helon.

hausa: “ ‘Sarki zai kasance da fili da ya yi iyaka da kowane gefe na yankin wuri mai tsarki da kuma mallakar birnin. Zai miƙe ya yi wajen yamma daga gefen yamma ya kuma yi wajen gabas daga gefen gabas, yana miƙewa a tsawo daga wajen yamma zuwa wajen gabashin iyaka don yă yi hannun riga da rabon kabilan.
english: “‘“What is for the prince shall be on the one side and on the other side of the holy allotment and of the possession of the city, in front of the holy allotment and in front of the possession of the city, on the west side westward, and on the east side eastward, and in length corresponding to one of the portions, from the west border to the east border.

hausa: Ya kuma yi dakalai guda goma na tagulla da ake iya matsar da su; kowane tsawonsa kamu huɗu ne, fāɗinsa kamu huɗu, tsayinsa kuma kamu uku.
english: He made the ten bases of bronze. The length of one base was four cubits, four cubits its width, and three cubits its height.

hausa: Zan aika da mai hallakarwa a kanki, kowane mutum da makamansa, za su kuma yayyanka gumaguman al’ul na ki masu kyau su jefa su cikin wuta.
english: I will prepare destroyers against you, everyone with his weapons, and they will cut down your choice cedars, and cast them into the fire.

hausa: Ku kiyaye su, ku aikata su, gama yin haka zai tabbatar wa sauran al’ummai, kuna da hikima da ganewa. Sa’ad da al’ummai za su ji waɗannan dokoki, za su ce, “Ba shakka, wannan babbar al’umma tana da hikima da ganewa.”
english: Keep therefore and do them; for this is your wisdom and your understanding in the sight of the peoples who shall hear all these statutes and say, “Surely this great nation is a wise and understanding people.”

hausa: Da suka taru a Galili, sai ya ce musu, “Za a bashe Ɗan Mutum, a hannun mutane.
english: While they were staying in Galilee, Jesus said to them, “The Son of Man is about to be delivered up into the hands of men,

hausa: amma ku gwada kome, ku riƙe abin da yake mai kyau,
english: Test all things, and hold firmly that which is good.

hausa: Birnin ba ya bukatar rana ko wata su haskaka shi, gama ɗaukakar Allah tana ba shi haske, Ɗan Ragon kuwa shi ne fitilar birnin.
english: The city has no need for the sun or moon to shine, for the very glory of God illuminated it and its lamp is the Lamb.

hausa: Maganar Ubangiji ta zo mini cewa,
english: Also Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

hausa: Sai ya faɗa musu wannan misali ya ce, “Ba wanda yakan yage ƙyalle daga sabuwar riga ya yi wa tsohuwar riga faci. In ya yi haka, zai yage sabuwar rigar, kuma facin daga sabuwar ba zai dace da tsohuwar rigar ba.
english: He also told a parable to them. “No one puts a piece from a new garment on an old garment, or else he will tear the new, and also the piece from the new will not match the old.

hausa: “Na bayyana kaina ga waɗanda ba su tambaye ni ba; ina samuwa ga waɗanda ba su neme ni ba. Ga al’ummar da ba tă kira bisa sunana ba, Na ce, ‘Ga ni, ga ni.’
english: “I am inquired of by those who didn’t ask. I am found by those who didn’t seek me. I said, ‘See me, see me,’ to a nation that was not called by my name.

hausa: Don me kuka tsaya a wutar sansani don ku ji makiyaya suna kiran garkuna? A yankunan Ruben aka yi bincike zuciya sosai.
english: Why did you sit among the sheepfolds? To hear the whistling for the flocks? At the watercourses of Reuben, there were great searchings of heart.

hausa: Sai suka sāke gaya masa abin da suka faɗa cewa, “Ga abin da zai faru da wanda ya kashe shi.”
english: The people answered him in this way, saying, “So shall it be done to the man who kills him.”

hausa: In mutum ya sāka alheri da mugunta, mugunta ba za tă taɓa barin gidansa ba.
english: Whoever rewards evil for good, evil shall not depart from his house.

hausa: Gama dole yă yi mulki har sai ya sa dukan abokan gābansa a ƙarƙashin ƙafafunsa.
english: For he must reign until he has put all his enemies under his feet.

hausa: Isra’ila ya yi tambaya, “Me ya sa kuka kawo wannan damuwa a kaina ta wurin faɗa wa mutumin cewa kuna da wani ɗan’uwa?”
english: Israel said, “Why did you treat me so badly, telling the man that you had another brother?”

hausa: Zan sa iyaka tsakanin jama’ata da jama’arka. Gobe ne wannan mu’ujiza za tă auku.’ ”
english: I will put a division between my people and your people. This sign shall happen by tomorrow.”’”

hausa: In sa’ad da firist ya bincike shi, cutar rigar ta bushe bayan da aka wanke kayan, sai yă yage sashen da cutar ta shafa na rigar, ko fatar, ko tariyar zaren, ko kuwa na kayan da aka saƙa.
english: If the priest looks, and behold, the plague has faded after it is washed, then he shall tear it out of the garment, or out of the skin, or out of the warp, or out of the woof;

hausa: wanda cikin fushi ya kashe mutane da bugu marar ƙarewa, kuma cikin fushi ya mamaye al’ummai da fushi ba ƙaƙƙautawa.
english: who struck the peoples in wrath with a continual stroke, who ruled the nations in anger, with a persecution that no one restrained.

hausa: Wannan gaskiya ce musamman ga waɗanda suke bin sha’awace-sha’awacen lalaci na mutuntaka, suna kuma rena masu mulki. Da ƙarfin hali da kuma girman kai, waɗannan mutane ba sa tsoro kawo zargin ɓata sunan talikan sama;
english: but chiefly those who walk after the flesh in the lust of defilement and despise authority. Daring, self-willed, they are not afraid to speak evil of dignitaries,

hausa: Sai ya yi wuf da ƙafafunsa ya fara tafiya. Ya tafi tare da su ya shiga cikin filin haikali yana tafiya yana tsalle, yana kuma yabon Allah.
english: Leaping up, he stood and began to walk. He entered with them into the temple, walking, leaping, and praising God.

hausa: Suka tashi daga Zalmona, suka yi sansani a Funon.
english: They traveled from Zalmonah, and encamped in Punon.

hausa: yayinda nake cikin addu’a, sai Jibra’ilu, mutumin nan da na gani a wahayin da ya wuce, ya zo wurina gaggauce wajen lokacin yin hadaya ta yamma.
english: yes, while I was speaking in prayer—the man Gabriel, whom I had seen in the vision at the beginning, being caused to fly swiftly, touched me about the time of the evening offering.

hausa: Ku ƙirga kwana hamsin har zuwa kashegarin Asabbaci na bakwai, sa’an nan ku miƙa hadaya ta sabon hatsi ga Ubangiji.
english: The next day after the seventh Sabbath you shall count fifty days; and you shall offer a new meal offering to Yahweh.

hausa: Ana nan, sai wani Balawe ya auri wata Balawiya,
english: A man of the house of Levi went and took a daughter of Levi as his wife.

hausa: Gama na sani yadda kuke ’yan tawaye da masu taurinkai. In kuna yin tawaye ga Ubangiji tun ina da rai tare da ku, yaya tawayen da za ku yi masa bayan na rasu!
english: For I know your rebellion and your stiff neck. Behold, while I am yet alive with you today, you have been rebellious against Yahweh. How much more after my death?

hausa: Haka ya kasance shekaru ashirin da na yi a gidanka. Na yi maka aiki shekaru goma sha huɗu domin ’ya’yanka mata biyu, na kuma yi shekaru shida domin garkunanka, ka kuma canja albashina sau goma.
english: These twenty years I have been in your house. I served you fourteen years for your two daughters, and six years for your flock, and you have changed my wages ten times.

hausa: Amma Arameyawa suka gudu a gaban Isra’ila, mutanen Dawuda kuwa suka kashe masu hawan keken yaƙinsu dubu bakwai da sojojin ƙasa dubu arba’in. Ya kuma kashe Shobak shugaban mayaƙansu.
english: The Syrians fled before Israel; and David killed of the Syrian men seven thousand charioteers and forty thousand footmen, and also killed Shophach the captain of the army.

hausa: Kada ka ƙyifce ido a ruwan inabi sa’ad da ya yi ja, sa’ad da yana da kyan gani a cikin ƙwarya, sa’ad da yana gangarawa sumul a maƙogwaro!
english: Don’t look at the wine when it is red, when it sparkles in the cup, when it goes down smoothly.

hausa: Adalci yakan ɗaukaka al’umma, amma zunubi kan kawo kunya ga kowane mutane.
english: Righteousness exalts a nation, but sin is a disgrace to any people.

hausa: Wane ne wannan mai zuwa daga hamada kamar tunnuƙewar hayaƙi, cike da ƙanshin turaren mur da lubban da aka yi da kayan yajin ’yan kasuwa?
english: Who is this who comes up from the wilderness like pillars of smoke, perfumed with myrrh and frankincense, with all spices of the merchant?

hausa: Bai kamata ku ji tsorona ba?” In ji Ubangiji. “Bai kamata ku yi rawar jiki a gabana ba? Na sa yashi ya zama iyakar teku, madawwamiyar iyakar da ba zai tsallake ba. Raƙuman ruwa za su iya yin hauka, amma ba za su iya haye ta ba; za su iya yin ruri, amma ba za su iya ƙetare ta ba.
english: Don’t you fear me?’ says Yahweh; ‘Won’t you tremble at my presence, who have placed the sand for the bound of the sea by a perpetual decree, that it can’t pass it? Though its waves toss themselves, yet they can’t prevail. Though they roar, they still can’t pass over it.’

hausa: Sa’an nan Shafan magatakarda ya sanar da sarki ya ce, “Hilkiya firist ya ba ni wani littafi.” Sai Shafan ya karanta daga cikinsa a gaban sarki.
english: Shaphan the scribe told the king, saying, “Hilkiah the priest has delivered me a book.” Shaphan read from it to the king.

hausa: A wannan lokaci, Tattenai gwamnan Kewayen Kogin Yuferites, da Shetar-Bozenai da abokansu suka je wurinsu suka tambaye su cewa, “Wa ya ba ku iko ku sāke gina wannan haikali har ku gyara katangar?”
english: At the same time Tattenai, the governor beyond the River, came to them, with Shetharbozenai and their companions, and asked them, “Who gave you a decree to build this house and to finish this wall?”

hausa: Ku yabi Ubangiji da garaya; ku yi kiɗi gare shi da molo mai tsirkiya goma.
english: Give thanks to Yahweh with the lyre. Sing praises to him with the harp of ten strings.

hausa: Kamar yadda ruwan tsami yake ga haƙora hayaƙi kuma ga idanu, haka malalaci yake ga wanda ya aike shi.
english: As vinegar to the teeth, and as smoke to the eyes, so is the sluggard to those who send him.

hausa: Ku busa ƙahon rago a Sabon Wata, da kuma sa’ad da wata ya kai tsakiya, a ranar Bikinmu;
english: Blow the trumpet at the New Moon, at the full moon, on our feast day.

hausa: Allah ya gane hanyar zuwa wurinta. Shi ne kaɗai ya san inda take zama,
english: “God understands its way, and he knows its place.

hausa: Ubangiji Allahnmu bai bayyana abubuwa na yanzu da na nan gaba ba, amma ya umarce mu mu kiyaye kalmomin dokar da ya ba mu, mu da kuma ’ya’yanmu har abada.
english: The secret things belong to Yahweh our God; but the things that are revealed belong to us and to our children forever, that we may do all the words of this law.

hausa: A ƙarshen kowace shekara uku, ku kawo dukan zakkarku na amfanin gona na wannan shekara, ku ajiye su a cikin birane,
english: At the end of every three years you shall bring all the tithe of your increase in the same year, and shall store it within your gates.

hausa: Obadiya ya yi tambaya, “Me na yi da ba daidai ba, da kake miƙa bawanka ga Ahab don yă kashe?
english: He said, “How have I sinned, that you would deliver your servant into the hand of Ahab, to kill me?

hausa: za su rera a gaban Ubangiji, gama yana zuwa, yana zuwa don yă hukunta duniya. Zai hukunta duniya cikin adalci mutane kuma cikin amincinsa.
english: before Yahweh; for he comes, for he comes to judge the earth. He will judge the world with righteousness, the peoples with his truth.

hausa: Yanzu sai ka ba ni wannan ƙasar da take kan tudu wadda Ubangiji ya yi alkawari zai ba ni a ranan nan. Kai ma ka ji a lokacin, yadda Anakawa suke a can, biranensu manya ne kuma sun kewaye su sosai, amma na sani Ubangiji zai taimake ni, zan kore su kamar yadda ya faɗa.”
english: Now therefore give me this hill country, of which Yahweh spoke in that day; for you heard in that day how the Anakim were there, and great and fortified cities. It may be that Yahweh will be with me, and I shall drive them out, as Yahweh said.”

hausa: Waɗannan su ne ’ya’yan Etam. Yezireyel, Ishma da Idbash. ’Yar’uwarsu ita ce Hazzelelfoni.
english: These were the sons of the father of Etam: Jezreel, Ishma, and Idbash. The name of their sister was Hazzelelponi.

hausa: Ba matattu ba ne masu yabon Ubangiji, waɗanda suke gangara zuwa wurin da ake shiru;
english: The dead don’t praise Yah, nor any who go down into silence,

hausa: da ta Ya’ala, da ta Darkon, da ta Giddel,
english: the children of Jaala, the children of Darkon, the children of Giddel,

hausa: Sa’an nan, bayan da sha’awar ta yi ciki, takan haifi zunubi; zunubi kuwa, sa’ad da ya balaga yakan haifi mutuwa.
english: Then the lust, when it has conceived, bears sin. The sin, when it is full grown, produces death.

hausa: Gama zan tā da makiyayi a ƙasar wanda ba zai kula da ɓatattu, ko yă nemi ƙanana, ko yă warkar da waɗanda suka ji ciwo, ko kuma ciyar da masu lafiya ba, sai dai zai ci naman keɓaɓɓun tumaki, yă farfasa kofatonsu.
english: For, behold, I will raise up a shepherd in the land who will not visit those who are cut off, neither will seek those who are scattered, nor heal that which is broken, nor feed that which is sound; but he will eat the meat of the fat sheep, and will tear their hoofs in pieces.

hausa: Sai sarkin Assuriya ya aika da babban shugaban sojojinsa, da shugaban dattawansa, da wakilinsa daga birnin Lakish tare da ƙungiyar sojoji masu yawa zuwa Urushalima domin su yaƙi Sarki Hezekiya. Da suka haura sai suka tsaya a wurin lambatun da yake kawo ruwa daga Tafkin Tudu, kusa da hanyar Filin Mai Wanki.
english: The king of Assyria sent Tartan, Rabsaris, and Rabshakeh from Lachish to King Hezekiah with a great army to Jerusalem. They went up and came to Jerusalem. When they had come up, they came and stood by the conduit of the upper pool, which is in the highway of the fuller’s field.

hausa: Sa’ad da aka tara budurwai karo na biyu, Mordekai kuwa yana zama a bakin ƙofar sarki.
english: When the virgins were gathered together the second time, Mordecai was sitting in the king’s gate.

hausa: sai a kawo ta a ƙofar gidan mahaifinta, a can mazan gari za su jajjefe ta da dutse har tă mutu. Ta yi abin kunya a Isra’ila ta wurin lalaci a yayinda take a gidan mahaifinta. Dole ku fid da mugu daga cikinku.
english: then they shall bring out the young lady to the door of her father’s house, and the men of her city shall stone her to death with stones, because she has done folly in Israel, to play the prostitute in her father’s house. So you shall remove the evil from among you.

hausa: Wannan turare ai, da an sayar da shi da kuɗi mai yawa a ba matalauta kuɗin.”
english: For this ointment might have been sold for much and given to the poor.”

hausa: Saboda haka, sai mu fita mu je wajensa a bayan sansani, muna ɗaukar kunyar da ya sha.
english: Let’s therefore go out to him outside of the camp, bearing his reproach.

hausa: Gama za a datse mugayen mutane, amma waɗanda suke sa zuciya ga Ubangiji za su gāji ƙasar.
english: For evildoers shall be cut off, but those who wait for Yahweh shall inherit the land.

hausa: Sai suka fara ce masa, “Ranka yă daɗe sarkin Yahudawa!”
english: They began to salute him, “Hail, King of the Jews!”

hausa: Saboda haka suka kama ta yayinda take kaiwa mashigin Ƙofar Doki a filin fada, a can suka kashe ta.
english: So they made way for her. She went to the entrance of the horse gate to the king’s house; and they killed her there.

hausa: Amma zan hukunta al’ummar da suka yi bauta kamar bayi, daga baya kuma za su fita da mallaka mai yawa.
english: I will also judge that nation, whom they will serve. Afterward they will come out with great wealth;

hausa: Yanzu za mu ji cewa ku ma kuna yin duk wannan mugunta kuna zama marasa aminci ga Allahnmu ta wurin auren baren mata?”
english: Shall we then listen to you to do all this great evil, to trespass against our God in marrying foreign women?”

hausa: Da ya iso can, sai ya busa ƙaho a ƙasar tudu ta Efraim, Isra’ilawa kuma suka gangaro tare da shi daga tuddai, shi kuwa yana jagorarsu.
english: When he had come, he blew a trumpet in the hill country of Ephraim; and the children of Israel went down with him from the hill country, and he led them.

hausa: In kuwa ta wurin Be’elzebub nake fitar da aljanu, to, ta wa mutanenku suke fitar da su? Saboda haka, su ne za su zama alƙalanku.
english: If I by Beelzebul cast out demons, by whom do your children cast them out? Therefore they will be your judges.

hausa: Uban bikin kuwa ya ɗanɗana ruwan da aka juya ya zama ruwan inabi. Bai san daga ina ya fito ba, ko da yake bayin da suka ɗiba ruwan sun sani. Sai ya kira angon waje ɗaya
english: When the ruler of the feast tasted the water now become wine, and didn’t know where it came from (but the servants who had drawn the water knew), the ruler of the feast called the bridegroom

hausa: Sai Ubangiji ya ce mini, “Kada ku dami Mowabawa, ko ku tsokane su da yaƙi, gama ba zan ba ku wani sashe na ƙasarsu ba. Na ba da Ar ga zuriyar Lot, ta zama mallakarsu.”
english: Yahweh said to me, “Don’t bother Moab, neither contend with them in battle; for I will not give you any of his land for a possession, because I have given Ar to the children of Lot for a possession.”

hausa: ’Ya’yan Lawi maza su ne, Gershon, Kohat da Merari.
english: The sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.

hausa: “Ku ba mu shawara, ku yanke shawara. Ku mai da inuwarku kamar dare, a tsakar rana. Ku ɓoye masu gudun hijira, kada ku bashe masu neman mafaka.
english: Give counsel! Execute justice! Make your shade like the night in the middle of the noonday! Hide the outcasts! Don’t betray the fugitive!

hausa: Za su yi shelar adalcinsa ga mutanen da ba a riga an haifa ba, gama ya aikata shi.
english: They shall come and shall declare his righteousness to a people that shall be born, for he has done it.

hausa: “Sa’an nan Ubangiji ya ce masa, ‘Ka cire takalmanka; wurin da kake tsayen nan mai tsarki ne.
english: The Lord said to him, ‘Take off your sandals, for the place where you stand is holy ground.

hausa: Ashe, ba a girmama shi fiye da Ukun ba? Ya zama komandansu, ko da yake ba a haɗa shi a cikinsu ba.
english: Wasn’t he most honorable of the three? Therefore he was made their captain. However he wasn’t included as one of the three.

hausa: Ubangiji fa ya bugi mutanen Kush a gaban Asa da Yahuda. Mutanen Kush suka gudu,
english: So Yahweh struck the Ethiopians before Asa and before Judah; and the Ethiopians fled.

hausa: Rana don tă yi mulkin yini, Ƙaunarsa madawwamiya ce.
english: the sun to rule by day, for his loving kindness endures forever;

hausa: Sai ta ce, “Ubangiji ne ya yi mini wannan. A waɗannan kwanaki ya nuna tagomashinsa ya kuma kawar mini da kunya a cikin mutane.”
english: “Thus has the Lord done to me in the days in which he looked at me, to take away my reproach among men.”

hausa: Saboda haka, sai ku ƙarfafa raunanan hannuwanku da gwiwoyinku marasa ƙarfi!
english: Therefore lift up the hands that hang down and the feeble knees,

hausa: Ubangiji ya ce mini, “Ka sauka, ka jagoranci mutanen a hanyarsu, domin su shiga, su kuma mallaki ƙasar da na rantse wa kakanninsu, zan ba su.”
english: Yahweh said to me, “Arise, take your journey before the people; and they shall go in and possess the land which I swore to their fathers to give to them.”

hausa: (Zinariyar wannan ƙasa kuwa tana da kyau, akwai kuma kayan ƙanshi da duwatsun da ake kira onis a can ma.)
english: and the gold of that land is good. Bdellium and onyx stone are also there.

hausa: Da Bilatus ya ji haka, sai ya fito da Yesu, ya kuma zauna a kujerar shari’ar da ake ce da shi Daɓen Dutse (wanda a harshen Arameyik ana ce da shi Gabbata).
english: When Pilate therefore heard these words, he brought Jesus out and sat down on the judgment seat at a place called “The Pavement”, but in Hebrew, “Gabbatha.”

hausa: gama ba su fahimci al’amarin burodin nan ba, don zuciyarsu ta taurare.
english: for they hadn’t understood about the loaves, but their hearts were hardened.

hausa: Bala’am ya ce wa mala’ikan Ubangiji, “Na yi zunubi. Ban san ka tsaya a hanya don ka hana ni ba. Yanzu in ba ka ji daɗin tafiyata, sai in koma.”
english: Balaam said to Yahweh’s angel, “I have sinned; for I didn’t know that you stood in the way against me. Now therefore, if it displeases you, I will go back again.”

hausa: ‘Ga abin da Ubangiji ya ce zai kawo masifa a wannan wuri da mutanensa, dukan la’anar da aka rubuta a cikin littafin da aka karanta a gaban sarkin Yahuda.
english: “Yahweh says, ‘Behold, I will bring evil on this place and on its inhabitants, even all the curses that are written in the book which they have read before the king of Judah.

hausa: Da jin wannan, Yesu ya ce, “Ai, ba masu lafiya ba ne su bukatar likita, sai dai marasa lafiya.
english: When Jesus heard it, he said to them, “Those who are healthy have no need for a physician, but those who are sick do.

hausa: Amma ku ɗauki abubuwa masu tsarki, da kuma duk abin da kuka yi alkawari za ku bayar, ku tafi inda Ubangiji ya zaɓa.
english: Only your holy things which you have, and your vows, you shall take and go to the place which Yahweh shall choose.

hausa: Wannan ce hidimar da mutanen Merari za su yi a aikin Tentin Sujada, a ƙarƙashin jagorancin Itamar ɗan Haruna, firist.”
english: This is the service of the families of the sons of Merari, according to all their service in the Tent of Meeting, under the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.”

hausa: Saboda haka Ga’al ya fito da ’yan ƙasar Shekem suka yaƙi Abimelek.
english: Gaal went out before the men of Shechem, and fought with Abimelech.

hausa: Mace mafi hankali da kuma kirki a cikinku, kai, mafi hankali da kirki da ba ta ma karambanin taɓa ƙasa da tafin ƙafarta, za tă hana wa mijinta da take ƙauna, da kuma ɗanta, ko ’yarta abinci.
english: The tender and delicate woman among you, who would not venture to set the sole of her foot on the ground for delicateness and tenderness, her eye will be evil toward the husband that she loves, toward her son, toward her daughter,

hausa: Yesu kuwa cike da Ruhu Mai Tsarki, ya dawo daga Urdun, Ruhu kuma ya kai shi cikin hamada,
english: Jesus, full of the Holy Spirit, returned from the Jordan and was led by the Spirit into the wilderness

hausa: Na gaya muku wannan domin murnata ta kasance a cikinku, murnanku kuma ta zama cikakkiya.
english: I have spoken these things to you, that my joy may remain in you, and that your joy may be made full.

hausa: Tabbatacce hayaniyar bin gumaka a kan tuddai da duwatsu banza ne; tabbatacce a wurin Ubangiji Allahnmu ne akwai ceton Isra’ila.
english: Truly help from the hills, the tumult on the mountains, is in vain. Truly the salvation of Israel is in Yahweh our God.

hausa: Sai na juya don in ga muryar da take magana da ni. Da na juya kuwa sai na ga alkukan fitilu bakwai na zinariya.
english: I turned to see the voice that spoke with me. Having turned, I saw seven golden lamp stands.

hausa: Don mai bi da kaɗe-kaɗe. Da murya “Kurciya a Itatuwan Oak Mai Nisa.” Ta Dawuda. Wani miktam. Sa’ad da Filistiyawa suka kama shi a birnin Gat. Ka yi mini jinƙai, ya Allah, gama mutane sun tasar mini da zafi; dukan yini suna matsa harinsu.
english: For the Chief Musician. To the tune of “Silent Dove in Distant Lands.” A poem by David, when the Philistines seized him in Gath. Be merciful to me, God, for man wants to swallow me up. All day long, he attacks and oppresses me.

hausa: Haka ma, in kuka ga waɗannan abubuwa suna faruwa, ku san cewa ya yi kusan zuwa, yana ma dab da bakin ƙofa.
english: even so you also, when you see these things coming to pass, know that it is near, at the doors.

hausa: Amma ka yi tafiya a hanyoyin sarakunan Isra’ila, ka sa Yahuda ya kauce, ka kuma sa mutanen Urushalima suka yi karuwanci, kamar yadda gidan Ahab ta yi. Ka kuma kashe ’yan’uwanka, membobi gidan mahaifinka, mutanen da suka fi ka kirki.
