english: but have walked in the way of the kings of Israel, and have made Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem to play the prostitute like Ahab’s house did, and also have slain your brothers of your father’s house, who were better than yourself,

hausa: Sammai, har da sama sammai, da duniya, da kome da yake cikinta na Ubangiji Allahnku ne.
english: Behold, to Yahweh your God belongs heaven, the heaven of heavens, and the earth, with all that is therein.

hausa: Saboda haka fushin Ubangiji ya ƙuna a kan Isra’ila, kuma da daɗewa ya sa su a ƙarƙashin ikon Hazayel sarkin Aram da Ben-Hadad ɗansa.
english: Yahweh’s anger burned against Israel, and he delivered them into the hand of Hazael king of Syria, and into the hand of Benhadad the son of Hazael, continually.

hausa: “Duk wanda ya yi wa mai ba’a gyara yana gayyatar zagi duk wanda ya tsawata wa mugu yakan gamu da cin mutunci.
english: One who corrects a mocker invites insult. One who reproves a wicked man invites abuse.

hausa: Sun tuna cewa Allah ne Dutsensu, cewa Allah Mafi Ɗaukaka ne Mai fansarsu.
english: They remembered that God was their rock, the Most High God, their redeemer.

hausa: “Su kuwa suka amsa, suka ce, ‘A’a, wataƙila ba zai ishe mu da ku ba. Gara ku je wurin masu sayarwa ku sayo.’
english: But the wise answered, saying, ‘What if there isn’t enough for us and you? You go rather to those who sell, and buy for yourselves.’

hausa: “Bawanka mahaifinmu ya ce mana, ‘Kun san cewa matata ta haifa mini ’ya’ya biyu maza.
english: Your servant, my father, said to us, ‘You know that my wife bore me two sons.

hausa: Solomon yana da rumfunan dawakai masu jan kekunan yaƙi, dubu huɗu, da kuma dawakai dubu goma sha biyu
english: Solomon had forty thousand stalls of horses for his chariots, and twelve thousand horsemen.

hausa: Ka yi raga na tagulla dominsa, ka kuma yi zoben tagulla a kowace kusurwan nan huɗu na bagaden.
english: You shall make a grating for it of network of bronze. On the net you shall make four bronze rings in its four corners.

hausa: Wa ya sani? Ko Allah zai ji tausayinmu da kuma juyayinmu yă janye zafin fushinsa don kada mu hallaka.”
english: Who knows whether God will not turn and relent, and turn away from his fierce anger, so that we might not perish?”

hausa: Hikima ce mafi girma duka; saboda haka ka nemi hikima. Ko da za tă ci duk abin da kake da shi, ka dai nemi fahimi.
english: Wisdom is supreme. Get wisdom. Yes, though it costs all your possessions, get understanding.

hausa: Sauran ’yan Adam da ba a kashe ta wajen waɗannan annobai ba kuwa har wa yau ba su tuba daga aikin hannuwansu ba; ba su daina bauta wa aljanu, da gumakan zinariya, azurfa, tagulla, dutse da na itace, gumakan da ba sa iya gani ko ji ko tafiya ba.
english: The rest of mankind, who were not killed with these plagues, didn’t repent of the works of their hands, that they wouldn’t worship demons, and the idols of gold, and of silver, and of brass, and of stone, and of wood, which can’t see, hear, or walk.

hausa: A can ya shiga kogo ya kwana. Sai maganar Ubangiji ta zo masa, ta ce, “Me kake yi a nan, Iliya?”
english: He came to a cave there, and camped there; and behold, Yahweh’s word came to him, and he said to him, “What are you doing here, Elijah?”

hausa: Zuriyar Yekoniya kamamme su ne, Sheyaltiyel,
english: The sons of Jeconiah, the captive: Shealtiel his son,

hausa: da Hazor, da Rama, da Gittayim,
english: Hazor, Ramah, Gittaim,

hausa: Zai zama da albarka ga bawan nan wanda maigidan ya dawo, ya same shi yana yin haka.
english: Blessed is that servant whom his lord will find doing so when he comes.

hausa: Waɗannan su ne sunayen jarumawan Dawuda. Yosheb-Basshebet, mutumin Takemon ɗaya daga cikin shugabanni Uku; ya ɗaga māshinsa ya kashe mutum ɗari takwas a lokaci guda.
english: These are the names of the mighty men whom David had: Josheb Basshebeth, a Tahchemonite, chief of the captains; he was called Adino the Eznite, who killed eight hundred at one time.

hausa: “In wannan ba haka ba ne, wane ne zai shaida ƙarya nake yi har yă ƙi yarda da maganata?”
english: If it isn’t so now, who will prove me a liar, and make my speech worth nothing?”

hausa: Amma Esta ta ɓoye asalin iyalinta da na al’ummarta yadda Mordekai ya ce ta yi, gama ta ci gaba da bin umarnan Mordekai yadda take yi sa’ad da yake renonta.
english: Esther had not yet made known her relatives nor her people, as Mordecai had commanded her; for Esther obeyed Mordecai, like she did when she was brought up by him.

hausa: wanda kuma ya yi dukan waɗannan alamu banmamaki da al’ajaban da Ubangiji ya aike shi yă yi a Masar, da a kan Fir’auna, da a kan dukan shugabanninsa, da kuma a kan dukan ƙasarsa.
english: in all the signs and the wonders which Yahweh sent him to do in the land of Egypt, to Pharaoh, and to all his servants, and to all his land,

hausa: Bari su yi godiya ga Ubangiji saboda ƙaunarsa marar ƙarewa da kuma ayyukansa masu banmamaki saboda mutane.
english: Let them praise Yahweh for his loving kindness, for his wonderful deeds to the children of men!

hausa: Gama muna iya ƙoƙari mu yi abin da yake daidai, ba a gaban Ubangiji kaɗai ba, amma a gaban mutane ma.
english: Having regard for honorable things, not only in the sight of the Lord, but also in the sight of men.

hausa: Ku kuma tuna a lokacin ba ku san Kiristi ba. A ware kuke daga mutanen Isra’ila, ba ku kuma da dangantaka da alkawaran da Allah ya yi da su. Kun yi zama a duniyan nan babu bege kuma babu Allah.
english: that you were at that time separate from Christ, alienated from the commonwealth of Israel, and strangers from the covenants of the promise, having no hope and without God in the world.

hausa: Za a jefar da masu mulkinsu ƙasa daga ƙwanƙolin dutse, mugaye kuwa za su san cewa maganata daidai ne.
english: Their judges are thrown down by the sides of the rock. They will hear my words, for they are well spoken.

hausa: Sai shugaban ƙungiyar sojan ya ce, “Sai da na biya kuɗi mai yawa kafin in zama ɗan ƙasa.” Bulus ya ce, “Ni kuwa an haife ni ɗan ƙasa.”
english: The commanding officer answered, “I bought my citizenship for a great price.” Paul said, “But I was born a Roman.”

hausa: Mutumin ruhaniya yakan gwada dukan abubuwa, amma shi kansa ba ya ƙarƙashin shari’ar mutum.
english: But he who is spiritual discerns all things, and he himself is to be judged by no one.

hausa: Ta wurin bangaskiya ne iyayen Musa suka ɓoye shi har wata uku bayan haihuwarsa, domin sun ga cewa shi ba kamar sauran yara ba ne, ba su kuwa ji tsoron umarnin sarki ba.
english: By faith Moses, when he was born, was hidden for three months by his parents, because they saw that he was a beautiful child; and they were not afraid of the king’s commandment.

hausa: Ba da daɗewa ba fushina a kanku zai zo ga ƙarshe hasalata kuma za tă koma ga hallakarsu.”
english: For yet a very little while, and the indignation against you will be accomplished, and my anger will be directed to his destruction.”

hausa: Amma in ba su saurara ba, za su hallaka da takobi kuma za su mutu ba ilimi.
english: But if they don’t listen, they will perish by the sword; they will die without knowledge.

hausa: Da safe matar ta koma gidan da maigidanta yake, ta fāɗi a ƙofa ta kwanta a can har rana ta yi.
english: Then the woman came in the dawning of the day, and fell down at the door of the man’s house where her lord was, until it was light.

hausa: Duba, bawana zai aikata abubuwa da hikima; za a tā da shi a kuma ɗaga shi da ɗaukaka ƙwarai.
english: Behold, my servant will deal wisely. He will be exalted and lifted up, and will be very high.

hausa: Suka maƙala waɗancan bakin sarƙoƙin zinariya a tsaikon nan biyu, sa’an nan suka rataya su a kafaɗun efod daga gaba.
english: The other two ends of the two braided chains they put on the two settings, and put them on the shoulder straps of the ephod, in its front.

hausa: sai dattawanku da alƙalanku su je su gwada nisan wurin da gawar take zuwa garuruwan da suke maƙwabtaka.
english: then your elders and your judges shall come out, and they shall measure to the cities which are around him who is slain.

hausa: da aka ajiye a Ƙofar Sarki a gabas, har zuwa wannan lokaci. Waɗannan su ne matsaran ƙofofi na sansanin Lawiyawa.
english: who previously served in the king’s gate eastward. They were the gatekeepers for the camp of the children of Levi.

hausa: Kowannenku zai ɗauki faranti yă zuba turare a ciki. Wato, farantai 250 ke nan, a kuma miƙa su a gaban Ubangiji. Kai da Haruna za ku miƙa farantanku, ku ma.”
english: Each man take his censer and put incense on it, and each man bring before Yahweh his censer, two hundred fifty censers; you also, and Aaron, each with his censer.”

hausa: Ba a taɓa yin irin Bikin Ƙetarewa haka ba, tun zamanin da masu shari’a suke aiki a matsayin sarakuna, ko a kwanakin sarakunan Isra’ila, ko na Yahuda.
english: Surely there was not kept such a Passover from the days of the judges who judged Israel, nor in all the days of the kings of Israel, nor of the kings of Judah;

hausa: Yayinda suna cikin sauraron wannan, sai ya ci gaba da gaya musu wani misali, domin ya yi kusa da Urushalima, kuma mutanen suna tsammani mulkin Allah zai bayyana, nan da nan.
english: As they heard these things, he went on and told a parable, because he was near Jerusalem, and they supposed that God’s Kingdom would be revealed immediately.

hausa: Ki yi birgima cikin zafin azaba, ya Diyar Sihiyona, kamar macen da take naƙuda, don yanzu dole ki bar birni ki kafa sansani a filin Allah. Za ki tafi Babilon; a can za a kuɓutar da ki. A can ne Ubangiji zai fanshe ki daga hannun maƙiyanki.
english: Be in pain, and labor to give birth, daughter of Zion, like a woman in travail; for now you will go out of the city, and will dwell in the field, and will come even to Babylon. There you will be rescued. There Yahweh will redeem you from the hand of your enemies.

hausa: Mai yin hidimar ya ɗauki mutane zuwa gidan Yusuf ya ba su ruwa su wanke ƙafafunsu, ya kuma tanada wa jakunansu abinci.
english: The man brought the men into Joseph’s house, and gave them water, and they washed their feet. He gave their donkeys fodder.

hausa: Gama Ubangiji Allahnku ne Allahn alloli da Ubangijin iyayengiji, Allah mai girma, mai ƙarfi da kuma mai banrazana, wanda ba ya sonkai, ba ya cin hanci.
english: For Yahweh your God, he is God of gods and Lord of lords, the great God, the mighty, and the awesome, who doesn’t respect persons or take bribes.

hausa: “Sa’ad da na ji raina yana rabuwa da ni, na tuna da kai ya Ubangiji, addu’ata kuma ta kai gare ka, a haikalinka mai tsarki.
english: “When my soul fainted within me, I remembered Yahweh. My prayer came in to you, into your holy temple.

hausa: Da ba don dokarka ce farin cikina ba, da na hallaka a cikin azabana.
english: Unless your law had been my delight, I would have perished in my affliction.

hausa: Zai fi musu kyau da ba su taɓa sanin hanyar adalci ba, fiye da a ce sun sani sa’an nan su juya bayansu ga umarni mai tsarkin nan da aka ba su.
english: For it would be better for them not to have known the way of righteousness, than after knowing it, to turn back from the holy commandment delivered to them.

hausa: “Na ji gunagunin Isra’ilawa. Ka faɗa musu, ‘A tsakanin fāɗuwar rana da almuru, za ku ci nama, da safe kuma za ku ƙoshi da burodi. Sa’an nan za ku sani ni ne Ubangiji Allahnku.’ ”
english: “I have heard the murmurings of the children of Israel. Speak to them, saying, ‘At evening you shall eat meat, and in the morning you shall be filled with bread. Then you will know that I am Yahweh your God.’”

hausa: Iska takan hura zuwa kudu ta kuma juya zuwa arewa; tă yi ta kewayewa, tă yi ta koma inda take fitowa.
english: The wind goes toward the south, and turns around to the north. It turns around continually as it goes, and the wind returns again to its courses.

hausa: Suka ce musu, “Ku, za ku ce, ‘Almajiransa ne sun zo da dare suka sace shi, lokacin da muke barci.’
english: saying, “Say that his disciples came by night and stole him away while we slept.

hausa: Suna murƙushe mutanenka, ya Ubangiji; suna danne gādonka.
english: They break your people in pieces, Yahweh, and afflict your heritage.

hausa: Duk wanda ta taɓa su zai zama marar tsarki; dole yă wanke rigunansa yă kuma yi wanka, zai kuma ƙazantu har yamma.
english: Whoever touches these things shall be unclean, and shall wash his clothes and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening.

hausa: Amma yanzu Ubangiji Allahna ya ba ni hutu a kowane gefe, babu kuma gāba ko masifa.
english: But now Yahweh my God has given me rest on every side. There is no enemy and no evil occurrence.

hausa: Kashegari Ubangiji ya yi haka. Dukan dabbobin Masarawa suka mutu, amma babu dabba guda ta Isra’ilawan da ta mutu.
english: Yahweh did that thing on the next day; and all the livestock of Egypt died, but of the livestock of the children of Israel, not one died.

hausa: Yaƙub kuwa ya ce wa Fir’auna, “Shekarun hijirata, shekaru ɗari da talatin ne. Shekaruna kaɗan ne cike da wahala, ba za a kuwa daidaita su da shekarun hijirar kakannina ba.”
english: Jacob said to Pharaoh, “The years of my pilgrimage are one hundred thirty years. The days of the years of my life have been few and evil. They have not attained to the days of the years of the life of my fathers in the days of their pilgrimage.”

hausa: Amma ina gaya muku, Kada ku yi tsayayya da mugun mutum. In wani ya mare ka a kumatun dama, juya masa ɗayan ma.
english: But I tell you, don’t resist him who is evil; but whoever strikes you on your right cheek, turn to him the other also.

hausa: Mai bashe shi ɗin ya riga ya shirya alama da su cewa, “Wanda na yi wa sumba, shi ne mutumin, ku kama shi, ku riƙe sosai.”
english: Now he who betrayed him had given them a sign, saying, “Whomever I will kiss, that is he. Seize him, and lead him away safely.”

hausa: Sai Yosiya ya umarci Hilkiya babban firist, tare da firistocin da suke taimakonsa, da masu tsaron ƙofa su kawar da dukan abubuwan da aka yi domin Ba’al, da domin Ashera, da kuma domin dukan rundunar taurari, daga haikalin Ubangiji. Ya ƙone su a bayan Urushalima a filayen Kwarin Kidron, ya kwashe tokan zuwa Betel.
english: The king commanded Hilkiah the high priest, and the priests of the second order, and the keepers of the threshold, to bring out of Yahweh’s temple all the vessels that were made for Baal, for the Asherah, and for all the army of the sky; and he burned them outside of Jerusalem in the fields of the Kidron, and carried their ashes to Bethel.

hausa: Ya kira Sha Biyun nan wurinsa, ya aike su biyu-biyu, ya kuma ba su iko bisa mugayen ruhohi.
english: He called to himself the twelve, and began to send them out two by two; and he gave them authority over the unclean spirits.

hausa: Za a kuma kwashe waɗansu daga cikin zuriyarka, na jiki da jininka waɗanda za a haifa maka, su zama bābānni a fadan sarkin Babilon.”
english: ‘They will take away some of your sons who will issue from you, whom you will father; and they will be eunuchs in the palace of the king of Babylon.’”

hausa: Yayinda suke cin abinci a tebur, sai ya ce, “Gaskiya nake gaya muku, ɗaya daga cikinku zai bashe ni, wani wanda yake ci tare da ni.”
english: As they sat and were eating, Jesus said, “Most certainly I tell you, one of you will betray me—he who eats with me.”

hausa: Kai kuma Ezra, bisa ga hikimar da Allah ya ba ka, sai ka zaɓi mahukunta da alƙalai waɗanda za su zama masu yanke hukunci ga dukan mutanen Kewayen Kogin Yuferites, duk waɗanda suka san dokokin Allahnka, ka kuma koya wa duk waɗanda ba su san dokokin ba.
english: You, Ezra, according to the wisdom of your God that is in your hand, appoint magistrates and judges who may judge all the people who are beyond the River, who all know the laws of your God; and teach him who doesn’t know them.

hausa: Ka ɗauki waɗannan mutane, ka tafi da su ku tsarkaka gaba ɗaya, ka kuma biya musu kome don su samu su yi aski. Ta haka kowa zai sani babu gaskiya a waɗannan rahotanni game da kai, za a kuma ga cewa kai kanka kana kiyaye dokar.
english: Take them and purify yourself with them, and pay their expenses for them, that they may shave their heads. Then all will know that there is no truth in the things that they have been informed about you, but that you yourself also walk keeping the law.

hausa: Sai magana ta zo wa Irmiya daga Ubangiji bayan Nebuzaradan shugaban matsaran sarki ya sake shi a Rama. Ya sami Irmiya a daure da sarƙoƙi a cikin sauran kamammu daga Urushalima da kuma Yahuda waɗanda ake kaiwa zaman bauta a Babilon.
english: The word which came to Jeremiah from Yahweh, after Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard had let him go from Ramah, when he had taken him being bound in chains among all the captives of Jerusalem and Judah who were carried away captive to Babylon.

hausa: Dukan waɗanda kike tarayya da su, za su kore ki zuwa iyaka; abokanki kuma za su yaudare ki, su kuma sha ƙarfinki; waɗanda suke cin abincinki, za su sa miki tarko, amma ba za ki gane ba.
english: All the men of your alliance have brought you on your way, even to the border. The men who were at peace with you have deceived you, and prevailed against you. Friends who eat your bread lay a snare under you. There is no understanding in him.”

hausa: Ku yi wannan domin kun san irin zamanin da kuke ciki. Lokaci ya yi da za ku farka daga barcinku, don cetonmu ya yi kusa yanzu fiye da lokacin da muka fara ba da gaskiya.
english: Do this, knowing the time, that it is already time for you to awaken out of sleep, for salvation is now nearer to us than when we first believed.

hausa: Ko za ka iya huda fatarta da kibiya ka kuma huda kansa da māsu?
english: Can you fill his skin with barbed irons, or his head with fish spears?

hausa: Sa’ad da suka tafi tare da garkunan shanu, tumaki da awakinsu don su nemi Ubangiji, ba za su same shi ba; ya janye kansa daga gare su.
english: They will go with their flocks and with their herds to seek Yahweh, but they won’t find him. He has withdrawn himself from them.

hausa: ranar da ya nuna mu’ujizansa a Masar abubuwan banmamakinsa a yankin Zowan ba.
english: how he set his signs in Egypt, his wonders in the field of Zoan,

hausa: Ka ce, ‘Ina da arziki; na sami dukiya ba na kuma bukatar kome.’ Amma ba ka gane ba cewa kai matsiyaci ne, abin tausayi, matalauci, makaho kana kuma tsirara.
english: Because you say, ‘I am rich, and have gotten riches, and have need of nothing,’ and don’t know that you are the wretched one, miserable, poor, blind, and naked;

hausa: Ubangiji ya kira Musa ya yi masa magana daga cikin Tentin Sujada ya ce,
english: Yahweh called to Moses, and spoke to him from the Tent of Meeting, saying,

hausa: Na san ba abin da ya fi wa mutane kyau fiye da su ji daɗi su kuma yi alheri yayinda suke da rai.
english: I know that there is nothing better for them than to rejoice, and to do good as long as they live.

hausa: Gama laifofinmu suna da yawa a gabanka, zunubanmu kuma suna ba da shaida gāba da mu. Laifofinmu kullum suna a gabanmu, muna kuma sane da laifofinmu,
english: For our transgressions are multiplied before you, and our sins testify against us; for our transgressions are with us, and as for our iniquities, we know them:

hausa: Suka kawo masu ba da shaidar ƙarya, waɗanda suka ba da shaida cewa, “Wannan mutum ba ya rabuwa da maganar banza a kan wurin nan mai tsarki da kuma doka.
english: and set up false witnesses who said, “This man never stops speaking blasphemous words against this holy place and the law.

hausa: Ga abin da Ubangiji ya faɗa mini, “Tafi ka sayo abin ɗamara na lilin ka sha ɗamara da shi, amma kada ka bari yă taɓa ruwa.”
english: Yahweh said to me, “Go, and buy yourself a linen belt, and put it on your waist, and don’t put it in water.”

hausa: Gama duk mai abu za a ƙara masa, zai kuma same shi a yawalce. Duk wanda ba shi da shi kuwa, ko ɗan abin da yake da shi ma, sai an karɓe masa.
english: For to everyone who has will be given, and he will have abundance, but from him who doesn’t have, even that which he has will be taken away.

hausa: Yanzu kuwa an ajiye mini rawanin adalci, wanda Ubangiji, Alƙali mai adalci zai ba ni a ranan nan ba kuwa ni kaɗai ba, amma ga duk waɗanda suka yi marmarin bayyanuwarsa.
english: From now on, the crown of righteousness is stored up for me, which the Lord, the righteous judge, will give to me on that day; and not to me only, but also to all those who have loved his appearing.

hausa: Za a sāke sayi filaye a wannan ƙasa da kuka ce, ‘Kango ce, ba mutane ko dabbobi, gama an ba da ita ga Babiloniyawa.’
english: Fields will be bought in this land, about which you say, ‘It is desolate, without man or animal. It is given into the hand of the Chaldeans.’

hausa: Sai wuta ta fito daga Ubangiji ta cinye su, suka kuma mutu a gaban Ubangiji.
english: Fire came out from before Yahweh, and devoured them, and they died before Yahweh.

hausa: ’Ya’yan Onam maza su ne, Shammai da Yada. ’Ya’yan Shammai maza su ne, Nadab da Abishur.
english: The sons of Onam were Shammai and Jada. The sons of Shammai: Nadab and Abishur.

hausa: Suka ɗauko akwatin alkawarin Allah a sabuwar keken yaƙi, suka kawo shi daga gidan Abinadab, wanda yake bisa tudu. Uzza da Ahiyo, ’ya’yan Abinadab maza, suka bi da keken yaƙin da akwatin alkawarin Allah yake ciki suka bi da keken yaƙin
english: They set God’s ark on a new cart, and brought it out of Abinadab’s house that was on the hill; and Uzzah and Ahio, the sons of Abinadab, drove the new cart.

hausa: mugun mutum bai taɓa daɗewa ba, farin cikin mutum na ɗan gajeren lokaci ne.
english: that the triumphing of the wicked is short, the joy of the godless but for a moment?

hausa: Suka faɗa masa cewa, “Ga abin da Hezekiya ya ce wannan rana ce ta baƙin ciki da tsawatawa da shan kunya, sai ka ce sa’ad da ’ya’ya kan zo matakin haihuwa sa’an nan a rasa ƙarfin haihuwarsu.
english: They said to him, “Hezekiah says, ‘Today is a day of trouble, and of rebuke, and of rejection; for the children have come to the birth, and there is no strength to give birth.

hausa: Kada ka zama kamar doki ko doki, wanda ba su da azanci wanda dole sai an bi da su da linzami da ragama in ba haka ba, ba za su zo wurinka ba.
english: Don’t be like the horse, or like the mule, which have no understanding, who are controlled by bit and bridle, or else they will not come near to you.

hausa: Gama ba haka kawai yake kawo wahala ko ɓacin rai ga ’yan adam ba.
english: For he does not afflict willingly, nor grieve the children of men.

hausa: ’Ya’yanku za su zama masu albarka, haka ma hatsin gonakinku da kuma ’ya’yan dabbobinku, wato, ’ya’yan shanu da ’yan tumakinku.
english: You shall be blessed in the fruit of your body, the fruit of your ground, the fruit of your animals, the increase of your livestock, and the young of your flock.

hausa: Sai shugaban masu tsaro ya danƙa su a hannun Yusuf, ya kuwa yi musu hidima. Bayan sun jima cikin kurkuku,
english: The captain of the guard assigned them to Joseph, and he took care of them. They stayed in prison many days.

hausa: Bayan Nuhu ya yi shekara 500, sai ya haifi Shem, Ham da Yafet.
english: Noah was five hundred years old, then Noah became the father of Shem, Ham, and Japheth.

hausa: Akwai fitilu da yawa a ɗakin gidan saman da muka taru.
english: There were many lights in the upper room where we were gathered together.

hausa: Zuciyar mai adalci takan auna amsoshinta, amma bakin mugu yakan fitar da mugunta.
english: The heart of the righteous weighs answers, but the mouth of the wicked gushes out evil.

hausa: Da ma Allah zai yi magana, yă buɗe baki yă faɗi wani abin da ka yi da ba daidai ba
english: But oh that God would speak, and open his lips against you,

hausa: Sun nemi shawarar gunkin da aka yi da itace suka kuwa sami amsa daga sanda. Halin karuwanci yakan ɓad da su; sun yi rashin aminci ga Allahnsu.
english: My people consult with their wooden idol, and answer to a stick of wood. Indeed the spirit of prostitution has led them astray, and they have been unfaithful to their God.

hausa: “Ka ɗebi kitse daga wannan rago, ka yanke wutsiyarsa mai kitse, ka kuma ɗebi kitsen da ya rufe kayan ciki, da kitsen da yake bisa hanta, da ƙoda biyu da kitsen da yake kansu, da cinyar dama. (Gama rago ne don naɗi.)
english: Also you shall take some of the ram’s fat, the fat tail, the fat that covers the innards, the cover of the liver, the two kidneys, the fat that is on them, and the right thigh (for it is a ram of consecration),

hausa: Ku rera ga Ubangiji! Ku yabi Ubangiji! Ya kuɓutar da ran mabukaci daga hannuwan mugaye.
english: Sing to Yahweh! Praise Yahweh, for he has delivered the soul of the needy from the hand of evildoers.

hausa: Sa’ad da alkamar ta tashi ta yi kawuna, sai ciyayin ma suka bayyana.
english: But when the blade sprang up and produced grain, then the darnel weeds appeared also.

hausa: Dukan rundunar ta shiga kurmi, sai ga zuma a ƙasa.
english: All the people came into the forest; and there was honey on the ground.

hausa: domin Ubangiji yakan hori waɗanda yake ƙauna, kamar yadda mahaifi yake yin wa ɗa da yake fariya da shi.
english: for whom Yahweh loves, he corrects, even as a father reproves the son in whom he delights.

hausa: Da Bitrus ya ga haka, sai ya ce musu, “Mutanen Isra’ila, don me wannan ya ba ku mamaki? Don me kuke kallonmu sai ka ce da ikon kanmu ne ko kuwa don ibadarmu ne muka sa wannan mutum ya yi tafiya?
english: When Peter saw it, he responded to the people, “You men of Israel, why do you marvel at this man? Why do you fasten your eyes on us, as though by our own power or godliness we had made him walk?

hausa: In mutane za su yi rantsuwa sukan yi haka da wanda ya fi su ne, rantsuwar kuwa takan tabbatar da abin da aka faɗa ta kuma kawo ƙarshen dukan gardama.
english: For men indeed swear by a greater one, and in every dispute of theirs the oath is final for confirmation.

hausa: Mutumin ya yi tambaya ya ce, “Waɗanne?” Yesu ya amsa ya ce, “ ‘Kada ka yi kisankai, kada ka yi zina, kada ka yi sata, kada ka yi shaidar ƙarya,
english: He said to him, “Which ones?” Jesus said, “‘You shall not murder.’ ‘You shall not commit adultery.’ ‘You shall not steal.’ ‘You shall not offer false testimony.’

hausa: Bari waɗanda suke tsoronka su yi farin ciki sa’ad da suke gan ni, gama na sa zuciyata a maganarka.
english: Those who fear you will see me and be glad, because I have put my hope in your word.

hausa: Bayan wannan Ayuba ya rayu shekara ɗari da arba’in; ya ga ’ya’yansa da ’ya’yansu har tsara ta huɗu.
english: After this Job lived one hundred forty years, and saw his sons, and his sons’ sons, to four generations.

hausa: Ka taimake ni, ya Ubangiji Allahna; ka cece ni bisa ga ƙaunarka.
english: Help me, Yahweh, my God. Save me according to your loving kindness;

hausa: Wannan shi ne madawwamin shirinsa, kuma an aikata shi ta wurin Kiristi Yesu Ubangijinmu.
english: according to the eternal purpose which he accomplished in Christ Jesus our Lord.

hausa: Yi masa magana ka ce, ‘Ga abin da Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka yana cewa, “ ‘Ina gāba da kai, Fir’auna sarkin Masar, kai babban mugun dodon ruwa kwance cikin rafuffukanka. Ka ce, “Nilu nawa ne; na yi shi wa kaina.”
english: Speak and say, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “Behold, I am against you, Pharaoh king of Egypt, the great monster that lies in the middle of his rivers, that has said, ‘My river is my own, and I have made it for myself.’

hausa: Da mutumin nan ya ji cewa Yesu ya isa Galili daga Yahudiya, sai ya je wurinsa ya roƙe shi yă zo yă warkar da ɗansa da yake bakin mutuwa.
english: When he heard that Jesus had come out of Judea into Galilee, he went to him and begged him that he would come down and heal his son, for he was at the point of death.

hausa: Matar Finehas, ɗansa tana da ciki a lokacin ta kuma kusa haihuwa. Sa’ad da ta ji labari cewa an ƙwace akwatin alkawarin Allah, ta kuma labarin surukinta da mijinta sun mutu, sai ta shiga naƙuda, ta kuma haihu. Amma naƙuda ta sha ƙarfinta.
english: His daughter-in-law, Phinehas’ wife, was with child, near to giving birth. When she heard the news that God’s ark was taken and that her father-in-law and her husband were dead, she bowed herself and gave birth; for her pains came on her.

hausa: Kullum za ku kasance da matalauta, amma ba kullum za ku kasance tare da ni ba.”
english: For you always have the poor with you, but you don’t always have me.”

hausa: A rana ta shida, Eliyasaf ɗan Deyuwel, shugaban mutanen Gad, ya kawo hadayarsa.
english: On the sixth day, Eliasaph the son of Deuel, prince of the children of Gad,

hausa: Duk da haka na tuna da wannan na kuma sa bege ga nan gaba.
english: This I recall to my mind; therefore I have hope.

hausa: Duk naman hadayar da ya rage har kwana uku, dole a ƙone shi.
english: but what remains of the meat of the sacrifice on the third day shall be burned with fire.

hausa: in kuma na yi muku tambaya ba za ku iya ba ni amsa ba.
english: and if I ask, you will in no way answer me or let me go.

hausa: “Yanzu mene ne damuwarku da ni, ya Taya da Sidon da kuma dukan mazaunan yankunan Filistiya? Kuna ƙoƙari ku sāka mini don abin da na yi ne? In kuna sāka mini ne, to, da gaggawa zan mayar muku da sakayya a kanku.
english: “Yes, and what are you to me, Tyre and Sidon, and all the regions of Philistia? Will you repay me? And if you repay me, I will swiftly and speedily return your repayment on your own head.

hausa: Ka yi ƙugiyoyin zinariya domin wannan labule da katakai itacen ƙirya biyar, waɗanda aka dalaye da zinariya. Ka kuma yi zubi na tagulla biyar dominsu.
english: You shall make for the screen five pillars of acacia, and overlay them with gold. Their hooks shall be of gold. You shall cast five sockets of bronze for them.

hausa: Matasan, waɗanda suka yi girma tare da shi, suka amsa, “Faɗa wa waɗannan mutanen da suka ce maka, ‘Mahaifinka ya sa kaya masu nauyi a kanmu, amma ka sassauta kayanka.’ Ka ce musu, ‘Ƙaramin yatsana ya fi ƙugun tsohona kauri.
english: The young men who had grown up with him said to him, “Tell these people who spoke to you, saying, ‘Your father made our yoke heavy, but make it lighter to us’—tell them, ‘My little finger is thicker than my father’s waist.

hausa: Kamar yadda matattun ƙudaje sukan ɓata ƙanshin turare, haka ’yar wauta takan ɓata hikima da daraja.
english: Dead flies cause the oil of the perfumer to produce an evil odor; so does a little folly outweigh wisdom and honor.

hausa: Ka ji addu’ata, ya Ubangiji; ka saurari kukata na neman jinƙai.
english: Hear, Yahweh, my prayer. Listen to the voice of my petitions.

hausa: ‘Ni ne Allahn kakanninka, Allah na Ibrahim, Ishaku, da kuma Yaƙub.’ Sai Musa ya yi rawan jiki don tsoro, bai kuwa yi karambanin dubawa ba.
english: ‘I am the God of your fathers: the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob.’ Moses trembled and dared not look.

hausa: Ga abin da Ubangiji yana cewa, “Duba, sojoji suna zuwa daga ƙasar arewa; babbar al’umma ce ta yunƙuro daga iyakokin duniya.
english: Yahweh says, “Behold, a people comes from the north country. A great nation will be stirred up from the uttermost parts of the earth.

hausa: Sa’an nan Sama’ila ya ce wa mutane, Ubangiji ne ya naɗa Musa da Haruna suka fitar da kakanninku daga Masar.
english: Samuel said to the people, “It is Yahweh who appointed Moses and Aaron, and that brought your fathers up out of the land of Egypt.

hausa: Gama ran halitta yana a cikin jinin, kuma na ba da shi gare ku don kafara a kan bagade, jini ne yake kafara saboda ran mutum.
english: For the life of the flesh is in the blood. I have given it to you on the altar to make atonement for your souls; for it is the blood that makes atonement by reason of the life.

hausa: Da sauri ya kira mai riƙon masa makami ya ce, “Zaro takobinka ka kashe ni, don kada a ce ‘Mace ce ta kashe shi.’ ” Saboda haka bawansa ya soke shi, ya mutu.
english: Then he called hastily to the young man, his armor bearer, and said to him, “Draw your sword and kill me, that men not say of me, ‘A woman killed him.’ His young man thrust him through, and he died.”

hausa: “Sa’an nan Ubangiji ya ce mini, ‘Je ka; zan aike ka can nesa a wurin Al’ummai.’ ”
english: “He said to me, ‘Depart, for I will send you out far from here to the Gentiles.’ ”

hausa: A wannan rana raguwar Isra’ila, waɗanda suka ragu na gidan Yaƙub, ba za su ƙara dogara ga wanda ya kusa hallaka su ba amma za su dogara ga Ubangiji, Mai Tsarkin nan na Isra’ila.
english: It will come to pass in that day that the remnant of Israel, and those who have escaped from the house of Jacob will no more again lean on him who struck them, but shall lean on Yahweh, the Holy One of Israel, in truth.

hausa: Suka miƙa bijimai guda ɗari, da raguna ɗari biyu, da ’yan raguna ɗari huɗu. Suka kuma miƙa hadayu don zunubi saboda dukan Isra’ila, suka kuma miƙa bunsurai guda goma sha biyu don hadaya ta zunubi, kowane bunsuru ɗaya don kowace kabila ta Isra’ila.
english: They offered at the dedication of this house of God one hundred bulls, two hundred rams, four hundred lambs; and for a sin offering for all Israel, twelve male goats, according to the number of the tribes of Israel.

hausa: “Ka kuma kawo bijimin a gaban Tentin Sujada, sai Haruna da ’ya’yansa su ɗora hannuwansu a kansa.
english: “You shall bring the bull before the Tent of Meeting; and Aaron and his sons shall lay their hands on the head of the bull.

hausa: Abu guda Allah ya ce, abubuwa biyu na ji, “Cewa kai, ya Allah, kake mai ƙarfi,
english: God has spoken once; twice I have heard this, that power belongs to God.

hausa: Ko da na yi tafiya ta kwari na inuwar mutuwa, ba zan ji tsoron mugu ba, gama kana tare da ni; bulalarka na dūka da kuma sandanka na tafiya, za su yi mini ta’aziyya.
english: Even though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil, for you are with me. Your rod and your staff, they comfort me.

hausa: Zan jiƙa ƙasar da jininka mai gudu har zuwa duwatsu, magudanan ruwa za su cika da namanka.
english: I will also water the land in which you swim with your blood, even to the mountains. The watercourses will be full of you.

hausa: Zuciya ta fi kome ruɗu ta fi ƙarfin warkewa. Wa zai iya gane ta?
english: The heart is deceitful above all things and it is exceedingly corrupt. Who can know it?

hausa: Ya miƙe rassansa zuwa Teku tohonsa har zuwa Kogi.
english: It sent out its branches to the sea, its shoots to the River.

hausa: “Ɗan mutum, ka faɗa wa mai mulkin Taya cewa, ‘Ga abin da Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka yana cewa, “ ‘Cikin alfarmar zuciyarka ka ce, “Ni allah ne; ina zama a kan kursiyin allah a tsakiyar tekuna.” Amma kai mutum ne ba allah ba, ko da yake ka ɗauka kana da hikima kamar allah.
english: “Son of man, tell the prince of Tyre, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “Because your heart is lifted up, and you have said, ‘I am a god, I sit in the seat of God, in the middle of the seas;’ yet you are man, and no god, though you set your heart as the heart of a god—

hausa: “Ni ma a dā na tabbata cewa ya kamata in yi duk abin da zan iya yi domin in yi gāba da sunan Yesu Banazare.
english: “I myself most certainly thought that I ought to do many things contrary to the name of Jesus of Nazareth.

hausa: Zuriyar Ferez waɗanda suka zauna a Urushalima sun kai ɗari huɗu da sittin da takwas, dukansu kuwa muhimman mutane ne.
english: All the sons of Perez who lived in Jerusalem were four hundred sixty-eight valiant men.

hausa: Saboda haka sai taron ya umarci jarumai dubu goma sha biyu su je Yabesh Gileyad su karkashe waɗanda suke zaune a can, duk da mata da yara.
english: The congregation sent twelve thousand of the most valiant men there, and commanded them, saying, “Go and strike the inhabitants of Jabesh Gilead with the edge of the sword, with the women and the little ones.

hausa: Sa’an nan Sama’ila ya shiga da Shawulu da baransa ya zaunar da su a gaban waɗanda aka gayyata, mutanen sun kai wajen mutum talatin.
english: Samuel took Saul and his servant and brought them into the guest room, and made them sit in the best place among those who were invited, who were about thirty persons.

hausa: Kada ku ji tsoro, ya ku namun jeji, gama wuraren kiwo sun yi kore shar. Itatuwa suna ba da ’ya’yansu; itacen ɓaure da na inabi suna ba da amfaninsu.
english: Don’t be afraid, you animals of the field; for the pastures of the wilderness spring up, for the tree bears its fruit. The fig tree and the vine yield their strength.

hausa: “ ‘In kuma aka ruɗi annabin har ya yi annabci, Ni Ubangiji na rinjayi wannan annabi, zan kuma miƙa hannuna gāba da shi in hallaka shi daga cikin mutanena Isra’ila.
english: “‘“If the prophet is deceived and speaks a word, I, Yahweh, have deceived that prophet, and I will stretch out my hand on him, and will destroy him from among my people Israel.

hausa: Sai mutumin ya ce, “Yanzu kam wannan ƙashi ne na ƙasusuwana nama kuma na namana. Za a ce da ita ‘mace,’ gama an ciro ta daga namiji.”
english: The man said, “This is now bone of my bones, and flesh of my flesh. She will be called ‘woman,’ because she was taken out of Man.”

hausa: “Tambayi na gaba da kai ka ji abin da iyayenka suka koya
english: “Please inquire of past generations. Find out about the learning of their fathers.

hausa: Da yana jan jiki, sai mutanen suka kama hannunsa da hannuwan matarsa da na ’ya’yansa biyu mata, suka kai su bayan birni, gama Ubangiji ya nuna musu jinƙai.
english: But he lingered; and the men grabbed his hand, his wife’s hand, and his two daughters’ hands, Yahweh being merciful to him; and they took him out, and set him outside of the city.

hausa: Amma zan taurare zuciyar Fir’auna, kuma ko da na ninka mu’ujizai da kuma alamu a Masar,
english: I will harden Pharaoh’s heart, and multiply my signs and my wonders in the land of Egypt.

hausa: Amma ba su yi aminci da Allahn kakanninsu ba, suka kuma yi karuwanci ga waɗansu allolin mutanen ƙasar, waɗanda Allah ya hallaka a gabansu.
english: They trespassed against the God of their fathers, and played the prostitute after the gods of the peoples of the land whom God destroyed before them.

hausa: Daga baya Yesu ya sāke bayyana kansa ga almajiransa, a bakin Tekun Tibariya. Ga yadda ya faru.
english: After these things, Jesus revealed himself again to the disciples at the sea of Tiberias. He revealed himself this way.

hausa: “Gama ni, Ubangiji, ina ƙaunar adalci; na ƙi fashi da aikata laifi. Cikin adalcina zan sāka musu in kuma yi madawwamin alkawari da su.
english: “For I, Yahweh, love justice. I hate robbery and iniquity. I will give them their reward in truth and I will make an everlasting covenant with them.

hausa: Zuriyoyin Yahuda su ne, Ferez, Hezron, Karmi, Hur da Shobal.
english: The sons of Judah: Perez, Hezron, Carmi, Hur, and Shobal.

hausa: Na dauri aniyata in gwada don in bincika ta wurin hikima dukan abin da ake yi a duniya. Kaya mai nauyi ne Allah ya ɗora a kan mutane!
english: I applied my heart to seek and to search out by wisdom concerning all that is done under the sky. It is a heavy burden that God has given to the sons of men to be afflicted with.

hausa: Wani lokaci a fili an tsananta muku aka kuma zage ku aka kuma tsananta muku; a wani lokaci kuma kuka tsaya tare da waɗanda aka yi musu haka.
english: partly, being exposed to both reproaches and oppressions, and partly, becoming partakers with those who were treated so.

hausa: “In dai wannan kafaffiyar ƙa’ida ta daina aiki a gabana,” in ji Ubangiji, “to, sai zuriyar Isra’ila ta daina zama al’umma a gabana.”
english: “If these ordinances depart from before me,” says Yahweh, “then the offspring of Israel also will cease from being a nation before me forever.”

hausa: mayunwata sun kwashe girbinsa, har abubuwan da suke cikin ƙaya, masu jin ƙishirwa kuma suna zuba ido ga dukiyarsa.
english: whose harvest the hungry eat up, and take it even out of the thorns. The snare gapes for their substance.

hausa: Sai ya ce musu, “An ba ku sanin asirin mulkin Allah. Amma ga waɗanda suke waje kuwa, kome sai da misalai.
english: He said to them, “To you is given the mystery of God’s Kingdom, but to those who are outside, all things are done in parables,

hausa: Kin dogara a muguntarki kika kuma ce, ‘Babu wanda ya gan ni.’ Hikimarki da saninki sun ɓad da ke sa’ad da kika ce wa kanki, ‘Ni ce, kuma babu wani in ban da ni.’
english: For you have trusted in your wickedness. You have said, ‘No one sees me.’ Your wisdom and your knowledge has perverted you. You have said in your heart, ‘I am, and there is no one else besides me.’

hausa: “Wanda ba ya tare da ni, yana gāba da ni ne, kuma wanda ba ya taya ni tarawa, watsarwa yake yi.
english: “He who is not with me is against me, and he who doesn’t gather with me, scatters.

hausa: Da Yesu yana kan tafiya a bakin Tekun Galili, sai ya ga waɗansu ’yan’uwa guda biyu, Siman wanda ake kira Bitrus da ɗan’uwansa Andarawus. Suna jefa abin kamun kifi a tafki, gama su masunta ne.
english: Walking by the sea of Galilee, he saw two brothers: Simon, who is called Peter, and Andrew, his brother, casting a net into the sea; for they were fishermen.

hausa: Da lokacin bikin ya yi, sai ya aiki bawansa ya je ya ce wa waɗanda aka gayyata, ‘Ku zo, don an shirya kome.’
english: He sent out his servant at supper time to tell those who were invited, ‘Come, for everything is ready now.’

hausa: Zuriyar Solomon su ne Rehobowam, da Abiya, da Asa, da Yehoshafat,
english: Solomon’s son was Rehoboam, Abijah his son, Asa his son, Jehoshaphat his son,

hausa: Ku ’yan’uwana ne, jikina, jinina kuma. To, don me za ku zama na ƙarshe na yarda a dawo da sarki zuwa fada?’
english: You are my brothers. You are my bone and my flesh. Why then are you the last to bring back the king?’

hausa: Samarin Heliyofolis da Bubastis za su mutu ta wurin takobi, biranen kansu za su tafi bauta.
english: The young men of Aven and of Pibeseth will fall by the sword. They will go into captivity.

hausa: Saboda haka, ina faɗa muku, duk abin da kuka roƙa cikin addu’a, ku gaskata kun riga kun karɓa, zai kuwa zama naku.
english: Therefore I tell you, all things whatever you pray and ask for, believe that you have received them, and you shall have them.

hausa: Kun yar da umarnan Allah, kuna bin al’adun mutane.”
english: “For you set aside the commandment of God, and hold tightly to the tradition of men—the washing of pitchers and cups, and you do many other such things.”

hausa: Ya kuma gina filin ciki da sassaƙaƙƙun duwatsu, jeri uku, da jeri ɗaya na katakan itacen al’ul.
english: He built the inner court with three courses of cut stone and a course of cedar beams.

hausa: Kakan hallaka masu yin ƙarya. Masu kisankai da mutane masu ruɗu Ubangiji yana ƙyama.
english: You will destroy those who speak lies. Yahweh abhors the bloodthirsty and deceitful man.

hausa: Don haka Yahudawa suka ƙara nema su kashe shi; ba don yă karya Asabbaci kawai ba, har ma yana ce Allah Ubansa ne, yana mai da kansa daidai da Allah.
english: For this cause therefore the Jews sought all the more to kill him, because he not only broke the Sabbath, but also called God his own Father, making himself equal with God.

hausa: Da jakar ta ga mala’ikan Ubangiji, sai ta kwanta a ƙasa, Bala’am kuwa ya husata, sai ya buge ta da sandansa.
english: The donkey saw Yahweh’s angel, and she lay down under Balaam. Balaam’s anger burned, and he struck the donkey with his staff.

hausa: “Saboda haka in wani ya ce muku, ‘Ga shi can a hamada,’ kada ku fita; ko, ‘Ga shi nan a ɗakunan ciki,’ kada ku gaskata.
english: “If therefore they tell you, ‘Behold, he is in the wilderness,’ don’t go out; or ‘Behold, he is in the inner rooms,’ don’t believe it.

hausa: Sa’ad da kuka yi sansani don ku yi yaƙi da abokan gābanku, ku kiyaye kanku daga duk wani abu marar tsabta.
english: When you go out and camp against your enemies, then you shall keep yourselves from every evil thing.

hausa: Amma ’ya’yanku ƙanana waɗanda ba su san mugunta ko nagarta ba, waɗanda kuke tsammani za a kwashe su ganima, su za su shiga ƙasar. Zan ba da ita gare su, za su kuwa mallake ta.
english: Moreover your little ones, whom you said would be captured or killed, your children, who today have no knowledge of good or evil, shall go in there. I will give it to them, and they shall possess it.

hausa: Mowab shi ne kwanon wankina, a kan Edom zan jefa takalmina; a bisa Filistiya zan yi kirari cikin nasara.”
english: Moab is my wash pot. I will toss my sandal on Edom. I will shout over Philistia.”

hausa: Shekel zai kasance da gera ashirin. Shekel ashirin a haɗa da shekel ashirin da biyar a haɗa da shekel goma sha biyar zai zama mina guda.
english: The shekel shall be twenty gerahs. Twenty shekels plus twenty-five shekels plus fifteen shekels shall be your mina.

hausa: Kai ɗan zaki ne, ya Yahuda, ka dawo daga farauta, ɗana. Kamar zaki, yakan kwanta a miƙe, kamar zakanya, wa yake da ƙarfin halin tashe shi?
english: Judah is a lion’s cub. From the prey, my son, you have gone up. He stooped down, he crouched as a lion, as a lioness. Who will rouse him up?

hausa: A lokacin nan yamma ta yi, sai almajiransa suka zo wurinsa suka ce masa, “Wurin nan ƙauye ne, ga shi kuma lokaci ya ƙure.
english: When it was late in the day, his disciples came to him and said, “This place is deserted, and it is late in the day.

hausa: Ubangiji yana bincike adalai, amma ransa yana ƙi mugaye da masu son rikici.
english: Yahweh examines the righteous, but his soul hates the wicked and him who loves violence.

hausa: Ba shi da mahaifi ko mahaifiya, ba shi da asali, ba shi da farko ko ƙarshe, shi dai kamar Ɗan Allah ne kuma firist ne har abada.
english: without father, without mother, without genealogy, having neither beginning of days nor end of life, but made like the Son of God), remains a priest continually.

hausa: Shawulu ya ce wa bawansa, “Madalla, zo mu tafi.” Sai suka kama hanya suka nufi birnin da mutumin Allah yake.
english: Then Saul said to his servant, “Well said. Come! Let’s go.” So they went to the city where the man of God was.

hausa: Yayinda yake zama a Jejin Faran, sai mahaifiyarsa ta samo masa mata daga Masar.
english: He lived in the wilderness of Paran. His mother got a wife for him out of the land of Egypt.

hausa: Itatuwan gona za su ba da ’ya’yansu, ƙasa kuma za tă ba da amfaninta; mutane za su zauna lafiya a ƙasarsu. Za su san cewa ni ne Ubangiji, sa’ad da na karya karkiyarsu, na cece su daga hannun waɗanda suka bautar da su.
english: The tree of the field will yield its fruit, and the earth will yield its increase, and they will be secure in their land. Then they will know that I am Yahweh, when I have broken the bars of their yoke, and have delivered them out of the hand of those who made slaves of them.

hausa: Ya sa fatar jikina da naman jikina sun tsufa ya kuma karya ƙasusuwana.
english: He has made my flesh and my skin old. He has broken my bones.

hausa: “Idon da yake yi wa mahaifi ba’a, wanda yake wa mahaifiya dariyar rashin biyayya, hankakin kwari za su ƙwaƙule masa ido, ungulai za su cinye su.
english: “The eye that mocks at his father, and scorns obedience to his mother, the ravens of the valley shall pick it out, the young eagles shall eat it.

hausa: Amma fa kuna da wata al’ada in lokacin Bikin Ƙetarewa ya yi, nakan sakar muku da ɗan kurkuku ɗaya. To, kuna so in sakar muku ‘sarkin Yahudawa’?”
english: But you have a custom that I should release someone to you at the Passover. Therefore, do you want me to release to you the King of the Jews?”

hausa: da hanya a gabansu. Waɗannan sun yi kama da ɗakunan da suke wajen arewa; tsawonsu da fāɗinsu duk iri ɗaya ne, da irin mafita ɗaya da kuma yadda aka shirya su. Sun yi kama da ƙofofin da suke wajen arewa
english: The way before them was like the appearance of the rooms which were toward the north. Their length and width were the same. All their exits had the same arrangement and doors.

hausa: Ban kuma tafi Urushalima domin in ga waɗanda suka riga ni zaman manzanni ba, sai dai na hanzarta na tafi ƙasar Arabiya, daga baya sai na koma Damaskus.
english: nor did I go up to Jerusalem to those who were apostles before me, but I went away into Arabia. Then I returned to Damascus.

hausa: Solomon ya sāke gina ƙauyukan da Hiram ya ba shi, ya kuma zaunar da Isra’ilawa a cikinsu.
english: Solomon built the cities which Huram had given to Solomon, and caused the children of Israel to dwell there.

hausa: domin duk haifaffe na Allah yana cin nasara a kan duniya. Bangaskiyarmu kuwa ita ce ta ba mu wannan nasara a kan duniya.
english: For whatever is born of God overcomes the world. This is the victory that has overcome the world: your faith.

hausa: Yesu ya amsa ya ce, “Gaskiya nake faɗa maka, ba wanda zai iya ganin mulkin Allah sai an haife shi ta wurin ruwa da kuma Ruhu.
english: Jesus answered, “Most certainly I tell you, unless one is born of water and Spirit, he can’t enter into God’s Kingdom.

hausa: Wani Balawe mai suna Mattitiya, ɗan farin Shallum mutumin Kora ne aka danƙa masa hakkin toya burodin miƙawa.
english: Mattithiah, one of the Levites, who was the firstborn of Shallum the Korahite, had the office of trust over the things that were baked in pans.

hausa: Yaya za ka ce wa ɗan’uwanka, ‘Ɗan’uwa, bari in cire maka ɗan tsinke da yake idonka,’ alhali kuwa, kai kanka ka kāsa ganin gungumen da yake a naka ido? Kai munafuki! Ka fara cire gungumen daga idonka, sa’an nan za ka iya gani sosai, ka kuma cire ɗan tsinken da yake a idon ɗan’uwanka.”
english: Or how can you tell your brother, ‘Brother, let me remove the speck of chaff that is in your eye,’ when you yourself don’t see the beam that is in your own eye? You hypocrite! First remove the beam from your own eye, and then you can see clearly to remove the speck of chaff that is in your brother’s eye.

hausa: “Ɗan mutum, ka yi rawar jiki yayinda kake cin abincinka, ka kuma yi makyarkyata don tsoro yayinda kake shan ruwanka.
english: “Son of man, eat your bread with quaking, and drink your water with trembling and with fearfulness.

hausa: A wannan dare, za su gasa naman, su ci da ganyaye masu ɗaci, da kuma burodi marar yisti.
english: They shall eat the meat in that night, roasted with fire, with unleavened bread. They shall eat it with bitter herbs.

hausa: ’Ya’yan itatuwa na kowane iri za su yi girma a kowane gefen kogin. Ganyayensu ba su bushe ba, ba kuwa za su fasa yin ’ya’ya ba. Kowane wata za su ba da ’ya’ya domin ruwa daga wuri mai tsarki yana malalo musu. ’Ya’yansu za su zama abinci, ganyayensu kuma za su zama magani.”
english: By the river banks, on both sides, will grow every tree for food, whose leaf won’t wither, neither will its fruit fail. It will produce new fruit every month, because its waters issue out of the sanctuary. Its fruit will be for food, and its leaf for healing.”

hausa: Ka sanar da su Asabbacinka mai tsarki, ka kuma ba su umarnai, da farillai, da kuma dokoki ta wurin bawanka Musa.
english: and made known to them your holy Sabbath, and commanded them commandments, statutes, and a law, by Moses your servant,

hausa: Amma Lot ya ce musu, “A’a, ranka yă daɗe, ka yi haƙuri!
english: Lot said to them, “Oh, not so, my lord.

hausa: ya ce musu, “Kun kawo mini wannan mutum, a matsayin wanda yana zuga mutane su yi tawaye. Na bincike shi a gabanku, ban ga a kan me kuka kawo kararsa ba.
english: and said to them, “You brought this man to me as one that perverts the people, and behold, having examined him before you, I found no basis for a charge against this man concerning those things of which you accuse him.

hausa: Jefa ƙuri’a kan daidaita tsakanin masu faɗa ta kuma ajiye masu faɗan a rabe.
english: The lot settles disputes, and keeps strong ones apart.

hausa: A cikin ƙasar duka,” in ji Ubangiji, “kashi biyu bisa uku za a buge su su hallaka; duk da haka za a bar kashi ɗaya bisa uku a cikinta.
english: It shall happen that in all the land,” says Yahweh, “two parts in it will be cut off and die; but the third will be left in it.

hausa: Bari in ratsa cikin dukan garkunanka yau in fid da masu dabbare-dabbare da tumaki babare-babare, da kowane ɗan rago baƙi, da dabbare-dabbare da babare-babare na awaki daga ciki, waɗannan ne za su zama ladana.
english: I will pass through all your flock today, removing from there every speckled and spotted one, and every black one among the sheep, and the spotted and speckled among the goats. This will be my hire.

hausa: In ba haka, bayan an binne ranka yă daɗe sarki, tare da kakanninsa, za a wulaƙance ni da Solomon ɗana, kamar masu laifi.”
english: Otherwise it will happen, when my lord the king sleeps with his fathers, that I and my son Solomon will be considered criminals.”

hausa: Yana cikin magana ke nan, sai Yahuda, ɗaya daga cikin Sha Biyun ya bayyana. Ya zo tare da taro da suke riƙe da takuba da sanduna. Manyan firistoci da malaman dokoki, da kuma dattawa ne suka turo taron.
english: Immediately, while he was still speaking, Judas, one of the twelve, came—and with him a multitude with swords and clubs, from the chief priests, the scribes, and the elders.

hausa: Bayan suka shiga birnin, sai Elisha ya ce, “Ubangiji, ka buɗe idanun mutanen nan don su gani.” Sa’an nan Ubangiji ya buɗe idanunsu suka ga kansu a tsakiyar Samariya.
english: When they had come into Samaria, Elisha said, “Yahweh, open these men’s eyes, that they may see.” Yahweh opened their eyes, and they saw; and behold, they were in the middle of Samaria.

hausa: Za ka iya tattara taurari bisa ga lokacinsu ko kuma ka bi da beyar da ’ya’yanta zuwa waje?
english: Can you lead the constellations out in their season? Or can you guide the Bear with her cubs?

hausa: Gama duk wanda ya kiyaye dukan doka amma ya yi tuntuɓe a kan abu ɗaya kaɗai, ya zama mai laifin karya dukansu ke nan.
english: For whoever keeps the whole law, and yet stumbles in one point, he has become guilty of all.

hausa: Ubangiji ya yi shela ga iyakokin duniya cewa, “Faɗa wa Diyar Sihiyona, ‘Ga Mai Cetonki yana zuwa! Ga ladarsa tana tare da shi, sakamakonsa yana raka shi.’ ”
english: Behold, Yahweh has proclaimed to the end of the earth: “Say to the daughter of Zion, ‘Behold, your salvation comes! Behold, his reward is with him, and his recompense before him!’”

hausa: Ku kyakkece zuciyarku ba rigunanku ba. Ku juyo ga Ubangiji Allahnku, gama shi mai alheri ne mai tausayi kuma mai jinkirin fushi da yawan ƙauna, yakan kuma janye daga aika da bala’i.
english: Tear your heart and not your garments, and turn to Yahweh, your God; for he is gracious and merciful, slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness, and relents from sending calamity.

hausa: A ranan nan kuka a Urushalima zai yi yawa kamar kukan Hadad Rimmon a filin Megiddo.
english: In that day there will be a great mourning in Jerusalem, like the mourning of Hadadrimmon in the valley of Megiddo.

hausa: “Sa’ad da na je ƙofar birni na zauna a bainin jama’a,
english: when I went out to the city gate, when I prepared my seat in the street.

hausa: ta Bigwai 2,067
english: The children of Bigvai: two thousand sixty-seven.

hausa: Ba shakka da sun fi yashin teku nauyi, shi ya sa nake magana haka.
english: For now it would be heavier than the sand of the seas, therefore my words have been rash.

hausa: Saboda haka sarkin Isra’ila da Yehoshafat sarkin Yahuda suka haura zuwa Ramot Gileyad.
english: So the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat the king of Judah went up to Ramoth Gilead.

hausa: Isra’ilawa suka nemi nufin Ubangiji (A kwanakin nan akwatin alkawarin Allah yana can,
english: The children of Israel asked Yahweh (for the ark of the covenant of God was there in those days,

hausa: Laban ya ce, “Ya fi kyau in ba ka ita, da in ba wani mutum dabam. Zauna tare da ni.”
english: Laban said, “It is better that I give her to you, than that I should give her to another man. Stay with me.”

hausa: Suna haurawa a hanyarsu zuwa Urushalima ke nan, Yesu yana a gaba, almajiran suna bin sa suna mamaki, waɗanda suke bi kuma suna ji tsoro. Ya sāke kai Sha Biyun nan gefe, ya gaya musu abin da zai faru da shi.
english: They were on the way, going up to Jerusalem; and Jesus was going in front of them, and they were amazed; and those who followed were afraid. He again took the twelve, and began to tell them the things that were going to happen to him.

hausa: Zan yabe ka, ya Ubangiji, a cikin al’ummai; zan rera game da kai cikin mutane.
english: I will give thanks to you, Yahweh, among the nations. I will sing praises to you among the peoples.

hausa: Ubangiji tabbatacce zai bayar da abin da yake da kyau, ƙasarmu kuwa za tă ba da amfaninta.
english: Yes, Yahweh will give that which is good. Our land will yield its increase.

hausa: A wannan rana ce Debora da Barak ɗan Abinowam suka rera wannan waƙa.
english: Then Deborah and Barak the son of Abinoam sang on that day, saying,

hausa: Absalom ɗan’uwanta ya ce mata, “Amnon, ɗan’uwanki ya ɓata ki ko? To, ki yi shiru ’yar’uwata; ai, ɗan’uwanki ne. Kada wannan abu yă dame ki.” Tamar kuwa ta zauna a gidan ɗan’uwanta Absalom, zaman kaɗaici.
english: Absalom her brother said to her, “Has Amnon your brother been with you? But now hold your peace, my sister. He is your brother. Don’t take this thing to heart.” So Tamar remained desolate in her brother Absalom’s house.

hausa: Hanyoyinta hanyoyi ne masu daɗi, dukan hanyoyinta kuma salama ne.
english: Her ways are ways of pleasantness. All her paths are peace.

hausa: Dole ne in jira yanzu da suka yi shiru, yanzu da suke tsaye a wurin ba su da amsa.
english: Shall I wait, because they don’t speak, because they stand still, and answer no more?

hausa: Tsawon lokacin da Dawuda ya yi mulki a Hebron a kan gidan Yahuda, shekara bakwai ne da wata shida.
english: The time that David was king in Hebron over the house of Judah was seven years and six months.

hausa: In kuma wahayi ya zo wa wani da yake zaune, sai mai magana na farko yă yi shiru.
english: But if a revelation is made to another sitting by, let the first keep silent.

hausa: Kiristi a rabe ne? Bulus ne aka gicciye dominku? An yi muku baftisma a cikin sunan Bulus ne?
english: Is Christ divided? Was Paul crucified for you? Or were you baptized into the name of Paul?

hausa: Waƙar haurawa. Sa’ad da Ubangiji ya dawo da kamammu zuwa Sihiyona, mun kasance kamar mutanen da suka yi mafarki.
english: A Song of Ascents. When Yahweh brought back those who returned to Zion, we were like those who dream.

hausa: Gabana tana ta fāɗuwa, tsoro ya sa ina rawan jiki; hasken da nake marmari ya zo da razana gare ni.
english: My heart flutters. Horror has frightened me. The twilight that I desired has been turned into trembling for me.

hausa: Mai albarka ne wanda yake karanta waɗannan kalmomin annabci, masu albarka ne kuma waɗanda suke jinsu, suke kuma sa abin da aka rubuta a ciki a zuciya, domin lokaci ya yi kusa.
english: Blessed is he who reads and those who hear the words of the prophecy, and keep the things that are written in it, for the time is near.

hausa: Ba a ba wa bayinka tattaka, duk da haka ana ce mana, ‘Ku yi tubula!’ Ana wa bayinka dūka, amma fa laifin na mutanenka ne.”
english: No straw is given to your servants, and they tell us, ‘Make brick!’ and behold, your servants are beaten; but the fault is in your own people.”

hausa: Sa’an nan idanun waɗanda suka gani ba za su ƙara rufewa ba, kunnuwan waɗanda suka ji kuma za su saurara.
english: The eyes of those who see will not be dim, and the ears of those who hear will listen.

hausa: Ta haka za ka kuɓuta daga rantsuwata sa’ad da ka tafi wurin dangina, ko ma sun ƙi su ba ka ita, za ka kuɓuta daga rantsuwata.’
english: Then you will be clear from my oath, when you come to my relatives. If they don’t give her to you, you shall be clear from my oath.’

hausa: Firistoci da Lawiyawa suka tsaya suka albarkace mutane, Allah kuma ya ji su, gama addu’arsu ya kai sama, mazauninsa mai tsarki.
english: Then the Levitical priests arose and blessed the people. Their voice was heard, and their prayer came up to his holy habitation, even to heaven.

hausa: Ba zan zartar da fushina mai zafi ba, ba kuwa zan juya in ragargaza Efraim ba. Gama ni Allah ne, ba mutum ba, Mai Tsarki a cikinku. Ba zan zo cikin fushi ba.
english: I will not execute the fierceness of my anger. I will not return to destroy Ephraim, for I am God, and not man—the Holy One among you. I will not come in wrath.

hausa: Akwai hidimomi iri-iri, amma Ubangiji ɗaya ne.
english: There are various kinds of service, and the same Lord.

hausa: Ya mutu a kyakkyawar tsufa, bayan ya more dogon rai, wadata da girma. Ɗansa Solomon ya gāje shi a matsayin sarki.
english: He died at a good old age, full of days, riches, and honor; and Solomon his son reigned in his place.

hausa: da ta Barkos, da ta Sisera, da ta Tema,
english: the children of Barkos, the children of Sisera, the children of Temah,

hausa: Matan da suka zo tare da Yesu, daga Galili suka bi Yusuf suka ga kabarin, da kuma yadda aka ajiye jikin.
english: The women who had come with him out of Galilee followed after, and saw the tomb and how his body was laid.

hausa: Gaskiya nake gaya muku, zai sa shi yă lura da dukan dukiyarsa.
english: Most certainly I tell you that he will set him over all that he has.

hausa: Da ya yi kusa da wurin da hanyar ta gangara zuwa Dutsen Zaitun, sai dukan taron almajirai suka fara yabon Allah, da muryoyi masu ƙarfi, da murna, saboda dukan ayyukan banmamaki da suka gani. Suna cewa,
english: As he was now getting near, at the descent of the Mount of Olives, the whole multitude of the disciples began to rejoice and praise God with a loud voice for all the mighty works which they had seen,

hausa: Kai, ka matsa kusa, ka saurara ga dukan abin da Ubangiji Allahnmu ya faɗa. Sa’an nan ka faɗa mana dukan abin da Ubangiji Allahnmu ya faɗa maka. Za mu saurara, mu kuma yi biyayya.”
english: Go near, and hear all that Yahweh our God shall say, and tell us all that Yahweh our God tells you; and we will hear it, and do it.”

hausa: Me ya sa na ma fito daga cikin ciki in ga wahala da baƙin ciki in kuma ƙare kwanakina da kunya?
english: Why did I come out of the womb to see labor and sorrow, that my days should be consumed with shame?

hausa: Sa’an nan Ehud ya fita daga shirayin; ya rufe ƙofar ɗakin saman, ya kuma kulle su.
english: Then Ehud went out onto the porch, and shut the doors of the upper room on him, and locked them.

hausa: Dukansu marasa azanci ne wawaye; gumakan itacen banza ne suke koya musu.
english: But they are together brutish and foolish, instructed by idols! It is just wood.

hausa: Na gane cewa Allah bai aike shi ba, ya yi annabci a kaina domin Tobiya da Sanballat sun yi hayarsa ne.
english: I discerned, and behold, God had not sent him, but he pronounced this prophecy against me. Tobiah and Sanballat had hired him.

hausa: Waɗansu daga cikin mutane suna neman dalilin zargin Yesu, sai suka zuba masa ido, su ga ko zai warkar da shi a ranar Asabbaci.
english: They watched him, whether he would heal him on the Sabbath day, that they might accuse him.

hausa: Leɓunanki suna zub da zaƙi kamar kakin zuma, amaryata; madara da zuma suna a ƙarƙashin harshenki. Ƙanshin rigunanki ya yi kamar na Lebanon.
english: Your lips, my bride, drip like the honeycomb. Honey and milk are under your tongue. The smell of your garments is like the smell of Lebanon.

hausa: “Ta haka bari dukan abokan gābanka su hallaka, ya Ubangiji! Amma bari waɗanda suke ƙaunarka su zama kamar rana sa’ad da ta fito da ƙarfinta.” Sa’an nan ƙasar ta sami zaman lafiya shekara arba’in.
english: “So let all your enemies perish, Yahweh, but let those who love him be as the sun when it rises in its strength.” Then the land had rest forty years.

hausa: Sai ya fara ce musu, “A yau, Nassin nan, ya cika a kunnenku.”
english: He began to tell them, “Today, this Scripture has been fulfilled in your hearing.”

hausa: Sa’an nan Shawulu da dukan mutanensa suka taru suka tafi yaƙi. Suka tarar Filistiyawa sun ruɗe suna yaƙi da juna da takubansu.
english: Saul and all the people who were with him were gathered together, and came to the battle; and behold, they were all striking each other with their swords in very great confusion.

hausa: Duk wanda ya yi ɓatanci wa maƙwabcinsa a ɓoye shi za a kashe; duk mai renin wayo da mai girman kai, ba zan jure masa ba.
english: I will silence whoever secretly slanders his neighbor. I won’t tolerate one who is arrogant and conceited.

hausa: Saboda haka, ku yi tunani da kyau yadda kuke saurara. Duk wanda yake da shi, za a ƙara masa, duk wanda ba shi da shi kuma, abin da yake tsammani yana da shi ma, za a karɓe daga gare shi.”
english: Be careful therefore how you hear. For whoever has, to him will be given; and whoever doesn’t have, from him will be taken away even that which he thinks he has.”

hausa: Mutanen Isra’ila kuwa suka ce wa Hiwiyawa, “Wataƙila kuna kusa da mu, ta yaya za mu yi alkawari da ku?”
english: The men of Israel said to the Hivites, “What if you live among us? How could we make a covenant with you?”

hausa: Dole Haruna yă ƙone turare sa’ad da ya ƙuna fitilu da yamma, ta haka za a riƙa ƙona turare a gaban Ubangiji, daga tsara zuwa tsara.
english: When Aaron lights the lamps at evening, he shall burn it, a perpetual incense before Yahweh throughout your generations.

hausa: Sai ƙungiyar annabawa a Betel suka fito zuwa wajen Elisha suka ce masa, “Ka san cewa Ubangiji zai ɗauki maigidanka daga wurinka yau?” Sai ya ce, “I, na sani, amma kada ku yi magana game da wannan.”
english: The sons of the prophets who were at Bethel came out to Elisha, and said to him, “Do you know that Yahweh will take away your master from over you today?” He said, “Yes, I know it. Hold your peace.”

hausa: Yayinda nake kallon rayayyun halittun nan, sai na ga da’ira a ƙasa kusa da kowace halitta da fuskokinsa huɗu.
english: Now as I saw the living creatures, behold, there was one wheel on the earth beside the living creatures, for each of the four faces of it.

hausa: Sai Musa, bawan Ubangiji da Isra’ilawa suka ci Sihon da Og da yaƙi. Musa bawan Ubangiji kuwa ya ba da ƙasarsu ga mutanen Ruben, mutanen Gad da kuma rabin mutanen kabilar Manasse.
english: Moses the servant of Yahweh and the children of Israel struck them. Moses the servant of Yahweh gave it for a possession to the Reubenites, and the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh.

hausa: Sai ya yi addu’a ya ce, “Ya Ubangiji Allah na maigidana Ibrahim, ka ba ni nasara yau, ka kuma nuna alheri ga maigidana Ibrahim.
english: He said, “Yahweh, the God of my master Abraham, please give me success today, and show kindness to my master Abraham.

hausa: To, ɗan Shawulu yana da ’ya’ya maza biyu da suke shugabannin ’yan hari. Ana kiran ɗaya Ba’ana, ɗayan kuma Rekab. Su ’ya’yan Rimmon mutumin Benyamin ne daga Beyerot, an lissafta Beyerot a ɓangaren Benyamin,
english: Saul’s son had two men who were captains of raiding bands. The name of one was Baanah and the name of the other Rechab, the sons of Rimmon the Beerothite, of the children of Benjamin (for Beeroth also is considered a part of Benjamin;

hausa: Shamsherai, Shehariya, Ataliya,
english: Shamsherai, Shehariah, Athaliah,

hausa: “Kada ka yi addu’a domin wannan mutane ko ka miƙa wani roƙo ko kuka dominsu, domin ba zan saurara ba sa’ad da suka kira gare ni a lokacin ƙuncinsu.
english: “Therefore don’t pray for this people. Don’t lift up cry or prayer for them; for I will not hear them in the time that they cry to me because of their trouble.

hausa: ka ji daga sama, ka kuma gafarta zunubin bayinka, mutanenka Isra’ila. Ka koya musu hanyar da ta dace ta rayuwa, ka kuma aika da ruwan sama a ƙasar da ka ba wa mutanenka gādo.
english: then hear in heaven, and forgive the sin of your servants, and of your people Israel, when you teach them the good way in which they should walk; and send rain on your land which you have given to your people for an inheritance.

hausa: Sai ta ce wa Iliya, “Mutumin Allah, yaya haka? Ka zo ne domin ka nuna wa Allah zunubaina, ka kuma jawo mutuwar ɗana?”
english: She said to Elijah, “What have I to do with you, you man of God? You have come to me to bring my sin to memory, and to kill my son!”

hausa: Allah ɗin, Allahn Yahudawa ne kaɗai? Shi ba Allahn Al’ummai ba ne? I, shi Allahn Al’ummai ne ma,
english: Or is God the God of Jews only? Isn’t he the God of Gentiles also? Yes, of Gentiles also,

hausa: Kada fa mu yi fasikanci yadda waɗansunsu suka yi, har a rana guda mutane dubu ashirin da uku a cikinsu suka mutu.
english: Let’s not commit sexual immorality, as some of them committed, and in one day twenty-three thousand fell.

hausa: Saboda haka, duk wanda yake cikin Kiristi, sabuwar halitta ce, tsohon al’amari ya shuɗe, sabon ya zo!
english: Therefore if anyone is in Christ, he is a new creation. The old things have passed away. Behold, all things have become new.

hausa: ƙaramin ƙururu, babba da jaka, zalɓe,
english: the little owl, the cormorant, the great owl,

hausa: Itacen da ka gani; wanda ya yi girma da ƙarfe, da tsayinsa ya taɓa sararin sama, wanda ana ganinsa ko’ina a duniya,
english: The tree that you saw, which grew and was strong, whose height reached to the sky and its sight to all the earth;

hausa: Ya aiko da duhu ya kuma sa ƙasar tă yi duhu, ba domin sun yi tawaye a kan maganarsa ba?
english: He sent darkness, and made it dark. They didn’t rebel against his words.

hausa: Sa’ad da duniya da dukan mutanenta suka girgiza, ni ne wanda na riƙe ginshiƙan daram. Sela
english: The earth and all its inhabitants quake. I firmly hold its pillars. Selah.

hausa: In kuwa ya ƙi yă saurare su, sai ka gaya wa ikkilisiya; in kuma ya ƙi yă saurari ikkilisiya ma, ka yi da shi kamar marar sanin Allah ko mai karɓar haraji.
english: If he refuses to listen to them, tell it to the assembly. If he refuses to hear the assembly also, let him be to you as a Gentile or a tax collector.

hausa: Ya ce, “Ku tafi ku nemi nufin Ubangiji saboda ni da kuma saboda raguwa a Isra’ila da Yahuda game da abin da aka rubuta a wannan littafin da aka samu. Fushin Ubangiji mai girma ne da aka zuba a kanmu domin kakanninmu ba su kiyaye maganar Ubangiji ba; ba su aikata bisa ga dukan abin da yake a rubuce a wannan littafi ba.”
english: “Go inquire of Yahweh for me, and for those who are left in Israel and in Judah, concerning the words of the book that is found; for great is Yahweh’s wrath that is poured out on us, because our fathers have not kept Yahweh’s word, to do according to all that is written in this book.”

hausa: “ ‘Amma in wanda ake zargin ya kuskura ya fita, ya kai iyakar birnin mafaka wadda ya gudu ya je,
english: “‘But if the man slayer shall at any time go beyond the border of his city of refuge where he flees,

hausa: Gama ɗa yakan ce wannan ba mahaifinsa ba ne, diya kuma takan tayar wa mahaifiyarta, matar ɗa takan yi gāba da uwar mijinta, abokan gāban mutum su ne iyalin cikin gidansa.
english: For the son dishonors the father, the daughter rises up against her mother, the daughter-in-law against her mother-in-law; a man’s enemies are the men of his own house.

hausa: Sai Sarkin ya tambaye su ya ce, “Wanda irin mutum ne ya yi muku wannan magana?”
english: He said to them, “What kind of man was he who came up to meet you and told you these words?”

hausa: Aka yi makoki sosai da azumi, da kuka mai zafi a cikin Yahudawa a kowane lardin da aka kai doka da kuma umarnin sarki. Mutane da yawa suka kwanta a cikin tsummokin makoki da kuma toka.
english: In every province, wherever the king’s commandment and his decree came, there was great mourning among the Jews, and fasting, and weeping, and wailing; and many lay in sackcloth and ashes.

hausa: In haka ne, “Ba sai mu yi ta yin mugunta don yă zama hanyar samun nagarta ba”? Kamar yadda masu baƙar magana game da mu suna cewa wai haka muke faɗa. Tabbatacce za a hukunta irin waɗannan da hukuncin da ya dace da su.
english: Why not (as we are slanderously reported, and as some affirm that we say), “Let’s do evil, that good may come?” Those who say so are justly condemned.

hausa: Suka sa wa birnin suna Dan, wato, sunan kakansu Dan, wanda aka haifa wa Isra’ila, ko da yake a dā ana kira birnin Layish.
english: They called the name of the city Dan, after the name of Dan their father, who was born to Israel; however the name of the city used to be Laish.

hausa: Ka raba teku a gaban kakanninmu, saboda su wuce cikinsa a busasshiyar ƙasa, amma ka hallaka masu binsu cikin zurfafa, nutse kamar dutse a cikin ruwa.
english: You divided the sea before them, so that they went through the middle of the sea on the dry land; and you cast their pursuers into the depths, as a stone into the mighty waters.

hausa: Ai, lokaci yana zuwa da za a ɗauke musu angon. A sa’an nan ne fa za su yi azumi.
english: But the days will come when the bridegroom will be taken away from them, and then they will fast in that day.

hausa: shi mai zuciya biyu ne, marar tsai da zuciyarsa wuri ɗaya a cikin duk abin da yake yi.
english: He is a double-minded man, unstable in all his ways.

hausa: A waje takobi ne, a ciki annoba ne da yunwa; waɗanda suke fili za su mutu ta wurin takobi, waɗanda kuma suke cikin birni yunwa da annoba za su cinye su.
english: “‘The sword is outside, and the pestilence and the famine within. He who is in the field will die by the sword. He who is in the city will be devoured by famine and pestilence.

hausa: Sai Yahuda ya auro wa Er mata, ɗansa na fari, sunanta Tamar.
english: Judah took a wife for Er, his firstborn, and her name was Tamar.

hausa: Saboda haka ana iya fansa mallakar Lawiyawa, wato, gidan da aka sayar a duk birnin da yake nasu, za a kuma mayar a Shekara ta Murna, gama gidaje a biranen Lawiyawa, mallakar Isra’ilawa ne.
english: The Levites may redeem the house that was sold, and the city of his possession, and it shall be released in the Jubilee; for the houses of the cities of the Levites are their possession among the children of Israel.

hausa: Kun yi rayuwa kamar yadda sauran mutanen duniya suke yi, cike da zunubi, kuna biyayya ga sarki masu ikon sarari sama, wato, ruhun nan da yanzu yake aiki a cikin masu ƙin biyayya ga Allah.
english: in which you once walked according to the course of this world, according to the prince of the power of the air, the spirit who now works in the children of disobedience.

hausa: Nan take mutumin ya warke; ya ɗauki tabarmarsa ya yi tafiya. A ranar da wannan ya faru ranar Asabbaci ce,
english: Immediately, the man was made well, and took up his mat and walked. Now that day was a Sabbath.

hausa: Yesu ya amsa ya ce, “A ƙarshe kun gaskata!
english: Jesus answered them, “Do you now believe?

hausa: Sai Haman ya ce wa Sarki Zerzes, “Akwai waɗansu mutanen da suke a warwatse, sun kuma bazu a cikin mutane cikin dukan lardunan masarautarka, waɗanda al’adunsu sun yi dabam da na dukan sauran mutane. Mutanen nan ba sa biyayya da dokokin sarki; ba zai yi wa sarki kyau a jure su ba.
english: Haman said to King Ahasuerus, “There is a certain people scattered abroad and dispersed among the peoples in all the provinces of your kingdom, and their laws are different from other people’s. They don’t keep the king’s laws. Therefore it is not for the king’s profit to allow them to remain.

hausa: “Zan yashe gidana, in rabu da gādona; Zan ba da wadda nake ƙauna a hannuwan abokan gābanta.
english: “I have forsaken my house. I have cast off my heritage. I have given the dearly beloved of my soul into the hand of her enemies.

hausa: Gama ga wane daga cikin mala’ikun Allah ya taɓa cewa, “Kai Ɗana ne; yau na zama Uba a gare ka”? Ko kuwa, “Zan zama Ubansa, shi kuma zai zama Ɗana”?
english: For to which of the angels did he say at any time, “You are my Son. Today I have become your father?” and again, “I will be to him a Father, and he will be to me a Son?”

hausa: ya naɗa mutum uku a bisa waɗannan muƙaddasan, Daniyel yana ɗaya daga cikin mutum ukun nan. Sai aka sa muƙaddasan nan a ƙarƙashin waɗannan uku ɗin domin kada sarki ya yi hasarar kome.
english: and over them three presidents, of whom Daniel was one, that these local governors might give account to them, and that the king should suffer no loss.

hausa: Suka tafi wurin Hilkiya babban firist suka ba shi kuɗin da aka kawo cikin haikalin Allah, wanda Lawiyawa masu tsaron ƙofofi sun tattara daga mutanen Manasse, Efraim da dukan raguwar Isra’ila da kuma daga dukan mutanen Yahuda da Benyamin da kuma mazaunan Urushalima.
english: They came to Hilkiah the high priest and delivered the money that was brought into God’s house, which the Levites, the keepers of the threshold, had gathered from the hands of Manasseh, Ephraim, of all the remnant of Israel, of all Judah and Benjamin, and of the inhabitants of Jerusalem.

hausa: Mu duka ’ya’yan mutum ɗaya maza ne. Bayinka mutane ne masu gaskiya, ba ’yan leƙen asiri ba ne.”
english: We are all one man’s sons; we are honest men. Your servants are not spies.”

hausa: Ya ce, musu, “Ku tafi cikin dukan duniya, ku yi wa’azin bishara ga dukan halitta.
english: He said to them, “Go into all the world and preach the Good News to the whole creation.

hausa: Sai Bulus ya amsa ya ce, “Don me kuke kuka kuna kuma ɓata mini zuciya? A shirye nake ba ma a daure ni kawai ba, amma har ma in mutu a Urushalima saboda sunan Ubangiji Yesu.”
english: Then Paul answered, “What are you doing, weeping and breaking my heart? For I am ready not only to be bound, but also to die at Jerusalem for the name of the Lord Jesus.”

hausa: Al’ul a cikin lambun Allah ba su kai shi ba, balle itatuwan kasharina su kai rassansa, ko itatuwan durumi su kai rassansa, ko itace a lambun Allah ya kai kyansa.
english: The cedars in the garden of God could not hide it. The cypress trees were not like its branches. The pine trees were not like its branches; nor was any tree in the garden of God like it in its beauty.

hausa: Mutanen suka ɗauki saurayin da rai zuwa gida suka kuma ta’azantu ƙwarai da gaske.
english: They brought the boy in alive, and were greatly comforted.

hausa: A tanada musu duk abin da suke bukata. A ba su ’yan bijimai, da raguna, da ’yan tumaki domin miƙa hadaya ta ƙonawa ga Allah na sama, haka kuma dole a tanada wa firistoci alkama, da gishiri, da ruwan inabi, da mai, kullum ba fasawa yadda firistoci suke yi a Urushalima
english: That which they have need of, including young bulls, rams, and lambs, for burnt offerings to the God of heaven; also wheat, salt, wine, and oil, according to the word of the priests who are at Jerusalem, let it be given them day by day without fail,

hausa: “Game da wannan haikalin da kake ginawa, in ka bi ƙa’idodina, ka cika farillaina, ka kiyaye dukan umarnaina, ka kuma yi biyayya da su, zan cika alkawarin da na yi wa mahaifinka Dawuda ta wurinka.
english: “Concerning this house which you are building, if you will walk in my statutes, and execute my ordinances, and keep all my commandments to walk in them, then I will establish my word with you, which I spoke to David your father.

hausa: Sa’ad da wani daga cikin mutanen ya gan haka, sai ya gaya wa Yowab, “Na ga Absalom yana rataye a itacen oak.”
english: A certain man saw it, and told Joab, and said, “Behold, I saw Absalom hanging in an oak.”

hausa: wanda yake so dukan mutane su sami ceto su kuma zo ga sanin gaskiya.
english: who desires all people to be saved and come to full knowledge of the truth.

hausa: Iska takan hura zuwa inda take so. Kai kakan ji motsinta, sai dai ba ka iya sanin inda take fitowa ko kuwa inda za ta. Haka yake ga duk wanda aka haifa ta wurin Ruhu.”
english: The wind blows where it wants to, and you hear its sound, but don’t know where it comes from and where it is going. So is everyone who is born of the Spirit.”

hausa: Ku duba hannuwana da ƙafafuna. Ai, ni ne da kaina! Ku taɓa ni ku ji, ai, fatalwa ba ta da nama da ƙashi, yadda kuke gani nake da su.”
