english: See my hands and my feet, that it is truly me. Touch me and see, for a spirit doesn’t have flesh and bones, as you see that I have.”

hausa: Yaƙub kuwa, ya tafi Sukkot, inda ya gina wuri domin kansa, ya kuma yi bukkoki domin dabbobinsa. Shi ya sa aka kira wurin Sukkot.
english: Jacob traveled to Succoth, built himself a house, and made shelters for his livestock. Therefore the name of the place is called Succoth.

hausa: Ahaz ya ɗauki azurfa da zinariyar da suke a haikalin Ubangiji da suke kuma a ma’ajin fada ya aika wa sarkin Assuriya kyauta.
english: Ahaz took the silver and gold that was found in Yahweh’s house, and in the treasures of the king’s house, and sent it for a present to the king of Assyria.

hausa: Suka yanke shawara su yi shelar a ko’ina a Isra’ila, daga Beyersheba zuwa Dan, suna kiran mutane su zo Urushalima, suka kuma yi Bikin Ƙetarewa ga Ubangiji Allah na Isra’ila. Ba a yi bikin da mutane masu yawa bisa ga abin da aka rubuta ba.
english: So they established a decree to make proclamation throughout all Israel, from Beersheba even to Dan, that they should come to keep the Passover to Yahweh, the God of Israel, at Jerusalem, for they had not kept it in great numbers in the way it is written.

hausa: Kai kuma, ka nuna alheri ga bawanka, gama ka riga ka yi yarjejjeniya da ni a gaban Ubangiji, in kuwa na yi laifi ne sai ka kashe ni da kanka. Don me za ka bashe ni ga mahaifinka?”
english: Therefore deal kindly with your servant, for you have brought your servant into a covenant of Yahweh with you; but if there is iniquity in me, kill me yourself, for why should you bring me to your father?”

hausa: Sa’ad da dukan shugabannin hafsoshin tare da mutanen da suke a karkara suka ji cewa sarkin Babilon ya naɗa Gedaliya ɗan Ahikam gwamna a kan ƙasar ya kuma sa shi ya lura da maza, mata da ’ya’yan da suke mafi talauci a ƙasar da waɗanda ba a kwashe zuwa zaman bauta a Babilon ba,
english: Now when all the captains of the forces who were in the fields, even they and their men, heard that the king of Babylon had made Gedaliah the son of Ahikam governor in the land, and had committed to him men, women, children, and of the poorest of the land, of those who were not carried away captive to Babylon,

hausa: An yi ƙasa da dukan alfarmarka zuwa kabari, tare da surutan garayunka; tsutsotsi sun bazu a ƙarƙashinka tsutsotsi kuma suka rufe ka.
english: Your pomp is brought down to Sheol, with the sound of your stringed instruments. Maggots are spread out under you, and worms cover you.

hausa: Sa’ad da take cikin zafin haihuwa, sai macen da ta karɓi haihuwar ta ce mata, “Kada ki ji tsoro, gama yanzu kin sami wani ɗa.”
english: When she was in hard labor, the midwife said to her, “Don’t be afraid, for now you will have another son.”

hausa: Ta haifa masa ’ya’ya maza. Yewush, Shemariya da Zaham.
english: She bore him sons: Jeush, Shemariah, and Zaham.

hausa: kuka ci abincin ƙasar, ku miƙa wani sashe na amfanin ƙasar a matsayin hadaya ga Ubangiji.
english: then it shall be that when you eat of the bread of the land, you shall offer up a wave offering to Yahweh.

hausa: Shekaru masu yawa ka yi haƙuri da su. Ta wurin Ruhunka ka gargaɗe su ta wurin annabawa. Duk da haka ba su kasa kunne ba, saboda haka ka miƙa su ga maƙwabtansu.
english: Yet many years you put up with them, and testified against them by your Spirit through your prophets. Yet they would not listen. Therefore you gave them into the hand of the peoples of the lands.

hausa: Dawuda ya ce wa Rekab da ɗan’uwansa Ba’ana, ’ya’yan Rimmon mutumin Beyerot, “Muddin Ubangiji yana a raye, wanda ya kuɓutar da ni daga wahala,
english: David answered Rechab and Baanah his brother, the sons of Rimmon the Beerothite, and said to them, “As Yahweh lives, who has redeemed my soul out of all adversity,

hausa: A maimakon haka, sun ga cewa an danƙa mini hakkin wa’azin bishara ga Al’ummai, kamar yadda aka danƙa wa Bitrus ga Yahudawa.
english: but to the contrary, when they saw that I had been entrusted with the Good News for the uncircumcised, even as Peter with the Good News for the circumcised—

hausa: domin kun san cewa gwajin bangaskiyarku yakan haifi daurewa.
english: knowing that the testing of your faith produces endurance.

hausa: Amma Yesu ya juya, ya kwaɓe su.
english: But he turned and rebuked them, “You don’t know of what kind of spirit you are.

hausa: To, waɗanda suka warwatsu saboda tsananin da ya tashi a kan batun Istifanus suka tafi har Funisiya, Saifurus da kuma Antiyok, suna ba da saƙon ga Yahudawa kaɗai.
english: They therefore who were scattered abroad by the oppression that arose about Stephen traveled as far as Phoenicia, Cyprus, and Antioch, speaking the word to no one except to Jews only.

hausa: To, akwai waɗannan firistoci da yawa, da yake mutuwa ta hana su cin gaba da aikin zaman firist;
english: Many, indeed, have been made priests, because they are hindered from continuing by death.

hausa: Dan da Naftali; Gad da Asher.
english: Dan and Naphtali, Gad and Asher.

hausa: Ba su yi nisa da birnin ba sa’ad da Yusuf ya ce wa mai yin masa hidima, “Tashi, ka bi waɗannan mutane nan da nan, in ka same su, ka ce musu, ‘Me ya sa kuka sāka alheri da mugunta?
english: When they had gone out of the city, and were not yet far off, Joseph said to his steward, “Up, follow after the men. When you overtake them, ask them, ‘Why have you rewarded evil for good?

hausa: Dalilin da ya sa na bar ka a Kirit shi ne don ka daidaita abubuwan da suka rage da ba a kammala ba, ka kuma naɗa dattawa a kowane gari, yadda na umarce ka.
english: I left you in Crete for this reason, that you would set in order the things that were lacking and appoint elders in every city, as I directed you—

hausa: Zai yunƙura yă zo da ƙarfin dukan masarautarsa zai kuma nemi haɗinkan sarkin Kudu. Zai kuma ba shi diyarsa yă aura don yă lalatar da mulkin, amma shirinsa ba zai yi nasara ba ko yă taimake shi ba.
english: He will set his face to come with the strength of his whole kingdom, and with him equitable conditions. He will perform them. He will give him the daughter of women, to destroy the kingdom, but she will not stand, and won’t be for him.

hausa: Ya Ubangiji, ka ba da nasara ga sarki! Ka amsa mana sa’ad da muka yi kira!
english: Save, Yahweh! Let the King answer us when we call!

hausa: Kowace mace ta tambayi maƙwabciyarta, da kuma duk wata macen da take cikin gidanta, kayayyakin azurfa da na zinariya da kuma na riguna, waɗanda za ku sa wa ’ya’yanku maza da mata. Ta haka nan za ku washe Masarawa.”
english: But every woman shall ask of her neighbor, and of her who visits her house, jewels of silver, jewels of gold, and clothing. You shall put them on your sons, and on your daughters. You shall plunder the Egyptians.”

hausa: Bayan ya faɗi haka, sai ya tofa miyau a ƙasa, ya kwaɓa laka da miyau ɗin, ya kuma shafa a idanun mutumin.
english: When he had said this, he spat on the ground, made mud with the saliva, anointed the blind man’s eyes with the mud,

hausa: Ni ne na farkon da ya ce wa Sihiyona, ‘Duba, ga su nan!’ Na ba wa Urushalima saƙon labari mai daɗi.
english: I am the first to say to Zion, ‘Behold, look at them;’ and I will give one who brings good news to Jerusalem.

hausa: Ka faɗa wa dukan jama’ar Isra’ila cewa a rana ta goma ga wannan wata, kowane mutum zai ɗauki ɗan rago domin iyalinsa, ɗaya domin kowane gida.
english: Speak to all the congregation of Israel, saying, ‘On the tenth day of this month, they shall take to them every man a lamb, according to their fathers’ houses, a lamb for a household;

hausa: “Saboda haka, ga abin da Ubangiji ya ce, ‘Zan komo Urushalima da jinƙai, a can ne za a sāke gina gidana. Za a kuma miƙe ma’auni a bisa Urushalima,’ in ji Ubangiji Maɗaukaki.
english: Therefore Yahweh says: “I have returned to Jerusalem with mercy. My house shall be built in it,” says Yahweh of Armies, “and a line shall be stretched out over Jerusalem.”’

hausa: Allah ya taimake shi a kan Filistiyawa da kuma a kan Larabawa waɗanda suke zama a Gur-Ba’al da kuma a kan Meyunawa.
english: God helped him against the Philistines, and against the Arabians who lived in Gur Baal, and the Meunim.

hausa: ka kuma saurari abin da suke faɗi. Bayan haka za ka sami ƙarfin hali ka auka musu.” Saboda haka sai ya tafi tare da Fura bawansa zuwa sansanin.
english: You will hear what they say; and afterward your hands will be strengthened to go down into the camp.” Then went he down with Purah his servant to the outermost part of the armed men who were in the camp.

hausa: Ubangiji yana tsare masu tawali’u; sa’ad da nake cikin tsananin bukata, ya cece ni.
english: Yahweh preserves the simple. I was brought low, and he saved me.

hausa: Shawulu ya aiki mutane zuwa gidan Dawuda su yi gadin gidan, su kuma kashe Dawuda. Amma Mikal matar Dawuda ta gargaɗe Dawuda, ta ce, “In ba ka gudu a daren nan ba, kashegari za a kashe ka.”
english: Saul sent messengers to David’s house to watch him and to kill him in the morning. Michal, David’s wife, told him, saying, “If you don’t save your life tonight, tomorrow you will be killed.”

hausa: Don haka, wanda ya auri budurwar ya yi daidai, amma wanda bai aure ta ba ya ma fi.
english: So then both he who gives his own virgin in marriage does well, and he who doesn’t give her in marriage does better.

hausa: Amma game da ’ya’yanku da kuka ce za a kwashe ganima, zan kawo su cikin ƙasar, su ji daɗin ƙasar wadda kuka ƙi.
english: But I will bring in your little ones that you said should be captured or killed, and they shall know the land which you have rejected.

hausa: Saboda haka suka yi wa Musa maganganun banza suka ce, “Ba mu ruwa mu sha.” Musa ya amsa ya ce, “Don me kuke mini maganganun banza? Don me kuke gwada Ubangiji?”
english: Therefore the people quarreled with Moses, and said, “Give us water to drink.” Moses said to them, “Why do you quarrel with me? Why do you test Yahweh?”

hausa: Ka ba bawanka farin ciki gama gare ka, ya Ubangiji, na miƙa raina.
english: Bring joy to the soul of your servant, for to you, Lord, do I lift up my soul.

hausa: ta haka rumbunanka za su cika har su zuba, randunanka kuma su cika har baki da sabon ruwan inabi.
english: so your barns will be filled with plenty, and your vats will overflow with new wine.

hausa: Amma Allah, wanda yakan yi wa masu ɓacin rai ta’aziyya ya yi mana ta’aziyya da zuwan Titus,
english: Nevertheless, he who comforts the lowly, God, comforted us by the coming of Titus,

hausa: Sai Irmiya ya ce wa Sarki Zedekiya, “Wane laifi na yi maka ko fadawanka ko kuwa wannan mutane, da ka sa aka jefa ni cikin kurkuku?
english: Moreover Jeremiah said to King Zedekiah, “How have I sinned against you, against your servants, or against this people, that you have put me in prison?

hausa: Solomon ya tara kekunan yaƙi da dawakai, ya kasance da kekunan yaƙi dubu da ɗari huɗu da kuma dawakai dubu goma sha biyu, waɗanda ya ajiye a biranen kekunan yaƙi, da kuma tare da shi a Urushalima.
english: Solomon gathered chariots and horsemen. He had one thousand four hundred chariots and twelve thousand horsemen that he placed in the chariot cities, and with the king at Jerusalem.

hausa: Mai albarka ne mutumin da ya aikata wannan, mutumin da ya riƙe kam yana kiyaye Asabbaci ba tare da ƙazantar da shi ba, yana kuma kiyaye kansa daga yin mugun abu.”
english: Blessed is the man who does this, and the son of man who holds it fast; who keeps the Sabbath without profaning it and keeps his hand from doing any evil.”

hausa: Sai mutanen ƙasar suka ɗauki Yehoyahaz ɗan Yosiya suka naɗa shi sarki a Urushalima yă gāji mahaifinsa.
english: Then the people of the land took Jehoahaz the son of Josiah, and made him king in his father’s place in Jerusalem.

hausa: Sa’an nan Ubangiji ya ce, “In ba su gaskata ba, ko kuma ba su kula da mu’ujiza ta fari ba, wataƙila su gaskata da ta biyun.
english: “It will happen, if they will not believe you or listen to the voice of the first sign, that they will believe the voice of the latter sign.

hausa: Sa’ad da aka yi masa shari’a, bari a same shi da laifi, bari kuma addu’o’insa su hukunta shi.
english: When he is judged, let him come out guilty. Let his prayer be turned into sin.

hausa: Faɗa wa mahaifina game da dukan girman da aka ba ni a Masar, da kuma game da kome da kuka gani. Ku kuma kawo mahaifina a nan da sauri.”
english: You shall tell my father of all my glory in Egypt, and of all that you have seen. You shall hurry and bring my father down here.”

hausa: Zan suturta firistocinta da ceto, tsarkakanta kuma kullum za su rera don farin ciki.
english: I will also clothe her priests with salvation. Her saints will shout aloud for joy.

hausa: Efraim ba ƙaunataccen ɗana ba ne, ɗan da nake jin daɗinsa? Ko da yake sau da dama ina maganar gāba a kansa, duk da haka nakan tuna da shi. Saboda haka zuciyata tana marmarinsa; ina da jinƙai mai girma dominsa,” in ji Ubangiji.
english: Is Ephraim my dear son? Is he a darling child? For as often as I speak against him, I still earnestly remember him. Therefore my heart yearns for him. I will surely have mercy on him,” says Yahweh.

hausa: “Amma kakanninmu suka ƙi yin masa biyayya. A maimakon haka, sai suka ƙi shi a cikin zuciyarsu kuwa suka koma Masar.
english: to whom our fathers wouldn’t be obedient, but rejected him and turned back in their hearts to Egypt,

hausa: ’Yan’uwa, ina roƙonku ku yi haƙuri da wannan gargaɗi, don ba wata doguwar wasiƙa ce na rubuta muku ba.
english: But I exhort you, brothers, endure the word of exhortation, for I have written to you in few words.

hausa: Daga Mamre, Ibrahim ya kama hanya ya nufi wajajen Negeb, ya zauna a tsakanin Kadesh da Shur. Ya zauna a Gerar na ɗan lokaci,
english: Abraham traveled from there toward the land of the South, and lived between Kadesh and Shur. He lived as a foreigner in Gerar.

hausa: Sai Ubangiji ya ce wa Musa,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

hausa: yadda suka yi tun lokacin da na naɗa shugabanni bisan mutanena Isra’ila, zan kuma hutashe ka daga hannun abokan gābanka. “ ‘Ubangiji ya furta maka cewa Ubangiji kansa zai kafa maka gida.
english: and as from the day that I commanded judges to be over my people Israel. I will cause you to rest from all your enemies. Moreover Yahweh tells you that Yahweh will make you a house.

hausa: Farillanka ne abin farin cikina; su ne mashawartana.
english: Indeed your statutes are my delight, and my counselors. DALETH

hausa: Saboda haka na yi kuka, yadda Yazer take kuka, saboda inabin Sibma. Ya Heshbon, ya Eleyale, na cika ku da hawaye! Sowa ta murna a kanku saboda ’ya’yan itatuwanku da suka nuna da kuma girbinku sun ɓace.
english: Therefore I will weep with the weeping of Jazer for the vine of Sibmah. I will water you with my tears, Heshbon, and Elealeh: for on your summer fruits and on your harvest the battle shout has fallen.

hausa: Dattawan nan ashirin da huɗu da halittu huɗun nan masu rai suka fāɗi suka yi wa Allah sujada, wannan da yake zaune a kursiyi. Suka tā da murya suka ce, “Amin, Halleluya!”
english: The twenty-four elders and the four living creatures fell down and worshiped God who sits on the throne, saying, “Amen! Hallelujah!”

hausa: Sai mahaifiyarsa ta ce wa bayin, “Ku yi duk abin da ya faɗa.”
english: His mother said to the servants, “Whatever he says to you, do it.”

hausa: Ban ga wani a ciki sauran manzanni ba, sai dai Yaƙub ɗan’uwan Ubangiji.
english: But of the other apostles I saw no one except James, the Lord’s brother.

hausa: Ta wurin fushin Ubangiji Maɗaukaki ƙasar za tă ci wuta mutane kuma za su zama abin hura wutar, babu wanda zai ji tausayin ɗan’uwansa.
english: Through Yahweh of Armies’ wrath, the land is burned up; and the people are the fuel for the fire. No one spares his brother.

hausa: Manna kuwa kamar tsabar riɗi take, kamanninta kuma kamar ƙaro ne.
english: The manna was like coriander seed, and it looked like bdellium.

hausa: “Bayan shekaru arba’in suka wuce, sai mala’ika ya bayyana ga Musa cikin harshen wuta a ɗan itace a hamada kusa da Dutsen Sinai.
english: “When forty years were fulfilled, an angel of the Lord appeared to him in the wilderness of Mount Sinai, in a flame of fire in a bush.

hausa: Amma, ’yan’uwa, sa’ad da aka raba mu da ku na ɗan lokaci (a jiki, ba a tunani ba), daga cikin marmarinmu mai tsanani mun yi duk abin da muke iya yi mu gan ku.
english: But we, brothers, being bereaved of you for a short season in presence, not in heart, tried even harder to see your face with great desire,

hausa: Tare da su kuma ’yan’uwansa da suke biye bisa ga matsayi. Wato, Zakariya, Ya’aziyel, Shemiramot, Yehiyel, Unni, Eliyab, Ben, Ma’asehiya, Mattitiya, Elifelehu, Miknehiya, Obed-Edom da Yehiyel, matsaran ƙofofi.
english: and with them their brothers of the second rank: Zechariah, Ben, Jaaziel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Unni, Eliab, Benaiah, Maaseiah, Mattithiah, Eliphelehu, Mikneiah, Obed-Edom, and Jeiel, the doorkeepers.

hausa: Sa’an nan gawawwakin wannan mutane za su zama abinci ga tsuntsayen sama da kuma namun jeji, ba za a kuwa sami wani da zai kore su ba.
english: The dead bodies of this people will be food for the birds of the sky, and for the animals of the earth. No one will frighten them away.

hausa: “Ya tambaye ni ya ce, ‘Wane ne kai?’ “Na ce, ‘Ni mutumin Amalek ne.’
english: He said to me, ‘Who are you?’ I answered him, ‘I am an Amalekite.’

hausa: Sai Ubangiji ya ce wa Musa, “Miƙa hannunka a bisa Masar domin fāra su sauko bisa ƙasar, su ci duk abin da yake girma a gonaki, duk abin da ƙanƙara ta rage.”
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “Stretch out your hand over the land of Egypt for the locusts, that they may come up on the land of Egypt, and eat every herb of the land, even all that the hail has left.”

hausa: Suka sāke tā da murya suka ce, “Halleluya! Hayaƙin yake fitowa daga wurinta ya yi ta tashi sama har abada abadin.”
english: A second said, “Hallelujah! Her smoke goes up forever and ever.”

hausa: Da ya yi kusa da Damaskus a kan hanyarsa, ba zato ba tsammani sai wani haske daga sama ya haskaka kewaye da shi.
english: As he traveled, he got close to Damascus, and suddenly a light from the sky shone around him.

hausa: Zan kawo a kan Elam a kusurwoyi huɗu daga kusurwoyi huɗu na duniya; zan watsar da su zuwa kusurwoyi huɗu, kuma ba al’ummar da masu gudun hijirar Elam ba za su kai ba.
english: I will bring on Elam the four winds from the four quarters of the sky, and will scatter them toward all those winds. There will be no nation where the outcasts of Elam will not come.

hausa: ta goma sha takwas a kan Hanani, na goma sha biya a kan Yerimot, ’ya’yansa maza da danginsa 12
english: for the eighteenth to Hanani, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

hausa: Ya shiga gidan Allah, ya ɗauki keɓaɓɓen burodi, sa’an nan ya ci abin da firistoci kaɗai sukan ci bisa ga doka. Ya kuma ba wa abokan tafiyarsa?”
english: how he entered into God’s house, and took and ate the show bread, and gave also to those who were with him, which is not lawful to eat except for the priests alone?”

hausa: Yanzu bari Allahnmu da Ubanmu kansa da kuma Ubangijinmu Yesu yă shirya mana hanya mu zo wurinku.
english: Now may our God and Father himself, and our Lord Jesus Christ, direct our way to you.

hausa: suka haura da akwatin alkawarin Ubangiji da kuma Tentin Sujada, da dukan kayayyaki masu tsarkin da suke cikinsa. Firistoci da Lawiyawa suka ɗauko su,
english: They brought up Yahweh’s ark, the Tent of Meeting, and all the holy vessels that were in the Tent. The priests and the Levites brought these up.

hausa: Lokacin da ’ya’yansa suka yi masa zunubi, yakan bar su su sha wahalar da zunubi yake kawowa.
english: If your children have sinned against him, he has delivered them into the hand of their disobedience.

hausa: Gama ga abin da Ubangiji yana cewa, ‘Zan maishe ka abin razana ga kanka da kuma ga dukan abokanka; da idanunka za ka gan takobin abokan gāba yana kashe su. Zan miƙa Yahuda duka ga sarkin Babilon, wanda zai kwashe su zuwa Babilon ya kuma kashe su da takobi.
english: For Yahweh says, ‘Behold, I will make you a terror to yourself and to all your friends. They will fall by the sword of their enemies, and your eyes will see it. I will give all Judah into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he will carry them captive to Babylon, and will kill them with the sword.

hausa: Hannuwan shaidun ne za su zama na farko a kisan wanda ake zargin, sa’an nan hannuwan dukan mutane. Dole ku fid da mugu daga cikinku.
english: The hands of the witnesses shall be first on him to put him to death, and afterward the hands of all the people. So you shall remove the evil from among you.

hausa: daga kabilar Naftali kuma aka ba su, Kedesh a cikin Galili (garin masu neman mafaka don sun yi kisa), Hammon-Dor da kuma Kartan, tare da wuraren kiwonsu, garuruwa uku ke nan.
english: Out of the tribe of Naphtali, Kedesh in Galilee with its pasture lands, the city of refuge for the man slayer, Hammothdor with its pasture lands, and Kartan with its pasture lands: three cities.

hausa: Ya kai, Sa Zuciyar Isra’ila, Mai Cetonsa a lokutan wahala, me ya sa kake yi kamar baƙo a ƙasar, kamar matafiyi wanda yake shirya wuri don yă kwana gari ya waye ya wuce?
english: You hope of Israel, its Savior in the time of trouble, why should you be as a foreigner in the land, and as a wayfaring man who turns aside to stay for a night?

hausa: In har sun kuɓuta daga lalacin duniya ta wurin sanin Ubangijinmu da kuma Mai Cetonmu Yesu Kiristi sai suka sāke koma a cikin lalacin, har ya rinjaye su, za su fi muni a ƙarshe fiye da farko.
english: For if, after they have escaped the defilement of the world through the knowledge of the Lord and Savior Jesus Christ, they are again entangled in it and overcome, the last state has become worse for them than the first.

hausa: Yana sa ciyawa tă yi girma saboda shanu, tsire-tsire domin mutum ya nome, suna fid da abinci daga ƙasa,
english: He causes the grass to grow for the livestock, and plants for man to cultivate, that he may produce food out of the earth:

hausa: Fāɗin shirayin kamu ashirin ne, kamu goma sha biyu kuma daga gaba zuwa baya. A kan kai samansa ta wurin hawan matakai, akwai kuma ginshiƙai a kowane gefe na madogaran.
english: The length of the porch was twenty cubits and the width eleven cubits, even by the steps by which they went up to it. There were pillars by the posts, one on this side, and another on that side.

hausa: Kuma ba wanda ya sami ƙarfin halin yin masa waɗansu tambayoyi.
english: They didn’t dare to ask him any more questions.

hausa: Sarauniya Bashti ita ma ta yi liyafa saboda mata a fadar Sarki Zerzes.
english: Also Vashti the queen made a feast for the women in the royal house which belonged to King Ahasuerus.

hausa: Amma mutane suka yi shiru ba su amsa masa ba, domin sarki ya umarta cewa, “Kada ku amsa masa.”
english: But the people stayed quiet, and answered him not a word; for the king’s commandment was, “Don’t answer him.”

hausa: Sai ta kawo wa Shawulu da bayinsa suka kuwa ci. A daren nan suka tashi suka tafi.
english: She brought it before Saul and before his servants, and they ate. Then they rose up and went away that night.

hausa: Kada wani yă kula da kansa kawai, sai dai yă kula da waɗansu kuma.
english: Let no one seek his own, but each one his neighbor’s good.

hausa: Mashaidin gaskiya kan ceci rayuka, amma mashaidin ƙarya mai ruɗu ne.
english: A truthful witness saves souls, but a false witness is deceitful.

hausa: A lokacin ne Annas da Kayifas suke manyan firistoci. Sai maganar Allah ta zo wa Yohanna, ɗan Zakariya a hamada.
english: during the high priesthood of Annas and Caiaphas, the word of God came to John, the son of Zacharias, in the wilderness.

hausa: Amma muka tashi daga Filibbi a jirgin ruwa bayan Bikin Burodi Marar Yisti bayan kuma kwana biyar muka sadu da sauran a Toruwas, inda muka zauna kwana bakwai.
english: We sailed away from Philippi after the days of Unleavened Bread, and came to them at Troas in five days, where we stayed seven days.

hausa: Bayan mako guda, har wa yau almajiransa suna cikin gidan, Toma kuwa yana tare da su. Ko da yake ƙofofi suna kulle, sai ga Yesu ya zo ya tsaya a tsakiyarsu ya ce, “Salama tă kasance tare da ku!”
english: After eight days, again his disciples were inside and Thomas was with them. Jesus came, the doors being locked, and stood in the middle, and said, “Peace be to you.”

hausa: Me Nassin ya ce? “Ibrahim ya gaskata Allah, aka kuma lissafta wannan adalci ne a gare shi.”
english: For what does the Scripture say? “Abraham believed God, and it was accounted to him for righteousness.”

hausa: Amma Ubangiji ya amsa, ya ce; “Daidai ne ka yi fushi?”
english: Yahweh said, “Is it right for you to be angry?”

hausa: Sai Ubangiji Allah na kakanninsu, ya yi ta aika da magana gare su ta wurin ’yan saƙonsa sau da sau, domin ya ji tausayi mutanensa da mazauninsa.
english: Yahweh, the God of their fathers, sent to them by his messengers, rising up early and sending, because he had compassion on his people and on his dwelling place;

hausa: Sa’ad da suka taru a Mizfa, suka kawo ruwa suka zuba a gaban Ubangiji. A wannan rana suka yi azumi suka tuba, suka ce, “Mun yi wa Ubangiji zunubi!” Sama’ila kuwa ya zauna a Mizfa ya yi mulkin Isra’ilawa.
english: They gathered together to Mizpah, and drew water, and poured it out before Yahweh, and fasted on that day, and said there, “We have sinned against Yahweh.” Samuel judged the children of Israel in Mizpah.

hausa: Sai Dawuda ya ɗaga ido ya ga mala’ikan Ubangiji tsaye tsakanin sama da duniya, da takobi a zāre a hannunsa ya miƙa a kan Urushalima. Sai Dawuda da dattawa, saye da rigunan makoki suka fāɗi rubda jiki.
english: David lifted up his eyes, and saw Yahweh’s angel standing between earth and the sky, having a drawn sword in his hand stretched out over Jerusalem. Then David and the elders, clothed in sackcloth, fell on their faces.

hausa: Wani mutum yakan ɗauki kansa mai arziki ne, alhali ba shi da kome, wani ya ɗauki kansa shi matalauci ne, alhali shi mawadaci ne ƙwarai.
english: There are some who pretend to be rich, yet have nothing. There are some who pretend to be poor, yet have great wealth.

hausa: Sai Huram ya yi wani ƙaton kwano na ƙarfen tagulla, da ya kira Teku. Zurfin kwanon nan kamu bakwai da rabi, fāɗinsa kamu goma sha biyar, da’irarsa kuma kamu talatin ne.
english: He made the molten sea ten cubits from brim to brim, round in shape. Its height was five cubits; and a line of thirty cubits encircled it.

hausa: Dubi irin ƙaunar da Uba ya ƙaunace mu da ita mana, har ana ce da mu ’ya’yan Allah! Haka kuwa muke! Dalilin da ya sa duniya ba tă san mu ba shi ne, don ba tă san shi ba.
english: See how great a love the Father has given to us, that we should be called children of God! For this cause the world doesn’t know us, because it didn’t know him.

hausa: Da idanunku kun ga waɗannan gwaje-gwaje, waɗannan alamu masu banmamaki, da al’ajabai masu girma.
english: the great trials which your eyes saw, the signs, and those great wonders.

hausa: Ubangiji kuwa ya ji Hezekiya ya kuma warkar da mutane.
english: Yahweh listened to Hezekiah, and healed the people.

hausa: Rana ba za tă ƙara zama haskenki a yini ba, balle hasken wata ya haskaka a kanki, gama Ubangiji zai zama madawwamin haskenki, Allahnki kuma zai zama ɗaukakarki.
english: The sun will be no more your light by day, nor will the brightness of the moon give light to you, but Yahweh will be your everlasting light, and your God will be your glory.

hausa: Ga karin magana da za su taimake ka don samun hikima da horo; don ganewa kalmomi masu zurfi;
english: to know wisdom and instruction; to discern the words of understanding;

hausa: Uba da ya aiko ni kuwa kansa ya yi shaida game da ni. Ba ku taɓa jin muryarsa ko ganin siffarsa ba,
english: The Father himself, who sent me, has testified about me. You have neither heard his voice at any time, nor seen his form.

hausa: ya kuma ya ba wa kabilar Merari kekunan yaƙi huɗu da shanu takwas bisa ga aikinsu. Aka ba da su duka a ƙarƙashin ikon Itamar ɗan Haruna, firist.
english: He gave four wagons and eight oxen to the sons of Merari, according to their service, under the direction of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.

hausa: Annabawa biyu ko uku za su iya yin magana, sauran kuma sai su auna a hankali abin da aka faɗa.
english: Let two or three of the prophets speak, and let the others discern.

hausa: Sai Asa ya yi fushi sosai da mai duban saboda wannan; ya yi fushi ƙwarai har ya sa aka jefa shi a kurkuku. A lokaci guda kuma Asa ya fara gwada wa mutane azaba.
english: Then Asa was angry with the seer, and put him in the prison; for he was in a rage with him because of this thing. Asa oppressed some of the people at the same time.

hausa: Bulus kuwa ya ci gaba da zama a Korint na ’yan kwanaki. Sa’an nan ya bar ’yan’uwa ya shiga jirgin ruwa zuwa Suriya tare da Firiskila da Akwila. Kafin ya tashi, ya aske kansa a Kenkireya saboda alkawarin da ya yi.
english: Paul, having stayed after this many more days, took his leave of the brothers, and sailed from there for Syria, together with Priscilla and Aquila. He shaved his head in Cenchreae, for he had a vow.

hausa: Ina rubuta muku, ubanni, domin kun san shi wanda yake tun farko. Ina rubuta muku, samari, domin kun ci nasara a kan mugun nan.
english: I write to you, fathers, because you know him who is from the beginning. I write to you, young men, because you have overcome the evil one. I write to you, little children, because you know the Father.

hausa: haske don bayyanawa ga Al’ummai da kuma ɗaukaka ga mutanenka Isra’ila.”
english: a light for revelation to the nations, and the glory of your people Israel.”

hausa: Sai firist ya yi farin ciki. Ya ɗauki efod, sauran allolin gida da siffar da aka sassaƙa ya tafi tare da mutanen.
english: The priest’s heart was glad, and he took the ephod, the teraphim, and the engraved image, and went with the people.

hausa: Sheshan ba shi da ’ya’ya maza, sai ’ya’ya mata kawai. Yana da bawa mutumin Masar mai suna Yarha.
english: Now Sheshan had no sons, but only daughters. Sheshan had a servant, an Egyptian, whose name was Jarha.

hausa: Sama’ila ya ce wa Shawulu, “Ni ne wanda Ubangiji ya aika in shafe ka ka zama sarki bisa mutanensa Isra’ila. Saurara yanzu ka ji saƙo daga wurin Ubangiji.
english: Samuel said to Saul, “Yahweh sent me to anoint you to be king over his people, over Israel. Now therefore listen to the voice of Yahweh’s words.

hausa: Ya Allahnmu, ba kai ba ne ka kore mazaunan wannan ƙasa a gaban mutanenka Isra’ila ka kuma ba da ita har abada ga zuriyar Ibrahim abokinka?
english: Didn’t you, our God, drive out the inhabitants of this land before your people Israel, and give it to the offspring of Abraham your friend forever?

hausa: Ka ƙaunaci abin da yake daidai, ka kuma ƙi mugunta; saboda haka Allah, Allahnka, ya ɗora ka a bisan abokan zamanka, ta wurin shafan da ya yi maka da man farin ciki.”
english: You have loved righteousness and hated iniquity; therefore God, your God, has anointed you with the oil of gladness above your fellows.”

hausa: Daga wannan rana Sama’ila bai ƙara saduwa da sarki Shawulu ba, har rasuwar Sama’ila, amma ya yi baƙin ciki sosai a kan Shawulu. Ubangiji kuwa ya damu da ya sa Shawulu ya zama Sarkin Isra’ila ba.
english: Samuel came no more to see Saul until the day of his death, but Samuel mourned for Saul. Yahweh grieved that he had made Saul king over Israel.

hausa: Da yake mutane da yawa suna taƙama irin ta duniya, ni ma haka zan yi.
english: Seeing that many boast after the flesh, I will also boast.

hausa: Waɗanda suka yi gaba, da kuma waɗanda suke biye, duk suka ɗaga murya, suna cewa, “Hosanna!” “Mai albarka ne wanda yake zuwa a cikin sunan Ubangiji!”
english: Those who went in front and those who followed cried out, “Hosanna! Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord!

hausa: Kaurin ya kai tafin hannu, kuma da’iransa ya yi kama da’irar kwaf, kama furen da ya tohu. Ya riƙe randuna dubu uku.
english: It was a handbreadth thick. Its brim was made like the brim of a cup, like the flower of a lily. It received and held three thousand baths.

hausa: Suka yi labule da gashi akuya goma sha ɗaya don tenti a bisa tabanakul.
english: He made curtains of goats’ hair for a covering over the tabernacle. He made them eleven curtains.

hausa: A maimakonsu, zai ɗaukaka allahn kagarai; allahn da kakanninsa ba su ko sani ba, shi ne zai miƙa masa zinariya, da azurfa, da duwatsu masu daraja, da abubuwa masu tsada.
english: But in their place, he will honor the god of fortresses. He will honor a god whom his fathers didn’t know with gold, silver, and with precious stones and pleasant things.

hausa: Sa’an nan Hosheya ɗan Ela ya ƙulla wa Feka ɗan Remaliya maƙarƙashiya. Ya fāɗa masa ya kuma kashe shi, sa’an nan ya gāje shi a matsayin sarki a shekara ta shirin ta mulkin Yotam ɗan Uzziya.
english: Hoshea the son of Elah made a conspiracy against Pekah the son of Remaliah, attacked him, killed him, and reigned in his place, in the twentieth year of Jotham the son of Uzziah.

hausa: Kujerar tana da matakalai shida, da wurin sa ƙafa na zinariya haɗe da ita. A kowane gefen wurin zama, akwai wurin ajiye hannu, da zaki tsaye kusa da kowannensu.
english: There were six steps to the throne, with a footstool of gold, which were fastened to the throne, and armrests on either side by the place of the seat, and two lions standing beside the armrests.

hausa: Shi da zuriyarsa za su kasance da alkawari na zama firist har abada, saboda kishinsa domin ɗaukakar Allahnsa, ya kuma yi kafara domin Isra’ilawa.”
english: It shall be to him, and to his offspring after him, the covenant of an everlasting priesthood, because he was jealous for his God, and made atonement for the children of Israel.’”

hausa: Duk da haka, waɗansu mutanen Asher, Manasse da Zebulun suka ƙasƙantar da kansu suka tafi Urushalima.
english: Nevertheless some men of Asher, Manasseh, and Zebulun humbled themselves and came to Jerusalem.

hausa: Ba na so ku kasance da rashin sani, ’yan’uwa, cewa dukan kakannin-kakanninmu sun yi tafiya a ƙarƙashin girgije, dukansu kuma suka bi ta tsakiyar teku.
english: Now I would not have you ignorant, brothers, that our fathers were all under the cloud, and all passed through the sea;

hausa: “Ba na sarakuna ba ne, ya Lemuwel, ba na sarakuna ba ne su sha ruwan inabi, ba na masu mulki ba ne su yi marmarin barasa,
english: It is not for kings, Lemuel, it is not for kings to drink wine, nor for princes to say, ‘Where is strong drink?’

hausa: Kabilar Issakar za su yi sansani biye da su. Shugabansu shi ne Netanel ɗan Zuwar.
english: “Those who encamp next to him shall be the tribe of Issachar. The prince of the children of Issachar shall be Nethanel the son of Zuar.

hausa: Zan mai da kai kango har abada; ba za a zauna a cikin garuruwanka ba. Sa’an nan za ka san cewa ni ne Ubangiji.
english: I will make you a perpetual desolation, and your cities will not be inhabited. Then you will know that I am Yahweh.

hausa: Sai Bilatus ya sanar wa manyan firistoci da taron ya ce, “Ni fa, ban sami wani ainihin abin zargi game wannan mutum nan ba.”
english: Pilate said to the chief priests and the multitudes, “I find no basis for a charge against this man.”

hausa: ko ma sa’ad da suka yi wa kansu siffar ɗan maraƙi, suka ce, ‘Wannan shi ne allahnku, wanda ya fitar da ku daga Masar,’ ko sa’ad da suka yi saɓo mai bantsoro.
english: Yes, when they had made themselves a molded calf, and said, ‘This is your God who brought you up out of Egypt,’ and had committed awful blasphemies,

hausa: Ƙasarku ta zama kufai, an ƙone biranenku da wuta; baƙi suna ƙwace gonakinku a idanunku, ta zama kango kamar sa’ad da baƙi suka rushe ta.
english: Your country is desolate. Your cities are burned with fire. Strangers devour your land in your presence and it is desolate, as overthrown by strangers.

hausa: Ya tafi tare da komandodin sojoji, Keretawa, matsara da kuma dukan mutanen ƙasar, tare kuwa suka kawo sarki daga haikalin Ubangiji zuwa cikin fada, ta ƙofar matsara. Sarki kuwa ya ɗauki mazauninsa a bisa kursiyin sarauta,
english: He took the captains over hundreds, and the Carites, and the guard, and all the people of the land; and they brought down the king from Yahweh’s house, and came by the way of the gate of the guard to the king’s house. He sat on the throne of the kings.

hausa: Sai annabi Haggai, da annabi Zakariya zuriyar Iddo, suka yi wa Yahudawa a Yahuda da Urushalima annabci a cikin sunan Allah na Isra’ila wanda yake da mulki a kansu.
english: Now the prophets, Haggai the prophet and Zechariah the son of Iddo, prophesied to the Jews who were in Judah and Jerusalem. They prophesied to them in the name of the God of Israel.

hausa: Makafi biyu kuwa suna zaune a bakin hanya, da suka ji cewa Yesu yana wucewa, sai suka ɗaga murya suka ce, “Ubangiji, Ɗan Dawuda, ka ji tausayinmu!”
english: Behold, two blind men sitting by the road, when they heard that Jesus was passing by, cried out, “Lord, have mercy on us, you son of David!”

hausa: da madogaran ƙofa da matsattsun tagogi da rumfuna kewaye da su ukun, har da kome da yake gaba haɗe da madogarar ƙofa, an rufe su da katako. An rufe bangon haikalin daga ƙasa har zuwa tagogi, tagogin kuwa an rufe su.
english: the thresholds, and the closed windows, and the galleries around on their three stories, opposite the threshold, with wood ceilings all around, and from the ground up to the windows, (now the windows were covered),

hausa: Duk da haka sarkin Ammonawa bai kula da saƙon da Yefta ya aika ba.
english: However, the king of the children of Ammon didn’t listen to the words of Jephthah which he sent him.

hausa: Ka kuma ba ɗana Solomon cikakkiyar zuciya don yă kiyaye umarnanka, farillanka da ƙa’idodinka yă kuma yi kome don yă gina ƙasaitaccen gini wanda na riga na yi tanadi dominsa.”
english: and give to Solomon my son a perfect heart, to keep your commandments, your testimonies, and your statutes, and to do all these things, and to build the palace, for which I have made provision.”

hausa: Ko tun dā can, kuna tsammani muna kāre kanmu a gare ku ne? A gaban Allah muke magana, kamar waɗanda suke cikin Kiristi. Ƙaunatattuna, kome da muke yi, muna yi ne don inganta ku ne.
english: Again, do you think that we are excusing ourselves to you? In the sight of God we speak in Christ. But all things, beloved, are for your edifying.

hausa: Ahaz ya tattara kayayyaki daga haikalin Allah ya kwashe su. Ya kulle ƙofofin haikalin Ubangiji ya kakkafa bagadai a kowace kusurwa a titin Urushalima.
english: Ahaz gathered together the vessels of God’s house, cut the vessels of God’s house in pieces, and shut up the doors of Yahweh’s house; and he made himself altars in every corner of Jerusalem.

hausa: Sai Shawulu ya ce wa mutanen da suke tare da shi, “Ku ƙidaya mayaƙa ku ga wane ne ba ya nan.” Da suka ƙirga sai suka tarar Yonatan da mai ɗaukan makamansa ba sa nan.
english: Then Saul said to the people who were with him, “Count now, and see who is missing from us.” When they had counted, behold, Jonathan and his armor bearer were not there.

hausa: Bel ya rusuna, Nebo ya durƙusa ƙasa; ana ɗaukan gumakansu a kan dabbobi ne. Siffofin da ake yawo da su nawaya ne, kayan nauyi masu gajiyarwa.
english: Bel bows down. Nebo stoops. Their idols are carried by animals, and on the livestock. The things that you carried around are heavy loads, a burden for the weary.

hausa: Ga dai umarnansa, “Kada ku ɗauki kome don tafiyar, sai dai sanda ba burodi, ba jaka, ba kuɗi a ɗamararku.
english: He commanded them that they should take nothing for their journey, except a staff only: no bread, no wallet, no money in their purse,

hausa: sai talauci ya shigo maka kamar ’yan fashi rashi kuma ya zo maka kamar mai hari.
english: so your poverty will come as a robber and your want as an armed man.

hausa: mutum fa? Ai, wannan tsutsa ne, ɗan ƙwaro kawai. Me mutum ya daɗa a gaban Allah!”
english: How much less man, who is a worm, and the son of man, who is a worm!”

hausa: Ku shirya ƙasashe don yaƙi da ita, sarakunan Medes, gwamnoninsu da dukan masu shugabancinsu da kowace ƙasar da take ƙarƙashin mulkinsu.
english: Prepare against her the nations, the kings of the Medes, its governors, and all its deputies, and all the land of their dominion!

hausa: Za su yi ta tuntuɓe; za su fāɗi akan juna. Za su ce, ‘Mu tashi, mu koma zuwa wurin mutanenmu da kuma ƙasashenmu, daga takobin masu danniya.’
english: He made many to stumble. Yes, they fell on one another. They said, ‘Arise! Let’s go again to our own people, and to the land of our birth, from the oppressing sword.’

hausa: Sauran Kohatawan kuma aka ba su garuruwa goma daga iyalan kabilar Efraim, Dan da kuma rabi kabilar Manasse.
english: The rest of the children of Kohath had ten cities by lot out of the families of the tribe of Ephraim, out of the tribe of Dan, and out of the half-tribe of Manasseh.

hausa: Yana ba su horo, don muguntarsu, inda kowa zai gan su,
english: He strikes them as wicked men in the open sight of others;

hausa: sa’ad da dukan jama’a kuwa suka ji cewa Haruna ya mutu, sai dukan gidan Isra’ila suka yi makoki dominsa har kwana talatin.
english: When all the congregation saw that Aaron was dead, they wept for Aaron thirty days, even all the house of Israel.

hausa: Ga abin da ya nuna mini. Ubangiji yana tsaye kusa da bangon da aka gina, bisa ga awon igiyar gwada gini, da kuma magwaji a hannunsa.
english: Thus he showed me: behold, the Lord stood beside a wall made by a plumb line, with a plumb line in his hand.

hausa: “Ya gidan Isra’ila, ashe, ba zan yi da ku yadda mai ginin tukwanen nan yake yi ba?” In ji Ubangiji. “Kamar yumɓu a hannun mai ginin tukwane, haka kuke a hannuna, ya gidan Isra’ila.
english: “House of Israel, can’t I do with you as this potter?” says Yahweh. “Behold, as the clay in the potter’s hand, so are you in my hand, house of Israel.

hausa: Gama abin da nake yi ba shi ne abu mai kyau da nake so in yi ba; a’a, mugun da ba na so in yi, shi ne nake ci gaba da yi.
english: For the good which I desire, I don’t do; but the evil which I don’t desire, that I practice.

hausa: Ga abin da Ubangiji ya ce, “Saboda zunubai uku na Damaskus, har guda huɗu ma, ba zan fasa hukunta su ba. Domin sun ci zalunci Gileyad zalunci mai tsanani,
english: Yahweh says: “For three transgressions of Damascus, yes, for four, I will not turn away its punishment, because they have threshed Gilead with threshing instruments of iron;

hausa: Idanun Ubangiji suna a ko’ina, suna lura da masu aikata mugunta da masu aikata alheri.
english: Yahweh’s eyes are everywhere, keeping watch on the evil and the good.

hausa: Dawuda ya roƙi Allah saboda yaron. Ya yi azumi, ya kuma shiga gidansa ya kwana kwance a ƙasa.
english: David therefore begged God for the child; and David fasted, and went in and lay all night on the ground.

hausa: Sa’an nan za su san cewa ni ne Ubangiji, sa’ad da na mai da ƙasar kango saboda dukan abubuwan banƙyamar da suka yi.’
english: Then they will know that I am Yahweh, when I have made the land a desolation and an astonishment because of all their abominations which they have committed.”’

hausa: Hadayar da ya kawo ita ce, faranti guda ɗaya na azurfa, nauyinsa shekel ɗari ɗaya da talatin, da kuma daro na yayyafawa na azurfa, nauyinsa shekel saba’in, dukan biyu, an auna su bisa ga ma’aunin shekel na tsattsarkan wuri ne, kowannensu cike da lallausan gari, haɗe da mai kamar hadaya ta gari;
english: and his offering was: one silver platter, the weight of which was one hundred thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary, both of them full of fine flour mixed with oil for a meal offering;

hausa: A wata ranar Asabbaci, Yesu yana bi ta gonakin hatsi, sai almajiran suka fara kakkarya kan hatsi suna murjewa a hannuwansu suna ci.
english: Now on the second Sabbath after the first, he was going through the grain fields. His disciples plucked the heads of grain and ate, rubbing them in their hands.

hausa: “Zan mai da kai al’umma mai girma, zan kuma albarkace ka; zan sa sunanka yă zama mai girma, ka kuma zama sanadin albarka.
english: I will make of you a great nation. I will bless you and make your name great. You will be a blessing.

hausa: Saboda haka Sarauniya Esta, ’yar Abihayil, tare da Mordekai mutumin Yahuda, suka rubuta da cikakken iko, suka tabbatar da wannan wasiƙa ta biyu game da Furim.
english: Then Esther the queen, the daughter of Abihail, and Mordecai the Jew wrote with all authority to confirm this second letter of Purim.

hausa: Sai Irmiya ya ce wa iyalin Rekabawa, “Ga abin da Ubangiji Maɗaukaki, Allah na Isra’ila, yana cewa, ‘Kun yi biyayya da umarnin kakanku Yehonadab kuka kuma kiyaye dukan umarnansa kuka yi kome bisa ga tsari.’
english: Jeremiah said to the house of the Rechabites, “Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel, says: ‘Because you have obeyed the commandment of Jonadab your father, and kept all his precepts, and done according to all that he commanded you,’

hausa: Godiya ga Allah, saboda kyautarsa da ta wuce misali!
english: Now thanks be to God for his unspeakable gift!

hausa: Game da sauran zuriyar Lawi kuwa, Daga ’ya’yan Amram maza. Shubayel; daga ’ya’yan Shubayel maza. Yedehiya.
english: Of the rest of the sons of Levi: of the sons of Amram, Shubael; of the sons of Shubael, Jehdeiah.

hausa: Wannan mai zama a can kuwa yana da kamannin dutsen yasfa da karneliya. Bakan gizo, mai kama da zumurrudu, ya kewaye kursiyin.
english: that looked like a jasper stone and a sardius. There was a rainbow around the throne, like an emerald to look at.

hausa: Ka bar mutane suka hau a kawunanmu; mun bi ta wuta da ruwa, amma ka kawo mu zuwa wurin yalwa.
english: You allowed men to ride over our heads. We went through fire and through water, but you brought us to the place of abundance.

hausa: “Kun dai ji na ce, ‘Zan tafi in kuma sāke dawo wurinku.’ In har kuna ƙaunata, za ku yi farin ciki cewa za ni wurin Uba, domin kuwa Uban ya fi ni.
english: You heard how I told you, ‘I am going away, and I will come back to you.’ If you loved me, you would have rejoiced because I said ‘I am going to my Father;’ for the Father is greater than I.

hausa: Amma sojojin Babiloniyawa suka runtumi sarki Zedekiya, suka ci masa a filayen Yeriko. Dukan sojoji suka yashe shi.
english: but the army of the Chaldeans pursued the king, and overtook Zedekiah in the plains of Jericho; and all his army was scattered from him.

hausa: Mutanen Bet-Shemesh suka yi tambaya suka ce, wa zai iya tsaya a gaban Ubangiji Allah Mai Tsarki? Wurin wa akwatin alkawari zai je daga nan?
english: The men of Beth Shemesh said, “Who is able to stand before Yahweh, this holy God? To whom shall he go up from us?”

hausa: Ina yabonka domin yadda ka yi ni abin tsoro ne da kuma abin mamaki; ayyukanka suna da banmamaki, na san da haka sosai.
english: I will give thanks to you, for I am fearfully and wonderfully made. Your works are wonderful. My soul knows that very well.

hausa: Ban da haka ma, ba wanda ya san sa’ad da lokacin mutuwarsa zai yi. Kamar yadda akan kama kifi a muguwar raga, ko a kama tsuntsu a tarko, haka mugun lokaci yakan auko wa mutane, ba tsammani.
english: For man also doesn’t know his time. As the fish that are taken in an evil net, and as the birds that are caught in the snare, even so are the sons of men snared in an evil time, when it falls suddenly on them.

hausa: Da Fir’auna ya ji wannan, sai ya yi ƙoƙari yă kashe Musa, amma Musa ya gudu daga wajen Fir’auna, ya tafi ƙasar Midiyan inda ya zauna kusa da wata rijiya.
english: Now when Pharaoh heard this thing, he sought to kill Moses. But Moses fled from the face of Pharaoh, and lived in the land of Midian, and he sat down by a well.

hausa: Ga abin da Ubangiji ya ce, da wannan za ka san cewa ni ne Ubangiji. Da sandan da yake hannuna zan bugi ruwan Nilu, zai kuma zama jini.
english: Yahweh says, “In this you shall know that I am Yahweh. Behold: I will strike with the rod that is in my hand on the waters which are in the river, and they shall be turned to blood.

hausa: ta Gibeyon 95.
english: The children of Gibeon: ninety-five.

hausa: Gama duk wanda ya roƙa, akan ba shi; wanda ya nema kuwa, yakan samu, wanda kuma ya ƙwanƙwasa, za a buɗe masa ƙofa.
english: For everyone who asks receives. He who seeks finds. To him who knocks it will be opened.

hausa: Amma sarki ya ce, “Ba ruwana da ku, ku ’ya’yan Zeruhiya. Idan yana la’ana ne domin Ubangiji ya ce masa, ‘La’anci Dawuda,’ wa zai ce, ‘Don me kake haka?’ ”
english: The king said, “What have I to do with you, you sons of Zeruiah? Because he curses, and because Yahweh has said to him, ‘Curse David,’ who then shall say, ‘Why have you done so?’”

hausa: Yesu ya ce, “Ni ba mai aljani ba ne, ni dai ina girmama Ubana, ku kuwa ba kwa girmama ni.
english: Jesus answered, “I don’t have a demon, but I honor my Father and you dishonor me.

hausa: Dukan wannan ya faru da mu, ko da yake ba mu manta da kai ba ko mu kasance masu ƙarya ga alkawarinka.
english: All this has come on us, yet we haven’t forgotten you. We haven’t been false to your covenant.

hausa: yă ƙarfafa zukatanku yă kuma gina ku cikin kowane aikin nagari da kuma magana.
english: comfort your hearts and establish you in every good work and word.

hausa: Kada ku bar ƙofar Tentin Sujada ko kuwa ku mutu, domin man Shafan Ubangiji yana kanku.” Saboda haka suka yi kamar yadda Musa ya faɗa.
english: You shall not go out from the door of the Tent of Meeting, lest you die; for the anointing oil of Yahweh is on you.” They did according to the word of Moses.

hausa: Bai nuna bambanci tsakaninmu da su ba, gama ya tsarkake zukatansu ta wurin bangaskiya.
english: He made no distinction between us and them, cleansing their hearts by faith.

hausa: “A lokacin nan, zan zama Allah na dukan kabilan Isra’ila, za su kuma zama mutanena,” in ji Ubangiji.
english: “At that time,” says Yahweh, “I will be the God of all the families of Israel, and they will be my people.”

hausa: A cikinsu akwai Ahiya sanye da efod. Shi yaron Ikabod ɗan’uwan Ahitub ne, ɗan Finehas, ɗan Eli, firist na Ubangiji a Shilo. Ba wanda ya san cewa Yonatan ya tafi wani wuri.
english: including Ahijah the son of Ahitub, Ichabod’s brother, the son of Phinehas, the son of Eli the priest of Yahweh in Shiloh, wearing an ephod. The people didn’t know that Jonathan was gone.

hausa: Bitrus ya ce, “Ka bayyana mana wannan misali.”
english: Peter answered him, “Explain the parable to us.”

hausa: Na dubi duwatsu, sai na ga suna makyarkyata; dukan tuddai kuwa suna lilo.
english: I saw the mountains, and behold, they trembled, and all the hills moved back and forth.

hausa: Wani lokaci girgijen yakan zauna daga yamma har safiya ne kawai, sa’ad da kuma aka ɗaga shi da safe, sai su kama hanya. Ko da rana, ko da dare, duk sa’ad da aka ɗaga girgijen, sai su ma su tashi.
english: Sometimes the cloud was from evening until morning; and when the cloud was taken up in the morning, they traveled; or by day and by night, when the cloud was taken up, they traveled.

hausa: Saboda haka Musa ya sauka wurin mutane ya kuma faɗa musu.
english: So Moses went down to the people, and told them.

hausa: Mutumin Allah ya ce, “Ba zan koma tare da kai ba, ko in ci abinci, ko in sha ruwa tare da kai a can ba.
english: He said, “I may not return with you, nor go in with you. I will not eat bread or drink water with you in this place.

hausa: Rikici ya yi girma ya zama sandar da za a hukunta mugunta; babu wani daga cikin mutanen da za a bari, babu wani dukiyarsu da za a bari, babu wani abin amfani.
english: Violence has risen up into a rod of wickedness. None of them will remain, nor of their multitude, nor of their wealth. There will be nothing of value among them.

hausa: “ ‘Kada ka yi jima’i da matar maƙwabcinka ka ƙazantar da kanka tare da ita.
english: “‘You shall not lie carnally with your neighbor’s wife, and defile yourself with her.

hausa: “Ku ma, ya Kushawa, za a kashe ku da takobina.”
english: You Cushites also, you will be killed by my sword.

hausa: ban da bayinsu maza da mata 7,337; suna kuma da mawaƙa maza da mata 200.
english: in addition to their male servants and their female servants, of whom there were seven thousand three hundred thirty-seven; and they had two hundred singing men and singing women.

hausa: Yesu ya ce, “Zan yi muku tambaya guda. Ku ba ni amsa, ni kuma zan gaya muku, ko da wane iko nake yin waɗannan abubuwa.
english: Jesus said to them, “I will ask you one question. Answer me, and I will tell you by what authority I do these things.

hausa: Sai maganar Ubangiji ta zo wa Iliya, ta ce,
english: Then Yahweh’s word came to him, saying,

hausa: Sai Dawuda ya yi wa matarsa Batsheba ta’aziyya, ya kuma tafi wurinta ya kwana da ita. Ta kuma haifi ɗa, suka ba shi suna Solomon. Ubangiji ya ƙaunace shi;
english: David comforted Bathsheba his wife, and went in to her, and lay with her. She bore a son, and he called his name Solomon. Yahweh loved him;

hausa: Na kuma ga mutane shida suna zuwa daga kowane gefen ƙofar ta bisa, wadda take fuskantar arewa, kowanne da makamin kisa a hannunsa. Tare da su akwai mutum saye da lilin yana rataye da jaka ƙunshe da kayan rubutu a gefensa. Suka shiga suka tsaya kusa da bagaden tagulla.
english: Behold, six men came from the way of the upper gate, which lies toward the north, every man with his slaughter weapon in his hand. One man in the middle of them was clothed in linen, with a writer’s inkhorn by his side. They went in, and stood beside the bronze altar.

hausa: don kada su sha su manta da abin da doka ta umarta, su hana wa waɗanda aka danne hakkinsu.
english: lest they drink, and forget the law, and pervert the justice due to anyone who is afflicted.

hausa: Tabbas suna kama da bunnu; wuta za tă cinye su ƙaf. Ba za su ma iya ceton kansu daga ikon wutar ba. Ba wutar da wani zai ji ɗumi; ba wutar da za a zauna kusa da ita.
english: Behold, they are like stubble. The fire will burn them. They won’t deliver themselves from the power of the flame. It won’t be a coal to warm at or a fire to sit by.

hausa: “Saboda haka, ka ce, ‘Ga abin da Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka yana cewa zan tattaro ku daga al’ummai in kuma dawo da ku daga ƙasashen da aka warwatsa ku, zan kuwa sāke mayar muku da ƙasar Isra’ila.’
english: “Therefore say, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “I will gather you from the peoples, and assemble you out of the countries where you have been scattered, and I will give you the land of Israel.”

hausa: Ya aiki Eliyakim sarkin fada, Shebna marubuci da shugabannin firistoci, dukansu sanye da tufafin makoki, zuwa wurin annabi Ishaya ɗan Amoz.
english: He sent Eliakim, who was over the household, Shebna the scribe, and the elders of the priests, covered with sackcloth, to Isaiah the prophet the son of Amoz.

hausa: Sai maganar Ubangiji ta zo wa Iliya mutumin Tishbe.
english: Yahweh’s word came to Elijah the Tishbite, saying,

hausa: A ranan nan, ba za ku sāke tambaya ta kome ba. Gaskiya nake gaya muku, Ubana zai ba ku kome da kuka roƙa cikin sunana.
english: “In that day you will ask me no questions. Most certainly I tell you, whatever you may ask of the Father in my name, he will give it to you.

hausa: To, fa, takobi ba zai taɓa rabu da gidanka ba, domin ka rena ni, ka kuma ƙwace matar Uriya mutumin Hitti ta zama matarka.’
english: Now therefore the sword will never depart from your house, because you have despised me and have taken Uriah the Hittite’s wife to be your wife.’

hausa: A lokacin ne muka ƙwace wannan ƙasa daga hannun sarakunan nan biyu na Amoriyawa, wato, ƙasa wadda take a hayin Urdun, daga Kwarin Arnon zuwa Dutsen Hermon.
english: We took the land at that time out of the hand of the two kings of the Amorites who were beyond the Jordan, from the valley of the Arnon to Mount Hermon.

hausa: Saboda haka Solomon ya zauna a kujerar sarautar Ubangiji a matsayin sarki a maimakon mahaifinsa Dawuda. Ya yi nasara, dukan Isra’ila kuwa suka yi masa biyayya.
english: Then Solomon sat on the throne of Yahweh as king instead of David his father, and prospered; and all Israel obeyed him.

hausa: Betani bai kai mil biyu ba daga Urushalima,
english: Now Bethany was near Jerusalem, about fifteen stadia away.

hausa: Kada ka yi gudu har ƙafafunka su zama ba takalma maƙogwaronka kuma ya bushe. Amma sai ka ce, ‘Ba amfani! Ina ƙaunar baƙin alloli kuma dole in bi su.’
english: “Keep your feet from being bare, and your throat from thirst. But you said, ‘It is in vain. No, for I have loved strangers, and I will go after them.’

hausa: Dukan yini abokan gābana suna tsokanata; waɗanda suke mini ba’a suna amfani da sunana yă zama abin la’ana.
english: My enemies reproach me all day. Those who are mad at me use my name as a curse.

hausa: Bugu da ƙari, suka ba da rabo ga maza ’yan shekaru uku ko fiye waɗanda sunayensu suna a tarihin zuriya, dukan waɗanda ba za su iya shiga haikalin Ubangiji su yi ayyukansu na kullum ba, bisa ga nawayarsu da kuma sassansu.
english: in addition to those who were listed by genealogy of males, from three years old and upward, even everyone who entered into Yahweh’s house, as the duty of every day required, for their service in their offices according to their divisions;

hausa: Wanda amfani ne, ’yan’uwana, a ce wani yă ce yana da bangaskiya, amma ba shi da ayyuka? Anya, wannan bangaskiya za tă iya cetonsa kuwa?
english: What good is it, my brothers, if a man says he has faith, but has no works? Can faith save him?

hausa: Sa’an nan Musa ya ce wa Haruna da Eleyazar da Itamar ’ya’yansa maza, “Kada ku bar gashin kanku barkatai, kada kuma ku yage tufafinku, don kada ku mutu. Yin haka zai jawo fushin Ubangiji a kan dukan jama’a. Amma dangoginku, wato, dukan Isra’ilawa, suna iya kuka saboda waɗanda Ubangiji ya hallaka da wuta.
english: Moses said to Aaron, and to Eleazar and to Ithamar, his sons, “Don’t let the hair of your heads go loose, and don’t tear your clothes, so that you don’t die, and so that he will not be angry with all the congregation; but let your brothers, the whole house of Israel, bewail the burning which Yahweh has kindled.

hausa: Game da Naftali ya ce, “Naftali ƙosasshe ne da tagomashin Ubangiji, ya kuma cika albarkarsa; zai gāji gefen kudu zuwa tafki.”
english: About Naphtali he said, “Naphtali, satisfied with favor, full of Yahweh’s blessing, Possess the west and the south.”

hausa: Ubangiji Maɗaukaki, zai sa hallakar da aka ƙaddara a kan dukan ƙasa ta faru.
english: For the Lord, Yahweh of Armies, will make a full end, and that determined, throughout all the earth.

hausa: Game da ƙauyukan da filayensu, waɗansu mutanen Yahuda suka zauna a Kiriyat Arba da ƙauyukanta, da Dibon da ƙauyukanta, da Yekabzeyel da ƙauyukanta.
english: As for the villages with their fields, some of the children of Judah lived in Kiriath Arba and its towns, in Dibon and its towns, in Jekabzeel and its villages,

hausa: Yefta ya shugabanci Isra’ila shekara shida. Sa’an nan Yefta mutumin Gileyad ya mutu, aka kuwa binne shi wani gari a Gileyad.
english: Jephthah judged Israel six years. Then Jephthah the Gileadite died, and was buried in the cities of Gilead.

hausa: Taron mutane mai yawa suka bi shi, ya kuwa warkar da su a can.
english: Great multitudes followed him, and he healed them there.

hausa: An ɗaga hannun dama na Ubangiji sama; hannun dama na Ubangiji ya aikata manyan abubuwa!”
english: The right hand of Yahweh is exalted! The right hand of Yahweh does valiantly!”

hausa: Da jin haka Yahudawa suka ce, “Tabɗi, yanzu kam mun san kana da aljani! Ibrahim ya mutu haka ma annabawa, ga shi kana cewa duk wanda ya kiyaye maganarka ba zai ɗanɗana mutuwa ba sam.
english: Then the Jews said to him, “Now we know that you have a demon. Abraham died, as did the prophets; and you say, ‘If a man keeps my word, he will never taste of death.’

hausa: Sa’an nan ya yi kwanoni goma na tagulla, kowane yana cin garwa arba’in, kuma kamu huɗu daga wannan zuwa wancan, kowane dakali yana da daro ɗaya.
english: He made ten basins of bronze. One basin contained forty baths. Every basin measured four cubits. One basin was on every one of the ten bases.

hausa: Sai suka tambayi junansu, “Wa ya yi wannan?” Sa’ad da suka bincika a hankali, sai aka faɗa musu, “Gideyon ɗan Yowash ne ya yi haka.”
english: They said to one another, “Who has done this thing?” When they inquired and asked, they said, “Gideon the son of Joash has done this thing.”

hausa: A shekara ta uku ta mulkinsa, ya yi wa dukan hakimansa da ma’aikatansa liyafa. Shugabannin mayaƙan Farisa, da Mediya, da yerimai; da kuma hakimai na lardunan suka kasance.
english: in the third year of his reign, he made a feast for all his princes and his servants; the army of Persia and Media, the nobles and princes of the provinces being before him.

hausa: Sa’ad da aka gama dukan wannan, sai Isra’ilawan da suke can suka fita zuwa garuruwan Yahuda, suka rurrushe keɓaɓɓun duwatsu suka kuma farfashe ginshiƙan Ashera. Suka rurrushe masujadan kan tudu da bagadai, ko’ina a Yahuda da Benyamin da kuma cikin Efraim da Manasse. Bayan sun rurrushe dukansu, sai Isra’ilawa suka koma garuruwansu, kowanne zuwa mahallinsa.
english: Now when all this was finished, all Israel who were present went out to the cities of Judah and broke the pillars in pieces, cut down the Asherah poles, and broke down the high places and the altars out of all Judah and Benjamin, also in Ephraim and Manasseh, until they had destroyed them all. Then all the children of Israel returned, every man to his possession, into their own cities.

hausa: Ɗan Yonatan shi ne, Merib-Ba’al wanda shi ne mahaifin Mika.
english: The son of Jonathan was Merib-baal. Merib-baal became the father of Micah.

hausa: Ya sa la’antarwa kamar rigarsa; ta shiga cikin jikinsa kamar ruwa, cikin ƙasusuwansa kamar mai.
english: He clothed himself also with cursing as with his garment. It came into his inward parts like water, like oil into his bones.

hausa: Zan kafa wurin zamana a cikinku, ba zan kuma yi ƙyamarku ba.
english: I will set my tent among you, and my soul won’t abhor you.

hausa: Sa’an nan kofatan dawakai suka ƙwaƙula, suna sukuwa, haka dawakansa masu ƙarfi suke tafiya.
english: Then the horse hoofs stamped because of the prancing, the prancing of their strong ones.

hausa: da magariba, yayinda rana tana fāɗuwa, yayinda duhun dare yana farawa.
english: in the twilight, in the evening of the day, in the middle of the night and in the darkness.

hausa: Ya kuma ce, “Albarka ta tabbata ga Ubangiji Allah na Shem! Bari Kan’ana yă zama bawan Shem.
english: He said, “Blessed be Yahweh, the God of Shem. Let Canaan be his servant.

hausa: Yesu ya ce, “Kada ku hana shi. Ba wanda yake yin ayyukan banmamaki a cikin sunana, nan take yă faɗi wani abu mummuna game da ni.
english: But Jesus said, “Don’t forbid him, for there is no one who will do a mighty work in my name and be able quickly to speak evil of me.

hausa: Sa’an nan “ ‘za su ce wa duwatsu, “Ku fāɗi a kanmu!” Za su ce wa tuddai kuma, “Ku rufe mu!” ’
english: Then they will begin to tell the mountains, ‘Fall on us!’ and tell the hills, ‘Cover us.’

hausa: Nebukadnezzar sarkin Babilon ya hauro ya kara da shi. Ya kama shi, ya daure da sarƙoƙin tagulla, ya kuma kai shi Babilon.
english: Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came up against him, and bound him in fetters to carry him to Babylon.

hausa: Zan kai mace har haihuwa in kuma sa ta kāsa haihu?” In ji Ubangiji. “Zan rufe mahaihuwa sa’ad da lokacin haihuwa ya yi?” In ji Allahnku.
english: Shall I bring to the birth, and not cause to be delivered?” says Yahweh. “Shall I who cause to give birth shut the womb?” says your God.

hausa: Kada ku yi yadda suke yi a Masar inda da kuke zama, kuma ba a ku yi kamar yadda suke yi a ƙasar Kan’ana inda nake kawo ku ba. Kada ku yi yadda suke yin abubuwa.
english: You shall not do as they do in the land of Egypt, where you lived. You shall not do as they do in the land of Canaan, where I am bringing you. You shall not follow their statutes.

hausa: Kowace safiya zan rufe bakunan dukan mugaye a ƙasar; zan yanke kowane mai aikata mugunta daga birnin Ubangiji.
english: Morning by morning, I will destroy all the wicked of the land, to cut off all the workers of iniquity from Yahweh’s city.

hausa: Ka sa waɗannan a cikin kwando. Sa’an nan ka miƙa su tare da ɗan bijimin da ragunan nan biyu.
english: You shall put them into one basket, and bring them in the basket, with the bull and the two rams.

hausa: Ku ji, ya Isra’ila, Ubangiji Allahnmu, Ubangiji ɗaya ne.
english: Hear, Israel: Yahweh is our God. Yahweh is one.

hausa: Yaron ya yi girma, wata rana sai ya tafi wurin mahaifinsa, wanda yake tare da masu girbi.
english: When the child was grown, one day he went out to his father to the reapers.

hausa: haɗe da Yehohiyada, shugaban iyalin Haruna tare da mutane 3,700,
english: Jehoiada was the leader of the household of Aaron; and with him were three thousand seven hundred,

hausa: Yehiyel na Gibeyon ya zauna a Gibeyon. Sunan matarsa Ma’aka,
english: The father of Gibeon, whose wife’s name was Maacah, lived in Gibeon

hausa: Ka ɗauki garkuwa da kuma makami; ka tashi ka taimake ni.
english: Take hold of shield and buckler, and stand up for my help.

hausa: har da kuka manta da Ubangiji Mahaliccinku, wanda ya shimfiɗa sammai ya kuma kafa harsashen duniya, har kuna zama da tsoro kowace rana saboda fushin masu zalunci, waɗanda sun ƙudura sai sun hallaka? Gama ina fushin mai zalunci?
english: Have you forgotten Yahweh your Maker, who stretched out the heavens, and laid the foundations of the earth? Do you live in fear continually all day because of the fury of the oppressor, when he prepares to destroy? Where is the fury of the oppressor?

hausa: Amma ba wanda ya ce, ‘Ina Allah wanda ya halicce ni, mai ba da waƙoƙi cikin dare,
english: But no one says, ‘Where is God my Maker, who gives songs in the night,

hausa: Wurin dausayin kiwo sun rufu da garkuna kwari kuma sun cika da hatsi; suna sowa don farin ciki.
english: The pastures are covered with flocks. The valleys also are clothed with grain. They shout for joy! They also sing.

hausa: suka kuwa roƙe shi yă bar marasa lafiya su taɓa ko da gefen rigarsa kawai, duk waɗanda suka taɓa shi kuwa suka warke.
english: and they begged him that they might just touch the fringe of his garment. As many as touched it were made whole.

hausa: Bilatus kuwa ya sāke fitowa ya ce wa Yahudawa, “Ga shi, zan fito muku da shi don ku san cewa ban same shi da wani abin zargi ba.”
english: Then Pilate went out again, and said to them, “Behold, I bring him out to you, that you may know that I find no basis for a charge against him.”

hausa: Zai zama murabba’i, tsawon zai zama kamu ɗaya, fāɗi kuma kamu ɗaya, amma tsayin yă zama kamu biyu, ƙahoninsa kuma su zama ɗaya da shi.
english: Its length shall be a cubit, and its width a cubit. It shall be square, and its height shall be two cubits. Its horns shall be of one piece with it.

hausa: Muna rubuta wannan domin farin cikinmu yă zama cikakke.
english: And we write these things to you, that our joy may be fulfilled.

hausa: Wata ne ke ƙididdigar lokuta, rana kuma ta san sa’ad da za tă fāɗi.
english: He appointed the moon for seasons. The sun knows when to set.

hausa: Wata rana kuma mala’iku suka sāke kawo kansu gaban Ubangiji, sai Shaiɗan shi ma ya zo tare da su yă nuna kansa a gabansa.
english: Again, on the day when God’s sons came to present themselves before Yahweh, Satan came also among them to present himself before Yahweh.

hausa: Ba sa yin wani abin da ba daidai ba; suna tafiya a hanyoyinsa.
english: Yes, they do nothing wrong. They walk in his ways.

hausa: A rana ta uku Ibrahim ya ɗaga ido sai ya ga wurin daga nesa.
english: On the third day Abraham lifted up his eyes, and saw the place far off.

hausa: Na aiki Tikikus zuwa Afisa.
english: But I sent Tychicus to Ephesus.

hausa: Da suka iso, sai ya ce musu, “Kun san irin zaman da na yi tun lokacin da na zauna da ku, daga ranar farkon da na zo cikin lardin Asiya.
english: When they had come to him, he said to them, “You yourselves know, from the first day that I set foot in Asia, how I was with you all the time,

hausa: A cikin addu’arsu dominku kuwa, zukatansu za su koma gare ku, saboda mafificin alherin da Allah ya ba ku.
english: while they themselves also, with supplication on your behalf, yearn for you by reason of the exceeding grace of God in you.

hausa: Za ka yi kyakkyawan tsufa kafin ka mutu, kamar yadda ake tara dammuna a lokacin girbi.
english: You will come to your grave in a full age, like a shock of grain comes in its season.

hausa: Duba, za su zo daga nesa waɗansu daga arewa, waɗansu daga yamma, waɗansu daga yankin Aswan.”
english: Behold, these shall come from afar, and behold, these from the north and from the west, and these from the land of Sinim.”

hausa: Ƙofofi goma sha biyun nan lu’ulu’ai goma sha biyu ne, kowace ƙofa an yi ta da lu’ulu’u guda. Babban titin birnin kuwa an yi shi da zinariya zalla, yana kuma ƙyalli kamar madubi.
english: The twelve gates were twelve pearls. Each one of the gates was made of one pearl. The street of the city was pure gold, like transparent glass.

hausa: amma ya yi tsayi daka, ya bugi Filistiyawa sai da hannunsa ya gaji har ya liƙe wa māshinsa. Ubangiji kuwa ya sa aka yi babban nasara a ranar. Sauran sojoji suka komo wurin Eleyazar, don kawai su washe ganima.
english: He arose and struck the Philistines until his hand was weary, and his hand froze to the sword; and Yahweh worked a great victory that day; and the people returned after him only to take plunder.

hausa: Sa’ad da Enosh ya yi shekara 90, sai ya haifi Kenan.
english: Enosh lived ninety years, and became the father of Kenan.

hausa: Sa’ad da kake tafiya, za su bishe ka; sa’ad da kake barci, za su lura da kai; sa’ad da ka farka, za su yi maka magana.
english: When you walk, it will lead you. When you sleep, it will watch over you. When you awake, it will talk with you.

hausa: “ ‘In mutum ya kwana da bābarsa, ya ƙasƙantar da kawunsa ke nan. Hakkin zai kasance a kansu, za su mutu babu ’ya’ya.
english: If a man lies with his uncle’s wife, he has uncovered his uncle’s nakedness. They shall bear their sin. They shall die childless.

hausa: A yanzu, a cikin ƙasar duka, ba abinci, gama yunwa ta yi tsanani ƙwarai, har ƙasar Masar da ƙasar Kan’ana suka shiga matsananciyar wahala!
english: There was no bread in all the land; for the famine was very severe, so that the land of Egypt and the land of Canaan fainted by reason of the famine.

hausa: Ka kuɓutar da ni ka cece ni cikin adalcinka; ka juya kunnenka gare ni ka kuma cece ni.
english: Deliver me in your righteousness, and rescue me. Turn your ear to me, and save me.

hausa: Wanda ya ci nasara, kamar su, za a sanya masa fararen tufafi. Ba zan taɓa share sunansa daga cikin littafin rai ba, sai dai zan shaida sunansa a gaban Ubana da mala’ikunsa.
english: He who overcomes will be arrayed in white garments, and I will in no way blot his name out of the book of life, and I will confess his name before my Father, and before his angels.

hausa: Daga yanzu duk namijin da aka haifa a cikinku za a yi masa kaciya a rana ta takwas har dukan zamananku, ko haifaffen gida ne, ko sayayye da kuɗi daga kowane baƙo wanda ba na zuriyarku ba.
english: He who is eight days old shall be circumcised among you, every male throughout your generations, he who is born in the house, or bought with money from any foreigner who is not of your offspring.

hausa: Sai macen ta ce, “Ranka yă daɗe, ba ka da guga rijiyar kuwa tana da zurfi. Ina za ka sami wannan ruwan rai?
english: The woman said to him, “Sir, you have nothing to draw with, and the well is deep. So where do you get that living water?

hausa: Saboda haka, ka tuna fa, abin da ka karɓa ka kuma ji; ka yi biyayya da shi, ka kuma tuba. Amma in ba ka farka ba, zan zo kamar ɓarawo, ba kuwa za ka san lokacin da zan zo maka ba.
english: Remember therefore how you have received and heard. Keep it and repent. If therefore you won’t watch, I will come as a thief, and you won’t know what hour I will come upon you.

hausa: ’Yan kasuwa a cikin al’ummai suna yin miki tsaki; kin zo ga mummunar ƙarshe ba za ki ƙara kasancewa ba har abada.’ ”
english: The merchants among the peoples hiss at you. You have come to a terrible end, and you will be no more.”’”

hausa: “Ga abin da Ubangiji, Allah na Isra’ila, yana ce maka, Baruk.
english: “Yahweh, the God of Israel, says to you, Baruch:

hausa: Waɗanda suke jagorar wannan mutane suna ɓad da su, su ne waɗanda ake jagora aka sa suka kauce.
english: For those who lead this people lead them astray; and those who are led by them are destroyed.

hausa: Ban da haka, na zaɓi Oholiyab ɗan Ahisamak, na kabilar Dan, don yă taimake shi. Na kuma ba da fasaha ga dukan masu aikin sana’ar hannu, don yin duk abin da na umarce ka.
english: Behold, I myself have appointed with him Oholiab, the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan; and in the heart of all who are wise-hearted I have put wisdom, that they may make all that I have commanded you:

hausa: Suka kuwa rera sabuwar waƙa a gaban kursiyin da kuma a gaban halittu huɗun nan masu rai, da kuma a gaban dattawa. Ba wanda ya iya koyon waƙar sai mutanen nan 144,000 da aka fansa daga duniya.
english: They sing a new song before the throne and before the four living creatures and the elders. No one could learn the song except the one hundred forty-four thousand, those who had been redeemed out of the earth.

hausa: Suka wofinta dukan umarnan Ubangiji Allahnsu, suka yi wa kansu gumakan zubi na siffar ’yan maruƙa biyu, da kuma ginshiƙin Ashera. Suka rusuna wa rundunan taurari, suka kuma yi wa Ba’al sujada.
english: They abandoned all the commandments of Yahweh their God, and made molten images for themselves, even two calves, and made an Asherah, and worshiped all the army of the sky, and served Baal.

hausa: Amma annabin nan Gad ya ce wa Dawuda, “Kada ka zauna a nan, maza ka tashi ka shiga ƙasar Yahuda”. Sai Dawuda ya tashi ya tafi jejin Heret.
english: The prophet Gad said to David, “Don’t stay in the stronghold. Depart, and go into the land of Judah.” Then David departed, and came into the forest of Hereth.

hausa: Gama hikima za tă shiga cikin zuciyarka, sani kuma zai faranta maka rai.
english: For wisdom will enter into your heart. Knowledge will be pleasant to your soul.

hausa: Suka tambaye ta cewa, “Mace, don me kike kuka?” Ta ce, “Sun ɗauke Ubangijina, ban kuma san inda suka ajiye shi ba.”
english: They asked her, “Woman, why are you weeping?” She said to them, “Because they have taken away my Lord, and I don’t know where they have laid him.”

hausa: Ba a kawo kuɗi daga hadayun laifi da na hadayun zunubi a haikalin Ubangiji ba, waɗannan na firistoci ne.
english: The money for the trespass offerings and the money for the sin offerings was not brought into Yahweh’s house. It was the priests’.

hausa: Ya ba shi suna Nuhu ya kuma ce, “Zai yi mana ta’aziyya a cikin aikinmu da wahalar hannuwanmu a ƙasar da Ubangiji ya la’anta.”
english: He named him Noah, saying, “This one will comfort us in our work and in the toil of our hands, caused by the ground which Yahweh has cursed.”

hausa: Saboda haka, ta wurin Yesu, bari mu ci gaba da miƙa hadaya ta yabo ga Allah, yabon leɓuna da yake shaidar sunansa.
english: Through him, then, let’s offer up a sacrifice of praise to God continually, that is, the fruit of lips which proclaim allegiance to his name.

hausa: Sa’an nan Amnon ya ce wa Tamar, “Kawo abincin a nan a cikin ɗakin kwanciyata, don in ci daga hannunki.” Tamar kuwa ta ɗauki burodin da ta toya, ta kawo wa ɗan’uwanta Amnon a ciki ɗakin kwanciyarsa.
english: Amnon said to Tamar, “Bring the food into the room, that I may eat from your hand.” Tamar took the cakes which she had made, and brought them into the room to Amnon her brother.

hausa: Sa’an nan aka buɗe haikalin Allah da yake a sama, kuma a cikin haikalinsa aka ga akwatin alkawarinsa. Sai kuwa ga walƙiya, ƙararraki, tsawa, girgizar ƙasa, da kuma ƙanƙara masu girma.
english: God’s temple that is in heaven was opened, and the ark of the Lord’s covenant was seen in his temple. Lightnings, sounds, thunders, an earthquake, and great hail followed.

hausa: An nuna mini mugun wahayi, mai bashewa ya bashe, mai washewa ya washe. Elam, ki yi yaƙi! Mediya, ki yi kwanto! Zan kawo ƙarshen dukan nishe-nishen da ta jawo.
english: A grievous vision is declared to me. The treacherous man deals treacherously, and the destroyer destroys. Go up, Elam; attack! I have stopped all of Media’s sighing.

hausa: Kowane abu mai rai da yake tafiya a duniya ya hallaka, tsuntsaye, dabbobin gida, namun jeji, da dukan masu rarrafe waɗanda suke rarrafe a duniya, da kuma dukan mutane.
english: All flesh died that moved on the earth, including birds, livestock, animals, every creeping thing that creeps on the earth, and every man.

hausa: Saboda haka a gabas sun ɗaukaka Ubangiji, a ɗaukaka sunan Ubangiji, Allah na Isra’ila, a cikin tsibiran teku.
english: Therefore glorify Yahweh in the east, even the name of Yahweh, the God of Israel, in the islands of the sea!

hausa: To wani mala’ikan Ubangiji ya ce wa Filibus, “Ka yi kudu zuwa hanyar, hanyar hamada, da ta gangara daga Urushalima zuwa Gaza.”
english: Then an angel of the Lord spoke to Philip, saying, “Arise, and go toward the south to the way that goes down from Jerusalem to Gaza. This is a desert.”

hausa: Mutanen Dawuda suka ce, wannan rana ce Ubangiji ya yi magana ya ce maka, “Zan ba da maƙiyinka a hannunka domin ka yi abin da ka ga dama da shi.” Sai Dawuda ya tashi a hankali ya je ya yanke shafin rigar Shawulu.
english: David’s men said to him, “Behold, the day of which Yahweh said to you, ‘Behold, I will deliver your enemy into your hand, and you shall do to him as it shall seem good to you.’” Then David arose and cut off the skirt of Saul’s robe secretly.

hausa: ko za ka iya shimfiɗa sararin sama tare da shi da ƙarfi kamar madubi?
english: Can you, with him, spread out the sky, which is strong as a cast metal mirror?

hausa: a gaban abokansa da kuma sojojin Samariya ya ce, “Me waɗancan Yahudawan nan marasa ƙarfi suke yi? Za su maido da katangarsu ne? Za su miƙa hadayu ne? Za su gama a rana ɗaya? Za su iya samun duwatsun gini daga tsibin matattun duwatsu?”
english: He spoke before his brothers and the army of Samaria, and said, “What are these feeble Jews doing? Will they fortify themselves? Will they sacrifice? Will they finish in a day? Will they revive the stones out of the heaps of rubbish, since they are burned?”

hausa: Amma da Yesu ya juya ya dubi almajiransa, sai ya tsawata wa Bitrus ya ce, “Tashi daga nan Shaiɗan! Ba ka da al’amuran Allah a zuciyarka, sai na mutane.”
english: But he, turning around and seeing his disciples, rebuked Peter, and said, “Get behind me, Satan! For you have in mind not the things of God, but the things of men.”

hausa: A kuma ba da tunkiya daga kowane garke mai tumaki ɗari biyu daga makiyaya da aka yi masa banruwa sosai na Isra’ila. Za a yi amfani da waɗannan don hadayun gari, hadayun ƙonawa da hadayun salama don yin kafara saboda mutane, in ji Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka.
english: and one lamb of the flock out of two hundred, from the well-watered pastures of Israel—for a meal offering, for a burnt offering, and for peace offerings, to make atonement for them,” says the Lord Yahweh.

hausa: Dukan mutanen ƙasar za su binne su, kuma ranar da za a ɗaukaka ni za tă zama ranar tuni a gare su, in ji Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka.
english: Yes, all the people of the land will bury them; and they will become famous in the day that I will be glorified,” says the Lord Yahweh.

hausa: “A kwanaki masu zuwa, in ɗanka ya tambaye ka, ‘Mene ne manufar wannan?’ Ka faɗa masa cewa, ‘Da hannu mai iko Ubangiji ya fito da mu daga Masar, daga ƙasar bauta.
