english: It shall be, when your son asks you in time to come, saying, ‘What is this?’ that you shall tell him, ‘By strength of hand Yahweh brought us out from Egypt, from the house of bondage.

hausa: Su ne za su lura da burodin da aka ajiye a tebur, lallausan gari don hadaya ta gari, waina marar yisti, toyawa da kwaɓawa, da kuma dukan awon yawa da kuma girman abubuwa.
english: for the show bread also, and for the fine flour for a meal offering, whether of unleavened wafers, or of that which is baked in the pan, or of that which is soaked, and for all measurements of quantity and size;

hausa: Sai ya yi kira ya ce, “Yesu, Ɗan Dawuda, ka yi mini jinƙai!”
english: He cried out, “Jesus, you son of David, have mercy on me!”

hausa: A wannan dare Ubangiji ya bayyana gare shi ya ce, “Ni ne Allah na mahaifinka Ibrahim. Kada ka ji tsoro, gama ina tare da kai, zan albarkace ka, zan kuma ƙara yawan zuriyarka saboda bawana Ibrahim.”
english: Yahweh appeared to him the same night, and said, “I am the God of Abraham your father. Don’t be afraid, for I am with you, and will bless you, and multiply your offspring for my servant Abraham’s sake.”

hausa: Amma in Ruhu ne yake bishe ku, ba ku a ƙarƙashin Doka ke nan.
english: But if you are led by the Spirit, you are not under the law.

hausa: Mutumin da muke wannan zance a kai, ai, shi na wata kabila ce dabam, wadda ba wani daga kabilar da ya taɓa yin hidima a bagade.
english: For he of whom these things are said belongs to another tribe, from which no one has officiated at the altar.

hausa: In ya same ta, zai sa ta a kafaɗa da murna,
english: When he has found it, he carries it on his shoulders, rejoicing.

hausa: ’Ya’yan Dishon maza su ne, Hemdan, Eshban, Itran da Keran.
english: These are the children of Dishon: Hemdan, Eshban, Ithran, and Cheran.

hausa: Waɗannan sun nemi sunayen iyalansu a cikin littafin da ake rubuta sunayen amma ba su ga sunayensu ba, saboda haka sai aka hana su zama firistoci domin an ɗauka su marasa tsabta ne.
english: These sought their place among those who were registered by genealogy, but they were not found; therefore they were deemed disqualified and removed from the priesthood.

hausa: Da jarumin ya ga abin da ya faru, sai ya yabi Allah ya ce, “Gaskiya, wannan mutum mai adalci ne.”
english: When the centurion saw what was done, he glorified God, saying, “Certainly this was a righteous man.”

hausa: “Ga abin da Ubangiji Maɗaukaki, Allah na Isra’ila, yana cewa ka aika da wasiƙu da sunanka ga dukan mutane a Urushalima, zuwa ga Zefaniya ɗan Ma’asehiya firist da kuma ga sauran firistoci. Ka ce wa Zefaniya,
english: “Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel, says, ‘Because you have sent letters in your own name to all the people who are at Jerusalem, and to Zephaniah the son of Maaseiah, the priest, and to all the priests, saying,

hausa: Ka biya masa bukatar zuciyarsa ba ka kuwa hana masa roƙon da ya yi da leɓunansa ba. Sela
english: You have given him his heart’s desire, and have not withheld the request of his lips. Selah.

hausa: Sai mutanen Gibeyon suka aika zuwa wurin Yoshuwa a sansani a Gilgal, “Kada ka juya wa bayinka baya, ka zo da sauri ka cece mu! Ka taimake mu domin sarakunan Amoriyawa duka daga kan tudu sun haɗa ƙarfinsu tare za su tasar mana.”
english: The men of Gibeon sent to Joshua at the camp at Gilgal, saying, “Don’t abandon your servants! Come up to us quickly and save us! Help us; for all the kings of the Amorites that dwell in the hill country have gathered together against us.”

hausa: Bokaye suka kāsa tsayawa a gaban Musa saboda maruran da suke bisansu da a kan dukan Masarawa.
english: The magicians couldn’t stand before Moses because of the boils; for the boils were on the magicians and on all the Egyptians.

hausa: sarakuna biyar na Filistiyawa, dukan Kan’aniyawa, Sidoniyawa, da kuma Hiwiyawan da suke zaune a duwatsun Lebanon daga Dutsen Ba’al-Hermon zuwa Lebo Hamat.
english: the five lords of the Philistines, all the Canaanites, the Sidonians, and the Hivites who lived on Mount Lebanon, from Mount Baal Hermon to the entrance of Hamath.

hausa: Ku gai da Afelles wanda amincinsa cikin Kiristi tabbatacce ne. Ku gai da iyalin gidan Aristobulus.
english: Greet Apelles, the approved in Christ. Greet those who are of the household of Aristobulus.

hausa: Ina da shanu da jakuna, tumaki da awaki, bayi maza da mata. Yanzu ina aika da wannan saƙo zuwa ga ranka yă daɗe, don in sami tagomashi a idanunka.’ ”
english: I have cattle, donkeys, flocks, male servants, and female servants. I have sent to tell my lord, that I may find favor in your sight.’”

hausa: ga abin da Ubangiji yana cewa, tabbatacce zan hukunta Shemahiya mutumin Nehelam da zuriyarsa. Ba zai kasance da wani da ya rage a cikin wannan mutane ba, ba kuwa zai ga abubuwa alherin da zan yi wa mutanena ba, in ji Ubangiji, domin ya yi wa’azin tawaye a kaina.’ ”
english: therefore Yahweh says, “Behold, I will punish Shemaiah the Nehelamite and his offspring. He will not have a man to dwell among this people. He won’t see the good that I will do to my people,” says Yahweh, “because he has spoken rebellion against Yahweh.”’”

hausa: Ga shi yanzu ka faɗa mini alherin da ka yi mini. Ubangiji ya bashe ni a hannunka amma ba ka kashe ni ba.
english: You have declared today how you have dealt well with me, because when Yahweh had delivered me up into your hand, you didn’t kill me.

hausa: A buɗe ƙofofi saboda al’umma mai adalci ta shiga, al’ummar da mai aminci.
english: Open the gates, that the righteous nation may enter: the one which keeps faith.

hausa: Yanzu, ya mata, ku ji maganar Ubangiji; ku buɗe kunnuwanku ga maganar bakina. Ku koya wa ’yan matanku yadda za su yi kuka; ku koya wa juna makoki.
english: Yet hear Yahweh’s word, you women. Let your ear receive the word of his mouth. Teach your daughters wailing. Everyone teach her neighbor a lamentation.

hausa: Wani mutum kan bayar hannu sake, duk da haka yakan sami fiye; wani yakan riƙe abin da ba nasa ba, amma sai ya ƙarasa cikin talauci.
english: There is one who scatters, and increases yet more. There is one who withholds more than is appropriate, but gains poverty.

hausa: Yohanan mahaifin Azariya (shi ne ya yi hidima a matsayin firist a haikalin da Solomon ya gina a Urushalima),
english: Johanan became the father of Azariah, who executed the priest’s office in the house that Solomon built in Jerusalem.

hausa: yana musu bayani da tabbatarwa cewa dole Kiristi ya sha wahala ya kuma tashi daga matattu. Ya kuma ce, “Wannan Yesu da nake sanar muku shi ne Kiristi.”
english: explaining and demonstrating that the Christ had to suffer and rise again from the dead, and saying, “This Jesus, whom I proclaim to you, is the Christ.”

hausa: Sa’an nan bari yarinyar da ta gamshi sarki, tă zama sarauniya a maimakon Bashti.” Wannan shawara ta gamshi sarki, ya kuwa yi na’am da ita.
english: and let the maiden who pleases the king be queen instead of Vashti.” The thing pleased the king, and he did so.

hausa: Allah yă ƙarfafa ku da dukan iko bisa ga ɗaukakar ƙarfinsa domin ku kasance da jimrewa sosai da kuma haƙuri, cikin farin ciki
english: strengthened with all power, according to the might of his glory, for all endurance and perseverance with joy,

hausa: Wannan shi ne hidimar da kabilar Gershonawa za su yi a Tentin Sujada. Ayyukansu za su kasance bisa ga umarnin Itamar ɗan Haruna firist.
english: This is the service of the families of the sons of the Gershonites in the Tent of Meeting. Their duty shall be under the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.

hausa: Da Yesu ya faɗa haka, sai ɗaya daga cikin ma’aikatan da yake tsaye kusa ya mare shi a fuska ya ce, “Haka za ka amsa wa babban firist?”
english: When he had said this, one of the officers standing by slapped Jesus with his hand, saying, “Do you answer the high priest like that?”

hausa: Yahudawa da yawa suka gaskata, haka ma waɗansu manyan matan Hellenawa da kuma mazan Hellenawa da yawa.
english: Many of them therefore believed; also of the prominent Greek women, and not a few men.

hausa: Zuciyata ta ƙosa saboda marmari don dokokinka koyaushe.
english: My soul is consumed with longing for your ordinances at all times.

hausa: Ba su kori Kan’aniyawan da suke zama a Gezer ba, don haka Kan’aniyawa suna zama tare da mutanen Efraim har wa yau; amma Kan’aniyawa suka zama masu yin aikin dole.
english: They didn’t drive out the Canaanites who lived in Gezer; but the Canaanites dwell in the territory of Ephraim to this day, and have become servants to do forced labor.

hausa: Tsoron Ubangiji kan ƙara tsawon rai, amma akan gajartar da shekarun mugaye.
english: The fear of Yahweh prolongs days, but the years of the wicked shall be shortened.

hausa: Kada ka yi sha’awarta a cikin zuciyarka kada ka bar ta tă ɗauki hankalinka da idanunta.
english: Don’t lust after her beauty in your heart, neither let her captivate you with her eyelids.

hausa: Dawuda ya ci gaba da mutane ɗari huɗu, don mutane ɗari biyu sun gaji sosai har sun kāsa ƙetare rafin Besor.
english: But David pursued, he and four hundred men; for two hundred stayed behind, who were so faint that they couldn’t go over the brook Besor.

hausa: To, fa, ɗaukakar Allah na Isra’ila ta haura daga bisa kerubobi, inda ta kasance, ta tashi zuwa bakin madogarar ƙofar haikali. Sai Ubangiji ya kira mutumin da yake saye da lilin wanda ya rataye jaka ƙunshe da kayan rubutu a gefensa
english: The glory of the God of Israel went up from the cherub, whereupon it was, to the threshold of the house; and he called to the man clothed in linen, who had the writer’s inkhorn by his side.

hausa: Ban yi fushi ba. Da a ce ƙayayyuwa da sarƙaƙƙiya ne suke kalubalanta na mana! Zan fita in yi yaƙi da su; da na sa musu wuta duka.
english: Wrath is not in me, but if I should find briers and thorns, I would do battle! I would march on them and I would burn them together.

hausa: Dawakai sukan yi gudu a kan duwatsu? Wani yana iya yin noma a teku da shanun noma? Amma ga shi kun mai da gaskiya ta zama dafi amfanin adalci kuma ya zama ɗaci,
english: Do horses run on the rocky crags? Does one plow there with oxen? But you have turned justice into poison, and the fruit of righteousness into bitterness,

hausa: A ranan nan Ubangiji ya ɗaukaka Yoshuwa a gaban Isra’ilawa; suka kuma ba shi girma dukan kwanakin ransa, kamar yadda suka girmama Musa.
english: On that day, Yahweh magnified Joshua in the sight of all Israel; and they feared him, as they feared Moses, all the days of his life.

hausa: Don mai bi da kaɗe-kaɗe. Da kayan kiɗi masu tsirkiya. Bisa ga sheminit. Ta Dawuda. Ya Ubangiji, kada ka tsawata mini cikin fushinka ko ka hore ni cikin hasalarka.
english: For the Chief Musician; on stringed instruments, upon the eight-stringed lyre. A Psalm by David. Yahweh, don’t rebuke me in your anger, neither discipline me in your wrath.

hausa: Gama mun san cewa da yake an tā da Kiristi daga matattu, ba zai sāke mutuwa ba; mutuwa ba ta da sauran iko a kansa.
english: knowing that Christ, being raised from the dead, dies no more. Death no longer has dominion over him!

hausa: Sai suka dalaye katakan da zinariya, suka yi zoban zinariya don su riƙe sandunan. Suka kuma dalaye sandunan da zinariya.
english: He overlaid the boards with gold, and made their rings of gold as places for the bars, and overlaid the bars with gold.

hausa: Amma wani annabin Ubangiji mai suna Oded yana a can, sai ya fito don yă sadu da mayaƙa sa’ad da suke komowa zuwa Samariya. Ya ce musu, “Domin Ubangiji Allah na kakanninku yana fushi da Yahuda, ya ba da su cikin hannunku. Sai kuka kashe su cikin fushin da ya kai sama.
english: But a prophet of Yahweh was there, whose name was Oded; and he went out to meet the army that came to Samaria, and said to them, “Behold, because Yahweh, the God of your fathers, was angry with Judah, he has delivered them into your hand, and you have slain them in a rage which has reached up to heaven.

hausa: Sai Bildad mutumin Shuwa ya amsa,
english: Then Bildad the Shuhite answered,

hausa: Sa’ad da suka ga kuɗin ya yi yawa, sai su ba wa waɗanda aka zaɓa su lura da aikin haikalin. Da shi suka biya waɗanda suka yi aiki a haikalin Ubangiji, su kafintoci, da magina,
english: They gave the money that was weighed out into the hands of those who did the work, who had the oversight of Yahweh’s house; and they paid it out to the carpenters and the builders who worked on Yahweh’s house,

hausa: Gama wanda yake bawa sa’ad da Ubangiji ya kira shi, ’yantacce ne na Ubangiji; haka ma, wanda yake ’yantacce sa’ad da aka kira shi, bawa ne na Kiristi.
english: For he who was called in the Lord being a bondservant is the Lord’s free man. Likewise he who was called being free is Christ’s bondservant.

hausa: Ka yi mini jinƙai, Ubangiji, gama na suma; Ya Ubangiji, ka warkar da ni, gama ƙasusuwana suna zafin ciwo.
english: Have mercy on me, Yahweh, for I am faint. Yahweh, heal me, for my bones are troubled.

hausa: Duk da haka, domin alkawarin da Ubangiji ya yi wa Dawuda, Ubangiji bai so yă hallaka gidan Dawuda ba. Ubangiji ya riga ya yi alkawari zai ci gaba da riƙe fitila domin Dawuda da zuriyarsa har abada.
english: However Yahweh would not destroy David’s house, because of the covenant that he had made with David, and as he promised to give a lamp to him and to his children always.

hausa: A shekara ta goma sha biyu, a wata na goma sha biyu a rana ta fari, maganar Ubangiji ta zo mini cewa,
english: In the twelfth year, in the twelfth month, in the first day of the month, Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

hausa: Sa’an nan Ubangiji ya ce, “Kamar dai yadda bawana Ishaya ya yi ta yawo tsirara kuma ba takalmi a ƙafa shekara uku, a matsayin alama da shaida a kan Masar da Kush,
english: Yahweh said, “As my servant Isaiah has walked naked and barefoot three years for a sign and a wonder concerning Egypt and concerning Ethiopia,

hausa: Sai Na’omi ta ce, “Ki jira, ’yata, sai kin ga abin da zai faru. Gama mutumin ba zai huta ba sai an warware batun a yau.”
english: Then she said, “Wait, my daughter, until you know what will happen; for the man will not rest until he has settled this today.”

hausa: Duba, wuta ta sauko daga sama ta cinye su kaftin nan biyu waɗanda suka zo da farko da dukan sojojinsu. To, yanzu dai, ka daraja raina!”
english: Behold, fire came down from the sky and consumed the last two captains of fifty with their fifties. But now let my life be precious in your sight.”

hausa: Me ya sa na sami wannan tagomashi har da mahaifiyar Ubangijina za tă zo wurina?
english: Why am I so favored, that the mother of my Lord should come to me?

hausa: “Su bayinka ne da kuma mutanenka da ka fansa ta wurin ƙarfinka mai girma da kuma hannunka mai iko.
english: “Now these are your servants and your people, whom you have redeemed by your great power and by your strong hand.

hausa: Yawancinsu za su yi tuntuɓe; za su fāɗi a kuwa ragargaza su, za a sa musu tarko a kuma kama su.”
english: Many will stumble over it, fall, be broken, be snared, and be captured.”

hausa: Mutumin kirki kan bar gādo wa ’ya’ya ’ya’yansa, amma arzikin mai zunubi ajiye ne da aka yi wa mai adalci.
english: A good man leaves an inheritance to his children’s children, but the wealth of the sinner is stored for the righteous.

hausa: “ ‘Kowace hadaya ta garin da kuka kawo ga Ubangiji, dole a yi shi ba tare da yisti ba, gama ba za ku ƙone wani yisti, ko zuma a cikin hadayar da aka yi ga Ubangiji ta wuta ba.
english: “‘No meal offering which you shall offer to Yahweh shall be made with yeast; for you shall burn no yeast, nor any honey, as an offering made by fire to Yahweh.

hausa: Laifofina sun mamaye ni kamar nauyin da ya sha ƙarfin ɗauka.
english: For my iniquities have gone over my head. As a heavy burden, they are too heavy for me.

hausa: Don mai bi da kaɗe-kaɗe. Zabura ta Dawuda. Waƙa. Zabura. Ku yi sowa ta farin ciki ga Allah, dukan duniya!
english: For the Chief Musician. A song. A Psalm. Make a joyful shout to God, all the earth!

hausa: Kabilar Simeyon za su yi sansani biye da su. Shugaban mutanensa shi ne Shelumiyel ɗan Zurishaddai.
english: “Those who encamp next to him shall be the tribe of Simeon. The prince of the children of Simeon shall be Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai.

hausa: Saboda haka Lawiyawa suka zaɓi Heman ɗan Yowel, da Asaf ɗan Berekiya daga cikin ’yan’uwansu. Daga iyalin Merari kuma aka zaɓi Etan ɗan Kushahiya.
english: So the Levites appointed Heman the son of Joel; and of his brothers, Asaph the son of Berechiah; and of the sons of Merari their brothers, Ethan the son of Kushaiah;

hausa: Sai sarki ya ba da umarni ya ce, “Ku je ku tabbatar da inda yake don in aika mutane a kamo shi.” Sai ya sami rahoto cewa, “Yana a Dotan.”
english: He said, “Go and see where he is, that I may send and get him.” He was told, “Behold, he is in Dothan.”

hausa: Maganar Ubangiji ta zo mini cewa
english: Yahweh’s word also came to me, saying,

hausa: Na gaji tiƙis daga nishi. Dukan dare na jiƙe gadona da kuka na jiƙe kujerata da hawaye.
english: I am weary with my groaning. Every night I flood my bed. I drench my couch with my tears.

hausa: ya kuma kasance a hamada kwana arba’in, Shaiɗan yana gwada shi. Yana tare da namomin jeji, mala’iku kuma suka yi masa hidima.
english: He was there in the wilderness forty days, tempted by Satan. He was with the wild animals; and the angels were serving him.

hausa: Ku ɗaukaka Ubangiji Allahnku kafin ya kawo duhu, kafin ƙafafunku su yi tuntuɓe a kan tuddai masu duhu. Za ku sa zuciya ganin haske amma zai mai da shi duhu mai kauri ya kuma canja shi zuwa duhu baƙi ƙirin.
english: Give glory to Yahweh your God, before he causes darkness, and before your feet stumble on the dark mountains, and while you look for light, he turns it into the shadow of death, and makes it deep darkness.

hausa: Ya ci gaba, “Na ji cewa akwai hatsi a Masar. Ku gangara can ku sayo mana, domin mu rayu kada mu mutu.”
english: He said, “Behold, I have heard that there is grain in Egypt. Go down there, and buy for us from there, so that we may live, and not die.”

hausa: Sai Yesu ya kira su, ya yi musu magana da misalai ya ce, “Yaya Shaiɗan zai fitar da Shaiɗan?
english: He summoned them and said to them in parables, “How can Satan cast out Satan?

hausa: Amma ba kamar mahaifinsa Manasse ba, bai ƙasƙantar da kansa a gaban Ubangiji ba; Amon ya ƙara laifinsa.
english: He didn’t humble himself before Yahweh, as Manasseh his father had humbled himself; but this same Amon trespassed more and more.

hausa: Sai ’yar’uwarsa ta tambayi ’yar Fir’auna, ta ce, “In tafi in samo ɗaya daga cikin matan Ibraniyawa tă yi miki renon yaron?”
english: Then his sister said to Pharaoh’s daughter, “Should I go and call a nurse for you from the Hebrew women, that she may nurse the child for you?”

hausa: Ya yi magana, sai fāri ɗango suka fito, fāran da ba su ƙidayuwa;
english: He spoke, and the locusts came with the grasshoppers, without number.

hausa: Bayan kwanakin makoki suka ƙare, Dawuda ya sa aka kawo ta gidansa, ta kuwa zama matarsa, ta kuma haifa masa ɗa. Sai dai abin da Dawuda ya yi bai gamshi Ubangiji ba.
english: When the mourning was past, David sent and took her home to his house, and she became his wife and bore him a son. But the thing that David had done displeased Yahweh.

hausa: Amma idanun mugaye ba za su iya gani ba, kuma ba za su iya tserewa ba; begensu zai zama na mutuwa.”
english: But the eyes of the wicked will fail. They will have no way to flee. Their hope will be the giving up of the spirit.”

hausa: “Kaiton ’ya’ya masu tayarwa,” in ji Ubangiji, “ga waɗanda suke ƙulle-ƙullen da ba nawa ba, suna yin yarjejjeniya, amma ba ta Ruhuna ba, suna jibga zunubi a kan zunubi;
english: “Woe to the rebellious children”, says Yahweh, “who take counsel, but not from me; and who make an alliance, but not with my Spirit, that they may add sin to sin;

hausa: Amma Ubangiji ya wahalar da Fir’auna da gidansa da cututtuka masu zafi saboda Saira, matar Abram.
english: Yahweh afflicted Pharaoh and his house with great plagues because of Sarai, Abram’s wife.

hausa: Kafin Ishaya yă bar tsakiyar filin gida, sai maganar Ubangiji ta zo masa cewa,
english: Before Isaiah had gone out into the middle part of the city, Yahweh’s word came to him, saying,

hausa: Ƙungiyoyin mawaƙa biyu da suka yi godiya suka ɗauki wurarensu a gidan Allah, haka ma ni, tare da rabin shugabanni,
english: So the two companies of those who gave thanks in God’s house stood, and I and the half of the rulers with me;

hausa: Sa’an nan Ubangiji ya ce wa Musa, “Ka ce wa Haruna, ‘Miƙa hannunka ka bugi ƙurar ƙasa,’ dukan ƙurar ƙasar Masar kuwa za tă zama ƙwari masu cizo.”
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “Tell Aaron, ‘Stretch out your rod, and strike the dust of the earth, that it may become lice throughout all the land of Egypt.’”

hausa: Kamar dai yadda muka ɗauki siffar mutumin turɓaya, haka kuma za mu ɗauki siffar mutumin sama.
english: As we have borne the image of those made of dust, let’s also bear the image of the heavenly.

hausa: “Kana ina lokacin da na aza harsashen duniya? Gaya mini, in ka sani.
english: “Where were you when I laid the foundations of the earth? Declare, if you have understanding.

hausa: “Sai na yi tambaya na ce, ‘Wane ne kai, ya Ubangiji?’ “Ubangiji ya ce, ‘Ni ne Yesu wanda kake tsananta wa.
english: “I said, ‘Who are you, Lord?’ “He said, ‘I am Jesus, whom you are persecuting.

hausa: Saboda haka, ina so in faɗakar da kai, ka lura baiwan nan ta Allah, wadda take tare da kai ta wurin ɗibiya maka hannuwana.
english: For this cause, I remind you that you should stir up the gift of God which is in you through the laying on of my hands.

hausa: Ayyukan mutuntaka kuwa a fili suke. Wato, fasikanci, ƙazanta da kuma lalata;
english: Now the deeds of the flesh are obvious, which are: adultery, sexual immorality, uncleanness, lustfulness,

hausa: Akwai wani allahn da ya taɓa yin ƙoƙari yă ɗauko wa kansa wata al’umma daga wata al’umma, ta wurin gwaje-gwaje, ta wurin alamu masu banmamaki da al’ajabai, ta wurin yaƙi, ta wurin hannu mai iko, da kuma hannu mai ƙarfi, ko kuwa ta wurin ayyuka masu bangirma da na banmamaki, kamar dukan abubuwan da Ubangiji Allahnku ya yi saboda ku a Masar, a kan idanunku?
english: Or has God tried to go and take a nation for himself from among another nation, by trials, by signs, by wonders, by war, by a mighty hand, by an outstretched arm, and by great terrors, according to all that Yahweh your God did for you in Egypt before your eyes?

hausa: Zan ba da Masarawa ga ikon azzalumi shugaba, mugun sarki kuma zai yi mulki a kansu,” in ji mai girma, Ubangiji Maɗaukaki.
english: I will give over the Egyptians into the hand of a cruel lord. A fierce king will rule over them,” says the Lord, Yahweh of Armies.

hausa: “Sa’ad da sammai suka rufu ba kuwa ruwan sama saboda mutanenka sun yi maka zunubi, sa’ad da kuwa suka yi addu’a suna duban waje wannan wuri suka kuma furta sunanka suka juye daga zunubinsu domin ka azabta su,
english: “When the sky is shut up and there is no rain because they have sinned against you, if they pray toward this place and confess your name, and turn from their sin when you afflict them,

hausa: Yesu ya amsa musu ya ce, “Ba a rubuce yake a cikin Dokarku ba cewa, ‘Na ce ku alloli ne’?
english: Jesus answered them, “Isn’t it written in your law, ‘I said, you are gods’?

hausa: Musa yana da shekara tamanin da haihuwa, Haruna kuma yana da shekara tamanin da uku, sa’ad da suka yi magana da Fir’auna.
english: Moses was eighty years old, and Aaron eighty-three years old, when they spoke to Pharaoh.

hausa: duk da haka a gare mu dai akwai Allah ɗaya kaɗai, Uba, wanda dukan abubuwa suke daga gare shi, wanda kuma saboda shi ne muke rayuwa, kuma akwai Ubangiji ɗaya, Yesu Kiristi, wanda ta wurinsa ne aka yi dukan abu, ta wurinsa ne kuma muke rayuwa.
english: yet to us there is one God, the Father, of whom are all things, and we for him; and one Lord, Jesus Christ, through whom are all things, and we live through him.

hausa: Yanzu ina niyya in yi alkawari da Ubangiji, Allah na Isra’ila, domin fushinsa yă kauce daga gare mu.
english: Now it is in my heart to make a covenant with Yahweh, the God of Israel, that his fierce anger may turn away from us.

hausa: Sa’ad da Ubangiji Allahnku ya fadada iyakarku kamar yadda ya yi muku alkawari, kuka kuma ji marmarin nama, kuka kuma ce, “Muna so mu ci nama,” to, za ku iya cin yadda kuke so.
english: When Yahweh your God enlarges your border, as he has promised you, and you say, “I want to eat meat,” because your soul desires to eat meat, you may eat meat, after all the desire of your soul.

hausa: Saboda haka dare yana zuwa a bisanku, ba tare da wahayi ba, kuma duhu, ba tare da duba ba. Rana za tă fāɗi wa annabawa, yini kuma zai zama musu duhu.
english: “Therefore night is over you, with no vision, and it is dark to you, that you may not divine; and the sun will go down on the prophets, and the day will be black over them.

hausa: Da sarkin Mowab ya ga yaƙi ya rinjaye shi, sai ya ɗauki mutane masu takobi ɗari bakwai, ya ratsa zuwa wajen sarkin Edom, amma ba su yi nasara ba.
english: When the king of Moab saw that the battle was too severe for him, he took with him seven hundred men who drew a sword, to break through to the king of Edom; but they could not.

hausa: Shamma, mutumin Harod, Elika, mutumin Harod,
english: Shammah the Harodite, Elika the Harodite,

hausa: Muryar Ubangiji tana a bisa ruwaye; Allah Maɗaukaki ya yi tsawa, Ubangiji ya yi tsawa a bisa manyan ruwaye.
english: Yahweh’s voice is on the waters. The God of glory thunders, even Yahweh on many waters.

hausa: Suka ce wa Musa, “Don babu makabarta a Masar ne, ka kawo mu a hamada mu mutu? Me ka yi mana ke nan da ka fitar da mu daga Masar?
english: They said to Moses, “Because there were no graves in Egypt, have you taken us away to die in the wilderness? Why have you treated us this way, to bring us out of Egypt?

hausa: “Me zai sa in gafarta muku? ’Ya’yanku sun yashe ni sun yi rantsuwa da allolin da ba alloli ba ne. Na biya musu dukan bukatunsu, duk da haka suka yi zina suka tattaru a gidajen karuwai.
english: “How can I pardon you? Your children have forsaken me, and sworn by what are no gods. When I had fed them to the full, they committed adultery, and assembled themselves in troops at the prostitutes’ houses.

hausa: in kuwa har ya ceci Lot, mai adalci, wanda ya damu ainun da ƙazamar rayuwar mutane marasa bin doka;
english: and delivered righteous Lot, who was very distressed by the lustful life of the wicked

hausa: In hannunka ko ƙafarka yana sa ka zunubi, yanke shi ka yar. Zai fiye maka ka shiga rai da hannu ko ƙafa ɗaya da hannuwa biyu ko ƙafafu biyu da a jefar da kai cikin madawwamiyar wuta da hannuwa biyu ko ƙafafu biyu.
english: If your hand or your foot causes you to stumble, cut it off and cast it from you. It is better for you to enter into life maimed or crippled, rather than having two hands or two feet to be cast into the eternal fire.

hausa: Gama kai mai girma ne kana kuma aikata ayyuka masu banmamaki; kai kaɗai ne Allah.
english: For you are great, and do wondrous things. You are God alone.

hausa: Shi ya sa Littafin Yaƙoƙin Ubangiji ya ce, “Waheb ta cikin yankin Sufa, da kwaruruka na tuddan Arnon,
english: Therefore it is said in The Book of the Wars of Yahweh, “Vaheb in Suphah, the valleys of the Arnon,

hausa: Bayan Ubangiji Yesu ya yi musu magana, sai aka ɗauke shi zuwa sama, ya kuma zauna a hannun dama na Allah.
english: So then the Lord, after he had spoken to them, was received up into heaven and sat down at the right hand of God.

hausa: Sai Yesu ya ce, “Zo, ku bi ni, ni kuwa zan mai da ku masu jan mutane zuwa wurina.”
english: He said to them, “Come after me, and I will make you fishers for men.”

hausa: Kowane faranti na azurfa yana da nauyin shekel ɗari da talatin, kuma kowane daro na azurfa don yayyafawa yana da nauyin shekel saba’in. Duka-duka dai, nauyin kwanonin azurfa, shekel dubu biyu ne da ɗari huɗu, bisa ga ma’aunin shekel na tsattsarkan wuri.
english: each silver platter weighing one hundred thirty shekels, and each bowl seventy; all the silver of the vessels two thousand four hundred shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary;

hausa: Sa’an nan ya huta tare da kakanninsa, aka kuma binne shi a birnin Dawuda mahaifinsa. Sai Rehobowam ɗansa ya gāje shi a matsayin sarki.
english: Solomon slept with his fathers, and was buried in his father David’s city; and Rehoboam his son reigned in his place.

hausa: Sa’ad da hannuwan Musa suka gaji, sai Haruna da Hur suka ɗauki dutse suka sa ya zauna a kai. Sa’an nan su kuma suka tsaya gefe da gefe, suna riƙe da hannuwansa har fāɗuwar rana.
english: But Moses’ hands were heavy; so they took a stone, and put it under him, and he sat on it. Aaron and Hur held up his hands, the one on the one side, and the other on the other side. His hands were steady until sunset.

hausa: Sa’ad da Eber ya yi shekaru 34, sai ya haifi Feleg.
english: Eber lived thirty-four years, and became the father of Peleg.

hausa: Ita itacen rai ne ga waɗanda suka rungume ta; waɗanda suke riƙe da ta za su zama masu albarka.
english: She is a tree of life to those who lay hold of her. Happy is everyone who retains her.

hausa: Amma labari daga gabas da arewa za su firgita shi, shi kuwa zai ci gaba da yin yaƙi da zafi, yă karkashe mutane da yawa, yă shafe su.
english: But news out of the east and out of the north will trouble him; and he will go out with great fury to destroy and utterly to sweep away many.

hausa: Ubangiji ya yi fushi da ni saboda ku, ya kuma yi rantsuwa cewa ba zan haye Urdun, in shiga ƙasan nan mai kyau da Ubangiji Allahnku yake ba ku gādo ba.
english: Furthermore Yahweh was angry with me for your sakes, and swore that I should not go over the Jordan, and that I should not go in to that good land which Yahweh your God gives you for an inheritance;

hausa: Da ya juya ya gan ni sai ya kira ni, na kuwa ce masa, ‘Ga ni?’
english: When he looked behind him, he saw me and called to me. I answered, ‘Here I am.’

hausa: gama ya gina ta a kan tekuna ya kafa ta a kan ruwaye.
english: For he has founded it on the seas, and established it on the floods.

hausa: Ina ƙaunar Ubangiji, gama ya ji muryata; ya ji kukata ta neman jinƙai.
english: I love Yahweh, because he listens to my voice, and my cries for mercy.

hausa: ya karɓa ya ci a gabansu.
english: He took them, and ate in front of them.

hausa: Sa’an nan na ga a hannun damar wannan wanda yake zaune a kursiyin naɗaɗɗen littafi da rubutu a ciki da wajensa an kuma hatimce shi da hatimai bakwai.
english: I saw, in the right hand of him who sat on the throne, a book written inside and outside, sealed shut with seven seals.

hausa: Sai ya bar su, ya koma cikin jirgin ruwan, suka ƙetare zuwa ɗaya hayin.
english: He left them, and again entering into the boat, departed to the other side.

hausa: Yanzu duk sun mutu, ba za su ƙara rayuwa ba; waɗannan ruhohin da suka rasu ba za su tashi ba. Ka hukunta su ka kuma kawo su ga hallaka; ka sa ba za a ƙara tunawa da su ba.
english: The dead shall not live. The departed spirits shall not rise. Therefore you have visited and destroyed them, and caused all memory of them to perish.

hausa: Za a bizne shi a kabari, a kuma yi tsaron kabarinsa.
english: Yet he will be borne to the grave. Men will keep watch over the tomb.

hausa: Mahaifiyarku za tă sha babbar kunya; ita da ta haife ku za tă sha kunya. Za tă zama mafi ƙanƙanta na al’ummai, jeji, busasshiyar ƙasa, hamada.
english: your mother will be utterly disappointed. She who bore you will be confounded. Behold, she will be the least of the nations, a wilderness, a dry land, and a desert.

hausa: Na zo a cikin sunan Ubana, ba ku kuwa karɓe ni ba; amma a ce wani dabam ya zo a cikin sunan kansa, za ku karɓe shi.
english: I have come in my Father’s name, and you don’t receive me. If another comes in his own name, you will receive him.

hausa: Ko da yake mutanen Benyamin sun kāsa su kori Yebusiyawa, waɗanda suke zaune a Urushalima; har yă zuwa yau, Yebusiyawa suna zaune a can tare da mutanen Benyamin.
english: The children of Benjamin didn’t drive out the Jebusites who inhabited Jerusalem, but the Jebusites dwell with the children of Benjamin in Jerusalem to this day.

hausa: Yana bin ƙa’idodina yana kuma kiyaye dokokina da aminci. Wannan mutumin adali ne; tabbatacce zai rayu, in ji Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka.
english: has walked in my statutes, and has kept my ordinances, to deal truly; he is just, he shall surely live,” says the Lord Yahweh.

hausa: Za ku kori abokan gābanku, za su kuwa fāɗi a kaifin takobi a gabanku.
english: You shall chase your enemies, and they shall fall before you by the sword.

hausa: Sai ya ce, “Waɗannan su ne biyun da aka shafe don su yi wa Ubangiji dukan duniya hidima.”
english: Then he said, “These are the two anointed ones who stand by the Lord of the whole earth.”

hausa: Zan ƙara ’ya’yan itatuwa da amfanin gona, saboda kada ku ƙara shan kunya a cikin al’ummai saboda yunwa.
english: I will multiply the fruit of the tree and the increase of the field, that you may receive no more the reproach of famine among the nations.

hausa: Sai halittu huɗun nan masu rai suka ce, “Amin”, dattawan kuma suka fāɗi suka yi sujada.
english: The four living creatures said, “Amen!” Then the elders fell down and worshiped.

hausa: Dukansu biyu kuwa masu adalci ne a gaban Allah, suna kuma bin umarnan Ubangiji da farillansa duka da halin rashin zargi.
english: They were both righteous before God, walking blamelessly in all the commandments and ordinances of the Lord.

hausa: sai aka zaɓe shi ta wurin ƙuri’a, bisa ga al’adar aikin firist, yă shiga haikalin Ubangiji yă ƙone turare.
english: according to the custom of the priest’s office, his lot was to enter into the temple of the Lord and burn incense.

hausa: Gama ko Kiristi ma bai gamshi kansa ba, amma kamar yadda yake a rubuce cewa, “Zage-zagen da waɗansu suka yi maka, duk sun fāɗo a kaina.”
english: For even Christ didn’t please himself. But, as it is written, “The reproaches of those who reproached you fell on me.”

hausa: Sai Irmiya ya ce, “Ba gaskiya ba ce, ba na gudu daga Babiloniyawa.” Amma Iriya bai saurare shi ba; a maimako, ya kama Irmiya ya kawo shi wurin fadawa.
english: Then Jeremiah said, “That is false! I am not defecting to the Chaldeans.” But he didn’t listen to him; so Irijah seized Jeremiah, and brought him to the princes.

hausa: Dariyus mutumin Medes kuwa ya karɓi mulkin, yana da shekara sittin da biyu.
english: Darius the Mede received the kingdom, being about sixty-two years old.

hausa: ko da yake Yahuda shi ne mafi ƙarfi cikin ’yan’uwansa kuma mai mulki ya fito daga gare shi, ’yancin zaman ɗan fari na Yusuf ne),
english: For Judah prevailed above his brothers, and from him came the prince; but the birthright was Joseph’s)—

hausa: “Yanzu, ya Ubangiji Allahna, ka sa bawanka a wurin mahaifina Dawuda. Amma ni ɗan yaro ne kawai, ban kuma san yadda zan yi ayyukana ba.
english: Now, Yahweh my God, you have made your servant king instead of David my father. I am just a little child. I don’t know how to go out or come in.

hausa: A wannan lokaci waɗansu annabawa sun zo Antiyok daga Urushalima.
english: Now in these days, prophets came down from Jerusalem to Antioch.

hausa: Ka tuna da ranar Asabbaci domin ka kiyaye ta da tsarki.
english: “Remember the Sabbath day, to keep it holy.

hausa: Mutanen da aka jera sunayensu sun zo ne a zamanin Hezekiya sarkin Yahuda. Suka yaƙi mutanen Ham a wuraren zamansu, haka kuma suka yi da Meyunawa da suke can, suka hallaka su ƙaƙaf, yadda yake har yă zuwa yau. Sa’an nan suka zauna a wurin, gama akwai makiyaya domin garkunansu.
english: These written by name came in the days of Hezekiah king of Judah, and struck their tents and the Meunim who were found there; and they destroyed them utterly to this day, and lived in their place, because there was pasture there for their flocks.

hausa: da shanu biyu, raguna biyar, bunsurai biyar da kuma ’yan raguna biyar, dukansu bana ɗaya-ɗaya, a miƙa su hadaya ta salama. Wannan ita ce hadayar Elishama ɗan Ammihud.
english: and for the sacrifice of peace offerings, two head of cattle, five rams, five male goats, and five male lambs a year old. This was the offering of Elishama the son of Ammihud.

hausa: Mugaye kan yi rance ba sa kuma biya, amma masu adalci suna bayar hannu sake;
english: The wicked borrow, and don’t pay back, but the righteous give generously.

hausa: “ ‘A wannan rana,’ in ji Ubangiji Maɗaukaki, ‘Zan ɗauke ka, bawana Zerubbabel ɗan Sheyaltiyel,’ in ji Ubangiji, ‘in kuma maishe ka kamar zoben hatimi, gama na zaɓe ka,’ in ji Ubangiji Maɗaukaki.”
english: In that day, says Yahweh of Armies, I will take you, Zerubbabel my servant, the son of Shealtiel,’ says Yahweh, ‘and will make you like a signet ring, for I have chosen you,’ says Yahweh of Armies.”

hausa: mu’ujizai a ƙasar Ham ayyukan banrazana a Jan Teku.
english: wondrous works in the land of Ham, and awesome things by the Red Sea.

hausa: zai kuwa kasance a wuri mai tsarki; amma ga dukan gidajen Isra’ila zai zama dutsen da zai sa mutane su yi tuntuɓe dutse kuma da zai sa su fāɗi. Ga dukan mutanen Urushalima kuma zai zama tarko da raga.
english: He will be a sanctuary, but for both houses of Israel, he will be a stumbling stone and a rock that makes them fall. For the people of Jerusalem, he will be a trap and a snare.

hausa: Shi ya cece mu daga irin wannan hatsari na mutuwa, zai kuwa cece mu. A kansa muka kafa bege cewa zai ci gaba da cetonmu,
english: who delivered us out of so great a death, and does deliver, on whom we have set our hope that he will also still deliver us,

hausa: Gama ka rubuta abubuwa marasa daɗi game da ni; ka sa na yi gādon zunuban ƙuruciyata.
english: For you write bitter things against me, and make me inherit the iniquities of my youth.

hausa: Bari Ubangiji, Mahaliccin sama da ƙasa, ya albarkace ku daga Sihiyona.
english: May Yahweh bless you from Zion, even he who made heaven and earth.

hausa: Annabci. Maganar Ubangiji tana gāba da ƙasar Hadrak za tă kuma sauko a kan Damaskus, gama idanun dukan mutane da na kabilan Isra’ila suna a kan Ubangiji,
english: A revelation. Yahweh’s word is against the land of Hadrach, and will rest upon Damascus— for the eye of man and of all the tribes of Israel is toward Yahweh—

hausa: Yehozadak ne aka ɗauka sa’ad da Ubangiji ya tura Yahuda da Urushalima zuwa zaman bauta ta hannun Nebukadnezzar.
english: Jehozadak went into captivity when Yahweh carried Judah and Jerusalem away by the hand of Nebuchadnezzar.

hausa: sai dai in ka ƙi mu gaba ɗaya kana fushi da mu fiye da yadda za a iya aunawa.
english: But you have utterly rejected us. You are very angry against us.

hausa: Dukan fadawa kuwa suka zo wurin Irmiya suka tambaye shi, ya kuma faɗa musu dukan abin da sarki ya umarce shi ya faɗa. Saboda haka ba su ƙara ce masa kome ba, gama ba wanda ya ji zance da suka yi da sarki.
english: Then all the princes came to Jeremiah, and asked him; and he told them according to all these words that the king had commanded. So they stopped speaking with him, for the matter was not perceived.

hausa: Saboda haka ta kwanta a ƙafafunsa sai da safe, amma ta tashi kafin a gane wani, sai ya ce, “Kada ki bar wani yă san cewa mace ta zo masussuka.”
english: She lay at his feet until the morning, then she rose up before one could discern another. For he said, “Let it not be known that the woman came to the threshing floor.”

hausa: Ya kawar da firistocin gumakan da sarakunan Yahuda suka naɗa don su ƙona turare a masujadan kan tuddai na garuruwan Yahuda, da kuma waɗanda suke kewaye da Urushalima, masu ƙona turare wa Ba’al, rana da wata, ga rukunin taurari, da kuma ga dukan rundunan taurari.
english: He got rid of the idolatrous priests whom the kings of Judah had ordained to burn incense in the high places in the cities of Judah and in the places around Jerusalem; those also who burned incense to Baal, to the sun, to the moon, to the planets, and to all the army of the sky.

hausa: To, Ga’al ɗan Ebed ya riga ya fita waje yana tsaye a ƙofar birni daidai Abimelek da mayaƙansa suka fito daga inda suka ɓuya.
english: Gaal the son of Ebed went out, and stood in the entrance of the gate of the city. Abimelech rose up, and the people who were with him, from the ambush.

hausa: “Ka koma ka ce wa Hezekiya, shugaban mutanena, ‘Ga abin da Ubangiji Allah na mahaifinka Dawuda ya ce, na ji addu’arka na kuma ga hawayenka; zan warkar da kai. A rana ta uku daga yau za ka haura zuwa haikalin Ubangiji.
english: “Turn back, and tell Hezekiah the prince of my people, ‘Yahweh, the God of David your father, says, “I have heard your prayer. I have seen your tears. Behold, I will heal you. On the third day, you will go up to Yahweh’s house.

hausa: Ubangiji ya sa Filistiyawa da Larabawa waɗanda suke zama kusa da Kushawa su yi gāba da Yehoram
english: Yahweh stirred up against Jehoram the spirit of the Philistines and of the Arabians who are beside the Ethiopians;

hausa: Duk sa’ad da wani ya ji saƙo game da mulkin bai kuwa fahimce shi ba, mugun nan yakan zo yă ƙwace abin da aka shuka a zuciyarsa. Wannan shi ne irin da ya fāɗi a kan hanya.
english: When anyone hears the word of the Kingdom and doesn’t understand it, the evil one comes and snatches away that which has been sown in his heart. This is what was sown by the roadside.

hausa: Ya tambayi Amnon ya ce, “Don me kowace safiya fuskarka a ɓace take? Kai ba yaron sarki ba ne? Faɗa mini, me ke faruwa?” Amnon ya ce masa, “Ina son Tamar ƙanuwar wan nawa Absalom ne.”
english: He said to him, “Why, son of the king, are you so sad from day to day? Won’t you tell me?” Amnon said to him, “I love Tamar, my brother Absalom’s sister.”

hausa: Mai yin ƙiyayya yakan ɓoye kansa da maganar bakinsa, amma a cikin zuciyarsa yana cike da munafunci
english: A malicious man disguises himself with his lips, but he harbors evil in his heart.

hausa: sai da kibiya ta soki hantarsa, kamar tsuntsun da ya ruga cikin tarko, ba tare da sani zai zama sanadin ransa ba.
english: Until an arrow strikes through his liver, as a bird hurries to the snare, and doesn’t know that it will cost his life.

hausa: Ubangiji amsa wa Musa, “Ka ɗauki sandan da ka bugi ruwan Nilu da shi. Ka kira waɗansu shugabannin Isra’ila, ku wuce a gaban jama’ar.
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “Walk on before the people, and take the elders of Israel with you, and take the rod in your hand with which you struck the Nile, and go.

hausa: na shida kuma shi ne Itireyam, ɗan Egla matar Dawuda. An haifi waɗannan wa Dawuda a Hebron.
english: and the sixth, Ithream, of Eglah, David’s wife. These were born to David in Hebron.

hausa: Sai Liyatu ta ce, “Na yi sa’a!” Saboda haka ta ba shi suna Gad.
english: Leah said, “How fortunate!” She named him Gad.

hausa: Filistiyawa suka zauna a tudu guda, Isra’ilawa kuma suka zauna a ɗaya tudun. Kwari yana a tsakaninsu.
english: The Philistines stood on the mountain on the one side, and Israel stood on the mountain on the other side: and there was a valley between them.

hausa: Sa’ad da nake yaro a gidan mahaifina, yaro kaɗai kuma na mahaifiyata,
english: For I was a son to my father, tender and an only child in the sight of my mother.

hausa: gama mugu ba shi da zuciya ta nan gaba, kuma fitilar mugaye za tă mutu.
english: for there will be no reward to the evil man. The lamp of the wicked will be snuffed out.

hausa: Yanzu sai ka aiki mutane zuwa Yoffa su dawo da wani mutum mai suna Siman wanda ake kira Bitrus.
english: Now send men to Joppa, and get Simon, who is also called Peter.

hausa: Ya tambaye su ya ce, “Kun bar dukan mata da rai?
english: Moses said to them, “Have you saved all the women alive?

hausa: Babu bambanci tsakanin mutumin Yahuda da mutumin Al’ummai, bawa da ’yantacce, namiji da ta mace, gama dukanku ɗaya ne cikin Kiristi Yesu.
english: There is neither Jew nor Greek, there is neither slave nor free man, there is neither male nor female; for you are all one in Christ Jesus.

hausa: Sai Isra’ilawa duka, da baƙi, da haifaffun gida, da dattawansu, da shugabanninsu, da alƙalansu, suka tsaya a gefe-gefen akwatin alkawarin Ubangiji, suna fuskantar waɗanda suke ɗauke da shi, wato, firistoci waɗanda su ne Lawiyawa. Rabin mutanen suka tsaya a gaban Dutsen Gerizim, rabinsu kuma suka tsaya a gaban Dutsen Ebal, kamar yadda Musa bawan Ubangiji ya riga ya umarta, cewa su sa wa mutanen Isra’ilawa albarka.
english: All Israel, with their elders, officers, and judges, stood on both sides of the ark before the Levitical priests, who carried the ark of Yahweh’s covenant, the foreigner as well as the native; half of them in front of Mount Gerizim, and half of them in front of Mount Ebal, as Moses the servant of Yahweh had commanded at the first, that they should bless the people of Israel.

hausa: Duk wanda ya yi wa mahaifinsa fashi ya kuma kori mahaifiyarsa ɗa ne da kan kawo kunya da wulaƙanci.
english: He who robs his father and drives away his mother is a son who causes shame and brings reproach.

hausa: In ya zo shi kaɗai, zai tafi ’yantacce shi kaɗai; amma in yana da mata a lokacin da ya zo, za tă tafi tare da shi.
english: If he comes in by himself, he shall go out by himself. If he is married, then his wife shall go out with him.

hausa: Ku waɗanda kuka tsere wa takobi, ku gudu kada ku tsaya! Ku tuna da Ubangiji a ƙasa mai nesa, ku kuma yi ta tunani a kan Urushalima.”
english: You who have escaped the sword, go! Don’t stand still! Remember Yahweh from afar, and let Jerusalem come into your mind.”

hausa: da kai ne na ragargaza miji da mata, da kai ne na ragargaza tsoho da saurayi, da kai ne na ragargaza saurayi da budurwa,
english: With you I will break in pieces the chariot and him who rides therein. With you I will break in pieces man and woman. With you I will break in pieces the old man and the youth. With you I will break in pieces the young man and the virgin.

hausa: Duk da haka suka yi tawaye suka ɓata wa Ruhu Mai Tsarki rai. Saboda haka ya juya ya kuma zama abokin gābansu shi kansa kuma ya yaƙe su.
english: But they rebelled and grieved his Holy Spirit. Therefore he turned and became their enemy, and he himself fought against them.

hausa: ya farfashe bagadai da ginshiƙan Ashera; ya niƙa gumaka suka zama gari, ya kuma yayyanka dukan bagadan turare kucu-kucu ko’ina a Isra’ila. Sa’an nan ya koma Urushalima.
english: He broke down the altars, beat the Asherah poles and the engraved images into powder, and cut down all the incense altars throughout all the land of Israel, then returned to Jerusalem.

hausa: Mowab za tă hallaka a kuma kai wa garuruwanta hari; samarinta kyawawa za su gangara cikin mayanka,” in ji Sarki, wanda sunansa Ubangiji Maɗaukaki ne.
english: Moab is laid waste, and they have gone up into his cities, and his chosen young men have gone down to the slaughter,” says the King, whose name is Yahweh of Armies.

hausa: Saboda haka zan fitar da ku daga wannan ƙasa zuwa wata ƙasar da ku da kakanninku ba ku taɓa sani ba, a can kuwa za ku bauta wa waɗansu alloli dare da rana, gama ba zan nuna muku tagomashi ba.’
english: Therefore I will cast you out of this land into the land that you have not known, neither you nor your fathers. There you will serve other gods day and night, for I will show you no favor.’

hausa: Sa’ad da suka aike mutane don su leƙi asirin Betel (da dā ake kira Luz),
english: The house of Joseph sent to spy out Bethel. (The name of the city before that was Luz.)

hausa: Ta haka aka cika abin da aka faɗa ta wurin annabi cewa, “Zan buɗe bakina da misalai, zan faɗi abubuwan da suke ɓoye tun halittar duniya.”
english: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through the prophet, saying, “I will open my mouth in parables; I will utter things hidden from the foundation of the world.”

hausa: Daga wannan rana zuwa gaba gidan Isra’ila zai san cewa ni ne Ubangiji Allahnsu.
english: So the house of Israel will know that I am Yahweh their God, from that day and forward.

hausa: yadda kuma ko ta yaya, in kai ga tashin nan daga matattu.
english: if by any means I may attain to the resurrection from the dead.

hausa: Waɗannan su ne manyan shugabanninsa. Azariya ɗan Zadok shi ne firist;
english: These were the princes whom he had: Azariah the son of Zadok, the priest;

hausa: Sau na bakwai, bawan ya ce, “Wani girgije ƙarami kamar hannun mutum yana tasowa daga teku.” Sai Iliya ya ce, “Je ka faɗa wa Ahab, ‘Shirya keken yaƙinka, ka gangara kafin ruwan sama yă tare ka.’ ”
english: On the seventh time, he said, “Behold, a small cloud, like a man’s hand, is rising out of the sea.” He said, “Go up, tell Ahab, ‘Get ready and go down, so that the rain doesn’t stop you.’”

hausa: Sarki da hakimansa suka gamsu da wannan shawara. Saboda haka sarki ya yi kamar yadda Memukan ya faɗa.
english: This advice pleased the king and the princes, and the king did according to the word of Memucan:

hausa: amma tabbatacce Allah ya saurara ya kuma ji muryata a cikin addu’a.
english: But most certainly, God has listened. He has heard the voice of my prayer.

hausa: ka kuma ce musu, ‘Ga abin da Ubangiji Maɗaukaki yana cewa zan farfasa wannan al’umma da wannan birni kamar yadda aka farfasa wannan tulu mai ginin tukwane ba kuwa zai gyaru ba. Za a binne matattu a Tofet har sai ba sauran wuri.
english: and shall tell them, ‘Yahweh of Armies says: “Even so I will break this people and this city as one breaks a potter’s vessel, that can’t be made whole again. They will bury in Topheth until there is no place to bury.

hausa: sa’ad da bala’i ya sha kanku kamar hadiri, sa’ad da masifa ta share ku kamar guguwa, sa’ad damuwa da wahala suka mamaye ku.
english: when calamity overtakes you like a storm, when your disaster comes on like a whirlwind, when distress and anguish come on you.

hausa: Masunta za su tsaya a gaɓar; daga En Gedi zuwa En Eglayim, za a kasance da wuraren jefa abin kamun kifi. Za a sami kifayen iri-iri, kamar kifaye Bahar Rum.
english: It will happen that fishermen will stand by it. From En Gedi even to En Eglaim will be a place for the spreading of nets. Their fish will be after their kinds, as the fish of the great sea, exceedingly many.

hausa: Maganar Ubangiji ta zo mini cewa,
english: Moreover Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

hausa: A rana ta ashirin da huɗu ga watan farko, a sa’ad da nake tsaye a bakin babban kogi, Tigris,
english: In the twenty-fourth day of the first month, as I was by the side of the great river, which is Hiddekel,

hausa: Kuka yi mūsun sanin Mai Tsarki da Mai Adalci kuka roƙa a sakar muku mai kisankai.
english: But you denied the Holy and Righteous One and asked for a murderer to be granted to you,

hausa: Ba zan ƙara yi muku magana ba, gama mai mulkin duniyan nan yana zuwa. Ba shi da iko a kaina,
english: I will no more speak much with you, for the prince of the world comes, and he has nothing in me.

hausa: Ku tafi ku yi wa allolin da kuka zaɓa. Bari su cece ku sa’ad da kuke cikin wahala!”
english: Go and cry to the gods which you have chosen. Let them save you in the time of your distress!”

hausa: Zai kuma ɗebe kitsenta duka kamar yadda a kan ɗebe na ragon hadaya ta salama. Firist zai ƙone shi a bisa bagaden a bisa hadaya ta ƙonawa ga Ubangiji. Ta haka firist ɗin zai yi kafara dominsa saboda zunubin da ya yi, za a kuwa gafarta masa.
english: He shall remove all its fat, like the fat of the lamb is removed from the sacrifice of peace offerings. The priest shall burn them on the altar, on the offerings of Yahweh made by fire. The priest shall make atonement for him concerning his sin that he has sinned, and he will be forgiven.

hausa: Da suka gama, suka kawo sauran kuɗin wa sarki da Yehohiyada, da su ne kuwa aka yi kayayyaki domin hidima da kuma domin hadayun ƙonawa, haka kuma kwanoni da sauran kayayyakin zinariya da azurfa. Muddin Yehohiyada yana raye, aka riƙa kawo hadayun ƙonawa a haikalin Ubangiji.
english: When they had finished, they brought the rest of the money before the king and Jehoiada, from which were made vessels for Yahweh’s house, even vessels with which to minister and to offer, including spoons and vessels of gold and silver. They offered burnt offerings in Yahweh’s house continually all the days of Jehoiada.

hausa: “Duk da haka in ka miƙa masa zuciyarka, ka kuma miƙa hannuwanka gare shi,
english: “If you set your heart aright, stretch out your hands toward him.

hausa: Albarka kan zauna a kan mai adalci kamar rawani, amma rikici kan sha bakin mugu.
english: Blessings are on the head of the righteous, but violence covers the mouth of the wicked.

hausa: “ ‘Mutanen Arabiya da dukan sarakunan Kedar abokan cinikinki ne; sun yi ciniki da ke suka sayi kayanki da ’yan raguna, da raguna, da awaki.
english: “‘“Arabia and all the princes of Kedar were your favorite dealers in lambs, rams, and goats. In these, they were your merchants.

hausa: Sa’ad da suka karɓa, sai suka fara yin gunaguni a kan mai gonar.
english: When they received it, they murmured against the master of the household,

hausa: Don a ganina wauta ce a aika da ɗan kurkuku ba tare da an nuna zargin da ake yi a kansa ba.”
english: For it seems to me unreasonable, in sending a prisoner, not to also specify the charges against him.”

hausa: “Wannan ya sa gabana ya fāɗi, zuciyata ta yi tsalle.
english: “Yes, at this my heart trembles, and is moved out of its place.

hausa: Ka ɗauki wannan sashe daga rabin rabonsu ka ba wa Eleyazar firist, a matsayin sashe na Ubangiji.
english: Take it from their half, and give it to Eleazar the priest, for Yahweh’s wave offering.

hausa: Amma gumakansu azurfa da zinariya ne, da hannuwan mutane suka yi.
english: Their idols are silver and gold, the work of men’s hands.

hausa: Ubangiji ya ce wa Musa,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

hausa: “Kun dai ji an faɗa wa mutanen dā cewa, ‘Kada ka yi kisankai;kuma duk wanda ya yi kisankai za a hukunta shi.’
english: “You have heard that it was said to the ancient ones, ‘You shall not murder;’ and ‘Whoever murders will be in danger of the judgment.’

hausa: Bayan shekara uku, sai na haura zuwa Urushalima domin in sadu da Bitrus, na kuwa zauna tare da shi kwana goma sha biyar.
english: Then after three years I went up to Jerusalem to visit Peter, and stayed with him fifteen days.

hausa: “Ya amsa ya ce, ‘Ina gaya muku, duk wanda yake da abu, za a ƙara masa. Amma wanda ba shi da shi kuwa, ko abin da yake da shi ma, za a karɓe.
english: ‘For I tell you that to everyone who has, will more be given; but from him who doesn’t have, even that which he has will be taken away from him.

hausa: To, game da abincin da aka miƙa hadaya ga gumaka kuwa. Mun san cewa dukanmu muna da ilimi. Ilimi yakan kawo girman kai, amma ƙauna takan gina.
english: Now concerning things sacrificed to idols: We know that we all have knowledge. Knowledge puffs up, but love builds up.

hausa: Ubangiji ya kasance tare da Yoshuwa, aka kuma san da shi a duk fāɗin ƙasar.
english: So Yahweh was with Joshua; and his fame was in all the land.

hausa: “A gare ni wannan ya yi kamar kwanakin Nuhu, sa’ad da na rantse cewa ruwan Nuhu ba za su ƙara rufe duniya ba. Yanzu fa na rantse ba zan yi fushi da ke ba, ba zan ƙara tsawata miki kuma ba.
english: “For this is like the waters of Noah to me; for as I have sworn that the waters of Noah will no more go over the earth, so I have sworn that I will not be angry with you, nor rebuke you.

hausa: daga zuriyar Adin, Ebed ɗan Yonatan ne shugaba, tare da shi akwai mutum 50;
english: Of the sons of Adin, Ebed the son of Jonathan; and with him fifty males.

hausa: Mutumin bai ce uffam ba, ya dai kalle ta sosai don yă san ko Ubangiji ya ba shi nasara a tafiyarsa ko babu.
english: The man looked steadfastly at her, remaining silent, to know whether Yahweh had made his journey prosperous or not.

hausa: Sa’an nan waɗansu Lawiyawa daga Kohatawa da Korayawa suka tashi tsaye suka yabe Ubangiji, Allah na Isra’ila, da babbar murya sosai.
english: The Levites, of the children of the Kohathites and of the children of the Korahites, stood up to praise Yahweh, the God of Israel, with an exceedingly loud voice.

hausa: Zimri ya shiga, ya buge shi ya kashe a shekara ta ashirin da bakwai na Asa sarkin Yahuda. Sa’an nan ya gāje shi a matsayin sarki.
english: and Zimri went in and struck him and killed him in the twenty-seventh year of Asa king of Judah, and reigned in his place.

hausa: Ka tabbata ka yi amfani da kuɗin nan don ka sayi bijimai, da raguna, da ’yan raguna, da hadayu na gari, da na sha, ka kuma miƙa su a kan bagade na haikalin Allahnka a Urushalima.
english: Therefore you shall with all diligence buy with this money bulls, rams, and lambs with their meal offerings and their drink offerings, and shall offer them on the altar of the house of your God which is in Jerusalem.

hausa: Kada ka bar zuciyata ta juya ga yin abin da yake mugu, ta sa kai ga aikata mugayen ayyuka tare da mutane masu aikata mugunta; kada ka bari in ci abincinsu.
english: Don’t incline my heart to any evil thing, to practice deeds of wickedness with men who work iniquity. Don’t let me eat of their delicacies.

hausa: Sa’ad da Iliya ya ji ta, ya ja mayafinsa ya rufe fuskarsa, ya fita ya tsaya a bakin kogon. Sai ya ji murya ta ce masa, “Me kake yi a nan, Iliya?”
english: When Elijah heard it, he wrapped his face in his mantle, went out, and stood in the entrance of the cave. Behold, a voice came to him, and said, “What are you doing here, Elijah?”

hausa: “Ɗan mutum, ka yi makoki domin sarkin Taya ka kuma ce masa, ‘Ga abin da Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka yana cewa, “ ‘Ka kasance hatimin cikakke, cike da hikima da cikakke a kyau.
english: “Son of man, take up a lamentation over the king of Tyre, and tell him, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “You were the seal of full measure, full of wisdom, and perfect in beauty.

hausa: Da yin haka kuwa sai mutanen da suka yi kwanto suka tashi nan da nan daga inda suke, suka nufi birnin a guje, suka shiga suka ci birnin da yaƙi, suka kuma cinna mata wuta da sauri.
english: The ambush arose quickly out of their place, and they ran as soon as he had stretched out his hand and entered into the city and took it. They hurried and set the city on fire.

hausa: Mutanen Isra’ila da na Yahuda suka rugo gaba da babbar murya, suka fafari Filistiyawa har zuwa mashigin Gat da kuma ƙofofin Ekron. Gawawwakin Filistiyawa suka bazu a hanyar Sha’arayim zuwa Gat da kuma Ekron.
english: The men of Israel and of Judah arose and shouted, and pursued the Philistines as far as Gai and to the gates of Ekron. The wounded of the Philistines fell down by the way to Shaaraim, even to Gath and to Ekron.

hausa: Sa’ad da muka ƙetare tekun da yake sassan gaɓar Silisiya da Famfiliya sai muka sauka a Mira ta Lisiya.
english: When we had sailed across the sea which is off Cilicia and Pamphylia, we came to Myra, a city of Lycia.

hausa: I, Uba, gama wannan shi ne abin da ka ji daɗin yi.
english: Yes, Father, for so it was well-pleasing in your sight.

hausa: Masu furfura da tsofaffi suna gefenmu mutanen da sun girme babanka.
english: With us are both the gray-headed and the very aged men, much older than your father.

hausa: Duka-duka garuruwan firistoci, zuriyar Haruna, su goma sha uku ne tare da wuraren kiwonsu.
english: All the cities of the children of Aaron, the priests, were thirteen cities with their pasture lands.

hausa: Haihuwa ba tă amfane wanda aka haifa gawa ba, gama ya zo daga duhu ya koma duhu inda aka manta da shi.
english: for it comes in vanity, and departs in darkness, and its name is covered with darkness.

hausa: Kamar dai yadda Ruhu Mai Tsarki ya ce, “Yau, in kuka ji muryarsa,
english: Therefore, even as the Holy Spirit says, “Today if you will hear his voice,

hausa: “Ka yi tabanakul da katakon itacen ƙiryar da aka kakkafa a tsaye.
english: “You shall make the boards for the tabernacle of acacia wood, standing upright.

hausa: Da ƙyar wani yă mutu saboda mai adalci, ko da yake saboda mutumin kirki wani zai iya ƙarfin hali yă mutu.
english: For one will hardly die for a righteous man. Yet perhaps for a good person someone would even dare to die.

hausa: ya kuma mai da mu masarauta da firistoci don mu yi wa Allahnsa da Ubansa hidima, a gare shi ɗaukaka da iko sun tabbata har abada abadin! Amin.
english: and he made us to be a Kingdom, priests to his God and Father—to him be the glory and the dominion forever and ever. Amen.

hausa: Sai na ce musu, “Maganar Ubangiji ta zo mini cewa
english: Then I said to them, “Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

hausa: gama ya rena maganar Ubangiji, ya kuma karya umarninsa. Tabbatacce za a kashe wannan mutum, alhakinsa laifinsa kuwa yana wuyansa.’ ”
english: Because he has despised Yahweh’s word, and has broken his commandment, that soul shall be utterly cut off. His iniquity shall be on him.’”

hausa: Gama, “Dukan mutane kamar ciyawa suke, darajarsu kuma kamar furannin jeji ne; ciyawa takan yanƙwane furannin kuma su kakkaɓe,
english: For, “All flesh is like grass, and all of man’s glory like the flower in the grass. The grass withers, and its flower falls;

hausa: Mun zama marayu marasa ubanni, uwayenmu kamar gwauraye.
english: We are orphans and fatherless. Our mothers are as widows.

hausa: Hezro mutumin Karmel, Na’arai ɗan Ezbai,
english: Hezro the Carmelite, Naarai the son of Ezbai,

hausa: “ ‘Duk wanda mai ɗiga ya taɓa ba tare da ya wanke hannuwansa da ruwa ba, dole yă wanke rigunansa yă kuma yi wanka, zai kuma ƙazantu har yamma.
english: “‘Whomever he who has the discharge touches, without having rinsed his hands in water, he shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening.

hausa: Gama ga abin da Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka yana cewa, “Da farko mutanena suka gangara zuwa Masar don su zauna; a baya-bayan nan, Assuriya sun zalunce su.
english: For the Lord Yahweh says: “My people went down at the first into Egypt to live there; and the Assyrian has oppressed them without cause.

hausa: Gara waɗanda aka kashe su da takobi da waɗanda suke mutuwa da yunwa; sun rame domin rashin abinci a gona.
english: Those who are killed with the sword are better than those who are killed with hunger; for these pine away, stricken through, for lack of the fruits of the field.

hausa: A ƙarshe, kada kowa yă ƙara damuna, gama ina ɗauke da raunuka masu nuna ni bawan Ubangiji Yesu ne.
english: From now on, let no one cause me any trouble, for I bear the marks of the Lord Jesus branded on my body.

hausa: Abubuwan da ka ji na faɗa a gaban shaidu masu yawa kuwa ka danƙa wa amintattun mutane waɗanda su ma za su iya koya wa waɗansu.
english: The things which you have heard from me among many witnesses, commit the same things to faithful men who will be able to teach others also.

hausa: Sa’an nan ya tuna da mafarkansa game da su, ya kuma ce musu, “Ku ’yan leƙen asiri ne! Kun zo don ku leƙi asirin ƙasar ku ga inda ba ta da tsaro.”
english: Joseph remembered the dreams which he dreamed about them, and said to them, “You are spies! You have come to see the nakedness of the land.”

hausa: Sa’ad da wasiƙar ta iso, sai mutanen nan suka ɗauki dukan ’ya’yan sarkin nan saba’in, suka kashe su, suka sa kawunansu cikin kwanduna, suka aika wa Yehu a Yezireyel.
english: When the letter came to them, they took the king’s sons and killed them, even seventy people, and put their heads in baskets, and sent them to him to Jezreel.

hausa: “Saboda haka sai ku zauna a faɗake, don ba ku san ranar ko sa’ar ba.
english: Watch therefore, for you don’t know the day nor the hour in which the Son of Man is coming.

hausa: Ubangiji ya ce, “Matan Sihiyona suna da girman kai, suna tafiya da wuya a miƙe, da idanu masu yaudara, suna takawa ɗaya-ɗaya a hankali, da mundaye a ƙafafunsu, suna cas-cas.
english: Moreover Yahweh said, “Because the daughters of Zion are arrogant, and walk with outstretched necks and flirting eyes, walking daintily as they go, jingling ornaments on their feet;

hausa: Aka ba wa waɗansu na mutanen gidan Kohat yankin garuruwansu daga kabilar Efraim.
english: Some of the families of the sons of Kohath had cities of their borders out of the tribe of Ephraim.

hausa: Bowaz wanda kike aiki da bayinsa ’yan mata ba danginmu ne na kusa ba? Da daren yau zai sussuka sha’ir nasa a masussuka.
english: Now isn’t Boaz our kinsman, with whose maidens you were? Behold, he will be winnowing barley tonight on the threshing floor.

hausa: gama jiya kaɗai aka haife mu ba mu san kome ba, kuma kwanakinmu a duniya masu wucewa ne.
english: (For we are but of yesterday, and know nothing, because our days on earth are a shadow.)

hausa: “Tuna da waɗannan abubuwa, ya Yaƙub, gama kai bawana ne, ya Isra’ila. Na yi ka, kai bawana ne; Ya Isra’ila, ba zan manta da kai ba.
english: Remember these things, Jacob and Israel, for you are my servant. I have formed you. You are my servant. Israel, you will not be forgotten by me.

hausa: Ubangiji ya naɗe kansa da haske kamar riga ya shimfiɗa sammai kamar tenti
english: He covers himself with light as with a garment. He stretches out the heavens like a curtain.

hausa: In gidan na kirki ne, bari salamarku ta zauna a kansa; in kuwa ba mai kirki ba, salamarku ta komo muku.
english: If the household is worthy, let your peace come on it, but if it isn’t worthy, let your peace return to you.

hausa: Ta ce, “Mahaifina, idan ka riga ka yi wa Ubangiji magana, sai ka yi da ni yadda ka yi alkawari, da yake Ubangiji ya ɗau maka fansa a kan Ammonawa.”
english: She said to him, “My father, you have opened your mouth to Yahweh; do to me according to that which has proceeded out of your mouth, because Yahweh has taken vengeance for you on your enemies, even on the children of Ammon.”

hausa: Azmawet ɗan Adiyel shi ne mai lura da ɗakuna ajiyar fada. Yonatan ɗan Uzziya shi ne mai lura da ɗakunan ajiya a yankuna, cikin garuruwa, ƙauyuka da kuma hasumiyoyin tsaro.
english: Over the king’s treasures was Azmaveth the son of Adiel. Over the treasures in the fields, in the cities, in the villages, and in the towers was Jonathan the son of Uzziah;

hausa: Matar kuwa tana da maraƙin da take kiwo a gida, sai ta ɗauke shi nan da nan ta yanka. Ta ɗauki garin fulawa ta kwaɓa, ta yi waina marar yisti.
english: The woman had a fattened calf in the house. She hurried and killed it; and she took flour and kneaded it, and baked unleavened bread of it.

hausa: Shefatiya, Hattil, Fokeret-Hazzebayim, da Amon.
english: the children of Shephatiah, the children of Hattil, the children of Pochereth Hazzebaim, and the children of Amon.

hausa: Ku ’ya’yan Ubangiji Allahnku ne. Kada ku yi wa kanku zāne, ko ku yi wa kanku aski irin da akan bar sanƙo, saboda wanda ya mutu,
english: You are the children of Yahweh your God. You shall not cut yourselves, nor make any baldness between your eyes for the dead.

hausa: Amma kai ne garkuwa kewaye da ni, ya Ubangiji; ka ba ni ɗaukaka ka kuma ɗaga kaina.
english: But you, Yahweh, are a shield around me, my glory, and the one who lifts up my head.

hausa: Daga zuriyar Hashum, akwai Mattenai, da Mattatta, Zabad, Elifelet, Irmai, Manasse, da Shimeyi.
english: Of the sons of Hashum: Mattenai, Mattattah, Zabad, Eliphelet, Jeremai, Manasseh, and Shimei.

hausa: Ka ƙaunaci Ubangiji Allahnka da dukan zuciyarka, da dukan ranka, da dukan hankalinka, da kuma dukan ƙarfinka.’
english: You shall love the Lord your God with all your heart, with all your soul, with all your mind, and with all your strength.’ This is the first commandment.

hausa: Zan aika da wuta a katangar Gaza ta ƙone duk kagarunta.
english: but I will send a fire on the wall of Gaza, and it will devour its palaces.

hausa: Yahuda ya amsa ya ce, “Me za mu ce wa ranka yă daɗe? Yaya kuma za mu wanke kanmu daga wannan zargi? Allah ya tona laifin bayinka. Ga mu, za mu zama bayinka, da mu da wanda aka sami kwaf ɗin a hannunsa.”
english: Judah said, “What will we tell my lord? What will we speak? How will we clear ourselves? God has found out the iniquity of your servants. Behold, we are my lord’s slaves, both we and he also in whose hand the cup is found.”

hausa: Na Gershonawa, Ladan da Shimeyi.
english: Of the Gershonites: Ladan and Shimei.

hausa: Suna mutuwa nan take, a cikin tsakiyar dare; an girgiza mutanen amma sun wuce; an taɓa manya amma ba da hannun mutum ba.
english: In a moment they die, even at midnight. The people are shaken and pass away. The mighty are taken away without a hand.

hausa: Sai ya ce mata, “Har yaushe za ki ci gaba da maye? Ki daina shan ruwan inabi.”
english: Eli said to her, “How long will you be drunk? Get rid of your wine!”

hausa: Gama Ubangiji Allahnku zai albarkace ku kamar yadda ya yi alkawari, za ku kuma ba al’ummai masu yawa bashi, amma ba za ku karɓa bashi daga wurin wani ba. Za ku yi mulkin al’ummai masu yawa, babu wata kuwa da za tă yi mulkinku.
english: For Yahweh your God will bless you, as he promised you. You will lend to many nations, but you will not borrow. You will rule over many nations, but they will not rule over you.

hausa: Gideyon da mutanensa ɗari uku, sun gaji, duk da haka suka yi ta fafarar, suka zo Urdun suka haye shi.
english: Gideon came to the Jordan and passed over, he and the three hundred men who were with him, faint, yet pursuing.

hausa: Kamar suƙar ƙaya a hannun wanda ya bugu haka karin magana yake a bakin wawa.
english: Like a thorn bush that goes into the hand of a drunkard, so is a parable in the mouth of fools.

hausa: Amma bawan ya amsa ya ce, “Duba, a wannan gari akwai wani mutumin Allah, ana ganin girmansa ƙwarai kuma duk abin da ya faɗa yakan zama gaskiya. Mu tafi can wurinsa wataƙila zai gaya mana hanyar da za mu bi.”
english: The servant said to him, “Behold now, there is a man of God in this city, and he is a man who is held in honor. All that he says surely happens. Now let’s go there. Perhaps he can tell us which way to go.”

hausa: Sihon dai, bai amince da Isra’ila su ratsa ƙasarsa ba. Ya tattara dukan mutanensa suka yi sansani a Yahza suka kuwa yaƙi Isra’ila.
english: But Sihon didn’t trust Israel to pass through his border; but Sihon gathered all his people together, and encamped in Jahaz, and fought against Israel.

hausa: Sai Yesu ya fara yin tir da biranen da aka yi yawancin ayyukansa na banmamaki, don ba su tuba ba.
english: Then he began to denounce the cities in which most of his mighty works had been done, because they didn’t repent.

hausa: Sa’an nan Bowaz ya ce, “A ranar da ka saya filin daga Na’omi da kuma daga Rut mutuniyar Mowab, ka sayi gwauruwar marigayin nan, domin ka riƙe sunan marigayin da kuma kayansa.”
english: Then Boaz said, “On the day you buy the field from the hand of Naomi, you must buy it also from Ruth the Moabitess, the wife of the dead, to raise up the name of the dead on his inheritance.”

hausa: Sai ya aiki ’yan saƙo, su yi gaba. Su kuwa, suka shiga cikin wani ƙauyen Samariyawa, don su shirya masa abubuwa.
english: and sent messengers before his face. They went and entered into a village of the Samaritans, so as to prepare for him.

hausa: Sa’an nan su rufe shi da fatun shanun teku, su shimfiɗa zane mai ruwan shuɗi a bisansa, su sa masa sandunansa.
english: put a covering of sealskin on it, spread a blue cloth over it, and put in its poles.

hausa: Bari in rayu don in yabe ka, bari kuma dokokinka su raya ni.
english: Let my soul live, that I may praise you. Let your ordinances help me.

hausa: Ya ce, “Babu shakka su mutanena ne, ’ya’ya maza waɗanda ba za su ruɗe ni ba”; ta haka ya zama Mai Cetonsu.
english: For he said, “Surely, they are my people, children who will not deal falsely;” so he became their Savior.

hausa: Kai bawa ne sa’ad da aka kira ka? Kada wannan yă dame ka, sai dai in kana iya samun ’yanci, sai ka yi amfani da wannan dama.
english: Were you called being a bondservant? Don’t let that bother you, but if you get an opportunity to become free, use it.

hausa: Gama bai taɓa yin tunanin yin alheri ba, amma ya tsananta wa matalauta da mabukata da kuma masu fid da zuciya har suka mutu.
english: because he didn’t remember to show kindness, but persecuted the poor and needy man, the broken in heart, to kill them.

hausa: Har yaushe, ya Ubangiji, zan yi kukan neman taimako, amma ka ƙi ji? Ina kuka a gare ka saboda zalunci amma ba ka ce ufam ba.
english: Yahweh, how long will I cry, and you will not hear? I cry out to you “Violence!” and will you not save?

hausa: Shi ne Ubangiji Allahnmu; hukuntansa suna a cikin dukan duniya.
english: He is Yahweh our God. His judgments are in all the earth.

hausa: Akwai mata da yawa a can, suna kallo daga nesa. Sun bi Yesu tun daga Galili, suna masa hidima.
english: Many women were there watching from afar, who had followed Jesus from Galilee, serving him.

hausa: Da sarki ya ji kalmomin Littafin Doka, sai ya kece tufafinsa.
english: When the king had heard the words of the book of the law, he tore his clothes.

hausa: Sai ya sauko tare da su, ya tsaya a wani fili. A can, akwai taro mai yawa na almajiransa, da kuma mutane masu yawan gaske daga ko’ina a Yahudiya, Urushalima da kuma Taya da Sidon da suke bakin teku,
english: He came down with them and stood on a level place, with a crowd of his disciples and a great number of the people from all Judea and Jerusalem and the sea coast of Tyre and Sidon, who came to hear him and to be healed of their diseases,

hausa: Gama Allah ya ji daɗi yă sa dukan cikarsa ta kasance a cikin Kiristi,
english: For all the fullness was pleased to dwell in him,

hausa: Ba ka gaskata cewa ina cikin Uba, Uba kuma yana cikina ba? Kalmomin da nake gaya muku ba na kaina ba ne. Ai, Uban da yake raye a cikina ne yake aikinsa.
english: Don’t you believe that I am in the Father, and the Father in me? The words that I tell you, I speak not from myself; but the Father who lives in me does his works.

hausa: “Efraim yana kama da kurciya, marar wayo, marar hankali, yanzu yana kira ga Masar, yanzu yana juyewa ga Assuriya.
english: “Ephraim is like an easily deceived dove, without understanding. They call to Egypt. They go to Assyria.

hausa: Amma ina gani ya dace in aika da Afaforiditus, ɗan’uwana, abokin aikina da kuma abokin famana, wanda kuma yake ɗan saƙonku, wanda kuka aika domin yă biya mini bukatuna.
english: But I thought it necessary to send to you Epaphroditus, my brother, fellow worker, fellow soldier, and your apostle and servant of my need,

hausa: Ku biya kuɗin aikinsa kowace rana kafin fāɗuwar rana, domin shi matalauci ne, yana kuma sa rai a kan wannan hakkin ne, don kada ya yi wa Ubangiji kuka a kanku, har yă zama laifi a gare ku.
english: In his day you shall give him his wages, neither shall the sun go down on it, for he is poor and sets his heart on it, lest he cry against you to Yahweh, and it be sin to you.

hausa: Kada mutum yă auri matar mahaifinsa, kada yă ƙasƙantar gādon mahaifinsa.
english: A man shall not take his father’s wife, and shall not uncover his father’s skirt.

hausa: Gama doka takan naɗa babban firist a cikin mutane masu kāsawa; amma rantsuwar da ta zo bayan dokar, ta naɗa Ɗan, wanda aka mai da shi cikakke har abada.
english: For the law appoints men as high priests who have weakness, but the word of the oath, which came after the law, appoints a Son forever who has been perfected.

hausa: Waɗannan ɓangarori na matsaran ƙofofi, ta wurin manyansu, suna da ayyukan yin hidima a haikalin Ubangiji, kamar yadda danginsu suke da shi.
english: Of these were the divisions of the doorkeepers, even of the chief men, having offices like their brothers, to minister in Yahweh’s house.

hausa: ya yi ta taƙama game da ɗumbun wadatarsa, da yawan ’ya’yansa maza, da dukan yadda sarki ya girmama shi, ya kuma ɗaga shi bisan sauran hakimai da shugabanni.
english: Haman recounted to them the glory of his riches, the multitude of his children, all the things in which the king had promoted him, and how he had advanced him above the princes and servants of the king.

hausa: Ga abin da Ubangiji yana cewa, “A lokacin tagomashina zan amsa muku, kuma a ranar ceto zan taimake ku; zan kiyaye ku zan kuma sa ku zama alkawari ga mutane, don ku maido da ƙasa ku kuma sāke raba gādon kufai,
english: Yahweh says, “I have answered you in an acceptable time. I have helped you in a day of salvation. I will preserve you and give you for a covenant of the people, to raise up the land, to make them inherit the desolate heritage,

hausa: Game da dukan tuddai da dā ake nome da garemani kuwa, ba za ku ƙara je wurin ba saboda tsoron ƙayayyuwa da sarƙaƙƙiya; za su zama wuraren da ake kai shanu a sake su su yi ta yawo da kansu, tumaki kuma su yi ta gudu.
english: All the hills that were cultivated with the hoe, you shall not come there for fear of briers and thorns; but it shall be for the sending out of oxen, and for sheep to tread on.”

hausa: Ko da yake sun ɗauka su masu hikima ne, sai suka zama wawaye,
english: Professing themselves to be wise, they became fools,

hausa: Ananiyas ya amsa ya ce, “Ubangiji, na ji labarin mutumin nan sosai da kuma duk lahanin da ya yi wa tsarkakanka a Urushalima.
english: But Ananias answered, “Lord, I have heard from many about this man, how much evil he did to your saints at Jerusalem.

hausa: domin sun bar shi suka bauta wa Ba’al da Ashtarot.
english: They abandoned Yahweh, and served Baal and the Ashtaroth.

hausa: A kwanakin gidan Yahuda zai haɗu da gidan Isra’ila, tare kuma za su zo daga ƙasar da take wajen arewa zuwa ƙasar da na ba kakanninsu gādo.
english: In those days the house of Judah will walk with the house of Israel, and they will come together out of the land of the north to the land that I gave for an inheritance to your fathers.

hausa: Mashaidi na gaskiya ba ya ruɗu, amma mashaidin ƙarya kan baza ƙarairayi.
english: A truthful witness will not lie, but a false witness pours out lies.

hausa: Ya ce, “Kada ka ji tsoro, mahaifina Shawulu ba zai taɓa sa hannu a kanka ba. Za ka zama sarki a Isra’ila, ni kuma in zama na biyu gare ka. Kai, ko mahaifina Shawulu ma ya san da haka.”
english: He said to him, “Don’t be afraid, for the hand of Saul my father won’t find you; and you will be king over Israel, and I will be next to you; and Saul my father knows that also.”

hausa: sai Nebukadnezzar ya ce musu, “Gaskiya ne Shadrak, Meshak da Abednego, cewa kun ƙi ku bauta wa alloli kuka kuma ƙi yi sujada ga gunkin da na kafa?
english: Nebuchadnezzar answered them, “Is it true, Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego, that you don’t serve my gods and you don’t worship the golden image which I have set up?

hausa: Gama yana ganin iyakar duniya kuma yana ganin duk abin da yake ƙarƙashin sama.
english: For he looks to the ends of the earth, and sees under the whole sky.

hausa: Na san cewa umarninsa yana kai ga rai madawwami. Saboda haka duk abin da na faɗa na faɗe shi ne kamar dai yadda Uba ya ce in faɗa.”
english: I know that his commandment is eternal life. The things therefore which I speak, even as the Father has said to me, so I speak.”

hausa: Tare da shi akwai kabilar Benyamin mutum dubu, tare da Ziba, mai hidimar gidan Shawulu, da ’ya’yansa maza goma sha biyar, da bayi ashirin. Suka ruga zuwa Urdun, inda sarki yake.
english: There were a thousand men of Benjamin with him, and Ziba the servant of Saul’s house, and his fifteen sons and his twenty servants with him; and they went through the Jordan in the presence of the king.

hausa: Matanku, da yaranku, da kuma dabbobinku za su kasance a ƙasar da Musa ya ba ku a gabashin Urdun, amma dole mayaƙanku, su yi shirin yaƙi su haye, su yi gaba tare da ’yan’uwanku, za ku taimaki ’yan’uwanku
english: Your wives, your little ones, and your livestock shall live in the land which Moses gave you beyond the Jordan; but you shall pass over before your brothers armed, all the mighty men of valor, and shall help them
