hausa: Zai yanka shi a gefen arewa na bagaden a gaban Ubangiji, ’ya’yan Haruna firistoci kuwa za su yayyafa jinin dabbar a bagaden a kowane gefe.
english: He shall kill it on the north side of the altar before Yahweh. Aaron’s sons, the priests, shall sprinkle its blood around on the altar.

hausa: Yayinda ɗayansu yake cikin saran itace, sai kan gatarin ya fāɗi a ruwa, sai ya ce, “Kash, ranka yă daɗe, kayan aro ne fa!”
english: But as one was cutting down a tree, the ax head fell into the water. Then he cried out and said, “Alas, my master! For it was borrowed.”

hausa: ya kuma aika zuwa ga sarakunan arewa waɗanda suke kan tuddai da kuma waɗanda suke cikin Araba a kudancin Kinneret da cikin filayen kwari, da cikin Nafot Dor a yamma;
english: and to the kings who were on the north, in the hill country, in the Arabah south of Chinneroth, in the lowland, and in the heights of Dor on the west,

hausa: Hikima ta gina gidanta; ta yi ginshiƙansa bakwai.
english: Wisdom has built her house. She has carved out her seven pillars.

hausa: Ba don aure-aure irin waɗannan ne Solomon sarkin Isra’ila ya yi zunubi ba? A cikin yawancin al’ummai babu sarki kamar sa. Allahnsa ya ƙaunace shi, Allah kuma ya mai da shi sarki a kan dukan Isra’ila, amma duk da haka baren mata suka rinjaye shi ga zunubi.
english: Didn’t Solomon king of Israel sin by these things? Yet among many nations there was no king like him, and he was loved by his God, and God made him king over all Israel. Nevertheless foreign women caused even him to sin.

hausa: Leɓunan sarki kan yi magana kamar ta wurin ikon Allah, kuma bai kamata bakinsa ya yi kuskure a yanke shari’a ba.
english: Inspired judgments are on the lips of the king. He shall not betray his mouth.

hausa: Rera wa Ubangiji waƙar godiya; ku kada garaya ga Allahnmu.
english: Sing to Yahweh with thanksgiving. Sing praises on the harp to our God,

hausa: Waɗanda suke daɗe suna shan ruwan inabi, waɗanda suke neman ƙoƙon damammen ruwan inabi.
english: Those who stay long at the wine; those who go to seek out mixed wine.

hausa: Ku tunashe ni abin da ya riga ya wuce, bari mu yi muhawwara wannan batu tare; ku kawo hujjarku na nuna rashin laifinku.
english: Put me in remembrance. Let us plead together. Declare your case, that you may be justified.

hausa: Don me za ku kashe kuɗi a kan abin da ba abinci ba, ku kuma yi wahala a kan abin da ba za ku ƙoshi ba? Ku saurara, ku saurare ni, ku kuma ci abin da yake da kyau, ranku kuma zai ji daɗin abinci mafi kyau.
english: Why do you spend money for that which is not bread, and your labor for that which doesn’t satisfy? Listen diligently to me, and eat that which is good, and let your soul delight itself in richness.

hausa: Da suka fara waƙa, suna kuma yabo, sai Ubangiji ya kai hari a kan mutanen Ammon da Mowab da Dutsen Seyir, waɗanda suka kawo hari a Yahuda, aka kuwa ci su da yaƙi.
english: When they began to sing and to praise, Yahweh set ambushers against the children of Ammon, Moab, and Mount Seir, who had come against Judah; and they were struck.

hausa: Game da Titus kuma, shi abokin tarayyata ne, da kuma abokin aikina a cikinku; game da ’yan’uwanmu kuwa, su wakilai ne na ikkilisiyoyi, kuma su masu ɗaukaka Kiristi ne.
english: As for Titus, he is my partner and fellow worker for you. As for our brothers, they are the apostles of the assemblies, the glory of Christ.

hausa: Sai sarki ya miƙa wa Esta sandan sarauta na zinariya, ta kuwa tashi ta tsaya a gabansa.
english: Then the king held out to Esther the golden scepter. So Esther arose, and stood before the king.

hausa: Kwana uku da rabi mutane daga kowace jama’a, kabila, harshe da kuma al’umma za su yi ta kallon gawawwakinsu su kuma ƙi binne su.
english: From among the peoples, tribes, languages, and nations, people will look at their dead bodies for three and a half days, and will not allow their dead bodies to be laid in a tomb.

hausa: Zai miƙa kwandon burodi marar yisti, yă kuma miƙa ɗan ragon hadaya ta salama tare da hadaya ta gari, da hadaya ta sha ga Ubangiji.
english: He shall offer the ram for a sacrifice of peace offerings to Yahweh, with the basket of unleavened bread. The priest shall offer also its meal offering and its drink offering.

hausa: Ya amsa ya ce, “Zuwa ƙasar Babiloniya don a gina masa haikali. Sa’ad da aka gama ginin, za a ajiye shi a ciki.”
english: He said to me, “To build her a house in the land of Shinar. When it is prepared, she will be set there in her own place.”

hausa: Sa’ad da Solomon ya gama yin addu’a, sai wuta ya sauko daga sama ya cinye hadaya ta ƙonawa da kuma sadakokin, ɗaukakar Ubangiji kuwa ta cika haikalin.
english: Now when Solomon had finished praying, fire came down from heaven and consumed the burnt offering and the sacrifices; and Yahweh’s glory filled the house.

hausa: Ta wurin yawan zunubanka da kasuwancinka na cuta ka ƙazantar da wuri mai tsarkinka. Saboda haka na sa wuta ta fito daga cikinka, ta cinye ka, na maishe ka toka a bisa ƙasa a kan idon dukan waɗanda suke kallonka.
english: By the multitude of your iniquities, in the unrighteousness of your commerce, you have profaned your sanctuaries. Therefore I have brought out a fire from the middle of you. It has devoured you. I have turned you to ashes on the earth in the sight of all those who see you.

hausa: “Sai na yi tambaya na ce, ‘Wane ne kai, ya Ubangiji?’ “Ya amsa ya ce, ‘Ni ne Yesu Banazare, wanda kake tsanantawa.’
english: I answered, ‘Who are you, Lord?’ He said to me, ‘I am Jesus of Nazareth, whom you persecute.’

hausa: Gama wa ya san abin da ya fi dacewa ga mutum a ’yan kwanakinsa marasa amfani da sukan wuce kamar inuwa? Wa kuma zai iya faɗa masa abin da zai faru a duniya bayan ya rasu?
english: For who knows what is good for man in life, all the days of his vain life which he spends like a shadow? For who can tell a man what will be after him under the sun?

hausa: ta kuma buɗe bakinta, ta haɗiye su tare da mutanen gidansu da dukan mutanen Kora da dukan abin da yake mallakarsu.
english: The earth opened its mouth and swallowed them up with their households, all of Korah’s men, and all their goods.

hausa: da kurciyoyi biyu ko tattabarai biyu, wanda zai iya samu, ɗaya domin hadaya don zunubi ɗayan kuma domin hadaya ta ƙonawa.
english: and two turtledoves, or two young pigeons, such as he is able to afford; and the one shall be a sin offering, and the other a burnt offering.

hausa: ’Yan’uwa a Listira da Ikoniyum sun yi magana mai kyau ƙwarai a kansa.
english: The brothers who were at Lystra and Iconium gave a good testimony about him.

hausa: Wa ya ba da Yaƙub don yă zama ganima Isra’ila kuma ga masu kwasar ganima? Ba Ubangiji ba ne, wanda kuka yi wa zunubi? Gama ba su bi hanyoyinsa ba; ba su yi biyayya da dokarsa ba.
english: Who gave Jacob as plunder, and Israel to the robbers? Didn’t Yahweh, he against whom we have sinned? For they would not walk in his ways, and they disobeyed his law.

hausa: Muna gudu kada wani yă zarge mu, a kan yadda muke gudanar da wannan kyautar da aka bayar hannu sake.
english: We are avoiding this, that any man should blame us concerning this abundance which is administered by us.

hausa: Zan sa zuriyarka tă yi yawa kamar ƙurar ƙasa, har in wani yana iya ƙidaya ƙurar, to, za a iya ƙidaya zuriyarka.
english: I will make your offspring as the dust of the earth, so that if a man can count the dust of the earth, then your offspring may also be counted.

hausa: Bari al’ummai su bauta maka mutane kuma su rusuna maka. Ka zama shugaba a kan ’yan’uwanka bari kuma ’ya’yan mahaifiyarka su rusuna maka. Bari waɗanda suka la’anta ka, su la’antu; waɗanda kuma suka sa maka albarka, su sami albarka.”
english: Let peoples serve you, and nations bow down to you. Be lord over your brothers. Let your mother’s sons bow down to you. Cursed be everyone who curses you. Blessed be everyone who blesses you.”

hausa: To, yanzu sai ku yi haka! Gama Ubangiji ya yi wa Dawuda alkawari ya ce, ‘Ta wurin bawana Dawuda zan ceci mutanena Isra’ila daga hannun Filistiyawa, da kuma hannun dukan abokan gābansu.’ ”
english: Now then do it! For Yahweh has spoken of David, saying, ‘By the hand of my servant David, I will save my people Israel out of the hand of the Philistines, and out of the hand of all their enemies.’”

hausa: Kama mana ɓeraye, ƙananan ɓerayen da suke lalatar da gonakin inabi, gonakin inabinmu da suke cikin yin fure.
english: Catch for us the foxes, the little foxes that plunder the vineyards; for our vineyards are in blossom.

hausa: Matalauta dai suna tare da ku kullum, za ku kuma iya taimakonsu a duk lokacin da kuke so. Amma ni ba zan kasance da ku kullum ba.
english: For you always have the poor with you, and whenever you want to, you can do them good; but you will not always have me.

hausa: Filibus ya gangara zuwa wani birni a Samariya ya kuma yi shelar Kiristi a can.
english: Philip went down to the city of Samaria and proclaimed to them the Christ.

hausa: Suka kira sarki, sai Eliyakim ɗan Hilkiya sarkin fada, da Shebna magatakarda, da Yowa ɗan Asaf marubuci suka je wurinsu.
english: When they had called to the king, Eliakim the son of Hilkiah, who was over the household, and Shebnah the scribe, and Joah the son of Asaph the recorder came out to them.

hausa: Hasken Isra’ila zai zo kamar wuta, Mai Tsarkinsu zai zama kamar wuta; a rana guda zai ƙone yă kuma cinye ƙayayyuwa da sarƙaƙƙiyarsa.
english: The light of Israel will be for a fire, and his Holy One for a flame; and it will burn and devour his thorns and his briers in one day.

hausa: Bayan wannan, sai Yesu ya fita, ya ga wani mai karɓar haraji, mai suna Lawi, yana zaune a wurin da ake karɓar haraji. Yesu ya ce masa, “Bi ni.”
english: After these things he went out and saw a tax collector named Levi sitting at the tax office, and said to him, “Follow me!”

hausa: Mutanen Dan suka ce, “Kada ka kuskura ka ce kome, in ba haka ba mutanen nan za su harzuƙa, da kai da iyalinka duka ku rasa rayukanku.”
english: The children of Dan said to him, “Don’t let your voice be heard among us, lest angry fellows fall on you, and you lose your life, with the lives of your household.”

hausa: Waɗannan abubuwa sun faru don a cika Nassi ne cewa, “Ba ko ɗaya daga cikin ƙasusuwansa da za a karya,”
english: For these things happened that the Scripture might be fulfilled, “A bone of him will not be broken.”

hausa: Babu wanda yake kira bisa sunanka ko ya yi ƙoƙarin riƙe ka; gama ka ɓoye fuskarka daga gare mu ka kuma sa muka lalace saboda zunubanmu.
english: There is no one who calls on your name, who stirs himself up to take hold of you; for you have hidden your face from us, and have consumed us by means of our iniquities.

hausa: In na ce, “Tabbatacce duhu zai ɓoye ni haske kuma zai zama dare kewaye da ni,”
english: If I say, “Surely the darkness will overwhelm me. The light around me will be night,”

hausa: Ko da mutum goma ne suka ragu a gida guda, su ma za su mutu.
english: It will happen that if ten men remain in one house, they will die.

hausa: Sai Saira ta ce wa Abram, “Kai ne da alhakin wahalan nan da nake sha. Na sa baiwata a hannunka, yanzu da ta sani tana da ciki, sai ta fara rena ni. Bari Ubangiji yă shari’anta tsakanina da kai.”
english: Sarai said to Abram, “This wrong is your fault. I gave my servant into your bosom, and when she saw that she had conceived, she despised me. May Yahweh judge between me and you.”

hausa: Sai Sofater ɗan Fairrus daga Bereya, Aristarkus da Sekundus daga Tessalonika, Gayus daga Derbe, Timoti ma, da Tikikus da Turofimus daga lardin Asiya suka tafi tare da shi.
english: These accompanied him as far as Asia: Sopater of Beroea, Aristarchus and Secundus of the Thessalonians, Gaius of Derbe, Timothy, and Tychicus and Trophimus of Asia.

hausa: Amma Habila ya kawo mafi kyau daga ’ya’yan fari na garkensa. Ubangiji ya yi farin ciki da sadakar da Habila ya kawo,
english: Abel also brought some of the firstborn of his flock and of its fat. Yahweh respected Abel and his offering,

hausa: Ga shi, a yau, ina sa a gabanku albarka da kuma la’ana,
english: Behold, I set before you today a blessing and a curse:

hausa: Bawan ya sāke ce masa, “Duba ina da kwatar azurfar da zan ba wa mutumin Allah don yă gaya mana wace hanya ce za mu bi.”
english: The servant answered Saul again and said, “Behold, I have in my hand the fourth part of a shekel of silver. I will give that to the man of God, to tell us our way.”

hausa: A dukan al’amuran hikima da na fahimta wanda sarki ya tambaye su, ya tarar sun fi dukan masu sihiri da bokaye waɗanda suke cikin mulkinsa sau goma.
english: In every matter of wisdom and understanding concerning which the king inquired of them, he found them ten times better than all the magicians and enchanters who were in all his realm.

hausa: da dukan abin da wuta ba ta iya ci, dole yă shiga wuta sa’an nan zai zama da tsabta. Amma dole a kuma tsarkake ta da ruwan tsarkakewa. Duk abin da wuta za tă iya ci, dole a shigar da ita a ruwan tsarkakewa.
english: everything that may withstand the fire, you shall make to go through the fire, and it shall be clean; nevertheless it shall be purified with the water for impurity. All that doesn’t withstand the fire you shall make to go through the water.

hausa: Ya ba su waɗannan umarnai, “Ku yi aikinku da aminci da tsoron Ubangiji da dukan zuciyarku.
english: He commanded them, saying, “You shall do this in the fear of Yahweh, faithfully, and with a perfect heart.

hausa: Sai ya ce, “Ku duba ina ganin mutum huɗu suna tafiya suna yawo a cikin wutar, a sake kuma babu abin da ya same su, na huɗun sai ka ce ɗan alloli.”
english: He answered, “Look, I see four men loose, walking in the middle of the fire, and they are unharmed. The appearance of the fourth is like a son of the gods.”

hausa: “Me ku mutane kuke nufi da faɗar wannan karin magana a kan ƙasar Isra’ila cewa, “ ‘Ubanni sun ci ’ya’yan inabi masu tsami, haƙoran ’ya’ya kuwa sun mutu’?
english: “What do you mean, that you use this proverb concerning the land of Israel, saying, ‘The fathers have eaten sour grapes, and the children’s teeth are set on edge’?

hausa: Sa’an nan suka jefa ƙuri’u, ƙuri’ar kuwa ta fāɗo a kan Mattiyas; sai aka sa shi cikin manzannin nan goma sha ɗaya.
english: They drew lots for them, and the lot fell on Matthias; and he was counted with the eleven apostles.

hausa: Annoba ta sha gabansa; cuta kuma tana bin bayansa.
english: Plague went before him, and pestilence followed his feet.

hausa: don yin yaƙi kana bukatar bishewa, kuma don ka yi nasara kana bukatar mashawarta masu yawa.
english: for by wise guidance you wage your war, and victory is in many advisors.

hausa: A cikin gidan Ubana akwai wurin zama da yawa; da a ce ba haka ba ne, da na gaya muku. Za ni can don in shirya muku wuri.
english: In my Father’s house are many homes. If it weren’t so, I would have told you. I am going to prepare a place for you.

hausa: Bugu da ƙari, Uban ba ya hukunta kowa, sai dai ya danƙa dukan hukunci a hannun Ɗan,
english: For the Father judges no one, but he has given all judgment to the Son,

hausa: Za su buɗe hannuwansa a cikinsa, yadda mai iyo kan buɗe hannuwansa don yă yi iyo. Allah ya ƙasƙantar da girmankansu duk da wayon hannuwansu.
english: He will spread out his hands in the middle of it, like one who swims spreads out hands to swim, but his pride will be humbled together with the craft of his hands.

hausa: “Yanzu, ya Allahnmu, ka ji addu’o’i da koke-koken bayinka. Saboda sunanka, ya Ubangiji, ka duba da rahama wurinka mai tsarki da ya zama kango.
english: “Now therefore, our God, listen to the prayer of your servant and to his petitions, and cause your face to shine on your sanctuary that is desolate, for the Lord’s sake.

hausa: Ka sa ni kamar hatimi a zuciyarka, kamar hatimi a hannunka; gama ƙauna tana da ƙarfi kamar mutuwa, kishinta yana kamar muguntar kabari, yana ƙuna kamar wuta mai ci, kamar gagarumar wuta.
english: Set me as a seal on your heart, as a seal on your arm; for love is strong as death. Jealousy is as cruel as Sheol. Its flashes are flashes of fire, a very flame of Yah.

hausa: Zan jira Ubangiji, raina zai jira, kuma a cikin maganarsa na sa zuciyata.
english: I wait for Yahweh. My soul waits. I hope in his word.

hausa: Dukan kwarin da ake zubar da toka da kuma gawawwaki, da dukan lambatun da suke can har zuwa Kwarin Kidron a gabas zuwa kusurwar Ƙofar Doki, za su zama mai tsarki ga Ubangiji. Ba za a ƙara tumɓuke birnin ko a rushe shi ba.”
english: The whole valley of the dead bodies and of the ashes, and all the fields to the brook Kidron, to the corner of the horse gate toward the east, will be holy to Yahweh. It will not be plucked up or thrown down any more forever.”

hausa: A wannan yamma sai ga wani tsoho daga ƙasar tudu ta Efraim, wanda yake zama a Gibeya (mutane wurin kuwa mutanen Benyamin ne), ya shigo daga wurin aiki a gonaki.
english: Behold, an old man came from his work out of the field at evening. Now the man was from the hill country of Ephraim, and he lived in Gibeah; but the men of the place were Benjamites.

hausa: To, me kuke tsammani nake nufi a nan? Hadayar da aka miƙa wa gunki ce wani abu, ko kuma gunkin ne wani abu?
english: What am I saying then? That a thing sacrificed to idols is anything, or that an idol is anything?

hausa: Amma mutane da yawa waɗanda suka ga tashinsu, sun gane su, sai suka ruga da gudu a ƙafa daga dukan birane, suka riga su kaiwa can.
english: They saw them going, and many recognized him and ran there on foot from all the cities. They arrived before them and came together to him.

hausa: Wannan ne ya sa sau da yawa aka hana ni zuwa wurinku.
english: Therefore also I was hindered these many times from coming to you,

hausa: Ka kasa kunne ga mahaifinka, wanda ya ba ka rai, kada kuwa ka rena mahaifiyarka sa’ad da ta tsufa.
english: Listen to your father who gave you life, and don’t despise your mother when she is old.

hausa: Ba’asha ya huta tare da kakanninsa, aka kuma binne shi a Tirza. Sai Ela ɗansa ya gāje shi a matsayin sarki.
english: Baasha slept with his fathers, and was buried in Tirzah; and Elah his son reigned in his place.

hausa: Sarki ya amsa musu da kakkausar murya. Ya ƙi shawarar dattawan,
english: The king answered them roughly; and King Rehoboam abandoned the counsel of the old men,

hausa: Ta haka muka san waɗanda suke ’ya’yan Allah da kuma waɗanda suke ’ya’yan Iblis. Duk wanda ba ya yin abin da yake daidai, ba ɗan Allah ba ne; haka ma wanda ba ya ƙaunar ɗan’uwansa.
english: In this the children of God are revealed, and the children of the devil. Whoever doesn’t do righteousness is not of God, neither is he who doesn’t love his brother.

hausa: Mutanensu, suka rasa ƙarfi, sun firgita suka kuma sha kunya. Suka zama kamar tsire-tsire a gona, kamar tsire-tsiren ta suka tohu, kamar ciyawar da ya tsiro a kan rufi, wadda zafi ya yi wa ƙuna kafin tă yi girma.
english: Therefore their inhabitants had little power. They were dismayed and confounded. They were like the grass of the field, and like the green herb, like the grass on the housetops, and like a field before its crop has grown.

hausa: ta ce musu, “Na sani Ubangiji ya riga ya ba ku ƙasan nan, tsoronku kuma ya kama mu har zukatan mazaunan ƙasar duka sun narke saboda ku.
english: She said to the men, “I know that Yahweh has given you the land, and that the fear of you has fallen upon us, and that all the inhabitants of the land melt away before you.

hausa: saboda haka ga abin da Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka yana cewa ina gāba da ke, ya Taya, zan kuwa kawo al’ummai masu yawa su yi gāba da ke, kamar yadda teku takan kawo raƙuman ruwa.
english: therefore the Lord Yahweh says, ‘Behold, I am against you, Tyre, and will cause many nations to come up against you, as the sea causes its waves to come up.

hausa: Kansa da kuma gashin fari ne fat kamar ulu, fari kamar dusar ƙanƙara, idanunsa kuwa kamar harshen wuta.
english: His head and his hair were white as white wool, like snow. His eyes were like a flame of fire.

hausa: Ɗana, ka riƙe sahihiyar shari’a da kuma basira, kada ka bar su su rabu da kai;
english: My son, let them not depart from your eyes. Keep sound wisdom and discretion,

hausa: To, yaya kowannenmu yana ji suna yarensa?
english: How do we hear, everyone in our own native language?

hausa: Gama ƙaunarka da girma take gare ni; kai ka cece ni daga zurfafa, daga mazaunin matattu.
english: For your loving kindness is great toward me. You have delivered my soul from the lowest Sheol.

hausa: har zuwa talenti ɗari na azurfa, da mudu ɗari na alkama, da garwa ɗari na ruwan inabi, da garwa ɗari na man zaitun, da kuma gishiri ba iyaka.
english: up to one hundred talents of silver, and to one hundred cors of wheat, and to one hundred baths of wine, and to one hundred baths of oil, and salt without prescribing how much.

hausa: Ni ne Ubangiji Allahnku, wanda ya fitar da ku daga Masar don kada ku ƙara zama bayi ga Masarawa; na karya sandunan wahalarku, na kuma bar ku ku yi tafiya a sake.
english: I am Yahweh your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, that you should not be their slaves. I have broken the bars of your yoke, and made you walk upright.

hausa: Iliya ya ɗauki duwatsu goma sha biyu, ɗaya don kowace kabila zuriyar Yaƙub, wanda maganar Ubangiji ta zo masa, cewa, “Sunanka zai zama Isra’ila.”
english: Elijah took twelve stones, according to the number of the tribes of the sons of Jacob, to whom Yahweh’s word came, saying, “Israel shall be your name.”

hausa: Mutumin da ya ce, “Na san shi,” amma ba ya yin abin da ya umarta, maƙaryaci ne, gaskiya kuwa ba ta cikinsa.
english: One who says, “I know him,” and doesn’t keep his commandments, is a liar, and the truth isn’t in him.

hausa: Amma in kuma muka ce, ‘Daga mutane ne,’ dukan mutanen za su jajjefe mu da duwatsu, domin sun tabbata cewa, Yohanna annabi ne.”
english: But if we say, ‘From men,’ all the people will stone us, for they are persuaded that John was a prophet.”

hausa: Ba mu bi tatsuniyoyin da aka ƙaga da wayo sa’ad da muka gaya muku game da ikon Ubangijinmu Yesu Kiristi da zuwansa ba, sai dai mu shaidu ne na ɗaukakarsa mai girma da muka gani da ido.
english: For we didn’t follow cunningly devised fables when we made known to you the power and coming of our Lord Jesus Christ, but we were eyewitnesses of his majesty.

hausa: A ranar, Gad ya koma wurin Dawuda ya ce, “Ka tashi, ka tafi ka gina wa Ubangiji bagade a masussukar Arauna, mutumin Yebus.”
english: Gad came that day to David and said to him, “Go up, build an altar to Yahweh on the threshing floor of Araunah the Jebusite.”

hausa: Ka fanshi Isra’ila, ya Allah, daga dukan wahalarsu!
english: God, redeem Israel out of all his troubles.

hausa: Daga zuriyar Asher. Aka rubuta sunayen dukan maza ɗaya-ɗaya da suka kai shekara ashirin ko fiye da suka isa shiga soja, bisa ga iyalansu da kabilarsu da take a rubuce.
english: Of the children of Asher, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war:

hausa: A kan tudun da yake nan kusa kuwa, akwai wani babban garken aladu, suna kiwo.
english: Now on the mountainside there was a great herd of pigs feeding.

hausa: Ta wurin ziyarar Yoram, Allah ya kawo fāɗuwar Ahaziya. Sa’ad da Ahaziya ya iso, ya tafi tare da Yoram domin yă sadu da Yehu ɗan Nimshi, wanda Ubangiji ya shafe don yă hallaka gidan Ahab.
english: Now the destruction of Ahaziah was of God, in that he went to Joram; for when he had come, he went out with Jehoram against Jehu the son of Nimshi, whom Yahweh had anointed to cut off Ahab’s house.

hausa: Sai manzanni da dattawa suka taru don su duba maganar.
english: The apostles and the elders were gathered together to see about this matter.

hausa: Mugu kan zama abin fansa don adali, marar aminci kuma don mai aikata gaskiya.
english: The wicked is a ransom for the righteous, the treacherous for the upright.

hausa: Alheri yă tabbata ga dukan masu ƙaunar Ubangiji Yesu Kiristi da ƙauna marar ƙarewa.
english: Grace be with all those who love our Lord Jesus Christ with incorruptible love. Amen.

hausa: Akwai wani filin nan kusa wanda yake na Fubiliyus, babban shugaban tsibirin. Shi ne ya karɓe mu a gidansa da alheri ya kuma ciyar da mu har kwana uku.
english: Now in the neighborhood of that place were lands belonging to the chief man of the island, named Publius, who received us and courteously entertained us for three days.

hausa: Duba, an bar muku gidanku fanko. Ina kuwa faɗa muku, ba za ku sāke ganina ba, sai kun ce, ‘Mai albarka ne shi wanda yake zuwa cikin sunan Ubangiji.’ ”
english: Behold, your house is left to you desolate. I tell you, you will not see me until you say, ‘Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord!’”

hausa: Amma don ku san cewa, Ɗan Mutum yana da iko a duniya yă gafarta zunubai.” Sai ya ce wa shanyayyen,
english: But that you may know that the Son of Man has authority on earth to forgive sins”—he said to the paralytic—

hausa: A miƙa waɗannan tare da hadayarsu ta sha, haɗe da hadaya ta ƙonawa ta kullum, da kuma hadayarta ta sha. A tabbata dabbobin nan marasa lahani ne.
english: Besides the continual burnt offering and its meal offering, you shall offer them and their drink offerings. See that they are without defect.

hausa: Ku ƙona burodinku mai yisti kamar hadaya ta godiya, ku yi fariya game da hadayunku na yarda rai, ku yi taƙama game da su, ya ku Isra’ilawa, gama abin da kuke jin daɗin aikata ke nan,” in ji Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka.
english: offer a sacrifice of thanksgiving of that which is leavened, and proclaim free will offerings and brag about them; for this pleases you, you children of Israel,” says the Lord Yahweh.

hausa: “Saboda haka fa, kwanaki suna zuwa,” in ji Ubangiji, “sa’ad da mutanen ba za su ƙara cewa, ‘Muddin Ubangiji yana raye, wanda ya fito da Isra’ila daga Masar ba,’
english: “Therefore, behold, the days come,” says Yahweh, “that they will no more say, ‘As Yahweh lives, who brought up the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt;’

hausa: Ba shakka za ka manta da wahalolinka, za ka tuna da su kamar yadda ruwa yake wucewa.
english: for you will forget your misery. You will remember it like waters that have passed away.

hausa: (Ga abin da suka rubuta.) Zuwa ga sarki Artazerzes. Daga bayinka, mutanen Kewayen Kogin Yuferites.
english: This is the copy of the letter that they sent: To King Artaxerxes, from your servants, the people beyond the River.

hausa: Da aka busa ƙahoni, sojoji suka yi ihu, da jin ƙarar ƙahoni, mutane suka kuma yi ihu, sai katangar ta rushe; dukan mutanen kuwa suka shiga birnin kai tsaye, suka yi nasara a kanta.
english: So the people shouted and the priests blew the trumpets. When the people heard the sound of the trumpet, the people shouted with a great shout, and the wall fell down flat, so that the people went up into the city, every man straight in front of him, and they took the city.

hausa: Shugabanni biyar na Filistiyawan nan suka ga duk abin da ya faru, suka koma zuwa Ekron a ranar.
english: When the five lords of the Philistines had seen it, they returned to Ekron the same day.

hausa: Saboda fushin Ubangiji ba za tă zauna a cikinta ba amma za tă zama kufai gaba ɗaya. Duk waɗanda suka wuce Babilon za su ji tsoro su kuma yi tsaki saboda dukan mikinta.
english: Because of Yahweh’s wrath she won’t be inhabited, but she will be wholly desolate. Everyone who goes by Babylon will be astonished, and hiss at all her plagues.

hausa: Kowace rana, daga rana farko zuwa ƙarshe, Ezra ya karanta daga Littafin Dokar Allah. Suka yi bikin kwana bakwai, a rana ta takwas kuma suka yi muhimmin taro bisa ga ƙa’ida.
english: Also day by day, from the first day to the last day, he read in the book of the law of God. They kept the feast seven days; and on the eighth day was a solemn assembly, according to the ordinance.

hausa: Amma da manzannin nan Barnabas da Bulus suka ji haka, sai suka yayyage tufafinsu suka ruga cikin taron, suna ihu suna cewa,
english: But when the apostles, Barnabas and Paul, heard of it, they tore their clothes and sprang into the multitude, crying out,

hausa: A ranar kuwa Ubangiji ya husata har ya yi wannan rantsuwa cewa,
english: Yahweh’s anger burned in that day, and he swore, saying,

hausa: Ya fanshi raina daga fāɗawa cikin rami, kuma zan rayu in ji daɗin hasken.’
english: He has redeemed my soul from going into the pit. My life will see the light.’

hausa: Sai Dawuda da dattawan Isra’ila da shugabannin ƙungiyoyi dubu suka haura don su kawo akwatin alkawarin Ubangiji daga gidan Obed-Edom, da farin ciki.
english: So David, the elders of Israel, and the captains over thousands went to bring the ark of Yahweh’s covenant up out of the house of Obed-Edom with joy.

hausa: Kowa yana yi wa maƙwabcinsa ƙarya; zaƙin bakinsu maganar ƙarya ce suna cike da ruɗu a zukatansu.
english: Everyone lies to his neighbor. They speak with flattering lips, and with a double heart.

hausa: Na ga katanga da ya kewaye filin haikali gaba ɗaya. Tsawon karan awon da yake a hannun mutumin kamu shida ne, sai ya auna kaurin katangar ya sami kamu shida, tsayinta kuma kamu shida.
english: Behold, there was a wall on the outside of the house all around, and in the man’s hand a measuring reed six cubits long, of a cubit and a hand width each. So he measured the thickness of the building, one reed; and the height, one reed.

hausa: Suka amsa suka ce, “Wani mutumin Masar ne ya taimake mu daga hannun waɗansu makiyaya. Har ma ya ɗebo ruwa ya shayar da dabbobin.”
english: They said, “An Egyptian delivered us out of the hand of the shepherds, and moreover he drew water for us, and watered the flock.”

hausa: An ba wa baƙi gādonmu, gidajenmu kuma aka ba bare.
english: Our inheritance has been turned over to strangers, our houses to aliens.

hausa: Da ya gane abin da suke tattaunawa, sai Yesu ya tambaye su ya ce, “Don me kuke zancen rashin burodi? Har yanzu ba ku gane ko fahimta ba? Zukatanku sun taurare ne?
english: Jesus, perceiving it, said to them, “Why do you reason that it’s because you have no bread? Don’t you perceive yet or understand? Is your heart still hardened?

hausa: sai ka sauko daga gicciyen, ka ceci kanka!”
english: save yourself, and come down from the cross!”

hausa: Bayan ’yan kwanaki sai Ubangiji ya ce mini, “Tafi yanzu zuwa Fera ka ɗauko abin ɗamara da na ce maka ka ɓoye a can.”
english: After many days, Yahweh said to me, “Arise, go to the Euphrates, and take the belt from there, which I commanded you to hide there.”

hausa: Duk da haka, Dawuda ya kame kagarar Sihiyona, wadda ta zama Birnin Dawuda.
english: Nevertheless David took the stronghold of Zion. This is David’s city.

hausa: Duk da haka, domin Musa ya bar muku kaciya (ko da yake a gaskiya, ba daga wurin Musa ne ya fito ba, sai dai daga wurin kakannin kakanninku), ga shi kuna yin wa yaro kaciya a ranar Asabbaci.
english: Moses has given you circumcision (not that it is of Moses, but of the fathers), and on the Sabbath you circumcise a boy.

hausa: Ka hallaka su kamar jiragen ruwan Tarshish da iskar gabas ta wargaje.
english: With the east wind, you break the ships of Tarshish.

hausa: Garuruwan nan da ƙauyukansu su ne gādon da kabilar Asher ta samu bisa ga iyalansu.
english: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Asher according to their families, these cities with their villages.

hausa: “Sa’an nan mutumin da ya karɓi talenti ɗaya ya zo. Ya ce, ‘Maigida, na san cewa kai mutum ne mai wuyan sha’ani, kana girbi inda ba ka shuka ba, kana kuma tara inda ba ka yafa iri ba.
english: “He also who had received the one talent came and said, ‘Lord, I knew you that you are a hard man, reaping where you didn’t sow, and gathering where you didn’t scatter.

hausa: Taron mutane mai yawa daga Galili, Dekafolis, Urushalima, Yahudiya da kuma yankin hayin Urdun suka bi shi.
english: Great multitudes from Galilee, Decapolis, Jerusalem, Judea, and from beyond the Jordan followed him.

hausa: Yanzu, kai la’ananne ne, an kuma kore ka daga ƙasa wadda ta buɗe bakinta ta shanye jinin ɗan’uwanka daga hannunka.
english: Now you are cursed because of the ground, which has opened its mouth to receive your brother’s blood from your hand.

hausa: Za a ƙone mutane kamar da ƙuna farar ƙasa; kamar ƙayayyuwan da aka sare aka kuma sa musu wuta.”
english: The peoples will be like the burning of lime, like thorns that are cut down and burned in the fire.

hausa: Ishmayel ya kuma kashe dukan Yahudawan da suke tare da Gedaliya a Mizfa, haka ma ya yi da sojojin Babiloniyawan da suke can.
english: Ishmael also killed all the Jews who were with Gedaliah at Mizpah, and the Chaldean men of war who were found there.

hausa: Ko da yake mugu ya aikata laifi ɗari ya kuma yi tsawon rai, na san cewa zai fi wa masu tsoron Allah kyau, waɗanda suke girmama Allah.
english: Though a sinner commits crimes a hundred times, and lives long, yet surely I know that it will be better with those who fear God, who are reverent before him.

hausa: Kada yă ƙazantar da kansa saboda mutanen da suke da dangantakar da shi ta wurin aure, ta yin haka zai ƙazantar da kansa.
english: He shall not defile himself, being a chief man among his people, to profane himself.

hausa: Ya kawar da rumfa Asabbacin da aka gina a haikalin, ya kuma kawar da mashigin sarki na waje da haikalin Ubangiji, duk dai don yă gamshi sarkin Assuriya.
english: He removed the covered way for the Sabbath that they had built in the house, and the king’s outer entrance to Yahweh’s house, because of the king of Assyria.

hausa: Da muka bi ta bayan wani ɗan tsibirin da ake kira Kauda, da ƙyar muka jawo ɗan ƙaramin jirgin kusa da jirgin.
english: Running under the lee of a small island called Clauda, we were able, with difficulty, to secure the boat.

hausa: to, daga sama, mazauninka, sai ka ji addu’arsu da kuma roƙe-roƙensu, ka kuwa biya musu bukatunsu. Ka gafarta wa mutanenka, waɗanda suka yi maka zunubi.
english: then hear from heaven, even from your dwelling place, their prayer and their petitions, and maintain their cause, and forgive your people who have sinned against you.

hausa: Sai na karya sandana na biyu mai suna Haɗinkai, ta haka na karya ’yan’uwantakar da take tsakanin Yahuda da Isra’ila.
english: Then I cut apart my other staff, Union, that I might break the brotherhood between Judah and Israel.

hausa: Sai Nuhu ya fito tare da matarsa da ’ya’yansa maza da matan ’ya’yansa,
english: Noah went out, with his sons, his wife, and his sons’ wives with him.

hausa: Masarawa suka matsa wa Isra’ilawa su fita daga ƙasarsu da sauri. Gama mutanen Masar sun ce, “Ai, za mu mutu duka, in ba su tafi ba!”
english: The Egyptians were urgent with the people, to send them out of the land in haste, for they said, “We are all dead men.”

hausa: Na san cewa Ubangiji yana da girma, cewa shugabanmu ya fi dukan alloli girma.
english: For I know that Yahweh is great, that our Lord is above all gods.

hausa: ‘Ba za su sāke jin yunwa ba; ba za su kuma sāke jin ƙishirwa ba. Rana ba za tă buga su ba,’ ko kuma kowane irin zafin ƙuna.
english: They will never be hungry or thirsty any more. The sun won’t beat on them, nor any heat;

hausa: Zifawa suka je wurin Shawulu a Gibeya suka ce, “Ashe, ba Dawuda ne ya ɓuya a tudun Hakila da yake fuskantar Yeshimon ba?”
english: The Ziphites came to Saul to Gibeah, saying, “Doesn’t David hide himself in the hill of Hachilah, which is before the desert?”

hausa: Ku ba ta isashen azaba da baƙin ciki kamar daraja da kuma jin daɗin da ta ba wa kanta. A zuciyarta takan yi taƙama, ta ce, ‘Ina zama kamar sarauniya; ni ba gwauruwa ba ce, kuma ba zan taɓa yin makoki ba.’
english: However much she glorified herself and grew wanton, so much give her of torment and mourning. For she says in her heart, ‘I sit a queen, and am no widow, and will in no way see mourning.’

hausa: Ku nuna mini kuɗin da ake biyan haraji da shi.” Sai suka kawo masa dinari,
english: Show me the tax money.” They brought to him a denarius.

hausa: ba tare da kun ji tsoron waɗanda suke gāba da ku ta kowace hanya ba. Wannan alama ce a gare su cewa za a hallaka su, amma a gare ku za a cece ku, wannan tabbacin kuwa daga wurin Allah ne.
english: and in nothing frightened by the adversaries, which is for them a proof of destruction, but to you of salvation, and that from God.

hausa: Yau nan, Ubangiji zai bashe ka a hannuna, zan kuwa kashe ka, in datse kanka. Yau, zan ba da gawawwakin rundunar Filistiyawa ga tsuntsayen sama da namun jeji, da haka duniya za tă sani lalle akwai Allah a cikin Isra’ila.
english: Today, Yahweh will deliver you into my hand. I will strike you and take your head from off you. I will give the dead bodies of the army of the Philistines today to the birds of the sky and to the wild animals of the earth, that all the earth may know that there is a God in Israel,

hausa: Kabilan Isra’ila suka aika jakadu a ko’ina a cikin kabilar Benyamin cewa, “Wace irin mugunta ce wannan da kuka aikata?
english: The tribes of Israel sent men through all the tribe of Benjamin, saying, “What wickedness is this that has happened among you?

hausa: Masu zargina za su sha kunya za a rufe su da kunya kamar mayafi.
english: Let my adversaries be clothed with dishonor. Let them cover themselves with their own shame as with a robe.

hausa: To, Elimelek mijin Na’omi ya rasu, aka bar ta da ’ya’yanta maza biyu.
english: Elimelech, Naomi’s husband, died; and she was left with her two sons.

hausa: A wannan rana, Ibrahim ya ɗauki ɗansa Ishmayel da dukan waɗanda aka haifa cikin gidansa, da waɗanda aka sayo da kuɗinsa, ya kuwa yi wa kowane namiji a cikin gidansa kaciya kamar yadda Allah ya faɗa masa.
english: Abraham took Ishmael his son, all who were born in his house, and all who were bought with his money: every male among the men of Abraham’s house, and circumcised the flesh of their foreskin in the same day, as God had said to him.

hausa: Amma ku, kukan ce, in mutum ya ce wa mahaifinsa, ko mahaifiyarsa, ‘Duk taimakon da ya kamata ku samu daga wurina, Korban ne,’ (wato, abin da aka keɓe wa Allah),
english: But you say, ‘If a man tells his father or his mother, “Whatever profit you might have received from me is Corban,”’” that is to say, given to God,

hausa: Wannan kuwa domin a cika abin da aka faɗa ta bakin annabi Ishaya ne cewa,
english: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through Isaiah the prophet, saying,

hausa: Yanzu kuwa game da ƙaunar ’yan’uwa, ba ma bukata mu rubuta muku, gama ku kanku Allah ya riga ya koya muku ku ƙaunaci juna.
english: But concerning brotherly love, you have no need that one write to you. For you yourselves are taught by God to love one another,

hausa: don yă umarci sarakunansa yadda ya ga dama yă kuma koya wa dattawa hikima.
english: to discipline his princes at his pleasure, and to teach his elders wisdom.

hausa: A nawa ra’ayi, za tă fi jin daɗi in ta zauna haka, a ganina kuwa ina ba ku shawara ce daga Ruhun Allah da na ce haka.
english: But she is happier if she stays as she is, in my judgment, and I think that I also have God’s Spirit.

hausa: “Na faɗa muku waɗannan abubuwa ne, domin a cikina ku sami salama. A duniyan nan za ku sha wahala. Amma ku yi ƙarfin hali! Na yi nasara a kan duniya.”
english: I have told you these things, that in me you may have peace. In the world you have trouble; but cheer up! I have overcome the world.”

hausa: Duba, Ubangiji Allahnku ya ba ku ƙasar. Ku haura ku mallake ta yadda Ubangiji Allahn kakanninku ya faɗa muku. Kada ku ji tsoro, kada ku fid da zuciya.”
english: Behold, Yahweh your God has set the land before you. Go up, take possession, as Yahweh the God of your fathers has spoken to you. Don’t be afraid, neither be dismayed.”

hausa: A ranar da Ubangiji ya hutashe ku daga wahala da azaba da muguwar bauta,
english: It will happen in the day that Yahweh will give you rest from your sorrow, from your trouble, and from the hard service in which you were made to serve,

hausa: Ya Ubangiji, sa’ad da ka yi mini alheri, ka sa katangar dutsena ya tsaya daram; amma sa’ad da ka ɓoye fuskarka, sai in cika da tsoro.
english: You, Yahweh, when you favored me, made my mountain stand strong; but when you hid your face, I was troubled.

hausa: Jijiyoyina za su kai cikin ruwa, kuma raɓa za tă kwanta a rassana dukan dare.
english: My root is spread out to the waters. The dew lies all night on my branch.

hausa: Kada mu zama masu girman kai, muna tsokana muna kuma jin kishin juna.
english: Let’s not become conceited, provoking one another, and envying one another.

hausa: Yonatan da Ahimawaz suna zaune a En Rogel. Wata baranya ce za tă je ta faɗa musu, su kuma su tafi su gaya wa Sarki Dawuda don suna tsoro kada a ga suna shiga birnin.
english: Now Jonathan and Ahimaaz were staying by En Rogel; and a female servant used to go and report to them, and they went and told King David; for they couldn’t risk being seen coming into the city.

hausa: Amma Nuhu ya sami tagomashi a gaban Ubangiji.
english: But Noah found favor in Yahweh’s eyes.

hausa: Ya aikata mugunta a gaban Ubangiji bai kuwa kauce wa duk zunuban Yerobowam ɗan Nebat, wanda ya sa Isra’ila ta aikata ba.
english: He did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight. He didn’t depart from all the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, with which he made Israel to sin.

hausa: Ko da yake ni ba kome ba ne a cikin dukan mutanen Ubangiji, aka ba ni wannan baiwa mai daraja don in faɗa wa Al’ummai cewa saboda Kiristi akwai albarkun da suka wuce gaban misali.
english: To me, the very least of all saints, was this grace given, to preach to the Gentiles the unsearchable riches of Christ,

hausa: Ubangiji ya ce wa Musa,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

hausa: Ƙaunarsa marar ƙarewa ta ɓace ke nan har abada? Alkawarinsa ya kāsa ke nan a dukan lokaci?
english: Has his loving kindness vanished forever? Does his promise fail for generations?

hausa: Da oak daga Bashan suka yi sandunan tuƙan jirgin ruwa da itatuwan kasharina daga bakin tekun Saifurus suka yi daɓe jirgin ruwanki, suka kuma manne masa hauren giwa.
english: They have made your oars of the oaks of Bashan. They have made your benches of ivory inlaid in cypress wood from the islands of Kittim.

hausa: Ubangiji ya yi tsawa daga sararin sama; aka ji muryar Mafi Ɗaukaka.
english: Yahweh thundered from heaven. The Most High uttered his voice.

hausa: Ba cewa ina neman shaidar mutum ba ne; sai dai na faɗi haka ne domin ku sami ceto.
english: But the testimony which I receive is not from man. However, I say these things that you may be saved.

hausa: Sa’an nan sarki ya yi kujerar sarauta mai nauyin giram na hauren giwa, aka kuma dalaye ta da zinariya zalla.
english: Moreover the king made a great throne of ivory, and overlaid it with the finest gold.

hausa: To, Istifanus, mutum cike da alheri da ikon Allah, ya aikata manyan ayyukan da alamu masu banmamaki a cikin mutane.
english: Stephen, full of faith and power, performed great wonders and signs among the people.

hausa: Annabawanki, ya Isra’ila, suna kama da diloli a kufai.
english: Israel, your prophets have been like foxes in the waste places.

hausa: ’Ya’yan ’yar’uwarki wadda Allah ya keɓe, suna gaishe ku.
english: The children of your chosen sister greet you. Amen.

hausa: “In kuka ce, ‘Za ku ci gaba da matsa mini, tun da shi ne tushen damuwa,’
english: If you say, ‘How we will persecute him!’ because the root of the matter is found in me,

hausa: Sai Yesu ya ce, “Ku kawar da dutsen.” Marta, ’yar’uwan mamacin ta ce, “Ubangiji, yanzu, ai, zai yi wari, don yau kwanansa huɗu ke nan a can.”
english: Jesus said, “Take away the stone.” Martha, the sister of him who was dead, said to him, “Lord, by this time there is a stench, for he has been dead four days.”

hausa: Hezekiya ya huta tare da kakanninsa, aka kuma binne shi a kan tudu inda makabartan zuriyar Dawuda suke. Dukan Yahuda da kuma mutanen Urushalima suka girmama shi sa’ad da ya mutu. Sai Manasse ɗansa ya gāje shi a matsayin sarki.
english: Hezekiah slept with his fathers, and they buried him in the ascent to the tombs of the sons of David. All Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem honored him at his death. Manasseh his son reigned in his place.

hausa: ’Yan’uwanki kuwa, Sodom da ’ya’yanta mata da Samariya tare da ’ya’yanta mata, za su koma kamar yadda suke a dā; ke kuma da ’ya’yanki mata za ku koma kamar yadda kike a dā.
english: Your sisters, Sodom and her daughters, will return to their former estate; and Samaria and her daughters will return to their former estate; and you and your daughters will return to your former estate.

hausa: A kwandon na bisa, akwai kayan iri-iri da aka toya, masu kyau domin Fir’auna, amma tsuntsaye suka ci su a kwandon da yake kaina.”
english: In the uppermost basket there were all kinds of baked food for Pharaoh, and the birds ate them out of the basket on my head.”

hausa: Maganar Ubangiji ta zo mini cewa,
english: Yahweh’s word came again to me, saying,

hausa: Gama mu ma mun ji an yi mana wa’azin bishara, kamar yadda su ma suka ji; sai dai saƙon da suka ji ba tă amfane su ba, domin waɗanda suka ji ba su karɓe shi da bangaskiya ba.
english: For indeed we have had good news preached to us, even as they also did, but the word they heard didn’t profit them, because it wasn’t mixed with faith by those who heard.

hausa: Saurayin ya ce, “Yahudawa sun ƙulla za su roƙe ka ka kawo Bulus a gaban Majalisa gobe kamar suna neman ƙarin cikakken bayani game da Bulus.
english: He said, “The Jews have agreed to ask you to bring Paul down to the council tomorrow, as though intending to inquire somewhat more accurately concerning him.

hausa: Ubangiji na zaune yana sarauta a bisa rigyawa; Ubangiji yana sarauta kamar Sarki har abada.
english: Yahweh sat enthroned at the Flood. Yes, Yahweh sits as King forever.

hausa: Da manyan kwanoni kuke shan ruwan inabi kuna kuma shafa mai mafi kyau, amma ba kwa baƙin ciki game da kangon da Yusuf ya zama.
english: who drink wine in bowls, and anoint themselves with the best oils, but they are not grieved for the affliction of Joseph.

hausa: ta Ater (ta wurin Hezekiya) 98
english: The children of Ater: of Hezekiah, ninety-eight.

hausa: Kakannin-kakanninku sun ci Manna a hamada, duk da haka suka mutu.
english: Your fathers ate the manna in the wilderness and they died.

hausa: Wata rana itatuwa suka fita don su naɗa wa kansu sarki. Suka ce wa itacen zaitun, ‘Ka zama sarkinmu.’
english: The trees set out to anoint a king over themselves. They said to the olive tree, ‘Reign over us.’

hausa: Bisa ga umarnin sarki, aka yi akwati aka sa a waje, a mashigin haikalin Ubangiji.
english: So the king commanded, and they made a chest, and set it outside at the gate of Yahweh’s house.

hausa: Aka cinye mutanen Isra’ila a wannan lokaci, mutanen Yahuda kuwa suka yi nasara domin sun dogara ga Ubangiji Allah na kakanninsu.
english: Thus the children of Israel were brought under at that time, and the children of Judah prevailed, because they relied on Yahweh, the God of their fathers.

hausa: Ahishar, shi ne sarkin fada. Adoniram ɗan Abda, shi ne mai lura da aikin gandu.
english: Ahishar was over the household; and Adoniram the son of Abda was over the men subject to forced labor.

hausa: Ku Samariyawa ba ku san abin da kuke yi wa sujada ba; mu kuwa mun san abin da muke yi wa sujada, gama ceto daga Yahudawa yake.
english: You worship that which you don’t know. We worship that which we know; for salvation is from the Jews.

hausa: Sarki ya rufe fuskarsa ya yi kuka da ƙarfi yana cewa, “Ya ɗana Absalom! Ya Absalom ɗana, ɗana!”
english: The king covered his face, and the king cried with a loud voice, “My son Absalom, Absalom, my son, my son!”

hausa: Waɗannan su ne rabe-raben gādon da Eleyazar firist, Yoshuwa ɗan Nun, da kuma shugabannin kabilan iyalan Isra’ila suka rarraba ta hanyar jefa ƙuri’a a Shilo a gaban Ubangiji a ƙofar Tentin Sujada. Da haka suka yi suka gama rarraba ƙasar.
english: These are the inheritances, which Eleazar the priest, Joshua the son of Nun, and the heads of the fathers’ houses of the tribes of the children of Israel, distributed for inheritance by lot in Shiloh before Yahweh, at the door of the Tent of Meeting. So they finished dividing the land.

hausa: Za a cike kowane kwari, a baje kowane dutse da kowane tudu; za a mayar da karkatattun wurare su zama sumul, munanan wurare kuma su zama da kyau.
english: Every valley shall be exalted, and every mountain and hill shall be made low. The uneven shall be made level, and the rough places a plain.

hausa: An yi wani mutum, attajiri daga kabilar Benyamin, sunansa Kish, ɗan Abiyel, jikan Zeror na iyalin Bekorat daga dangin Afiya.
english: Now there was a man of Benjamin, whose name was Kish the son of Abiel, the son of Zeror, the son of Becorath, the son of Aphiah, the son of a Benjamite, a mighty man of valor.

hausa: Suka yi rami a gefe-gefen labulen da zaren ruwan bula, haka kuma suka yi da ɗayan gefen na biyu ɗin.
english: He made loops of blue on the edge of the one curtain from the edge in the coupling. Likewise he made in the edge of the curtain that was outermost in the second coupling.

hausa: Yahuda ya aikata mugunta a gaban Ubangiji. Ta wurin zunuban da suka yi, sun tā da fushin kishinsa fiye da yadda kakanninsu suka yi.
english: Judah did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight, and they provoked him to jealousy with their sins which they committed, above all that their fathers had done.

hausa: Dole yă sa a kankare duka shafen bangon cikin gidan a kuma zuba kayan da aka kankare a wurin marar tsarki waje da birnin.
english: He shall cause the inside of the house to be scraped all over. They shall pour out the mortar that they scraped off outside of the city into an unclean place.

hausa: Sa’an nan matar ta tafi wurin dukan mutane da shawararta mai hikima, sai suka datse kan Sheba ɗan Bikri suka jefa wa Yowab. Saboda haka sai ya busa ƙaho, mutanensa kuwa suka watse daga birnin, kowa ya koma gidansa. Yowab kuma ya koma wurin sarki a Urushalima.
english: Then the woman went to all the people in her wisdom. They cut off the head of Sheba the son of Bichri, and threw it out to Joab. He blew the trumpet, and they were dispersed from the city, every man to his tent. Then Joab returned to Jerusalem to the king.

hausa: Baba ko yaro, malami ko ɗalibi, duk suka jefa ƙuri’a saboda ayyukan da za su yi.
english: They cast lots for their offices, all alike, the small as well as the great, the teacher as well as the student.

hausa: Ban da waɗannan abubuwa, kowace rana ina ɗauke da nauyin kula da dukan ikkilisiyoyi.
english: Besides those things that are outside, there is that which presses on me daily: anxiety for all the assemblies.

hausa: Sa’ad da aka sanar da shi game da zunubin da ya yi, dole yă kawo akuya marar lahani a matsayin hadayarsa domin zunubin da ya yi.
english: if his sin which he has sinned is made known to him, then he shall bring for his offering a goat, a female without defect, for his sin which he has sinned.

hausa: dattawan garinsa za su aika a kawo shi, a dawo da shi daga birnin, a miƙa shi ga mai neman fansar jini don yă kashe shi.
english: then the elders of his city shall send and bring him there, and deliver him into the hand of the avenger of blood, that he may die.

hausa: Saboda haka suka haura, suka binciki ƙasar daga Hamadan Zin har zuwa Rehob, wajen Lebo Hamat.
english: So they went up, and spied out the land from the wilderness of Zin to Rehob, to the entrance of Hamath.

hausa: A watan Nisan a shekara ta ashirin ta mulkin Sarki Artazerzes, sa’ad aka kawo masa ruwan inabi, sai na karɓa na ba shi. Ban taɓa ɓata fuskata a gabansa ba, sai wannan karo.
english: In the month Nisan, in the twentieth year of Artaxerxes the king, when wine was before him, I picked up the wine, and gave it to the king. Now I had not been sad before in his presence.

hausa: Saboda haka ga abin da Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka yana cewa, “Bayin za su ci, amma ku za ku ji yunwa; bayina za su sha, amma ku za ku ji ƙishi; bayina za su yi farin ciki amma ku za ku sha kunya.
english: Therefore the Lord Yahweh says, “Behold, my servants will eat, but you will be hungry; behold, my servants will drink, but you will be thirsty. Behold, my servants will rejoice, but you will be disappointed.

hausa: Shallum shi ne mahaifin Yekamiya, Yekamiya kuma shi ne mahaifin Elishama.
english: and Shallum became the father of Jekamiah, and Jekamiah became the father of Elishama.

hausa: Ina dai faɗa muku, a ranan nan, za a fi jin tausayin Sodom fiye da wannan garin.
english: I tell you, it will be more tolerable in that day for Sodom than for that city.

hausa: Kashegari da sassafe mutane suka gina bagade suka miƙa hadaya ta ƙonawa da hadaya ta salama.
english: On the next day, the people rose early and built an altar there, and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings.

hausa: Sai Amaziya ya aika ’yan aika wurin Yehowash ɗan Yehoyahaz, ɗan Yehu, sarkin Isra’ila, yana tsokanarsa cewa, “Zo, mu sadu fuska da fuska.”
english: Then Amaziah sent messengers to Jehoash, the son of Jehoahaz son of Jehu, king of Israel, saying, “Come, let’s look one another in the face.”

hausa: Wane ne a cikin mutane ya san tunanin mutum, in ba ruhun mutumin da yake cikinsa ba? Haka kuma ba wanda ya san tunanin Allah, sai dai Ruhun Allah.
english: For who among men knows the things of a man except the spirit of the man which is in him? Even so, no one knows the things of God except God’s Spirit.

hausa: ta wurin wanda kuma ya tafi ya yi wa ruhohin da suke a kurkuku wa’azi
english: in whom he also went and preached to the spirits in prison,

hausa: Sai ya miƙa hannu wajen almajiransa ya ce, “Ga mahaifiyata da kuma ’yan’uwana.
english: He stretched out his hand toward his disciples, and said, “Behold, my mother and my brothers!

hausa: Sai Bitrus ya ce, “Faufau, ba za ka taɓa wanke ƙafafuna ba.” Yesu ya amsa ya ce, “Sai na wanke ka, in ba haka ba, ba ka da rabo a gare ni.”
english: Peter said to him, “You will never wash my feet!” Jesus answered him, “If I don’t wash you, you have no part with me.”

hausa: Wanda ya buge manyan sarakuna, Ƙaunarsa madawwamiya ce.
english: to him who struck great kings, for his loving kindness endures forever;

hausa: Duk wanda ya kawo wahala wa iyalinsa zai gāji iska kawai, kuma wawa zai zama bawan masu hikima.
english: He who troubles his own house shall inherit the wind. The foolish shall be servant to the wise of heart.

hausa: Sa’ad da kuka bi ta ruwaye, zan kasance tare da ku; sa’ad da kuka bi ta koguna, ba za su kwashe ku ba. Sa’ad da kuke tafiyata cikin wuta, ba za tă ƙone ku ba; harsunan wutar ba za su ƙone ku ba.
english: When you pass through the waters, I will be with you, and through the rivers, they will not overflow you. When you walk through the fire, you will not be burned, and flame will not scorch you.

hausa: In ta ƙazantar da kanta ta kuma ci amanar mijinta, to, yayinda aka sa tă sha ruwa mai jawo la’ana, ruwan zai shiga cikinta, yă jawo mata wahala mai zafi; cikinta zai kumbura, cinyarta kuma yă shanye, tă kuwa zama la’ananniya a cikin mutanenta.
english: When he has made her drink the water, then it shall happen, if she is defiled and has committed a trespass against her husband, that the water that causes the curse will enter into her and become bitter, and her body will swell, and her thigh will fall away; and the woman will be a curse among her people.

hausa: Gama ba abin da zai gagari Allah.”
english: For nothing spoken by God is impossible.”

hausa: “ ‘Kaitonki, Korazin! Kaitonki, Betsaida!’ Ai, da a ce a Taya da Sidon ne aka yi ayyukan banmamaki da aka yi a cikinku, da tuni sun tuba, suna zama cikin rigar makoki da toka.
english: “Woe to you, Chorazin! Woe to you, Bethsaida! For if the mighty works had been done in Tyre and Sidon which were done in you, they would have repented long ago, sitting in sackcloth and ashes.

hausa: Ba wanda ya yi karambanin shiga cikinsu, duk da haka mutane suna girmama su ƙwarai.
english: None of the rest dared to join them; however, the people honored them.

hausa: “Yanzu fa, bari ranka yă daɗe, yă aiko wa bayinsa alkama da sha’ir da kuma man zaitun da ruwan inabin da ka alkawarta,
english: “Now therefore, the wheat, the barley, the oil, and the wine which my lord has spoken of, let him send to his servants;

hausa: Duk da haka kana kusa, ya Ubangiji, kuma dukan umarnanka gaskiya ne.
english: You are near, Yahweh. All your commandments are truth.

hausa: Biye da shi, Meremot ɗan Uriya, ɗan Hakkoz, ya yi gyaran wani sashe, daga mashigin gidan Eliyashib zuwa ƙarshensa.
english: After him, Meremoth the son of Uriah the son of Hakkoz repaired another portion, from the door of the house of Eliashib even to the end of the house of Eliashib.

hausa: A shekara ta goma sha ɗaya, a wata na fari a rana ta goma sha bakwai, maganar Ubangiji ta zo mini cewa,
english: In the eleventh year, in the first month, in the seventh day of the month, Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

hausa: “Kai ne za ka ɗauki nauyin lura da wuri mai tsarki da bagade, domin kada fushi yă sāke fāɗa a kan Isra’ilawa.
english: “You shall perform the duty of the sanctuary and the duty of the altar, that there be no more wrath on the children of Israel.

hausa: Ba sun kwanta tare da sauran jarumawa marasa kaciyan da aka kashe, waɗanda suka gangara kabari tare da makaman yaƙinsu, waɗanda aka yi musu matashin kai da takubansu ba? Hukuncin zunubansu yana a bisa ƙasusuwansu, ko da yake tsoron waɗannan jarumawa ya manne cikin ƙasar masu rai.
english: They will not lie with the mighty who are fallen of the uncircumcised, who have gone down to Sheol with their weapons of war and have laid their swords under their heads. Their iniquities are on their bones; for they were the terror of the mighty in the land of the living.

hausa: Ka ce, “Na yi alkawari da zaɓaɓɓena, na rantse wa Dawuda bawana,
english: “I have made a covenant with my chosen one, I have sworn to David, my servant,

hausa: Na shida, don wata na shida, shi ne Ira ɗan Ikkesh mutumin Tekowa. Akwai mutane 24,000 a sashensa.
english: The sixth captain for the sixth month was Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite. In his division were twenty-four thousand.

hausa: kowa zai sha kunya saboda mutanen da ba su da amfani gare su, waɗanda ba sa taimako ko amfani, sai dai jawo kunya da da-na-sani.”
english: They shall all be ashamed because of a people that can’t profit them, that are not a help nor profit, but a shame, and also a reproach.”

hausa: Daga cikin birnin kuma ya ɗauki shugaban sojojin, da mutum bakwai ’yan majalisar sarki, da magatakardan shugaban sojojin wanda yakan tara sojojin ƙasar, da mutane sittin na ƙasar, waɗanda aka same su a birnin, ya tafi da su.
english: and out of the city he took an officer who was set over the men of war; and seven men of those who saw the king’s face, who were found in the city; and the scribe of the captain of the army, who mustered the people of the land; and sixty men of the people of the land, who were found in the middle of the city.

hausa: “Zan watsar da ku kamar yayin da iskar hamada take hurawa.
english: “Therefore I will scatter them as the stubble that passes away by the wind of the wilderness.

hausa: Suka yi katakai ashirin don gefen kudu na tabanakul
english: He made the boards for the tabernacle, twenty boards for the south side southward.

hausa: Mai yiwuwa ku ce, “Me za mu ci a shekara ta bakwai in ba mu yi shuki ko girbin hatsinmu ba?”
english: If you said, “What shall we eat the seventh year? Behold, we shall not sow, nor gather in our increase;”

hausa: Yana buɗe abubuwan da suke cikin duhu yă kuma kawo haske a wuraren da ba haske;
english: He uncovers deep things out of darkness, and brings out to light the shadow of death.

hausa: Saboda haka ka ba bawanka zuciyar ganewa, don yă shugabanci mutanenka, yă kuma iya rarrabe tsakanin abin da yake daidai da abin da ba daidai ba. Gama wa zai iya shugabance wannan mutanenka masu girma haka?”
english: Give your servant therefore an understanding heart to judge your people, that I may discern between good and evil; for who is able to judge this great people of yours?”

hausa: Sa’an nan Yaƙub ya ci gaba da tafiyarsa har ya kai ƙasar mutanen gabashi.
english: Then Jacob went on his journey, and came to the land of the children of the east.

hausa: Cikin fushinsa a kan Isra’ila Ubangiji ya ba da su ga hannun waɗanda suka kawo musu hari suka washe su. Ya sayar da su ga abokan gābansu da suke kewaye da su, waɗanda ba za su iya yin tsayayya da su ba.
english: Yahweh’s anger burned against Israel, and he delivered them into the hands of raiders who plundered them. He sold them into the hands of their enemies all around, so that they could no longer stand before their enemies.

hausa: Gama ba ku kai wurin hutawa wanda Ubangiji Allahnku zai ba ku gādo ba tukuna.
english: for you haven’t yet come to the rest and to the inheritance which Yahweh your God gives you.

hausa: A nan naƙasassu da yawa sukan kwanta, makafi, guragu, shanyayyu.
english: In these lay a great multitude of those who were sick, blind, lame, or paralyzed, waiting for the moving of the water;

hausa: Zabad da Shutela. Wani ɗan ƙasa haifaffen mutanen Gat ya kashe Ezer da Elad, sa’ad da suka gangara don su ƙwace dabbobinsu.
english: Zabad his son, Shuthelah his son, Ezer, and Elead, whom the men of Gath who were born in the land killed, because they came down to take away their livestock.

hausa: Mun ji cewa, waɗansu da sun fita daga cikinmu ba tare da izininmu ba suka kuma dame ku, suna tā da hankalinku ta wurin abin da suka ce.
english: Because we have heard that some who went out from us have troubled you with words, unsettling your souls, saying, ‘You must be circumcised and keep the law,’ to whom we gave no commandment;

hausa: In kuma ya dace in tafi, to, sai su tafi tare da ni.
english: If it is appropriate for me to go also, they will go with me.

hausa: Waɗannan su ne kabilan Simeyon; jimillarsu ta kai 22,200.
english: These are the families of the Simeonites, twenty-two thousand two hundred.

hausa: Sai Bitrus ya amsa ya ce, “Ubangiji in kai ne ka ce mini in zo wurinka a kan ruwan.”
english: Peter answered him and said, “Lord, if it is you, command me to come to you on the waters.”

hausa: Duba, ranar Ubangiji tana zuwa, muguwar rana, mai hasala da zafin fushi, don ta mai da ƙasar kango ta kuma hallakar da masu zunubi da suke cikinta.
english: Behold, the day of Yahweh comes, cruel, with wrath and fierce anger; to make the land a desolation, and to destroy its sinners out of it.

hausa: Dole a rushe gidan, a fid da duwatsun, katakai da kuma dukan shafen daga birnin zuwa wuri marar tsarki.
english: He shall break down the house, its stones, and its timber, and all the house’s mortar. He shall carry them out of the city into an unclean place.

hausa: Da yaron ya tafi, sai Dawuda ya tashi daga inda ya ɓuya kusa da tarin duwatsu, ya rusuna har sau uku. Sa’an nan suka sumbaci juna, suka yi kuka, Dawuda kuwa ya yi kuka sosai.
english: As soon as the boy was gone, David arose out of the south, and fell on his face to the ground, and bowed himself three times. They kissed one another and wept with one another, and David wept the most.

hausa: Haka Asher ma bai kori waɗanda suke zama a Akko ko Sidon ko Ahlab ko Akzib ko Helba ko Afik ko kuma Rehob ba,
english: Asher didn’t drive out the inhabitants of Acco, nor the inhabitants of Sidon, nor of Ahlab, nor of Achzib, nor of Helbah, nor of Aphik, nor of Rehob;

hausa: Sai suka yi masa dariya. Bayan ya fitar da su duk waje, sai ya ɗauki mahaifin da mahaifiyar yarinyar tare da almajiran da suke tare da shi, suka shiga inda yarinyar take.
english: They ridiculed him. But he, having put them all out, took the father of the child, her mother, and those who were with him, and went in where the child was lying.

hausa: A rana ta bakwai firist zai bincike ƙaiƙayin, idan bai bazu a fatar jikin ba, bai kuma yi zurfin fiye da fatar jikin ba, firist ɗin zai furta shi tsarkakakke. Dole kuma yă wanke rigunansa, zai kuwa zama tsarkakakke.
english: On the seventh day, the priest shall examine the itch; and behold, if the itch hasn’t spread in the skin, and its appearance isn’t deeper than the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him clean. He shall wash his clothes and be clean.

hausa: Amma da Hiridus ya ji haka, sai ya ce, “Ai, Yohanna ne, mutumin da na yanke masa kai, shi ne ya tashi daga matattu!”
english: But Herod, when he heard this, said, “This is John, whom I beheaded. He has risen from the dead.”

hausa: amma kada ka ci daga itacen sanin abin da yake mai kyau da abin da yake mugu, gama a ranar da ka ci shi, lalle za ka mutu.”
english: but you shall not eat of the tree of the knowledge of good and evil; for in the day that you eat of it, you will surely die.”

hausa: Ka kuma sa Urim da Tummim a ƙyallen maƙalawa a ƙirji, don su kasance a zuciyar Haruna, a duk sa’ad da zai shiga gaban Ubangiji. Haka kuwa kullum Haruna zai riƙa kai koke-koken Isra’ilawa a gaban Ubangiji.
english: You shall put in the breastplate of judgment the Urim and the Thummim; and they shall be on Aaron’s heart, when he goes in before Yahweh. Aaron shall bear the judgment of the children of Israel on his heart before Yahweh continually.

hausa: Gaskiyar cewa Allah ya tā da shi daga matattu, a kan ba zai taɓa ruɓewa ba, an faɗe shi a cikin waɗannan kalmomi. “ ‘Zan ba ku tsarki da kuma tabbatattun albarkun da na yi wa Dawuda alkawari.’
english: “Concerning that he raised him up from the dead, now no more to return to corruption, he has spoken thus: ‘I will give you the holy and sure blessings of David.’

hausa: Wata rana na tafi gidan Shemahiya ɗan Delahiya, ɗan Mehetabel, wanda aka hana fita a gidansa. Ya ce mini, “Mu sadu gobe a gidan Allah, a cikin haikali, mu kuma kulle ƙofofin haikali, gama mutane suna zuwa su kashe ka, tabbatacce za su zo da dare su kashe ka.”
english: I went to the house of Shemaiah the son of Delaiah the son of Mehetabel, who was shut in at his home; and he said, “Let us meet together in God’s house, within the temple, and let’s shut the doors of the temple; for they will come to kill you. Yes, in the night they will come to kill you.”

hausa: Saboda haka suka kira Rebeka suka ce mata, “Za ki tafi tare da mutumin nan?” Sai ta ce, “Zan tafi.”
english: They called Rebekah, and said to her, “Will you go with this man?” She said, “I will go.”

hausa: Ku guji fasikanci. Duk sauran zunubai da mutum yakan aikata suna waje da jikinsa, amma mai yin fasikanci, yana ɗaukar alhalin jikinsa ne.
english: Flee sexual immorality! “Every sin that a man does is outside the body,” but he who commits sexual immorality sins against his own body.

hausa: “Yanzu raina yana ƙarewa; kwanakin wahala sun kama ni.
english: “Now my soul is poured out within me. Days of affliction have taken hold of me.

hausa: Ɗan Mutum zai tafi kamar yadda aka rubuta game da shi. Amma kaiton mutumin da zai bashe Ɗan Mutum! Da ma ba a haifi mutumin nan ba, da ya fi masa.”
english: The Son of Man goes even as it is written of him, but woe to that man through whom the Son of Man is betrayed! It would be better for that man if he had not been born.”

hausa: Gwamna ya karanta wasiƙar ya kuma tambaya ko daga wanda lardi ne ya fito. Da ya ji cewa shi daga Silisiya ne,
english: When the governor had read it, he asked what province he was from. When he understood that he was from Cilicia, he said,

hausa: Zai ɗibiya hannunsa a kanta yă kuma yanka ta a gaban Tentin Sujada. Sa’an nan ’ya’yan Haruna maza za su yayyafa jininta a kowane gefe na bagade.
english: He shall lay his hand on its head, and kill it before the Tent of Meeting; and the sons of Aaron shall sprinkle its blood around on the altar.

hausa: Yanzu, in kuka yi mini cikakken biyayya, kuka kuma kiyaye yarjejjeniyata, to, za ku zama keɓeɓɓiyar taska a gare ni a cikin dukan al’ummai. Ko da yake duk duniya tawa ce,
english: Now therefore, if you will indeed obey my voice and keep my covenant, then you shall be my own possession from among all peoples; for all the earth is mine;

hausa: Wane ne kuwa kama da ni? Ya faɗa a ji. Bari yă yi shela ya kuma nuna shi a gabana mene ne ya faru tun da na kafa mutanena na dā, mene ne kuma bai riga ya faru ba, I, bari yă faɗa abin da zai zo.
english: Who is like me? Who will call, and will declare it, and set it in order for me, since I established the ancient people? Let them declare the things that are coming, and that will happen.

hausa: Sai Shawulu ya kawo kayan yaƙinsa ya sa wa Dawuda. Ya sa masa hular kwanon da aka yi da tagulla a kansa, ya kuma sa masa rigar ƙarfensa.
english: Saul dressed David with his clothing. He put a helmet of bronze on his head, and he clad him with a coat of mail.

hausa: A shekara ta goma sha biyu ta zaman bautanmu, a wata na goma a rana ta biyar, wani mutumin da ya gudu daga Urushalima ya zo wurina ya ce, “Birnin ya fāɗi!”
english: In the twelfth year of our captivity, in the tenth month, in the fifth day of the month, one who had escaped out of Jerusalem came to me, saying, “The city has been defeated!”

hausa: “Finehas ɗan Eleyazar, ɗan Haruna, firist, ya kawar da fushina daga Isra’ilawa; saboda ya yi kishi irin nawa a gabansu, don haka saboda ɗaukakata ban kawo ƙarshensu ba.
english: “Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest, has turned my wrath away from the children of Israel, in that he was jealous with my jealousy among them, so that I didn’t consume the children of Israel in my jealousy.

hausa: A rana ta goma sha biyu ga watan farko, muka tashi daga bakin rafin Ahawa don mu tafi Urushalima. Alherin Allahnmu yana tare da mu, ya kuma kāre mu daga magabta da ’yan fashi.
english: Then we departed from the river Ahava on the twelfth day of the first month, to go to Jerusalem. The hand of our God was on us, and he delivered us from the hand of the enemy and the bandits by the way.

hausa: Da matar ta zo wurin Shawulu, ta ga shi a firgice, sai ta ce masa, “Duba baranyarka ta yi maka biyayya ta yi kasai da ranta, ta yi abin da ka ce ta yi.
english: The woman came to Saul and saw that he was very troubled, and said to him, “Behold, your servant has listened to your voice, and I have put my life in my hand, and have listened to your words which you spoke to me.

hausa: Namijin da ya fi shekara sittin, za a biya azurfa goma sha biyar, mace kuma azurfa goma.
english: If the person is from sixty years old and upward; if he is a male, then your valuation shall be fifteen shekels, and for a female ten shekels.

hausa: Firist zai fita waje da sansani ya bincike shi. In mutumin ya warke daga cutar fatar jiki mai yaɗuwa,
english: and the priest shall go out of the camp. The priest shall examine him. Behold, if the plague of leprosy is healed in the leper,

hausa: Sa’an nan ya kwanta a ƙarƙashin itacen ya yi barci. Farat ɗaya sai wani mala’ika ya taɓa shi, ya ce, “Tashi ka ci abinci.”
english: He lay down and slept under a juniper tree; and behold, an angel touched him, and said to him, “Arise and eat!”

hausa: Amma da zarar na yi ihu neman taimako, sai ya bar rigarsa kusa da ni, ya gudu ya fita daga gida.”
english: and as I lifted up my voice and cried, he left his garment by me, and ran outside.”

hausa: Don haka dole ku yi tafiya a hanyoyin mutanen kirki ku kuma yi ta bi hanyoyin adalai.
english: Therefore walk in the way of good men, and keep the paths of the righteous.

hausa: “Ga abin da Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka yana cewa, ‘Domin Edom ya ɗauki wa kanta fansa a kan gida Yahuda, ta yi babban laifi ta wurin yin haka,
english: “‘The Lord Yahweh says: “Because Edom has dealt against the house of Judah by taking vengeance, and has greatly offended, and taken revenge on them,”

hausa: A cikin kwana uku duk mutanen Yahuda da na Benyamin suka taru a Urushalima. A ranar ashirin ga watan tara, dukan mutanen suka zauna a dandali a gaban gidan Allah cike da ɓacin rai saboda abin da ya faru da kuma ruwan da aka yi.
english: Then all the men of Judah and Benjamin gathered themselves together to Jerusalem within the three days. It was the ninth month, on the twentieth day of the month; and all the people sat in the wide place in front of God’s house, trembling because of this matter, and because of the great rain.

hausa: Saboda haka zaki daga kurmi zai fāɗa musu, kyarkeci kuma daga hamada zai cinye su, damisa za tă yi musu ƙawanya kusa da garuruwansu yă yayyage duk wanda ya kuskura ya fita, gama tawayensu da girma yake jan bayansu kuma yana da yawa.
english: Therefore a lion out of the forest will kill them. A wolf of the evenings will destroy them. A leopard will watch against their cities. Everyone who goes out there will be torn in pieces, because their transgressions are many and their backsliding has increased.

hausa: An yi sandunansa da azurfa, aka yi ƙasarsa da zinariya. An lulluɓe wurin zaman da zanen shunayya, ’yan matan Urushalima sun yi mata irin yayen da ake yi na ƙauna.
english: He made its pillars of silver, its bottom of gold, its seat of purple, the middle of it being paved with love, from the daughters of Jerusalem.

hausa: Ya fid da baƙin alloli, ya kuma fid da siffofi daga haikalin Ubangiji, haka ma dukan bagadan da ya gina a kan tudun haikali da kuma cikin Urushalima, ya zubar da su a bayan birni.
english: He took away the foreign gods and the idol out of Yahweh’s house, and all the altars that he had built in the mountain of Yahweh’s house and in Jerusalem, and cast them out of the city.

hausa: Suka ce, “Mun yarda, za mu dai daure ka mu ba da kai gare su. Ba za mu kashe ka ba.” Saboda haka suka daure shi da sababbin igiyoyi biyu, suka saukar da shi daga dutsen.
english: They spoke to him, saying, “No, but we will bind you securely and deliver you into their hands; but surely we will not kill you.” They bound him with two new ropes, and brought him up from the rock.

hausa: ta ce wa bawan, “Wane ne mutumin can a fili, da yake zuwa yă tarye mu?” Bawan ya ce, “Maigidana ne.” Saboda haka ta ɗauki mayafinta to rufe kanta.
english: She said to the servant, “Who is the man who is walking in the field to meet us?” The servant said, “It is my master.” She took her veil, and covered herself.

hausa: Bari mu ɗauko akwatin alkawarin Allahnmu mu kawo wurinmu, gama ba mu neme shi a lokacin mulkin Shawulu ba.”
english: Also, let’s bring the ark of our God back to us again, for we didn’t seek it in the days of Saul.”

hausa: “Bari dukan waɗanda suke marasa azanci su zo cikin nan!” Tana ce wa marasa hankali.
english: “Whoever is simple, let him turn in here.” As for him who is void of understanding, she says to him,

hausa: Suka tashi daga Dibon Gad, suka yi sansani a Almon Dibilatayim.
english: They traveled from Dibon Gad, and encamped in Almon Diblathaim.

hausa: sai in yanke mutanen Isra’ila daga ƙasar da na ba su, in kuma ƙi wannan haikalin da na tsarkake domin Sunana. Isra’ila kuwa za tă zama abin gori da abin dariya a cikin dukan mutane.
english: then I will cut off Israel out of the land which I have given them; and I will cast this house, which I have made holy for my name, out of my sight; and Israel will be a proverb and a byword among all peoples.

hausa: Ya ba wa ɗansa na biyu suna Efraim ya ce, “Gama Allah ya wadata ni cikin wahalata.”
english: The name of the second, he called Ephraim: “For God has made me fruitful in the land of my affliction.”

hausa: Gama mun tsaya a kan cewa ta wurin bangaskiya ne ake kuɓutar da mutum, ba ta wurin kiyaye doka ba.
english: We maintain therefore that a man is justified by faith apart from the works of the law.

hausa: Zinariyarku da azurfarku sun yi tsatsa. Tsatsarsu kuwa za tă zama shaida a kanku, ta kuma ci namar jikinku kamar wuta. Kun ɓoye dukiya a kwanakin ƙarshe.
english: Your gold and your silver are corroded, and their corrosion will be for a testimony against you and will eat your flesh like fire. You have laid up your treasure in the last days.

hausa: Fushin Ubangiji kuwa ya yi ƙuna a kan Isra’ila har ya sayar da su ga Kushan-Rishatayim sarkin Aram-Naharayim, a wurinsa ne Isra’ilawa suka zama bayi shekara takwas.
english: Therefore Yahweh’s anger burned against Israel, and he sold them into the hand of Cushan Rishathaim king of Mesopotamia; and the children of Israel served Cushan Rishathaim eight years.

hausa: Ka ji muryata sa’ad da na yi kira, ya Ubangiji; ka yi mini jinƙai ka kuma amsa mini.
english: Hear, Yahweh, when I cry with my voice. Have mercy also on me, and answer me.

hausa: Da zarar ka ji motsin takawa a sama itatuwan tsamiya, ka fita don yaƙi, domin wannan zai nuna cewa Allah ya fita a gabanka don yă bugi mayaƙan Filistiyawa.”
english: When you hear the sound of marching in the tops of the mulberry trees, then go out to battle; for God has gone out before you to strike the army of the Philistines.”

hausa: In ba ayyukan da Ubana yake yi ne nake yi ba, to, kada ku gaskata ni.
english: If I don’t do the works of my Father, don’t believe me.

hausa: Sai Laban ya yi tambaya, “Me zan ba ka?” Yaƙub ya amsa ya ce, “Kada ka ba ni wani abu. Amma in za ka yi mini abu guda ɗaya, zan ci gaba da kiwon garkunanka, ina kuma lura da su.
english: Laban said, “What shall I give you?” Jacob said, “You shall not give me anything. If you will do this thing for me, I will again feed your flock and keep it.

hausa: Sihiyona ta ji ta kuma yi farin ciki kuma dukan ƙauyukan Yahuda suna murna saboda hukunce-hukuncenka, ya Ubangiji.
english: Zion heard and was glad. The daughters of Judah rejoiced because of your judgments, Yahweh.

hausa: Haka birnin ta kasance a kewaye har shekara ta goma sha ɗaya ta mulkin Zedekiya.
english: So the city was besieged until the eleventh year of King Zedekiah.

hausa: “Ba amfani! Ba amfani!” In ji Malami, “Gaba ɗaya ba amfani!”
english: “Vanity of vanities,” says the Preacher. “All is vanity!”

hausa: amma dai rafuffuka suna ɓullo da ruwa daga ƙasa suna jiƙe ko’ina a fāɗin ƙasa.
english: but a mist went up from the earth, and watered the whole surface of the ground.

hausa: Mutane da suke gaba suka kwaɓe shi, suka ce masa ya yi shiru. Amma sai ya ƙara ɗaga murya, yana cewa, “Ɗan Dawuda, ka yi mini jinƙai!”
english: Those who led the way rebuked him, that he should be quiet; but he cried out all the more, “You son of David, have mercy on me!”

hausa: Gama sa’ad da wani ya ce, “Ni na Bulus ne,” wani kuma ya ce, “Ni na Afollos ne,” ba rayuwa irin ta mutane ke nan kuke yi ba?
english: For when one says, “I follow Paul,” and another, “I follow Apollos,” aren’t you fleshly?

hausa: Benahiya ɗan Yehohiyada shi ma wani barden yaƙi ne daga Kabzeyel, wanda ya yi manyan abubuwa. Ya bugi gwanayen Mowab biyu. Ya kuma gangara zuwa cikin rami a ranar da aka yi dusar ƙanƙara ya kashe zaki.
english: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, the son of a valiant man of Kabzeel, who had done mighty deeds, killed the two sons of Ariel of Moab. He also went down and killed a lion in the middle of a pit on a snowy day.

hausa: don kada ku ba da ƙarfi mafi kyau ga waɗansu da kuma shekarunku ga wani marar imani,
english: lest you give your honor to others, and your years to the cruel one;

hausa: Na nemi fuskarka da dukan zuciyata; ka yi mini alheri bisa ga alkawarinka.
english: I sought your favor with my whole heart. Be merciful to me according to your word.

hausa: Ba zan ƙara sa Isra’ilawa su fita daga ƙasar da na ba kakanninsu ba, idan dai za su kula su aikata dukan abin da na umarce su, su kuma kiyaye dukan dokokin da na ba wa bawana Musa yă umarce su.”
english: I will not cause the feet of Israel to wander any more out of the land which I gave their fathers, if only they will observe to do according to all that I have commanded them, and according to all the law that my servant Moses commanded them.”
