hausa: Ka yi mini gyara, Ubangiji, amma fa da adalci kaɗai ba cikin fushinka ba, don kada ka wofinta ni.
english: Yahweh, correct me, but gently; not in your anger, lest you reduce me to nothing.

hausa: ka ji ni ka kuma amsa mini. Tunanina yana damuna na kuma gaji tilis
english: Attend to me, and answer me. I am restless in my complaint, and moan

hausa: Kuma a wannan rana zai busa ƙaho mai kāra sosai. Waɗanda suke mutuwa a Assuriya da kuma waɗanda aka kai zaman bauta a Masar za su zo su kuma yi wa Ubangiji sujada a dutse mai tsarki a Urushalima.
english: It will happen in that day that a great trumpet will be blown; and those who were ready to perish in the land of Assyria, and those who were outcasts in the land of Egypt, shall come; and they will worship Yahweh in the holy mountain at Jerusalem.

hausa: Yabi Ubangiji. Ku rera sabuwar waƙa ga Ubangiji, yabonsa a cikin taron tsarkaka.
english: Praise Yahweh! Sing to Yahweh a new song, his praise in the assembly of the saints.

hausa: “Duk wanda ya fi ƙaunar mahaifinsa ko mahaifiyarsa fiye da ni, bai dace yă zama nawa ba; duk kuwa wanda yake ƙaunar ɗansa ko diyarsa fiye da ni, bai dace yă zama nawa ba;
english: He who loves father or mother more than me is not worthy of me; and he who loves son or daughter more than me isn’t worthy of me.

hausa: gama a rubuce yake cewa, “Ku zama masu tsarki, domin ni mai tsarki ne.”
english: because it is written, “You shall be holy, for I am holy.”

hausa: Fiye da kome, ku ƙaunaci juna sosai, domin ƙauna tana rufe zunubai masu ɗumbun yawa.
english: And above all things be earnest in your love among yourselves, for love covers a multitude of sins.

hausa: Sa’ad da mai ruɓan nan ya maye marar ruɓan nan, mai mutuwa kuma ya maye marar mutuwan nan, sa’an nan ne karin maganar da yake a rubuce zai zama gaskiya cewa, “An haɗiye mutuwa cikin nasara.”
english: But when this perishable body will have become imperishable, and this mortal will have put on immortality, then what is written will happen: “Death is swallowed up in victory.”

hausa: Ɗana, ka kula da abin da nake faɗa, ka saurara sosai ga kalmomina.
english: My son, attend to my words. Turn your ear to my sayings.

hausa: Na umarce ku a lokacin na ce, “Ubangiji Allahnku ya ba ku wannan ƙasa ku mallake ta. Dukan mayaƙanku za su haye da shirin yaƙi a gaban ’yan’uwanku, Isra’ilawa.
english: I commanded you at that time, saying, “Yahweh your God has given you this land to possess it. All of you men of valor shall pass over armed before your brothers, the children of Israel.

hausa: Saboda haka Ubangiji, Ubangiji Maɗaukaki, Mai Iko nan na Isra’ila, ya furta, “Kai, zan sami hutu daga maƙiyana in kuma yi ramuwa a kan abokan gābana.
english: Therefore the Lord, Yahweh of Armies, the Mighty One of Israel, says: “Ah, I will get relief from my adversaries, and avenge myself on my enemies.

hausa: mutanen Yahuda kuwa suka tā da kirarin yaƙi. Da ji kirarin yaƙi, Allah ya fatattake Yerobowam da dukan Isra’ila a gaban Abiya da Yahuda.
english: Then the men of Judah gave a shout. As the men of Judah shouted, God struck Jeroboam and all Israel before Abijah and Judah.

hausa: A kuma kawo rabin garwan ruwan inabi na hadaya ta sha. Za tă zama hadayar da aka yi da wuta mai daɗin ƙanshi ga Ubangiji.
english: and you shall offer for the drink offering half a hin of wine, for an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to Yahweh.

hausa: “Nuna mini, ya Ubangiji, ƙarshen rayuwata da kuma yawan kwanakina; bari in san yadda rayuwata tana wucewa da sauri.
english: “Yahweh, show me my end, what is the measure of my days. Let me know how frail I am.

hausa: Ubangiji shi ne Allah ya kuma sa haskensa ya haskaka a kanmu. Da kwanoni a hannunmu, muka shiga jerin gwanon biki ku kai su ƙahoni na bagade.
english: Yahweh is God, and he has given us light. Bind the sacrifice with cords, even to the horns of the altar.

hausa: Saboda haka zan hau kansu kamar zaki, zan ɓuya a bakin hanya kamar damisa.
english: Therefore I am like a lion to them. Like a leopard, I will lurk by the path.

hausa: Suna lallube cikin duhu ba haske; yă sa su yi ta tangaɗi kamar bugaggu.
english: They grope in the dark without light. He makes them stagger like a drunken man.

hausa: har Ubangiji ya kawar da su daga gabansa, kamar yadda ya gargaɗe su ta bakin bayinsa annabawa. Saboda haka aka kwashi mutanen Isra’ila daga ƙasarsu zuwa bauta a Assuriya, har wa yau kuwa suna can.
english: until Yahweh removed Israel out of his sight, as he said by all his servants the prophets. So Israel was carried away out of their own land to Assyria to this day.

hausa: Daga Benyamin, Eliyada, jarumi soja, yana da sojoji 200,000 riƙe da baka da garkuwoyi;
english: From Benjamin: Eliada, a mighty man of valor, and with him two hundred thousand armed with bow and shield;

hausa: A ƙafafunta ya fāɗi, ya fāɗi; a can ya kwanta. A ƙafafunta ya fāɗi, ya fāɗi; a can ya fāɗi, matacce.
english: At her feet he bowed, he fell, he lay. At her feet he bowed, he fell. Where he bowed, there he fell down dead.

hausa: Shugaban ya amsa, “Ita ce mutuniyar Mowab da ta zo daga Mowab tare da Na’omi.
english: The servant who was set over the reapers answered, “It is the Moabite lady who came back with Naomi out of the country of Moab.

hausa: na biyu shi ne Kileyab, ɗan Abigiyel gwauruwar Nabal mutumin Karmel; na uku shi ne Absalom, ɗan Ma’aka ’yar Talmai sarkin Geshur;
english: and his second, Chileab, of Abigail the wife of Nabal the Carmelite; and the third, Absalom the son of Maacah the daughter of Talmai king of Geshur;

hausa: Yanzu ka gudu domin kana marmari komawa gidan mahaifinka. Amma don me ka sace mini gumakana?”
english: Now, you want to be gone, because you greatly longed for your father’s house, but why have you stolen my gods?”

hausa: Zuciya mai la’akari kan nemi sani, amma bakin wawa wauta ce ke ciyar da shi.
english: The heart of one who has understanding seeks knowledge, but the mouths of fools feed on folly.

hausa: to, sai ku sa farin cikina yă zama cikakke ta wurin kasance da hali ɗaya, kuna ƙauna ɗaya, kuna zama ɗaya cikin ruhu da kuma manufa.
english: make my joy full by being like-minded, having the same love, being of one accord, of one mind;

hausa: Kada ka yi abokantaka da mai zafin rai, kada ka haɗa kai da wanda ba shi da wuya ya yi fushi,
english: Don’t befriend a hot-tempered man. Don’t associate with one who harbors anger,

hausa: Gama in kuwa, sa’ad da muke abokan gāban Allah, aka sulhunta mu da shi ta wurin mutuwar Ɗansa, ashe, da yake an sulhunta mu, za mu sami ceto ta wurin ransa!
english: For if while we were enemies, we were reconciled to God through the death of his Son, much more, being reconciled, we will be saved by his life.

hausa: Ƙasar Yahuda kuma za kawo fargaba ga Masarawa; kowanne da Yahuda ya ambace zai firgita, saboda abin da Ubangiji Maɗaukaki yake shiri a kansu.
english: The land of Judah will become a terror to Egypt. Everyone to whom mention is made of it will be afraid, because of the plans of Yahweh of Armies, which he determines against it.

hausa: Sai Dawuda ya aiki manzanni zuwa wurin Ish-Boshet ɗan Shawulu cewa, “Ka ba ni matata Mikal wadda na biya sadakinta da loɓa ɗari na Filistiyawa.”
english: David sent messengers to Ishbosheth, Saul’s son, saying, “Deliver me my wife Michal, whom I was given to marry for one hundred foreskins of the Philistines.”

hausa: Jin daɗinsa ba ya a ƙarfin doki, balle farin cikinsa yă kasance a ƙafafun mutum;
english: He doesn’t delight in the strength of the horse. He takes no pleasure in the legs of a man.

hausa: “Bari Ruben yă rayu, kada yă mutu, kada mutanensa su zama kaɗan.”
english: “Let Reuben live, and not die; Nor let his men be few.”

hausa: Sai sarki ya mutu, aka kuwa kawo shi Samariya, aka binne shi a can.
english: So the king died, and was brought to Samaria; and they buried the king in Samaria.

hausa: “ ‘Yanzu ƙazantarki ita ce lalaci. Domin na yi ƙoƙari in tsabtacce ke amma ba ki tsabtattu daga ƙazantarki ba, ba za ki ƙara yin tsabta ba sai hasalata a kanki ya kwanta.
english: “‘“In your filthiness is lewdness. Because I have cleansed you and you weren’t cleansed, you won’t be cleansed from your filthiness any more, until I have caused my wrath toward you to rest.

hausa: Ke mafiya kyau a cikin mata, in ba ki sani ba, to, ki dai bi labin da tumaki suke bi ki yi kiwon ’yan awakinki kusa da tentunan makiyaya.
english: If you don’t know, most beautiful among women, follow the tracks of the sheep. Graze your young goats beside the shepherds’ tents.

hausa: Sarki yakan yi murna a kan bawa mai hikima, amma bawa marar kunya kan jawo fushinsa.
english: The king’s favor is toward a servant who deals wisely, but his wrath is toward one who causes shame.

hausa: To, ana nan sai waɗansu karuwai biyu suka zo wurin sarki, suka tsaya a gabansa.
english: Then two women who were prostitutes came to the king, and stood before him.

hausa: Gama masu mulki ba abin tsoro ba ne ga waɗanda suke yin abin da yake daidai, sai dai ga waɗanda suke aikata laifi. Kana so ka rabu da jin tsoron wanda yake mulki? To, sai ka aikata abin da yake daidai, zai kuwa yabe ka.
english: For rulers are not a terror to the good work, but to the evil. Do you desire to have no fear of the authority? Do that which is good, and you will have praise from the authority,

hausa: Amma waɗansu ’yan iska suka ce, “Yaya wannan mutum zai iya cetonmu?” Suka rena shi suka ƙi su kawo masa kyautai. Amma Shawulu bai ce uffam ba.
english: But certain worthless fellows said, “How could this man save us?” They despised him, and brought him no tribute. But he held his peace.

hausa: Don mai bi da kaɗe-kaɗe. Ta Dawuda. Wawaye sukan ce a ransu, “Ba Allah.” Sun lalace, ayyukansu kuwa mugaye ne; babu wani da yake yi abu mai kyau.
english: For the Chief Musician. By David. The fool has said in his heart, “There is no God.” They are corrupt. They have done abominable deeds. There is no one who does good.

hausa: Akwai teku, babba da kuma fāɗi, cike da halittun da suka wuce ƙirga, abubuwa masu rai babba da ƙarami.
english: There is the sea, great and wide, in which are innumerable living things, both small and large animals.

hausa: Kada ku ji tsoron masu kashe jiki amma ba sa iya kashe rai. A maimakon haka, ku ji tsoron Wannan wanda yake da iko yă hallaka rai duk da jiki a jahannama ta wuta.
english: Don’t be afraid of those who kill the body, but are not able to kill the soul. Rather, fear him who is able to destroy both soul and body in Gehenna.

hausa: Saboda wannan ne Kiristi ya mutu, ya kuma sāke rayuwa domin yă zama Ubangiji na matattu da na masu rai.
english: For to this end Christ died, rose, and lived again, that he might be Lord of both the dead and the living.

hausa: Ba ma so ku zama masu ƙyuya, sai dai ku yi koyi da waɗanda ta wurin bangaskiya da haƙuri suka gāji abin da aka yi alkawari.
english: that you won’t be sluggish, but imitators of those who through faith and perseverance inherited the promises.

hausa: ’Yan’uwa, salama tare da ƙauna da kuma bangaskiya daga Allah Uba da Ubangiji Yesu Kiristi su kasance tare da ku.
english: Peace be to the brothers, and love with faith, from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

hausa: Na gaskata, saboda haka na ce, “An azabtar da ni ƙwarai.”
english: I believed, therefore I said, “I was greatly afflicted.”

hausa: “Faɗa wa Isra’ilawa cewa, ‘Duk wani mutumin Isra’ila ko baƙon da yake zama a cikin Isra’ila da ya miƙa wani daga cikin ’ya’yansa wa Molek, dole sa kashe shi. Mutanen ƙasar za su jajjefe shi.
english: “Moreover, you shall tell the children of Israel, ‘Anyone of the children of Israel, or of the strangers who live as foreigners in Israel, who gives any of his offspring to Molech shall surely be put to death. The people of the land shall stone that person with stones.

hausa: Runduna guda kuma ta nufi Bet-Horon, ɗayan kuwa ta nufi iyakar da take fuskantar Kwarin Ziboyim wajen jeji.
english: another company turned the way to Beth Horon; and another company turned the way of the border that looks down on the valley of Zeboim toward the wilderness.

hausa: Suka rasa abin faɗi.
english: They couldn’t answer him regarding these things.

hausa: Gama kowace rana suna nemana; suna marmarin sanin hanyoyina, sai ka ce al’ummar da take yin abin da yake daidai ba ta kuma yashe umarnan Allahnta ba. Sun nemi shawarwaran da suke daidai daga gare ni suna kuma marmari Allah ya zo kusa da su.
english: Yet they seek me daily, and delight to know my ways. As a nation that did righteousness, and didn’t forsake the ordinance of their God, they ask of me righteous judgments. They delight to draw near to God.

hausa: “Kada ka karɓi cin hanci, gama cin hanci yakan makanta waɗanda suke gani, yakan kuma karkatar da maganar masu adalci.
english: “You shall take no bribe, for a bribe blinds those who have sight and perverts the words of the righteous.

hausa: Ubangiji kuwa ya ce, “Yanzu ku tashi ku ƙetare Kwarin Zered.” Sai muka ƙetare kwarin.
english: “Now rise up and cross over the brook Zered.” We went over the brook Zered.

hausa: Ka san cewa kowa a lardin Asiya ya juya mini baya, har da Figelus da Hermogenes.
english: This you know, that all who are in Asia turned away from me, of whom are Phygelus and Hermogenes.

hausa: shi da ya yi zukatan duka, wanda yake kula da kome da suke yi.
english: he who fashions all of their hearts; and he considers all of their works.

hausa: Wahala da damuwa suna a kaina, amma umarnanka su ne farin cikina.
english: Trouble and anguish have taken hold of me. Your commandments are my delight.

hausa: Za ka yi wasa da ita kamar yadda za ka yi da tsuntsu? Ko za ka daure ta da tsirkiya domin bayinka mata?
english: Will you play with him as with a bird? Or will you bind him for your girls?

hausa: “ ‘Wannan dawwammamiyar farilla ce ga tsararraki masu zuwa, a inda za ku zauna. Ba za ku ci wani kitse ko wani jini ba.’ ”
english: “‘It shall be a perpetual statute throughout your generations in all your dwellings, that you shall eat neither fat nor blood.’”

hausa: Saboda haka, alhakin jinin dukan annabawa da aka kashe, tun farkon duniya, yana kan wannan zamani,
english: that the blood of all the prophets, which was shed from the foundation of the world, may be required of this generation,

hausa: Ibrahim ya kuma ce wa Allah, “Me zai hana a dai bar Ishmayel kawai yă gāji alkawarin nan da ka yi mini.”
english: Abraham said to God, “Oh that Ishmael might live before you!”

hausa: Ba na so yă zama kamar ina ƙoƙari in tsorata ku ne da wasiƙuna.
english: that I may not seem as if I desire to terrify you by my letters.

hausa: Sarkin Yeriko, ɗaya sarkin Ai (kusa da Betel), ɗaya
english: the king of Jericho, one; the king of Ai, which is beside Bethel, one;

hausa: Bari gidan Haruna yă ce, “Ƙaunarsa madawwamiya ce har abada.”
english: Let the house of Aaron now say that his loving kindness endures forever.

hausa: Ka lissafta makokina; ka jera hawayena a littafinka, ba a rubuce suke a cikin littafinka ba?
english: You count my wanderings. You put my tears into your container. Aren’t they in your book?

hausa: Yosiya yana da shekara goma sha takwas sa’ad da ya zama sarki, ya kuma yi mulki a Urushalima shekara talatin da ɗaya.
english: Josiah was eight years old when he began to reign, and he reigned thirty-one years in Jerusalem.

hausa: Sa zuciyar da aka ɗaga zuwa gaba kan sa zuciya tă yi ciwo, amma marmarin da aka ƙosar yana kamar itacen rai.
english: Hope deferred makes the heart sick, but when longing is fulfilled, it is a tree of life.

hausa: Da tsawon rai zan ƙosar da shi in kuma nuna masa cetona.”
english: I will satisfy him with long life, and show him my salvation.”

hausa: amma Shawulu ya sami labarin shirinsu. Dare da rana suka yi fakonsa a ƙofofin birnin don su kashe shi.
english: but their plot became known to Saul. They watched the gates both day and night that they might kill him,

hausa: Ina gaya muku, ko da yake ba zai so ya tashi ya ba shi burodin don shi abokinsa ne ba, duk da haka, zai tashi ya ba shi yawan abin da yake bukata, saboda nacewarsa.
english: I tell you, although he will not rise and give it to him because he is his friend, yet because of his persistence, he will get up and give him as many as he needs.

hausa: Sai ga waɗansu jiragen ruwa daga Tibariya suka iso kusa da wurin da mutanen suka ci burodi bayan Ubangiji ya yi godiya.
english: However, boats from Tiberias came near to the place where they ate the bread after the Lord had given thanks.

hausa: Sa’an nan ya ce wa dangin nan mai fansa, “Na’omi, wadda ta dawo daga Mowab, tana so ta sayar da filin da yake na ɗan’uwanmu Elimelek.
english: He said to the near kinsman, “Naomi, who has come back out of the country of Moab, is selling the parcel of land, which was our brother Elimelech’s.

hausa: in kuma dukanku za ku yi ɗamara, ku ɗauki makaman yaƙi a hayin Urdun a gaban Ubangiji har lokacin da ya kori abokan gābansa daga gabansa,
english: and every one of your armed men will pass over the Jordan before Yahweh until he has driven out his enemies from before him,

hausa: gama mai Kāriyarsu yana da ƙarfi; zai kuwa yi magana dominsu.
english: for their Defender is strong. He will plead their case against you.

hausa: ɗan Hashabiya, ɗan Amaziya, ɗan Hilkiya,
english: the son of Hashabiah, the son of Amaziah, the son of Hilkiah,

hausa: Gama abu farko mafi muhimmancin da na karɓo shi ne na ba ku cewa Kiristi ya mutu domin zunubanmu bisa ga Nassi,
english: For I delivered to you first of all that which I also received: that Christ died for our sins according to the Scriptures,

hausa: Tare da su suka aika da wannan wasiƙa. Daga manzanni da dattawa, ’yan’uwanku. Zuwa ga Al’ummai masu bi a Antiyok, Suriya da Silisiya. Gaisuwa.
english: They wrote these things by their hand: “The apostles, the elders, and the brothers, to the brothers who are of the Gentiles in Antioch, Syria, and Cilicia: greetings.

hausa: Kusa da Refahiya, Yedahiya ɗan Harumaf ya yi gyare-gyaren daga gaban gidansa, sai Hattush ɗan Hashabnehiya ya yi gyare-gyaren biye da shi.
english: Next to them, Jedaiah the son of Harumaph made repairs across from his house. Next to him, Hattush the son of Hashabneiah made repairs.

hausa: Kada ku ci wani abincin da aka yi da yisti. Ko’ina kuka zauna, dole ku ci burodi marar yisti.”
english: You shall eat nothing leavened. In all your habitations you shall eat unleavened bread.’”

hausa: in kuma kishi ya sha kan mijinta kuma tana da ƙazanta, ko kuwa idan yana kishi yana kuma zatonta ko ma ba ta da ƙazanta
english: and the spirit of jealousy comes on him, and he is jealous of his wife and she is defiled; or if the spirit of jealousy comes on him, and he is jealous of his wife and she isn’t defiled;

hausa: Daga cikin wannan, sashe guda da yake murabba’i mai tsawo kamu 500 zai zama don wuri mai tsarki, kamu 50 kewaye da shi zai zama fili.
english: Of this there shall be a five hundred by five hundred square for the holy place, and fifty cubits for its pasture lands all around.

hausa: Ni, Ubangiji na lura da ita; na yi ta yin mata banruwa. Na yi tsaronta dare da rana don kada wani yă yi mata ɓarna.
english: I, Yahweh, am its keeper. I will water it every moment. Lest anyone damage it, I will keep it night and day.

hausa: Ka umarci waɗanda suke da arziki a wannan duniya kada su ɗaga kai ko su sa begensu a kan dukiyar da ba ta da tabbaci, sai dai su sa begensu ga Allah, wanda yake ba mu kome a yalwace don jin daɗinmu.
english: Charge those who are rich in this present age that they not be arrogant, nor have their hope set on the uncertainty of riches, but on the living God, who richly provides us with everything to enjoy;

hausa: Kun manta mugayen ayyukan kakanninku, da na sarakuna da sarauniyoyin Yahuda da mugayen ayyukanku, da na matanku a cikin Yahuda da kan titunan Urushalima?
english: Have you forgotten the wickedness of your fathers, the wickedness of the kings of Judah, the wickedness of their wives, your own wickedness, and the wickedness of your wives which they committed in the land of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem?

hausa: Da yamma ta yi, aka kawo masa masu aljanu da yawa, ya kuwa fitar da ruhohin ta wurin magana, ya kuma warkar da dukan marasa lafiya.
english: When evening came, they brought to him many possessed with demons. He cast out the spirits with a word, and healed all who were sick,

hausa: Sa’ad da diyar Hiridiyas ta shigo, ta kuma yi rawa, sai ta gamshi Hiridus tare da baƙinsa. Sai Sarkin ya ce wa yarinyar, “Ki tambaye ni kome da kike so, ni kuwa zan ba ki.”
english: When the daughter of Herodias herself came in and danced, she pleased Herod and those sitting with him. The king said to the young lady, “Ask me whatever you want, and I will give it to you.”

hausa: kwanon zinariya ɗaya mai nauyin shekel goma, cike da turaren hayaƙi;
english: one golden ladle of ten shekels, full of incense;

hausa: Matan da suke zama a wurin suka ce, “Na’omi ta sami yaro.” Suka kuwa ba shi suna Obed. Shi ne ya haifi Yesse, mahaifin Dawuda.
english: The women, her neighbors, gave him a name, saying, “A son is born to Naomi”. They named him Obed. He is the father of Jesse, the father of David.

hausa: Ɗan Fallu kuwa shi ne Eliyab,
english: The son of Pallu: Eliab.

hausa: Ku gai da Anduronikus da Yuniyas, dangina waɗanda aka daure a kurkuku tare da ni. Su fitattu ne sosai a cikin manzanni, sun riga ni zama masu bin Kiristi.
english: Greet Andronicus and Junia, my relatives and my fellow prisoners, who are notable among the apostles, who were also in Christ before me.

hausa: Saboda haka Dawuda ya biya Ornan shekel ɗari shida na zinariya saboda wurin.
english: So David gave to Ornan six hundred shekels of gold by weight for the place.

hausa: Zai hallaka har abada, kamar bayan gidansa; waɗanda suka gan shi za su ce, ‘Ina yake?’
english: yet he will perish forever like his own dung. Those who have seen him will say, ‘Where is he?’

hausa: “Ka ajiye bagade na yin hadaya ta ƙonawa a gaban ƙofar tabanakul, da Tentin Sujada;
english: “You shall set the altar of burnt offering before the door of the tabernacle of the Tent of Meeting.

hausa: Sai ya sāke yin musu. Bayan ɗan lokaci kaɗan, sai waɗanda suke tsattsaye kusa suka ce wa Bitrus, “Lalle, kana ɗaya daga cikinsu, gama kai mutumin Galili ne.”
english: But he again denied it. After a little while again those who stood by said to Peter, “You truly are one of them, for you are a Galilean, and your speech shows it.”

hausa: Sa’an nan Siman ya sa musu albarka ya ce wa Maryamu mahaifiyarsa, “An ƙaddara yaron nan yă zama sanadin fāɗuwa da tashin mutane da yawa a Isra’ila, zai kuma zama alamar da mutane ba za su so ba,
english: Simeon blessed them, and said to Mary, his mother, “Behold, this child is appointed for the falling and the rising of many in Israel, and for a sign which is spoken against.

hausa: Shi da sojojinsa, mafi bantsoro cikin al’ummai, za a kawo don su hallaka ƙasar. Za su zāre takuba a kan Masar su kuma cika ƙasar da kisassu.
english: He and his people with him, the terrible of the nations, will be brought in to destroy the land. They will draw their swords against Egypt, and fill the land with the slain.

hausa: Sojojin Fir’auna suka fita daga Masar, sa’ad da Babiloniyawa waɗanda suke ƙawanya wa Urushalima suka ji labari game da su, sai suka janye daga Urushalima.
english: Pharaoh’s army had come out of Egypt; and when the Chaldeans who were besieging Jerusalem heard news of them, they withdrew from Jerusalem.

hausa: Bulus da abokan tafiyarsa suka zazzaga dukan yankin Firjiya da Galatiya, don Ruhu Mai Tsarki ya hana su yin wa’azi a lardin Asiya.
english: When they had gone through the region of Phrygia and Galatia, they were forbidden by the Holy Spirit to speak the word in Asia.

hausa: Da suka sauka, sai suka ga garwashin wuta a can da kifi a kai, da kuma ’yan burodi.
english: So when they got out on the land, they saw a fire of coals there, with fish and bread laid on it.

hausa: Sai suka fara tambayar junansu, ko wane ne a cikinsu zai yi wannan.
english: They began to question among themselves which of them it was who would do this thing.

hausa: Bisa ga shaidar mutum biyu ko uku, za a iya kashe mutum, amma ba za a iya kashe mutum bisa ga shaida mutum guda ba.
english: At the mouth of two witnesses, or three witnesses, he who is to die shall be put to death. At the mouth of one witness he shall not be put to death.

hausa: Da sassafe a ranar farko ta mako, matan suka je kabarin, da kayan ƙanshin da suka shirya.
english: But on the first day of the week, at early dawn, they and some others came to the tomb, bringing the spices which they had prepared.

hausa: Ɗauki dutsen niƙa ki niƙa gari; ki kware lulluɓinki. Ki ɗaga fatarinki ki bar ƙafafunki tsirara, ki kuma yi ta ratsa cikin rafuffuka.
english: Take the millstones and grind flour. Remove your veil, lift up your skirt, uncover your legs, and wade through the rivers.

hausa: Ba ni matana da ’ya’yana, waɗanda na bauta maka dominsu, zan kuwa tafi. Ka dai san yadda na bauta maka.”
english: Give me my wives and my children for whom I have served you, and let me go; for you know my service with which I have served you.”

hausa: da Hazar Shuwal, da Beyersheba da ƙauyukanta.
english: in Hazar Shual, in Beersheba and its towns,

hausa: Yesu ya ce, “Ka amsa daidai. Ka yi haka, kuma za ka rayu.”
english: He said to him, “You have answered correctly. Do this, and you will live.”

hausa: Sa’ad da kuma masifu masu yawa da wahaloli masu yawa suka auko musu, wannan waƙa za tă zama shaida a kansu, domin zuriyarsu ba za tă manta da ita ba. Na san abin da za su iya yi, kafin ma in kawo su cikin ƙasar da na yi musu alkawari da rantsuwa.”
english: It will happen, when many evils and troubles have come on them, that this song will testify before them as a witness; for it will not be forgotten out of the mouths of their descendants; for I know their ways and what they are doing today, before I have brought them into the land which I promised them.”

hausa: domin bishararmu ba tă zo gare ku da kalmomi kawai ba, amma da iko, da Ruhu Mai Tsarki, da kuma cikakken tabbaci. Kun san irin rayuwar da muka yi a cikinku don amfaninku.
english: and that our Good News came to you not in word only, but also in power, and in the Holy Spirit and with much assurance. You know what kind of men we showed ourselves to be among you for your sake.

hausa: Ban hana kaina duk wani abin da idona ya yi sha’awarsa ba; ban hana zuciyata wani jin daɗi ba. Zuciyata ta yi murna da dukan aikina, wannan kuwa shi ne ladan dukan famata.
english: Whatever my eyes desired, I didn’t keep from them. I didn’t withhold my heart from any joy, for my heart rejoiced because of all my labor, and this was my portion from all my labor.

hausa: Babu mai adalci a duniya wanda yake yin abin da yake daidai da bai taɓa yin zunubi ba.
english: Surely there is not a righteous man on earth who does good and doesn’t sin.

hausa: “ ‘Haran, Kanne da Eden da kuma ’yan kasuwan Sheba, Assuriya da Kilmad sun yi ciniki da ke.
english: “‘“Haran, Canneh, Eden, the traders of Sheba, Asshur and Chilmad, were your traders.

hausa: Allah ya yi abin da ya nufa, ya kuma sanar mana shirin asirin da ya riga ya shirya yă cika ta wurin Kiristi.
english: making known to us the mystery of his will, according to his good pleasure which he purposed in him

hausa: Sa’an nan ya miƙa bijimi domin hadaya don zunubi, sai Haruna da ’ya’yansa suka ɗibiya hannuwansu a bijimin.
english: He brought the bull of the sin offering, and Aaron and his sons laid their hands on the head of the bull of the sin offering.

hausa: Hazar Shuwal, Bilha, Ezem,
english: Hazar Shual, Balah, Ezem,

hausa: Sai Ubangiji ya ce wa Hosiya, “Ka ba shi suna Yezireyel, domin ba da daɗewa ba zan hukunta gidan Yehu saboda kisan da aka yi a Yezireyel, zan kuma kawo ƙarshen mulkin Isra’ila.
english: Yahweh said to him, “Call his name Jezreel, for yet a little while, and I will avenge the blood of Jezreel on the house of Jehu, and will cause the kingdom of the house of Israel to cease.

hausa: “Game da sauran kabilun kuwa, “Benyamin zai sami rabo; zai miƙe daga wajen gabas zuwa wajen yamma.
english: “As for the rest of the tribes: from the east side to the west side, Benjamin, one portion.

hausa: “ ‘Kada ka ƙasƙantar da ’yarka ta wurin mai da ita karuwa, in ba haka ba ƙasar za tă juya ga karuwanci tă kuma cika da mugunta.
english: “‘Don’t profane your daughter, to make her a prostitute; lest the land fall to prostitution, and the land become full of wickedness.

hausa: Da jin an ci Babilon da yaƙi sai duniya ta girgiza; za a ji kukanta cikin al’ummai.
english: The earth trembles at the noise of the taking of Babylon. The cry is heard among the nations.

hausa: Sa’ad da suke haura tudun zuwa birnin, sai suka sadu da waɗansu ’yan mata sun fito za su ɗiban ruwa. Sai suka tambaye su, suka ce, “Mai duba yana nan?”
english: As they went up the ascent to the city, they found young maidens going out to draw water, and said to them, “Is the seer here?”

hausa: Ubangiji Mafi Ɗaukaka mai banmamaki ne, Sarki ne mai girma a bisa dukan duniya!
english: For Yahweh Most High is awesome. He is a great King over all the earth.

hausa: Ku yi kuwwa a kanta a kowane gefe! Ta miƙa wuya, hasumiyarta ta fāɗi, katangarta sun rushe. Da yake wannan sakayya ce ta Ubangiji, ku ɗauki fansa a kanta; yi mata yadda ta yi wa waɗansu.
english: Shout against her all around. She has submitted herself. Her bulwarks have fallen. Her walls have been thrown down, for it is the vengeance of Yahweh. Take vengeance on her. As she has done, do to her.

hausa: ya ce masa, “Ni ne Ubangiji. Sai ka faɗa wa Fir’auna sarkin Masar kome da na faɗa maka.”
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “I am Yahweh. Tell Pharaoh king of Egypt all that I tell you.”

hausa: Bari su ɓace kamar ruwa mai wucewa; sa’ad da suka ja bakansu, bari kibiyoyinsu su murtsuke.
english: Let them vanish like water that flows away. When they draw the bow, let their arrows be made blunt.

hausa: Ya ce, “A’a, ranka yă daɗe, ka ji ni, na ba ka filin, na kuma ba ka kogon da yake cikinsa. Na ba ka shi a gaban mutanena. Ka binne mataccenka.”
english: “No, my lord, hear me. I give you the field, and I give you the cave that is in it. In the presence of the children of my people I give it to you. Bury your dead.”

hausa: da ta Hanan, da ta Giddel, da ta Gahar,
english: the children of Hanan, the children of Giddel, the children of Gahar,

hausa: Kai da dukan mutanen da suke zuwa wurinka za ku gajiyar da kanku. Aikin ya fi ƙarfinka; ba za ka iya yinsa kai kaɗai ba.
english: You will surely wear away, both you, and this people that is with you; for the thing is too heavy for you. You are not able to perform it yourself alone.

hausa: don yă ji nishe-nishen ’yan kurkuku yă kuma saki waɗanda aka yanke musu hukuncin mutuwa.”
english: to hear the groans of the prisoner, to free those who are condemned to death,

hausa: Nan da nan, sai yarinyar ta tashi ta yi tafiya (shekarunta goma sha biyu ne). Saboda wannan, suka yi mamaki ƙwarai.
english: Immediately the girl rose up and walked, for she was twelve years old. They were amazed with great amazement.

hausa: A kwanakin nan, da kuma a lokacin nan,” in ji Ubangiji, “za a yi bincike don laifin Isra’ila, amma ba za a samu ba, kuma don zunubin Yahuda, amma ba za a sami wani abu ba, gama zan gafarta wa raguwar da na rage.
english: In those days, and in that time,” says Yahweh, “the iniquity of Israel will be sought for, and there will be none, also the sins of Judah, and they won’t be found; for I will pardon them whom I leave as a remnant.

hausa: Ka sallami mutanen su shiga ƙauyukan da suke kurkusa, su sayi wa kansu wani abu, su ci.”
english: Send them away, that they may go into the surrounding country and villages and buy themselves bread, for they have nothing to eat.”

hausa: In kuma muka kula, muka kiyaye dukan dokokin nan a gaban Ubangiji Allahnmu, kamar yadda ya umarce mu, wannan zai zama adalci a gare mu.”
english: It shall be righteousness to us, if we observe to do all these commandments before Yahweh our God, as he has commanded us.”

hausa: “Ka umarci Isra’ilawa cewa, ‘Ku tabbatar kun miƙa mini hadaya ta abinci ta wuta mai daɗin ƙanshi a gare ni, a daidai lokaci.’
english: “Command the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘See that you present my offering, my food for my offerings made by fire, as a pleasant aroma to me, in their due season.’

hausa: Ubangiji Allah ya umarci mutumin ya ce, “Kana da ’yanci ka ci daga kowane itace a cikin lambun,
english: Yahweh God commanded the man, saying, “You may freely eat of every tree of the garden;

hausa: Abimelek ya kuma ce, “Ƙasata tana gabanka, ka zauna a duk inda kake so.”
english: Abimelech said, “Behold, my land is before you. Dwell where it pleases you.”

hausa: Amma tsarkaka na Mafi Ɗaukaka za su karɓi wannan sarauta, za su kuwa mallake ta har abada, I, har abada abadin.’
english: But the saints of the Most High will receive the kingdom, and possess the kingdom forever, even forever and ever.’

hausa: “Zan sauko da su kamar tumaki zuwa mayanka, kamar raguna da bunsurai.
english: “I will bring them down like lambs to the slaughter, like rams with male goats.

hausa: Mutanen Ruben da mutanen Gad, da suke da garken shanu da kuma garke tumaki masu yawa, suka ga cewa ƙasashen Yazer da Gileyad wurare ne masu kyau don kiwon shanu da tumaki.
english: Now the children of Reuben and the children of Gad had a very great multitude of livestock. They saw the land of Jazer, and the land of Gilead. Behold, the place was a place for livestock.

hausa: Allah kuwa ya ji kukansu sai ya tuna da alkawarinsa da Ibrahim da Ishaku da Yaƙub.
english: God heard their groaning, and God remembered his covenant with Abraham, with Isaac, and with Jacob.

hausa: Ko sa’ad da na tsufa da furfura, kada ka yashe ni, ya Allah, sai na furta ikonka ga tsara mai zuwa, ƙarfinka ga dukan waɗanda suke zuwa.
english: Yes, even when I am old and gray-haired, God, don’t forsake me, until I have declared your strength to the next generation, your might to everyone who is to come.

hausa: Kada mu zub da wani jini. Mu dai jefa shi cikin wannan rijiya a nan cikin hamada, amma kada mu sa hannu a kansa.” Ruben ya faɗa wannan ne don yă cece shi daga gare su, yă kuma mai da shi ga mahaifinsa.
english: Reuben said to them, “Shed no blood. Throw him into this pit that is in the wilderness, but lay no hand on him”—that he might deliver him out of their hand, to restore him to his father.

hausa: Ka tashi, ka tashi! Ka yafa wa kanka ƙarfi, Ya hannun Ubangiji; ka farka, kamar a kwanakin da suka wuce, kamar a zamanai na dā. Ba kai ba ne wanda ya yayyanka Rahab gunduwa-gunduwa, wanda ya soki dodon ruwan nan?
english: Awake, awake, put on strength, arm of Yahweh! Awake, as in the days of old, the generations of ancient times. Isn’t it you who cut Rahab in pieces, who pierced the monster?

hausa: “Amma yayinda suke kan tafiya garin sayen mai, sai ango ya iso. Budurwai da suke a shirye, suka shiga wajen bikin auren tare da shi. Aka kuma kulle ƙofa.
english: While they went away to buy, the bridegroom came, and those who were ready went in with him to the wedding feast, and the door was shut.

hausa: Zimri, ɗaya daga cikin shugabanni, wanda ya shugabanci rabin kekunan yaƙin Ela, ya yi maƙarƙashiya a kansa. Ela yana a Tirza a lokacin, ya bugu a gidan Arza, sarkin fada a Tirza.
english: His servant Zimri, captain of half his chariots, conspired against him. Now he was in Tirzah, drinking himself drunk in the house of Arza, who was over the household in Tirzah;

hausa: Ba za a taɓa tumɓuke masu adalci ba, amma mugaye ba za su ci gaba da kasance a ƙasar ba.
english: The righteous will never be removed, but the wicked will not dwell in the land.

hausa: Sai Ubangiji ya ce mini, “Na ga mutanen nan, su masu taurinkai ne sosai!
english: Furthermore Yahweh spoke to me, saying, “I have seen these people, and behold, they are a stiff-necked people.

hausa: Wata rana Yesu ya ce wa almajiransa, “Mu haye zuwa wancan gefen tafkin.” Sai suka shiga jirgin ruwa suka fara tafiya.
english: Now on one of those days, he entered into a boat, himself and his disciples, and he said to them, “Let’s go over to the other side of the lake.” So they launched out.

hausa: Sa’an nan Iliya ya umarce su, ya ce, “Ku kama annabawan Ba’al, kada ku bar waninsu yă tsere!” Suka kama su, Iliya kuwa ya sa aka gangara da su zuwa Kwarin Kishon, aka yayyanka su a can.
english: Elijah said to them, “Seize the prophets of Baal! Don’t let one of them escape!” They seized them; and Elijah brought them down to the brook Kishon, and killed them there.

hausa: Za ku ci naman manyan mutane ku kuma sha jinin sarakunan duniya sai ka ce an yanka raguna da ’yan tumaki, awaki da bijimai, dukansu turkakkun dabbobi daga Bashan.
english: You shall eat the flesh of the mighty, and drink the blood of the princes of the earth, of rams, of lambs, and of goats, of bulls, all of them fatlings of Bashan.

hausa: Amma ɗaya daga cikin almajiransa, Yahuda Iskariyot, wanda daga baya zai bashe shi, bai amince ba ya ce,
english: Then Judas Iscariot, Simon’s son, one of his disciples, who would betray him, said,

hausa: Gama mutumin da ya sami warkarwar banmamaki, shekarunsa sun fi arba’in.
english: For the man on whom this miracle of healing was performed was more than forty years old.

hausa: Ana cikin haka, Absalom da dukan Isra’ila suka iso Urushalima, Ahitofel kuwa yana tare da shi.
english: Absalom and all the people, the men of Israel, came to Jerusalem, and Ahithophel with him.

hausa: “ ‘Sa’ad da baƙo yana zama tare da ku a ƙasarku, kada ku wulaƙanta shi.
english: “‘If a stranger lives as a foreigner with you in your land, you shall not do him wrong.

hausa: Ku dukan mutanen duniya, ku da kuke zama a duniya, sa’ad da aka ɗaga tutar a kan duwatsu, za ku gan shi, sa’ad da kuma aka busa ƙaho, za ku ji shi.
english: All you inhabitants of the world, and you dwellers on the earth, when a banner is lifted up on the mountains, look! When the trumpet is blown, listen!

hausa: Don mai bi da kaɗe-kaɗe. Zabura ta Dawuda. Mai albarka ne wanda yake jin tausayin marasa ƙarfi; Ubangiji yakan kuɓutar da shi a lokutan wahala.
english: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. Blessed is he who considers the poor. Yahweh will deliver him in the day of evil.

hausa: Ku ci su yadda akan ci barewa ko mariri. Marar tsarki da mai tsarki, za ku iya ci.
english: Even as the gazelle and as the deer is eaten, so you shall eat of it. The unclean and the clean may eat of it alike.

hausa: Yariyan ta gudu ta faɗa wa mutanen gidan mahaifiyarta game da abubuwan nan.
english: The young lady ran, and told her mother’s house about these words.

hausa: Kada masu wuce su ce, “Albarkar Ubangiji ta kasance a kanku; muna sa muku albarka a cikin sunan Ubangiji.”
english: Neither do those who go by say, “The blessing of Yahweh be on you. We bless you in Yahweh’s name.”

hausa: Allah ya yi haka saboda kisan ’ya’ya saba’in na Yerub-Ba’al, don a ɗauki fansar jininsu a kan Abimelek ɗan’uwansu da kuma ’yan ƙasar Shekem, waɗanda suka taimake shi kisan ’yan’uwansa.
english: that the violence done to the seventy sons of Jerubbaal might come, and that their blood might be laid on Abimelech their brother who killed them, and on the men of Shechem who strengthened his hands to kill his brothers.

hausa: Sai ta haura ta shimfiɗa shi a gadon mutumin Allah, ta rufe ƙofar, ta fita.
english: She went up and laid him on the man of God’s bed, and shut the door on him, and went out.

hausa: Ya ci gaba da cewa, “Shi ya sa na faɗa muku cewa ba mai iya zuwa wurina, sai dai Uba ya yardar masa.”
english: He said, “For this cause I have said to you that no one can come to me, unless it is given to him by my Father.”

hausa: Na sani kana dogara da Masar, wadda take kamar karar masara, wadda in ka jingina a kai, za tă karye tă soki hannunka. Haka Fir’auna sarkin Masar yake ga dukan wanda ya dogara da shi.
english: Now, behold, you trust in the staff of this bruised reed, even in Egypt. If a man leans on it, it will go into his hand and pierce it. So is Pharaoh king of Egypt to all who trust on him.

hausa: Yonatan ya ce, “Dawuda ya nemi izinina don yă tafi Betlehem.
english: Jonathan answered Saul, “David earnestly asked permission of me to go to Bethlehem.

hausa: Da Ubangiji ya ji gunagunin da mutanen suke yi saboda wahalarsu, sai ya husata ƙwarai. Sai wuta daga Ubangiji ta yi ta ci a cikinsu har ta ƙone waɗansu wurare na sansanin.
english: The people were complaining in the ears of Yahweh. When Yahweh heard it, his anger burned; and Yahweh’s fire burned among them, and consumed some of the outskirts of the camp.

hausa: In ya ƙi kula da wannan, shi ma sai a ƙi kula da shi.
english: But if anyone is ignorant, let him be ignorant.

hausa: “Saboda haka zuciyata na makoki don Mowab kamar busa; tana makoki kamar busa saboda mutanen Kir Hareset. Arzikin da suka samu ta ƙare.
english: Therefore my heart sounds for Moab like flutes, and my heart sounds like flutes for the men of Kir Heres. Therefore the abundance that he has gotten has perished.

hausa: Bayan sarki ya kama zama a fadansa Ubangiji kuma ya hutashe shi daga dukan abokan gābansa da suke kewaye da shi,
english: When the king lived in his house, and Yahweh had given him rest from all his enemies all around,

hausa: Sa’ad da suka yi kusa da Yebus dare kuma ya riga ya yi, bawan ya ce wa maigidansa, “Mu dakata a birnin nan na Yebusiyawa mu kwana.”
english: When they were by Jebus, the day was far spent; and the servant said to his master, “Please come and let’s enter into this city of the Jebusites, and stay in it.”

hausa: Ta tafi gida, ta tarar da diyarta kwance a gado, aljanin kuwa ya fita.
english: She went away to her house, and found the child having been laid on the bed, with the demon gone out.

hausa: amma rana ta bakwai, Asabbaci ne ga Ubangiji Allahnka. A kanta ba za ka yi wani aiki ba, ko kai, ko ɗanka, ko ’yarka, ko bawanka, ko baiwarka, ko saniyarka, ko jakinka, ko wani daga dabbobinka, ko baƙo a ƙofofinka, don bayinka maza da mata su ma su huta, kamar ka.
english: but the seventh day is a Sabbath to Yahweh your God, in which you shall not do any work—neither you, nor your son, nor your daughter, nor your male servant, nor your female servant, nor your ox, nor your donkey, nor any of your livestock, nor your stranger who is within your gates; that your male servant and your female servant may rest as well as you.

hausa: Helez, mutumin Falti, Ira, ɗan Ikkesh mutumin Tekowa,
english: Helez the Paltite, Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite,

hausa: da ƙyashi; buguwa, shashanci, da ire-irensu. Na gargaɗe ku, yadda na yi a dā, cewa masu irin wannan rayuwa ba za su gāji mulkin Allah ba.
english: envy, murders, drunkenness, orgies, and things like these; of which I forewarn you, even as I also forewarned you, that those who practice such things will not inherit God’s Kingdom.

hausa: “Wuraren kiwo a kewayen garuruwan da za a ba wa Lawiyawa, girmansu zai zama mai fāɗin kamu dubu ɗaya daga katangar garin.
english: “The pasture lands of the cities, which you shall give to the Levites, shall be from the wall of the city and outward one thousand cubits around it.

hausa: Tabbatacce, akwai waɗansu da suke na ƙarshe, da za su zama na farko, na farko kuma, da za su zama na ƙarshe.”
english: Behold, there are some who are last who will be first, and there are some who are first who will be last.”

hausa: Amma in ba su haye tare da ku da shirin yaƙi ba, to, sai ku ba su gādo a wancan haye kamar sauran kabilun a Kan’ana.”
english: but if they will not pass over with you armed, they shall have possessions among you in the land of Canaan.”

hausa: (To, Yesu kansa ya taɓa faɗa cewa annabi ba shi da daraja a ƙasarsa.)
english: For Jesus himself testified that a prophet has no honor in his own country.

hausa: wanda ya kuɓutar da ni daga maƙiyina. Ka ɗaukaka ni bisa maƙiyina; ka kiyaye ni daga hannun mugayen mutane.
english: who brings me away from my enemies. Yes, you lift me up above those who rise up against me. You deliver me from the violent man.

hausa: Duk sarakunan nan suka haɗa mayaƙansu tare, suka kafa sansani a bakin Ruwayen Meron don su yi yaƙi da Isra’ilawa.
english: All these kings met together; and they came and encamped together at the waters of Merom, to fight with Israel.

hausa: Sa’an nan waɗanda suka tsira daga cikin al’umman da suka yaƙe Urushalima za su haura shekara-shekara su yi wa Sarki, Ubangiji Maɗaukaki sujada, su kuma yi Bikin Tabanakul.
english: It will happen that everyone who is left of all the nations that came against Jerusalem will go up from year to year to worship the King, Yahweh of Armies, and to keep the feast of booths.

hausa: ta ashirin da huɗu a kan Romamti-Ezer, na goma sha biya a kan Yerimot, ’ya’yansa maza da danginsa 12.
english: for the twenty-fourth to Romamti-Ezer, his sons and his brothers, twelve.

hausa: sa’ad da na wasa takobi mai walƙiya hannuna kuwa ya cafke shi don yin hukunci, zan ɗau fansa a kan abokan gābana in sāka wa waɗanda suke ƙina.
english: if I sharpen my glittering sword, my hand grasps it in judgment; I will take vengeance on my adversaries, and will repay those who hate me.

hausa: Ku yi zance da juna cikin zabura, da waƙoƙi, da kuma waƙoƙin ruhaniya. Ku rera, ku kuma yi kiɗe-kiɗe a zuciyarku ga Ubangiji.
english: speaking to one another in psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs; singing and making melody in your heart to the Lord;

hausa: Yahudawan da suke Shusha suka taru a ran goma sha huɗu na watan Adar suka kuma karkashe mutum ɗari uku a Shusha, amma ba su taɓa dukiyarsu ba.
english: The Jews who were in Susa gathered themselves together on the fourteenth day also of the month Adar, and killed three hundred men in Susa; but they didn’t lay their hand on the plunder.

hausa: Suka kuma binne shi a ƙasarsa ta gādo, a Timnat Sera a ƙasar kan tudu ta Efraim, arewa da Dutsen Ga’ash.
english: They buried him in the border of his inheritance in Timnathserah, which is in the hill country of Ephraim, on the north of the mountain of Gaash.

hausa: wanda yakan yi mana ta’aziyya a cikin dukan wahalolinmu, domin mu kuma mu iya ta’azantar da waɗanda suke cikin kowace irin wahala, da ta’aziyyar da mu kanmu muka samu daga Allah.
english: who comforts us in all our affliction, that we may be able to comfort those who are in any affliction, through the comfort with which we ourselves are comforted by God.

hausa: Kamar yadda ya gamshi Ubangiji ya sa kuka yi arziki kuka kuma ƙaru, haka zai gamshe shi yă lalatar yă kuma hallaka ku. Za a tumɓuke ku daga ƙasar da kuke shiga ku mallaka.
english: It will happen that as Yahweh rejoiced over you to do you good, and to multiply you, so Yahweh will rejoice over you to cause you to perish and to destroy you. You will be plucked from the land that you are going in to possess.

hausa: Mordekai kuwa ya sami labarin makircin, ya kuma faɗa wa Sarauniya Esta, wadda ta faɗa wa sarki, ta kuma nuna masa cewa Mordekai ne ya ji.
english: This thing became known to Mordecai, who informed Esther the queen; and Esther informed the king in Mordecai’s name.

hausa: Da yaya zai kasance ke nan da a ce an bar sojoji suka ci abincin da suka ƙwace daga abokan gābansu? Ai, da gawawwakin Filistiyawan da aka kashe sun fi haka.”
english: How much more, if perhaps the people had eaten freely today of the plunder of their enemies which they found? For now there has been no great slaughter among the Philistines.”

hausa: Zai mutu a inda suka kai shi zaman bauta; ba zai ƙara ganin wannan ƙasa ba.”
english: But he will die in the place where they have led him captive. He will see this land no more.”

hausa: “Sa’ad da suka yi maka zunubi, gama babu wani wanda ba ya zunubi, ka kuwa yi fushi da su ka miƙa su ga abokin gāba, wanda ya kai su zaman bauta a ƙasa mai nisa ko kuwa kusa;
english: “If they sin against you (for there is no man who doesn’t sin), and you are angry with them and deliver them to the enemy, so that they carry them away captive to a land far off or near;

hausa: Shawulu ya sami labari cewa, “Dawuda yana Nayiwot a Rama.”
english: Saul was told, saying, “Behold, David is at Naioth in Ramah.”

hausa: Saboda haka mutum biyar ɗin suka tashi suka iso Layish, inda suka ga mutane suna zamansu a huce, kamar Sidoniyawa, ba sa zato ga tsaro. Kuma da yake ƙasarsu ba ta bukata kome, suna da wadata. Suna kuma nesa da Sidoniyawa, ba sa kuma hulɗa da kowa.
english: Then the five men departed and came to Laish and saw the people who were there, how they lived in safety, in the way of the Sidonians, quiet and secure; for there was no one in the land possessing authority, that might put them to shame in anything, and they were far from the Sidonians, and had no dealings with anyone else.

hausa: Hannun damanka, ya Ubangiji, Mai kwarjini ne da iko, hannun damanka, ya Ubangiji, ya farfashe magabci.
english: Your right hand, Yahweh, is glorious in power. Your right hand, Yahweh, dashes the enemy in pieces.

hausa: Waɗannan su ne zuriyar Ehud, waɗanda suke kawunan iyalan waɗanda suke zama a Geba waɗanda aka kuma kwasa zuwa Manahat.
english: These are the sons of Ehud. These are the heads of fathers’ households of the inhabitants of Geba, who were carried captive to Manahath:

hausa: Ina cikin zafi da kuma azaba; bari cetonka, ya Allah, yă tsare ni.
english: But I am in pain and distress. Let your salvation, God, protect me.

hausa: “Duk wanda ya bugi mahaifinsa ko mahaifiyarsa, dole a kashe shi.
english: “Anyone who attacks his father or his mother shall be surely put to death.

hausa: Saboda haka, Allah a cikin hikimarsa ya ce, ‘Zan aika musu da annabawa da manzanni. Za su kashe waɗansu, su kuma tsananta wa waɗansu.’
english: Therefore also the wisdom of God said, ‘I will send to them prophets and apostles; and some of them they will kill and persecute,

hausa: Suna kashe gwauraye da kuma baƙi; suna kisan marayu.
english: They kill the widow and the alien, and murder the fatherless.

hausa: Amma dukan waɗanda suka nemi Ubangiji za su tsira. Kamar yadda Ubangiji ya ce, gama a Dutsen Sihiyona da Urushalima akwai ceto, a cikin waɗannan da Ubangiji ya kira.
english: It will happen that whoever will call on Yahweh’s name shall be saved; for in Mount Zion and in Jerusalem there will be those who escape, as Yahweh has said, and among the remnant, those whom Yahweh calls.

hausa: Sai Yowab ya ce wa wani mutumin Kush, “Je ka faɗa wa sarki abin da ka gani.” Mutumin Kush ɗin kuwa ya rusuna wa Yowab, sai ya ruga a guje.
english: Then Joab said to the Cushite, “Go, tell the king what you have seen!” The Cushite bowed himself to Joab, and ran.

hausa: Ya yi wannan magana ba don ya kula da matalauta ba ne, sai dai don shi ɓarawo ne. Da yake shi ne mai ajiya jakar kuɗin, yakan taimaki kansa da abin da aka sa a ciki.
english: Now he said this, not because he cared for the poor, but because he was a thief, and having the money box, used to steal what was put into it.

hausa: In ya yi girma har ya isa yanke shawara don kansa, madara da zuma ne abincinsa.
english: He shall eat butter and honey when he knows to refuse the evil and choose the good.

hausa: Ni ne Ubangiji Allahnku; ku tsarkake kanku ku kuma zama da tsarki, domin Ni mai tsarki ne. Kada ku ƙazantar da kanku ta wurin wani halittar da take rarrafe a ƙasa.
english: For I am Yahweh your God. Sanctify yourselves therefore, and be holy; for I am holy. You shall not defile yourselves with any kind of creeping thing that moves on the earth.

hausa: Aka faɗa wa Sarki Solomon cewa Yowab ya gudu zuwa tentin Ubangiji, yana kuma kusa da bagade. Sai Solomon ya umarci Benahiya ɗan Yehohiyada ya ce, “Je ka kashe shi!”
english: King Solomon was told, “Joab has fled to Yahweh’s Tent; and behold, he is by the altar.” Then Solomon sent Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, saying, “Go, fall on him.”

hausa: An nuna muku dukan waɗannan abubuwa saboda ku san cewa Ubangiji, shi ne Allah; ban da shi, babu wani.
english: It was shown to you so that you might know that Yahweh is God. There is no one else besides him.

hausa: “Me ya sa ban mutu ba da za a haife ni, ko kuma in mutu sa’ad da ana haihuwata ba?
english: “Why didn’t I die from the womb? Why didn’t I give up the spirit when my mother bore me?

hausa: Kashegari Musa ya ce wa mutane, “Kun yi zunubi mai girma. Amma yanzu zan hau wurin Ubangiji; wataƙila zan iya yin kafara domin zunubinku.”
english: On the next day, Moses said to the people, “You have sinned a great sin. Now I will go up to Yahweh. Perhaps I shall make atonement for your sin.”

hausa: Kuna shari’a bisa ga ma’aunin mutane; ni kuwa ba na yin wa kowa shari’a.
english: You judge according to the flesh. I judge no one.

hausa: Ubangiji ya ce wa Musa, “Ka kama dukan shugabannin mutanen nan, ka kashe su, ka kuma bar su a tsakar rana a gaban Ubangiji, don Ubangiji yă huce daga fushin da nake yi da Isra’ila.”
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “Take all the chiefs of the people, and hang them up to Yahweh before the sun, that the fierce anger of Yahweh may turn away from Israel.”

hausa: Ahitofel ya ce wa Absalom, “Je ka kwana da ƙwarƙwaran mahaifinka waɗanda ya bari su lura da fada. Ta haka dukan Isra’ila za su ji cewa ka mai da kanka abin wari a hancin mahaifinka, dukan hannuwan waɗanda suke tare da kai kuwa za su sami ƙarfi.”
english: Ahithophel said to Absalom, “Go in to your father’s concubines that he has left to keep the house. Then all Israel will hear that you are abhorred by your father. Then the hands of all who are with you will be strong.”

hausa: Yetro surukin Musa tare da ’ya’yan Musa da matarsa suka zo wurin Musa a hamada, inda suka kafa sansani kusa da dutsen Allah
english: Jethro, Moses’ father-in-law, came with Moses’ sons and his wife to Moses into the wilderness where he was encamped, at the Mountain of God.

hausa: Ana nan sai Ubangiji ya ce wa Musa, “Ku hauro zuwa wurina, kai da Haruna, Nadab da Abihu, da kuma dattawa saba’in a cikin Isra’ila. Za ku yi sujada da ɗan nisa,
english: He said to Moses, “Come up to Yahweh, you, and Aaron, Nadab, and Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel; and worship from a distance.

hausa: Iyakar za tă miƙe daga teku zuwa Hazar-Enon, ta iyakar Damaskus, da iyakar Hamat a arewa. Wannan ita ce iyakar a wajen arewa.
english: The border from the sea shall be Hazar Enon at the border of Damascus; and on the north northward is the border of Hamath. This is the north side.

hausa: Wane irin hukunci mai tsanani ne kuke tsammani zai dace da mutumin da ya nuna rashin bangirma ga Ɗan Allah, wanda ya yi banza da jinin nan na alkawarin da ya tsarkake shi, wanda kuma ya zargi Ruhun alheri?
english: How much worse punishment do you think he will be judged worthy of who has trodden under foot the Son of God, and has counted the blood of the covenant with which he was sanctified an unholy thing, and has insulted the Spirit of grace?

hausa: Za su yi gāba da ke da kayan yaƙi, kekunan yaƙi da kekunan doki da mutane masu yawa; za su ja dāgā a kanki a kowane gefe da garkuwoyi manya da ƙanana da kuma hulunan kwano. Zan miƙa ke gare su don hukunci, za su kuma hukunta ki bisa ga shari’arsu.
english: They will come against you with weapons, chariots, and wagons, and with a company of peoples. They will set themselves against you with buckler, shield, and helmet all around. I will commit the judgment to them, and they will judge you according to their judgments.

hausa: Abin da ya sa Ubana yake ƙaunata ke nan, domin ina ba da raina, in ɗauko shi kuma.
english: Therefore the Father loves me, because I lay down my life, that I may take it again.

hausa: Al’ummai za su zo wurin haskenki, sarakuna kuma zuwa asubahin sabon yininki.
english: Nations will come to your light, and kings to the brightness of your rising.

hausa: “Kada ku yi annabci” in ji annabawansu. “Kada ku yi annabci game da waɗannan abubuwa; abin kunya ba zai same mu ba.”
english: “Don’t prophesy!”—they prophesy— “Don’t prophesy about these things. Disgrace won’t overtake us.”

hausa: Saboda alamun nan da aka ba ta iko tă yi a madadin dabban nan ta fari, sai ta ruɗi mazaunan duniya. Ta umarce su su kafa siffa don girmama dabbar da aka ji mata rauni da takobi duk da haka ta rayu.
english: He deceives my own people who dwell on the earth because of the signs he was granted to do in front of the beast, saying to those who dwell on the earth that they should make an image to the beast who had the sword wound and lived.

hausa: Gama al’umma ko masarautar da ba tă bauta miki ba, za tă hallaka; za tă lalace sarai.
english: For that nation and kingdom that will not serve you shall perish; yes, those nations shall be utterly wasted.

hausa: Amma sarki ya nace a kan maganar da ya yi wa Yowab. Sai Yowab ya tashi ya tafi cikin dukan Isra’ila, ya kewaye sa’an nan ya dawo Urushalima.
english: Nevertheless the king’s word prevailed against Joab. Therefore Joab departed and went throughout all Israel, then came to Jerusalem.

hausa: “A cikin mutanena an sami mugaye waɗanda suke kwanton ɓauna kamar masu sa tarko wa tsuntsaye kamar waɗanda suke kafa tarko don su kama mutane.
english: For wicked men are found among my people. They watch, as fowlers lie in wait. They set a trap. They catch men.

hausa: Ka ce musu, ‘Ga abin da Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka yana cewa, Zan ɗauki sandan Yusuf, wanda yake a hannun Efraim, da na kabilan Isra’ilawan da suke tare da shi, in haɗa shi da sandan Yahuda, in mai da su sanda guda, za su kuwa zama ɗaya a hannuna.’
english: tell them, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “Behold, I will take the stick of Joseph, which is in the hand of Ephraim, and the tribes of Israel his companions; and I will put them with it, with the stick of Judah, and make them one stick, and they will be one in my hand.

hausa: Gama tulun garin bai ƙare ba, kwalabar man kuma bai bushe ba, kamar yadda Ubangiji ya faɗa wa Iliya.
english: The jar of meal didn’t run out and the jar of oil didn’t fail, according to Yahweh’s word, which he spoke by Elijah.

hausa: Cikin ɗaga kai mutum ba ya neman Allah; cikin tunaninsa ba ya ba da wata dama saboda Allah.
english: The wicked, in the pride of his face, has no room in his thoughts for God.

hausa: “ ‘Kowa da ya kashe wani, za a kashe shi a matsayin mai kisankai, bisa ga shaidar shaidu. Amma kada a kashe wani bisa ga shaidar mutum ɗaya.
english: “‘Whoever kills any person, the murderer shall be slain based on the testimony of witnesses; but one witness shall not testify alone against any person so that he dies.

hausa: Zan kuwa roƙi Uba, zai kuwa ba ku wani Mai Taimakon da zai kasance tare da ku har abada,
english: I will pray to the Father, and he will give you another Counselor, that he may be with you forever:

hausa: ’Yan kwanakina ba su kusa ƙarewa ba ne? Ka rabu da ni don in ɗan samu sukuni na ɗan lokaci
english: Aren’t my days few? Stop! Leave me alone, that I may find a little comfort,

hausa: “Yi wa Isra’ilawa magana, ku ce musu, ‘Duk sa’ad da wani namiji yake ɗiga daga azzakarinsa, wannan ɗiga marar tsarki ne.
english: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘When any man has a discharge from his body, because of his discharge he is unclean.

hausa: Ga abin da Ubangiji Maɗaukaki ya ce, ‘Zan hori Amalekawa saboda abin da suka yi wa Isra’ila sa’ad da suka ba su wahala yayinda suka fito daga Masar.
english: Yahweh of Armies says, ‘I remember what Amalek did to Israel, how he set himself against him on the way when he came up out of Egypt.

hausa: don yă haskaka a kan waɗanda suke zama cikin duhu, da kuma cikin inuwar mutuwa, don yă bi da ƙafafunmu a hanyar salama.”
english: to shine on those who sit in darkness and the shadow of death; to guide our feet into the way of peace.”

hausa: “Amma mai karɓar harajin ya tsaya daga nesa. Bai ma iya ɗaga kansa sama ba, sai ya buga ƙirjinsa, yana cewa, ‘Allah, ka yi mini jinƙai, ni mai zunubi ne.’
english: But the tax collector, standing far away, wouldn’t even lift up his eyes to heaven, but beat his chest, saying, ‘God, be merciful to me, a sinner!’

hausa: Waɗansu mutane kuwa suna kama da irin da aka shuka a ƙasa mai kyau, sukan ji maganar Allah, su kuma karɓa, sa’an nan kuma su fid da amfani riɓi talatin-talatin, ko sittin-sittin, ko ɗari-ɗari.”
english: Those which were sown on the good ground are those who hear the word, accept it, and bear fruit, some thirty times, some sixty times, and some one hundred times.”

hausa: Mala’ikan Ubangiji ya kafa sansani kewaye da waɗanda suke tsoronsa, ya kuwa cece su.
english: Yahweh’s angel encamps around those who fear him, and delivers them.

hausa: Sa’ad da hafsoshin suka gama magana da mayaƙan, sai su naɗa komandodi a kansu.
english: It shall be, when the officers have finished speaking to the people, that they shall appoint captains of armies at the head of the people.

hausa: Ana ce da shi Nabal, sunan matarsa kuwa Abigiyel. Tana da hikima ga ta kuma kyakkyawa, amma mijinta mai rowa ne marar mutunci. Shi daga kabilar Kaleb ne.
english: Now the name of the man was Nabal; and the name of his wife Abigail. This woman was intelligent and had a beautiful face; but the man was surly and evil in his doings. He was of the house of Caleb.

hausa: Amminadab ya haifi Nashon, Nashon ya haifi Salmon,
english: and Amminadab became the father of Nahshon, and Nahshon became the father of Salmon,

hausa: Kada ku ji tsoron sarkin Babilon, wanda kuke tsoro a yanzu. Kada ku ji tsoronsa, in ji Ubangiji, gama ina tare da ku zan kuma cece ku daga hannuwansa.
english: Don’t be afraid of the king of Babylon, of whom you are afraid. Don’t be afraid of him,’ says Yahweh, ‘for I am with you to save you, and to deliver you from his hand.

hausa: Sai Shawulu ya ce wa Sama’ila, “Na yi zunubi, na ƙi bin umarnin Ubangiji, na kuma ƙi bin maganarka. Na ji tsoron mutane ne shi ya sa na bi maganarsu.
english: Saul said to Samuel, “I have sinned; for I have transgressed the commandment of Yahweh and your words, because I feared the people and obeyed their voice.

hausa: Ga abin da Ubangiji yana cewa, ‘In ban kafa alkawarina game da rana da kuma game da dare ba in kuma gyara dokokin sama da duniya ba,
english: Yahweh says: “If my covenant of day and night fails, if I have not appointed the ordinances of heaven and earth,

hausa: don su ɗaura sarakuna da sarƙoƙi, manyan garinsu da sarƙoƙin ƙarfe,
english: to bind their kings with chains, and their nobles with fetters of iron;

hausa: Esta ta amsa ta ce, “Bukatata da kuma roƙona shi ne,
english: Then Esther answered and said, “My petition and my request is this.

hausa: Gaza za tă aske kanta cikin baƙin ciki; Ashkelon zai yi shiru. Ya raguwar da suke zama a fili, har yaushe za ku tsattsage kanku?
english: Baldness has come on Gaza; Ashkelon is brought to nothing. You remnant of their valley, how long will you cut yourself?

hausa: Menahem ya huta tare da kakanninsa. Fekahiya ɗansa kuma ya gāje shi.
english: Menahem slept with his fathers, and Pekahiah his son reigned in his place.

hausa: “Da ba don an taƙaita kwanakin nan ba, da babu wani da zai tsira, amma saboda zaɓaɓɓun nan, za a taƙaita kwanakin.
english: Unless those days had been shortened, no flesh would have been saved. But for the sake of the chosen ones, those days will be shortened.

hausa: Amma yanzu al’ummai da yawa suna gāba da ke. Suna cewa, “Bari a ƙazantar da ita, bari mu zuba wa Sihiyona ido.”
english: Now many nations have assembled against you, that say, “Let her be defiled, and let our eye gloat over Zion.”

hausa: Da kun san ni, da za ku san Ubana ma. Daga yanzu, kun san shi kun kuma gan shi.”
english: If you had known me, you would have known my Father also. From now on, you know him and have seen him.”

hausa: Cetona da girmata sun dangana ga Allah ne, shi ne dutsena mai ƙarfi, mafakata.
english: My salvation and my honor is with God. The rock of my strength, and my refuge, is in God.

hausa: Amma har yanzu, Yesu bai ba da amsa ba, Bilatus ya yi mamaki.
english: But Jesus made no further answer, so that Pilate marveled.

hausa: Samson ya ce, “Bari in mutu tare da Filistiyawa!” Sa’an nan da dukan ƙarfinsa ya tura haikali ya fāɗa a kan shugabanni da dukan mutanen da suke ciki. Ta haka ya kashe mutane da yawa fiye da yayinda yake da rai.
english: Samson said, “Let me die with the Philistines!” He bowed himself with all his might; and the house fell on the lords, and on all the people who were in it. So the dead that he killed at his death were more than those who he killed in his life.

hausa: Yana yin abubuwan al’ajabi waɗanda ba a ganewa, mu’ujizai waɗanda ba a ƙirgawa.
english: who does great things that can’t be fathomed, marvelous things without number;

hausa: Shin, wane ne Afollos? Wane ne kuma Bulus? Ai, bayi ne kawai waɗanda ta wurinsu kuka gaskata, kamar yadda Ubangiji ya ba kowannensu aikinsa.
english: Who then is Apollos, and who is Paul, but servants through whom you believed, and each as the Lord gave to him?

hausa: Amma in ana wa’azi cewa Kiristi ya tashi daga matattu, yaya waɗansu a cikinku suke cewa babu tashin matattu?
english: Now if Christ is preached, that he has been raised from the dead, how do some among you say that there is no resurrection of the dead?

hausa: Bari yă tuna da dukan sadakokinka yă kuma karɓi hadayunka na ƙonawa. Sela
english: remember all your offerings, and accept your burned sacrifice. Selah.

hausa: Yesu kuwa yana ƙaunar Marta da ’yar’uwarta da kuma Lazarus.
english: Now Jesus loved Martha, and her sister, and Lazarus.

hausa: A ƙasar Uz akwai wani mutum mai suna Ayuba. Mutum ne marar laifi kuma mai adalci; yana tsoron Allah, ba ruwansa da mugunta.
english: There was a man in the land of Uz, whose name was Job. That man was blameless and upright, and one who feared God, and turned away from evil.

hausa: Duk waɗansu ’ya’yan da aka haifa maka bayansu za su zama naka; a yankin da suka gāda za a lissafa a ƙarƙashin sunayen ’yan’uwansu.
english: Your offspring, whom you become the father of after them, will be yours. They will be called after the name of their brothers in their inheritance.

hausa: Duk rayuwarsa ya ci abinci a cikin duhu, da ɓacin rai mai tsanani, da azaba, da fushi.
english: All his days he also eats in darkness, he is frustrated, and has sickness and wrath.

hausa: “Saboda haka zan koya musu a wannan lokaci zan koya musu ikona da ƙarfina. Sa’an nan za su sani cewa sunana Ubangiji ne.
english: “Therefore behold, I will cause them to know, this once I will cause them to know my hand and my might. Then they will know that my name is Yahweh.”

hausa: Ya fitar da ni zuwa wuri mai sarari; ya kuɓutar da ni, gama yana jin daɗina.
english: He brought me out also into a large place. He delivered me, because he delighted in me.

hausa: “Mene ne ƙaunatacciyata take yi a haikali da yake ta yin ƙulle-ƙullen mugayen makircinta tare da mutane masu yawa? Tsarkakar nama zai iya kawar da hukuncinki? Sa’ad da kike yin muguntarki sa’an nan ki yi farin ciki.”
english: What has my beloved to do in my house, since she has behaved lewdly with many, and the holy flesh has passed from you? When you do evil, then you rejoice.”

hausa: Duk wanda ya yi tafiya marar abin zargi zai zauna lafiya, amma duk wanda hanyoyinsa mugaye ne zai fāɗi nan da nan.
english: Whoever walks blamelessly is kept safe; but one with perverse ways will fall suddenly.

hausa: Da Arameyawan Damaskus suka zo su taimaki Hadadezer sarkin Zoba, sai Dawuda ya bugi dubu ashirin da biyunsu.
english: When the Syrians of Damascus came to help Hadadezer king of Zobah, David struck twenty-two thousand men of the Syrians.

hausa: Mulkinsa ya taso daga Dutsen Hermon, da Saleka, da dukan Bashan har zuwa iyakar Geshurawa da Ma’akatiyawa haɗe da rabin Gileyad, zuwa kan iyakar Heshbon ta sarki Sihon.
english: and ruled in Mount Hermon, and in Salecah, and in all Bashan, to the border of the Geshurites and the Maacathites, and half Gilead, the border of Sihon king of Heshbon.

hausa: Da yake magana game da mala’iku kuwa ya ce, “Ya mai da mala’ikunsa iska, bayinsa kuma harsunan wuta.”
english: Of the angels he says, “He makes his angels winds, and his servants a flame of fire.”

hausa: Irin su ne suke saɗaɗawa su shiga gidaje suna rinjayar mata marasa ƙarfin hali, waɗanda zunubai suka sha kansu, mugayen sha’awace-sha’awace kuma sun ɗauke hankulansu,
english: For some of these are people who creep into houses and take captive gullible women loaded down with sins, led away by various lusts,

hausa: Sarki Arewa kuma zai ƙara tara babbar rundunar soja, wadda ta fi ta dā girma; bayan waɗansu shekaru kuma, zai tafi yaƙi da babbar rundunar mayaƙa cike da kayan yaƙi.
english: The king of the north will return, and will send out a multitude greater than the former. He will come on at the end of the times, even of years, with a great army and with abundant supplies.

hausa: Har yanzu, ka ɗibi kaɗan na waɗannan ka zuba su cikin wuta su kuma ƙone. Wuta zai bazu daga nan zuwa dukan gidan Isra’ila.
english: Of these again you shall take, and cast them into the middle of the fire, and burn them in the fire. From it a fire will come out into all the house of Israel.

hausa: Ga jerin sunayen ’ya’yan Ishmayel maza bisa ga haihuwarsu, Nebayiwot ɗan farin Ishmayel, Kedar, Adbeyel, Mibsam,
english: These are the names of the sons of Ishmael, by their names, according to the order of their birth: the firstborn of Ishmael, Nebaioth, then Kedar, Adbeel, Mibsam,

hausa: Ubangiji ya ce wa Musa,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

hausa: Ka riƙe umarni, kada ka bari yă kuɓuce; ka tsare shi sosai, gama ranka ne.
english: Take firm hold of instruction. Don’t let her go. Keep her, for she is your life.

hausa: Cikin fariyarsa mugun mutum yakan cuci marasa ƙarfi, waɗanda yake kama cikin makircin da ya shirya.
english: In arrogance, the wicked hunt down the weak. They are caught in the schemes that they devise.

hausa: Dawuda ya faɗi haka sa’ad da ya yi magana game da albarkar da aka yi wa mutumin da Allah ya lissafta adalci a gare shi, ba don yă yi ayyuka ba.
english: Even as David also pronounces blessing on the man to whom God counts righteousness apart from works:

hausa: A wannan lokaci Merodak-Baladan ɗan Baladan sarkin Babilon ya aika wa Hezekiya wasiƙu da kuma kyauta, domin ya ji rashin lafiyarsa da kuma warkarwarsa.
english: At that time, Merodach-baladan the son of Baladan, king of Babylon, sent letters and a present to Hezekiah, for he heard that he had been sick, and had recovered.

hausa: saboda haka Dawuda ya nemi nufin Ubangiji, ya kuwa ce, “Kada ka haura kai tsaye, amma ka kewaya ta bayansu ka fāɗa musu a gaban itatuwan balsam.
english: When David inquired of Yahweh, he said, “You shall not go up. Circle around behind them, and attack them in front of the mulberry trees.

hausa: da Shabbetai, da kuma Yozabad, biyu cikin shugabanni Lawiyawa waɗanda suke da nawayar aiki waje da gidan Allah.
english: and Shabbethai and Jozabad, of the chiefs of the Levites, who had the oversight of the outward business of God’s house;

hausa: Saboda haka mun ga cewa ba su iya shiga ba, saboda rashin bangaskiyarsu ne.
english: We see that they weren’t able to enter in because of unbelief.

hausa: ya ba su ƙasashen al’ummai, suka kuma sami gādon abin da waɗansu sun sha wahala a kai,
english: He gave them the lands of the nations. They took the labor of the peoples in possession,

hausa: Ba ku sani ba? Ba ku ji ba? Ubangiji madawwamin Allah ne, Mahaliccin iyakokin duniya. Ba zai taɓa gaji ko yă kasala ba, kuma fahimtarsa ya wuce gaban ganewar mutum.
english: Haven’t you known? Haven’t you heard? The everlasting God, Yahweh, the Creator of the ends of the earth, doesn’t faint. He isn’t weary. His understanding is unsearchable.

hausa: Ya fi kyau in nemi mafaka a wurin Ubangiji da in dogara ga sarakuna.
english: It is better to take refuge in Yahweh, than to put confidence in princes.

hausa: Duk wanda ya zargi Ɗan Mutum, za a gafarta masa, amma duk wanda ya zargi Ruhu Mai Tsarki, ba za a gafarta masa ba, ko a wannan zamani ko a zamani mai zuwa.
english: Whoever speaks a word against the Son of Man, it will be forgiven him; but whoever speaks against the Holy Spirit, it will not be forgiven him, either in this age, or in that which is to come.

hausa: Ko da ma gawar ta mahaifinsa ce, ko ta mahaifiyarsa, ko ta ɗan mahaifiyarsa, ko kuma ta ’yar’uwarsa ce, ba zai ƙazantar da kansa saboda su ba, domin alamar keɓewarsa ga Allah tana kansa.
english: He shall not make himself unclean for his father, or for his mother, for his brother, or for his sister, when they die, because his separation to God is on his head.

hausa: Ya ce wa yaron, “Yi ruga da gudu ka nemo kibiyoyin da na harba.” Da yaron ya ruga sai ya harba kibiya a gaba da shi.
english: He said to his boy, “Run, find now the arrows which I shoot.” As the boy ran, he shot an arrow beyond him.

hausa: Ku saki zuciya da mu. Ba mu yi wa kowa laifi ba, ba mu ɓata kowa ba, ba mu cuci kowa ba.
english: Open your hearts to us. We wronged no one. We corrupted no one. We took advantage of no one.

hausa: Zan yabe ka har abada game da abin da ka yi; a cikin sunanka zan dogara, gama sunanka yana da kyau. Zan yabe ka a gaban tsarkakanka.
english: I will give you thanks forever, because you have done it. I will hope in your name, for it is good, in the presence of your saints.

hausa: Ka aiko da walƙiya ka watsar da abokan gāba; ka karɓa kibiyoyinka ka sa su gudu.
english: Throw out lightning, and scatter them. Send out your arrows, and rout them.

hausa: A can suka iske Adoni-Bezek, suka yaƙe shi, suka fatattaki Kan’aniyawa da Ferizziyawa.
english: They found Adoni-Bezek in Bezek, and they fought against him. They struck the Canaanites and the Perizzites.

hausa: Sai sarkin Assuriya ya ba da umarni cewa, “A sami wani daga cikin firistocin da aka kwaso zuwa bauta daga Samariya, yă koma yă zauna a can, yă koya wa mutanen abin da allahn ƙasar yake bukata.”
english: Then the king of Assyria commanded, saying, “Carry there one of the priests whom you brought from there; and let him go and dwell there, and let him teach them the law of the god of the land.”

hausa: bisa mutanen Zebulun shi ne, Ishmahiya ɗan Obadiya; bisa mutanen Naftali shi ne, Yerimot ɗan Azriyel;
english: of Zebulun, Ishmaiah the son of Obadiah; of Naphtali, Jeremoth the son of Azriel;

hausa: Sa’an nan shafaffen firist zai ɗibi jinin bijimi zuwa cikin Tentin Sujada.
english: The anointed priest shall bring some of the blood of the bull to the Tent of Meeting.

hausa: Haka ma, ku matan aure, ku yi biyayya ga mazanku, domin in waɗansunsu ba su gaskata maganar ba, wataƙila a shawo kansu ba tare da magana ba
english: In the same way, wives, be in subjection to your own husbands, so that, even if any don’t obey the Word, they may be won by the behavior of their wives without a word,

hausa: Yahat shi ne na fari, Ziza kuma na biyu, amma Yewush da Beriya ba su haifi ’ya’ya maza da yawa ba; saboda haka aka ƙidaya su kamar iyali ɗaya a wurin rabon aiki.
english: Jahath was the chief, and Zizah the second; but Jeush and Beriah didn’t have many sons; therefore they became a fathers’ house in one reckoning.

hausa: Misali, bisa ga doka mace mai aure tana daure ga mijinta muddin mijin yana da rai, amma in mijinta ya mutu, an sake ta ke nan daga dokar aure.
english: For the woman that has a husband is bound by law to the husband while he lives, but if the husband dies, she is discharged from the law of the husband.

hausa: Babu wani abu a cikin akwatin alkawarin sai alluna biyu da Musa ya sa a cikinsa a Horeb, inda Ubangiji ya yi alkawari da Isra’ilawa bayan sun fito Masar.
english: There was nothing in the ark except the two tablets which Moses put there at Horeb, when Yahweh made a covenant with the children of Israel, when they came out of Egypt.

hausa: “Ku yi hankali da malaman dokoki. Sukan so sa manyan riguna suna zaga, suna sha’awan karɓan gaisuwa a wuraren kasuwanci, da kuma wuraren zama mafi daraja a majami’u, da wuraren bangirma a bukukkuwa.
english: “Beware of those scribes who like to walk in long robes, and love greetings in the marketplaces, the best seats in the synagogues, and the best places at feasts;

hausa: Amalekawa suka zo, suka yaƙi Isra’ilawa a Refidim.
english: Then Amalek came and fought with Israel in Rephidim.

hausa: Bari su zama naka kaɗai, don kada ka raba da baƙi.
english: Let them be for yourself alone, not for strangers with you.

hausa: Bayan ambaliyar, Nuhu ya yi shekaru 350.
english: Noah lived three hundred fifty years after the flood.

hausa: ta Harim 1,017.
english: The children of Harim, one thousand seventeen.

hausa: Ibrahim ya auro wata mace, mai suna Ketura.
english: Abraham took another wife, and her name was Keturah.

hausa: “In na hana wa matalauta abin da suke so, ko kuma in sa idanun gwauruwa su yi nauyi don kuka,
english: “If I have withheld the poor from their desire, or have caused the eyes of the widow to fail,

hausa: Masu bin da suke da kaciya waɗanda suka zo tare da Bitrus suka yi mamaki cewa an ba da kyautar Ruhu Mai Tsarki har ma a kan Al’ummai.
english: They of the circumcision who believed were amazed, as many as came with Peter, because the gift of the Holy Spirit was also poured out on the Gentiles.

hausa: dukan mutanen ƙasar suka yi murna. Birnin ya sami salama don an kashe Ataliya da takobi a fada.
english: So all the people of the land rejoiced, and the city was quiet. They had slain Athaliah with the sword at the king’s house.

hausa: Na ce, “Da dukan iyakar ƙoƙarinmu, mun fanshi ’yan’uwanmu Yahudawan da aka sayar wa Al’ummai. Amma ga shi kuna sayar da ’yan’uwanku ga Al’ummai, don kawai a sāke sayar mana da su!”
english: I said to them, “We, after our ability, have redeemed our brothers the Jews that were sold to the nations; and would you even sell your brothers, and should they be sold to us?” Then they held their peace, and found not a word to say.

hausa: Daga cikin hasken gabansa garwashi wuta mai ci ya yi walƙiya.
english: At the brightness before him, coals of fire were kindled.

hausa: A can kursiyoyin shari’a yake tsaye, kursiyoyin gidan Dawuda.
english: For there are set thrones for judgment, the thrones of David’s house.

hausa: Ina tsakiyar zakoki; ina kwance a cikin namun jeji masu cin mutane, mutanen da haƙoransu masu ne da kuma kibiyoyi, waɗanda harshensu suna da kaifi kamar takobi.
english: My soul is among lions. I lie among those who are set on fire, even the sons of men, whose teeth are spears and arrows, and their tongue a sharp sword.

hausa: “An kashe fitilar mugu; harshen wutarsa ya daina ci.
english: “Yes, the light of the wicked will be put out. The spark of his fire won’t shine.

hausa: Ko da sun yi renon ’ya’ya, zan sa su yi baƙin cikin kowannensu. Kaitonsu sa’ad da na juya musu baya!
english: Though they bring up their children, yet I will bereave them, so that not a man shall be left. Indeed, woe also to them when I depart from them!

hausa: Ka karɓi hakkinka ka tafi. Ni na ga damar ba waɗannan na ƙarshe daidai da yadda na ba ka.
english: Take that which is yours, and go your way. It is my desire to give to this last just as much as to you.

hausa: “Bari dukan waɗanda suke marasa azanci su zo nan ciki!” Tana faɗa wa marasa hankali.
english: “Whoever is simple, let him turn in here!” As for him who is void of understanding, she says to him,

hausa: Bawan ya yi sauri ya same ta ya ce, “Ina roƙonki ki ba ni ɗan ruwa daga tulunki.”
english: The servant ran to meet her, and said, “Please give me a drink, a little water from your pitcher.”

hausa: Sa’an nan Ubangiji ya ce wa Musa, “Miƙa hannunka sama don a yi ƙanƙara a bisa dukan Masar, a bisa mutane da dabbobi, da bisa dukan abubuwan da suke girma a gonakin Masar.”
