english: Yahweh said to Moses, “Stretch out your hand toward the sky, that there may be hail in all the land of Egypt, on man, and on animal, and on every herb of the field, throughout the land of Egypt.”

hausa: Sai na ji wata murya daga sama ta ce, “Ku fita daga cikinta, mutanena, don kada zunubanta su shafe ku, don kada wata annobarta ta same ku;
english: I heard another voice from heaven, saying, “Come out of her, my people, that you have no participation in her sins, and that you don’t receive of her plagues,

hausa: Sai Yaƙub ya aiki manzanni su sha gabansa zuwa wurin ɗan’uwansa Isuwa a ƙasar Seyir, a ƙauyen Edom.
english: Jacob sent messengers in front of him to Esau, his brother, to the land of Seir, the field of Edom.

hausa: In kuka ce, “Ai, ba mu san wani abu a kai wannan ba,” shi da yake awon ba shi da zuciyar ganewa ne? Shi da yake tsare ranka bai sani ba ne? Ba zai sāka wa kowane mutum bisa ga abin da ya aikata ba?
english: If you say, “Behold, we didn’t know this,” doesn’t he who weighs the hearts consider it? He who keeps your soul, doesn’t he know it? Shall he not give to every man according to his work?

hausa: Sa’ad da Ubangiji ya fara magana ta wurin Hosiya, Ubangiji ya ce masa, “Ka tafi, ka auro wa kanka mazinaciya da ’ya’yan da aka haifa ta hanyar rashin aminci, domin ƙasar tana da laifin mummunan zina ta wurin rabuwa da Ubangiji.”
english: When Yahweh spoke at first by Hosea, Yahweh said to Hosea, “Go, take for yourself a wife of prostitution and children of unfaithfulness; for the land commits great adultery, forsaking Yahweh.”

hausa: “Yanzu, ya Ubangiji Allahnmu, wanda ya fito da mutanensa daga Masar ta hannu mai ƙarfi wanda kuma ya yi wa kansa sunan da ya dawwama har yă zuwa yau, mun yi zunubi, mun yi abin da ba daidai ba.
english: “Now, Lord our God, who has brought your people out of the land of Egypt with a mighty hand, and have gotten yourself renown, as it is today, we have sinned. We have done wickedly.

hausa: Jimillar maza daga mutanen Benyamin 35,400 ne.
english: those who were counted of them, of the tribe of Benjamin, were thirty-five thousand four hundred.

hausa: Ba wanda ya iya gani wani ko yă bar wurinsa na kwana uku. Amma dukan Isra’ilawa sun kasance da haske a inda suke zama.
english: They didn’t see one another, and nobody rose from his place for three days; but all the children of Israel had light in their dwellings.

hausa: Amma Yehoshafat ya yi tambaya ya ce, “Babu wani annabin Ubangiji a nan da za mu tambaya?”
english: But Jehoshaphat said, “Isn’t there here a prophet of Yahweh besides, that we may inquire of him?”

hausa: Ina cin naman bijimai ne ko ina shan jinin awaki ne?
english: Will I eat the meat of bulls, or drink the blood of goats?

hausa: Dukiyarka ko dukan yawan ƙoƙarinka sun isa su riƙe ka su hana ka shan ƙunci?
english: Would your wealth sustain you in distress, or all the might of your strength?

hausa: Aka ninka girmama shi bisa Ukun, sai ya zama shugaba, ko da yake ba a haɗa shi a cikinsu ba.
english: Of the three, he was more honorable than the two, and was made their captain; however he wasn’t included in the three.

hausa: Za ka sha daga rafin, zan kuma umarci hankaki su ciyar da kai a can.”
english: You shall drink from the brook. I have commanded the ravens to feed you there.”

hausa: Duk da haka ka ce, ‘Me Allah ya sani? A cikin duhu ne yake shari’a?
english: You say, ‘What does God know? Can he judge through the thick darkness?

hausa: cewa za a ’yantar da halitta kanta daga bautarta ga ruɓewa a kuma kawo ta cikin ’yancin ɗaukakar ’ya’yan Allah.
english: that the creation itself also will be delivered from the bondage of decay into the liberty of the glory of the children of God.

hausa: Sai ɗaya ta ce, “Ranka yă daɗe, wannan mata da ni muna zama a gida ɗaya. Na haifi jariri yayinda take can tare da ni.
english: The one woman said, “Oh, my lord, I and this woman dwell in one house. I delivered a child with her in the house.

hausa: Sai Allahna ya sa a zuciyata in tara manyan gari, shugabanni da talakawa don a rubuta su bisa ga iyalansu. Na sami littafin asali na waɗanda suka fara dawowa. Ga abin da na tarar an rubuta a ciki.
english: My God put into my heart to gather together the nobles, and the rulers, and the people, that they might be listed by genealogy. I found the book of the genealogy of those who came up at the first, and I found this written in it:

hausa: Firistoci ba su iya shiga haikalin Ubangiji ba domin ɗaukakar Ubangiji ta cika shi.
english: The priests could not enter into Yahweh’s house, because Yahweh’s glory filled Yahweh’s house.

hausa: Ku rera ga Ubangiji, ku yabe sunansa; ku yi shelar cetonsa kowace rana.
english: Sing to Yahweh! Bless his name! Proclaim his salvation from day to day!

hausa: Sarakunanmu, da shugabanninmu, da firistocinmu da kuma kakanninmu ba su bi dokarka ba, ba su ma mai da hankali ga umarnanka ko gargaɗin da ka yi musu ba.
english: Also our kings, our princes, our priests, and our fathers have not kept your law, nor listened to your commandments and your testimonies with which you testified against them.

hausa: Sai ya farka ya tsawata wa iskar, ya ce wa raƙuman ruwan, “Shiru! Ku natsu!” Sai iskar ta kwanta, kome kuma ya yi tsit.
english: He awoke and rebuked the wind, and said to the sea, “Peace! Be still!” The wind ceased and there was a great calm.

hausa: Ammonawa suka fito suka ja dāgā a ƙofar birninsu, yayinda sarakunan da suka zo, su kansu suka ware suna a fili.
english: The children of Ammon came out, and put the battle in array at the gate of the city; and the kings who had come were by themselves in the field.

hausa: “Ya Uba Mai Adalci, ko da yake duniya ba tă san ka ba, ni na san ka, sun kuma san kai ka aiko ni.
english: Righteous Father, the world hasn’t known you, but I knew you; and these knew that you sent me.

hausa: A miƙa hadayar da aka yi da wuta mai daɗin ƙanshi ga Ubangiji, a yi hadaya ta ƙonawa da bijimi guda, rago guda, da ’yan raguna bakwai, bana ɗaya-ɗaya, dukansu marasa lahani.
english: but you shall offer a burnt offering, an offering made by fire, a pleasant aroma to Yahweh: one bull, one ram, seven male lambs a year old without defect;

hausa: “ ‘Za a yi Bikin Ƙetarewa ga Ubangiji a rana ta goma sha huɗu ga wata na fari.
english: “‘In the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month, is Yahweh’s Passover.

hausa: “Ko da yake Efraim ya gina bagadai masu yawa don hadayun zunubi, waɗannan sun zama bagade don yin zunubi.
english: Because Ephraim has multiplied altars for sinning, they became for him altars for sinning.

hausa: Waɗansu mutane suna kama da irin da ya fāɗi a kan hanya, inda akan shuka maganar Allah. Da jin maganar, nan da nan sai Shaiɗan yă zo yă ɗauke maganar da aka shuka a zuciyarsu.
english: The ones by the road are the ones where the word is sown; and when they have heard, immediately Satan comes and takes away the word which has been sown in them.

hausa: Duk wanda ya jagorance masu aikata gaskiya a hanyar mugunta zai fāɗa cikin tarkonsa amma marasa abin zargi za su sami gādo mai kyau.
english: Whoever causes the upright to go astray in an evil way, he will fall into his own trap; but the blameless will inherit good.

hausa: Ka rage kwanakin ƙuruciyarsa; ka rufe shi da mayafin kunya. Sela
english: You have shortened the days of his youth. You have covered him with shame. Selah.

hausa: Ka yayyanka rago gunduwa-gunduwa, ka wanke kayan cikin, da ƙafafun, da kan, ka haɗa su da gunduwoyin.
english: You shall cut the ram into its pieces, and wash its innards, and its legs, and put them with its pieces, and with its head.

hausa: Musa da Haruna suka aikata yadda Ubangiji ya umarce su.
english: Moses and Aaron did so. As Yahweh commanded them, so they did.

hausa: Nan da nan, ya tashi tsaye a gabansu, ya ɗauki tabarmar da yake kwance a kai, ya tafi gida, yana yabon Allah.
english: Immediately he rose up before them, and took up that which he was laying on, and departed to his house, glorifying God.

hausa: Sai sarki ya tashi, haka kuma gwamna da Bernis da kuma waɗanda suke zaune tare da su.
english: The king rose up with the governor and Bernice, and those who sat with them.

hausa: ‘Gama a cikinsa ne muke rayuwa muke motsi muka kuma kasance.’ Yadda waɗansu mawaƙanku suka ce, ‘Mu zuriyarsa ce.’
english: ‘For in him we live, move, and have our being.’ As some of your own poets have said, ‘For we are also his offspring.’

hausa: Ubangiji ya ce, “Waɗannan mutane sun zo kusa da ni da bakinsu suka kuma girmama ni da leɓunansu, amma zukatansu suna nesa daga gare ni. Sujadar da suke mini cike take da dokokin da mutane suka koyar.
english: The Lord said, “Because this people draws near with their mouth and honors me with their lips, but they have removed their heart far from me, and their fear of me is a commandment of men which has been taught;

hausa: Kafin fāɗuwarsa zuciyar mutum takan yi girman kai, amma sauƙinkai kan zo kafin girmamawa.
english: Before destruction the heart of man is proud, but before honor is humility.

hausa: Mutanen kuma suka ce, “Za mu bauta wa Ubangiji Allahnmu, mu kuma yi masa biyayya.”
english: The people said to Joshua, “We will serve Yahweh our God, and we will listen to his voice.”

hausa: Sunan kogi na biyu, Gihon. Shi ne ya malala kewaye da ƙasar Kush.
english: The name of the second river is Gihon. It is the same river that flows through the whole land of Cush.

hausa: Ba za ka yi amfani da sunan Ubangiji Allahnka a banza ba, gama Ubangiji zai hukunta duk wanda ya mai da sunansa banza.
english: “You shall not misuse the name of Yahweh your God, for Yahweh will not hold him guiltless who misuses his name.

hausa: Saboda haka, ku ji abin da Ubangiji ya shirya a kan Babilon, abin da ya nufa gāba da ƙasar Babiloniyawa. Za a kwashe ƙananan garkensu a tafi; zai hallaka wurin kiwonsu sarai saboda su.
english: Therefore hear the counsel of Yahweh that he has taken against Babylon; and his purposes that he has purposed against the land of the Chaldeans: Surely they will drag them away, even the little ones of the flock. Surely he will make their habitation desolate over them.

hausa: ga abin da maganar Ubangiji ya faɗa a kansa, “Budurwa Diyar Sihiyona ta rena tana kuma maka ba’a. Diyar Urushalima tana kada kai yayinda kake gudu.
english: this is the word which Yahweh has spoken concerning him: The virgin daughter of Zion has despised you and ridiculed you. The daughter of Jerusalem has shaken her head at you.

hausa: Sa’an nan suka yi kuka ga Ubangiji cikin wahalarsu, ya kuwa cece su daga damuwarsu.
english: Then they cry to Yahweh in their trouble, and he saves them out of their distresses.

hausa: Zan tashi in koma wurin mahaifina, in ce masa, “Baba, na yi wa sama, na kuma yi maka zunubi.
english: I will get up and go to my father, and will tell him, “Father, I have sinned against heaven and in your sight.

hausa: Wata rana yayinda yake sujada a haikalin Nisrok, allahnsa, sai ’ya’yansa maza, Adrammelek da Sharezer suka kashe shi da takobi, suka gudu zuwa ƙasar Ararat. Sai Esar-Haddon ɗansa ya gāje shi.
english: As he was worshiping in the house of Nisroch his god, Adrammelech and Sharezer struck him with the sword; and they escaped into the land of Ararat. Esar Haddon his son reigned in his place.

hausa: Ko da yake ita ce mafi ƙanƙanta cikin ƙwayoyinku, duk da haka sa’ad da ta yi girma, takan zama mafi girma cikin tsire-tsiren lambu ta kuma zama itace, har tsuntsayen sararin sama su zo su yi sheƙa a rassansa.”
english: which indeed is smaller than all seeds. But when it is grown, it is greater than the herbs and becomes a tree, so that the birds of the air come and lodge in its branches.”

hausa: “ ‘Kada ka yi jima’i da mace da kuma ’yarta. Kada ka yi jima’i da ’yar ɗanta ko ’yar ’yarta; su danginta ne na kusa. Wannan mugun abu ne.
english: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of a woman and her daughter. You shall not take her son’s daughter, or her daughter’s daughter, to uncover her nakedness. They are near kinswomen. It is wickedness.

hausa: amma ba zan ɗauke ƙaunata daga gare shi ba, ba kuwa zan taɓa rasa cika amincina ba.
english: But I will not completely take my loving kindness from him, nor allow my faithfulness to fail.

hausa: Saboda haka suka kama ta yayinda ta kai inda dawakai sukan shiga filin fada, a can kuwa aka kashe ta.
english: So they seized her; and she went by the way of the horses’ entry to the king’s house, and she was slain there.

hausa: Kwana uku yana a makance, bai ci ba bai kuma sha kome ba.
english: He was without sight for three days, and neither ate nor drank.

hausa: Gama ba ka yi biyayya ga Ubangiji ba, ba ka zartar da hukuncinsa mai zafi a kan Amalekawa ba. Saboda haka Ubangiji ya yi maka haka yau.
english: Because you didn’t obey Yahweh’s voice, and didn’t execute his fierce wrath on Amalek, therefore Yahweh has done this thing to you today.

hausa: Sai Benahiya ya shiga tentin Ubangiji ya ce wa Yowab, “Sarki ya ce, ‘Ka fita!’ ” Amma Yowab ya amsa ya ce, “A’a, a nan zan mutu.” Sai Benahiya ya ce wa sarki, “Ga yadda Yowab ya amsa mini.”
english: Benaiah came to Yahweh’s Tent, and said to him, “The king says, ‘Come out!’” He said, “No; but I will die here.” Benaiah brought the king word again, saying, “This is what Joab said, and this is how he answered me.”

hausa: Gama in ya sa tushen gini, amma bai iya gamawa ba, duk wanda ya gani zai yi masa ba’a,
english: Or perhaps, when he has laid a foundation and isn’t able to finish, everyone who sees begins to mock him,

hausa: “ ‘In bayan dukan wannan, ba ku saurare ni ba, zan hukunta ku saboda zunubanku har sau bakwai.
english: “‘If you in spite of these things will not listen to me, then I will chastise you seven times more for your sins.

hausa: Duk mai yin laifi yă ci gaba da yin laifi; duk mai aikata ƙazanta yă ci gaba da aikata ƙazanta. Duk mai aikata abin da yake daidai, yă ci gaba da aikata abin da yake daidai. Kuma duk wanda yake mai tsarki, yă ci gaba da yin abin da yake da tsarki.”
english: He who acts unjustly, let him act unjustly still. He who is filthy, let him be filthy still. He who is righteous, let him do righteousness still. He who is holy, let him be holy still.”

hausa: maganar Ubangiji ta zo wa Ezekiyel firist, ɗan Buzi, kusa da Kogin Kebar a ƙasar Babiloniyawa. A can hannun Ubangiji yana a kansa.
english: Yahweh’s word came to Ezekiel the priest, the son of Buzi, in the land of the Chaldeans by the river Chebar; and Yahweh’s hand was there on him.

hausa: Allah ya sa su a sararin sama domin su ba da haske a duniya,
english: God set them in the expanse of the sky to give light to the earth,

hausa: Kada ka yi marmarin abincinsa mai daɗi gama wannan abinci ruɗu ne.
english: Don’t be desirous of his dainties, since they are deceitful food.

hausa: Ya sa dutsen Lebanon ya yi ta tsalle kamar ɗan maraƙi, Siriyon kuma kamar ɗan jakin jeji.
english: He makes them also to skip like a calf; Lebanon and Sirion like a young, wild ox.

hausa: Suka yi koyarwa a dukan Yahuda, suna ɗauke da Littafin Dokar Ubangiji tare da su; suka tafi ko’ina a dukan garuruwan Yahuda suka koyar da mutane.
english: They taught in Judah, having the book of Yahweh’s law with them. They went about throughout all the cities of Judah and taught among the people.

hausa: Sai suka amsa masa suka ce, “Ai, mu zuriyar Ibrahim ne kuma ba mu taɓa bauta wa kowa ba. Yaya za ka ce za a ’yantar da mu?”
english: They answered him, “We are Abraham’s offspring, and have never been in bondage to anyone. How do you say, ‘You will be made free’?”

hausa: Ka ƙara kwanakin ran sarki, shekarunsa su kasance a zamanai masu yawa.
english: You will prolong the king’s life. His years will be for generations.

hausa: Mun kuma kawo ƙarin azurfa tare da mu don mu saya abinci. Ba mu san wa ya sa azurfanmu a cikin buhunanmu ba.”
english: We have brought down other money in our hand to buy food. We don’t know who put our money in our sacks.”

hausa: biyar domin waɗanda suke ɗayan gefen da kuma biyar domin katakan da suke gefen yamma na iyaka ta ƙarshen tabanakul.
english: and five bars for the boards of the other side of the tabernacle, and five bars for the boards of the tabernacle for the hinder part westward.

hausa: Sai Gad ya zo wurin Dawuda ya ce masa, “Kana so a yi yunwa shekara uku a ƙasarka? Ko kana so ka yi ta gudu a gaban abokan gābanka har wata uku? Ko kuwa ka fi so a yi annoba kwana uku a ƙasarka? Yanzu, sai ka yi tunani, ka yanke shawarar game da amsar da zan mayar wa wanda ya aiko ni.”
english: So Gad came to David, and told him, saying, “Shall seven years of famine come to you in your land? Or will you flee three months before your foes while they pursue you? Or shall there be three days’ pestilence in your land? Now answer, and consider what answer I shall return to him who sent me.”

hausa: Ubangiji ka kafa salama dominmu; duk abin da muka iya yi kai ne ka yi mana.
english: Yahweh, you will ordain peace for us, for you have also done all our work for us.

hausa: Yana da ɗa mai suna Shawulu, wani kyakkyawan saurayi. A cikin mutanen Isra’ila ba wanda ya fi shi kyau, ya kuma fi kowa tsaye.
english: He had a son whose name was Saul, an impressive young man; and there was not among the children of Israel a more handsome person than he. From his shoulders and upward he was taller than any of the people.

hausa: An sa dole su zauna a kwazazzabai da kuma cikin kogunan duwatsu da kuma cikin ramummuka cikin ƙasa.
english: so that they live in frightful valleys, and in holes of the earth and of the rocks.

hausa: Maganar Ubangiji ta zo mini cewa,
english: Yahweh’s word came to me again, saying,

hausa: Ubangiji zai wanke duk wani ƙazantar matan Sihiyona; ya tsabtacce jinin da aka zubar daga Urushalima ta wurin ruhun hukunci da yake ƙuna kamar wuta.
english: when the Lord shall have washed away the filth of the daughters of Zion, and shall have purged the blood of Jerusalem from within it, by the spirit of justice and by the spirit of burning.

hausa: Duk wanda ya zaɓi yin nufin Allah, zai gane ko koyarwata daga Allah ce, ko kuwa don kaina ne nake magana.
english: If anyone desires to do his will, he will know about the teaching, whether it is from God or if I am speaking from myself.

hausa: Sa’ad da wata mutuniyar Samariya ta zo ɗiban ruwa, sai Yesu ya ce mata, “Ba ni ruwa in sha?”
english: A woman of Samaria came to draw water. Jesus said to her, “Give me a drink.”

hausa: Mayaƙan Yahuda suka kuma kama mutane dubu goma da rai, suka ɗauke su zuwa ƙwanƙolin dutsen, suka yi ta tunkuɗa su ƙasa suka yi kaca-kaca.
english: The children of Judah carried away ten thousand alive, and brought them to the top of the rock, and threw them down from the top of the rock, so that they all were broken in pieces.

hausa: Daga wannan lokaci, Yahuda ya yi ta neman zarafin da zai miƙa shi.
english: From that time he sought opportunity to betray him.

hausa: sai Yahudawa suka taru kewaye da shi, suka ce masa, “Har yaushe za ka bar mu da shakka? In kai ne Kiristin, ka faɗa mana a fili mana.”
english: The Jews therefore came around him and said to him, “How long will you hold us in suspense? If you are the Christ, tell us plainly.”

hausa: ’Yan’uwa, ban ɗauki kaina a kan cewa na riga na sami abin ba. Sai dai abu guda nake yi. Ina mantawa da abin da yake baya, ina kuma nacewa zuwa ga samun abin da yake gaba,
english: Brothers, I don’t regard myself as yet having taken hold, but one thing I do: forgetting the things which are behind and stretching forward to the things which are before,

hausa: A ƙarshe, ita macen ma ta mutu.
english: Afterward the woman also died.

hausa: Da zai shiga wani ƙauye, sai maza goma da suke da kuturta suka sadu da shi. Suka tsaya da nesa,
english: As he entered into a certain village, ten men who were lepers met him, who stood at a distance.

hausa: Dawuda ya ce wa Gibeyonawa, “Me zan yi muku? Yaya zan yi kafara domin ku sa wa masu gādon Ubangiji albarka?”
english: and David said to the Gibeonites, “What should I do for you? And with what should I make atonement, that you may bless Yahweh’s inheritance?”

hausa: Yakan tsare marayu da gwauraye, yana ƙaunar baƙon da yake zama a cikinku, yana ba su abinci da tufafi.
english: He executes justice for the fatherless and widow and loves the foreigner in giving him food and clothing.

hausa: Idanuna ba sa gani sosai don baƙin ciki; jikina ya zama kamar inuwa kawai
english: My eye also is dim by reason of sorrow. All my members are as a shadow.

hausa: “ ‘Ga abin da Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka yana cewa domin mutane suna magana game da ku cewa, “Kun cinye mutane kuka kuma sa al’ummarku ta rasa ’ya’yanta,”
english: “‘The Lord Yahweh says: “Because they say to you, ‘You are a devourer of men, and have been a bereaver of your nation;’

hausa: Amma yanzu wahala ta zo maka, sai ka karaya; wahala ta sa ka rikice.
english: But now it has come to you, and you faint. It touches you, and you are troubled.

hausa: Allahna zai ƙi su saboda ba su yi masa biyayya ba; za su zama masu yawo a cikin al’ummai.
english: My God will cast them away, because they didn’t listen to him; and they will be wanderers among the nations.

hausa: Saboda haka za su zama kamar hazon safiya, kamar raɓar safen da yakan kakkaɓe, kamar ƙaiƙayin da ake tankaɗe daga masussuka, kamar hayaƙin da yake fita daga taga.
english: Therefore they will be like the morning mist, like the dew that passes away early, like the chaff that is driven with the whirlwind out of the threshing floor, and like the smoke out of the chimney.

hausa: ko da yake ba Yesu ne yake baftismar ba, almajiransa ne.
english: (although Jesus himself didn’t baptize, but his disciples),

hausa: Firjiya da Famfiliya, Masar da sassa Libiya kusa da Sairin; baƙi daga Roma
english: Phrygia, Pamphylia, Egypt, the parts of Libya around Cyrene, visitors from Rome, both Jews and proselytes,

hausa: Na ga cewa macen ta bugu da jinin tsarkaka, jinin waɗanda suka shaida Yesu. Da na gan ta, sai na yi mamaki ƙwarai.
english: I saw the woman drunken with the blood of the saints and with the blood of the martyrs of Jesus. When I saw her, I wondered with great amazement.

hausa: Ya yi rumman jeri biyu kewaye da kowace yanar don yă yi adon dajiyoyin a bisa ginshiƙan. Haka kuma ya yi wa ɗaya dajiyar.
english: So he made the pillars; and there were two rows of pomegranates around the one network, to cover the capitals that were on the top of the pillars; and he did so for the other capital.

hausa: “Na tambaye ta, ‘Ke ’yar wane ne?’ “Ta ce, ‘’Yar Betuwel ɗan Nahor, wanda Milka ta haifa masa.’ “Sai na sa mata zobe a hancinta, woroworo kuma a hannuwata,
english: I asked her, and said, ‘Whose daughter are you?’ She said, ‘The daughter of Bethuel, Nahor’s son, whom Milcah bore to him.’ I put the ring on her nose, and the bracelets on her hands.

hausa: Saboda haka ya tafi ya kama yanyawa ɗari uku ya ɗaura wutsiyoyinsu wutsiya da wutsiya. Sa’an nan ya daure acibalbal a tsakanin ko waɗanne wutsiya biyu,
english: Samson went and caught three hundred foxes, and took torches, and turned tail to tail, and put a torch in the middle between every two tails.

hausa: Sa’ad da Ahaziya sarkin Yahuda ya ga abin da ya faru, sai ya haura hanyar Bet Haggan a guje. Yehu ya bi shi yana ihu, “A kashe shi, shi ma!” Suka ji masa rauni a keken yaƙinsa a hanya zuwa Gur, kusa da Ibileyam amma ya tsere zuwa Megiddo ya mutu a can.
english: But when Ahaziah the king of Judah saw this, he fled by the way of the garden house. Jehu followed after him, and said, “Strike him also in the chariot!” They struck him at the ascent of Gur, which is by Ibleam. He fled to Megiddo, and died there.

hausa: “Duk da haka, sau nawa fitilar mugu take mutuwa? Sau nawa bala’i yake auka masa, ko Allah ya taɓa hukunta mugu cikin fushi?
english: “How often is it that the lamp of the wicked is put out, that their calamity comes on them, that God distributes sorrows in his anger?

hausa: Ra’ayin nan naku ya yi mini kyau, saboda haka na zaɓe ku goma sha biyu, mutum guda daga kowace kabila.
english: The thing pleased me well. I took twelve of your men, one man for every tribe.

hausa: Yoshuwa kuwa ya yi wa Ubangiji, Allah na Isra’ila bagade a Dutsen Ebal,
english: Then Joshua built an altar to Yahweh, the God of Israel, on Mount Ebal,

hausa: gama shi wani irin mutum ne wanda kullum yana tunani game da tsadar abincin. Zai ce maka, “Ci ka sha,” amma zuciyarsa ba ta tare da kai.
english: for as he thinks about the cost, so he is. “Eat and drink!” he says to you, but his heart is not with you.

hausa: Fir’auna ya ce, “Haura ka binne mahaifinka, kamar yadda ya sa ka rantse za ka yi.”
english: Pharaoh said, “Go up, and bury your father, just like he made you swear.”

hausa: Kada ka yi mamaki da na ce, ‘Dole ne a sāke haifarku.’
english: Don’t marvel that I said to you, ‘You must all be born anew.’

hausa: Masu ba’a kan kuta faɗa a birni, amma masu hikima sukan kwantar da fushi.
english: Mockers stir up a city, but wise men turn away anger.

hausa: da ƙaramin bijimi guda ɗaya, tunkiya ɗaya, da rago, dukansu bana ɗaya-ɗaya domin hadaya ta ƙonawa;
english: one young bull, one ram, one male lamb a year old, for a burnt offering;

hausa: Sa’an nan sama da ƙasa da dukan abin da yake cikinsu, za su yi sowa ta murna a kan Babilon, gama daga arewa masu hallakarwa su auko mata,” in ji Ubangiji.
english: Then the heavens and the earth, and all that is therein, will sing for joy over Babylon; for the destroyers will come to her from the north,” says Yahweh.

hausa: Za su yi bikin yalwar alherinka suka kuma rera adalcinka da farin ciki.
english: They will utter the memory of your great goodness, and will sing of your righteousness.

hausa: gama kuna samun sakamakon bangaskiyarku, ceton rayukanku ke nan.
english: receiving the result of your faith, the salvation of your souls.

hausa: Dole yă biya abin da ya kāsa yi dangane da abubuwa masu tsarki, yă ƙara kashi ɗaya bisa biyar na darajar abin a kan wannan sa’an nan yă ba wa firist. Firist kuwa zai yi kafara dominsa da ragon hadaya don laifi. Za a kuwa gafarta masa.
english: He shall make restitution for that which he has done wrong regarding the holy thing, and shall add a fifth part to it, and give it to the priest; and the priest shall make atonement for him with the ram of the trespass offering, and he will be forgiven.

hausa: Zan ba shi lissafin duk abin da na taɓa yi; zan zo gabansa kamar ɗan sarki.)
english: I would declare to him the number of my steps. I would go near to him like a prince.

hausa: zakara mai taƙama, da bunsuru, da kuma sarki mai sojoji kewaye da shi.
english: the greyhound; the male goat; and the king against whom there is no rising up.

hausa: A ba da barasa ga waɗanda suke cikin halin ƙaƙa naka yi, ruwan inabi ga waɗanda suke cikin wahala;
english: Give strong drink to him who is ready to perish, and wine to the bitter in soul.

hausa: Saboda haka suka je wurin mai yin wa Yusuf hidima, suka yi masa magana a bakin ƙofar gida.
english: They came near to the steward of Joseph’s house, and they spoke to him at the door of the house,

hausa: aka kuma santa sosai saboda ayyuka masu kyau, kamar renon ’ya’ya, da karɓan baƙi, tana yi wa tsarkaka hidima, tana taimakon waɗanda suke cikin wahala tana kuma ba da kanta ga yin kowane aikin mai kyau.
english: being approved by good works, if she has brought up children, if she has been hospitable to strangers, if she has washed the saints’ feet, if she has relieved the afflicted, and if she has diligently followed every good work.

hausa: Magana ta zo wa Irmiya game da dukan mutanen Yahuda a shekara ta huɗu ta Yehohiyakim ɗan Yosiya sarkin Yahuda, wadda ta kasance shekara ta fari ta Nebukadnezzar sarkin Babilon.
english: The word that came to Jeremiah concerning all the people of Judah, in the fourth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah (this was the first year of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon),

hausa: Yanzu, idanuna za su buɗu, kunnuwata kuma za su saurara ga addu’o’in da aka miƙa a wannan wuri.
english: Now my eyes will be open and my ears attentive to prayer that is made in this place.

hausa: Sai suka sāke yin ƙoƙari su kama shi, amma ya kuɓuce musu.
english: They sought again to seize him, and he went out of their hand.

hausa: sarkin Dor (A Nafot Dor), ɗaya sarkin Goyim a Gilgal, ɗaya
english: the king of Dor in the height of Dor, one; the king of Goiim in Gilgal, one;

hausa: Ya kuma auna tsawon wuri mai tsarki da yake can ciki; tsawon kamu ashirin ne, fāɗinsa kuma kamu ashirin daga ƙurewa wuri mai tsarki da yake waje. Ya ce mini, “Wannan shi ne Wuri Mafi Tsarki.”
english: He measured its length, twenty cubits, and the width, twenty cubits, before the nave. He said to me, “This is the most holy place.”

hausa: Amma Musa ya ce, “Dole ka bari mu kasance da hadayu, da kuma hadayu na ƙonawa waɗanda za mu miƙa wa Ubangiji Allahnmu.
english: Moses said, “You must also give into our hand sacrifices and burnt offerings, that we may sacrifice to Yahweh our God.

hausa: Dukan mutanen Yahuda suka ce wa mutanen Isra’ila, “Mun yi haka domin sarki danginmu na kurkusa ne. Don me kuke fushi game da wannan? Mun ci wani abu daga cikin kayan sarki ne? Mun ɗauki wani abu wa kanmu ne?”
english: All the men of Judah answered the men of Israel, “Because the king is a close relative to us. Why then are you angry about this matter? Have we eaten at all at the king’s cost? Or has he given us any gift?”

hausa: Na yi fushi da mutanena na ƙazantar da gādona; na ba su ga hannunki, ba ki kuwa nuna musu jinƙai ba. Har ma da tsofaffi kin jibga musu kaya masu nauyi sosai.
english: I was angry with my people. I profaned my inheritance and gave them into your hand. You showed them no mercy. You laid a very heavy yoke on the aged.

hausa: Amma ni, cikin adalci zan ga fuskarka; sa’ad da na farka, zan gamsu da ganin kamanninka.
english: As for me, I shall see your face in righteousness. I shall be satisfied, when I awake, with seeing your form.

hausa: “ ‘Ga abin da Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka yana cewa a farkon wata a rana ta fari za ku ba da ɗan bijimi marar lahani a kuma tsarkake wuri mai tsarki.
english: “‘The Lord Yahweh says: “In the first month, on the first day of the month, you shall take a young bull without defect, and you shall cleanse the sanctuary.

hausa: Ta duba, a can kuwa ga sarki, tsaye kusa da ginshiƙinsa a mashigi. Manyan sojoji da masu bushe-bushe suna kusa da sarki, dukan mutanen ƙasar kuwa suna farin ciki suna busa ƙahoni, mawaƙa kuma da kayan kiɗi suna bi da yabo. Sai Ataliya ta yage rigunanta ta yi ihu tana cewa, “Cin amanar ƙasa! Cin amanar ƙasa!”
english: Then she looked, and behold, the king stood by his pillar at the entrance, with the captains and the trumpeters by the king. All the people of the land rejoiced and blew trumpets. The singers also played musical instruments, and led the singing of praise. Then Athaliah tore her clothes, and said, “Treason! treason!”

hausa: Ya zaɓa yă haife mu ta wurin kalmar gaskiya, domin mu zama ’ya’yan fari na dukan abin da ya halitta.
english: Of his own will he gave birth to us by the word of truth, that we should be a kind of first fruits of his creatures.

hausa: Sa’an nan mala’ikan ya ce mini, “Ruwayen da ka gani, inda karuwan take zama, jama’a ce, taro masu yawa, al’ummai da kuma harsuna.
english: He said to me, “The waters which you saw, where the prostitute sits, are peoples, multitudes, nations, and languages.

hausa: bayan ya yi godiya, sai ya kakkarya ya ce, “Wannan jikina ne, wanda yake dominku, ku yi wannan don tunawa da ni.”
english: When he had given thanks, he broke it and said, “Take, eat. This is my body, which is broken for you. Do this in memory of me.”

hausa: “Bayan an daɗe, sai maigidan bayin nan ya dawo, ya kuma daidaita lissafi da su.
english: “Now after a long time the lord of those servants came, and settled accounts with them.

hausa: Sauran da suka rage na gidan Yahuda kuwa za su yi saiwa a ƙarƙashi su kuma ba da ’ya’ya a bisa.
english: The remnant that is escaped of the house of Judah will again take root downward, and bear fruit upward.

hausa: Sa’an nan ya ɗauki wani daga iyalin sarauta ya yi yarjejjeniya da shi, ya sa shi ya yi rantsuwa. Ya kuma tafi da shugabannin ƙasar,
english: He took one of the royal offspring, and made a covenant with him. He also brought him under an oath, and took away the mighty of the land,

hausa: Sai maganar Ubangiji ta zo mini cewa,
english: Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

hausa: “Maigidan ya amsa ya ce, ‘Madalla, bawana mai kirki! Tun da ka yi aminci a kan abu ƙanƙani, ka yi riƙon birane goma.’
english: “He said to him, ‘Well done, you good servant! Because you were found faithful with very little, you shall have authority over ten cities.’

hausa: Ba ku tuna ba cewa sa’ad da nake tare da ku nakan gaya muku waɗannan abubuwa?
english: Don’t you remember that when I was still with you, I told you these things?

hausa: Sai Rahila da Liyatu suka amsa suka ce, “Muna da wani rabo a gādon kayan mahaifinmu ne?
english: Rachel and Leah answered him, “Is there yet any portion or inheritance for us in our father’s house?

hausa: Firistoci da Lawiyawa suka tsarkake kansu, suka zama da tsabta. Lawiyawa suka yanka ragon Bikin Ƙetarewa domin dukan waɗanda suka dawo daga bauta, da kuma domin ’yan’uwansu firistoci, da kuma domin kansu.
english: Because the priests and the Levites had purified themselves together, all of them were pure. They killed the Passover for all the children of the captivity, for their brothers the priests, and for themselves.

hausa: Allah madawwami shi ne mafakarka, a ƙarƙashina kuma madawwamin hannuwa ne. Zai kore abokin gābanka a gabanka, yana cewa, ‘Ka hallaka shi!’
english: The eternal God is your dwelling place. Underneath are the everlasting arms. He thrust out the enemy from before you, and said, ‘Destroy!’

hausa: Da mahaifiyarta ta zuga ta, sai ta ce, “Ba ni a cikin kwanon nan, kan Yohanna Mai Baftisma.”
english: She, being prompted by her mother, said, “Give me here on a platter the head of John the Baptizer.”

hausa: ko Yahuda ma ba su kiyaye umarnan Ubangiji Allahnsu ba. Sun bi gurbin da Isra’ila ta kawo.
english: Also Judah didn’t keep the commandments of Yahweh their God, but walked in the statutes of Israel which they made.

hausa: Ku riƙa yin haƙuri da juna kuna kuma gafarta wa juna duk wani laifin da wani ya yi muku. Ku gafarta kamar yadda Ubangiji ya gafarce ku.
english: bearing with one another, and forgiving each other, if any man has a complaint against any; even as Christ forgave you, so you also do.

hausa: Saboda haka aka kawo Daniyel a gaban sarki, sai sarki ya ce masa, “Kai ne Daniyel ɗin nan, ɗaya daga cikin kamammu waɗanda mahaifina sarki ya kawo daga Yahuda?
english: Then Daniel was brought in before the king. The king spoke and said to Daniel, “Are you that Daniel of the children of the captivity of Judah, whom the king my father brought out of Judah?

hausa: Sai Balak ya ce wa Bala’am, “Zo in kai ka wani wuri. Wataƙila zai gamshi Allah, yă bari ka la’anta mini su daga can.”
english: Balak said to Balaam, “Come now, I will take you to another place; perhaps it will please God that you may curse them for me from there.”

hausa: Yabo ya tabbata gare ka, ya Ubangiji; ka koya mini ƙa’idodinka.
english: Blessed are you, Yahweh. Teach me your statutes.

hausa: Da shi da mai sayansa, za su ƙirga lokaci daga shekarar da ya sayar da kansa har zuwa Shekara ta Murna. Farashin sakinsa zai dangana a kuɗin da ake biyan ma’aikacin da aka ɗauka aiki, na yawan shekarun ne.
english: He shall reckon with him who bought him from the year that he sold himself to him to the Year of Jubilee. The price of his sale shall be according to the number of years; he shall be with him according to the time of a hired servant.

hausa: tare kuwa suka zo wurin Musa da Haruna, suka ce musu, “Kun wuce gona da iri! Dukan jama’an nan masu tsarki ne, kowannensu, Ubangiji kuma yana tare da su. Me ya sa kuke ɗaukan kanku fiye da taron jama’ar Ubangiji?”
english: They assembled themselves together against Moses and against Aaron, and said to them, “You take too much on yourself, since all the congregation are holy, everyone of them, and Yahweh is among them! Why do you lift yourselves up above Yahweh’s assembly?”

hausa: a jeri na huɗu akwai beril, da onis, da yasfa. Aka sa su cikin tsaiko na zinariya.
english: and the fourth row, a chrysolite, an onyx, and a jasper. They were enclosed in gold settings.

hausa: Wane ne Ubangiji ya nemi shawararsa don yă ganar da shi, wane ne kuma ya koya masa hanyar da ta dace? Wane ne ya koya masa sani ko ya nuna masa hanyar fahimta?
english: Who did he take counsel with, and who instructed him, and taught him in the path of justice, and taught him knowledge, and showed him the way of understanding?

hausa: Yanzu ka saurare su amma ka yi musu kashedi sosai, ka sa su san abin da sarkin da zai bi da su zai yi.”
english: Now therefore, listen to their voice. However, you shall protest solemnly to them, and shall show them the way of the king who will reign over them.”

hausa: Kaiton waɗanda suke jarumawa a shan ruwan inabi da gwanaye a haɗin abubuwan sha,
english: Woe to those who are mighty to drink wine, and champions at mixing strong drink;

hausa: Dawuda ya ce, “A’a, ’yan’uwana ba za ku yi haka da abin da Ubangiji ya ba mu ba. Ya tsare mu, ya kuma bashe sojojin da suka yi gāba da mu a hannuwanmu.
english: Then David said, “Do not do so, my brothers, with that which Yahweh has given to us, who has preserved us, and delivered the troop that came against us into our hand.

hausa: Zai ji tausayin gajiyayyu da masu bukata yă ceci masu bukata daga mutuwa.
english: He will have pity on the poor and needy. He will save the souls of the needy.

hausa: Na dubi marasa aminci da ƙyama, gama ba sa yin biyayya da maganarka.
english: I look at the faithless with loathing, because they don’t observe your word.

hausa: Bari mugu ya bar irin halinsa mugu kuma ya sāke irin tunaninsa. Bari yă juyo ga Ubangiji, zai kuwa ji tausayinsa, ya juyo ga Allahnmu kuma, gama shi mai gafartawa ne a sauƙaƙe.
english: Let the wicked forsake his way, and the unrighteous man his thoughts. Let him return to Yahweh, and he will have mercy on him, to our God, for he will freely pardon.

hausa: Amma Sama’ila ya ce, “Yadda takobinka ya sa mata suka rasa ’ya’ya, haka mahaifiyarka za tă zama marar ’ya’ya a cikin mata.” Sama’ila kuwa ya kashe Agag a Gilgal a gaban Ubangiji.
english: Samuel said, “As your sword has made women childless, so your mother will be childless among women!” Then Samuel cut Agag in pieces before Yahweh in Gilgal.

hausa: Ya tayar wa mutanensa ƙaho, yabon dukan tsarkakansa, na Isra’ila, mutanen da suke kurkusa da zuciyarsa. Yabi Ubangiji.
english: He has lifted up the horn of his people, the praise of all his saints, even of the children of Israel, a people near to him. Praise Yah!

hausa: Sa’ad da waɗannan abubuwa sun fara faruwa, ku tashi tsaye, ku ɗaga kawunanku, domin fansarku yana matsowa kusa.”
english: But when these things begin to happen, look up and lift up your heads, because your redemption is near.”

hausa: ya kuma kawo bunsuru ɗaya domin hadaya don zunubi;
english: one male goat for a sin offering;

hausa: “Ta haka zan kawo ƙarshe ga lalaci a ƙasar, don dukan mata su ji gargaɗi kada kuma su kwaikwaye ku
english: “‘Thus I will cause lewdness to cease out of the land, that all women may be taught not to be lewd like you.

hausa: Zan zo haikalinka da hadayun ƙonawa zan kuwa cika alkawurana gare ka,
english: I will come into your temple with burnt offerings. I will pay my vows to you,

hausa: Zan kuma miƙa hannuna a kansu in mai da ƙasarsu kango daga hamadan Dibila, a duk inda suke zama. Sa’an nan za su san cewa ni ne Ubangiji.’ ”
english: I will stretch out my hand on them and make the land desolate and waste, from the wilderness toward Diblah, throughout all their habitations. Then they will know that I am Yahweh.’”

hausa: Ta ce musu, “Ku tafi cikin tuddan ƙasar don kada mutanen sarki su same ku. Ku ɓuya a can na kwana uku, har sai masu nemanku su komo, sa’an nan ku kama hanyarku.”
english: She said to them, “Go to the mountain, lest the pursuers find you. Hide yourselves there three days, until the pursuers have returned. Afterward, you may go your way.”

hausa: A wannan rana Ubangiji zai tankaɗe daga Yuferites mai gudu zuwa Rafin Masar, ku kuma, ya Isra’ilawa, za a tattara ku ɗaya-ɗaya.
english: It will happen in that day that Yahweh will thresh from the flowing stream of the Euphrates to the brook of Egypt; and you will be gathered one by one, children of Israel.

hausa: “Ta haka zan zo kusa da ku don in yi hukunci. Zan hanzarta ba da shaida a kan masu yin sihiri, da mazinata da masu shaidar zur. Zan ba da shaida a kan waɗanda suke zaluntar ma’aikata a kan albashinsu, da waɗanda suke ƙwarar gwauraye da marayu, suna kuma hana baƙi samun adalci, ba sa ma tsorona,” in ji Ubangiji Maɗaukaki.
english: I will come near to you to judgment. I will be a swift witness against the sorcerers, against the adulterers, against the perjurers, and against those who oppress the hireling in his wages, the widow, and the fatherless, and who deprive the foreigner of justice, and don’t fear me,” says Yahweh of Armies.

hausa: Alade, ko da yake yana da rababben kofato, amma ba ya tuƙa, saboda haka namansa haram ne gare ku.
english: The pig, because it has a split hoof, and is cloven-footed, but doesn’t chew the cud, is unclean to you.

hausa: “Gaskiya nake gaya muku, duk wanda ya ji maganata ya kuma gaskata da wanda ya aiko ni yana da rai madawwami ba za a kuma hukunta shi ba; ya riga ya ƙetare daga mutuwa zuwa rai.
english: “Most certainly I tell you, he who hears my word and believes him who sent me has eternal life, and doesn’t come into judgment, but has passed out of death into life.

hausa: Sa’an nan aka tattara sarakuna zuwa wurin da a Ibraniyanci ake kira Armageddon.
english: He gathered them together into the place which is called in Hebrew, “Harmagedon”.

hausa: Amma abin da dā ya zama mini riba yanzu, na ɗauka hasara ce saboda Kiristi.
english: However, I consider those things that were gain to me as a loss for Christ.

hausa: Yaƙub ya ji cewa ’ya’ya Laban mazan suna cewa, “Yaƙub ya kwashe dukan abin da mahaifinmu yake da shi, ya kuma sami dukan wannan arziki daga abin da yake na mahaifinmu.”
english: Jacob heard Laban’s sons’ words, saying, “Jacob has taken away all that was our father’s. He has obtained all this wealth from that which was our father’s.”

hausa: Suka gama yankin da gudu, suna ɗaukan marasa lafiya a kan tabarmai zuwa duk inda suka ji yake.
english: and ran around that whole region, and began to bring those who were sick on their mats to where they heard he was.

hausa: Sai Shawulu ya sami labari cewa an ga Dawuda da mutanensa. Shawulu kuwa yana zaune da māshinsa kusa a ƙarƙashin itacen tsamiya a tudun Gibeya, tare da dukan ma’aikatansa kewaye da shi.
english: Saul heard that David was discovered, with the men who were with him. Now Saul was sitting in Gibeah, under the tamarisk tree in Ramah, with his spear in his hand, and all his servants were standing around him.

hausa: raƙuma 435, da kuma jakuna 6,720.
english: their camels, four hundred thirty-five; their donkeys, six thousand seven hundred twenty.

hausa: Tabbatacce zai cece ka daga tarkon mai farauta da kuma daga cututtuka masu kisa.
english: For he will deliver you from the snare of the fowler, and from the deadly pestilence.

hausa: Duk wanda yake bayarwa ga matalauta ba zai rasa kome ba, amma duk wanda bai kula da su ba yana samu la’ana masu yawa.
english: One who gives to the poor has no lack; but one who closes his eyes will have many curses.

hausa: Ka aikata mugunta fiye da dukan waɗanda suka rayu kafin kai. Ka yi wa kanka waɗansu alloli, gumakan da aka yi da ƙarfe; ka tsokane ni na yi fushi, ka kuma juye mini baya.
english: but have done evil above all who were before you, and have gone and made for yourself other gods, molten images, to provoke me to anger, and have cast me behind your back,

hausa: Amma ba a ba su ikon gane shi ba.
english: But their eyes were kept from recognizing him.

hausa: Biranenka masu tsarki sun zama hamada; har Sihiyona ma ta zama hamada; Urushalima ta zama kango.
english: Your holy cities have become a wilderness. Zion has become a wilderness, Jerusalem a desolation.

hausa: Da yake burodin nan ɗaya ne, ashe kuwa, mu da muke da yawa jiki ɗaya ne, gama dukanmu muna ci daga burodi nan guda.
english: Because there is one loaf of bread, we, who are many, are one body; for we all partake of the one loaf of bread.

hausa: na Harim 2 320
english: The children of Harim: three hundred twenty.

hausa: Ba’asha sarkin Isra’ila ya haura, ya yi yaƙi da Yahuda, ya kuma gina Rama don yă hana wani daga fita ko shiga yankin Asa, sarkin Yahuda.
english: Baasha king of Israel went up against Judah, and built Ramah, that he might not allow anyone to go out or come in to Asa king of Judah.

hausa: Ku yi kuka mai zafi, ku jiragen ruwan Tarshish; an rurrushe kagararku!
english: Howl, you ships of Tarshish, for your stronghold is laid waste!

hausa: da Hallohesh, da Filha, da Shobek,
english: Hallohesh, Pilha, Shobek,

hausa: Ya shirya hanya wa fushinsa; bai tsare ransu daga mutuwa ba amma ya miƙa su ga annoba.
english: He made a path for his anger. He didn’t spare their soul from death, but gave their life over to the pestilence,

hausa: Jimillar birane da wurarensu na kiwon da aka ba Lawiyawa daga cikin mallakar jama’ar Isra’ila guda arba’in da takwas ne.
english: All the cities of the Levites among the possessions of the children of Israel were forty-eight cities with their pasture lands.

hausa: Musa ya duba aikin, sai ya ga cewa sun yi shi daidai yadda Ubangiji ya umarta. Sai Musa ya sa musu albarka.
english: Moses saw all the work, and behold, they had done it as Yahweh had commanded. They had done so; and Moses blessed them.

hausa: Bayi, ku yi biyayya ga iyayengijinku da matuƙar ladabi, ba kawai ga waɗanda suke da kirki da masu sauƙinkai ba, amma har ga masu zafin rai ma.
english: Servants, be in subjection to your masters with all respect, not only to the good and gentle, but also to the wicked.

hausa: Ya umarta a koya wa mutanen Yahuda wannan waƙa mai suna Makokin Baka (tana a rubuce a Littafin Yashar),
english: (and he commanded them to teach the children of Judah the song of the bow; behold, it is written in the book of Jashar):

hausa: Haka za ku yi da dukan biranen da suke nesa da ku, waɗanda kuma ba na al’ummai da suke kusa ba.
english: Thus you shall do to all the cities which are very far off from you, which are not of the cities of these nations.

hausa: Da yawa daga cikinsu suka ce, “Yana da aljani, yana kuma hauka. Don me za ku saurare shi?”
english: Many of them said, “He has a demon and is insane! Why do you listen to him?”

hausa: Da ya sauko daga dutsen, sai taron mutane mai yawan gaske suka bi shi.
english: When he came down from the mountain, great multitudes followed him.

hausa: Shi ne kuma wanda ya ci mutanen Edom dubu goma a yaƙi, a Kwarin Gishiri, ya kuma ci Sela da yaƙi, ya ba ta suna Yokteyel, sunan da ake kiranta har wa yau.
english: He killed ten thousand Edomites in the Valley of Salt, and took Sela by war, and called its name Joktheel, to this day.

hausa: Saboda haka abin da na ce, shi ne mutum yă ji daɗi, domin iyakar jin daɗinsa a wannan rai, shi ne yă ci, yă sha, yă ji wa kansa daɗi. Aƙalla yana iya yin wannan in ya yi aiki a kwanakin da Allah ya ba shi a wannan duniya.
english: Then I commended mirth, because a man has no better thing under the sun than to eat, to drink, and to be joyful: for that will accompany him in his labor all the days of his life which God has given him under the sun.

hausa: Sai Musa ya tashi daga gaban Fir’auna, ya fita daga birni. Da ya miƙa hannuwansa ta wajen Ubangiji, sai tsawa da ƙanƙara suka tsaya, kwararowar ruwa kuma ta ɗauke.
english: Moses went out of the city from Pharaoh, and spread out his hands to Yahweh; and the thunders and hail ceased, and the rain was not poured on the earth.

hausa: Abin da ka zaɓa za ka yi za ka yi nasara a ciki, haske kuma zai haskaka hanyarka.
english: You will also decree a thing, and it will be established to you. Light will shine on your ways.

hausa: Amma domin sun yi musu hidima a gaban gumakansu suka sa gidan Isra’ila ya yi zunubi, saboda haka na ɗaga hannu na rantse cewa dole su ɗauki alhakin zunubinsu, in ji Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka.
english: Because they ministered to them before their idols, and became a stumbling block of iniquity to the house of Israel, therefore I have lifted up my hand against them,” says the Lord Yahweh, “and they will bear their iniquity.

hausa: har kake fushi da Allah kake kuma faɗar waɗannan maganganu daga bakinka?
english: that you turn your spirit against God, and let such words go out of your mouth?

hausa: Don gudun kada a fyaɗa mu a kan duwatsu, sai suka saki ƙugiyoyin jirgin guda huɗu daga bayan jirgin suka yi fata gari ya waye.
english: Fearing that we would run aground on rocky ground, they let go four anchors from the stern, and wished for daylight.

hausa: Dole su riƙe asirin bangaskiya su kuma kasance da lamiri mai tsabta.
english: holding the mystery of the faith in a pure conscience.

hausa: Ga abin da Ubangiji yana cewa, “An ji murya daga Rama, makoki da kuka mai zafi, Rahila tana kuka domin ’ya’yanta ta kuma ƙi a ta’azantar da ita domin ’ya’yanta ba su.”
english: Yahweh says: “A voice is heard in Ramah, lamentation and bitter weeping, Rachel weeping for her children. She refuses to be comforted for her children, because they are no more.”

hausa: In kun yi zunubi ta yaya wannan zai shafi Allah? In zunubanku sun yi yawa, me wannan zai yi masa?
english: If you have sinned, what effect do you have against him? If your transgressions are multiplied, what do you do to him?

hausa: “Daga sama ya aiko da wuta, ya aiko ta cikin ƙasusuwana. Ya shimfiɗa raga a ƙafafuna ya juyo da ni. Ya bar ni ni kaɗai, sumamme dukan yini.
english: “From on high has he sent fire into my bones, and it prevails against them. He has spread a net for my feet. He has turned me back. He has made me desolate and I faint all day long.

hausa: Ammiyel na shida, Issakar na bakwai da Feyuletai na takwas. (Gama Allah ya albarkace Obed-Edom.)
english: Ammiel the sixth, Issachar the seventh, and Peullethai the eighth; for God blessed him.

hausa: Tun yana cikin magana, sai sarki ya ce masa, “Yaushe muka naɗa ka mai ba sarki shawara? Rufe mana baki! Me zai hana a kashe ka?” Sai annabin ya yi shiru, amma ya ce, “Na dai sani Allah ya riga ya shirya zai hallaka ka, saboda ka aikata wannan, ba ka kuma saurari shawarata ba.”
english: As he talked with him, the king said to him, “Have we made you one of the king’s counselors? Stop! Why should you be struck down?” Then the prophet stopped, and said, “I know that God has determined to destroy you, because you have done this and have not listened to my counsel.”

hausa: Na tabbata kun ji labarin hidimar alheri na musamman da Allah ya ba ni dominku.
english: if it is so that you have heard of the administration of that grace of God which was given me toward you,

hausa: Da kutaren nan suka kai bakin sansanin, sai suka shiga wani tenti, suka ci, suka sha, suka kwashi azurfa, da zinariya, da riguna, suka tafi, suka ɓoye su. Sa’an nan suka koma, suka shiga wani tenti, sai suka kwashi kaya daga ciki, suka kuma ɓoye su.
english: When these lepers came to the outermost part of the camp, they went into one tent, and ate and drank, then carried away silver, gold, and clothing and went and hid it. Then they came back, and entered into another tent and carried things from there also, and went and hid them.

hausa: In ya zo kwaram, kada ka bari yă tarar da kai kana barci.
english: lest, coming suddenly, he might find you sleeping.

hausa: Ai, mu aikinsa ne, an sāke halittarmu a cikin Kiristi Yesu musamman domin mu yi kyawawan ayyuka, waɗanda Allah ya tanadar mana tun da fari, mu yi.
english: For we are his workmanship, created in Christ Jesus for good works, which God prepared before that we would walk in them.

hausa: Yawan hadayun ƙonawan da taron suka kawo, bijimai saba’in ne, raguna ɗari da kuma bunsurai ɗari biyu, dukansu kuwa domin hadayun ƙonawa ga Ubangiji ne.
english: The number of the burnt offerings which the assembly brought was seventy bulls, one hundred rams, and two hundred lambs. All these were for a burnt offering to Yahweh.

hausa: Gama za tă zo a kan kowa da yake kan dukan duniya.
english: For it will come like a snare on all those who dwell on the surface of all the earth.

hausa: Ku saurari maganar Ubangiji, ku masu mulkin Sodom; ku kasa kunne ga dokar Allahnmu, ku mutanen Gomorra!
english: Hear Yahweh’s word, you rulers of Sodom! Listen to the law of our God, you people of Gomorrah!

hausa: Maganganun Sarki Lemuwel, magana ce horarriya mahaifiyarsa ta koya masa,
english: The words of King Lemuel—the revelation which his mother taught him:

hausa: don su fahimci karin magana da kuma misalai, kalmomi da kuma kacici-kacici masu hikima.
english: to understand a proverb and parables, the words and riddles of the wise.

hausa: Sarki Zerzes ya sa a biya haraji a ko’ina a cikin daular, har zuwa ƙasashe masu nesa na bakin teku.
english: King Ahasuerus laid a tribute on the land and on the islands of the sea.

hausa: Da suka zo Mara, ba su iya shan ruwan ba saboda yana da ɗaci (shi ya sa ake kira wurin Mara).
english: When they came to Marah, they couldn’t drink from the waters of Marah, for they were bitter. Therefore its name was called Marah.

hausa: A Listira kuwa akwai wani gurgu zaune a ƙafafunsa, wanda gurgu ne tun haihuwa, kuma bai taɓa tafiya ba.
english: At Lystra a certain man sat, impotent in his feet, a cripple from his mother’s womb, who never had walked.

hausa: An sanar da su cewa kana koya wa dukan Yahudawan da suke zama a cikin Al’ummai cewa su juye daga Musa, kana kuma faɗa musu kada su yi wa ’ya’yansu kaciya ko su yi rayuwa bisa ga al’adunmu.
english: They have been informed about you, that you teach all the Jews who are among the Gentiles to forsake Moses, telling them not to circumcise their children and not to walk after the customs.

hausa: A haɗa da bunsuru guda a matsayin hadaya don zunubi, don yin muku kafara.
english: and one male goat for a sin offering, to make atonement for you;

hausa: Hawayena ne sun zama abincina dare da rana, yayinda mutane suke ce da ni dukan yini, “Ina Allahnka ɗin?”
english: My tears have been my food day and night, while they continually ask me, “Where is your God?”

hausa: “ ‘In mutum ya auri matar ɗan’uwansa, aikin rashin tsabta ne, ya ƙasƙantar da ɗan’uwansa ke nan. Za su mutu babu ’ya’ya.
english: “‘If a man takes his brother’s wife, it is an impurity. He has uncovered his brother’s nakedness. They shall be childless.

hausa: Ubangiji ya ce, “Tabbatacce na ga azabar mutanena a Masar. Na ji su suna kuka saboda matsin da shugabannin gandunsu suke musu, na kuma damu da wahalarsu.
english: Yahweh said, “I have surely seen the affliction of my people who are in Egypt, and have heard their cry because of their taskmasters, for I know their sorrows.

hausa: Sai taron suka ce, “Ahab, Dokarmu ta gaya mana cewa, Kiristi zai kasance har abada, to, yaya za ka ce, ‘Dole ne a ɗaga Ɗan Mutum?’ Wane ne wannan ‘Ɗan Mutum’?”
english: The multitude answered him, “We have heard out of the law that the Christ remains forever. How do you say, ‘The Son of Man must be lifted up’? Who is this Son of Man?”

hausa: Ta waje gabas sun zauna a ƙasar har zuwa bakin hamadan da ya nausa zuwa Kogin Yuferites, domin dabbobinsu sun ƙaru a Gileyad.
english: and he lived eastward even to the entrance of the wilderness from the river Euphrates, because their livestock were multiplied in the land of Gilead.

hausa: Da haka aka kafa tabanakul, a rana ta fari ga wata na fari a shekara ta biyu.
english: In the first month in the second year, on the first day of the month, the tabernacle was raised up.

hausa: Ƙafafunki a cikin takalma kyakkyawa ne, Ya diyar sarki! Tsarin ƙafafunki sun yi kamar kayan ado masu daraja, aikin hannun gwanin sassaƙa.
english: How beautiful are your feet in sandals, prince’s daughter! Your rounded thighs are like jewels, the work of the hands of a skillful workman.

hausa: Sai Zedekiya ya ce wa Irmiya, “Kada ka bar wani ya san wannan zance, in ba haka ba za ka mutu.
english: Then Zedekiah said to Jeremiah, “Let no man know of these words, and you won’t die.

hausa: In mace mai bi tana da gwauraye a iyalinta, ya kamata tă taimake su, kada tă bar wa ikkilisiya wannan nauyi, domin ikkilisiya ta sami zarafin taimakon gwaurayen da suke da bukata ta ainihi.
english: If any man or woman who believes has widows, let them relieve them, and don’t let the assembly be burdened, that it might relieve those who are widows indeed.

hausa: Abin farin ciki ne ga mutanenka! Abin farin ciki ne ga fadawanka, waɗanda suke cin gaba da tsayawa a gabanka suna kuma jin hikimarka!
english: Happy are your men, happy are these your servants who stand continually before you, who hear your wisdom.

hausa: Mutanenku za su sāke gina kufai na da su kuma daga tsofaffin harsashai; za a ce da ku Masu Gyaran Katangar da ta Rushe, Masu Farfaɗo da Tituna da kuma Wuraren zama.
english: Those who will be of you will build the old waste places. You will raise up the foundations of many generations. You will be called Repairer of the Breach, Restorer of Paths with Dwellings.

hausa: ya ce, “In kowane sojan mutanen Gad da na mutanen Ruben, ya ɗauki makaman yaƙi, ya haye Urdun tare da ku a gaban Ubangiji, to, sa’ad da a ci ƙasar a gabanku, ku ba da ƙasar Gileyad tă zama mallakarsu.
english: Moses said to them, “If the children of Gad and the children of Reuben will pass with you over the Jordan, every man who is armed to battle before Yahweh, and the land is subdued before you, then you shall give them the land of Gilead for a possession;

hausa: Da Dawuda ya ji labari Shawulu yana shirya hanyar da zai kashe shi, sai ya ce wa Abiyatar firist, “Kawo mini efod a nan.”
english: David knew that Saul was devising mischief against him. He said to Abiathar the priest, “Bring the ephod here.”

hausa: Sai suka tambaye shi suka ce, “Me za mu yi don mu aikata ayyukan da Allah yake so?”
english: They said therefore to him, “What must we do, that we may work the works of God?”

hausa: Ubangiji ya husata da Isra’ila har ya sa suka yi ta yawo a hamada shekara arba’in, sai da dukan tsaran da suka aikata wannan mugunta a gabansa, suka mutu.
english: Yahweh’s anger burned against Israel, and he made them wander back and forth in the wilderness forty years, until all the generation who had done evil in Yahweh’s sight was consumed.

hausa: Abokaina ƙaunatattu, ba kowane ruhu za ku gaskata ba, sai dai ku gwada ruhohi don ku ga ko daga Allah ne, domin annabawan ƙarya da yawa sun fito duniya.
english: Beloved, don’t believe every spirit, but test the spirits, whether they are of God, because many false prophets have gone out into the world.

hausa: Zuciyata ta shirya a kan kiyaye ƙa’idodinka har ƙarshe.
english: I have set my heart to perform your statutes forever, even to the end. SAMEKH

hausa: Sa’an nan Dawuda ya kira Zadok da Abiyatar, firistoci, tare da Uriyel, Asahiya, Yowel, Shemahiya, Eliyel da Amminadab, Lawiyawa.
english: David called for Zadok and Abiathar the priests, and for the Levites: for Uriel, Asaiah, Joel, Shemaiah, Eliel, and Amminadab,

hausa: Ya yi abin da yake daidai a gaban Ubangiji, kamar yadda mahaifinsa Uzziya ya yi, sai dai bai kutsa cikin haikalin Ubangiji kamar mahaifinsa ba. Mutane kuwa, suka ci gaba da aikata ayyukan lalaci.
english: He did that which was right in Yahweh’s eyes, according to all that his father Uzziah had done. However he didn’t enter into Yahweh’s temple. The people still acted corruptly.

hausa: sai suka dawo ƙasar Yahuda, wurin Gedaliya a Mizfa, daga dukan ƙasashen da suke a warwatse. Suka girbe ruwan inabi a yalwace da ’ya’yan itatuwan kaka.
english: then all the Jews returned out of all places where they were driven, and came to the land of Judah, to Gedaliah, to Mizpah, and gathered very much wine and summer fruits.

hausa: Isuwa ya ce, “Ba saboda haka ne aka raɗa masa suna Yaƙub ba? Ya yi mini ƙwace sau biyu ke nan; ya ƙwace mini matsayina na ɗan fari, ga shi yanzu kuma ya karɓi albarkata.” Sa’an nan ya yi tambaya, “Ba sauran albarkar da ka rage mini?”
english: He said, “Isn’t he rightly named Jacob? For he has supplanted me these two times. He took away my birthright. See, now he has taken away my blessing.” He said, “Haven’t you reserved a blessing for me?”

hausa: “Ga abin da Ubangiji yana cewa, Mai Fansarka, wanda ya yi ka a cikin mahaifa. “Ni ne Ubangiji, wanda ya yi dukan abubuwa, wanda ya shimfiɗa sammai ya kuma kafa harsashen duniya da kansa,
english: Yahweh, your Redeemer, and he who formed you from the womb says: “I am Yahweh, who makes all things; who alone stretches out the heavens; who spreads out the earth by myself;

hausa: Alheri da salama daga Allah Ubanmu, da Ubangiji Yesu Kiristi, su kasance tare da ku.
english: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

hausa: cikakku da sakamakon aikin adalci da yake zuwa ta wurin Yesu Kiristi, zuwa ga ɗaukakar Allah da kuma yabonsa.
english: being filled with the fruits of righteousness which are through Jesus Christ, to the glory and praise of God.

hausa: Gara ka zama ɗaya daga cikin matalauta masu sauƙinkai, da ka raba ganima da masu girman kai.
english: It is better to be of a lowly spirit with the poor, than to divide the plunder with the proud.

hausa: “Zan cire taƙaici daga gare ki a ƙayyadaddun bukukkuwa; su kaya ne da kuma zargi a gare ki.
english: I will remove those who grieve about the appointed feasts from you. They are a burden and a reproach to you.

hausa: Zan yi farin ciki a yin musu alheri, tabbatacce zan su dasa a wannan ƙasa da dukan zuciyata da dukan raina.
english: Yes, I will rejoice over them to do them good, and I will plant them in this land assuredly with my whole heart and with my whole soul.”

hausa: Gama mun sani, ’yan’uwa, ƙaunatattu na Allah, cewa ya zaɓe ku,
english: We know, brothers loved by God, that you are chosen,

hausa: A wannan lokaci, Rezin sarkin Aram ya sāke ƙwato Elat wa Aram ta wurin korar Yahuda. Sa’an nan mutanen Edom suka mamaye Elat suna kuwa zaune a can har yau.
english: At that time Rezin king of Syria recovered Elath to Syria, and drove the Jews from Elath; and the Syrians came to Elath, and live there to this day.

hausa: Suna da sarkin da yake mulki a bisansu wanda yake mala’ikan Abis, wanda sunansa a harshen Yahudawa shi ne Abaddon, da harshen Hellenawa kuwa shi ne, Afolliyon.
english: They have over them as king the angel of the abyss. His name in Hebrew is “Abaddon”, but in Greek, he has the name “Apollyon”.

hausa: a jeri na uku akwai yakinta, da idon mage, da ametis;
english: and the third row, a jacinth, an agate, and an amethyst;

hausa: Irmiya annabi suka ce masa, “Muna roƙonka ka ji kukanmu ka kuma yi addu’a ga Ubangiji Allahnka saboda dukan wannan raguwar mutane. Gama kamar yadda kake gani yanzu, ko da yake dā muna da yawa, yanzu ɗan kaɗan muka rage.
english: and said to Jeremiah the prophet, “Please let our supplication be presented before you, and pray for us to Yahweh your God, even for all this remnant, for we are left but a few of many, as your eyes see us,

hausa: Da mutane a ɓoye a cikin ɗaki tare da ita, sai ta yi ihu ta ce, “Samson ga Filistiyawa sun zo su kama ka!” Da jin haka sai ya tsintsinke igiyoyin kamar zaren da ya yi kusa da harshen wuta. Saboda haka asirin ƙarfinsa bai tonu ba.
english: Now she had an ambush waiting in the inner room. She said to him, “The Philistines are on you, Samson!” He broke the cords as a flax thread is broken when it touches the fire. So his strength was not known.

hausa: To a yamman da ya wuce kafin mutumin ya iso, hannun Ubangiji yana a kaina, ya kuma buɗe bakina kafin mutumin ya iso wurina da safe. Sai bakina ya buɗu ban kuma yi shiru ba.
english: Now Yahweh’s hand had been on me in the evening, before he who had escaped came; and he had opened my mouth until he came to me in the morning; and my mouth was opened, and I was no longer mute.

hausa: Bakinsa zaƙi ne kansa; komensa yana da kyau. Haka ƙaunataccena, abokina, yake ’yan matan Urushalima.
english: His mouth is sweetness; yes, he is altogether lovely. This is my beloved, and this is my friend, daughters of Jerusalem.

hausa: Ba zato sai ya ce wa mahaifinsa, “Wayyo! Kaina yana mini ciwo! Kaina yana mini ciwo!” Sai mahaifinsa ya ce wa bawansa, “Kai shi wurin mahaifiyarsa.”
english: He said to his father, “My head! My head!” He said to his servant, “Carry him to his mother.”

hausa: Ga abin da Ubangiji ya ce game da wannan mutane, “Suna son yawace-yawace ƙwarai; ba sa hana ƙafafunsu yawo. Saboda haka Ubangiji bai yarda da su ba; yanzu zai tuna da muguntarsu zai kuma hukunta su saboda zunubansu.”
english: Yahweh says to this people: “Even so they have loved to wander. They have not restrained their feet. Therefore Yahweh does not accept them. Now he will remember their iniquity, and punish them for their sins.”

hausa: Saboda haka Delila ta ɗauki sababbin igiyoyi ta ɗaura shi da su. Sa’an nan, tare da mutane a ɓoye a ɗakin, ta yi ihu ta ce, “Samson ga Filistiyawa sun zo su kama ka!” Amma sai ya tsintsinke su kamar zare.
english: So Delilah took new ropes and bound him with them, then said to him, “The Philistines are on you, Samson!” The ambush was waiting in the inner room. He broke them off his arms like a thread.

hausa: Ahimawaz mahaifin Azariya, Azariya mahaifin Yohanan,
english: Ahimaaz became the father of Azariah. Azariah became the father of Johanan.

hausa: “Muddin ina raye,” in ji Ubangiji, “ko kai, Yehohiyacin ɗan Yehohiyakim sarkin Yahuda, ka zama zoben hatimin dama a hannuna na dama, zan kwaɓe ka.
english: “As I live,” says Yahweh, “though Coniah the son of Jehoiakim king of Judah were the signet on my right hand, I would still pluck you from there.

hausa: Duk da haka za a keɓe ribarta da kuɗin shigarta wa Ubangiji; ba za a yi ajiyarsu ko a ɓoye su. Ribarta za tă tafi ga waɗanda suke yi wa Ubangiji sujada, don su sami yalwataccen abinci da tufafi masu kyau.
english: Her merchandise and her wages will be holiness to Yahweh. It will not be treasured nor laid up; for her merchandise will be for those who dwell before Yahweh, to eat sufficiently, and for durable clothing.

hausa: Mun kai hari a Negeb ta Keretawa ta Yahuda, da Negeb ta Kaleb, muka kuma ƙone Ziklag.”
english: We made a raid on the South of the Cherethites, and on that which belongs to Judah, and on the South of Caleb; and we burned Ziklag with fire.”

hausa: Na tsananta wa masu bin wannan Hanyar har ga mutuwarsu, ina kama maza da mata ina kuma jefa su cikin kurkuku,
english: I persecuted this Way to the death, binding and delivering into prisons both men and women,

hausa: In wani ya yi gini a kan tushen ginin nan da zinariya, azurfa, duwatsu masu daraja, itace, ciyawa ko kara,
english: But if anyone builds on the foundation with gold, silver, costly stones, wood, hay, or straw,

hausa: Dukansu kabilan Shuhamawa ne, jimillarsu ta kai 64,400.
english: All the families of the Shuhamites, according to those who were counted of them, were sixty-four thousand four hundred.

hausa: Sa’ad da Yehoram ya kafa kansa sosai a bisa mulkin mahaifinsa, sai ya kashe dukan ’yan’uwansa da takobi tare da waɗansu sarakunan Isra’ila.
english: Now when Jehoram had risen up over the kingdom of his father, and had strengthened himself, he killed all his brothers with the sword, and also some of the princes of Israel.

hausa: Dawuda kuwa yana a mafaka. Wata ƙungiyar sojojin Filistiyawa kuma suna Betlehem.
english: David was then in the stronghold; and the garrison of the Philistines was then in Bethlehem.

hausa: Sai Yesu ya bar wajajen Taya, ya bi ta Sidon har zuwa Tekun Galili da kuma cikin yankin Dekafolis.
english: Again he departed from the borders of Tyre and Sidon, and came to the sea of Galilee through the middle of the region of Decapolis.

hausa: Sau da sau na aiki bayina annabawa, waɗanda suka ce, ‘Kada ku yi wannan abin ƙyama da na ƙi!’
english: However I sent to you all my servants the prophets, rising up early and sending them, saying, “Oh, don’t do this abominable thing that I hate.”

hausa: Filibus kuwa ya fito a Azotus, ya yi ta zagawa, yana wa’azin bishara a dukan garuruwan sai da ya kai Kaisariya.
english: But Philip was found at Azotus. Passing through, he preached the Good News to all the cities until he came to Caesarea.

hausa: Ka yi zobai biyu na zinariya domin bagade a ƙarƙashin zubin, biyu a gefe da gefe su fuskanci juna, don su riƙe sandunan da ake amfani da su don ɗaukarsa.
english: You shall make two golden rings for it under its molding; on its two ribs, on its two sides you shall make them; and they shall be for places for poles with which to bear it.

hausa: Na kuma ɗauki Lawiyawa a maimakon dukan ’ya’yan fari maza a Isra’ila.
english: I have taken the Levites instead of all the firstborn among the children of Israel.

hausa: ’Ya’yan Kush maza su ne, Seba, Hawila, Sabta, Ra’ama da Sabteka. ’Ya’yan Ra’ama maza kuwa su ne, Sheba da Dedan.
english: The sons of Cush were: Seba, Havilah, Sabtah, Raamah, and Sabteca. The sons of Raamah were: Sheba and Dedan.

hausa: Ku kula fa kada ku miƙa hadayun ƙonawa a wani wurin da kuka ga dama.
english: Be careful that you don’t offer your burnt offerings in every place that you see;

hausa: Allah kuma ya sa muguntar mutanen Shekem suka koma kansu. La’anar Yotam ɗan Yerub-Ba’al kuma ta kama su.
english: and God repaid all the wickedness of the men of Shechem on their heads; and the curse of Jotham the son of Jerubbaal came on them.

hausa: sai wani manzo ya zo wurin Shawulu yana cewa, “Ka koma da sauri, Filistiyawa sun kawo wa ƙasar hari.”
english: But a messenger came to Saul, saying, “Hurry and come, for the Philistines have made a raid on the land!”

hausa: Bayan ya haifi Enok, Yared ya yi shekaru 800, ya kuma haifi waɗansu ’ya’ya maza da mata.
english: Jared lived after he became the father of Enoch eight hundred years, and became the father of other sons and daughters.

hausa: Na kuma ga wani misali game da hikima a duniya wanda ya burge ni sosai.
english: I have also seen wisdom under the sun in this way, and it seemed great to me.

hausa: Akwai aiki iri-iri, amma duk Allah ɗaya ne yake aikata su a cikin dukan mutane.
english: There are various kinds of workings, but the same God who works all things in all.

hausa: Duk aiki tuƙuru yakan kawo riba, amma zama kana surutu kan kai ga talauci kawai.
english: In all hard work there is profit, but the talk of the lips leads only to poverty.

hausa: Ɗana, ka mai da hankali ga hikimata ka saurara da kyau ga kalmomin basirata,
english: My son, pay attention to my wisdom. Turn your ear to my understanding,

hausa: Isra’ilawa suka kame kamammu daga ’yan’uwansu mata, ’ya’ya maza da kuma ’ya’ya mata dubu ɗari biyu. Suka kuma kwashe ganima mai yawan gaske, waɗanda suka kwasa zuwa Samariya.
english: The children of Israel carried away captive of their brothers two hundred thousand women, sons, and daughters, and also took away much plunder from them, and brought the plunder to Samaria.

hausa: Gama naman jikina abinci ne na gaskiya jinina kuma abin sha ne na gaskiya.
english: For my flesh is food indeed, and my blood is drink indeed.

hausa: Ka kiyaye raina bisa ga ƙaunarka, zan kuwa yi biyayya da farillan bakinka.
english: Preserve my life according to your loving kindness, so I will obey the statutes of your mouth. LAMEDH

hausa: Ta sāke yin ciki, sa’ad da kuma ta haifi ɗa sai ta ce, “Gama Ubangiji ya ji cewa ba a ƙaunata, ya ba ni wannan shi ma.” Saboda haka ta ba shi suna Simeyon.
english: She conceived again, and bore a son, and said, “Because Yahweh has heard that I am hated, he has therefore given me this son also.” She named him Simeon.

hausa: Wannan ya tashi daga Arower a gefen kwarin Arnon, da kuma daga garin da yake tsakiyar kwarin, ya kuma haɗa da ƙasar da take tudun Medeba har zuwa Dibon,
english: from Aroer, that is on the edge of the valley of the Arnon, and the city that is in the middle of the valley, and all the plain of Medeba to Dibon;

hausa: Suna wucewa kamar jirgin ruwan da aka yi da kyauro, kamar jahurma da ta kai wa namanta cafka.
english: They have passed away as the swift ships, as the eagle that swoops on the prey.

hausa: A karɓi rigunan wanda ya ɗauki lamunin baƙo; a riƙe shi jingina in ya yi shi don mace marar aminci.
english: Take the garment of one who puts up collateral for a stranger; and hold him in pledge for a wayward woman.

hausa: A kan rana ta goma ga watan goma, a shekara ta tara ta mulkin Zedekiya, Sarkin Yahuda, sai Nebukadnezzar, Sarkin Babilon, ya zo yaƙi da Urushalima tare da dukan sojojinsa. Suka kewaye ta da yaƙi, suka gina katanga kewaye da ita.
english: In the ninth year of his reign, in the tenth month, in the tenth day of the month, Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came, he and all his army, against Jerusalem, and encamped against it; and they built forts against it round about.

hausa: Dubi samarin Sihiyona masu daraja, waɗanda a dā darajarsu ta isa nauyin zinariya, yanzu ana ɗaukar su a matsayin tukwanen ƙasa, aikin maginin tukwane!
english: The precious sons of Zion, comparable to fine gold, how they are esteemed as earthen pitchers, the work of the hands of the potter!

hausa: Mala’ikan ya ƙara da cewa, “Zan ƙara zuriyarki har su yi yawan da ba wanda zai iya lasafta su.”
english: Yahweh’s angel said to her, “I will greatly multiply your offspring, that they will not be counted for multitude.”

hausa: Kaburburansu suna cikin zurfafan rami kuma sojojinta suna kwance kewaye da kabarinta. Dukan waɗanda suka haddasa tsoro a ƙasar masu rai sun mutu, an kashe su da takobi.
english: whose graves are set in the uttermost parts of the pit, and her company is around her grave, all of them slain, fallen by the sword, who caused terror in the land of the living.

hausa: Yadda yake dai, akwai gaɓoɓi da yawa, amma jiki ɗaya.
english: But now they are many members, but one body.

hausa: Ga Yahudawa kuwa, lokaci ne na murna da farin ciki, da jin daɗi da bangirma.
english: The Jews had light, gladness, joy, and honor.

hausa: A shekara ta goma sha takwas ta mulkinsa, Sarki Yosiya ya aiki Shafan ɗan Azaliya, ɗan Meshullam, magatakarda, zuwa haikalin Ubangiji. Ya ce,
english: In the eighteenth year of King Josiah, the king sent Shaphan, the son of Azaliah the son of Meshullam, the scribe, to Yahweh’s house, saying,

hausa: Dajiyoyin da suke a bisa suna da fasalin bi-rana ne. Ta haka aka gama aiki a kan ginshiƙan.
english: On the tops of the pillars was lily work. So the work of the pillars was finished.

hausa: Dukan duniya sun rusuna a gabanka suna rera yabo gare ka, suna rera yabo ga sunanka.” Sela
english: All the earth will worship you, and will sing to you; they will sing to your name.” Selah.

hausa: Gaba da shi, Nehemiya ɗan Azbuk, mai mulkin rabin yankin Bet-Zur ne ya yi gyare-gyaren har zuwa kusa da kaburburan Dawuda, har zuwa haƙaƙƙen tafki da kuma Gidan Jarumawa.
english: After him, Nehemiah the son of Azbuk, the ruler of half the district of Beth Zur, made repairs to the place opposite the tombs of David, and to the pool that was made, and to the house of the mighty men.

hausa: Sai uwar Yesu da ’yan’uwansa suka zo, domin su gan shi, amma ba su iya zuwa kusa da shi ba, saboda taron.
english: His mother and brothers came to him, and they could not come near him for the crowd.

hausa: Sai Maryamu ta ɗauki wajen awo guda na nardi zalla, turare mai tsada; ta zuba a ƙafafun Yesu ta kuma goge ƙafafunsa da gashinta. Gidan duk ya cika da ƙanshin turaren.
english: Therefore Mary took a pound of ointment of pure nard, very precious, and anointed Jesus’ feet and wiped his feet with her hair. The house was filled with the fragrance of the ointment.

hausa: (Yahudawa da kuma waɗanda suka tuba suka shiga Yahudanci); Kiretawa da Larabawa, mun ji su suna shelar abubuwan banmamaki na Allah da yarenmu!”
english: Cretans and Arabians—we hear them speaking in our languages the mighty works of God!”

hausa: Ni kamar kurma ne, wanda ba ya ji, kamar bebe, wanda ba ya iya buɗe bakinsa.
english: But I, as a deaf man, don’t hear. I am as a mute man who doesn’t open his mouth.

hausa: Bari mu yi farin ciki mu kuma yi murna mu kuma ɗaukaka shi! Domin lokacin auren Ɗan Ragon ya yi, amaryarsa kuwa ta shirya kanta.
english: Let’s rejoice and be exceedingly glad, and let’s give the glory to him. For the wedding of the Lamb has come, and his wife has made herself ready.”

hausa: Akwai ƙofofi uku a gabas, uku a arewa, uku a kudu, uku kuma a yamma.
english: On the east were three gates, and on the north three gates, and on the south three gates, and on the west three gates.

hausa: Haruna ya auri Elisheba, ’yar Amminadab, ’yar’uwar Nashon, sai ta haifa masa Nadab da Abihu, Eleyazar da Itamar.
english: Aaron took Elisheba, the daughter of Amminadab, the sister of Nahshon, as his wife; and she bore him Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar.

hausa: Kamar katantanwun da suke narkewa yayinda suke tafiya, kamar jinjirin da aka haifa matacce, kada su ga hasken rana.
english: Let them be like a snail which melts and passes away, like the stillborn child, who has not seen the sun.

hausa: Sai Ayuba ya amsa wa Ubangiji,
english: Then Job answered Yahweh,

hausa: Ka sa su yi amfani da zinariya, da zare mai ruwan shuɗi da shunayya da ja, da kuma lallausan lilin.
english: They shall use the gold, and the blue, and the purple, and the scarlet, and the fine linen.

hausa: Saboda haka Nebuzaradan shugaban matsara, Nebushazban babban hafsa, Nergal-Sharezer bafade mai girma da sauran hafsoshin sarkin Babilon
english: So Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard, Nebushazban, Rabsaris, and Nergal Sharezer, Rabmag, and all the chief officers of the king of Babylon

hausa: Suka nemi kyakkyawar yarinya cikin fāɗin Isra’ila, sai suka sami Abishag, mutuniyar Shunam, suka kawo ta wa sarki.
english: So they sought for a beautiful young lady throughout all the borders of Israel, and found Abishag the Shunammite, and brought her to the king.

hausa: Sa’ad da Enok ya yi shekara 65, sai ya haifi Metusela.
english: Enoch lived sixty-five years, then became the father of Methuselah.

hausa: Sarakuna za su zama kamar iyayen reno, sarauniyoyinsu kuma za su yi renonku kamar uwaye. Za su rusuna a gabanki da fuskokinsu har ƙasa; za su lashe ƙura a ƙafafunki. Sa’an nan za ki san cewa ni ne Ubangiji; waɗanda suke sa zuciya gare ni ba za su sha kunya ba.”
english: Kings shall be your foster fathers, and their queens your nursing mothers. They will bow down to you with their faces to the earth, and lick the dust of your feet. Then you will know that I am Yahweh; and those who wait for me won’t be disappointed.”

hausa: Dukiyarki, cinikinki da kayan kasuwarki, ma’aikatanki na jirgi, matuƙan jiragenki da masu tattoshe mahaɗan katakan jiragenki, ’yan kasuwarki da dukan sojojinki, da kuma kowa da yake cikin jirgi zai nutsa a tsakiyar teku a ranar da jirginki zai nutse.
english: Your riches, your wares, your merchandise, your mariners, your pilots, your repairers of ship seams, the dealers in your merchandise, and all your men of war who are in you, with all your company which is among you, will fall into the heart of the seas in the day of your ruin.
