hausa: Kowace tukunya a Urushalima da Yahuda za tă zama mai tsarki ga Ubangiji Maɗaukaki, kuma duk wanda ya zo don miƙa hadaya zai ɗauki waɗansu tukwane yă yi dahuwa da su. A ranan nan kuwa, ba Bakan’ane da zai ƙara kasance a gidan Ubangiji Maɗaukaki.
english: Yes, every pot in Jerusalem and in Judah will be holy to Yahweh of Armies; and all those who sacrifice will come and take of them, and cook in them. In that day there will no longer be a Canaanite in the house of Yahweh of Armies.

hausa: Don me mugun mutum zai ƙi Allah? Don me yakan ce wa kansa, “Allah ba zai nemi hakki daga gare ni ba”?
english: Why does the wicked person condemn God, and say in his heart, “God won’t call me into account”?

hausa: da jakuna 61,000.
english: sixty-one thousand donkeys,

hausa: “Zan miƙa hannuna gāba da Yahuda da kuma dukan mazaunan Urushalima. Zan datse raguwar Ba’al daga wannan wuri, da sunayen firistocin gumaka da na marasa sanin Allah,
english: I will stretch out my hand against Judah and against all the inhabitants of Jerusalem. I will cut off the remnant of Baal from this place—the name of the idolatrous and pagan priests,

hausa: Sai ya ce, “Daga mai ci, abinci ya fito; daga mai ƙarfi, abu mai zaki ya fito.” Har kwana uku ba su iya ba da amsa ba.
english: He said to them, “Out of the eater came out food. Out of the strong came out sweetness.” They couldn’t in three days declare the riddle.

hausa: Ina farin ciki ne don na amince da ku ƙwarai da gaske.
english: I rejoice that in everything I am confident concerning you.

hausa: Za su yi karo da juna kamar waɗanda suke tsere wa takobi, ko da yake babu wanda yake korinsu. Ta haka ba za ku iya tsaya a gaban abokan gābanku ba.
english: They will stumble over one another, as it were before the sword, when no one pursues. You will have no power to stand before your enemies.

hausa: Duk wanda ba ya ƙaunar Ubangiji, la’ana ta zauna a kansa. Zo, ya Ubangiji!
english: If any man doesn’t love the Lord Jesus Christ, let him be cursed. Come, Lord!

hausa: Arameyawa daga gabas da Filistiyawa daga yamma sun cinye Isra’ila da buɗaɗɗen baki. Duk da haka, fushinsa bai huce ba, hannunsa har yanzu yana a miƙe.
english: The Syrians in front, and the Philistines behind; and they will devour Israel with open mouth. For all this, his anger is not turned away, but his hand is stretched out still.

hausa: Amma sa’ad da suka bar Masar, Isra’ila ta bi ta hamada zuwa Jan Teku har suka zo Kadesh.
english: but when they came up from Egypt, and Israel went through the wilderness to the Red Sea, and came to Kadesh,

hausa: Da ya kai wurin, sai ya ce musu, “Ku yi addu’a don kada ku fāɗi cikin jarraba.”
english: When he was at the place, he said to them, “Pray that you don’t enter into temptation.”

hausa: Za su ce, “Kamar yadda mutum kan yi huda yă tsage ƙasa, haka aka watsar da ƙasusuwanmu a bakin kabari.”
english: “As when one plows and breaks up the earth, our bones are scattered at the mouth of Sheol.”

hausa: Kamar yadda azurfa kan narke a tanderu, haka za ku narke a cikinta, kuma za ku san cewa Ni Ubangiji na zubo muku da zafin fushina.’ ”
english: As silver is melted in the middle of the furnace, so you will be melted in the middle of it; and you will know that I, Yahweh, have poured out my wrath on you.’”

hausa: Ku sa zuciya ga Ubangiji ku kuma kiyaye hanyarsa. Zai ɗaukaka ku ku ci gādon ƙasar, sa’ad da aka kawar da mugaye, za ka gani.
english: Wait for Yahweh, and keep his way, and he will exalt you to inherit the land. When the wicked are cut off, you shall see it.

hausa: Leɓunan adalai kan amfane yawanci, amma wawa kan mutu saboda rashin azanci.
english: The lips of the righteous feed many, but the foolish die for lack of understanding.

hausa: A’a, ina nufin akan miƙa hadayun da masu bautar gumaka suka wa aljanu ne, ba Allah ba. Ba na so ku zama ɗaya da aljanu.
english: But I say that the things which the Gentiles sacrifice, they sacrifice to demons and not to God, and I don’t desire that you would have fellowship with demons.

hausa: zai kuma fito don yă ruɗi al’ummai da suke a kursuyoyi huɗu na duniya, Gog da Magog, yă tattara su don yaƙi. Yawansu kuwa ya yi kamar yashi a bakin teku.
english: and he will come out to deceive the nations which are in the four corners of the earth, Gog and Magog, to gather them together to the war, whose number is as the sand of the sea.

hausa: Kibiyoyin Maɗaukaki suna a kaina, ruhuna yana shan dafinsa; fushin Allah ya sauka a kaina.
english: For the arrows of the Almighty are within me. My spirit drinks up their poison. The terrors of God set themselves in array against me.

hausa: Da ’ya’yan Yaƙub maza suka dawo daga jeji sai suka ji labarin. Abin kuwa ya zafe su ƙwarai, don Shekem ya jawo abin kunya wa jama’ar Isra’ila ta wurin kwana da ’yar Yaƙub, don bai kamata wannan abu yă faru ba.
english: The sons of Jacob came in from the field when they heard it. The men were grieved, and they were very angry, because he had done folly in Israel in lying with Jacob’s daughter, a thing that ought not to be done.

hausa: Saboda haka bisa ga umarnin Ubangiji, Musa ya aike su daga Hamadan Faran. Dukansu kuwa shugabanni ne na Isra’ilawa.
english: Moses sent them from the wilderness of Paran according to the commandment of Yahweh. All of them were men who were heads of the children of Israel.

hausa: ku yi kiɗi ga Ubangiji da garaya, da garaya da ƙarar rerawa,
english: Sing praises to Yahweh with the harp, with the harp and the voice of melody.

hausa: Gama Yesu ya riga ya umarci mugun ruhun ya fita daga mutumin. Sau da yawa mugun ruhun ya sha kamunsa. Ko da yake akan daure shi hannu da ƙafa, da sarƙa, a kuma yi gadinsa, amma yakan tsinke sarƙoƙinsa, aljanun kuma su kore shi zuwa wuraren kaɗaici, inda ba kowa.
english: For Jesus was commanding the unclean spirit to come out of the man. For the unclean spirit had often seized the man. He was kept under guard and bound with chains and fetters. Breaking the bonds apart, he was driven by the demon into the desert.

hausa: Musa kuwa ya aikata kamar dai yadda Ubangiji ya umarce shi.
english: Moses did so. As Yahweh commanded him, so he did.

hausa: Shi kaɗai ne dutsena da cetona; shi ne kagarata, ba zan jijjigu ba.
english: He alone is my rock, my salvation, and my fortress. I will never be greatly shaken.

hausa: Babbar ’yar’uwarki mutuniyar Samariya ce, wadda take zaune da ’ya’yanta mata wajen arewa da ke; ƙanuwarki ita ce Sodom wadda take zaune kudu da ke tare da ’ya’yanta mata.
english: Your elder sister is Samaria, who dwells at your left hand, she and her daughters; and your younger sister, who dwells at your right hand, is Sodom with her daughters.

hausa: Ka fadada hanyar da yake a ƙarƙashina, don kada ɗiɗɗigena yă juya.
english: You have enlarged my steps under me, My feet have not slipped.

hausa: Amma wane ne a cikinsu ya taɓa tsaya a majalisar Ubangiji yă ga ko ya ji maganarsa? Wa ya saurari ya kuma ji maganarsa?
english: For who has stood in the council of Yahweh, that he should perceive and hear his word? Who has listened to my word, and heard it?

hausa: Kamar datsewar ƙafafun wani ko shan dafi haka yake da a aika da saƙo ta hannun wawa.
english: One who sends a message by the hand of a fool is cutting off feet and drinking violence.

hausa: A ɗaya gefen, gefen arewa na tabanakul, suka yi katakai ashirin
english: For the second side of the tabernacle, on the north side, he made twenty boards

hausa: To, saboda mutane da yawa suna kai da kawowa, har ma ba su sami damar cin abinci ba, sai ya ce musu, “Ku zo mu kaɗaita inda ba kowa don ku ɗan huta.”
english: He said to them, “Come away into a deserted place, and rest awhile.” For there were many coming and going, and they had no leisure so much as to eat.

hausa: To, abin da nake umartanku a yau, ba mai wuya ba ne gare ku, ba kuma abin da ya fi ƙarfinku ba ne.
english: For this commandment which I command you today is not too hard for you or too distant.

hausa: A mazaunin masarautar a Shusha, Yahudawa suka karkashe, suka kuma hallaka mutum ɗari biyar.
english: In the citadel of Susa, the Jews killed and destroyed five hundred men.

hausa: Za ku kuma ga bambanci tsakanin masu adalci da mugaye, tsakanin waɗanda suke wa Allah hidima da kuma waɗanda ba sa yi.
english: Then you shall return and discern between the righteous and the wicked, between him who serves God and him who doesn’t serve him.

hausa: Da ya sami izini daga shugaban ƙungiyar sojan, sai Bulus ya tsaya a matakala, ya ɗaga wa taron hannu. Da dukan suka yi shiru, sai ya ce musu da Arameyanci,
english: When he had given him permission, Paul, standing on the stairs, beckoned with his hand to the people. When there was a great silence, he spoke to them in the Hebrew language, saying,

hausa: An yanke inabinka, an ƙone shi da wuta; a tsawatawarka mutanenka sun hallaka.
english: It’s burned with fire. It’s cut down. They perish at your rebuke.

hausa: Dawuda kuwa ya umarta a tattara baƙin da suke zama a Isra’ila, daga cikinsu ya sa masu farfasa duwatsu don su shirya duwatsun da aka sassaƙa saboda ginin gidan Allah.
english: David gave orders to gather together the foreigners who were in the land of Israel; and he set masons to cut dressed stones to build God’s house.

hausa: Mu shaidu ne ga waɗannan abubuwa, haka kuma Ruhu Mai Tsarki, wanda Allah ya ba wa waɗanda suke yin masa biyayya.”
english: We are his witnesses of these things; and so also is the Holy Spirit, whom God has given to those who obey him.”

hausa: “ ‘Ku kiyaye Asabbacina, ku kuma girmama wuri mai tsarkina. Ni ne Ubangiji.
english: “‘You shall keep my Sabbaths, and reverence my sanctuary; I am Yahweh.

hausa: Daga nesa na sami sanina; zan nuna cewa Mahaliccina shi mai gaskiya ne.
english: I will get my knowledge from afar, and will ascribe righteousness to my Maker.

hausa: jimiri kuma yakan kawo hali mai kyau; hali mai kyau kuma yakan sa bege.
english: and perseverance, proven character; and proven character, hope;

hausa: saboda haka zan miƙa hannuna gāba da ku in kuma ba da ku ganima ga al’ummai. Zan datse ku daga al’ummai in kuma kore ku daga ƙasashe. Zan hallaka ku, za ku kuwa san cewa ni ne Ubangiji.’ ”
english: therefore, behold, I have stretched out my hand on you, and will deliver you for a plunder to the nations. I will cut you off from the peoples, and I will cause you to perish out of the countries. I will destroy you. Then you will know that I am Yahweh.”

hausa: Ban da haraji daga ’yan kasuwa, da fatake, da kuma daga dukan sarakunan Arabiya, da gwamnonin ƙasar.
english: in addition to that which the traders brought, and the traffic of the merchants, and of all the kings of the mixed people, and of the governors of the country.

hausa: Ya yi mata alkawari da rantsuwa cewa, “Duk abin da kika roƙa, zan ba ki, ko da rabin mulkina ne.”
english: He swore to her, “Whatever you ask of me, I will give you, up to half of my kingdom.”

hausa: Zai shari’anta tsakanin mutane yă kuma sulhunta tsakanin manyan al’ummai nesa da kuma kusa. Har su mai da takubansu su zama garemani, māsunsu kuma su zama wuƙaƙen askin itace. Al’umma ba za tă ɗauki takobi gāba da wata al’umma ba, ko a yi horarwa don yaƙi.
english: and he will judge between many peoples, and will decide concerning strong nations afar off. They will beat their swords into plowshares, and their spears into pruning hooks. Nation will not lift up sword against nation, neither will they learn war any more.

hausa: Sai mutanen suka amsa suka ce, “Allah ya kiyashe mu da rabuwa da Ubangiji Allahnmu, har a ce mu bauta wa waɗansu alloli!
english: The people answered, “Far be it from us that we should forsake Yahweh, to serve other gods;

hausa: Suka girmama mu ta kowane hali da muka shirya za mu tashi, sai suka ba mu abubuwan da muke bukata.
english: They also honored us with many honors; and when we sailed, they put on board the things that we needed.

hausa: Saboda haka, fushin Ubangiji ya fāɗo a kan Yahuda da Urushalima; ya mai da su abin tsoro da abin banrazana da kuma abin ba’a, kamar yadda kuke gani da idanunku.
english: Therefore Yahweh’s wrath was on Judah and Jerusalem, and he has delivered them to be tossed back and forth, to be an astonishment and a hissing, as you see with your eyes.

hausa: Idanuna za su ci gaba da kwararowa da hawaye, ba hutawa.
english: My eye pours down and doesn’t cease, without any intermission,

hausa: Ko da duwatsu za su girgiza a kuma tumɓuke tuddai, duk da haka madawwamiyar ƙaunata da nake yi miki ba za tă jijjigu ba ba kuwa za a kawar da alkawarin salamata ba,” in ji Ubangiji, wanda ya ji tausayinki.
english: For the mountains may depart, and the hills be removed, but my loving kindness will not depart from you, and my covenant of peace will not be removed,” says Yahweh who has mercy on you.

hausa: Zadok da Ahimawaz.
english: Zadok his son, and Ahimaaz his son.

hausa: Naman jikina na rawan jiki don tsoronka; na cika da tsoron dokokinka.
english: My flesh trembles for fear of you. I am afraid of your judgments. AYIN

hausa: Mai farin ciki ne mutumin da Ubangiji ba ya lissafin zunubinsa a kansa wanda kuma babu ruɗu a ruhunsa.
english: Blessed is the man to whom Yahweh doesn’t impute iniquity, in whose spirit there is no deceit.

hausa: Suka sami saɓanin ra’ayi tsakaninsu har suka rabu. Barnabas ya ɗauki Markus suka shiga jirgin ruwa zuwa Saifurus,
english: Then the contention grew so sharp that they separated from each other. Barnabas took Mark with him and sailed away to Cyprus,

hausa: Saboda haka Allah ya nuna alheri wa ungozomomin, Isra’ilawa kuwa suka yi yawa fiye da dā.
english: God dealt well with the midwives, and the people multiplied, and grew very mighty.

hausa: Sai mutanen nan suka je wurin sarki a ƙungiyance suka ce masa, “Ka tuna, ya sarki; cewa bisa ga dokar Medes da Farisa, babu umarni ko dokar da sarki ya yi da za a iya sokewa.”
english: Then these men assembled together to the king, and said to the king, “Know, O king, that it is a law of the Medes and Persians, that no decree nor statute which the king establishes may be changed.”

hausa: Awwim, Fara, Ofra,
english: Avvim, Parah, Ophrah,

hausa: “Ga yadda mazinaciya take yi. Takan ci ta share bakinta ta ce, ‘Ban yi wani abu marar kyau ba.’
english: “So is the way of an adulterous woman: She eats and wipes her mouth, and says, ‘I have done nothing wrong.’

hausa: Sa’ad da mala’ikan Ubangiji ya bayyana wa Gideyon, sai ya ce masa, “Ubangiji yana tare da kai, jarumi.”
english: Yahweh’s angel appeared to him, and said to him, “Yahweh is with you, you mighty man of valor!”

hausa: daga kabilar Naftali, Ahira ɗan Enan.”
english: Of Naphtali: Ahira the son of Enan.”

hausa: Firist zai sa sauran mai da yake cikin tafinsa a leɓatun kunnen dama na wanda za a tsabtacce, a babbar yatsarsa na dama da kuma a babbar yatsar ƙafarsa ta dama, a bisa jinin hadaya don laifin.
english: The priest shall put some of the rest of the oil that is in his hand on the tip of the right ear of him who is to be cleansed, and on the thumb of his right hand, and on the big toe of his right foot, upon the blood of the trespass offering.

hausa: Sa’an nan Eleyazar firist, ya ce wa sojojin da suka je yaƙi, “Wannan ita ce ƙa’idar da Ubangiji ya ba wa Musa.
english: Eleazar the priest said to the men of war who went to the battle, “This is the statute of the law which Yahweh has commanded Moses.

hausa: Amma Ga’al ya sāke magana ya ce, “Duba, mutane suna gangarowa daga tsakiyar filaye, kuma wata ƙungiya tana zuwa daga wajen itacen masu duba.”
english: Gaal spoke again and said, “Behold, people are coming down by the middle of the land, and one company comes by the way of the oak of Meonenim.”

hausa: yayinda taurarin safe suke waƙa tare dukan mala’iku kuma suka yi sowa don farin ciki.
english: when the morning stars sang together, and all the sons of God shouted for joy?

hausa: Sai Finehas ɗan Eleyazar, firist, ya ce wa mutanen Ruben, mutanen Gad da kuma rabin mutanen kabilar Manasse, “Yau mun san Ubangiji yana tare da mu, domin ba ku yi wa Ubangiji rashin aminci cikin wannan abu ba. Yanzu kun kuɓutar da Isra’ilawa daga hannun Ubangiji.”
english: Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest said to the children of Reuben, to the children of Gad, and to the children of Manasseh, “Today we know that Yahweh is among us, because you have not committed this trespass against Yahweh. Now you have delivered the children of Israel out of Yahweh’s hand.”

hausa: Ko da yake muna cikin duniya, ba ma yaƙi kamar yadda duniya take yi.
english: For though we walk in the flesh, we don’t wage war according to the flesh;

hausa: Simeyon zai sami rabo; zai yi iyaka da yankin Benyamin daga gabas zuwa yamma.
english: “By the border of Benjamin, from the east side to the west side, Simeon, one portion.

hausa: Sa’ad da na kira, ka amsa mini; ka sa na zama mai ƙarfin hali ka kuma ƙarfafa ni.
english: In the day that I called, you answered me. You encouraged me with strength in my soul.

hausa: Saboda haka sai ya gaya musu a fili cewa, “Lazarus ya mutu,
english: So Jesus said to them plainly then, “Lazarus is dead.

hausa: Mutum zai yi tunani hanyoyinsa daidai suke, amma Ubangiji yakan auna zuciya.
english: Every way of a man is right in his own eyes, but Yahweh weighs the hearts.

hausa: Sai kuka matso kusa, kuka tsaya a gindin dutse yayinda yana cin wuta har zuwa sararin sama, ga kuma baƙin gizagizai da kuma baƙin duhu.
english: You came near and stood under the mountain. The mountain burned with fire to the heart of the sky, with darkness, cloud, and thick darkness.

hausa: Akan tumɓuke mugaye ba a ƙara ganinsu, amma gidan masu adalci kan tsaya daram.
english: The wicked are overthrown, and are no more, but the house of the righteous shall stand.

hausa: Abin da adali yake sa rai yakan kai ga farin ciki, amma sa zuciyar mugu ba ya haifar da kome.
english: The prospect of the righteous is joy, but the hope of the wicked will perish.

hausa: cewa, “Tabbatacce zan albarkace ka in kuma ba ka zuriya mai yawa.”
english: saying, “Surely blessing I will bless you, and multiplying I will multiply you.”

hausa: Isra’ilawa suka yi kamar yadda aka faɗa musu, waɗansu suka tattara da yawa, waɗansu kuma kaɗan.
english: The children of Israel did so, and some gathered more, some less.

hausa: Haɗe da Gileyad, inda mutanen Geshur da Ma’aka suke. Dukan Dutsen Hermon, da dukan Bashan har zuwa Saleka,
english: and Gilead, and the border of the Geshurites and Maacathites, and all Mount Hermon, and all Bashan to Salecah;

hausa: Har wa yau, wani ya ce, “Zan bi ka, Ubangiji, amma ka bar ni in je in yi bankwana da iyalina tukuna.”
english: Another also said, “I want to follow you, Lord, but first allow me to say good-bye to those who are at my house.”

hausa: ya ce wa mahaifiyarsa, “Shekel dubu ɗaya da ɗari ɗaya na azurfa da aka ɗauka daga gare ki wanda kuma ji kin furta la’ana a kai, azurfan yana wurina; ni ne na ɗauka.” Sa’an nan mahaifiyarsa ta ce, “Ubangiji yă albarkace ka ɗana!”
english: He said to his mother, “The eleven hundred pieces of silver that were taken from you, about which you uttered a curse, and also spoke it in my ears—behold, the silver is with me. I took it.” His mother said, “May Yahweh bless my son!”

hausa: Ya ce wa mutanensa, “Ubangiji yă sawwaƙe in yi abu haka ga shugabana da Ubangiji ya shafe, ko in ɗaga hannuna in kashe shi, gama shi shafaffe ne na Ubangiji.”
english: He said to his men, “Yahweh forbid that I should do this thing to my lord, Yahweh’s anointed, to stretch out my hand against him, since he is Yahweh’s anointed.”

hausa: Sai Na’omi ta ce, “Duba, ’yar’uwanki ta koma zuwa ga mutanenta da kuma allolinta. Ki koma tare da ita.”
english: She said, “Behold, your sister-in-law has gone back to her people and to her god. Follow your sister-in-law.”

hausa: Kowane irin abu da mushensu ya fāɗa a kai ya ƙazantu ke nan; ko a kan murhu, ko a tukunyar dahuwa, dole a farfashe su. Su haramtattu ne kuma dole ku ɗauke su haramtattu.
english: Everything whereupon part of their carcass falls shall be unclean; whether oven, or range for pots, it shall be broken in pieces. They are unclean, and shall be unclean to you.

hausa: Yana girgiza ƙasa, yana girgiza harsashenta.
english: He shakes the earth out of its place. Its pillars tremble.

hausa: Sa’an nan sarkin Isra’ila ya umarta, “Ɗauki Mikahiya ku aika da shi zuwa ga Amon mai mulkin birni da kuma ga Yowash ɗan sarki,
english: The king of Israel said, “Take Micaiah, and carry him back to Amon the governor of the city, and to Joash the king’s son;

hausa: Sarkin Isra’ila ya tattara dukan dattawan ƙasar, ya ce musu, “Ku duba fa, wannan mutum yana neman tsokana! Sa’ad da ya aika in ba shi matana da ’ya’yana, azurfana da zinariyana, ban hana masa ba.”
english: Then the king of Israel called all the elders of the land, and said, “Please notice how this man seeks mischief; for he sent to me for my wives, and for my children, and for my silver, and for my gold; and I didn’t deny him.”

hausa: In mai neman yă kashe shi don ramako ya bi shi zuwa can, ba za su miƙa shi ba domin ba da niyya ya kashe wani ba, kuma ba fushi ne ya sa ya yi kisan ba.
english: If the avenger of blood pursues him, then they shall not deliver up the man slayer into his hand; because he struck his neighbor unintentionally, and didn’t hate him before.

hausa: sai na sa abokan gābanka su zama matashin sawunka.” ’
english: until I make your enemies a footstool for your feet.”’

hausa: Suka cika da baƙin ciki, da ɗaya-ɗaya suka ce masa, “Tabbatacce, ba ni ba ne, ko?”
english: They began to be sorrowful, and to ask him one by one, “Surely not I?” And another said, “Surely not I?”

hausa: Ta wurin bangaskiya cikin sunan Yesu ne wannan mutum da kuke gani kuka kuma sani ya sami ƙarfi. Da sunan Yesu, da kuma bangaskiyar da take samuwa ta wurinsa ne ya ba shi cikakkiyar warkarwa, yadda dukanku kuke gani.
english: By faith in his name, his name has made this man strong, whom you see and know. Yes, the faith which is through him has given him this perfect soundness in the presence of you all.

hausa: Daga bakinsa takobi mai kaifi ya fito. Da shi zai karkashe al’ummai. “Zai yi mulkinsu da sandan sarautar ƙarfe.” Yana tattake wurin matsin ruwan inabi na fushin Allah Maɗaukaki.
english: Out of his mouth proceeds a sharp, double-edged sword that with it he should strike the nations. He will rule them with an iron rod. He treads the wine press of the fierceness of the wrath of God, the Almighty.

hausa: Bayan ya haifi Yared, Mahalalel ya yi shekara 830, ya kuma haifi waɗansu ’ya’ya maza da mata
english: Mahalalel lived after he became the father of Jared eight hundred thirty years, and became the father of other sons and daughters.

hausa: “Ku bugar da ita domin ta tayar wa Ubangiji. Bari Mowab tă yi ta birgima a cikin amanta; bari tă zama abin dariya.
english: “Make him drunk, for he magnified himself against Yahweh. Moab will wallow in his vomit, and he also will be in derision.

hausa: Ka yi kuka ka yi makoki, ɗan mutum, gama yana gāba da dukan sarakunan Isra’ila. An jefa su ga takobi tare da jama’ata. Saboda haka ku buga ƙirjinku.
english: Cry and wail, son of man; for it is on my people. It is on all the princes of Israel. They are delivered over to the sword with my people. Therefore beat your thigh.

hausa: Ku sanya sabon halin nan da aka halitta bisa ga kamannin Allah, halin nan kuwa, yă bayyana cikin adalci, da zaman tsarki.
english: and put on the new man, who in the likeness of God has been created in righteousness and holiness of truth.

hausa: Kaiton mata masu ciki, da mata masu renon ’ya’ya a waɗancan kwanakin!
english: But woe to those who are with child and to those who nurse babies in those days!

hausa: Mun ɗauke kuɗin da an ajiye a haikalin Ubangiji muka ba wa masu aiki da waɗanda suke lura da su.”
english: They have emptied out the money that was found in Yahweh’s house, and have delivered it into the hand of the overseers and into the hand of the workmen.”

hausa: Ya kuwa mutu ne saboda dukan mutane, domin kada waɗanda suke rayuwa kada su yi zaman ganin dama a nan gaba, sai dai su yi zaman wannan da ya mutu saboda su, aka kuma tashe shi saboda su.
english: He died for all, that those who live should no longer live to themselves, but to him who for their sakes died and rose again.

hausa: Bayan dukan wannan, ya Ubangiji, ba za ka yi wani abu ba? Za ka yi shiru ka hore mu fiye da kima?
english: Will you hold yourself back for these things, Yahweh? Will you keep silent and punish us very severely?

hausa: “In mutum ya yi aron dabba daga wurin maƙwabcinsa, sai dabbar ta ji rauni ko ta mutu, yayinda mai shi ba ya nan, dole wanda ya yi aron dabbar yă biya.
english: “If a man borrows anything of his neighbor’s, and it is injured, or dies, its owner not being with it, he shall surely make restitution.

hausa: Na bi abokan gābana na kuma cim musu; ban juya ba sai da na hallaka su.
english: I will pursue my enemies, and overtake them. I won’t turn away until they are consumed.

hausa: “Duk da haka kamar abu marar nauyi suke a kan ruwa; gefen ƙasar da suke, an la’anta ta, yadda ba wanda yake zuwa gonar inabinsu.
english: “They are foam on the surface of the waters. Their portion is cursed on the earth. They don’t turn into the way of the vineyards.

hausa: Waɗanda suka taɓa samun haske, waɗanda suka ɗanɗana kyauta ta sama, waɗanda suka sami rabo cikin Ruhu Mai Tsarki,
english: For concerning those who were once enlightened and tasted of the heavenly gift, and were made partakers of the Holy Spirit,

hausa: Ku ƙaunaci Ubangiji, dukanku tsarkakansa! Ubangiji yakan adana amintattu, amma masu girman kai yakan sāka musu cikakke.
english: Oh love Yahweh, all you his saints! Yahweh preserves the faithful, and fully recompenses him who behaves arrogantly.

hausa: su mallaki yini da kuma dare, su kuma raba haske da duhu. Allah kuwa ya ga yana da kyau.
english: and to rule over the day and over the night, and to divide the light from the darkness. God saw that it was good.

hausa: Ya sa suka sauka a cikin sansaninsu, ko’ina kewaye da tentunansu.
english: He let them fall in the middle of their camp, around their habitations.

hausa: Haka kuwa aka caɓa miki zinariya da azurfa; tufafinki kuwa na lilin mai kyau da riguna masu tsada waɗanda aka yi musu ado. Abincinki na gari mai laushi ne, zuma da man zaitun. Kika zama kyakkyawa har kika kuma zama sarauniya.
english: Thus you were decked with gold and silver. Your clothing was of fine linen, silk, and embroidered work. You ate fine flour, honey, and oil. You were exceedingly beautiful, and you prospered to royal estate.

hausa: Dole Haruna da ’ya’yansa su sa su sa’ad da za su shiga Tentin Sujada, ko sa’ad da suka kusace bagade domin hidima a Wuri Mai Tsarki, don kada su yi laifi, su kuma mutu. “Wannan za tă zama dawwammamiyar farilla wa Haruna da zuriyarsa har abada.
english: They shall be on Aaron and on his sons, when they go in to the Tent of Meeting, or when they come near to the altar to minister in the holy place, that they don’t bear iniquity, and die. This shall be a statute forever to him and to his offspring after him.

hausa: Da Dawuda da mutanensa suka isa Ziklag suka tarar an ƙone garin, an kuma kwashe matansu, da ’ya’yansu mata, da kuma ’ya’yansu maza ganima,
english: When David and his men came to the city, behold, it was burned with fire; and their wives, their sons, and their daughters were taken captive.

hausa: Amma ku, jikunanku za su fāɗi a wannan hamada.
english: But as for you, your dead bodies shall fall in this wilderness.

hausa: Firistoci. Zuriyar Yedahiya (ta wurin iyalin Yeshuwa) 973
english: The priests: the children of Jedaiah, of the house of Jeshua, nine hundred seventy-three.

hausa: Nan da nan da Yahuda ya karɓi burodin, sai ya fita. A lokacin kuwa dare ya yi.
english: Therefore having received that morsel, he went out immediately. It was night.

hausa: Saboda haka suka amsa wa Yesu suka ce, “Ba mu sani ba.” Sai ya ce, “Ni ma ba zan gaya muku ko da wane iko nake yin waɗannan abubuwa ba.”
english: They answered Jesus, and said, “We don’t know.” He also said to them, “Neither will I tell you by what authority I do these things.

hausa: Yesu ya amsa ya ce, “Yaya baƙin ango za su yi makoki yayinda yake tare da su? Lokaci yana zuwa da za a ɗauke ango daga gare su, sa’an nan za su yi azumi.
english: Jesus said to them, “Can the friends of the bridegroom mourn as long as the bridegroom is with them? But the days will come when the bridegroom will be taken away from them, and then they will fast.

hausa: lokacin da ruwa ya zama da ƙarfi kamar dutse, lokacin da saman ruwa ya daskare?
english: The waters become hard like stone, when the surface of the deep is frozen.

hausa: A wannan rana mutane za su yi muku ba’a za su yi muku gwalo da wannan waƙar makoki, ‘An lalatar da mu sarai; an rarraba mallakar mutanena. Ya ɗauke shi daga gare ni! Ya miƙa filayenmu ga maciyan amanarmu.’ ”
english: In that day they will take up a parable against you, and lament with a doleful lamentation, saying, ‘We are utterly ruined! My people’s possession is divided up. Indeed he takes it from me and assigns our fields to traitors!’”

hausa: Ni ne burodin rai.
english: I am the bread of life.

hausa: amma zama a damana ko haguna, ba ni nake ba da izinin ba. Waɗannan wurare na waɗanda aka riga aka shirya musu ne.”
english: but to sit at my right hand and at my left hand is not mine to give, but for whom it has been prepared.”

hausa: Sai wanda yake da hannu mai tsabta da kuma tsabtar zuciya, wanda ba ya ba da ransa ga bautar gunki ko ya rantse bisa abin da yake ƙarya.
english: He who has clean hands and a pure heart; who has not lifted up his soul to falsehood, and has not sworn deceitfully.

hausa: Waɗannan garuruwa da ƙauyukansu su ne gādon kabilar Dan, bisa ga iyalansu.
english: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Dan according to their families, these cities with their villages.

hausa: Za ku turke dabbar har rana ta goma sha huɗu ga wata, wato, sa’ad da dukan taron jama’ar Isra’ila za su yanka ragunansu da yamma.
english: You shall keep it until the fourteenth day of the same month; and the whole assembly of the congregation of Israel shall kill it at evening.

hausa: In ba ka da ƙarfi a lokacin wahala, ka tabbatar kai marar ƙarfi ne sosai!
english: If you falter in the time of trouble, your strength is small.

hausa: Ta wurin wannan magana ce aka ajiye sammai da ƙasa na yanzu domin wuta, an ajiye su kuma don ranar hukunci da hallaka ta mutane marasa tsoron Allah.
english: But the heavens that exist now and the earth, by the same word have been stored up for fire, being reserved against the day of judgment and destruction of ungodly men.

hausa: Sa’ad da Yowab da dukan sojoji suka dawo, aka gaya masa cewa Abner ɗan Ner ya zo wurin sarki, sarki kuwa ya sallame shi, ya kuma tafi lafiya.
english: When Joab and all the army who was with him had come, they told Joab, “Abner the son of Ner came to the king, and he has sent him away, and he has gone in peace.”

hausa: Dukan namun jeji da dukan tsuntsayen sama da kowace halitta mai rarrafe a ƙasa, da dukan kifayen teku, za su riƙa jin tsoronku, suna fargaba. An sa su a cikin hannuwanku.
english: The fear of you and the dread of you will be on every animal of the earth, and on every bird of the sky. Everything that moves along the ground, and all the fish of the sea, are delivered into your hand.

hausa: Amma Mikahiya ya ce, “Na rantse da ran Ubangiji, zan faɗa masa kawai abin da Allahna ya faɗa.”
english: Micaiah said, “As Yahweh lives, I will say what my God says.”

hausa: Waɗansu mutane masu wucewa suka ga an yar da gawar a can, zaki yana tsaye kusa da gawar, sai suka tafi suka ba da labarin a birni inda tsohon annabin nan yake zama.
english: Behold, men passed by and saw the body thrown on the path, and the lion standing by the body; and they came and told it in the city where the old prophet lived.

hausa: Da wannan magana Dawuda ya kwaɓi mutanensa, bai yarda su fāɗa wa Shawulu ba. Shawulu kuwa ya bar kogon ya yi tafiyarsa.
english: So David checked his men with these words, and didn’t allow them to rise against Saul. Saul rose up out of the cave, and went on his way.

hausa: Ku mallaki ƙasar, ku kuma zauna a ciki, gama na ba ku ƙasar, ku mallake ta.
english: You shall take possession of the land, and dwell therein; for I have given the land to you to possess it.

hausa: A ranan nan Ubangiji zai kiyaye waɗanda suke zama a Urushalima, domin marasa ƙarfi a cikinsu su zama kamar Dawuda, gidan Dawuda kuma zai zama kamar Allah, kamar mala’ikan Ubangiji da yake tafiya a gabansu.
english: In that day Yahweh will defend the inhabitants of Jerusalem. He who is feeble among them at that day will be like David, and David’s house will be like God, like Yahweh’s angel before them.

hausa: Sa’ad da Yabin sarkin Hazor ya ji wannan, sai ya aika saƙo zuwa wurin Yobab sarkin Madon, da sarkin Shimron, da Akshaf,
english: When Jabin king of Hazor heard of it, he sent to Jobab king of Madon, to the king of Shimron, to the king of Achshaph,

hausa: “Don me ba a sayar da turaren nan aka kuma ba da kuɗin ga matalauta ba? Ai, kuɗin ya kai albashin shekara guda.”
english: “Why wasn’t this ointment sold for three hundred denarii and given to the poor?”

hausa: Mala’ikan ya je wurinta ya ce, “A gaishe ki, ya ke da kika sami tagomashi ƙwarai! Ubangiji yana tare da ke.”
english: Having come in, the angel said to her, “Rejoice, you highly favored one! The Lord is with you. Blessed are you among women!”

hausa: Na gode wa Allah, domin ina magana da harsuna fiye da ku duka.
english: I thank my God, I speak with other languages more than you all.

hausa: Kada ku yarda Hezekiya yă rinjaye ku cewa ku dogara ga Allah, sa’ad da ya ce da ku, ‘Ba shakka Ubangiji zai cece mu; yana ce da ku birnin nan ba zai faɗa a hannun sarkin Assuriya ba.’
english: Don’t let Hezekiah make you trust in Yahweh, saying, “Yahweh will surely deliver us, and this city shall not be given into the hand of the king of Assyria.”

hausa: Saboda haka, ba ku rasa kowace baiwa ta ruhaniya ba, yayinda kuke jira da marmari, saboda bayyanuwar Ubangijinmu Yesu Kiristi.
english: so that you come behind in no gift, waiting for the revelation of our Lord Jesus Christ,

hausa: To, fa, Na’omi tana da dangi a gefen mijinta da iyalin Elimelek, mutum mai martaba, mai suna Bowaz.
english: Naomi had a relative of her husband’s, a mighty man of wealth, of the family of Elimelech, and his name was Boaz.

hausa: Haruna ya yanka maraƙin da ragon a matsayin hadaya ta salama domin mutane. ’Ya’yansa maza suka miƙa masa jinin, ya kuwa yayyafa shi a kowane gefe na bagade.
english: He also killed the bull and the ram, the sacrifice of peace offerings, which was for the people. Aaron’s sons delivered to him the blood, which he sprinkled around on the altar;

hausa: Sai Elisha ya bar shanun, ya ruga ya bi Iliya. Ya ce, “Bari in sumbace mahaifina da mahaifiyata, in yi musu bankwana, sa’an nan in zo in bi ka.” Iliya ya ce, “Koma! Me na yi maka?”
english: Elisha left the oxen and ran after Elijah, and said, “Let me please kiss my father and my mother, and then I will follow you.” He said to him, “Go back again; for what have I done to you?”

hausa: Zan rabu da ragowar gādona, in kuma miƙa su ga maƙiyansu. Abokan gābansu za su washe suka kuma kwashi ganima daga gare su,
english: I will cast off the remnant of my inheritance and deliver them into the hands of their enemies. They will become a prey and a plunder to all their enemies,

hausa: Ka yi nesa da maganganun banza na rashin tsoron Allah, gama waɗanda suka mai da hankali ga yin waɗannan za su ƙara zama marasa tsoron Allah.
english: But shun empty chatter, for it will go further in ungodliness,

hausa: Sai tsohon annabin ya tā da murya wa mutumin Allah wanda ya zo daga Yahuda, “Ga abin da Ubangiji ya ce, ‘Ka ƙazantar da maganar Ubangiji, ba ka kuma kiyaye umarnin Ubangiji Allahnka ba.
english: and he cried out to the man of God who came from Judah, saying, “Yahweh says, ‘Because you have been disobedient to Yahweh’s word, and have not kept the commandment which Yahweh your God commanded you,

hausa: Cikin dukan Isra’ilawa, na ba da Lawiyawa kyauta ga Haruna da ’ya’yansa, su yi hidima a Tentin Sujada a madadin Isra’ilawa, su kuma yi kafara dominsu saboda kada annoba ta bugi Isra’ilawa sa’ad da suka je kusa da wuri mai tsarki.”
english: I have given the Levites as a gift to Aaron and to his sons from among the children of Israel, to do the service of the children of Israel in the Tent of Meeting, and to make atonement for the children of Israel, so that there will be no plague among the children of Israel when the children of Israel come near to the sanctuary.”

hausa: Ransa yana matsawa kusa da rami, ransa kuma kusa da ’yan aikan mutuwa.
english: Yes, his soul draws near to the pit, and his life to the destroyers.

hausa: Zan komo da su su zauna a Urushalima; za su zama mutanena, ni kuwa zan zama amintaccen Allahnsu mai adalci.”
english: I will bring them, and they will dwell within Jerusalem. They will be my people, and I will be their God, in truth and in righteousness.”

hausa: Ko da na yi tafiya a tsakiyar wahala, kana kiyaye raina; ka miƙa hannunka a kan fushin maƙiyana, da hannunka na dama ka cece ni.
english: Though I walk in the middle of trouble, you will revive me. You will stretch out your hand against the wrath of my enemies. Your right hand will save me.

hausa: Bayan waɗannan al’amura, sai Sarki Zerzes ya girmama Haman ɗan Hammedata, mutumin Agag, ya ɗaukaka shi, ya kuma ba shi matsayi mafi girma fiye da na dukan sauran hakiman.
english: After these things King Ahasuerus promoted Haman the son of Hammedatha the Agagite, and advanced him, and set his seat above all the princes who were with him.

hausa: Zai zāre ta daga bayansa, tsinin zai fita daga hantarsa; tsoro zai cika shi;
english: He draws it out, and it comes out of his body. Yes, the glittering point comes out of his liver. Terrors are on him.

hausa: In sun yarda da salamar, suka buɗe ƙofofin garinsu, to, sai dukan mutanen da suke cikinsa su yi muku aikin gandu, su kuma yi muku aiki.
english: It shall be, if it gives you answer of peace and opens to you, then it shall be that all the people who are found therein shall become forced laborers to you, and shall serve you.

hausa: Amma yayinda kowa yake barci, abokin gābansa ya zo ya yafa ciyayi a cikin alkamar, ya tafi abinsa.
english: but while people slept, his enemy came and sowed darnel weeds also among the wheat, and went away.

hausa: Yesu ya ji labari cewa sun kore shi, da ya same shi kuwa, sai ya ce, “Ka gaskata da Ɗan Mutum?”
english: Jesus heard that they had thrown him out, and finding him, he said, “Do you believe in the Son of God?”

hausa: Na nutsa har ƙarƙashin tuddai; a ƙarƙashin duniya, ka rufe ni har abada. Amma ka dawo da raina daga rami, Ya Ubangiji Allahna.
english: I went down to the bottoms of the mountains. The earth barred me in forever; yet you have brought my life up from the pit, Yahweh my God.

hausa: Da isarsu, Sama’ila ya ga Eliyab sai ya yi tsammani shi ne, sai ya ce, “Lalle ga shafaffe na Ubangiji tsaye a gaban Ubangiji.”
english: When they had come, he looked at Eliab, and said, “Surely Yahweh’s anointed is before him.”

hausa: Me ya sa za a ƙara yin muku dūka? Me ya sa kuka nace ga yin tayarwa? An yi wa dukan kanku rauni, zuciyarku duk tana ciwo.
english: Why should you be beaten more, that you revolt more and more? The whole head is sick, and the whole heart faint.

hausa: Fir’auna ya ce wa Yusuf, “Mahaifinka da ’yan’uwanka sun zo maka,
english: Pharaoh spoke to Joseph, saying, “Your father and your brothers have come to you.

hausa: Sa’ad da na gan shi, sai na fāɗi a gabansa sai ka ce matacce. Sai ya ɗibiya hannunsa na dama a kaina ya ce, “Kada ka ji tsoro. Ni ne Farko da kuma Ƙarshe.
english: When I saw him, I fell at his feet like a dead man. He laid his right hand on me, saying, “Don’t be afraid. I am the first and the last,

hausa: Lokacin da Isra’ila suke a sansani a Shittim, sai maza suka fara yin lalata da matan Mowabawa,
english: Israel stayed in Shittim; and the people began to play the prostitute with the daughters of Moab;

hausa: “Mutumin ya amsa ya ce, ‘Ranka yă daɗe, ka bar shi, in yi masa banƙasa, in kuma zuba masa taki har na shekara ɗaya.
english: He answered, ‘Lord, leave it alone this year also, until I dig around it and fertilize it.

hausa: Bakina ya cika da yabonka, ina furta darajarka dukan yini.
english: My mouth shall be filled with your praise, with your honor all day long.

hausa: Da ya zo Urushalima, ya yi ƙoƙarin shiga cikin almajiran amma dukansu suka ji tsoronsa, ba su gaskata cewa tabbatacce shi almajiri ba ne.
english: When Saul had come to Jerusalem, he tried to join himself to the disciples; but they were all afraid of him, not believing that he was a disciple.

hausa: Ku hallaka dukan wuraren da al’umman da kuke kora suke yi wa allolinsu sujada, a kan duwatsu masu tsawo, da a kan tuddai, da kuma ƙarƙashin kowane itace gaba ɗaya.
english: You shall surely destroy all the places in which the nations that you shall dispossess served their gods: on the high mountains, and on the hills, and under every green tree.

hausa: A wannan dare Allah ya yi haka. Ulun ne kaɗai yake a bushe, amma dukan ƙasar ta jiƙe da raɓa.
english: God did so that night; for it was dry on the fleece only, and there was dew on all the ground.

hausa: Kabilar Yahuda kuwa ba su iya korar Yebusiyawa waɗanda suke zama cikin Urushalima ba; har wa yau Yebusiyawa suna nan zaune tare da mutanen Yahuda.
english: As for the Jebusites, the inhabitants of Jerusalem, the children of Judah couldn’t drive them out; but the Jebusites live with the children of Judah at Jerusalem to this day.

hausa: Ku yi godiya ga Ubangiji, gama shi nagari ne; ƙaunarsa madawwamiya ce.
english: Oh give thanks to Yahweh, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.

hausa: Mutane suka buɗe baki suka yi mini riyar reni; suka yi mini ba’a suka haɗu suka tayar mini.
english: They have gaped on me with their mouth. They have struck me on the cheek reproachfully. They gather themselves together against me.

hausa: Sa’an nan Ubangiji ya ce mini, “Akwai maƙarƙashiya a cikin mutanen Yahuda da waɗanda suke zaune a Urushalima.
english: Yahweh said to me, “A conspiracy is found among the men of Judah, and among the inhabitants of Jerusalem.

hausa: Ku saurara! Rahoto yana zuwa babban hargitsi daga ƙasar arewa! Zai mai da garuruwan Yahuda kufai, mazaunin diloli.
english: The voice of news, behold, it comes, and a great commotion out of the north country, to make the cities of Judah a desolation, a dwelling place of jackals.

hausa: Saboda haka zan kunyata manyan baƙi na haikalinku, zan tura Yaƙub ga hallaka Isra’ila kuwa yă zama abin dariya.
english: Therefore I will profane the princes of the sanctuary; and I will make Jacob a curse, and Israel an insult.”

hausa: Aka ƙidaya Lawiyawan da suke ’yan shekaru talatin da haihuwa ko fiye, suka kai wajen mutum dubu talatin da takwas.
english: The Levites were counted from thirty years old and upward; and their number by their polls, man by man, was thirty-eight thousand.

hausa: Ba ku ci burodi ba, ba ku kuwa sha ruwan inabi, ko wani abu mai sa jiri ba. Ya yi haka don ku san cewa shi ne Ubangiji Allahnku.
english: You have not eaten bread, neither have you drunk wine or strong drink, that you may know that I am Yahweh your God.

hausa: Gare shi kuma, shi da yake kaɗai Allah Mai Cetonmu, ta wurin Yesu Kiristi Ubangijinmu, bari ɗaukaka, daraja, iko da mulki, su tabbata a gare shi, tun farkon zamanai, yanzu, da har abada abadin! Amin.
english: to God our Savior, who alone is wise, be glory and majesty, dominion and power, both now and forever. Amen.

hausa: To, fa, Hiram sarkin Taya ya aika da ’yan aika zuwa wurin Dawuda, tare da gumaguman al’ul, maginan duwatsu da kafintoci, don su gina wa Dawuda fada.
english: Hiram king of Tyre sent messengers to David with cedar trees, masons, and carpenters, to build him a house.

hausa: Yahudawa sun kama wannan mutum suna kuma dab da kashe shi, amma na zo da sojojina na ƙwato shi, saboda na ji shi ɗan ƙasar Roma ne.
english: “This man was seized by the Jews, and was about to be killed by them when I came with the soldiers and rescued him, having learned that he was a Roman.

hausa: Wannan za tă zama ziyarata ta uku a wurinku ke nan. “Dole a tabbatar da kowace magana ta bakin shaidu biyu ko uku.”
english: This is the third time I am coming to you. “At the mouth of two or three witnesses shall every word be established.”

hausa: A wata na farkon a farkon shekarar mulkinsa, ya buɗe ƙofofin haikalin Ubangiji ya gyara su.
english: In the first year of his reign, in the first month, he opened the doors of Yahweh’s house and repaired them.

hausa: Fushin Ubangiji kuwa ya ƙuna a kan Uzza domin aikin rashin bangirma, saboda haka Allah ya buge shi ya kuma mutu a can kusa da akwatin alkawarin Allah.
english: Yahweh’s anger burned against Uzzah, and God struck him there for his error; and he died there by God’s ark.

hausa: Ana bin sawunmu, ba za mu iya tafiya kan tituna ba. Ƙarshenmu ya kusa, kwanakinmu sun ƙare, gama ƙarshenmu ya zo.
english: They hunt our steps, so that we can’t go in our streets. Our end is near. Our days are fulfilled, for our end has come.

hausa: Surukin Musa ya amsa ya ce, “Abin da kake yi ba daidai ba ne.
english: Moses’ father-in-law said to him, “The thing that you do is not good.

hausa: waɗanda zai ce, “Wannan shi ne wurin hutu, bari waɗanda suka gaji su huta”; da kuma, “Wannan shi ne wurin wartsakewa” amma sun ƙi su saurara.
english: to whom he said, “This is the resting place. Give rest to the weary,” and “This is the refreshing;” yet they would not hear.

hausa: An yi dukan labulan da suke kewaye da filin Tentin Sujada da lallausan zaren lilin.
english: All the hangings around the court were of fine twined linen.

hausa: Suka sa sandan da yake a tsakiya yă wuce daga wannan gefe zuwa wancan.
english: He made the middle bar to pass through in the middle of the boards from the one end to the other.

hausa: Ga abin da Ubangiji Maɗaukaki ya ce, “Ku lura da al’amuranku.
english: “This is what Yahweh of Armies says: ‘Consider your ways.

hausa: Ya aikata mugunta a gaban Ubangiji, yana tafiya a hanyoyin Yerobowam da kuma cikin zunubinsa, wanda ya sa Isra’ila suka yi.
english: He did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight, and walked in the way of Jeroboam, and in his sin with which he made Israel to sin.

hausa: Malaman dokokin da suka zo daga Urushalima suka ce, “Ai, yana da Be’elzebub! Da ikon sarkin aljanu yake fitar da aljanu.”
english: The scribes who came down from Jerusalem said, “He has Beelzebul,” and, “By the prince of the demons he casts out the demons.”

hausa: suka kuma bi gurbin al’umman da Ubangiji ya kora a gabansu, da kuma ayyukan da sarakuna Isra’ila suka gabatar.
english: and walked in the statutes of the nations whom Yahweh cast out from before the children of Israel, and of the kings of Israel, which they made.

hausa: Dawuda ya gayyace shi, ya kuwa ci ya sha tare da shi, Dawuda ya sa ya bugu tilis. Amma da yamma Uriya ya koma ya kwanta a tabarmarsa cikin bayin maigidan sarki; bai je gida ba.
english: When David had called him, he ate and drank before him; and he made him drunk. At evening, he went out to lie on his bed with the servants of his lord, but didn’t go down to his house.

hausa: Saboda haka Ubangiji ya ce, “Zan shafe Yahuda ma kamar yadda na shafe Isra’ila, daga gabana, zan ƙi Urushalima birnin da na zaɓa, da wannan haikali wanda na ce, ‘A can Sunana zai kasance.’ ”
english: Yahweh said, “I will also remove Judah out of my sight, as I have removed Israel; and I will cast off this city which I have chosen, even Jerusalem, and the house of which I said, ‘My name shall be there.’”

hausa: Wata ranar Asabbaci, da Yesu ya shiga gidan wani sanannen Bafarisiye don cin abinci, sai mutane suka zuba masa ido da kyau.
english: When he went into the house of one of the rulers of the Pharisees on a Sabbath to eat bread, they were watching him.

hausa: Za ka iya sa igiya a cikin hancinta ko kuma ka huda muƙamuƙanta da ƙugiya?
english: Can you put a rope into his nose, or pierce his jaw through with a hook?

hausa: Ina marmarin ganinku don in ba ku wata baiwar ruhaniya, don ku yi ƙarfi
english: For I long to see you, that I may impart to you some spiritual gift, to the end that you may be established;

hausa: Kana ƙaunar maƙiyinka, kana ƙin waɗanda suke ƙaunarka. Ka bayyana a fili cewa komandodi da sojojinsu ba kome ba ne a gare ka. Na ga cewa da za ka yi farin ciki, da a ce Absalom yana da rai a yau, dukanmu kuma mun mutu.
english: in that you love those who hate you and hate those who love you. For you have declared today that princes and servants are nothing to you. For today I perceive that if Absalom had lived and we had all died today, then it would have pleased you well.

hausa: Masu kawo ceto za su haura zuwa Dutsen Sihiyona don su yi mulkin duwatsun Isuwa. Ubangiji ne zai yi mulki.
english: Saviors will go up on Mount Zion to judge the mountains of Esau, and the kingdom will be Yahweh’s.

hausa: A lokacin nan Abimelek da Fikol, komandan rundunoninsa suka zo suka ce wa Ibrahim, “Allah yana tare da kai a ko mene ne kake yi.
english: At that time, Abimelech and Phicol the captain of his army spoke to Abraham, saying, “God is with you in all that you do.

hausa: Zan gaggauta ba zan ɓata lokaci ba in yi biyayya da umarnanka.
english: I will hurry, and not delay, to obey your commandments.

hausa: A farko-farko, Allah ya halicci sama da ƙasa.
english: In the beginning, God created the heavens and the earth.

hausa: Alheri da salama su zama naku a yalwace ta wurin sanin Allah da Yesu Ubangijinmu.
english: Grace to you and peace be multiplied in the knowledge of God and of Jesus our Lord,

hausa: Zai zauna a wannan birni har sai taron jama’a sun yi masa shari’a, kuma har sai lokacin da babban firist wanda yake aiki a lokacin ya mutu, sa’an nan zai iya koma garinsa na dā.”
english: He shall dwell in that city until he stands before the congregation for judgment, until the death of the high priest that shall be in those days. Then the man slayer shall return, and come to his own city, and to his own house, to the city he fled from.’”

hausa: Zefaniya firist kuwa, ya karanta wasiƙar annabi Irmiya.
english: Zephaniah the priest read this letter in the hearing of Jeremiah the prophet.

hausa: Amma ɗan’uwanta da mahaifiyarta suka ce, “Bari yarinyar ta ɗan zauna tare da mu kwana goma ko fiye, sa’an nan ka ta fi.”
english: Her brother and her mother said, “Let the young lady stay with us a few days, at least ten. After that she will go.”

hausa: Sa’an nan Yesu ya umarce su su sa dukan mutanen su zazzauna ƙungiya-ƙungiya a kan ɗanyar ciyawa.
english: He commanded them that everyone should sit down in groups on the green grass.

hausa: Yanzu, me kake da shi a hannu? Ka ba ni burodi guda biyar, ko wani abu da kake da shi a nan.”
english: Now therefore what is under your hand? Please give me five loaves of bread in my hand, or whatever is available.”

hausa: Amma Allah yana tsaron dattawan Yahudawa, saboda haka ba a hana su aikin ba har sai rahoto ya kai wurin Dariyus aka kuma sami amsarsa a rubuce tukuna.
english: But the eye of their God was on the elders of the Jews, and they didn’t make them cease until the matter should come to Darius, and an answer should be returned by letter concerning it.

hausa: “ ‘Ta haka za ka tsarkake Isra’ilawa daga rashin tsarkinsu, domin kada su mutu saboda rashin tsarkinsu ta wurin ƙazantar da wurin zamana wanda yake tsakiyarsu.’ ”
english: “‘Thus you shall separate the children of Israel from their uncleanness, so they will not die in their uncleanness when they defile my tabernacle that is among them.’”

hausa: Yesu ya tsawata wa aljanin, ya kuwa rabu da yaron, nan take yaron ya warke.
english: Jesus rebuked the demon, and it went out of him, and the boy was cured from that hour.

hausa: Yanzu ’ya’ya muguwar macen nan Ataliya maza sun fasa zuwa cikin haikalin Allah, suka kuma yi amfani da kayayyaki masu tsarki ma wa Ba’al.
english: For the sons of Athaliah, that wicked woman, had broken up God’s house; and they also gave all the dedicated things of Yahweh’s house to the Baals.

hausa: Waɗannan su ne hadayun shugabannin Isra’ilawa saboda keɓewar bagade sa’ad da aka shafe shi, an kawo faranta goma sha biyu na azurfa, darunan goma sha biyu na azurfa don yayyafawa, da kuma kwanonin zinariya goma sha biyu.
english: This was the dedication offering of the altar, on the day when it was anointed, by the princes of Israel: twelve silver platters, twelve silver bowls, twelve golden ladles;

hausa: Fadawansa su ma suka ba da taimako da yardar rai ga mutane da kuma firistoci da Lawiyawa. Hilkiya, Zakariya da Yehiyel masu aiki a haikalin Allah, suka ba firistoci hadayun Bikin Ƙetarewa dubu biyu da ɗari shida da kuma shanu ɗari uku.
english: His princes gave a free will offering to the people, to the priests, and to the Levites. Hilkiah, Zechariah, and Jehiel, the rulers of God’s house, gave to the priests for the Passover offerings two thousand six hundred small livestock, and three hundred head of cattle.

hausa: Ta ce, “A’a! Korina zai fi muni da abin da ka riga ka yi mini.” Amma ya ƙi yă saurare ta.
english: She said to him, “Not so, because this great wrong in sending me away is worse than the other that you did to me!” But he would not listen to her.

hausa: Sa’an nan zai ɗauki bijimin waje da sansani yă ƙone shi kamar yadda ya ƙone bijimi na fari. Wannan ita ce hadaya don zunubi domin jama’a.
english: He shall carry the bull outside the camp, and burn it as he burned the first bull. It is the sin offering for the assembly.

hausa: Da ya ji cewa Yesu Banazare ne, sai ya ɗaga murya, yana cewa, “Yesu Ɗan Dawuda, ka yi mini jinƙai!”
english: When he heard that it was Jesus the Nazarene, he began to cry out and say, “Jesus, you son of David, have mercy on me!”

hausa: Amma ya fitar da mutanensa kamar garke; ya bi da su kamar tumaki ta cikin hamada.
english: But he led out his own people like sheep, and guided them in the wilderness like a flock.

hausa: Ni katanga ce kuma nonaina sun yi kamar hasumiya. Ta haka na zama idanunsa kamar wanda yake kawo gamsuwa.
english: I am a wall, and my breasts like towers, then I was in his eyes like one who found peace.

hausa: Wajen sa’a ta goma sha ɗaya, ya sāke fita, ya tarar da waɗansu har yanzu suna tsattsaye. Ya tambaye su, ‘Don me kuke yini tsattsaye a nan ba kwa kome?’
english: About the eleventh hour he went out and found others standing idle. He said to them, ‘Why do you stand here all day idle?’

hausa: Ragwanci kan jawo zurfin barci, mutum mai sanyin jiki kuma yana tare da yunwa.
english: Slothfulness casts into a deep sleep. The idle soul shall suffer hunger.

hausa: Akwai kuma mata 32,000 da ba su yi lalata ba da namiji ba.
english: and thirty-two thousand persons in all, of the women who had not known man by lying with him.

hausa: Mutumin da ya yarda da ita ya tabbatar da cewa Allah mai gaskiya ne.
english: He who has received his witness has set his seal to this, that God is true.

hausa: To, fa, Sennakerib ya sami labari cewa Tirhaka, mutumin Kush sarkin Masar, yana fitowa don yă yi yaƙi da shi. Sa’ad da ya ji haka, sai ya aiki jakadu zuwa wurin Hezekiya da wannan magana.
english: He heard news concerning Tirhakah king of Ethiopia, “He has come out to fight against you.” When he heard it, he sent messengers to Hezekiah, saying,

hausa: To, Shawulu yana da ƙwarƙwarar da ake kira Rizfa, ’yar Aiya. Sai Ish-Boshet ya ce wa Abner, “Don me kake kwana da ƙwarƙwarar mahaifina?”
english: Now Saul had a concubine, whose name was Rizpah, the daughter of Aiah; and Ishbosheth said to Abner, “Why have you gone in to my father’s concubine?”

hausa: Heshbon da Yazer, tare da wuraren kiwonsu.
english: Heshbon with its pasture lands, and Jazer with its pasture lands.

hausa: Ganimarku, ya al’ummai ƙanana fāri sun girbe; kamar tarin fārin da mutane sun fāɗa wa.
english: Your plunder will be gathered as the caterpillar gathers. Men will leap on it as locusts leap.

hausa: “ ‘Ke mazinaciyar mace! Kin gwammace baƙi a maimakon mijinki!
english: “‘“Adulterous wife, who takes strangers instead of her husband!

hausa: shi da yake kawo reni a kan manyan mutane ya sa suka yi ta yawo a cikin jejin da ba hanya.
english: He pours contempt on princes, and causes them to wander in a trackless waste.

hausa: Zo, bari mu ƙulla yarjejjeniya, da kai da ni, bari kuma ta kasance shaida a tsakaninmu.”
english: Now come, let’s make a covenant, you and I. Let it be for a witness between me and you.”

hausa: Gama ya ce, “A lokacin samun alherina, na ji ka, a ranar samun ceto kuma, na taimake ka.” Ina gaya muku, yanzu ne lokacin samun alherin Allah, yanzu ne ranar samun ceto.
english: For he says, “At an acceptable time I listened to you. In a day of salvation I helped you.” Behold, now is the acceptable time. Behold, now is the day of salvation.

hausa: Yana cikin magana sai ga wani ɗan aika ya zo ya ce, “Ƙungiyoyin mahara uku na Kaldiyawa sun auka wa raƙumanka sun kwashe su duka, suka kuma karkashe masu yi maka aiki, ni kaɗai ne na tsira na zo in gaya maka!”
english: While he was still speaking, another also came and said, “The Chaldeans made three bands, and swept down on the camels, and have taken them away, yes, and killed the servants with the edge of the sword; and I alone have escaped to tell you.”

hausa: Sa’an nan dukan mutane suka koma gidajensu suka ci, suka sha, suka aika wa wanda ba shi da abinci, gama yanzu sun fahimci kalmomin da aka karanta musu.
english: All the people went their way to eat, to drink, to send portions, and to celebrate, because they had understood the words that were declared to them.

hausa: Da Bilatus ya ji haka, sai tsoro ya ƙara kama shi,
english: When therefore Pilate heard this saying, he was more afraid.

hausa: Har yanzu Filistiyawa suka sāke haurawa suka bazu a Kwarin Refayim;
english: The Philistines came up yet again and spread themselves in the valley of Rephaim.

hausa: sai dukan mutanen ƙasar suka yi farin ciki. Birnin kuwa ya samu zaman lafiya domin an kashe Ataliya da takobi.
english: So all the people of the land rejoiced, and the city was quiet. They had slain Athaliah with the sword.

hausa: Almajiran suka manta su riƙe burodi, sai dai guda ɗaya da suke da shi a cikin jirgin ruwan.
english: They forgot to take bread; and they didn’t have more than one loaf in the boat with them.

hausa: Sama’ila ya ce wa Shawulu, “Don me ka dame ni, ta wurin hauro da ni?” Shawulu ya ce, “Ina cikin babban damuwa ce, Filistiyawa sun fāɗa mini, Allah kuma ya juya mini baya. Bai amsa mini, ko ta mafarki, ko kuma ta annabawa ba, saboda haka na kira ka don ka gaya mini abin yi.”
english: Samuel said to Saul, “Why have you disturbed me, to bring me up?” Saul answered, “I am very distressed; for the Philistines make war against me, and God has departed from me, and answers me no more, by prophets, or by dreams. Therefore I have called you, that you may make known to me what I shall do.”

hausa: ku faɗa wa waɗanda suka karai a zukata, “Ku yi ƙarfin hali, kada ku ji tsoro; Allahnku zai zo, zai zo domin ya ɗau fansa; da ramuwar Allah zai zo don yă cece ku.”
english: Tell those who have a fearful heart, “Be strong! Don’t be afraid! Behold, your God will come with vengeance, God’s retribution. He will come and save you.

hausa: “ ‘Zan dube ku da idon rahama, in kuma sa ku riɓaɓɓanya ku kuma ƙaru, zan kiyaye alkawarina da ku.
english: “‘I will have respect for you, make you fruitful, multiply you, and will establish my covenant with you.

hausa: Ki farka, ki farka! Ki tashi, ya Urushalima, ke da kika sha daga hannun Ubangiji kwaf na fushinsa, ke da kika shanye har ƙasar kwaf kwaf da ya sa mutane suna tangaɗi.
english: Awake, awake! Stand up, Jerusalem, you who have drunk from Yahweh’s hand the cup of his wrath. You have drunken the bowl of the cup of staggering, and drained it.

hausa: Aka kuma cika haikalin da hayaƙi daga ɗaukakar Allah da kuma daga ikonsa, kuma ba wanda ya iya shiga haikalin sai da aka cika annobai bakwai nan na mala’iku bakwai.
english: The temple was filled with smoke from the glory of God and from his power. No one was able to enter into the temple until the seven plagues of the seven angels would be finished.

hausa: to zan ƙi zuriyar Yaƙub da na Dawuda bawana ba zan kuma zaɓi ɗaya daga cikin ’ya’yansa maza ya yi mulki a kan zuriyar Ibrahim, Ishaku da Yaƙub ba. Gama zan mayar da wadatarsu in kuma yi musu jinƙai.’ ”
english: then I will also cast away the offspring of Jacob, and of David my servant, so that I will not take of his offspring to be rulers over the offspring of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob; for I will cause their captivity to be reversed and will have mercy on them.”

hausa: Sa’an nan waɗanda suke tsoron Ubangiji suka yi magana da juna, Ubangiji kuwa ya kasa kunne ya kuma ji. A gabansa aka rubuta a littafin tarihi waɗanda suke tsoron Ubangiji, suna kuma girmama sunansa.
english: Then those who feared Yahweh spoke one with another; and Yahweh listened and heard, and a book of memory was written before him for those who feared Yahweh and who honored his name.

hausa: “Idan kuma wani yă sa ɗaya daga cikin waɗannan ’yan yara masu gaskatawa da ni yă yi laifi, zai fiye masa a rataya wani babban dutsen niƙa a wuyarsa, a jefa shi cikin teku.
english: “Whoever will cause one of these little ones who believe in me to stumble, it would be better for him if he were thrown into the sea with a millstone hung around his neck.

hausa: daga kabilar Gad kuwa aka ba su, Ramot Gileyad (garin masu neman mafaka don sun yi kisa), Mahanayim,
english: Out of the tribe of Gad, Ramoth in Gilead with its pasture lands, the city of refuge for the man slayer, and Mahanaim with its pasture lands,

hausa: Kada ku bari su zauna a cikin ƙasarku, in har kuka bar su, za su ɓata ku da zunubinsu na bautar allolinsu, har zai yă zama muku tarko.”
english: They shall not dwell in your land, lest they make you sin against me, for if you serve their gods, it will surely be a snare to you.”

hausa: Aka jajjefe su da duwatsu; aka raba su biyu da zarto; aka kashe su da takobi. Suka yi ta yawo saye da fatun tumaki da na awaki, suka yi zaman rashi, suka sha tsanani da kuma wulaƙanci
english: They were stoned. They were sawn apart. They were tempted. They were slain with the sword. They went around in sheep skins and in goat skins; being destitute, afflicted, ill-treated—

hausa: Sa’an nan sarki ya ce wa Zadok, “Ka komar da akwatin alkawarin Allah cikin birnin. Idan na sami tagomashi a idon Ubangiji, zai dawo da ni, yă kuma sa in sāke gan shi a mazauninsa.
english: The king said to Zadok, “Carry God’s ark back into the city. If I find favor in Yahweh’s eyes, he will bring me again, and show me both it and his habitation;

hausa: “Ku kasa kunne ga wannan, ya gidan Yaƙub, waɗanda ake kira da sunan Isra’ila suka kuma fito daga zuriyar Yahuda, ku da kuke yin rantsuwa da sunan Ubangiji kuna kuma kira sunan Allah na Isra’ila, amma ba da gaskiya ko adalci ba,
english: “Hear this, house of Jacob, you who are called by the name of Israel, and have come out of the waters of Judah. You swear by Yahweh’s name, and make mention of the God of Israel, but not in truth, nor in righteousness—

hausa: Sa’ad da Isra’ilawa suka ga iko mai girma da Ubangiji ya yi gāba da Masarawa, sai mutanen suka ji tsoron Ubangiji, suka amince da shi, da kuma bawansa Musa.
english: Israel saw the great work which Yahweh did to the Egyptians, and the people feared Yahweh; and they believed in Yahweh and in his servant Moses.

hausa: In ka ji daɗina, ka koya mini hanyarka don in san ka, in kuma ci gaba da samun tagomashi daga gare ka. Ka tuna cewa wannan al’umma mutanenka ne.”
english: Now therefore, if I have found favor in your sight, please show me your way, now, that I may know you, so that I may find favor in your sight; and consider that this nation is your people.”

hausa: Bari yă aiko maka da taimako daga wuri mai tsarki yă kuma ba ka gudummawa daga Sihiyona.
english: send you help from the sanctuary, grant you support from Zion,

hausa: Mun ji fariyar Mowab, mun ji yawan fariyarta da girmankanta, fariyarta da reninta, amma taƙamarsu ta banza ce.
english: We have heard of the pride of Moab, that he is very proud; even of his arrogance, his pride, and his wrath. His boastings are nothing.

hausa: Sa’ad da mutane suka tsattsaya da nesa, sai Musa ya matsa kusa da girgije mai duhu, inda Allah yake.
english: The people stayed at a distance, and Moses came near to the thick darkness where God was.

hausa: Kada ku lalatar da aikin Allah saboda abinci. Dukan abinci mai tsabta ne, sai dai ba daidai ba ne mutum yă ci abin da zai sa wani yă yi tuntuɓe.
english: Don’t overthrow God’s work for food’s sake. All things indeed are clean, however it is evil for that man who creates a stumbling block by eating.

hausa: In kuna niyya ku yarda da wannan, to, shi ne Iliya da dā ma zai zo.
english: If you are willing to receive it, this is Elijah, who is to come.

hausa: Da yamma ta yi, sai Yesu ya zauna don cin abinci tare da Sha Biyun.
english: Now when evening had come, he was reclining at the table with the twelve disciples.

hausa: Zan yi madawwamin alkawari da su. Ba zan taɓa barin aikata musu alheri ba, zan kuma iza su su ji tsorona, don kada su ƙara juya daga gare ni.
english: I will make an everlasting covenant with them, that I will not turn away from following them, to do them good. I will put my fear in their hearts, that they may not depart from me.

hausa: Amma Musa ya ce, “Ga ni a cikin mutane dubu ɗari shida tafe tare da ni, kana kuma cewa, ‘Zan ba su nama su ci har wata guda cur!’
english: Moses said, “The people, among whom I am, are six hundred thousand men on foot; and you have said, ‘I will give them meat, that they may eat a whole month.’

hausa: Sa’an nan sai ya zo wurin, wurin mutane ya ce, ‘Na yi zunubi, na kauce wa abin da yake daidai, amma ban samu abin da ya kamata in samu ba.
english: He sings before men, and says, ‘I have sinned, and perverted that which was right, and it didn’t profit me.

hausa: Ba ku san cewa shi wanda ya haɗa jikinsa da karuwa sun zama ɗaya a cikin jiki ke nan ba? Gama an ce, “Biyun za su zama jiki ɗaya.”
english: Or don’t you know that he who is joined to a prostitute is one body? For, “The two”, he says, “will become one flesh.”

hausa: Amma mutanen za su yarda su zauna tare da mu kamar mutane ɗaya kawai bisa wannan sharaɗi, cewa a yi wa mazanmu kaciya, kamar yadda su kansu suke.
english: Only on this condition will the men consent to us to live with us, to become one people, if every male among us is circumcised, as they are circumcised.

hausa: “Fada musu cewa, ‘Ga abin da Ubangiji yana cewa, “ ‘Sa’ad da mutane suka fāɗi, ba sa tashi ne? Sa’ad da mutum ya kauce, ba ya dawowa?
english: “Moreover you shall tell them, ‘Yahweh says: “‘Do men fall, and not rise up again? Does one turn away, and not return?

hausa: Mai albarka ne mutumin da korinsa sun cika da su. Ba za a kunyata su ba sa’ad da suke ƙarawa da abokan gābansu a ɗakin shari’a.
english: Happy is the man who has his quiver full of them. They won’t be disappointed when they speak with their enemies in the gate.

hausa: kada ku bar jikinsa a kan itacen yă kwana. Ku tabbata kun binne shi a ranar, domin duk wanda aka rataye a kan itace la’ananne ne ga Allah. Kada ku ƙazantar da ƙasar da Ubangiji Allahnku yake ba ku gādo.
english: his body shall not remain all night on the tree, but you shall surely bury him the same day; for he who is hanged is accursed of God. Don’t defile your land which Yahweh your God gives you for an inheritance.

hausa: ’Ya’yana ƙaunatattu, ina rubuta muku wannan ne don kada ku yi zunubi. Amma in wani ya yi zunubi, muna da wani wanda yake magana da Uba don taimakonmu, wato, Yesu Kiristi, Mai Adalci.
english: My little children, I write these things to you so that you may not sin. If anyone sins, we have a Counselor with the Father, Jesus Christ, the righteous.

hausa: “Na zuga wani daga arewa, ya kuwa zo, wani daga inda rana ke fitowa wanda yake kira bisa sunana. Yana takawa a kan masu mulki kamar da taɓarya, sai ka ce maginin tukwane yana taka laka.
english: “I have raised up one from the north, and he has come, from the rising of the sun, one who calls on my name, and he shall come on rulers as on mortar, and as the potter treads clay.

hausa: kuma fansassu na Ubangiji za su komo. Za su shiga Sihiyona da rerawa; matuƙar farin ciki zai mamaye su. Murna da farin ciki za su sha kansu, baƙin ciki kuma da nishi za su gudu.
english: Then Yahweh’s ransomed ones will return, and come with singing to Zion; and everlasting joy will be on their heads. They will obtain gladness and joy, and sorrow and sighing will flee away.”

hausa: ku ce ga abin da sarki ya ce, ‘Ku jefa wannan mutum a kurkuku kada kuma ku ba shi wani abu sai dai burodi da ruwa har sai na dawo lafiya.’ ”
english: and say, ‘The king says, “Put this fellow in the prison, and feed him with bread of affliction and with water of affliction, until I return in peace.”’”

hausa: Waɗannan su ne kabilan Naftali, jimillarsu ta kai 45,400.
english: These are the families of Naphtali according to their families; and those who were counted of them were forty-five thousand four hundred.

hausa: Saboda haka, kada ku shari’anta kome tun lokaci bai yi ba. Ku jira sai Ubangiji ya zo. Zai bayyana abin da yake a ɓoye a cikin duhu a sarari, zai kuma tone nufin zukatan mutane. A lokacin ne fa kowa zai karɓi yabo daga wurin Allah daidai gwargwado.
english: Therefore judge nothing before the time, until the Lord comes, who will both bring to light the hidden things of darkness and reveal the counsels of the hearts. Then each man will get his praise from God.

hausa: Yayinda Isra’ilawa suke ciki hamada, sai aka sami wani mutum yana tattara itace a ranar Asabbaci.
english: While the children of Israel were in the wilderness, they found a man gathering sticks on the Sabbath day.

hausa: Me ya sa kuka tsokane ni in yi fushi saboda abin da hannuwanku suka yi, kuna ƙone turare wa waɗansu alloli a Masar, inda kuka zo don ku zauna? Za ku hallakar da kanku ku kuma mai da kanku abin la’ana da abin zargi da abin ba’a a cikin dukan al’umman duniya.
english: in that you provoke me to anger with the works of your hands, burning incense to other gods in the land of Egypt where you have gone to live, that you may be cut off, and that you may be a curse and a reproach among all the nations of the earth?

hausa: “Mu shirya don yaƙi da ita! Ku tashi, bari mu fāɗa mata da tsakar rana! Amma, kaito, rana tana fāɗuwa, inuwar yamma kuwa sai ƙaran tsawo take.
english: “Prepare war against her! Arise! Let’s go up at noon. Woe to us! For the day declines, for the shadows of the evening are stretched out.

hausa: Ɗana, kada ka manta da koyarwata, amma ka kiyaye umarnaina a cikin zuciyarka,
english: My son, don’t forget my teaching, but let your heart keep my commandments,

hausa: Yakan yi wa masu girman kai ba’a amma yakan yi wa mai sauƙinkai alheri.
english: Surely he mocks the mockers, but he gives grace to the humble.

hausa: “Ku tuna da umarnin da Musa bawan Ubangiji ya yi muku. ‘Ubangiji Allahnku ya ba ku hutawa, ya kuma ba ku wannan ƙasa.’
english: “Remember the word which Moses the servant of Yahweh commanded you, saying, ‘Yahweh your God gives you rest, and will give you this land.

hausa: Sa’an nan mutumin ya ce, “Bar ni in tafi, gama gari ya waye.” Amma Yaƙub ya amsa ya ce, “Ba zan bar ka ka tafi ba, sai ka sa mini albarka.”
english: The man said, “Let me go, for the day breaks.” Jacob said, “I won’t let you go unless you bless me.”

hausa: In sashen da aka miƙa a matsayin nunan fari tsattsarka ne, to, sauran ma tsattsarka ne; in saiwar tsattsarka ce, to, sauran rassan ma tsattsarka ne.
english: If the first fruit is holy, so is the lump. If the root is holy, so are the branches.

hausa: Mala’ika na biyar ya juye kwanonsa a bisan gadon sarautar dabbar, mulkinta kuwa ya zama duhu. Mutane suka yi ta cizon bakinsu saboda azaba
english: The fifth poured out his bowl on the throne of the beast, and his kingdom was darkened. They gnawed their tongues because of the pain,

hausa: Biranen da suke a jeji kuwa su ne, Bet-Araba, Middin, Sekaka,
english: In the wilderness, Beth Arabah, Middin, Secacah,

hausa: Ruhu kansa yana ba da shaida tare da ruhunmu cewa mu ’ya’yan Allah ne.
english: The Spirit himself testifies with our spirit that we are children of God;

hausa: Sa’ad da suka zo wurin mahaifinsu Yaƙub a ƙasar Kan’ana, suka faɗa masa dukan abin da ya faru da su. Suka ce,
english: They came to Jacob their father, to the land of Canaan, and told him all that had happened to them, saying,

hausa: Ko da yake Dokar Musa ta ce dole firistoci su kasance zuriyar Lawi, waɗannan firistoci ba su iya sa wani yă zama cikakke ba. Saboda akwai bukata wani firist kamar Melkizedek ya zo, a maimakon wani daga iyalin Haruna.
english: Now if perfection was through the Levitical priesthood (for under it the people have received the law), what further need was there for another priest to arise after the order of Melchizedek, and not be called after the order of Aaron?

hausa: Za ku iya kwashe ’ya’yan, amma ku tabbata kun bar mahaifiyar tă tafi. Yin haka zai sa ku sami zaman lafiya da tsawon rai.
english: You shall surely let the hen go, but the young you may take for yourself, that it may be well with you, and that you may prolong your days.

hausa: “Ka ji, kai kurma; duba, kai makaho, ka kuma gani!
english: “Hear, you deaf, and look, you blind, that you may see.

hausa: Bai cika rantsuwa ba ta wurin take alkawari. Domin sarkin Isra’ila ya ƙulla alkawari ya kuma aikata dukan waɗannan abubuwa, ba zai tsira ba.
english: For he has despised the oath by breaking the covenant; and behold, he had given his hand, and yet has done all these things. He won’t escape.

hausa: Sai wani mutum daga cikin taron ya yi kira da ƙarfi ya ce, “Malam, ina roƙonka, ka dubi ɗan nan nawa, gama shi ne kaɗai nake da shi.
english: Behold, a man from the crowd called out, saying, “Teacher, I beg you to look at my son, for he is my only born child.

hausa: Ya amsa ya ce, “Daidai ne Ishaya ya yi annabci game da ku munafukai; kamar yadda yake a rubuce cewa, “ ‘Waɗannan mutane da baki suke girmama ni, amma zukatansu sun yi nesa da ni.
english: He answered them, “Well did Isaiah prophesy of you hypocrites, as it is written, ‘This people honors me with their lips, but their heart is far from me.

hausa: sai ruwan da yake gangarowa ya tsaya, ya tattaru a wuri ɗaya ya yi tudu daga nan har zuwa wani garin da ake kira Adam kusa da Zaretan, ruwan da yake gangarowa zuwa Tekun Araba (Tekun Gishiri) kuma ya yanke gaba ɗaya. Sai mutane suka ƙetare kusa da Yeriko.
english: the waters which came down from above stood, and rose up in one heap a great way off, at Adam, the city that is beside Zarethan; and those that went down toward the sea of the Arabah, even the Salt Sea, were wholly cut off. Then the people passed over near Jericho.

hausa: An ɗauke farin ciki da murna daga gonakin itatuwa masu ’ya’ya; babu wanda yake rerawa ko yake sowa a cikin gonakin inabi; babu wanda yake matsin ruwan inabi a wuraren matsi, gama na kawo ƙarshen yin sowa.
english: Gladness is taken away, and joy out of the fruitful field; and in the vineyards there will be no singing, neither joyful noise. Nobody will tread out wine in the presses. I have made the shouting stop.

hausa: ’Ya’yan Zeruhiya, maza uku sun kasance a can. Su ne, Yowab, Abishai da Asahel. To, Asahel mai gudu ne kamar barewa.
english: The three sons of Zeruiah were there: Joab, Abishai, and Asahel. Asahel was as light of foot as a wild gazelle.

hausa: A inda kan ginshiƙin ya buɗu kamar kwano, sama da zāne-zānen sarƙar, an yi zāne-zānen rumman wajen ɗari biyu, layi-layi kewaye da kawunan ginshiƙan nan.
english: There were capitals above also on the two pillars, close by the belly which was beside the network. There were two hundred pomegranates in rows around the other capital.

hausa: Sai Agiriffa ya ce wa Festus, “Ni ma zan so in saurari mutumin da kaina.” Sai ya amsa ya ce, “Za ka kuwa ji shi gobe.”
english: Agrippa said to Festus, “I also would like to hear the man myself.” “Tomorrow,” he said, “you shall hear him.”

hausa: Kalaudiyus Lisiyas. Zuwa ga Mai Girma, Gwamna Felis. Gaisuwa.
english: “Claudius Lysias to the most excellent governor Felix: Greetings.

hausa: Suka hau zuwa sammai suka kuma tsinduma cikin zurfafa; a cikin azabarsu sai ƙarfin halinsu ya karai.
english: They mount up to the sky; they go down again to the depths. Their soul melts away because of trouble.

hausa: Sai ku ci gaba cikin bangaskiyarku, kuna tsaye a kafe kuma tsayayyu, ba tare da gusawa daga begen da kuka ji daga bishara ba. Wannan ita ce bisharar da kuka ji wadda aka yi shelarta ga kowace halittar da take ƙarƙashin sama, wadda kuma ni Bulus, na zama mai hidimarta.
english: if it is so that you continue in the faith, grounded and steadfast, and not moved away from the hope of the Good News which you heard, which was proclaimed in all creation under heaven, of which I, Paul, was made a servant.

hausa: ’Yan’uwansa kuwa suka zo suka fāɗi a gabansa suka ce, “Mu bayinka ne.”
english: His brothers also went and fell down before his face; and they said, “Behold, we are your servants.”

hausa: ko da ya yi shekara dubu biyu amma bai more wadatarsa ba. Ba wuri ɗaya dukansu biyu za su tafi ba?
english: Yes, though he live a thousand years twice told, and yet fails to enjoy good, don’t all go to one place?

hausa: Sun keɓe waɗansu ganimar da aka kwaso a yaƙi don gyaran haikalin Ubangiji.
english: They dedicated some of the plunder won in battles to repair Yahweh’s house.

hausa: Waɗannan su ne ’ya’yan da Zilfa ta haifa wa Yaƙub, ita ce Laban ya ba wa ’yarsa Liyatu. ’Ya’yan duka, su sha shida ne.
english: These are the sons of Zilpah, whom Laban gave to Leah, his daughter, and these she bore to Jacob, even sixteen souls.

hausa: Mai adalci kan yi rayuwa marar abin zargi; masu albarka ne ’ya’yan da za su biyo bayansa.
english: A righteous man walks in integrity. Blessed are his children after him.

hausa: “Mayaƙansa sun fito kamar harshen wuta suka ƙone birnin Ar na Mowab suna hallaka ’yan ƙasar tuddan Arnon.
english: for a fire has gone out of Heshbon, a flame from the city of Sihon. It has devoured Ar of Moab, The lords of the high places of the Arnon.

hausa: Ku guji abincin da aka yi wa alloli hadaya, da jini, da naman dabbar da aka murɗe da kuma fasikanci. Za ku kyauta in kun kiyaye waɗannan abubuwa. Ku huta lafiya.
english: that you abstain from things sacrificed to idols, from blood, from things strangled, and from sexual immorality, from which if you keep yourselves, it will be well with you. Farewell.”

hausa: Na yi ta kuka domin ba a iya samun wanda ya cancanta yă buɗe naɗaɗɗen littafin ko yă duba cikinsa ba.
english: Then I wept much, because no one was found worthy to open the book or to look in it.

hausa: Masu ruɗi da yawa, waɗanda ba su yarda da zuwan Yesu Kiristi cikin jiki ba, sun riga sun fito a duniya. Duk irin mutumin nan mai ruɗi ne kuma magabcin Kiristi.
english: For many deceivers have gone out into the world, those who don’t confess that Jesus Christ came in the flesh. This is the deceiver and the Antichrist.

hausa: Ubangiji Maɗaukaki shi ne za ka ɗauka a matsayi mai tsarki, shi ne wanda za ka ji tsoro, shi ne za ka yi rawar jiki a gabansa,
english: Yahweh of Armies is who you must respect as holy. He is the one you must fear. He is the one you must dread.
