hausa: Debora ta ce, “To, shi ke nan, zan tafi tare da kai. Amma saboda yadda ka ɗauki wannan batun, darajar ba za tă zama taka ba, gama Ubangiji zai ba da Sisera a hannun mace.” Saboda haka Debora ta tafi tare da Barak zuwa Kedesh,
english: She said, “I will surely go with you. Nevertheless, the journey that you take won’t be for your honor; for Yahweh will sell Sisera into a woman’s hand.” Deborah arose, and went with Barak to Kedesh.

hausa: Mahaifinsa Ishaku ya tambaye shi, “Wane ne kai?” Ya amsa, “Ni ne ɗanka, ɗan farinka, Isuwa.”
english: Isaac his father said to him, “Who are you?” He said, “I am your son, your firstborn, Esau.”

hausa: Gama ku kanku kun san yadda ya kamata ku bi gurbinmu. Ba mu yi zaman banza sa’ad da muke tare da ku ba,
english: For you know how you ought to imitate us. For we didn’t behave ourselves rebelliously among you,

hausa: Ka nuna ni marar laifi ne ciki adalcinka, Ya Ubangiji Allahna; kada ka bari su yi farin ciki a kaina.
english: Vindicate me, Yahweh my God, according to your righteousness. Don’t let them gloat over me.

hausa: “ ‘Ko kuwa in mutum ya taɓa wani abin da yake mai ƙazanta, ko gawar naman jeji marar tsabta, ko na shanu marar tsabta, ko na halittu marasa tsabtan da suke motsi a ƙasa; ko da yake bai sani ba, ya ƙazantu ke nan, kuma ya yi laifi.
english: “‘Or if anyone touches any unclean thing, whether it is the carcass of an unclean animal, or the carcass of unclean livestock, or the carcass of unclean creeping things, and it is hidden from him, and he is unclean, then he shall be guilty.

hausa: “Ki tashi, ki haskaka, gama haskenki ya zo, ɗaukakar Ubangiji ya taso a kanki.
english: “Arise, shine; for your light has come, and Yahweh’s glory has risen on you!

hausa: Sa’ad da Yoshuwa ya tsufa, Ubangiji ya ce masa, “Ka tsufa ƙwarai, ga shi kuma akwai sauran ƙasa mai fāɗi da ba ku riga kun mallaka ba.
english: Now Joshua was old and well advanced in years. Yahweh said to him, “You are old and advanced in years, and there remains yet very much land to be possessed.

hausa: Ka ce musu, ‘Ku ji maganar Ubangiji, ku sarakunan Yahuda, da dukan mutanen Yahuda da dukan mazaunan Urushalima waɗanda suke bi ta waɗannan ƙofofi.
english: Tell them, ‘Hear Yahweh’s word, you kings of Judah, all Judah, and all the inhabitants of Jerusalem, that enter in by these gates:

hausa: Amma ya lura da wahalarsu sa’ad da ya ji kukansu;
english: Nevertheless he regarded their distress, when he heard their cry.

hausa: In fa kun kiyaye dokan nan ta mulki wadda take cikin Nassi mai cewa, “Ƙaunaci maƙwabcinka kamar kanka,” kun yi daidai.
english: However, if you fulfill the royal law according to the Scripture, “You shall love your neighbor as yourself,” you do well.

hausa: Ka ɗauki azurfar da zinariyar ka yi rawani, ka ɗora shi a kan babban firist, Yoshuwa ɗan Yehozadak.
english: Yes, take silver and gold, and make crowns, and set them on the head of Joshua the son of Jehozadak, the high priest;

hausa: Sai Yesse ya sa Shamma yă zo gaban Sama’ila, amma Sama’ila ya ce, “Ubangiji bai zaɓi wannan ma ba.”
english: Then Jesse made Shammah to pass by. He said, “Yahweh has not chosen this one, either.”

hausa: Ka bi da ni a hanyar umarnanka, gama a can zan sami farin ciki.
english: Direct me in the path of your commandments, for I delight in them.

hausa: Dukan tsarkakakkun abubuwan da Isra’ilawa suka kawo wa firist za su zama nasa.
english: Every heave offering of all the holy things of the children of Israel, which they present to the priest, shall be his.

hausa: Sai ya ce wa dukansu, “In wani zai bi ni, dole yă mūsanta kansa, ya ɗauki gicciyensa kowace rana, ya bi ni.
english: He said to all, “If anyone desires to come after me, let him deny himself, take up his cross, and follow me.

hausa: Gama inda dukiyarka take, a nan ne fa zuciyarka za tă kasance.
english: for where your treasure is, there your heart will be also.

hausa: Suna cewa, “Ku zo, bari mu hallaka su ɗungum a matsayin al’umma, don kada a ƙara tuna da sunan Isra’ila.”
english: “Come,” they say, “let’s destroy them as a nation, that the name of Israel may be remembered no more.”

hausa: Sai suka tashi daga Obot, suka yi sansani a Iye Abarim a hamadar da take fuskantar Mowab, wajen fitowar rana.
english: They traveled from Oboth, and encamped at Iyeabarim, in the wilderness which is before Moab, toward the sunrise.

hausa: “Ya sarki ka ga ɗan saƙon mai tsarkin nan, yana saukowa daga sama yana cewa, ‘A sare itacen a hallaka shi, amma a bar kututturensa daure da ƙarfe da tagulla, a bar shi can a ɗanyar ciyawar filaye, ya jiƙe da raɓa, ya zauna tare da namun jeji har shekara bakwai.’
english: “Whereas the king saw a holy watcher coming down from the sky and saying, ‘Cut down the tree, and destroy it; nevertheless leave the stump of its roots in the earth, even with a band of iron and bronze, in the tender grass of the field, and let it be wet with the dew of the sky. Let his portion be with the animals of the field, until seven times pass over him.’

hausa: da Yattir, da Eshtemowa,
english: Jattir with its pasture lands, Eshtemoa with its pasture lands,

hausa: to, su wane ne mutane masu zama a gidan da aka yi da laka, waɗanda da ƙura aka yi harsashensu, waɗanda za a iya murƙushe su kamar asu!
english: How much more those who dwell in houses of clay, whose foundation is in the dust, who are crushed before the moth!

hausa: “Dukan mazauna kan yankunan tuddai daga Lebanon zuwa Misrefot Mayim, wato, dukan Sidoniyawa, ni da kaina zan kore su a gaban Isra’ilawa. Ka tabbata ka raba wa Isra’ilawa ƙasar ta zama gādonsu kamar yadda na umarce ka,
english: all the inhabitants of the hill country from Lebanon to Misrephoth Maim, even all the Sidonians. I will drive them out from before the children of Israel. Just allocate it to Israel for an inheritance, as I have commanded you.

hausa: Zamanai sukan zo zamanai su wuce, amma duniya tana nan har abada.
english: One generation goes, and another generation comes; but the earth remains forever.

hausa: Kuma da firistoci waɗanda suke ɗauke da akwatin alkawarin Ubangiji, Ubangiji dukan duniya, sun sa ƙafa cikin ruwan kogin Urdun, ruwan da yake gudu a rafin zai tsaya cik yă taru a wuri ɗaya.”
english: It shall be that when the soles of the feet of the priests who bear the ark of Yahweh, the Lord of all the earth, rest in the waters of the Jordan, that the waters of the Jordan will be cut off. The waters that come down from above shall stand in one heap.”

hausa: domin idan wani ya kashe wani bisa kuskure ba da niyyar yin kisankai ba, mutumin zai iya gudu zuwa can yă fake don kada a kashe shi.
english: that the man slayer who kills any person accidentally or unintentionally may flee there. They shall be to you for a refuge from the avenger of blood.

hausa: Benyamin shi ne mahaifin, Bela ɗansa na fari, Ashbel ɗansa na biyu, Ahara na uku,
english: Benjamin became the father of Bela his firstborn, Ashbel the second, Aharah the third,

hausa: in ba mu da aminci, shi dai mai aminci ne, domin shi ba zai iya mūsun kansa ba.”
english: If we are faithless, he remains faithful; for he can’t deny himself.”

hausa: Amma ya ce mini, “Alherina ya ishe ka, domin a cikin rashin ƙarfi ne ake ganin cikar ikona.” Saboda haka, zan ƙara yin taƙama da farin ciki game da rashin ƙarfina, domin ikon Yesu Kiristi yă zauna tare da ni.
english: He has said to me, “My grace is sufficient for you, for my power is made perfect in weakness.” Most gladly therefore I will rather glory in my weaknesses, that the power of Christ may rest on me.

hausa: Asa ya fita don yă ƙara da shi, suka ja dāgā yaƙi a Kwarin Zefata kusa da Maresha.
english: Then Asa went out to meet him, and they set the battle in array in the valley of Zephathah at Mareshah.

hausa: “ ‘A rana ta takwas kuwa za a yi tsattsarkan taro, ban da aikin da aka saba.
english: “‘On the eighth day you shall have a solemn assembly. You shall do no regular work;

hausa: Sarki kuma ya yanka masa kuɗin da za a dinga ba shi, kowace rana muddin ransa.
english: and for his allowance, there was a continual allowance given him from the king, every day a portion, all the days of his life.

hausa: Ba a sanar da wannan asiri wa wani a sauran zamanai ba, amma a yanzu an bayyana shi ta wurin Ruhu Mai Tsarki ga manzanninsa da annabawansa.
english: which in other generations was not made known to the children of men, as it has now been revealed to his holy apostles and prophets in the Spirit,

hausa: “ ‘Kada ku yi sata. “ ‘Kada ku yi ƙarya. “ ‘Kada ku ruɗe juna.
english: “‘You shall not steal. “‘You shall not lie. “‘You shall not deceive one another.

hausa: Sa’an nan ya ce musu, “Saboda haka duk malamin dokokin da ya horu game da koyarwar mulkin sama, yana kama da maigida wanda yakan fitar daga ɗakin ajiyarsa sababbin dukiya da kuma tsofaffi.”
english: He said to them, “Therefore every scribe who has been made a disciple in the Kingdom of Heaven is like a man who is a householder, who brings out of his treasure new and old things.”

hausa: Sa’ad da mutane suka ga Musa ya daɗe bai sauko daga dutse ba, sai suka taru kewaye da Haruna suka ce, “Zo, ka yi mana alloli waɗanda za su yi mana jagora. Game da wannan Musa wanda ya fitar da mu daga Masar dai, ba mu san abin da ya faru da shi ba.”
english: When the people saw that Moses delayed coming down from the mountain, the people gathered themselves together to Aaron, and said to him, “Come, make us gods, which shall go before us; for as for this Moses, the man who brought us up out of the land of Egypt, we don’t know what has become of him.”

hausa: “Ina zuba ido ga cetonka, ya Ubangiji.
english: I have waited for your salvation, Yahweh.

hausa: Enok ya kasance cikin zumunci da Allah, sa’an nan ba a ƙara ganinsa ba. Saboda Allah ya ɗauke shi.
english: Enoch walked with God, and he was not found, for God took him.

hausa: Zan yi godiya cikin taro mai girma; cikin ɗumbun mutane zan yabe ka.
english: I will give you thanks in the great assembly. I will praise you among many people.

hausa: Hadayar da ya kawo ita ce, faranti guda ɗaya na azurfa, nauyinsa shekel ɗari ɗaya da talatin, da kuma daro na yayyafawa na azurfa, nauyinsa shekel saba’in, dukan biyu, an auna su bisa ga ma’aunin shekel na tsattsarkan wuri, kowannensu cike da lallausan gari, haɗe da mai kamar hadaya ta gari;
english: gave his offering: one silver platter, the weight of which was one hundred thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary, both of them full of fine flour mixed with oil for a meal offering;

hausa: Wanne a cikin dukan allolin ƙasashen nan ya iya ceton ƙasarsa da gare ni? Shugaban sojojin ya kuma ci gaba da cewa, ta yaya Ubangiji zai ceci Urushalima daga hannuna?”
english: Who are they among all the gods of the countries, that have delivered their country out of my hand, that Yahweh should deliver Jerusalem out of my hand?’”

hausa: Amma bokaye ma suka yi abubuwan nan ta wurin sihirinsu; suka sa kwaɗi suka fito suka mamaye ƙasar Masar.
english: The magicians did the same thing with their enchantments, and brought up frogs on the land of Egypt.

hausa: A wannan bishara ce, aka naɗa ni mai shela da manzo da kuma malami.
english: For this I was appointed as a preacher, an apostle, and a teacher of the Gentiles.

hausa: “Haikalin da zan gina zai zama mai girma, domin Allahnmu ya fi dukan sauran alloli girma.
english: “The house which I am building will be great, for our God is greater than all gods.

hausa: “Ku ji muryar kuka daga Babilon, Da hargowar babbar hallakarwa daga ƙasar Babiloniyawa!
english: “The sound of a cry comes from Babylon, and of great destruction from the land of the Chaldeans!

hausa: zukatansu ba sa biyayya gare shi, ba su da aminci ga alkawarinsa.
english: For their heart was not right with him, neither were they faithful in his covenant.

hausa: Ka kiyaye alkawarinka da ka yi wa bawanka Dawuda mahaifina. Da bakinka ka yi alkawari, da hannunka kuma ka cika shi, yadda yake a yau.
english: who has kept with your servant David my father that which you promised him. Yes, you spoke with your mouth, and have fulfilled it with your hand, as it is today.

hausa: Amma a wannan lokaci ma, Fir’auna ya taurare zuciyarsa, bai kuma bar mutanen suka tafi ba.
english: Pharaoh hardened his heart this time also, and he didn’t let the people go.

hausa: Yoram ya huta tare da kakanninsa, aka kuma binne shi a birnin Dawuda. Sai Ahaziya ɗansa ya gāje shi a matsayin sarki.
english: Joram slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in David’s city; and Ahaziah his son reigned in his place.

hausa: Tana kwanciya a ƙarƙashin inuwar itacen lotus ta ɓuya cikin kyauro da fadama.
english: He lies under the lotus trees, in the covert of the reed, and the marsh.

hausa: Yesu ya amsa ya ce, “Ku masanan dokoki ma, kaitonku, domin kun ɗora wa mutane kaya masu nauyi waɗanda da ƙyar suke ɗaukawa, amma ku da kanku ba za ku sa ko yatsa ɗaya, don ku taimake su ba.
english: He said, “Woe to you lawyers also! For you load men with burdens that are difficult to carry, and you yourselves won’t even lift one finger to help carry those burdens.

hausa: Yaya za ka yi tsayayya da mafi ƙanƙantan hafsan shugabana, ko da kana dogara da Masar don kekunan yaƙi da mahaya dawakai?
english: How then can you turn away the face of one captain of the least of my master’s servants, and put your trust on Egypt for chariots and for horsemen?

hausa: “In ɓarayi suka zo miki, in kuma ’yan fashi suka shigo gidan da dare, kash, bala’i zai jira ki ba abin da suke so ne kawai za su sata ba? In kuma masu tsinka ’ya’yan inabi suka zo miki, ba sukan bar ’ya’yan inabi kaɗan ba?
english: “If thieves came to you, if robbers by night—oh, what disaster awaits you—wouldn’t they only steal until they had enough? If grape pickers came to you, wouldn’t they leave some gleaning grapes?

hausa: Saboda haka, “Sai ku fito daga cikinsu, ku keɓe kanku, in ji Ubangiji. Kada ku taɓa wani abu marar tsabta, zan kuma karɓe ku.”
english: Therefore “‘Come out from among them, and be separate,’ says the Lord. ‘Touch no unclean thing. I will receive you.

hausa: Sa’an nan suka ce wa Irmiya, “Ubangiji ya zama shaida na gaskiya da kuma aminci a kanmu in ba mu yi bisa da duk abin da Ubangiji Allahnka ya aike ka ka faɗa mana ba.
english: Then they said to Jeremiah, “May Yahweh be a true and faithful witness among us, if we don’t do according to all the word with which Yahweh your God sends you to tell us.

hausa: Yayinda Yesu yana cikin magana, sai waɗansu mutane daga gidan Yayirus, mai mulkin majami’a, suka zo suka ce, “Diyarka ta rasu. Kada ma ka wahal da Malam.”
english: While he was still speaking, people came from the synagogue ruler’s house, saying, “Your daughter is dead. Why bother the Teacher any more?”

hausa: Yesu ya ce, “Yanyawa suna da ramummuka, tsuntsayen sararin sama suna da sheƙuna, amma Ɗan Mutum ba shi da wurin da zai sa kansa.”
english: Jesus said to him, “The foxes have holes and the birds of the sky have nests, but the Son of Man has no place to lay his head.”

hausa: Suka yi zobai biyu na zinariya a ƙarƙashin zubin, biyu-biyu ɗaura da juna, don su riƙe sandunan da za a ɗauka shi.
english: He made two golden rings for it under its molding crown, on its two ribs, on its two sides, for places for poles with which to carry it.

hausa: Saboda haka suka shiga don su miƙa hadayu da kuma hadaya ta ƙonawa. To, Yehu ya riga ya ba wa mutane takwas wannan kashedi a waje cewa, “In waninku ya bar ɗaya daga cikin mutanen nan da nake danƙa a hannunku ya tsere, to, a bakin ransa.”
english: So they went in to offer sacrifices and burnt offerings. Now Jehu had appointed for himself eighty men outside, and said, “If any of the men whom I bring into your hands escape, he who lets him go, his life shall be for the life of him.”

hausa: Duk mai son faɗa yana son zunubi, duk wanda ya gina ƙofar shiga mai tsawo yana gayyatar hallaka.
english: He who loves disobedience loves strife. One who builds a high gate seeks destruction.

hausa: Takan zauna a ƙofar gidanta, a wurin zama a wurin mafi tsayi na birni,
english: She sits at the door of her house, on a seat in the high places of the city,

hausa: Don me ka ɓoye mini fuskarka; ka kuma sa na zama kamar maƙiyinka?
english: Why do you hide your face, and consider me your enemy?

hausa: “Ni ne kuringar inabin; ku ne kuma rassan. In mutum ya kasance a cikina ni kuma a cikinsa, zai ba da ’ya’ya da yawa; in ba tare da ni ba, ba za ku iya yin kome ba.
english: I am the vine. You are the branches. He who remains in me and I in him bears much fruit, for apart from me you can do nothing.

hausa: Saboda haka sarkin fada, da gwamnan birnin, da dattawa, da kuma masu lura da ’ya’yan suka aika da saƙo ga Yehu, cewa, “Mu bayinka ne, za mu kuma yi duk abin da ka ce. Ba za mu naɗa kowa sarki ba; sai ka yi abin da ka ga ya fi kyau.”
english: He who was over the household, and he who was over the city, the elders also, and those who raised the children, sent to Jehu, saying, “We are your servants, and will do all that you ask us. We will not make any man king. You do that which is good in your eyes.”

hausa: Ya sa waɗannan a hannuwan Haruna da ’ya’yansa, suka kuma kaɗa su a gaban Ubangiji a matsayin hadaya ta kaɗawa.
english: He put all these in Aaron’s hands and in his sons’ hands, and waved them for a wave offering before Yahweh.

hausa: Amma in laifinsu yana nufin albarka ga duniya, hasararsu kuma albarka ga Al’ummai, ina misalin yalwar da albarkunsu za su kawo!
english: Now if their fall is the riches of the world, and their loss the riches of the Gentiles, how much more their fullness!

hausa: Na riga na yi muku gargaɗi sa’ad da nake tare da ku a zuwana na biyu. Yanzu da ba na nan tare da ku, ina maimaita irin gargaɗin nan domin in na zo ba wanda zai kuɓuce wa horon nan,
english: I have warned previously, and I warn again, as when I was present the second time, so now, being absent, I write to those who have sinned before now and to all the rest that if I come again, I will not spare,

hausa: Wane ne zai iya kawo abin da yake da tsarki daga cikin abu marar tsarki? Babu!
english: Who can bring a clean thing out of an unclean? Not one.

hausa: Muryar Ubangiji za tă firgita Assuriya da sandar mulkinsa zai kashe su.
english: For through Yahweh’s voice the Assyrian will be dismayed. He will strike him with his rod.

hausa: Domin zukata su narke da yawa kuma su fāɗi, na tsai da takobin kisa a dukan ƙofofinsu. Kash! A sa ya haska kamar walƙiya, ana riƙe da shi don kisa.
english: I have set the threatening sword against all their gates, that their heart may melt, and their stumblings be multiplied. Ah! It is made as lightning. It is pointed for slaughter.

hausa: Ga abin da Musa ya ba rabin kabilar Manasse, wato, wa rabin zuriyar Manasse, bisa ga iyalansu.
english: Moses gave an inheritance to the half-tribe of Manasseh. It was for the half-tribe of the children of Manasseh according to their families.

hausa: Ka kawo ’ya’yansa maza ka sa musu taguwoyi.
english: You shall bring his sons, and put tunics on them.

hausa: Akan zaɓi kowane babban firist daga cikin mutane ne, akan kuma naɗa shi domin yă wakilce su a kan al’amuran Allah, domin yă miƙa kyautai da hadayu saboda zunubai.
english: For every high priest, being taken from among men, is appointed for men in things pertaining to God, that he may offer both gifts and sacrifices for sins.

hausa: Sai Iliya ya ce masa, “Ka dakata a nan Elisha; Ubangiji ya aike ni Yeriko.” Sai ya ce masa, “Muddin Ubangiji yana a raye, kai ma kana a raye, ba zan rabu da kai ba.” Saboda haka sai suka tafi Yeriko.
english: Elijah said to him, “Elisha, please wait here, for Yahweh has sent me to Jericho.” He said, “As Yahweh lives, and as your soul lives, I will not leave you.” So they came to Jericho.

hausa: Ta Dawuda. Kada ka tsorata saboda mugayen mutane ko ka yi kishin waɗanda suka aikata mugunta;
english: By David. Don’t fret because of evildoers, neither be envious against those who work unrighteousness.

hausa: Sai ku ci a cikin biranenku. Mutum marar tsabta da mai tsabta zai iya ci kamar yadda ake yi da barewa ko mariri.
english: You shall eat it within your gates. The unclean and the clean shall eat it alike, as the gazelle and as the deer.

hausa: Game da jinin ranka kuwa lalle zan bukaci lissafi. Zan bukaci lissafi daga kowane dabba. kuma daga kowane mutum, shi ma zan bukaci lissafi game da ran ɗan’uwansa.
english: I will surely require accounting for your life’s blood. At the hand of every animal I will require it. At the hand of man, even at the hand of every man’s brother, I will require the life of man.

hausa: amma sai sarkin fada ya ce wa Daniyel, “Ina jin tsoron ranka yă daɗe, sarkina wanda ya sa a ba ku abinci da ruwan inabi. Me zai sa yă ga kuna ramewa fiye da sauran samari, tsaranku? Sarki zai sa a fille mini kai saboda ku.”
english: The prince of the eunuchs said to Daniel, “I fear my lord the king, who has appointed your food and your drink. For why should he see your faces worse looking than the youths who are of your own age? Then you would endanger my head with the king.”

hausa: Yayinda Yesu na cikin magana har yanzu, sai ga wani daga gidan Yayirus, mai mulkin majami’ar ya ce, “Kada ka ƙara damun malam, diyarka ta rasu.”
english: While he still spoke, one from the ruler of the synagogue’s house came, saying to him, “Your daughter is dead. Don’t trouble the Teacher.”

hausa: Har sai in Ubangiji ya duba daga sama ya gani.
english: until Yahweh looks down, and sees from heaven.

hausa: Daga kabilar Benyamin kuwa aka ba su, Gibeyon, Geba,
english: Out of the tribe of Benjamin, Gibeon with its pasture lands, Geba with its pasture lands,

hausa: Da Yesu ya cika shekaru goma sha biyu, sai suka tafi Bikin bisa ga al’ada.
english: When he was twelve years old, they went up to Jerusalem according to the custom of the feast;

hausa: Irmiya kuwa ya zauna a sansanin masu gadi har ranar da aka ci Urushalima da yaƙi. Ga yadda aka ci Urushalima,
english: So Jeremiah stayed in the court of the guard until the day that Jerusalem was taken.

hausa: ba wa Ibrahim a matsayin mallakarsa a gaban dukan Hittiyawa waɗanda suka zo ƙofar birnin.
english: to Abraham for a possession in the presence of the children of Heth, before all who went in at the gate of his city.

hausa: da zarar sun ji ni, sukan yi mini biyayya; baƙi suna rusuna a gabana.
english: As soon as they hear of me they shall obey me. The foreigners shall submit themselves to me.

hausa: Duk wanda ya zo wurinku bai kuma kawo koyarwan nan ba, kada ku karɓe shi a gidanku ko ku marabce shi.
english: If anyone comes to you and doesn’t bring this teaching, don’t receive him into your house, and don’t welcome him,

hausa: “Sai ya ce, ‘Ga abin da zan yi. Zan rushe rumbunana, in gina manya, in zuba dukan hatsina da kayana a ciki.
english: He said, ‘This is what I will do. I will pull down my barns, build bigger ones, and there I will store all my grain and my goods.

hausa: Yanzu da ka bincika dukan kayayyakina, me ka samu da yake na gidanka? Kawo shi nan a gaban danginka da kuma dangina, bari su zama alƙali tsakaninmu biyu.
english: Now that you have felt around in all my stuff, what have you found of all your household stuff? Set it here before my relatives and your relatives, that they may judge between us two.

hausa: Ga abin da Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka yana cewa yayinda dukan duniya take farin ciki, zan mai da kai kango.
english: The Lord Yahweh says: “When the whole earth rejoices, I will make you desolate.

hausa: Mala’ika na huɗu ya juye kwanonsa a bisan rana, sai aka ba wa rana iko ta ƙona mutane da wuta.
english: The fourth poured out his bowl on the sun, and it was given to him to scorch men with fire.

hausa: “ ‘Iyakarku a yammanci, za tă kasance bakin Bahar Rum. Wannan ce za tă zama iyakarku a yamma.
english: “‘For the western border, you shall have the great sea and its border. This shall be your west border.

hausa: Sarki yana dawowa daga lambun fada zuwa babban zauren liyafan ke nan, sai ga Haman ya fāɗi a kan shimfiɗar da Esta take zaune. Sarki ya tā da murya da ƙarfi ya ce, “Har ma zai ci mutuncin sarauniya yayinda take tare da ni a cikin gida?” Sarki bai ma rufe baki ba, sai bayin sarki suka rufe fuskar Haman.
english: Then the king returned out of the palace garden into the place of the banquet of wine; and Haman had fallen on the couch where Esther was. Then the king said, “Will he even assault the queen in front of me in the house?” As the word went out of the king’s mouth, they covered Haman’s face.

hausa: Duk sun rame don rashi da yunwa, suna yawo a gaigayar ƙasa a kufai da dare.
english: They are gaunt from lack and famine. They gnaw the dry ground, in the gloom of waste and desolation.

hausa: In na ci abinci da godiya, don me za a zarge ni a kan abin da na ci da godiya ga Allah?
english: If I partake with thankfulness, why am I denounced for something I give thanks for?

hausa: Bai gane shi ba, gama hannuwansa suna da gashi kamar na ɗan’uwansa Isuwa, saboda haka ya albarkace shi.
english: He didn’t recognize him, because his hands were hairy, like his brother Esau’s hands. So he blessed him.

hausa: Tare da kyautai mafi kyau na duniya da cikarta, da tagomashi na wanda yake zama a ƙaramin itace mai ƙonewa. Bari duk waɗannan su zauna a kan Yusuf, a goshin sarki a cikin ’yan’uwansa.
english: for the precious things of the earth and its fullness, the good will of him who lived in the bush. Let this come on the head of Joseph, on the crown of the head of him who was separated from his brothers.

hausa: Ya Ubangiji, ka goyi bayana; ka fanshi raina.
english: Lord, you have pleaded the causes of my soul. You have redeemed my life.

hausa: Sai sarki ya umarci Benahiya ɗan Yehohiyada, yă fita, yă bugi Shimeyi, yă kashe shi. Ya kuwa kashe shi. Mulki kuwa ya kahu sosai a hannun Solomon.
english: So the king commanded Benaiah the son of Jehoiada; and he went out, and fell on him, so that he died. The kingdom was established in the hand of Solomon.

hausa: Gama a dā zukatanku sun cika da duhu, amma yanzu ku haske ne a cikin Ubangiji. Ku yi rayuwa kamar ’ya’yan haske
english: For you were once darkness, but are now light in the Lord. Walk as children of light,

hausa: Zan ƙara yawan gwaurayensu su fi yashin teku yawa. Da tsakar rana zan kawo mai hallakarwa a kan iyaye mata na samarinsu; farat ɗaya zan kawo musu wahala da razana.
english: Their widows are increased more than the sand of the seas. I have brought on them against the mother of the young men a destroyer at noonday. I have caused anguish and terrors to fall on her suddenly.

hausa: Sai ku ƙaunaci baƙi, gama dā ku ma baƙi ne a ƙasar Masar.
english: Therefore love the foreigner, for you were foreigners in the land of Egypt.

hausa: Ka dalaye bisansa da kuma dukan gefe-gefensa da kuma ƙahoninsa da zinariya zalla, ka kuma yi zubi na zinariya kewaye da shi.
english: You shall overlay it with pure gold, its top, its sides around it, and its horns; and you shall make a gold molding around it.

hausa: Bari mu ɗaga zuciyarmu da hannuwanmu ga Allah na cikin sama, mu ce,
english: Let’s lift up our heart with our hands to God in the heavens.

hausa: “Saboda haka ga abin da Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka ya ce kin yi ƙin ji fiye da al’umman da suke kewaye da ke ba ki kuma bi ƙa’idodina ko ki kiyaye dokokina ba. Ba ki ma dace da matsayin al’umman da suke kewaye da ke ba.
english: “Therefore the Lord Yahweh says: ‘Because you are more turbulent than the nations that are around you, and have not walked in my statutes, neither have kept my ordinances, neither have followed the ordinances of the nations that are around you;

hausa: “ ‘Ga abin da Ubangiji Mai Iko na ce ku sarakunan Isra’ila, danniya da zaluncin da kuke yi sun isa! Ku yi shari’a bisa ga gaskiya da adalci, ku bar korar mutanena, in ji Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka.
english: “‘The Lord Yahweh says: “Enough, you princes of Israel! Remove violence and plunder, and execute justice and righteousness! Stop dispossessing my people!” says the Lord Yahweh.

hausa: (Dukan mutane, har da masu karɓar haraji, da suka ji kalmomin Yesu, sai suka yarda cewa hanyar Allah gaskiya ce, domin Yohanna ne ya yi musu baftisma.
english: When all the people and the tax collectors heard this, they declared God to be just, having been baptized with John’s baptism.

hausa: Daɓen ya bi ta daidai gefen hanyoyin shiga, kuma faɗinsa ya yi daidai da tsawon ƙofofin shiga; wannan shi ne daɓen da yake ƙasa-ƙasa.
english: The pavement was by the side of the gates, corresponding to the length of the gates, even the lower pavement.

hausa: Mai albarka ne mutumin da ka yi masa horo, ya Ubangiji, mutumin da ka koyar daga dokarka;
english: Blessed is the man whom you discipline, Yah, and teach out of your law,

hausa: Sai matsaran ƙofar suka sanar da labarin a cikin fada.
english: Then the gatekeepers called out and told it to the king’s household within.

hausa: Bari Allah na Ibrahim da Allah na Nahor, Allah na iyayensu, yă zama alƙali tsakaninmu.” Saboda haka Yaƙub ya yi rantsuwa da sunan Tsoron mahaifinsa Ishaku.
english: The God of Abraham, and the God of Nahor, the God of their father, judge between us.” Then Jacob swore by the fear of his father, Isaac.

hausa: Isra’ilawa suka zama bayin Eglon sarkin Mowab shekara goma sha takwas.
english: The children of Israel served Eglon the king of Moab eighteen years.

hausa: saboda haka ga abin da Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka yana cewa ina gab da miƙa hannuna a kan Filistiyawa, zan kuwa datse Keretawa in kuma hallaka waɗanda suka rage a bakin teku.
english: therefore the Lord Yahweh says, “Behold, I will stretch out my hand on the Philistines, and I will cut off the Cherethites, and destroy the remnant of the sea coast.

hausa: Ka haura zuwa ƙasar da take zub da madara da zuma. Amma ba zan tafi tare da ku ba, saboda ku mutane ne masu taurinkai domin mai yiwuwa in hallaka ku a hanya.”
english: Go to a land flowing with milk and honey; but I will not go up among you, for you are a stiff-necked people, lest I consume you on the way.”

hausa: “Ubangiji ya duba ƙasa daga wurinsa mai tsarki a bisa, daga sama ya hangi duniya,
english: for he has looked down from the height of his sanctuary. From heaven, Yahweh saw the earth,

hausa: “Urushalima, ayya Urushalima, ke da kike kashe annabawa, kike kuma jifan waɗanda aka aiko gare ki, sau da sau na so in tattara ’ya’yanki wuri ɗaya, yadda kaza takan tattara ’ya’yanta cikin fikafikanta, amma kuka ƙi.
english: “Jerusalem, Jerusalem, who kills the prophets and stones those who are sent to her! How often I would have gathered your children together, even as a hen gathers her chicks under her wings, and you would not!

hausa: Sa’ad da Bowaz ya gama ci da sha yana kuma cikin farin ciki, sai ya tafi ya kwanta a ƙarshen tarin hatsi. Rut kuwa ta sulalle ta je ta buɗe ƙafafunsa ta kwanta.
english: When Boaz had eaten and drunk, and his heart was merry, he went to lie down at the end of the heap of grain. She came softly, uncovered his feet, and lay down.

hausa: Mutum ɗari biyar na waɗannan mutane Simeyon, waɗanda Felatiya, Neyariya, Refahiya da Uzziyel, ’ya’yan Ishi maza suka jagorance, sun mamaye ƙasar tudu ta Seyir.
english: Some of them, even of the sons of Simeon, five hundred men, went to Mount Seir, having for their captains Pelatiah, Neariah, Rephaiah, and Uzziel, the sons of Ishi.

hausa: Amma in mutane suna daure da sarƙoƙi, ƙunci kuma ya daure su,
english: If they are bound in fetters, and are taken in the cords of afflictions,

hausa: Duba, abubuwan da sun tabbata, sababbin abubuwa kuwa nake furtawa; kafin ma su soma faruwa na sanar da su gare ku.”
english: Behold, the former things have happened and I declare new things. I tell you about them before they come up.”

hausa: Me ya sa kake yi kamar mutumin da aka far masa kwasam ba zato, kamar jarumi marar ƙarfin ceto? Kana a cikinmu, ya Ubangiji, da sunanka ake kiranmu; kada ka yashe mu!
english: Why should you be like a scared man, as a mighty man who can’t save? Yet you, Yahweh, are in the middle of us, and we are called by your name. Don’t leave us.

hausa: Saboda haka, sa’ad da suka taru, sai suka tambaye shi, “Ubangiji, a wannan lokaci za ka mayar da mulki ga Isra’ila?”
english: Therefore, when they had come together, they asked him, “Lord, are you now restoring the kingdom to Israel?”

hausa: Za su juye kunnuwansu daga gaskiya zuwa ga jin tatsuniyoyi.
english: and will turn away their ears from the truth, and turn away to fables.

hausa: gama Amalekawa da Kan’aniyawa za su kara da ku a can. Domin kun juya daga Ubangiji, ba zai kasance da ku ba, za a kuma karkashe ku da takobi.”
english: For there the Amalekite and the Canaanite are before you, and you will fall by the sword because you turned back from following Yahweh; therefore Yahweh will not be with you.”

hausa: Ku tā da tuta gāba da katangan Babilon! Ku ƙara matsara, ku kafa masu tsaro, ku shirya kwanto! Ga shi, Ubangiji zai aikata abin da ya faɗa umarninsa a kan mutanen Babilon.
english: Set up a standard against the walls of Babylon! Make the watch strong! Set the watchmen, and prepare the ambushes; for Yahweh has both purposed and done that which he spoke concerning the inhabitants of Babylon.

hausa: Sai Farisiyawa suka amsa cikin fushi suka ce, “Af, kuna nufi har da ku ma ya ruɗe ku ke nan?
english: The Pharisees therefore answered them, “You aren’t also led astray, are you?

hausa: “ ‘Firist zai kawo su a gaban Ubangiji, yă miƙa hadaya don zunubi da hadaya ta ƙonawa.
english: The priest shall present them before Yahweh, and shall offer his sin offering and his burnt offering.

hausa: Na sāke dubawa sai ga naɗaɗɗen littafi mai firiya a gabana!
english: Then again I lifted up my eyes and saw, and behold, a flying scroll.

hausa: Mun gaskata cewa Yesu ya mutu ya tashi kuma daga matattu, ta haka muka gaskata cewa Allah zai kawo waɗanda suka yi barci a cikinsa tare da Yesu.
english: For if we believe that Jesus died and rose again, even so God will bring with him those who have fallen asleep in Jesus.

hausa: “Sa’an nan na faɗa musu cewa, ‘Ga abin da Ubangiji Maɗaukaki, Allah na Isra’ila, yana cewa ku sha, ku bugu ku kuma yi amai, ku fāɗi, kada kuma ku ƙara tashi saboda takobin da zan aiko muku.’
english: “You shall tell them, ‘Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel says: “Drink, and be drunk, vomit, fall, and rise no more, because of the sword which I will send among you.”’

hausa: Sa’an nan Ibrahim ya kawo kuka ga Abimelek game da rijiyar ruwan da bayin Abimelek suka ƙwace.
english: Abraham complained to Abimelech because of a water well, which Abimelech’s servants had violently taken away.

hausa: “Ka faɗa wa Lawiyawa cewa, ‘Sa’ad da kuka miƙa sashi mafi kyau, za a lissafta shi a matsayin abin da ya fito daga masussuka, ko wurin matsewar ruwan inabi ne.
english: “Therefore you shall tell them, ‘When you heave its best from it, then it shall be credited to the Levites as the increase of the threshing floor, and as the increase of the wine press.

hausa: Zan sa zuriyarka ta yi yawa kamar taurari a sararin sama zan kuwa ba su dukan waɗannan ƙasashe, ta wurin ’ya’yanka kuma za a albarkaci dukan al’umman duniya,
english: I will multiply your offspring as the stars of the sky, and will give all these lands to your offspring. In your offspring all the nations of the earth will be blessed,

hausa: Ubangiji ya ce wa Musa,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

hausa: In maigidansa ya yi masa aure, ta kuwa haifa masa ’ya’ya maza ko mata, matan da ’ya’yan, za su zama na maigidan, sai mutumin kaɗai zai tafi ’yantacce.
english: If his master gives him a wife and she bears him sons or daughters, the wife and her children shall be her master’s, and he shall go out by himself.

hausa: ’Ya’yan Kaleb maza, ɗan’uwan Yerameyel su ne, Mesha ɗan farinsa, wanda shi ne mahaifin Zif, da ɗansa Maresha, wanda shi ne mahaifin Hebron.
english: The sons of Caleb the brother of Jerahmeel were Mesha his firstborn, who was the father of Ziph, and the sons of Mareshah the father of Hebron.

hausa: Sa’an nan a shekara ta arba’in da ɗaya ta mulkinsa, Asa ya mutu ya kuma huta tare da kakanninsa.
english: Asa slept with his fathers, and died in the forty-first year of his reign.

hausa: “Na ba wa Lawiyawa dukan zakka na Isra’ilawa a matsayin gādonsu, saboda aikin da suke yi yayinda suke hidima a Tentin Sujada.
english: “To the children of Levi, behold, I have given all the tithe in Israel for an inheritance, in return for their service which they serve, even the service of the Tent of Meeting.

hausa: Kuma duk wanda ba yakan ɗauki gicciyensa ya bi ni ba, ba zai iya zama almajirina ba.
english: Whoever doesn’t bear his own cross and come after me, can’t be my disciple.

hausa: Mutane za su ce muku, ‘Ga shi can!’ Ko kuma, ‘Ga shi nan!’ Kada ku yi hanzarin binsu.
english: They will tell you, ‘Look, here!’ or ‘Look, there!’ Don’t go away or follow after them,

hausa: Ba wanda yake da iko a kan iska har da zai riƙe ta, saboda haka babu mai iko kan ranar mutuwarsa. Kamar yadda ba a sallamar mutum a lokacin yaƙi, haka ma mugunta ba za tă saki masu aikata ta ba.
english: There is no man who has power over the spirit to contain the spirit; neither does he have power over the day of death. There is no discharge in war; neither shall wickedness deliver those who practice it.

hausa: Ba shi da wani amfani, ko ga ƙasa, ko ga juji, sai dai a zubar da shi. “Duk mai kunnen ji, yă ji.”
english: It is fit neither for the soil nor for the manure pile. It is thrown out. He who has ears to hear, let him hear.”

hausa: Daga sama ka yi shelar hukunci, ƙasa kuwa ta ji tsoro ta kuwa yi tsit,
english: You pronounced judgment from heaven. The earth feared, and was silent,

hausa: Kowane dakali yana da hannuwa huɗu, ɗaya a kowane gefe, da yake nausawa daga dakalin.
english: There were four supports at the four corners of each base. Its supports were of the base itself.

hausa: Hiwiyawa, Arkiyawa, Siniyawa,
english: the Hivite, the Arkite, the Sinite,

hausa: Hannunka mai iko ne; hannunka yana da ƙarfi, hannunka na dama ya sami ɗaukaka.
english: You have a mighty arm. Your hand is strong, and your right hand is exalted.

hausa: Zan gina hasumiyarki da jan yakutu, ƙofofinki kuma da duwatsu masu haske, dukan katangarki kuma da duwatsu masu daraja.
english: I will make your pinnacles of rubies, your gates of sparkling jewels, and all your walls of precious stones.

hausa: “Ka bar nan, ka nufi wajajen gabas, ka ɓuya a Rafin Kerit, gabas da Urdun.
english: “Go away from here, turn eastward, and hide yourself by the brook Cherith, that is before the Jordan.

hausa: Da yake ba wanda ya san nan gaba, wa zai iya faɗa masa abin da zai faru?
english: For he doesn’t know that which will be; for who can tell him how it will be?

hausa: yă zama muku alama. Nan gaba in yaranku suka tambaye ku suka ce, ‘Mece ce ma’anar kasancewar duwatsun nan a nan?’
english: that this may be a sign among you, that when your children ask in the future, saying, ‘What do you mean by these stones?’

hausa: Waɗansu daga cikin waɗanda suke wurin, suka ji haushi, suka ce wa juna, “Me ya sa za a ɓata turaren nan haka?
english: But there were some who were indignant among themselves, saying, “Why has this ointment been wasted?

hausa: Kashegari, sai Bulus ya ɗauki mutanen ya kuma tsarkake kansa tare da su. Sa’an nan ya tafi haikali domin yă sanar da ranar cikar tsarkakewarsu da kuma ranar da za a ba da sadaka domin kowannensu.
english: Then Paul took the men, and the next day purified himself and went with them into the temple, declaring the fulfillment of the days of purification, until the offering was offered for every one of them.

hausa: A ranar da shekara 430 ɗin nan suka cika, a ran nan ne dukan ɓangare-ɓangare na mutanen Ubangiji suka bar Masar.
english: At the end of four hundred thirty years, to the day, all of Yahweh’s armies went out from the land of Egypt.

hausa: Suka wanke keken yaƙi a tafki, a Samariya (inda karuwai suke wanka), sai karnuka suka lashe jininsa, kamar yadda maganar Ubangiji ta furta.
english: They washed the chariot by the pool of Samaria; and the dogs licked up his blood where the prostitutes washed themselves, according to Yahweh’s word which he spoke.

hausa: Sarki ya ce masa, “Me ya sa kake zancen nan? Ai, na riga na umarta, da kai, da Ziba ku raba filayen.”
english: The king said to him, “Why do you speak any more of your matters? I say, you and Ziba divide the land.”

hausa: Bayan Musa ya gama rubuta kalmomin dokan nan a littafi daga farko zuwa ƙarshe,
english: When Moses had finished writing the words of this law in a book, until they were finished,

hausa: Duk mai ƙin ɗan’uwansa mai kisankai ne, kun kuma san cewa ba mai kisankan da yake da rai madawwami a cikinsa.
english: Whoever hates his brother is a murderer, and you know that no murderer has eternal life remaining in him.

hausa: Ku tsaya a bakin hanya ku duba, ku da kuke zama a Arower. Ku tambayi mutumin da yake gudu da macen da take tserewa, tambaye su, ‘Me ya faru?’
english: Inhabitant of Aroer, stand by the way and watch. Ask him who flees, and her who escapes; say, ‘What has been done?’

hausa: “In ɗaya a cikinku yana da bawa, wanda yake masa noma, ko kiwon tumaki, da dawowar bawan daga gonar, ai, ba zai ce masa, ‘Ka zo nan, ka zauna, ka ci abinci ba’?
english: But who is there among you, having a servant plowing or keeping sheep, that will say when he comes in from the field, ‘Come immediately and sit down at the table’?

hausa: Da ya gama addu’a, sai Yesu ya fita tare da almajiransa suka haye Kwarin Kidron. A wancan ƙetaren kuwa akwai lambun zaitun, da shi da almajiransa suka shiga ciki.
english: When Jesus had spoken these words, he went out with his disciples over the brook Kidron, where there was a garden, into which he and his disciples entered.

hausa: Saboda haka Saratu ta yi dariya da ta yi tunani a zuci tana cewa, “Bayan ƙarfina ya ƙare, maigidana kuma ya tsufa, yanzu zan sami wannan jin daɗi?”
english: Sarah laughed within herself, saying, “After I have grown old will I have pleasure, my lord being old also?”

hausa: Daga baya, Hezron ya kwana da ’yar Makir mahaifin Gileyad (ya aure ta sa’ad da take da shekara sittin), ta haifa masa Segub.
english: Afterward Hezron went in to the daughter of Machir the father of Gilead, whom he took as wife when he was sixty years old; and she bore him Segub.

hausa: Maƙwabta duk suka cika da tsoro, mutane kuwa suka yi ta yin magana game da dukan waɗannan abubuwa a ko’ina a cikin ƙasar tudu ta Yahudiya.
english: Fear came on all who lived around them, and all these sayings were talked about throughout all the hill country of Judea.

hausa: A Galili waɗannan mata ne suka riƙa bin sa suna yin masa hidima. Waɗansu mata da yawa da suka zo tare da shi daga Urushalima, su ma suna nan a can.
english: who, when he was in Galilee, followed him and served him; and many other women who came up with him to Jerusalem.

hausa: Gaskiya nake gaya muku, zamanin nan ba zai shuɗe ba sai duk abubuwan nan sun faru.
english: Most certainly I say to you, this generation will not pass away until all these things happen.

hausa: Da yake kuma Ubangiji bai ce zai shafe sunan Isra’ila daga fuskar duniya ba, sai ya cece su ta hannun Yerobowam ɗan Yowash.
english: Yahweh didn’t say that he would blot out the name of Israel from under the sky; but he saved them by the hand of Jeroboam the son of Joash.

hausa: “Dalilin da ya sa nake kuka ke nan idanuna kuma suna ta zubar da hawaye. Babu wani a kusa da zai yi mini ta’aziyya, ba wanda zai sabunta ruhuna. ’Ya’yana sun zama fakirai domin maƙiyina ya yi nasara.”
english: “For these things I weep. My eye, my eye runs down with water, because the comforter who should refresh my soul is far from me. My children are desolate, because the enemy has prevailed.”

hausa: To, sai Filistiyawa suka taru don su miƙa hadaya ga Dagon allahnsu su kuma yi biki cewa, “Allahnmu ya bashe abokin gābanmu Samson a hannuwanmu.”
english: The lords of the Philistines gathered together to offer a great sacrifice to Dagon their god, and to rejoice; for they said, “Our god has delivered Samson our enemy into our hand.”

hausa: Duk waninku da yake ƙaunar rayuwa yana kuma so yă ga kwanaki masu kyau,
english: Who is someone who desires life, and loves many days, that he may see good?

hausa: Sai sarki, a lokacin sarauniya da tana zama kusa da shi, ya tambaye ni, ya ce, “Kwana nawa tafiyar za tă ɗauke ka, kuma yaushe za ka dawo?” Ya gamshi sarki ya aike ni; saboda haka na shirya lokaci.
english: The king said to me (the queen was also sitting by him), “How long will your journey be? When will you return?” So it pleased the king to send me, and I set a time for him.

hausa: To, rijiyar da ya zubar da gawawwakin mutanen da ya kashe tare da ta Gedaliya ita ce wadda Sarki Asa ya haƙa a matsayin kāriya saboda Ba’asha sarkin Isra’ila. Ishmayel ɗan Netaniya ya cika ta da gawawwaki.
english: Now the pit in which Ishmael cast all the dead bodies of the men whom he had killed, by the side of Gedaliah (this was that which Asa the king had made for fear of Baasha king of Israel), Ishmael the son of Nethaniah filled it with those who were killed.

hausa: Yana cikin magana, sai ga wani ɗan aika ya zo ya ce, “’Ya’yanka maza da mata suna biki, suna ci suna sha a gidan babban ɗanka,
english: While he was still speaking, there came also another, and said, “Your sons and your daughters were eating and drinking wine in their oldest brother’s house,

hausa: Ya yi wa jarumin umarni yă tsare Bulus amma yă ba shi ’yanci yă kuma bar abokansa su lura da bukatunsa.
english: He ordered the centurion that Paul should be kept in custody and should have some privileges, and not to forbid any of his friends to serve him or to visit him.

hausa: Amma da dare wani mala’ikan Ubangiji ya buɗe ƙofofin kurkukun ya fitar da su.
english: But an angel of the Lord opened the prison doors by night, and brought them out and said,

hausa: Za a kunyatar da masu hikima; za su yi fargaba a kuma kama su. Da yake sun ƙi maganar Ubangiji, wace irin hikima kuka ce kuke da ita?
english: The wise men are disappointed. They are dismayed and trapped. Behold, they have rejected Yahweh’s word. What kind of wisdom is in them?

hausa: An ɗaukaka shi zuwa ga hannun dama na Allah, ya karɓi alkawarin Ruhu Mai Tsarki daga Uba, ya kuma zubo abin da yanzu kuke gani kuke kuma ji.
english: Being therefore exalted by the right hand of God, and having received from the Father the promise of the Holy Spirit, he has poured out this which you now see and hear.

hausa: Za ki sha shi ki kuma lashe shi ƙaf; za ki buga shi da ƙasa ya yi rugu-rugu ki tsattsage nononki. Ni Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka na faɗa.
english: You will even drink it and drain it out. You will gnaw the broken pieces of it, and will tear your breasts; for I have spoken it,’ says the Lord Yahweh.

hausa: Waɗannan su ne sunayen ’ya’yan Gershom. Libni da Shimeyi.
english: These are the names of the sons of Gershom: Libni and Shimei.

hausa: zan ƙaddara ku ga kaifin takobi, dukanku kuma za ku sunkuya wa mai yanka; gama na yi kira amma ba ku amsa ba, na yi magana amma ba ku saurara ba. Kuka aikata mugunta a gabana kuka kuma zaɓi abin da ba na jin daɗi.”
english: I will destine you to the sword, and you will all bow down to the slaughter; because when I called, you didn’t answer. When I spoke, you didn’t listen; but you did that which was evil in my eyes, and chose that in which I didn’t delight.”

hausa: Umarnan nan, “Kada ka yi zina.” “Kada ka yi kisankai.” “Kada ka yi sata.” “Kada kuma ka yi ƙyashi.” Da dai duk sauran umarnai an ƙunshe su ne a wannan kalma “Ka ƙaunaci maƙwabcinka kamar kanka.”
english: For the commandments, “You shall not commit adultery,” “You shall not murder,” “You shall not steal,” “You shall not covet,” and whatever other commandments there are, are all summed up in this saying, namely, “You shall love your neighbor as yourself.”

hausa: Ubangiji ya ce wa Musa “Sassaƙa alluna biyu kamar na farko, ni kuwa in rubuta kalmomin da suke cikin alluna na farko da ka farfasa.
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “Chisel two stone tablets like the first. I will write on the tablets the words that were on the first tablets, which you broke.

hausa: Suka shiga Urushalima suka shiga haikalin Ubangiji da kiɗin molaye da sarewa da kuma garayu.
english: They came to Jerusalem with stringed instruments, harps, and trumpets to Yahweh’s house.

hausa: Mutumin ya ce, “Malam, ka faɗi daidai. Daidai ne da ka ce, Allah ɗaya ne, babu kuma wani sai shi.
english: The scribe said to him, “Truly, teacher, you have said well that he is one, and there is none other but he;

hausa: Saboda haka na yi annabci yadda aka umarce ni, sai numfashi ya shiga musu; suka rayu suka kuma miƙe tsaye a ƙafafunsu babbar runduna ce ƙwarai.
english: So I prophesied as he commanded me, and the breath came into them, and they lived, and stood up on their feet, an exceedingly great army.

hausa: ta goma sha ɗaya a kan Azarel, ’ya’yansa maza da danginsa, 12
english: the eleventh to Azarel, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

hausa: Mutanen Isra’ila suka kira burodin Manna. Manna yana nan fari kamar farin riɗi, ɗanɗanonsa kuma yana kama da masa da aka yi da zuma.
english: The house of Israel called its name “Manna”, and it was like coriander seed, white; and its taste was like wafers with honey.

hausa: “Ku tattara mini shafaffuna, waɗanda suka yi alkawari da ni ta wurin hadaya.”
english: “Gather my saints together to me, those who have made a covenant with me by sacrifice.”

hausa: Mala’ika na uku ya biyo su ya ce da babbar murya, “Duk wanda ya yi wa dabban nan da siffarta sujada ya kuma sami alamarta a goshi ko a hannu,
english: Another angel, a third, followed them, saying with a great voice, “If anyone worships the beast and his image, and receives a mark on his forehead or on his hand,

hausa: Ga doka game da mutumin da ya kashe wani, ya kuma gudu don yă cece ransa, wani wanda ya kashe maƙwabcinsa ba da gangan ba, ba kuwa da wata ƙiyayya a tsakaninsu a dā ba.
english: This is the case of the man slayer who shall flee there and live: Whoever kills his neighbor unintentionally, and didn’t hate him in time past—

hausa: Ahab ya ce wa Obadiya, “Ka ratsa ƙasar zuwa dukan maɓulɓulai da fadamu. Mai yiwuwa ka sami ciyawa mu ba dawakai da alfadarai don su rayu, don kada mu kashe dabbobinmu.”
english: Ahab said to Obadiah, “Go through the land, to all the springs of water, and to all the brooks. Perhaps we may find grass and save the horses and mules alive, that we not lose all the animals.”

hausa: Saboda haka Yehoram ya tafi can tare da shugabannin sojojinsa da kuma dukan keken yaƙinsa. Mutanen Edom suka kewaye shi da shugabannin keken yaƙinsa, amma ya tashi ya fatattaki su da dare.
english: Then Jehoram went there with his captains and all his chariots with him. He rose up by night and struck the Edomites who surrounded him, along with the captains of the chariots.

hausa: Sai sarki ya umarce Doyeg ya ce, “Ka juya ka kakkashe firistocin.” Doyeg mutumin Edom ya juya ya kakkashe firistocin. A ranar kuwa ya kashe mutum tamanin da biyar waɗanda suke sanye da efod na lilin.
english: The king said to Doeg, “Turn and attack the priests!” Doeg the Edomite turned, and he attacked the priests, and he killed on that day eighty-five people who wore a linen ephod.

hausa: suna cewa, “Kai da za ka rushe haikali, ka kuma gina shi cikin kwana uku, ceci kanka mana! In kai Ɗan Allah ne, ka sauka daga gicciyen!”
english: and saying, “You who destroy the temple and build it in three days, save yourself! If you are the Son of God, come down from the cross!”

hausa: A zamanin Amrafel sarkin Shinar, shi da Ariyok sarkin Ellasar, Kedorlayomer sarkin Elam, da kuma Tidal sarkin Goyim
english: In the days of Amraphel, king of Shinar; Arioch, king of Ellasar; Chedorlaomer, king of Elam; and Tidal, king of Goiim,

hausa: Irin da suka fāɗi a cikin ƙaya kuwa, su ne mutanen da suka ji, amma a kwana a tashi, tunanin kayan duniya, da neman arziki, da son jin daɗi, sukan hana su ba da ’ya’ya.
english: What fell among the thorns, these are those who have heard, and as they go on their way they are choked with cares, riches, and pleasures of life; and they bring no fruit to maturity.

hausa: Amma mugaye za su hallaka, Abokan gāban Ubangiji za su zama kamar kyan gonaki, za su ɓace, za su ɓace kamar hayaƙi.
english: But the wicked shall perish. The enemies of Yahweh shall be like the beauty of the fields. They will vanish— vanish like smoke.

hausa: (An tuɓe sauran dabbobin daga mulkinsu, amma aka bar su su rayu na wani lokaci.)
english: As for the rest of the animals, their dominion was taken away; yet their lives were prolonged for a season and a time.

hausa: Kowa ya ga ɗan’uwansa yana yin zunubin da bai kai ga mutuwa ba, sai yă yi masa addu’a. Ta dalilin mai addu’an nan kuwa, Allah zai ba da rai ga mai yin zunubin da bai kai ga mutuwa ba. Akwai zunubin da yakan kai ga mutuwa. Ban ce a yi addu’a domin wannan ba.
english: If anyone sees his brother sinning a sin not leading to death, he shall ask, and God will give him life for those who sin not leading to death. There is sin leading to death. I don’t say that he should make a request concerning this.

hausa: Sa’an nan mala’ikan ya ce mini, “Don me kake mamaki? Zan bayyana maka asirin macen nan da dabbar da take hawa, wadda take da kawuna bakwai da ƙahoni goma.
english: The angel said to me, “Why do you wonder? I will tell you the mystery of the woman and of the beast that carries her, which has the seven heads and the ten horns.

hausa: “Ku faɗa wa Hezekiya sarkin Yahuda, kada ka bar allahn da kake dogara gare shi yă ruɗe ka cewa, ‘Urushalima ba za tă fāɗi a hannun sarkin Assuriya ba.’
english: “Tell Hezekiah king of Judah this: ‘Don’t let your God in whom you trust deceive you, saying, Jerusalem will not be given into the hand of the king of Assyria.

hausa: “Duba, Ubangiji, ka ga ƙuncin da nake ciki! Ina shan azaba a raina, ba ni da kwanciyar rai a cikin zuciyata, domin na yi tawaye sosai. A waje takobi na kisa; a ciki kuma akwai mutuwa.
english: “Look, Yahweh; for I am in distress. My heart is troubled. My heart turns over within me, for I have grievously rebelled. Abroad, the sword bereaves. At home, it is like death.

hausa: zai gamu da tsarar kakanninsa, waɗanda ba za su taɓa ganin hasken rayuwa ba.
english: he shall go to the generation of his fathers. They shall never see the light.

hausa: za ku ceci rayukan mahaifina da mahaifiyata, da ’yan’uwana maza da mata, da duk waɗanda suke nasu, za ku cece mu daga mutuwa.”
english: and that you will save alive my father, my mother, my brothers, and my sisters, and all that they have, and will deliver our lives from death.”

hausa: Za ka ba da ɗan bijimi a matsayin hadaya ta ƙonawa ga firistoci, waɗanda suke Lawiyawa, na iyalin Zadok, waɗanda suke zuwa kusa don hidima a gabana, in ji Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka.
english: You shall give to the Levitical priests who are of the offspring of Zadok, who are near to me, to minister to me,’ says the Lord Yahweh, ‘a young bull for a sin offering.

hausa: Yana wa duwatsu banruwa daga ɗakinsa na sama; ƙasa tana ƙoshiya da amfanin aikinsa.
english: He waters the mountains from his rooms. The earth is filled with the fruit of your works.

hausa: Sa’an nan Ubangiji ya ce, “Ga wani wuri kusa da ni inda za ka tsaya bisa dutsen.
english: Yahweh also said, “Behold, there is a place by me, and you shall stand on the rock.

hausa: Daga kabilar Benyamin kuma aka ba su Gibeyon, Geba, Alemet da Anatot, tare da wuraren kiwonsu. Waɗannan garuruwa waɗanda aka raba a tsakanin mutanen gidan Kohat, goma sha uku ne duka.
english: and out of the tribe of Benjamin, Geba with its pasture lands, Allemeth with its pasture lands, and Anathoth with its pasture lands. All their cities throughout their families were thirteen cities.

hausa: Amma fa, zuriyar Kora ba tă mutu ba.
english: Notwithstanding, the sons of Korah didn’t die.

hausa: Da yamma ta yi, sai almajiransa suka gangara zuwa tafki,
english: When evening came, his disciples went down to the sea.

hausa: duwatsu suka yi tsalle kamar raguna, tuddai kamar tumaki.
english: The mountains skipped like rams, the little hills like lambs.

hausa: Amma Ni Ubangiji zan yi magana abin da na nufa, za tă kuwa tabbata ba tare da jinkiri ba. Gama cikin kwanakinku, kai gidan ’yan tawaye, zan cika duk abin da na faɗa, in ji Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka.’ ”
english: For I am Yahweh. I will speak, and the word that I speak will be performed. It will be no more deferred; for in your days, rebellious house, I will speak the word and will perform it,” says the Lord Yahweh.’”

hausa: An ayana masa wannan a matsayin adalci har zamanai marar matuƙa masu zuwa.
english: That was credited to him for righteousness, for all generations to come.

hausa: In mutum ya albarkaci maƙwabcinsa da murya mai ƙarfi da sassafe, za a ɗauka shi a matsayin la’ana.
english: He who blesses his neighbor with a loud voice early in the morning, it will be taken as a curse by him.

hausa: ɗan zuriyar Shekaniya ne shugaba, daga zuriyar Farosh, Zakariya ne shugaba, tare da shi akwai mutum 150;
english: Of the sons of Shecaniah, of the sons of Parosh, Zechariah; and with him were listed by genealogy of the males one hundred fifty.

hausa: domin Ubangiji yakan hori waɗanda yake ƙauna, yakan kuma hori duk wanda yakan karɓa a matsayin ɗa.”
english: for whom the Lord loves, he disciplines, and chastises every son whom he receives.”

hausa: Bayan ya haifi Kenan, Enosh ya yi shekara 815, ya kuma haifi waɗansu ’ya’ya maza da mata.
english: Enosh lived after he became the father of Kenan eight hundred fifteen years, and became the father of other sons and daughters.

hausa: Sai ya ɗauki burodi ya yi godiya, ya kakkarya ya ba su, da cewa, “Wannan jikina ne, da aka bayar dominku. Ku riƙa yin haka don tunawa da ni.”
english: He took bread, and when he had given thanks, he broke and gave it to them, saying, “This is my body which is given for you. Do this in memory of me.”

hausa: Sai gari ya waye inuwa kuma ta watse, ka juye, ƙaunataccena, ka zama kamar barewa ko kamar sagarin ƙishimi a kan tuddai masu ciyawa.
english: Until the day is cool, and the shadows flee away, turn, my beloved, and be like a roe or a young deer on the mountains of Bether.

hausa: Ubangiji yakan sāka wa kowa bisa ga adalcinsa da amincinsa. Ubangiji ya bashe ka a hannuna yau, amma ba zan sa hannuna a kan shafaffe na Ubangiji ba.
english: Yahweh will give to every man his righteousness and his faithfulness; because Yahweh delivered you into my hand today, and I wouldn’t stretch out my hand against Yahweh’s anointed.

hausa: Sa’ad da ya ji haka, sai Yesu ya ce, “Wannan rashin lafiya ba zai kai ga mutuwa ba. A’a, sai dai don a ɗaukaka Allah a kuma ɗaukaka Ɗan Allah ta wurin wannan.”
english: But when Jesus heard it, he said, “This sickness is not to death, but for the glory of God, that God’s Son may be glorified by it.”

hausa: Yesu ya ce, “An yi waɗansu mutum biyu da suke riƙe bashin mai ba da rance. Ana bin guda dinari ɗari biyar, ɗayan kuma hamsin.
english: “A certain lender had two debtors. The one owed five hundred denarii, and the other fifty.

hausa: “ ‘Kina da rashin ƙarfi a zuci, in ji Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka, sa’ad da kika yi duk waɗannan abubuwa, kina yi kamar karuwar da aka watsa!
english: “‘“How weak is your heart,” says the Lord Yahweh, “since you do all these things, the work of an impudent prostitute;

hausa: Rera wa Allah, rera yabo ga sunansa, ku ɗaukaka wanda yake hawa a kan gizagizai; sunansa Ubangiji ne, ku kuma yi farin ciki a gabansa.
english: Sing to God! Sing praises to his name! Extol him who rides on the clouds: to Yah, his name! Rejoice before him!

hausa: kafin rana da haske wata da taurari su daina haske, gizagizai kuma su tattaru bayan da suka sheƙa ruwa;
english: Before the sun, the light, the moon, and the stars are darkened, and the clouds return after the rain;

hausa: A gare ku da kuka gaskata, wannan dutse mai daraja ne. Amma ga waɗanda ba su gaskata ba, “Dutsen da magina suka ƙi ya zama dutsen kusurwar gini,
english: For you who believe therefore is the honor, but for those who are disobedient, “The stone which the builders rejected has become the chief cornerstone,”

hausa: Mai yiwuwa ku ce wa kanku, “Yaya za mu san cewa wannan saƙo ba Ubangiji ne ya faɗa ba?”
english: You may say in your heart, “How shall we know the word which Yahweh has not spoken?”

hausa: dattawan kuwa za su ɗauki mutumin su hukunta shi.
english: The elders of that city shall take the man and chastise him.

hausa: Saboda Dawuda bawanka, kada ka ƙi shafaffenka.
english: For your servant David’s sake, don’t turn away the face of your anointed one.

hausa: Lokacin da na fitar da iyayenku daga Masar, suka zo teku, sai Masarawa suka fafare su da kekunan yaƙi da dawakai har zuwa Jan Teku.
english: I brought your fathers out of Egypt: and you came to the sea. The Egyptians pursued your fathers with chariots and with horsemen to the Red Sea.

hausa: Yana fitowa daga arewa da haske na zinariya, Allah yana zuwa da ɗaukaka mai ban al’ajabi.
english: Out of the north comes golden splendor. With God is awesome majesty.

hausa: Bayan haka, Bulus ya bar Atens ya tafi Korint.
english: After these things Paul departed from Athens and came to Corinth.

hausa: Yana matsar da manyan duwatsu kafin su sani kuma yana juya su cikin fushinsa.
english: He removes the mountains, and they don’t know it, when he overturns them in his anger.

hausa: “Kawo Haruna da ’ya’yansa maza, ka ɗauki rigunansu, man keɓewa, bijimi domin hadaya don zunubi, ’yan raguna biyu da kuma kwandon da yake da burodi marar yisti,
english: “Take Aaron and his sons with him, and the garments, and the anointing oil, and the bull of the sin offering, and the two rams, and the basket of unleavened bread;

hausa: Domin an ɓata ’yar’uwansu Dina, sai ’ya’yan Yaƙub maza suka amsa a ha’ince yayinda suke wa Shekem da mahaifinsa Hamor magana.
english: The sons of Jacob answered Shechem and Hamor his father with deceit when they spoke, because he had defiled Dinah their sister,

hausa: Za su hallaka, amma za ka ci gaba; duk za su tsufe kamar riga. Kamar riga za ka canja su za a kuwa zubar da su.
english: They will perish, but you will endure. Yes, all of them will wear out like a garment. You will change them like a cloak, and they will be changed.

hausa: Mutane kuwa su wajen mutum goma sha biyu ne.
english: They were about twelve men in all.

hausa: wanda ya fi koya mana fiye da dabbobin duniya ya kuma sa muka fi tsuntsayen cikin iska hikima.’
english: who teaches us more than the animals of the earth, and makes us wiser than the birds of the sky?’

hausa: Akwai wani mutumin Zora, mai suna Manowa, daga kabilar Dan, matarsa kuwa bakararriya ce, ba ta haihuwa.
english: There was a certain man of Zorah, of the family of the Danites, whose name was Manoah; and his wife was barren, and childless.

hausa: Saboda haka, kullum muna da tabbaci mun kuma san cewa, muddin muna a duniya cikin jikin nan, ana raba mu da Ubangiji.
english: Therefore we are always confident and know that while we are at home in the body, we are absent from the Lord;

hausa: In su bayin Kiristi ne, ni na fi su ma, ina magana kamar ruɗaɗɗe ne fa! Ai, na fi su shan fama ƙwarai da gaske, da shan dauri, na sha dūka marar iyaka, na sha hatsarin mutuwa iri-iri.
english: Are they servants of Christ? (I speak as one beside himself.) I am more so: in labors more abundantly, in prisons more abundantly, in stripes above measure, and in deaths often.

hausa: “Wa ya taɓa ba wa Allah wani abu, da Allah zai sāka masa?”
english: “Or who has first given to him, and it will be repaid to him again?”

hausa: Bakin adalai kan fitar da hikima, amma za a dakatar da mugun harshe.
english: The mouth of the righteous produces wisdom, but the perverse tongue will be cut off.

hausa: Dukan yini sun kewaye ni kamar rigyawa; sun mamaye ni ɗungum.
english: They came around me like water all day long. They completely engulfed me.

hausa: sai wani mutum ya same shi yana yawo a cikin jeji, sai mutumin ya tambaye shi ya ce, “Me kake nema?”
english: A certain man found him, and behold, he was wandering in the field. The man asked him, “What are you looking for?”

hausa: Dawuda ya tafi Nob a wurin Ahimelek firist. Da Ahimelek ya gan shi sai ya firgita ya ce, “Me ya sa kai kaɗai ne? Me ya sa ba wani tare da kai?”
english: Then David came to Nob to Ahimelech the priest. Ahimelech came to meet David trembling, and said to him, “Why are you alone, and no man with you?”

hausa: Amma ya fitar da mu daga can domin yă kawo mu cikin ƙasar da ya yi wa kakanninmu alkawari tare da rantsuwa zai ba mu.
english: and he brought us out from there, that he might bring us in, to give us the land which he swore to our fathers.

hausa: Dukan ’ya’yansa maza da mata, suka zo don su ta’azantar da shi, amma ya ƙi yă ta’azantu. Ya ce, “A’a, cikin makoki zan gangara zuwa kabari wurin ɗana.” Saboda haka, mahaifin Yusuf ya yi kuka saboda shi.
english: All his sons and all his daughters rose up to comfort him, but he refused to be comforted. He said, “For I will go down to Sheol to my son, mourning.” His father wept for him.

hausa: Ka ba wa Eleyazar firist; a kuma kai ta bayan sansani, a yanka a gaban Eleyazar.
english: You shall give her to Eleazar the priest, and he shall bring her outside of the camp, and one shall kill her before his face.

hausa: Yawan mutanen sashensa 35,400 ne.
english: His army, and those who were counted of them, were thirty-five thousand four hundred.

hausa: Shi kaɗai ya shimfiɗa sammai ya kuma yi tafiya a kan raƙuman ruwan teku.
english: He alone stretches out the heavens, and treads on the waves of the sea.

hausa: Bari ɗan’uwan da yake cikin halin ƙasƙanci yă yi taƙama a matsayinsa na ɗaukaka.
english: Let the brother in humble circumstances glory in his high position;

hausa: Sai ya gargaɗe shi ya ce, “Mahaifina Shawulu yana neman hanyar da zai kashe ka. Ka kula da kanka gobe da safe, ka tafi wani wuri ka ɓuya.
english: Jonathan told David, saying, “Saul my father seeks to kill you. Now therefore, please take care of yourself in the morning, live in a secret place, and hide yourself.

hausa: Za su zauna a can lafiya su kuma gina gidaje su nome gonakin inabi; za su zauna lafiya sa’ad da zan zartar da hukunci a kan dukan maƙwabtansu da suka wulaƙanta su. Sa’an nan za su san cewa ni ne Ubangiji Allahnsu.’ ”
english: They will dwell in it securely. Yes, they will build houses, plant vineyards, and will dwell securely when I have executed judgments on all those around them who have treated them with contempt. Then they will know that I am Yahweh their God.”’”

hausa: Leɓunan masu hikima sukan baza sani; ba haka zukatan wawaye suke ba.
english: The lips of the wise spread knowledge; not so with the heart of fools.

hausa: Sai Ishaya ya ce, “A kwaɓa ɓaure.” Sai aka yi haka, aka shafa wa marurun, ya kuma warke.
english: Isaiah said, “Take a cake of figs.” They took and laid it on the boil, and he recovered.

hausa: Rana ta yi sama a sa’ad da ya wuce Fenuwel yana kuma ɗingishi saboda ƙashin cinyarsa.
english: The sun rose on him as he passed over Peniel, and he limped because of his thigh.

hausa: Ko firistocin da za su kusato Ubangiji sai su tsarkake kansu, don kada in hallaka su.”
english: Let the priests also, who come near to Yahweh, sanctify themselves, lest Yahweh break out on them.”

hausa: Sai Ubangiji ya ce, “Ka ba shi suna Lo-Ammi, gama ku ba mutanena ba ne, ni kuma ba Allahnku ba ne.
english: He said, “Call his name Lo-Ammi, for you are not my people, and I will not be yours.

hausa: Suka daure shi, suka tafi da shi, suka ba da shi ga gwamna Bilatus.
english: They bound him, led him away, and delivered him up to Pontius Pilate, the governor.

hausa: haka su ma suka zama marasa biyayya a yanzu domin su ma su sami jinƙai ta dalilin jinƙan da Allah ya yi muku.
english: even so these also have now been disobedient, that by the mercy shown to you they may also obtain mercy.

hausa: La’ananne ne mutumin da ya kawo wa mahaifina labari, wanda ya sa shi ya yi murna cewa, “An haifa maka yaro, ɗa namiji!”
english: Cursed is the man who brought news to my father, saying, “A boy is born to you,” making him very glad.

hausa: Mutumin da laifin kisa ya yi ta damunsa zai zama mai gudu don tsoro har mutuwa; kada wani ya taimake shi.
english: A man who is tormented by blood guilt will be a fugitive until death. No one will support him.

hausa: Sai Yesu ya ce musu, “Gaskiya nake gaya muku, sai kun ci naman jikin Ɗan Mutum kuka kuma sha jininsa, ba za ku kasance da rai a cikinku ba.
english: Jesus therefore said to them, “Most certainly I tell you, unless you eat the flesh of the Son of Man and drink his blood, you don’t have life in yourselves.

hausa: Yakan ƙasƙantar da waɗanda suke zama a bisa ya kawar da birni mai alfarma ƙasa; ya rusa ta har ƙasa ya jefar da ita cikin ƙura.
english: For he has brought down those who dwell on high, the lofty city. He lays it low. He lays it low even to the ground. He brings it even to the dust.

hausa: “Na kasance tare da kai shekaru ashirin. Tumakinka da awakinka ba su yi ɓarin ciki ba, ban kuwa ci raguna daga garkunanka ba.
english: “These twenty years I have been with you. Your ewes and your female goats have not cast their young, and I haven’t eaten the rams of your flocks.

hausa: Manyan firistoci da malaman dokoki suna tsaye a wurin, suna kawo zargi masu ƙarfi a kansa.
english: The chief priests and the scribes stood, vehemently accusing him.

hausa: ya yi mulki a Urushalima shekara arba’in da ɗaya. Sunan mahaifiya mahaifiyarsa, Ma’aka ne ’yar Abisalom.
english: He reigned forty-one years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Maacah the daughter of Abishalom.

hausa: Ban rabu da dokokinka ba, gama kai da kanka ne ka koya mini.
english: I have not turned away from your ordinances, for you have taught me.

hausa: Kada ka ƙara yin annabci a Betel, gama nan wuri mai tsarki ne na sarki da kuma haikalin ƙasar.”
english: but don’t prophesy again any more at Bethel; for it is the king’s sanctuary, and it is a royal house!”

hausa: Amma manyan firistoci suka zuga taron su sa a saki Barabbas, a maimakon Yesu.
english: But the chief priests stirred up the multitude, that he should release Barabbas to them instead.

hausa: “ ‘To, ga doka saboda Banazare sa’ad da kwanakin keɓewarsa suka gama. Za a kawo shi a bakin ƙofar Tentin Sujada.
english: “‘This is the law of the Nazirite: when the days of his separation are fulfilled, he shall be brought to the door of the Tent of Meeting,

hausa: Haka fuskokinsu suka kasance. Fikafikansu sun buɗu sama; kowanne yana da fikafikai biyu, ɗaya yana taɓa fikafikan ɗayan halittar a ɗayan gefe, fikafikai biyu kuma suna rufe jikinsa.
english: Such were their faces. Their wings were spread out above. Two wings of each one touched another, and two covered their bodies.

hausa: Ya kawar da dawakan nan da sarakunan Yahuda suka keɓe wa gumakan nan na rana daga mashigin haikalin Ubangiji. Waɗannan dawakan suna kusa da ɗakin Natan Melek, ɗaya daga cikin dattawan sarki. Yosiya ya kuma ƙone kekunan yaƙi a yin sujada ga gumakan nan rana.
english: He took away the horses that the kings of Judah had dedicated to the sun, at the entrance of Yahweh’s house, by the room of Nathan Melech the officer who was in the court; and he burned the chariots of the sun with fire.

hausa: Ko akwai wanda zai iya kama ta ba ta kallo, ko kuma a kama ta da tarko a huda hancinta?
english: Shall any take him when he is on the watch, or pierce through his nose with a snare?

hausa: Ka ce wa Allah, ‘Abin da na gaskata ba laifi ba ne kuma ni mai tsabta ne a gabanka.’
english: For you say, ‘My doctrine is pure. I am clean in your eyes.’

hausa: Ka tsage sammanka, ya Ubangiji, ka sauko; ka taɓa duwatsu, domin su yi hayaƙi.
english: Part your heavens, Yahweh, and come down. Touch the mountains, and they will smoke.

hausa: Muna da ƙanuwa, nonanta ba su riga sun yi girma ba. Me za mu yi da ƙanuwarmu a ranar da za a yi maganar sonta?
english: We have a little sister. She has no breasts. What shall we do for our sister in the day when she is to be spoken for?

hausa: Wannan maganata zo wa Irmiya game da dukan Yahudawa masu zama a Masar ta Ƙasa, a Migdol, Tafanes da Memfis, da kuma a Masar ta Bisa.
english: The word that came to Jeremiah concerning all the Jews who lived in the land of Egypt, who lived at Migdol, and at Tahpanhes, and at Memphis, and in the country of Pathros, saying,

hausa: Amma ya ce, ba za ka ga fuskata ba, don ba mutumin da zai gan ni yă rayu.”
english: He said, “You cannot see my face, for man may not see me and live.”

hausa: Ya ce, “Ku sāke yin haka,” sai suka sāke yin haka. Ya umarta, “Ku yi haka sau na uku,” suka kuma yi haka sau na uku.
english: He said, “Do it a second time;” and they did it the second time. He said, “Do it a third time;” and they did it the third time.

hausa: Saboda haka Rut ta tsaya kusa da bayi mata na Bowaz don tă yi kala sai da girbin sha’ir da na alkama suka ƙare. Ta kuwa zauna tare da surukarta.
english: So she stayed close to the maidens of Boaz, to glean to the end of barley harvest and of wheat harvest; and she lived with her mother-in-law.

hausa: da yatsarsa na dama zai yayyafa man daga tafinsa sau bakwai a gaban Ubangiji.
english: and the priest shall sprinkle with his right finger some of the oil that is in his left hand seven times before Yahweh.

hausa: Bari maɓulɓulanka ya zama mai albarka, bari kuma ka yi farin ciki da matar ƙuruciyarka.
english: Let your spring be blessed. Rejoice in the wife of your youth.

hausa: saboda kuma ina lura da dukan farillanka da kyau, na ƙi kowace hanyar da ba daidai ba.
english: Therefore I consider all of your precepts to be right. I hate every false way. PE

hausa: Shi da mutanensa suka ji tsoron wannan sosai, gama Gibeyon muhimmiyar birni ce, har ma kamar ɗaya daga cikin biranen sarauta, ya ma fi Ai girma, mazanta duka kuwa mayaƙa ne na ƙwarai.
english: they were very afraid, because Gibeon was a great city, as one of the royal cities, and because it was greater than Ai, and all its men were mighty.

hausa: Saboda haka Haruna da ’ya’yansa maza suka yi kome da Ubangiji ya umarta ta wurin Musa.
english: Aaron and his sons did all the things which Yahweh commanded by Moses.

hausa: Zai fadada mulkinsa har zuwa ƙasashe masu yawa; Masar ma ba za tă tsira ba.
english: He will also stretch out his hand on the countries. The land of Egypt won’t escape.

hausa: Amma zuciyar Hezekiya ta yi girman kai, bai kuwa yi amfani da alherin da aka nuna masa ba, saboda haka fushin Ubangiji ya sauko a kansa da kuma a kan Yahuda da Urushalima.
english: But Hezekiah didn’t reciprocate appropriate to the benefit done for him, because his heart was lifted up. Therefore there was wrath on him, Judah, and Jerusalem.

hausa: Ka cece mu, Ubangiji Allahnmu, ka kuma tattara mu daga al’ummai, don mu yi wa sunanka mai tsarki godiya mu kuma ɗaukaka cikin yabonka.
english: Save us, Yahweh, our God, gather us from among the nations, to give thanks to your holy name, to triumph in your praise!

hausa: Kaitonsu, domin sun kauce daga gare ni! Hallaka za tă aukar musu, domin sun tayar mini! Na ƙudura in cece su amma suna faɗar ƙarya a kaina.
english: Woe to them! For they have wandered from me. Destruction to them! For they have trespassed against me. Though I would redeem them, yet they have spoken lies against me.

hausa: gama za a tura waɗannan biyu zuwa hallaka nan da nan, kuma wa ya sani irin bala’in da za su iya kawowa?
english: for their calamity will rise suddenly. Who knows what destruction may come from them both?

hausa: za a kashe mazaunan filin ƙasar da takobi. Ta haka za su san cewa ni ne Ubangiji.
english: Her daughters who are in the field will be slain with the sword. Then they will know that I am Yahweh.’

hausa: Kukan yi ƙyashin gonaki ku kuma ƙwace su, ku yi ƙyashin gidaje ku kuma ƙwace. Kukan zalunci mutum, ku ƙwace masa gidansa, har ku ƙwace masa gādonsa.
english: They covet fields and seize them, and houses, then take them away. They oppress a man and his house, even a man and his heritage.

hausa: An gicciye ’yan fashi biyu tare da shi, ɗaya a damansa, ɗaya kuma a hagunsa.
english: Then there were two robbers crucified with him, one on his right hand and one on the left.

hausa: Sai Allah ya ce, “Ka ɗauki ɗanka, makaɗaicin ɗanka Ishaku, wanda kake ƙauna, ka tafi yankin Moriya, ka miƙa shi hadaya ta ƙonawa a can a kan ɗaya daga cikin duwatsun da zan nuna maka.”
english: He said, “Now take your son, your only son, Isaac, whom you love, and go into the land of Moriah. Offer him there as a burnt offering on one of the mountains which I will tell you of.”

hausa: Waƙar haurawa. Ta Dawuda. Zuciyata ba mai girman kai ba ce, ya Ubangiji, idanuna ba sa fariya; ban dami kaina da manyan al’amura ba ko abubuwan da suka sha ƙarfina.
english: A Song of Ascents. By David. Yahweh, my heart isn’t arrogant, nor my eyes lofty; nor do I concern myself with great matters, or things too wonderful for me.

hausa: Amma Ubangiji ya ce wa Musa da Haruna. “Tun da yake ba ku gaskata ni ba, ba ku kuwa ɗaukaka ni a idon Isra’ilawa ba, to, ba za ku kai taron jama’an nan a ƙasar da na ba su ba.”
english: Yahweh said to Moses and Aaron, “Because you didn’t believe in me, to sanctify me in the eyes of the children of Israel, therefore you shall not bring this assembly into the land which I have given them.”

hausa: Kwana bakwai za ka yi kafara saboda bagaden, ka kuma tsarkake shi. Sa’an nan bagaden zai zama mafi tsarki, kuma duk abin da ya taɓa bagaden zai tsarkaka.
english: Seven days you shall make atonement for the altar, and sanctify it; and the altar shall be most holy. Whatever touches the altar shall be holy.

hausa: A maimakon haka, na miƙa kaina ga aiki a kan wannan katanga. Na tattara dukan mutanena a can don aikin; ba mu samar wa kanmu wata gona ba.
english: Yes, I also continued in the work of this wall. We didn’t buy any land. All my servants were gathered there to the work.

hausa: Duk wanda ya ci naman jikina ya kuma sha jinina, yana cikina, ni kuma ina cikinsa.
english: He who eats my flesh and drinks my blood lives in me, and I in him.

hausa: Sa’ad da babu tekuna, aka haife ni, sa’ad da babu maɓulɓulai masu ruwa;
english: When there were no depths, I was born, when there were no springs abounding with water.

hausa: Tsayinki ya yi kamar itacen dabino, kuma nonanki sun yi kamar ’ya’yan itace.
english: This, your stature, is like a palm tree, your breasts like its fruit.

hausa: “Yanzu fa, ’ya’yana, ku saurare ni; masu albarka ne waɗanda suke kiyaye hanyoyina.
english: “Now therefore, my sons, listen to me, for blessed are those who keep my ways.

hausa: “Alkawarina da shi, alkawari ne na rai da salama, wanda na ba shi; domin yă girmama ni, ya kuwa girmama ni, ya kuma ji tsoron sunana ƙwarai.
english: “My covenant was with him of life and peace; and I gave them to him that he might be reverent toward me; and he was reverent toward me, and stood in awe of my name.

hausa: Dukan mutane suka tashi kamar mutum ɗaya, suna cewa “Ba waninmu da zai tafi gida. Sam, babu ko ɗayanmu da zai koma gidansa.
english: All the people arose as one man, saying, “None of us will go to his tent, neither will any of us turn to his house.

hausa: Ana nan, sai aka sāke yin wani yaƙin da Filistiyawa, a Gob. A lokacin Sibbekai mutumin Husha ya kashe Saf, wani daga zuriyar Rafa.
english: After this, there was again war with the Philistines at Gob. Then Sibbecai the Hushathite killed Saph, who was of the sons of the giant.

hausa: Filistiyawa suka haura suka yi sansani a Yahuda, suka bazu kusa da Lehi.
