english: Then the Philistines went up, encamped in Judah, and spread themselves in Lehi.

hausa: Sai maganar Ubangiji ta zo mini cewa,
english: Moreover Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

hausa: Sai Shawulu ya ce wa dukan Isra’ilawa, “Ku tsaya a can, ni kuma da Yonatan ɗana mu tsaya a nan.” Mutanen suka ce, “Ka yi abin da ya fi maka kyau.”
english: Then he said to all Israel, “You be on one side, and I and Jonathan my son will be on the other side.” The people said to Saul, “Do what seems good to you.”

hausa: Wannan ya zama sananne ko’ina a Yoffa, mutane da yawa kuma suka gaskata da Ubangiji.
english: This became known throughout all Joppa, and many believed in the Lord.

hausa: wato, Allah yă kashe ni, yă miƙa hannunsa yă yanke raina!
english: even that it would please God to crush me; that he would let loose his hand, and cut me off!

hausa: Ana cikin haka sai Yahuda ya aika da ɗan akuya ta hannun abokinsa mutumin Adullam don yă karɓo masa jinginar daga wurin macen, amma bai same ta a can ba.
english: Judah sent the young goat by the hand of his friend, the Adullamite, to receive the pledge from the woman’s hand, but he didn’t find her.

hausa: Ba na iya ganinsa lokacin da ya wuce ni; ba na sani ya wuce lokacin da ya wuce.
english: Behold, he goes by me, and I don’t see him. He passes on also, but I don’t perceive him.

hausa: Yaron nan Sama’ila ya dinga girma cikin kwarjini da cikin tagomashi a gaba Ubangiji da mutane.
english: The child Samuel grew on, and increased in favor both with Yahweh and also with men.

hausa: Amma saboda taurinkanka da zuciyarka marar tuba, kana tara wa kanka fushi a ranar fushin Allah, sa’ad da za a bayyana hukuncinsa mai adalci.
english: But according to your hardness and unrepentant heart you are treasuring up for yourself wrath in the day of wrath, revelation, and of the righteous judgment of God,

hausa: Sararin sama kuwa ya janye kamar naɗaɗɗen littafi, ya yi ta naɗewa, aka kuma kawar da kowane dutse da kowane tsibiri daga wurinsa.
english: The sky was removed like a scroll when it is rolled up. Every mountain and island was moved out of its place.

hausa: tsuntsayen sararin sama da kifin teku, da dukan abin da yake yawo a ƙarƙashin ruwan teku.
english: the birds of the sky, the fish of the sea, and whatever passes through the paths of the seas.

hausa: da ƙaramin bijimi guda ɗaya, tunkiya ɗaya, da rago, dukansu bana ɗaya-ɗaya domin hadaya ta ƙonawa;
english: one young bull, one ram, one male lamb a year old, for a burnt offering;

hausa: a kan zunubi, domin mutane ba su gaskata da ni ba;
english: about sin, because they don’t believe in me;

hausa: “Mu da muke Yahudawa ta wurin haihuwa ba Al’ummai masu zunubi ba,
english: “We, being Jews by nature and not Gentile sinners,

hausa: Suka tashi daga Elim, suka yi sansani kusa da Jan Teku.
english: They traveled from Elim, and encamped by the Red Sea.

hausa: Kwanakin marasa zarge suna sane ga Ubangiji, kuma gādonsu zai dawwama har abada.
english: Yahweh knows the days of the perfect. Their inheritance shall be forever.

hausa: Sa’ad da bawan mutumin Allah ya farka ya kuma fita kashegari da sassafe, sai ga mayaƙa tare da dawakai da kekunan yaƙi sun kewaye birni. Sai bawan ya ce, “Ranka yă daɗe! Me za mu yi?”
english: When the servant of the man of God had risen early and gone out, behold, an army with horses and chariots was around the city. His servant said to him, “Alas, my master! What shall we do?”

hausa: “Ɗan mutum, ka kafa idonka a kan duwatsun Isra’ila; ka yi annabci a kansu
english: “Son of man, set your face toward the mountains of Israel, and prophesy to them,

hausa: saboda daga fitowar rana har zuwa fāɗuwarta mutane za su san cewa babu wani in ban da ni. Ni ne Ubangiji, kuma babu wani.
english: that they may know from the rising of the sun, and from the west, that there is no one besides me. I am Yahweh, and there is no one else.

hausa: Bai dace da wawa ya yi rayuwa cikin jin daɗi ba, haka ya fi muni bawa ya yi mulki a kan sarki!
english: Delicate living is not appropriate for a fool, much less for a servant to have rule over princes.

hausa: Sai ya ruga wajen Eli ya ce, “Ga ni, gama ka kira ni.” Eli ya ce, “Ɗana ban kira ba, je ka kwanta”. Saboda haka ya tafi ya kwanta.
english: He ran to Eli and said, “Here I am; for you called me.” He said, “I didn’t call. Lie down again.” He went and lay down.

hausa: Sai Elisha ya koma Gilgal, a can kuwa ana yunwa a yankin. Yayinda ƙungiyar annabawa suke tattaunawa da shi, sai ya ce wa Gehazi bawansa, “Ka sa babban tukunya a wuta, ka yi wa mutanen nan fate.”
english: Elisha came again to Gilgal. There was a famine in the land; and the sons of the prophets were sitting before him; and he said to his servant, “Get the large pot, and boil stew for the sons of the prophets.”

hausa: Ku sa tsummoki, ya firistoci, ku yi makoki; ku yi ihu, ku da kuke yin hidima a gaban bagade. Zo, ku kwana saye da tsummoki, ku waɗanda kuke yi wa Allahna hidima, gama an yanke hadayun hatsi da hadayun sha daga gidan Allahnku.
english: Put on sackcloth and mourn, you priests! Wail, you ministers of the altar. Come, lie all night in sackcloth, you ministers of my God, for the meal offering and the drink offering are withheld from your God’s house.

hausa: Ka yi mini jinƙai, ya Ubangiji, gama ina cikin damuwa; idanuna sun gaji da baƙin ciki, raina da jikina sun tafke tilis.
english: Have mercy on me, Yahweh, for I am in distress. My eye, my soul, and my body waste away with grief.

hausa: Bari Allah yă auna a kan ma’auni na gaskiya zai kuma san cewa ni marar laifi ne.
english: (let me be weighed in an even balance, that God may know my integrity);

hausa: I, ga abin da Ubangiji Maɗaukaki yana cewa, “Zan aika da takobi, yunwa da annoba a kansu zan kuma sa su zama kamar ɓaure marar amfani da suka yi munin da ba a iya ci.
english: Yahweh of Armies says: “Behold, I will send on them the sword, the famine, and the pestilence, and will make them like rotten figs that can’t be eaten, they are so bad.

hausa: lokacin da fitilarsa take haske a kaina na yi tafiya cikin duhu tare da haskensa.
english: when his lamp shone on my head, and by his light I walked through darkness,

hausa: ta wurin sani aka rarraba zurfafa, gizagizai kuma suka zubo raɓa.
english: By his knowledge, the depths were broken up, and the skies drop down the dew.

hausa: “Saboda haka na sa a rena ku, a kuma wulaƙanta ku a gaban dukan mutane, domin ba ku bi hanyoyina ba amma kuka nuna sonkai a al’amuran shari’a.”
english: “Therefore I have also made you contemptible and wicked before all the people, according to the way you have not kept my ways, but have had respect for persons in the law.

hausa: ’Ya’yan Ruben maza ɗan farin Isra’ila (shi ne ɗan fari, amma sa’ad da ya ƙazantar da gadon auren mahaifinsa, sai aka ba wa ’yancin ɗan farinsa wa ’ya’yan Yusuf maza ɗan Isra’ila; don kada a lissafta shi a tarihin zuriya bisa ga matsayin haihuwarsa,
english: The sons of Reuben the firstborn of Israel (for he was the firstborn, but because he defiled his father’s couch, his birthright was given to the sons of Joseph the son of Israel; and the genealogy is not to be listed according to the birthright.

hausa: Sa’an nan Fir’auna ya ce, “Ga shi mutane sun yi yawa a ƙasar Masar, ku kuma yanzu kuna so ku hana su yin aiki.”
english: Pharaoh said, “Behold, the people of the land are now many, and you make them rest from their burdens.”

hausa: Amma Istifanus, cike da Ruhu Mai Tsarki, ya dubi sama ya kuma ga ɗaukakar Allah, da Yesu kuma tsaye a hannun dama na Allah.
english: But he, being full of the Holy Spirit, looked up steadfastly into heaven and saw the glory of God, and Jesus standing on the right hand of God,

hausa: Ko da sun ɓuya a bisa Karmel, a can zan farauce su in cafko. Ko da sun ɓuya can ƙarƙashin teku, a can zan umarci maciji yă sare su.
english: Though they hide themselves in the top of Carmel, I will search and take them out from there; and though they be hidden from my sight in the bottom of the sea, there I will command the serpent, and it will bite them.

hausa: “Ka yi wa Haruna da ’ya’yansa maza duk abin da na umarce ka, ka ɗauki kwana bakwai don naɗinsu.
english: “You shall do so to Aaron and to his sons, according to all that I have commanded you. You shall consecrate them seven days.

hausa: Natan ya amsa wa Dawuda ya ce, “Duk abin da kake tunani a zuciya, ka yi, gama Allah yana tare da kai.”
english: Nathan said to David, “Do all that is in your heart; for God is with you.”

hausa: Masu arziki ba za su bayar fiye da rabin shekel ba, talakawa kuma ba za su bayar ƙasa da haka ba, sa’ad da za ku yi hadaya ga Ubangiji don kafara rayukanku.
english: The rich shall not give more, and the poor shall not give less, than the half shekel, when they give the offering of Yahweh, to make atonement for your souls.

hausa: Ba mu ƙi nuna muku ƙaunarmu ba, sai dai ku kuka ƙi nuna mana.
english: You are not restricted by us, but you are restricted by your own affections.

hausa: “Zan ba da Zedekiya sarkin Yahuda da fadawansa ga abokan gābansu waɗanda suke neman ransu, ga sojojin sarkin Babilon, waɗanda suke janye daga gare ku.
english: “I will give Zedekiah king of Judah and his princes into the hands of their enemies, into the hands of those who seek their life and into the hands of the king of Babylon’s army, who has gone away from you.

hausa: Wannan shi ne Benahiya wanda yake ɗaya daga cikin jarumawa Talatin nan kuma shi ne yake babba a cikin Talatin ɗin. Ɗansa Ammizabad ne yake lura da sashensa.
english: This is that Benaiah who was the mighty man of the thirty and over the thirty. Of his division was Ammizabad his son.

hausa: (Yana nufin Yahuda, ɗan Siman Iskariyot, wanda, ko da yake ɗaya ne cikin Sha Biyun, zai bashe shi daga baya.)
english: Now he spoke of Judas, the son of Simon Iscariot, for it was he who would betray him, being one of the twelve.

hausa: Kada ku ci nama ɗanye, ko kuma dafaffe, amma a gasa shi, da kan, da ƙafafun, da kuma kayan cikin.
english: Don’t eat it raw, nor boiled at all with water, but roasted with fire; with its head, its legs and its inner parts.

hausa: ya kuma kawo kwanon zinariya ɗaya mai nauyin shekel, goma cike da turaren hayaƙi;
english: one golden ladle of ten shekels, full of incense;

hausa: Filistiyawa suka matsa sosai suna bin Shawulu da ’ya’yansa maza, suka kuma kashe ’ya’yansa maza Yonatan, Abinadab da Malki-Shuwa.
english: The Philistines followed hard after Saul and after his sons; and the Philistines killed Jonathan, Abinadab, and Malchishua, the sons of Saul.

hausa: hankalina ya tashi saboda yawan surutan masu ƙina, saboda danniyar mugaye. Gama sukan jawo mini wahala, suna jin haushina suna ƙina.
english: because of the voice of the enemy, because of the oppression of the wicked. For they bring suffering on me. In anger they hold a grudge against me.

hausa: Sa’ad da suka ga ’ya’yansu a tsakiyarsu, aikin hannuwansu, za su kiyaye sunana da tsarki; za su san tsarkin Mai Tsarkin nan na Yaƙub, za su kuma ji tsoron Allah na Isra’ila.
english: But when he sees his children, the work of my hands, in the middle of him, they will sanctify my name. Yes, they will sanctify the Holy One of Jacob, and will stand in awe of the God of Israel.

hausa: Ka ce kana da dabara da kuma ƙarfin mayaƙa, amma kana magana banza ce kawai. Ga wa ka dogara, da kake tayar mini?
english: I say that your counsel and strength for the war are only vain words. Now in whom do you trust, that you have rebelled against me?

hausa: na Magbish 156
english: The children of Magbish, one hundred fifty-six.

hausa: Amma muka washe, muka kuma kwasa shanu da kuma ganima daga biranen wa kanmu.
english: Only the livestock we took for plunder for ourselves, with the plunder of the cities which we had taken.

hausa: Suna matse zaitun a cikin kunyoyi suna kuma matse ruwan inabi daga ’ya’yan inabi, duk da haka suna fama da ƙishi.
english: They make oil within the walls of these men. They tread wine presses, and suffer thirst.

hausa: Abram ya gaskata, Ubangiji kuma ya lasafta shi adalci ga Abram.
english: He believed in Yahweh, who credited it to him for righteousness.

hausa: Kana so ka kashe ni kamar yadda ka kashe mutumin Masar nan na jiya?’
english: Do you want to kill me as you killed the Egyptian yesterday?’

hausa: “Akwai abubuwa uku da duniya kan yi rawan jiki, abubuwa huɗu da ba ta iya jurewa,
english: “For three things the earth trembles, and under four, it can’t bear up:

hausa: Bayan sun tafi, sai mala’ikan Ubangiji ya bayyana ga Yusuf a mafarki ya ce, “Tashi, ka ɗauki yaron da mahaifiyarsa, ku gudu zuwa Masar. Ku zauna a can sai na gaya muku, gama Hiridus zai nemi yaron don yă kashe.”
english: Now when they had departed, behold, an angel of the Lord appeared to Joseph in a dream, saying, “Arise and take the young child and his mother, and flee into Egypt, and stay there until I tell you, for Herod will seek the young child to destroy him.”

hausa: Ku kuma yi farin ciki a gaban Ubangiji Allahnku a wurin da ya zaɓa a matsayin mazauni don Sunansa, da ku da ’ya’yanku maza da mata, da bayinku maza da mata, da Lawiyawan cikin biranenku, har ma da baƙi, da marayu, da kuma gwaurayen da suke zama a cikinku.
english: You shall rejoice before Yahweh your God: you, your son, your daughter, your male servant, your female servant, the Levite who is within your gates, the foreigner, the fatherless, and the widow who are among you, in the place which Yahweh your God shall choose to cause his name to dwell there.

hausa: Wannan shi ne gādon da aka ba wa kabilar Manasse, a matsayin ɗan farin Yusuf. Manasse yana da ɗan farin mai suna Makir. Makir shi ne mahaifin mutanen Gileyad, aka ba shi Gileyad da Bashan gama Makiriyawa jarumai ne ƙwarai.
english: This was the lot for the tribe of Manasseh, for he was the firstborn of Joseph. As for Machir the firstborn of Manasseh, the father of Gilead, because he was a man of war, therefore he had Gilead and Bashan.

hausa: Sa’ad da kika gina ɗakunan samanki a kowane gefen titi kika kuma gina ɗakunan tsafinki a kowane dandali, ba kamar karuwa kike ba, domin kin karɓi kuɗi.
english: in that you build your vaulted place at the head of every way, and make your lofty place in every street, and have not been as a prostitute, in that you scorn pay.

hausa: Aka rufe duwatsu da inuwarsa, manya-manyan itatuwan al’ul da rassansa.
english: The mountains were covered with its shadow. Its boughs were like God’s cedars.

hausa: Sai Ubangiji ya ce wa Musa, “Da a ce mahaifinta ne ya tofa mata miyau a fuskarta, ashe, ba za tă ji kunya har kwana bakwai ba? A fitar da ita bayan sansani kwana bakwai; bayan haka za a iya dawo da ita.”
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “If her father had but spit in her face, shouldn’t she be ashamed seven days? Let her be shut up outside of the camp seven days, and after that she shall be brought in again.”

hausa: ’Ya’yanku za su zama makiyaya a nan, shekaru arba’in suna shan wahala domin rashin amincinku, har sai mutum na ƙarshe a cikinku ya kwanta a hamada.
english: Your children shall be wanderers in the wilderness forty years, and shall bear your prostitution, until your dead bodies are consumed in the wilderness.

hausa: Wannan shi ne labarin Shem. Shekara biyu bayan ambaliya, sa’ad da Shem ya yi shekara 100, sai ya haifi Arfakshad.
english: This is the history of the generations of Shem: Shem was one hundred years old when he became the father of Arpachshad two years after the flood.

hausa: Ko da an sāke shuka ta, za tă yi amfani ne? Ba za tă bushe gaba ɗaya sa’ad da iskar gabas ta hura ba, tă bushe a ƙasar da ta yi girma?’ ”
english: Yes, behold, being planted, will it prosper? Won’t it utterly wither when the east wind touches it? It will wither in the ground where it grew.”’”

hausa: “Akwai abubuwa uku da suke ba ni mamaki, abubuwa huɗu da ba na iya fahimtarsu,
english: “There are three things which are too amazing for me, four which I don’t understand:

hausa: Amma Musa ya ce wa Ubangiji, “In Isra’ilawa ba su ji ni ba, yaya Fir’auna zai ji ni, da yake ina magana da ƙyar?”
english: Moses spoke before Yahweh, saying, “Behold, the children of Israel haven’t listened to me. How then shall Pharaoh listen to me, when I have uncircumcised lips?”

hausa: Mai zama a kursiyi a sama yana dariya; Ubangiji yana musu ba’a.
english: He who sits in the heavens will laugh. The Lord will have them in derision.

hausa: Zai dunƙule ka kamar ƙwallo ya jefa ka a cikin ƙasa mai girma. A can za ka mutu a can kuma kekunan yaƙinka masu daraja za su kasance, abin kunya kake ga gidan maigidanka!
english: He will surely wind you around and around, and throw you like a ball into a large country. There you will die, and there the chariots of your glory will be, you disgrace of your lord’s house.

hausa: Sai Yesu ya ce, “Ba don mutumin ko iyayensa sun yi zunubi ne ba, sai dai don a bayyana aikin Allah ne a rayuwarsa.
english: Jesus answered, “This man didn’t sin, nor did his parents, but that the works of God might be revealed in him.

hausa: Cikin dukan abubuwan da suka faru da mu, ka kasance mai adalci; ka yi aminci, yayinda mu kuwa muka aikata mugu.
english: However you are just in all that has come on us; for you have dealt truly, but we have done wickedly.

hausa: saboda haka Sarki Yoram ya koma zuwa Yezireyel don yă yi jinyar raunin da Arameyawa suka ji masa a Rama a yaƙinsa da Hazayel sarkin Aram. Sai Ahaziya ɗan Yehoram, sarkin Yahuda ya gangara zuwa Yezireyel yă dubi Yoram ɗan Ahab domin an yi masa rauni.
english: King Joram returned to be healed in Jezreel from the wounds which the Syrians had given him at Ramah, when he fought against Hazael king of Syria. Ahaziah the son of Jehoram, king of Judah, went down to see Joram the son of Ahab in Jezreel, because he was sick.

hausa: kamar maza da suke jiran maigidansu ya dawo daga bikin aure. Saboda duk lokacin da ya dawo ya ƙwanƙwasa ƙofa, a shirye suke su buɗe masa nan da nan.
english: Be like men watching for their lord when he returns from the wedding feast, that when he comes and knocks, they may immediately open to him.

hausa: Mala’ika na biyu ya busa ƙahonsa, sai ga wani abu kamar babban dutse mai cin wuta, aka jefa cikin teku. Kashi ɗaya bisa uku na teku ya zama jini,
english: The second angel sounded, and something like a great burning mountain was thrown into the sea. One third of the sea became blood,

hausa: La’ananniya ce ranar da aka haife ni! Kada ranar da mahaifiyata ta haife ni ta zama mai albarka!
english: Cursed is the day in which I was born. Don’t let the day in which my mother bore me be blessed.

hausa: amma Allah ya ce, ‘Kada ku ci daga ’ya’yan itacen da yake tsakiyar lambu, kada kuma ku taɓa shi, in ba haka ba kuwa za ku mutu.’ ”
english: but not the fruit of the tree which is in the middle of the garden. God has said, ‘You shall not eat of it. You shall not touch it, lest you die.’”

hausa: Da a ce na san inda zan same shi; da a ce zan iya zuwa wurin da yake zama!
english: Oh that I knew where I might find him! That I might come even to his seat!

hausa: Talakawa dai kamar shaƙar iska suke, Attajirai dai kamar shirim suke; in aka auna a ma’auni, su ba wani abu ba ne; dukansu dai kamar shaƙar iska ne kawai.
english: Surely men of low degree are just a breath, and men of high degree are a lie. In the balances they will go up. They are together lighter than a breath.

hausa: Ba Zadok da Abiyatar firistocin nan suna nan tare da kai ba? Ka gaya musu duk abin da ka ji a fadan sarki.
english: Don’t you have Zadok and Abiathar the priests there with you? Therefore whatever you hear out of the king’s house, tell it to Zadok and Abiathar the priests.

hausa: Kowace ’ya wadda ta ci gādon ƙasa, a kowace kabilar Isra’ilawa, dole tă auri wani cikin kabilar kakanninta, saboda kowane mutumin Isra’ila yă mallaki gādon kakanninsa.
english: Every daughter who possesses an inheritance in any tribe of the children of Israel shall be wife to one of the family of the tribe of her father, that the children of Israel may each possess the inheritance of his fathers.

hausa: Haka kuwa bayan Ibrahim ya jira da haƙuri, sai ya karɓi abin da aka yi alkawari.
english: Thus, having patiently endured, he obtained the promise.

hausa: “Maigidansa ya ce, ‘Kai ka yi riƙon birane biyar.’
english: “So he said to him, ‘And you are to be over five cities.’

hausa: Gaskiya nake gaya muku, za a gafarta duk zunubai da kuma saɓon mutane suka yi.
english: “Most certainly I tell you, all sins of the descendants of man will be forgiven, including their blasphemies with which they may blaspheme;

hausa: Kada ku ji tsoro, gama ina tare da ku; zan kawo yaranku daga gabas in kuma tattara ku daga yamma.
english: Don’t be afraid, for I am with you. I will bring your offspring from the east, and gather you from the west.

hausa: Suka ce, “In kai ne sarkin Yahudawa, ka ceci kanka mana.”
english: and saying, “If you are the King of the Jews, save yourself!”

hausa: Sai Shekaniya ɗan Yehiyel, daga zuriyar Elam ya ce wa Ezra, “Mun yi wa Allah rashin aminci ta wurin yin auratayya da maƙwabtanmu, amma duk da haka bai yashe mutanen Isra’ila ba.
english: Shecaniah the son of Jehiel, one of the sons of Elam, answered Ezra, “We have trespassed against our God, and have married foreign women of the peoples of the land. Yet now there is hope for Israel concerning this thing.

hausa: Suka yi ta neman Yesu, da suke a tsaitsaye a filin haikali kuwa suka dinga tambayar juna, suna cewa, “Me kuka gani? Anya, zai zo Bikin kuwa?”
english: Then they sought for Jesus and spoke with one another as they stood in the temple, “What do you think—that he isn’t coming to the feast at all?”

hausa: “ ‘In mutum ya yi jima’i da dabba, dole a kashe shi, dole kuma ku kashe dabbar.
english: “‘If a man lies with an animal, he shall surely be put to death; and you shall kill the animal.

hausa: Gat, Maresha, Zif,
english: Gath, Mareshah, Ziph,

hausa: Ga tarihin Nuhu. Nuhu mutum ne mai adalci, marar abin zargi a cikin mutanen zamaninsa, ya kuma yi tafiya tare da Allah.
english: This is the history of the generations of Noah: Noah was a righteous man, blameless among the people of his time. Noah walked with God.

hausa: “Saboda haka ku saurare ni, ku masu ganewa. Ko kaɗan Allah ba ya mugunta, Maɗaukaki ba ya kuskure.
english: “Therefore listen to me, you men of understanding: far be it from God, that he should do wickedness, from the Almighty, that he should commit iniquity.

hausa: wanda ba ya nuna sonkai ga ’ya’yan sarki kuma ba ya goyon bayan masu arziki a kan matalauta, gama dukansu shi ya yi su da hannuwansa.
english: He doesn’t respect the persons of princes, nor respect the rich more than the poor, for they all are the work of his hands.

hausa: Abner ya husata saboda abin da Ish-Boshet ya ce, sai ya ce, “Kana tsammani ni mai cin amana ne? Kana zato ni mai goyon bayan Yahuda ne? Tun farko na nuna aminci ga gidan babanka Shawulu, da ’yan’uwansa, da abokansa! Ban kuwa ba da kai a hannun Dawuda ba. Ga shi yanzu a kan mace za ka ga laifina?
english: Then Abner was very angry about Ishbosheth’s words, and said, “Am I a dog’s head that belongs to Judah? Today I show kindness to your father Saul’s house, to his brothers, and to his friends, and have not delivered you into the hand of David; and yet you charge me today with a fault concerning this woman!

hausa: Duk wanda ya fāɗi a kan dutsen nan, zai kakkarye. Amma duk wanda dutsen nan ya fāɗi a kansa, za a murƙushe shi.”
english: He who falls on this stone will be broken to pieces, but on whomever it will fall, it will scatter him as dust.”

hausa: Amma lokacin da aka tuge shukar daga wurin da take, wurin ba zai san da ita kuma ba, wurin zai ce, ‘Ban taɓa ganin ki ba.’
english: If he is destroyed from his place, then it will deny him, saying, ‘I have not seen you.’

hausa: Ɗan farin da ta haifa zai ɗauki sunan ɗan’uwan da ya rasu saboda kada sunansa yă ɓace daga Isra’ila.
english: It shall be that the firstborn whom she bears shall succeed in the name of his brother who is dead, that his name not be blotted out of Israel.

hausa: Haka ma, bari haskenku yă haskaka a gaban mutane, domin su ga ayyukanku masu kyau, su kuwa yabi Ubanku da yake cikin sama.
english: Even so, let your light shine before men, that they may see your good works and glorify your Father who is in heaven.

hausa: “Wane ne wannan mai tashi kamar Nilu, kamar koguna masu tafasar ruwaye?
english: “Who is this who rises up like the Nile, like rivers whose waters surge?

hausa: Amma kyautan nan dabam take da laifin nan. Gama in mutane da yawa sun mutu saboda laifin mutum ɗayan nan, to, ai, alherin Allah da kuma kyautan nan mai zuwa ta wurin alherin mutum ɗayan nan, Yesu Kiristi, ya shafi mutane da yawa!
english: But the free gift isn’t like the trespass. For if by the trespass of the one the many died, much more did the grace of God and the gift by the grace of the one man, Jesus Christ, abound to the many.

hausa: Sai Bitrus ya dawo hankalinsa ya ce, “Yanzu na sani ba shakka Ubangiji ne ya aiki mala’ikansa yă cece ni daga hannun Hiridus da kuma dukan mugun fatan Yahudawa.”
english: When Peter had come to himself, he said, “Now I truly know that the Lord has sent out his angel and delivered me out of the hand of Herod, and from everything the Jewish people were expecting.”

hausa: Yaƙub ya amsa ya ce, “Ka fara sayar mini da matsayinka na ɗan fari tukuna.”
english: Jacob said, “First, sell me your birthright.”

hausa: “Ya halicci ƙasa ta wurin ikonsa; ya kafa duniya ta wurin hikimarsa, ya kuma shimfiɗa sammai ta wurin fahiminsa.
english: “He has made the earth by his power. He has established the world by his wisdom. By his understanding he has stretched out the heavens.

hausa: Umarni na barin kututturen itacen da saiwoyinsa yana nufin cewa za a maido maka da mulkinka a lokacin da ka gane cewa Mai sama ne yake mulki.
english: Whereas it was commanded to leave the stump of the roots of the tree, your kingdom shall be sure to you after you know that Heaven rules.

hausa: Cikinsu kuwa akwai Himenayus da Alekzanda, waɗanda na miƙa ga Shaiɗan don su horo su bar yin saɓo.
english: of whom are Hymenaeus and Alexander, whom I delivered to Satan that they might be taught not to blaspheme.

hausa: Sai dukan shugabannin Isra’ila suka taru suka zo wurin Sama’ila a Rama.
english: Then all the elders of Israel gathered themselves together and came to Samuel to Ramah.

hausa: Ko da a ce za ku ci dukan sojojin Babiloniyawan da suke yaƙi da ku har raunana ne kawai aka bari a tentunansu, za su fito su ƙone wannan birni.”
english: For though you had struck the whole army of the Chaldeans who fight against you, and only wounded men remained among them, they would each rise up in his tent and burn this city with fire.’”

hausa: Bābān yana karanta wannan Nassin, “An ja shi kamar tunkiya zuwa mayanka, kuma kamar ɗan rago a hannun mai askin gashinsa yake shiru, haka kuwa bai buɗe bakinsa ba.
english: Now the passage of the Scripture which he was reading was this, “He was led as a sheep to the slaughter. As a lamb before his shearer is silent, so he doesn’t open his mouth.

hausa: Dukan hanyoyin mutum sukan yi kamar marar laifi ne gare shi, amma Ubangiji yakan auna manufofi.
english: All the ways of a man are clean in his own eyes, but Yahweh weighs the motives.

hausa: kuna kuwa cin gaba da riƙe maganar rai domin in yi taƙama a ranar Kiristi cewa ban yi gudu ko fama a banza ba.
english: holding up the word of life, that I may have something to boast in the day of Christ that I didn’t run in vain nor labor in vain.

hausa: Amma kamar yadda wanda ya kira ku yake mai tsarki, haka ku ma sai ku kasance masu tsarki cikin dukan abubuwan da kuke yi;
english: but just as he who called you is holy, you yourselves also be holy in all of your behavior,

hausa: Jikin matar ba nata ne kaɗai ba, amma na mijinta ne ma. Haka ma jikin mijin, ba na shi ne kaɗai ba, amma na matarsa ne ma.
english: The wife doesn’t have authority over her own body, but the husband does. Likewise also the husband doesn’t have authority over his own body, but the wife does.

hausa: “Duk da haka, daga baya, zan maido da wadatar Ammonawa,” in ji Ubangiji.
english: “But afterward I will reverse the captivity of the children of Ammon,” says Yahweh.

hausa: Ka raba abin hannunka ga mutum bakwai, I, har ma takwas, gama ba ka san bala’in da zai auko wa ƙasar ba.
english: Give a portion to seven, yes, even to eight; for you don’t know what evil will be on the earth.

hausa: Yanzu sai ku zaɓi mutum goma sha biyu daga kabilan Isra’ila, ɗaya daga kowace kabila.
english: Now therefore take twelve men out of the tribes of Israel, for every tribe a man.

hausa: Amma ku zaunar da waɗansu ’yan iska biyu ɗaura da shi, ku sa su ba da shaida cewa ya zagi Allah da sarki. Sa’an nan ku ɗauke shi ku jajjefe shi da dutse sai ya mutu.”
english: Set two men, wicked fellows, before him, and let them testify against him, saying, ‘You cursed God and the king!’ Then carry him out, and stone him to death.”

hausa: sai ya shiga jirgin ruwa tare da almajiransa, suka tafi yankin Dalmanuta.
english: Immediately he entered into the boat with his disciples and came into the region of Dalmanutha.

hausa: Duk wanda ya bi umarnai kan tsare ransa, amma duk wanda ya ƙi binsu zai mutu.
english: He who keeps the commandment keeps his soul, but he who is contemptuous in his ways shall die.

hausa: wadda aka rubuta cewa, “An ba da labari cikin al’ummai, kuma Geshem ya ce gaskiya ne, cewa kai da Yahudawa kun shirya tawaye, saboda haka kuke sāke ginin katangar. Ban da haka ma, bisa ga waɗannan rahotanni kana shirin zaman sarkinsu
english: in which was written, “It is reported among the nations, and Gashmu says it, that you and the Jews intend to rebel. Because of that, you are building the wall. You would be their king, according to these words.

hausa: Kada ka ji tsorona, ba abin da zai fi ƙarfinka.
english: Behold, my terror will not make you afraid, neither will my pressure be heavy on you.

hausa: Dukan zuriyar ma’aikatan haikali, da kuma bayin Solomon 392.
english: All the temple servants, and the children of Solomon’s servants, were three hundred ninety-two.

hausa: Sarkin Isra’ila ya amsa wa Yehoshafat, ya ce, “Akwai mutum guda har yanzu wanda ta wurinsa za mu iya nemi nufin Ubangiji, amma na ƙi jininsa domin bai taɓa yin annabci wani abu mai kyau game da ni ba, sai dai mummuna kullum. Shi ne Mikahiya ɗan Imla.” Yehoshafat ya ce, “Kada sarki ya ce haka.”
english: The king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, “There is yet one man by whom we may inquire of Yahweh, Micaiah the son of Imlah; but I hate him, for he does not prophesy good concerning me, but evil.” Jehoshaphat said, “Don’t let the king say so.”

hausa: “Har yaushe za ku kāre marasa adalci ku kuma goyi bayan mugaye? Sela
english: “How long will you judge unjustly, and show partiality to the wicked?” Selah.

hausa: Sai Ubangiji ya yi wa mala’ikan da ya yi magana da ni magana da kalmomi masu daɗi da kuma masu ta’azantarwa.
english: Yahweh answered the angel who talked with me with kind and comforting words.

hausa: Da yana magana da su sai Goliyat, jarumin nan Bafilistin daga Gat ya fito daga rundunar Filistiyawa, ya tā da murya kamar yadda ya saba. Dawuda kuwa ya ji shi.
english: As he talked with them, behold, the champion, the Philistine of Gath, Goliath by name, came up out of the ranks of the Philistines, and said the same words; and David heard them.

hausa: Barak ya ce, “In kika tafi tare da ni, zan tafi; amma in ba ki zo tare da ni ba, ba zan tafi ba.”
english: Barak said to her, “If you will go with me, then I will go; but if you will not go with me, I will not go.”

hausa: na ƙi jinin taron masu aikata mugunta na ƙi in zauna tare da mugaye.
english: I hate the assembly of evildoers, and will not sit with the wicked.

hausa: Dawuda ya yi faɗi game da shi cewa, “ ‘Kullum ina ganin Ubangiji a gabana. Gama yana a hannuna na dama, ba zan jijjigu ba.
english: For David says concerning him, ‘I saw the Lord always before my face, for he is on my right hand, that I should not be moved.

hausa: ’Ya’yan Merari su ne, Mali da Mushi. Ɗan Ya’aziya shi ne, Beno.
english: The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. The son of Jaaziah: Beno.

hausa: Wannan kuwa domin a tabbatar da sahihancin bangaskiyarku ne, wadda ta fi zinariya daraja nesa, ita zinariya kuwa, ko da yake mai ƙarewa ce, akan gwada ta da wuta, domin bangaskiyan nan taku ta jawo muku yabo da girma da ɗaukaka a bayyanar Yesu Kiristi.
english: that the proof of your faith, which is more precious than gold that perishes, even though it is tested by fire, may be found to result in praise, glory, and honor at the revelation of Jesus Christ—

hausa: Ba ku gane cewa duk abin da ya shiga baki yakan wuce ciki ne daga nan kuma yă fita daga jiki ba?
english: Don’t you understand that whatever goes into the mouth passes into the belly and then out of the body?

hausa: Ta wurin yin ƙuri’a aka raba wa kabilan nan tara da rabi, yadda Ubangiji ya umarta ta wurin Musa.
english: by the lot of their inheritance, as Yahweh commanded by Moses, for the nine tribes, and for the half-tribe.

hausa: Sai Amaziya firist na Betel ya aika da saƙo zuwa wurin Yerobowam sarkin Isra’ila. “Amos yana shirya maka maƙarƙashiya a tsakiyar Isra’ila. Ƙasar ba za tă iya ɗauka abubuwan da yake faɗi ba.
english: Then Amaziah the priest of Bethel sent to Jeroboam king of Israel, saying, “Amos has conspired against you in the middle of the house of Israel. The land is not able to bear all his words.

hausa: Amma sa’ad da Allah, wanda ya keɓe ni daga mahaifa ya kira ni ta wurin alherinsa, ya kuma gamshe shi
english: But when it was the good pleasure of God, who separated me from my mother’s womb and called me through his grace,

hausa: Sai annabin ya ce wa ’ya’yansa, “Ku yi wa jakina shimfiɗa.” Sai suka yi.
english: He said to his sons, saying, “Saddle the donkey for me,” and they saddled it.

hausa: fuskar Ubangiji yana gāba da waɗanda suke aikata mugunta, don yă sa a manta da su a duniya.
english: Yahweh’s face is against those who do evil, to cut off their memory from the earth.

hausa: Yana ba da shaidar abin da ya gani da kuma ya ji, duk da haka ba wanda ya yarda da shaidarsa.
english: What he has seen and heard, of that he testifies; and no one receives his witness.

hausa: Da malaman dokoki, waɗanda su ma Farisiyawa ne, suka ga yana ci tare da masu “zunubi” da masu karɓar haraji, sai suka tambayi almajiransa, suka ce, “Me ya sa yake ci tare da masu karɓar haraji da masu zunubi?”
english: The scribes and the Pharisees, when they saw that he was eating with the sinners and tax collectors, said to his disciples, “Why is it that he eats and drinks with tax collectors and sinners?”

hausa: Kamar abokin gāba, ya ɗana bakansa; hannun damansa na shirye. Kamar maƙiyi, ya kashe duk wanda idonsa ya ji daɗin gani; ya zuba fushinsa kamar wuta a kan tenti na Diyar Sihiyona.
english: He has bent his bow like an enemy. He has stood with his right hand as an adversary. He has killed all that were pleasant to the eye. In the tent of the daughter of Zion, he has poured out his wrath like fire.

hausa: Sojojin da ta yi hayarsu a cikinta suna kamar ’yan maruƙa masu kitse. Su ma za su juya su kuma gudu gaba ɗaya, ba za su iya tsayawa ba, gama ranar masifa tana zuwa a kansu, lokacin da za su sha hukunci.
english: Also her hired men in the middle of her are like calves of the stall, for they also are turned back. They have fled away together. They didn’t stand, for the day of their calamity has come on them, the time of their visitation.

hausa: Da ya sami Ammonawa da Amalekawa suka haɗa hannu tare, sai Eglon ya tafi ya auka wa Isra’ila, suka ƙwace Birnin Dabino.
english: He gathered the children of Ammon and Amalek to himself; and he went and struck Israel, and they possessed the city of palm trees.

hausa: “Bawan da ya san nufin maigidansa, kuma bai yi shiri ba, ko kuma bai yi abin da maigidansa yake so ba, zai sha mummunan duka.
english: That servant who knew his lord’s will, and didn’t prepare nor do what he wanted, will be beaten with many stripes,

hausa: Bari Allah yă ba ka da kuma zuriyarka albarkar da ya ba wa Ibrahim, don ka amshi ƙasar da kake baƙunci, ƙasar da Allah ya ba wa Ibrahim.”
english: and give you the blessing of Abraham, to you and to your offspring with you, that you may inherit the land where you travel, which God gave to Abraham.”

hausa: Sam ba za ku yi wani aiki ba. Wannan za tă zama dawwammamiyar farilla ce, wa tsararraki masu zuwa, a ko’ina kuke da zama.
english: You shall do no kind of work: it is a statute forever throughout your generations in all your dwellings.

hausa: ‘In na ce zan manta da abin da yake damu na, zan yi murmushi in daina nuna ɓacin rai,’
english: If I say, ‘I will forget my complaint, I will put off my sad face, and cheer up,’

hausa: Sa’ad da nake yaro, na yi magana kamar yaro, na yi tunani kamar yaro, na yanke shawara kamar yaro. Da na isa mutum kuwa, sai na bar halin yarantakata.
english: When I was a child, I spoke as a child, I felt as a child, I thought as a child. Now that I have become a man, I have put away childish things.

hausa: Gama mene ne begenmu, farin cikinmu, ko kuma rawanin da zai zama mana abin ɗaukaka a gaban Ubangijinmu Yesu sa’ad da ya dawo? Ba ku ba ne?
english: For what is our hope, or joy, or crown of rejoicing? Isn’t it even you, before our Lord Jesus at his coming?

hausa: Na yi barci amma zuciyata tana a farke. Ku saurara! Ƙaunataccena yana ƙwanƙwasa ƙofa. “Buɗe mini, ’yar’uwata, ƙaunatacciyata, kurciyata, marar laifina. Kaina ya jiƙe da raɓa, gashina ya yi danshin ɗiɗɗigar dare.”
english: I was asleep, but my heart was awake. It is the voice of my beloved who knocks: “Open to me, my sister, my love, my dove, my undefiled; for my head is filled with dew, and my hair with the dampness of the night.”

hausa: Amma mutanen ba su saurare shi ba. Saboda haka mutumin ya ba da ƙwarƙwaransa, suka yi mata fyaɗe suka yi lalata da ita dukan dare, gari yana wayewa sai suka bar ta.
english: But the men wouldn’t listen to him; so the man grabbed his concubine, and brought her out to them; and they had sex with her, and abused her all night until the morning. When the day began to dawn, they let her go.

hausa: Don me? Domin sun yi ƙwazo wajen binta ba ta wurin bangaskiya ba sai dai ta wurin ayyuka. Sun yi tuntuɓe a kan “dutsen sa tuntuɓe.”
english: Why? Because they didn’t seek it by faith, but as it were by works of the law. They stumbled over the stumbling stone,

hausa: Maganarka, ya Ubangiji madawwamiya ce; tana nan daram a cikin sammai.
english: Yahweh, your word is settled in heaven forever.

hausa: Kuma gaɓoɓin da muke tsammani ba su da martaba sosai, su ne mukan fi ba su girma. Sa’an nan gaɓoɓi marasa kyan gani, mun fi mai da hankali a kansu,
english: Those parts of the body which we think to be less honorable, on those we bestow more abundant honor; and our unpresentable parts have more abundant modesty,

hausa: Sa’an nan duk suka zo suka roƙi Dawuda yă ci wani abu tun rana ba tă fāɗi ba; amma Dawuda ya rantse ya ce, “Bari Allah yă hukunta ni, in na ɗanɗana abinci ko wani abu kafin rana ta fāɗi!”
english: All the people came to urge David to eat bread while it was yet day; but David swore, saying, “God do so to me, and more also, if I taste bread or anything else, until the sun goes down.”

hausa: daga mugaye waɗanda suke kai mini hari, daga abokan gāba masu mutuwa waɗanda suka kewaye ni.
english: from the wicked who oppress me, my deadly enemies, who surround me.

hausa: Waɗanda suke biyayya da umarnansa kuwa suna rayuwa a cikinsa, shi kuma a cikinsu. Ta haka muka san cewa yana raye a cikinmu. Mun san haka ta wurin Ruhun da ya ba mu.
english: He who keeps his commandments remains in him, and he in him. By this we know that he remains in us, by the Spirit which he gave us.

hausa: Ya zāna siffofin kerubobi, zakoki da itatuwan dabino a saman abubuwan riƙewa da kuma a kan ɓangarorin, a kowane abin da ya ga akwai ɗan fili, ya zāna furanni.
english: On the plates of its supports and on its panels, he engraved cherubim, lions, and palm trees, each in its space, with wreaths all around.

hausa: Kamar yadda yake a rubuce, “Ga shi, na sa dutse a Sihiyona da yake sa mutane yin tuntuɓe da kuma dutsen da yake sa su fāɗi wanda kuwa ya dogara gare shi ba zai taɓa shan kunya ba.”
english: even as it is written, “Behold, I lay in Zion a stumbling stone and a rock of offense; and no one who believes in him will be disappointed.”

hausa: Da suka shiga cikin birni, sai Ishmayel ɗan Netaniya da mutanen da suke tare da shi suka karkashe su suka zubar a rijiya.
english: It was so, when they came into the middle of the city, that Ishmael the son of Nethaniah killed them, and cast them into the middle of the pit, he, and the men who were with him.

hausa: Filistiyawa suka mayar wa Isra’ila da garuruwan da suka ƙwato, wato, daga Ekron zuwa Gat, dukan yankin ƙasarsu da yake ƙarƙashin ikon Filistiyawa. Aka kuma sami zaman lafiya tsakanin Isra’ilawa da Amoriyawa.
english: The cities which the Philistines had taken from Israel were restored to Israel, from Ekron even to Gath; and Israel recovered its border out of the hand of the Philistines. There was peace between Israel and the Amorites.

hausa: Solomon tare da dukan taron suka tafi masujadan kan tudu a Gibeyon, gama Tentin Sujadar Allah yana can, wanda Musa bawan Ubangiji ya yi a hamada.
english: Then Solomon, and all the assembly with him, went to the high place that was at Gibeon; for God’s Tent of Meeting was there, which Yahweh’s servant Moses had made in the wilderness.

hausa: muddin ina raye, in ji Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka, ko da waɗannan mutum uku suna cikinta, ba za su iya ceton ’ya’yansu maza ko mata ba. Su kaɗai za a iya ceto.
english: though these three men were in it, as I live,” says the Lord Yahweh, “they would deliver neither sons nor daughters, but they only would be delivered themselves.

hausa: Sa’ad da rana ta fāɗi, zai zama tsarkakakke, bayan wannan kuwa zai iya cin tsarkakakkun hadayu, gama abincinsa ne.
english: When the sun is down, he shall be clean; and afterward he shall eat of the holy things, because it is his bread.

hausa: Yusuf ya ce wa mutane, “Yanzu da na saye ku da kuma gonakinku a yau wa Fir’auna, ga iri don ku shuka a gonaki.
english: Then Joseph said to the people, “Behold, I have bought you and your land today for Pharaoh. Behold, here is seed for you, and you shall sow the land.

hausa: In ba ta da amfanin wani abu sa’ad da take cikakkiya, balle bayan da wuta ta babbake ta, za a iya yin amfani da ita?
english: Behold, when it was whole, it was suitable for no work. How much less, when the fire has devoured it, and it has been burned, will it yet be suitable for any work?”

hausa: Kwana bakwai za ku ci burodi marar yisti. A rana ta fari, za ku fid da yisti daga gidajenku gama duk wanda ya ci abu mai yisti daga rana ta fari har zuwa rana ta bakwai, za a fid da shi daga Isra’ila.
english: “‘Seven days you shall eat unleavened bread; even the first day you shall put away yeast out of your houses, for whoever eats leavened bread from the first day until the seventh day, that soul shall be cut off from Israel.

hausa: Dimna da kuma Nahalal, tare da wuraren kiwonsu, garuruwa huɗu ke nan;
english: Dimnah with its pasture lands, and Nahalal with its pasture lands: four cities.

hausa: wadda ta bar mijin ƙuruciyarta ta kuma ƙyale alkawarin da ta yi a gaban Allah.
english: who forsakes the friend of her youth, and forgets the covenant of her God;

hausa: Ya shimfiɗa arewancin sararin sama a sarari; ya rataye duniya ba a jikin wani abu ba.
english: He stretches out the north over empty space, and hangs the earth on nothing.

hausa: Ga abin da Ubangiji yana cewa, “Kada ku koyi hanyoyin al’ummai ko ku razana game da alamun sararin sama, ko da yake al’ummai sun razana saboda su.
english: Yahweh says, “Don’t learn the way of the nations, and don’t be dismayed at the signs of the sky; for the nations are dismayed at them.

hausa: Suka kawo kyautansu a gaban Ubangiji. Kyautayin kuwa su ne, kekunan yaƙi shida da aka rufe, da shanu goma sha biyu, saniya guda daga kowane shugaba, da kuma keken yaƙi guda daga shugabanni biyu. Suka miƙa waɗannan a gaban tabanakul.
english: and they brought their offering before Yahweh, six covered wagons and twelve oxen; a wagon for every two of the princes, and for each one an ox. They presented them before the tabernacle.

hausa: Sarki ya cika da sha’awar kyanki; ki girmama shi, gama shi ne maigidanki.
english: So the king will desire your beauty, honor him, for he is your lord.

hausa: Nan take, domin Hiridus bai yi wa Allah yabo ba, wani mala’ikan Ubangiji ya buge shi, tsutsotsi kuwa suka cinye shi ya kuma mutu.
english: Immediately an angel of the Lord struck him, because he didn’t give God the glory. Then he was eaten by worms and died.

hausa: Ishaku ya yi makyarkyata ƙwarai ya ce, “To, wane ne wannan da ya farauto nama ya kawo mini kafin ka zo, har na ci na kuma sa masa albarka? Tabbatacce zai zama mai albarka!”
english: Isaac trembled violently, and said, “Who, then, is he who has taken venison, and brought it to me, and I have eaten of all before you came, and have blessed him? Yes, he will be blessed.”

hausa: “Amma wannan shi ne abin da ka ɓoye a zuciyarka, na kuma san abin da yake cikin zuciyarka ke nan.
english: Yet you hid these things in your heart. I know that this is with you:

hausa: Yayinda kake kan hanyar zuwa kotu da maƙiyinka, ka yi matuƙar ƙoƙari ku shirya tun kuna kan hanya. In ba haka ba, zai kai ka gaban alƙali, alƙali kuma ya miƙa ka ga ɗan sanda, ɗan sanda kuma ya jefa ka a kurkuku.
english: For when you are going with your adversary before the magistrate, try diligently on the way to be released from him, lest perhaps he drag you to the judge, and the judge deliver you to the officer, and the officer throw you into prison.

hausa: “Ku ware kanku daga taron nan don in gama da su nan take.”
english: “Separate yourselves from among this congregation, that I may consume them in a moment!”

hausa: Gama ba za a ƙara ganin wahayin ƙarya ko a yi duba na daɗin baki a cikin mutanen Isra’ila ba.
english: For there will be no more any false vision nor flattering divination within the house of Israel.

hausa: domin kun yi biyayya da Ubangiji Allahnku, kuna kiyaye dukan umarnan da nake ba ku a yau, kuna kuma aikata abin da yake daidai a idanunsa.
english: when you listen to Yahweh your God’s voice, to keep all his commandments which I command you today, to do that which is right in Yahweh your God’s eyes.

hausa: “Mata da yawa suna yin abubuwan yabo, amma ke kin fi su duka.”
english: “Many women do noble things, but you excel them all.”

hausa: ɗan Shallum, ɗan Zadok, ɗan Ahitub,
english: the son of Shallum, the son of Zadok, the son of Ahitub,

hausa: Amma na haƙura na kuma kwantar da raina; kamar yaron da aka yaye tare da mahaifiyarsa, kamar yaron da aka yaye haka raina yake a cikina.
english: Surely I have stilled and quieted my soul, like a weaned child with his mother, like a weaned child is my soul within me.

hausa: Ɗan Affayim shi ne, Ishi, wanda shi ne mahaifin Sheshan. Sheshan shi ne mahaifin Alai.
english: The son of Appaim: Ishi. The son of Ishi: Sheshan. The son of Sheshan: Ahlai.

hausa: Mugayen mutane da masu ruɗi kuwa, ƙara muni za su riƙa yi, suna yaudara, ana kuma yaudararsu.
english: But evil men and impostors will grow worse and worse, deceiving and being deceived.

hausa: Allah ya ce, “Bari ruwa yă cika da halittu masu rai, bari tsuntsaye kuma su tashi sama a bisa duniya a sararin sama.”
english: God said, “Let the waters abound with living creatures, and let birds fly above the earth in the open expanse of the sky.”

hausa: Duk wanda ya ci nasara zan mai da shi ginshiƙi a haikalin Allahna. Ba kuwa zai sāke barin wurin ba. Zan rubuta a kansa sunan Allahna da kuma sunan birnin Allahna, sabuwar Urushalima, wadda take saukowa daga sama daga Allahna; ni kuma zan rubuta a kansa sabon sunana.
english: He who overcomes, I will make him a pillar in the temple of my God, and he will go out from there no more. I will write on him the name of my God and the name of the city of my God, the new Jerusalem, which comes down out of heaven from my God, and my own new name.

hausa: Zai yanka shi gunduwa-gunduwa, firist kuwa zai shirya su haɗe da kan, da kuma kitsen a kan itace mai cin wutar da yake a kan bagade.
english: He shall cut it into its pieces, with its head and its fat. The priest shall lay them in order on the wood that is on the fire which is on the altar,

hausa: Sai Ukun suka kutsa kai cikin sansanin Filistiyawa, suka ja ruwa daga rijiyar da take kusa da ƙofar Betlehem suka ɗauko shi suka kawo wa Dawuda. Amma ya ƙi yă sha; a maimako, sai ya zubar da shi a gaban Ubangiji.
english: The three broke through the army of the Philistines, and drew water out of the well of Bethlehem that was by the gate, took it, and brought it to David; but David would not drink any of it, but poured it out to Yahweh,

hausa: Ubangiji zai cece ni, za mu kuma rera da kayan kiɗi masu tsirkiya dukan kwanakinmu a cikin haikalin Ubangiji.
english: Yahweh will save me. Therefore we will sing my songs with stringed instruments all the days of our life in Yahweh’s house.

hausa: mun san cewa mutum ba ya samun kuɓuta ta wurin kiyaye Doka, sai dai ta wurin bangaskiya cikin Kiristi Yesu. Saboda haka, mu ma, muka sa bangaskiyarmu cikin Kiristi Yesu don mu sami kuɓuta ta wurin bangaskiya cikin Kiristi ba ta wurin kiyaye Doka ba, domin ba wanda zai kuɓuta ta wurin bin Doka.
english: yet knowing that a man is not justified by the works of the law but through faith in Jesus Christ, even we believed in Christ Jesus, that we might be justified by faith in Christ and not by the works of the law, because no flesh will be justified by the works of the law.

hausa: Ku ji gardamata yanzu; ku ji roƙon da zai fito daga bakina.
english: Hear now my reasoning. Listen to the pleadings of my lips.

hausa: Duk sa’ad da aka ɗaga girgijen daga Tentin, sai Isra’ilawa su kama hanya; duk inda girgijen ya tsaya, a nan Isra’ilawa za su yi sansani.
english: Whenever the cloud was taken up from over the Tent, then after that the children of Israel traveled; and in the place where the cloud remained, there the children of Israel encamped.

hausa: Kamar yadda yake a rubuce, “Ana saɓon sunan Allah a cikin Al’ummai saboda ku.”
english: For “the name of God is blasphemed among the Gentiles because of you,” just as it is written.

hausa: Tafi yanzu, ka rubuta musu a kan allo, ka rubuta shi a kan littafi, cewa kwanaki suna zuwa zai zama madawwamin shaida.
english: Now go, write it before them on a tablet, and inscribe it in a book, that it may be for the time to come forever and ever.

hausa: Sai ta tafi ta faɗa wa mutumin Allah. Shi kuwa ya ce mata, “Tafi, ki sayar da man, ki biya bashinki. Ki biya bukatanki da na ’ya’yanki da sauran da ya rage.”
english: Then she came and told the man of God. He said, “Go, sell the oil, and pay your debt; and you and your sons live on the rest.”

hausa: In muna rayuwa, muna rayuwa ne ga Ubangiji; in kuma muna mutuwa, muna mutuwa ne ga Ubangiji. Saboda haka, ko muna a raye ko muna a mace, mu na Ubangiji ne.
english: For if we live, we live to the Lord. Or if we die, we die to the Lord. If therefore we live or die, we are the Lord’s.

hausa: Ya tashi ya kuma albarkaci dukan taron Isra’ila da babbar murya, yana cewa,
english: He stood and blessed all the assembly of Israel with a loud voice, saying,

hausa: Idanunsu sun cike da zina, ba sa ƙoshi da yin zunubi; suna jarrabtar waɗanda ba tsayayyu ba; gwanaye ne a kan kwaɗayi, la’anannun iri!
english: having eyes full of adultery, and who can’t cease from sin, enticing unsettled souls, having a heart trained in greed, accursed children!

hausa: Dare ya huda ƙasusuwana; ina ta shan azaba ba hutawa.
english: In the night season my bones are pierced in me, and the pains that gnaw me take no rest.

hausa: Akwai waninku da zai iya haƙaƙƙewa na taɓa yin zunubi? In kuwa gaskiya na faɗa, me ya sa ba kwa gaskata ni?
english: Which of you convicts me of sin? If I tell the truth, why do you not believe me?

hausa: Ku yi biyayya da juna saboda bangirmar da kuke nuna wa Kiristi.
english: subjecting yourselves to one another in the fear of Christ.

hausa: Ya ɗaga tuta don al’ummai masu nisa, ya yi feɗuwa wa waɗanda suke a iyakar duniya. Ga shi sun iso, da sauri da kuma gaggawa!
english: He will lift up a banner to the nations from far away, and he will whistle for them from the end of the earth. Behold, they will come speedily and swiftly.

hausa: Sa’an nan zan miƙa ki ga kwartayenki, za su kuwa rurrushe ɗakunan samanki su kuma farfashe ɗakunan tsafinki. Za su tuɓe miki tufafinki su kuma kwashe kayan adonki masu kyau su bar ki tsirara tik.
english: I will also give you into their hand, and they will throw down your vaulted place, and break down your lofty places. They will strip you of your clothes and take your beautiful jewels. They will leave you naked and bare.

hausa: Waje da ƙofar ciki, a cikin filin ciki, akwai ɗakuna biyu, ɗaya a gefen ƙofar arewa yana kuma fuskantar kudu, wani kuma a gefen ƙofar kudu yana fuskantar arewa.
english: Outside of the inner gate were rooms for the singers in the inner court, which was at the side of the north gate. They faced toward the south. One at the side of the east gate faced toward the north.

hausa: Ya ji mini rauni a kai a kai ya auko mini kamar mai yaƙi.
english: He breaks me with breach on breach. He runs at me like a giant.

hausa: Saboda haka in na zo, zan tone abin da yake yi, yana surutu game da mu, yana ɓaɓɓata mu. Wannan ma bai ishe shi ba, har yana ƙin marabtar ’yan’uwa. Yana hana waɗanda suke so yin haka, yana ma korinsu daga ikkilisiya.
english: Therefore, if I come, I will call attention to his deeds which he does, unjustly accusing us with wicked words. Not content with this, he doesn’t receive the brothers himself, and those who would, he forbids and throws out of the assembly.

hausa: Mijina ba ya gida; ya yi tafiya mai nisa.
english: For my husband isn’t at home. He has gone on a long journey.

hausa: Yana da rashin jituwa da mutanen Taya da na Sidon; sai suka haɗa kai suka nemi ganawa da shi. Bayan suka sami goyon bayan Bilastus, amintaccen bawan sarki, sai suka nemi salama, domin sun dogara ga ƙasar sarkin don samun abincinsu.
english: Now Herod was very angry with the people of Tyre and Sidon. They came with one accord to him and, having made Blastus, the king’s personal aide, their friend, they asked for peace, because their country depended on the king’s country for food.

hausa: A wajen gumaka kusa da Gilgal, shi kansa ya juya ya koma ya ce, “Ranka yă daɗe, ina da saƙo na asiri dominka.” Sarkin ya ce, “Ku ba mu wuri!” Sai dukan fadawansa suka fita.
english: But he himself turned back from the stone idols that were by Gilgal, and said, “I have a secret message for you, O king.” The king said, “Keep silence!” All who stood by him left him.

hausa: Manyan firistoci da dukan ’yan Majalisa, suka shiga neman shaidar laifin da za a tabbatar a kan Yesu, domin su kashe shi. Amma ba su sami ko ɗaya ba.
english: Now the chief priests and the whole council sought witnesses against Jesus to put him to death, and found none.

hausa: “Mutum mai hikima zai amsa da surutai marasa kan gado ko yă cika cikinsa da iskar gabas?
english: “Should a wise man answer with vain knowledge, and fill himself with the east wind?

hausa: Ubangiji ya ce wa Musa, “Hauro wurina a kan dutse, ka tsaya a nan, zan ba ka allunan dutsen, da doka da umarnan da na rubuta don koyonsu.”
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “Come up to me on the mountain, and stay here, and I will give you the stone tablets with the law and the commands that I have written, that you may teach them.”

hausa: Za a ci Edom da yaƙi; za a ci Seyir, abokiyar gābanta, amma Isra’ila zai ƙara ƙarfi.
english: Edom shall be a possession. Seir, his enemy, also shall be a possession, while Israel does valiantly.

hausa: Duk wanda aka kama za a soke shi yă mutu; dukan waɗanda aka kama za su mutu ta takobi.
english: Everyone who is found will be thrust through. Everyone who is captured will fall by the sword.

hausa: Haka suka zazzauna a ƙungiyar ɗari-ɗari, da kuma hamsin-hamsin.
english: They sat down in ranks, by hundreds and by fifties.

hausa: Maigidan ya fita waje ya ce musu, “A’a, abokaina, kada ku yi abin kunyan nan. Da yake mutumin nan baƙona ne, kada ku yi rashin kunyan nan.
english: The man, the master of the house, went out to them, and said to them, “No, my brothers, please don’t act so wickedly; since this man has come into my house, don’t do this folly.

hausa: Saboda haka, in kuna da damuwa game da irin waɗannan al’amura, sai ku naɗa alƙalai ko cikin waɗanda ba kome ba ne a ikkilisiya!
english: If then you have to judge things pertaining to this life, do you set them to judge who are of no account in the assembly?

hausa: na iyalin Abiya, Zikri; na iyalin Miniyamin da na Mowadiya, Filtai;
english: of Abijah, Zichri; of Miniamin, of Moadiah, Piltai;

hausa: Ba da daɗewa ba mutanena sun tashi kamar magabci. Kun tuɓe riga mai tsada daga waɗanda suke wucewa ba tare da kun damu ba, sai ka ce mutanen da suke komowa daga yaƙi.
english: But lately my people have risen up as an enemy. You strip the robe and clothing from those who pass by without a care, returning from battle.

hausa: Daga zuriyar Elam, akwai Mattaniya, Zakariya, Yehiyel, Abdi, Yeremot, da Iliya.
english: Of the sons of Elam: Mattaniah, Zechariah, Jehiel, Abdi, Jeremoth, and Elijah.

hausa: Da suka fitar da su, sai ɗaya daga cikin mala’ikun ya ce, “Ku gudu domin ranku; kada ku duba baya, kada kuma ku tsaya ko’ina cikin kwarin! Ku gudu zuwa cikin duwatsu, don kada a hallaka ku!”
english: It came to pass, when they had taken them out, that he said, “Escape for your life! Don’t look behind you, and don’t stay anywhere in the plain. Escape to the mountains, lest you be consumed!”

hausa: Ashe, ba Mahaifi guda dukanmu muke da shi ba? Ba Allah ɗaya ne ya halicce mu ba? Don me muka keta alkawarin kakanninmu ta wurin cin amanar juna?
english: Don’t we all have one father? Hasn’t one God created us? Why do we deal treacherously every man against his brother, profaning the covenant of our fathers?

hausa: Gama na yi kishin masu girman kai sa’ad da na ga cin gaban da masu mugunta suke yi.
english: For I was envious of the arrogant, when I saw the prosperity of the wicked.

hausa: A maimakon haka, ya kamata mu rubuta musu cewa, su guji abincin da alloli suka ƙazantar, da fasikanci, da naman dabbar da aka murɗe da kuma jini.
english: but that we write to them that they abstain from the pollution of idols, from sexual immorality, from what is strangled, and from blood.

hausa: Mafi talauci na matalauta zai sami wurin kiwo, mabukata kuma za su kwana lafiya. Amma zan hallakar da saiwarka da matsananciyar yunwa; za tă kashe naka da suka rage da rai.
english: The firstborn of the poor will eat, and the needy will lie down in safety; and I will kill your root with famine, and your remnant will be killed.

hausa: Ɗakunanta, bangayenta da shirayinta duk girmansu iri ɗaya ne kamar sauran. Hanyar shiga da shirayinta suna da tagogi duk a kewaye. Tsawon hanyar shiga kamu hamsin ne, fāɗinta kuma kamu ashirin da biyar.
english: with its lodges, its posts, and its arches, according to these measurements. There were windows in it and in its arches all around. It was fifty cubits long, and twenty-five cubits wide.

hausa: Mala’ikan ya amsa mini ya ce, “Waɗannan su ne ruhohi huɗu na sama, waɗanda suka fito daga wurin Ubangiji na dukan duniya.
english: The angel answered me, “These are the four winds of the sky, which go out from standing before the Lord of all the earth.

hausa: Maƙiyin gaskiya zai iya yin mulki? Za ka iya ba mai gaskiya, Maɗaukaki laifi?
english: Should even one who hates justice govern? Will you condemn him who is righteous and mighty,

hausa: Sa’an nan Ubangiji ya ce wa Musa, “Ka je wurin Fir’auna, ka ce masa, ‘Ga abin da Ubangiji yana cewa, ka bar mutanena su tafi domin su yi mini sujada.
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, “Go in to Pharaoh, and tell him, ‘This is what Yahweh says, “Let my people go, that they may serve me.

hausa: Da sarki ya ji haka, sai ya damu sosai, ya ƙudura yă ceci Daniyel, ya yi ta fama har fāɗuwar rana yadda zai yi yă kuɓutar da shi.
english: Then the king, when he heard these words, was very displeased, and set his heart on Daniel to deliver him; and he labored until the going down of the sun to rescue him.

hausa: a sa’an nan ne mutanen Isra’ila za su juya su fāɗa wa mutane Benyamin da yaƙi. Mutanen Benyamin sun fara karkashe mutum talatin na Isra’ila, sai suka ce, “Muna cin nasara a kansu kamar dā.”
english: The men of Israel turned in the battle, and Benjamin began to strike and kill of the men of Israel about thirty persons; for they said, “Surely they are struck down before us, as in the first battle.”

hausa: Sa’an nan firistoci suka kawo akwatin alkawarin Ubangiji zuwa wurinsa a ciki cikin wuri mai tsarki na haikali, Wuri Mafi Tsarki, suka sa shi ƙarƙashin fikafikan kerubobin.
english: The priests brought in the ark of Yahweh’s covenant to its place, into the inner sanctuary of the house, to the most holy place, even under the wings of the cherubim.

hausa: Sarki Asa ya tuɓe mahaifiyar mahaifiyarsa daga matsayinta na mahaifiyar sarauniya, domin ta gina ginshiƙin banƙyama na Ashera. Asa ya rurrushe shi, ya farfasa shi ya kuma ƙone shi a Kwarin Kidron.
english: Also Maacah, the mother of Asa the king, he removed from being queen mother, because she had made an abominable image for an Asherah; so Asa cut down her image, ground it into dust, and burned it at the brook Kidron.

hausa: sa’an nan ku zo ku tsaya a gabana a wannan gida, wanda ake kira da Sunana, kuna cewa, “An cece mu,” mun dace mu aikata waɗannan abubuwa banƙyama?
english: then come and stand before me in this house, which is called by my name, and say, ‘We are delivered,’ that you may do all these abominations?

hausa: Garkuna za su kwanta a can, da kowace irin halitta, Mujiyar hamada da bushiya za su zauna a kan ginshiƙanta. Kukansu za tă ratsa tagogi, ɓuraguzai za su tare ƙofofin shiga, za a kware ginshiƙan al’ul.
english: Herds will lie down in the middle of her, all kinds of animals. Both the pelican and the porcupine will lodge in its capitals. Their calls will echo through the windows. Desolation will be in the thresholds, for he has laid bare the cedar beams.

hausa: Sai Elisha ya tambayi Gehazi ya ce, “Me za mu yi mata?” Sai ya amsa ya ce, “Ba ta da ɗa, ga shi kuma mijinta ya tsufa.”
english: He said, “What then is to be done for her?” Gehazi answered, “Most certainly she has no son, and her husband is old.”

hausa: gama Isra’ilawa nawa ne a matsayin bayi. Su bayina ne waɗanda na saya daga Masar. Ni ne Ubangiji Allahnku.
english: For to me the children of Israel are servants; they are my servants whom I brought out of the land of Egypt. I am Yahweh your God.

hausa: Za su kuwa san cewa ni ne Ubangiji; ba a banza na ce zan kawo musu wannan masifa ba.
english: They will know that I am Yahweh. I have not said in vain that I would do this evil to them.”’

hausa: Mikahiya ya furta, “Idan har ka dawo lafiya, to, Ubangiji bai yi magana ta wurina ba.” Ya kuma ƙara da cewa, “Ku lura da maganata, dukanku mutane!”
english: Micaiah said, “If you return at all in peace, Yahweh has not spoken by me.” He said, “Listen, all you people!”

hausa: Kada ka ji tsoron wahalar da kake gab da sha. Ina gaya maka, Iblis zai sa waɗansunku a kurkuku don yă gwada ku. Za ku sha tsanani na kwana goma. Ka yi aminci ko da za a kashe ka, ni kuwa zan ba ka rawanin rai.
english: Don’t be afraid of the things which you are about to suffer. Behold, the devil is about to throw some of you into prison, that you may be tested; and you will have oppression for ten days. Be faithful to death, and I will give you the crown of life.

hausa: Don mene ne wani mai rai zai yi gunaguni sa’ad da aka ba shi horo domin zunubansa?
english: Why should a living man complain, a man for the punishment of his sins?

hausa: Masu albarka ne waɗanda suke masu ƙulla zumunci, gama za a kira su ’ya’yan Allah.
english: Blessed are the peacemakers, for they shall be called children of God.

hausa: Kashegari, Yoshuwa ya tashi da sassafe, firistoci kuma suka ɗauki akwatin alkawarin Ubangiji.
english: Joshua rose early in the morning, and the priests took up Yahweh’s ark.

hausa: A wurin kuwa, akwai babban garken aladu da suke kiwo a gefen tudu. Aljanun suka roƙi Yesu ya bar su, su shiga cikin aladun, ya kuwa yardar musu.
english: Now there was there a herd of many pigs feeding on the mountain, and they begged him that he would allow them to enter into those. Then he allowed them.

hausa: Sa’an nan, Elkana ya koma gida a Rama amma yaron ya yi hidima a gaban Ubangiji a ƙarƙashin Eli firist.
english: Elkanah went to Ramah to his house. The child served Yahweh before Eli the priest.

hausa: Sai na tafi Fera da haka na ɗauko abin ɗamara daga wurin da na ɓoye shi, amma abin ɗamara yanzu ya lalace ya zama ba shi da amfani sam.
english: Then I went to the Euphrates, and dug, and took the belt from the place where I had hidden it; and behold, the belt was ruined. It was profitable for nothing.

hausa: Sai Hazayel ya rabu da Elisha ya koma wurin maigidansa. Da Ben-Hadad ya yi tambaya, “Me Elisha ya ce maka?” Sai Hazayel ya amsa, “Ya faɗa mini cewa tabbatacce za ka warke.”
english: Then he departed from Elisha, and came to his master, who said to him, “What did Elisha say to you?” He answered, “He told me that you would surely recover.”

hausa: In ’yan’uwa suna zama tare, in ɗayansu ya mutu babu ɗa, kada gwauruwar tă yi aure waje da iyalin. Ɗan’uwan mijinta zai ɗauke ta, yă aure ta, yă kuma cika abin da yă kamaci ɗan’uwan miji yă yi.
english: If brothers dwell together, and one of them dies and has no son, the wife of the dead shall not be married outside to a stranger. Her husband’s brother shall go in to her, and take her as his wife, and perform the duty of a husband’s brother to her.

hausa: Kada ka yarda jinina yă zuba a ƙasa nesa da gaban Ubangiji. Sarkin Isra’ila ya fito yă nemi kuɗin cizo kamar mai farautar kazan duwatsu.”
english: Now therefore, don’t let my blood fall to the earth away from the presence of Yahweh; for the king of Israel has come out to seek a flea, as when one hunts a partridge in the mountains.”

hausa: Sa’ad da Yesu da almajiransa suke barin Yeriko, sai wani babban taro ya bi shi.
english: As they went out from Jericho, a great multitude followed him.

hausa: Da dukan tulunan suka cika, sai ta ce wa ɗanta, “Kawo mini wani tulu.” Amma ya amsa ya ce, “Ai, ba saura.” Sa’an nan man ya daina zuba.
english: When the containers were full, she said to her son, “Bring me another container.” He said to her, “There isn’t another container.” Then the oil stopped flowing.

hausa: Taron suka amsa suka ce, “Kana da aljani, wane ne yake so yă kashe ka?”
english: The multitude answered, “You have a demon! Who seeks to kill you?”

hausa: Da almajiransa, Yaƙub da Yohanna suka ga haka, sai suka yi tambaya suka ce, “Ubangiji, kana so mu kira wuta ta sauka daga sama ta hallaka su?”
english: When his disciples, James and John, saw this, they said, “Lord, do you want us to command fire to come down from the sky and destroy them, just as Elijah did?”

hausa: Kada a ruɗe ku, ’yan’uwana ƙaunatattu.
english: Don’t be deceived, my beloved brothers.

hausa: Yesu ya amsa ya ce, “Don me kake ce da ni mai nagarta? Ai, ba wani nagari, sai Allah kaɗai.
english: Jesus said to him, “Why do you call me good? No one is good except one—God.

hausa: Duk wanda bai kasance a cikina ba, yana kamar reshen da aka jefar yă bushe; irin waɗannan rassan ne akan tattara, a jefa cikin wuta a ƙone.
english: If a man doesn’t remain in me, he is thrown out as a branch and is withered; and they gather them, throw them into the fire, and they are burned.

hausa: Wa yake ciyar da kansa yayinda yake aikin soja? Wa yake shukar gonar inabi, da ba ya cin amfaninta? Wa yake kiwon garke, da ba ya sha madararsa?
english: What soldier ever serves at his own expense? Who plants a vineyard, and doesn’t eat of its fruit? Or who feeds a flock, and doesn’t drink from the flock’s milk?

hausa: ’Ya’yan Ketura maza, ƙwarƙwarar Ibrahim su ne, Zimran, Yokshan, Medan, Midiyan, Ishbak da Shuwa. ’Ya’yan Yokshan maza su ne, Sheba da Dedan.
english: The sons of Keturah, Abraham’s concubine: she bore Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak, and Shuah. The sons of Jokshan: Sheba and Dedan.

hausa: Misali, in mutum ya je jeji da maƙwabcinsa domin yankan itace, sai ruwan gatarinsa ya kwaɓe daga ƙotar yayinda yake saran itacen, ya sari maƙwabcin har ya mutu. Mutumin nan zai iya gudu zuwa ɗaya daga cikin waɗannan birane don yă ceci ransa.
english: as when a man goes into the forest with his neighbor to chop wood and his hand swings the ax to cut down the tree, and the head slips from the handle and hits his neighbor so that he dies—he shall flee to one of these cities and live.

hausa: Kabilar Asher ce za tă zama ta biye. Shugabansu shi ne Fagiyel ɗan Okran.
english: “Those who encamp next to him shall be the tribe of Asher. The prince of the children of Asher shall be Pagiel the son of Ochran.

hausa: Suka haɗa da dukan ƙanana ’ya’yansu, mata, da kuma ’ya’ya maza da ’ya’ya mata, al’umma gaba ɗaya da aka jera a waɗannan tarihin zuriya. Gama sun yi aminci cikin tsarkake kansu.
english: and those who were listed by genealogy of all their little ones, their wives, their sons, and their daughters, through all the congregation; for in their office of trust they sanctified themselves in holiness.

hausa: Ga yadda za ka tsarkake su, ka yayyafa musu ruwan tsarkakewa; ka sa su aske jikunansu duka su kuma wanke tufafinsu, ta haka za su tsarkake kansu.
english: You shall do this to them to cleanse them: sprinkle the water of cleansing on them, let them shave their whole bodies with a razor, let them wash their clothes, and cleanse themselves.

hausa: shirin kai bisharar salama yă zama kamar takalmi a ƙafafunku.
english: and having fitted your feet with the preparation of the Good News of peace,

hausa: Hushai ya ce wa Absalom, “A’a, ai, wanda Ubangiji ya zaɓa ta wurin waɗannan mutane, da kuma ta wurin dukan mutane Isra’ila, shi zan zama nasa, zan kuma kasance tare da shi.
english: Hushai said to Absalom, “No; but whomever Yahweh and this people and all the men of Israel have chosen, I will be his, and I will stay with him.

hausa: Daga mutanen Izhar, Kenaniya da ’ya’yansa maza su aka sa a ayyukan da ba na haikali ba, su suka zama manya da kuma alƙalai a bisa Isra’ila.
english: Of the Izharites, Chenaniah and his sons were appointed to the outward business over Israel, for officers and judges.

hausa: Sa’an nan, sa’ad da na yi kafara saboda ke domin dukan abin da kika aikata, za ki tuna ki kuma ji kunya har ki kāsa buɗe bakinki saboda kunya, in ji Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka.’ ”
english: that you may remember, and be confounded, and never open your mouth any more because of your shame, when I have forgiven you all that you have done,” says the Lord Yahweh.’”

hausa: Kamar yadda mafasa sukan yi fakon mutum, haka ƙungiyoyin firistoci suke; suna kisa a hanya zuwa Shekem, suna aikata laifofi bankunya.
english: As gangs of robbers wait to ambush a man, so the company of priests murder on the path toward Shechem, committing shameful crimes.

hausa: Don a tsabtacce gidan, zai ɗauki tsuntsaye biyu da itacen al’ul, jan ƙyalle da hizzob.
english: To cleanse the house he shall take two birds, cedar wood, scarlet, and hyssop.

hausa: Yanzu fa, ya Isra’ila, mene ne Ubangiji Allahnku yake so a gare ku, in ba ku ji tsoron Ubangiji Allahnku, ku yi tafiya cikin hanyoyinsa, ku ƙaunace shi, ku bauta wa Ubangiji Allahnku da dukan zuciyarku da kuma dukan ranku,
english: Now, Israel, what does Yahweh your God require of you, but to fear Yahweh your God, to walk in all his ways, to love him, and to serve Yahweh your God with all your heart and with all your soul,

hausa: Ka ɓoye ni daga ƙulle-ƙullen mugaye, daga daure dauren wannan taro masu aikata mugunta.
english: Hide me from the conspiracy of the wicked, from the noisy crowd of the ones doing evil;

hausa: Zan sa wuta a katangar Rabba da za tă ƙone kagarunta za a yi kururuwa a ranar yaƙi, faɗan kuwa zai yi rugugi kamar hadiri.
english: But I will kindle a fire in the wall of Rabbah, and it will devour its palaces, with shouting in the day of battle, with a storm in the day of the whirlwind;

hausa: Mala’ikan ya ce, “Ni ne Jibra’ilu. Ina tsaya a gaban Allah, an kuma aiko ni in yi maka magana, in kuma faɗa maka wannan labari mai daɗi.
english: The angel answered him, “I am Gabriel, who stands in the presence of God. I was sent to speak to you and to bring you this good news.

hausa: daga kabilar Asher mutum 12,000, daga kabilar Naftali mutum 12,000, daga kabilar Manasse mutum 12,000,
english: of the tribe of Asher twelve thousand, of the tribe of Naphtali twelve thousand, of the tribe of Manasseh twelve thousand,

hausa: Tsawata kan sa mutum ya koyi basira fiye da abin da wawa zai koya ko da an dūke shi sau ɗari.
english: A rebuke enters deeper into one who has understanding than a hundred lashes into a fool.

hausa: ya karɓi wannan aikin manzanci, wanda Yahuda ya bari don yă tafi wurin da yake nasa.”
english: to take part in this ministry and apostleship from which Judas fell away, that he might go to his own place.”

hausa: “Duk sa’ad da Haruna zai shiga Wuri Mai Tsarki, zai shiga riƙe da sunayen ’ya’yan Isra’ila a zuciyarsa a kan ƙyallen maƙalawa a ƙirji na neman nufin Allah, domin yă zama abin tunawa a gaban Ubangiji.
english: Aaron shall bear the names of the children of Israel in the breastplate of judgment on his heart, when he goes in to the holy place, for a memorial before Yahweh continually.

hausa: Sa’ad da ya bugi dutse, ruwa ya ɓulɓulo, rafuffuka suka yi gudu a yalwace. Amma zai iya ba mu abinci? Zai iya tanada wa mutanensa nama?”
english: Behold, he struck the rock, so that waters gushed out, and streams overflowed. Can he give bread also? Will he provide meat for his people?”

hausa: Sa’an nan matar ta tafi wajen mijinta ta faɗa masa cewa, “Wani mutumin Allah ya zo wurina. Ya yi kama da mala’ikan Allah, yana da bantsoro ƙwarai. Ban tambaye shi inda ya fito ba, kuma bai gaya mini sunansa ba.
english: Then the woman came and told her husband, saying, “A man of God came to me, and his face was like the face of the angel of God, very awesome. I didn’t ask him where he was from, neither did he tell me his name;

hausa: Sa’ad da mugaye suka tasar mini don su cinye ni, sa’ad da abokan gābana da maƙiyina suka kawo mini hari, sun yi tuntuɓe suka fāɗi.
english: When evildoers came at me to eat up my flesh, even my adversaries and my foes, they stumbled and fell.

hausa: Amma kai, ya Allah, kai ne sarki tun da daɗewa; ka kawo ceto a kan duniya.
english: Yet God is my King of old, working salvation throughout the earth.

hausa: “Ranka yă daɗe sarki, waɗannan mutane sun yi mugun abu a duk abin da suka yi wa Irmiya annabi. Sun jefa shi cikin rijiyar da ba ruwa, inda zai mutu da yunwa gama ba sauran wani burodi a birnin.”
english: “My lord the king, these men have done evil in all that they have done to Jeremiah the prophet, whom they have cast into the dungeon. He is likely to die in the place where he is, because of the famine; for there is no more bread in the city.”

hausa: Ba ka ba masu jin ƙishirwa su sha ba kuma ka hana wa masu jin yunwa abinci su ci.
english: You haven’t given water to the weary to drink, and you have withheld bread from the hungry.

hausa: Muna yin muku shelar abin da muka gani, muka kuma ji ne, domin ku ma ku yi zumunci tare da mu. Zumuncinmu kuwa yana tare da Uba da kuma Ɗansa, Yesu Kiristi.
english: that which we have seen and heard we declare to you, that you also may have fellowship with us. Yes, and our fellowship is with the Father and with his Son, Jesus Christ.

hausa: Duk wanda ya ci wani sashe na gawar dole yă wanke rigunansa, kuma zai ƙazantu har yamma. Duk wanda ya ɗauki gawar dole yă wanke rigunansa, zai kuwa ƙazantu har yamma.
english: He who eats of its carcass shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the evening. He also who carries its carcass shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the evening.

hausa: amma Sarki Yoram ya koma Yezireyel don yă farfaɗo daga raunukan da Arameyawa suka ji masa a wata gabzawar da ya yi da Hazayel sarkin Aram.) Yehu ya ce, “In haka kuke ji, kada ku bar wani yă sulluɓe daga birnin yă kai labarin Yezireyel.”
english: but King Joram had returned to be healed in Jezreel of the wounds which the Syrians had given him when he fought with Hazael king of Syria.) Jehu said, “If this is your thinking, then let no one escape and go out of the city to go to tell it in Jezreel.”

hausa: “ ‘Kika kuma kwashe ’ya’yanki maza da mata waɗanda kin haifa mini kika miƙa su kamar abinci ga gumakanki. Karuwancinki bai isa ba ne?
english: “‘“Moreover you have taken your sons and your daughters, whom you have borne to me, and you have sacrificed these to them to be devoured. Was your prostitution a small matter,

hausa: Sai Allah ya ce, “Ni ne Allah na kakanninka, Allah na Ibrahim, Allah na Ishaku da kuma Allah na Yaƙub.” Da jin wannan, sai Musa ya ɓoye fuskarsa, domin ya ji tsoro yă dubi Allah.
english: Moreover he said, “I am the God of your father, the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob.” Moses hid his face because he was afraid to look at God.

hausa: Wanne ya fi sauƙi, a ce, ‘An gafarta maka zunubanka,’ ko kuma a ce, ‘Tashi, ka yi tafiya’?
english: Which is easier to say, ‘Your sins are forgiven you,’ or to say, ‘Arise and walk’?

hausa: don ku zama ’ya’yan Ubanku na sama. Shi yakan sa ranarsa ta haskaka a kan mugaye da masu kirki; yakan kuma sako ruwan sama a bisa masu adalci da marasa adalci.
english: that you may be children of your Father who is in heaven. For he makes his sun to rise on the evil and the good, and sends rain on the just and the unjust.

hausa: Sai na tā da murya na ce, “Kaitona! Na shiga uku! Gama ni mutum ne mai leɓuna marar tsarki, kuma ina raye a cikin mutane masu leɓuna marasa tsarki, idanuna kuma sun ga Sarki, Ubangiji Maɗaukaki.”
english: Then I said, “Woe is me! For I am undone, because I am a man of unclean lips and I live among a people of unclean lips, for my eyes have seen the King, Yahweh of Armies!”

hausa: “Allah ya ce, ‘A kwanakin ƙarshe, zan zubo Ruhuna bisa dukan mutane. ’Ya’yanku maza da mata za su yi annabci, samarinku za su ga wahayoyi, dattawanku kuma za su yi mafarkai.
english: ‘It will be in the last days, says God, that I will pour out my Spirit on all flesh. Your sons and your daughters will prophesy. Your young men will see visions. Your old men will dream dreams.

hausa: Da ya yi kusa da Urushalima, ya kuma ga birnin, sai ya yi kuka a kanta,
english: When he came near, he saw the city and wept over it,

hausa: Yayinda aka kulle Irmiya a sansanin matsara, maganar Ubangiji ta zo masa cewa,
english: Now Yahweh’s word came to Jeremiah while he was shut up in the court of the guard, saying,

hausa: Saboda haka na rantse a kan gidan Eli, ‘Ba za a taɓa shafe laifin gidan Eli da hadaya ko baiko ba.’ ”
english: Therefore I have sworn to the house of Eli that the iniquity of Eli’s house shall not be removed with sacrifice or offering forever.”

hausa: Manyan duwatsu na awakin jeji ne; tsagaggun duwatsun mafaka ne ga rema.
english: The high mountains are for the wild goats. The rocks are a refuge for the rock badgers.
