hausa: Kashegari muka tashi cikin jirgin ruwa daga can muka zo gefen Kiyos. Kwana ɗaya bayan wannan, sai muka ƙetare zuwa Samos, kashegari kuma muka iso Miletus.
english: Sailing from there, we came the following day opposite Chios. The next day we touched at Samos and stayed at Trogyllium, and the day after we came to Miletus.

hausa: In ba a tashe Kiristi ba kuwa, ai, wa’azinmu, da bangaskiyarku banza ne.
english: If Christ has not been raised, then our preaching is in vain and your faith also is in vain.

hausa: Kada ku nemi ɗan’uwanku yă biya bashin da kuka ba shi da ruwa, ko kuɗi, ko abinci, ko kowane irin abin da yana iya ba da ruwa.
english: You shall not lend on interest to your brother: interest of money, interest of food, interest of anything that is lent on interest.

hausa: Mene ne kake yi a nan kuma wa ya ba ka izini ka haƙa kabari wa kanka a nan, kana fafe kabarinka a bisa kana sassaƙa wurin hutunka a dutse?
english: ‘What are you doing here? Who has you here, that you have dug out a tomb here?’ Cutting himself out a tomb on high, chiseling a habitation for himself in the rock!”

hausa: Waɗannan su ne ’ya’yan Ishmayel maza, waɗanda kuma suke sunayen kabilu goma sha biyu masu mulki bisa ga wuraren zamansu da sansaninsu.
english: These are the sons of Ishmael, and these are their names, by their villages, and by their encampments: twelve princes, according to their nations.

hausa: Ku da Lawiyawa da baƙin da suke a cikinku, za ku yi murna cikin dukan abubuwa masu kyau da Ubangiji Allahnku ya ba ku tare da gidanku.
english: You shall rejoice in all the good which Yahweh your God has given to you, and to your house, you, and the Levite, and the foreigner who is among you.

hausa: Gama Ɗan Mutum shi ne Ubangijin Asabbaci.”
english: For the Son of Man is Lord of the Sabbath.”

hausa: Hilkiya ya ce wa Shafan magatakarda, “Na sami Littafin Doka a cikin haikalin Ubangiji.” Sai ya ba wa Shafan.
english: Hilkiah answered Shaphan the scribe, “I have found the book of the law in Yahweh’s house.” So Hilkiah delivered the book to Shaphan.

hausa: na goma sha ɗaya a kan Eliyashib, na goma sha biyu a kan Yakim,
english: the eleventh to Eliashib, the twelfth to Jakim,

hausa: Zuriyar Farosh mutum 2,172
english: The children of Parosh: two thousand one hundred seventy-two.

hausa: Sa’ad da kuma kuka haye Urdun, ku kakkafa waɗannan duwatsu a bisa Dutsen Ebal, kamar yadda na umarce a yau, ku yi musu shafe da farar ƙasa.
english: It shall be, when you have crossed over the Jordan, that you shall set up these stones, which I command you today, on Mount Ebal, and you shall coat them with plaster.

hausa: suna gina almajirai suna kuma ƙarfafa su su tsaya da gaske cikin bangaskiya. Suka ce, “Sai da shan wahaloli masu yawa za mu shiga mulkin Allah.”
english: strengthening the souls of the disciples, exhorting them to continue in the faith, and that through many afflictions we must enter into God’s Kingdom.

hausa: A cikin kaiwa da kawowar da nake yi cikin dukan Isra’ilawa, na taɓa ce wa wani shugabanninsu wanda na umarta su lura da mutanena Isra’ila, “Don me ba ku gina mini mazauni da katakon al’ul ba?” ’
english: In all places in which I have walked with all the children of Israel, did I say a word to anyone from the tribes of Israel whom I commanded to be shepherd of my people Israel, saying, ‘Why have you not built me a house of cedar?’”’

hausa: Lokutana suna a hannuwanka; ka cece ni daga abokan gābana da kuma daga waɗanda suke fafara ta.
english: My times are in your hand. Deliver me from the hand of my enemies, and from those who persecute me.

hausa: Ka cece ni, ya Ubangiji, daga leɓuna masu ƙarya da kuma daga harsuna masu yaudara.
english: Deliver my soul, Yahweh, from lying lips, from a deceitful tongue.

hausa: Babbar alama mai banmamaki ta bayyana a sama, mace tana lulluɓe da rana, da kuma wata a ƙarƙashin sawunta, akwai kuma rawani mai taurari goma sha biyu a kanta.
english: A great sign was seen in heaven: a woman clothed with the sun, and the moon under her feet, and on her head a crown of twelve stars.

hausa: Sai Allah ya bayyana ga Laban mutumin Aram a mafarki da dare, ya ce masa, “Ka yi hankali kada ka faɗa wa Yaƙub wani abu, ko mai kyau ko marar kyau.”
english: God came to Laban the Syrian in a dream of the night, and said to him, “Be careful that you don’t speak to Jacob either good or bad.”

hausa: Kalmomin Malami, ɗan Dawuda, Sarki a Urushalima.
english: The words of the Preacher, the son of David, king in Jerusalem:

hausa: tabbatacce a yau zan aikata abin da na yi miki rantsuwa da sunan Ubangiji, Allah na Isra’ila; Solomon ɗanki zai zama sarki bayana, kuma shi zai zauna a kan kujerar sarautata a maimakona.”
english: most certainly as I swore to you by Yahweh, the God of Israel, saying, ‘Assuredly Solomon your son shall reign after me, and he shall sit on my throne in my place;’ I will most certainly do this today.”

hausa: To, ya Ubangiji Allahnmu, ka cece mu daga hannunsa, don dukan mulkokin duniya su san cewa kai kaɗai, ya Ubangiji ne Allah.”
english: Now therefore, Yahweh our God, save us, I beg you, out of his hand, that all the kingdoms of the earth may know that you, Yahweh, are God alone.”

hausa: Sai ya juya wajen wani kuma ya sāke kawo zancen, mutanen kuwa suka amsa masa kamar dā.
english: He turned away from him toward another, and spoke like that again; and the people answered him again the same way.

hausa: Ƙarfin halinki zai jure ko kuwa hannuwanki za su yi ƙarfi a ranar da na gamu da ke? Ni Ubangiji na faɗa, zan kuma aikata.
english: Can your heart endure, or can your hands be strong, in the days that I will deal with you? I, Yahweh, have spoken it, and will do it.

hausa: wanda yake sunkuya yă dubi sammai da duniya?
english: who stoops down to see in heaven and on the earth?

hausa: sai ya gudu ya bar rigarsa, ya gudu tsirara.
english: but he left the linen cloth and fled from them naked.

hausa: ’Ya’yanki sun sume; sun kwanta kusurwar kowane titi, kamar barewar da aka kama da tarko. Sun cika da fushin Ubangiji da kuma tsawatawar Allahnki.
english: Your sons have fainted. They lie at the head of all the streets, like an antelope in a net. They are full of Yahweh’s wrath, the rebuke of your God.

hausa: ’Ya’yan Gomer maza su ne, Ashkenaz, Rifat, da Togarma.
english: The sons of Gomer were: Ashkenaz, Riphath, and Togarmah.

hausa: saboda haka ga abin da Ubangiji Maɗaukaki yana cewa, ‘Zan hukunta su. Samarinsu za su mutu ta wurin takobi, ’ya’yansu maza da mata kuwa ta wurin yunwa.
english: therefore Yahweh of Armies says, ‘Behold, I will punish them. The young men will die by the sword. Their sons and their daughters will die by famine.

hausa: Ana nan wata rana Musa yana kiwon tumakin Yetro surukinsa, firist na Midiyan, sai ya bi da tumaki zuwa gefe mai nisa a cikin hamada, har ya zo Horeb, dutsen Allah.
english: Now Moses was keeping the flock of Jethro, his father-in-law, the priest of Midian, and he led the flock to the back of the wilderness, and came to God’s mountain, to Horeb.

hausa: “Ga abin da Ubangiji Maɗaukaki ya ce, ‘Ba da jimawa ba zan sāke girgiza sammai da kuma ƙasa, teku da busasshiyar ƙasa.
english: For this is what Yahweh of Armies says: ‘Yet once more, it is a little while, and I will shake the heavens, the earth, the sea, and the dry land;

hausa: Zan mai da garuruwanka kufai za ka kuma zama kango. Sa’an nan za ka san cewa ni ne Ubangiji.
english: I will lay your cities waste, and you will be desolate. Then you will know that I am Yahweh.

hausa: Duk waɗanda suke zama a Lidda da Sharon suka gan shi suka kuma juyo ga Ubangiji.
english: All who lived at Lydda and in Sharon saw him, and they turned to the Lord.

hausa: sai ya aika musu da annabi, wanda ya ce, “Ga abin da Ubangiji, Allah na Isra’ila ya ce na fitar da ku daga Masar, daga ƙasar bauta.
english: Yahweh sent a prophet to the children of Israel; and he said to them, “Yahweh, the God of Israel, says, ‘I brought you up from Egypt, and brought you out of the house of bondage.

hausa: Waɗannan su ne ɓangarori na matsaran ƙofofi waɗanda suke zuriyar Kora da Merari.
english: These were the divisions of the doorkeepers; of the sons of the Korahites, and of the sons of Merari.

hausa: A wannan lokaci, hafsoshin Nebukadnezzar sarkin Babilon suka kawo wa Urushalima yaƙi, suka kuma kewaye ta.
english: At that time the servants of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came up to Jerusalem, and the city was besieged.

hausa: Dawuda da mutanensa suka haura suka yaƙi Geshurawa, da Girziyawa, da Amalekawa. (Waɗannan su ne mazaunan ƙasar a dā, tun daga Shur har zuwa ƙasar Masar.)
english: David and his men went up and raided the Geshurites, the Girzites, and the Amalekites; for those were the inhabitants of the land who were of old, on the way to Shur, even to the land of Egypt.

hausa: Ga abin da Ubangiji Maɗaukaki ya ce, “Kamar dai yadda na yi niyyar kawo muku bala’i, in kuma ƙi jin tausayi sa’ad da kakanninku suka ba ni haushi,” in ji Ubangiji Maɗaukaki,
english: For Yahweh of Armies says: “As I thought to do evil to you when your fathers provoked me to wrath,” says Yahweh of Armies, “and I didn’t repent,

hausa: Kush shi ne mahaifin Nimrod, wanda ya yi girma ya zama babban jarumi a duniya.
english: Cush became the father of Nimrod. He began to be a mighty one on the earth.

hausa: “Zan yi gāba da su,” in ji Ubangiji Maɗaukaki. “Zan kau da sunan Babilon da waɗanda suka rage da rai a cikinta, ’ya’yanta da zuriyarta,” in ji Ubangiji.
english: “I will rise up against them,” says Yahweh of Armies, “and cut off from Babylon name and remnant, and son and son’s son,” says Yahweh.

hausa: Amma wanda ya karɓi irin da ya fāɗi a ƙasa mai kyau, shi ne mutumin da yakan ji maganar yă kuwa fahimce ta. Yakan ba da amfani wani riɓi ɗari, sittin, ko talatin na abin da aka shuka.”
english: What was sown on the good ground, this is he who hears the word and understands it, who most certainly bears fruit and produces, some one hundred times as much, some sixty, and some thirty.”

hausa: Duk inda mushe yake, can ungulai za su taru.
english: For wherever the carcass is, that is where the vultures gather together.

hausa: Tsirara mutum yakan fito daga cikin mahaifiyarsa, kuma kamar yadda ya fito, haka zai koma. Ba ya ɗaukan kome daga wahalarsa da zai riƙe a hannunsa.
english: As he came out of his mother’s womb, naked shall he go again as he came, and shall take nothing for his labor, which he may carry away in his hand.

hausa: Amma Ubangiji ya taurare zuciyar Fir’auna, bai kuwa bar Isra’ilawa suka tafi ba.
english: But Yahweh hardened Pharaoh’s heart, and he didn’t let the children of Israel go.

hausa: Kada yă zama sabon tuba, in ba haka zai zama mai girman kai yă kuma fāɗa cikin irin hukuncin da ya fāɗo wa Iblis.
english: not a new convert, lest being puffed up he fall into the same condemnation as the devil.

hausa: A gaban Allah da kuma Kiristi Yesu, wanda zai yi wa masu rai da matattu shari’a, saboda kuma bayyanuwarsa da mulkinsa, ina ba ka umarni.
english: I command you therefore before God and the Lord Jesus Christ, who will judge the living and the dead at his appearing and his Kingdom:

hausa: waɗansu suka mutu, domin yaƙin na Allah ne. Suka zauna a ƙasar har lokacin da aka kai su zaman bauta.
english: For many fell slain, because the war was of God. They lived in their place until the captivity.

hausa: Ba sa faɗa wa kansu, ‘Bari mu ji tsoron Ubangiji Allahnmu, wanda yake ba mu ruwan sama a kan kari na kaka da na bazara, wanda kullum yake tabbatar mana da girbi.’
english: They don’t say in their heart, ‘Let’s now fear Yahweh our God, who gives rain, both the former and the latter, in its season, who preserves to us the appointed weeks of the harvest.’

hausa: “Ka faɗa wa Isra’ilawa cewa, ‘In wani ya mutu ba shi da ɗa, a ba da gādonsa ga ’yarsa.
english: You shall speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘If a man dies, and has no son, then you shall cause his inheritance to pass to his daughter.

hausa: Ya cinna wa haikalin Ubangiji wuta, da fadan sarki, da kuma dukan gidajen Urushalima. Ya kuma ƙone duk wani gini mai muhimmanci.
english: He burned Yahweh’s house, the king’s house, and all the houses of Jerusalem. He burned every great house with fire.

hausa: Bayan wannan sai na duba, can a gabana kuwa ga wani taro mai girma, wanda ba mai iya ƙirgawa, daga kowace al’umma, kabila, mutane da kuma harshe, suna tsaye a gaban kursiyin da kuma gaban Ɗan Ragon nan. Suna saye da fararen tufafi suna kuma riƙe da rassan dabino a hannuwansu.
english: After these things I looked, and behold, a great multitude which no man could count, out of every nation and of all tribes, peoples, and languages, standing before the throne and before the Lamb, dressed in white robes, with palm branches in their hands.

hausa: “Ka yi magana da Isra’ilawa, ka ce musu, ‘Sa’ad da kuka shiga ƙasar da ina kai ku,
english: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘When you come into the land where I bring you,

hausa: Ka aika zuwa Yoffa don a kira Siman wanda ake ce da shi Bitrus. Shi baƙo ne a gidan Siman mai aikin fatu, wanda yake zama a bakin teku.’
english: Send therefore to Joppa and summon Simon, who is also called Peter. He is staying in the house of a tanner named Simon, by the seaside. When he comes, he will speak to you.’

hausa: Ya nemi ruwa, ta kuwa ta ba shi madara; a ƙwaryar da ta dace da sarakuna ta kawo masa kindirmo.
english: He asked for water. She gave him milk. She brought him butter in a lordly dish.

hausa: Haka yake da masu mafarke-mafarken nan, gama sun ƙazantar da jikunansu, suka ƙi bin masu mulki, suna ɓata sunan talikan sararin sama.
english: Yet in the same way, these also in their dreaming defile the flesh, despise authority, and slander celestial beings.

hausa: A wannan yamma, bayan fāɗuwar rana, mutane suka kawo wa Yesu dukan marasa lafiya, da masu aljanu.
english: At evening, when the sun had set, they brought to him all who were sick and those who were possessed by demons.

hausa: ban fasa yin godiya saboda ku ba, ina tuna da ku cikin addu’o’ina.
english: don’t cease to give thanks for you, making mention of you in my prayers,

hausa: “Ya Ubangiji Allah Maɗaukaki, Allah na Isra’ila, zaune a tsakanin kerubobi, kai kaɗai ne Allah a kan dukan masarautan duniya.
english: “Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel, who is enthroned among the cherubim, you are the God, even you alone, of all the kingdoms of the earth. You have made heaven and earth.

hausa: Sai Yoshuwa ya kafa duwatsu goma sha biyun nan da suka ɗauko daga Urdun.
english: Joshua set up those twelve stones, which they took out of the Jordan, in Gilgal.

hausa: Kamar yadda ruwa kan nuna yadda fuska take, haka zuciyar mutum kan nuna irin mutumin.
english: Like water reflects a face, so a man’s heart reflects the man.

hausa: A rana ta ashirin ga wata na biyu, a shekara ta biyu, sai girgijen ya tashi daga tabanakul na Shaida.
english: In the second year, in the second month, on the twentieth day of the month, the cloud was taken up from over the tabernacle of the covenant.

hausa: Aka shigo da dawakan Solomon daga Masar da kuma daga Kuye ’yan kasuwan fada suka saye su daga Kuye.
english: The horses which Solomon had were brought out of Egypt and from Kue. The king’s merchants purchased them from Kue.

hausa: Sa’an nan Musa ya jagoranci mutane daga sansani domin su sadu da Allah, sai suka tsaya a gefen dutsen.
english: Moses led the people out of the camp to meet God; and they stood at the lower part of the mountain.

hausa: Ba su yi yadda muka za tă ba, sai ma suka fara ba da kansu ga Ubangiji, sa’an nan sai suka ba da kansu gare mu bisa ga nufin Allah.
english: This was not as we had expected, but first they gave their own selves to the Lord, and to us through the will of God.

hausa: Sa’an nan sarki ya yi tambaya ya ce, “Babu wani har yanzu da ya rage a gidan Shawulu don in nuna masa alherin Allah?” Ziba ya ce wa sarki, “Har yanzu akwai ɗan Yonatan da ya rage, sai dai shi gurgu ne a dukan ƙafafu.”
english: The king said, “Is there not yet any of Saul’s house, that I may show the kindness of God to him?” Ziba said to the king, “Jonathan still has a son, who is lame in his feet.”

hausa: ka ji daga sama, mazauninka, ka kuma yi dukan abin da baƙon ya tambaye ka, saboda dukan mutanen duniya su san sunanka, su kuma ji tsoronka, kamar yadda mutanenka Isra’ila suke yi, bari kuma su san cewa wannan gidan da na gina, ya amsa Sunanka.
english: hear in heaven, your dwelling place, and do according to all that the foreigner calls to you for; that all the peoples of the earth may know your name, to fear you, as do your people Israel, and that they may know that this house which I have built is called by your name.

hausa: “Mu kuwa shaidu ne na dukan abin da ya yi a ƙasar Yahudawa da kuma a Urushalima. Suka kashe shi ta wurin rataye shi a kan itace,
english: We are witnesses of everything he did both in the country of the Jews and in Jerusalem; whom they also killed, hanging him on a tree.

hausa: Bayan ya binne mahaifinsa, sai Yusuf ya koma Masar, tare da ’yan’uwansa da kuma dukan waɗanda suka tafi tare da shi don binne mahaifinsa.
english: Joseph returned into Egypt—he, and his brothers, and all that went up with him to bury his father, after he had buried his father.

hausa: Sai na gane cewa, duk wata fama da duk wata nasara sun samo asali daga kishin da mutum yake yi na maƙwabcinsa ne. Wannan ma ba shi da amfani, naushin iska ne kawai.
english: Then I saw all the labor and achievement that is the envy of a man’s neighbor. This also is vanity and a striving after wind.

hausa: kana kāre marayu da waɗanda aka danne, domin mutum, wanda yake na duniya kada ƙara haddasa wata razana.
english: to judge the fatherless and the oppressed, that man who is of the earth may terrify no more.

hausa: Zai zuba jinin a ƙahonin bagaden da suke gaban Ubangiji a cikin Tentin Sujada. Zai zuba sauran jinin a gindin bagaden hadaya ta ƙonawa a ƙofar zuwa Tentin Sujada.
english: He shall put some of the blood on the horns of the altar which is before Yahweh, that is in the Tent of Meeting; and the rest of the blood he shall pour out at the base of the altar of burnt offering, which is at the door of the Tent of Meeting.

hausa: Sa’ad da Fir’auna ya taurare zuciyarsa, bai yarda ya sallame mu ba, sai Ubangiji ya kashe dukan ’ya’yan farin ƙasar Masar, na mutum da na dabba, gaba ɗaya. Domin haka nake yin hadaya ga Ubangiji da ’ya’yan fari, maza, da suka fara buɗe mahaifa, amma nakan fanshi dukan ’ya’yan farina maza.’
english: When Pharaoh stubbornly refused to let us go, Yahweh killed all the firstborn in the land of Egypt, both the firstborn of man, and the firstborn of livestock. Therefore I sacrifice to Yahweh all that opens the womb, being males; but all the firstborn of my sons I redeem.’

hausa: Kullum ka kasance cikin farin riguna, ka kuma shafe kanka da mai kullum,
english: Let your garments be always white, and don’t let your head lack oil.

hausa: Da Bafarisiyen da ya gayyace shi, ya ga wannan, sai ya ce a ransa, “Da mutumin nan annabi ne, da ya san ko wace ce take taɓansa, da kuma irin macen da take, cewa mai zunubi ce.”
english: Now when the Pharisee who had invited him saw it, he said to himself, “This man, if he were a prophet, would have perceived who and what kind of woman this is who touches him, that she is a sinner.”

hausa: Dawuda da kansa ya yi magana ta wurin Ruhu Mai Tsarki ya ce, “ ‘Ubangiji ya ce wa Ubangijina, “Zauna a hannun damana sai na sa abokan gābanka a ƙarƙashin sawunka.” ’
english: For David himself said in the Holy Spirit, ‘The Lord said to my Lord, “Sit at my right hand, until I make your enemies the footstool of your feet.”’

hausa: Ƙuri’a ta farko ta fāɗa a kan Kohatawa bisa ga iyalansu. Sai aka ba wa Lawiyawa waɗanda suke ’yan zuriyar Haruna, firist, garuruwa goma sha uku daga kabilan Yahuda, Simeyon da Benyamin.
english: The lot came out for the families of the Kohathites. The children of Aaron the priest, who were of the Levites, had thirteen cities by lot out of the tribe of Judah, out of the tribe of the Simeonites, and out of the tribe of Benjamin.

hausa: Na ga Birni Mai Tsarki, sabuwar Urushalima tana saukowa daga sama, daga Allah, a shirye kamar amaryar da aka yi mata ado mai kyau saboda mijinta.
english: I saw the holy city, New Jerusalem, coming down out of heaven from God, prepared like a bride adorned for her husband.

hausa: Amma in wurin nan yana da nisa sosai, Ubangiji Allahnku kuma ya albarkace ku, ba za ku kuwa iya riƙe zakkarku ba (Saboda wurin da Ubangiji ya zaɓa yă sa Sunansa ya yi nisa sosai),
english: If the way is too long for you, so that you are not able to carry it because the place which Yahweh your God shall choose to set his name there is too far from you, when Yahweh your God blesses you,

hausa: Ka rufe kanka da gajimare don kada addu’armu ta kai wurinka.
english: You have covered yourself with a cloud, so that no prayer can pass through.

hausa: Ta wurin bangaskiya ne muka fahimci cewa an halicci duniya bisa ga umarnin Allah, saboda an halicce abin da ake gani daga abin da ba a gani.
english: By faith we understand that the universe has been framed by the word of God, so that what is seen has not been made out of things which are visible.

hausa: Dawuda ya isa wurin Shawulu ya shiga hidimarsa. Shawulu kuwa ya so shi ƙwarai da gaske. Dawuda ya zama ɗaya daga cikin masu sanya sulke.
english: David came to Saul and stood before him. He loved him greatly; and he became his armor bearer.

hausa: daga kabilar Benyamin, Abidan ɗan Gideyoni;
english: Of Benjamin: Abidan the son of Gideoni.

hausa: Saboda haka za ku zama na farkon da za su tafi zaman bauta; bukukkuwanku da shagulgulanku za su ƙare.
english: Therefore they will now go captive with the first who go captive. The feasting and lounging will end.

hausa: Jimillar dukan jarirai maza daga wata ɗaya ko fiye, 8,600 ne. Kohatawa ne suke lura da wuri mai tsarki.
english: According to the number of all the males from a month old and upward, there were eight thousand six hundred keeping the requirements of the sanctuary.

hausa: Sa’an nan Yaƙub ya tambaye su, “Yana nan lafiya?” Suka ce, “I, yana lafiya, ga ma ’yarsa Rahila tafe da tumaki.”
english: He said to them, “Is it well with him?” They said, “It is well. See, Rachel, his daughter, is coming with the sheep.”

hausa: da ƙaramin bijimi guda ɗaya, tunkiya ɗaya, da rago, dukansu bana ɗaya-ɗaya domin hadaya ta ƙonawa;
english: one young bull, one ram, one male lamb a year old, for a burnt offering;

hausa: Amma idanunku masu albarka ne domin suna gani, haka ma kunnuwanku domin suna ji.
english: “But blessed are your eyes, for they see; and your ears, for they hear.

hausa: Amma yanzu da ya mutu, me zai sa in yi azumi? Zan iya dawo da shi ne? Ni zan je wajensa, ba shi zai dawo wurina ba.”
english: But now he is dead. Why should I fast? Can I bring him back again? I will go to him, but he will not return to me.”

hausa: “La’ananne ne mutumin da ya kwana da ’yar’uwarsa, ’yar mahaifinsa ko ’yar mahaifiyarsa.” Sai dukan mutane su ce, “Amin!”
english: ‘Cursed is he who lies with his sister, his father’s daughter or his mother’s daughter.’ All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’

hausa: Sai Isuwa ya ce, “To, bari in bar waɗansu mutanena tare da kai.” Yaƙub ya ce, “Amma me ya sa za ka yi haka? Bari dai in sami tagomashi a idanunka ranka yă daɗe.”
english: Esau said, “Let me now leave with you some of the people who are with me.” He said, “Why? Let me find favor in the sight of my lord.”

hausa: Ba za su yi lahani ko su hallaka wani a dutsena mai tsarki ba, gama duniya za tă cika da sanin Ubangiji kamar yadda ruwaye suka rufe teku.
english: They will not hurt nor destroy in all my holy mountain; for the earth will be full of the knowledge of Yahweh, as the waters cover the sea.

hausa: Abin da zan gaya maka ba ƙarya ba ne; mai cikakken sani yana tare da kai.
english: For truly my words are not false. One who is perfect in knowledge is with you.

hausa: Ko ba ku sani ba cewa dukanmu da aka yi wa baftisma a cikin Kiristi Yesu an yi mana baftismar ne zuwa cikin mutuwarsa?
english: Or don’t you know that all of us who were baptized into Christ Jesus were baptized into his death?

hausa: Ruhu ya ce mini kada in yi wata-wata game da tafiya tare da su. Waɗannan ’yan’uwa guda shida su ma suka rako ni, muka kuwa shiga gidan mutumin.
english: The Spirit told me to go with them without discriminating. These six brothers also accompanied me, and we entered into the man’s house.

hausa: da kuma inda dā ya gina bagade. A can Abram ya kira bisa sunan Ubangiji.
english: to the place of the altar, which he had made there at the first. There Abram called on Yahweh’s name.

hausa: jikinsa ɓulɓul, ƙasusuwansa da alamar ƙarfi.
english: His pails are full of milk. The marrow of his bones is moistened.

hausa: Dawuda ya yi mulki a bisa dukan Isra’ila, yana yin abin da yake daidai da kuma gaskiya saboda dukan mutanensa.
english: David reigned over all Israel; and he executed justice and righteousness for all his people.

hausa: Za a kore ka daga cikin mutane za ka kuma yi rayuwa tare da namun jeji. Za ka ci ciyawa kamar sa har shekara bakwai cif, sa’an nan za ka gane Mafi Ɗaukaka ne mai iko duka a kan dukan mulkoki a duniya, yake kuma ba da mulki ga duk wanda ya ga dama.”
english: You shall be driven from men, and your dwelling shall be with the animals of the field. You shall be made to eat grass like oxen. Seven times shall pass over you, until you know that the Most High rules in the kingdom of men, and gives it to whomever he will.’”

hausa: Waɗansu suka so su kama shi, sai dai ba wanda ya taɓa shi.
english: Some of them would have arrested him, but no one laid hands on him.

hausa: In mahaifinta ya ƙi yă ba da ita ga mutumin, dole mutumin yă biya dukiya daidai da abin da akan biya domin budurwai.
english: If her father utterly refuses to give her to him, he shall pay money according to the dowry of virgins.

hausa: Efraim yana kiwo a kan iska; yana fafarar iskar gabas dukan yini yana riɓaɓɓanya ƙarairayi da rikici. Ya yi yarjejjeniya da Assuriya ya kuma aika wa Masar man zaitun.
english: Ephraim feeds on wind, and chases the east wind. He continually multiplies lies and desolation. They make a covenant with Assyria, and oil is carried into Egypt.

hausa: In tafi cikakke, amma Ubangiji ya dawo da ni ba kome. Don me kuke kirana Na’omi? Ubangiji ya wahalshe ni, Maɗaukaki ya kawo mini masifa.”
english: I went out full, and Yahweh has brought me home again empty. Why do you call me Naomi, since Yahweh has testified against me, and the Almighty has afflicted me?”

hausa: Sa’an nan ka ɗauki dukan kitsen da ya rufe kayan ciki, da kitsen da yake manne da hanta, da ƙoda biyu da kuma kintsen da yake a kansu, ka ƙone su a kan bagade.
english: You shall take all the fat that covers the innards, the cover of the liver, the two kidneys, and the fat that is on them, and burn them on the altar.

hausa: Haka ma harshe yake, ga shi ɗan ƙanƙanin gaɓar jiki ne, amma sai manyan fariya. Ku dubi yadda ɗan ƙaramin ƙyastu yake ƙuna wa babban jeji wuta mana.
english: So the tongue is also a little member, and boasts great things. See how a small fire can spread to a large forest!

hausa: Mala’ikan Ubangiji ya ce, ‘Ka la’anci Meroz.’ ‘Ka la’anci mutanensa sosai, domin ba su kawo wa Ubangiji taimako ba, su kawo wa Ubangiji taimako a kan masu ƙarfi ba.’
english: ‘Curse Meroz,’ said Yahweh’s angel. ‘Curse bitterly its inhabitants, because they didn’t come to help Yahweh, to help Yahweh against the mighty.’

hausa: Zan yi biyayya da ƙa’idodinka; kada ka yashe ni ɗungum.
english: I will observe your statutes. Don’t utterly forsake me. BETH

hausa: Yebusiyawa, Amoriyawa, Girgashiyawa
english: the Jebusite, the Amorite, the Girgashite,

hausa: Bai kamata in hukunta su saboda wannan ba?” In ji Ubangiji. “Bai kamata in yi ramuwa a kan irin al’umma kamar wannan ba?
english: “Shouldn’t I punish for these things?” says Yahweh. “Shouldn’t my soul be avenged on such a nation as this?

hausa: Mafi ƙanƙanta a cikinki za tă zama dubu, ƙarami zai zama al’umma mai girma. Ni ne Ubangiji, cikin lokacinsa zan yi haka da sauri.”
english: The little one will become a thousand, and the small one a strong nation. I, Yahweh, will do this quickly in its time.”

hausa: Karusan Fir’auna da sojojinsa ya jefa cikin teku. Zaɓaɓɓun jarumawansa ya nutsar da su cikin Bahar Maliya.
english: He has cast Pharaoh’s chariots and his army into the sea. His chosen captains are sunk in the Red Sea.

hausa: Sai ya tambaye ni cewa, “Ɗan mutum, waɗannan ƙasusuwa za su iya rayu?” Ni kuwa na ce, “Ya Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka, kai kaɗai ka sani.”
english: He said to me, “Son of man, can these bones live?” I answered, “Lord Yahweh, you know.”

hausa: Ga shi mun aiko ɗan’uwanmu nan tare da shi, wanda ikkilisiyoyi duka suna yabo saboda hidimarsa ga bishara.
english: We have sent together with him the brother whose praise in the Good News is known throughout all the assemblies.

hausa: ‘In kuka zauna a wannan ƙasa, zan gina ku ba zan kuwa rushe ku ba; zan dasa ku ba kuwa zan tumɓuke ku ba, gama ina baƙin ciki a kan masifar da na aukar a kanku.
english: ‘If you will still live in this land, then I will build you, and not pull you down, and I will plant you, and not pluck you up; for I grieve over the distress that I have brought on you.

hausa: sai dukan jarumawa suka tafi suka ɗauki jikunan Shawulu da na ’ya’yansa maza suka kawo Yabesh. Sa’an nan suka binne ƙasusuwan a ƙarƙashin babban itace oak a Yabesh, suka kuma yi azumi kwana bakwai.
english: all the valiant men arose and took away the body of Saul and the bodies of his sons, and brought them to Jabesh, and buried their bones under the oak in Jabesh, and fasted seven days.

hausa: Duk mai dogara ga kansa wawa ne, amma duk wanda yake tafiya da hikima zai zauna lafiya.
english: One who trusts in himself is a fool; but one who walks in wisdom is kept safe.

hausa: Allunan aikin Allah ne; rubutun kuma rubutun Allah ne, da ya zāna a kan alluna.
english: The tablets were the work of God, and the writing was the writing of God, engraved on the tablets.

hausa: Sai ta ce wa uwargijiyarta, “Da dai shugabana zai ga annabin da yake Samariya, da annabin zai warkar da shi daga kuturtarsa.”
english: She said to her mistress, “I wish that my lord were with the prophet who is in Samaria! Then he would heal him of his leprosy.”

hausa: don kada ku lalace, ku kuma yi wa kanku gunki, siffa ta wani kama, ko a kamannin namiji, ko kuwa ta mace,
english: lest you corrupt yourselves, and make yourself a carved image in the form of any figure, the likeness of male or female,

hausa: Kayinu ya kwana da matarsa, ta kuwa yi ciki, ta haifi Enok. A lokacin Kayinu yana gina birni, sai ya sa wa birnin sunan ɗansa Enok.
english: Cain knew his wife. She conceived, and gave birth to Enoch. He built a city, and named the city after the name of his son, Enoch.

hausa: Ka bincike ni, ya Allah ka kuma san zuciyata; ka gwada ni ka kuma san damuwata.
english: Search me, God, and know my heart. Try me, and know my thoughts.

hausa: aka kuma yi katakai biyu domin kusurwoyi tabanakul a iyaka ta ƙarshe.
english: He made two boards for the corners of the tabernacle in the far part.

hausa: Sai na kira ga sunan Ubangiji na ce, “Ya Ubangiji, ka cece ni!”
english: Then I called on Yahweh’s name: “Yahweh, I beg you, deliver my soul.”

hausa: Dawuda ya ce, “Ga māshin sarki, ka aiko wani saurayi yă zo yă karɓa.
english: David answered, “Behold the spear, O king! Let one of the young men come over and get it.

hausa: “Gare ka dai, ka yi tafiyarka har zuwa ƙarshe. Za ka huta, sa’an nan a ƙarshen kwanaki za ka tashi don karɓi sashen gadon da aka ba ka.”
english: “But go your way until the end; for you will rest, and will stand in your inheritance at the end of the days.”

hausa: in ka kawar da zunubin da yake hannunka, ba ka bar zunubi ya kasance tare da kai ba
english: If iniquity is in your hand, put it far away. Don’t let unrighteousness dwell in your tents.

hausa: Sa’an nan Ruhun Ubangiji ya sauko masa da iko. Sai ya fita ya gangara zuwa Ashkelon, ya kashe mutanensu talatin, ya kwashe kayansu ya kuma ba da rigunarsu ga waɗanda suka bayyana kacici-kacicin. Cike da fushi, ya haura zuwa gidan mahaifinsa.
english: Yahweh’s Spirit came mightily on him, and he went down to Ashkelon and struck thirty men of them. He took their plunder, then gave the changes of clothing to those who declared the riddle. His anger burned, and he went up to his father’s house.

hausa: A cikin wahayin ya kai ni can, na kuma ga mutum wanda kamanninsa ya yi kamar tagulla; yana tsaye a hanyar shiga yana riƙe da igiyar lilin da kuma karan awo a hannunsa.
english: He brought me there; and, behold, there was a man whose appearance was like the appearance of bronze, with a line of flax in his hand and a measuring reed; and he stood in the gate.

hausa: Suka yi ƙahoni a kusurwansa huɗu, ƙahonin da bagade a haɗe suke, suka kuma dalaye bagaden da tagulla.
english: He made its horns on its four corners. Its horns were of one piece with it, and he overlaid it with bronze.

hausa: Tagullar da sarki Solomon ya yi wa haikalin Ubangiji da ita, wato, ginshiƙai biyu, da ƙaton kwano mai suna Teku na tagulla, da bijimai goma sha biyu, waɗanda suke ɗauke da kwatarniya, da dakalai, ta fi ƙarfin a auna.
english: They took the two pillars, the one sea, and the twelve bronze bulls that were under the bases, which King Solomon had made for Yahweh’s house. The bronze of all these vessels was without weight.

hausa: Duk mai lahani, ko makaho, ko gurgu, ko mai naƙasa, ko mai wani lahani a jiki;
english: For whatever man he is that has a defect, he shall not draw near: a blind man, or a lame, or he who has a flat nose, or any deformity,

hausa: Amma maganata da dokokina da na umarta ta wurin bayina annabawa fa, ashe, ba su tabbata ba a kan kakanninku? “Sa’an nan suka tuba suka ce, ‘Ubangiji Maɗaukaki ya yi mana daidai abin da hanyoyinmu suka cancanci mu samu, kamar dai yadda ya yi niyya yi.’ ”
english: But my words and my decrees, which I commanded my servants the prophets, didn’t they overtake your fathers? “Then they repented and said, ‘Just as Yahweh of Armies determined to do to us, according to our ways and according to our practices, so he has dealt with us.’”

hausa: in kuma kuka ce, ‘A’a, za mu tafi mu zauna a Masar, inda ba za mu ga yaƙi ko mu ji ƙarar ƙaho ko mu ji yunwa ba,’
english: saying, “No, but we will go into the land of Egypt, where we will see no war, nor hear the sound of the trumpet, nor have hunger of bread; and there we will dwell;”’

hausa: Saboda haka sai Musa ya gaya wa Isra’ilawa su yi Bikin Ƙetarewa,
english: Moses told the children of Israel that they should keep the Passover.

hausa: Na duba, can kuwa a gabana ga wani farin doki! Mai hawansa yana riƙe da baka, aka kuma ba shi rawani, ya yi sukuwa ya fito kamar mai nasara da ya kutsa don nasara.
english: Then a white horse appeared, and he who sat on it had a bow. A crown was given to him, and he came out conquering, and to conquer.

hausa: kuma bai kawo shi a ƙofar Tentin Sujada don yă miƙa shi ga Ubangiji ba, dole a raba wannan mutum da mutanensa.
english: and doesn’t bring it to the door of the Tent of Meeting to sacrifice it to Yahweh, that man shall be cut off from his people.

hausa: “In akwai cutar fatar jiki a riguna, duk wani rigar ulu ko na lilin,
english: “The garment also that the plague of leprosy is in, whether it is a woolen garment, or a linen garment;

hausa: “Duba, zan sa ka cikin abin sussuka, saboda kuma mai kaifi mai haƙora da yawa. Za ka yi sussukar duwatsu ka ragargaza su, ka kuma farfashe tuddai su zama kamar yayi.
english: Behold, I have made you into a new sharp threshing instrument with teeth. You will thresh the mountains, and beat them small, and will make the hills like chaff.

hausa: Sai Farisiyawa suka tambaye shi suka ce, “Ga kai dai, kana yi wa kanka shaida, shaidarka kuwa ba tabbatacciya ba ce.”
english: The Pharisees therefore said to him, “You testify about yourself. Your testimony is not valid.”

hausa: Sai ya ce mata, “Je ki zo da mijinki.”
english: Jesus said to her, “Go, call your husband, and come here.”

hausa: Gama zunubi, da ya sami dama ta wurin umarni, sai ya ruɗe ni, kuma ta wurin umarnin kuwa ya kashe ni.
english: for sin, finding occasion through the commandment, deceived me, and through it killed me.

hausa: Sai dukan garin suka fito don su taryi Yesu. Da suka kuwa gan shi, sai suka roƙe shi yă bar musu yanki.
english: Behold, all the city came out to meet Jesus. When they saw him, they begged that he would depart from their borders.

hausa: da shanu biyu, raguna biyar, bunsurai biyar da kuma ’yan raguna biyar, dukansu bana ɗaya-ɗaya, a miƙa su hadaya ta salama. Wannan ita ce hadayar Abidan ɗan Gideyoni.
english: and for the sacrifice of peace offerings, two head of cattle, five rams, five male goats, and five male lambs a year old. This was the offering of Abidan the son of Gideoni.

hausa: A wannan zance kam, ina magana da ku kamar ’ya’yana, ku ma ku saki zuciya da mu.
english: Now in return—I speak as to my children—you also open your hearts.

hausa: Zai rurrushe manyan katangar kagaru ya kuma ƙasƙantar da su; zai rushe su har ƙasa, su zama ƙura.
english: He has brought the high fortress of your walls down, laid low, and brought to the ground, even to the dust.

hausa: “Saboda haka ta yaya za ku iya yi mini ta’aziyya da surutan banzan nan naku? Babu wani abu cikin amsarku sai ƙarya!”
english: So how can you comfort me with nonsense, because in your answers there remains only falsehood?”

hausa: Yabo ya tabbata ga Allah Uban Ubangijinmu Yesu Kiristi, wanda ya kawo mana kowace albarka ta ruhaniya daga sama.
english: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who has blessed us with every spiritual blessing in the heavenly places in Christ,

hausa: Na lulluɓe gadona da lili masu launi dabam-dabam daga Masar.
english: I have spread my couch with carpets of tapestry, with striped cloths of the yarn of Egypt.

hausa: Sa’an nan za ku yi kira, Ubangiji kuma zai amsa; za ku yi kuka don neman taimako, zai kuwa ce ga ni nan. “In kuka kawar da karkiyar zalunci, kuka daina nuna wa juna yatsa da kuma faɗar mugayen maganganu,
english: Then you will call, and Yahweh will answer. You will cry for help, and he will say, ‘Here I am.’ “If you take away from among you the yoke, finger pointing, and speaking wickedly;

hausa: A karɓe rigunan wanda ya ɗauki lamunin baƙo; a riƙe shi jingina in ya yi shi don mace marar aminci.
english: Take his garment when he puts up collateral for a stranger. Hold it for a wayward woman!

hausa: “ ‘Ta ɗebi waɗansu irin ƙasarku ta sa a ƙasa mai taƙi. Ta shuka shi kamar itacen wardi kusa da ruwa mai yawa,
english: “‘“He also took some of the seed of the land and planted it in fruitful soil. He placed it beside many waters. He set it as a willow tree.

hausa: Ubangiji zai ba shi ƙarfi a gadon rashin lafiyarsa ya mayar masa da lafiya daga ciwon da ya kwantar da shi.
english: Yahweh will sustain him on his sickbed, and restore him from his bed of illness.

hausa: Ashe, ba zai ce masa, ‘Ka shirya mini abincin yamma, ka shirya ka yi mini hidima domin in ci in sha, bayan haka kana iya ci, ka kuma sha ba’?
english: Wouldn’t he rather tell him, ‘Prepare my supper, clothe yourself properly, and serve me while I eat and drink. Afterward you shall eat and drink’?

hausa: To, game da tara kuɗi domin taimakon mutanen Allah, ku yi abin da na gaya wa ikkilisiyoyin Galatiyawa.
english: Now concerning the collection for the saints: as I commanded the assemblies of Galatia, you do likewise.

hausa: Azel yana da ’ya’ya maza shida, kuma ga sunayensu. Azrikam, Bokeru, Ishmayel, Sheyariya, Obadiya da Hanan. Waɗannan su ne ’ya’yan Azel maza.
english: Azel had six sons, whose names are Azrikam, Bocheru, Ishmael, Sheariah, Obadiah, and Hanan. These were the sons of Azel.

hausa: Ka bar bawanka yă koma, don in mutu a garina, kusa da kabarin mahaifina da mahaifiyata. Amma ga bawanka Kimham. Bari yă ƙetare tare da ranka yă daɗe, sarki. Ka yi abin da ka ga dama da shi.”
english: Please let your servant turn back again, that I may die in my own city, by the grave of my father and my mother. But behold, your servant Chimham; let him go over with my lord the king; and do to him what shall seem good to you.”

hausa: Yi kuka saboda ita, dukanku mazaunan kewayenta, duk waɗanda suka san shahararta; ku ce, ‘Dubi yadda sandan sarauta mai iko ya karye, dubi yadda sanda mai daraja ya karye!’
english: All you who are around him, bemoan him; and all you who know his name, say, ‘How the strong staff is broken, the beautiful rod!’

hausa: Na san wani a cikin Kiristi wanda shekaru goma sha huɗu da suka wuce an ɗauke zuwa sama ta uku. Ko a cikin jiki ne, ko kuwa ba a cikin jiki ba, ni dai ban sani ba, Allah ne ya sani.
english: I know a man in Christ who was caught up into the third heaven fourteen years ago—whether in the body, I don’t know, or whether out of the body, I don’t know; God knows.

hausa: “Sa’ad da an ci mutanenka Isra’ila a yaƙi ta wurin abokin gāba domin sun yi maka zunubi kuma sa’ad da suka juya suka furta sunanka, suna addu’a suka kuma yin roƙe-roƙe a gabanka a wannan haikali,
english: “If your people Israel are struck down before the enemy because they have sinned against you, and they turn again and confess your name, and pray and make supplication before you in this house,

hausa: Masu fafarar mu sun fi gaggafa mai firiya a sararin sama sauri; sun fafare mu a kan duwatsu suna fakon mu a jeji.
english: Our pursuers were swifter than the eagles of the sky. They chased us on the mountains. They set an ambush for us in the wilderness.

hausa: Zan sa mabuɗin gidan Dawuda a kafaɗarsa; abin da ya buɗe ba mai rufewa, kuma abin da ya rufe ba mai buɗewa.
english: I will lay the key of David’s house on his shoulder. He will open, and no one will shut. He will shut, and no one will open.

hausa: “Dole a ci shi a cikin gida ɗaya; kada a kai naman waje. Kada a karya wani daga ƙasusuwansa.
english: It must be eaten in one house. You shall not carry any of the meat outside of the house. Do not break any of its bones.

hausa: In kun shiga gonar hatsin maƙwabcinku, za ku iya murmure tsabar da hannuwanku, amma kada ku sa lauje ku yanka hatsinsa da yake tsaye.
english: When you come into your neighbor’s standing grain, then you may pluck the ears with your hand; but you shall not use a sickle on your neighbor’s standing grain.

hausa: Bugu da ƙari, bisa ga bukatar Daniyel sai sarki yă naɗa Shadrak da Meshak da Abednego su zama masu kula da harkokin lardin Babilon, amma Daniyel kuma ya tsaya a fadar sarki.
english: Daniel requested of the king, and he appointed Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego over the affairs of the province of Babylon, but Daniel was in the king’s gate.

hausa: Tsawon labule na wajen gefen arewa kamu ɗari ne, yana kuma da sanduna guda ashirin da rammuka ashirin na tagulla, da ƙugiyoyin azurfa da maɗaurai a kan sandunan.
english: For the north side one hundred cubits, their pillars twenty, and their sockets twenty, of bronze; the hooks of the pillars, and their fillets, of silver.

hausa: Ta haka aka gama yin sammai da duniya da dukan abubuwan da suke cikinsu.
english: The heavens, the earth, and all their vast array were finished.

hausa: Amma abu ɗaya tak ake bukata, Maryamu ta zaɓi abin da ya fi kyau, kuma ba za a raba ta da shi ba.”
english: but one thing is needed. Mary has chosen the good part, which will not be taken away from her.”

hausa: Ya zauna a kujeransa inda ya saba zama kusa da bango yana fuskantar Yonatan, Abner kuma ya zauna kusa da sarki. Amma kujeran Dawuda ba kowa.
english: The king sat on his seat, as at other times, even on the seat by the wall; and Jonathan stood up, and Abner sat by Saul’s side, but David’s place was empty.

hausa: Sai Na’aman da dukan masu hidimarsa suka koma wurin mutumin Allah. Na’aman ya tsaya a gaban mutumin Allah ya ce, “Yanzu na san cewa babu wani Allah a duk duniya sai a Isra’ila. Ina roƙonka ka karɓi kyauta daga hannun bawanka.”
english: He returned to the man of God, he and all his company, and came, and stood before him; and he said, “See now, I know that there is no God in all the earth, but in Israel. Now therefore, please take a gift from your servant.”

hausa: To, da dukan sarakunan Amoriyawa na yammancin Urdun, da dukan sarakunan Kan’aniyawan da suke bakin teku suka ji yadda Ubangiji ya busar da kogin Urdun a gaban Isra’ilawa, har sai da dukansu suka ƙetare, zuciyarsu ta narke, suka karaya sosai har ma suka rasa samun ƙarfin hali su fuskanci Isra’ilawa.
english: When all the kings of the Amorites, who were beyond the Jordan westward, and all the kings of the Canaanites, who were by the sea, heard how Yahweh had dried up the waters of the Jordan from before the children of Israel until we had crossed over, their heart melted, and there was no more spirit in them, because of the children of Israel.

hausa: Nan gaba, sa’ad da ’ya’yanku suka tambaye ku, “Mene ne ma’anar farillai, ƙa’idodi da kuma dokokin da Ubangiji Allahnmu ya umarce ku?”
english: When your son asks you in time to come, saying, “What do the testimonies, the statutes, and the ordinances, which Yahweh our God has commanded you mean?”

hausa: Biye da su, Zadok ɗan Immer ya yi gyare-gyaren ɗaura da gidansa. Biye da shi, Shemahiya ɗan Shekaniya, mai tsaron Ƙofar Gabas ya yi gyare-gyare.
english: After them, Zadok the son of Immer made repairs across from his own house. After him, Shemaiah the son of Shecaniah, the keeper of the east gate, made repairs.

hausa: Kashegari da sassafe suka tashi suka yi sujada a gaban Ubangiji, sai suka koma garinsu a Rama. Elkana kuwa ya kwana da matarsa Hannatu, Ubangiji kuma ya tuna da ita.
english: They rose up in the morning early and worshiped Yahweh, then returned and came to their house to Ramah. Then Elkanah knew Hannah his wife; and Yahweh remembered her.

hausa: Harshenka kan shirya hallaka; yana nan kamar reza mai ci, kana ta ruɗu.
english: Your tongue plots destruction, like a sharp razor, working deceitfully.

hausa: Waɗannan su ne zuriyar Isuwa (wato, Edom).
english: Now this is the history of the generations of Esau (that is, Edom).

hausa: Ahiyo, Shashak, Yeremot
english: and Ahio, Shashak, Jeremoth,

hausa: Iliya ya ce wa annabawan Ba’al, “Ku ku fara zaɓi bijimi ɗaya, ku shirya, da yake kuna da yawa. Ku kira a bisa sunan allahnku, amma kada ku ƙuna wuta.”
english: Elijah said to the prophets of Baal, “Choose one bull for yourselves, and dress it first, for you are many; and call on the name of your god, but put no fire under it.”

hausa: Wane ne yake gaya masa abin da ya yi? Wane ne yake rama abin da ya yi?
english: Who will declare his way to his face? Who will repay him what he has done?

hausa: suka kuma yi musayar ɗaukakar Allah marar mutuwa da siffofin da aka ƙera su yi kama da mutum mai mutuwa da tsuntsaye da dabbobi da kuma halittu masu ja da ciki.
english: and traded the glory of the incorruptible God for the likeness of an image of corruptible man, and of birds, four-footed animals, and creeping things.

hausa: Ya yi karin magana dubu uku. Waƙoƙinsa kuwa sun kai dubu ɗaya da biyar.
english: He spoke three thousand proverbs, and his songs numbered one thousand five.

hausa: Bai kamata ki rena ɗan’uwanki a ranar masifarsa ba, ko ki yi farin ciki a kan mutanen Yahuda a ranar hallakarsu, ko ki yi fariya sosai a ranar wahalarsu.
english: But don’t look down on your brother in the day of his disaster, and don’t rejoice over the children of Judah in the day of their destruction. Don’t speak proudly in the day of distress.

hausa: Ban da haka, sukan koyi zaman banza, suna zirga-zirga gida-gida. Ba kawai sun zama masu zaman banza ba, har ma sun zama masu gulma da masu shisshigi, suna faɗin abubuwan da bai kamata su faɗa ba.
english: Besides, they also learn to be idle, going about from house to house. Not only idle, but also gossips and busybodies, saying things which they ought not.

hausa: Waɗannan su ne sunayen ’ya’yan Isuwa maza, Elifaz, ɗan Ada matar Isuwa, da Reyuwel ɗan Basemat matar Isuwa.
english: these are the names of Esau’s sons: Eliphaz, the son of Adah, the wife of Esau; and Reuel, the son of Basemath, the wife of Esau.

hausa: Absalom kuwa yakan ƙara da cewa, “Da a ce an naɗa ni alƙali a ƙasar mana! Da duk mai ƙara, ko kuka wanda zai zo wurina, zan in tabbatar an yi masa adalci.”
english: Absalom said moreover, “Oh that I were made judge in the land, that every man who has any suit or cause might come to me, and I would do him justice!”

hausa: Amma da yake sun ga mutumin da aka warkar yana tsaye a wurin tare da su, sai suka rasa abin faɗi.
english: Seeing the man who was healed standing with them, they could say nothing against it.

hausa: Irin tsaran waɗanda suke nemansa ke nan, waɗanda suke neman fuskarka, ya Allah na Yaƙub. Sela
english: This is the generation of those who seek Him, who seek your face—even Jacob. Selah.

hausa: Ubangiji ya yi haka da ni bisa ga adalcina; bisa ga tsabtar hannuwana ya ba ni lada.
english: Yahweh has rewarded me according to my righteousness. According to the cleanness of my hands, he has recompensed me.

hausa: al’umma mai zafin hali wadda ba ta ba wa tsofaffi girma, kuma ba ta tausayin yara.
english: a nation of fierce facial expressions, that doesn’t respect the elderly, nor show favor to the young.

hausa: Suka tashi daga Mitka, suka yi sansani a Hashmona.
english: They traveled from Mithkah, and encamped in Hashmonah.

hausa: Bunsurun kuwa sarkin Girka ne, kuma babban ƙahon da yake tsakanin idanunsa, sarki na farko ne.
english: The rough male goat is the king of Greece. The great horn that is between his eyes is the first king.

hausa: “Ku macizai! ’Ya’yan macizai! Ta yaya za ku tsere wa hukuncin jahannama ta wuta?
english: You serpents, you offspring of vipers, how will you escape the judgment of Gehenna?

hausa: tukwane, manyan cokula, cokula masu yatsu don nama da dukan kayayyakin da suka shafi wannan. Dukan kayayyakin da Huram-Abi ya yi domin Sarki Solomon saboda haikalin Ubangiji an yi su da gogaggen tagulla ne.
english: Huram-abi also made the pots, the shovels, the forks, and all its vessels for King Solomon, for Yahweh’s house, of bright bronze.

hausa: Eliyab Yeroham, Elkana da Sama’ila.
english: Eliab his son, Jeroham his son, and Elkanah his son.

hausa: ta Ara 652
english: The children of Arah: six hundred fifty-two.

hausa: Sai Hushai mutumin Arkitawa, abokin Dawuda ya je wurin Absalom ya ce masa, “Ran sarki yă daɗe! Ran sarki yă daɗe!”
english: When Hushai the Archite, David’s friend, had come to Absalom, Hushai said to Absalom, “Long live the king! Long live the king!”

hausa: to, sa’ad da aka ci ƙasar a gaban Ubangiji, kwa kuɓuta daga alhakinku ga Ubangiji da kuma Isra’ila. Ƙasan nan kuwa za tă zama mallakarku a gaban Ubangiji.
english: and the land is subdued before Yahweh; then afterward you shall return, and be clear of obligation to Yahweh and to Israel. Then this land shall be your possession before Yahweh.

hausa: Ku matan da kuke zaman jin daɗi, ku tashi ku saurare ni; ku ’yan matan da kuke tsammani kuna da kāriya, ku ji abin da zan faɗa!
english: Rise up, you women who are at ease! Hear my voice! You careless daughters, give ear to my speech!

hausa: A shekara ta tara ta Zedekiya sarkin Yahuda, a wata na goma, Nebukadnezzar sarkin Babilon ya fita yaƙi da Urushalima da dukan sojojinsa ya kuma yi mata ƙawanya.
english: In the ninth year of Zedekiah king of Judah, in the tenth month, Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon and all his army came against Jerusalem, and besieged it.

hausa: Wa ya san ƙarfin fushinka? Gama hasalarka tana da girma kamar tsoron da ya dace da kai.
english: Who knows the power of your anger, your wrath according to the fear that is due to you?

hausa: Bari Allah yă sa sunansa yă kasance, yă hamɓarar da duka wani sarki ko mutanen da za su sa hannu don a sāke wannan doka, ko kuma don su rushe haikalin nan a Urushalima. Ni Dariyus na ba da wannan umarni, bari a yi biyayya babu wasa.
english: May the God who has caused his name to dwell there overthrow all kings and peoples who stretch out their hand to alter this, to destroy this house of God which is at Jerusalem. I Darius have made a decree. Let it be done with all diligence.

hausa: Saboda haka mutane masu ƙarfi za su girmama ka; biranen mugayen al’ummai za su ji tsoronka.
english: Therefore a strong people will glorify you. A city of awesome nations will fear you.

hausa: ina nacewa gaba zuwa ga manufar, don in sami ladar da Allah ya yi mini na kiran nan zuwa sama a cikin Kiristi Yesu.
english: I press on toward the goal for the prize of the high calling of God in Christ Jesus.

hausa: Sharuɗansu sun gamshi Hamor da ɗansa, Shekem.
english: Their words pleased Hamor and Shechem, Hamor’s son.

hausa: haka ma zai zama abinci domin dabbobinku, da kuma namun jeji a ƙasarku. Duk abin da ƙasar ta bayar za a ci.
english: For your livestock also, and for the animals that are in your land, shall all its increase be for food.

hausa: Daga Kogin Shihor a gabashin Masar zuwa sashen Ekron a arewa, dukan wannan ƙasa ana lissafta ta a cikin ƙasar Kan’aniyawa, ko da yake tana a sashen da sarakuna biyar na Filistiyawa na Gaza, Ashdod, Ashkeloniyawa, Gat da Ekron; na Awwiyawa.
english: from the Shihor, which is before Egypt, even to the border of Ekron northward, which is counted as Canaanite; the five lords of the Philistines; the Gazites, and the Ashdodites, the Ashkelonites, the Gittites, and the Ekronites; also the Avvim,

hausa: Na buɗe hannuwana gare ka; raina yana jin ƙishinka kamar busasshiyar ƙasa. Sela
english: I spread out my hands to you. My soul thirsts for you, like a parched land. Selah.

hausa: Ya ɗauki wani ƙaramin yaro ya sa yă tsaya a tsakiyarsu. Ya ɗauke shi a hannunsa, ya ce musu,
english: He took a little child and set him in the middle of them. Taking him in his arms, he said to them,

hausa: “Ba za ka yi wa kanka waɗansu alloli ba sai ni.
english: “You shall have no other gods before me.

hausa: A rana ta takwas, Musa ya kira Haruna da ’ya’yansa maza da kuma dattawan Isra’ila.
english: On the eighth day, Moses called Aaron and his sons, and the elders of Israel;

hausa: Aka jibga su tsibi-tsibi, ƙasar ta yi ɗoyi saboda su.
english: They gathered them together in heaps, and the land stank.

hausa: Yanzu tafi, zan taimake ka ka yi magana, zan kuma koya maka abin da za ka faɗa.”
english: Now therefore go, and I will be with your mouth, and teach you what you shall speak.”

hausa: Ya tambayi mai tsaro na sarki, “Me ya sa sarki ya fitar da wannan doka haka da fushi?” Sai Ariyok ya yi wa Daniyel bayanin batun.
english: He answered Arioch the king’s captain, “Why is the decree so urgent from the king?” Then Arioch made the thing known to Daniel.

hausa: Ka riƙe sandunan da ka yi rubutun a gabansu
english: The sticks on which you write will be in your hand before their eyes.”’

hausa: Da bazara, a lokacin da sarakuna sukan fita zuwa yaƙi, sai Dawuda ya aiki Yowab tare da mutanen sarki, da dukan Isra’ila. Suka je suka hallaka Ammonawa, suka kuma yi wa Rabba kwanton ɓauna. Amma Dawuda ya yi zamansa a Urushalima.
english: At the return of the year, at the time when kings go out, David sent Joab and his servants with him, and all Israel; and they destroyed the children of Ammon and besieged Rabbah. But David stayed at Jerusalem.

hausa: Sai Shawulu ya aiki manzanni zuwa wurin Yesse ya ce, “Ka aiko mini da ɗanka Dawuda wanda yake kiwon tumaki.”
english: Therefore Saul sent messengers to Jesse, and said, “Send me David your son, who is with the sheep.”

hausa: Amma ina abin taƙama in kuka sha duka saboda kun yi laifi kuka kuma jimre? Sai dai in kuka sha wahala saboda yin nagari kuka kuma jimre, abin yabo ne a gaban Allah.
english: For what glory is it if, when you sin, you patiently endure beating? But if when you do well, you patiently endure suffering, this is commendable with God.

hausa: suka jibga hatsinsu a kan jakuna, sai suka kama hanya.
english: They loaded their donkeys with their grain, and departed from there.

hausa: Ku yi shelar azumi mai tsarki; ku kira tsarkakan taro. Ku kira dattawa da kuma dukan mazaunan ƙasar zuwa gidan Ubangiji Allahnku, ku kuma yi kuka ga Ubangiji.
english: Sanctify a fast. Call a solemn assembly. Gather the elders and all the inhabitants of the land to the house of Yahweh, your God, and cry to Yahweh.

hausa: Sai aka ba zuriyar Haruna firist, ƙasar Hebron (garin masu neman mafaka don sun yi kisa), da Libna,
english: To the children of Aaron the priest they gave Hebron with its pasture lands, the city of refuge for the man slayer, Libnah with its pasture lands,

hausa: “Amma in sa’ad da firist ya bincike shi, cutar rigar ba ta yaɗu a rigar, ko a tariyar zare, ko a kayan da aka saƙa, ko a kayan da aka yi da fata ba,
english: “If the priest examines it, and behold, the plague hasn’t spread in the garment, either in the warp, or in the woof, or in anything of skin;

hausa: ko da yake Allah ya ce masa, “Ta wurin Ishaku ne za a lissafta zuriyarka.”
english: to whom it was said, “Your offspring will be accounted as from Isaac,”

hausa: “ ‘Ga abin da Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka yana cewa, “ ‘Zan kawo ƙarshen mutanen Masar ta hannun Nebukadnezzar sarkin Babilon.
english: “‘The Lord Yahweh says: “I will also make the multitude of Egypt to cease, by the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon.

hausa: “Sa’ad da aka haifi ɗan maraƙi, tunkiya, ko akuya, sai yă kasance da mahaifiyarsa kwana bakwai. Daga rana ta takwas zuwa gaba, zai zama yardajje hadaya, hadaya ce da aka ƙone da wuta ga Ubangiji.
english: “When a bull, a sheep, or a goat is born, it shall remain seven days with its mother. From the eighth day on it shall be accepted for the offering of an offering made by fire to Yahweh.

hausa: Sai sarki ya ce, “Ina jikar maigidanka?” Ziba ya ce, “Yana zaune a Urushalima gama yana tsammani cewa, ‘Yau gidan Isra’ila za su mayar mini da sarautar kakana.’ ”
english: The king said, “Where is your master’s son?” Ziba said to the king, “Behold, he is staying in Jerusalem; for he said, ‘Today the house of Israel will restore me the kingdom of my father.’”

hausa: Ya zama kuwa cewa, Hezekiya ya bayar da dukan azurfan da suke a haikalin Ubangiji da kuma a ma’ajin fadan sarki.
english: Hezekiah gave him all the silver that was found in Yahweh’s house and in the treasures of the king’s house.

hausa: “Sa’ad da firist zai ɗauki ɗaya daga cikin ragunan ya kuma miƙa shi kamar hadaya don laifi, tare da moɗan mai; zai kaɗa su a gaban Ubangiji kamar hadaya kaɗawa.
english: “The priest shall take one of the male lambs, and offer him for a trespass offering, with the log of oil, and wave them for a wave offering before Yahweh.

hausa: Sai mala’ikan da yake mini magana ya zo gaba ya ce mini, “Duba ka gani ko mene ne wannan da yake fitowa.”
english: Then the angel who talked with me came forward and said to me, “Lift up now your eyes and see what this is that is appearing.”

hausa: Miriyam ta yi musu waƙa. “Ku rera ga Ubangiji gama ya ci gawurtacciyar nasara. Doki da mahayi, ya jefa cikin teku.”
english: Miriam answered them, “Sing to Yahweh, for he has triumphed gloriously. He has thrown the horse and his rider into the sea.”

hausa: sai dukan Isra’ilawa suka taru a Shilo don su je su yaƙe su.
english: When the children of Israel heard of it, the whole congregation of the children of Israel gathered themselves together at Shiloh, to go up against them to war.

hausa: Ibrahim yana da shekara ɗari, sa’ad da aka haifa masa ɗansa Ishaku.
english: Abraham was one hundred years old when his son, Isaac, was born to him.

hausa: duk da haka yakan yi tanade-tanadensa da rani ya kuma tattara abincinsa a lokacin girbi.
english: provides her bread in the summer, and gathers her food in the harvest.

hausa: Da waɗannan kuma masu tangaɗi saboda sun sha ruwan inabi suke jiri don sun sha barasa Firistoci da annabawa suna tangaɗi saboda sun sha barasa sun kuma yi tatur da ruwan inabi; suna jiri saboda sun sha barasa, suna tangaɗi sa’ad da suke ganin wahayi, suna tuntuɓe sa’ad da suke ba da shawara.
english: They also reel with wine, and stagger with strong drink. The priest and the prophet reel with strong drink. They are swallowed up by wine. They stagger with strong drink. They err in vision. They stumble in judgment.

hausa: Sa’an nan Isra’ila ta yi kwanto kewaya da Gibeya.
english: Israel set ambushes all around Gibeah.

hausa: “ ‘ “Amma fa, duk al’umma ko mulkin da bai bauta wa Nebukadnezzar sarkin Babilon ba bai kuwa rusunar da wuyarsa ga karkiyarsa ba, zan hukunta wannan al’umma da takobi, yunwa da annoba, in ji Ubangiji, har sai na hallaka ta ta wurin hannunsa.
english: “‘“‘It will happen that I will punish the nation and the kingdom which will not serve the same Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and that will not put their neck under the yoke of the king of Babylon,’ says Yahweh, ‘with the sword, with famine, and with pestilence, until I have consumed them by his hand.

hausa: Sai ya fita waje, ya yi kuka mai zafi.
english: He went out, and wept bitterly.

hausa: A ƙwanƙolin dutsen Isra’ila zan shuka shi; zai yi rassa yă ba da ’ya’ya yă kuma zama al’ul mai daraja. Tsuntsaye iri-iri za su yi sheƙa a cikinsa; za su sami mafaka a inuwar rassansa.
english: I will plant it in the mountain of the height of Israel; and it will produce boughs, and bear fruit, and be a good cedar. Birds of every kind will dwell in the shade of its branches.

hausa: “Zan mai da ki kufai da kuma abin dariya a cikin al’ummai kewaye da ke, a gaban dukan waɗanda suke wucewa.
english: “‘Moreover I will make you a desolation and a reproach among the nations that are around you, in the sight of all that pass by.

hausa: Amma a fanshi kowane ɗan farin jakinku da ɗan rago. In kuwa ba za ku fanshe shi ba, sai ku karye wuyansa. Sai ku fanshe kowane ɗan farin daga cikin ’ya’yanku.
english: Every firstborn of a donkey you shall redeem with a lamb; and if you will not redeem it, then you shall break its neck; and you shall redeem all the firstborn of man among your sons.

hausa: “Ubangiji yana a raye! Yabo ta tabbata ga Dutsena! Ɗaukaka ga Allah, Dutse, Mai Cetona!
english: Yahweh lives! Blessed be my rock! Exalted be God, the rock of my salvation,

hausa: gama duka sun yi zunubi suka kuma kāsa ga ɗaukakar Allah,
english: for all have sinned, and fall short of the glory of God;

hausa: Yă tsoma yatsarsa a cikin jinin, yă kuma yafa sau bakwai a gaban Ubangiji, a gaban labulen wuri mai tsarki.
english: The priest shall dip his finger in the blood, and sprinkle some of the blood seven times before Yahweh, before the veil of the sanctuary.

hausa: Sa’an nan firist zai sa rigunarsa ta lilin da kuma rigar lilin da ake sa a ciki, sa’an nan yă kwashe tokan hadaya ta ƙonawa da wuta da ta ci a kan bagaden, yă sa kusa da bagaden.
english: The priest shall put on his linen garment, and he shall put on his linen trousers upon his body; and he shall remove the ashes from where the fire has consumed the burnt offering on the altar, and he shall put them beside the altar.

hausa: Sai ya ce musu, “Raina yana cike da baƙin ciki har kamar zan mutu. Ku dakata a nan, ku kuma yi tsaro tare da ni.”
english: Then Jesus said to them, “My soul is exceedingly sorrowful, even to death. Stay here and watch with me.”

hausa: Sai suka ɗaɗɗauko rassan dabino suka fiffita taryensa, suna ɗaga murya suna cewa, “Hosanna!” “Mai albarka ne wanda yake zuwa cikin sunan Ubangiji!” “Mai albarka ne Sarkin Isra’ila!”
english: they took the branches of the palm trees and went out to meet him, and cried out, “Hosanna! Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord, the King of Israel!”

hausa: Bayan ya faɗi wannan, sai aka ɗauke shi sama a idanunsu sai wani girgije ya rufe shi daga ganinsu.
english: When he had said these things, as they were looking, he was taken up, and a cloud received him out of their sight.

hausa: da ƙasar Gebaliyawa; da dukan Lebanon wajen gabas daga Ba’al-Gad a gindin Dutsen Hermon zuwa Lebo Hamat.
english: and the land of the Gebalites, and all Lebanon, toward the sunrise, from Baal Gad under Mount Hermon to the entrance of Hamath;

hausa: To, fa, shugabannin mutane suka zauna a Urushalima, sauran mutanen kuma suka jefa ƙuri’a don su kawo mutum ɗaya daga kowane mutum goma don su zauna a Urushalima, birni mai tsarki, yayinda sauran tara suka zauna a garuruwansu.
english: The princes of the people lived in Jerusalem. The rest of the people also cast lots to bring one of ten to dwell in Jerusalem, the holy city, and nine parts in the other cities.

hausa: Don mai bi da kaɗe-kaɗe. Zabura ta Dawuda. Sa’ad da annabi Natan ya zo wurinsa bayan Dawuda ya yi zina da Batsheba. Ka yi mini jinƙai, ya Allah, bisa ga ƙaunarka marar ƙarewa; bisa ga tausayinka mai girma ka shafe laifofina.
english: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David, when Nathan the prophet came to him, after he had gone in to Bathsheba. Have mercy on me, God, according to your loving kindness. According to the multitude of your tender mercies, blot out my transgressions.

hausa: Sa’an nan ya gyara bagaden Ubangiji ya kuma miƙa hadayun salama da kuma hadayun godiya a bagaden, ya kuma faɗa wa Yahuda su bauta wa Ubangiji, Allah na Isra’ila.
english: He built up Yahweh’s altar, and offered sacrifices of peace offerings and of thanksgiving on it, and commanded Judah to serve Yahweh, the God of Israel.

hausa: Sa’ad da Yaƙub ya gama ba da umarnan ga ’ya’yansa maza, sai ya ɗaga ƙafafunsa zuwa gado, ya ja numfashinsa na ƙarshe, aka kuwa tara shi ga mutanensa.
english: When Jacob finished charging his sons, he gathered up his feet into the bed, breathed his last breath, and was gathered to his people.

hausa: da Amon, da Yosiya.
english: Amon his son, and Josiah his son.

hausa: “ ‘Ga abin da Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka yana cewa a ranar, tunani zai shiga cikin zuciyarka za ka kuma ƙirƙiro muguwar dabara.
english: “‘The Lord Yahweh says: “It will happen in that day that things will come into your mind, and you will devise an evil plan.

hausa: suka yi tambaya suka ce, “Ina shi wanda aka haifa sarkin Yahudawa? Gama mun ga tauraronsa a gabas mun kuwa zo ne domin mu yi masa sujada.”
english: “Where is he who is born King of the Jews? For we saw his star in the east, and have come to worship him.”

hausa: yadda zai ji ƙyamar abinci, har yă ƙi son abinci mafi daɗi.
english: so that his life abhors bread, and his soul dainty food.

hausa: Gizagizai suna zubo da raɓarsu kuma ruwan sama yana zubowa ’yan adam a wadace.
english: which the skies pour down and which drop on man abundantly.

hausa: ta Shefatiya 372
english: The children of Shephatiah, three hundred seventy-two.

hausa: ta Fahat-Mowab (ta wurin Yeshuwa da Yowab) 2,812
english: The children of Pahathmoab, of the children of Jeshua and Joab, two thousand eight hundred twelve.

hausa: Ba ku ga wata siffa a ranar da Ubangiji ya yi magana da ku a Horeb daga wuta ba. Saboda haka ku lura da kanku sosai,
english: Be very careful, for you saw no kind of form on the day that Yahweh spoke to you in Horeb out of the middle of the fire,

hausa: “ ‘Mutanen Bet Togarma sun sayi kayan cinikinki da dawakai, dawakan yaƙi da alfadarai.
english: “‘“They of the house of Togarmah traded for your wares with horses, war horses, and mules.

hausa: da kuma don ƙasar mutanena, da ƙasar da ƙayayyuwa da sarƙaƙƙiya ne suka yi girma, I, ku yi kuka saboda dukan gidajen da dā ake biki da kuma domin wannan birnin da dā ake murna a ciki.
english: Thorns and briers will come up on my people’s land; yes, on all the houses of joy in the joyous city.

hausa: “Ba mai yin faci da sabon ƙyalle a kan tsohuwar riga, gama facin zai kece rigar yă sa kecewar ma ta fi ta dā muni.
english: No one puts a piece of unshrunk cloth on an old garment; for the patch would tear away from the garment, and a worse hole is made.

hausa: to, cutar fatar jikin ne mai ƙarfi kuma firist zai furta shi marar tsarki. Ba zai kaɗaice shi ba, domin ya riga ya zama marar tsarki.
english: it is a chronic leprosy in the skin of his body, and the priest shall pronounce him unclean. He shall not isolate him, for he is already unclean.

hausa: Sa’ad da kuke bayin zunubi, ba ruwanku da aikin adalci.
english: For when you were servants of sin, you were free from righteousness.

hausa: Setur ɗan Mika’ilu, daga kabilar Asher;
english: Of the tribe of Asher, Sethur the son of Michael.

hausa: Mutane masu tsoron Allah suka binne Istifanus suka kuma yi makoki ƙwarai dominsa.
english: Devout men buried Stephen and lamented greatly over him.

hausa: Da rana tana fāɗuwa, sai kuka ta bazu cikin mayaƙa, “Kowane mutum ya tafi garinsu; kowa ya tafi ƙasarsa!”
english: A cry went throughout the army about the going down of the sun, saying, “Every man to his city, and every man to his country!”

hausa: kuma saboda Ubangiji ya ƙaunace shi, sai ya aika da saƙo ta wurin annabi Natan yă ba shi suna Yedidiya.
english: and he sent by the hand of Nathan the prophet, and he named him Jedidiah, for Yahweh’s sake.

hausa: Ya amsa ya ce, “Duk wanda ya saki matarsa, ya auri wata, yana da laifin aikata zina a kan matar da ya saki.
english: He said to them, “Whoever divorces his wife and marries another commits adultery against her.

hausa: Muka ƙaunace ku ƙwarai har muka ji daɗin bayyana muku, ba bisharar Allah kaɗai ba amma har rayukanmu ma, domin kun zama ƙaunatattu a gare mu.
english: Even so, affectionately longing for you, we were well pleased to impart to you not the Good News of God only, but also our own souls, because you had become very dear to us.

hausa: ’Yan’uwansa suka yi kishinsa, amma mahaifinsa ya riƙe batun nan a zuciya.
english: His brothers envied him, but his father kept this saying in mind.

hausa: Da dukan Isra’ila suka ga sarki ya ƙi yă saurare su, sai suka amsa wa sarki, “Ina ruwanmu da Dawuda! Ai! Ba mu da gādo wurin ɗan Yesse. Ya Isra’ila, kowa yă koma tentinsa! Dawuda, sai ka lura da gidanka!” Saboda haka Isra’ilawa suka watse zuwa gida.
english: When all Israel saw that the king didn’t listen to them, the people answered the king, saying, “What portion have we in David? We don’t have an inheritance in the son of Jesse. To your tents, Israel! Now see to your own house, David.” So Israel departed to their tents.

hausa: Amma waɗansunsu ba su iya yin Bikin Ƙetarewa a ranar ba gama sun ƙazantu ta wurin taɓa gawa. Saboda haka suka zo wurin Musa da Haruna a wannan rana
english: There were certain men who were unclean because of the dead body of a man, so that they could not keep the Passover on that day, and they came before Moses and Aaron on that day.

hausa: Ka sha ɗamara kamar namiji; zan yi maka tambaya, za ka kuwa amsa mini.
english: Brace yourself like a man, for I will question you, then you answer me!

hausa: Za ku yi tashin yarinya, amma wani ne zai ɗauke ta yă kwana da ita. Za ku gina gida amma wani ne zai zauna a ciki. Za ku shuka inabi, amma ba za ku ma fara jin daɗin ’ya’yansa ba.
english: You will betroth a wife, and another man shall lie with her. You will build a house, and you won’t dwell in it. You will plant a vineyard, and not use its fruit.

hausa: Bayan haka, ka ɗauki ƙirjin ragon domin naɗin Haruna, ka kaɗa shi a gaban Ubangiji kamar hadaya ta kaɗawa. Wannan ƙirji zai zama rabonka.
english: “You shall take the breast of Aaron’s ram of consecration, and wave it for a wave offering before Yahweh. It shall be your portion.

hausa: da ba ya jin muryar gardi, kome dabarar gwanin mai waƙar zai zama.
english: which doesn’t listen to the voice of charmers, no matter how skillful the charmer may be.

hausa: In wannan labari ya kai kunnen gwamna, za mu lallashe shi, mu kuma kāre ku daga duk wata wahala.”
english: If this comes to the governor’s ears, we will persuade him and make you free of worry.”

hausa: Haka ma Ubanku da yake cikin sama ba ya so ko ɗaya daga cikin ƙananan nan yă ɓace.
english: Even so it is not the will of your Father who is in heaven that one of these little ones should perish.

hausa: Nebuzaradan shugaban matsara ya tafi da waɗannan mutane wurin Sarkin Babilon a Ribla,
english: Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard took them, and brought them to the king of Babylon to Riblah.

hausa: ‘Kira gare ni zan kuwa amsa maka in kuma faɗa maka manyan abubuwan da ba a iya kaiwa, da ba ka sani ba.’
english: ‘Call to me, and I will answer you, and will show you great and difficult things, which you don’t know.’

hausa: Amma in ƙaiƙayin ya yaɗu a cikin fatar jikin bayan aka furta shi tsarkakakke,
english: But if the itch spreads in the skin after his cleansing,

hausa: In hankalinmu a taɓe yake, ai, saboda Allah ne, in kuwa cikin hankalinmu muke, ai, saboda ku ne.
english: For if we are beside ourselves, it is for God. Or if we are of sober mind, it is for you.

hausa: Duk wanda ya rena umarni zai ɗanɗana ƙodarsa, amma duk wanda ya yi biyayya da umarni zai sami lada.
english: Whoever despises instruction will pay for it, but he who respects a command will be rewarded.

hausa: Sa’an nan ya ce, “Ga ni nan, na zo in aikata nufinka.” Ya kawar da na farkon domin yă kafa na biyun.
english: then he has said, “Behold, I have come to do your will.” He takes away the first, that he may establish the second,

hausa: Duk da haka, maganar sarki ya rinjayi Yowab da komandodin soja, sai suka tashi daga gaban sarki, suka tafi su ƙirga mayaƙan Isra’ila.
english: Notwithstanding, the king’s word prevailed against Joab and against the captains of the army. Joab and the captains of the army went out from the presence of the king to count the people of Israel.

hausa: ’Ya’yan Ham maza su ne, Kush, Masar Fut da Kan’ana.
english: The sons of Ham: Cush, Mizraim, Put, and Canaan.

hausa: cewa ‘Zan kafa zuriyarka har abada in kuma sa kursiyinka yă tsaya daram dukan zamanai.’ ” Sela
english: ‘I will establish your offspring forever, and build up your throne to all generations.’” Selah.

hausa: Yayinda yake faɗin wannan, sai wani mai mulki ya zo ya durƙusa a gabansa ya ce, “Yanzu-yanzu diyata ta rasu. Amma ka zo ka ɗibiya hannunka a kanta, za tă kuwa rayu.”
english: While he told these things to them, behold, a ruler came and worshiped him, saying, “My daughter has just died, but come and lay your hand on her, and she will live.”

hausa: Ba shakka ka riga ka ji abin da sarkin Assuriya ya yi da dukan ƙasashe, yana hallaka su gaba ɗaya. Kai kuwa kana ji za a cece ka?
english: Behold, you have heard what the kings of Assyria have done to all lands, by destroying them utterly. Will you be delivered?

hausa: Sai suka sa Yason da sauran su biya kuɗin saki sa’an nan suka sallame su.
english: When they had taken security from Jason and the rest, they let them go.

hausa: Saboda haka ka miƙa su ga abokan gābansu waɗanda suka yi musu danniya. Amma sa’ad da ake danniyarsu sai suka yi kuka gare ka. Daga sama ka ji su, cikin jinƙanka mai girma kuwa ka ba su mai ceto, wanda ya fisshe su daga hannun abokan gābansu.
english: Therefore you delivered them into the hand of their adversaries, who distressed them. In the time of their trouble, when they cried to you, you heard from heaven; and according to your manifold mercies you gave them saviors who saved them out of the hands of their adversaries.

hausa: Zan cire sunayen Ba’al daga leɓunanta; ba za a ƙara kira sunayensu ba.
english: For I will take away the names of the Baals out of her mouth, and they will no longer be mentioned by name.

hausa: “In da na danne wa bayina maza da mata hakkinsu, sa’ad da suke da damuwa da ni,
english: “If I have despised the cause of my male servant or of my female servant, when they contended with me,

hausa: “Ubangiji, kai mai adalci ne, amma a yau kunya ta rufe mu, mutanen Yahuda da mutanen Urushalima da na dukan Isra’ila, waɗanda suke kusa da kuma nesa, a dukan ƙasashen da ka warwatsa mu saboda rashin amincinmu a gare ka.
english: “Lord, righteousness belongs to you, but to us confusion of face, as it is today; to the men of Judah, and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and to all Israel, who are near and who are far off, through all the countries where you have driven them, because of their trespass that they have trespassed against you.

hausa: Za a ba Heldai, Tobiya, Yedahiya da kuma Hen ɗan Zefaniya kamar abin tunawa a cikin haikalin Ubangiji.
english: The crowns shall be to Helem, to Tobijah, to Jedaiah, and to Hen the son of Zephaniah, for a memorial in Yahweh’s temple.

hausa: Sai Bitrus ya zo wurin Yesu ya yi masa tambaya ya ce, “Ubangiji, sau nawa zan yafe wa ɗan’uwana sa’ad da ya yi mini zunubi? Har sau bakwai?”
english: Then Peter came and said to him, “Lord, how often shall my brother sin against me, and I forgive him? Until seven times?”

hausa: cikin wannan al’amari kuwa kada wani yă yi wa ɗan’uwansa laifi ko yă cuce shi. Ubangiji zai hukunta mutane saboda dukan irin waɗannan zunubai, kamar yadda muka riga muka gaya muku, muka kuma yi muku gargaɗi.
english: that no one should take advantage of and wrong a brother or sister in this matter; because the Lord is an avenger in all these things, as also we forewarned you and testified.

hausa: Sai Ariyok ya kai Daniyel wurin sarki nan take ya ce masa, “Na gano wani mutum daga cikin kamammun kabilar Yahuda wanda zai faɗa wa sarki abin da mafarkin yake nufi.”
english: Then Arioch brought in Daniel before the king in haste, and said this to him: “I have found a man of the children of the captivity of Judah who will make known to the king the interpretation.”

hausa: Da masu kiwon aladun suka ga abin da ya faru, sai suka ruga da gudu zuwa garin da kewaye suka kai labari.
english: When those who fed them saw what had happened, they fled and told it in the city and in the country.

hausa: Wane ne ya taɓa haura zuwa sama ya dawo? Wane ne ya tattara iska a tafin hannuwansa? Wane ne ya nannaɗe ruwaye a cikin rigarsa? Wane ne ya kafa dukan iyakokin duniya? Mene ne sunansa, da kuma sunan ɗansa? Faɗa mini in ka sani!
english: Who has ascended up into heaven, and descended? Who has gathered the wind in his fists? Who has bound the waters in his garment? Who has established all the ends of the earth? What is his name, and what is his son’s name, if you know?

hausa: To, shi ke nan, ban nawaita muku ba. Ashe, sai ku ce dabara na yi muku, na shawo kanku ta hanyar yaudara!
english: Even so, I myself didn’t burden you. But you might say that being crafty, I caught you with deception.

hausa: Yana magana da rana sai ta ƙi yin haske; yana hana taurari yin haske.
english: He commands the sun and it doesn’t rise, and seals up the stars.

hausa: Sa’ad da dukan dattawan Isra’ila suka zo wurin Sarki Dawuda a Hebron, sarki ya yi yarjejjeniya da su a gaban Ubangiji, suka kuwa naɗa Dawuda sarki bisa Isra’ila.
english: So all the elders of Israel came to the king to Hebron, and King David made a covenant with them in Hebron before Yahweh; and they anointed David king over Israel.

hausa: A can Ubangiji zai zama Mai Iko Duka namu. Zai zama kamar inda manyan koguna da rafuffuka suke. Matuƙan jirgin ruwa ba za su kai wurinsu ba, manyan jiragen ruwa ba za su yi zirga-zirga a kansu ba.
english: But there Yahweh will be with us in majesty, a place of wide rivers and streams, in which no galley with oars will go, neither will any gallant ship pass by there.

hausa: Daga baya, Mordekai ya dawo zuwa ƙofar sarki. Amma Haman ya ruga gida, kansa a rufe, saboda baƙin ciki.
english: Mordecai came back to the king’s gate, but Haman hurried to his house, mourning and having his head covered.

hausa: da ƙaramin bijimi guda ɗaya, tunkiya ɗaya, da rago, dukansu bana ɗaya-ɗaya domin hadaya ta ƙonawa;
english: one young bull, one ram, one male lamb a year old, for a burnt offering;
