hausa: Saboda haka sai muka yi azumi, muka kai roƙonmu a wurin Allah, ya kuwa amsa mana.
english: So we fasted and begged our God for this, and he granted our request.

hausa: Yayinda mahaifinsa Tera yana da rai, Haran ya rasu a Ur ta Kaldiyawa, a ƙasar haihuwarsa.
english: Haran died in the land of his birth, in Ur of the Chaldees, while his father Terah was still alive.

hausa: Sai ya tafi ko’ina a Galili, yana wa’azi a majami’unsu, yana kuma fitar da aljanu.
english: He went into their synagogues throughout all Galilee, preaching and casting out demons.

hausa: Ya tsaya, ya kuwa girgiza duniya; ya duba, sai ya sa al’ummai suka yi rawan jiki. Tsofaffin duwatsu sun wargaje daɗaɗɗun tuddai kuma suka rurrushe. Hanyoyinsa dawwammamu ne.
english: He stood, and shook the earth. He looked, and made the nations tremble. The ancient mountains were crumbled. The age-old hills collapsed. His ways are eternal.

hausa: Ba a samun ceto ta wurin wani dabam, gama babu wani suna a ƙarƙashin sama da aka ba wa mutane wanda ta wurinsa dole mu sami ceto.”
english: There is salvation in no one else, for there is no other name under heaven that is given among men, by which we must be saved!”

hausa: Ku yi mana addu’a. Mun tabbata cewa muna da lamiri mai kyau, kuma muna da marmari mu yi rayuwa ta bangirma a ta kowace hanya.
english: Pray for us, for we are persuaded that we have a good conscience, desiring to live honorably in all things.

hausa: Bari a sa addu’ata a gabanka kamar turaren ƙonawa; bari ɗagawa hannuwana ta zama kamar hadayar yamma.
english: Let my prayer be set before you like incense; the lifting up of my hands like the evening sacrifice.

hausa: Bari Ubangiji yă bi da zukatanku ga ƙaunan nan ta Allah da kuma jimirin nan na Kiristi.
english: May the Lord direct your hearts into God’s love and into the perseverance of Christ.

hausa: Sun auro wa kansu da ’ya’yansu ’yan mata mutanen nan, ta haka aka kwaɓa zuriyar da aka tsarkake da ta mutanen nan da suke tare da su. Shugabanni da manyan ma’aikata su ne a gaba-gaba a aikata wannan abin kunya.”
english: For they have taken of their daughters for themselves and for their sons, so that the holy offspring have mixed themselves with the peoples of the lands. Yes, the hand of the princes and rulers has been chief in this trespass.”

hausa: ga abin da Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka yana cewa cikin kishina mai ƙuna na yi magana gāba da sauran al’ummai, da kuma gāba da Edom, gama da farin ciki da reni a zukatansu suka mai da ƙasata mallakarsu don su washe wuraren kiwonta.’
english: therefore the Lord Yahweh says: “Surely in the fire of my jealousy I have spoken against the residue of the nations, and against all Edom, that have appointed my land to themselves for a possession with the joy of all their heart, with despite of soul, to cast it out for a prey.”’

hausa: Da hannu mai ƙarfi da hannu mai iko; Ƙaunarsa madawwamiya ce.
english: with a strong hand, and with an outstretched arm, for his loving kindness endures forever;

hausa: Amma ku yi murna ku kuma yi farin ciki har abada a abin da na halitta, gama zan halicci Urushalima ta zama abin murna mutanenta kuwa abin farin ciki.
english: But be glad and rejoice forever in that which I create; for, behold, I create Jerusalem to be a delight, and her people a joy.

hausa: Kamar yadda son cika buri yakan zo sa’ad da kana da yawan damuwa, haka jawabin wawa yake sa’ad da yake yawan magana.
english: For as a dream comes with a multitude of cares, so a fool’s speech with a multitude of words.

hausa: albarka in kun yi biyayya da umarnan Ubangiji Allahnku, da nake ba ku;
english: the blessing, if you listen to the commandments of Yahweh your God, which I command you today;

hausa: Sa’ad da Ubangiji Allahnku ya kawo ku ƙasar da kuke shiga don ku mallaka, ya kuma kori al’ummai masu yawa a gabanku; wato, Hittiyawa, Girgashiyawa, Amoriyawa, Kan’aniyawa, Ferizziyawa, Hiwiyawa da Yebusiyawa, al’ummai bakwai masu girma da ƙarfi fiye da ku.
english: When Yahweh your God brings you into the land where you go to possess it, and casts out many nations before you—the Hittite, the Girgashite, the Amorite, the Canaanite, the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite—seven nations greater and mightier than you;

hausa: “A wurin mutum ne na kawo kukana? Don me ba zan kāsa haƙuri ba?
english: As for me, is my complaint to man? Why shouldn’t I be impatient?

hausa: Hadayar da ya kawo ita ce, faranti guda ɗaya na azurfa, nauyinsa shekel ɗari ɗaya da talatin, da kuma daro na yayyafawa na azurfa, nauyinsa shekel saba’in, dukan biyu, an auna su bisa ga ma’aunin shekel na tsattsarkan wuri, kowannensu cike da lallausan gari, haɗe da mai kamar hadaya ta gari;
english: gave his offering: one silver platter, the weight of which was a hundred and thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary, both of them full of fine flour mixed with oil for a meal offering;

hausa: Sai Ubangiji ya yi magana daga wutar. Kuka ji furcin kalmomin, amma ba ku ga siffar kome ba, sai dai murya kaɗai kuka ji.
english: Yahweh spoke to you out of the middle of the fire: you heard the voice of words, but you saw no form; you only heard a voice.

hausa: Aka ba wa zuriyar Gershon, waɗanda suke Lawiyawa, rabo. Daga rabin kabilar Manasse, Golan a cikin Bashan (garin masu neman mafaka don sun yi kisa), da Be’eshtera, tare da wuraren kiwonsu, garuruwa biyu ke nan;
english: They gave to the children of Gershon, of the families of the Levites, out of the half-tribe of Manasseh Golan in Bashan with its pasture lands, the city of refuge for the man slayer, and Be Eshterah with its pasture lands: two cities.

hausa: Sai Yeshuwa ɗan Yozadak da sauran firistoci, da Zerubbabel ɗan Sheyaltiyel da abokan aikinsa, suka fara gina bagaden Allah na Isra’ila don miƙa hadaya ta ƙonawa bisa ga abin da yake a rubuce a Dokar Musa mutumin Allah.
english: Then Jeshua the son of Jozadak stood up with his brothers the priests and Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel and his relatives, and built the altar of the God of Israel, to offer burnt offerings on it, as it is written in the law of Moses the man of God.

hausa: (ko da yake mahaifin bai yi ko ɗaya daga cikinsu ba). “Yakan ci abinci a duwatsun tsafi. Yakan ƙazantar da matar maƙwabci.
english: or who does not do any of those things but has eaten at the mountain shrines and defiled his neighbor’s wife,

hausa: Gama masu barci, da dad dare suke barci, masu sha su bugu kuwa, da dad dare suke buguwa.
english: For those who sleep, sleep in the night; and those who are drunk are drunk in the night.

hausa: Ku kasance a cikina, ni kuma zan kasance a cikinku. Babu reshen da zai iya yin ’ya’ya da kansa, dole yă kasance a jikin kuringar inabin. Haka ku ma, ba za ku iya ba da ’ya’ya ba sai kun kasance a cikina.
english: Remain in me, and I in you. As the branch can’t bear fruit by itself unless it remains in the vine, so neither can you, unless you remain in me.

hausa: Waɗanda suke nesa za su zo su taimaka gina haikalin Ubangiji, za ku kuma san cewa Ubangiji Maɗaukaki ne ya aiko ni gare ku. Wannan zai faru in kuka yi biyayya sosai ga Ubangiji Allahnku.”
english: Those who are far off shall come and build in Yahweh’s temple; and you shall know that Yahweh of Armies has sent me to you. This will happen, if you will diligently obey Yahweh your God’s voice.”’”

hausa: Amma Bitrus da Yohanna suka amsa, “Ku shari’anta da kanku ko daidai ne a gaban Allah mu yi muku biyayya maimakon Allah.
english: But Peter and John answered them, “Whether it is right in the sight of God to listen to you rather than to God, judge for yourselves,

hausa: Ɗaukaka ta tabbata ga Allahnmu da Ubanmu har abada abadin. Amin.
english: Now to our God and Father be the glory forever and ever! Amen.

hausa: ’Ya’yan Izhar maza su ne, Shelomit ne ɗan fari.
english: The son of Izhar: Shelomith the chief.

hausa: ’Ya’yan Shem maza su ne, Elam, Asshur, Arfakshad, Lud da Aram. ’Ya’yan Aram maza su ne, Uz, Hul, Geter da Meshek.
english: The sons of Shem: Elam, Asshur, Arpachshad, Lud, Aram, Uz, Hul, Gether, and Meshech.

hausa: “Yanzu fa wannan gargaɗi dominku ne, ku firistoci.
english: “Now, you priests, this commandment is for you.

hausa: Ana nan, sa’ad da Ubangiji ya yi magana da Musa a Masar,
english: On the day when Yahweh spoke to Moses in the land of Egypt,

hausa: Zan sha gabanka in baje duwatsu; zan farfashe ƙofofin tagulla in kuma kakkarye ƙyamaren ƙarfe.
english: “I will go before you and make the rough places smooth. I will break the doors of bronze in pieces and cut apart the bars of iron.

hausa: Saboda haka, ga abin da Ubangiji Maɗaukaki, Allah na Isra’ila, yana cewa, ‘Yehonadab ɗan Rekab ba zai taɓa rasa mutumin da zai yi mini hidima ba.’ ”
english: therefore Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel, says: ‘Jonadab the son of Rechab will not lack a man to stand before me forever.’”

hausa: Ka tashi, ya Alƙalin duniya; ka sāka wa masu girman kai abin da ya dace da su.
english: Rise up, you judge of the earth. Pay back the proud what they deserve.

hausa: Sarki Hezekiya da annabi Ishaya ɗan Amoz suka yi kuka cikin addu’a ga sama game da wannan.
english: Hezekiah the king and Isaiah the prophet, the son of Amoz, prayed because of this, and cried to heaven.

hausa: “Amma kai, ya Isra’ila, bawana, Yaƙub, wanda na zaɓa, zuriyar Ibrahim abokina,
english: “But you, Israel, my servant, Jacob whom I have chosen, the offspring of Abraham my friend,

hausa: Ƙasa ta yi rawa ta kuma girgiza, harsashan sararin sama sun jijjigu; suka yi makyarkyata saboda yana fushi.
english: Then the earth shook and trembled. The foundations of heaven quaked and were shaken, because he was angry.

hausa: Saboda haka ka faɗa masa cewa zan yi alkawarin salama da shi.
english: Therefore say, ‘Behold, I give to him my covenant of peace.

hausa: Ya kwana a can, daga cikin abin da yake tare da shi kuwa, ya zaɓi kyauta domin ɗan’uwansa Isuwa,
english: He stayed there that night, and took from that which he had with him a present for Esau, his brother:

hausa: Sai ya kai ni filin da yake ciki a gefen gabas, ya kuma auna hanyar shiga; girmanta iri ɗaya ne kamar sauran.
english: He brought me into the inner court toward the east. He measured the gate according to these measurements;

hausa: sa’an nan sarakuna da suke zama a kursiyin Dawuda za su shiga ta ƙofofin wannan birni tare da fadawansu. Su da fadawansu za su shiga a kan kekunan yaƙi da kuma a kan dawakai, mutanen Yahuda suna musu rakiya tare da waɗanda suke zaune a Urushalima, wannan birni kuwa za tă kasance da mazauna har abada.
english: then there will enter in by the gates of this city kings and princes sitting on David’s throne, riding in chariots and on horses, they and their princes, the men of Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem; and this city will remain forever.

hausa: Harsuna fa alama ce ba ga masu bi ba, sai dai ga marasa bi. Annabci kuwa ga masu bi ne ba ga marasa bi ba.
english: Therefore other languages are for a sign, not to those who believe, but to the unbelieving; but prophesying is for a sign, not to the unbelieving, but to those who believe.

hausa: Amma wurin zaman ’yan fashi yana nan ba mai damunsu, waɗanda kuma suke saɓa wa Allah suna zamansu lafiya, har ma da masu ɗaukar allahnsu a hannuwansu.
english: The tents of robbers prosper. Those who provoke God are secure, who carry their god in their hands.

hausa: ’Yan’uwa, kada ku yi gunaguni da juna, don kada a hukunta ku. Alƙalin yana tsaye a bakin ƙofa!
english: Don’t grumble, brothers, against one another, so that you won’t be judged. Behold, the judge stands at the door.

hausa: Ganin wannan abu da matuƙar bantsoro yake, har Musa ya ce, “Ina rawar jiki don tsoro.”
english: So fearful was the appearance that Moses said, “I am terrified and trembling.”

hausa: Ku tattara kayanku don shirin zuwa zaman bauta, ku da kuke zama a Masar, gama Memfis za tă zama kufai ta zama kango, babu mazauna.
english: You daughter who dwells in Egypt, furnish yourself to go into captivity; for Memphis will become a desolation, and will be burned up, without inhabitant.

hausa: Ruwan ya gangara kewaye da bagaden har ma ya cika wuriyar.
english: The water ran around the altar; and he also filled the trench with water.

hausa: Ya kuma gina Tadmor a hamada da kuma dukan biranen ajiyar da ya gina a Hamat.
english: He built Tadmor in the wilderness, and all the storage cities, which he built in Hamath.

hausa: Sai suka ce, “Rabbi, ba da daɗewa ba ne Yahudawa suka nemi su jajjefe ka, duk da haka za ka koma can?”
english: The disciples asked him, “Rabbi, the Jews were just trying to stone you. Are you going there again?”

hausa: Bulus, wanda Allah ya zaɓa don yă zama manzon Kiristi Yesu, da kuma daga Timoti ɗan’uwanmu,
english: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus through the will of God, and Timothy our brother,

hausa: Musa ya ji mutanen suna ta gunaguni ko’ina a cikin iyalansu, kowane mutum a ƙofar tentinsa. Ubangiji kuwa ya husata ƙwarai, sai Musa ya damu.
english: Moses heard the people weeping throughout their families, every man at the door of his tent; and Yahweh’s anger burned greatly; and Moses was displeased.

hausa: A wannan rana, Sarki Zerzes ya ba wa Esta mallakar Haman, abokin gāban Yahudawa. Mordekai kuma ya zo gaban sarki, gama Esta ta faɗa yadda ta haɗa dangi da shi.
english: On that day, King Ahasuerus gave the house of Haman, the Jews’ enemy, to Esther the queen. Mordecai came before the king; for Esther had told what he was to her.

hausa: Sa’an nan za ku kira gare ni ku zo ku kuma yi addu’a gare ni, zan kuwa ji ku.
english: You shall call on me, and you shall go and pray to me, and I will listen to you.

hausa: Sai Isra’ilawa suka ce wa Musa, “To, ai in haka ne, mun ƙare ke nan!
english: The children of Israel spoke to Moses, saying, “Behold, we perish! We are undone! We are all undone!

hausa: To, Heber Bakene ya riga ya bar Keniyawa, zuriyar Hobab, ɗan’uwan matar Musa, ya kafa tentinsa wajen babban itace a Za’anannim kusa da Kedesh.
english: Now Heber the Kenite had separated himself from the Kenites, even from the children of Hobab, Moses’ brother-in-law, and had pitched his tent as far as the oak in Zaanannim, which is by Kedesh.

hausa: Zai amsa addu’ar marasa ƙarfi; ba zai ƙyale roƙonsu ba.
english: He has responded to the prayer of the destitute, and has not despised their prayer.

hausa: Yahudawa suka amsa suka ce, “Ai, ba don wani daga cikin waɗannan ayyukan alheri ne muke so mu jajjefe ka ba, amma don saɓon da kake yi, kai da kake mutum kawai, kana mai da kanka Allah.”
english: The Jews answered him, “We don’t stone you for a good work, but for blasphemy, because you, being a man, make yourself God.”

hausa: Sa’ad da suka zaɓi sababbin alloli, sai ga yaƙi a ƙofofin birnin, ba a kuwa ga garkuwa ko māshi a cikin mutum dubu arba’in a Isra’ila ba.
english: They chose new gods. Then war was in the gates. Was there a shield or spear seen among forty thousand in Israel?

hausa: Amram ya auri ’yar’uwar mahaifinsa Yokebed, wadda ta haifa masa Haruna da Musa. Amram ya yi shekara 137.
english: Amram took Jochebed his father’s sister to himself as wife; and she bore him Aaron and Moses. The years of the life of Amram were one hundred thirty-seven years.

hausa: A ranan nan, dukan mutanen Ai da aka kashe, mutum dubu goma sha biyu ne maza da mata.
english: All that fell that day, both of men and women, were twelve thousand, even all the people of Ai.

hausa: amma Ubangiji yakan yi dariyar mugaye, gama ya sani ranarsu tana zuwa.
english: The Lord will laugh at him, for he sees that his day is coming.

hausa: Ya ce wa, “Na tabbata ba ka sonta sam-sam, don haka na ba da ita ga abokinka. Ba ƙanuwarta ta fi kyau ba? Ka ɗauke ta a maimako.”
english: Her father said, “I most certainly thought that you utterly hated her; therefore I gave her to your companion. Isn’t her younger sister more beautiful than she? Please, take her instead.”

hausa: Wannan shi ne saƙon da muka ji daga wurinsa, muna kuma sanar da ku cewa Allah haske ne; a cikinsa kuwa babu duhu ko kaɗan.
english: This is the message which we have heard from him and announce to you, that God is light, and in him is no darkness at all.

hausa: “Haka mutum yake lalacewa kamar ruɓaɓɓen abu, kamar rigar da asu ya cinye.
english: though I am decaying like a rotten thing, like a garment that is moth-eaten.

hausa: Wane ne kuma yake kamar mutanenka Isra’ila, al’umma guda a duniya wadda Allahnta ya fita don yă fanshi mutane wa kansa, ya kuma yi suna wa kansa, ya kuma aikata manyan abubuwa masu banmamaki masu banrazana ta wurin korin al’ummai daga gaban mutanenka, waɗanda ka fansa daga Masar?
english: What one nation on the earth is like your people Israel, whom God went to redeem to himself for a people, to make you a name by great and awesome things, in driving out nations from before your people whom you redeemed out of Egypt?

hausa: Zunubin da Feyor ya yi bai ishe mu ba ne? Ga shi, har yanzu ba mu gama tsarkakewa daga wannan zunubi ba, ko da yake annoba ta auko wa mutanen Ubangiji!
english: Is the iniquity of Peor too little for us, from which we have not cleansed ourselves to this day, although there came a plague on the congregation of Yahweh,

hausa: Gideyon ya ce, “In lalle na sami tagomashi a gabanka, to, ka ba ni wata alamar da ta nuna lalle kai kake magana da ni.
english: He said to him, “If now I have found favor in your sight, then show me a sign that it is you who talk with me.

hausa: In ya yi maka laifi sau bakwai a rana ɗaya, ya kuma dawo sau bakwai ɗin a wurinka, yana cewa, ‘Na tuba,’ sai ka gafarta masa.”
english: If he sins against you seven times in the day, and seven times returns, saying, ‘I repent,’ you shall forgive him.”

hausa: Ai, dole Kiristi yă sha waɗannan wahalolin, kafin yă shiga ɗaukakarsa.
english: Didn’t the Christ have to suffer these things and to enter into his glory?”

hausa: Saboda haka sai Sama’ila ya koma tare da Shawulu, Shawulu kuwa ya yi wa Ubangiji sujada.
english: So Samuel went back with Saul; and Saul worshiped Yahweh.

hausa: Ta wurin ’ya’yan da Ubangiji zai ba ka ta wurin wannan mace, bari iyalinka yă zama kamar na Ferez, wanda Tamar ta haifa wa Yahuda.”
english: Let your house be like the house of Perez, whom Tamar bore to Judah, of the offspring which Yahweh will give you by this young woman.”

hausa: “Yanzu kuna shirin yin tsayayya da mulkin Ubangiji, wanda yake a hannuwan zuriyar Dawuda. Tabbatacce ku ƙasaitacciyar mayaƙa ne kuma kuna tare da ku maruƙan zinariyar da Yerobowam ya yi domin su zama allolinku.
english: “Now you intend to withstand the kingdom of Yahweh in the hand of the sons of David. You are a great multitude, and the golden calves which Jeroboam made you for gods are with you.

hausa: Wannan ya husata sarkin Aram. Ya kira hafsoshinsa ya tambaye su ya ce, “Ku faɗa mini, wane ne a cikinmu yake gefen sarkin Isra’ila?”
english: The king of Syria’s heart was very troubled about this. He called his servants, and said to them, “Won’t you show me which of us is for the king of Israel?”

hausa: Mai sayarwa ba zai mayar da ƙasar da ya sayar tuntuni ba muddin dukansu suna da rai, gama ba za a sauya wahayin da ya shafi dukan jama’a ba. Saboda zunubansu, babu ɗayansu da zai adana ransa.
english: For the seller won’t return to that which is sold, although they are still alive; for the vision concerns the whole multitude of it. None will return. None will strengthen himself in the iniquity of his life.

hausa: Ku yi nesa da hanyarta, kana ku je kusa da ƙofar gidanta,
english: Remove your way far from her. Don’t come near the door of her house,

hausa: “La’ananne ne mutumin da ya gusar da dutsen da aka kafa don nuna shaidar iyaka.” Sai dukan mutane su ce, “Amin!”
english: ‘Cursed is he who removes his neighbor’s landmark.’ All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’

hausa: Ku shirya wa Bulus dawakai da zai hau don a kai shi wurin Gwamna Felis lafiya.”
english: He asked them to provide mounts, that they might set Paul on one, and bring him safely to Felix the governor.

hausa: “A lokacin mulkin waɗannan sarakunan, Allah na sama zai kafa mulki da ba zai taɓa rushewa ba, ba kuma za a ba ma waɗansu mutane ba. Zai ragargaje waɗannan mulkokin da kuma kawo su ga ƙarshe, amma shi wannan mulki zai dawwama har abada.
english: “In the days of those kings the God of heaven will set up a kingdom which will never be destroyed, nor will its sovereignty be left to another people; but it will break in pieces and consume all these kingdoms, and it will stand forever.

hausa: Sa’ad da Ubangiji ya ji su, ya yi fushi ƙwarai; wutarsa ta ɓarke a kan Yaƙub, hasalarsa kuwa ta tashi a kan Isra’ila,
english: Therefore Yahweh heard, and was angry. A fire was kindled against Jacob, anger also went up against Israel,

hausa: Mai albarka ce, ya ke ƙasa wadda sarkinki haifaffen gidan sarauta ne, wadda hakimanta suke samun abincinsu a daidai lokacin don samun ƙarfi ba don buguwa ba.
english: Happy are you, land, when your king is the son of nobles, and your princes eat in due season, for strength, and not for drunkenness!

hausa: Dole ku zama marasa zargi a gaban Ubangiji Allahnku.
english: You shall be blameless with Yahweh your God.

hausa: Na ɗaga ido, a gabana kuwa sai ga rago mai ƙahoni biyu, yana tsaye a gefen mashigin kogin, ƙahonin kuma suna da tsawo. Ɗaya daga cikin ƙahonin ya fi ɗayan tsawo. Wanda ya fi tsawon shi ne ya tsiro daga baya.
english: Then I lifted up my eyes and saw, and behold, a ram which had two horns stood before the river. The two horns were high, but one was higher than the other, and the higher came up last.

hausa: Suka tashi daga Harada, suka yi sansani a Makhelot.
english: They traveled from Haradah, and encamped in Makheloth.

hausa: Har yaushe ƙasar za tă kasance busasshiya ciyawar kowane fili ta bushe? Domin waɗanda suke zaune cikinta mugaye ne, dabbobi da tsuntsaye sun hallaka. Ban da haka ma, mutane suna cewa, “Ba zai ga abin da yake faruwa da mu ba.”
english: How long will the land mourn, and the herbs of the whole country wither? Because of the wickedness of those who dwell therein, the animals and birds are consumed; because they said, “He won’t see our latter end.”

hausa: A ikkilisiyar da take a Antiyok akwai waɗansu annabawa da malamai. Barnabas, Siman wanda ake kira Baƙi, Lusiyus mutumin Sairin, Manayen (wanda aka goya tare da Hiridus mai mulki), da kuma Shawulu.
english: Now in the assembly that was at Antioch there were some prophets and teachers: Barnabas, Simeon who was called Niger, Lucius of Cyrene, Manaen the foster brother of Herod the tetrarch, and Saul.

hausa: Suka tashi daga Refidim, suka yi sansani a Hamadan Sinai.
english: They traveled from Rephidim, and encamped in the wilderness of Sinai.

hausa: Dole kullum mu gode wa Allah saboda ku, ’yan’uwa, haka kuwa ya dace, domin bangaskiyarku tana girma gaba-gaba, ƙaunar da kowannenku yake yi wa juna kuwa tana ƙaruwa.
english: We are bound to always give thanks to God for you, brothers, even as it is appropriate, because your faith grows exceedingly, and the love of each and every one of you toward one another abounds,

hausa: Da suka tafi ƙofar shiga Tentin Sujada, sai suka tsaya a gaban Musa, Eleyazar firist, shugabannin da sauran taro, suka ce,
english: They stood before Moses, before Eleazar the priest, and before the princes and all the congregation, at the door of the Tent of Meeting, saying,

hausa: “Gaskiya nake gaya muku, mutumin da bai shiga inda ake ajiye garken tumaki ta ƙofa ba, amma ya hau ta katanga, ɓarawo ne, ɗan fashi kuma.
english: “Most certainly, I tell you, one who doesn’t enter by the door into the sheep fold, but climbs up some other way, is a thief and a robber.

hausa: Kyautar da aka yi a asirce takan kwantar da fushi, kuma cin hancin da aka rufe a cikin riga kan tā da fushi mai tsanani.
english: A gift in secret pacifies anger, and a bribe in the cloak, strong wrath.

hausa: Ba za su sayar da shi ko su musayar da wani sashensa ba. Wannan shi ne mafi kyau na ƙasar ba kuma za a jinginar da ita ga wani ba, gama mai tsarki ce ga Ubangiji.
english: They shall sell none of it, nor exchange it, nor shall the first fruits of the land be alienated, for it is holy to Yahweh.

hausa: na gaya maka, “Ka bar ɗana yă tafi domin yă yi mini sujada.” Amma ka ƙi ka bari yă tafi, saboda haka zan kashe ɗan farinka.’ ”
english: and I have said to you, “Let my son go, that he may serve me;” and you have refused to let him go. Behold, I will kill your firstborn son.’”

hausa: Ga shi kun wulaƙanta matalauta. Ashe, ba masu arziki ne suke cutarku ba? Ba su ba ne suke jan ku zuwa kotu?
english: But you have dishonored the poor man. Don’t the rich oppress you and personally drag you before the courts?

hausa: Tsoron Ubangiji ne mafarin hikima; dukan waɗanda suke bin farillansa suna da ganewa mai kyau. Gare shi ne madawwamin yabo.
english: The fear of Yahweh is the beginning of wisdom. All those who do his work have a good understanding. His praise endures forever!

hausa: Mugaye sukan shirya wa adalai maƙarƙashiya su ciji baki a kansu;
english: The wicked plots against the just, and gnashes at him with his teeth.

hausa: Sa’ad da Filistiyawa suka fāɗa wa Isra’ilawa da yaƙi mai tsanani, suka sa su cikin wani hali mai wuya, sai Isra’ilawa suka ɓuya a kogwanni, da ciyayi, da duwatsu, da ramummuka, da rijiyoyi.
english: When the men of Israel saw that they were in trouble (for the people were distressed), then the people hid themselves in caves, in thickets, in rocks, in tombs, and in pits.

hausa: Zan mai da Dutsen Seyir kango in kuma yanke dukan waɗanda suke shiga da fita a cikinka.
english: Thus I will make Mount Seir an astonishment and a desolation. I will cut off from it him who passes through and him who returns.

hausa: A ranar, Hiridus da Bilatus suka zama abokan juna, don tun dā ma, su abokan gāba ne.
english: Herod and Pilate became friends with each other that very day, for before that they were enemies with each other.

hausa: Saboda haka sa’ad da Fataken Midiyawa suka iso, sai ’yan’uwansa suka ja Yusuf daga rijiyar, suka sayar da shi a bakin shekel ashirin na azurfa wa mutanen Ishmayel, waɗanda suka ɗauke shi zuwa Masar.
english: Midianites who were merchants passed by, and they drew and lifted up Joseph out of the pit, and sold Joseph to the Ishmaelites for twenty pieces of silver. The merchants brought Joseph into Egypt.

hausa: Da Dawuda ya iso Ziklag, sai ya aika wa abokansa, dattawan Yahuda da rabo daga cikin ganimar ya ce, “Ga kyauta dominku, daga cikin ganimar maƙiyan Ubangiji.”
english: When David came to Ziklag, he sent some of the plunder to the elders of Judah, even to his friends, saying, “Behold, a present for you from the plunder of Yahweh’s enemies.”

hausa: A hamadan, dukan taro suka yi gunaguni a kan Musa da Haruna.
english: The whole congregation of the children of Israel murmured against Moses and against Aaron in the wilderness;

hausa: Ni ne na yi cikin dukan mutanen nan? Ni ne na haife su? To, me ya sa ka ce in ɗauke su a ƙirjina kamar yadda mai reno yake rungume jariri, zuwa ƙasa wadda ka yi alkawari da rantsuwa za ka ba wa kakanninsu?
english: Have I conceived all this people? Have I brought them out, that you should tell me, ‘Carry them in your bosom, as a nurse carries a nursing infant, to the land which you swore to their fathers’?

hausa: Zai ba da sarakunsu a hannunku, za ku kuwa shafe sunayensu daga duniya. Babu wani da zai yi tsayayya da ku, za ku hallaka su.
english: He will deliver their kings into your hand, and you shall make their name perish from under the sky. No one will be able to stand before you until you have destroyed them.

hausa: Nan da nan, sai kuturtar ta rabu da shi, ya kuma warke.
english: When he had said this, immediately the leprosy departed from him and he was made clean.

hausa: ’Ya’yan Yaban maza su ne, Elisha, Tarshish, Kittim da Rodanim.
english: The sons of Javan: Elishah, Tarshish, Kittim, and Rodanim.

hausa: Na naɗa muku masu tsaro a kanku na kuma ce, ‘Ku saurari karan ƙaho!’ Amma kuka ce, ‘Ba za mu saurara ba.’
english: I set watchmen over you, saying, ‘Listen to the sound of the trumpet!’ But they said, ‘We will not listen!’

hausa: “ ‘A rana ta shida a miƙa bijimai takwas, raguna biyu, da ’yan raguna goma sha huɗu, bana ɗaya-ɗaya, dukansu marasa lahani.
english: “‘On the sixth day: eight bulls, two rams, fourteen male lambs a year old without defect;

hausa: Za ku raba ta kamar gādo wa kanku da kuma wa baƙin da suka zauna a cikinku waɗanda suke da ’ya’ya. Za ku ɗauka su kamar ’yan ƙasa haifaffun Isra’ilawa; za su yi gādo tare da ku a cikin kabilan Isra’ila.
english: You shall divide it by lot for an inheritance to you and to the aliens who live among you, who will father children among you. Then they shall be to you as the native-born among the children of Israel. They shall have inheritance with you among the tribes of Israel.

hausa: Wata rana, Lamek ya ce wa matansa, Ada da Zilla, “Ku saurara, matan Lamek, ku ji maganata. Na kashe wani saboda ya yi mini rauni, na kashe wani saurayi saboda ya ji mini ciwo.
english: Lamech said to his wives, “Adah and Zillah, hear my voice. You wives of Lamech, listen to my speech, for I have slain a man for wounding me, a young man for bruising me.

hausa: Na bayyana ga Ibrahim, ga Ishaku da kuma ga Yaƙub a matsayin Allah Maɗaukaki, amma sunan nan nawa Ubangiji, ban bayyana kaina a gare su ba.
english: I appeared to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, as God Almighty; but by my name Yahweh I was not known to them.

hausa: Waɗannan mutanen suna sanye da riguna, da wanduna, da rawani da waɗansu kayan sawa, aka daure su, aka jefa su cikin tanderun wuta.
english: Then these men were bound in their pants, their tunics, and their mantles, and their other clothes, and were cast into the middle of the burning fiery furnace.

hausa: Al’ummai za su yi tafiya cikin hasken birnin, sarakunan duniya kuma za su kawo darajarsu cikin birnin.
english: The nations will walk in its light. The kings of the earth bring the glory and honor of the nations into it.

hausa: Amma mala’ikan ya ce musu, “Kada ku ji tsoro. Na kawo muku labari mai daɗi na farin ciki mai yawa ne wanda zai zama domin dukan mutane.
english: The angel said to them, “Don’t be afraid, for behold, I bring you good news of great joy which will be to all the people.

hausa: ku da kuke murna saboda an ci Lo Debar da yaƙi kuka kuma ce, “Ba da ƙarfinmu ne muka ƙwace Karnayim ba?”
english: you who rejoice in a thing of nothing, who say, ‘Haven’t we taken for ourselves horns by our own strength?’

hausa: Amma fa mazaunan can ɗin ƙarfafa ne, an kuma kewaye biranen da manya-manyan katanga. Mun kuma ga zuriyar Anak a can.
english: However, the people who dwell in the land are strong, and the cities are fortified and very large. Moreover, we saw the children of Anak there.

hausa: Duba, ina tsaye a bakin rijiyar ruwa, ’ya’ya matan mutanen gari kuma suna fitowa domin ɗiban ruwa.
english: Behold, I am standing by the spring of water. The daughters of the men of the city are coming out to draw water.

hausa: Sa’ad da nake lafiya, na ce, “Ba zan jijjigu ba.”
english: As for me, I said in my prosperity, “I shall never be moved.”

hausa: Game da Gad ya ce, “Mai albarka ne wanda ya fadada mazaunin Gad! Gad yana zama a can kamar zaki, yana yayyage a hannu da kai.
english: About Gad he said, “He who enlarges Gad is blessed. He dwells as a lioness, and tears the arm and the crown of the head.

hausa: Sai mutanen da aka kira sunansu suka tashi, suka ɗauki kamammun, da ganimar, suka sa wa dukan waɗanda suke tsirara sutura. Suka sa musu sutura, suka ba su takalma, suka ba su abinci da abin sha, suka shafa musu mai. Suka hawar da dukan raunana a kan jakuna, suka kai su wurin ’yan’uwansu a Yeriko, wato, Birnin Itatuwan Dabino, sa’an nan suka koma Samariya.
english: The men who have been mentioned by name rose up and took the captives, and with the plunder clothed all who were naked among them, dressed them, gave them sandals, gave them something to eat and to drink, anointed them, carried all the feeble of them on donkeys, and brought them to Jericho, the city of palm trees, to their brothers. Then they returned to Samaria.

hausa: Mutanen Yahuda suka ce, “Me ya sa kuka zo mana da yaƙi?” Sai suka ce, “Mun zo ne mu kama Samson, a matsayin fursunan yaƙi, mu yi masa kamar yadda ya yi mana.”
english: The men of Judah said, “Why have you come up against us?” They said, “We have come up to bind Samson, to do to him as he has done to us.”

hausa: An haifa ’ya’ya maza wa Shaharayim a Mowab bayan ya saki matansa Hushim da Ba’ara.
english: Shaharaim became the father of children in the field of Moab, after he had sent them away. Hushim and Baara were his wives.

hausa: Na san wahalarka da kuma talaucinka, duk da haka kai mai arziki ne! Na san ɓata suna da waɗannan suke yi maka waɗannan da suke cewa su Yahudawa ne alhali kuwa ba haka ba ne, su dai majami’ar Shaiɗan ne.
english: “I know your works, oppression, and your poverty (but you are rich), and the blasphemy of those who say they are Jews, and they are not, but are a synagogue of Satan.

hausa: Har lokacin da kuka tsufa kuka yi furfura ni ne shi, ni ne shi wanda zai lura da ku. Na yi ku zan kuma riƙe ku; zan lura da ku in kuma kuɓutar da ku.
english: Even to old age I am he, and even to gray hairs I will carry you. I have made, and I will bear. Yes, I will carry, and will deliver.

hausa: Sai Lawi ya tashi, ya bar kome da kome, ya bi shi.
english: He left everything, and rose up and followed him.

hausa: Mala’ikan Ubangiji ya yi wa Yoshuwa wannan gargaɗi.
english: Yahweh’s angel solemnly assured Joshua, saying,

hausa: Maganar Ubangiji ta zo mini cewa,
english: Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

hausa: Ubangiji Allahnku ya ƙara yawanku har yau kuka zama da yawa kamar taurari a sarari.
english: Yahweh your God has multiplied you, and behold, you are today as the stars of the sky for multitude.

hausa: Mika ya ce, “Yanzu na san cewa Ubangiji zai yi mini alheri, da yake Balawen nan ya zama firist nawa.”
english: Then Micah said, “Now I know that Yahweh will do good to me, since I have a Levite as my priest.”

hausa: Yana yi wa tsoro dariya ba ya jin tsoron kome; ba ya guje wa takobi.
english: He mocks at fear, and is not dismayed, neither does he turn back from the sword.

hausa: Sai Ibrahim ya ƙara cewa, “Yanzu da na yi karambani har na yi magana da Ubangiji, ko da yake ni ba kome ba ne illa turɓaya da toka,
english: Abraham answered, “See now, I have taken it on myself to speak to the Lord, although I am dust and ashes.

hausa: Kuka ƙirga gine-gine a Urushalima kuka kuma rurrushe gidaje don ku ƙarfafa katanga.
english: You counted the houses of Jerusalem, and you broke down the houses to fortify the wall.

hausa: Dukansu sun bayar ne daga cikin arzikinsu; ita kuwa, daga cikin talaucinta, ta ba da kome, duk abin da take da shi na rayuwa.”
english: for they all gave out of their abundance, but she, out of her poverty, gave all that she had to live on.”

hausa: Ku gina bagaden Ubangiji Allahnku da duwatsun fili, ku kuma miƙa hadaya ta ƙonawa a kansa ga Ubangiji Allahnku.
english: You shall build Yahweh your God’s altar of uncut stones. You shall offer burnt offerings on it to Yahweh your God.

hausa: “Ina muku baftisma da ruwa domin tuba. Amma wani yana zuwa a bayana wanda ya fi ni iko, wanda ko takalmansa ma ban isa in ɗauka ba. Zai yi muku baftisma da Ruhu Mai Tsarki da kuma wuta.
english: “I indeed baptize you in water for repentance, but he who comes after me is mightier than I, whose sandals I am not worthy to carry. He will baptize you in the Holy Spirit.

hausa: Ya fitar da su daga duhu da zurfin ɓaci rai ya tsintsinke sarƙoƙinsu.
english: He brought them out of darkness and the shadow of death, and broke away their chains.

hausa: Cikin daraja yana yi kamar ɗan fari na bijimi; ƙahoninsa ƙahonin ɓauna ne. Tare da su zai tukwiyi al’ummai, har ma da waɗanda suke ƙarshen duniya. Haka dubu dubban Efraim suke; haka dubban Manasse suke.”
english: Majesty belongs to the firstborn of his herd. His horns are the horns of the wild ox. With them he will push all the peoples to the ends of the earth. They are the ten thousands of Ephraim. They are the thousands of Manasseh.”

hausa: yă shiga, yă kuma fita a gabansu, wanda zai bishe su zuwa waje, yă kuma dawo da su ciki, don kada mutanen Ubangiji su zama kamar tumakin da ba su da makiyayi.”
english: who may go out before them, and who may come in before them, and who may lead them out, and who may bring them in, that the congregation of Yahweh may not be as sheep which have no shepherd.”

hausa: Daga zuriyar Elizafan, Shimri da Yehiyel. Daga zuriyar Asaf, Zakariya da Mattaniya.
english: and of the sons of Elizaphan, Shimri and Jeuel; and of the sons of Asaph, Zechariah and Mattaniah;

hausa: Kuma in mugu ya juye daga muguntarsa ya aikata abin da yake gaskiya da kuma daidai, zai rayu ta yin haka.
english: When the wicked turns from his wickedness and does that which is lawful and right, he will live by it.

hausa: Amma ba a shekara guda zan kore muku su ba, don kada ƙasar tă zama kufai har namun jeji su fi ƙarfinku.
english: I will not drive them out from before you in one year, lest the land become desolate, and the animals of the field multiply against you.

hausa: Ya kamata a sāka wa alheri da mugunta? Duk da haka sun haƙa mini rami. Ka tuna cewa na tsaya a gabanka na kuma yi magana a madadinsu don ka janye fushinka daga gare su.
english: Should evil be recompensed for good? For they have dug a pit for my soul. Remember how I stood before you to speak good for them, to turn away your wrath from them.

hausa: Kada ku rama mugunta da mugunta ko zagi da zagi, sai dai ku sa albarka, gama ga wannan ne aka kira ku, ku kuma gāji albarka.
english: not rendering evil for evil or insult for insult; but instead blessing, knowing that you were called to this, that you may inherit a blessing.

hausa: Gama yana sane da abubuwan da suke yi, yana hamɓarar da su da dare a kuma ragargaza su.
english: Therefore he takes knowledge of their works. He overturns them in the night, so that they are destroyed.

hausa: “Ka gargaɗe su su dawo ga dokarka, amma suka yi fariya, suka bijire wa umarnanka. Suka yi zunubi game da farillanka waɗanda ta wurinsu ne mutum zai rayu in ya yi biyayya da su. Cikin taurinkai suka juye bayansu daga gare ka, suka zama masu taurinkai, suka kuma ƙi su saurara.
english: and testified against them, that you might bring them again to your law. Yet they were arrogant, and didn’t listen to your commandments, but sinned against your ordinances (which if a man does, he shall live in them), turned their backs, stiffened their neck, and would not hear.

hausa: Gama in ka lura da bin waɗannan umarnai, to, sarakunan da suke zaune a gadon sarautar Dawuda za su shiga ta ƙofofin wannan fada, suna hawan kekunan yaƙi da dawakai, fadawansu da mutanensu suna musu rakiya.
english: For if you do this thing indeed, then kings sitting on David’s throne will enter in by the gates of this house, riding in chariots and on horses—they, their servants, and their people.

hausa: “Saboda haka yanzu, in saurayin ba ya nan tare da mu sa’ad da na koma ga bawanka mahaifina, in kuma mahaifina, wanda ransa yana daure kurkusa da ran saurayin,
english: Now therefore when I come to your servant my father, and the boy is not with us; since his life is bound up in the boy’s life;

hausa: Dawuda ya ji ƙishirwa, sai ya ce, “Kash, da a ce wani yă samo mini ruwa daga rijiyar da take kusa da bakin ƙofar Betlehem mana!”
english: David said longingly, “Oh that someone would give me water to drink from the well of Bethlehem, which is by the gate!”

hausa: Musa ya tattara dukan Isra’ila ya ce, Ku ji, ya Isra’ila, ƙa’idodi da dokokin da na furta a kunnuwanku a yau. Ku koye su, ku kuma tabbata kun bi su.
english: Moses called to all Israel, and said to them, “Hear, Israel, the statutes and the ordinances which I speak in your ears today, that you may learn them, and observe to do them.”

hausa: ‘Ga mutane sun fito daga Masar sun mamaye ƙasar. Ka zo yanzu ka la’anta mini su. Wataƙila ta haka zan yi nasara a kansu, in kuma kore su.’ ”
english: ‘Behold, the people that has come out of Egypt covers the surface of the earth. Now, come curse them for me. Perhaps I shall be able to fight against them, and shall drive them out.’”

hausa: Addu’a ce ta Dawuda. Ka ji, ya Ubangiji, roƙona na adalci; ka saurari kukata. Ka kasa kunne ga addu’ata, ba ta fitowa daga leɓuna masu ƙarya.
english: A Prayer by David. Hear, Yahweh, my righteous plea. Give ear to my prayer that doesn’t go out of deceitful lips.

hausa: Shekaru bakwai na yalwa a Masar suka zo ga ƙarshe,
english: The seven years of plenty, that were in the land of Egypt, came to an end.

hausa: Ubangiji ya ɗauki mazauninsa a cikin ɗakin shari’a; ya tashi don yă shari’anta mutane.
english: Yahweh stands up to contend, and stands to judge the peoples.

hausa: Mala’ika na shida ya juye kwanonsa a bisan babban kogin Yuferites, sai ruwansa ya shanye don a shirya hanya saboda sarakuna daga Gabas.
english: The sixth poured out his bowl on the great river, the Euphrates. Its water was dried up, that the way might be prepared for the kings that come from the sunrise.

hausa: Daga can ya nufi Debir ya yi yaƙi da mutanen da suke zama a can (Dā sunan Debir, Kiriyat Sefer ne).
english: He went up against the inhabitants of Debir: now the name of Debir before was Kiriath Sepher.

hausa: Sa’an nan wani babban sarki zai bayyana, wanda zai yi mulki da babban iko yă kuma yi abin da ya ga dama.
english: A mighty king will stand up, who will rule with great dominion, and do according to his will.

hausa: In kuma wani ya yi annabci, sai mahaifinsa da mahaifiyarsa su ce masa, ‘Ba za ka rayu ba, gama kana faɗar ƙarya da sunan Ubangiji.’ Sa’ad da yake yin annabci, iyayensa za su soke shi da takobi.
english: It will happen that when anyone still prophesies, then his father and his mother who bore him will tell him, ‘You must die, because you speak lies in Yahweh’s name;’ and his father and his mother who bore him will stab him when he prophesies.

hausa: A shirayin hanyar shiga akwai tebur biyu a kowane gefe, inda ake yankan hadayun ƙonawa, hadayun zunubi da kuma hadayun laifi.
english: In the porch of the gate were two tables on this side and two tables on that side, on which to kill the burnt offering, the sin offering, and the trespass offering.

hausa: Faɗin ginin da yake fuskantar filin haikali a wajen yamma kamu saba’in ne. Kaurin bangon ginin kamu biyar ne kewaye, tsawonsa kuma kamu tasa’in ne.
english: The building that was before the separate place at the side toward the west was seventy cubits wide; and the wall of the building was five cubits thick all around, and its length ninety cubits.

hausa: Na ba su kalmomin da ka ba ni sun kuwa karɓa. Sun san tabbatacce daga wurinka na fito. Sun kuma gaskata kai ka aiko ni.
english: for the words which you have given me I have given to them; and they received them, and knew for sure that I came from you. They have believed that you sent me.

hausa: Ko da yake ina da gaskiya, an ɗauke ni maƙaryaci; ko da yake ba ni da laifi, kibiyoyinsa sun ji mini ciwo wanda ba ya warkewa.’
english: Notwithstanding my right I am considered a liar. My wound is incurable, though I am without disobedience.’

hausa: Haka ya faru da ɗan’uwa na biyu da na uku, har zuwa na bakwai.
english: In the same way, the second also, and the third, to the seventh.

hausa: Ubangiji ya ce wa Musa,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

hausa: Ko da yake kai mai ƙarfi ne, ka mallaki ƙasa, mutum mai martaba kuma, kana zama cikin ƙasarka.
english: But as for the mighty man, he had the earth. The honorable man, he lived in it.

hausa: Dawuda ya zauna a yankin Filistiyawa shekara ɗaya da wata huɗu.
english: The number of the days that David lived in the country of the Philistines was a full year and four months.

hausa: Kamar yadda mafarki yake sa’ad da mutum ya farka, haka yake sa’ad da ka farka, ya Ubangiji, za ka rena su kamar almarai.
english: As a dream when one wakes up, so, Lord, when you awake, you will despise their fantasies.

hausa: Ƙasar da kanta takan ba da ƙwaya, da farko takan fid da ƙara, sa’an nan ta fid da kai, sa’an nan kan yă fid da ƙwaya.
english: For the earth bears fruit by itself: first the blade, then the ear, then the full grain in the ear.

hausa: Yesu ya amsa ya ce, “Bari yă zama haka yanzu; ya dace mu yi haka don mu cika dukan adalci.” Sa’an nan Yohanna ya yarda.
english: But Jesus, answering, said to him, “Allow it now, for this is the fitting way for us to fulfill all righteousness.” Then he allowed him.

hausa: Meshelemiya yana da ’ya’ya maza da kuma ’yan’uwa, waɗanda jarumawa ne, su 18 ne duka.
english: Meshelemiah had sons and brothers, eighteen valiant men.

hausa: Adali yana ƙin abin da yake ƙarya, amma mugu kan jawo kunya da ƙasƙanci.
english: A righteous man hates lies, but a wicked man brings shame and disgrace.

hausa: Bala’am ya ce, “Ka gina mini bagadai bakwai a nan, ka shirya mini bijimai bakwai da raguna bakwai.”
english: Balaam said to Balak, “Build here seven altars for me, and prepare here seven bulls and seven rams for me.”

hausa: Shi ne mai zuwa bayana, wanda ko igiyar takalmansa ma ban isa in kunce ba.”
english: He is the one who comes after me, who is preferred before me, whose sandal strap I’m not worthy to loosen.”

hausa: Taku ta ƙare, ku da kuke shirya makirci, ku da kuke ƙulle-ƙullen mugunta a kan gadonku! Da gari ya waye sai ku fita ku aikata mugunta domin ikon aikatawa yana hannunku.
english: Woe to those who devise iniquity and work evil on their beds! When the morning is light, they practice it, because it is in the power of their hand.

hausa: Amma Isuwa ya ce, “Na riga na sami abin da ya ishe ni, ɗan’uwana. Riƙe abin da kake da shi don kanka.”
english: Esau said, “I have enough, my brother; let that which you have be yours.”

hausa: Yesu ya amsa ya ce, “Mutanen zamanin nan suna aure, suna kuma ba da aure,
english: Jesus said to them, “The children of this age marry and are given in marriage.

hausa: A duk kabilar da baƙon yake zama, a can za ku ba shi gādonsa,” in ji Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka.
english: In whatever tribe the stranger lives, there you shall give him his inheritance,” says the Lord Yahweh.

hausa: A wannan lokaci, Yahuda ya bar ’yan’uwansa ya gangara don yă zauna da mutumin Adullam, mai suna Hira.
english: At that time, Judah went down from his brothers, and visited a certain Adullamite, whose name was Hirah.

hausa: Ku ’ya’ya, ku yi biyayya ga iyayenku, gama ku na Ubangiji, abin da ya dace ku yi ke nan.
english: Children, obey your parents in the Lord, for this is right.

hausa: Shawulu kuwa ya janye daga fafaran Dawuda, ya tafi yă ƙara da Filistiyawa. Dalilin ke nan da ake kiran wannan wuri Sela Hammalekot, wato, dutsen tserewa.
english: So Saul returned from pursuing David, and went against the Philistines. Therefore they called that place Sela Hammahlekoth.

hausa: Saboda haka suka tashi, suka gudu da yamma, suka bar tentunansu, da dawakansu, da jakunansu. Suka bar sansanin yadda yake, suka gudu don su ceci rayukansu.
english: Therefore they arose and fled in the twilight, and left their tents, their horses, and their donkeys, even the camp as it was, and fled for their life.

hausa: Da mai ɗaukar masa kayan yaƙi ya ga Shawulu ya mutu, sai shi ma ya fāɗi a kan takobinsa ya mutu.
english: When his armor bearer saw that Saul was dead, he likewise fell on his sword and died.

hausa: Wata rana Yesu yana addu’a a wani wuri. Da ya gama, sai ɗaya daga cikin almajiransa ya ce masa, “Ubangiji, ka koya mana yin addu’a, kamar yadda Yohanna ya koya wa almajiransa.”
english: When he finished praying in a certain place, one of his disciples said to him, “Lord, teach us to pray, just as John also taught his disciples.”

hausa: Zan lanƙwasa Yahuda yadda nake lanƙwasa bakana, in kuma cika ta da Efraim kamar kibiya. Zan tā da ’ya’yanki maza, ya Sihiyona, gāba da ’ya’yanki, ya Girka, in kuma mai da ke kamar takobin jarumin yaƙi.
english: For indeed I bend Judah as a bow for me. I have loaded the bow with Ephraim. I will stir up your sons, Zion, against your sons, Greece, and will make you like the sword of a mighty man.

hausa: na Netofa 56
english: The men of Netophah, fifty-six.

hausa: Don haka, ba wanda na iya cewa an yi muku baftisma a cikin sunana.
english: so that no one should say that I had baptized you into my own name.

hausa: saboda fushinka mai girma, gama ka ɗaga ni sama ka yar a gefe.
english: because of your indignation and your wrath; for you have taken me up and thrown me away.

hausa: Sai gaban sarki ya faɗi. Ya haura zuwa ɗakin da yake kan katangar hanyar shiga ya yi kuka. Yayinda yake tafiya ya ce, “Ya ɗana Absalom! Ɗana, ɗana Absalom! Da ma a ce ni ne na mutu maimakonka. Ya Absalom, ɗana, ɗana!”
english: The king was much moved, and went up to the room over the gate and wept. As he went, he said, “My son Absalom! My son, my son Absalom! I wish I had died instead of you, Absalom, my son, my son!”

hausa: Na aika rina ta kore su a idonku, haka kuma sarakunan Amoriyawan nan. Ba da takobinku ko bakanku ne kuka yi haka ba.
english: I sent the hornet before you, which drove them out from before you, even the two kings of the Amorites; not with your sword, nor with your bow.

hausa: Wannan mutum Daniyel, wanda sarki ya kira Belteshazar, an gane yana da ruhu nagari, da ilimi, da ganewa don yin fassarar mafarkai, da bayyana ma’anar kacici-kacici, da warware al’amura masu wuya. Ka kira Daniyel shi kuwa zai faɗa maka abin da rubutun nan yake nufi.”
english: because an excellent spirit, knowledge, understanding, interpreting of dreams, showing of dark sentences, and dissolving of doubts were found in the same Daniel, whom the king named Belteshazzar. Now let Daniel be called, and he will show the interpretation.”

hausa: Bari wannan Kiristi, wannan Sarkin Isra’ila, yă sauko yanzu daga gicciye, don mu ga mu kuma gaskata.” Waɗanda aka gicciye tare da shi ma suka zazzage shi.
english: Let the Christ, the King of Israel, now come down from the cross, that we may see and believe him.” Those who were crucified with him also insulted him.

hausa: Daga ranar da aka gina ta har zuwa yanzu, wannan birni ta tā da fushina da hasalata da dole a kawar da ita daga gabana.
english: For this city has been to me a provocation of my anger and of my wrath from the day that they built it even to this day, so that I should remove it from before my face,

hausa: Sai annabi Hananiya ya cire karkiya daga wuyar annabi Irmiya ya karya ta,
english: Then Hananiah the prophet took the bar from off the prophet Jeremiah’s neck, and broke it.

hausa: A ƙarshe suka sāke koma ga makahon suka ce, “Kai fa, me ka gani game da shi? Idanunka ne fa ya buɗe.” Sai mutumin ya ce, “Tab, ai, shi annabi ne.”
english: Therefore they asked the blind man again, “What do you say about him, because he opened your eyes?” He said, “He is a prophet.”

hausa: In kuwa ba a tashe Kiristi ba, bangaskiyarku a banza take, ya zama har yanzu kuna cikin zunubanku ke nan.
english: If Christ has not been raised, your faith is vain; you are still in your sins.

hausa: Amma Bulus ya ce wa ma’aikatan, “Sun yi mana dūka a fili ba tare da shari’a ba, ko da yake mu ’yan ƙasar Roma ne, suka kuma jefa mu cikin kurkuku. Yanzu suna so su fitar da mu a ɓoye? A’a! Sai dai su zo da kansu su rako mu waje.”
english: But Paul said to them, “They have beaten us publicly without a trial, men who are Romans, and have cast us into prison! Do they now release us secretly? No, most certainly, but let them come themselves and bring us out!”

hausa: Sai shi da keken yaƙinsa suka shirya, ya kuma ɗauki sojojinsa tare da shi.
english: He prepared his chariot, and took his army with him;

hausa: “Saboda haka, ga abin da Ubangiji Allah Maɗaukaki, Allah na Isra’ila, yana cewa, ‘Ku saurara! Zan kawo wa Yahuda da kuma kowane mutumin da yake zama a Urushalima kowace masifar da na ambata a kansu. Na yi musu magana, amma ba su saurara ba; na kira su, amma ba su amsa ba.’ ”
english: “Therefore Yahweh, the God of Armies, the God of Israel, says: ‘Behold, I will bring on Judah and on all the inhabitants of Jerusalem all the evil that I have pronounced against them, because I have spoken to them, but they have not heard; and I have called to them, but they have not answered.’”

hausa: (a nan firist zai sa macen a ƙarƙashin la’anar rantsuwa cewa) “bari Ubangiji yă sa mutanenki su la’ance ki, su kuma yi Allah wadai da ke, sa’ad da Ubangiji ya sa cinyarki ta shanye, cikinki kuma ya kumbura.
english: then the priest shall cause the woman to swear with the oath of cursing, and the priest shall tell the woman, “May Yahweh make you a curse and an oath among your people, when Yahweh allows your thigh to fall away, and your body to swell;

hausa: Da suka ji ya yi musu magana da Arameyik, sai suka yi tsit. Sai Bulus ya ce,
english: When they heard that he spoke to them in the Hebrew language, they were even more quiet. He said,

hausa: Tabanakul na Ubangiji da Musa ya yi a hamada, da kuma bagaden hadaya ta ƙonawa a lokacin suna a tudun Gibeyon.
english: For Yahweh’s tabernacle, which Moses made in the wilderness, and the altar of burnt offering, were at that time in the high place at Gibeon.

hausa: Abin da Allah ya yi magana a kan Mowab shi ne, An lalatar da Ar a Mowab, an hallaka ta da dare! An lalatar da Kir a Mowab, an hallaka ta da dare!
english: The burden of Moab. For in a night, Ar of Moab is laid waste, and brought to nothing. For in a night Kir of Moab is laid waste, and brought to nothing.

hausa: Ta haka sai ku karɓi juna kamar yadda Kiristi ya karɓe ku, don a yabi Allah.
english: Therefore accept one another, even as Christ also accepted you, to the glory of God.

hausa: dole ku miƙa dabba namiji marar lahani, daga shanu, tumaki, ko awaki, domin yă zama yardajje a madadinku.
english: that you may be accepted, you shall offer a male without defect, of the bulls, of the sheep, or of the goats.

hausa: Irin nasarorin da Benahiya ɗan Yehohiyada ya yi ke nan; shi ma jarumi ne sosai kamar jarumawan nan uku.
english: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada did these things, and had a name among the three mighty men.

hausa: Ka yi wannan. Ka cire dukan sarakuna daga matsayinsu ka sa waɗansu shugabanni a maimakonsu.
english: Do this thing: take the kings away, every man out of his place, and put captains in their place.

hausa: Amma Yesu ya tafi Dutsen Zaitun.
english: but Jesus went to the Mount of Olives.

hausa: Abin da na faɗa muku a asirce, ku faɗe shi a sarari; abin da aka faɗa muku a kunne, ku yi shelarsa daga kan rufin ɗaki.
english: What I tell you in the darkness, speak in the light; and what you hear whispered in the ear, proclaim on the housetops.

hausa: Mai adalci kan kula da bukatun dabbobinsa, amma halaye mafi kyau na mugaye su ne ƙeta.
english: A righteous man respects the life of his animal, but the tender mercies of the wicked are cruel.

hausa: To, fa, Nebukadnezzar sarkin Babilon ya ba da wannan umarnai game da Irmiya ta wurin Nebuzaradan shugaban matsaran sarki cewa,
english: Now Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon commanded Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard concerning Jeremiah, saying,

hausa: “Kaitonku, domin ku kamar kaburbura ne da ba a sa musu alama ba, waɗanda mutane suke takawa don rashin sani.”
english: Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you are like hidden graves, and the men who walk over them don’t know it.”

hausa: Sai mutanen Ruben, mutanen Gad da kuma rabin mutanen kabilar Manasse suka amsa wa shugabannin iyalan Isra’ila suka ce,
english: Then the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half-tribe of Manasseh answered, and spoke to the heads of the thousands of Israel,

hausa: Sa’ad da maigidansa ya ji labarin da matarsa ta faɗa masa cewa, “Ga yadda bawanka ya yi da ni,” sai ya husata.
english: When his master heard the words of his wife, which she spoke to him, saying, “This is what your servant did to me,” his wrath was kindled.

hausa: Ishaku kuwa ya zo daga Beyer-Lahai-Royi, gama yana zama a Negeb.
english: Isaac came from the way of Beer Lahai Roi, for he lived in the land of the South.

hausa: Ganin itacen ɓaure kusa da hanya, sai ya je wajensa amma bai sami kome a kansa ba sai ganye. Sai ya ce masa, “Kada ka ƙara yin ’ya’ya!” Nan da nan itacen ya yanƙwane.
english: Seeing a fig tree by the road, he came to it and found nothing on it but leaves. He said to it, “Let there be no fruit from you forever!” Immediately the fig tree withered away.

hausa: ku kuwa na Kiristi ne, Kiristi kuma na Allah ne.
english: and you are Christ’s, and Christ is God’s.

hausa: Ƙuri’ar kabilar Benyamin bisa ga iyalansu. Rabonsu ya kama daga ƙasar da take tsakanin kabilar Yahuda da ta Yusuf.
english: The lot of the tribe of the children of Benjamin came up according to their families. The border of their lot went out between the children of Judah and the children of Joseph.

hausa: Isra’ilawa suka yi ta cewa, “Kun ga yadda wannan mutum yana ta fitowa? Yana fitowa ne don yă kalubalanci Isra’ila. Sarki zai sāka wa mutumin da ya kashe wannan da dukiya mai yawa. Zai kuma ba shi ’yarsa yă aura, yă cire suna mahaifinsa daga biyan kuɗin haraji cikin Isra’ila.”
english: The men of Israel said, “Have you seen this man who has come up? He has surely come up to defy Israel. The king will give great riches to the man who kills him, and will give him his daughter, and will make his father’s house tax-free in Israel.”

hausa: Mizrayim shi ne mahaifin Ludiyawa, Anamawa, Lehabiyawa, Naftuhiyawa,
english: Mizraim became the father of Ludim, Anamim, Lehabim, Naphtuhim,

hausa: Amma sauran mutanen da suka je tare da shi, suka ce, “Ba za mu iya kara da mutanen nan ba; sun fi mu ƙarfi.”
english: But the men who went up with him said, “We aren’t able to go up against the people; for they are stronger than we.”

hausa: Dole ku hallaka dukan mutanen da Ubangiji Allahnku ya bashe su gare ku. Kada ku ji tausayinsu, kada kuma ku bauta wa allolinsu, gama wannan zai zama tarko gare ku.
english: You shall consume all the peoples whom Yahweh your God shall deliver to you. Your eye shall not pity them. You shall not serve their gods; for that would be a snare to you.

hausa: Sa’ad da Hiram sarkin Taya ya ji an shafe Solomon sarki yă gāji mahaifinsa Dawuda, sai ya aika da jakadunsa zuwa wurin Solomon, gama shi da Dawuda abokai ne sosai dukan kwanakinsa.
english: Hiram king of Tyre sent his servants to Solomon, for he had heard that they had anointed him king in the place of his father, and Hiram had always loved David.

hausa: Da tana tafiya a kan jaki, ta kai gindin wani dutse ke nan, sai ga Dawuda da mutanensa suna gangarowa zuwa wajen da take. Sai ta tafi, ta sadu da su.
english: As she rode on her donkey, and came down hidden by the mountain, behold, David and his men came down toward her, and she met them.

hausa: Kada ka so barci in ba haka ba za ka talauce; ka zauna a faɗake za ka kuwa kasance da sauran abinci.
english: Don’t love sleep, lest you come to poverty. Open your eyes, and you shall be satisfied with bread.

hausa: Yesu ya ce, “Saboda shari’a ce na zo duniya nan, saboda makafi su sami ganin gari, waɗanda suke gani kuma su makance.”
english: Jesus said, “I came into this world for judgment, that those who don’t see may see; and that those who see may become blind.”

hausa: suna zama a kaburbura su kwana suna yin asirtattun ayyuka; suna cin naman aladu, tukwanensu kuma sun cika da nama marar tsabta;
english: who sit among the graves, and spend nights in secret places; who eat pig’s meat, and broth of abominable things is in their vessels;

hausa: “Amma suka yi rashin biyayya suka kuma yi tawaye gare ka; suka sa dokarka a bayansu. Suka kashe annabawanka waɗanda suka gargaɗe su don su mai da su gare ka; suka aikata saɓo mai bantsoro.
english: “Nevertheless they were disobedient and rebelled against you, cast your law behind their back, killed your prophets that testified against them to turn them again to you, and they committed awful blasphemies.

hausa: Gari na wayewa tun da sassafe Dawuda da mutanensa suka tashi suka kama hanyar komawa ƙasar Filistiyawa. Filistiyawa kuwa suka haura zuwa Yezireyel.
english: So David rose up early, he and his men, to depart in the morning, to return into the land of the Philistines; and the Philistines went up to Jezreel.

hausa: suka yi ta yawo daga al’umma zuwa al’umma, daga wannan mulki zuwa wancan.
english: They went about from nation to nation, from one kingdom to another people.

hausa: Ubangiji ya ce wa Musa,
english: Yahweh said to Moses,

hausa: A can ya ga rijiya a jeji da garkuna uku na tumaki kwance kusa da ita, gama a wannan rijiya ce ake shayar da garkuna. Dutsen da ake rufe bakin rijiyar mai girma ne.
english: He looked, and saw a well in the field, and saw three flocks of sheep lying there by it. For out of that well they watered the flocks. The stone on the well’s mouth was large.

hausa: in har ya hukunta biranen Sodom da Gomorra ta wurin ƙone su suka zama toka, ya kuma maishe su misali na abin da zai faru da marasa tsoron Allah;
english: and turning the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah into ashes, condemned them to destruction, having made them an example to those who would live in an ungodly way,

hausa: Amma Omri ya yi mugunta a gaban Ubangiji, ya kuma yi zunubi fiye da dukan waɗanda suka kasance kafin shi.
english: Omri did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight, and dealt wickedly above all who were before him.

hausa: Bayan ya bar su, sai ya hau kan dutse don yă yi addu’a.
english: After he had taken leave of them, he went up the mountain to pray.

hausa: To, ana nan, sai ɗaya daga cikin Farisiyawa ya gayyaci Yesu cin abincin yamma a gidansa, ya kuwa tafi gidan Bafarisiyen, ya zauna a tebur.
english: One of the Pharisees invited him to eat with him. He entered into the Pharisee’s house and sat at the table.

hausa: Da yawa suka ba da shaidar ƙarya a kansa, amma shaidarsu ba tă zo ɗaya ba.
english: For many gave false testimony against him, and their testimony didn’t agree with each other.

hausa: A washe azurfa; a washe zinariya; dukiyarsu ba ta da iyaka, arzikinsu kuma ba ya ƙarewa.
english: Take the plunder of silver. Take the plunder of gold, for there is no end of treasure, an abundance of every precious thing.

hausa: Suna cutar macen da ba ta da ɗa, suna nuna wa gwauruwa rashin alheri.
english: He devours the barren who don’t bear. He shows no kindness to the widow.

hausa: “ ‘Da wa cikin itatuwan Eden za a kwatanta da kai cikin girma da daraja? Duk da haka kai ma, za a yi ƙasa da kai tare da itatuwan Eden zuwa ƙarƙashin ƙasa; za ka kwanta a cikin marasa kaciya, tare da waɗanda aka kashe da takobi. “ ‘Fir’auna ke nan da dukan jama’arsa, in ji Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka.’ ”
english: “‘To whom are you thus like in glory and in greatness among the trees of Eden? Yet you will be brought down with the trees of Eden to the lower parts of the earth. You will lie in the middle of the uncircumcised, with those who are slain by the sword. “‘This is Pharaoh and all his multitude,’ says the Lord Yahweh.”

hausa: Ta ajiye rigar kusa da ita sai da maigidansa ya dawo gida.
english: She laid up his garment by her, until his master came home.

hausa: Amma Musa ya amsa ya ce, “Kana kishi domina ne? Da ma a ce dukan mutanen Ubangiji annabawa ne, da ma a kuma ce Ubangiji ya sa Ruhunsa a kansu mana!”
english: Moses said to him, “Are you jealous for my sake? I wish that all Yahweh’s people were prophets, that Yahweh would put his Spirit on them!”

hausa: “Kakanni-kakanninmu suna da tabanakul na Shaida tare da su a hamada. An yi shi bisa ga yadda Allah ya umarci Musa, bisa ga zānen da ya gani.
english: “Our fathers had the tabernacle of the testimony in the wilderness, even as he who spoke to Moses commanded him to make it according to the pattern that he had seen;

hausa: ku yi godiya cikin kowane hali, gama wannan shi ne nufin Allah dominku cikin Kiristi Yesu.
english: In everything give thanks, for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus toward you.

hausa: sai manyan mutanen Ammonawa suka ce wa Hanun shugabansu, “Kana tsammani Dawuda yana girmama mahaifinka ne da ya aiko da jakadu su kawo maka ta’aziyya? Ai, wayo ya yi don yă ga asirin birninmu, yă san ƙarfinmu, yă kuma ci mu da yaƙi.”
english: But the princes of the children of Ammon said to Hanun their lord, “Do you think that David honors your father, in that he has sent comforters to you? Hasn’t David sent his servants to you to search the city, to spy it out, and to overthrow it?”

hausa: Duk wanda ya gaskata, aka kuma yi masa baftisma, zai sami ceto. Amma duk wanda bai gaskata ba kuwa, zai hallaka.
english: He who believes and is baptized will be saved; but he who disbelieves will be condemned.

hausa: Ku saurara ku kuma ji muryata; ku kasa kunne ku kuma ji abin da na faɗa.
english: Give ear, and hear my voice! Listen, and hear my speech!

hausa: In an jefa mu cikin tanderun wutar nan, Allahn da muke bauta wa zai iya cetonmu daga ita, kuma ya sarki, zai cece mu daga hannunka.
english: If it happens, our God whom we serve is able to deliver us from the burning fiery furnace; and he will deliver us out of your hand, O king.

hausa: Aka yi farin ciki mai girma a Urushalima, gama tun zamanin Solomon ɗan Dawuda sarkin Isra’ila, ba a taɓa yin wani abu kamar haka a Urushalima ba.
english: So there was great joy in Jerusalem; for since the time of Solomon the son of David king of Israel there was nothing like this in Jerusalem.

hausa: Amma kana nan yadda kake, kuma shekarunka ba za su taɓa ƙarewa ba.
english: But you are the same. Your years will have no end.

hausa: Waƙar haurawa. Masu albarka ne dukan masu tsoron Ubangiji, waɗanda suke tafiya a hanyoyinsa.
english: A Song of Ascents. Blessed is everyone who fears Yahweh, who walks in his ways.

hausa: kuna kuma koya musu, su yi biyayya da duk abin da na umarce ku, kuma tabbatacce, ina tare da ku kullum, har ƙarshen zamani.”
english: teaching them to observe all things that I commanded you. Behold, I am with you always, even to the end of the age.” Amen.

hausa: Kenaz, Teman, Mibzar.
english: chief Kenaz, chief Teman, chief Mibzar,

hausa: Ya yi ihu da babbar murya ya ce, “Ina ruwanka da ni Yesu, Ɗan Allah Mafi Ɗaukaka? Ka rantse da Allah cewa ba za ka ba ni azaba ba!”
english: and crying out with a loud voice, he said, “What have I to do with you, Jesus, you Son of the Most High God? I adjure you by God, don’t torment me.”

hausa: Sihon sarkin Amoriyawa ya yi mulkin Heshbon, bayan ya ci sarkin Mowab na dā da yaƙi, ya kuma ƙwace dukan ƙasarsa har zuwa arewancin kogin Arnon.
english: For Heshbon was the city of Sihon the king of the Amorites, who had fought against the former king of Moab, and taken all his land out of his hand, even to the Arnon.

hausa: Ko bayan Yesu ya yi dukan waɗannan abubuwan banmamaki a gabansu, duk da haka ba su gaskata da shi ba.
english: But though he had done so many signs before them, yet they didn’t believe in him,

hausa: Kowane mutumin da yake da shuɗi, shunayya ko jan zare, ko lallausan lilin, ko gashin akuya, ko fatun rago da aka rina ja, ko fatun shanun teku, suka kawo.
english: Everyone with whom was found blue, purple, scarlet, fine linen, goats’ hair, rams’ skins dyed red, and sea cow hides, brought them.

hausa: Daga hamadar Kedemot, na aiki ’yan saƙo zuwa wurin Sihon sarkin Heshbon, a kan ina neman zaman lafiya, ina cewa,
english: I sent messengers out of the wilderness of Kedemoth to Sihon king of Heshbon with words of peace, saying,

hausa: To, wannan mutum Mika yana da ɗakin gumaka, ya yi efod da waɗansu gumaka, ya kuma naɗa ɗaya daga cikin ’ya’yansa firist nasa.
english: The man Micah had a house of gods, and he made an ephod, and teraphim, and consecrated one of his sons, who became his priest.

hausa: Ka saurara, ɗana, ka zama mai hikima, ka kafa zuciyarka a hanyar da take daidai.
english: Listen, my son, and be wise, and keep your heart on the right path!

hausa: “Ayuba ya ce, ‘Ba ni da laifi, amma Allah ya hana mini hakkina.
english: For Job has said, ‘I am righteous, God has taken away my right.

hausa: Ku dubi irin manya-manyan harufan da na yi amfani da su yayinda nake rubuta muku da hannuna!
english: See with what large letters I write to you with my own hand.

hausa: Sa’an nan sarki ya ce wa mutanensa, “Ba ku gane cewa ɗan sarki kuma babban mutum ya mutu a ƙasar Isra’ila a yau ba?
english: The king said to his servants, “Don’t you know that a prince and a great man has fallen today in Israel?

hausa: Samson ya ce musu, “Tun da kun aikata wannan, ba zan bari ba har sai na ɗau fansa a kanku.”
english: Samson said to them, “If you behave like this, surely I will take revenge on you, and after that I will cease.”

hausa: Duk da haka, in akwai mala’ika a gefensa kamar matsakanci, ɗaya daga cikin dubu, da zai gaya wa mutum abin da yake daidai gare shi,
english: “If there is beside him an angel, an interpreter, one among a thousand, to show to man what is right for him,

hausa: Ba zan taɓa yarda cewa kuna da gaskiya ba; har in mutu, ba zan daina kāre mutuncina ba.
english: Far be it from me that I should justify you. Until I die I will not put away my integrity from me.

hausa: Ya kuma ga tsara ta uku ta ’ya’yan Efraim. Haka ma ’ya’yan Makir ɗan Manasse, an haife su aka sa a gwiwoyin Yusuf.
english: Joseph saw Ephraim’s children to the third generation. The children also of Machir, the son of Manasseh, were born on Joseph’s knees.

hausa: Sa’ad da aka shigo da Bulus, sai Tertullus ya shiga kai ƙararsa a gaban Felis yana cewa, “Mun daɗe muna zaman lafiya a ƙarƙashinka, hangen nesanka kuma ya kawo gyare-gyare a wannan ƙasa.
english: When he was called, Tertullus began to accuse him, saying, “Seeing that by you we enjoy much peace, and that prosperity is coming to this nation by your foresight,

hausa: ’Ya’yan Lotan maza su ne, Hori da Homam. Timna ’yar’uwar Lotan ce.
english: The children of Lotan were Hori and Heman. Lotan’s sister was Timna.

hausa: Sai ya sunkuya kusa da ita, ya kuma tsawata wa zazzaɓin, sai zazzaɓin ya sāke ta. Nan take ta tashi, ta yi musu hidima.
english: He stood over her and rebuked the fever, and it left her. Immediately she rose up and served them.

hausa: Gama ba wanda ya taɓa ƙin jikinsa, sai dai yă ciyar da shi, yă kuma kula da shi, kamar yadda Kiristi yake yi wa ikkilisiya,
english: For no man ever hated his own flesh, but nourishes and cherishes it, even as the Lord also does the assembly,

hausa: Ba ni na umarce ka ba? Ka yi ƙarfin hali ka kuma kasance da rashin tsoro. Kada ka ji tsoro; kada ka karaya, gama Ubangiji Allahnka zai kasance tare da kai duk inda za ka je.”
english: Haven’t I commanded you? Be strong and courageous. Don’t be afraid. Don’t be dismayed, for Yahweh your God is with you wherever you go.”

hausa: daga zuriyar Shefatiya, Zebadiya ɗan Mika’ilu ne shugaba, tare da shi akwai mutum 80;
english: Of the sons of Shephatiah, Zebadiah the son of Michael; and with him eighty males.

hausa: Wutsiyarta tana da ƙarfi kamar itacen al’ul; jijiyoyin cinyoyinta suna haɗe a wuri ɗaya.
english: He moves his tail like a cedar. The sinews of his thighs are knit together.

hausa: Adalcin marasa laifi kan miƙe hanyarsu, amma akan ƙasƙantar da mugaye ta wurin muguntarsu.
english: The righteousness of the blameless will direct his way, but the wicked shall fall by his own wickedness.

hausa: Ana ce da su azurfar da aka ƙi, gama Ubangiji ya ƙi su.”
english: Men will call them rejected silver, because Yahweh has rejected them.”

hausa: Ka ba da girma ga mahaifinka da mahaifiyarka, yadda Ubangiji Allahnka ya umarce ka, don ka yi tsawon rai, ka kuma sami zaman lafiya a ƙasar da Ubangiji Allahnka yake ba ka.
english: “Honor your father and your mother, as Yahweh your God commanded you, that your days may be long and that it may go well with you in the land which Yahweh your God gives you.

hausa: Baƙin ciki ya rufe raina shekaruna sun cika da nishi; ƙarfina ya karai saboda azaba, ƙasusuwana kuma sun gaji tiƙis.
english: For my life is spent with sorrow, my years with sighing. My strength fails because of my iniquity. My bones are wasted away.

hausa: Ka neme su da laifi a kan laifi; kada ka bar su su sami rabo a cikin cetonka.
english: Charge them with crime upon crime. Don’t let them come into your righteousness.

hausa: Daga hadaya ta salama ta Isra’ilawa, na ɗauki ƙirjin da aka kaɗa da kuma cinyar da aka miƙa, na ba da su ga Haruna firist da kuma ’ya’yansa maza a matsayin rabonsu na kullum daga Isra’ilawa.’ ”
english: For the waved breast and the heaved thigh I have taken from the children of Israel out of the sacrifices of their peace offerings, and have given them to Aaron the priest and to his sons as their portion forever from the children of Israel.’”

hausa: Maganar Allah tana da rai, tana kuma da ƙarfin aiki. Ta fi kowane takobi mai baki biyu kaifi. Maganarsa takan ratsa har ciki-ciki, tana raba rai da ruhu, gaɓoɓi da kuma ɓargon ƙashi; har sai ta tone ainihi wane ne muke.
english: For the word of God is living and active, and sharper than any two-edged sword, piercing even to the dividing of soul and spirit, of both joints and marrow, and is able to discern the thoughts and intentions of the heart.

hausa: Sa’an nan ki shiga ciki, ki kulle ƙofar da ke da ’ya’yanki kuke ciki. Ku ɗuɗɗura man a dukan tulunan, sa’ad da kowanne ya cika, sai ki ajiye a gefe.”
english: Go in and shut the door on you and on your sons, and pour oil into all those containers; and set aside those which are full.”

hausa: Gama Makidoniya da Akayya sun ji daɗin yin gudummawa domin matalautan da suke cikin tsarkakan da suke a Urushalima.
english: For it has been the good pleasure of Macedonia and Achaia to make a certain contribution for the poor among the saints who are at Jerusalem.

hausa: Ku tabbata ka ɗauki wannan da muhimmanci. Don me za a bari wannan abu yă zama abin damuwa ga sarauta?
english: Be careful that you not be slack doing so. Why should damage grow to the hurt of the kings?

hausa: Ana ɗaukaka Ubangiji a bisa dukan al’ummai, ɗaukakarsa a bisa sammai
english: Yahweh is high above all nations, his glory above the heavens.

hausa: Zan kuwa kawo ku a ƙasar da na rantse da hannun da na ɗaga sama, cewa zan ba wa Ibrahim, wa Ishaku, da kuma wa Yaƙub. Zan ba da ita gare ku gādo. Ni ne Ubangiji.’ ”
english: I will bring you into the land which I swore to give to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob; and I will give it to you for a heritage: I am Yahweh.’”

hausa: Wata murya ta fito daga cikin girgijen, tana cewa, “Wannan Ɗana ne, zaɓaɓɓena, ku saurare shi.”
english: A voice came out of the cloud, saying, “This is my beloved Son. Listen to him!”

hausa: cewa Kiristi zai sha wahala, kuma a matsayin wanda yake na fari da zai tashi daga matattu, zai yi shelar haske ga mutanensa da kuma Al’ummai.”
english: how the Christ must suffer, and how, by the resurrection of the dead, he would be first to proclaim light both to these people and to the Gentiles.”

hausa: Ya je wurinsa, ya daddaure masa raunukansa, sa’an nan ya zuba mai, da ruwan inabi. Ya ɗauki mutumin ya sa a kan jakinsa, ya kai shi wani masauƙi, ya yi jinyarsa.
english: came to him, and bound up his wounds, pouring on oil and wine. He set him on his own animal, brought him to an inn, and took care of him.

hausa: Sa’an nan maganar Ubangiji ta zo gare shi cewa, “Wannan mutum ba zai zama magājinka ba, ɗa da yake zuwa daga jikinka ne zai zama magājinka.”
english: Behold, Yahweh’s word came to him, saying, “This man will not be your heir, but he who will come out of your own body will be your heir.”

hausa: Sun ɗauka cewa sun san Allah, amma ta wurin ayyukansu suna mūsunsa. Sun zama abin ƙyama, marasa biyayya, ba su ma isa su yi aiki nagari ba.
english: They profess that they know God, but by their deeds they deny him, being abominable, disobedient, and unfit for any good work.

hausa: “Duba, zan maishe ki ƙarama a cikin al’ummai; za a rena ki ƙwarai.
english: Behold, I have made you small among the nations. You are greatly despised.

hausa: ya kuma ce musu, “Ku saurare ni, Lawiyawa! Ku tsarkake kanku yanzu, ku kuma tsarkake haikalin Ubangiji Allah na kakanninku. Ku fid da ƙazanta daga wuri mai tsarki.
english: and said to them, “Listen to me, you Levites! Now sanctify yourselves, and sanctify the house of Yahweh, the God of your fathers, and carry the filthiness out of the holy place.

hausa: Yanzu kuma Ubangiji ya cika shi; ya yi kamar yadda ya faɗa. Dukan wannan ya faru domin kun yi zunubi ga Ubangiji ba ku kuwa yi masa biyayya ba.
english: and Yahweh has brought it, and done according as he spoke. Because you have sinned against Yahweh, and have not obeyed his voice, therefore this thing has come on you.

hausa: “Duk mai jin kalmomina bai kuwa kiyaye su ba, ba ni ba ne nake shari’anta shi. Gama ban zo domin in yi wa duniya shari’a ba, sai dai domin in cece ta.
english: If anyone listens to my sayings and doesn’t believe, I don’t judge him. For I came not to judge the world, but to save the world.

hausa: Sarki Dawuda ya miƙa waɗannan kayayyakin ga Ubangiji, kamar yadda ya yi da azurfa da kuma zinariyan da ya kwaso daga dukan waɗannan al’ummai. Edom da Mowab, Ammonawa da Filistiyawa, da kuma Amalek.
english: King David also dedicated these to Yahweh, with the silver and the gold that he carried away from all the nations: from Edom, from Moab, from the children of Ammon, from the Philistines, and from Amalek.

hausa: Ya yi wannan zance a sarari. Sai Bitrus ya jawo shi gefe, ya fara tsawata masa.
english: He spoke to them openly. Peter took him and began to rebuke him.

hausa: Gama dukan allolin al’ummai gumaka ne, amma Ubangiji ya yi sammai.
english: For all the gods of the peoples are idols, but Yahweh made the heavens.

hausa: Sa’an nan Barnabas ya tafi Tarshish don yă nemi Shawulu,
english: Barnabas went out to Tarsus to look for Saul.

hausa: Ya ce, “Ubangiji ya zo daga Sinai ya haskaka a bisansu daga Seyir; ya haskaka daga Dutsen Faran. Ya zo tare da dubban tsarkakansa daga kudu, daga gangara dutsensa.
english: He said, “Yahweh came from Sinai, and rose from Seir to them. He shone from Mount Paran. He came from the ten thousands of holy ones. At his right hand was a fiery law for them.

hausa: Allah kuwa ya yi magana ga Isra’ila a wahayi da dare ya ce, “Yaƙub! Yaƙub!” Yaƙub kuwa ya amsa ya ce, “Ga ni.”
english: God spoke to Israel in the visions of the night, and said, “Jacob, Jacob!” He said, “Here I am.”

hausa: duk da haka hannuwana ba su aikata ɓarna ba kuma addu’ata mai tsabta ce.
english: although there is no violence in my hands, and my prayer is pure.

hausa: Yesu ya amsa ya ce, “Gaskiya nake gaya muku, duk mai yin zunubi bawan zunubi ne.
english: Jesus answered them, “Most certainly I tell you, everyone who commits sin is the bondservant of sin.

hausa: “Wannan wata za tă zama a gare ku wata na farko, wata na fari na shekararku.
english: “This month shall be to you the beginning of months. It shall be the first month of the year to you.

hausa: Dawuda ya ce, “Wa zai gaya mini idan mahaifinka ya amsa maka da amsa marar daɗi?”
english: Then David said to Jonathan, “Who will tell me if your father answers you roughly?”

hausa: Saboda haka Sarki Belshazar ya firgita ƙwarai kuma fuskarsa ta ƙara ruɗewa. Hakimansa kuma suka rikice.
english: Then King Belshazzar was greatly troubled, and his face was changed in him, and his lords were perplexed.

hausa: Kowace irin dabba, tsuntsu, masu ja da ciki da kuma halittun da suke cikin teku an sarrafa su kuma mutum ne ya sarrafa,
english: For every kind of animal, bird, creeping thing, and sea creature is tamed, and has been tamed by mankind;
