hausa: Ku duba, na sa a gabanku a yau, rai da wadata, mutuwa da kuma hallaka.
english: Behold, I have set before you today life and prosperity, and death and evil.

hausa: Ƙaunataccena yana kamar ƙanshin mur a gare ni, kwance a tsakanin ƙirjina.
english: My beloved is to me a sachet of myrrh, that lies between my breasts.

hausa: Daga Yohanna, Zuwa ga ikkilisiyoyi bakwai da suke a lardin Asiya. Alheri da salama gare ku daga shi wanda yake a yanzu, wanda yake a dā, da kuma wanda zai zo, da kuma daga ruhohi bakwai da suke a gaban kursiyinsa,
english: John, to the seven assemblies that are in Asia: Grace to you and peace from God, who is and who was and who is to come; and from the seven Spirits who are before his throne;

hausa: Shawulu ya ce, “Ashe, ni ba mutumin Benyamin ba ne daga ƙaramar kabila ta Isra’ila? Dangina kuma ba shi ba ne mafi kakanni a cikin kabilar Benyamin ba? Yaya za ka faɗa mini irin wannan magana.”
english: Saul answered, “Am I not a Benjamite, of the smallest of the tribes of Israel? And my family the least of all the families of the tribe of Benjamin? Why then do you speak to me like this?”

hausa: Sa’ad da ya faɗa haka, sai Yesu ya yi kira da babbar murya ya ce, “Lazarus, ka fito!”
english: When he had said this, he cried with a loud voice, “Lazarus, come out!”

hausa: Nan da nan Yahuda ya je wurin Yesu ya ce, “Rabbi!” Ya kuma yi masa sumba.
english: When he had come, immediately he came to him and said, “Rabbi! Rabbi!” and kissed him.

hausa: Bari ’ya’yansa su zama masu yawo suna bara; bari a yi ta koransu daga gidajensu da suke kufai.
english: Let his children be wandering beggars. Let them be sought from their ruins.

hausa: Sai Yahudawa suka tambaye shi, “Wace abar banmamaki za ka nuna mana ka tabbatar mana ikonka na yin duk waɗannan?”
english: The Jews therefore answered him, “What sign do you show us, seeing that you do these things?”

hausa: Za su naɗa rawunan lilin a kawunansu, su kuma sa wandunan lilin. Kada su sa wani abin da zai sa su yi zuffa.
english: They shall have linen turbans on their heads, and shall have linen trousers on their waists. They shall not clothe themselves with anything that makes them sweat.

hausa: zai kahu har abada kamar wata, amintacciyar shaida a cikin sarari.” Sela
english: It will be established forever like the moon, the faithful witness in the sky.” Selah.

hausa: Da ya samo muƙamuƙin jaki, ya ɗauka, sai ya karkashe mutane dubu ɗaya.
english: He found a fresh jawbone of a donkey, put out his hand, took it, and struck a thousand men with it.

hausa: Sai sarki ya amsa ya ce, “Na gane cewa kuna ƙoƙari ku ɓata lokaci ne kawai domin ku ga na manta da abin.
english: The king answered, “I know of a certainty that you are trying to gain time, because you see the thing has gone from me.

hausa: Sa’ad da wani ya yi alkawari game da gādonsa, dole a tabbatar da mutuwar wanda ya yi ta,
english: For where a last will and testament is, there must of necessity be the death of him who made it.

hausa: Masar ta yi murna sa’ad da suka tafi, saboda tsoron Isra’ila ya fāɗo musu.
english: Egypt was glad when they departed, for the fear of them had fallen on them.

hausa: Ta yi abin da ta iya yi. Ta zuba turare a jikina kafin lokaci, don shirin jana’izata.
english: She has done what she could. She has anointed my body beforehand for the burying.

hausa: da kuma a kan Hamat ita ma, wadda ta yi iyaka da ita, da kuma a kan Taya da Sidon, ko da yake suna da hikima ƙwarai.
english: and Hamath, also, which borders on it, Tyre and Sidon, because they are very wise.

hausa: Salama da jinƙai su tabbata ga dukan waɗanda suke bin wannan ƙa’ida, har ma ga Isra’ila na Allah.
english: As many as walk by this rule, peace and mercy be on them, and on God’s Israel.

hausa: Saboda haka, ’yan’uwa, da yake muna da wannan tabbaci na shiga Wuri Mafi Tsarki ta wurin jinin Yesu,
english: Having therefore, brothers, boldness to enter into the holy place by the blood of Jesus,

hausa: Saboda haka an hana yayyafi, kuma babu ruwan bazara da ya sauka. Duk da haka kina da irin kallon da karuwa takan yi; kin ƙi ki ji kunya.
english: Therefore the showers have been withheld and there has been no latter rain; yet you have had a prostitute’s forehead and you refused to be ashamed.

hausa: tohonsa za su yi girma. Darajarsa za tă zama kamar itacen zaitun, ƙanshinsa kamar al’ul na Lebanon.
english: His branches will spread, and his beauty will be like the olive tree, and his fragrance like Lebanon.

hausa: Ka bi da mutanenka kamar garke ta hannun Musa da Haruna.
english: You led your people like a flock, by the hand of Moses and Aaron.

hausa: Masu karɓar haraji ma suka zo, domin a yi musu baftisma. Suka yi tambaya, suka ce “Malam, me ya kamata mu yi?”
english: Tax collectors also came to be baptized, and they said to him, “Teacher, what must we do?”

hausa: Hurai daga kogunan Ga’ash, Abiyel mutumin Arba,
english: Hurai of the brooks of Gaash, Abiel the Arbathite,

hausa: Ya nuna wa mutanensa ikon ayyukansa, yana ba su ƙasashen waɗansu al’ummai.
english: He has shown his people the power of his works, in giving them the heritage of the nations.

hausa: Yadda Ubangiji ya umarci bawansa Musa, haka Musa ya umarci Yoshuwa, shi kuwa ya yi duk abin da Ubangiji ya umarci Musa.
english: As Yahweh commanded Moses his servant, so Moses commanded Joshua. Joshua did so. He left nothing undone of all that Yahweh commanded Moses.

hausa: Ina jin kunya in ce mun nuna kāsawa da ba mu yi waɗannan abubuwan ba! Abin da wani yake da ƙarfin hali yin taƙama a kai, shi ne ni ma nake ƙarfin hali yin taƙama a kai. Ina magana kamar wawa ne.
english: To my shame, I speak as though we had been weak. Yet in whatever way anyone is bold (I speak in foolishness), I am bold also.

hausa: Ina gaya muku, a’a! Amma in ba ku tuba ba, ku ma duka za ku hallaka.”
english: I tell you, no, but, unless you repent, you will all perish in the same way.”

hausa: Sa’an nan Allah ya buɗe wani rami a Lehi, ruwa kuwa ya fito daga ciki. Da Samson ya sha, sai ƙarfinsa ya dawo, ya kuma wartsake. Aka sa wa wannan maɓulɓula suna En Hakkore, yana nan a Lehi har wa yau.
english: But God split the hollow place that is in Lehi, and water came out of it. When he had drunk, his spirit came again, and he revived. Therefore its name was called En Hakkore, which is in Lehi, to this day.

hausa: da Hebron, da dukan wuraren da Dawuda da mutanensa suka taɓa zagawa.
english: to those who were in Hebron, and to all the places where David himself and his men used to stay.

hausa: Dukan taron suka durƙusa suka yi sujada, yayinda mawaƙa suke rerawa, ana kuma busa ƙahoni, dukan wannan ya ci gaba sai da aka gama miƙa hadaya ta ƙonawa.
english: All the assembly worshiped, the singers sang, and the trumpeters sounded. All this continued until the burnt offering was finished.

hausa: Isra’ila suka aiki manzanni wurin Sihon sarkin Amoriyawa su ce,
english: Israel sent messengers to Sihon king of the Amorites, saying,

hausa: “Ku gudu daga Babilon; ku bar ƙasar Babiloniyawa, ku zama kamar awakin da suke bi da garke.
english: “Flee out of the middle of Babylon! Go out of the land of the Chaldeans, and be as the male goats before the flocks.

hausa: In wani a cikinku yana da damuwa da wani, don me zai kai ƙara a gaban marasa bi, maimakon yă kai ƙara a gaban tsarkaka?
english: Dare any of you, having a matter against his neighbor, go to law before the unrighteous, and not before the saints?

hausa: Sai suka tambaye suka ce, “Shin, me ya yi maka? Ta yaya ya buɗe idanunka?”
english: They said to him again, “What did he do to you? How did he open your eyes?”

hausa: “Yanzu na kusa barin fuskar duniyan nan. Kun sani da dukan zuciyarku, da dukan ranku cewa, Ba ko ɗaya daga cikin alkawuran da Ubangiji Allahnku ya yi, da bai cika ba. Kowane alkawari ya cika; ba ko ɗaya da bai cika ba.
english: “Behold, today I am going the way of all the earth. You know in all your hearts and in all your souls that not one thing has failed of all the good things which Yahweh your God spoke concerning you. All have happened to you. Not one thing has failed of it.

hausa: ’Yan’uwana, a matsayinmu cikin Ubangiji Yesu Kiristi maɗaukaki, kada ku nuna bambanci.
english: My brothers, don’t hold the faith of our glorious Lord Jesus Christ with partiality.

hausa: da ta Lebana, da ta Hagaba, da ta Shalmai,
english: the children of Lebana, the children of Hagaba, the children of Salmai,

hausa: Sama’ila kuwa ya ci gaba da mulkin Isra’ila dukan rayuwarsa.
english: Samuel judged Israel all the days of his life.

hausa: Amma Musa bai ba kabilar Lawiyawa gādo ba; Ubangiji, Allah na Isra’ila, shi ne gādonsu kamar yadda ya yi musu alkawari.
english: But Moses gave no inheritance to the tribe of Levi. Yahweh, the God of Israel, is their inheritance, as he spoke to them.

hausa: Ya lalatar da Tofet, wanda yake a Kwarin Ben Hinnom, don kada kowa yă iya yin amfani da wurin don yă miƙa hadayar ɗansa, ko ’yarsa a wuta ga Molek.
english: He defiled Topheth, which is in the valley of the children of Hinnom, that no man might make his son or his daughter to pass through the fire to Molech.

hausa: Sa’an nan Haggai ya ce, “In mutumin da ya ƙazantar da kansa ta wurin taɓa gawa, ya taɓa wani daga cikin waɗannan abubuwa, za su ƙazantu?” Firistoci suka amsa, suka ce, “I, zai ƙazantu.”
english: Then Haggai said, “If one who is unclean by reason of a dead body touches any of these, will it be unclean?” The priests answered, “It will be unclean.”

hausa: Amma Farisiyawa da masanan dokoki, suka ƙi nufin Allah game da su, domin Yohanna bai yi musu baftisma ba.)
english: But the Pharisees and the lawyers rejected the counsel of God, not being baptized by him themselves.

hausa: Maganar Ubangiji ta zo mini cewa,
english: Now Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

hausa: Sa’ad da suke nan a tsaye, aka ɗauki awa uku ana karanta Littafin Dokar Ubangiji Allahnsu. Aka kuma ɗauki awa uku ana sujada ga Ubangiji Allahnsu.
english: They stood up in their place, and read in the book of the law of Yahweh their God a fourth part of the day; and a fourth part they confessed and worshiped Yahweh their God.

hausa: Kashegari da dare Ubangiji ya tsaya kusa da Bulus ya ce, “Ka yi ƙarfin hali! Don kamar yadda ka yi shaida game da ni a Urushalima, haka kuma lalle, za ka yi shaidata a Roma.”
english: The following night, the Lord stood by him and said, “Cheer up, Paul, for as you have testified about me at Jerusalem, so you must testify also at Rome.”

hausa: Ya ba shi tsari game ɓangarori na firistoci da Lawiyawa, da game dukan aikin hidima a cikin haikalin Ubangiji, da kuma game da dukan kayayyakin da za a yi amfani da su a hidima.
english: also for the divisions of the priests and the Levites, for all the work of the service of Yahweh’s house, and for all the vessels of service in Yahweh’s house—

hausa: Ubangiji kuwa yana tare da Yehoshafat domin a shekarunsa na farko-farko ya yi tafiya a hanyoyin da kakansa Dawuda ya bi. Bai nemi shawarar Ba’al ba
english: Yahweh was with Jehoshaphat, because he walked in the first ways of his father David, and didn’t seek the Baals,

hausa: Na yi shiri in ziyarce ku a kan hanyata zuwa Makidoniya, in kuma sāke dawo wurinku a kan hanyata daga Makidoniya, sa’an nan ku yi mini rakiya a hanyata zuwa Yahudiya.
english: and by you to pass into Macedonia, and again from Macedonia to come to you, and to be sent forward by you on my journey to Judea.

hausa: ’Ya’yan Midiyan maza su ne, Efa, Efer, Hanok, Abida, da kuma Elda’a. Dukan waɗannan zuriyar Ketura ce.
english: The sons of Midian were Ephah, Epher, Hanoch, Abida, and Eldaah. All these were the children of Keturah.

hausa: Lot da ’ya’yansa biyu mata suka bar Zowar suka kuma zauna a cikin duwatsu, gama ya ji tsoro yă zauna a Zowar. Shi da ’ya’yansa biyu mata suka zauna a ciki wani kogo.
english: Lot went up out of Zoar, and lived in the mountain, and his two daughters with him; for he was afraid to live in Zoar. He lived in a cave with his two daughters.

hausa: Amma ko da bai cece mu ba, muna so ka sani, ya sarki; cewa ba za mu bauta wa allolinka ba ko kuma mu yi sujada ga gunkin zinariyar da ka kafa ba.”
english: But if not, let it be known to you, O king, that we will not serve your gods or worship the golden image which you have set up.”

hausa: Da Solomon ya gama dukan waɗannan addu’o’i da roƙe-roƙe ga Ubangiji, sai ya tashi daga gaban bagaden Ubangiji, inda ya durƙusa da hannuwansa a buɗe waje sama.
english: It was so, that when Solomon had finished praying all this prayer and supplication to Yahweh, he arose from before Yahweh’s altar, from kneeling on his knees with his hands spread out toward heaven.

hausa: Nikodimus ya yi tambaya ya ce, “Yaya wannan zai yiwu?”
english: Nicodemus answered him, “How can these things be?”

hausa: Da jin haka, sai suka yi ƙoƙari su kama shi, sai dai ba wanda ya taɓa shi, don lokacinsa bai yi ba tukuna.
english: They sought therefore to take him; but no one laid a hand on him, because his hour had not yet come.

hausa: Saboda haka Sennakerib sarkin Assuriya ya janye. Ya koma zuwa Ninebe ya zauna a can.
english: So Sennacherib king of Assyria departed, went away, returned to Nineveh, and stayed there.

hausa: Sai Allah ya zo wurin Bala’am ya ce, “Su wane ne waɗannan tare da kai?”
english: God came to Balaam, and said, “Who are these men with you?”

hausa: Ya amsa ya ce, “Mahaifiyata da ’yan’uwana, su ne waɗanda suke jin maganar Allah, suna kuma aikata ta.”
english: But he answered them, “My mother and my brothers are these who hear the word of God and do it.”

hausa: Da suka yi kusa da Urushalima suka kuma kai Betfaji da yake kan Dutsen Zaitun, sai Yesu ya aiki almajirai biyu,
english: When they came near to Jerusalem and came to Bethsphage, to the Mount of Olives, then Jesus sent two disciples,

hausa: Yayinda yake la’antar, Shimeyi ya ce, “Tafi daga nan, tafi daga nan, mai kisankai, mutumin banza kawai!
english: Shimei said when he cursed, “Be gone, be gone, you man of blood, and wicked fellow!

hausa: Amma Ubangiji zai karɓe mallakarta, zai hallaka ikonta da take da shi a kan teku, wuta kuma za tă cinye ta.
english: Behold, the Lord will dispossess her, and he will strike her power in the sea; and she will be devoured with fire.

hausa: Mai ba da shaidar ƙarya zai hallaka, kuma duk wanda ya saurare shi zai hallaka har abada.
english: A false witness will perish. A man who listens speaks to eternity.

hausa: Amma lokacin da ka kira biki, ka gayyaci matalauta, da guragu, da shanyayyu, da makafi.
english: But when you make a feast, ask the poor, the maimed, the lame, or the blind;

hausa: “Mutane suna ji ina nishi da ƙyar, amma ba wanda zai yi mini ta’aziyya. Dukan maƙiyana sun ji wahalar da nake ciki; suna farin ciki da abin da ka yi. Ka kawo ranan nan da ka sanar domin su ma su zama kamar ni.
english: “They have heard that I sigh. There is no one to comfort me. All my enemies have heard of my trouble. They are glad that you have done it. You will bring the day that you have proclaimed, and they will be like me.

hausa: Dawuda ya yi mulkin dukan ƙasar Isra’ila, yana yin wa dukan jama’arsa shari’ar gaskiya da adalci.
english: David reigned over all Israel; and David executed justice and righteousness for all his people.

hausa: Ni a cikinsu kai kuma a cikina. Bari su kasance da cikakken haɗinkai, domin duniya ta san cewa kai ka aiko ni. Ka kuwa ƙaunace su yadda ka ƙaunace ni.
english: I in them, and you in me, that they may be perfected into one, that the world may know that you sent me and loved them, even as you loved me.

hausa: Azariya ya huta tare da kakanninsa, aka kuma binne shi kusa da su a Birnin Dawuda. Yotam ɗansa, kuma ya gāje shi.
english: Azariah slept with his fathers; and they buried him with his fathers in David’s city; and Jotham his son reigned in his place.

hausa: Sai Ubangiji ya aika da babban iska a bisan teku, hadiri ya tsananta ƙwarai har jirgin ya yi barazanar farfashewa.
english: But Yahweh sent out a great wind on the sea, and there was a mighty storm on the sea, so that the ship was likely to break up.

hausa: Na tashi don in buɗe wa ƙaunataccena, sai hannuna ya jiƙe sharkaf da mur, yatsotsina suna ɗiga da mur, a hannuwan ƙofar.
english: I rose up to open for my beloved. My hands dripped with myrrh, my fingers with liquid myrrh, on the handles of the lock.

hausa: Mutane suna tangaɗi daga gari zuwa gari suna neman ruwa amma ba su sami isashen ruwan sha ba, duk da haka ba ku juyo gare ni ba,” in ji Ubangiji.
english: So two or three cities staggered to one city to drink water, and were not satisfied; yet you haven’t returned to me,” says Yahweh.

hausa: Bawanka zai ƙetare Urdun tare da sarki, yă ɗan yi maka rakiya kaɗan. Me ya sa ranka yă daɗe zai ba ni irin wannan lada.
english: Your servant will just go over the Jordan with the king. Why should the king repay me with such a reward?

hausa: Da ya komo, sai ya gaya wa mahaifinsa da mahaifiyarsa ya ce, “Na ga wata mace a Timna; ku auro mini ita ta zama matata.”
english: He came up, and told his father and his mother, saying, “I have seen a woman in Timnah of the daughters of the Philistines. Now therefore get her for me as my wife.”

hausa: Dukan yini ina miƙa hannuwana ga mutane masu tayarwa, waɗanda suna tafiya a hanyoyin da ba su da kyau, suna bin tunaninsu,
english: I have spread out my hands all day to a rebellious people, who walk in a way that is not good, after their own thoughts;

hausa: Iyakarsu a kudanci ta tashi tun daga kurewar kudu na Tekun Gishiri,
english: Their south border was from the uttermost part of the Salt Sea, from the bay that looks southward;

hausa: Wannan ne zai zama sakamakon girmankansu, saboda zagi da kuma ba’ar da suka yi wa mutanen Ubangiji Maɗaukaki.
english: This they will have for their pride, because they have reproached and magnified themselves against the people of Yahweh of Armies.

hausa: Nan da nan, sai wani abu kamar ɓawo ya fāɗo daga idanun Shawulu, ya kuma sāke iya ganin gari. Sai ya tashi aka kuma yi masa baftisma,
english: Immediately something like scales fell from his eyes, and he received his sight. He arose and was baptized.

hausa: Amma sarki ya ce, “Lalle Ahimelek za ka mutu, da kai da dukan iyalin mahaifinka.”
english: The king said, “You shall surely die, Ahimelech, you and all your father’s house.”

hausa: Sa’ad da kuka shiga ƙasar da Ubangiji zai ba ku yadda ya alkawarta, ku kiyaye wannan biki.
english: It shall happen when you have come to the land which Yahweh will give you, as he has promised, that you shall keep this service.

hausa: Ya ce musu, “Ku ne masu mai da kanku marasa laifi a gaban mutane, amma Allah ya san zuciyarku. Abu mai daraja a gaban mutane, abin ƙyama ne a gaban Allah.
english: He said to them, “You are those who justify yourselves in the sight of men, but God knows your hearts. For that which is exalted among men is an abomination in the sight of God.

hausa: Sukan ɗaura kaya masu nauyi, su sa wa mutane a kafaɗa. Amma su kansu, ba sa ko sa yatsa su taimaka.
english: For they bind heavy burdens that are grievous to be borne, and lay them on men’s shoulders; but they themselves will not lift a finger to help them.

hausa: Sai suka fara tattaunawa da junansu suna cewa, “Ko don ba mu kawo burodi ba ne.”
english: They reasoned among themselves, saying, “We brought no bread.”

hausa: da Felatiya, da Hanan, da Anahiya,
english: Pelatiah, Hanan, Anaiah,

hausa: Dole ku ɗauki baƙon da yake zama tare da ku kamar haifaffe ɗan ƙasa. Ku ƙaunace shi kamar kanku, gama dā ku ma baƙi ne a Masar. Ni ne Ubangiji Allahnku.
english: The stranger who lives as a foreigner with you shall be to you as the native-born among you, and you shall love him as yourself; for you lived as foreigners in the land of Egypt. I am Yahweh your God.

hausa: Aka ƙidaya mazan Merari ta kabilarsu da kuma iyalansu.
english: Those who were counted of the families of the sons of Merari, by their families, by their fathers’ houses,

hausa: Suka tambaye shi suka ce, “Ina mutumin yake?” Ya ce, “Ban sani ba.”
english: Then they asked him, “Where is he?” He said, “I don’t know.”

hausa: Sa’an nan mahaifinsu Isra’ila ya ce musu, “In dole ne a yi haka, to, sai ku yi. Ku sa waɗansu amfani mafi kyau na ƙasar a buhunanku, ku ɗauka zuwa wurin mutumin a matsayin kyauta, da ɗan man ƙanshi na shafawa, da kuma ’yar zuma, da kayan yaji, da ƙaro, da tsabar citta da kuma almon.
english: Their father, Israel, said to them, “If it must be so, then do this: Take from the choice fruits of the land in your bags, and carry down a present for the man, a little balm, a little honey, spices and myrrh, nuts, and almonds;

hausa: A kwanakin nan zan ceci Yahuda Urushalima kuma za tă zauna lafiya. Sunan da za a kira ta shi ne, Ubangiji Adalcinmu.’
english: In those days Judah will be saved, and Jerusalem will dwell safely. This is the name by which she will be called: Yahweh our righteousness.”

hausa: A ranar, Dawuda ya ce, “Duk wanda zai kame Yebusiyawa, dole yă yi amfani da wuriyar ruwa don yă kai ga waɗannan ‘guragu da makafi’ waɗanda suke abokan gāban Dawuda.” Shi ya sa suka ce, “ ‘Makafi da guragu’ ba za su shiga fadan sarki ba.”
english: David said on that day, “Whoever strikes the Jebusites, let him go up to the watercourse and strike those lame and blind, who are hated by David’s soul.” Therefore they say, “The blind and the lame can’t come into the house.”

hausa: Ya kuma faɗa wannan game da Yahuda, “Ka ji, ya Ubangiji, kukan Yahuda; ka kawo shi wurin mutanensa. Da hannuwansa ya kāre kansa. Ka taimake shi a kan maƙiyansa!”
english: This is for Judah. He said, “Hear, Yahweh, the voice of Judah. Bring him in to his people. With his hands he contended for himself. You shall be a help against his adversaries.”

hausa: Sai mai bin hakkin jinin yă kashe mai kisankan, sa’ad da ya sadu da mai kisankan, sai yă kashe shi.
english: The avenger of blood shall himself put the murderer to death. When he meets him, he shall put him to death.

hausa: “ ‘Firist zai kawo ta, yă sa tă tsaya a gaban Ubangiji.
english: The priest shall bring her near, and set her before Yahweh.

hausa: Da sarkin yaƙin ya ji cewa sarkin Assuriya ya bar Lakish, sai ya janye, ya kuma iske sarkin yana yaƙi da Libna.
english: So Rabshakeh returned and found the king of Assyria warring against Libnah; for he had heard that he had departed from Lachish.

hausa: Kada ka ɗauke raina tare da masu zunubi raina tare da masu son yin kisankai
english: Don’t gather my soul with sinners, nor my life with bloodthirsty men

hausa: Ta wurin ikonsa, Allah ya tashe Ubangiji daga matattu, haka zai tashe mu mu ma.
english: Now God raised up the Lord, and will also raise us up by his power.

hausa: “Me ya sa kuke tuhumana? Dukanku kun yi mini tawaye,” in ji Ubangiji.
english: “Why will you contend with me? You all have transgressed against me,” says Yahweh.

hausa: “ ‘Cikin dukan halittu masu rai da suke a cikin ruwan tekuna da rafuffuka, za ku iya cin kowane da yake da ƙege da kamɓori.
english: “‘You may eat of all these that are in the waters: whatever has fins and scales in the waters, in the seas, and in the rivers, that you may eat.

hausa: Saboda haka, mu jakadu ne na Kiristi, sai ka ce Allah kansa yake magana ta wurinmu. Muna roƙonku a madadin Kiristi. Ku sulhuntu da Allah.
english: We are therefore ambassadors on behalf of Christ, as though God were entreating by us: we beg you on behalf of Christ, be reconciled to God.

hausa: Saboda haka, abokaina ƙaunatattu, da yake kun riga kun san wannan, sai ku zauna a faɗake don kada a ɗauke hankalinku ta wurin kuskuren marasa bin dokan nan har ku fāɗi daga matsayinku.
english: You therefore, beloved, knowing these things beforehand, beware, lest being carried away with the error of the wicked, you fall from your own steadfastness.

hausa: Sai suka tambaye shi suka ce, “Wane ne wannan da ya ce maka ka ɗauke ta ka yi tafiya?”
english: Then they asked him, “Who is the man who said to you, ‘Take up your mat and walk’?”

hausa: Sun jefa ƙuri’a a kan mutanena suna kuma sayar da yara maza don karuwanci, sun sayar da ’yan matan domin ruwan inabi wanda za su sha.
english: and have cast lots for my people, and have given a boy for a prostitute, and sold a girl for wine, that they may drink.

hausa: A ƙarshen shekaru ashirin, a lokacin da Solomon ya gina haikalin Ubangiji da nasa fadan,
english: At the end of twenty years, in which Solomon had built Yahweh’s house and his own house,

hausa: Amma in wani ya yi biyayya da maganarsa, ƙaunar Allah ta zama cikakkiya ke nan a cikinsa. Ta haka muka san cewa muna cikinsa.
english: But God’s love has most certainly been perfected in whoever keeps his word. This is how we know that we are in him:

hausa: Sai dukanku kuka zo wurina kuka ce, “Bari mu aiki mutane su yi gaba su leƙi mana asirin ƙasar, su kuma kawo mana labari game da hanyar da za mu bi, da kuma biranen da za mu shiga.”
english: You came near to me, everyone of you, and said, “Let’s send men before us, that they may search the land for us, and bring back to us word of the way by which we must go up, and the cities to which we shall come.”

hausa: da Bela ɗan Azaz. Azaz ɗan Shema daga dangin Yowel. Yowel ya yi zama a yankin Arower har zuwa Nebo da Ba’al-Meyon.
english: and Bela the son of Azaz, the son of Shema, the son of Joel, who lived in Aroer, even to Nebo and Baal Meon;

hausa: Mijinta yana iya tabbatar, ko yă rushe duk wani alkawari ko rantsuwar da ta ɗauka.
english: Every vow, and every binding oath to afflict the soul, her husband may establish it, or her husband may make it void.

hausa: Za ku iya kawo su ga Ubangiji kamar hadaya ta ’ya’yan fari, amma ba za a miƙa su a bagade kamar turare mai ƙanshi ba.
english: As an offering of first fruits you shall offer them to Yahweh, but they shall not rise up as a pleasant aroma on the altar.

hausa: Za su ce, “Ina wannan ‘dawowar’ da ya yi alkawari ne? Tun mutuwar kakanninmu, kome yana tafiya kamar yadda yake tun farkon halitta.”
english: and saying, “Where is the promise of his coming? For, from the day that the fathers fell asleep, all things continue as they were from the beginning of the creation.”

hausa: Sai macen ta ce masa, “Ranka yă daɗe, ka ba ni ruwan nan, don kada in ƙara jin ƙishirwa, in yi ta zuwa nan ɗiban ruwa.”
english: The woman said to him, “Sir, give me this water, so that I don’t get thirsty, neither come all the way here to draw.”

hausa: Sai suka sāke kiransu ciki suka kuma umarce su kada su kuskura su yi magana ko su ƙara koyarwa a cikin sunan Yesu.
english: They called them, and commanded them not to speak at all nor teach in the name of Jesus.

hausa: Gama Ubangiji ya riga ya gaya wa Musa cewa, “Kowace rana, shugaba guda zai kawo hadayarsa saboda keɓewar bagade.”
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “They shall offer their offering, each prince on his day, for the dedication of the altar.”

hausa: sai ya fusata da su. Ya sayar da su ga hannun Filistiyawa da Ammonawa,
english: Yahweh’s anger burned against Israel, and he sold them into the hand of the Philistines and into the hand of the children of Ammon.

hausa: Sai Na’omi ta ɗauki yaron, ta kwantar da shi a cinyarta ta kuma kula da shi.
english: Naomi took the child, laid him in her bosom, and became nurse to him.

hausa: A rana ta huɗu suka ce wa matar Samson “Ki rarrashi mijinki yă bayyana mana kacici-kacicin, ko kuwa mu ƙone ki da gidan mahaifinki duka da wuta. Kun kira mu domin ku yi mana fashi ne?”
english: On the seventh day, they said to Samson’s wife, “Entice your husband, that he may declare to us the riddle, lest we burn you and your father’s house with fire. Have you called us to impoverish us? Isn’t that so?”

hausa: Lawiyawa za su tsaya kewaye da sarki, kowane mutum da makamansa a hannunsa. Duk wanda ya shiga haikali sai a kashe shi. Ku tsaya kusa da sarki a duk inda ya tafi.”
english: The Levites shall surround the king, every man with his weapons in his hand. Whoever comes into the house, let him be slain. Be with the king when he comes in and when he goes out.”

hausa: Sai Bitrus ya ce wa Yesu, “Ubangiji, ya yi kyau da muke nan. In kana so, sai in kafa bukkoki uku, ɗaya dominka, ɗaya domin Musa, ɗaya kuma domin Iliya.”
english: Peter answered and said to Jesus, “Lord, it is good for us to be here. If you want, let’s make three tents here: one for you, one for Moses, and one for Elijah.”

hausa: “ ‘Tabbatacce zan tafa hannuwana a kan ƙazamar riba da kika ci da jinin da kin zubar a cikinki.
english: “‘“Behold, therefore I have struck my hand at your dishonest gain which you have made, and at the blood which has been shed within you.

hausa: Allah ya ga yadda duniya ta lalace, gama dukan mutane a duniya sun lalatar da rayuwarsu.
english: God saw the earth, and saw that it was corrupt, for all flesh had corrupted their way on the earth.

hausa: Duk wanda bai rusuna ya yi sujada ba, nan take za a jefa shi a cikin tendarun wuta.”
english: Whoever doesn’t fall down and worship shall be cast into the middle of a burning fiery furnace the same hour.”

hausa: “Yayinda ake haka, babban ɗan yana gona. Da ya zo kusa da gida, sai ya ji ana kiɗi ana rawa.
english: “Now his elder son was in the field. As he came near to the house, he heard music and dancing.

hausa: Solomon ya aika wannan saƙo ga Hiram sarkin Taya. “Ka aika mini gumaguman al’ul kamar yadda ka yi wa mahaifina Dawuda sa’ad da ka aika masa al’ul don yă gina fada yă zauna a ciki.
english: Solomon sent to Huram the king of Tyre, saying, “As you dealt with David my father, and sent him cedars to build him a house in which to dwell, so deal with me.

hausa: Waɗanda suke cikin jirgin ruwan kuwa suka yi masa sujada, suna cewa, “Gaskiya kai Ɗan Allah ne.”
english: Those who were in the boat came and worshiped him, saying, “You are truly the Son of God!”

hausa: Suna guje wa Isra’ilawa suna gangarawa a kan hanyar Bet-Horon har zuwa Azeka, sai Ubangiji ya turo manyan duwatsu daga sararin sama suka karkashe su, waɗanda manyan duwatsun suka kashe sun fi waɗanda Isra’ilawa suka kashe da takobi.
english: As they fled from before Israel, while they were at the descent of Beth Horon, Yahweh hurled down great stones from the sky on them to Azekah, and they died. There were more who died from the hailstones than those whom the children of Israel killed with the sword.

hausa: Saboda haka sai ku ba da umarni yanzu cewa mutanen su daina wannan aiki sai lokacin da na ba da umarni.
english: Make a decree now to cause these men to cease, and that this city not be built until a decree is made by me.

hausa: In muka ce, ‘Za mu shiga cikin birni’ yunwa tana can, za mu kuwa mutu. Idan kuwa muka zauna a nan, za mu mutu. Saboda haka, bari mu ƙetare zuwa sansanin Arameyawa mu miƙa kai. Idan suka bar mu da rai, to; idan kuwa suka kashe mu, shi ke nan.”
english: If we say, ‘We will enter into the city,’ then the famine is in the city, and we will die there. If we sit still here, we also die. Now therefore come, and let’s surrender to the army of the Syrians. If they save us alive, we will live; and if they kill us, we will only die.”

hausa: Sun faɗa wa ikkilisiya game da ƙaunarka. Za ka kyauta in ka sallame su a hanyar da ta cancanci Allah.
english: They have testified about your love before the assembly. You will do well to send them forward on their journey in a way worthy of God,

hausa: Yehoyahaz yana da shekara ashirin da uku sa’ad da ya zama sarki. Ya yi mulki na wata uku a Urushalima. Sunan mahaifiyarsa Hamutal ’yar Irmiya; mutuniyar Libna.
english: Jehoahaz was twenty-three years old when he began to reign; and he reigned three months in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Hamutal the daughter of Jeremiah of Libnah.

hausa: Sai Bitrus, cike da Ruhu Mai Tsarki ya ce musu, “Masu mulki da dattawan mutane!
english: Then Peter, filled with the Holy Spirit, said to them, “You rulers of the people and elders of Israel,

hausa: ’ya’ya maza goma na Haman ɗan Hammedata, abokin gāban Yahudawa. Amma ba su taɓa dukiyarsu ba.
english: the ten sons of Haman the son of Hammedatha, the Jews’ enemy, but they didn’t lay their hand on the plunder.

hausa: Na ce, “Ya Ubangiji, ka yi mini jinƙai; ka warkar da ni, gama na yi maka zunubi.”
english: I said, “Yahweh, have mercy on me! Heal me, for I have sinned against you.”

hausa: Ubangiji ya bayyana mana a dā, yana cewa, “Na ƙaunace ku da madawwamiyar ƙauna; na janye ku da ƙauna marar iyaka.
english: Yahweh appeared of old to me, saying, “Yes, I have loved you with an everlasting love. Therefore I have drawn you with loving kindness.

hausa: Saboda haka Shawulu ya ce, “Ku zo nan dukanku shugabannin rundunoni, mu bincika mu san zunubin da ya kawo rashin amsan nan yau.
english: Saul said, “Draw near here, all you chiefs of the people, and know and see in whom this sin has been today.

hausa: waɗannan mutane uku kuma a daure, suka fāɗa cikin tanderun wutar.
english: These three men, Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego, fell down bound into the middle of the burning fiery furnace.

hausa: Sai Absalom ya aika a kira masa Yowab don yă aike shi wurin sarki, amma Yowab ya ƙi zuwa. Saboda haka ya sāke aika sau na biyu, amma ya ƙi yă zo.
english: Then Absalom sent for Joab, to send him to the king, but he would not come to him. Then he sent again a second time, but he would not come.

hausa: Birni mai katanga za tă ɓace daga Efraim, ikon sarauta kuma daga Damaskus; raguwar Aram za tă zama kamar darajar Isra’ila,” in ji Ubangiji Maɗaukaki.
english: The fortress shall cease from Ephraim, and the kingdom from Damascus, and the remnant of Syria. They will be as the glory of the children of Israel,” says Yahweh of Armies.

hausa: Sa’an nan Yehohiyada ya yi alkawari tsakanin Ubangiji da sarki da kuma mutane cewa za su zama mutanen Ubangiji. Ya kuma yi alkawari tsakanin sarki da mutane.
english: Jehoiada made a covenant between Yahweh and the king and the people, that they should be Yahweh’s people; also between the king and the people.

hausa: “Manya da ƙanana duka za su mutu a wannan ƙasa. Ba za a binne su ba, ba kuwa za a yi makokinsu ba, kuma ba wanda zai tsaga kansa ko ya aske kansa saboda su.
english: Both great and small will die in this land. They will not be buried. Men won’t lament for them, cut themselves, or make themselves bald for them.

hausa: Sai na ce, “Kada ka ɗauke ni a tsakiyar kwanakina, ya Allah; shekarunka suna bi cikin dukan zamanai.
english: I said, “My God, don’t take me away in the middle of my days. Your years are throughout all generations.

hausa: Saboda haka ka gaya musu cewa, ‘Muddin ina raye, in ji Ubangiji, zan yi muku daidai da abin da na ji kuke faɗa.
english: Tell them, ‘As I live, says Yahweh, surely as you have spoken in my ears, so I will do to you.

hausa: Yayinda ya zo gab da Lehi, sai Filistiyawa suka sheƙo a guje da ihu suka nufo shi. Ruhun Ubangiji kuwa ya sauko da iko a kansa. Igiyoyin da suke daure a hannuwansa kuwa suka zama kamar abin da wuta ta babbaka, suka tsintsinke suka zuba daga hannuwansa.
english: When he came to Lehi, the Philistines shouted as they met him. Then Yahweh’s Spirit came mightily on him, and the ropes that were on his arms became as flax that was burned with fire; and his bands dropped from off his hands.

hausa: Sa’an nan dukan Isra’ilawa daga Dan zuwa Beyersheba kuma daga ƙasar Gileyad mutane kamar mutum guda suka fito suka taru a gaban Ubangiji a Mizfa.
english: Then all the children of Israel went out, and the congregation was assembled as one man, from Dan even to Beersheba, with the land of Gilead, to Yahweh at Mizpah.

hausa: “Ɗan mutum, ga abin da Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka yana cewa, ka gayyato kowane irin tsuntsu da dukan namun jeji, ‘Ku taru ku kuma zo wuri ɗaya daga ko’ina don hadayar da nake shirya muku, babbar hadaya a kan duwatsun Isra’ila. A can za ku ci nama ku kuma sha jini.
english: “You, son of man, the Lord Yahweh says: ‘Speak to the birds of every sort, and to every animal of the field, “Assemble yourselves, and come; gather yourselves on every side to my sacrifice that I sacrifice for you, even a great sacrifice on the mountains of Israel, that you may eat meat and drink blood.

hausa: Tabbatacce masu adalci za su yabi sunanka masu aikata gaskiya kuma za su zauna a gabanka.
english: Surely the righteous will give thanks to your name. The upright will dwell in your presence.

hausa: Sai mai hidimar ya ce, “Ba kome, kada ku ji tsoro. Allahnku, Allahn mahaifinku ne ya ba ku dukiyar a cikin buhunanku; ni dai, na karɓi azurfanku.” Sa’an nan ya fitar musu da Simeyon.
english: He said, “Peace be to you. Don’t be afraid. Your God, and the God of your father, has given you treasure in your sacks. I received your money.” He brought Simeon out to them.

hausa: “Sa’an nan, kamar dai yadda Ubangiji ya faɗa, sai ga Hananel yaron ɗan’uwan mahaifina ya zo wurina a sansanin matsara ya ce, ‘Saya filina a Anatot a yankin Benyamin. Da yake hakkinka ne ka fanshe shi ka kuma mallake shi, ka sayo shi wa kanka.’ “Sai na gane cewa wannan maganar Ubangiji ce;
english: “So Hanamel my uncle’s son came to me in the court of the guard according to Yahweh’s word, and said to me, ‘Please buy my field that is in Anathoth, which is in the land of Benjamin; for the right of inheritance is yours, and the redemption is yours. Buy it for yourself.’ “Then I knew that this was Yahweh’s word.

hausa: Kun koyi wannan gaskiya daga wurin Efafaras, ƙaunataccen abokin hidimarmu, wanda yake amintacce mai hidimar Kiristi a madadinmu,
english: even as you learned from Epaphras our beloved fellow servant, who is a faithful servant of Christ on your behalf,

hausa: “Gare ni kam, wannan shi ne alkawarina da kai, za ka zama mahaifin al’ummai masu yawa.
english: “As for me, behold, my covenant is with you. You will be the father of a multitude of nations.

hausa: Ubangiji zai kawo al’umma daga nesa, daga iyakar duniya, ta sauko a kanku kamar gaggafa, al’ummar da ba ku san yarenta ba,
english: Yahweh will bring a nation against you from far away, from the end of the earth, as the eagle flies: a nation whose language you will not understand,

hausa: Gama ga abin da Ubangiji yana cewa, ‘Dawuda ba zai taɓa rasa mutumin da zai zauna a gadon sarautar Isra’ila ba,
english: For Yahweh says: “David will never lack a man to sit on the throne of the house of Israel.

hausa: Kashegari da sassafe sai Sama’ila ya tashi ya tafi domin yă sadu da Shawulu, amma aka gaya masa cewa Shawulu ya tafi Karmel. A can ya yi wa kansa abin tunawa don yă girmama kansa, daga can kuma ya juya ya gangara zuwa Gilgal.
english: Samuel rose early to meet Saul in the morning; and Samuel was told, saying, “Saul came to Carmel, and behold, he set up a monument for himself, turned, passed on, and went down to Gilgal.”

hausa: Ya ce wa Haruna, “Ka ɗauki ɗan maraƙi domin hadayarka don zunubi da kuma ɗan rago domin hadaya ta ƙonawa, dukan biyu su kasance marar lahani, ka miƙa su a gaban Ubangiji.
english: and he said to Aaron, “Take a calf from the herd for a sin offering, and a ram for a burnt offering, without defect, and offer them before Yahweh.

hausa: Sai Yesu ya ce masa, “Wato ka gaskata saboda ka gan ni ne, masu albarka ne waɗanda ba su gan ni ba, amma suka gaskata.”
english: Jesus said to him, “Because you have seen me, you have believed. Blessed are those who have not seen and have believed.”

hausa: Sa’an nan sai firistoci, da Lawiyawa suka karɓi azurfa da zinariya da kuma tsarkakan kwanonin da aka auna don a kai haikalin Allahnmu a Urushalima.
english: So the priests and the Levites received the weight of the silver, the gold, and the vessels, to bring them to Jerusalem to the house of our God.

hausa: Ku koma maɓuya, ya ku ’yan kurkuku masu sa zuciya; ko yanzu ma na sanar cewa zan mayar muku ninki biyu.
english: Turn to the stronghold, you prisoners of hope! Even today I declare that I will restore double to you.

hausa: Mugun mutum yakan zaƙu ya aikata mugunta; maƙwabcinsa ba ya samun jinƙai daga gare shi.
english: The soul of the wicked desires evil; his neighbor finds no mercy in his eyes.

hausa: Akwai abin zai gagari Ubangiji? Zan komo wurinka a ƙayyadadden lokacin nan shekara mai zuwa kuma Saratu za tă haifi ɗa.”
english: Is anything too hard for Yahweh? At the set time I will return to you, when the season comes around, and Sarah will have a son.”

hausa: “Ga masu aminci, kakan nuna kanka mai aminci, ga marasa laifi, kakan nuna kanka marar laifi,
english: With the merciful you will show yourself merciful. With the perfect man you will show yourself perfect.

hausa: Maƙiyanka za su sha kunya, za a kawar da tentin mugaye.”
english: Those who hate you will be clothed with shame. The tent of the wicked will be no more.”

hausa: Ko begena zai tafi tare da ni zuwa kabari ne? Ko tare za a bizne mu cikin ƙura?”
english: Shall it go down with me to the gates of Sheol, or descend together into the dust?”

hausa: Gaskiya nake gaya muku, ‘Duk wanda ya karɓi wani da na aiko, ni ne ya karɓa ke nan. Kuma duk wanda ya karɓe ni, ya karɓi wanda ya aiko ni ne.’ ”
english: Most certainly I tell you, he who receives whomever I send, receives me; and he who receives me, receives him who sent me.”

hausa: Amma Ubangiji Allahnku zai ba da su gare ku, yana jefa su cikin rikicewa mai girma, har sai an hallaka su.
english: But Yahweh your God will deliver them up before you, and will confuse them with a great confusion, until they are destroyed.

hausa: Ba zato ba tsammani, sai wani babban hadari ya taso a tafkin, har raƙuman ruwan suka sha kan jirgin. Amma Yesu yana barci.
english: Behold, a violent storm came up on the sea, so much that the boat was covered with the waves; but he was asleep.

hausa: wanda ya ba wa kowane iyali a sama da ƙasa suna.
english: from whom every family in heaven and on earth is named,

hausa: “ ‘Sa’ad da namiji ya ɗigar maniyyi, dole yă wanke jikinsa gaba ɗaya da ruwa, zai kuma ƙazantu har yamma.
english: “‘If any man has an emission of semen, then he shall bathe all his flesh in water, and be unclean until the evening.

hausa: A can Ribla sarkin Babilon ya kashe ’ya’yan Zedekiya a idanunsa aka kuma kashe dukan manyan mutanen Yahuda.
english: Then the king of Babylon killed Zedekiah’s sons in Riblah before his eyes. The king of Babylon also killed all the nobles of Judah.

hausa: Ta wurin haƙuri akan rinjaye mai mulki, magana mai hankali kan karye ƙashi.
english: By patience a ruler is persuaded. A soft tongue breaks the bone.

hausa: tsofaffin mata kuwa sai ka ce uwaye, ’yan mata kuma a matsayin ’yan’uwa da matuƙar tsarki.
english: the elder women as mothers; the younger as sisters, in all purity.

hausa: Su masu girman kai ne kuma suka aikata abubuwa masu banƙyama a gabana. Saboda haka na kau da su kamar yadda ka gani.
english: They were arrogant and committed abomination before me. Therefore I took them away when I saw it.

hausa: “Faɗa wa Isra’ilawa cewa, ‘Sa’ad da wani ya yi zunubi ba da gangan ba, har ya karya ɗaya daga cikin dokokin Ubangiji,
english: “Speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘If anyone sins unintentionally, in any of the things which Yahweh has commanded not to be done, and does any one of them,

hausa: Amma in Kiristi yana a cikinku, jikinku matacce ne saboda zunubi, duk da haka ruhunku yana a raye saboda adalci.
english: If Christ is in you, the body is dead because of sin, but the spirit is alive because of righteousness.

hausa: Amma Hadad yana ɗan yaro a lokaci, wanda ya gudu zuwa Masar tare da shugabannin mutanen Edom waɗanda suka yi wa mahaifinsa hidima.
english: Hadad fled, he and certain Edomites of his father’s servants with him, to go into Egypt, when Hadad was still a little child.

hausa: Yanzu ka duba fa, Ubangiji, Ubangiji Maɗaukaki, yana shirin yă ɗauke kowane tanadi da taimako daga Urushalima da Yahuda dukan tanade-tanaden abinci da kuma dukan tanade-tanaden ruwa,
english: For, behold, the Lord, Yahweh of Armies, takes away from Jerusalem and from Judah supply and support, the whole supply of bread, and the whole supply of water;

hausa: A maimakon kunyarsu mutanena za su sami rabi riɓi biyu, a maimakon wulaƙanci za su yi farin ciki cikin gādonsu; ta haka za su gāji rabo riɓi biyu a ƙasarsu, da kuma madawwamin farin ciki zai zama nasu.
english: Instead of your shame you will have double. Instead of dishonor, they will rejoice in their portion. Therefore in their land they will possess double. Everlasting joy will be to them.

hausa: Ku kasa ganimar kashi biyu, ku ba sojojin da suka tafi yaƙi kashi ɗaya, kashi ɗaya kuma ku ba wa jama’a.
english: and divide the plunder into two parts: between the men skilled in war, who went out to battle, and all the congregation.

hausa: Sa’ad da suka isa haikalin Ubangiji a Urushalima, sai waɗansu shugabannin iyalai suka yi bayarwar yardar rai ta gudummawarsu domin sāke gina gidan Allah a wurin da yake.
english: Some of the heads of fathers’ households, when they came to Yahweh’s house which is in Jerusalem, offered willingly for God’s house to set it up in its place.

hausa: Ga maganar da ta zo wa Irmiya daga wurin Ubangiji a lokacin mulkin Yehohiyakim ɗan Yosiya sarkin Yahuda.
english: The word which came to Jeremiah from Yahweh in the days of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah, saying,

hausa: Ina roƙonku yanzu ku ci abinci. Kuna bukatarsa don ku rayu. Ba ɗayanku da zai rasa ko gashin kansa guda ɗaya.”
english: Therefore I beg you to take some food, for this is for your safety; for not a hair will perish from any of your heads.”

hausa: cikin tsarki da adalci a gabansa dukan kwanakinmu.
english: in holiness and righteousness before him all the days of our life.

hausa: Ina rubuta muku ba domin ba ku san gaskiya ba ne, a’a, sai dai domin kun santa, kun kuma san cewa babu yadda ƙarya za tă fito daga gaskiya.
english: I have not written to you because you don’t know the truth, but because you know it, and because no lie is of the truth.

hausa: Sai ga dabbobi huɗu, kowannensu ya yi dabam da sauran, suna fitowa daga teku.
english: Four great animals came up from the sea, different from one another.

hausa: ’Yan’uwa, da a ce har yanzu ina wa’azin kaciya ne, to, me ya sa ake tsananta mini har yanzu? In haka ne, ashe, an kawar da abin da yake sa tuntuɓe game da gicciye ke nan.
english: But I, brothers, if I still preach circumcision, why am I still persecuted? Then the stumbling block of the cross has been removed.

hausa: Allah ne ya ƙarfafa ni da ƙarfi ya kuma sa hanyarta ta zama cikakkiya.
english: the God who arms me with strength, and makes my way perfect?

hausa: Sai sarki Solomon ya tafi Gibeyon don yă miƙa hadayu, gama a can ne wuri mafi muhimmanci na sujada. Solomon kuwa ya miƙa hadayun ƙonawa guda dubu a kan wannan bagade.
english: The king went to Gibeon to sacrifice there, for that was the great high place. Solomon offered a thousand burnt offerings on that altar.

hausa: Na sami labari cewa kana da ruhun alloli a cikinka da kuma basira, da hazaka da kuma fitacciyar hikima.
english: I have heard of you, that the spirit of the gods is in you and that light, understanding, and excellent wisdom are found in you.

hausa: Dukan mutanen Isra’ila suka taso daga wurarensu suka ja dāgā a Ba’al-Tamar, Isra’ilawan da suka yi kwanto a yammancin Geba kuwa suka fito.
english: All the men of Israel rose up out of their place and set themselves in array at Baal Tamar. Then the ambushers of Israel broke out of their place, even out of Maareh Geba.

hausa: Amma yanzu da babu sauran wurin da ya rage mini in yi aiki a waɗannan yankuna, da yake kuma shekaru masu yawa ina da marmari in gan ku,
english: but now, no longer having any place in these regions, and having these many years a longing to come to you,

hausa: Zan so ku ’yantu daga damuwa. Mutum marar aure ya damu ne da al’amuran Ubangiji, yadda zai gamshi Ubangiji.
english: But I desire to have you to be free from cares. He who is unmarried is concerned for the things of the Lord, how he may please the Lord;

hausa: Sai Ezra ya tashi ya sa firistoci da suke shugabanni, da Lawiyawa, da dukan mutanen Isra’ila su rantse, cewa za su yi abin da aka ce. Sai suka yi rantsuwar.
english: Then Ezra arose, and made the chiefs of the priests, the Levites, and all Israel to swear that they would do according to this word. So they swore.

hausa: Duk da haka, ina da abubuwa kima game da kai. Kana da mutane a can waɗanda suke riƙe da koyarwar Bala’am, wanda ya koya wa Balak yă ja hankalin Isra’ilawa su yi zunubi ta wurin cin abincin da aka miƙa wa gumaka hadaya, su kuma yi fasikanci.
english: But I have a few things against you, because you have there some who hold the teaching of Balaam, who taught Balak to throw a stumbling block before the children of Israel, to eat things sacrificed to idols, and to commit sexual immorality.

hausa: Sa’an nan Yesu ya tafi da almajiransa zuwa wani wurin da ake kira Getsemane, ya ce musu, “Ku zauna nan, in je can in yi addu’a.”
english: Then Jesus came with them to a place called Gethsemane, and said to his disciples, “Sit here, while I go there and pray.”

hausa: Ai, ba ya nan, ya tashi kamar yadda ya faɗa. Ku zo ku ga inda ya kwanta.
english: He is not here, for he has risen, just like he said. Come, see the place where the Lord was lying.

hausa: Ga abin da Ubangiji yana cewa game da shi, “ ‘Budurwar Sihiyona ta rena ka tana kuma yin maka ba’a. Diyar Urushalima ta kaɗa kanta yayinda kake gudu.
english: This is the word that Yahweh has spoken concerning him: ‘The virgin daughter of Zion has despised you and ridiculed you. The daughter of Jerusalem has shaken her head at you.

hausa: Suka yi gunaguni wa Musa suka ce, “Da ma mun mutu sa’ad da ’yan’uwanmu suka mutu a gaban Ubangiji!
english: The people quarreled with Moses, and spoke, saying, “We wish that we had died when our brothers died before Yahweh!

hausa: Kulki a gare ta kamar ciyawa ne, tana dariyar wucewar māshi.
english: Clubs are counted as stubble. He laughs at the rushing of the javelin.

hausa: ’Yar farko ya kira ta Yemima, ta biyun Keziya ta ukun Keren-Haffuk.
english: He called the name of the first, Jemimah; and the name of the second, Keziah; and the name of the third, Keren Happuch.

hausa: (Yonatan ɗan Shawulu yana da ɗa mai suna Mefiboshet wanda yake gurgu a duka ƙafafu. Yana da shekara biyar ne sa’ad da labarin mutuwar Shawulu da Yonatan ya zo daga Yezireyel. Sai mai renonsa ta ɗauke shi ta gudu, amma yayinda take hanzari tă gudu, sai ya fāɗo, ya gurgunce.)
english: Now Jonathan, Saul’s son, had a son who was lame in his feet. He was five years old when the news came about Saul and Jonathan out of Jezreel; and his nurse picked him up and fled. As she hurried to flee, he fell and became lame. His name was Mephibosheth.

hausa: Yehu ya ce musu, “Ku jefa ta ƙasa!” Sai suka jefar da ita, jininta ya fantsama a jikin bango da kuma a jikin dawakai yayinda suke tattaka ta.
english: He said, “Throw her down!” So they threw her down; and some of her blood was sprinkled on the wall, and on the horses. Then he trampled her under foot.

hausa: To da kyau, da leɓunan baƙi da ku harsunan da ba sani ba Allah zai yi magana da wannan mutane,
english: But he will speak to this nation with stammering lips and in another language,

hausa: Elisha ya mutu, aka kuma binne shi. To, mahara Mowabawa sun saba kawo hari a ƙasar Isra’ila a kowace bazara.
english: Elisha died, and they buried him. Now the bands of the Moabites invaded the land at the coming in of the year.

hausa: Wace ce wannan da take haurawa daga hamada tana dogara a kan ƙaunataccenta? Ƙaunatacciya A ƙarƙashin itacen gawasa na farkar da ke, a wurin da aka haife ki, wurin da mahaifiyarki ta haife ki.
english: Who is this who comes up from the wilderness, leaning on her beloved? Beloved Under the apple tree I awakened you. There your mother conceived you. There she was in labor and bore you.

hausa: Baiwarka tana da ’ya’ya maza biyu. Suka yi faɗa da juna a fili, kuma ba wanda yake can don yă raba su. Ɗayan ya bugi ɗayan, ya kashe shi.
english: Your servant had two sons; and they both fought together in the field, and there was no one to part them, but the one struck the other and killed him.

hausa: Bayan almajiran Yohanna suka tafi, sai Yesu ya fara yi wa taron magana game da Yohanna ya ce, “Me kuka je kallo a hamada? Ciyawar da iska take kaɗawa ne?
english: When John’s messengers had departed, he began to tell the multitudes about John, “What did you go out into the wilderness to see? A reed shaken by the wind?

hausa: Idan mun bar bin Ubangiji, muka gina wa kanmu bagade don mu miƙa hadayun ƙonawa, ko kuwa hadayun gari, ko kuwa hadayun salama, to, bari Ubangiji kansa ya sāka mana.
english: that we have built us an altar to turn away from following Yahweh; or if to offer burnt offering or meal offering, or if to offer sacrifices of peace offerings, let Yahweh himself require it.

hausa: Ubangiji Allahnku ne za ku bi, shi ne kuma za ku girmama. Ku kiyaye umarnansa, ku kuma yi masa biyayya; ku bauta masa, ku kuma manne masa.
english: You shall walk after Yahweh your God, fear him, keep his commandments, and obey his voice. You shall serve him, and cling to him.

hausa: Da ya gan su sai ya ce, “Ku je ku nuna kanku ga firistoci.” Suna kan hanyar tafiya sai suka tsabtacce.
english: When he saw them, he said to them, “Go and show yourselves to the priests.” As they went, they were cleansed.

hausa: Dawuda ya gina bagade wa Ubangiji a can ya kuma miƙa hadayu na ƙonawa da hadayu na salama, Ubangiji kuwa ya amsa masa ta wurin wuta daga sama a kan bagaden hadaya ta ƙonawa.
english: David built an altar to Yahweh there, and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings, and called on Yahweh; and he answered him from the sky by fire on the altar of burnt offering.

hausa: Ban gudu zaman mai yin maka kiwo ba; ka sani ban marmarin ranan nan ta masifa ba. Abin da ya fito daga leɓunana kuwa, a bayyane suke gare ka.
english: As for me, I have not hurried from being a shepherd after you. I haven’t desired the woeful day. You know. That which came out of my lips was before your face.

hausa: Yanzu ina ba da umarni cewa duk wani mutumin Isra’ilan da yake cikin mulkina, haɗe da firistoci, da Lawiyawa, da suke so su tafi tare da kai zuwa Urushalima za su iya tafiya.
english: I make a decree that all those of the people of Israel and their priests and the Levites in my realm, who intend of their own free will to go to Jerusalem, go with you.

hausa: sa’an nan ya ja numfashinsa na ƙarshe, ya kuwa mutu, aka kuma tara shi ga mutanensa da kyakkyawan tsufa da kuma cikakken shekaru. ’Ya’yansa maza, Isuwa da Yaƙub suka binne shi.
english: Isaac gave up the spirit and died, and was gathered to his people, old and full of days. Esau and Jacob, his sons, buried him.

hausa: Ubangiji zai ba da Isra’ila da kuma kai ga Filistiyawa, gobe kuwa da kai da ’ya’yanka za ku kasance tare da ni. Ubangiji kuma zai ba da sojojin Isra’ila a hannun Filistiyawa.”
english: Moreover Yahweh will deliver Israel also with you into the hand of the Philistines; and tomorrow you and your sons will be with me. Yahweh will deliver the army of Israel also into the hand of the Philistines.”

hausa: Dukan al’ummai za su bauta masa da ɗansa da kuma jikansa har sai har lokacin ƙasarsa ya kai; sa’an nan al’ummai masu yawa da kuma manyan sarakuna za su kasance a ƙarƙashinsa.
english: All the nations will serve him, his son, and his son’s son, until the time of his own land comes. Then many nations and great kings will make him their bondservant.

hausa: “Zan aika musu da iri masu hallakarwa guda huɗu,” in ji Ubangiji, “takobi zai kashe, karnuka za su kwashe, tsuntsaye da namun jeji kuma su cinye su kuma hallaka.
english: “I will appoint over them four kinds,” says Yahweh: “the sword to kill, the dogs to tear, the birds of the sky, and the animals of the earth, to devour and to destroy.

hausa: Ina yin wa duk wanda ya ji kalmomin annabcin wannan littafi gargaɗi. Duk wanda ya ƙara wani abu a kansu, Allah zai ƙara masa annoban da aka bayyana a littafin nan.
english: I testify to everyone who hears the words of the prophecy of this book: if anyone adds to them, God will add to him the plagues which are written in this book.

hausa: Ta haka, mutuwa tana aiki a cikinmu, ku kuwa rai a cikinku.
english: So then death works in us, but life in you.

hausa: Ba za ka ba da shaidar ƙarya a kan maƙwabcinka ba.
english: “You shall not give false testimony against your neighbor.

hausa: Ya sāke mūsu har da rantsuwa, yana cewa, “Ban ma san mutumin nan ba!”
english: Again he denied it with an oath, “I don’t know the man.”

hausa: Na yi muku magana a kan abubuwan duniya amma ba ku gaskata ba; to, yaya za ku gaskata in na yi magana a kan abubuwan sama?
english: If I told you earthly things and you don’t believe, how will you believe if I tell you heavenly things?

hausa: Manufata ita ce a ƙarfafa su su kuma zama ɗaya a cikin ƙauna. Ina so su kasance da cikakken ƙarfin hali domin suna da cikakken fahimtar asirin Allah, wato, Kiristi kansa,
english: that their hearts may be comforted, they being knit together in love, and gaining all riches of the full assurance of understanding, that they may know the mystery of God, both of the Father and of Christ,

hausa: Me ya sa ka gudu a ɓoye ka kuma ruɗe ni? Me ya sa ba ka faɗa mini don in sallame ka da farin ciki da waƙoƙi haɗe da kiɗin ganguna da garayu ba?
english: Why did you flee secretly, and deceive me, and didn’t tell me, that I might have sent you away with mirth and with songs, with tambourine and with harp;

hausa: “Abubuwan nan sun faru da mu sakamakon mugayen ayyukanmu ne, amma duk da haka ya Allahnmu, ba ka ba mu horo bisa ga yawan zunubanmu ba, ka kuma bar mana saura.
english: “After all that has come on us for our evil deeds and for our great guilt, since you, our God, have punished us less than our iniquities deserve, and have given us such a remnant,

hausa: Saboda haka ’yan’uwa, muna da hakki, amma ba na wanda za mu yi rayuwar mutuntaka da yake so ba.
english: So then, brothers, we are debtors, not to the flesh, to live after the flesh.

hausa: Ke kuma Kafarnahum, kina tsammani za ki sami ɗaukaka ne? A’a, za a hallaka ki.
english: You, Capernaum, who are exalted to heaven, will be brought down to Hades.

hausa: “Waɗanda suka tsarkake suka kuma tsabtacce kansu don su je lambu, suna bin wannan da yake tsakiya waɗannan da suke cin naman aladu da ɓeraye da waɗansu abubuwan banƙyama, za su sadu da ƙarshensu tare,” in ji Ubangiji.
english: “Those who sanctify themselves and purify themselves to go to the gardens, following one in the middle, eating pig’s meat, abominable things, and the mouse, they shall come to an end together,” says Yahweh.

hausa: shi ne za ka iya ɗaga fuskarka ba tare da jin kunya ba; za ka tsaya da ƙarfi kuma ba za ka ji tsoro ba.
english: Surely then you will lift up your face without spot. Yes, you will be steadfast, and will not fear,

hausa: Sai Ayuba ya amsa,
english: Then Job answered,

hausa: Amma ku da kuka manne ga Ubangiji Allahnku, kuna da rai har wa yau.
english: But you who were faithful to Yahweh your God are all alive today.

hausa: Ko zai sami farin ciki daga Maɗaukaki? Ko zai yi kira ga Allah a kowane lokaci?
english: Will he delight himself in the Almighty, and call on God at all times?

hausa: Gama a cikinsa kuka sami wadata ta kowace hanya, a cikin dukan maganarku, da kuma cikin dukan saninku
english: that in everything you were enriched in him, in all speech and all knowledge—

hausa: Kana kula da ƙasa kana kuma yi mata banruwa; kana azurta ta a yalwace. Rafuffukan Allah sun cika da ruwa don su ba mutane hatsi, don haka ne ka ƙaddara.
english: You visit the earth, and water it. You greatly enrich it. The river of God is full of water. You provide them grain, for so you have ordained it.

hausa: Sai gardama ta tashi tsakanin waɗansu almajiran Yohanna da wani mutumin Yahuda a kan zancen al’adar tsarkakewa.
english: Therefore a dispute arose on the part of John’s disciples with some Jews about purification.

hausa: Sai Ruben ya ce wa mahaifinsa, “Ka kashe dukan ’ya’yana maza, in ban dawo da shi gare ka ba. Ka sa shi ga kulawata, zan kuwa dawo da shi.”
english: Reuben spoke to his father, saying, “Kill my two sons, if I don’t bring him to you. Entrust him to my care, and I will bring him to you again.”

hausa: Da yake Yahuda ne ma’aji, waɗansunsu suka ɗauka Yesu yana ce masa yă sayi abin da ake bukata don Bikin ne, ko kuwa yă ba wa matalauta wani abu.
english: For some thought, because Judas had the money box, that Jesus said to him, “Buy what things we need for the feast,” or that he should give something to the poor.

hausa: Zabura ce. Wata waƙa. Don keɓewar haikali. Ta Dawuda. Zan girmama ka Ya Ubangiji, gama ka tsamo ni daga zurfafa ba ka bar abokan gābana sun yi farin ciki a kaina ba.
english: A Psalm. A Song for the Dedication of the Temple. By David. I will extol you, Yahweh, for you have raised me up, and have not made my foes to rejoice over me.

hausa: Ba dama ido ya ce wa hannu, “Ba na bukatarka ba!” Kai kuma ba zai ce wa ƙafafu, “Ba na bukatarku ba!”
english: The eye can’t tell the hand, “I have no need for you,” or again the head to the feet, “I have no need for you.”

hausa: “A rana ta takwas dole yă kawo ɗan rago da ’yar tunkiya bana ɗaya, kowane marar lahani, tare da rabin garwan gari mai laushi haɗe da mai domin hadaya ta gari, da kuma moɗa ɗaya na mai.
english: “On the eighth day he shall take two male lambs without defect, one ewe lamb a year old without defect, three tenths of an ephah of fine flour for a meal offering, mixed with oil, and one log of oil.

hausa: Tabbatacce, ina gāba da waɗannan da suke annabci mafarkan karya,” in ji Ubangiji. “Suna faɗarsu suna ɓad da mutanena da ƙarairayinsu na rashin hankali, duk da haka ban aike su ba, ban kuwa umarce su ba. Ba su amfani wannan mutane ba ko kaɗan,” in ji Ubangiji.
english: Behold, I am against those who prophesy lying dreams,” says Yahweh, “who tell them, and cause my people to err by their lies, and by their vain boasting; yet I didn’t send them or command them. They don’t profit this people at all,” says Yahweh.

hausa: Sunan matar Abishur ita ce Abihayil, wadda ta haifa masa Aban da Molid.
english: The name of the wife of Abishur was Abihail; and she bore him Ahban and Molid.

hausa: Sai gari ya waye inuwa kuma ta watse, zan je dutsen mur da kuma tudun turare.
english: Until the day is cool, and the shadows flee away, I will go to the mountain of myrrh, to the hill of frankincense.

hausa: “Kaitonku, malaman dokoki da Farisiyawa, munafukai! Kukan ba da kashi ɗaya bisa goma na kayan yajinku, na’ana’a, anise, da lafsur. Amma kun ƙyale abubuwan da suka fi girma na dokoki, adalci, jinƙai da aminci. Waɗannan ne ya kamata da kun kiyaye ba tare da kun ƙyale sauran ba.
english: “Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you tithe mint, dill, and cumin, and have left undone the weightier matters of the law: justice, mercy, and faith. But you ought to have done these, and not to have left the other undone.

hausa: Yayinda Shawulu yake magana da firist kuwa, harguwa ya yi ta ƙaruwa a sansanin Filistiyawa. Sai Shawulu ya ce wa firist, “Janye hannunka.”
english: While Saul talked to the priest, the tumult that was in the camp of the Philistines went on and increased; and Saul said to the priest, “Withdraw your hand!”

hausa: Ko diloli suna ba ’ya’yansu nono su sha, amma mutanena sun zama marasa zuciya kamar jiminai a cikin jeji.
english: Even the jackals offer their breast. They nurse their young ones. But the daughter of my people has become cruel, like the ostriches in the wilderness.

hausa: Sai Bilatus ya tambaye shi ya ce, “Ba ka jin shaidar da suke kawowa a kanka?”
english: Then Pilate said to him, “Don’t you hear how many things they testify against you?”

hausa: Ban da haka ma, Ubangiji Allahnku zai aika da rina a cikinsu, har sai sun hallaka sauran mutanen da suka ragu, waɗanda suka ɓuya daga gare ku.
english: Moreover Yahweh your God will send the hornet among them, until those who are left, and hide themselves, perish from before you.

hausa: A can ya sadu da wani mutumin Yahuda mai suna Akwila, ɗan garin Fontus, wanda ya je can ba da daɗewa ba daga Italiya tare da matarsa Firiskila, gama Kalaudiyus ya umarci dukan Yahudawa su bar Roma. Sai Bulus ya tafi yă gan su,
english: He found a certain Jew named Aquila, a man of Pontus by race, who had recently come from Italy with his wife Priscilla, because Claudius had commanded all the Jews to depart from Rome. He came to them,

hausa: “Sun tanƙwasa harshensu kamar baka, don su harba ƙarya; ba da gaskiya ba ne suke nasara a cikin ƙasar. Sukan tashi daga wannan zunubi zuwa wancan; ba su san ni ba,” in ji Ubangiji.
english: “They bend their tongue, as their bow, for falsehood. They have grown strong in the land, but not for truth; for they proceed from evil to evil, and they don’t know me,” says Yahweh.

hausa: Zuciya mai salama kan ba jiki rai, amma kishi kan sa ƙasusuwa su yi ciwo.
english: The life of the body is a heart at peace, but envy rots the bones.

hausa: Ta ce, “In sarki ya yarda, in kuma na sami tagomashi daga gare shi, idan kuma ya gamshe shi yă yi abin da yake daidai, idan yana jin daɗina, bari a rubuta umarni a soke hukuncin saƙonin da Haman ɗan Hammedata, mutumin Agag, ya shirya ya kuma rubuta domin a hallaka Yahudawa a dukan lardunan sarki.
english: She said, “If it pleases the king, and if I have found favor in his sight, and the thing seems right to the king, and I am pleasing in his eyes, let it be written to reverse the letters devised by Haman, the son of Hammedatha the Agagite, which he wrote to destroy the Jews who are in all the king’s provinces.

hausa: Rut ta amsa ta ce “Zan yi abin da kika faɗa.”
english: She said to her, “All that you say, I will do.”

hausa: Kina, Dimona, Adada,
english: Kinah, Dimonah, Adadah,

hausa: Tare da bijimin, ragon da kuma ’yan ragunan, a miƙa hadayunsu na gari da hadayu na sha bisa ga adadin da aka ƙayyade.
english: their meal offering and their drink offerings for the bull, for the ram, and for the lambs, shall be according to their number, after the ordinance,

hausa: Zelek, mutumin Ammon Naharai, mutumin Beyerot mai ɗaukan wa Yowab, ɗan Zeruhiya makamai,
english: Zelek the Ammonite, Naharai the Beerothite, armor bearers to Joab the son of Zeruiah,

hausa: Dukan sauran annabawan suka yi irin annabcin nan. Suka ce, “A haura zuwa Ramot Gileyad a yi nasara, gama Ubangiji zai ba da shi cikin hannun sarki.”
english: All the prophets prophesied so, saying, “Go up to Ramoth Gilead, and prosper; for Yahweh will deliver it into the hand of the king.”

hausa: Wa zai yi hukunci? Yesu Kiristi ne, wanda ya mutu, fiye da haka ma, shi da aka tā da zuwa rai, yana zaune a hannun dama na Allah yana kuma yin roƙo a madadinmu.
english: Who is he who condemns? It is Christ who died, yes rather, who was raised from the dead, who is at the right hand of God, who also makes intercession for us.

hausa: Yanzu fa sai ku fitar da waɗannan ’yan iskan da suka aikata wannan abu na Gibeya don mu kashe su mu kawar da mugunta daga Isra’ila!” Amma mutanen Benyamin ba su saurari ’yan’uwansu Isra’ilawa ba.
english: Now therefore deliver up the men, the wicked fellows who are in Gibeah, that we may put them to death and put away evil from Israel.” But Benjamin would not listen to the voice of their brothers, the children of Israel.

hausa: Waɗannan su ne waɗanda Musa da Eleyazar firist, suka ƙidaya sa’ad da suka ƙidaya Isra’ilawa a filaye Mowab kusa da Urdun a hayen Yeriko.
english: These are those who were counted by Moses and Eleazar the priest, who counted the children of Israel in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho.

hausa: Daga zuriyar Nebo, akwai Yehiyel, Mattitiya, Zabad, Zebina, Yaddai, Yowel da Benahiya.
english: Of the sons of Nebo: Jeiel, Mattithiah, Zabad, Zebina, Iddo, Joel, and Benaiah.

hausa: Kamar mace mai ciki da take gab da haihuwa takan yi ta murɗawa tana kuka saboda zafi, haka muka kasance a gabanka, ya Ubangiji.
english: Just as a woman with child, who draws near the time of her delivery, is in pain and cries out in her pangs, so we have been before you, Yahweh.

hausa: A wannan rana Reshen Ubangiji zai zama kyakkyawa da kuma ɗaukaka, kuma amfanin ƙasar zai zama abin fariya da ɗaukakar waɗanda suka rayu a Isra’ila.
english: In that day, Yahweh’s branch will be beautiful and glorious, and the fruit of the land will be the beauty and glory of the survivors of Israel.

hausa: dattawan Gileyad suka je suka nemo Yefta daga ƙasar Tob.
english: When the children of Ammon made war against Israel, the elders of Gilead went to get Jephthah out of the land of Tob.

hausa: da shanu biyu, raguna biyar, bunsurai biyar da kuma ’yan raguna biyar, dukansu bana ɗaya-ɗaya, a miƙa su hadaya ta salama. Wannan ita ce hadayar Shelumiyel ɗan Zurishaddai.
english: and for the sacrifice of peace offerings, two head of cattle, five rams, five male goats, and five male lambs a year old: this was the offering of Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai.

hausa: Sa’an nan babban firist ya yage tufafinsa ya ce, “Ya yi saɓo! Don me muke bukatar ƙarin shaidu? Ga shi, yanzu kun dai ji saɓon.
english: Then the high priest tore his clothing, saying, “He has spoken blasphemy! Why do we need any more witnesses? Behold, now you have heard his blasphemy.

hausa: Ku yi ayyukan da suka dace da tuba. Kada ma ku yi tunani za ku iya ce wa kanku, ‘Ai, muna da mahaifinmu Ibrahim.’ Ina gaya muku cewa daga cikin duwatsun nan Allah zai iya tā da ’ya’ya wa Ibrahim.
english: Therefore produce fruits worthy of repentance, and don’t begin to say among yourselves, ‘We have Abraham for our father;’ for I tell you that God is able to raise up children to Abraham from these stones!

hausa: Ba cewa maganar Allah ta kāsa ba ne. Gama ba duk waɗanda suke zuriyar Isra’ila ne suke Isra’ila na gaske ba.
english: But it is not as though the word of God has come to nothing. For they are not all Israel that are of Israel.

hausa: ta Adin 454
english: The children of Adin, four hundred fifty-four.

hausa: Ku kam, ana mulkinku ba ta wurin mutuntaka ba, sai dai ta wurin Ruhu, in Ruhun Allah yana zaune a cikinku. In kuma wani ba shi da Ruhun Kiristi, shi ba na Kiristi ba ne.
english: But you are not in the flesh but in the Spirit, if it is so that the Spirit of God dwells in you. But if any man doesn’t have the Spirit of Christ, he is not his.

hausa: Saboda haka, ga abin da Ubangiji Maɗaukaki ya ce, “Ya mutanena masu zama a Sihiyona, kada ku ji tsoron Assuriyawa, waɗanda suka dūke ku da sanda suka kuma ɗaga kulki a kanku, kamar yadda Masar ta yi.
english: Therefore the Lord, Yahweh of Armies, says, “My people who dwell in Zion, don’t be afraid of the Assyrian, though he strike you with the rod, and lift up his staff against you, as Egypt did.

hausa: “ ‘In zuriyar Haruna yana da kuturu, ko mai ɗiga, ba zai ci daga cikin tsarkakakkun abubuwa ba, sai lokacin da ya tsarkaka. Duk wanda ya taɓa wani abu marar tsarki na mamaci, ko wanda maniyyinsa yake ɗiga,
english: “‘Whoever of the offspring of Aaron is a leper or has a discharge shall not eat of the holy things until he is clean. Whoever touches anything that is unclean by the dead, or a man who has a seminal emission,

hausa: “Saboda haka sa’ad da kake ba wa masu bukata taimako, kada ka yi shelarsa, yadda munafukai suke yi a majami’u da kuma kan tituna, don mutane su yabe su. Gaskiya nake gaya muku, sun riga sun sami ladarsu cikakke.
english: Therefore, when you do merciful deeds, don’t sound a trumpet before yourself, as the hypocrites do in the synagogues and in the streets, that they may get glory from men. Most certainly I tell you, they have received their reward.

hausa: Sa’ad da kuke tafiya, ku yi wa’azi, kuna cewa, ‘Mulkin sama ya kusato.’
english: As you go, preach, saying, ‘The Kingdom of Heaven is at hand!’

hausa: mu sayi matalauta da azurfa masu bukata kuma da takalmi, mu sayar da alkamar haɗe da yayi.
english: that we may buy the poor for silver, and the needy for a pair of sandals, and sell the sweepings with the wheat?’”

hausa: Mahaifin yarinyar zai ce wa dattawa, “Na ba da ’yata aure ga wannan mutum, amma ya ƙi ta.
