hausa: Daga baya ta haifi ’ya ta kuwa ba ta suna Dina.
english: Afterwards, she bore a daughter, and named her Dinah.

hausa: Kada ku yi farin ciki, ku maƙiyana! Ko da yake na fāɗi, zan tashi. Ko da yake na zauna a cikin duhu, Ubangiji zai zama haskena.
english: Don’t rejoice against me, my enemy. When I fall, I will arise. When I sit in darkness, Yahweh will be a light to me.

hausa: Gama sun sha wuya sosai saboda tsananin wahalar da suka shiga, har yawan farin cikinsu ya kai su ga yin alheri ta bayarwa ga waɗansu, ko da yake suna cikin tsananin talauci.
english: how in a severe ordeal of affliction, the abundance of their joy and their deep poverty abounded to the riches of their generosity.

hausa: Ko da kun kawo mini hadayu na ƙonawa da kuma hadayu na hatsi, ba zan karɓa ba. Ko da kun kawo zaɓaɓɓun hadayu na zumunta, ba zan ɗauke su a bakin kome ba.
english: Yes, though you offer me your burnt offerings and meal offerings, I will not accept them; neither will I regard the peace offerings of your fat animals.

hausa: Sarkin Babilon ya kashe ’ya’yan Zedekiya a idonsa. Ya kuma kashe dukan shugabannin Yahuda a Ribla.
english: The king of Babylon killed the sons of Zedekiah before his eyes. He also killed all the princes of Judah in Riblah.

hausa: Da sarkin Isra’ila ya gan su, sai ya tambayi Elisha ya ce, “In kashe su ne, mahaifina? In kashe su?”
english: The king of Israel said to Elisha, when he saw them, “My father, shall I strike them? Shall I strike them?”

hausa: Zan saurari Ubangiji, wanda ya ɓoye fuskarsa daga gidan Yaƙub. Zan dogara gare shi.
english: I will wait for Yahweh, who hides his face from the house of Jacob, and I will look for him.

hausa: To, game da baye-baye na ruhaniya, ’yan’uwa, ba na so ku kasance da rashin sani.
english: Now concerning spiritual things, brothers, I don’t want you to be ignorant.

hausa: “Bayan ’yan kwanaki, sai ƙaramin ɗan ya tattara kayansa duk, ya tashi ya tafi wata ƙasa mai nisa. A can, ya ɓatar da dukiyarsa duka a rayuwar banza.
english: Not many days after, the younger son gathered all of this together and traveled into a far country. There he wasted his property with riotous living.

hausa: Isuwa ya yi tambaya, “Me kake nufi da dukan abubuwan nan da na sadu da su ana korarsu?” Sai Yaƙub ya ce, “Don in sami tagomashi a idanunka ne, ranka yă daɗe.”
english: Esau said, “What do you mean by all this company which I met?” Jacob said, “To find favor in the sight of my lord.”

hausa: ya ce, “Na rantse da kaina, in ji Ubangiji, domin ka yi wannan, ba ka kuwa hana ni ɗanka, makaɗaicin ɗanka ba,
english: and said, “‘I have sworn by myself,’ says Yahweh, ‘because you have done this thing, and have not withheld your son, your only son,

hausa: Zan murƙushe maƙiyansa a gabansa in kashe dukan abokan gābansa.
english: I will beat down his adversaries before him, and strike those who hate him.

hausa: Suka tashi daga Funon, suka yi sansani a Obot.
english: They traveled from Punon, and encamped in Oboth.

hausa: Su biyunsu kuwa suka ɗaura yarjejjeniya a gaban Ubangiji. Sai Yonatan ya koma gida amma Dawuda ya zauna Horesh.
english: They both made a covenant before Yahweh. Then David stayed in the woods and Jonathan went to his house.

hausa: Wannan shi ne gādon kabilar Yahuda bisa ga iyalansu.
english: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Judah according to their families.

hausa: Ana nan dai, a kwana a tashi, sai sarkin Masar ya mutu. Isra’ilawa suka yi kuka mai zafi saboda bautarsu mai wuya, sai kukar neman taimakonsu saboda bauta, ya kai wurin Allah.
english: In the course of those many days, the king of Egypt died, and the children of Israel sighed because of the bondage, and they cried, and their cry came up to God because of the bondage.

hausa: Da Yowanna matar Kuza, manajan iyalin Hiridus; da Suzana; da waɗansu mata da yawa. Waɗannan mata suna taimaka musu cikin hidima, daga cikin abin da suke da shi na zaman gari.
english: and Joanna, the wife of Chuzas, Herod’s steward; Susanna; and many others who served them from their possessions.

hausa: Ubangiji ya amsa, “Sauka ka kawo Haruna tare da kai. Amma kada firistoci da mutane su zarce iyakan nan, a kan za su zo wurin Ubangiji, don kada in hallaka su.”
english: Yahweh said to him, “Go down! You shall bring Aaron up with you, but don’t let the priests and the people break through to come up to Yahweh, lest he break out against them.”

hausa: Kowace safiya da kowace yamma sukan miƙa hadayun ƙonawa da turare mai ƙanshi ga Ubangiji. Sukan shirya burodi a tsarkaken tebur mai tsabta, sukan kuma ƙuna fitilu a alkukai kowace yamma. Muna kiyaye ƙa’idodin Ubangiji Allahnmu. Amma ku kun yashe shi.
english: They burn to Yahweh every morning and every evening burnt offerings and sweet incense. They also set the show bread in order on the pure table, and care for the gold lamp stand with its lamps, to burn every evening; for we keep the instruction of Yahweh our God, but you have forsaken him.

hausa: in ta yi mugunta a gabana ba tă kuwa yi mini biyayya ba, sai in janye alherin da na yi niyya in yi mata.
english: if they do that which is evil in my sight, that they don’t obey my voice, then I will repent of the good with which I said I would benefit them.

hausa: Mutanen kuwa suka tā da murya da ƙarfi suka ce, “Gaskiya ka faɗa, dole mu yi yadda ka ce,
english: Then all the assembly answered with a loud voice, “We must do as you have said concerning us.

hausa: In kuna shan wahala, kada yă zama don ku masu kisankai ne ko ɓarayi ko masu wani irin laifi ko kuma masu shisshigi.
english: But let none of you suffer as a murderer, or a thief, or an evil doer, or a meddler in other men’s matters.

hausa: “Ka lura kada ka gaya wa kowa wannan. Amma ka tafi ka nuna kanka ga firist, ka kuma miƙa hadayun da Musa ya umarta saboda tsarkakewarka, don yă zama shaida gare su.”
english: and said to him, “See that you say nothing to anybody, but go show yourself to the priest and offer for your cleansing the things which Moses commanded, for a testimony to them.”

hausa: Ba za a ƙara jin ƙarar kiɗin masu garaya da muryar mawaƙa, da na masu bushe-bushe, da na masu busan ƙaho a cikinki ba. Ba za a ƙara samun ma’aikaci na kowace irin sana’a a cikinki kuma ba. Ba za a ƙara jin ƙarar dutsen niƙa a cikinki kuma ba.
english: The voice of harpists, minstrels, flute players, and trumpeters will be heard no more at all in you. No craftsman of whatever craft will be found any more at all in you. The sound of a mill will be heard no more at all in you.

hausa: ’ya’yan da aka haifa ba bisa hanyar ’yan adam, ko shawarar mutum ko nufin namiji ba, sai dai haifaffu bisa ga nufin Allah.
english: who were born, not of blood, nor of the will of the flesh, nor of the will of man, but of God.

hausa: “Ku saurara, ya ku duwatsu game da tuhumar da Ubangiji yake muku, ku ji, ku daɗaɗɗun tushin duniya. Gama Ubangiji yana da ƙara a kan mutanensa; yana tuhumar Isra’ila.
english: Hear, you mountains, Yahweh’s indictment, and you enduring foundations of the earth; for Yahweh has a case against his people, and he will contend with Israel.

hausa: Ba’ana ɗan Hushai, shi ne a Asher da Bayelot;
english: Baana the son of Hushai, in Asher and Bealoth;

hausa: Dalilin da ya sa ya yi haka shi ne, dukan waɗanda suka fito daga Masar, dukan mazan da suka kai shekarun shiga soja, sun mutu a cikin jeji a hanya bayan sun bar Masar.
english: This is the reason Joshua circumcised them: all the people who came out of Egypt, who were males, even all the men of war, died in the wilderness along the way, after they came out of Egypt.

hausa: Sai dai a duk inda muka kai, mu ci gaba da haka.
english: Nevertheless, to the extent that we have already attained, let’s walk by the same rule. Let’s be of the same mind.

hausa: “ ‘Sa’ad da kuka yi girbin gonarku, kada ku girbe har ƙarshen gefen gonar, ko ku yi kalar girbinku. Ku bar su wa matalauta da baƙi. Ni ne Ubangiji Allahnku.’ ”
english: “‘When you reap the harvest of your land, you must not wholly reap into the corners of your field. You must not gather the gleanings of your harvest. You must leave them for the poor and for the foreigner. I am Yahweh your God.’”

hausa: Ka lura fa da alheri da kuma tsananin Allah, tsanani ga waɗanda suka fāɗi, amma alheri a gare ka, da fata za ka ci gaba cikin alherinsa. In ba haka ba, kai ma za a sare ka.
english: See then the goodness and severity of God. Toward those who fell, severity; but toward you, goodness, if you continue in his goodness; otherwise you also will be cut off.

hausa: “Ka sanar da wannan ga gidan Yaƙub ka yi shelarsa a Yahuda.
english: “Declare this in the house of Jacob, and publish it in Judah, saying,

hausa: Ya ɗebi mutane dubu saba’in su zama ’yan ɗauko, mutane dubu tamanin su zama masu fasa dutse a tuddai, da kuma mutane dubu uku da ɗari shida su zama masu lura da su.
english: Solomon counted out seventy thousand men to bear burdens, eighty thousand men who were stone cutters in the mountains, and three thousand six hundred to oversee them.

hausa: Suka kuma yi masa waɗansu baƙaƙen maganganu masu yawa.
english: They spoke many other things against him, insulting him.

hausa: Sa’ad da Ubangiji ya ga ba a ƙaunar Liyatu, sai ya buɗe mahaifarta, amma Rahila ta zama bakararriya.
english: Yahweh saw that Leah was hated, and he opened her womb, but Rachel was barren.

hausa: “Duk da haka Ubangiji, Allah na Isra’ila, ya zaɓe ni daga dukan iyalina don in zama sarki bisa Isra’ila har abada. Ya zaɓi Yahuda a matsayin shugaba, kuma daga gidan Yahuda ya zaɓi iyalina, daga ’ya’yan mahaifina maza kuwa ya gamsu ya mai da ni sarki bisa dukan Isra’ila.
english: However Yahweh, the God of Israel, chose me out of all the house of my father to be king over Israel forever. For he has chosen Judah to be prince; and in the house of Judah, the house of my father; and among the sons of my father he took pleasure in me to make me king over all Israel.

hausa: Kashegari, Balak ya ɗauki Bala’am ya kai shi kan Bamot Ba’al, daga can ya iya ganin sassan sansanin Isra’ilawa.
english: In the morning, Balak took Balaam, and brought him up into the high places of Baal; and he saw from there part of the people.

hausa: Isra’ilawa masu taurinkai ne, kamar karsana mai taurinkai. Yaya Ubangiji zai iya kiwonsu kamar tumaki a makiyaya mai ɗanyar ciyawa?
english: For Israel has behaved extremely stubbornly, like a stubborn heifer. Then how will Yahweh feed them like a lamb in a meadow?

hausa: Da a ce abokin gāba ne ke zagina, da na jure da shi; da a ce maƙiyi yana tā da kansa a kaina, da na ɓoye daga gare shi.
english: For it was not an enemy who insulted me, then I could have endured it. Neither was it he who hated me who raised himself up against me, then I would have hidden myself from him.

hausa: Amma in sa’ad da firist ya bincike shi, ya tarar babu farin gashi a ciki, kuma bai yi zurfi fiye da fatar jikin ba, ya kuma bushe, sai firist ɗin ya kaɗaice shi har kwana bakwai.
english: But if the priest examines it, and behold, there are no white hairs in it, and it isn’t deeper than the skin, but is dim, then the priest shall isolate him seven days.

hausa: Saboda haka kada ku bar zunubi yă mallaki jikin nan naku mai mutuwa yă sa ku zama masu biyayya ga mugayen sha’awace-sha’awacensa.
english: Therefore don’t let sin reign in your mortal body, that you should obey it in its lusts.

hausa: Saboda haka ɗana, ka saurara da kyau ka kuma yi abin da na faɗa maka.
english: Now therefore, my son, obey my voice according to that which I command you.

hausa: Ya sumbaci dukan ’yan’uwansa, ya kuma yi kuka a kansu. Bayan haka sai ’yan’uwansa suka yi masa magana.
english: He kissed all his brothers, and wept on them. After that his brothers talked with him.

hausa: Da Bala’am ya duba sai ya ga Isra’ila sun yi sansani kabila, kabila, Ruhun Allah kuwa ya sauko masa,
english: Balaam lifted up his eyes, and he saw Israel dwelling according to their tribes; and the Spirit of God came on him.

hausa: Ga samarin nan guda huɗu Allah ya ba su sani da ganewar dukan irin littattafai da kuma koyarwa. Daniyel kuma ya iya gane wahayi da kowane irin mafarki.
english: Now as for these four youths, God gave them knowledge and skill in all learning and wisdom; and Daniel had understanding in all visions and dreams.

hausa: Ni ne ƙofar; duk wanda ya shiga ta wurina zai sami ceto. Zai riƙa shiga yă fita yă kuwa sami wurin kiwo.
english: I am the door. If anyone enters in by me, he will be saved, and will go in and go out and will find pasture.

hausa: Tun da yake kuna kira ga Uba wanda yake yin wa kowane mutum shari’a bisa ga ayyukansa ba bambanci, sai ku yi rayuwarku a nan kamar baƙi cikin tsoro mai bangirma.
english: If you call on him as Father, who without respect of persons judges according to each man’s work, pass the time of your living as foreigners here in reverent fear,

hausa: Suna biki a yalwar gidanka; kakan ba su sha daga rafin farin cikinka.
english: They shall be abundantly satisfied with the abundance of your house. You will make them drink of the river of your pleasures.

hausa: Ubangiji zai aika da annoba masu zafi a kanku da zuriyarku, masifu masu zafi waɗanda za su daɗe, da mugayen cututtuka waɗanda ba sa kawuwa.
english: then Yahweh will make your plagues and the plagues of your offspring fearful, even great plagues, and of long duration, and severe sicknesses, and of long duration.

hausa: Amma mijin ya raka ta, yana tafe yana kuka, ya bi ta har Bahurim. Sai Abner ya ce masa, “Koma gida!” Sai ya koma.
english: Her husband went with her, weeping as he went, and followed her to Bahurim. Then Abner said to him, “Go! Return!” and he returned.

hausa: “Yanzu bari Ubangiji yă nuna ikonsa, kamar dai yadda ka furta.
english: Now please let the power of the Lord be great, according as you have spoken, saying,

hausa: Ku kuma riƙa zarar mata waɗansu daga dammunan don ta ɗauka, kada ku kwaɓe ta.”
english: Also pull out some for her from the bundles, and leave it. Let her glean, and don’t rebuke her.”

hausa: Yanzu ka rantse mini da Ubangiji cewa ba za ka hallaka zuriyarta ko ka share sunana daga iyalin mahaifina ba.”
english: Swear now therefore to me by Yahweh that you will not cut off my offspring after me, and that you will not destroy my name out of my father’s house.”

hausa: Ni na shuka iri, Afollos kuma ya yi banruwa, amma Allah ne ya sa irin ya yi girma.
english: I planted. Apollos watered. But God gave the increase.

hausa: Suka zama karuwai a Masar, suka yi karuwanci tun daga ƙuruciyarsu. A wancan ƙasar an rungumi mamansu da ƙirjinsu na budurwanci.
english: They played the prostitute in Egypt. They played the prostitute in their youth. Their breasts were fondled there, and their youthful nipples were caressed there.

hausa: Duk suka ci suka ƙoshi, almajiran kuwa suka kwashe ragowar gutsattsarin cike da kwanduna goma sha biyu.
english: They all ate and were filled. They took up twelve baskets full of that which remained left over from the broken pieces.

hausa: Ga abin da Ubangiji yana cewa, shi wanda ya yi ka, wanda ya siffanta ka a cikin mahaifa, wanda kuma zai taimake ka. Kada ka ji tsoro, ya Yaƙub, bawana, Yeshurun, wanda na zaɓa.
english: This is what Yahweh who made you, and formed you from the womb, who will help you says: “Don’t be afraid, Jacob my servant; and you, Jeshurun, whom I have chosen.

hausa: ɗan Mali, ɗan Mushi, ɗan Merari, ɗan Lawi.
english: the son of Mahli, the son of Mushi, the son of Merari, the son of Levi.

hausa: Matar wani daga ƙungiyar annabawa ta yi wa Elisha kuka ta ce, “Mijina, bawanka, ya mutu, ka kuma san yadda ya girmama Ubangiji. Amma ga shi yanzu mai binsa bashi ya zo yă kwashe ’ya’yana maza biyu su zama bayinsa.”
english: Now a certain woman of the wives of the sons of the prophets cried out to Elisha, saying, “Your servant my husband is dead. You know that your servant feared Yahweh. Now the creditor has come to take for himself my two children to be slaves.”

hausa: Yabo ya tabbata ga sunansa mai ɗaukaka har abada; bari dukan duniya ta cika da ɗaukakarsa.
english: Blessed be his glorious name forever! Let the whole earth be filled with his glory! Amen and amen.

hausa: Ga abin da Ubangiji ya ce, “Ko da yake sun yi tarayya, suna kuma da yawa, za a yanke su, a kawar a su. Ko da yake na ba ki azaba, ya Yahuda, ba zan ƙara ba ki azaba ba.
english: Yahweh says: “Though they are in full strength and likewise many, even so they will be cut down and pass away. Though I have afflicted you, I will afflict you no more.

hausa: ruwan nan kuwa kwatancin baftisma ne da yanzu ya cece ku ku ma, ba kawar da dauda daga jiki ba, sai dai yin alkawari na lamiri mai kyau ga Allah. Ya cece ku ta wurin tashin Yesu Kiristi daga matattu,
english: This is a symbol of baptism, which now saves you—not the putting away of the filth of the flesh, but the answer of a good conscience toward God—through the resurrection of Jesus Christ,

hausa: “ ‘In mutum ya keɓe gonar da ya saya, wadda take ba sashe na gonar iyali ba, ga Ubangiji,
english: “‘If he dedicates a field to Yahweh which he has bought, which is not of the field of his possession,

hausa: Na ga Efraim, kamar birnin Taya, da aka kafa a wuri mai daɗi. Amma Efraim zai fitar da ’ya’yansu ga masu yanka.”
english: I have seen Ephraim, like Tyre, planted in a pleasant place; but Ephraim will bring out his children to the murderer.

hausa: “Wane ne a cikinku in ɗansa ya roƙe shi burodi, sai yă ba shi dutse?
english: Or who is there among you who, if his son asks him for bread, will give him a stone?

hausa: Ya yi tambaya ya ce, “Su wane ne mahaifiyata, da ’yan’uwana?”
english: He answered them, “Who are my mother and my brothers?”

hausa: Da yake an ragargazar da mutanena, an ragargaza ni ke nan; na yi kuka, tsoro ya kama ni.
english: For the hurt of the daughter of my people, I am hurt. I mourn. Dismay has taken hold of me.

hausa: Sai Agiriffa ya ce wa Bulus, “Kana tsammani cewa a cikin ɗan ƙanƙanin lokaci kana so ka mai da ni Kirista?”
english: Agrippa said to Paul, “With a little persuasion are you trying to make me a Christian?”

hausa: Ka umarce su su yi nagarta, su wadatu cikin ayyuka nagari, su kuma zama masu bayarwa hannu sake da kuma masu niyyar yin taimako.
english: that they do good, that they be rich in good works, that they be ready to distribute, willing to share;

hausa: Ku riƙa tunawa da waɗanda suke a kurkuku kamar tare kuke a kurkuku, da kuma waɗanda ake gwada musu azaba, kamar ku ake yi wa.
english: Remember those who are in bonds, as bound with them, and those who are ill-treated, since you are also in the body.

hausa: Ina sha’awar aikata nufinka, ya Allahna; dokar tana cikin zuciyata.”
english: I delight to do your will, my God. Yes, your law is within my heart.”

hausa: Suka gabatar da waɗannan mutane wa manzanni, waɗanda kuwa suka yi addu’a, suka ɗibiya hannuwansu a kansu.
english: whom they set before the apostles. When they had prayed, they laid their hands on them.

hausa: Ba za ku ci namansu ba, ko ku taɓa gawawwakinsu, gama haram ne gare ku.
english: You shall not eat their meat. You shall not touch their carcasses. They are unclean to you.

hausa: Za a yi manyan girgizar ƙasa, da yunwa, da annoba a wurare dabam-dabam, da kuma abubuwa masu bantsoro, da manyan alamu daga sama.
english: There will be great earthquakes, famines, and plagues in various places. There will be terrors and great signs from heaven.

hausa: Sun damu ƙwarai da gaske domin manzannin suna koya wa mutane suna kuma shela a cikin Yesu cewa akwai tashin matattu.
english: being upset because they taught the people and proclaimed in Jesus the resurrection from the dead.

hausa: Ya zāzzāna kerubobi, itatuwan dabino, da kuma furanni buɗaɗɗu a kansu, ya kuma dalaye su da zinariyar da aka buga daidai a kan sassaƙa.
english: He carved cherubim, palm trees, and open flowers; and he overlaid them with gold fitted on the engraved work.

hausa: An rataye ’ya’yan sarakuna da hannuwansu; ba a ba wa dattawa girma.
english: Princes were hanged up by their hands. The faces of elders were not honored.

hausa: (Asher yana da ’ya mace da ake kira Sera.)
english: The name of the daughter of Asher was Serah.

hausa: Irmiya kuwa ya ce wa Serahiya, “Lokacin da ka kai Babilon, sai ka karanta dukan maganan nan.
english: Jeremiah said to Seraiah, “When you come to Babylon, then see that you read all these words,

hausa: “ ‘Yaya za ku ce, “Muna da hikima, gama muna da dokar Ubangiji,” alhali alƙalamin ƙarya na magatakarda ya yi ƙarya?
english: “‘How do you say, “We are wise, and Yahweh’s law is with us”? But, behold, the false pen of the scribes has made that a lie.

hausa: Ban da haka ma, wane ne zan bauta wa? Ashe, ba ɗan ne zan bauta wa ba? Kamar dai yadda na bauta wa mahaifinka, haka zan bauta maka.”
english: Again, whom should I serve? Shouldn’t I serve in the presence of his son? As I have served in your father’s presence, so I will be in your presence.”

hausa: Ku yi siffofin marurai da na ɓeraye da suke hallaka gari, ku ba da girma ga Allah na Isra’ila. Wataƙila zai ɗauke hukuncinsa daga gare ku da allolinku da kuma ƙasarku.
english: Therefore you shall make images of your tumors and images of your mice that mar the land; and you shall give glory to the God of Israel. Perhaps he will release his hand from you, from your gods, and from your land.

hausa: Da Shawulu ya aiki mutane su kama Dawuda. Mikal ta ce, “Ba shi da lafiya.”
english: When Saul sent messengers to take David, she said, “He is sick.”

hausa: “Ku ji maganar Ubangiji, ya al’ummai; ku yi shelarta a gaban teku masu nesa cewa, ‘Shi wanda ya watsar da Isra’ila zai tattara su zai kuma lura da garkensa kamar makiyayi.’
english: “Hear Yahweh’s word, you nations, and declare it in the distant islands. Say, ‘He who scattered Israel will gather him, and keep him, as a shepherd does his flock.’

hausa: Zan shimfiɗa masa ragata, za a kuwa kama shi da tarkona; zan kawo shi Babiloniya, ƙasar Kaldiyawa, amma ba zai gan ta ba, a can kuwa zai mutu.
english: I will also spread my net on him, and he will be taken in my snare. I will bring him to Babylon to the land of the Chaldeans; yet he will not see it, though he will die there.

hausa: inda suka ci gaba da wa’azin labari mai daɗi.
english: There they preached the Good News.

hausa: Ɗan Haruna da ya miƙa jini da kitsen hadaya ta salama, zai ɗauki cinyar tă zama rabonsa.
english: He among the sons of Aaron who offers the blood of the peace offerings, and the fat, shall have the right thigh for a portion.

hausa: Ka yi rammuka hamsin a ƙarshen gefen kashi ɗaya na labulen, haka kuma a ƙarshen kashi ɗayan.
english: You shall make fifty loops on the edge of the one curtain that is outermost in the coupling, and fifty loops on the edge of the curtain which is outermost in the second coupling.

hausa: Duk mai yin zunubi yana karya doka ne; tabbatacce, zunubi, karya doka ne.
english: Everyone who sins also commits lawlessness. Sin is lawlessness.

hausa: Mutanen Yahuda suka yaƙi Urushalima ita ma suka ci ta. Suka karkashe mutanen birnin suka cinna mata wuta.
english: The children of Judah fought against Jerusalem, took it, struck it with the edge of the sword, and set the city on fire.

hausa: Ku dogara ga Ubangiji, gama shi Ubangiji, ne madawwamin Dutse.
english: Trust in Yahweh forever; for in Yah, Yahweh, is an everlasting Rock.

hausa: Ubangiji ya ba ni lada bisa ga adalcina, bisa ga tsabtan hannuwana a gabansa.
english: Therefore Yahweh has rewarded me according to my righteousness, according to the cleanness of my hands in his eyesight.

hausa: Har yaushe za ki yi ta yawo, Ya ’ya marar aminci? Ubangiji zai ƙirƙiro sabon abu a duniya mace za tă kewaye namiji.”
english: How long will you go here and there, you backsliding daughter? For Yahweh has created a new thing on the earth: a woman will encompass a man.”

hausa: Amoriyawa, Kan’aniyawa, Girgashiyawa da kuma Yebusiyawa.”
english: the Amorites, the Canaanites, the Girgashites, and the Jebusites.”

hausa: Zan sa zuriyar Dawuda bawana da kuma Lawiyawan da suke hidima a gabana su yi yawa kamar taurarin sararin sama da kuma yashin bakin tekun da ba a iya ƙidaya.’ ”
english: As the army of the sky can’t be counted, and the sand of the sea can’t be measured, so I will multiply the offspring of David my servant and the Levites who minister to me.’”

hausa: Hukok da Rehob, tare da wuraren kiwonsu;
english: Hukok with its pasture lands, and Rehob with its pasture lands;

hausa: Za a yi kuka mai zafi ko’ina a Masar, irin wadda ba a taɓa yi ba, ba kuwa za a ƙara yi ba.
english: There will be a great cry throughout all the land of Egypt, such as there has not been, nor will be any more.

hausa: Sai Yesu ya ji tausayinsu, ya taɓa idanunsu. Nan da nan kuwa suka sami ganin gari, suka kuma bi shi.
english: Jesus, being moved with compassion, touched their eyes; and immediately their eyes received their sight, and they followed him.

hausa: “Allah ne mai iko da kuma hikima, shawara da ganewa nasa ne.
english: “With God is wisdom and might. He has counsel and understanding.

hausa: Yaya mutum guda zai kore dubu, mutum biyu su sa dubu goma su gudu, sai ko Dutsensu ya sayar da su, sai ko Ubangiji ya bashe su.
english: How could one chase a thousand, and two put ten thousand to flight, unless their Rock had sold them, and Yahweh had delivered them up?

hausa: Cibinki kamar kwaf ne da bai taɓa rasa gaurayayyen ruwan inabi ba. Kwankwasonki ya yi kamar damin alkama wanda furen bi-rana ya kewaye.
english: Your body is like a round goblet, no mixed wine is wanting. Your waist is like a heap of wheat, set about with lilies.

hausa: Sa’an nan ya ba shugabannin māsu da garkuwoyi manya da ƙanana na sarki Dawuda, waɗanda suke cikin haikalin Allah.
english: Jehoiada the priest delivered to the captains of hundreds the spears, bucklers, and shields that had been king David’s, which were in God’s house.

hausa: “A ce mutanena za su saurare ni, a ce Isra’ila zai bi hanyoyina,
english: Oh that my people would listen to me, that Israel would walk in my ways!

hausa: Ka sa su a kafaɗarka yayinda suke kallo ka kuma fitar da su da dare. Ka rufe fuskarka don kada ka ga ƙasar, gama na mai da kai alama ga gidan Isra’ila.”
english: In their sight you shall bear it on your shoulder, and carry it out in the dark. You shall cover your face, so that you don’t see the land, for I have set you for a sign to the house of Israel.”

hausa: Leɓunan basira ba su dace da wawa ba, ya ma fi muni a ce mai mulki yana da leɓunan ƙarya!
english: Excellent speech isn’t fitting for a fool, much less do lying lips fit a prince.

hausa: Sai mala’ikan da na gani na tsaye a teku da ƙasa ya ɗaga hannunsa na dama sama.
english: The angel whom I saw standing on the sea and on the land lifted up his right hand to the sky

hausa: Kuka yi gunaguni a cikin tentunanku, kuna cewa, “Ubangiji ya ƙi mu; shi ya sa ya fitar da mu daga Masar don yă ba da mu ga hannuwan Amoriyawa su hallaka mu.
english: You murmured in your tents, and said, “Because Yahweh hated us, he has brought us out of the land of Egypt, to deliver us into the hand of the Amorites to destroy us.

hausa: sai ku tashi daga inda kuka yi kwanto, ku ci birnin da yaƙi, Ubangiji Allahnku zai ba da shi a hannunku.
english: and you shall rise up from the ambush, and take possession of the city; for Yahweh your God will deliver it into your hand.

hausa: Saboda haka sai Isra’ilawa suka aiki Finehas ɗan Eleyazar, firist, zuwa ƙasar Gileyad, wurin mutanen Ruben, mutanen Gad da kuma rabin mutanen kabilar Manasse.
english: The children of Israel sent to the children of Reuben, and to the children of Gad, and to the half-tribe of Manasseh, into the land of Gilead, Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest.

hausa: A rana ta fari, ku yi taro mai tsarki, ba kuwa za ku yi aiki na kullum ba.
english: In the first day you shall have a holy convocation. You shall do no regular work.

hausa: In dabbar tana da lahani, gurguntaka ko makantaka, ko kuwa tana da wani mugun lahani, kada ku miƙa ta ga Ubangiji Allahnku.
english: If it has any defect—is lame or blind, or has any defect whatever, you shall not sacrifice it to Yahweh your God.

hausa: Hanyar masu adalci sumul take; Ya Mai Aikata Gaskiya, ka sa hanyar masu adalci ta yi sumul.
english: The way of the just is uprightness. You who are upright make the path of the righteous level.

hausa: Amma in ka yi wa mugun kashedi bai kuwa juya daga mugayen hanyoyinsa ba, zai mutu saboda zunubinsa; amma kai kam za ka kuɓuta.
english: Yet if you warn the wicked, and he doesn’t turn from his wickedness, nor from his wicked way, he will die in his iniquity; but you have delivered your soul.”

hausa: Har yanzu, ya sāke aikan na uku, amma suka ji masa rauni, suka jefar da shi waje.
english: He sent yet a third, and they also wounded him and threw him out.

hausa: Ya kwashe dukan zinariya da azurfa da dukan kayayyakin da aka samu a haikalin Allah waɗanda suke a ƙarƙashin kulawar Obed-Edom, da kaya masu daraja na gidan sarki, da waɗanda aka kamo cikin yaƙi, ya kawo Samariya.
english: He took all the gold and silver, and all the vessels that were found in God’s house with Obed-Edom, and the treasures of the king’s house, and the hostages, and returned to Samaria.

hausa: Waɗannan su ne zuriyarsu. Nebayiwot ɗan farin Ishmayel, Kedar, Adbeyel, Mibsam,
english: These are their generations: the firstborn of Ishmael, Nebaioth; then Kedar, Adbeel, Mibsam,

hausa: “ ‘In ba zai iya kawo kurciyoyi biyu ko tattabarai biyu ba, sai yă kawo humushin garwan gari mai laushi domin hadaya don zunubi. Ba lalle ba ne yă sa mai ko turare a kansa, saboda wannan hadaya ce ta zunubi.
english: “‘But if he can’t afford two turtledoves or two young pigeons, then he shall bring as his offering for that in which he has sinned, one tenth of an ephah of fine flour for a sin offering. He shall put no oil on it, and he shall not put any frankincense on it, for it is a sin offering.

hausa: Ka tuna da ni saboda wannan, ya Allahna, kuma kada ka shafe abin da na yi da aminci domin gidan Allahna da kuma hidimarsa.
english: Remember me, my God, concerning this, and don’t wipe out my good deeds that I have done for the house of my God, and for its observances.

hausa: Muryar Allah tana tsawatawa a hanyoyi masu ban al’ajabi; yana yin manyan abubuwa waɗanda sun wuce ganewarmu.
english: God thunders marvelously with his voice. He does great things, which we can’t comprehend.

hausa: Gama kamar yadda yake a kwanakin da aka ci Midiyan da yaƙi, kuka ji tsoro nauyin da ya nawaita musu, sandar da yake a kafaɗunsu, sandar masu zaluncinsu.
english: For the yoke of his burden, and the staff of his shoulder, the rod of his oppressor, you have broken as in the day of Midian.

hausa: Gara a ci abincin kayan ganye inda akwai ƙauna da a ci kiwotaccen saniya inda ƙiyayya take.
english: Better is a dinner of herbs, where love is, than a fattened calf with hatred.

hausa: Shugaban rundunar sojojin Ubangiji ya amsa ya ce, “Ka cire takalmanka, gama wurin da kake tsaye, mai tsarki ne.” Sai Yoshuwa ya cire takalmansa.
english: The prince of Yahweh’s army said to Joshua, “Take off your sandals, for the place on which you stand is holy.” Joshua did so.

hausa: Mugaye ba su san gaskiya ba, amma waɗanda suke neman Ubangiji sun santa sosai.
english: Evil men don’t understand justice; but those who seek Yahweh understand it fully.

hausa: Ga abin da Ubangiji ya ce, “Saboda zunubai uku na Isra’ila, har guda huɗu ma, ba zan fasa hukunta su ba. Don sun sayar da adalai waɗanda suka kāsa biyan bashinsu. Sun kuma sayar da matalauta waɗanda bashinsu bai ma kai ko kuɗin bi-labi ba.
english: Yahweh says: “For three transgressions of Israel, yes, for four, I will not turn away its punishment, because they have sold the righteous for silver, and the needy for a pair of sandals;

hausa: Amma in ba a sami ɓarawon ba, sai wanda aka yi ajiyar a gidansa, yă bayyana a gaban alƙalai a bincika ko yana da hannu a kan kayan maƙwabcinsa.
english: If the thief isn’t found, then the master of the house shall come near to God, to find out whether or not he has put his hand on his neighbor’s goods.

hausa: Neziya da Hatifa.
english: the children of Neziah, the children of Hatipha.

hausa: Suka tuɓe ta tsirara, suka kwashe ’ya’yanta maza da mata suka kuma kashe ta da takobi. Ta kuwa zama abin karin magana a cikin mata, aka kuma yi mata hukunci.
english: These uncovered her nakedness. They took her sons and her daughters, and they killed her with the sword. She became a byword among women; for they executed judgments on her.

hausa: “Saboda haka ga abin da Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka yana cewa da yake kin manta da ni kika tura ni bayanki, dole ki sha sakamakon marmarinki da karuwancinki.”
english: “Therefore the Lord Yahweh says: ‘Because you have forgotten me and cast me behind your back, therefore you also bear your lewdness and your prostitution.’”

hausa: “Har yanzu kuma duk abin da aka keɓe daga kyautai na dukan hadayun kaɗawa na Isra’ilawa naka ne. Na ba da wannan gare ka da ’ya’yanka maza da mata, a kowane lokaci. Kowa da yake da tsarki a gidanka zai iya ci.
english: “This is yours, too: the wave offering of their gift, even all the wave offerings of the children of Israel. I have given them to you, and to your sons and to your daughters with you, as a portion forever. Everyone who is clean in your house shall eat of it.

hausa: “Sai yunwa ta auko wa dukan Masar da Kan’ana, ta kawo wahala mai tsanani, kakanninmu ba su iya samun abinci ba.
english: Now a famine came over all the land of Egypt and Canaan, and great affliction. Our fathers found no food.

hausa: Ga abin da Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka ya nuna mini. Ubangiji ya nuna mini kwandon nunannun ’ya’yan itace.
english: Thus the Lord Yahweh showed me: behold, a basket of summer fruit.

hausa: Sai mutumin ya kawo ni ƙofar da take fuskantar gabas,
english: Afterward he brought me to the gate, even the gate that looks toward the east.

hausa: Wani mutum ya zo wurin Eli ya ce masa, “Ga abin da Ubangiji ya ce, ‘Ashe ban bayana kaina sosai ga mahaifinka lokacin da yake a Masar a ƙarƙashin Fir’auna ba?
english: A man of God came to Eli and said to him, “Yahweh says, ‘Did I reveal myself to the house of your father when they were in Egypt in bondage to Pharaoh’s house?

hausa: Shekaru arba’in, shekara ɗaya a madadi kwana ɗaya cikin kwanakin arba’in da kuka ɗauka kuka leƙi asirin ƙasa, za ku sha wahala saboda zunubanku, ku kuma san abin da ake nufi da sa ni in yi gāba da ku.’
english: After the number of the days in which you spied out the land, even forty days, for every day a year, you will bear your iniquities, even forty years, and you will know my alienation.’

hausa: “ ‘Mutanen Yahuda sun yi mugunta a gabana, in ji Ubangiji. Sun kafa gumakansu masu banƙyama a gidan da ake kira da Sunana suka ƙazantar da shi.
english: “For the children of Judah have done that which is evil in my sight,” says Yahweh. “They have set their abominations in the house which is called by my name, to defile it.

hausa: Ko zai yi gardama da maganganun wofi maganganu marasa amfani?
english: Should he reason with unprofitable talk, or with speeches with which he can do no good?

hausa: Amma Allah ya tuna da Nuhu da dukan namun jeji da dabbobin da suke tare da shi a cikin jirgi, ya kuma aika da wata iska ta hura dukan duniya, ruwan kuwa ya janye.
english: God remembered Noah, all the animals, and all the livestock that were with him in the ship; and God made a wind to pass over the earth. The waters subsided.

hausa: Sai saurayin nan, annabi, ya tafi Ramot Gileyad.
english: So the young man, the young prophet, went to Ramoth Gilead.

hausa: “Ban haka ma, ka faɗa wa gidan sarauta na Yahuda cewa, ‘Ku saurari maganar Ubangiji;
english: “Concerning the house of the king of Judah, hear Yahweh’s word:

hausa: “Sa’ad da sammai sun kulle, babu kuma ruwan sama domin mutane sun yi maka zunubi, sa’ad da suka yi addu’a suna fuskantar wannan wuri, suka kuma furta sunanka, suka juye daga zunubinsu domin ka hore su,
english: “When the sky is shut up and there is no rain because they have sinned against you, if they pray toward this place and confess your name, and turn from their sin when you afflict them,

hausa: In fadawa suka ji cewa na yi magana da kai, suka kuma zo wurinka suka ce, ‘Faɗa mana abin da ka faɗa wa sarki da kuma abin da sarki ya faɗa maka; kada ka ɓoye mana, in ba haka za mu kashe ka,’
english: But if the princes hear that I have talked with you, and they come to you, and tell you, ‘Declare to us now what you have said to the king; don’t hide it from us, and we will not put you to death; also tell us what the king said to you;’

hausa: gama ya farfashe ƙofofin tagulla ya kuma ragargaza ƙyamaren ƙarfe.
english: For he has broken the gates of bronze, and cut through bars of iron.

hausa: “Kun kawo mini hadayu da sadakoki shekaru arba’in a cikin jeji, ya ku gidan Isra’ila?
english: “Did you bring to me sacrifices and offerings in the wilderness forty years, house of Israel?

hausa: Ya kamata ka nemi manyan abubuwa wa kanka? Kada ka neme su. Gama zan aukar da masifa a kan dukan mutane, in ji Ubangiji, amma duk inda ka tafi zan bar ka ka kuɓutar da ranka.’ ”
english: Do you seek great things for yourself? Don’t seek them; for, behold, I will bring evil on all flesh,’ says Yahweh, ‘but I will let you escape with your life wherever you go.’”

hausa: ko kuwa a wannan lokaci zan aika da cikakkiyar annoba mai ƙarfi a kanka da a kan fadawanka da mutanenka, domin ka san cewa ba kama da ni a dukan duniya.
english: For this time I will send all my plagues against your heart, against your officials, and against your people; that you may know that there is no one like me in all the earth.

hausa: kwaɗayi, ƙeta, ruɗu, ƙazantaccen sha’awa, kishi, ɓata suna, girman kai da kuma wauta.
english: covetings, wickedness, deceit, lustful desires, an evil eye, blasphemy, pride, and foolishness.

hausa: Ƙarshen abubuwa duka ya yi kusa. Saboda haka ku kasance masu tunani mai kyau da masu kamunkai don ku iya yin addu’a.
english: But the end of all things is near. Therefore be of sound mind, self-controlled, and sober in prayer.

hausa: Cikin Lawiyawa, akwai Yozabad, Shimeyi, Kelaya (wato, Kelita), Fetahahiya, Yahuda, Eliyezer.
english: Of the Levites: Jozabad, Shimei, Kelaiah (also called Kelita), Pethahiah, Judah, and Eliezer.

hausa: Sa’ad da yake aiki a arewa, ba ni ganinsa; sa’ad da ya juya zuwa kudu, ba na ganinsa.
english: He works to the north, but I can’t see him. He turns south, but I can’t catch a glimpse of him.

hausa: Sa’an nan za ku sani ina cikin Isra’ila, cewa ni ne Ubangiji Allahnku, babu wani kuma; mutanena ba za su ƙara shan kunya ba.
english: You will know that I am among Israel, and that I am Yahweh, your God, and there is no one else; and my people will never again be disappointed.

hausa: An bar su domin su gwada Isra’ilawa a ga ko za su yi biyayya da umarnin Ubangiji, wanda ya ba wa kakanninsu ta wurin Musa.
english: They were left to test Israel by them, to know whether they would listen to Yahweh’s commandments, which he commanded their fathers by Moses.

hausa: Gama maganar Ubangiji daidai ne da kuma gaskiya; yana da aminci cikin kome da yake yi.
english: For Yahweh’s word is right. All his work is done in faithfulness.

hausa: Ina kwatanta ke ƙaunatacciyata, da goɗiya mai jan keken yaƙin kayan Fir’auna.
english: I have compared you, my love, to a steed in Pharaoh’s chariots.

hausa: A wannan rana Yoshuwa ya yi alkawari saboda mutanen, kuma a can Shekem ya tsara musu ƙa’idodi da dokoki.
english: So Joshua made a covenant with the people that day, and made for them a statute and an ordinance in Shechem.

hausa: “Dukan maƙiyanmu suna ta yin mana magana marar daɗi.
english: “All our enemies have opened their mouth wide against us.

hausa: Ben-Hadad ya yarda da maganar Sarki Asa, ya kuma aika shugabannin sojojin mayaƙansa ya yi yaƙi da garuruwan Isra’ila. Ya kame Iyon, Dan, Abel-Bet-Ma’aka da dukan Kinneret, haɗe da Naftali.
english: Ben Hadad listened to King Asa, and sent the captains of his armies against the cities of Israel, and struck Ijon, and Dan, and Abel Beth Maacah, and all Chinneroth, with all the land of Naphtali.

hausa: Da jin kalmominsa, waɗansu mutane suka ce, “Ba shakka, mutumin nan shi ne Annabin.”
english: Many of the multitude therefore, when they heard these words, said, “This is truly the prophet.”

hausa: ka karɓi shekel biyar domin kowannensu, bisa ga ma’aunin shekel na tsattsarkan wuri, wanda yake da nauyin gera ashirin.
english: you shall take five shekels apiece for each one; according to the shekel of the sanctuary you shall take them (the shekel is twenty gerahs);

hausa: Ya ƙara da cewa, “Wace hanya za mu bi?” Sai Yoram ya amsa ya ce, “Ta hanyar jejin Edom.”
english: Then he said, “Which way shall we go up?” Jehoram answered, “The way of the wilderness of Edom.”

hausa: In an riga an yi wa mutum kaciya sa’ad da aka kira shi, to, kada yă zama marar kaciya. In an kira mutum sa’ad da yake marar kaciya, to, kada a yi masa kaciya.
english: Was anyone called having been circumcised? Let him not become uncircumcised. Has anyone been called in uncircumcision? Let him not be circumcised.

hausa: Kada ku harare ni domin ni baƙa ce, gama rana ta dafa ni na yi baƙa. ’Ya’yan mahaifiyata maza sun yi fushi da ni suka sa ni aiki a gonakin inabi; na ƙyale gonar inabi na kaina.
english: Don’t stare at me because I am dark, because the sun has scorched me. My mother’s sons were angry with me. They made me keeper of the vineyards. I haven’t kept my own vineyard.

hausa: Da suka dawo wurin sauran almajiran, sai suka ga babban taro kewaye da su, malaman dokoki suna gardama da su.
english: Coming to the disciples, he saw a great multitude around them, and scribes questioning them.

hausa: Gama abin da Maɗaukaki da kuma Mai daraja ya faɗa wanda yake raye har abada, wanda sunansa mai tsarki ne, “Ina zama a bisa da kuma a tsattsarkan wuri, amma kuma tare da shi wanda yake mai halin tuba mai tawali’u a ruhu, don in farfaɗo da ruhu mai tawali’u in kuma farfaɗo da zuciyar mai halin tuba.
english: For the high and lofty One who inhabits eternity, whose name is Holy, says: “I dwell in the high and holy place, with him also who is of a contrite and humble spirit, to revive the spirit of the humble, and to revive the heart of the contrite.

hausa: Har yanzu maganar Ubangiji ta zo gare ni cewa,
english: Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

hausa: Ku yi rawar jiki a gabansa, ya ku duniya duka! Duniya ta kahu sosai; ba za tă jijjigu ba.
english: Tremble before him, all the earth. The world also is established that it can’t be moved.

hausa: sa’ad da dukan Isra’ila suka zo, don su bayyana a gaban Ubangiji Allahnku, a wurin da zai zaɓa, za ku karanta wannan doka a gabansu, a kunnuwansu.
english: when all Israel has come to appear before Yahweh your God in the place which he will choose, you shall read this law before all Israel in their hearing.

hausa: Sa’an nan firist zai ɗiba hatsi na hadaya cike da hannunsa don hadayar tunawa, yă kuma ƙone a bagade; bayan haka sai yă sa macen tă sha ruwan.
english: The priest shall take a handful of the meal offering, as its memorial portion, and burn it on the altar, and afterward shall make the woman drink the water.

hausa: Waɗanda suke zuriyar Isra’ilawa suka ware kansu daga dukan baƙi. Suka tsaya, suka kuma furta zunubansu da muguntar kakanninsu.
english: The offspring of Israel separated themselves from all foreigners and stood and confessed their sins and the iniquities of their fathers.

hausa: Ba abin mamaki ba ne, gama Shaiɗan kansa ma yana ɓad da kamanni kamar shi mala’ikan haske ne.
english: And no wonder, for even Satan masquerades as an angel of light.

hausa: ƙasa inda abinci ba zai yi ƙaranci ba, ba kuma za ku rasa kome ba; ƙasa ce inda ƙarfe ne duwatsunta, ana kuma haƙar tagulla a tuddanta.
english: a land in which you shall eat bread without scarcity, you shall not lack anything in it; a land whose stones are iron, and out of whose hills you may dig copper.

hausa: Amma ba da ni Ayuba ya yi gardama ba kuma ba zan amsa masa da irin amsarku ba.
english: for he has not directed his words against me; neither will I answer him with your speeches.

hausa: A rana ta uku, Esta ta sanya rigunanta na sarauta, ta tafi ta tsaya a harabar fada, a gaban zaure sarki. Sarki yana zaune a kan gadon sarautarsa a zauren, yana fuskantar ƙofar shiga.
english: Now on the third day, Esther put on her royal clothing and stood in the inner court of the king’s house, next to the king’s house. The king sat on his royal throne in the royal house, next to the entrance of the house.

hausa: wanda yake hidima a cikin wuri mai tsarki, tabanakul na gaskiya wanda Ubangiji ne ya kafa, ba mutum ba.
english: a servant of the sanctuary and of the true tabernacle which the Lord pitched, not man.

hausa: Mace tana haɗe da mijinta muddin yana da rai. Amma in mijinta ya mutu, tana da ’yanci ta auri wanda take so. Amma fa, sai mai bin Ubangiji.
english: A wife is bound by law for as long as her husband lives; but if the husband is dead, she is free to be married to whomever she desires, only in the Lord.

hausa: Cikin taron tsarkaka Allah ne aka fi tsoro; shi ne mafi bantsoro fiye da dukan waɗanda suka kewaye shi.
english: a very awesome God in the council of the holy ones, to be feared above all those who are around him?

hausa: In kuka dawo wurin Ubangiji, sa’an nan waɗanda suka kama ’yan’uwanku da ’ya’yanku za su nuna musu tausayi, su kuma dawo wannan ƙasa, gama Ubangiji Allahnku mai alheri ne mai jinƙai kuma. Ba zai kau da fuskarsa daga gare ku ba, in kuka dawo gare shi.”
english: For if you turn again to Yahweh, your brothers and your children will find compassion with those who led them captive, and will come again into this land, because Yahweh your God is gracious and merciful, and will not turn away his face from you if you return to him.”

hausa: A maimakon haka, za su bauta wa Ubangiji Allahnsu Dawuda sarkinsu kuwa, wanda na tayar musu.
english: but they will serve Yahweh their God, and David their king, whom I will raise up to them.

hausa: Manyan firistoci suka ɗauki kuɗin, suka ce, “Doka ta hana a sa kuɗin a cikin ma’aji, da yake kuɗin jini ne.”
english: The chief priests took the pieces of silver and said, “It’s not lawful to put them into the treasury, since it is the price of blood.”

hausa: Ba ni da laifi a gabansa na kiyaye kaina daga yin zunubi.
english: I was also perfect toward him. I kept myself from my iniquity.

hausa: Duk mai ƙulla mugunta za a ɗauka shi mai kuta hargitsi ne.
english: One who plots to do evil will be called a schemer.

hausa: Dattawan Yabesh suka ce masa, “Ka ba mu kwana bakwai don mu aika manzanni a dukan ƙasar Isra’ila idan ba mu sami wanda zai cece mu ba, za mu ba da kanmu gare ka.”
english: The elders of Jabesh said to him, “Give us seven days, that we may send messengers to all the borders of Israel; and then, if there is no one to save us, we will come out to you.”

hausa: “Amma kaitonku da kuke da arziki, gama kun riga kun sami ta’aziyyarku.
english: “But woe to you who are rich! For you have received your consolation.

hausa: Sai Yowab ya busa ƙaho, dukan mutane kuwa suka tsaya; suka daina fafaran Isra’ila. Nan take faɗan ya tsaya.
english: So Joab blew the trumpet; and all the people stood still and pursued Israel no more, and they fought no more.

hausa: Ko da yake Ubangiji yakan ba da abincin azaba da ruwan wahala, ba za a ƙara ɓoye malamanku ba; da idanunku za ku gan su.
english: Though the Lord may give you the bread of adversity and the water of affliction, yet your teachers won’t be hidden any more, but your eyes will see your teachers;

hausa: Suka manta da Allahn da ya cece su, wanda ya aikata manyan abubuwa a Masar,
english: They forgot God, their Savior, who had done great things in Egypt,

hausa: Barnabas ya so Yohanna, wanda ake kira Markus ya tafi tare da su,
english: Barnabas planned to take John, who was called Mark, with them also.

hausa: “Sai mahaifin ya tafi waje na biyun ya faɗa masa iri magana guda. Sai ya amsa ya ce, ‘Zan tafi, ranka yă daɗe,’ amma bai tafi ba.
english: He came to the second, and said the same thing. He answered, ‘I’m going, sir,’ but he didn’t go.

hausa: Sa’ad da suka roƙe shi ya ƙara ’yan kwanaki da su, bai yarda ba.
english: When they asked him to stay with them a longer time, he declined;

hausa: Yoshuwa ya ƙwace masarautun nan duka ya kuma kashe sarakunansu da takobi, ya hallakar da su ƙaƙaf kamar yadda Musa bawan Ubangiji ya umarta.
english: Joshua captured all the cities of those kings, with their kings, and he struck them with the edge of the sword, and utterly destroyed them, as Moses the servant of Yahweh commanded.

hausa: Amma ina gaya muku, duk wanda ya yi fushi da ɗan’uwansa, za a hukunta shi. Kuma duk wanda ya ce wa ɗan’uwansa ‘Raka,’za a kai shi gaban Majalisa. Amma duk wanda ya ce, ‘Kai wawa!’ Zai kasance a hatsarin shiga jahannama ta wuta.
english: But I tell you that everyone who is angry with his brother without a cause will be in danger of the judgment. Whoever says to his brother, ‘Raca!’ will be in danger of the council. Whoever says, ‘You fool!’ will be in danger of the fire of Gehenna.

hausa: yana da tumaki dubu bakwai, raƙuma dubu uku, shanu ɗari biyar, da jakuna ɗari biyar, yana kuma da masu yi masa aiki da yawa. A ƙasar Gabas ba wani kamar sa.
english: His possessions also were seven thousand sheep, three thousand camels, five hundred yoke of oxen, five hundred female donkeys, and a very great household; so that this man was the greatest of all the children of the east.

hausa: Da Bitrus ya gan shi sai ya ce, “Ubangiji, wannan fa?”
english: Peter, seeing him, said to Jesus, “Lord, what about this man?”

hausa: kuma kowane mai gini ya ɗaura takobinsa a gefe yayinda yake aiki. Amma mutum mai busa ƙaho ya kasance tare da ni.
english: Among the builders, everyone wore his sword at his side, and so built. He who sounded the trumpet was by me.

hausa: Alkawaran nan fa ga Ibrahim ne aka faɗa da kuma wani zuriyarsa. Nassi bai ce, “da zuriyoyi ba” wanda ya nuna kamar mutane da yawa, amma “ga zuriyarka,” wanda yake nufin mutum ɗaya, wanda shi ne Kiristi.
english: Now the promises were spoken to Abraham and to his offspring. He doesn’t say, “To descendants”, as of many, but as of one, “To your offspring”, which is Christ.

hausa: Sa’an nan daga bakinsa macijin ya kwarara ruwa kamar kogi, don ruwan ya cimma matan yă kuma kwashe ta tare da ambaliya.
english: The serpent spewed water out of his mouth after the woman like a river, that he might cause her to be carried away by the stream.

hausa: Na kira ga Ubangiji, wanda ya cancanci yabo, na kuwa kuɓuta daga abokan gābana.
english: I call on Yahweh, who is worthy to be praised; and I am saved from my enemies.

hausa: Kullum nakan gode wa Allahna sa’ad da nake tuna da kai cikin addu’o’ina,
english: I thank my God always, making mention of you in my prayers,

hausa: Duk wanda ya taɓa wani abin da ta zauna a kai, dole yă wanke rigunansa yă kuma yi wanka, zai kuma ƙazantu har yamma.
english: Whoever touches anything that she sits on shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening.

hausa: Ni, Daniyel, kaɗai ne na ga wahayin; mutanen da suke tare da ni ba su gani ba, amma wata irin babbar razana ta auko musu har suka gudu suka ɓuya.
english: I, Daniel, alone saw the vision, for the men who were with me didn’t see the vision, but a great quaking fell on them, and they fled to hide themselves.

hausa: Ya kai gari cike da hayaniya, Ya ke birnin tashin hankali da alkarya mai murna? Mutanenki ba su mutu ta wurin takobi ba, ba kuwa za su mutu a yaƙi ba.
english: You that are full of shouting, a tumultuous city, a joyous town, your slain are not slain with the sword, neither are they dead in battle.

hausa: Lokacin da Yoshuwa da dukan Isra’ilawa suka ga waɗanda suka yi kwanto sun ci birnin da yaƙi, hayaƙi kuwa ya cika birnin, sai suka juya suka kai wa mutanen Ai hari.
english: When Joshua and all Israel saw that the ambush had taken the city, and that the smoke of the city ascended, then they turned back and killed the men of Ai.

hausa: Sa’ad da masu hawan dawakai suka isa Kaisariya, sai suka ba wa gwamna wasiƙar suka kuma miƙa masa Bulus.
english: When they came to Caesarea and delivered the letter to the governor, they also presented Paul to him.

hausa: Za ku haifi ’ya’ya maza da mata, amma za su zama naku ba, domin za a kai su bauta.
english: You will father sons and daughters, but they will not be yours, for they will go into captivity.

hausa: A rubuce yake cewa, “ ‘Muddin ina raye,’ in ji Ubangiji, ‘kowace gwiwa za tă durƙusa a gabana; kowane harshe kuma zai furta wa Allah.’ ”
english: For it is written, “‘As I live,’ says the Lord, ‘to me every knee will bow. Every tongue will confess to God.’”

hausa: Daga mutanen Izhar, Shelomot; daga ’ya’yan Shelomot maza, Yahat.
english: Of the Izharites, Shelomoth; of the sons of Shelomoth, Jahath.

hausa: Sa’an nan ku kira bisa sunan allahnku, ni kuwa zan kira bisa sunan Ubangiji. Duk allahn da ya amsa ta wurin wuta, shi ne Allah.” Sai dukan jama’a suka ce, “Abin nan da faɗa yana da kyau.”
english: You call on the name of your god, and I will call on Yahweh’s name. The God who answers by fire, let him be God.” All the people answered, “What you say is good.”

hausa: Zan ci gaba da adalcina, ba zan fasa ba; lamirina ba zai taɓa yashe ni ba, dukan kwanakin raina.
english: I hold fast to my righteousness, and will not let it go. My heart will not reproach me so long as I live.

hausa: Musa ya sa teburin a Tentin Sujada, a gefen arewa na tabanakul waje da labulen.
english: He put the table in the Tent of Meeting, on the north side of the tabernacle, outside of the veil.

hausa: Gama ni kaina, mutum ne a ƙarƙashin iko, akwai kuma sojoji a ƙarƙashin ikona. Nakan ce wa wannan, ‘Je ka,’ sai yă tafi, ga wani kuma in ce, ‘Zo nan,’ sai yă zo. Nakan kuma ce wa bawana, ‘Yi abu kaza,’ sai yă yi.”
english: For I also am a man placed under authority, having under myself soldiers. I tell this one, ‘Go!’ and he goes; and to another, ‘Come!’ and he comes; and to my servant, ‘Do this,’ and he does it.”

hausa: Mahaliccin sama da ƙasa, teku, da kome da yake cikinsu, Ubangiji, wanda yake mai aminci har abada.
english: who made heaven and earth, the sea, and all that is in them; who keeps truth forever;

hausa: Amma ya ce, “Ɗan’uwanka ya zo da makirci ya karɓi albarkarka.”
english: He said, “Your brother came with deceit, and has taken away your blessing.”
